Title: Error While Posting a Revaluation of a Fixed Assed: 'Asset AAA val.view ABC: Postings related to current year is not permitted as total acquisition costs posted into the current year is zero'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a revaluation of a Fixed Asset and receive some error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the respective Fixed Asset.-Click Manual Posting -> Revaluation.-Enter the relevant information.-Click Simulate.-Here you can see the below error messages:-'An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset AAA'-'Asset AAA val.view ABC: Postings related to current year is not permitted as total acquisition costs posted into the current year is zero'-'Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated'-Cause-The reason why system is raising the errors is that the "Related To" field was maintained as "1 - Current Year" and the total Acquisition Posted to the current year is zero.-You can check the Acquisition Posted using as follows:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Fixed Asset ABC.-Click Edit -> Values.-Show the current Fiscal Year.-The Posted Amount for the current Fiscal Year is zero.-Resolution-The Revaluation can be successfully simulated and posted by changing the "Related To" field to "2 - Previous Years".-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Revaluation.

Title: No Time Model Available for Mapping in Migration of Time and Labor Management Data
Content: Symptom-During the migration of Time and Labor Data, no time model is available for selection inside the Value Mapping task for Time Model.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Enter Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview view, search for the activity Migration of Employee Data.-Enter the respective activity for the employee country.-Enter the sub activity Migrate time and Labor management data using the migration tool.-Select a template from the staging are, and click on Execute Migration -> Step by Step.-Proceed to the step 2 - Mapping.-Select the task for Time Model mapping.-When clicking on the value help for a source value, no time model is displayed for selection.-Cause-For the migration of Labor Management data, only Schedule type models are supported, so daily and period models are not available for mapping.-To make the schedule models available, you must have selected them in the project scope, and also you must have configured the schedule models in the Time Administration work center before you migrate time and labor management data.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Time data, migration workbench

Title: Depreciation Due Too Early for Migrated Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You migrate a Fixed Asset, using the Extended Fixed Asset Migration template, into your SAP ByDesign system. -The Capitalization date of the Fixed asset is maintained in a previous Fiscal Year YYYY (YYYY represents any previous Fiscal Year).-The Migration Posting date is defined in period B of Fiscal Year ZZZZ (ZZZZ represents the current Fiscal Year; B represents an Accounting Period in Fiscal Year ZZZZ).-When checking the Fixed Asset values you notice that Depreciation amounts are calculated already with the first period, period A, of the current fiscal year ZZZZ.-You expect the depreciation to start only from period B.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Show All Fixed Assets and search XXX (XXX represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Press Edit and choose Values.-Select the relevant Set of Books and Valuation View.-Go to the Depreciation Overview sub-tab.-Here you notice the Depreciation amounts starting from accounting period A in Fiscal Year ZZZZ. You expected depreciation to only start from accounting period B, the period of the Migration Posting date.-Cause-The Asset Valuation date of Fixed XXX is the first day of the current fiscal Year ZZZZ in period A:-The Fixed Asset was posted with Movement Category Migration of Accumulated Values (Current Year) and Line Item type Historical Cost.-Historical cost is the cost of the asset carried over from the capitalization year of the fixed asset.-The Line Item type determines the Asset Valuation Date which defines from when depreciation is to be calculated for that amount.-If the migration movement category code used for the posting is Migration of Accumulated Values (Current Year) and the Line Item Type is Historical Cost, the Asset Valuation date is then derived to be the start date of Fiscal Year ZZZZ calculating the depreciation due since the first date of the Migration Fiscal year (period A), rather than calculating from the period of the migration Posting Date (period B).-In the Fixed Asset, you can find the Asset Valuation Date as follows:-In the Fixed Asset's Values tab (as above) select the corresponding Set of Books and Valuation View.-From here navigate to the Journal sub-tab.-Enter the Personalization Mode.-Here you can add the Asset Valuation Date field to the screen. Here you notice system used a different Asset Valuation Date instead of the Valuation Date and Posting Date you maintained in the Asset Posting Lines tab of the Extended Migration template.-Resolution-In general, the system behavior is as expected, as long as the acquisition cost really is a Historical Cost.-If you do not want any historical costs of previous fiscal years to be considered for migrated fixed assets use Line Item Type Historical Costs: Current Year. The Capitalization date of the Fixed Asset then needs to  be any date in the Migration Fiscal Year, earlier than the Migration Posting Date.-Keywords-Depreciation starting too early, Migrated Fixed Asset

Title: "Unexpected error on period-dependent action" When Previewing Data Source Fixed Assets Account Balances
Content: Symptom-When trying to preview the data source Fixed Assets Account Balances [FINFXAU05], you receive the following error messages:-"Unexpected error on period-dependent action.-Unexpected error occurred.-An exception with the type CM_MDRS_MDAV_FAILED occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause."-Eventually, the error message "FSP_FINFXA003" can also be displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Go to work center view Design Data Sources.-Search for data source Fixed Assets Account Balances.-Click on Preview button to open the data source in preview mode.-The error messages are displayed, and you are unable to see data on the data source preview.-Cause-The data source is being previewed without providing the mandatory selection parameters, which are mandatory, thereby causing the error messages to be displayed. This is the expected behavior since data source Fixed Assets Account Balances - as well as many other Financials data sources - has mandatory fields (fields that require to be filled in the Selection pane of data source / report preview).-Resolution-Please make sure to apply valid filter values into the following fields on the Selection pane:-Company-Set of Books-Accounting Period/Year-Note: If you open the standard report "Fixed Assets - Trial Balance [FINFXAU05_Q0001]", the mandatory fields will be highlighted with an red asterisk in the report Selection pane, which will help you identify which fields have to be filled in the data source preview. You can use this to help in the preview of other data sources, as long as they have a standard report available in the system.-See Also-1632044 - Errors returned with a Custom Financial report - Fiscal Year variant missing-Keywords-FINFXAU05;Fixed Assets Account Balances;Data Source Error;Unexpected error Data Source;period-dependent action;

Title: Excel Add-In Disabled
Content: Symptom-Everytime you start or restart the Microsoft Excel the Cloud for Customer/Business ByDesign Add-In gets disabled.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Business ByDesign-Cause-Microsoft Office imposes strict time limits for add-ins and this includes 1000 ms for loading, 500 ms for folder switch and for shutdown. If the add-in exceeds this time limit, then Office disables the add-in.-Resolution-Enable the Add-in in the disabled items:-Go to File menu and click on Option.-Select Add-ins in the left menu.--Now, on the drop-down select Disabled Items and click on Go button.-Select the Add-in in the list and click on Enable.---  If, after these steps the add-in is not showing in the ribbon, follow the next steps:-Go to File menu and click on Option.-Select Add-ins in the left menu.--Now, on the drop-down select COM Add-ins and click on Go button.-Select the Add-in in the list and click on the check-box to enable it.-- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-See Also-FAQs – SAP Excel Add-in for C4C/ByD-Keywords-Excel Add-In; disabled;

Title: When Entering Tax Number for Supplier Error Message Appears 'Tax number is invalid'
Content: Symptom-You are maintaining data for taxes for a supplier master data. When entering the Tax Number NIF, the system throws an error 'Tax number is invalid' and you cannot add the new row.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Open Supplier master data.-Click on View All.-Go to the Financial Data tab.-Go to the Tax Data sub-tab.-Under Tax Number session, press Add Row.-You enter the NIF details.-When you press save, the error message 'Tax number is invalid' appears.-Cause-The error happens due to the format of the number entered.-The expected format is 9 characters, where the first 8 characters are to be numeric and the last one is to be alphabetic.-Resolution-Check the NIF number and provide the number according to the format expected.-Keywords-NIF. Tax Number. Supplier.

Title: All the users are locked in the tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-[INTERNAL USE ONLY]-All the users are locked and no one can access the system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer, SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator work center.-Go to Users view.-Go to Business users.-                                    Resolution-As all the users are locked, no one from customer end can access the system. To unlock the user we need an incident raised by customer, may it be Call from Customer or Customer incident.-Please follow the below guidelines:-Login to the tenant, if all the users are locked then please drop an email to the IT Contact which can be checked under Service Control Center work center asking which user needs to be unlocked [The user must be a Key user].-Once you have the permission to unlock and reset the password , please send the credentials to IT contact.-If the customer does not have any IT contact. Kindly reach out to CEE/CSM/ Sales representatives to add the IT contact details. Without a valid IT contact we can't unlock and reset the password.-Note: We will only unlock one Key user.-Keywords-All the users are locked, User locked, password reset, Key user, Admin, password, credentials, IT contact.-user locked,reset password

Title: Create New Country Version Error
Content: Symptom-You want to create  New Country Version in Business configuration (for Nigeria). On action Save, you have the error message:-Save failed-Change or delete duplicate row with key '0' " 'NGN' '0' 'ZXXX' in 'Expense Report Review and Approval Scenario'-Nigeria is an example.-NGN is the currency.-ZXXX is the country version ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Show All Configuration Elements and search for the activity: Create new country version.-On the Create new country version page, fill in the field--Country Version (ID): ZXXX (ZXXX stands for the ID of the country version).--Description:--Country: Nigeria.-Select Create.-Select Save.-Error message:-Save failed-Change or delete duplicate row with key '0' " 'NGN' '0' 'ZXXX' in 'Expense Report Review and Approval Scenario'-Cause-You have made some entries in Fine Tuning in your system that does not exist in standard and that are not required.-To see these Fine Tuning entries, follow the bellow steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the overview view.-Search and open  the activity: Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management.-Select Edit audit and approval scenarios-In the column Country Version, we have a standard "XX01 - Settlement for generic country version" with currency EUR - Euro.-You have made another entry for "XX01 - Settlement for generic country version" with currency as for example USD-US Dollar or GBP-Pound Sterling or NGN-Naira.-Resolution-Only the standard country version that is "XX01 - Settlement for generic country version" with currency EUR - Euro should be available with other standard country settlement.-Delete the entry you have made for "XX01 - Settlement for generic country version" with currency as for example USD-US Dollar or GBP-Pound Sterling or NGN-Naira.-After deletion of the entry, select 'Save and Close' and create the new country version for the country (Nigeria) again.-Keywords-New Country Version, Expense Report Review and Approval Scenario.

Title: Missing Documents on Business Communication Monitoring View
Content: Symptom-When you try check the XML sent out on Business Communication Monitoring Output, the XML archive does not appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Checking the Invoice--1. Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-2. Select the Invoice Document view.-3. Search for the Invoice Document ID: ABC (ABC represents your Invoice Document ID).-4. Click on Edit button and View All button.-5. Navigate to the Output History tab.--Note that there is a XML archive which has been sent out to your customer. The status is successful.--1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Select the view Business Communication Monitoring.-3. Search for the Business Document: Customer Invoice.-The query will retireve the Invoice ID DEF (DEF represents your Invoice Document ID) as last number, but the customer number is ABC, it means that there is a gap on the view.-Cause-As the message was successful so it will have default retention time of 62 days, after that it won't be shown on Business Communication Monitoring view.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Business Communication Monitoring; Customer Invoicing; Application and User Management;

Title: Open Items Receivable was Migrated to a Different Business Partner From The Migration File
Content: Symptom-After migrating Open Items Receivable and when checking the migration postings there are different Business Partner IDs showing for the entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center General Ledger.-Go to view Reports.-Go to subview List.-Find and open Accounts Receivable - Open Items report.-Enter selection:-Journal Entry Type: 00079-Document Type: 1-Click Apply.-Check Document Number ID from the migrated file, the Business Partner ID is XYZ while the expected one was ABC, the one showing in the file.-XYZ and ABC are example of Business Partner IDs.-Cause-When migrating Customers a Value Conversion file was used in Customer Migration activity.-This file contains the From/To logic that the system uses when migrating Open Items Receivable as well.-Hence when the ID ABC was entered in the migration file the system changed it to XYZ due to the From/To logic.-Resolution-System is working as designed logic.-Keywords-Open Items Receivable, Migration, Business Partner, Conversion, ID

Title: Italy: VAT to be Paid Less Than 25.82€
Content: Symptom-For month MM (MM is the month), you have less than 25.82€ to pay as VAT to tax authority.-According to Italian tax rules, if the amount to be paid on the VAT summary of a month MM is less than 25.82€, then the amount to be paid could be reported in the next VAT Return for month MM+1 (MM+1 is the next month).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You do not see an option to postpone the payment of the VAT return to the next month.-Resolution-This option is currently not available in SAP Business ByDesign system.- -The carryforward of payment of taxes into the next month, if the amount is less than 25.82 euro, is just an "option" and "not an obligation".-This is not a frequent scenario (normally companies have to pay higher amounts of taxes) and therefore not planned for future releases.-If you would still like to have this option, then you may register your idea/requirement for this feature in the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum, link available at:-https://www.sap.com/about/customer-involvement/influence-adopt.html-The requirements posted here are taken up by development according to customer demand/ interest.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Italy VAT Reporting

Title: Inconsistency Detected in Material Ledger Account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You get a health check Material Ledger Account Consistency Check with the message Material Ledger Account Consistency Check.- Resolution-There may be 3 cases for which this health check can be raised.-Case 1: This is a false alarm. There was an inconsistency in the past and now it has been corrected. So no manual intervention is required and the incident can be closed.-Case 2: The health check may be raised due to rounding errors. In that case the incident can be closed.-Case 3: The health check may be raised due to some genuine inconsistency. Manual correction is required. Forward the incident to component AP-ACC-MAT.- Case 1: For identifying if this is false alarm, follow the below steps:-1. Run the transaction SE38 in the back end.-2. Run the program FIA_MATLA_BLOODHOUND.-3. Select the Health Check Result Monitor radio button and execute.-4. Double-click on the most recent health check log.-5. This shows all the materials reported by the bloodhound report for inconsistencies in the incident.-6. Run the bloodhound report again with the option Manual Consistency Check.-7. In the parameter screen, give the company, business residence and materials from the result health check run.-8. In the check interval provide current date.-9. Run the report. If the report doesn’t show any error, this means there are no errors existing in the current period and the inconsistencies in the previous periods were already resolved.- Case 2: For identifying if this is a recurring issue, follow the below steps:-1. First follow all the steps described in Case 1.-2. The report shows the inconsistencies present in the system.-Based on the stock quantity and amount, calculate the cost: Cost = Amount / Quantity-3. Get the maintained Inventory Cost from the front end of the system:-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Materials view.-Go to Materials sub-view.-Search and open the material in edit mode.-Select View All and go to Valuation tab.-The cost is maintained here.-4. If the cost obtained from the bloodhound report and the cost maintained in the UI are almost same (for example: 10.90 and 10.91), this is considered as a rounding error and can be ignored.-If the inconsistency is caused by a standard material (VPr = STD), then the cost maintained in the UI should be the same as the cost calculated from the bloodhound result. If these two values are different, then the same cost should be maintained in the UI.-Please note that this should only be done for a standard price material. In case of a moving average material, further analysis should be done.- Case 3: For identifying if this requires back end correction, follow the below steps:-1. Follow the first two steps of Case 1.-2. Select the Fin View with MatLa Check radio button and execute.-3. If there are entries as mentioned in the screenshot, backend correction is needed.-Created by BYDMS-KB-SLM-Keywords

Title: Maintenance Page is Shown While Accessing the URL and at the Bottom the Message vsaXXYZ:' No target system found- myURL'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-While accessing the URL the maintenance page is shown  and at the bottom the message vsa1031: 'No target system found- myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com' (xxxxxx represents the system ID).-Reproducing the Issue-Check for the affected SID and TENANT.-Select the affected URL.-Maintenance page is displayed.-Scroll down in the maintenance page to check the error in the left bottom of the page.-The error message will be displayed as the following: vsa1031:' No target system found- myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com'.-Cause-Cause 1: The DNS manager was not updated with the URL Forward Zone.-Cause 2: The system is added in the web dispatcher cluster but not configured --> No target system found. The Web Dispacther is checking ICM (Internet Communication Manager) of all configured message servers and was not able to find a URL mapping which fits.-Check in Web Dispatcher config file (systems.txt), if the corresponding message server is configured on vsaXXXX (e.g.vsa5229).-grep -i <SID> /usr/sap/WEB/SYS/profile/WEB.PFL --wdisp/system_26 = MSHOST=<HOST.wdf.sap.corp, MSPORT=8101, SID=<SID>, NR=01, SRCVHOST=SYSTEM-Resolution-Solution for Cause1: Add the Forward zone in the DNS manager.-Go to GMP and select Network & Security and then select DNS Manager.-Give the affected URL in Search criteria and select enter, the pop-up appears.-Select the URL and the pop-up appears.-Here give EDIT and add the Forward zone.; above screen shot you have add the appropriate Forward zone and save.-Solution Cause 2: Check the Web Dispatcher config file (systems.txt), if the corresponding message server is configured on vsaXXXX (e.g.vsa5229).-If not, configuration is needed for the message server in the config file.-Example: System KLY URL is not accessing because of no target system found:-Find which prod cluster the system is in (in this case it is in wd-prod-f cluster).-Take any node server and log in (in this case vsa1031).-Check the web dispatcher profile in vsa1031.-vsa1031:~ # grep -i KLY /usr/sap/WEB/SYS/profile/WEB.PFL and found no entry for KLY.-You have to check in the path vsa1031:~ # cd /usr/sap/WEB/SYS/profile/ and  vsa1031:/usr/sap/WEB/SYS/profile # more systems.txt | grep -i KLY and found no entry in the configuration file “systems.txt”.-Edit the file systems.txt and add the info as " wd-prod-f: MSHOST=vacskly.byd.sap.corp, MSPORT=8101, SID=KLY, NR=01, SRCVHOST=SYSTEM" and save it.-Go to GMP and select Web Dispatcher and select Wd-prod-f and then select Reload cluster and Restart cluster.-And then log in vsa1031 and check  the message server has been configured.- Created by BYDMS-KB-IM -Keywords

Title: Cloud Access Manager error :LDAP API error: No LDAP connector available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-After moving the application servers of SPC to new hardware, Cloud access manager (CAM) tool was not working. While accessing CAM tool, users will get the following error-User is invalid-Error                      LDAP API error: No LDAP Connector available-Cause-The access control lists are based on the physical IP address of the server. If moved the VM’s from one server to another, the ACL’s needs to be adjusted.-Resolution-Get all affected LDAP connections-Open transaction LDAP  and select LDAP Server-Check the list of servers, all host names must be reachable via port 389.-This can be checked it on OS level e. g. telnet DS2WDF0001.global.corp.sap 389 .if the output message as shown , the connection is working and no further action has to be taken.-                          Check the LDAP connector : transaction LDAP  and LDAP connectors , double click LDAP_VACI<sid>-Connector has issues, current status will be yellow triangle.-               2.  If connector is fine, current status will be green.-          If the connector has issues, follow these steps.-Open a IT/IBC ticket like IT/IBC 0120031469 0000107374 2014 to get the ByD side working.-Open an ITDirect ticket like 7000593724 to get the SAP IT side working.-If both tickets are solved, check all servers via telnet command ,if all connections are working, you can close both tickets.-Check the LDAP connector , if it’s still yellow, it needs to be restarted it on OS side-Check for the process ID (command ps –ef|grep LDAP_VACI<sid>)-                   6.    Kill the process (e.g. kill 6699) , process ID is not always 6699, use the kill command just if you are sure that you have identified the correct process.-      7.    Activate the LDAP connector again-              Created by BYDMS-KB-IM--Keywords

Title: HTTPS Inactive in Internet Communication Manager due to Error: RC=1 or RC=2
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When checked in transaction SMICM, found that HTTPS is inactive. When tried to activate the HTTP/HTTPS service from transaction SMICM, it gives an error RC=1 Or RC=2-This issue is generally found in the following cases:-1. While RP is not accessible.-2. PI messages fail with error while receiving by HTTP, error code: 110 , error text: HTTPIO_PLG_CANCELED.-Cause-For RC=1 :-HTTPS is unable to active due to port block by other processor also unable to listen the port 50001.-For example:-vsa025204:gm2adm 55> netstat -anp | grep 50001-NOTE: Not all processes could be identified, non-owned process information will not be shown, you have to be root to see it all.-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:50001         127.0.0.1:389           ESTABLISHED 2299/gwrd-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:389           127.0.0.1:50001         ESTABLISHED --udp        0      0 127.0.0.1:50001         127.0.0.1:58454         ESTABLISHED 28843/dw.sapGM2_DVE-Here port 50001 is established by other processor (ESTABLISHED 2299/gwrd and ESTABLISHED 28843/dw.sapGM2_DVE).-For RC=2 :-HTTP/HTTPS service is unable to active due to port unavailability (> Operation: Failed)-Resolution-For RC=1 :-vsa025204:gm2adm 55> netstat -anp | grep 50001-Note: Not all processes could be identified, non-owned process information will not be shown, you have to be root user to see all the information.-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:50001         127.0.0.1:389           ESTABLISHED 2299/gwrd-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:389           127.0.0.1:50001         ESTABLISHED --udp        0      0 127.0.0.1:50001         127.0.0.1:58454         ESTABLISHED 28843/dw.sapGM2_DVE- vsa025204:gm2adm 55> ps -ef|grep icman-gm2adm    6137 24900  0 23:26 pts/1    00:00:00 grep icman-gm2adm   31320  2257  0 23:14 ?        00:00:00 icman -attach -apptrc pf=/usr/sap/GM2/SYS/profile/ GM2_DVEBMGS00_vacigm2- Kill the process which is blocked by "ESTABLISHED 28843/dw.sapGM2_DVE":-vsa025204:gm2adm 56> kill -9 28843-Check the port 50001:- vsa025204:gm2adm 57> netstat -anp | grep 50001-Note: Not all processes could be identified, non-owned process information will not be shown, you have to be root user to see all the information.-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:50001         127.0.0.1:389           ESTABLISHED 2299/gwrd-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:389           127.0.0.1:50001         ESTABLISHED -- Find the PID of gwrd:-vsa025204:gm2adm 58> ps -ef|grep gwrd-gm2adm    2299  2257  0 Sep07 ?        00:07:28 gwrd -dp pf=/usr/sap/GM2/SYS/profile/GM2_DVEBMGS00_vacigm2-gm2adm    8736 24900  0 23:30 pts/1    00:00:00 grep gwrd-Again kill the PID which was blocked by "ESTABLISHED 2299/gwrd":-vsa025204:gm2adm 59> kill -9 2299-vsa025204:gm2adm 60> netstat -anp | grep 50001-Note: Not all processes could be identified, non-owned process information will not be shown, You have to be root user to see all the information.-tcp        0      0 127.0.0.1:50001         127.0.0.1:389           TIME_WAIT   --Now the port 50001 works fine.-vsa025204:gm2adm 61> netstat -anp | grep 50001-Note: Not all processes could be identified, non-owned process information will not be shown, You have to be root user to see all the information.-tcp        0      0 0.0.0.0:50001           0.0.0.0:*               LISTEN      31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.60:59428      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.54:45477      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.57:60831      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.60:59426      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.57:60828      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.57:60827      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-tcp        0      0 172.19.195.5:50001      172.19.68.57:60830      ESTABLISHED 31320/icman-unix  2      [ ACC ]     STREAM     LISTENING     107938255 31320/icman         /tmp/.sapicm50001- From the above you can confirm that the port 50001 is able to LISTENING (connect).- For more confirmation of blocked processor running or not you can check again.-vsa025204:gm2adm 61> ps -ef | grep gwrd-gm2adm   12960  2257  0 23:31 ?        00:00:00 gwrd -dp -apptrc pf=/usr/sap/GM2/SYS/profile/GM2_DVEBMGS00_vacigm2-gm2adm   18774 24900  0 23:37 pts/1    00:00:00 grep gwrd-Now go to SID_000 client and run the transaction SMICM and make the HTTPS to active.-FOR RC=2 :-The ICM and the ICM error log showed that the port itself was not available.-Activated it by restarting the ICM globally across all the application servers.-Steps to restart the ICM globally:-1. Go to transaction SMICM, select Administration in the menu and select Global ICM and then Exit Hard.-2. Check on transaction SMICM. You get an output with activeHTTP/HTTPS services.- Keywords

Title: ADS Issue: Restart ICM and Increase the Trace Level
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Whenever you have an ADS issue in one of the ADS systems, you are required to restart ICM and increase the trace level of the ADS clones to 3.-Environment-SAP Sales Cloud-SAP Business byDesign-Resolution-Whenever you have an ADS issue in one of the ADS system (you are notified through alert mails or get a call from support), do the following steps:-1. Check the icm logs in all the clones as displayed:-a. If no error message reflects in the log, switch to the next clone.-b. The error message appears as follows:-2. You need to restart the icm of the affected clone .Therafter check in the logs.The error message should not appear. Then set the trace level for all the clones to 3 to avoid the issue in them. Refer to below screenshots on how to increase the trace level.-a. Take the logs from below path:-SID stands for your system ID/ host name.-/usr/sap/SID/J00/work-/usr/sap/SID/SCS01/work-/usr/sap/SID/J00/j2ee/cluster/server0/log-b. Log in to sap mmc (link on the desktop) and add the required clones as displayed:-c. Proceed as per the following screenshot and restart the icm of the affected clone.-d. After the icm is restarted, increase the icm trace level to 3 by selecting ICM and then right-click to select increase trace level (twice). Once this is increased you can check the current trace level in show developer trace. To get the trace details in the starting of the file (show developer trace), either the icm has to be restarted or the file needs to be truncated (happens when the file reaches the size limit). So if you are just increasing the trace level without an icm restart, kindly confirm the trace value from dev_icm file (os level).-3. Few additional information: If you are required to create a thread dump for the further analysis by developer, following is the process:-If the icm restart does not solve the issue, you need to berform an entire clone restart. Follow the below steps:-Check if the OS native process of XMLForm (>>ps –ef | grep XML) is started or not.-Stop the clone from ACC.-Check the OS native XMLForm process again. All XMLForm process should be stopped.-If XMLForm module process still remains, XMLForm lost IIOP connection and is running as zombie process.-Save the result of ps –ef | grep XML.-If XMLForm OS process remains, terminate it. (>> kill -9 <PID>)-Start the clone from ACC. -Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: Recording and Posting of Times Possible Althought Period is Closed
Content: Symptom-You are able to record and release times retroactively, although the relevant accounting period is already closed. You don't even receive any error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Under Self-Services select the Self-Services Overview.-Select Edit Time Sheet.-Enter time for a time frame for which the accounting period is closed.-Select Save.-Select Release.-The time is Released.-Cause-You have recorded time type Actual hours worked without reference to any project. Such recordings don't affect projects and accounting. Thus no error with respect to closed accounting period or closed project occurs for any date. Also approvals and postings are not prevented.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. If a Time Recording is not affecting posting to accounting, then it is possible to Save and Release this recording. This will be reflected in Time Accounts. However, as long as the recording is approval relevant, it will not be activated unless the manager approves it.-Keywords-time recording, accounting period, employee times

Title: Generic Custom Code As Deviating Cost Assignment Is Missing During Expense Report Creation
Content: Symptom-You are using generic custom code criteria in the account assignment types during the creation of the Supplier Invoice, Customer Invoice and  Journal Entry Vouchers.-You want to use the custom codes in expense reports as well but under the tab Deviating Cost Assignment, Generic Custom Codes field is not available during the creation of expense reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Click New Expense report and fill in all the mandatory details.-Navigate to the Expenses tab and then to the Deviating Cost Assignment subtab.-There is no field for Generic Custom Code, however it can be seen in e.g.: invoices.-Cause-Expense Report Management (ERM) does not use the reuse User Interface (UI) provided by Coding Block and uses their own UIs to show Account Assignment fields. Hence these fields are not available on the ERM UI's.-Resolution-It is not possible to use Custom Code in ERM Coding Block.-Keywords-Spesenabrechnung; benutzerdefinierter Code; Kontierung

Title: Adding Forward Zone in DNS Alias for Web Dispatcher
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-During the tenant copy following error is triggering, due to which URLs are not accessible: SOAP:1.023 SRT: Processing error in Internet Communication Framework: ("ICF Error when receiving the response: ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR").-Reproducing the Issue-Check whether the URL is accessible or not.-If URL is not accessible then follow below steps:-Search the URL in the GMP.-In the search results go to Inventory.-Choose DNS Alias.-Select the URL which you are trying to access.-Check whether in the forward zone the DNS Alias is maintained properly.-Cause-After the upgrade of the DNS Manager is done you find the forward zone (domain name) is not maintained properly in the DNS Alias.-Resolution-Following are the steps to resolve the issue:-Search the URL in GMP.-Select the DNS Alias (one without host) in the inventory.-   3.    Select the URL and edit the DNS Alias.-  4.    Add the forward zone based on the URL domain name. This is either sapbydesign.com or crm.ondemand.com  and save it.-5.    Update the DNS, this means update the domain name from GMP in the DNS Manager (which helps URL for accessible).-   6.   Choose the domain name which you have added in forward zone and update the DNS (here for example: sapbydesign.com).-Note: Changes in DNS will take approximately 30 min.- Created by ByDMS-KB-IM-See Also-For refernce check incident ID:1000853514-Keywords

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Whenever you are creating any incident to Network team when the URL’s are Not reachable,check whether there is any DNS replication already triggered .-This should be the first preliminary check before sending any incident to Network team .-Resolution-You can find whether the replication is going on or not only in GMP under DNS Trigger log as shown in the screenshot :-How to Check-Go to DNS Trigger Log.-Give ByD in the search tab and check for only the by design host names.-Check for the respective date and time.-Select the UUID message of the corresponding entry .-You will get the log information .-Few points to be noted :-You will be able to see only the logs for the past 1 month rest will be deleted .-Currently you will be able to see the logs only from Google chrome browsers .-Created by ByDMS-KB-IM-Keywords-c5156811

Title: Root Cause Analysis of the Problem 'Vanished PSE file (from the File System)'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY****-1           Problem Description1.1          Original Problem Description-In the ByD SPC systems (VLAB and PROD) the PSE file for ‘SSL client Standard’ SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse is vanished from the file system frequently. That prevents the system/tenant provisioning.-The PSE file exists on the data base furthermore. However in transaction STRUST the application server instance beneath the entry ‘SSL client Standard’ (sometimes ‘SSL client DFAULT’) is marked red and the error message ‘Error while opening file’ appears if someone wants to display the PSE. That points to the fact that the PSE file is deleted from the file system.-1.2          Symptom Removal-Distribute the PSE from the data base to the file system manually:-Call the transaction STRUST in the affected tenant.-Select the entry ‘SSL client Standard’ (sometimes ‘SSL client DFAULT’).-Choose the menu entry PSE → Distribute All (F6).--1.3          Workaround-Withdrawing write access of the share /usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec.-1.4          Side Effect of the Workaround-All PSE files of the affected system could not be changed, new PSE files could not be created. Therefore ByD Support Users cannot be provided for such system because the PSE for encrypting the generated support user password cannot be created.-1.5          Task-The root cause of the PSE file deletion has to be found out.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Resolution-2           Problem Solution2.1          Overview-The root cause analysis contains several steps:-Establish when the file is deleted on the file system.-Establish by whom/what the file is deleted.-If an ABAP system causes the problem:-Evaluate the statistical records via transaction STAD.-If an RFC call causes the problem:-Verify the used RFC destination.-Use the security audit log to find the affected function module.-Perform a RFC trace instead of using the security audit log.-Investigate the source code of the affected function module, method or report.-  2.2          Use Daemons on the File System-2.2.1        Joschyd Daemon: Establish the Time Frame when the File was Deleted-A daemon called Joschyd daemon (/opt/imal/bin/joschyd) watches the existence of the PSE file every 5 minutes.-The Joschyd daemon is running on a system on OS level already and can be configured for new tasks (here: watch the existence of the file SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse) by entering a further configuration file into the path /opt/imal/etc/joschyd-sections/.-Execute following commands on an UNIX terminal:-Edit configuration file for watching the SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse file -(replace <SID>, <CLIENT> and <email_recipient> by the real values):-# vi /opt/imal/etc/joschyd-sections/SAPSSLD.conf-  [SAPSSLD]-eval             = -e '/usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse' or print "No such file or directory"-regex           = .+-red               = > 0-max_retries   = 1-description    = File: /usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse gone away!  Please inform: <email_recipient>!-  Restart daemon:-# /etc/init.d/joschyd restart-  Watch alert:-# tail -f /opt/imal/log/joschyd.log- search for:-joschyd: Suspending to watch "SAPSSLD" after 1 retries !!!<yyyy-mm-dd> <hh:mm:ss>: Mailing: Customer:Vlab-Date: <yyyy-mm-dd> <hh:mm:ss>-Thema:SAPSSLD-Alarmtyp:JOSCHY-Severity:red-Host:<host name>-User:-Description:File: /usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse gone away. Please inform: <email_recipient>!-  The general configuration file for the Joschyd daemon (joschyd.conf) establishes that all alerts of the Joschyd daemon are sent to the system GMP.-Therefore the alerts can be monitored also in GMP and you could request also HIM Second Level Support to watch it for you and to send an email to <email_recipient> (no automatically email  sending off!).-If you have got GMP access you can monitor the alert by yourself in following manner:-Navigate to Alert -> History.-Enter following selection values:-Inbox: Any alert, in inbox or not-Search:  SAPSSLD-Date from, until, from …-Press the button Show.-Choose the link in the column Problem to check the details of a single alert if the alerts have been displayed in the Alert Overview.-If a Joschyd alert has been arrived in GMP you can set also a subsequent automatic alert action for all alerts of the same Problem category by defining a filter in GMP:-Choose action Create Filter in the alert details.-Enter the alert filter values and the desired alert actions.-Enter the Problem category and select it for the filter.-Enter E-Mail recipients if they should be informed automatically that the alert was raised.-Select the Action Move to history and Forward None if no one else should deal with this alert.-Save the filter. -  Hint: Up to now the filter cannot be created before one Joschyd alert has been arrived in GMP. That means the first occurrence of this alert has to be monitored manually.-Evaluation of the Joschyd daemon alert:-The file has been deleted in the last 5 minutes since the alert was logged /sent.-  2.2.2        Audit Daemon: Establish Who/What Accessed the File and When-All actions (read, write, delete) regarding the mentioned file are logged because an existing audit daemon (/sbin/auditd) watches the real file access on the file system if the audit daemon is configured correctly and started on OS level.-Execute following commands on an UNIX terminal:-Edit audit rules of the daemon (replace <SID> and <CLIENT> by the real values).-# vi /etc/audit/audit.rules-append this line:--w /usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse -S unlink-  Start the daemon-# /etc/init.d/auditd start-  Enable the configuration of the daemon-# auditctl -e 1-  Check daemon status-# auditctl –s-should show:-AUDIT_STATUS: enabled=1 flag=1 pid=2794 rate_limit=0 backlog_limit=320 lost=0 backlog=0-  Find access event in the log-# grep SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse /var/log/audit/audit.log-shows:-type=PATH msg=audit(1326856346.102:766847): item=0 name="/usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse" inode=300062 dev=00:24 mode=0100660 ouid=50348 ogid=79 rdev=00:00-  Get the time-# perl -e 'print scalar localtime 1326856346'-shows the time:-Wed Jan 18 03:12:26 2012-  Compare the time with the time frame of the file deletion established by the joschyd daemon.-Following command can be used to convert the joschyd daemon time to the UNIX time (epoch).-# perl -MTime::Piece -e 'print Time::Piece->strptime("2012-02-07 10:20:27",-"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")->epoch'-shows the UNIX time (epoch):-1328610027- If the correct event is found in the audit log then establish the causer by using the time stamp.-  Get the causer-# grep 1326856346 /var/log/audit/audit.log-shows:-type=SYSCALL msg=audit(1326856346.102:766847): arch=c000003e syscall=2 success=yes exit=46 a0=f1b0530 a1=0 a2=7f1c12a22e57 a3=0 items=1 ppid=13186 pid=2163 auid=4294967295 uid=50348 gid=79 euid=50348 suid=50348 fsuid=50348 egid=79 sgid=79 fsgid=79 tty=(none) ses=4294967295 comm="<SID>_00_DIA_W<nn>" exe="/usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/exe/disp+work" key=(null)-type=CWD msg=audit(1326856346.102:766847):  cwd="/usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/work"-type=PATH msg=audit(1326856346.102:766847): item=0 name="/usr/sap/<SID>/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT<CLIENT>.pse" inode=300062 dev=00:24 mode=0100660 ouid=50348 ogid=79 rdev=00:00 -  2.2.3        Evaluation of Both Daemons-Evaluation of real log events:-The file /usr/sap/VNS/DVEBMGS00/sec/SAPSSLD_DFAULT002.pse was deleted from the file system:-on Tue Jan 17 12:03:45 2012-by the dialog work process VNS_00_DIA_W17 of the ABAP system (/usr/sap/VNS/DVEBMGS00/exe/disp+work)--  2.3          Use the Statistical Records of the ABAP System (Transaction STAD)-As the deletion is caused by the ABAP system, go to transaction STAD and enter the Date, Time and the affected Client.-Start the analysis by pressing ENTER.-Hint: The statistical records are stored only 48 hours, afterwards they are overwritten. Therefore the analysis should be carried out shortly after the issue occurred.-On the overview, select the statistical record which fits to the time stamp and display the details (button Choose (F2) or double-click).-On the screen ‘SAP Workload: Single Statistical Record’, jump to the RFC section.-In the RFC section, make a click on the green highlighted value at as Client Connection and evaluate the details.-In the RFC section, make a click on the green highlighted value at as Server Connection and evaluate the details.-Sometimes the value in the row Calls in the RFC section of a single statistical record is highlighted in green. Then the remote called function module is listed also in the call details. Unfortunately it was not the case in our example.-2.3.1        Evaluation of the Statistical Records-At the established time stamp a remote function call is executed from client 002 of system VNS by user SAP_SPC and by means of destination VNS_002_000000000730016321 to client 002 of system VNS.-2.4          Verify the Information about the RFC Destination-Call transaction SM59 and verify the information of the statistical record about the RFC destination:-    2.4.1        Evaluation of the Used Destination-The tenant specific RFC destination VNS_002_000000000730016321 establishes a connection from VNS/002 to VNS/002 by using user SAP_SPC.-  2.5          Use the Security Audit Log-Try to get the information which function module was called remotely. This information is reported inside the security audit class RFC call which is not watched for all users per default in a ByD system.-2.5.1        Configure the Security Audit Log Filter-If the RFC calls of the affected user are not reported, an administrator can change the security audit filter configuration via transaction SM19 before the issue occurs again:-Call transaction SM19 in the administration client (000) with an administration user.-(If necessary make an User Request for User Category SP_ADMIN and Access LevelSP_ADMIN_L6 (full access) in the appropriate SPC system).-Go to Filter 8 (filter setting for all users) and select the audit class RFC call.-Save the changes and confirm the distribution of the changed profile.-  Attention: Revert the security audit log filter changes after the needed data are logged in order to keep the log file small.-  2.5.2        Display the Security Audit Log-Call transaction SM20 and display the security audit log for the certain user in the certain client at the interesting time frame by pressing the button Reread Audit Log after entering the selection values.-Hint: The security audit log records are stored only some days. Therefore the analysis should be carried out shortly after the issue occurred.-  2.5.3        Evaluation of the Security Audit Log-The user SAP_SPC logged on to the system VNS in client 002 on Tue Jan 17 12:03:45 2012 and call the function module A1S_IAM_GET_CERT_FROM_PSE.-Hint: In older releases (< ByD FP4.0) the function module is reported on the detail view. Therefore select the row in the overview and press the button Details. The called function module is listed as Parameter on the Details screen.-    2.6          Use the RFC Trace-A RFC trace can be switched on before the issue occurs again in order to get the called function module.-Attention: Tracing leads to a performance decrease! Therefore the RFC trace must be switched off once the needed data are captured by the trace (see chapter Deactivate the RFC trace).-  2.6.1        Increase the Trace File Size-If the problem occurs seldom then increase the trace file size so that the reported issue is not overwritten by later reported events.-Call transaction ST01.-Choose the menu entry Goto -> Administration.-Increase the value of Maximum File Size.-Hint: The value of Trace Files: Max. Number establishes the number of trace files which are written one after another with the Maximum File Size and which are overwritten in the round trip manner. That means, the possible total trace file capacity amounts Trace Files: Max. Number * Maximum File Size and must be available on the file system.-Activate changed parameters.-   Attention: The maximum trace file size should be decreased to the old value once the needed data are captured.-  2.6.2        Activate the RFC Trace via Transaction ST01 or ST05-Call transaction ST01.-Select the Trace Component RFC Calls.-Press the button General Filters.-Enter the desired user as filter setting.-Choose the button Back (F2) on the screen System Trace: General Filter.-Press the button Trace on on the screen System Trace.-  OR-Call transaction ST05.-Select the trace RFC trace.-Press the button Activate Trace with Filter.-  Set the filter values and choose the button Activate Trace with Filter for Writing the Trace (Enter).-    2.6.3        Deactivate the RFC Trace-Deactivate the RFC trace after the issue is traced:-in ST01 by selecting the Trace Component RFC Calls and pressing the button Trace off-or ST05 by selecting the RFC Trace and pressing the button Deactivate Trace- Attention: This action must be executed to increase the system performance again.-  2.6.4        Display the RFC Trace via Transaction ST01 or ST05-Call the transaction ST01.-Press the button Analysis (F2).-Enter the selection values for User name, Client, From, To and RFC calls.--Choose Start reporting (F8).-- OR-Call the transaction ST05.-Press the button Display Trace (F7).-Enter the selection values for RFC Trace, Date, Time, User name and Client.-- Choose Execute (F8).--  2.6.5        Evaluation of the RFC Trace-The user SAP_SPC logged on to the system VNS in client 002 on Tue Jan 17 12:03:45 2012 and call the function module A1S_IAM_GET_CERT_FROM_PSE.-  2.7          Investigate the Source Code of the Called ABAP Function Module-Investigate the source code of the remotely called ABAP function module via transaction SE37 or SE80 and search for the ABAP command ‘DELETE DATASET …’ (also in sub routines, further called function modules and methods).-2.7.1        Investigation Result of the Called Function Module-Bug was found.-The attributes of the function module/report source/method contain the appropriate ABAP package (and in internal systems also the responsible person):-Navigate to the ABAP Package Builder per double-click on the Package entry.-The ABAP package properties show the appropriate Application Component to which the incident/CSS message should be forwarded to the development.-  2.8          Investigate the Source Code of the Caller-As the used RFC destination establishes a connection from the system/client to the same system/client, the where-used list of the called function module can point to the caller.-Call transaction SE37.-Enter the Function Module.-Press the button Where-Used List.-Where-Used List of FM A1S_IAM_GET_CERT_FROM_PSE:-→ class /A1SSPC/CL_LMPROV_CR_MGM_CONN, method MAP_CERT_TO_MGM_USER-Where-Used List of class /A1SSPC/CL_LMPROV_CR_MGM_CONN, method MAP_CERT_TO_MGM_USER:-→ class /A1SSPC/CL_LMPROV_CR_MGM_CONN, method /A1SSPC/ITP_IF_TASKAUTO~SYNC-→ class /A1SSPC/CL_LMPROV_CR_MGM_CONN, method FIX_MANAGEMENT_CONNECTION-  2.8.1        Investigation Result of the Caller Source Code-The transferred parameters suit to the behavior of the called function module.-Another function module can be called instead of the erroneous function module for the same purpose.-ABAP classes can be displayed via transaction SE24 or SE80 and the class definition contains the appropriate ABAP package and maybe the developer as Properties. Navigate to the ABAP package and find the appropriate Application Component to forward the incident to the development if the problem can be solved also on caller side.-  Created by BYDMS-KB-IM-

Title: How to troubleshoot frequent host switches
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Monitoring metrics grey due to frequent host switches-Many entries in a short time period for host switches in the hosts ACLSCHANGEVENTS-Cause-The SAPHostAgent will check the host availability frequently to determine if a system is still up and running. For monitoring the System Availability the SAP system is associated to a host, when a SAP System moves to another host it will be associated to that host and this is where the metrics should be connected. If the switches occur to frequently no metrics can be collected because the association of the SAP System to the host is constantly changed, this is supposed to be a fairly infrequent event-Resolution-For Solution Manager 7.2 SP6 and higher switch to the new Outside Discovery -> 2556432 -Are there any DNS aliases? -When there is a DNS alias the system cannot determine which hostname to associate to the SAP System-Nslookup the IP address  > Does it have more than one hostname?--Check the table ACLSCHANGEVENTS-Are there many host switches within a short period of time (minutes)-Make sure to filter e.g. by time stamp to see the actual latest switches-Check the LMDB changes, what changed?-What hostname, what IP?-Keywords

Title: Report Actual Utilization Doesn't Show Planned Working Time for Employees
Content: Symptom-You don't know from where the report Actual Utilization - My Area pulls the number for the Planned Working Time. You think that the shown Planned Working Time is incorrect since it is less than the planned working hours specified in the employee time agreement.-You may wonder why the report Actual Utilization - My Area doesn't show any numbers for the figure Planned Working Time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center-Click on Reports-Select and open report Actual Utilization - My Area -Cause-The figure Planned Working Time is pulled from the availability of the employee from the Resource Management work center > Internal Resource Overview. -The figure Availability is calculated as today's date until the end of the period specified. For example, if the period starts from the 1st of August and the period view is 30 days, then the range would be 1st of August to 30th of August. If today is the 12th of August, then all days up to the 12th of August, which are in the past, will not be considered in the figure Availability. All days that are not considered are grayed out. The available days are green.-The figure Planned Working Time is a summation of the time calendar period items. If the report doesn't show any numbers for this figure, then it means that the time data is outdated and not up-to-date for a specific employee or for all employees.-Resolution-To keep time data up-to-date, we recommend that the day closure run is scheduled to run every day for all employees. This is possible via Regular Tasks > Administer Day Closure in work center Time Administration.-Keywords-Report ID HCMRPMU03_Q0003, Bericht Tatsächliche Auslastung - Mein Bereich, Kennzahl Sollarbeitszeit, Sollarbeitszeiten im Bericht nicht korrekt, Sollarbeitszeit falsch ausgegeben,

Title: How to Identify a Copy Issue for PI Incidents
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to identify a copy issue for PI incidents.-Resolution-Checks while processing PI incidents, if it is failing after the restart of the messages.-1. If the tenant is copied from some other system you can find that application server name in the incident itself.- (For example if the incident is created for xyz it shows some other systems application server name inside the incident.)-From that you can confirm that it is a copy issue.-2. Check the tenant creation date with the message creation date. If the message creation date is older than the tenant creation date then it should be a copy issue.-For example: SPC #1000013267 was created for the system G78_005. For the message ID 0000000000011ED082B8659E544B3B8A, message creation date is 17.12.2010.- But the tenant creation date is 02.02.2011. You can find the tenant creation date from Tenant Fact Sheet Overview.- 3. If you want to know from which system this tenant was copied, go to the system tenant in target system and run transaction TLM. You can find from where this tenant was copied.- You can find the same message in the source tenant.-If you confirm that the message is failed due to a copy issue from the above checks, you can cancel the message (first 2 steps are enough to find the issue).- Keywords

Title: How to Reactivate Tax Codes
Content: Symptom-You want to reactivate a tax code NN (NN stands for the tax code) for the country ABC (ABC stands for the country name) which has been set to obsolete.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Activity Tax on Goods and Services and select it.-Click on the Change Immediately button.-Under Tax Codes, click on the Define Tax Codes link.-The Tax code NN for the country ABC has been set obsolete.-Resolution-You can reactivate the tax code as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Activity Tax on Goods and Services and select it.-Click on the Change Immediately button.-Under Tax Codes, click on the Define Tax Codes link.-Click on the Add Row button and add the country ABC.-All Tax Codes for country ABC are shown and all Tax Codes marked as obsolete under "Is Obsolete" can be edited.-Uncheck the Is Obsolete button for the tax code and click save.-An error message asking to enter details for the new country is asked.-Select the new country ABC added and click delete.-Click save.-Search and select Country ABC, the tax code NN which was obsolete is now active again.-For example: Screenshots for Reactivating tax code 12 for country Switzerland.-Keywords-Tax code, Obsolete, Reactivate Tax code, Steuerkennzeichen

So configure the preview functionality in the QAF screen.

Title: An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset for Migrated Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You create an acquisition cost reducing document, such as a Supplier Credit Memo for a migrated capitalized Fixed Asset XYZ.  Upon posting an error message appears: 'An error occurred during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ'. (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoice work center.-Navigate to the  Invoices and Credit Memos view or choose New Credit Memo Without Purchase Order under Common Tasks.-In the Items tab choose a Fixed Asset relevant product category. -Link the credit memo to the Individual Material associated with Fixed Asset XYZ.-Cause-When accounting operational documents to migrated fixed assets it is essential that the acquisition cost have been imported and maintained for all defined valuation views for all sets of books. A credit memo will not post if this is not the case since its line items always relate to all valuation views.-Resolution-Check the master data of Fixed Asset XYZ.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Select Fixed Asset XYZ and choose Edit - Values. -In the Book Values tab you find a table containing the Acquisition Cost for each maintained valuation view.-In case you did not migrate accurate acquisition costs for all valuation views of the fixed asset it is recommended to reverse the migration for the affected fixed asset.-In the fixed asset's master data navigate to the Migration tab.-Make a note of the initially migrated valuation views, amounts and columns.-Choose the Reverse Migration button. -After confirming a pop-up dialog enter and save the accurate acquisition cost in the relevant columns for all defined sets of books and valuation views. -It should now be possible to post the Operational document.-Keywords-Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset; Supplier Credit Memo

Title: Time Entries Not Being Accounted
Content: Symptom-You are trying to manually enter leaves or enter actual working hours in the employee times, however the amount of days is not being reflected in the time account balance.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Find the concerned employee and click Edit.-On the screen that opens, select Employee Times tab. You have active time entries, e.g. Vacation Days.-Go to the tab Time Account Balances-In the Details Section, click tab Posting-Date is not listed here-or-Go to Time Administration-Click on Employee Time Record-Find the concerned employee and click Edit-Select Employee times: You have active time entries, e.g. Vacation Days or Actual Hours Worked -Click on tab Time Account Balances-In the Details Section, click tab Posting -Date is not listed here-The vacation days or the actual hours worked have not been reflected in the time account for vacation or for working time.-Cause-The mapping between the time type and the time account is not done.-Resolution-In order to properly account the recorded days, you have to map the time type with the time account as per below steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Select Activities-Search for Time Types-Open the activity Time Types - <Country>-Click Maintain Employee Time Types-Select the concerned time type-Click on Add Row-Search for the code of time type-Click on Save-Maintain the relevant time account in the Time Account Posting tab.-After that, times recorded with the concerned time type will be reflected in the time account balance.-Keywords-Arbeitszeitkonto, Arbeitszeiten, Istarbeitszeiten, Sollarbeitszeiten, Mitarbeiterzeiten, Überstunden, Zeitabrechnungsbuchung, time account balances, maintain employee times, time types, time account posting, employee time records, time administration

Title: Depreciation Run Generates Postings For Fixed Assets With No Automatic Depreciation
Content: Symptom-You changed the Depreciation Method of Fixed Asset ABC to 0000-No Automatic Depreciation (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID).-You execute the Depreciation Run and notice that for Fixed Asset ABC postings have been generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Depreciation view.-Find and open the respective Depreciation Run ID.-Go to the Postings tab.-For Fixed Asset ABC Postings have been generated.-Cause-When you re-execute the Depreciation Run after changing Depreciation Method to 0000 - No automatic depreciation all the depreciations posted in previous periods will be reversed.-Resolution-If the desired outcome is to have no postings on the Depreciation Run the 0000 - No automatic depreciation Depreciation Method should be set only for the desired interval, as per the below steps:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Find and open Fixed Asset ABC.-Click Edit - Master Data.-Go to the Asset Valuation sub-tab.-Go to the Valuation Intervals sub-tab.-Select each Valuation View at a time.-Click Add Row.-Select the needed Start and End Date.-Change Depreciation Method to 000 - No automatic depreciation.-Repeat these steps for all valuation views.-Click Save.-Execute a new Depreciation Run (first, in Test mode to check that all changes were successful).-This time, no postings are generated for Fixed Asset ABC, as the intervals defined for the Depreciation Method 0000 - No automatic depreciation do not overlap the periods for which automatic depreciation values were already posted.-Keywords-Depreciation, Depreciation run, Fixed Asset, No automatic depreciation, Depreciation Method, incorrect postings-depreciation,depreciation run,fixed asset,no automatic depreciation,depreciation method,incorrect postings

Title: Error Message "Product Category ID XYZ does not exists", While Uploading Materials Using MS Excel
Content: Symptom-When you try to Upload New Materials using Microsoft Excel, system throws below error message:-"Product Category ID XYZ does not exist"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select New button and choose Material from MS Excel.-Download the Excel and update the Material details.-Select Save Data To in the Excel.-Cause-There could two possibilities which caused the issue:-The Product Category entered by you in the excel is wrong.-You have assigned the Product Category ID to another field instead of Product Category field.-Resolution-Solution 1: Check in the system (Product Category view in Product Data work center) whether the Product Category exists and assign the correct Product Category ID.-Solution 2: Check the excel again and assign the Product Category ID to correct field.

Title: How to Change Fiscal Year Variant
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Fiscal Year Variant XXX to YYY (XXX and YYY represents the years your want to change from and to).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center and navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation Project and open the Activity List.-In the Integrate and Extend phase find the Set of Books activity. If your system is live you can find this activity in the Overview view. Open it via Change Immediately.-Select the desired Set of Books ID and press Edit.-In the General tab you see that fiscal year variant XXX is selected whereas you require the fiscal year variant to be YYY.-Cause-It is not possible to switch to a different fiscal year variant for a set of books if journal entries exist for that set of books.--Resolution-You can change the Fiscal Year Variant from the existing set of book for which no postings exist by first deleting all the existing Fiscal Years, then changing the fiscal year variant and finally creating the fiscal years again.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-In the Master Data view, select the Companies subview.-Select the respective company and press Edit Fiscal Year.-Select/highlight all the fiscal year(s), for which you intend to change the fiscal year variant, and choose Delete Fiscal Year.-Now go to the Set of Books activity as described above.-Select the desired Set of Books ID and press Edit.-Change the Fiscal Year Variant and press Save.-At last create the Fiscal Year(s) again in the Master Data - Companies view of the General Ledger work center.-Keywords-fiscal year variant; fyv; delete fiscal year; edit fiscal years;-fiscal year variant,csg_q,fyv,delete fiscal year,edit fiscal years

Title: Migration of Appointment Activities Selects Primary Contact Automatically
Content: Symptom-You migrate Appointment Activities via the Migration Tool. Although no Primary Contact is maintained in the Migration File, a Primary Contact for the Appointment activity is automatically picked and filled by the system. You consider this selection as incorrect.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to the Implementation Projects view.-3. Select the Open Activity List button.-4. Search and open activity Migration of Appointment Activities.-5. Select the Migrate Appointment Activities Using the Migration Tool link.-6. Select Show Completed Files.-7. Search for any successfully migrated file.-8. Open it in Microsoft Excel.-9. The General tab shows all the Appointment Activity IDs.-10. Go to the Activity Parties tab.-11. This tab is completely empty.-Now check for the migrated Appointment Activity in the UI:-1. Go to Activities work center.-2. Go to Appointments view.-3. Search for the Appointment Activity ID migrated through the above process.-4. Open the Appointment.-5. Although no Primary Contact is maintained in the Activity Parties tab of the related Migration File, it is automatically filled by the system.-Cause-When you create an Appointment manually or through Migration, the Primary Contact in the Appointment is picked in below sequence:--1. Primary Contact of the Appointment is the Primary Contact or Main Contact of the Account assigned in that Appointment.-2. If there is no Main Contact, then the first Contact of that Account is picked as a Primary Contact for that assignment.--Resolution-If you want a particular contact to be the Primary Contact, then you can maintain that contact as Main in the respective Account.-Keywords-Termin Migration, Sequence, Kontakt

Title: Error Message "Conversion not valid; quantity types must be different" While Migrating Materials or Services
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating Materials or Services in your system and during simulation, system throws below error message:-Conversion not valid; quantity types must be different-Conversion between XXX and YYY already exists-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity for Service or Material-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the issue is that, in the Quantity Conversion sheet, you have maintained Quantity Conversion between same UoM for Materials or Service.-For Example: 1 EA is mapped to 100 EA, which is not possible.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Quantity Conversions cannot be maintained from same quantity type to same quantity type like mass to mass. You can find the same error if you maintain the such UoM in UI as well.-You have maintained quantity conversions from same quantity type to same quantity type in the quantity conversion sheet. For example, the conversion have been maintained from cm to m, m to ft and kg to pound. In all such cases conversion are from same quantity type to same quantity type.-Change the erronous values (maintained valid conversion between two different UoMs) and simulate the migration again.-Keywords-Conversion not valid; quantity types must be different , Uom , Display Help , Additional message generated; see help for more information

Title: Unable to Delete Master Data or Transactional Data
Content: Symptom-You want to delete master data or transactional data, but you cannot find the option to do so.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Master data is the data that is used over and again without any changes for a longer period of time. It is the core data that is essential for operations in a specific business or business unit. Master data can be an attribute, text or hierarchy — e.g. Accounts, Contacts, Products, Materials, etc.--Transactional data is the data that cannot be changed; this data is created in SAP as a result of a business user completing a business transaction, such as creating a sales quote, creating a process order, creating an opportunity etc. This type of data can be reversed or canceled, but is usually not changeable.-Transactional data depends on master data. Before transactional data is executed in the system, proper master data validations are carried out in the background. So deletion of these, leads to severe inconsistencies in the system, and as such is not supported.-Resolution-Master Data: If you don't intend to use the master data further, you can mark it as Obsolete / Not Active / Blocked.-Transactional Data: Reverse or cancel the documents from the UI only, depending on the transaction status.-You also have the option to use the Data Protection and Privacy work centre tools.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Data Protection and Privacy-Keywords-delete master data, delete transactional data, remove master data, remove transactional data, blocked, obsolete, not active, documents

Title: Return Order Flagged With Error
Content: Symptom-You can see that a Return is flagged as erroneous, once you open the same the following error message is displayed:-'Tax region for country XYZ in item is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Open the view Returns.-Show All Returns.-Select the row with the Return ID ABC.-You can see that under the details it is flagged with error.-Open the same and click view all.-You will see the error message:- 'Tax region for country XYZ in item is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab.'-Cause-The error message is being displayed because no address is maintained in the Sales Unit, which is being used in the Return ABC.-Your system is scoped with an Automated Tax Software, as for example Avalara or any other similar. In this case, the external provider validates each and every address within that document and noticed an empty address during validation and therefore, throws an error.-Any tax calculation or determination would require the addresses of all involved parties.-Resolution-To solve the error, which is being displayed, you need to maintain the address of the Sales Unit with a proper Postal and Region Codes.-Keywords-Tax Region, Tax Country, Tax Code, Error Message, Sales Order, Return, Sales Return, Avalara, External Provider.

Title: Bank Charges Are Automatically Allocated When Uploading Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-A Payment Allocation resulting from an automatic Bank Statement upload shows an incoming payment representing the payment of bank interests which has been automatically allocated.-However, you expect that these payments are not automatically posted by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work centre.-Go to the Payment Allocations sub view.-Show All Payment Allocations and find Payment Allocation XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Payment Allocation).-Open Payment Allocation and click View All.-The Payment Method used is Bank Charge.-The External Transaction Code is ABC (ABC represents the External Transaction Code).-The Import Format used is DEF (DEF represents the Import Format).-No Postprocessing Required even though you expect the amount to be allocated manually.-Cause-In order for bank interests to be allocated and posted automatically an explicit and working rule of type Bank Interest with appropriate search parameters has to be defined in the Business Configuration.-In this case you do not want the allocation to happen automatically and hence you have to remove these rules.-Resolution-In order to change the rule for the identification and automatic posting of bank charges proceed as follows:-Go the Business Configuration work centre and navigate to Fine Tuning.-Choose the activity Global Settings for Payment.-Create and edit rules for analyzing memo lines.-You see that a rule for Rule Type Bank Interest is maintained and also a General Ledger Account in association with this rule.-If you do not want an automatic allocation of bank charges you have to delete this rule.-In case no separate general-ledger account is assigned here, the accounts for bank interests as defined in the Fine Tuning activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination / Cash / Interest/Charge will be posted by default.-In order to adjust the matching of External Transaction Code and assigned Payment Method proceed as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and navigate to Fine Tuning.-Choose the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Select Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Highlight the relevant Import Format (e.g. MT490 DE).-External Transaction Code ABC has a Payment Method assigned.-In order to disable the automatic allocation of Bank Interests you need to remove this row and save your changes.-See Also-1916638 - Automatic Posting of Interest Payments when Uploading Bank Statements-Keywords-Bankgebühren, automatische Zuordnung, Zahlungszuordnung, Kontoauszug
