Title: No ETax Invoice Created for South Korea
Content: Symptom-While creating new Electronic Invoice (ETax) for South Korea no ETax are being created under Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1902-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Electronic Tax Invoice Run view.-Press new.-Select New ETax Invoice Run.-Enter relevant information.-Click Schedule or Start Immediately button.-Once you save or schedule, you will see the message: 'No ETax Invoice created'.-Cause-A correction is being developed and will be implemented for next releases. However, there is a workaround by scoping Japan Summary Invoice. The number range profile and the Interval used for South Korea ETax and for Japan Summary Invoice are same.-Resolution-This configuration will not have any impact on functionality to Japan. To scope Japan Summary Invoices you can follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation projects view.-Click button Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step 4 - Questions.-Search for Scoping Element Cash Flow Management.-Select Payables and Receivables Processing.-Select Communication for Payables and Receivables Processing.-Under Business Option, go to Group: Electronic Tax Invoice Processing-South Korea (2).-Unselect both Scoping Questions.-Go until Step 5 - Review.-Save.-Open Project Scope again and select same scoping element.-For Group: Invoice Summary Processing-Japan (3).-Select first two question ("Do you want to create and process monthly and summary invoices?" & "Do you want to enable new number range for summary invoices?").-Go until step 5 and save again.-Open Project scope again and select the same scoping element.-Now go to Group South Korea.-Select only the first scoping question ("Do you want to create and process monthly or standalone electronic tax invoices?").-Go to Step 5 and save the scoping.-Keywords-South Korea ETax-south korea etax

Title: Unable to Assign Service to a Project - Service is not Available in the Value Help
Content: Symptom-You want to assign a service to a project but the service is not available in the value help.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Select the Projects subview.-Select a project and click Edit.-Go to the Work tab.-Click Add Row and select the value help.  -The service you want to add to the project is not available in the value help.-Cause-If the service is not associated with any time based unit (days, hours, minutes) the service is not available for selection in a project.-The service should either have a time based UoM or a quantity conversion rule maintained.-Resolution-The Quantity Conversion rule can be set as follows:-Go to the Product Data work center.-Select the Services view.-Search for the service and click Edit.-Select the View All button.-In the General Tab, under Quantity Conversions, you can maintain the quantity conversion for the Service.-Keywords-Service, Project, Select, Work, Quantity Conversion, Unit of measurement

Title: An Error Message Is Being Displayed While Trying to Merge Project Changes
Content: Symptom-An error message is being displayed while trying to merge a Project Change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select project ABC.-Click button Actions.-Then, select Simulate button.-Once simulation is done, click 'see details'.-Error messages are shown:-Value YYY in setting Miscellaneous Ledger General Ledger Account Alias must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by Account Type and Posting-Value YYY in setting General Ledger: Other Assets must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by Account Type and Posting-Acct YYY in COA BBB cannot be deleted/changed; transaction data exists-ABC Refers to project ID.-YYY Refers to General Ledger account.-BBB Refers to Chart of Accounts.-Cause-There are postings against this General Ledger Account and GL Account has been in the edit charts of account view of Business Configuration. Hence, system wouldn't allow deletion of General Ledger Account on Chart of Accounts.-Resolution-You will need to maintain General Ledger Account then perform merge.-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open activity List button.-Search for activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination'.-Open 'Edit Chart of Account'.-Maintain General Ledger Account YYY.-Keywords-merge project changes; gl account-merge project changes,gl account

Title: Customer Account Statement Vs. Balance Confirmation of Accounts Payables and Receivables Setup
Content: Symptom-You want to print customer account statements and hence you have scoped the following questions in business configuration: Do you send out account statements to your customers and suppliers?-You expected that, after scoping this option, the work center view for Customer Account Statements would be enabled under Receivables work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Questions step.-Expand the following scoping elements: Cash Flow Management -> Payables and Receivables Processing.-Click Communication for Payables and Receivables Processing.-You'll see the scoping question related to send out accounts statements is flagged.-Cause-The above-mentioned scoping question does not relate to the work center view named Customer Account Statement.-The work center view for Customer Account Statement, under Receivables, is a feature only available for South Africa. If you scope South Africa, you find the scoping question Customer Account Statements - South Africa.-Resolution-The scoping question "Do you send out account statements to your customers and suppliers?" is related to Balance Notifications (the question is in the Balance Confirmation group).-This question enables the Account Statements with Due Date List, which allows you to send the account statements of your account's payables and receivables to your customers and suppliers.-The account statement is a balance confirmation form which shows all the open items for each key date on the account. In addition, it shows due items for specific periods, such as due in 10-30 days.-This is created via Balance Confirmation Runs view under Payables and/or Receivables.-In case the feature is scoped and you are still missing the Balance Confirmations view, check whether the user has proper access rights via Application and User Management -> Business Users.-Keywords-Balance Notification, Account Statement, Due Date List, Balance Confirmation, south africa

Title: How the System Determines the Import Format for an Inbound Bank Statement File
Content: Symptom-You want to know how the system proposes the Import Formats when creating a new Inbound Bank Statement file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management view.-Go to the Inbound Files subview.-Click New.-Select Inbound File.-Enter the relevant data in the fields File Type, Company and Bank ID.-Display the Import Format drop down menu.-Note: The system shows one or two different options depending on the data entered on Step 6 above.-Cause-The maximum number of options that the system will display under Import Format drop down menu when creating a new Inbound Bank Statement is two.-The Import Format options will be proposed depending on the settings in the Business Configuration activity called ''Automatically Generated Bank Statements''.-Resolution-The first Import Format shown in the drop down menu when creating the Inbound Bank Statement, will be proposed according to the Import Format with the highest priority set up in the activity ''Automatically Generated Bank Statements''> ''Assign import formats for bank statements'' for the Company and Bank ID selected, this is, the Import Format with the highest Sequence Number for the Company and Bank ID selected.-The second Import Format shown in the drop down menu when creating the Inbound Bank Statement, will be proposed according to the Import Format maintained in the activity ''Automatically Generated Bank Statements''>''Assign custom bank statement format'' for the Country Code maintained.-If no entry has been maintained with the selected Country Code in the activity ''Automatically Generated Bank Statements''>''Assign custom bank statement format'' then the system will only show one option as Import Format, which is the one according to Point 1 above.-Keywords-Bank Statement; Incoming, Inbound, New, Import Format, Liquidity Management, File, Upload-bank statement file format not found for

Title: Line Item Currency Not Assigned in Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-In the Trial Balance Report for some G/L-Accounts the Line Item Currency is not assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Lists subview in the Reports view.-Search for the report Trial Balance and select it.-Run the report for Company ABC (ABC stands for the company ID) and Set of Books XYZ (XYZ stands for the Set of Books).-To the Row Fields add the Field Line Item Currency. -For certain G/L-Accounts the Line Item Currency is Not Assigned.-Cause-For Miscellaneous balance sheet accounts without subledger, the line item currency is not populated.-As a result the Journal entries for these postings have no debit- and credit- line item currency. This behavior is displayed in the G/L-Account Line items report.-The same information is being pulled in to the trial balance report and therefore displays the line item currency as not assigned.-Resolution-In terms of the report, the report can only show what is present in the Journal Entry.-The Journal Entry does not have line item currency or amount for Balance Sheet Miscellaneous G/L-Accounts (without subledger), so it's essentially initial and shown as not assigned.-Keywords-Trial Balance report; not assigned; line item currency; G/L-Account

Title: Button Edit Without Business Roles is Disabled
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the access rights of a business user, but notice that the button Edit Without Business Roles is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Cloud for Customer:-Navigate to the Administrator work center.-Go to the General Settings tab.-Click Business Users.-Select a business user in which to perform the changes.-Click Edit and then choose Access Rights.-The button Edit Without Business Roles is disabled.-In SAP Business ByDesign:-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view.-Select the business user in which to perform the changes.-Click Edit and then choose Access Rights.-The button Edit Without Business Roles is disabled.-Cause-The business user which you wish to edit is currently part of an active substitution (either substituting another business user or being substituted by one). In such cases, the Edit Without Business Roles button will be disabled to prevent changes that may lead to inconsistencies during the substitution.-Resolution-Once the substitution involving this business user is terminated, the button Edit Without Business Roles will become active again for the business user's Access Rights screen.-Keywords-Edit Without Business Roles, Button Disabled, Access Rights

Title: Invoice Schedule Is Not Supported in Service Documents Such as Service Order
Content: Symptom-You want to maintain invoice schedule on service orders like you do in the sales orders, but there is no Invoice Schedule tab available in the service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Service Orders.-Go to the view Service Order Processing.-Edit one service order and go to Pricing and Invoicing tab, you find there is no Inovice Schedule tab there.-While in sales orders, you can find Invoice Schedule tab.-Cause-Currently, invoice schedule function is supported in Customer Contracts, Sales Orders, and Sales Quotes. It is not supported in service orders.-Resolution-This is the system designed behavior.-See Also-Find more explanation from help center document:Invoice Schedule.-Keywords-service order; invoice schedule; 服务订单;开票计划

Title: No Option to Mass Upload Materials Including Quantity Conversions via Excel
Content: Symptom-You want to perform a mass upload of materials including Quantity Conversions. But the available excel file to upload materials does not contain any fields related to Quantity Conversions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Materials view.-To download the excel, select the New button.-In the drop down menu, select Material from Microsoft Excel®.-Open the ListOfMaterials file.-Fields related to Quantity Conversions are not available.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign does not provide any standard excel option to upload the Quantity Conversions of materials.-Resolution-Alternatively, you may use the migration tool to migrate materials including Quantity Conversions information:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview activity.-Find and select the Migration of Materials activity.-Select Migrate Materials using the Migration tool.-In the upper right corner, select You Can Also.-Select Download Migration Template.-Open the template.-Find the tab Quantity Conversions.-Keywords-not find, missing, migration, not found, mapping, save back, not possible, not able, conversions, Quantity , Corresponding Quantity-materials,migration,quantity conversion

Title: Error: Account Determination for Acct for Group not Defined for Reclassification
Content: Symptom-You get the error message "Account determination for acct ABC for Group DEF <GHI> not defined for reclassification" in Reclassification of Receivable run.-(ABC represents the account determination profile, DEF represents the group, GHI represents the receivables account).-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Reclassification of Receivable subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search for Run XYZ (XYZ represents the run ID) and select it.-The Run ends in Error.-Click View.-Navigate to the Messages tab.-The error message displays "Account determination for acct ABC for Group DEF <GHI> not defined for reclassification".-Cause-You have not maintained the account GHI for reclassification under Receivables Account for Account Determination in the business configuration.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click the Change Immediately.-Click the Accounts Receivable link under Account Determination.-Select Account Determination Profile ABC.-Navigate to the Reclassification subtab.-Search for Account GHI under Receivables Account.-The account is missing.-Resolution-You need to maintain the account GHI under Receivables Account for Reclassification.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click the Change Immediately.-Click the Accounts Receivable link under Account Determination.-Select Account Determination Profile ABC.-Navigate to the Reclassification subtab.-Click Add Row.-If missing, maintain the relevant Account Determination Group and then the G/L-Account GHI.-Keywords-Reclassification run; Umgliederung von Verbindlichkeiten; Receivables

Title: Excess Time Lost When User Records Vacation And Productive Time on the Same Day
Content: Symptom-You recognise that the actual hours worked for an employee are displayed correctly when you click on the tab Employee Times, but when you click on the tab Time Account Balance the excess time is lost.-Vacation has been deducted from entitlement.-But other than expected, actual hours worked have not been deducted.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Click on Employees view-Search for Employee ID-Click on Employee Name-Click Edit-Select tab Employee Times-Search for the date-For example, Actual Hours Worked are displayed as 5 hours or two times 2.5 hours, and Vacation is displayed as 4 hours-Click on tab Time Account Balances-When selecting the relevant Working Time Account, you expect 5 recorded hours. But only 4 hours are recorded.-Cause-If a user records time that contains leave and productive time on the same day, leave time will only be considered for the calculation of working time account posting, till the total time recorded fulfills the planned hours. It will not be considered for calculating excess time.-Resolution-There are the following, possible combinations if user records leave as well as productive hours on the same day.-Scenario 1:-Total recorded time exceeds the planned time. Productive time is less than planned time. The working time account will not have any excess posting entry.-Example:-Planned time = 8 hours-Leave recorded time = 4 hours-Productive time = 5 hours-Total time = 9 hours-Absence time will only be considered to the extent of fulfilling the total planned time but not to calculate excess time.-A workaround for scenario 1 is either to manually adjust the time account balance in Time Administration > Time Account Balance or to configure a new time recording profile in Business Configuration work center and then assign the new profile to the employee's Time Profile.-Scenario 2:-Total recorded time exceeds the planned time. Productive time also exceeds the planned time. The working time account will only have a posting entry for excess productive time.-Example:-Planned time = 8 hours-Leave recorded time = 2 hours-Productive time = 9 hours-Total time = 11 hours-Working time account posting = 1 hour which is excess productive time.-Scenario 3:--Total working time is less than planned time.-Example:-Planned time = 8 hours-Leave recorded time = 4 hours-Productive time = 3 hours-Total time = 7 hours-Working time account posting = -1 hour-Keywords-Überstunden bei Abwesenheit am selben Tag nicht berücksichtigt, Mitarbeiterzeiten korrekt, Arbeitszeitkonto berücksichtigt Überstunden nicht, Sollarbeitszeit, Istarbeitszeit, Actual hours worked, planned hours, overtime lost

Title: Work in Process Clearing is Again Considered as Variance in Material Actual Costing
Content: Symptom-You have executed a WIP clearing run.  WIP account has been cleared and posted into inventory by the WIP clearing run.-Then you execute the Actual Cost Rollup run. In Material Actual Costing, you find Work in Process Clearing is again considered as Variance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Material Actual Costing view.-Search ABC(ABC represents the material ID).-Select the material line and Click on Edit.-You find Work in Process Clearing is considered as Variance.-Cause-WIP clearing gets considered here again because it needs to be canceled out in the actual costing calculation. This is because the Goods Receipt from Production line would already consider the WIP delta amount. Hence if we don't negate its value in the actual costing result, it would lead to a double posting.-For e.g If Goods Issue for Production is of 100 CNY, Internal Service Confirmation is of 100 CNY and Goods Receipt from Production is of 100 CNY then WIP account will have a delta of 100 CNY which will be cleared and posted into inventory by the WIP clearing run.-Now when actual costing considers the inputs, it takes the Goods Issue for Production and Internal Service Confirmation in its whole again and subtracts the Goods Receipt from Production amount from it for calculating the variance. This would result in a variance of 100+100-100 = 100 CNY. Hence indirectly the WIP clearing amount is considered in it already and hence it needs to be negated in the actual costing calculation. That is why the WIP clearing variance comes as -100 CNY which is the negative of the actual WIP clearing posting into inventory.-Resolution-Basically the WIP clearing part is considered indirectly in the Goods Receipt from Production line(s) of material actual costing result. Hence we need to negate the actual WIP clearing posting that happened into inventory while calculating the actual cost to ensure consistency. Moreover it is absolutely essential that customer does WIP clearing before doing Actual Cost Rollup Run to ensure that double posting doesn't happen.-Keywords-Material Actual Costing, Work in Process Clearing, Variance, 物料实际成本核算

Title: Old Tax Return Items Are Picked up in New Tax Return Run in Country UK
Content: Symptom-You make a Tax Return Run for country UK for the current period but some old items from previous years are picked up as well. You expect that only the current documents are being picked up. This scenario is valid mostly for UK, but can be applied to other countries as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select the Tax Returns - VAT Returns View.-Show Tax Returns In Preparation, find XXX (where XXX represents the Tax Return in Preparation).-Press View.-Switch to the tab Tax Return.-Highlight the Tax Box Code YYY (where YYY represents the Tax Box Code ID) and press Details.-Filter after the Source Document ZZZ.-Click the Customer Invoice ABC.-You can see that the Customer Invoice has a Posting Date as e.g. of 2 years in the past and the status is Release canceled. You expect that this Customer Invoice should not be included in the VAT Return since it is outdated.-You can see as well a Cancellation Customer Invoice DEF in status Released with the same Posting Date as of 2 years ago.-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks - VAT Return Runs View.-Show Active Tax Return Runs, find YYY.-Select the Application Log ID ZZZ.-Switch to tab Results.-You can see a warning message: Error is above the reporting threshold; create a correction return.-Cause-The Tax Returns you created which did not pick up those old documents had all warning messages like that the tax amount is above the reporting threshold. So you just change the reporting threshold. A second solution is to delete the recent Tax return ID. Then you create a new VAT return run for all open documents in previous periods. A third solution is that directly after the warning message is raised you just create a Correction Return.-Resolution-Solution A:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search for in asterisks <Tax Return for Goods and Services - UK>.-Click Tax Return for Goods and Services - UK.-Adjust the Threshold Value for VAT Return.-Rerun the VAT Return Run. Note: This solution A cannot be applied in the country UK since it is legally not allowed to change the Reporting Threshold in the country UK. For the country UK please refer to Solution B below.-Solution B:-Delete the recently created VAT Return ID XXX.-Create a new VAT Return Run for all open documents from 2 years ago and bring the return to a final released status so documents cannot be picked up further in future runs.-Rerun the VAT Return run for the recent actual period.-You notice that no longer old documents are being picked up.-Solution C:-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks - VAT Return Runs View.-Press New - Tax Return Run.-Enter the necessary Details and tick the checkbox Correction Run.-Press Set to Active.-Press Save and Close.-The Correction Run clears the Warning Message and old documents will no longer picked up in future returns.-Keywords-Error is above the reporting threshold create a correction return; old tax items in new tax return run

Title: How to Perform Custom Adjustments For Time Accounts or Time Account Daily Accrual
Content: Symptom-You want to enable a daily accrual for time accounts. This shall allow you to send time account postings on a specified date. But the functionality is not available in the standard configuration. Therefore you want to use a Custom Adjustments web service which can be called from any other non ByDesign system and where you can send the time account postings on any input date. But you cannot find Time Account Adjustments as Communication Scenario, and you don't know how to enable the desired scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Select the Communication Scenarios view-You notice that the scenario Time Account Adjustments is not available-Cause-The Custom Adjustment for Time Accounts needs to be scoped in the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps in order to enable the Custom Adjustment web service in Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select the required project and Edit Project Scope-Select Next to go to the Questions (step4)-Expand the scoping element Human Resources-Expand the sub-element Time and Labor Management to select Time Accounts option-Under the business option Time Accounts-Custom Adjustments you can enable the question: "Do you want to scope Custom Adjustments for Time Accounts?" -Save your settings-After the above steps are completed, follow the below steps to configure the Communication Arrangements to call the service from any other non ByDesign System.-Go to the Application and User Management-Select the Communication Scenarios view-Search for the scenario: Time Account Adjustments-Select New Configuration and add Communication Arrangements-Save the Communication Arrangement-Go to Application and User Management-Select the Communication Arrangements view-Select the service Time Account Adjustments-Download WSDL which will be used to achieve the requirement for web service-Keywords-Zeiten, buchen, gewünschtes Datum,-webservice,time and labor management,time accounts,time account daily accrual,time account configuration,custom adjustment

Title: Initial Capitalization Date Must be in Closed Fiscal Year - Retroactive Capitalization for Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You create a manual Retroactive Capitalization posting for Fixed Asset ABC. When you press Simulate/Post an error message appears (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID):-'Initial capital. date must be in closed fiscal year; first opened year YYYY. Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated.' (YYYY represents the current, open fiscal year)-Or-'Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY must be in Fiscal Year XXXX for Fixed Asset ABC.' (DD.MM.YYYY represents the posting date maintained in the manual posting. XXXX represents the first, still open fiscal year which has not bee carried over yet)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the Fixed Asset ABC.-Press Manual Posting and select Retroactive Acquisition.-Define the Document Date and the Posting Date in the Current Year YYYY.-Enter the Initial Posting date in Fiscal Year YYYY.-Press Simulate/Post.-Cause-Retroactive capitalization is the revaluation of a fixed asset for which the acquisition costs were set too low in the past. If the fiscal year in which these acquisition costs should have been capitalized is now closed, then you can post the Retroactive capitalization.-The posting date of a Retroactive Capitalization must be in the first fiscal year open for posting, here YYYY. All other, previous fiscal years, such as XXXX, must be already carried over.-Note, Retroactive capitalization does not equate subsequent acquisition in the current fiscal year: If you need to post additional acquisition costs into the current fiscal year YYYY and do not need to revaluate the Fixed Asset's net value from its Initial Capitalization date, you can create a normal acquisition posting to increase the Fixed Asset's net value.-Resolution-Instead of Retroactive Acquisition select the Acquisition manual posting. Alternatively, use the Fixed Asset Procurement process to capitalize the Asset (by creating a Supplier Invoice or Goods receipt for the Fixed Asset's Individual Material.-To create a manual Acquisition via Journal Entry Voucher-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets - view.-Select the respective Fixed Asset.-Press Manual Posting and select Acquisition.-Define the Document Date and the Posting Date-In the Relating To field select 1 - Current Year.-Press Simulate/Post.-Keywords-Retroactive Capitalization, first opened fiscal year

Title: How to Enable the Pro Forma Invoice for Service Quote
Content: Symptom-You have enabled Service Quote function and want to print Pro-Forma Invoice based on service quote. But you are not able to find the option in the work center view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Service Quotes view.-Select any service quote, there is no option to create Pro Forma Invoice.-Cause-The Pro Forma Invoice based on Sales Quotes is not enabled. Service Quote and Sales Quote are sharing the same scope question. To enable the Pro Froma Invoice for service quote, you need to scope the question 'Pro Forma Invoice Based on Sales Quote'.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step 4 Questions, Open Sales -> Customer Invoicing ->Miscellaneous Invoicing, you can find the question 'Pro Forma Invoice Based on Sales Quote'.-Select it and finish the change.-Afterwards, the Pro Forma Invoice option will be available in Sales Quotes and Service Quotes view.-See Also-Relevant KBA:-2614403 - Pro-Forma Invoice Button Is Missing-2249179 - Errors When Creating a New Service Quote-1822749 - You are not Able to Generate the Proforma Invoice From a Sales Quotes-2545522 - Pro Forma Invoice Button is Not Enabled-Keywords-Pro-Forma Invoice; Service Quote; Sales Quote

Title: Unable to Delete Bank Accounts
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a Bank Account but there is no action available to perfom this.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work centre.-Go to the My Banks sub view .-Select the respective Bank and click Edit - Bank Accounts.-Under Actions you only have the options Block, Unblock and Close.-You can not find an activity to delete the Bank Account.-Cause-You are unable to delete a Bank Account because you can not delete Master Data.-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-In case the Bank Account is not blocked:-Select the respective Bank Account-Click Actions - Close-Save the changes-In case the Bank Account is already blocked:-Select the respective Bank Account-Click Actions - Unblock-Save the changes-Click Actions - Close-Save the changes-Once the Bank Account is in status Closed it is no longer considered for this bank.-Keywords-Bankkonten löschen, Bankkonto, Bankkonto sperren, gesperrt

Title: Standalone Selling Price of Revenue Accounting Contract Cannot be Changed
Content: Symptom-You cannot manually change the Standalone Selling Price of a Revenue Accounting Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Show Sales Order Items and select the respective Sales Document Item. Alternatively, enter the Revenue Accounting Contract ID in the Search field to display all Sales Order items assigned to this Revenue Accounting Contract.-From the Revenue Accounting Contract column click on the corresponding Revenue Accounting Contract ID to open it.-Go to the Manual Changes tab.-Here, the Change Standalone Selling Price column in grayed out. You cannot change the Standalone Selling Price.-Cause-The Standalone Selling Price is not editable for the Revenue Accounting Contract because the No Allocation checkbox in the Performance Obligations table is marked.-If the No Allocation indicator is set for Sales Document Items, then the item(s) do not influence the allocation basis of the Revenue Accounting Contract and, hence a manual entry for Standalone Selling Price is not available.-The No Allocation checkbox is marked because there is no Accrual Method assigned to the item(s) of the Sales Order.-In other words, the allocation basis is only relevant when a Sales Document Item has an Accrual Method assigned.-Resolution-You need to assign an Accrual Method to all the item(s) of the relevant Sales Order and then the Standalone Selling Price will be available for manual changes:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Search for the Revenue Accounting Contract to display all Sales Order items assigned to it.-Select a Sales Order item and navigate to the Accounting Data tab in the Details area.-Here, under Assignment of Accrual Method there is currently no Accrual Method assigned.-Now, in the top of the screen press Reassign and choose Accrual Method.-Assign an Accrual Method according to your business needs.*-*Note: The Accrual Method must be assigned to all Set of Books that the Company is associated with.-See Also-SAP ByDesign Community Blog: Special Topic: Derivation of SSP Standalone Selling price-Keywords-Change Standalone Selling Price, Revenue Accounting Contract, Standalone Selling Value - Manual

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Error: 'Fixed asset XXX cannot be locked since locked by ABC'
Content: Symptom-In the Inventory Valuation work center, when you try to do a GR/IR Clearing run the system returns the following error message:-'Fixed asset XXX cannot be locked since locked by ABC.'-*XXX represents the fixed asset ID.-*ABC represents the user ID/name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the GR/IR Clearing view.-Show all GR/IR Clearing Runs.-Find the relevant clearing run ID.-Open it.-A new tab will be opened, on the top right corner of the screen, click View All.-Go to subtab Processed with Errors.-You will see the error message displayed on the screen:-'Fixed asset XXX cannot be locked since locked by ABC.'-Cause-There are two possible causes for this error:-The GR/IR clearing run tries to make postings to the fixed assets. However, the operation was not possible because a user was already working on the respective asset XXX in edit mode.-The GR/IR clearing run uses parallel instances. When one of the parallel sequences is using the Fixed Asset under Construction, and another tries to access it, the error of a locked Fixed Asset is thrown. This happens when multiple project tasks are assigned to the same Fixed Asset.-Resolution-For the first scenario:-Restart the GR/IR clearing run when there are no users working on the relevant assets.-For the second scenario:-If you have done the first scenario but the error persists, check if the number of errors have reduced.  If it is reduced, keep running it until the number of errors reaches zero. Each time you run the GR/IR Clearing, some Project Tasks will be posted, hence, the number of errors will reduce each time.-Remark: notice that if you are executing the run in Test mode the number of errors won't decrease as the project tasks won't be posted. You should execute the run in Update mode.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing; fixed asset locked; parallel instances; AuC; Asset under construction; project task;

Title: The Approval Task For The Sales Order Remains Unassigned
Content: Symptom-The approval task for the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order) remains unassigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Go to the Business Task Management subview.-Show Unassigned Items.-You see that the approval task created for the sales order XYZ is unassigned.-Select the unassigned task for the sales order.-Open the application log XXX in the General subtab (XXX represents the ID of the log file).-You find two error messages in the Results section of the log:-"Employees without sufficient access rights for the item: Employee: ABC" (ABC represents the ID of the employee).-"No employee has sufficient access rights".-Cause-The employee ABC who is the approver for the sales order is not assigned to the Sales Orders work center.-Resolution-Go to the Application and user Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view.-Show All Business Users and find ABC.-Select the business user ABC and choose Edit button > select Access Rights.-Go to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Assign the CRM_WOC_SALESORDERS work center and the CRM_SALESORDERS view to the user.-Click Save and Close button.-See Also-2807601 - Sales Order Approval Notifications are not Sent for the Approver.-Keywords-responsible person, Genehmigungsaufgabe, Verantwortlicher, Kundenauftrag,

Title: Posted Amount Differs From Cross-Check Balances Amount in Inventory Migration
Content: Symptom-When you are checking inventory migration Cross-Check Balances, you see that the Inventory G/L account balance is aaa.bb ZZZ(aaa.bb represents the cross-check balance amount, ZZZ represents the currency). After successful import, you check the balance in the general ledger and find that the inventory G/L account balance is aaa.cc ZZZ(aaa.cc represents the posted amount, ZZZ represents the currency).-For example, you're migrating inventory of material ABC(ABC represents the material ID). Perpetual Cost Method of Material ABC is Moving Average. Material unit cost is 141856.19 CNY/ 10000 EA.-In the migration file, you entered two lines for the material ABC. One line is 45 EA and one line is 165 EA.-The Cross-Check Balances is 2,978.98 CNY, however, the posted amount is 2,978.97 CNY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select inventory migration relevant title and click on Cross-Check Balances Preview.-You see the balance of Inventroy G/L account is 2,978.98 CNY.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to General Ledger Accounts view.-Input required parameters to search out the Inventroy G/L account balance, you see the Account Balance is 2,978.97 CNY.-Cause-When the migrated material uses the Moving Average perpetual cost method and the material in the migration file has multiple rows of data, amounts will be different due to rounding.-If you check the inventory cost history for material ABC you will see that the migration to inventory happens in two steps. First 45 EA is capitalized at a cost rate of 14.185619 (141856.19 CNY/ 10000 EA) which leads to a capitalization of 638.35 CNY after rounding. Now as the costing method is moving average, the new cost rate becomes 638.35 / 45 = 14.185556. Hence the next 165 ea is capitalized at this new cost rate leading to a capitalization of 165 * 14.185556 = 2340.62 after rounding. Therefore, the resulting posted amount is 638.35+2340.62=2978.97 CNY.-In the migration simulation, the system only calculated the total amount according to the inventory cost 14.185619 before posting 45 EA. Therefore, Cross-Check Balances amount is (45+165)*14.185619=2978.98 CNY.-This is leading to the rounding difference.-Resolution-System behaves as designed. You can try to combine the data of the same material on one line to avoid rounding difference.-Keywords-Inventory migration

Title: Add-in doen't save the previous user credentials after switching to another user
Content: Symptom-For Add-ins such as Lotus notes, Outlook or Excel, the user name and password of the previous user is not saved, even if when you check the option “Remember my user name and password”.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click on 'Log on' button from the add-in (Outlook add-in or Excel add-in or Lotus notes)-Enter system url, name (for example: USER A) and password.-Check the option "Remember my user name and password" and click logon.-The Add-in will remember the credentials for this user and the user will be logged on when clicked on log on every time.-Now use a different user name (for example: USER B) and password. Also check the option "Remember my user name and password".-The Add-in saves the credentials and logon works fine without any issue.-Now again change the user from USER B to USER A.-Here, the add-in will not remember the previous user's credentials. You will have to enter the credentials again to logon.-Cause-The Add-in is built in a way that only one user's credentials are saved.-Resolution-Multiple users are not supported in add-in and this is the expected behaviour.-Keywords-remember user name and password, logon, add-in, Lotus notes

Title: Error Message: Missing Entry in Mandatory Field Country of Cust./Suppl. for SEPA Credit Transfer
Content: Symptom-When processing a payment, you receive the following error messages:-"Missing entry in mandatory field Country of cust./suppl. ABC (ABC is the cust./supplier/ business partner ID) for SEPA Credit Transfer."-"Technical error FOP_PAYMED_PREP 024."-"Payment details not determined."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management or the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for the Payment ID XYZ (XYZ is the Payment ID) and select it.-The Payment is in status In Preparation, the Payment method is Outgoing Bank Transfer, there is no Bank Account ID being displayed.-Click the Payment ID to open it and then View All.-You get the following error messages: "Payment method or bank not available." "Payment details not determined."-Enter the Bank Account ID as EFG (EFG is the Bank Account ID).-You get the error message: "Technical error FOP_PAYMED_PREP 024."-Click the Check Button.-You get the following error messages:-"Missing entry in mandatory field Country of cust./suppl. ABC for SEPA Credit Transfer."-"Technical error FOP_PAYMED_PREP 024."-"Payment details not determined."-Cause-The error message is due to missing address information in the business partner master data of the payee.-You can check this as follows:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Search for the business partner ABC and select it.-Click Edit Addresses.-No address has been maintained.-Resolution-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Search for the respective business partner.-Press Edit Addresses.-In the  Addresses tab choose Add Row tab to maintain the address.-Save the new address.-Now you will be able to post the payment.-Keywords-Technischen Fehler bei Zahlung; Zahlung; payment; bank statement; Kontoauszug

Title: How to Find the XML File of Balance Confirmations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to find the XML File of a Balance Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The XML File can be found using the below steps:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer view -> Balance Confirmation.-Select the row of any Not Released Balance Confirmation.-Click Preview -> Send Options (Here you can change the template to the desired one or skip this step if the selected template is the correct one).-Select Send By as Printer.-Click Apply.-Click Release.-Observation: The above steps can also be used for Balance Confirmations of Payables.-Once the Balance Confirmation is released:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Work view -> Manual Print Tasks.-Here you should see the document in the list (Balance Notification).-Select the relevant now.-Under Attachments section you can open and check the XML File of the Balance Notification.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation, XML, Balance Notification.

Title: Requirements for Installing Client Side Microsoft Outlook Add-in
Content: Symptom-Before installing the Cloud for Customer or Business ByDesign client side Outlook Add-In, make sure your computer has the following requirements.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Please find the below information on supported versions of Microsoft Office for Outlook Add-in to work.-Microsoft Office® support:-Outlook Version-Types Supported-Outlook 2019-Office Professional Plus-Office 365 ProPlus-Outlook 2016-Office Professional Plus-Office 365 ProPlus-Outlook 2013 (32-Bit or 64-Bit)-Office Professional Plus-Office 365 ProPlus-Outlook 2010 (32-Bit or 64-Bit)-Office Professional Plus-Professional-Standard-Note:-Microsoft Exchange™ 2010 and 2013 are supported.-Microsoft .Net Framework 4.6.2 (Installer)-Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 Tools for Office Runtime (VSTOR 2010) Redistributable (x86)-Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 Tools for Office Runtime (VSTOR 2010) Redistributable (x64)-Microsoft Windows Operating System up to and including Windows 10-Keywords-Outlook Add-in; pre-requisites outlook ; client side outlook add-in

Title: How to Identify Cost Rate Changes for Services from the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You need to check which user has changed the Cost Rate of a Service. However, there is no Cost Rate change information available in the Service Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Services view*.-Search and open the Service you would like to check.-In the Valuation tab you notice that the Cost Rate of the Service has been changed.-Navigate to the Changes tab.-There is no Cost Rate change available.-*You can access Service master data in several areas, such as the Product and Service Portfolio or the Product Data work center.-Cause-Currently, the Change log of Service Master Data does not provide any information on Cost Rate changes. This information can only be found via backend analysis.-Resolution-Take note of the Service ID.-Access STFK.-Go to SESFTS transaction and load the BO FIA_SERVPROD_VALU_DATA.-Choose Load by Query and select COST_RATE - QUERY_BY_DATE.-In the SERVICE_PRODUCT_KEY_PRODUCT_ID-CONTENT field enter the Service ID and press Enter.-Select the Table view.-The list will show all the changes done for the cost rate of the service.-To find out who made a change select the respective line and choose Navigate.-Either select  CREATION_IDENTITY or LAST_CHANGE_IDENTITY.-The User ID and User Name are displayed in the ID_CONTENT and FORMATTED_NAME field.-Keywords-Cost Rate Change Service, Service Change log Cost rate-cost rate change user service

Title: Unposted Production Confirmation - Default entry without acc. det. group: G/L account missing for services
Content: Symptom-You notice an unposted source document for which an error message is displayed: 'Default entry without acc. det. group: G/L account missing for services'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-You find an unposted Production Confirmation here for which the error message is displayed in the Messages area 'Default entry without acc. det. group: G/L account missing for services'.-Cause-In the production confirmation, resources can confirm their work without providing a special service. If a service is involved, then the respective G/L account is derived using the account determination group of this service. If no service is involved, then the G/L account is derived using the default entry in Account Determination.-Resolution-To maintain a Default Account Determination for Services:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose Open Activity List.-In the Activity List search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, select it and press Open.-Under the section Account Determination, click Costs.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-In the Service tab press Add Row.-Leave the Account Determination Group for Services empty.-In the Credit for Internal Services as well as the  Debit for Internal Services column maintain the relevant G/L Account.-In the Expenses for External Services also select the relevant G/L Account.-Press Save and Close.-Now you are able to post the Unposted Source Document:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, the production confirmation.-Select the ID and press Actions and select Post Business Transaction-Remark: ensure the month that you intend to post the unposted source document is open.-Keywords-Default entry without account determination group; G/L account missing for services; production confirmation; costs;

Title: UI Path for the Microsoft Office Templates
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to know where the Microsoft Office Template is being used in the UI(Application Area).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management.-Click on Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance.-Look up for the required Template.-Cause-The where used path for the above template is nowhere found in the screen.-Resolution-Open SE38 and enter the program FLX_TMPL_CHANGE_TOOL_NEW and execute(F8).-Switch to tab 'Download Variants'.-Do F4 help on field Group Code.-In the pop up screen, search for the required template e.g. Payment Approval Outgoing Payments.-Copy the value available in the Group Code e.g. XLS_FIN_FDT_PAY_APPROV.-Open SE16 and enter table APXR_EXTREFU and enter group code copied above to the field OBJ_URI and hit F8.-Copy the CONT_ID.-Open the table APXR_AHEADERU. Enter the copied value above and paste in CONT_ID field and hit F8.-Double click on the any of the field of the row.-Now the field 'FilePath' Shows the path where the template is being used. e.g. '/SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/fin/pm/fdtpayapprovqaf.QA.uicomponent'.-The above can be interpreted as 'Business Configuration Activity : Business Task Management for Payment and Liquidity Management -> Payment Ap-proval - Outgoing Payments.'-The same can be applied to any of the templates.-Keywords-Microsoft Office Template

Title: New Description Doesn't Appear on The Sales Document
Content: Symptom-You have entered an item on your sales document, but the new description maintained before, is not being shown on the sales document.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-Checking the Sales Order.-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Orders document ABC (ABC represents your Sales Orders Document ID).-Click on Edit and View All button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Enter the Product EFG (EFG represents your Product ID).-Result: The system is bringing the old description instead of the new one.-Cause-There are 3 material descriptions for this product in the system.-Each one is created for a different language, English, Spanish and German. As the account language is Spanish, the product description language which would be picked up is Spanish.-The product description for this language probably was not changed and remains the old one.-This is the reason why you are still seeing the old description.-Resolution-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Search for the Product ID EFG. -Click on Edit and View All button.-Navigate to the General tab.-Navigate to the Other languages sub tab.-You will see that there are other languages maintained and these have the old product description.-Change the description to the desired one and save the product details.-With this action would be able to see the correct description on the Sales Document.-Keywords-Product; Description; Sales Order; Invoice; Product and Service Portfolio

Title: Unable to Update State/Region for Accounts Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are trying to update the State/Region field for Accounts but you are getting the error  'Customers with invalid data found', but it is possible to manually select that State from the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select the link to import Customers.-Upload the particular file (using which you are updating the State/Region).-In the Validation step we get the error 'Customers with invalid data found'.-Cause-There are some issues with translation object for several Regions.-Resolution-As a workaround you can enter the code value of the state/Region.-The code value can be found in the Business Configuration Regions activity.-We have kept this as our enhancement backlog and we will try to fix it in one of our future releases.-Keywords-Customers with invalid data found; mass data maintenance; account management

Title: How to Check the Values of Extension Field in a Backend Table
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-How to check all values filled for an extension field in a table.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Access the backend and go to /n/ext/field and search for the field label.-Copy and save the Field ID.-In Field Metadata tab, in the section Persistences, click in the puzzle icon.-A new screen will be opened. Adjust the value on the field Maximum No. of Hits, or let it empty to load all items (recommended).-Click in Execute (F8).-A new screen with a table will be displayed with all extension fields available for the system.-Use the Field ID to localize the extension field that you are looking for.-You can use the option Change Layout (Ctrl+F8) to order the columns.-And also use Set Filter (Ctrl+F5) to add some search criteria.-Please refer the images below and the steps numbers.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."

Title: Non-Localized Country: System Crashes in Withholding Tax Tab in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-For a non-localized country, the system crashes when you click Add Row under Withholding Tax tab > Tax subledger in Business Configuration activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click to open the Tax subledger.-Select the row of the Account Determination Profile to be assigned to the referred non-localized country.-Click Assign Countries to Profile.-Click Add Row.-Select the respective non-localized country.-Click OK.-Under Withholding Tax tab, click Add Row.-System crashes.-Cause-The system crashes because the assignment of the non-localized country to the account determination profile was not saved. There's a save-in-between action which is required after you perform Assign Country to Profile action and before you maintain the Withholding Tax account determination setup.-Resolution-After selecting the non-localized country and clicking OK (step #9 above) you should click Save to save the assignment. After that you can click Add Row under Withholding Tax tab and proceed with the configuration.-See Also-Related KBA: 2692126 - Non-Localized Country: No Withholding Tax Tab Displayed in Tax Subledger in Business Configuration-Keywords-withholding tax tab; non-localized country; tax type; withholding tax

Title: Error Message When Trying to Migrate Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform a migration for Fixed Assets, but you keep having these error messages at the step 3, when executing the import.- 'Master fixed asset not found for inventory ID'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool option.-Click on Create Unit.-Enter Data and file for the migration.-Execute the migration.-At step 3, when you Start Import, the system throws the error.-Cause-The issue occurs because the Master Inventory ID column should only be filled if this is a sub-asset and the Master Fixed Asset has already been created, or is earlier than this record on the sheet.-Resolution-Remove this entry from Master Inventory ID or correct it to one that is correct within the system.-Keywords-Master. Fixed Asset. Inventory ID. Migration.

Title: Payee Address Shows Different in Overview and in Payment Document
Content: Symptom-When selecting a payment in the Payment Monitor, in the section Details, the system shows one address. But when you click in the document ID and the document is open, under the same Payee Data area, the system shows another address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Select the payment row that you see the inconsistency.-Under Details section, you can see address for Payee.-Open the payment document.-Under Payee section, you can see there is a different address.-Cause-In the Supplier master data under the Communication tab, you can see that the Payee Option is marked as NO for Main Address and Yes(Standard) for Other address, hence this is causing the behavior. If Payee option is set as Yes(Standard) for Main Address, and Yes/No for Other Address, the system should display only Main Address in Payment Monitor, as well as its Overview.-Resolution-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the Supplier account master data.-Click in View All.-Go to Communication tab, Addresses subtab.-Once you are there, you can set the Payee option as Yes(Standard) for Main Address. This way, the system will consider this address for the Payee Address in Payment and in Overview, and no inconsistencies will be shown.-Keywords-Payee. Address. Outgoing Check. Payment. Monitor. Supplier.

Title: Error Message for VAT Return in SII Declaration
Content: Symptom-Some invoices are not included in the VAT Return and you cannot identify the reason why, as they are correctly posted, from the accounting point of view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-You have run the VAT Return Run ABC (where ABC represents the ID of the run) and it has generated a VAT Return DEF (where DEF represents the Return ID) for SII Declaration.-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Go to VAT Return Run view.-You search for return DEF and open it.-Click in View All.-Go to Returns tab.-You check the list of invoices, but not all relevant documents are listed there.-Cause-If you check the Application Log for the Return runs, you will see the warning message 'Tax number missing for business partner XYZ' (where XYZ represents the Business Partner ID and name).-This message means that there is no relevant Tax Number (VAT/NIF/CIF/NIE) for this Business Partner within its master data.-Resolution-Go to the master data of Business Partner XYZ and add any one the Tax Numbers for this partner.-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the Master Data.-Go to Financial Data tab.-Under Financial Data, go to Tax Data subtab.-Add a relevant Tax Number for this supplier.-Save it.-Reschedule the VAT Return Run.-Keywords-SII. Run. VAT Return. IVA. Declaración. Autoridad Fiscal. Spain. Factura. Invoice. Supplier. Proveedor. Falta el número de identificación fiscal para el socio comercial.

Title: Origin of the Overridden Tax Amount in the All VAT / Sales Tax Items With Journal Entry Details Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to know where the Overridden Tax Amount in the 'All VAT / Sales Tax Items With Journal Entry Details' report is coming from.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In this case the Overridden Tax Amount is due to rounding difference distribution.-The transaction currency and the reporting currency is different, therefore the System will calculate the values applying an exchange rate.-Applying the exchange rate results in rounding differences that are distributed among the transactions.-Resolution-You can check this rounding difference by adding the following Key Figures to the report and comparing the values shown.--Tax Amount--Internal Tax Amount-Keywords-Tax Amount; Overridden; Report; Sales; Rounding; Distribution; Key Figure; Difference; Values

Title: Unable To Select Multiple Payee Addresses for Customer
Content: Symptom-You have maintained multiple addresses in customer master data. Now you want to make two or more addresses as main addresses for Payee. So that you can choose any address while creating a payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customers view.-Select the respective customer account.-Click Edit.-Go to the Communication tab.-In the Addresses tab you have maintained multiple addresses and you want to make two or more addresses as main addresses for Payee.-Cause-Please notice that system will allow only one address as a Payee main address. If you want to make main/permanent address then you have to select the option Yes (Standard) from the dropdown list. For any future communication system will fetch this address and communicate.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior and cannot be changed in future releases.-Remark: For your understanding, when you go to open saving account in any bank, they will ask you to provide office address and residence address. However, they will make only one address as a main address, which means bank will send your debit or credit card and checks to only one address. They will never send to both the addresses.-Keywords-Payee; Address; Main; Yes (Standard);

Title: "An MDCI Implementation (from Business Object) Has Rejected the Save" Error During Migration of Personnel Data
Content: Symptom-During the migration of employee Personnel Administration Data, the following error message is raised in the simulation step.-"An MDCI implementation (from Business Object) has Rejected the Save"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list of the project.-Search for the activity Migration of Employees.-Click on Migrate Employee Personnel Data using the Migration Tool.-Inside the migration tool, upload the migration template with data.-Click on Execute Migration -> Step-by-step.-Proceed to the step 3 - Simulation.-After the simulation, the error message is raised.-Cause-This error is raised because the hire date of the employee is prior to the date when the pre-delivered content of the system for Germany was deployed. The content for Germany was delivered in the system in 2006, so any employee with a hire date that is before 2006 will cause this error.-Resolution-In order to fix the issue, maintain the employee hire date field in the migration template with a date after 01.01.2006.-Keywords-Personal file, migration

Title: Payment Method Missing for Employee
Content: Symptom-You are trying to setup payment methods information for an employee, however no other method aside from bank account is available for selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Navigate to the Employees view.-Select an employee and click on Edit.-Enter the Personal Data tab, and navigate to the Payment Information sub-tab.-In this screen, it is not possible to add other methods of payment, only bank accounts.-Cause-This behavior occurs because the employee was hired from the Regular Tasks of Germany country. Because of that, the employee has a German personal file, which does not support other payment methods.-Resolution-To have the correct country personal file assigned to the employee, make sure that the respective country is selected from the list inside the Regular Tasks screen.-Keywords-payment information, payroll information

Title: Approved and Released Customer Invoice With Open Approval Tasks
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice) is approved and released. For one or several business users there are open approval tasks remaining in the Managing My Area workcenter. When accessing the approval task, the Approve button is greyed out and the task cannot be completed by the business user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select Show All Documents.-In the Find field enter Invoice ID ABC.-You can see the invoice listed in the OWL with status Approved and Released.- Go to the Application and User Management Workcenter.-Go to the Business Task management View.-Select Show All Items.-In the Find field enter Invoice ID ABC.-You can see Approval Tasks in the OWL that are still with status In Process.- Resolution-The Invoice is already approved and released. Therefore, we can complete the open approval tasks manually from the backend:-Enter the backend via the STFK connection.-Use transaction code SBTM_TASK_SEL to access the BTM Task Instance Selection.-To refine your search enter a time frame in the Creation Time fields, if you have this information.-You can also filter on Task type: CRM_CI_APPROVE in Selection Based on Task Type Properties.-In the Maximum No. of hits field, increase the number of displayed search results if necessary.-Click Execute.-In the displayed list, search for the relevant approval task for the invoice ABC with status Started.-Select the line of the open approval task.-In the header bar above, chose the button with the flag with the function Complete Task instance(s).-This sets the status of the approval task to Complete and any open approval tasks no longer remain in the Managing My Area workcenter for the business user.-  Keywords-tâche d'approbation, facture client, bloquée, bouton, grisé, stuck, greyed out, approbateur, approver, approval processes, processus d'approbation, delete customer invoice approval task, remove approval task-transaction code,sbtm_task_sel,crm_ci_approve,backend

Title: Definition of Standard Queries in Registered Products View
Content: Symptom-Definition of the queries in the Registered Products view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlement work center.-Go to the Registered Products view.-From Show list, you can see some queries provided by SAP and you want to know the definition of these queries.-Products Running /Ran out of warranty-All Registered Product Disclosure-All Registered Products-Cause-1. Products Running /Ran out of warranty - Displays all the registered products for which Warranty has already expired or the warranty will expire in next 28 days.- -2. All Registered Product Disclosure - Automatically fires the query and displays all the registered products which are associated to a party(customer), when the Data Privacy Officer uses the Personal Data Disclosure view to display the relevant registered products for a business partner(Customer). This Query is purely designed for GDPR functionality.-3. All Registered Products - Displays all the registered products available in the system when the user executes the query explicitly. Since a system can have huge amount of registered products over the time period, we expect the customer to fill few search fields (like ID or Reference Product or Status) and execute the query manually.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-Registered Products; Queries; Definition

Title: Quota Account Balance is Not Carried Forward
Content: Symptom-Quota Account balance is not carried forward as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select an employee and Edit.-Navigate to Time Account Balances.-In Time Account column you need to select the required current years Quota Account XXX (where XXX represents Quota Account) and check the corresponding Balance column.-Here you observe that the Balance is less than or greater than the expected hours.-Cause-The previous years Quota Account YYY(where YYY represents Quota Account) has Bookable Period from start of Time Account to the end of March of the following year.--Thus for the Quota Account YYY, the processing will happen on 31st March of current year and on this date the balance hours will get carried forwarded to the current Quota Account XXX.-Resolution-The system behaves as per the Quota Account configuration.-Keywords-Quota Account, Carried Forward

Title: How to Exclude Project Task in Time sheet for an Employee?
Content: Symptom-You use cost collectors for different cost centers for collecting internal times which have the same structure.-Employee can see multiple Project tasks with the same description in the value help in the employee time sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Team work center-Select Edit Timesheet-Select Add Time Entry-The value help for work package task shows 2 tasks with same name-Cause-When an employee gets reassigned to another cost center, he also gets staffed on another cost collector. Therefore he would now see two Project Tasks with the same description.-This is the standard behavior.-Resolution-As a work around, Employees can manage the worklist in order to avoid confusion between the Project Tasks.This will be a one time activity for the employee. Please follow below steps:-Go to Home Work center-Click on view Self Service Overview-Click on Edit Time Sheet-Click on Button Manage My Worklist, Select the project task which belongs to Project from old Cost Center-Click on Action -> select Hide in Time Sheet-This will not default this Project Task in the Time Sheet and will help in avoiding the confusion between the old and the new project task of similar description.-Keywords-Project Task, Time sheet, Duplicate Task

Title: Financial Reporting Structure Excel Download does not Comprise G/L Account Descriptions
Content: Symptom-The descriptions of the G/L Accounts are not present in the Financial Reporting Structure Excel file downloaded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1902-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the respective Financial Reporting Structure and click Export to Microsoft Excel.-Open the Excel file (.xlsx) and notice that the G/L Account descriptions are not present under Item column.-Resolution-The system behaves as expected in this case. In the current ByDesign version the Financial Reporting Structure Excel Download functionality does not comprise the G/L Account descriptions, only the G/L Account IDs.-Keywords-Financial Reporting Structure; G/L Account description; Excel download; xlsx; xls

Title: How to Include Attachments in the Output Document to Customer in Sales Quotes and Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to send attachments along with the output document to your customers in Sales Quotes and Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-N/A-Cause-You need to select option 'Include in Output' when adding the attachment.-Resolution-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Edit one certain sales quote and go to the Attachments tab.-Click 'Add - File' button, in the pop-up windown, use Brower to select a file, in the lower part of the windown, tick the option 'Include in Output?'. Click Add button again, this file is then added into the quote.-Click 'You Can Also - Edit Output Settings' button, you can check the output details. Click the Attachments tab, the added file/attachment is displayed in the output.-Once you submit this sales quote, the attachment will be sent to the customer along with the output document. Same behavior in sales orders.-Keywords-output; attachment; confirmation to customer; sales

Title: Line Items Missing in a Journal Entry for Goods and Services Receipt
Content: Symptom-The journal entry posted for a goods and services receipt is missing line items related to the material items of the business document. Only line items related to the service items are present in the journal entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to the Receipts and Returns > Show by Documents view.-Select show list All Documents.-Search and open goods and services receipt XXX (XXX means the goods and services receipt ID).-Click View All.-Open the Document Flow.-Click the journal entry icon.-Notice that a journal entry of type 00042 - External Service Confirmation is opened. In this journal entry, only postings related to the goods and services receipt service items are present.-Cause-The goods and services receipt XXX contains items of types Material and Service. System creates separated journal entries for each type of item. For service items a journal entry of type 00042 - External Service Confirmation is created, while for material items, a journal entry of type 00029 - Goods Receipt from Supplier is created. By clicking the journal entry icon in the document flow of goods and services receipt, the External Service Confirmation journal entry is opened, and you will see the Goods Receipt from Supplier journal entry listed under Related Journal Entries section.-Resolution-System behaves as designed here.-Keywords-service; direct; material; non-stock; external service confirmation; goods receipt from supplier; related journal entries;

Title: How to Change the Language of the Reporting Runs CSV File Created
Content: Symptom-You create a CSV file report using the Reporting Runs functionality.-The CSV file report has been created in the wrong language and you want to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The CSV file resulting from using the Reporting Runs functionality is created in the language that is assigned to the Business User that has executed the report.-For example, if the relevant Business User has English set up as the default language in the User Profile, then the CSV file will be created in English.-Resolution-You need to change the language assigned to the Business User so it matches the language you want the CSV file to be created on.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Go to the Business Users subview.-Find the relevant Business User ID.-Click on the Edit button.-Select the Attributes option.-Under Language box display the drop-down menu.-Select the desired language.-Click on the Save button.--After the language change has been performed you can create a new CSV file report.-See Also-For more information on how to use the Reporting Runs functionality, please refer to the KBA 2534805 - Reporting Runs usability.-You can also find more information in the built-in document called 'Reporting Runs' that you can find in the Help Center.-Keywords-Reporting Runs, Language, Change, CSV, File

Title: The Goods and Services Receipt is Not Posted Due to Error Message: Cannot Find Account Determination Group for Product Category
Content: Symptom-In the General Ledger work center, the goods and service receipt is shown in the Unposted Source Documents list, the error message is: Cannot Find Account Determination Group for Product Category. But the goods and service receipt document is for fixed asset procurement process, you feel the system should not give such an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Select the not posted goods and services receipt document in question.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the same error message: Cannot Find Account Determination Group for Product Category XYZ.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and choose the common task Edit Asset Class Determination.-You can see that product category XYZ (XYZ means the Product Category ID) is assigned with a Fixed Asset Class, so the system should not give error message: Cannot Find Account Determination Group for Product Category XYZ, which looks for an expense account.-Cause-Starting from ByDesign 3.5 release, it is possible to purchase several individual materials that belong to each other and will be treated as one fixed asset in the system. If you create a purchase order, goods receipt, or supplier invoice with a product category for fixed assets, you can now create new individual materials directly in the purchase order, and you can also create a purchase order for an individual material that represents an existing fixed asset. If the individual material is not created in the related purchase order, later on, you can also create the individual material in the goods and service receipt document. When the goods receipt is posted, the system uses the derivation rule together with the Company and Product Category to determine the relevant asset class, and creates a fixed asset with its assigned individual material.-If a new individual material is not created, or the account assignment type in the purchase order is not set as Individual Material, then the system will not post the item as fixed asset but as expense even though the Product Category is assigned with a Fixed Asset Class.
