Title: Field Product Tax Category for U.S is not Available in the Migration of Services or Migration of Materials Template
Content: Symptom-You want to update the Product Tax Category for U.S. for Services using the migration tool in Business Configuration. But the field Product Tax Category for U.S. is not available in the migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Services or Migration of Materials.-Select the link Migrate Services using the Migration Tool respectivly Migrate Materials using the Migration Tool.-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen and click on Download Migration Template.-The field Product Tax Category for U.S. is not available in the migration file.-Cause-Update of Product Tax Category for U.S. is not supported using Migration.-Resolution-You may perform the Mass Change of Product Tax Category for U.S. using the below steps:-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Products view.-Select the By Services or By Materials subview.-Select the relevant Services or Materials.-Select Mass Change.-Show General.-Select Start Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen.-Show Children of the relevant table.-Mark the field Product Tax Category for U.S. as Visible.-Select Save and Stop Personalization Mode.-Fill the required information.-Apply Mass Change for Selected Items or for All Items.-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-Mass Change, Services, Migration of Services, Product Tax Category for U.S.

Title: Error "Sequence of Activity Types Below Operation XYZ Not Valid" in Migration of Bills of Operations
Content: Symptom-When migrating Bills of Operations, the migration tool raises an error in the simulation step:-"Sequence of Activity Types Below Operation XYZ not Valid" (XYZ represents the ID of the operation in the migration template)-Environment-SAP Hybris Business ByDesign - 1805 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview view, search for Migration of Bills of Operations.-Click on Migrate Bills of Operations Using the Migration Tool.-Click on Upload and upload the migration template with bills of operations data.-After uploading, click on the button Execute Migration -> Step by Step.-Proceed to the step 3 - Simulation.-After the simulation, the error message is raised.-Cause-The error is raised because if there is a setup and a produce activity in the bill of operations, then the setup activity needs to be listed first in the migration template.-Resolution-Using the field Row Number and the Activity ID, make sure that the setup activity is the first for every bill of operations inside the template.-Keywords-Migration Workbench, Sequence, Productive

Title: SAP Solution Manager Content Activation from 7.1 to 7.2: migration of executable variants
Content: Symptom-For Content Activation of SAP Solution Manager 7.1 SOLAR content to SAP Solution Manager 7.2 Solution Documentation content, a migration mechanism for executable variants is not available.-Environment-In SAP Solution Manager 7.1, executable variants are available for some executable types (for example transactions or reports). Those executable variants in SAP Solution Manager 7.1 can be used like any other executable type (in the transaction tab, as a test object, as key for global attributes and object links).-In Solution Documentation of SAP Solution Manger 7.2, executable variants are not a preferred solution. However, on an executable Process Step level, Solution Documentation provides mechanisms to build Process Step variants in two different flavors:-Re-usable Process Step variants: In the Process Step library define multiple Process Step originals for the same executable original. These multiple Process Step originals can then be used to create de-facto-variants for the same executable.--Local Process Step variants: Within the end-to-end business process assign local properties (assignments and attributes) to Process Step originals thereby creating local Process Step variants. -Resolution-In SAP Solution Manager 7.1, the intended use of executable variants had always been at Process Step level only. However, executable variants could be used in SAP Solution Manager 7.1 at all structure nodes within a transaction tab. Nevertheless, the intended use had always been to assign executable variants at Process Step level only.-Therefore, we provide in the guided procedure for content activation a migration mechanism only for executable variants which are assigned at process step level. The executable variants assigned at any other level are not migrated.-In SAP Solution Manager 7.2, executable variants at Process Step level only are strictly enforced. Therefore, a migration workaround is established for SAP Solution Manager 7.1 executable variants which are not defined on Process Step level. This workaround is described in the following.-Basic Idea of the Migration Workaround-The migration of a process step with executable variants in 7.1 leads to a couple of process steps (one basic process step for the base executable and one additional “variant” process step for each executable variant). All specific information related to executable variants are kept (assigned TBOMs and the executable variants as test objects) and assigned to the corresponding additional “variant” process steps.-Note that the migration of executable variants is restricted to executable variants of the transaction tab of process steps. Any other executable variant is not subject of migration, that means they are ignored in the business blueprint migration.-Algorithm of the Migration Workaround-For each executable variant V for a base executable Exe within the transaction tab of a process step PS within process P, the migration works as described in the following algorithm:-In addition to the standard process step original PS created in the process step library, a “variant” process step original PS-V is created in the process step library.-The title of the “variant” process step combines the titles of the process step and the executable variant.--In addition to the reference to standard process PS within P, a reference process step PS-V is added within P.--All assignments of the process step PS which are not depending on an executable variant, are replicated in the process step original PS-V.--In particular the base executable Exe contained in the transaction tab is migrated to a reference into the executable original Exe in the executable library.--Those assignments of the process step PS which are depending on the executable variant V are also assigned to the process step original PS-V.--A TBOM assigned to the executable variant V is migrated as child of the reference to Exe within the process step original PS-V.-Any test case with test object V is also assigned to process step original PS-V.--The executable variant V is not directly migrated to any target element.-Example for a Migration Workaround-Source Blueprint in 7.1-In our example, there are two transaction variants VarA and VarB for the transaction VA01 within a process step PS1. The process step contains two variant specific TBOMs TB_A and TB_B and a variant specific test case TC1. In addition, the process step has a transaction variant independent assignment of document D1.-Target Solution Documentation in 7.2-The Solution Documentation of the migration target has three process step originals in a specific process step folder Folder PS1: the basic step PS1 and two “variant” steps PS1-VarA and PS1-VarB. The variant independent assignment of document D1 is replicated at all process step originals.-All process step original share an assignment of transaction original VA01. The transaction variant specific test case TC1 and TBOMs TB_A and TB_B are assigned only at the corresponding “variant” process step originals PS1-VarA resp. PS1-VarB.-Manual Task to improve the Migration Result-The migration algorithm described above leads to some redundancies in the target Solution Documentation. Manual reworking respectively refactoring tasks have to be performed in the Solution Documentation in order to achieve a high quality Solution Documentation. In particular, the following manual tasks have to be done:-Merge redundant process step originals in the process step library.--Clean up the process step references for the different variants within the processes or revise of the corresponding process diagrams accordingly.-Advantages of the Migration Workaround-The advantages of the migration workaround are:-You keep all variant specific TBOMs and assignments (at process step level).--You keep the variant specific test case assignments (at process step level).--You provide an initial definition of variants as re-usable process step originals.-Keywords-content migration, executable variants, varianten, tranportieren, transport, transfer, Kontent,

Title: How to Use Report Forecasted Utilization for Service Agents
Content: Symptom-The requirement is to use the HCMRPMU01_Q0001 – Forecast Utilization for Service Agents report. However, the report currently displays only employees, while information related to service agents’ availability and commitments is required for extraction. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for HCMRPMU01_Q0001.-Open the report.-Only employees are seen in this report.-Cause-The Forecasted Utilization report displays the availability and commitments of both Internal Employees and Service Agents (External Employees).-If only employees are displayed in the report, it indicates that the required Organizational and Job Assignment information may be missing for the Service Agents in the system.-Resolution-Assign the Organizational Unit and Job to the relevant Service Agents.-If commitments are maintained for those Service Agents, they will be visible in the report. -Keywords-external workers, contractors, resource planning, capacity planning, staffing, headcount planning, work center navigation, report filters, utilization analysis, resource utilization, time allocation, workforce utilization ,HCMRPMU01_Q0001

Title: Error Message: “Exception occurred. Contact your system administrator.” While Trying to Upload Suppliers Using Microsoft Excel Approach
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to upload Suppliers using Excel Add-in. For example, you want to upload Suppliers for the Country CI - Cote d'Ivoire. During the upload process, you get below mentioned error:-Exception occurred. Contact your system administrator.-Update operation failed: Error during Maintain operation:'/SAP_BYD_CodeList/CodeListItem/DisplayAs[.='CI - Cote d'Ivoire']/../Code' has an invalid token.]]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base workcenter-Go to Suppliers view-Select New -> Suppliers From Microsoft Excel-Download the Suppliers XML template-Fill the details-Upload the file using Excel Add-in-System throws errors-Cause-Some of the characters are not allowed while the data is converted to XML. The XML mapping property of the Microsoft Excel does not allow the char ( ' ) in the code list. The single quote is treated as invalid character.-Resolution-To overcome the issue, you may use any of the options below:-1. If the single quote ( ‘ ) in the Country code name is replaced with the ( ` ) the upload will work as expected.-2. You may use the List Of Suppliers Template.xlsx which is attached to this document where, the Country Name which is displayed in the excel would be different (code will be same), however when it is uploaded into the system the Country Name will be stored as expected.-You may refer the blog Office/Excel Integration for Hybris Cloud for Customers and Business ByDesign FAQs for the details.-Keywords-Upload Suppliers using excel add-in, Upload Suppliers, Update operation failed, Error during Maintain operation, Code' has an invalid token, Cote d'Ivoire

Title: Cannot Edit Approval Processes
Content: Symptom-Cannot Edit Approval Processes-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Approval Process View-When you select any approval process, the buttons(e.g Edit, Delete) in tool bar are grey out.-Cause-You don't have the read/write access of APPROVALPROCESSES_WCVIEW even your user account has been assigned with view APPROVALPROCESSES_WCVIEW.-Resolution-To set access right, do below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business Users View-Select your user ID and select button Edit->Access Rights.-Go to tab Access Restrictions.-Select APPROVALPROCESSES_WCVIEW and set Read/Write Access to Unrestricted -Keywords-Approval Process, Access Right, Edit Approval Process, Delete Approval Process-approval process, access right,delete approval process,edit approval process

Title: VAT Return Release - Account Determination Missing for Item Type Tax Payables. Specify Account Determination in Chart of Accounts and Account Determination Profile
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a Tax Return but the system gives the below error message:-'Release of tax return XYZ failed'  ( XYZ represents Tax return ID).-'Account determination is missing for item type Tax Payables. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC Chart of Accounts DEF and account determination profile <ABC Column Path Tax->Tax Payments->Product Tax Payable, Item Type Tax Payables'.-(ABC represents Account ID, DEF represents Account Determination Profile)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view of the respective tax return type, for example, VAT Returns.-Select your Tax Return ID and click Release.-You get an error message:-'Release of tax return XYZ failed'.-'Account determination is missing for item type Tax Payables. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC Chart of Accounts DEF and account determination profile <ABC Column Path Tax->Tax Payments->Product Tax Payable, Item Type Tax Payables'.-Cause-The account determination for Tax Type to the respective Country is not maintained.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open the Activity List.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Press View.-Under Account Determination section select Tax.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-Then navigate to the Tax Payments tab.-Select resepective Country.-Click on Add Row button.-Maintain the Account Determination for respective Tax Type.-Press Save and Close.-Keywords-Tax return release, Account Determination Missing for Item Type Tax Payables

Title: Error While Uploading Tax Data for Suppliers Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-The Tax details are not present for the Suppliers. Your requirement is to upload the Tax data for the Suppliers using Mass Data Maintenance. Upon executing the file, you receive the below error:-Update not possible; specified data for SUPPLIER-DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION with key COUNTRY_CODE = `XX` AND TAX_NUMBER_TYPE_CODE-CON does not exist-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Select Export Suppliers link-Export the Taxes tab to CSV file and add the data in the field required fields-Select Import Suppliers link and upload the file to the Taxes tab-Execute Data Import Immediately-Error occurs-Cause-Mass Data Maintenance tool is used to modify already existing records, but it is not possible to upload new data in the system.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Suppliers-Choose Migrate suppliers using the migration tool-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen and Download Migration Template-Fill the necessary fields and upload the migration file in the migration tool-Select Properties and choose the migration mode: Enhance already existing records-Execute Migration-Check the respective Suppliers to understand if the Taxes data upload was successful.-Keywords-SUPPLIER-DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION, Tax, TAX_NUMBER_TYPE_CODE-CON, COUNTRY_CODE

Title: Internal Comment Missing in Inventory Difference Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You created the Inventory Adjustment XXX and you added an Internal Comment to the Count Item. However, it is missing in the Inventory Difference Confirmation.-XXX = PI Count Document ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select the New Inventory Adjustment common task.-Fill the relevant Storage Location ID.-Select Next.-Select Add Row.-Fill the relevant Logistics Area ID.-Select Ok.-Select the relevant Product ID and relevant Product Actual Quantity.-Select Notes tab.-Write your Internal Comment.-Select Next.-Select Finish.-The Inventory Adjustment XXX is created.- To check the missing note, please follow the steps:-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select Monitoring: By PI Count Document.-Search for PI Count Document ID XXX.-Open the PI Count Document ID XXX.-Select View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the related Goods and Activity Confirmation.-The Inventory Difference Confirmation is opened and the Internal Comment you added is missing.-Cause-In case of Physical Inventory, the comments are restricted to the item level of Physical Inventory Document only. They are not passed to other documents. That is why the comments are not shown there in Inventory Difference Confirmation.-Resolution-As a workaround, the Internal Comment is added to the PI Count Document XXX. You can check it by following the steps:-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select Monitoring: By PI Count Document.-Search for PI Count Document ID XXX.-Open the PI Count Document ID XXX.-Select View All.-Go to the Count Items tab.-Select Notes sub tab.-The note you added to the Inventory Adjustment is appearing here.-Keywords-Adjustment-Internal-Comment-internal,adjustment,comment

Title: Regular Tasks View in Personnel Administration Appears Blank
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to hire Employees for Non-Localized or Pre-Localized countries, but the Regular Tasks view in Personnel Administration appears blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration workcenter-Go to Regular Tasks view-System shows a blank screen-Cause-This issue occurs when the below is not scoped in the relevant Project in Business Configuration:-Country XYZ (where XYZ represents Country name)-Scoping Element Non-localized Employees-Resolution-Only Localized versions are available for localized countries for HCM.-Regular Tasks for Pre-localized countries would be same as that for Non-Localized countries. Although Country is Pre-localized, you need to scope the Scoping Element Non-localized Employees and use it for HCM related activities.-You may follow the below steps in your system:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Implementation Projects view-For the relevant project select Edit Project Scope button-In the scoping step Country and Type of Business, select Edit Countries and choose Country XYZ-Select Next and proceed to the Implementation Focus step-Select Next to go to Scoping step-Expand Human Resources-Expand Personnel Administration-Select the checkbox for Non-Localized Employees-Complete the scoping by selecting Confirm and Finish-  To check the Regular Tasks for the respective Country XYZ:-Go to Personnel Administration workcenter-Select Regular Tasks view-Choose the required Country XYZ from the drop-down menu-Now you will be able to use the available Tasks.-Keywords-Regular Tasks, Personnel Administration, Non-Localized Employees, Human Resources, Pre-localized, Non-Localized

Title: Payment Medium Format CA 005 Domestic Payment: Payment File Created Doesn't Have the Bank Processing Center Code Displayed as Expected
Content: Symptom-You are creating Payment Files with payment medium format CA 005 Domestic Payment for Canada (either through a Payment Media Run or manually through Actions for Bank Transactions > Create Payment File) and you notice that on the file header (Record A) the Bank Processing Center Code is not displayed in the character positions 31-35, but a sequence of five zeros is displayed instead (00000).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to File Management > Outbound Files view-Search for the respective File ID and click to open it-Click View All-Download and open the respective file created by the system-In the fist line, which is the file header (Record A), check the characters on positions 31-35: there is a sequence of five zeros displayed (00000) instead of the Bank Processing Center Code you were expecting.-Cause-The reason why the system retrieves zeros instead of the appropriate code is that you didn't enter data in the Additional Name field for the Bank ID you are creating the payment file. Since the field was left blank the system fills it with zeros.-Resolution-In order to include the Bank Processing Center Code in the payment file you just need to enter it in the Additional Name field, as follows:-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to Master Data > My Banks view-Select the respective My Bank-Click Edit > General-Under Bank section, enter the 5 digit number in the Additional Name field-As a result, in the next payment file you create for this Bank ID the Bank Processing Center Code should come up in the Record A of the file.-  See Also-The Bank Processing Center Code is a 5 digit number, which is required by major Canadian banks (e. g. RBC, BMO).-It represents the center where the file will be processed, as follows:-Halifax 00330-Montreal 00310-Toronto 00320-Regina 00278-Winnipeg 00370-Calgary 00390-Vancouver 00300

Title: Partner ID Field is Disabled While Creating a Partner
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new Partner, but observe that the Partner ID field is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management workcenter-Go to Common Tasks view-Select New Partner-On the New Partner screen, the Partner ID field has a label, but no field to specify the ID-Cause-By default, the Partner ID field is disabled while creating the Partner. -Resolution-Upon specifying the Name and selecting Save, the system saves the Partner and the Partner ID is auto generated by the system.-In the Business Configuration workcenter, in the activity General Business Partners, you may define the Number Ranges for Partners by choosing Define Number Ranges for Business Partners.-Keywords-Partner ID, Partner, General Business Partners, Define Number Ranges for Business Partners.

Title: Is there any Report that will Provide Information on the Wrong FTE values Calculated for Employees?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You, as a Personnel Administrator, observe that the FTE values of a particular Employee are different in the Work Agreement and Organizational Assignment sub-tab in Employee's Personnel File. You want to know if there is any report that will display information on the wrong FTE values calculated for Employees.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Select the Employees view-Highlight the respective Employee and select the Edit button-Select the Employment tab then go to the Work Agreement sub-tab and also check the Organizational Assignment sub-tab, where the FTE values are different-Cause-Currently we do not have any report in the frontend that will provide information on the wrong FTE values calculated for Employees.-Resolution-We have added this functionality as a new requirement and will be available in one of the future releases.-Keywords-FTE, Full Time Equivalent, Wrong FTE, Incorrect FTE

Title: Custom Fields are Displaying Twice in the Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You have created extension fields in a screen through a custom solution and the same have been adapted to the migration. However, when accessing the latest migration template for the respective object, you observe that the fields are displaying twice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, all its versions.-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer, all its versions.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior in test systems. As a test system will have both the original and patch solutions, it is expected that there will be one instance of the extension fields for each solution. That will be the case even though the solution is disabled, as the extension field will remain active should the solution be reactivated in the future, avoiding possible inconsistencies.-Resolution-In order to be able to differentiate between these fields with same label:-Open the migration template's XML file;-Select the rows 3 to 6;-Right-click them and select "Unhide";-In row 5, you can see the technical name of the fields — for the PDI fields, the technical name will begin with the namespace of the PDI solution to which it belongs.-As the fields should not be deleted, the workaround is to hide or ignore the field which is irrelevant, maintaining data only in the field belonging to the solution which is in the latest version. This behavior will not occur in the productive system.-Keywords-PDI field, duplicate, migration template

Title: How to Open Large Reports on SAP Business ByDesign Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-You want to open large reports on Excel using the SAP Business ByDesign Add-In, however depending on the report size the Excel freeze or you receive an error message: The  remote server returned an error (500).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign; SAP Business ByDesign Excel Add-In-Reproducing the Issue-Open Excel.-Click on Log On button on SAP Business ByDesign Add-In ribbon.-Click on Insert Report.-Select your report on the list.-You receive an error message.-Cause-The Business ByDesign Excel Add-In are not able to open large reports in one single list.-Resolution-To open large reports on Excel you need to use the option Paging. This option split the reports on pages.-Open Excel-Click on Log On button on SAP Business ByDesign Add-In ribbon-Click on Insert Report-Select the check box Paging in the Insert Report screen-  Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign Excel Add-In; Large Reports

Title: Requesting More Than One Service Operation Is Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You cannot request more than one service request (e.g. tenant refresh, restore point, etc.) at a time for the same tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You have an active service request, (e.g. a tenant copy) and you want to request another service request for the same donwtime.-Cause-This is not possible as only one service request can be active at any one time for the same tenant.-Resolution-You need to create seperate incidents for each service operation request.-You also need to make sure that each request has a seperate downtime window.-See Also-2136036 - How to Request a New System-2315326 - How to Request a Restore Point-Keywords-Service Operations, Tenant Refresh, Restore Point, Downtime Window, Hosting, Provisioning, Service request, Tenant Copy

Title: Error Message: Postal Code ABC Can Only Contain Numbers
Content: Symptom-You want to maintain an address for Customers or other Business Partners via migration tool in the Business Configuration work center. But although the postal code is maintained correctly in the migration template, the error message 'Postal code ABC can only contain numbers' appears (ABC represents the Postal Code). The migration fails.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview.-Click on the Activity List tab.-In Show field, select All Activities.-Search and open Migration of Customers activity.-Select Migrate Customers using the Migration Tool.-Mark the relevant file.-Choose Execute Migration Step By Step.-Go forwards till Simulation step.-The error message 'Postal code ABC can only contain numbers' appears.-  Cause-You maintained an incorrect Country Code in the migration template and therefore a rule for the wrong country applies. This may happen when a common abrevation for the country doesn't match the ISO 3166 Code.-Resolution-Check which ISO 3166 Country Code applies for the relevant address and maintain this Country Code in the migration file.-Keywords-migration, Business Partners, Customers address, Kunden Adresse

Title: Error Message: “Hierarchy with ID XXXXX already exists. Hierarchy node with ID XXXXX already exists“ While Migrating Customer Hierarchies
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to link new Accounts to the existing Account Hierarchies in your system. Upon trying to migrate using the Migration of Customer Hierarchies, system throws error:-Hierarchy with ID XXXXX already exists-or-Hierarchy node with ID XXXXX already exists-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Customer Hierarchies-Select Migrate customer hierarchies using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-Cause-Migration of Account Hierarchy is only capable to create complete Account Hierarchies. Adding more Account Hierarchy Nodes or further Accounts using a delta-migration is not supported by the system.-Resolution-Once a Migration is done, adding of further Accounts or Nodes needs to be done manually by a user.-Further, neither a deletion nor a mass-deletion of Account Hierarchies is supported by the system.-Keywords-Migration of Account Hierarchy, Migration of Customer Hierarchies, Delete Account Hierarchy-migration of customer hierarchies,account hierarchies,delete account hierarchy

Title: How to Create Time Accounts with Bookable Periods and Accrual Quantities that are not Supported by Standard Functionality
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to configure the system to allow the automatic creation of Time Accounts with the required Accrual Rules.-For example:-For the activity Time Accounts - Japan, you have local requirement for Japan as per law regarding Annual Paid Leave.--The summary rule is like below:-Years of service     Annual paid leave-0.5                          10-1.5                          11-2.5                          12-3.5                          14-4.5                          16-5.5                          18-6.5                          20-Two years rule is limitation of Annual Paid leave. Annual paid leave must be Set to Zero after 2 years.--Example:-2016/1/1 join a Company-2016/7/1 get 10 days of Annual Paid Leave-2017/7/1 get 11 days of Annual Paid Leave-2018/7/1 lose 10 days of Annual Paid Leave which was obtained on 2016/7/1-2018/7/1 get 12 days of Annual Paid Leave-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The automatic creation of Time Accounts with the required Accrual Rules cannot be performed by the system.-You have to modify the Bookable Dates for the Time Account instances in the Time File of the Employees. This would be done in conjunction with Manual Adjustments, that will handle the Accrual Quantities.-You may follow the below steps in your system:-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Choose Implementation Projects view-3. Choose Open Activity List Button-4. Choose Fine Tune Tab-5. Find and choose the activity Time Accounts - XXXXX (where XXXXX represents the name of country)-6. Choose Open Button-7. Under Time Account Types, choose Maintain Time Account Types-8. Select Add Row-9. Create a Time Account Type with the Recurrence Type as Calendar Year with Validity from 01.01.0001 to Unlimited-10. At the bottom of the screen, select Add Row-11. The Bookable From field would be Start of time account, and Bookable To can be End of time account with Validity from 01.01.0001 to Unlimited-12. Select Save and Close-13. Under Time Account Types, choose Maintain Time Account Rules-14. Select Add Row-15. Create the Time Account Type -16. Go to Period End Rules tab-17. The Period End Processing Rule which is Posting Type should be Set to Zero-18. In addition, the Vacation Time Type has to be modified in Business Configuration workcenter to specify the new Time Account to which Postings will be made (as Deductions)-  Changes to be made in Time file of the Employee are as below:-1. Go to Time Administration workcenter-2. Go to Employees view-3. Show All Employees and find the Employee XYZ (where XYZ represents the Employee)-4. Select Edit-5. Go to Time Profile tab-6. Select Add Row-7. Assign the Time Account Type in the Employee's Time Profile-8. Select Save-9. Go to Time Account Balances tab of the Time File-10. Select the Time Account instance that is created for this Time Account-11. At the bottom of the screen, select the sub-tab Basic Data-12. Change the dates that are to match the required dates that are particular to the Employee (for the above example, based on the date that is 6 months after their Hire date)-13. Select the Adjustments tab-14. Select Add Row-15. Create a Manual Adjustment of the Time Account-16. The Posting On date of the Manual Adjustment must be the same as that as the date of the Time Account itself-17. The Quantity would be based on the Seniority Rules as specified-18. Select Save and Close-When the configuration of the Time Account Type is done in this way, the change of the Time Account instance dates as well as the Quantity can be done once a year for all the Employees, for the newly created Time Account instances. Therefore, you can cover the legal aspects of the particular Time Account Type.-Keywords-Time Account, Manual Adjustment, Seniority Rules, Recurrence Type, Time Account Type, Bookable From, Bookable To, Accrual Rules

Title: Error Message: “Process Type Can’t be Changed” While Migrating Activities
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to update the Description for the Task Activities and Appointment Activities using the Migration workbench. While migrating the data, system throws the error during Simulation:-Process type can’t be changed-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Task Activities / Migration of Appointment Activities-Upload the Migration File in the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Replace already existing records-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step-Cause-In the General tab of the Migration File, the Document Type Code field is blank.-Resolution-Maintain the value in Document Type Code field, even if it is not mandatory and proceed with the migration activity.-For example:-Document Type Code 0001 for Appointment activities-Document Type Code 0002 for Phone Call activities-Document Type Code 0004 for E-mail activities-Document Type Code 0006 for Task activities-Keywords-Document Type Code, Activities, Task, Appointment, Phone Call, E-mail, Email, Process type can’t be changed

Title: Spain - CSB 43 file format Error Message No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number ABC, national bank code XYZ, and currency WWW found
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a Bank Statement using the File Format Spain - CSB 43 but you receive the following error messages:-No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number ABC, national bank code DEF, and currency GHI found (Where ABC represents the Bank Account number, DEF represents the national bank code, GHI represents the currency).-Bank account missing or cannot be determined.-Bank statement ID $1 for bank account ID rejected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management view and choose Inbound Files.-Select New and Inbound File.-Select the file containing the bank statement(s) via Add for the selected house bank.-Press Start File Upload.-Cause-The system is failing to find the 10-digit account. The Bank account number should be corrected for this function to work. The Correct Account number should contain 10 digits.-Also, the header details should be maintained in the upload file. For file format CSB 43 - 00-FILE HEADER RECORD should be maintained as the first line on the file.-Resolution-To solve this issue, you must maintain the following:-Maintain the data in the Bank master data:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the Master Data view.-Select the My Banks sub view.-Select the relevant Bank.-Click the Edit button and select the Bank Accounts tab.-Select the Relevant Bank Account ID.-Maintain the Bank Account Number with the correct 10-digit Bank Account number.-Maintain the File Header record in the upload file.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the sub view File Management.-Select the view Incoming File.-Select the relevant File.-Under the area Attachments, select the upload file hyperlink to open the file.-The first line of the file should contain the File Header Record.-The File Header Record should contain the following:-Record Code, 2 positions 00-Bank Code used in the file, 4 positions - 1234 (1234 represents the Bank Code)-Accounting Date of the period to which the information corresponds YYMMDD- The File Header Record should look like the following example: 001234YYMMDD -Keywords-CSB 43, Bank Statement, Upload File, No bank account active

Title: VAT Within Customer Invoice Shows Wrong VAT Base Amount
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Manual Invoice in the system and you could see that the Taxes for the item are not using the correct Base Amount.-There are two rows for taxes, one IEPS and the other VAT (Value Added Tax) and the line for IEPS is pulling the Net Amount as Base Amount, as expected. But the VAT row is summing the Net Amount and IEPS Tax Amount to compose VAT Tax Base Amount which is not correct, both rows should pull Net Amount as Tax Base.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After you create the Manual Invoice-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Search the document in question.-Click View All button.-Go to Items tab and Taxes subtab.-You can see that the amounts for the Tax Base is not what was expected.-Cause-The Tax Code 505 - Sale With IEPS - Goods is chosen for this invoice, which means the system will take this calculation for the VAT Tax Base Amount. Hence, this is expected from the system. The IEPS tax is composed of these two tax line items that are calculated this manner.-Resolution-This is system behavior for this Tax Code.-See Also-Customizing the Tax Calculation Procedure within SAP Help Portal, and IEPS (FI) also under SAP Help Portal.-Keywords-EIPS. VAT. Value Added Tax. Customer Invoice. Tax Base Amount. Net Amount.

Title: Cannot Request a Test Sytem or a Data Migration Test System From a Decoupled Test System
Content: Symptom-You have a test system which is de-coupled from your production system. You now want to request a test system or a data migration test system for a change project on the current test system. But after the request, you do not get any notification about the new system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center-Select the Systems view-Select Request Creation-Choose the relevant Source system, Data Source and Target system-Select OK-There is no notification about the new system-Cause-You are requesting a test system from a test system.-Resolution-It is not possible to request a Test system from another Test system. You have to re-create the change project on your production system and thereafter, request a test system from the production system.-Keywords-Request creation, decoupled test system, request test system from another test system

Title: Cube 0SM_ARCHH - Unable to activate aggregates
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***WAITING FOR VALIDATION, if proven, change status to Released to Customer and remove this statement***-An activation of aggreagates for an InfoCube 0SM_ARCHH is failling and the following error is present in SLG1 log:-An SQL exception occurred-SQL Error: 802-Environment-Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-In Solution Manager system execute Tcode: RSA1-In Modelling section, select InfoProvider-Click on Binocular icon to Search:------In Search pop-up window, search for 0SM_ARCHH InfoProvider----Right click on the InfoProvider:---From drop-down menu, select "Maintain Aggregates":---Click on "Activate and Fill aggregates" icon:-----In Solution Manager system execute Tcode: SLG1-The following error occurrs in the log:-An SQL exception occurred-SQL Error: 802-Cause-The SQL error and the Aggregation activation issue is caused by many duplications which exist in the 0sm_ARCHH cube.-Data in the cube needs to be consistent again and then you should have no problem to activate Aggregation.-Resolution-To fix the issue we suggest the following steps:-Deactivate extractors:-In EFWK Admin UI, deactivate all the affected 'DVM ARCHIVING STATISTICS' extractors to prevent further inconsistent data been written into 0SM_ARCHH cube.--Clean up inconsistency in cube 0SM_ARCHH using report 'RAGS_DVM_CLEANUP_UTILITIES'.-You can tick the option 'Delete for Full Reload' of report 'RAGS_DVM_CLEANUP_UTILITIES', it will delete the archive document that is still available on the managed system side , and waiting for the archive extractor to reload again. The pre-requisite to use 'Delete for Full Reload' is the new ST-PI based archive extractor is used for this managed system.-Or if you are sure all the archive documents still available on the managed system side, you can also use Delete Data of cube 0SM_ARCHH in RSA1 which will be faster.--In case the managed system ST-PI release is as follows:-From Release 2008_1_700 to 2008_1_700  -From Release 740        to 740-Please make sure the following SAP Note is implemented on managed system side: 2108920 - Correction of DVM_GET_ADMI_RUN_DATA--EFWK Configuration:-a) Execute transaction code: SE16, table name: E2E_ACTIVE_WLI,-b) In field EXTRACTOR, enter: AGS_DVM_EXTRACTOR_ARCH_STATS,-c) SID= system ID you would like to configure-d) change the corresponding entry: in column POSTPROCESSOR, enter: AGS_DVM_PP_ARCH_STATS-- In Solution Manager system, implement the following SAP Note:-2699133 - DVM archiving statistics extractor is writing duplicated data into 0SM_ARCHH cube--Re-activate extractor again:-When all above steps have been finished, we can activate the archive extractor again and wait for archive data to load to cube--Please try to activate the Aggregation again

Title: Migrated Supplier Invoice Does Not Display Withholding Tax During Payment
Content: Symptom-A Migration Supplier Invoice has been created and during payment process Withholding Tax Amount is not being displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Go to the Suppliers > Supplier Account View.-Search for the respective Supplier.-Click View button.-Select the Migration Supplier Invoice.-Click Pay Manually By > Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Complete the payment.-Go to the Document Flow.-Open the Journal Entry.-Journal Entry does not display the Withholding Tax.-Cause-In the Migration file, on the Withholding Tax Data tab, the column 'Planned' was left empty. Leaving this column empty, it is assumed that Withholding Tax has been paid already in the legacy system and does not need to be activated within the payment process.--If open items are migrated with the 'Planned' Indicator set (with an X) then the Withholding Taxes are planned and it is assumed that they have not been paid yet. Then they will be activated in the payment process and therefore be displayed in the respective payment document.-Resolution-If you need to migrate the documents again, you can reverse them as per following steps:-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit > Source Documents View.-Display all source documents and find ABC (ABC represents the Migrated Supplier Invoice ID).-Press Actions > View Business Transaction.-In the new screen click Reverse button.-If the invoices have already been cleared you need to reverse the payment first.--Then re-migrate the invoices and create a new payment. This time the Withholding Tax should appear in the payment.-Keywords-Withholding Tax, Migration of Open Payables, Migrated Supplier Invoice, Missing Withholding Tax

Title: Employees Not Displayed in Basic Search Results of Time Sheet View
Content: Symptom-You, as time administrator, notice that employees are missing in the basic search results of the Time Sheet view in the Time Administration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Sheet view.-Query for an employee using the basic search functionality-The system displays the message 'No Results Found'.-Cause-The basic search functionality for employees in the Time Sheet view is country-specific and defaults to the country of the time administrators company. If more than one country is scoped in the system, the basic search may not provide any results. In such cases the Country field in the Advanced search functionality needs to be supplied when executing the query.-Resolution-To search for the employees, use the following steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Sheet view.-On the right corner of the screen, click Advanced or use keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Alt + G.-Under Employment, select the relevant country in the drop-down field Country.-Add the information for the employees to be found and click Go or press Enter.-The employees will be displayed.-Keywords-Mitarbeiter, Arbeitszeitblatt, Resultat, kein, keine, Ergebnis, Suche

Title: Automatic File Naming for Mexico Electronic Accounting Files
Content: Symptom-You have created a file from the Mexico Electronic Accounting, however the file name is not as per the specification. You expect the system to name the file automatically to be uploaded to SAT portal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Mexico Electronic Accounting view.-Highlight the relevant run.-Click View Report Run Results.-Go to the Attachments tab.-You see that he file name is not as per the SAT requirement.-Cause-At the moment, the system does not support the automatic naming of the file.-Resolution-You need to download the file and, before upload in the SAT portal, change the file name manually as per the mandatory nomenclature for the XML.-Keywords-SAT. Mexico Electronic Accounting.

Title: Military Data and Ethnic Origin Fields Missing from Hire Employee Screen
Content: Symptom-You are on the process of hiring an employee and notice that the fields to maintain military data and ethnicity are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center;-Access the Regular Tasks view;-Select a country;-Click the link to Hire Employee;-In step 1, Enter Personal Data, sections Military Data and Ethnic Origin are missing.-Cause-The functionality to maintain military data and ethnicity of an employee is only available for United States and the United Kingdom.-Resolution-This is currently the standard system behavior.-If you need this functionality for other countries than the United States and the United Kingdom urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-Military Data, Ethnic Origin, Missing Field, Hire Employee, Personnel Administration

Title: Error: "Useful life for valuation view ABC in set of books XYZ is missing" While Creating a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-During Supplier Invoice and Goods and Service Receipt creation, system generated a Business Transaction with the error Error: "Useful life for valuation view ABC in set of books XYZ is missing" (ABC represents the ID of the Valuation View, XYZ represents the ID of the Set of Books).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View.-Go to the Source Documents Subview.-Select the Supplier Invoice/Goods and Service Receipt.-Click Actions > Post Business Transaction.-System displays the error.-Cause-No Useful Life has been entered for the respective Valuation View in the Fixed Asset Classes Business Configuration activity based on the Product Category maintained in the Individual Material linked to the Supplier Invoice/Goods and Service Receipt.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Select the respective Implementation Project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Fixed Asset Classes.-Click Edit fixed asset classes.-Select respective Asset Class.-Maintain a Default Useful Life for the missing Valuation View.-Keywords-Useful life, Fixed Asset, Supplier Invoice, Goods and Service Receipt, Valuation View

Title: Calculation of Results in the Forecasted Utilization Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Forecasted Utilization with the key figures Absence, Gross Capacity and Forecasted Utilization. You have also set up a result line, but you notice that the aggregated results for these 3 key figures are not correct.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center that this report is assigned to and open the reports list.-Open and run the report Forecasted Utilization.-Go to Settings > Characteristics, and set up a result line.-Go to Settings > Key Figures and make the key figures Absence, Gross Capacity and Forecasted Utilization visible.-You will see that the aggregation of results is not as expected.-Cause-The behaviour is correct. The report needs to be set up in a specific way.-Resolution-The key figures Gross Capacity and Absence are related to an employee’s work schedule and leave. Therefore, it is not meaningful to have an aggregation (i.e. a result line) on the Project field and this characteristic is not part of the default report view. However in case you add it via Add Fields, the following aggregation rules are set up:--Gross Capacity has the exception aggregation 'First Value' based on the project, so in case there are multiple projects, it only considers the first value. As mentioned, Gross Capacity completely relies on the employee's work schedule and does not need to be summed up since it would be same for all projects.--Absence has the exception aggregation 'Average of Detailed Values which are not Zero, Null or Error' based on Project. So if there are multiple values, the key figure result only considers the average value. As mentioned, Absence completely relies on the employee's work schedule and does not need to be summed up since it would be same for all projects.-By contrast, Forecasted Utilization has neither an aggregation nor an exception aggregation. The result row in the report is based on the formula:-Forecasted Utilization = ((Scheduled Work + Vacation) * 100) / Gross Capacity-Keywords-report, analytics, forecasted utilization, result row, GROSS_CAPACITY, VACATION, FORECAST_UTILISATION, HCMRPMU01_Q0001

Title: Non-Localized Country: No Withholding Tax Tab Displayed in Tax Subledger in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-For a non-localized country, the Withholding Tax tab is not displayed in Tax subledger in Business Configuration activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click to open the Tax subledger.-Select the row of the Account Determination Profile assigned to the referred non-localized country.-Notice that there's no Withholding Tax tab displayed.-Cause-The BC sets which are responsible for the enablement of the Withholding Tax tab in Chart of Accounts are missing.-Resolution-The steps to create the BC sets are described in the Localization Toolkit, Category Tax > Subtopic Withholding Tax > Documentation How To enable Withholding Tax content for non-localized countries in the SAP Cloud Applications studio > Chapter 5.11 Configure Account Determination-The Withholding Tax solution should be completed and as a result the Withholding Tax tab will become available.-Keywords-bc sets; withholding tax tab; Account Determination Withholding Tax Countries; Configure account determination;

Title: Unable to Use OData Services to Create Credit Memos
Content: Symptom-You created a custom OData service and added the business object Customer Invoice Request to create new credit memos, but you noticed that the field Type Code (field that contains the document type code "1463" for Manual Credit Memo) is not enabled to Create or Update.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center, in the OData Services view.-Change the filter to Custom OData Services.-Click on New, add a name to the service and open it.-Choose the business object Customer Invoice Request.-Add the Type Code field to the service and see it is not enabled to Create or Update.-Cause-The Type Code field is not write enabled, because its data is automatically determined based on other criteria, so it cannot be passed in the payloads by external sources.-Resolution-The field ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode decides whether the document should be a credit memo or invoice. The field is not yet enabled for OData usage, but it is available in the A2X service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.-The enablement of the field ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode in OData services is planned for a future release of the system.-See Also-The documentation about the A2X service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn can be found in the link below:-Inbound Service ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn-Keywords-odata service, credit memo, customer invoice request, A2X, ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn

Title: Understand how a copy of KW documents works in scenario "Solution Documentation" in SAP Solution Manager 7.20
Content: Symptom-You copy elements that store Knowledge Warehouse (KW) documents in your process structure in SAP Solution Manager 7.20, scenario "Solution Documentation". In some cases the KW documents are copied and in some cases the copied element points to the same KW document. This KBA explains how this works in detail. It helps you to understand when the KW documents are really copied, and when the copied node will refer to the same KW document.-Environment-Starting with SAP Solution Manager 7.20 SP05, a new flag was introduced on the KW documents. It is called "Document reference". With this flag, a new algorithm was implemented that decides how KW documents are copied, in case the element that stores the document is copied.-Before SAP Solution Manager 7.20 SP05, KW documents were never copied when the element that stores the document was copied.-Resolution-In this chapter, we want to explain when KW documents are copied in case an element is copied, and when the copied element refers to the same KW document.-As already mentioned above, the copy behavior has been changed in SP05. Whereas no copies of KW documents were created up to SP05, this is done in some cases starting in SP05, if elements are copied. In SP05, a new attribute was introduced that has an influence on the document copy process. It is called "Document reference" and is a checkbox on the UI that can be set manually, but it is also set automatically in some cases. How this works, is described in following chapter.-There are two different variants of a copy action in SP05 and higher:-1. Copying structures-If a structure is copied (e.g. a scenario or a process) all child elements and all assignments contained in this structure (e.g. KW document assignments) are copied along with the structure. It now depends on the flag "Document Reference", how the KW document on the different elements are handled:-A KW document is regarded as "original" if the attribute "Document Reference" is false. Such "original" KW documents are copied into an independent new KW document. The copies of all elements where this flag is false will point to a new KW document.-A document is regarded as a reference to another ("original") KW document, if the attribute "Document Reference" is true. An element that represents a KW document reference (where the attribute "Document Reference" is true) is not copied if a structure is copied, but an additional assignment to the same original KW document is included into the copied structure.-Please note that even if a KW document is copied to a new KW document, the description of the copy is the same as the description of the original. So different to SAP Solution Manager 7.1, where an appendix "(copy)" was added to the document description, this is not done in SAP Solution Manager 7.2. For that reason, you usually cannot directly see if you have the same KW document on two elements or not. At the end of this SAP note, you find a workaround that describes how you can compare two elements that store documents. So you can see if you have stored the same or different KW documents on these two elements.-If a structure is copied which contains originals ("Document Reference" = SPACE) and references that point to that originals ("Document Reference" = "X"), then the copy of this structure will also contain copies of the originals and references. But the references ("Document Reference" = "X") in the copied structure will now point to the originals in the copied structure. They will not point to the originals in the source structure, as this would not be the expected behaviour. In this sense, the originals and their references are consistent in the copy. The references in the copy will point to original documents that are also inside the copied hierarchy, in case of this scenario, where documents and their references are both contained in the source structure of the copy process.-2. Copying KW documents directly-If one or multiple KW documents are directly selected for a "copy" an "insert" action, the copy will always create independent KW document copies. This is done regardless of the flag "Document Reference" mentioned above.-For this direct copy process of KW documents, we consider to provide an addition function to insert document references (i.e. additional assignments of the same documents) instead of inserting always independent KW document copies. As mentioned above, at the moment the system always creates KW document copies and ignores the flag "Document Reference" if the copy process is done on one or more KW document elements directly.-We plan to give the users the choice to insert the documents at the destination as reference (without copying the KW document) or to insert it as a new original (which is a copy of the original KW document). Please note that we have such plans, but for legal reasons we cannot commit if or when such a new functionality will be available.-3. Meaning and handling of the "Document Reference" flag-As mentioned above, the flag controls the copy process in case you copy hierarchies (as described in section 1 above). It does not have any effect if you directly copy one or several documents (as described in section 2 above).-The "Document Reference" flag is set automatically:-It is unchecked if a new document is created using "Document (Upload)" or "Document (From template)" from the context menu-It is checked if a new document is assigned using "Document (Assign)" from the context menu, in case you assign a document that is already used in the hierarchy. In case you assign a document that is not yet assigned to the hierarchy (these documents are called "orphans") the flag is not set, because a copy of the orphan document is created.-In case you copy a hierarchy (as described in section 1 above), the flag is kept as it was in the original structure, as only documents with the unchecked attribute are copied.-In case you copy one or several documents directly  (as described in section 2 above), the flag is always unchecked, as new originals are created -If you uncheck or check the flag manually, the copy processes that are performed after this change will be influenced accordingly.-Since the "Document Reference" flag did not yet exist up to SP05, it is not 100% reliable that you really have a document that is not used at any other place if the flag is not set.-Any change of the "Document Reference" flag does not affect the document stored on the element. Only further copy processed that happen after the change of the flag are influenced. But unchecking the flag itself will not create a copy of the document. The flag only describes the fact whether a document is seen as an original or reference for further copy processes, but changing the flag itself does not trigger any creation of document copies.-See Also-How to see if two elements in the Solution Documentation hierarchy point to different KW documents:-If you want to see if a copy action resulted in different KW documents, or if the copied elements still point to the same KW document, you can see this from the "Created at" attribute in the attribute panel. You see this in the "History" attribute group of the attribute panel:-Check the attribute "Created at" for both elements in the hierarchy you want to compare. If both elements refer to the same KW document, all attributes have the same values. Especially the "Created at" attributes have the same values. If the documents are different, because one was copied from another document, the "Created at" timestamps are different.-Keywords-copy document, dokument, kopieren, refer to original, change document, ändern, Kopie, Verhalten, KW, original, reference document,

Title: Changes Made to Data Under Collaboration Tab Within the Account View are Not Shown in The Changes Tab
Content: Symptom-Changes made to account Collaboration data are not displayed in the Changes history for the account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Select All Accounts query under Show.-Choose button Go.-Open any account.-Choose option View All.-Switch to Communication tab, again switch to Collaboration sub tab.-Do some changes to the document, for example Customer Invoice/ Credit Memo, set Output Channel to E-Mail, and change E-Mail as test@testing.com. (test@testing.com represents the mail address)-Click Save.-Switch to Changes tab, search for changes made for today.-Changes made to Collaboration data are not shown here.-Cause-This functionality is not supported in the current releases.-Resolution-This is a new requirement and will be made available in one of the future release.-Keywords-Collaboration, Communication, Änderungshistorie, Zusammenarbeit, Änderungen-collaboration,account management

Title: Information Required for JAM Integration With SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues efficiently, we should gather the following information:-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-In case an error message occurs: Error message that occurs and the action that triggered the error message.-Do JAM Integration is already scoped in Business Configuration.-If any recent changes in JAM/C4C integration set-up has been done.-Do customer access JAM using SSO.-Do the impacted user ID & E-mail address is same in both JAM & C4C.-What is the actual result and what is the expected result.-Screenshots Required from JAM tenant:-In Admin Area -> Click on Integrations -> oAuth Client -> select the relevant C4C client and click on View -> Capture the screenshot.-In Admin Area -> Click on Integrations -> click on SAML Trusted IDPs -> Capture the screenshot.-In Admin Area -> Click on Integrations -> Click External Applications -> Capture the screenshot-In Admin Area -> Click on Compliance & Security -> Click Security -> Capture the screenshot.-In Admin Area -> Click on Users -> Click on Users & Member Lists -> Search for the user who is facing this issue -> Capture the screenshot once the search result is there on the screen.-In Admin Area -> Click on Company Overview -> Capture the screenshot.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer

Title: Sales and Use Tax Tab not Available in Account Determination
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Customer or Supplier Invoice and you receive an error message/ exception: 'Account determination is missing for position type Sales Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts Chart of Accounts and account determination profile XXX. Column Path Tax->Sales and Use Tax->Sales and Use Tax, Position Type Sales Tax'.-But when checking the Account Determination Profile the Sales and Use tax tab is not available.-XXX - Account Determination Profile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Under Account Determination.-Select Tax.-There is no Sales and Use Tax tab.-Cause-To view the Sales and Use Tax tab you have to make sure that all the countries using these two taxes are configured in the system, for example US, India.-Resolution-To make the Sales and Use tab available you need to assign the respective country to the Account Determination Profile:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Under Account Determination.-Select Tax.-Click Assign Countries to Profile.-Add the desired countries.-Now the Sales and Use Tax tab will be showing under Tax Account Determination.-Keywords-Account Determination; Sales and Use Tax; tab not showing; Chart of Accounts; Account determination is missing.-account determination,chart of accounts,sales and use tax,tab not showing,account determination is missing

Title: Unable to Select Reconciliation Account Payable or Receivable in the Personalization Mode of a New Bank-to-Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-Unable to Select Reconciliation Account Payable or Receivable in the Personalization Mode of a New Bank-to-Bank Transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks > New Bank to Bank Transfer.-Click the user photo button at the top right of the screen.-Click Start Personalization Mode.-Expand the table From Bank Account.-The fields Reconciliation Account Payable and Reconciliation Account Receivable are grayed out.-Cause-It is necessary to have this feature scoped in the system, once it is scoped, in the Bank-to-Bank screen a Posting Rule must be entered and then the system will allow the selection of Reconciliation Account Payable or Receivable field in the Personalization Mode.-Resolution-Scoping the directly transfer cash to Bank from Partner Companies:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Select the respective Implementation Project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step 4 Questions.-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select Cash and Bank Accounts.-Scope the question Do you directly transfer cash to Bank from Partner Companies?-Selecting the Posting Rule in Bank-To-Bank Transfer:-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks > New Bank-to-Bank Transfer.-Complete the From Company and the To Company.-Posting Rule Drop Box will be enabled.-Click the dropbox and select one of the options Standard Payable or Receivable.-Click the user photo button at the top right of the screen.-Click Start Personalization Mode.-Click the arrow for From Bank Account.-Reconciliation Account Payable or Receivable will be available for selection based on the option chosen in the Posting Rule field.-Keywords-Reconciliation Account Payable, Reconciliation Account Receivable, Bank-To-Bank Transfer, Reconciliation, Bank Transfer

Title: SII Invoice on Behalf of a Buyer scenario
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Customer Invoice on behalf of the buyer with present tax date. (i.e. Tax Due Date not in the future).-This scenario should be included in the Standard 01 Regime.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Create an Invoice on behalf of the buyer:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Create a New Manual Invoice Request.-In SII Outgoing invoice, the external reference field needs to be filled with invoice number in the below format: ERS-<invoice number>-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select the New Tax Return Run under Common Tasks.-Enter the details for the New Tax Return Run.-Tax Return will be created.-Go to Tax Return Runs.-Select the Run ID and at the bottom of the screen you will notice Tax Return ID will be maintained.-Click on the Tax Return ID.-Go to the Tax Return tab.-Here we can see the Invoice that was created earlier.-Release and submit Tax Return to the Tax Authority.-See Also-2685598 - SII Regime 15 - Tax Due Date is in the Future scenario-Keywords-SII, SII Standard Regime, Spain Tax Authority, Behalf of a Buyer
