Title: SII Regime 15 - Tax Due Date is in the Future scenario
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Customer Invoice when the Tax Due date is in the future. And you want to know what has to be completed for this scenario under SII Regime 15 to be accepted by the Spanish SII Tax Authority.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Create a New Manual Invoice.-Enter a Tax Due date as a date in the future.-Save and Post this invoice.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select New Tax Return Run.-Save and close the Tax Return Run.-Tax Return Run will be created.-Go to the view VAT Return Runs, here you will see the Tax Return and the Tax Return ID.-Open the Tax Return ID.-Go to the Tax Return tab, here you will see the Invoice with the Tax Due Date that was maintained in the Invoice you created.-Release and submit the Tax Return to the Tax Authority.-Once released you can see Tax Return Status changes to Reported.-Also acceptance Status has been updated to Accepted.-  See Also-2685298 - SII Regime 15 - Invoice on Behalf of a Buyer scenario-Keywords-SII, SII Regime 15, Spain Tax Authority, Invoice on behalf of buyer

Title: Unable to Specify Password for Business User
Content: Symptom-You are unable to specify password for Business User during employee data migration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List.-Search and open activity Migration of Employee and User Data.-Cause-It is not possible to set the Default Password while creation of Business Users through migration.-Resolution-The only available option is to maintain it manually via Application and User Management workcenter.- Steps to follow:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Search required Business User.-Select Edit Attributes.-You can save the password for the Business User here.-  Keywords-Business User, Password, Migration of Employee and User Data

Title: Error Message in Tax Subledger: Change or delete duplicate rows with key 'ABC' 'ABC' in 'Tax: Tax Payments'
Content: Symptom-Error message is thrown when maintaining accounts for Tax Payable and Tax Pre-Payment within Tax subledger > Tax Payments tab:-Change or delete duplicate rows with key 'ABC' 'ABC' in 'Tax: Tax Payments'-ABC represents the Chart of Accounts ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination section, click Tax.-Go to the Tax Payments tab.-Notice that account AAA is maintained for Tax Payable and Tax Pre-Payment (AAA represents a G/L Account ID).-Click Add Row.-Enter G/L Account BBB for Tax Payable, Tax Pre-Payment or both (BBB represents a G/L Account ID).-Click Save.-Error message is thrown:-Change or delete duplicate rows with key 'ABC' 'ABC' in 'Tax: Tax Payments'-Cause-For Tax Payments only one entry for Tax Payable and Tax Pre-Payment can be maintained per Account Determination Profile/Chart of Accounts.-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected. If there's the need of assigning more than one account for Tax Payable and Tax Pre-Payment, a new Chart of Accounts should be created. If that is the case, please refer to help document About Copy Chart of Accounts, available in the Help Center.-Keywords-Tax; Tax subledger; Tax Payments; Tax Payable; Tax Pre-Payment;

Title: Reconciliation: Differences in Calculated and Posted Tax Amount Due to Rounding Logic
Content: Symptom-You have executed a Reconciliation Run that shows Processing Status as Red and errors in the resulting log.-An error shows as:-'Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry XXX' (XXX represents the Journal Entry ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Periodic Tasks select Reconciliation.-Press New and Reconciliation in order to launch a Reconciliation Run.-After finishing, select the respective run and follow the link Log Result.-Navigate to tab Messages and expand the node Source Document Type: 272 - Tax Ledger Account.-Here you see the error 'Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry XXX' for at least one source document.-Cause-Further inside into the error-source can be gathered when going to the Tax tab in the log of the Reconciliation Run.-Under VAT / Sales Tax Calculation Details, in rows marked as red - differences show with respect to calculated - and posted tax amounts.-In this context these differences usually amount to less than 0,50 and are caused by the applied system-immanent rounding calculation logic.-Example: Customer Credit Memo with applied discount over 98% and an applied VAT-rate of 20%.-Select the Journal Entries shown as erroneous under the Messages tab.-Under  VAT / Sales Tax Calculation Details differences show for the involved 2 revenue-relevant journal-entry lines for the Discounts/Rebates Account YYY (YYY represents the Discount G/L Account ID) and Sales-Revenues Account ZZZ (ZZZ represents the Sales Revenues account ID).-Discounts - Account YYY:-Tax Base Amount:            -1175.02 EUR-Calculated Tax Amount:     -235.00 EUR-Posted Tax Amount:           -235.20 EUR-Sales Revenue - Account ZZZ:-Tax Base Amount:            1199.00 EUR-Calculated Tax Amount:     239.80 EUR-Posted Tax Amount:           240.00 EUR-In the original journal entry created by the credit memo postings show correspondingly as:-Revenue ZZZ:                  1199.00 EUR-Discounts YYY:               -1175.02 EUR-For VAT g/l account VVV (VVV represents the Tax G/L Account)only one entry is shown, combining the resulting VAT posting and VAT-adjustment for the preceding customer invoice.-VAT VVV:                            4,80 EUR-The reconciliation report however calculates each revenue item separately following this logic:-Sum of applied Tax Base Amounts: 1199.00 EUR - 1175.02 EUR = 23.98 EUR-Consequently sales revenues ZZZ represents a ratio of 1199/23.98 = 50.00.-The tax value attributed to revenues ZZZ is therefore 50 * 4,80 EUR = 240.00 EUR. (Calc. 239.80)-The ratio for applied discounts is correspondingly -1175.02/23.98 = -49.00.-The tax value attributed to discounts YYY is therefore -49 * 4,80 EUR = -235.20 EUR. (Calc. -235.00 EUR)-Resolution-As illustrated, the differences between calculated and posted tax amounts resulting from the applied rounding logic in the Reconciliation Report cancel each other out for sales-revenues- and discount/rebate g/l accounts.-Errors originating from these rounding differences can hence be ignored.-Keywords-Reconciliation. Rounding. Revenue. Tax Base Amount.

Title: Payroll Data Error: Employee’s Tax Data Cannot be Changed
Content: Symptom-When you try to complete Payroll Data for an employee, system throws an error:-The employee’s tax data cannot be changed as federal tax information is not setup for your company. You must add this information in the Personnel Administration ‘Authorities’ view by adding a new federal tax arrangement record and activating it OR-Company tax arrangement for federal tax authority is missing or incomplete. For reporting purposes, the employer must have a valid company tax arrangement.-You have already maintained a valid company tax arrangement as follows:-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Choose the Tax Authorities subview under the view Authorities.-3. Edit Tax Authority: XX(XX represents Tax Authority).-4. Company Tax Arrangements is filled.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Personal Administration workcenter.-2. Work view.-3. Select an employee.-4. Select Task : Complete Payroll Data- for specific Country.-5. Select Payroll Group ID.-Error messagge thrown mentioned above.-Cause-There is no Employee Identification Number maintained for Tax Authority.-Resolution-Steps to add Employee Identification Number for Tax Authority : XX and employee's Company : 1000:-1. Go to Personnel Administration workcenter.-2. Choose the Tax Authorities subview under the Authorities view.-3. Edit Tax Authority: XX.-4. Go to Company Tax Arrangements-5. Select Tax Numbers.-6. Add Row and select Tax Number Type as Employee Identification Number.-Keywords-Tax Authority, Payroll Data

Title: Unable to Release Price List as Some Products Have Status Not Released
Content: Symptom-You are unable to release a price list, such as a Customer Specific Price List, after saving your changes, because some Products show as Not Released, but the price list, on header level, has the status 'Released'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Click on the Pricing view and then on 'Price Lists' sub view.-Open the respective price list. -Modify the data (e.g. dates or prices).-Save the changes.-You can see that the Release button is not enabled.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that some Products have the status Not Released.-Cause-Due to an internal technical buffer handling issue, it might happen that some products in the price list are not released, even though the price list header is released.-SAP is already aware of this and is working to permanently solve it in the future releases.-Resolution-For the affected price list, you need to perform a dummy change for one of the products in the items tab, e.g. by changing the amount, pressing the enter key on your keyboard and then changing the price back to the its original value. The header status will then change and it will again be possible to release the price list.-To avoid this issue, you can use either workaround described below:-After adding a new product into the price list, don’t save the price list, instead use the Release action in the User Interface (the Release will save the price list internally and then trigger the release action). -After adding a product price in the price list, Save the price list and then Close it. Reopen the price list via the Edit button and then Release it.-Keywords-price list, release button, greyed out, product and service portifolio, pricing

Title: While Opening Any Material, System Opens a New Screen to Create a New Material With Error: "XYZ is Not a Valid Value for This Field. Enter a Valid Value"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-On opening any Material and selecting View All, the system does not show the details of the Material. Instead, a new screen opens to create a New Material and displays the error:-XYZ is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.-*XYZ represents the Currency-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Products view-Go to By Materials subview-Open any Material-Choose Edit-Select View All-A new screen opens to create a New Material, and displays the error-Cause-Technical inconsistencies in the backend.-Resolution-As a workaround, you may follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Currencies-Search for Currency Code XYZ-Uncheck the Blocked box-Select Save and Close-Further, report an incident to SAP to fix the issue.-Keywords-System Opens a New Screen to Create a New Material

Title: Error Appears While Creating New Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new supplier invoice and system throws an error message.-Error: Item 1: Jurisdiction code missing in address of Location ABC (where ABC represents the location).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Enter Buying Company.-Error appears.-Cause-You have not maintained the Tax Jurisdiction Code for the location or the associated site XYZ (where XYZ represents the site).-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to maintain the Tax jurisdiction code;-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Locate the Org Unit DEF (where DEF represents the Org Unit).-Go to the Definitions tab.-Select the link for the site XYZ, available against the field Associated Site.-Select Edit and navigate to the General tab.-In the Site Address field, you can see that Tax Jurisdiction Code is missing.-Maintain the Tax Jurisdiction Code and select Save.

Title: Account Determination Group of Payment Data cannot be modified.
Content: Symptom-Cannot modify the Account Determination Group of Payment Data in accounts via ManageCustomerIn servcie.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to User and Account Management workcenter.-2. Select Service Explorer view.-3. Search for the service : ManageCustomerIn.-4. Download the WSDL file.-5. Perform the modification of the field : Account Determination Group using SOAP UI.-The value does not change.-Resolution-Use the following code to change the AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode and the name of the customer accordingly:-<n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">- <BasicMessageHeader/>- <Customer actionCode="02">-  <!--Optional:-->-  <InternalID>XXX</InternalID> // (where XXX represents Internal ID of Account)-  <Organisation>-   <!--Optional:-->-   <FirstLineName></FirstLineName>-   <!--Optional:-->-   <SecondLineName></SecondLineName>-  </Organisation>-  <PaymentData actionCode="02">-   <!--Optional:-->-   <CompanyID></CompanyID>-   <!--Optional:-->-   <AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode></AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode>-  </PaymentData>- </Customer>-</n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-Keywords-Account Determination Group, Payment Data

Title: Solution Profile Value Help is Empty While Requesting a new Productive System
Content: Symptom-You are requesting a new Productive system from Test system through Service Control Center but in the value selection for Solution Profile, no Solution Profile is listed.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Control Center work center.-Select Systems view.-Select Request Creation button by highlighting the Test System.-Resolution-The current value help is correctly showing as empty.--1. If you want to create a new test system with a given Solution Profile, you have to create a Change Project first. This can then be selected. The value help currently does not show anything to select from, because there is no appropriate Change Project. The status of Solution Profile must not be Live or Closed. Status has to be In Preparation, Started or Tested.--2. If you want to reuse this test system with a new Solution Profile then you need to use the action copy solution profile. However the value help also shows only the possible Solution Profiles. Hence you need to create a Change Project first.--3. If you want a full copy of the productive tenant including data and all profiles, you need to select option copy of source system instead of copy of source system (copy of solution profile).-Keywords-Copy Solution Profile, Service and Control,

Title: Data Migration Template for Business Roles is not available in SAP Business ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to Migrate Business Roles for the Employees in SAP Business ByDesign system. But the activity Migration of Business Roles is missing in Business Configuration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search for the activity Migration of Business Roles-Cause-Data Migration Template for Business Roles is not available in SAP Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-To Migrate Business Roles for Employees in the SAP Business ByDesign system, use the Migration of Employee Data template.-You may follow the below steps in your system:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Employee Data-Choose Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen-Select Download Migration Template-In the Access Rights sheet, you will be able to enter the Business Role information for the Employees -Keywords-Migration of Employee Data, Migrate Business Roles, Migration of Business Roles

Title: Terminated Employee is Available in the List of Active Employees in Personnel Administration work center
Content: Symptom-The Employee XYZ (where XYZ represents the Employee) is Terminated from the Organization, but is available in the list of Active Employees in Personnel Administration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To Terminate the Employee XYZ:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Show Active Employees and Search the Employee XYZ-Select Actions->Terminate Relationship with Employee-Update Last Working Day as DD.MM.YYYY-Termination Category: XXXXX (where XXXXX represents the Terminaton Category)-Termination Reason: YYYYY (where YYYYY represents the Termination Reason)-Select Save-To check if the Employee XYZ is Active:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Show Active Employees and Search the Employee XYZ-Employee XYZ is still available as an Active Employee-Cause-The Employee XYZ is terminated since DD.MM.YYYY. Therefore, the Employee is still part of the Organization upto DD.MM.YYYY 23:59 HRS and hence, will be available in the list of Active Employees in Personnel Administration work center.-Resolution-Check the Personnel Administration work center on DD1.MM1.YYYY1. You will notice that Employee XYZ is part of Inactive Employees in the system.-Keywords-Terminate Relationship with Employee, Terminated Employee is Available

Title: Cannot Post Time for Sales Order for an Employee
Content: Symptom-You are not able to select the Sales Order for an Employee in Time Sheet while posting time.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Time Administration workcenter.-2. Select Time Sheet view.-3. Search the Employee ID: XXX (where XXX represents Employee ID).-4. Select Time Entry and Add Row.-5. You cannot search the required Sales Order.-  Cause-Service Performer under Sales Order is not assigned to employee XXX.-Resolution-1. Go to Sales Order workcenter.-2. Open required Sales Order.-3. Navigate to tab : Items.-4. Add Row to add new line item.-5. Under Details sub-tab navigate to Service and add employee XXX under Service Performer.

Title: Error Message "Registerd Product ID XXX not valid" When Migrating Registered Products
Content: Symptom-System throws the below error in the simulation step, while Migrating Registered Products.- Error: "Registerd Product ID Productxyz not valid" (Where Productxyz represents Registered Product ID)-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select the Overview view-3. Search and Select Migration of Registered Products-4. Select Migrate Registered Products using Migration tool-5. Select the file you need to Migrate-6. Select the option to Execute Migration Step by Step-7. Select Next till the Simulation step-Cause-There can be multiple reasons for this error message. One of reasons can be that the Registered Product ID which you are trying to migrate have some special character (e.g. $, %, *, space or number that start with zero).-Resolution-1. Remove the Special Characters and then Migrate-2. Registered Product Serial ID field value is alphanumeric and supports alphabet A - Z, numbers 0 – 9, hyphen (-), underscore ( _ ), colon (:)-Any other characters other than the above mentioned are not supported. Currently this is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Registered Products, Migration of Registered Products,

Title: Limited Employees in Sending Task on Personnel Administration
Content: Symptom-User want to create a new task in Personnel Administration work center, but the user want to send the task is not available on new task screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Work view.-Select the button New.-The employee that user want to send the task is not available on field To.-Cause-The user that want to send the task does not have access for Personnel Administration work center.-As per help document Working with Tasks, Notifications, and Alerts, User can only send Tasks for those users who have access to the work center from where users are creating the task.-Resolution-This is a designed system behavior.-Keywords-personnel administration, limited employees, tasks, work view-employee missing,sending task,limited employee, access resriction

Title: In the Report Cash - Trial Balance Your Selection Shows Bank Account/Petty Cash with # (Hash) Sign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the Report Cash - Trial Balance your selection is showing information in Bank Account/Petty Cash with # (Hash) sign instead of the correct amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-On Silverlight User Interface:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search Cash - Trial Balance.-Click Cash - Trial Balance.-Click Go.-Information on Bank Account/Petty Cash is showing.-On Rows, move fields G/L Account; My Bank; Cash Location Type to Move to Not Currently Shown.-On Not Currently Shown move field Line Item Currency to Move to Rows.-Click Go.-Once the Report runs again, Bank Account/Petty Cash shows all information with #.-On HTML5 User Interface:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search Cash - Trial Balance.-Click Cash - Trial Balance.-Click Apply.-Information on Bank Account/Petty Cash is showing.-Go to View tab.-On Row Fields, remove G/L Account; My Bank; Cash Location Type.-Click Row Fields Add Fields to Row.-Select Line Item Currency.-Click OK.-Click Go.-Once the Report runs again, Bank Account/Petty Cash shows all information with #.-Cause-The Bank Account/Petty Cash ID is in combination with Cash Location Type. So, if Cash Location Type is removed, the value of Bank Account/Petty Cash ID changes to # as the report is no longer able to fetch its value.-Resolution-Don't remove Cash Location Type while doing your field selection for the Report, this way the information will be fetched correctly.-Keywords-Cash Location Type, Bank Account/Petty Cash, Cash - Trial Balance, amount not showing, Hash Sign, Sharp Sign

Title: Negative Balance for Cost of Goods Sold after Applying Periodic Valuation Runs
Content: Symptom-The Deferrerd Cost of Goods Sold (DCoGS) account XYZ shows a negative balance (Credit) for a given accounting period XXX.YYYY. The applied accrual methods is Reverse deferrals and accruals.-Given that associated valuation runs as GR/IR Clearing and Revenue Recognition are periodically executed - the distinct assumption is that the DCoGS account is balanced at the end of each financial period.-( Where XYZ represents G/L account )-  Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Reports select G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Fill in the necessary attributes for Company, Set of Books, Accounting Period/Year.-As G/L Account specify the respective DCoGS-account XYZ.-Via Settings / Key Figures you can draw the attribute Balance Company Currency into the results-table.-G/L account XYZ shows a negative balance (Credit).-Cause-The fact alone that the DCoGS-account shows a negative balance (Credit) for a given accounting period does not necessarily imply a system error - even when all valuation runs have been conducted periodically and the applied accrual methods is  Reverse deferrals and accruals.-A balance in Credit can originate for example from Goods and Service Receipt cancelations associated with previous periods or fiscal years.-In order to identify such documents causing a negative balance it applies to filter for affected projects.-  Example:-Project PPP shows a balance of - 20.000 EUR for period 002.2015 for DCoGS account XYZ. This is also reflected in the report Project - Line Items for the respective period.-When filtering for Journal Entry Type it becomes apparent how this balance is computed.- ( Where PPP represents Project ID ) ( Where DEF,GHI, JKL represents Supplier ID)-Journal Entry Type  Posting Date  Balance DCoGS-Goods Receipt from Supplier DEF over 35.000 EUR (Debit).  10.02.2015  35.000 EUR-Reversal of Goods Receipt from Supplier GHI over -20.000 EUR (Credit).-Reversal GHI cancels Goods Receipt from Supplier JKL exhibiting a posting date 15.02.2014.- 15.02.2015- 15.000 EUR-Goods Receipt/Invoice Clearing over -5.000 EUR (Credit) relating to Goods Receipt from Supplier DEF.  28.02.2015  10.000 EUR-Revenue Recognition clearing -30.000 EUR (Credit) against DCoGS account XYZ.  28.02.2015 -20.000 EUR

Title: Error Message "Material ID ZZ34 not valid; it does not fall within the allowed range A - ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ or 1 - 99999999999999" While Migrating Materials
Content: Symptom-When you are migrating Materials, system throws below error message:-Material ID Productxyz not valid; it does not fall within the allowed range A - ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ or 1 - 99999999999999-(ProductXYZ represents the material ID)-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-3. Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Materials-4. Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The Material ID must be starting with Alphabets and ends with Numeric ﻿and specific configuration hasn't been maintained in activity Number Ranges for Materials-Resolution-You can maintain the Number Ranges for Materials as below in order to have Material ID starting with Alphabets and ends with Numeric.-Start Number: .-End Number: ZZZZZZZZZZ9999999999-Interval Type: Manual

Title: Namespace in ISO20022 Payment File for Switzerland not as Expected
Content: Symptom-You want to create an Outgoing Payment File with format ISO20022 for Switzerland. The file has been created but it is not readable by the bank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This is a bank specific scenario resulting in this error message (provided by the bank):-The XML namespace of the system-generated payment files "isurn: std: iso: 20022: tech: xsd: pain.001.001.03" deviates from the namespace required by the bank.-Cause-There are two very similar payment medium formats for ISO20022 but for Switzerland it has to be CH ISO20022.-Resolution-In Bank Details under Payment Format enter Payment Medium Format code: CH ISO20022.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Banks subview.-Select your bank and click Edit - Bank Account.-Select the relevant bank account and go to the Payment Format tab.-Choose format CH ISO20022and save.-Then the payment file will be created with the correct Namespace for Switzerland.-Keywords-Namespace ISO20022 Payment file Switzerland

Title: Mexico Electronic Accounting Run: Not Able to Specify G/L Account for AUX File
Content: Symptom-There's no option to specify a G/L Account or a range of G/L Accounts upon execution of Mexico Electronic Accounting Run with Report Data Selection AUX File.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1805-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > Mexico Electronic Accounting view.-Click New > Electronic Accounting Report Run.-Under Report Selection Data section, select AUX File.-Notice that there's no option to specify a G/L Account or a range of G/L Accounts.-Cause-The Account Auxiliary (AUX File) can be generated for 2 reasons:-Tax refunds: all accounts have to be reported.-Audit from the government: in this case, the government could request the file for only some accounts.-Resolution-The possibility to generate the AUX File for a specific G/L Account or a set of G/L Accounts (to adhere with item number #2 above) is currently not available in the system.-SAP is working to provide this functionality in a future Business ByDesign release.-Keywords-Mexico Electronic Accounting Run; AUX File; Contabilidad electrónica México; Fichero AUX

Title: End-User Can Change Order Of The Work Centres
Content: Symptom-Although the Personalization was disabled, the end-users can still change the order of the work centres themselves.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the system with any user.-Change the order of the work centres by drag and drop.-Result: It is possible to change the order of the work centres with any user at all.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour.-Even if the Personalization has been disabled, this is still possible.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-See Also-2560599 - Rearrange Work Center Sequence via Edit Master Layout-Keywords-End-User Can Change Order Of The Work Centres, Sequence

Title: How to Search for Materials That Have Been Blocked for Sales or Purchasing
Content: Symptom-You want to search for all Materials that you have blocked for Sales or Purchasing﻿.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-On Advanced Search there is no option to search for Materials in Blocked status for Purchasing or Sales.-Cause-This functionality is not available in current Business ByDesign release.-Resolution-As workaround is possible to look the Sales and Purchasing status of Materials using the Mass Change functionality following the steps below-Go to Product Data work center and select Products view.-Select a certain amount of Materials that you want to see (use the key SHIFT from your keyboard to select a large range).-Press the button 'Mass Change'.-On the tab General, you will find the Purchasing status of the Materials.-On the tab Sales, you will find the Sales status.-Note: This workaround is also valid for Services.-See Also-As per the knowledge base article "1619077 - Filters Do Not Work in Any Views of the Mass Change of Materials And Services", it is not possible to use filters in Mass Change screen.-Keywords-mass change, materials, search materials, blocked materials, sales, purchasing-search material blocked

Title: Advanced: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You observe an error/warning/information UI message and want to know what is causing the issue.-This KBA will give you the steps to locate and understand what Method/Class/Object/Variable is causing an error in the system and where to find the root cause in the code.-Note: Every scenario is different, but you should follow the same troubleshooting steps.-Prerequisites: -Please ensure you understand fully the process described in KBA: 2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger-Please ensure you have a good understanding of how to identify elements of the ABAP language.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer and SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Issues that occur in the SAP System can come from multiple sources in the ABAP code. As we have access to the backend system, we can view every location available to us to identify the root cause.-Some areas that failures can occur:-UI Layer (Oberon classes/methods)-Application Layer (Standard classes/methods)-PDI Layer (Custom classes/methods)-Database Layer (HANA commits)-Frequently seen error locations:-Function Modules (These can be recognised by the statement 'Call Function' in the method).-Conditional/Validation Statements (IF / Else statements,  TRY CATCH Block).-Method calls returning the wrong values.-Time Out dumps in methods where we are processing a large amount of data. (The system has a standard profile setting stating the maximum time per transaction. If this is reached, the process is aborted).-  Resolution-Scenario A: You receive an Error message when saving an opportunity.-When you trigger the debugger using the Message Class CM_ESI_T100, you are able to identify the message Object variable holding the message class/number and the Application Component responsible.-Now you want to add to your analysis with the view to closing the incident by locating the root cause of the error.-  How to use the Debugger tools/buttons-The debugger comes with multiple buttons for the user to analyse the ABAP code logic. The buttons allow us to step through the ABAP code, one executable line at a time or process the entire method in one click. The diagram below is a representation of the buttons available for you to debug with.-How to use the Variables pane in the Debugger-When you are debugging, you will need to open some ABAP elements to view the content inside. This can help you determine the processing error(s) in this method, or a previous method where the information has been passed from.-To enable you to view the contents of a variable, 'Double-Click' on the ABAP variable in the method you are debugging in. This will load the variable to the Variable pane for viewing.-You will see different values shown in the Value column depending on the variable type you opened.-Example:-Opening a variable <LT_DATA>: This is a local table and will show you the [Rows*Columns] inside.-Opening an object LO_ATTRIBUTE: This is a local object that will show you methods/classes the object has been created about and data inside.-Note: Please be aware that the variables you will see will NOT always be the same as in the example above.  As a general rule the prefix before the '_' will inform you what type of ABAP element you are opening.-Examples:-LO_      (Local Object).-LR_      (Local Resource).-LT_      (Local Table).-LS_      (Local Structure).- You also have a 'Delete' button. This does not delete data. This will only clear the list of variables in your pane.-   What to look for in the Call Stack-The Call stack is a representation of the processes that are executed for a particular action. This will be different for every action that occurs in the system.-When you are debugging you should be familiar with the call stack and which stack levels to open.-Best Practices:-Do not open any Constructor(s) (unless needed).-You check the method preceeding the Constructor method first.  You should be able to identify in the abap coding language what is happening to lead to the Message Object being created.-Check the names of the methods that are executed. Example: MODIFY  This will perform/show some changes on the Business Object instance that the action has been executed on.-Open a lower level in the stack and follow the process flow to the top to track the application's behaviour.-Identify if the issue is because of PDI or Standard Application Classes. A PDI Class will have PDI written in the name.-Application causing error:-PDI Classes causing the error.-IF the last method call in the stack is a PDI class, then the PDI team need to analyse the issue. This is because the Message Object is created in the PDI class and pushed to the Constructor.-  What to look for in the ABAP code.-Before debugging you should have a good understanding of the ABAP language. This will allow you to recognise certain ABAP elements in the code and make troubleshooting faster.-As the ABAP program executes,  the system has to distribute, transform and transfer data. In a large system like the SAP System, 1 method does not hold all the code necessary to complete an action. This may be made up of multiple branches of methods or functions to process data. This data also has to be transferred to other methods in some way that the system can receive and perform further tasks.-You should be able to recognise:-Tables: These usually have the prefix 'LT_' before.  Example:  <LT_DATA>.-Structures: These are usually a transformation of a table and can have the prefix 'LS_'. Example: <LS_DATA>.-Objects: These usually have the prefix 'LO_' before. Example: LO_Attribute.-Method Calls.-Variables.-Developer comments will be shown in a grey colour in the methods.-There are two statements which you should take care to observe. These are:-TRY CATCH statements.-IF / Else  statements.- A TRY CATCH statement will 'Try to' perform some actions. This could be calling a method and passing information to be processed further. If there is an issue that occurs during processing, then instead of the system crashing, the catch statement is able to handle this error and create the Message Object.-The IF / Else statement is a conditional statement. There will be an ABAP element in the IF clause. This will be checked against a parameter. IF this element succeeds the clause, this block of code is processed. IF NOT, then the Else statement is processed instead. Example: An error is shown in the UI.-    Setting more breakpoints in the debugger.-The ability to set more breakpoints in the debugger is a good asset to the user. When debugging complex issues and moving deeper in the process from the original breakpoint, you can set multiple breakpoints to allow you to jump forward through the different methods in execution.-You set a new breakpoint in the debugger by clicking on the left margin of the code. You can then hit the Save button on the toolbar. This will activate the breakpoint.-You can then press F8 (Continue) which will execute the code leading up to the new breakpoint. This can be very useful when marking points where the issue is not occurring, or even executing a LOOP statement with a large number of itterations.-  After reviewing this KBA, you should be enabled to debug deeper in the SAP System in different scenarios presented to you.-  What information should I take from the Debugger?-Take between 5-10 lines from the top of the Call Stack to be passed to development (if applicable) (Press CTRL+Y to highlight).-The Message class and Number values / Component.-ABAP Line number where issue is occurring.-Any relevant and applicable developer comments in the method.-A detailed step by step reproduction for development to follow (and other colleagues).-The application component responsible for the method where the issue occurs (Class definition). -The methods that you entered when stepping through the application process and the information you observed. This should included variable names, tables, structures and objects which are relevant.-See Also-Case Document:  2638478 - Central Case Document for Debugging-Case Document:  2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger-Case Document: Advanced: How to Debug Web Services Using The Debugger  (to be created)-Case Document: How to Debug and Analyse a ST22 Dump  (to be created)-Keywords-Advance, Debug, ABAP, ABSL, Class, Method, PDI

Title: You Want to Migrate Addresses Through the Migration of Leads
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate Addresses through the Migration of Leads but notice that the Migration of Leads template does not offer the possibility to maintain Addresses.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Open Activity List button.-Search and open activity Migration of Leads.-Select Migrate leads using the migration tool link.-Select You Can Also than chose Download Migration Template link -Once you open the migration template in Microsoft Excel there is no tab or field where you can maintain an Address.-Cause-The Address fields are still not part of the migration template. This requirement will be considered for one of the future release.-Resolution-In the meantime, you can use the NOTE field for keeping address details.-Keywords-Adresse, Migrations, Vorlage-migration of leads

Title: Error Message: "Rehire failed", While Rehiring Employee in Personnel Administration Work Center
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to Rehire a Service Agent XYZ (where XYZ represents the Service Agent) as an Internal Employee in Personnel Administration work center. Upon Rehiring and saving changes, you receive the error:-Rehire failed-Error activating employee assignment at position; see detailed messages-Employee XYZ (ID YYYYY) has more than one position assignment per time frame-*XYZ represents the Employee and YYYYY represents the Employee ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Choose the tab relevant to the Country in which you would Rehire the Employee XYZ-Select Rehire Employee-Fill the required details-Select Save-System throws errors-Cause-System does not allow a Service Agent and Employee with the same Employee ID to have the same Job and Organizational Assignment in the system.-Resolution-Before Rehiring the Employee as an Internal Employee, remove the Job and Organizational assignment for Service Agent XYZ in the Business Partner workcenter.-Keywords-Rehire failed, Error activating employee assignment at position, Employee has more than one position assignment per time frame, Service Agent, Employee

Title: Note For Open Item Is Blank in New Manual Clearing
Content: Symptom-The Note field for an Open Item is blank in New Manual Clearing screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers > Supplier Accounts view.-Search for the Account ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Account ID).-Select the row of the account and click View (Supplier Account Monitor will open).-Select the row of one open item which has Note field maintained (for example Invoice ABC with Note DEF).-Click Clear Manually.-Notice that Note DEF is displayed in New Manual Clearing screen.-Unmatch the Open Item.-Notice that Note field vanishes.-Cause-It is the system standard behavior to make the Note field visible only when the item is matched on the Manual Clearing screen (not just the Note, but any other field that creates a Due clearing explanation, for example Cash Discount, Cleared Amount, etc.).-Resolution-The ideal way to do a Manual Clearing while referring to the Note at the same time would be to filter the documents by Note field in the Account Monitor itself, as follows:-Include the Note field in the Supplier Account Monitor using Personalization mode (Personalize > This Screen).-Select single/multiple items that you want to clear by referring the Note in the Account Monitor itself.-Select Clear Manually, and you'll see that the document(s) selected for clearing would already be matched and the Note field displayed.-Keywords-Item Details; Note; Clear Manually; New Manual Clearing; Open Items; Matched; Match Items; Unmatch Items;

Title: Currency Conversion Not Occurring During Fixed Assets Migration
Content: Symptom-While migration Fixed Assets, in the 'Verify Posting Preview' step, no currency conversion is taking place.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Select respective project and click Open Activity List.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration button.-Select the Migration Object Fixed Assets.-Click Process File button.--In the step 'Verify Posting Preview', system does not display the values converted as per Exchange Rates maintained in the General Ledger Work Center > Edit Exchange Rates view.-Cause-The cross-check values are based entirely upon what is provided by the user to the system via the template, and no currency conversion will be done separate to this.-Resolution-System takes the same values entered in the template, no conversion is done at this stage, and no conversion will be done on posting into the system itself. The same values here will appear on the Journal Entries. So, this is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Migration, Currency, Conversion, Fixed Assets

Title: Missing Automatic Convertion for Logistic Area in the Mapping Task of Inventory Migration
Content: Symptom-When executing the migration of inventory, the values for logistic areas are not automatically mapped in the migration step 2 with the IDs inserted in the template, although they are the exact same.-If you open the value help, you are able to find the IDs and select them for the mapping.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1805 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview view, search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migrate Accounting Transaction Data using the Migration Tool.-Select one of the migration instances and click on Execute Migration.-Select the file for Inventory and click on Process File.-Proceed to the step 2 - Mapping.-Open the mapping task Convert Values for Logistic Area ID.-You can see the list of values that should be mapped automatically, but the mapped value field is blank.-Cause-The issue happens because the logistic areas are set with status "In Preparation" instead of "Active".-Resolution-To have the automatic mapping in the migration, make sure that the logistic areas in the template are active in the system.-Keywords-accounting transaction data, migration workbench

Title: Error Message: No Valid Cost of Type ABC Exists for Material DEF in Business Residence XYZ
Content: Symptom-You have executed Update Inventory Cost run and received error message:-No valid cost of type ABC exists for material DEF in business residence XYZ. (ABC represents cost type, DEF represents Material ID, XYZ represents Business Residence ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Update Inventory Costs subview.-Select the relevant run.-Click on View.-Go to Not Processed tab.-You can see the error message: No valid cost of type ABC exists for material DEF in business residence XYZ.-Cause-The error is due to Source Cost Type is selected as ABC under Data Selection tab and you have not maintained the ABC cost type in the Material master data.-Resolution-You need to maintain the Cost Type for the respective Material.-In the Product Data work center, choose the Materials view.-Search material DEF and click Edit.-In the Valuation tab, select the respective Business Residence XYZ.-Edit the ABC Cost Type for the assigned Sets of Books and for a certain validity-period.-Click Save.-You should now be able to sucessfully complete an Update Inventory Cost run for Source Cost Type ABC.-Keywords-No valid cost, Update Inventory Cost

Title: How to Set the Deactivation Date for Migrated Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-A migrated Fixed Asset needs to be deactivated. The migration has already been reversed.-The fixed asset's net value is 0.00 LC (Local Currency).-The fixed asset remains in status Capitalized.-In general, assets with a net value of 0.00 LC can be deactivated by setting the Deactivation date in the life cycle data; However, the Deactivation Date is not enabled for migrated fixed assets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Fixed Assets work center.-Select the affected Fixed Asset XYZ (where XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID) and press Edit -Master Data.-Navigate to the Life Cycle Data subtab.-The Deactivation Date cannot be maintained.-Cause-Either the Process Control for Migration Postings has not been maintained,-or the Entry Possible Until date is not restricted, meaning that Unlimited has been maintained for the relevant Business Process Group.-Resolution-To enable the Deactivation Date for migrated fixed assets set up the Process Control as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Navigate to the Companies view  and select the relevant company.-Make a note of the Posting Date for Migration.-Choose Set Process Control button.-In the new screen press Add Row and maintain the following settings:-Process Control Status: Not Blocked-Business Process Group: 09 - Migration-Entry Possible Until: Enter a current date, for example, Today or later.-From Posting Date and To Posting Date:  Equal to Posting Date for Migration-With this setting the Deactivation date will be enabled from the date after the last possible entry date.-Keywords-Fixed asset cannot be scrapped ; Migration ; Life Cycle Data ; Deactivation Date ;  Scrap ; Scrapping ; Manual Postings ; Complete Scrapping ;-fixed asset cannot be scrapped,migration,life cycle data,deactivation date,scrap,scrapping,manual postings,complete scrapping

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Error: Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY must be migration date for Movement Category 07
Content: Symptom-You are performing the migration of Fixed Assets and you encountered an error : Posting Date DD.MM.YYYY must be migration date for Movement Category 07.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Open the Activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate Accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the Migration Unit for the fixed asset.-Click on Execute Migration.-Cause-Movement Category 07- Migration of Accumulated Values (Last Period Previous Year) can be selected only when you are executing Migration at the end of a fiscal year and your migration date is ( for example, December 31, 2016 ) but if you are doing Migration during a fiscal year and your migration date is also in current year then Movement Cateogory needs to be 08 - Migration of Accumulated Values (Current Year).-Resolution-If the migration is at end of a fiscal year ( for example, December 31, 2016 ) then Movement Category can be applied as 07- Migration of Accumulated Values (Last Period Previous Year).-If the migration is during a fiscal year ( for example, June 30, 2017 )  then Movement Category can be applied as 08-Migration of Accumulated Values (Current Year).-When your migration date is set in the current year ( for example, June 30, 2017 ) then what ever values you are accumulating of your old fixed assets then that has to be in the current year accumulation of your previous year and that is possible only with movement category 08 - Migration of Accumulated Values ( Current Year ) .-Keywords-Fixed Asset Migration Movement Category, MIgration Date

Title: Journal Entry Voucher of type Manual Entry for Accounts Payable does not Clear Invoice
Content: Symptom-A Journal Entry Voucher of type Manual Entry for Accounts Payable is posted against a Payables general ledger account, referencing a Supplier and the corresponding open Supplier Invoice XYZ(XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice number). When checking the Supplier Account Monitor you notice that invoice XYZ is still listed as open with the full open amount, not taking the Journal Entry posting into consideration.-You were expecting the Manual Journal Entry to reduce the Open amount of the Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Navigate to the Journal Entries view and choose Journal Entry Vouchers, click New.-As Journal Entry Type select Manual Entry for Accounts Payable.-Add a Payables g/l account (e.g. Accounts Payables - Domestic), state the amount, Supplier and Source Document reference.-Enter a balancing line and Post.-In order to check the invoice status in the Supplier Account Monitor complete the following:-Access the Payables work center and select the relevant Supplier in the Supplier Accounts view.-Press View and and access the tab Trade Payables, Invoices/Payments.-You notice that invoice XYZ is still listed under Open Items and the full values remains as the Open Amount in Transaction Currency.-Cause-Journal Entry Vouchers of type Manual Entry for Accounts Payables are not intended to act as clearing document against the referenced Supplier Invoice. These transactions serve as manual adjustment merely affecting the General Ledger. The referencing of invoice document XYZ is declaratory, and does not affect the Open Amount in Transaction Currency. Consequently neither in the Supplier Account Monitor nor in the Document Flow of invoice XYZ or the resulting adjustment journal entry a corresponding Clearing ID is listed.-Resolution-In order to post adjustments against invoice XYZ, for the value that was entered in the Journal Entry Voucher you must make a manual adjustment as an Additional Discount or Credit.-Navigate to the Payables work center and highlight invoice XYZ in the Supplier Account Monitor.-Choose Clear Manually.-Here you have the option to Apply Discount or Credit stating a Payment Difference Reason.-Select Agreed settlement and enter the value that was entered in the Journal Entry Voucher.-Once Invoice XYZ is fully cleared the Manual Journal Entry write-ups/write-downs with reference to a source document automatically generate an inverse posting. You will also see the clearing ID will appear as reference on the Manual Journal Entry.-See Also-Please see Help Document: Manual Entries for Accounts Payable-Keywords-Manual Entry for Accounts Payable, Manual Write-Up/Write-Down Accounts Pay, Additional Discounts or Credit

Title: Unable to Discard Outbound File
Content: Symptom-The outbound file in Liquidity Management is in In Transfer status and the Discard button is grayed out. You want to Discard the file because the relevant payments, which are included in this file are canceled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management view and select the Outbound Files subview.-Select the file that is In Transfer, and click Actions.-Under the Actions tab, Discard button is grayed out, and only option is to Confirm.-Cause-In Transfer Outbound File cannot be discarded, now the file status is independent from the payment status. Since the file arrived the bank, you can only Confirm the file.-Resolution-Confirmation of a file means that it arrived at the bank and the bank knows about it. This is the only meaning. It does NOT mean, that a payment was executed by the bank. In this case it is correct to confirm the files though.--However, since your payments were canceled, you can inform your bank about it, that these items to be included or not to be included in the bank account transactions and statement that you are going to receive.-Keywords-Outbound file; release; discard; confirm; cancel confirm payment;-outbound file,release,discard,confirm,cancel confirm payment

Title: Customer Invoice / Credit Memo Grayed Out Under the Account
Content: Symptom-You want to maintain a template for the Customer Invoice / Credit Memo under an Account, however you find the Template field to be grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account).-Click the Edit button and select the General option.-Navigate to the Collaboration subtab, under the Communication tab.-Select the Customer Invoice / Credit Memo line.-The Template field is grayed out/inactive.-Cause-The field ‘Template’ for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo under account level is grayed out or inactive by default and this is the expected system behavior.-For the Customer Invoice / Credit Memo, the system will first use the Invoicing Unit to determine the form selection, and if the Invoicing Unit cannot be found, it will use the Seller Party.-Thus the form template selection does not depend on the Account, but on the rules that are defined in the ‘Form Template Selection’ subview under the Application and User Management work center.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.--Manually change the rules under the ‘Form Template Selection’.-Keywords-Template; Customer Invoice; Credit Memo; Account;

Title: Planned Days Are Not Showing in Time Account Balances
Content: Symptom-You have vacation days approved for future days, however they are not showing in the Planned Days of Time Account Balances.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Open the Employees view.-Select the employee.-Click on the Edit button.-Go to the Time Account Balances tab.-See that the Planned Days are not showing as expected.-Go to the Employee Times tab.-See that the employee has future holiday days approved, but they are not showing in the Planned days as expected.-Cause-Cause 1:-The reason for showing the Balance as Zero is due to the Posting Type Set to Zero which was done initially by the employee or the time administrator.-Cause 2:-For reducing the balance of the vacation account, there needs to be a work schedule assigned to that employee. This is necessary as the balance is calculated against the work schedule.-Cause 3:-Time model for the selected duration is not added in the Work Schedule under the Time Profile for the employee.-Cause 4:-Mapping between Time Type and Time Account: Holiday requests have been made with Time Type ABC, but if we check the configuration for it, this Time Type doesn't have the Time Account XYZ assigned to it (ABC being the Time Type selected for the vacation requests and XYZ being the Time Account selected in Time Account Rules of employee's Time Profile).-Cause 5:-For the Time Type ABC, the Time Account ZYX has been registered for accrual as well as deduction. Both operations in same Time Account will result in Time Valuation error.-Cause 6:-Time Type FGH is not marked as "Relevant for Work Schedule" (where FGH is used in Daily Model assigned to the employee).-Resolution-Resolution for Cause 1: Check resolution of KBA 1506738 - Time Account Balance of an Employee Shows Incorrect Value- Resolution for Cause 2: Check resolution of KBA 1421100 - Vacation Time Account Balance Not Updated Even After Approval of Absence Request- Resolution for Cause 3: Add the Time Model with a valid duration to the Work Schedule of the employee's Time Profile:-Go to Time Administration work center;-Open Employees view;-Select the employee;-Click edit;-Go to Time Profile tab;-Under Details, go to Work Schedule tab;-Add a Time Model;-Make sure the Start and End Date of the Time Profile are valid for the required duration.- Resolution for Cause 4: These are the required adjustments for mapping Time Type ABC and Time Account XYZ:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Search for the Time Types.-Click on the Maintain Employee Time Types option.-Select the Time Type ABC.-Go to the Time Account Posting tab.-Click on Add Row and add the Time Account XYZ.-Save the changes.- Resolution for Cause 5: The Time Account XYZ was registered for Accrual in the Time Account Posting tab of the Time Type and registered for deduction in the Special Posting Order tab of the Time Type. It should be either accrual or deduction.-If only Accrual is required, the Posting Order should be removed from the Special Posting Order tab.-If only Deduction is required, the Time Account XYZ should be removed from the Time Account Posting tab.- Resolution for Cause 6: The Time Type FGH must be marked "Relevant for Work Schedule" by selecting the Productive Time from the drop-down:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Search for the Time Types.-Click on Maintain Employee Time Types.-Select Time Type FGH.-Select Productive Time under "Relevant for Work Schedule" column.-Save the changes.- In any of these cases, after making the configurations, Day closure for every affected Employee will be required. Please find steps below:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Open the Regular Tasks view.-Click on the Run Day Closure for One Employee option.-Select the employee in the value help.-Choose the action "Start Time Valuation".-Click on the Run button.-Provide the Time Profile Start date of the employee selected and click on the Ok button.-Keywords-planned days; time account balances; holiday; future; vacation;

Title: How System Determines the Service Performer in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Sales Order, and in the Sales Order the system has determined the Service Performer ABC (ABC represent the Service Performer ID), but you expected the Service Performer XYZ (XYZ reprsents the Service Performer ID), and now you want to know how the system determines the Service Performer in your Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select New Sales Order.-Enter the Account ACC (ACC represents the Account ID).-Go to View All.-Go to the Involved Tab.-You can see that the Service Performer ABC is determined automatically instead of the Service Performer XYZ.-Cause-In the current release, the system will now determine the Service Performer according to the priority of the rule.  Meaning that a responsibility with “country = US” has an higher priority than “country = ALL”.-Additionally, the system will do a sort on the agent internal UUID (the internal UUID is the identifier from the backend and not visible in the User Interface) and delete duplicate entries.-Pre-requisite: You have maintained the Work Distribution Service Performer for Sale Order and Contracts. This rule can be maintained in the following path:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Employee Work Distribution.-Select the Rule Service Performer for Sale Order and Contracts-  Resolution-This is the normal system behavior for the current release.-Keywords-Service Performer, Sales Order, Determination

Title: Error in Revenue Recognition: A mix of Different Merge Method Codes is not Supported
Content: Symptom-You have executed a revenue recognition run. For a given sales order item the error 'Doc. item <document ID and item ID>: A mix of different merge method codes is not supported' is reported.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition view.-Find and open the related run.-Go to the Messages tab.-You see the error as follows: 'Doc. item <document ID and item ID>: A mix of different merge method codes is not supported'-Cause-The document item in the error message has accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC assigned.  However,  it's leading item has no accrual method assigned.-In order to verify the accrual method and leading items, please follow below steps:-Go to the  Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find the related sales order item.-Highlight the one mentioned in the error message.-Navigate to the Accounting Data tab. You see that the accrual method is 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC. You also find the leading sales order item ID.-Search for the leading sales order item. You see that for the leading item, no accrual method is set.-Resolution-When working with accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC, it is mandatory to have this accrual method assigned to all sales order items of revenue type project sales fixed price. You therefore need to assign the accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC to the leading item also. Then execute the revenue recognition run again. You may also check if there are further fix price items of this sales order missing the accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC.-Keywords-Sales Order. Revenue Recognition. POC. Cost-to-Cost project POC. Accrual Method. Merge Method Codes.

Title: Default Profit Center Derived for On Account Payments
Content: Symptom-You create an Incoming/Outgoing Check or Cash payment using the Assign On Account Payment option.-You notice that the Journal Entry posted the amount to the Default Profit Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search and open Incoming/Outgoing Check/Cash payment ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Check/Cash payment).-Under Accounting Data click on the Journal Entry ID.-The amount assigned as On Account Payment has been posted to the Default Profit Center.-Cause-When an Incoming/Outgoing Check/Cash payment is created via the Assign On Account Payment option then the respective Accounts Receivables/Payables account is being credited (incoming)/debited (outgoing) and the Cash Account is debited (incoming)/credited (outging). For this posting the Default Profit Center is derived as maintained in Fine Tuning in the Profit Center Derivation Activity.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-If you want to define a specific profit center for Cash payments you can select the Cash Subledger when setting up the Default Profit Center:-In the Business Configuration either open the Activity list via the Implementation Project and then navigate to the Fine-Tune phase, or (if your system is live already) open the Business Configuration workcenter and go to the Overview view.-Find the Default Profit Center activity and open it.-In the new screen, under Defaulty Profit Center click on the Edit Default Profit Center link.-Add a row, maintain the relevant Company ID.-In the Subledger column select Cash.-Then select the profit center DEF in the Profit Center column (DEF represents the profit center to be maintained for Cash payments specifically).-Move this setting on top of the generic Default Profit center setting as the profit center derivation works in hierarchical order.-Press Save and Close.-After this all on account payments involving the Cash register will be posted to the defined Profit Center.-Keywords-Default Profit Center, Cash Payment, Incoming/Outgoing On Account Payment, Profit Center Derivation

Title: SII Tax Return is Rejected, Partially Approved or Approved With the Wrong Amount by the Tax Authority
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the SII Tax Return XX (XX Represents the Tax Return ID) has been Rejected or Partially Approved by the Tax Authority.-You want to know what to do in these cases.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to the VAT Tax Returns subview.-Select the Tax Return XX.-Note: The status of Tax Return XX is Rejected or Partially Approved.-Cause-The Tax Authority has rejected all invoices in the Tax Return XX (Rejected status) or the Tax Authority has rejected some of the invoices in the Tax Return XX (Partially Approved status).-In order to check the reason for the rejection, please follow the steps below:--Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to the VAT Tax Returns subview.-Open the Tax Return XX.-Open the Tax Return tab.-Note: The reason for rejection is displayed under Error Description column.-Resolution-You need to make the required changes according to the Error Description linked to the rejected invoices in the Tax Return XX.-Once the changes have been done, please follow the steps below:--A) Tax Return XX is on Rejected status:-    1. Re-schedule the Tax Return Run XY (XY represents the Tax Return Run ID from which Tax Return XX was created).-    2. Submit the newly created Tax Return to the Tax Authority.--B) Tax Return XX is on Partially Approved status:-    1. Re-schedule the Tax Return Run XY.-    2. Submit the newly created Tax Return to the Tax Authority.--C) Tax Return XX was Approved by the Tax Authority but there is a change in the amount of one or more of the submitted invoices:-    1. Cancel the erroneous invoice.-    2. Create a new invoice reflecting the new amount using the same External Reference as in the original invoice.-    3. Create a new Tax Return Run which will create two Tax Returns, one Cancellation Tax Return and one Correction Tax Return.-    4. Release and Submit the Cancellation Tax Return followed by the Correction Tax Return.--Keywords-Tax Management, SII, Suministro Immediato de Información, Tax Return, Run, Amount, Rejected, Partially Approved, Status, Error

Title: Cannot Enter the Identified Stock in Replenishment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You would like to perform Replenishment for a Product and Identified Stock which does not have available quantity in your system. However, you cannot enter the Identified Stock in the Replenishment, the field is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Select the New Replenishment common task.-Click Go.-Select Add Row.-Enter the relevant Site, Logistics Area, Product and Quantity.-The Identified Stock is not editable.-Cause-For a product that you do not have in stock, you cannot enter the Identified Stock in the Replenishment.-Resolution-You can enter the Identified Stock in the Replenish Task by following the steps:-Go to the Internal Logistics work center.-Select the Task Control view.-Search for the Replenish Task XXX generated.-Select the Replenish Task XXX.-Click Confirm.-Here you can enter the Identified Stock ID you want.-XXX = Task ID.-Keywords-IStock ; Replenishment-istock,replenishment

Title: Unable to Change the Credit Card Data in the Credit Card Payment Screen
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the Credit Card Data in the Credit Card Payment Screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Go to the Customer Accounts View.-Select the respective Customer Account.-Click View button.-Select the document to be paid.-Click Pay Manually By > Credit Card.-In the Credit Card Payment Screen, click the Value Help to change the Credit Card.-System does not open the Value Help.-Cause-Credit Card needs to be added in Customer Master Data.-Resolution-To assign a new Credit Card, you need to execute following steps:-Go to the Business Partner Data Work Center.-Go to the Accounts View.-Search and select the Account ID ABC (ABC represents the Account number).-Click Edit and then Financial Data.-Go to the tab Bank Data.-Under Credit Cards, click Assign button.-Add a new credit card.-Click Save.-With this configuration, you should be able to select the Credit Card maintained in the Master Data during the Payment.-Keywords-credit card ; payment ;

Title: Payment Method is Defaulted When Creating a New Customer Account
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Customer Account and the Payment Method field is automatically populated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select New Corporate Account under Common Tasks.-Click View All.-Open the Financial Data tab and the Payment Data subtab.-Enter Company ID-Note: Payment method is defaulted.- Resolution-This is the expected SAP Business Bydesign system behavior. The Payment Method information gets populated by copying the last one used on Customer Account creation.-Keywords-Customer Account; Payment Method; Payment Data; Company

Title: New JEV Failed With Error Messages: 'Derivation for accounting principle XXX, chart of accounts ABC, G/L account ZZZ'
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Journal Entry Voucher, you receive the following error messages:-'No functional area could be assigned.'-'Derivation for accounting principle XXX, chart of accounts ABC, G/L account ZZZ.'-'Nonsales Object.'-'No type is assigned to cost center.'-'Journal entry voucher cannot be posted.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view -> Journal Entry Vouchers.-Click New -> Journal Entry Voucher.-Fill the fields as requested.-Click Simulate.-See the error messages showed in Symptom area.-Cause-The origin of this behavior is regarding the lack of Functional area of the respective G/L Account for the Accounting Principle.-Resolution-You have to maintain Functional area of the respective G/L Account for the Accounting Principle.-To maintain the data, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Select and Click View.-Click Edit Functional Area Determination.-Here you can maintain the required data.-Keywords-Functional area, Journal entry voucher.

Title: How to check Downtime details for previous Month/Year.
Content: Symptom-You need to check the Downtime details for a particular Month/Year.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer, SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to System Availability View.-Cause-Downtime Details are not maintained correctly or missing.-To check the duration for which the system was down.-Resolution-Under the Downtime Details (Current System), Downtime will be shown for a particular Month.-To check for Previous Month's, follow the below steps:-Click on Show More.-Click on Analyze Data.-In Calender Month/ Year, Choose the month for which you want to check the downtime details.-Click on Go.-                  Keywords-Downtime details-downtime details

Title: 'Account of payer/payee ABC with requested ID XXX is not valid' Error Message in Outgoing Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message while creating a New Outgoing Bank Transfer:-'Account of payer/payee ABC with requested ID XXX is not valid'-ABC means the payee (supplier) ID.-XXX means the payee bank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks view > New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Enter all the mandatory data.-System throws error message: 'Account of payer/payee ABC with requested ID XXX is not valid'-Cause-The reason for the error message is that the payee (supplier) bank account is not valid at the Outgoing Bank Transfer Document Date.-For example the Supplier Bank Account is valid as of 02.03.2018, but the Document Date you have entered is 01.03.2018.-Resolution-There are two options to overcome the error message:-1) Change the Outgoing Bank Transfer Document Date to a date equal or after the Supplier Bank Account Valid From date.-2) Change the Supplier Bank Account Valid From date to a date equal or before the Outgoing Bank Transfer Document Date.-For the second option, the steps to be followed are:-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Search for the respective supplier.-Select the row of the supplier and click Edit > Financial Data.-Go to Bank Data tab.-On top, right-hand side, click the user profile picture > Start Personalization Mode.-Expand Unnamed Table UI Element.-Tick Valid From to make it Visible (the Valid From field is hidden by default so you need to make it visible).-Click Save.-Now you can change the Bank Data validity.-Keywords-outgoing bank transfer; account not valid;

Title: Dump Occurs After Saving New Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new fixed asset. After clicking on Save, dump occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Click on New and select Fixed Asset.-Input all required parameters, among which input Company as XXX(XXX represents the company ID).-Click on Save, then dump occurs.-Cause-The new fixed asset is assigned to company XXX, which is the owner party. The owner party should be a legal business partner entity.-Resolution-By correcting the business partner data, the error can be rectified and fixed assets can be created.-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts View.-Show All Accounts and Search the assigned owner party.-Select the line of the assigned owner party and click on Edit General.-Mark the check-box of Legal Competence.-Click on Save and Close.-Keywords-Fixed Asset

Title: Unexpected Exchange Rate Difference Causing Wrong VAT Value When Posting Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You post a customer invoice with foreign currency. On the journal entry, there is posting to Exchange Difference account that is unexpected, because the Invoice Date is the Posting Date, and there is no change of exchange rate on this date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Choose the Journal Entries view.-Select the Journal Entries subview.-Search for the journal entry in question.-Open this journal entry.-Check the Line Items, and you can see, there is one line with posting to Exchange Difference account.-However, the Source Document Date and the Posting Date are on the same day.-Cause-The system works as designed.-When you create the customer invoice, the system calculates the tax information immediately at the Tax Date. When the invoice is posted, the system calculates it again.-Since the Tax Date on the source document is not the Posting Date, and the Exchange Rate on the Tax Date is different from that on the Posting Date, so there is tax difference caused by different exchange rate, and the difference is posted to Exchange Difference account.-Resolution-If you want the new exchange rate to be used for tax calculation, you need to cancel this invoice and create a new one:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and search for the Customer Invoice in question.-Choose the Customer Invoice, and Cancel it.-After that, create a new customer invoice with the right Tax Date and post it.-  Keywords-tax date, posting date, invoice date, exchange rate difference, Steuersatz, Rechnungsdatum, Buchungsdatum, Steuerdatum

Title: How to Reverse a Tax Payment For a Replaced Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse a tax payment but the system gives several error messages and the cancellation fails.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments subview.-Show all Tax Payments and find Tax Payment ID XXX (XXX represents the ID of the Tax Payment)-Click Reverse-The following error messages are displayed:  -Cancellation of tax payment <ID> failed-Cancellation of document <ID> failed- Action REOPEN not possible; action is disabled- Cause-The Tax Payment XXX that you are trying to reverse is paying a Tax Return YYY with status Replaced.(YYY represents the ID of the Tax Return)-This means that after the Tax Return YYY was paid and completed, a correction run was executed for the same and created a new Tax Return ZZZ (ZZZ represents the ID of the New Tax Return)-Resolution-Since the Tax Payment reversal is being made with reference to the amended Tax Return, the return that amends has to be reversed first.-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments subview.-Edit the Tax Payment XXX.-In the Tax Retunr Details open the associated Tax Return YYY.-The status of the Tax Return YYY is Replaced.-Click on the Tax Return ID ZZZ under Corrected By on top of the page.-The Correction Return ZZZ is opened.-Click Reverse to reverse the Tax Return ZZZ.-You are now able to reverse the Tax Payment XXX.-Keywords-Steuerzahlung, Umsatzsteuermeldung, stornieren

Title: Warning: Accounting Period is Closing - Financial Closing in Progress for Posting Date
Content: Symptom-When recording time on a project task you notice a warning message: Accounting period is closing; contact accounting department.-When creating a customer or supplier invoice you notice a similar warning after maintaining the invoice/posting date:-Supplier Invoice: You cannot post the invoice. Financial closing in progress for posting date DD.MM.YYYY.-Customer Invoice: Financial closing is in progress on DD.MM.YYYY.
