The G/L accountant will check and decide in which period the document will be posted.-It is, however, possible to release the time recording or post the Supplier/ Customer Invoice.-In the General Ledger you verify that the respective accounting period is fully open and that it is still possible to make entries for this period. Why are these warnings generated?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Time Recording:-In the Home workcenter navigate to the Self-Services - Self-Services Overview view.-Under Time select Edit Time Sheet.-Select the respective date, and project task. Then enter the number of hours.-A warning appears: Accounting period is closing; contact accounting department.-Customer Invoice:-In the respective customer invoice enter Account Name, Invoice Unit ID and Sales Unit ID.-Now enter the Invoice Date.-A warning appears: Financial closing is in progress on DD.MM.YYYY. The G/L accountant will check and decide in which period the document will be posted.-Supplier Invoice:-In the respective supplier invoice enter the Supplier ID.-Now enter the Invoice Date.-A warning appears: You cannot post the invoice. Financial closing in progress for posting date DD.MM.YYYY.-To verify the period in which you want to post your document is open for posting-Navigate to the General Ledger and here to the Master Data - Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select the respective set of books and press Open and Close Periods.-In the new screen check the top table and verify that the period is fully open for operational postings.-In the table underneath you verify that it is still possible to make entries into the period (Entry Possible Until - Process Control Time Zone column).-Cause--The reason for this warning message is the manually set Posting date for Migration, which is set to a date after the posting date that you are using for your time recording/ invoice. As the selected date is after the initial migration posting date you are still allowed to post the document.-Resolution-In order to remove the warning message maintain a Posting Date for Migration which is set before the posting date that you are using in your document:-In the General Ledger navigate to the Master Data - Companies view.-Here you can see that the Posting Date for Migration for the relevant company is a date after the posting date which you are using for your transaction.-To change the Posting Date for Migration press Actions and select Set Posting Date for Migration.-Enter a date before the posting date of your time recording/ invoice.-The warning will not appear anymore.-Keywords-Financial closing is in progress on; The G/L accountant will check and decide; Posting Date for Migration;

Title: How to Change Employees Name
Content: Symptom-When user try to change employees' names But Name field is greyed out in Personnel administration work center, only could change values of contact, bank data, etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employee work center view-Select Edit-User found Name field is greyed out which is unable to edit.-Cause-This is standard system behavior, once name is applied in one period, it is not allowed to change name in this period.-User can only add a new period for different name.-Resolution-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employee work center view-Choose Edit-Go to Personal Data tab-Go to Biographical Data tab-Here user can add row for employee, in different period, they could have different names.-Change of the name is only possible when Employee view is available under Business Partner Data work center since Personnel Administration work center is not used.-Keywords-Effective dating, Time-sliced data, HR master data, Name correction, Legal rename, Surname update, given name update, Record edit restriction, Non-editable field, employee profile, master data change, human resources administration, period-based change, time-bound attribute, change log

Title: Unable to pay GSTR-1 and GSTR-2 Due to Error : Document ID X not Found in Receivables Payables Register and No Valid Tax Return Found
Content: Symptom-When attempting to pay a reported GSTR-1 or GSTR-2 VAT return, the Pay action is not allowed. -Error messages appear: 'Document ID X not found in receivables payables register' and 'No valid tax return found'. -The issue occurs after selecting a reported GSTR-1 or GSTR-2 and choosing Pay.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center. -Under Tax Returns, select VAT Returns. -Show All Tax Returns and select the reported Tax Return X of type GSTR-2-Select the Tax Return ID line and click on Pay.-Errors: 'Document ID X not found in receivables payables register'. 'No valid tax return found' appear-Cause-GSTR-1 and GSTR-2 VAT returns are not payment relevant; only GSTR-3 is payment relevant in Company Tax Arrangements.-Go to Tax Management work center.-Under Tax Authorities select Company Tax Arrangements.-Edit the Tax Authority and navigate to Company Tax Arrangements tab and to the subtab Tax Return Arrangements tab.-For the Tax Return Type: GSTR-1 and GSTR-2, can see Payment Relevant is not marked and only for GSTR-3 it is marked as Payment Relevant.-Resolution-When GSTR-1 and GSTR-2 are executed, the system performs a reconciliation of the relevant tax transactions. Based on this reconciliation, the total GST payable or receivable amount is determined at the GSTN level.-Afterward, GSTR-3 needs to be executed to close the relevant tax lines in the ByD system. Once GSTR-3 is processed and the filing status is reported, the corresponding GST payable or receivable amount can be finalized and considered for payment or settlement at the GSTN level.-Keywords-GSTN reconciliation, India GST compliance, GSTR-3 settlement, VAT payment workflow, Return processing sequence, Payment relevant flag, Tax authority configuration, Payable calculation, GST payment run, Localization India, Tax liabilities clearing, Reported status, Payment processing, Return payment eligibility

Title: Report With Information on Revenue For Future Periods in the Cost and Revenue Work center
Content: Symptom-You are looking for a Report that gives you information on Revenues for future Periods.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Select the Reports - List View.-Show by Report Category, search for keyword Revenue and press Go.-Only two reports appear, which are only valid for Projects. You, however are looking for revenues posted in future periods of any Sales Documents regardless if they are connected to projects or not.-Cause-You need to refine your search with other key words.-Resolution-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Select the Reports - List View.-Show by Report Category, search for key word Sales Documents and press Go.-This search displays the Report Sales Order - Line items, ID FINPRFU24_Q0001*. That report contains the information you need regarding Revenue for future periods.-*Reports with IDs starting with FIN always indicate that these reports entail accounting relevant data, i.e. the displayed data is connected to actual postings in accounting.-Alternatively try the following:-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Select the Design Reports View.-Show All and find CRMRVFU_Q000.-Press Go.-You can see that this is the Report 'Revenue Forecast', ID CRMRVFU_Q0001. It is designed for Revenue Forecast Data from e.g. Opportunities, Sales, Contracts and Service Documents. This report will not display any information on values posted in accounting.-Keywords-Revenues in Future accounting periods, Sales Documents

Title: How to Migrate Data Without a Test System After Go-Live
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate data directly in your production system using the migration tool after the go live without requesting a test system, but don't know how to proceed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select Implementation Projects view-Open the activity list of your change project-Search for any migration activity-You receive the message "Activity cannot be completed"-  Resolution-There are two possibilities to migrate data without a Test system after the go-live.--1. Without a Change Project--For some migration objects like customers, materials, sales orders, it is possible to migrate data without a change project.-To do so, you have go to Business Configuration->Overview and search for migration activity and perform the migration---2. With a change project--For those activities like migration of financial data, migration of employee data, etc a change project is necessary for migration-In order to access these migration activities without a test system, your project needs to be in "Merged" status.-So, below are the steps to create and merge your change project in order to access the migration activities--1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation projects view.-3. Select New button.-4. Complete the Scoping (you can bypass the steps until Finish)-5. Highlight the new change project and select Open Activity List button.-6. Go to Integrate and Extend tab and search for migration activities you want add to project (e.g: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data )-7. Select Add to Project and Close all the activity.-8. Merge the change project, through the activity "Merge Changes with Production System" under Go-Live tab-8. Now, the status of the change project should be merged.-9. Go to Integrate and Extend tab-10. You will be able to open the migration activities.--Note: Do not change anything in scope of your change project, otherwise these changes will be implemented when you merge the project.-3. Migration in a test System through Change Project:-Once you copy the change project into your test system, you can perform migration for the activities which are there in the change project or through Business Configuration work center, Overview view.-Note: In this scenario , the migrated data will not be moved to the Target system after during merge.-4. You can also refer to the KBA 1867232 which describes the steps to "Enable/Disable data migration per object"-See Also-Remark: The same steps are valid in case you are using a Permanent Test system.-See Case Document 2136036 - How to Request a New System for further information

Title: Dump After Changing Depreciation Start Date
Content: Symptom-Dump occurs after Depreciation Start Date is changed for Set of Books ABC (ABC represents the Set of Books Name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center and Fixed Assets view.-Select fixed asset XYZ and select Edit--Master Data.-Select tab Asset Valuation.-Change the Depreciation Start Date to a new date.-Save, then dump occurs.-Cause-The related fiscal year variant for Set of Books ABC is not defined for the new Depreciation Start Sate.-Resolution-You need to maintain the fiscal year variant valid for the new depreciation start date.-You can find the related fiscal year variant assigned to Set of Books ABC with following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend.-Open activity Set of Books, then you can see the fiscal year variant assigned to Set of Books ABC.-Maintain fiscal year variant valid for the new depreciation start date with following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Select Fine-Tuning Activity.-Open Other Fiscal Year.-Select the fiscal year variant, and then select Add Row to add the new fiscal year settings to include the new depreciation start date.-Please maintain both in Period Details and Period Control for Fixed Assets.-

Title: 'Bank reference to XXXXX not found in bank directory' When Migrating Suppliers
Content: Symptom-When using template to make migration of suppliers into the system, you got the below error message:-'Bank reference to XXXXXX not found in bank directory' (XXX represents National Bank Code)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access Implementation Projects view.-Open activity Migration of Suppliers.-Access Migrate suppliers using the migration tool link.-Execute Migration for the respective migration template.-Cause-The reason why the system throws the error message is because the National Bank Code Type maintained in the template is not matching the one maintained in the system for Bank Directory Entry.-Resolution-When uploading the template, make sure that the National Bank Code Type maintained for that supplier is the same type that is maintained for the Bank Directory Entry that is using that National Bank Code in the system.-To check the correct National Bank Code Type:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Access Bank Directory view.-With the Advanced Filter, search for the National Bank Code maintained for the supplier.-Access it.-In General tab, check the National Bank Code Type maintained.-Keywords-National Bank Code Type. National Bank Code. Migration. Supplier. Bank Directory.

Title: Goods Receipt from Supplier Posting Does Not Update Inventory Cost of Material
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Cost History of a Material maintained with Perpetual Cost Method Moving Average.-You notice a Goods receipt from Supplier Business Transaction which did not update the Inventory Cost of the material even though the Purchase Price is different to the inventory cost value of the material.-When checking the Journal Entry of this posting you notice that only the original inventory cost was realised on the Material ledger.-The purchase difference was posted to a Gains/Losses, i.e. a Profit and Loss G/L Account.-In general, Purchase Price Differences are posted to Profit and Loss accounts for materials valuated with the Standard Perpetual Cost Method.-It therefore seems that the Perpetual Cost Method must have been changed after the Goods Receipt posting; However, when checking the Material Master Data change log you do not find a change of the Perpetual Cost Method from Standard to Moving Average.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the Inventory Cost History:-In the Inventory Valuation work center navigate to the Master Data - Materials view.-Highlight the respective Material - Business Residence combination and press View Cost History.-In the Inventory Cost History Screen navigate to the Period when the Goods Receipt from Supplier was posted.-You notice that the Capitalized Quantity got updated.-As the Purchase value of the goods receipt is different to the Materials inventory cost you expect a change of the inventory cost.-However, the Resulting Inventory Cost is exactly the same as the Inventory Cost value before the Goods Receipt Posting.-To check the Goods Receipt Postings:-In the Inventory Cost History Screen press on the Journal Entry ID of the Goods Receipt from Supplier posting.-In the Posting you notice that the difference between the original inventory cost and the Purchase price based on the Purchase order Item was posted to a Gains/Losses account, e.g. Difference from Purchasing, just as this would be the case of Materials maintained with the Standard Perpetual cost Method.-As the material is maintained with Moving Average Perpetual Cost Method you expected the purchase price difference to update the Material inventory cost.-However, the Material Master data change log does not document any Perpetual Cost Method change since the Goods receipt posting.-Cause-The Inventory Cost of Materials maintained with the Moving Average Perpetual cost method always gets updated either through Goods receipt postings or through GR/IR clearing postings (provided purchase price differences were identified and are to be capitalized on the Material Ledger).-Price Differences posted for Materials maintained with the Standard cost method will always be posted to Profit and Loss accounts and never be capitalized on the Material Ledger.-Hence, the Standard Perpetual Cost Method must have been in place when the Good Receipt posted purchase price differences to a separate Profit and Loss Account.-Changes in regards to the Material Valuation cannot be found in the general Material Master Data Change Log.-You can only find them in the Material Valuation Change log.-Resolution-To check for Material Valuation relevant changes:-Navigate to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Master Data - Materials view and find the respective Material - Business Residence combination.-Now press Maintain Valuation Data.-In the new screen press 'View Changes'.-In the Changes: Material Valuation screen just press Go.-You can now see that the perpetual cost method was indeed changed from Standard to Moving Average after the Goods Receipt from Supplier posting. This change cannot be found in the general Material master data change log.

Title: Reconciliation for Expenses Paid by Company Expenses
Content: Symptom-An Expense Report ABC has been submitted with only Paid by Company Expenses, and information is required regarding the reconciliation process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expense work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Show All Expense Reports and find Expense Reports ABC.-Click on Edit.-The Reimbursement Status is displayed as “No Reimbursement Requested” for Paid by Company expenses.-Cause-Expense Reports containing only Paid by Company expenses will not be paid out to employee.-Resolution-The Paid by Company expenses trigger a G/L Account to G/L Account posting where the master cost center is decreased (credit) and the cost object entered in the expense report is increased (debit).-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-2182674 - Expense Reports Containning Only Paid By Company Expenses Will not be Reimbursed to Employee -Keywords-Expenses Paid By Company, expense reports,reconciliation, No Reimbursement Requested, master cost center, cost object

Title: Dunning Level Differs Between Header Level and Item Level
Content: Symptom-When checking customer account ABC (ABC represents the name of the customer) you realize that the dunning level displayed under item level differs to the highest dunning level shown on the header.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Click the Customer Accounts subview.-Enter the customer name ABC on the Search box.-Click on the account ID hyperlink.-Open the Trade Receivables tab.- You notice that the Highest Dunning Level on the header is different than the Dunning Level shown under Dunning Information.-Cause-The Highest Dunning Level is determined by the last released Dunning occurrence for a Business Partner.-So the reason for the different values shown for Dunning Levels is because manual changes were applied on the original Dunning Level but a new Dunning Run was not created and released after these changes were made.-Resolution-The system behaviour is correct.--Steps to check if manual changes have been performed.-Go to the Receivables work center.-Click the Customer Accounts subview.-Enter the customer name ABC on the Search box.-Select the Customer Account you are checking so it is highlighted.-Click on the Item Details tab.-Click on the Changes tab.-Enter relevant search dates.-Click Go.-You can see what changes were applied, the date and the user that performed them.---The Highest Dunning Level field will be automatically updated once a new Dunning Run is created and released.-Keywords-Dunning Level Open Items, Header Level, Item Level

Title: 'Tax registration number not valid' Error Message While Entering Company Tax Arrangement Tax Number
Content: Symptom-You are setting up the Tax Arrangements for Tax Authority and while adding the VAT Registration Number XXX for Company XYZ the error message is shown as Tax Registration Number not valid.-This KBA is valid for the United Kingdom and some other countries, for example, Canada.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view and to Tax Authorities sub view.-Show All Tax Authorities and Find Tax Authority ABC.-Select the Tax Authority.-Choose Edit and then go to Company Tax Arrangements.-Choose Add Row and Add Company, Valid From and Valid To.-Go to Tax Numbers.-Choose Add Row and Enter the Tax Registration Number as VAT Registration Number and the Tax Number is XXX.-You can see an error message: "Tax registration number not valid."-Cause-As per legislation in some countries, VAT Registration Number should start with Country code followed by numbers.-This would be for example, country code GB followed by numbers for country United Kingdom.-Resolution-The system works as designed for Tax Registration Number field validation.-Keywords-VAT Registration Number; Tax Number; Company Tax Arrangements

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Not Processing All Relevant Purchase Document Items
Content: Symptom-You created a GR/IR Clearing Run for a particular Company and Set of Books. After checking, you could see that not all Purchase Document Items are being processed in the run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to Periodic Tasks > GR/IR Clearing Run View.-Search and open the Run ID XXX for Set of Books ABC (XXX represents the ID of the Run and ABC represents the ID of the Set of Books).-Go to Processed Successfully tab.-You see that not all Purchase Document Items have been picked by the Run. You know this by comparing the run results with GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary report results.-Cause-A huge amount of data caused the GR/IR Clearing Run to end in a dump/time-out error.-Resolution-It is  recommended to use the field Purchasing Document from/to ID in the selection parameter. This way the run processes less Purchase Order items and will not end up in a time-out error.--We also recommend to execute a test run first, to know about the postings before executing a  run in update mode: When you face issues with the  test run, you know that it is necessary to split the run based on Purchase Order documents.-Keywords-GR/IR clearing time-out error, not all Purchase Documents processed

Title: Negative Depreciation Posting for Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom valuation view for fixed assets and set the Value Range for Acquisition Cost and Net Book Value (NBV) as Complete Value Range Permitted from the drop-down options.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the Valuation Views activity.-Create a custom valuation view-Set the Value Range for Acquisition Cost and the Value Range for Net Book Value as Complete Value Range Permitted.-After proper set up of this valuation view to be used in the fixed assets, the asset has been e.g. depreciated and after adjustments the NBV is negative. You execute an automatic depreciation run and either nothing is posted or the asset is written-off, however you expect the system to keep posting a negative depreciation so that the NBV would go on into negative values.-Cause-The Complete Value Range Permitted option does not mean that the automatic depreciation runs would go on endlessly into the negative values. This setup means that the checks during manual postings or automatic postings (e.g. credit memos) would not enforce any condition on the NBV or acquisition cost to be positive or negative.-For example:-If you acquire an asset as $5000 you may post a manual depreciation of $6000 so that the NBV goes into negative (no error message is raised since complete value range is allowed). You could also post further manual negative depreciation postings in this case. Whereas the Depreciation Run is expect to stop when NBV is Zero and/or a reversal is required. It only reverses the automatic depreciation postings. In this example, if you execute a depreciation run, no postings would occur.-Resolution-The NBV can go into negative amounts via manual depreciation only.

Title: Process Communication Error - Customer Invoice Cannot Create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)
Content: Symptom-Once you are in the Document Flow tab of a Customer Invoice and you identify a Process Communication as Customer Invoice ABC (ABC stands for the Customer Invoice ID) cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for Customer Invoice ABC-Click on Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Click on the error icon.-You can see the error: Customer Invoice ABC cannot create a Business transaction (For Accounting).-Then:-Go to the Application and User management work center.-Navigate to the Business Data Consistency view.-Select the Process Communication Errors subview.-Show Open Errors with Incidents.-Find Customer Invoice ABC.-On error details, you can see that the main error is: Update for tax register failed for.-Cause-There will be a Business Transaction for Clearing document task to be done: Review and Complete Clearing for Customer - XYZ (XYZ refers to Customer ID) - YYY USD.-It's necessary to check and confirm the task related to the Clearing.-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Search for Customer Invoice ABC.-Click on Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Go to the Clearing document and click on the Note icon to check the task.-After you check and confirm the task, the process communication error will not be there anymore.-Keywords-Customer Invoice ; Process Communication Error ; Business Transaction ; Accounting

Title: Only One Script Available for Selection in Account Management
Content: Symptom-You want to use Multiple Scripts while creating or editing an Account, but only one script is available for selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center and access the view Accounts;-Click on the New Button;-In the New Account screen, click the dropdown menu for the Script field;-There is only one script available.-Cause-The scripts were not setup in the activity Multiple Scripts.-Resolution-You need to setup the multiple scripts from the Business Configuration activity. You can do so by following the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the view Implementation Projects;-Select your First Implementation Project and click on Open Activity List;-Search for the activity Multiple Scripts;-Open it and select which scripts you want to use, you will also need to select which script is the default;-After saving the settings here, the scripts will be displayed in the Scripts field in account creation.-Keywords-account management, multiple scripts

Title: Timesheet Upload via Excel not Available With In Approval Status to Manager
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload the timesheet of employees by excel file but the time has not reflected as status In Approval for manager/approver.-Hence, due to missing time recordings, Cost Assessment is not possible for a department.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Time Administration workcenter.-2. View Time Recordings.-3. Search for employee.-4. Select Time Sheet.-5. Under tab Time Entry select required Calendar Week.-6. Status = Inactive.-Cause-Uploading Employee Times is an asynchronous process which means the Employee Times are not activated directly after the upload but with some delay.-Therefore it can happen, if the time administrator wants to check the uploaded times in the time sheet or time file, the time administrator is now locking the time data and preventing the activation.-This should be considered while using the excel upload.-Resolution-The inactive Employee Times it is possible to activate them via the employee Time File. In tab Employee Times select the relevant entries and choose Actions and Activate.

Title: No Subsequent Reversal Posting Box is Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-You want to assign the No Subsequent Reversal Posting option to Accounting Principle ABC in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash activity.-You notice the box is greyed out. (ABC represents the Accounting Principle Name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Find Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash and open it.-Select Edit Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods option.-Choose the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Method.-Open the Use for Cash tab.-Select the Accounting Principle ABC from the list.-Note: No Subsequent Reversal Posting box is grayed out.-Cause-The Use for Cash tab is not editable. It only displays the already applied settings in option Assign Remeasurement Method to Accounting Principle in the activity Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash.-Resolution-In order to flag the box No Subsequent Reversal Posting, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Find Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash and open it.-Select option Assign remeasurement Method to Accounting Principle.-Choose the Accounting Principle ABC.-Open the Use for Cash tab.-Select the No Subsequent Reversal Posting box.-Save.-See Also-For further information, please check the Help Center document 'Configuration: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Payables and Receivables' which will guide you through the configuration for the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash activity.-Keywords-Remeasurement; Currency; Foreign; Cash; Methods; Subsequent; Reversal; Posting; Box; Greyed Out

Title: Row Filter Does Not Work
Content: Symptom-You want to search for a specific payment in Payment Monitor view, but when you enter the Bank Account ID in the search field, the system does not make any filter, and keeps showing random results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-In the Bank Account column, you click the row name, and when filter options shows up, you enter the ID ABC-XY (where ABC-XY represents the Bank Account ID).-The system does not make any filtering, just shows random results.-Cause-This is expected behavior as the system interprets the hyphen as a range of values and hence the selection gets created as Between and not Equal.-Resolution-To custom filter in a column using a value which contains a hyphen (-) in it, the string needs to be enclosed in double-quotes i.e. "ABC-XY". This may serve to all filters used in the system when searching for an ID, value, etc.-Keywords-Filter. Hyphen. -. Search.

Title: Is it Possible to Change the Country of the Employee Who was Incorrectly Rehired?
Content: Symptom-Employee XYZ was rehired with the incorrect Country PQR instead of Country ABC. Your requirement is to change the Country PQR to Country ABC.-*XYZ represents the Employee, PQR and ABC represents the Country-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Choose the tab relevant to the Country in which you would Rehire the Employee XYZ-Select Rehire Employee-Fill the required details-Select Save-Cause-You will not be able to Delete the Employee XYZ or Delete the old reference of Employee XYZ from the system. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-You can Terminate the Employee XYZ and Rehire for Country ABC, but the Employee ID will be different. Further, the old reference to Rehire in Country PQR cannot be deleted even via backend.-To Terminate the Employee XYZ, you may follow the below steps:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Show Active Employees and Search the Employee XYZ-Select Actions->Terminate Relationship with Employee-Update Last Working Day as DD.MM.YYYY-Termination Category: XXXXX (where XXXXX represents the Termination Category)-Termination Reason: YYYYY (where YYYYY represents the Termination Reason)-Select Save -Keywords-Terminate Relationship with Employee, Rehire, Delete the Employee

Title: Full Time Equivalent Value for Employee Shows Wrong Value
Content: Symptom-Employee works for XX hours per month, but the Full Time Equivalent for employee shows wrong value.-*XX represents the hours-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Select Employees view-Search for Employee ID-Select Edit-Go to tab Employment-In Clauses section, select the line with Agreed Working Hours YY (where YY represents the Agreed Working Hours)-Full Time Equivalent value on this is '1'-Customer expectation is ZZ (where ZZ represents the Full Time Equivalent value)-Cause-The Full Time Equivalent calculations for an Employee is currently implemented in a such a way that, whenever it is not given in weeks, the value is set to '1'.-Resolution-When Agreed Working Hours are given in Weeks, then a proper Full Time Equivalent is calculated. Otherwise, when it is not in weeks, value is set to '1'.-Full Time Equivalent does not work for Month or a manual maintaining is not possible. This is the system behaviour.-Keywords-Full Time Equivalent, FTE, Agreed Working Hours

Title: User Subscription Type/License Type in Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Where to find User License Type/Subscription Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To know the User Subscription Type/License Type.-We can find the user type in two methods,--Method 1.-1. Login to Business ByDesign-2. Go to Application and User Management Work Center-3. Click on Business Users under User and Access Management View-4. Select the User and click on User ID or Select User and Click on Edit Attributes-5. On the top you will see the License Type-Below Screenshot will help you to find the License Type.-  Method 2.-1. Login to Business ByDesign-2. Go to Service Control Center Work Center-3. Click User Subscriptions View-4. Select particular User Type and Click on it-5. Once Clicked on the User Type you will find the List of Users who assigned with that License Type-Below Screenshot will help you to find the License Type.-NOTE-NOTE: License consumed in the production tenant are only considered for the billing and invoicing.-  Keywords-User Subscription Type in Business ByDesign, User License Type in Business ByDesign.

Title: Different File ID Number Range per Company
Content: Symptom-More than one company operate in your system. For each company different bank accounts are maintained.-When you send an Outbound file to the bank the file IDs are not in continuous order. One ID might not follow the last submitted file ID.-As result your bank requests you to verify correctness of the file.-You are now looking for a separate number sequence per company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files view.-Select All Outbound files.-You will see one numbering sequence of File ID for all the companies.-Cause-The number range configuration for Outbound File ID generation is not based on Companies.  Therefore it is not possible to achieve the continuity of numbers for each company.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Number Range; Outbound File; Numbering; Number Range by Company;-number range,outbound file,numbering,number range by company

Title: Time Entry Status Changes to Active Without Manager Approval
Content: Symptom-When an employee releases a time entry in their time sheet, status becomes Active even though configuration for that time type requires it to go for approval by the manager.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Home work center.-2. Select Self Services view.-3. Select Edit Time Sheet link.-4. The Timesheet shows Active status even though it should be going to the line manager for approval.--Cause-If there's no line manager assigned to the employee, then the time entry automatically becomes Active once released.-Additionally, a time entry will automatically become Active when created by a time administrator for the employee in the Time Administration workcenter, since systems interprets the time administrator has the authority to approve employee times as well.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Time Entry; Active; No Approval

Title: Incoming Check Cannot be Released Due to Error Message: Releasing the allocation not possible
Content: Symptom-You cannot release an incoming check. The system gives an error message: Releasing the allocation not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Select New Incoming Check under Common Tasks view.-Enter the necessary information such as Company, Payer and Check Number.-Enter the Payment Amount and select Direct Posting to G/L Account.-Select General Ledger Account XYZ and enter the details (XYZ means the G/L Account ID).-System throws the error message:-Releasing the allocation not possible.-Save failed-Cause-Potential Cause 1:-While posting an incoming check with reference to g/l account the resulting journal entry typically would show as:--Debit:   Check Clearing Account-Credit:  Revenue Account-You entered the credit account manually. As debit-entry the system will try and pick the general ledger account maintained in the Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, Sub-ledger Cash, sub-tab: Check Deposit- In Transit.-Since the account is missing the system fails to save the incoming check.-Potential Cause 2:-No Functional Area is maintained in Business Configuration for the specific G/L Account.-Resolution-Resolution 1:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project and choose Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-Tune phase.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination list.-Under Account Determination section, Open the Cash sub-ledger.-Refer to Check Deposit- In Transit tab-Maintain the G/L Account for the missing payment method.-Once you maintain the relevant G/L account, try releasing the incoming check and system will allow incoming check posting.-Resolution 2:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project.-Click Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune Tab.-Search and open the activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Click Edit Functional Areas link.-Here you can define a Functional Area as Default or either select one for the respective G/L Account and then try to post the Incoming Check again.-Keywords-Allocation, Incoming check-allocation,incoming check

Title: Missing information in Business Partners – Business Document in Functions tab Under Org Unit
Content: Symptom-Missing information in Business Partners – Business Document in Functions tab under Org Unit.-Business Requirement: In the Org Unit Overview for Functions tab, an overview of all valid business partners and business documents should be available. Based on this information it can be verified where the cost center is still used.-Without this, it makes the process of clearing / delimitating the cost center very difficult.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management workcenter.-Seect Org Structures view.-Currently selected Date: select current date and select OK.- Select Find.-Enter Org Unit and Locate.-In the General tab selecton the Org Unit ID 9999.-Go to Functions.-Related Business Partners: No information displayed-Relevant Business Documents: No information displayed-The Org Unit is used for Purchasing and Fixed Assets are posted against it. Therefore these documents should be displayed in this tab.-Cause-The information on the Factsheet is shown based on the Sales/Service Organization. The org unit 9999 is a Sales Unit under the Sales Organization XXXX(where XXXX is Sales Org Unit).-The factsheet for Org Unit XXXX, the count of the sales documents associated with the sales organizationis present.-The individual sales units will not have this reference stored. The documents as well refer to the Sales Organization and not the sales units. Hence the document count for Org Unit XXX shows 0.-Resolution-This is expect system behavior.-Keywords-Business Document, Org Unit, Functions tab, Factsheet

Title: User Subscription details not available for Business Users
Content: Symptom-You cannot find User Subscription view under the Edit option for Business users.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User and Management Work center.-Go to Business Users.-Select a user.-Click on Edit.-You can see only two options Attributes and Access Rights and not User Subscription-Cause-The option of User Subscription functionality allows to assign licenses to users. In C4C systems this assignment should only be maintained by an admin.-Hence, this option is given in the Administrator work center.-Resolution-The Admin can maintain the User Subscription details by following the below steps:-Go to Administrator Work Center.-Go to Business Users View.-Select a user.-Click on Edit.-We see three options Attributes ,Access Rights & User Subscriptions.Under User Subscription View all the subscription related information can be seen.-Keywords-user subscription,business users

Title: Error 'Purchasing terms must be specified for an active procurement arrangement' While Trying to Delete Payment Term in a Supplier's Master Data
Content: Symptom-You receive the error message 'Purchasing terms must be specified for an active procurement arrangement' when trying to delete the Payment Term from the Supplier's Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base Work Center.-Go to Suppliers View.-Search for the affected Supplier.-Open its Master Data and click View All.-Go to Purchasing tab.-Try to delete the Payment Term under Commercial Data section.-Cause-When you create a Supplier, you do not need to specify Purchasing Terms, although once you maintain one such as Payment Term, Incoterms or Purchase Order Currency. You will no longer be able to leave it empty.-Resolution-If you need to delete the Payment Term, you would need to fill in any of the other fields under Commercial Data.-If you select any currency as the default Purchase Order Currency or define an Incoterm, then you should be able to delete the Payment Term with no errors.-Keywords-Payment Term, Payment, Purchasing, Term, Supplier, Master Data, Commercial Data

Title: Journal Entry Voucher Excel Upload Error: Business Transaction Type Journal Entry Voucher Does not Match Document Type
Content: Symptom-While uploading a Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel you get the following error message:-'Business transaction type Journal Entry Voucher does not match document type ABC' (ABC represents the Journal Entry Type).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Journal Entry Voucher Excel file:-Enter mandatory data (for example, Company, Posting Date, etc.).-Enter Journal Entry Type ABC.-Go to SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN Excel tab.-Click Save data to button.-A pop-up is thrown with the following error message:-'Business transaction type Journal Entry Voucher does not match document type ABC'.-Cause-You have selected a Journal Entry Type which is not supported in the Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel, for example 00085 - Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable.-There are three Journal Entry Types currently supported for this functionality:-00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher-00079 - Data Migration-00103 - Manual Posting - JEV with Offset Entry-The supported types can be seen if you do the following:-Click the cell below Journal Entry Type field.-Go to SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN Excel tab.-Under Workbook section, click Lookup button.-Click Search button.-The three types will be displayed and you can select one of those.-Resolution-If you want to use a Journal Entry Type different than those you need to create the Journal Entry Voucher via User Interface (UI).-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel; Upload Journal Entry Vocuher; Journal Entry Type;

Title: Is It Possible to Delete Suppliers?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to Delete Suppliers Master data?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center-Go to Suppliers view-There is no option to Delete the Suppliers.-Cause-Suppliers is Master data. Master Data once created cannot be deleted even if it is not used in any business documents.-Resolution-The only option is to Block or Obsolete the status of the Suppliers.-Note:-Currently, system does not allow multiple selections on the Suppliers OWL to Change Status to Active/Obsolete/Blocked. This is the system behaviour.-Keywords-Supplier, Master Data

Title: Unable to Set Tax Exemption based on Percentage
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a new Tax Exemption with Percentage for an Account (Customer/Supplier), however it is not possible to find where to add it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management Work Center.-Go to Accounts View.-Search and open the Account ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Click on View All.-Go to Financial Data Tab.-Go to Tax Exemption Certificates.-You cannot find any option to add percentage for the Tax Exemption.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. Currently we do not support this functionality in the Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-Tax Exemption Certificates

Title: Error: You are not Authorized to Execute Report Downtime Details (Productive System)
Content: Symptom-You have more than one live production system. However, in Service Control Center the Downtime Availability report shows error "You are not authorized to execute report Downtime Details (Productive System)"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Work center.-Go to System Availability View.-Cause-You have not assigned the report to the System Availability work center.-Resolution-In order to see the system downtime availability report in Service Control Center. You can follow the below steps:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Report View.-In Show All Reports, Find Downtime Details.-Click on Assign.-Look for the Work Center Service Control Center, System Availability Sub View.-Select Assign and Save.-Keywords-Service Control Center, System Availability Report-system availability,downtime report

Title: How to Activate Financial Planning on a HANA Based System
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the Planning area on the Cost and Revenue work center, however the system informs you that planning is not supported on a system with HANA database.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Planning view.-Click New -> Plan.-The following error message is raised: Planning on HANA is currently not supported-Alternatively, a system crash may occur in step 2.-Cause-For systems which were not already using Financial Planning in the other database (Max DB), there is a new Financial Planning available on HANA.-Resolution-To be able to use the financial planning functionality, the financial planning integration business option must be selected in scoping.-To find this option, please go through the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Questions phase.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting -> Management Accounting and click Financial Planning. Note that Financial Planning has to be scoped in the previous phase.-Flag the question: You allow third-party software to create financial planning data.-Finish your changes.-Select Set as Reviewed.-Note that once planning is switched on, it cannot be switched off.-Keywords-financial planning; planning; budget planning; HANA; MaxDB; planning data; financial planning data;

Title: Error Message: “Update Not Possible; Specified Data for CUSTOMER-CONTACT_PERSON With Key UUID-CONTENT = `XYZ` does not exist” While Migrating Customers
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to upload data to the newly created Extension field of the Contacts associated with Accounts. On using the activity Migration of Customers to update the Contacts, you receive the below error:-Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER-CONTACT_PERSON with key UUID-CONTENT = `XYZ` does not exist-*XYZ represents the Account-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Customers-Choose Migrate customers using the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration file with Migration Mode Modify already existing records-You receive the error message in the Simulation step -Cause-This is the expected system behavior. Modify Already Existing Records or Enhance Already Existing Records is not supported to update the data of Contacts.-Migration Mode Enhance already existing records is not supported, as the Contact assigned to the Account is not enhanced but a new one with Last Name will be created instead.-Resolution-To upload data to the newly created Extension field of existing Contacts associated with Accounts, use Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Keywords-CUSTOMER-CONTACT_PERSON, UUID-CONTENT, Migration of Customers

Title: Keyword functionality was changed from SAP Solution Manager 7.10 to SAP Solution Manager 7.20
Content: Symptom-Keyword functionality was changed from SAP Solution Manager 7.10 to SAP Solution Manager 7.20. The list of possible keywords, which was maintained in transaction SOLAR_PROJECT_ADMIN under the "Project standards" tab in 7.10, can no longer be maintained in 7.20, as this transaction was switched to "Read only" mode in 7.20. The whole concept of keywords does no longer work the same way in 7.20 as before. But project and solution data maintained in 7.10 can be transferred to 7.20 during the "Content activation" process, to allow customers to work in 7.20 without loss of data.-Resolution-Keyword attributes were used in release 7.10, as they allowed customers to add custom content to the structure without the necessity to create customer attributes. In 7.10. there were keyword attributes associated to different kinds of element types on the project structure. And keywords could also be attached to documents.-As SAP has shipped major improvements in the concepts of Solution Documentation in 7.20, the keyword attribute has lost importance. For many purposes where customers decided to use keywords in 7.10, we now have specific attributes or specific other functionality. For that reason, the old concept did no longer fit to the new architecture in 7.20. Only the keywords on KW documents were kept in the standard of 7.20. The keywords on the structure are obsolete in 7.20, however they can be activated during the content activation process. This means that for new installations, keywords are not available on the structure elements in 7.20.-Value help for keywords in 7.10-In 7.10 you could configure the data that was used as a basis for the keywords value help. This application (transaction SOLAR_PROJECT_ADMIN, "Project standards" tab) is "display only" in 7.20 - together with all the old transactions that were used in 7.10 for solution documentation. For that reason, you can not define additional keywords for the keyword value help in 7.20 in that transaction any more. But there is a workaround described below.-KW document attribute "Keywords" in 7.20-The KW document attribute "Keyword" is standard in 7.20.-This KW document attribute does not have an input help any more in the attribute panel and no input check on the values, in the standard shipment.-Please note: With SAP note 2624562 we provide an option for those customers who require a value help on the KW "Keywords" that is similar to the functionality of 7.10. The value help that can be switched on using note 2624562 is not exactly the same as in 7.10, as the restriction of values to different tabs is not available any more. But the overall list of all configured values will be shown in the value help. This also implies that all entered values are checked against the values of the value help.-Non-KW attribute "Keywords" in 7.20-In 7.20, the non-KW keywords have disappeared in the standard for new installations, however they can be activated by the "content activation" for customers that upgrade from 7.10. These keywords appear in the corresponding content activation step under the section "Obsolete SAP attributes". If you had data in these attributes in 7.10, you can migrate the attribute definition to 7.20 and the content of these fields will be migrated as well.-But if you do not select the keywords attribute in the corresponding content activation step, and for all new installations, these non-KW keyword attributes will no longer be available in the application. SAP recommends to activate these keywords only if you have the requirement to take over this kind of data from 7.10.-This attribute still has the old value help. However, the list of values can no longer be enhanced via transaction SOLAR_PROJECT_ADMIN. But you can maintain additional keywords in the maintenance dialog on table TKEYEPR, which you can access in transaction SM30.-"Keywords" as a search field in the "Advanced search" in 7.20-Please note that in the "advanced search" functionality in 7.20, there is still the old value help assigned to the "Keywords" search field, but only as a convenience. This is done because this search field is used for both kinds of keywords (if activated) and we wanted to help customers in the transition phase from 7.10 to 7.20.-Alternatives to the keyword concept in 7.20-If the whole keyword concept is no longer suitable for you in 7.20, you might consider to create one or several new customer attributes that fit to your specific needs, using transaction SMUD_MODEL_WIZARD. Only in case you need the data that is migrated from 7.10 in the keyword fields, you should use the keywords in 7.20.

Title: Columns in Customer Migration Template have Switched
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have developed some code to extract data from your systems and populate the Customer Migration template. But you notice that the columns of the Customer Migration template in Test tenant are not in the same order as in the Customer Migration template available in Production tenant.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer, SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Customers-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen-Select Download Migration Template-Cause-We have added some new fields to Customer Migration Object as part of the 1608 release. Due to this, order of the fields in the Customer Migration template get changed. Further, when we add new fields (or) delete the existing fields of Customers Migration Object, we cannot control the order of the columns of the Migration template.-Resolution-Customer does not rely on order of the columns of Migration template. This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Columns in Customer Migration Template have Switched, Columns switched

Title: Outlook Add In - Add Contact button Greyed out
Content: Symptom-When trying to create a new contact, the button "Add Contact" is greyed out.-Environment-Outlook Add-In-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Folders Location by clicking the People Icon.-2) Click on New Contacts from the Contacts Folder.-3) Add Contact Button is greyed out.-Cause-Add Contact button is specific to Outlook Add-in. So you will not be able to use on other local Outlook Folders.-Resolution-Inorder to add a contact, you need to do it from the folder "SAP Cloud for Customer Contacts".-Keywords-Outllook Addin, Add Contact GreyedOut, Add Contact Button Disabled

Title: How to Release Customer Invoice to Bill-to/Payer
Content: Symptom-Bill-to and Payer are different from invoice Account.-When releasing customer invoice, invoice will be automatically released to Account.-There is no option to release to Bill-to or Payer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Show Not Released Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice).-Select Invoice ID XYZ and click Edit.-Click on View All, you can see Account as ABC (ABC represents the name), Payer and Bill-To as DEF (DEF represents the name).-Click on Release, your entries have been saved without any option to select account.-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Show All Customers and Find ABC.-Select account ABC and click View.-View tab Trade Receivables and subtab Invoices/Payments.-You can see open item invoice XYZ.-Cause-The right business partner is the party Account. System behavior is correct.-Definitions:-Account is a party that buys goods or services.-Payer is a party that pays for goods or services.-Bill-to is a party to which the invoice for goods or services is sent.-Resolution-If you want to release invoice to Bill-to or Payer, you have to manually repost the invoice to the respective account.-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Show All Customers and Find ABC.-Select account ABC and click View.-View tab Trade Receivables and subtab Invoices/Payments.-Select open item invoice XYZ and click on Actions and then select Repost Open Items.-Customer as DEF and fill in Document Description.-Click Post.-Keywords-Bill-to, Payer, Receivable

Title: Outgoing Check Preview Displays with Unexpected Format
Content: Symptom-Outgoing Check XYZ(XYZ stands for Payment ID) preview format varies from what you expect to be same with previous one as no change has ever been made for the outgoing check template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center and access Payment Monitor view.-Show All and Find Outgoing Check Document ID XYZ, open.-In the Outgoing Check Overview session, click View All.-Click Preview - Check.-You compare both of them and find them displayed differently.-Cause-Go to Application and User Management work center and access Form Template Maintenance view.-Search for Form Template Outgoing Check.-You will find the same type of form template is categorized by languages derived from languages of supplier master data. Format versions show differently by language.-Resolution-Go to Suppliers view within Account under Payables work center.-Find the supplier account ID ABC(ABC represents payee account ID in the payment document) and Click Edit->General.-Maintain the language of ABC as the same as that of your expected form template.- Keywords-Outgoing Check, Preview, Format

Title: Supplier Invoices not Processed on a 1099-Misc Tax Reporting
Content: Symptom-You wish to issue the 1099-Misc forms in the system, however no invoices are being processed by the run.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Withholding Tax Return Runs view.-Create the tax run with the 1099 related tax arrangement.-The tax run did not process any invoices, hence the tax return is not created.-Cause-You missed a master data set up for this tax scenario, hence withholding tax was not processed within the invoices.-Resolution-In order for the system to properly generate a tax return for 1099 reporting, there are settings in your master data that need to be made.- The below master data objects carry attributes that are specific to Withholding tax:-Company Tax Arrangement: The company should be marked to withhold tax. Refer to the Withholding Tax Required checkbox in your Tax Authority master data. -Supplier: The Supplier is subject to withholding. Note that if for the US, for example, you do not withhold amounts but report payments with 1099-Misc, select No backup withholding. If you have to withhold a certain percentage, select Liable to withholding. This is maintained in the supplier master data -> Financial Data -> Tax Data -> Withholding Tax Classifications. -Product: The product is relevant to withholding. Go to the Material or Service master data, choose View All, then go to Taxes tab. Maintain the required data in the Withholding Tax Classification section. -If the supplier invoice does not have a product ID assigned to it, the Withholding tax code is not populated automatically. You can, however, maintain a Withholding Tax Code in the Supplier's master data, in the Withholding tax Classifications section, field Withholding Tax Income Type. The information maintained here is then defaulted to the supplier invoice when no product ID is selected.-After posting and paying the invoice, you can go to the Tax Management work center and open the Withholding Tax Item report. The report display all payments relevant for withholding tax for a specific period. The display includes the underlying invoices, the withholding tax amounts, and the tax base amounts relating to each payment.-Note that this setup is valid from the date that you do the changes. In case you have not classified your supplier as being relevant to withhold taxes, the tax amount would not be accounted with the invoices. The amount, however, can be entered manually as a Manual Tax Entry. Please, refer to the SAP Business ByDesign Help Document Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries Quick Guide.-See Also-Help Document Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries Quick Guide

Title: G/L Account Cannot Be Found in Expense Plan
Content: Symptom-G/L account cannot be found in expense plan.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-The issue can be reproduced with following steps:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center and Planning View.-Select a plan and select Edit.-In tab Versions, select G/L Accounts as Leading List.-Select Find, enter the G/L account XYZ, but you cannot find it.-Cause-G/L account XYZ is not added to the reporting structure ABC, which is used in this plan.-If you go to tab General of this plan, you can see reporting structure ABC is assigned to this plan.-Resolution-You need to add G/L account XYZ to reporting structure ABC.-Go to Business Configuration work center and view Implementation Projects.-Select the project and select Open Activity List.-Go to tab Fine Tuning Activities.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Edit financial reporting structures.-Select reporting structure ABC, and select Edit.-Select the structure you want to assign G/L account XYZ, and select Actions--Assign Account.-Select G/L account XYZ, and select OK.-Select Save.-Now, if you reopen the plan, you can find G/L account XYZ.-Keywords-Expense Plan

Title: Journal Entry of Clearing Does Not Show in Statutory Report Edit Journal Entry Voucher - China
Content: Symptom-Journal entry of clearing does not show in statutory report Edit Journal Entry Voucher - China.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center, view Periodic Tasks and then subview Statutory Report.-Select report Edit Journal Entry Voucher - China.-Select a run and input journal entry ID as XYZ, which is a journal entry of clearing.-Select Next-The report does not include such journal entry.-  Cause-Journal entry XYZ is of type clearing, which does not have any item.-This is a dummy journal entry which is created for clearing purposes and does not affect sets of books. Consequently it is not shown in the Journal Entry Voucher - China statutory report.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Chinese Statutory Report, Journal Entry Voucher - China, Clearing Journal Entry

Title: Incorrect Country Code in Excel List Exported from EC Sales List
Content: Symptom-Registration Country and Customer Country show number instead of abbreviation of country in excel list exported from EC Sales List.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Issue can be reproduced with following steps:-Go to Tax Management work center and EC Sales List view.-Select tax return XYZ and open it.-Select View All and go to tab Tax Return.-Select EC Sales List ABC and select Export--To Microsoft Excel. However, yo see the country as number instead of country abbreviation. For example, it shows 63 in the field of country, instead of IE (for Ireland), which is incorrect.-Cause-For all EU countries, the VAT number is generally prefixed with the country code,example for Netherlands the VAT registration number starts with NL for Belgium with BE and so on.-The fields of Country ID in the excel list are derived from this.-In this case, the VAT number is maintained without prefix of country code, but directly starts with digit. So system shows the digit.-Resolution-Please maintain the VAT Number in Account with prefix of country code as IE for Ireland and so on.-Keywords-EC Sales List, Country Code

Title: In Reports Using HTML5 the Navigation Button is Missing to Access Microsoft Excel Add-On
Content: Symptom-When opening a Report in the Silverlight layout the Navigation Button is available, however when you are using the HTML5 layout there is no Navigation Button present on the Report screen.-Reproducing the Issue-Behaviour in Silverlight:-  As an example let's use the Application and User Management work center:-Click Application and User Management work center.-Click Reports view.-Open any Report.-Locate the Navigate To button.-Behaviour in HTML5:-Click Application and User Management work center.-Click Reports view.-Open any Report.-The Navigate To button is missing.-Cause-This is an expected behavior. The HTML5 and Silverlight layouts have a slightly different functionality.-Resolution-As an example let's use the Application and User Management work center:-Click Application and User Management work center.-Click the Reports view.-Highlight a Report.-Click the View With button.-Select Microsoft Excel.

Title: How to Find Changes Made to G/L-Accounts
Content: Symptom-You want to check for changes/updates made to the structure of G/L-Accounts in the System.-Resolution-You can check and see changes/ deletion done to the structure to any G/L-Accounts in the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Reports view.-Under Reports, click on the Configuration Change History link.-Navigate to the Fine-Tuning Settings.-Select Chart of Accounts, Financial Report Structures, Account Determination Fine-Tuning Activity.-Under Details select any of the Project and click on the Download Change Details button. -The data can be saved as a Zip file and opened.-You shall be able to see all the changes made.

Title: How To Change The Customer ID/Supplier ID On A Bank Statement In Status Posted
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Bank Statement and want to change the Customer/Supplier ID for one particular item.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Liquidity Management workcenter.-Navigate to Bank Statements.-Select the respective Bank Statement in Status Posted.-Click on View.-Go to Tab Transactions.-Item 123 (where 123 stands for a transaction item) has Customer/Supplier ID XXX (where XXX represents the ID of the customer/supplier).-Cause-To change the Customer/Supplier ID it is not necessary to change the Bank Statement.-The Data can be corrected via the Payment Allocation.-Resolution-Open the Liquidity Management workcenter.-Navigate to Bank Statements.-Select the respective Bank Statement.-Click on the Document Flow tab.-You see that the Payment Allocation ABC (where ABC stands for the Payment Allocation ID) is in Status Posted.-Open the Payment Management workcenter.-Go to Payment Allocations.-Select Payment Allocation ABC.-Click Reverse.-The Message Payment Allocation reversed successfully appears.-Payment Allocation ABC is now is Status Canceled.-A new Payment Allocation DEF for the respective Bank Statement has automatically been created in the ByDesign System.-Open Payment Management workcenter.-Go to Payment Allocations.-Select Show In Preparation Payment Allocation and search for the newly created Payment Allocation DEF.-Click Edit.-Add/Change the Customer/Supplier ID.-Click Actions - Create Proposal.-Confirm with Save and Post.-The Message Payment Allocation posted successfully appears.-If you check the Bank Statement now you see that the initial customer/supplier ID XXX was changed to the new customer/ supplier for Item 123.-Keywords-bank statement,payment allocation,supplier id,customer id

Title: Employee Private and Address Data in not displayed in HCM Reports
Content: Symptom-You are trying to generate a report to list the Employee Name with their Residence Address and/or other Personal Data like Private Mobile, Private Phone, Private E-mail.-The information may be required for Postal Communications or other purposes.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to the view Design Report-Open any Standard or Custom report face based on Headcount or Employee Master Data Data Source.-All the Private Contact Data are not displayed accordingly.-Cause-The HCM Data Sources only have the Employees' Workplace Contact Data and not their Private Contact Data.-Therefore, by design, this data cannot be displayed.-Resolution-Through the Personnel Administration work center, it is possible for you to get a list of all Private Contact Data maintained for the Active Employees and also is available to be exported to Microsoft Excel.-Go to Personnel Administration Work Center-Go to view Reports-Go to the sub view Employee List Reports-Switch the show view to Address List-Choose Export to Microsoft Excel-To get the Personal Data of the Terminated/ Inactive Employees, you may create a Z report based on the Data Source HCMPAB01. You have to filter on Termination Date to remove Active Employees.-Keywords-Private Mobile, Private Phone, Private E-mail, Private Contact Data, HCMPAB01, Workplace Contact Data

Title: Projected Stock Not Considering Dependent Demand
Content: Symptom-You are selling the product ABC which is used as Input Product for another product too. You have a Production Order on going, hence in the Product Planning of the product ABC there is a Dependent Demand reducing the Available Stock. But the Projected Quantity in the Sales Order you are selling the product ABC is not considering this Dependent Demand.-ABC = Product ID-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order XXX.-Open the Sales Order XXX.-Select Items.-Select the Line Item for product ABC.-Click Replace Product.-Notice that the Projected Quantity is 100 ea, as an example-  To check the Available Stock, please follow the steps:-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Search for product ABC.-Click Open.-Notice that the Available Stock is 50 ea, because 50 ea is being taken as Dependent Demand. However, in the Projected Stock the system is considering the 100 ea as available.-XXX = Sales Order ID-Cause-The Projected Quantity is calculated by the Available Stock + Total Supply – Total Demand, considering the horizon set. For ATP availability, the stock is only reduced if the demand has corresponding confirmation associated with it. Dependent Demand is just a requirement without a corresponding confirmation. Therefore, 100 ea stock is still available in the Projected Quantity.-Resolution-The system is working as designed as there is no Confirmation against Dependent Demand.

Title: Customer Tax Exemption Certificates (with US specifics)
Content: Symptom-Tax Exemption Certificates are a special form of tax exemption and not applicable in every country. They are issued for a specific reason for transactions between specified business partners, in contrast to a normal tax exemption which is valid in general. Hence the tax exemption certificate is only taken into account in transactions between these specified business partners-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Tax Exemption Certificates within ByDesign are currently only available as Customer Tax Exemption Certificates, and can therefore only be used between a customer and a company. They can be limited for a certain period of time and even up to a certain amount.-There exist different types of usage for tax exemption certificates: single usage (only applicable once) and continuous usage (applicable several times till the validity expires or till the exempt amount is used up). The limitation to a total tax exemption amount is not applicable within the United States.-When creating a customer tax exemption certificate, you must set its validity period and the appropriate certificate type (Direct Payment Certificate, Exempt Organization Certificate, Exempt Use Certificate, or Resale Certificate) in combination with the type of usage.-A customer tax exemption certificate being a kind of tax exemption, the corresponding exemption reason needs to be provided as well. For the United States this can be one of the following: Agricultural Production, Charitable Organization, Direct Pay Permit,  Foreign Diplomat, Industrial Production / Manufacturing, Multiple Points of Use, Religious or Educational Organization, Resale, Federal Government, State or Local Government, or Tribal Government, or an Other reason not further specified.-For a customer tax exemption certificate for the United States, you furthermore have to specify the state in which it is valid. Please note that a tax exemption certificate can only be used in a transaction if it is created for the same state where the account is located.--Creation of a Customer Tax Exemption certificate-A Customer Tax Exemption Certificate can be created from within the account, or on the fly in a sales transaction document from the tax details section. Note that before a customer tax exemption certificate can be used, it must be activated.--Usage of a Customer Tax Exemption Certificate within Tax Calculation-Tax calculation automatically checks whether a customer tax exemption certificate can be used within a transaction. This depends on the involved parties (company and account), the tax date of the transaction and the validity period of the customer tax exemption certificate and other facts such as the certificate type and its usage so far.-As the customer tax exemption certificate types "Direct Payment Certificate - continuous" and "Exempt Organization Certificate - continuous" always apply, they can be determined automatically by tax calculation. For all the other certificate types you need the information from the customer whether the certificate can be used for the current transaction. So they have to be assigned manually in a sales transaction.-During tax calculation the manual set customer tax exemption certificate will be validated and in case it is not necessary or not possible to use this one, it will be discarded and the user informed accordingly. Reasons for discarding a manual set customer tax exemption certificate might be, for example: it is not valid at that point of time (check tax date in the document and the validity period of the customer tax exemption certificate), it has already been applied before in case of single usage, or the manual set customer tax exemption certificate is not necessary because the transaction is exempt due to other reasons (due to missing nexus or general tax-exemption of product or business partner).

Title: How to configure automatic e-mail notification for CSA tasks
Content: Symptom-You would like to configure automatic e-mail notification for CSA tasks-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.1-Reproducing the Issue-You would like to configure automatic e-mail notification for CSA tasks-Resolution-In Technical Administration workcenter, go to Configuration -> Central System Administration-Choose your solution from the popup and in the next screen open the CSA Setup session of the desired managed system ID-In the navigation area, choose "Global Customizing" and then "Global E-Mail Notification Customizing (CSA)".- On the "Global E-Mail Notification Customizing" tab, you can select the "Send E-Mail Notification at OVERDUE" checkbox to define that an e-mail notification is sent when the task status is Overdue.-On the "Select Task Frequency for Notification tab, you can customize the task frequency types for which you want to send out Overdue notifications.-On the "Select Solution for Notification" tab, you can define the SAP Solution Manager solutions in which you want to send out Overdue notifications.-For each solution, you can define a notification recipient. This recipient receives overdue notifications instead of the general e-mail recipient defined on the Global E-Mail Customizing tab.-See Also-2554693 - CSA don't send automatically Email on overdue tasks

Title: Error: Target UI Could Not be Determined in the Current Scope. Please Ask Your System Administrator to Check the Scoping
Content: Symptom-You are trying to view a Payment Order which still has not been created.-But the Payment is still in 'In Approval' status and when you click on it, you get the error: Target UI Could Not be Determined in the Current Scope. Please Ask Your System Administrator to Check the Scoping.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management Work Center-Go to Payment Monitor view-Open the Payment ID which is in In Approval status-Open the Document ID-Click on View All-Go to Document Flow tab-Click on the Payment Order ID hyperlink-Error appears Target UI could not be determined in the current scope. Please ask your system administrator to check the scoping.-Cause-The Payment is still in In Approval status, hence the error appears as the system is trying to open a Payment which has not yet been created.-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Resolution-Approver has to approve the Payment by going to:-Managing My Area Work Center-Go to Approvals View.-Go to Payment Approvals sub view.-Search for the Payment ID-Approve the Payment-Once the Payment is approved, the Payment Order ID will be created and now if you click on the Payment Order ID the error won't appear.

Title: Where to find Service Level Agreement for Cloud Services.
