Content: Symptom-Where to find Service Level Agreement for Cloud Services.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to look at the SLA documentation.-1.Login to www.sap.com-2.Go to About tab-3.Go to SAP Agreements-4.Navigate to "SAP Cloud Services Customers"-5.Under it, you can see Second section "Cloud Service Description"-6.Click on Service Level Agreement-7.You can select the language version whichever you want and can download the document-You can also refer to the direct link:https://www.sap.com/about/agreements/cloud-services.html?search=service%20level%20agreement<(>&<)>sort=title_asc<(>&<)>tag=language:Englishdocumentation.-Keywords-SLA, Service Level Agreement, SLA Documentation.

Title: Due Period Range in Aging List Report
Content: Symptom-You are running the Aging List for Receivables report, nevertheless the expected amount is not displayed in the first overdue range [1-30]. Instead, it is displayed as outstanding amount.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open the Aging List for Receivables.-Specify the selection criteria. For illustration purposes, consider Cut Off Date as 31.10.2017-Run the report.-Add the Due Date characteristic to the report's row.-You see that the entries with Due Date equal to the Cut Off Date, the related amount is not displayed in the 1st Due Period range. Instead, the amount is shown as Outstanding.-Cause-The aging list report only show in the ranges the amounts that are overdue. If you choose cut off date as 31.10.2017 and the due date of an item is also on 31.10.2017, the due date was not elapsed yet, hence item was not overdue.-The 1st Due Period displays the overdue amount with a due date between 1 and 30 days in the past.-In this example, an item with due date on 30.10.2017 then would be displayed in the first due range.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. You may also consider using the Forecast List for Receivables for due items.

Title: Unassigned Task - Overdue: Complete Compensation Data (Hire) Created in the Business Task Management for HR Administrator
Content: Symptom-You want to know, why system created the unassigned task - Overdue: Complete Compensation Data (Hire) in the Application and User Management work center.-Cause-The HR Administrator does not have access rights to work center view HCM_PA_REGULARTASKS and hence the task was unassigned.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Select the relevant Business User.-Navigate to the tab Work Center and View Assignment.-Assign the work center view HCM_PA_REGULARTASKS.-Save and Close.-The Overdue: Complete Compensation Data (Hire) is an escalation task informing you as HR administrator that compensation data for a hired employee was not entered on time. The original task Complete Compensation Data (Hire) which appeared in Compensation work list still needs to be processed. The original task Complete Compensation Data (Hire) which appeared in Compensation work list still needs to be processed.-The system automatically triggers this escalation task after a (configured) deadline has passed. As responsible for the hire of the employee concerned relevant HR should ensure that the compensation data is entered in the ByDesign system by completing the escalated task Complete Compensation Data (Hire) in the Compensation Work view.-The escalation task Overdue: Complete Time Data (Hire) will be completed and removed from the work list automatically once the original task is completed.

Title: Inactive Time(s) Message in Employee Timesheet
Content: Symptom-You open the timesheet of an employee and the system shows a warning message "Inactive Time(s)" in the field Period Status.-Reproducing the Issue-Enter Time Administration work center-Navigate to the  Time sheet section under the Time Recording view-Search for the employee-Click on Open Time Sheet Button-In the Period Status field, you can see the warning message-Cause-This message is displayed because the employee does not have the target hours registered and approved for that specific period, in one or more days of the week.-By clicking on the tab Review and Correct, you can see the specific days when the target working time was not completed-Resolution-In order to correct this, the time records that have status "Pending cancellation", "Cancelled" or "In Approval" must be approved.-This is done by the employee manager of the org structure (which can be found by clicking in the employee name anywhere on the time sheet screen).

Title: Ticket Type Is Not Getting Defaulted To Last Used Ticket Type
Content: Symptom-When you create a new Ticket using Quick Create option, the Ticket Type is not getting defaulted to the last used ticket type.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service workcenter,-Select Tickets view.-Select New button here you can see the Type is not defaulted to last used ticket type.-Cause- If the user is assigned to Employee Support view, for that user the ticket type defaulting will not work and user have to select the ticket type manually.-Resolution-To enable the defaulting ticket type to the last used ticket type follow the below steps.-Login to the Silverlight UI of Cloud for Customer system.-Go to  the Applications and User Management workcenter.-Select the User And Access Management view.-Search for the Business User ABC (ABC represents the ID of the user).-Select Edit - Access Rights.-Go to the Business Role Assignments tab.-Select Business Role assigned to the user is XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the business role).-Select View All button-Go to the Work Center And View Assignment tab.-Now unassigned the Deprecated: Employee Support and Employee Support from Service work center.-Select the Save button.

Title: How to Stop the Notifications for the Changed Purchase Order Being Sent to the Supplier After Modifications
Content: Symptom-You have created and ordered the purchase order. Later you have attached a document like package details, additional terms etc. to the purchase order. This triggers a changed purchase order notification to the supplier and creates a confusion at supplier side because they get notification for changed purchase order. Hence you want to know, how to stop this notification for changed purchase order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Common Task section.-Select New Purchase Order.-Fill the mandatory details.-Order the Purchase document.-Now attach the required documents to the sent Purchase Order.-System triggers a Changed Purchase Order to the Supplier.-Resolution-System triggers change purchase order notification because purchase order has been changed after it was sent to the supplier. Whatever the changes you do after it was sent to the supplier, system will consider the order as Changed Purchase Order. This is a standard behavior. As a workaround, you can attach the required documents before the approval process. This will not trigger the Changed Purchase Order and avoids confusion at Supplier side.

Title: The Scheduled Invoice Request is Showing Total Amount as Zero
Content: Symptom- The Scheduled Invoice Requests is showing total amount as 0.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show All Invoice Requests.-Filter with Scheduled Invoice Requests.-You will find invoice requests having Total as 0,00.-Cause-The Scheduled Invoice Request will have the Net Value and the Total will remain as 0. When you Invoice the Scheduled Invoice Request, you will see the Total Value in the invoice document.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: How to Edit Planned Delivery Date in Stock Transfer Delivery Notification.
Content: Symptom-Planned Delivery Date is not editable in Stock Transfer Delivery Notification 1234567890.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view-Show All Delivery Notifications by Selection and Find Delivery Notification ID 1234567890.-Select Delivery Notification and View All.-You will notice that Planned Delivery Date is greyed out and not editable.-Cause-It is not possible to change the Planned Delivery Date in Stock Transfer Delivery Notification if any of the below criteria for the Status fails:-1. Consistency Status: Consistent-2. Delivery Notification Status: Advised-3. Release Status: Not Released-4. Delivery Status: Not Started-5. Cancellation Status: Not Canceled-Resolution-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center .-Go to Outbound Deliveries View.-Find the Delivery ID corresponding to the Delivery Notification ID 1234567890 and in the Actions perform Undo Release.-Edit the Delivery ID and change the Planned Delivery Date as required and release the Delivery ID XYZ.-Now check the Stock Transfer Delivery Notification it should reflect the changed date in Planned Delivery Date.-Keywords-Delivery Notification, Planned, Stock Transfer, Inbound, Undo Release.

Title: Error Message: “Role for Employee XYZ Missing” While Migrating the Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you Import Org Structure using the migration tool, you receive the below error message:-Role for employee XYZ missing-*XYZ represents the Employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the migration activity Perform Organizational Structure Setup-Select Import org structure using the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step-Cause-Migration is failing as the Role field is empty.-Resolution-In the current release, in the Migration template, in the sheet Employees the field Role is not flagged as mandatory. Role is an optional field.-Provide desired Role values for the Employee from a business point of view as below:-218 = Manager-219 = Employee-Keywords-Perform Organizational Structure Setup, Role for employee missing

Title: How to Identify Purchase Document Items to be Cleared in a GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You want to know which Purchase Document Items are ready to be cleared in a Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt (GR/IR) Clearing run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Steps to identify Purchase Document Items ready to be cleared:--1. Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-2. Select the Purchasing Document Items view.-3. Show Items to be cleared.-4. Open the Advance Search and enter the relevant Company ID.-5. Sort the Purchase Document Item list by Ascending.-6. Create a new GR/IR Clearing Run entering a range in the Purchasing Document From / To ID fields from the list in above Step 5.-See Also-KBA 2301752 - GR/IR Clearing Run Jobs Failing/Cancelled - The Internal Session Was Terminated With a Runtime Error (See ST22)-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing; Purchase Document Item, Inventory Valuation; Clearing

Title: No Profit Center Field While Creating a New Incoming Check
Content: Symptom-When creating a New Incoming Check with Direct Posting to G/L Account you don't find the Profit Center field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Incoming Check.-Scroll down to Payment Application Method.-Select Direct Posting to G/L Account.-You don't find the Profit Center field.-Cause-This is not one of the standard fields of New Incoming Check with Direct Posting to G/L Account.-Resolution-The Profit center is hidden in the Personalize menu. In order to make it visible, please follow below steps:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Incoming Check.-Scroll down to Payment Application Method.-Select Direct Posting to G/L Account.-Click Start Personalization Mode (in the User photo in the upper right corner of the screen).-Search Unnamed Table.-Select Unnamed Table section.-Search Profit Center.-Mark the checkbox for Profit Center.-Press Save.-Click Stop Personalization Mode.-Now you can see the Profit Center field added.-Keywords-Profit center, Incoming check, Personalization Mode.

Title: Customer Invoice Rebate Is Posted To Debit And Credit Side of the Sales Discount Account
Content: Symptom-You have a customer invoice that contains a rebate posting, and you believe that the posting is incorrect. It is appearing on a discount account and showing as both a debit and credit posting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have an active rebate agreement in place that is applied to a Customer Invoice when there is a combination of the specific Customer Account and a Specific Product.-If you check the Journal entry of the Customer Invoice with rebate you notice:-Invoice: ABC (ABC stands for invoice number) with an amount of, say, 180,00 LC (LC stands for Local Currency)-Journal Entry: DEF (DEF stand for Journal Entry number)-Debit:   Trade debtors-domestic: 180,00 LC-Credit:  VAT payable-output tax: 30,00 LC-Credit:  Sales -revenue: 150,00 LC-You notice the following accrual postings:-Credit: customer discounts allowed 7,50 LC-Debit: customer discounts allowed 7,50 LC-In rebate agreement the accrual rate is here 5% ( 5% of 180,00 LC = 7,50 LC)-You now want to know why the system is not using an accrual account and also why is there a debit and credit posting on it.-Cause-Accrual postings happen when a rebate-relevant billing document is transferred to accounting, so that the funds are available later during the settlement. Settlement happens when a rebate agreement is scheduled and settled so that system calculates rebate payment amount based on the cumulated sales volume and creates a rebate credit memo.-Resolution-When an Invoice document is released, the amount that is relevant for accrual should be cumulated, this should not have any implications on the total value of the document. The amount is posted as a debit and credit amount, so when the posting to accrual account happens the total values are the same.-Rebates currently do not have a separate accrual account for ledger posting, the account for discounts is used for rebates accrual postings.-The credit amount corresponds to Rebate Settlement Due Rate (%).-Debit amount corresponds to Accrual Rate (%) which can be seen in the pricing tab of Invoice that is posted.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Rebate, Journal Entry Voucher Rebate Posting, Rebate Accrual

Title: Error Message "Organizational assignment not valid; validity period is DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1"
Content: Symptom-When you try to change the Hire Date of an employee, the system shows the error:-"Organizational assignment not valid; validity period is DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1802 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Select Employees view-Open the employee-Go to the Employment tab-Open the Work Agreement sub-tab-Click Change Hire Date-Enter a new date-Click OK- The system throws the error message.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the new hire date is before the org unit 'Valid From' date. Which means the Org Unit itself doesn't exist with the new hire date. This can be verified in the Organizational Management work center.-Resolution-It is not possible to extend the Hire date before the start date (Valid From) of the Org Unit. So, the hire date of the employee should always be on or after the start date of the Org Unit.-There are two possible options to overcome this scenario:-Extend the validity of the Org Unit, as the same validity of the desired date and then change the hire date of the employee.-Change the Hire Date of the Employee to the org unit Valid From date and make use of Service Start Date in the employee Work Agreement tab, to add the desired Hire Date.-Note:-If the Employee is created in the system using Migration, then the hire date can be earlier than the Org Unit date. For Employees created manually in the system, it is not possible to have the Hire date earlier that than the Organizational Assignment date.-Keywords-organizational assignment not valid, hire date error, change hire date issue, org unit validity, validity period error, employee hire date, SAP Business ByDesign

Title: How to Get Customer Contact Details
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While sending the incident to the Direct Support you have to provide the customer details. This CD helps in getting the correct customer details from SPC.-Resolution-The following are the steps to get the customers details:-1. Copy the tenant ID and go to Provisioning tab and paste the copied tenant ID.-  2. In the Service Request Details you get the Service Request ID. Copy the Service Request ID.-3. Go to ICP and to Service Engagement and then to Service Orders. Place the service request ID.-4. Title: Cost of Goods Sold not Reduced by Supplier Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier credit memo, however it has not reflected in the cost of goods sold amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open Profit Overview by Key Figure-Fill in the required data in order to find the cost of goods sold for the sales order.-Execute the report.-The cost of goods sold is not as expected. It should be a reduced the amount due to supplier credit memo posting.-Cause-The credit memo posting is not going to the sales ledger.-Resolution-You need to make the cost distribution in the credit memo referring to the relevant sales order, then the cost of goods sold is reduced accordingly.-In order to check the cost distribution, you may:-Open the supplier credit memo.-Click View All.-Go to Items tab.-Click the Cost Distribution tab.-The account assignment type should be SLS - Sales Order with reference to the required sales order.-Keywords-Sales Ledger. GoGS. Profit Overview.

Title: How to check the list of Company Specific Help documents available
Content: Symptom-To check all the list of Company Specific Help Documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer.-Cause-You want to know the Company Specific Help documents uploaded in the system.-Resolution-Go to Help Center.-Click on Edit Company-Specific Help for all screens Or Edit Company-Specific Help.-There are two possibilities to check the customer specific help documents:-If you are in some Work Center view you can use "Edit Company Specific Help for All Screens” and then the documents you are creating are visible for every Work Center and every View.-But if you use “Edit Company Specific Help” then the documents will be visible only for the Work Center view in which it is created.-Keywords-Company specific Help documents.-company specific help documents

Title: Report Net Revenue Gives Error Message 'No Financial Companies Found in The System Check Fin Company Set up'
Content: Symptom-The report Net Revenue is not working. There is an error message: 'No Financial Companies found in the system. Check Fin Company set up. Report inconsistent. It cannot be started'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the view Design Reports.-Search for the report Net Revenue (ID FINPRFMMCU40_MMCQ0003) and open the report.-You can see an error message:  'No Financial Companies found in the system. Check Fin Company set up. Report inconsistent. It cannot be started'.-Cause-This report works only if the Business User has a company assigned. In this case the company field is empty. You need to assign the company in the Organizational Management Work Center.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to the Org Structures View.-Select an Org Structure and press Edit.-Switch to the tab Employees.-Press Add and maintain the necessary fields for the Employee.-Press Save and close.-The report runs as expected.-See Also-For further reference, see KBA 1901180.-Keywords-Net Revenue; Nettoerlös; Company field empty; Organizational Management; design KPI report based

Title: Not Due Amount in the Aging List for Receivables by Document Date
Content: Symptom-You ran the Aging List for Receivables by Document Date and noticed that for a certain invoice, even though it is due (as per Document Date) and displayed in one of the due ranges (e.g. 1 - 30 Days) the amount is also displayed in the Not Due Amount key figure. Hence, you are not sure if the amount is due or not.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open the Aging List for Receivables by Document Date-Fill in the required selection parameters.-Bring the Customer Invoice ID, Document Date and Due Date as characteristics in the report.-You notice that for a given invoice, the corresponding amount is shown under a due range, on the Overdue Amount key figure as well as in the Not Due Amount key figure.-The expectation is that if an invoice is overdue, the amount is not displayed as Not Due Amount. The backwards is also true.-Cause-The report you are using is the Aging List based on the Document Date. This report considers the document date in comparison with the Cut Off Date of the selection parameters in order to display the invoice in an overdue range (e.g. 1 - 30 Days) and set the Overdue Amount. Nevertheless, the Not Due Date key figure is based on the Due Date. Therefore, if you have a document date on 01.03.2018, due date on 15.03.2018 but a cut-off date in the report as 08.03.2018, you'll see the document's amount in both the Overdue Amount due to document date and also on the Not Due Amount because of the Due Date.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Note that in the Aging List for Receivables (not by Document Date) both key figures depend on the Due Date only.-Keywords-Aging List. Payables. Receivables. Due Date. Overdue Amount. Not Due.

Title: You Assigned a Common Task to a User But it is Not Available to User
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a View ID to a user in order to give them access to a Common Task, however when they access the system, they are not able to see this Common Task under the respective Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1802 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Administrator assigning the Common Task to the user:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Business User view.-Select the user.-Click on Edit -> Access Rights.-Open Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Expand the work center of the Common Task.-Assign the Common Task to the user.-Save it.-User not able to see the Common Task:-Go to the respective work center;-The only views available are Overview and Reports. There are no Common Tasks showing.-Cause-In order for the Common Tasks to be available in the work center, the user needs to have one of the views of this work center assigned.-Resolution-Assign one of the views of the work center to the user, then they will be able to access the tasks.--Also note that by doing this, all of the Common Tasks will be available for them, it is not possible to release only specific tasks.-Keywords-common tasks, work center, assignment, business user, access rights, work center view assignment

Title: Approval Task for Expense Report Cannot be Completed for Second Approver
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-As second approver, you have an Approval Task In progress for an Expense Report that you cannot complete after the first approver has rejected the expense report.-Please note that the backend steps outlined below are also valid for other scenarios where Expense Report Tasks need to be marked as Completed or Deleted from the backend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work centre.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Show all and search for Expense Report XYZ; Its Status is Rejected.-Click on Edit, then View All.-In the General tab, click on the Show Approver details hyperlink.-The list of all approvers for this expense report is displayed including the one for which the task cannot be completed.-  Now go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Task Distribution view, Business Task Management sub-view.-Search for Expense Report XYZin All items.-The following task is with status In progress and cannot be completed by the approver: Approve Expense Report XYZ.-Cause-As indicated in Case Document 2014502 - Multi-Step Approval Of Expense Report Is Not Released for Business ByDesign, multi-step approval is not supported and might be the cause of the approval task inconsistencies.-Resolution-Once you have clarified with the customer that the task is not necessary anymore and you have secured their approval for backend corrections, complete or delete the relevant approval task from the backend by using transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-Enter the task details in the search function such as the Due date and Creation time (this information can be found in the UI) and task type HCM_ERM_ERM_EXREP_APP.-Click on Execute.-Select the relevant approval task of type Approve Expense Report XYZ.-In the Details tab, click on the Complete button:-  If it is greyed out, then delete the task instance by clicking on the paper bin icon, this will delete the task permanently.-Go back to the UI and refresh the task table, check that it is now completed or deleted (the task).-  See Also-Please refer to Case document 2014502 - Multi-Step Approval Of Expense Report Is Not Released for Business ByDesign and inform the customer accordingly about the restrictions on this functionality.-Keywords-approval task, cannot delete, approver, second approver, approbateur, expense report, note de frais, tâche, upprimer

Title: Leading Zeros for Employee IDs are Truncated
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to create employee IDs with leading zeros, but while saving the employee, the system removes the zeros. This occurs by creating an employee in UI, during migration or by replicating employees from other systems.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer 1802 and higher.-SAP Business ByDesign 1802 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Creating employees in UI:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Hire Employee.-Enter the Employee ID with leading zeros and the mandatory information.-Save the employee and see the leading zeros were removed from the ID.-Cause-If the ID has alpha-conversion enabled, then the below mentioned behavior is the same for all alpha-conversion identifiers. The reason for that is because the ID accepts different format rules i.e. accepts letters and special characters.-For pure numerical IDs, the alpha-conversion takes place. Alpha-conversion means that numerical values are padded with leading zeros until they reach the length of the referenced data type.-For IDs containing letters or special characters, the alpha-conversion is not needed and hence no leading zeros will be inserted in the ID.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-If you enter the Employee ID with leading zeros, followed by numeric values, the zeros will be truncated.-If you have an Employee ID with leading zeros followed by alphanumeric values, then the zeros will not be truncated.-Keywords-leading zero, employee ID, master data replication, employee replication, employee central, personnel administration, employee hiring

Title: No Recipient E-mail on Follow-Up
Content: Symptom-You are creating an e-mail as a follow-up for a Private Account, however, the recipient is not filled automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the Private Account ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Click the Follow-up button.-Select the New E-mail option.-The To field is not filled as expected.-Cause-This behavior is only available for the Corporate Accounts as the e-mail retrieved is the one maintained under the Contacts tab. For Private accounts, you can manually enter the information. Once determining the account manually, the systems selects the e-mail address maintained under the General tab of the account.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the Private Account ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Click the Follow-up button.-Select the New E-mail option.-Click on the Value Box on the To field.-Search for the ID ABC.-Select the line.-Click the single arrow downwards button.-The account shows under Selected.-Click the OK button-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior and it is applied for all sales documents.

Title: No Tax Number Type for Country Japan
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to create a New Tax Authority for country Japan and see that the Tax Numbers are not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Tax Authorities view.-Go to Tax Authorities subview.-Create a New -> Tax Authority.-Add Country: Japan.-Navigate to tab Company Tax Arrangements. ﻿Now select Tax Numbers tab.-Click Add Row to enter new Tax Number Type.-Tax Number Type shows No items found.-Cause-You cannot maintain Tax Numbers (Tax Number Type and Tax Number) for Japan because it is not legally supported in Japan.--Resolution-The Tax Authority for Japan can be saved without maintaining Tax Numbers and the business transactions in future is not affected.-See Also-2076199 - Adding Tax Number Type for Japanese Business Partner Not Working-Keywords-Tax Number Japan Tax Auhtority

Title: Wrong Tax Rate Type and/or Tax Rate Determination on Purchase Order for Countries such as Spain and France.
Content: Symptom-You have defined a Default Tax information in the affected Product's Master Data containing default Tax Country, Region, Tax Type, Tax Rate Type and Tax Rate. Although, this information is being wrongly detemined under Items > Taxes tab for Purchase Order, even though all the information including the Country and Region are the same as maintained in the Product's Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Search and open the affected PO.-Click on View All and go to Items tab.-Select the affected Line Item and go to Taxes subtab.-See that the Tax Type and/or Tax Rate Type are for example Standard 21%.-Now for the selected Line Item, double click on the Product's ID Hyperlink and open its Master Data.-Go to Taxes tab and see that the information maintained in there is different.-Cause-This is happening because you have defined a Region on the Product Master Data.-There is no region based tax calculation for countries like Spain and France and this is the reason why the automatic Tax Rate Determination is picking a different information. The Tax Rate percentages for those countries are not different from region to region.-Resolution-The Tax information maintained in the Material Master Data will work correctly if the Region for those countries is empty.-Keywords-Tax Rate Type, Tax Type, Wrong Tax, Determination, Purchase Order, PO, Spain, France

Title: How To Reverse a Processed Payment Run
Content: Symptom-You want to reverse the Payment Run XXX (XXX stands for the Payment Run ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Steps to reverse the Payment Run XXX below:--Go to the Payables work center.-Select the Periodic Tasks view and go to the Payment Run subview.-Find the Payment Run XXX and select it.-Click on the View Payment Proposals button in Execution Details field.-On the new screen, perform the below steps for each one of the payments on the list.--a)  Select a payment from the list.-b)  Click the Actions button.-c)  Select the Reverse option.-Keywords-Payment Run-Reversal-Deletion-Cancellation-Payments-Payment Proposal

Title: Columns Function and Department are Empty on Service Performer Value Help Inside Service Orders
Content: Symptom-You want to filter the Service Performer on Service Orders using the 'Function' and 'Department' columns, but while searching for the service performers, you see that both columns are empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1802 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Hover the mouse pointer over the Service Orders work center.-Click on New Service Order.-Click on the value help from field 'Service Performer'.-Search for the employee.-See columns 'Function' and 'Department' are empty.-Cause-The reason for the fields being empty is that you are searching for Employees, instead of Service Agents. The fields 'Function' and 'Department' are linked to the Service Agent master data, they are part of the Business Details of a Service Agent.-Resolution-To maintain information on 'Function' and 'Department' fields, follow the steps below:-Go to the Supplier Base work center, in Service Agents view.-Search for the desired Service Agent and edit it.-If the Service Agent has already a Supplier determined, both Function and Department fields will be editable.-If the Service Agent has no Supplier determined, both fields will be read only.-You should determine a Supplier for the Service Agent and then update both fields.-Keywords-function, department, service agent, supplier base, service order, service performer

Title: Service Order Cancelation Error: You Cannot Change the Data in Cancelation Reason
Content: Symptom-When cancelling the Service Order ABC the following error message is displayed and saving is not possible: 'You cannot change the data in Cancellation Reason. Refresh screen and try again'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Order work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Search for the Service Order ABC (This represents the number of the serivce order).-Click on the Edit and then the View All button.-On the header level enter a Reason for Rejection.-The following error message is displayed: You cannot change the data in Cancellation Reason. Refresh screen and try again.-Cause-You are facing this errror due to a missing reason for rejection on the Service Confirmation document.-Resolution-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmation view.-Search for Service Order ABC.-Click on the Edit and then the View All button.-Enter a Reason for Rejection.-Save-Go back to the Servicer Order ABC-Remove the Reason for Rejection and enter the reason for rejection again.-The status of the Service Order will change to Completed.

Title: How to Delete Communication Collaboration on Account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Customer is reporting that undesired communication arrangements were created, and now is requesting on how to delete them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1802 and above.-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview view, search for "Migration of Accounts".-Click on "Migrate Accounts using the Migration Tool".-Select a file in the staging area which contains information in the communication sheet.-Execute the migration by following the steps after clicking on Execute Migration -> Step-by-step.-After the migration, access Customers work center.-In the Accounts view, click to enter any account.-Click on the button "View All".-Go to Communication tab of the account.-Enter the subtab Collaboration-In the table, you can see that there is no option to delete the existing rows.-Cause-Since Communication arrangement is a foreign business object (BO /DOC/OM_COMM_ARRANGEMENT) which is bound to customer business object via association, currently it's not possible to delete such entries through the UI.-Resolution-In order to remove such entries in backend, we can use the BO test shell (SESFTS transaction).-Enter BO name Customer.-Search for the Internal ID.-Navigate via association to Communication_Arrangement.-Select corresponding entry for particular document (i.e. Customer Invoice) and navigate to Child Communication Arrangements.-Select Edit Mode.-Select the entry to be deleted.-Click on Delete button.-Save-If needed, reach to development component SRD-CRM-ACC.-Keywords-Collaboration, Arrangements, Communication, Printer, E-mail, Fax, XML

Title: Check: No Errors are Reported in Managed Systems during Extractor Execution
Content: Symptom-You want to check whether really no errors occurred when extractors were executed on the managed systems.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager-Resolution-Step 1 Check the execution time of the extractor-It is important that you need to wait for the next execution of the extractor.  Then don't forget to look at the time of execution as you will use this to filter in the SLG1 as well the required objects. You can find the execution time in the Extractor Log:-  Step 2 Log onto Managed System and check SLG1 or alternatively use Exception Analysis in Root Cause Analysis-This is how to check application log for errors:-Go to the transaction SLG1 on the Managed System-Change the time according to the execution of the extractor-Use the admin user that is specified in the managed system configuration. If in doubt, check in transaction SM59 for the RFC destination.-Check if there are any errors that might relate to the ST-PI-  Step 3 Log onto Managed System and check ST22 for any dumps relating to the Extractor execution-This is how to check if there are any dumps on the ABAP system:-Go to the transaction ST22 on the Managed System-Change the time to the execution time frame of the extractor-Use the admin user that is specified in the managed system configuration. If in doubt, check in transaction SM59 for the RFC destination.-Check if there are any ABAP dumps that might relate to the ST-PI-Keywords-Extractor Framework

Title: Error message: 'Maintain Valuation Intervals From DD.MM.YYYY For Valuation View X of Fixed Asset ABC'
Content: Symptom-The error message: 'Maintain Valuation Intervals From DD.MM.YYYY For Valuation View X of Fixed Asset ABC' (where ABC stands for the fixed asset ID) is displayed while executing a Depreciation for a Particular Fixed Asset/ Manual Posting for Acquisition-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets sub view.-Show All Fixed Assets and select Fixed Asset ABC.-Select View all at the top right of the screen.-The error message: 'Maintain valuation intervals from DD.MM.YYYY for valuation view X of fixed asset ABC' is displayed.-Cause-This Error is displayed while executing a Depreciation for a Particular Fixed Asset/ Manual Posting for Acquisition and the reason for this is when the  validity Start Date of the valuation interval of the Fixed Asset is on or before the first date of the fiscal year.  -Resolution-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets sub view.-Show All Fixed Assets and select the Fixed Asset ABC.-Click on the Master data Tab and Asset Valuation sub tab.-Further in the Valuation Intervals Sub tab and in the Start Date field.-Enter first date of the fiscal year and click on Save button.-Keywords-valuation intervals, 'Bearbeiten Sie die Bewertungsintervalle von DD.MM.YYYY für Bewertungssicht X der Anlage ABC', Anlagen, Betwertungsintervall, FIA_FXA_DC:008, fixed asset

Title: Stock Overview is Showing a Product Without any Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-Stock overview is showing Stock of a Product without any Logistics Area. You want to know what is the significance of such Stock and how to remove this entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Stock Overview link from Common Task.-Search Stock of the relevant Product ID. It shows Stock but it is not assigned to any Logistics Area.-Cause-The Stock, which is shown without any Logistics Area, is of type Goods Issue. Stock type Goods Issue indicates that in the Outbound Delivery process goods have been issued from a Logistics Area and the Outbound Delivery has been created. But the corresponding Outbound Delivery has not been released yet. Since  goods are already moved from the Logistics Area, this type of Stock is shown without any Logistics Area. However, it will show corresponding Warehouse Order ID.-Note: You need to personalize Stock Overview screen to see columns Stock Type and Warehouse Order ID.-Resolution-Once you release the Outbound Delivery, entry from Stock Overview will be removed. To release the Outbound Delivery:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the relevant outbound delivery.-Select it and choose Release button.-Keywords-stock, overview, without, logistics, area, outbound, delivery, goods, issue

Title: The Bank Accounts Are Not Proposed Correctly During Automatic Payments
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Your company has businesses with foreign suppliers whose company currencies are different from yours, so you set up different bank accounts with different currencies, and expect that during automatic payments, the system can propose the right bank accounts according to the currency codes in the supplier invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center and choose the Automatic Payments view.-Show All Payment Proposals.-Choose one payment proposal in which the transactional currency is not your company currency, and the Payment Method is Bank Transfer.-Choose Edit, and then go to the General Data tab.-You can see the Bank Account ID is XYZ. (XYZ represents the Bank Account ID)-Then go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Choose the My Banks subview.-Choose the related bank, and then click Edit Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account XYZ and then go to the Account tab.-You can see the Currency of the Bank Account is not the same in the payment proposal.-Cause-When you select Prioritize Bank Accounts and Payment Methods in the fine-tune activity Global Settings for Payment,  you can see that for the Payment Method 'International Bank Transfer' only bank account XYZ is maintained.-As this bank account is set as the highest priority  it is proposed whenever an international bank transfer transaction happens.-Resolution-In order to have the correct Bank Account selected by the system the prioritization has to be changed for Bank Account XYZ.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Select the My Banks subview.-Select the related bank, and choose Edit Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account XYZ, and then choose Alternative Currency tab.-To allow transactions to be processed in a currency other than the main bank account currency, specify that currency here.-Note:  If you do not specify any alternative currencies, then all currencies are allowed for the bank account.-Maintain the alternative currency for all the other bank accounts in this bank.-Meanwhile, if you keep an agreed amount on deposit with your bank, you should enter this amount in the Minimum Amount field.-If you wish to keep an amount on deposit below a certain amount, you can enter this in the Maximum Amount field.-These are not mandatory but they are used by the Liquidity Check and influence the Bank Account selection as well.-Keywords-Bankkonto, Währung, automatische Zahlungen

Title: Per Diem Rates for Meals - Germany is Calculated Differently
Content: Symptom-You have created an Expense Report for two days and you can see that the per diem rates for meals calculated is not correct.-This applies for companies based in Germany that have trips planned within and outside Germany. The per diem rates for meals varies according to country and duration of trip.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and expense work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Search and select the Expense Report ABC (ABC is the ID of the Expense report).-Click Edit, then View All.-In expense report ABC, under Reimbursement and Expense Summary:-Meals per Diem is equal to 62,00EUR (for example for country Switzerland).-Start date of trip is DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM and end date is DD+1.MM.YYYY HH:MM.-The Per diem rates for meals for Germany is statutory (standard rates provided by SAP and according to German Law) and can be found in the Business configuration work center.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search and select the Activity: Per Diem Rates for Meals - Germany and click open.-Under Per diem rates for meals, click on the Edit per diem rates for meals link.-Navigate to the Statutory Rates tab under Available Per Diem Rates for Meals.-In country version DE01 - German settlement:-For example, for country Switzerland, for Duration 5- Upto 24hours, the applicable per diem rates for FIRST - First day is 41,00EUR, LAST - Last day is 41,00EUR and OTHER - All days (except for the first/last day) is 62,00EUR.-This is currently valid from 01.01.2016 and is valid till unlimited.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-For business trips which start on day one and end on day two, we have to differentiate between two scenarios:-The business trip which starts on day one and ends on day two with Lodging. In this case the allowances are as follows: the journey start day = 12,00€, journey end day = 12,00€ and in between days = 24,00€ (these are the per diem rates for meals for trips within Germany for Duration 5- Upto 24hours.).-The business trip which starts on day one and ends on day two without lodging. In this case the absence time of two days are calculated together. After the calculation of the absence, if there is more than 8 hours, a rate of  12,00 € is considered (Handbuch Reisekostenrecht 2017; Kapitel 3.1.1.2; Seite 55)-Per diem rate for meal of an amount  24 ,00 € is only considered if the whole activity was performed over night or the activity on corresponding calendar date takes 24 hours (please refer to http://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Content/DE/Downloads/BMF_Schreiben/Steuerarten/Lohnsteuer/2014-10-24-ergaenztes-bmf-schreiben-reform-steuerliches-reisekostenrecht.html PDF: Ergänztes BMF-Schreiben zur Reform des steuerlichen Reisekostenrechts ab 1.1.2014, Seite 25).-Please note that the rates mentioned here are the rates for trips within Germany. But the scenario can also be applied in cases for Foreign trips rates (41,00 € and 62,00€, example Switzerland).-As in here the mentioned trip for business without lodging (Scenario 2) and the calculated Absence is more than 24 hours, the rates considered/ derived is 62,00€.-The system is set up as follows:-The system can recognize a Lodging with an activated Lodging- rate or a created hotel bill/ receipt.-The much more unexpected case, where a lodging exists but no activation of lodging -rate or hotel receipt is available, the creation of a hotel bill with 0,00 € is required.-Resolution-As mentioned before, for the much more unexpected case, where a lodging exists but no activation of lodging -rate or hotel receipt is available, the creation of a hotel bill with 0,00 € is required.-Go to the Travel and expense work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Search and select the expense report ABC.-Click Edit, then View All.-In expense report ABC,  under Reimbursement and Expense Summary:-Meals per Diem is equal to 62,00EUR.-Start date of trip is DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM and end date is DD+1.MM.YYYY HH:MM.-Navigate to the Expenses tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-Select the Expense Type as Hotel from the drop down menu and enter Expense Amount as 0,00 €.-Click Save.-Click the Simulate button to simulate a journal entry.-In the simulated journal entry, you can see the correct Per Diem Rates for Meals.-Keywords-Two-day Business Trip; Meals per Diems; Breakfast not deducted; Outstanding Reimbursement amount; Spesenabrechnung; Verpflegungspauschal

Title: Error Message: 'Action CLOSE not Possible; Action is Disabled' While Setting the Campaign to Finished
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set the status of a Campaign to Finished, but you are getting the below error:-'Action CLOSE not possible; action is disabled'-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Sales Campaign work center.-2. Select the Campaigns view.-3. Select any Campaign.-4. Click the gear wheel icon and set it as Finished.-Cause-The cause for this issue is that the Campaign is Active but not Scheduled and was never executed.-Resolution-To mark the Campaign as Finished is possible only for executed Campaigns. You should revoke the activation and execute the Campaign again to get a Finished Campaign.-Keywords-campaign, finish, delete

Title: How to Generate Runtime Object and Conversion Rules
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Use Only-When opening the migration tool, you experience a 500 SAP Internal Server Error, for instance:-ERROR: Exception condition "IMPORTING_PARA_MISSING" raised. (termination: RABAX_STATE)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview activity.-Select the Activity for the relevant Migration Object.-Choose the link to migrate the object using the Migration Tool.-Now or in a later step the error occurs.-Cause-A Regeneration of Runtime Objects or Conversion Rules may be required.-Resolution-How to Generate Runtime Object:-Log into Backend.-Use the T-code MWB_SRVC_CENTER.-Select Project as SAP_A1S and select the respective Migration Object.-Choose Generate Runtime Object () icon.-Select Target Structure.-Wait until successful completion.-How to Generate Conversion Rules:-Log into Backend.-Use the T-code MWB_SRVC_CENTER.-Select Project as SAP_A1S and select the respective Migration Object.-Select Target Structure.-Choose Edit.-Choose Conversion Rules icon.-After completion, choose Edit again.-Select Target Structure for the Migration Object.-Choose Generate Runtime Object icon.-Wait until successful completion.-In case the error remains after the generation of the Runtime Objects, try to generate Conversion Rules.-In case both actions don't eliminate the error, a cleanup report may be required.-Keywords-RTO; regenerate;

Title: Only One Standard Working Time Is Being Assigned Correctly During Hire Process
Content: Symptom-You have created two or more Standard Working Times in the relevant Business Configuration activity, mapped them to the relevant Work Agreements and assigned them to a Company. However, when doing the hiring of a new employee, only one of theses Standard Working Times is being defined correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1711 or later.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration > Regular Tasks.-Select the relevant country and then click Hire Employee.-Enter the basic Personal Data for the employee and click Next.-On the next screen, input all information (including the Company and a Work Agreement that is assigned to the desired Standard Working Time).-For one of the Work Agreements maintained, the Standard Working Time is correctly defined by the system — for the other(s), system won't assign anything.-Cause-One of the reasons for this is that you created two different sets of Working Times in the Business Configuration activity and assigned them both to the relevant Company.-Resolution-Ideally, only one set of Working Time should be assigned per Company. To correct this:-Go to Business Configuration > Overview.-Search for the Working Time activity.-Open the option to Assing Working Times to Companies.-Delete one of the sets assigned to the Company, then click Save and Close.-Now, open Maintain Standard Working Times.-Delete the set which was unassigned from the company.-Select the remaining set and click Add Row to add the additional Work Agreements to this set.-Once done, click Save and Close.

Title: Tax Exemption Code of Product For Specific Region Not Considered In Sales Document
Content: Symptom-You have maintained tax exemption reason 5 - Tax Exempt According to §4, 8 - 28 UStG for a specific region in the master data of a product, e.g. service XYZ (XYZ represents the service ID). Therefore you expect that when selecting service XYZ in sales documents, such as Sales Quotes or Sales Orders, the tax code 510 - Exempt According to §4, 8 - 28 UStG shall be applied automatically.-Instead, the standard tax rate was determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To maintain the Tax Eemption reason:-In the Product and Service Portfolio workcenter navigate to the Services view and find service XYZ.-Press Edit and then View All.-Navigate to the Taxes tab.-Press Add Row.-Maintain the Country, e.g. Germany.-Maintain region ABC (ABC represents the region name) in the Region column.-Maintan Tax Type 1-Value Added Tax and Tax Rate Type 3-Zero.-Finally, enter the Tax Exemption Reason 5 - Tax Exempt According to §4, 8 - 28 UStG.-Press Save, then Close.-Now create a sales document, e.g. a New Sales Quote:-In the New Business workcenter go to the Common Tasks and select New Sales Quote.-Select account DEF (DEF represents the Account ID) and enter all the mandatory data.-In the Items tab select service XYZ.-Open the Taxes sub-tab.-You notice that the standard tax rate has been determined instead of the tax exemption rate.-Cause-You have specified region ABC for the tax exemption reason. In the case the system checks the addresses of all the involved parties. If there is a deviation where region ABC is not maintained then the system automatically selects the standard tax rate.-If, for example, the State GHI (GHI represents the state name) is not maintained in the Main Address of account DEF then the system will determine the standard tax rate.-Resolution-In the sales document, here the sales quote, navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Highlight the Account row.-In the Party Details sub-tab check if the State GHI is maintained in the Address section.-Then highlight the Seller row and also check the State here.-If the region ABC is missing for any of them you need to add them in order to have the tax exemption reason and therefore the respective tax code applied in the sales document.-Keywords-Tax exemption code not derived in Sales Document, tax exemtion code wrong

Title: Single Sign On Html5
Content: Symptom-You are using an ADFS ( Active Directory Federation Service) and modified the URL into the html5 URL. While you are using the SSO URL the System opens in Silverlight.-Environment-Business byDesign-Cloud for Customer-Cause-As long as the Client is not changed from Silverlight to HTML5 the system will use Silverlight as default UI (User Interface).-Resolution-Go to the Key user settings.-Open the Company Settings.-Select Client and change the preferred Client to Html5.-Now using the SSO Url ie. https://myXXXXX-sso.sapbydesign.com will open the system in the desired html5 UI-Keywords-SSO, Single sign on.

Title: Automatic Clearing of Source Document Failed for Invoice Reversal
Content: Symptom-You have posted customer/ supplier invoice XYZ with posting date DD.MM.YYYY. You cleared this invoice with a posting date after the posting date of the invoice.-Later you need to reverse the customer/ supplier invoice. Therefore you first cancel the clearing with a posting date after the posting date of the invoice as well as the original clearing (DD+X.MM+X.YYYY).-You then reverse the customer/ supplier invoice:-The cancelation invoice ABC is not getting posted but appears as unposted source document in the General Ledger workcenter reporting the following error: Automatic clearing of source document with posting date DD.MM.YYYY failed. Customer Invoice XYZ to be cleared has postings assigned with posting date DD+X.MM+X.YYYY. Create a new manual clearing containing only XYZ and save the clearing. Then post the source document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger navigate to the Closing Cockpit view and here to the Source Documents sub-view.-Automatically the Unposted Source Documents are shown.-You find the cancellation invoice ABC here stating the above error message.-Cause-In certain cases an invoice cancelation is being created as a separate open item. This is the case when a follow-on document, such as a clearing and its cancelation, is posted after the posting date of the cleared invoice.-When a cancelation invoice is created as open item the system automatically tries to clear the cancelation document with the original document with a posting date greater than the posting date of the two involved documents (the invoice XYZ and the cancelation ABC). However; as there exist postings related to the original invoice that are even greater than the automatically chosen date this error message is being triggered.-Resolution-To be able to post the cancellation invoice ABC you need to block the automatic clearing attempt by creating a manual clearing, only for the original customer invoice XYZ, without actually clearing it:-1. In the Receivables/Payables workcenter navigate to the Customer/Supplier Accounts view.-2. Find the respective account and press view to open the Trade Receivables/Payables - Invoices/Payments tab.-3. Select the customer/supplier invoice XYZ and press Clear Manually.-4. Now press Save (Do not really clear the invoice).-Post the Cancelation:-5. After this navigate to the General Ledger workcenter and here to the Source Documents view.-6. Highlight the business transaction of the cancelation invoice ABC and press Actions - Post Business Transaction.-Clear the invoice and its cancelation:-7. The posting should now be generated and the cancelation invoice ABC will then appear as open item in the Trade Receivables/Payables  list of the customer/supplier monitor.-8. You can now clear the original invoice with the cancelation invoice manually.-Keywords-Clearing, Unposted Source Document, Customer Invoice, Cancel, Reverse, Cancelation Invoice

Title: Exception in Chart of Accounts
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to maintain the Description for the Chart of Accounts in Business Configuration. But system throws the below exception while saving the Description.-Unexpected error during backend processing-Reproducing the Issue-Import using Microsoft Excel file:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-For the relevant project, select Open Activity List-In tab Fine-Tune, open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Open activity Edit chart of accounts-Select Add Row and provide the Chart of Accounts XYZ-Select Import from Microsoft Excel-On the Import Chart of Accounts from File screen, select Download Template-Fill the required details and Save the file-Browse for the Import File for Chart of Accounts-Select Import-Select Save-System throws an exception-  Update manually using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-For the relevant project, select Open Activity List-In tab Fine-Tune, open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Open activity Edit chart of accounts-Select Add Row and provide the Chart of Accounts XYZ-Select Translate-Choose the Source Language and Target Language from the respective drop-down-Select any structure and maintain the Target Language for the Description-Choose OK-Select Save-System throws an exception-Cause-The data type used for Description field allows only 80 characters in length. But the Account Description which you provided is longer than 80 characters.-Resolution-Adjust the length of Account Description within 80 characters.-Keywords-Account Description, Editing Chart of Accounts, Edit Chart of Accounts

Title: Migration Activity of Location and Logistics Area is Missing
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find activity for Location and Logistics Area.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-2. Select Implementation Project view-3. Open the Activity List.-4. The activity Location and Logistics Area is not available.- Cause-The migration activity of Location and Logistics Area is not scoped.-Resolution-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-2. Select Implementation Projects view  -3. Select the Edit Project Scope button.-4. Navigate to the fourth stage Questions.-5. Search navigate the below scoping element & select the checkbox Migration of Location and Logistics Area.-Business option-> Built-in Services and Support-> Business Configuration-> Data Migration-Note:-If the option to select the checkbox for Migration of Location and Logistics Area is greyed out, this is due to a dependency.-The Migration of Location and Logistics Area business option relies/dependent on the business option Distribution Networks to be selected.--Search  Supply Chain Setup Management, in the right pane and select the below question:-Supply Chain Design - Supply Chain Network question: Do you define some regional distribution networks including multiple transport zones?-Once this question is checked the Migration of Location and Logistics Area option will be automatically selected.-Keywords-migration of locations,loctaion * logistic * migration

Title: How to Check for the Corresponding Productive System on SPC
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In this KBA you will find out how to find the corresponding Productive system of a test tenant on SPC.-This is useful for scenarios during the System's Upgrade Period, where customer only have a test tenant and would like to request the productive tenant.-To request the productive tenant, the test and productive systems must be on the same release level.-You as a support engineer can check in which system the productive tenant will be created on, and then look up on the Display Upgrade Planning: https://spc-emea.ondemand.com/sap/bc/webdynpro/a1sspc/upg_plan_all?sap-wd-client=002&sap-language=EN-Resolution-Please follow the steps below:-Open the ﻿SPC (Service Provider Cockpit) - https://spc40-emea.byd.sap.corp-Select Cloud Landscape and Systems-  Search for the Test system SID (In the example: LHO)-  Go to the Miscellaneous tab and look for the Extension "IS_TEST_SYSTEM_FOR_PROD_SYSTEM" and copy the value-  Search for the value and you will find the Productive SID (In the example: K7T)-This means when the customer request a new productive tenant it will be created on system K7T.-Keywords-test, tenant, system, to, productive, corresponding, upgrade

Title: Available Migration Mode for Service Quote in Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You have only Add New Records mode in Migration tool of Service Quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project.-Click Open Activity List.-Find Migration of Service Quote.-Upload Migration file, and find you have only Add New Records migration mode. You cannot use migration tool to perform mass change for existing service quotes.-Cause-This is normal system behavior, currently data migration tool only support initial load for Service Quote.-Resolution-You could only have Add New Records migration mode in data migration tool for service quote.-The options for your mass data update to service quotes use case are A2X service, Odata service and report.-Keywords-Sales Quote-Service Quote-Migration mode-sales quote,service quote,enhance,migration mode

Title: Unable to Migrate Open Items Payables
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are receiving the following error messages when try to migrate the Open Items Payables:-'Errors detected during import simulation'.-'Import Simulation (x Errors Found, x Warnings Found)'.-'Error detected in source record with key value 'Y, ABCDXY'.-'Company ABC not registered in country DEF; define relevant tax number.'. (ABC and DEF represents the Company ID and Country)-'Account determination group missing for Supplier XYZ and company ABC'. (XYZ represents the Supplier ID)-You do not understand why the mentioned messages are being triggered, since you checked and the Tax Number is maintained accordingly and the Master Data of the company ABC is complete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select the View Implementation Project.-Open the Activity List.-Show All Activities.-Open the Activity Migrate of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select the respective Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration button.-Check the message Log, and you can see the error messages:-'Errors detected during import simulation'.-'Import Simulation (x Errors Found, x Warnings Found)'.-'Error detected in source record with key value 'Y, ABCDXY'.-'Company AB not registered in country DEF; define relevant tax number.'.-'Account determination group missing for supplier XYZ and company ABC'.-Cause-Most of those error messages, are generic messages, the ones which will help you find the resolution is the one regarding the Account Determination Group and the one about Tax Number.-The Tax Number is maintained, however the message is being displayed due the Valid From date of this Tax Number. If you compare the Valid From date of the Tax Number in the system and the Document dates in the Excel, you can see that the Tax Number Valid From is after the Document Date. Hence, when system check the validity of it, it cannot find a Tax Number valid on that date.-I.e. Tax Number Valid From date is 01/01/2018 and Document Date is 10/11/2017.-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Select the Company Arrangements view.-Search for the Company ABC.-Open the Tax Authority.-Select the Company ABC.-Go to Tax Numbers view. Here, you can see the Tax Number, and the date of the same.-Resolution-You need to change the Tax Number Valid From date so that the error does not occur.-See Also-Check the Case Document 1989231 - Migration Error: "Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ, for the error message regarding Account Determination Group.-Keywords-Migration Tool, Migration of Accounting, Migration of Open Items Payables, Tax Number, Tax Date, Account Determination Group.

Title: Quantity for Stock Transfer Order Still in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You have the product ABC which does not have Identified Stock in Planning Area YYY and it has Identified Stock in Planning Area XXX. You created a Stock Transfer Order for this Product from YYY to XXX. Although all the scenario is finished, now the incoming and outgoing quantity is still being shown in the Stock Overview.-ABC = Product ID-XXX = Planning Area ID-YYY = Planning Area ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Stock Overview common task.-Fill the Product ID ABC.-Click Go.-Notice that the incoming quantity in XXX and the outgoing quantity in YYY is still being shown.-Cause-In this case, the system will not take the quantity off from the Stock Overview automatically.-Resolution-To solve the issue, you need to manually perform an Inventory Adjustment to clear the quantities from Stock Overview. You should follow the steps:-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Select New Inventory Adjustment common task.-Search for the quantity related to the Stock Transfer Order.-Select Next.-Enter the Product Actual Quantity and the Identified Stock.-Select Next.-Click Finish.-Keywords-STO

Title: How to Cancel a Subscription Bought in the SAP Store
Content: Symptom-You bought a subscription for a SAP system via the SAP Store and you request to cancel the subscription and stop being charged for it.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. Log in to https://www.sapstore.com/.-2. In the top right-hand corner of the page, click on your name and click on My Account.-3. Click on the Subscriptions link on the left-hand side of the page.-4.
