Title: Same Fixed Asset with different Depreciation Method for Different Set of Books
Content: Symptom-You have created a Fixed Asset ABC (ABC is the ID of the Fixed Asset). The Fixed Asset ABC is to be valuated according to two Set of Books XYZ (XYZ stands for Set of Books 1) and KLM (KLM stands for Set of Books 2).-You see that for Set of Books XYZ, the Useful Life Years/Periods is NNN years/periods (N stands for any number of years or periods) and the Depreciation Method is NXXX (NXXX stands for the Depreciation Method).-But for Set of Books KLM, the Useful Life Years/Periods is MMM years/periods (M stands for any number of years or periods) and the Depreciation Method is MXXX (MXXX stands for the Depreciation Method).-You want the same Depreciation Method for both the Set of Books.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work centre.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search and select Fixed Asset ABC.-Navigate to the Basic Data sub tab in the Master Data tab.-The Fixed Asset Class is maintained as ZZZZ (ZZZZ represents the Fixed Asset Class).-Navigate to the Asset Valuation sub tab in the Master Data tab.-You see that for Set of Books XYZ, the Useful Life Years/Periods is NNN years/periods  and the Depreciation Method is NXXX.-But for Set of Books KLM, the Useful Life Years/Periods is MMM years/periods and the Depreciation Method is MXXX.-Resolution-The system first determines whether the mentioned asset is a low value asset or not.-Once this is determined the system checks the valuation view of the Set of Books to find out the default depreciation method for the fixed asset.-This can be checked in the Business Configuration either via the Activity Fixed Asset Classes or via the Activity Fixed Assets Valuation View.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Overview View.-Search and select the Activity Fixed Asset Classes.-Click View/ Change Immediately.-Click on the Edit fixed asset classes link.-Search and select Asset Class ZZZZ.-Under Details, navigate to the Default Valuation Settings.-Search and select Valuation View for Set of Books XYZ.-The Depreciation Method is maintained as NXXX with Default Useful Life in Fiscal Years as NNN.-Search and select Valuation View for Set of Books KLM.-The Depreciation Method is maintained as MXXX with Default Useful Life in Fiscal Years as MMM.-You will need to maintain the correct depreciation method here.-It would also be necessary to check the Activity Fixed Assets Valuation View especially if the Fixed Asset is a Low value asset and the above mentioned check shows the same depreciation method maintained for both Set of Books.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Overview View.-Search and select the Activity Fixed Assets Valuation View.-Click View/ Change Immediately.-Search and select the Valuation View for Set of Books XYZ.-Under Details check the Default Depreciation Method for Low-Value Assets.-The Depreciation Method is maintained as NXXX with Default Useful Life in Fiscal Years as NNN.-Search and select Valuation View for Set of Books KLM.-Under Details check the Default Depreciation Method for Low-Value Assets.-The Depreciation Method is maintained as MXXX with Default Useful Life in Fiscal Years as MMM.-You will need to maintain the correct depreciation method here also.-Keywords-Anlage; Abschreibungsmethode

Title: HTTP Response Code:403 An Exception Occured.Upload In Process
Content: Symptom-You receive an error while opening a New Solution.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Application Studio.-Try to Open newly created Solution.-Error appears.-Protocal excpetion (CLIENT) : JSON communication error. HTTP response code : 403 An exception occured.-Upload in Process-Cause-In process of creating a new Solution, if the connectivity of the Cloud Applicaton Repository is lost, then this error may occur.-Resolution-The created the solution is corrupted, so you have to delete this solution.-Login to Cloud Application Studio.-Right click and delete the solution, which is corrupted.-Click on new and Create a new Solution again.

Title: Unassigned Task Overdue: Complete Time Data (Hire) Created in the Business Task Management for HR Administrator
Content: Symptom-You want to know, why system created unassigned task Overdue: Complete Time Data (Hire) in the Application and User Management work center.-Cause-The HR Administrator does not have access rights to work center view HCM_TIMREGULARTASKS and hence the task was unassigned.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the User and Access Management view-Select the relevant Business User-Navigate to the tab Work Center and View Assignment-Assign the work center view HCM_TIMREGULARTASKS-Save and Close-The Overdue: Complete Time Data (Hire) is an escalation task informing a user that time data for a hired employee was not entered within the set time period. The original task Complete Time Data (Hire), which appeared in the work list of the Time Administration work center, still needs to be processed. The system automatically triggers this escalation task after a (configured) deadline has passed. The task is sent to the HR administrator who performed the hire in the Personnel Administration work center. This HR Administrator triggered the hire and is considered to be responsible for the overall process. The HR administrator receives the escalation task in the Work view of the Home work center.-As the person responsible for the hire of the employee concerned, you should ensure that the time data is completed. Depending on your task distribution you can either complete the escalated task Complete Time Data (Hire) in the Time Administration work center or you contact the HR time administrator responsible for this task.-The escalation task Overdue: Complete Time Data (Hire) will be completed and removed from the work list automatically once the original task is completed. Alternatively, the user can manually set the escalation task to completed or canceled. If you choose not to respond, both tasks remain in the following locations:-•Original task: Time Administrator’s work list in Time Administration work center.-•Escalation task: Your work list in the Home work center.

Title: In the Sales Kits it is not Possible to add an Item of Type Service
Content: Symptom-In the Sales Kits it is not possible to add an item of type service.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-From the Common Tasks, select the New Sales Kit.-In the New Sales Kits screen enter the mandatory details in the General tab and the Sales tab and click on the Save button.-Click on the button View or Create Item List.-In the Sales Kit Item List screen, under the section Items click on the Add Row button.-Click on the Product ID value help.-Here you only have option to add only Material, not an item of type as Services.-Cause-Sales Kits only support materials and not services.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: How To Create Previous Fiscal Year
Content: Symptom-The goal is to create a fiscal year for the previous year; however, the system defaults the fiscal year to the Current Year instead of the Previous one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Set of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select the row with company and Set of Books combination.-Click on Edit Fiscal Year.-Click on New Fiscal Year.-Notice that the system enters the Current Fiscal Year.-Cause-By default, the system suggests either the current year or the next following future year when creating a new fiscal year. The Fiscal Year is, however, editable.-Resolution-Before changing the Fiscal Year to a previous Fiscal Year, it must be confirmed that the company’s validity starts in this, previous year.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies.-Select the row.-Click on Edit Fiscal Year.-Click on New Fiscal Year.-By default, the System creates a Fiscal Year for the Current year.-Notice that the Fiscal Year field is editable.-Change the value to the Fiscal Year that is desired to be created.-Press enter and wait for the screen to refresh.-Click on Save.-Keywords-new fiscal year; previous fiscal year; current fiscal year; FY

Title: How to enable monitoring of HANA 2.0 according to Note 2403493 in Solution Manager 7.2 system
Content: Symptom-You want to follow the solution in Note 2403493 to enable the monitoring for HANA 2.0, however you are not sure about the detailed steps.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Cause-The steps in Note 2403493 are only valid for Solution Manager 7.1 system, while it is a little bit different to do this in Solution Manager 7.2 system.-Resolution-Please follow steps in the attachment in this KBA to enable the monitoring of HANA 2.0 in your Solution Manager 7.2 system.-See Also-2403493 - Solution Manager: Enabling the Monitoring of HANA 2.0-Keywords-monitoring of HANA 2.0

Title: G/L Account Balance Varies in General Ledger Accounts and Tax Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-The amount of G/L Account Service Input Tax Deferred differs in General Ledger Accounts view and Tax - Trial Balance report (Report ID FINTAXU03_Q0001).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In order to check the Balance amount of the G/L Account Service Input Tax Deferred in General Ledger work Center, follow the below steps:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to General Ledger Accounts View.-Search With All Accounts.-Choose Advance Search.-Enter General Ledger Account, Corresponding Company ID, Set of Books, Period, Fiscal Year.-Observe that the G/L Account balance for G/L Account Service Input Tax Deferred is XXX.-In order to check the Balance amount of the G/L Account Service Input Tax Deferred in Tax - Trial Balance report, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Analytics work Center.-Go to Design Reports View.-Open the Tax - Trial Balance report (Report ID FINTAXU03_Q0001).-Enter corresponding Company ID, Set of Books, Accounting Period and G/L Account.-Run the report.-Observe that the G/L Account balance for G/L Account Service Input Tax Deferred in Trial balance is YYY.-Cause-Most likely Balance Carry Forward has not been done for previous Fiscal year and hence the G/L Account balances are not similar.-If Balance Carry Forward has been done, the Journal Entry type and Sub ledger Account Line Item type for the Journal entries corresponding to the GL Account can be checked.-Resolution-Follow the below two options to resolve the issue:-1. Balance Carry Forward for previous Fiscal year has not been done. Run the Balance Carry Forward for the previous year and run the report again.-2. In case Balance Carry Forward run has been done and differences in GL Account Balances are still observed, check the Journal Entry Type and Sub Ledger Account Line Item Type for the journal entries corresponding to the G/L Account through the following steps:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Reports view.-Go to List Sub view.-Search with G/L Accounts-Line items.-Here for the G/L Account XYZ, add the following characteristics: Sub Ledger Account Line item Type: Manual Entered Account and Journal Entry Type is Data Migration.-Any manual posting tax entries directly in the General Ledger work center/ Data Migration entries entered will not be recognized by the tax register hence a difference in the Tax - Trial Balance report is seen. It's needed to manually add the tax items posted in the general ledger and data migration into the return forms for submission to the tax authority.-Keywords-G/L Account Service Input Tax Deferred; Tax - Trial Balance report; FINTAXU03_Q0001; Balance Carry Forward; bcf; General Ledger Accounts

Title: Unable to Upload Accounts From Microsoft Excel Due to Potential Duplicates
Content: Symptom-Unable to upload accounts from Microsoft Excel due to potential duplicates.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Account Management work center.-2. Go to the Accounts view.-3. Select the New button and select the Corporate Accounts From Microsoft Excel option. -4. Enter the Account Name similar to the name of existing ones.-5. Select the button Save Data To in the SAP Business ByDesign tab.-You the following error message occurs and the accounts are not uploaded: Potential Duplicates Found.-Cause-When attempting to upload new accounts via the excel template the duplicate check is more sensitive compare to the information which is entered manually.-Resolution-You have 2 possibilities to solve the issue if the data should be really uploaded via excel:-First Possibility:-You can deactivate the duplication check manually for specific business partners in the Microsoft Excel Template as follows:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select the New button select the Corporate Accounts From Microsoft Excel option.-In the Microsoft Excel Template select the respective account.-Navigate to the column Duplicate Check Indicator.-Select the No option.-In the SAP Business ByDesign tab select the button Save Data To.--Second Possibility:-If you are sure that all the accounts in the excel are not duplicates, deactivate the duplicate check in Business Configuration, upload the data and activate it again afterwards.-Please follow the below steps to do the changes:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view and click on the button View Project Scope.-Go to the chevron Questions.-Select the scoping element General Business Data -> Business Partners -> Handling of Business Partners.-Under question section expand the option Duplicate Check for Business Partners.-Select Yes for the option Do you want to disable the duplicate check for business partners?-The error message does not occur and you are able to upload the account to your system.

Title: Posting not allowed due to mismatch in Seller or Company of Return and Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-On a customer return, due to several circumstances, (e.g. org changes, higher management decisions) the sales unit and the seller has to be changed on Customer Return which is different from parent Sales Order.-In this case, in financials, it’s not possible to post the warehouse confirmations considering this discrepancy.- Reproducing the Issue-Create a Sales Order with Sales Unit A and Seller B.-Create a Return with reference to Sales Order and then change the Sales Unit to A' and Seller to B'.- Cause-Organizational Changes and higher management decisions.-In financials, it’s not possible to post the warehouse confirmations since the return and sales order's Company/Seller differs.-Resolution-Hence, the only solution then would be the following:-Please request customer to cancel the return with different Sales Unit and Seller. Then create a new Return without having reference to the parent Sales Order. Specify the Return to be from external source.-Then in this new return use the desired Seller and Sales Unit. Financials then would not validate the return's Seller and Sales Unit data with the parent Sales Order.-And customer would then be able to return the product/service.

Title: Removing the currency sign from Amount Company Currency value within financial reports
Content: Symptom-You want to know if it is possible to show the Amount Company Currency key figure, within financial reports, without the currency sign.-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the General Ledger work center and then choose Reports List view.-Open the report Financial Statements.-Select the mandatory fields and click go.-Make sure the Amount Company Currency key figure is visible on the report.-You will see that the column Amount Company Currency is showing the currency along with the amount value, for example 123 USD.-You want to know if the currency (USD) can be hidden.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The system behavior is as designed and unfortunately such behavior cannot be changed to fulfill your request.--In fact, neither for standard or custom report/data sources possible to create key figures without company currency sign. The reason is that the key figures (for example, Amount Company Currency) currency is being displayed at run-time hence the Amount currency key figure cannot be displayed without a currency sign in the reports.

Title: Functionality Foreign Input Tax Deduction is not Available in SAP ByDesign and CfTE
Content: Symptom-You have the following setup in your system:--The company has its main residence in country A (e.g. Germany).-Employee  ABC ( ABC stands for the employee ID) belongs to a subsidiary in country B  (e.g.Belgium).-The main company is registered with a tax authority in country A.-The subsidiary is registered with a tax authority in country B.-Employee ABC from country B travels to country A and gets an invoice with the advance tax refund.-You have the following expectations:-Because the main company is located in Germany you expect that the tax country for these expenses is Germany and the available Tax-code is Domestic purchase of goods, standard rate, fully deductible.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses Workcenter.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view.-Create a New Expense Report on Behalf of employee ABC.-On step 2, maintain the expense type for XYZ (XYZ stands for any Expense Type).-You can see that the country which is selected is country B.-You want to change the country from country B to country A but, the only available tax-code is:  Imported goods (supplier invoice).-Cause-The desired functionality (foreign input tax deduction) is not supported in Business ByDesign and Cloud for Travel and Expense.-The employee ABC is assigned to a subsidiary in Country B and therefore a trip to Country A is considered as a journey abroad.-Resolution-As a workaround you can post the invoice without tax deduction and then manually submit the input tax deduction as a voucher.-The Expense Reports - Input VAT Refund report is available for determining the associated documents.

Title: List for Countries Embrace Postal Code as Essential field in Account Management
Content: Symptom-You want to know list for countries embrace Postal Code as essential field in Account Management work center. Since you find for some account Postal Code is essential,but for some it is not.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the the Accounts view.-Search for the XYZ (XYZ represents the name of the account).-Click the Edit button and select the General tab as defaulted.-You find for this account Postal Code is not mandatory field. But for some account,this field is mandatory.-Cause-The maintenance of the postal code depends on the country. Some countries don't have a postal code or the postal code is rarely used, however in some countries the postal code is required/mandatory part of the postal address.-Resolution-Please find the following list with countries that need postal code for essential.-Andorra-Armenia-Argentina-Samoa, America-Austria-Australia-Azerbaijan-Bosnia-Herz.-Barbados-Belgium-Bulgaria-Bahrain-Bermuda-Brunei Daruss.-Brazil-Belarus-Canada-Switzerland-Costa Rica-Cape Verde-Curaçao-Czech Republic-Germany-Denmark-Dominican Rep.-Algeria-Ecuador-Estonia-Egypt-Spain-Finland-Falkland Islnds-Faroe Islands-France-United Kingdom-Georgia-French Guayana-Greenland-Guadeloupe-Greece-Guatemala-Guam-Guinea-Bissau-Honduras-Croatia-Hungary-Indonesia-Israel-India-Iraq-Iran-Iceland-Italy-Japan-Kyrgyzstan-Cambodia-South Korea-Kuwait-Cayman Islands-Kazakhstan-Laos-Lebanon-Liechtenstein-Sri Lanka-Liberia-Lithuania-Luxembourg-Latvia-Morocco-Monaco-Moldova-Madagascar-Marshall Islnds-Macedonia-Burma-Mongolia-N.Mariana Islnd-Martinique-Malta-Maldives-Malaysia-Mozambique-New Caledonia-Nigeria-Netherlands-Norway-Nepal-Frenc.Polynesia-Pap. Title: Report on the Employee Change Details
Content: Symptom-You want to report on the information available from Employee Change Details.-Reproducing the Issue-Personnel Administration work center then select the Employee view.-Edit any employee then go to Changes tab.-Enter the desired criteria and click Go.-Under the Details section the Changes Details are shown and you would like to report on that.-Resolution-With the current standard functionalities it is not possible to report on the employee change details. The only way to see the employee changes, made in the system, is using the Change tab from the Personnel Administration then Employee View.

Title: The Cost on Customer Invoice and Sales Order Does not Match With the Cost Maintained in the General Ledger
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order and the related Customer Invoice, you note the Cost on sales Order and in Customer Invoice is not matching with the Cost showed in the General Ledger for the same Sales Order. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC-Edit the invoice ABC.-Go to the Pricing tab.-Under Item Pricing choose Expand All.-You find the pricing component Cost for this Invoice is EDF,however if you go to relevant account in General Ledger Work Center, the Cost shows as GHI which does not match with the Cost on invoice.-ABC represents ID of the Customer Invoice.-EDF represents amount of the Cost.-GHI represents amount of the Cost in General Ledger.-Cause-The Cost that is shown on the Sales Order and the Invoice is always the average cost of all Business Residence that are maintained for the Material.  The amount on the invoice is the average Cost for all items which is correct.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Downloading the Segregation of Duty Conflicts information
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to bypass the limitation of 60 characters in Business Analytics reports and to download the complete Segregation of Duty Conflicts information.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Search for the report Segregation Of Duty Conflicts.-Click on Go.-Find that the data shown in the rows: SOD Conflict Reason and SOD Conflict Resolution are incomplete. -Resolution-You can either extend the number of shown characters to 1024 (see below), or alternatively, end users can download the Segregation of Duty Conflicts information directly from the UI and need not necessarily obtain the same information from the Segregation of Duty Conflicts report.-The following is the path to download the information from the UI:-Go to the Business Users View present in the Application and User Management Work Center.-Click on the View SOD Conflicts.-If you want to view all the SOD conflicts irrespective of the user then click on Go.-Or if you want to view the SOD conflicts for a specific user then click on Advanced option and then filter by User.-Now use the Export option to download the SOD data To Microsoft Excel.-Refer the attached word document to find screenshots showing the steps to download SOD Conflicts information from the UI.-See Also-2492778 - Report Fields Restricted to 60 Characters in ByD-2490119 - Report Fields Restricted to 60 Characters in C4C

Title: Not possible to Determine the Order of Assignment of Internal IDs to Contacts
Content: Symptom-You have migrated the Customers and Contacts data successfully in the system. Upon downloading the Value Conversion of the migrated file, you see that the Target values assigned for Contacts are not in sequence. You want to understand what is the order followed while system assigns the Target values for Contacts.-Reproducing the Issue-Perform migration using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Customers-Select Migrate customers using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-Migration is successful-Download the Value Conversion file as below: -On the migration tool Show Completed Files-Select the Completed File and choose Actions->Download Value Conversion-This will download the value conversion for all the converted IDs for Customers and Contacts which have been already migrated-Save and open the exported .TRV file-You will be able to see the Source and Target values-But the Target value assigned for Contacts are not in descending or ascending sequence of Contact IDs available in the Number Range-Cause-While creating Contact, whatever next available ID exists in the Number Range, that will be used for Contact Internal ID.-Resolution-Internal ID of Contacts are picked from the Number Range maintained in the activity General Business Partners. It is not possible to control the order of assignment of internal IDs in ascending /descending order.

Title: While Exporting Members Of Target Group To Excel, Some Fields Are Missing.
Content: Symptom-You have exported the Members of a Target Group to Microsoft Excel but few fields are missing in exported file.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Marketing work center.-Select Target Groups view.-Click on any Target Group.-Under Members, select Export button and choose Microsoft Excel.-Cause-The missing fields are not set to visible in Personalize.-Resolution-In personalize section, set the missing fields to visible as stated below:-Go to Marketing work center.-Select Target Groups view.-Click on any Target Group.-Select Personalize and choose This Screen option.-Under Screen Layout, select Members section.-Under Fields check the Visible check box for the required fields.-Save the changes.

Title: Backend Error Message When Releasing The VAT Return
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when you release the VAT Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Switch to the VAT Returns view.-Show Tax Returns in Preparation, find XXX (where XXX represents the Tax Return in Preparation) and press Go.-Click Release.-After a certain period the system crashes (runs into a backend error).-Cause-This issue might occur because the amount of data in the VAT Return is too much.-You can reduce the amount of data by releasing the VAT Return monthly.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Switch to the VAT Return Runs sub-view.-Press New -> Tax Return Run.-Enter a Run Description.-Choose a Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Select From and To dates: DD.MM.YYYY so that they fall within a month.-Press Set to Active.-Press Save and Close.-The previous error message is not raised when releasing the VAT Return since the data amount has been reduced.-Keywords-vat returns, tax returns, in preparation, dump, system crash, backend error

Title: You get Error Message While Selecting the Registered Product: "Reference Product ABC: Serial Number Profile is No Serial Number Assigned"
Content: Symptom-Error message appears while selecting the registered product: Reference Product ABC: Serial Number Profile is No Serial Number Assignment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Service Entitlements work center.-Select the Registered Products view.-Select the registered product XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the registered product).-Result:-A warning message appears: "Reference Product ABC: Serial Number Profile is No Serial Number Assignment" (ABC represents the ID of the item).-Cause-The error occurs because the reference product’s Serial Number Profile is set to No Serial Number Assignment in Product Master Data.-Resolution-Navigate to the Product and service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Select the product ABC and choose the Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the General tab.-For the field Serial Number Profile you have selected No Serial Number Assignment.-Change the Serial Number Profile to any other required value and Save the changes.-Keywords-Service Entitlements; Registered Products; Reference Product; Serial Number Profile; No Serial Number Assignment; Product Master Data; Serial Number Assignment; Registered Product ID; Service Entitlement Error; Product Configuration; Serial Number

Title: Unable to Reopen Canceled Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You canceled an Expense Report and want to reopen the same Expense Report again.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work centre.-Go to the Expense Reports sub view.-Show Canceled Expense Reports and find Expense Report XXX (XXX represents the Expense Report ID).-You find no action that can reverse the cancelation.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-You have to create a new Expense Report with the same details.

Title: PDI Solution Upload Error - "The solution has no quality review. Please select another zip file. The upload to the repository failed."
Content: Symptom-When trying to upload the latest assembled version of a Multi-Customer Solution (MCS) to tenant an error is raised: "The solution has no quality review. Please select another zip file. The upload to the repository failed."-The option to 'Request Quality Review' is not available.-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Application Studio (PDI).-Log into the tenant with installation key.-Upload solution zip file.-You will get the message "The solution has no quality review. Please select another zip file. The upload to the repository failed."-Cause-Customer-specific solutions for the SAP cloud solution can be installed in a multi-tenant environment. The solution provider needs to ensure that all solutions are of the highest quality.-Quality Review is not triggered when using the "Assemble & Download" regular option to download solution zip file.-Resolution-Click on "Download for Delivery to Customer".-You should get the reviewed ZIP file.-Clicking on "Download for Delivery to Customer" will trigger SAP quality review for Multi-Customer Solution (MCS).

Title: Customer Invoice not visible on the Profit overview by key figure report
Content: Symptom-The Profit overview by key figure report is not showing a specific Customer invoice although it was successfully released.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Cost and revenue work center and choose Reports view.-2. Open the Profit overview by key figure report.-3. Select the desired values for the variable selection screen.-4. Search for the desired Invoice ID.-5. The invoice is not found.-6. When you check the invoice Document flow, from Customer Invoicing work center, you can see that there is pending task.  -Cause-The system behavior is as designed. In fact, the Profit overview by key figure report shows only invoices which have been posted to financial Accounting.-From the Invoice Document flow we can see that the invoice is released however there is a pending Business Transaction for Accounting which is stopping the invoice to be posted.-When we drill down in the task we can see the following:-Tasks Related To Business Transaction for Accounting-Task: Update Valuation data for Material Y/business residence XXX.-Un-posted Business Transactions.-In process by the XYZ team since a specific date.-Resolution-The reason why the invoice is not shown in the Profit overview by key figure report is because the invoice has not been posted to Accounting.-In this case to solve the issue the Invoice must be posted by Maintaining and activating the valuation data for the specified combination of material and business residence.-Once the above financial transaction is completed the invoice should be visible in the Profit overview by key figure report.

Title: Error Message when uploading CSV data file: Only files created in Mass Data Maintenance supported
Content: Symptom-While uploading a data file the following error message occurs: Only files created in Mass Data Maintenance supported.-Reproducing the Issue-We will use Import Customers as example.-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the Link hyperlink of the field Import Customers, found under the Update Data From Local File section.-Click the Browse button of the Source File field and select the file XYZ (XYZ represents the name of the file).-Click the Upload button.-While uploading the file XYZ, the following error message occurs: Only files created in Mass Data Maintenance supported.-Cause-Cause 1: The file XYZ was not downloaded from the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Cause 2: The format of the file XYZ was changed from one release of the system to another.-For example the file was downloaded while your system was on release 1302 and you are uploading the file now while your system is on release 1305.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-Resolution for cause 1:-You must download the file XYZ from the Mass Data Maintenance work center in order to be able to upload it in the same work center.-To download the file XYZ you can use the following steps:-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click the Link hyperlink of the field Export Customers, found under the Export Data To Local File section.-Click the Go button.-All Customers are displayed in the result list.-Click the Export Data to CSV File button.-Customers are exported to a local CSV file.-Resolution for cause 2: -You must maintain the suffix   _SAP_INTERNAL  in the first field of the header line, in the file XYZ.-To maintain the suffix you can follow the steps below:-Open the file XYZ.-Select the first field of the header line.-Enter the suffix _SAP_INTERNAL .-Save your changes.-You can now upload the file and the error message does not occur anymore.

Title: Unqualified Sales Quote Goes for Approval
Content: Symptom-The Sales Quote is sent for approval even though it does not meet the configured approval conditions of Net Value greater than 1 million or Total Discount greater than 0%.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesgin-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Navigate to the Approvals view.-Select Open Tasks.-Locate the relevant Sales Quote.-Verify that the Sales Quote is sent for approval even though it does not meet the configured approval conditions.-Cause-The approval process is triggered when at least one of the configured approval conditions is fulfilled. It is skipped only when none of the configured conditions are fulfilled.-In this case, the Sales Quote meets one of the configured approval conditions. Therefore, the system sends the Sales Quote for approval, which is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior in SAP Business ByDesign. A Sales Quote is sent for approval when at least one of the configured approval conditions is met.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Approval Process, Approval Conditions, Approval Workflow, SAP Business ByDesign

Title: You Cannot Find an Option to Apply Pricing Scales on a Cumulative Basis
Content: Symptom-You want to apply pricing scales on a cumulative basis however you are not able to find the possibility in SAP Business ByDesign system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Add the account, sales unit, employee responsible and product in the sales order.-Select the View All button.-Go to the Pricing tab.-While calculating price & scale for the order for the product , there is no possibility to consider the price of ordered quantity of same product of previous order.-Also there is no possibility to define the Cumulative Price at product & price master data.- Cause-The pricing scales functionality in Business ByDesign can only be used at individual sales documents, it is not capable of doing a cumulative calculation considering products added for the previous sales orders of the same customer.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign

Title: The Life Cycle Status Code of the Sales Arrangement is not Correct in the XML File Created During the 'Account Export Run' for Web Shop Scenario
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The life cycle status code of the Sales Arrangement is not correct in the XML file created during the Account Export Run for Web Shop scenario.-The life cycle status code for the Sales Arrangement is shown as 2 (Inactive) instead of 1 (Active).-Reproducing the Issue-Do a Account Export Run for the Web Shop scenario.-Put the XML files in the WebDav folder.-One of the XML file for the account has the status code 2 (Inactive) for the Sales Arrangement which is wrong.-Cause-The wrong/not expected lifecycle status of the Sales Arrangement in the xml is not a status of the sales organization. It is the status of the BO Sales Arrangement.-This status is completely irrelevant and it is wrong that the status is part of the xml, you should not keep this in the XML.-Resolution-You can remove the status of the Sales Arrangement from the XML as this status is irrelevant and not required to be the part of the XML.

Title: Expense Types Missing in New Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You cannot select a certain Expense Type when you create a new Expense Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Click New Expense Report on Behalf.-Enter an Employee ID.-Select Report Type = Receipts Only.-Maintain a Description.-Press Next.-Under Expenses click Add Row.-In Expense Type you cannot select the Expense type even it is maintained in Business Configuration work center.-Cause-In Business Configuration work center you have not only to maintain the Definition and Account Determination of the Expense Type but also the Expense Reimbursement Group.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find Expense Reporting - ABC where ABC is the Country.-Press Change Immediately.-Click Edit Expense Types.-Select Expense Type CDE.-Under Details make sure that not only Definition and Account Determination have Valid To Dates in the future but also the Expense Reimbursement Group.-Switch to tab Expense Reimbursement Group.-Select a Valid From date which is the same as in tab Definition and Account Determination and maintain a Valid to Date in the future.-Switch to tab Definition.-Check that the desired flags are marked, for example, flag Trip-Based is marked if you want to use expense type in business trips.-Under Group for Expense Reimbursement choose All.-Press Save and Close.-In the new Expense Report the Expense Type CDE should be selectable now.-Keywords-expense type, report type, Expense Reporting, Expense Reimbursement Group, Trip-Based

Title: Deviation Reason Field Displays Value As Not Assigned In Confirmation Journal Report
Content: Symptom-You have performed an Inventory Adjustment for a product and have updated the reason for deviation in the field Deviation Reason. However, in Confirmation Journal report the system displays Deviation Reason value as Not Assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Navigate to the Reports: List view.-Select the Confirmation Journal report link.-Enter the relevant product information to view the confirmation ID for the Inventory Adjustment performed.-You can see that under the colum Deviation Reason system displays the value as Not Assigned.-Cause-The Deviation Reason field available in Confirmation Journal report is mapped to the difference posting confirmations in logistics tasks (Inbound, Outbound and Internal) and not to count task and inventory adjustment related confirmations. This is the reason why you are not able to see the deviation reason you have maintained in inventory adjustments or count task documents.-Resolution-As a work around you can build a custom data source by the joining the Confirmation Journal data source and Physical Inventory Count business object. This custom data source will be able to display Deviation Reason maintained for count task confirmations and inventory adjsutments. The Physical Inventory Count business object is released to partners for further modifictions.

Title: Maximum Failed Password Logon Attempts
Content: Symptom-You get too many wong attempts to login in the system and password gets locked.-The specific property “Number of failed logon attempts” is fixed and is not exposed to the customers at present. It is fixed set to 5 attempts. Default setting information also is not visible to the customer at present.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the login page of the system-2) Input the password wrongly 5 times on the logon page.-3) The password gets locked.-4) Now login as Key User go to Application & User Management >Business Users view to check that user.-5) The password field will be locked.-6) Authorized Key user needs to unlock the locked user.-Cause-When the user enters the incorrect password after 5 times, the password gets locked.-Resolution-This is normal system behaviour.-The password gets locked after 5 incorrect logon attempts.-Key Users must unlock the User manually in Application & user Management > Business User View

Title: Promised Delivery Date on Outbound Delivery Performance by Time Report
Content: Symptom-You want to understand what value does the field Promised Delivery Date displays in the report Outbound Delivery Performance by Time Report-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Navigate to Design Reports view.-Search for the report Outbound Delivery Performance by Time and select the hyperlink against the reports name.-You can see that the system has displayed a date value in the field Promised Delivery Date and you want to know what does this date represent.-Cause-Promised delivery date is the date on which you can deliver to customer, which means ATP confirmation date. Please do note that ATP can be Green, Yellow or Red.-Green: Requested delivery date will be your promised delivery date;-Yellow: Date on which you can deliver system will propose if you move the mouse upon triangle symbol with a warming message Late Delivery/Earliest delivery date: DD/MM/YYYY;-Red: No promised delivery date.-Promised Delivery Date is given when you move mouse over ATP.

Title: Error Appears While Posting Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Supplier Invoice and the below error message appears:-'Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting.' (where ABC stands for the Goods and Service Receipt ID, XYZ for the Purchase Order and XYZ-1 for the Item on this Purchase Order)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoice work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select the Check button-The error message 'Cannot find goods or service receipt ABC for Purchase Order XYZ, item XYZ-1 in accounting.' is raised.- Cause-The relevant Warehouse Confirmation did not get posted to accounting yet due to the error message 'No functional area could be assigned. Derivation for accounting principle XXX, chart of accounts YYY, G/L account ZZZ, Non sales object.' (where XXX stands for the Accounting Principle ID, YYY for the impacted Chart of Account and ZZZ for the relevant G/L Account)-Resolution-You need to maintain the relevant functional area for the present G/L Accounts. Follow the below steps to derive the functional area automatically for future postings:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Fine Tuning activity-Select the activity Settings for Income Statements by Functions of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis-Select Edit the function area determination link-Select the Accounting Principle-In the Determination Using General Ledger Accounts tab, assign the Functional Area AAA to a G/L Account (where AA stands for the Functional Area ID)-Maintain the relevant functional area for the Accounting Principles-Select Save and close-Now go to the General Ledger work center-Navigate to the Source Document subview-show the Unposted Source Documents-Select the relevant Supplier Invoices and complete the Postings

Title: Reference Description in customer invoice is missing on item level
Content: Symptom-Reference description in the customer invoice is missing when using floow-up to an invoice for a credit memo- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice document).-Edit the invoice document and select the View All button.-Go to the item tab.-In the field reference the field reference is filled-Go top the function follow-up and create a credit memo-In the credit memo go to the tab items-Here the field reference is not filled-Cause-The reference description on the item of the customer invoice comes from the description on the general tab of the customer invoice request. However when creating a follow up credit memo, we do not fill the description field in the Credit memo Invoice request.-The reason for this is that we cannot correct determine which item reference description do we use. If the invoice was a invoice that was created from merging of two or more invoice request where the customer had maintain different description on the invoice request.-The system couldn't determine which description the customer would want on the credit memo invoice request, as this would differ from customer to customer, use case from use case-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-As workaround when the credit memo invoice request is created, you can go to view all and then fill in the description in the general tab. This will fill in the reference description in the corresponding credit memo.

Title: Overwrite admin or SAP selections
Content: Symptom-You have included new fields in the selection pane of a report, and when tried to save the report selection you noticed a message saying: "Sorry. You can't overwrite admin or SAP selections".-However, after closing and reopening the report, you notice the fields previously included in the report selection pane continue showing up.-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system-Go to work center Analysis and work center view Reports (or Business Analytics and Design Reports)-Search and open the report ABC-Make sure you are on the Initial (Standard) report selection-Click on Add Fields-Select one or more fields and check the option Display in Report Selection-Note the new fields are now displayed in the report selection pane-Now try to Save the report selection-Note the message Sorry. You can't overwrite admin or SAP selections-Close and reopen the report-Note the fields previously added to the report selection are still showing up-Cause-When you include fields in the report selection via Add Fields, this is a personalization for your user ID, which means these changes won't affect other users. The values you include on these fields (e.g. you manually input the value 1234 in the field BCDE) consist on the report selection itself, and these values are the information which is considered at the moment you save the report selection. If you try to save new values over a SAP default selection (e.g. selection Initial), the changes will not be taken by the system, since default selections are used by other users and cannot be changed. On the other hand, personalizations on the report, such as new fields included in the selection, will be recorded since it won't affect other users.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. In order to save a new report selection based on a admin or SAP selection, you must save it with a new name.

Title: System Shows Incorrect HSN/SAC Code in Purchase Order Form (India GST)
Content: Symptom-You have ordered the purchase order document and select preview to see the HSN/SAC code for line items. However, the HSN/SAC code appears wrong in the purchase order form.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Search for relevant Purchase Order which is Ordered (GST Relevant)-Select Edit and View All-Select Preview and you can see that the HSN/SAC code is wrong for Purchase Order line item-Cause-You are using a customized form template for purchase order document and mapped the HSN/SAC code to wrong binding path.-Resolution-Since you are using the customized form template for purchase order document, you can map the field to correct binding path to see the HSN/SAC code using Adobe Life Cycle Designer.-The correct mapping for HSN/SAC Code at purchase order item level is as below;-HSN code: $.HSNCodeIndia-SAC Code: $.ServiceAccountCodeIndia-Once you map the field to the above binding path, system will show the correct HSN/SAC code at item level in purchase order document.

Title: System Shows Incorrect GSTIN Number in Purchase Order Form for Seller, Ship-To and Bill-To Parties (India GST)
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order document and trying to preview the form to see the tax number. However, the GSTIN number for Seller, Bill-To & Ship-To appears wrong.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Search for relevant Purchase Order which is Ordered. (GST Relevant)-Select Edit and View All.-Select Preview and here you can see that the GSTIN number for Seller, Bill-To & Ship-To appears wrong.-Cause-You are using customized form template for purchase order document and mapped Seller, Bill-To & Ship-To GSTIN numbers to wrong binding path.-Resolution-Since you are using customized form template for purchase order document, you can map the fields to below binding path using Adobe Life Cycle Designer.-Buyer Party GSTIN: $record.PurchaseOrder.BuyerParty.GSTIdentificationNumberIndia-Seller Party GSTIN: $record.PurchaseOrder.SellerParty.GSTIdentificationNumberIndia-Bill to party GSTIN: $record.PurchaseOrder.BillToParty.GSTIdentificationNumberIndia-Once you map the fields to the correct binding path, system will show the correct GSTIN numbers for Seller, Bill-To & Ship-To in purchase order document.

Title: Library originals are not included in several use cases in the Solution Documentation UI
Content: Symptom-Business Processes and Libraries-In solution documentation 7.2 we introduced the libraries to reduce redundancies and to enable re-use. Therefore, the content has been divided in the business processes part and the libraries part which contains re-usable elements like process step originals.-For further information see also https://wiki.scn.sap.com/wiki/display/SM/Process+Capabilities+and+Libraries-Consequently, the process structures contain references to library elements which are not part of the process structure hierarchy. I.e. a process structures are not self-contained by themselves but need to be enhanced with the linked library elements to build the entire process documentations.-You might have experienced that currently not all functions in solution documentation are already respecting the distributed solution documentation structure in an adequate way. Depending on the usage of solution documentation you may observe shortcomings in some functions:-The list view does not show the linked elements from the libraries-The search does not find the linked library elements-It can happen that a structure cannot be released because of issues (like conflicts) in the linked library elements-The reports do not show the library elements in the context of the business process structures-Resolution-List View & Search-Currently the list view provides a flat list of all elements of a hierarchy that is denoted by its root element. The linked library elements are not part of the list.-In a similar way, the search only inspects the elements of the hierarchy starting from the selected root element and does not consider the linked library elements.-This might not fully meet your expectations since the assignment list of a reference element (e.g. a process step reference) shows also the assignments to the respective library element (e.g. a process step original). These “inherited” assignments are marked with a special icon in front of the element name.-We are aware of this deficiency and are already working on an improvement. We are intending to enhance the list view with the linked library elements and to adapt the search accordingly.-We cannot yet commit the enhanced list view for a specific point in time or SP.-As a workaround, the library elements should be handled separately:-The linked library elements may be displayed or edited by navigating from the business processes structure via “go to original”.-For the process step library the handling might be simplified by organizing the library in a suitable folder structure. Then the process step originals may be displayed and edited using the list view in the process step library.-As a prerequisite, the library parts should be included in the view definition. The easiest way would be to use the default view or else to include the library root element in the view definition.-Since the search with a root element in the business processes might not be sufficient, either a search in the entire solution or a second search in the library might be needed.-Another option is available if the solution documentation content has been built using content activation of projects and solutions from Solution Manager 7.1. In this case the business processes and respective non-technical library parts are organized in project and solution specific folders.-Using this folder structure, it is possible to define a view which corresponds to a 7.1 project or solution for the business part (business structure, process step, interface and configuration libraries). This allows to restrict the solution documentation UI and the search functionality to those parts coming from specific 7.1 projects or solutions. By this you may use the search functionality across business processes and libraries while restricting the results to the content created within a specific project or solution in 7.1.-Be aware that the technical parts (development and executable libraries) are always organized automatically per logical component group by the application component hierarchy and thus are not organized in project or solution specific folders.-  Lifecycle Operations: Release & Discard Changes-The lifecycle operations “Release changes” and “Discard changes” already apply to the selected structures including the linked library elements. Consequently, all affected elements are checked for conflicts and other pre-conditions and thus might cause error messages. Unfortunately, the list view does not display all affected elements which might make it complicated to identify the error causing elements.-We already improved the user interfaces of the lifecycle operations with SP06. With this improvement for a “Release changes” or “Discard changes” operation a detailed list of all affected elements is provided. In case of errors or warning all detected issues are displayed at the corresponding elements.-  Reporting-The element sources for a report are based on scopes. The scopes already provide an option to include the linked library elements (option “Include originals”). Thus, here you may get a reporting list containing elements of the business processes as well as the corresponding linked elements from the libraries.-Nevertheless, there are also some gaps in the reports concerning the distributed solution documentation structure. It is currently not yet possible to get a combined report list showing the library elements in the context of the business process structures. A special interest might also be to see the usages of the library elements and to identify those library elements which are not used at all.-We are planning to enhance the list of standard reports and put a special focus on the links to library elements.-Concerning the usage of library elements there are already two options available:-Starting from business processes is possible to display all reference elements to the library. Then a navigation to the library is required to show details.-Starting from a library element the “Where-used list” displays all references to the respective element. Of course, this can only be triggered for a single element.-With SP06 there is already a first usage report available showing statistical information for library elements. This report show the number of usages of each library element. Especially those elements which are not used at all may be identified immediately.-Further more advanced reports are subject for planning. But we cannot yet commit such reports for a specific point in time or SP.
