Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-****Not Yet Finalized****-Dump occurs when download Custom  Report"  via Business Analytics WOC /Upload/Download-Reproducing the Issue-Try to Download Data Source which the Report is based on-· Go to the WOC business analytics-· Common Task  view and Download/Upload  sub view.-· Download Data Source "XYZ" Click Downloads-OBSERVATION-Dump occur-Cause-The Custom data source XYZ is syntactically wrong.-One extension field used in this join Data Source is not available in the base data source.-Resolution-Please correct this data source and the corresponding report and then download the data source.

Title: Error Message: Holiday Account requires sufficent quota for posting on the DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Symptom-You receive an error when you apply for leave:-Error Message : Holiday Account requires sufficent quota for posting on the DD.MM.YYYY-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Select Employees view-Select the dropdown Show and select the value Modified View - Active Employees-Select the required employee-Select the tab Time Account Balances-Cause-This can happen due to two reasons:-Case 1) When the number of leaves applied exceeds the available leave balance (remaining leaves in the respective Time Account).-Case 2) Actual number matches but not displaying the actual unpaid break in Time Account Balance due to round off duration for unpaid break (break time may be less than an hour). Which is very negligible however still accountable. Hence a total of available leave balance and unpaid break exceeding the applied leave quota.-Example:-An employee can take total 30 leaves per year.-When you check the available leave balance for an employee it shows a balance of 5 days and taken 25.-However when apply for 5 days leave and you receive the error.-This is due to unpaid break. The unpaid break duration recorded by the time recorder is 0,01 time which then rounds off to 1,01 days in time recording.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.

Title: Manual Adjustment in distributing Unplanned Costs
Content: Symptom-In a Supplier Invoice, you wish to add an Additional Cost Debit Item and distribute its cost against other Supplier Invoice items.-When doing this, you cannot adjust the percentages and amounts in the Cost distribution for Unplanned Delivery Costs.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work centre.-Navigate to New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Provide mandatory details such as the Supplier, External Document ID, Invoice Date, Receipt Date and Posting Date.-Select View All.-Navigate to Items tab.-Choose Add Row under sub-tab Items.-Select type Additional Cost Debit Item.-Provide the appropriate Description, Tax code, Quantity, Net-Price-Navigate to Sub-tab Item Details and choose Cost Distribution.-Select Distribute among other invoices or credit memos.-Provide the Invoice ID and Item ID against the option Invoice ID/Item ID in the pop-up screen.-Choose Distribute.-Here the percentages cannot be manually changed.-Cause-By default, the system distributes the additional cost against all of the Supplier Invoice items. The distribution is proportional to the Net Values of these items.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-If you want to assign the cost distribution by quantity rather than individual price, you can create one Additional Cost Debit Item per invoice item to distribute to.

Title: Error: ID Mapping for Mapping of Product Categories to Material Groups Missing During Replication from ERP to BYD
Content: Symptom-You are replicating Product Categories from ERP system and the following error is displayed:-"ID Mapping for Mapping of Product Categories to Material Groups missing".-Cause-The ID Mapping has not been maintained for the proper system in the ID Mapping for Integration work center view.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center and access the view ID Mapping for Integration;-Click on Edit ID Mapping for Integration;-In the Mapping Of field select Product Categories to Material Groups;-In the System Instance ID select the system which you are integrating to;-Maintain the ID Mapping and click on Save.

Title: Timestamp not Showing Correctly After Updating Activity Phone Call Using Mass Data Maintenance.
Content: Symptom-You have updated the timestamp for the activity Phone Calls using Mass data Maintenance.-After the update the Timestamp shows different than what you had added in the template as per your Timezone.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Mass data Maintenance workcenter-2. Select Import Phone Call link to update the timestamp.-Cause-A timezone is set when the task Phone Call is initially created. Hence this timezone will be used though it is not visible in the UI.-Therefore during update, regardless user's timezone, only already stored timezone is used.-NOTE:-Scenario1 : If the data is initially uploaded into the system via migration workbench, the default timezone will be set to below : UTC + 00:00. -Timezone 1:-(UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland-or-Timezone 2:-Also you can check with Timezone ,with this timezone the time will be shown as daylight saving with one hr difference:-(UTC+00:00) Greenwich Mean Time with daylight saving time (UK).--Scenario2 : If data is manually created initially by the end user from UI, then the end user's timezone will be stored.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior as Migration tool only supports UTC + 00:00 during migration.

Title: Project Based(Fixed Price) Sales Order Item Not Considered For Revenue Recognition
Content: Symptom-Sales Order item XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order item ID) of type Service Fixed Price (Project) has been fully delivered and invoiced.-The project task is in status Stopped, Completed or Closed.-However, the Revenue Recognition run XXX (XXX represents the Revenue Recognition run ID) has not considered the Sales Order item, meaning not realized any costs or revenue associated with this Sales Order item. -In Customer Invoicing it's noticed that the Delivery Status set to Finished. The Invoicing status, however, is still In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.  -Go to the Projects view.-Find Project ABC (ABC represents the Project ID) which is in status Completed (Or Stopped or Closed).-Click Edit Percentage of Completion button.-The column Calculated PoC displays 100%. Hence, the Sales Order item has been fully delivered. -To check the Delivery and Invoicing Status of the Sales Order item:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Project Invoicing – Sales Orders view.-Find the respective sales order.-Notice the Invoicing Status is still In Process.-In the Details section, go to the Items tab. Here, notice that the Fulfilment Status of the item is set to Finished.-As the Sales Order item has been fully delivered and invoiced and as the Project task is Completed (or Stopped or Closed) the expectation is that the Invoicing Status to be Finished as well.-Cause-For project-based Sales Order items with accrual method Recognize at Completed Contract, the revenue recognition run considers Sales Order items which are completely fulfilled and invoiced and where the Final Delivery or Invoice Date has passed.-The Delivery/ Fulfilment status will be automatically set to Finished once the associated Project or Project Task has been set to status Stopped, Completed or Closed.-The Invoicing status, however, will remain in status In Process: Project- based sales order items can be invoiced more than once.-This also means that they can become relevant for revenue recognition more than once. Therefore, the invoicing needs to be manually finished if no further invoice is planned.-Resolution-To manually finish the Invoicing:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Project Invoicing: Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order.-Press Change Status and select Finish Invoicing. To change the Invoicing status of a particular Sales Order item, navigate to the Items tab in the Details section. Here change the Invoicing status to Finished.-Now, after all conditions are fulfilled the Sales Order/ Sales Order item will be considered for Revenue Recognition.-See Also-revenue recognition; Project Based (Fixed Price); invoicing status; delivery status

Title: How and When to Take a SAT Trace for JSON Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You have taken a HTTP Trace of an Operation, e.g. opening a Booking, which has been reported to have a high response time.-From the trace it is apparent that a JSON request is consuming most of the time:-Such incidents should be forwarded to the relevant Development Component for the associated Business Object.-The Business Object can be determined by checking the STAD Records in the Backend for the JSON request in question.-For instructions on this, see Case Document 1968043 .-Resolution-1. In order to generate the SAT Trace, log in to the Backend on the same Application Server that the Frontend User was connected to when they reproduced the issue.-2. You can determine the Frontend User's Application Server from the HTTP Trace as follows:-3a. Create a Variant for the User who is reproducing the issue in the Frontend.-3b. To do this, log in to the Backend and navigate to transaction SAT:-In From User field, enter the Technical User ID.-In the Variant field, choose an approiate name.-Click on the Create Variant icon.-4. Following this, you will be directed to the Variant screen.-In the Maximum Size of File field, change the value to a higher size e.g 200kB.-Under Aggregation, select None.-Click Save.-5. Open a new Backend Session and navigate to transaction SICF. On the next page entitled Define Servies, simply click Execute.-6. At the next screen, perform the following:-Under Virtual Hosts / Services, expand the folders.-Highlight json.-Click on Edit, select Runtime Analysis, then click Activate.-7. In the new pop-up window, do as follows:-In the User field, enter the Technical User ID.-In the Precision field, select High.-In the Variant field, enter the Variant Name.-  8. After activating Runtime Analysis, reproduce the corresponding step in the Frontend and then deactivate Runtime Analysis again in SICF. See step 6.-9. Then return to transaction SAT and switch to the Evaluate tab. The newly recorded SAT Trace file is displayed.-10. You can download the file, attach it to the incident and forward it to the corresponding Development Component as explained above.-

Title: B2B inbound interface SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the internal Sales Order Integration EDI in a B2B scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-You cannot find any information on Slaes Order Integration in the Service Explorer.-Cause-The B2B web service SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn with access URL <hostname>/sap/bc/srt/scs/sap/salesorderprocessingorderingi1 is not visible in the Service Explorer, because the web service only released for usage in context of integration scenario Sales Order Integration.-Resolution-The B2B inbound interface SalesOrderProcessingOrderingIn with access URL <hostname>/sap/bc/srt/scs/sap/salesorderprocessingorderingi1 is the interface of choice for B2B ordering scenarios. You get the interface by creating a communication arrangement for communication scenario “Sales Order Integration”. We currently have no plans to deprecate or replace this interface.-You can create sales orders via Web Service API or via B2B inbound interface; explained in this blog post https://blogs.sap.com/2017/08/10/create-byd-sales-orders-using-web-services/.-A detailed description to configure the B2B service: Setup B2B Sales Order Integration with SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: System Failed to Show Specific Time Types While Entering Time Sheets
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded customized time types in to the ByDesign system. While entering the time sheets for the employees, system shows default time types besides the uploaded ones. You expect the system to show only the uploaded time types from the drop down list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to the Time Recording view.-Select Time Sheets.-Upload customized Time Types.-Now select the relevant Employee.-Select Open Time Sheet.-Navigate to Time Entry tab and select Add Row button.-Select drop down list under Time Type column.-You can see the default one besides the uploaded time types.-Resolution-The feature will be available in the future releases of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Non-Localized Country Tab Missing in the Personnal Administration Work Center
Content: Symptom-In Personnel Administration you can not choose a non-localized country. The non-localized country tab is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Regular Tasks view.-You can not see the tab Non-Localized Country. -Cause-The Non-localized Employee selection has not been selected in Scoping.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects subview.-Press Button Edit Project Scope for the project you are editing.-Go to the Scoping step.-Expand Human Resources.-Expand Personnel Administration.-Select the Non-Localized Employees.-Click on next until the confirmation.-See Also-The Help Document "Quick Guide for Regular Tasks (in Personnel Administration) — Non Localized Country" gives more information about this functionality.

Title: The Phone Number of the Contact Person is Displayed Incorrectly in the Phone Call Activity
Content: Symptom-The phone number of the contact person is displayed incorrectly in the phone call activity.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Contacts view.-Show All Contacts and Find Contact ABC (ABC represents the ID of the contact).-Click the Edit button.-The phone number displayed here is XXX (XXX represents the phone number of the contact ABC).-Now go to the Activities view.-Show All Activities and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the phone call activity).-Click the Edit button for activity XYZ.-The phone number of contact ABC displayed here is YYY (YYY represents the phone number of the contact ABC).-Hence the phone number of the contact displayed in the activity is not same as it is maintained in the Contacts view. -Cause-The phone number of the contact in the Contacts view was changed after the creation of phone call activity. The open activities do not get updated automatically with this change.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.  The update phone number will be be displayed when you create any new activity.

Title: Test KBA Attachments not Visible in Payment Monitor
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You cannot see the attachment XYZ (XYZ stands for the attachment) for a Payment in Payment Monitor view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for the transaction ABC (ABC stands for the transaction ID) and select it.-Click View, then View All.-Navigate to the Attachments tab.-There are not attachments visible.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour, which would be corrected in the future releases.-Resolution-System is working as expected.-

Title: Customer Return not Created for Delivery Return Notification Document
Content: Symptom-You have received goods returned from your customer. Customer return document is not created in the system even after Inbound Delivery is successfully received in your system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center .-Navigate to the view Returns.-In Advanced search option choose the value for the field Reference Type as Inbound Delivery and enter the inbound delivery id in the field Reference ID.-Choose the button Go.-The system does not fetch any customer return corresponding the inbound delivery even though the respective inbound delivery have been successfully received.-Cause-There is a change project ID ABC, in which you have selected/changed scope related with Customer Return business option. You have then merged that project with the main project. However, you have not activated the solution capabilities yet.  That is why system is not able to create customer return.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project with ID ABC in which you have selected activities for customer returns and choose the button Open Activity List.-Under the tab All Select the activity Activate Solution Capabilities and choose the button Open.-In the Activate Solution Capabilities page select the Confirm button .-Once the above mentioned steps are performed close the project by selecting the activity Close Project.

Title: ATP considers Consignment Stock for the Stock Availability Check
Content: Symptom-ATP will consider the conisgnment stock  during the stock availability check even though the stock is physically not in the warehouse-Cause- Stock is always displayed as product + Site combination. Since, the consignment stock will also be referring to the lcoation/warehouse, ATP will consider this stock during availability check.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.  SAP Business ByDesign does not have a specific consignment stock process.

Title: Error : Solution is in Deletion Deployment Activities are not Allowed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-Customer will receive an error Solution is in deletion. Deployment activities are not allowed when trying to upload a patch solution.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to SDK.-Go to Implementation Manager tab.-Click on the Upload button.-Error occurs.-Cause-The error is caused because the patch solution is deleted from SDK but it is not completely deleted from the system. This issue can happen due to various reasons and they are:-Case 1: The patch solution is only partially deleted due to some inconsistencies in the solution.-Case 2: The same solution exists in another tenant of the same system.- Resolution-Case 1: You should help the customer to delete the solution completely from the backend, which is mentioned in the below mentioned case document.-2197604 - How to Delete a Solution From the Backend?-Case 2: You should check in the transaction SDIM to find out whether the same solution exists in any other tenants of the system, if so you have to inform the customer to delete the solution from that tenant also.-You can refer the following two case documents to suggest the customer to resolve the issue:-  2150528 - How to Find the Creator of an Addon-2175583 - How to Delete a Solution or Patch from the Cloud Studio-

Title: Item X: Product (Individual Material) ABC-XYZ Does not Exist or is Retired
Content: Symptom-You created a Credit Memo with Individual Material but when trying to post it the following error message appears: 'Item X: Product (individual material) ABC- XYZ does not exist or is retired.'-(ABC stands for the Individual Material ID, XYZ stands for the Individual Material Description).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant Credit Memo.-Click Post.-The system triggers the error message: 'Item X: Product (individual material) ABC- XYZ does not exist or is retired.'-Cause-In the Individual Material field in the Credit Memo you have manually entered the Individual Material ID and the Individual Material Description. The system will recognize whatever content is entered into this field as the Individual Material ID. If you enter the ID and the Description, the system will not find any matching Individual Material ID and will trigger the error message. Only the Individual Material ID should be entered into this field, the system will then add the Individual Material Description automatically.- Resolution-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant Credit Memo.-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Go to Items tab.-Highlight the relevant Item.-Under Item Details choose Cost Distribution tab.-In the Individual Material field only enter the relevant Individual Material ID without the Individual Material Description.- The Credit Memo will now be consistent and you will be able to post it.

Title: Contact Business Address is not Getting Updated after Migrating Partners Using the Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to migrate Contact of Partners with their Business Address using the Migration of Partners but the same is not getting reflected in UI after migration.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-3. Search and Open the migration activity-4. Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Resolution-To populate the Business Address for the Contact you have to fill the Address details under Workplace Address in Contacts tab.

Title: Recorded Times do not reach Time Account and Relevant Reporting
Content: Symptom-Employee times are recorded and Active or Approved. In Business Configuration times of this time type are assigned to a defined Time Account. They are visible in the Time File of the employee at the Employees Times tab and also in Employee Times report. However, they are not available under the Time Account Balance tab, and no posting to this account happens. They are also missing in the Employee Time Accounts report. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the respective Employee ID and choose Edit.-Select the Employee Times tab.-You find recordings for the relevant Time Type.-Select the Time Account Balances tab.-Mark the row of the relevant Time Account.-No appropriate balance is available.-Cause-The issue happens as soon as the following preconditions are met: The times are recorded with specified Start-/End Time or Duration, and they are recorded as Hours(s), although the Time Account has unit Day(s). In this case quantity calculation from Work Schedule is skipped.-Resolution-To recognize and accrual recorded Hours(s) with Start-/End Time or Duration, change the unit of the Time Account from Day(s) to Hours(s).-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview.-Show Activities and find Time Accounts (- Country).-Open the respective Time Accounts (- Country) Activity.-Choose Maintain Time Account Types.-Mark the row of Time Account Type.-Change entry in Unit from Day(s) to Hours(s).-Choose Save and Close.-Afterwards, perform a Day Closure run for the affected employee(s) by following the below steps:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Go to Regular Task view.-Choose Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Maintain the Employee.-Mark Start Time Valuation and choose Run.-Select a Valuation Start Date prior to the first date the Times were recorded.-Select OK.-Choose Save and Close.

Title: How to Define Goods and Service Receipt Approval Condition based on Purchase Order Quantity
Content: Symptom-You would like to define specific approval steps based on Purchase Order Quantity.-As an example, approval required if PO quantity exceeds XYZ%.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Choose Approval Processes View.-Select the existing Approval Process for Goods and Services Receipt and then choose Copy button.-Choose Add Row to add a process step and provide Process Step Name.-Define work distribution for the same.-Select this process step and choose Add Group to maintain the condition.-Choose Exceed quantity of PO quantity against Field.-Choose Equal to against Compare Operator.-Choose Value against With and check the Checkbox-Maintain the Validity and select Save button.-Cause-You cannot define Purchase Order quantity against an Approval Condition for Goods and Service Receipt. This is Standard System Behavior.-Resolution-You can set Over Delivery Tolerance in Purchase Order. If the Over-Delivery tolerance of the purchase order is exceeded by the goods and services receipt, the system creates a task to approve the goods and services receipt.

Title: The service order line item still remains in process for spare parts even when you click on complete execution
Content: Symptom-The service order line item remains in process for spare parts even when you use the function complete execution.-You will get the warning message Item ABC: Order item ABC not fulfilled Completely; Open quantities exist-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search and opem the service order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Select the Edit button.-Select the View All button.-Select the Tab Items-Search for the line item ABC-Here you can see, that the confirmed quantity has not reached the quantity in the line item.-Click on Complete Execution-Now you will get the warning message:-Item ABC: Order item ABC not fulfilled Completely; Open quantities exist-The status still remain in process.-Cause-In the Services, Spare parts cannot be completed with creating a confirmation with 0 quantity or a quantity which is less than requested in the line item.-For a spare part ( delivery relevent ) completion happens only when the total requested quantity is delivered and confirmation is created for the full quantity.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Display Description Fields in OData
Content: Symptom-You want to display the description for extension fields in a Custom OData Service, but only IDs are displayed.-Cause-There is a functionality named "Include Code Descriptions" which can be enabled for custom OData Services. This will allow the display of descriptions in the OData.-Resolution-To enable the functionality "Include Code Descriptions", please follow the steps below:-Go to the Administrator work center and access the view OData Service Explorer;-Change the view to Custom OData Services;-Select the desired OData service and select it, then click on Edit;-Check the box for "Include Code Descriptions" and then click on Save.

Title: Cannot Add a File to Already Posted Bank Statements
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a file to an already posted or cancelled bank statement.-You are able to upload the file in the Attach Documents step, but there is no Save button to save the changes. When you close the bank statement and reopen it, you cannot find the attachment that you had uploaded earlier.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank statements view.-Search and select Bank statement ABC (ABC is the ID of the bank statement).-Navigate to the Attachments tab.-Click on Add button to upload the File, the file seems to be attached.-Now close the Bank Statement.-Reopen the Bank Statement ABC.-Navigate to the Attachments tab.--You cannot find the attachment you added to the bank statement earlier.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-You can add a file to a Bank Statement only while creating a Bank Statement. Once the Bank Statement is posted or cancelled, this option is not available.-Eventhough you see the option to add a file to the bank statement after it is posted under the Attachments tab, there is no option to Save the attachment after this.-Resolution-If you want to add a file to a Bank Statement, you need to do this while creating the Bank Statement.

Title: Weighted Average Valuation Method not Found in the System
Content: Symptom-This KBA compares the valuation methods Moving Average and Weighted Average.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Master Data view.-Go to Materials subview.-Edit the material ID you want.-Go to Valuation tab.-In Perpetual Cost Method notice that only Standard and Moving Average are shown.-Cause-The Weighted Average and Moving Average are both valid average cost methods.-SAP Business ByDesign offers two types of Perpetual Cost Method: Standard and Moving Average.-Weighted Average cost method determines an average cost by adding beginning inventory and all purchases. With this average cost, all cost of goods sold and ending inventory is valuated in the same way.-Moving Average is usually used by perpetual inventory systems, such as SAP Business ByDesign. Here an average cost is calculated after each single business transaction. This could lead to different cost of goods sold within an accounting period. The advantage is that the unit costs are reflecting more quickly.-Resolution-Both are not the same type, and in SAP Business ByDesign the used one is Moving Average.-Keywords-Perpetual Cost Method; moving average; standard; Weighted Average

Title: Unable to change the parameters for SAP delivered security policy.
Content: Symptom-You want to change the parameters for SAP delivered Security Policy S_BUSINESS_USER.-Reproducing the Issue-Security Policy in the ByDesign system can be checked by a Key user following the below steps :-Go to Application and User Management ﻿work center.-Select the Common Task -> Edit Security Policies.-Here you can find the SAP delivered security policy with parameters already defined that is S_BUSINESS_USER.-Key users cannot edit the Parameters for this policy.-Cause-S_BUSINESS_USER is a SAP delivered Security Policy for Business Users existing in the system with SAP provided parameters. No changes are permitted to any user.-Resolution-Key users can create a new Security Policy with a different Policy name and Description using the Add Row option in Security Policy screen :-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select the Common Task -> Edit Security Policies.-Click on button Add Row and enter the mandatory fields like Policy ID, Policy Name. For example C_BUSINESS_USER.-Now you can edit the Parameters for this Policy and save it for the purpose of users assignment.-If you click the button Default for this new policy then it will be automatically assigned to all the new created users. To assign the Policy to existing users in the system , you need to edit each users attributes in the Access Rights screen for saving the changes.

Title: Unable to Export CSV Files in Google Chrome
Content: Symptom-You are trying to export data through the Mass Data Maintenance Work Center using Google Chrome, but when you select Export Data, the file is not generated.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance Work Center-Select the data you want to export. E.g: Customers-Run the query and select the tab you want to export-Click on Export Data to CSV File-The browser launches the data in new tab and the CSV file is not generated-Cause-Unfortunately the it is not possible to export CSV files in Google Chrome. This is a current limitation and Google is working to solve this issue.-Resolution-Please use another browser. E.g: Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox.-See Also-Link to Google Forum about this issue-https://productforums.google.com/forum/#!topic/chrome/CLig1Fc9e8k

Title: Exchange Rate Difference for Migrated Open Items
Content: Symptom-You migrated open invoice items, i.e. open items payable with a currency other than the company currency.-Therefore, in the migration template you maintain the transaction amount in the original currency, e.g. USD. Additionally, you maintain the company currency amount (e.g. EUR) according to the exchange rate on the day of the migration.-You then maintain a payment in the system with a company currency amount corresponding to the company currency amount of the migrated open invoice item.-Later you want to clear the open invoice item with a payment but the system displays an error message: Balance of -XX,XX EUR* clearing not possible.-You expected that the system uses the migrated exchange rate but it used the current exchange rate that is valid on the day of the clearing.-*Company Currency-Reproducing the Issue-Migration of Open Items-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project and click Open Activity list.-Go to the Integrate and Extend phase and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-In the next window open Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Create a migration unit and upload your open items template (i.e. Open Items Payable).-In the template you maintain the open invoice items in transaction currency (i.e. USD)  as well as the corresponding amount in company currency (i.e. EUR) according to the exchange rate that is valid on the day of migration.-Clearing of the migrated open invoice item (payable) and the payment-In the Payables workcenter navigate to the Suppliers view and here to the Supplier Accounts subview.-Select the respective supplier and click View. Automatically you are navigated to the Trade Payables - Invoices/Payments tab.-Here you select the migrated open invoice item or, alternatively, the corresponding payment and then press Clear Manually. The new clearing opens.-You now match the migrated open invoice item with the payment. An error message appears: Balance of -XX,XX EUR* clearing not possible.-*Company Currency-Cause-The system works as designed: When clearing (migrated) open items, the company currency amounts are always calculated with the exchange rate that is valid on the day of the clearing. It is not supported to use the company currency amounts that the open items were migrated with.-Resolution-In order to clear the migrated open invoice item with the payment you need to apply a discount/credit with payment difference reason 97-Currency exchange rate differences:-In the new clearing match the migrated open invoice item with the payment.-Select the open invoice item and click Apply Discount or Credit.-In the pop-up window maintain the difference amount.-Then select the payment reason 97-Currency exchange rate differences.-Click OK.-The clearing can now be posted.

Title: Error Message : Maximum Number Of Tenants Reached.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-You want to request a new test system and the following error message is displayed:-System error; create an incident on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS component-Maximum Number Of Tenants Reached-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Project View.-Select the XYZ Project.-Click on the Request System button.-Confirm the downtime Slot.-The error message will be displayed.-Cause-This is the system expected behavior.-The number of tenants they can request free of charge depends on their systems package.- The standard Business ByDesign, Sales and Travel OnDemand systems package includes one productive tenant and one test tenant.- Customers with the Enterprise Private Edition can have up to ten productive tenants and are allowed one test tenant per productive tenant.- Resolution-By default, customers are allowed the mentioned number  of tenants at any given point of time. If they want fresh tenants, they will have to trigger deletion of the older tenants before they can request for a new one.-Please verify with the customer which tenant can be deleted in case he wants to proceed with the request.

Title: Product XYZ is Not Displayed in the Product view
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to find the product XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of a product ID).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Product view.-In the OWL you are not able to find the product XYZ.-However, in SESFTS when you query the MATERIAL BO, you are able to find the product XYZ.- Cause-Technically, a competitor product is also stored as a product in the backend.-Resolution-The product XYZ might be a customer product as a result you will only find it in the UI in the Marketing work center in the Competitor Product view.-

Title: Error Message: "Tax Identification Number already exists for an employee"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to rehire the employee ABC, since he/she previously had a contract which got terminated. You also want to assign a different employee ID than the previous one for this employee. When trying to complete the payroll data of the employee, the error message Tax Identification Number already exists for an employee occurs.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Click the Hire Employee link.-Input the Employee ID as DEF.-Input the required employment data (name, address, organizational assignment etc.).-Click Finish.-Click Complete Payroll Data.-Fill in the mandatory values and click Next until you reach the Tax Data tab.-Add the Tax Identification Number xxxxxxxxxxx which was previously used for the payroll data of the employee ABC and click Next - the following error message occurs:-Tax Identification Number already exists for an employee.-Cause-The Tax Identification Number is unique for each employee, hence cannot be used for more than one employee.-Resolution-Rehiring the employee is not an option in this case, because the same employee ID will be assigned and you want to assign a different one to the same employee. Still, when hiring a new employee, EITHER the Tax Identification Number OR the Tax Year must be entered. Therefore, the issue can be solved by performing the following steps:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Find the employee ABC and click Edit.-Go to the Tax Data tab and select the Basic Tax Data sub-tab.-Remove the Tax Identification Number xxxxxxxxxxx.-Go to the Tax Year Data sub-tab.-Click Add Row.-Maintain the Tax Year, validity etc and save the changes.-It will be now possible to assign the same Tax Identification Number xxxxxxxxxxx to the new employee DEF.

Title: Workflow Rule uses Supplier Name instead of Supplier ID
Content: Symptom-Yoe are creating a new workflow rule for Purchase Orders with the condition "Supplier Equal to Supplier ID ABC" (ABC represents the Supplier ID), the expected notification or email doesn't get triggered.-However, if the condition is created as "Supplier Equal to Supplier name XYZ" (XYZ represents the Supplier Name), then the notification or email is triggered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Workflow Rules view.-Click New.-Enter Data.-Click Next.-Click Add Group.-Select Supplier - Equal to - Enter ABC in the Value field.-Click Next.-Enter Notification Data.-Activate the Rule and Finish.-Create a New Purchase Order for Supplier XYZ to trigger the notification.-Go to Home work center.-Go to Inbox.-The notification isn't triggered.-Cause-For the Supplier field in the workflow rules, the system looks for the Supplier Name rather than the Supplier ID.-Resolution-In the Workflow rule, change the Value of the condition to ABC instead of XYZ, and the notification or email will get triggered.

Title: The External Delivery ID is Missing. Enter an External Delivery ID
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create and save a 3PL Inbound Deivery document. While trying to save the document you get the below error message-The External Delivery ID is Missing. Enter an External Delivery ID-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Navigate to the 3PL Inbound: Inbound Delivery Notifications view-Select the relevant delivery notification document and choose the button New Inbound Delivery.-You Choose the Save button.-The above error message is displayed.-Cause-You have not entered the External Delivery ID, which is mandatory while creating the 3PL inbound delivery id.-Resolution-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center.-Navigate to the 3PL Inbound: Inbound Delivery Notifications view-Select the relevant delivery notification document and choose the button New Inbound Delivery.-In the field External Delivery ID enter the document id with the prefix which you have configured in the abusiness configuration activity, Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery.-You should also enter value in the field External Delivery Item ID available in the Items tab of the New Inbound Delivery document screen.- See Also-The system is working as designed.

Title: Analytics Features on the Mobile UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**** INTERNAL USE ONLY ****-This document outlines the current limitations for Analytics features on mobile devices. Incidents regarding the listed limitations can be closed with the note that this is the current behaviour and this UI is still being enhanced (do not send to development).-Resolution-Features and Limitations-Please note that the mobile UI is intended for end users to view data. It is not designed for key users to create data (reports, key figures etc), hence the functionalities are adapted accordingly. Please also note that this UI is still in development - the features are still limited as of now but will be expanded over time.-The feature are currently as follows:-General:-The Analysis work center is enabled in mobile devices from the release 1705.-The mobile application is not compatible with Windows 10.-All pop ups will cover the whole screen. By comparison, menus will always be shown as a list.-The overall performance of the mobile UI is not yet optimized (not specific to Analytics). This is continuously being enhanced, and improvements are expected with the upcoming releases. Please also note that the performance depends on the RAM size of the device.-Dashboards:-Irrespective of what layout is maintained in the dashboard, on the mobile UI, the report views will always be shown underneath each other.-The drilldown is not supported for the report views, hence there is no Reset button either.-Show Value and Table / Chart Settings are not available - only Show Legend is possible.-The Analyse Data feature to navigate to the report is not yet supported.-On windows devices, the area selection cannot be used for dashboard interactivity.-Reports:-When you open a report and swipe from right to left, it will change to the next report view.-While entering selection values, the auto-complete is not supported on smartphones.-Show Value and Table / Chart Settings are not available - only Show Legend is possible.-It is not possible to manually type in values in filters, you would need to use the value help.-Selections are not yet supported in the mobile UI.-There are no pop ups when clicking on the column header of a key figure / characteristic.-Reports are not supported in the offline mode.-The list of report views is sorted by end user views / key user views / standard views.-Windows devices have the following limitations:-The Filter icon is not available.-Show a single value by tapping on a chart is not supported.-Usability issues like difficulty in scrolling in a table and hierarchical reports can be expected.-Drag and drop for moving fields is not supported.-

Title: Unexpected PRICE DIFFERENCE posting in G/L Journal Voucher
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-After posting a General Ledger Journal Voucher you notice that a difference is posted on a Price Difference G/L account. You notice that the posting occured because the Inventory ﻿value and the Goods in Transit values don't match. You expect these values to be the same.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Jornal Entries.-Search and open Journal Entry XXX (XXX represents the Journal Entry number).-Navigate to the Line Items, where you will see the following postings:-the Inventory G/L account has value of ABC (ABC represents the value that has posted to the Inventory account) amount-Goods in Transit G/L has a value amount of DEF (DEF represents the value that has posted to the Goods in Transit account).-Price Difference G/L account is debited with amount GHI (GHI represents the value that has posted to the Price Difference account) which is the difference between the two values.-Cause-The Journal entry created is correct and this is standard system behavior which is caused by the system calculating the cost in a different way for remaining quantity not in stock.-Resolution-The posting can be explained with the following example:-Inventory quantity is 420 but you have issued 480, the resulting inventory quantity became -60  (system calculates the cost in different way for remaining quantity not in stock.)-System calculated the cost  for available 420 quantity utilizing the whole stock amount : 3625.14-In sales side (Debit) : 3625.14 + ( 8.63 * 60 ) =4142.94-For remaining quantity the formula is = ( Remaining Qty / total Qty ) * original amount issued-In Inventory side (Credit) : ( 60 / 480 ) * 4142.94 = 517.867. this value rounded off to 517.87. Hence the total becomes 3625.14 + 517.87 = 4143.01-Here the price difference is 0.07 ( 4143.01 - 4142.94  ) and the same got posted.

Title: Error "Unable to cast COM object of type" in Outlook Add-in
Content: Symptom-You installed the first time the SAP Outlook Add-in after launching Microsoft Outlook, you have the following error:-Unable to cast COM object of type 'Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook.ApplicationClass' to interface type 'Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook._Application'. This operation failed because the QueryInterface call on the COM component for the interface with IID '{00063001-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}' failed due to the following error: Library not registered.-Reproducing the Issue-Install SAP Outlook Add-in-Open Microsoft Office-Error-Cause-The issue is caused by a wrong registry file, this happens when you downgrade the version of Microsoft Office .e.g. 2010 to 2007.-Registry Key: HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\TypeLib\{00062FFF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046}-Here you will see that you have for example folders with numbers: 9.3, 9.4 or 9.5 - it depends of the versions of the Microsoft Packages-Outlook 2007      9.3-Outlook 2010      9.4-Outlook 2013      9.5-So when you downgrade, these folders are not deleted, if you went from Office 2010 the 9.4 will be present together with 9.3 from Office 2007.-Resolution-You should delete the folder related to the Microsoft Office that IS NOT installed in the computer.-Example:-If you have the 9.4 folder (from Office 2010) and you are using Office 2007 (folder 9.3). You should delete the folder 9.4, related to the Office 2010 that you do not have installed in your computer, inside the registry key:-HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\TypeLib\{00062FFF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046} - Obsevation: All of that with any program from Microsoft Office Package open (Excel/Outlook etc.)

Title: Manager's Substitute able to Self Approve his/her Expense Report
Content: Symptom-When a certain manager has active substitution, the substitute is able to approve his/her own expense report rather than forwarding to the line manager immediately above in the organizational hierarchy.-Reproducing the Issue-Using the Logon of a user who is an active substitute to his/her manager, the following are the steps to reproduce the issue:-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-In the open tasks, the user can find his/her own Expense Report.-Select the line entry for that expense report.-Select the Approve button.-Resolution-This happens if the option of self-approval is enabled in the Business Configuration — in this case, all users can approve any request sent to them for approval. Since the user is set as substitute for his/her manager, the expense reports that should be sent to the manager will be sent to the user who triggered them and, due to the rules of self-approval, this user will be able to approve the expense report.-To fix this, simply disable the self-approval option. Until system version 1402, this was done through a scoping question but since 1405, this has been moved to activity Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management > Edit self-approval and self-audit settings.-See Also-2036108 - Business Configuration Changes of Self-Approval of Expense Report

Title: Error Message : Copying document not possible; reference document is not active
Content: Symptom-The Error Message "Copying document not possible; reference document is not active" appears when you create a Follow-Up Service Order from Contract. The error messages disappears after few seconds and no data is copied from the Contract to the Service Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Show All Contracts and find contract ABC(ABC represents the ID of the contract).-Select the Contract ABC, click on Follow-Up Button and select Service Order.-In the Service order window, you will find the error message "Copying document not possible; reference document is not active" appearing only for few seconds.-You will also notice that no data including Account details, Line Items of the Contract is copied to the Service order.-You expect that the data is copied automatically copied from Contract to the Service Order since it is follow up service order.-Cause-The error message occurs because the Contract ABC has the validity with status "Not Released", you can check the same following below steps-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Show All Contracts and find contract ABC(ABC represents the ID of the contract).-Select the Contract ABC and click on Edit button.-In the Contract screen, you will find the validity of the Contract having status "Not Released".-Resolution-The follow up service order can be created for the contract once the validity of the contract is set to active. This is the expected behavior of system.-

Title: How to Create a Japanese Bank Account
Content: Symptom-When setting up a Japanese Bank Account it is not obvious what is needed to maintain National Bank Codes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Master Data sub view.-Go to the Bank Directory view.-Select your Japanese Bank Directory.-Select Add Row under National Bank Codes.-Enter National Bank Code: XXXX (Where XXXX represents the Bank Code).-Select National Bank Code Type.-Select Save.-When you try and enter the National Bank Code and save the information you will get an error 'SAVE FAILED'.-And you will also receive a warning Maintain Branch Name in Katakana if Company is in Japan.-Cause-When creating a Japanese Bank Account, it is not obvious how many characters are required for National Bank Code.-Resolution-National Bank Code is combination of Bank Code + Branch Code.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Master Data sub view.-Go to the Bank Directory view.-Select your Japanese Bank Directory.-Here we can see the Bank Code = XXXX-And there are two Branch Codes:-Branch Code: YYY, Branch Name: Japanese Branch (YYY represents the Branch Code)-Branch Code: ZZZ, Branch Name: Japanese Central Branch (ZZZ represents the Brank Code)-So, the National Bank Code = XXXXYYY and XXXXZZZ.-It is ok to ignore the warning message 'Maintain Branch Name in Katakana if Company is in Japan'.-Keywords-Japan; Japanese bank account; National Bank Code; NBC; branch code; Japanese branch; Japanese Central Branch; Katakana

Title: You Required Multiple Email Address for Each Account in Advanced Shipping Notification
Content: Symptom-You required multiple E-mail address for each Account in Advanced Shipping Notification.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Search for Account XYZ and select go.-Edit the Account and navigate to Communication tab and collaboration sub tab.-In Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound Business Document have only option to add one E-mail address.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-Multiple E-mail address for each Account in Advanced Shipping Notification is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: French VAT Return: Form Box 07- Achats en Franchise missing from the Tax Return tab in the User Interface
Content: Symptom-You execute a VAT Return for France and notice that the expected Form Box Code 07- Achats en Franchise (Tax exemption purchases) is not displayed in the Tax Return tab of the VAT Return as you would expect it.-If you try to map this specific Form Box to a Tax Event in Business Configuration Activity Tax on Goods and Services - France, it is not possible either.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Centre.-Go to Tax Returns View and open VAT Returns.-Show all Tax Returns an select Return ABC (where A stands for the TAx Retrun ID).-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Tax Return tab.-In the Tax Box Code column scroll down to find 07 -  Tax exemption purchases.-It is not displayed anywhere in Column Tax Box Code-Now, click on Preview button.-Scroll down and find 07 - Tax exemption purchases field.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. The Tax Return tab from the User Interface does not always reflect the VAT Return form to be given to the Fiscal Authorities.-07 is a box that holds a calculated amount and that is why there cannot be a direct mapping to it in Business Configuration as it is filled in with amounts coming from other UI Tax Box Codes.-Following your VAT Return, if any amount needs to be derived in Box 07 on the form, it will be calculated accordingly and filled in the form.-Resolution-To check this behaviour, you can do the following test:-Create a Supplier Invoice with the appropriate Tax Code: 8 - Exempted Domestic Purchase - Goods, for instance.-Execute a new VAT Return for the period including this invoice.-Open this VAT Return, navigate to the Tax Return tab.-Scroll down to find Tax Box Code 07B Not taxable Regularizations.-You can see that the amount reported here is the same as on the Supplier Invoice.-Select this line, click on the Details button.-The Supplier Invoice is maintained theere as well and is asociated to Tax Event 30 - Exempt Domestic Purchase of Goods.-Now, open the VAT Return form by clicking on the Preview button.-Field 07 TAx Exemption purchases is also fille din with the same amount as on the Supplier Invoice

Title: How to Download the Price List in Product and Service Portfolio Work Center
Content: Symptom-You need to download the Price List from Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price List view.-Select Base Price List from drop down menu and select the Go button.-Select a Base Price List and select the Download button.-Save the file and try to open the file.-The downloaded excel file does not show any data.-Cause-The download button on the Price List view is for downloading the template, it will not download the Price List data.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price List view.-Select Base Price List from drop down menu and select the Go button.-Select a Base Price List-Select the ID of the Base Price List, it will open the Price List factsheet screen.-Select the Download button.-Save the file.-The downloaded excel file will show the data of the price list.

Title: Financial Planning Data You Created is No More Visible and Shows No Records
Content: Symptom-You have created Financial Planning data under the Cost and Revenue work center. When entering the Planning view a message indicates No records found or an error shows UI application /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/fin/cm/cmowlfinplan.OWL.uicomponent is not in scope.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Planning view.-You see the message No records found or the error UI application /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/fin/cm/cmowlfinplan.OWL.uicomponent is not in scope.-Cause-You set the scoping question You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers to true and entered the plan data accordingly. Subsequently you have changed the scoping question You allow third-party software to create financial planning data as true. If you enter plan data using third party, you can not expect to see the data in Old Planning. These represent 2 different Business Objects (BO). Data is not deleted, but since you are looking at different BO data, it will not be shown.--Resolution-The system is behaving as expected. You will not be able to view the Planning Data you created unless you change back the scoping question based on which you created the data.

Title: You Want to Exclude Over-the-Counter Sales Documents From Invoice Runs
Content: Symptom-You want to exclude Over-the-Counter sales documents from Invoice Runs.-You have a specific business case where the Over-the-Counter sales documents may not require invoicing or immediate invoicing, however with the invoice runs the system generates the Customer Invoices. To avoid the creation of invoices for the Over-the-Counter sales document, you want a functionality so that the invoice runs would not consider them.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sale work center.-Create a New Over-the-Counter Sale document.-Enter the mandatory details and Save the document.-Now you want to exclude this document from the invoice runs.-Cause-In the current release of the SAP Business ByDesign, it is not possible to exclude only the Over-the-Counter Sale documents from the Invoicing Run.-Resolution-A workaround would be to exclude all Invoice Requests (Manual Invoice, Manual Credit Memo, Over-the-counter-Sales) from the Invoicing Run.-This would lead to the fact that all Manual Invoice Documents and Over-the-counter- Sale Documents have to be invoiced manually.

Title: Error Message "Conversion between UoMs XYZ and ABC is redundant"
Content: Symptom-When you maintain a Quantity Conversions between the UoMs XYZ and ABC, and upon saving system throws below error message:-Conversion between UoMs XYZ and ABC is redundant-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Edit a Material and maintain a Quantity Conversions-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you have already maintain a Quantity Conversion between these two UoMs. Hence, it not possible to maintain more than one Quantity Conversion for a same combination.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.

Title: All Contacts for an Account are not Displayed in the Target Group
Content: Symptom-All Contacts for an Account are not displayed n the Target Group.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the the issue:-Go to the Marketing work center.-Select New Target Group under Common Tasks.-Go to the step 2 i. e. Select Members.-In the Show field select the query Corporate Accounts.-Then add the Account Name ABC in the search fields and choose Go button (ABC represents the name of the account).-Only few Contacts related to account are shown in the result.-Follow the steps below to check number of contacts available for the account ABC:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Contacts view.-Search Contacts for the account ABC.-The result shows that account has far more contacts compared to the list shown in the Target Group screen.-Cause-You are not using the correct query for searching Contacts for a Account. The query Corporate Accounts with Contacts should be used for this purpose.-Resolution-Go to the Marketing work center.-Select New Target Group under Common Tasks.-Go to the step 2 i. e. Select Members.-In the Show field select the query Corporate Accounts with Contacts.-Then add the Account Name ABC in the search fields and choose Go button (ABC represents the name of the account).-The result will show all the contacts related to the account ABC.

Title: Cannot Create Invoice Requests From the Files Uploaded to the WebDav Folder
Content: Symptom-Cannot create invoice requests from the files uploaded to the WebDav folder.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Select the File Input subview.-Schedule the job for the run ID XXX (XXX represents the run ID).-No invoice requests have been generated in the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Cause-The files uploaded in the WebDav folders are erroneous.-Follow the steps below to check the error messages:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Select the File Input subview.-Select the run ID XXX and then select the Execution Details (XXX represents the run ID).-Open the latest Application Log ID.-Go to the the Results tab.-Following errors are shown:-Length of currency exceeds maximum length "3", specified with tt:maxLength while converting XML to data type for document.-The argument 'NaN' cannot be interpreted as a number while converting XML to data type for document.--Resolution-All files errors and before starting the import the you have to correct the files, you need to remove the existing files from the WebDAV and upload the corrected files again to it.-Remove the existing files from the WebDav folder.-Correct the files (external invoices).-Again upload the corrected files to WebDav folder.-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter.-Schedule the Run in the File Input subview of the Input and Output Management view.-Now the invoice requests is uploaded in the Customer Invoicing work center.

Title: Already Approved Sales Quotes do not Trigger the Approval Process Again if There is any Change in the Validity Dates
Content: Symptom-Already approved Sales Quotes do not trigger the approval process again if there is any change in the Validity Dates.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-The sales quote XYZ is already approved once.-Edit the sales quote XYZ and choose View All button.-Change the Validity Dates in the General tab.-Save the sales quote.-System do no trigger approval process again for the sales quote XYZ.-Cause-Changing the validity date after a sales quote is already approved will not change the approval status again and will not trigger the approval. Changes that affect the Price/Net Value of the quote will trigger approval again.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: The Address is Not Shown For the Party ID Added in the Sales Team of Opportunity
Content: Symptom-The address is not shown for the Party ID added in the Sales Team of opportunity.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities view.-Show All Opportunities and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the opportunity).-Edit the opportunity XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Involved Parties tab and select the Sales Team subtab.-Add the party ID ABC for a party role (ABC indicated the ID of the party).-No address detail appears for this party.-Cause-You have not maintained the address for the party ID ABC in the Business Partner Data.-Resolution-Go to the Business partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partners view.-Search for the business partner ABC (ABC represents the business partner ID).-Edit the business partner ABC and go to the General tab.-Add the country, then house number, postal code etc.-Save the business partner.-Now go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities view.-Show All Opportunities and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the opportunity).-Edit the opportunity XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Involved Parties tab and select the Sales Team subtab.-Add the party ID ABC again for a party role (ABC indicated the ID of the party).-The address details are available for this party.

Title: Retreive Creation Date and Business Partner of TextCollection in the Service Request via Web Service QueryServiceRequestIn_V1
Content: Symptom-You are using the outbound web service QueryServiceRequestIn_V1and would like to retrieve the TextCollection from the Service Request. The web service only sends back the data for the TypeCode and the ContentText. But the CreationDateTime and CreationBusinessPartnerFormattedName / LastChangeDateTime and LastChangeBusinessPartnerFormattedName is not passed back.-Cause-Since the CreationBusinessPartnerFormattedName / LastChangeDateTime is not a part of the message structure of the web service and the CreationDateTime is not filled in the Business Object it is not possible to retreive the respective data when you query the service request.-Resolution-It is only possible to retreive the TypeCode and the ContentText vie the web servie QueryServiceRequestIn_V1.-This is the current system behaviour.

Title: The Customer Invoice Form Does not Show the Text Added in the "Customer Information" Field of the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The customer invoice form does not show the text added in the Customer Information field of the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the line item XXX (XXX represents the number of the item).-You can see that the Customer Information field under the Notes subtab has the text added.-Now Go to the Document Flow tab of the sales order.-Open the customer invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-The text added in the Customer Information field of the sales order item is not available in the invoice.-Select the Preview button.-The Customer Information field of the sales order item is also not available in the invoice form-Cause-The customer invoice is created from the Third-Party Outbound Delivery, the Customer Information field of the sales order do not get transferred to the Third-Party Outbound Delivery,-hence the customer invoice created from any Third-Party Outbound Delivery do not collect the text entered in the Customer Information field of the sales order.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: An Error Occurred When Trying to Send an E-mail from the Marketing Work Center
Content: Symptom-You receive an error when trying to send an e-mail from the Marketing work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Select New E-Mail under Common Tasks.-Enter the mandatory fields (e.g. From, To, Subject and Employee Responsible).-Select the Save button.-An error occurs.-Cause-The ID entered in the From field is not available in the system. Since the system cannot find the From value an error is triggered.-Resolution-Add a valid From ID i.e. a business partner in the SAP ByDesign system:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Select New button and select Business Partner Person.-Add the mandatory details and email ID.-Save the data.-Now the error will not occur for new emails.-

Title: The Contact Name Does Not Appear in the Response Details of the Campaign
Content: Symptom-The Contact Name does not appear in the Response Details of the Campaign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Campaign view.-Show Active Campaigns and Find campaign ID XYZ  (XYZ represents the ID of the campaign).-Select the Campaign and choose Edit button.-Select View All and navigate to Response Details tab.-The Contact Name field do not display any data.-Cause-The contact is missing for response because the From party is maintained in the Response is Account instead of Contact. The system only shows the Contact Name in the Response Details of the campaign if the Form Party added in the campaign is a Contact.-You can check the Form Party in the response by following below steps:-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Campaign view.-Show Active Campaigns and Find Campaign ID XYZ  (XYZ represents the ID of the campaign).-Select the campaign and choose Edit button.-Select View All and navigate to Response Details tab.-Select the Campaign ID to open it in a separate screen.-You can find that the Form Party has Account ID.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: How to Check the Consistency of a Document in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You have an incorrect document and you want to check the consistency of the same.-Resolution-In order to check the consistency of a document you will need to know the Business Object of the document you want to check.-Steps to find ProxyName and BOField information from Document ID XXX (XXX stands for Document ID numeric sequence):-Open Document ID XXX in the tenant.-Click Help  > Technical Information.-Select Technical Information button.-Drag the green arrow to the Document ID XXX.-Go to Details tab.-Expand TextSourceInformation.-Expand Text.-Find ProxyName and BoField.-Steps to find the Business Object of the Document ID XXX:-Log in the Backend system STFK.-Start transaction MDRS.-Select MDRS Information System.-Go to Business Object.-Enter the Proxy Name in the Enterprise Service Name box.-Click Execute.-Double click on the Object Name.-Double click on Association to ACL.-Find Target BO Name.-Steps to check consistency of Document ID XXX.-Log in the Backend system STFK.-Start BO Test Shell (transaction SESFTS).-Enter BO Name in Load BO by Proxy Name box.-Click on Load BO Node Intances > Load by Query.-Select Root-Query_by_Elements.-Enter Document XXX ID in the ID field.-Right click on the Document ID XXX that has appeared on the left side.-Select Test Core Services > Manual Tests > Check_and_determine.-Change In_Check_scope to Attribute Value 1.-Click Execute core service.-Error message is displayed on the screen.

Title: While executing the Purchase Order Acknowledgement payload from SOAP UI, user gets the error SRT: Plain SOAP: Reliable messaging (RM) configured, but no Message ID and no WSRM assertion provided.
Content: Symptom-While executing the Purchase Order Acknowledgement payload from SOAP UI, user gets the error SRT: Plain SOAP: Reliable messaging (RM) configured, but no Message ID and no WSRM assertion provided.-Reproducing the Issue-Download the WSDL file from respective Communication Arrangement created and then compose a request on SOAP UI for Purchase Order Acknowledgement and then execute the Payload.-Cause-The Service Interface against the Purchase Order Acknowledgement has Reliable Messaging (RM) Configured. Hence, this interface expects a <messageId xmlns="http://www.sap.com/webas/640/soap/features/messageId/"> ﻿attribute on the Payload, in absence of which the system raises error in the Response.-Resolution-To resolve this, please provide <messageId xmlns="http://www.sap.com/webas/640/soap/features/messageId/"> attribute and value against it in the Payload.-For Example - <msgID:messageId xmlns:msgID="http://www.sap.com/webas/640/soap/fe atures/messageId/">uuid:005056ab-5b8d-1ed7-a0b6-a6db2da3fae6 </msgID:messageId>-NOTE: Here the value must start with uuid.

Title: Some of States Name are not in English
Content: Symptom-Some of States name are not in English on customer screen.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer workcenter.-Go to the Accounts view.-Click on New button to create new account.-Select the Country XYZ (XYZ is name of country).-Click on State field dropdown.-Here some states name are not in English.-Cause-Description of Regions currently maintain according to the description given in ""https://www.iso.org/obp/ui#iso:code:3166:JO"-Resolution-You can adjust the description to your needs in the Fine Tune activity. Kindly follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project.-Click on Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune-Search and Open Activity 'Regions'.-Here you can change the Region description as per your need.-Save.

Title: Restrictions and Access Rights are not Working Correctly for Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-Access rights and restrictions do not seem to be working. For instance, some users are able to see the stock in locations that have been restricted to them.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to the Stock Overview common task.-The user can see the stock available in locations that were not assigned to this user.-Cause-Access restrictions for screens, available in multiple work centers and views, consider the super set of all restrictions available.-If a restriction doesn't exist in any particular view, then it will not be available, if you access the screen from other view.-In this case, the user can still view all sites in the Stock Overview screen, because this screen is also accessible from other work centers such as Outbound Logistics, Production Control, Physical Inventory etc and user has not been restricted for all the work center views.-Resolution-You will need to restrict access for all the views, a screen is accessible from.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users view-Select the user and choose Edit-->Access Rights. Now you can restrict a particular user for all the views, from which Stock Overview is accessible.-You can also see access inconsistencies in the Edit Access Rights window.-Choose the Action-->Check Access Rights Consistency.-Filter for the Activity, in this case, Display Stock Details, you can see that there are many inconsistent access rights assigned for this activity. You will also be able to see all the views, relevant for this.

Title: How to fix load Issues with FSI Code Lists 'BO' using the FSI clean-up reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You face UI or Backend issues which are linked to the FSI Code List (technical BO name /1FS/CODELIST) or involved nodes. When you analyze the issue further you figure out that there were inconsistencies in FSI replication metadata.-These issues may happen after a Tennant copy or move, Hotfix deployment or upgrades activities.-This document will help you to analyze and solve such issues.-NOTE: These steps must be executed by Expert Support ONLY.-Reproducing the Issue-You face some errors or data inconsistencies while performing the following activities.-Possible Scenarios:-Unable to complete initial load or BO reload.-Error during replication of nodes into TREX.-BO cannot be checked.-Errors while opening a report or performing UI activities.-Object value selector list (OVS) is empty -Possible error message:-Background job /1FS/BUSINESS_OBJECT_INIT_LOAD failed.-Error in SFSG_FSI_LMEVENT_SPECIAL_LOAD while applying Add-On.-Report SFSG_FSI_LMEVENT_SPECIAL_LOAD for variant ran with errors while applying Hotfix.-FSI data is not loaded or is incorrectly loaded.-Reload of BO FSI Code Lists fails with a dump.-Measured Value: FSI load status is nconsistent:Current value: 1 > Threshold: 0 (HC: FSI Initial Load Check).-An error occurred while executing an ABAP program. (HC: Short Dumps).-SAPLSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATE (HC:Short dump).-Error: CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION at Program: SAPMHTTP.-Error Report poping up.-SAP.BYD.LS.UI.Core.API.Connectivity.BackendProcessingFailedException:-Transaction Id =-Session State = ToBeEstablished-Log Id =-Cause-There are inconsistent metadata entries for FSI codelist.-Resolution-In case you face inconsistent metadata entries for FSI codelists you can use the below reports to fix the issues.-Just start these reports in backend system in the particular tenant.-The report fixes the obsolete code list entries. Afterwards you may restart the load for code lists and the error won't occur anymore.-SFSG_CORRECT_CL_META_C_E_ENTRY – used for issues with initial load or extension code list.-You may run the report as follow:-Log in to the backend of the affected tenant.-Go to the transaction SE38 and run the report SFSG_CORRECT_CL_META_C_E_ENTRY. (The report runs just for 1 or 2 seconds).-Retry the action if required.-Note. You can check the result of the report as following:-Transaction SE16-Table SAUS_APP_LOG-Filter on REPORT_NAME = SFSG_CORRECT_CL_META_C_E_ENTRY-The report may return 1 hit with the message: No extension codelist correction necessary.-SFSG_DELETE_UNUSED_META_J_ENTR – used when there is an old entry in J table. e.g. anchor table not found (identify and correct the List of views having incorrect META_J entry)-You may run the reports as following:-Log in to the backend of the affected tenant.-Go to the transaction SE38 and run the report SFSG_DELETE_UNUSED_META_J_ENTR.-Make sure the flag is checked for the Only check - do not repair option. This will allow to check, the current client, for List of views having incorrect META_J entry.-If the report finds any inconsistency start it again with un-flagged check box Only check - do not repair.-This will then repair the metadata.-NOTE: To avoid such problems in the future these reports can be run before you start the tenant copy. e.g. you can check and repair the FSI metadata consistency in the source tenant.-See Also-Additional Information:-FSI Metadata Consistency Monitor - Link (Development Recording)-FSI Metadata Consistency issue - Link (Development Recording)-Overview Of Monitors I - Link (FSI Wiki)--

Title: The Tasks Created for the Lead Handover Remains Unassigned Although the Responsible Sales Person is Assigned to the Lead
