Content: Symptom-The tasks created for the lead handover remains unassigned although the responsible sales person is assigned to the lead.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Show Unassigned Items.-select item ABC (ABC represents the unassigned task).-Select and open the application log XXX (XXX represents the application log number).-Go to the General tab of the Application Log.-Error message displayed: Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization.-Cause-For the responsible employee maintained in the handed over leads no email ID has been maintained.-It is mandatory to have email ID for the responsible sales person for getting the approval tasks.-Follow the steps below to check if the email ID is maintained for the responsible sales person:-Go to the Marketing workcenter.-Go to the Leads view.-Show All Leads and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the lead).-Open the lead XYZ.-No email ID is maintained for the sales employee under the field Employee Responsible - Sales.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to maintain email ID of the sales employee to avoid this issue in future:-Go to the Business Partner Data Work Center.-Go to the Business Partner view-Show All Active Business Partners and Find DEF (DEF represents the ID of the employee).-Edit the Business Partner and Select the Link Employee.-Edit the employee.-Maintain a valid email ID for the employee.-Follow the steps below for assigning the un-assigned tasks manually to the sales employee:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Select the Business Task Management subview.-Show All Unassigned Tasks and Find the task ABC (ABC represents the task ID).-Select the task ABC.-Choose Actions button and select the Assign Item.-Search the responsible employee in value help.-Select the responsible employee DEF and choose Ok. (DEF represents the ID of the responsible employee).

Title: Opportunities are Not Displayed in the Report "Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager)”
Content: Symptom-You as a manager and want to check the report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager), however the expected opportunities are not displayed in this report.-Reproducing the Issue-Check the report:-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Report - List view.-Open the report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager).-Run the report.-You cannot see the expected opportunities in this report.-Check the opportunities:-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities - Opportunity List view.-Search and open the expected opportunity.-You can see the Relevant for Forecast checkbox is ticked, you expect this opportunity to be displayed in the report.-Cause-In the sales target plan, only the opportunities which have items maintained are listed in the sales target plan including the report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager).-Resolution-You have to maintain an item in the opportunity in order to display the opportunity in the report.

Title: User Can Not Add Response to a Campaign
Content: Symptom-User cannot add response to a Campaign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Select the Campaign Management view.-Open any Active campaign.-Select the View All button.-Select the Response Options tab.-The Add Row button is grayed out.-Cause-You can only add the response to a Campaign before its execution. The Add Row button will grayed out once the execution of Campaign is done.-Resolution-This is the expectd behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Unable to Update Address of a Contact Using Mass Data Maintenance & Migration of Customers Activities
Content: Symptom- You are not able to update the address of a contact using both Mass Data Maintenance & Migration of Customers activity.-1) When you try to update the Address of a Contact using the activity Migration of Customer, you get the below error message:-Error: Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER-CONTACT_PERSON with key UUID-CONTENT = `XYZ` does not exist-Or-2) When you try to update the Address of a Contact using Mass Data Maintenance, no changes happen in the Address tab of Customers after successful execution.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Mass Data Maintenance workcenter-2) Select Import Customer link.-Or-1.Go to Business Configuration workcenter-2.Select Implementation Projects view.-3.Search and Open the migration activity of Customers-4.Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Note: The mode of migration is Modify Already Existing Records- Cause-This is expected system behavior. Modify Already Existing Records or Enhance Already Existing Records is not supported to update Address of a Contacts.-Resolution-You can manually update/add the Address of a Contact from user interface following the below mentioned steps:-1. Go to Customers workcenter.-2. Select Contacts view-3. Select the tab Address-4. Select the required information address and update.-5. Select the Save button to save the changes

Title: Error: Incompatible source file (*.csv) While Uploading *.csv File in Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You want to upload .CSV files in Migration Tool and you receive below error:-Incompatible source file (*.csv)-Business Requirement: Import all tabs of Customer migration using single .csv file.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Overview.-Search Migration of Customers.-Upload .csv file using Data from Migration Template.-You recieve above error message.- Cause-Error is justified, please use option: Upload from Text File.- Resolution-Import the file with below steps:-Download the Template from You Can Also link and use Download .csv template.-Select Actions-Select Create-Add the File Name and Select the Migration Mode-Select Upload Data from Text File-Upload the CSV file which you have saved-Map the values-Add another .csv file using Upload Data from Text File.-Follow all steps from abaove and repeat untill all the .csv files of all tabs are uploaded,ex: Address, Contacts etc.-Note: Do not use more than 15000 records at a time for import. This may create performance issues.-Suggested to perform migration of one tab at a time and not upload all tabs together for better peroframce for bulk records more than 25000.

Title: Cannot activate Price per Period Indicator for a Product in a Contract
Content: Symptom- You are not able to activate the Price per Period indicator for a product in a contract.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Click on the New button and select the Contract option.-Enter all respective details.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add a product.-The Price per Period indicator is disabled and cannot be activated.-Cause-The product that you added to your contract under the tab Items has the item type Product – contract and therefore is a Material and not a Service. The field Price per Period can be activated in combination with an invoice schedule that was created for an item. This invoice schedule has to have the Schedule Type Period fixed price for a service which has a quantity unit which describes time (e.g. hours, working days etc.). Therefore, the Price per Period indicator can only be activated for the following item types:-Service - fixed price-Service - fixed price without actuals-Expense - fixed price without actuals-Entitlement - fixed price-Entitlement - fixed price without actuals-You can find further information in the Help Centre document Invoice Schedule. -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Clear Option is Grayed Out While Clearing Migrated G/L Account Open Items
Content: Symptom-Not able to clear the Migrated G/L Account Items as the Clear Option is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to General Ledger Accounts view.-Select the G/L account, click Edit button and Go to Open Items on Selected Account.-Show Open Items and select the checkbox for Open Items clearing.-Notice that the Clear tab is grayed out.-Cause-The Clear tab is grayed out due to the reason that different Open Item Reference Description for the migrated G/L Account open items have been assigned.-Resolution-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to General Ledger Accounts view.-Select the G/L account, click Edit button and Go to Open Items on Selected Account.-Show Open Items and choose Remove Assignment tab.-Choose Assign tab and Go to Assign Existing Open Item Reference.-Select the Open Reference ID and choose Ok tab (Open Reference ID should be same for both Open Items, which you want to clear against another Open Item).-Select both the Open Items and choose Clear tab.-Keywords-Migrated G/L Account Open Items; Assign Existing Open Item Reference

Title: Error Message: "PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure" While Updating Price Lists with Migration
Content: Symptom-When trying to update an existing Price List through Migration, you receive error message on Step 3 saying:-"PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure".-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center, Overview view-Search for migration of price list-Click the link and access the migration tool-Upload your migration file-Click Execute Migration and then, Execute Migration Step by Step-Conduct the migration until the Simulate Import step, where the error occurs-Cause-This issue occurs because you are trying to update the CopyRefProductID1 field.-Resolution-The CopyRefProductID1 field is a key field of Price Lists and thus, it's not modifiable once the Price List is created — it becomes read-only and cannot be updated. As a workaround, please Cancel Release of the existing Price List and migrate a new one with the correct data for the CopyRefProductID1 field.

Title: Missing the Net Amount Field in G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-You want to show Net Amount field in G/L Accounts - Line Items report, but cannot find it available.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Reports view and List subview.-Search for report G/L Accounts – Line Items.-Choose the selection criteria you want to use.-Click on Go.-Go to Settings option.-Select Key Figures.-You cannot find Net Amount option in Available Key Figures.-Cause-This report does not show the Net Amount data. This is standard system behavior.-Resolution-If you need this data to be displayed in this report, you can create a custom Key Figure and add it to the G/L Accounts – Line Items items. You have further instructions on how to create a Key Figure in the Help Document: Create and Edit a Key Figure, which can be found via Help Center.-After that, in the report tab, click on Add Fields button, in the tab key figures select the options you wish, then click on Ok.

Title: Contracts Data Sources don't show all the existing Contracts
Content: Symptom- You are looking for a way to pull out all the Contracts in the Customer Contract Item Period Values data source, including those ones set as In Preparation status, however the Contract Data Sources (with the pattern technical name: CRMCCO*) only bring up the contracts with the lifecycle: In Process, completed and Released status.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to Design Data Source View-Find the Data Source name: Customer Contract Item Period Values-Click on Preview button-Move to the rows the characteristics: Contracts and Lifecycle Status-Cause-The data source Customer Contract Hearder (Technical name: CRMCCOHB) shows all status, such as: In Preparation, In Process, Completed and Released lyfecycle status.-The data source Customer Contract Item (Techinal name: CRMCCOIB) shows the following status only: In Process, Completed or Released;-The data source Customer Contract Item Period Values (Techincal name: CRMCCOIPB) shows the following status only: In Process, Completed or Released;-Resolution-It's the correct system behavior.

Title: Tax Amount not Zero for SII Reporting: Only One Tax Item From The Invoice is Being Considered
Content: Symptom-You have created an incoming supplier invoice from a foreign supplier. In such scenario, not VAT should be recorded, hence the system shows two tax entries, one debit and one credit VAT. However, only the input VAT is being reported in the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos.-Open the relevant invoice.-Go to Items tab.-Click Taxes tab.-You see two VAT entries, one receivable and one payable, which offset each other.-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns view.-Open the concerned SII return for Incoming Invoices.-Go to Tax Return tab.-Highlight the invoice you've checked in above steps.-You see that both Deductible VAT Amount and Gross Amount fields are not zero.-Cause-As per requirement, for reverse charge and for Intra-community acquisitions of goods only the Input VAT has to be reported as SII to the tax authority.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior for the presented scenario.

Title: Why it is not Possible to Assign More Than one Product Category to a Cost Center in an Org Unit?
Content: Symptom-If you define an Org Unit as a Cost Center, then you are allowed to assign a Product Category to that Org unit. But it is possible to assign only one Product Category to that Cost Center. What is the reason for this behavior?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the Org Unit (Cost Center) and go to Definitions tab.-Select Details link adjacent to Cost Center.-Where, you are allowed to assign only one Product Category.-Cause-The usage of this feature is to get the Postings made against the cost center for the selected Product category in the report Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme in Cost and Revenue work center. -System cannot decide which Product Category has to be filled at the Cost Center. The Product Category most relevant to the Cost Center has to be entered at the Cost Center level if required for analysis. However, this is an optional field and it can be ignored, if there is no postings exist for the Cost Center.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Question:-So basically when four products categories are used at a cost center, these cannot be evaluated. But why does this work for revenues/customer invoices?-Answer:-We get the Product Category from the Sales scenarios from the Product in the Accounting Document. However, we do not get this information from Purchasing; hence we refer to the Cost Center assignment. There is a proposal to provide this link in Financials in future releases

Title: Response XML For A2X And B2B Web Services
Content: Symptom-Response XMLs for A2X & B2B web services in SAP Business ByDesign.-No Response message shown in External Interface (API) tool i.e. SOAP UI for B2B web services like Advanced Shipping Notification WSDL.-However, the Response message is displayed in External Interface (API) tool i.e. SOAP UI for A2X web services.-Cause-A2X services are Synchronous services, in that the response is send back in the same call. Essentially the concept is A2X service is for UI consumption, synchronous accesses and normally user get error message right away if something wrong, and user should be able to consume these service directly if required.-Whereas B2B services are Asynchronous services, no response is sent back in the same call, but response can only be viewed via business communication monitoring View in Applciation and User Management Work Center. Further, A2A or B2B process, in major case, will include forward error handling etc and need involve middleware.-Resolution-This is the standard protocol behavior.

Title: Cannot See Work Center Even Though Changes Are Scoped With Change Project
Content: Symptom-The user has recently closed its previous implementation project and created a new project. He has scoped a particular work center, but he is unable to see the work center in the system.- Reproducing the Issue-To see the scoping-Go to the Work Center- Business Configuration-Go to the view-Implementation Projects-Show All current Projects-Select the newly created project and click Edit Project Scope-Go to the 3rd Guided Activity Scoping-View whether the functionality or Work Center is scoped or not- It  would be scoped- Now, find whether the work Center exists in the system or not.-Cause-Probably, the New Project status is “In preparation” and the scoping is not complete. Also, the live solution is not affected by the changes until they are merged with the production system. And therefore you are not able to see the changes.-Resolution-Any scoping decisions you make as part of your change project are initially deployed when you complete the Confirm Milestone: Scoping Completed activity in the Prepare phase of the activity list. After confirming this milestone, if you return to the Edit Change Project guided activity and make any further scoping changes, the changes are deployed only once you click Finish again.- Once , the Confirm Milestone : Scoping Completed activity is completed the changes need to be merged with the production system. Only then will the changes be visible.

Title: Unable to Find the Questions About Certain Country's GAAP When Editing Project Scope
Content: Symptom-You are editing a project scope. You have selected a country, such as Mexico, in the scope. Now, you want to check the questions about the country's GAAP. But, you are not able to find them.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center -Go to View Implemantation Projects  -Select the Project you are editing -Press the button Edit Project Scope -Select a country, such as Maxico, in the Phase Country and Type of Business -Press Next button till the phase Questions -Select the display criterion in Show bar as Decision-Relevant Elements -Go to the business package Financial and Management Accounting -Go to business topic General Legder-Choose business option group Accounting Principles-You will find that you are not able to find the country's GAAP , such as Mexican GAAP.-Cause-Once a country, such as Maxico, is scoped, the country's GAAP is selected via constraint. For it, you do not need to do any decision. So, when you display the element in the criterion Decision-Relevant Elements, you are not able to see the country's GAAP.-Resolution-In order to see the country's GAAP, please use the criterion All Elements in Show bar. But the questions about the country's GAAP are Read-only.

Title: SAP Business ByDesign is Compliant with EU and French Legislation (Article 286)
Content: Symptom-You wish to know if SAP Business ByDesign is compliant with the EU and French legislation (specific asked for article 286 of the general tax code).-This article states that the system has a proper accounting management solution with data inalterability, security and archiving conditions.-French Law reference:-http://bofip.impots.gouv.fr/bofip/10691-PGP.html?identifiant=BOI-TVA-DE CLA-30-10-30-20160803-Resolution-According to our Local Product Manager department, SAP Business ByDesign is certified in France with standard NF203 that covers the mentioned law text.-Go to website infocert.org.-Click on tab List des produits certifies.-Search for SAP Business ByDesign.-The certification was granted during version 16.08 but is valid for the year.

Title: Unable to Migrate Sales Orders Using Migration of Open Sales Order Activity
Content: Symptom-Migration of Open Sales Order is failing using the Migration tool. You get the below error:-Error : "Service call failed"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Overview view.-Select and open  Migration of Open sales order activity.-Select and execute the required template.-Cause-There could be multiple reasons which could cause the Sales Order upload to fail. One of the scenario is listed as below:-If you try to migrate a Sales Order associated with Kit using Migration service(which is not yet possible) hence an error is being thrown.- Resolution-Currently the error message could not be thrown because of the dump.-The dump will be corrected in one of the future release however the Kit migration in Sales order is not in scope for near future releases.-As workaround you can use Sales order creation with kits through another web service : ManageSalesOrderIn.

Title: Unable to Terminate an Employee because the Termination Date Is Earlier Than Organizational Assignment Date
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded an employee through Data Migration, but you are not allowed to terminate the employee because the intended Termination Date is earlier than the Organizational Assignment Date.-Cause-There are two possible causes for this, which are:-The employee should be uploaded into the system through Data Migration, in which date consistency is not checked thoroughly.-There is an interval between the Hire Date and Organizational Assignment Date, and the intended Termination Date falls between these two dates. -For example, the employee's org unit is valid from DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 01/01/2000) but the employee's org unit assignment is starting from DD1/MM1/YYYY1 (e.g. 01/01/2011), regardless of the actual hire date being DD2/MM2/YYYY2 (e.g. 01/01/2003).-Resolution-The solution is changing the Hire Date of the employee temporarily to synchronize Hire Date and Org Unit Assignment Date, then the termination of the employee will be possible.-Change Hire Date of the employee from DD2/MM2/YYYY2 to DD1/MM1/YYYY1. This will synchronize Hire Date and Org Unit Assignment Date.-Change Hire Date back from DD1/MM1/YYYY1 to DD2/MM2/YYYY2. This will move both Hire Date and Org Unit Assignment Date back.-Now with the consistency of hire date and org unit assignment, date you can terminate the employee.-Please note:-Change of Hire Date will work only if the employee in question does not have any Transfer yet.-Step 2 will fail if the employee's actual Hire Date is before the Valid from date of org unit. In this case, it is not required to correct the Org Unit Assignment Date — you can terminate the employees with Termination Date DD1.MM1.YYYY1 directly.

Title: Unable to find Outbound File in Payment Monitor Advance Filter View
Content: Symptom-You have set the payments status to In Transfer by taking the action as Create Payment File/Batch.-You can see the created Outbound File in Liquidity Management work center under File Management.-System shows No Records Found upon searching for this Outbound File in the Advance Filter of the Payment Management work center and Payment Monitor view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view and Show Advanced Filter.-Enter the Outbound File ID XYZ in the field Outbound File ID.-No Records Found.-Cause-When you create Outbound File and sent to bank, then it has no connection with it's payments, and then on a later date if you change the status of payments again from In Transfer to Ready for transfer and discard the file.-(Discarded the payment file : XYZ).-During such instances, you will still find the Outbound File Under the File Management of Liquidity Management work center but No Records Found in the Payment Monitor view of Payment Management work center.-Resolution- Since the Outbound File status is independent and does not depend on it's payments anymore after the file is created, it will continue to show in the Liquidity Management even after the payments status were changed to Ready for Transfer and Discarded the file.- This is the expected system behavior.

Title: How to Create a Custom Search Query for Sales Quotes to Show the Same Results for Every User
Content: Symptom-You have created the search query ABC (where ABC stands for your custom query) for the Sales Quotes view using the Advanced Filter but the results of the query are different for each user.-Different employees can see different Sales Quotes under the query ABC. E.g. user A sees 9 results while user B sees 15 results when selecting it.-You expect that the same results are shown for every user when using the query ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales work center.-Open the Sales Quotes view.-Select the query ABC.-Cause-The issue is due to using the default query My Open Quotes instead of All when creating the new query ABC.-The custom query is not based on the default query All.-Resolution-Create your custom query based on the query All.-Go to the Sales work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Select the query All.-Select Show Advanced Filter.-Customize your query.-Select Save Query.

Title: Not able to create a Lead with OData APIs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Not able to create a Lead with OData APIs-Resolution-Use LeanLeadCollection in C4CODATA to create a lead also called a marketing lead . The endpoint should look like- https://<instance>.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/v1/c4codata/LeanLeadCollection-Keywords- LeanLeadCollection

Title: Unable to change column width of a Report in Byd HTML5
Content: Symptom-Unable to change column width of a Report in Business ByDesign in HTML5-Reproducing the Issue-1) Login to Business By Design HTML5 Client-2) Go to Business Analytics work center and open Design Reports Work Center View-3) Open the required Report and click on- Click here to start the report-4) Report opens-5) You cannot change the width of the columns of the report-Cause-Currently the option to change column width has not been provided for design reports.-Resolution-This is a current limitation.

Title: Data Incomplete after Migration of Master Data With Templates
Content: Symptom-After Data Migration with templates (e.g the template for Products, Production Models or Bill of Materials), you notice that data is incomplete: for example, parts of Description or Description Detail are missed. -Reproducing the Issue-The issue may happen on various templates.  We will put the template of Products as an example:-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to view Products-Go to sub-view By materials-Set search criteria as All Materials and search-You will see some data, such as Description or Description Detail, are not complete comparing the original information in the template cells.-Cause-The cells in several columns contain not only data, but format information that is preventing a correct interpretation of the corresponding cells.--Resolution-It is very important, to follow the instructions given in the Introduction tab of the template:-Use Paste Special > Values to copy columns from other lists. Do NOT USE the simple Paste, because it overwrites the original format information.--To move forward, please use a fresh template, and copy the content of your template sheets into the sheets of the new template following the Introduction.

Title: Error Message : "ID XXX not unique among branching, sequence, operation and marker"
Content: Symptom-You get the below error while migrating Bills of Operations using migration activity Migrating Bills of Operations:-ID XXX not unique among branching, sequence, operation and marker- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search and select Migration of Bills of operation.-Select Migrate Bills of Operation using Migration tool.-In the Migration tool select the file you want to migrate in Add new records mode.-Select execute migration step by step.-We get the error in the Simulation step-Cause-The data entered in the xml migration template is incorrect which you are trying to migrate.-In the sheet Operation and Mark Details, the Operation ID must be unique.-Resolution-In the Operation and Mark Details sheet, maintain a unique Operation ID and execute the migration again.

Title: Forms And Personalization Lost For User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Some users report that personalization are lost and/or the forms are not all visible (just some).-Usually this will trigger an incident that they suddenly lost the personalization/forms.-Cause-The user or key user has assigned PDI_DEVELOPMENT role for the user or business role.-When this access right is assigned to the user/business role this behavior will happen as PDI_DEVELOPMENT should only be assignned to PDI development user(SDK) and not regular Business Users-Resolution-Please remove the PDI_DEVELOPMENT Access Right from User or Business Role.-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter-Open Business Users View-Search and Open the related User ID-Go to Workcenter Assignments View-Check for Role related to PDI_DEVELOPMENT-Uncheck it-Click Save-In addition you need to check in backend if the Table from PDI_DEVELOPMENT still shows the user assigned:-Open system Backend-Go to Transaction SE16-Open Table PDI_DEVELOPMENNT-Press F8 in the new screen-Check in the list of user the related user is shown (it will show the BACKEND USER ID - you can check under Business Users as well for the backend user ID)-Click in Table option-Delete-Confirm the new box-Now if the user is logged you need to ask him to log off and then log back to the system and check the forms/UI that is affected.

Title: Payment File Does Not Generate a Line for Each Invoice
Content: Symptom-You created a payment for multiple Invoices and while generating the Payment File, system does not create a line for each Invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management Work Center.-Go to Payment Monitor View.-Select the Payment ID ABC.-Click on Actions > Create Payment File.-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to File Management > Outbound Files.-Click on the File ID XYZ.-Click on View All button.-Download the attachment.-System created only one line for the entire payment, instead of a line for each invoice.-Cause-It is not possible to have different payment line items for each invoice if you are paying the all the invoices at the same time.-Resolution-You can clear the invoices separately and generate the Payment File, then system will create different lines in Payment File against different invoices.-You can either enter Memo Lines, with the Invoice IDs, while posting the payment and the memo lines will be displayed in the Payment File.

Title: (GERMAN SCENARIO ONLY): No Legal Insurance For Dominating Mangaging Director For a GmbH Company
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For a Dominating Mangaging Director for a GmbH Company in Germany is no legal mandatory insurance.-  Please see following link for further information: -  https://www.lexware.de/artikel/sozialversicherungspflicht-des-gmbh-geschaeftsfuehrers-richtig-beurteilen/-  This scenario is currently not supported by BusinessByDesign.-

Title: How to Complete Notification: Approved Purchase Order ABC Changed
Content: Symptom-You find there is a notification: Approved Purchase Order ABC Changed in your Manage my Area work center >> Approvals view.-But you find nowhere to approve this notification and don't know how to complete it.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Manage my Area work center-Approvals view-You can find the open task: Approved Purchase Order ABC Changed-You can find nowhere to approve it.-Cause-This notification is only to inform you that changes has been done to purchase order ABC.-You can find nowhere to approve it because no approval is required here.-Resolution-If you want to complete Purchase Order Changes notification, you have to follow these steps:-Go to Managing my Area work center -Approvals view-Search and find your notification: Approved Purchase Order ABC Changed-Select your notification-Click Actions-Click Acknowledge-You can acknowledge multiple notifications simultaneously by selecting the lines in the table and choosing "Acknowledge" from the "Actions" menu.-Then the task will be completed and disappear from the list.--In addition, if you do not want to receive any more messages of changes, and you are able to fine tune this configuration. You can follow these steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Implementation Projects view-Click Open Activity List-Search and find: Business Task Management for Purchase Request and Order-Open it and extend the list of Process: Purchase Order-Uncheck the box with the notifications for Approved Purchase Order <PurchaseOrderID> Changed-Save and Close-Then you will not receive any change notifications of approved purchase order.

Title: Error Message on Report General Ledger - Line Items: No Financial companies found in the system. Check Fin company set up
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are trying to execute report G/L Account - Line Items and are faced with an error message about the Financial Company missing: No Financial companies found in the system. Check Fin company set up-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Centre-Go to the Report View-Search for report G/L account -Line item, open it-The system loads and raises error messages without displaying any data in the report:-No Financial companies found in the system. Check Fin company set up.-Report inconsistent. It cannot be started.-Cause-This issue can come either from data missing in Integrate and Extend Activity Set of Books or from an issue with FSI view FSP_FIN_DEFAULTCOMPANY.-Please check Case Document 1901180 - Error : No Financial Companies Found In The System. Check Fin Company Set Up first before proceeding with FSI view reload.-Resolution-If an FSI view reload is necessary, make sure you have secured approval for backend corrections with the customer.-Consult with either a senior colleague or someone from the Technology and Architecture team before proceeding:-Connect to the system backend-Enter Transaction Code GFSSTM-Select search field Fast Search View-Paste view ID: FSP_FIN_DEFAULTCOMPANY-Click on Execute-In the Load status tab, check how long it would take to reload the view (the view is associated to BO /MOM/ORG_CENTRE)-Once you are sure that the reload will not take too long, go back to tab Node Persistence and select the view-Click on Persistence-Click on Refresh-Once the refresh is done, go back to the UI and execute the report again-If the FSI view reload was sucessful, the report should now display the expected data and no error mesage should be raised- See Also-Other symptoms of this issue might be:-Company name missing for associated Set of Books in General Ledger View Set of Books and Assigned Companies-Company name and Set of Books ID being replaced by "*" at header level in Open and Close Periods screen-Company ID missing from the Value Help when trying to create a Manual Journal Entry Vouchers-Cost Centre determination missing from manually created invoices-

Title: Unable to Extract Data Using Data Extraction Workcenter.
Content: Symptom-You get an error when you extract data using Data Extraction workcenter. When you check the Application Log you see the below error, however it does not specify the cause for job fail.-Error: 1 work packages failed; for further information see details section- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User management workcenter-Select Data Extraction view-Select New button-Select the required Extraction Object and give a Run ID and save-Cause-The job fails as there is not enough memory available. Depending upon the number of records/data in required Extraction Object, probably the package size used is too large.-Unfortunately, the correct package size depends on various factors therefore only best guess works in this scenario.-Backend Error:  Runtime Errors TSV_TNEW_OCCURS_NO_ROLL_MEMORY-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Select Data Extraction view.-Select New button.-Select the Package Active checkbox and provide the number of instances. -Enabling definePackage Size automatically performs the extraction in packages with each package containing the number instances selected.-Select Extraction Object and give a Run ID and save-

Title: Report on Bookable To Dates for Time Accounts not Correct
Content: Symptom-You want a report on the different Time Accounts and there Bookable To date to instruct Employees to take leave and clear their Balances before the end of the Bookable To date, otherwise their balance will be set to Zero.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work center-Select Design reports view-Search and select Time Accounts: Yearly-In the Edit Selection tab search for employee with the required ID-Cause-We can see the Extra Statotory Leave of x1 hrs for a particular year getting carry forwarded to the next year and making it a total of x1+x2hrs.-We can also see the posting date there, which shows the date for the leaves.-Resolution-Follow the steps and maintain the Key Figures properly and then extract the report.

Title: While Adding Immigration Data for Employees, the Drop-Down Options are Missing for the Type Field
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to add the Immigration Data for the Employees. While adding the Immigration Data, the drop-down options like Other, Visa, Work Permit does not appear in the Type field.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Select Employees view-Search for Employee ID-Select Edit-Go to tab Employment-Go to Immigration Data-Select Add Row-Select Type using the drop-down available-Cause-This is due to the below scoping question not scoped in your system.-Do you plan to record employee's Work Permit Status?-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select Edit Project Scope button-Go to Questions section-Expand Human Resources -Personnel Administration-Personnel File-Scope the question Do you plan to record employee's Work Permit Status?-Complete the scoping by selecting Confirm and Finish

Title: Cannot Add Field State In Tickets View
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add the field State to the Tickets view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service work center-Go to Tickets view;-Click on Adapt -> Edit Master Layout;-Add Fields;-State is not available for addition in the view.-Cause-State field from Service Location is only available in the Work Tickets view, as this field refer only to Tickets for service/repair for any product/registered product.--As the Tickets view refers also to Tickets that do not need service on customer site, the Service Location is not always relevant and therefore not shown.-Resolution-You can use the view Work Tickets to see the field State.

Title: Deactivated Fixed Asset Classes are Still Displayed in Fixed Asset Class Determination Task
Content: Symptom-You have deactivated SAP delivered Fixed Asset Classes in Business Configuration so that only the personalised ones (starting with Z) that you created could be displayed and used.-In the Fixed Assets work centre you notice that the standard classes are still being shown in the Edit Asset Class Determination Common Task.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work Centre.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project, click on Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune tab.-Search for Activity Fixed Asset Classes and open it.-Open Activity Asset Class Deactivation.-All SAP delivered Classes are deactivated.-  Now,  go to the Fixed Asset work centre.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Open Edit Fixed Asset Class Determination.-Click on the Add Row button and fill in the relevant information in each column.-Open the drop-down menu for Fixed Asset Classes.-The classes that you had deactivated are still displayed and can be selected.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior and can be explained as such:-The Fixed Asset Class Determination view is a Business Configuration screen which is independent of any company. This is the reason why it is not possible to restrict the Fixed Asset Classes in Business Configuration based on the deactivation list configuration.-As the Business Configuration activities and views are independent of the companies, restricting the Fixed Asset Classes based on the companies there (even if the class is deactivated for all the companies at once) is not possible.-To the contrary, the actual deactivation of the Asset Classes is company based. This means, you can deactivate asset classes for a specific company or companies in SAP ByDesign. For instance, company XYZ and ABC (where XYZ and ABC stand for the specific company ID in your system) can each have different classes deactivated for them specifically.-If you deactivate some or all of the Fixed Asset Classes for company ABC or XYZ, this restriction is taken into account and applied when you create new fixed assets for these companies: only the active classes are available from the drop-down menu.

Title: Message: “System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime” While Uploading the Migration File
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to upload data using the Migration workbench. Upon uploading the Migration File to the migration tool, system throws the below message:-System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime Message-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the migration activity-Select Upload and choose Data from Migration Template-Browse for the migration file-Select Upload-System loads for a while and throws the Message-Cause-Issue may be due to the Migration File size being more than 100 MB which may have resulted in the performance issue. If the number of records in the migration file are more, the performance will be relatively slow and the system will throw the Message.-Resolution-In case of such slow execution and Message, it is always advisable to optimize the Migration File. For a better performance of the migration tool, we recommend to upload the Migration File which does not exceed 100 MB.-Reduce the number of records in the Migration File and split the records into different files such that each file is not more than 100 MB and test the behavior of the file upload and execution in the migration tool.

Title: Service Agents are Missing in the Manager's Contact List
Content: Symptom-You, as a Line Manager, want to see all Employees and Service Agents under your responsibility in the Contact List of the Managing My Area WorkCenter.-But you can only see internal Employees in the list, Service Agents never appears in the Contacts List.-Reproducing the Issue-Optionally a Service Agents can be assigned to an Organizational Unit:-1. Go to the Organization Management Workcenter.-2. Select the Organizational Structures View.-3. Choose an Organizational Unit and Select the Employees tab.-4. You can see Service Agents are assigned to the Organizational Unit.-Service Agents never appear in the Manager's Contact List:-1. Go to the Managing My Area Workcenter.-2. Select the Overview View.-3. Navigate to the Contact List area.-4. Only internal Employees under your responsibility are listed, Service Agents are not visible. -Cause-The Contact List only contains a list of the internal Employees that are under your responsibility, as a Line Manager. Service Agents, as external Employees, do not appear on the list.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: This CD outlines the most commonly observed situations, which customers and/or partners may come across with regards to performance.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Scenario 1:-The response time observed by the end user is in line with the response time observed by SAP. This means, that the end user is experiencing an expected response time behavior. In this scenario, SAP confirms that the response time behavior is in line with SAP expectations.-Scenario 2:-The response time observed by the end user is caused by PDI coding owned by the customer. In this case, SAP does not own the intellectual property of this customer own coding. As a consequence, SAP is not allowed to change the customer own coding, and with that improve the response time observed by the end user. Here, only the customer can improve the coding, and with that reduce the response time observed by the end user.-We appreciate your understanding and request you to close this incident.

Title: Error “Initialization Failed" When Checking the Availability of an Employee
Content: Symptom-When you try to check the availability of an Employee system throws the exception Initialization Failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management workcenter-Select Resource Search-Search for an Employee and select Show Availability-Cause-The reason for the error is in availability calendar that the Name should be on 1st column (that's how it is designed), but you have changed it to any other positions using personalization or click and move.-Resolution-Re-arrange the columns in the Availability Calendar in such a way that the column Name is always the 1st.

Title: How to Fill the Discount List Information in Migration of Discount Lists Template?
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate the Discount Lists using the Discount List Type Code in the migration template and want to know what fields need to be filled, so that you can avoid errors during the migration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Discount Lists-Choose Migrate discount lists using the migration tool-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen-Select Download Migration Template-Resolution-The property valuation data in the migration template must reflect the different types for Discount Lists:                 -1. Overall Discount for Specific Customers (Discount List Type Code: 7PL1)                                               -This is a list with Accounts and Percentage as line items.                                                            -General sheet: leave the Account ID field empty                                                            -Items sheet: fill the Account ID field and leave the Product ID, Customer Group, and Product Category ID fields empty                                                           - 2. Product Discounts for Specific Customers (Discount List Type Code: 7PL2)                                                           -A list that contains all Products that will be discounted for Specific Customer                                                    -General sheet: fill the Account ID field                                                -Items sheet: fill the Product ID field and leave the Account ID, Customer Group and Product Category ID fields empty                                            -3. Overall Discount for Specific Customer Groups (Discount List Type Code: 7PL3)                                                 -General sheet: leave the Account ID field empty                                                            -Items sheet: fill the Customer Group field and leave the Account ID, Product ID and Product Category ID fields empty                                                           -4. Discounts on Product Category level for Specific Customers (Discount List Type Code: 7PL4)                             -A list that contains all Product Categories that will be discounted for a Specific Customer                              -General sheet: fill the Account ID field                                                -Items sheet: fill the Product Category ID field and leave the Account ID, Customer Group and Product ID fields empty

Title: Unexpected error during backend processing While accessing a Personal File of an Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you access a personel file of an Employee system throws an exception.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Edit an Employee-Go to Personal Data tab-Cause-The cause for the issue is that Multiple Scripts question is scoped in Business Configuration.-Ideal situation could be that you scoped only one language e.g. Japanese, so it is not necessary to scope Multiple Scripts.- Resolution-Below is the steps to avoid this dump:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementations Projects view.-Select the First Implementation and select Edit Project Scope button-Go to Questions section-Expand Built-In Services and Support >>Business Environment >> Addresses and Languages-Uncheck the question Do you want to specify textual master data using more than one script?-Next and finish the scoping

Title: Data Workbench error for Service "RelatedTransactions"
Content: Symptom-When trying to GET C4C Entity Metadata for Service Name: RelatedTransactions.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go To Mass Data Workbench Workcenter-2. Select Export-3. Select the Servce Type: Related Transactions--Error Occurs: Error Fecthing Data--Same issue with Import -> Related Transactions -> Download Metadata-Cause-The Resource identified by the request is only capable of generating response entities which have content characteristics not acceptable according to the accept Headers Sent in the Request.-Resolution-You can use Service Request Preceeding and Follow-up Items instead of RelatedTransactions--That is the standard delivered for RelatedTransactions.-The object named RelatedTranscation will be removed from Data Workbench.

Title: Cannot Find Cost Center Manager When Trying to Assign the Unassigned Approval Task for Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-System creates an unassigned business task for supplier invoice document under Business Task Management view. You tried to manually assign the task for cost center manager, however user is missing in the list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Task Distribution view-Go to the Business Task Management sub view-Select Unassigned Items and search for relevant Supplier Invoice-Go to Actions and select Assign Item-Search for Cost Center Manager-No Search Results-Cause-Cost center manager is not available in the list because user does not have a proper validity From and To dates maintained under Business Users view. (For example: Validity From Date - 01.01.1001 - Validity To Date - 01.01.1001) -Resolution-You have to update the proper Validity From and To dates for the user and the determine the assignments manually.-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the User and Access Management view-Go to the Business Users view-Search for relevant Cost Center Manager-Select Edit and choose Attributes-Under User Data, define Valid From/To dates for this user-Select Save and Close-Go to the Task Distribution view and select Business Task Management sub view-Select Unassigned Items and search for relevant Supplier Invoice-Go to the Actions and select Assign Item.-Search for relevant Cost Center Manager and now the user is visible for selection

Title: Unable to select assigned Project Task for an Employee While Recoding Time in the Timesheet
Content: Symptom-The employee is assigned to a project task. When recording time for this employee in the Timesheet, this project task is not displayed in Manage my Worklist.-The employee is expecting to see this task displayed here automatically as an active work package. However this is not the case. The task is displayed under Inactive Work Packages only.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Work Center Home.-Go to the Self-Service view.-Select Edit Time Sheet.-Select Manage my Worklist.-Select Active Work Packages view.-The assigned Project Task is not displayed here.-Cause-The required Package is in the Inactive Package List and Worklist has not been refreshed. Hence the task is not displayed correctly or automatically even though the employee is assigned to the Project/ Project task.-Resolution-Go to edit time sheet for required employee.-Select Manage My Worklist.-Select Inactive Work Packages from the drop down.-Now select required task and select the button Show in Time sheet.-Select the button Refresh Worklist beside the Manage my Worklist button.--Once the Worklist has been refreshed, the project task should be displayed correctly and automatically under the Active Work Packages view.

Title: Web Service Query Doesn't have KUT and PDI Fields
Content: Symptom-You are querying a Web Service, but the response doesn't have the KUT and PDI fields extended to that Web Service.-Cause-The reason that the PDI and KUT fields are missing in the response is that there is no value for these fields in the respective BO.-Resolution-So, the response will have the KUT and PDI fields only if they hold a value/text. If the fields are blank in the UI then they are not part of web service response.

Title: Information Required for Human Capital Management
Content: Symptom-Please clarify following information from the customer to proceed with the analysis of an HCM issue:-In case of Dump:-Workcenter and view for the reported issue.-Steps to reproduce the issue.-If only specific user is impacted or all users recieve this issue.-Permission to reproduce the issue.-In case of Unexpected System Behavior /  Error Message:-What is the error message.-Workcenter and view for the reported issue.-Steps to reproduce the issue.-Affected Employee IDs as examples to analyze the issue.-What is the current system behavior?-Whatis the expected system behavior?-What are the changes performed for the affected Employee IDs?-Specific Business Configurations or Settings in the system with respect to the expected behavior.-Attach screenshots for error screen and related settings.-Business Impact of this issue in your company.-Permission to reproduce the issue.

Title: Items Mismatch between Manager Approval App and Desktop
Content: Symptom-The number of Approval Items shown in Manager Approval App is not the same as shown in desktop-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to Manager Approval App-For example for a particualar User A the number of items to be approved is 20-Log in to Desktop-Here for the same user the number of items to be approved is 8-Cause-In the mobile App, we aggregate two different kind of time approvals-Project based times-Cost center based (HR based) employee times-In the desktop version, these can be found at different places: The project based times can be found in Project Management Work Center. The cost center based times, however, can be found under the path Managing My Area -> Common Tasks -> Confirm Time Recordings.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Error Message: "Material ID XXXXX Already Exists" When Trying to Update Materials on Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update Materials through the BC activity Migration of Materials. Even though your migration template is correct the system is throwing the error message Material ID XXXXX already exists﻿.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center and access the view Overview;-Search for the activity Migration of Materials;-Open the activity Migration of Materials and select the option Migrate Materials using the Migration Tool;-Select the option Upload data from Migration Template;-After uploading the template click on Execute Migration Step by Step;-After reaching the step ﻿Simulation﻿ you will get an error message.-Cause-By default the ﻿Migration Tool﻿ will have the ﻿Migration Method﻿ set as ﻿Add New Records﻿.-Resolution-Change the Migration Method of the file to Enhance Already existing records by following the steps below.-In the Migration Tool select the file which you need to change the migration method and click on Properties;-Select the migration method Enhance already existing records.-Alternatively, Materials can be updated through the Mass Data Maintenance work center.

Title: How to Book Time Sheet Entries in Work Days Rather Than Hours?
Content: Symptom-You haev a requirement to book Time Sheet entries in Work Days rather than Hours-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Home work center-2. Select Self Services Overview view-3. Select Edit Time Sheet-Resolution- It is not possible to book Time Sheet entries in in Work Days rather than Hours.--Time Recording from the Edit Time Sheet only supports Hours. Only the Leave Request scenario can take in Days but this is from the Leave Request which is done from Time Administration work center

Title: Information required for Connectivity Issues with SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer with ERP/CRM
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues efficiently, we should gather the following information: -Is the certificate signed off by authorized vendor ?-What is the direction in which data is replicated ?-What is the middleware?-If HCI – What is the iFlow version?-If PI – Is it 7.1(dual stack) or PI 7.3 (Java only stack)-What type of authentication method is used ? User ID &password or Certificate based ?-Do you have any Web Despatcher/Reverse Proxy maintained between On Premise System and Cloud?-Is there any firewall for outbound from On-premise to C4C ?-

Title: Information Required for Master Data Issues in Foundation
Content: Symptom-Kindly clarify the below information to process incidents for Master Data Issues in Foundation.-In case of unexpected system behaviour or error message:-Is this issue occurring in Test system or Production system.-Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-Name and ID of the Accounts/ Contacts/ Suppliers/ Materials/ Services.-Is the issue occurring with the Extension fields or PDI fields.-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-In case an error message occurs, provide complete error message and the action that triggered the error message.-What were the changes that were performed?-What is the actual result?-What is the expected result?-Is this a general issue? If the issue occurs for a specific user, provide the user ID.-If the error triggers after Save, provide permission to reproduce the scenario by performing Save.-Relevant error screenshot if any.-In case of dump:-Is this issue occurring in Test system or Production system.-Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-Name and ID of the Accounts/ Contacts/ Suppliers/ Materials/ Services.-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-If the dump triggers after Save, provide permission to reproduce the scenario by performing Save.

Title: Material Cost Estimate Is Not Considering The Number of Resources Maintained In The Released Execution Model
Content: Symptom-A Material Cost Estimate has been executed, and for a certain Service ID valuated it's understood that the Result (Cost Estimate) is not correct.-The expectation is that the calculated Result to be multiplied by the Number of Resources maintained for the respective resource in the Released Execution Model, but this didn't happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Material Cost Estimates view.-Search for the respective material and click over its Cost Estimate Result.-Under Service Items section, for a certain Service ID it's understand that the Result calculated is not correct.-The expectation is the Result to be multiplied by the Number of Resources defined for the Resource ID concerned in the Released Execution Model (REM).-For example:-In the Material Cost Estimate there's a service valuated with Valuation Method Service Cost Rate where the cost rate is 20,00 USD/h.-Following a REM where the Number of Resources = 30 for the respective resource and Variable Duration of 00:05:00, the expectation is that the service cost estimate to be 20,00 USD/h (cost rate) * 2,5h (variable duration multiplied by number of resources, in hours) * 30 (number of resources) = 1.500,00 USD.-However, the calculation done is different. The service cost estimate calculated is only 20,00 USD/h (cost rate) * 2,5h (variable duration multiplied by number of resources, in hours) = 50,00 USD.-Cause-Using the previous example, the system considers that each resource will work for 5 minutes, and that together they will work for 150 minutes (2,5 hours), and not that each resource will work alone for 150 minutes (2,5 hours).-This is why the Result is not multiplied by 30 again.-Resolution-The system behaves as expected and the Material Cost Estimate is correct.-Keywords-Material Cost Estimate; Number of Resources;  Released Execution Model; REM; Cost Estimate

Title: IDOC Payload not found - Business Communication Monitoring
Content: Symptom-You are trying to show the IDOC Payload of a processed message from Business Communication Monitoring but you get the Error Message:-"Payload not found".-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and user management work center.-Input and Output Management view-Select Business Communication Monitoring-Search for All business messages and filter to find the relevent Message ( "Business Partner / Communication System" )-Select the Message and click on Show Payload -> IDOC-Error appears "Payload not found".-Cause-If you refer to the documentation about "Business Communication Monitoring" from your system Help section, you will see the following:--"To view the information that was sent with the message, you can display the message payload. The following options are available:--•To display the payload for the communication with the SAP® Business Suite, click Show Payload and then choose IDOC.-•To display the payload for communication with all other systems, click Show Payload and then choose SAP ESD.--=> Note that depending on the service interface, the action may not be available."-  If your communicating system is not part of SAP® Business Suite, there is no IDOC Payload available. This is normal system bahaviour.-Resolution-If the IDOC is not available, the SAP ESD Payload should be.-Also you can download the SAP ESD Payload by clicking on the button "Download Payload"

Title: Manual GST Tax Entrie is Missing
Content: Symptom-GST Entries sub view is missing under Manual Tax Entries view under Tax Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click on Manual Tax Entries view.-Notice that there is no sub view GST Entries to create manual GST entries.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-This functionality is not supported by the system.-User has to create manual GST Entries for Australia.-Resolution-Use the following steps to create manual GST entries for Australia:-Go to Tax Management work center.-Under Manual Tax Entries view, click VAT Entries sub view.-Click New and choose the option Tax Entry.-As soon as you change the Tax Country to Australia, the Tax Number field will appear.-Keywords-GST; Australia; Manual Tax Entry

Title: Missing Day Balances and Credited Values in Time Statement
Content: Symptom-When opening the Time Statement of an employee in the Time Administration work center, the values for Day Balances and Credited columns are not available and not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view and mark the line of an employee.-Choose the View Time Statement button.-Select the concerned period.-Choose the Preview button.-Although values for Working Time exist in the Start and End columns, the values for Day Balances and Credited columns are missing.-Cause-No Working Time Account is assigned to the Time Profile of this employee. Only with an assigned Working Time Account, the Credited column shows the number of hours that are credited to this Time Account, and the Daily Balance column shows the daily balance of the Time Account after time has been credited to or debited from it.-Resolution-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Find an employee and choose Edit.-Go to the Time Profile tab.-Mark the line of the current Time Profile.-Assign a Working Time Account with a Time Account Rule that specifies how the balance calculation is done.-See Also-Find further information in the help documentation under the heading Working Time Accounts.

Title: Information required for web service related incidents in Technology
Content: Symptom-The following information are needed by product support to investigate and process issues related web service incidents:-Name of the communication arrangement which is used for the corressponding communication scenario-Screenshot that shows the erroneous web service messages (Go to work center "Application and User Management" > "Web Service Message Monitoring" or "Business Communication Monitoring")-What web service interface is used (e.g ManageCustomerIn)?-What web service operation is used (e.g MAINTAIN_BUNDLE_V1)?-What action code is used in the web service request?-Please attach original XML request and response-In case you are facing the issue in your test tenant, please provide permission to reproduce the scenario via SOAP UI and backend-In case the scenario is enhanced with custom fields, KUT fields, custom business objects or custom web service, please provide us the following, additional information (if issue is related to these enhancements):-Names of PDI or KUT fields affected-Name of the custom business object-Name of the custom web service (PDI solution ID)-Please provide us detailed information about what you are expecting to achive by executing the web service.-Resolution

Title: How To Restrict Common Tasks From Any Workcenter
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to restrict Single Common Tasks from any Workcenter for a particular user.-Reproducing the Issue-Choose any Workcenter for example Internal Logistics.-Navigate to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-System displays multiple Views.-Now on right side, you can see Common Tasks associated as per views selected in the workcenter.-Note: This is valid for all Workcenters-> Common Tasks.-Cause-Common Tasks is associated with the Work Center views. So if a work center view is assigned to any user, then that User can see all the floorplans associated with it.-It is not possible to exclude any single common tasks for a particular user.-Resolution-It is an Expected System Behavior.-

Title: Unable to select multiple Set of Books/Companies for Financial Reports
Content: Symptom-You are trying to run any financial report and you are able to select multiple companies. The same option of selecting multiple Set of Books is not available.-Reproducing the Issue-For Example:-Go to General Ledger work center-Click on Reports view-Selct the Report - G/L Account - Line Item -Here, you are able to select multiple Companies. But when you click on search option for Set of Books, you can select only one Set of Books-Cause-The data in financial reports will depend upon the Set of Books. The restrictions have been made to achieve consistenet data with respect to the selcted Companies and assigned Set of Books. -Resolution-As of now, the financial reports in SAP ByDesign system supports only multiple Companies with single Set of Books. This is standard system beahvior and cannot be change.

Title: Fixed Asset Procurement With Project Task Error Message: Project task XYZ is Other than Overhead Cost and Direct Cost Ledger account with Individual Material as Primary Account Assignment
Content: Symptom-You want to take advantage of the new Business ByDesign 1702 functionality of Fixed Assets Procurement with Project Task Assignment. For this you have defined Project Task as an Optional account assignment for account assignment type IMAT - Individual Material in fine tuning activity Account Assignment Types. After that, you are now using IMAT account assignment with a project task in a purchase order, goods and services receipt or supplier invoice, but system is throwing an error message right after you enter the Project Task:-Project task XYZ is other than overhead cost and direct cost ledger account with individual material as primary account assignment-Reproducing the Issue-Open the concerned Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice or Goods and Services Receipt-Under Items section, select the item and enter Account Assignment Type as IMAT - Individual Material-Enter the concerned Project Task and click Check-System throws the error message Project task XYZ is other than overhead cost and direct cost ledger account with individual material as primary account assignment-Cause-The project task type you have selected is other than Overhead Cost Projects or Direct Cost Projects (e.g. Customer Projects or Multi-Customer Projects).-The Fixed Assets Procurement with Project Task Assignment ﻿functionality was designed to support Overhead Cost Projects and Direct Cost Projects only.-You can check project types and its process variants in fine tuning activity Project Types.-Resolution-Please select a project task of type Overhead Cost Projects or Direct Cost Projects.-See Also-ByD 1702 Help Documentation:-What’s New in Financial Management > What’s New > Fixed Assets

Title: Journal Entry Voucher Postings Shows Different GL Accounts than the Manually Entered
Content: Symptom-You are trying to simulate a Journal Entry Voucher and see that the General Leger Accounts picked are not the one manually entered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Leger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries View.-Go to the Journal Entry Vouchers Sub view.-Click on New button and select Journal Entry Voucher.-Maintain the relevant Data (marked with *) and check that the Set of Books is relevant.-Further down, click on Add row button.-In the G/L Account column, Maintain the G/L Account ID XYZ manually.-Click on Simulate.-You observe that, the simulation of Journal Entry Voucher is successful but it shows different general leger accounts ABC than what was entered before simulation.-Cause-There is a mapping configured between the Chart of accounts. You can check this by going to-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select GL Account Mapping.-Search for GL accounts XYZ which belong to chart of accounts PQR and are mapped to GL accounts ABC respectively.-This is consistent with the simulated journal entry generated by the journal entry vouchers created.-Resolution-You can define a mapping for G/L accounts that are used in different charts of accounts.-This mapping is applied in cases where journal entry vouchers are to be posted in all sets of books for a company and the sets of books do not all use the same chart of accounts.

Title: Warning Message "The file you are uploading includes the follwoing column(s) that is not part of the active source view"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to upload a Customer Migration Template, system throws below warning Message-The file you are uploading includes the following column(s) that is not part of the active source view: XYZ. Data from these columns will not be uploaded.-*XYZ - Is the combination of Sheet name - Column name/field name-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity-Select Upload and then Browse.-Cause-The cause for the issue is, that the field XYZ is not supported in the partial use mode. Not all fields/sheets can be used in enhance mode migrations. Fields that are not supported will be omitted during file upload and will not be available for further processing. For the same reason these fields will be cleared in case you are uploading a "normal" migration template and are then later switching the file property to partial use/enhancement mode.-Resolution-In partial use/enhancement mode, use only the fields and sheets that can be made visible in the migration cockpit for files with this property.

Title: Employee Does not Exist Upon Plan Upload
Content: Symptom-You are uploading a new plan data for expenses and income statement, however you receive an warning that the employee responsible does not exist.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center-Go to Plan view-Click New and choose your plan type to download in Excel.-Fill in the Excel properly and specify the Employee Responsible.-Upload the file via Save data to in the Excel add-in-You see the following warning: Employee <employee name> Does not Exist-Cause-In the Employee Responsible field, you've specified either the full name or user ID of the responsible employee, whereas the field only accepts the employee ID.-Resolution-In order to properly inform the responsible employee, please specify the employee ID in the field.-The employee ID can be found as follows:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view

Title: Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry: Cost Center and Project Task Fields Not Available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Starting in ByD 1702 release, it is now required to enter G/L Account information for each item while creating a manual entry of withholding tax.-You then enter a G/L Account and receives the error message Mandatory account assignment for account XYZ is missing: Cost Center, Project Task, which is expected since for the respective G/L Account Determination Group you defined CC - Cost Center and PRO - Project Task as mandatory account assignment types in fine tuning activity Mandatory Account Assignments.-Finally, you try to find the Cost Center and Project Task fields to enter the required data, but the fields are not displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Go to Manual Tax Entries > Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries view-Click New > Tax Entry, enter the concerned G/L Account which requires Cost Center and Project task account assignments-Notice that Cost Center and Project Task fields are not available in the screen, not even if you go to Personalize menu.-Cause-Currently, system does not support Cost Center and Project Task with Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry.-Resolution-System behaves as expected here.-You have two options:-1) To choose another G/L Account which does not require Cost Center and/or Project Task account assignment-2) Remove the mandatory account assignments for the concerned G/L Account and try again-See Also-SAP Community: Release of SAP Business ByDesign 1702-https://blogs.sap.com/2017/02/03/release-of-sap-business-bydesign-1702/

Title: Issue with the Hidden Tab 'Contacts-Marketing Permissions' during Migration of Customers
Content: Symptom-Unable to migrate the unhidden Tab Contacts-Marketing Permissions during the Migration of Customers.-Error Message: The File you are uploading includes the following sheet ( s ) that is not part of active source view. Contacts-Marketing Permissions Data from these sheets will not be uploaded.-The Tab 'Contacts-Marketing Permissions' is a hidden tab when open the Migration of Customer Template. Even unhidden and populated, the Tab 'Contacts-Marketing Permissions' will not show up during during file validation.- Reproducing the Issue-First, Unhide and maintain the Tab 'Contacts-Marketing Permissions'-Then-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select the Implementation Projects Subview-Click on the Activity List Tab-In Show field, Select All Activities-Select All Tab-Search for Migration of Customers-Select and click Open-Select Migrate Customers using the Migration Tool-Upload the Migration Template XYZ-Observation:-ERROR MESSAGE: The File you are uploading includes the following sheet ( s ) that is not part of active source view. Contacts-Marketing Permissions Data from these sheets will not be uploaded.- Cause-The mentioned behavior is expected.-Resolution-'Contacts-MarketingPermission' sheet will be supported in Mass Data Maintenance scenario only. i.e. Contact Marketing Permission can be modified through Mass Data Maintenance and cannot be created/updated/deleted using migration activity.--Additionally, if you unhide a hidden sheet and expecting it to work is incorrect.

Title: Embedded Report Cannot be Displayed - Check Variables; No Valid Contribution Margin Scheme Found - Cost And Revenue Overview
Content: Symptom-You are navigating to the Cost and Revenue workcenter Overview.-The Profit Analysis - Company report does not generate any data.-Instead, two error messages appear: Embedded report cannot be displayed; check variables. No valid Contribution Margin Scheme found.-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business ByDesign press on the Cost and Revenue workcenter. Automatically the Overview view opens. Alternatively, navigate to the Overview view of the Cost and Revenue workcenter.-The Profit Analyis - Company report in the bottom half of the screen is empty. Two error messages appear: Embedded report cannot be displayed; check variables. No valid Contribution Margin Scheme found.-Cause-The Profit Analysis - Company report is based on the Contribution Margin Scheme, i.e. the Function of Expense accounting method. The report uses the contribution margin scheme from a financial reporting structure of type Income Statement by Function of Expense. In your system, however, no reporting structure of this type is maintained:-Resolution-If you need the Profit Analysis- Company report to generate data in the Cost and Revenue Overview you need to add a function of expense reporting structure, for instance, by adding a standard reporting structure with the copy function:-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Overview.-Find the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity and press Change Immediately. Or, if your system is not live yet, access this activity from Fine Tuning in the Implementation Project.-In the next screen press on the Edit financial reporting structures link.-Press Copy from Template - With Assignment.-In the following, little pop-up window select an appropriate financial reporting structure (Template), of type I/S by Function of Expense.-Maintain a reporting structure name.-Assign the right chart of accounts.-Press OK.-Then, back in the Financial Reporting Structures screen press Save and Close.-After this the Profit Analysis- Company report will generate data in the Cost and Revenue Overview.
