Title: You Are Unable To Edit/Adapt The Overview Screen Of Home Work Center
Content: Symptom-You are unable to edit/adapt the overview view of home work center as all options are grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Choose Enter Adaptation Mode under the drop-down list of Adapt tab.-Choose Yes.-Choose Edit screen under the drop-down list of Adapt tab.-You can see that all options are grayed out.-Cause-In the current versions of SAP Business ByDesign it is not possible to edit the Overview screen of any work center.-However you can personalize them to any background image, quick links/content and reports specific to user.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to update the content/link to Overview view of Home work center,-Go to Home work center.-Choose This Screen under the drop-down of Personalize tab.-Select Available Content.-Check/Uncheck the required content.-Save.-Kindly follow the below steps to add the report to Overview view of Home work center.-Go to Home work center.-Choose This Screen under the drop-down of Personalize tab.-Select Add a Report.-Choose the relevant report and navigate to General Properties.-Provide a Title if required and Appearance.-Under Properties, if applicable, select the default view format and variant.-Choose Add.-Save.-See Also-The same logic applies for Overview view of every work center of SAP Business ByDesign.

Content: Symptom- - Have you checked if a new version is available ? If yes install new version and test again-- Are the questions scoped in the the Business configuration? please check documentation-- Is the problem happning to a specific User or several Users?-- Please give User ID the problem is happening to.-- Make sure the User do not has his Email Address maintained more than once in the system and it is unique to the User.-- If possible, please provide Reference to your Test system where the issue can be reproduced. This includes the URL,-user details and steps for replicating the issue; Along with your Authorisation to reproduce the problem. -In cases where the issue cannot be replicated in the Test system (for e.g. add-in crash), please indicate the same.-- Detailed Logs -The log should be collected as follows:-Copy the default logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%/SAP/C4C/logs-If detailed logging is not turned on, enable the same.-Now replicate the issue and as soon as the issue has been reproduced, close Outlook and copy the logs.-Closing outlook is required to flush out any logs that are still in cache and not written.-The logs provide most information as required in [DOC1] and can be viewed using the procedure mentioned in [DOC2]-- Configuration Files-The local configuration files collected from %LOCALAPPDATA%/SAP/C4C/config.-Since all the files are required, it is recommended to zip all files and folders in %LOCALAPPDATA%/SAP/C4C/ after collecting the detailed logs as mentioned above.-- Error/Conflicts in Synchronization Issues folder-Default path in end user mailbox: SAP Cloud for Customer\Synchronization Issues\.-The date /details of error or conflict captured should match with that of the issue reported]- Resolution

Title: Import of Materials via Mass Data Maintenance fails with Reference to System Maintenance
Content: Symptom-The Import Materials functionality in the Mass Data Maintenance work center doesn't work properly. After choosing the Upload of the csv file, the data validation remains in process and after a while a System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime screen appears.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select the Import Materials link.-Choose the Upload Data from Text button.-Browse for Source File, select relevant Tab and other settings.-Choose Upload.-After the data validation remains in process for some time, the System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime screen appears.-Cause-Although materials with language code exist in the system, the Language column of the import file is not filled.-Mass Data Maintenance can be used to modify existing attributes only. It cannot be used to clear values. Therefore the missing language code values are not accepted by the system.-Resolution-Keep respectively maintain the language code in the Language column of the import file and try the Upload again.

Title: Bank Statement Upload MT940 NL Format: Closing Balance Is Negative (Minus Sign) When It Should Be Positive
Content: Symptom-You've uploaded a bank statement file with MT940 NL import format. Upon verifying the bank statement created by the system you notice that the Closing Balance is incorrect: the system calculated the amount as a negative value (e.g. -100.000,00 EUR) when it should be positive (e.g. 100.000,00 EUR).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to Bank Statements view-Find the respective Statement ID-Notice that its Closing Balance shows up as a negative amount (with a minus sign) when it should be positive.-As a result the system throws the error message:-ID 123: Calculated closing balance 100.000,00 Euro is different from stated - 100.000,00 Euro-The ID, the amounts and the currency are just an example here.-Cause-In the last part of closing tag ":62F:" you've entered a final mark of message "-" when it should be "-}{5:}".-Please note that sign " is not part of the bank statement file and has been used for better illustration here.-Resolution-You should upload the file again with correct final mark of message "-}{5:}" and the Closing Balance will be correct.

Title: Plan Version from Microsoft Excel Message - Saving Data to SAP Business ByDesign; Please Wait
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are uploading the Planning/Budgeting for the year and system takes a noticable amount of time and continues to show the message as Saving Data to SAP Business ByDesign; Please Wait, while the planning data already started to appear in the planning view.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Planning view.-Choose New, Plan Version from Microsoft Excel and File ownload.-Logon to SAP Business ByDesign dialog box and enter the details.-Click on the button Save Data To.-System keeps showing the message Saving Data to SAP Business ByDesign; Please Wait.-Cause-The behaviour that Excel throws error while backend data is posted is because there is a time out limit for the UI . If that time limit is exceeded, the Excel times out but the backend process keeps on running.-That explains why the data was posted despite the fact that Excel showed otherwise.-Time out issues happen when the number of items loaded are much higher.-Please inform customer that performance improvement would have to be taken as a development topic in coming releases.-Note: Since it is kind of improvement/limitation, setting this document for internal release only for information purpose.-Resolution

Title: System Maintenance/ Temporary System Downtime Message While Exporting Data Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You require to Export data to CSV file using Mass Data Maintenance. On performing the Export, system loads for a while and shows the below message:-System Maintenance / Temporary System Downtime-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Select Export for the respective Object-Cause-Since the number of hits is too large, the performance will be relatively slow and the system will throw the message.-Resolution-In case of such slow execution and message, it is always advisable to optimize your Search criteria. Reduce the number of Search hits by restricting the Search criteria so that you can split the files for Export.

Title: Internal Process Allignment with Operations Team
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document is intended for the support engineers, to know the internal process allignment with the operations team.-Based on the support and operations team feedback, we have categories some pin points and agreed follow ups as summarized below:-1. Downtime between Test and Production CMP:-For all the tenant request incident, In which the customer provides a downtime, which falls between the test tenant CMP and production tenant CMP. Generally the test CMP occurs on saturday and Production CMP occurs on sunday.-In this case, the provisioning team will not be able to proceed as they will encounter HFC/EP version mismatch.-For all such incidents when sent to Provisioning queue (MS-System Setup/Terminations), Provisioning team will provide us the exact time for the production CMP when they can start the process again.-So that support engineer can clearly communicate this information and can ask for a new downtime.-2. Development Co-ordination:-For all the incidents such as tenant request, restore point, network issues, solution profile issue, reset to restore point requests which are routed from BCP to the Managed services queues and due to any technical issue.-Operation team will create a CSS ticket for the same and sends to the development, then in the customer incident, Operation team will update the CSS incident ID, so that if required support engineer can follow up on it.-3. Unplanned downtime and RCA:-For all the incidents, in which customer requests for a RCA. If the RCA is simple in nature and can be communicated to the customer. Then the operations team will provide us the RCA in the incident.-4. Communication with Support:-For any incident, if the operations team needs to contact the support. Then they can reach out to the owner of the incident (if the owner is not available),then the single point of contact will be the duty manager (DM).-Duty managers details can be find out using the below link:-http://supporttools-scpci.mo.sap.corp:8080/sap(bD1lbiZjPTEwMA==)/bc/bsp/sap/z_dp_dayview/dayview.htm?sap-unique=x&sap-params=dGRfZGF0ZT0xMC4wMS4yMDE3JnRkX3N1cHBfbGV2ZWw9-5. Delay in assignment: -Duty managers will ensure the assignment as per the IRT defined in the SLA's.-Priority IRT as per the SLA's-Very high (P1) 1 hour-High (P2) 4 hour-Medium (P3) 1 Business Day-Low (P4) 2 Business Day-Above information is as per the contractual SLA's towards the customers. If the CSM/CEE/AE contacts operations before the incident is sent to operations, then DM can be contacted.-

Title: Cannot Activate Fixed Asset due to Open Task: Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XYZ in Set of Books ABC
Content: Symptom-You have created a Low Value Asset XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Fixed Asset) as a collection of, for example office furniture. The Low Value Asset XYZ has an acquisition cost greater than the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets set by you in the Business Configuration.-While trying to post this Low Value Asset XYZ, you get a Business Task assigned: Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XYZ in Set of Books ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Set of Books).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Select Fixed Assets sub view in Fixed Asset view.-Search and select Fixed Asset XYZ.-The Fixed Asset is capitalized but has an open task: Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XYZ in Set of Books ABC.-You can check the Capitalization Threshold in Business Configuration as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-In Overview, search and select Activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Click Open.-Here you can see the different Accounting Principles and underneath it the Threshold Values. For every Accounting Principle you can define the Minimum Amount and Maximum Amount for an Asset to be considered as a Low Value Asset.-Cause-According to the Help Document, Task – Review and Release Changes to Low Value Asset in Set of Books, if the acquisition cost of an asset is above the limit of a low value asset set using Activity: Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets in Business Configuration, you must review the master data of the fixed asset. Changes to low value assets must be reviewed for correctness.-Resolution-You can either redefine the Capitalization Threshold or you can change the status of the Fixed Asset from a low value asset to a normal asset.-But, if you do not want to make any changes as mentioned in the Help Document and want to post the Fixed Asset as a Low Value Asset while keeping its higher acquisition cost, then you can set the task to complete.-You can do this as follows:-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Select Work view.-Search and select the Business Task: Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XYZ in Set of Books ABC.-Click on the Actions button.-In the drop down for Actions, click on Complete.-Now you can see that for Fixed Asset XYZ, the task has been removed and the Fixed Asset is activated.-See Also-For further information, please refer to Help Center Document, Task – Review and Release Changes to Low Value Asset in Set of Books.

Title: HSN Field Read Only in Invoice Screen for India
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Invoice document and you want to edit the HSN field for India, although it is in Read Only / Grayed Out.-It happens for both Supplier and Customer Invoices.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoice Entry View.-Select a Purchase Order yet to be invoiced and click on New Invoice.-As soon as the new screen shows up click on View All.-Go to Items tab, add a new product and see that the HSN Field is read only / Grayed Out.-Cause-The HSN field is indeed meant to be a read only field. It is not editable.-The HSN number is maintained in the material master data and if the mentioned material has the HSN value as XXX, then for it to show in the invoice screen it must have been maintained in the material master data first.-The value will be picked up only if it is present in the master data. It is not meant to be an editable field.-Resolution-For this information to show in the invoice screen, you have to maintain the HSN number in its master data.

Title: Homepage tiles do not show more than 50 records in reports
Content: Symptom-Report on homepage tile  shows message "maximum snapshot limit of 50 records exceeded" instead of report data.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Add report to homepage tiles-2. Go to homepage-3. Report tile does not show data, instead of that message is noticed as "maximum snapshot limit of 50 records exceeded"-4. Clicking on the tile will open the complete report-Cause-Currently this is expected behavior.-This is done to enhance the system performance.--If the number of records in a report exceeds 50 then it do not show reports or charts on the homepage tile, instead it just display a static icon with the message  "Maximum snapshot limit of 50 records exceeded. Click to view full report."-Resolution-You can either restrict the data to show less than 50 records or you can click on the tile and open the report to see the data.

Title: The Meals per Diems Link is Deactivated in an Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You cannot enter Meals per Diems. If you create an Expense Report, the Meals per Diems Link: Deduct Free Meals is deactivated.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses Work Center.-Select Expense Reports View.-Show All Expense Reports, find the relevant Expense Report.-Highlight the relevant Report ID and press Edit.-You can see that Under Per Diems, the link Deduct Free Meals is deactivated.-Cause-In the Adaptation mode the checkbox Meals is not activated therefore the link is not visible. Activate the checkbox and then the link becomes visible.-Resolution-Solution 1:-Go to Travel and Expenses Work Center.-Select Expense Report View.-Show All Expense Reports, find the relevant Expense Report.-Highlight the relevant Report ID and press Edit.-Click Adapt - Enter Adaptation Mode.-Press Yes and then select Ok.-Click Adapt - Edit Screen.-Press on Per Diems.-Under Fields select checkbox Meals under column (visible).-Press Publish twice.-The link Deduct Free Meals should now be editable.-Solution 2:-Delete the already created Expense Report by the auditor and create a new Expense Report. In the new Expense Report the link should be enabled.

Title: Limitations in SAP Business Bydesign for Goods and Service Tax ( GST )
Content: Symptom-Below are the current limitations in SAP Business Bydesign for Goods and Service Tax (GST).-Compensation cess is not available and there is no work around.-TDS on GST products.(try payment difference reason ) : create payment difference reason and put it as TDS and select this during payment. But there wont be any reporting support.-If anytime, the GST components have to be non deductible, then it has to be done manually in the invoice.-Reverse charge based on services like Goods Transport Agency (GTA) -> customers have to manually select the tax code (Dom Purch of goods and services (rev charge)).-Payment voucher is not currently supported.- Resolution

Title: Error Message "Lowercase or special characters not permitted in field InternalID of node PRODUCT_CATEGORY" When Migrating Product Category
Content: Symptom-During the simulation of Product Category migration, system throws below error message:-Lowercase or special characters not permitted in field InternalID of node PRODUCT_CATEGORY-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity for Product Category-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the issue is that there are Product Category ID have spaces, lower case and special characters in the values.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior that the Product Category IDs should not have spaces.-Change the erroneous IDs and simulate the migration again.

Title: Excel Refresh Query not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-You created an Advanced Filter query in a workcenter view however when you refreshed the data in Excel Add-in you have different data from that filter.-Reproducing the Issue-Example using Accounts View in SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Go to Customers Workcenter-Go to  Accounts View-Select filter All Accounts-Go to Advanced Filter and filter the data as you like-Click in Export-Open in Excel-Modify the data (for example delete rows)-Click in Refresh-Excel has more data than your initial download- Cause-Excel Add-in respects the data from the query as for example All Accounts, once you hit Refresh it will ignore the Advanced Filter and will download the All Accounts query again.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: Existing Work Package Not Found for Assignment
Content: Symptom-When querying for work package ABC to assign it to an employee, the relevant work package will not show up, even though you are able to select it by entering the full ID and pressing Enter.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Home, then in Self Service-Click Edit Time Sheet, then select Manage my worklist-Click Add Work Package-Enter the ID for work package ABC completely or partially in the corresponding field-Search will shown meassge No Search Result-Enter the complete ID for the work package and press Enter-Work package ABC will be selected despite not being found.-(ABC represents the ID of the work package)-Cause-In this case, the Valid To date for work package ABC is probably expired. By default, the validity period taken by the query is the last week from the current date — if a work package is not valid within that period, it'll not show up in the query, but will still be selectable.-Resolution-There are two alternatives to solving this issue:-Extend the Valid To date of work package ABC so it appears in the query-Expand the validity period taken by the query in the Advanced search options

Title: Product Assigned as a Line Item in a Sales Order Doesn’t get Updated With the Latest Update in the Material Master Data
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a Product to a Sales Order but when you change any data in the Product Master data like Product Category or Base UoM, these changes are not reflecting in the Sales Order.-Resolution- When you assign a Product to a Sales Order and after Invoicing of the Sales Order line item, changes made in the Product/Product Category will not reflect in the sales Order.-There are two possible cases using which you can overcome the issue,-If the Sales order line item is not invoiced (the Product ID field will be editable), then you can reassign the Product, so the changes made in the Product will reflect in the Sales Order / sales report.-If the Sales Order line item is invoiced (the product ID field will be read-only) then the changes will not reflect automatically. Here, the possible way is to cancel the delivery and the invoice and then re-assign the Product in the line item.

Title: Approval Task Sent to Only One Project Manager Although There Are More Projects as Cost Assignment
Content: Symptom-You have an invoice that was created for one item with different Cost Assignments. Each one from a different Project Task, each Project with a different Project Manager.-Your Approval Process is defined by Cost Assignment and in the Approval Screen, you could see that the Approval Task went to only one Project Manager and it should have been sent to all the Project Managers.-It might happen to both Supplier and Customer Invoices.-Reproducing the Issue-Reproducing it as if it was Supplier Invoice:-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Search and open the affected Invoice.-Go to Items tab.-You see that for the specific item, there are more than one Cost Assignment. Each one from a different Project Task, each Project with a different Project Manager.-Go to Approval tab.-You see that there is only one Approver showing.-Cause-Check what is the valid Approval Process for the specific document and see that the All Approvals Required box is not checked for the step in which the Approval Task was triggered.-Because of this, in the Invoice screen, you will only see the person who has approved the document first.-If you follow the steps below, you will see that the approval task went to all the project managers:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management View under Task Distribution.-Select the row related to the affected invoice and see that in Person Responsible it says Multiple Persons.-Click this link and you will see the name of all the project managers.-The approval task was created for all project managers, although since the Approval Step its shown that not All Approvals are required. In the Invoice Screen it will show only the person who has approved it first.-Resolution-System is behaving as designed and for this scenario, the Approval Task will show only the person who has approved the document, for it to show all the responsible persons, you have to maintain an Approval Process that for the affected step, the All Approvals Required box is checked.

Title: Fixed Asset not Flagged as Low Value Asset After Transfer of an Existing Low Value Asset
Content: Symptom-You created a new Low Value Asset by transferring an existing Low Value Asset. However the new one created is not flagged automatically as a Low Value Asset, even though the acquisition cost falls within the threshold value for an asset to be considered as such.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Select sub view Fixed Assets in view Fixed Assets.-Search and select Fixed Asset XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the new fixed asset).-The check box for the Fixed Asset XYZ is not flagged as you expect, based on its value which falls withing the determined threshold.-In the Fixed Asset XYZ, Click on tab Master data, navigate to tab Individual material.-The acquired Individual material is ABC (ABC is the ID of the individual material).-Go to view Fixed Assets.-Search and select fixed asset with Individual Material ABC by clicking on Advanced.-Select the Fixed Asset PQR (PQR is the ID of the Fixed Asset which was transferred).-the Fixed Asset PQR has the status Retired and is a Low Value Asset.-  In order to check if the Fixed asset is a Low Value Asset:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview.-Search for Activity: Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Select the relevant Accounting Principle.--Here you can maintain the minimum amount and the maximum amount of acquisition cost (threshold values), for the fixed asset to be considered as Low Value Asset.-The acquisition cost for this Fixed Asset XYZ, falls within this limit.-Cause-The Low value asset flag would be set automatically only for automatic postings (like Goods and Service Receipt, Supplier Invoice) based on threshold values.-Any manual postings would call for setting the Low Value Asset flag manually.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-You need to set the flag manually.-To set the flag manually you can use the following steps:-Go to Fixed Assets work center-Select sub view Fixed Assets in view Fixed Assets-Search and select Fixed Asset XYZ-In Tab Master Data click on Life Cycle Data-Select the correct Set of Books and then Flag it as Low Value Asset-The Fixed Asset is now flagged as a Low Value Asset

Title: Change Collector and its Process
Content: Symptom-Changes that you make to a particular business document, for example a Supplier, User, Account, or Organizational unit, over a period of time, can be consolidated by creating a change collection.-You can create the change collection in the Change Collector view of the Application and User Management work center.-Pre-requisites:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select Edit Project Scope button-Go to Questions section-Expand Built-in Services and Support-Business Environment-Change History-Scope the question Would you like to collect all changes for a document type at a mass level?- Steps to create Change Collector and export to Excel-In the Change Collector view, select New->New Change Collector-In the New Change Collector screen, enter the following parameters:-ID: A unique ID to distinguish the change collection you are creating from the rest-Document Type: The business document whose changes you are tracking. Depending on the document, the selection attributes in Selection Criteria table, change as shown below:-Account - Company ID and Customer ID-Organization Unit - Company ID and Organization Center ID-Supplier - Company ID and Supplier ID-User - Company ID and User ID-Validity Type: You can set the validity of the new change collection as:-Standard: Here you can specify the Start and End Date of a period to determine the changes that occurred during this time-Duration: Here you can give the number of days, during which the changes occurred-For example, the duration can be 80 days-From Last Execution Until Today-Use the Selection Criteria table to limit the scope of the collection using a particular selection attribute-Select Save and then click Action->Activate , to activate your changes-To schedule the run to gather the data for the collection immediately, select Action->Schedule Directly. You can schedule it for a later time by clicking Action->Schedule Later-Once the Scheduled Run is completed, the change collection for the business document type can be seen in the Change Collector view-Select the change collection and then select the Execution tab, various executions for the change collection run are displayed here-Select the Execution ID of the Change Collector, and in the screen that opens, select the Changes tab-All the Changes for the business document are listed here. These Changes are available for 7 days from the time they are generated. You can export these Changes to an excel by clicking Export->To Microsoft Excel-  For changes regarding the Materials and Services in the system, you may refer to the reports Changed Materials and Changed Services in Design Reports view in Business Analytics workcenter.-The Changed Materials and Changed Services report does not provide details on what exactly was changed, and there is no other report with this information available.--Detailed changed history may be accessed via each document or object separately. You may filter for the Changed On date in order to identify the changed Materials/ Services. That is, filter for the date or time period when the accidental changes were made.

Title: Time Report with 0.00 Hours Recorded Time and Start and End Time 00:00.00
Content: Symptom-You open a customized report in Time Administration work center. In this report you find a daily Time Recording with 0.00 hours duration and Start Time and End Time 00:00.00 for an employee. But actually no times with this duration have been recorded, and in the Time Sheet of this employee no related time recordings exist.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to List view.-Select the respective Report.-Filter for the respective Employee.-Move Start Time, End Time and Date to Rows.-Choose Go.-You find entries with a Recorded Time of 0.00 hours and Start Time and End Time 00:00.00.-Cause-The related Data Source HCMTLMU01 pulles Planned Time and Actual Time data. In this instance, only the actual time, but not the planned time contains information in relation to Start Time and End Time. Now, when a duration based and not start and end time based Time Model is assigned to an employee, the report creates an entry with Start Time and End Time at 00:00:00. Since no time passes between both points in time, the Recorded Time columns displays 0.00 hours. This happens in addition to any recorded Actual Times.- Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. To see more meaningful information regarding the Recorded Times move Time Types to Rows:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to List view.-Select the respective Report.-Filter for the respective Employee.-In additon to Start Time, End Time and Date move also Time Type to Rows.-Choose Go.-

Title: Error 'Party role ABC is not supported for party role category Buyer Party' During Replication
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the error aforementioned while replicating Sales Orders.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management-Select Web Service Message Monitoring-Select the erroneous Message ID-You see the error  'Party role ABC is not supported for party role category Buyer Party' (ABC represents the party role description)-Cause-The error is happening because you have not mapped the RoleCode used in Buyer Party correctly in your Code List Mapping.- For reference:-  <BuyerParty>-        <InternalID>111</InternalID>-        <RoleCode>ABC</RoleCode>-The role code ABC is not mapped to Buyer Role in your code list mapping. (ABC represents the Role Code used in your payload)-Resolution-You must map the role code to Party Role Buyer in code list mapping.-Go to Business Configuration and select Overview-Search for activity Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions-Select Maintain Code List Mapping-Filter for PartyRoleCode-Map the External Code ABC to Internal Code '1 - Buyer'-

Title: Not Possible to hide the Target Hours in the Worklist View of Time Sheet in Home Work Center
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to hide the Target Hours in the Worklist view of Time Sheet in Home workcenter. But there is no option available to hide the Target Hours being displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the wiew Worklist from the drop-down menu-The employees are able to see the Target Hours for the days of the week-Example: Monday HH:MM , Tuesday HH:MM-There is no option to hide those Target Hours displayed for the days of the week-Resolution-Currently, system does not support any other means to identify a Working Day without hours or start time-end time specification.-As a workaround, you may create a Work Schedule having Daily Model with minimal duration, for example: one minute, to just mark it as a Working Day.-It will still be visible as Target Hours of one minute in the Time Sheet of assigned Employees but can be then viewed as just an identifier for Working Day instead of the exact Target work hours.

Title: In ByDesign Mandatory Fields Are Not Triggering Errors When Saved Unfilled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You marked a field as mandatory in for example Contract. But when you create and save the contract without filling this mandatory field, you do not receive any error messages and you are able to save the contract.  -Reproducing the Issue-In the Silverlight version of system:-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select New Contract sub-view in Common Tasks view.-Cick on tab Adapt to enter Adaptation Mode.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then to Invoicing subtab.-Under Payment, select Payment Reference Type as ISR – Switzerland.-Then the field Bank Account is displayed.-Click on Adapt to edit the screen.-Set the Payment Reference Type field as Mandatory.-Also set the Bank Account field as Mandatory.-Click Save.-Click Publish.-Click on Adapt to Leave Adaptation Mode.-In the new Contract under Invoicing subtab of Pricing and Invoicing tab, the fields Payment Reference Type and Bank Account have been set as mandatory.-Now create a new contract without filling in the fields Payment Reference Type and Bank Account and click Save.-You are able to save the contract without any issues. You do not get any error message or warning.-  In the HTML version of the system:-Go to Sales Orders Work center.-Select New Contract sub-view in Common Tasks view.-In screen click on Settings wheel and click on Start adaptation mode-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then to Invoicing subtab.-Under Payment, select Payment reference type as ISR – Switzerland.-Then the field Bank account is displayed-Click on Adapt to edit the screen.-Set the field Payment Reference Type as Mandatory.-Also set the field Bank Account as Mandatory.-Click Save.-Click Publish.-Click on Adapt and leave adaptation mode.--Create a new contract without filling in the fields Payment Reference type and Bank account and click Save.-You cannot save the contract. You get the error message: Save rejected, because field is defined as mandatory by key user.-   Cause-This is a limitation in the Silverlight version of the ByDesign system.-The fields Payment Reference Type and Bank Account is under Embedded Component (EC) (/SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/Reuse/PaymentControl/PaymentControl_EC.EC.uicomponent).-Any field under EC will not be considered for mandatory checks.-If the same field was directly under OIF (Floor plan) then the mandatory error message is thrown during Save process.-Currently this is limitation in silverlight client. Fix is not recommended for this case since it might impact the existing core functionality.--Resolution-This is a limitation in the Silverlight version and will not be changed.-You will be able to fill in the fields even after saving the document.-You need to use the HTML version of the system as a workaround.

Title: Unable to Add a Key Figure as Condition to an Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You try to add a Key Figure from a report to an Approval Processe as a condition, however, you're unable to find it under Condition list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator work center;-Go to the Approval Processes view;-Select the ABC (ABC represents the Approval Process name) active Approval Process and click on Copy button;-Under Process Steps facet, click on Add Row button;-Select the recently created row and, under Conditions facet, click on Add Group button;-A new screen called Edit Condition will appear;-Notice that in the Field dropdown no field from a key figure is available.-Cause-You cannot add a Key Figure as condition to an Approval Process. -Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.

Title: Check Access Restrictions via Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You want to confirm via backend if the User XYZ (XYZ represents user's ID) has direct access to a document, e.g. Opportunity ABC (ABC represents Opportunities ID).-Resolution-For the User to have access to a document, the system needs to have matching UUIDs between the User XYZ and the Opportunity ABC.-To check if there are matching UUIDs for those both, perform the steps below:-Login the backend;-Go to the transaction SESFTS;-Open the BO OPPORTUNITY;-Load Query -> ROOT -QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS;-In the field ID/content add the Opportunity's ID. Refer to screenshot below:-Press Continue(Enter);-Double click in the Opportunity ID in the BO Instance Structure;-Press Navigate -> ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST;-Press Navigate -> ENTRY;-Press "Select All" (arrow icon at the left of the column Node ID);-Press Navigate -> ACCESS_GROUP;-Write down the values in the UUID column-Open the IDENTITY BO;-Press Load by Query ->ROOT-QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS;-In the ID/content field put the login ID of the user;-Press Navigate -> ROLE_ASSIGNMENT;-Select All and press Navigate -> ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_RESTRIC;-Select All and press Navigate -> ACCESS_GROUP;-Write down the values in the UUID column;-Crosscheck both UUIDs columns.-For this case the results were:-Opportunity's UUIDs User's UUIDs-00163E0664D31ED39E8E03DA9496C412-00163E0664D31ED39E91B57BF120EEB7-00163E136E2D1ED69B992E8E40C9215B-00163E03A0701EE288BA39BD20DA50B5-00163E136E2D1ED695FB812E6DD8A131-00163E0664D31EE3A1F4BB6440331823-00163E136E201ED6B1F53EF5F5031899-00163E136E201ED6B1F53EF5F5031899-00163E136E201ED6B1F53EF5F5031899-00163E136E201ED6B1F53EF5F5031899-00163E136E201ED6B1F54508FFD458F8-For this case, there aren't matching UUIDs, so the user XYZ does not have direct access to the opportunity ABC.-See Also-2500567  - How to Check If the User Has Access to a Document via Backend-2298774 - Access Retriction and Business Roles issues in Opportunity

Title: Fixed Asset Acquisition Error: 'An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation for Asset ABC Asset ABC val. View XXX: Acquisition cost negative'
Content: Symptom-While performing a Manual Posting – Acquisition for a fixed asset, the system displays the following error message:-"An error occurred during depreciation calculation for Asset ABC.-Asset ABC Valuation View XXX: Acquisition cost negative."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Find asset ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Fixed Asset).-Click Manual Posting - Acquisition.-Enter all the mandatory details.-Click Simulate.-Error Message: 'An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation for Asset ABC Asset ABC val. View XXX: Acquisition cost negative' is thrown.-Cause-The reason for the error message is that the Fixed Asset total amount has acquisitions from previous and current years, and when the Manual Posting amount is bigger than the amount for each individual year the error occurs.-Check the amount of each period following these steps:-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Find the Fixed Asset ID ABC.-Click View All.-Go to Values tab.-Go to Book Values subtab.-Choose one year at a time.- The information will be on Acquisition Cost line, on row Posted.- Resolution-In order to perform the Manual Posting – Acquisition, the amount for each year needs to be posted separately.-One manual posting needs to be created for the previous years, and another manual posting needs to be created for the current year.-Previous years posting:-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets views.-Find asset ABC.-Click Manual Posting - Acquisition.-In Transaction Currency Amount field put in amount added to asset on previous years.-Set Relating To: 2 - Previous Years.-Click Post.-Current year posting:-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets views.-Find asset ABC.-Click Manual Posting - Acquisition.-In Transaction Currency Amount field put in amount added to asset on current year.-Set Relating To: 1- Current Year.-Click Post.-As a result, the acquisitions can be posted successfully.- Keywords-Fixed Asset Work center, Fixed Asset Acquisition, Manual Posting – Acquisition, Error During Depreciation Calculation, Acquisition Cost Negative.

Title: Actual Cost Rollup Run is Crashing During Creation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to create an actual cost rollup, however the system is crashing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center-Go to Actual Cost Rollup view-Click New -> New Actual Cost Rollup Run-Fill out the required parameters.-Click Save.-If you check the dump, details you'll see that application error raised from /BOPF/CL_FRW=>/BOPF/IF_FRW_SERVICE_LAYER~ADJUST_NUMBERS line 111-Application Info:-1. Info: Error in Business Object Processing Framework (BOPF) /BOPF/CX_FRW_CORE, Program:SAPMHTTP, Include:, Position:0-2. Info: Internal application error of business object FIA_ACTUAL_COST_EST_RUN /BOPF/CX_FRW_FATAL, Program:SAPMHTTP, Include:, Position:0-Cause-Actual costing and material cost estimate are tightly coupled. Since Material cost estimate is not scoped, the dump occurs.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue, scope Material cost estimates and then create the Actual cost rollup run.-To Scope Material Cost Estimate, you need to go to:-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the current implementation and click Edit project scope-Navigate to the Scoping step-Mark the checkbox for material cost estimate under Financial and management accounting->Inventory Valuation.-Once scoped, you will be able to create the run.

Title: How Long Does It Take For A Test System To Be Terminated After You Click Request Termination
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You've reached the maximum number of tenants you are eligible for and hence, in order to request a new test tenant you must first request decommissioning of an existing one. However, after this process you don't know how long does the tenant take to disappear from the Active Systems list in the Service Control Center work center, and so you have no clue on when you could get back and request the creation of your new tenant.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center-Go to Systems view-Show Active Systems-Select the test tenant you'd like to terminate and click Request Termination-Notice that the Lifecycle Status changes from In Operation to Termination Requested. However, you don't know how long this process will take approximately.-Resolution-The termination of a tenant usually takes up to 2 hours. You should be able to successfully request a new test tenant after 2 hours from the moment you've submitted the termination request.-After that period, in case you still face the error message Maximum Number Of Tenants Reached while requesting a new tenant please report an incident to SAP informing the situation and we'll be able to assist you.-See Also-This Case Document is a complement of:-2196301 - Maximum Number Of Tenants Reached-1941544 - How to Delete or Terminate a Test System?-Further information is available on the following page on Business Center for Cloud Solutions from SAP:-https://wiki.sme.sap.com/wiki/display/BBD/Release+1308+and+higher

Title: SAP Global Cloud Service Center Solutions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-If you identify an issue reported is caused by a PDI Solution developed by the Cloud Service Center team, please follow this document.-Reproducing the Issue-You identify in a dump, in a screen or wherever else that the problem is caused by a component which has a name such as YIAB8Z4EY_(Following the model YXXXXXXX_, always starting with Y).-This means there is an issue with a PDI Solution, however you don't yet know who developed this solution. The solution can either be developed by a Partner, the Customer themselves or SAP Cloud Service Center.-To identify if this Solution is from the Service Center team, you must follow the below steps:-Open the system's backend-Go to the XREP transaction-Expand the All section-Look for the Folder with the solution name you found (such as YIAB8Z4EY_)-Double-click the folder YIAB8Z4EY_MAIN-You'll see in the right section of the screen the Properties of the Solution.-Below Solution name you'll see the field Description.-If the Description field starts with "SC_" the solution is from the SAP Service Center team and you are allowed follow the Resolution provided below.-Resolution-If the description is as described, starting with "SC_" you may reach the Cloud Service Center by sending the incident to the respective Cloud Service Center CSS NG component:-ByD: XX-PROJ-CSC-BYD-C4C: XX-PROJ-CSC-C4C-Please provide a proper pre-analysis providing a base to the theroy that the issue is caused by the PDI Solution.

Title: Fields grayed out when trying to edit planning on Cost and Revenue Work Center
Content: Symptom-You faced greyed out fields when trying to edit a Planning on Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Go to Planning View.-Select a Plan ID.-Click on Edit button.-You will see that all fields are greyed out and you cannot change any information.-Cause-System does not allow to make changes for a planning that has a version already started.-Resolution-In order to make changes in the Planning, you have to perform following steps:-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Go to Planning View.-Select a Plan ID.-Click on Edit button.-Go to Versions tab.-Change the status of all Version IDs to Not Started, then after performing the changes you can change the status back to the previous one.

Title: Time Related Business Tasks are Automatically Completed before Expiry Date is Reached
Content: Symptom-In Work Center Application and User Management at Business Task Management view, a Task type Solve Error after Uploading of Recorded Times is visible with status Completed, although you as Administrator never solved or even checked the related error, and never completed the task. The automatic completion happened even before the regular Expiry Date was reached.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Under Task Distribution, select the Business Task Management view.-3. Show:All Items.-4. You find a time activation related Task with status Completed that has never been processed and whose Expiry Date is not reached-Cause-In work center Application and User Management at Business Task Management view, Business Tasks related to activation errors for uploaded times get autocompleted after a week from the date of creation to avoid accumulation in the inbox. This also eases out administrator's job as he is not mandated to clean them up manually. However it is still possible to view and correct such errors afterwards.-Resolution-You can view the pending activation errors using the following view:-1. Go to the Time Administration work center.-2. Select the Time Recording view.-3. Show: Errors (Excel Upload).-This view is available if related data exists and displays the specific reason for activation failure(s). Moreover if the root cause of the error is not resolved before the next batch of upload, the task will be recreated.

Title: Initial Balance Field is missing in Time File of an Employee
Content: Symptom-You have observed that some of Employees don’t have the Initial Balance field in their Time File.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employee view-Search and Edit an Employee-Go to Time Profile tab-Select the Time Profile and go to Time Account Rules sub-tab-Select the Time Account and go to Accural/Entitlement Rules sub tab.-Resolution-As per the Help Center documentation Complete Time Data (Hire):-The Initial Balance field is displayed on this tab in the following cases:-If the employee's hire date lies no more than 3 months before the time file date, you have the option of assigning the employee an initial time account balance. The Initial Balance field is not available if the hire date lies more than three months before the time file date. In this case, an initial balance can only be assigned by means of a manual adjustment.-In the case of a rehire that is not flagged as a Reinstatement, which indicates that the rehired employee is granted his or her former benefits.-For more details you could checked it in Help Center.-  If the field is still missing then below could be the cause:-The First Regular Accrual has NOT happened for this employee. This would have happened when the time hire would have been done for this employee. During the time hire of the employee, the first regular accrual was not given and hence the Initial Balance Field is not available on the screen.-  Why the first regular accrual has not happened?-This can happen when respective the time account was invalid during the time hire of the employee. The validity of the time account was changed and adjusted as per the time profile start date of the employee. If this is the case then in time hire of this employee, the Initial Balance field does not appear on the UI.-  Workaround:-But to get the balance for the first time account instance the Manual Adjustments can be done.-  How to avoid this situation?-This could be avoided in future by checking the validity of the time account in the Business Configuration before doing the Time Hire of the employee, in case we wish to assign a particular time account to the employee.

Title: Approval task is not assigned to Respective Approver
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to assign approval task , system is not able to find employee responsible for the task-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Select view Business Task Management-Select any of the Approval tasks and click on Actions -> Assign Item-Click on the value help for the To field-Employee responsible is not displayed here.-Cause-The Approval process defined as Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit heance you have not defined the value limit for Cost Center Manager in the system.-Resolution-To Resolve this issue, follow these steps:-Scope this question in Business Configuration -Do you want to define advanced approval limits for projects, shopping carts, purchase orders, and purchase order item approvals?-Go to Application and User Management work center-Under common tasks, select Define Approval Value Limit and Define Rules for Approval Limit specifically based on the manager , company name etc.-Save and Activate-

Title: Employee Time Status Remains Inactive for the Time Recording Imported through Web Services
Content: Symptom-You are creating the Employee Time Recordings for some of the Employees through the Web Service ManageEmployeeTimeIn and the status of the Time Recordings in the payload in Active but in the system status is Inactive.-Resolution-For the Web Service ManageEmployeeTimeIn, there are three Operations and their behavior with respect to Time status is as follows,--MaintainActualEmployeeTimeBundle -> Does not release the Time Recording. The time remains inactive and needs to activated in the Time Sheet (Time Administration)--MaintainBundle -> This is used by Excel upload. Activation of Time happens in background.--MaintainEmployeeTimeAsBundle -> This activates the time which is immediate.-The user should use the correct operation to reflect the status of Time Recording.

Title: Error Mesage: Expense Report xxx Cannot Create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There is an Error Message Expense Report xxx Cannot Create a Business Transaction (For Accounting) displayed in the Expense report and there are no accounting entries for the same.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses Workcenter-Expense Reports View-Find the Expense Report XXX and click the Document Flow Tab-There is an Error Message Expense Report XXX cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting) Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically--Cause-The XI messages are stuck in the backend.-Resolution-Login into the Backend of the system-Select the Tcode - SE38-Choose the BO FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI and click Execute-Select the Operational Document Type as 47 - Expense Report and Operational Document ID XXX-Choose the Display Option select XI Mesage(s)-Select the XI message and in the Actions button select Restart-Now the Expense report in the UI will not display any errors

Title: Tenant Certificate is going to expire soon
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Customer gets an email notification with the subject “Tenant certificate is going to expire soon”-Cause-Whenever the tenant certificate is due to be renewed from the operations end, these emails are triggered to the customer.-We have a background job which will keep a check on the validity period of tenant certificate. This job runs at the start of every month and if the tenant certificate is going to expire in next 60 days.-Then it will automatically renew the certificate and triggers the notifications saying that the 'Tenant Certificate has been renewed'.- If the expiration date is between 60-90 days from the job run date then, it will trigger the notification saying that the 'Tenant Certificate is going to expire soon'. The reason for the second notification is to intimate the customer that the certificate will be renewed at the next run.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior. No action has to be taken from the customer.-See Also-Any support engineer who is handling such request can provide the cause mentioned to the customer and can propose the solution to the customer.

Title: How to Extract Customer IDs from Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the customer try to run the report Accounts Receivable Reconciliation for more or less than 14,000 customer accounts, he receives an error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open the Accounts Receivable Reconciliation.-You are not able to execute the report properly due to the high volume of customer accounts to be analyzed.-Cause-The Customer field not optimised for the user themselves to select a range. Development team is working on an optimization for this field in this report.-Resolution- We have a workaround to extract the customer IDs from the backend. One of the approaches to extact customer IDs is shown below:-Note that the below screenshots were taken from our internal test tenants, with our test data set, and does not reflect real customer IDs.- Open the customer backend system and enter the transaction SESFTS:-  In the Load BO by Proxy Name field, insert CUSTOMER:-  For the Customer BO, you will need to use the Query ROOT - QUERY_BY_ADRESS:-Enter the country code for the country that the customer wants to run the report. You can also increase the maximum rows if it is necessary:-Select all the records and click More Functions dropdown and Export Data:-Under ALV Functions, select the Spreadsheet option and generate the Excel File:-  Open the spreadsheet and copy the column with Internal ID:-  Paste those IDs on Notepad and click Ctrl+H. In the Find What box, use the regular expression pattern [/r/n]+, this will translate to the linefeed between each one of the IDs. In the Replace With box, use the ;. This is the accepted format in the parameter box for the customer field in the report:-Click Replace All and the file will look like this:-Copy this string into Customer ID selection in report and run it.-If you are still facing the issue, separate these IDs into two or three files. Each file supports up to 8,000 customer accounts, this is the maximum allowed by the system.-See Also-This is the only workaround we currently have. For further information about the optimization of this report, check the case document 2400924 - Data Limits When Executing and Downloading Reports.

Title: Error Message 'No report data available to display; check the selection' is displayed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to show the report 'Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme' or 'Profit Overview by Key Figures' but no data is being displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center -Subview 'Reports'-Find Report 'Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme'/'Profit Overview by Key Figures'-put in all your relevant data-click 'Go'-You get the  error message 'No report data available to display; check the selection'-Cause-An FSI inconsistency exists on the data source which can be solved via FSI reload of FSI View FSP_FIN_PROFLINE and FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT-Resolution-Request a L6 support user and log on to STFK.-Enter transaction GFSSTM-In the Fast Search View field enter FSP_FIN_PROFLINE and press F8-In the next screen, navigate to the Node Persistence tab expand all nodes-Select all nodes and press Persistence-Press Refresh to check if the reload is complete-Do the same for FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT-Please take the necessary precautions before performing a FSI Reload-See Also- 2303780 - Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme Report Shows Profitability Lines with Technical IDs

Title: Report Start Option Does Not Apply to All Selections
Content: Symptom-In a report ABC, you have selected the start option Show Selection Area but Do Not Start Report. When you open the report, the default selection is not executed straight away, which is correct. However, when you choose another selection from the drop-down list, it is executed at once and you are not able to make any changes before running it.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report ABC from the assigned work center.-The report opens without being run and you can make changes to the default selection. This is correct.-In the list of selections, choose another selection that is not the default one.-It is executed straight away, although the start option is set to Show Selection Area but Do Not Start Report-Cause-The start options only apply to the report when it is opened for the first time. All other selections are expected to be executed at once.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour. You need to mark a selection as default if you would like it to open without being executed on opening the report.

Title: Successfully Migrated Warranties are Missing in the Respective Work Center
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating Warranties and the migration successfull but those Warranties are missing in Warranties view of Service Entitlements work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Migrate the Warranties using Migration of Warranties fintuning activity in Business Configuration-Go to Service Entitlements work center-Go to Warranties view-Show All Warranties-Migrated Warranties are missing-Cause-The cause for the issue could be as follows,-You are trying to migrate Warranties with Product Category assigned to it. For the product category, if the product assignment allowed indicator is set to false. Then the Warranties wont be migrated.-This can be verified in that the Product Assignment Allowed indicator is not checked in the Product Categories view (Product Data workcenter) for the Product Category-Resolution-Notes for the User:--1. If you really intend to not allow product assignment to product category, then uncheck this option from the product category maintenance *before you assign this category to any products*-2. If you want to allow product assignment to product category, then first ensure that these categories allow product assignments.-In General,  Warranty is also treated as a product, and therefore in this context, the same rule applies. In order to assign a product category to the warranty, the product assignment allowed indicator needs to be set to true for that product category.

Title: After Migrating Organizational Structure the Address is not Getting Reflected
Content: Symptom-After migrating Organizational Structure using migration tool the Address information is not getting reflected in the respective Organizational Unit-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-3. Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Appointment Activities-4. Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-This is because that the Addresses tab from the template will be ignored when the columns Main Address and Bill-To Address are empty from sheet Addresses.-Resolution-Fill the fields Main Address and Bill-To Address from sheet Addresses ﻿while Migrating Organizational Structure

Title: System Crashes when you try to Schedule the Reminder for Time Approvals
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to schedule the reminder for Time Approvals, the system crashes.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Time Administration workcenter.-2. Select Reminders for Time Approvals view.-3.  Then select Schedule Reminder.-The system throws a dump.-Cause-You have not created a New Reminder.-Resolution-You need to first create a New Reminder.-Steps to follow:-1. Go to Time Administration workcenter.-2. Select Reminders for Time Approvals.-3. Create New Reminder.-4. Then select this New Reminder and choose Schedule Reminder.

Title: Service Agents Availability Shows 8 Hours per day
Content: Symptom-Service Agent availability is shown as 8 hours per day without any work schedule or time model assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Resource Management Work Center-Select Resource Profiles-Search for a Service Agent-Click Edit-Navigate to the Availability tab-Select Resource Availability-The system displays 8 hours per day for the Service Agent.-Cause-This is standard system behavior, as Service Agents are external resources and do not have a work schedule or time model.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior, as it is not possible to assign a work schedule to a Service Agent and the system automatically sets the availability to 8 hours per day.-Keywords-service agent availability, 8 hours default, availability 8 hours per day, service agent work schedule not possible, service agent time model not assigned, resource availability 8 hours, SAP ByDesign service agent availability

Title: Payment Strategy Assignment Rules for Accounts
Content: Symptom-You have defined rules for payment startegy assignment to supplier accounts, however upon executing a payment run you notice that the supplier accounts have the wrong strategy assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Payment Run view-Open the concerned Application Log.-Navigate to the Results tab.-You see that the run processed some supplier accounts, however with a payment strategy assignment that does not agree with the strategy assignment rules set in Business Configuration.-The payment startegy rules can be seen as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Open the Activity List.-Open activity Payment Strategies-Click Assign Payment Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier-Cause-You have defined a supplier range with logical operators of type GE (Grater or Equal), GT (Greater Then), LT (Less Then), ect. Nevertheless, these operators are not supported to define a range for payment strategy assignment. Only EQ (Equal) is supported.-Since the assignment was made with not supported operators (GE, GT, LT, etc) the supplier's payment strategy is not correctly assigned, hence the default payment stratgey is used.-Resolution-You need to change the assignment rules and only use the EQ operator.-In case you have a big number of accounts to maintain, you can:-Download the list of supplier accounts to Excel via Supplier Accounts view under Payables.-Sort the list of accounts-In the Assign Payment Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier screen, click Download.-Copy the sorted IDs from the first file to the second file. Maintain the operator and Payment Strategy using Excel shortcuts.-Upload this file and activate the rules.

Title: Tax Invoices Ukraine Created With 0 Quantity and 0 Invoice Amount
Content: Symptom-You have scoped Tax Invoice for Ukraine and maintained the settings required.-You have posted the Customer Invoice. The system creates the tax invoice automatically and this is available in the Outgoing Tax Invoices view. The issue is that Tax Invoice XYZ is based from Customer Invoice PQR which is supposed to have taxable items.-However, in Tax Invoice XYZ, the quantity of all items are 0 and the tax base amount is also 0 - which is not the case when referring back to customer invoice PQR, resulting which the invoice amount in the Tax Invoice is zero.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Invoice Documents view.-Find Customer Invoice PQR.-Click on Edit and View All and Items tab.-Select Invoice line and Click on sub-tab Taxes.-You will observe that invoice line has Quantity, List Price, Net Value which is more than zero and Tax Details also shows the Tax Amount not equal to zero.-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Under Tax Invoices, Select Outgoing Tax Invoices tab.-Show All Tax Invoices and search for Source Document ID PQR and Edit it.-Navigate to Items tab.-You will observe that for the same invoice line of your source document item now the Quantity, List Price,Net Value shows as zero and Tax Details also shows the Tax Amount as zero but the expectation Invoice Amount in the Tax Invoice should take the Tax Amount carried from the source customer invoice in which the Quantity, List Price,Net Value is not zero for each line of the customer invoice.-Cause-Cash Discount indicator setting in the General tab for all the line items in the Customer Invoice should be same then a proper Tax Invoice will be created. If certain lines have cash Discount enabled and for some if its disabled then there will be split in the condition and Tax Invoice will be generated with zero value instead of actual Tax Invoice Amount.-  Resolution-Cancel the Customer Invoice.-Again post a New Customer Invoice and make sure that all the line items have the same Cash Discount indicator what so ever, this will help in generating the Tax Invoice with correct invoice amount.

Title: Eight Hours are Getting Deducted Instead of Four Hours When Employee Requests Holiday on Half Working Days
Content: Symptom-Employees request for holiday on half working day but Eight hours are getting deducted instead of Four Hours-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Time Administration work center-2. Select Time Recording view-3. Select Time Sheet view-4. Select any Employee-5. Select Open Time Sheet-6. Select Show Work Schedule-Cause-The cause for this issue is Time Model can't show the Four hours difference on credited time as the model does not specify how to handle a Half Day or the number of hours which determines the Half Day-Resolution-You have to change the Daily Time Model assigned to the employee to allow for a half day deviation of Four hours. You can follow the below steps-1. Go to the Time Administration Work Center-2. Select the Time Model view-3. Select the specific Daily Time Model-4. Maintain Deviation On Half Day Off   -Keywords-Eight Hours, Getting, being,  Deducted, Holiday, on Half Working Days

Title: Cannot Add New Payment Difference Reason Code
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to add new Payment Difference Reason Code while creating New Bank Payment Advice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Payment Advices view.-Perform the action New Bank Payment Advice.-Enter the relevant information and select the option Posting Advice.-Under Other Discounts/Credits select Payment Difference Reason.-You want to add a new option in the Payment Difference Reason Field, but the option is not available.-Resolution-The reason you cannot add a new Payment Difference Reason Code is that these follow a standard list of codes that is taken from the standard UN ECE list: http://www.unece.org/trade/untdid/d10b/tred/tred4465.htm-This list is updated as and when the standard list above is extended. You cannot add a new reason code here.-As a workaround, you can choose an existing code and map it in Business Configuration to the respective ledger you want the posting to happen.

Title: Employee ID Field is not Available in Call Employee Services On Behalf under Managing My Area Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to have field Employee ID in Call Employee Services On Behalf view under Common Tasks-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Managing My Area work center-2. Go to Common Tasks view-3. Select Call Employee Services On Behalf -4) In Employees table, we have the Employees Names and their respective Phone Numbers-Resolution-A column named Employee ID is added to  existing Employee Services on Behalf screen. This column will be personalized hidden by default and has to be enabled using Personalization when required.

Title: Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry Not Relevant for a Business Transaction
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new base amount entry for Withholding tax; however, the system informs you that your company is not relevant for such transaction.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Withholding Tax Base Amount Entries view.-Click New -> Tax Payment.-For the selected company, the system raises an error as follows:-'Country <Company's country> is not relevant for this business transaction. Select a different company.'-Cause-The selected company is registered under a non-localized country.-Note that, Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry only creates a base amount entry in the tax register for reporting purposes. It is only possible for countries where the Withholding tax rate is 0%, because no tax can be calculated/posted via this process.-At the moment, even if the country that you've implemented via PDI (Partner Development infrastructure) has 0% rate the error is raised, reason being that CSL (Customer-Specific Localization) enablement of manual tax entries for Withholding tax is not supported.-Resolution-The system is currently working as designed.-In case you have created supplier invoices erroneously without Withholding tax, these documents should be reversed and reposted with proper Withholding tax data.-Keywords-withholding tax; wht tax; Withholding Tax Base Amount Entry; CSL; Customer-Specific Localization; Business Transaction

Title: Organizational Unit 'Supplier Invoicing' Unit Cannot be Seen in the Drop Down List
Content: Symptom-When Customer Reports Issue Regarding an Organizational Unit Supplier Invoicing which Disappeared from the Drop Down List.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Organizational Management work center-2. Select the Concerned Organizational Structures-3. Select the Concerned Company-4. Find the New Created Organizational Unit Supplier Invoicing Unit-Cause-The Structure was not activated-Resolution-1. Uncheck Organizational Unit as Supplier Invoicing-2. Activate the Parent Organizational Unit-3. Recheck Organizational Unit as Supplier Invoicing-4. Activate Parent Organizational Unit Again

Title: Minimum Break Deduction for Employees is Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-In Business Configuration workcenter, in the Time Recording Profile, the Administrator has maintained the Minimum Break Deduction by specifying the Work Duration and Break Duration hours respectively. But the Minimum Break Deduction for Employees is not working as expected.-For example, if the Employee works for 6 hours at a stretch without any Break, then the he/she is entitled to get 30 minutes of Break. This way, Employee can put together all the entitled Break hours and take it as a Holiday in future. But if the Employee takes Break earlier than 6 Working hours, then he/she should not be allotted 30 minutes of Break in the system.-Resolution-In the above scenario, if Employee records a break of two hours from 12:00 - 14:00 in between the two working times 08:00 to 12:00 hours and 14:00 to 17:00 hours, further Break Deduction will not happen. All Productive times per day are summed up to determine whether the Break should be deducted or not. But in case Breaks are explicitly recorded as well, it shall be considered during Automatic Break calculation.-For further details, you may also refer to the Help Center document Automatic Minimum Break Deduction.

Title: Not Able to Upload the Services Using the Excel Add-in Due to Errors
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to upload Services in the system using Excel Add-in. During the upload, you see errors:-The value ‘2 - Active’ of the field ‘Sales Status’ is invalid-Account determination group for service in company is missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Select New-> Service from Microsoft Excel-Download the New Services XML template-Fill the details-Upload the file using Excel Add-in-System throws errors-Cause-The standard excel template does not allow to create a Service with an Active Sales status nor does it allow to enter Account Determination Groups. Valuation status cannot be set Active without maintaining Account Determination Group.-Resolution-In the workcenter Business Configuration, we have a an activity Migration of Service Valuation Data to update the Valuation data of Services. Before you proceed with Migration approach, ensure that the relevant Service(s) should have created in the system with Valuation data, irrespective of Active status or In Preparation status.

Title: Wrong Bank Interim Account Posted When Confirming Petty Cash Transfers in Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-Postings for clearing Outgoing - and Incoming Cash Transfers are compared.-A separate Bank Interim Account XYZ is defined both for Cash Receipt - In Transit and Cash Disbursement - In Transit for the relevant Account Determination Profile.-For Outgoing Petty Cash Payments Bank Interim Account XYZ is debited when confirming the payment via bank statement. The subsequent clearing posts Bank Interim Account XYZ  and Cash in Transit Account ABC.-For Incoming Petty Cash payments however, the defined Cash in Transit Account ABC is posted again when confirmed in a bank statement.  -The technical clearing of bank accounts then will show a Debit and Credit entry, again for the same Cash in Transit account ABC.-The expectation is a posting against the Bank Interim Account XYZ also for incoming Petty Cash Payments when confirmed in a bank statement and consequently a clearing between Cash in Transit Account ABC and Bank Interim Account XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center-Enter Petty Cash view-Chose relevant Petty Cash ID-New Incoming Cash Transfer or Outgoing Cash Transfer-Select a relevant Bank Account ID, Dates and Transaction Amount-Post Outgoing Cash Transfer 1.-Post Incoming Cash Transfer 2.-Outgoing Petty Cash Transfer 1 is confirmed in a Bank Statement as Incoming Cash payment. The resulting Journal Entry (00078 - Bank Statement) credits Bank Interim Account XYZ.-Incoming Petty Cash Transfer 2 is confirmed in a Bank Statement as Outgoing Cash payment. The resulting Journal Entry (00078 - Bank Statement) debits the Cash in Transit Account ABC.-The expected result is a debit-entry on Bank Interim Account XYZ analog to Outgoing Petty Cash Transfer 1.-Consequently the associated clearing Journal Entry (00095 - Techn. Clearing of Bank Clearing Account) shows again an entry in debit and credit for Cash in Transit Account ABC.-Cause-The following are the conditions and parameters resulting in observed account determinations.-For the bank statement payment (Petty Cash IN/Bank OUT) the interim account will be taken from Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer.-If no Payment Method: Bank Transfer is defined - the account determination for Payment Method: 'Blank' will take effect.-The same G/L Account XYZ is defined for:-Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method Cash-Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method Transfer- Outgoing Petty Cash TO Bank - Outgoing Cash Transfer 1:-1) Cash Payment-  Account                             Account Determination-C: Cash on Hand Petty Cash-D: Cash in Transit XYZ Cash Receipt in Transit / Payment Method: Cash                     -  2) Bank Statement -  Account                            Account Determination-C: Bank Account Bank Accounts-D: Cash in Transit XYZ Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer-The offset-account to the bank-account is always the "In Transit - Account" / "Payment Method: Bank Transfer". In case no definition is made for "Payment Method: Bank Transfer" then the G/L account without any assigned Payment Method (Blank) is selected.-Since "Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer) defined - Cash in Transit XYZ will be selected.-  3) Technical Clearing-  Account Account Determination-D: Bank Interim Account ABC  Cash Receipt in Transit / Payment Method: Blank                    -C: Cash in Transit XYZ Cash Receipt in Transit / Payment Method: Cash                      -   Incoming Petty Cash FROM Bank - Incoming Cash Transfer 2:-1) Cash Payment-  Account Account Determination-D: Cash on Hand                     Petty Cash-C: Cash in Transit XYZ Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer-  2) Bank Statement -  Account Account Determination-C: Bank Account Bank Accounts-D: Cash in Transit XYZ             Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer-  The offset-account to the bank-account is always the In Transit - Account / "Payment Method: Bank Transfer". In case no definition is made for "Payment Method: Bank Transfer" then the G/L account without any assigned Payment Method (Blank) is selected.-"Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer" is defined - hence "Cash in Transit XYZ" will be selected.-"Cash in Transit XYZ" ALSO is defined as "Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Cash". Consequently the same g/l-account then is technicality cleared.-  3) Technical Clearing-  Account Account Determination-D: Cash in Transit XYZ              Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Cash-C: Cash in Transit XYZ Cash Disbursement in Transit / Payment Method: Bank Transfer-Resolution-The same clearing pattern in both cases would be observed in case no entry for "Payment Method: Bank Transfer" would be defined for Cash Disbursement in Transit. Then the Blank fallback-account determination would take effect. It is recommended however to define "Payment Method: Bank Transfer".-The account determination therefore has to be modified according to your requirements.

Title: Profit Detail Report does not show data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers.
