Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The profitability reports does not show data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Open any of Profit reports, such as: Profit details by contribution Margin Scheme; Profit Overview by Key Figure (FINPRFU30*), etc...-           No data is displayed.-The reports don't show results, despite your have maintained the profitability scenario for:-Functional areas-Functional area determination-Financial structure-Contribution margin assign-As well as you have maintained all profitable financial prerequisites, precisely as described in the following the help documentation:-Settings for Earned Profit Analysis – Configuration Guide-Settings for Profit Analysis Based on Invoices and Orders – Configuration Guide-Cause-Issue is in the Balance Sheet Indicator restriction in report whose value is set to 001 but data sources return blank value.-The Blank value of Balance Sheet Indicator on data source was due to no value in FSI  FSP_FIN_CHOFACCTAEO.-Resolution-Reload all BO nodes assigned to FSI FSP_FIN_CHOFACCTAEO.-CHOFACCT_ITEM_ASSGN-FIA_CHACT_GLACCOUNT-DOCUMENTATION-ROOT-Steps:-Open the t-code GFSSTM-Select fast search view and type: FSP_FIN_CHOFACCTAEO-Execute-Expand Fast Search Views and select all nodes  (Check the Number of Data Records Column and keep note of it);-Click on button Persistence and then click on button Refresh to check.-See Also-Consider also: 2177622 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports for Order / Invoice Profit

Title: System Throws the Error Message "Business Partner XYZ not active" When Creating Project Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-When creating a Project Purchase Request, the system displays the error message: “Business Partner XYZ not active.”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Project Management Work Center, choose the Projects view.-Search for Project XXX and select View All.-Choose the Products tab and select Product YYY.-Click Create Purchase Request and choose For Service/Supplier.-The system displays the error message: “Business Partner XYZ not active.”-Cause-The system displays the error message because Business Partner XYZ, assigned as the Service Agent, is blocked.-Although the Supplier status is Active, the assigned Service Agent XYZ has a Blocked status.-Resolution-In order to create the Purchase Request, the Service Agent status must be changed to Active.-In the Supplier Base Work Center, choose the Service Agents view-Search for the Service Agent XYZ and click on View All button-Click on Change Status button and choose Active-Click on Save.-Keywords-Project Purchase Request, Business Partner XYZ not active, Supplier Base, Service Agent, Blocked

Title: Sales Document's Incurred Costs Are Less than Expected
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Sales Document Items under Cost and Revenue, however you notice that there are missing Incurred Costs for the sales document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Sales Document Items view.-Find the relevant sales order.-Go to Accounting Data tab.-You see that the Incurred Costs amount is less than expected for this sales order.-Cause-The difference in incured cost calculated for the sales order is caused by unassigned expenses to this sales order.-In case you wish to drill down to the difference amount, the following reports are helpful:-Sales Document - Line Items for Sales Order Item-Sales Document - Line Items for Project-Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure -> Add the characterics for Sales Order and Sales Order Item. The items with # are unassigned. You may drill down from unassigned ICD Incurred Cost.-Resolution-In order to see the correct incured costs for the sales order, you need to assign the expenses to a sales order as follows:-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Select the concerned project and click Edit Time and Expenses.-Assign the not assigned time and expenses to the sales order.-After that the Incurred Cost under Accounting Data shall reflect the assigned entries.-See Also-You may also refer to help document Edit Assignment Rules for Linking Project Tasks to Sales Order Items.

Title: Multiple Approvers are Assigned to the Opportunity Approval Task
Content: Symptom-Multiple Approvars are Assigned to the Opportunity Approval Task, however you are expecting it to be assigned to only Reporting Line Manager of the Org Unit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Go to the Business Task Management Subview.-Show all items and find XYZ (XYZ represents the opportunity ID).-Edit the Approval Task.-You can find that the task is assigned to multiple approvars.-Cause-Determination of approver also depends upon the Alternative Approver concept.-If Employee Work Distribution for Opportunity Notification is defined then system tries to find out all possible alternative approver depending upon the rule defined.--You can find Opportunity Notification by following below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Go to the Employee Work Distribution subview.-Select Opportunity Notification under Business Area: Sales & Marketing.-Under Details: Opportunity Notification, you can find the Work Distribution Rules.-Description: The table shows the work distribution for the selected work category. The work is assigned to each employee based on the list of rules. All rules will be evaluated, and the task will be sent to all employees that fit the requirements.-Edit Opportunity Notification.-Here you can add or modify the rule.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Error: You Must Not Deactivate The Default Set Of Books Of A Company
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Deactivate the Default Set of Books maintained in the Set of Books activity and you can see the error message: You must not deactivate the default set of Books of a company-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration view-Go to Overview-Search and open activity Set of Books-Select the Set of Books and click on Edit-Go to Company Settings tab-Click on Deactivate-You can see the error message: You must not deactivate the default set of Books of a company-Cause-If you are using multiple Sets of Books, you need to make one of your Set of Books as the Default Set of Books for each company. This is necessary for business processes where pricing information is transferred to application areas outside financial and management accounting. In these cases the pricing information is taken from the Default Set of Books.-Resolution-Go to Business configuration view-Go to Overview-Search and open activity Set of Books-Select the Set of Books and click on Edit-Go to Company Settings tab-Deselect the option - Default Set of Books-Now click on option Deactivate, system will allow you to Deactivate the Set of Books.

Title: How To Download Or Extract Historical Data From Fine Tune Activity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You can see that data is archived or become historical for any Fine Tuning Activity. Now you want to download or extract the data in excel sheet.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Fine Tune Activity-Search for the activity - Dunning Strategies-Click on Assign Dunning Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier-Click on View Historical Versions-In the pop up screen click on the version asked in the question-You want to download/extract the data in excel sheet-NOTE: Here, I have given an example of fine tune activity - Dunning Strategies. The document is valid for any fine tune activity where you can see/view the historical version.- Cause-Over the OWL you can only see/view the historical data for any fine tune activity. However, you cannot extract or download the data in excel sheet.-Resolution-The historical data can be downloaded using BRF+ tool. For the detailed information click on link - https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/2vgOnLjYQZCIG9u9KKRQeu/content?folder_id=MnD7h1NlXJmt9Xe3WQ4VGy.- The below two documents will help you to download or extract the historical data:- 1) How to Find FDTID?- 2) How to export historical data for fine tune activity?- NOTE: If you find any difficulties while downloading or extracting historical data, then contact ES - FIN team for further help.

Title: How to Setup a Different Tax Rate for Product and Services - US Scenario With Tax Jurisdictions
Content: Symptom-You need to setup a different tax rate (different tax rate type) for a product or service that according to a legal requirement should have a special rate on US.-Reproducing the Issue-You need to charge Sales and Use Tax for invoices that will have a discount - for instance, in California you can charge less tax for BOE has some exceptions for manufacturing items depending how they will be consumed.-This special rate will be applied on State level. On County level tax rate should be the same.-Here is how you should setup this scenario.-Resolution-This process consists on 2 sets of settings you should do.-1 - On Tax settings you will need to add an entry for the special rate on Sales Tax Rate Schedules-2 - On Product master data you will assign the special tax type-Here is the details about how to configure these 2 settings:-Create new tax rate type:-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Go to Implementation Projects view-3. Select the relevant project-4. Click on Open Activity List-5. Go to Fine-Tune tab-6. Show - All activities and search for Tax on Goods and Services - US-7. Click on Define Sales Tax Rate Schedules-8. Create a new row for the tax jurisdiction code with tax rate type different from 1 - Standard, define tax rate and validity-Assign tax rate type to product:-1. Go to Product Data work center-2. Go to Materials view-3. Select the material which will have the newly created Tax Rate Type and click on Edit-4. On tab Taxes add a row for country US, State, Tax Type: 1 - Sales and Use Tax and Tax Rate Type as defined on Tax Rate Schedule----Optionally: you can create a Product Tax Classification category to assign several products to same tax settings as defined on Sales Tax Rate Schedules:-Create a Product Tax Classification: -1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Go to Implementation Projects view-3. Select the relevant project-4. Click on Open Activity List-5. Go to Fine-Tune tab-6. Show - All activities and search for Tax on Goods and Services - US-7. Click on Product Tax Classification-8. Add a new row with the combination of Product Tax Category + Description + Product Type -9. On Assigned Tax Classification, add a row for combination of State + Tax Type (1 - Sales and Use Tax) + Tax Rate Type (created on Tax Rate Schedule)-Assign the Product Tax Classification to products: -1. Go to Product Data work center-2. Go to Materials view-3. Select the material that will be assigned to the newly created product tax classification (max 999 materials)-4. Select Mass Change button-5. Select General in Show field-6. Select Personalize and choose This Screen-7. Check the visible check box for Product Tax Category for US and select Save button-8. Close the Personalize side bar-9. Now you will be able to find the column Product Tax category for US and change the value of it on Mass Change

Title: Grade Field is Not Displayed for Inactive Employees
Content: Symptom-You noticed the column Grade is not showing for some employees on Compensation screen.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Compensation work center-2. Select Employees View.-3. Select All Employees-4. Check the column Grade is missing for some employees-Cause-The Compensation Structure assigned for the respective employee is not valid.-You can check the Compensation Structure by opening the Compensation profile and selecting the tab Compensation Structure Assignment of the respective employee.-The system is designed to show the data valid on current system date. Since the compensation structure for this employee is not valid on current system date, hence the Grade is not displayed.-Resolution-System is working as designed.

Title: Unable to Delete Business Object Extension(XBO) as the Delete Button is not Enabled in the SDK
Content: Symptom-Partner is unable to delete Business Object Extension(XBO) as  the Delete button is not enabled in the SDK.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK-Select the Partner Solution-Go To Solution Explorer(Repository Explorer)-Select the Business Object Extension(*.xbo)-Right click on the Business Object Extension(XBO)-Delete button is disabled-Cause-Here, the partner solution Y* is a patch solution. It is not possible to delete the Business Object Extension in the patch solution. This action will be disabled. The reason being, the patch solution is a maintenance code on top of original solution. It is very likely that the patch solution could already been deployed in customer test/production tenants. Also, these XBOs which are delivered part of the patch will already have data. As a measure and to avoid data loss, we disable the Delete option of any XBO in the patch solution.-- Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-The Business Object Extension(XBO) in the patch solution cannot be deleted. However, you can clean the associated run time objects like Before Save & After Modify events if the XBO is not needed anymore.-

Title: Error Message: Company not Registered in Country ABC, Define Tax number as Type 2
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Manual Project Invoice Request and you are getting the below error message:-Company XYZ not registered in country ABC, define Tax number as Type 2.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Project view.-Select the Project 123.-Right Click -> Create Manual Project Invoice Request.-From General tab go to Refine Pricing tab and click Finish.-You see the error message: Company XYZ not registered in country ABC, define Tax number as Type 2.-Cause-Company tax arrangements have not been maintained accordingly.-Resolution-Via Tax Management work center, create Tax Authorities and assign to Company Tax Arrangements accordingly. When creating Company Tax Arrangements for Company XYZ, give Tax Number Type 2.

Title: Cancelled Supplier Invoice and Cancellation Invoice not Visible in Supplier Account Monitor
Content: Symptom-You expect to find all transactions made on a supplier account in work center Payables in the Supplier Account Monitor on tab Trade Payables, subtab Invoices/Payments. However, a cancelled supplier invoice and its cancellation invoice are missing on this subtab. Both source documents are posted successfully.  -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Under the Suppliers view go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Show All Suppliers and find the relevant account ID.-Mark the row of the account ID and choose the View button.-Now on tab Trade Payables, subtab Invoices/Payments show All Items and find the invoice ID you are searching for.-You will neither find the cancelled invoice nor the invoice cancellation.-Cause-As long as no follow-up documents exists, cancelled invoices and their cancellation invoices are not visible in Supplier Account Monitor at subtab Invoices/Payments. However, they are visible under tab Postings.-Resolution-Go to Payables work center.-Under the Suppliers view go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Show All Suppliers and find the relevant account ID.-Mark the row of the account ID and choose the View button.-Now on tab Trade Payables, subtab Invoices/Payments select the Postings subtab.-Show All Items and find the invoice ID you are searching for.-You will find the cancelled invoice as well as the invoice cancellation.

Title: Dump While Editing Material Due to the Duplicated Product in One Price List
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The system throws a dump when editing the Object Instance Floorplan (OIF) of a material.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data/Product and Service Portfolio workk center.-Go to the Materials view.-Select the concerned material.-Select the Edit Button.-Select View All. You get the system dump.-Cause-In price list the duplicate product price is maintained for the affected product.-Note: There could be multiple price lists , in which the product price is maintained , but product price is duplicated in one of the price list-Resolution-You need to delete the duplicate product prices in the price list and release the price list- Steps to find the duplicate price entry: (refer to the attachment for detaild steps with screenshots)-In backend goto transaction SESFTS.-Enter BO name PDM_Material.-Execute query Identification->Query_ID.-Enter query parameter ProductID/Content-> affected product ID.-Execute the query.-In the result list copy the Node_ID of the product.-In backend goto transaction SE16.-Enter the table name : /1CN/ACTSAPPR001.-Press F7.-Enter the node_ID of the product in filter CND_PRODUCT_GUID.-In the result list -> sort by 2 columns -> PRC_Price_list + CND_Product_Guid.-You will view the duplicate entry of the price list.-Copy the price list guid (prc_price_list)  -> in which the duplicate product entry maintained.-In backend goto transaction SESFTS.-Enter BO name prc_sales_price_list.-Perform operation -> Load by node id -> Root.-Enter the node id of the price list.-Copy the ID-Content from Price list result.-Note: you can find out the type of price list ( base price , customer specific price … )  by navigating to association Root -> Property_Valuation.-Goto UI  and navigate to Product and Service portfolio Work center -> Price List View -> Customer Specific Price List -> click on Advanced link in owl -> enter the Name field with Price list ID.-Price list is filtered.-Click on Edit button.-Goto Items tab.-Search for product by entering Find field.-You will find duplicate entries.-Share the price list name with the customer, have them delete the entry and release the price list.

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Even Acquisition Cost was Zero
Content: Symptom-You have acquired a Fixed Asset with 0,00 EUR but there is still a depreciation for future periods visible (To Be Posted).-Reproducing the Issue-Goto  Fixed Assets work center-Press view Fixed Assets-Show all Fixed Assets-Find the concerned Fixed Asset XXX-Press Edit - Master Data-Switch to tab Individual Material-Acquisition Cost is 0,00 EUR-Now switch to tab Values-There is still a Book Value of YYY EUR which is a contradiction to the Acquisition Cost of 0,00 EUR- Cause-You have to recalculate and adjust the values of the concerned Fixed Assets. You can do this in the Values tab of the concerned Fixed Asset.-Resolution-Goto Fixed Assets work center-Switch to view Fixed Assets-Show All Fixed Asssets - Find Fixed Asset XXX-Press Edit - Values-Under Valuation Values per Set of Books push button Values - Recalculate Adjustment-In case a huge amount of Fixed Assets is concerned just perform a new Depreciation Run with period 999/9999 and all Depreciations will be recalculated (but not posted) as desired.

Title: You are Looking for a Data Source or Report With Expense Report Approval Date
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the date when the Expense Report was approved by, for example, a Line Manager, in any of the analytics reports or data sources for expense reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently, there is no analytic report or data source with Approval Date field of the expense report.-Resolution-You may see the approval details with the Approver and the Approval Date under the Reimbursement History in the Review tab of the Expense Report document.-Keywords-expense report; approval date; Reimbursement History; report; analytical report; data source

Title: Project Activity IDs Are Not Being Copied When Copying a Project.
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Project ABC by copying an existent project XYZ. You expect the Activity IDs of this new project to follow the same pattern of the original one, they should have the same suffix. For example, the activity ID ABC-1 should be called ABC-123, since the same activity is called XYZ-123 in the original project.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center-Go to Projects view-Select New, then Project-For Source, select Existing Project-Enter the desired information and select Next-Select the original Project and perform the next steps until the project is created-Open the new project and see the IDs of its activities do not follow the pattern of the source project-Cause-When copying a project the new activity IDs are concatenations of the new project ID and the old activities IDs. This new activity IDs however have a maximum lenght of 24 characters.-In case this combination exceeds the limit, system will set the IDs following the standard order (1, 2, 3...).-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.

Title: Company Currency is not Shown in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post the Journal Entry Voucher with Currency ABC, and you realize after posting that Company Currency filed is blank.-ABC refers to the Currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Open the Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Search with Journal Entry Voucher: 123.-Only transactional currency can be seen, but not the amount converted into company currency. Company Currency is displaying blank.-Cause-In journal entry vouchers, only data entered by the user can be seen. The journal entry voucher will not show currency conversion. If a transaction currency and exchange rate to company currency is provided, only the conversion will be displayed in the resulting journal entry.-Resolution-System behavior is as designed.-Each business transaction is entered in the source document in the transaction currency. If the transaction differs from the local currency, the system subsequently converts the business transaction amount for the journal entry into the local currency.-Hence, company currency reflects in the journal entries based on exchange rates and this can also be seen in the G/L Line Item reports.-Keywords-company currency; transaction currency; journal entry voucher; jev; exchange rate

Title: Deferred Revenue Postings for Already Invoiced Revenues due to Applied Exchange Rates
Content: Symptom-A Revenue Recognition run for a Sales Order item XYZ-10 in foreign currency results in non-expected reversals of previously fully recognized revenues as deferred revenues. The applied Accrual Method is Recognize using cost-to-cost POC. The Percentage of Completion already is 100% and Sales Order item XYZ-10 has been fully invoiced.-Therefore all revenues should have been realized previously already and the expectation is that no additional adjustments or further revenue deferrals are to be shown.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center choose the Periodic Tasks view and Revenue Recognition.-Select the Revenue Recognition - Run ID and select Log Result.-Under Processed Successfully tab choose PoC Based and  filter for Sales Order item XYZ-10.-Here the Current Recognized Revenues Amount shows a figure with a negative sign.-Find the resulting Journal Entries under Postings / Journal Entries tab.-Cause-The applied Accrual Method: Recognize using cost-to-cost POC and its realization logic can explain the observed behaviour when taking applied exchange rates into account.-For Accrual Method: Recognize using cost-to-cost POC the Revenue Recognition calculates effective revenues applying the current percentage of completion (PoC) to the Plan Revenue at the time.-In the Sales Document Items view this can be illustrated by choosing the Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data / Percentage of Completion button.-The Plan Revenue represents the Net Value of Sales Order item XYZ-10, here in foreign currency. Due to currency fluctuations over time - an increase of the Company Currency value  will reduce the converted Plan Revenue in Company Currency at the time of the Revenue Recognition Run.-When comparing the already invoiced amount in Foreign Currency we see now an 'Over-invoicing' in relation to the now reduced Plan Value.-Example:-Company Currency: CHF-Transaction Currency: EUR-Exchange Rate CHF/EUR in 2014: 1,2-Exchange Rate CHF/EUR in 2015: 1,05- -Sales Order item  XYZ-10 shows a Net Value of 10.000 EUR in 2014. The Plan Revenue in Company Currency therefore is: 12.000,00 CHF.-Sales Order Item XYZ-10 is fully delivered and invoiced already in 2014. The PoC is 100% and the revenue fully recognized in 2014 as 12.000,00 CHF.-In 2015 the associated project is still open and the Sales Order status still In Process. Sales Order item XYZ-10 is therefore included in the Revenue Recognition applying the Accrual Method: Recognize using cost-to-cost POC.-The Plan Revenue in Company Currency now is: 10.500,00 CHF. The difference of Actual Revenue (12.000,00 CHF) and Plan Revenue in Company Currency (10.500,00 CHF) is 1.500,00 CHF. This amount will now be shown as Deferred Revenue.-   Resolution-In such a scnenario - if revenues exceeding the Plan Revenue shall be acknowledged as realized revenues, then Project (task) and Sales Order (item) have to be completed.-Another option would be the modification of the applied Accrual Method to Reverse deferrals and accruals and to re-run the Revenue Recognition for the concerning period.

Title: Inventories Migrated Incorrectly / Balances of Some Inventories Mistakenly Migrated
Content: Symptom-After the migration of inventories the opening balance of some inventories was found to be incorrect because of wrong file/incomplete file used for migration.-However, there is no option available to reverse the migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Journal Entries view under Journal Entries.-Filter with Journal Entry Type Data Migration, Related Source Document Type Goods and Activity Confirmation and locate the posting in question-Incorrect balances are observed for some materials; however, there is no available option to reverse the migration.-Or-Go to Business Configration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migration accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-The already migrated units do not have an option to perform a reverse migration.-Cause-This functionality of directly reversing migrated inventories is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Direct reversal of the migration is not supported. To adjust the inventory balances affected by incorrect quantity selection, re-migration can be performed using adjustment stock.-Here, adjustment stock means that if 3 quantities were entered during the original migration, the same material should now be entered with a quantity of -3. This will eventually nullify the balance in the relevant inventory account, as the value is being entered as negative stock.

Title: GR/IR Run Shows Error 'Account Determination is Missing for Position Type Exchange Rate Differences from Purchasing'
Content: Symptom-You get the errorr message:-Account determination is missing for position type Exchange Rate Differences from Purchasing-in the message log after performing the GR/IR Clearing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center-Navigate to GR/IR Clearing view-Find the concerned Run ID and click it-Mark the concerned GR/IR run in List of Logs view and click View-Go to tab Processed with Errors tab-In the section Details under messages you see the mentioned error message.-Cause-The error is raised since g/l-accounts are not maintained for exchange rate differencesr. You must maintain suitable g/l-accounts accunting for such differences in the Business Configuration / Fine Tuning.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Select the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and click Change Immidiately.-Under Account Determination select Inventories.-Now go to the tab Differences.-Maintain designated g/l-accounts here.-Once you maintain the accounts please re-run the Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing run (GR/IR Clearing).

Title: Can There Be A Restriction On The Number Of Leaves To Be Applied By An Employees
Content: Symptom-Can we retrict an employee on the number of leaves to be applied-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Select the New Leave Request link under My Requests.-Select the Type of Leave-Here we do not have a restriction for the number of leaves an employee can apply-Cause-We understand that the Time Types can have limitation only with the validity. But no restriction for the number of leaves an employee can apply.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Can The Leave Request Override the Day Off Defined In The Time Model
Content: Symptom-Is it possible for the Leave request to override the Day Off defined in Time Model and considered as a Employee Leave request in the system.-Cause-This is not possible because when a Time Model has day off as yes, they will not be considered as a working day.-Resolution-The System works as designed. The Leave Requests will not be taken into into consideration if they have been applied on the day offs.

Title: How to Schedule Data Uploads Through the Mass Data Maintenance Work Center?
Content: Symptom-Schedule data uploads through the Mass Data Maintenance Work Center using Scheduled Job option-Reproducing the Issue-You can schedule a Job by following the below steps--1. Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center-2. Select Import <(Link)>e.g. <Customers>-3. Select Upload Data from Text file-4. Select Execute Migration-5. Select With Scheduled Job-Resolution-Once you schedule a upload, the Data import run is scheduled for 3:00AM. Since this is the standard time set for all customers, changing this time is not possible.-Once a Job is scheduled you will not be able to cancel this job and this needs to be cancelled from backend.

Title: Not Able to Assign Posting Control Profiles to an Accounting Principle
Content: Symptom-You are trying to assign a Posting Control Profiles to an Accounting Principle, however there is no option to add the Accounting Principle﻿.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to view Implementation projects View.-Select your Implementation Project.-Click the button Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine Tuning tab.-Select the activity Posting Control Profiles for Procurement Processes and click Open.-Select your Posting Control Profile ID and go to tab Assignment to Accounting Principle.-You will see no option to add the Accounting Principle.-Cause-The process to assign an Accounting Principle to a Posting Control Profile is done via the activity Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.-Resolution-In order to assign an Accounting Principle to a Posting Control Profile, you need to execute the following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation projects view.-Select your Implementation Project.-Click the button Open Activity List and navigate to the Fine Tuning tab.-Search and open the activity Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.-Click the link Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.-Here you can change the Posting Control Profile linked to the Accounting Principles.-PS.: Each Accounting Principle has to have exactly one Posting Control Profile assigned to it.

Title: Restrict Balance Confirmation Run Result to a Single Currency in the Output
Content: Symptom-You want to restrict the Balance Confirmation Run to only show results of a single currency in the Output.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Under Periodic Tasks view choose Balance Confirmation Runs.-Start a new run.-You'll see that is not possible to restrict the run by currency.-Cause-It is not possible to restrict Balance Confirmation Run output to a single currency.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current system release. At this point in time, we are not in position to provide more accurate information if or when this will be available in a future release.

Title: How to Enter a New Bank Directory Entry for a Japanese Bank
Content: Symptom-You are trying to enter a new bank directory entry for a Japanese bank, however Katakana characters are not allowed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Master Data and choose the sub view Bank Directory.-Choose New and Select Country: Japan and fill all other mandatory fields-The system does not allow entering a new bank directory entry for a Japanese bank, but requires the bank name in Japanese katakana characters.-Cause-Multiple Scripts option is not currently scoped in your system.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Edit Project Scoping for the project.-Under the Built-in Services and Support -Drop down to Addresses and Languages-In the service Multiple Scripts and enable the option-Hence the Service Multiple Scripts enables you to be able to maintain Katakana/Japanese in your system.-Keywords-Katakana; Japanese; Multiple Scripts; Bank Directory; japan

Title: Error Message "Party XYZ does not exist" while Migrating Registered Products
Content: Symptom-When migrating Registered Products, system throws below error message-Party XYZ does not exist-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Registered Products-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-The cause for the error message is as follows,--There are customer ID which you have used in the Migration Template for Registered Products doesn't exists in the system.-This can be identified by,--Downloading the Error Log in the Simulation step of the migration--or---> Go to Convert Values step of the migration--> select Value Conversion for Account ID-Here, there are many conversions confirmed with same External Customer ID instead of its respective Cloud for Customer's Customer ID.--These are Customer which are throwing the error message during simulation.--or---> Copy the Customer ID which are causing the error,--> Go to Customer work center--> Select Account view--> Search with the ID-Resolution-Correct the data in the migration template and try the import again.

Title: How to Enter a Memo Line Text Into a Tax Payment
Content: Symptom-You are creating internal tax payments via bank transfer; However, the corresponding payment order does not have an automatic memo line created for the tax scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to concerned Tax Returns view.-In the Show field select Reported Tax Returns Relevant for Payment and select the respective tax return.-Press Pay.-Post the tax payment with the required details.-Refer to the payment order associated to this tax payment.-You'll see that no tax related memo line has been automatically generated in the bank transfer.-Cause-The memo line in the payment is a collection of text fragments defined by Payment Correspondence Profiles. This is defined in the Fine-Tune activity Outgoing Bank Transfers. These profiles are responsible for automatically generating the memo line in the payment based on respective invoice/credit memo data depending on the medium format.-The system is currently not designed to support rules for memo lines with tax details.-Resolution-In order to enter a memo line text manually for a tax payment, you may initiate an external bank transfer (this means, not in the Tax Management work center) and manually enter the desired memo line in the payment. This can be reached by the following steps:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click New Bank Transfer under Common Tasks.-On the new bank transfer screen, for the payee field select your tax authority.-Fill in all the other mandatory details, such as Payment Amount and Company. You'll be able to manually enter the memo line.-After you post the payment, go to the Payment Monitor. You'll see the created payment with status Ready for Transfer status. Note that the Postprocessing is Required.-Click the Required hyperlink to open the Tax Payment screen (as the payee is the tax authority).-On this screen you can match the payment with the tax return and post the tax payment.-As a result, you have the tax return completed by a tax payment with reference to a bank transfer, which has the manual memo line.

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Not Accounting Price Difference
Content: Symptom-GR/IR Clearing run did not realize the price difference when invoice price does not match order price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to GR/IR Clearing run view.-Open the run executed for the respective purchasing document or create a new run.-Display the Logs and navigate to the Processed Successfully tab.-Notice that the price difference was not accounted for.-Cause-Although the goods and services receipt, supplier invoice and GR/IR run belong to the same period, the price difference is not realized by the run because the goods and service receipt posted to Unbilled Payables account in a future date within this same period.-Since the GR/IR Clearing run was executed for the current period, it considers all the items posted till the execution date of the run. The run does not consider future posting within the same period (meaning, one week from execution date), which means that only the invoice amount, posted before execution date, was recognized and hence the price difference could not be calculated.-Note that if the run is executed for a previous accounting period, the posting takes place on the last day of the period. If the run is executed in the current period, posting date is the current execution date.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-In this situation, either the goods and services receipt can be cancelled and re-created to the current date (or before), or it can be waited until the execution date of the GR/IR Clearing run reaches the posting date of the document.-Keywords-gr/ir clearing run; price difference; unbilled payables

Title: Account not Found for Company XYZ and Customer/Cupplier ABC While Creating an Outgoing Check
Content: Symptom-System throws the error message Account not found for company XYZ and customer/supplier ABC while creating an Outgoing Check for an employee.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks > New Outgoing Check.-Complete the Company and Payee.-Select a Payment Amount and the Currency and Bank account ID.-Click on Assign on Account Payment button.-Select Customer/Supplier ID and click on OK button.-System shows up the error message Account not found for company XYZ and customer/supplier ABC.-Cause-The error message occurs if this is the first payment done for an employee. This kind of payment to be created without any Expense report or open item (invoice, charge/credit, etc.) is an advance payment which is currently not supported in SAP Business By Design.-To create an Outgoing check for an employee, the Account Determination group 4050 has to be assigned for him/her, you can see this by executing the following steps:-Go to Payables Work Center.-Go to Supplier Accounts View.-Show All Employees.-Search for the employee you are trying to pay.-You will see No results can be found.-Resolution-In order to overcome this situation our suggestion is to create an Expense Report for a very minor value such as 1,00 or even lesser and create a payment for this Expense Report. This way, the Account Determination group 4050 will be automatically assigned to the employee.-Later if you wish then you can cancel this posting and the Expense Report also.

Title: Error Message: Account Determination is Missing for Position Type Unbilled Receivables
Content: Symptom-When running a Revenue Recognition, you receive the error message:-Account determination is missing for position type Unbilled Receivables-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Select Revenue Recognition subview.-Click on the relevant Revenue Recognition ID.-Go to tab Messages.-You can see the error message: Account determination is missing for position type Unbilled Receivables.-Cause-A valid account determination is missing for sales and correspondingly for your customer-accounts. Hence the error message is raised.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on View button.-Under Account Determination section select Sales.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-Go to Revenue Recognition - Defferals tab. You have maintained G/L accounts for Account Determination Group for Customers.-Go to Revenue Recognition - Accruals tab.-Click on Add Row button.-Maintain the Account Determination Group for Customer. You need to maintain the same settings as maintained in the Revenue Recognition - Defferals tab.-Click on Save and Close.

Title: Unable To Add Exchange Rates
Content: Symptom-You are unable to add Exchange Rates as the Add Button is grayed out-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, select Edit Exchange Rates.-Now try to add exchange rates.-The Add button is grayed out.-Cause-The first record in the lines for the exchange rates does not exist.-Resolution-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, select Edit Exchange Rates.-Enter the first exchange rate in the empty row.-After saving it, the Add button is enabled.

Title: HTML E-mail Template Does not Consider Changed Text
Content: Symptom-Using an HTML e-mail  template for Customer invoice as example does not take over the free text maintained via the 'You can also' Fuction.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer invoice Work Center.-Then Go to Invoice Documents view.-Search for a Customer invoice which is not released and Edit document.-Then click on You can also ->Edit Output settings->E-Mail text Tab.-It is possible to maitain free text but after clicking Apply the free text will not be considered.-Cause-This is the expected behavior. When html templates is used, it does not over write this content when sending e-mail.-Resolution-To avoid confusion, we are going to remove Apply in future releases.

Title: How to Undo a Capitalization Posting Originated from a Legacy Asset
Content: Symptom-You have capitalized an asset from a legacy fixed asset and performed further manual postings, such as readjustments and depreciation, however you wish to undo this newly created asset.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Find the newly capitalized asset.-You wish to reverse the transactions and retire the asset.-Cause-The newly created asset was capitalized via partial transfer of an individual material from a legacy asset (migrated), hence you currently have both assets as Capitalized.-Resolution-You may reverse the Journal Entry Vouchers that accounted the transfer and/or Revaluations in the reverse chronological order in order to write-off the newly created asset. Once the asset has zero cost, you may set the Deactivation Date. This would leave asset with Retired status.-The depreciation run (which could also be executed after setting the deactivation date) would then do the adjustments to the depreciation postings based on the retirement transactions.

Title: Net Value and Net Price not displayed for Source of Supply
Content: Symptom-While assigning Source of Supply, system does not display the Net Value in the Source of Supply Screen-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Purchase Requests & Orders Work Center.-Go To Purchase Orders View-Select any Purchase Order-Go to Items Tab-Add an Item-Select the Item and click on tab - Assign Source of Supply-In the Source of Supply screen, Net Value is not displayed-Cause-No quantity was entered for the Item in the Purchase Order. In order to have the Net Value and Net Price being displayed when assigning a Source of Supply, you must enter a minimum quantity for the product in the Purchase Order.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-In order to have the Net Value and Net Price being displayed when assigning a Source of Supply, you must enter a minimum quantity for the product in the Purchase Order. For Instance: You could enter Quantity as 1 each for the given product. Later, if you select the tab - Assign Source of Supply, the Net Price will get populated for the list of Suppliers.

Title: Cleared Invoice Included in the Dunning Run
Content: Symptom-After the dunning run is executed you notice that it triggered the creation of dunning proposals for this customer XYZ and invoice PQR which is already cleared with payment.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables workcenter go to Periodic Tasks - Dunning Runs.-Press New-Dunning Run, maintain all mandatory data and the customer ID.-Then press Activate and after press Schedule.-Select Start Immediately and press Save and Close.-Back in the Dunning Run view refresh the screen until the run appears as well as the application log on the bottom of the screen.-Click on the Application Log ID to open it.-Here you notice that for your customer XYZ dunnings have been created.-The dunning proposals are maintained in the Dunning view of the Receivables workcenter.-Cause-The dunning cut-off date is as 05-05-2015 and the invoice was cleared on 24-07-2015. Hence the invoice is in the open status during the creation of the dunning run which trigerred the selection of the invoice in the proposal.-Resolution-During the execution of the dunning run there is a personalization hidden field on the screen which is cut-off date. We ask you to edit the run settings and remove this system defaulted date value during the creation of the dunning runs going forward. If the cut-off date is provided then system will only check if the invoice is cleared during this date or not and now you can choose if you require this date to be filled or left blank.

Title: Default Gross Rule is Copied from Base Document to Target Instead of Determined From Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the default gross pricing strategy in Business Configuration. But when creating sales quote out of an opportunity, the price strategy is Net instead of Gross.-Reproducing the Issue-Maintain the default gross pricing in Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-In the Business Configuration Search, find Configure Price Strategy.-Open it and click Default Gross Pricing. You has maintained the rule that if the distribution channel is A than the default pricing is Gross. (A represents the distribution channel ID)-Creat sales quote:-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunties view.-Find one opportunity and click Follow-up ->Sales Quote.-In the new sales quote, the distribution channel is A, however the Price In is Net instead of Gross.-It works fine if you manually create new sales quote without preceding documents.-Cause-When a follow up from opportunity is made, the pricing strategy also gets copied and no redetermination from Business Configuration is done.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior as designd.

Title: Company XYZ not Registered in Country United Arab Emirates
Content: Symptom-While creating a transactional document, such as a sales order, the following warning message is displayed.-Company XYZ not registered in country United Arab Emirates, define Tax number as Type 2-The country-specific tax return type is required to be maintained in the Company Tax Arrangements for the UAE Tax Authority. However, the corresponding option is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To verify the current Company Tax Arrangement please go to:-Tax Management work center-Company Tax Arrangements view-Select the Company Tax Arrangement maintained for country AE - United Arab Emirates-Click on Edit-Under the Tax Numbers subtab, attempt to select a Tax Number Type. It is not possible to select any Tax Number Type.-Cause-The United Arab Emirates is a special case where maintaining a tax number for the tax authority is not required.-As UAE does not charge taxes for the transactions supported on By Design there is no need to maintain tax type or tax number for tax authority.-The warning message displayed while creating a document in the system can be ignored.-This warning message appears only where there is no tax details maintained in the tax authority, however this warning message does not prevent the system from posting any document.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Tax ID not mandatory, disregard warning message, by design behavior, sales order warning, tax authority settings, country-specific filing type, cannot choose tax number type, edit company tax arrangement, tax number type selection disabled, no tax setup required

Title: External Reference Field in a Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the External Reference field in a new Journal Entry Voucher (JEV) is not visible to all users once a new JEV is created.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entry Voucher view.-Click New -> Journal Entry Voucher.-Depending on the user that execute these steps, you may or may not see the External Reference field.-Cause-For all the French companies, the External Reference field in a JEV is mandatory and is enabled once you fill the Company ID field. In cases where the Company ID remains in blank, the external reference is not shown. This is the behavior for all users, regardless of business roles.-Resolution-In order to make the field visible, fill in the Company ID field.-Note that the system stores a cache of the last JEV created by a specific user. When this user creates a new JEV the system will default the company ID as per the last JEV created. If the user has never created a JEV it's not possible to default such data, thus the field remains in blank. For the subsequent ones, the company ID is derived accordingly.

Title: Bank Details Alr. Used In X Paymts, For Instance In Paymt PQR of Comp Z
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-An attempt to delete a bank account from the customer account was unsuccessful due to the following error message:-"Bank Details Alr. Used in X Payments, for Instance in Payment PQR of Company Z."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center-Under Customers view navigate to Customer Accounts-Click on Customer Name XYZ-View All and navigate to Financial Data tab and click on sub tab Bank Data-Select the Bank Account and click on Remove-Cause-Although no payments have been made using this bank account and the only payment processed so far is a cash payment, the system does not allow the bank account to be removed. This is because, for certain cash payments, the Business Partner bank details are automatically determined from the Business Partner master data and updated in the Payment Order business object.-Resolution-If a customer reports incident for a similar error message then please follow either of the options as required from case to case-Suggest the customer De-limit the bank account if removal is not possible due to error message-Send to the development for the backend removal of the bank account with permission to do so.-Keywords-delete bank account error, bank account cannot be deleted, bank account in use error,payment order contains bank data, cash payment bank data populated, delimit bank account validity, set bank account to inactive, unassign bank account from customer,

Title: No DATEV Account Found for Acc., Chart of Acc. German Chart of Accounts
Content: Symptom-You have executed a DATEV export run. The run finished with errors. In the Application log you find the error message Journal entry XXXXXXXXXXXX: No DATEV account found for acc. YYYYYY chart of acc. German Chart of Accounts XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Periodic Tasks - DATEV Export view.-Select the respective run.-In the Execution Details table find the application log of the run that finished with errors (Red Alert) and select it.-Press View DATEV Export Results.-In the Data with Errors tab find the erronous journal entry(ies) displaying the message Journal entry XXXXXXXXXXXX: No DATEV account found for acc. YYYYYY chart of acc. German Chart of Accounts XYZ.-Cause-The G/L account YYYYYY of charts of accounts XYZ has not been mapped to a DATEV account of the DATEV chart of accounts ABC.-Resolution-You need to map a DATEV account to the G/L Account YYYYYY:-In the Business Configuration workcenter open the Activity List of the First Implemetation project and navigate to the Fine-Tune-phase.-Find the DATEV Chart of Accounts and Tax Code Mapping activity and open it.  If your system is life go to the Overview view, find the activity here and press Change immediately.-In the new window press Edit Account Mapping.-Here you can map the G/L accounts from your chart of accounts XYZ  to the respective DATEV account of the DATEV Chart of accounts ABC.-In the Details table  in the left column, G/L Account, search for the account YYYYYY. The account does not appear here. To map the account-Press Add Row.-In the G/L Account column select account YYYYYY.-In the DATEV Account column select/assign an appropriate DATEV account.-If none of the DATEV accounts fit you might have to add this account to the DATEV Chart of Accounts:-Back in the DATEV Chart of Accounts and Tax Code Mapping activity press Edit DATEV chart of accounts.-Select ABC and press Add row, enter the G/L account ID and maintain all relevant settings.-Press Save and Close.-Now you can map the G/L account YYYYYY to the newly created DATEV account.

Title: Price is Not Editable in Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-The user is unable to edit the price in Shopping Cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Services Overview view.-Select Go Shopping. -Price cannot be edited. -Cause-Price is not editable in Go Shopping option of "Home work center - Self-Services Overview view".-Resolution-The price is editable in Go Shopping (Advanced) of "Home work center - Self-Services Overview view".-Note: if the user have created a Catalog for non-stock materials and services that are ordered in the Shopping Cart, the price will be pulled from the published Catalog. Kindly note that this price field will be non-editable. That happens because the Catalogs are usually provided by external suppliers or set by purchasing department in case of custom catalogs with prior negotiation.-Keywords-Price; Shopping Cart; Self-Services; Go Shopping; Catalog

Title: Reimbursement Details are Visible When Creating a New Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new expense report for a user other than yourself, however you notice that the payment information for this employee is visible on expense report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Reports view.-Edit an Expense Report or create a new Expense Report on Behalf.-You notice that the employee's payment information (addresses, bank details) is visible in the document, although you expect this information to be masked.-Resolution-The bank details in the expense report should be restricted to the employee to whom the reimbursement is made and finance and HR only, who then usually own the access rights to Travel and Expenses work center. For users owning Travel and Expenses work center there is no masking as such a user should be able to see every information relevant for travel and expenses (including the address where i.e. a check should be sent to or the bank details where the reimbursement should be paid).

Title: Purchase Order approval task shows account assignment in language other than English
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-An approval task shows the account assignment in a language other than English. In some of the approval tasks, Cost Center is for example shown as Kostenstelle (German for Cost Center).-Reproducing the Issue-Open Application and User Management Workcenter-Select Task Distribution header> Business Task Management view-Select Show All Items-Find Approve Purchase Order*> Go-You can see that there are task titles in which the term "Cost Center" is shown as "Kostenstelle" for example (German for Cost Center).-"Approve Purchase Order XYZ - Supplier ABC - value Z EUR - Kostenstelle DEF"  instead of "Approve Purchase Order XYZ - Supplier ABC - value Z EUR - Cost center DEF"-Cause-The text for account assignment is generated at the time of ordering the PO and is a static text that cannot be translated dynamically.-If the user who created and ordered the Purchase order was logged into the system in a different language than English at the time, the system builds the subject of the task with the account assignment type in that language.-Later when the approver views this task the account assignment part the task has already been persisted in the said language and cannot be translated back into English.-Resolution-This is a technical limitation. To prevent this from occurring, the document must be created while the user is logged into the system is English.

Title: Clearing Date Shows XX-XX-XXXX In Accounts Receivable - Open Items Report
Content: Symptom-In the Accounts Receivable - Open Items Report shows those items which are still open in the customer account monitor but you observe that the Clearing Date shows for instance 12-31-9999 against these open item invoices. Ideally if the open item has clearing then it should never be shown in this report and you do not know the reason why it shows clearing date and the items against it.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables work center navigate to the Reports-List view-Open the Accounts Receivable - Line Items report-Maintain the mandatory variable fields as well as the select the customer to check opem items-From Not Currently Shown, select Clearing Date and click on Move to Rows-You will observe that against the open items you will see the clearing date as 12-31-9999-Cause-When we get an open item in accounting - the system sets the clearing date to XX-XX-XXXX. When the open item is cleared, this date is reset to the date of clearing.-Resolution-The Current system behavior is that, whenever you post an invoice by default the clearing date of 12-31-9999 is set by the system. This date is an indication that the invoice is yet to be cleared and is not the actual clearing date.-Upon clearing the invoice, then this invoice item is not shown in this report and the clearing date 12-31-9999 is reset to the date of actual clearing/payment date of the invoice.--This works to all the financial statements (reports), but not to every sub-ledger or G/L account type, as not all postings are subject to clearing.

Title: Exchange Rate Difference Only Recognized in Company Currency After Processing Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-Outgoing Bank Transfer XYZ is recorded in foreign currency - deviating from the Bank Account Currency. Subsequently this payment is confirmed in a bank statement allocating the entire amount.-In the resulting payment allocation journal entry you observe not only an exchange rate posting but also an entry only in Company Currency - however, not in the same Transaction Currency. Therefore you consider this entry to be inconsistent.-Reproducing the Issue-You can access relevant payment allocation(s) either in:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant Payment Allocation in status Posted.-or via the posted bank statement:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Open the Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and Edit.-Follow the Postprocessing: Not Required link to access the relevant payment allocation.-Cause-The applied exchange rate when recording the Outgoing Bank Transfer differs from the exchange rate applied in the Bank Statement. The Bank Statement transaction (Transaction Currency = Company Currency)already reflects this change in the recorded Bank Account Currency . Since the current exchange rate maintained in the system also tallies with the exchange rate applied in the Bank Statement -  amounts match for Bank Account Currency, Company Currency and Transaction Currency -  no exchange rate differences will have to be actively confirmed in the payment allocation for Cash-in-Transit-G/L Account ABC .-The original payment however has a different Transaction Currency. The clearing line in the resulting journal entry of type Techn. Clearing of Bank Clearing Account therefore shows different entries in Debit in Company Currency and Debit in Transaction Currency reflecting an exchange rate only in Company Currency and not the same Transaction Currency.-Example:-Company Currency:  EUR-Bank Account Currency:  EUR-Payment Currency: USD-  An outgoing bank transfer XYZ is issued on 15.07.2015 over 1000 USD.-The effective exchange rate is 1,13 USD/EUR.-The resulting journal entry therefore shows 884,96 EUR in Company Currency and Transaction Currency in Credit for Cash-in-Transit-G/L Account ABC. -  G/L Account Debit in Company Currency Credit in Company Currency Debit in Transaction Currency Credit in Transaction Currency-ABC - Cash in Transit 884,96 EUR 1.000,00 USD-Expense Account 884,96 EUR 1.000,00 USD-  In a Bank Statement this Outgoing Bank Transfer XYZ is confirmed on 02.08.2015 already reflecting the now effective exchange rate 1,00 USD/EUR.-The amount in Transaction Currency therefore is 1000 EUR.-In the journal entry resulting from the Payment Allocation the Cash-in-Transit-G/L Account ABC is credited with 1000 EUR in Company Currency (EUR) and Transaction Currency (EUR) - reflecting the actual disbursement on the EUR bank account on 02.08.2015. -The Debit entry on Cash-in-Transit-G/L Account ABC reflecting the technical clearing of the outgoing bank transfer shows the original 884,96 EUR in Company Currency and 1000 EUR in Transaction Currency.-A further Debit entry, accounting for the exchange rate loss of 115,04 EUR, only shows in Company Currency since this directly relates to the Credit entry recorded in the original Outgoing Bank Transfer in Company Currency.-  G/L Account Debit in Company Currency Credit in Company Currency Debit in Transaction Currency Credit in Transaction Currency-ABC - Cash in Transit 1000,00 EUR 1.000,00 EUR-ABC - Cash in Transit 884,96 EUR 1.000,00 EUR-Exchange Rates 115,04 EUR-  The system behaves correctly.-

Title: Employee Name Shows in Different Format in Expense Report
Content: Symptom-Employee name shows in difference format in expense report. Some shows in format of Last Name First Name, while other shows in format of First Name Last Name.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expense work center and Expense Reports view,  employee name of some expense reports shows in format of Last Name First Name, while other shows in format of First Name Last Name.- Cause-The formatting of the name is different for the employees because the Country for Name Format differs.- Resolution-You can update the setting of Country for Name Format for each employee with following steps:-Go to work center Business Partner Data and view Business Partners.-Select the business parnter and select Edit then General.-Select Additional Name Fields and maintain Country for Name Format.-

Title: No Automatic Payment Allocation Against Existing Incoming Direct Debit Payment
Content: Symptom-Customer invoices have been paid in the system using incoming direct debit. These payments are now confirmed in an automatic bank statement.-After posting the statement you notice that transactions are still in status Postprocessing: Required. Created payment allocations are still in status In Preparation.-Since bank account data, payment methods, dates and payment amounts match your expectation is an automatic allocation of concerned transactions.-Reproducing the Issue-You can access relevant payment allocation(s) either in:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant Payment Allocation having the status In Preparation.-or via the posted bank statement:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Open the Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and Edit.-Follow the Postprocessing: Required link to access the relevant payment allocation.-Cause-With every bank statement transaction an External Transaction Code is provided signifying the applied Payment Method.-The matching of External Transaction Code as in the statement and Payment Method in the system - in this case suggests the clearing of an open receivable rather than the allocation against an already existing payment.-A translation of External Transaction Code: Direct Debit (e.g. SEPA direct debit (single posting)) into Payment Method Payment: Processing - Of Incoming Bank Transfer facilitates the automatic  allocation and clearing against an open receivable - not an existing direct debit payment.-Resolution-The definition as to whether an open receivable should be cleared or an existing payment should be allocated to - has to be made in the Business Configuration.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open Activity List and select Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Choose Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Mark the relevant Import Format (e.g. MT940) and navigate to the grid matching External Transaction Codes and Payment Methods.-Highlight the row representing the relevant External Transaction Code as specified in the bank statement (e.g. SEPA direct debit (single posting)).-If an automatic allocation against existing direct debit payment(s) is intended the associated Payment Method has to be changed to Payment Processing - Of Incoming Direct Debit.-Note that this document describes the opposite scenario as outlined in case document:-1912959 - Direct Debit Payments Allocated Against Business Partner Account Instead of Payment Assignment

Title: Mismatch in Org Unit and Reporting Line Unit for Employees After Migration
Content: Symptom-Basic Employee Data of Employee ABC was migrated where the Reporting Line Unit is maintained as XYZ (Organizational Assignment). Later, the Personnel Administration data was migrated where the Organizational Assignment is maintained as RST in Work Agreements tab.-Now, in the system--1. Open the Personnel File of the Employee, the Reporting Line Unit is displaying as XYZ which is correct.--2. Go to Organizational Structure, where the Employee ABC is listed under the Org Unit XYZ. But as per the Personnel Administration migration, customer is expecting this Employee to be under RST and it suppose to be the Cost Center.-Cause-In the migration process of Basic Employee Data, you have entered Reporting Line Unit value in the Org Assignment tab which is XYZ. The migration was successful. Hence what happens now is in the backend a Position will be created for the migrated employee. Now during migration of Personnel Administration Data, you have filled Org Unit (Cost center) RST and expecting it to be shown in the same way in the Personnel File of the employee.-But this is not the case, once a position is created for an Employee, though Org Unit is entered in the Personnel Administration Template this cannot be overwritten. So here while doing basic employee data migration if RLU data is given, then position is created based on that and when you give it in Personnel Administration migration the position data is unchanged and hence the problem. To give you more idea, if you give RLU in basic step both the org and RLU is RLU and when you give cost center in basic step it derives RLU for RLU field and Cost center will be the original org assignment, further whatever you give in the Personnel Administration step it wont create update anything. This is not a core issue but the expected behavior of position .-Resolution-However this issue can still be solved, if you enter the value for Reporting Line Unit (XYZ) as Org Unit - RST. By doing so the system derives the corresponding RLU for the mentioned Org unit in the template.-So now you have to follow the below steps mentioned:-1. Enter the Org Unit/ Cost center in the Employee Basic template-2. Enter the same org unit in the personnel admin template as well.-Now once the migration is successful, the personnel file will reflect with the right vales for RLU & Org Unit.

Title: Cannot Create new Account Responsibility Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You want to create a new account responsibility in a corporate or private account using Mass Data Maintenance but it fails and you get an error message  Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for CUSTOMER-DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY - DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY_CTI       - Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Export Customers-Select the Account ID you need to update-Go to Direct Responsibility tab-Export Data to CSV File-Open the file and add a line for a new contact.-The field Direct Responsibility UUID[CURR_EMPL_RESP_UUID] can only be left blank since only the system can generate this field.-Save-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Import Customers-Select your CSV file and Import Data to Tab: Direct Responsibility-Upload-You will receive the message: Data Validation finished successfully. No Invalid data found-Execute Data Import -> immediately-You will receive the error message No Customers imported successfully, X Customers failed. In the details you will get the error Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for CUSTOMER-DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY - DIRECT_RESPONSIBILITY_CTI-Cause-The Reason for the error message is that the field Direct Responsibility UUID is missing. This field is mandatory for Mass Data Maintenance however, only the system can generate it. -Resolution-This is a normal system behavior. Mass Data Maintenance cannot be used to create new responsibilities.-You can create new responsibilities manually when editing an account from the Account Management Work Center-or you can also use the migration tool from the Business configuration Work Center --> activity Migration of Customers (Migration mode : Enhance already existing records)-

Title: Troubleshooting Forms Related Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to differentiate between Forms Issue and Application Issue?-If customer reports that some field values are not displaying/ value is incorrect, first you need to check in the XML of the document.-If the value is proper in the XML but is not displaying correctly in the form then it is a forms issue.-If the value is missing/ incorrect in the XML itself then respective application team should check the issue.-For any new requirement like incorporating new field to the form or new binding path for extension fields, application should check.-If the issue is with the binding path then application should check first.-Case Documents for Must Knows in Forms topic.-         2194433 - How Form Template Selection Rules and Master Template Selection Works for a Particular Document?-         2193339 - How to download the XML for a document from the backend-         2193219 - How to enable XML schema in Adobe Life Cycle Designer-         2193246 - How to find the binding path from Adobe Life Cycle Designer-         2194464 - How to Maintain Translations for the Footer Text in Various Languages for a Master Form Template-         1690729 - How to Troubleshoot a Content Issue in a Sales Form-Other related case documents:-2104897 - Form Template is Missing for Non Localized Countries-2134454 - Preview is getting changed while releasing-2134986 - Unable to Create New Zealand Variant for (particular ft is missing)-2137106 - Easy Form Editor is Disabled for Some Form Template  -          2085325 - Not Possible to Add Freehand Text in the Form Template using Easy Form Editor-

Title: Advanced Query Search for Postal Code isn’t Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-When you try to query Accounts Using Postal Code, system is displaying Accounts which doesn’t have any address with that Postal Code.-And also, when you give a range for Postal Code, the result is not as expected.-For Example:-Entering the range from 1000 to 39999.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Select Accounts view-Select Advanced-Enter a range X – Y in Postal code field-Select Go button-Cause-The query which is set for Postal Code for Accounts checks all the Account Address which has that Postal Code. But this will not check whether it is a Postal Code of a Main Address or from any other Address. -For Example, if an Account has multiple address and one of an Account (not a main) has this Postal Code, the search will still fetch this Account.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-There are two possible ways to fetch the expected result:-1. Selecting Postal Code as a range, for example between 1000 to 39999. Postal code format is different for different countries and some counties has alphanumeric nomenclature as well (like Poland).-Since Postal code is a generic field and must support all counties this field is alphanumeric hence range comparison will not work.-2. Selecting Postal Code using filter. Without clicking Advanced, you can select the filter icon and input the Postal code to filter and you can use wildcard (*) wisely here. For Example: if you need to find all the postal code that starts with 1 then you can enter 1* and select enter.-Note: The same cause and solution is applicable for Country field in Address.

Title: Basic troubleshooting for user request failures
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User request failures for tenant-Cause-SAP_SPC user or the certificate issue-Resolution-Check the logs in NZA_002 backend for this in SRTUTIL for error logs for that particular tenant or for your user id in the error list after you select the Request user button in SPC.-Case1: If you see the error as “Unauthorized” it means issue with either SAP_SPC user or the certificate we use to connect our tenant that is M user certificate.-hdbsql -U DEFAULT-select * from usr02 where bname='SAP_SPC' and MANDT=062-select uflag from usr02 where bname='SAP_SPC' and MANDT=062-Check if SAP_SPC is locked  -                                                                                                                                                                                                    4.Unlock it-   5.Still issue exists-   6.Now we need to check the next method of authentication that is M user certificate at tenant side and also SPC side.-   7.In STRUST check if M user certificate exists with correct tenant and validity date. If yes, Next step is to check the table USRCERTMAP where the M user certificate mapping to SAP_SPC should be present but in this case it was missing (highlighted entry was missing in the table in tenant)-   8.Solution is to check the lifecycle status of the tenant in SPC and also in SPC backend in the BO /A1SSPC/BLD_TENANT and here the status was “READY”. Please change this to LIVE. Even if you find if it is in LIVE status , please change the status from LIVE to QCIP and to LIVE-     9.It will update the USERCERTMAP table with M user entry and issue with user request will be solved.-   Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: Unable To Upload New Material Unit Cost Due To Error : Result SendChunkinstance(XmlDocument requestDoc)Missing Error Details in Service Response
Content: Symptom-Error is thrown during upload of new material unit cost: "Result SendChunkinstance(XmlDocument requestDoc)Missing Error Details in Service Response.Total Number of Records Saved:X"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Under Master Data View select Material Unit Costs.-Click Import Unit Costs.-Fill the required data and click Save Data to.-Cause-If the Cost UoM selected is different in the excel from that is maintained under Base UoM for this material in the master data, error message is thrown: "Result SendChunkinstance(XmlDocument requestDoc)Missing Error Details in Service Response. Total Number of Records Saved: X"-Resolution-The Base UoM maintained in the material master data and the Cost UoM that is selected in the excel should be same to upload material unit cost of the given material.-Keywords-Material Unit Cost; upload; base uom; cost uom.

Title: Unable to Modify Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in a Account
Content: Symptom-You are trying to modify/update the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in the Sales Data of an Account through Mass Data Maintenance. But, even after successful migration, the value has not changed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select Import Customers link-Update the file-After validation, select Execute Import-Cause-The Sales Organization and Distribution channel are key fields and are not modifiable. This is something that is present in the Account (Sales Data) screen too and Migration emulates the screen.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.

Title: Fixed Asset Manual Posting Acquisition: G/L Account Information is Not Fully Displayed in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You are manually posting a fixed asset acquisition and you expect to see all the G/L Account information in the resultant Journal Entry Voucher posted, meaning the G/L Account derived from the Individual Material and the Offsetting G/L Account you've chosen. However, only the second one is shown.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center-Go to Fixed Assets > Fixed Assets view-Click Manual Posting > Acquisition-Enter all required data and pay attention especially to Debit/Credit field under Details section and Account field under Offsetting Account Assignment section-Click Post-Open the journal entry voucher just created and notice that under Items section the G/L Account is blank for the first row. The only information available is the debit or credit posting.-On the second row, you can see the G/L Account you've maintained as offsetting account and the offsetting (debit or credit) posting.-Cause-The reason why the Journal Entry Voucher doesn't display the G/L Account derived from the Individual Material is explained by the system design.-The G/L Account derivation happens upon the creation of the journal entries. In this way, the information is not available during the source document creation (Journal Entry Voucher).
