The journal entry voucher is just a mechanism to trigger the journal entry creation and it cannot always have all the information that the journal entry owns.-Resolution-The system behaves as designed.-In order to check the complete posting information you should check the journal entries created from the journal entry voucher posting. The journal entries can be found under the Related Journal Entries section of the voucher.-See Also-Please check the Attachments section for an example of the scenario described in this Case Document.

Title: How To Reset The Production End Date For Production Lot Which Is Already Included In WIP Clearing
Content: Symptom-A Production Lot has a Production End Date of 01-06-2015  and you have already included this in Work in Progess Clearing. Now the status of the Production Lot is Finished. Now you have done a Adjustment Confirmation of the production task which actually belong to an older date 20-05-2015. Hence you want the production end date to reflect the same.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Inventory Valuation work center - navigate to the Production Lots view under Master Data-Select Production Lot XXX-You will observe that Production End Date is  01-06-2015-Cause-The Production End Date is picked from the date which is entered in the Production Task and this date will be reflected in the Miscellaneous tab upon releasing the task.-Resolution-Go to Inventory Valuation work center-Select Production Lot view under Master Data-Show All Production Lots and find the Production Lot in question and click on it and View All-Navigate to the tab Execution Monitor tab and click on Task ID YYY-In the Production Task Overview screen, Click on View Instruction and click on Change Status and choose Restart-In the new screen for Input Parameters for Restart, navigate to Executed on and enter the date 20-05-2015 which you want it has the production end date-Again click on Change Status and choose Finish-Refresh the screens and now the production end date for the production lot is changed to the date that you entered during the above step

Title: Payment Proposals for Receivables Picked Open Items That Are Not Due
Content: Symptom-You have created automatic payment run, which generated payment proposals for internally-initiated payments and you observe that even those open items which are not yet due were picked in the proposals.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Automatic Payments view.-Show All Payment Proposals.-Select the Payment ID XYZ and click Edit.-Click on Open items tab.-You will observe that payment which are not yet due for this run and due for the next payment run also got picked in the proposal.-Cause-These Payment Runs are for Receivables and are meant to create incoming payments.-When the system considers open items that would result in incoming payments, it will try to pay them as early as possible.-So, even though the item is not overdue yet, the payment run considers these and creates payments.-Resolution-In case you want to delay the creation of these payments, then you need to maintain required number of Grace Days in Business Configuration.-As a result, these items that are not yet overdue will not be picked up by the system.-Go to the Business Configuration work center and navigate to Fine Tuning.-Choose the activity Payment Strategies and click on Edit payment strategies.-Maintain Grace Days and other settings.-Click Save and Close.-Click on Assign Payment Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier and assign the payment strategy to your customer in question.-Keywords-payment proposals; receivables; open items; grace days; Payment Strategy; incoming payments

Title: Unable to Enhance the Value in the Field "Complete Delivery" Using Migration
Content: Symptom-During initial migration of customers, you have not marked (X) for the Complete Delivery field and you wants to enable this field. When you try to enhance this field using migration with mode Enhance Existing Records, the migration is successful but the field is not enhanced in the respective Accounts.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Customers-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with mode Enhance Existing Records-Cause-The field Complete Delivery can not be enhanced because in Sales Data there can be Sales Organizations which are marked as Cross-Account Sales Data and update to Complete Delivery in that case is not allowed via Account screen.--Hence this is not used as enhancement relevant. Data passed will be ignored and default (false) is set all the time. So, the field "Complete Delivery" cannot be enhanced using migration.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can consider updating the field Complete Delivery using Mass Data Maintenance which you have already confirmed that it works.

Title: All Organizational Units Are Being Proposed When Hiring Employee
Content: Symptom-When hiring a new employee, you only expect the organizational units which are marked as Reporting Line Unit to be proposed for the organizational assignment of the new employee. However, the system displays all the organizational units present in the system, hence all of them are available for selection.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Click Hire Employee.-Maintain the mandatory data in the first step - Enter Personal Data.-Click Next.-Open the value help of the Organizational Unit field.-All the organizational units from the system appear as available for selection, nevertheless you expect only the reporting line units to be displayed.-  Cause-The systems behaves as expected. An employee can be assigned to any organizational unit, but not only to reporting line unit. If you want only the reporting line units to be displayed, you can use the advanced search.-Resolution-Navigate to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Click Hire Employee.-Maintain the mandatory data in the first step - Enter Personal Data.-Click Next.-Open the value help of the Organizational Unit field.-Click Advanced.-Select the value Reporting Line Unit from the Definitions drop-down menu.-Click Go - only the reporting line units will be displayed.

Title: Statutory Reports Only for Balance Sheet
Content: Symptom-You want to run Statutory report only for Balance Sheet items.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Statutory Reports subview.-Here you see that there is no option to run Statutory Reports for Balance Sheet only.-Cause-System behavior is as designed. You can run Statutory report for both Balance Sheet and Income Statement together but not for Balance Sheet only.-Resolution-You can run the report only for Balance sheet items through Financial Statements or Financial Statement-Print Layout report.

Title: Error Message "IBAN missing in payer bank account for SEPA mandate XYZ" during Migration of Customers
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Customers, system throws below error messages:-IBAN missing in payer bank account for SEPA mandate XYZ--SWIFT/BIC missing in payer bank for SEPA mandate XYZ--Payer bank missing in SEPA mandate XYZ-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Customers-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-There are few causes that may result in this issue:-If the Bank Data ID was passed incorrectly in the migration template.-If the Sequence number of bank Data is maintained X (numeric value) but it has to be in the format as 000X (numeric value with leading zeros as defined in the system).-Resolution-Check the data as per above causes, correct the data and try the migration again.

Title: SLA Relevant Field In Downtime Details Report
Content: Symptom-There is an attribute SLA Relevant in the Downtime Details (Productive System) report that you can access from the Service Control Center work center. It has either value Yes or No.-You want to know the Yes or No is based on what principle.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Control Center work center-Go to the System Availability (Availability Monitoring) view-On the right hand side you see the Downtime Details (Productive System) report with column SLA Relevant-Resolution-If a downtime occurs during the Standard Weekly Contractual Maintenance Period Slots (CMP) it will be flagged as SLA Relevant = No.--If a downtime occurs outside this period then it will be flagged as SLA Relevant = Yes. However, depending on the reason for the downtime, we can manually change the flag from Yes to No.

Title: Cannot Receive Email for Service Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have selected the scope questions "Do you want to maintain Service Request (Tickets) automatically for incoming e-mails" and "Do you want to support e-mail channels for corporate accounts?". When you try to send test email to technical email address for corporate account (cod.b2b.servicerequest@myxxxxxx.mail.crm.ondemand.com), the email will bounce with error "The email address you entered couldn't be found."-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration-Go to Implementation Projects-Click button Edit Project Scope-Go to Questions-Expand Service->Customer Care->Service Request Management-Select question "Do you want to maintain Service Request (Tickets) automatically for incoming e-mails" and "Do you want to support e-mail channels for corporate accounts?".-Send email to cod.b2b.servicerequest@myxxxxxx.mail.crm.ondemand.com-The email bounces with error "The email address you entered couldn't be found."-Cause-The problem is missing email entry in email channel configuration.-Resolution-Go to backend-Input transaction code SCOT and press Enter-Expand Business Communication Administration->Settings->Inbound Messages->Inbound Processing-Click button New-Input email address cod.b2b.servicerequest@myxxxxxx.mail.crm.ondemand.com-Input inbound handler class CL_COD_B2BSRQ_EMAIL_IN-Save change

Title: Detailed Description and Financials tab are Missing in Mass Data Maintenance of Materials
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to Update certain records of Materials. When you export the Materials in Mass Data Maintenance, you have observed that the Detailed Description and Financials tab are missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Select Export Materials view-Select the Materials and select Go button-Resolution-The tab Detailed Description in Mass Data Maintenance is a new requirement. This will be considered in one of the future release.-Modifying Financials is not supported through Mass Data Maintenance.-Note: It is not possible to enhance the Financial data and Detailed Descriptions using Migration.

Title: Upload Employee Times From Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You would like to know if there is a restriction on the number of employees to be uploaded using the Upload Employee Times From Microsoft Excel option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work center.-Time Recordings View.-Time Sheet Sub view.-In the Actions button-Now click on Upload Times From Microsoft Excel-You can enter only 60 rows in the initial template setup-Cause-There is no restriction in the initial template setup and the lines just need to be enabled by inserting rows in the Excel Template.-Resolution-Go to Time Administration Work center.-In the Time Recordings View.-Click on Time Sheet Subview.-In the Actions button, Click on Upload Times From Microsoft Excel-You may insert rows by using the regular Insert option in the excel sheet or you can copy any amount of rows and the Excel Worksheet will be extended by that amount of lines.-Keywords-Upload,Employee Time, Microsoft Excel

Title: User Access Rights Not Updated After Migration of Employee and User Data
Content: Symptom-You maintained the access rights from your users via the Migration of Employee and User Data and the migration finished successfully. Still, the access rights have not been updated in Application and User Management.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Open the activity Migration of Employee and User Data.-Click Migrate of Employee and User Data Using the Migration Tool.-Download the migration template and fill in all the data, including the corresponding business roles in the Business Roles sheet.-Upload the file and perform the migration.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Highlight any of users which you uploaded via migration.-Click Edit - Access Rights.-Nevertheless the work centers and views have been assigned to the corresponding business role, and the business role has been successfully assigned to the user via migration, the work centers and views are not getting assigned to the user, nevertheless the migration did not show any error message.- Cause-The system works as expected.-Resolution-The distribution of the roles happens via a backend MDRO, and sometimes this takes a while until the data gets updated. This is the reason why the data is not available right after the migration. It can sometimes last up to a few days for the data to be completely updated.

Title: On Creating New Sales Kit error "Item category group KIT does not exist" is triggered
Content: Symptom-On creating New Sales Kit, an error Item category group KIT does not exist is trigger.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-From the Common Task select a New Sales Kit.-In the New Sales Kit, click on the View All button and go to the Sales tab .-Click on the Add Row and maintain Sales Organization and Distribution Channel and go to the General tab.-Click on the Value Help of Product Category and maintain the value for product category PQR (where PQR is product category) and Save the Sales Kit.-error message: Item category group KIT does not exist is triggered.-Cause-You need to scope the relevant scoping element in the Business Configuration .-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects and click on the Edit Project Scope and go to Step3:Scoping .-Now Expand the Scopng Element :Sales ->Product and Service Portfolio for Sales ->Sell Standard Products.-You need to make scoping element Sell Standard Product as check and later Finish your scoping.-Once done you will no more face error on saving the Sales Kit.

Title: Automatic Label Printing in Outbound Logistics for the Delivery Note
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want system to print the labels autimatically as soon as you release the delivery note under Outbound Logistics work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Delivery Control and select Delivery Proposals view.-Select the relevant proposal.-Select Post Goods Issue.-Release the Outbound Delivery.-When you release, you expect system to print the labels automatically.-Resolution-It is not possible to automate the label printing in outbound logistics work center for the Delivery Note directly from standard application. However you can achieve this, via partner development solution. (PDI Solution)--The PDI solution has to be triggered on Release of the Outbound Delivery ﻿document as structured below.--Get the Labels (Goods Tag) for the outbound Delivery.-BO Name: : OutboundDelivery, BO Node Name: Root-Association: Root=> GoodsTagAssignment-Read : GoodsTagUUID--Open the Label-Trigger Action:: CreateWithBusinessTransactionDocumentReference-On BO Name : GoodsTagGenerator, BO Node Name: Root-With Parameters:-BO Name: GDSTG_GOODS_TAG-BO Node Name: ROOT-Node ID: <GoodsTagUUID>--Print the Label-Trigger Action: PrintGoodsTags-On BO Name : GoodsTagGenerator, BO Node Name: Root

Title: Liquidity KPI Issues
Content: Symptom-You might come across two types of issues related to Liquidity Key Performance Indicator, where in both cases, they also can be independent each other:-Issue 01:-Error message: you try to set the Liquidity KPI to Activated status in the system, in order to monitor this Financial Indicator, however you get the following error message when check the Activate box: ABAP Exception: Value '1[1]' for variable Forecast Profile is not valid.--Issue 02: -Liquidity KPI does not show values: you consider incorrect the data shown in Liquidity KPI. In fact, the Liquidity indicator does not show any figure along the Time Series once the actual value shows null results in the Chart or Table.-Reproducing the Issue-Issue 01:-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design KPIs View.-Search by Liquidity.-Click on Activate button.-Issue  02:-Go to Corporate Performance Work Center.-Go to Key Performance Indicators View.-Select the Liquidity KPI in the Evaluation listed.-The dashboard right below does not show figures in the Chart or Table view.-Cause-Issue 01:-The issue occurs because a mandatory report is not scoped into the customer solution. The reason why the exception comes up is associated with a report that runs behind the Liquidity KPI, the KPI framework internally executes this report to get the required data.-Issue 02:- The Liquidity indicator provides figures based on the Liquidity Forecast executed until the current point in time. If you did not perform a Liquidity Forecast in the last three months, the system will not have the corresponding data (which is evaluated by the Liquidity KPI) for the time horizon set, by standard, for this particular KPI.-Resolution-Issue 01:-In order to have the report scoped and to resolve the Liquidity KPI, you might proceed as following:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Click on Edit Project Scope.-Jump to Step 4.-Expand: Cash Flow Management | Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select Cash and Liquidity.-Check the 'In Scope' box for the Question: 'Do you run liquidity forecasts to monitor your future liquidity situation?'.-Save and apply the changes.-Issue 02:-In order to populate data in the Liquidity indicator, the recommendation to the customer is to create and then execute or schedule a new Liquidity Forecast Run, which creates a set of current data. After that, It is expected to see appropriate data in the Key Performance Indicators.-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Liquidity Forecast Run view.-Click on New | Liquidity Forecast Run.

Title: Individual Material ID Incorrect In Fixed Asset - Inventory List Report
Content: Symptom-You are executing Fixed Asset - inventory List report and you found that the Individual Material is incorrect according to which is maintained in the Fixed Asset master data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Asset work center-Go to List view and click on Reports-Execute the report -Here, you can see the Individual Material is incorrect according to which is maintained in the Fixed Asset master data.-Cause-You have to change the settings for characteristic - Individual Material. -Resolution-Follow the below steps to get the correct Individual Material ID:-Execute the report - Fixed Asset - Inventory List-Click on Settings -Select Characteristic from drop down -In the popup screen change the "Attribute Shown" to Individual Material ID for Individual Material Characteristic -Execute the report once again-Now you can view the correct Individual Material ID

Title: The Value of List Price is Missing for the Product within Product and Service Portfolio Work Center
Content: Symptom-The List Price value is missing for Product within Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Products incl. Price Information and search for product ABC (where ABC is product id) and click on the Go button.-You can see for the column name List Price the value is missing-Edit the Product ABC and click on the View All button .-Go to the Sales tab and sub tab Sales Price.-You can see for the product ABC there exist the Price List record PQR (where PQR is Price List name ) with value in it.-Cause-List Price column will have the value only if there exist the Price List for product ABC of type Base i.e.  Base Price List OR Base Price List by Product Category. Since Price List PQR within Sales Price sub tab of product ABC is not of mention type ,hence value missing in List Price column.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Start and End Dates are Editable for Withholding Tax Classification In Supplier Master Data for Israel Country.
Content: Symptom-You have observed that there are Start and End Dates fields in Withholding Tax Classification Tab in Supplier Master Data but these fields are grayed out.-You want to know how to make use of these fields and why are they grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Go to Suppliers subview.-Go to Edit and then to Financial Data.-Go to Tax Data Sub tab.-Go to Withholding Tax Classifications.-You could see that Start Date and End Date are available and these fields are grayed out.-Cause-Start and End Dates fields are only editable in case of Supplier Withholding Tax for Israel Country. For all other Countries, these fields are not editable.-It is legal requirement to maintain the Supplier Withholding Tax time-dependent for Israel country.-Resolution-System behaves as designed.

Title: Partner Company ID is Missing in Reports
Content: Symptom-You are checking e.g. the Accounts Payable - Open Items report and you observed that Partner Company ID is missing for the supplier.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables workcenter.-Navigate to the Reports-List view.-Search for Accounts Payable - Open Items report.-Maintain the mandatory variable fields as well as the G/L account that you want to check.-Click Go.-From Not Currently Shown, select Partner Company and click on Move to Rows.-Here you can see the Partner Company ID is not showing in the report.-Cause-The reason is due to that you have not maintained the Parnter Company - details in the Master Data - Partner Companies view.-Resolution-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Master Data view.-Go to Partner Companies sub-view.-Click on New-> Partner Company tab.-Add the required details and click on Save and Close tab.-Once you maintain the Partner Company details, Partner Company ID will be derived for all future postings.

Title: You Cannot Process the Contract Due to Process Communication Error "Postings not permitted for project task XYZ"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You cannot process a the Contract due to error Postings not permitted for project task XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search and open the contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the contract).-Go to the Document Flow tab-You are able to see the red mark on Contract.-Click on the red mark, rrror message shown Contract XYZ cannot process an update sent by a Customer Invoice.-Now go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Process Communication Errors view.-Show Open Errors with Incidents.-For contract XYZ you can find the error: Postings not permitted for project task ABC (ABC represents the project task ID).-Backend Details:-XI Message in SRT_MONI transaction:-Receiver interface: CustomerContractProcessingRequestInvoicingIn-Sender Party: CustomerInvoiceProcessing--Error: Postings for project task ABC not allowed.-Cause-The Project Task is linked to the Project which is in status Stopped. This is the reason why you get the error messae Postings for project task ABC not allowed.--The invoice will not update the contract while this project is stopped.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, the customer will need to revert the status of the project.-Once the related project is in Started status, the XI message can be restarted in the SRT_MONI transaction to solve the process communication error.

Title: Bank Charges Paid By Field is Defaulted to Sharing of Costs and is Not Editable
Content: Symptom-While paying an employee via an Outgoing Bank Transfer you notice that the Bank Charges Paid By field is automatically defaulted to Sharing of costs and is not editable.-You would like to have the ability, for example, to choose that employee won't have to pay half of the bank charges (meaning, selecting Initiator).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Show All Employees.-Select the respective employee and click View.-Select an open item (for example, an expense report) and click Pay Manually By -> Outgoing Bank Transfer.-On Overview, under Payee Data section, notice that Bank Charges Paid By is automatically filled with Sharing of costs and the field is grayed out for changes.-Cause-The Bank Charges Paid By, also called as bank charge bearer code, is further influenced by the format of the payment.-In this case the payment format being used is very likely SEPA Credit Transfer. According to the guidelines of SEPA, the value should be Sharing of costs and hence it is defaulted and not editable.-Resolution-You may choose to change the Payment Method Details to Domestic bank transfer and then the field is again editable.-To achieve that you should click View All and change the Payment Method Details under Further Details section.-Keywords-Bank Charges Paid By, Sharing of Costs, Outgoing Bank Transfer, Payment Method Details, Domestic bank transfer

Title: Cancel Journal Entry Created By Web Service
Content: Symptom-A journal entry has been created via web service and cannot be reversed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Find the document concerned.-Notice that there's no option to reverse the document.-Cause-This journal entry has been created via the ManageJournalEntryIn web service. The reversal of documents created via web service is not supported.-Resolution-To adjust the amounts, an offset entry might be posted, by giving the same amounts with opposite signs.-See Also-SAP Help Document: Inbound Service Manage Journal Entries-Keywords-journal entry, web service, reverse, ManageJournalEntryIn

Title: Not Able To Scan Serial Numbers In Mobile Device
Content: Symptom-You are scanning serial numbers of your product via Mobile/Rugged Device. You see that the serial number details are not updated in the system even after scanning.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mobile Execution work center.-Navigate to the Select Outbound Task view.-Search for the relevant Task ID select it and choose F5 Start Task﻿ button.-Scan Serial Number of the relevant product.-You see that the serial number information is not updated in the system. The Open Quantity value does not reduce as well.-Cause-You will have to maintian the scanning profile for mobile device as Random Scanning to be able to scan the serial numbers.-Resolution-Go to Mobile Execution work center.-Navigate to Common Task view and select the option Settings.-In Logon Settings screen select profile as Random Scanning.-Choose Save and Close button.-After performing the above steps you will be able to scan the serial numbers without any issues with your mobile device.

Title: The Customer Contract Invoice Request is with Status as Conflict, Eventhough Preceding Contract Item is not Canceled
Content: Symptom-The Customer Contract Invoice Request is with status as Conflict ,eventhough preceding Contract->Item is not canceled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-From the Common Task click on the New Contract.-In the New Contract screen enter all mandatory field and go to the Items tab.-Click on Add Row button and add service PQR (where PQR is service base item of type - Service - fixed price without actuals) and Save the Contract, which create Contract ABC.-Maintain the quantity for Service PQR as N (where N is total quantity).-Select the product PQR and click on the Release button.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view and search with Contract ID ABC.-Select the Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC and click on the Invoice button.-In the New Invoice screen click on the Save button(without releasing).It creates Invoice Document LMN(where LMN is not released Invoice Document ID).-You will see at this stage the status of Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC is Proceed and Item PQR under detail section below shows as Invoiced.-Open the Contract ABC and go to the Items tab.-Change the quantity of service PQR from N to M (where M is number of quantity less than N) and Save the Contract.-Go to Invoice Request view again and search for Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC.-You will see the status change to With Conflict. -Cause-Since you have change the quantity of item PQR after Invoice Document was created (though Invoice LMN is not yet Released) ,it makes the Customer Contract Invoice Request ABC as Conflict.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: INSS Field as Mandatory While Hiring Employee for Country Belgium
Content: Symptom-To set INSS field as Mandatory/Non-Mandatory while hiring an employee for country Belgium-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Personnel Administration work center-2. Select Regular Tasks view.-3. Navigate to the tab Belgium-4. Select Hire Employee link-5. Add First Name and Last Name-6. Select Next button-Cause-INSS number is only mandatory if you are using payroll for the employees. If you are only entering employees for expenses then you can make the INSS field as Non-Mandatory-Resolution-Steps followed to maintain INSS field as mandatory-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view-3. Select project with status Started-4. Select on Edit Project Scope-5. Move to Questions activity by selecting Next button-6. Expand Human Resources-7. Expand Personnel Administration-8. Select Personnel File-9. Check Do you want INSS number field to be mandatory? question-10. Select on Finish button.-- Once this Question is checked, * (mandatory symbol) will be seen next to INSS field indicating that the data should be filled in mandatorily and validation is done for the given data both in Hiring screen and Personal file of the employee.-- If we uncheck the Question, it is not mandatory to enter the data, but even if the user tries to enter the data, then the validation of INSS number is performed both in Hiring screen and Personal file.

Title: Expenses Posted via Petty Cash Are Not Visible in the Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have posted expenses via petty cash and expected these expenses to be shown in the Project Invoice Request but they are not visible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Invoice Preparation - Project Invoice Requests view.-Select Project Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ is the identification of the project invoice request).-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Items tab.-Select Item ABC (ABC is the identification of the item).-Go to the Time and Expense Items sub tab.-The Expense posted via Petty Cash is not visible here.-Cause-In the current system release there is no integration between Payment/Liquidity Management and Project Management and therefore the debited amount is not being reflecting for Project Invoicing.-This is a direct expense posting and will not be available in Not invoiced time and expenses view.-Resolution-The system is hereby behaving as expected.

Title: Tax Prepayment for Switzerland
Content: Symptom-Your are unable to initiate the Tax Prepayment Option for country Switzerland-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Workcenter-Select Tax payments View-Click on New tax payment-In the Tax Payment type field the possibility to choose Tax Prepayment, but in the value help, no Tax Return Arrangement ID is coming up for CH(Switzerland)-Resolution-The Tax-prepayment is not supported for the country Switzerland (CH) in Business ByDesign system.

Title: UI Designer error in Digital for Customer D4C
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In D4C, you receive the following error: "SAP_BYD_UI_CT/Main/Support/UIDesignerPreview.QA.uicomponent marked as Application. Adapt if not correct"-Reproducing the Issue-You have generated a SUPPORT user in CAM Tool with support level other than L3 and without specifying the user profile.-With this SUPPORT user you log in to in to the customer's D4C system (for reproduce or test purposes).-Cause-The UIDesigner error only occurs with a generated Support User:-SAP_SUPPORT_L4-SAP_SUPPORT_L6-SAP_SUPPORT_L3 without specified user profile-When that error appears in the UI it blocks the rendering of information in the UI, but it doesn’t mean that data is lost.-The customer will never face this UI Designer related error.-Resolution-Generate a SAP_SUPPORT_L3 user and specify the user profile, for example using the technical ID of the user who created the incident.-

Title: Revenue Recognition Shows no Records Found for the Contract With Accrual Method as 307 - Recognize Based on Manual Amounts
Content: Symptom-You have assigned the accrual method as 307 - Recognize based on manual amounts for your contract XX and under Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data you have maintained the amount YYY  for the Recognized Revenue and Recognized Costs.-You have then performed the Revenue Recognition Run XYZ for the contract XX but you found a message that No Records Found under Processed Successfully tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Select Revenue Recognition subview.-Click the Revenue Recognition ID XYZ.-Navigate to Postings Successfully tab.-Filter for Customer Contract XX.-No records found.-Cause-Under Edit Manual Recognized Costs and Revenues the validity period maintained has become obsolete and the revenue recognition XYZ run performed is after the validity period.-Resolution-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Click on Sales Document Items view.-Filter for Customer Contract Items XX.-Select Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data and click Recognized Costs and Revenues. -Select Customer Contract Item and under Edit Manual Recognized Costs and Revenues.- To enable the system to recognize the manually entered values for the Recognized Revenue and Recognized Costs, make sure that you are running your Revenue Recognition for the same period for which you defined your manual recognized values for revenues and costs.

Title: Spain VAT Return Preview Disabled/Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-For the Country of Tax Authority: ES - Spain, Preview button is disabled for VAT Return 123 with the Tax Return Status as In Preparation.-123 Refers to VAT return ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Select the VAT returns subview.-VAT return 123 is displayed with the status "In Preparation," and the Preview button is disabled (greyed out)-Cause-In the Tax Management work center navigate to the Tax Authorities view.-Select the Tax Authority and country Spain and press Edit - Company Tax Arrangements.-In the Tax Return Arrangements sub tab for the Tax Return Arrangement ID XYZ, it can be seen that the Electronic Submission indicator is set.-Resolution-Electronic Submission, this indicator is enabled when the selected tax return type is submitted to the tax authorities electronically or through an electronic file. Since form output is not supported for electronic submissions, the Preview button is disabled.-This is a standard system behavior.-Keywords-print, PDF, download, e-filing, online filing, printing restricted, non-printable, expected behavior, configuration, settings, toggle, option, enable printing, generate PDF, compliance report

Title: Forgot Password link Stopped Working on Internet Explorer
Content: Symptom-Forgot Password link is not working on Internet Explorer-Reproducing the Issue-In the Login Page Click on Forgot Password button-Cause-The Screen will get blank and will not provide you information to reset your Password  -Resolution-With the new version of internet explorer, the document mode brought an old version, which is not letting the page to open. Please follow the steps below to correct this issue:-Press F12 in the system Login Page-Change to emulation tab-Change the document mode field to 10 or Edge-With this Change, system will open the page correctly.

Title: iViews in Workload Analysis do not work
Content: Symptom-You want to see iViews in Workload Analysis but they do not work and throw error: Value "IVIEWS" for varaiable "E2E Metric Type Variable" is invalid.--Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.10-Reproducing the Issue-Start SM_WORKCENTER to access RCA E2E Workload Analysis tool-Choose your system-Start Workload Analysis-Click Portal -> Top iViews-Run query-Cause-IVIEWS metrics are not activated by default, but prepared. You have to activate them manually.-Resolution-Go to step "7 Configure Automatically" of the Managed System Configuration for your system.-Go into "Edit" mode.-Start activity "Byte Code Adapter Installation" manually with pressing "Open Java URL" in Navigation column.-In the new browser window select all J2EE server nodes of your system, choose "Autoprobe Directives".-Mark the instrumentation files sap_ep.jar and sap_ep_iviews.jar-Click "Apply" to activate the parameterization.-  The additional instrumentation will become effective with the next restart of <SID>~JAVA.-The iView data should be available at latest after one day in E2E Workload Analysis Tool.---REMARK:-Make sure you are running newest patch for your Introscope Java Agent as many enhancement were introduced for iViews.-See Also-1565954 - Introscope 9 Release Notes-2071100 - Introscope 9.5 Release Notes-Keywords-E2E, workload, portal, i views, iviews, top, CL, RSR, RENDERER, GET, VARDEF, FOR

Title: Account Assignment Type Not Appearing For Business Transactions
Content: Symptom-In the Account Assignment tab or Cost Distribution tab of  a business transaction, you are not able to see account assignment type XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-For example :-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order-Click on View All-Fill the required data-Go to Item tab-Go to Cost Distribution sub tab-Click on the drop down list for the Account Assignment Type field.-Here you are missing a account assignment type XYZ-Cause-An account assignment type is only available in a business transaction if this business transaction, e.g. a supplier invoice, is assigned to the account assignment type in Fine Tuning.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Project view-Go to Fine-Tune tab-Search for the Account Assignment Types activity-Click on Maintain Account Assignment Types-Select Account Assignment Type XYZ.-Navigate to the Assignment to Business Transaction tab-Click on Add Row-Maintain the business transaction, in which account assignment type XYZ should be available.-Press Save

Title: G/L Account Cannot be Selected in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-In a Journal Entry Voucher you want to select G/L account XYZ. But in the G/L account value help this account can't be selected.-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Journal Entries - Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Press New - Journal Entry Voucher.-Maintain company DEF and all other mandatory data, such as Journal Entry Type, Screen Variant etc.-In the G/L Account column click into the value help and search for account XYZ.-The account is not displayed here.-Cause-In the easiest of cases the G/L account XYZ is not assigned to the charts of accounts of the company and set of books combination that you have selected in the journal entry voucher.-Resolution-You need to check the Chart of Accounts (CoA)  and Set of Books (SoB) set up in Business configuration:-To find out to which Chart of Accounts account XYZ is assigned to:- Navigate to the Business Configuration workcenter and here to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity list and go to the Fine Tune phase.-Find the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity and press Open.  If your system is live already, navigate to the Business Configuration- Overview and open the activity from here via View or Change immediately.-Click on the Edit chart of accounts link.-In the top table select a chart of accounts.-In the table below use the filter function to look for G/L account XYZ.-You find out that the account XYZ is assigned to chart of accounts ABC.-Note down the charts of accounts.-To find out which set of books this chart of accounts ABC and which company is assigned to this CoA-SoB combination:- Navigate to the Business Configuration workcenter and here to the Implementation Projects view-Open the Activity list and go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Find the Set of Books activity and press Open.  If your system is live already, navigate to the Business Configuration- Overview and open the activity from here via View or Change immediately.-In the new window look for the set of books for which chart of accounts ABC is displayed in the Chart of Accounts column.-In the Details table below check which company(-ies) is (are)  assigned to this CoA-SoB combination.-You can see company DEF is not listed here. Instead, company GHI is displayed.-Because company DEF is not assigned to CoA ABC and the respective set of books you can't select account XYZ in the journal entry voucher.-In the journal entry voucher change the company to GHI. Then it will be possible to select G/L account XYZ.-Should the G/L account still not be available, other Business Configuration settings will have to be evaluated.-

Title: Open items Displayed Inconsistently When Manually Processing Payment Allocations.
Content: Symptom-When processing various Payment Allocations in status In Process, you notice variations in the default allocation tab and selection of open items that is being displayed when the document is opened.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Open several Payment Allocations in status In Process.-You notice that different Payment Allocations have different allocation tabs opened automatically and, if allocation tab Customer/Supplier is opened, different default Open Item selection criteria may be used.-Cause-The system uses data from the Payment Allocation to determine which tab and which Open Items should be displayed automatically upon opening the document.-Resolution-If the payment to be allocated is created within ByD, the system assumes that it will be allocated to an Open Item and opens the tab Payment Confirmations/Returns for your convenience. If you would like to post the amount on account instead, you can switch to tab Customer/Supplier. In cases where the Customer/Supplier tab is opened automatically, system lists items of the opposite credit/debit side depending on the direction of the payment. If you would like to see a complete Open Items list for the Business Partner, you can use the Search Open Items function. Once these items are loaded, they will be displayed in that Payment Allocation permanently until it is posted.

Title: Error Message "Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption"
Content: Symptom-When you try to post an invoice to an account low value asset, system throws below error message.-Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents and open the Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-Click the View All button and navigate to the Exceptions tab.-You will see the error message: Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Account determination group XYZ: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption.-Cause-The Net Price of the Item is lower or higher than the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-Resolution- Please check the Threshold for Fixed Assets Account Principles.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets activity and select it.-Click the Change Immediately button.-Here you can check if the Account Principle are maintained correctly for the particular Accounts. Check also the Minimum Account to Maximum Account values. You can change the Minimum and Maximum Account value to the Net Price amount to post the Invoice.-Now you are able to post the Invoice without exceptions to a Low Value Asset account.- Or post to a G/L Account, therefore you have to maintain the Account Determination Group XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Account Determination Group).-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity and select it.-Click the Change Immediately button.-Click the General Ledger link under Account Determination.-Change the Change Subledger to Inventories.-Select the sub-tab Gains and Losses.-Here you have to maintain the Account Determination Group for Materials XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Account Determination Group).-Click the Save and Close button.-Now you are able to post the Invoice without exceptions to the maintained G/L Account.

Title: Posting to Profit Center Assigned to a Different Company
Content: Symptom-You create a manual Journal Entry Voucher for Company A and by mistake choose a Profit Center which has been assigned to Company B.-The Journal Entry Voucher creates a posting to Company A though the Profit Center is not assigned to this company.-You expect that such a posting is prevented by the system or that the system throws an error message.-Reproducing the Issue-Open General Ledger Work Center-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers-Search for the respective Journal Entry Voucher-You see that the Journal Entry Voucher for Company A created postings to Profit Center ID XXX-  Open Organizational Management Work Center-Click on Find-Enter Profit Center ID XXX-Confirm with Locate-You see that Profit Center ID XXX has been assigned to Company B- Cause-If you enter a profit center manually when creating a journal entry voucher, no automatic check is performed to determine whether an assignment exists in the organizational structure between the company and the profit center.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Import Simulation Errors
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You uploaded the Fixed Asset migration data file.-During the simulation one of the below or all error messages are reported:-'Invalid MovementCategory XX (XX represents the Movement Category ID) ith first acq./cap./depr. start date XX.YY.ZZZZ'.-'Invalid MovementCategory XX with first acq./cap./depr. start date XX.YY.ZZZZ'-'Invalid combination MovementCategory XX and SubledgerLineItemTypeCode YYYY'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity, either through the Business Configuration overview or via the Implementation project.-Open the Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link and create a new unit.-Select the new unit and press Execute Migration-Upload the Fixed Asset migration file.-Press Process File.-Errror messages appear.-Cause-If you migrate the assets with the capitalization/Initial acquisition date in the current year. In other terms, the capitalization date lies in the year of migration. Then the historical costs or historical dep. should be empty. Instead current year APC and depr. should be maintained. In this case you will get the following error message.-Invalid MovementCategory 08 with first acq./cap./depr. start date XX.YY.ZZZZ-If you migrate the assets with the capitalization/Initial acquisition date in the previous year. If the asset were capitalized in the fiscal year before the migration date and therefore the values should be treated as historical values. You have to maintain the values as Historical APC, Historical depreciation. You will get the following error message.-Invalid MovementCategory 11 with first acq./cap./depr. start date XX.YY.ZZZZ-Resolution-For the assets capitalized in the current year, you need to enter values for only the current year with the following transaction.-For the assets capitalized in the years before the year of migration, you need to necessarily enter values for historical columns. You may or may not enter current year values based on the business scenario.-Current Year Columns-1. Transaction Type: Acquisition-Line Item Type: Historical Costs: Current Year-2. Transaction Type: Periodic Depreciation-Line Item Type: Periodic Regular Depreciation-Previous Year Columns-1. Transaction Type: Migration of Accumulated Values (Last Period Previous Year)-Line Item Type: Historical Cost-2. Transaction Type: Migration of Accumulated Values (Last Period Previous Year)-Line Item Type: Accumulated Depreciation

Title: Auto Pick of the Attachment Maintained in the Product Master to New Purchasing Document.
Content: Symptom-You have saved attachment file in your product master ABC and you want your the system to auto-pick this data to your new created purchasing document XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Order work center.-Choose New Purchase Order view.-Input all mandatory information and choose View All.-Navigate to Items page.-Choose Add Row and input product master ID ﻿ABC.-Navigate to Item Details sub-view and choose Attachments.-You will see there is No record found i.e. Attachment maintained in product master ABC is not picked.-Cause-The attachments which are saved as document type Details for Supplier will only be auto picked from product master ABC to purchasing document ﻿XYZ.-Resolution-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Choose Products view.-Show All Products and search for product master ABC.-Edit the product master ABC and choose View All.-Navigate to page Attachments.-Choose Add File and select the document type as Details for Supplier.-Save.-See Also-The attachment added in any document type of product master ABC is not auto-picked in the New Sales Order/Sales Quote screen within the Items tab for the same product.

Title: VAT Declaration for Business Residence, Germany and Austria
Content: Symptom-You want to maintain a VAT Declaration for each Business Residence in the company but once you want to schedule various VAT Return Runs, you get the error message: Tax return XXX already exists for period dd-mm-yyyy to dd-mm-yyyy.-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Work Center Tax Management-Select view Periodic Tasks-Choose VAT Return Runs-Press New - Tax Return Run-Enter the necessary variables and choose Set To Active-In previous screen select relevant run and press Schedule-Try to perform steps 1 to 6 again for the same period and you will get error message Tax return XXX already exists for period dd-mm-yy to dd-mm-yy-Cause-Every company receives only one VAT-ID, even if the company has various Business Residences (UStG Paragr. 1 Abs. 2 Satz 3). Subcompanies do not get any VAT-ID's (UStG § 3a Abs. 3 Satz 2, 3f, 3g und Abs. 25 Satz 4 - UStDV § 1 Satz 2). -For further information for German companies see link below: -http://www.bzst.de/DE/Steuern_International/USt_Identifikationsnummer/Vergabe/Vergabe_node.html-For additional information for Austrian companies see link below:-https://www.wko.at/Content.Node/Service/Steuern/Umsatzsteuer/Spezielles-zur-Umsatzsteuer/Umsatzsteueridentifikationsnummer_(UID-Nummer).html -  Resolution-The system works as designed. In Germany and Austria it is not possible to maintain VAT ID's for Business Residences.-

Title: Incorrect Valuation Method in Material Cost Estimate
Content: Symptom-The Material Cost Estimate created for a given material is picking the incorrect valuation method.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Choose the Material Cost Estimates view.-Click Show All Cost Estimates.-Select the material and click View.-Notice that the Valuation Method shows as Purchase List Price for the material.-Cause-The inventory cost that is taken while calculating the cost estimate depends of the minimum order quantity mentioned in the purchase contract and the quantity mentioned in the Production Bill of material for one product.-If the minimum order quantity is higher than the BoM quantity, the contract price is ignored.-If the minimum order quantity is less or equal to the BoM quantity, the price of purchase contract is selected.-Resolution-System works as designed for valuation method selection upon material cost estimate creation.-Keywords-material cost estimate; valuation method; inventory cost; BoM

Title: Start Date of Depreciation Must Be Earlier Than Transfer Date of a Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You execute a partial or complete transfer posting of a fixed asset.-The transfer date is DD.MM.YYYY, but the start date of the depreciation should be earlier than DD.MM.YYYY.-If you do the transfer posting for day DD.MM.YYYY the sytem does not consider any depreciation date earlier than the transfer date even if you adjust the date in the fixed asset.-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Fixed Asset:-Open the Fixed Assets Work Center-Navigate to the view Fixed Assets-In the overview click on the button New - Fixed Asset-Fill in the necessary fields and finish with Save- Execute the Transfer Posting:-Open the Fixed Assets Work Center-Go to Fixed Assets and select the respective Fixed Asset-Click on Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material/Partial Transfer of Individual Material-Enter the Individual Material Number of the newly created Fixed Asset and fill in all other necesarry fields-Finish with Post- Change the Start Date for the Depreciation to a date earlier than DD.MM.YYYY:-Open the newly created Fixed Asset and click on View All-Navigate to the tab Master Data - Asset Valuation-Enter a Depreciation Start Date which is earlier than DD.MM.YYYY-Save and check the calculation of the depreciation under the tab Values-Choose the button Values - Explain Values-You see that the depreciation has not been considered for the start date you entered*- Cause-The field Asset Valuation Date is needed to achieve a start of depreciation date which is earlier than the transfer date.-Resolution-Create a new Fixed Asset as described above.- Execute the Transfer Posting:-Open the Fixed Assets Work Center-Go to Fixed Assets and select the respective Fixed Asset-Click on Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material/Partial Transfer of Individual Material-Choose Personalize - This Screen on the upper right hand corner of the screen-Under Sections select Details-Flag the box beside the Asset Valuation Date under the header Fields-Finish with Save-The field Asset Valuation Date is now availabe on the screen-Enter the Individual Material Number of the newly created Fixed Asset-Enter the required start date of depreciation in the field Asset Valuation Date and fill in all the necessary fields-Finish with Post- If you check the calculation for the depreciation in the fixed asset you see, that the start date of depreciation equals the asset valuation date even if this is earlier than the date of the transfer posting.-  *If the transfer posting was done in the first half of the month the deprecitation start date is in the same month.-*If the transfer posting was done in the second half of the month the depreciation start date is in the following month.

Title: Error: Missing Key Specification For Processing Node
Content: Symptom-When trying to update any details for an existing object using Migration/ Mass Data Maintenance the following error occurs:-Missing key specification for processing node <any entity>.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Taking Migration of Employee and User Data as example. -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view-Select to Show All Configuration Elements and find the activity: Migration of Employee and User Data.-Select the link: Employee and User Data using the migration tool.-Select the uploaded migration template.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error Occurs "Missing key specification for processing node EMPLOYEE ROOT"-Cause-These errors occurs when trying to add a new field data to an existing object(Employee) which is not possible using Migration(Modify Already Existing Records) or Mass Data Maintenance. Only existing field values in a record can be modified using this option.-Resolution-Add the new field value to an existing entity using Enhance Already Existing Records option in the migration tool with the following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view-Select to Show All Configuration Elements and find the activity: Migration of Employee and User Data.-Select the link: Migrate Employee and User Data Activity using the migration tool-Upload the file and select it.-Select the Properties button.-In the drop-down for Migration Mode, select Enhance Already Existing Records.-Click on Save.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-Keywords-Migration, Data Enhancement, Entity Root, Validation, Update, Error, Enhancement, Missing, Specification, Processing, Node, Employee

Title: MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN job aborted with ABAP Dump
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The job MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN related to Mass Data Run Object (MDRO) run was canceled with ABAP Dump.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SM37 t-code and search with the job name for the canceled jobs.-Select the job and click on Job Log button.-Here, you will see the complete job log and the step where job failed.-In this case, as MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN job has failed with ABAP dump.-Cause-Investigating the ABAP dump, it can be seen in the Error Analysis section that cause of this dump is  System Error occurred during Lock Management.-SAP system cannot enter the required lock correctly into the lock table managed in the ENQUEUE server and the ENQUEUE function, module therefore triggers an exception. If the application cannot process this exception, the active transaction is automatically canceled.--Issue is clearly from Enqueue server side the message server which establishes the connection between the application server and the ENQUEUE server in a local system, is no longer running.--Since the dump says lock entry couldn't be created basically the lock would be created in enqueue table and there could be two reasons for this dump:-1. either table size is overflow-2. second could be the enqueue process itself is not free-Resolution-Normally, such issues are temporary issue and once the enqueue server is free to handle in coming calls, job will finish automatically.-Recommendation is to trigger the MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN job again after sometime as this is a temporary issue.-If issue still persists, please forward the incident in ES Technology & Architecture team.

Title: How To Handle Basic Excise Duty Under First Stage Dealer Scenaio
Content: Symptom-How you handle Basic Excise Duty calculation when you buying material from the First Stage Dealer. Under First Stage Dealer Assessable Value for the Materials will be different from the Materials Cost. As per BED (Basic Excise Duty) system should calculate BED on the Assessable Value of the Materials instead of the Inventory Cost.-Reproducing the Issue-For Example you bought Material from First Stage Dealer where Cost of Material is Rs. 10,000/- but the Assessable Value for the Material is Rs. 9000/-. As per the Central Excise Rule BED should calculate on the Assessable Value i.e. Rs. 9000/- not on the Material Cost. But in Supplier Invoice UI there is no option to put the Assessable value amount.-Resolution-For Example BED (Basic Excise Duty) is 10%, Assessable Cost of the Material is Rs. 9000/- whereas Material Cost is Rs. 10000. As per the BED rule BED should calculate as 10% of Rs. 9,000 = Rs. 900 not on Rs. 10,000/-. Since there is no option to put Assessable Value in the Supplier Invoice and as per the BED rule BED Tax Code should take Assessable Value as Tax Base Amount. Hence we have the following workaround:-Go to the Supplier Invoice work center. -Select View Supplier Invoice Without Purchase Order under the Common Tasks.-Click on View All button.-In the General Tab, Items tab fill all the Require details in the supplier invoice like Material ID, Material Cost as Rs. 10,000/-, select your desired BED Tax Code etc.-Finally come to the General tab click on Taxes sub tab, click on Tax Details.-Here you can find Tax Amount field is editable, you can manually put the Tax Amount as Rs. 900.-Note: You may refer to the attached screenshot for your better understanding.

Title: Integration with SAP ERP for Subsidiaries scoping element missing in system scoping
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to scope the system for Integration with SAP ERP for Subsidiaries. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select the current project and click on Edit Project Scope button.-Go to third step Scoping.-Show All Elements.-Click on Communication and Information Exchange and select Business Process Management sub option.-Here element Integration with SAP ERP for Subsidiaries is missing in the system.-Cause-The issue occurs because the corresponding Add-on for the Subsidiary Integration is not activated in the system.-If the customer has license(purchase) to use the Subsidiary Integration then the corresponding Add-on needs to be activated by the SAP Store colleagues.-Resolution-If the Add-on is purchased by customer but still not visible in the scoping then the customer can provide us SAP store order number to track the progress of deployment. In this case we can forward the incident to queue MS-CP-Others (and additionally contact the colleagues from SAP Store via mail : store.admin@sap.com & store.content@sap.com) to check this issue and asking them to activate the Add-on if customer is licensed to use the Subsidiary Integration. Once the SAP Store colleagues activate the Add-on the element Integration with SAP ERP for Subsidiaries with be visible in the scoping.-See Also-Once the required element is scoped in the Business ByDesign system, also check the corresponding questions in step 4 to integrate SAP ERP for Subsidiaries with ByDesign system.

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Failed Due to Error Message: Postingdate 00.00.0000 is Before First Acquisition Date
Content: Symptom-During the Migration of Fixed Assets, you get the following error message.-Postingdate 00.00.0000 is Before First Acquisition Date-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search and open Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Open the Migrate Accounting Transaction Data using the migration tool link and create a new unit.-Select the new unit and click on Execute Migration-Click on Upload File to upload the Fixed Assets data.-Click on Process File and you get the following error message:  Postingdate 00.00.0000 is Before First Acquisition Date-Cause-You need to check the Migration Posting Date and the Capitalization Date for the Assets in question. You will observe that the Capitalization Date is after the Migration Posting Date.-In principle, the Migration of Fixed Asset is only intended for the asset capitalized before the Migration Posting Date. Hence you are getting error message as you are trying to migrate the Assets which were capitalized after the Migration Posting Date.-Resolution-The asset capitalized after the migration date should be created manually or via Fixed asset Procurement scenario in the system. Such an asset cannot be migrated.

Title: How to Find the Application Protcols Supported by a Service Interface in a Communication Scenario
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. (Eg Soap, XI, Mediation. IDOC, HTTP, Web Service Reliable Messaging)-

Title: Unable to Replicate the Exchange Rates From SAP ERP System Due to Error Message 'ICM_HTTP_TIMOUT' and 'Exchange Rate Transmission Run Failed While Replication'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to replicate the Currency Exchange Rates From ERP System and you got the error messages, ICM_HTTP_TIMOUT and Exchange rate transmission run failed while replication Currency Exchange Rates From ERP System.-You have also checked the relevant communication arrangement and ping is possible however still error message exists.-Reproducing the Issue-Check the Relevant Exchange Rate  Error:-Go to the Admin Work Center-Under the System Activities choose Replication and Integration Tasks.-Click on the Request Currency Exchange Rates From ERP hyperlink.-Select the Schedule button to maintain the scheduling options.-Go to the Execution Details.-Click on the Application Log ID link. -The error message Exchange rate transmission run failed is displayed.-When you select the Results tab the error message: ICM_HTTP_TIMOUT & Technical error, see Business Communication Monitoring, rate type 001. is displayed.-Check the Relevant Communication Arrangement:-Go to the Application & User Management Work Center.-Select the Communication Arrangements.-Click on the Request Exchange Rate From External Sources hyperlink.-Under the column Service select the Request Exchange Rate From External Sources & press Check Connection button.-The system displays the message Ping Successful.-Cause-The most common reason for such WEB Service related problems (HTTP errors, time out problems) during Exchange Rate replication is that two notes are not implemented in your ERP system.-Resolution-Complete the installation of SAP Notes 1631657 and 1825806 in your SAP ERP system or maintain the minimum service package level for the software component ESA ECC-SE.-ESA ECC-SE 602 SP 13-ESA ECC-SE 603 SP 12-ESA ECC-SE 604 SP 14-ESA ECC-SE 605 SP 11
