Title: Nothing Happens When You Click to Post the Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-Payment Allocation is not posting, when you click on Post button nothing happens, no error message is showed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management Work Center.-Go to Payment Allocation View.-Open the respective Payment Allocation In Preparation.-Click on Post button.-Nothing happens, no error message is shown.-Cause-One or more payments already confirmed are being allocated to this Payment Allocation.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, you have to remove the confirmed payment references from this allocation and add the correct ones, which were not confirmed yet.

Title: Backend Exception When Activating Org Structure
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the user try to activate the Org Structure, system dumps.-ST22 Traces:-Category ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors ASSERTION_FAILED-ABAP Program /APBP/CL_TWIN_HANDLING========CP-Application Component AP-BP-BPT-Active Calls:-42 METHOD /APBP/CL_TWIN_HANDLING========CP /APBP/CL_TWIN_HANDLING========CM001 432-/APBP/CL_TWIN_HANDLING=>CREATE_BP_FROM_ORGCENTRE-41 METHOD /APBP/CL_BUP_SP_TEMPLATE_LOCALCP /APBP/CL_BUP_SP_TEMPLATE_LOCALCM038 91-/APBP/CL_BUP_SP_TEMPLATE_LOCAL=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACTION~EXECUTE_ACT ION-40 METHOD CL_SP_BUPA_TEMPLATE===========CP CL_SP_BUPA_TEMPLATE===========CM00H 31-CL_SP_BUPA_TEMPLATE=>IF_ESF_PROVIDER_ACTION~EXECUTE_ACTION-.-.-.-.-34 METHOD CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CP CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CM005 24-CL_ESF_LCP_BASE=>IF_ESF_LCP~EXECUTE_ACTION-33 METHOD /MOM/CL_BUPA_SERVICES=========CP /MOM/CL_BUPA_SERVICES=========CM006 23-/MOM/CL_BUPA_SERVICES=>CREATE_BUPA-32 METHOD /MOM/CL_TWIN_ACTIVATOR========CP /MOM/CL_TWIN_ACTIVATOR========CM002 10-/MOM/CL_TWIN_ACTIVATOR=>/MOM/IF_ACTIVATION_LISTENER~AFTER_ACTIVATI ON-31 METHOD /MOM/CL_AAG_ACTIVATION_AGENT==CP /MOM/CL_AAG_ACTIVATION_AGENT==CM00S 9-/MOM/CL_AAG_ACTIVATION_AGENT=>SEND_AFTER_ACTIVATION-30 METHOD /MOM/CL_AAG_ACTIVATION_AGENT==CP /MOM/CL_AAG_ACTIVATION_AGENT==CM007 91-/MOM/CL_AAG_ACTIVATION_AGENT=>ACTIVATE-Incight Information:-BO_PROXY_NAME BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL-BO_ESR_NAME BusinessPartner_Template-BO_ESR_NAMESPACE http://sap.com/xi/AP/FO/BusinessPartner/Global-Cause-The cause for the issue is that, the user have maintained the Org Unit ID as XY (numeric value) and marked that Org Unit as Company.-Upon activation, the system dumps because the ID 99 is not a valid as per the number range maintained.-Resolution-This issue occurring only when the customer maintained a alphanumeric number range for Business Partner.-If it is a alpha numeric Number Range, then it will be like this: 0000001A - 9999999Z, with this range the allowed patterns are, --The following numbers are not allowed with this Range:--• Any number with less than 8 digits which is purely numerical (Because the BuPa ID is defined as Char8 with Alpha-Conversion, i.e. for purely numerical numbers leading zeros are added automatically if the length is smaller 8)--* Any number that starts with 9 either numeric or alphanumeric--The following numbers and patterns are covered with this Range:--• Any number with 1 to 8 length and ends with or have a alphabet--Examples:-Allowed Numbers:-1A-22B-333C-4444D-55555E-666666F-7777777G-8888888F-12345678D-123456789D--Not allowed Numbers:--1 = 0000000001-22 = 0000000022-333 = 0000000333-4444 = 0000004444-55555 = 0000055555-666666 = 0000666666-7777777 = 0007777777-88888888 = 0088888888-999999999 = 0999999999--9 A to 9999999Z--Important points to be noted:--1. It is not possible to create a numeric ID for Customers, Suppliers, Partners, Contacts, etc.--2. Automatic Number range, i.e third row in the number range screen for all the Business Partner which is only numeric--3. The last row is reserved for Employees.--4. It is not possible to have all combinations of number range for Business Partner. It is either numeric or alpha numeric. But maintain alpha numeric as in current case, has few limitations as described above.-PLEASE NOTE:-It is a limitation in using a alpha numeric number range for Business Partner. Hence, we recommended for using numeric number range for Business Partners.-See Also-You can also refer to the BCP incident 3100799676 for the solution when the customer has a requirement to maintain alphanumeric IDs for Suppliers

Title: Payment Medium does not Support the Payment Currency
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform a payment, however the system informed that the currency in use is not supported by the given payment medium format.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-View the related account.-Choose an open item.-Click Pay Manually By and select the payment method, e. g.: Bill Of Exchange.-The following error is raised by the system: Currency <payment currency> not supported by payment medium <payment medium format> and procedure <payment method>-Cause-The currency being used in the payment is not assigned to the payment medium, reason being that the medium format indeed does not support the selected currency.-Resolution-The assignment of payment medium and currency can be seen through the below steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Open the activity Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Click Edit checks for payment medium formats. On the screen that opens you can see the combinations of payment mediums and currencies.-The content of this screen must be pre-delivered to the system and hence it is not possible to edit the checks for payment medium formats, unless there is a legal requirement behind your scenario.

Title: HSBCNET MT940 Format Statement Error
Content: Symptom-You receive the following errors while uploading a bank statement using MT940 format-Bank statement ID XX for bank account ID rejected-Date YYMMDD not valid for-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to File Management view and select Inbound Files sub view-Click on New and select Inbound File-Under Attachments click Add and select File-Add the file and click on Start File Upload-You receive the error messages.-Cause-The error messages appear as the information in the TAGS is not consistent in the MT940 file supporting format used in the bank statement.-Resolution-The date format in TAGS under Tag 20 should be maintained as YYYYMMDD instead it was maintained as YYMMDD-Example: Tag 20        : 20: 20130305

Title: JSON Communication Error
Content: Symptom-When user tries to connect to SAP Cloud Applications Studio he gets the JSON Communication Error.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Log on to SAP Cloud Application Studio.-2. Connect to the Repository.-3. Enter your System Details-4. Enter your User ID and Password.-5. Click on ok.-6. Error pops up as JSON Communication Error.-  Cause-The Service agent user does not have the needed workcenter or Role is unassigned.-Resolution-Kindly create a New Service Agent with the correct authorizations or check and correct the current Service Agent authorizations by referring to the Quick User Setup Guide in the studio help documentation.-Make sure that atleast the User is assigned to Partner Development Work Center and Application User and Access Management work center.-See Also-Please refer to below path to get the detail information.-Help ->SAP Cloud Applications Studio.

Title: Translation in Fine Tuning Activity "Configure Pricing Procedure" Doesn't Take Effect
Content: Symptom-You maintain the French translation text for pricing procedure. However, when you login system in French, you still see the old texts.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Configuration-Go to view Implementation Projects-Open activity list-Open activity Configure Price Strategy-Open the link Configure Pricing Procedure-For example, select Standard Procedure-> Step 70 Restocking Fee-Click on the button Translate-Enter French as the target language and maintain the translated text.-Now login system in French and create a new sales order-The options under the Pricing tab in the Price Determination section are still the old, standard texts.-Cause-The description maintained in the UI has higher priority over the translation text maintained in the Translate. Hence , the translation text is not picked up but the old description is picked up.-Resolution-Update the description of the corresponding price strategy in the French UI

Title: Valid From Date not Updated to Personal Data via Migration of Employee and User Data
Content: Symptom-When you migrate employee and user data, the value of Valid From is not migrated to the personal data of the employee.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Open activity list-Open activity Migration of Employee and User Data-In the sheet Organizational Assignment of the migration file, ensure field Valid From is maintained.-Execute the migration-Now go to Administrator work center-Go to view Employee-Find a migrated employee and click button Edit-Go to tab Personal Data -> Biographical Data-You will find Valid From date is 01.01.0001 which is not same as the Valid From date in the migration template.-Cause-The Valid From date mentioned in the template is the date from which the employee is assigned to the org unit. This is not the validity start date of the Employee. Whenever an employee is created, the Valid From date and the Valid To date in Personal Data are defaulted to 01.01.0001 and Unlimited respectively.-Resolution-The Valid From date provided under the Org. Assignment sheet of the migration template is the effective start date from which the employee is assigned to the respective org unit. In order to check whether the org. assignment of the employee happened successfully or not please follow the steps mentioned below:-Go to Organizational Management work center-Go to Org Structures view-Select the Effective Date as the Valid From date-Navigate to the respective org unit-Go to Employees tab.-The respective employee should appear in the list.

Title: How To Avoid Invoicing Of Goods Received Free Of Cost From Supplier
Content: Symptom-You do not want to invoice the items that are provided Free of Cost by your supplier. However you would want to invoice other products in the same purchase order which are not free of cost.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Navigate to the view Common Tasks and select the option New Purchase Order.-In the Purchase Order screen enter the relevant details.-Chose View All and navigate to the Items tab.-Select Add Row and enter the Product ID.-Then enter the required Additional Quantity with Price maintained as 0.00 Price Unit, as you do not want to invoice these quantities.-Then select Check , system throws message : Price missing; price required for expected follow-up documents invoice or ERS.-Cause-Since you have marked the checkbox Invoice Expected or ERS for the line item whose  price is maintained as Zero, the system expects an Invoice for the line item.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-In the field Show, select All Purchase Orders using drop down and Find Purchase Order ID.-Select the Purchase Order and choose the Edit button.-Select the required Line Item with Product having Additional Quantity with Price maintained as 0.00 Price Unit.-Then under Follow Up Documents section, deselect the checkbox for Invoice Expected and ERS.-System will not then expect any Supplier Invoice for quantity which is Free of Cost against the Purchase Order.

Title: Tax Amount Is The Same As Net Amount In Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a Supplier Invoice with Import VAT tax code. You see that for this supplier invoice the Tax Amount calculated for a line item is the same as the Net Amount entered even though the tax rate maintained is less than one hundred percentage.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Navigate to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant Invoice, select it and choose the Edit button.-In the Basic View screen of the Invoice choose the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab and select the sub-tab Taxes, under the Tax Details tab you can see that the Tax Amount calculated by the system and the Net Amount for the line item are the same.-Cause-The Supplier Invoice is created with the tax code Import VAT. This tax code is to be used with items of type Import VAT Credit Item or Import VAT Debit Item. The line item for your invoice has the Item Type as Invoice Items. The tax code Import VAT is used to record any duty or freight charges against goods imported, and as a result of this the system performs a back calculation on the Net Amount entered. Which means, whatever quantity is updated in the Net Amount field will be calculated as the tax paid for the imported goods and the system will calculate the Tax Net Base Amount back from the Net Amount.--So you will have to use a different tax code if you expect the system to calculate the tax for the Net Amount you update in the invoice for your Invoice Items.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.

Title: No Plan Data Displayed in the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast Report
Content: Symptom-You have successfully uploaded a financial Plan Version from Microsoft Excel and afterwards you want to check the plan data by executing the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast report, however you notice that no Plan data is displayed. There is Actual data displayed in the report but Plan column is empty.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Reports > List view.-Search and open the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast report.-Select report view Actual/Plan/Forecast by Cost Center.-Enter data in mandatory fields Company, Set of Books, Accounting Period/Year and Display Currency - Conversion Date.-Hit Go.-Notice that the report returns no data for the Plan column.-Cause-You didn't define your uploaded financial plan version as the Default one. Since the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast report only displays Plan data for the default plan version, no Plan data is displayed.-Resolution-You need to define your uploaded financial plan version as the Default one in order to obtain Plan data from the report.-In order to achieve this, please refer to the below steps:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Planning view.-Select the Plan Version that you uploaded from Microsoft Excel and for which you want to see Plan data in the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast report.-Click Set as Default.-After this setup you can run the Cost Centers - Plan/Actual/Forecast report again and you'll see Plan data displayed.-

Title: Migrated Purchase Orders are not Going for Approval
Content: Symptom-Migrated purchase orders are not going for approval process.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Go to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Select the template Migration of Purchase Orders.-Fill the template and migrate the orders using migrating tool.-Now the migrated Purchase Orders bypass the approval process and status of Purchase Order set to Sent.-Resolution-The Approval Process is not supported for migrated Purchase Orders. As a result, all purchase orders created through migration will be sent without approval. This is as designed and based on the practice of using the migration tools to migrate completed purchase orders. As a result, there is no need for approval since the purchase orders are already sent.-Important Note: The purchase order item approval process is supported for migrated Purchase Orders. If you do any changes to the Quantity, Price and Account Assignment system will trigger an item approval process.

Title: It is not Possible to Select the Tax Return Type EC Sales List
Content: Symptom-You want to set up Tax Return Type EC Sales List; however it is not shown in the Tax Return Arrangement ID selection box.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view -> EC Sales List Runs sub view. -Click New -> Tax Return Run.-Open the selection box in Tax Return Arrangement ID.-You expect to choose the Tax Return Type EC Sales List, but it is not available.-Cause-Master Data for the tax authority must be maintained before using this Tax Return Type EC Sales List.-Resolution-To enable the system to select this tax return type, you must set up the tax authority master data accordingly, as follows:- Go to the Tax Management work center.- Go to the Tax Authorities view -> Company Tax Arrangements sub view.- Mark the respective tax authority and click Edit.- Go to Company Tax Arrangement tab.- Go to Tax Return Arrangements tab.- Click Add Row and maintain tax return type EC Sales List.-Keywords-EC Sales List, Tax Return Arrangement ID, Company Tax Arrangements, Tax Return Type

Title: Migration Template or Activity for Business Partner Relationship is Not Available
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find the Migration Template or Activity for Business Partner Relationships in your system.-Cause-This is because the scoping element Migration of Business Partner Relationships is in the status Not in Scope.-You can verify this by the following steps:-Navigate to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Overview view.-Find the scoping element Migration of Business Partner Relationships from All Configuration Elements.-You would be able to see this scoping elements shows as Not in Scope.-Resolution-In order to get the migration template or activity for Business Partner Relationships you need to scope this activity in your system and In order to scope this, please follow the below mentioned steps:-Navigate to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the fourth step Questions.-Show All Elements , Expand Built-in Services and Support.-Expand Business Configuration and select Data Migration.-Find the question Do you want to migrate Business Partner Relationships? ,Which will be in the review status Not Reviewed.-Select the Check Box In Scope.-Save your changes and Finish Scoping.--Now you could go and check the prepare data migration activity you would be able to see the migration template Business Partner Relationships or the activity Migrate business partner relationships in the Integrate and extend tab.

Title: Unable to Migrate Compensation Data: Compensation component XXX already assigned
Content: Symptom-While working on Migration of Employee Data - XXX (Country) activity, you attempt to Migrate compensation data using the migration tool but when you check the Log of step 3 Simulate Import there's an error message that avoids you to conclude the migration: Compensation component XXX already assigned-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the project and click Open Activity List-Go to Integrate and Extend phase-Search and open Migration of Employee Data - XXX (Country) activity-Click Migrate compensation data using the migration tool-Under Source Files select the file to be migrated and click Execute Migration > Execute Migration Step by Step-On step 3 Simulate Import, note the error messages on the Log session:-Error detected in source record with key value 'YY'-Compensation component XXX already assigned-Cause-On the Compensation Data Migration Template on Compensation Components tab you have entered multiple rows for same Employee ID using same Compensation Component ID XXX, aiming to migrate employee's historical salaries.-Resolution-Currently legacy employee's information cannot be migrated using the Migration Tool, so system is behaving as expected. We advise you to migrate only the current data that is relevant for Employee's Compensation in Business ByDesign system. However, if you are really keen to migrate this legacy information and store in the system, we advise you to use different Compensation Component IDs as long as there are no issues in using different codes from business perspective.

Title: Master Data Replication Work Center is Missing
Content: Symptom-You want make Master Data Replication Work Center visible in the system which is relevant for the replication of employee master data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Business Users View.-Select any user and click on Edit - Access Rights.-Navigate to the tab Work Center and View Assignment.-There you would not be able to find the work center Master Data Replication or MDR_EMPLOYEE_WCVIEW node for assigning to the user.-Cause-You have not done the employee replication related scoping in the system.-Resolution-You could can activate the employee replication by the following steps:---Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects View.-Click on Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Scoping tab.-Expand Human Resources and then expand Personnel Administration .-Select Integration of Employee Data from External Application to Cloud Solution check box.-Then click on Next and Navigate to Questions tab.- Expand Communication and Information Exchange, and expand Integration with External Applications and Solutions and then select Integration of Master Data.- Under Employee Data group, flag the checkbox for the question Do you want to replicate employee data from an external application to your cloud solution?.-Click ‘Next’ and ‘Finish’.-After these steps are done, you could logout from the system and login again to see the changes that is you would be able to see the view MDR_EMPLOYEE_WCVIEW for the Work center Master Data Replication in Application and User Management Work Center , Access Rights section of a particular user, select and SAVE.-

Title: Debugging Party Processing Issues in Cloud for Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-What is Party Processing?-Party Processing as a main consumer of master data:-Accesses many different master data objects (BP, Org.Centre, Location)-Prepares master data access of other components (make it “simple”)-Is finding parties by a determination logic defined for the respective business transaction documents-Assign party scheme to process type of document-E.g. determine a contact person for the buyer-E.g. determine the bill-to party.-Party Processing uses master data (BP, Org. Centre, etc.) with dedicated roles in a business transaction document.-Integration via BO Nodes (Party, Business Area, etc.)- Resolution-PAPR Lib – Breakpoints for Analysis-Party Determination:-Class Method Description-CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_D_DET_LIB-Execute_Det-(lines go_papr_det->start/continue) Call of party determination service (executes determination logic from party scheme and thus creates/deletes PAPR node instances)-CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_D_<NODE>_LIB (or BO specific subclass) IF_AP_PAPR_LIB_DET~UPDATE_RECORDS Processing of entered/determined PAPR node instance data- CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_V_LIB (or BO specific subclass)-EXECUTE-Execute PAPR validations (consistency checks)-CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_LIB-CREATE_MESSAGE_INSTANCE-Creation of error message instances (during determinations or validations)-CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_P_<NODE>_LIB (or BO specific subclass)-RETR_NODE_ELEMENT_PROPERTIES-Properties for PAPR node-CL_AP_<BO>_P_<NODE>-CHECK_PROP_BO_RULE_<node>-BO specific rules to influence properties-CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_LIB COPY-Copy logic-Debugging Steps for class CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_D_DET_LIB:-Login to the C4C backend system.-Go to MDRS transaction -> click on “Repository Browser”.-Select “Class / Interface” and class “CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_D_DET_LIB” -> press “Enter”.-Click on class “CL_AP_PARTY_PROC_D_DET_LIB” under “Object Name”.-Go to “Methods” tab.-Click on method “EXECUTE_DET”.-Put a external breakpoint on line 101 “IF <ls_det_node_rel>-entry_is_new EQ abap_true.”-Login to the C4C system.-Create “New Opportunity from Side Pane”.-Debugger will start -> Kepp pressing F7 till you are out of debugger and you are able to enter the values in the New Opportunity.-Add Account in UI -> Debugger will start again.-Click on Table and variable to check the values inside.-Check for the point if the debugger stops with a dump.- **You can debug  other classes mentioned in the table by adding breakpoint to the relavant methods (see table for more details on class and methods).-

Title: How to Update Contact Details For a VAT Return
Content: Symptom-In a German VAT return it is possible to provide the contact details of the for the VAT return responsible clerk in the lines 80-83.-You have updated the main address of the responsible Business Partner.-But when opening the preview of the tax return the address maintained in the lines 80-83 is missing or incorrect.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre- Conditions:-You have already created a VAT Return via the VAT Return Run.-You have maintained contact details for the responsible colleague.-In the Tax Management workcenter navigate to the Tax Returns -VAT Returns view.-Select the respective VAT return and press Preview.-In the PDF file scroll down to the last page, lines 80-83.-Here the lines are a) either empty or b) the address maintained is incorrect.-Cause-a) If the lines 80-83 are empty there is no responsible person maintained for the company tax return arrangement ID.-b) If the address is incorrect the business partner maintained as responsible person for the tax return arrangement is not the same as the business partner for which you have updated the contact details.-Resolution-First change the business address of the respective employee, service agent etc.-Navigate to the Tax Management workcenter.-Go to the Tax Authorities - Company Tax Arrangements view.-Highlight the tax authority for which you want to create the tax return and press Edit.-Automatically the Company Tax Arrangements tab opens.-Go to the Tax Return Arrangements sub-tab.-In the Person Responsible column select the colleague who's contact details you have updated for the respective tax return arrangement.-Recreate the tax return.-This time the lines 80-83 will display the correct contact data.-

Title: Multiple errors while creating Outgoing check
Content: Symptom-You are creating an outgoing check for a supplier, and the following errors are displayed:-'Error while recalculating the withholding tax:'-'Jurisdiction code missing in address of Supplier XXX' (XXX represents the Supplier name).-'Amounts on Invoice XYZ are inconsistent' (XYZ represents the invoice ID).-'The assigned payment amount for the item must not be zero. You can only clear items with deductions or discounts manually'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Suppliers / Supplier Accounts view.-Search for the supplier you intend to pay.-Tab Trade payables appear the open item, choose the one you want.-Select this line and click Payment Manually By Outgoing Check.-Errors are displayed:-'Error while recalculating the withholding tax:'-'Jurisdiction code missing in address of Supplier XXX' (XXX represents the Supplier name).-'Amounts on Invoice XYZ are inconsistent' (XYZ represents the invoice ID).-'The assigned payment amount for the item must not be zero. You can only clear items with deductions or discounts manually'-Cause-The Main Address in the supplier account is empty for the fields below:-City/State/ZIP-Tax Jurisdiction Code-To check that, follow steps below:-Open the Supplier ID.-Click View All button.-Under Main Address, notice that the above fields are empty. -Resolution-You must maintain the Main Address of the supplier completely, including City/State/ZIP and Tax Jurisdiction Code.-After maintaining the fields, the outgoing check could be posted.-Keywords-Error while recalculating the withholding tax, Jurisdiction code missing in address of Supplier, Main Address, City/State/ZIP, Tax Jurisdiction Code

Title: The Newly Added Financial Reporting Structure is Not Visible in the Financial Reporting structure for G/L Accounts Report
Content: Symptom-In the fine-tune activity of Chars of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, you add a new financial reporting structure XYZ, and you expect it to be available in the Financial Reporting structure for G/L Accounts report, but in fact you cannot find it when specifying variables for this report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project in question and choose Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the fine-tune activity Chars of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, and then choose Edit financial reporting structures.-In the Available Financial Reporting Structures table, add a new financial reporting structure XYZ.-Choose Save and Close.-Then go to the General Ledger work center and choose the Reports view.-Choose the Financial Reporting structure for G/L Accounts report.-In the Variables screen, display all the available G/L Account Reporting Structure.- You cannot find the newly added financial reporting structure XYZ in the list.-Cause-You have defined the Structure Type of the new financial reporting structure as Income Statement by Function of Expense. This means this financial reporting structure is used in the financial statement reports, but not the G/L Account Reporting Structure report.-Resolution-In order to make a financial reporting structure available for selection in the Financial Reporting structure for G/L Accounts report, make sure the Structure Type of this financial reporting structure is set to Account Type during creation.

Title: Selection on G/L Account Not Working In Financial Reports
Content: Symptom-You run a standard financial report such as Accounts Receivable Reconciliation or Accounts Payable Reconciliation. You want to run a selection on a certain G/L Account and find that whatever value you select will not affect the report result. Regardless of the selection you will always get all G/L Accounts in the report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work centre, Reports view-Find and Open either of the two above reports-Make sure to include G/L Account as a variable in the selection area-Select any G/L account and run the report-Cause-G/L Account is a compounded field. It is compounded with Chart of Accounts. So it won't work if you put it as a selection parameter directly.-Resolution-We can suggest two solutions.--Solution 1:-If you want to put G/L Account as selection parameter then it has to be added as hierarchy: To do so hit the Add Fields button in the report. Then expand the Dimension: Accounting. For item G/L Account check all three boxes (Display in Report, Display in Selection Area and Display as Hierarchy). You will then have two selection variables G/L Account ( Hierarchy ) and G/L Account. In productive use you then need to select a value first from G/L Account ( Hierarchy ) and afterwards from G/L Account.--Solution 2:-You can use Edit Filter instead of the selection: After you produced a report switch to the Edit Filter tab and select the desired accounts from the value help for G/L Account. For this solution you do not need the hierarchy as in solution 1.--Please note that these solutions might not work with direct / manual data entry (i.e. you should always use the value help for selection).

Title: Open Receivables/Payables with Clearing Proposal not open for automatic Payment Allocation.
Content: Symptom-Suitable Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines have been defined in Business Configuration which work in simulation mode.-When importing a bank statement, containing the correct references, the expectation is that open receivables/payables are identified and automatically assigned in a payment allocation.-However, there are open receivables/payables which are not allocated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The relevant payment allocations can be accessed either in:-Work Center: Payment Management.-Navigate to View: Payment Allocations.-Select the relevant payment allocation.-- or via the posted bank statement:-Work Center: Liquidity Management.-View: Bank Statements.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.-Cause-A clearing proposal based on another payment transaction has already been created for the open receivables/payable.-Clearing proposals are created, for example, in case document references match, however the amount paid represents an overpayment.-Invoices for which a clearing proposal already exists are not regarded as open for automatic payment allocation anymore.-Resolution-Make sure whether an open payment allocation including a clearing proposal already exists for the open receivable/payable.-Then it can be decided which payment should be eventually allocated and cleared.-Keywords-payment allocation; open receivable; open payable; Receivables/Payables; payment proposal

Title: Depreciation Calculated Automatically is Wrong for Migrated Fixed Asset: Closing Balance of Migrated Fixed Asset Balance is not Zero After Useful Life Periods
Content: Symptom-A fixed asset with a useful life of 2 years is migrated, with depreciation starting on 01.01.2011. The expectation is that the book value should be zero by the end of fiscal year 2013. However, a remaining depreciation balance is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Select fixed asset XYZ and choose Edit.-Navigate to the Values tab.-Select Book Values and choose fiscal year 2013.-The closing balance is not zero and a remaining asset value is displayed.-Cause-For a useful life of 24 periods, the total depreciation should be, for example, 18,568.00. However, during asset migration, the cumulated historical depreciation was calculated for only 20 periods, resulting in depreciation of 15,473.00.-Actual Asset Value: 27,852.00-Useful Life: 24 periods-Historical Depreciation Migrated: 20 periods-Remaining Depreciation: 4 periods-Resolution-The cumulated historical depreciation was not fully calculated during migration. Therefore, the depreciation corresponding to the remaining 4 periods was carried forward to the subsequent fiscal year.-This is the expected system behavior. The remaining depreciation is posted in the following year, and the book value can be verified in fiscal year 2014.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Asset Migration, Depreciation, Historical Depreciation, Cumulated Depreciation, Useful Life, Book Value, Closing Balance, Remaining Depreciation, Depreciation Periods, Fiscal Year, Asset Value, Migrated Asset, Fixed Asset Valuation, Depreciation Carry Forward.

Title: Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme Report Not Showing Cost of Goods Solds With a Zero Value
Content: Symptom-A Service Order has been created with a zero value. This Service Order is not displayed in the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue workcenter.-Go to Reports.-Go to View Lists.-Navigate to Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme.-Enter the relevant parameters and press Go.- The report does not display any zero values for the Cost of Goods Sold report item.-Cause-Since the cost related for this service is zero, it is considered as free item and therefore not added to Cost of Goods Sold. The report picks the value based on this along with the service confirmation and customer invoice.-Resolution-Check the service master that for Service XXXXX-The cost is maintained as 0,00 in the Valuation tab.-Maintain a value greater than 0.00 in the Valuation tab and then process the service order again through Service Confirmation, followed by the Customer Invoice. Once these steps are completed, the report will display a value for the Cost of Goods Sold report item in the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report.-Keywords-Service Order, Zero Value, Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme, Report, Valuation, Service Confirmation, Customer Invoice, Cost of Goods Sold.

Title: You are not able to add a G/L account determination group which you want to use later in your transactions
Content: Symptom-You get error while adding account determination group under General Ledger in fine tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to Implementation Projects.-3. Select activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-4. Select Edit Account Determination Groups.-5. Under General Ledger, select Groups for Other Current Assets.-6. Select Add row. Add Group ID as XYZ.-You get the below errors-Change or Delete duplicate rows with key 'XYZ' in 'G/L Account determination group'.-Save Failed- Cause-The error occurs because account determination group XYZ already exists under General Ledger ->Groups for Other Income. Now you try to add the same group under Other Current Assets, the system checks that the account determination group for Other Income, Other Current Assets, Other Liabilities and General Expenses is unique.-Resolution-It is not possible to add the same account determination group under different sets of General Ledger.

Title: MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN job aborted with ABAP Dump
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The job MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN related to Mass Data Run Object (MDRO) run was canceled with ABAP Dump.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SM37 t-code and search with the job name for the canceled jobs.-Select the job and click on Job Log button.-Here, you will see the complete job log and the step where job failed.-In this case, as MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN job has failed with ABAP dump.-Cause-Investigating the ABAP dump, it can be seen in the Error Analysis section that cause of this dump is  System Error occurred during Lock Management.-SAP system cannot enter the required lock correctly into the lock table managed in the ENQUEUE server and the ENQUEUE function, module therefore triggers an exception. If the application cannot process this exception, the active transaction is automatically canceled.--Issue is clearly from Enqueue server side the message server which establishes the connection between the application server and the ENQUEUE server in a local system, is no longer running.--Since the dump says lock entry couldn't be created basically the lock would be created in enqueue table and there could be two reasons for this dump:-1. either table size is overflow.-2. second could be the enqueue process itself is not free.-Resolution-Normally, such issues are temporary issue and once the enqueue server is free to handle in coming calls, job will finish automatically.-Recommendation is to trigger the MDRO AMDCI_OCN_RUN job again after sometime as this is a temporary issue.-If issue still persists, please forward the incident in ES Tech & Architecture queue.
