Title: Closing Relevant Task: Check Journal Entries For Employee Time Calendar
Content: Symptom-A Closing Relevant Task is received with the title “Check Journal Entries for Employee Time Calendar.”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-  Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center General Ledger.-Go to view Closing Cockpit.-Go to sub-view Closing Relevant Tasks.-Find the task “Check Journal Entries for Employee Time Calendar.”-Cause-For example, ABC and PQR were previously defined as profit centers but have now it has been changed to cost centers. Hence, the system is notifying that these organizational structure changes have been made and that, in some Time Calendar postings, these organizational structures were posted as profit centers and are now defined as cost centers.-Due to the organizational structure change, the system is advising to check the journal entries. The message also indicates that adjusting journal entries should be created if required.-Resolution-If the changes require correction, perform the correction postings using the journal entry voucher. Otherwise, follow the steps below to close the task:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Closing Relevant Tasks sub-view.-Find the task “Check Journal Entries for Employee Time Calendar.”-Click Actions and select Complete.- Keywords-Correction postings, Journal Entry Voucher, General Ledger, Closing Cockpit, Closing Relevant Tasks, Check Journal Entries for Employee Time Calendar, Organizational Structure Changes, Time Calendar Postings, and Complete Task.

Title: Supplier Invoice Tax Due Date is the Same as The Posting Date.
Content: Symptom-You want system to pick the Supplier Invoice Date as the Tax Due Date; However, the system selects the Posting Date.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Workcenter.-Go to the Common Task.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-In the General tab, The Invoice Date is different from the Tax Due Date.- Cause-This is general system behaviour. By default the posting date is selected as tax due date of the supplier invoice.-Resolution-You can maintain the Tax Due Date field for a new supplier invoice in order to not have the supplier invoice posting date selected as tax due date.

Title: Target Discount is Not Taken Over in the Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-The value of the Target Discount field within an Opportunity is not taken over in the Sales Quote, which was created as a follow up document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales work center.-Select the Opportunities view.-Open an Opportunity.-Select the Products tab.-Fill in the Target Discount field of the added Product.-Save changes.-Select the Sales Documents tab.-Click the New button and create a new Sales Quote.-Save and open the new created Sales Quote.-Select the Products tab.-The field Discount is empty.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-The field Target Discount within the Opportunity has a different function as the field Discount within the Sales Quote.-Resolution-It is only relevant to use this field only if SAP Cloud for Customer is integrated with SAP Price and Margin Management (SAP PMM by Vendavo).

Title: Not Possible to add Attachment to Journal Entry Vouchers
Content: Symptom-How to attach a File/Link in a Journal Entry Voucher?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger workcenter.-Select the Journal Entry Voucher view.-Select the document for which you want to attach a File/Link and click on  Journal Entry Voucher ID to display.-Click on Edit.-Go to Attachments tab.-Add Button is disabled.-Cause-If you first display the Journal Entry Voucher by selecting the  Journal Entry Voucher ID and then click Edit, the Add option will be disabled in the Attachements tab.  This is  current system behaviour.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger workcenter.-Select the Journal Entry Voucher view.-Select the document for which you want to attach a File/Link.-Click on Edit.-Go to Attachments tab.-Click on Add.-Select File or Link to attach.

Title: How to Remove Customer Return Approval
Content: Symptom-You want to remove the Customer Return Approval process entirely from the system. However,you find this activity is unable to revoke from the Business Configuration work center.-   Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Approval for Customer Return.-You want to de-scope this activity but you don't find any option to do so.-Cause-Customer Return Approval is a protected activity in the system, meaning once it is scoped in system it can not be scoped out.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-As a workaround you can set an extremely high value as threshold in the approval, so that no document go for approval.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view then select the Approval Processes sub view.-Find the relevant process for customer return and set Condition for high value.-Save.

Title: Valuation tab Missing Under Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-The Valuation tab is missing under the Export Materials option in Mass Data Maintenance.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select the Export Materials link.-Query the necessary material/s.-The Valuation tab cannot be found.-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign does not provide an option to maintain the Valuation data of materials through Mass Data Maintenance or even the Migration of Materials activity in Business Configuration.-There is a separate Business Configuration activity Migration of Material Valuation Data through which the Valuation data of materials can be maintained.-This is the intended behavior of the system.

Title: How to Display the "Total Given Discount" Field on Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-You want the filed Total Given Discount field to be displayed on the Sales Quote.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the SALES work center.-Choose the SALES QUOTES view.-You want the Total Given Discount field to be shown on the sales quote.-Cause-You have to set the relevant activities in the Business Configuration work center to make Total Given Discount field available in the sales quote.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go o the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Go to the Fine-tune tab.-Open the activity Configure Price Strategy.-Start Configure Pricing Procedure.-Select the Standard Pricing Procedure.-Check step 112 for price component Total Given Discounts.-Change the dropdown in column Total Discount.-Change the dropdown list from No to Yes.-Save.

Title: How to Set All Purchase Orders to One Specified Manager For an Approval.
Content: Symptom-You want to set up system in such a way that all purchase orders created should go to one specified manager for an approval. You want to know how to do that.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase requests and orders work center.-Select Purchase orders view.-Find the purchase order which is in status  In Approval.-You would like to set up that all the purchase orders approvals has to go to one manager for approval.- Resolution-This can be done be following the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview.-Select the fine tuning activity Purchase Order Approvals.-Select the default approval process for the Purchase orders defined.-Select Copy button.-Change the Process Name.-Under the Work Distribution, choose the Work Distribution as Direct Approver.-Select Edit button and then choose the person who should be the Approver.-Select Save and Close button.-Select Edit Validity to make that there is only one active approval process in one time period.-

Title: How to Add New G/L Accounts to a Direct Posting Payment
Content: Symptom-You want to add G/L Accounts to the dropdown list to be available when posting a payment directly to a G/L Account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under Common Tasks, click New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-On the Payment Application Method, select Direct Posting to G/L Account.-You want to add more G/L Accounts to the G/L Account dropdown list.-Resolution-The entries that you can select in the G/L Account dropdown when you post the payment directly to G/L Account are, in fact, the account determination groups that are used to determine the correct G/L Account based on the account determination for the ledger at posting time.-In order to add new account determination groups to the dropdown menu, please refer to the following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Edit Account Determination Groups.-Expand either the Cost ledger or General ledger.-Select the Groups under each of the above two ledgers that have the Available in Non-Cash Form of Payment column.-You see a list of all account determination groups under the concerned group. Note that for each account determination group you have five columns with checkboxes.-Each column determines where that specific group can be visible. For payments, the concerned column is Available in Non-Cash Form of Payment. If you flag it - the account determination group becomes visible on bank transfers, incoming and outgoing check, payment allocation, bank statements.--The G/L Account that is selected for posting depend upon which G/L Account assignment to your account determination group is done for each ledger.

Title: How to Change Reporting Line Unit or Job ID in Employee's Personnel File
Content: Symptom-You, as a personnel administrator, try to change the Reporting Line Unit or Job ID in employee's personnel file. But you find these fields are not editable.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select the respective employee and choose the Edit button to open employee's personnel file.-You will find non-editable fields in Organizational Data under the General tab.-Cause-You cannot directly change the Reporting Line Unit or Job ID in employee's personnel file. If you want to change them, you need to transfer the employee.-Resolution-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Regular Tasks view.-Select the Transfer Employee link.-Select the transferred employee.-Fill in necessary fields.-Select the Save and Close.

Title: Unable to Assign a Service Agent or an Employee as an Org Unit Manager
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to assign a Service Agent or an Employee as a Manager for an Org Unit but the Service Agent/Employee is missing in the value selection.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Select Edit Org Structures-Highlight the Org Unit-Go to General tab-Select the value selection for Org Unit Manager.-Cause-The general rule is, An Employee can be assigned to an Org Unit as a Manager only when that Employee is assigned to any of the Org Unit in the particular Organizational Structure.-Resolution-So, assign the Service Agent/Employee to any of the Org Unit as Employee (or Service Agent). Also note, if the Employee assignment to an Org Unit starts at DD.MM.YYYY then you can assign him/her as Manager only on/after DD.MM.YYYY.

Title: Org Unit Missing During Hiring or Transferring of an Employee
Content: Symptom-When you Hire or Transfer an Employee, the expected Org Unit is missing in the value selection for Organizational Unit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Hiring or Transfer Employee-Select the value selection of Organizational Unit.-Cause-The cause for the issue might be that the Org Unit‘s validity is in the future. EX: You are performing the hiring on 22.7.2014 but the validity of the Org Unit starts at 01.08.2014.-Resolution-To overcome the issue, either extend the validity of the Org Unit to the current date or perform the hiring on/after the valid date of the Org Unit.

Title: A User-Created Time Account Is Not Available for Selection In The Employee's Time Profile
Content: Symptom-You have created a Time Account in one of the country-based time account activities available in Business Configuration > Fine Tune (e.g. Time Accounts - Australia). Right after, you tried to add this time account to an employee's Time Profile, however you noticed that the newly created Time Account is not available for selection on the drop-down list for time accounts. As your last attempt to assign the time account, you force the situation by typing the Time Account code and pressing enter and then the system throws the error message: Type of time account not valid.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the respective employee-Click Edit button-Under Time Profile tab, click Time Account Rules sub tab-Click Add Row-Click to open Time Account drop-down menu-See that your newly created Time Account is not available for selection-Type the Type Account code and press enter-System throws error message: Type of time account not valid-Cause-The reason for the unavailability of your newly created Time Account in the drop-down list for time accounts and for the error message: Type of time account not valid is the same: the Time Profile Start Date is a prior date than the Time Account Valid From date you defined in the fine tuning activity (e. g. Time Accounts - Australia) and hence the Time Account is not valid for the respective Time Profile for a certain period.-For example:-Time Profile Start Date: 15.08.2014-Time Account Valid From date: 21.08.2014-The Time Account is not valid for this respective Time Profile from 15.08.2014 to 20.08.2014.-Resolution-There are two available resolutions here:-1st -  Change the Time Account Valid From date to be the same as Time Profile Start Date (e.g. 15.08.2014) or even a prior date:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search for the country-based activity (e.g. Time Accounts - Australia)-Click Maintain Time Account Types-Select the respective Time Account Code-Change the Valid From date and click Save-2nd - Copy the Time Profile in order to create a new one (Start Date of new Time Profile entry will be defined as today's date) and then add the Time Account to this new Time Profile entry:-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the respective employee-Click Edit button-Under Time Profile tab, select the available Time Profile entry and click Copy-On the newly created entry, you can use the drop-down list to find your Time Account-The second solution is also quoted on the help document Assign a Vacation Time Account under Procedure session.

Title: How to Terminate an Employee Whose Intended Termination Date is Lesser Than Org Assignment Start Date?
Content: Symptom-You have migrated few Employees into you system and currently you have a requirement to terminate these Employees. But you are not able to perform it since the termination date is past date. That means intended termination date is lesser than org assignment start date.-Resolution-One way to achieve the same could be :--1. Terminate the employee at any date after org assignment start date via Personnal Administration - Regular Task .-2. Now go to Personnal Administration - Employees and search for this employee. Click Edit. Go to Employment - Work Agreement, use button Change termination date to change to the actual termination date i.e. before org assignment start date.---For example : for the employee with employee id XYZ.-Hire Date = 10/15/2012-Expected Termination Date = 1/7/2013-Current Org Ass Date in the system is = 01/08/2013--Step 1: Terminate this employee from the Regular Tasks by giving the Termination Date as 01/08/2013 or any date after this.--Step 2: Change the termination date to 1/7/2013 from the Change Termination Date button. It gets changed.--This way, you need not pre-pone employees org assignment for employees.--But, please note by doing this: employees org assignment shall no more exist in the system since during his work agreement period there is no org assignment.

Title: No Reporting Package Available for Selection When Creating a New Extraction Run for Financial Data
Content: Symptom-You would like to create a New Extraction Run for Financial Data to export financial data from reports and save them in a file in SAP Audit format.-However when creating the New Extraction Run for Financial Data ,  there's no Reporting Package available to be selected on the required field Reporting Package.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center-Select the Periodic Tasks option Extraction Run for Financial Data-Press the New button-Click on Extraction Run for Financial Data-Under Data Selection session, look for the field Reporting Package and click on the value selection icon on the right.-See that there's no Reporting Package available for selection.-Cause-The Reporting Package delivered by SAP is not available in the Business Configuration activity Digital Extract, and hence not available for selection when creating a Extraction Run for Financial Data, because you didn't selected the scoping element Consolidation Preparation within your Project Scope, in the Scoping phase.-Resolution-You should select the scoping element Consolidation Preparation within your Project Scope, in Business Configuration work center:- Go to the Business Configuration work center.- Go to Implementation Projects view.- Select your project and click on Edit Project Scope.- Click on Next two times until reach the phase 3 Scoping.- In the Show field, select All Elements.- Press the Actions button, and then click on Expand All.- Under Financial and Management Accounting -> General Ledger, find Consolidation Preparation and mark the checkbox to select it.- Click on Next twice more and on the phase 5 Review, press the Finish button.-Returning to the New Extraction Run for Financial Data screen, you will be able to find the SAP delivered Reporting Package.-You can also find it on the Business Configuration activity Digital Extract, where you can create your own reporting packages as well.

Title: Is it Possible to Migrate Contacts Without Linking it to Accounts Migration?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to migrate Contacts into the system but there is no specific activity for Contacts Migration instead Contacts can be migrated only through Accounts Migration by linking it with specific Accounts.-Resolution-This feature is not available in current release and we have added the requested functionality in the next higher release.

Title: Sections Enabled for Extension Fields in Employee's Personnel File
Content: Symptom-Users want to add an extension field in an employee's personnel file. The section users want to enhance is not listed as a section which is enabled for extension fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center. -Select the Employees view. -Select an employee -Select the Edit button. -Select the Adapt option -Choose Enter Adaptation Mode. -Select Adapt -Choose Edit Screen. -In the right pane, select Extension Fields. -Cause-The system works as designed. Users can only add extension field in specific sections in employee's personnel file.-Resolution-Users can add an extension field in the following sections:-In the General tab in the Contract Data section-In the General tab in the Personal Data section-In the Personal Data tab in the Biographical Data sub tab in the Details section-Keywords-Customization, Configuration, UI enhancement, Data model customization, Additional attributes, Page layout, Record customization, HR master data, Biodata, User interface, Personalization, Layout editor, Form design, Module limitations, Supported areas

Title: Use Fixed Asset Extension Fields in the Migration Template.
Content: Symptom-You have created several extension fields on the New Fixed Asset screen and now you want to migrate fixed assets using the Fixed Assets (extended) template and the extension fields have to part of the template header, nevertheless you do not know where to find this template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center-Select the Fixed Assets view-Select the Fixed Assets subview-Click on the New Fixed Asset button-You can see the extension fields you have created.-Resolution-You can simply download the Fixed Asset Extend template in the Business Configuration work center using the Perform Data Extraction activity.-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select the project name and click on Open Activity List button-On the Fine-Tune chevron search for the Perform Data Extraction activity and open it-Click on Download migration templates tittle-Search for the Fixed Assets (extended) Migration Object-And click on Download-The excel template will open and on the tab Master Data you will be able to see the new fields created on the Fixed Asset screen.

Title: Field "Legal Competence" is Missing in Mass Data Maintenance of Customers
Content: Symptom-The field Legal Competence is missing in the Export screen of Customers in Mass Data Maintenance.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Select Export Customers-Select the Accounts and select Go button- Resolution-The field legal competence is not a part of Mass Data Maintenance. This is a new requirement.-In the meantime, you can use Migration while adding new Customers.

Title: How to Create a Form Template in a Specific Language Which is Not Available in the List of Languages in Form Template Maintainance
Content: Symptom-You want to create a form template in a specific language (eg: Turkey), but while creation this particular language is not available in the list of languages for selection.-  Reproducing the Issue- Application and User Management work cente.- Form Template Maintenance subview.- Upload As new Variant.- Select Country as Turkey from the List but the Language Turkish is not available in the drop down list to select.--Cause-This is the standard system behavior, the system will list out only standard languages and the languages which are added in the Additional Communication Languages.-Resolution-In order to add the required languages to the list follow the below steps:-Work Center Business Configuration.-View Implementation Projects.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tuning Tab.-Find the Activity Additional Communication Languages.-Add this activity to your project(If it is not).-Select the Language Turkish check box.-Save.-Now if you go to the form template maintenance view and try to create a form you could find the country Turkey and Language Turkish in the dropdown of respective fields(Same way you could maintain for other languages also).--Note: The respective country should be scoped in your system in order to find the country in the drop down of form template country selection during the creation of  a form template.

Title: Error Message Posting Failed while Creating a New Charge/Credit
Content: Symptom-You are attempting to create a new Charge/Credit for an Employee and when you click on Save, system shows an error message saying Posting Failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center.-Go to Suppliers View.-Go to Supplier Accounts Sub-view.-Search for the respective Employee.-Click on View button.-Choose New Charge/Credit button.-Complete the necessary information.-Click on Post button.-System shows up an error message saying Posting Failed﻿.-Cause-The Business Partner Country is not being maintained for the employee and thus, in the existing Central Bank Reporting functionality that is being checked during the posting and an error is thrown.-Resolution-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center.-Go to Business Partners View.-Search for the respective employee.-Select it and click on Edit > General button.-Go to Addresses tab.-Click on Add Row button and maintain a Country.-Choose Save button.-After performing these steps, you will be able to post a New Charge/Credit.

Title: The Journal Entry for a Goods and Service Receipt Document Doesn't Show the Right Amount
Content: Symptom-You order some goods from one of your suppliers, after the complete delivery, you create a goods and service receipt document XYZ with reference to the purchase order and post it to accounting. You then check the details of the journal entry ABC and find out that the amount shown on the journal entry is larger than the net value displayed in the goods and service receipt document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center and choose the Journal Entries view.-Select the Journal Entries subview, and then display the journal entry ABC of the goods and service receipt document XYZ.-Check the line item of the journal entry and you can see that the debit or credit amount is XXX.-Under Journal Header, choose to open the source document XYZ.-Choose View All and navigate to the Items tab.-Under Basic Data, you can see the amount in the Net Price field is YYY, which is smaller than XXX.-Also if you check the net value on the related purchase order, the amount is also YYY.-Cause-The net value on the purchase order is YYY, but if you go to the Taxes tab of the item, you can see the tax code is set as not deductable, which means the system won't expect the tax to be deducted on the supplier invoice, so when posting the goods and service receipt document to accounting, the tax amount is also posted, this equals to the difference between XXX and YYY. But the tax amount is not shown on the goods and service receipt document XYZ, its net value only corresponds to that on the purchase order, which is YYY. This is why you see a difference between the net value on the goods and service receipt document XYZ and the amount on the journal entry document ABC.

Title: Partner Companies view not Available in General Ledger Workcenter
Content: Symptom-The Partner Companies view is not available in the General Ledger work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center navigate to the Master Data view.-Here you are missing the Partner Companies view.-Cause-The scoping element Consolidation Preparation is not included in your project scope.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration work center navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project and press Edit Project Scope.-In phase 3-Scoping select All Elements in the Show field.-Navigate to Financial and Management Accounting and there to General Ledger.-Here tick the box for the element Consolidation Preparation.-Click Next two times, review the changes and then press Finish.-Now assign the Partner Companies view to your user in the Application and User Management work center.-Just to be safe log off and log-in to your system.-The Partner Companies view is now available in the General Ledger work center.-Keywords-partner companies; general ledger; Consolidation Preparation; scoping element

Title: Extension Field Added Through PDI is Missing in Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You have added a Extension Field through PDI but this field is not available in Mass Data maintenance during Export.-Note: This case document is applicable for all the Migration objects in MDM.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-Since the field has been added via PDI, there is nothing from the migration object that we need to enhance for this field to be available in the migration template.- -You will have to create a Process Extension Scenario in the PDI where you can specify the Namespace, BO Name and the node which is extended. Right click on this scenario and select "Check-In Content".- -Create an extension BO and specify the scenario name in the following manner:-[Scenario (<ScenarioName>)] element <ElementName>: <ElementType>;-Activate the extension BO.- -And now this field would be available in the underlying web service. Once you open the migration object for materials on the UI, the template would get adapted automatically.- -You can refer to the SAP Cloud Applications Studio Help in the Cloud Applications Studio tool. You can navigate to the help by using the following path:-Developer Desktop -> Extensibility -> Process Extension Scenarios -> Example: Sales Tracking.- -Please follow the steps mentioned in the document in order to add the field in the extension BO.

Title: Cancel Supplier Invoice - Fixed Asset: Acquisition Cost Negative
Content: Symptom-You create a fixed asset from a supplier invoice. The supplier invoice is being paid but later you realize that you need to cancel the fixed asset.-The posting of the cancellation invoice does not go through. A BTM task has been genereated and the cancellation invoice appears as unposted source document in the General Ledger workcenter.-The posting is not possible due to the error message Asset XX val.view Y: Acquisition cost negative.-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger navigate to the Closing Cockpit and there to the Source Documents.-The cancellation invoice appears with status In Process.-An error message is displayed: Asset XX val.view Y: Acquisition cost negative-Cause-The payment to clear the supplier invoice is less than the amount of the supplier invoice because in the clearing there is a cash discount maintained.-In the Fixed Asset Values Tab navigate to the Journal tab and there look under Source Doc. Type: Payment. Click on the payment ID and check if the payment amount is less then the invoice amount and if for the invoice a cash discount has been maintained. If yes, then the system therefore reduced the value of the fixed asset.-In the Journal of the values tab of the fixed asset check for the amount of the supplier invoice under Source Doc. Type: Supplier Invoice and then compare it with the acqusition cost under Planned Values in the General tab . It will be less then the amount in the values tab.-When you try to cancel the supplier invoice the original amount of the supplier invoice is to be cancelled but as the amount has been reduced this would result in a negative acquisition cost amount. That's why the error message appears.-Resolution-You need to cancel the payment clearing so that the amount of the original supplier invoice and it's cancellation invoice is the same again:--Navigate to the Payables workcenter and here to the Suppliers - Supplier Accounts view.-Select the respective supplier and choose View.-In the Trade/Payables Tab show All Items.-Press on the cleaing ID that cleared the supplier invoice and it's payment.-Choose View All and then press Reset Clearing-Save your changes.-Now navigate to the Source Documents View of the General Ledger.-Mark the cancellation invoice and choose Actions - Post Business Transaction.

Title: Payment In Status Void Changes To Status In Preparation After Executing The Next Payment Run
Content: Symptom-A Payment that has been changed from In Preparation to Void is automatically changed back to In Preparation when the next Payment Run is executed.-The expected behavior is for the Payment to remain in Void status after the Payment Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate the Payables work center.-Select the Automatic Payments view.-Select the Payment 123 with status In Preparation (123 represents the Payment ID).-Click Void Proposal.-Verify that the Payment status changes from In Preparation to Void.-Execute the next Payment Run.-Open the Payment 123 and check its status.-Actual Result:-Payment 123 changes back to In Preparation after the Payment Run.-Expected Result:-Payment 123 should remain in Void status after the Payment Run.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-If a Payment should not be executed, one of the following options can be used:-    Option 1: Void the Payment-The Payment can be voided by following the steps described above.-Note: A Payment with status Void can only be changed back to In Preparation by executing a new Payment Run.-Option 2: Postpone the Payment-Instead of voiding the Payment, the Payment can be postponed:-Open the Payables work center.-Navigate to the Automatic Payments view.-Select the relevant Payment with status In Preparation.-Click Actions and select Postpone.-Verify that the Payment status changes from In Preparation to Postponed.-A Payment with status Postponed can be changed back to In Preparation at any time by selecting Actions → Reset Postpone.-Option 3: Block the Supplier/Customer for Payments-If Payments to a specific Supplier or Customer should be prevented, a Payment Block can be maintained.-Open the Payables or Receivables work center.-Navigate to the Suppliers or Customers view.-Select the relevant Supplier or Customer.-Click Edit and select Financial Data.-Maintain the Payment Block.-Important: The Payment Block applies to all Payments for the selected Supplier or Customer. No Supplier Invoice or Customer Invoice will be released for Payment while the Payment Block is active.-If a business partner has both Supplier and Customer roles, the Payment Block applies to both roles.-Keywords-Void, In preparation, Postpone, Payment run, Payment block, Proposal

Title: How to Determine Correct Approver in Expense Report
Content: Symptom-Incorrect Approver is being determined in Expense Report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel And Expenses work center-Go to the Expense Reports view-Choose an Expense Report and display-Approver Name field has incorrect approver-Cause-This issue occurs because, the Cost Assignment has not been modified in the Expense Arrangement.-Whenever you change the Organization assignment of an Employee in Organization Management work center, accordingly the Cost Assignment has to be modified in the Expense Arrangement of Employee.-Resolution-Whenever you change the Organization assignment of Employee, make a note of the new Cost Center and follow the steps below.-Go to Travel and Expenses work center-Go to Expense Arrangements view-Select All Expense Arrangements in the Show field-Enter the Employee ID in the Find field-Click on Go-Choose the resulting record-Click on Edit-Select the applicable record for current date under Validity Assignment tab-Select the resulting record under Cost Assignment tab (below)-Click on Remove button -Now, Click on Add Row -Enter the new Cost Center to which Employee currently belongs to-Click Save and Close

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Values Displayed Wrongly
Content: Symptom-When you check the depreciation tab in the fixed asset, you notice that for a fiscal year the system is not showing planned depreciation for all periods. Instead the planned depreciation for the complete year is displayed for period 12 only.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Asset work center-Select Fixed Asset view-Show all fixed asset-Search for the fixed asset and select the row-Click on Edit and select Values-Go to Depreciation overview tab-Select Fiscal year from the dropdown list.-Cause-You have created the relevant fiscal year in the system. Depreciation are only displayed for the available fiscal year in the system + 1 year. For the remaining year(s) one line for last period will be shown. This entry includes the complete planned depreciation for the entire year.-For example:-For example fixed asset XYZ, in each period you should depreciate 10 USD. You have fiscal year 2015 available in the system. So system will display depreciation for all periods for 2015 and 2016. For 2017 onwards, system will display complete depreciation (i.e Depreciation for each period * Number of period. In this case 10 USD * 12 Periods = 120 USD) in the last period which is period 12.-Resolution-This is behavior is the standard system behaviour. The system is working as designed.-However, if you would like to see the depreciation for the currently available Fiscal year(s) + 2 years, you need to create a new fiscal year in the system.-For example : You have fiscal year 2015 available in the system. Consequently depreciation for all periods for 2015 and 2016 are displayed. If you would like to display the depreciation for fiscal year 2017 also, you need to create the fiscal year 2016 accordingly. Once you create fiscal year 2016, depreciation for fiscal year 2017 are displayed. -Please follow below mentioned steps to create a new fiscal year.-Go to General ledger work center-Select Set of books and assigned companies view-Select the set of books and click on Edit Fiscal Year-Click on New Fiscal Year to create new fiscal year in the system-Click on Save.-Please note that you cannot have more than 3 years open in the system. In case you already have 3 fiscal year open, before you create new fiscal year, you need to close the past fiscal year by performing all closing activities.-

Title: Error No Functional Area could Be Assigned of Unposted Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You found unposted source documents XYZ -1 and XYZ-2 are listed with error No functional area could be assigned. The source document type is Expense Report.-There is additional information: Derivation for accounting principle ABC, chart of accounts DEF, G/L account UVW, Nonsales Object.-But you have configured the functional area for the cost center type, of which the cost center is assigned in the cost assignment of expense report XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center, Closing Cockpit view and Source Document view.-The document XYZ-1 and XYZ-2 are listed in list of unposted source documents with error and information as below.-No functional area could be assigned.-Derivation for accounting principle ABC, chart of accounts DEF, G/L account UVW, Nonsales Object.-Cause-When the first version of the expense report created, the cost assignment is not cost center, but pure G/L account. But there is no functional area assigned to the G/L account UVW. So the first version is not posted.-Then you changed the cost assignment to cost center in expense report XYZ.-But due to first version is not posted, the second version is not posted either.-Resolution-You need to follow the steps below to set the configuration and post the documents.-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project, and select Open Activity List.-Go to tab Fine-Tuning Activities.-Select activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Select Functional Area Determination.-Select Add Row in tab Determination Using G/L Accounts.-Input the G/L account UVW, and select Functional Area as the same as you configured in Determination Using Cost Center Types.-Select Save. Please note, if you configure difference functional area for G/L account, system gives priority to functional area of G/L accounts.-Go to General Ledger work center, Closing Cockpit view and Source Document subview.-Select XYZ-1 and select Actions, then Post Business Transaction.-Select XYZ-2 and select Actions, then Post Business Transaction.

Title: How to create a Fixed Asset from a procurement process while using a down payment
Content: Symptom-Practically, the Individual Material option is not available as an Account Assignment in a Down Payment Request.-This is not the way to create a Fixed Asset from a Down Payment.-Reproducing the Issue-You created a down payment request-You selected the product type : material.-Yet, the account assignment type Individual Material is not present in the value help-Therefore it is not possible to create the Fixed Asset from the Down Payment.-Cause-It is not allowed to raise a Down Payment against an IMat since a Fixed Asset cannot be created out of a Down Payment.-Resolution-Here are the steps to create a fixed asset from procurement process while using Down Payment:-a) Create a Purchase Order against the Supplier. While creating the PO, Account Assignment can be made against a Cost Center. The PO Item can be converted into an IMat by clicking on the New Individual Material button.-b) Create a Down Payment in the system by giving the PO Reference. The Account Assignment should be the same as in the PO.-c) Create a Goods & Services Receipt for the PO which was created once the goods are received. This will result in creation of the Fixed Asset-d) Make the payment for the Down Payment-e) Create a Supplier Invoice & include this Down Payment in it.-f) If the Down Payment is less than the amount of the Supplier Invoice, make the payment for the difference-g) Execute a GR/IR Clearing Run

Title: Error Occurs While Performing Migration of Customer Contracts
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to migrate Customer Contracts, system throws the error message:-ID XX not permitted-during the simulation of migration and thus you are unable to complete the migration.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Choose the relevant project title and select the Open Activity List button.-In the opened window, go to the Integrate & Extend tab-Search for Migration of Customer Contracts activity and select Open button.-In the opened window, select Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool link.-Select the respective file name, select Execute Migration -> Step by Step option.-It executes the migration, there select the Next button and go to the Simulate Import step, you could see that the system has resulted in error messages.-Resolution-For migrated contracts only Alphanumeric values are permitted as ID. (For e.g. A1). Numeric values will be rejected as ID.-Please provide alphanumeric values as ID in the migration Excel and try to migrate the customer contracts again.

Title: Target Selection is Not Available in the General Ledger Account Drop-down List When Creating a New Charge/Credit
Content: Symptom-You try to create a new Charge/Credit for a customer, and assign the charge or credit to a General Ledger Account ABC, but the desired account is not available for selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customer Accounts sub view.-Select a customer and choose View.-Choose New Charge/Credit.-In the New Charge/Credit screen, enter the required information.-In the Line Items table, choose Add Row.-In the drop-down list of the General Ledger Account field, try to select the value ABC.-    But the selection ABC is not shown in the drop-down list.-Cause-The drop-down list of General Ledger Account does not consist of a list of real G/L accounts, but of a list of account determination groups, which are assigned to the desired G/L accounts.-To have an account determination group shown in the list, you have to set it as Available in Other Transactions in the fine-tune activity of Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination. Here Other Transactions refer to transactions such as manual tax correction, new charge, new credit and intercompany business transaction.-Resolution-In order to set the account determination group ABC as Used in Other Transactions, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view if your system has gone live.-Otherwise, go to the Implementation Projects view, and select the related project to Open Activity List.-Select the fine-tune activity of Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination.-Choose Edit Account Determination Groups.-Go to the General Ledger, or Groups for General Expenses under Costs.  -Find the group ABC, and tick the option of Available in Other Transactions.-Choose Save and Close.-    You should be able to select the account determination group ABC when creating a New Charge/Credit.-Keywords-new charge/credit; G/L accounts; account determination groups

Title: Purchase Order Still Displayed In Open Item View In The Inventory Valuation Work Center
Content: Symptom-A purchase order is finished. However, it still appears in the Open Purchase Order Items in the Inventory work center, Purchasing document view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Purchase Document Item view.-Show Open Purchase Order Items.-Here the purchase orders which are finished and cleared are displayed. However, they are still displayed when the filter Open Purchase Order Items is used.-Cause-When a particular purchase order item has not set the flag for either Goods Receipt Expected or Supplier invoice expected, such items will be displayed in the Open Purchase Order Items filter under the Inventory Valuation work center, Purchasing Document Items View.-Resolution-Purchase orders where either Goods Receipt Expected or Supplier invoice expected is not set are also displayed when Open Purchase Order Items filter is used.-Purchase order where either Goods Receipt Expected or Supplier invoice expected is not set will be displayed only when Open Purchase Order Items filter is used.-However, these items will not be displayed when Items to Be Cleared filter is used.  This means no further action is required for this purchase order.-System is working as designed.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Purchasing Document Items Quick Guide-Keywords-Open Purchase Order Items; Supplier invoice expected; Goods Receipt Expected

Title: A Fixed Asset is not marked as Low Value Asset Even Though a Capitalization Threshold is Maintained
Content: Symptom-You create a new Fixed Asset via Supplier Invoice procurement. The fixed asset has a value that is within the low-value asset range that you have maintained in Fine Tuning.-The fixed asset should be marked as Low Value Asset but, instead it is maintained as general fixed asset and not as Low Value Asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Supplier Invoicing Work center navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose for instance New Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order.-Fill in all the obligatory fields and maintain a value that is between the minimum and maximum amount of the low value asset range in fine tuning.-In the Items Tab and there in the Cost Distribution tab you select Individual Material as Account Assignment Type.-Post the Invoice.-Now navigate to the Fixed Assets work center and there to the Fixed Assets view.-Notice that the fixed asset that was just created is not marked as Low Value Asset.-Cause-There is no minimum and maximum amount maintained for the accounting principle that is assigned to the set of books that is used for the posting of the supplier invoice.-Resolution-In the new Fixed Asset, navigate to the Master Data tab and here to the Life Cycle Data Tab.-Here you can see the assigned set of books, for instance HGB.-Now navigate to the Business Configuration Work center and there to the Activity List.-Open the Integrate and Extend Phase and search for the activity Set of Books.-Notice that the set of books (for instance, HGB) is assigned to accounting principle XXXX.-Now navigate to the Fine Tuning activity Capitalization Threshold for Fixed Assets.-There are several accounting principles maintained, for instance, XXXX and YYYY.-Now check in the Low Values for both.-Notice that there is a value range, meaning, a minimum and maximum amount maintained for YYYY but not for XXXX.-It's required to maintain the value range also for the accounting principle XXXX.-Keywords-fixed asset; Low Value Asset; Capitalization Threshold; value range; minimum amount; maximum amount

Title: Error message Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ
Content: Symptom-You are trying to proceed with the Migration of the Open Items Payable. -The following error shows:-Error message Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center;-Go to Implementation Projects view;-Click Open Activity List button;-Go to Integrate and Extend phase;-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data;-Click Open button;-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool option;-Select desired Migration Unit;-Click Execute Migration button;-Select Open Items Payable line;-Click Process File button.-Check error message: Error message Account determination group missing for supplier ABC and company XYZ.-Cause-The reason for the issue is that the migration activity was not done in sequential order. Usually the trade receivables/payables (TRP) accounts for Business Partner of type Employee are automatically created during the first expense settlement using the default Account Determination. You have to migrate the account determination group of employees so that employee master data is complete.-Resolution-In order for you to be able to resolve this issue, please follow the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center;-Go to Implementation Projects view;-Click Open Activity List button;-Search for Migration of Suppliers activity;-Click Change Immediately button;-Click Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool option.-There you can migrate the Account Determination Group for those mentioned business partners. You have to do this for all business partners (employees) added to the Excel migration file.-Then the employee master data will get an account determination group and you will be able to migrate Open Payables items to these employees.

Title: Transfer of an Employee is always determined to the 1st of next month
Content: Symptom-An employee was transferred to a new job position. This transfer however was determined to a specific date. After stating this, customer again tried to transfer the respective employee and again the transfer was saved determined to a specific date.-Question:-Why was the transfer determinable, although nothing has been requested in that direction?- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Regular Tasks view.-Use the task Transfer Employee.-Resolution-When you select Transfer Employee, Transfer Date determined is always the 1st of next month which is the expected system behavior.-For Example, if you select any Employee in Transfer Employee screen now then the Transfer Date should be the 1st of the next coming month.-Furthermore, the Transfer Date is editable date in Transfer Employee screen and system always determine the date as above.

Title: Bank Statements with same ID
Content: Symptom-You have In Preparation Bank Statements and you noticed that the documents have the same ID.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to Bank Statements view.-You will see the In Preparation bank statements with the same ID.-Cause-The ID counter will only be increased once a bank statement is posted. Therefore, every In Preparation bank statement would have the ID of the last posted bank statement plus one.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Note that in the first step (Enter General Data) of the guided activity for creating bank statements, you have the option to adjust the bank statement ID. Nevertheless, if you change this ID, you have to make sure that the Opening and Closing balances between bank statements are in sync.

Title: Reports "Schedule of Fixed Assets" And "Financial Statements" Show Different Results For The Value Of Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom- You run the Reports Schedule Of Fixed Assets and Financial Statements and get different values for Fixed Assets. - You expect that the same values are shown in both reports.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets Work Center-Run the Report Schedule of Fixed Assets-The result shows an amount of XXX- Go to the General Ledger Work Center-Run the report Financial Statements-The value for Fixed Assets is YYY-Cause-The reports select data from different sources.-While the report Financial Statements is selecting data from the consolidation accounts, the report Schedule of Fixed Assets selects the data based on the values in the actual Fixed Assets.-Example:-You purchase and create a new Fixed Asset with a Supplier Invoice. This creates a posting to the respective Consolidation Accounts and will be reflected in the report Financial Statements with value XXX.-Afterwards you deactivate the same Fixed Assset in the Work Center Fixeds Assets. There is no posting created to the respective Consolidation Accounts for this Business Transaction.-The report ﻿Schedule of Fixed Assets ﻿shows the amount of YYY.-Resolution-This is the standard System Behaviour.-In regards to the example above you could either remove the Deactivation Date in the respective Fixed Asset or Scrap it with a Manual Posting.-If you run the Reports afterwards you will get the same value for Fixed Assets in both reports.

Title: Error message: CorrespondenceTransmissionStatusCode does not fit to InitiatorCode, while Migrating E-mail Activities
Content: Symptom-You receive the error message CorrespondenceTransmissionStatusCode does not fit to InitiatorCode while migrating e-mail activities-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list of your project.-Search for Migration of E-mail Activities and open it.-Execute migration step by step for your migration template.-You receive the error message on Simulation step.-Cause-The fields Transmission Status and Sender Type Activity E-mail in the migration template don't have the same status.-Resolution-You have to complete the field Transmission Status accordingly to field Sender Type Activity E-mail-These are the options for field Sender Type Acitivty E-mail-STATUS: SENT - 1 - When the field Sender is an account ID) / 2 ( When the field Sender is an Employee.-STATUS: NOT TRANSMITTED - 147 - When the field Sender is an account ID) / 167 - When the field Sender is an Employee.-E.g: if you have filled the field Sender Type Activity E-mail with status 1, you must complete the field Transmission Status with Sent.

Title: Posted Amount differs From Cost Amount of Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You notice that the cost amount of a Service Confirmation AAA and the posted amount in the corresponding Journal Entry BBB are different.-Reproducing the Issue-In the  Field Service and Repair workcenter navigate to the Service Confirmations view.-Find the respective Service Confirmation and open it by clicking on the service confirmation ID.-The cost amount is XX.-Release the corresponding customer invoice request to post the customer invoice.-The invoiced amount corresponds with the amount confirmed in the service confirmation.-The invoice creation also triggered the creation of an internal service confirmation journal entry.-You notice (i.e. in the document flow or a relevant report) that here the posted amount is different to the cost amount displayed in the service confirmation or the billed amount in the customer invoice.  -Cause-Accounting derives the amount to be posted for the internal service confirmation from the Actual Duration as maintained in the service confirmation. If there is a different duration listed than in the quantity column of the service confirmation or the customer invoice then the posted amount will be different.-Resolution-If you do not want these items to be calculated you should leave the Actual Duration and Labor Resource fields empty in the service confirmation document.-To amend the service confirmation-navigate to the Field Service and Repair workcenter and here to the Service Confirmations view.-select the respective service confirmation and press Edit.-In the service confirmation navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the respective item.-Now open the Time Reporting sub-tab.-Here you can maintain (or not maintain) the Actual Duration field as well as the Labor Resource field.-If the service confirmation is already finished you need to cancel it:-Open the service confirmation via Edit.-Go to the General tab and maintain a Reason for Rejection.-Press Save.-If you already released a customer invoice for the service confirmation you need to first cancel the customer invoice before the Reason for Rejection becomes editable.

Title: Filter Materials with one or more Distribution Chains
Content: Symptom-You want to filter in the Products those Materials with one or more active Distribution Chains.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to the Materials view.-Search for Material ABC and select it.-Click on Edit.-Click on View All.-Switch to the Sales tab.-Here you would like to filter or create a report with materials which have one or more active distribution chains.-Resolution- The feature described in this case document is not available in the current release of SAP Business By Design.

Title: Migration Error: "Source data file of Open Items Receivable is not released for import"
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool, the following error message occurs:-Source data file of Open Items Receivable is not released for import-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select your XML file and click Execute Migration - the following error occurs: Source data file of Open Items Receivable is not released for import-Cause- The uploaded file records have not been correctly maintained.-Resolution-Some fields from the migration template have been marked as mandatory and the required information has not been maintained in these fields. Please make sure that you maintained the information in the mandatory fields.

Title: Outgoing Check Memo Line Vanishes While Changing Payment Application Method
Content: Symptom-While creating a New Outgoing Check you enter a text in Memo Line field that will be submitted to the payee on the check. Right after, you change the payment allocation in Payment Application Method area, from Reference to Items to Direct Posting to G/L Account or the opposite and note that the text entered in Memo Line vanished.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center-Select New Outgoing Check under Common Tasks menu-Enter a text in Memo Line field-Under Payment Application Method area, change the payment allocation from the default selection (e.g. from Reference to Items to Direct Posting to G/L Account)-Note that the text you typed in Memo Line vanished-Cause-This is the normal system behavior. It was a development decision to delete all data from Memo Line field when switching the Payment Application Method. The reason for this behavior is that if you pay open items, usually the Memo Line is automatically generated, and hence if the data entered manually are kept while switching the account assignment, the automatic generation will not be done.-Resolution-System behavior is correct. If you enter a text in Memo Line field and then change the account assignment on Payment Application Method, please enter the text again.

Title: Dunning Run Creates Dunning Proposals For Customers With Dunning Block
Content: Symptom-You have set a dunning block for a customer XYZ by setting a dunning block reason and a dunning block expiry date.-After the dunning run is executed you notice that it triggered the creation of dunning proposals for this customer XYZ.-Your expectation is that there will be no dunning proposals created for customers with dunning block.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To set the dunning block-In the Receivables work center, navigate to the Customers view and there to the Customers sub view.-Find customer XYZ and press Edit - Financial Data.-In the Payment Data subtab under Companies set a Dunning Block Reason as well as a Dunning Block Expiry Date for all companies for which the customer's dunning block is valid.- To execute and verify the dunning run-In the Receivables work center, go to Periodic Tasks - Dunning Runs.-Press New-Dunning Run, maintain all mandatory data and the customer ID.-Then press Activate and after press Schedule.-Select Start Immediately and press Save and Close.-Back in the Dunning Run view refresh the screen until the run appears as well as the application log on the bottom of the screen.-Click on the Application Log ID to open it.-Here you notice that for your customer XYZ dunnings have been created.-The dunning proposals are maintained in the Dunning view of the Receivables work center.-Cause-The dunning block functionality still allows the dunning run to create dunning proposals with Dunning Release Status set to Business Partner Blocked. This way the  Execute Dunning button is greyed out for these dunning proposals.-It is, however, possible to unblock dunning proposals and to then execute the dunning if needed for certain cases.-Resolution-If you want to have no dunning proposal, even with blocked execution status, you can create and assign a specific dunning strategy with a payment deadline that is high enough (i.e. 999 days) to not have the dunning run consider open items of customers with dunning block:- Create the Dunning Strategy-In the Business Configuration work center, navigate to the Implementation Projects view, select the current project and open the Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune phase, search for the Dunning Strategies activity and open it.-In the new screen open the Edit Dunning Strategies link.-Click Add Row and maintain a dunning strategy ID as well as a description.-In the General tab enter the dunning currency, the exchange rate and the rate that the calculation is based on.-In the Assigned Business Transactions to Be Dunned tab maintain relevant business transactions, i.e. Invoice.-In the Details section underneath enter a payment deadline that is high enough to not have the dunning run create dunning proposals, i.e. 999 days.-Press Save and Close.-Assign the Dunning Strategy to the Customer-Back in the Dunning Strategies activity select the Assign Dunning Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier link.-In the Customer/Supplier column click on the asterix (*) and maintain your customer XYZ in the Enter Value field.-Press OK.-In the Dunning Strategy column select your new dunning strategy.-Now select the row of this new rule and move it above all the rules for companies that customer XYZ is assigned to by pressing on the arrow pointing upwards.-This way the dunning run will find the new rule before the general rule for the assigned companies in order to not have dunning proposals created for customer XYZ.-Keywords-dunning; dunning block; dunning strategy

Title: Exchange Rate for XYZ for Rate Type Default Exchange Rate Type already exists for Date Time MM-DD-YYYY XX:XX:XX
Content: Symptom-You attempt to upload exchange rates from Microsoft Excel® and receive the error message Exchange Rate for XYZ for Rate Type Default Exchange Rate Type already exists for Date Time MM-DD-YYYY XX:XX:XX-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to General Ledger Work Center.-2. Go to Common Tasks > Edit Exchange Rates.-3. Click on Import button and select From Microsoft Excel® option.-4. Add the Valid From MM-DD-YYYY XX:XX:XX and try to upload.-5. System shows up the error saying Exchange Rate for XYZ for Rate Type Default Exchange Rate Type already exists for Date Time MM-DD-YYYY XX:XX:XX-Cause-Internally the exchange rate data is stored in UTC time zone in order to support the business of companies operating world wide.--The User Interface (UI) takes the time zone settings of the tenant and the personal settings of the user into account.--Example: In UTC time stamp is 01.05.2014 00:00-The UI will display 01.05.2014 00:00 as 30.04.2014 7 00 PM for time zone EST (example).--The Excel framework used for the exchange rate upload is not enabled to support time zones. This is not directly possible in Excel - Excel has no data formats/native support for this. Any date or time entered is considered as UTC time zone, as there is no time zone column in the excel sheet.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, our recommendation is to assign UTC as time zone for users working on exchange rates and handle exchange rates in UTC time zone always.

Title: No Open Items for Tax Payment

Go to the Tax Management workcenter.-2.   Go to Tax Payments View.-3.   Show All Tax Payments and select your reference ID.-4.   Here is possible see the field Ext Ref ID with the payment ID.-5.   Select the Tax Payment ID and click on View button.-6.   You will find the details of this tax payment.

Title: Migration Error: "ISO codes for start date and time not valid"
Content: Symptom-When performing the migration of customer contracts, the below error message occurs:-“ISO codes for the start date and time are not valid.”-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for and open the Migration of Customer Contracts activity.-Click Migrate Customer Contracts Using the Migration Tool.-Select the XML file.-Click on Execute Migration and select the Execute Migration Step-by-Step option.-During the Simulate Import step, the below error occurs:-“ISO codes for start date and time not valid.”-Cause-When validating the file in the migration tool, the date values are not maintained in the required format. The valid ISO date format is YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z. However, even after entering the dates in the correct format, the values revert to the previously incorrect format when the file is uploaded to the migration tool.-Resolution-The Contract End Date for one or more contracts has been maintained in an invalid ISO date format. The date must be entered in the format YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z.-If the month or day contains a single digit, a leading zero must be added. For example, 1 March YYYY must be entered as YYYY-03-01T00:00:00Z instead of YYYY-3-1T00:00:00Z.-Keywords-Migration, Start Date, End Date, Error, ISO Format, Invalid, Time, Contract End Date, Data Validation, Customer Contract

Title: You dont want to use the next check number from the check lot when creating a New Outgoing Check
Content: Symptom-You dont want to use the next check number from the check lot when creating a New Outgoing Check-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Liquidity Management work center.-2. Go to Master Data view.-3. Click on the My Banks subview.-4. Select your active Bank and click  Edit and select Bank Accounts.-5. In the new window, select the particular Bank Accounts and navigate to the detail tab Check Lot.-Here you can see the check lot and the next check number XYZ which will be used. Now you dont want to use this check number XYZ anymore.-Cause-In some cases the check form becomes unusable before the check was created and in that case the check Id should be removed from the check lot.-Resolution-This is rectified by using the Void Unused Check action.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Master Data view.-Click on the My Banks subview.-Select your active Bank and click Edit and select the Bank Accounts.-In the new window, select the particular Bank Accounts and navigate to the detail tab Check Lot.-Select the check lot and press the Void Unused Check button.-On the pop up screen you enter the check number which you want to void, date of void and the reason for which you are voiding.-This will help you to skip this check number and the next check created will be with the next consecutive number.

Title: Higher Level Manager Showing Instead of Actual Manager
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the system is displaying a higher level manager instead of actual manager for Employees-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Personnel Administration-View Employees-Find ABCD-You will see that the Manager displaying is incorrect-Resolution-In Organizational Management, a reporting line unit represents an org unit that has personnel responsibility within the reporting line. If a manager is assigned to the reporting line unit, all employees on the org unit and below it report to that manager.-One should flag the org unit as a reporting line unit if one wants a manager of the org unit to be a personnel manager. A personnel manager is responsible for employees’ work center assignments, personnel-related tasks, and purchasing approvals.-If no manager is assigned to a reporting line unit, the manager assigned to the next reporting line unit above it in the org structure takes on the responsibilities of the personnel manager.-If one wants to find the Org Unit Manager, follow the below steps:-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Select Employees view-Search the Employee ABCD-Select the link ABCD-Select the link ABCD on upper left corner of the screen-Select Show Employee in Organization Chart link under Organizational Data section-Here, you can find the respective Line manager and Reporting line manager.-**ABCD here refers to an employee for which one wishes to  see the manager.

Title: Missing value conversion "CHARGE"
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate materials using the migration tool, the migration fails with the following error message:-"Sales organization ABC (Service) does not exist".-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the desired project and click Open Activity List.-Select the tab All.-Find and open the activity Migration of Materials.-Click the hyperlink Migrate materials using the migration tool-Click Execute Migration - Execute Migration step by Step.-It can be seen in step 2: Convert Values that the task Edit Value Conversion for Identified Stock Type requires action - click to open the task => the value needs to be confirmed - open the value help in the Identified Stock Type field - only the value 01 - Batch is available.-Close the task processing and go to step 3 Simulate Import - following error occurs:-Error detected in source record with key value XYZ. Click Edit Source Record => an error appears:--Sales organization XYZ (Service) does not exist.-Cause-The cause for the error is that the Base UoM from the General sheet differs from the one in the Purchasing sheet. The Quantity Conversion is mainly to convert the Base UoM to other Uom but here there is no relation between Base UoM and Quantity Conversion.-Resolution-You have to rectify the difference between the 2 values of the Base UoM and repeat the simulation.

Title: Service Agents set to Obsolete Are Still Appearing in the Org Unit View
Content: Symptom-You have observed that service agents which have been set to obsolete in Business Partner Data work center are still appearing in the user interface.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Service Agents view.-Choose the relevant Service Agent.-Click on Change Status button and select Obsolete.-The Service Agents status now changes into Obsolete.- Checking the Service Agent in the Org Unit view.-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Go to the Org Unit the Service Agent which you have set to status Obsolete is in.-Navigate to tab Employees-Here the Service Agent set to Obsolete is still visible.-Cause-Changing the status of the Service Agent will not end the validity of the Service Agent in the respective Org Unit.-Resolution-If your requirement is to end the validity of a particular Service Agent from his/her Org Unit then there are two ways:-Option 1:-1. Edit the Service Agent.-2. In the General tab, remove the Org Unit and the Job-3. Save the Service Agent.- Option 2:-1. Go to Organizational management work center.-2. Edit-3. Highlight the Org Unit where the Service Agent belongs to-4. Go to Employees tab.-5. Highlight the Service Agent.-6. Select End Employee Assignment-7. Save and activate the Org Unit.-See Also- 1961501 - Employee Type is Displaying as Service Agent for the Internal Employees

Title: How Many Contacts can be added to a Single Account?
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of adding Contacts to the Accounts and would like to know the maximum limit for Contacts in a single Account?-Resolution-There is no specification for this. You can have max. 200 contacts for an account, with more there will be a performance issue.-Q: How many Contacts that can be used in a Migration template (Customers)?--A: You can have a maximum of 20,000 Contacts.

Title: The following error message is Triggered : "No ID mapping found for Business Partner XYZ"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The following error message is triggered : No ID mapping found for Business Partner XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the view Business Monitoring Communication.-You will see that a message with the following error : No ID mapping found for Business Partner XYZ.-Cause-ID mapping errors can occur only within inbound processing in C4C. Missing ID mapping is accepted in outbound communication since we allow that customers use ID mapping also on their On Premise Systems. During inbound communication you receive an error like: “No ID mapping found for Business Partner 4711” or “Object Reference is unknown….”-Resolution-Ideally ID mapping in C4C should be generated automatically during regular or initial replication of the master data objects. ID mapping is later on used for transactional processes like Opportunity replication. In case you receive an ID mapping error during a transactional replication, the root cause is most probably that the master data replication had already an error.-Ask the customer to check why the original integration of the particular master data object failed.-Try to replicate it again from the On Premise System. In case this fails, analyze the issues and solve them. Finally you can restart the failed message – or trigger the transactional replication (e.g. the Opportunity) from the On Premise System.
