Title: Within the Message Monitor you See Many Messages with Status "Wait for Scheduler“.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Within the message monitor you see many messages with status : "Wait for Scheduler".-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the view Business Monitoring Communication.-You will see many messages with status Wait for Scheduler.-Cause-This can happen easily during an initial load, where thousands of messages must be processed in short time.-Resolution-To avoid bottlenecks in such a phase it is important to use the queues very efficiently:-Avoid inbound errors which go into retry mode (e.g. missing references)-Use the bulk interfaces-Load the data in packages in not everything at the same time-In case this doesn’t help you should contact basis administration for sizing/hardware. Please forward this problem directly to hosting colleagues.-

Title: Unable to Renew Soon Expiring Purchasing Contract due to Missing Negotiate Button
Content: Symptom-You are unable to renegotiate the soon expiring purchasing contract because of missing Negotiate button.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Select the task with subject: Check Expired Purchasing Contract XYZ.-Select Edit.-The contract opens in the new screen but the Negotiate button is missing.-Cause-Once the contract is negotiated, a sourcing request is created. But Sourcing Requests option is not selected in scoping, so the Negotiate button is missing in the contract.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center .-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select All Current Projects Query in the Show field.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Guided activity step 3 Scoping.-Go to Scoping step and then select the arrow beside Sourcing.-Select the arrow beside Sourcing and Contracting.-Select the checkbox beside Sourcing Requests.-Select Next until Finish button gets enabled.-Select Finish.-Once the above mentioned steps are performed you will be able to see the Negotiate button in the relevant contract.

Title: Payment Proposal Remains In Preparation Status Even Supplier Invoice Is Canceled
Content: Symptom-After you cancel a supplier invoice, you find that the payment proposal remains in the list of Payments in Preparation.-Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce the issue with following steps:-Payment proposal is created per automatic payment run for a supplier invoice.-Cancel the invoice. But the payment proposal still remains in the list of Payments in Preparation.-Go to Payables work center and Automatic Payments view, you can see it.-Cause-Payment created before invoice cancelation will not be voided automatically.-But even we execute payment for such payment proposal, system will block the payment.-Resolution-You can manually void such payment proposal.-Go to Payables work center and Automatic Payment view.-Select the payment proposal and select Void Proposal.

Title: How to find the CSS Component responsible for a Business Object
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Quick guide on how to find the development Component responsible for a Business Object (BO).-Reproducing the Issue-You would need to find out the responsible component for a Business Object.-Resolution-Log in to the backend of a system of the product and version you are referring to;-Enter the transaction MDRS (Metadata Repository).-Make sure that the selection on the drop box is Business Object as on the image above.-You may have the Business Object's ID or Name. If you have the ID, input it directly on the field and press Enter (then jump to the third screenshot of the document).-If you have the Name of the BO, click on the black downwards arrow on the right side of the input field. That will pop-up the BO search.-With the pop-up open, look for the second field called ES Name.-Input the BO name and remember: The field is case sensitive and there are no spaces between words. Tip: Use wildcards such as * to help you with your search.-E.g.: See the below screenshot, where I search for the BO SalesOrder(SALES_ORDER).-Double-click the row which has the Business Object you need.-Double-click now on the name of the BO, that appeared on the left menu, so the Overview will open as below.-Now, scroll down the overview until you find the field Package, under General Data.-Double-click the package.-The Component will be available as shown on the last screenshot below, as it was marked in yellow.

Title: Migrated Employee neither Visible in Personnel Administration nor in Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-In the Business Configuration work center, you migrate basic employee data such as biographical data, private contact data and bank details to the system using migration tool. Then you go to the Personnel Administration work center, but you cannot see the newly uploaded employee in the list. You also find that those employees are not visible to choose when you try to assign them as Org Unit Manager.   -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project, and choose Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Under the Activity Group: Maintain Master Data, choose the Migration of Employee Data activity.-Choose Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.-Upload the source employee data file, and then choose Execute Migration.-Go to the Personnel Administration work center and choose the Employees view.-You cannot find the uploaded employees in the Employees list.-Cause-As you set Personnel Administration in scope, so in order to make the migrated employees visible in the Personnel Administration work center, you have to migrate personnel administration data as well as basic data.  If you only migrate basic employee data, you cannot see these employees in the Personnel Administration work center. Meanwhile, because the Work Agreements information, such as Organizational Assignment, is not uploaded, you cannot see the employees when assigning an Org Unit Manager either.-Resolution-You can migrate the personnel administration data of employees as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project, and choose Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Under the Activity Group: Maintain Master Data, choose the Migration of Employee Data activity.-Choose Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool.-Make sure all the mandatory fields are entered in the template.-After the successful migration, you should be able to see these employees in the Personnel Administration work center.

Title: Difference of Total Tax Amount Between VAT Return and VAT / Sales Tax Calculation – Details Report
Content: Symptom-The total tax amount in the VAT Return differs from the tax amount shown in the VAT/Sales Tax Calculation – Details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Tax Management work center.-2. Select the VAT Returns view.-3. Select the option Tax Returns In Preparation in the Show field and click on the Go button.-4. Select the desired Tax Return ID and click on the View button and go to Overview tab. Check the Total Tax Amount, and note down this figure.-5. Go to the Tax Management work center.-6. Select the Reports Lists View.-7. Select the Report VAT / Sales Tax Calculation – Details report and compare the Posted Tax Amount with the previously noted Total Tax Amount. The amounts are different.-Cause-The difference in the total tax amount between the VAT/Sales Tax Calculation – Details report and the VAT Return is due to the corresponding clearing documents. The VAT Return was created before these clearing documents were created. Therefore, these documents were not included in the VAT Return.-Resolution-If the existing VAT Return is deleted and the VAT Run is scheduled again for the same period, these documents will be picked up, and there should be no difference in the Total Tax Amount between the VAT Return and the VAT/Sales Tax Calculation – Details Report.-Keywords-VAT Return, VAT Run, Clearing Documents, Total Tax Amount, VAT/Sales Tax Calculation – Details Report, Same Period, Tax Amount Difference, VAT Calculation.

Title: Standard Bank Statement Format MT940 for UK
Content: Symptom-You attempt to upload a bank statement with a format differing from the pre-configured format MT940 UK in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Access the Bank Statements view.                        -Click on the New button.-Choose Bank Statement upload option.-The singly option for for Import Format here is 'MT940 UK'.-Cause-This is a system definition.-There are many variations of the format MT940 for the UK. However, the single supported format is the standard MT940 UK as delivered in the system.

Title: Different Amounts for Same Document from Different Work Centers
Content: Symptom-The same document is opened from Tax Management and General Ledger work centers, but different amounts are displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-From Tax Management:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select the Tax Return view.-Select the VAT Return subview.-Select the relevant VAT return and choose Tax Event.-Click on Details.-The document shows a Tax Base Amount in Company Currency of XXX.-From General Ledger:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Journal Entries view.-Find the relevant journal entry for the same document.-The Debit in Company Currency is different from XXX.-Cause-The currency conversion performed by the tax engine differs from the currency conversion used in accounting because different currency conversion settings are maintained.-Tax Management settings:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Find activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Open the activity and select Currency Conversion Types.-Check the maintained Exchange Rate Type and Conversion Type for the relevant document.-Journal Entry settings:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Find Activity Set of Books.-Edit the relevant Set of Book and go to Company Settings tab.-Note the Currency Conversion Profile-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Find activity Currency Conversion Profiles.-Choose the Currency Conversion Profile noted in Step 5.-Under Details: Currency Conv. - Bid/Mid/Ask Rates, different Exchange Rate Types and Conversion Types are maintained for the same document.-Resolution-For solving the apparent issue that the tax base amount in tax returns is different from the amount in journal entries, the following steps need to be performed:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Find Activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Select Currency Conversion Types.-Maintain the same entries as maintained for Journal Entry settings under Currency Conversion Profile activity.-Cancel the affected documents and post the new document.-Note: The Reverse and Repost option does not resolve this issue because the affected items are already recorded in the tax register and are not recalculated through Reverse and Repost.-Keywords-Tax Base Amount, Journal Entry Amount, Tax Return, Tax Management, General Ledger, Currency Conversion, Currency Conversion Types, Currency Conversion Profile, Exchange Rate Type, Conversion Type, Tax Register, Tax on Goods and Services, Cancel Document, Repost Document, Reverse and Repost, Company Currency, VAT Return.

Title: User ABC has no access to the Document XYZ
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User ABC has no access to the Document XYZ-Resolution-1)      Retrieve the business object for the Document XYZ-2)      In the test shell go to the Node > ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST  > ENTRY-3)      Write down the UUID in the column :  ACCESS_GROUPING_OBJECT_UUID-CONTENT for each row-UUID 1-UUID 2-4)      Go to the BO IDENTITY in the test shell-5)      Select the user ABC-6)      Go to the Node Role Assignment > Select the relevant role assignment for the DOCUMENT XYZ > Select the Node ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_RESTRICT-7)      Write down the UUID in the column :  ACCESS_GROUPING_OBJECT_UUID-CONTENT for each row-UUID 3-UUID 4-  User ABC would be able to see Document XYZ if and only if (UUID 1 = UUID 3 or UUID 4) OR (UUID 2 = UUID 3 or UUID 4).-If this is not the case, then you need to check, if UUID 3 and UUID 4 might be parents of UUID 1 and/or UUID 2. This only holds if they are either for OrgCentres or Territories. You might check this by going to SESFTS-a)      For OrgCentres, BO /MOM/ORG_CENTRE, open folder icon, Load by NodeID -> Root, enter the UUID 1 and UUID 2, mark the records and navigate via UPPER_ORG_CENTRE_REL and UPPER_ORG_CENTRE. An Alternative is to retieve the OrgCenters for all UUIDs and then check in the UI (WoCView General Settings in WoC Administrator)-b)      For Territories, BO SALES_TERRITORY, open folder icon, Load by NodeID -> Root, enter the UUID 1 and UUID 2, mark the records and navigate via PARENT_TERRITORY. An Alternative is to retieve the Territories for all UUIDs and then check in the UI (WoCView General Settings in WoC Administrator)-

Title: Not Able to Use Same Tax Exemption Certificate
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add an already existing Tax Exemption Certificates in a Corporate Account, system shows the message: Instance with the same key already exists.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Search for the account.-Click on Edit > Financial Data button.-Go to Tax Exemption Tab.-You attempt to add a new row with an existing Tax Exemption Certificate ID and system throws the error:-Instance with the same key already exists.-Cause-The system won't allow to create another certificate with the same Tax Exemption Certificate ID. It is also is not possible to delete a void certificate from the system. This is the expected behavior.-Resolution-It is not possible to create another certificate with same Tax Exemption Certificate ID. Neither is it feasible  to perform this from the backend of the system.-An alternative would be the field External ID in General tab which is enabled when you create a new certificate. This field is editable only when the certificate is in Preparation status (before making it active).

Title: Migrated Accounting Transaction Data is Missing in Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have successfully migrated Accounting transaction data, ie Open Items Payables or Open Items Receivables.-In the General Ledger you can find all the respective Journal entries of type 0079-Data Migration.-But when trying to verify the migrated data in a report, ie G/L Accounts - Line Items none of the migration postings are displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-You successfully migrated Accounting Transaction Data.-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Journal Entries view.-Open the Advanced Search and filter for Journal Entry Type 0079-Data Migration.-The Journal Entries created via the data migration are all displayed here.-In the General Ledger workcenter navigate to the Reports view and open the G/L Accounts -  Line Items report. -Maintain the posting date of the data migration.-There is no data migration posting displayed here.-Cause-If you have verified that the data migration was successful and the system created journal entries then an FSI reload of the Accouting documents is necessary.-Resolution-Forward the incident to ES Cross - FSI and ask the colleagues to reload the following FSI views:-FSI View: FSP_FIN_ACC_DOC_AEO-BO: FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT_AEO - Root-FSI View: FIASV_ACCDOC_ITEM-BO: FIA_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT - Item-FSI View: FSP_FIN_ACCDOC_ITEM-BO: FIA_ACCDOC_SLAOFF_AT_AEO - Item-After the reload verify that the data is displayed in the respective report.-

Title: Value Difference Between Aging List for Receivables Report and Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-You run the reports Aging List for Receivables (Report ID FINDUEU04_Q0008) and Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance (Report ID FINGLAU07_Q0001) for the same selection criteria and observe a value difference.-The value in the Aging List for Receivables report is decimal number, while in the Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance report, there is only integer, which causes the value difference.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center and select the Reports view.-Select the List sub view.-Open the Aging List for Receivables report.-In the selection criteria, set Today as Cut Off Date, and choose the required Display Currency.-Click Go.-In the result, check the Outstanding Amount, and you can see the value is decimal number. -Then:-Go to General Ledger work center and select the Reports view.-Select the List sub view.-Open Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance report.-In the selection criteria, set Year to Date as Accounting Period/Year, and also set the same currency as that in the Aging List for Receivables report.-In the result, check the Ending balance, and you can see the value is integer.-You can see the total has value difference with the Outstanding Amount in Aging List for Receivables report, which is caused by the decimal part in the decimal number.-Cause-In the Aging List for Receivables report you set two decimal places for the key figures, and this is why the value is displayed as decimal number.-Resolution-In order to get the value in the Aging List for Receivables report as integer, follow the steps below:-Open the Aging List for Receivables report and go to Settings.-Select Key Figures.-In the Key Figure Settings, go to the Specific tab.-For all Key Figures, set the Decimal Places as 0. -Press OK.-Then all the key figures are displayed as integers.-Keywords-Aging List for Receivables, FINDUEU04_Q0008, Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance, FINGLAU07_Q0001, decimal places, integer, key figure

Title: IBAN Field is Missing in the Migration Template for Personnel Administration Data
Content: Symptom-You are migrating the Personnel Administration Data of Employees using the migration activity Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool, but there is no column for IBAN. You also observed that the IBAN field is available in the migration Basic Employee Data template.-What is the reason for this difference?-Resolution-There are two steps for migrating employee data :-1. Migrate Basic Employee Data-2. Migrate Personnel Admin Data--The first step (basic employee data) migrates employee specific data e.g--Personal Data--Private contact data--Bank data--The second step (personnel admin data) is for migrating additional information e.g. Organizational assignment of employees.--In Personnel Administration date migration , you can again give bank id but not all the fields as in the basic step. This is to further identify the main bank of employee out of the different banks already migrated in the first step. The main bank is used for renumeration purposes in further business processes.--If you only enter one bank account per employee (during basic data migration) , it will automatically be used as the default account for payments. In this case, you do not need to migrate information indicating the default bank account during migration of personnel-administration data.

Title: Why the Changes to the Business Partner is Reflecting in all its Business Partner Roles?
Content: Symptom-You have made a change to a Business Partner in Business Partner Data work center or changes to a Business Partner Role in one of the work center but the changes are reflecting in other work centers where the same Business Partner Role exists. Your requirement is that, you wants to see the changes only in that specific work center and no where else.-Resolution-Any changes that is being performed in the Business Partners will always reflect in the respective roles of other work centers. The reason being, the Business Partner is so called the Business Partner template and all the roles are basically the part of it. Secondly, the screen that you access in the Business Partner Data work center is actually the master work center and any views related to this which you are accessing in other work centers is actually the same (copy of this).--This is expected system behavior.--For example: The Contacts view in Account Management work center is one and the same as the Contacts view in the Business Partner data work center.

Title: Is it Possible to Search for Swift/BIC in the Bank Field of Payment Information in the Personnel File of an Employee?
Content: Symptom-You would like to whether it is possible to search for Swift/BIC in the Bank field of Payment Information in the Personnel File of an Employee? because many banks have the same name as well as the same bank code. These banks can only be distinguished via the BIC. But the system doesn't support the search for the Swift/BIC in the Bank field. you need to find out the given number of the Bank in the bank directory.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Edit an Employee and go to Personal Data and sub tab Payment Information.-Input the BIC in the Bank field but the respective Bank is not fetching.-Resolution-The feature described is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-In the meantime, below workaround can be considered. You can make use of the SWIFT/BIC column in the value Selection of Bank to select the correct bank. As of now, it is not possible to include it in search parameters.--The steps are,--1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Edit the Employee through Employees view.-3. Go to Payment Information sub tab of Personal Data tab.-4. Select the Value Selection for Bank.-5. Select Personalize icon to include the SWIFT/BIC in the table, using which you select a correct Bank.

Title: Mass Change of Material Master Data
Content: Symptom-You want to perform a mass change of materials in master data.-Reproducing the Issue-A big amount of materials has wrong data, for example due to incorrect migration.-Cause-For example incorrect data was migrated using Excel.-Resolution-To rectify the issue. Please follow the below steps to change for example fields Identified Stock Type and Serial Number Profile:-Go to Product Data work center-Select Materials view-Select the required materials-Select Mass Change button-Select Show and General-Here you can provide the new values for the above mentioned fields in default row-Select Apply Mass Change button and all Items-Select Save and Close button-

Title: Approver Is Missing for Time Records of Projects
Content: Symptom-Approver is missing for time records of projects even there is reponsible person assigned for the projects.-Reproducing the Issue-Employee inputs the time records for projects and saves it. But the Approver is missing.-Cause-The reason is that such time recordings are in status of Inactive, which means that the employee has not released them for approval.--Resolution-Employee needs to release the time records in work center Home and select Edit Time Sheet in view Self -Service, then there are approvers because approval determination should happen when time sheet is released by an employee.

Title: Variable 'VAT / Sales Tax Percent' in Report 'Accounts Receivable - Line Items' Shows as 0.000000
Content: Symptom-In the report Accounts Receivable - Line Items you are selecting an account with account movements and vat-relevant customer invoices. However, in the column VAT / Sales Tax Percent the value 0.000000 is shown for all relevant positions. Moreover, other related variables e.g.: VAT / Sales Tax Rate Type, VAT / Sales Tax Rate Type, VAT / Sales Tax Country, VAT / Sales Tax Due Category - are shown as Not assigned. - Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Navigate to view Reports / List.-Choose the report Accounts Receivable - Line Items.-As Customer select an account with vat-relevant invoices and press Go.-Drag the variable VAT / Sales Tax Percent into the report / rows.-Cause-This is a system definition. For this Accounts Receivable -Line Items report, attributes of the offsetting items (credit) are only shown in certain cases.-The mentioned tax relevant categories are filled, for example, in case of VAT-relevant down payments for customer accounts.-For an illustration, please refer to the below screenshot taken from the report Accounts Receivable - Line Items in the case of applied down payments. -

Title: Error Check XYZ Already Exists in the System When Posting New Incoming Check Even Check XYZ Was Canceled
Content: Symptom-Incoming check XYZ is canceled, but when you create a new one with the same check ID, the system gives error message: Check XYZ already exists in the system.--Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce the issue with following steps:-Go to work center Liquidity Management and select common task New Incoming Check.-Input the same thing as check XYZ, which is already canceled.-Select Post, then you get the error.--Cause-System does not allow you to create a new check with the same ID and same posting date as the one you already cancel.-Resolution-You can create a new incoming check with the same check ID, but select another posting date.

Title: Rejected Time Sheet Entries Cannot Be Deleted
Content: Symptom-The timesheet entries that are rejected from the approver cannot be deleted by the employee ABC for a project XYZ because of the Delete button is in greyed out mode.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Choose Self-Services Overview view.-Choose the link Edit Time Sheet.-The time sheet screen opens and here when the employee ABC tries to delete the rejected hours from the Time Sheet for the project XYZ, the Delete button is in grayed out mode.--Cause-The cause for the issue is the project XYZ is in Closed Status and it is not possible to delete those time entries recorded against the project by the employee ABC hence the Delete button is in greyed out.-Resolution-This is the standard system behaviour.-There are two possible ways if you wish to delete those rejected time hours, and they are-The Administrator can delete the Rejected hours from the Employee Time Sheet via Time Administration work center or-Can revoke the project status back to Release status then the system enables the delete button and the employee can delete the rejected hours from the time sheet.-The steps to revoke the project status back to release status are as follows-Navigate to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects View.-Select Projects sub view.-Choose Project XYZ .-Choose Edit button and click on Project Plan Button.-Go to Basic Data tab.-Go to Project Status value help select Revoke Closure and Revoke Completion.-Click on Save ﻿button.----

Title: How to Handle Open Tasks to Enter Cost Rates for Resource ABC Valid on YYYY.MM.DD in Cost and Revenue Work Center
Content: Symptom-You get some tasks to enter cost rate for resource ABC valid on YYYY.MM.DD in Cost and Revenue work center and Work view.-You want to know why there are the tasks and how to handle them.-Reproducing the Issue-You can see the tasks with following steps:-Go to work center Cost and Revenue-Select view Work, then you can see the tasks.-Cause-There are some projects in the system with start date being YYYY.MM.DD. And the resources mentioned in these tasks are used in those projects.-System is unable to calculate planned costs as the valid from date of resource is after YYYY.MM.DD. So system generates such tasks.-Resolution-If you check and find that the related projects are closed and you do not want to change the project any more, you can just close these tasks by selecing Actions and then Complete in the Cost and Revenue work center.-You can also edit the start dates of the mentioned projects so that they start on or after the valid from date of the resources used.-A third option would be to edit the valid from dates of the resource cost rates so that they start on/before the start dates of the related projects.-Please see which option suits you the best, and proceed accordingly.
