Title: System Truncates Leading Zero in Telephone Number Maintained in Org Unit
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a Phone Number in the Address of a particular Org Unit but after saving, the leading zeros are truncated instead country code is added as prefix.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Select Edit Org Structures.-Maintain the telephone number with leading zero(s).-Activate the changes.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-When you enter the Phone number, the country code will be picked based on the country that you selected for the Org Unit.

Title: Cannot Maintain Cyclic Quantity Conversions
Content: Symptom-Error message appears: Conversion between A and B not valid; conversion to B already exists.-Occurs when saving a quantity conversion for a product.-Happens while editing a material in Product Data work center, Materials view, General tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center-Go to Materials view -Edit a material-In General tab, try to maintain quantity conversion-The error message appears: Conversion between A and B not valid; conversion to B already exists-Cause-The system prevents cyclic quantity conversions; if conversions exist between A–B and A–C, a direct B–C conversion is unnecessary and blocked.-Resolution-Review existing quantity conversions for the material.-Identify the redundant conversion that creates a cycle (for example, B–C when A–B and A–C already exist).-Remove the unnecessary conversion.-Save the material.-See Also--Keywords-unit of measure, UoM, circular reference, indirect calculation, transitive mapping, redundancy, consistency check, duplicate entry, master data maintenance, item master, SKU, rate mapping, intermediary unit, prevent loop, validation

Title: Unable to Add Department Name and Company Name to an Employee Using Change Workplace Contact Data
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to add Company Name and Department Name for some the Employees but it is not possible to update using Change Workplace Contact Data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Change Workplace Contact Data link.-Here, the Department Name and Company Name are empty and grayed out.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that you might have manually maintained all the Work Place addresses for the employees during migration as individual addresses but there no company or department is given and hence it is not mainatined and displayed .-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Normally personal addresses is different for each employee and as per workplace addresses only building and room no varies and all other details are same and hence the business residences are referred giving individual room and building details.--As the company name and department name can not be maintained in the migration it is not fetching. You can use the business residence addresses and set other details. If you want to reuse the business residence address click on the value help of company and you can see two entries on selecting any of them you can set the employee addresses based on their business residence location.

Title: Is it Possible to Migrate Employee Tax Informations?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to migration Tax Information (canton of residence, tax liability, work permit...) for the Employees in you system but the there is no worksheet for Tax in the Migration Templates.-Note: This requirement is country specific. For Example: Employees hired for country Swiss.-Reproducing the Issue-Checked in all Migration Templates related to Employee:-Configuration: Migration of Employees-Configuration: Migration of Personnel Administration Data-Configuration: Migration of Time and Labour Management Data-Configuration: Migration of Compensation Data-Configuration: Migration of Payroll Data-Resolution-It is not possible to migrate Tax information of the employees and hence you will have to maintain the tax / insurance data from the personnel file of each employee manually

Title: Is it Possible to Migrate Materials Without Material ID
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating the Material into your Business ByDesign system and would like to have the below questions answered:-Is it possible to migrate Materials without filling the Material ID?-Will the Material ID be generated automatically using the Number Range maintained?- Resolution-Every template must have at least the key information. Otherwise we can’t build the references across the various sheets.-The Material ID from the template is in addition also the new material ID in the Business ByDesign system. There is no internal number that will be assigned. This only is somehow different to others like customers or suppliers.--You have to setup your number range for materials in advance to migration either as numbers or alphanumeric ID. If you populate the migration template you have to give material IDs which are within this number range.--Also keep in mind, that we have successor objects which refer to the material IDs. So, you have to fill the Material ID in the migration Template as per the Number Range defined.--If you have to assign accounts or suppliers you have to provide an ID for them as well. This has to be the old legacy account or supplier ID. In this case, the Convert Values step you can select whether the the old and new (internal) account and supplier id should be selected during the migration of accounts or suppliers.

Title: External Reference Number is Missing in the Preview of Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-When you preview any Customer Invoice Documents, the External Reference Number is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Documents-Preview a Customer Invoice.-Resolution-The SAP standard customer invoice forms do not include the External Reference by default. If required you would need to add it by you.-Note:--You can either make the changes in the existing Form.-OR--Create your own form, copying the existing form and make the required changes (As feasible for you).-You need to maintain the binding path in the form, as below:-Step 1: -Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Form Template Maintenance view and select the Customer Invoice form.-Open with Easy Form Editor and select and add the field. i.e.Field Name: CustomerInvoice-ReferenceBusinessTransactionDocumentID.-Save it and later Publish and Close.-Step 2:-After completing Step 1, again select the Form and Open it in LifeCycle Designer.-Select the field which you added in Easy Form Editor as mentioned in Step 1.-You can change the Name (for eg: to External Reference).-Once done, you need to maintain the binding with value(Binding path is) :-$.CustomerInvoice.ReferenceBusinessTransactionDocumentID.-Publish the Form Template.-Now, External Reference should be visible in the Invoice Document form preview.

Title: Sales Organization Missing in Sales tab of Materials and Services
Content: Symptom-You are not able to assign Sales Organization(s) to Materials and Services since the Sales organization(s) is missing in the value help.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view or Service view-Search and Edit (View All) the Material ﻿or ﻿Service-Go to Sales tab.-Select the value help to Sales Organization-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Sales organization property of the Org Units were delimited to a particular date (mostly the date could be past date). Hence, the Org Units are not available in the values of Sales Organization in Materials and Services.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-You can verify this in Timelines tab of respective Org Unit in Organizational management work center.

Title: Preview of Statutory Report Journal Entry Voucher - China Shows Part of Running Result
Content: Symptom-The preview of statutory report Journal Entry Voucher - China shows part of the run result. Furthermore, it shows different result when you preview.-Reproducing the Issue-You can reproduce the issue with following steps:-Go to work center General Ledger and view Periodic Tasks.-Go to subview Statutory Report and select Journal Entry Voucher - China.-Select any run, and select Next, you can see there are a lot of entries in the running result.-Select Preview, only part of the running result shows in the preview PDF file.-Select Preview again, it shows only part of the result again, but different than last time.-Cause-Please note that when there is lot of data, all the data doesn't come into one pdf file. The data is divided into multiple packages, and data of those packages are printed on multiple PDF files. The preview shows records from one of those packages, and hence each time different records are shown.-Resolution-You can view the PDF files by selecting View Printed Results button of the run after you release the run to get all data.-And if there is not that big data volume of the run, the data will be collected into one package, then the preview shows all data.

Title: On Uploading Bank Directory File of Format Accuity you are Getting an Error Mssage
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload a Bank Directory File of the Accuity format you get an error message with the description: Upload of Mime Type application/octet-stream is not permitted.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Master Data and choose the sub view Bank Directory.-Choose New and select Bank Directory File Upload. Then a new window will open up.-From the guided-activity step 1 File Details choose the Format as Accuity(ZIP) and give it's Description.-At the bottom of the screen you can observe an error message with the description: Upload of Mime Type application/octet-stream is not permitted.-Cause-While trying to upload a Bank Directory File of Format Accuity (ZIP), you did not use the correct file extension.-Resolution-The Bank Directory File should have the extension as .ZIP, with this file extension you should be able to upload the file.

Title: Manual Journal Entry for Materials Does Not Update inventory Cost
Content: Symptom-A journal entry voucher with type 087 — Manual Entry for Materials and screen variant 630 – Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials does not update the inventory cost of the material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries View.-Go to Journal Entry Voucher sub-view.-Create a New Journal Entry Voucher with type 087 — Manual Entry for Materials.-Select the screen variant as 630 – Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials.-Enter the relevant details and Post the Journal Entry Voucher.-Navigate to Inventory Valuation work center.-The Material Cost is not updated although the cost method of the material is maintained as Moving Average.-Cause-The journal entry voucher has been created with G/L Account of type Purchase Price Difference.-These are differences accounts and therefore by using the Write-up and Write down these accounts will be balanced. This does not update the inventory cost of the material.-Resolution-To update the material cost, it's necessary to post the manual entry to the Inventory G/L accounts and not differences accounts.-These are basically Asset accounts. Posting to these accounts hits the material ledger, and it will be reflected in the Material Cost.-Keywords-journal entry voucher; jev; material cost; Purchase Price Difference; write-up; write-down; Inventory G/L accounts; asset accounts

Title: Address Missing for Migrated Organizational Units
Content: Symptom-You have added few new Org Units using Migration with definitions and Address data filled in the Template. Migration is successful but the address (planning area) is displaying only in the Timelines tab and in address tab it is empty.-When checking the consistency, system throws below error message:--Address incomplete; complete all mandatory fields for org unit XYZ--DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; main address must be specified for org unit XYZ-Reproducing the Issue-Migrate the Organizational Units through Migration with Address.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Address and Timelines tab of the migrated Org Units.-Cause-The reason that the Address is not visible in the Address tab of the Org Unit is that the Address is not marked as Main Address in the Address tab of the Migration Template.-Resolution-If you wants to have the Address in the Address then mark "X" in the Main Address Column for the respective address in Address tab of the Migration Template.

Title: Cost Center is Not Displayed When Making a Direct Posting to G/L Account of a Payment
Content: Symptom-You open the Set Default Account Assignments for G/L Account Determination Group, for a G/L Account Determination Group, you assign it with a Cost Center. When creating an outgoing bank transfer, you make a Direct Posting to G/L Account. But after you select the G/L Account Determination Group, the Cost Center is not automatically displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-First of all, Set Defaults for G/L Account Determination Groups:-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Master Data view.-select the Companies subview.-For the concerned company, and choose Set Defaults for G/L Account Determination Groups under Actions.-Add a new row.-Select a G/L Account Determination Group, and specify a Cost Center ID.-Enter other information like Valid From and Valid To dates.-Save it.-Then follow the steps below to create an outgoing payment:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Under Common Tasks, choose New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Enter all the relevant information.-Select the radio button of Direct Posting to G/L Account.-Add a row.-Select the G/L Account Determination Group in question.-You could see that the Cost Center field is not automatically filled, also in the journal entry of the payment, the Cost Center is not displayed in the line item.-Cause-When you Set Defaults for G/L Account Determination Groups,there is Valid From date for this assignment, as it's later than the posting date of the outgoing payment, so the cost center assignment is not available by the time you post the outgoing bank transfer.-Resolution-If you want to post the outgoing bank transfer in the current date, you should change the Valid From date of the Default Account Assignment for the G/L Account Determination Group, and make it before the current date, in this case, you should be able to see the cost center when you do the posting, also the cost center should be showing up in the journal entry line item.

Title: Error Message "Save canceled due to invalid data, Save failed"
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate the Organizational Structure, system throws below error message-Save canceled due to invalid data, Save failed-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Highlight the Org Unit-G o to Definitions tab.-Maintain: UID Appendix: MWST - Sales Tax Register-Select Save (save not problem).-Select Activate - Activate Selected Structure-Cause-The cause for the issue is the tax number maintained in the tax authority is different. The tax number maintained in the tax authority and the org center should be the same.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, follow the below steps:--1. Go to Tax Management work center.-2. Select Company Tax arrangements view.-3. Select company ID: XYZ and Edit-4. Go to Company Tax Arrangements view.-5. Select company XYZ. Note the tax numbers maintained already for VAT.-6. Remove it.-7. Add the company XYZ again-8. The UUID maintained in the org center would be updated automatically.--If needed, also add the VAT number. Now activate the Org Structure.

Title: Wrong Form Template Determined For Purchase Order (Not According to Sender's Country)
Content: Symptom-The system determines an unexpected form template when previewing the Purchase Order, instead of selecting the template based on the sender’s country and the receiver’s language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant purchase order.-Choose Edit button.-Choose the Preview button in the edit purchase order screen.-Select the option Created Purchase Order.-The Purchase Order preview displays a different form template than expected.-Cause-The system determines the Purchase Order form template based on the Country of Registration of the Company selected in the Purchase Order document.-If this country differs from the country maintained in the company’s address, the system will still use the template variant that corresponds to the company’s registration country.-To check the company’s registration country:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view.-Select the relevant Company.-Open the Definitions tab.-Under Legal Definitions, view the Country/Region of Registration field.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Created Purchase Order; Country of Registration; Company; Purchase Order Template; Form Template

Title: Cannot Post In Preparation Bank Statement to Accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You cannot post an uploaded bank statement which is still In Preparation to accounting, the system gives error message:' Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting'.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Bank Statements view.-Show All Bank Statements, and find Bank Statement in question.-View the bank statement.-You can see that the status is still In Preparation.-Navigate to the Posting Date field, you can see that it's read-only.-Also at the bottom of the screen, you can see there is an error message: Period within closing phase; manual maintenance required by accounting.-Resolution-As the Posting Date of the Bank Statement cannot be changed, also your business does not allow you to re-open the closed period to post the concerned bank statement, so you hope SAP can post the bank statement to a different period in the backend, but it is not possible to change the posting date for the uploaded bank statement.-In order to post the items contained in the bank statement, follow the steps below:-First of all, take a note of the items contained in the concerned Bank Statement, and then delete the bank statement.-After that, manually create the bank statement with the related items. -In the manually created bank statement, enter the original Bank Statement Date.-For the Posting Date, specify a desired date or a date that is still open.-Post the bank statement to accounting.-Thus, although you cannot change the Posting Date in the originally uploaded bank statement, you can do this in a newly created manual bank statement.-  Keywords-Bank Statement, Kontoauszug

Title: No Invoices Shown in Dunning Letter for Dunning Level XYZ
Content: Symptom-When previewing a dunning proposal, you notice that no receivable items are displayed in the dunning document for dunning strategy ABC and dunning level XYZ, but merely a request for payment of due items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Select the relevant Dunning Proposal.-Click on Preview and choose Dunning Letter.-In the resulting preview, no grid containing overdue invoices is displayed.-Cause-The root cause is the conflicting definitions for legal effectiveness of dunning documents for dunning strategy ABC and the applied Form Template Selection.-Consequently, instead of the dunning letter containing to-be-dunned items, the template for the reminder letter is drawn.-By definition this template does not contain a list of receivable items to be dunned.-Resolution-Check your definitions concerning the legal effectiveness of dunning steps:-Enter the Business Configuration work center.-Open the activity Dunning Strategies and choose Edit dunning strategies.-Select the relevant Dunning Strategy ABC.-Choose the tab Assigned Business Transactions to Be Dunned.-The column Legally Effective for the relevant Dunning Step and assigned Dunning Level XYZ is checked.-Compare with the settings made for Form Template Selection:-Enter the Application and User Management work center.-Access Form Template Selection in the Input and Output Management view.-In the choose from list Show Rules For, select Dunning Letter.-Observe the definitions and sequence for rules relating to Max Dunning Level XYZ and Dunning Strategy ABC.-Here the Form Template Reminder Letter is maintained before applicable definitions for the Form Template Dunning Letter for Dunning Level XYZ and Dunning Strategy ABC.-Adapt the configuration for Dunning Strategies and the corresponding Form Template Selection in order to effect a consistent printing of dunning letters. Replacing the rule for Reminder Letter with a rule for Dunning Letter would be a viable solution in this scenario.-Keywords-dunning; dunning letter; dunning level; form template selection; Dunning Strategy; Dunning Strategies

Title: Error Message "Service properties of XYZ () should be changed in future only. When the service properties are changed in the past, service reporting may become inconsistent."
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate a Organizational Structure, system throws below error message-Service properties of XYZ () should be changed in future only. When the service properties are changed in the past, service reporting may become inconsistent.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Structure.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.-Cause-The cause for the error message is might be because below reasons,-You try to delimit the Service Properties of any Service Organization or Customer Service to a Past date.-You try to delimit the Service Properties of any Service Organization or Customer Service to a Present date itself.-The Functions was unchecked completely.-Resolution-It is not possible to delete these functions, in case if there is Service requests created for the Service organization.-Hence, to resolve the error message, follow the below steps:-1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Set the Effective From date.-4. Highlight the Org Unit .-5. Go to Functions tab.-6. Check Service Organization.-7. Go to Timelines tab.-8. Scroll down to Functions attribute.-9. Change the Valid To date of Service Organization and Customer Service to a future date.-11. Save and Activate the Changes.

Title: Outbound File Error: Content has characters not supported by BIG5, file not created
Content: Symptom-The outbound file in Liquidity Management is in Error in File Creation status, the error message is:Content has characters not supported by BIG5, file not created.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, choose the File Management view, and then choose the Outbound Files subview.-Select the file that is Error in File Creation, and choose Display Log.-Under the General tab, you could see the error message: Content has characters not supported by BIG5, file not created.-Cause-One of the payment documents in the outbound file contains unexpected characters in the Memo Line which is supposed to contain external invoice number, In fact, these characters come from the payment correspondence profile defined in Business Configuration.-The problem is that in the Payment Correspondence Profile assigned to Payment Medium Format in the concerned payment document, the Fixed Text Before Variable Data is empty, so the system finds nothing is maintained in English,and then it uses as fallback, the language of the supplier's country.-Resolution-In order to avoid the issue in the future, you need to maintain a text in the Fixed Text Before Variable Data of Payment Correspondence Profile in question.-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view.-Find the Outgoing Bank Transfers activity.-Edit payment correspondence profiles.-Find the profile in question, and navigate to the Details.-Find the line item with Source of Variable Data being 12 - External Invoice Number.-Add a text to the Fixed Text Before Variable Data column.-Then the issue should not happen again.-For the erroneous outbound file, as the file data is invalid, you can also reverse (cancel) or discard the outbound file:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, choose the File Management view, and then choose the Outbound Files subview.-Select the file that is Error in File Creation,-Choose Actions and choose the appropriate action to do so. The status of the payments contained in the reversed or discarded file changes to Not Transferred.-You can create a new file for these payments after you have corrected the original error.

Title: G/L Account Drop-down list Displays Multiple Records During Advanced Search of Journal Entries by G/L Account
Content: Symptom-In the General Ledger work center, when you try to do Advanced Search of Journal Entries by G/L Account, you enter one account number, multiple account items show up in the list, but you expect only one to be displayed in the list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Journal Entries view.-Show All Postings, and then select Advanced search.-In the G/L Account field, enter a target account number.-The system displays more than one items in the G/L Account drop-down list.-Cause-You have two Chart of Accounts in the system, and only one is assigned to the Set of Books and is being used. But when you do the search, the G/L accounts in all the Chart of Accounts are displayed.-Resolution-While doing the Advanced search, specify the Set of Books as well, then the system shows only the account that is in use.

Title: The Posting of Warehouse Confirmation Document Does Not Take the Right Inventory Cost of the Material
Content: Symptom-You post the warehouse confirmation document of material ABC to accounting, in the respective journal entry XYZ, you can see that the amount posted to the finished goods inventory account isn't calculated based on the Inventory Cost maintained in the material master data of ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center, and choose the Reports view.-Select the List subview, and then choose the Material Inventories - Line Items view.-In the Variable Screen, enter the jouranl entry XYZ.-You can see that for material ABC, the Amount Company Currency is XXX.  -Check the material master data of ABC, you can see that the Perpetual Cost Method is Standard, and the cost vaild on the posting date of XYZ is YYY.-If you multiply the Inventory Cost in the material master data YYY by the Fulfilled Quantity in the warehouse confirmation document, the amount is ZZZ not XXX.-Cause- By the time the journal entry XYZ is generated, the Perpetual Cost Method of the material is still Moving Average, and it's changed to Standard after the journal entry XYZ is generated. You can follow the steps below to check the material cost history:-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Select Material Costs Overview subview.-Select material ABC and then choose View Cost History.-Change Period/Year to include the date on which journal entry XYZ is generated, and you can see the Resulting Inventory Cost right before then.-Multiply this Inventory Cost by the quantity in the warehouse confirmation document, you will get the amount XXX.-

Title: Data Source for New System Request
Content: Symptom-Copy of Source System = This type of system is a replica of the production system that is in the list which includes everything (i.e master data and all the transaction data) from the existing production system.-Copy of Source System (Copy Solution Profile) = This type of system is the same replica of the existing production system, but provides an option to copy a different solution profile if there is any existing.-Initial System = This type of system is a fresh system without any data in it.-Initial System (Copy Solution Profile) = This type of system is a fresh system again but you again have a choice of choosing a solution profile;-Resolution

Title: Unable to Create New Supplier Invoice Because of Error Message: Company ABC not registered in Country United States, define tax number as Type X
Content: Symptom-You are unable to save a new supplier invoice because of an error message: Company ABC not registered in Country United States, define tax number as Type X-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice without Purchase Order link in the Common Tasks.-Fill in the details like: Supplier, Posting Date, Item and Amount.-Select Save button.-System displays the above error message.-Cause-The Company Tax arrangement is missing for the combination of Country United States and the Company.-Resolution-The Company Tax Arrangement is missing for the combination of Country United States and the Company.

Title: Accounting Principle which is maintained for the Set Of Books is not getting displayed in the Functional Area Determination
Content: Symptom-Three Sets of Books have been created with three Accounting Principles for three different companies. However, only one Accounting Principle is displayed in the Functional Area Determination.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-  Reproducing the Issue-The desired G/L Account and Chart of Accounts cannot be viewed in the Functional Area Determination for the respective Accounting Principle. To check this, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click on Implementation Projects.-Select the required project and click Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune and click on it.-Enter Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis in the Find field.-Select Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis and click Open.-Click Edit Functional Area Determination. No G/L Accounts or Chart of Accounts corresponding to the respective Accounting Principle are displayed.- Cause-The root cause of this issue is that the Contribution Margin Scheme field is left blank for the other two Sets of Books, which is why they are not displayed in the Functional Area Determination.-Resolution-The Contribution Margin Scheme field must be maintained in the Set of Books. Follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click on Implementation Projects.-Select the required project and click Open Activity List.-Go to Integrate and Extend and click on it.-Find Settings for Set of Books and click Go.-Select Set of Books and click Open.-Select the relevant Set of Books ID based on the company ID and Accounting Principle.-Click Edit. The Set of Books: ABC window will open.-Click on Company Settings and maintain the Contribution Margin Scheme field with the desired value, then save.-Go to Fine-Tune and click on it.-Enter Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis in the Find field.-Select Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis and click Open.-Click Edit Functional Area Determination and maintain the Functional Area for the respective Accounting Principle corresponding to the Set of Books.-Click Save and Close.- Keywords-Business Configuration, Implementation Projects, Set of Books, Accounting Principle, Company Settings, Contribution Margin Scheme, Fine-Tune, Functional Area Determination, G/L Account, Chart of Accounts, Functional Area.

Title: Error Appears When You Cancel the Released Time Recording
Content: Symptom-You are trying to modify the released time sheets and got error message when you select Cancel under actions button.-Error: Time confirmation not allowed on unreleased task ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self Services Overview.-Select Edit Time Sheet.-Enter Time Sheet for the relevant user.-Go to the Actions button and select Cancel. System is showing error message: Time confirmation not allowed on unreleased task ABC-Cause-Time recordings are not allowed for the project task ABC and hence the you are unable to change the time recording.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, allow time recordings in the project task ABC.

Title: Is it Possible to Mass Upload Skill Profiles for Service Agents?
Content: Symptom-You have migrated some Service Agents and would like to know whether it is possible to upload Skill Profiles for those Service Agents either through Mass Change or Migration?-Resolution-It is not possible to mass upload the Skill profile/details for Service Agents either through Mass Change or Excel Upload or Migration. The only workaround is that it needs to be added manually.-One of the reason that, we don’t have this functionality is that it is a free-text item. Hence, the number of characters in this field could more.

Title: E-mail Output Channel for Delivery Note is Missing
Content: Symptom-You cannot setup the output channel selection as E-mail for Delivery Note. The system only offers Printer option in the drop-down.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Select Output Channel Selection sub-view under Input and Output Management view.-Select Delivery Note in the Show rules for field and then click on Go.-Click on New.-In the new screen click on drop-down for Output Channel option.-There is no E-mail option for selection.-Cause-The delivery note cannot be sent via e-mail. Instead you can use the Advanced Shipping Notification (ASN) to send information to your product recipient.-Resolution-A delivery note is meant for being used as the accompanying document with a shipment. In case your customer has to be notified in advance about the delivery then Advanced Shipping Notification should be used.-Navigate to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select the Account.-Click on Edit and then General.-Go to Communication tab.-Select Collaboration.-In the Business Document Settings area, select Advanced Shipping Notification.-Select E-mail in the output channel.-Maintain the E-mail address in the column E-mail.-In the column Template, you can select the output template for Advanced Shipping Notification.

Title: Error Message : The Logged-In System Cannot Be Terminated
Content: Symptom-You want to terminate a tenant and the system display the following error message: The Logged-In System Cannot Be Terminated.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to Systems view.-Select the system to be terminated.-Click on the Request Termination Button .-The Error Message : The Logged-In System Cannot Be Terminated will be displayed.-Cause-This is the system expected behavior when you try to terminate the system that you are logged-in.-Resolution-Logon on a different system and request the tenant termination.

Title: Error: Employee Found With Status Internal; Hire in Personnel Administration
Content: Symptom-The above error is seen when adding an employee through the Employees tab of Organizational Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Enter the Planning Area by selecting the Edit button and supplying the Effective Date.-Select a particular org unit where you intent to hire an employee.-Navigate to the Employees tab.-Select the Add button.-Enter the ID of a terminated employee/ employee for whom Basic Data has already been created and hit Enter.-Cause-The cause for this is that as per the design of Business ByDesign, the system allows only to add service agents in the Employees tab of the org unit. This can be verified when you select the value help for employees in the org management work center, you see only service agent IDs in the list and not IDs of internal employees.-Resolution-The scenario of assigning an internal employee to an org unit can be explained in two ways as below:-In a solution where HCM elements are scoped, Hiring, Re-hiring and Transfer can be done in the Personnel Administration work center.-In a solution where HCM elements are not in scope, the same can be done through the Employees view of the Business Partner Data work center.

Title: Error Messages While Editing the Time Sheet.
Content: Symptom-When you edit the time sheet and enter one week of work, you get the following error messages when you click on Save-Save Failed-Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data.-   Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select the Self Services view.-Select the Self-Services Overview sub view.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Enter one week of work in the sheet.-Click on Save.-Cause-You need to maintain a duration greater than 0 when confirming project task confirmations.- Resolution-Go to Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Select the Projects sub view.-Select the project and click on Edit and choose Team and staffing.-Check the team member and assign a duration of the task.

Title: Is it Possible to add New Document Types to the Personnel File Attachments?
Content: Symptom-In the Attachments tab of Personnel File of any Employees, you can find pre-defined Document Types such as Application, Certificate, Curriculum Vitae, Job Description, Skills Profile and Standard Attachment. So, you would like to know, whether there is a possibilities to add some more document types other than the above six types?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search and Edit an Employee.-Go to Attachments tab.-Select Add button and choose File option.-Select the drop down for Document Type.-Resolution-It is not possible to add new Document Types in the Attachments of Employee Personnel Files.--It is also not possible to change the titles with the Cloud Development Studio or via Business Configuration.

Title: Warning Message "General: value XYZ in column Supplier Name will be truncated; edit source value"
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Customer Data or Supplier Data into your system, after validation, system throws below warning messages:-Customer Data Migration:-General: value XYZ in column Supplier Name will be truncated; edit source value-Supplier Data Migration:-General: value XYZ in column Account Name will be truncated; edit source value-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view or Overview-Search and Open Migration of Customer or Migration of Supplier.-Execute the respective migration file.-Cause-The standard system behavior during Customer/Supplier migration with account names / Supplier names >40 characters is a truncation. During migration Validation step, you are being notified on the truncations with above warning message-Resolution-This is a warning message and is to notify that the name will be truncated to 40 characters. You can continue with your migration but after migration only 40 characters of the Account/Supplier name will be available in the system

Title: Error Message: Work Agreement for Employee Exists In Entered Period
Content: Symptom-The following errors are seen when trying to rehire a terminated employee:-Work Agreement for Employee Exists In Entered Period-Rehire Failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Regular Task view.-Select Rehire Employee.-From the value help select a terminated employee.-Fill required fields.-Select the Save button.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Hire Date chosen is on or before the Last Termination Date of the employee. -This is logically not possible.-Resolution-The rehire date used should be after the Last Termination Date of the employee. Please correct the same and rehire.-In a case when the employee was initially hired with wrong Work Agreement, Organizational Assignment, etc., and you want to correct them. -The options proposed would be as following: -Re-hire can be made effective one day post the termination date. With this the new work agreement can be assigned to the same employee.-The other option would be creating a new employee with a new ID and work agreement effective the same date.-Keywords-employment overlap, time slice overlap, validity conflict, start-after-end inconsistency, contract type change, reactivation blocked, returning staff onboarding, employment record gap handling, staffing lifecycle correction, system validation conflict, timeframe check conflict, re-engagement restriction, historical employment mismatch, duplicate employment window, role mapping alternative

Title: Error Message "Action not possible, Several termination records exist for work agreement"
Content: Symptom-When you try to change the Termination Date of an Employee to a past date who was already terminated, system throws below error message:-Action not possible, Several termination records exist for work agreement-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select All Employees in Show field.-Highlight the Employee and select Edit button.-Go to Employment tab and Work Agreement sub tab.-Select Change Termination button and provide a new date which is earlier than current termination date.- Cause-The cause for the issue is that you are trying change the Termination Date to a date which is earlier than current Termination date.-Resolution-To resolve the issue and also to change the Termination Date, follow the below steps:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Terminate Relationship with employee link under Termination.-Here select the employee, give the new last working day.-Enter the Termination Category and select Save button.-This will change the last working day of the employee and it can be seen in from Personnel file of that Employee.

Title: Error Message "Bank details entered is not valid for customer/supplier XYZ (Name), While Migrating Customer Data
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Customer Data into your system, system throws below error message:-Error detected in source record with key value XYZ-Bank details entered is not valid for customer/supplier XYZ (Name)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview or Implementation Projects view.-Search and open Migration of Customers activity.-Select Migrate customers using the migration tool link.-Execute the Migration.-Resolution-If you use Direct Debit method in Payment sheet of Migration template then the sequence number of Bank Data should be at least the same sequence number on the bank sheet.--The field Sequence number of bank data get's visible using the maximum view (changeable in field SHOW).--Note: In case, if you have several banks (in Bank sheet) you can indicate which bank should be the direct debit, the bill of exchange or the payment card bank (in Payment sheet)

Title: Unexpected Error During backend Processing While Accessing Materials view in Product Data work center
Content: Symptom-When you try to navigate to Materials view of Product Data work center, the system takes longer processing time and results in Unexpected Error During backend error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-The issue may occur here or when you select Go button with query as Incomplete Materials.-Cause-The default query Incomplete Materials of work center Product Data, view Materials can cause a delay during the search when a large number of materials and a large amount of data on the Purchasing, Logistics, Planning, Availability Confirmation, Sales or Valuation tabs are available in the system.-System will throw the error when the processing takes longer than 60 seconds.-Resolution-To avoid error screen or the dumps when opening work center Product Data, view Materials, please switch from the default query Incomplete Materials to any other default query by executing the following steps:-Option 1: (For a Specific User)-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Overview view.-Select any Quick Link under paragraph Materials, except Incomplete Materials, e.g. Materials Changed within last 31 Days.-Select the Advanced link in the upper-right hand corner.-Select Organize Queries button.-Select any query except query Incomplete Materials under paragraph Set Default Query, e.g. Materials Changed within last 31 Days.-Select Ok button.-The default query for work center Product Data, view Materials is changed now.-Option 2: (For a All the Users in the system and this steps will be performed by Key User only)-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select Adapt and choose Enter Adaptation Mode-Select Advanced link .-Select Organize Queries button.-Set Default Query to any query other than Incomplete Materials and select Ok button.-Select Save Query Button and select Ok Button.-Again select Adapt and choose Edit Screen-Select Publish Button-Leave Overwrite Flag unchecked and select Publish button.-Wait until publishing is finished.-Select Adapt and choose Leave Adaptation

Title: Report 'G/L Accounts - Open Items' does not Show all Open Items at a Key Date
Content: Symptom-Although open items to exist for g/l account XYZ, the report G/L Accounts - Open Items does not show all open items that exist for a certain key date or g/l account XYZ is not listed at all.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Enter the Reports view and List.-Open the report G/L Accounts - Open Items.-Enter appropriate filter data selecting the open items for G/L Account XYZ at a given Key Date.-Cause-Open g/l account items must exhibit an associated Open Item Reference in order to be listed in the report G/L Accounts - Open Items. This is a system definition.-Resolution-As an alternative we recommend to employ the report G/L Accounts - Line Items in order to display the entirety of all items without clearing for a g/l account at a given key date.-In the General Ledger work center under Reports choose G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Enter the relevant filter data, also defining the appropriate Accounting Period/Year which corresponds with the Key Date in the report G/L Accounts - Open Items and run the report for G/L Account XYZ.-Draw the characteristic Clearing Date into the report-rows and access the tab Edit Filter.-By the setting the filter for Clearing Date to "#", only un-cleared (and therefore open) items are shown for the selected period.

Title: Is it Possible to Change the Hire Date and Service Date of an Employee Before the Start Date of the Org Unit?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to change the Hire Date and Service Date of an Employee to a date prior to the valid from of the org unit to which the Employee is assigned to.-Is it possible to do this? And also, the Hire date and Service date should be same.-Resolution-1. It is not possible to extend the Hire date before the start date (Valid From) of the Org Unit. So, the hire date of the employee should always on/after the start date of the Org Unit.--2. It is possible to have the Service Date on an Employee to any date. The Service date can be before the Hire date and as well before the Valid From of the Org Unit.--3. You can change the Service Date of an Employee in the Personnel File of the Employee.

Title: Error: Comp. Agreement for Employee XYZ Already Exists; Migration not Possible
Content: Symptom-Error Message: Comp. agreement for employee XYZ already exists; migration not possible, while migrating compensation data for employee XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the concerned change project and Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend chevron.-Find and Open the activity Migration of Employee Data - <Country>.-Select the link Migrate compensation data using the migration tool.-Upload the populated file and Execute Migration.-Continue to the Simulate Import stage.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign does not allow for partial migration of employee data where the personnel data is manually created and the follow-up compensation data is tried to be migrated. As soon as an employee is hired, his Compensation Agreement gets created with minimal information. Specific information is supposed to be created through Compensation Hire, by editing the Compensation File for the employee.-Resolution-The system is working as per design. The compensation data can be migrated for only those employees whose basic and personnel administration data were created through migration, and not manually. For manually created employees, the compensation files will also have to be manually entered.

Title: How to Make a Supplier ID Field Non-Mandatory During Service Agent Migration
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate a Service Agent in your system, you have some Service Agents don't belong to a company since they are independent contractors and hence Supplier ID is not required. But in the Migration Template for Service Agent, the Supplier ID column is mandatory. So, you would like to know how to migrate Service Agents without Supplier ID?-Resolution-The Supplier ID field in the sheet Service Agent Data is mandatory only when you enter the Service Agent ID in the sheet Service Agent Data.--Again, if you have only few Service Agents in the system who should have a Supplier then enter only those Service Agents in the sheet Service Agent Data with their relevant Supplier ID.--If you don’t have a Supplier ID for any of the Service Agent then do not enter the Service Agent ID in the sheet Service Agent Data. For this type of Service Agent, you fill other sheets if required.

Title: Error Message: Country missing in address of company, While Migrating Open Items Payables
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Open Items Payables, system throws below error message:-Country missing in address of company-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-Execute Migration of Open Items Payables.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that there is no Account Determination Group maintained for the Employees.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you need to maintain the account determination group for the Employees that you are using in the Migration template for Open Item Payables. The steps are,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Suppliers.-Select Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool link-Once, this is performed, you can able to continue with the Migration of Open Item Payables.-Note:-In the migration template for Open Item Payables, For employees, use Creditor Type as 2 which stands for Employees, and the same Employee ID in field Creditor ID that you have used during migration of Employees or during creation of that employee.

Title: Interface error; WS-Runtime; AP-ACC; AccountingGoodsAndServiceAccountingIn. Error: Goods and service confirmation is not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have failed XMLs from GSA to ACC in the XI monitor (SRT_MONI transaction) that will not restart after solving the original cause of the issue due to the error: Goods and service confirmation is not possible; posting on DD/MM/YYYY blocked.-Details of the transactions that are impacted--The XI message are stuck from GSA to Accounting thus inconsistency occurs in GSA document.-Step to find GSA IDs (FormattedID) from backend:-Open backend using SRT_MONI transaction-Search the XI message stuck from GSA to ACC-Select the XI Message and double click - XML file will open-Select the Version:00 and double click on message body provider-Find the FormattedID based on ObjectTypeCode:56 and OperationalDocumentObjectTypeCode:282.-Cause-The corresponding period in Accounting is closed for postings.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Select the Companies subview and mark the relevant Company.-Press the Set Process control button and choose Add Row.-Enter Process Control Status = 1 - Not Blocked-Enter Business Process Group = 06 - Goods and Service confirmation-Enter Entry Possible Until >= Today's Date-The posting dates of the GSRs should be contained between the dates "From Posting Date" and "To Posting Date"-Choose Save and Close.-Afterward restart the messages in the XI Monitor.

Title: Delta File of Not Imported Records are not Generated During Migration
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating datas into your system and observed that the XYZ records are not imported but there is no delta file created for that automatically.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select a Implementation Project or a Change Project and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Search and open the activity and navigate to Data Migration screen.-Here, you can find the migrated file where there is a difference between the total records and imported records whereas the delta file for not imported records is not generated.-Cause-The delta file was not created for Not Imported Records of the migration file because the Execute Import step has not been finished.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Complete the migration of the migration file using the Finish button in the last step of migration.

Title: Migration of Suppliers error message "Supplier is not active. Procurement arrangement not activated."
Content: Symptom-You are migrating suppliers using the Migration Tool and receive the error message Supplier is not active. Procurement arrangement not activated while processing the file.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity list button.-Search for Migration of Suppliers and open it.-Select open with migration tool.-Process your migration file.-The mentioned error happens when simulating the migration.-Cause-You are maintaining Payment Terms and Purchase Order Currency for suppliers with status Blocked or Obsolete.-These field are only used for suppliers in status Active.-Resolution-On sheet General of your migration template, leave the fields Payment Terms and Purchase Order Currency empty for suppliers in status Block or Obsolete.

Title: LiveCache Short Dumps in AP-RC-CBP
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You get dumps from liveCache with following Return codes-1)      -28514-2)      -28833-3)      -28000-4)      17831-Or with the following error:-1. "Error creating secondary database connection".-The error can be viewed directly in the BCP/customer CSS. The snapshot of the error is given below.-The return codes can be found either in the incident itself or in SAP Incight or from the ST22 dump information given in the message. Kindly find the screen shots below. Please check for the return code in SAP Incight first, then the message and if it is not there in both places kindly check in ST22.-  ST22-CSS Message-SAP Incight-   Reproducing the Issue-The issues resulting with these return codes carry certain specific meaning and are as per design and are therefore not needed to be reproduced.-The error mentioned about the 'secondary database connection' also signifies something specific and cannot be reproduced.-Cause-a)      For -28514 or -28833 or 17831-This error code is thrown when the liveCache has already thrown away the so called consistent view of a session, what usually happens after the liveCache "MaxRetentionTime" has been overstepped.-liveCache cancels the consistent view of session in order to save memory since such very long running liveCache sessions tend to cause a lot of history data and thus slow down the liveCache.- Details can be found in the wiki link below:- https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/lcapps/Error+-28514- b)      For -28000-This error code is terminated when liveCache call was terminated due to insufficient memory in liveCache.-This normally happens during the application scenario which operates on far too many liveCache objects at the same time causing the memory to go out of bounds.-Details can be found in wiki link below:- https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/lcapps/Error+-28000- This issue ideally occurs during customer upgrade or during background job runs as during these times large memory is utilized within the liveCache application.-The solution for this would be is to increase the liveCache parameter OmsMaxHeapSize. This needs to be decided in consultation with system colleagues as this is directly linked to system hardware.-  c)  For error " Error creating secondary database connection".-This error occurs when no 'Live Cache' connection could be established. Without Live Cache none of the SCM Planning functionality can function and hence a dump occurs which is expected and very much required.-The dump is raised by LCAP Core and has to be looked into by Live Cache colleagues. Of late this has been observed a lot when there is an external LC attached to the system.-The solution would be to forward the ticket to component BC-DB-LCA for further analysis from them. As such the application teams do not have any control over this.-Resolution-a) For error codes -28514, -28833 or 17831, close the ticket giving explanation as given in previous section as it is an expected behavior.-b) For -28000, the tickets can be closed but the frequency of the ticket for a particular customer needs to be checked. If the issue is occurring too frequently for a particular customer, this would need to be checked in detail from both application as well as system     colleagues. However, we have seen this issue mostly coming during customer upgrades which is mostly expected.-c) For error " Error creating secondary database connection".This error occurs when no 'Live Cache' connection could be established. Without Live Cache none of the SCM Planning functionality can function and hence a dump occurs which is expected and very much required. The dump is raised by LCAP Core and has to be looked into by Live Cache colleagues. Of late this has been observed a lot when there is an external LC attached to the system.The solution would be to forward the ticket to component BC-DB-LCA for further analysis from them. As such the application teams do not have any control over this.

Title: How to Extend the Validity of an Org Unit to a Past date?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to extend the validity of an Org Unit to a past date (i.e changing the Valid From date of the Org Unit to a past date) but while doing so, system may throw below error messages:-Segment XYZ () still being used in projects-Cannot delete cost center XYZ (); it is the requesting unit of a project-Cannot delete cost center XYZ (); it is the responsible unit of a project-Profit center XYZ () still being used in projects-Cannot delete segment (); used in projects-Note: The solution provided in this document can be used even if the system throws any one of the above error message.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you are trying to delete the above parameter from that org unit or altering the Validity of the above parameters in the Timelines tab of the Org Unit.-Resolution-Option 1: (If you want to split the Segment or Cost Center or Profit Center parameters)-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective From date as DD.MM.YYYY (This is the date from which you want the Org Unit to valid). -Highlight the Org Unit XYZ and go to Definitions tab.-Check the Segment, Profit Center and Cost center attributes.-Now, Set the Effective From date as DD1.MM1.YYYY1 (This is the current Valid From date of the Org Unit which you actually wanted to change).-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ and go to Definitions tab.-Uncheck the Managerial Definitions Segment, Profit Center and Cost center.-Now, again check the Segment, Profit Center and Cost center.-Go to Timelines tab and scroll down to Managerial section. You can find the validity of the definitions in two lines. i.e, first line from DD.MM.YYYY to one day before DD1.MM1.YYYY1 and second line from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to Unlimited.-Check the consistency of the Org Structure.-Now, you can activate the Org Structure.-Option 2: (If you changed the valid From or Valid To date of Segment or Cost Center or Profit Center)-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Go to Timelines tab and scroll down to Managerial section-Revert the Valid From or Valid To date to the actual date.-Check the consistency of the Org Structure-Now, you can activate the Org Structure.

Title: Migration of Accounting transaction Data
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Financial Data into your system using Migration of Accounting transaction Data and would like to clarify some of the basic questions-Resolution-Is it possible to create more than one Process Unit in Migration of Accounting transaction Data?-Yes. You can create multiple units per company to migrate the Accounting information but user needs to make sure that the records should be unique. That is, you cannot migrate a same record in different Units.-In this case, you must ensure that the main and auxiliary books are matched . They can also be seen using the booking previews on each migration object .-Why Change Immediately button is disabled for Migration of Accounting transaction Data?-Change Immediate is disabled because, Accounting Transaction is critical information that is being migrated into the system and directly changes into the system will make inconsistencies or mismatch with the existing records. Hence, you need to create a new Change Project to use this activity.

Title: How to Change Employee Responsible for a Contact?
Content: Symptom-The employee responsible for the contact needs to be changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center -Navigate to the Contacts view-Select a contact and choose Edit-In the General tab, attempt to modify the Employee Responsible field and observe it cannot be changed. -Cause-The Employee Responsible for a contact cannot be changed directly. It is determined based on the Account/Partner assigned to the contact. When the Account/Partner is changed, the corresponding employees assigned to that account are automatically reflected as Employee Responsible for the contact.-Resolution-The Employee Responsible for the contact cannot be changed directly. If the Account/Partner field is changed, then the corresponding Employee Responsible will be assigned to the contact.- -1. Go to Account Management Work center.-2. Go to Contacts View.-3. Select a contact and select Edit button.-4. In the General tab, change the Account/Partner field.-5. The Employees assigned in that particular account will be shown in the Relationships tab of the contact with the Party Role Employee Responsible.-Keywords-Record owner, responsibility assignment, owner reassignment, automatic assignment, derived from parent, field locked, editing restriction, role derivation, team assignment, association change, ownership update, assignment behavior, linked object, data dependency, UI restriction

Title: Valuation sheet is Missing in the Migration Template of Services
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating Services and observed that there is no sheet called Valuation because of which there is no ways to migrate Company and Account Determination Groups which are actually required for importing Financial Datas.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Migration of Services.-Select Migrate services using the migration tool link.-Download the Migration Template where there is no sheet for Valuation.-Cause-With the migration object Services, you can't migrate Valuation datas for Services.-Resolution-Instead you can use Migration of Service Valuation Data activity to migrate the Valuation Datas. The steps are as follows,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Migration of Service Valuation Data.-Select Migrate service valuation data using the migration tool link.-Download the Migration Template, in which you can find the respective fields.

Title: Troubleshooting ITSAM_SELFMON_00024 SAP Support Request could not be forwarded to SAP Backbone
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While processing ITSAM_SELFMON_00024 SAP support request could not be forwarded to SAP backbone incidents,instead of directly creating ticket to CSA-ADM-XI, you can check where the issue lies.-Reproducing the Issue-You can check GBB connections in SE38->/ITSAM/PI_CONNECTION_TEST, you get error for User Incidents to Service Provider and Provider Incidents to Service Provider scenarios when some configuration is not maintained properly.-GBB Registration Task is done by Provisioning Team. We can as well check for the related tasks for the tenant. If we find it has ended in error, you can trigger a task and check it-After checking here you can proceed.-Cause-M-User Certificate is missing/M-User details missing in IBase(The Installed Base (IBASE) database contains software license information)-RFC not created in PE* systems-Resolution- M-User Certificate is missing./M-User details missing in IBase(The Installed Base (IBASE) database contains software license information.) (sometimes Status can be 401: Unauthorised),check whether M-User/M-User Certificate is present, the steps to check Muser settings are-Select Configured-Select Test Connection-You get the window as pointed by (3), then M-User or M-User certificate is not maintained.-Whether M-User is present or not can be checked in PE* System,using this you can create IT/IBC to CSA-ADM-XI stating the same.-RFC Not Created in PE* Systems-Logon to PE* system.-Start transaction SM59-Select Search-in RFC Destination, give A1S_#Tenant ID. eg.  A1S_000000000740089142-If RFC destination is maintained then you get the following results.-Select Connection Test-You should get 500 Response--If the RFC is not present, then report the issue through a ticket to CSA-ADM-XI. you have to check this in both PE1 & PE2 as it might be maintained in any one of these two.-Note: Usually when we create IT/IBC ticket to CSA-ADM-XI for "ITSAM_SELFMON_24”, sometimes you get reply as:-Hence, before sending a ticket make sure that GBB Registration is triggered.-You can trigger it from both SPC and backend(NZA_002).-Following are the steps for checking/triggering it in backend(this has to be done in SPC Backend(NZA)-Prerequisite:-          Ensure you have the SAPSID and the client number of the Tenant at hand.- Proceed as follows:- Log on to the SPC with SAPGUI in client 002 using your user ID.-Start transaction SE38-Execute report: /A1SSPC/BLD_SUPPORT_TOOL-After having started the report, select Execute--Locate the SAPSID of the system which carries the recently created Tenant and select the associated SystemNumber/Client:--     5.   In the right upper frame, locate the client number and select the line and select Details--    6.   In the detail dialog scroll down and locate the field: GBB and check whether its content is:--GBB = X--See the following screenshot for an example:-   7.   If GBB is equal to 'X', close the dialog and continue-   8.   If GBB is not equal to 'X', then:-Close the dialog-In the upper right frame, select the line with the Client number, select More functions and select menu entry Register the tenant to GBB-Repeat step 5.-The client is now successfully registered and GBB communication is permitted.--Even after this if the issue persists, we can create a ticket to IT/IBC to CSA-ADM-XI.- Created by BYDMS-KB-IM

Title: Error Message : “ID XYZ not permitted .
Content: Symptom-You want to simulate the customer contract migration object and the following error message is displayed: ID XYZ not permitted.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Project View.-Select the Project and Open the activity List.-Search by the activity:Migration of Customer Contracts.-Select the option: Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool.-Select the migration object file.-Click on Execute migration>> Execute migration Step – by – Step .-Simulate the migration. -The error message is displayed: ID XYZ not permitted .- Cause--The contract ID entered on the migration template is bigger than the number range defined by the customer under the activity : Number Ranges for Sales Orders, Customer Contracts, and Customer Returns .-Resolution-In order to solve the error message you have to option.-Case 1: Enter a new contract id smaller that the number ranger defined.-Case 2: Increase the number ranger for customer contract.-             Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Project View.-Select the Project and Open the activity List.-Search by the activity: Number Ranges for Sales Orders, Customer Contracts, and Customer Returns.-Open the activity and select the Customer contract option.-Increase the number ranger and save it.-after perform one of those two cases proceed with the simulation.

The subview will then be available.

Title: Holiday Configuration - Victoria Day in Canada, the Last Monday Before the 25th of May
Content: Symptom-Configuration Requirement: Victoria Day has to be set to the Last Monday before the 25th of May in any calendar year for Canada.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find and select activity Working Day Calendar.-Select the Open button.-Select Maintain an existing holiday calendar.-Select the holiday calendar Canada (General) and select the Next button.-You will see an Information Dialog pop up. This can be ignored as we are only trying to view the calendar. Select the OK button.-Select Victoria Day and Display.-It can be seen that in the SAP delivered holiday calendar for Canada, Victoria Day is configured to be the third Monday of May.-Cause-This is a constrain with the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The issue will be fixed by SAP in one of the future releases of Business ByDesign.-However until then, as a workaround a new holiday calendar can be created for Canada. And in that a new holiday can be added to replace the current configuration for Victoria Day.-To so so, kindly follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find and select activity Working Day Calendar.-Select the Open button.-Select Create a new holiday calendar.-Select country Canada and check Use General Holiday Calendar template for selected country.-Select the Next button.-Supply an appropriate name for the calendar.-Select Add Row button in the List of Holidays section.-Create a holiday with the following details:-a. Name: Victoria Day-b. Description: <An appropriate description>-c. Class: Ordinary Public holiday-d. Type: Fixed Day of Week-Select the second radio button with rule Monday After or on the 18 of May.-Select the OK button.-Select the newly created holiday in the calendar and remove the default holiday Victoria Day.-Select the Next button and confirm.-A corresponding working day calendar can be created and this new holiday calendar can be assigned to it.-Keywords-Holiday Calendar, Victoria Day, Canada, 25th of May

Title: Leading Zeroes get Truncated for Fields of Type Text in the Migration Template for any Object
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For any field of that has been defined of type Text, populated with a numeric value with leading 0s[zeroes], the zeroes are truncated by the migration tool.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be because the type Text for the field provided within the standard migration template, has been changed to some other type in Microsoft Excel.-Resolution-A support consultant is expected to verify this type in the template for the particular field based on the customer's concern.-Say, if the customer complains about leading zeroes being truncated for the Postal Codes of US during the Migration of Customers, then kindly check the format of the cells for the Postal Code column in the template excel which the customer is performing the migration with.-The verification can be done through the following steps:-Download the excel file from the migration tool.-Open the file using Microsoft Excel.-Right-Click on any of the cells under the concerned column.-Select the Format Cells option from the drop-down.-In the subsequent pop-up, check if the Category selected under the Number tab is anything but Text.-If this is the case, communicate the same to the customer and have them change it back to category Text and re-trigger the migration.

Title: Error Message "G/L Accounts not Found" When Importing Chart of Accounts
Content: Symptom-When you import chart of accounts from excel file, you get the error message G/L Accounts not found. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the project and open activity list-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Click link Edit chart of accounts-Select button Import from Microsoft Excel-Choose the file and import-Error occurs: G/L Accounts not found-Resolution-Follow below steps to fix the issue:-When you download template, save the excel file in the format XML data instead of XML Excel.-Check the entries in Open Item Management as the value help only allows value X or space.

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers.
