Title: Error Message "Document Type Employee Image not Permitted for Employee" While Uploading a Image for an Employee
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload a Image/Photo of an Employee in his/her Personnel File, system throws below error message,-Document Type Employee Image not Permitted for Employee-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search and Edit an employee.-Select Image and select Add-or-Go to Home work center.-Select Self-Service Overview-Select Edit My Contact Data link.-Go to Step 3 and select Change Photo.-Select Image and choose Add-Cause-The cause for the error message is that the question Do you plan to upload images of your employees? is not scoped in your system.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to scope the question:--1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Select Implementation projects view.-3. Select Edit Project Scope button.-4. Go to 4 Questions section.-5. Expand General Business Data.-6. Expand Employees and Service Agents-7. Select Employees.-8. In the right side of the screen, question Do you plan to upload images of your employees? is not scoped.-9. Select the check box for this question and select Set as Reviewed button.-10. Complete the Scoping till Confirmation step to finish the scoping.--Now, you can try to upload the Image of the employee into your system.

Title: Fail to Logon Bydesign System From Excel Add-in
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You try to logon Business ByDesign from Excel Add-In, but receive below error messages-"Server sent unexpected HTML response"-"Connection disrupted; the connected SAP Business By Design System has version <unknown>"-Reproducing the Issue-Open Excel-Go to tab SAP Business Bydesign-Select button Logon-Input Sytem URL, User Name and Password-Select button Log On-Error messages pop up-Cause-The Analytics Web Service AP_ANA_EXCEL_WS is disabled.-Resolution-Activate web service by following below steps:-Run transaction SE38-For field Program, input ANA_EXCEL_WS_TOOL-Select button Execute-For field Service, input AP_ANA_EXCEL_WS-Select Activate service and select button Execute-Keywords-Excel, Logon, Connection Disrupted

Title: You are not Able to do a Mass Update for Supplier Time Lead
Content: Symptom-You are not able to do a Mass Update Supplier Time Lead.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Material view.-Select the list of Materials.-Select Mass Change button.-There will be no option to mass update the Supplier Time Lead.-Cause-In the current releases, the Mass Update for Supplier Time Lead is not supported.

Title: Error Message "Service ID XYZ invalid; Incorrect Characters used" While Migrating Services
Content: Symptom-When you try to Migrate Service, system throws below error message-Service ID XYZ invalid; Incorrect Characters used-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Service ID used in the Migration Template is invalid. A blank or a '!' or not allowed signs. Also ensure that the Service numbers must be included in the defined number range.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Change the Service ID with the valid characters and try migrating the Service again.

Title: IGS Troubleshooting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Internet Graphics Service (IGS) constitutes the infrastructure to enable the application developers to display graphics in an Internet browser with minimum effort.-The IGS has been integrated in the different SAP UI technologies from HTML GUI to Web Dynpro ABAP/Java and provides a server architecture where data from an SAP system or another source can be used to generate graphical or non-graphical output.-The IGS may not work properly due to incorrect configuration, missing executables or due to gateway issue.- Reproducing the Issue-Following checks need to be done to ensure IGS is working fine.-Execute transaction SM59 and search for IGS_RFC_DEST RFC and check the connection test.-   2.  Check from the transaction SE38 run BW_IGS_ADMIN, the following graph should be displayed.-     3.   You can also use GRAPHICS_IGS_ADMIN. It should display the graph as shown.-     4.    Run the transaction RSRT, select IGS TEST, if you get a graph. It means IGS is working fine.-If the charts are not shown then it means IGS is not working properly.-Cause-IGS  may not work if:-IGS services are not running.-Configuration files are missing.-Executables files are missing.-Gateway service is not running.-Resolution-1. Log in into the server and check whether igsmux, igspw, igswd, (these 3 services) are running. If these services are running, but still IGS is not working then, you can kill igsmux and igspw and restart using the following command: /usr/sap/SID/SYS/exe/run/igswd_mt -mode=profile pf=/usr/sap/SID/SYS/profile/<instance profile> &-2. Make sure the following entries are present in profile files:-_IG = ig.sap$(SAPSYSTEMNAME)_$(INSTANCE_NAME)-Execute_11 = local rm -f $(_IG)-Execute_12 = local ln -s -f $(DIR_EXECUTABLE)/igswd_mt $(_IG)-Start_Program_03 = local $(_IG) -mode=profile pf=$(DIR_PROFILE)$(DIR_SEP)-HSN_DVEBMGS00_vacihsn-3. If still IGS not working then check the following: -     The config files *gfwchart.tpl (note 596825),  and xmlchart.tpl must be existing on /usr/sap/SID/DVEBMGS*/igs/conf.-     There should be the following 11 files in <DIR_EXECUTABLE> for IGS to run.-bwgis.so-gfwchart.so-igsexe.lst-igsmanifest.mf-igsmux_mt-igspw_mt-igswd_mt-imgconv.so-sgxgis.so-xmlchart.so-zipper.so -If any of the above files are missing, then the same needs to be copied from service market place.*-Go to http://service.sap.com/swdc and select Download and then select Support Packages and Patches.-Select Entry by Application Group and select SAP Frontend Components and then select SAP IGS.-Select SAP IGS <version> and select SAP IGS <VERSION> > <operating system>.-There you find the IGS executables and libraries (igsexe_.sar) as well as the IGS folder structure (igshelper_.sar) containing among others font files.-Download the igsexe_*.sar file.-Unpack the file igsexe_.sar in kernel directory using the "SAPCAR -xvf" command. The upgrade files (igshelper_*.sar) for the IGS folder structure must be extracted to the instance directory (DIR_INSTANCE).-The config files should be in /usr/sap/SID/DVEBMGS**/igs/conf  (gfwchart.tpl and xmlchart.tpl).-4. After doing all these, if still IGS is not working then probably there might be some problem with the gateway, so try to restart the gateway at OS level restart gwrd service*.*-After performing all these steps IGS should be working fine.-*Note: Updating of IGS should not be done without approval. Contact SPOCs if any of the above mentioned inconsistencies are found.-Created by BYDMS-KB-IM

Title: Leave Request Sent to Wrong Manager for Approval
Content: Symptom-According to the Personnel file, the Employee XYZ is assigned of the Department ABC. In the Organisation Structure, the Employee XYZ belongs to the Department ABC as well. But when the Employee XYZ creates a Leave Request, the request is going to wrong Manager.-Cause-The Employee XYZ is belongs to the Org Unit ABC but this Org Unit is not a Reporting Line Unit or Cost Center.-Resolution-In the Personnel File of any employee, the responsible Org Unit is always the reporting line unit.-Follow below steps to find the respective Reporting Line Unit for Employee XYZ,-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Select Employee ID (link).-Under Organizational Data section, you can find the respective Reporting Line Unit.-So, the Leave Request of the Employee XYZ will go the Manager of the Reporting Line Unit.-In the same section, you can find the Manager as well.

Title: Automatic Approval of Shopping Cart
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You create a shopping Cart and release it. The status of the Shopping Cart is changed to In Approval but the approval task is not assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home.-Select the Go Shopping.-Fill in all the mandatory details.-Select Finish button .-The status of the shopping cart changes to in approval.-Cause-The shopping cart approval process is defined as Approval by Cost Assignment means depending on the cost assignment, the approver can be the cost center manager or project manager, or the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible.-The shopping cart is assigned to Project task ID: XYZ for a non stock item and Project manager is ABC. Since the manager of the project is the creator of the shopping cart himself system fails to find the responsible and becomes unassigned.-If the Shopping cart is created for the stock item then the approval task has to be routed to the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible.-Resolution-As a standard Behavior, for the work distribution rule defined as Approval by Cost Assignment and the manager of the Project/cost center creates the shopping cart then the approval task status changes to completed automatically. Setting to be done for the approval task to behave as explained above.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Shopping Cart Approvals fine-tuning activity.-Here the checkbox Automatic Approval should be selected.-Note: Select this checkbox, if no employee responsible is to be found for this step.

Title: Description and Product Category Missing in A2X Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You create supplier invoices via A2X interface. For the items, the Description and Product Category are missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Choose Show: All Documents.-Select Advanced and choose Entry Method = "External application".-Find the A2X Invoice then choose Edit.-For the items, the fields Description and Product Category are empty.-Cause-You set the wrong Product Type Code for the Product in the XML.-Resolution-If the product is a material, enter the tag  <ProductTypeCode>1</ProductTypeCode>.-If the product is a service, enter the tag  <ProductTypeCode>2</ProductTypeCode>.

Title: Error Message: Last Name Missing, during the Simulate Import Stage of Migration of Employee Data
Content: Symptom-Error Message: Last Name Missing in the Simulate Import stage during Migration of Basic Employee Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find Activity Migration of Employee Data - <Country>.-Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.-Upload the populated migration template.-Select Execute Migration button.-Choose to Execute Migration Step by Step.-Subsequently go to the Simulate Import stage after data validation and completing necessary value conversions.-Cause-The Last Name field cannot be marked as mandatory in the migration template for Basic Employee Data as this is mandated only by some countries, not all. For employees from countries like US, Germany, the field is mandatory, whereas countries like Mexico don't make it mandatory to have the Employee's Last Name on the organizational records.-Resolution-In case the migration tool is to throw such an error, kindly maintain a Last Name for all the employees and re-trigger the migration.-Keywords-Last Name, Migration, Employee Data, Country, Migration tool, Migration template, Organizational Records

Title: How to Find the Tenant Request Status and details of Change Test System?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document helps you to find out the different ways to find the status of Tenant Requests (only for tenants requested through Business Configuration work center).-Case 1: Business ByDesign Frontend-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Here, you can find the list of Change project and the respective System Status will be displayed. For example: Test System Available or Test System Request Sent.-Additional Information:-Select the link. For example: Test System Available or Test System Request Sent.-In the new pop-up, you can find the Request ID, Requestor and Requested Date/Time.-Points to be remembered:-If the pop-up doesn't have any information, then it is because that Change Test System is created/decommissioned out of BC process. Please refer to the case document 1817730 - No Records Found While Opening Test System Available link of a Change project-Case 2: Business ByDesign backend-Note down the Request ID as mentioned above.-Login to Backend of the system.-Use T-code Se16.-Open the table BCTD_WSTENANTREQ.-In the subsequent screen, provide the Request ID and Workspace ID, and execute the search.-Here, you can find the complete details where RESPONSE_TEN_ID is the Tenant ID and RESPONSE_TEN_URL is the Change Test system's URL.-If the REQUEST STATUS is 3, then the system is available.-Case 3: SPC-Login SPC.-Go to Cloud Landscape work center and Systems view.-Search and open the system (click system ID).-Under Tenants tab, you can find the list of Tenants for this particular system.-Search for the URL and select the Tenant ID link.-In the Build History tab, you can able to find the which is Source Tenant of this Test System.-Note: The above steps are actually vice-versa of steps used in Case 2.-Case 4: CMDB-As mentioned in Case 2, with the help of the details that you found. You can find the System Usage, Capacity and so on.

Title: Troubleshooting failed B2B PO XI messages
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-  If you come accross Failed XI Messages sent by supplier into BYD interface "PurchaseOrderProcessingOrderingIn" via B2B (For creation of Purchase Order Confirmation)-These instructions show you what the errors might look like and were to look for missing or wrong data.- The causes could be: -Failed B2B PO messages due to confirmed schedule lines missing- B2B messages with receiver interface name like PurchaseOrderProcessingOrderingIn are failing with error like “Schwere Laufzeitausnahme ausgelöst von Komponente ''. Einzelheiten finden Sie im Abschnitt 'Application Info' im Dump.”  Or “Fatal Runtime Exception triggered by component . Please see Application Info section in the dump for more details.”- Cause: The XML message does not have confirmed schedule line info which is required for PCO creation.-These should not be occurring anymore as Hotfix 46977 was deployed to prevent this issue back in April 2013- In any case, if you get these errors, you can check if all the data is present:- How to Identify:-1)      Click on the XML content of the PI message.-  2)      On the screen that opens up click on message body on the left hand side.-  3)      On the right hand side you will see a label called Purchase Order under which there will be 2 components.-ID --> this is the purchase order ID as sent by supplier.-Seller ID --> This is the supplier sales order ID sent by the supplier.- 4)      Under Items label there will be the below components-a)      “AcceptanceStatusCode” which can have the values “AP” “AJ” and “RE”.-b)      “ConfirmedScheduleLine” Which has the schedule line info like Delivery start date/end date etc.-  The following case will result in error and need to be resolved as below:---->  Acceptance status code is “AP” : Accepted in which case confirmed schedule line info is mandatory (confirmed quantity must be greater than 0) and must be provided. If this is not provided then PI message will fail. Only solution is for supplier to resend the message with confirmed schedule line info. We can cancel the failed PI message in this case as we can’t take any further action.- Failed B2B Po messages with invalid PO ID's-B2B messages with receiver interface name like PurchaseOrderProcessingOrderingIn are failing with error like “Bestellung zu Bestätigung  nicht gefunden “ or “Purchase order for purchase order confirmation not found”.-Check xml content of the PI message as in step 1, 2, 3 above.  -The relevant information is again:-ID --> this is the purchase order ID as sent by supplier.-Seller ID --> This is the supplier sales order ID sent by the supplier.-It might look something like this:-Step 4. Login to BYD front end and check if the PO ID in the xml sent by the supplier (here BESTELLUNG 9.5.11) exists in the “Purchase requests and orders” work center using the query all purchase orders.-Step 5. If the PO exists send this to the Dev team for further analysis. If the PO does not exist inform the end user using the supplier sales order ID (1004357) as reference and have him ask the supplier to resend the PI message with the correct PO ID. This PI message can then be cancelled in the backend as no further processing can be done from our side.

Title: Default Value Limit for an Item in the Purchase Request in the Third Party Repair Scenario
Content: Symptom-How to set higher value than zero as a default value for an item in the Purchase Request created automatically in the Third party Repair Scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Requests view.-Select the Purchase request created from a source: Service Order.-In the Limit Item Details area you can see the Value Limit as zero in the Basic Data sub tab of Items tab. -Cause-By default the Net value of the Service Order will be zero and the same is picked as Value Limit in the Purchase request.-Resolution-You can set the higher value as a Value Limit in the purchase request by maintaining the Cost Estimate as required in the Service Order and release the Service Order.-Go to the Service Orders Work center.-Select Service Order Processing View.-Select the Service Order and go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select Add Row button and insert the Price Component as Cost Estimate.-Maintain the Amount as per your requirement.-The Limit Value also considers this amount and gets updated accordingly in the Purchase Request.

Title: Error Message "Permanent Establishment Missing" When Creating Material By Using Excel
Content: Symptom-When you create material by using excel, you get error message: Permanent establishment missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Product Data-Go to view Materials-Select New button and choose Material from Microsoft Excel-Upload fails with above error message.-Cause-The field Business Residence is not filled in the excel file.-Resolution-Download the latest version of excel file and fill the field Business Residence.

Title: Unable to Post the Supplier Invoice due to an Error Message: Postings not Permitted for the Project Task
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a supplier invoice because of an exception: Postings not Permitted for the Project Task.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice without Purchase Orders in Common Tasks.-Enter all mandatory details.-Choose Save. You get the error: Postings not Permitted for the Project Task.-Cause-You cannot post a supplier invoice against a project XYZ with status Closed or Hold.-Resolution-The closed project XYZ against which you want to post the supplier needs to be open. To revoke the closure of the closed project XYZ follow the below steps:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Select the Project XYZ and choose Edit -> Project Plan.-Go to the Basic Data subt ab and check the Project Status field which should be set to Closed .-Select the dropdown arrow of the Project Status field and select Revoke Closure.-Select the Save button.-Now you can post the supplier invoice. The status will change to Posted.

Title: Working Guidlines for Dispatching the Incidents to Focus Area Queue
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The aim of this document is to act as quick reference to dispatcher when dispatching of the incidents from Direct Support root queue like Direct Support-English or Direct Support-German, to a focus-area sub-queue.-The incident dispatcher will follow the below table while dispatching the incidents in general,-Kind of issue reported in the incident-Queue to be forwarded-Observations if any-Issues related to Financials topic area-DS-XX-Financials-Even issues in posting of Expense Reports-Issues related to core SCM, CRM and SRM business process-DS-XX-Logistics (CRM,SRM,SCM)-  Issues related to Human Capital Management, Projects, PLM, ByD Studio-DS-XX-Other ByD Topics-  Issues related to Analytics like Reports, KPI’s and FSI error / dump-DS-XX-Analytics/FSI-In most cases FSI errors cannot be identified from customer issues-Issues related to Foundation, Migration, Business Configuration work center and Forms like business documents selection, preview and content-DS-XX-BC/Forms/FND/MIG-Including issues with Service center extensions.-Issues related to migration tools. Migration Content issues should be dispatched to respective application area sub-queue.-Issues related to PI/XI, BTM, B2B integration, Outlook add on, TREX, Security / IAM and Server operations like database / Max DB-DS-XX-Technology & Arch-  Issues related to UI/Oberon, Fax/e mail/ Printing of business documents, Web browser and mobile application interface like barcode scanner,  telephony integration and any other mobile hand held devices-DS-XX-Client Infra, Mobile-If the issue is only in printing of Outbound Delivery and not with any other business documents forward to DS-XX-Logistics 1-Issues related to non-topic specific work center, Business Center usage, HCM, Projects, ByD Studio, PDI issues, system down situation and any other issue which doesn’t fit into any of the above-DS-XX-Other ByD Topics-Work centers like: Home, Application and user management and Service Control Center.-Additional points to be noted by the Incident Dispatcher-In some cases the incident has to be forwarded to a queue that is not mapped with the root work center-Kindly refer the below given examples . –-Issue relate to Project Invoicing view in Customer Invoicing Work Center follow the case doc 1579540-Issue relate to Employee Reimbursement or expense report follow the case doc 1507911-Issues relate to Accounts, Supplier, Contacts business partner data or Work Distribution related issues like so follow the case document 1588083-Issues related to non-topic specific work centers follow the case document 1511842.-Issues related to Business Center usage follow the central case document 1669910.-All incidents related to data migration should be assigned to BC/Forms/FND/MIG queue.-If you see incidents of type “Workflow” or "Test" on any of the regular support queues, please move these to Workflows – Internal only!! queue.-Incidents created as “Feedback to Development” should be assigned to CS Problems queue (as earlier).-Resolution

Title: Cannot change Field Extensions in Adaption Mode in a Partner Development Tenant
Content: Symptom-You cannot change Field Extensions in the Adaption Mode in a partner development tenant.-The following error message is displayed:-Operation not possible; user setting could not be determined.-Reproducing the Issue-This issue can be reproduced in any work center and any view. We will use the Marketing work center as an example.-Go to the Marketing work center and select the Leads view.-Open any lead and navigate to the General tab.-Select Adapt -> Enter Adaptation Mode in the menu bar.-Select Adapt -> Edit Screen in the menu bar.-Select Extension Fields-The following error occurs: Operation not possible; user settings could not be determined.-Cause-The system you are using is a partner development tenant. There are 2 possible reasons for this error message.-A. You are trying to adapt a partner field.-The mentioned user is not registered as a key user for the respective Add On Solution which is developed in this tenant.-B. You are trying to adapt a standard delivered field using the field extensions within the standard SAP Business ByDesign solution.-This is the correct and intended system behaviour. It is not possible to add customer fields (use the field extensions of the standard SAP Business ByDesign System) in partner development tenants.-Resolution-A. You are trying to adapt a Partner field.-The mentioned user is not registered as a key user for the respective Add On Solution which is developed in this tenant.-Please register the user via the ByDesign Studio and you can make this partner field visible in the adaption mode.-B. You are trying to adapt a standard delivered field using the field extensions within the standard SAP Business ByDesign solution.-It is not possible to add customer fields (use the field extensions of the standard SAP Business ByDesign System) in partner development tenants. You can only adapt the fields relevant to your solution.-

Title: No Time Intervals Selectable in the GR/IR Clearing Run.
Content: Symptom-You want to run the GR/IR Clearing Run for for a certain period of time. However in the data selection for the run you do not find the option to enter parameters for a time interval.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Enter the Periodic Task view and GR/IR Clearing.-Via New create a new GR/IR Clearing Run.-Enter the relevant parameters.-In the Period/Year field you do not see the option to enter a time interval.-Cause-The concept of the GR/IR Clearing Run is not to clear inventory effective amounts and quantities for a selected time interval but open sets with inventory-effective documents (e.g. inbound delivery) for a chosen period.-Resolution-Especially when the perpetual inventory valuation method is chosen it is recommended to perform the GR/IR Clearing Run at least once a month continuously in order to reflect an accurate view of the current inventory value.

Title: How Can Employee/Service Agent Maintain his/her Email Address in the System
Content: Symptom-How can Employee/Service Agent maintain his/her email address in the system-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self Services view and Self Services Overview sub view.-Select Edit My Contact Data link.-Here the Email field is not editable and grayed out in the system.-Cause-In the Employee Self Services activity Edit My Contact Data, email has been made read only due to security reasons. Employee/ Service Agent can no more maintain his/her workplace email address in the system.-Only HR administrator can maintain this for an Employee/Service Agent.-Resolution-The workplace email address can only be maintained by administrator not by employee/service agent himself/ herself.-To maintain the email address for:-(A) For Internal employees:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Regular Tasks view.-Select Change Workplace Contact Data task.-Search the Employee and enter Email under Communication Data.-(B) For Service Agent:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Service Agents view.-Select Service Agent and edit Email.-See Also-This information is also available in What's New: Employee Self Service.

Title: Is it Possible to Assign Managers for Multiple Org Units?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to assign Manager for multiple Org Units and would like to know, is there a simpler way other than maintaining manually one by one?-Resolution-It is not possible to maintain Managers for multiple Org Units through Mass Change or any other ways except maintaining it manually.-But, if you are migrating the Org Structures through Data Migration then it is possible to migrate Org Structure with Manager assigned for all the Org Units that you are migrating.

Title: How to find whether a Form is Modified Using Adobe LifeCycle Designer?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There is no fingerprint in the XML file, to distinguish, whether is modified by Easy Form Editor or Adobe Lifecycle Designer.-But there is a XREP attribute ( EDITORUSED ), to find out whether the XDP file modified by Easy Form Editor / Adobe Lifecycle Designer / UPLOADED from form template maintenance OWL (can consider this also as modified by Adobe Lifecycle Designer).-In simple terms:  (T-code: APXREP_BROWSER)-If EDITORUSED = <Blank> The SAP delivered form template. If EFE_ENABLED = X, that means this form template is compatible with Easy Form Editor.-If EDITORUSED = 1, Form template is modified using Easy Form Editor.-If EDITORUSED > 1, Form template is modified using Adobe Lifecycle Designer.-You can check the logic of to calculate value for this attribute ( EDITORUSED) @-CL_FLX_TEMPLATE_MNGR  -> IF_FLX_TEMPLATE~SAVE_FORM_VARIANT and-CL_TMPL_CO_IMPL  -> IF_FORMS_TMPL_CO~CREATE_TEMPLATE_VARIANT

Title: Troubleshoot the Xuser Entry -- Wrong User Name and Password
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to troubleshoot the Xuser entry, if you get an error message: Unknown User Name and Password for xuser.-Reproducing the Issue-Log in into OS level with site admin user name.-Check the database connectivity by executing the script R3trans -d.-You get the following error: 2EETW169 no connect possible:DBMS = ADABAS D--- DBNAME =R3trans finished (0012).-Cause-The issue with Sqlmode maintained wrongly in the xuser file instead of SAPR3.-XUSER Entry  2----------------Key                    :c-Username           :CONTROL-UsernameUCS2   :C.O.N.T.R.O.L. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .-Password            :?????????-PasswordUCS2     :?????????-PasswordUTF8     :?????????-Dbname             :G2H-Nodename          :vadbg2h-Sqlmode             : INTERNAL-Cachelimit           :-1-Timeout              :-1-Isolation             :-1-Charset              :<unspecified>-In the Sqlmode instead of SAPR3 you have INTERNALentry.-Resolution-Maintain the correct Username and Password by executing the below commands:-vsa0959:g2hadm 79> xuser clear -U DEFAULT-vsa0959:g2hadm 81> xuser -U DEFAULT -u SAPR3,JifnU4us -d <SID> -n vadb<sid> -S SAPR3 -t 0 -I 0 set-vsa0959:g2hadm 81> xuser -U c -u control,JifnU4us -d <SID> -n vadb<sid> -S SAPR3 -t 0 -I 0 set-After executing the above commands you can see the correct entry in the Sqlmode of Xuser entry.-As shown in screenshot the sqlmode entry should be SAPR3 rather than INTERNAL.-  Note: Regarding creation of xuser entries, there are several SAP notes available. -Example:-1542818   Changing DBM users-396492    Changing the CONTROL user-39439    XUSER entries for SAP DB and MaxDB-25591    Password change for DBM and DBA users -Also, refer https://wiki.sdn.sap.com/wiki/display/MaxDB/User+Concept for more information regarding users in MaxDB.-  Created by BYDMS-KB-IM-

Title: Is it Possible to Maintain Different Values for Fields Net Weight and Gross Weight Based on Subsidiary
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to maintain different values for the fields Net Weight and Gross Weight based on different Subsidiary in a Material Master Data. You would like to whether it is possible?-Resolution-The Net Weight and Gross Weight maintained in a Material is unique and cannot be maintained based on subsidiaries.

Title: Cannot Close Fiscal Period 001
Content: Symptom-You try to close fiscal period 001 of fiscal year YYYY, but the system gives the error message: Closing of period 001 not possible: Previous fiscal year not closed;-But you check in the system and find out that all the fiscal periods of the previous year are blocked.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose Open and Close Period under Common Tasks.-You can see the period 001 of fiscal year YYYY is opened.-You move on to close this period, but the system gives error message: Closing of period 001 not possible: Previous fiscal year not closed;-Cause-The system works as designed, as the previous year YYYY-1 is not closed, you cannot close the first period of YYYY.  Meanwhile, just closing all accounting periods of year YYYY-1 does not mean that the whole fiscal year is closed, once you have closed all accounting periods of the fiscal year to be closed for all closing steps, you have to close the fiscal year as a whole.-Resolution-Before you can close a fiscal year, the following prerequisites must be fulfilled:-The preceding fiscal year is closed.-You have performed the depreciation run for the fiscal year.-You have performed balance carryforward in the second step. This posts the following:-The closing balances for the balance sheet accounts and the opening balances in the following fiscal year. The Balance Carried Forward column indicates whether the balance sheet accounts have been carried forward.-The annual net profit/loss for the profit and loss accounts. The Result Posted column indicates whether the annual net profit or annual net loss was posted.-When balance carryforward is performed in the second step, the fiscal year is automatically locked against postings. Nevertheless, you still need to formally close the fiscal year before you can open a new (third) fiscal year:-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Select Set of Books and Assigned Companies subview.-Select the combination of Set of Books and Company in question, and choose Edit Fiscal Years.-Select the Fiscal Year YYYY-1, and then choose Close Fiscal Year.-The Fiscal Year Status of year YYYY-1 is then shown as Blocked, and you can go ahead and close period 001 of fiscal year YYYY.-For more information, please go to Help Center, and search Closing Fiscal Years.

Title: Error Message: DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1: employee XYZ cannot be moved to company ABC1. You will need to transfer the employee in the Personnel Administration work center
Content: Symptom-When you try to check or activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1: employee XYZ cannot be moved to company ABC. You will need to transfer the employee in the Personnel Administration work center-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures.-Check or Activate an Org Structure.-Cause-The Org Unit (in the employee XYZ belongs to) was actually belongs to the Company ABC but it has been moved under Company ABC1. This is not allowed because there are Employees assigned to this Org Unit and the Company ABC.--Note: The error message displaying might be for one of the employee but all the employees are affected because of this movement.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, You can either revert the changes, that is moving the Org Unit back to its original company ABC or transfer the Employees in the Org Unit to another Org Unit.

Title: Check the SPC Fix which has been Imported
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document describes how to check the SPC fix which has been imported.-Resolution-The hotfix can be checked with a hotfix ID or by the hotfix name (transport).-For example:-Hotfix ID: 46569-Transport: N4EK007127-  A merge is a group of transports (hotfix) which has to be implemented altogether.-There are two options to check whether the SPC fix has been imported or not:-Case A from transaction STMS_IMPORTC-Case B from transaction SE16 (Table E070) -Case A:-Go to transaction STMS_IMPORTC. -Select Ctrl + F to search the required transport.-Enter the transport name and search it. Here for example: ASPK036468ASPK036468-       4.   If a transport exists, it is displayed. If it does not exist, you get the error message as shown in the following screenshot:-  Case B:-Go to the transaction  SE16.-Enter E070 in the Table Name field and select F7 (table contents).-Enter the transport name in TRKORR field and  select Execute.-      4.  If no  transport exists, you can see the error message which appears at the bottom of the left side as the following screenshot:-  If you do not find the transport in STMS_IMPORTC as well as in SE16 (E070), check  the same in the VLAB systems.-Here the name of transport is K036468ASP, which means that you have to check for the system ASP.-Log in to the ASP system.-Log in to GUI using sapgui ldciasp 00 (VLAB DEV system).-The username and password are Username: DISPLAY and Password: SHOWME.-Go to transaction SE01.-Give the request number and select the Logs tab.-       6.  You get the complete logs for the request.-   7.  Here the transport ASPK036468 has been included in the merge RPCKZP400T.-   8.  Check for the merge RPCKZP400T in STMS_IMPORTC and SE16 (E070).-In STMS_IMPORT-In SE16 (Table name E070)-Here you can see that the transport was not shown in the first two transactions, as it was included in the merge. So you searched for the merge, and found the transport.-If the transport is included in the merge, then you cannot find the transport through STMS_IMPORT  and SE16 (Table name E070).-Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: Error Message: Copy of Main Solution Profile not Allowed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to request a new test system with the copy of a Solution Profile and the following error message is displayed:-Copy of main solution profile not allowed-System error; create an incident on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS component-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center.-Go to System view.-Select the Request System button.-Fille in the necessary information including the down time slot.-Select the OK button.-Cause-Once the system has gone live with the Initial Implementation project, the Copy Solution Profile option is reserved for change projects only. Hence the copy of the main solution profile is disallowed.-In this case, the Solution Profile you selected is checked as Active in the value help.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Only the Solution Profiles corresponding to change projects can be copied into a test system.-If the requirement is to have a dedicated test system, the customer can trigger the creation of a test tenant using on of these data source options:--1) Initial system => results in a DECOUPLED* initial tenant-2) Copy of source system => results in a DECOUPLED* 1-to-1 copy of the source tenant--*DECOUPLED: System would be isolated and BC merge would not work.-Additionally, for the error System error; create an incident on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS component, a support consultant is expected to act according to case document 1925401 - Issue creating system / tenant r1308 or later , ensure that the require Web Service operations are registered in the system before proposing solution.

Title: Error message: 'HTTP 404 not found' During Approval of Trip request via link available in Approval E-mail Notification
Content: Symptom-You received error message HTTP 404 not found while trying to approve Trip Request via link available in approval E-mail Notification.-Reproducing the Issue-You received an e-mail for approval of trip request.-Once you pressed the link in the e-mail for approval, You got the error message HTTP 404 not found.- Cause-User does not have authorization to use Approvals Work center because Business Role Approver is not assigned in Access rights.-Resolution-Go to the Application & User Management Work center.-Go to User and Access Management View and open Business User-Find the User and press Edit, Access rights.-Go to Business Role Assignment.-Assign the User to Business role Approver.

Title: Error Message: Payment Manually Cleared on Account of Company XXX (Company_Name) and Partner XXX (Partner_Name).
Content: Symptom-While trying to reverse a released bank statement or a released payment, the error message Payment Manually Cleared on Account of Company XXX (Company_Name) and Partner XXX (Partner_Name) is shown.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work centre.-Go to the Bank Statements View.-Find the bank statement you want to reverse and highlight the row.-Press the Actions button and select the option Reverse. Alternatively View the Bank Statement and press the Reverse button.-Input the posting date for the cancel bank statement.-Press the OK button-The error message: Payment Manually Cleared on Account of Company XXX (Company_Name) and Partner XXX (Partner_Name) is shown and the reversal of the bank statement cannot be completed.-Cause-One or several payments items included in the bank statement you want to reverse are cleared manually.-Resolution-From the error message and the bank statement details identify the business partner(s) (customer(s) or supplier(s) for which payment items have already been cleared.-Check the Account Monitor of the concerned business partner(s) for the related payment(s). Those payments should be with the status Cleared in the account monitor.-Go to the Receivables/Payables work centre.-Go to the Customers/Suppliers view.-Go to the Customers Accounts/Suppliers Accounts sub-view.-Select the concerned Customer(s)/Supplier(s) and click the View button.-Check the status on the related payments.-To be able to reverse the bank statement those payments needs to be open therefore the clearing has to be reset.-From the account Monitor press the Clearing ID link of the concerned payment.-Press the View All button.-Press the reset Clearing Button-Input a cancelation date and press the OK button.-Repeat the actions above for all payment already cleared included in the bank statement you want to reverse.-Once the clearing of all the concerned payments is reset the bank statement can be reversed.-Nota Bene:-The system reverses clearings automatically if they have been done either manually by Payment Clearing or when the clearing was done automatically as well.-Manual clearings, repostings or splits done on the account monitor have to be reversed manually via the reset clearing options.

Title: Checking if no End-to-End Analysis Workload Analysis for granularity hour are available for the EWA time frame for Java Memory Usage - Extractor Setup
Content: Symptom-This article explains how to check if no End-to-End Analysis (E2E) Workload Analysis (WA) for granularity hour are available for the EWA time frame for Java Memory Usage. You need to check the extractor setup status. -Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.1-Resolution-If you have no data for granularity hour either for the EWA time frame for Java Memory Usage-----Check extractor setup:-Open transaction E2E_EXTRACTOR_FWK-Select filter similar to below example (you need to check for extractors like WORKLOAD ANALYSIS (INTROSCOPE DATA) of type JAVA for your managed system)------The relevant target cube can be found in tab Extractor Detail → Configuration-----If the last status of the extractor is Red LED; stop; errors, please check the message from tab Extractor Log and follow the recommendations from the log message:----In case you cannot find such JAVA WORKLOAD ANALYSIS related extractors for your managed system:-Open transaction SOLMAN_SETUP-Go to Managed Systems Configuration-Select Technical System-Go to step Configure Automatically and click Edit-Select Activity Extractors Setup and click Execute Selected----If the issue will persist after re-run the Extractor Setup, please check the system landscape definition according to SAP note 1945186.-Keywords

Title: Administrator is Unable to Approve the Expense Reports
Content: Symptom-Administrator is unable to approve the Expense Reports.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cockpit Work Center.-Go to All Expense reports.  -In Advanced Search, select the Status Pending Approval & press Go.-Select any Expense Report & you will observe that Action button is disabled.-Cause-User can approve Expense Reports only once the Business role Approver is assigned to his Access Rights. Also it depends further upon company specific Multi-Step-Approval Process configuration.-Resolution-Administrator can assign approval tasks to the user(s) having Approver role assigned.-Go to the Application & user Management Work Center.-Go to Task distribution View & open Business Task Management.-Open the approval task lying as Unassigned items.-Select the task, press Actions button & then select Assign Items.-Click on the value help for Assign item.-You can assign the task to relevant approver.

Title: Expense Report show cost assignment of the employee, instead of Cost Assignment of receipts.
Content: Symptom-Expense report shows in the general tab the Cost Assignment of the employee, instead of Cost Assignment of receipts.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Travel and Expenses Work Center.-2. Go to Expense Reports View.-3. Search for Expense report.-4. Click on Edit.-5. You will see the cost assignment as XXXX which is the same of employee that the expense report was created.-6. Go to Receipts tab.-7. In Details click on Deviating Cost Assignment.-8. You will see all the receipts with a different cost assignment as General Tab.-Cause-This is the system correct behavior.-Resolution-The cost assignment shown in the General tab is for overall expense report and deviating cost assignment is entered in case you want a different one from the general for a specific receipt(s).--The final cost assignment of different amounts are shown in the Review tab or by clicking on the number of expense report.

Title: Journal Entry Voucher of type Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable does not Clear Invoice
Content: Symptom-A journal entry voucher of type Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable is posted against a receivables general ledger account, referencing a customer and corresponding open customer invoice XYZ over the full amount.-When checking the customer account monitor you notice that invoice XYZ is still listed as open.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Navigate to the Journal Entries view and choose Journal Entry Vouchers, click New.-As Journal Entry Type select Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable.-Add a receivable G/L account (e.g. Trade Receivables - Domestic), state the amount, Customer and Source Document reference.-Enter a balancing line referencing the same document and Post.-In order to check the invoice status in the customer account monitor proceed as follows:-Access the Receivables work center and select the relevant customer in the Customer Accounts view.-Press View and and access the tab Trade Receivables, Invoices/Payments.-You notice that invoice XYZ is still listed under Open Items.-Cause-Journal entry vouchers of type Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable are not intended to act as clearing document against the referenced customer invoice. -These transactions serve as manual adjustment merely affecting the General Ledger.-The referencing of invoice document XYZ is declaratory, and does not affect the open receivable.-Consequently neither in the Customer Account Monitor nor in the Document Flow of invoice XYZ or the resulting adjustment journal entry a corresponding Clearing ID is listed.-Resolution-In order to post adjustments against invoice XYZ, transactions affecting the sales ledger have to be employed. This can be effected by conventional receivable documents (e.g. credit memo) or by posting manual adjustments in the Customer Account Monitor.-Navigate to the Receivables work center and highlight invoice XYZ in the Customer Account Monitor.-Choose Clear Manually.-Here you have the option to Apply Discount or Credit stating a Payment Difference Reason.-In case you already posted an inaccurate Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable, this transaction may have to be reversed by editing the voucher and choose Reverse.-The same logic applies accordingly for journal entry vouchers of type Manual Entry for Accounts Payable.-Keywords-journal entry voucher; jev; Manual Entry for Accounts Receivable

Title: On dd/mm/yyyy duration of absences 8h exceeds planned working time 4h during Time Recording
Content: Symptom-You try recording time for an Employee and when you try entering the a new day with less hours as compared to the previous days the system throws an error On dd/mm/yyyy duration of absences 8h exceeds planned working time 4h.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Select Employees view-Select the particular employee and Click Edit-Go to Time Profile tab-Go to Work Schedule sub tab-Select the option Individual-Enter the entries-Cause-The system runs a cycle based on the first day or the hire day of the employee. If for example an employee works for three days in a week and has a day off for the other four days the system requires a cycle to be set for the first seven days. If you have maintained only three days then the system calculates the days as maintained and the next day though a day off for the employee will be considered as a working day by the system.-Resolution-Go to Time Administration work center-Select Employees view-Select the particular employee and Click Edit-Go to Time Profile tab-Go to Work Schedule sub tab-Select the option Individual-Enter the entries for all seven days as per the normal schedule-Kindly refer to the attachment for further clarification.

Title: What is the report E2E_EFWK_RESOURCE_MGR used for?
Content: Symptom-What is the report E2E_EFWK_RESOURCE_MGR used for?-Environment-Solution Manager 7.1-Reproducing the Issue-The report E2E_EFWK_RESOURCE_MGR can be resource intensive, what is it used for?-Cause-N\A-Resolution-E2E_EFWK_RESOURCE_MGR report (job EFWK RESOURCE MANAGER): This job is checking if data extractors defined within the EFWK in table E2E_ACTIVE_WLI are due to execution regarding their actual status described in table E2E_EFWK_STATUS. If data extractors are due, then they are executed in the managed systems via RFC calls due to the settings in the table E2E_RESOURCES.If no extractors are due, the report is finished immediately, generating no further workload. By default the job is scheduled every minute. Since ST710 SP1.-See Also-N\A-Keywords-EFWK-EWA-Extractors

Title: Unable to Save New Supplier Invoice Because of Error Message About Missing Company Tax Arrangement, but unable to Create a new Company Tax Arrangement also
Content: Symptom-When you try to save a new invoice system displays an error message: Company 10 not registered in Country United States, define tax number as Type 2.-Furthermore, the New button in the Company Tax Arrangements view in the Tax Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-New Supplier Invoice creation:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice With out Purchase Order link in the Common Tasks.-Fill in the details like: Supplier, items, ship to party-Select Save button.-System displays above error message.-New company Tax Arrangement creation:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select Company Tax Arrangements view.-The button New is disabled.-Cause-Tax authority is not created for the ship-to party location, in this case it is United States.-Resolution-You have to maintain the tax authority for the country - United States. Now the New button in the Company Tax Arrangement view of Tax Management work center will be enabled.

Title: It is not Possible to Add GLN in the Business Partner Which is not Marked as Account or Supplier
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to add GLN (Global Location Number) in the Business Partner which is not marked as account or supplier.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Show All Business Partners and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the business partner).-Edit the business partner XYZ and go to the General tab.-You can't find the Additional Identifiers option where GLN can be added.-Cause-Adding GLN to a Business Partner which is not of type account or supplier is not supported in the Busness ByDesign.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: Cannot Configure Providers in Expense Report Details
Content: Symptom-You want to configure the providers in expense report details, but there are no such options in ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Travel and Expenses and select common task New Expense Report on Behalf.-Select any employee and select Next.-Select Type of Expense Report as Business Trip, enter all required information and select Next.-In step Receipts, select Add Row and select Receipt Type as Hotel.-In the section of Other Details, you can see there is field named Provider. It contains a drop down list. You want to add more providers in this drop down list. But there is no such option in system.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to configure provider details as they are pre-delivered by SAP.-Resolution-In case you have other provider details which need to be added, please use Additional Provider field that can be seen right down the provider field, so that details can be saved along with the expense report.

Title: Is it Possible to Assign Work Schedule Based on days per year While Creating an Employee
Content: Symptom-You are Hiring Employees in your Organization and observed that the Work Schedule is based on hours/day/week. You would like to know, whether it is possible to assign Work Schedule based on days/per/year?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Hire an Employee.-Step 2 indicates the number of hours per day or per week.-Resolution-This is general system behavior and it is not possible to have Work Schedule based on days per year.

Title: Error Message "Instance with the same key already exists", While Creating a Product Category
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a new Hierarchy in Product Category, system throws below error message:-Instance with the same key already exists-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Product Categories view.-Select New Hierarchy button.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The issue might have occurred because of locking (ex: same screen open in another window or another user tried to create the hierarchy)-Resolution-Please check whether any other user is trying to create a New Hierarchy and try to create the Product category again.

Title: Scheduling Background Job With Different User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-SP_ADMIN user credentials expire in short durations. Scheduling and running a job for more than 5 hours makes the user credentials lose the validity.-Resolution-Change the user from SP_ADMIN to DDIC without rescheduling or deleting the existing job.-1. Log in with SP_ADMIN user and run the transaction SM37.-2. Enter the job name as in the following example: <SAP_CCMS_MONI_BATCH_DP>, username as '*'.-3. Title: Duplicate Check Not Working for Private Accounts
Content: Symptom-You have created 2 similar private accounts and hope system can recognize and report error. But system does not give error message.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center,-Go to Common Tasks: New Private Account.-Create 1 private account with name ABD, which is quite similar to account ABC.-Choose Check For Duplicates, but no error message appears.-If you check in Business Configuration, you can find check profile is already set as Strong Check.-Cause-Strong check only searches duplicate business partners with high similarity. So the weaker the rule is, the more possible duplicates are returned by the system.-Percentage for duplicate check is as follow:-Strong Check: 90%-Medium Check: 80%-Weak Check:   70%-So if you only enter name ABC and ABD, then similarity rate is 66%, lower than any of check profile. That's the reason duplicate check fails and no error message comes out.-Resolution-Set duplicate check profile by following below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Choose Edit Project Scope then go to step 2 Scoping, tick Business Partners within General Business Data.-In the Questions step, expand General Business Data and select Business Partners.-Select Handling of Business Partners and answer the questions related to the duplicate check for business partners.

Title: PI - Execution Error in SAPLSPAF_RUNTIME_UTILITIES
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Dumps with Execution Error are displayed in SAPLSPAF_RUNTIME_UTILITIES.-You can find the dumps in the transaction ST22 and the actual error text in the variable L_ORIG_ERROR_TXT in the section Active Calls/Events.-- Resolution-The following solution is for the error SRT: Unexpected failure in SOAP processing occurred.-1. Find the Sender Communication Party, Sender Service, Receiver Communication Party and Receiver Service from variables IM_LOC_PARTY, IM_LOC_SERVICE, IM_REM_PARTY, IM_REM_SERVICE respectively. Log in to the back end and execute the transaction SXI_CACHE.-6. Check if the configuration is available in the cache. If the configuration is not available, there is an issue with cache refresh. Send the incident to BC-XI-IBC for analysis.-7. If the entries are available in the cache, send the incident back to the customer to check if the dump is still exists or not.-8. If the dump is there again, send the incident to BC-ESI-WS-ABA for further analysis.-   Created by BYDMS-KB-PI-See Also-Additional Info:

Title: Cannot Post nor Cancel Warehouse Confirmation in General Ledger. Error: Referenced Purchase Order not found
Content: Symptom-Unable to post or cancel a warehouse confirmation in the Closing Cockpit.-Error displayed: Referenced Purchase Order not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Open the Closing Cockpit view.-Open the Source Documents subview.-Select the relevant Warehouse Confirmation.-Observe the error message: Referenced Purchase Order not found.-Cause-The purchase order item was canceled before the warehouse confirmation was processed.-Resolution-For future cases, cancel the warehouse confirmation before canceling the related purchase order.-If already affected, create a support case and request a manual correction to mark the warehouse confirmation as irrelevant.-Keywords-posting failure, cancellation error, PO reference missing, document linkage issue, period close, GL closing, source document error, manual correction request, support case, process sequence, order cancellation timing, goods confirmation, document not found, inbound confirmation, backend correction

Title: Wrong Postings after Uploading Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-After importing a bank statement, you find that some of the automatically created postings are not according to your intentions.-For example: a wrong G/L account has been posted against, or you find that no automatically posting should have been conducted at all.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You import a bank statement in one of the of the accepted formats (for example, MT940 for Germany) via work center Liquidity Management / View Inbound Files view.-The bank statement is processed automatically. Consequently, post-processing is not required.-Under work center Liquidity Management / view Bank Statements you click on Postprocessing -> Not Required.-Via the relevant bank statement line, you get to the corresponding Payment Allocation containing the automatically generated Journal Entry.-Cause-Usually, a bank statement file issued by bank comes with predefined external operation codes (External Transaction Codes) which describe a set of bank transactions (for example, direct debit, check redemption, standing order).-The automatic bank statement processing, and therefore the creation of automatic postings for certain events, depends on the definitions made in the Fine Tuning in work center Business Configuration / Automatically Generated Bank Statements activity, and the mapping of External Transaction Codes and Internal Transaction Codes for maintained import file formats.-Resolution-Check the following settings under:-Work center Business Configuration / Fine Tuning, Activity: Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Here you find the mapping of External Transaction Codes and Internal Transaction Codes.-For example:-External Transactions Codes for 'Closing' or 'Commission' are mapped under Internal Transaction Code 'Payment Processing - Of Outgoing Bank Fees'.-In case no particular G/L Account is stated here, the settings in G/L Account Determination for Cash are taking effect.-Go to Fine Tuning Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination / Cash.-Here you will find the relevant G/L Account under the Tab Interest/Charge.-In case you want to prevent the system from automatically posting transactions for certain transactions, the mapping between External Transaction Code and Internal Transaction Code must be canceled.-Under work center Business Configuration / Fine Tuning, Activity: Automatically Generated Bank Statements the field for 'Internal Transaction Code' has to be left blank.-       Keywords-bank statement upload; External Transactions Codes; g/l accounts; internal transaction codes; Automatically Generated Bank Statements

Title: Mini Scenario SRM : Procure-to-Pay (Stock) - variant: Supplier Return and PO Update
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Summary:-1) Create a purchase proposal from Supply Control for a material.-2) Purchase Request is created and follow-up Purchase Order is sent out to the supplier.-3) Inbound Delivery is created upon receiving the material.-4) Material is faulty and must be returned to the supplier: New Return to Supplier Request.-5) Change the Delivery Data on the PO and send the updated PO to the supplier.-6) Once again, Inbound Delivery is created upon receiving the material.-7) Create a Supplier Invoice based on the PO and Delivery.-8) Check the invoice in General Ledger work center.-9) Pay the invoice via Outgoing Check. Check that the invoice is automatically cleared with the payment.-1) Supply Control work center-Go to the Supply Control work center.-Choose the task New Planning Proposal.-Choose a Product ID corresponding to a 'Purchased' Product (cf. Master Data of the product).-Choose a Panning Area ID and Quantity.-Choose Save. A Purchase Proposal is created.-Go to the view Process Purchase Proposals.-Find the previous purchase proposal and choose Release.-Go to the view Monitor Purchase Requests.-Choose Open Purchase Requests to find the relevant PR.-Note: In case the system is configured in a way that a PO is created automatically for the Product, no open PR will be found.-Go to the view Monitor Purchase Orders.-Choose Open Purchase Orders to find the relevant PO.- 2) [Optional (in case the PO is not ordered automatically)] Purchase Requests and Orders work center (in case the PO is not ordered automatically)-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Find the relevant purchase request and choose Edit.-Enter the relevant info.-Choose Check and then Post--3) Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Mark the PO created above and choose 'Post Goods Receipts'.-Enter ID and Quantity then choose Save and Close.-4) Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center-Choose the task New Return to Supplier Request.-Select the PO and choose Next.-Enter a Quantity then choose Next.-In step 3, choose Finish.-In Step 4, click the link Post Goods Issue for Return to Supplier Document XYZ.-In the new activity, enter the Actual Quantity and Source Logistics Area ID.-Choose Release and then Save and Close.-5) Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find the relevant purchase order and choose Edit.-Go to the Items tab.-Increase the delivery date by a week.-Click the button Send Update.-(in the tab Output History, a form Changed PO will be sent to supplier).-Close the PO.-6) Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Mark the PO created above and choose 'Post Goods Receipts'.-Enter ID and Quantity then choose Save and Close.--7) Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Mark the PO and choose New Invoice.-Enter External Document ID, Invoice Date.-Press Check and choose Post.-8) General Ledger work center-Go to the General Ledger work center-Go to the Closing Cockpit View and Source Documents subview.-Verify that the supplier invoice has status Finished.-9) Payables work center-Go to the Payables work center-Go to the view Supplier Accounts.-Mark the relevant supplier and choose View.-Mark the relevant invoice and choose Pay Manually By -> Outgoing Check.-Choose Post to generate the Payment. Choose Close.-Check that the invoice and payment have been cleared automatically while opening the related Clearing ID.-Resolution

Title: System Dumps While Creating a New Plan Version
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While creating new plan version for a new fiscal year for a company from an existing plan for previous fiscal year the system is dumping in the termination program CL_A1FIA_FIN_PLAN_OIF_ECO.-The dump is visible in the backend via transaction ST22.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work centre.-Go to the Planning view.-Select an existing Plan.-Click the New button and select the Plan Version option.-Go to General tab and check the Income Statement in use. -Go to Versions tab and click New button  and select Version from Actuals option.-In Pop-up window give a value for New Version ID and Copy Actual Data from Fiscal Year, press OK.-The system dumps and no new plan version is created.-Cause-The reporting structure set as income statement is inconsistent.-Resolution-Check the consistency of the Financial Reporting Structure set as Income Statement when creating the new plan version.-In Business Configuration, Go to the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Press Edit financial reporting structures.-Edit the Financial Reporting Structure set as Income Statement when creating the new plan version.-Check the consistency of the structure. it is likely that the structure is inconsistent.-One known inconsistency is having GL accounts assigned under item where there should not be any, like item node Net income/Net loss.-Amend the inconsistent reporting structure to make it consistent and initiate the creation of a new plan version.

Title: New Clarification Request Option is Disabled for an Open Item
Content: Symptom-The document describes why the new clarification request option is disabled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Work view.-Select the Inbox subview.-Select the Open Clarification.-Cause-There are different types of tasks in the open items. If a task is of the type Clarification, then you cannot create a clarification request via New->Clarification Request. A clarification task is created by the system which describes how you can correct data which is inconsistent or not clear. Therefore, the New button is disabled for a clarification task.-See Also-Overview of Clarification Requests:-A clarification request is designed to support a question and answer process between users. You can start the process from anywhere in the system whenever you need additional information from another user to further process a business document or task. A clarification request is always created in relation to a business document or task.-Clarification Requests in Detail:-Sending a Clarification Request: -As the sender of a clarification request you can give it a title and enter details. You can also add attachments and set a due date by which an answer is needed. Finally, you can give the request a priority level indicating its importance to the recipient. It is not possible to   send a clarification request to a group or a department, it can only be sent to individual users. You can send a clarification request to any user. The recipient of a clarification request can open the related documents, depending on their access rights. Should the recipient not have the necessary access rights, they will have access to the details of the clarification request only, not to the related business document or task.-Receiving a Clarification Request:-Clarification requests display in the Inbox subview of the Work view in the Home work center. The recipient of the clarification request can send a reply that includes his or her answer. As the sender of the request you then become the recipient of their response. They can also forward the request if another user needs to be involved.-Tracking a Clarification Request:-Responses to your clarification request display in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center. If, as the sender of the clarification request, you receive the expected response, you can finalize and complete it. However, if the request needs further clarification, you can either return the response to the same user or forward it to another user.

Title: Use of a Deviating Dunning Address During Dunning Process.
Content: Symptom-The use case refers to invoices where the Account differs from the Bill-to Party and/or the Payer. The subsequent dunning document will be sent to the Account address and not the Bill-to Party and/or the Payer address.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite:-A dunning document is generated for an invoice where the Account differs from the Bill-To-Party and/or the Payer.-Go to the Receivables work centre.-Go to the Periodic Task view, Dunning Runs sub-view.-Perform an active dunning run.-Dunning proposals are generated and can be reviewed. The dunning document is addressed to the Account address and not to the Bill-to Party or Payer address.-Cause-The liability resides with the Account stated on the invoice not with the Bill-to Party or the Payer. the Account is the debtor and it is of his responsibility to ensure that the liability will be paid according to the payment terms specified on the invoice.-The debtor can have an agreement that another partner will pay for his liabilities or is invoiced for it, but still a Dunning will be sent to the debtor. In the same way, the liability is shown on the Account's account monitor in Receivables not on the Bill-to Party or Payer's account.

Title: How to Prevent Voided Checks for Extended Remittances
Content: Symptom-When you use the check printing option and print a check which involves a numerous lines in the remittance (beyond 41 line) the application is using the next checks (as many as needed) to continue the remittance. those checks will then be voided. Is it possible to avoid to have those checks printed and then voided and instead print the last on the remittance line on plain paper and not on pre-numbered check forms.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite:-The Pre-numbered Check Forms flag has to be checked in the check lot.-Go to the Liquidity Management work centre.-Go to the Masterdata view.-Go to the My Banks sub-view.-Select the bank for whcih the bank account from which the check iis drawn belongs to and click the Edit button and select the Bank Accounts option.-Go to the Check Lot Tab and verify if the flag Prenumbered Check Forms is checked or not.-Initiate an outgoing check payment which involves payment of multiple (more than 41) line items-Go to the Liquidity Management or Payment Management work centre.-Click on the New Outgoing Check link from the Common Tasks zone.-Enter the necessary data and select multiple open items (more than 41) which are paid with the check.-click the Print Check Form button.-The check is printed and the long remittance is using the following checks which are then automatically voided-Cause-If the Pre-numbered Check Form is flagged is active the page break logic will be used, voiding the additional used checks.-If it is not active the check and the remittance items will be printed but no checks will be voided.-There is no possibility of printing check first and the remaining remittance items later in a separate print run.---Resolution-If there are to many open invoices which are paid with the outgoing check, one way to avoid to have the next pre-numbered check form used and voided is to split the payment.-Instead of one outgoing checks for the full number of open invoices create 2 separate checks including each an inferior number of open invoices.-It might occur that the check print form in use is not the standard form delivered by SAP. In this case the total amount of open invoice listed in the stub might vary.

Title: Is it Possible to Delete a Business Partner Which was Created Twice With Same Name
Content: Symptom-You have created two Business Partners with same name and would like to know, whether one of the Business Partner can be deleted?-Resolution-In Principle, a Business Partner is a Master Data and it can not be removed from the system. Because these datas are intended to be used in other business transactions (CRM, HCM and so on) and deleting these datas will result in inconsistency in those documents. Hence the system is designed in such way that you cannot delete these datas but you are allowed to Block or Obsolete these datas.-Here is the evaluation of status of Business Partner:-In Preparation: It is not possible to use the Business Partner in any other business transaction documents.-Active: All business documents are allowed to create references with this status value. This status value is a prerequisite for the consistency of the reference.-Blocked: Business documents are only allowed to create new references with this status when they can save inconsistent data.-In contrast, if the Business documents which already have a reference to a meanwhile blocked Business Partner can finish their process / do not need to change their behavior.-Obsolete: It is not allowed to create references to Business Partner with this status because the intention of this status value is that the Business partner gets archived.-So, you can block the status of the Business Partner as per above evaluation.

Title: IAM - Check Whether the Password are Correct or Incorrect
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to find whether the password is correct or incorrect.-Resolution-1. Log in to the back end of the system through user DDIC.-2. Enter the transaction SE37.--3. Enter SUSR_CHECK_LOGON_DATA in the Function Module field.-4. Select Test/Execute (F8) button.--5. Enable the Uppercase/Lowercase checkbox button.-6. Enter the AUTH_METHOD field as P.-7. Enter the user name (that has to be checked) in the USERID field.-8. Enter the password in the PASSWORD field.-9. Select the Execute button.--10. If the given password is correct, the below screen is displayed with no exception.--11. If the given password is incorrect, the below screen is displayed with Exception: USER_OR_PASSWORD_INCORRECT.--Created by BYDMS-KB-IM

Title: Error Message "Timeline of Org Unit XYZ Should be Changed in Future only" While Activating the Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you try to Check or Activate an Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-Timeline of Org Unit XYZ should be changed in future only-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit button or Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Unit or Org Structure.-Select Check All or Activate All option.- Cause-The cause for the issue is that you are trying to end the validity of the Org Unit XYZ to a past date. The reason for this behavior is, this Org Unit might have the Sales functions assigned to it. Because Sales Properties should be changed in future only. When the Sales Properties are changed in the past, reporting related to Sales may become inconsistent.-Resolution-To overcome this issue, the validity of the Org Unit XYZ should be ended in future date only. It can be performed either of the below steps:-Using Effective From Date:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective Date as on or after two days from current date (Ex: if the todays date is 13/7/2012, then the effective from date should be on or after 15/7/2012)-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ.-Select Edit Org Unit button and choose End validity.-Now, the Org Unit's validity will end by Next day's date (Ex: 14/7/2012), which is a future date.-Now, you can able to activate the Org Unit.-Using Timelines Tab:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Unit XYZ.-Go to Timelines tab.-Change the Valid To date of the Org Unit to a future date (Ex: if the todays date is 13/7/2012, then the Valid To date should be on or after 14/7/2012)-Select Enter key in the keyboard.-Now, you can able to activate the Org Unit.
