Title: The Data Shown in Balance Sheet and Income Statement Report is Wrong
Content: Symptom-You execute the statutory report Balance Sheet and Income Statement, you then preview the result, and find out that for the balance sheet, the Year Ended amount for the Comparison Year is not right.-This issue is specific to Chinese customers.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Statutory Reports subview.-Open Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China.-Choose Blank Report Run under New to create a blank report.-Select Company, Set of Books, Balance Sheet Structure, and Income Statement Structure.-In the Type Code field, choose 3 Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement.-In the Year field, enter YYYY.-In the Comparison Year field, enter YYYY -1.-Set Period From/To as 012 and 012.-Set Balance Sheet Structure as as CN - Balance Sheet.-Set Income Statement Structure as CN - I/S by Function of Expense.-Select Next and preview to open the PDF document.-Then you can find for the Balance Sheet and Income Statement, the year-beginning balances are wrong.- Cause-Since Feature Pack 3.0, the Balance Sheet and the Income Statement are created together. For Type Code 3 -Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement, Balance Sheet is created for Period To and Year, and comparison amount for Comparison Period To and Comparison Year. Meanwhile, for Income Statement for the respective time spans, which means from Period From to Period To specified. This means, the respective texts on the form template are wrong, correct would be Comparison Period. Since Feature Pack 3.5, an additional Type Code 5 -Compare opening balance sheet, changes for income statement, with which, the Balance Sheet is created for the opening balance, and the Income Statement is created for respective Comparison Period.- Resolution-If you set the Type Code as 3 -Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement , you can execute the report twice to generate the required Balance Sheet and Income Statement report:-First of all, execute the report for the Balance Sheet.-Choose Blank Report Run under New to create a blank report.-Select Company, Set of Books, Balance Sheet Structure, and Income Statement Structure.-In the Type Code field, choose 3 Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement.-In the Year field, enter YYYY.-In the Comparison Year field, enter YYYY -1.-Set Period From/To as 012 and 012.-Set Balance Sheet Structure as as CN - Balance Sheet.-Select Next and Finish.-Second of all, execute the report for the Income Statement for the respective year.-Choose Blank Report Run under New to create a blank report.-Select Company, Set of Books, Balance Sheet Structure, and Income Statement Structure.-In the Type Code field, choose 3 Cumulative balance sheet, changes for income statement.-Specify the Year and Comparison Year.-Specify the Period From/To and Comparison Period From/To.-Set Balance Sheet Structure as as CN - Balance Sheet.-Set Income Statement Structure as CN - I/S by Function of Expense.-Select Next and Finish.-You should be able to get the required report data as expected.-

Title: Error Message: Sales properties of () should be changed in future only. When the sales properties are changed in the past, reporting related to Sales may become inconsistent
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate a Organizational Structure, system throws below error message-Sales properties of () should be changed in future only. When the sales properties are changed in the past, reporting related to Sales may become inconsistent-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org Structure.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.-Note: You had unchecked the Sales Properties in the Org Unit XYZ in a past date and assigned Sales Property to another Org Unit ABC.-Cause-The cause for the error message is might be because below reasons,-You are try to delimit the sales Properties of any Sales Organization, Sales Unit or Service organization to a Past date.-You are try to delimit the sales Properties of any Sales Organization, Sales Unit or Service organization to a Present date itself.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Sales Properties of any Org Unit should be delimited only on a future date but not on past date/present date. The system doesn't allow because, that will end up in inconsistent Sales Document.-So, you can delimit the Sales Property of an Org Unit to a future date.-To resolve the issue, you should delimit the validity of the Sales Organization function of XYZ to a future date and then assign the Sales Organization back to ABC.--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures.-3. Set the Effective from date as DD.MM.YYYY (the date when the XYZ was unassigned as Sales Organization and made Org Unit ABC as Sales Organization).-4. Highlight the Org unit ABC.-5. Go to Functions tab.-6. Uncheck Sales Organization function.-7. Highlight the Org Unit XYZ.-8. Go to Timelines tab.-9. Change the Valid To of the Sales Organization and Sales to DD1.MM1.YYYY1 (This date should be at least tomorrow's date if you are delimiting the validity today)-10. Set the effective from date as DD2.MM2.YYYY2 (This date should be at least next day of DD1.MM1.YYYY1)-11. Highlight the Org unit ABC.-12. Go to Functions tab.-13. Check Sales Organization function.-14. Select Check and choose Check all.--Now, you can able to activate the Org Structure.-

Title: How to Re-activate the Cost Center which was Delimited in the Past?
Content: Symptom-You have delimited (End Validity) an Cost Center in a past date and after some times, you wants to activate again as a Cost Center. This document helps you with step by step procedure to re-activate the Cost Center.-Resolution-There are two possible ways that you can reactivate the Cost Center which was delimited, they are--To extend the validity again from the last valid date:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-3. Set the Effective Date (This date should be a date when the Cost Center was valid, this should be a past date).-4. Highlight the Org Unit.-5. Go to Timelines tab.-6. Change the Valid From date of the Cost Center attribute to a future date.-7. Activate the Changes.--To reactive as Cost Center but with different Time Period:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-3. Set the Effective Date (This date should be a date when you want this Cost Center should valid again, this may be a future date).-4. Highlight the Org Unit.-5. Go to Definitions tab.-6. Check the Cost Center attribute.-7. Activate the Changes.

Title: How to Clear Extra Down Payment
Content: Symptom-In the Trade Receivables account of the customer, there is a down payment which is a little more than an open invoice item, now you want to manually clear these two items once for all, but the system only allows you to partially clear the down payment, which is not desired.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customers Accounts sub view.-Choose Customer XYZ, and then select View.-In the Trade Receivables tab, show Open Items.-You can see a customer invoice, and a down payment whose amount is just a little more than the customer invoice.-Select these two items, and choose Clear Manually.-In the new screen, it's not possible to completely clear these two items, and the down payment can only be set as Partially Cleared.-Cause-In the SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not supported to set tolerant amount for the document type down payment.-Resolution-In order to completely clear the down payment all at once, you may create New Charge/Credit to clear the extra amount in the down payment, after that you can clear multiple invoices with the down payment.-The detailed steps are as follows:-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customers Accounts sub view.-Choose Customer XYZ, and then select View.-Choose New Charge/Credit to create an other receivable with the difference between the down payment and the customer invoice.-Now go to the Trade Receivables tab, show Open Items.-Select the down payment to be cleared, the invoice in question, and the other receivable just created.-Choose Clear Manually.-You should be able to completely clear the down payment at one time.-Keywords-trade receivables, down payment, New Charge/Credit

Title: How to Change the Accural Assigned to Time Accounts?
Content: Symptom-How to change the Accural assigned to time accounts after the system has gone Live.-Scenario:-An initial accural of XYZ hours has been assigned to time account of an employee before system goes live. But now you want to change/remove the accural assigned to that time account after go-live. And the time account has been used by employees.-Resolution-If the time account has been used in the time profile of emloyees then the changes in Business Configuration work center to the account data (recurrence) is not allowed anymore.-Therefore, it is recommend to create a new time account and replace the old time account with this newly created time account in the employee's time profiles.-This will trigger a re-calculation of account balance automatically and thus no extra correction run trigger is needed. -Follow the steps to create a time account and assign the time account to the employees:--To create time account: --1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Select Activity list view.-3. Select Fine-Tune chevron (arrow).-4. Select Time Accounts activity.-5. Select Maintain Time accounts link .-6. Select Add button and fill in the Time account name and other details as per your business need.-7. Select Save and Close button.--To assign the newly created time account to an employee:--1. Go to Time Administration work center.-2. Select Employees view. -3. Search and select the employee.-4. Select Edit button.-5. Go to Time Profile tab and Time Account Rules sub-tab.-6. Select the Add Row button and set the newly created time account in the row.-7. Select Save button.

Title: How to Find the Change History of Material Cost Rate?
Content: Symptom-There are some changes in the Material Valuation Cost but the change history of the Material doesn't show anything.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Search and Edit the Material.-Go to Changes tab.-Cause-In the Changes tab of the Material, changes of Cost Rate can be found only if they were performed in the Materials.-If the changes to the Cost Rate were performed via Inventory Valuation they won't be displayed.-Resolution-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Select Material Unit Costs sub view under Master Data view.-Select All Unit Costs and search for the Material.-Highlight the material ID with the respective Business Residence ID/Company.-Select View Cost History button.-All the change documents can be seen.-Keywords-cost rate; cost history; material; product data; Material Valuation Cost

Title: Is it Possible to Migrate Business Partner with Roles Account?
Content: Symptom-Is it Possible to Migrate Business Partner with roles Account and Supplier?-Resolution-It is not possible to migrate the Business Partner with the roles Account.-You can migrate the Business Partner only with roles Supplier and Customer. It is not possible to migrate a Business Partner directly as a Supplier or Customer. First, you should migrate the Suppliers or Customers using the activities Migration of Suppliers or Migration of Customers respectively. Then you can migrate the Business Partner Relationships using the activity Migrate business partner relationships using the migration tool.-

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-PI (Process Integration) message ends with the application error: XSLT-Ausnahme bei Offset XX , XPath nm:CustomerReturnExecutionRequestXXCustomerReturnXXItemXX.-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the back end.-Enter the transaction SRT_MONI.-Enter the message ID.-Select Execute.-Select the message and select Error Log.-You can see the error under short text: XSLT-Ausnahme bei Offset XX , XPath nm:CustomerReturnExecutionRequestXXCustomerReturnXXItemXX.-Cause-The XI messages for the Customer Return is failing because for Customer Return XXX, item XX Reference is not maintained, Organization Data is missing, Currency For Account is not maintained etc...-Resolution-Ask the customer to maintain all the missing data for Customer Return XXX.-Note: You should provide the Customer Return ID and Item number details to the customer.-Once the customer confirms that the required action is taken, you can restart the stuck XML messages.-Created By ByDMS-KB-PI-

Title: Supplier Invoice With Status Posted is not Displayed in the Supplier Account
Content: Symptom-You created a cancelation invoice for a supplier invoice with status Paid but the supplier account is not updated accordingly.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memo view.-Select the invoice created and select Edit button.-You can see the status of the supplier invoice as Paid.-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the Supplier Accounts view.-Select the Supplier (used in the invoice) and select View button.-Here the cancelation invoice is not displayed.-Cause-You have made some changes in the paid supplier invoice which are not posted to accounting successfully  and a task is created in the General Ledger work center. Then cancelation invoice is  posted but a task is created because of pending tasks of the original supplier invoice .-Since the posting of both invoices is unsuccessful, supplier account is not updated with the cancelation invoice.-Resolution-According to the error messages please try to do the required settings and post the tasks sequentially .-First the supplier invoice task has to be posted and then the cancelation invoice has to be posted.

Title: GTIN can not be Edited in Material Master Data
Content: Symptom-You want to edit GTIN in Material Master Data view,but the field is uneditable.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Product Data.-Select view Materials.-Select any material and select Edit button, the Edit Material Screen opens.-Under the General Tab, Select the link UoM Characteristics.-The GTIN field is uneditable. -Cause-The GTIN can only be maintained for trading units like EA, XBX. For all physical units like KGM the GTIN field will be disabled.-Resolution-Ensure that you have not entered any physical unit like KGM as Unit of Measure (UoM) for the GTIN field to be editable.

Title: The Option 'Function of costs and PrCtr/segment' not Available for Reporting Principle while Creating Set of Books
Content: Symptom-While creating a new set of books the option Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg is not present for Reporting Principle.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the button Open Activity List.-Go to Integrate and Extend.-Select activity Set of Books -> Maintain Set of Books.-Select New -> Set of Books.-Notice that the option Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg is not available for Reporting Principle field.-Cause-Profit center and segment reporting is not selected in the scoping.-Resolution-The project scope needs to be edited:-Select Financial and Management Accounting -> General Ledger.-Go to Questions.-Here select the question:-You can create financial reports based on segments and profit centers.-This question should be answered Yes.-Once this is done the option Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg becomes available for Reporting Principle while creating a set of books.-Keywords-Function of costs and PrCtr/segment; Funct of exp, profit ctr/seg; Income Statement by Function of Expense; Profit Center Accounting and Segment Reporting

Title: Is it Possible to Create More Than one Root Product Category Hierarchy?
Content: Symptom-In the process of creating Product Category Hierarchy, you may have a requirement to create more than one Product Category Hierarchy. But after creating a single Product Category Hierarchy, you could find that the New Hierarchy button is disabled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Product Categories view.-After creating a first Product Category Hierarchy, the New Hierarchy button is disabled.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-If you want to create more than one Product Category Hierarchy, then it is a Classification Concept but not a Category Concept. SAP Business ByDesign supports only Category Concept.  So it is not possible to create more than one Product Category Hierarchy.

Title: Making a Company Obsolete in Organizational Management
Content: Symptom-You have multiple comapnies defined in Organizational Management and you want to make a company obsolete.-Resolution-You can use Edit Timelines functionality to make a company obsolete.-Editing the Timelines:-You can set the end date of a company here. To do so-Goto Edit Organizational Structure.-Select an effective date and select the top Org Unit of the respective Company.-Goto the  Timelines tab and change the Value of Valid To date of Company field under Definitions. The date needs to be set to a date when the company becomes obsolete.-Here it is possible that Veto Check messages thrown if there are open business documents or Business residence is defined or Cost centers has been assigned. You may see the following error messages- <Start_Date> to <End_Date>; business residence XXXX cannot be moved from its current company. The business residence is a legal property that is permanently linked with its company. Instead of moving the business residence to a different company, create a new business residence.- <Start_Date> to <End_Date>; cost center YYYY (YYYY) must be below a company. It is also possible to flag both definitions on the same org unit.-In this case you may have to close any open document and also set the end dates for properties such as Business Residence, Cost Centers etc.-

Title: Making an Org Structure Obsolete in Organizational Management
Content: Symptom-You have multiple Organizational Structures defined in Organizational Management and you want to make an Organizational Structure obsolete.-Resolution-There are 2 ways of making an Org structure obsolete.-Delimit the Org Units.-Edit the Timelines.-Delimiting the Org Units:-In this case you can use the delimit functionality provided in Organizational Management. The Delimit function will use the effective date as the end date for the Org units. To use the delimit functionality-Goto Edit Org Structure.-Select an effective date and select the top Org Unit of the respective Company.-Right click and under Edit use the delimit function.-You may get an error message stating that Cannot delimit org unit XXXX ('XXX'); child org unit exists from <Valid From Date> to <Valid To Date>. Here you need to repeat the above action as there will be child Org Units present in the Org Structure.-Editing the Timelines:-You can also use the edit Timeline functionality. To use this-Goto Edit Org Structure.-Select an effective date and select the top Org Unit of the respective Company.-Goto the  Timelines tab and change the Value of Valid To date of Org Unit Timeline field. The date needs to be set to a date when the Org Structure becomes obsolete.-In both the possibilities mentioned above if you try to change from top to bottom it may not allow you to change as child org units may be present in the structure. Our suggestion would be to change the timelime or use the delimit function in edit org structure from bottom to top. There will be veto check messages thrown if there are open business documents and employees assigned to those org units.-

Title: Is it Possible to Change the ID of a Product or Material ?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to chnage the material ID of a Product or a Material ?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data workcenter.-Select Materials view.-Highlight the material and select Edit button.-Where you could able to edit/change all fields except Material ID.-Cause-The system works as designed.-Resolution-Material ID is master data. Once it is created it is very difficult to change it from System level. Changing would require followup in Business Intelligence reports and other system level tables and there is very real possibility of causing inconsistency in the system.-So it is recommended to block those materials and create a new material.

Title: Update Error Health Check Processing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You receive an ABAP Update Error Health check incident which is auto created by user SMQR_XBQR and the text may look something as described below: -Update error in report: LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU07-Update error in report: LSPAF_PERSISTANCEU01-Update error in report: CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003-Update error in report: /HOE/CL_DB_WRAPPER============CM002 -Update error in report: /DOC/LDS_DB_UPDATEU01-Update error in report: /SRMAP/CA_LSIV_D_47LINKP======CM004  -This incident has been created automatically by a ByD System. Since the Customer is not involved, the incident has to be solved internally by Service Provider/Support/Development to avoid negative impact for the customer business. Diagnostic Information Health Check Component: ABAP Engine Health Check Name: Update Errors Message: Update request with error Description A user has an open update request that contains an error. The error itself is described in the short description. For each error, the Context Information section shows the following information: - The date (VBDATE) - The user (VBUSER) - The name of the report that was called (VBREPORT) - The transaction code (VBTCODE) - The number of errors (ERRORS) To ensure data is consistent, the system must update a SAP transaction in full or not at all. This is referred to as a rollback requirement. If a runtime error occurs, the system reverses critical database changes. Other changes are not reversed. A message tells the user that the update is cancelled. There is no guarantee that the user will react to this message. That is why you need to check the system for aborted updates."-Cause-Due to an aborted update in the system the update error is thrown. The cause of the update error could be one of the following:-Trex down or unavailable.-Corrupted indexes in the database table.-MaxDB down.-Remote connection failure.-Inactive FSI views.-Database crash.-Unplanned downtime.-Work process time out.-Termination of background job.-Defect in code.-Resolution-A. Initial mandatory steps for processing the incidents with Update Error:-1. Open the incident in the support studio to check the context data. Document the following details in the incident (Health checks for FP2.5 system contain the context data in the problem description):-Key Field: (e.g. LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU07|SFSG_AFTERSAVE_TREX_TRNS_CFIUT|199|SFSG_REPLICATION_UPD|004).-Error message: (e.g. An update error occurred in CL_ESI_TRANSACTION_HANDLER====CP at 04.05.2009 18:46:01 called by DDIC).-Identifier: (e.g IDENTIFIER:49FF29D824652FD9E10000000A10D04010).-timestamp: (TIMESTAMP:20090504184601).-User: (USERNAME:DDIC).-Function name (e.g FUNCTION:SFSG_AFTERSAVE_TREX_TRNS_CFIUT).-Error report name (.e.g. ERRORREPORT:LSFSG_REPLICATION_UPDATEU07).-Class name (for e.g. MESSAGECLASS:SFSG_REPLICATION_UPD) & some other Key messages).-2. Check the update error in backend:-Login to the backend.-Go to the transaction code SM13.-Check the error message and find the error message among the list of update errors for which the Health check was triggered. Correlate the Error message with the information Collected in the Support Studio.-Select the Error Record and double click on it.-You see a list of Steps containing a sequence of Modules Executed.-Double click on the Record where the status is Error. Copy the error text and the Class name (e.g SFSG_REPLICATION_UPD).-Check if the error message shows any index ID which is corrupt.-In the error details check if a short dump has been generared in ST22 transaction:-If yes, then check if a health check incident for short dump has been generated for this and link it to this incident.-If no, then check the dump details in ST22 transaction and try to find out the Class which triggered the dump and responsible component. Maintain the details in the incident.-You can investigate further by going into SM14 (Update Administration) and checking the update data (In SM14 select Update Errors. Then double click your error record and check the update data).This data may the record UUID which was supposed to be updated, which can be provided further to development support if applicable.-B. Analyzing the root cause of the update error:-1. Go to the SM21 transaction and check the logs for the user for whom update error occurs.-Check if you can find below errors in the log:-Operating system call connect failed (error no. 111)-Remote communication failure with host.-Connection_Refused.-function asxml/searchCellTable/network error NIECONN_REFUSED-Error in the RFC communication: Error when opening an RFC-Database error -28534 at EXE >TREX_RFC_FUNCTION_BXML/TREX_RFC_GET_TARGET.-If you are able to find the above errors in the SM21 logs then the issue may have occurred due to one of the following:-Remote Connection Failure.-Trex was down/unavailable.-DB Crash/Down.-Unplanned downtime -Forward such incidents to MS-Customer Support Request for further processing.-2. Go to TREXADMIN transaction -> FASTSEARCH -> Execute.-Check if all services are up and running (Green status), if not then send the incident to MS-Customer Support Request.-Check if trace files in the tab Trace contains any error message at the timestamp when update error occurred. The error messages may have occurred due to bad indexing or inactive Trex/FSI view.-Hosting colleagues should recreate the indexes and check if the parameters set in the Trex is working fine.-Forward such incidents to MS-Customer Support Request for further processing.-3. For cases where dump has been generated and you are not able to find any error messages in the logs, follow the below approach:-Go to the ST22 transaction and check the dump details.-Collect the information like Class, Method, Function Module, Responsible Component, Code where termination occurred. -Forward the incident to the responsible CSS component.-4. If the context data collected shows the update error occurred due to Termination of background job then also check the job history in SM37 transaction for the cancelled/terminated job.-Forward such incidents to MS-Customer Support Request for further processing.

Title: Project Management Business Functions in Organizational Management
Content: Symptom-You may want to assign a business function related to project management to an organizational unit. You cannot find any business functions related to project management in the Organizational Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Edit Organizational Structure tab.-Choose the organizational unit where you want to assign the business function related to project management.-Select the Functions tab.-Here you cannot see any function related to project management.-Cause-There are no business functions specifically defined for project management.-Resolution-You cannot assign any organizational unit to a project, rather it is the other way around. When a manager or any employee has access to the Project Management work center and creates any project, that project belongs to the creator's organizational unit. The person who creates the project is the responsible person for the project. However the minimum requirement for creating a project is that the responsible organizational unit must be a Cost Center. Moreover if the project is marked as Billable, the responsible organizational unit must be a Profit Center as well.

Title: The Overhead Distribution Run Gives Error Message: Rule XYZ Does Not Contain Any Senders
Content: Symptom-You perform an overhead distribution run to distribute overhead from one support cost center to the primary cost center for a specified accounting period. When the execution is done, you go to check the execution details of the run and find the following error message: Rule XYZ does not contain any senders.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Periodic Task view.-Select the Overhead Distribution subview.-Choose New, and then choose Distribution Run to open the New Distribution Run quick activity.-Enter a Run Description. Select Test Run if you want to perform a simulation of the run.-Select the data for the run by entering filter values, such as the Company ID, the Set of Books ID, or the Rule ID.-Select the Closing Step that you want the system to use for the postings.-In the Period/Year field, enter the accounting period and fiscal year for which you want to execute the distribution run.-Schedule the run to start immediately, and click OK.-Open the run and navigate to the Messages tab.-You can see the error message: Rule XYZ does not contain any senders.-You then go to check the details of rule XYZ:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Master Data and Allocations view.-Select the Distribution Rules subview.-Show Currently Active Rules, and select rule XYZ.-Choose the Senders tab.-You can see the Cost Center ID is actually maintained, so you don't know why the system still gives the error message: Rule XYZ does not contain any senders.-Cause-You need to have finished entering the overhead costs before you start the distribution run.-Following the steps below, you can see there is no cost assigned to the sender cost center specified in rule XYZ:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Reports view.-Choose the Cost Centers- Line Items report.-In the Cost Center field, enter the cost center specified in Distribution Rule XYZ.-In the Accounting Period/Year field, enter the same value as specified in the distribution run.- This is why the system gives the error message: Rule XYZ does not contain any senders.-Resolution-Before you start the distribution run to allocate the cost from one support cost center to a primary cost center, you have to make sure that there is already overhead cost assigned to this support cost center.

Title: Inbound purchase order not reaching ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-Your customer have sent a Purchase Order through Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) however it fails to reach your system. Therefore you don't see any sales order against it.-Cause-You have not maintained the Product ID of the Purchase order XXX in your ByDesign System. As a result no synchronizationof product master data between Cross gate and Byd system happens and issue is raised.-Resolution-Please maintain the master data for Product Id YYY in ByDesign System.

Title: The System Gives Error Message When Posting Service Confirmation to Accounting
Content: Symptom-After the service is performed for the customer, you post the service confirmation to accounting but the system generates a task and tells you: Financials assignment for material XYZ/business residence ABC not specified. You feel this error message should not be generated as the business residence ABC has no material XYZ in stock.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Service Orders work center, choose the Service Order Processing view.-Click New and select Service Order.-Enter the service line item and the spare part XYZ that is needed for the service.-From the Submit drop-down list, choose Release to Service Execution.-Deliver the spare part to the customer site and perform the required service.-In the Field Service and Repair work center, choose the Order Pipeline view.-From the Show drop-down list, choose All Orders to be Executed.-Select the order that is just created and click Confirm Execution.-In the New Service Confirmation screen, click Release and select With Order Completion.-Then go to the General Ledger work center and check the journal entries.-For the posted service confirmation, there is a journal entry with the type Internal Service Confirmation.-Check the document flow of the journal entry, you can find there is a Goods and Activity Confirmation document generated by the service confirmation.  -Go to the Closing Cockpit view and select the Source Document subview.-You can see this Goods and Activity Confirmation document is shown as unposted document.-Click View Business Transaction.-You can see the error message: Financials assignment for material XYZ/business residence ABC not specified.-Meanwhile, go back to the Journal Entries view and choose Work subview.-Select the open task with the same error message and check the description of the task.-    You can see the description: Maintain the valuation view of the material for the specified combination of company and business residence.-Cause-The reason why the system gives such an error message is that an account determination group is needed to determine the cost of goods sold (COGS) account. When the service confirmation is posted, the system first find the business residence of the service organization that performs the service to the customer, which is ABC, and then checks the valuation view of material XYZ and see if the account determination group is maintained for the business residence ABC, if not, it then generates a task.-Resolution-To successfully finish the task, follow the instructions of the message and edit the material master data of XYZ:-In the Product Data work center, choose the Materials view.-Search material XYZ and click Edit.-In the Valuation tab, add one row for Business Residence ABC.-Enter the Account Determination Group.-Click Save.-     You should be able to successfully finish the task.

Title: How to Start an Activity From Period End Closing ?
Content: Symptom-How to Start an Activity From Period End Closing ?-Resolution-You can start the activity from period end closing by doing the below steps:--1. Go to the General Ledger work center.-2. Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-3. Go to the Closing Cockpit subview.-4. Select your entry. Then select the Edit button.-5. Now to start a manual activity, select your activity and then select the button Initiate Activity -> Start Manual Activity/Start Test Run/Start Update Run.--Please note that if the 'Execution Possible' column for your activity shows 'No' then it means there are certain pre-requisites which should be completed. In such cases you can only create a test run.-You can view the pre-requisites by selecting the button 'Display Pre-requisites'.-And other thing is that your user must have the required authorization. For example if you need to run GR/IR clearing run then your user should be assigned to work center 'Inventory Valuation'.

Title: Update error in report: 'TREX server has reported an error: xxx (<Index ID> : Error in the RFC)'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You get a health check for update error and when you analyze it, you find that the issue is occurring because of following error:-'TREX server has reported an error: xxx (<Index ID> : Error in the RFC)'-Reproducing the Issue-To reproduce the error follow the steps mentioned below:-1. Open the 'CheckContexProvider' XML message from the 'Attachments'.-2. In the XML message go to the tag 'ErrorInformation' and search for the user name.-E.g.-<Item>-  <Name>Message</Name>-  <Value>An update error occurred in CL_ESI_TRANSACTION_HANDLER====CP at 27.06.2010 05:44:47 called by 0ESQQ2JMAIE1</Value> -</Item>-3. Copy the user name (shown in bold letters in above example).-4. Open transaction SM13 and paste the user name in the input field for 'User' and then execute.-5. In the opened page search for the line which is in red color. Double click this line.-6. It will open 'Update Module' page.-7. Search for red colored line in this page and double click on the searched line.-Result: You will get the error message like: 'TREX server has reported an error: xxx (<Index ID> : Error in the RFC)'-Cause-This issue might occur when a particular 'Index Rebuild' results in an error for an index.-Resolution-To analyze the issue follow the steps mentioned below:-1. Copy the 'Index ID'.-2. Open transaction 'TREXADMIN'.-3. In the 'Connection to RFC Server' field write 'FASTSEARCH' (this field is case sensitive) and execute.-4. Click on 'Index Admin' tab and paste copied 'Index ID'.-5. Click on 'Display entries' icon.-6. In the 'Index Info' page check the field 'State' and 'last indexing' field.-Results:-1. If the 'State' field is green and 'last indexing' field is showing time which is greater than the time when the health check was created, than it shows that the 'Index Rebuild' has been performed successfully and the issue is resolved now. Close the incident in this case.-2. If the 'State' field is not green and still showing error then forward the incident to 'Expert Support - NetWeaver - TREX/FSI' queue for further analysis.

Title: Scope A Work Center in A Change Project But Cannot Find The Work Center in System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A customer has scoped a work center in a change project in Business Configuration. When the customer confirmed the scoping option, he/she cannot find the work center in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD) system.-In this case, the customer selected Project Management work center in scoping in a change project but cannot see it when the customer confirmed the project.-Reproducing the Issue-After a system going live-Open Business Configuration work center-Open a change project in Change Projects in Implementation-Select Change Solution Profile Option, in selection phase, you can see the work centers have been selected. But you cannot find the work centers in work center list.-Resolution-The root cause of this problem unknown. We don't know the reason, why the scoped work center missed in the system. And we cannot find the scoping change logs in the backend.-The only one way to solve this issue is to trigger a full deployment with the permission from the customer.  Then you can see the work centers in the system.

Title: No Account Assignment for Structure Type "Income Statement by Function of Expense"
Content: Symptom-When you create a new financial reporting structure, if the structure type is "0IA2 -IFRS I/S by Function of Expense" or "Income Statement by Function of Expense", regardless what you fill into "Chart of Accounts" (CoA) field, it becomes empty after saving.-Reproducing the Issue-Goto 'Business Configuration' work center-Select view 'Activity List'-Select 'Fine Tuning'-Select 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination'-Click 'Edit Financial Reporting Structure'--When click on 'Copy From Template', do the following selection:---Template for financial reporting structure -- 0IA2 -IFRS I/S by Function of Expense-New Chart of Account -- select one-Structure Key -- give a new name-Structure Description -- give a new description-After saving, the column "Chart of Accounts" becomes empty.--Cause-When you use structure type "Income Statement by Function of Expense", account assignment is not allowed. Hence the Chart of Account (CoA) is not filled.--Although the CoA field is filled during the reporting structure creation process, especially when you create multiple structures; after you save, close, and come back, the CoA column becomes empty.  This is intentional as explained above.

Title: How to solve Solve Lock Issue in Supplier Processing Invoicing Verification Inbound
Content: Symptom-You got number of unassigned items Task: Solve Lock Issue in Supplier Processing Invoicing Verification Inbound.- Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-2.Go to the Utilities View and Business Task Management sub view.-3.In Show area of Business Task Management, select the unassigned item.-Resolution-Kindly take over such task in your name. Once you do that you will get a link to access the task or you can access this task from your work inbox under Home work center.-When you will open the task, it will give you relevant information about the task and also it will guide you to resolve the task at your end itself. After following the resolution, these task will be cleared off.

Title: Error retrieving cost centre assignment of resource RRR.
Content: Symptom-The transaction (Sales order or Purchase order) is not posted into accounting because of Business Task Management (BTM) task 'Error retrieving cost centre assignment of resource RRR'.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Work Center 'General Ledger'.-2. Go to view 'Closing cockpit'.-3. Go to subview 'Source Documents'.-4. Show 'Not Posted Source Documents'.-5. Select the source document for your transaction (Sales order or Purchase order).-6. Click on 'View Business Transaction'.-7. You will see task 'Error retrieving cost centre assignment of resource RRR'.-Cause-The transaction date for your transaction (Sales order or Purchase order) has date before the resource is assigned to the cost center. So a BTM task is raised.-Resolution-1. Go to Work Center 'Cost and Revenue'.-2. Go to view 'Master Data'.-3. Go to subview 'Resource'.-4. Select resource RRR and go to 'Valuation' tab for this resource.--You will find that cost center is effective from XX.XX.XXXX date. So kindly assign valid cost center for date 14.08.2009.

Title: How to Reconcile an XML message using the report '/SRMAP/PI_RECONCILIATION'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In this document you will see how to ‘Reconcile’ an XML message using a specific report. This report was developed by SRM Development but can be used in other areas too. Your support user only needs the authorizations to execute the transaction se38 in the backend.-Cause-Due to an 'Application Error' the XML message got stuck in PI. The development colleague analyzes the application error and provides correction. After correcting the application part, stuck XML message needs to be reconciled.-During the reconciliation process a new XML message gets created.-Resolution-To 'Reconcile' the XML message proceed as follows:-Log in to the backend.-Execute the transaction SXI_Monitor and copy the Message ID of the failed XI message- Now execute the transaction 'SE38'.- Enter the report "/SRMAP/PI_RECONCILIATION" in the field 'Program'.--4. Press on F8 (Execute).-5. Enter the copied message ID and press on F8 (Execute).--6. At the bottom of the screen, you have have a confirmation message that the reconciliation was successfull.

Title: IAM - Check user logon information and history
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to check the user logon information and user history.-Resolution-1. Log on to the back end, execute the transaction 'RSUSR200' and execute.--2. Here you can check the following information:--User validity date: if valid from and valid through column is empty, the user is having unlimited validity.-User created date-Who created the user-Deleted Users: The logon field value is in state 'Not in Use'.-Type of user and group-Last logon date and time-Is user locked and reason for lock-When the password has been changed- Created by BYDMS-KB-IM

Title: Payment Proposal Display in Cash Position Report
Content: Symptom-You run 'Cash Position by Payment Method' report (Report ID FINPAYU03_Q0001) and find it lists bank transfers that are in automatic payments with status In Preparation.-As those are payment proposals, you think these payments with status In Preparation must be thrown off from the 'Cash Position by Payment Method' report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cash and Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Reports view.-Open 'Cash Position by Payment Method' report (Report ID FINPAYU03_Q0001).-Drag free characteristics Bank Account and Source Document ID into Rows.-You can see the source document <ABC> of bank account <XYZ> in result list.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-In list, the status of the document <ABC> for bank account <XYZ> shows In Preparation.-The payment with status In Preparation is proposal.-You think it is not real payment and must not display in 'Cash Position by Payment Method' report.-Cause-When the payments are initiated from the payment run, a payment proposal is created and the money is allocated.-This payment on the Payment Monitor is a reservation (Re-served Money) which status is In Preparation. -In 'Cash Position by Payment Method' report, the reserved money must come under disbursements because the money is already reserved and it cannot be used by any other payments.-The money is locked by the payment proposals. Thus, the Cash Position report shows this information.-Resolution-You can accept the payment proposals displayed in 'Cash Position by Payment Method' report.-Keywords-Cash Position by Payment Method; FINPAYU03_Q0003; payment proposals; in preparation

Title: Error: Hidden BON issue for FSI data is not loaded or is incorrect
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to find the BON which is not displayed in the transaction 'GFSSTM', but found in the incident for a particular business object.-Cause-BCP incident: # 3100240895-Business Object: SITE_LOGISTICS_LOT-Hidden BON: OPERATION-Resolution-1. Check in the back end using the transaction 'GFSSTM'.-2. Provide the affected business object mentioned in the incident. In this case the business object is 'SITE_LOGISTICS_LOT' and select 'Execute'.-3. If BON is not displayed, do the following steps: execute the transaction 'SE16' and give the table name as 'SFSG_REPL_META_H' and select 'Execute'.-4. In the next page in 'BO_NAME' column give the corresponding business object name. In the 'BON_NAME' column give the 'BON' which is not shown in 'GFSSTM'. Then 'Execute'.-Here in our case business object and BON are 'SITE_LOGISTICS_LOT' and 'OPERATION' respectively.-5. Copy the 'META_KEY'.--- 6. Open another session, execute the transaction 'SE16'; this time give the table as 'SFSG_REPL_META_V' and paste the 'META_KEY' which you copied earlier in the 'META_KEY' column and 'Execute'.-7. In the next page list of 'VIEW_NAME' is displayed; copy the view.--8. In the transaction 'GFSSTM' and paste the view in 'Fast Search View' and 'Execute'. If more views are there, then do the following:-9. In the next page find the BON 'OPERATION' which is in red status. Select that particular BON and give 'DB and TREX'.--   Created by BYDMS-KB-FSI/TREX

Title: Upload Function is Not Working for 'Market Information'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Upload Function is not working for 'Market Information'.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Work Center 'Marketing'.-2. Select view 'Market Information'-3. Click on Upload button.  -4. Error: New window display with Alert message "Page not found or not available".-Cause-The view should have permission for the end user .Currently there-was no permission enabled to access the view.-Resolution-1. Go to Work Center 'Content Administration'-2. Select view 'Portal Content'.-3. Portal Content-> Content Provided by SAP->Templates->iView Templates-    ->KM Upload iView, group Everyone is missing.-4. Add the group for this iView and check the tick for the "End User" for this group.-5. Save it.-6. Now you can check and the issue will be resolved for the End-users.

Title: Is It Possible to Maintain the Same Employee ID for Different Employees in Different Companies
Content: Symptom-In your corporation there may be multiple affiliated companies. You want to know if it is possible to maintain the same employee ID for different employees in different companies. The payroll provider of companies may already assign a fixed ID to the employees. So duplicate ID for employees in different companies may occur in this case. -Resolution-Currently, it is not possible to assign the same ID to different employees in different companies/org units.-So you have to create an employee with unique ID.

Title: Troubleshooting Windows Installer Errors
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Target audience: Expert Support - Client Infrastructure Team-This document describes how to troubleshoot problems occurring during the installation of frontend components which are using the Windows Installer. Logfiles can be found here:-Open a Windows Explorer window and navigate to the folder %temp%-Search for all files named "SAP_BYD_<productname>_Installation.log". For example, "SAP_BYD_ExcelAddin_Installation.log".-Windows Installer records errors and events in its own error log and in the Event log. The diagnostic information that the installer writes to these logs can help users and administrators understand the cause of a failed installation.-Normal Logging-The installer records errors and events in its own error log. The type of logging that is performed by the installer is determined by the setting of the logging mode. Logging is enabled and the mode can be set by using the following methods:-The logging mode of an installation launched from the command line can be specified by using the /L option of the Command Line Options. If the logging mode is not specified by using the /L command-line option, the default logging mode will be used.-The logging mode of an installation process can be specified programmatically by using the MsiEnableLog function or the EnableLog method. If the logging mode is not specified by using the MsiEnableLog function or the EnableLog method, the default logging mode will be used.-The default logging mode of a particular installation package can be specified by setting the MsiLogging property in the Property table of the package. This property is available starting with Windows Installer 4.0.-If the MsiLogging property is present in the Property table, the default logging mode of the package can be modified by changing the value by using a database transform. The default logging mode cannot be changed by using Patch Packages (a .msp file.)-If the MsiLogging property has not been set, the default logging mode for all users of the computer can be specified by using the Logging policy.-If the MsiLogging property has been set, the default logging mode for all users of the computer can be specified by setting both the DisableLoggingFromPackage policy and Logging policy.-If the logging mode has not been specified by the /L option, MsiEnableLog, EnableLog, MsiLogging property, or the Logging policy, then the default logging mode for the package is the same mode that is obtained as setting the MsiLogging property to 'iwearmo'.-Event Logging-Windows Events provides a standard, centralized way for applications (and the operating system) to record important software and hardware events. The event-logging service stores events from various sources in a single collection called an event log. Prior to Windows Vista, you would use either Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) or Event Logging to log events. Windows Vista introduced a new eventing model that unifies both ETW and the Windows Event Log API.-The installer also writes entries into the event log. These record events such as following:-Success or failure of the installation; removal or repair of a product.-Errors that occur during product configuration.-Detection of corrupted configuration data.-If a large amount of information is written, the Event Log file can become full and the installer displays the message, "The Application log file is full."-For details about the logged events see http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/aa368560(v=VS.85).aspx.-Wilogutl.exe-Wilogutl.exe assists the analysis of log files from a Windows Installer installation, and it displays suggested solutions to errors that are found in a log file.-Non-critical errors are not displayed. Wilogutl.exe can be run in quiet mode or with a user interface (UI). The tool generates reports as text files in both the UI and quiet modes. It works best with verbose Windows Installer log files, but also works with non-verbose logs. This tool is only available in the Windows SDK Components for Windows Installer Developers. Download and install the Windows SDK from here: http://www.microsoft.com/download/en/details.aspx?displaylang=en&id=3138.-Information on how to use Wilogutl.exe can be found here: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/aa372811(v=VS.85).aspx.

Title: The Supplier Payment Difference is Not Posted to the Desired Account
Content: Symptom-On a supplier account, there is an open item of credit memo for the bank charges.-You try to manually clear this supplier credit memo and apply discount to it.-After that, you clear this item.-When you check the related journal entry, you find out that the payment difference is posted to account XYZ, which is not the desired account, and you have no idea how to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Select the supplier in question, and choose View.-In the Trade Payables tab, select the credit memo XYZ and then choose Clear Manually.-Choose Apply Discount or Credit.-Choose the Payment Diff. Reason, 11 Bank charges.-Choose Clear.-Check the related journal entry, and you can see that the payment difference is posted to account XYZ, which is not the desired account.-Cause- Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view.- Search the fine-tune activity Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination.- Choose Accounts Payables under Account Determination.- Choose the Payment Differences tab.- Here you can see the assigned account for all is XYZ.-    This is why you can see that the difference is posted to account XYZ.-Resolution-To post the difference to the desired account ABC, you have to do the followings:- Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view.- Search the fine-tune activity Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination.- Choose Edit Chart of Accounts.- Select account ABC, and change the G/L Account Type to DIFFER-Differences.- Then, choose Accounts Payables under Account Determination.- Choose the Payment Differences tab.- Change the account from XYZ to ABC.-    After that, you should be able to post the difference to the desired account ABC.--Keywords-Payment Diff. Reason, 11 Bank charges, Supplier Payment Difference, DIFFER-Differences

Title: Where to Find the Contact List of All Employees in the Company
Content: Symptom-You would like to know where to find Contact List of all employees in the system.-In the Home and Managing My Area work center, you can only find the contact list of employees belonging to that particular Organizational Unit.-Resolution-If you want to find the list of all employees and their phone no., email and address, follow the below steps:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Reports view and the Employee List Reports subview.-Choose Address List in the Show field.

Title: When You Create a Downpayment Request, the System Calculates the GST for the Downpayment Amount Only
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In Australia, when you buy a good or service for a certain amount, you are supposed to make a full payment of GST on total contract amount when you receive a downpayment. However, in the ByD system, when you create a downpayment request, the system calculates the GST for the downpayment amount only.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter and open a New Down Payment Request.-Create and post a down payment request.-Go to Receivable workcenter and receive the payment against the downpayment request.-Note that the GST calculated is only on the down payment amount. The legal requirement is that the GST should be on the total contract amount.-Cause-This feature is not supported in the ByDesign system.-Resolution-Workaround: Create GST Liability-Go to the Tax Management work center and under the Manual Tax Entries view,  select VAT Entries.-Create an entry for the GST liability by selecting the appropriate tax codes and the G/L accounts.-Post a new customer invoice for the balance amount with 0% tax code.-Revenue Recognition-To recognize the revenue for the amount received as downpayment, post and clear a customer invoice against down payment.

Title: A G/L Account is Not Available for Selection When Directly Posting a New Incoming Check
Content: Symptom-You try to directly post a new incoming check to a G/L account, but the desired account is not available for selection.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select New Incoming Check under Common Tasks.-Enter the necessary information.-In the Incoming Payment with field, choose Direct Posting to G/L Account.-In the Account Assignment table, choose Add Row.-In the drop-down list o G/L Account, try to select the G/L account XYZ.-    But the G/L account XYZ is not shown in the drop-down list.-Cause-The drop-down list of the G/L Account field is consisted with a list of account determination groups, in order to have an account determination group shown in the list, you have to set it as Used in Non-Cash Form of Payment in the fine-tune activity of Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination.-Because G/L account XYZ is assigned to account determination group ABC, which is not Used in Non-Cash Form of Payment, so the new incoming check cannot be posted to G/L account XYZ.-Resolution-In order to set the account determination group ABC as Used in Non-Cash Form of Payment, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view if your system has gone live.-Select the fine-tune activity of Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination.-Choose Edit Account Determination Groups.-Select the Group Types by Ledgers of the account determination group ABC.-Find the group ABC, and tick the option of Used in Non-Cash Form of Payment.-Choose Save and Close.-    You should be able to select the account determination group ABC when having a direct post of a new incoming check.

Title: The Manual Tax Entries Are Not Included in the Sales and Use Tax Return as Expected
Content: Symptom-You enter a sales and use tax entry manually in the system and post it in period XXX.-Later, when you execute a Sales and Use Tax Return run for the same period, the generated tax return didn't include this manual entry.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Choose the Manual Tax Entries view.-Select the Sales and Use Tax Entries sub view.-Choose New Tax Entry.-Enter the necessary data and set the Posting Date to a date in period XXX.-Choose Post, and the tax entry XYZ is created.-Then go to the Periodic Tasks view and choose the Sales and Use Tax Return Runs.-Choose New Tax Return Run.-In the Selection Criteria section, specify the Tax Return Arrangement ID.-Set the From and To and make sure it follows into the period XXX.-Choose Save and Close.-Then choose Set to Active.-Select this run, and you can see the generated Tax Return ID ABC.-Check the details of this tax return ABC, and you cannot find the manual tax entry in the list.-Cause-When creating the manual tax entry, by default, the system takes the current date as the Tax Due Date of the items, because you don't change the tax due date in your manual tax entry XYZ, and leave it with a date that is in period XXX+1, so the tax return run for period XXX doesn't take this manual tax entry into consideration.  -Resolution-The manual tax entry XYZ will be included in the tax return generated from the tax return run of period XXX+1.-Keywords-manual tax entry; tax return run; sales and use tax return; Tax Due Date

Title: Product Descriptions Inconsistent in Different Work Centers
Content: Symptom-Product descriptions are inconsistent between different work centers. For example, between Purchase Requests and Orders and Product Data work centers.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-Mark a purchase request and choose Edit.-Notice the product description.-Press the Product ID to open the product record.-You notice that the product description there is different than the one in the purchase request.-Cause-The product description is defaulted at the point where the product is entered into the document. In a purchase request, at the point where it is created. When the description is changed in the product master, this change does not update the existing documents.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. Create a new product master record in case the specifications of the product have changed.

Title: DFV - Determine Compared Business Object (BO) Attributes by Data Flow Verification (DFV) Error Keys
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While processing the incidents created by the healthcheck for Data Flow Verification (DFV) inconsistencies in SPC, it is necessary to find out if the BO nodes and the BO node attributes that are affected when DFV detected certain error symptoms for a pair of BO instances. For a detailed analysis, access to several ByD back end transactions is required.-The affected Business Object (BO) nodes or BO node attributes can be read using the transaction SESFTS. -The error symptoms are given by the T100 error keys in the Healthcheck Event ITSAM_DFV_00002 or BO DFV_RESULT, the nodes VERIF_SCOPE_OBJ_DIFF and VERIF_SCOPE_OBJ_DIFF_DET.-The following screenshot shows the error keys displayed in the DFV Healthcheck Event.-Error information in DFV Incident -ByD Releases FP20, FP25, FP26-Error information in DFV Incident-ByD Release FP30 or higher-Resolution-1. Determining Missing BO Nodes:-If a BO node instance is missing in one of the compared BO instances, the error description in the DFV result will be Corresponding * missing or * not found.-1. You must determine the name of the BO node, where an instance is missing.-2. Start the table browsing transaction SE16, and enter the table DFV_BONODEPAIR_X.-3. Select the two BO type codes. The DFV incident contains the BO names. Use the value help in selection screen of the transaction SE16 to find the type code of the involved BOs.-4. Select the Message Class and Message_Number. To enter the message number, you can use the value Help. You can also match the error key from the Healthcheck Event with the error description from the DFV result:-You can see the IDs of the BO nodes (object node type codes). You can also use the value help to obtain the related BO node proxy names. The following screen helps to identify the missing node ITEM_SCHEDULE_LINE in BO SALES_ORDER.-2. Determining Differing BO Node Attributes:-If the attribute values differ between two BO node instances, the error description in the DFV Result displays as in the following screen.-1. To obtain the affected BO node attributes, you can look the table DFV_BOATTR_PAIR in the transaction SE16. -2. Select the BO type codes, the Message Class and Message_Number. Use the value help for entering the message number. You can also match the error key from the Healthcheck Event with the error description from the DFV Result. The proxy names of the affected BO Node Attributes are displayed.- 3. To find the proxy names of the affected BO nodes by the BO node type codes, you can use the value help for BO1_NODE and BO2_NODE.-Created by BYDMS-KB-CF

Title: How to Cancel the Approved Time Recording of a Service Agent?
Content: Symptom-If user is Administrator, would like to know the possibilities to cancel the Time Recorded (Status: Approved) by a Service Agents-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partner Data or Supplier Base work center.-Select the Service Agents view.-Search for and highlight the relevant Service Agent.-Open the Time Sheet for the Service Agent.-Locate the time recording with the status "Approved" or "Inactive." -Cause-Time recordings with statuses "Approved" or "Inactive" require specific steps for cancellation.-Resolution-User can able to cancel the Time Recording as stated below,-Active Time (Status: Approved)-Go to Business Partner Data or Supplier Base work center.-Select Service Agents view.-Search and highlight the Service Agent.-Select Open Time Sheet button.-Go to respective Calendar Week.-Select the Row and select the Remove button.-Select Save button.-Select Release button and choose Selected Week.-Inactive Time (Status: In Approval, In Process)-Go to Business Partner Data or Supplier Base work center.-Select Service Agents view.-Search and highlight the Service Agent.-Select Open Time Sheet button.-Go to respective Calendar Week.-Clear the cell (Clear the time for the respective date) and Press Enter key in the keyboard.-Select Save button.-Select Release button and choose Selected Week.-Keywords-cancel time recording, approved time recording, service agent time sheet, remove time entry, business partner data, supplier base work center, inactive time recording, active time recording, time sheet release, clear time entry, administrator cancel time, time recording process, calendar week time sheet, save and release time sheet

Title: Is it Possible to Delete the Accounts Which are Migrated into the System Using Data Migration?
Content: Symptom-You have migrated some Accounts into the system using Data Migration and would like know, How to delete that from the system?-Note: This document is valid for all Business Partner datas like Customers, Contacts, Suppliers and so on.-Resolution-No, It is not possible to delete a Business Partner once it migrated/saved into the system. Instead you can Block or Obsolete the Business Partner Data using below steps.-For Example, if the Business Partner is Accounts:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select Show All Accounts.-You can select more than one records by standard keys - CTRL+ mouse click (to add single records to the selection) and SHIFT + mouse click (to add ranges to the selection)-Select Change Status button and choose either Block or Obsolete. Note: If the Account is already used in any Business documents, then the status will remains in Active.-Note: It is not possible to change the status of any Account using Mass Change.

Title: How to find out the FSI View which Fetches Data on the Screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The document describes the steps to find the FSI view name which fetches data on the screen.-NOTE: -The steps in this case document must not be performed in a Customer system.-These steps must be executed ONLY by Expert Support (Direct support should not perform these steps as system consistency may be affected).-Method:-Log on to Front End and backend with the same user.-TCode: SE37.-Enter the function module TREX_EXT_SEARCH_CELL_TABLE.-Select the Display button.-Set External Break Point on the line 228.-Move to screen from front end where you want to find FSI View name. It enters to ABAP debugger.-Press F5. Cursor moves to line 229.-Double click on the l_indexlist which is present on line 228.-Note down the value which appaears at the bottom for the variable l_indexlist. This is required join index.-Select Debugger and Exit Debugger option on the menu bar.-Select Yes on the Stop Debugger screen.-Remove External debugger point which is set on line number 228.-Note:-Remove external break points before performing any further steps.-Do not perform these steps in customer system. You can perform these steps in IRA system to find FSI View name (see attached document on how to do this). You can perform further analysis in customer system once you find the FSI view name.-You may find that many FSI Views or BOs are not loaded correctly. But concentrate on FSI View which is related to your error message.-Every FSI View has one Join index assigned to it. You can search FSI view name from Join index.-You can search BO and BO node name from Physical index.-Example 1: Join index is .c003:1fs:jdx_opp_overview_elements. FSI View name is opp_overview_elements.-Example 2: Join index is .c003:1fs:jdx_bupa_ident_a_addr_qrs. FSI View name is bupa_ident_a_addr_qrs.-Example 3: Physical index is .c012:1fs:idx__srmap_lpurx_po_item_actual_valu_n5170120. In case of physical indices, BO name and BO node is part of the index name. So, in this example, srmap_lpurx_po is the BO name and item_actual_valu_n5170120 is the BO node name.---How do you find BO name, BO Node Name and Query on which the FSI view is created?-Tcode: SE16-Enter the table name as SFSG_QR_DEF and press Enter-Enter the FSI view name in the VIEW_NAME field and press F8. You can find BO Name in the BO_MODEL column, BO Node Name in the BO_NODE column, Query Name in the BO_QUERY column. Also you can find more information like Created By, Created At-Find details of FSI View: OPP_ELEMENTS and FSP_BP_SUPPLIER-Note: FSI views created for Analytics do not show BO Name, BO Node Name and Query Name in the table.-Go through the link below to view demo.-URL: https://sap.emea.pgiconnect.com/p68263060/

Title: Cannot Open Fiscal Period
Content: Symptom-During the first implementation, a fiscal period 001 of year YYYY was opened by mistake, but the expected fiscal period to be opened is the same period of fiscal year YYYY-1.-When trying to open the period 001 for year YYYY-1, the system gives error message: "Revoking period 001 not possible: Only one open interval allowed".-Then it's attempted to close period XXX of fiscal year YYYY, but errors are raised:-"Closing of period 001 not possible: Previous fiscal year not closed;"-"Cannot close all periods in fiscal year YYYY; Bal.Car.Fwd. not finished."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Choose Open and Close Periods under Common Tasks.-Notice that the period 001 of fiscal year YYYY is opened.-Try to open period 001 of fiscal year YYYY-1, the system gives error message: "Revoking period 001 not possible: Only one open interval allowed".-Try to close period 001 of year YYYY first before opening the same period of year YYYY-1, but the system gives other error messages:-"Closing of period 001 not possible: Previous fiscal year not closed;" -"Cannot close all periods in fiscal year YYYY; Bal.Car.Fwd. not finished".-Cause-It is not allowed to open periods which do not correspond to one interval. For example, only periods 6, 7 and 8 can be opened, but period 011 cannot be opened.-In this way, one open interval is from period 006 till 008.-Accounting period 001 of YYYY needs to be closed first, however, as the previous year YYYY-1 is not closed, the first period of YYYY cannot be closed.-Resolution-To fix the issue, the fiscal year YYYY must be deleted, as there are no postings made to this year yet:-Go to the General Ledger work center, and select the Master Data view.-Then select the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies subview.-Choose Edit Fiscal Year.-Delete fiscal year YYYY.-After that, open the correct period 001 of YYYY-1, and then create fiscal year YYYY again. -Keywords-fiscal period; accounting period; interval;

Title: Central Case Document: How to handle issues related to Partner Add-On and Partner Development Infrastructure (PDI)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-If an incident is received in BCP, your first step is to identify as quickly as possible if the root cause area is on SAP side PDI infrastructure side or on the partner development side.-Reproducing the Issue-Following are some of the key words which suggest that the incident could be related to Partner development Infrastructure or Partner Add-Ons- Partner development, ByDesign Studio, Copernicus, PDI(Partner Development Infrastructure), Layer  Strategy, Global Solution, Solution Deployment, SAP Store, Partner Fine Tuning activity, Add On, One Offs, partner extensibility, generating UI in ByD Studio, ABSL coding etc.-Cause-Please follow the below mentioned steps to make sure if the incident situation involves Partner BO or Partner Workcenter.-1. Open the incident in BCP and click on 'SAP Incight' button from the top of the screen.-2. An instance of SAP incight will open in the new screen with all the context data.-3. Please make sure on the left side of the screen, the very first entry in the heirarchy is selected. This entry will look like '3100****** - <Short Text of the Incident>'.-4. Once this entry is selected, on the right side of the screen you will see the details under the header 'Context Information'.-5. Check the information against the headers-Header Information Information you will see in case of normal ByDesign Work Center Involvment Information you will see in case the Partner BO is Involved-Work Center CRM_WOC_SAlESORDERS  /BY000792/ILOG_WCF.WCF   -Work Center View CRM_SOC_OVERVIEW  /BY000792/ILOG_WCVIEW.WCVIEW-UI Component Package A1S_CRM_SALES_ORD_QAF_UIC /BY000792/DEV-If you simply compare the set of information mentioned above, the bold text A1S_CRM and /BY000792 is self explanatory to show which case belong to an partner add on situation. Here the code /BY000792 belong to a partner add on and you can find the details about this Add On from the Wiki https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/BYDES/Overview-Support+of+Partner+Add+On+solutions-Please Note :- The above mentioned steps are only valid when the incident is created from the actual workcenter where the issue occured. In case the incident is created from a different screen, the context data is not reliable to do the analysis.-Resolution-As per the current guidelines, you should forward the PDI related incidents directly to CSS components AP-RC-BDS- *-In case you have any doubt or you are not sure which CSS component is relevant, please send the incident to “DS-EN - Other ByD Topics Queue”-

Title: Way to Turn Wily Lost Incident Light Green when no Unsent SPRs Found
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-If no unsent SPRs found and still lost incident traffic light is red in Wily, follow this procedure.-Resolution- Make sure no unsent SPRs are left in the system.-Check in the table /ITSAM/MTHISMGN with check group/check ID ITSAM_SELFMON 00023. Here the status is 02 (Forwarded).- Make sure that template is not "all checks off", if so apply a non empty template which includes SELFMON_23 as explained:-        Configuration template: 9106 BYD_3.5_prod (ITSAM_SELFMON_00023 Check ID is included in this template as shown in screenshot):-                Go to Monitoring Setup, select Template Distribution and then select a template for activation as displayed in the following screenshot:- Run the HC for SELFMON_23 alone with the report /ITSAM/HC_TEST with below parameter values:-Once this is done, ensure that the status of SELFMON changes to 04 (Completed) in the table /ITSAM/MTHISMGN and the Wily agent should turn GREEN during the next run of the job.- Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: Error Message "Cannot Post Document; Debit and Credit Lines do not Balance" on the GR/IR clearing Run logs
Content: Symptom-After performing a GR/IR clearing Run, you check the logs and the error message "Cannot Post Document; Debit and Credit Lines do not Balance" appears on the Messages tab of the logs. Furthermore there are a number of items processed with error with the same message on the Processed with Errors tab of the logs.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work centre.-Go to the GR/IR clearing view.-Select the GR/IR clearing run for which you want to check the logs, in the Details area access the run Logs Result.-Within the logs view, go to the Messages tab, the error message Cannot Post Document; Debit and Credit Lines do not Balance is shown.-Go to the Processed with Errors tab, there are a number of Purchasing Document Items which have not been processed by the GR/IR Clearing Run and appears with the message Cannot Post Document; Debit and Credit Lines do not Balance.- Cause-The error Cannot Post Document; Debit and Credit Lines do not Balance is to be put in parallel with a second error message visible in the GR/IR clearing logs on the Messages tab, Account Determination group <Group_ID>; GL account missing for <Sub-ledger>, which is in fact the real cause of the problem.-As some setups are missing for account determination, the system is not able to determine on which GL accounts, postings should happen for the Purchasing Document Items processed with errors during the GR/IR Clearing run.-Resolution-Maintain the missing setups for account determination within the Fine Tuning activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination - Account Determination, and run again the GR/IR Clearing. The previous erroneous Purchase Document Items will be processed successfully.

Title: Error Message: Status change not possible; corresponding organizational center exists, While Changing the Business Partner Status
Content: Symptom-When you try to change the status of a Business partner, system throws below error message:-Status change not possible; corresponding organizational center exists-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Business Partner view.-Highlight the Business Partner.-Select Change Status button and choose Blocked or Obsolete.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that this Business Partner is created automatically based on a Organizational Unit which was activated as a Company which is valid.-Resolution-If you want to Block or Obsolete this Business Partner, then the respective parameter Company of that Org Unit should be delimited.-After ending the validity of the Company parameter, then you can able to Block the status of the Business Partner.

Title: Error Message: Product Category ID Missing, While Uploading Material Through MS Excel
