Content: Symptom-When upload some Materials in the system using MS Excel, excel throws below error message:-Product Category ID missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select New button and choose New Material from Microsoft Excel.-Logon to the Excel (Business ByDesign Excel add-in)-Update the Material details in the excel.-Select Save data to.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Production Group is not entered for the Logistics.-If you are activating the Logistics for the Material then the Status, Site and Production Group are mandatory fields.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-You have to maintain the Production Group for the Site in Logistics section.-If you have not yet created the Production Group, follow the below steps:-1. Go to Supply Chain Design master Data work center.-2. Go to Production Groups view.-3. You can create the Production Group Hierarchy here.--After creation, you can enter the Production Group ID into the excel in the Logistics section.

Title: How to Set Termination Reason as 'Retirement' when Terminate an Employee
Content: Symptom-You may have a requirement to terminate an employee with the reason as Retirement.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Personnel Administration.-Select view Regular Tasks.-Select link Terminate Relationship with Employee. A new window pops up.-Select an employee abc who needs to be terminated.-Set Termination Category as Dismissal or Resignation. Then select Termination Reason. Note that there is no item Retirement in dropdown list Termination Reason.-Resolution-For terminating an employee, the Termination Category can be Dismissal (initiated by employer) or Resignation (initiated by employee).-For both categories, termination reason Retirement is not pre-configured. However, such a reason can be added via Business Configuration work center. For using Termination Reason as Retirement it is always recommended to use it under Resignation category.-Follow the below steps to add a termination reason:-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Select view Activity List.-Select chevron/arrow Fine-Tune on the top.-Select All Activities in the Show drop down list and search with Termination Reasons in the Find field.-Search for activity Termination Reasons in Find. Note that Termination Reasons is an optional activity and may not appear in fine-tuning activity list. Please follow the below steps to make it visible:-Select button Add Optional Activities to open a popup window.-Search Termination Reasons in Find.-Check In Activity List for Termination Reasons line.-Click Save button then Close button.-Select link Termination Reasons to open a popup window.-Select the Event type as Resignation.-Select Add button in the below Details pane.-In added line enter Retirement in Reason column and a code starting with letter Z in Code column.-Select Save and Close button.-Now Retirement should appear in Termination Reason for category Resignation during employee termination.

Title: No Authorization to Configure An Activity in the Business Configuration Work Center
Content: Symptom-When a user configures an activity within Business Configuration Work Center, he encounters an error, which is similar as the following when editing Manual Entry of Bank Directory:-You cannot open this activity. Your user does not have the necessary work center assignment. You may contact your System Administrator to assign the Cash and Liquidity Management, Business Partner Data Work Center in the Application and User Management Work Center.-Cause-While working on those activities within Business Configuration Work Center, a user not only needs the authorization of Business Configuration Work Center, but also the relevant application area work centers.-Resolution-Got to the Application and User Management Work Center and grant the user relevant access authorizations (assigning work centers to the user).

Title: Is it Possible to Replace the Business Partner Used in a Completed Transactional Process Documents With Another Business Partner?
Content: Symptom-You have many Transactional Process Documents like Sales Order, Purchase Order and Financial documents which had used the Business Partner XYZ and all the documents are in completed status. Now, you have requirement to replace the Business Partner XYZ to ABC. you would like to know, whether it is possible to replace the Business Partner?-Resolution-If you have created any business transaction document from a Business Partner, then it is not possible to replace the Business partner with another one. Also it is not possible to move those documents to a new Business Partner.-Instead, you can block/obsolete the existing Business Partner and use the new Business partner for the documents that you are created newly.-To block a Business Partner, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Partner data work center.-Select Business Partners view.-Highlight the Business Partner.-Select Change Status button and choose Block/Obsolete.-Note: It is not possible to block a business partner, if it is created for a Company which is in Active status.

Title: How to Transfer an Employee in Lean HCM Scoped System
Content: Symptom-How to transfer an employee from one Org unit to another Org unit in a Lean HCM scoped system?-Resolution-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight the Org unit where the employee needs to be moved.-Go to Employees tab.-Select Add button.-Search and select the employee.-Additional Information:-After adding the employee, you can also able to assign a new Job ID.-Once the employee is added into the new Org Unit, the old Org Unit assignment will be removed automatically.

Title: Is It Possible to Print or View the Activity Record of Other Employee?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible for an employee A to print (export to excel) or view the activity report of other employee B, who is substitue for employee A?--Resolution-It is not possible for a substitute to access an employee's time sheet except the below mentioned cases:-1. The employee's line manager is able to access the employee's time sheet and his activity report via Call Employee Services on Behalf in the Managing My Area work center.--2. For service agents, a project manager is able to access the Service Agent's time sheet through below steps:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Resources view.-Select the Service Agent and Select Edit Time Sheet button.

Title: Error Message: UoM XYZ not Valid; It is not Released, While Uploading Material Through MS Excel
Content: Symptom-When upload some Materials in the system using MS Excel, excel throws below error message:-UoM XYZ not valid; it is not released-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Select New button and choose New Material from Microsoft Excel.-Logon to the Excel (Business ByDesign Excel add-in)-Update the Material details in the excel.-Select Save data to.-Cause-There are two possible causes for this issue,-The UoM entered by you in the excel is not a valid symbol (ex: Typo error).-The UoM entered by you was created in the system but in Blocked status-Resolution-Verify whether the UoM symbol entered by you is as same as the one which is available in the system.-To check, whether status of the UoM, follow the below steps:-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Search for the fine tuning activity Quantities and Units of Measure under Business Configuration Search.-3. Select Create and Maintain Trading Units.-4. Show Blocked.-5. Search for UoM XYZ.--You can see the Activation Status of the respective UoM.-If you want to use this UoM for the Material, then the status of the UoM should be reverted to Active.

Title: Wrong Tax Event for Third-Party Purchase Orders. Tax Country Code of Foreign Account is Wrongly Fetched for Tax Determination
Content: Symptom-In a third-party purchase order, the supplier address and the buying company address are within the same country. The ship-to address, derived from from the account (end-customer) is located abroad. In the tax details, the tax country code is the one of the foreign account. Consequently, a tax code corresponding to a foreign acquisition is defaulted instead of one corresponding to a domestic acquisition.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Choose New -> Sales Order.-Choose an account located abroad.-Go to the Items tab.-Set the Fulfillment as External and select a domestic supplier.-Fill in all other mandatory details.-Choose Save and then Release.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the follow-up purchase order.-Go to the Items tab and then Taxes subtab.-The tax event is incorrect (foreign acquisition instead of domestic).-Cause-This is a new requirement. At present the tax determination is based on the ship-from address of the supplier and the ship-to address of the account (final recipient) rather than the bill-to address for your company.-Resolution-The above requirement will be part of a future release of SAP Business ByDesign. Until then, the tax details for the purchase orders must be maintained manually.

Title: No Cost Center Available for Selection While Creating a Labor Resource
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of creating a new Labor Resource and have observed that there is no Cost Center available in the value Help under Cost Center Assignments.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue or Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Resources view.-Select New button and choose Labor Resource.-In General tab, assign Site XYZ.-Go to Valuation tab, under Cost Center Assignments section; select the value help for Cost Center.-Cause-The cause for the issue might be because of below reason:-Initially the Org Unit XYZ might have marked as Business Residence and activated. So the system automatically created the Site XYZ. In case, if you have removed the Business Residence definition from the org unit XYZ and made another Org Unit as Business Residence then the Site XYZ will be active but not the Business Residence.-In Labor Resource, you can able to find the list of Cost Center only if the selected Site has a valid Business Residence because for a Cost Center, Business Residence is mandatory.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-To overcome the issue, you can either extend the validity of the Business Residence assignment of the Org Unit XYZ or assign another Site into the Labor Resource which has a valid Business Residence.-Note: In case, if you are using the Site XYZ then you can Block the status of that Site.

Title: Error Message: Business Partner XYZ (Business Partner Name) Already Exists, While Activating the Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate the Organizational Structure, system throws below error message:-Business Partner XYZ (Business Partner Name) already exists-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Highlight a Org unit.-Go to General tab and select External Business Identifiers link.-Add Internal Business Partner ID as XYZ.-Select Activate button and choose Activate All.- Cause-The cause for the issue is that there is already a Business Partner exist with the same ID XYZ. To verify, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Business Partners view.-Search for the Business Partner XYZ.- Resolution-The system works as designed.-When an org unit is defined as a company, a business partner is automatically created by the system when the company is activated. If you want overwrite the proposed system ID before the company is activated, then you can enter the Internal Business Partner ID inside External Business Identifiers. So this ID will considered as a Business partner ID.-You can verify the existing Business Partner ID using above steps and then you can enter a new Business Partner ID which was not yet created in the system.

Title: Best Practices in Handling System Down Situations & Getting Detailed Information on Customer Fact Sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When a customer calls to report a system down situation, it is extremely important that the engineers in cloud support are able to assess the situation very quickly and trigger the right actions.-The goal of this case document is to standardize the way such situation are handled and achieve the bigger goal:-Within maximum 10 minutes of receiving the call/incident, the Support Engineer should be able to:-Confirm, if the system is indeed down-Quickly identify, if the system is down because of an emergency maintenance activity or due to a technical error-Confirm, if Hosting is already working on this-What next action is needed.-This document covers the following key aspects:-How to handle calls from customer for system down cases-Working with Customer Fact Sheet to get a clear and accurate information on various administrative data.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below when you receive a call from customer or an incident to report a "system-down" situation.-DO NOT immediately ask the customer to "create an incident from Business Center" or "to lower the priority".-Instead, follow the step-by-step guideline below and then decide on the appropriate next action.-Resolution-A)     Get URL of the system-Check if the customer can give you the details regarding system ID, URL, customer name.-If customer is unable to recall the URL or the URL provided appears to be incorrect/not-working, confirm the URL from your side as per step (B).-B)     Get URL details from customer name-Log in to SPC to find the URL from customer name.-Go to Service Provider Cockpit-> LandScape-> Customers.-Select the customer ID.-Go to Tenants.-The link below shows the navigation in SPC to find the URL.-https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/x/z6e-R-C)     Check if the URL is accessible from SAP side-If URL is accessible at your side: Discuss this with customer and get more clarity on "what happens on his side". -If URL is not accessible at your side: Inform customer, that you will spend the next few minutes to do a few quick checks and that you will get back to him in a maximum of 10 minutes.-Execute steps D/E/F within the next 10 minutes - in a production down situation, 10 minutes is a already a significant amount of time.-D)     Confirm if there is an overlap with the contractual maintenance  window-Check in SPC for the contractual downtime window.-Go to Service Provider Cockpit-> LandScape-> Systems.-Select the corresponding system ID.-        Go to Contract Maintenance tab.- The below link shows the navigation in SPC to find planned downtime.-         https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/x/Ez2bR-If you find that the system is currently under contractual downtime, then update customer on the call itself that it is a contractual downtime for X number of minutes. If there is no contractual downtime, then do the following:-E)     Confirm if there is an overlap with emergency downtime window-Check in SPC for emergency downtime window.-               Go to Service Provider Cockpit-> Downtime.-               Select the corresponding system ID.-               The fields Maintenance Start time and Maintenance End Time shows that system might be down for some particular timeframe between this window.-               Please note that the maintenance window can be for 24 hours but it does not mean that system will not be accessible for that timeframe. The patch will be applied in this window for X number of minutes only and system can be made down mutiple times during this window for patch-The below link shows the navigation in SPC to find emergency downtime window.--https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/x/Mj2bR-    F)     Call ByD-MS Hotline --> Clarify on phone --> forward BCP incident to MS-ALL- Operations Topics queue if necessary-Call Hosting on their hotline number and get the latest update. In case of emergency downtime window, check with hosting about the real downtimes during that window.-Forward the ticket to "MS-All Operations Topics" queue after agreeing with counterpart on Hosting side.-G)     Call customer back as promised, within 10 minutes-Summarize status to customer based on findings based in steps D/E/F - consult a more experienced team member, if necessary.-Inform customer of the next update as per your conversation with colleagues from Hosting.-Document summary of all conversation in incident, ensuring customer is also adequately informed (via email also).-H)     Trigger incident escalation, if downtime is unplanned and exceeds 30 minutes-In the course of action, if you find that there is an unplanned downtime exceeding 30 minutes, without agreed action plan between SAP and all involved parties, then trigger the incident escalation and follow the escalation process guideline.-https://portal.wdf.sap.corp/irj/go/km/docs/corporate_portal/WS%20BSO/Products/OnDemand/SAP%20Cloud%20Services/SAP%20Cloud%20Support/Incident%20Management/Processes/2.4_Escalation_Handling.pdf-I)     If additional information regarding customer details is required, the following link provides an overview about what information can be found in which tool-https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/x/uIA5Qw -See Also-The link to SPC systems is already published in 24 *7 home page.-https://documents.wdf.sap.corp/share/proxy/alfresco/api/node/content/workspace/SpacesStore/06d6ddd5-1b53-4ffa-b5d4-74a0832d8a4f/7x24%20Expert%20Support%20Home%20Page.htm2-2. Password reset link for SPC is below :-https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/ByDHostingFactory/SPC+Access-3. You can assign certificate for your log-in to enable SSO.-4, Timezone- convertor link is below :-http://www.worldtimeserver.com/current_time_in_UTC.aspx

Title: Exchange Rate in Item Details Transaction Data
Content: Symptom-When entering a bank statement line you access the Item Details Transaction Data in order to enter an exchange rate applying to this bank transaction.-Your expectation is that this exchange rate will be applied when converting foreign currency into company currency.-However, the exchange rate in the Item Details Transaction Data does not override the exchange rate maintained in Work Center General Ledger. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Liquidity Management.-Access View Bank Statements.-Enter a new bank statement via New / Bank Statement.-In Step 3 - Create and Edit Items after entering the relevant line item details choose Item Details.-Here you are able to enter an exchange rate pertaining to this bank transaction.-Cause-The information in the field Exchange Rate is declaratory and for information purposes only (e.g. applied exchange rate by your house bank when converting payment currency into account currency).-This field does not take effect either for any internal conversions or for any accounting purposes.-Resolution-The maintained exchange rate for a particular date range in Work Center General Ledger / Common Tasks / Edit Exchange Rates is applied when converting transactions between foreign currency and company currency.

Title: Is it Possible to Delete an Employee and its Respective Business User?
Content: Symptom-You as a Key User, would like to know whether it is possible to delete an Employee and its respective Business User?-Resolution-Once an employee is hired into the system, it is not possible to remove the employee from the system and you can only terminate  them using below steps.-Employee:-Case 1: Lean HCM scoped system--1. Go to Business Partner Data work center.-2. Select Employees view.-3. Search for the Employee.-4. Highlight the Employee.-5. Select Edit button.-6. In the Valid To field, you can enter the termination date of the employee.-7. Select Save and Close button.-8. Now, select Active Employees in Show field. Here you cannot view this employee. But you can still check the data of this employee, if you search with All Employees.-Case 2: HCM scoped system-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Select Regular Tasks view.-3. Select Terminate an Employee link.-4. Select the Employee.-5. Enter other mandatory details.-6. Select Save and Close button.---Business Users:--Once, an employee is terminated as per above steps. His/Her Business User validity will also be terminated/ended. So he/she cannot able login into the system.

Title: Solution for FSI_REPAIR_DISPATCHER Job Fails
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Dispatcher job /1FS/REPAIR_DISPATCHER_001 fails.-Cause-The root cause is Business Object (BO) SBTM_TASK. -This is the cause of the problem:-There is a health check, which compares TREX indexed data with BO data. If there is any inconsistency, an entry is written into SFSG_BO_DELTA. Then there is a job, which reads from SFSG_BO_DELTA and tries to repair the inconsistency. This fails for BO SBTM_TASK.-There is one hotfix #18306, which guarantees that SBTM_TASK is not checked via health check. So no more data is written to SFSG_BO_DELTA. But if you have a system, which already has entries for SBTM_TASK in SFSG_BO_DELTA, then you have to delete them manually. The approach would be to check if hotfix # 18306 is deployed in the system and then clear SFSG_BO_DELTA.-After checking the hotfix, the entries in the table SFSG_BO_DELTA need to be cleared.-Resolution-1. Go to transaction SM37 and check the job /1FS/REPAIR_DISPATCHER_001.--The job was canceled with INITIAL_LOAD user.-2. Check the job log. The job fails due to the dump.--3. While checking the dump, it is caused due to the BO SBTM_TASK.--For cleaning SFSG_BO_DELTA, you need to run a report SFSG_CLEANUP_BO_DELTA.-4. Go to transaction SE38 and execute the report SFSG_CLEANUP_BO_DELTA.--5. In the Business Object field, enter the BO name, which is the cause for the issue (here the BO is SBTM_TASK) and execute it.-After executing the report, check the job in transaction SM37. It runs successfully in the next schedule.-Created by BYDMS-KB-FSI/TREX

Title: Cannot Specify Leave Hours when Applying for Partial Leave
Content: Symptom-Users want to apply for Partial Leave Request but cannot find the Time Interval field to specify leave hours.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Select the New Leave Request link under My Requests.-Select the Type of Leave and select the Half Day.-Cause-The option to record partial day vacation with unit hours is only available if the time type is mapped to a Quota Account which has unit hours.-Resolution-To record partial day leave with leave hours, users should consider to map time type to a quota account with unit hours. Generally users should always use Quota Account for vacation.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune chevron.-Search and open the Time Accounts - <Country> activity.-Select the Maintain Time Accounts link.-Here users can change the Category of the Time Account from Statistical to Quota.-Keywords-Time off, Absence request, PTO, Hourly leave, Hour-based quota, Unit of measure, UoM hours, Time account balance, Entitlement, Work schedule, Field not visible, UI visibility, Time range input, Form field missing, Leave configuration

Title: Error Messages : "Cost Centre does not Belong to Segment" or "Cost Centre does not Belong to Profit Centre"
Content: Symptom-When you create manually a new fixed asset and specify a cost centre assignment type you are not able to save the new fixed asset and the error messages Cost Centre does not Belong to Segment, Cost Centre does not Belong to Profit Centre and warning message Cost Centre <cost_centre_ID> not available for entire period 01/01/YYYY - 31/12/9999.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite:-The cost centre <cost_centre_ID> has a validity date starting from DD/MM/YYYY different from 01/01/YYYY-Go to the Fixed Assets work centre.-From the Common task area select the New Fixed Asset option.-Enter the mandatory data Fixed Asset Description, Company, Fixed Asset Class. The Assignment Type is Cost Center and you enter a Cost Center as <cost_centre_ID>.-Press the Save button.-The error messages:-Cost Centre does not Belong to Segment-Cost Centre does not Belong to Profit Centre-and the warning message:-Cost Centre <cost_centre_ID> not available for entire period 01/01/YYYY - 31/12/9999-are shown.-Cause-The problem is the derivation of segment and profit center from the cost center specified.-If a cost center is entered directly at the create screen, it creates an organizational assignment with this cost center with no time limitation. For deriving a profit center and a segment it uses the earliest point in time where posting is possible, meaning the first day in the first open fiscal year (01/01/YYYY in this case). If the cost center <cost_centre_ID> is not valid for this date no profit center and segment might be derived.-Resolution-3 options are available to create the new fixed asset manually.--1) Change the Valid from value of the organizational unit <cost_centre_ID> define as cost centre from DD/MM/YYYY to 01/01/YYYY in the organizational structure.--2) Close the fiscal year YYYY and then create the fixed asset asset with the cost centre <cost_centre_ID>. Closing fiscal year YYYY leads to deriving the profit center and segment on 01/01/YYYY+1, date on which the cost centre <cost_centre_ID> is valid for the entire fiscal year.--3) Create a new fixed asset manually without Cost Centre Assignment with all the data except the cost center <cost_centre_ID> and save. Ignore the message. The fixed asset is created with status "in preparation" you can then edit the new fixed asset. Navigate to Master Data view, Basic Data tab and create a new Organizational Assignment Intervals. Press the Add Row button and enter your cost center <cost_centre_ID> with start date later or equal to the start date of the validity of the organizational unit <cost_centre_ID>.-The third possibility is usually preferable.

Title: Project Task Column Is Missing in the Exported Activity Report
Content: Symptom-Users have a requirement to view all the time recordings on the tasks of specific project. When users export those recordings into Excel, they may observe that the Project Task is missing in exported Excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Self-Services Overview view.-Select the Edit Time Sheet link.-Select the View Activity Report button.-In the popup screen, select a Project.-Select the Export button -Choose the To Microsoft Excel.-In the Excel, the Project Task column is missing.-Cause-The Project Task column is available in the Excel but as a hidden column so it is not shown explicitly.-Resolution-Open the exported Excel:-Select both the columns (header level) six and seven using Ctrl key on the keyboard.-Right click on the header level (upon selection).-Select the Unhide option.-Now the Project Task column should appear.-Keywords-Spreadsheet download, XLSX output, CSV output, Data field not displayed, Reveal fields in spreadsheet, Exported file display settings, Timesheet spreadsheet output, WBS element in download, Worklog spreadsheet download, Field visibility options, Assignment line in spreadsheet, Show all fields in XLSX, Layout settings spreadsheet

Title: Error Message :Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters
Content: Symptom-When you create a New Supplier and upon saving, system throws below error message:-Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 40 characters-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base or Business Partner work center.-Select Suppliers view.-Select New button and choose Supplier.-In the field Supplier name, enter the Supplier name with more than 40 characters.-Select Save button.-Cause-The Supplier name entered by you is more than 40 characters.-Resolution-We have received many feedbacks regarding the Supplier name should be more than 40 characters but there are no plans to change this behavior because of below reasons:-With more than 40 characters we get a problem with the way how the data is provided for printing, with more than 40 characters, you have a problem to print the name on an envelope.-40 characters is the length in all other SAP solutions as well, as data exchange with i.e. ERP or CRM is very important to have the fields in Synchronization.-Apart from the above, the effort to change this at so many places is to huge.-Hence, we recommend you to make a meaningful abbreviation for Supplier Name, with equal to or less than 40 characters.

Title: Employee Deductions Are Not Available in Pay Data of Payroll Processing
Content: Symptom-Certain employee deductions (for example, illness or overtime) are missing from the Pay Data section during Payroll Processing. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payroll Processing work center.-Go to Payroll Run view.-Select the Payroll Group.-Go to the Employee Data tab and select the Pay Data sub tab.-Cause-If there is a deduction A which is mapped to Pay Type X, this deduction will only be visible in the Pay Data tab if the Pay Type X is Gross Relevant.-This can be verified as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine-Tune chevron.-Open the Provider Pay Types for Other Providers - <Country> activity.-Here it can be found which Pay Type is assigned as Gross Relevant.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords-withholding components, garnishment items, benefit contributions, wage element setup, net calculation criteria, eligibility flag settings, display filtering, localization rules, calculation schema, wage type catalog, compensation element, reporting relevance, taxable classification, remuneration code assignment

Title: Customer Tax Exemption Certificates (with US specifics)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Tax Exemption Certificates are a special form of tax exemption and not applicable in every country. They are issued for a specific reason for transactions between specified business partners, in contrast to a normal tax exemption which is valid in general. Hence the tax exemption certificate is only taken into account in transactions between these specified business partners.-Resolution-Tax Exemption Certificates within ByDesign are currently only available as Customer Tax Exemption Certificates, and can therefore only be used between a customer and a company. They can be limited for a certain period of time and even up to a certain amount.-There exist different types of usage for tax exemption certificates: single usage (only applicable once) and continuous usage (applicable several times till the validity expires or till the exempt amount is used up). The limitation to a total tax exemption amount is not applicable within the United States.-When creating a customer tax exemption certificate, you must set its validity period and the appropriate certificate type (Direct Payment Certificate, Exempt Organization Certificate, Exempt Use Certificate, or Resale Certificate) in combination with the type of usage.-A customer tax exemption certificate being a kind of tax exemption, the corresponding exemption reason needs to be provided as well. For the United States this can be one of the following: Agricultural Production, Charitable Organization, Direct Pay Permit,  Foreign Diplomat, Industrial Production / Manufacturing, Multiple Points of Use, Religious or Educational Organization, Resale, Federal Government, State or Local Government, or Tribal Government, or an Other reason not further specified.-For a customer tax exemption certificate for the United States, you furthermore have to specify the state in which it is valid. Please note that a tax exemption certificate can only be used in a transaction if it is created for the same state where the account is located.--Creation of a Customer Tax Exemption certificate-A Customer Tax Exemption Certificate can be created from within the account, or on the fly in a sales transaction document from the tax details section. Note that before a customer tax exemption certificate can be used, it must be activated.--Usage of a Customer Tax Exemption Certificate within Tax Calculation-Tax calculation automatically checks whether a customer tax exemption certificate can be used within a transaction. This depends on the involved parties (company and account), the tax date of the transaction and the validity period of the customer tax exemption certificate and other facts such as the certificate type and its usage so far.-As the customer tax exemption certificate types "Direct Payment Certificate - continuous" and "Exempt Organization Certificate - continuous" always apply, they can be determined automatically by tax calculation. For all the other certificate types you need the information from the customer whether the certificate can be used for the current transaction. So they have to be assigned manually in a sales transaction.-During tax calculation the manual set customer tax exemption certificate will be validated and in case it is not necessary or not possible to use this one, it will be discarded and the user informed accordingly. Reasons for discarding a manual set customer tax exemption certificate might be, for example: it is not valid at that point of time (check tax date in the document and the validity period of the customer tax exemption certificate), it has already been applied before in case of single usage, or the manual set customer tax exemption certificate is not necessary because the transaction is exempt due to other reasons (due to missing nexus or general tax-exemption of product or business partner).

Title: Health Insurance Funds List Is Shown in Employee Personnel File but Health Insurance Branch List Is Not Shown in Complete Payroll Data Task
Content: Symptom-You, as a payroll administration, maintain the list of Social Insurance Funds in the system. But the valuehelp of Health Insurance Branch Office in employee's Complete Payroll Data task shows empty list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Work view.-You can see Complete Payroll Data tasks. Highlight one and open it.-Go to step 2 Social Insurance Data. Select the valuehelp of Health Insurance Branch Office. The list may be empty.-Cause-Even you maintain Social Insurance Funds in Personnel Administration, the Branch Office is not defined. This is why the valuehelp of Health Insurance Branch Office is empty.-Resolution-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Authorities view.-Select the Show All Branch Offices. Choose the New Branch Office button to create new branch office.

Title: Datev Export Process: Meaning of the Warning Message "Journal Entry XXX not transformed"
Content: Symptom-When you check the Display Logs of a DATEV Export run the warning message Journal Entry XXX not transformed is shown on the Results tab.-There are as many warning messages as many journal entries are concerned.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work centre.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view then the DATEV Export sub-view.-Select the concerned run, choose Display Log.-Go to the Results tab of the logs.-The Warning message Journal Entry XXX not transformed is shown.-Cause-The concerned Journal Entries stated in the warning messages are Journal Entries with amount zero in the posting lines. Those Journal Entries are in general internal ones.-DATEV does not allow postings with amount zero. That's why these postings are not included in the DATEV export and warning messages are raised for them.-Resolution-As the Journal Entries with amount zero don't influence the account balance, such warning messages can be safely ignored.

Title: Formula to Calculate the Time Required to Run a Job "Check Data Including Index"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document calculates the time required to run a job "Check Data Including Index".-Resolution-You can calculate the time required to run a job Check Data Including Index based on the following formula:-    Time=used size(kb)/8(kb/page)*~5ms(IO time/page)*server tasks (one task per data volume)-1. Used size can be calculated as the following:-Log in to OS level with user sqd<sid>.-Execute the query to get the used size as displayed in the following screenshot:-2.  The number of Data Volumes is calculated in the following methods:-     Method:1-Log in to the back end system.-Go to the transaction DBACOCKPIT, navigate as System <SID>->Space->Data Area, the value Current Number gives the Data Volumes as displayed in the following screenshot:-    Method:2-Log in to the database studio. -Add the server vadb<sid>.-Right-click the <SID> and select the Administration.-Number of data volumes is found under the tab Data Area, No.of Data Volumes as displayed in the following screenshot:-                Example:-  With the Used size and Data volumes as shown in the screenshots, time required to run a job is as displayed:-   Time= 103044072(kb)/8*5ms/9=7155838ms/60=119 minutes approx.-  Hence for the system GMD, time requires to run a job Check Data Including Index is 119min approx.-Created by BYDMS-KB-IM-

Title: Background Job Tables and Mechanism
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Background job tables and mechanism-Resolution-1. Log on to the system to schedule a report or program in the background mode.-When the dialog: user defines the run of a job is in the background; it is entered into the tables TBTCT and TBTCS.-Background processing time scheduled is present in the table TBTCS and takes the value for batch job selection from the table TBTCT.-2. A background job scheduler runs every 60 seconds in the dialog mode to pick the background jobs.-Background job scheduler: SAPMSSY2 is the ABAP program that runs every rdisp/btctime. It runs for every 60 seconds or the time specified by the parameter rdisp/btctime=. It checks for the jobs in the ready state and brings them into the background job queue for processing.-3. If the job is picked and ready to execute, then the status is set to READY.-4. The status of the job is ACTIVE when the background process is assigned to the background job.-5. The status of job is CANCELED when the job is not finished successfully.-Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: ARCHIVED Incorrect Fiscal Period and Year Display in Production Variance Details in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The fiscal period and year are incorrectly displayed in the Production Variance Details report, showing values like 012.9999, which do not align with expected accounting periods. This leads to confusion when analyzing production variances.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports.-Search for the report FININVU19_Q0001 (Production Variance Details).-Open the report and execute it.-Remove any non-mandatory selection fields and rerun the report.-In the View tab, add the field Accounting Period/Year.-Notice that some periods display as 012.9999 instead of valid fiscal periods.-Cause-This issue can occur when the Production End Date for certain production lots is not properly updated or synchronized across the system. As a result, the system cannot accurately map the production data to the corresponding fiscal period and year, leading to the display of incorrect values (e.g., 012.9999).-Resolution-Therefore, we need to recalculate the cost variance. This might be labeled as "Recalculate Cost Variance".-Execute the recalculation process.-Once the recalculation is complete, verify the results.-Ensure that the variance calculation now considers the updated Production End Date.-Once done, Run the Production Variance Details report again.-Check that the fiscal period and year are correctly displayed and that the cost variances are accurate.-By following these steps, the incorrect fiscal period and year should be resolved in the production variance details report.-Keywords-Production Variance, Cost Variance, Fiscal Period, Year Display, Incorrect IBAN, Production Lot, SAP Business ByDesign, Accounting Period, Recalculate Cost Variance, Production End Date.

Title: ARCHIVED: Exchange Rate In Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run Differs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Wording in Cause and Resolution section is dubious and leads towards confusing interpretation of the process***-Exchange rate for a pair of currencies: ABC to DEF was maintained for a particular period and a Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Receivables was executed for that period. However, it is noted that the Remeasurement Run uses an exchange rate from the past. (ABC and DEF represents the currencies acronyms)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables work center choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs subview.-Click on New and choose Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run from the list.-Enter the Company ID and Period/Year.-Click on Start Immediately.-Choose Display Log.-In the List of Logs screen, click on View.-Go to the Processed Successfully tab.-Choose one line item with the transaction currency being ABC.-Document the exchange rate shown in the 'Key Date Exchange Rate' column.-Then go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click the Edit Exchange Rates link.-In the Exchange Rate for Foreign Currencies table, the exchange rate from ABC to DEF is different from that in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run.-Cause-During the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, the system determines the key date on the basis of the selection parameters 'Period' and 'Fiscal Year'. The last day of the period or fiscal year is the key date. In the system, there is one exchange rate from currency ABC to DEF which is valid from the last day of the month. When the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run is executed the system takes the Exchange Rate prevailing for that period end only and not as per the valid date in the Exchange rate history.-Resolution-System behaves as designed. It is expected for the system to take the exchange rate as per valid dates maintained, but the system takes the exchange rate that is valid for the period for which the Foreign Currency Remeasurement was executed.-Keywords-foreign currency, exchange, wrong, incorrect

Title: Error in VAT Return Run: Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to create a VAT Return Run and in the final of the process you are getting the following error message 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.-XYZ represents the code of the package ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Return Runs subview. -Search for the Run ID DEF (DEF represents the run ID).-Click in the Application log ID ABC (ABC represents the application log ID).-You will see the error message:-'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.-Cause-Dump is happening due to large amount of selected data being retrieved from the Tax Register Item node.-The VAT had an error due to lack of memory.-Resolution-There are some ways in which the issue can be handled:-Reduce the data selection of the VAT Return run. You can inform a smaller period in the From/To dates;-Or,-Use Aggregation Run-You can use the aggregation run functionality that creates multiple returns for the same run, one after the other to avoid huge data in a single return. For more information refer to the Blog Aggregation Tax Returns in SAP Business ByDesign -See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-VAT Return run, package, report an incident, dump,

Title: ARCHIVED: How to Request an Avoid Escalation Towards IEMT CSD CSUP TS PBC ERP BYD
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: The Escalation Management of SAP Business ByDesign has been transitioned to SAP CIM/MCC as of 01.10.2024. For updated escalation process refer to WIPS Golden Standard - Critical Incident Situation.*** -***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA informs how you can request an Avoid Escalation to Incident Escalation Management Team (IEMT). Such request is meant for cases stuck (no visibility, no updates, etc) in Development Team and Operations Team.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Prerequisites before involving IEMT on an Avoid Escalation Request:-The case priority is Very High and the case is older than 7 calendar days.-The case priority is High and has no or little update visibility by Development or Operations Team.-The Development Product Owner (Product Area Lead copied) has been emailed already.-If the prerequisites above are fulfilled, please use the following templates to request the Avoid Escalation:-Development Avoid Escalation, download the template from the Attachments Section named as "Customer Name - Avoid Escalations P2 - Case ID XXX.oft".-Operations Avoid Escalations, download the template from the Attachments Section named as "Customer Name - Avoid Operations Escalations - Case ID XXX.oft".-See Also-3323959 - Central KBA for IEMT Services-3137387 - How to Request a Case Escalation Towards IEMT CSD CSUP TS PBC ERP BYD-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, ByD, Avoid Escalation Request, How To, Development Team, Operations Team.

Title: ARCHIVED: How to Request a Case Escalation Towards IEMT CSD CSUP TS PBC ERP BYD

For updated escalation process refer to WIPS Golden Standard - Critical Incident Situation.*** -***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Business ByDesign customer or partner is unhappy with case resolution progress for one or multiple critical cases and you as a customer-facing SAP employee need help from our Incident Escalation Management Team (IEMT).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Very High case without provided workaround or solution-Resolution-There are two ways to escalate.-The customer calls the support hotline and CIC colleague decides whether to involve IEMT or CIM.-The customer contacts her/his SAP contact.-Options at your disposal:-SAP contact enters all necessary information into the MCC SOS App. IEMT might get involved after request from MCC.-Instructions how to use the MCC SOS APP are here: SAP MCC SOS App-Or-Recommended:-SAP contact fills e-mail template and send to IEMT directly. IEMT starts working on the escalation request immediately and provides the first update within 1 hour towards the requestor.-Remark: the e-mail template is available in the Attachments section of this KBA.-See Also-Below please see the setup of the Escalation Request e-mail:-Sent to: CSD CSUP TS PBC ERP BYD Incident Escalation Team: DL CSD CSUP TS PBC ERP BYD IEMT-Subject: Escalation Request: <BYD>, <Case number>, P1,<Customer Name>-Body of the e-mail:-Dear Colleagues,-Please be aware of this new incoming Case Escalation Request.-Escalation Request Form- ----------------------------------------------------------Case Number:-Customer Name/No.:-Date/Time of Request (CET):-Requester of Escalation:-Customer Contact (24x7 - phone, e-mail):-Subject (short issue description)-Affected Business Area: < e.g. FIN/CRM>-Reason for Escalation:-Overall Business Impact for Customer:-Additional Information: (screenshots, related cases, e-mail communication...)-------------------------------------------------------------3323959 - Central KBA for IEMT Services-Keywords-Escalation, Case escalation, IEMT, Incident Escalation Management Team, PS, MCC

Title: ARCHIVED Project Task Not Available for Selection in Expense Report Cost Assignment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Project Task ABC (ABC represents the Project Task ID) is not available for selection in Edit Cost Assignment option within an Expense Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Common Tasks -> New expense report on behalf option.-Select the respective Employee ID.-Select Type of Expense report: Out-of-pocket expenses.-Enter any Purpose and click Edit Cost Assignment.-Click Add Row.-Select Account Assignment Type: Project Task.-Click the value help icon.-Notice that Project Task ABC is not available for selection.-Remark: the Expense Report Allowed checkbox has been marked for the Project Task ABC in its respective Project Plan, so the expectation was that ABC would show up for selection in the expense report.-Cause-The value help for the Project Task field shows the project tasks relevant for the respective employee. -Resolution-To display all tasks, after clicking the value help icon for Project Task you should click Open Advanced Filter icon and remove the Employee ID. -Remark: this explanation is also visible by hovering the mouse over the Project Task label in the Edit Cost Assignment pop-up.-Keywords-project task; employee ID; expense report allowed; edit cost assignment; account assignment type

Title: ARCHIVED Intercompany Supplier Invoice not Created Automatically From Customer Invoice Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2677533***-In the intercompany scenario, you have released the customer invoice document however system failed to create intercompany supplier invoice automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Documents view-Select the relevant Customer Invoice document-Select Release button-Now go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice and Credit Memos view-Search for Intercompany Supplier Invoice created from Customer Invoice document-No records found-Cause-In the account master data, you have defined the Output Channel Settings as Printer and then Internal EDX. -Resolution-When you define multiple output channels in the account master data, you need to maintained the Output Channel Internal EDX in the first position or else, system will not create intercompany supplier invoice. This is an expected behavior. -See Also-2677533 - Intercompany Supplier Invoice not Created Automatically From Customer Invoice Document-2911155 - How to Define Multiple Output Channels-Keywords-Intercompany Supplier Invoice not Created Automatically From Customer Invoice Document;

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA  2594317***--While trying to send an case to provider, you receive error message "Cannot send to the provider; please update your e-mail address and/or telephone number"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Help Center.-Click Solve Problem or Report case.-Select Send to Provider and enter other mandatory information.-Click Finish.-You receive an error message "Cannot send to the provider; please update your e-mail address and/or telephone number".-Cause-The error is triggered because the key user did not maintain their workplace contact information in the Personnel Administration work center.-Resolution-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Find the relevant employee record associated to the key user.-Click Action, then Change Workplace Contact Data.-Maintain your phone/mobile phone and your e-mail address.-Click Save and Close.

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: duplicate of KBA 2412550*** -***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When customer faces Error message while approving Purchase Order which Approvals are not required - "Action Not Enabled" and they give you permission to complete then we wanted steps on how to complete the task in back end.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Choose the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Click on Approve button.-System throws an error message as "Action not enabled".-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search for Purchase Order ABC.-Check the Status is not in Approval.-Cause-Document like purchase order is not in status In approval and approval task  is still open due to Backend inconsistencies.-Resolution-Tasks needs to be completed in backend, follow below steps:-Open backend.-Open Transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-Enter the BO Name (/SRMAP/LPURX_PO).-Enter the BO Node ID (In SESFTS -> enter the BO Name /SRMAP/LPURX_PO and click on enter -> Load by query -> ROOT-QUERY_BY_ELEMETS -> Enter the PO ID ABC next to the field ID/content and enter -> BO Node ID is fetched).-Click on Execute (or F8).-Search for the task to be completed for the Purchase Order ABC.-Click on the Flag button.-Complete the task.-See Also-1994439 - While Approving Purchase Order You Receive An Error Message Action Not Enabled-3333529 - Approver unable to approve or reject due to Error:' Action not enabled' -Keywords-Purchase Order, Approval, Error Message, Action Not Enabled

Title: ARCHIVED:Unexpected/ Skipped Approver in Purchase Order Approval Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: duplicate of KBA 3279932 - Unexpected / Skipped Approver in Purchase Order Approval Process -You notice that a Purchase Order Approval Task is sent to an unexpected Approver which is not following the Approval Process-Or-An Approval step is skipped even when the condition is satisfied.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Create Purchase Order ABC.-Navigate to Approvals tab, and notice that the step 1 Approver is X, and step 2 Approver is Y.-Submit the Purchase Order for Approval.-Approver X approves the Purchase Order and the order status is updated to Sent. Step 2 of the approval is skipped.-Navigate to the Purchase Order, to the Approval tab, and notice only step 1 is showing, step 2 has disappeared.-Cause-There can be multiple causes for this behavior, one of which is outlined below.-In Application and User Management work center - Approval Processes view, in the Purchase Order Approval Process, you have scoped Skip Reapproval for Step 2.-Meanwhile, in Application and User Management work center - Substitutions view, Approver Y is substituted by Approver X, with a validity of Active.-Hence, when the system is checking the necessity of the step 2 Approval, it notices that the actual Approver should be Y's substitute X, who already approved the Purchase Order in earlier steps.-As Skip Reapproval is in scope, the system skips step 2 and triggers the next step approval (if there are any) or directly sends the order to the supplier (if no follow up approval steps required).-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-If you want to stop the system behaving in this way, you can either descope Skip Reapproval from the Approval Process, or deactivate the substitution for the users according to your business case.-Keywords-Wrong Approver, skipped step, substitution, Purchase Order, Approval Process.

Title: ARCHIVED How does a Purchasing Contract expire automatically?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Purchasing Contract status is showing as Expired-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to Contracts view.-Search for the Purchasing Contract XXX.-Expiry status of the Purchasing Contract is Expired. -Resolution-A Purchasing Contract Expires in the following cases:-The validity period of the Purchasing Contract is expired.-The open target value of the Purchasing Contract is expired.-The open quantity or value of at least one item in the Purchasing Contract is expired.-The released amount exceeds the target amount of contract.-Above are the scenario's where the system updates the status to closed/expired even if validity end date is in future.-See Also-Please refer to the SAP Help Document for further information:-Task - Check Expired Purchasing Contract | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Purchasing contract expired, validity date is not expired.

Failed message in the backend.-In order to check this please follow the below steps:-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select Sales Order view.-Opened the relevant document.-Navigate to Changes tab.-See that the Consistency Status was changed from Inconsistent to Consistent.-Resolution-In the backend using SRT_MONI follow the below steps:-Search in the Business Object Selection.-Enter the BO Proxy Name as SALES_ORDER.-In the BO Identifier enter the Sales Order ID.-See the failed message: Item invoicing method (time and material, or fixed price) missing.-If the Sales Order is now consistent in the UI you can reconcile this failed message, after that all the subsequent messages should be delivered as well.-Keywords-Sales Order, Project, Failed Message

Title: Journal Entries Already Exist for Set of Books While Changing Company Currency
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to change the Company Currency but you receive the error message:-Set of books ABC(ABC refers to Set of Books), Company XYZ (XYZ refers to Company) Journal Entries already exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Activity Set of Books.-Select the Set of Books and click Edit.-Go to the Company Settings and change the Company Currency.-Error message is shown.-Cause-Journal Entries already exist for the Set of Books ABC(ABC refers to Set of Books) and Company XYZ(XYZ refers to Company). It is not possible to change the Currency if Journal Entries exist as it would create some inconsistencies due to the difference of currencies.-Resolution-You can change the Company Currency only if there is no Journal Entry. If you reverse the Journal Entries, then also you cannot change the Company Currency.-Note: The solution is applicable to Fiscal Year Variant and Chart of Accounts also. Once the Journal Entry is created then you cannot change the Fiscal Year Variant and Chart of Accounts.--See Also-KBA 2553084 - 'Set of books ABC, company XYZ; Service cost rates already exist' Error Message While Changing Company Currency-Keywords-Set of Books , Currency, Journal Entries already Exist

Title: Error Message Field 'Attachments-Attachments Folder UUID" cannot be empty in migration mode "Update existing records"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a requirement to enhance the Attachment (Link) in some of the Customers (Accounts). When you try to migrate Customer in Enhancement mode only for Attachments, system throws below error message during simulation,-Field 'Attachments-Attachments Folder UUID" cannot be empty in migration mode "Update existing records"--Field 'Attachments-Attachments Document UUID" cannot be empty in migration mode "Update existing records"-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to Overview view.-3. Search and open the activity Migration of Customers.-4. Select Migrate customers unsing migration tool-5. Select the file-6. Execute Migration and the system throws above error messages-Resolution-The system works as designed. It is not possible to Enhance the Attachment of Customers.-The feature described in this case is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-For further details, you can refer to the documentation can be found using the help center document Configuration: Prepare for Data Migration in a Change Project.- Path:-Expand Task.-Expand Fill migration templates.-Section 3. Enhance already existing records-Select the link Customers — Enhance Records in a Change Project.-This misleading situation exists only in the current release and from next release, you will see that in enhancement mode the sheet for Attachments does not appear at all.-Note:-These fields Attachment Folder UUID and Attachment Document UUID are only relevant for the net update. If the user extract the data via Mass Data Maintenance work center, these 2 fields are automatically filled.--So, while migrating the Customer Data using Data Migration these fields can be ignored.

Title: ARCHIVED:Error: "File Validation failed; Create an case." While Migrating Purchase Orders
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Similar case raised earlier ,so i will merge the root cause and resolution on to one KBA:2874598 - Error Message "File Validation Failed. Create an case" During Migration of Purchase Order-Your requirement is to migrate purchase orders using the migration tool. During the validation of the migration file, you receive the error:-File validation failed. Create an case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to the Overview view-Find and Open the activity Migration of Purchase Orders-Upload the migration file-Select the Execute Migration button and choose the Step by Step option-You see the error-Cause-It is likely that the field Price Unit on the Items tab of the Migration of Purchase Orders file is mistaken to be e.g. a Currency or UOM field. The current value of the field Price Unit is not correct.-The field Price Unit expects a number. It indicates the number of product units. This is to specify, for how many eaches/liters/kilograms (or what ever the UoM is) the indicated price applies. Therefore values like EUR, USD, INR etc. are not compatible for the field Price Unit.-Resolution-Modify the content of the template, so that only numeric data is supplied for fields with type Number, and proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords-Migration of Purchase Orders, Purchase Orders upload, Price Unit, Migrate Purchase Orders, Purchase Orders

Title: Archived: Unable To Remove Time Entry
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 3216923***-You are trying to remove a time entry in the user's time sheet, however the Remove button is not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time Sheet sub-view.-Open the user's Time Sheet.-Go to tab Review and Correct.-Under the Time Recording Completeness section, select the desired date.-Under the Details section of the chosen date, select the time entry you wish to remove.-You will see that the Remove button is grayed out.-Cause-The time type which concerns the time entry you selected has not been activated for usage in the employee time sheet or in the Time File of the Time Administration, therefore all the recordings for the given time type appear as read-only.-Resolution-You will need to activate the time type via Business Configuration.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find the activity Time Types - XX (XX represents the country abbreviation)-Click Change Immediately.-On the screen that opens, click Maintain Employee Time Types, under Employee Time Types section.-Choose the concerned time type.-In the Service Activation tab, you will be able to flag the time type for Time Sheet and Time Administration.-Save your changes.-Open the user's time sheet again.-Keywords-Time, Read-only, Remove button, Grayed out

Title: How to activate DKIM for the Business Email
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2937666 ***-Customers are requesting for the activation of DKIM for the Business emails for sub-domains maintained in Cloud for Customer tenants.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Activation needs to be handled by CPS Lifecycle & Inbuilt Services(LIS) team-Resolution-Please share the below information to the customer and once they agreed to proceed with activation, send the incident to Hosting Team for further action-**************-We support DKIM signing for the outbound mails and SPF Policy. Please refer the blog for more details :https://blogs.sap.com/2021/01/15/dkim-key-activation-for-business-emails-in-cloud-for-customerc4c-business-bydesignbyd/ -If you want to continue with the activation, please provide the following details:-Sender domain(s) list that are used for relaying business mails from your tenant, Example: abc.com/test.com/etc.-Once we get the list of domains, we will generate a DKIM key for those domain(s) and will share the public key with you, which then has to be maintained on your DNS server as a DKIM TXT record.-After maintaining the DKIM key on your DNS successfully, we will activate the configuration from our side, such that the mails sent from then onwards from your  tenant will be DKIM signed.-**************-See Also-Please refer to the documentation below for additional information regarding DKIM key:-Community Link: DKIM Key Activation for Business Emails in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD)-3234704 - How to activate Mass Email Functionality in SAP BYD and C4C-Keywords-DKIM, business mail, DNS, Business Email for C4C, Business Email for BYD, DKIM for Business Emails, DKIM Activation.

Title: ARCHIVED: Unable to Remove Booked Time Against Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Solution consolidated in KBA 3216923***-Unable to remove booked time against Project in Employee Time Sheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Choose Time Recording view.-Choose Time Sheet subview.-Choose the employee XYZ (XYZ represents the employee ID).-Choose Open Time Sheet button.-Here the entry is read-only and the Remove button is grayed out.-Cause-The Time Recording is marked as Not Allowed for the project task against which the employee is recording time hence the time recording cannot be changed. Hence the Remove button is greyed out in the time sheet.-Resolution-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose Projects view.-Choose Projects subview.-Choose show All Projects.-Search for Project ABC (ABC represents the Project ID against which the employee XYZ is recording time).-Choose Edit --> Project Plan Button.-Choose Project Task which is assigned to the employee XYZ.-Choose the field Time Recording and change the field from Not Allowed to Approval Required or No Approval Required as per your requirement.-Click Save button. Then the Remove button will be enabled in the Time administration work center, the employee time entries should be editable.-Keywords-Greyed out, Remove button, Time recording, Time sheet

Title: ARCHIVED:Error Message That E-mail Address Is Invalid When Approving Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:Duplicate of KBA  2726291 - Error Message:E-mail address is invalid: Not listed in allowed email domain-When approving Purchase Orders, system shows an error message: E-Mail Address is Invalid: Not Listed in Allowed Domain.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Filter for Open Tasks.-Select the task and click Approve button.-System shows error messages:-E-Mail Address is Invalid: Not Listed in Allowed Domain.-Save failed; refresh list to perform further action.-Cause-The Sender e-mail Address in the Output Settings for Purchase Order is wrong.-Resolution-You can check if the sender e-mail address is correct in the edit output history of Purchase Order.-To add an e-mail domain, follow the steps bellow:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Choose All Configuration Elements.-Search for e-mail and Fax Settings.-For Allowed Sender e-mail Domains, add a row and maintain a domain (all details after the @ for the e-mail Address) as you have maintained for Sender's e-mail Address.-Save and Close.-When you create new Purchase Orders, the errors should not appear.-To solve this issue for old documents, we have 2 options:-You need to cancel all documents that you're having the error message and create from beginning (not copping) as the e-mail is maintained correct for the employee right now.-You can authorize us to change manually this sender e-mail into the backend and tell us the affected documents, but you need to Send Back for Revision all of them (In approval is not possible to do the changes).-See Also-2726291 - Error Message:E-mail address is invalid: Not listed in allowed email domain;-Keywords-Approval Errors; Purchase order; E-mail Address Invalid; Sender E-mail; Email;

Title: ARCHIVED: Error "Start Date Can't Be Changed Because of Manual adjustments on Time Account" During Migration of Time and Labor Management
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 3036471***-You are trying to complete a migration of Time and Labor Management, but receive error message "Start Date can't be changed because of Manual adjustments on time account".-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Employee and User Data.-Click the link to Migrate time and labor management data using the migration tool.-Select a migration file available in the Source Files table or upload a new one by clicking the Upload button.-Click Execute Migration, then Execute Migration Step by Step.-Proceed with the migration until the third step (Simulate), where error occurs.-Cause-One of the possible causes for the issue is that the date in the Time File Start Date field of the migration template is different than the date in the time file of the employee(s) being migrated.-To check this, please follow the below instructions:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Search and select the employee(s) being migrated.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-In the Time Profile section, you can check the Start Date — if this value is different than what was entered in the migration template, the error message will occur.-Resolution-To solve this, please change the date in the migration template to match the date maintained in the time file of the employee(s).-Keywords-Start Date, Changed, Migration

Title: Cancelled Supplier Invoice is not Posted due to Error: Cannot find goods or service receipt XYZ for purchase order AAA item AAA-1 in accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-DO NOT USE-You have canceled a Supplier Invoice but a task is displayed with error message: Cannot find goods or service receipt XYZ for purchase order AAA item AAA-1 in accounting. (XYZ stands for Goods or Service Receipt ID, AAA stands for Purchase Order ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the Invoice and select the Cancel Document button.-Fill in all the mandatory details.-Select Post button.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Source Documents sub-view in Closing Cockpit view.-A task is displayed for the Supplier Invoice.-Cause-The Supplier Invoice is not posted to accounting because of missing goods and services receipt in accounting.-The Task created for the Goods and services receipt in the General Ledger is set as irrelevant. So system fails to find the goods and service receipt in accounting.-Resolution-So please mark the task created for the cancellation invoice as irrelevant.--Then tasks created for the supplier invoice and cancellation invoice become irrelevant.-To do so, please follow the steps below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Source Documents sub-view in Closing Cockpit view.-Select the task related to Supplier invoice (Cancellation Invoice).-Select the View Business Transaction option from the drop-down list of Actions button.-Select Mark As Irrelevant button.-Select Save.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, goods or service receipt

Title: ARCHIVED: Business Partners Generated for Companies are Not Having the Same ID as the Org Unit ID
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: Duplicate of 1694086 - Business Partners Generated for Companies Don't Always Have the Same ID As Org Unit ID-In SAP Business ByDesign, setting an org unit as a company automatically generates a corresponding business partner.-You have created your organizational structure and activated it, but noticed that for some companies, the business partner ID is the same as the org unit's ID, while for others, it is different.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When you create and activate a new Company in the Organisational Management the corresponding business partner will be created with an internal ID determined as follows:-If the business partner ID is provided in the Internal Business Partner ID field of the org unit, then upon activation, that ID will be used.-If there is no business partner ID specified, then the org unit ID will be taken, as long as the org unit ID's length is ≤ 10 characters and as long as this org unit ID is within an external number range of the business partner maintained in the General Business Partners fine-tuning activity of the Business Configuration.-Otherwise the business partner ID will be taken from the internal automatic number range maintained in the General Business Partners fine-tuning activity of the Business Configuration. -Resolution- The system works as designed.-Keywords-Org Unit ID, Business Partner ID, Company, Different, Internal Business Partner ID

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**TO BE ARCHIEVED**-Reason: Functionality not valid-You want to change UID in Organizational Management from old company to new company.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Organizational Management wokrcenter and select Organization Structure view.-2.  Edit the Org Structure and choose the date DD1.MM1.YYYY1 in the field Currently selected effective-from date.-3. Press OK.-4. Switch to facet Definitions.-5. Note that the value in the field UID Number is XXX.-6. Change the date to DD2.MM2.YYYY2.-7. Press GO.-8. Change the value in the field UID Number to YYY.-9. Enter.-10.Switch to facet Timelines-Actual Result:-The UID Number shows the value DD3.MM3.YYYY3 in the Valid From field which is the initial Organization set-up date instead of change date DD2.MM2.YYYY2.-Cause-The UID field is a Standard ID field which is also synchronized to the twin instance of Business Partner (Supplier, Customer).--Since the field in Business Partner is not time dependent, we always update the Standard IDs for complete validity of the org unit so that the Business Partner and Organizational Management Data are in sync.-Resolution-System works as expected.

Title: Error Message: "XYZ (Org Unit Name) Not Permitted; ID Already in Use" When Activating an Organizational Unit
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**TO BE ARCHIVED**-Reason: Consolidated in KBA 2461723-When attempting to save or activate your organizational structure, the system displays the following error message:-ID XYZ (Name) not permitted; ID already in use.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-While saving or activating the Org Structure, system throws the above error message.-Cause-There are different reasons that could have caused this issue:-You may have already activated an Org Unit with a specific ID and are attempting to activate another Org Unit with the same ID.-An Org Unit was previously activated, then deleted. This can be verified in the Changes tab of Org Unit XYZ in the Active Area. In the Planning Area, the Org Unit XYZ was deleted and a new Org Unit with the same ID was created. The issue occurs when, before activating the deletion, you attempt to create a new Org Unit with the same ID and activate the changes.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1: you have to delete the inactive org structure which has the same ID.-Go to Organizational management work center.-Select Edit button.-Select Select Org Structures button. (Where you can find two structures with same ID).-Choose both and select Ok button.-Now you can find the duplicate (in complete structure) and delete this structure (bottom to top approach).-Now, you can able to activate the original structure without any issues.-Note:-How to find which org unit is active?-Select the Org unit in Definitions tab, the Org unit ID field should be read-only which means it is active org unit. If the org unit ID field is editable then this org unit is not yet active.-Resolution for cause 2:-It is always recommended to activate the Org Structure after deleting the Org Unit and then create a new org unit with the same ID. Hence, use Roll Back option to roll back all the changes done in the Planning area.-Note that roll back will delete all the changes done in the planning area and revert to last active version.-Go to Planning Area of the Organizational Structure.-Select Roll Back button.-Then you can delete the Org unit XYZ and activate this deletion.- After which, you can create a new org unit with the same ID.-  Keywords- 2461723

Title: Business Partner ID Does Not Match Number Range Definition
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom--You assume the business partner ID should be between 1 to 1,000,000 as defined in number range definition, but when you create a new business partner, its ID is outside of this range, for example, 5,000,001.-***Archived reason: KBA is Outdated***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-During the project scoping phase, the number range should be defined.
