Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer requests to unlock a user and/or reset its password.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Please note that SAP will only do this if no other administrator in the system can do this (or if, for example, the only administrator user available is the one locked)-To unlock a user, follow the steps below:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Access the Business Users work center view.-Select the locked user and click button Unlock User.-To reset the user's password:-Once you have unlocked the user in the Business Users view, click Edit and select Attributes.-Unmark the "Password locked" checkbox, if applicable.-Enter the new password.-Click the Save and Close button.-You can also reset a user's password from the backend:-Note down the user's technical ID, which can be found in Business Users view.-Access the system's backend (refer to KBA 1704961).-Go to transaction code SU01.-In field User, input the technical ID, then click the Display button.-Navigate to the Logon Data tab and click button Display/Change.-Input the new password and click the Save button.-Keywords-business user, unlock, password reset

Title: Incoming Bank Payment Posted on Account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Incoming bank payment is directly allocated to customer/supplier account.-You expected the incoming bank statement to confirm an already In Transfer payment in the Payment Monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements  view.-Search for Bank statement ABC (ABC is the bank statement ID) and select it.-The Post Processing status is Required.-Click View.-Generated: Automatically.-File ID: DEF (DEF is the inbound file ID).-Bank Statement Format: for example MT940 DE.-Navigate to the Transactions tab.-For all Items the Payment Method is Incoming Bank Transfer.-Select Item ID ABC-NN (ABC-NN is the bank statement item ID).-Click Required to open the clearing.-This opens the Clearing Overview ABC/NN (ABC/NN is the clearing overview ID).-The Clearing Status is Paid on Account.-The transaction amount is AA,AA (AA,AA is the exact transaction amount).-According to the Memo lines, the related Invoice is NOP (NOP is the invoice ID).-There is an open task: "Review and Clear Bank Statement ABC/NN."-Click View All.-The status is Paid on Account.-Opens the Manual Payment Clearing ABC/NN.-Go back to the Bank statement item ABC/NN.-For the Item ABC/NN, navigate to the Document Flow subtab.-The payment has a Payment Allocation HIJ (HIJ is the payment allocation ID).-Click open the Paymetn Allocation HIJ and then View All.-Document ID:KLM (KLM is the payment/ document ID).-External Transaction Code: XYZ (XYZ is the external transaction code).-The Payment Allocation has been posted to the Customer Account.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search and select Invoice NOP.-Click Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The related Payment Order is QRS (QRS is the payment ID).-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-There is a confirmed Payment with Document ID KLM and Post Processing Required status.-Open PostProcessing Required to open the Clearing ABC/NN.-Go back to the Payment Monitor view.-Search and select the Payment Order QRS.-The status is In Transfer.-The Payment method is Incoming Direct Debit.-Click Edit.-Payment Amount in Transaction Currency: AA,AA-Payment Medium Format Code: SEPA Direct Debit-The Memo Line contains invoice NOP.-You expected the incoming bank statement ID ABC/NN to directly confirm the Payment QRS for the invoice NOP. Instead, an account payment KLM was created and confirmed in the Payment Monitor.-Cause-Self-initiated payments, like incoming Direct Debit, are not intended to be posted against the Business Partner Account since the actual payments are expected to be recorded in the system. Instead, the bank transactions should be matched and allocated against those candidate payments in the Payment Allocation.-If the payment method is Incoming Direct Debit and there is a Payment with status In Transfer (with matching IBAN and transaction amount), the payment gets automatically confirmed.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Automatically Generated Bank Statements activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Select Import Format MT940 DE.-Navigate to the External transaction Codes section.-Filter for External Transaction Code XYZ.-The description is SEPA direct debit deposit.-The Payment method is Payment Processing - Of Incoming Bank Transfer.-The payment method Incoming or Outgoing Bank Transfer would mean that the bank statement item has to be either assigned to an open invoice or paid on account.-You need to change the payment method to Payment Processing - Of Incoming Direct Debit.-Resolution-To solve the issue, change the payment method for the external transaction code XYZ of the import format for example MT940 DE.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the Automatically Generated Bank Statements activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Select Import Format MT940 DE.-Navigate to the External transaction Codes section.-Filter for External Transaction Code XYZ.-The Payment method is Payment Processing - Of Incoming Bank Transfer.-Change the payment method to Payment Processing - Of Incoming Direct Debit.-Click Save.-If you leave the payment method blank, no automatic payment allocation would happen. The PostProcessing status of the bank statement would be Required and nothing would be allocated. The payment method would be other incoming methods in the payment allocation of the bank statement item.-Keywords-incoming bank payment; Paid on account; Akonto Zahlung; Eingehende Banküberwiesung; SEPA- Lastschrift; SEPA Direct Debit

Title: PSM Release Request For Split Open Items Action
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to reach the Split Open Items action via Cloud Application Studio in order to split open items payable and open items for receivables, however the action cannot be found via Studio.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Account view.-Open any supplier account monitor.-Select an open items.-Click Actions -> Split Open Items.-You wish to reach the Split Open Items action via Studio, but the action is not being shown.-Resolution-The Split Open Items action in the customer/supplier accounts monitor is done by BO DueClearing and the corresponding action is CreateWithReference. However, this action is not PSM released. The action itself is too complex to be released for public usage, since it would be required, among other things, the release of subsequent elements and BO nodes that would significantly increase the complexity for making this PSM enabled.-As a workaround, you can check the availability of partner badi exit BADI_FOP_TRP_ITEM_SPLIT, which would be called when the invoice is posted in Financials.-Here the invoice can be passed to be split and the information regarding the individual splits. When the invoice is posted, if this badi is implemented, then the invoice will already be split in multiple open items in the account monitor.-Keywords-Public Solution Modeling. PSM. SDK. Cloud Studio.

Title: ARCHIVE - Negative stock not permitted in logistics area DEF, material PQR while creating Stock transfer Order.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 3510984***-While trying to release the Outbound delivery in Stock transfer Order, the system gives you below error message even if stock is available for product PQR.*DEF refers to Logistics Area, PQR refers to Material id, N refers to No of Quantities, XYZ refers to Site id-Negative stock not permitted in logistics area DEF, material PQR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Under Delivery Control, Navigate to Delivery Proposals View.-Search for  the relevant Delivery Request id.-Select Go.-Select Post Goods Issue  and Select Propose Quantities.-Select Release.-Error message appears Negative stock not permitted in logistics area DEF, material PQR.-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-In Common tasks Navigate to Stock Overview-Select Product PQR and Site as XYZ-Select Go-We observe On-hand Stock with N quantities.-Cause-The On-Hand stock available for material PQR in the logistics area DEF is allocated and assigned to a Warehouse Order which is still in process.-Since there is not enough stock available in logistics are DEF, system gives the reported error.-Resolution-It is necessary to maintain stock for logistics area DEF.-You will be able to create Stock transfer Order successfully.-Keywords-Negative stock not permitted in logistics area, material, Negative Stock error appears while creating Stock Transfer Order

Title: Service Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The service request functionality is used to start a process from external interface automatically. The functionality can also be used by scheduling from the background. Based on the number of processes maintained in the table /A1SSPC/SR_PRC for a particular operation type, the processes are started. The process can be scheduled or started immediately.-Resolution-The following guides you to start a process through Service Request.-1. In User Interface (UI), select Service Provider Cockpit and choose Service Request.-The Operation Type has the details on the type of the request. The status field displays the status of the Service Request.-The process details are stored in a Process management tab of the main view. Service Request Information and Application Log details are displayed in the appropriate tabs.-2. Select Start to start the request in the approved status.-3. Once the request is started, the request calls the method CREATE_ITP_PROCESS in class /A1SSPC/CL_SR_UTILITY in background mode. In this method, function module  /A1SSPC/ITP_SCH_REPORT is called with the following details:-Job Name-Process Name-Priority-Number of Parallel Instance-Start Date-Recurrence-The function module /A1SSPC/ITP_SCH_REPORT receives the service request details and updates the /A1SSPC/ITP_SYSD table with the previously mentioned details.-The background report /A1SSPC/ITP_BGSCH_CONTINUOUS retrieves the job ID and other details from /A1SSPC/ITP_SYSD table and starts the process by updating the /A1SSPC/ITP_CNTR table. If the process is not started, the status is N (New) in /A1SSPC/ITP_CNTR table.-If the process is started through /A1SSPC/ITP_BGSCH_CONTINUOUS report, the status is set to S (Started) and Process Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) is generated for the particular instance. The generated identifier is updated in the identifier field of service request view. The Service Request status changes to INPROC (InProcess) after starting the process. The status is sent through /A1SSPC/TR_PROCESS_TRIGGER function module from /A1SSPC/ITP_BGSCH_CONTINUOUS report.-4. To view the triggered process, enter the process UUID in /A1SSPC/ITP_CNTR table.-5. Enter the ESI_BO_TEST_TOOL transaction and the UUID in the query selection and execute. You can also use the generated identifier.-6. Complete the process through UI or back end, So that the status in /A1SSPC/ITP_CNTR table changes to C (Complete).-The process status C is passed to the service request through /A1SSPC/TR_PROCESS_TRIGGER FM from the Complete Task Action class. The Service Request status is changed to Completed.-Created by BYDMS-KB-Tools

Title: Unable to Manually Enter The Office Location in Edit my Contact Data View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to enter the office location in the Edit my Contact Data view under Home work center. However the country field is inactive for selection and user can not continue to enter the address information.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self Services Overview.-Select Edit My Contact Data under Company Address Book view .-Navigate to second step, Edit Office Location.-You can see that, manual entry of office address is not possible.-Even Country filed is grayed out.-Resolution-From FP 3.5 version onwards, we have changed the functionality with respect to Edit My Contact Data. Only when the Office address is selected the country field gets enabled for edit. This functionality is introduced because in edit my contact data you enter the office address which is the business residence address and this is the address which has to be maintained in the edit my contact data. Since this address is already pre maintained in the system it is easy for employees to select the stored address. Employees work in a particular business residence will have the same address and only the building and room can be updated within the business residence.-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self Services Overview.-Select Edit My Contact Data under Company Address Book view.-Navigate to second step, Edit Office Location.-Select the Address from Value Selection. (F 4)-Country field will be active and you can manually enter the office address.

Title: Unable to Find Certain Scoping Question when Edit Project Scope

You will find it.

Title: Using a Not Relevant Task in a Process Definition
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document describes the usage of a Not Relevant (NR) task within a process definition. If a particular task or a step has to be skipped in a procedure, the task has to be categorized as Auto Type Code NR. If the task is categorized in such a way, the task will be ignored or skipped in the procedure after starting.-Resolution-1. You can define a task as an NR Task while creating or editing the task in Service Catalog -> Task Definitions as follows:-If the task is defined, the task will appear in the support package level details of a task as in the following screen:-2. Include the task in a process definition and activate it.-3. Start the process.-You can view the identifier as follows:-4. Query for the procedure in the Service Provider Cockpit.-Once the 2nd task is taken over and completed, you can see the status of 3rd task, which is Not Relevant and is set to Z - Not Relevant. You can also see the successor task of 3rd, which is 4, coming into a workable status.-This indicates that the 3rd task was skipped and it triggered the next task, as if the 3rd task did not exist in the process definition.-Similarly, when the 4th task is taken over and completed, it will complete the process.-Created by BYDMS-KB-Tools

Title: Check for SAP Basis Hotfix Details for Leap Systems
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For SAP_BASIS Hotfix, you can use the Hotfix of LEAP 1.0 itself to LEAP 1.5 or in the other way round, the SAP_BASIS Hotfix of LEAP 1.0 is always to be deployed in LEAP 1.5.-This document explains the steps to find the correct Hot Fix Collection (HFC) level in LEAP 1.5.-Resolution-Following are the steps to be followed:-1. Log in to HFX system and give the transaction code HOTFIX.-2. Enter the hotfix ID and execute (for example: hotfix ID is 47011).-  3. Check the hotfix level for the system in the Service Provider Cockpit where the hotfix import needs to be checked.-For instance: The system HSQ is in HFC 11 EP 2 and 1211 suggests it is LEAP 1.5.-  4. Go to the transaction code hf_patch_assembly in HFX system. Following are the steps:-1. Expand LEAP 1.0.-2. Expand LEAP 1.0 SPS 32 (the SPS level where the hotfix is present – explained in step 2).-3. Expand Patch Collections.-4. Double-click on the dropped down from Patch Collections -> Check SAP_BASIS number there as shown in below screenshot. Here it is SAPK-80432, this suggests that the hotfix is in SPS 32.-  5. Now expand LEAP 1.5.-6. Expand LEAP 1.5 SPS 11 (SPS level where the system is present – explained in step 3).-7. Expand Patch Collections.-8. Double-click on the dropped down from Patch Collections -> Check SAP_BASIS number there as displayed in the following screenshot. Here it is SAPK-80434 . This suggests the system is already in SPS 34 . This means the hotfix is already imported in the system in SPS 32.-  Created by ByDMS-KB-IM-

Title: Implementing the Synchronous (SY) Task Automation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document describes the step by step implementation of the synchronous (SY) Task Automation to help the end user.-Abbreviations Used:-T - To be executed-R - Run Time-W - Work In Progress-E - Error-C - Complete -Resolution-Procedure-Define a Process Definition with the Synchronous (SY) Task Automation as displayed in the following screenshot:- The process contains the following:-Task # 2 (independent manual)-Task # 3 (dependent on Task # 2 and SY)-Task # 4 (dependent on Task # 3 and SY)-The completion of Task # 2 triggers the Task # 3. If the class name of the Task # 3 exists in ACTIVE version, then the task is updated to the Run Time (R) status, otherwise it updates to the Error (E) status.-The completion of Task # 3 triggers the status of the Task # 4 from To be executed (T) to Run Time (R) and then to Complete (C) with the above class name ACTIVE check, if it runs successfully. Otherwise, the status is updated from To be executed (T) to Run Time (R) and then to Error (E).- If the Tasks 3 and 4 are completed, the process is completed.-  Execution:-When the tasks are completed, the implementation in the class name displayed in the Variant Name per the previous screenshot is executed. For example, ZCLMAIL has the functionality of checking the locked/unlocked status of a table entry in ZCMDB* table. If the status is locked, the error message displays, else, the table level changes are performed and saved accordingly. Once the table entry is saved, the task is completed, otherwise, it is updated to the Error (E) status.-The following screenshot displays the Task # 2 in the New (N) status.-The following screenshot displays the Task # 2 in the completion status:-  The completion of Task # 3 updates the Task # 4 to the To be executed (T) status, which then updates to Complete (C) as displayed in the following screenshot:-Once the Task # 4, is completed, it completes the process as displayed in the following screenshot:-Created by BYDMS-KB-Tools

Title: Asynchronous Get Status Task Automation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Step by step implementation of the Asynchronous Get status (AG) Task Automation to help the End User.-Resolution-Define a process definition with the AG task as mentioned in the screenshot below: -Task number 2 is a manual task. Task number 3 and 4 depend on the completion of task number2. When starting the process, task 2 comes to NEW state.-Abbreviations of the status of the tasks:-T - To be executed-R - Run Time-W - Work In Progress-E - Error-C - Complete.  -Since the task 2 is a manual task, the task is Taken Over and Completed manually. Once the task 2 is completed, the task 3 and 4 are triggered. Task 3 comes to 'T - to be executed' state, since it is an asynchronous task.-Then task 3 goes to Running state. Task 4 will be in New state since it is a manual task.-As the background report runs every 5 minutes, the task will be completed. Completion of the task means, the system will execute the code present inside the Class mentioned in variant name for the particular task. The task 3 will be completed. If there is any problem with the code execution, the status of the task 3 will be changed to E - Error.-Task 4 must be completed manually, which in turn completes the process.-Created by BYDMS-KB-Tools -

Title: Check the SPC Transport Imported to SPC System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The developer is providing some transport number for solving the issue for SPC system. This case document helps to check whether it is imported or not in SPC system.-Resolution-There is some issue in the SPC and the developer is providing a fix for resolving the issue. The fix is the transport number and it is imported manually in the SPC system. For example the developer provided a transport ASPK041241 for solving some issue. If this fix is very urgent then it goes via single transport import to the SPC system otherwise it goes via takt merge import (collection of transport).-If the transport is imported via single transport import then you can find it in the e070 table as mentioned in the following screenshot:-For example, you have to find out if the transport ASPK041289 is imported to the SPC system or not. When checked this transport you can see that it is not available in e070 table. So the transport has not reached the system or is imported via takt merge import. -For finding out which transport belongs to which takt merge,-Log in into the RPC system (dev system - ldcirpc) with display user.-Go to /nse01 transaction and give the transport number and select Display.-    3.  Select the transport and select log display.-     4.  Then you can see the transport belongs to which merge. As mentioned in the following screenshot, this transport belongs to merge RPCKZP4011.-    5. Check in the e070 table whether that merge transport number is available or not. If it is there then the transport ASPK041289 reached the SPC system.-Note: The transport is developed in the development system. A merge collection is created of the last two weeks transports. Then that merge will reach the Vlab SPC system. Once it reached to Vlab system, after two weeks that merge will reach the Prod SPC system.-    6.  Here the Vlab SPC system is VNS and the merge has reached on 16th May 2013.-    7.  After two weeks from 16th May 2013, the merge reaches the Prod SPC system. Here Prod SPC is NZA.-Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: Cannot Select Sales Order Item While Creating Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-While creating Expense report, under Cost assignment for Sales order, the respective Sales Order item is not visible for selecting. -According to ByDesign Help Document, Create New Expense Report on Behalf:-When you select an account assignment type, the system automatically offers you the corresponding entry fields for this type, so that you can enter further details of your cost assignment. if you select Sales Order, for example, you will be able to enter the sales order and sales order item.-But this is not the case, you have to fill in this manually.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expense work center.-Go to the Expense reports view.-Click the New button to create a new Expense report on behalf.-Create an Expense Report ABC (ABC is the ID of the Expense Report).-In the Expense Report ABC, click on the Edit Cost Assignment link under Cost Assignment.-Select account assignment type Sales Order from the drop down menu.-Search and select the Sales Order XXX (XXX is the ID of the Sales Order).-Click on the Sales Order Item field.-No Items are visible to be selected. The Item has to be typed in manually.-Cause-The Root Cause Analysis is as such, according to development:-The Type Code values are not passing to Sales order item OVS . Because Type code value populate only, when both Sales order and Item entered in screen . Coding Block has some technical limitation to populate the type code value while Item ID is not maintained.-In general coding block embedded component, type code values are hard coded as '114' for Sales order.-Resolution-Hotfix 73369 deployed has solved the issue.-See Also-This Case Document has been created to inform colleagues internally that this issue was  solved with the Hotfix ID 66743 in 2015 but reoccured in 2017.-If the issue still comes up in the future, inform the developers of the hotfixes 66743 and 73369 while forwarding first to SRD-FIN-ERM. The correction was eventually made by the component AP-RC-CB.-Related incidents are 3500249146/ 0000242814 2015 and 3101024305/ 0000301353 2017.

Title: Central case document for issues relating to SAP Store
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Outdated***--You have received an incident in BCP centered on an enquiry/issue with SAP Store.-This case document lists the incident management process to be followed by employees in SAP for such incidents.-An overview of the support model for issues with SAP Store is outlined in the diagram below.-  Reproducing the Issue-Please check who your real customer is (who has reported/forwarded the incident to Support). One of the following scenarios may happen:-Scenario-1: INCIDENT IS REPORTED BY CUSTOMER-This means, a customer has some issues with the Store, but uses the Business Center or Built-in Support to report an incident (instead of sending an email to store.admin@sap.com). Such an incident would arrive on one the Direct Support queues.-Scenario-2: INCIDENT IS REPORTED BY SAP STORE HELPDESK-This means, the customer has reported the issue to SAP Store helpdesk (via email), who in turn have created an incident using Built-In Support, this incident subsequently arrives on "MS-CP-Others" queue. Managed Services then takes one of the following actions:-If communication from customer is required in EN and this is an issue with technical access to content, colleagues in Managed Services will do the communication with customer. The incident is not expected to arrive in any of the Cloud Support queues in this case.-Managed Services will forward the incident to Cloud Support in one of the following cases:-This an issue with technical access to the Store website or content, but the communication with customer cannot be done in EN. IN this case, the colleagues in Managed Services will forward the incident to "Direct Support-<Language>" queue for translation.-An interaction with customer is needed from a business application/scenario perspective. In this case, colleagues in Managed Services will forward the incident to "SAP Store" queue.-Scenario-3: INCIDENT CREATED VIA STORE FRONTEND "H7J/002"-If a visitor on Store website encounters an error, the website prompts him/her to report this error to SAP. If the visitor proceeds with this option, this incident would arrive on "MS-CP-Others" queue.-Scenario-4: INCIDENT IS CREATED BY A HEALTH-CHECK-This means, an auto alert has been created from SAP Store. Such an incident would arrive in the Managed Services queue (<‘MS-CP-Others’>) in BCP.-Resolution-Scenario-1: INCIDENT IS REPORTED BY CUSTOMER-Forward this incident to "MS-CP-Others" queue. If the original language is not EN, please translate to EN before forwarding.-Add an "async info for customer" with the following standard text (to be translated in local language, if necessary):-An follow-up as per ownership model is not necessary unless explicitly triggered by the customer.- Dear <Mr./Ms. Last_Name>-This incident has been reported for SAP Business ByDesign; however it seems that you have a query/issue related to SAP Store. We have forwarded your query/issue to the SAP Store Team, who will in turn get in touch with you.-Should a follow-up be needed, you may contact the SAP Store Team directly at store.admin@sap.com. -Regards-<name>-Scenario-2: INCIDENT IS REPORTED BY STORE HELPDESK-Confirm that this actually the case - the system details show tenant as "H9K/071" and this incident has been forwarded by Managed Services.-If not, reassign incident to MS-CP-Others queue, informing the colleagues that:-this incident was wrongly forwarded to Support.-guide the colleague to proceed as described in case document 1692294.-If not, process this incident as per standard-When providing a solution, phone+email to communicate with customer.-When the topic has been clarified/resolved with customer, summarize the outcome and reassign incident to MS-CP-Others queue, removing your name from processor field.-Scenario-3: INCIDENT IS CREATED VIA STORE FRONTEND "H7J/002"-No action is required from Cloud Support.-Managed Services will take care and proceed as described in ‘Reproducing the issue Scenario-2’. Please be aware that in this scenario no keyuser will be involved and thus no communication back to the visitor/customer is possible nor is it needed.-Scenario-4: INCIDENT IS CREATED BY A HEALTH-CHECK -No action is required from Cloud Support.-Managed Services will take care and proceed as described in ‘Reproducing the issue Scenario-2’. Please be aware that in this scenario no keyuser will be involved and thus no communication back to the visitor/customer is possible nor is it needed.-See Also-URL for SAP Store: https://store.sap.com-Incident Management Process for SAP Store:-Customer reports issue using the "Contact" link on SAP Store page.-The above generates an email which is attended to by SAP Store Helpdesk team.-SAP Store Helpdesk Team tries to answer issues related to navigation, ordering process, etc.-If this is technical issue with SAP Store, the colleagues in Helpdesk create an incident in BCP, which lands at MS-CP-Others queue.-Colleagues in MS work on this incident and try to provide a solution.-If Cloud Support involvement is still necessary, the colleagues from MS forward this incident to a relevant topic queue of Cloud Support.-Cloud Support provides solution as "Async. Info for Customer" and reassigns incidents to MS-CP-Others queue.-You want to provide feedback or need more help:-Please contact the following colleagues via email:-Gupta, Raman ( I023524 )-Gradl, Johann  ( D019411 )-CURENT SAP STORE MANAGER: Thiaener, Michael ( D045265 )-

Title: Sales and Use Tax Configuration for ByD Customers in Origin States such as California and Texas
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Even though the tax jurisdiction codes are maintained within the customer or suppler account, taxes are not calculated as expected for transactions within California or Texas. -Resolution-In general ByD calculates Sales and Use tax for goods and services within the United States destination based, i.e. based on the tax jurisdiction code of the ship-to location for both purchases and sales.  -The exemption are intrastate transactions within the so-called origin states where the tax calculation for both purchases and sales of goods is origination based, i.e. that the tax jurisdiction used in the Sales and Use tax calculation is the ship-from location.-ByD’s tax calculation treats California and Texas as an origination state. Several users have requested the ability to treat California respectively Texas as a destination state for purchases meaning that the tax jurisdiction used is the ship-to jurisdiction.-  Following is the current method for setting up ByD to calculate sales tax in California for the ship-to jurisdiction. -If the ByDesign company is a single California company, each California-located supplier master record must be populated with the jurisdiction code of the ByD company ship-to jurisdiction code.-For the California jurisdiction level the tax rate will be set currently at 7.25%. The next jurisdiction level will be the District level and will be populated with the appropriate District level rate, for example Alameda District used in the example below. In Fine-tuning, the jurisdiction rate configuration will resemble this table:-Jurisdiction-Description-Rate-CA-California-7.25%-CAALAMED-Alameda District-1.50%-      The supplier master record would be populated normally with the correct address e.g. city, state postal code, but the tax jurisdiction code assigned to a California vendor would be that of the location at which the user expects to accept deliveries in California.-Street Address-123 Main Street-City-San Diego-State-CA-Postal Code-92113-Tax Jurisdiction Code-CAALAMED-The tax calculation engine will calculate the tax based on the tax jurisdiction code for CAALAMED at 8.75% which is the ship-to tax jurisdiction code for the ByD user’s company.-  This setup can also be used for other origin states such as Texas.-  ByDesign Release FP3.0-The user is able to overwrite the determined tax jurisdiction code on each position.-  ByDesign Release FP3.5-FP3.5 provides a new configuration functionality so that the user can override the tax jurisdiction determination rule for intrastate transactions.-

Title: Authorization Issue in Data Extraction Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error Message:-No authorization to perform business data extraction.-(or)-Cannot launch background job DMC_EXPORT.... Create an incident.-is seen while trying to extract any data from the Data Extraction Tool.-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the Data Extraction Tool through the link:-https://myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/dmc_ext_eol_data?sap-language=EN-where XXXXXX is the to be replaced by the snippet of the customer system URL.-Select the concerned data object, specify the range and execute extraction.-Cause-According to the laid process it is only SAP that has the authorizations for data extraction. This action can only performed by a user with L6 authorizations.-The reason for this decision is as below:-The Data Extraction tool was designed only for “End of Lifecycle” scenario.-Here, Customer/Customer Advocate asks Hosting to extract data for required objects.-Since this is not a regular business activity, the authorization to extract data via this tool is limited to L6 users.-Resolution-Advice the customer to contact the Customer Advocate to accomplish the tasks or you may also contact the Provisioning team for the same.

You can now also choose E-mail and Fax as additional output channel options when setting output rules in process-integrated printing.-Resolution-Output Channel Rules:-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-In the Output Channel Selection view, select Remittance Advice from Show Rules For dropdown list and click Go.-Click New.-The Create Output Channel Rule dialog box opens.-From the Output Channel dropdown list, select E-mail.-Under Parameter Settings, enter the parameters for which you want this rule to apply.-These parameters determine when the output channel selected in the previous step is used to output Remittance Advices. Note that if you leave a parameter blank, this acts as a wildcard.-Click Save and Close.-Note that you may now have to adjust the sequence in which the output channel rules are applied to ensure that the rule is applied by the system correctly.-Business Partner-Specific Output Settings:-Business partner-specific output settings allow you to define how Remittance Advices are sent to your accounts or suppliers. These settings override any output channel rules.-Navigate to the Supplier Base work center, Suppliers view. Select a supplier and choose General from the Edit menu. Navigate to the Collaboration section of the Communication tab.-or-Navigate to the Account Management work center, Accounts view. Select an account and choose General from the Edit menu. Navigate to the Collaboration section of the Communication tab.-Under Collaboration, you can view all documents that are valid for the selected business partner.-Choose Remittance Advice Outbound and then select E-mail in the Output Channel column.-Enter the e-mail address recipient under E-mail column.-Click Save and Close.-  Keywords-Remittance advice; remittance advice outbound; e-mail; collaboration; communication;

Title: ARCHIVE - How Does Tax Code Changes by Auditor Influence Tax Calculation in Expense Report Posting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: KBA is not applicable to SAP Business ByDesign***-You have observed that VAT calculated is Inconsistent in Expense Report Posting.-For Eg:Expense Type -Meals  is claimed thrice in Expense Report XYZ and VAT is calculated only once on this Expense Type and is not calculated on remaining Meal Expense Types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Postings Work center.-Go to Postings view.-Go to Posted Reports and Find Expense Report XYZ.-Select the Expense Report XYZ and Go to Details tab.-You could see that the VAT is calculated only once on Expense Type-Meal.-Cause-VAT is calculated only once on Expense Type Meals as the Tax Code related to Expense Type is changed by Auditor.-Tax Code linked to Expense Type Meals is set as Non-deductible in Business Configuration settings but the Auditor has changed the Tax Code on one of the Expense Type Meals to Fully-deductible. Hence, VAT is calculated only on this Expense Type.-In order to view the Tax Code Group and Tax Code related to Expense Type, you should follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Go to Overview.-Find Expense Reporting-Country.-Go to Edit Expense Types.-Choose the Expense Type and Go to Definition.-You could see the Tax Code Group which is assigned to Expense Type.-In order to view Tax Code which is linked to Tax Code Group follow the below steps:-Follow Steps from 1 to 3.-Go to Define and Edit Tax Code Groups.-Under Available Tax Code Groups, elect the Tax Code Group.-You could see the Tax code assigned to Tax Code Group under Assigned VAT Tax Code.-Resolution-You need to check if there are any changes done by Auditor by following the below steps:-Go to Cockpit Work center.-Go to All Expense Reports.-Find Expense Report XYZ.-Choose Expense Report XYZ.-Go to View Expense Report Changes.-You could see the changes made by Auditor on Expense Types.-Keywords-Expense report, tax type

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A specific user that has visualization authorization for Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity receives RBAM error messages when opening Account Determination in the form of:-"RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default>.........."-"RBAM: Skip operation 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default>.........."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click Open.-Click one of the Account Determination options.-Two RBAM error messages appear.-RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default> A1FIA_BC_ACDET_QAF_ECO <default> ROOT' in context 'UIApplication <default> /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/fin/gl/BusinessConfigurationAccountDeterminationProfileQAFEnhancedController_QAF.QA.uicomponent <default> <default> Operation <default> Start'-RBAM: Skip operation 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default> A1FIA_BC_ACDET_QAF_ECO <default> ROOT'-Cause-This error is occurring because the user trying to open the activity only has read access for Implementation Projects (BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS).-Resolution-The user needs Unrestricted Write Access for Implementation Projects (BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS) to view the activity.-1. Edit the access rights of the affected user-2. Go to Access Restrictions tab-3. For Work Center View ID: BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS, set the Write Access to Unrestricted-Keywords-Account Determination, A1FIA_BC_ACDET_QAF_ECO, user, access, restriction, RBAM, RBAM WRITE

Title: ARCHIVED: Unable to Execute the Extraction Run for Financial Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2642700***-You are not able to execute the Extraction Run for Financial Data as the system throws the error message Details report execution failed. Start the extraction run again.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger workcenter.-Navigate to the Extraction Run for Financial Data view.-Click New and then Extraction Run for Financial Data.-Complete the necessary data.-Press Start Now.-An error message appears: Details report execution failed. Start the extraction run again.-Cause-The error message is raised due to a huge data amount in your financial reports.-Resolution-It is possible to extract up to approximately 700.000 data records in one run.-In order to generate the whole data amount you could try the following:-If the error message is raised for the Journal report only:-With SAP ByDesign Verison 1608 a new Split file feature has been implemented. When this function is selected the run will automatically split the data into 2 files per accounting period.-In the Periodic Tasks: Extraction Run for Financial Data view press New.-Enter the respective Company and Set of Books as well as periods to be considered.-Mark the Split File box.-Execute the run.-This way the run might be able to extract all the relevant data of the Journal report. *It is possible that the run generates very technical warnings which have no influence on the data files. Our development is working on reducing these messages in upcoming system releases.-If the error message is raised for more than one report, the Journal as well as the G/L Accounts - line items report for instance:-A) Execute the extraction run for shorter periods, e.g. for 6 months, 3 months or monthly intervals. Then combine the extracted files together manually:-In the Periodic Tasks: Extraction Run for Financial Data view press New.-Enter the respective Company and Set of Books.-In the Year/Period From and To fields enter a shorter period as above.-*Tip: Open the respective reports first from the Reports- List view in the General Ledger workcenter before:-Enter the time period of your choice and check if the report is able to load the data.-Should the report finish with an error reduce the time intervals.-Once the report is able to generate data for the selected period the extraction run will be able to extract the data for this same period as well.-B) For the Extraction run use a reporting package without the report triggering the error message. Instead, extract the data of the respecitve report(s) from the Reports - List view:-In the General Ledger navigate to the Reports view and there to the List sub-view.-Choose the Journal report (or the G/L Accounts- Line Items report).-Change the view from Journal to Journal for GDPDU.-Complete the necessary data and click Go.-Click the Download button and then select Report in Microsoft Excel® in XML Format.

Title: Deviating Holiday Calendar Does Not Display any Records in Employee's Time File and Public Holidays are Not Displayed in Employee’s Timesheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**TO BE ARCHIVED**-Reason: Consolidated in KBA 2289648 - Deviating Holiday is not Displayed in Time File-You have maintained the Deviating Holiday Calendar for the employees, but unable to see DD.MM.YYYY declared as Public Holiday in Timesheet or in the Time Profile of the employees. Further, the Holiday Calendar assigned to the Employees does not contain any records.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home workcenter-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time select Edit Time Sheet-Select DD.MM.YYYY-DD.MM.YYYY does not appear as Public Holiday.-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Find the employee and go to Employee Times tab-Go to Calendar view-Not able to see DD.MM.YYYY declared as Public Holiday.-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Regular Tasks view-Select the Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar-Search for the employee ABC (where ABC represents the Employee ID)-Select the holiday calendar link available in the field Public Holiday Calendar -Holiday Calendar does not contain any records.-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the employee ABC-On the OWL, select Actions->Maintain Deviating Holiday Calendar-In the Display field, select link available in the Holiday Calendar Name-Holiday Calendar does not contain any records.-Cause-There is no Working Day Calendar PQR (where PQR represents the Working Day Calendar) corresponding to the Holiday Calendar XYZ (where XYZ represents the Holiday Calendar) assigned to the Employee ABC from 1st Jan of the current year. In Business Configuration work center, in the activity Working Day Calendar, in Maintain an existing Working Day Calendar, for none of the Working Day Calendars, the Holiday Calendar is XYZ.-Resolution-Either create a new Working Day Calendar and assign this Holiday Calendar to the Employee ABC or update an already existing Working Day Calendar with this Holiday Calendar details.-Once this assignment is done, Run Day Closure for this Employee ABC, from 1st Jan of the current year, that is, from the date DD1.MM1.YYYY1 from which these changes need to take place.-Keywords-Working Day Calendar, Holiday Calendar, Deviating Holiday Calendar, Public Holiday

Title: Archived: Activity Code is Displaying Instead of Activity Description in Edit Time Sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archive reason: The behavior is no longer occuring-Unusual behavior in Time Sheet while entering Activity Description-Case 1:--Type the description and choose the same from the system prompt but system displays the respective numeric code after selection--Case 2:--Then add the Time in any of the day and click, then system creates a new empty row and the entered time goes to third row.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self Service Overview-Click Edit Time Sheet-Select Add Row-Enter the Description of the activity-Cause-When you explicitly entry description of the activity followed by 'Enter' (keyboard enter key), system is unable to find the valid 'Activity'. Due to the fact that its not able to find correct activity, when hours are entered against it, system does not want to put your valuable hours against this activity and shift it to next row.-At present, Explicit entry of 'Activity' with description is not currently supported in the system-Resolution-There are two workarounds for this:--1. Type the activity description and select from system suggested activity, and enter your hours against this. This way system finds correct 'Activity'.-2.  Use value help (F4) and then select the activity, and enter your hours against this. This way as well system finds correct 'Activity'.-Additional notes:-There can be multiple activities with the same description, explicit entry of description can lead to mistakes in time entry and hence 'activity code' can only be entered explicitly and not just the description of activity.--Additionally, with explicit entry of description system could not find the right Key for 'Activity'. it creates next row for the time/hours entered. When you press 'Save' error is raised 'Activity <XX> is not valid' to ensure there is no inconsistency in data entry.--You can alternatively use value help and select the required activity OR type the activity description in the activity field and select from the system proposed value.-These ways there we don't have any problem-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-activity, description, time recording, time sheet

Title: ARCHIVED: Error Occurred When Releasing Time Record: Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 1843148***-When releasing time entries, you receive the following error message: Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Select Time Sheet view-Search for the repective employeee-Select Open Time Sheet-Select Add row-Select Release for selected Week-Error occurs-Cause-A possible cause is that the business feature for default premium pay is on, because the question below is scoped: Do you want to valuate internal time confirmations with actual employee compensation rates? (Edit Project Scope > Expand Financial and Management Accounting > Expand Management Accounting > Select Project Cost and Revenue Management).-For example, when you try to release a time recording for 01.01.2018, then time valuation starts running from a day before the actual date 01.01.2018. It detects and applies the default premium pay to the 31.12.2017. Due to this, system tries to cancel the already sent source document to financials and tries to send a new source document. But, while sending it finds that the process control for posting date 31.12.2017 is blocked.-Resolution-Please create a process control that allows time confirmation for the date before the date of time recording and try to release the time recording. When doing so, the system will send a new source document to financial side applying this new default premium pay.-See Also-1999451 - Error Message : Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes.-Keywords-Time Administration, Premium Pay, Process Control

Title: ARCHIVED: Groupware: You are Not Able to Track the Responses Sent by Attendees from Outlook
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archive reason: KBA is no longer relevant-You create an appointment from the Business ByDesign system and synchronize it with Outlook client. You want to track the meeting responses sent back by the attendees in Outlook but you are not able to do the same.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Choose the New Appointment link under the Common Task tab. This opens a new screen.-Enter all the required details such as Subject, Start Time , End Time and List of Attendees and save the appointment.-The appointment in the Business ByDesign system is successfully synchronized with your outlook calendar.-You want to know the response status for this appointment from the Tracking tab of outlook meeting window but you are not able to track the same.-Cause-As per the current functionality, when the appointment is created and sent out from the Business ByDesign system, the option of the attendees to be able to send the response is disabled by default.-Hence you are not able to track the responses sent back by attendees in Outlook.-Resolution-Following is the work around that you may use in case you want to enable the response tracking from Outlook.-Enable the Request Responses option from the Outlook client as mentioned below:-Microsoft Outlook 2003:-Open the appointment from the Outlook and choose on the Actions link available in the upper main menu.-Enable the Request Response option in the list.-Microsoft Outlook 2007:-Open the appointment from the Outlook. You will find Attendees block at the top center of your outlook meeting window.-Under the Attendees block you will find Responses drop-down menu.-From the Responses drop down menu, enable the Request Response option.-After enabling the Request Response option by one of the two ways mentioned above, send the updated meeting request to the attendees again.-Now if the attendees send the responses, you will be able to track them in the Tracking tab of the meeting screen.

Title: ARCHIVED: Error Occurred When Approving / Releasing Time Entries. Error: Save failed. Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 1843148***-You are to trying to release time sheet entry. When releasing it, an error occurred. Error: Save failed. Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in as employee.-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Service Overview work center.-Click Edit Time Sheets.-Select time entries from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY.-Click Release.-Or-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Click Time Sheet view.-Search for the relevant employee.-Go to the relevant calendar week.-Click Release > All.-Or-Go to the Time Administration Work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Edit the relevant employee and go to Time Profile tab.-Select Time Account Rules tab.-Change the Deviating Accrual Rate field and save.-Cause-A possible cause is that there was a change in the labour resource, org unit, or in the job ID.-The employee was associated with a job valid from DD.MM.YYYY. He was assigned to this job on DD.MM.YYYY which was a backdated change effective from DD.MM.YYYY. During this assignment period, the employee recorded times for the labour resource. Labour resource XXX is for cost center YYY and job ZZZ (where XXX is the labour resource, YYY is the cost center, and ZZZ is the job).-On the DD.MM.YYYY, the job assignment was changed to ZZZ effective from DD.MM.YYYY. Times recorded and released for DD.MM.YYYY now show different labour resource XXX which is for different cost centre YYY and different job ZZZ.-However, when releasing time recordings, the system starts a full valuation from DD.MM.YYYY and detects a delta with the labour resource due to the backdated change from one job ZZZ to another job ZZZ. So, now the system is trying to cancel the existing times posted to projects and accounting with the old Labour resource and trying to re-post again with the new labour resource. Since the accounting periods are closed, you are getting the error message.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you make changes to the Time Profile split, it will trigger a time valuation. This valuation will go back all the way to the start of the Time Profile. If any of the records have changes (for example, labour resources), the system throws the error as it is trying to change them, but it cannot be done due to the financial period being closed.-There are two options for resolution:-You can try to copy the existing time profile and save it in the Time Administration work center and then you can try to release the time.-You can also try to open the accounting periods.-We are working on changing this system behaviour in one of the next releases.-Keywords-financial period blocked, releasing time, approving time, change deviating accrual rate

Title: Archived: Time Recording is Grayed Out for Editing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive reason: Consolidated in KBA 3216923***-You are trying to correct or delete a time recording, but all fields and buttons related to it are grayed out.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center-Access the Employees work center view-Select the relevant employee-Click Edit-Navigate to the Employee Times tab-Select the relevant time recording-All fields are blocked for editing; the Remove and Actions buttons are also grayed out and can't be clicked-The same behavior can be observed in the Edit Time Sheet work center view as well.-Cause-A possible cause for this behavior is that this time recording is linked to a project currently in status Stopped.-From a technical perspective, Stopped and Closed status have the same behavior, but Closed implies that the project ended successfully and Stopped means that it was canceled with a low probability of being activated. Hence, time recordings related to a Stopped project are blocked for any change because they are deemed as finalized.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-If the project's status is reverted by using the Revoke Stopping action, the related time recordings will be editable once again.-Keywords-Time Recording, Grayed Out, Can't Delete, Can't Edit, Project, Stopped

Title: Missing Transaction Currency Amount in Journal Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-To be archived - please refer to KBA 1876756 - Transaction Currency Missing in Financial Report.-You are checking the Journal report (Report ID: FINGLAU03_Q0001) or the G/L Accounts - Line Items (FINGLAU02_Q0001), however you notice that for some journal entries the Transaction Currency is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Lists view.-Open the Journal report.-Click the View button.-Under Column Fields, Key Figures add the key figures for Transaction Currency.-Run the report.-You noticed that the key figures in Transaction Currency have a 0,00 amount, although the company currency figures are shown.-Cause-The journal entries that you are checking are of type e.g. Goods Receipt from Supplier. For this types of journal entry, we do not fill the debit nor credit Transaction Currency (the field is in blank in the journal entry).-The field is not populated in the journal entry because for goods movement processes you have no transaction currency at all, since you move goods within your company and these goods have a valuated amount (in company currency) but they do not have a transaction amount.-Therefore, a 0,00 is shown for the Transaction Currency key figures.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Keywords-Missing Transaction Currency Amount, Goods and Services Receipt, FINGLAU03_Q0001

Title: ARCHIVED: Unable to Approve Customer Payments
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: The Work Center View ID: FIN_CLOSINGRELTASKSAUDIT is designed not to have No Access. You can view this yourself by selecting an approver of successful payments and you will always see that there is no Write Access for the Work Center View ID: FIN_CLOSINGRELTASKSAUDIT. ***-You are trying to approve the customer payments, however the system does not allow you to approve the payment due to below warning message:-You are defined as approver but do not have authorization to approve-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customers view.-Go to the Customer Accounts object work list.-Select the desired account.-Click View button.-Click Trade Receivables tab.-Click Invoices / Payments tab.-Select the Invoice and click Clearing ID.-Click View ALL tab.-Warning message shown: You are defined as approver but do not have authorization to approve-(or)-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Find the task Approve Clearing of Under-/Overpayment by Customer - <Clearing ID> - <Customer name> - <Amount and Currency>.-Click Approve.-Warning message shown: You are defined as approver but do not have authorization to approve-Cause-The warning message is due to authorization is not complete to approve the task. You have only read access for the FIN_CLOSINGRELTASKSAUDIT view under Audit work center.-Resolution-You need to contact your Administrator to provide the Access Rights to approve the customer payments.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management view.-Go to the Business Users subview.-Find the relevant user and choose Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to the tab Access Restrictions.-Search for FIN_CLOSINGRELTASKSAUDIT and check for the Write Access.-Change No Access to Unrestricted.-Keywords-Approve customer payments, You are defined as approver but do not have authorization to approve

Title: How to identify and correct the virtual host entry in Wily server
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*TO BE ARCHIVED*-Reason: KBA not relevant anymore-While checking wily_17 incident even though after following recommended action if issue do not resolve then you need to check whether Physical host name is maintained properly at (wily monitoring)OS level or not-Monitor the logs in /usr/sap/etc/shadow/work-    2.   In the following screen shot the hostname for KCQ was in Upper case (VADBKCQ),-Even though the physical host in Introscope for vadbkcq is shown as vsa123289(Physical host name for vadbkcq), but it was VADBKCQ in /usr/sap/etc/shadow/work/monitoring.0.log file.-So wily will look for virtual host vadbkcq which is mainatined wrongly as VADBKCQ and data will not reflect in wily becausw wily is trying to fetch data from wrong virtual hostname.-   3.   You will receive wily_17 alerts stating that Physical_host[VADBKCQ]/WILY_AGENT_AVAIL critical,-   So you need to change the host name in both local and central bld.-Resolution-Go to SPC backend then enter the txn: SESFTS-Enter BLD_BYD_SYSTEM in load BO by proxy name-In right panel Go to query by element and enter the SID and system number details-Go to Navigate then INSTANCES and then change the hostname to small letters like vadbkcq for affected instance type (DB)  -Go to SPC Backend Transaction SE38.-Use Report /A1SSPC/BLD_SUPPORT_TOOL and select the restored system on the left side (double click the SystemNumber required)and then select the Tenant on the right side and select Replicate Data-In this way you can identify and correct the virtual host entry in Wily server-  Created by ByDMS-KB-IM

Title: How to Move a Tenant to Another Data Center Location
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-NO VALID DOCCUMENTATION ANYMORE -This document is to better guide you in the process of how to request a tenant move to a different data center.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Resolution-You must request it via incident to SAP Product Support. Operations team will check which data center we have available based on companies region.-The request should be done with at least 5 buffer days, this time is necessary to hosting team get all necessary approvals.-Also, it is mandatory to provide a downtime for tenant move outside CMP (Contractual Maintenance Period).-Note: Minimum downtime required for tenant move is 12 hours. Title: ARCHIVED:Employee Name Does not Appear in the Direct Approvers List of the Purchase Order Approval Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason:All details combined into one KBA 2344117 - Employee Not Visible in Direct Approver List ,cause they have same cause and solution except the document is different.-You are creating purchase order approval process with work distribution rule Direct Approvers, however the employee name is not visible while selecting in the list of Direct Approvers work distribution.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Task Distribution view.-Select the Approval Process view.-Select the Default approval process for Purchase Order.-Select the Copy button.-Select the Work Distribution as Direct Approvers and select Edit button.-Employee name ABC is not visible to whom you would like to define Direct Approver.-Cause-Employee is not visible in the list of Direct Approvers because for the specific user to perform the task execution, they need to have write permission for the work center view  from where the task execution required permissions are granted. Since the user is having the work center view assigned in Read only mode, the user is not displayed as one of the probable persons who can participate in the approval process as Direct Approver.-Resolution-You can assign the work center view PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES to the employee ABCwith the following steps;-Go to the Application & User Management Work Center.-Under the Business Users and select the employee ABC.-Select Edit & Access Rights.-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab.-Filter the work center view PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES.-Both Read Access and Write Access should be Unrestricted.-Select Save.

Title: Accounting Posting for the Zero Balance Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have posted a customer invoice with the zero balance and you are not clear of the journal entry posting done in the system.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Journal Entries view select Journal Entries.-Search with the Source Document of your customer invoice and click on the corresponding Journal Entry ID.-You observe that-Both the debit and credit lines are posting to same general ledger account i.e., to Sales Ledger account.-Sample:-800000 - Net Sales Domestic 0,00 USD Debit-800000 - Net Sales Domestic 0,00 USD Credit-If you compare with other customer invoice posting which is posted with some value, the debit postings are going to Accounts Receivable ledger account.-140000 - Trade Receivables - Domestic 10,000.50 USD Debit-800000 - Net Sales Domestic 10,000.50 USD Credit.-Another case is customer invoice with zero amount is posted as below-800000 - Net Sales Domestic 10,000.50 USD Credit.-200101 - Foreign Currency Rounding Differences A/C Debit-Cause-Only for the zero amount invoices the logic is modified and a debit line will post to the same general ledger account which you have it on the credit side.-Since it’s a zero amount invoice it makes no difference to have both Accounts Receivable account.-Also, in case of a zero amount Customer Invoice, one is going on differences revenue account and if this is not maintained it gives an error related to account determination not being maintained.-If the customer invoice with zero amount has more then one line, system will post the journal entry with both debit and credit to sales ledger account.-If the customer invoice with zero amount has only one line, system will post the journal entry with debit to Foreign Currency Rounding Differences and credit sales ledger account. You can also refer to KBA 2316947.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice with Zero Amount, 零金额客户发票过账

Title: Customer Invoice is Posted to General ledger Account: Foreign Currency Rounding Differences
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have posted a Customer Invoice XYZbut instead of system debiting the Receivables account maintained under subledger: Accounts Receivable, Receivables sub-tab, system debited Foreign Currency Rounding Differences account which is maintained in subledger: General Ledger and sub-tab Others.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Journal Entries view.-Search for Customer Invoice XYZ.-Click on Journal Entry ID 123.-Expected Sample Posting:-Debit:    100 - Accounts Recivable A/C -Credit:  123 - Sales Revenue A/C-Actual Posting:-Debit: 200 - Foreign Currency Rounding Differences A/C-Credit: 123 - Sales Revenue A/C-Cause-If the invoices with total amounts as zero, then system will not debit the Trade Receivables A/C-Resolution-Whenever the invoices with total amounts as zero arises then system will choose the G/L Account from the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, Subledger, General Ledger, Others and picks the G/L Account maintained under Foreign Currency Rounding Differences sub-tab.-When the balance is zero the postings will flow through another account i.e., Foreign Currency Rounding Differences instead of Receivables A/C.

Title: ARCHIVED: Error Message: 'Absolute value of assigned amount too high' in Payment Allocation.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2594961***-After allocating payments to open receivables the Open Amount of the payment allocation is 0,00. However, when trying to post the payment allocation you retrieve the error message:-Absolute value of assigned amount too high.-Reproducing the Issue-You can access the relevant payment allocation via:-Work Center: Payment Management.-Navigate to View: Payment Allocations.-Select and edit the relevant payment allocation.-- or via the posted bank statement.-Work Center: Liquidity Management.-View: Bank Statements.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.-Cause-For at least one receivable (e.g.: customer invoice) the Applied Net Amount exceeds the Open Amount and thereby the Cleared Amount.-Resolution-Make sure that the Applied Amount for a receivable document does not exceed its open amount. Problematic payment allocations can be identified by a negative Remaining Balance for receivables in the payment allocation grid in tab Customers/Suppliers. (The same applies for positive Remaining Balances for payables).

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to check whether a particular tenant/system is AKAMAI enabled or not.[RELEASED INTERNALLY]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In two ways we can find whether the tenant or system is AKAMAI enabled or not:-Using tenant URL:-Launch the URL :  https://www.dnswatch.info/-Enter your tenant URL (eg: myxxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com) under Hostname or IP column-Choose Resolve button-You will get the output as shown in the above screenshot.-Under the Answer Column if you find the word "akamai", then the tenant is AKAMAI enabled.-You will get the output as shown in the above screenshot.-Under the Answer Column if you don't find the word "akamai", then the tenant is not AKAMAI enabled.-Using System ID in SPC:-Find the 3 digit System ID(SID) of the tenant for which you want to find the AKAMAI status Ex: LCU-Go to SPC tool.-Navigate to Systems view under Cloud Landscape.-Input the SID in the search filed and Click on Search icon.-Under General Properties find for the Akamai filed.-If check box is enabled than the Akamai is enabled for that system tenants.-You can find the tenant list and customer details under Tenants tab.-  From Cloud Reporting Tool:-Go to Cloud Reporting tool-Search for Tenant URL/System ID as shown-See Also-For AKAMAI enabled systems IP Ranges are dynamic and therefore cannot be determined or shared to customers.-For more details refer case document :-2073170 - IP ranges for the different data centers -Keywords-AKAMAI Status, SID, System ID, IP Ranges.

Title: Customer Invoice Journal Entry With no Profit Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A Profit Center configuration by Product Category was set up for sales, however it is not working.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Select the Journal Entries view.-Show all postings.-Open the Journal Entry XXX for the Customer Invoice ABC.-You can see that there is no Profit Center is appearing.-Cause-The Reporting Principle that it is being used is Function of Expense. In this case, the Income Statement is only based on Function of Expense.-Resolution-To derive the Profit Center, it is necessary to use a Reporting Principle involving Profit Center Derivation. Example: Any other Reporting Principle apart from the Function of Expense.-To change the Reporting Principle, follow the steps follow:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the Implementation Project.-Search and open the Activity Set of Books.-Select the Set the Set of Books and press Edit.-In the next screen go to the General Tab.-Select the Reporting Principle of your choice in the respective field.-After change the same, if you have Customer Invoices that you would like to derive the correct Profit Center, you can reverse and repost the same. It will retrigger the creation of the Journal Entry and the Profit Center will be derived.-To reverse and repost the Customer Invoice please do the following:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Search for the respective Invoice.-Select the row with the Invoice.-Click Actions.-Select the option Business Transaction.-In the new screen press Reverse and Repost.-It will cancel the previous posting and repost it by deriving the Profit Center this time.-Keywords-Profit Center, Customer Invoice, Journal Entry, Product Category, Configuration, Business Configuration, General Ledger.

Title: Offset General Ledger Account Is Wrongly Picked in G/L Accounts - Line Items
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A particular general ledger account, for example Account XXX, shows a journal entry transaction. When viewing  this transaction and selecting the line in which this G/L account is debited or credited you observe a G/L Account(Origin) as g/l account XXX only.-Now you are running G/L Accounts - Line items report for this g/l account XXX and you observe that against this same journa entry the offset General Ledger account is not XXX but instead account YYY.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center General Ledger.-Go to the view Reports.-Select the report G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Enter the required fields and the GL Account XXX-Offset G/L Account picked is ex: YYY but if you see the journal entry it is XXX.-Go to General Ledger work center view-Select Journal Entries view-Find the concenred Journal Entry- You observe by selecting the G/L account XXX in this journal entry that the G/L Account(Origin) maintained as XXX  and is not the same as what is picked in the report.-   Cause-The Offset G/L Account is always calculated for the entire document and sub-transactions in document. Title: ARCHIVED:Account Assignment Details not Copied From Purchase Order to Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicat of KBA  2536409 - Account Assignment Details not Appearing in Supplier Invoice-You have created a purchase order ABC with account assignment cost center. However up on creating the supplier invoice for the purchase order, system failed to update the Account Assignment details in the cost distribution tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select All Purchase Orders to be Invoiced.-Select the relevant Purchase Order.-Select New Invoice and Save.-Cause-You have scoped the functionality Delayed Verification in Progress in the scoping. While creating supplier invoice, account details will not be reflected in the cost distribution. Once you post the supplier invoice, the account distribution details will automatically reflect under cost distribution.-Resolution-If you want account details to be populated under cost distribution during invoice creation, then uncheck the Delayed Verification checkbox in the scoping. Steps to be followed to uncheck this functionality is mentioned below;-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Questions and select the scoping element Purchasing.-Select Supplier Invoicing and Supplier invoice and credit memos.-Select the question; Do you want to use delayed verification as supplier invoice entry capability? Set as No-Finish the scoping.

Title: Customer Request for ISO 27001 Certificate, SOC 1 / SSAE 16 and SOC 2 / SSAE 16 Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You receive a customer's request for ISO 27001 Certificate, SOC 1 / SSAE 16 and SOC 2 / SSAE 16 Reports and you don't know what is the procedure to be followed in order to deliver them the required documentation.- Cause-1)  ISO 27001 Certificate-The ISO 27000 family of standards helps organizations keep information assets secure.-Using this family of standards will help your organization manage the security of assets such as financial information, intellectual property, employee details or information entrusted to you by third parties.-ISO/IEC 27001 is the best-known standard in the family providing requirements for an information security management system (ISMS).-2) SOC 1 / SSAE 16 Report-A SOC 1 Report (Service Organization Controls Report) is a report on Controls at a Service Organization that are relevant to user entities’ internal control over financial reporting.-3) SOC 2 / SSAE 16 Report-The SOC 2 Report focuses on a business’s non-financial reporting controls as they relate to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of a system, as opposed to SOC 1/SSAE 16, which is focused on the financial reporting controls.-Resolution-All the information covering the availability and the proper ways of delivering such documentation to the customers is available in the SAP JAM page Cloud Certification and Attestation Overview.-You can quickly access it via https://jam4.sapjam.com/wiki/show/oZeGsEp4YGNEncjpipiymH-Please access this JAM page and proceed as indicated there.
