Title: Cannot Create Duplicate Entries in Collaboration View Error When Migrating Customers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-During the migration of customers to the system, the following message is raised in the simulation step:-"Cannot Create Duplicate Entries in Collaboration View"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the Business Configuration work center.-In the Overview view, search for the activity Migration of Customers.-Enter the sub-activity Migrate Customers Using the Migration Tool.-Select a migration template, and click Execute Migration -> Step-by-Step.-Proceed to step 3 - Simulation.-After the simulation is completed, the error message is raised.-Cause-The error is raised due to an inconsistent setup of the migration file related to Collaboration.-Resolution-The sheets to be populated in the migration template depend on whether multi channel for document output is scoped.-In order to find the mentioned scoping question, follow the below steps:-Enter the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click Edit Project Scope.-Proceed to step 4 - Questions.-Expand Sales -> Account and Activity Management -> Account Management.-Depending on how this question is set up, the migration works as the following:-If multi channel document output is disabled, all relevant information needs to be entered in the sheet “Collaboration”. In such cases, you cannot enter multiple e-mails to differ with  “to”, “CC”, or “BCC”.-If the multi channel is enabled, you need to fill the sheet “Collaboration MultiChannel” and also the sheet “Document Output Channels”. In the first tab you define which Business Documents are supported, and in the latter tab you can define the specific settings for each document type.-Keywords-Collaboration, multi-channel

Title: ARCHIVED: Outgoing Payments Are Not Automatically Cleared in the Payment Allocation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Duplicate of KBA 2569826***-You have uploaded your bank statement, nevertheless, the associated payment allocation remains In Preparation, although you have memo line rules to match payments.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Find the In Preparation payment allocation.-You'll see that the payment under Payment Confirmation/Returns is not allocated as expected.-Cause-The memo line analysis tool is used for:-Allocation to Customer/Supplier account or Open items in these accounts.-Allocation to G/L Account.-Allocation to Payments made from the system, Payment Confirmation/Returns tab.-The memo line analysis works differently for allocations to existing payments than for G/L Account and Customer/Supplier account assignment.-For an allocation to automatically post for payments made from the system, a memo line rule of type DME Reference (data medium exchange) must exist.-The rule searches for the DME identifier in the corresponding bank statement item. Therefore, the exact Document ID or External Document ID of the payment to be allocated should have been mentioned in the bank statement, which is empty in this case. Hence, although the memo line simulation finds the payment order, the automatic allocation does not happen since the identifier is not present in the bank statement item.-Relevant Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines can me accessed either via the open payment allocation, or:-Fine Tuning Activity: Global Settings for Payment.-Create and edit rules for analyzing memo lines.-  Resolution-You need to check why the identifier is not being sent in the bank statement file. For MT940 format, for example, when individual payments are confirmed, the system expects the payment references to be sent in tag 61, which fills the Doc ID field of the bank statement item.

Title: Confirm Execution for Contract with an Entitlement
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archived reason: change in system behaviour KBA not valid anymore***-You want to confirm the execution for a Contract with an Entitlement but the Confirm Execution button is not active.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements or the Sales Order work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Select the respective contract.-The Confirm Execution button is not active.-Cause-In order for the Confirm Execution to be active for an Entitlement you need to enter a enter all products that the account is entitled to for this contract item.-Resolution-Go to the Service Entitlements or the Sales Order work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Open the respective contract and navigate to the Items tab-Select the respective entitlement and then navigate to the Entitled Products sub tab.-You can enter a single product or a product category. When a category is entered, the account is entitled to all products in that category. Once you have entered the product or product category the Confirm Execution button will be active.-When you then confirm the execution you have to navigate into the Service and Spare Parts tab in your New Service Confirmation and you must select the items that you want to confirm. In the Services and Spare Parts section, press on the drop down selection for the Product field.-The system proposes the following items from the entitled product list:-Services-Spare parts-Expenses-Products in the product category-The system proposes only active products from the product category that have been enabled for object assignment (in the category master) and that have the same sales organization and distribution channel as the confirmation.-  For more information please refer to the following help documentation:-Create a Service Confirmation-Customer Contracts Quick Guide

Title: Error While Uploading a Bank Statement With MT940 DE File Format Due to IBAN House Bank Account Identifier
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are unable to upload a Bank Statement using the File Format M940 DE due to error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Click New -> Inbound File.-Enter the File Type as Bank Statement and select Import Format as MT940 DE.-Add the relevant file.-Click Start File Upload.-System raises the error messages below:-'No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number, national bank code, currency ABC found'-'Bank account missing or cannot be determined'-'Bank Statement ID XXX for Bank Account ID rejected'-DD.MM.YYYY - Date-ABC - Currency-XXX - Bank Statement ID-Cause-The errors are raised because in the tag 25 of the file only the IBAN is being maintained.-Currently it is not supported to use only the IBAN Number to determine the Bank Account with File Format MT940 DE.-Resolution-An Internal Development Request has been added to the Product Backlog in order to enhance the functionality with this feature in one of the future product releases.-As a workaround it is possible to use the Alternative Account Number in combination with the IBAN Number as follows:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the My Banks view.-Select the relevant Bank.-Click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Populate the IBAN Number in the Alternative Account Number field.-Then, in the tag 25 of the file, it is required to maintain the BIC + IBAN, following the example:-Bank Statement Header-:25:BIC/IBAN-Keywords-Bank Statement, MT940 DE.

Title: System is not Selecting the List Price With Lowest Price as Source of Supply
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are creating a new Planning Proposal and system does not select a List Price with lowest price as Source of Supply for the Proposal. You expect system to select the List Price with lowest price. Please note that the Product for which you are creating proposal is Externally Procured.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the  Supply Control or Supply Planning work center.-Select the option New Planning Proposal from the Common Tasks view.-In the New Planning Proposal screen choose Add Row button.-Enter the Product ID, Planning Area ID and Quantity.-System will select a List Price which does not have the lowest price as Source of Supply.-Cause-While determining a Source of Supply in Planning, system does not compare the price of all available List Price documents for a product. System will randomly pick the first List Price it encounters while creating a Proposal for the Product.-Resolution-The system is working as designed. However, if you mark the List Price with lowest price as Fixed Source of Supply, system will always select this list price as Source of Supply when a Proposal is created. Please follow the below given steps to do so.-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Navigate to the Source Determination: Fixed Sources of Supply view.-Choose the button New and select the option Fixed Source of Supply.-Enter the relevant Product in the field Product and choose the button Get Sources of Supply.-System will display available Sources of Supply. You can mark the relevant Source of Supply as Fixed Source of Supply, by selecting the check box Fixed against your desired Source of Supply.-Choose the button Save and then Close the page.-Keywords-Source of Supply, List Price, Source Determination

Title: ARCHIVED: How to Mark Not Posted Source Documents as Irrelevant from Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Incomplete KBA. Do not use***--You have several Not Posted Source Documents in the General Ledger > Unposted Source Documents view.-For example:-Customer Return has the error message ''Sales organization for sales unit XYZ missing in master data, or missing role sales unit''.-Several Warehouse Confirmations with same error messages about the same Inbound Delivery: ''Referenced customer return not found (Inbound Delivery ABC)''.-or-Sales Orders: ''Determination of profit center from DEF on DD.MM.YYYY failed''.-Customer Project Expense List: ''Sales order reference is not valid''.-It is not possible to fix the issue in the relevant document, so there is no way to post the documents to Accounting from the Front-end.-(XYZ represents the Sales Unit ID); (ABC represents the Inbound Delivery ID); (DEF represents the Profit Center ID); (DD.MM.YYYY represents a Date)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-You find the relevant document in the Unposted Source Document list.-Cause-There are possible causes depending on the Source Document Type, please find the example of Customer Return below:--The Customer Return is not posted to Accounting due to the Sales Unit issue, so the Warehouse Confirmations cannot be posted either, because it has reference to the Customer Return, therefore they are shown as Unposted Source Documents.-The Customer Return error message regarding Sales Unit, sometimes cannot be easily fixed with either CRM or FIN Applications. In the end, CRM Development or Customer will have to cancel the Inbound Delivery, in order to cancel the Customer Return.-Note that, you cannot directly cancel the Customer return, but have to cancel the Inbound Delivery instead. Meanwhile, the cancellation of the Customer Return does not change the already created Business Transactions.-The related Inbound Delivery is canceled, so the Customer Return is set to Complete. In this case, the Unposted Warehouse Confirmations and Customer Returns regarding the same Inbound Delivery in the Unposted Source Document list are not valid any more.-The same situation sometimes also happens with Sales Orders and the documents that reference the Sales Orders.-Keywords-Irrelevant; Documents; Mark; Error; Unposted; Source Document; General Ledger; Customer Return; Warehouse Confirmation; Sales Order; CPEL

Title: ARCHIVED:Mandatory Extension Fields Behavior
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: We are nomore on silverlight after 2018 approx.-Mandatory extension fields created in View All mode do not trigger any error message in Overview mode when left empty. The expectation is that every mandatory field, no matter on which screen it was created, should trigger an error when left unfilled.-Reproducing the Issue-As an example we take Purchase Orders.-Open the Work Center Purchase Orders and Requests-Go to Purchase Order view-Select Show > All Purchase Orders-Copy e.g. a Purchase Order in Finished status-The new Purchase Order is opened in Overview mode-Although the mandatory extension field you created is only added to the View All mode, you expect an error message when saving the document on Overview mode-The system allows saving the Purchase Order without error-Cause-The system uses a different UI component for both Overview and View All mode. The extension field created in one does not trigger error message in the other.-Note: in addition to the above, the system also does not trigger the "mandatory error" message when you save in View All mode in a tab with no mandatory field, even though there are other empty mandatory fields in other tabs. The mandatory field check is only performed for the currently displayed screen.-Resolution-This is a technical limitation in the Silverlight mode of Business ByDesign. Currently there are no plans to adjust this as the main focus is on the HTML5 mode, which will not have the same logical structure as the Silverlight mode.

Title: ARCHIVED:Time and Expenses Reassignment Stuck With Status In Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:  Duplicate of KBA   3105317 , since KBA  3105317  is written by user Arun still with SRM  though it was released after this KBA was released, so i considered to archive this KBA itself.-You have reassigned some Project hours from one Project Task to another, but the reassignment status remains "In Process" for several hours or days.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Time and Expenses view.-Search for the relevant Time and Expenses task.-See that the Reassignment Status column is showing a symbol of two arrows.-Click on the symbol.-You can see that Reassignment Status is In Process. In the Administrative Data, you can also see the Triggered On date, that shows since when the system is trying to process the reassignment.-Cause-The system tried to process the reassignment requests several times, and was not successful. Then it tried to finish the processing to set the status to erroneous, but this was as well not successful because the corresponding expense items might have been locked by another user, most probably due to project invoicing activities.-Resolution-To solve the issue, you can do the following:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Delayed Business Object Processing view.-Select from the dropdown menu "All Interrupted Delayed Business Object Processing".-Select the lines that contain Object Name as "Project Expense Reassignment Requisition".-Click on the Restart button.-This should retrigger the process and solve the issue.-Keywords-In Process, Status, stuck, Time and Expenses, Project Task, reassignment

Send an email to Mr. Friedmann, Martin (martin.friedmann@sap.com) with below mentioned details.-           We have received an incident for the system outage in the month of XXXX. (This is just for your information, about what happens, once the email is sent to Martin Friedmann) The concerned team will look upon the request and will evaluate the claim, if found violated then, the SAP cloud terminations team will trigger the approvals for the credit amount for the customer.  The Global Commercial operations team member will send the final credit amount and the SLA calculation sheet and in turn Mr. Martin Friedmann will send the same to the support engineer (Owner of the incident, who sends the email). The SLA calculation sheet looks like the below screenshot:-  Step3. Once you have received the SLA calculation sheet for the customer, then you need to create an O2I ticket.-Click on the link: https://fiorilaunchpad.sap.com/sites#Help-Create&/create/ZFAR/ZFAR_O2I/--This link will lead you the unified ticketing tool, and you will have to create a ticket as shown below: --*Country: Can be found in the SLA Credit calculation excel.-*Order ID: Can be found in the SLA Credit Calculation Excel.-NOTE: You have to use the exact description, ticket type and ticket category as shown in the screenshot above.-Before you “SUBMIT” the ticket, you MUST attach the email in which you received the SLA calculation sheet.-Step4. Once the ticket has been responded, you will get the credit note attached in the ticket. I have attached a sample credit note for your reference.-The credit note MUST be attached in the BCP incident while closing the incident with the comments as below:-“Dear Customer,-We have completed the service credit claim request, have attached the credit note ID. Title: ARCHIVED - How to escalate incidents towards Incident Escalation Management Team (IEMT) from Product Support Customer Experience (PSCX)

Please refer to KBA 3137387 instead***-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-ByD/C4C or Cloud Marketing customer or partner is unhappy with incident resolution progress for one or multiple critical incidents and you as a customer-facing SAP employee need help from our IEMT team.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer (Sales Cloud and Service Cloud), Marketing Cloud-Very High incident without provided workaround or solution-Resolution-There are two ways to escalate.-The customer calls the support hotline and CIC colleague decides whether to involve IEMT or CIM.-The customer contacts her/his SAP contact.-Options at your disposal:-     SAP contact enters all necessary information into the MCC SOS App.  IEMT might get involved after request from MCC.-   Instructions how to use the MCC SOS APP are here: https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/Uit0yfV4hybEaihDxSX6LD/overview_page/ov5uDE4nFsvveQUa5ZylgV-Or-Recommended:-    SAP contact fills Email template and send to IEMT directly. IEMT starts working on the escalation request immediately and provides the first update within 1 hour towards the requestor.-See Also-Below please see the setup of the Escalation Request Email:-Sent to: DL PS CX Incident Escalation Team <DL_011000358700000711042011E@global.corp.sap>-Subject: Escalation Request: <BYD/C4C/MKT Cloud>, <Incident number>, P1,<Customer Name>-Body of the email:-Dear Colleagues,-Please be aware of this new incoming Incident Escalation Request.-Escalation Request Form- ----------------------------------------------------------Incident Number:-Customer Name/No.:-Date/Time of Request (CET):-Requester of Escalation:-Customer Contact (24x7 - phone, email):-Subject (short issue description)-Affected Solution/Products: <BYD/C4C/MKT Cloud>-Affected Business Area: < e.g. FIN/CI>-Reason for Escalation:-Overall Business Impact for Customer:-Additional Information: (screenshots, related incidents, email communication...)-------------------------------------------------------------Chose the correct option-Keywords-Escalation, Incident escalation, IEMT, Incident Escalation Management Team, PS, MCC

Title: ARCHIVED:Defaulting of Purchasing Unit via Product Category in Manual Purchase Orders
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of  KBA 2338159 - How to Default Purchasing Unit and Buyer Responsible in Purchase Request or purchase order-You create a purchase order (PO) manually and you expect the Purchasing Unit to default automatically according to the Product Category as per the work Distribution rules defined for the work category Operational Purchasing (work center Organizational Management). However the defaulting does not occur according to the Product Category.-Cause-The Product Category setting in work category Operational Purchasing is not used for manual POs.-So it will have effect only for the automatic creation of Purchase Requests (and follow-up POs if it is configured) via Planning, Shopping Carts, etc... So the Purchase Requests will contain the right Purchasing Unit.-The setting is only to distribute the workload among the purchasing units (purchasers), not to automate the filling of POs.

Title: ARCHIVED:Error Occurs While Trying to Change the Quantity Conversion Rule of the Product "Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open items to be invoiced"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA: 1720124 - Error Message "Changing the conversion not possible" While Changing the Quantity Conversion of a Material-While you are trying to change the Quantity Conversion Rule of a Product, the system returns the error message: Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open customer quotes, demand plans, inbound deliveries, internal requests, items to be invoiced, projects, purchase orders, purchase requests, purchasing contracts, sales orders, source documents (General Ledger), source documents for supplier invoices, stock.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search for the product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Edit the product and go to the General tab.-Change the quantity conversion rule maintained and click the Save button.-You receive the following error: Changing the conversion not possible; it is used by one or more open inbound deliveries, items to be invoiced, source documents (general Ledger).-Cause-This error is valid, you are not allowed to change the rule if it is getting used in any of the business document available in the system.-This error message is valid for Invoice documents with all status related to Open and also status Blocked-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Also changing the rule of conversion in the backend is not recommended as it would lead to an incompatible change. This rule may be used by multiple documents, hence changing the quantity conversion will lead to inconsistency in those documents.- You may have to use the respective reports to find the  effected documents that have used the Product.-Keywords-Quantity, Conversion, Product, Material, Master

Title: ARCHIEVED: VAT Return Failed With Error Message: 'No account determined for VRN XXX'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Archieved Reason: KBA '2885865 - UK MTD VAT Return Error: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located IN: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA' explains a similar scenario. ***-You have executed the VAT Return and it failed due error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns view.-Open the relevant VAT Return ID.-On the Submission Information you can see the Approval Status as Rejected and the error message '|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located in'.-Cause-This error message can happen because the VAT Registration Number is incorrectly maintained.-For example: VAT Registration Number is XXX.-The  VAT Registration Number maintained in the configurations has to be GB + XXX as maintained in the Company Tax Arrangement.-Resolution-To maintain the Account, you can refer to the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the UK Tax Digital activity.-Here it is possible to maintain the Account Number GB + XXX.-Once the Account in the UK Tax Digital activity is changed accordingly, the VAT Return should be released successfully.-See Also-VAT Return, UK Tax Digital, VAT Registration Number.-Keywords-VAT Return, VAT Registration Number.

Title: ARCHIVED:Buyer Responsible Field In New Purchase Order Is Empty
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: Duplicate of first part of resolution in KBA   1658962 - How to Define Default Buyer Responsible for the Purchase Order -You are creating a New Purchase Order. You see that the field Buyer Responsible is empty.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select New Purchase Order option.-After you enter the supplier Id, you expect the Buyer Responsible field to be filled automatically by the system.-You can see the Buyer Responsible field is not filled automatically by the system.-Cause-The Buyer Responsible field picks the name of the employee who creates the Purchase Order. If a service agent creates the Purchase Order, the system picks the user who is maintained as Employee Responsible for Purchase Orders in Employee Work Distribution. As your user is assigned to the service agent role, you need to maintain the Employee Work Distribution rule.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select Employee Work Distribution view.-Select Employee Responsible for Purchase Requests and Orders and select Edit button.-Fill in all the mandatory details.-Select Check button.-Select Save and Close button.-Once you have maintained the work distribution rule and create a new purchase order you can see that the Buyer Responsible field is filled by the system automatically with the employee name defined in the Employee Work Distribution rule: Employee Responsible for Purchase Requests and Orders.

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA 2571114 - Supplier Invoice is not Posted and is in Status Delayed Verification in Process-You have created a Supplier Invoice without Purchase Order and when you post it, the status goes to:"Delayed Check in Progress".-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Under Common Tasks select New Invoice without Purchase Order.-Fill in all the mandatory details and press Post.-Cause-The status of this newly created Supplier Invoice goes to "Delayed Check in Progress" because of a question that has been scoped under Edit Project Scope.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select your Implementation Project.-Click "Edit Project Scope".-Go to the fourth part:"Questions".-Select Purchasing > Supplier Invoicing > Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-Unscope the question "Do you want to use delayed verification as supplier invoice entry capability?"-If this question is set, every newly created Supplier Invoices would be posted in the background and hence the delayed verification.-Keywords-Supplier Invoices, Delayed Check in Progress, Supplier Invoicing

For example when you try to assign a source of supply: Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 107, report an incident.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to the view Purchase Requests.-Choose Show: Open Tasks.-Mark a task Assign Supplier to Purchase Request.-Choose Assign Source of Supply.-You get the error: Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 107, report an incident.-Cause-The error with the Purchase Request is thrown because the Open Quantity = 0. A purchase order has already been created for the full quantity.-Resolution-Once you processed a document, it does not disappear automatically from the work list. A refresh is needed. It finishes with the error "No configuration for tax Value Added Tax, event ABC, and rate DEF."-ABC - relevant Tax Event.-DEF - relevant Tax Rate Type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Return Runs view.-Select relevant run ID.-Click relevant Application Log ID.-Go to the Results tab.-Error: "No configuration for tax Value Added Tax, event ABC, and rate DEF."-Cause-This may be caused due to the Valid From and Valid To of related Tax Rate Type on the Tax Returns for Goods and Services - GHI.-GHI - relevant country/region for the VAT Return.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Select Tax Returns for Goods and Services - GHI.-Click Change Immediately.-Click Product Tax Return GHL.-Select Tax Return Type.-Go to the Tax Event tab.-Select Tax Event ABC.-Filter for Tax Rate Type DEF.-Adjust the Valid From and Valid To dates so that all relevant Tax Percentages are Valid for the duration of the VAT Return Run.-Keywords-Tax Rate, Tax Event, VAT Return Run, VAT Return

Title: ARCHIVED:Updated Supplier Name does not show on Purchase Order

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA  2380941 - Modified Supplier Name is not reflected in Purchase Order Preview -You have updated a supplier name from ABC to DEF but you can still see the old value on some purchase orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the work center Supplier Base-Select the Suppliers view-Search the supplier ABC-Change the supplier name to DEF and Save-When checking the purchase orders created before this change, you can see that the name is still ABC instead of DEF.-Cause-When changing the supplier name, only the purchase orders created after this change will reflect this new value.-The purchase orders created before this change will remain with the old value (ABC in this case).-Resolution-This is the expected behavior from the system.-However, should you copy an old purchase order that would contain an older value under supplier name, the newly created value would be visible in the newly copied purchase order.-Keywords-Supplier Name, Change, Update, Purchase Orders.

Title: How to Request the Tenant Refresh Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Purpose-Operation can offer a new process to you where you can request for a tenant refresh of an existing test tenant. This service is available for Business ByDesign/ Cloud for Customer/ Cloud for Travel. D4C/ Edge customers cannot request this service.-The tenant refresh process contains of the following steps:-Copy of the source tenant (which requires a downtime about at least 4 hours)-Switch of the tenant identities (switch of tenant ID and tenant URL)-Invalidation/Decommissioning of original test tenant-That means that we do a full copy of a source tenant, this could be a productive or an existing test tenant and switch the identities (tenant ID and URL) of the test tenant which should refreshed.-In the end, the original test tenant will be decommissioned by this process.-The result of this process is to retain the URL and tenant ID of an existing test tenant and to refresh it with data of source tenant (mainly your productive tenant but it could also be your existing test tenant).-Usecase:-For example, a tenant refresh can be used for integration tests of a SAP Cloud for Customer test tenant which is already integrated with an ERP system and testing requires new data of the productive tenant.   -Prerequisites-The customer is requesting a full copy (clone = 1:1 copy containing all data)-The customer is not LIVE yet and has not closed the first implementation project-Restrictions-Please note that when customer-specific solutions (PDI solutions/oneoff projects) are in place, this will only work when version of existing customer-specific solutions are the same in source tenant and tenant to be refreshed.-How to Request a Tenant Refresh via an Incident-To request a tenant refresh, please create an incident out of your Cloud tenant. You will find further information in the Business Center via URL https://wiki.sme.sap.com/wiki/x/cwUYF.-Provide the following information in the incident to request tenant refresh:-Customer name-Customer number (Business Partner Number, CRM)-Tenant ID or URL of tenant which is source of the copy-Tenant ID or URL of test tenant which should be refreshed-Requested downtime of source tenant: Start time, start date-During the tenant refresh creation, the source tenant needs to be stopped for 4 hours.-This activitiy can only be performed outside of the contractual maintenance window -Confirmation about short downtime of test tenant to be refreshed and new tenant during identity switch-Confirmation that you can agree with deletion of original test tenant (test tenant which should be refreshed)-Requestor Contact Person-It is important that you provide us with the name and e-mail address of the person who should be informed when we face issues during this process  -The tenant refresh is generally provided within 1 business day of the customer making the request. The customer will be informed of completion via update on the incident.

Title: Calculating Actual Cost through Percentage of Completion Results In Unexpected Value
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The actual cost calculated by percentage of completion (POC) is unexpected.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center and to Sales Document Items view.-Select any sales order.-Click the button Edit Percentage of Completion.-You can check the actual costs here.-Cause-In general, the percentage of completion, no matter system calculated or manual POC, plays only a role in case an accrual method is assigned.-Without accrual method, costs and revenues are directly posted to profit and loss accounts.-In case a POC accrual method is assigned, the system calculates the POC based on the actual costs which is calculated through confirmed cost divide by planned cost.-Note: you can get the confirmed cost from the expense report, while the planned cost is the cost that you entered in the sales order item as the price component cost estimate.-If there's no planned cost maintained, system will calculate POC as 100%.-Generally, the POC value is used from revenue recognition to calculate the revenues to be realized. Means that in case of a manual POC of 10%, 10% of the planned revenues are realized by the revenue recognition. All costs incurred until this period, will be recognized too.-See Also-For detailed information, please check the system documentation in the help center (search for Revenue Recognition for Project Sales)

Title: [Archived]The Quantity Field is Not Editable for few Items in Project Invoice Request Screen-Refer KBA: 1980428
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a project related sales order for item type:Service - fixed price (project).For few items, the quantity is maintained as 1ea. ("ea" is a Unit of Measurement)-Now, you create a manual project invoice request and in the "Refine Invoice Items" tab, you are able to edit the quantity for all the items which have quantity greater than 1 ea but not for the line items with quantity 1 ea.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select the relevant project under "All Projects" view-Now select New-> Project Invoice Request->Create Manual Project Invoice Request-Under tab "Define Invoice Items", propose invoice items – using sales order items-Navigate to tab "Refine Invoice Items", and try to edit the quantity where 1 ea is maintained-The field is greyed out. Other line items with quantity greater than 1 ea are editable-Cause-For items with Fixed Price invoicing (e.g.item type:Service - fixed price (project)) where the quantity is equal to 1, the quantity is not relevant for the calculation of the net value. The amount is considered to be a lump sum for the service or expense.-Hence, you cannot change the quantity of 1ea.-Resolution-You can enter a quantity greater than 1 in preceding sales order document, then the quantity is relevant for the calculation of the net value and the field will be editable in project invoice request.-See Also-Refer Help Document: Create a Project Invoice Request for a Customer Project-Refer KBA: 1980428 - The Quantity Field is not Editable in Project Invoice Request-Keywords-Project invoice Request, Refine Invoice Items, Service - fixed price (project), quantity

Title: ARCHIVED:500 error while uploading Purchase orders via Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: Duplicate of  1921060 - Find the Cause for 500 Error during Supplier Invoice or purchase order Excel upload- also I have  updated the KBA 1921060  with  the details of this KBA (II_SRM_PO_MBO) which is the only difference between this two KBA's-Excel Import of Purchase Orders stops with a 500 internal Error.-Reproducing the Issue-The customer has downloaded the Excel template from Purchase Requests and Orders / Purchase Orders / New / Import from Microsoft Excel®-He populated the data in the template then connected to his system via the add-in and selected "Save Data to" to send the data over and created the POs.-The import starts but aborts with the 500 internal Error.-The error does not specify what the issue is.-Cause--Some of the data sent across to the system is either missing or not formatted correctly.-Unfortunately, technically, not all issues can be fed back to the UI to let the user know what needs to be corrected.-In this case, support has to connect to the backend to see what the issue was and inform the customer of what he needs to do for the upload to be successful.-Resolution--These instructions are aimed at Expert Support Logistics to help them find out what caused this generic error.-Connect to the customer system backend.-In transaction SRT_UTIL you can check for raised error messages during the Excel upload.-By default, we see only the errors from today.-Click re-select and set the correct date and remove the user-Remove all the selections beside the dates-Execute-Scroll to the right to see the interface name.-Sort by interface name-The interface we are looking for is named II_SRM_PO_MBO-If there was an error during the upload you should see a message mentioning the field in question and the reason for the fail.-If you cannot directly find the field in the upload file to advise the customer, open the Standard Excel template and select the Developer tab-Under this tab, go to Source. A panel called XML SOURCE will open on the right hand side.-You will have to manually search for the field mentioned in the error you found in SRT_UTIL (no automatic search feature)-Once you find it, clicking on it will highlight the corresponding field in the template.-Compare with the customer file. (make sure you have the original full file uploaded by the customer to compare)-This field might have been left empty or might have been populated incorrectly (again, the error in SRT_UTIL should tell you this)-Inform the customer accordingly.

Then you can change the Migration mode to Add New records and continue migrating the X records using the delta file.

Title: ARCHIVED:Sales Order is in Status In Process but you Expect it to be in Status Completed.

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:dulicate of KBA  1752792 - Sales Order is in Status In Process but you Expect it to be in Status Completed.- Sales order is in status In Process but you expect it to be in status Completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order number).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select line item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Line item XX is linked to project XYZ (XYZ represents the number of the project).-The Invoice Status for the line item is in status Finished and all invoicing has been completed for this sales order.-Therefore you would expect the sales order ABC to be in status Completed but the status is In Process.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.
