Title: ARCHIVED:How To Remove Down Payment From The Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA  2811500 - Error Message:Total gross amount less than total down payment request amount-Invoice is not getting posted due to error message" Total gross amount less than total down payment request amount". How to remove down payment from the invoice and post the invoice.-Cause-Down payment (already paid) will remain as an open item in the system unless it is being adjusted with the invoice. For example you have down payment 1000 USD  and you want to post a invoice of 2000 USD. In this case system will automatically add the down payment  while posting the invoice amount of 2000 USD and your final amount of Invoice (Applied amount) amount will be 1000 USD as Down payment is already been added to invoice. In case invoice is lesser amount than the down payment then system will not allow to post invoice unless you remove the down payment (s) from the invoice.-Resolution-In order to remove the Down payment from the invoice from the supplier invoice follow these steps:- Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.- Go to the view Invoice Entry.- Select the option All Orders to Be Invoiced in the Show field and give your desired document ID in the  Find field and click on Go button.- Select your document to be invoiced and click on New Invoice.- New Invoice document window will open and click on Save option.- After the document get save and click on the General- tab of the invoice and then click on the Payment Information and click again on the Down Payments.- You can view  that system has automatically added down payment against that invoice and select your Down Payment ID and click on Remove button and then post the invoice.

Title: Redundant Journal Entries Removed from Supplier Invoices with Zero Balances
Content: Symptom-As of SAP Business ByDesign 2308 Release (August 2023), a function has changed to now remove redundant journal entries from supplier invoices with zero balances. You would like to better understand this change.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The change in SAP Business ByDesign 2308 Release has been implemented in the following scenario:-if a supplier invoice with Invoice Item and Credit Memo Item is posted, the corresponding journal entry has been generated with postings to the Gain/Loss on Foreign Currency Remeasurement G/L Account (credit and debit sides, balance to zero). The change done is to avoid those lines when supplier invoice has zero balance (Total Gross Amount is zero).-See Also-Help Document:-What's New in Financial Management -> What Has Changed -> Redundant Journal Entries Removed from Supplier Invoices with Zero Balances-Keywords-redundant journal entries; Gain/Loss on Foreign Currency Remeasurement; zero balance

Title: Custom Field Displays Only 30 Characters in a Price List Created via Web Service
Content: Symptom-When you create a Price List with Custom Fields in the system via Standard Web Service, the Custom Field only displays the first 30 characters of the content stored in the field.      -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Price List view.-Filter for the desired Price List.-In the search field, Search for the Price List EFG (EFG represents the Price List ID).-Open and select the View All button.-Navigate to the Item tab.-In the Custom Field only the first 30 characters of the field content are displayed, even though more than 30 characters were maintained in the field in the creation of the Price List.-Cause-Even though is possible to store more than 80 characters in a Custom Field while creating a Price List via Standard Web Service, the placeholders for Custom Fields in Custom Price Lists allow only 32 characters. Because of this, in the UI, no Custom Field will display more than 32 characters.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. --In order to avoid any mismatch between the parameters of the Price List and the Sales Orders, it is recommend to maintain 32 characters or less for the content in a Custom Field when creating a Price List via Standard Web Service.-See Also-Please kindly refer to the KBA below to find further information regarding the usage of Price List with Extension Fields:-3099502 - How To Create a Custom Price List With Extension Fields-Keywords-length, custom price list, price list, custom field, extension field, character, characters, 30 characters, 30, web service

Title: How is the Sender E-Mail Address of a Sales Document Determined?
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how the sender e-mail address is determined of your output in a sales document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Service Request/Service Quote/Service Order follow the following order of sender email address determination:-If the email address of the Service and Support Team in maintained in the service document, then on sending the service request or service order form to the customer an e-mail will be sent with the sender email address as email address of the Service and Support Team.-In case, the email address of the Service and Support Team in not found, then the e-mail address of the Processor will be used.-If the email address for both the Service and Support Team and the Processor is not maintained, then email address of the Seller will be used as the sender email address.-Sales Quote/Sales Order/etc. follow the following order of sender email address determination:-If the email address of the Sales Unit in maintained in the sales document, then on sending the e.g. sales order form to the customer an e-mail will be sent with the sender email address as email address of the Sales Unit.-In case, the email address of the Sales Unit in not found, then the e-mail address of the Employee Responsible will be used.-If the email address for both the Sales Unit and the Employee Responsible is not maintained, then email address of the Seller will be used as the sender email address.-Customer Invoice follows the following order of sender email address determination:-If the email address of the Invoicing Unit (Bill From Party) in maintained in the sales document, then on sending the e.g. Customer Invoice form to the customer an e-mail will be sent with the sender email address as email address of the Invoicing Unit.-In case, the email address of the Invoicing Unit in not found, then the e-mail address of the Seller Party will be used.-If there is no document-specific sender address demined, the system will use the Default Sender Address maintained in the Fine-Tuning Activity E-Mail and Fax Settings in your Business Configuration.-It is possible to change the default system determination of the sender email address as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Output Channel Selection view.-Select the respective Sales Document in the Show Rules For filter e.g. Sales Order.-Edit an existing Output Channel rule or add a new Output Channel rule for the Output Channel E-Mail.-You can set up the Sender E-Mail Source and Sender E-Mail Address as per your requirement.-Please Note: Changes in Master Data e.g. Accounts or Org Units are not dynamically taken over in existing documents, follow up documents or documents that are copied. This means that if a document e.g. a Sales Order was created and the E-Mail Address in an Org Unit (e.g. the one used as a Sales Unit) is changed this change will not be taken over in the already existing Sales Order or any document that is created as a follow up of this Sales Order. You will have to change the data manually in the respective document.-Keywords-service order, service quote, service request, sales order, sales quote, customer invoice, sender e-mail, output, e-mail, e-mail address, email, determination, determine

Title: Latest Start Date and Latest End Date swapped their positions
Content: Symptom-The Latest Start Date and the Latest End Date have swapped their positions in Task Control view under Production Control work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Show Latest Start Date and Latest End Date.-Open Advanced Filter and filter the Production Order: ABC (ABC means the Production Order ID) .-Click Go.-You can see there are 3 rows.-The First row Supply you can see the Latest Start Date is correct.-However, for the other two rows Make and Check the Latest Start Date is later than the Latest End Date.-Cause-During the creation of the tasks, the Earliest Start Date and the Earliest End Date are being stored incorrectly, the date for Earliest Start Date is actually being stored in the Earliest End Date field and vice versa.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can click into the task and the correct values are visible there.-Keywords-Production Order, Latest Start Date, Latest End Date, Task

Title: E-Mail, Phone and Fax of the Processor in the Output Document of a Service Request is Not the Expected One
Content: Symptom-The E-Mail, Phone and Fax in the output document of a Service Request is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Select the Service Requests view.-Open service request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service request).-You can see in the Organizational Assignment section that the following details are maintained:-Processor: DEF(DEF represents the employee entered in the processor field) -Service Organization: ABC (ABC represents the service organization maintained)-Click on the Preview button.-You can see the Processor, the Sales Organization, Phone, Fax and the E-Mail address is displayed as follows:-DEF-ABC-Phone:XXX( XXX represents the phone number displayed)-Fax: :YYY ( YYY represents the fax number displayed)-E-Mail: ABCexample@example.com (ABCexample@example.com represents the e-mail displayed)-Click on the name (hyperlink) of the processor to open the Employee Overview.-In the Communication Data section you can see that the following one, Fax and the E-Mail address is maintained for the Employee.-Phone:ZZZ (ZZZ represents the phone number maintained for the employee)-Fax: : WWW (WWWrepresents the fax number maintained for the employee)-E-Mail: DEFexample@example.com (DEFexample@example.com represents the e-mail maintained for the employee)-You expect that this Phone, Fax and the E-Mail address of the Processor is displayed.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Org Structures view.-Select Org Unit ABC.-In the General tab you can see that the following data has been maintained for the Phone, Fax and the E-Mail address:-Phone: XXX (XXX represents the phone number maintained for the org unit)-Fax: :  YYY (YYY represents the fax number maintained for the org unit)-E-Mail: ABCexample@example.com (ABCexample@example.com represents the e-mail maintained for the org unit) -Cause-The system determined the output settings in the following manner:-Firstly, the data is picked from the Service and Support team.-In case no data is maintained for the Service and Support team in the Organizational Management the system will determine data from the Processor of the service request.-If both the Service and Support team and the Processor data is not maintained then the data is from the Seller Company is determined.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-See Also-2025807 - E-mail Text in Edit Output Settings for Service Request is Read Only-2880782 - Duplicate Service Requests Created via Outlook Addin-3345865 - How to Create Service Request via Microsoft Outlook-Configuration: Creating Service Requests From Incoming E-Mails-Create Service Requests from E-Mails-Keywords-Service Request; Output; Output History; You can Also; Template; E-Mail

Title: Filtering Approval Process for Employee Responsible or Document Creator
Content: Symptom-You would like to create an approval process for the sales quotes where the conditions can filter for the employee responsible or the user who created the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management.-Go to the Approval Processes View.-Filter for All Process.-In the Related Business Document, Filter for Quote.-Mark the Active Approval Process.-Select Copy button.-In the Condition section, Add Group button.-In the Edit Condition Window, Select the dropdown.-No condition can be maintained as employee responsible or document creator.-Cause-Resolution-This is expected system behavior for approval process conditions.-Currently using the standard system options it is not possible to maintain a condition to filter the approval process per document creator or employee responsible.-In case you would like to add this condition as a possibility to filter approval processes then, we kindly request you to please check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords- sales quote, approval process, conditions, filter approval, document creator, employee responsible, quotes, quote

Title: Dump While Posting Concur Expense Report in ByDesign
Content: Symptom-When attempting to post Expense Report XYZ (represents Expense Report ID) from Concur, the system throws an exception.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur view.-Go to the Expense Reports sub view.-Click on Post for Expense Report XYZ.-The system crashes.-Cause-The Expense Report is Project-based and the Project is closed.-Check the Project Name in the JSON under the tag,-"entryOrgUnit3Code":"PRO"-"entryOrgUnit4Code":"DEF" (represents Project ID).-Path to check the Project Status in SAP Business ByDesign system:-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view.-Filter All Projects and search for Project ID DEF.-Here the status is Closed.-Resolution-Please report a case to SAP Support by providing your written approval to mark the Expense Report as Failed from the backend.-Once completed, send the posting confirmation as Failed to Concur, make the necessary amendments, and resubmit the Expense Report.-Keywords-Concur, Internal Server error, Expense Report, Dump, GET_COMPANY_FROM_MPS, project, internal server error, get_company_from_mps

Title: Cannot Make Outgoing Check or Bank Payment from One Bank Account
Content: Symptom-When you make outgoing check payment, the system gives the following error message: 'No payment format exists at bank XYZ to support bank check'. Then, you try to make outgoing bank payment from the same bank, and the system gives you another error message: 'No payment format exists at bank XYZ to support domestic bank transfer'.-(XYZ represents the bank ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and choose New Outgoing Check under Common Tasks.-Specify the Company ID, Payee, Payment amount and currency, as well as Bank Account ID.-Set the payment Reference to Items.-In the Open Items table, select the target open item, and then choose Complete Bank Data.-The system gives error message: 'No payment format exists at bank XYZ to support bank check'.-You then try to make outgoing bank payment to the supplier from the same bank, then the system gives you another error message: 'No payment format exists at bank XYZ to support domestic bank transfer'.-In the bank account master data, you could see payment methods Bank check and Domestic bank transfer are maintained under Payment Method tab.  --Cause-Payment format is the electronic file format used to make payments from the bank. Your chosen payment formats define the allowed payment methods for your bank accounts and check lots. As you do not maintain payment formats for Bank Check and Domestic bank transfer, so the system gives the error messages.-Resolution-In order to successfully make outgoing check or bank payment from the bank account, follow the steps below:-First of all, go to the Business Configuration work center, and open the activity: "Outgoing Bank Transfers".-Select "Edit assignment of payment method details to your payment medium formats".-Check the Payment Formats for the payment methods: Domestic bank transfer and Bank check.-Go back to the Liquidity Management work center, and open the related bank master data.-Go to the Payment Formats tab, and Add Row.-Select the Payment Medium Format Code you get above, and save the master data. -You should be able to successfully make the outgoing check or bank payment from this bank account.-Keywords-Payment medium format, Bank Account, Domestic bank transfer, Outgoing Check

Title: Incorrect Unit of Measure Displayed in the Template
Content: Symptom-You are previewing a document PDF, however you notice that the Unit of Measure is incorrectly displayed. For example, instead of displaying the unit as "KG/Kilogram", the form shows "Mass/Weight"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For this document, we will use a Goods and Activity Confirmations as an example:-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go to Goods and Activity Confirmations View.-Search for required document.-Click on the Edit button.-Check the Actual Quantity of the Line Items.-They are maintained as KG.-Click Preview button > Preview.-Quantity is shown as Mass/Weight.-Cause-One of possible cause for this issue is that incorrect mapping of "QuantityTypeCodeName" for the Unit of Measure. The correct tagging should be the "QuantityMeasureUnitCodeName". If you check in the XML file, the QuantityMeasureUnitCodeName tag presents the abbreviations (kg), as expected.-Resolution-Ensure correct mapping by using this binding in Adobe LiveCycle Designer. If the field involves custom scripts, we recommend contacting your SAP Implementation Partner for guidance on rectifying any issues with your custom form, if necessary.-Keywords-Measure, Unit, Quantity, Wrong, Template

Title: Temporary Folder Occupies Increased Storage Size During Bot Execution
Content: Symptom-You have set up a bot as part of BPA/iRPA setup (for example, the Business Document Extraction from E-mails bot), however you notice that the temporary folder reaches a large storage size during the execution of the bot.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The storage space occupied during the bot execution depends on the amount of files collected. This, in turn, depends on the amount of rules set in the configuration file.-One factor that can increase the amount of files is the use of the condition "Like" for filtering in the configuration file, instead of "Equal". This causes more data to be considered, hence increasing the storage consumption.-Resolution-Please check the amount of records in the configuration file, and also try to use conditions "Equal" instead of "Like".

Title: Tax Country Determination is not Correct for a 'Sale of Service' From One EU (European Union) Country to Another EU Country
Content: Symptom-Tax country determination is not correct for a Sale of Service from one EU (European Union) country to another EU country.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Create a New Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Add the necessary details like Account, Sales Unit etc.-Click the View All button and go to the Items tab.-Add a service product ABC in the Items table (ABC represents the ID of the service product).-In this scenario the source or seller and ship-to countries DEF & GHI are member of the EU respectively (DEF represents the seller country & GHI represents the destination country).-Go to the Taxes subtab.-The tax country determined is for the source or seller country which is DEF.-However you expect the tax country determination to be based on the ship-to destination GHI.-Cause-Service taxability based on destination or at source is decided by using the master data of the service.-The service used in the sales order XYZ is not set up to be taxed at the destination and hence it is not taxable in the destination country GHI but at the source country DEF.-If the nothing is maintained in the Service Master Data, the Service is taxable at the source country by default. The system determines the Tax Country of the source Country according to the country maintained in the address data of the Sales Unit. If no address is maintained in the Sales Unit the system will use the country of the Seller.-This logic is designed as per the legal laws for the service taxability in the EU countries.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to make the service taxable in the destination country GHI:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Services view.-Show All Services and find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service product).-Edit the service product ABC.-Click the View All button.-Go to the Taxes tab.-Click the Add Row button to add the country GHI (GHI represents the destination EU country).-Save the changes.-Re-trigger the price calculation in the sales order and it will trigger tax re-calculation for the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ and click the View All button.-Go to the Pricing tab.-Under the table Total Pricing -> click the Update Pricing - Completely button.-The prices and tax will be updated as per the changes done in the service master data for the destination country GHI.-Keywords-Tax; Determination; Sales; Service; imposition; pays; UE; taxe-csg_q,####,###

Title: Public Write Access of Outgoing Cheque BO (BO: FOPXP_OUTCHQ)
Content: Symptom-You are requesting SAP to enable Public Write Access of standard BO Outgoing Cheque (BO: FOPXP_OUTCHQ) due to a software customization requirement which demands writing on the referred BO (usually to attend a business requirement).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The OutgoingCheque BO (BO: FOPXP_OUTCHQ) is created from PaymentOrder BO (FOPXP_PAYORD) and both BOs are closed for writing. There is no public write access for these BOs due to the underlying complexity and the placement of the BOs in the process-chain. The same behavior will remain in future SAP Business ByDesign releases.-An alternative might be using existing the following webservices:-Inbound Service Manage Cash Payments: which can be used to create payments, however, only with assignment to G/L Account.-Inbound Service Manage Cash Payments with Reference to Items: which allows to Manage Cash Payments with Reference to Items.-Keywords-FOPXP_OUTCHQ; OutgoingCheque; PaymentOrder; FOPXP_PAYORD; PSM; PSM Release; public write access; BO

Title: Unit of Measure Working day(s) is not Available for Selection Under Work Tab of Project Plan
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new project and unit of measurement Working day(s) is not available for selection under Work tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view and select the relevant Project.-Go to Project Plan and go to Work subtab.-Select Unit of work and choose drop down list.-Only 'hours' is visible.-Cause-The unit of measure Working day(s) is not available because it is blocked for usage.-Resolution-Unblock the unit of measure Working day(s), by following the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects.-Go to Fine Tune activity.-Select the activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select Create and Maintain Trading Units.-UoM Symbol wDay, which means Working day(s) is blocked for usage.-Keywords-Unit of Measure Working day(s); Working day(s); No unit of work "days" available in project

Title: Cannot Enhance Confirmation Journal Datasource (SCMCFJU01) with Extension field from Inbound Delivery.
Content: Symptom-You have a Business Requiement to enhancing standard datasource "Confirmation Journal" (SCMCFJU01) using SAP cloud application studio.-In this datasource there is information about outbound delivery ID and inbound delivery ID.-You will notice that you are unable to add extension field from Inbound  Delivery  to enhance report SCMCFJU01.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter and Inbound Deliveries view.-2. Select any Inbound Delivery in Not Started status-3. Start Adaptation mode and create an extension field in General tab-3. Select the newly created extension field and click on Further Usage-4. Go to Datasources and Reports tab-You will not see Confirmation Journal Datasource/Report-Cause-There are some list of datasources per context that are enabled for extension fields.-There will be no issue while adding extension field from outbound delivery, but from Inbound Delivery ,  Confirmation Journal (SCMCFJU01) datasource/report is missing.-The reason for it is in the case of Outbound delivery Confirmation Journal (SCMCFJU01) data source has been enabled for Outbound Delivery - General Information business context.-Whereas for Inbound Delivery Confirmation Journal (SCMCFJU01) data source has not enabled.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-Link to Helpcenter document:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2bca667a722d10148d35c044e770c405.html?version=2005-Keywords-Confirmation Journal (SCMCFJU01) datasource, Inbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, extension field, business context, further usage.

Title: Landed Cost Components are Not Visible under Prices and Cost tab in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Scoping question "Do you want to plan landed costs in purchase orders?" is enabled in the Business Configuration work center. However, upon creating a new Purchase Order, no Landed Cost Components are visible under the Prices and Cost tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Select Prices and Cost tab.-Select Add row.-"No items found" in Cost Component drop-down under Landed Cost Components.-Cause-No Landed Cost Components have been defined in the "Define Landed Cost Components" section under Common Tasks in the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to define Landed Cost Components:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work center.-Go to Define Landed Cost Components under common tasks.-Add a Landed Cost Component ID and Landed Cost Category using the Add Row option.-Maintain the required description for the Landed Cost Component ID.-Select Actions and set it to Activate.-Only Landed Cost Components with Active status are available for selection in a Purchase Order and Supplier Invoice.-Keywords-Landed cost component; Landed cost in purchase order; Prices and Cost tab in Purchase Order

Title: Duplicated Values of Reference Document Type Code Exist in Inbound Service QuerySiteLogisticsTaskIn
Content: Symptom-In the help documentation for Inbound Service Query Site Logistics Tasks, duplicated type code values for purchase order and sales order can be found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Service Explorer View.-Search for Inbound Service QuerySiteLogisticsTaskIn.-Open its documentation, you will note that code value 001 and 981 are for purchase order, similarly code value 114 and 556 are for Sales Order.-Cause- Resolution-Our development team find another link, where the same details are given-https://edigkim.wordpress.com/2021/07/15/sap-reference-document-type-codes/ -Since this is externally facing to the users, both the codes 001 and 981 for purchase order, and 114 and 556 for sales order, all of them should work without error.-See Also-https://edigkim.wordpress.com/2021/07/15/sap-reference-document-type-codes/ -https://api.sap.com/api/PSM_ISI_R_II_QUERY_SLT_IN/resource-Keywords-Reference Document, Type Code, QuerySiteLogisticsTaskIn, Purchase Order, Sales Order.

Title: After Releasing a Business Document the Output E-mail does not Arrive
Content: Symptom-After releasing a document set up with e-mail output, the receiver does not receive the e-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For this document, we will use a Customer Invoice as an example:-Open the workcenter Customer Invoicing.-Enter the Invoice Documents view.-Select the respective document.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Here you can see that the output status is shown as successful, however no e-mail is received.-Cause-The issue happens because either the email subject or the document name contains an unsupported character, not following the SAP Standard name conventions. Some examples of unsupported characters are:-\ / : * ? " < > |@ $ £ ~ #-Resolution-Please ensure that no unsupported characters are used in the subject or document name.-Keywords-unsupported characters, e-mail, e-mail subject, e-mail output, e-mail

Title: Not able to Cancel a Contract Line Item with the Same Date as the Start Date
Content: Symptom-You are not able to cancel a contract line item for which the Cancellation Effective On date is the same date as the as Contract Item Start date due to the following error message: Item XX: Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Contracts view.-Open contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the contract).-Go to the Items tab.-Select the line item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Go to the General sub tab.-Enter a Cancellation Received On date, a Cancellation Requested For date and a Cancellation Reason.-In the field Cancellation Effective On enter the same date as in the field Contract Item Start.-The following error occurs: Item XX: Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates.-Cause-The contract was migrated. In a migrated contract the Cancellation Effective On date cannot be the same date as the as Contract Item Start date.-In a manually created contract the contract item start date, the item end date and the cancellation effective date are saved in the backend in UTC time zone (taking into account the proper conversion from local time zone to UTC) . When a contract is migrated then we have to explicitly specify the timestamp as 00:00:00 therefore, the timestamp of the original contract is lost and is defaulted to 00:00:00 for a migrated contract. Now, when the user tries to cancel this contract then timestamp is taken into consideration according to the users settings.-For example: The Contract Item Start Date for a migrated contract is 09.10.1999 (the timestamp is saved as 09.10.1999 00:00:00 backend). If a user is using a different time zone than UTC, e.g. the time zone AUSNSW (UTC+10) and the  user enters the cancellation effective date as 09.10.1999, then in the backend this is stored as 08.10.1999 14:00:00 (respective to the UTC conversion) and therefore the cancellation effective date will be less than contract item start date.-Resolution-You can cancel the contract line item with a Cancellation Effective On date that is 1 day after the Contract Item Start date.-Keywords-effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates, effective cancellation date, cancel, contract, contract item start date, cancellation effective on, migrated contract

Title: Amount of External Payment Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The system is throwing an error that the amount of external payment is missing for a Sales Order and thus a process communication error was created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-You see the Process Communication Error icon.-In SRT_MONI you find the following process communication error:-Sender Party: SalesOrderProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: CustomerInvoiceProcessingRequestInvoicingIn-Error: Amount of external payment missing-Cause-The reason the system is showing this error is because the customer has selected External Payment as the payment method and the amount being passed is 0.0.-Example:-<ExternalPayment>-<Amount currencyCode=" ">0.0</Amount>-</ExternalPayment>-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please ask the customer to update the Sales Order document with an Amount via webservice.-See Also-Inbound Service ManageSalesOrderIn-Keywords-Amount of external payment missing, Amount, External Payment, Sales Order, Process Communication Error

Title: Blocked Service Centers Still Available in Service Orders
Content: Symptom-In a Service Order, you notice that you are still able to select a Service Center from the list even though the Service Center is Blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders Work Center.-Open the Service Order Processing View.-Open Service Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Service Order).-In the field "Location of Service Provision", use "Own Service Center".-Open the value help for the "Service Center" field.-You see that one or more Locations that are available in the list currently have their status as Blocked. -Cause-The list that the system fetches when using the value help of the Service Center field does not make a distinction between blocked and non-blocked sites when pulling information from the Business Object, which is why even blocked sites are shown.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Service Order, Site, Blocked, List, Blocked, Obsolete, Incorrect, Erroneous, Service Center

Title: How to extract Sales Order information for Customer Projects using Standard Report?
Content: Symptom-You are trying to get details of sales order associated with customer projects only using standard project related data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center or Project Management work center-Select Design reports view from Business Analytics work center or Reports list form project management work center-Select standard project report: "Customer Project Overview".-You are not able to filter for only customer projects with sales order information.-Cause-There is no such specific project data source that shows customer project information only. There are reports considering time confirmations and planned/actual work for the project tasks but those are not specific for customer projects.-Resolution-You can refer the standard financial report (Projects - Line Items) to get the Sales order information associated with each project.-It shows the line items for projects of all project types. For customer projects, the report also lists the line items of assigned sales order items. Here you can find the sales order assigned to the project line items.-Keywords-projects missing in standard report, Customer Project Overview report, customer project with sales order integration

Title: How To Edit G/L Account Description
Content: Symptom-How do you edit the existing description in a G/L account XYZ (XYZ- represents G/L account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Navigate Overview View.-Under the Show filter select the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click the button Change Immediately after which a new window will open up.-Select the link Edit chart of accounts.-Highlight the Chart of Accounts XXX(XXX- represents chart of accounts) and the select the G/L account XYZ(XYZ- represents G/L account)-Enter to desired details in the description field and click Save.-This change will be reflected in the General Ledger account view under the General ledger workcenter and the updated description will appear in all the Financial reports for this G/L account.-Keywords-G/L Account, Description, Edit,

Title: Cust Dev Reserve Fields in Payment Structure Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You are creating a custom payment file structure and noticed that the CUST DEV RESERVE data sources are available and wonder how to customize them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Find and open activiyt Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Click Edit payment file structures.-Edit the relevant custom structure.-Navigate to the third step (Define Fields).-Open the dropdown in the Data Source column.-You'll see the CUST DEV RESERVE at the end of the list.-Resolution-The CUST DEV RESERVE data sources in payment file structure are reserved data sources for custom logic developed via PDI. You need to create a custom add-on (or use an existing one) with an enhancement implementation for DMEE mapping.-Keywords-Payment Order. Payment Medium Format. Payment File. Outbound File. Payment Structure. Bank Transfer.

Title: Error Message While Trying to Post a Time Entry via SOAP Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Time Entry for the ManageEmployeeTimeIn SOAP web service, however, system is returning the error message below:-"Authorization role missing for service "ServiceInterface http://sap.com/xi/AP/TimeAndLabourManagement/Global ManageEmployeeTimeIn <default> <default>", operation "Operation http://sap.com/xi/AP/TimeAndLabourManagement/Global MaintainBundle" (UTC timestamp YYYYMMDD; Transaction ID X" (where X represents the transaction ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Communication arrangements View.-Search for the related arrangement.-Download the WSDL file for service interface https://myxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/bc/srt/scs/sap/manageemployeetimein-Open a SOAP Client and open the WSDL request.-Paste the payload with the user credentials.-Execute the request and you will receive the error message.-Cause-The web service "MaintainBundle" is specifically designed for excel uploads. Therefore it is not allowed to be used by technical users.-Resolution-Currently, it is the expected system behavior. Please use the web services named as MaintainActualEmployeeTimeBundle and MaintainEmployeeTimeAsBundle.-See Also-2396225 - Employee Time Status Remains Inactive for the Time Recording Imported through Web Services -Keywords-Post, Time Entry, SOAP, Web Service, ManageEmployeeTimeIn, MaintainBundle, Authorization role missing, ServiceInterface, TimeAndLabourManagement, ManageEmployeeTimeIn.

Title: Cannot Post Supplier Invoice due to Error Message: Error while converting <Currency A> to <Currency B>; Contact technical support
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a supplier invoice due to the error message: Error while converting <Currency A> to <Currency B>; Contact technical support. However no currency conversion should take place as both your Company and your Supplier have the same currency in use.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order link in Common Tasks.-Fill in all the mandatory details.-Select Cost Distribution sub tab in the Items tab and select Accounting Type as Cost Center.-Select the cost center given using the value help.-Select the button Post.-You get the above mentioned error message.-Cause-The two reasons for this behavior of the supplier invoicing application are:-There are no currency rates maintained for the currency conversion.-The approval currency maintained in the fine-tune activity Supplier Invoice Approvals differs from the currency in the supplier invoice.-Resolution-Maintain the Currency Exchange Rates as follows:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select the link Edit Exchange Rates under Common Tasks.-Select the button Maintain Exchange Rates.-By Default the approval currency for supplier invoice should be the one of your residence in the fine-tuning activity Supplier Invoice Approvals.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the Open Activity List  button.-Select Fine tune wizard and select Supplier Invoice Approvals.   -Check the currency maintained here. -Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Curremcy Conversion, Exchange Rate, Currency Exchange, Supplier Invoice Approvals

Title: No Data Shown in Financial Data Source Preview
Content: Symptom-You are doing a preview of a Financial Data Source and receive an info message:-'No report data available to display; check the selection'-along with an empty result list.-However, when you run reports on the same data source you are well able to retrieve data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Find a Financial Data Source, for example: G/L Account Period Totals / Balances.-Hit Preview button.-You'll receive above info message. But reports on that data source (for example: Trial Balance) show data as expected.-Cause-It is not unusual and not incorrect when a Financial data source does not display any data in preview mode. The reason is that many Financial reports have mandatory selection parameters on purpose because of interdependencies between such parameters. Due to these interdependencies a report could logically not produce any meaningful data. For example, report Trial Balance requires parameters Company, Set of Books and Accounting Period/Year before it can be executed. As the data source preview does not support such parameter entry the report output is empty.-Resolution-This is not a technical issue. Please make use of reports based on the respective data source to view system data.-Keywords-financial data source, no data, no results, business analytics, financial reporting, missing-financial data source,no report data

Title: Troubleshooting PDI UI Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In this Knowledge Based Article, we will look at known issues regarding the PDI UI topic, and how we can troubleshoot PDI UI issues.-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“  -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-Steps to open UI component in UI / filepath of UI component in Solution.-Accessing the UI Designer:-Open the Cloud Applications Studio (SDK).-Open the affected solution.-Open the affected UI screen.-Accessing the UI Designer without opening the SDK:-Insert the C4C or ByD tenant URL in the Edge browser.-Replace everything after the ".com" with /sap/public/ap/ui/xrep/VIRTUAL/SAP_BYD_UI_DT/UIDesigner.application?startComponent=HTTP/1.1 -Hit enter to start UI Designer.-In the login screen, put the tenant URL (with "https://") in the System field and 433 in the Port field.-Enter Client number from CAM tool (for example, 000) or it can be left empty.-Log in with the username and password.-Select Ok and the UI Designer will open.-OR-If you have SDK installed, navigate to where it is installed on your machine and open the file UIDesigner.exe, for example: C:\Program Files (x86)\SAP\SAP Cloud Applications Studio 2XXX\Extensions\Application\UIDesigner.exe -Do steps 4-7 as above.-UI Designer training from a public SAP JAM group: https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/AjpMgLOC6SsT0XLc0CzMUs/content?folder_id=jqPr4a3TuWBcHEjf4zcanE -UI Designer explained: https://blogs.sap.com/2020/03/05/ui-designer-of-the-sap-cloud-application-studio/-General: 2396197 - FAQ’s on UI Designer Issues -Data Controller tab:-Inports and Outports are used to allow one UI component to interact with another UI component. For example, you have a source component (i.e. a Quick Create) and a target component (i.e. a Thing Inspector).-Source components must have an outport maintained, in order to send information that was added to the QC to the TI, and in order to actually open that TI.-Target components need an inport to inport the data from the previous UI component.-If the partner says no data, or the wrong data, is being passed from one UI component to another UI component:-Check the configurations for the Inport / Outport.-Does the Source have an Outport, and the Target have an Inport? -> if these aren't configured (especially for mashup UIs), return the incident to the partner.-Has the partner maintained parameters? Do they make sense, will they pass the desired information? -If you do not see parameter configurations in the Inport / Outport, then check the PortTypePackage (PTP).-PortTypePackage (PTP) is a blueprint for an Inport or Outport. (Inports and Outports that have the same PTP can be plugged together without any extra mapping efforts). Here you can maintain the parameters.-There are two types of inports: Object Based Navigation (OBN) or Normal Inport. -There is one type of outport: Normal Outport.-There are two types of parameters for Inports and Outports: -List parameter is used when a list of values need to be passed.-Normal parameter is used when a single value needs to be passed.-Event Handlers respond to user actions on the UI screen. To create an event, you can use one of the following methods.-Create the user interface control, for example, a button, and then create an event handler.-Create the event handlers first and then associate the event handler to the required user interface control.-If the partner expects a specific event to occur when the user does a specific action on the UI, then check the configurations of the Event Handler in the UI Designer. -Also, check if there is any custom code involved to carry out the desired functionality as the configurations may be correct in the UI Designer, but their custom code is incorrect.-Relevant for Work Protocol is a popular event handler for the Save and Close, or Close option. . If true it forces a pop-up on the screen (e.g. "do you want to save your work?") If this is set to false, that is when you wont see the pop-up but you will see "your changes have been saved" at the end of the screen.-Message Mapping is used to map a message in order to change the terminology appearing on the UI or to change their behaviour on the UI.-Message mapping in the UI designer is only available for BOs that contain messages.-If useUIController is false for a UI, you will not be able to configure MessageMapping and the Message Mapping folder will not be visible.-If useUIController is false for a UI, the partner cannot create and configure a SADL query.-You have the following options:-Replace (the original message is replaced by the new message).-Ignore (the original message will be ignored, and will not display at runtime).-Original (the original message is displayed at runtime by the system).-Aggregate (the original message is replaced, and multiple messages can be combined into one new message).-If a partner is having an issue with a custom message, check the UI Designer configurations if you cannot see any issue in their code.-Field Transformations is the folder where you can check UI Switches, and depending on scoping, certain fields can be displayed / hidden.-Dedicated Fields (fields that are dynamically filled) can be seen here also. -Dedicated Fields come from the Ruby Script (Ruby Script is converted to JavaScript at runtime, and is stored as XML in XREP.) i.e. isDedicatedField is set to true, means that Ruby Script code was created to make a condition for this field.-Most Dedicated Fields are dynamically calculated in a CIP class -> calculation is not stored in the database i.e. no persistency in the BO, it is serialized from the CIP class to the client during runtime.-Queries can be created and configured here. If there are issues with the query:-Check the configurations in the UI Designer.-You need to identify what type of Query this is: SADL (Service Adaptation Definition Language) or Model query. (Partners only have the option to make these two. In standard we also have ALV).-If the issue is with a Value Help (OVS), then the query can only be a SADL or Model query.-If the customer states their field is not behaving as expected in a query, (especially for custom fields on standard screens) check that the List binding matches the rest of the fields.-Check in SESFTS to see what results are being returned for this query in the backend. 2571142 - How to Use The Backend Transaction SESFTS-Do a JSON Response, and see what the table number being returned is (will show the same value as in SESFTS).-If only a certain amount of records are displaying on a UI at a time, check if Delta Serialization is enabled in Properties. -SADL: -SADL queries fetch data from the database directly, and it has a result list.-When a SADL query is executed, it executes the method "Call_Fetch" in the class CL_OBERON_RT_FETCH_BO_NODE. (Always put the breakpoint in the fetch method).-During debugging of the above class, if no data is found here or if no issue is found here, then the issue is not caused by the SADL class.-The SADL class is the last of the Oberon classes which means your issue is not caused by the UI team. Please continue debugging, and check the Call Stack to see what class is responsible for the issue.-Model:-Model queries are directly bound to a BO (i.e. QueryByElements). Instance binding must be the same as the query binding for it to work.-  Extensibility Explorer: -If the partner wants to make changes or add items to a standard screen, they need to use the Extensibility Explorer.-If a partner cannot add a mashup / button / configuration to the standard UI screen, it means there is no anchor for this section of the UI.-Such incidents need to be routed to the Application support team who are responsible for this UI screen.-An anchor holds a custom change to a screen.
