Title: Approval of Credit Memos in Supplier Relationship Management
Content: Symptom-The approval process for Credit Memos needs to be configured, for example, to disable approval for Credit Memos.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Select Advance filter.-Credit Memos is not available for selection in the dropdown list.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, Credit Memos and Supplier Invoices share the same business object.-As a result, the approval rules defined for Supplier Invoices automatically apply to Credit Memos and cannot be configured independently.-Resolution-Configure the Supplier Invoice approval process with the parameters required for Credit Memo approval, as the same approval settings apply to both document types and cannot be maintained separately.-Keywords-Approval Process, Credit Memo; Not Available; Selection; Disable Approval

Title: VAT is Levied for Buyer and Supplier Companies in Sweden
Content: Symptom-For intercompany scenario in Sweden, taxes are charged for charge-to companies. This is a legal requirement. But in the current SAP Business ByDesign system, for intercompany scenario, taxes are not levied within the intercompany.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisite-You have maintained an entry in Enable Companies under Intercompany Supplier Invoice section. To view the entry you can navigate to Business Configuration work center -> Implementation Project -> Open Activity List -> Fine-Tune-> Direct Posting to Partner Companies -> Intercompany Supplier Invoice section -> Enable Companies.-Steps-Navigate to General Ledger work center and select Master Data.-Check if two set of books are assigned to the parent company and charge-to company.-Navigate to Supplier Invoicing work center and select Invoice Entry.-Choose New Invoice.-Create invoice with parent company as Supplier.-Enter charge-to company in the Bill-To field.-Post the invoice.-Navigate to General Ledger work center and select Journal Entries.-Enter the Source Document ID in search tab to view the journal entries.-Result-Tax lines are available for journal entry of parent company, but not for the journal entry of charge-to company.-Cause-This is a standard solution that no taxes are charged to the charge-to companies. But for Sweden, tax should be charged to charge-to company as per the new legal requirement. For more information please refer to https://www.skatteverket.se/omoss/varverksamhet/rapporterremissvarochskrivelser/skrivelser/arkiv/ar/2002/2002/skrivelser20021108.4.18e1b10334ebe8bc80005731.html?q=vidarefakturering+inom+koncernen .-Resolution-Customer should not use intercompany functionality but must create an additional customer invoice.-See Also-Additional Information-Sweden Intercompany Account Posting - An Example-Step 1: Parent company receives invoice-  Debit-Credit-A/P-  125,00-Cost from purchasing-50,00-  VAT-25,00-  Claims on charge-to company-50,00-  Step 2: Parent company charging charge-to company (Create a customer invoice for charge-to company)-  Debit-Credit-A/R-62,50-  Claims on charge-to company-  50,00-VAT-  12,50-Step 3: Charge-to company receives an invoice from the parent company-  Debit-Credit-A/P-  62,50-Cost from purchasing-50,00-  VAT-12,50-  Keywords-VAT, Supplier Companies, Sweden, Invoice Entry, Supplier Invoice, Intercompany,

Title: Debug the Message Occurred During Execution of a Standard Business Scenario
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You Execute a standard business scenario e.g. Payment posting or releasing an invoice and encounter an error message (Warning or Error or Information) and want to know the logic stack from which this is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Login to backend.-Open SE24 T-code(Class builder).-Enter Class CM_ESI_T100 and hit 'Display'(F7).-Double click on 'CONSTRUCTOR' Method(Constructor is a method within class which is trigged for the 1st time when a class is executed followed by other methods).-Click on the line 'CALL METHOD SUPER->CONSTRUCTOR' and hit External Breakpoint .-Now execute the scenario in the UI where you encountered message earlier. This will trigger the debugging screen from backend and click on 'Desktop 2' within debugger.-This will show the Call Stack and from here you can all the code logics involved till it reached the message. In case of any PDI is involved, any program start with Y* is shown.-Keywords-Debug, SE24, Class Builder, Message Class

Title: Form Template Wrongly Picked in Output Channel
Content: Symptom-You are working with SAP Business ByDesign PDFs, and noticed that the system is taking the wrong Form Template when generating the PDF for a Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There might be several causes behind this behavior, this article will help you to troubleshoot this scenario properly and it also shows possible causes for the issue.-Scenario 1:-When configuring form template determination, there may be a conflict between the Form Template Selection ruleset and the Business Document Settings for the involved Account/Supplier.-When there is a rule for a specific Account/Supplier in Form Template Selection, and also a rule inside the Business Document Settings for the same document, the rule inside the business partner takes priority.-To check the ruleset of the Form Template Selection, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center -> Form Template Selection view.-From the dropdown, select the affected Document.-Click Go.-Here you can see the rules maintained for the document, and search the one relevant for the Account/Supplier.-To check the business partner Business Document Settings, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Enter the Accounts view.-Search and open the affected Account.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Communication tab and then Collaboration subtab.-Under Business Document Settings, select the document.-In the panel below, you can check if there is a rule for Form Selection.-In order to test if the Form Template Selection rules are the ones being applied , you can create a default rule and maintain it in the top of the rules. If the document then picks the form template set in this default rule, then there should be no Account/Supplier specific rules.-This test works based on the principle that the Rules work hierarchically, from top to bottom. So if a generic rule is set up and is applied to the document, then it is the Form Template Selection rules which are taking place in the determination for this specific document.-Scenario 2:-When you preview a Sales Order, system picks a wrong Form Template instead of what is assigned in the Form Template Selection.-There may be some causes for this behavior:-The Form Template selection is done based on Sales Organization and not on Sales Unit. If you assigned the Sales Unit instead of Sales Organization in the Form Template Selection then it will result in this issue.-Customer maintained a different Form Template in the Account Master Data: Edit any Account and click View all. Navigate to the communication tab sub tab collaborations. Here you can maintain a template of your desire for the respective document and it will overrule the form template rules.-Scenario 3:-When you are previewing a business document, the Wrong Form Template or no Form Template is picked.-There are some cases that result in this behavior:-Case 1:-When you open the document in the Output History, the preview is in Form Template XYZ but when you preview the same document, the preview is in Form Template ABC.-The cause for the issue could be, after you submitted the document there might be a change in the Form Template or the Rule to pick the form template. In this case, the preview will always picks the form which suffices the current rule.-Case 2:-You might have maintained the rule for the Form Template (Form Template Selection) in such a way that, for a particular Org Unit (Ex: sales unit), this Form Template should be picked and for other Org Units different Form template.-Check the Rule for the Form Template in Form Template Selection view (Application and User Management work center) and correct the rule if applicable.-Note: You can manually change the template via Edit Output Settings but that would only be applicable for that document only, if you again check the Preview or Sends Confirmation to Account then it will pick the template based on the Form template rule defined.-Case 3:-You have maintained an empty Rule (without any parameter checked) in Form Template Selection. In this case, this Template will be picked always despite any rule that set below this Template rule.-Case 4:-The Form Template is picked based on the Tax Country maintained in the document. So, check the Tax Country maintained in the document and if required create a new Form template if there is no Form template for that particular country variant.-In principle, The Form Template is picked in the document preview based on the Country Variant and Language, and the country variant is based on the Tax Country.-Scenario 4:-A different form template than the one you expect gets picked. Your expectation is based on a UI change performed for example on sales quotes.-A possible cause is, you might used the Apply button when changing the Org Unit in the Edit Output Settings.-The expectation is that the template is still changing based on the i.e. Sales Org. change as before the customer hit the "Apply" button.-After hitting the apply button no further template validation happens therefore the last template before hitting apply will always be shown.-See Also-3015430 - Wrong Form template is Picked-2004941 - Preview of a Sales Order is Picking Wrong Form Template-1952277 - Wrong Form Template or no Form Template is Picked While Previewing Any Business Document-1938117 - Wrong Form Template is Picked for Previewing a Business Document-3064026 - Different Form Template is expected in the form preview-Keywords-Form Template, is, Wrong, Wrongly, Picked, Output, Settings.

Title: 'No records found' Message While Previewing Dunning Letter
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an information message while previewing Dunning Letter: No records found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Select a Dunning ID with In Preparation status.-Click Preview button and select Dunning Letter.-There is an information message: No records found.-Cause-The reason is due to below settings missing in the system:-1) No Dunning Letter/Reminder Letter form templates maintained for the country.-2) Output Channel for Dunning Letter defined as Printer/Email.-Resolution-You have to create a new Form Template for the country of the referred Customer Account, by following the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance subview.-Select any existing form template Dunning Letter.-Select Copy and choose As New Variant.-Select country and language.-Click OK.-Click Publish.-Go to the Application and User Management Workcenter.-Go to Input and Output Management > Output Channel Selection view.-Select Show Rules For: Dunning Letter.-Click on New and maintain the output channel to Printer/E-mail.-After the above steps you will be able to preview the dunning letter.-Keywords-Preview dunning id, dunning id, dunning run

Title: Error: File exists already in solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-While trying to activate a PDI file (for example, .csd) on SAP Cloud Applications Studio, the below errors are raised:-Failed to create or update one or more BC sets of solution YABCDEFGY_.-Exception raised from XRepository-File /YABCDEFGY_BC_GEN/YABCDEFGY_CPG_7718C77EFB840A.BCBS exists already in solution YABCDEFGY_BC_GEN branch $DEFAULT.-Error creating BCsets for/YABCDEFGY_MAIN/SRC/ExternalWebServiceIntegration.csd-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-Go to XREP on dev layer-Locate and double click on the file /YABCDEFGY_BC_GEN/YABCDEFGY_CPG_7718C77EFB840A.BCBS (as shown on the error)-Click on Logical Delete button-Activate the file on XREP-Now go to SE38 > PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP-Provide below parameters:-xREP file path                    /YABCDEFGY_MAIN/SRC/ExternalWebServiceIntegration.csd (as shown on the error)-Content type                      CSD (this may vary depending on the file path type)-Scope (Item,Solution)             I-Mode (Dev,Install)                D-Execute -Keywords-PDI, SDK, failed, to, create, or, update, one, more, BC, sets, solution, file, exists, already, error, creating, BCsets, csd

Title: How to Delete a Depreciation Run with Status as Scheduled
Content: Symptom-You created a Depreciation Run ID ABC (ABC represents the depreciation run ID). During the run a system failure/ dump occurred after which the status of the run remained Scheduled.-You were able to successfully complete a new depreciation run later for the same period and company.-You want to delete the Depreciation run ID ABC with status as "Scheduled".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Depreciation subview in the Periodic Tasks view.-Search for Run ID ABC and select it.-The status is Scheduled.-The Run is for Company XYZ (XYZ is the company ID).-Click View Jobs.-The status is Completed.-Next Start Date/Time is DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM.-Under Change History: Planned Start Date/Time is DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM.-There is no option to delete the run.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Background Jobs subview.-Under All Scheduled Jobs, search for Run ID ABC.-The status is Completed.-Resolution-If the run is not planned as recurring, you can ignore the same. It will have no effect on depreciation.-Jobs which ended abruptly due to system errors are usually cleared by automatic checks performed by the system weekly or biweekly.-Keywords-Abschreibung, Eingeplant, scheduled

Title: System Didn't Post Journal Entry for Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-A Supplier Invoice was created and no Journal Entry was posted, however the Invoice Status is Posted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find Invoice ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Invoice ID).-Click View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-No Journal Entry exists for the Invoice.-Cause-This is the expected behavior since the Invoice is a zero value Invoice. The System will not create a Journal Entry.-An accounting notification is created from SRM that will notify accounting that this posting has taken place.-You can see this with below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show Finished Source Documents.-Find Invoice ID XYZ.-Click Actions - View Business Transaction.-This is the Accounting Notification. However, because there was zero value, there was no need to create a Journal Entry because there was no effect on the Subledgers.-Resolution-System works as expected.-Keywords-Journal Entry, Supplier Invoice, No Journal Entry, No Entry, Finished, Zero Amount, Zero Value

Title: Configure Output Channel for Dunning Letter per Company
Content: Symptom-When configuring the output channel determination rule for Dunning Letter, you want the system to determine the output channel per company, but it seems that the system doesn't offer this option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center, and choose the Input and Output Management view.-Select the Output Channel Selection subview.-Set Show Rules For as Dunning Letter.-Choose New to open the Create Output Channel Rule page.-You can see that under Parameter Settings, there is only Dunning Strategy.-Resolution-In order to set the system to determine Dunning Letter Output Channel based on company, follow the steps below:- First of all, create a specific Dunning Strategy, and assign it to a company.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select your project and click on Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune phase and open Dunning Strategies activity.-Choose Edit Dunning Strategies.-Choose Add Row to create a new dunning strategy, and then choose Save and Close.-After that, choose Assign Dunning Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier.-Assign the dunning strategy just created to the desired company.-After that, maintain output channel per dunning strategy.-Go to the Application and User Management work center, and choose the Input and Output Management view.-Select the Output Channel Selection subview.-Set Show Rules For as Dunning Letter.-Choose New to open the Create Output Channel Rule page.-Specify the Output Channel,and select the dunning strategy just created from the Dunning Strategy drop-down list.-In this way, you manage to assign Output Channel per Company, though indirectly.-Keywords-Dunning Letter, Per Company,

Title: Unable to find the Assessable Value in SDK
Content: Symptom-There might be a Business Requirement to generate an E-Way bill without generating an IRN for Stock Transfer without going for Legal Approval.-For this requirement, it is required to pass the Assessable Value for the respective product.--In the SDK, it shows the Assessable value, but when you use the item node in the script file you will be unable to get the assessable value. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-N/A-Cause-The Assessable Value field in Outbound delivery gets updated when we go for Legal Approval (when JSON file is created). -Since your requirement is to get Assessable Value without going for Legal Approval based on Ship from Location.-  As checked, APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY --> ITEM --> GLO_IN_MATL_ASSES_PRICE is not PSM released, -but the value is filled only when the Legal Approval is done.-  Resolution-The valuation price can be fetched from-BO: FIA_MATERIAL_VALU_DATA-Node: VALUATION_PRICE-Element: GLO_IN_MATL_ASSES_PRICE-Here the element GLO_IN_MATL_ASSES_PRICE is PSM read released. -Also, the QUERY_BY_DATE_INTERVAL and QUERY_BY_DATE on VALUATION_PRICE node is PSM read released.-Therefore you can use the query based on Product ID, Valuation Type Code and Permanent Business Residence (can be evaluated from Ship-from Location).-Value can be fetched from Business Object FIA_MATERIAL_VALU_DATA --> VALUATION_LEVEL - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS --> Navigate to VALUATION_PRICE based on Product ID, Valuation Type Code and Permanent Business Residence (can be evaluated from Ship-from Location). -Keywords-Assessable Value, Outbound delivery, Legal Approval, APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY, GLO_IN_MATL_ASSES_PRICE,FIA_MATERIAL_VALU_DATA, VALUATION_PRICE, GLO_IN_MATL_ASSES_PRICE, VALUATION_PRICE ,VALUATION_LEVEL

Title: Invoice Schedule Item Invoice Date Field Not Populated in Report Contracts with Invoice Schedules For a Specific User
Content: Symptom-When using the "Contracts with Invoice Schedules" report, you notice that one or more users cannot see any values in the field "Invoice Schedule Item Invoice Date".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logged in as the affected user, follow these steps:-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Open the Reports View.-Find the Report: Contracts with Invoice Schedules.-Open the Report.-Run the Report.-You notice that the field "Contracts with Invoice Schedules" is not showing any values.-When running this report as another user with different authorizations, the data is then fetched correctly for this field.-Cause-In order for the data in field "Invoice Schedule Item Invoice Date" to be displayed, the user running the report needs to have unrestricted access to Work Center CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES in their Access Rights.-Resolution-These are the steps that need to be followed to assign unrestricted access to work center CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES for the user: -Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Open the Business Users View.-Find user ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the affected user).-Click on Edit and then Access Rights.-Navigate to the Access Restrictions tab-Find Work Center View ID CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES-Change the Read Access to Unrestricted.-Save and Close.-Keywords-Report, Access Rights, Restricted, Write, Read, View, Unable, Blank, Empty, Value, Field

Title: How To Open the UI Designer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to open the UI Designer-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“  -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-Insert the C4C or ByD tenant URL in the Edge browser.-Replace everything after the ".com" with /sap/public/ap/ui/xrep/VIRTUAL/SAP_BYD_UI_DT/UIDesigner.application?startComponent=HTTP/1.1-Hit enter to start UI Designer.-In the login screen, put the tenant URL (with "https://") in the System field and 433 in the Port field.-Enter Client number from CAM tool (for example, 000) or it can be left empty.-Log in with the username and password.-Select Ok and the UI Designer will open.-OR-If you have SDK installed, navigate to where it is installed on your machine and open the file UIDesigner.exe, for example: C:\Program Files (x86)\SAP\SAP Cloud Applications Studio 2XXX\Extensions\Application\UIDesigner.exe-Do steps 4-7 as above.-See Also-KBA 2396197 - FAQ’s on UI Designer Issues-KBA 2936686 - Error: "Application cannot be started. Contact the application vendor." while trying to launch the UI Designer-Keywords-UI, Designer, Run, PDI, SDK

Title: Which type of data is copied into Copy Solution Profile Request for SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-A solution profile is a collection of scoping decisions and business configuration settings for the SAP solution throughout its entire life cycle. With this function, you can copy your existing solution profile from one tenant to another tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Copy Solution Profile option in the Service Control Center (SCC) allows you to copy a solution profile from a source system to a target system. -The copy of the solution profile includes scoping and fine tuning only.-You can only select a test tenant as the target tenant. -No copy or refresh of data is possible, so the data in the target tenant remains the same. -The SAP Cloud Applications Studio solution must be of the same version in the source and target tenants, or there must be no SAP Cloud Applications Studio solution deployed in either tenant.-Keywords-Copy Solution Profile, Service Control Center, Data, ByD.

Title: E-mail and Fax Settings Activity Throws an Error When Trying to Send Test E-mail
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Change Project and are trying to send a test e-mail through activity E-mail and Fax Settings, but you are receiving errors.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access Implementation Projects view.-Select your new change project and click Open Activity List button.-In the Fine-Tuning phase, search for the activity E-mail and Fax Settings.-Open the activity and click option "Send Test E-mail".-See the error messages.-Cause-You cannot access this activity due to one of the following reasons:-Cause 1: You have decided to run your change project without a test system.-Cause 2: You have requested a runtime system, but the system is not yet available.-Cause 3: The activity E-mail and Fax Settings -> Send Test E-mail is not a configuration element, but a test activity and it cannot be performed unless the changes in the change project are merged with production. You can only use this activity after the changes in the scoping/fine-tuning are merged.-Resolution-Resolution for cause 1: Close this activity to continue your change project without test system. The activity will be automatically reopened after the merge and must be completed in your production system.-Resolution for case 2: To request a test system, go to the Implementation Projects view in the Business Configuration work center. Select your project, click Actions and Request System.-Note: This applies to all activities that have to be repeated (see the Repetition Required column)-Resolution for cause 3: You have to close the change project in order to be able to use this activity.-Keywords-Test, E-mail, Fax

Title: Expense Report without posting date
Content: Symptom-For the users that can just create an expense report over the Work Center Home, the field Posting Date is not appearing for the expense reports type: Business Trip or Out of Pocket Expenses, for example.-For the users that also have access to the Travel and Expense Work Center the field Posting Date is present.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Home work center.-2. Go to Self-Services view.-3. Go to Self-Services Overview subview.-4. In session Expenses.-5. Click New Expense Report.-6. Include a Type of Expense Report.-7. Screen will load details, but in the top of the right side of the screen the session Posting Information, the field Posting Date is not appearing.-Cause-The system is designed in this way that only the auditor is able to see and edit the Posting date.-By definition the person assigned to the Travel and Expense Work Center is considered an Auditor.-By default the posting date is calculated as the creation date of the Expense Report irrespective of the type of Expense Report.-The auditor has the rights to change the posting dates according to the needs.-Exception:-If the expense report dates are in the past, the expense report end date is used as the default posting date (in case of an out-of-pocket expense report it is the last expense date out of the entered receipts). This is correct because the posting dates describe the date when the costs occurred.-If the expense report dates are in the future, the expense report end date cannot be used, because posting dates in the future are not allowed in the Financial Accounting. So the creation date is used.-In both cases the auditor is able to adapt the posting date according to his need.-Resolution-System is working as desired.-Keywords-expense report; posting date

Title: How to Mass Update Material Valuation
Content: Symptom-Unable to find option to add Material Valuation for existing Materials using Migration tool for Materials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is expected system behavior. Migration tool for Material Valuation and Mass data Maintenance for Material do not provide option to enhance the data.-The data could be uploaded only as a one time activity. The same can't be enhanced later with Migration tool.-Resolution-Use below options to enhance the material valuation data:-Option A)-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Material Unit Costs view.-Select the button Import Unit Costs.-Now select the option From Microsoft Excel and import.-Option B) Web Service ManageMaterialValuationDataIn can also used to enhance this.-Keywords-Inventory Valuation; Inventory Valuation mass update; Mass Update

Title: Is it Possible to Reset Milestone Design Accepted Status?
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reset the status of Milestone: Design Accepted from status Accepted to Open.-But there is no option avaiable in Business Configuration workcenter to change this status.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center.- Select Implementation Projects view.- Select Open Activity List button.- Select Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted activity.-The status Design Accepted is greyed out.-Cause-This is an expected system behavior.-Resolution-Once you have created and accepted the Milestone Design, it is not possible to set the status to open again.-The Milestone Design accepted is irreversible.-Additional Information: Out of the four different Milestones available in the Business Configuration workcenter, following are their system behavior:-Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted - Cannot be reverted. The status cannot be changed from Accepted to Open.-Confirm Milestone: Solution Accepted - Can be reset. The status can be changed from Accepted to Open.-Confirm Milestone: Go-Live Readiness Acceptance - Can be reset. The status can be changed from Accepted to Open.-Go-Live Activity - Cannot be reverted. The status cannot be changed from Accepted to Open.-Keywords-Business Configuration, Milestone, Design

Title: Error: "VALIDITY_PERIOD-END_DATE is Read Only" When Hiring an Employee Through Web Service managepersonnelhiringin or via Migration of Employee Data
Content: Symptom-When hiring an employee through Web Service managepersonnelhiringin in SOAP UI or via Migration of Employee Data, you are getting the below error:-Error Message: <Note>VALIDITY_PERIOD-END_DATE is read only</Note>-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If you are using Web Service:-Cause: You are trying to set a Leaving Date while you are hiring a Permanent employee using the below parameter-<LeavingDate>XXXX-YY-ZZ</LeavingDate>-If you are using Migration:-Cause: It is not allowed to specify the Termination Date for an employee whose Work Agreement Type is Permanent.-Resolution-If you are using Web Service:-Solution: You need to either remove the leaving date or set the TypeCode to 2, Which is under the <WorkAgreement> parameter.-If you are using Migration:-Solution: Specify the Termination Date for such Employees as Unlimited. If you wish to terminate the employee, that can be done from the Personnel Administration work center's Terminate Relationship with Employee regular task.-Keywords-Managepersonnelhiringin, Web Service, Employee Hire, VALIDITY_PERIOD-END_DATE, Migration, Employee-validity_period,validity_period-end_date,termination date

Title: Process Communication Error in the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Process communication error in the Purchase orders and Purchase order Acknowledgment-Error – Product Category Missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Data Consistency view.-Select Process Communication Errors view.-Sending Document is blank.-Receiving Document is Purchase Order & Purchase Order Acknowledgment.-Related error - Unplanned items in purchase order confirmation.( you may see other errors also along with warnings)-            Note:-            Sender Party - Blank-            Receiver Interface Name - PurchaseOrderProcessingOrderingIn-            Error - Product category missing.-Cause-One of the below following reasons leads to process communication error;-At the time of Purchase Order acknowledgement;-One of the Product/Services appearing in PO acknowledgment does not exist in the Purchase order .-The Supplier part number does not exist in Material master-Purchase Order's Supplier and Supplier maintained in the Supplier Part Number tab of Material master does not match or differs.-Resolution-Delete the Purchase order acknowledgement then follow below-Make sure Product/Services and Supplier Part Number should be available at the time of Purchase Order Acknowledgement creation that happens when you select 'Send confirmation to Account' from  Service order.- To check the acknowledgment XML payload and to understand the differences in details compared to Purchase order follow below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business communication monitoring view-Enter PO acknowledgment ID in the document ID column or filter using creation time that you see under ' steps to reproduce' mentioned above.-Select the entry and clickon download and choose SAA ESD-Copy and paste the XML on to note pad or word doc on your computer-Compare the XML details with the Purchase order details(we can have deviations in price, quantity and delivery date)-Also make sure that purchase order supplier and Supplier in Supplier Part Number tab under Purchasing matches.-Mention findings and differences you found with Supplier and ask them to send the new PO acknowledgment with correct details.-Keywords-red mark in PO, PCe error in PO, red mark in PO ac

Title: Planned Cost with 0 Value in Project Plan Value
Content: Symptom- When looking at the Project Plan Value of a specific Project, the Plan Cost shows 0 in Materials tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue--1--Work CenterProject Management.-Projects View.-Search, Open and View All the Project ABC.-Under Project Plan > Gantt Chart >Materials, you have maintained the Materials XYZ and selected the option "From Stock".--2--Open the Master Data of Material XYZ.-Select the Valuation Tab.-You have maintained Warehouse as a Business Residence with a positive cost maintained; you expect this cost to be visible in the Project Plan Value.--3--Work Center Cost and Revenue.-Projects view.-Search for Project ABC > View Planned Value related to the task which contained the Material XYZ.-Select Materials sub-tab, the Planned Cost shows a value of 0 instead of what is maintained under Material Master Data.-Cause-Upon the creation of the Project ABC, under Ship From, you have not selected Warehouse.-Resolution-Work Center Project Management-Project View-Search, Open and View All the Project ABC-Select Project Plan tab > Gantt Chart, under Ship From select Warehouse (or the same Business Residence maintained in Product Master Data) and Save.-After doing so, the correct value will show up in Work Center Cost and Revenue.-Keywords-Planned Cost; Project Plan Value; Business Residence; Material

Title: Production Model for Product A Site B on Date YY:YY:YYYY DD:DD for Quantity XXX ea Not Found
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Following error occurs when you creating production proposal,- "Production model for Product A Site B on Date YY:YY:YYYY DD:DD for quantity XXX ea not found-Creation of all receipts not possible-Creation of item not possible".---Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning Work Center.-Navigate to Products View.-Search for Product A which planning area is B.-Choose Open button.-Choose New Planning Proposal button.-Fulfill the date as YY:YY:YYYY DD:DD.-If you fulfill the quantity less than XXX, the production proposal would be created; If the quantity is greater than XXX, the above error would be occurs. -Cause-The total production time required for the planned quantity XXX of the product A has exceeded the maximum capacity for a limited time.-The limit time is determined by the date YY:YY:YYYY DD:DD, the valid date of Release Planning Model, and the operation hours of the Site B.-It's an expected system behavior.-Look at an example as following screenshots, please note that all the data come from SAP internal test system.--"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."---The valid date of the Released Planning Model is from 2022-08-23 16:00 UTC.-Each output product will takes 2 hours to be produced.- The operation hours of Site is from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.-Fulfill the date as 2022-08-24 11:00 UTC.-The limit time to use to produce Product are [08-23 16:00- 17:00 UTC] and [08-24  09:00 - 11:00 UTC]. -Since the limit time is 3 hours and each product takes 2 hours to produce.-Therefore, an expected error occurs when the quantity is greater than 1.-Resolution-You need to adjust the date and quantity according to capacity.-Keywords-Production Model; Site; Quantity; Maximum Capacity.

Title: Error "Assignment Set Cannot be Restricted: Referencing Expense Reports Exist" When Replicating Employee Between Business ByDesign and Concur
Content: Symptom-When trying to replicate termination date for an employee, you receive the error below:-"Assignment set cannot be restricted: referencing expense reports exist"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center and Employees view.-Search for the affected Remote Business partner ID.-Check the latest Date with the Replication Status Failed.-Check the Log Items.-You will see the error.-Cause-There might be two causes:-The error occurs because there is an expense report with future date, dated after the employee's termination date.-Employee Class maintained in the Concur side is not supported in the ByD. So the system assignment of the employee class is not working and due to that the validity in SAP Business ByDesign is terminated-Resolution-You need to open these expense reports with future dates and try correcting their dates and rebooking them. If this is not possible, the suggestion is to cancel the expense reports and create them again with the correct start and end dates.-This is the expected system behavior, here are the supported Employee Classes in Business ByDesign:-M = Employee -I = Intern-A = Assignee      -E = Expatriate    -P = Apprentice     -T = Trainee-In order to have a different pattern in Business ByDesign, you can post your requirement in the Customer Influence Site.-Keywords-Employee replication, termination date, expense report, Master Data Replication, Employee Class.

Title: Inventory Count Document By Product Category
Content: Symptom-You want to create inventory count on the basis of product category instead of logistics area count and product count.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Go to Common tasks view.-Here you can find options New Logistics area count and New Product Count but no product category count.-Cause-There are only two ways of creating count documents either via Logistics Area Count or Product count. - Resolution-Currently, Inventory Count can be created via Logistics Area Count or Product count. -You can post this requirement on below influence forum with business use case.:-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/896- Keywords-product category, logistics area count, product area count, Physical Inventory, Inventory Count

Title: Modifying Delivery Date of Advised Delivery Notes does not Modify Planning
Content: Symptom-Due to real time business scenarios like to manage delays in deliveries between warehouses it may require redetermination of the Stock Transfer Order.-Modifying the Delivery Date in advised delivery notes in case of 3PL does not reflect in material planning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Third Party Logistics workcenter and Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-2. Filter by Advised Delivery Notifications-3. Select 888(where 888 is the Delivery Notification ID), Actions-Set to Received.-4. Now Edit 888.-Change Planned Delivery Date as per business requirement Ex: 99.99.9999-5. Perform check consistency and Change status to Advised and save.--1. Go to Supply Planning workcenter and Products view.-2. Find Product ID 222(where 222 is the Product ID) and Planning Area ABC(where ABC is the Planning Area ID) and Open-3. You will notice that the Date in Product Planning does not reflect the new Delivery Date of Inbound Delivery Notification.-Cause-In case of 3PL the Inbound Delivery Notification is created based on Outbound Delivery.-Therefore it is required to make changes in Outbound Delivery First.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to change the Delivery Date in Outbound Delivery (555 where 555 is the Outbound Delivery ID)-1. Undo Release the Outbound Delivery 555.-2. Change the Delivery Date to Ex: 99.99.9999 and Release Outbound Delivery 555-3. After this the date changes are reflected in Inbound Delivery Notification 888 and same is reflected in Product Planning Details Ex. 222/ABC-Keywords-Product Planning, Product ID, Inbound Delivery Notification ID, Outbound Delivery ID, Outbound Logistics, Advised, Received, Third Party Logistics, 3PL, Delivery Date

Title: Extension field created on Invoice screen is not available in standard Financial Report
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in supplier invoice but you are unable to find this field in standard finance report for payables.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoice work center-Select Adaptation mode-Create an extension field say X( X refers to the extension field)-Now, navigate to Business Analytics work center-Select Design Reports view-Open the financial report for Payables where you can see the invoice data-But the extension field is missing here-Cause-There is no relevant extension scenario available in the supplier invoice screen to display this field in financial report. You can only extend a field from one document to another if there is a standard extension scenario available .-Resolution-Please check the relevant extension scenarios that are available for that field in the particular document like supplier invoice, purchase order etc so that the extension field can be extended to those documents and report.-Go to Adaptation mode->select the extension field->Show Further Usage -Also check if there is any standard field already available in the report which populates the same value as the extension field.-Keywords-extension field missing in report, supplier invoice extension field, extension scenario, further usage

Title: How to default "From Stock" check box for Materials in Project?
Content: Symptom-You have multiple materials in project where you need to flag the "From Stock" check box every time you add a material.-You want to avoid this and set it as default check.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select view Projects-Select Project Plan tab-Navigate to Materials sub tab-Add row-Check "From stock" checkbox for each item -You want to set this as default instead of flagging it every time one by one.-Cause-As of now it is not possible to set "From stock" checkbox as default in standard By Design system.-Resolution-This field is PSM released, so you can check with PDI partner if they can customize it and set this as default.-Keywords-From stock , materials, project , default check

Title: How to Check the Previous Resource Load
Content: Symptom-In work center Supply Planning view Resource Load, you wonder how to see the resource load situation before today.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supply Planning.-Access view Resource Load.-Select a resource and click Open.-In the new window, you can only see resource load since today.-Resolution-In the OWL screen "Supply Planning - Resource Load", open advanced filter, change date in Period Start to a previous date since when you would like to check. Click Go.-In the below select the resource that you would like to check, click Open.-Keywords-Resource Load, Date, Previous, Period

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-The customer requests to activate the new home design.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This option is available as of release 2302.-Resolution-Forward to AP-RC-UIF-RT-B development for activation. Title: Approval Task Remains Unassigned When the Work Distribution is 'Approver of Document'
Content: Symptom-Task regarding 'Approve Goods and Services Receipt' remains unassigned. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Show: Unassigned Items-Search for ABC (ABC is the Goods and Services Receipt's ID).-Select the task 'Approve Goods and Services Receipt ABC'.-Open the latest application log of this task.-Go to Summarizing Messages section.-You can see the Description:-Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Searching for responsible in non-configurable work category: Approver of Supplier Invoices, Purchasing Contracts, Goods and Service Receipts-Searching using method Purchase Document by Manager of Purchasing or Supplier Invoicing Unit-Result:-No employee found-Cause-Firstly confirm that the Work Distribution is 'Approver of Goods and Service Acknowledgement':-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Select the active approval process regarding Goods and services receipt.-Click View button.-Select the step that triggered the approval process. -Check that 'Work Distribution: Approver of Goods and Service Acknowledgement'. -Description: The manager of cost assignment to the goods and service acknowledgement has to approve. In addition, additional approvers assigned in the application and user management work center get the approval task. In case no approver is defined in that way, the reporting line manager of the employee responsible for the goods and service acknowledgement is the approver.-So it needs to be checked the employees / users assigned to each step of the approval flow. -First step (Manager of Cost assignment to the Goods and Service Acknowledgement): -Open the Purchase Order related to this Goods and service receipt. -Check that the Buyer Responsible is XYZ (XYZ is the Buyer Responsible). -Open XYZ. -Click You Can Also button and select Open Personnel File. -Check that -> Reporting Line Unit is JKL (JKL is the Reporting Line Unit). -Navigate to Responsible Managers tab. -You can see the message: 'No records found'. -Second step (Additional approvers assigned in the Application and User Management work center):-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Employee Work Distribution view.-Select 'Additional Accountant'.-Click Edit button.-Check that there is nothing maintained for the company of the Purchase Order. -Third step (Reporting line manager):-Open XYZ. -Click You Can Also button and select Open Personnel File. -Navigate to Responsible Managers tab. -You can see the message: 'No records found'. -Resolution-The user can maintain one or more steps to guarantee that the approval task will be assigned, as listed below: -Step 1: Assign a manager to the cost assignment of the specific Goods and service receipt; -Step 2: Assign an employee responsible for Additional Accountant for the Purchase order's company;-Step 3: Assign a manager to the user assigned as Purchase order's Buyer responsible. -See Also-KBA: 1947478 - Huge list of Persons Responsible Determined for an Approval Task-Keywords-Goods and Services Receipt; Approval; Task; Unassigned; Work Distribution

Title: Sales Order With Items Finished and Canceled is Showing the Delivery Status on the General tab as In Process.
Content: Symptom-Delivery Status is showing as 'In Process' in the General tab of a Sales Order that has a Product Line Item with Delivery Status as 'Finished' and a Service Line Item with Delivery Status as 'Not started' due to a reason for rejection maintained on the item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-In the search field, search for the Sales Order ID ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open and select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-A Product Line Item has the Delivery Status as 'Finished/ xx Each' and Invoice Status as 'Not Started'.-Service Line Item that was canceled has the Service Status as 'Not Relevant', Delivery Status 'Not Started' and Invoice Status as 'Not Relevant'.- Go back to the General tab.-The Delivery Status is 'In Process'.-Cause-When a Service Line Item is canceled with a reason for rejection maintained, the Delivery Status for that Line Item will be as 'Not Started' and the overall Delivery Status in the General tab will be 'In Process'.-To complete the sales document the Product Line Item has to be invoiced, therefore it will change the Sales Order Status to 'Completed' but the Delivery Status will be 'In Process'.-This behavior occurs because the Delivery/Fulfillment Status of Service Line Item is "Not Started", hence this will keep the overall Delivery Status of the Sales Order as 'In Process' even after the document is completed.-Resolution-This is the Standard System Behavior for this scenario.-See Also-The following KBA will provide further information regarding the cancelation of a Service Line Item in a Sales Order document:-2911400 - How To Cancel Sales Order With a Service Line Item-Keywords-not started, service item, cancel, canceled, product delivery base, service line item, in process, finished

Title: Information Required for Financials
Content: Symptom-The following points should be gathered in order to process issues efficiently and bring a case to an early conclusion.-Note that this list presents guidelines and is not exhaustive. Probing questions are to be applied and adapted depending on the context of a reported problem.-In order to swiftly analyze a reported issue we need a reproducible instance of the problem.-This requires:-Sufficient description of applied business-process-Is this a new occurrence or was this experienced before. If Yes - are there previous Support-Incidents we can refer to.-Specify affected documents, runs, selection criteria etc.-Where conducive, illustrate the situation with screenshots-Clearly state the expected result vs. the observed actual result-Ideally demonstrate by focusing on a single example representing an issue-If possible - substantiate the expectation referring to pertinent settings and definitions-Permission to execute actions including possible data-change at Support-side where applicable-Concerning fiscal periods should be open for posting (open period/valid process control entry) if applicable-Examples:-Valuation Runs (e.g. Depreciation Run, Revenue Recognition Run, Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run)-Illustrate pertinent selection criteria for a run including: Company, Run ID, Dates, Set of Books, Run-mode (Update/Test)-Describe the problem using assorted instances (e.g. Fixed Assets, Sales Documents, Projects, Bank Accounts)-Explain expectations based on underlying definitions and methods (e.g. Depreciation Methods, Valuation Views, Accrual Methods, Exchange Rates)-Did previous runs show similar results-Permission to perform valuation-runs in test-mode/update mode/update-Processing of Inbound Files (e.g. Bank Statements, Bank Advice)-Provision of affected file-Identification of Company, Bank ID, Bank Account ID-File format description-Have previous files been successfully processed for similar settings-Refer to applied settings in Business Configuration and Master Data-Permission to execute the file-upload and/or processing from Support-side--Inconsistent Results in Financial Reports-Specify exact selection criteria for running the report-Break-down observed wrong results into categories exemplifying the issue (e.g. G/L Account, Financial Period, Sales Document Item, Project Task)-Illustrate expected result based relevant attributes (e.g. Posting Date, Tax-Due-Date, Document Type)-Consistency of previous reports using similar selection criteria -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign

Title: Error Message "Activity is Read-Only; Settings Cannot be Changed" While Editing Activity in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-In the Business Configuration overview, when you try to edit an activity, system throws the below message:-Settings cannot be changed.-Activity is read only. To edit this activity, add it to your project-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search for the relevant activity.-Click the Edit or Change Immediately button.-You see the message.-Cause-The message is displayed due to one of the below reasons:-You do not have an open project (with status Started) on your tenant.-The activity in question is not added to any project.-Resolution-If you do not have an open project on your tenant, please create a change project and add the fine-tuning activity to the change project in order to edit the activity.-To add the activity to an existing change project, you need to follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects work center view.-Select the available project and click Open Activity List.-Show All Activities.-Select the Fine-Tune tab.-Search for the relevant activity.-Click the Add to Project button.-Another possibility for this scenario is when there is no button to 'Edit' or 'Add Row' in the activity. In such cases, you will also receive a warning message as well. This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Activity is read only, read only, settings cannot be changed, business configuration, open activity, edit activity, overview, Change Immediately

Title: Price Component: Sales Price List UUID Shows Zeros as Value
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components (CRMCIVIPATCB) and for some of the invoiced items the field Price Component: Sales Price List UUID is coming with zeros (0000000000000000000000000000).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for the report Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components.-Click Edit.-Maintain Price Component: Sales Price List UUID as one of the values under Rows.-Run the report.-Here you see that the field Price Component: Sales Price List UUID is showing with zeros (0000000000000000000000000000).-Cause-The reason the Price Component: Sales Price List UUID is coming with zeros is because the price for the item under the invoice was manually determined. -Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -See Also-2980953 - Unexpected List Price Value in Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components Report-Keywords-Report, Price Component: Sales Price UUID, Zero, CRMCIVIPATCB, Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components, Wrong, Issue

Title: 'Internal EDX' in Communication output channel in Supplier Master is missing
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the output channel for internal EDX on Supplier output for Purchase Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the-Supplier Base work centre view-Supplier view-Open any supplier -> click 'View all'-Navigate to the facet Communication -Go to the sub-facet Collaborations and open the output channel-Internal EDX is missing-Cause-You have not scoped the respective Scoping question-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Open your Implementation project-Click on View active scope-Go to  Review Questions-Go to  Element Purchase order-Go to Purchase request and orders-Select Communication for Purchase Request and Order Management-Scope  the question "Do you want to send purchase orders electronically to your suppliers using electronic data exchange (EDX)?"-also-Go to Business Configuration work center-Open your Implementation project-Click on View active scope-Go to  Scoping step-Go to  Element Purchase order-Go to Purchase request and orders-Select Purchasing Between Partner Companies-Finish scoping -log out and log in-Go to Business Configuration work center-Open your Implementation project-Click on View active scope-Go to  questions step-Go to  Element Purchase order-Go to Purchase request and orders-Select Purchasing Between Partner Companies-You will see  below questions-"You can purchase stock materials from partner companies that use the same SAP solution"-"Do you purchase services from partner companies that use the same SAP solution?"-Keywords-Internal EDX, PO internal EDX, EDX missing in Supplier master

Title: How to generate an output with only a XML file without sending the PDF
Content: Symptom-You would like to generate an output of a document that only contains the XML file without sending the PDF file to your business partner.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In order to generate an output with only the XML file, you may use the Output Channel "XML". This Output Channel will prevent that a PDF file is sent to your business partner. After the output is generated, you will need to manually download the XML file and send it.-You may also use the Output Channel "External System". This Output Channel requires a Communication Arrangement and a Communication System, and the transformed XML gets sent as part of content to an end point URL.-See Also-Blog: SAP Business ByDesign Output Management – part 1-Blog: SAP Business By Design Output Management – part 2-Blog: E-Invoicing with SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Output XML, output XML instead of PDF, account, supplier, customer invoice, purchase order, supplier invoice

Title: Receiver Email is Expected to Appear with Upper and Lower Cases Characters
Content: Symptom-You have maintained an e-mail address in the format XXccbbFF@XXX.com (please notice the upper and lower case used).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Maintain a receiver e-mail in the format XXccbbFF@XXX.com for example:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the view Dunning.-Search and find Dunning ID 123 (123 represents the Dunning ID).-Select the button Preview.-Select Send Options.-Here we can see the e-mail address is maintained as XXccbbFF@XXX.com (please note the upper and lower case).-When the e-mail is sent the e-mail naming convention is always lower case in this example  xxccbbff@xxx.com-Cause-This is expected system behaviour. SAP is following the RFC 821/822 ff  were SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) - upper case lower cases are irrelevant.-Resolution-System is following the RFC 821/822 ff Standard as SAP is not planning to make any enhancements.-Keywords-E-Mail, Cases Sensitive, upper case, lower case

Title: Bill-To Party is Read Only in Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You edit sales documents and you cannot change the Bill-To party, as the fields are greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Sales Order workcenter.-Select the Sales Order view.-Open any sales order.-Navigate to the items tab.-The Bill-To Party is always greyed out.-Cause-You have scoped the address redetermination for Bill-To in Sales Documents in the Scoping Questions.-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration Workcenter.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to tab 4. Questions.-Open Sales->Customer Invoicing->Miscellaneous Invoicing->Miscellaneous Invoicing.-You will find question "Do you want to redetermine the address of the Bill-To Party from the master data at the time of invoice creation?".-Once this question is scoped, you are not able to manually change the bill-to party in sales documents anymore, including customer invoicing.-The redetermination does not redetermine the party itself, but only the entered details in the party master data for the Bill-To address.-If you want to adjust the Bill-To Party manually, unscope this question.-Keywords-Contract, Sales Order, Invoice, Bill-To, Greayed, Greyed out, Read Only, Vertrag, Kundenauftrag, Rechnung, Rechnungsempfänger, Ausgegraut, Sales Quote

Title: BYD2305 Demand Plan - Limit in upload file ( 1200 line items)
Content: Symptom-Demand Planning - Uploading Key Figures-You found that there is a limit to upload only 1200 line items for a demand plan.-Now you would like SAP to increase the limit to the maximum possible, because your customer have weekly demand for multiple Products for which this range is not sufficient.-Environment-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign 2305--Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Demand Planning work center. -Go to the Demand Plans view. -Select a relevant Demand Plan and click of Upload.-Open the downloaded Excel Template.-Go to the UploadProductAndPeriod tab.-You can see under "Adding Data" that the maximum possible allowed Entries is given as 1200 rows which for instance, in a montly plan, corresponds to a set of 100 products in one planning area and in one demand plan for an history horizon of 12 months.-Cause-There is a hard limit of 1200 rows due to performance concerns.-Resolution-As mentioned in the Template, the maximum allowed entries is 1200 rows. This cannot be increased to avoid Performance issues. -Please kindly follow the advise to split your file with each template having up to 1200 entries, if you want to upload more entries.

Title: Action POST not possible; action is disabled
Content: Symptom-You are managing journal entry vouchers (JEV) with an ABSL script from an add-on of SAP Cloud Applications Studio and when trying to post the JEV with Post() action, the below error comes:-Action POST not possible; action is disabled-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-The journal entry voucher should be submitted for posting before being posted.-Resolution-First use action SubmitForPosting() and then Post().-See Also-PDI, SDK, script, action, error, action, POST, not, possible, action, is, disabled, AccountingEntry, FinancialAccounting, CompanyFinancialsProcessControl, journalEntryVoucher, JEV

Title: Error message "Error: Provide Target Language in uploaded file text element" when trying to import translations
Content: Symptom-You are trying to import translations into the system but get the error message "Error: Provide Target Language in uploaded file text element".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Text Pool Administration view.-Enter the relevant text pool.-Go to Attachments tab.-Attach your file.-Click Define and Execute Run.-Select the Process Type: Process Input File.-Wait a few minutes until the job is finished.-Now go back to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Background Jobs view.-You can see that the job failed with error "Error: Provide Target Language in uploaded file text element".-Cause-There are two possible causes for this error:-You have made changes to the file template (for example: removed header, removed or added columns, etc.).-The file template you are using has been downloaded a while ago. With new system releases it is possible that the template is modified with new elements.-In the internal logic, the system needs to identify the column headers to be able to match the content of a column to it's back end type and for this the integrity of the list is important.-Since there is an element missing in the template, the system could not identify the table header row properly and thus no data was transferred from the file.-Resolution-You should download the file template again and make sure that no changes are made in the file structure.-Keywords-language adaptation tool, excel import, translations

Title: "Save Data To" is greyed out in Intrastat Export
Content: Symptom-You are trying to export some Intrastat Data to Microsoft Excel, but the button "Save Data To" is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-WoC Intrastat-Material Classification View-Use the filter "Unclassified Materials" and execute.-Click Export > Microsoft Excel -From here, login with your credential, as you can see the button "Save Data To" is greyed out and cannot be used.-Cause-The "Save Data To" function in Excel file will only be available during an import of data: from Excel to Business ByDesign.-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-For any export of Data, you can directly save the Excel file to your local hard drive through File > Save or Save as.

Title: Japan Summary Invoice: Freight Calculation Is Not Supported
Content: Symptom-Freight calculation is not supported in Summary Invoice Form for Japan Summary Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Invoice Summary Documents view.-Find and open Invoice ID ABC (ABC means the Invoice Summary ID).-Click Preview (at this moment, the Summary Invoice Form PDF template is loaded).-Check the table named 現在の販売詳細 (Current Sales Details).-Notice that 単価 (Unit Price) is AAA, when you expected BBB.-AAA is Unit Price displayed.-BBB is Unit Price expected.-Cause-Detailed breakdown of the pricing component or various pricing components are not shown or handled currently in the Summary Invoice Form template.-For example, if Price Component Freight has been used in the referred customer invoice, this is not considered in the Unit Price.-The Unit Price is calculated as: (Amount - Tax Amount )/Quantity-Resolution-System behaves as expected for SAP standard form template 'Summary Invoice Form'.-You can create your own custom form template if desired.-Keywords-japan; invoice summary; Summary Invoice Form; 現在の販売詳細, Current Sales Details, 単価, Unit Price

Title: Duplicate Invoice Volume Report in the Customer Invoicing Work Center
Content: Symptom-When accessing the Reports View in the Customer Invoicing Work Center, the report Invoice Volume is duplicated in the Reports View.-Both reports are browser-based type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Reports View.-Scroll down to the Report Category: Sales and Marketing - Customer Invoicing section.-In both Invoice Volume reports, hover the mouse over the graphic Icon in the report type column.-Both Invoice Volume reports are displayed as browser-based type.-Cause-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Go to Design Reports View.-In the search field, Search for Invoice Volume.-Two Invoice Volume reports are displayed in the UI.-Both have different IDs and different Report Types, the following information is showned :-Invoice Volume report:-ID: CRMCIVIB_Q0001-Report type: browser-based type-  Invoice Volume report:-ID: CRMCIVIB_MQ0001-Report type: Mobile Type-  The Invoice Volume report CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 is displayed with Report type as browser-based type in the Customer Invoicing.-  Summarizing:-In Business Analytics Work Center:-Invoice Volume - CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 - Mobile Based Type-Invoice Volume - CRMCIVIB_Q0001 - Browser Based Type-  In Customer Invoicing Work Center Work Center:-Invoice Volume - CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 - Browser Based Type-Invoice Volume - CRMCIVIB_Q0001 - Browser Based Type-  The report  CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 is displayed as Browser Based Type in the Customer Invoicing Work Center due to changes performed by the development side in the version 1811 of the mobile app performed in 1902 release.-Resolution-This a know issue from SAP Support side and no definitive solution has been implemented yet to avoid the report CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 from being displayed as Browser Based Type in the Customer Invoicing Work center.-As workaround for this scenario there are two available options:-If you do not require/use the CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 for your business needs:-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports View.-In the search field, Search for the report ID CRMCIVIB_MQ0001.-Filter for Assigned.-In the Column Assign, unselect all checkboxes that are related to the Customer invoicing Work Center.-Select Save.-  The CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 report will no longer be displayed in the Customer Invoicing Work Center-  If you do require/use the CRMCIVIB_MQ0001 for your business needs: -Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Reports View.-Select the Invoice Volume report that requires to be used in the Work Center (CRMCIVIB_Q0001).-Select the Priority Button.-Select Mark as Priority.-A exclamation icon will appear in the Priority column of the selected report, this can be used to identify the correct Browser Based Type (CRMCIVIB_Q0001) to be used. -In Addition, for this workaround the user requires to have the priority column available in the Reports: List table of the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Note: This configuration is not applied to all users, each user who make use of the report (CRMCIVIB_Q0001) in the Customer Invoicing Work Center, needs to perform the above steps once for the exclamation icon to appear in the UI.-Keywords-Invoice volume, volume, report, CRMCIVIB_Q0001, browser based type, CRMCIVIB_MQ0001, mobile based type, moblie type, duplicated report, duplicated, reports view

Title: Error: "Item xxx: Mandatory List Price Missing for the Price Calculation" due to Missing List Price Component
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Customer has reported that a Sales/Service document is with status Inconsistent and the error "Item xxx: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is displayed in the UI.-The status of the preceding document is completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-For this example we will use a Sales Order document, but the resolution steps can be applied for any Sales/Service document.-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-In the search field, Search for the Sales Order ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID). -Select View All.-The error message "Item xxx: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation (KBA: 3147367)" is displayed in UI.-Also, the status of the Sales Order is displayed as "Inconsistent".-Cause-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-In the search field, Search for the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID). -Select View All.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Select the dropdown to show all price components of the Line Item ABC (ABC represents the Line Item Number).-No List Price component has been maintained for the Line Item ABC causing the error to be displayed in the UI. -Since the Sales Order has already been released without assigning any List Price for the Line Item ABC, this is causing the document to be inconsistent and generating the error messages.-Note: A error message will be generate for each Line Item that does not contain a List price.-Resolution-In this case a backend correction will be required by the support side.-Note: For this backend correction it will be necessary to obtain customer approval. Once customer provides approval the following steps can be performed:-Go to Transaction SEFTS.-Search for the BO name -> SALES_ORDER.-Select the arrow in the Folder Icon.-Select the option Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the "ID/content" field, insert the Sales Order ID XYZ.-Select Confirm.-Click on the Navigate Button.-Select ITEM.-Select all the affected items.-Click on the Navigate Button.-Select PRICE_AND_TAX_CALC_ITEM.-Copy the Node ID of each the affected Item to a Notepad document.-Select all the affected items.-Navigate to the ITEM_OPERAT_PRICE_COMP.-A new window will open, Select Confirm.-Click F6 (Laid Back mode ON).-Select the line item affected.-Click on the Pencil Icon.-Click on the BO Node Instance (Paper Icon).-In the new Window select the Node ID of the affected Item.-Scroll until the TYPE_CODE-CONTENT column.-In the new empty field of the TYPE_CODE-CONTENT column, Enter I7PR1.-Repeat the steps to all affected items.-Click Save (Disk Icon).-Click F6 to turn off Laid Back mode.-Navigate to the Sales Order XYZ in the UI, the status is now displayed as Processed.-Keywords-Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation, List Price missing for the price calculation, Mandatory List Price missing, Inconsistent document, List Price, Laid Back Mode, Inconsistent, Sales Order, Service Order, Invoice Request, Invoice

Title: In Approval Shopping Cart cannot be find in Shopping Cart Management.
Content: Symptom-While browsing the Shopping Carts in Shopping Cart Management, you cannot find any Shopping Cart Under status "In Approval".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the Work Center Application and User Management-Select the View Shopping Cart Management-Execute-No "In Approval" Shopping Cart are available-Cause-The main function of this view is to assign Shopping Cart to other users.-Assigning a Shopping Cart "In Approval" to another user is not permitted as this would create some potential inconsistencies.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Shopping Cart Management, In Approval, Shopping Cart

Title: Error When Trying to Create a Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Communication Arrangement to use Analytics DataSources OData, however the system is showing an internal error.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Administrator and General Settings view.-Click Communication Arrangements link.-Press "New".-Select "Analytics DataSources OData" and Press "Next".-On the "Define Business Data" step, select the search help for "System Instance ID".-When the "Select System Instance ID" popup appears, the error appears at that point.-Cause-The cause behind this error is an inconsistency in the backend, where an old entry must be corrected manually.-Resolution-Kindly raise a case to SAP Product Support to have the error fixed from the backend.-Keywords-Dump, Error, New, Communication Arrangement, Server, 500 error, Triggering application component, BC-ESI-ESF-BSA, Info: Retrieve for Parent Node ID, failed on node ROOT, BO.

Title: Sales Order Item ID not Showing for Customer Return Notification
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Customer Return Notification and the system is not proposing the expected Sales Order item to be selected for the return scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Customer Return Notifications from the Common Tasks-Click Go-System returns all items to be selected from system.-Filter for product ID ABC (abc represents the ID of the material).-When searching for the Sales Order ID, system does not propose. -Cause-Sales Order item ID will only showing under the Customer Return Notification when the items has been delivered.-This can be confirmed for items in the Sales Order that have the Delivery Status as Finished and/or for items with partial delivery.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -Please finish the delivery process of the order for the item to show in the selection. -See Also-2789231 - Error When Creating a New Customer Return Notification-1818008 - How to Create a Customer Return without a Reference-Keywords-Sales Order, Delivery, Sales Order Item ID, Customer Return, Notification, Not Showing, Order

Title: Employee Data Showing the Wrong Org Unit Manager After Replicating Employees to SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-After replicating Employees to the SAP Business ByDesign, you noticed that the system is assigning the wrong Reporting Line Unit Manager to the replicated Employee. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Employee Data Work Center and then Employee view.-Search for the affected Employee ID.-Click Edit.-Check the Manager field.-Manager assigned to the Employee is not correct.-Cause-Although you have replicated the Employee properly, the Manager is a result from the data maintained in the Org Unit. You can check the Org Unit Manager by following the steps below:- Go to the Organizational Management and then click Edit Org Structures.-Maintain the curret date.-Click Find and search for the Org Unit that is the Reporting Line Unit assigned to the affected Employee.-Click Locate.-Go to the Timelines tab.-Check the Organizational Unit Manager data.-Note: It might not have any Manager or the validity has ended.-Resolution-Please replicate the Reporting Line Unit with the right Manager via Master Data Replication work center. Once the Reporting Line Unit is replicated properly, it will be updated in the Employee Data.-Please follow the steps below to replicate the Reporting Line Unit:-Go to the Master Data Replication Work Center and then Reporting Line Units view.-Click Show All and search for the Reporting Line Unit assigned to the affected Employee.-Click Edit and go to the Manager tab in order to check the Manager assigned to this Reporting Line Unit.-Now you can Add Row and maintain a new Employee or you can trigger a New Replication Request under Reporting Line Units view.-See Also-2521562 - Frequently Asked Questions on Business ByDesign and SuccessFactors Employee Central Integration-Keywords-Wrong Manager, Employee, Master Data Replication, Reporting Line Unit, Manager, Replication, ByD, SF.

Title: Export Sales Price List
Content: Symptom-You Want to know How to Export the Sales Price List from Bydesign System-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfiolo work center.-Choose the Price Lists view.-Show relevant Price list and open-Click on View All and navigate to Items tab.-Choose all Items and click on Export.-Select to MS Excel.-Keywords-Price List, Item, Export, Product, Base Price List, Sales Price List

Title: Cancellation Requested but Invoice Already Exists
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that an Invoice Request which was processed is now showing as With Conflict in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request document).-Status: With Conflict.-Click Check.-Error: Conflict in item 10; cancellation requested but invoice already exists.--Cause-The reason the system is making the invoice request as with conflict is because an Invoice document, in this case a Credit Memo, has been released and the previous documents such as Customer Return was cancelled.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. --Please cancel the Invoice document and the status of the Invoice Request will turn into Processed. -Keywords-Customer Invoice, Invoice Request, Return, Cancel, Cancellation Requested But Invoice Already Exist

Title: Error Appears While Trying to Upload Supplier Invoices Through SAP Collaboration Window
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload supplier invoices through SAP Collaboration window using pdf and doc files and system shows the error message. -Error - Valid file pair cannot be found in observed folder-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SAP Collaboration tool-Login and go to Invoice Scanning-Select the pdf document from the observed folder-System uploads and error appears-Cause-In the scoping questions, you have selected the question - Do you want to enter supplier invoices via PDF scanning? which means, you have scoped the Intelligent Invoice Scanning. In the Intelligent Invoice Scanning, you can upload supplier invoice documents only in PDF format for creating supplier invoices in the system. Since you have both pdf and doc. files, system shows the error message. -Note: In the Invoice Scanning view of the Supplier Invoicing work center, you can upload supplier invoice documents in PDF format for creating supplier invoices in the system. The system scans the uploaded documents leveraging the SAP AI Business Services – Document Information Extraction service and proposes the values for creating the invoices in the system.
