You can review and edit the scanned values on the Review screen using the snapshot of the uploaded document. -Resolution-You can use only the pdf files to upload the invoices and not doc files in the observed folder. This way you can avoid the error. -Note: You can make use of this functionality by selecting the following questions to enable the settings in your system:-Do you want to enter supplier invoices via PDF scanning?-Do you want automatic creation of invoices from scanned documents? (If you select this option, system creates invoices automatically after scanning.)-Do you want to compare scanning invoice items with purchase order items?-This enables the comparison of scanned invoiced items with the existing purchase order items and allows the use of scanned values instead of purchase order values. During the scanned invoice review process, the system checks for the unique items (Product ID and Product Description) in the purchase order and creates an invoice item with or without the purchase order reference. The non-scanned purchase order items are ignored. Values such as account assignment, product ID, product description, and header information that are not part of an invoice, or are not yet part of the scanning process are taken from the purchase order item.-Do you want to default the company based on scanned value?-If you select this scoping question, the scanned values are defaulted as reviewed values in the following use cases:-If no company ID is given in the upload UI-When PDFs are uploaded via the collaboration window (if the question is not scoped, normally the company of the user logged into the collaboration window gets defaulted instead of the scanned value)-Important Note:-Upload via SAP Collaboration Window-The solution supports the upload option via the collaboration window through the required settings and defaulting logic of company (by determining the company of the user logged into the collaboration window).-For the invoice scanning solution, on SAP Collaboration Window, select the following Invoice Scanning Settings:-Enable Service Scanned Invoices-Only Upload PDF files-Observed Folder location-Refer to the help document - Intelligent Invoice Scanning Quick Guide-Keywords-valid file pair cannot be found in observed folder; valid file pair cannot be found; observed folder; Invoice scanning error

Title: Unable to Remove The Scoping Element Employee Payroll Data Maintenance From The Current Scoping
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error occurs while trying to remove the scoping element Employee Payroll Data Maintenance from the current scoping:--Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.-If error message are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Implementation Projects view.-Select the project First Implementation.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Scoping step.-Expand Human Resources.-Remove Employee Payroll Data Maintenance.-Next, Next and Finish.-System shows the error.-Cause-If payroll is in scope, then you will still be able to maintain tax (Payroll related data) for your employees. However, if payroll is descoped for a country/region, then the tax / social insurance tabs for that country/region will no longer be accessible for maintenance on personnel Administration work center. Currently there are employees having tax data assigned to them.--If you still wish to proceed with the descoping of payroll (understanding the consequences for payroll data recording i.e. Tax data) then you will need to remove the payroll type mappings in Business configuration, to prevent the errors that you have experienced whilst descoping payroll.-Also, if payroll is descoped for a country, then the tax / social insurance tabs for that country will no longer be accessible for maintenance with the steps below:-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Select the Employee and click Edit.-Resolution-In order to remove the scoping, customer needs to follow the steps below to remove the Map Time Types:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Map Time types and Time Account Types to Provider Entities - desired country/region (e.g US)-Open the activity.-Click Map Time Types to Provider Time Types.-Remove the entries for Employee Time Type ZABC and ZABC and Save.-Next option, remove the entry for Time Account Type ZABC and Save.-Important: Do not remove the entry for the Standard Employee Time Type.-Then the customer can try to descope Employee Payroll Data Maintenance again.-Keywords-Scoping Element, Employee Payroll Data Maintenance, Unable, Cannot, Remove, Descope, Error, Currently unable to finalize these scope changes, some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.

Title: Emails are not received after being sent from PDI script
Content: Symptom-You are making use of Mail.Send reuse library function from Platinum Engineering library in your custom solution from SAP Cloud Applications Studio to send e-mails, but they are not reaching the recipient inbox.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-The DKIM activation for your domain is not enabled on the system.-Resolution-Please follow the SAP help documentation to have DKIM activated on your tenant:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_CLOUD_FOR_CUSTOMER/c0c1f41cb50e4d92b4d6fe2d49b89907/2d0dfd08722d1014bd06d3f4aa663e32.html?locale=en-US-See Also-You can also refer to this blog post:-DKIM Key Activation for Business Emails in SAP Business ByDesign(ByD)-Keywords-PDI, SDK, platinum, engineering, mail, send, email, PDI, script, enable, activate, missing

Title: Multiple Acknowledgments Created for Purchase Order not Displayed in the Document Flow
Content: Symptom-You are unable to see multiple Purchase Order Acknowledgements created for the Purchase order. Only the latest acknowledgment is shown in the document flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Go to the tab Document Flow.-Here we can see only the latest Purchase Order Acknowledgement.-Cause-Basically it is a confirmation from a supplier to deliver the specified quantities of products at specified price on specified date.-Within this document, the supplier can accept the terms and conditions of the purchase order, propose changes to particular aspects of the purchase order, or reject the purchase order. Buyer can accept or reject the deviations in the purchase order made by the supplier.-In case of more than one purchase order acknowledgement, the latest one shows all the details that are accepted by the buyer. The remaining Purchase order acknowledgements becomes Out-of-date.-So the document flow shows the up-to-date purchase order acknowledgment i.e. the latest PO acknowledgment document.-Resolution-You can see all the purchase order acknowledgments by following the below path:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Select the acknowledged link with respect to the purchase order.-Now you can see all the Purchase order acknowledgements listed for that purchase order.-Keywords-purchase order acknowledgment, acknowledgment in document flow, PO acknowledgment, confirmation

Title: Migration of Additional Part Numbers for Existing Materials
Content: Symptom-The approach to be taken while migrating additional part numbers for existing materials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview.-Show Activities and Find Migration of Materials.-Select the Change Immediately button.-Select the hyperlink Migrate materials using the Migration tool.-Resolution-As to your query of being able to upload additional part numbers for materials, you only need to specify the additional part numbers in the template. The system will only append the new part numbers to the list of existing ones, existing parts remain.--The Customer Part Numbers and Supplier Part Numbers sheets are hidden in the migration template. You can un-hide them and feed the new part numbers corresponding to the respective material IDs. To un-hide them, right-click title of any visible sheet and select the Unhide option. In the subsequent window, select the aforementioned sheets.-While Migrating, please see to that the option to Enhance already existing records is selected.-This can be done through the following steps:-In the Migration tool, select the file you are trying to migrate.-Select Properties button.-Select Advanced option.-You will see an option to choose the Migration Mode.-In the drop down choose Enhance already existing records.-Note: It is not possible to delete Supplier Part Number in bulk after import. You can only delete it manually following below mentioned steps:-Go to Product Data work center-Select Materials view-Select Edit button and select View All-Select Purchasing subtab-Select Supplier Part Number-Select the required row-Select Remove-In case the requirement is to update an existing Supplier Part Number, that is only possible through web service. In the below link, you can find the documentation for the Material web service API:-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2011/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_MATERIAL_IN.html-See Also-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2011/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_MATERIAL_IN.html-Keywords-Supplier part number , delete , update , enhance , migration, webservice

Title: No Data is Returned When Executing an OData Query for TextCollection
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Customer is executing an OData query for TexCollection, however although the data exists in the system, the query does not return anything.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the URL below:-https://myxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/z_customerinvoice/CustomerInvoiceCustomerInvoiceCollection?$filter=ID eq 'xyz'&$expand=CustomerInvoiceCustomerInvoiceText-Although the issue occured for Customer Invoice Collection, it can occur for other BOs, such as InboundDeliveryTextCollection.-Cause-The problem occurs due to an inconsistency in the backend.-Resolution-Please forward the case to Operations team to reload the BO table. e.g /1FS/APCI_CUS_D5056000.-The table will depend on the affected Object.-See Also-2571142 - How to Use The Backend Transaction SESFTS-Keywords-OData, Query, Not Returning, Does not Return, Empty, Not Working, TextCollection.

Title: Missing Expected Customer Invoice Rule
Content: Symptom-Invoice Documents have been created in the system but no rule was maintained under Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Documents view.-The system shows Invoice Documents starting from 1.-Cause-If you do not define specific rules, the system applies default rules and starts numbering your invoicing documents (such as customer invoices, credit memos and down payment requests) automatically with the number 1 irrespective of the company or the invoicing document type and without any prefixes, suffixes or separators.-Once there is a numbering rule maintained in the fine tuning activity Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing for your specific country, you have to maintain a rule for each of the individual document types (Credit memo, Down Payment Request, Invoice, etc).-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-If you would like to have defined rules, please create the expected rule.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Overview view.-Search for Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Select the Document Numbering.-See Also-Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing - Configuration Guide-Keywords-Invoice, Invoice Document, Document Numbering, Missing, Customer Invoice

Title: Error Serial Number Recording is Forbidden for Product XYZ & SERIALABC
Content: Symptom-For Product XYZ(where XYZ is the Product ID) the serial number profile is set to Optional.-During Confirmation of Put Away task when you key in the serial number SERIALABC(where SERIALABC is the serial number ID/registered product) you will encounter the following error-Serial Number Recording is Forbidden for Product  XYZ & SERIALABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter and Task Control view-2. Find Task ID 999(where 999 is the Task Id) and Confirm-3. Go to Line Items tab-you can see that Serial Number Recording is Forbidden for Product  XYZ & SERIALABC.-Cause-As per the Logistic Model used in the Warehouse Request, Logistics Area Proposal is When task is created.-Since the Logistics Model says the Destination Logistics Area proposal should happen at the time of task creation,-confirmation Quantity Proposal is enabled.-Therefore system proposes the Destination Logistics Areas as per the Material Flow Rules maintained and further quantity is proposed.-Now in general for an optional serial number profile product, if quantity is entered, you cannot enter serial numbers.-As per the Material Flow Rules maintained it has proposed quantities therefore serial number recording is marked as forbidden.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-See Also-Serial Number Profile, Optional, forbidden, Material Flow Rules, Logistics Model,Destination Logistics Area proposal ,Recording,Quantity.

Title: Dump During Confirmation of Make Task XYZ
Content: Symptom-Dump During Confirmation of Make Task XYZ(where XYZ is the Make Task ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Production Control workcenter and Task Control view.-2. Find  and Select Make Task XYZ and Confirm.-You will encounter a dump.-Cause-The issue here is with the UoM discrepancy of service ( Make Task XYZ->Confirmations -> Activities -> Services sub tab).-  When the task is confirmed in one UoM, the resource and service utilization calculated for this output quantity is in different UoM.-  This is due to the calculation method maintained in the resource master (Equal to resource utilization, you can check it in Resource > Services tab).-  However, the UoM of the Service ABC(where ABC is the Service ID) is different and there is no conversion maintained between both UoMs, which results in this issue.-  Example:-  When the task is confirmed with 1 MT, the resource and service utilization calculated for this output quantity is in EA this is due to the calculation method-  maintained in the resource master (Equal to resource utilization).-  However, the UoM of the service is EA and there is no conversion maintained between EA and MT, which results in this issue.- Resolution-You have 2 solutions:-1. Maintain the Base UoM of the Service ID ABC same as the UoM of the output product.-OR-2. Maintain the Quantity Conversions  in  Service Id ABC.- Keywords-Make Task, Dump, Resource, Utilization, Quantity, Conversion, Service, Calculated, UoM,

Title: You Get Error Message "Changing not possible; field is read-only." When Creating Service Order Via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are creating service orders via web service, and get error message "Changing not possible; field is read-only."-The error not happens to all the orders, but some. You want to why the error comes up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are using SOAPUI and excuting the payload to create service orders.-Cause-The error "Changing not possible; field is read-only." is usually caused because an change is tried to update a field which is not editable.-While debugging you would see in the PDI modify from Buffer method tried to update the Delivery Priority field of the item.-For item type Consumable and Direct Good Issue, the delivery priority cannot be changed. In your case, the item type of the service order line is Consumable, hence the creation failed.-You are also not able to change the Priority or Delivery Rule for this item type manually in the Service Order for these item types. They will always be derived from the Delivery Terms on header level.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-"Changing not possible; field is read-only", service order, consumable, direct good issue, Delivery Priority.-

Title: "Edit Payables Line Item" in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Supplier Invoice ABC with a Payment Blocking Reason maintained in it, but you cannot remove it through the hyperlink "Edit Payables Line Item".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search the posted Supplier Invoice ABC, open it and click View All-Under General tab, Payment Information sub-tab, Payment Details, you can see the field "Payment Blocking Reason" has data maintained such as Complaint, Other Reason, Payment method changed or To be clarified with payer-As you wish to remove this data, you click the hyperlink "Edit Payables Line Item" and remove the data from the field "Payment Block Reason"-After saving, you can see that the data in field "Payment Blocking Reason" are still present on the invoice ABC-Cause-This is a limitation in the current version of Business ByDesign.-Once the payment blocked is removed and saved, the payment blocked is removed from the payment control, which allows the Supplier Invoice to be picked up in any suitable payment runs scheduled.-However, it will have no effect on the Supplier Invoice itself as the data will remain present in field "Payment Blocking Reason".-Resolution-Should you need any new enhancement added to the software, feel free to directly submit your request for this feature to the correct decision makers at SAP via Customer Influence.-The Customer Influence site, https://influence.sap.com, allows customers to log Improvement Requests themselves and have the ability to work directly with our technology and development group.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Payment Blocking Reason, Edit Payables Line Item.

Title: Unable to set Warehouse Location to Obsolete Using Migration Template Migration of Location and Logistics Area.
Content: Symptom-Unable to set warehouse location to Obsolete using Migration Template 'Migration of Location and Logistics Area'.-Error: Invalid status value 3 in field -LifeCycleStatus -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter and Overview-2. Find Migration of Location and Logistics Area-3. Select Migrate Location and Logistics Area using the migration tool-4. Select template ABC(where ABC is the Migration Template with customer specific data).-5. Execute Migration Step by Step > Error is faced:-Invalid status value 3 in field -LifeCycleStatus-Cause-In the Migration of Location and Logistics Area it is only possible to add new records, meaning the enhance mode is not available in the migration object.-Obsolete status is not supported by the migration tool. This is why the error is raised in the simulation step for the Life cycle status.-Resolution-There is no Standard webservice which can be used for triggering this action.-The Enhance/Modification is available only for a few Migration object, the Migration of Locations is not included here. -This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Location, Logistics Area, Obsolete, LifeCycleStatus , Migration Template, Migration of Location and Logistics Area, warehouse

Title: SAP Insight Information For PDI Analysis
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-We can use this tool before logging in to the customer's tenant for analysing the issue. All the information like deployment information/log details/Add - on details  for customer-specific solutions, solution templates, and multi-customer are recorded in it.-Note -> SAP insight can be used,- If a user has not provided all the information in the reported incident, rather that sending information back to customer. We can double check in our In built tool.-Cannot login to the backend system which is causing delay in processing your incident.-Resolution-Partner Development Check-This check determines all the business objects BOs registered to the user interface from which the incident was created. Then it determines all BO’s associated to these registered BOs and so forth on the next associated level. The system checks if one of these BOs is a partner BO. If this is the case then the status of the check will be set to Warning. In case no partner BO was involved the status is set to Passed.-  Partner Development One Offs Table.-This node lists all customer-specific solutions, solution templates, and multi-customer solutions of the tenant from wich the incident was created.-It contains information such as-Solution name-Version-Status-etc.-  Deployment information-Incight displays a check result per solution. If the deployment of a solution failed, then Incight display an Alert. If available, an application component is proposed.-Error log- If the deployment failed, then the error messages of the log are available under node Log.-

Title: Federal Excise Tax (FET) Availability in US and Canada
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up Federal Excise Tax, but you notice that the functionality is not available. An error message is also raised when trying to maintain the same under Tax on Goods and Services activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Click Define Excise Tax Classification.-The following error is raised: Excise Tax not Scoped in System; Maintenance of Excise Tax not possible-Cause-The system is currently not supporting the excise Tax in US/Canada localization. Also, note that excise tax for a few other Globalization countries have been deprecated.-Resolution-This would be an industry specific requirement. You can reach out to your implementation partner to further evaluate the feasibility of addressing this business case through a custom add-on.-Keywords-Excise Tax, FET. Tax Event, Federal Excise Tax,

Title: How to Update Country Description into Specific Language in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to update Country Description into specific language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can use the translation tool to update country description. Please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Activity "Countries".-Select Edit Countries.-Click Translate button.-In the popup window, maintain the Source Language as "EN - English" and select the required Target Language.-Put the desired description to both Description and Long Description.-Save.-Keywords-Country; Description; Translation

Title: Form Template Selection Rule Not Working
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a rule in Form Template Selection, however it is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management.-Enter the Form Template Selection view.-In the dropdown list, select the business document for which you maintained the rules.-Here the rules are maintained, however they are not applied when the document is sent.-Cause-There is a generic rule above the desired rule in the list.-Resolution-The system processes the rules in order of their appearance in the list starting at the top.  The more specific rules should be placed in the top of list.-Considering this, it is recommended that the more generic rules are placed on the bottom of the list.-Keywords-Master template, template selection, form-form template selection,generic rule,maintained a rule in form template

Title: Posting date in journal entry for service provision from CRM document
Content: Symptom-You are posting a service provision for a service item in one of these CRM documents:-Sales order (by completing an item of type 'Service - fixed price without actuals')-Service order (by completing an item of type 'Service - fixed price without actuals')-Service confirmation (by releasing an item of type 'Service - fixed price' or 'Service - time and material').-This will post an internal activity allocation in Financial Accounting with creation of a journal entry, crediting the cost center of the labor resource in the CRM document item and debiting the CRM document item.-The question now is which of the date fields in the CRM document is relevant for determining the posting date in the journal entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently, the CRM document can only provide one single date as posting date for the journal entry. This date is located on header level (not on item level) in the CRM document.-The date which is used as posting date is the-Sales order: 'Requested Date' from sales order header. If 'Requested Date' is not filled, 'Posting Date' is used-Service order: 'Requested Date' from service order header. If 'Requested Date' is not filled, 'Reported On' is used-Service confirmation: 'Fixed On' date from service confirmation header. If 'Fixed On' is not filled, 'Created On' is used-Resolution-If you have the requirement that you need to post to different accounting periods for the different items in one single sales or service order, you need to use item type 'Service - fixed price' or 'Service - time and material'. You can then create several service confirmations for one sales or service order and use different dates on each service confirmation.-See Also-KBA 3357876 - How is The Posting Date in a Service Order Created as a Follow-Up From a Service Request Determined?-KBA 2581426 - Posting Date in Service Confirmation Displays Creation Date-Keywords-Posting Date; Sales Order; Service Order; Service Confirmation; Provision; Requested Date; Fixed On; Reported On;

Title: How to Export Values of Fine-Tune Activity Quantities and Units of Measure
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to export predefined values in Quantities and Units of Measure activity to prepare your own UoM.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Fine-Tune Activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select Create and Maintain Trading/Physical Units.-Then you can find the predefined values cannot be exported in UI.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, for Units of Measure (UoM), we use the world wide standard provided by UNECE Recommendations 20, 21.-Resolution-Please refer to the attached file which we use to get the UoMs in the system.-Keywords-Quantities and Units of Measure; UoM

Title: Post Goods Receipt Enabled for Cancelled Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-In Inbound Logistics workcenter, cancelled purchase orders have "Post Goods Receipt" enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter and Purchase Orders view.-2. Find Purchase Order 999(where 999 is the purchase order id)-You can see that the status is canceled but "Post Goods Receipt" is enabled.-Cause-"Post Goods Receipt" and " Post Goods Receipt as Planned" actions enablement does not depend on Purchase Order status but on the Supplier type.-For normal suppliers it will always be enabled regardless of Purchase Order status.-And in case of suppliers who act as Organizational Centre (like we have in Intercompany Scenario) it will always be disabled regardless of Purchase Order Status.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-See Also-Keywords-Inbound Delivery, Purchase Order, Cancelled, Post Goods Receipt, Post Goods Receipt as Planned,

Title: How to process incidents created as "Inbound Error"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-“Inbound Error messages” are a special type of incidents. If an Inbound Error incident was created this indicates that some kind of information in the incident was lost.-A new incident got corrupted technically and could not be opened as a usual incident in BCP (Either a customer opened an incident (“ByD User Incident”), or the incident was sent out of the customer system automatically (“Health Check”)).-An update to an existing incident was not possible. The missing information is the update which should have been sent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Incidents received in BCP as inbound error can be recognized by the incident source "Inbound Error" and in the headline of the incident it says "(...) the source is a 'Inbound Error'". Furthermore an internal note starting with "Inbound Error Text" explains the technical reason why the incident was created as inbound error.-Cause-These incidents appear in one of the following cases:-BCP receives a message which tries to update an incident, which does not exist or is in status “Confirmed” where it cannot be changed anymore.-BCP receives a new incident where the information provided is not sufficient to create an incident or the information provided is inconsistent.-Resolution-Try to gather some information about the incident to be able to understand the background of the incident. With this you then should decide whether and how to process the incident.-Incidents can be closed in the following cases-If it is a Health Check incident (e.g. “Health Check”, “Recommended Action”, “System self monitoring issue” is mentioned in the problem description or incident source)-If there is no information at all in the incident (no Short Text, no Long Text, no Key User, no System)-If it is clear that this has been a test incident-If there is no possibility to reconstruct the original incident, close the incident with a comment “Closing due to no usable information”.-If the incident cannot be "just closed", try to collect sufficient information to process the incident itself-Try to identify a potential “original” incident e.g. by searching for incidents with same subject, from same system or from same Key-User-Is the Key-User maintained? – call him for details-Is there a system maintained? - try to narrow down who could have opened the incident, lookup system in System Database (CMDB), identify the customer-Is there a problem description (from the original incident)? – does it tell anything on the system or the person who opened the incident-Process the incident as any other manually created incident, if it is possible at all (communication to the customer must happen via Phone/Email).-Keywords-Inbound, Error

Title: Separator in Reports Downloaded to CSV Are Different
Content: Symptom-You open your system ABC and download the report DEF into a CSV file. After opening the file you see that the separator that is used is, for example, the semicolon (;). Now you open another system, GHI, and download another report into CSV. Opening this second file, you see that the separator is a different one, for example comma (,). You would like to know how you can set up the same separator, for example, you would like your CSV files to use the separator semicolon (;) across all systems.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to system ABC.-Open the report DEF and click on Download > Report in CSV Format.-Open the CSV file and check the separator: it will be for example semicolon (;).-Log on to another system and repeat the same steps.-When opening the second CSV file the separator is another one, for example comma (,).-Cause-Your user specific settings are different in the two systems.-Resolution-The first relevant setting is configured in Windows. The steps in Windows 11 are:-In the control panel, go to "Time & Language" > "Language & Region".-Go to "Administrative language settings".-Go to the tab "Formats".-Click Additional settings...-Here you can maintain a "list separator". This setting is relevant for windows applications, however if you access the ByDesign systems from different computers with different regional settings, the result in the CSV file will be different as well.--The second setting is done in the ByDesign / C4C system, under Personalize > My Settings > Decimal Notation.--Please check that you have the same settings for both systems (and for both computers should you use several). This should ensure the same format in CSV files.-Keywords-report, reporting, download, csv, decimals, after comma, separator, semicolon, tab, excel, gap, cell, delimiter, difference in csv file

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Calculation Starts in the Same Period of Partial Transfer Posting Date
Content: Symptom-You partially transfer the individual material of Fixed Asset XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sending Fixed Asset) to Fixed ABC (ABC represents the ID the receiving Fixed Asset) on posting date DD.MM.YYYY in period AAA.YYYY (AAA represents the period of the transfer’s posting date; YYYY represents the Fiscal Year). You expect the transfer to be considered from the following period, i.e. the depreciation to start in period BBB.YYYY for Fixed Asset ABC. However, the depreciation already starts in the period of the partial transfer, in period AAA.YYYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Show All Fixed Assets and Find ABC (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID), press Go.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC and click Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material.-Enter the required parameters, Posting Date as current month end day, and click Post.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC in view Fixed Assets and click Edit Values.-View Depreciation Overview subtab.-The Depreciation happens in the same period as the Partial Transfer of Individual Material rather than in the next period.-Cause-The depreciation method L011 has the period control method 003 (Acquisition pro rata at period and year start; retirement and transfer pro rata mid period). The partial transfer transaction is treated like an acquisition posting unlike the complete transfer posting. Hence, transaction partial transfer follows period control key 01, in other words, the depreciation start date is always on the first day of the period in which the transaction is posted.-Resolution-You can use the Asset Valuation Date (personalized hidden field) in the manual posting screen to change the period of inclusion for depreciation calculation.-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Show All Fixed Assets and Find ABC and press Go.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC and click Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material.-Click Start Personalization Mode.-Click Show Children of Details.-Mark Visible of UI Element Asset Valuation Date.-Input Asset Valuation Date as expected depreciation calculation start date.-Input other required parameters and click Post.-Note that the period control setting would still be applied for the given Asset Valuation Date.-See Also-Help document: Depreciation Methods – US and Period Control Methods and Keys-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Manual Posting; Partial Transfer; Depreciation; Partial Transfer; Posting Date

Title: No Journal Entry was Created for Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have a customer invoice and the cancellation document which do not have the journal entry created as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Here you see that no journal entry was created for the documents.-Cause-When the invoicing document is released, the invoice data is transferred to accounting, then the invoice is posted as a receivable in the general ledger. -In this case, the customer invoice was never released and later cancelled, hence the reason why the journal entry was not created.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Journal Entry, Missing, Not Created, Released

Title: How System Defines the Posting Date on Sales Order and Sales Order Volume Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-To know how system defines the Posting Date on Sales Order and Sales Order Volume report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the Sales Orders view.-Verify that the Posting Date is ABC (ABC represents the submitting date).-Navigate to the Report view.-Select the List sub view.-Find the Sales Order Volume report.-Enter the required criteria and search for Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Verify that the Creation Date is DEF (DEF represents the creation date).-Cause-The Posting Date displays on UI for sales order depends on time zone maintenance for login user, via Personalize -> This Settings.-The Creation Date displays on Sales order volume report depends on the time zone setting in the database table, via the Business Configuration work center -> Time Zone Maintenance.-Report determination tries to find entry in the time zone configuration tables, if nothing is found it will be defaulted to UTC. If, there is nothing in the system in the time zone configuration tables, the default time zone is defaulted to UTC, and posting date is converted into this.--Why it was designed in such way:-This was because of compliance to the old CRM suite BO model in the early ages of Vienna / A1S in 2005. You cannot use a time zone of Requested Date for conversion of the Posting Date. -These are independent entities. In case the Posting Date needs to be used in reporting it will have its limitations.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Keywords-Posting date; Sales order; Sales order volume report, Creation Date; Business Configuration

Title: Legal Phrase Missing in Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer invoice does not contain the expected legal phrase within the document  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click View Data XML.-The legal phrase is not showing as expected. -Cause-The reason the system is not determining the Legal Phrase to the Invoice is because legally required text is expected to be printed in the invoice for the reason of exemption.-This will only be determined for tax code associated with tax events which have an exemption reason. -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour -See Also-Elements of Tax Determination-Define Standard Phrases for Legal Text Information-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Legal Phrase, Missing, Printing, Form, Template, Tax Code, Tax Events

Title: "Not more than 1 parties of role Supplier permitted" Error Raised in Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-In a scenario where a Service Confirmation is raised from a Service Order, the error "Not more than 1 parties of role Supplier permitted" is displayed when trying to Release the Service Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Confirmations view.-Find Service Confirmation ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Service Confirmation).-Release the document.-Error "Not more than 1 parties of role Supplier permitted" is displayed and the release won't be possible.-Cause-One of the reasons for this to happen is when there is an empty "Supplier" party in the Service Order.-Resolution-Follow these steps:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Confirmations view.-Find Service Confirmation ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Service Confirmation).-Open the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Open Service Order DEF (Where DEF Represents the ID of the Service Order that generated Service Confirmation ABC).-Click on View All in the Service Order.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Here, you see that there is an entry for a "Supplier" party with no value maintained. In order to avoid the error in the Service Confirmation, you have two options:-Add a value for the "Supplier" party in the Service Order.-Remove the entire "Supplier" party from the Service Order.-Keywords-ID of party with role Supplier missing, Error, Issue, Release not possible, Unable, Service Confirmation, Service Order, SO, SC, Party, Parties.

Title: Change the Supplier Address in Return to Supplier Delivery
Content: Symptom-You are unable to change the supplier address when making a Post Goods Issue against Return to Supplier Proposals or New Return to Supplier.-Environment-Sap Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Choose Common task 'New Return to Supplier' -Select the respective entry and click on next-You will notice there is no option to choose the supplier address from drop down option.-However, you can change the information in all of the ship-to address fields manually.-Cause-When you create a new Return to Supplier Delivery the system automatically enters the supplier's ship-to party along with the address details.-Resolution-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Choose Outbound Deliveries view.-Show Return to Supplier Deliveries and find your DEF (DEF - Represent Return to Supplier Delivery)-Choose Edit ( DEF - should be in Not Released status )-Select the hyperlink Address Details under Ship-to Address section.-Change the address.-Save and ﻿Release.

Title: The Button View Data XML is Grayed Out in the Output History of Service Order or Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a Service Order or a Sales Order where the output channel is XML and completed the Order. However when you go to output history tab, the button View Data XML is grayed out and you cannot see any output data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesting-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a Service Order:-Go to the Service Order work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Select the relevant Service Order.-Select View All and navigate to Output History tab-The View Data XML button is grayed out .-Cause-Sales Orders or Service Orders can either be created manually in the system, or automatically by a business-to-business (B2B) message, or Intercompany Repair Scenario (A2A) message from an external system. In case of B2B messages, the Sales or Service Orders are electronically transferred in the form of XML messages.--Hence in B2B Scenario there will be no feasibility to see the data by selecting View Data XML.--For a manual entry, as long as the Service Order or Sales Order Confirmation is not send to the Account by selecting the Submit button and Send Order Confirmation to Account, the Output Document will not be generated and hence no Output History will be avaliable and in tune no XML will be avaiable for display.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-See Also-2221148 - The Button View Data XML is Grayed Out in the Output History of Purchase Order Document

Title: Incorrect posting date of the Expense report
Content: Symptom-When posting an Expense Report from the SAP Concur to the SAP Business ByDesign, you noticed that the posting date of the expense report in the SAP Business ByDesign is not the same as the report date in the SAP Concur.-     Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Concur-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, Post Concur Documents Run view-Click New, and then Post Concur Documents Run-Enter all the necessary details for the run-When the run is finished, the status of the successfully posted expense reports is set to Posted and journal entries gets created for these reports.-You notice that the posting date is not the expected date-Cause-When using the standard integration between the SAP Concur and SAP Business ByDesign, the integration solution is taking over the Submit Date from the SAP Concur expense report as posting date in SAP Business ByDesign. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you would like to change this behavior, you can use the CPI integration, then, you can map the "reportUserDefinedDate" field to "reportSubmitDate" field. In this case, the system will use the Report date of the Expense report as Posting date in the SAP Business ByDesign.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide-Post Expense Reports in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Expense, report, concur, posting date, report date, incorrect, wrong date

Title: Extension fields added in a custom node under XBO are not available to be enhanced to standard forms or reports
Content: Symptom-You have added an extension field to a custom node from an extended business object but the fields cannot be enhanced to a form or report.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisites: You have created an extension field under a custom node from an extended business object (.XBO) in your solution.-Login to Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the custom solution.-Right click on affected XBO file.-Switch on admin mode.-Click on Enhance Form or Enhance Data Source options.-The custom node field cannot be selected.-Cause-Extension fields added in a custom node under an extended business object (.XBO) will not be available on enhanced report (data source) or form.-Resolution-You would need to add the extension field on another standard BO node which is extensible.-Keywords-SDK, PDI, enhance, form, report, extension, fields, not, availble, missing

Title: Field Open Quantity in Order UoM not populated during Post Goods Issue.
Content: Symptom-When creating an outbound delivery it does not appear the quantity in order UoM (Unit of Measure).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to the Delivery Proposal View.-Find the Delivery Proposal ID ABC (ABC means the Delivery Proposal ID).-Click Post Goods Issue.-Notice that the tab “Open Quantity in Order UoM” is empty.-Cause-If a conversion with the batch managed indicator enabled is not maintained, the field Open Quantity in Order UoM will not be populated during Post Goods Issue.-Resolution-In Product Master Data, it is necessary to maintain a conversion with the batch managed indicator enabled. Then the field Open Quantity in Order UoM will be populated during Post Goods Issue.-Keywords-UoM, Post Goods Issue, Outbound Delivery, Batch Managed, Delivery Proposal

Title: Prevent Automatic Logoff of Users
Content: Symptom-The system signs out a user after an hour of inactivity in a particular screen. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center. -Navigate to the Task Control view-Select a task, choose the confirm button. -Leave the screen as is for an hour, after an hour the system times out. -The business user wants this time out to be extended and wants to have this increased at-least up to four hours.-PS : Please note that if the user is inactive in any screen in ByDesign the same behaviour can be observed.-Cause-For security reasons users are automatically logged off the system if they have been inactive in the system for a certain period of time. You have to adjust the Inactivity Duration value in the system to prevent auto log-off by the system. You will not be able to completely disable the auto user logoff option in the system. -Resolution-Please follow below given steps to adjust/change the Inactivity Duration in the system.-Navigate to and select the User Icon in the top right corner of ByDesign system.-Choose the Key User Settings Option and select Company Settings. -Navigate to the auto Logoff tab. -In the field Inactivity Duration you can define the duration of inactive time. -You can choose from 15 minutes to 4 hours as Inactivity Duration. -If you leave this field empty the system will logoff inactive users from the system after one hour. -Keywords-auto logoff, disable auto logoff, system timeout, automatic time out, disable automatic timeout, screen timeout , automatic screen time out

Title: ISO20022 Bank Statement File Upload: System Is Not Able to Create Multiple Bank Statement Files
Content: Symptom-While uploading bank statement file with import format 'ISO20022 Bank Statement' containing more than one bank statement in the XML file, system only creates/posts one bank statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Click New -> Inbound File.-Enter data required data, such as Company and Bank ID (Import Format ISO20022 Bank Statement will de derived).-Upload respective XML file.-Click Start File Upload.-As a result, notice that system has created one bank statement from the file, while there was two bank statements contained in the XML file.-For example, in the respective XML file there is two occurrences of line <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?.-  Cause-Combining various files into one will create an issue in SAP Business ByDesign. Every bank statement has to be uploaded separately.-When the bank complete bank statement is copied or combined with another one, including all document elements this will create an invalid XML document.-Resolution-Each file should be uploaded separately. If it is the bank providing the file in this format then it might be advisable to ask if the bank can separate the bank statements (might even be a setting if it is a self-service portal).-Keywords-CAMT.053; ISO20022; XML

Title: Migration of Fixed Assets Fails With Error Message Cost Center XXX Does Not Exist in Profit Center YYY For Fixed Asset INTERN-00001-0
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Fixed Assets. While processing the file in the migration tool, in the Simulate Import step you get the error message Cost center XXX does not exist in profit center YYY for fixed asset INTERN-00001-0.-XXX stands for Cost Center ID.-YYY stands for Profit Center ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool-Select the respective Migration Unit and click Execute Migration-Select the respective Migration Object (Fixed Assets) and click Process File  -In the Simulate Import step, you will see the error message in the Log table (you will see one message per affected source record):--Cost Center XXX Does Not Exist in Profit Center YYY For Fixed Asset INTERN-00001-0-Cause-Likely causes (mutually exclusive):-In the org. structure, the org. unit with ID XXX is both Cost Center and Profit Center. In this case, when system tries to derive the Profit Center for the XXX, unit itself is identified as Profit Center, and hence the system raise the error message.-In the org. structure, the org. unit with ID YYY is not the Profit Center for org. unit XXX. It is the Profit Center hierarchically above the Profit Center for XXX.-Resolution-You should review your org. structure and correct the Profit Center ID in the Fixed Asset Migration Template accordingly.-After that, the Simulate Import step should finish successfully.-Keywords-Migration; Fixed Asset; Cost Center; Profit Center; Accounting Transaction Data; org. structure;

Title: How to Handle HTTP Error While Receiving Response Error in Custom Web Service For Custom Business Object Instance Creation
Content: Symptom-You have created an external web service which results in error. The error says "HTTP error while receiving response". Now, you would like to use such failure request to create instances in a custom business object via script in order to handle such scenarios. -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Custom Business Object.-Create an External Web Service.-Send a Request for External Web Service.-You can see "HTTP error while receiving response".-Now, you create a script to create an instance in custom business object when the web service response has aforementioned error message.-The instances of the custom business object are not saved. -Cause-These errors are raised because web service fails and even before taking exact error of the web service response, the system already raises "HTTP error while receiving response" error message. Since it is an Error (E) message, the system does not save those instances, which is expected from a technical system perspective. In summary, if the web service itself fails, then the system raises error message and consequently the save also fails. - Resolution-The system currently does not support such scenario. There is no way to handle these web service errors since these error messages will be raised and prevent you to save any instance in custom business objects.-Keywords-HTTP error while receiving response, web service, business object, save fails, custom web service

Title: System crashes When Opening the Activity "Addtional_Surcharge" in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-System crashes when opening the activity Addtional_Surcharge in Business Configuration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view .-Search and open the activity Addtional_Surcharge.-Click Configure Pricing Procedure.-After few seconds, you receive a system exception. -Cause-The activity Addtional_Surcharge should not be available for edition.-Resolution-We will delete the business configuration edit screen for Addtional_Surcharge in a future release. Until then please follow the workaround below.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view .-Click in Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Search and open the activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on Pricing Procedure.-You can see that the Price Component Surcharge is available in step 71, 72, 73 and 74.-See Also-"additional surcharges" "pricing procedure" Cannot "activity list"

Title: IRN not Generated for B2C E-Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created an Invoice document in a B2C (Business to Customer) scenario and the IRN (Invoice Reference Number) was not generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-IRN is missing under the General tab.-Cause-For the B2C scenario, the IRN generation is not relevant.-As per the Generate IRN website, the category of transaction of "Business to Consumer (B2C)" invoices will not be considered and hence the API interface should not request for IRN for these transactions.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-Generate IRN-Electronic Invoicing - India-QR Code on B2C Invoices – India-Keywords-IRN, Invoice, India, B2C, Customer Invoice, E-Invoicing

Title: Concur Expense Report Posting Failed With Message 'The status of expense report was changed to 'Posting Failed'.'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-DO NOT USE - TO BE REVISED -An expense report fetched from Concur has Posting Failed status with Information message 'The status of expense report was changed to 'Posting Failed'.'-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur view --> Expense Reports subview.-Find the respective Report Key / Report ID, notice Status Posting Failed and message 'The status of expense report was changed to 'Posting Failed'.'-Cause-In the respective JSON file, the parameter "isTest" has been filled with "Y", indicating that the Employee ID was created as a test user in Concur.-That's the reason why the expense report has been marked as Posting Failed in SAP Business ByDesign.-The Test User feature allows clients to safely test SAP Concur functionality within the production environment. Test user is not a role assigned to an employee. Instead, test user is an attribute of an employee. Once the checkbox "Is a Test User?" is checked in Concur, it cannot be undone.-Resolution-The system behaves as expected here.-Keywords- expense report; posting failed; istest; json; test user

Title: How to accomodate Blanket Purchase Order in Business ByDesign system?
Content: Symptom-You need blanket purchase order(PO refers to purchase order) functionality for your business usecase because you cannot specify the exact quantity in the purchase order document while creating it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to Business ByDesign system-Select Purchase Requests and Orders work center-There is no option to create blanket purchase order-Cause-Blanket purchase order terminology is not used in business bydesign system, hence you do not see any option to create blanket PO.-Resolution-Instead of blanket PO, we use Limit Item. It is applicable for Non-stock material and service.--When you do not know the details of a Non-stock material or Service that you want, you can create a limit item in a shopping cart or in a-purchase order. In the SAP Business ByDesign solution, limit items are items that are assigned a maximum value limit rather than a price in a purchase document.--When creating a limit item in a shopping cart or purchase order, a material, service, or related expense is not specified.-This information is entered later in the goods and services receipt or supplier invoice.-When you create a new Purchase Order, when you add an item, under Item Type, in the drop-down, you can select limit .Once you select Limit item type, the Process type will be either Direct or Third-party .-See Also-Please go through these Help Documents for your understanding.---Limit Items--Add a Limit Item to a Shopping Cart--Process Types of Purchase Order Items--Create a Goods and Services Receipt for Open Limit Items--Confirm the Delivery of a Limit Item from a Shopping Cart-Keywords-limit item, blanket PO

Title: Purchase Order is not Going for Approval after Selecting Send Update
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a purchase order and it was sent to supplier directly, now you made changes in the purchase order e.g.net value to meet the approval conditions, but order is not sent for approval on selecting send update and goes to sent status directly.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Create a purchase order which does not meet the approval conditions defined and select order-Purchase order is sent to supplier-Now change the net value as per the conditions set and select send update-Purchase Order is again re-sent to supplier directly without going through approval-Cause-You have not scoped header reapproval  question.-If you want the same purchase order to go for approval on making changes to the order, then you need to scope header re-approval.-You also have option to scope item level approval which is based on changes to specific fields only, however if you scope item approval, then system will trigger item approval and then header reapproval will be triggered because item approval cannot be scoped without header reapproval.-If you scope the approval process for purchase orders at item level, the header re-approval process will be scoped automatically.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration-> under scoping questions for Purchasing-> Purchase orders-> scope this question: "Do you want to use the header re-approval process for purchase orders?"-and if your business requires item approval as well, you can scope  "Do you want to use an approval process for purchase orders at item level?".-Keywords-purchase order approval, header reapproval-header re-approval,purchase order approval

Title: MRP (Material Requirement Planning) not Generating Production Proposal
Content: Symptom-You expected that the Production Proposal would be created by MRP (Material Requirement Planning) run when available stock is below the Reorder Point.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Product view.-Open Advanced Search. -Insert Product's ID.-Insert Product's specification.-Insert Planning area.-Click Go button.-Click Open button.-Click Run Planning button and select Single BoM level.-Click Ok.-Notice that no production proposal is created.-Cause-With Product Specification involved, Reorder Point Quantity is not considered. As whenever Product Specification is involved, Lot-Sizing Method is always Lot-for-Lot.-Resolution-This scenario is the system's expected behavior.-See Also-KBA: 2167113 - Reorder Point Not Considered When MRP is Executed-KBA: 1842595 - MRP Run Does Not Create Any Proposals for Consumption Based Planning-Keywords-MRP, BoM, Product, Production Proposal, Planning area, Product Specification

Title: Journal Entry of a Supplier Invoice Posted Into a Migration G/L Account
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Supplier Invoice and expected that system should have used a Purchase Ledger Account in the Journal Entry, however the respective Journal Entry posted into a Migration Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Invoice.-Click Edit.-Press View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the Journal Entry.-System posted into a Migration Account, for example 'XYZ - Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables' (XYZ represents the G/L Account).-Cause-The Migration Account was used because the referenced Inbound Delivery in the Cost Distribution of the Invoice is not a document that has been created in the system.-The migrated document can be identified in the Document Flow of the Invoice, you will note that the Document ID of the Inbound Delivery is grayed out.-When there is a migrated document involved in the chain, it will be taken into account which is why the Item with migrated document posted into G/L Account 'XYZ- Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables'.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-See Also-SAP Knowledge Base Article: 2817678 - Supplier Invoice Journal Entry Posting to a Balance Sheet Account-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Journal Entry; Migration Account; Cost Distribution; Supplier Invoice; G/L account; Journal Entry;

Title: Object is inactive. Please activate it in the UI-Designer.
Content: Symptom-When performing a PDI solution consistency check or activation pdi in the Cloud Applications Studio, the following error appears:-Object myscreen.EC.uicomponent is inactive. Please activate it in the UI-Designer. (Where myscreen represents the UI component name)-Object PM00001.MC.uimashup is inactive. Please activate it in the UI-Designer. (Where PM00001 represents the mashup name)-Check and activate the file myscreen2.EC.uicomponent in the UI designer. (Where myscreen2 represents the UI component name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Cloud Applications Studio. -Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open your solution YABCDEFY (YABCDEFY represents the solution name).-In the Solution Explorer section, right-click on the solution name and select Activate -> All Items or Check -> Items and Runtime Objects.-Error message is prompted.-Cause-The object runtime data has not been created or updates post performing the changes in the UI designer.-Resolution-You would need to launch the affected object in the UI Designer and activate the same.-See Also-You can also refer to https://blogs.sap.com/2018/11/16/checkmate-in-ui-designer/ for identifying these erorrs while modeling the solution.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, error, assemble, items, runtime

Title: Cannot Login to Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You cannot login to Cloud Applications Studio although this tenant is accessible in the web browser.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business Bydesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio -Fill in user and password -Click OK-Your user cannot login to Cloud Applications Studio -Resolution-Please kindly check the following suggestions.-1. Copy the URL used in the Cloud Applications Studio and paste this URL in the web browser to check if this URL is accessible in the fronted UI. If not, please kindly correct your URL.-2. Go to Cloud Applications Studio-> Administration->Options and settings-> Runtime data-> Clear cache--3. Try to re-install Cloud Applications Studio-4. Try to check with different valid PDI users. The valid PDI user needs to be assigned to the following Work centers: Partner Development; Business Analytics; Administrator(for C4C) or Application and User Management(for BYD)-5. Try to check with different network home/office etc.-6.  Go to Cloud Applications Studio-> Administration->Options and settings-> get the Projects Location-Try to go to the Projects Location Folder displayed above -> Delete all the folders.--7. Close all the tabs like Community and Repository Explorer before logging into Cloud Applications Studio -8. Go to Cloud Applications Studio-> Administration->Options and settings->Connectivity tab->Try to use select/deselect HTTP proxy http://proxy:8080-Keywords-Login; Cloud Applications Studio;SDK;user

Title: OData Error: only filter to multiple single values
Content: Symptom-When running an OData URL for your report, you face the following error message:-only filter to multiple single values-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The default selection type of this field is "Multi-value", meaning that only single values or multiple single values can be used in the filter.-As a consequence, only the selection option EQ (equals) be used.-To check the selection type, please run a metadata query on your report and search for your characteristic. Check the property sap:filter-restriction="multi-value".-Resolution-If you would like to use options other than EQ, you can consider the following workaround:-Copy the report if it's standard, or edit it with the report wizard if it's a custom report.-Go to step 4.-Find your field and change the "Value Selection" to "Using Variable".-Go to step 5. -Change the "Selection Type" to "Any Selection".-Save this report.-Now create an Odata URL which shows the metadata of your report, for example:-https://<your system URL>/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/$metadata?entityset=RP<your report ID>QueryResults-Search for your field and take note of the field ID. Note that it will be listed twice now, once with the usual characteristic ID, and once with a variable ID. The variable ID starts with PAR or PARA*. Please take note of the variable ID.-Run your usual OData query once again, however replace the characteristic ID with the variable ID.-Now options such as NE or BT will work.-Keywords- property only filter to multiple single values, odata, error message, selection type, value help type, report, data source, build odata queries

Title: Form Template Change Language While Printing
Content: Symptom-You have created a form template in your language but at the time of printing the information is shown in English.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance View.-Search and Select the affected Form Template.-Click Open > Easy Form Editor.-You will see the information prints out in English.-Cause-This happens because the activity Additional Communication Languages is not in the Project.-This Activity allows you to communicate in languages other than the logon languages chosen during scoping, you can select a number of languages from the list of available communication languages. The system then supports the translation of certain texts on system UIs and printed forms into these allowed communication languages.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and click on Open Activity List.-Then search in All Activities for Additional Communication Languages.-See that it says it is not in the Project.-Select the Activity and click on Add to Project.-After following the steps above and setting up the activity, the future printings shall come out in the selected language.-Keywords-Template, Language, Missing, Changed, Incorrect, Inconsistent, Communication, Print

Title: Form Templates for a Certain Country/Region are Missing in Form Template Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that they cannot find form templates for a certain country/region and language combination in the Form Template Maintenance work center.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Under Business Flexibility, access the Form Template Maintenance work center view.-Search for a form template filtering by a certain country/region.-No results are found.-Cause-The relevant form template versions for a country/region are automatically generated once that country/region is scoped (except in some cases for non-localized and pre-localized country/regions—check the See Also section for more information).-However, an inconsistency can occur sometimes which will cause the relevant templates to not be generated properly.-Resolution-To solve this inconsistency:-Open the tenant's backend-Go to transaction SE38.-Enter P_XREP_CORE_GENERATE_FORM in the field, then click Execute (or press F8).-Uncheck the "Test Only?" check box.-Check the "TPXD" box.-Check the "Always generate even no chang?" box.-At this point, selection should look like this:----Run the report by clicking Execute or pressing F8.-The report will re-generate all missing form templates and solve the issue.-See Also-2104897 - Form Templates for a Certain Template Group are Missing in Form Template Maintenance-Keywords-Form Template, Country, Language, Missing, P_XREP_CORE_GENERATE_FORM, Form Template Maintenance-p_xrep_core_generate_form,regenerate,form regenrate,form templates missing,form missing,form templates view,reload,missing form

Title: Error Message: "Upload of MIME Type Application/jpeg not permitted" While Synchronizing With System in Outlook Add-in
Content: Symptom-You are trying to synchronize an e-mail with an attachment that is an image file. However, the system is throwing an error:-'Upload of MIME type application/jpeg not permitted'.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The system does not currently support emails with the specified MIME Type. In order for the system to receive such emails, you need to allow this specific MIME Type in the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-You may add the MIME Type using the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload.-Select Add Row.-Make Z entry for MIME Type application/jpeg and select Allowed checkbox.-Select Save.-Once it is allowed, the system will accept E-mails that have MIME Type.-Keywords-MIME type, Outlook, Jpeg, Image

Title: Sales Documents Actual Costing reports - No report data available to display; check the selection
Content: Symptom-You execute the-Sales Documents Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown(Item Type) report (technical ID: FININVU18_Q0001) or Sales Documents Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown(G/L Account) report  (technical ID FININVU18_Q0002) and observe that there is no data over the screen. Instead, the message 'No report data available to display; check the selection' appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Search for the Sales Documents Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown(Item Type) or the Sales Documents Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown(G/L Account) report.-You can see the message 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Cause-These reports are based on the data source FININVU18 which fetches data from the Material Actual Costing screen. If no data is displayed in the report then there is no data in this view.-To display data here, you have to execute the Actual Cost Rollup Run.-Resolution-Go to the Inventory Management work center.-Select Periodic Tasks view --> Actual Cost Rollup subview.-Create and Execute the Actual Cost Rollup run.-You can see the data in Material Actual Costing view. -As a result, you can execute the Sales Documents Actual Costing reports which will now display data.-Keywords-No report data available to display; check the selection, Sales Documents Actual Costing, FININVU18_Q0001 & FININVU18_Q0002

Title: Tax Return Currency X Differs From Currency Y of Country Z
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-No Journal Entry is created for a Supplier invoice with a failed XML message from SupplierInvoiceProcessing to AccountingInvoiceAccountingIn with the error: Tax return currency X differs from currency Y of country Z.-The XI message cannot be restarted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The currency would be converted to a taxable country currency if an exchange rate was maintained.-Such an exchange rate is either not configured or the validity date does not precede that of the invoice.-Resolution-A valid date for the exchange rate should be maintained by the customer under General Ledger work center --> Edit exchange rates view.-The customer must then cancel the invoice and create a new invoice with the same details.-The customer should revert so that Expert Support can then cancel the original XI message.-Remark: to be able to cancel the XI message in Message Monitor (t-code SRT_MONI), a user with L6 access level should be requested. Otherwise, the message 'No authority to cancel messages' will be displayed.-Keywords-tax return currency; exchange rate

Title: No Template Code in the Predefined Output Determination Rule Error on Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you try to release a Customer Invoice, the system displays an error: There's no template code in the predefined output determination rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Open Customer Invoice ABC (ABC Represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Click on the Release button.-You see the error: There's no template code in the predefined output determination rule.-Cause-This error is shown when the system cannot find a valid Output Determination Rule for Customer Invoice which fits the information maintained in this document.-Resolution-To fix this, you need to create a rule that fits the information maintained in the Customer Invoice (Either Bill-To, Seller/Invoicing Unit or Business Document type).-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Form Template Selection view.-Show Rules For: Customer Invoice.-Click on the New button.-Maintain the desired information.-As a general tip, the system checks the rules created from top to bottom, so you can maintain a generic rule at the bottom with just the desired Form Template Code and Business Document as Invoice in order to have a fallback rule and avoid this error.-See Also-2982572 - Error :Form template is mandatory or Error Message:There's no Template Code in the Predefined Output Determination Rule-Keywords-Customer Invoice ; Predefined Output Determination ; Template ; Release ; Preview

Title: Wrong Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in Return
Content: Symptom-When you open a Return document you face an error related to having a mismatch between Sales Organization and Distribution Channel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Return).-Click Edit.-Error:  The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data. Check your entries in the document or the product master.-Cause-The reason the system is returning this error is because under the material master data the sales information maintained in the Return document is showing with status Blocked.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To solve this, please proceed with the following:-Add a valid combination between Sales Organization and Distribution Channel.-Or-Change the status of the Distribution Chain to Active and perform the following:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Remove the Sales Unit and Distribution Channel data.-Click Enter.-Add the Sales Unit again.-Now the system will retrieve the value as expected and will eliminate the error.-See Also-2737560 - The Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in the Document Do Not Match with the Product Master Sales Data.-Keywords-Sales Unit, Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Error, Return

Title: The 'Manage Document Output History' Report is not Displaying any Data
