Content: Symptom-Despite selecting various views and filters, no data appears in the 'Manage Document Output History' report when it is run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Select Design Reports View.-Search for Manage Document Output History and open it.-Determine the Selection and run it.-No report data available to display; check the selection-Cause-The required Work Center Views are not assigned to the employee.-Resolution-As a key user, you can perform these actions only if the following Work Center Views are assigned to the user:-OUTPUT_RETRY_CUST_INV: This work center view allows you to resubmit or retry Customer Invoice documents from the report.-OUTPUT_RETRY_SUPP_INV: This work center view allows you to resubmit or retry Supplier Invoice documents from the report.-OUTPUT_RETRY_DELIVERY_NOTES: This work center view allows you to resubmit or retry Delivery Notes from the report.-OUTPUT_RETRY_GOODS_SRV_RCPT: This work center view allows you to resubmit or retry Goods and Services Receipts from the report.-Please, assign above Work Center Views to the employee in order to access 'Manage Document Output History' Report.-See Also-Manage Document Output History-Keywords-Manage Document Output History, Analytics, Design Reports

Title: Dump When Trying to Restore Default Values for Account Determination Groups
Content: Symptom-System crashes when trying to restore values for Account Determination Groups.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and click Open Activity List button.-Search for Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and select it.-Click Change Immediately button.-Click Edit Account Determination Groups option.-Click Restore Defaults.-Select default values that you want to restore.-Click Restore.-Dump occurs.-Cause-It's a product limitation.-Resolution-When restoring the default values, you should choose the corresponding subledger where the restoration needs to happen.-For example: You need to select "Groups for Customers" under "Accounts Receivable" and then click Restore in order restore the values.-The restoration will also not reflect immediately, therefore it is necessary to save and go out and come back into the screen.-Keywords-Dump, Restore, Restore Default Values, Account Determination Group

Title: How to Trace the Demand Document Elements Which Corresponding to the Proposal Created by MRP
Content: Symptom-A proposal is created by MRP. Open the Material Flow, you will find a demand document which corresponds this proposal.-You want to understand how to trace the demand document elements in SAP Cloud Application Studio(SDK).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Here are the steps to navigate to the Demand Elements from Production (Purchase) Proposal in SDK.-Case 1: For Production Proposal,-From Proposal to Material Flow (BO: PlannedMaterialFlow).-        ProductionPlanningOrder -> MainMaterialOutput -> MaterialSupplyPlannedMaterialFlow...-    2. PlannedMaterialFlow.-        for DemandMaterialFlowElementTypeCode = 7 - Schedule line of a supply planning requirement-    3. From Material Flow to Customer Demand (Sales Order, Service Order, Stock Transfer Order and Project Stock Order).-        ...-> SupplyPlanningRequirementItemScheduleLine -> ToRoot -> Item -> CustomerRequirementItemReference...-        ...-> CustomerRequirementExternalRequestItem -> BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentItemReference-    4. Fields.-        BusinessTransactionDocumentReference/TypeCode (114 – Sales Order, 117 – Service Order, 814 – Stock Transfer Order, 1940 - Project Stock Order)-        BusinessTransactionDocumentReference/ID/content : <Document ID>-        BusinessTransactionDocumentReference/ItemID : <Item ID>-Case 2: For Purchase Proposal,-From Proposal to Material Flow (BO: PlannedMaterialFlow).-        ProcurementPlanningOrder -> Item -> ItemScheduleLine -> MaterialSupplyPlannedMaterialFlow...-    2. PlannedMaterialFlow.-        for DemandMaterialFlowElementTypeCode = 7 - Schedule line of a supply planning requirement-    3. From Material Flow to Customer Demand (Sales Order, Service Order, Stock Transfer Order and Project Stock Order).-        ...-> SupplyPlanningRequirementItemScheduleLine -> ToRoot -> Item ->  LogisticsExecutionRequistion-Confirmation Item...-        ...-> Item -> BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentItemReference-    4. Fields.-        BusinessTransactionDocumentReference/TypeCode (114 – Sales Order, 117 – Service Order, 814 – Stock Transfer Order, 1940 - Project Stock Order)-        BusinessTransactionDocumentReference/ID/content : <Document ID>-        BusinessTransactionDocumentReference/ItemID : <Item ID>-Keywords-MRP; Proposal; SDK; Demand Element.

Title: Not able to add UI text for web service
Content: Symptom-When checking the WSIL information in the Service Explorer view you notice that the </wsil:name> tag has the following value:-UI text missing for YABCDEFGY_II_YABCXYZQITRFOPCTU (where YABCDEFGY_II_YABCXYZQITRFOPCTU represents the web service name)-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator or Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer View.-Select the filter 'Inbound Partner Service Interface'. -Click at Open WSIL button.-Cause-The system does not support adding UI texts for custom web services, so it is not possible to change the UI texts.-Resolution-The UI texts for custom web services created from the Studio can not be changed.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, UI text missing, wsil, name, tag, web, service

Title: How to find Time Entry from Backend which created the Goods Receipt document? [INTERNAL USE ONLY]
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer wants to cancel a GSR document which is in preparation status and created from time entry but user does not know how to identify the time entry. How to find the relevant time entry from backend?[INTERNAL USE ONLY]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-UI:-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center-Select view Receipts and Returns: Show by Documents-Filter by PO, Service agent and Created Based on:Employee time confirmation-You can see the list of GSRs created for the relevant time entries.-Now you can check the delivery date and creation date of the GSR and -Go to Project -> Gantt chart-> Under work tab, select the service agent and relevant task for which time entry got created-Select Display History-You can see all the time entries here-Search for time entry for that delivery date (provision date) and created on (approval date) and delivered quantity(in hrs/days)-You can find the relevant time entry, and cross check the details-Backend:-How to check time entry in Backend:-SESFTS:-BO: /SRMAP/LPURX_GSA->-Load by Query-> Root_Query by elements->search with GSR ID: XXX-Navigate->EMPL_TM_CAL_PERD_ITMREF-BTD_REF-ID-CONTENT: YYY-This is the relevant time entry id.-Resolution-You can give the time entry details to the customer to cancel from their end.-If they are not ready to cancel, you can contact AP-TIM-TIM development.-Keywords-how to find time entry from backend, Time confirmation status is "Pending cancellation" because purchase order is Canceled, User is unable to cancel time entries, Referenced purchase order canceled

Title: How to Check for XI Messages in the Backend with SE38 and FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have noticed that there is a Process Communication Error on a document or the relevant Business Process is incomplete due to a document being stuck in accounting or associated to a Business Task﻿.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The most common way to notice a Process Communication Error or a pending Business Task is to navigate to the Document Flow of the relevant Business Transaction.-You can also check if an an accounting document is stuck in accounting:-Open the General Ledger work center-Navigate to the Closing Cockpit view-Navigate to Subview Source Documents-Show: Unposted Source Documents-Search if the relevant Source Document can be found there-If there is a Process Communication Error, it can be checked in the Application and Users Management Work Centre:-Open the Work Centre Application and Users Management-Navigate to View Business Data Consistency-Navigate to subview Process Communication Errors-Show Errors with Incident-Check if the impacted document is there-Cause-These are issues that can be due to an XI message that failed to deliver in the backend.-Resolution-In order to check if this is the case, you can use transaction SE38 and the report FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI to verify if any XI messages failed to deliver:-Request an L6 Support User from the CAM Tool:-Click STFK Connection link: On the new window that opens, click Allow-Request opening of the backend by selecting R/3 Support and then click the "Request Opening" button-Check that the system is going to be opened for 4 hours, click Open-Go back to the Service Connection Screen, click the "Logon" button-Select Incident Processing > click OK > No password-In the new window that opens, maintain the tenant ID as well as the User and Password generated by the CAM Tool-Click the green tick in the top left-hand corner to log in-You are now in SAP Easy Access - Type in your transaction in the search field, here, SE38. Activate the green tick again to open the transaction-In Program, search with the Value Help or type in FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI, then execute => click the clock with the green tick icon (or press F8 on your keyboard)-For the next step, you will need the Operational Document Type, i.e. Supplier Invoice, Goods and Services Receipt, etc, as well as its ID. Use the Value Help to find the Reference of the Document Type you need. Keep the Display Options set on XI messages-Execute again-If any message is to be found, it will then be displayed-Once there, you can take note of the message ID and include it in your analysis.-Here we can see that the status of one of the messages is clearly in error. One thing that can be done is to restart it (select the line first, it's highlighted in yellow)-Please consult with one of your senior colleagues before attempting to act on anything!-Keywords-SE38; FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI; PCE; XI; RESTART

Title: Label or Content of Report Field is Missing in Some Logon Languages
Content: Symptom-You are using a report and notice that for some fields, the label is either missing or in the wrong language. Alternatively, the content of that field (for example if it is a codelist field) is not showing the correct description, but the ID.-For example, you log on in German but some report fields show English labels or no labels at all, either in the report view or selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center that your report is assigned to.-Go to the report list and open your report.-You will notice wrong / missing labels for some fields. This can happen in the view or in the selection area.-Cause-The fields are extension fields or codelist fields and no translation was maintained.-Resolution-If the field was created in the system (key user tool extension field), please maintain the translation as follows:-Go to the work center view and screen where this field was created.-Click Adapt and enter the adaptation mode (in C4C: Edit Master Layout).-Mark and edit the field. In C4C, this is done by clicking Field Definition. In ByDesign, please click Further Usage.-In the general tab, you will see a table where you can enter labels and descriptions for different languages. Make sure that there is a label in every language used in the system, and also that the values for that field are maintained for each relevant language.-If the field was created via PDI, the translation has to be maintained in the Studio. For details, please open the help center in the Studio and check the document called Translation.-Keywords-Business Analytics, report, data source, field name missing, analysis, translation, wrong language, description missing, ID, codelist

Title: Wrong Cost for Sales Document being Calculated
Content: Symptom-The cost for invoicing and sales documents is calculated incorrectly, distorting the profit margin, even though the ship from location contains a valid business residence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Select Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Over-the-Counter Sale).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Click Expand.-The cost value displayed for the items is not being calculated as expected.-Cause-The cost component for individual items is calculated based on the business residence maintained in Inventory Valuation work center, under the Material Unit Costs subview.-If the document is not able to determine a valid business residence, it will take the average value of all business residences maintained for that product, as per KBA 2547292.-In order to use the ship-from location to determine the business residence, a valid Identified Stock ID must be maintained for the item, otherwise the system will revert to the above functionality of taking the average of all business residences.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Maintaining a valid Identified Stock ID in the document and triggering a pricing recalculation will allow the costs to be calculated correctly.-This is also considered as a new requirement and it was added in the Product Backlog in order to enhance the functionality with this feature in one of the future product releases. Meanwhile, another possibility is to reach out Development Partner for a Custom Add-On Solution.-See Also-2547292 - Cost Component of Items in Sales Order Shows Incorrect Value-Keywords-Over-the-Counter, Sale, Cost, Ship-From, Wrongly, Calculated, Calculate, Wrong, Sales Quote

Title: Logic for Populating the Actual Execution Dates in Warehouse Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You want to understand the populating logic for the Actual Execution Date of standard/ adjustment Warehouse Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Delivery Work Center.-Navigate to Monitoring - By Warehouse Order View.-Search for the Warehouse Order XXX.-Edit it and go to Confirmations Tab.-You note that there is a field "Actual Execution on" for warehouse confirmations and you want to know where the value comes from.-Cause-[Enter your Cause here...]-Resolution-Business transaction date/time for both standard and adjustment confirmation: it comes from the arrival date on confirmed inbound delivery – it is this date that gets sent to FIN. as posting date; this can be validated with the General Ledger postings for both the confirmations in FIN..-Transaction date/time (Actual Execution on) for standard confirmation: can be edited while posting the confirmation and this date/time can be different from the creation date/time of the confirmation.-Transaction date/time (Actual Execution on) for adjustment confirmation: this gets copied from the business transaction date/time which cannot be modified.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Actual Execution On; Business Transaction Date; Warehouse Confirmation.

Title: Unposted Customer Invoice Error: 'Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue'
Content: Symptom-A Customer Invoice appears as Unposted Source Document with the error message 'Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC - Chart of Accounts and account determination profile <XYZ>. Column Path Sales -> Revenues (Service)->Sales Revenue, Item Type Sales Revenue'-(ABC represents the Chart of Accounts).-(XYZ represents the Account Determination Profile).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center and navigate to the Source Documents view. -By default Unposted Source Documents appear.-Find the Customer invoice in question and select it. -The error  'Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC - Chart of Accounts and account determination profile <XYZ>. Column Path Sales -> Revenues (Service)->Sales Revenue, Item Type Sales Revenue' appears. -Cause-There is a Product maintained in the Customer Invoice with missing account determination settings in Fine Tuning.-In the invoice press the Product ID to open its Master Data.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-Take note of the Account Determination Group DEF entered here. (DEF represents the assigned Account Determination Group). -Resolution-Maintain Account Determination Group DEF with the respective G/L Account in Fine Tuning:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity. -Under Account Determination select Sales.-Go to the Revenues tab, select Services/ Materials (if the Product is a material).-Enter the item’s Account Determination in column Account Determination Group for Services/Materials and assign a G/L Account in column Sales Revenue. -Press Save and Close. -It is now possible to post the Source Document from the General Ledger via Actions - Post Business Transaction.-Keywords-Account Determination Group. Sales Revenue. Charts of Accounts. Invoice. Unposted Source Documents.

Title: How to Restore Default Account Determination Group
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The default values delviered by SAP were initially included in your fine-tuning settings but were subsequently removed or changed for your business needs.-If necessary, you can use this screen to restore these values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Go to the Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit Account Determination Groups.-There is a Restore Defaults button. Click on it. -All the deleted Group IDs will show in the popup.-Select the line that you want to restore and click Restore.-See Also-In case there's a system crash upon clicking Restore button, please consult KBA 3320517 - Dump When Trying to Restore Default Values for Account Determination Groups-2890661 - Error: General Ledger Account Alias A-1500 Does not Exist-Keywords-Default Account Determination Group, Restore Defaults

Title: The Error Message "Item : Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is Triggered in a Customer Return
Content: Symptom-The error message Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation is Triggered in a Customer Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Select and Edit Customer Return XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the customer return).-The following error message is triggered: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation-Cause-In case the Return was created with reference to an existing sales document:-Due to an inconsistency the price information was not passed successfully from the sales document and invoice to the customer return.--In case the Return was created with reference to an external sales document:-There is no valid Price in a Price List maintained for the respective product and therefore the List Price cannot be determined by the system. -Resolution-One of the workarounds below can be followed:-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Select and Edit Customer Return XYZ.-Go to View All and Select the Pricing tab.-In the Total Pricing section, select the button Update Pricing and the option Completely or the option Keep Manual Change if there was a manual change in the return.-Or-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Select and Edit Customer Return XYZ.-In the Item Pricing section, expand the respective Item.-Click the Add Row button.-In the dropdown list for the Price Component select List Price-In the Amount field, you can enter the respective Amount.-Save.-See Also-3336850 - The Error Message "Price and Tax Calculation Not Possible" is Triggered in a Customer Return-Please check that the Price List to be applied on the Customer Return is valid for the Pricing Date displayed on the associated Sales Order.-Keywords-Price list, list price, item, customer return, price determination, error message, price calculation, valid, prix, détermination du prix, liste de prix, valide, retour client, message d'erreur, poste

Title: Unable to Scope Question "Do You Want to Enable Netting of Payables and Receivables?"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer wants to select the scoping option 'Do you want to enable Netting of payables and receivables?', but finds the checkbox is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, in Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click 'Edit Project Scope'.-Click Next until you reach Step 4 - Questions.-Navigate to 'Cash Flow Management'.-Expand 'Payables and Receivables Processing'.-Expand 'Payments and Clearing'.-Under the Group: 'Netting of Payables and Receivables', find the question 'Do you want to enable Netting of payables and receivables?'.-Cause-The system won't allow scoping of netting functionality if Japan summary invoice functionality is already scoped. (path: Cash Flow Management -> Payables and Receivables Processing -> Communication for Payables and Receivables Processing -> Invoice Summary Processing-Japan).-Resolution-As a workaround, you can send the incident to the component SRD-BC-CNT-GLB-FIN, to disable the scoping of Japan summary invoice functionality from the back end. After that the User will be able to scope the Netting functionality in the UI. Before doing this you have to check whether the customer wants to use Japan summary invoice functionality and if there is any critical data which will get affected, if the scoping question of Japan summary invoice functionality gets deselected.-Keywords-netting of payables and receivables; enable scoping question; business configuration; edit project scope; netting functionality; summary invoice; Japan;

Title: Customer Invoice is not Posting Because of Error Message: 'Referenced item of Sales Order XYZ not found'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a Customer Invoice and you are getting the following error message: 'Referenced item of Sales Order XYZ not found'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub view.-Select the source document of your customer invoice DEF (DEF represents the customer invoice ID).-You will see the task 'Referenced item of Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID) not found'.-Now, you will check the Sales Order in question:-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Show All Orders.-Select your Sales Order XYZ.-You will find that the sales order is having the status Completed.-Cause-Your sales order is not posted successfully in accounting. One more Business Transaction task exists for your sales order. You can see the task by doing the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub view.-Select Unposted Source Documents.-Select the source document of your sales order XYZ.-Select the View Business Transaction button.-You will see the other Business Transaction task there. For example the task can be 'Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY is closed for closing step Operational postings'.-If there is a Process Communication Error in the Sales Order you can find the actual error message as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Process Communication Errors view.-Select Open Errors with Cases.-In the Column Sending Document ID enter the filter CreateAccountingNotification.-Select the Sales Order XYZ.-You will see the error that is causing the process communication error. For example the task can be ‘Service Execution Confimation not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked in company A’ (A represents the ID of the Company)’.-Resolution-You need to resolve the Business Transaction tasks first. Once this is done, you need to repost the source document of your sales order. After that repost the source document of your customer invoice. Your customer invoice will be posted successfully in accounting.-If there was a process communication error in the Sales Order, you can trigger the process message after you corrected the error (in our example, open the posting period for postings on the DD.MM.YYYY for company A and Business Process Group as 08 - Service Execution Confimation) using the following steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Document Differences view.-Select the Sales Order XYZ.-Click on the Start Document Synchronization button.-Your Sales Order will be posted successfully in accounting. --Steps to repost the source document are below:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub view.-Select Unposted Source Documents.-Select the source document of your customer invoice DEF.-Select the button Action -> View Business Transaction button.-Select the Post button.-This will post your source document successfully in accounting.-Keywords-Customer Invoice; Referenced item of Sales Order XYZ not found; Source Document; Unpost Source Document; Sales Order; Blocked; Service Execution Confimation, Service Execution Confirmation,

Title: Error When Posting Expense Report From Concur: 'Account cannot be created; role is not maintained'
Content: Symptom-You have an expense report that came through the Concur integration with SAP Business ByDesign. However, the expense report has landed as an unposted source document with the error 'Account cannot be created; role is not maintained'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Find the related expense report.-See error message 'Account cannot be created; role is not maintained'-Cause-The Creditor ID / Clearing Account code received from Concur in the expense report payload is not maintained with a supplier role in Business ByDesign or in Concur side.-You can find the related clearing acount code as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select the relevant expense report.-Click Actions -> Edit Business Transaction.-In the details of the line items, refer to the Creditor ID field.-Alternatively, you can check the same via JSON file:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Find the related expense report.-Click Download Original JASON.-Open the file.-Search by 'clearingAccountCode'-Resolution-To check/maintain the roles for business partners in SAP Business ByDesign, proceed as follows:-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Business Partner view.-Find the related business partner with the clearing account code.-Check/maintain the roles accordingly.-To check/maintain the same in Concur, you may refer to the 'Configure Payment Types' section of the SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide-Keywords-Concur. Expense Report. Supplier. Unposted Source Document.

Title: Various Issues with Custom Form Templates
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-The cusomer reports various issues with the output of business documents. The issues can range from lines incorrectly or not displaying to incorrect data displayed, etc.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-For the example we use Sales Orders, but the issue is applicable for any documents.-- generate either Preview or an output PDF from the Sales Order.-- in the generated PDF you notice, that some fields are missing / containing wrong data / is displayed incorrectly.-Cause-The customer might use their own customised templates for generating the output documents. As SAP does not have control over the customisation process, the template can contain incorrect configuration.-Resolution-The first step in analysing such issues should be to test the behaviour with a standard SAP provided template. In case that works, the customer needs to adjust their template. SAP cannot assist them with this process.-Keywords

Title: Default Value of a KUT Field is Not Working as Expected
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have configured a default value for a KUT field inside of it's properties. However, after applying this, the field is not showing the default value.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to any Work Center view for e.g. Accounts.-Open any Account.-Start Adaptation.-Create a new field with a default value filled (or edit a current KUT field and set a default value).-Open any Account and click Edit.-The default value for the field is not filled.-Cause-Defaulting works only for the new instance.-Create, e.g., a new Account and click Edit.-The default value will be filled for the field "A".-It will not default for the existing documents.-Resolution-The default value set for this field will work just for newly created records. It will not override already created records with this new set default value.-For example, after setting the default value, it will appear only for newly created Accounts (or other objects). The already created Accounts will remain with the old value.-Keywords-Defaulting in Extension field, Default value, extension field, KUT, field, account

Title: Sales Order In Process When it Should be Completed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a Sales Order that has been delivered and invoiced but the document still remains In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Document is In Process.-Cause-The reason the document is still In Process is because it contains an item type Service which has not been released for execution.-When you go to the Items tab, you see that the Complete Execution button is disabled for the service item, and this is because you have maintained a Delivery Block for the document.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to complete the document, please perform the following:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the General tab.-Scroll and remove the Delivery Block.-Now you can click on Submit and select:-Confirm Service Execution-Complete Service Execution- If only one item needs to be completed:-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the item.-Click on Complete Execution.-See Also-3050995 - Sales Order is in Status In Process but you Expect it to be in Status Completed-Keywords-Delivery Block, Sales Order, Service, Complete Execution, grayed out, In Process, Completed, Stuck

Title: Crash in Silverlight UI, When Accessing Implementation Projects View Using Firefox Browser
Content: Symptom-Using Firefox browser, you require to access Implementation Projects view in Business Configuration workcenter to make changes to the project, but you experience a crash/ dump while accessing the same.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer, SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Silverlight using Firefox-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view-System throws an exception-The Silverlight plugin has crashed.-Reload the page to try again.-Cause-With new Firefox version greater than 40.0 or above, there is some changes made which Silverlight is unable to handle. Due to this, exception is triggered. There is no solution from Firefox or Microsoft.-Resolution-Mozilla Firefox is currently not supported on Silverlight UI. Please refer System Requirements document using below link.-http://help.sap.com/saphelp_byd1608/en/ktp/Software-Components/01200615320100003379/WEKTRA_for_Work_Centers/Cross/SystemRequirements/ESS_Con_SystemRequirements.html-We recommend to use Internet Explorer browser. If there is any critical activity which needs to be performed using Firefox browser, please report an case to SAP stating business reasons.-Keywords-The Silverlight plugin has crashed, Reload the page to try again

Title: Extension Field is Missing in the Form Template.
Content: Symptom-Extension Field cannot be added to the Form Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Application and User management Work Center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance.-Select Form template for respective Task.-Open via Easy Form Editor.-Added Extension Field is missing.-Cause-The Cause for the issue is user has to perform Publish Activity.-Resolution-User has to create extension field with anchor on root node and then update the template to accommodate the extension field. The flow wise, application provides the message type based on extensibility, they have to use that message type and map the extension field on the template then only it will be visible.-After creating the above changes kindly follow below steps:-Download the Template-Update the Extension Field & Upload it again-Perform Publish Activity-Now User can able to see the field on preview or Easy form editor.-  Keywords-Extension Field,easy form editor,ALD,Form Template,Field not available.

Title: Enable Company Default Theme Does not Work
Content: Symptom-The option Enable Company Default Theme, which we introduced with the release 2305, does not seem to work.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Key User Settings-Select Company Settings-Choose a Theme and activate the new feature 'Enable Company Default Theme'-Save-Logout and Login again-There aren't any changes.-Cause-This is the expected behavior.-Resolution-As standard behavior, the Company Default theme which is selected will be available to new users that are created post selection of default theme, and for users who have not selected/changed the theme before.-Keywords-Theme, Company default Theme,

Title: Invoicing Status in Contract Remains Finished
Content: Symptom-You have created a Customer Contract with invoice schedule and when invoicing partial quantity, the system Finished the Invoicing Status of the item invoiced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Contract).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Invoicing status is Finished.-Cause-In order to perform the Revoking action, the item needs to meet the following criteria:-Item type as fixed price, fixed price without actuals or expense fixed price without actuals-Invoicing status as Finished-Associated with invoice schedule-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-If the item meets the above criteria, please perform the following:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Contract).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select item 10.-Click Revoke.-Select Invoicing.-Invoice status changes back to In Process and system permits to add an extra date to the Schedule.-Keywords-Contract, Customer, Revoke, Invoice, Status, Finished, Schedule

Title: Error Message: "Voiding of Check XXX not Allowed as Automatic Numbering is not Activated"
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to void an Outgoing Check with status In Transfer you get the error message "Voiding of Check XXX not Allowed as Automatic Numbering is not Activated." (XXX stands for the Outgoing Check ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The check lot containing the check you want to void is not activated for Used for Automatic Check Numbering.-Go to the Liquidity Management or Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Use the Show Filter and select the option All Payments and press the Go button.-Search and select the outgoing check with status In Transfer you want to void and press the gear button and select the option Void.-The error message: "Voiding of Check XXX not Allowed as Automatic Numbering is not Activated" is shown.-Cause-The check lot containing the In Transfer check you want to void is not set for Used for Automatic Check Numbering.-Resolution-You have 2 possibilities to void the unwanted check:--1) Activate (even temporarily) the Used for Automatic Check Numbering option on the check lot containing the check you want to use. Then you will be able to void the unwanted check. That means old check will be canceled and the system will automatically create a new check with the same information but different check number. Afterwards you can remove the option Used for Automatic Check Numbering from the check if desired.-Go to Liquidity Management work center, Master Data view, My Banks sub-view.-Select the bank with the bank account on which the check lot is defined.-Press the Edit button and select the option Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account on which the check lot is defined.-In the bottom zone, go to the Check Lot tab, select the check lot containing the check you want to void and flag the option Used for Automatic Check Numbering.-You can now void the check, then a new check with the same information but a different check number will be created automatically.-If you are not requiring the option Used for Automatic Check Numbering after voiding the check you can uncheck it again.-2) If you don't want to allow the Used for Automatic Check Numbering option on the check lot then you have to cancel the existing check and create a new one with the same number manually. To be able to reverse an outgoing check it has to be in status Ready for Transfer. Therefore as the unwanted check is already with the status In Transfer, you have to set it back in status Ready for Transfer.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Select the Outgoing Check to be canceled.-Press the gear button and select the option Set to Not Transferred.-Select the button 'Reverse' to reverse the unwanted check.-You can create a new outgoing check with a new check number.-Keywords-Void, Check, In Transfer

Title: Communication Error between Customer Demand and Purchase Request.
Content: Symptom-There is a communication error between Customer Demand and Purchase Request and you go to Document Flow of the Sales Order XXX.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders-Select Sales Orders-Search for Sales Order XXX-Open the document-Select View All-Go to Document Flow-Select Extended View on Show field-Select the Anchor symbol in the Customer Demand-See the Process Communication Error in Purchase Request Planning Details-Cause-You have not maintained the Currency Exchange Rate from Source currency to Target currency.-Resolution-Go to General Ledger-Select Edit Exchange Rates-Choose Add Row-Fill the Source Currency and the Target Currency-Fill the Bid Rate, Mid Rate and Ask Rate-The Valid From date can be current date and time-Press Enter-Select Save and Close-After doing this, you need to open an case on Solve Problem or Report case in Help Center so the Support Team can restart the message.

Title: 'An error occurred in business configuration for tax calculation: APBTC_COMMON 801. Report an incident.' Error in Supplier Invoice With Custom Withholding Tax Code
Content: Symptom-Error is raised in supplier invoice when using a custom/PDI withholding tax code:-'An error occurred in business configuration for tax calculation: APBTC_COMMON 801. Report an incident.'-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Find and open invoice ID ABC (ABC means the invoice ID).-Click View All.-Click Check.-Error is displayed:-'An error occurred in business configuration for tax calculation: APBTC_COMMON 801. Report an incident.'-Cause-In supplier invoice ABC, custom/PDI withholding tax code DEF is being used (DEF means the custom withholding tax code).-The withholding tax code DEF is tied to custom tax event GHI (GHI is the custom tax event).-In the respective PDI Solution (accessible via SAP Cloud Application Studio), you haven't assigned a Tax Calculation Procedure to the custom tax event GHI.-Resolution-To solve the issue, create and assign a Tax Calculation Procedure to custom tax event GHI.-See Also- For further information please refer to the Localization Toolkit, Category Tax > Subtopic Withholding Tax > Documentation How To enable Withholding Tax content for non-localized countries in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Keywords-PDI; tax calculation procedure; withholding tax code

Title: Change Project not Editable in Production System
Content: Symptom-A Change Project in inactive in the production system with the message: The project is active only in the test system. Open the test system to continue working on the project.-However, the test system associated with the change project has been decommissioned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the concerned change project.-Cause-Once a manual decommissioning of the test system if performed, it will not be possible to continue with the implementation of the associated project.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-In case you want the the change project removed from the system, you may create an case and send to SAP requesting the change with your approval. The case should also include your explicit approval.-Keywords-inactive,test system,change project

Title: Error when creating Scheduled Invoice Request for Contracts or Sales order
Content: Symptom-The system is not automatically creating Scheduled Invoice Requests for contracts or sales order. When you try to create the Scheduled Invoice Request manually the following error is displayed and the Scheduled Invoice Request is not created: Error in business configuration for number range; report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue occurs when creating Scheduled Invoice Requests for Contracts and Sales Orders. In our example we are using Scheduled Invoice Requests for Contracts.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select customer contract invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Contract).-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the You Can Also button and select Create Scheduled Invoice Requests.-The following error is displayed:Error in business configuration for number range; report an case-    Cause-You did not create any rules in the fine tuning activity Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing and are therefore. If you do not define specific rules, the system applies default rules and starts numbering your invoicing documents (such as customer invoices, credit memos and down payment requests) automatically with the number 1 irrespective of the company or the invoicing document type and without any prefixes, suffixes or separators.-However, the default number range for customer invoicing depends on the scoping of the element Miscellaneous Invoicing in your Business Configuration. Since you have not scoped this element the system the default number range settings are not scoped for customer invoicing and the system is not able to determine the numbering range. Therefore the system is not able to create an invoice and also not a scheduled invoice request.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Scoping step.-Open the path Sales -> Customer Invoicing-Select the element Miscellaneous Invoicing and finish your scoping changes.-Once it is activated the creation of Scheduled Invoice Requests is possible.

Title: Expense Report is not displayed in Project Not Invoiced Times and Expenses
Content: Symptom-When you are creating a Project Invoice Request you notice that the expenses are not available to be invoiced, then you check the Not Invoiced Times and Expenses for the Project ABC (ABC represents the Project ID) and you see that only Time Recordings are available.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Not Invoiced Times and Expenses view.-Search for ABC.-Click on New Automatic Project Invoice Request.-See that only Time Confirmations are available.-or-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Time and Expenses view.-Search for ABC.-Group By Source Document Type.-See that only Time Confirmations are available.-Cause-Missing configuration in the Implementation Project, the scoping option "Expense Recording" was not activated in Business Configuration - Implementation Projects work center.-Resolution-In order to activate this please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project.-Click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 3 - Scoping.-Expand Project Management.-Expand Project Planning and Execution.-Check the box for Expense Recording.-Click on Next until step 5 - Review.-Click on Finish.-The scoping element Expense Recording business topic allows project team members to record miscellaneous and travel expenses. The project team member can then assign the expenses to either projects or cost centers. The project manager can approve expenses recorded to projects.-Then create a new Expense Report, assign it to a Project, approve it and check whether the related Expenses appear now in Project Management.-Keywords-Project Management, Projects, Expense Report, Business Configuration, Project Invoice Request

Title: Webservice for Incidents
Content: Reproducing the Issue-User wants to consume/manage the case information by using the webservice.-Cause-In the current functionality of SAP Business Bydesign and SAP Hybris cloud for customer. We dont have any such webservice that will help in managing/consuming the case informations.-Resolution-This is a system designed behaviour and if in future any such functionality will be given, then all the customer/partners will be informed.-

Title: Error: You cannot change the data in Product Category Hierarchy ID. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an case.
Content: Symptom-Error appears when attempting to maintain or change the Product Category for an assigned Individual Material in Fixed Assets - Master Data.-At the time of selecting the Product Category ID, the error message: "You cannot change the data in Product Category Hierarchy ID. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report a case." appears-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center-Navigate to Fixed Assets view-Search for fixed asset, click on Edit and select Master Data-Navigate to the sub-tab Individual Material-Maintain Product Category or change the Product Category -Error message: You Cannot Change The Data In Product Category Hierarchy ID appears.-Cause-The fixed asset in question was not created via procurement process (i.e purchase order, goods receipt, invoice). Instead the asset was created manually or via journal entry voucher.-Since there are no associated documents (purchase order, goods receipt) - the Individual Material assigned to the asset does not have a product category. Due to this - in the Fixed Asset - Master Data, the Product Category is not displayed.-If an asset already has a Product Category assigned, the system does not allow changing the Product Category.-The Product Category can be changed in the Individual Material screen.-Resolution-Go to Fixed Asset work center-Select Reports view-Search for the report Fixed Assets - Master Data and Open-Enter the relevant parameter-Click on the Individual Material in the report-Select navigation as View Individual Material Overview-Click on Edit-Maintain Product Category-Click on Save and Close-Or-Go to Fixed Asset work center-Select Fixed Asset view-Search for the Fixed Asset-Click On Edit and Select Values-Navigate to Journal tab-Click on any Journal Entry ID-In the Journal Entry Screen, Click on the Individual Material. This will open the Individual Material view-Click on Edit-Maintain Product Category-Click on Save and Close.-NOTE: Ideally, the Product Category is used to derive the Fixed Asset Class. Once the Fixed Asset is created in the system, maintaining the Product Category has no impact on that Fixed Asset. In this case, the system will still allow the Fixed Asset to be saved. -Keywords-asset categorization, hierarchy field, edit restriction, product assignment, asset creation method, individual material, journal, product category, fixed asset,

Title: Exception in Supplier Invoice: Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Account determination is missing for item type Exchange Rate Differences
Content: Symptom-Exception in Supplier Invoice is preventing the posting of the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Exceptions tab.-See the error:-Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Account determination is missing for item type Exchange Rate Differences: Tax Postings general. Specify account determination in chart of accounts <XYZ> and account determination profile <PQR>. Column Path Tax->Differences->Differences from Exchange Rate Fluctuat..., Item Type Exchange Rate Differences: Tax Postings general.-XYZ means Chart of Accounts.-PQR means Account Determination Profile.-Cause-The G/L Accounts are not maintained in activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination'.-Resolution-The steps to maintain the activity correctly are listed below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Select the activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination'.-Click in Change Immediately button.-In the Account Determination area, click in Tax.-Select Account Determination Profile PQR.-Open the Differences tab.-Maintain a G/L Account for Differences from Exchange Rate Fluctuation.-Keywords-Exception; Supplier invoice; Account determination; G/L account; Exchange Rate

Title: Error triggered during Removal Run
Content: Symptom-Mass Data Run Object (MDRO) Removal ran with errors.-Technical error /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA 033; Report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Background Jobs View.-In Show All Failed Jobs.-Select any Job ABC.-Select on View Job Log.-You can see the error: Technical error /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA 033; Report an case.-Cause-As the MDRO run is scheduled for every 15 minutes  this is causing the error,  In order to check the frequency of the Job, Mass Data Run Object (MDRO) Removal ran with errors.-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go to Automated Actions.-Search for Active Runs.-Select on View Jobs.-Resolution-In Order to avoid the error, you need to modify the frequency of run so that the second run doesn't start before the completion of the first run.-Keywords-Technical error /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA 033; Report an case, /BOPF/LIBRARY_ESA 033; Report an case

Title: System Error or Dump When Trying to Reverse Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-A system error or dump occurs when attempting to reverse a payment allocation using the Reverse button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation subview.-Show all Payment Allocations in status Posted.-Select Payment Allocation ID ABC (ABC is the payment allocation ID).-Click Reverse button.-You get the following system error:-"An error occurred-Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-Details-ClassName-sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-MethodName-post-Response-500 SAP Internal Server Error-ERROR: The application running deliberately caused an abort with short dump. (termination: RABAX_STATE)-500 SAP Internal Server Error-ERROR: The application running deliberately caused an abort with short dump. (termination: RABAX_STATE)."-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Click on the Journal entry Icon of the payment allocation to open the same.-The Journal entry ID is DEF (DEF is the journal entry ID).-The Set of Books is HIJ (HIJ is the set of books ID).-Creation date: DD.MM.YYYY-Posting has been made to the following G/L-Accounts:-G/L-Account G/L-Account Type-KLM AAA-NOP BBB-(KLM is the G/L-Account ID and its G/L-Account Type is AAA.)-(NOP is the G/L-Account ID and its G/L-Account Type is BBB.)-Cause-At the time of posting the payment allocation, the G/L account KLM was assigned to G/L Account Type CCC (initial G/L Account Type).-The G/L Account Type was subsequently changed from CCC to AAA (new G/L Account Type).-Since the same G/L account was used with a different G/L Account Type for the posted payment allocation, it is not possible to reverse the allocation.-This can be checked as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Click the Configuration Change History link.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune Settings tab.-Filter for Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Download Change Details.-A zip file will be downloaded.-Open the same and then open the Excel file-Use CTRL+F function to search and search for each G/L-Account KLM.-The G/L-Account type was changed from type CCC to type AAA on DD+X.MM.YYYY (X is any number of days after day DD).-Resolution-To reverse the payment allocation, the same G/L Account Type must be maintained for the G/L Account that was used when the payment allocation was posted.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview subview.-Search and select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Click the Edit Chart of Accounts link.-Choose the respective G/L Account and maintain G/L Account Type.-Save your changes.-Keywords-Zahlungszuordnung; Payment allocation; system error; reverse; stornieren; dump-payment allocation,stornieren,zahlungszuordnung,reverse,cl_fai2d_accountdet

Title: Relevant for Withholding Tax Key Figures are Empty in Report
Content: Symptom-When executing the Monitoring Invoices report (Data Source SRMIV_B03), no data is displayed for Key Figures related to Withholding Taxes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports view.-Open report Monitoring Invoices.-In Selection section, in the Invoice ID field, enter ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice ID).-Click in Go button.-In View section, click in Settings - Key Figures.-Add the following to the Selected column: 'Gross Amount - Relevant for Withholding Tax'; 'Gross Amount in Company Currency - Relevant for Withholding'; 'Net Amount - Relevant for Withholding Tax'; 'Net Amount in Company Currency - Relevant for Withholding Tax'; 'Tax amount - Relevant for Withholding Tax' and 'Tax amount in Company Currency - Relevant for Withholding Tax'.-Click in Ok button.-No data is displayed in these Key Figure fields.-Cause-The fields marked as relevant for Withholding Tax are restricted on the field determination level. They only display data when the Supplier Invoice contains the following data for withholding tax:-Tax type: 1 - VAT (Value Added Tax) -Tax code: 2 - Domestic Purchase - Goods-This scenario is the standard system behaviour.-Resolution-If you wish to have fields displaying Withholding tax, we recommend that you create Custom Key figures.-Also if you want to know how the system is picking the Tax information for the Supplier Invoice, please see the steps below to check the information maintained in the Supplier's master data:-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view. -Search for XYZ (XYZ is the Supplier's ID). -Navigate to Financial Data tab.-Navigate to Tax Data subtab.-In Withholding Tax Classifications section, you can see the Tax Type maintained for this Supplier. -Keywords-Report; Supplier Invoice; Withholding Tax; Tax Code; Tax Type; VAT; Monitoring Invoices

Title: Information required for Designing issues with Report and Key figures in Analytics
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues related to Reports, customized Data Sources, customized Key Figures or KPIs in a efficient way and to enable the Analytics team to narrow down in the issue better, please provide the following information:-Reports-Is it a standard or custom report ? (You may find this out via the Report details or Technical Information via the Created By field) -What is the Report name, the report ID and Data source ID ? (To learn how to show or use the report ID you may check the CD 1652460)-What is the precise selection set on the variable screen? (You may view the variable selection when you open the report or by selecting the Variable button, then Edit, from the report layout)-What is the expected behaviour ?-Data Sources-What is the name and ID of the customized data source?-If an error occurs, what are the steps that lead to the error message? Do you have the permission to perform these steps?-If it is a content issue in this data source, does the same behaviour occur in the related standard data source? If yes, please forward the case to the related application team (see also CD 1499953)-Key figures-What is the name and ID of the customized key figure?-What data source is the key figure based on?-What is the expected result?-KPIs-Which User is affected ?-Which KPI is/are affected ? -What is the End User expectation ?-What is the Evaluation name? (Available from Corporate Performance work center - KPI view - KPI monitor)-Is the KPI/Evaluation Currently Monitored? (You can check this from the Evaluation Monitor Properties CD 1488916).-Ask customer for screenshots where you can visualize the issue from his/her perspective.- Business Impact and case Priority-Please note that not being able to create a customized report, data source, key figure or KPI does generally not justify a Very High priority.- Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.

Title: No E-Mail Notification When Creating a New Incident or Updating Existing Incident in Customer Support Work Center
Content: Symptom-When you create a new case or update an existing case in Customer Support work center they is no E-mail notification triggered by the system.-Resolution-It is crucial to have the Notification feature in place, when people at your end want to react on new/updates on customer cases rather than regularly monitoring the cases list.  Notifications may not be crucial, in case if there are dedicated set of people working completely on the Customer cases, regularly monitoring the cases list.-Currently we don’t have the Notifications (with email subscription) capability for this functionality developed . We have received this feedback from other Partners who are using this functionality and this has been already added to our backlog, to be considered for future development roadmap of this functionality. Depending on the priority this receives in our list of backlog items, this will be taken up in one of the earliest possible releases in the future.

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on Payroll Processing
Content: Symptom-This document gathers some of the common questions related to Payroll Processing, from configuration and utilization to issues that may occur.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1.   What is the correct process flow in Payroll Processing?-First, a snapshot is created of the specific payroll group for which the payroll is being generated by clicking "Create Snapshot" — this automatically gathers all relevant information required for the provider to run the payroll. After you check the snapshot generated for errors, you may correct any information and regenerate the snapshot using the button "Update Snapshot". Next, you generate the data file for this snapshot by clicking the button "Create Data File" — the data file is generated in standard XML, but since it uses XSLT conversion templates, you may adapt the format and contents of the output file. Then, click "Download Data File" and select the output files you wish to download from the list. The next step is to transfer the data file to your payroll provider according to the agreements in place. The provider will execute the payroll run in his payroll system and make the results available for you to consolidate in your financial accounting. Afterwards, you need to close the appropriate payroll period in your system (and in your payroll provider system, depending on workflow agreements in place).-2.   You are receiving an error message "Payroll period cannot be completed; Next Payroll Period does not Exist" when attempting to change or close your current payroll period.-This happens because there's no continuous payroll period configured to start immediately after the date on which you are closing the current period. Please maintain payroll periods in continuation so that the system can identify the next period (see 2140524).-3.   A certain employee is missing from the payroll snapshot you are generating, even though he or she has positive time entries for the relevant payroll period.-Please ensure that the employee in question has compensation components assigned to him/her:-a. Go to the work center Compensation -> Employees.-b. Search for the relevant employee, select him and click Edit.-c. Navigate to the tab Compensation Structure Assignment.-d. Here, you can add a compensation component to the employee.-In case this was already maintained or the issue persists after it's done, it may be the case that there is a problem in the communication from Time Administration to Payroll Processing which is causing the recorded time to not show in the payroll snapshot. In that case, please report an case so the issue can be checked by support.-4.   Where do you find the reports related to Employee Payroll?-You may review Analytical Reports within Personnel Administration, Reports in Time Administration and Reports in Compensation for extract purposes.-As of the 1908 release a report is available for listing employee master data. The report is called Internal Employee Details and is available under the Personnel Administration work center. It has multiple views with logical groups of data:-- View Payment Info covers employees bank details -- View Private Contact Data holds employees Private address-- Workplace Contact Data provides workplaces address- - Reports are available for listing employee salaries and compensation components in the Compensation work center.-.-  Keywords-Payroll Processing, Employee Payroll, Compensation, Payroll Snapshot, create snapshot, Employee, payroll period

Title: Information Required for OData issues in Analytics
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues related to Odata service for Reports in an efficient way and to enable the Analytics team to narrow down the issue better, you should provide the following information:-The precise steps to reproduce the issue, including the OData URL.-Have you tried to run the query in other Internet Browser (e.g. Chrome, Firefox..) ?-Is there any recent change done in the system or report ?-What is the actual result/error faced by customer (screenshots are helpful) ?-Since when does the issue exist ? or Was it working before ?-Does the same report return data in UI (Analysis Pattern) for the initial selection and the filter values passed via URL (with same user) ?-What is the expected result ?-Business Impact and case Priority-Please note that not being able to create run a customized Odata query due to lack of knowledge or consulting on correct parameters, does not justify Very High priority.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords

Title: Information Required for Scripting issues in PDI
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyze issues related to PDI Scripting, the following details should be gathered.-Solution Name and ID-Is the Solution in the same tenant where the case is created from.-Business impact in case of Very High priority cases-Complete path of the PDI Script-Overview of the logic implemented in this script-Status of the solution and activation status of the PDI script.-Complete steps to reproduce-Permission to reproduce the issue-Details of error messages (if any)-Expected result and the actual result

Title: Information Required for PDI Reports in Analytics
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues related to Reports or Data sources created by Partners (PDI solutions) in a efficient way and to enable the Analytics team to narrow down the issue better, you should provide the following information:-The precise steps to reproduce the issue.-What is the Report name, the report ID and Data source ID ? (To learn how to show or use the report ID you may check the CD 1652460).-Error messages found in SDK.-Original Solution name and Patch solution name.-Is the problem in Assemble and Download or during Activation ?-If the problem is during Activation, in which system it is failing ? ( Source system or Target system).-If the issue is in Target system, provide Source system details.-Is there any recent change done in the system or report ?-Since when does the issue exist ? or Was it working before ?-What is the expected result ?-   Business Impact and case Priority-Please note that not being able to run a customized PDI report (where the report ID starts with Y), does generally not justify the Very High priority, since a fault in a customized object usually does not mean a production or go live showstopper.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords

Title: Web service activation failed due to long derived names
Content: Symptom-When trying to activate a wedservice in your Custom Solution, customer is facing the error message "Web service YXXXXXXXX_WS_XXXX activation failed due to long derived names" at activation step.-Hence, it is not possible to activate the webservice .-Reproducing the Issue--1. Click on Activate-2. Wait for some time and the following error logs will show up-Error- Web service YXXXXXXXX_WS_XXXX activation failed due to long derived names"-Cause-This error message shows up at activation step only when you have not maintained the abbreviated name for a Wer Service.-The maximum lenght of the Original Derived Name allowed in a custom Web Service is 120.-In cases where its lenght is bigger than 120 it is compulsory to add an Abbreviated Name for the same.-Resolution-You should maintain Abbreviated Names for each Service Operation where the Original Derived Name is bigger than 120 as per the screenshot bellow:-----After setting the Abbreviated Names acordingly and saving/activating the Web Service in question you will be able to Assemble and Download the solution without issues.-   Keywords

Title: Information Required for SCM Issues
Content: Symptom-In order to analyse issues in a SCM scenarios, we should gather the following information:-Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-ID of the affected document (Inbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, etc.).-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-In case an error message occurs: Error message that occurs and the action that triggered the error message.-Changes that were performed.-What is the actual result and what is the expected result.-If the issue affects more only one user, the user who is affected by the issue.-In case the issue occurs when data (Webservice), please provide the respective file (SOAP request and SOAP response) as an attachment in the case as well as which webservice is being used. -Can this issue be reproduces and do we have the permission to reproduce this in your system in case data is changed or created (possibly in a test system)? -Business Impact the issue has on your company or for your users.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords

Title: Business Partner Data work center is not Available for SAP_INITUSER User
Content: Symptom-Unable to create a Service Agent because the work center Business Partner Data is available for the SAP_INITUSER.-Note: Even after confirming the Milestone Activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted also the work center is not available.-or-Below error message, while confirming the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted-You cannot change this activity because you do not have the required authorizations.-Create a new service agent and proceed with that user. Note that you must sign the contract for your SAP solution before you can start working on the activity list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The cause and proposals for the issue are,-1. Some the work center assignment for the SAP_INITUSER has been skipped during tenant provisioning.-The assignment of the work center for the SAP_INITUSER needs to be performed manually in the backend.-The assignment can be performed by Managed Services or, the case can be forwarded to Business Configuration Expert Support.-2. Scoping is not yet completed by the User-The Scoping should be completed by the user before using he Fine Tuning activities. The access to Service Agent creation will be possible only after confirming the milestone ‘Scoping Completed’. Even after performing the scoping, if the issue exist then the cause could same as above case.- Keywords-Initial User, Service Agent, Business Partner Data, Work Center, SAP_INITUSER.

Title: Activities Close Project and Confirm Go Live Appear Completed for the First Implementation Project in Production System, before System Go Live
Content: Symptom-Although the Production system has not yet gone live, the activities Close Project and Confirm Go Live appear Completed for the First Implementation project in Business configuration workcenter. These activities have status Completed by default, since the time the system was delivered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view-Highlight the First Implementation project and choose Open Activity List-Select the Go-Live tab-The activities Close Project and Confirm Go Live are Completed-Cause-The two activities may have been Closed while the workspace was still in the test tenant. Further, when the workspace was copied to the new Production tenant, the Closed information was also copied.-You may have saved the scoping changes in a draft version at that point of time. Therefore, these unintended activity closings are related to having a draft workspace.-Resolution-Report an case to SAP for further analysis.

Title: Interactive Form Not Available in the Form Template Maintenance
Content: Symptom-With 1511 you have the possibility to use Interactive Forms.  However, the interactive form template e.g. the Sales Quotes (Interactive Form) is not available in the Form Template Maintenance even though Interactive Forms ﻿are scoped.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the Advanced Search hyperlink.-Click on the Go button.-You can see that the respective form template e.g. Sales Quotes (Interactive Form) is not available.-Interactive forms are included in your scoping:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your first implementation project-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Step 3 Scoping.-Expand the element Sales -> New Business.-Select the element Communication for New Business.-You can see that Interactive Forms is in scope.-Navigate to Step 4 Questions.-Expand the element Sales -> New Business.-Select the element Communication for New Business.-The following question is active: You can use a template to send sales quotes to your customers.-  Cause-SAP delivers forms for Germany and USA as the standard. Therefore, the form template Sales Quotes (Interactive Form) is available only for the country Germany and USA. However, since in your system is only scoped for another country and since the form templates for the scoped countries only are displayed in the Form Template Maintenance UI, the form template Sales Quotes (Interactive Form) will not be seen.-Resolution-To resolve this issue the customer can scope the either of the countries (Germany/USA). The Sales Quotes (Interactive Form) will then be visible in the Form Template Maintenance UI and you can then create a new variant for the respective country and save it.-If the customer does not want to scope either Germany or the USA but still requires forms (e.g. form template Sales Quotes (Interactive Form)) for a specific country, the customer can place a request via the case. This case then has to be forwarded to the application specific globalization component and they can take it forward.

Title: Information Required for Pricing issues in CRM
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues efficiently, we should gather the following information:-Work center and View in which the issue occurs.-Name and type of the Price List and validity of the Price List-Document ID of the affected Sales/Service Document.-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-In case an error message occurs: Error message that occurs and the action that triggered the error message.-Changes that were performed.-What is the actual result and what is the expected result.-Is this issue a general issue or does this only occur for a specific user (in this case please provide the user).-Additional questions if the issue is related to pricing calculation in a Sales Document:-Exact data entered in the Sales Document such as account, employee responsible and organizational assignment-What is the Pricing Date in the Sales Document-What price list is determined and which do you expect to be determined-Additional questions if the issue is related to the price list/discount list:-Is it a custom Price List (Pricing with Extension Fields)-In case the issue occurs when data is uploaded to your system please provide the respective file (migration template, excel file or SOAP request and SOAP response) as an attachment in the case. -Can this issue be reproduces and do we have the permission to reproduce this in your system in case data is changed or created (possibly in a test system). -Business Impact the issue has on your company or for your users.
