Title: Navigation from Notification Does not Open the Selected Object/Business Document
Content: Symptom-Navigation from Notification does not open the selected Object/Business Document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Feed view.-Show All Notifications.-Open one Notification related to cases.-You cannot navigate directly from notifications to the case.-Cause-Notification is not designed to link it directly to the related Object/Business Document via hyperlink.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Cloud for Customer.-However, we are checking the possiblity of adding the navigation feature to notifications in one of the future release.

Title: Some of the Employees are also Having a Role Service Agent
Content: Symptom-You have observed that some of the Employees are also having the role as Service Agent. You are not sure, How these Employees also having the Service Agent role?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Service Agent view.-Some of the Employees are displaying here as a Service Agent.-Cause-There are many causes that could leads to this and they are,-1) The already existing Internal Employee will be assigned to a Project which is assigned to an other Company as the Internal Employee is assigned. Then the Internal Employee will get automatically an External Employee, too. But this is not the case for all the mentioned Employees.--2) In Business Partner Data workcenter within Business Partners view an user can trigger the action Create as Service Agent for an Internal Employee. Then the Internal Employee will get also an External Employee.-Resolution-To check when the Employee become Service Agent and by which user, please follow the below steps:-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Select Employees view.-3. Search and Edit an employee.-4. Go to Changes tab.-5. Select Go button.-In the changes log, you can find Role as BBP005-Service Agent or BusinessCharacterCode/content as BBP005-Service Performer then the Employee is also having the Service Agent role.

Title: Error During Creation of Follow-Up Activities
Content: Symptom-When you create an activity such as an Appointments, E-Mail, Letter, Fax or Phone Call via the Follow-Up functionality, the following error occurs:-Process type not determined for type code.-Error in bus. configuration for party determination; report an case.-Reproducing the Issue-You are able to create Follow-Up activities is different ways. We are using a Follow-Up activity from a sales order as an example:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-In the Show drop-down list, select All Orders and then press the Go button.-Click the Follow-Up button and then select any of the following-up activities such as Appointments, E-Mail, Letter, Fax or Phone Call.-The following error messages occur:-Process type not determined for type code.-Error in bus. configuration for party determination; report an case.-Cause-The respective follow-up activity is not selected in your scoping under the Questions phase.- Resolution-This is the standard behavior.-You can check you activities in scope using the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select your implementation project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Expand Sales > Account and Activity Management and then select Activity Management.-On the right side you can check which follow-up activities can be selected in your scope.- See Also-The reason users are able to create these activities although they are not scoped is because this user has assigned Partner Development work center assigned (Identity Role: MAI_DEVELOPMENT).-This work center should not be used by business users, but only by SAP or partner developer users.-This workcenter bypasses all assignment checks.-If you unassign it from the user, the system will behave as expected.-Keywords

Title: Error Message When Download a Report to Xlsx or XML Format; Report cannot be opened
Content: Symptom-You are trying to export a report to XLSX or XML format, you receive an error message after the report is loaded:-Report cannot be opened; report an case-Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - report an case.-You may also get the same error Message when you send the report as E-Mail Attachments a Xlsx or XML format. In both cases no report data is displayed and you can only close the report screen.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario One:-Go to the Work Center Business Analytics.-Go to the View Design Report.-Find and Execute the report you would like to download.-Click on the "Share" icon and select "Report in Microsoft Excel in XML Format"-Scenario Two:-Go to the Work Center Business Analytics.-Go to the View Design Report.-Find and Open the report you would like to send as E-Mail Attachments a Xlsx or XML format.-Click on the "Share" icon and select "As Email Link (Microsoft Excel in XML Format)"-Add a valid E-Mail address.-In both cases after some time the following error message shows up: Report cannot be open - please report an case.-Cause-In many cases the cause is due to the huge data that is being fetched in the report and that leads to a time out.-Report has more formatting information so the file size becomes big and during processing it leads to memory issues and these reported dumps are encountered.-If it is a custom report (possibly based on a custom data source), the modeling of that report or the data source may not be optimal.-Resolution-To avoid the Dump (time out) use the following options:-Use CSV Format and open it in Excel for the same amount of data. In case it is needed to see the data in XML or XLXS format,  please reduce the amount of records with a selection on some variables in the report to limit the data.-If you need to send the report as an E-Mail Attachment, broadcast the report and choose the CSV format.-Reduce the report data by adding variables in the report selection.-For custom data sources and reports, it is strongly recommended that they adhere to the best practices of modeling analytical objects. You will find a complete list in the KBA 2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling Data Sources and Reports - Performance . If you need assistance with optimising your reports, please contact your implementation partner. -Keywords-xlsx format, XML format, Export report, send Report as E-Mail attachment, Report cannot be opened, report an case,

Title: Unable to Close a First Implementation Project in Test System
Content: Symptom-You have a first implementation project in a test system. Now, you want to close this first implementation project in the test system. But there is no Close Project button and Close Project activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-The First Implementation project is in Tested status-Cause-In the following tenant types, the status Tested is the last status of a first implementation project :-Initial test tenants, through which a productive system was created-Standalone test tenants-Resolution-The prerequisite to perform the Close Project activity in a first implementation project is to perform the Go-Live activity. Therefore, it was decided to remove the Close Project activity for the first implementation project in a test tenant.-It is very important to know how you want to use this test tenant in the future.-If you want to use a (initial or non-initial) test tenant as standalone test tenant without connection to the production tenant, it is not a good approach to close the first implementation project in the test tenant. In this case, the first implementation project has to remain open for immediate changes or scoping/fine-tuning changes in the project. After closing the project, any business configuration changes are no longer possible. Since the first implementation project in a test system hasn't a live status, it is also not possible to create change projects in this system. So it is not possible to perform any changes in this test tenant anymore (You may have to reset the status to Tested. This is possible via the Activity List).-If you want to use an initial test tenant as a remote test system with connection to the production tenant so that you can use it to work on remote change projects, then follow below steps.-Request a termination of the test system which has the First Implementation with status "Started" or "Tested"-Request a new system with copy of source system (production)-In the source system, create and then copy a change project via button Copy Solution Profile--If you want to use a non-initial test tenant as remote test system with connection to the production tenant, you may open an case and ask SAP Support to close the project. However, this is not a recommended option because there is a potential risk of data mismatch between the test and production system. Often a standalone test tenant is an older tenant with older test data. If a user copies a change project from the production to the standalone test tenant, then maybe the test data in the test tenant does not fit to the configuration copied from the productive tenant. In this case, the test tenant cannot be used and may end up in data inconsistency with the configuration. With that in mind, the best way is to handle this is set up a fresh test tenant as full copy from the production tenant, so that the data is recent, and afterwards copy the solution profile.-See Also-2136036 - How to Request a New System-1941544 - How to Delete or Terminate a Test System?-Keywords-First Implementation project, Project status is Tested, Close Project, Tested status, First Implementation Project in Test tenant

Title: Error Message: “You must log on to the productive system to perform this operation” While Performing Copy Solution Profile / Terminating the Restore Point
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to copy the Solution Profile from the Test system to existing Production system. Upon requesting the Solution Profile copy from the test system, you see the below error:-You must log on to the productive system to perform this operation-Note: The same error could happen while Terminating the Restore Point. By logging into the Test tenant, upon trying to terminate the Restore Point from the Test system-Reproducing the Issue-Login to your Test system-Go Service Control Center work center-Go to Systems view-Select Source instance-Select Copy Solution Profile button-Source system is selected-Choose your respective Solution Profile-Select respective tenant as Target System-Select Ok-System throws error-Cause-The copy of Solution Profile from test system to existing production system is not valid.-Resolution-Resolution for Copy Solution profile scenario:-This is the standard behavior. It is not possible to transfer the data by any means from existing test system to an existing production system. There is no way to move the delta changes from Solution Profile of Test system to existing Production system.-In standard package you can have only one Test Tenant and one Production Tenant.-In this case, you need to report an case to SAP and provide the decommissioning date for the existing Production system. Thereafter, you may request for a new Production system with the Solution Profile copy of Test system.-The other scenarios which may lead to this error message is,-Test to Test-Test to Development-In both the cases, Copy Solution profile is not supported.-Please note, Solution profile copy is supported only from Production System to Test System.-Note: In case of copying solution profile from Test to Test, the functionality works when there is no PDI solution in the system (or to copy a solution profile it is generally necessary to have the PDI solutions in sync regarding name, version and status in the source and in the target tenant). In case of any issues, report an case to SAP-Resolution for Terminating the Restore Point scenario:-It is not possible to terminate the Restore Point for the Test tenant by logging into the same Test tenant. Logon to the Production tenant and perform the action to terminate the Restore Point.

Title: Error Message "Service Call Failed; Report an case" During Migration of Open Items Payable
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload Open Items Payables, but system is throwing error message "Service call failed; report an case."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective Migration Unit and click Execute Migration.-Select the Open Items Payable object and click Process File.-In the Simulate Import step, you will see the error message in the log table (you will see one message per affected source record).-Cause-The cause for the issue might be because you are migrating deferred taxes that refer only to part of the invoice amount.-Business ByDesign supports only either migrating no taxes at all for an open item or migrating all taxes.-Resolution-In order to solve this, please migrate the non-deferred part of the taxes related to the invoice as well or remove all taxes from the migration.-Keywords-Service Call Failed, Open Items Payable, Migration

Title: When logging in into a system a message shows up: Result was restricted on datasource level - more than x records
Content: Symptom-You open the Home work center, however the system shows the error message 'Result was restricted on datasource level - more than 260.000 records'.-You open the Business Analytics work center, however the system shows the error message 'Result was restricted on datasource level - more than x records'.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to your system.-Go to the work center Home.-Error appears 'Result was restricted on datasource level - more than 260.000 records'-Please note that the error might also appear in other work centers or with different amount of records.-Cause-All reports and tiles on the Home page will be executed as soon you open the page. If there is too much data in one of the reports you get the error message.-Resolution-1. Home work center:-You need to identify the tile or report which has a high data volume and check if using a selection can reduce the data.-2. Business Analytics work center:-You can unlimit the data in the report table setting by unticking 'Limit Data'.-Keywords-restricted, data source, 260.000, report an case, datasource level, Limit Data, home, business analytics, more than records, ByD, C4C,-data source 250.000

Title: Prerequisites to Enable Customer Language Adaptation
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to enable the feature "Customer Language Adaptation" and would like to know the pre-requisites.-Resolution-If you want to TEST the tool then you can become a pilot customer.--Productive use of course is possible but the limitations outlined in the guideline needs to be observed. Thereafter the functionality can be scoped by us in the backend of the tenants as long as it is not officially released. Attached the document for your reference.--if you agree then raise an case and send it to us to enable this feature.-Note: For the Translation Hub activation (if needed) usage legal sign off is prerequisite.-FAQ:-1. You are not able to add the new Text Pool ID using HTML5, but are able to do so using Silverlight.-This functionality is available only in Silverlight.

Title: Cost Estimate Price Component Is Not Listed as a Standard Procedure in Configure Price Strategy Fine Tuning Activity
Content: Symptom-You are unable to see Cost Estimate price component for fixed fee project based services.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Activity Configure Price Strategy and open it.-Select Pricing Procedure.-Select Standard procedure.-You will see that Cost Estimate is not listed in the list.-Cause-The scoping for Material Cost Estimate has not been done.-Resolution-You need to scope the below:-• The Production Models business package is selected within the Supply Chain Setup Management scoping element.--• The Valuation of Warehouse Inventory business topic is selected within the Financial and Management Accounting scoping element.--The Material Cost estimate Function is activated automatically when you select these elements.-Keywords-Cost Estimate, Fixed Fee, Project Base Services

Title: Know How on KUT Solutions and Issues Due to KUT Solutions During Solution Profile Copy/ Merge
Content: Symptom-You will receive the following errors when you try to perform Copy Solution Profile Copy/ Merge:-System versions do not match-Copy not allowed; source and target system have different add on versions-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You will be performing any of the following actions:-Copy Solution Profile-Merge-Tenant Move-Above mentioned error will be displayed but you will not be able to find any add on solution in the Custom Object Builder(COB) as you have not created any.-Cause-The KUT solution is implicitly created first time when a CBO(Custom Business Object) is created (in case of test tenant ) and CBO is uploaded (in case of productive tenant).--If you naviagte to the following path-Login to frontend UI.-Naviagate to Administrator work center.-Click on Custom Object Builder link.-Here only the custom objects can be seen and not the KUT solution name(Y name).-A KUT solution will get automatically created if you add any custom BO's in the UI, which will be created by SAP and you would not be able to see it in the frontend. If you login to SDK you will be able to see a KUT solution there, but you cannot perform any actions in this solution.-Download and upload of the custom solutions can be done through below path:-Login to frontend UI.-Navigate to the work center Custom Solution Builder.-Here you can perform create/ upload / download.-In Custom Object Builder, you can create/download/upload/delete the custom objects. The KUT solution is implicitly created. Now if you want to upload this to the production tenant you have to raise an case with SAP Support.-Resolution-In order to resolve the KUT solution mismatch issues and you do not need the Custom BO's created, you will have to delete the solution from Custom Object Builder. You can see the Delete Solution button in the top, which needs to be performed even there is no custom object available.-Keywords-Solution Copy Profile mismatch-Unable to copy solution profile

Title: Error: 'Error in business conf.: item type code not determined; report case' occurs when Entering a Product into a Service Order
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when entering a product into a service order:-Item 10: Error in business conf.: item type code not determined; report case.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Press the New button and select the Service Order option.-Enter all respective data.-Press the View All button.-Go to Service and Spare Parts tab and enter product ABC (ABC represents the number of the product).-Following error message occurs:-Item 10: Error in business conf.: item type code not determined; report case.-Cause-The product ABC is of the item group DIGI - Spare part - direct goods issue.-The following scoping question has been answered with No:-When executing a service order, do your service engineers perform a direct goods issue by entering a logistic area for the spare parts used?-Hence, the item type DIGI cannot be sold in sales documents.-  Resolution-If you would like to sell products of item type DIGI you need to change your scoping as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your current project and press the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Step 4 Questions.-Navigate to Service -> Product and Service Portfolio for Field Service and Repair -> Spare Parts Handling-Go to the Questions for Spare Parts Handling section:-The question: When executing a service order, do your service engineers perform a direct goods issue by entering a logistic area for the spare parts used? has to be answered with Yes.-See Also-2013633 - Error: Products w/ item group Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) not supported for location of srv provision On-Site Occurs When Entering a Product into a Service Order-2209995 - Item of Item Group SERV - Service - Fixed Price Cannot be Added in a Service Order

Title: India: Migration of Open Items Receivable or Payable Fails With Error Message "Service Call Failed; Report an Incident"
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Open Items Receivable or Open Items Payable for a company based in India. While processing the file in the migration tool, in the Simulate Import step you get the error message "Service call failed; report an case."-This knowledge base article is relevant for India.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective Migration Unit and click Execute Migration.-Select the respective Migration Object (Open Items Receivable or Open Items Payable) and click Process File .-In the Simulate Import step, you will see the error message in the log table (you will see one message per affected source record): "Service Call Failed; Report an case".-Cause-In the data migration template you are migrating tax data related to the open items, but left blank the Permanent Establishment ID field, which is responsible for identifying the tax reporting location.-Since in India the tax legislation is different by region, the tax reporting location is mandatory.-Resolution-You should maintain the Permanent Establishment ID in the data migration template for Open Items Payable or Open Items Receivable. This field is hidden by default and can be made visible in the Tax Data sheet > Tax Location group.-For further details, you can also check the Field List sheet within the template.-Keywords-Open Items Payable, Open Items Receivable, Migration, Service Call Failed, India

Title: How to Install and Update Desktop Agent?
Content: Symptom-This KBA lists the Help Center docuementation which helps to Install and Update Desktop Agent-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation-Installing Desktop Agent-Updating Desktop Agent-Use the Desktop Agent-Best Practices for the Desktop Agent 3-SAP Build Process Automation-Installing Desktop Agent-Updating Desktop Agent-Best Practices when Migrating from Desktop Agent 2 to Desktop Agent 3-Keywords-desktop agent, install, update, best practices

Title: Web Service ManageKitItemListIn Does not Work.
Content: Symptom-Execution of standard web service: ManageKitItemListIn to create a kit with two or more components is not working and below is response for the same.-<MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>3</MaximumLogItemSeverityCode> without error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Soap UI-Create new SOAP project.-Select WSDL file XYZ(where XYZ is the Request payload)-Copy XML from attachment and paste on Request.-Click on Submit.- You will encounter the above error.-Cause-Error 'KIT header does not exist in the system' is observed.-Resolution-The KIT header needs to be created in the system and then used in the web service.-Keywords-ManageKitItemListIn, MaximumLogItemSeverityCode, webservice

Title: Inconsistencies in Report Selections / Filters in Custom Reports
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom data source and report. When you now use the selection area or a filter, you notice inconsistent behaviours, such as:-You have a field ABC (ABC represents the name of a field) which was added to the selection area. When you start the report without any selection, it shows the value Unassigned (#). However when you enter a specific value, e.g. 123, the report shows the value 123 as well. You would expect that the value 123 is listed straight away, even when no selection is entered.-Other scenarios are possible, however they have in common that the report result is not consistent with different selections / filters / views.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the Reports view of the respective work center.-Set the variables as required for your scenario.-Start the report.-The results are not as expected from the selection / filter.-Cause-This behaviour is usually caused by a wrong modelling of the data source, or sometimes the report.-Resolution-Please check the design of your data source:-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Data Sources.-Search for the data source that the report is based on.-Click on Edit, then click on Check.-If any errors or warnings come up here, they need to be resolved. Typically, the most common cause is a wrong join condition, for example an ID field is mapped to a UUID field. Another issue can be that the joined field do not actually show the same content.-If required, please check with your implementation partner on how to resolve inconsistencies in custom data sources. You can also use the tips on this blog.-Should you require assistance from SAP Support, please provide the results of your analysis in the case.-Keywords-selection, filter, incorrect data, modelling, reports, data sources, business analtics

Title: Unable to Edit a Scoping Question
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add or remove a specific question from scope. However, it cannot be changed because the checkbox is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant implementation project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Questions section.-Find the relevant question.-The checkbox is disabled.-Cause-There are three main reasons why it is not possible to edit a specific scoping question.-The status of the project is different than Started.-Some questions and fine-tuning activities are not editable when the status of the project is different from Started (Merged, Activated, etc.).-The question is marked as Protected on tab Dependency.-The elements marked as Protected cannot be removed from scope after the system has gone live.-There is a dependency of other elements on tab Dependency-Some elements can cause automatic selection or de-selection of other elements.-Resolution-For case a: Create and/or use a change project.-For case c: Check what are the dependencies to scope the relevant element and check or uncheck them.-In case the issue is not any of the ones listed above, please send the case to SAP Support for further investigation.-Keywords-Scoping, Edit, Activity-the element is selected and protected

Title: Custom or Partner Add-on Content is not Available in HTML5 Productive System
Content: Symptom-Your custom or partner add-on contents are not visible in HTML5 Productive System. For example, custom workcenters or fields are not visibe in HTML5 Productive System.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to your ByD productive system in HTML5. You will notice that your custom or partner add-on content cannot be found even though they are enabled.-Cause-By Default, Partner Add-on content on productive system is not availablein HTML5. However; from system version 1705 onwards,  a new process is in place to ensure that custom or partner content can be properly accessed in the HTML5 productive system.-Resolution-You can now request the display of Partner Add-on content in the HTML4 productive system:-To enable viewing of this content, report an case to Support where indicate firstly that the partner content is visible in the test environment of your HTML5 client. This way we can be sure that the Partner Add-On content used HTML5 will not corrupt any data in the productive system.-For further information on this new process please view the What's New section:  Here, select the Cross Area Topics and expand down to the User Interface topic: Viewing Partner Add-on content on productive system with HTML5 user interface.-Keywords

Title: Canada: Expense Report Not Posted Due To Process Communication Error
Content: Symptom-An expense report created for an employee based in Canada is not posted to accounting (no journal entry created) due to a Process Communication Error showing up in Document Flow tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Find expense report ID AAA (AAA means the expense report ID) that has status Released for Reimbursement.-Click Edit.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Notice that there's a red and white icon with an exclamation mark for the expense report: Click it.-Error is displayed:-"The following errors have been addressed to your service provider:-- Expense Report AAA cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically."-Cause-The tax code '200 - GST Imported Goods and Services (Supplier Invoice)' has been used along with other tax code for a single expense item within the expense report.-The usage of tax code 200 in an expense report along with other tax codes in 'Add Additional Tax Details' is not allowed. This should not be used as it's not a valid scenario as per confirmation from Canada LPM (Local Product Manager).-Resolution-The solution here is to not use tax code 200 with any other tax code. If you need to use it, it should be used alone for any expense type.-Please cancel expense report ID AAA and create a new one with correct tax codes.-Keywords-Canada; pce; process communication error; tax code; add additional tax details

Title: OData for Data Sources not working
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create an OData query for data source using the link available in the integration information section of the data source documentation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center. -Go to Design Data Source Work Center View.-Search for the required Data Source.-In the Documentation column, click the magnifying glass icon.-In the new window, click in the Integration Information link.-In the section Integration Information, you will find the OData URL.-Run the URL in a new browser.-Cause-The OData URL available in the integration information section of the data source documentation is not complete.-Resolution-You need to create your OData URL using the "Build OData Queries" functionality to generate the OData URL correctly.-Keywords-Odata, URL, Integration, Information, Documentation, Data, Source

Title: You Are Not Able to Find Ship-To Party in Calculation Rule When Creating a New Extension Field
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field ABC in account master. In the sales order, you need to create a new extension field and use ABC from Ship-to party role in calculation rule. While checking the available fileds, you cannot find it.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Open any Sales Order.-Click View All button.-Enter Adaptation Mode, create a new Extension Field, select Calculated check box, open calculation rule.-You can see the field ABC, it shows options on involved parties, like:-ABC (ABC - BillToParty)-ABC (ABC - BuyerParty)-ABC (ABC - PayerParty)-But you do not see ABC - ShipToParty.-Cause-ProductRecipientParty and ShipTo party are the same. It contains the ship-to address.-Resolution-You can use the ABC (ABC - ProductRecipientParty) to get the ship-to address information.-Keywords-ProductRecipientParty; ShipTo; Extension field.

Title: Error During Deploy Business Configuration: Deployment Not Possible. Enable Solution For Business User Testing
Content: Symptom-When you try to perform Deploy Business Configuration for a solution you will receive the following errors:-Deployment not possible. Enable solution YABCDEFGY_ for business user testing. (where YABCDEFGY_ is the solution ID)-BC Deployment failed.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the solution.-Right click on the solution.-Select Deploy Business Configuration option.-Error and warning messages appears.-Cause-The cause for the error is that the solution is Disabled in Implemantaion Manager.-Resolution-You need to first Enable the solution. You can do this by following the steps below:-Open the Solution.-Go to Implementation Manager tab.-Click on the Enable button.-Now you will be able to perform Deploy Business Configuration for the solution.-See Also-PDI, SDK, MCS, add, on, deployment, not, possible, enable, solution, business, user, testing-Keywords

Title: Error Message: Posting on date DD/MM/YYYY blocked, Release not Possible when you Approve a Cancellation Invoice
Content: Symptom-You want to approve a Cancellation Invoice but when you click Approve you receive the error message: Posting on date DD/MM/YYYY blocked, Release not Possible.-You don't understand why you have this error message because in the Invoice was canceled already.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select the Approvals view.-Search for the Approve Manual Customer Invoice/Credit (ABC represents the ID of your Invoice).-Click on Edit Button.-Click on Approve.-The system throws error message: Posting on date DD/MM/YYYY blocked, Release not Possible.-Cause-When creating a cancellation invoice, the document will take the details from the original invoice, this includes the post date which in this case is the invoice date.-As the period is closed you can either open it or add a new posting date under the accounting section of the general tab.-If a manual invoice is created with a blocked posting date, the approval process will continue but the invoice can't be released, unless the posting date is changed.-Resolution-You will need to send the document back for revision. Make the changes, release and approve the documents again.-Keywords-Approve; Customer Invoice; Cancellation Invoice; Posting Period

Title: How to Find an Error Message Key from the UI With the Browser Development Tool
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You need to find the exact error message key, number and text of an error message in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. In the UI navigate to the position just before the error message appears. -2. Start the browser development tool by pressing Fn + F12 to start recording with the development tool:-3. Now trigger the error message: You notice 2 JSON files in the development  tool:-4. Select the second JSON.-4.1. In the Preview you notice the response tag.-4.2. In the second line right-click and choose Expand recursively:-5. Find the Messages and the key tag. Take note of the message key, here "CM_FIA_BCF_MSG.ANP_PRIOR_YEAR_NOT_CALCULATED":-5.1. The first part of the message key (until the period), here CM_FIA_BCF_MSG is the ABAP class.-5.2. The second part of the message key (after the period), here ANP_PRIOR_YEAR_NOT_CALCULATED, represents the ABAP class text attribute.-6. Now access STFK and find the error message key and number:-7. In STFK go to transaction SE24.-8. In the Object type field, enter the ABAB class (the first part of the error message, here CM_FIA_BCF_MSG and press Display:-9. In the next screen navigate to the Texts tab.-10. Find the  ABAP class text attribute in Exception ID column:-11. Select the line and press Message Text:-12. You now find the exact error message attributes, such as class, number and text:-Keywords-Error Message; Key; error message key; number; text;

Title: Incorrect Purchasing Unit Description in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The purchasing unit descriptions are being wrongly retrieved when you create a purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the New Purchase Order common task.-Click on the Purchase Unit selection button.-Verify that your purchase units have the wrong descriptions compared to their org units descriptions.-Cause-The reported issue occurs because the related parties' IDs are so called "twin objects". Whenever a company is created automatically, a business partner (customer/supplier role) is created in the background and the data from the company/org structure (name, address, IDs, etc.) are copied to this business partner. If the data is changed afterwards, there is no synchronization between the org unit and the business partner anymore.-Resolution-The source for the business partner name fields (which are copied to the Purchase Order description) are the fields maintained in the Organizational Management work center (on the Address tab). Follow the steps below to verify:-Go to the Organizational Management work center-Go to the Org Structures view-Select each one of the affected org units and click on Edit-Navigate to its Addresses tab-You can change the information there directly, but in order to ensure the information will be synchronized in the future, please change the data located on the Business Partner Data work center:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center-Go to the Business Partner view-Search for each affected unit and click on Edit > General-Change the Business Partner Name field to the correct name-Keywords-Purchase Order; Purchasing Unit; Wrong Description

Title: Target Value for Supplier Contracts does not calculate automatically
Content: Symptom-When you create a supplier contract with an item with Target Quantity and Price, the Target Value will not be calculated automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Show All Contracts.-Search and open the Contract 123 (123 represents the ID of the Contract).-Go to the General tab.-You will see the Target Value is not defined. You expected this to be calculated automatically.-Go to Items tab.-You will see the Target Value is not defined. You expected this to be calculated automatically.-Cause-The system does not calculate the Target Value automatically as Target Value depends on your business and conditions you have discussed with your supplier.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-You must enter the Target Value manually.-Keywords-target value, total price, gross price

Title: Custom Approval buttons not working on TI screen
Content: Symptom-You have configured custom Approve, Reject or Send Back for Revision buttons on a TI screen however they are throwing the below errors when triggered:-"Could not find the executed task(s)"-"Could not correlate the process activity"-"Process instance not found for BO . ID"-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have created a custom Approval Process for a business object in the Cloud Application Studio.-You have configured custom buttons for this Approval Process on the TI screen of this business object.-Cause-When approval related actions (Approve, Reject or Send Back for Revision) are configured on the TI screen as buttons, the Approval Task ID and the business object instance Node ID have to be passed to the framework for them to check if there is a correct correlation between the instance the user is trying to approve and the Task ID. Because of technical reasons, the Task ID is not passed to the framework and the correlation check fails.-Resolution-The BO Instance can be approved directly from the Notifications UI. Please don't create and use approval related buttons except Submit and Withdraw on the TI as these actions will not work due to the limitation.-Keywords-Approval Process, Task, Node ID, Instance, BO, Submit, Withdraw, PDI, SDK, UI Designer, failed

Title: Not Able to Select India as Tax Country
Content: Symptom-You are creating a manual invoice request and when making the attempt of selecting India as the Tax Country, the system defaults to the ship-from country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice under Common Tasks view.-Enter the needed sales data.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Added Item ABC (ABC represents the ID of the material or service).-Navigated to the Taxes subtab.-When trying to change the Tax Country to India, system does not accept and revert back to the previous value.-Cause-System will try to use a default tax code maintained in the backend while changing the tax country manually. However, due to a special case, there is no default tax code for India. Hence, system reverts back to calculating the previously maintained country.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to select India as the tax country of the document, please change the address of the seller company, making the companies country as India.-See Also-2566977 - Tax Reporting Unit is not Determined for Service Confirmation Invoice Request-2377224 - How is the Tax Country Determined in a Down Payment Request which was Created via a Sales Order-Keywords-Tax Country, Invoice, Invoice Request, Manual, India, Tax Determination, Taxes, Region, Automatically

Title: Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group Service - time and material not supported for location of srv provision Supplier Service Center
Content: Symptom-When adding an item of type SECO – Service – Time and Material to a Service Order with Supplier Service Center as the Location of Service Provision, the error message “Item XX: Products w/ item group Service - time and material not supported for location of srv provision Supplier Service Center” is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open the Service Order ABC (where ABC stands for service order). -Add Item XX (where XX stands for the item with type SECO - Service - time and material)-Results the error message "Item XX: Products w/ item group Service - time and material not supported for location of srv provision Supplier Service Center".-Cause-The item type SECO - Service - time and material is not supported for Service Location Supplier. It cannot be processed in the Service Order for Location of Service Provision "Supplier".-The following item types available in service orders cannot be processed by Location of Service Provision "At Supplier Service Center".-CONS - Spare part - consumable-DIGI - Spare part - direct goods issue-PICK - Spare part - engineer pick-up or sales-SECO - Service - time and material-SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals-SERV - Service - fixed price-SHIP - Spare part - advanced ship or sales-XACT - Expense - time and material-XFIX - Expense - fixed price without actuals-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2616602 - Adding a Spare Part to a Service Order Leads to The Error ‘Item XXX: Products w/ item Group Spare Part (Advanced Ship/Sales) Not Supported For Location of srv Provision Supplier Service Center.’-Help Centre document: Services-Keywords-Service Order; Service - time and material; Service location Supplier; Location of Service Provision; item types

Title: All VAT/Sales Tax Items Report Does not Show All Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-You are checking the All VAT / Sales Tax Items report, however you are missing some customer invoices that have VAT and are posted as well.-This KBA is relevant for IT-Italy, which has tax payment deferral.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Lists view.-Open All VAT / Sales Tax Items report.-Execute the report so that the tax due date covers the related customer invoice dates.-You'll notice that some customer invoices that have VAT are not being retrieved in this report.-Cause-The missing customer invoices are posted with the checkbox for Tax Payment Deferral checked, so the VAT will be posted first to a deferred tax account and moved to the normal VAT account once the invoice is paid/cleared. After that, the invoice will also be picked up for reporting.-Resolution-In order for the invoices to show up for reporting, the documents need to be paid/cleared.-Note that once the invoice is posted, there is no way to change the deferred tax indicator anymore. If the invoices are incorrect and cannot be reversed, you may create credit memos for all incorrect invoices.-You can also adjust the payment deferral settings via fine-tune activity Tax on Goods and Services – Italy.-Keywords-VAT. Payment Deferred. Tax Deferral. Customer invoice. Supplier Invoice. Non-localized countries
