Title: Goods and Services Receipts Approval Process
Content: Symptom-When you post a Goods and Services Receipt, the status is changed to In Approval instead of Released. You expect the manager of the employee responsible for the goods and services receipt to be the approver. But the Manager is unable to see the approval task in the work items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Select the Approvals view.-The Goods and Services Receipt is not listed.-Resolution-The Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) approval task is routed to the manager of the cost object that is maintained at item level.-For example, the GSR is created with two line items: First line item is maintained with account assignment as Cost Center. Second line item is maintained with account assignment as Project Task-Then the approval task will be routed to the manager of the Cost Center and also the Person Responsible assigned in a Project.-See Also- 1947478 - Huge list of Persons Responsible Determined for an Approval Task-3325919 - How is approver determined in Goods receipt when account assignment has Service order or Sales order-Keywords

Title: 'Item AAA: No period defined for date DD.MM.YYYY in fiscal year' Error in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Error is displayed in Check action in purchase order handling: 'Item AAA: No period defined for date DD.MM.YYYY in fiscal year'-AAA means the purchase order line item.-DD.MM.YYYY means the purchase order line item Delivery Date.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign 2302-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Open the respective Purchase Order.-Click Edit.-Click Check.-Error is displayed:-'Item AAA: No period defined for date DD.MM.YYYY in fiscal year'-Remark: the same error might also be displayed while creating a New PO Acknowledgment, then changing the Delivery Date to a future date and clicking Accept Deviation.-Cause-The error comes because a year-specific fiscal year variant is being used for respective Company and Set of Books and the respective fiscal year in which DD.MM.YYYY date is included has not been maintained. With non-year-specific variants, the system has a "best guess" based on following the months of the year, but year-specific could have a period that starts in March and ends in April - we can't derive future years based on what exists because it could be changing each year.-Remarks:-To "post" the purchase orders and acknowledgments without this error appearing was previously possible in the system. From the SRM side, everything seemed to have gone fine, but in the background, the communication sending this purchase order to Financials had actually failed due to the year not being present. So in reality, this issue was always there, with the introduction of this error on the Purchase Order directly, we are stopping this at source. -An additional validation for the error message is planned to be implemented. This will consist in checking the scoping question for Financial Forecast "Do you want to use financial forecast for procurement?". If the question is scoped and a year-specific fiscal year variant is used (with respective fiscal year not maintained), then only the error will be displayed. This is planned for a future release of SAP Business ByDesign.-If there are more items with the same error, you need to edit all item's Delivery Dates before clicking in Send Update button in the Purchase Order. Otherwise the system will not accept the change in each item. -Resolution-So because you have the fiscal year variant as year-specific, this error gets raised as the year does not yet exist in the configuration. To solve the issue, you need to maintain the respective fiscal year.-Keywords-po; delivery date; fiscal year; year-specific; fyv; financial forecast

Title: Sales Order Mass Update Tool is Not Available in The System
Content: Symptom-You would like to mass update Sales Orders documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There is no tool which allows mass updates for Sales Orders.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order, Mass, Update, Tool.

Title: Error 'The requested material inspection does not exist' Appears When Trying to Change the Planned Quantity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the Planned Quantity from a Production Order but system throws error message 'The requested material inspection does not exist' and reverts the Planned Quantity to its original quantity, not allowing you to change the Planned Quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Workcenter.-Go to Production Orders.-Select All Production Orders then search for the relevant Production Order.-Click Edit then View all to open the Production Order.-In General tab, try to Change Planned quantity from the original quantity to a considerable larger amount (ex.: from 50,000 to 500,000 each) using the calculator icon then press Enter key on keyboard.-Error message "The requested material inspection does not exist" throws and the Planned quantity changes back to its original quantity.-Cause-The error encountered is valid and a normal system behavior.-You can check that there is a Quality check related to it if we open the Production Order workcenter and Order Structure view.-Also, if you are trying to change the original quantity to a smaller or larger amount the Requested End date is no longer feasible for the new amount that you are now requesting, hence the error message appears.-Resolution-As a solution, you can first extend the End Date and then change the planned quantity to the desirable amount.-Keywords-planned quantity, production order,

Title: Validation of ISR Payment Reference Number and ISR Subscriber Number Fields in Supplier Invoice for Supplier Located in Switzerland
Content: Symptom-You would like to pay the supplier located in Switzerland through Swiss account number but when you are trying to create supplier invoice you found that fields ISR Payment Reference Number and ISR Subscriber Number are editable.-You would like to hide these fields because you suspect the values for ISR Payment Reference Number and ISR Subscriber Number can be changed and this may cause incorrect payment to the supplier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Select the supplier & Edit the Financial Data.-Got to the Bank Data tab.-You can see that  ISR Payment Reference Number and ISR Subscriber Number not maintained.-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Find the Invoice ABC.-Select the Edit button and then click on View All.-You will find the fields ISR Payment Reference Number and ISR Subscriber Number are displayed and editable.-Resolution-The ISR Payment Reference Number and ISR Subscriber Number Fields are shown on the supplier invoicing screens regardless of the financial data of the Supplier. When you will enter ISR Payment Reference Number & ISR Subscriber Number details the system does a check with the data maintained in the financial data of the supplier.-You can post the invoice only if the data matches between the value entered while creating the Supplier Invoice and financial data of the Supplier maintained in Supplier Base work center. Also if financial data of the supplier are not maintained, the system will not allow you to post the supplier invoice.-Keywords-isr subscriber number,supplier invoice,isr payment reference number

Title: Monitoring Invoices Report Not Showing Values As Expected
Content: Symptom- The Monitoring Invoices report does not show the Supplier Invoices once the Row Fields and Key Figures are insert in the Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports view.-Open report 'Monitoring Invoices'.-In the superior tab, insert 'Selection: Initial' and 'View: Monitoring Invoices'.-In lower Selection section, insert the needed information (Supplier, Display Currency and other fields).-Click in Apply.-It shows invoices ABC, DEF and GHI (ABC, DEF and GHI are supplier invoices).-In View section, maintain the needed Row Fields and Key Figures.-Now invoices ABC, DEF and GHI are no longer being shown.-Cause-You are using the Key Figure 'Invoice Price'. If the values for Invoice Price are zero or null in invoice, then the records will not be displayed in the Report. So the Invoice Price needs to have a value for the records to be shown when this Key Figure is used.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Report; Key Figure; Invoice Price; Monitoring Invoices

Title: Process Communication Error in Supplier Quote
Content: Symptom-Process Communication Error in Supplier Quote-Error - Intercompany posting not allowed;Cost Center belongs to different company-Environment-SAP Busines ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing and Contracting Workcenter-RFQS and Quotes View-Quotes subview-Select the Quote - DEF(DEF refers to the Supplier Quote)-Navigate to the Document flow-You see that there is a Process communication error-The following errors have been addressed to your service providerSupplier Quote DEF(DEF refers to the Supplier Quote) cannot create a Purchase Order Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Cause- Intercompany posting not allowed; Cost Center belongs to a different company. The employee is trying to use as Cost Assignment a Cost Center that does not belong to the same company the error message will be shown. Intercompany assignment are only allowed for Cost Assignment as Other Cost Objects-Resolution-System allows only cost centers of the company in which Purchase order is created.( that is creator or on behalf of person's company's cost centers only).-This is the system behavior

Title: How to determine 'Service Execution Team' in a Service Order
Content: Symptom-The service execution team is not the one expected in the service order.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Work Center 'Service Orders'.-2. Go to View 'Service Order Processing'.-3. Edit the Service Order <X>.-4. Go to 'View All' -> Go to the 'General' tab.-The service execution team is not the one expected.-Cause-The service execution team is determined according to the following rules :-Rule #1 Responsibility to Determine Execution Team - Service Order-It is possible to create responsibility rules for this work category related to the following standard set of parameters derived from the account entered in the sales document:-Country, Region, ZIP Code, City, Service Category, case Category-Country, Region, ZIP Code, City, Account ID, ABC Classification-Country, Region, ZIP Code, City-Country, Region, ZIP Code, City, Product ID, Product Category-Prerequisites :-The following business option must be activated: Service > Product and Service portfolio > Offered Services and Service > Service > Field Service and Repair > Service Order-The service units must have been defined in the org management which are responsible for executing the services sold in a service order.-Rule #2 Functional Unit of Processor-If the first rule is not set-up the system tries to derive the functional unit from the processor.-Rule #3-If the Organizational model contains only one sales unit, then this one is taken.-Resolution-How to maintain the Responsibility to Determine Service Execution Team-1. Go to Work Center 'Organizational Management'.-2. Go to View 'Work Distribution'.-3. Select Work Category -> Service and Support.-4. Select Resp. to Determine Service Execution Team - Service Order and Edit.-You can define work distribution rules by selecting the priority (from 1 to n), the ID of Org Unit Responsible and the valid from and to date. -Then you can select the rule details : Company, Country, Region, City, ZIP Code, ABC Classification and Account.

Title: How Output Channel Selection Works in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You would like to understand how the system determines which output channel to use for each of the documents in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The document will determine the output channel in the following sequence:-If the document involves a customer account or a supplier (e.g. sales orders and purchase orders respectively), system will prioritize the output channel determined for that document within the Communication > Collaboration tab of the customer/supplier's master data.-In case no output channel is maintained as mentioned above or the document does not involve customers/suppliers, the output channel is determined based on the rules maintained for that document under the Application and User Management > Output Channel Selection work center view.-The system will go sequentially through the rules and will pick the first valid rule. You can change the Sequence by clicking on the Change Sequence button. Click Move Up or Move Down to change the order of the form template rules. The system applies the rules in the order they appear on the screen.-If the system cannot resolve the selection—either because there are many rules conflicting with each other or there is no output channel which matches the restrictions set up in the rule or it simply does not understand the rules maintained—it will resort to the default output channel for that document.-Additionally, for some documents (depending on status), you can manually select the output setting by clicking the You Can Also button and selecting Edit Output Settings while in View All mode.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Sales Order, Output Channel Selection, Output Channels Selection, Definition, Determination, Created, Changed, Canceled, 采购订单, 输出渠道, Print Queue, Printer, E-Mail, Fax, Output Channel Selection

Title: Delivery Status of Puchase Order is Shown as Not Relevant after it was sent to Supplier
Content: Symptom-You create a purchase order and after filling in all the necessary details you send it to the supplier. The status of the purchase order is changed to Sent but the delivery status for this purchase order is shown as Not Relevant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to the system and go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center and then to the Purchase Orders view.-Choose the New Purchase Order hyperlink at the bottom left corner of the screen.-On the purchase order details screen, enter all the necessary header as well as item information and choose the Send button.-Go back to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center and then to the Purchase Orders view and search for the newly created purchase order.-The value in the Delivery Status column is shown as Not Relevant instead of Not Started or In Process.-Cause-While creating the purchase order you did not enable the Goods and Services Receipt Expected indicator.-Resolution-Log on to the system and go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center and then to the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the purchase order in question and choose the Edit button.-On the details screen, go to the Items tab.-At the bottom left of the screen you will find the indicator Goods and Services Receipt Expected, flag this checkbox. -If this indicator is checked for the purchase order, the delivery will be expected and the delivery status will not be shown as Not Relevant.-After making the above mentioned changes, resend the purchase order to the supplier. The issue should be resolved now.

Title: Number Ranges for Strategic Purchasing Documents is close to depletion
Content: Symptom-While creating a new Strategic Purchasing Documents, the system generates a unique number for the Strategic Purchasing Documents. It is necessary that the system should have enough unique numbers left in the existing number range to allow you to create new Strategic Purchasing Documents.-Your system is running out of unique numbers for new Strategic Purchasing Documents. It may happen that your system may get exhausted of the unique numbers of the existing number range. You may not be able to create any further new Strategic Purchasing Documents in your system.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the work center 'Business configuration'.-2. Go to the view 'Fine Tuning Activity'.-3. Click on the link for the activity 'Number Ranges for Number Ranges for Strategic Purchasing Documents'.-Here you can see two columns 'Start Number' & 'End Number' and you will find that Number range for Strategic Purchasing Documents is close to depletion.-Resolution-1. Go to the work center 'Business configuration'.-2. Go to the view 'Fine Tuning Activity'.-3. Click on the link for the activity 'Number Ranges for Number Ranges for Strategic Purchasing Documents'.-4. Now click on the value of 'End Number' and increase the number as per as your requirment.-5. Click the button 'Save and Close'.-6. Now you would get a confirmation message 'Your settings are saved and deployed successfully'.-7. Click the button 'OK'.-Now, your number range has sufficient free numbers to create new Strategic Purchasing Documents.-In case, you need any further assistance, please forward the case to SAP by action 'Send to Service provider'.

Title: How to Cancel a Scheduled Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have several Scheduled Invoice Requests that need to be cancelled but you do not see a cancel button on the Invoice Requests Worklist and the Cancel button of the Invoice Schedule subtab is also greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-These steps also apply for Scheduled Invoice Requests coming from a Sales Order.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice requests View.-Search for Scheduled Invoice Requests YYY and select it (YYY represents the Invoice Request ID).-There is no possibility to either delete or cancel this Invoice Request from the worklist nor from the Invoice Request screen itself.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for contract CCC and select it (CCC stands for the associated contract ID).-Click on Edit and then View all.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Invoice Scheduling subtab.-In the Invoice Schedule: Item View, the Cancel button is also greyed out for all items.-Resolution-To proceed with the cancellation of these Scheduled Invoice Requests, please do the following:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for contract CCC and select it.-Click on Edit and then View all.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Invoice Scheduling subtab.-In the Invoice Schedule: Item View, click on the Expand All button.-The different items to be invoiced are now displayed.-Select the line which has the same date as the Invoice Date on the Invoice Request to be cancelled: dd.mm.yyyy.-Click on the Remove button to remove this Item from the Scheduled Invoice Request.-The line is immediately removed.-If this Invoice requests have several items that need to be invoiced at the same time, make sure all Items are removed for the same date dd.mm.yyyy.-Once all items are removed, the Scheduled Invoice Requests disappears from the Invoice request worklist.-Please note:-If the Price per Period indicator is activated, then invoicing amount is proportionally distributed amongst all Invoice requests and removing a line from the Item does not impact the overall amount (100%).-If this indicator is not flagged, it is necessary to update the amount of one of the remaining lines in order to bring the total amount to be invoiced to 100% again.-To check if this indicator is activated, navigate to the Items tab of your Contract and check the General subtab in Details.-See Also-Help Document: Invoice Schedule-Keywords-Invoice Scheduling, Invoice Schedule, Scheduled Invoice Requests, contract, sales order, Price per Period, cancel, cancellation, remove

Title: Size Limit For Attachments In SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The goal of this knowledge base article is to provide useful information about file size restrictions on attachments uploaded into SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-SAP Business Bydesign and SAP Cloud for Customer do not have user specific limit in the contract. However, there are some general restrictions.-The file size of individual attachments that are being uploaded into SAP Business ByDesign should not exceed 100MB. Furthermore, there could also be file size restrictions on certain business documents.-For example, 5MB is the maximum size allowed for attachments in Incidents under the Application and User Management work center. With 2305 release, the maximum allowed attachment size for Incidents will be 50 MB-In any case, the system should not be used as a document management system and it is not designed to store and administer many large files like videos. For such requirements, we would recommend using an external document management system and then adding a link to this system in the corresponding SAP Business ByDesign master data/transactional data records.-Keywords-Attachment size, File size, File size limit, Attachment upload

Title: Number Ranges for Operational Purchasing Documents is close to depletion
Content: Symptom-There are two Operational Purchasing Documents available for which number range may get exhausted.-1. Goods and Services Receipts-2. Purchase Orders-While creating a new Operational Purchasing Documents, the system generates a unique number for the Operational Purchasing Documents. It is necessary that the system should have enough unique numbers left in the existing number range to allow you to create new Operational Purchasing Documents.-Your system is running out of unique numbers for new Operational Purchasing Documents. It may happen that your system may get exhausted of the unique numbers of the existing number range. You may not be able to create any further new Operational Purchasing Documents in your system-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the work center 'Business configuration'.-2. Go to the view 'Fine Tuning Activity'.-3. Click on the link for the activity 'Operational Purchasing Documents'.-Here, you can see two number ranges for 'Operational Purchasing Documents'.-   Goods and Services Receipts-   Purchase Orders-Here you can see two columns 'Start Number' & 'End Number' and you will find that Number range for either Goods and Services Receipts or Purchase Orders which one is close to depletion.-Resolution-1. Go to the work center 'Business configuration'.-2. Go to the view 'Fine Tuning Activity'.-3. Click on the link for the activity 'Operational Purchasing Documents'.-Here, you can see two number ranges for 'Operational Purchasing Documents'.-   Goods and Services Receipts-   Purchase Orders-4. Now click on the value of 'End Number' and increase the number either for Goods and Services Receipts or Purchase Orders as per as your requirment which one is close to depletion.-5. Click the button 'Save and Close'.-6. Now you would get a confirmation message 'Your settings are saved and deployed successfully'.-7. Click the button 'OK'.-Now, your number range has sufficient free numbers to create new 'Operational Purchasing Documents'.-In case, you need any further assistance, please forward the case to SAP by action 'Send to Service provider'.

Title: How to Assign Person Responsible for BTM Tasks Related to Point of Sale Transactions
Content: Symptom-Tasks get created after the failure of the A2A messages for Point of Sales Transaction documents.-How to assign person responsible to process these tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and User Management workcenter and Business Task Management-2. Select by All Activities-3. You will find Tasks related to Point of Sale Transaction.-  Cause-For Tasks created in Business Task Management related to Point of Sales Transactions it is not possible to assign a specific user.-We understand that only Admins and limited colleagues have access to Application and User Management so they can process these tasks.-Resolution-System is behaving as per the design.-Keywords-Point of Sales Transaction, Business Task Management, Application and User Management, Assign, Responsible

Title: System Crashes While Posting Supplier Invoice Containing a Custom Tax Code
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when trying to either Post or Simulate Journal Entry for a supplier invoice containing a custom tax code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Find the respective supplier invoice and click Edit.-Click Post.-System crashes.-Remark: the system also crashes if you click Actions --> Simulate Journal Entry.-Cause-One of the possible causes is that an incorrect Due Category has been assigned to the respective custom tax event.-For example, for Supplier Invoices the system expects Due Category 2 - Receivable instead of 1 - Payable (which is expected for Customer Invoices).-Due to this incorrect Due Category assignment, in the system crash logs (that can be checked by SAP Support via backend system), the error log would show a doubling in the tax amount and therefore the overall invoice balance would not be consistent.-Resolution-The Due Category should be corrected for the respective custom tax event (changed to 2 - Receivable). This shall be done in respective custom/PDI solution in SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK).-Keywords-siv; tax code; due category; CL_FIA_ACCNOTIF_SF_INVACCNOTIF=>CHECK_ACC_DOC_CREATION; Invoice Accounting Notification: Balance of the invoice is bigger than permitted

Title: The Payment File SEPA - <AdrLine> has More Than 70 Characters
Content: Symptom-You are facing an issue with bank where they cannot process the payment file (SEPA).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Outbound Files subview.-Select All Outbound Files in the dropdown field. -Search for File ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the file ID).-Click View All.-Download the Document file XML in the Attachment tab. -You will see in the XML file the following tag:-<AdrLine>ABC</AdrLine>-(ABC represents the data between the tag <AdrLine> and </AdrLine>-When you try to upload the file in the bank system, the bank reports the following error:-The length of the value 'ABC' value '70' of the type definition 'AT_Max70Text'.-Cause-Based on the SEPA specification, the tag <AdrLine> has field length of 70 characters. But in our system, this exceeds this limit due to its data type.-That's why you are receiving the error message from bank that the bank is not able to process the file.-Resolution-As the field length is limited to 70 characters, you need to adjust the address details in the limited length.-Keywords-SEPA; <AdrLine>; 70; length; Payment File; XML

Title: How to Remove the Watermark "Implementation Project Not Yet Live"
Content: Symptom-You are working on a system which yet to Confirm Go Live. Hence, you can find the watermark "Implementation Project Not Yet Live" on the bottom of the screen. But, you would like to know whether it is possible to remove or hide this watermark.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Activity "Confirm Go Live" in activity list of the Implementation Project has not been performed.-Resolution-It is not possible to remove the watermark. You have to perform the activity "Confirm Go Live" in activity list of the Implementation Project. After this the status of the Implementation Project is set to "Live" and afterwards the watermark will be removed.-Keywords-Watermark, Go Live

Title: PTRS file not created
Content: Symptom-You have ran the Payment Times Reporting and you noticed that the PTRS file was not created after the execution of the report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Wc > Payment Times Reporting > Select the Report ID and open it-Go to Australia PTRS Output file tab-The file is not available-Cause-The reason that the output file is not created by default is that the output file is based on a detailed legal requirement / description by the Australian government and one of the basic rules is that reporting is to be done in the local Set of Books (SoB) currency which is expected to be Australian Dollar.-To check the currency assigned for the Set of Book-Go to General Ledger Wc > Master Data > Sets of Books and Assigned Companies-Search for your Company ID and Set of Books ID-In General Information, you can see the company currency-Resolution-If the currency of the Set of Book is different than Australian Dollar, during the execution of the report, flag the parameter "Report in Set Of Books Currency" and run the report again-See Also-Payment Times Reporting - Australia -Keywords-PTRS, report, file not created, not available, generated

Title: Sales Order In Process Due to Delivery Status But Outbound Delivery and Invoicing is Already Completed
Content: Symptom-In a Sales Order scenario, you notice that some line items still have their Delivery Status as 'In Process', however, the full quantity has been already delivered via Outbound Delivery and invoiced via Customer Invoice.-This KBA is only relevant if the Sales Order has been created from a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order which is still In Process).-Click on Edit.-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.- You see the following setup on the line items:- Line item AA: This line item is Completed.- Line item BB: This line item contains the same Product as AA, but the Delivery Status is 'In Process' and the Invoicing Status is 'Not Started'.-Now, navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Open Purchase Order DEF (Where DEF represents the ID of the Purchase Order which created Sales Order ABC).- You notice that the Purchase Order only has one line item which represents the sum of Products in line item AA and BB of the Sales Order.-Cause-This issue can happen when the quantity of an item is changed in the Purchase Order by increasing the amount (For example, changing an amount from 5 to 10), but in the Sales Order this change is represented by adding a new item to the document (For example, having an item with an amount of 5 and then adding a new line item with another amount of 5 of the same product).- This causes a scenario where the Purchase Order is only linked to the line item which was originally present in the Sales Order, and not to the new one. When the documents are then Delivered and Invoiced, the system understands that the original item in the Sales Order (Which came from the Purchase Order) was over-delivered and that the new item in the Sales Order has not been Delivered or Invoiced, which causes the Sales Order to still be In Process.-Resolution-You have two options to correct the scenario:-You can cancel all of the documents and re-create them with the correct quantities and following the correct process.-You can cancel the line items in the Sales Order that are not present in the Purchase Order. This will affect the total value of the sales order due to the process that was followed, but the delivered and invoiced amounts will still be correct.-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Request, Invoiced, Delivered, Fulfilled, Incorrect, Inconsistent, Status, Outbound Delivery, OD, Customer Invoice, Invoicing, Link, Linked

Title: Filter and Sort Functionality Not Available for the Requested Date field in the Service Quotes Screen
Content: Symptom-When navigating in the Service Quotes screen, you notice that there is no option to Sort or Filter by the field Requested Date.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center. -Open the Service Quotes view.-In the Service Quote list screen, click the "Requested Date" column.-You will notice that the menu with the "Sort Ascending"/"Sort Descending"/"Filter" options does not pop up.-However, if you try the same in other screens, such as Sales Order, the options are available.-Cause-The Service Quotes screen is built upon a different technical infrastructure from other screens such as Sales Order, which makes the behaviour of the "Requested Date" field different.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. Not being able to Sort and Filter by the "Requested Date" field is a technical limitation due to how the Service Quotes screen works.-Keywords-Requested Date, Field, Service Quotes, OWL, ./RequestedDate, Limitation, Issue, Filtering, Sorting

Title: How to solve "Duplicate variants exists for the variantid" error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-When releasing a document, an output error informs about duplicate variants for the variant number. The following error is shown: "There are duplicate variants for the variant number"-But there are no duplicates in the Form Template Maintenance UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example for Purchase Order Reminder Letter:-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Order Reminder Letter view-Go to Purchase order Remainder Letter Proposals subview-Search for the relevant proposal-Go to Output Details under Output History Tab-Find the error message: Duplicate variants exists for the Variantid-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Form Template Maintenance view-Filter for the document, in this case for Template Name: Purchase Order Reminder Letter-Find only one variant per Country/Language combination-Cause-These duplicate variants were created during a release upgrade. Development is not yet sure about the root cause. So far, only the Purchase Order Reminder Letter (S1038) template is affected, but the issue might also happen for other forms.-Resolution-Until the issue is fixed, the only option is to remove the duplicate variants manually:-Go to Application and User Management-Go to Form Template Maintenance-Filter for the document, in this case for Template Name: Purchase Order Reminder Letter-Find several form variants, like in English, Dutch, German and French language-Mark the row of one of the form variants, e.g.: Purchase Order Reminder Letter in Dutch language-Open the debugging console via Ctrl+Alt+Shift+D (keep all keys pressed until the console appears)-In the debugging console, select the Controllers / Data tab-Select the second Controller ID row (ending with '_OWL.OWL.uicomponent')-In the list below, find the Variant Path records for all form variants-Scroll down to the first Variant Path record (you may need to select More to reach it)-Copy the path of the value, e.g. /SAP_BYD/Purchasing/Templates/%2fS18.FLDR/00163E073D681ED7B6FA0ABC9B144451.TMPL/S1038__EN__NL.xdp (which relates to the Dutch language version)-Note it down-Scroll down further to find the variant paths for the other language versions-Note them down-Go to the backend-Select XREP transaction-Below File/Folder on the left side, expand Development-Expand SAP_BYD according to the path (in this case: SAP_BYD > Purchasing > Templates > %2fS18.FLDR > 00163E073D681ED7B6FA0ABC9B144451.TMPL)-Now check the endings. For some language versions, there might be two records with a different amount of underscores before the country code (here: '__NL' and '_NL')-For the given example,  find a record like 'S1038__EN__NL.xdp' which matches the ending of above mentioned path-But find also another record like 'S1038__EN_NL.xdp' which does not match the ending of the path and is an incorrect/duplicate record-Double-click this incorrect/duplicate record -Click Logical Delete button-Select Save-Do the same for all affected form variants-If you unsure, please involve an experienced colleague.-Keywords-Duplicate Variants, Forms, There are duplicate variants for the variant number

Title: Error in Supplier Invoice: 'Posting is not possible. Invoicing unit has no employee assigned. Contact a user administrator to assign the default employee responsible.'
Content: Symptom-Error message is triggered for Supplier Invoice when opened, but it is gone after saving it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Click in Check button.-You get error message: 'Posting is not possible. Invoicing unit has no employee assigned. Contact a user administrator to assign the default employee responsible.'-Click in Save button.-The error message is no longer there.-Cause-If you open Supplier Invoice ABC's General tab, you can see that 'Entry Method: External application'. Since this invoice was created by an external application, no employee (business user) was assigned to the Invoicing Unit. When the user opens the Invoice and Save it, only then, the system is able to assign the Invoicing Unit for this user. For the invoices that are created externally, the system is unable to automatically assign it. That's why this message is triggered.-For example, if the Supplier invoice was created manually, this message wouldn't be triggered. That's because the Invoicing unit would already be assigned to the creator (business user).-Resolution-The system is behaving as expected.-Keywords-Supplier invoice; Invoicing unit; Employee responsible; User administrator; External application

Title: Extension Field Added to the Payment Data of Customers is not Visible in Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You have added an Extension Field in the Payment Data screen of Customers but the Field is missing in the Migration Template for Customers.-When you select Adapt Migration Object of Migration of Customers, system shows the Information No Adaptations available for migration object. But still the field is not available in the Migration Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Select Customers view and sub view Customers.-Select a Customer and select Edit button and choose Financial Data.-In the subtab Payment Data, you have added the extension field.-Cause-The feature of extending an Extension Field added to a Payment Data to a Migration template cannot be implemented at the moment due to technical constraints.-Resolution-Therefore, check whether an extension on the General tab would be feasible for you as extension in this area are supported in the migration process for Accounts.-See Also-Note:-Above scenario will holds good only for the Customer Migration and for the Payment Data tab-This KBA holds good for both KUT & PDI fields which you have created under Payment Data tab-Fields which you created will not be available to Migration of Customers-Keywords-Account, Extension Field, KUT Field, Payment Data, Migration Template, Migration Tool, Migration of Customers.

Title: Mails going into spam even with DKIM
Content: Symptom-Mails are going into the spam folder although the header contains a valid DKIM signature-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-IP's are not whitelisted-Resolution-Please contact your IT Department to set IP's allowed:-Listing for receiving E-Mails in your Infrastructure and-SPF records that you created in your own DNS and-any throttling on your e-Mail server based on IP address,-Whitelisting / Authentication based on e-mail headers like “Return-Path” / “Envelope-Sender” / “mailfrom” / “Bounce Address-See below:-Business E-Mails are relayed from ByDesign (SAP Network) – Cronus (Hosted in SAP Network) – AWS (Hosted in Internet) – Recipients.-Business E-Mails will be enabled with SPF policy by default.-Business E-Mails are sent through these IP ranges/addresses 199.255.192.0/22, 199.127.232.0/22, 54.240.0.0/18, 69.169.224.0/20, 23.249.208.0/20, 23.251.224.0/19, 76.223.176.0/20, 54.240.64.0/19, 54.240.96.0/19, 52.82.172.0/22.-SPF records for the business mails are updated on the technical From/Mail From/Envelop-From address, which is always dsn@myXXXXXX.mail.sapbydesign.com or dsn@myXXXXXX.mail.sapbyd.cn. Example: SPF record for domain: myXXXXXX.mail.sapbydesign.com or myXXXXXX.mail.sapbyd.cn would look be like: “v=spf1 include:_spf.cmail.ondemand.com include:amazonses.com ~all“-See Also-Blog: Next-Generation Cloud Delivery transition – New Business ByDesign E-mail Infrastructure-Keywords-Spam Folder, DKIM, Emails going into Spam, White List, IP address

Title: Slowness When Trying to Activate Org Structure
Content: Symptom-You are facing a slowness when trying to activate Org Structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management Work Center.-Go to the Org Structures View.-Click Edit.-Select the Org Unit.-Click Activate -> Activate Selected Structure.-The page keeps loading and the changes are not activated.-Cause-The selection action Activate Selected Structure will activate / process the entire org structure from the root till the leaf. Since there are a lot of org units, the check action processes a lot of org units and time slices and hence it is taking time for the execution.-Resolution-To execute the action at the leaf level or a lower level it is better if the Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units option is selected. This will make sure that only the selected org unit and anything below that is processed for activation. This will also make sure that the action is completed faster.-Please try to execute the activation action by selecting Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units option option.-Keywords-Org Structure, Slowness, Activate, Selected Structure and Dependent Org unit

Title: ODATA Query for Report and Data Sources Fetches Only 50 Records
Content: Symptom-ODATA query for report and data sources fetches only 50 records.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You tried to fetch data from a report or data source using an Odata query, but the result is restricted to 50 entries.-Cause-There is a restriction for the records fetch in ODATA to be 50 to avoid memory timeout. Hence an ODATA query for a report or data source will not fetch more than 50 records.-Resolution-You can bypass this limitation using the $top or $skip option. The $top=n where n is a number option specifies that only the first n records will be returned. Hence if you specify the $top=100 will return the first 100 entries. This might end up in a timeout for larger values for $top.-See Also-Please, refer the blog on ODATA for further information OData for SAP Business ByDesign Analytics.-Keywords-ODATA, 50 records, $top, $skip, restricted data retrieval

Title: Unable to Cancel Customer Invoices - Japan
Content: Symptom-You want to cancel the Customer Invoice ABC (where ABC stands for the Customer Invoice). However, you find that the "Cancel" button of Customer Invoice ABC is grayed out.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center-Go to Invoice Documents View-Search for Customer Invoice ABC, you find that the "Cancel" button is grayed out.-Cause-As per the system design, you cannot cancel the Customer Invoices if they are included in the Summary Invoices. If you open Invoice Summary Documents: Monthly Invoice EFG (where EFG stands for the Monthly Invoice), you can see the Customer Invoice ABC is included in the Monthly Invoice EFG.-You can also use the following steps to check if the Customer Invoices are included in the Summary Invoices:-Go to Receivables Work Center, Reports View-Open the Report:Clearing Status Report for Japan (GLOISJPU01_Q0001)-In the Selection, maintain Customer Invoice ID in the Field: Invoice ID Item-In the View, add the Field: Monthly Invoice ID to the Row Field-Click Apply button-If the report can display the results, the Customer Invoices are included in the Summary Invoices.-Resolution-To cancel this kind of Customer Invoices, you first have to cancel the corresponding recent Payer Invoice (Only latest Payer Invoice for the Payer-Grouping Unit combination can be cancelled). Cancellation of Payer Invoice will lead to the cancellation included Monthly Invoices, post which you can cancel the Customer Invoice and then schedule a Summary Invoice Run again.-Instead of canceling all the latest Payer Invoices, you are recommended to create Credit Memos for Customer Invoices instead.-Keywords-Customer Invoices, Cancel, Summary Invoices, Payer Invoices

Title: The Function ReadOutputPDF Does not Return the PDF File When Using the Webservice of QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn
Content: Symptom-You noticed that when using the function ReadOutputPDF from Webservice QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn, it does not return the PDF file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2302 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center and then Service Explorer view.-Search for the Service Name QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn.-Click Download WSDL.-Open the WSDL and maintain the credentials.-Edit the values according to your request.-Execute the call.-PDF file is not generated.-Cause-This is expected behaviour, in code it is marked as original when Country is Australia (AT), group code is C41 and template code is C4101.-Clearing the output PDF data when original is marked. So, it is not getting the output PDF data in response section.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-ReadOutputPDF, Not working, not Returning, PDF, Webservice, QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn.

Title: Extension Field Still Editable Even When the Document is Finished
Content: Symptom-You have created an Extension Field in the e.g Sales Order screen and you expect that when the Sales Order is Completed that field would become non editable. However, the field is still editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2302 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center and then Sales Orders view.-Search for the Required Sales Order and open it.-Click View.-Go to the location of the Extension Field.-Field is still editable.-Cause-When we open the Adaptation Mode we can set the field to read only, then it will be always read only. The same is valid when the Extension Field is marked as editable, it will be editable as well.-Resolution-Currently this is the expected system behavior.-You can achieve your requirement by creating the field from the SDK (PDI) in order to create specific rules.-Keywords-Extension Field, KUT Field, Editable, Still Can edit, Document, Business Object, Completed, Adaptation Mode.

Title: Return to Supplier Lifecycle Status Not Updated to Finished
Content: Symptom-You expect the lifecycle status of a return to supplier to be Finished, but it remains as In Process or Released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Return to Suppliers view-Open return to supplier ABC (ABC refers to the document ID)-You see the lifecycle status is unexpected-Cause-In order to finish a return to supplier, you need to maintain the Follow-up decision and complete the outbound delivery process for each of the return to supplier items.-If you only maintained Follow-up decision, but have not started outbound delivery process, the lifecycle status of the return to supplier remains as In Process.-If you only completed the outbound delivery process, but have not maintained the Follow-up decision, the lifecycle status of the return to supplier remains as Released, with a task "Provide Follow-Up Decision in Return to Supplier ABC".-Resolution-Please maintain the Follow-up decision or complete the outbound delivery process accordingly.-See Also-2702184 - Return to Supplier With Follow-Up Decision: Replacement is in Status- In Process-Keywords-Return to Supplier Status, Lifecycle Status, Not Finished, Follow-up Decision

Title: The Key Figure Group is not Preserved in the Custom Reports
Content: Symptom-You are creating a report by copying a SAP standard report or creating a new data source based on a SAP standard data source, however, all the original Key Figure Groups in the standard report do not get copied to the new report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Select the SAP standard report XYZ from which you want to copy and create a new report. (Where XYZ corresponds to report ID)-Click on New button and select the option Report as Copy.-On Copy Report: XYZ screen, under step 1: Define Report and Select Data Source, give the name and the description of the report.-Click Next and Go to Step 2: Select Key Figures.-Here in the show field, select Key Figure Group option from the drop down menu.-All the Key Figure Groups will be displayed in the list.-Here, you can only select one Key Figure Group from the list.-Cause-This is designed system behavior. Each Key Figure Group is a structure delivered as part of standard data sources. Each Key Figure Group has an underlying implementation and has a 1:1 relationship with the report.-Each Structure has an exit class under parameters. If there are multiple Key Figure Groups in the report then there will be a conflict at runtime in determining which structure was involved in execution.-Please note: If the exit class is on a characteristic with 'Fixed value selection' the value help will be blank as the chosen value is hard coded.-Please note the same logic also exisits for custom data sources and custom reports.-Resolution-When creating a report as a copy of a standard report or creating a new report, make sure you always select one Key Figure Group that matters the most in your report. When you go to Step 2: Select Key Figures, click on Show and from the drop down options, select Key Figure Group .-All the Key Figure Groups will be listed down. Now choose the one which you require in the report.-If not selected the system randomly selects a Key Figure Group.-Keywords-Key Figure Groups, Custom Reports, Report, Key figure, Standard Reports, blank

Title: Field Person Responsible auto-populate in Project Task
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when clearing the field "Person Responsible" in a Project Task, after saving, the same field auto-populate with the responsible person of the Project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the work center Project Management-Select the Projects view-Search, Open and View All the Project ABC-Under Project Plan > Gantt Chart, select the task ABC.1-Remove the actual Person Responsible and Save: the same or another responsible person will be auto-populated.-You can replace the person responsible with another one and save, but you cannot keep the field blank as the Person Responsible from the main task always repopulate the field.-Cause-This is a standard functionality in ByD.-Resolution-If a checklist is assigned to a task, you cannot clear out the responsible employee.-If it is blanked out,  then the responsible person for the project or the one above in the hierarchy will be proposed automatically.-Keywords-Project Task, Person Responsible, Responsible Employee

Title: Warning message - Stand alone Credit memo XXXXX not included in this tax return
Content: Symptom-You have executed the EC Sales List Runs and observed the warning message - Stand alone Credit memo XXXXX not included in this tax return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click on EC Sales List Runs.-Click New - Tax Return Run.-Fill the data and Schedule the run.-Open the Log ID and Go to Results tab.-Here, you can find the warning message Stand alone Credit memo XXXXX not included in this tax return.-Cause-The Tax Return Type is "8 - Modelo 349" in the EC Sales List Run. AS of February 2002, a Ministerial Order approved a new format for Model 349.This new order included Record type 2 “Rectification”. The rectification record must contain detailed information to identify the rectification made.[Please find the Rectification document in the attached Text file]-In this case, there must an invoice linked with the Credit Memo. If the invoice is not linked then the Tax authority can’t calculate the rectification record amount.-Resolution-You need to link an Invoice with the Credit Memo and then execute the EC Sales List Run.-Keywords-Stand alone Credit memo, Tax Return, 8 - Modelo 349, Model 349.

Title: Cannot Add Surcharge with Percentage at Header Level
Content: Symptom-You have performed the needed changes under the activity Configure Price Strategy and added Surcharge to show in the Total Pricing section, but the same is not working.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Scroll down to Total Pricing.-Click Add Row.-System does not display the Surcharge with Percentage as expected.-Cause-Currently the header Price Component Surcharge available in the system are in step 71, 72, 73 and 74, but all having fixed price.-Surcharges% (Percentage) are only available on item level and on header level you can add only Surcharges fixed amount.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2461886 - Price Component Surcharge Cannot be Selected in the Total Pricing Section of a Sales Order or Service Order-2898021 - Pricing Components Are Not Available in Item Level for Sales Documents-Keywords-Surcharge, Sales, Document, Percentage, Total Pricing, Header, Level, Item, 71, 72, 73, 74, %, Fixed Amount

Title: Blue Invoice Text is Not Passed from Customer Invoice to Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You find that the Blue Invoice Text field is not passed from Customer Invoice to Journal Entry. The Blue Invoice Text field is only supported in China.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoice Work Center-Open Customer Invoice XXX (where XXX stands for Customer Invoice document)-You have maintained Internal Comment EFG (where EFG stands for Internal Comment) under General tab-Go to General Ledger Work Center-Open Journal Entry YYY (where YYY stands for Journal Entry)-You can see the Blue Invoice Text field is blank-Cause-The header text of the Journal Entry will only take from Internal Comment or Customer Information of Customer Invoice and will not pass to the Blue Invoice Text.-This is the current system design.-Resolution-You can manually maintain the Blue Invoice Text in Journal Entry.-Keywords-Blue Invoice Text, Customer Invoice, Journal Entry

Title: Report missing in the Home work center in ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a report to the Home work center, but when you navigate to the reports list in this work center, the report is missing.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center and the view Reports - List.-Search for your report - it is not available here.-Cause-The reports in the Home work center allow users to see all the reports that they are assigned to see via other work center view assignments.-So for example, if you assign different reports to the work centers Sales Orders, Account Management and Marketing, and if users are assigned to these work centers as well, they will see all these reports in the Home reports list.-It would not be meaningful to assign a report to the Home work center itself, since every user has access  to this work center, so it does not provide much access restriction.-Resolution-Please assign the reports to other work centers / views (depending on the data in the report). Afterwards, if users are assigned to those work center views, theywill see the report in Home as well.-Keywords-report missing, home, reports list, overview, launchpad, business analytics, report assignment, assigned, not available

Title: Bill of Exchange Is Missing in Account Determination Group Configuration of Receivables or Cash Subledger
Content: Symptom-You add the Bill of Exchange feature to your solution profile, but the Bill of Exchange related account determination group is still missing for Receivables or Cash subledger.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration workcenter access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine-tune activity. -Under Account Determination select Receivables or Cash.-In the next screen the Bill of Exchange related account determination group configuration is missing.-Cause-To see the Bill of Exchange specific columns, the used account determination profile must be assigned also to a country which is supporting Bill of Exchange.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration workcenter access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine-tune activity. Under Account Determination select Receivables or Cash.-In the next screen select the Account Determination Profile, and press Assign Countries/Regions to Profile. -Select the desired country version, such as China.-Keywords-Bill of Exchange, BoE, 汇票，科目确定

Title: How to Create 3PL Inbound Delivery With Restricted Quantity Through B2B Message
Content: Symptom-Your warehouse provider want to send a B2B message to your Business ByDesign system through web service "Inbound Delivery Execution Confirmation", but not sure how to maintain the XML message to contain restricted quantity of inbound delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Access view Communication Arrangements.-Select the item whose communication scenario is "Third-Party Logistics Integration", open it directly.-In the screen "Communication Arrangement Overview: Third-Party Logistics Integration", in the block "Inbound Communication Services", select "Inbound Delivery Execution Confirmation", click Display Documentation.-In this documentation, we cannot find any information related to restricted quantity.-Resolution-You can refer to below XML
