Title: Customization of the Production Order Form Template with Easy Form Editor
Content: Symptom-User want to modify the Production Order Form with the Easy Form Editor but many standard fields are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter view-Under Business Flexibility view choose Form Template Maintenance-Search for Production Order Form Template.-Open using Easy Form Editor.-Under "Section" choose "tblOperation".-Drop down to select "Columns".-Maintain "Do not show" for any of the columns from list.-Click Save.-Choose Publish and Close.-Refresh the page and re-open the Production Form Template where user notice modification is nor reflected in Form Template.-Cause-It is a known limitation for Production Order Form Template.-Resolution-Production Order Form does not support modifications with the Easy Form Editor. Kindly customize Production Order Form only with the Adobe LiveCycle Designer(ALD).-Keywords-ALD, Production Order, EFE, easy Form Editor

Title: Unable to Print Document Using Cloud Print Manager Since Business User "XXX" Locked Business User Account.
Content: Symptom-You are using the Cloud Print Manager for the "Printing by Document Owner" Scenario and are logged in multiple times with different Business Users.-No user can print anymore (Indicator is Yellow in the Cloud Print manager).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Business User A logged in with his Business User.-Business User B logged in with his Business User.-Business User C logged in with his Business User.-Business User B locked his Business User account. Now all users cannot print anymore (Indicator switched from green to yellow in the Cloud Print manager).-Cause-Multiple Business User logons are not supported.-Resolution-We expect the same Installation Scenario as before with the Collaboration Windows. Means every Business User needs to have his independent Cloud Print Manager.-Keywords-Cloud Print Manager, printing by Document Owner, unable to print, can't, switched, green, shows, visible, see,

Title: Form of Balance Confirmation Does Not Work Properly with Extension Fields
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Form of balance confirmation does not show value of extension fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center > Balance Confirmation subview.-Open Balance Confirmation XXX (XXX stands for the balance confirmation ID).-Preview--Print.-Open the form, extension fields in the form shows empty.-Cause-If there are entries with duplicated document ID in one balance confirmatin, sytem cannnot distinguish among them, so stops binding the value of extension fields.-Another possible root cause is: If in balance confirmation, credit memo (reference to invoice) document is there,then system is unable to show-extension field value because internally credit memo id is replaced by original invoice id and while fetching data based on original invoice id extensibilty mapping fails-Go to Receivables work center > Balance Confirmation subview.-Open Balance Confirmation XXX (XXX stands for the balance confirmation ID)-You can see entries of same document ID or credit memo there.-Resolution-It is a know issue so far, and Jira backlog https://jira.sme.c.eu-de-2.cloud.sap/browse/REQBYD-1922 is generated for it.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation; Preview, Form; Extension Fields;

Title: How To Find The User Who Deleted A Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to search for a particular Sales Order in the system, but you are unable to find it and want to find the user who performed the Delete operation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order, XYZ (XYZrepresents the ID of the Sales Order).-The Sales Order cannot be found.-Cause-Sales Orders with the "In Preparation" status can be deleted.-Resolution-Once a document is completely deleted, it is not possible to identify the Business User who performed the action.-Keywords-Sales Order; missing; deleted; no records found; user; log; log file; database

Title: Goods and Service Receipts Sent for Approval
Content: Symptom-You created a goods and services receipt (GSR) for a purchase order however the system sent it for approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered view.-Select Show by Documents and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Select the button New Goods and Services Receipt.-Fill the mandatory details and select Post.-System sent the new GSR for approval.-Cause-If the over-delivery tolerance of the purchase order is exceeded by the goods and services receipt (GSR), the system creates a task to approve the goods and services receipt to the employee responsible of the cost center or project of each item.-For Example: You created a Purchase Order for 10 EA and two Goods and Services Receipts have been created for quantity 12 EA. As the purchase order quantity is exceeded, system sent GSR for approval.-Resolution-There is no activity/chance to maintain threshold values for extra delivered quantity via Business Configuration work center. As a workaround you can maintain Over/Under-Delivery Tolerances in the purchase order for each line item. You can enter a value as a percentage by which the delivered quantity can exceed the ordered quantity and still be accepted by the system. In such business cases, the system will not create approval tasks for Goods and Service Receipts.-Go to the Purchase Order work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Go to the Items tab and navigate to Basic Data sub-tab.-Under Settings field you will find Over/Under-Delivery Tolerance checkboxes.-Maintain tolerances in terms of Percentage before you Order.-See Also- 1947478 - Huge list of Persons Responsible Determined for an Approval Task

Title: Bankend Report for How to Compare the Cost Center Assignment of the Expense Arrangement With the Organizational Assignment in Employee's Personnel File
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are reviewing the cost center assignment in the employee's expense arrangement and comparing with the organizational assignment in the employee's personnel file.-You have checked the Expense Arrangement report and see that it does not have the Cost Center characteristic.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-For more details on the scenario, please refer to KBA 3204118 - How to Compare the Cost Center Assignment of the Expense Arrangement With the Organizational Assignment in Employee's Personnel File-Resolution-Apart from the PDI approach mentioned in the above KBA, it is possible to run an abap report to do the comparison, as follows:-Open system's backend.-Go to transaction SE38.-Run abap repot ERM_CHECK_EXPARR_DEV_COBLS -See parameters in below screenshot:-Run the report.-The output of this report can be exported to a .txt or Excel file.-The backend report was developed so that it checks all validity assignments and returns deviations regarding Coding Block / Cost Center assignment between Expense Arrangement and Personnel Administration, regardless of the time interval. Therefore, if there is no "Unlimited" entry shown, all currently valid cost assignments have the same cost center in the expense arrangement and personnel administration.-Keywords-Expense Arrangement. Personnel Administration. Expense Report. Cost Assignment. Cost Center.

Title: Error Message When Releasing Lease Contract: Defaults of Valuation View Missing in Fine Tuning of Asset Class
Content: Symptom-You want to release Lease Contract XYZ but an error message appears: "Defaults of Valuation view XX missing in fine tuning of asset class DEF." (XYZ represents the lease contract ID, XX represents a valuation view ID, DEF represents an ROU asset class)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Lease Contract Management work center go to the Lease Contract view.-Find lease contract XYZ and press Edit.-Press Actions and choose Release. -The error Defaults of Valuation view XX missing in fine tuning of asset class DEF" appears. -Cause-There are valuation views assigned to the used set of books which are not assigned to fixed asset class DEF.-Resolution-Maintain all valuation views assigned to all set of books used by the company.-Example: Lease contract XYZ is created for company AAA which uses set of books GHI.-To identify the valuation views:-Access the Set of Books Integrate and Extend activity in the Business Configuration work center.-Select set of books GHI and press Edit. -Go to the Fixed Asset Settings screen. -Here, you notice valuation view XX as well as YY (YY represents another valuation view ID). -Both valuation views, YY as well as XX must be assigned to asset class DEF.-To maintain the valuation view for the ROU Asset class:-Access the Lease Management Accounting fine tune task.-Choose the Edit ROU Asset Classes link. -Find ROU asset class DEF. In the Details section, in the Default Valuation Settings you notice valuation view YY. But valuation view XX is missing.-Press Add row and find valuation view XX. -Maintain all further, relevant details, according to your business needs. -Keywords-Defaults of Valuation view missing in fine tuning of asset class; release lease contract error

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Mass Data Run Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In this Knowledge Base Article, we will look at known issues regarding the Mass Data Run topic, and how we can troubleshoot Mass Data Run (MDR) issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the affected Mass Data Run view in the frontend.-Highlight the Run ID provided by the Partner.-Check the Application Log for this Run ID to identify what the error is.-Select the View Jobs button to check the status of scheduled jobs.-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-Permission to execute the Mass Data Run (if needed to view the behavior / issue).-Mass Data Run file path in SDK, and steps to the MDR view in the frontend.-Mass Data Run ID of the affected Run.-Known issues:-No rows of data appear for this MDR in the OWL:-An FSI reload is to be done by a Senior member of the PDI Support team for Business ByDesign system only - 2655378 - How To Use The Backend Transaction GFSSTM-Application log has blank rows:-Happens when MDRO has not processed any records.-Verify this in sesfts or in the SDK, by executing the query.-If sesfts is retrieving it then check FSI view, if that returns data problem solved otherwise an FSI reload is to be done by a Senior member of the PDI Support team.-Scheduling Issues:-In case of any issue with scheduling check the user has appropriate Work Centre View assigment to execute the relevant MDR - -If so, then forward to BC-ESI-ESF-MBS MDRI Framework to investigate further.-Go to MDRS and load the Business Object BACKGROUND_JOB_SCHEDULE to check the scheduling information for a particular MDRO.- Slow performance:-Check if parallel processing has been selected for the MDR in the SDK.-Parallel Processing is an option the Partner can choose to enable or not in the SDK (however, they cannot enable parallel processing if the instances in this BO are dependent on each other which would lead to locking issues).-Parallel Processing can shorten the processing time of a MDR. If Parallel Processing is selected, blocks of 50 BO instances are processed in parallel.-If one instance within this package of 50 instances fails, and no instances in that package will save.-If Parallel Processing is not selected, this is called Sequential Processing. There are no packages, BO instances run separately. If one BO instance fails to save, the run will continue and the other instances will run and save.-The number of processes being executed in parallel depends on the current system activities and cannot be influenced.-Right click on the Action ABSL script file for the MDR in the SDK, and check the Performance Tips. We can send these to the Partner.-Check the partners query for this MDR in this BO, and see if changes can be made to reduce result set, and enhance the performance.- Locking:-If Parallel Processing of the BO instances changes the same instance of another BO, locking problems can occur.- Timeout (Time Limit Exceeded):-A Mass Data Run will automatically run into an error state after 10 hours, this is the designed operation time.-When the Mass Data Run does not finish in this 10 hour time frame all the remaining sub-processes are "stuck" in the background. -If a Mass Data Run timeouts, its status "In Process" will not be updated as a separate job is responsible for updating the status which will not executed in this scenario.-The 10 hour limit is implemented to optimize the system performance and reduce the possibility of parallel tasks being ran, as Mass Data Runs cannot be run in parallel. - New button missing from MDR OWL:-If the new button to create a new MDR is disabled, the partner will need to update the metadata in the UI designer. - Dumps:- in case of memory leaks from Application log. In this case app log is empty but in the job log you can see it job has started and failed. Forward to AP-RC-APL.- Error messages:-Error during invocation of FPP service GET_MDRO_FPP; action failed MDRO executed with error(s).-first check duplicate schedules. If there are check if this was created by customer. In this case ask them to get cancel it. If done by SAP, forward to scheduling team.-Otherwise, if st22 dump has memory issue then forward to AP-RC-APL. -    2. Error Error during invocation of FPP service GET_MDRO_FPP; action failed  -- The above error occurs when a user(s) creates multiple jobs and schedules them to execute at the same time resulting in duplicate jobs.    In this case, one of the job execution acquires lock on the MDRO while the other fails to do so.-To resolve this, click on the “View Jobs” button after selecting an MDRO instance on the MDRO OWL and delete duplicate jobs. -    3. RFC Exception System failure error please refer the KBA - 2488600 - Error While Executing MDR : RFC Exception SYSTEM_FAILURE Raised No Roll Storage Space of Length Available for OCCURS Area .-See Also-2488600 - Error While Executing MDR : RFC Exception SYSTEM_FAILURE Raised No Roll Storage Space of Length Available for OCCURS Area-2577516 - Multiple MDR execution process - PDI-2583192 - Custom Mass Data Run Failing-2690152 - Custom MDR Execution for Parallel Processing OFF - PDI-3040948 - Custom Mass Data Run Execution Status Stuck as In Process-2589118 - No Records Displaying for Mass Data Run-2589514 - No Records Displaying For Custom Mass Data Run-1667999 - Health Check: Next start of t he job schedule will fail: XYZ-2655378 - How To Use The Backend Transaction GFSSTM-2571142 - How to Search for a Business Object in the Backend Transaction SESFTS-2655230 - How To Use The Backend Transaction VIEWBUILDER- 2950798 - Custom errors not appearing in MDR results log- 2657668 - Troubleshooting PDI FSI Related Issues- 2918666 - Mass Data Run deletion causes error - "The assigned custom business object does not exist"- 2911501 - Error While Execution of Custom Mass Data Run-Keywords-MDR, Mass Data Run, Custom MDR, dump, error, empty row, Timeout,Time Limit Exceeded-A Mass Data Run will automatically run into an error state after 10 hours this is the designed operation time,-when the Mass Data Run does not finish in this 10 hour time frame all the remaining sub processes are "stuck" in the background.-This is done to optimize the system performance and reduce the possibility of parallel tasks being ran, as Mass Data Runs cannot be run in parallel.

Title: Unable to Delete Employee From Project Task
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when trying to delete employee from project task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Project's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Select task ABC-N (N is the number of the task).-Navigate to Work subtab.-Select team member XYZ (XYZ is the team member).-Click in Delete button.-System crashes.-Cause-This scenario is a system limitation which can be corrected by following the workaround.-Resolution-There is a workaround for this scenario:-First option:-Add employee XYZ as Team Member under Team Members tab.-Then try to delete XYZ from Team Members. It will prompt for "If the team member has any assignment(s), it will also be deleted. Would you like to continue?", click Ok and then save the project. Ideally, it should also delete XYZ's name from the Work tab.-Second option (in case the first one does not work):-Add employee XYZ as team member under Team Members tab.-Go to the work tab of task ABC-N and delete the entry for employee XYZ.-Go to the Team Members tab again.-Delete XYZ's name.-Save the project.-Keywords-Dump; Employee; Project Task; Team Members; system crash

Title: Wrong Project Task IDs When Creating Project From Older One
Content: Symptom-The project's task IDs have wrong suffix.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Project's ID).-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Project Plan tab and Gantt Chart subtab.-See the project's task IDs: ABC-12, ABC-13, ABC-14 (and it goes on)...-You expected that the first task would be ABC-1 and not ABC-12.-Also: ABC-12 is an example; 12 could be any number that is not 1.-Cause-Project ABC was created based on an existing one. In this case, the system does in principle the following:-Create new project ID according to project type. This results in RDCx (x is the next free ID of all projects starting with RD).-Try to create new task ID based on original task (for example PQR-40-1 becomes RDx-1).-Check if this task ID is already used by any other task. If yes, determine highest existing ID and take the next free one.-When the project ID is then changed on the UI, only the prefixes of the tasks are adjusted, not the determined numbers behind the '-'.-In this case explained in the Symptom we have the following situation (for example):-There exist 2 projects of project type "research and development project" starting with RD: RD1 and RD2. Therefore, the system determines for a new project of type "research and development project" the project ID RD3. There exist the following project tasks: RD3-1 until RD3-11, belonging to project PQR-01234-5678-091011-50 (PQR-01234-5678-091011-50 is an older project).-Therefore, the system determines for the tasks of the new project RD3 the first number that is free, resulting in RD3-12. Changing then the project ID from RD3 to PQR-01234-5678-091011 leads to the project tasks PQR-01234-5678-091011-12, PQR-01234-5678-091011-13...-The reason why project PQR-01234-5678-091011-50 has the tasks RD3-1 until RD3-11, whose IDs don't fit to the project ID, is, that task IDs have a maximum length of 24. PQR-01234-5678-091011-50-1 would exceed this maximum, therefore the system kept the originally determined IDs RD3-1 until RD3-11.-Resolution-To overcome this situation for the creation of new projects in the future, the user has to create projects RD3 and RD4 in the system, and immediately set them to closed.-When copying then the next time, the system would propose project ID RD5, and task IDs RD5-1, ..., which are not yet in use. When changing the project ID (and by this change, also the task IDs), the user has to keep the maximum length of task IDs in mind.-Keywords- Project; Task ID; Suffix

Title: 'Referenced Service Order AAA not found' Error Message for Unposted Service Confirmation BBB
Content: Symptom-Service Confirmation BBB is unposted due to error message 'Referenced Service Order AAA not found'.-AAA means the Service Order ID.-BBB means the Service Confirmation ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select the show list Unposted Source Documents.-Find the Service Confirmation BBB.-Notice the error message: 'Referenced Service Order AAA not found'.-Cause-This is a known system issue.-The issue is due to a line item in Service Confirmation BBB.-This line item is an unplanned item linked to Service Order AAA. As service order is linked to contract, it is completely invoiced via attached contract.-The functionality has been delivered to enable the addition of unplanned items in service confirmation which are already present in contract but not in service order.-Resolution-To fix the issue, the following workaround should be done:-Cancel Service Confirmation BBB (if Service Confirmation BBB has already been invoiced, you must cancel the relevant invoice first).-Go back to the contract XXX (XXX means the Contract ID) and add the relevant item to the contract.-Create a new Service Confirmation CCC (CCC means the Service Confirmation ID), and add the item again.-Ensure that the contract reference is maintained for the item.-Release the Service Confirmation CCC (and invoice it, if necessary).-To avoid the occurrence of the issue in the future, the following steps should be taken care while creating/updating Service Confirmations:-When all the confirmation items have contract reference attached already and a new item is added: please check if the contract item reference is determined. If not, then create that item in contract first and then add it in the confirmation.-When service order is linked to contract and you create confirmation from it. There is no item in the confirmation and you add an item: please check if the service order item reference is determined. If not, then check if there is any item in service order which does not have a contract reference (unplanned item of service order). Alternatively you can check if a service order customer invoice request is present. If you can't find a service order invoice request or an unplanned item in service order - add the item in service order first and then only create confirmation.-Keywords-service confirmation; service order; unposted; reason for rejection; unplanned item; unposted source document

Title: Option Custom Payment Medium Format is Not Available in Outgoing Bank Transfers Activity
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find the option Custom Payment Medium Format in Outgoing Bank Transfers Activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find and open Outgoing Bank Transfers activity.-Option Custom Payment Medium Format is not available.-Cause-The option is only available when the Cloud Application Studio is opened at the same time using PDI user(means user who has access to Cloud application studio).-Resolution-To be able to see this option, follow the below steps.-Logon to the Cloud Application Studio using PDI User-Search for the relevant solution and double click it. Make sure this is activated.-And after that Login to UI and open the Business Configuration->overview and since you used PDI user, you will see error message 'Upgrade check failed, You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings.'-Hit close and then search for activity 'Outgoing bank transfers'. Now the 'Edit assignment of custom structure mappings to custom payment medium formats' hyperlink will be available-Keywords-PaymentToPaymentFileConversion, Custom Payment Medium Format, Import Payment Medium Formats-paymenttopaymentfileconversion,custom payment medium format,import payment medium formats

Title: Error in OData Metadata Query for Reports
Content: Symptom-When running an OData reporting metadata query, such as:-https://my<insert system URL>/sap/c4c/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/$metadata?-You receive an error message or the page does not finish loading.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-This query returns the metadata of every single report in your system. In most cases, this will lead to a memory issue, since there are too many reports with too many fields.-Resolution-If you require to see report metadata, please run the query for a specific report, for example:-https://my<insert system URL>/sap/c4c/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/$metadata?entityset=RPCODCUSTOMER_Q0001QueryResults-Alternatively, you can run the metadata query for a different work center (not Business Analytics) if there are no too many reports assigned to that work center. For example:-https://my<insert system URL>/sap/c4c/odata/cod_activities_analytics.svc/$metadata-See Also-To see the list of OData work center names, you can run the following query:-https://my<insert system URL>/sap/c4c/odata-Keywords-odata, report, time out, memory, meta data, no results, error message, business analytics, dump

Title: Error Message While Creating New Supplier Invoice Against the Delivery
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Supplier delivered the goods against the purchase order and you created a supplier delivery in inbound logistics work center. When creating new supplier invoice against the delivery, system throws the error message for the taxes.-Error message: Tax code Import Use Tax - Standard Rate not valid for country United States on tax date DD.MM.YYYY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select the query All Deliveries to be Invoiced.-Select the relevant Delivery ID and select New Invoice button.-Fill the mandatory details and check the consistency.-Cause-The validity of tax code maintained for the country say for example US in the business configuration work center is valid only until DD.MM.YYYY. Hence the messages between the business documents say Inbound Delivery and Supplier Invoicing were not processed successfully in the backend. The validity check does not allow a further usage in your business documents E. g. Purchase Order 402343.-Sender Party: InboundDeliveryProcessing.-Receiver Interface Name: SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoiceVerificationIn-Error: Tax code Import Use Tax - Standard Rate not valid for country United States on tax date 01.03.2012-Sender Interface Namespace: http://sap.com/xi/AP/LogisticsExecution/Global-Sender Interface Name: InboundDeliveryProcessingInvoiceVerificationOut--Note: In the table TEC_AP_TAXCODE check the valid dates for tax codes.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview View.-Select Activities in the drop-down-Select the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Select the link Define Tax Codes.-Select the relevant Tax Code for specific Country say for example 16 - Import Use Tax - Standard Rate for US.-Extend the Validity To Date of the Tax Code manually.-Select Save.-Note: After you maintain the validity for tax code, please restart the XI message.-Keywords-tax code not valid for country; supplier invoice; supplier delivery; inbound delivery

Title: Error: The action REJECT is not possible. Unable to perform Reject, follow up documents could not be updated, when rejecting a warehouse request using PDI
Content: Symptom-You have the requirement to reject a warehouse request using a script from your custom solution in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-When calling the standard action Reject() from BO SiteLogisticsRequest, you face the below errors:-The action REJECT is not possible.-Unable to perform Reject, follow up documents could not be updated.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-As a pre-requisite, you have:-created a customer specific or multi customer solution in the Studio;-created an ABSL script (which can be an Event BeforeSave) for the SiteLogisticsRequest BO or created a script on a different BO which tries to rejet a warehouse request-Cause-The Reject() action from SiteLogisticsRequest BO is used for 3PL Request cases and not for standard sell from stock scenarios.-If you want to roll back a warehouse request and follow-on documents where the tasks are in "not started" status, you should use the Cancel() action.-Resolution-Please use the Cancel() BO action instead to roll back a warehouse request. Using this action on root level will cancel the items as well.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, script, ABSL, SDK, cancel, document, action, is not possible, unable to perform reject, follow up documents could not be updated

Title: Action Not Permitted; Confirmations Already Exist for Confirmation Group
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Following error occurs when clicking on Confirm as Planned button.-"Error while executing action------> Action failed-----------> Execution of action not permitted----------------> Action not permitted; confirmations already exist for confirmation group".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for task XXX.-Select it.-Choose Confirm as Planned button, then the error occurs.-Cause-This issue arises when you change anything in production task level (apart from Qty), then status of production task changes from "Not Started" to "In Process", however there is no qty confirmed at production task level, due to production task status change confirmation group status also change from "Not Started" to "In Process", hence when trying to click "Confirmed as Planned" button, you are getting the above error.-Resolution-At this time, our development team still do not have a date for when it is expected to be resolved.-They can't commit to a time frame for when this is expected to be resolved, but it is still in the pipeline for future release.-Until this is done please use the following workaround:-1. "Confirmed as planned" will work only if Status of production task is "Not Started".-2. In this production task XXX, you need to enter qty manually at Production task level and do the confirmation.-Keywords-Confirm as Planned; Production Task.

Title: Process Communication Error in Sales Order Do Not Restart: "Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type Standard"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Process Communication Error in Sales Order: "Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type Standard", XI failed message do not restart.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Error was triggered because different Tax Rates were saved in the Sales Order. System does not allow to show the same Tax Rate Type with two different VAT Rates in one document.-Resolution-For this case, customer needs to correct it from their end. Once this is done you can follow the steps:-Login in Backend.-Access Transaction: SRT_MONI.-Find the XI Failed Message.-Click On Restart - if the Restart does not work, you are allowed to Reconcile the message.-Message will be delivered.-See Also- KBA: 2943501 - Error When Adding Items With Different Tax Rates for the Same Tax Rate Type: Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type-Keywords-Tax Rate, Tax Type, One Tax Rate, XI failed message, reconcile; Only one tax rate allowed for tax type TCS and rate type Standard;

Title: Master Form Template Is Not Assigned To Form Templates
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a Form Master Template (e.g. with your company's logo); and you also set it as default. When you open a Form Template (e.g.  'Customer invoice' ), however, you find that the content which is maintained in the Master Form Template (e.g.  the company's logo) is not displayed in the Form Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To create a default Master Form Template:-Go to the Work Center Application and User Management-Go to the View 'Business Flexibility'-Choose 'Master Template Maintenance'-Create a Form Master Template; and set the Master Form Template as default and assigned it to a company-Click 'Edit' to see how the template looks like (For example, if logo is being displayed)-To check the Form Template:-Go to the Work Center Application and User Management-Go to the View 'Business Flexibility'-Choose 'Form Template Maintenance' and select a 'Form Templates'-Choose 'Change Master Template Usage' in button 'Actions' to confirm that the Form Template uses the Master Form Template-You see the contents maintained in the Master Form Template do not display in the Form Template-Cause-Master Form Templates and Form Templates control different functions: The Master Form Template is used to define the header and footer of a document; and a Form Template, on the other hand, is used to define the specific fields and structure of the document. Hence, when you view a Form Template, you are not able to see the maintenance of the Master Form Templates.-When you preview a specific document, however, you will see the effects of Master Form Template maintenance, and the same from Form Templates as well.-Resolution-When you preview some specific documents, such as customer invoice, you see the maintenance in the Master Form Template such as logo, has been used in the document.-Furthermore,  if you want to display, such as your company's logo, in a Form Template, you need to press the button 'Action' in the view 'Form Templates', and uncheck the 'Use Form Master Template' box in 'Change Master Template Usage'. Then you can edit the Form Template manually.-Keywords-Master Form Template, Usage, Form Template Maintenance, Logo, Footer.

Title: What is Considered by the Paid Amount in the Japan Invoice Summary Document
Content: Symptom-You have generated an invoice summary for Japan, which has processed an invoice that got cleared by an overpayment. However, the invoice summary shows the Paid Amount being the cleared invoice amount instead of the received payment amount.-You expect the Paid Amount to show the exact amount paid by the customer, so that the company can identify over and under payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Invoice Summary Documents.-Find and open the related invoice summary.-Open it and select the line in the Balance Information section.-Refer to the Paid Amount field.-You have an invoice of e.g. 16.500 JPY for which a payment of 20.000 JPY is received. The invoice is fully cleared by this payment. In the mentioned invoice summary, you expect the Paid Amount to be 20.000 JPY, but the system shows 16.500 JPY.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. In SAP Business ByDesign, the payment amount in the Balance Information is considered as cleared invoice amount (uncleared amount is not included).-The invoice summary in SAP Business ByDesign shows only the cleared invoice amount. Uncleared/overpayments are not considered.-Resolution-This is the correct and expected system behavior. Below are the field definitions for the Japan Invoice Summary:-Paid amount = Payments for previous invoices + Payments for the current invoices (cleared invoice amounts, not considering overpayments).-Balance carry forward = Previous invoiced amount – paid amount.-Total amount = Gross amount + Balance carry forward.-The invoice summary feature may vary accoridng to business expectations, hence please consider the below observations:-Invoice Summary is a Japanese business practice and not defined by law.-Current ByD design is based on the customers' feedback but does not guarantee all business use cases since there are many different use cases by customers.-Iif current ByD behavior about Invoice Summary is not satisfactory, then raising an enhancement request by using Customer Influence site is recommended.-Keywords-Invoice Summary. Japan.

Title: Incorrect Navigation of Account in Sales Order Created via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order via Web Service, when you open the Sales Order and click on Ship-to the system opens the Bill-to Account instead.-Environment- SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Open the Sales Order and select the View All button. -Ship-to Account is DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Ship-to Account).-Bill-to Account is GHI (GHI represents the ID of the Bill-to Account).-2x click on the Ship-to Account.-The Bill-to Account (GHI) is opened instead of the expected (DEF).-Cause-In the payload the Product Recipient Party is considered as the Ship-to party, therefore, if <ProductRecipientParty><PartyID>GHI</PartyID> is maintained in the payload this is why it appears in the Ship-to field. The payload is behaving as expected.-Resolution-The correct Account for Ship-to (DEF) has to be maintained under <ProductRecipientParty><PartyID>.-Keywords-Ship-to, Bill-to, payload, sales order.

Title: Process Communication Error from SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn to CustomerRequirementProcessing: Unit of measure deviates between schedule lines
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -In an inconsistent Sales Order, you find the following Process Communication Errors between Sender Interface SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn to Receiver Interface CustomerRequirementProcessing:--"Unit of measure deviates between schedule lines"-"Quantity conversion for schedule line ABC of confirmation item DEF failed" (Where ABC represents the schedule line number and DEF represents the confirmation item number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to Backend transaction SRT_MONI.-Select tab Business Object Selection.-Enter business object: SALES_ORDER-Enter query: ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-Enter Element: ID-CONTENT-Input ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Execute the query-In the Message Monitor you see the following failed messages:-Sender:  SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn-Receiver: CustomerRequirementProcessing-Error: Unit of measure deviates between schedule lines-Error: Quantity conversion for schedule line ABC of confirmation item DEF failed-Restart is not effective on the XI messages.-Cause-This happens in a Sales Kit scenario in the Sales Order, when the Sales Kit present has no Kit item list. Because the kit item list is not present, the system is raising errors related to quantity conversions, and might also shows errors related to the system trying to do the conversion between two Units of Measure, but this cannot happen.-Resolution-In order to solve this, it is necessary to remove the incorrect Sales Kit from the Sales Order. After that, it can be added again as long as it is done properly in a way that the Item List is also present.-Keywords-Sales Order, Sales Kit, PCE, Inconsistent, XI Message, Stuck, Backend, SRT_MONI, SESFTS, Restart-

Title: Error Occurs when Posting Goods Receipt Based on Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-Following error occurs when posting goods receipt based on Inbound Delivery Notificaiton(IDN).-"Error during delivery update------> The action FINISH is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.------> The total number of serial numbers must be the same as the quantity for product XXX."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Search for IDN YYY.-Choose Post Goods Receipt.-Fulfill the fileds: Actual quantity, Target Logistics Area ID.-Choose Save and Close, then the error occurs.-Cause-The IDN YYY was created when the Serial Number Profile was <Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes> for product XXX.-However, the product profile is now <Optional Serial Number Assignment>.-Resolution-You have two options.-Fulfill the Serial Number for Product XXX during posting goods receipt based on the IDN YYY.-Cancel the IDN YYY and re-create a new one.-Keywords-Post Goods Receipt, Serial Number Profile, Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes, Optional Serial Number Assignment.

Title: Watermark Original is Shown in the Output Document PDF for Country Austria.
Content: Symptom-The Watermark "Original" is shown in the Output Document PDF for country Austria.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Open the respective Invoice.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Open the PDF Document.-You can see that in the lower right corner the Watermark "Original" is displayed.-Cause-With the release 2302 we fulfilled a legal requirement from the Austrian Authorities BMF (Bundesministerium fuer Finanzen).-Resolution-You can find the description of the legal requirement by opening the link:https://findok.bmf.gv.at/ and search for :11.1.5.11-See Also-Please see also Help Center Document What's New in Customer Relationship Management section Country/Region-Specific Changes -> Austria.-Keywords-watermark Original, Customer invoice watermark, Austria; Original; Output, PDF Ouput History; XML

Title: You are using a KPI 1:1 on a key figure and noticed that the result is wrong.
Content: Symptom-You are using a KPI 1:1 on a Key Figure and noticed that the result is wrong.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Preview the KPI in the view Design KPI in the work center Business Analytics.-Ensure that your Key Figure is part of the report view.-Click on Settings --> Characteristics.-Set up a Result Row for one of the Characteristics and click on OK.-Check the Result Row for your Key Figure and compare it with the KPI. Notice they are different.-Cause-You have not set the Aggregation in the Key Figure properties.-Resolution-Go to the work center Business Analytics --> Design Key Figures.-Search for your Key Figure and click on Edit.-Go to step 3.-In the option Aggregation Type, select a value (e.g. Total if you want to see a summary).-Choose a Characteristic of the context of the report.-Save this setting.-Keywords-aggregation, KPI, key figure, total, context, result

Title: Sales Order Remains In Process for Released Customer Return
Content: Symptom-You have released a Customer Return document using the option Without Credit Memo and you expect that the Sales Order to change its status to Complete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-You see that the document shows with status In Process.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Customer Return is Released.-Cause-The reason the Sales Order remains In Process is because the initial Customer Invoice document was canceled and this caused the item Invoicing Status to change from Finished to Not Started.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to complete the Sales Order, as the invoicing was canceled, you can cancel the Sales Order document.-See Also-2609702 - Cancellation of Inbound Delivery Does Not Cancel Customer Return-Keywords-Sales Order, Status, Complete, In Process, Customer Return, Return, Without Credit Memo

Title: Error Time Frame: Date DD.MM.YYYY is invalid
Content: Symptom-You are facing an error message when opening a Sales Order document and cannot find the cause.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Error: Time Frame: Date DD.MM.YYYY is invalid-Cause-The reason the error is happening is because the Sales Order was created as a copy from another document and the document contains historical data from the copied Sales Order.-When performing the Copy functionality, the system will copy the pricing and other details from the previous Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select Invoice Schedule subtab.-Click Edit Invoicing Time Frame button.-Under Invoicing Time Frames, there is an additional option which is in the past.-Select the additional option and click Remove.-Error disappears.-Click OK.-Click Save.-Keywords-Time Frame, is invalid, Sales Order, Error, Edit, Time, Invoice Schedule, Invoicing

Title: Customer Project Invoice Request Cannot be Deleted
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are trying to delete the Customer Project Invoice Request XYZ (XYZ represents the Customer Project Invoice Request ID), but you get the following errors:-The action NOTIFY_OF_CPIR_ASSGT_R is not possible because the object does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-SAMR_A1S_ESI_COMMON.003-The action PROPOSE_INVOICING_PARAM is not possible because the object does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-SAMR_A1S_ESI_COMMON.003-Delete is not possible because the object does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-SAMR_A1S_ESI_COMMON.007-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work centre.-Go to Project Invoice Requests view.-Show All Project Invoice Requests.-Find XYZ.-Press Delete.-The following errors might appear:-The action NOTIFY_OF_CPIR_ASSGT_R is not possible because the object does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-SAMR_A1S_ESI_COMMON.003-The action PROPOSE_INVOICING_PARAM is not possible because the object does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-SAMR_A1S_ESI_COMMON.003-Delete is not possible because the object does not exist. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.-SAMR_A1S_ESI_COMMON.007-Cause-The customer project invoice request has a reference to one ore more customer project expense lists that never got sent to accounting but got cancelled since the invoice request creation*. This creates an inconsistency so that the invoice request cannot be cancelled.-Resolution-The Customer Project Invoice Request needs to be deleted via the Debugger in the back-end.-Request permission from the Customer and send the incident to SRD-PRO-INV.-Keywords-delete not possible because the object does not exist; delete customer project invoice request

Title: How to check for ABSL involvement in Unexpected System Behavior
Content: Symptom-You are experiencing unexpected system behavior and want to determine if your ABSL scripting logic is having an impact. However, you do not want to entirely Disable or de-scope the PDI Solution, or impact other users in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer -Resolution-You can write a small piece of logic to skip over relevant ABSL scripting logic for a particular user:-Reproduce the unexpected behavior and use the Trace functionality in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Identify which ABSL scripts are being called (actions, events, validations, functions).-At the beginning of each script, write the following logic (or similar):-import AP.PC.IdentityManagement.Global;-var identity = Context.GetCurrentIdentityUUID();-var userId = Identity.Retrieve(identity).ID.content;-if (!userId.Contains("SAP_SUPP")){-//script body-} // end of script-NOTE: This can easily be also implemented in the Production Tenant using the Production Bug-Fix functionality.-See Also-Performance ABSL Trace – New functionality in 2005 Release.-Bug Fix in Production and Pre-production Tenants-Keywords-SDK, PDI, SAAB, Trace, correction patch, bug-fix, switch

Title: You are Unable to Cancel the Requested Quantity of Shopping Cart.
Content: Symptom-When you try to cancel the requested quantity of the shopping cart ABC, you can see that the Cancel option is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Choose sub-view Self Services Overview under Self Services view.-Choose Track My Shopping Cart under Shopping.-Select the shopping cart ID ABC-you can see that Cancel Requested Quantity is grayed/disabled.-Cause-Since follow-up document like Goods and Service Receipt, Supplier Invoice are already created,you cannot cancel shopping cart requested quantity.-Resolution-You can only cancel the shopping cart if the follow-up documents are canceled.-Keywords-cancel remaining quantity, cancel open quantity

Title: 40% of Tax Deductibility for Italy VAT Code
Content: Symptom-You are looking for an important VAT Code for Italy. It is related to the following law: (Articolo 19 bis 1 del Dpr 633/1972, al comma 1, lettera c), where you need do deduct 40% of the VAT, but you didn't find the option of 40% available to create a custom tax code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Tax on Goods and Services activity.-Select the option Define Tax Codes.-Add a new Tax Code using a 10 - Domestic Purchase Tax Event.-In Tax Type select: "VAT", Tax Rate Type: "Standard", in Tax Deductibility there is no option for 40%.-Cause-The 'Partially Deductibility' option in the dropdown list of 'Tax Deductibility' is configured to 40%. Just that '40%' is not explicitly mentioned in the description of the deductibility code.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The 'Partially Deductibility' is configurated to 40%, so you can use this option to create your own Z* tax code with 40% of tax deductibility for Italy VAT Code.-Keywords-Tax Deductibility; Italy VAT Code; 40%; 10 - Domestic Purchase Tax Event; Partially Deductibility; Articolo 19 bis 1 del Dpr 633/1972, al comma 1, lettera c; Tax;

Title: Error "Authorization Code Not Available" in the User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services View
Content: Symptom-You are configuring the integration between SAP Business ByDesign and Concur, however when checking in the User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services view, system shows the following error:-Authorization Code not available-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management WoC and User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services view.-Select the affected Service Provider. -Check the Access Permission Status column and you will see the mentioned error.-Cause-This scenario might be occurring due to the Concur Web Service the Server URL, where the URL is not valid.-Resolution-Please make sure that the Concur URL is correct according to your Concur system.-Examples of Concur URL:-https://eu2.api.concursolutions.com-https://us.api.concursolutions.com-Keywords-ByD, Concur, Integration, User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services, Authorization Code not available, Error.

Title: A technical error (Changing condition maintenance group not possible) occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 505
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom code solution which returns an error when initializing the business object PRC_SALES_PRICE_LIST with group code PLPRICE1.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the SDK (Software Development Kit).-Navigate to expected Add-on logic.-Access the UI (User Interface).-Navigate to Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Under the General tab, change any value.-The script is triggered in the debugger and the following errors thrown (PRC_SALES_PRICE_LIST, PriceSpecification.ROOT) A technical error (Changing condition maintenance group not possible) occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 505. Report an incident.-Cause-When an account data is loading up, by default the business object is being initialized with PLALL3 group code.-Hence, when the script is reinitializing group code in same session, the QueryByGroupCode cannot be called in the same session with different Group Codes.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 505, QueryByGroupCode, Business Object, PLPRICE1, PLALL3, SDK, Error, Changing condition maintenance group not possible, A technical error,Sales Price List Query, Query, Price List

Title: Workflow Rule Does Not Trigger Notifications When Purchase Order Approver Involved in Conditions
Content: Symptom-You activated a workflow rule for purchase order. In the conditions, you defined that the notification should be triggered when approver is ABC. However no notifications is triggered after releasing a purchase order which has approver ABC. (i.e.Here ABC is an Approver ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Application and User Management work center.-Go to Workflow Rules view.-There is a workflow rule for purchase orders, with condition Approver (or Approver ID) equal to ABC  -Create and release a purchase order, send to approver ABC for approval.-You expect a notification for the purchase order should be triggered by the workflow rule, however no notification is being triggered.-Cause-Purchase order approver ID / approver name is determined only when the order is approved.-Therefore if you create a new Purchase Order, save it and send it for approval, no workflow notification is being triggered.-Resolution-The system sends notifications according to the workflow rule conditions only if an approved purchase order is changed again.-Keywords-Workflow, Purchase Order Approval, Workflow Rule Condition, Notification Email Not Sent-workflow,purchase order approval,workflow rule condition,notification email not sent

Title: The New Button for Free Cost Objects Is Not Enabled
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new free cost object in your system, nevertheless the New button is not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center-Go to Free Cost Object view.-You see that the New button is disabled.-Cause-The Free Cost Objects functionality is not fully configured in your system yet. There exists preliminary steps to be performed in order to be able to create a new Free Cost Object instance via Cost and Revenue work center. The prerequisites are:--Include free cost objects in your implementation project scope: Via Business Configuration, open you project's scope and navigate to the 4-Questions step. Expand Financial and Management Accounting and Management Accounting. Click Cost Center Management Accounting and answer Yes to the relevant questions.-Define cost object types for free cost objects: Refer to the fine tune activity Cost Object Types.-Create account assignment types: This is performed via Account Assignment Types fine-tune activity.-Resolution-In order to create the required setup for free cost objects, the aforementioned fine-tune activities have to be completed. These activities can be found by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the relevant project and click Open Activity List.-In case you are already live, both these activities can be changed immediately, which means that you do not need a change project in order to deploy the changes. You need to:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Find the activity and click Change Immediately.-Once you create your custom cost object types (ID start with Z) and set up the account assignment type, you may create new free cost objects via Cost and Revenue.-Keywords-Free cost objects. acount assignment. disabled. cost and revenue.

Title: How to Control the Amount of the Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a Down Payment Request ABC (where ABC stands for Down Payment Request) for a Sales Order EFG (where EFG stands for Sales Order) multiple times and the amount has exceeded the Sales Order EFG.-You want to make control over the amount of the Down Payment Request ABC that can make it not exceed the amount of the Sales Order EFG.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center-Select Sales Orders EFG-Click the Creat Down Payment button-In the Amount field of Create Down Payment Request view, you maintain the value as XXX (where XXX stands for Amount greater than the Total amount of Sales Order EFG)-Click OK button-The Down Payment Request ABC is created.-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center, Invoice Requests View-Select the Down Payment Request ABC-Click Invoice button-Click Release button-The Customer Invoice GHI (where DEF stands for Customer Invoice) is created.-No error messages occurrs during the process for creating the Down Payment Request of which the amount is greater than the Sales Order.-Cause-You can't control the amount of the Down Payment Request.-There is no limit on the amount of advance payment. The excess amount can be used for the liquidation of the next transaction.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Down Payment Request, Sales Order, Amount

Title: Preview of a Sales Order or Sales Quotes is Picking Wrong Form Template
Content: Symptom-When you preview a Sales Order or a Sales Quote, system picks a wrong Form Template instead of what is assigned in the Form Template Selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of a Sales Order:-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select Sales Order view.-Preview a Sales Order.-Wrong Template is picked.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Form Template Selection view.-Where the Form Template is assigned in a particular sequence.-  Cause-The Form Template selection is done based on Sales Organization and not on Sales Unit. In case, if you assigned the Sales Unit instead of Sales Organization in the Form Template Selection then it will result in this issue.-You maintained a different Form Template in the Account Master Data.-Edit any Account and click View all. Navigate to the communication tab sub tab collaborations. Here you can maintain a template of your desire for the respective document and it will overrule the form template rules.-Resolution-You need to maintain the Form Template Selection rule based on the Sales Organization.-See Also-3015430 - Wrong Form template is Picked-Keywords-Form Template; Quote; Sales Order; Rule; wrong template; form template

Title: The G/L Account Description is Missing for Some Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers While Working in Other Language.
Content: Symptom-You are facing an issue where the G/L Account description is missing for some intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers while working in another language.-In this case, we will use the English and German languages as an example, the same can be applied to other languages too.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Search for the IC Journal Entry Voucher ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the IC Journal Entry Voucher ID).-In Details: Line Items of the IC Journal Entry Voucher ID XYZ you will see that G/L Account description is missing for some intercompany Journal Entry Voucher while working in German language.-Cause-The G/L account in the Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers is actually not the G/L Account, it's the G/L account alias (Account Determination Group).-The reason for the issue is that for certain accounts the translation is not maintained correctly.-Resolution- To check and maintain the translation correctly for these accounts you need to follow the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration WoC.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-In Account Determination section, click in Costs and select the General Expenses tab.-Click Translate > set source language to English and target language to Deutsch (German) > expand the node G/L Account Determination Group.-Search for the affected accounts and expand them. -You will see that Target Language is not maintained in German Language. -You have to maintain the Target Language in German Language, then you will be able to see the G/L account in the German language in the Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers.-Keywords-G/L Account; Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers; IC Journal Entry Voucher ID; Language

Title: How to Enable Scale Function in Discount List
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to enable the scale in discount Lists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to Pricing view and select Discount Lists sub view.-Select Overall Customer Discount from the dropdown.-Edit the discount list and navigate to Items tab.-There is no option to add Scales.-Cause-BC scope question 'Do you use scales with product discounts?' is not yet enabled in the system.-Resolution-You need to make the scope question 'Do you use scales with product discounts?' as selected.-Go to the Business Configuration - Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step: 4 Question,  go through General Business Data ->Product and Service Pricing -> Sales Price and Discount Lists folder, and you will see the question: Do you use scales with product discounts?-Select it and finsh the modification.-Afterwards, the scale will be enabled in product based discount lists, i.e. Customer Specific Discount Products.-Keywords-discount list; scale.

Title: A Technical Error (No Business Configuration for Property Valuations) Occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error message when trying to create a Discount List, Price List, Freight List or Surcharge List in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the example of creating a Discount List:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Discount Lists (Gross) view.-Search for Customer Group/Product Category Discount (Gross) in the dropdown.-Click New.-Enter the expected information.-Click Save.-Error:  A technical error (No business configuration for property valuations) occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003. Report an incident.-Cause-Whenever there is a creation of a Price/Discount list with any custom table, the item level table must contain the "List Identifier" technical field.  This is for the system to connect both levels.-Example:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementations Projects view.-Click the Open Activity List.-Search for the Configure Price Strategy activity.-Open Pricing Group Assignments.-Select the Group Name: Discounts.-Under the Pricing Group Item Assignments, you see the Discount List ABC (ABC represents the name of the Discount List).-Discount list ABC is made by a Custom Header Pricing Table CUS123 with a standard Item Pricing Table. (CUS123 represents the ID of the custom table).-Click Close.-Open Pricing Tables.-Search for the tables used.-As the item table is standard, it will not contain the List Identifier field.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-If you are creating the pricing table for price list or discount list, then you must select List Identifier as the first row under the Fields table, followed by the extension field.-If you are creating the pricing table for surcharge or freight, then the first row must be the extension field and the List Identifier should not be added.-To correct this for discount or price lists, please create a custom Item level table, add List Identifier as the first field and proceed by adding the other expected fields, being standard or custom.-Once this is completed, you can create a new Pricing/Discount list combining the custom header table with the custom item table.-To correct this for surcharge or freight list, please create a custom Item level table, add extension field as the first field and proceed by adding the other expected fields, being standard or custom.-Once this is completed, you can create a new Surcharge or Freight list combining the custom header table with the custom item table.-See Also-SAP ByDesign Price Determination using Extension Fields-3003415 - Following Error Occurs When Saving a Custom Pricing Table: Please Enter Field List Identifier as the First Item in the Key Field-3099502 - How To Create a Custom Price List With Extension Fields-Keywords-PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT, Discount List, Price List, List Identifier, Custom, Table

Title: How To save XML Data send to the Form Template at Runtime
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document helps in getting the XML data that is send to the form template at runtime whenever we preview a document in any work center.-Resolution-1. Login to the backend and go to the transaction SE24 and enter the class name CL_FC_FP_HANDLER and click the button Display.-2. Open the method ADS_RENDER and set the external breakpoint at the section before function FPRT_CREATE_DOCUMENT is called(Try Statement).-  3. Login to the frontend and get any document in the UI and click the button Preview.-  4. The debugger stops at the breakpoint and we need to double click on the variable IV_XML_DATA.-5. Go to the DetailDisplay tab and click on the button  on the right side.-  6. On the pop up window, select Save to Local File and choose Binary in the next pop up.-  7. Save the file with extention as .xml to your system.-8. You can open this file in XML editor or use it in Adobe Livecycle Designer.-Note: You need to login with the same user in both frontend and backend, for the external breakpoint to work.-

Title: Broadcast is not sent: No report data available to display
Content: Symptom-You have created a broadcast, but when you start it, the recipients do not receive an e-mail and you can see the following message in the broadcast logs:-"No report data available to display; check the selection"-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Cause-The report view and selection that you have chosen for the broadcast do not result in any data in the respective report.-Resolution-When a report has no results, the broadcast is not sent out since it would only contain an empty e-mail. This is the expected behavior.-If you would like to suggest a change to the standard behavior, you can make use of the Influence portal. Depending on the feedback of other customers, technical feasibility and priority of the change, our product management may take up the request for a future release.-Keywords-broadcast, not sent, missing email, no report data, no data empty report

Title: Delivery Block for Credit Limit Removed in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have entered a credit limit in an account in the Financial tab and also entered the delivery block Credit Limit in the Sales Data tab.-As soon as you add an item to the sales order the delivery block is removed. You expect that the delivery block is not removed since you have set the delivery block in the Sales Data tab of the account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have entered a credit limit in an account in the Financial tab and also entered a delivery block in the Sales Data tab.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Go to the Financial Data tab-The amount XXX is entered in the field Credit Limit (XXX represents the amount in your respective currency).-Go to the Sales Data tab-In the field Delivery Block the option Credit Limit is selected.-You expect that in a sales order the amount XXX is not taken in to consideration since the Credit Limit is set in the Sales Data tab.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from the Common Tasks.-Enter account ABC.-The following warning message appears: Document blocked for delivery-In the field Delivery Block the option Credit limit is entered automatically by the system in the General tab.-Go to the Items tab.-Add Product XYZ (XYZ represents the product ID).-The warning message Document blocked for delivery disappears.-In the General tab the system removed the option Credit limit in the field Delivery Block.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-The Credit Limit is set as a delivery block when the account is added since the credit limit check is not triggered before any item is added. Once an item is added, the credit limit check is triggered as per your settings in the fine-tune activity Credit Limit Check in your Business Configuration. The check applies not only according to the amount XXX entered in the Financial Data tab but also if the option Credit Limit has been set in the Sales Data tab. Therefore, if the credit limit amount XXX is not reached, as per amount entered as a credit limit in your account master data, the credit status changes from 'Not Relevant' to 'Limit not Exceeded' and the delivery block is removed.-Therefore, if as per the amount maintained in account Financial Data tab, the limit is not yet exceeded, the delivery cannot be blocked due to the credit limit.-Resolution-If you would like to set a delivery block which is not cross checked with the amount maintained in account Financial Data tab you would need to either use a different option such as Customer Request or alternatively create a customer specific Delivery Block.-This can be done as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the activity Account.-Click on the Maintain Delivery Block Reasons hyperlink.-Click on the Add Row button.-Create a new Delivery Block Reason e.g. Z01 General Credit limit.-Click Save and Close.-You can select this option now in your account master data in the Sales Data tab in the field Delivery Block.

Title: Analytical Object was deleted in your system
Content: Symptom-You created an analytical object in your system (for example: report; data source; selection; view; dashboard; KPI; key figure) but now it is not available anymore.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-There are several reasons why an object got deleted. The most common one is that a key or business user deleted it.-The system does not have any concept of maintaining change history for these objects, so we cannot revert the object to a previous stage.-Resolution-There are no change logs or any other information available related to the deletion of the analytical object. Keeping these data logs increases performance issues in the system, due to too much data and this is why change logs are not kept.-Unfortunately, we cannot confirm who deleted the object.-Our suggestion is to rebuild the content which has been lost or changed.-See Also-If the analytical object is a cloud data source, please take a look at the following Knowledge Base Article:--2539996 - Error in Cloud Data Source - Restriction on Number of Fields-Keywords-Cloud Data source, Report, Dashboard, KPIs Object deleted-analytics,data source deleted,report field deleted

Title: Missing Register With Service Provider Button
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of integrating with a service provider for customer payments by credit card. You have gone through the needed scoping changes, set up the communication arrangement, Clearing House, Clearing House Account  and maintained proper supplier details for your service provider, however, despite of that, the Register With <Service Provider Name> button is not available in the account's master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Select a customer account and click Edit -> Financial Data.-Go to the Bank Data sub-tab.-In the Credit Cards section, you are missing the  Register With <Service Provider Name> button, therefore you cannot generate a token and add the credit card in the system.-Cause-You are not able to generate a token with your service provider because the clearing house account usage has been set as external only. The external usage means that transactions can only be created through Point of Sales (PoS), externally to the system from a PoS machine.-Resolution-For creating credit card transactions within Business ByDesign, you have to change the usage of your clearing house account to either Internal or Internal & External.-In order to assign the correct usage to your clearing house account, you have to close the current account, since the field is no editable, and create a new one with proper setup. You can manage you clearing house account by the following steps:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Clearing House Accounts view.-Find your clearing house account and close it.-Create a new clearing house account and set usage to either Internal or Internal & External.-After that, the Register with <Service Provider> button becomes visible on the customer's master data.-Note that, once you close a clearing house account, you cannot create a new with the same Merchant ID. You have to request a new Merchant in order to identify your company.-See Also-1977717 - Unable to Register Credit Card With Service Provider-Keywords-Payment Service Provider. Register With. Credit Card. Tokenize.

Title: Created by Field in the Sales Order OWL does not Display any Value
Content: Symptom-For some sales orders the field Created by is empty in the sales order OWL (Object Work List).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Sales Orders Work Center View.-You notice that in the OWL (Object Work List) for some Sales Orders the Created by field does not display any user.-Cause-The respective sales orders were created by a technical user e.g. via an interface from a third party system. Due to technical and performance related reasons it is not possible to display technical users in the Created by field in the sales orders OWL.-Resolution-This is a system limitation.-See Also-3048255 - Individual Customers Created By Field has No Data.-Keywords-Created By; Created; By; Technical User; Sales Order; Sales; Order; C4C; BYD;
