Title: Error When Trying to Replicate Employee Between ByD and Concur
Content: Symptom-You are trying to replicate Employee from Concur to ByD, however you receive the following error:-Employee XYZ not replicated-Employee with Emp ID 'XYZ' and Login ID 'ABC' could not be updated because the Login ID was specified as 'ABC'. If you want to change the-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Employee Outbound Runs view.-Select the SAP_COMMON.-Click in the Link of the Application Log ID.-Go to the Results tab.-Expand All.-Sort Descending for the column Status.-Cause-Problems like this might occur because the employee's workplace email address is the key for the employee (= user) on Concur side.-So, if an employee has a certain workplace email address there must not be another employee with the same workplace email address - even if it is inactive.-Resolution-To solve this error the user's email address (= LoginID) of the inactive user has to be changed on Concur side to enable the creation of the new employee with this email address (= loginID).-Note: Please keep in mind that in general employee data must not been changed on Concur side, because this might cause inconsistencies!-Keywords-Employee Replication, Concur, Master Data Replication, Employee XYZ not replicated, Employee with Emp ID, Login, could not be updated because the Login ID was specified as, If you want to change the.

Title: Error on Customer Invoice - Fund Accounting is active. Please select a Fund for Sub ledger Sales
Content: Symptom-Error shows on Source Document view for unposted Customer Invoice in Public Sector scenario.-Fund Accounting is active. Please select a Fund for Sub ledger Sales-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Select relevant Customer Invoice.-Error: Fund Accounting is active. Please select a Fund for Sub ledger Sales-Cause-This error occurs due to missing account assignment type in Manual Invoice Request that generated this Customer Invoice.-Resolution-This information needs to be maintained when creating the Manual Invoice Request:-Go to the Items tab.-Select each Item at a time.-Go to the Revenue Assignment sub-tab.-Select Account Assignment Type.-The field for G/L Account and Fund will open and this needs to be added.-After this is maintained and the Customer Invoice generated this error will not occur.-Keywords-Public Sector, Customer Invoice, Fund, Fund for Sub ledger Sales-customer invoice,fund,public sector,fund for sub ledger sales

Title: Opening and Closing Balances for Trial Balance Not Zero When Exporting to MS Excel
Content: Symptom-You call the Trial Balance report spanning over 2 Fiscal Years. All Debit/Credit entries tally in summation as expected.-Aggregating all accounts Opening Balance and Ending Balance result in 0,00 LC (Local Currency) in  the Application UI. -A summation of all Opening Balances and Ending Balances however - results in negative or positive aggregated values deviating from the 0,00 LC Result as shown in the Trial Balance Report when viewing the report in MS Excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Navigate to Reports view and List.-Choose Trial Balance report or the technical Report ID FINGLAU01_Q0001.-Define suitable Company and Set of Books settings.-For Accounting Period/Year, choose a range spanning over 2 Fiscal Years (e.g. [July.2015 .. July.2016 ]).-Use the Download function and Report in Microsoft Excel® in XML Format.-Cause-The Trial Balance shows the Opening Balance Result as aggregation of all Debit/Credit-Transactions for all accounts of the first contained accounting period.-Accordingly - the Closing Balance Result represents the aggregation of all Debit/Credit-Transactions for all accounts of the last accounting period contained in the report.-Following the Trial Balance logic that Debit/Credit-Transactions have to tally for a chosen time-frame, Opening Balance and Closing Balance will show as 0,00 LC in the application.-This can be best illustrated by pulling the attribute Accounting Period/Year in first position in the report's columns before exporting to MS Excel.-In case it has not been conducted, the Balance Carryforward is simulated for the previous Fiscal Year 2015 in the Trial Balance Report. Hence these differences usually show for Profit & Loss Accounts and Annual Net Income/Net Loss.-This deviates from a conventional summation of all Opening- and Closing Balances for the selected range in MS-Excel applying default report-settings.-Resolution- System behaves as per design.-Keywords-trial balance; opening balance; closing balance

Title: Support for MS Excel Customised Workbooks
Content: Symptom-You have created a workbook based on a standard report or data source and customized specific fields using Excel Formulas or Macros.-You noticed that while the data related to the standard report seems to be correct the data related to the Excel Formulas or Macros is not.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Customized fields determined by Excel formulas or Macros are not supported in SAP Business by Design or SAP Cloud for Customer-In order to verify the correctness of the Excel workbook is recommended to compare the report content with a standard report or data source.-Keywords-MS Excel; workbook; custom workbook; excel formulas; formulas; incorrect data-####,excel###

Title: How to Check Deleted and Delimited Org Units in the Planning Area Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Use Only-When trying to check a certain org unit, you notice that the unit appears in the active area of the Org Structure, however does not appear in the planning area.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Enter the Org Structure view.-Search the org unit desired.-Now click on the Edit button to enter the planning area.-When searching the same org unit, it does not appear anywhere.-Cause-A common cause for this issue is that the org unit has been delimited or deleted in the planning area. However since the changes were not activated, the org unit still appears in the active area.-Resolution-To check the information maintained for the org unit in the backend follow the below steps:-Open the backend and enter transaction SESFTS.-Enter BO name as "/MOM/ORG_CENTRE".-Click on the arrow pointing down near the folder icon.-Go to Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ID.-In the ID field, enter the ID of the org unit and click on Execute.-After the BO is opened, click on the Navigate button.-Select navigation node STAGING_AREA.-Here there are two options:-The org unit will appear, displaying the data of the unit in the planning area. This will show the new validity of the unit, so it can be found in the planning area UI.-No data will be displayed in the node. This means that the unit was likely removed in the planning area.-See Also-1922036 - How to Revert an Org Unit Deletion in the Planning Area of an Organizational Structure-1938173 - Migrated Org Units are Missing in the Planning Area of Organizational Structure-1654052 - Saved Org Structure is Missing in Organizational Management Work Center -Keywords-rollback, staging area, cost center, profit center, reporting line unit

Title: BCO Returns Only Codes in UI Field Instead of Description
Content: Symptom-You observe that a field created whose data type comes from a Business Configuration Code List in SAP Cloud Applications Studio displays the value as Code instead of Description.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the tenant.-Navigate to the screen where the field is configured.-You will see the values are displaying as codes as shown in the below screenshot.-Cause-While defining the BCO, you have used the Field type as Attribute instead of Description.-Resolution-You should choose the Field Type as Description if you want the description text to display in the UI.-Note: After the solution is assembled, a field type change is not allowed, due to maintenance mode.-Keywords-Description, codelists, missing, value, appears, drop, down, values, shows, code, only

Title: System Crashes While Simulating Expense Report
Content: Symptom-System crashes while clicking Simulate button for an expense report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Find Expense Report ID AAA (AAA means the Expense Report ID) and click Edit.-Click Simulate.-Here you expect the system to simulate the journal entry for expense report AAA, however, system crashes instead.-Cause-The expense report AAA has been released for payment (status changed to 4-Released for Reimbursement) before, and then edited again.-In such case the expense report should not be simulated, it should be posted directly.-Resolution-The solution here is to post the expense report directly. Simulation works only when the expense report is not posted (payout is not completed).-Keywords- expense report; simulate; dump; crash

Title: How To Check if a KUT Field is Used in any PDI Solution (RP_PDI_SEARCH)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You try to delete a KUT Field but nothing happens or you receive the following error:- "Field deletion not possible; field is used in customer-specific solutions."-There are also multiple Solutions on the Tenant and you cannot find where the KUT Field is used.-Note: you can also use these steps to find out if any PDI is used in a certain BO, for example.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Resolution-As it is a KUT Field, you cannot use "Where-Used" functionality. The easiest way to find where the KUT Field is referenced is to use the back end function RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL. This function searches all files in all Solutions for the ESR Name of the KUT Field.-Firstly, you need the ESR Name:-Open the back end of the Customer Tenant.-Open Transaction /N/EXT/FIELD (Extensibility: Field Viewer).-Search for the relevant KUT Field with using the UI Label (Field Label).-See the ESR Name under Definition:-Now you can use this ESR Name in the Function RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL:-Open Transaction SE38 (ABAP Editor).-Select Program: RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL.-Click Execute (F8).-Paste the ESR Name into the SEARCH.-Optional: Enable "Search in Enabled PDI solutions only".-Click Execute (F8).-Inform the Partner / Customer of the returned files where the KUT Field is used.-Note: This function will return positive results for any string that contains the ESR name (for example, abcde will be a positive result for search term bcd). Please double check the files returned in the SDK to confirm if the KUT Field is used and active.-Keywords-Adaptation, Mode, RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL, Extension, Key User, Tools, ESR Name, /N/EXT/FIELD, SE38, Extensibility, Label, PDI, rp, search, all, RP_PDI_SEARCH,, SDK, how to find all PDI

Title: Financial Data Source Cannot be Extracted in BW
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message as "Errors in source system", while trying to extract data source in BW.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A financial data source was extracted in SAP Business ByDesign but cannot be extracted in BW.-You get the error:-Error in the Source System or -Extract Data (Warning: Not Simulated) Error while accessing data-Cause-There are mandatory parameters (variables) of the data sources to ensure in complex cases that correct data is fetched from a business point of view. This means for example that when accounting period 001 is given, it would need a correct fiscal period of the set of books. Without a selection on these fields, 001 could be January or April or any other month.-Resolution-Add additional selection on the Fiscal Year Variant that corresponds to the chosen Set of Books to ensure the correct extraction for the selected fiscal years and periods.-Additionally, it may be required to add more selections on other fields (for example G/L Account etc) to ensure that the data volume is restricted sufficiently.-Keywords-fiscal year variant, BW, ODP, financial, FIN, fin data source, standard data source, error in source system

Title: Cannot Order Purchase Order Document due to Exchange Rate Errors
Content: Symptom-You are unable to order the purchase order document due to exchange rate error.-Error for example:-Exchange Rate for EUR and USD for Rate Type does not exist for DD.MM.YYYY-Error during currency conversion from US Dollar into Euro for at DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant purchase order-Select Edit and click on Check button-Error appears-Cause-System asked you to maintain the exchange rate because the purchase order is assigned to the Source of supply as Purchasing Contract. In the contract, the target value and released value is maintained in the currency USD. Hence the exchange rate error occurs and it is necessary to maintain the exchange rate between EUR and USD. Please note that, the resolution is common for other currencies as well.-Resolution-You need to maintain the exchange rates from the below steps;-Go to General Ledger work center -Go to Common Tasks and select Edit Exchange Rates-Add exchange rates between EUR to USD currency valid from date DD.MM.YYYY-Select Save and Close

Content: Symptom-Error during Preview of Shipments with login Language as Deutche.-XML-Transformation fehlgeschlagen (CONTENT Feld überschreitet maximale Zeichenbegrenzung)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login into system in language Deutche.-1. Go to Warenausgang workcenter and Sendungen view.-2. Find document ID XXX and Preview( where XXX is the Freight List ID)-You will encounter above error.-Cause-During Preview of Shipments with login Language as Duetsche error displayed as CONTENT field exceeds maximum character limit because in Duetsche language Package Type Description is maintained as a text that exceeds Char 40 hence the error.-Resolution-Field length of package type description is Char 40.-Therefore maintain the package type description in Duetsche within 40 character length.-Keywords-Shipments, Freight List, package type, Duetsche , CONTENT

Title: How to Configure Supplier Invoice Number Range in Sequence
Content: Symptom-You are experiencing that numbering sequence of created Supplier Invoices is not sequential & you would like to configure the format of newly created Supplier Invoices in sequence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-In the Show dropdown, select All Documents.-In the list, the Document IDs are not in sequence.-Cause-The cause for the gaps in the Supplier Invoice Document numbers is due to the missing Document Numbering Formats in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and press Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-Tune phase, then select the activity Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-In the Document Numbering Formats for All Countries no values are defined.-Press the button Insert Row.-Enter the Company ID, Select the Document Type as Supplier Invoice & select Prefix Value as per your choice.-Save the changes.-Once you defined the Numbering Format, the sequence of newly created Supplier Invoices will always be sequential (no gaps).- Also-Supplier invoice Number range object works on Company and Document type combination.-If Customer has maintained same company and document type combination multiple times expecting it to pick different prefix values which-will not work, however, it will pick up the first company and document type that matches and generate a number for that.-It is a rule engine and system will use company ID and document type to pick the prefix, number range object etc.-Keywords- Supplier Invoices, Numbering Sequence, Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing

Title: "Actual Dates" field is missing in Project.
Content: Symptom-"Actual Dates" field & information are not present in Project ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work Center Project Management-Select the Project view-Open the project ABC-Go to Project Plan > Gantt Chart > Scheduling sub-tab-From here we can see the field "Actual Dates" and related information are not displayed.-Cause-Time Recording is not scoped for Project in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to Work Center Business Configuration-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select your Implementation Project and click "Edit Project Scope"-Go to the Scoping phase-Select Project Management > Project Planning and Execution > and scope Time Recording Field & Save.-Keywords-Actual Dates, Project, Scheduling, Implementation Project

Title: System Allows to Fraction Quantity for Trading Unit in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order with an item that uses a trading unit as its Unit of Measure, such as Pack and you are able to add decimal quantities for the quantity without facing any error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click New Sales Orders.-Enter the needed header level data.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add material ABC (ABC represents the ID of the material with quantity conversion between Pack and Each).-Change the quantity to e.g. 1.2 Pack.-No error is displayed by the system.-Cause-The reason the system is allowing decimals to the quantity and not returning any error, is because under Trading Units of the Quantities and Units of Measure activity, the number of decimals for Display Decimals is greater than 0.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To solve this, please perform the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project from the list.-Click the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine –Tune tab.-Show All Activities and click the Go button.-Select the Quantities and Units of Measure activity.-Click the Open button.-Select the Create and Maintain Trading Units hyperlink.-Select the Line for Pack-Display decimals has been maintained for 3.-Change the decimals to 0.-Now an error will be displayed when someone makes the attempt of adding decimals for the selected trading unit, such as pack.-See Also-3150741 -  Minimum Order Quantity not applied in OTC Sales-1913136 - Error message in Sales Order :Quantity 0,5 ea has too many decimals; only 0 decimal(s) permitted-1881012 - Error Message when Saving Sales Document: Item X: Quantity 0,00 ea has too many decimals; only 0 decimal(s) allowed-Keywords-MOQ, Minimum Order Quantity, Fraction, Quantity, Sales Orders, Error, Decimals, `Unit of Measure, Trading Units, Quantities and Units of Measure, Activity, Item, Rounding, Selection

Title: You Are Unable to Close a Bank Account as Balance Is Not Zero
Content: Symptom-You are not able to close a bank account, even though the closing balance of your last bank statement indicates a zero amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Banks view.-Select the concerned entry and click Edit -> Bank Account.-Select the bank account that you want to close and click Actions -> Close.-As error is raised informing that the balance is not zero, as follows: 'Balance not zero; account cannot be closed'.-Cause-There is still an amount as balance in the bank account.-Resolution-The bank account balance is not a simple matter of Confirmed payments. The system, in fact, uses the confirmed bank account balance and the planned liquidity at a specified due date to calculate the relevant bank account balance. This means that even an outgoing bank transfer yet to be transferred is captured when system calculates the bank account balance.-In order to easily track your bank account payments, you can view your cash position via "Cash Position - Transaction Details" report, under Liquidity Management or Business Analytics work center.-The Closing Cash Balance must be made zero and all the open payments must be either Canceled or Confirmed so that the account balance becomes Zero and hence allowable to be closed. The payment transactions recorded within the system shall, of course, be supported by real life transactions.-See Also-2568054 - How to Create a New Bank Account Upon a Company Merge-Keywords-Bank Account Balance, Bank Currency, Closing Balance, Bank Statement

Title: Is it Possible to Change/Edit Posting Control Profile Assigned to Custom Accounting Principle?
Content: Symptom-You have assigned the Posting Control Profile to Accounting Principle in Localization Toolkit and you are unable to change the Posting Control Profile for Custom Accounting Principle in Fine-Tune Activity Generally Accepted Accounting Principles in Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Choose the relevant Project and Go to Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune Activities.-Show All Activities and Find Activity Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.-Click Generally Accepted Accounting Principles hyperlink.-You could see that the Custom Accounting Principle is assigned to Posting Control Profile and you are unable to edit it.-Resolution-Ideally, it is recommended that the Partner creates an Accounting Principle and leaves the rest of the Fine-Tune Activity to user to maintain the configurations in the system.-In such cases where the Solution is deployed with Accounting Principle being assigned to Posting Control Profile in a Productive Tenant, the following is recommended:-The responsible person for the PDI Solution would need to create a Patch Solution in order to remove this table entry as the table entry was added via the PDI Solution. There are now three things which Partner can try out:-Check the checkbox which allows them to remove the table entries from the Fine Tuning Activity => then it should be possible to remove the rows from the Fine-Tune Activity in the UI.-Remove the Table Entry from the corresponding BC Set.-Delete and re-create the BC Set - this time without the table entry.-See Also-If the record is created through PDI, it should not allow you to edit the record and also to make any change.-Keywords-posting control profile; accounting principle; PDI; customization; localization toolkit

Title: How to Determine Service Performer in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Service Performer determined in the Sales Order is not the one expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Edit the Sales Order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of Sales Order)-Go to View All and Go to the Items tab.-Select the Service Item, the Service Performer is not the one expected.-Cause-The Service Performer is determined according to the following rules:-Rule #1 Responsibility for Ship-To:-Direct responsibility to the ship-to party can be define. All direct responsibilities overrule the responsibilities maintained in the Application and User Management work center.-Rule #2 Determine Responsibilities for Service Performer - Sales Order for Ship-To:-The Responsibility to Determine Service Performer - Sales Order work category is used to determine the Service Performer that is responsible to execute the standardized service products in a Sales Order. It is possible to create responsibility rules for this work category related to the following standard set of parameters derived from the account entered in the sales document: Company, Country, Region, City, ZIP Code.-It is also possible to activate additionally the usage of ABC Classification via fine-tuning. Prerequisites:-The business option for selling services in sales is activated in scoping.-The Service Units have been defined in the Organizational Management which are responsible for executing the services sold in a Sales Order.-Resolution-How to maintain Rule #1 Responsibility for Ship-To:-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Select the Ship-To Account and choose Edit -> Contacts.-On the Contact tab select Relationships and Responsibilities.-In the Responsibilities section, add a service performer.-Save.-All direct responsibilities overrule the responsibilities maintained in the Application and User Management work center.-How to maintain Rule #2 Determine Responsibilities for Service Performer - Sales Order for Ship-To:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Task Distribution and then Employee Work Distribution view.-Go to Service and Support and Resp. to Determine Service Performer - Sales Order-You can define work distribution rules by selecting the ID of User Responsible and the valid from and to date. -Then you can select the rule details: Company, Country, Region, City, ZIP Code.-Example: Employee E_X (E_X is the ID of the Employee) has to be the Service Performer for all Sales Order with a Ship-To Party with country US.-Maintain a new rule in Work Distribution for the employee E_X.-In the rule details choose the Country United State and Save.-How to define responsibility criteria for the selected responsibility category:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Activity List view.-Select fine tuning activity > Criteria to Determine Responsibilities for Service Execution - Sales Order.-Select Criteria to Determine Service Performer - Sales Order.-How to change the determination logic:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Activity List view.-Select fine tuning activity and then Involved Parties for Sales Orders.-Select the party role > Maintain Determination.-You can activate or deactivate determination steps for your party role.-Keywords-Service Performer, Sales Order, Determination, Rule

Title: Error DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED When Trying to Complete Exection for a Service
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to complete the execution of a Service item under a Sales Order via webservice, and when executing the payload, the system returns the error: DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Send the payload with FinishFulfilmentProcessing set as True for one of the items.-Cause-The reason the error is occurring is because for one of the items within the payload you are passing itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator set as True and using the action code is 06.-Example:-<Item actionCode="06" itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-    <ID>123</ID>-</Item>-<Item actionCode="02" itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-    <ID>456</ID>-    <FinishFulfilmentProcessing>true</FinishFulfilmentProcessing>-</Item>-Action code 06 means "No action (check)".-The inconsistency occurs because you are passing  itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator as True with action code 06 requiring no action.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-When using action code 06, please pass itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator as False.-See Also-2865905 - When creating a Sales Order via Web Service the following warning occurs Action RELEASE_CUSTOMER_REQUEST not possible; action is disabled-Keywords-DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED, Complete Execution, Service, Sales Order, Item, FinishFulfilmentProcessing, itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator, Finish, Webservice

Title: Unable to delete or update a .codelist entry
Content: Symptom-When changing a .codelist description entry in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio and activating the file, the previous description is kept.-Also, the Delete All button makes no effect to the entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Studio.-Open the affected solution.-Open the .codelist file and make a change into the description of any value and save.-When closing and opening the file again, the changes are not reflected.-The entries are not deleted when clicking on the Delete All button as well.-Cause-The Delete All button is only supported for a .codelist file which is created within the same patch version.-Resolution-Once you change the description of the value, you can be clicking on any other field so that an asterisk (*) appears next to the .codelist tab name at the top, to indicate that the file is dirty. After that, you can save and activate.-Also, in such where the codelist values need to be updated regularly, you can be creating a configurable code list instead.-See Also-Please refer to this blog post: Two approaches to create Code List in Cloud Studio and to the SAP Help Portal documentation: Configurable Code Lists-Keywords-PDI, SDK, BC, BCO, value, row, key

Title: Copying Document not Possible; Reference Document is not Submitted
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is trying to reference two business documents using the OData service and upon the response, the referencing is not happening.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the backend.-Navigate to the transaction SE24.-Enter program CM_ESI_T100.-Set a breakpoint for the user executing the request.-Send the OData link.-Open the first method after the Constructor.-CHECK_CUST_QUOTE_STATUS (CL_APCRM_COPY_PRECD_CUST_QUOTE)-Double click on the error and copy the following:-MSG: APCRM_COPY-MSG Number: 059-Go to the transaction SE91.-Enter the following:-Message: APCRM_COPY-Message Number: 059-Text: Copying Document not Possible; Reference Document is not Submitted.-Cause-The reason the customer is facing the message "Copying document not possible; reference document is not submitted" is because one of the documents has not been approved and thus the system cannot perform the reference.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please advise the customer to approve the document.-See Also-3285415 - OData Service Does not Reference Sales Quote to a Sales Order-Keywords-OData, Service, Sales Order, Sales Quote, Reference, URL, Link, AddReferenceWithDataProvision,

Title: Error - Amount ABC in Cover Document YYYY Unequal to Amount DEF in Tax Return XX, While Releasing Withholding Tax Return for Country India
Content: Symptom-You have noticed below errors while releasing Withholding Tax Return for Country India:-Tax Payable Amount not correct.-Amount ABC (ABC represents the amount) in Cover Document YYYY (YYYY represents the Supplier Invoice ID) unequal to Amount DEF (DEF represents the other amount) in Tax Return XX (XX represents the Withholding Tax Return).-Release of Tax Return XX failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work center.-Choose Withholding Tax Returns view.-Select the Withholding Tax Return XX In Preparation and click Release (XX represents Withholding Tax Return).-You see error messages:-Tax Payable Amount not correct.-Amount ABC in Cover Document YYYY unequal to Amount DEF in Tax Return.-Release of Tax Return XX failed.-Cause-There are two reasons:-For Country - India, it is not allowed to have multiple items in a single invoice with different Delivery Address (different states).-The state field is empty in some of the items of Supplier Invoice and the Withholding Tax return does not pick up these items of the invoice because it treats them as tax item falling under different Tax reporting unit.-This is a standard system behavior for Tax Country - India.-Resolution-You have to cancel this supplier invoice and re-create with correct states in Delivery Address. Then, you should execute a new Withholding Tax Return Run and Release the Withholding Tax Return.-Keywords-amount in cover document unequal to; release of tax return failed; wht return India; wht return release error; withholding tax return; release error

Title: Dump due to Duplicate Node IDs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You may receive a dump exception when performing any regular activity on the UI, such as accessing a work center views or opening ticket or any other record.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-As an example, Go to Sales work center.-Click on Opportunities view.-Open any Opportunity. There is exception.-If you check for exception details in incight, it points to issue with UI component.- In ABAP Call stack, it refers to issue in Oberon class as below:-    Cause-This issue occurs due to Duplicate Node ID’s available to fetch in SADL OWL.-Typical dump details:-Category               ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors         UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION-Except.                CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION-ABAP Program           CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE==========CP-Application Component  AP-RC-UIF-RT-Short Text-    An exception occurred that was not caught.-Application Information-  /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/BCTools/FactSheet/BCFactSheet_Model.FS.uicomponent-Error analysis-    An exception occurred that is explained in detail below.-    The exception, which is assigned to class 'CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION', was not caught in procedure "_SORT_AND_CHECK_NODE_IDS" "(METHOD)", nor was it propagated by a RAISING clause.-    Since the caller of the procedure could not have anticipated that the exception would occur, the current program is terminated.-    The reason for the exception is:-    Duplicate Node IDs from Fetch: Create ticket on BC-ESI-ESF-BSA or TREX-Active Calls/Events-   13 METHOD       CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION==CP    CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION==CM003    19-      CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION=>THROW-   12 METHOD       CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE==========CP    CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE==========CM01E     8-      CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE=>_SORT_AND_CHECK_NODE_IDS-Resolution-Foward the incident to the responsible team of the related UI screen which is dumping or underlying Business Object.--In case the dump is happening when opening a custom fine-tunining activity from the implementations projects view, please check the below KBA:-3288111 - Dump when opening a custom fine tuning activity-Keywords-dump, error, CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION, CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE, duplicate, node, ID

Content: Symptom-You want to assign the user ABC as Direct Approver for Shopping cart/Purchase request/Purchase order/Supplier invoice/Request for quotation/Purchasing contract approvals, however the user is not available in the list of Direct approvers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the View Task Distribution & Select Approval Process-Go to the respective Approval Process-Copy the existing approval process and navigate to  step-Select Work Distribution as Direct Approvers and Edit-Search for user ABC-No MMA_SUPPLIERINVOICING-Request for quotation/Purchasing contract:MMA_STRATEGICPURCHASING-Project purchase request:PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES-Cause 2: The user does not have Read & Write Access for above
