Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY***-You want to know when this run will happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If you have scoped the question"Do you want automatic closure of expired purchasing contract?" and contract is expired then a back ground job will run every day  once midnight in general and contract will be closed automatically.(we cannot extend the frequency of the run more than once a day)-Go to Transaction MDRS in backend-Click on meta data repository-Choose Job definitions in the drop down and enter"/SRMAP/R_LPUR_PCT_CHECK"-Click on enter-Double click on on object name appearing-Goto right side tabs called recurrence-you can see the start  time-To know the time zone:-On any screen in that customer system back end-Go to left top you have system tab-Click on it and choose status-There you can see the system timeC-Check whcih time zone that time is like UTC or CET etc(Mostly it is UTC)

Title: Error During Migration of Identified Stock.
Content: Symptom-During migration of identified stock you will encounter below error-Quantity conversion maintained for pair and must be batch relevant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter and Overview view.-2. Filter by Activities and Search Migration of Identified Stock and View.-3. Click on Migrate identified stock using the migration tool.-4. Select the migration template MIG01 where MIG01 is the Migration template.-5. Click on Execute Migration - step by step.-In the following screen you will encounter the above error.-Ex: Error detected in source record with key value 'PROD, dd-mm-yy' where PROD is the Product ID and dd-mm-yy is the date.- Quantity conversion maintained for pair and must be batch relevant-Cause-This error is raised when batch dependent  flag for the quantity conversion isn’t maintained in the product master.-  Resolution-You will have to set the flag for batch dependent for the quantity conversion in the product portfolio for product PROD.-Keywords-Migration, Identified Stock,quantity conversion, batch relevant, batch dependent

Title: Logistics Use Setting for Location Layout
Content: Symptom-You are setting Logistics Use for Logistics Areas, however you do not know which option to use.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center. -Select Locations view. -Find the relevant Location ID. -Edit Layout. -Select the relevant Logistics Area. -Under General tab you can set the Logistics Use. -Cause-You can find below the explanation about every option available for Logistics Use:-Movable Storage: Used in the pick-up scenario for Service order and Project Stock order - this usage captures mobile storages. Only one Logistics Area under a site can have this usage.- -Restricted Stock: As the name suggests, it can be used to maintain restricted stock. Maintaining this usage against a LoA doesn’t mean that the system will automatically mark the stock stored in this LoA as restricted – this is more of a soft classification, which can be used in the logistics model for a Returns scenario. - -Project Stock: Used in consumption-at-site scenario in project stock orders. Only one Logistics Area under a site can have this usage.- -Not Relevant for Planning: Stock in this Logistics Area is not considered for planning and availability checks but will be available for execution. Please refer to this blog post for further details (https://blogs.sap.com/2020/05/05/exclude-a-logistic-area-from-planning-and-availability-check/)- -Over The Counter Stock: Used in Over-the-counter-sale document. Only one Logistics Area under a site can have this usage set.-The Stock maintained the LoA that has this usage is used in the OTCS process.- -Storage: Selected when the logistics area is intended to be used as a storage area/bin. There is no restriction on the kind of stock that can be stored in the LoAs with this usage.-                -Receiving Staging: Used as a staging area for the inbound stock when it is unloaded from the delivery. -                -Shipping Staging: Used as a staging area for the outbound stock when it is to be loaded into a delivery.- -Packing: Used for packing operations. Again, this is more from the identification of the LoA used in the WH process – in the system the packing can only be done if the OD is created, by then the stock is tagged to the WH order and may no longer be in any LoA.- -Inspection: Used for quality inspections. Maintaining this usage against a LoA doesn’t mean that the system will automatically mark the stock stored in this LoA as Inspection stock. Also, it plays a role in LoA proposal in Source and Destination determination in case of receiving inspections when the Inspection stock separation by LoA is maintained on the Inspection Plan. - -Intermediate Storage: Used for storing the in-process inventory on a production floor. However, this again is more from the identification standpoint in the warehouse because doesn’t support intermediate products.- -Production Supply: Used for storing the input products that act as a supply to the production floor.- -Production Output: Used for storing the output products that are produced on the production floor before they are moved to the storage areas.-Resolution-You can choose the Logistics Use as per your business requirement.-Keywords-Logistics, Use, LoA

Title: System Throws Exception While Editing The Inspection Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***- System Throws Exception While Editing The Inspection Document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All Versions]-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Quality Control work center and Inspections view.-2. Find Inspection ABC -> change status as Decision Revoked -> then Edit the Inspection-3. Go to Results tab and Delete Row-4 In the Decision tab enter the Quality Decision-5. Click on Save-System throws exception with the following details as shown in ST22 TCode (backend) --Application Information:-Index Information-    1 Triggering application component: AP-MIP-MI-    2 /ISPCD/CX_BASE_EXCEPTION, Program:/ISPCD/CX_BASE_EXCEPTION======CP, Include:/ISPCD/CX_BASE_E-    3 Info: An exception was raised- Active Calls:-   21 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003    66-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-   20 METHOD       CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001    24-      CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-   19 METHOD       /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION===========CP    /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION===========CM006   102-      /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION=>ADD_DELETED_NODES-   18 METHOD       /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION===========CP    /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION===========CM002    79-      /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION=>ADD_CHANGED_NODES-   17 METHOD       /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION===========CP    /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION===========CM00D   223-      /ISPCD/CL_OPERATION=>ORGANIZE_CHANGES-Cause-When the inspection defects are removed, the findings attachments aren’t deleted, which results in an exception from change documents framework.-System dumps when the findings have attachments assigned to them.-Resolution-To overcome this issue, user has to remove the attachments against the defects, save the document and then remove the inspection defects row and change the decision.-This is a known system limitation that should be documented-Keywords-Quality Inspection, Inspection Defect, Attachments

Title: Extra Characters in Report Downloaded in CSV Format
Content: Symptom-When you download a report in CSV format there are added characters for negative values.-Environment-SAP ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Go to Design reports and find your report.-Open your report and run it.-Download the report in CSV format.-Open the report in excel.-Notice there is an extra character in cells that have a negative value.-Example:-Instead of -20 you see '-20-Cause-The reason you are seeing the extra character for minus values in your excel reports is due to a potential csv injection/security issue.-Please see the below article that explains what a csv injection is --> https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/CSV_Injection-Note this happens only for report characteristics, not key figures. Negative numerical values in characteristics should be a rare use case.-Resolution-You can manually remove the extra character from the excel report.-However if you work with reports where you frequently have negative values in characteristics, we can activate a backend switch for your system to change the escaping of quotes. This will remove the character.-If you would like to request this, please open an incident and refer to this KBA.-See Also-https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/CSV_Injection-Keywords-extra character, inverted comma, CSV, download, report, excel,

Title: Error message in the Preview of Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-When you click on the Preview button on a Project Invoice Request the system display an error message: 'Preview not possible; project invoice request not consistent'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Project Invoice Requests view.-Select the relevant document.-Click Edit.-Click Preview.-See the error message: 'Preview not possible; project invoice request not consistent'.-Cause-Project Invoice Request not consistent since the Project or Project task is with the status Closed.-Resolution-This is a normal behavior, the Project Invoice Request need to be consistent so the system can create a preview. If the Project related to this Invoice Request is closed, then the document will be inconsistent and the error will be displayed.-To correct this change the Project status to 'Started', 'Released' or 'Completed' so the Project Invoice Request is consistent again.-In order to change the Project status follow the below steps:-Go to Project Management work center.-Select Projects view.-Filter for All Projects.-Search for the relevant Project.-Click on Edit.-Select Project Plan view.-Select Gantt Chart tab.-Select Basic Data sub-tab.-Change the Project Status from Closed to Revoke Closure in the dropdown.-Click on Save.-After that, please cancel the existent Project Invoice Request and create a new one.-Keywords- Project Invoice Request, Project

Title: No Relative Select Or Value Help Entries For Date/Time Report Fields
Content: Symptom-You open a report ABC (where ABC represents the name of the report) and click the value help of a selection field which is a date. You notice that the value help does not offer you any values to choose from, as well as no relative selection like Yesterday etc is available.-Further, filtering on this date field is resulting on report timeout or performance issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the respective work center and open the report.-There is a date field in the selection. Click the value help.-No relative selections nor any direct values are offered.-If you try to filter on the related date field, you also experience performance issues or timeout errors.-Cause-The field in question is a field of type DATE_TIME. It does not only show a date, but a combination of date and time, for example 01.01.2016 00:00:00 UTC. For DATE_TIME fields, no value help entries nor relative selections can be supported. If we allowed entries here, the system would load a value for every second, for example:-01.01.2016 00:00:00 UTC-01.01.2016 00:00:01 UTC-01.01.2016 00:00:02 UTC-And so on.-Such values are not practical. Additionally, they would cause performance issues in the system, hence it is not supported.-For the same reason, using intervals (for example, between, greater than, or less than) is not practical when filtering on DATE TIME fields. Instead, it's advised that fields of type DATE are used for report filtering, relative selections or value help.-Resolution-Date time fields in selections cannot be supported generally. Please note that for some fields it is possible to type in the values manually, however this is not a generic feature feasible for all date time fields. If it is supported for your field, please make sure you enter the spaces correctly between the date, time and time zone:-DD.MM.YYYY<space>HH:MM:SS<space>UTC.-In some cases, you can check if a field is of type DATE_TIME by proceeding as follows:-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Data Sources.-Search for the respective data source and open the documentation (click the link in the Documentation column).-Look for your field and check the Characteristic ID.-If it ends with DATE_TIME, this document is applicable. Please note however, that this is not possible for all fields (i.e. some date time fields will have other characteristic IDs).-Keywords-date time, datetime, time date, report, analytics, data source, value help, relative selection-empty,missing,value help,relative selection,report selection,date time fields

Title: Error Message "Business Residence Not Found" While Ordering A Purchase Order
Content: Symptom- Error message "Business residence not found; check ship-to or service location" while ordering a Purchase Order.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Filter for All Purchase Orders.-Search for ABC and open it (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Click on Order button and see the error message: "Business residence not found; check ship-to or service location" -Cause-Delivery Date in Purchase Order before or equal to the date when the ship-to location be created in the system.-However, there can be 2 scenarios depend on the ship to location time zone.-Scenario 1: The ship to location is located in UTC - time zone (Brazil, Mexico, etc)-For example, the purchase order item ship to location is created on 01-01-1900. When creating a new purchase order, select the delivery date as a date before 01-01-1900, system would trigger the error. When the delivery date is 01-01-1900 itself or after, system would not trigger the addressed error.--Scenario 2: The ship to location is located in UTC + time zone (China, Japan, etc)-For example, the purchase order item ship to location is created on 01-01-1900. When creating a new purchase order, select the delivery date as a date before or 01-01-1900 itself, system would trigger the addressed error. When the delivery date is after 01-01-1900, system would not trigger the addressed error.-In system UI, the delivery date is maintained in the ship to location time zone, and be considered as starting from 00:00. When it stores in backend, the time would be converted to UTC time.-If the ship to location is in Japan (UTC+9), and you maintain the delivery date as 01-01-1900, it would be considered as 01-01-1900 00:00 UTC+9, then be converted to 12-31-1899 15:00 UTC in backend. 12-31-1899 is before the ship to location creation date, hence system triggers the error.-Resolution-As the delivery date for Purchase Order is before the date that the ship to was created, system shows the error message. You'll need to change the delivery date for this Purchase Order for a date after the date as ship to master data was created.-Keywords-Business Residence; Error; Ordering Purchase Order; Ship-to; Business Residence Not Found; Delivery Date

Title: Invoice Split When Trying to Combine Manual Invoice Request and Customer Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are trying to invoice a Manual Invoice Request and a Customer Project Invoice Request into a single Invoice Document, however, the system is splitting into two documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests views.-Search for the ID's ABC and XYZ (ABC and XYZ represent the ID's of the invoice requests).-Select both Invoice Requests.-Click Invoice.-System splits.-Cause-The system is splitting the invoice requests as the Posting Date is maintained under the Manual Invoice Request but not available in the Customer Project Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.- Since the field Posting Date is not available under Customer Project Invoice Request, please remove the value under the Manual Invoice Request in order to combine both document into one single Invoice document.-See Also-1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-1879086 - Invoice Split Occurs due to a Different Seller Tax Number even though the Seller Tax Number Should be the Same for all Items-2564411 - Invoice Split of Credit Memo and Invoice Items-Keywords-Invoice, Split, Customer Invoice, Invoice Request, Unable, Combine, Trying, Try, Release, Project, Manual Invoice

Title: Dump when opening a custom fine tuning activity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**** INTERNAL USE ONLY ****-A dump is being faced while opening a custom fine tuning acitvity in the implementation Projects view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Open Implementation Project view-Click on "open activity list" button-Open the related activity-Cause-There is a restriction/limitation from the BC Tools framework that a Business Option can be assigned a maximum of 109 fine-tuning BC Sets. In case there are 110 or more fine-tuning BC Sets assigned to a single business option, the activity link dumps on the UI.-Resolution-To confirm that the dump is due to this cause, you need to locate the dump in ST22 transaction and look for this information:-Category               ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors         UNCAUGHT_EXCEPTION-Except.                CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION-ABAP Program           CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE==========CP-Application Component  AP-RC-UIF-RT-Short Text-    An exception occurred that was not caught.-Application Information-  /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/BCTools/FactSheet/BCFactSheet_Model.FS.uicomponent-Error analysis-    An exception occurred that is explained in detail below.-    The exception, which is assigned to class 'CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION', was not caught in procedure "_SORT_AND_CHECK_NODE_IDS" "(METHOD)", nor was it propagated by a RAISING clause.-    Since the caller of the procedure could not have anticipated that the exception would occur, the current program is terminated.-    The reason for the exception is:-    Duplicate Node IDs from Fetch: Create ticket on BC-ESI-ESF-BSA or TREX-Active Calls/Events-   13 METHOD       CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION==CP    CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION==CM003    19-      CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION=>THROW-   12 METHOD       CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE==========CP    CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE==========CM01E     8-      CL_OBERON_RT_BO_NODE=>_SORT_AND_CHECK_NODE_IDS-Resolution:-The responsible for the add-on would need to delete as many BC Sets and Fine-tuning UIs (QA view) as possible from the custom solution for the BC activity to work again.-Also, when there is a requirement for such a high number of BC Sets and Fine-tuning sets, it is recommended to create the BAC with the option "Business Topic and Business Options" rather than selecting a single "Business Option".-Once the BAC is created as "Business Option" it can't be changed due to maintenance mode.-See Also-Please check the SAP Help Documentation: Create a Business Topic and Business Options-Keywords-PDI, SDK, BC, BCO, BAC, dump, CX_OBERON_DYN_CONT_EXCEPTION, duplicate, node, IDs

Title: Extension Field is Missing From Price/Discount List Excel Upload
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload/update a price/discount list and noticed that an extension field is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use Discount Lists ABC(ABC represents the name of the custom discount list which contain the extension field) that has extension field XYZ(XYZ represents the ID of the extension field).-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Discount Lists view.-Select a discount list ABC.-Click Download button.-Open the Microsoft Excel file. -Here you noticed that the file does not contain the extension field XYZ.-Cause-The reason the extension field is not showing in the Excel file is because it is field of type Long Text and currently price list/discount list Excel upload functionality does not support this data type.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Please use the Migration of Discount Lists to upload the discount lists.-See Also-2938699 - Unable to Upload Price List Via Excel-2994967 - Error When Updating Price/Discount List via Microsoft Excel Add-In-2877953 - Excel Upload of Custom Price List with extension field does not work-2774043 - Upload of Currency Price Lists is Failing-Keywords-Extension Field, Missing, Price List, Discount List, Excel, Upload, Migration, Custom, Data Type, Long Text

Title: Odata Service Does not Reference Sales Quote to a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reference a Sales Quote to a Sales Order via the OData services, you receive a confirmation but the referencing does not happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The reason the system cannot perform the referencing is because of the Sales Quote which has not been approved.-Go to the New Business work center.-Select Sales Quotes view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Quote).-Document Status: Open.-Click Edit.-You can see that the submit button is enabled and under the General section, Approval Status shows as Not Started.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please approve the Sales Quote or document in question and perform the referencing again.-Keywords-OData, Service, Sales Order, Sales Quote, Reference, URL, Link, AddReferenceWithDataProvision

Title: Troubleshooting "Document Cannot Be Generated" Errors With Output or Preview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This knowledge base article is designed to provide some tips on what to check regarding the "Document cannot be generated" errors documented in KBA #3233470.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Always check the form with the Data source in ALD what does not work in ALD would not work in ByD nor C4C.-If it is a standard form Application needs to check further.-If its a custom form Customer need to review the customization as SAP would not remodel any custom forms.-ANY INCIDENTS FORWARDED TO BC-SRV-FP REQUIRE THE TRACES attached and a short problem description . STEPS TO REPRODUCE ARE NOT REQUIRED AS THE COLLEAGUES NEED THE TRACES ETC.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Initially:-Ensure that customer has checked KBA #3233470 and tried the solutions proposed in it.-Collect all necessary information and authorization to reproduce the issue (ideally in customer's test tenant).-If possible, recreate the scenario and reproduce the issue in one of our internal test tenants.-I. Document cannot be generated; ADS rendering of SAP template failed-First of all, identify which form template is being used in customer's scenario. This can be done in multiple ways, such as:-In the document's Output History tab:--SAP Cloud for Customer----SAP Business ByDesign---Under You Can Also > Edit Output Settings (when available):--SAP Cloud for Customer------SAP Business ByDesign- ---Go to the Form Template Maintenance work center view, locate this form template and click Download to get its .XDP file.-Next, access the tenant's backend and get the application XML for the affected document following the steps in KBA #2193339.-With both the XDP and the XML, you can attempt generating a PDF preview with Adobe LifeCycle Designer to get more information.-(If you do not have Adobe LifeCycle Designer installed, please download the latest version following KBA #3210199)-Open the form template's .XDP file; this should automatically open it in Adobe LifeCycle Designer if the software is installed.-Click File in the toolbar at the top, then select Form Properties.-In the prompt, navigate to Preview.-Next to the Data File field, click the Browse button (folder icon).-Select the XML you've downloaded and click Open; the Data File field should now show its path.----Click OK.-Now, navigate to the Preview PDF tab; this will cause Adobe LifeCycle Designer to automatically generate a PDF by inputting the data from the XML into the form designed in the .XDP file.-You can then check the Log tab in the bottom section for more information (it might be necessary to expand this section by selecting its border and dragging it). Below, you can see an example of logs in the Log tab.--As issues in rendering the preview on Adobe LifeCycle Designer are often due to incorrect customizations by the customer, provide them the information on the log and ask them to address the issues.-If the PDF load successfully in Adobe LifeCycle Designer, but still fails in the system, this will have to be checked by the BC-SRV-FP development. Take an ADS trace of the scenario (as described in KBA #2655972) then attach the trace logs, the .XDP of the form and the XML of the document to the incident before forwarding to the BC-SRV-FP team.-II. Document cannot be generated; ADS server returned an SOAP error-As stated in KBA #3233470, this issue generally occurs when the application XML being generated for the document is too large for processing by the ADS server. Keep in mind that the AP-RC-OUT team is only responsible for the output framework—if customer would like more assistance on how to trim down the size of the XML, this should be handled by the application responsible for the document, as with all issues regarding the application XML.-Customer might occasionally experience this error even with documents that have a reasonable application XML size. In this case, kindly forward the incident to the Hosting team asking them to check if there are any issues with the ADS server.-III. Document cannot be generated; form master template error-Once customer has provided us the authorization, execute the steps described in KBA #2641742.-Keywords-Output, Preview, Document cannot be generated, ADS, ADS rendering of SAP template failed, ADS server returned an SOAP error, form template, form master template error, FPRT_CREATE_DOCUMENT, ADS, trace, Adobe LifeCycle, log, download, application, XML

Title: Dump received on webservice response: RABAX occurred on server side
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**** INTERNAL USE ONLY ****-Customer reports a dump/error when receiving a web service response.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-This error happens because the partner has created a .pid file on their add-on and proceeded to delete the receiving business object without adjusting the .pid file.-To confirm if this is the right root cause for your case, please check the Resolution section.-Resolution-There should be a dump on ST22 with the following details:-Category                          ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors                DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED-ABAP Program                 CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS====CP-Application Component   AP-RC-BDS-SI-Short Text- No access possible via a 'NULL' data reference.- -Error analysis- It was tried to access a data object using a 'NULL' data reference (points to 'nothing').- A data reference must point to a data object before it can be used to access the referenced data object.- The reference has either never been set, or it was set to 'ZERO' with a CLEAR statement.- -Active Calls/Events-22 METHOD CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS====CP CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS====CM008 296- CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS=>BUILD_OUTBOUND_CONFIG- -21 METHOD CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS====CP CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS====CM002 31- CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS=>CONSTRUCTOR- -20 METHOD CL_PDI_PI_GENERIC_OUTBOUND_A==CP CL_PDI_PI_GENERIC_OUTBOUND_A==CM004 46- CL_PDI_PI_GENERIC_OUTBOUND_A=>IF_SPAF_OUTB_PROCESS_AGENT~INIT- -19 METHOD CL_SPAF_OUTB_PA_CONTROLLER====CP CL_SPAF_OUTB_PA_CONTROLLER====CM00H 74- CL_SPAF_OUTB_PA_CONTROLLER=>IF_SPAF_OUTB_ASYNC_CONTROLLER~RUN_AGENT- -18 METHOD CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CP CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER===========CM00D 27- CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER=>RUN_AGENTS- How to find the BO name:-Open the "Chosen variables" section from the dump-Search for the variable LR_BUSINESS_OBJECT->NAME-Take note of the BO name- How to find the .pid file:-Go to SE38 > RP_PDI_SEARCH_ALL and execute-Place the BO name found on SEARCH field and select the "Enable" checkbox-Execute the report-Take note of the .pid file available on the list-You can now be closing the incident informing the partner/customer about the root cause and that the .pid file should be deleted or that another business object should be selected.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Configure Internal Communication-Keywords-PDI, SDK, dump, error, web, webservice, RABAX, server, side, CL_PDI_PI_RT_CONFIG_ACCESS, BUILD_OUTBOUND_CONFIG, DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED

Title: Service Performer not Showing In Order Pipeline View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a Sales Order with an item type service, you added the Service Performer in the item and you expected to see the Service Performer name under the Order Pipeline OWL (Object Work List).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Order Pipeline view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order created).-Service Performer column is empty.-Cause-The Service Performer is only displayed in the OWL of the Order Pipeline if the Service Performer party role is maintained in the Involved Parties tab, under the Sales Order header.-The logic behind this behavior is that, in a Sales Order you can have multiple line items with item type Service and you can add different Service Performers for each of the line items.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-If you create a new Sales Order and maintain the Service Performer in the Involved Parties tab you can see that this Service Performer will also be displayed in the Order Pipeline view, under the Field Service and Repair work center.-Keywords-Service, Sales Order, Service Performer, Order Pipeline, Field Service and Repair, Missing, Not Showing, Data Not Found, Template, Form, Without

Title: Relative Selections Missing in Report Fields
Content: Symptom-You notice that in some reports, there are no relative selections on some fields. For similar fields, relative selections are available.-For example, you may notice that the report field "Employee" has relative selections such as Employee - My User Name, My Workforce and Me, etc.-However the report field "Task Approver", which also refers to employees, has no relative selections.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Cause-Relative selections are automatically added based on the data type of the respective field. For example:-There is a relative selection on "Employee" because the underlying data type supports the concept of employee relationships.-The field "Task Approver" and its data type however merely refer to users in the system. This field cannot reflect employee relationships, so no relative selections are available.-Resolution-Requests for new relative selections on standard fields cannot be accepted via incidents, however you can reach out to product management via the Influence portal.-Please check if you can use an alternative field which has the selection you require.-See Also-2944322 - Relative Selections Missing for Cloud Data Source Field-2811968 - No Relative Selection for Extension Fields in Reports-2929977 - Relative Selection in PDI Fields-2340173 - No Relative Select Or Value Help Entries For Date/Time Report Fields-Keywords-relative selection, advance select, missing, report, business analytics

Title: System Dumps When Creating Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You are creating a copy of an approval process and after maintaining all of the expected date, when clicking Save and Close the systems creates an exception/dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this case we will use the following example:-Related Business Document: Quote-Condition Field: Sales Unit-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Approval Processes view.-Search for the approval process ABC (ABC represents the name of the approval process for Quote).-Click the Copy button.-Edit the Condition.-Field: Sales Unit.-Compare Operator: Equal to.-With: Value and add the Sales Unit XYZ (XYZ represent the name of the Sales Unit/Organizational Unit).-Cause-The system is generating an exception/dump because you are adding the name of the Sales Unit/Org Unit instead of the ID.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please enter the ID of the Sales Unit/Organizational Unit and the system will no longer return an error.-Keywords-Approval, Process, Dump, Exception, Copy, Sales Unit, Condition, Sales, Entity, Organizational Unit, Save, Save and Close, Error

Title: You Are Not Able to Add Negative Quantity in the Sales Order or Contract
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add negative quantity in the Sales Order or a Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Add mandatory details in the sales order.-Select the View All button and go to the Items tab.-Add a product at Item level and add a negative quantity.-Save the sales order.-The system does not allow to have negative quantity.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign is working as designed.-Resolution-The standard SAP Business ByDesign system does not support negative quantity in the Sales Order or the Contract.-Keywords-Negative; Quantity;

Title: Stock Transfer Proposal Cannot Be Processed and Cannot Be Deleted
Content: Symptom-Stock Transfer Order proposal XXX from ZZZ to YYY cannot be processed and cannot be deleted from product planning.-XXX = Stock Transfer Order Proposal ID-ZZZ = Planning Area ID of the ship-from-YYY = Planning Area ID of the Ship-to-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Find the relevant Product Planning, for Planning Area YYY.-Click Open.-Notice that Delete and Release buttons are grayed out for XXX.-Cause-You are trying to delete or release the Stock Transfer Proposal in Product Planning related to the ship-to.-Resolution- You need to delete or release the Stock Transfer Proposal in Product Planning for the Ship-from:-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select Products view.-Find the relevant Product Planning, for Planning Area ZZZ.-Click Open.-Notice that you can Delete and Release XXX.-Keywords-MRP, run, planning

Title: SAP Collaboration Window Crashing When the User Tries to Logon
Content: Symptom-When the user tries to access the SAP Collaboration Window, the app is crashing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Download the SAP Collaboration Window.-Try to logon in the Collaboration Window.-Program crashed.-Cause-A possible cause for this scenario is that the Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0 is not installed in the user's computer.-Resolution-Install the Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0.-See Also-Link to download the Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0.-Keywords-SAP Collaboration Window, not working, crashing, crashed.-

Title: Report Opportunity Pipeline Duplicating Value
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When using the report Opportunity Pipeline, the system is duplicating the values in two lines, such as account and material, but under the second line, at times the values show as Not Assigned-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for Opportunity Pipeline.-Edit the report.-Add Account and Product.-Apply the changes.-System displays two lines for the same account, but one has no value.-Cause-The system is duplicating the values because for the report Opportunity Pipeline the system is using a union data source (CRMOPPU).-Since the report is a combination/union of header and item data sources, one more row is coming with extra values (#) when adding master data to the report, such as account and product.-This extra value comes from header level and for this reason no value shows.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Data Source, CRMOPPU, Opportunity Pipeline, Opportunity, Sales Order, Report

Title: How to Handle Requests for Updating New Fonts
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You will get a request from customer to upload new font in Adobe (ADS) server. This document explains steps to be followed for processing such request.-Pre-Requisites:-Customer must provide licensed font version which needs to be updated in ADS.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Customer created or personalized the form template with a non standard font.-Resolution-1) Install the new fonts:-Forward customer incident to host queue MS- Customer Support Request asking for updating font. You must attach the font license and font file.-Once relevant font is updated by hosting, check in backend for it:-Go SE16 transaction.-Access table FPC_I_CUST_FONTS.-Execute the selection query (no need to enter anything in FONT_NAME fields).-Cross check if custom fonts are updated in this table (ADS gets font information from this table).-2) Create Custom Font entry in FPC_I_CUST_FONTS:-If custom font is not updated, you need to run a report attached with name REPORT - Custom FONT Addition.txt attached in "Attachments" section.-Note: This is a sample report. You need to customize report based on customer's scenario and font requests.-Overwrite each font type name in the report with a required font type name (example:  ls_font_name-font_name = 'Kanit Black'.  >  ls_font_name-font_name = 'ABC'.  (where ABC represents a New Font Type Name).-Remove redundant records and save a copy of the report-In field  Go to SE38 -Program: Maintain a name starting with Z_-Select Create-In field Title: Maintain a Title-In the next pop-up, select Local Object-Overwrite all text with the report text-Select Save-Click Activate and click Direct Processing-Repeat steps in 1) Install the new Fonts to check if the fonts are available now-3) JobProfile Update in Backend:-After the new font is installed you should update the JobProfile in backend.-Attention:-There are different processes for Cloud for Customer and Business ByDesign systems.-This should be repeated every time customer update the form version.-Only in Business ByDesign:-In System backend, enter BCE transaction.-Select BC Projects from dropdown.-Enter * in BC Project.-Select True for main project and click on enter.-Double click on Scope selection.-Select Scoping (With Question) in the right window, and click on ‘edit’ to change the scoping.-  Navigate through Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Process-Integrated Input and Output Management   -> Job Profile for PDF Rendering.-Check the 'Status' box for Job Profile for PDF Rendering.-Select the 'Save' button.-Select the 'Activate' button-  In Cloud for Customer:-We should execute the backend report ZINSERT_JOB_PROFILE. However, this report should be created at the first run time:-Go to backend transaction SE38.-In Program add a program name e.g ZINSERT_JOB_PROFILE.-Press Create.-In Tittle field add a tittle e.g. ZINSERT_JOB_PROFILE.-Press Save.-Now select Local Object.-Delete the entire text from the report screen.-Paste all text from attached file ZINSERT_JOB_PROFILE.txt.-Select the Save icon (the disket icon).-Select Activate.-Now return to SE38 and Run the report.-Fill the necessary fields:--GRP_CODE: Template group code-LANGUAGE: Template language-COUNTRY: Template Country (if there is no one, left blank)-VER_ID: Template ID (See it on Form Template Maintenance).-Execute.-4) Update JobProfile for Form Template in Bydesign Only (Customer has to perform based on steps outlined in below KBA):-Then, customer has to update Job Profile for the form template as explained in the below KBA-SAP Note KBA 2781776  - How to Add Job Profile to Form Template-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Keywords-Custom fonts, ADS fonts, Job profile assignment, Job profile , font update, Install font-custom fonts,ads fonts,job profile assignment,job profile, font update,font missing,fpc_i_cust_fonts,font

Title: Service Agents Are Not Displayed in Employee Times Reports
Content: Symptom-You have recorded times for a Service Agent and want to find these time recordings in one of the standard Employee Times reports. However, service agents are not listed in the reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the Time Administration work center and access the view Reports.-You select one of the Employee Times reports.-For example you open the report Employee Times: Monthly and click Go.-You see that the service agents are not displaying in this report even though times are recorded for them. Only internal employees are displayed.-Cause-The standard reports like Employee Times: Monthly do not show service agent data.-Resolution-The data source which is used in the standard reports (Data Source name: Employee Times, technical name: HCMTLMU01) contains the service agent data. Therefore you can create a new report based on this data source from the Business Analytics work center. Please proceed as follows:-Go to the Business Analytics work center, Design Reports view.-Select New Report (this will open the Report Wizard).-In Step 1 choose the data source HCMTLMU01.-In the next steps select the necessary keyfigures and characteristics.-Make sure to select the Key Date characteristic (Step 3), define it as a variable (Step 4) and make it mandatory (Step 5) to give the date period in the report.-Also make sure to select characteristic Time Type Category (Step 3). In step 4 choose the value selection as Fixed Value Selection. Then click the button Set Fixed Value Selections. A pop up window opens up with the field Time Type Category. Select the More icon next to the input field. Another Pop up screen opens up. Check the But Exclude option and in the below given input field enter the value 12 (valuation result).-Also ensure that the value selection for internal employee is changed to No value Selection.-Finish the report wizard and check the newly created report. It will contain Service Agent data.-Note: Since this report is based on data source HCMTLMU01,t you cannot see the approval status of time recordings. In case you would like to see the approval status,  the following data source and reports could be used instead.-Data Source ID :HCMTLMB07-Data Source Name : Employee Recorded Times-Keywords-Service Agents, Employee Times, HCMTLMU01,-employee times report,service agent

Title: Dump When Performing Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order
Content: Symptom-You want to perform Adjustment Confirmation with Serial Numbers for Warehouse Order XXX, however a dump is faced when saving.-XXX = Inbound Warehouse Order ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Select Monitoring:By Warehouse Order view. -Find Warehouse Order XXX. -Open Warehouse Order XXX.-Click View All.-Select Adjustment Confirmation.-For the relevant line, select Enable Entry.-Remove the Serial Numbers.-Select Save.-Dump is faced. -Cause-This is a Stock Transfer scenario, and the Outbound Delivery corresponding to this Inbound Delivery is already in undo released status. Due to that reason, the Serial Numbers in question are marked as negative and non-adjustable against the sending site.-And in this case, the adjustment (removal) of Serial Numbers in the receiving site is not allowed, because once these Serial Numbers are adjusted, the stock against the sending site should become adjustable automatically, and currently the system cannot do this.-Resolution-You need to first Release the Outbound Delivery:-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Select Outbound Deliveries view. -Find the related Outbound Delivery. -Select Release button. -This will remove the Non-Adjustable and negative stock from the sending site, then the adjustment confirmation in the Warehouse Order XXX to remove the Serial Numbers will be possible.-Keywords-OD, CID, WH

Title: Missing Tag BuyerTaxIdentificationNumber from XML
Content: Symptom-You have created a Customer Invoice for a customer based in Hungary and noticed that the tag BuyerTaxIdentificationNumber is missing in the  XML despite the account having the Tax Number Type: Tax Number under the master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click View Data XML.-Search for the tag BuyerTaxIdentificationNumber-The system is not able to find any value for the tag-Cause-In order to have the number passed to the XML so as to be able to claim VAT, please change the tax number type to VAT(Value Added Tax).-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the account).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Financial Data tab.-Go to the Tax Data subtab.-Maintain the VAT under the Tax Numbers.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, BuyerTaxIdentificationNumber, Tax, Tax Number, Hungary

Title: Attachments not sent via Interface
Content: Symptom-Attachments are not sent via internal external EDX or XML output i.e.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Use XML as output for any output and attach an attachment. Attachments are not considered.-Cause-Attachments are not sent.-Resolution-This is a known Limitation confirmed by the OM Framework Team.-What you can try is, -add a KUT Field or extension field-here maintain the link from the attachment via PDI-Partner Solution.-The attachment will be then part of the XML itself.-Keywords-Attachments, XML Output, Internal-External EDX, Attachments.

Title: Error Message Received When using Transport Management with Reports or Data Source analytical objects
Content: Symptom-When you try to upload the XML file which contains Extension Fields or a custom report via Transport Management, you might get an error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator work center > Transport Management and create New Transport Request-Provide Transport Request Name > Save and Open-In Transport Objects tab Click on Select under Available Transport Objects and Select Transport Object type Analytical Content-Then click on Add Selected and this will add the object selected to the Selected Transport Objects section below. .-After saving it, one of the following error messages appear: 'Unexpected Error' or 'Data type of data source field XYZ is not available' (XYZ represents the data type name).-Cause-This import error is due to the content incompatibility in your XML model file. The template file contains customer or partner created Extension fields, which are not supported by the standard Key User Analytics tool.-Resolution-Upload is failing as the referenced extension fields (Partner/KUA) present in source system are not present in target system. Export and Import Layout feature is not supported in SAP Business ByDesign. Only PDI fields can be transferred to any other tenant by deploying the solution, while KUT created fields cannot be exported.-The PDI solution download/upload should be done from source system to target system first via PDI studio. After that, KUA report/data source upload to target system should work fine.-See Also-In order to figure out if there is one or more extension field in the content for the customer file model, it is necessary to open the XML code and seek the following term:-"/1AN"-For example:-/1AN/DF6BFB3DD7E481-/1AN/471FB8C93A410E_CURR-/1AN/43B10F0B9CDF07-/1AN/471FB8C93A410E-For further details also refer to the SAP Business ByDesign documentation available in the Help Center by searching the term: Upload and Download an Object-1803144 - C4C: Error Message Received When Uploading a Report or Data Source Objects-2645267 - Export Layout Functionality in Business ByDesign-Keywords-Report Upload; Upload Error; Upload Failed; Upload issue; Extension Field; Data Type-extension field,xml upload,report data type,data type error,data type not available

Title: Sales Kit not Determined in Sales Order Created From Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created an intercompany Purchase Order with Sales Kit and you expected that the follow-up Sales Order document would retrieve the Sales Kit items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order created from the Purchase Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the items tab.-Sales kit items are missing.-Cause-The issue occurred because Sales Order was inconsistent when it was created without the correct Sales Unit and Distribution Channel.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please maintain the correct party role determination.-Kindly refer to the Knowledge Base Article 2852861 - Party Role Determination in a Sales Document and the Blog Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-See Also-2852861 - Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-Keywords-Sales Order, Sales Kit, Intercompany, Purchase Order, Missing, Item, Items, Third-Party

Title: Conflicts in Business Configuration Scoping Questions under Project Resource Management
Content: Symptom-There are conflicts shown in the Business Configuration scoping phase under Project Management → Project Planning and Execution → Project Resource Management for the two questions:-"Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on Commitment Quantity of the employee from the Project - Team and Staffing Tab?" (deselected)-"Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on planned work specified at the task level of a project?" (selected)-and you cannot proceed to the step 5 („Review“) in the guided activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the view Implementation Projects and choose a project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Add any countries/regions in step 1.-Proceed to step 3.-Select the following scoping elements-Service → Product and Service Portfolio for Service and Repair-Project Management → Project Planning and Execution-Project Management → Project Planning and Execution → Time Recording-Proceed to step 4.-Show Elements with Conflicts.-The above mentioned two conflicts are shown.-Cause-Actually, there are no conflicts. But the Scoping Engine wrongly detects conflicts dependent on the order of the scoping and the selection of the Type of Business.-Resolution-In the step 4 of the scoping show the Elements with Conflicts and select Project Management → Project Planning and Execution → Project Resource Management-Select the first question with a conflict ("Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on Commitment Quantity of the employee from the Project - Team and Staffing Tab?"). The second question will be deselected by the system.-Select the second question with a conflict ("Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on planned work specified at the task level of a project?"). The first question will be deselected by the system.-Keywords-Project Management, Business Configuration, Scoping, Project Resource Management

Title: Can we Delete an Employee?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to Delete an Employee, however you are not able to find any option for it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It is not possible to delete an employee. Instead you may Terminate the employee.-Resolution-1. Go to Personal Administrator workcenter.-2. Select Regular Task view.-3. Select Terminate Relationship with Employee.-4. Search the Employee you want to terminate.-5. Select Last Working Day for the employee.-6. Select the Save and Close button to save the changes.-In case of wrong hiring or rehire, the only option is to terminate the Employee on the same day of Hire/rehire. But it is not possible to remove the Work Agreement

Title: Return to Supplier with Identified Stock
Content: Symptom-How to handle return to supplier process when a product holds multiple identified stock IDs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Let's take below example to explain the scenario.-Release a purchase order for product ABC, quantity 2 ea.-Release inbound delivery for the product, quantity 1 ea, but 1 ea with identified stock ID 1, 1 ea with identified stock ID 2.-Create a new return to supplier to completely return the product.-When checking the item details, you see system proposed 2 line items for product ABC. One with I stock 1, the other one with I stock 2. You see for line 1, everything is automatically proposed, while line 2's ship from location, delivery notification, and purchase order ID information are missing.-Manually maintain the ship from location, however the delivery notification and purchase order ID cannot be edited.-For line 2, select the follow up decision as Credit Memo.-Press Check, you see error: For this item, a credit memo is not permitted since no supplier invoice is expected for the corresponding purchase order item.-You cannot process the return to supplier further.-Cause-Currently, when there is a product holds multiple identified stock ID, system can only propose the inbound and purchase order references to one of the item. For the rest of the items, you cannot decide follow up as credit memo as the system cannot find the purchase order linked to it.-Resolution-Please split the product and create one return to supplier document for each identified stock ID. Then in each return to supplier, the inbound and purchase order references would be successfully proposed.-Later when creating outbound delivery, you can merge all of the return to supplier documents (delivery requests) and process further.-Keywords-Return to Supplier, Identified Stock, I Stock, Follow Up Decision, Credit Memo,-A credit memo is not permitted since no supplier invoice is expected for the corresponding purchase order item

Title: Missing Report Access Context Despite User Restrictions.
Content: Symptom-When users view a certain report, the access context in that report is Unrestricted. However, you have maintained restrictions on user level / business role level for all relevant work centers so you would expect the report to be restricted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-There are 2 possible causes:-The work center view that the report is assigned to has a conflict. You can check this as follows:-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Search for your report.-Click Assign.-Show all assigned work center views.-It is assigned to views with a conflict - see the "Conflict" column.-The report itself does not have an access context. This means that it's always unrestricted. You can check this as follows-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Search for your report.-Mark the report and in the table underneath the report list, check the "Access Context" entry. If it is empty, the report is not restricted. -Resolution-Depending on the cause:-When assigned to a conflicting work center view, the report is always unrestricted. Please change the assignment to another view without conflict.-Such reports cannot be restricted by user access rights. You could consider creating a copy of the report. In step 4, you can maintain fixed value selections. Here, you could set a relative restriction such as "My User Name", depending on how you would like the report to be restricted.-See Also-KBA 2488825 - Access Context of Report Not Working-KBA 2575041 - Conflict of access context during report assignment-Keywords-reporting, access context, missing restriction, too much data, business analytics, user restrictions

Title: Error 'Individual material XYZ is not assigned to an active fixed asset'.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to complete a customer invoice or create a manual invoice for the scrapping of an asset, and a business transaction error was created saying individual material is not assigned to an active asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Closing-Relevant Tasks subview. -You will see the closing relevant task with the following message: -'Individual material XYZ (XYZ represents the individual material ID) is not assigned to an active fixed asset'-Cause-The error message is caused by the fact that the status of the individual material in the fixed asset is "Assigned".-You can check the same following the steps below:-Go to Fixed Asset work center. -Go to Fixed Assets subview. -Open the advanced search. -Search for Individual material XYZ. -Click View All. -Go to Master Data tab > Individual Material subtab.-Here you can see the individual material XYZ with Assigned status.-Resolution-You have to make a manual posting to add a value to Fixed Asset, this will change status of individual material to acquired and allow the posting to take place. Make a manual acquisition posting with debit and credit of 1.00 CC (Company Currency) which adds up to zero but changes status to acquired.-Open the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets subview, select the asset number ABC (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID) and open it.-Choose Edit > Master Data tab page.-Navigate to the Individual Material subtab page.-Here, you can see that the status of the individual material XYZ > Fixed Asset ABC is Assigned.-To change the status, use Manual Postings > Acquisition.-Post a nominal amount of 1.00 CC on the credit side and in debit (in this way, the amount ultimately remains at 0.00 CC but the status changes to Acquired).-Afterwards it should be possible to post the customer invoice.-Also, is important to check the status of the fixed asset. If the fixed asset has Retired status, so you can't select the Manual Postings button, you have to change the status of the fixed asset first.-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Individual Material; Individual material is not assigned to an active fixed asset; customer invoice; Business transaction; Tasks; ﻿Closing-Relevant Tasks

Title: Purchase Request ID is Blank/not Populated.
Content: Symptom-Purchase requests are not created when purchase proposal is released either manually or via run.-Also Purchase Request ID is blank/not populated.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Control workcenter and  Monitor Purchase Requests view.-2. Filter by Open Purchase Requests.-3. You can see that the Request ID field is blank.-Cause-Summation of Quota Arrangement for Supplier is exceeding 1,00,000 hence there is a dump in the backend and resulting in unprocessed messages.-Resolution-Set a quota arrangement for the product in such a way that summation of quota for all the supplier should not be more than 99,999 in Sourcing and Contracting workcenter and Quota Arrangements  view.-Keywords-Purchase Request, Quota Arrangement, Sourcing and Contract, Supplier

Title: Balance Confirmation not Available for Setting in the Business Document Settings Section of Accounts
Content: Symptom-Requirement: To be able to define the document communication settings for Balance Confirmation document, specific to a particular Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The option to define document settings for Balance Confirmation is not available in the Collaboration tab of Accounts.-However, to suffice your requirement, you could select a particular output channel (in your case e-mail) for Balance Confirmation documents that are addressed from a certain company to a particular customer.-The steps to do so are the following:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Input and Output Management view.-Go to Output Channel Selection subview.-Show the rules for Balance Confirmation.-Here you could add a new output channel and also specify the parameter settings: Company and the Business Partner (Customer).-Also bear in mind to change the sequence of the newly created rule so that it appears first in the list. This can be done be selecting the Change Sequence button and the list can be manipulated with the Move Up/Move Down buttons. This, because the rules work based on sequential priority.-Keywords-balance confirmation; output channel; e-mail; collaboration-balance confirmation,collaboration,document setting,account,settings

Title: Error "Vertex Error: AUTHENTICATION FAILED" When Invoicing a Document
Content: Symptom-When trying to Invoice an Invoice Request, you receive the following errors:- -Vertex Error: AUTHENTICATION FAILED- -Error during calculation of price and tax-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Requests view.-Find Invoice Request ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Highlight the desired Invoice Request.-Click on the Invoice button.- In the New Invoice screen, you see errors 'Error during calculation of price and tax' and 'Vertex Error: AUTHENTICATION FAILED'.-Cause-This error is caused due to an outdated Avalara password.-Resolution-In order to solve this, please update your Avalara password and maintain the new password in the system.- You can read more about how to achieve this in the Blog 'Avalara Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign'.-Keywords-Avalara, Tax, Authentication Failed, Authorization, Password, Invoice, Customer Invoice, Error, Unable, Tax

Title: Sales Notes Maintained in Product Master Data is Missing for an Invoice Item under Customer Information section
Content: Symptom-Sales Notes which is maintained in the product master data is missing for an invoice item under Customer Information section.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Product Data work center.-2. Go to the Services/Material view.-3. In the Show field , from the drop-down select All Materials/All Services.-4. Go to Find field ,enter XYZ (XYZ represents the materials/services number).-5. Select XYZ and click on View All button and go to Sales tab and sub tab Sales Notes.-You can see value is maintained for XYZ.-6. Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-7. Go to the Invoice Documents view.-8. In the Show field from the drop-down select All Invoice Documents.-9. Go to the Find field ,enter  ABC (ABC represents the invoice number).-10. Select invoice id ABC and click on the View All button.-11. Go to Item tab and select item XYZ.-Under section Detail Product in General tab and Sub tab Customer Information , value is not fetched,though it's maintained in Product master data .-Cause-The Customer Information will get fetched for an Invoice item if it is maintained within the Sales Order document, as it's not based on value maintained in the Product master data.-Hence in case of New Manual Invoice it's not getting fetched.-Resolution-In case of Customer Invoice created from the sales order, the Customer Information is visible .-1. Go to the Sales Order work center.-2. From the Common Tasks , create a New Sales Order.-3. Enter all mandatory information related to account and click on View All button.-4. Go to the Items tab and add item XYZ.-5. Go to sub tab Notes and maintained Customer Information(Information can be same/different which is maintained in product master data).-Now you can see these information is available within the Customer Invoice-Item as Customer Information.-See Also-This applies also to the Sales Notes maintained in the Account Master Data which are passed to the Customer Information in the General tab.-Keywords-Customer Information, Product, Material, Invoice, Credit Memo, Manual Invoice, Product Data, Missing, Sales Notes

Title: System Behavior in Relation to the "Yes" and "Yes (standard)" Options in Account Addresses
Content: Symptom-When dealing with account addresses, you notice that in the first record the system automatically sets the address as "Yes" for Ship-To, Bill-To, Remittance Advice To and Dun-To. When adding a new line, the system only allows the option "Yes (standard)" or "No" for these properties.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select New Corporate Account (from the common tasks).-Navigate to the Communication tab.-Enter the Addresses subtab.-Select Add Row button.-Ship-To, Bill-To, Remittance Advice To, Dun-To are all marked as "Yes" and not "Yes (Standard)".-Cause-Currently the UI will have up to three options for the address usages ("No", "Yes" and "Yes (Standard)").-If one or more addresses of an Account is maintained as ship-to/bill-to address, at least one of the ship-to/bill-to addresses of the Account needs to be maintained as default ship-to/bill-to address.-Once that Account is selected as ship-to/bill-to party in a business document (such as a customer invoicing), the following is picked as the document address:-First the system checks, if a default ship-to/bill-to address exists. If it does, the default is selected.-If no default ship-to/bill-to address exists, the main address of the Account is selected.-If user only maintain one address line, this address is marked as the main address and all usage option have the "Yes" option. This address can be used for all usage types.-If user maintain a second address line, the usages will be marked with "No" and you must explicitly set the desired usage to "Yes" or "Yes (Standard)".-When user choose Yes (Standard) for a category (such as Ship-To or Bill-To), that address becomes the default address for that specific purpose. The system automatically proposes the standard address during document creation.-Yes, value can only be set if another address already has the value "Yes (Standard)". -No, means this is not a ship-to/bill-to party address.-Only one address can be used as the main address for an account. Select the Main checkbox beside the appropriate address. -Additionally, in the address value help on the Involved Parties facet, all addresses of the Account will be offered, and all can be selected, irrespective of their ship-to/bill-to party value. Also, the address options Yes/Yes(Standard)/Yes(Automatic)/No are not configurable and cannot be removed.-Resolution- This is the expected System Behavior.-Keywords-communication, business partner

Title: Customer Return Missing for the Inbound Delivery with Item Type CSNG - Product - consignment
Content: Symptom-Customer return not created from the inbound delivery with item type CSNG - Product - consignment-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics - Inbound Deliveries-Edit the Customer Return Delivery XYZ (XYZ represents the Customer Return Delivery ID) -Navigate to Document flow-There is Process Communication Error-Cause-You have used an external reference, it is not possible to create customer return for items of the type CSNG - Product - consignment without a valid sales order reference.-Resolution-You need to use a valid sales order reference to create a customer return for items of the type CSNG - Product - consignment.-Keywords-inbound delivery released; Return not found;

Title: Extension Field Value Not Automatically Cleared Even The Source Document Is Removed
Content: Symptom-You created an extension field XYZ and activated the extension scenario from document A to document B.-When creating a new document B, you see the extension value is successfully picked from document A.-However, when you removing document A from the document B, you see the extension field value is not automatically cleared as you expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Take extension scenario "Purchasing Contract - General Information to Purchase Order - General Information" for example.-In Purchasing Contract, General tab, create an extension field XYZ, activate extension scenario "Purchasing Contract - General Information to Purchase Order - General Information", and add the extension field to Purchase Order, General tab.-Maintain the extension field for purchasing contract ABC-Create a new purchase order, maintain mandatory fields-In purchase order Items tab, Source of Supply subtab, maintain contract ABC, you see the purchase order extension field value is successfully picked from Contract ABC-Remove contract ABC from Source of Supply, leave the contract field as blank, you see the purchase order extension field remains the value from contract ABC-You expect the extension field value should be automatically cleared when contract ABC is removed.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior. It's not only happening for purchasing contract to purchase order, but also other extension scenarios like supplier master data to supplier invoice, etc.-Until a new source document A (contract) be maintained in document B (purchase order), the extension field value will not be refreshed.-Resolution-Please manually clear the extension field value, or maintain a new source document A in document B.-Keywords-Extension Field, Value Not Clear, Value Not Refresh, Extension Scenario
