Title: Font Restrictions and recommendations for Myanmar (Burmese)
Content: Symptom-You want to use Myanmar (Burmese) fonts  in an ABAP based SAP system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Adobe Document Server (ADS) does not support Burmese fonts.-Resolution-Display on a Windows based frontend (SAPGUI or html based fronted) and printing with a Windows based device type (for example SWINCF) are supported only with Windows 10. Note: Do not use 3rd party solutions offering input methods and fonts that are not based on Unicode. Only Unicode texts can be handled in a Unicode SAP system.-The SAP language code MY for Myanmar (Burmese) can only be used in a Unicode system. General information about Unicode-only language keys can be found in SAP note 895560.-Printing of ABAP lists may work only with device type SWINCF (as outlined in SAP note 1866491), but not with other device types including UPE (SAP note 1812076).-Print preview and printing of Sapscript and Smartforms are not supported.-PDF conversion is not supported.-SAP Interactive Forms by Abobe (IFbA) are not supported. -See Also-Note: 895560 - Support for languages only available in Unicode systems-Note: 1866491 - Changes to device type SWINCF-Note: 1812076 - Unicode Printing Enhancement (UPE)-Keywords-Fonts, Burmese, Myanmar, text, Print, preview, printing, Sapscript, Smartforms, PDF conversion, SAP Interactive Forms, Abobe, (IFbA), 3rd party, language code, MY

Title: Deleted Input Product Still Exists in Released Planning/ Execution Model
Content: Symptom-You delete input product XXX in Production Bill of Material (BoM) and re-released the Planning and Execution Model for Corresponding Production Model YYY.-However, you find the deleted input product XXX still exists in the released planning and execution model.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Go to Production Models View.-Search for Production Model YYY.-Choose Edit.-Choose Open Released Planning Model button or Open Released Execution Model button.-Select the Released Planning/ Execution Model Version after re-release.-Go to Products - Input Products Sub-tab.-You note that the deleted input product XXX still exists in the released planning/ execution model.-Cause-During deleting the input product XXX in the BoM, you not only click the delete button, but also uncheck the BoM Variant used in the production model YYY.-Resolution-You need to make sure the BoM Variant is scoped for the deleted input product XXX in the BoM.-Please scope it and release the Planning and Execution Model again.-Keywords-Delete; Input Product; BoM; Production Model; Variant.

Title: Marked for Internal Fulfillment, but Service Performer is External
Content: Symptom-You are submitting a Service Order document and when you perform the action, the system returns a warning message informing that the fulfillment is internal but the performer is external.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Search for the Service Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Order).-Click Submit.-Warning: Marked for internal fulfillment, but Service Performer is external.-Cause-The reason the system is raising this warning message is because the Service Agent relationship to the seller of the document has not been corrected maintained.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To solve this, please perform the following steps:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Select the Service Agents view.-Select the Agent ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Agent assigned to the document).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Relationships tab.-Under Relationship Type select Is Service Performer For.-Under Business Partner add the seller of the service document.-Click Save. -Once this is maintained, the warning message will be removed.-Keywords-Internal, Fulfillment, Service Agent, External, Business Partner, Service Order, Service Confirmation

Title: Cannot Delete Employee via Administer Obsolete Business Partner Removal Runs
Content: Symptom-You want to use the Data Protection tool to removal employees older than 3 months.-You are trying the removal of an Employee which the validity was set than more 3 months ago and you also configured the activity 'Data Retention Rule for Employees' to be 3 months for respective Country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher-SAP Cloud for Customer 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Data Protection and Privacy woc > Common Tasks.-Click Administer Obsolete Business Partner Removal Runs.-Check the Run ID Z02 and check the application log ID 3418 from October 27th.-It will shows the message No Employees found as per selection criteria.-Cause-As Employee status cannot be set to "Obsolete", the "Administer Obsolete Business Partner Removal Runs" wouldn't pick up this type of business partner for deletion.-Resolution-Please select the set of Employees from "Personal Data Removal" and click on "Remove Data".-Keywords-Data Protection and Privacy, Obsolete Business Partner Removal Runs, Removal, Employee, Obsolete.

Title: Error When Using Migration of Discount Lists
Content: Symptom-You are facing error when trying to migrate discount lists in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Discount Lists.-Click Change Immediately.-Click the Migrate discount lists using the migration tool hyperlink.-Execute the discount template. -The system returns the following errors:-Mandatory currency is missing-Item for ABC 123already exists (ABC 123 represents the ID information displayed in the error)-Cause-The reason you are facing this error is because you have not given a different ID for each discount list type, such as 7PL2 and 7PL4.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-As each list type represents a different list, please indicate a unique ID for each type.-Keywords-Migration,  Discount Lists, 7PL2, 7PL4, Mandatory currency is missing, Item for, already exists, Migration, Tool

Title: Emails from Test Tenant to CC and BCC Recipients are not Received
Content: Symptom-You are sending e-mails out from a test tenant. Only the To receiver gets an e-mail, but CC and BCC receiver do not receive any mails.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate i.e. to the Customer Invoice work center.-Invoice document and resubmit any released customer invoice via the output history, after adding a CC and BCC e-mail address.-Only the Main To address receives the mail.-Cause-In the relevant test tenant, the following setup can be found:-Navigate to the work center Business Configuration.-Go to Overview and search for Fax.-Open the Emails and Fax Settings.-Here you chosed: Send all Emails to this e-mail address ...-With this setup the system creates only one e-mail output per document.-Resolution-If you want to test CC and BCC e-mail outputs, please select in the Business configuration: "send all documents to the Business Partner".-Now CC and BCC e-mail outputs will be send and received.-Keywords-Email, CC, BCC, Output, E-Mails, E-Mail

Title: Tax Code is not Being Displayed in the Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-When you create a Down Payment Request you try to add a Tax Code but in the list you cannot see the desirable tax code.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Down Payment Request Common Tasks.-Enter a Supplier and Buying Company.-Enter a product.-See that in the Tax Code field the desired tax is not an option.-Cause-The desired tax code has the Tax Deductibility as Not Deductible and as per standard SAP ByDesign behavior non-deductible and partial deductible tax codes are not allowed in the Down Payment.-Resolution-Change the deductibility of this tax code or select another Tax Code.-In order to check the deductibility of the Tax Code please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Tax on Goods and Services and open it.-Select Define Tax Code.-Find the relevant Tax Code.-Scroll down and see the Details.-Check the column Tax Deductibility.-Keywords-Down Payment, Down Payment Request, Tax Code, Tax Deductibility, Define Tax Code

Title: Unable to Migrate the Launchpad Shortcuts From a Tenant to Another Tenant.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate the Launchpad Shortcuts from a tenant to a different tenant but you are unable to do it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior. Currently you cannot migrate the Shortcuts of an user from a tenant to another.-Keywords-Shortcuts, Migrate, transport, Launchpad.

Title: How to encrypt a string with PDI
Content: Symptom-You would like to encrypt a string with a keyed-hash authentication code via an ABSL script from your SAP Cloud Applications Studio add-on.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign -Cause-You may achieve this encoding or encryption of a string using ABSL, with the use of Hash.EncryptString() reuse library function, from library PlatinumEngineering.-The encoding alrorighitms "AES128", "AES192", "AES256" are supported.-Resolution-Please refer to the below sample code which you can try on your script:-import ABSL;-import AP.PlatinumEngineering;-  var StringToBeEncrypted : XPEString;-StringToBeEncrypted = "test-123";-  var Secretkey : XPEString;-Secretkey = "ExactlyThisLeng!" ; // the secretkey must have exactly this length-var EncryptedString = Hash.EncryptString("AES128",StringToBeEncrypted,Secretkey); // "AES128", "AES192", "AES256" can be used-Please be aware that the functions under PlatinumEngineering are internal functions from SAP so they are not revised by the documentation team yet and they are not released for general uses, hence they cannot be supported via incidents.-See Also-Please refer to the below blog for more details about the library:-https://blogs.sap.com/2017/09/25/sap-platinum-engineering-libraries/-Keywords-PDI, SDK, hash, EncryptString, PlatinumEngineering, reuse, library

Title: Error Message: Inbound delivery XYZ not valid for distribution
Content: Symptom-When creating new supplier invoice, ou are unable to select the inbound delivery when trying to add line items to the allocation document. The system throws an error message:-Inbound delivery XYZ not valid for distribution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing.-Go to view Landed Cost Invoice Items.-Search and open the affected allocation document.-Add the inbound delivery in the inbound delivery field under the item and click on Distribute.-You see the error message: Inbound delivery XYZ not valid for distribution (XYZ refers to Inbound Delivery ID).-Cause-The affected allocation document is unable to process the request with the inbound delivery because the inbound delivery falls into one of the below categories.-The status of the inbound delivery is Cancelled.-The inbound delivery is not a standard supplier inbound delivery but is the delivery about other flows ( viz., customer return, third party order fulfillment, etc.).-Resolution-To proceed with the inbound delivery in the allocation document, the inbound delivery should fall into the below category.-The status of the inbound delivery is Not Cancelled.-The inbound delivery is a standard supplier inbound delivery.-The selection of inbound delivery as per the above-selected classification would no longer give you the error message.-Keywords-Inbound delivery not valid for distribution, Landed Cost Invoice, Inbound Delivery

Title: Pick List Sorting
Content: Symptom-Pick List sorting has not been scoped in Business Configuration, however you still see that Pick list is sorted in Descending Order of Logistics Area.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter and Implementation Projects View.-Select the Project and Edit Project Scope-Go to Questions and find Scoping Element Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics-In Outbound Logistics: Pick List Sorting, the question Do you want to sort your pick list by logistics area in ascending order? is not scoped.-Cause-By default the Pick List Sorting will be in Descending Order of Logistics Area. -If you wish to sort it in Ascending Order then the question mentioned above has to be scoped in Business Configuration.-Note: Pick List sorting criteria is only based on Logistics Area. This is because it will enable the Warehouse users to pick the products in an order that is ideal which helps save time.-Resolution-System is behaving as expected.-Keywords-Pick List sorting, Descening Order, Logistics Area, Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics, Business Confirguation, Scoping

Title: Follow-Up Still Showing on Drop-Down List
Content: Symptom-You have de-scoped questions related to a Follow-Up, however, the follow-up options are still present on the drop-down list.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-You are able to create Follow-Up activities in different ways. We are using a Follow-Up activity from a sales order as an example:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-In the Show drop-down list, select All Orders.-Press the Go button.-Click the Follow-Up button and then select any of the following-up activities such as Appointments, E-Mail, Letter, Fax or Phone Call.-The following error messages occur:-"Process type not determined for type code."-"Error in bus. configuration for party determination; report an incident."-Cause-The reason why these messages are showing is because the respective Follow-Up activity has been de-selected from your scoping under the Questions phase.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-When an option is de-scoped, it is not hidden from the options list. If there are activities which have been de-scoped in the system, an error message is raised for the respective users when they try to create such activities.-To scope the option back to the system, perform the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select your implementation project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Expand Sales > Account and Activity Management and then select Activity Management.-On the right side you can check which follow-up activities can be selected in your scope.-For example:-Do you use letters to communicate with your accounts?-Do you fax as a means of communicating with your accounts?--Please Note: We are currently are not hiding the options for activities that are not in scope in the drop down list of the Follow-Up button. -Keywords-Show; Follow-Up; Scope; Sales Order Follow-Up; Fax; E-mail; Letter;

Title: Upload of Report Fails: Data Type of Data Source Field Is Not Available
Content: Symptom-In your test system (source system), you have created a report or data source which in turn uses a PDI data source. Then you download it via the Analytics key user tools. When you try to upload it in the production (target) system, you get numerous errors like these:-'Data type of data source field XYZ is not available'-In Cloud for Customer, you will see these errors in Transport Management.-Disclaimer: "Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental"-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example steps in Business ByDesign:-Go to the source system.-Go to the Common Tasks in the Business Analytics work center.-Select Download.-Download the report or data source which you have created.-Go to the target system -> Common Tasks in the Business Analytics work center.-Select Upload.-Upload the file you have previously downloaded and click on Save.-You will receive the mentioned errors.-Cause-In your source tenant, you created the data source / report which is based on a PDI data source with a different namespace to the one from the target tenant. So the solution namespaces of the data sources are not in synch in the source and target system - The source tenant has the data source with the patch solution namespace and the target tenant has the data source with the original solution namespace. This is the reason for the error messages.-To illustrate this on an example:-Note: The terms Y123_, Y456_, Y456_ABC are dummy-Source System Target System-Original Solution Y123_-Patch: Y456_-This patch contains a data source, e.g. Y456_ABC- Deployment of Original Solution: Y123_-Deployment of Patch: Y123_ (new version)-The data source will be called Y123_ABC- Create a custom report / data source that is using Y456_ABC-   Download this report data source. The XML now contains references to Y456_-   Upload this file in the target-The system does not recognize references to Y456 since this solution ID does not exist in the target.-Hence you get an error with reference to Y456_.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour - an upload is only possible if the target system also contains the same solution with the same namespace.-However, you can apply a workaround: Please ensure that in the test system, both the patch as well as the original solution have the same version. This will mean that they both have the same content. Then, when you go to the system and create your Z data source / report, you can select the object with the original namespace. This new object can then be downloaded and uploaded to the target system - this will be successful since the namespace is the same.-See Also-For more details on namespaces and PDI solution lifecycle management, please see the following blog.-The section "PHASE 4: Life-cycle for patching and bug fixing" describes how to ensure the same namespace is used in both systems.-Keywords-Name Space, namespace, PDI, upload, extension fields, common tasks, Report, AP-RC-ANA, Solution, Data source, transport management-upload error,report upload

Title: Key Figure Result Wrong With Hierarchy in Report
Content: Symptom-You have created a key figure and you are using it in a report view which contains a hierarchy (characteristic or hierarchy). You notice that the result row of the key figure does not show the correct value.-You may also notice that it works correctly when you switch off the hierarchy.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Cause-This happens due to different types of aggregations in the report result row vs the hierarchy.-Resolution-Ideally, result rows should not be used with a hierarchy. However if this is required, you can test the following workaround:-Edit your key figure.-Go to step 3.-Remove the result setting (e.g. Total, Average etc).-Maintain it in the exception aggregation instead. So for example, maintain Total, if the key figure is supposed to show a sum.-Choose a characteristic for the exception aggregation. This should be at the most granular level of the report. For example, if it is an opportunity report and it includes opportunity items, you should choose the Opportunity Item. If your report is on header level only, you can choose the Opportunity.-Keywords-business analytics, custom key figure, result line, result row, wrong total, wrong summation, report

Title: You Expect that Avalara Tax on Freight Charges Should be Only On Net Value
Content: Symptom-Avalara has been set up to determine the Tax for the Sales Order into the system. However, Avalara calculates the Tax on the Net Value and Freight value, whereas you expect it should calculate only on the Net Value.-You reached out to the Avalara, they provided below feedback:-"SAP is not able to pass the <TaxCode/> code at the line level, hence Avalara can not filter the Tax calculation" , I have also attached the Request data the we have received from the Avalara.-<Lines>-<Line>-<TaxCode/>-</Line>-</Lines>-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When we use Avalara we send the price lines , freight lines along with orgin , destination codes only. We do not send a tax code along with it.-This might be an issue with the freight tax code mapping in your Avalara configurations.-The payloads of request and response from our internal systems using Avalara to not include freight for the state CA. Checking them its clear we do not need tax code in the request payload. It might be more to do with the configurations.-Resolution-The configurations in Avalara are not done by us and we only work with the external payload returned to us by Avalara. Please reach out to Avalara on how this should be done.-Keywords-Avalara, Tax, Calculation

Title: Extension Field on Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is Not Carried to the Invoice Item
Content: Symptom-You have enabled the extension scenario from invoice request general to customer invoice item. But when invoicing the outbound delivery invoice request, the extension field filled in the outbound delivery invoice request is not carried to the customer invoice item level. It however works for manual invoice request.-Reproducing the Issue-You have enabled the following extension scenarios for your extension field.-Invoice Requests - General Information to Customer Invoice - General Information-Invoice Requests – General Information to Customer Invoice – Item-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Find the outbound delivery invoice request and ensure that the extension field is filled.-Click Invoice and save the invoice, the extension field is copied to the invoice general but it is missing in the invoice item level. So the extension scenario: Invoice Requests – General Information to Customer Invoice – Item does not work.-Cause-For the extension scenario, Invoice Request General information to Customer Invoice Item to work, you will need to have the extension scenario Sales Order General Information to Invoice Request General Information active. Then on the Sales Order gerneral information screen, the extension field will be filled out. This field will be available on the item level of the Customer Invoice through the use of the extenstion scenario mentioned.-Since the manual invoice request has no preceeding document like sales order, the extension field on the manual invoice request could be taken ino the customer invoice item level.-Resolution-You need to enable the extension scenario: Sales Order General Information to Invoice Request General Information.

Title: Unexpected Failure in SOAP Processing Occurred: No Web Service Configuration for This Access Path
Content: Symptom-You observe the following error message, or similar, while testing your custom created web service in SOAP UI:-Unexpected failure in SOAP processing occurred: "No Web service configuration for this access path: /sap/bc/srt/scs/sap/ABC (ABC relates to the service URL configured for Inbound/Outbound Communication)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-In C4C navigate to the Administrator WoC.-Open the Communication Arrangement View-Select the relevant Communication Arrangement.-Click on the web service in question.-Click on Download WSDL button.-Open SOAP UI.-Click File and choose New SOAP Project.-Input the initial WSDL which you have downloaded in step 5.-Configure Authentication tab, use basic authentication, enter user ID and Password for technical user present on your C4C system. This user must have needed privileges to alter the BO in question.-Open WS-A tab and flag checkbox for "Enable WS-A addressing" as well as checkbox for "Randomly generate MessageId".-Open WS-RM and flag the checkbox "Enable WS-Reliable Messaging, also change WS-RM Version to 1.1.-Insert Payload into the request you have configured.-Click send.-If the message has been successfully sent to C4C the response XML will be blank if you have an asynchronous web service.-In this case however you observe the following error message in the Raw tab of SOAP UI:-No Web service configuration for this access path: /sap/bc/srt/scs/sap/ABC-Cause-This issue may occur after the deployment of the solution as the communication arrangement and the communication scenarios may not be in sync anymore.-Resolution-Communication arrangement has been created in the UI but all corresponding communication scenarios have been created/altered in the SDK. To synchronize both scenarios, the corresponding communication arrangement needs to be reactivated in the UI. This can be performed following these steps:-Navigate to the Administration WoC.-Under General Settings choose Integration, and Communication arrangement.-Highlight Communication Arrangement in question and hit Reactivate button.-Perform this action after each deployment to avoid these issues.-Keywords-No Web service configuration for this access path: /sap/bc/srt/scs/sap, SOAP UI, Custom web service, Inbound Service Interface

Title: Is it possible to report on the Master Data Change History?
Content: Symptom-You want to report on the master data changes history, for example on Customer and Supplier Master data, however such information is not available via any data sources and reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this case, from the Audit work center, Payables view, Suppliers sub view then View All and Changes you can see changes history for a specific supplier. You want to have a report which shows the changes history for all the available Suppliers, Customer etc.-Cause-Missing functionality.-Resolution-Currently such a report considering the Change History only exist to view Business User changes, for example for work center view assignment, restrictions, etc., but such reports do not exist for other master data objects like Customer and Supplier.-Keywords-change history, report, business analytics, data source, customer, supplier, employee; missing

Title: Error: Depreciation method ABC still used in fixed asset DEF at company GHI
Content: Symptom-You are getting the error: "Depreciation method ABC still used in fixed asset DEF at company GHI", when trying to update the change project system in the test system using the option Update Project from Production.-ABC means the Depreciation Method.-DEF means the fixed asset.-GHI means the Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center and select Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant change project and then choose Actions.-In the Actions, Choose Update Project from Production.-You will get the error "Depreciation method ABC still used in fixed asset DEF at company GHI".-Cause-The merge is prevented by a veto check which is based on a changed depreciation method. Once a Depreciation Method is used in a fixed asset, it cannot be changed any more.-The veto check will raise an error even if you have changed any flag under the tab Calculated Parameters.-Resolution-Revert the changes which you have done in Depreciation Method and then try to merge the Project.-If all the parameters of Depreciation method in test tenant match with the Production system, then the merge will be successful.-Keywords-Change Project, Merge, Depreciation method

Title: How to Enable "Customer Contracts - Managed Service Consumption Integration" in SAP Business ByDesign?
Content: Symptom-This KBA will help you to figure out the ExternalServicePerformingAndChargingSystemRequestServiceConfirmationMaintenanceIn service in Service Explorer view under Application User and Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The web service ExternalServicePerformingAndChargingSystemRequestServiceConfirmationMaintenanceIn is an asynchronous web service released for the pre-packaged application to application scenario "Customer Contracts - Managed Service Consumption Integration" only.-To enable the communication scenario "Customer Contracts - Managed Service Consumption Integration", you have to request to install the ByD Add-on "Add-on Managed Service Consumption Integration for Customer Contracts" and answer the business configuration question "Do you want to receive service confirmations electronically from an external system over electronic data exchange?" with Yes.-Please scope the question by following below steps:-Login to your system-Go to Business Configuration work center-Edit Implementation Project-Navigate to the Questions tab-Navigate Service -> Service and Repair -> Communication for Service and Repair -> Scope the question "Do you want to receive service confirmations electronically from an external system over electronic data exchange?" as shown in the attached screenshot.-Save the changes -  If this is done, you can create a communication arrangement for scenario "Customer Contracts - Managed Service Consumption Integration", To create the communication arrangement please follow the below steps:-Go to Application User and Management work center-Go to Communication Arrangements-Click on New-Select "Customer Contracts - Managed Service Consumption Integration" as shown in the screenshot.-Interface documentation, access URL and WSDL are available in the communication arrangement as soon as created.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 Integration Scenarios-Customer Contracts - Managed Service Consumption Integration-Inbound Service ExternalServicePerformingAndChargingSystemRequestServiceConfirmationMaintenanceIn-Community Answer-Keywords-Customer Contracts, Service Consumption Integration, Communication Arrangements, Integration Scenario's.

Title: SAP Business ByDesign Next-Generation Cloud Delivery FAQs
Content: Symptom-List of questions and answers for SAP Business ByDesign Next-Generation Cloud Delivery-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign Next-Generation Cloud Delivery-Resolution-Q:  What is a customer supposed to do regarding the migration? Is the entire migration implemented by SAP?-Basically, all is handled by SAP but customers need to pay attention to the following points:-IP address change: IP addresses will change, and customers need to check their network configurations (for example, firewall setting, IP Blocking). New IP addresses will be communicated in the 14-day customer communication.-Certificates: Certificate information will be sent out with the 14-day customer communication. For standard system access via browser no action is required. For integration scenarios a certificate update will be required to seamlessly access your system. A blog post with detailed instructions can be found here.-Transition timelines: Productive tenant transitions are taking place within the Maintenance Windows described in your SLA. Test tenants will be transitioned during the week (outside of working hours as much as possible as it will require a system downtime), and we have tried to account for other events (e.g., quarterly system upgrades schedules) to make the transition process as efficient as possible.-  Q:  Where can customers check the planned migration date?-Customer will find that information in SAP for Me (me.sap.com). After accessing SAP for Me, customers need to select the Customer Dashboard option on the left side and choose the Systems & Provisioning dashboard and click on the Cloud Delivery tab.-  Q:  How will customers be notified?-SAP will communicate and engage with all customers in the transition process via e-mail and SAP4ME. Notifications will be sent directly to all affected customers as further described below. E-mails are sent from “sapcloudsupport@alerts.ondemand.com” and the subject line of these e-mails will always start with “Next-Generation Cloud Delivery ...”.-   Q:  Who will receive the notifications?-To receive notifications about the Next-Generation Cloud Delivery Program, customers need to be subscribed in Cloud System Notification Subscriptions (CSNS) to get SAP Business ByDesign notifications. -The currently maintained customer recipients are also listed in the monthly Customer Information Reports to allow customers to check if the correct recipients are maintained. It can be found in the “General Data” section à “Your current CSNS contacts”.-Check out the User Guide to learn how to subscribe yourself and others to notifications and how to change or delete subscriptions.-Q:  Will the migration to SAP Converged Cloud affect the function of the solution, the interface integration function, or the standard process of the system?-The functionality of the solution itself won’t be impacted. Also all standard processes and the interface integration function will work as before. If there is an integration using a hardcoded IP address this needs to be adjusted to the new IP address. Please also see comments regarding IP address change and certificates, above.-  Q:  Will the URL be changed?-No, the URL will stay the same for existing tenants.-  Q:  Will the IP address be changed?-Inbound/Outbound IPs will change; more details will be included in 14-day customer communication. -  Q:  Is it possible to conduct a connectivity test in advance?-The system itself will only be transitioned at the planned date, so upfront integration tests can't be done. As the test tenants get migrated before the productive tenants this will allow testing in the test environment.-  Q:  What needs to be done regarding certificates? And when?-Certificate information will be sent out with the 14-day customer communication. For standard system access via browser no action is required. For integration scenarios a certificate update will be required to seamlessly access your system. A blog post with detailed instructions can be found here.-  Q:  When will the migration of the systems happen?-Only test systems will be migrated during weekdays. This will also happen during the non-business hours as far as possible. Production systems are planned to be migrated during the  Maintenance Window described in your SLA. The migration will require a downtime of the production system, which will take place during the Maintenance Window.-  Q:  Is it possible to choose the target data center location (the country where the data center is located)?-No, it is not possible to choose the target data center. However, the new data center will be in the same country (sometimes the same location) as the previous data center.-Q: Will all tenants after the migration change its URL from myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com to myxxxxxx.businessbydesign.cloud.sap ? --Yes, but for existing tenants Old URL is mapped to new URL and hence Old URL continues to work.--Q: Will  new tenants only have the new URL as converged cloud myxxxxxx.businessbydesign.cloud.sap?-- Yes--Q: If customer has tenants live as myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com and request a new tenant and it comes as myxxxxxx.businessbydesign.cloud.sap may it affect integration or refresh scenario?--When a customer requests a new tenant , they receive it as myxxxyyy.businessbydesign.cloud.sap , so whatever changes they would have required to do with older domain would be needed and nothing extra.-Q: Is there any action required from customer regarding URLs? --No action is required from the customer regarding URLs

Title: How is the Language of the Sender Country Determined
Content: Symptom-If the sender country and the receiver country differ, the system will always print the address in the language of the sending country since the postal service which needs to deliver the letter needs to be able to read the country name.-How is the language of the sender country determined for countries that have multiple languages as for example Belgium or Switzerland.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The language of all countries is maintained in the Business Configuration in the fine tuning activity Countries/Regions as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your respective implementation project.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune tab.-Select the fine tuning activity Countries/Regions.-Click on the Add to Project button.-Open the fine tuning activity Countries/Regions.-Click on the Edit Countries/Regions hyperlink.-Click on the Filter symbol and enter desired country (in our example BE for Belgium) and press Enter.-Select the General Attributes tab.-In the Language field you can see which language will be used for the country e.g. FR – French--Hence, if your seller country is located in Belgium and the recipient is located in a different country the country in the postal address will be displayed in French.-See Also-2059150 - Recipient's Country Name is Not Written in Recipient's Native Language-Keywords-Country, Language, Form Template

Title: Fixed Asset Depreciation Amount Calculation for Partial Transfer and Complete Transfer of Individual Material
Content: Symptom-You are comparing the depreciation amounts for two receiving Fixed Assets, one received values via the partial transfer and one via a complete transfer posting.-Both Fixed Assets use the same Depreciation method, calculated on a daily base. -For both transfers, you expect the depreciation amount to be calculated the same way in Accounting Period AAA.-AAA means the accounting period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Show All Fixed Assets and Find ABC (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID), press Go.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC and click Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material.-Enter the required parameters, Posting Date as current month end day, and click Post.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC in view Fixed Assets and click Edit Values.-View Depreciation Overview subtab and check for the Depreciation amount.--For Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material:-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Show All Fixed Assets and Find ABC (ABC represents the Fixed Asset ID), press Go.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC and click Manual Posting - Complete Transfer of Individual Material.-Enter the required parameters, Posting Date as current month end day, and click Post.-Select Fixed Asset ID ABC in view Fixed Assets and click Edit Values.-View Depreciation Overview subtab and check for the Depreciation amount.-Both depreciation amounts for period AAA are different.-Cause-Below is the system logic on how the depreciation is calculated in the case of Partial Transfer and Complete Transfer.-The depreciation calculation for partial transfer transaction is treated just like acquisition postings unlike the complete transfer posting. For acquisition postings happening in the same fiscal year as the capitalization fiscal year, the depreciation is always calculated from the depreciation start date.-For any other type of transaction, the depreciation is calculated only as per the period control configuration corresponding to the type of transaction and the posting date of the transaction. For the complete transfer, as it's a daily depreciation based depreciation method, the depreciation is calculated from the date of posting of the complete transfer and not from the depreciation start date.-Resolution-Hence, system behavior is as designed.-For acquisition postings (including partial transfer) in the first year of capitalization, the depreciation is always calculated from the depreciation start date. For other cases, the depreciation is calculated only from the date of posting of the transaction.-Keywords-Depreciation calculation; Partial transfer; Complete transfer; Daily depreciation; Fixed Asset; Individual Material

Title: Incoming Check Cannot be Released Due to Error Message: Credit payment balance not yet assigned to accounts
Content: Symptom-You cannot release an incoming check, the system gives an error message: Credit payment balance not yet assigned to accounts; Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select New Incoming Check under Common Tasks.-Enter the necessary information such as Company, Payer and Check Number.-Enter the Payment Amount XXX (XXX means the Payment Amount).-Choose Release.-   The system gives you an error message: Credit payment balance of XXX not yet assigned to accounts.-Cause-The reason why you get this error message is that you do not choose the Assign Payment On Account button before releasing the incoming check.-Resolution-In order to fix the issue, follow the steps below:-In the Open Items table, click the Assign Payment on Account button.-In the Customer/Supplier ID field, select the customer.-Set the Account Type as Receivable.-Enter the Payment Amount.-Specify Credit or Debit, if you don't specify it, the system classifies based on the plus/minus sign of the payment amount. -Choose OK, and then Release.-In this way, the amount is assigned on account, and the incoming check should be released and set to Ready for Deposit. Meanwhile, the payment should be showing up in the Trade Receivables account of the customer.-Keywords-assign payment on account

Title: How to Integrate By-Product into Final Inspection - Production
Content: Symptom-There are some by-products during production process, and you wonder is it possible to check the quality of by-products and then receive those qualified into warehouse, like what we do for output product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-ByDesign only supports Final Inspection - Production against the one output product in production model and doesn't support the same process against by-product.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Nevertheless, you can add by-product into make/check task and confirm its quantity without checking its quality as below:-In production model, under tab Bill of Operations - Product Assignment, the button Assign By-Product is enabled for Produce Activity, but disabled for Quality Check Activity.-If the by-product is assigned to Produce Activity in production model, in corresponding make task confirming screen, the by-product will display under tab Confirmation - Output Products, its confirmed quantity will be received directly into warehouse. If you click Add Row, the confirmed quantity of new product will be received into warehouse, with Product Type as "By-Product" (you can confirm this through checking the corresponding production confirmation).-In check task confirming screen, under tab Confirmation - Output Products, you can click Add Row, the confirmed quantity of new product will be received into warehouse, with Product Type as "By-Product" (you can confirm this through checking the corresponding production confirmation).-See Also-Help Document Integration of Quality Assurance and Production-Keywords-Inspection, By-Product, Production, Check Task

Title: How to Check Involved Parties Determination from Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You would like to see the Simulation of Involved Parties Determination from Backend for Sales documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Log in to Backend /NSTFK.-Go to SE38.-Enter Program /PAPR/TOOL and click Execute (F8).-Click Party Determination under Party Processing.-Under Scheme of Document Enter the sales document.-For example we are selecting SRVO Service Header for Service order document.-Select Party Role which you need to see the determination, for example: 1001 - Account.-For Party ID field maintain the Account ID.-System will display the Simulation of Parties Determination with steps executed and waiting for inputs.-See Also-KBA 3262684 - Service Performer - Service is not Determined in the Service Quote / Service Order-Keywords-Simulation of Party Determination; Party Determination is sales;

Title: Inbound Delivery Notification is Created in Inbound Logistics Workcenter for 3PL Stock Transfer Order
Content: Symptom-In case of 3PL Stock Transfer Order(STO) , Inbound Delivery Notification IDN1(where IDN1 is the Inbound Delivery Notification ID) is created in Inbound Logistics workcenter  instead of Third Party Logistics workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Third-Party Logistics workcenter and Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-2. Find   Inbound Delivery Notification IDN1-You will not find the document.-Cause-Ship-to Location tag was maintained in the payload but location id was missing in the tag.-It is this id that is checked to see if the location is an externally managed.-Since there was no ID system expects it not to be externally managed and not 3PL.-Resolution-Do not add any ship-to location tag in payload, it is determined automatically and IDN is created in 3PL Logistics - Inbound delivery notifications as expected.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, ship-to location, tag, Inbound Delivery Notification, 3PL Logistics,Third-Party Logistics

Title: Copying Item 10 Not Possible; Configuration From Product - Delivery-Based to Product - Delivery-Based Missing
Content: Symptom-You are creating a follow-up Service Quote from a Return and when the Service Quote window opens, you face a warning message and the item is not copied over.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Return).-Click Follow-Up button.-Select Service Quote.-New window shows warning:-"Copying item 10 not possible; configuration from Product - delivery-based to Product - delivery-based missing-Cause-The follow-up from a Return to a Service Quote was only designed to copy the data from the Header level and not from the Item level.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-For such scenarios, you can add the service item manually to the Service Quote.-Keywords-Return, Customer Return, Service Quote, Service, Quote, Copying item 10 not possible; configuration from Product - delivery-based to Product - delivery-based missing

Title: How to Release Service Confirmation via PDI
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to release a Service Confirmation using PDI (Partner Development Infrastructure) logic.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To release a Service Confirmation using a custom add-on/logic, please use the FinishFulfilmentProcessing action under the Items for all of the items within the Service Confirmation document.-Please check the item fulfillment status before calling this action as it should not be called for status Finished (3) and Not Relevant (4).-Keywords-Service Confirmation, FinishFulfilmentProcessing, PDI, Release, Add-On, Logic, Without Order Completion, With Order Completion

Title: Guidelines for Business ByDesign Company Logo
Content: Symptom-When uploading a company logo in an SAP Business ByDesign tenant, there are no specific guidelines regarding the supported image size and dimensions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to SAP Business ByDesign as a Key User.-Navigate to Home Work Center.-Open My Launchpad View.-Select the profile picture.-Choose Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Right-click the home page background.-Select Change Company Logo.-A file selector window opens without displaying specific guidelines for the supported image size or dimensions.-Resolution-Below are the guidelines for SAP Business ByDesign company logo:-The image must be less than 1MB in size.-Images larger than 60px in height will be resized. Height will be resized to 60px, width will be resized proportionally.-Images smaller than or equal to 60px in height will not be resized.-Recommended image height is 48px.-Recommended image width is less than 300px.-See Also-KBA 2551387 - How To Add a Company Logo In SAP Business ByDesign HTML5-Keywords-Company, Logo, Adaptation mode, Guidelines, Key user, Size, Dimension, Company logo

Title: Account Assignment Details not Appearing in Supplier Invoice( Goods receipt exist)
Content: Symptom-Account Assignment details that are Cost Center and GL Account are empty under the Cost distribution tab of the Supplier invoice, where the Supplier invoice is either in status  In approval or Ready for posting.- or-You have created a purchase order ABC with account assignment cost center. However up on creating the supplier invoice for the purchase order, system failed to update the Account Assignment details in the cost distribution tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to invoice entry view-Show All orders to be invoiced-Select the relevant order and click on New invoice button-In case there are more than 100 GSA's / a single GSA with many individual materials you will see that a dialog box pops up-If you choose deliveries more than 100 / a single GSA with more than 100 individual materials, then you will have only one option to click on New Invoice with Delayed Verification-Cause-Currently for supplier invoice the base document is Purchase Order and the Account account information flows from Purchase order to GSR and then  from GSR to Invoice, when you have scoped the functionality Delayed Verification in Progress in the scoping.-Since invoice is created in the delayed verification mode ,the cost distribution details shows that the invoice item is referring to the Purchase Order directly instead of the Goods and Services Receipt.-However the assignment of GSA references and Account assignment details happens only during the posting of Invoice.-This was mainly done to avoid time system takes for assignment of GSA references and Account assignment in case of huge number of GSA’s, hence the Reference will appear as Purchase order and no Account Assignment details appear in cost distribution tab of invoice.-Resolution-This is expected  and current system behavior.-However, as a workaround you may follow below steps to avoid this situation.-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to invoice entry view-Show "All deliveries to be invoiced"-Then select all goods receipts and click on New invoice button-Also, if you still think that based on Purchase orders appearing in reference item column (when you use the delayed verification under Cost-distribution sub tab in Invoice) the Account assignment details has to be Pulled, Kindly put this in ideas forum mentioning the business use  case so that-based on the votes received our developers can consider for developing it in future releases.-Submit an idea via the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum:-https://ideas.sap.com/SAPByDesign- or-If you want account details to be populated under cost distribution during invoice creation, then uncheck the Delayed Verification checkbox in the scoping. Steps to be followed to uncheck this functionality is mentioned below;-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to Questions and select the scoping element Purchasing.-Select Supplier Invoicing and Supplier invoice and credit memos.-Select the question; Do you want to use delayed verification as supplier invoice entry capability? Set as No-Finish the scoping.-See Also- 3221176 - Account Assignment Data Missing Exception For Supplier Invoice-3071353 - G/L account missing in the account assignment tab of Supplier invoice or Goods and service receipt -Keywords-Account; Supplier Invoice; Exception; Data Missing;GL account; Account assignment missing;cost distribution details missing

Title: Substitute is unable to view Shopping Carts
Content: Symptom-The substitute of a user is not able to view the shopping carts of the relevant user for whom he is the substitute.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Work Center.-Choose  Self-Services view.-Choose Self-Services Overview-Choose Track My Shopping Carts here the substitute will not be able to see the Shopping Carts.-Cause-Shopping cart is user specific and substitute is not allowed to view the shopping carts of other user whom he/she is substitute of. So only the creators of the shopping carts can view the shopping carts.-Resolution-Creator of shopping carts can follow below steps before going on leave or leaving organisation- Go to Application and User Management work center- Go to Shopping Cart Management View- Select  the shopping cart - Click on  button 'Assign to'-See Also-2856475 - The approval task does not show up in the substitute's approval list-Keywords-Unable to access shopping carts

Title: Error Message "Number range interval 01 does not exist" While Creating New Service Agent
Content: Symptom-When you create a Service Agent, system throws below error messages:-Number range interval 01 does not exist-Save Failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. Select Implementation Project view and open activity Define Administrators for Project Team.-3. Select create new Service agent option.-Cause-There is a problem with the number range for business partners. When creating service agents you also create a business partner. And for that you need a working internal number range for the business partner.-For some reason, this number range might be missing in the system.-One of the reason is error is due to the overlap between the available number range rows.-The number ranges are separated, often by source (internal and external), so that the system knows from which "pool" of number ranges to draw a new ID when a new record is created based on the source. If these number ranges overlapped, the system could draw IDs from an incorrect number range pool and this would generate inconsistencies — as such, system does not allow saving a configuration in which number ranges overlap.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Look for the activity General Business Partners -Select Define number ranges for Business Partners.--There perform a change for the Internal number range, which might be ranging from 0001000000 to 0099999999. Then save. With this the change be deployed and then the missing number range should be available.-Please define number ranges that do not overlap between categories. For example, if you are defining the internal number range as 0001 to 9999, the external number range should be 10000 to XXXXX (where XXXXX represent any end number higher than 10000).-If you can see no overlap, than the issue might be caused by alphanumeric values in the interval of a manual number range, which can cause effects that are not obvious at first sight. Check the "See Also" section for more information.-Then you should be able to create service agents.-See Also-Number Ranges and Number Assignment, at SAP Community wiki.-1468023 - Error Message "Interval with Start Number XXX and End Number YYY Must Not Overlap"-1845471 - The Following Number Range Error Message is Triggered 'Interval with start number XXX and end number YYY must not overlap'-Keywords-Number range overlap,Number range interval

Title: Purchase Order in Goods and Services Receipts Instead Third-Party Fulfillment
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order XXX is not showing in Third-Party Fulfillment work center.-XXX = Purchase Order ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Go to the Third-Party Purchase Orders view.-Search for XXX.-See No Records Found.-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders to Be Delivered view.-Search for XXX.-The Purchase Order is found here.-Cause-Purchase Order XXX was created manually with item type Third-Party. Whenever a Third-Party Purchase Order is created with no Sales Order reference, the system will take it as a Non-Stock Product, hence it will appear in Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Resolution-Since the Purchase Order has no Sales Order reference, the system is working as expected.-Keywords-SO, 3PL, PO

Title: Automatic Release of Production Proposal And Creation of Production Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating Production Proposal and when you click Save, the System is Automatically Releasing the Proposal and Creating Production Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find and select the relevant Product ID.-Click Open to open the Product Planning Details.-Click Run Planning and select "Multi BoM Level".-Click OK.-You can see that after the Planning Run has been executed that the Production Proposals have been created.-Click Save.-You can see that the system has released the Proposals automatically released and the Production Requests have the Status: Production Order Creation Started.-Cause-You have scoped Production Order Creation Strategy in your Business Configuration and selected the Default Production Order Creation Strategy: A010 - Automatic creation of production order.-Resolution-This is not a bug as the system is working as designed. If you do not wish for the Production Order Creation to automatically start, please change your Default Production Order Creation Strategy to: B010 - Manual creation of production order.-You can change the settings by following the steps below:-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center. -Go to the Implementation Projects view. -Find and select the relevant Implementation Project.-Click Open Activity List and Show All Activities.-Find and select Production Order Creation Strategy.-Click Open.-Click Set the default production order creation strategy.-You can see that the currently selected Code is: A010 - Automatic creation of production order.-Please change the code to: B010 - Manual creation of production order per your requirement.-Save your changes.-Keywords-Production Order Creation Started, B010 - Manual creation of production order, A010 - Automatic creation of production order, Production Order Creation Strategy, Automatic Release, Production Proposal-Default Production Order Creation Strategy-

Title: Purchase Request Not Created Out of Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-You are using external as the fulfillment in a Customer Contract and you expect that a Purchase Request be created from the Customer Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Create a new contract.-Enter the expected data.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Enter product/service ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product/service).-Under Execution, chance the Fulfillment to External.-Release the document.-Since the fulfillment is external, you expect a Purchase Request tobe created automaitally. But it does not.-Cause-Purchase request will not created from contract.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-You can create a follow-up document, such as a Sales Order or Service Order, the external fulfillment will come automatically and from these documents will the Purchase Request (intercompany process) be created.-See Also-2852086 - Third Party Inter Company Scenario-Keywords-Intercompany, Customer Contract, Sales Order, Service Order, Purchase Request, Not, Created, Process

Title: Initiation of Lease Posting Run Message: 'As per data selection, there is nothing to process for initiation run'
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Lease Posting Run with control parameter as Initiation. You have a valid lease contract, but the run returns the following message: 'As per data selection, there is nothing to process for initiation run'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Posting Run.-Select the relevant lease run for Initiation.-View the log details. -Go to Messages tab.-The following Information message is displayed 'As per data selection, there is nothing to process for initiation run'. No opening postings are made for your contract.-Cause-The relevance of the lease object for the set of books in the lease contract is defined as an Expense. Therefore, since this is defined as an expense, no initiation postings are generated.-You can check the relevance type of the lease object and set of books as follows:-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Contract view.-Open the relevant lease contract.-Go to Lease Object tab.-Go to Set of Books Relevance tab.-For each set of books assigned, refer to the Relevance column.-Resolution-The Initiation run is relevant for the set of books with relevance as Finance Lease.-The relevance being set as expense means that all lease payments are posted to expense accounts and can be displayed in the Clearing section.-Therefore, if the relevance as Expense is correctly defined, you need to create a new lease posting run with control parameter as clearing. This can be done as follows:-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Posting Run.-Create a new lease run with all relevant parameters.-Define the Control Parameter as Clearing.-Execute the run.-After that, you see the corresponding postings in the Clearing section of the run.-Keywords-IFRS16. Lease Contract.

Title: Fast Entry in Sales Order not Working with Tab Button
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Sales Order using Fast Entry and when you are trying to move between columns using the Tab button, the system is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Click New Sales Order from the Common Tasks.-Enter account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Click Fast Entry.-Adjust the table and add the Quantity column next to the Product ID column.-Type Product ID: XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the product).-Click the "Tab" button to go to the next column.-Enter quantity 1.-Go to the next line.-Type Product ID: XYZ.-Click the "Tab" button to go to the next column.-Go to the Next line.-Repeat this several times.-It's possible to notice that for some lines you have to click 3 times on the tab button until it goes to the next column and for other lines, clicking once or twice is sufficient.-Cause-We have observed the following behavior:-Clicking Tab 1x --In this case you hit tab even before system starts to load value help, system simply navigates to quantity column with 1 tab.-Clicking Tab 2x --Enter product ID and hit Tab first selects data from value help (after data is loaded) and the second tab navigates to quantity column.-Clicking Tab 3x --In case you hit Tab while value help loads, system still expects 2 tabs - first for selecting data from value help and the second for navigating to quantity column.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Fast Entry, Sales Order, Tab, button, Clicking, Click, Function

Title: Report Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail Shows Wrong Value in Balance Company Currency
Content: Symptom-You are viewing the report Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail to check the balance. You have set up the view as required, for example with the characteristics G/L account, Supplier, Accounting Period / Year,... You can see that the key figure Balance Company Currency is showing the wrong amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report Accounts Payable - Balance Audit Trail from the assigned work center.-Change the view as required.-Check the Balance Company Currency.-You will see that the amount is incorrect.-Cause-This report has a particular use case and needs a specific layout to show the correct balance. This means that you will have to use the characteristics Source of Data and Posting Date in the rows.-Generally, the key figure Balance Company Currency is calculated based on the following formula:-Opening Balance + Debit Amount - Credit Amount-Resolution-Please pull the characteristics Source of Data and Posting Date into the rows in order to check the balance. Source of Data is invisible in the report but it is required for technical purposes.-Please note, if you do not want to use these characteristics and require a layout that shows the data grouped by e.g. the Accounting Period / Year, you can use the report Accounts Payable - Trial Balance instead.-Keywords-Balance Audit Trial. Business Analytics.

Title: You Get Error: First Dimension UOM' for Scale Key '1'; Mismatch with UOM in 'Data', Whiling Creating Price List Via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a price list with scales via web service payload and when performing the upload, you face the following error: "First Dimension UOM' for Scale Key '1'; mismatch with UOM in 'Data'".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The reason you are facing this error is because you are passing the <Amount> tag within the header level of the payload.-Resolution-This is the system expected.-Please remove the <Amount> tag from the header of the payload.-Keywords-Price List, Scale, Amount, Key, First Dimension, UOM, Data, Mismatch

Content: Symptom-You are unable to upload the Commodity Catalog because the upload is failing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Commodity Catalogs view.-Click in Upload Commodity Catalog button.-Select your Commodity Catalog file.-Click in Upload button.-You can see that the catalog has failed upload status.-Cause-The catalog that is being uploaded is not supported.-Resolution-Please use the sample XML file here in Attachments (Sample_Commodity_Catalog.xml).
