Title: Sales Order Pricing Component Update Does not Show In Changes tab
Content: Symptom-In this example a Sales Order document will used.-You have performed changes to the Sales Order's pricing area and you expect to see these changes reflecting under the Changes tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Total Pricing section of the document.-Click Add Row button.-Enter the expected component.-Enter a value.-Click Save.-Navigate to the Changes tab.-Click Go.-In changes, the system only displays the changes in values and not the change performed in the pricing component.-Cause-Currently not all the changes are displayed in the Changes tab, however this information is stored in backend.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Pricing Component, Changes, Tab, Sales Order, Pricing

Title: Unable to Replicate Employee Phone Numbers from SuccessFactors to Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Employee phone number is missing after replication from SuccessFactors via Standard Integration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication WorkCenter.-Go to Employees List Reports View.-Search for employee ID ABC and open it (ABC means Employee ID).-Click Edit button.-Go to Personal Data tab.-Go to Private Contact Data subtab.-The phone number is missing.-Cause-Configuration in Business Configuration Workcenter might be missing.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to maintain the values in the Business Configuration:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-In the search window type "Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions".-Select it and click Open.-Click Maintain Code List Mapping.-Click "Add Row" under Code List mapping Definition.-Maintain entry as:-Mapping Group: Employee Central Integration-Local Data Type Name: AddressTypeCode-For the above entry maintained in "Code List Mapping Definition", maintain "Code List Mapping Rule" as "Map Individual Codes" under "Mapping Rule".-For the above entry maintain "Code List Mapping" as:-Local Code       Description                     External Code-    1                 Organization Address             C-    2                 Personal Address                   P-After performing the changes above in Business Configuration, please upload the data again in master data replication Work Center. The steps above should show the phone numbers in Private Contact data tab.-There is a document attached with screenshots - Code List Mapping.docx-Keywords-SuccessFactors, Phone, Missing, Number, Private Contact Data, Replication

Title: Error Message: 'Time recording not permitted for project, user is not part of the team'
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to add a Time Recording for a specific user in the Project where the Organizational Unit is assigned. You receive an error message 'Time recording not permitted for project ABC; XYZ is not part of the team' (where ABC represent the project name and ID and XYZ represent the username).-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the relevant user and open it.-Navigate to Employee Times.-Click Add Row and fill out the relevant information.-Click Save.-See the error message 'Time recording not permitted for project ABC; XYZ is not part of the team' (where ABC represent the project name and ID and XYZ represent the username).-Cause-Missing function in Org Unit.-Resolution-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Click on Find button.-Search for the Relevant Org Unit.-Click on Locate.-Click on Edit-Click on the sub-tab Functions.-Select the Functions of this Org Unit.-Click on Save and Close.-Now you should be able to submit Time Recordings for the employee.-Keywords-Time Recording, Project, Org Unit, Organizational Management, Function

Title: Issues with email outbound potential DKIM issue
Content: Symptom-You are sending an e-mail but the mail never reaches the recipients.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-It was communicated earlier to all customers that, to send e-mails, a DKIM request and Profile Activation is required.-Resolution-If you have already completed the DKIM Profile Activation process, then check your output settings and configuration settings.-If you have not already requested DKIM, open a new Incident as shown in the video below.-If the Key is already maintained in your DNS successfully, make sure that the incident has been send back for profile activation.-You will be able to send emails only after profile activation.-Please check the video below:-See Also-Next-Generation Cloud Delivery transition – New Business ByDesign e-mail Infrastructure-DKIM Enablement for Sender Domains – ByD-Keywords-Emails not send, Email, DKIM, Recipients, Outbound Email, DNS, DKIM Profile.

Title: Closed Petty Cash Being Considered in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash
Content: Symptom-You have closed a petty cash in foreign currency, however the system still considers it in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement run for Cash. You expect that the run should not remeasure the petty cash since it has been closed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Open the relevant run.-Go to Remeasured Balances tab.-Refer to G/L Account 12345 and see that there is either a Gain or Loss being posted.-G/L Account 12345 refers to a Cash Account for Petty Cash XYZ, which has a zero balance and it is already closed. Due to which you do not expect it to be remeasured.-Cause-There were transactions posted in foreign currency related to this Petty Cash. The exchange rate from transaction currency to company currency fluctuated in between the transactions dates and Foreign Currency Remeasurement run date, due to which a posting related to a Gain or Loss of exchange rate for this transaction is required, but was not done (or it was automatically reversed due to the settings for Foreign Currency Remeasurement run for Cash). Therefore, the petty cash closed with Zero balance in transaction currency but non-zero balance in company currency due to such exchange rate differences that were not posted.-To analyze this in further details, you can proceed as follows:-Open the G/L Account Line items report.-Add all the mandatory and relevant selection parameters.-Include G/L Account 12345-Include ALL accounting period/fiscal year, from the beginning until the period/year for which the run is being executed.-Remove the Journal Entry Items characteristic to optimize performance.-Bring the Bank Account / Petty Cash ID characteristic to the rows.-Bring the Balance Company Currency and Balance Transaction Currency key figures to the column.-Run the report.-Refer to the Bank Account / Petty Cash ID characteristic and ensure that all postings relate to the same petty cash in question related to account 12345. If not, filter it accordingly.-As an example, lets consider Transaction Currency as INR and Company Currency as JPY.-Sum the amounts of each column (Balance in Company and Transaction Currency) to have an overview of the balances as a whole for the petty cash. This should match with the amounts in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run (Remeasured Balances tab) as follows:-Sum of all Balance Amounts column = 0,00 INR-Sum of Historic Valuation Amount column = -600 JPY-The Sum of Historic Valuation Amount is the continuous cumulation of ALL payment transactions in company currency for the exchange rate pair in the cash location (petty cash or bank account) from inception to period for which the run is executed.-The Sum of all Balance Amounts column refers to balance in the petty cash or, in case of a bank account, refers to the closing balance of the last posted bank statement for this bank account.-Having the data shown in the report as above, you can take one Journal Entry for analysis. See example below: -Assuming you have a Journal Entry for a Cash Transfer of 30,000.00 INR posted on 31.12.2019.  At that time, exchange rate from INR to JPY was 1.53 (see journal entry). Therefore, 30,000.00 INR = 45,900.00 JPY. For the accounting period/year that you are executing the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, the exchange rate from INR to JPY is 1.51.  If you revaluate this transaction at current rate, you have 30,000.00 INR = 45,300.00 JPY.-Therefore, 45,900.00 JPY - 45,300.00 JPY = 600 JPY, which is considered a loss due to exchange rate fluctuation. Such exchange rate differences are being correctly identified by the Foreign Currency Remeasurement and needs to be posted to a differences account. This is what the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run recognizes and posts at the end of the period. Be aware that since the run in your system may be set up to reverse the posting at the next period start, the differences are carried over through time.-For more details, please refer to help document Foreign Currency Remeasurement.-Resolution-Since the exchange rate difference has not been posted yet, the system keeps raising the difference in the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run. You must execute the run in update mode to post the gains/losses (without reversing it in the subsequent period) or adjust the amounts manually via Journal Entry Voucher to mimic the postings that the Foreign Currency Remeasurement run would do.-At the end, G/L Account 12345 must be debited or credited (depending if there is a gain or loss to be posted) so that the balance in company currency becomes zero. Once that is achieved, the petty cash account is no longer considered by the run.-The settings that define whether or not the Foreign Currency Remeasurement run postings are reversed in the subsequent period are maintained in business configuration, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash.-Click Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle.-Select the respective accounting principle.-Go to tab Use for Cash-Refer to column No Subsequent Reversal Posting. -If this checkbox is flagged for the respective accounting period, the foreign currency remeasurement run postings are not reversed in the subsequent period and differences are not carried over through time.-Observations (in case of manual journal entry voucher postings):-Journal Entry Type 00083 - Manual Entry for Cash-Business Transaction Type 636 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Cash-If you decide to manually post the differences, be aware of different combinations of Profit Center and Segments that can have. Due to that, separate Journal Entry Vouchers may be required to post all the differences. It can happen that some Journal Entry Vouchers will Credit the G/L Account 12345 while others will debit this account considering each combination of Segment and Profit Center to bring the account balance to zero in company currency. Note that the balance is checked against the G/L Account as a whole (for the specific cash location), which may raise some errors in the process of crediting/debiting this account:-For example, G/L Account 12345 has -600 JPY balance in company currency. However, the differences must be allocated to different Profit Center and Segment combinations:-Debit of 1200 JPY to Profit Center and Segment AAA.-Credit of 600 JPY to Profit Center and Segment BBB.-If you start by the credit postings, since you have a negative balance in G/L Account 12345, no credit postings would be allowed by the system. The following error would be raised: 'No credit amount possible for account 12345, cash location XYZ'. Therefore, you need to start by posting the debit amounts to increase the G/L Account balance and make it positive, to then post the credit differences.-However, this lead to a subsequent problem: There exists a system logic to check if a given posting (in the same journal entry voucher) would make the account balance from negative to positive. If yes, an error is raised: Amount <amount> too high; only <difference> open for cash location <ID>, set of books <ID>.-To overcome that, you need to start by the debit postings and split the amounts to first make the G/L Account from negative to zero instead of from negative to positive in the same document. Considering the above example, the following would be the required postings:-For the debit of 1200 JPY to Profit Center and Segment AAA: -First Journal Entry Voucher debit 600 JPY to G/L Account 12345 with Profit  Center and Segment AAA -> G/L Account balance becomes 0,00 JPY-Second Journal Entry Voucher debit the remaining 600 JPY (1200 - 600) to G/L Account 12345 with Profit  Center and Segment AAA -> G/L Account balance becomes 600 JPY-For the credit of 600 JPY to Profit Center and Segment BBB:-Journal Entry Voucher credit 600 JPY to G/L Account 12345 with Profit  Center and Segment BBB -> G/L Account balance becomes 0,00 JPY-This sequence of postings overcomes both the above mentioned errors in case of manual adjustments via journal entry vouchers.-As always, it is highly recommended to test the scenario and postings as a whole in your test environment and evaluate the same with your accounting/finance team before applying the same in production.-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run. Cash. Differences. Exchange Rate.

Title: Line Item is not shown as Canceled in Purchase Order Preview
Content: Symptom-You want to print the Purchase Order XXX which has one canceled Line Item (XXX represents ID of the Purchase Order). The cancelation does not appear in the preview, although the Total Value is right.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Select Purchase Orders-Search for the Purchase Order XXX-Open the Purchase Order XXX-Select Preview-Select Changed PO-See the canceled Line Item is shown just like the other Line Items-Cause-Canceling one item is only a Purchase Order change. When you then save it with one canceled line item the Purchase Order will be sent to supplier as changed but not canceled. The cancelation PDF does not visualize any detailed change as the whole Purchase Order is canceled. The changed PDF visualizes changes on item level (not in item details).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: Number Range of Business Partners Has Been Overwritten After Merging Project
Content: Symptom-Number range of Business Partners has been overwritten from the test system to the production system after merging the implementation project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is an expected system behavior.-Resolution-All changes made in a remote change project in a test system will be merged with production system after the merge process is triggered.-Keywords-Number range, Merge, Business Partners

Title: How to Remove Extension Field From CRM Pricing
Content: Symptom-You have an extension field that is no longer going to be used and you would like to remove it from the pricing engine.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Configure Price Strategy.-Select Pricing Table.-Click Add Row.-Enter a Custom name and the relevance.-Under Fields, select the dropdown.-The extension field ABC is showing in the drop-down. (ABC represents the name/ID of the extension field).-Cause-To remove the field from the drop-down list, you need to remove the CRM Pricing from the extension scenario for this field.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In this example we will use Sales Orders are the origin of the field.-(Optional) Cancel the existing Surcharge created with this extension field.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Configure Price Strategy.-Select Pricing Group Assignments.-Remove the custom surcharge.-Go to the Access Sequence and remove the custom table.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select any Sales Order document.-Click Edit.-Enter the Adaptation Mode.-Select Extension Fields.-Select the extension field ABC and go to the Extension Scenarios.-Remove CRM Pricing.-Click Save and Publish the changes.- The extension field will now stop appearing in the Configure Price Strategy.-See Also-3099502 - How To Create a Custom Price List With Extension Fields-Keywords-Extension Field, Pricing, Remove, Extension, CRM Pricing, Engine, Configure Price Strategy

Title: System is Triggering a Dump with Error "DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED"
Content: Symptom-You are receiving a dump with the following error: "No access possible via a 'NULL' data reference. (termination: RABAX_STATE)".-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-This error is related to a custom solution which exists in the system. It is raised when an association, or an element is used without being defined. To avoid such cases, you should test the elements or associations before using it.-Resolution-Use the methods IsSet() to test associations before using them in the code, and method IsInitial() for the elements. If the association is not set, or the element is initial, this should not be used in the runtime.-You can check for more details in the Dump Analysis tool within the Cloud Applications Studio.-In case there is no information on the script path or code line where this dump is being triggered from, raise an incident to SAP Support assist further.-Keywords-DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED, custom, solution, dump, PDI, SDK, points, nothing, null, exception, error

Title: Account Hierarchy Specific Price List Does Not Work
Content: Symptom-You have created an Account Hierarchy Specific Price List and you would expected that the system would consider the pricing for the Account Hierarchy and product/service you have maintained in the price list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will use account ABC which is under the 8th level (node) of the Account Hierarchy and product XYZ (ABC and XYZ represents the ID of the account and product).- Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select new Sales Order.-Enter Account ABC.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add item XYZ.-The system does not capture the expected pricing value.-Cause-Due to a system limitation, we cannot support more than 5 levels of the Account Hierarchy  in the Account Hierarchy Specific Price List.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-3070744 - Standard pricing tables appear multiple times in the Access Sequence-Keywords-Account Hierarchy Specific Price List, Account Hierarchy, Price List, 5, Level, Nodes, Account, Limited, Levels

Title: Leave Request Approvals are not Being Assigned to the Relevant Approver's
Content: Symptom-You are able to observe that some leave request approvals are not being assigned to the relevant approvers.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center-2. Select the Business Task Management work center view-3. Search and Select the required task-4. Click on Determine Asssignment button we get a warning message as "No assignment can be determined for 1 items" is raised-Cause-The leave request is for the time type Paid Time Off (PTO). This time type does not have any approval option maintained in Business configuration ,hence this request would be active without any approval task.-Resolution-This is a standard system behaviour.-In order to have an approval option ,make the configuration settings accordingly in the system.-Keywords-Approval Tasks ,Paid Time Off ,Determine Asssignment ,Business Task Management

Title: Issue Date in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have identified a new field in the General section of the Sales Order called Issue Date.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click New.-Under the General section, Issue Date shows after Posting and Requested Date.-Resolution-Based on the help document Consignment Issue and Invoicing Process, the field works as follows:-In the Issue Date field of the sales order, provide the date on which the consumption of the consignment stock was reported. This date is used as the shipment date for Issue delivery and subsequently as the Invoice date.-When you create a consignment issue sales order, the issue date at the header level is defaulted to the current date of the sales order. When you add the issue items, the issue date from the header level automatically gets updated at the item level for the issue items. You can manually change the issue date at both levels. If the issue date is changed for an item, it is not affected by any further changes at the header level.-For existing sales orders, any change to the issue date at the header level does not affect the issue items. If new issue items are added, the issue date is defaulted to the creation date of the sales order.-See Also-Consignment Issue and Invoicing Process-Keywords-Issue Date, Sales Order, General, Field, New, Issue, Date, Consignment

Title: Error 'Budget not available for Budget Category ABC Cost Center DEF Fund GHI Function JKL' While Creating Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-Error 'Budget not available for Budget Category ABC Cost Center DEF Fund GHI Function JKL' While Creating Purchase Orders.-(ABC represents the ID of the Budget Category, DEF represents the ID of the Cost Center, GHI represents the ID of the Fund and JKL represents the ID of the Function).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search and open the respective Purchase Order.-Click the View All button.-Click the Check button.-See the error 'Budget not available for Budget Category ABC Cost Center DEF Fund GHI Function JKL'.-Cause-The budget is not available for Budget Category ABC, Cost Center DEF, Fund GHI, Function JKL.-In the report "Planning Object - Plan/Release/Actual/Forecast", it is possible to check the current budget.-To see this information in the report, please execute the following steps:-1. Go to the Business Analytics work center.-2. Go to the Design Report view.-3. Search and open the "Planning Object - Plan/Release/Actual/Forecast" report.-4. Enter the respective Budget Category.-5. Execute the Report.-6. Click the View button.-7. In the Column Fields, add the Key Figure 'Release - (Actual + Forecast )'-Report displays the actual budget.-The formula used for calculating available budget is the following:-Available budget = Release YTP - Actuals YTP - Forecast YTP.-The actuals is the budget consumed already, release is the budget released for consumption and forecast is generally the Purchase Orders already created but have no Goods and Services Receipt or Supplier Invoice posted yet.-Resolution- This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-Help Documents:-Budget Release Quick Guide-Enter Budget Release Data-Active Budget Control Adoption in Supplier Relationship Management for the Public Sector Edition-Keywords-Budget; Purchase Order; Budget Category; Budget not available for Budget Category; Cost Center;

Title: Meaning of Dates in Outgoing Checks
Content: Symptom-You have created and processed an Outgoing Check and wish to know the meaning of each of the Date fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Find and open the Outgoing Check.-Resolution-Document Date: Date on which the document is created.-Posting Date: Date on which the document is posted in accounting.-Date of Issue: Date on which the Outgoing Check has been issued. It can be manually changed when creating the Check.-Voiding Date: Date on which the Outgoing Check has been voided.-Expected Bank Value Date: Date on which the Check is expected to be cashed. The value of the bank value date is set to a default of plus 6 work days in order to reflect the delay in check processing (long duration could occur), so that the document is not recognized as immediate disbursements (taken into account in the liquidity forecast / Cash Position). This default is a best guess to optimize values for the forecast reporting. More details with regards to Bank Value Date can also be found in KBA 2492819 - Balance Difference Between Cash Position and Bank Statement.-Confirmed Bank Value Date: This is the Value Date of the bank statement item where the check has been confirmed.-Cashing Date: This date is populate only when the check is confirmed by a bank statement and it assumes the date value being the same date on which the check has been confirmed in the bank statement, that is the creation date of the bank statement.-See Also-2492819 - Balance Difference Between Cash Position and Bank Statement-Keywords-Outgoing Cheque. Liquidity Management.

Title: Broadcasts - User Specific and Broadcast Bursting
Content: Symptom-You notice that the broadcast options User specific and Use Broadcast Bursting are not always available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-The User specific option is not available straight away when you open the broadcast creation screen. You will need to add broadcast recipients first, and the recipients need to have a valid user in the system. Only then can a broadcast be specific to the user.-If you use the broadcast bursting feature, the system cannot check if the recipients have a valid user. For this reason, it is not possible to use the User specific and the broadcast bursting feature together - please either use the boradcast bursting, or make the broadcast user specific (after selecting users as recipients).-Keywords-broadcast bursting selected, please remove e-mail address, broadcast bursting, user specific, disappear, not available, business analytics, missing

Title: Error: Failed to Delete Form Template Header in XRep Template Registry
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to activate a solution or delete a file in SAP Cloud Applications Studio, one or more of the following errors appear:-"Failed to Delete Form Template Header in XRep Template Registry"-"An Exception was raised"-"Unable to perform the content operation for user KXXXXXXX in client xxx"-"Failed to do cleanup ABC because it is used by file (PQR)"-ABC represents the XREP path of the affected entity, for example: /YABCDEFGY_MAIN/GEN/Forms/YABCDEFGY_XYZ.FLDR/123AB456CDD9.TMPL/YABCDEFGY_P9SRR__EN.xdp-PQR represents the content ID of the LAYER_CUST version of the affected entity, for example: /BYD/ZZZZZYABCDFGY_P9SRR__EN TPXD-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the relevant solution.-Try to activate the solution or delete a .FTHD file.-The error message appears in a popup.-Cause-A business user edited a custom form through the Application and User Management or Administrator work center in the Form Template Maintenance view. This creates $CUST entries in the XREP registry that conflict with the development-layer version of the form.-Add-on forms and forms extended by a development user should not be modified by business users through the Form Template Maintenance view.-Resolution-Remove the conflicting $CUST entries from the XREP registry:-Log in to the backend.-Enter transaction code XREP.-Verify that your user is on LAYER_CUST.-Navigate to the path from the error message (the ABC value).-Select the Version History tab of the .XDP file.-Locate one or more entries marked as $CUST with the content ID from the error message (the PQR value).-Click Clean Up to remove all $CUST entries.-Return to SAP Cloud Applications Studio and verify that the file can be deleted or the solution can be activated without errors.-See Also-SAP blog: why you should avoid editing custom forms from UI-Keywords-Failed to Delete Form Template Header, XRep Template Registry, XREP, LAYER_CUST, $CUST, Form Template Maintenance, FTHD, form cleanup, custom form, solution activation error, content operation

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate on Service Order Item Cannot be Determined

Title: The KPI Preview Shows 0 or a Wrong Value
Content: Symptom-You are using a KPI and noticed that the result is wrong. The most common scenarios are that it shows 0 even though there should be data present. Alternatively, the result may show a wrong number.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the KPI from the respective work center view (most commonly Home) or open a preview:-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design KPIs.-Search for the respective KPI and click on Preview.-Check either the KPI or the Reference Value.-A wrong result is shown. If you compare it to the report and key figure that this KPI is based on, the report will show the correct value.-Cause-There can be several causes for this.-A KPI shows the key figure value that is displayed when you start the corresponding report with the corresponding selection in a Web browser and remove all characteristics from the rows and columns; the resulting key figure value is the relevant value. A key figure may show a different value without any characteristics, compared to a view with specified characteristics.-The report on which the KPI is based is assigned to a specific work center view, for example ABC. The user viewing the KPI has unrestricted read access to the work center view ABC. This causes a conflict in access restrictions which does not allow any data to be returned.-Resolution-For standard key figures, this is the correct behaviour. In custom key figures, this may be caused by a missing setting in the local calculation, as described in the KBA 2574052 - Custom Key Figure Shows Wrong Result. It may also be cause if you save conditions / exceptions to the report view - note that these are not considered because they are saved to the view, not the key figure or the report selection.-Please restrict the user / the business role with regards to the work center view ABC.-See Also-2574052 - Custom Key Figure Shows Wrong Result-2488825 - Access Context of Report Not Working (cause A)-2547529 - KPI showing wrong value-2657239 - Key Figures Behavior in KPI's-2862370 - KPI Shows Different Current Value-Keywords-KPI wrong result, KPI zero, home, KPI context report, wrong reference value, KPI preview-access rights,kpi value,kpi shows zero,incorrect value

Title: Automatic Partial Clearing of Bank Advices Failed With Error 'Posting not possible; clearing inconsistent'
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create automatic partial Clearings using the ManageBankAdviceIn web service due to the error 'Posting not possible; clearing inconsistent'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Open SOAP UI software (for example). -Enter the relevant XML details.-Start the upload.-You receive the mentioned response, while the respective Customer Invoice remains Open, the Bank Advice is posted as an Open Item and a Clearing is also generated with Proposed Status.-Cause-The error is being raised because the checkbox 'Create Manual Clearing Task If Underpaid' is maintained in the Clearing Strategy.-You can refer to the steps below to validate the configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Open the Clearing Strategies activity.-Click Maintain clearing strategies.-The 'Create Manual Clearing Task if Underpaid' checkbox is marked.-When that is configured, the system generates a manual task and generates a Clearing in 'Proposed' Status.-The following steps can be used to check the Proposed Clearing:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Open the relevant Customer Account.-Search for the Invoice referenced in the payload.-The Invoice is still Open, but you can find a Clearing ID in the Clearing ID column.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-In case you wish to execute automatic partial Clearings using the ManageBankAdviceIn web service it is possible to unmark the 'Create Manual Clearing Task if Underpaid' checkbox.-Keywords-Bank Advice, Customer Invoice, Clearing Strategy, Manual Task

Title: KPI Shows Different Current Value
Content: Symptom-A KPI current value is based on a key figure value existent in a report view. However, it is showing different values when compared to the report.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the Design KPI view.-Search and Find the needed KPI.-See that the Current Value is showing a greater value than shown in the report.-Cause-Conditions and exceptions (C4C) / Conditional formatting and value filters (ByD) created on the key figures will not take place in the current value of your KPI. Title: Error: For the Approval the System Needs a Currency Conversion from XYZ to Yuan XYZ. This Failed. Solution: Maintain a Currency Conversion or Change Approval Threshold Currency in Fine Tuning Activity for Approvals.
Content: Symptom-Error message "For the approval the system needs a currency conversion from XYZ to XYZ. This failed. Solution: Maintain a currency conversion or change approval threshold currency in fine tuning activity for approvals." occurs when you try to release the Customer Return with Credit Memo.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Returns View.-Search for Customer Return ABC (where ABC stands for Customer Return you created) .-Click on release with Credit Memo.-You will get the error message: "For the approval the system needs a currency conversion from XYZ to XYZ. This failed. Solution: Maintain a currency conversion or change approval threshold currency in fine tuning activity for approvals." (where XYZ stands for the currency in the Customer Return).-Cause-You have maintained the threshold 0,01 EFG, in the Fine Tuning Activity 'Approval for Customer returns'. (where EFG stands for the currency).-However there is no currency conversion maintained from EFG to XYZ.-You can check the same with below steps:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Select Edit Exchange Rates in common tasks.-You can see no conversion from EFG to XYZ is maintained.-Resolution-You need to either maintain the currency conversion from EFG to XYZ or make sure that in the Activity "Approval for Customer Returns" there is no threshold values. System relies on this value to find if a document is in approval or not.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Open the activity "Approval for Customer Returns".-Select the option "Maintain Threshold Value".-Add the values and save.- Keywords-Customer Return, Currency Conversion, Approval for Customer Returns

Title: Counter in Custom Data Sources is Wrong
Content: Symptom-You have created a joined data source and would like to use the key figure Counter. However you notice that depending on which characteristics you add in the view, the counter might show an unexpected result. For example, it may change to a higher number once you add a field, and then change back if you remove the field and refresh the report.-You may also notice another behavior, for example that different users see different values in the counter. The main issue is that the counter of a joined data source shows a wrong value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report based on your joined data source.-Check the key figure Counter. It shows for example the counter 10.-Add a characteristic to the view.-The report result is now broken down to separate values, depending on the characteristic. The counter may now show numbers like 3,5 and 7. In total, this is more than 10, which was shown initially.-Remove the characteristic from the view and click on Go again.-The counter changes back to 10.-Please note that other scenarios are possible. They all have in common that the counter in a joined data source shows unexpected results. Any custom key figure based on the counter may show the same behaviour.-Cause-Let us assume that you have created an inner join, with the join conditions set to the characteristic Account. If you do not display any other fields in the report view, the counter will show the number of accounts that both data sources have in common. Now, if you add a characteristic from one of the data sources to the view where there is more than one entry per account, the counter will change. For example, if you add the field Sales Order to the view, the counter will change to show the number of sales orders per account. If you then remove the field and refresh the report, the counter will once again show the number of accounts.-In summary, the counter will initially show the count of results of the join conditions. However it may vary depending on which other fields you add to the view.-In the case where different users see different values: This usually happens when you compare users with different access contexts (for examples a business user with an access context in the report, and the key user with administrator access). The access context and the specific restrictions on a user may impact the counter value.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour for a counter in a join.-We would strongly recommend to not use the counter of a custom join in your report, or for further custom key figures since the result is not reliable.-If you need to use the counter, please contact your implementation parnter for assistance on modelling and the correct interpretation of the values.-Keywords-joined data source, inner join, left outer join, wrong counter, custom key figure

Title: Add or Replicate an E-Mail Address with Special Character is Giving "E-Mail Address is Invalid"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add or synchronize an E-Mail Address with special character but system throws error message "E-Mail Address is Invalid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration Work Center.-Go to the Employees View.-Open any Employee and change from the e-mail with a special character such as ñ.-It will fail saying E-mail Address is invalid.-Or then, trying to replicate the E-Mail Address of an Employee will fail too.-Cause-This happens because special characters on E-Mail Address are not supported in Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Currently this function is not supported. We suggest you to post an Idea on Customer Influence.-Keywords-Employee; EMail; E-Mail; Invalid; Replication; Character; Special;

Title: How to Derive Profit Center for Tax Line Items in Journal Entry of Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-In the journal entry resulting from a customer invoice, it is expected that the profit center is automatically derived for the tax line items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries subview.-Find the journal entry of customer invoice XYZ and open it (XYZ means the customer invoice ID).-For line items in the Taxes subledger, it can be observed that the profit center is not derived from the preceding documents, even though the profit center and segment were assigned in those documents.-Cause-For line items in the Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash, and Taxes subledgers, a profit center is derived only when profit center segment accounting with clearing or balancing is in use.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the Set of Books activity.-Edit Set of Books for the company.-Under General tab, for Reporting Principle, use profit center segment accounting with clearing or with balancing, for example:-Profit center & segment, balancing.-Profit center & segment, clearing.-Function of exp, profit ctr/seg, balancing.-Function of exp, profit ctr/seg, clearing.--The reporting principle can be changed according to the relevant business requirements.-See Also-Reporting Principles-Derivation of Profit Centers and Segments-Keywords-profit center derivation, journal entry, reporting principle, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash, Taxes subledgers, automatically derived

Title: How to View Technical Information in Bydesign HTML5 UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to open Debug Console (techncial information) to view technical details of specific Bydesign HTML5 UI.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. This can be set if development requests additional log level in analyzing issues:-Under Controllers/Data:-You will find UI component path and you can also find data model and its corresponding data as shown below:-In System Information tab, you can find use ful information on system time, application server.-Technical Information of specific UI element:-Alternatively, you can see the technical information for just a single UI element by pressing Ctrl + Shift + Alt + Mouse Right Click.-Keywords-Technical Information, UI, ByD, debug, UI path

Title: Change in Bill-To Address Maintained in Relationship Subtab in Account Master Data Do Not Update the New Created Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You need to change the Bill-To Address for different Invoice Requests of the same Source Document.-You maintain the Bill-To Address as Relationship in Account Master Data. Before creating the Invoice Request, you update the Bill-To Address in Relationship subtab, however, this new address is not taken for Invoice creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the New Contract common task-In the Invoice Scheduled subtab, add item.-Create the first Invoice - Bill-To Address is correct.-Update the Bill-To Address in Relationship subtab in Account Master Data.-Create the sencond Invoice - Bill-To Address is not taken accordingly to the change.-Cause-The reason why the scenario does not work - change done in the Account (Party ID) in the Relationship subtab to a different Account (Party ID) - is because the redetermination does not redetermine the Party itself, but only the entered details in the Party Master Data for the Bill-To Address.-Resolution-If you have the Scoping Question "Do you want to redetermine the address of the Bill-To Party from the master data at the time of invoice creation?" activate, instead of defaulting the Bill-To Address from the corresponding predecessor document, the system will default the Address from the Account Master Data at the time of Customer Invoice and Project Invoice Request creation.-Once this question is scoped, you are not able to manually change the Bill-To Party in Sales Documents anymore, including Customer Invoicing.-It means that you can update the Bill-To Party Address from the Account Master Data before creating Invoices, but you can't update the Bill-To Party in Relationship subtab.-See Also-KBA: 2745562 - Bill-To Party is Read Only in Sales Documents-Keywords-Bill-To, Address, Relationship, Not change, Invoice Request, Not update address

Title: Hotkeys for Business By Design
Content: Symptom-You want to use Hotkeys in Business by Design.-Environment-SAP Business for ByDesign-Resolution-Please refer to the link below for the Keyboard Navigation documentation in our Help Portal.-There, we provide some predefined hotkeys for users to navigate the Business by Design UI.-Currently, we do not support self-defined shortkeys.-See Also-Help Portal: Keyboard Navigation-Keywords-Shortcuts, Hotkeys, Quick Keys, shortkeys

Title: Freight is Duplicated Once Adding a New Item in a Follow-Up Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-The Freight Price Component is unexpectedly duplicated when adding an Item to a Follow-Up Sales Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Search for ABC (ABC is the Sales Quote ID).-Click on Follow Up button, then Sales Order (for example).-In the Items tab, add a new row and add a new item.-In the Pricing and Invoicing tab, Freight Price Component is duplicated.-Cause-If Freight is maintained to differentiate based on Document Type, Freights on different Sales Documents are seen as different Price Components by the system.-For example: Freight on a Sales Quote is different to Freight on a Sales Order.-If you create a Follow Up Document that is of a Different Type to the original document, it can happen that the Freight is duplicated when adding an Item, as the system does not recognize the two as different.-Resolution-Freight should not be maintained with reference to the Document Type.-This can be achieved by adding a New Custom Pricing Table with any Key Fields except Document Type.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for: Configure Price Strategy activity.-Open the Pricing Tables.-Add a New Custom Pricing Table at the Item Level. (You can use Sales Organization as Key Field, for example)-Open Access Sequence, scroll down to Item Level - Freight.-Add the Custom Pricing Table you created.-Open Pricing Group Assignments, click on Freights.-Add the Custom Pricing Table you created again on the right hand column "Item Pricing Table", and name it as you prefer.-Once you have added this Customer Table to the Access Sequence for Item Level Freight and to the Pricing Group assignments, you can maintain Freights without having to maintain a Document Type.-After, you can got to the Products and Service Portfolio work center, under Frights view, you can see the new Custom Table in the dropdown under the name you have created. You can maintain your new Freights here, the key difference being that you no longer have to maintain a Document Type. Once you remove the old Freights and maintain them here, you will no longer see this issue.-Keywords- Freight, Duplicated, Follow Up, Sales Document

Title: Query Activation error: Element is not valid; The name is reserved by SAP.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When the partner is trying to activate a query file of a PDI solution within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio, the below error happens:-Query 'QueryName' for node 'Root': Name 'SAP_CreationIdentity_BusinessPartnerUUID' of element is not valid; The name is reserved by SAP. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Cause-Only SAP_SystemAdministrativeData elements are allowed for selection in the query.-The partner might have selected the following fields in the query wizard which are reserved by SAP:-- 'SAP_CreationIdentity_BusinessPartnerUUID'-- 'SAP_CreationIdentity_Person_CurrentCommon_BusinessPartnerFormattedName'-- 'SAP_LastChangeIdentity_BusinessPartnerUUID'-- 'SAP_LastChangeIdentity_Person_CurrentCommon_BusinessPartnerFormattedName'-Resolution-Since the partner cannot make changes to the query, please send the incident to AP-RC-BDS-QRY development component in order to have the reserved fields removed from the query.

Title: PriceSpecificationElementTypeCode for Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are using the QueryCodeListIn service to query data from the data type PriceSpecificationElementTypeCode, but when making the attempt the system does not return data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The query web service II_QUERY_CODE_LIST_IN cannot return values for data types which are having specific implementation code list providers such as the data type PriceSpecificationElementTypeCode.-The same applies to PricingProcedureCode.-Resolution-The data type PriceSpecificationElementTypeCode is currently not supported in the web service QueryCodeListIn for Business ByDesign.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-PriceSpecificationElementTypeCode, Web Service, Data Type, QueryCodeListIn; PricingProcedureCode

Title: Update of Sales Order Not Possible; Change Not Allowed: No Project Task Assigned to Item
Content: Symptom-You see a process communication error within an intercompany Purchase Order and Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Process Communication From the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Cause-Sales Order XYZ was released with only one (1) item of type PBTM - Service - time and material (project).-Purchase Order ABC has two (2) items, hence generating the error.--Once the A2A Sales Order is released, adding an item of type Expense - time and material (project) is not allowed. This can only be accomplished when the Sales Order is with the "In Preparation" status.-Only adding of item type Service – Time and Material (Project) is allowed after a Sales Order is released. But if a service has the expense indicator active you cannot change the item type to a service item type such as Service – Time and Material (Project) and therefore you need to cancel the Item in the Purchase Order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-For the new added item of type Expense - time and material (project), a new Purchase Order has to be created.-To solve the issue in your existing Purchase Order and Sales Order you need to cancel the Item in the Purchase Order and then send the incident to SAP with the request to also cancel the failed Process Message.-See Also-2925259 - Process Communication Error in Inter-company Sales Order-Keywords-Purchase Order, Sales Order, PBTM, Time and Material, Intercompany

Title: BC Sets Using SAP BCOs
Content: Symptom-The creation of a patch solution in the test system fails due to the below errors:-Creation of patch not possible.-Solution YXXXXXXXY_ contains the following BC sets using SAP BCOs:-BC_SET_NAME.bcc-Create patch on development tenant.-Patch Creation in background failed.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the Original Solution.-Go to the Implementation Manager tab and click on the create patch button.-Patch creation fails.- Cause-Business configuration (BC) sets created on SAP BCOs (Business Configuration Objects) can only be maintained on a partner development tenant and it is not supported to be developed on a standard test tenant.-Resolution-Create the patch solution on the partner development tenant.-See Also-Please check the Create a BC Set Using an SAP BCO help document.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Solution, contains, the, following, BC, sets, using, SAP, BCOs

Title: Error "File is empty; enter a valid file" When Uploading a Form Template
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a form template, however receive the following error:  "File is empty; enter a valid file"-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Title: Key date Not Valid Error When Creating Physical Inventory Count/Adjustment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA is not valid any more. Please use the KBA - "2831591 - Actual Delivery Date Must Be Between DD.MM.YYYY And Today" for customers to enable posting documents beyond six months in the past by themselves.-You are creating a physical inventory count, such as  Product Count, Logistics Area Count, New Inventory Adjustment. You enter a Key Date more than 6 months ago. An error message appears:-'Key date DD/MM/YYYY not valid; date should be between AA/MM/YYYYand BB/MM/YYYY' (DD/MM/YYYY represents the entered key date; AA/MM/YYYY and BB/MM/YYYY represent the time period when a confirmation can be made).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-Choose any of the following from Common Task-New Logistics Area Count-New Inventory Adjustment-New Product Count-Enter Key Date XX/YY/ZZZZ, which is beyond 6 months in past. It shows error message.  -Note: This date check is applicable to all inventory change processes, where data entry is enabled. Examples of such processes are:-Goods Issue in Outbound Process (Shipment Date).-Goods Receipt in Inbound Process (Actual Delivery Date).-Scrapping (Actual Execution on).-Unplanned goods movement (Actual Execution on).  -Consumption for cost center (Actual Execution on).-Consumption for project (Actual Execution on).-Change of Stock (Actual Execution on).-Cause-The purpose of this check is to provide data entry control. Even if the corresponding account period is open for operational postings, the key date cannot be used.-Resolution-The inventory posting period is now extended. You can post documents older than 6 months that are within past 24 months in the inventory. Please refer to the KBA -2823591 for details.-Until 1908 release of SAP Business ByDesign, there was an option to bypass the check from the backend as detailed below --If the customer has a valid reason to make adjustments for a time before 6 months ago, then we can disable this data control check from the backend:-Logon into the backend of customer system.-For making this change, 'Development Full' (L7) authorization is required.-Run transaction SAAB.-Enter Checkpoint Group as APCFM_TDT_VALIDATION and then click Change button as shown below:-Select the entries as shown below and click Add Activation.-Now enter the user (backend user) for which you want to allow this entry. Only this user will be able to enter Key Date beyond 6 months in past. It can be activated for multiple users. This check should not be activated for all users, so get users from customer for which it should be activate.-Press Save, following screen will open:-In this screen, you can enter a date. The checkpoint will be activated till this date. Hence, till this date, user can enter Key Date beyond 6 months.-Note:-This activity should be executed in exceptional cases, when customer has real business requirement. Otherwise it should be communicated to customer as system design. Please check Case Document Number 1653526 which is 'Released For Customer'.-Users for which this needs to be activated have to be confirmed by the customer.-Due to complexity of the steps, these steps should not be executed at direct support level. So this case document is relevant for expert support colleagues.-Keywords-physical, inventory, count, error, key, date, 6 months, past, not, valid, development, full, L7

Title: Date Format Changes When Opening Reports From The Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-You opened a report via the MS Excel Add-in and noticed that the date format changes for some entries.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open MS Excel and go to the Add-in tab.-Log-in to your tenant with your user credentials and password.-Click Insert Report.-Search for the report view you would like to open via the Excel Add-in (for example a view from standard report User Logon Details technical ID CCARUSRLOG).-Insert the report.-You will notice that the column for characteristic Last Logon Date - UTC will display different date formats.-Cause-This behavior occurs if your SAP Cloud for Customer user settings do not match with your maintained windows settings for the date format.-Resolution-Please make sure you are using the same date format in your Cloud for Customer system and windows settings. For example if C4C is showing format DD.MM.YYYY under my settings please make sure that windows is using the same format. Please notice that the available date formats in windows are depending from your regional settings.-See Also-Our development team will try to fix this behavior in future releases.-Keywords-Excel Add-in; date format; wrong format; incorrect date; incorrect format;

Title: How to Check the Relevant Business Object Node for an Anchor
Content: Symptom-You want to bind an Extension Field using the Extensibility Explorer to a Standard Screen in the UI Designer and you are unsure which Business Object Node is relevant to the selected Anchor.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have created a Custom Solution.-You have created an Extension Field on an Extension Business Object.-Steps to Reproduce:-Open a Standard Screen in the UI Designer.-Open the Extensibility Explorer tab.-Select any Anchor.-The Add Extension Field option is unavailable or it is available and you cannot find your Extension Field.-Resolution-Not all Anchors refer to an extensible Business Object Node but you can use the below steps to check:-Open the Anchor in the Extensibility Explorer [...]-Copy the Xrep Path.-Close Window.-Open the Properties tab.-Under Extensibility, open the Anchor Collection [...]-Scroll to the Anchor that matches the Xrep Path.-Check the BONode Name.-See Also-Refer to Knowledge Based Article: 2587174 - PDI Field Cannot be Added to Standard-Keywords-SDK, PDI, Xrep path, BONode, Anchor Collection, Add Extension Field

Title: Not Possible to Complete a Service Order - Warning Message: Order items not fulfilled; service conf. for item AA does not exist
Content: Symptom-You are trying to complete a Service Order and then the following warning message appears:-Order items not fulfilled; service conf. for item AA does not exist. (AA is the Line Item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search for XYZ (XYZ represents the Service Order ID).-Click on Submit, then Complete Service Execution.-Click OK.-Warning message appears: Order items not fulfilled; service conf. for item AA does not exist. -Cause-Service Confirmation was created, however, it does not have reference on Service Order Items.-In usual cases, the Service Confirmation is created with reference to the Service Order Items. Once this is released and invoiced, the communication will update the Service Order with the invoicing status.-Resolution-There are two options that are able to proceed in this case:-It's necessary to cancel the Customer Invoice, then cancel the Service Confirmation. Create a new Service Confirmation and invoice this.-In case the cancellation for the Customer Invoice is not feasible in your business scenario, you can:-Open the Service Order XYZ.-Click on Confirm Execution button, this will create another Service Confirmation that will have the reference to the Service Order Items and create the link between them.-You can set the Quantity as 0 (zero).-Release this.-You can then, click on Complete Execution button.-Keywords-Service Order, Complete, Complete Execution, Service Confirmation, Not fulfilled

Title: Single Delivery Options for a Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-What is the difference between the different options for Single Delivery in the Delivery Rules for an Item in a Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Single Delivery-Only one delivery may be sent to the customer, this means that only one confirmation is created. The requested delivery date does not have to be met and the delivery may comprise the requested quantity or only part of the requested quantity.-Single Delivery – Full Quantity-Only one delivery may be sent to the customer, this means that only one confirmation is created. The requested delivery date does not have to be met but the delivery has to comprise the requested quantity.-Single On-Time Delivery-Only one delivery may be sent to the customer, this means that only one confirmation is created. The requested delivery date has to be met, but the delivery may comprise less than the requested quantity.-Single On-Time Delivery – Full Quantity-This Delivery Rule needs to be used with care since only one delivery may be sent to the customer, this means that only one confirmation is created. The requested quantity has to be delivered at the requested delivery date.-If this is not possible, the system issues a confirmation with zero quantity and the sales order will be completed.-Keywords-Single Delivery, On-Time, Full Quantity; Single delivery - full quantity; Multiple Deliveries; Single Delivery; Single on-time delivery; Single on-time delivery - full quantity

Title: How To Check Scoping Questions Dependencies on the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY!-You would to know how to find out the dependencies of a Scoping Question. We will use as example for this article, the question "You can create service requests from incoming e-mails.", from the Cloud for Customer system. This is also valid for ByDesign Questions.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Edit the current project.-Go to Step 4: Questions.-Expand Service > Customer Care > Service Request Management > Under E-Mail Integration with Service Request Management, you can see the question "You can create service requests from incoming e-mails.".-Resolution-Log in to the system backend.-Go to transaction code BC80.-On the Dropdown, select Business Adaptation Catalog like seen in the screen below:-Here, you need to navigate the Scoping Options, similarly as you do on the system frontend. Tip: use the Description column to find the option you need.-Once you find the option you need, you double click it.-On the right side of the screen, you will see the details of this Scoping Option. Go to the Rules tab to find the dependencies like below:-If you click on the "T" icon (number 3 in the screenshot), you change the ID's for descriptions.-To find out what the options shown in the Rules are, you copy the ID, in this case BT_A1S_FND_GROUPWARE and paste it on the BAC Elements field and press enter.-You will be redirected to the Scoping Option.-Double Click it and go to the General Settings tab.-On the top of the right pane, you can see the Scoping Option description.-Note: there might be dependencies of the dependencies. You need to follow the same steps to find them, if required.-See Also-BC-Tools Internal Wiki.-Keywords-Scoping Question ; Backend ; How to ; implementation project ;

Title: Exemption for Business Partner Taxability on Avalara is Not Deriving
Content: Symptom-After maintaining the Exemption for Business Partner Taxability on Avalara the Rate expected is not derived in the system.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Click respective Invoice.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes sub tab.-Tax Rate is not the Tax Rate that was set on Avalara for this exemption.-Cause-The Customer Code getting picked is the Company ID and not the Customer ID, while the exemption was maintained for the Customer ID.-The Customer Code is destination based only in standard scenarios, where Nexus is set up. This scenario is non-standard and the Customer Code in this case is 'Contract From' hence the Company ID.-In this particular case, the Nexus setup is missing in the system. Company Tax Arrangement was not maintained (can be seen in the Company Tax Arrangements work center) specific to the relevant Jurisdiction (Ship-To jurisdiction) for the relevant Company.-This is causing the issue.-If Nexus was set up for the Company in Ship-To jurisdiction, Ship-To would have been picked as Customer Code and exemptions would have been applied.-If there is no Nexus, there is no Tax. The Tax Code determined automatically by the system was 507 – Non Taxable Sale Under Nexus Rules.-Resolution-Please maintain Nexus for the relevant Company and Jurisdiction to relevant State (basically Tax Number in Company Tax Arrangement) and the exemptions will get determined correctly.-Keywords-Avalara, Nexus, Exemption, Company Code, Customer Code, Tax-exemption,nexus,avalara,company code,tax,customer code

Title: Filter Option Not Available When Opening KPIs
Content: Symptom-When accessing a KPI displayed into your home screen, you cannot see 'Filter' option in the top right of the screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-As a business user, select the KPI displayed into your home screen. -Click to open it.-You can see it has no 'Filter' option in the top right of the screen. -Cause-The KPI Filter is not a business user feature and therefore it is just available when accessing it via Design KPI work center view. From the business user perspective, a classic KPI or a KPI variant are perceived as 100 % equivalent.-Resolution-In case you need to change those filters applied in the KPI filterable, you can access it via Business Analytics following these steps:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Search for the KPI filterable. -Click to Edit.-You will be able to see 'Filter' option and you can edit as required. -Save it. -Keywords-filter kpi, kpi filterable, end user missing kpi filter, user kpi, filter, kpi parameter, kpi variant, business user kpi, key performance indicator filter.

Title: How to check if a Clean has been triggered on an Add-On Solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Runtime data is missing for a Solution in the Development or Test Tenant and you want to know if a Clean has been triggered on Solution level.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Resolution-You can check the logs in the System back end:-Open transaction SLG1.-Search Object: COP*.-Select date corresponding to when the runtime data was reported missing.-Execute (F8).-Filter by Program "PDI_LM_PRODUCT_CLEAN".-See Also-See Supporting Knowledge Based Article:-2581573 - How to Use The Backend Transaction SLG1-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Clean, BO, empty, instances, Project Explorer, PDI_LM_PRODUCT_CLEAN, SLG1, COP

Title: Not Able to Scope Direct Debit on Project Scope
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add  Direct Debit to your Solution Scope.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step 4 - Questions.-Expand Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select Payment Methods.-Mark checkbox with the question 'Do you want to use direct debit to receive payments from your customers?'-Go to the Review tab.-Click Accept Preselected Answers.-Click Finish.-A pop-up-notification appears:-'Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.-If error messages are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.'-Cause-This issue can occur due to existing manual entries of Payment Methods under Global Settings for Payment activity.-Resolution-The Payment Method needs to be removed from Global Settings for Payment:-Go to the Business Configuration activity.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Global Settings for Payment.-Click Open.-Click Prioritize payment methods.-Remove entries for ID 8 and 15.-Click Save.-After this is done the question regarding Direct Debit can be scoped.-Keywords-Direct Debit, scope, project scope, payment method-project scope,direct debit,scope,payment method
