Title: In the report invoice volume the freight is missing.
Content: Symptom-You run the report Invoice Volume (CRMCIVIB_Q0001) the key figure Freight shows the value zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the view Design Report.-Open the report Invoice Volume (CRMCIVIB_Q0001).-You see the key figure Freight shows the value zero.-Cause-This report only shows the freight if it was added to the preceding sales order items.-Resolution-To check that follow the below steps.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the view Invoice Document. -Search for the affected invoice and open.-View All and select the tab Document Flow.-You can see that no sales order was added to this invoice and the same happens with other invoices not showing freight in the report Invoice Volume (CRMCIVIB_Q0001).-Alternatively you can use the report Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components with the Report ID: CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001-This report shows the values in customer invoices. By default, the year-to-date net values for the current year are displayed. along with details about the price components like price, discount, freight, surcharge, goodwill, warranty, quality loss fee, cost estimate, profit margin. also provides information like is the price component is manually changed or automatically determined, what prices are proposed by the system and which is the active price, base value of each price component calculation for price, discount, freight, surcharge. Calculation of total discount , total tax value .-Keywords-Report invoice volume, CRMCIVIB_Q0001, freight, Sales Order, Key Figure, AP-RC-ANA; Price Components; Freight

Title: Auto Renew for Renewal Agreement in the Activity Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts is Greyed out
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to Auto Renew the Active Renewal Agreement in the system but the option is Greyed out-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Overview ﻿view-3. Search for Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts-4. Select Change Immediately-Cause-When you create a new Renewal Agreement and when it is in In Preparation only then you can check the box for Auto Renew. You also can't change Active Renewal Agreement to In Preparation.-Resolution-The is the expected system behaviour.  After a Renewal Agreement is set to Active it cannot be changed anymore as otherwise it would cause inconsistencies in Contracts to which it was assigned already.--If you have any Renewal Agreement not assigned to any Contracts you can make those as Obsolete-Keywords-Contract; Renewal; Rule; Auto Renewal; Customer Contract

Title: Missing Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown Reports
Content: Symptom-You are looking for both the 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type) [FININVU15_Q0001]' and 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (G/L Account) [FININVU15_Q0002]' reports, but when accessing Design Reports work center view they are not visible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports work center view.-Search for the report 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type)' or 'FININVU15_Q0001'.-You can see no results.-Cause-Both 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type) [FININVU15_Q0001]' and 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (G/L Account) [FININVU15_Q0002]' reports are not available because there is a missing scoping question which enables these reports. The 'Actual Costing' scoping question was not selected in the Business Configuration. You can check if the question was scope following these steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects work center view.-Select your Implementation Project. -Click on Edit Project Scope.-Go to Scoping.-Select Financial and Management Accounting > Inventory Valuation.-You can see the 'Actual Costing' question was not selected.-Resolution-In order to have both 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type) [FININVU15_Q0001]' and 'Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (G/L Account) [FININVU15_Q0002]' reports available, you need to scope the 'Actual Costing' question. You can follow these steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects work center view.-Select your Implementation Project. -Click on Edit Project Scope.-Go to Scoping.-Select Financial and Management Accounting > Inventory Valuation.-Check 'Actual Costing' checkbox. -Save it-Then, you will be able to see those reports under Business Analytics.-See Also-Material Actual Costing – Cost Breakdown (By Item Type)-Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (G/L Account)-Keywords-Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type), report missing, FININVU15_Q0001, FININVU15_Q0002, Material Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown, standard report missing

Title: Contract or Quote for Contract is Not Being Created Based on the Renewal Rule Maintained
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a Renewal Rule for Customer Contract which a Quote for Contract or a Contract is supposed to be created, however, nothing has been created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario: You have set up a Renewal Rule where a Quote for Contract should be created one month before the end of Contract Validity. Contract Ends on April 30th.-On March 30th, you expect to see the Quote for Contract created:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for XX (XX is the Contract ID)-Click on Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-It's possible to see no Quote for Contract created.-Cause-Once you are setting up the Renewal Rule, it's necessary to select the checkbox for Auto Renew. If this is not selected, the system will not trigger the creation automatically.-Only a task reminding the Renewal Rule will be created.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for: Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts activity.-Select Maintain Renewal Rules.-Confirm that in the rule created, the checkbox Auto Renew is selected.-See Also-KBA: 2461011 - Auto Renew for Renewal Agreement in the Activity Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts is Greyed out-Keywords-Renewal Rule, Contract, Quote for Contract, Auto Renew

Title: File Format/Extension Error When Trying to Open Downloaded Price/Discount List Excel File
Content: Symptom-When trying to open a Price List/Discount List Excel file downloaded from the system, you get the following error in Excel:-"The file format and extension of 'ABC.xls' don't match. The file could be corrupted or unsafe. Unless you trust its source, don't open it. Do you want to open it anyway?" (Where ABC.xls Represents the filename of the downloaded file).-Clicking "Yes" results in error: "The file is damaged and cannot be opened."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Open the "Price List" or "Discount List" view.-Change the type of List (Pricing Assignment Group) in the dropdown below "Price Lists" or "Discount Lists" to the desired one.-Click the "Download" Button.- The system will generate a file, which upon opening results in the previously mentioned errors.- In some environments, it is also possible to see the following Error Description: "Whitespace is not allowed at this location. Location: Line: DEF, Column: GHI" (Where DEF and GHI Represent the Line and Column numbers, respectively).-Cause-This is caused by the usage of a special character in the name of the Pricing Assignment Group of the Price List or Discount List. Most likely the character "&" is being used, but it could also be caused by other special characters.-The reason for this is that Excel treats some special characters as symbols, which are then used in internal functionalities. So using any of those in the name of the Pricing Group Assignment results in a corrupted .xls file.-Resolution-In order to avoid this issue, please make sure that no Pricing Group Assignments have "&" or any other special characters in their names. You can check this by following these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Configure Price Strategy.-Select the activity Configure Price Strategy and click on Open.-Click the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-Select "Prices" or "Discounts" under Pricing Group and Group Name.-Check the names created under Pricing Group Item Assignments.-Keywords-Price List, Discount List, Excel, Error, Message, Dump, Fail, Failure, Symbol, Symbols, Special Character, Special Characters, Ampersand

Title: The Attachment Maintained in the Master Data is not Copied into the New Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You maintained an attachment in the Master Data such as Account Master Data or Product Master Data but it is not automatically copied into the new Sales Order or new Sales quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use Product Master Data and Sales Orders as an example. -Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-In the Show field, select All Products.-Search for the product ID ABC (ABC is the name of the product) and click Go.-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Go to the Attachments tab.-Click Add > File to add the file as an attachment.-Click Save.-Go to the Sales Orders work center and from Common Tasks select New Sales Order.-In the New Sales Order screen maintain the account and other mandatory details.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab.-Click Add Row and add the product ABC.-Go to the Attachments sub tab.-You can see: No records found.-Cause-The attachment maintained in the account or product master data is not transferred when creating a new sales document.-Resolution-It is currently the expected system behavior.

Title: "Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" Error When Trying to Create a Sales Order with 0.00 Value via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Sales Order via Webservice where one or more items have the value of 0.00, however, the document is created as inconsistent with error "Item AB: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" (Where AB Represents the line item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example of Pricing sent in XML Request via API Testing Tool (e.g. SoapUI):-  <PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>-     <ItemMainPrice>-        <Rate>-           <DecimalValue>0.00</DecimalValue>-        </Rate>-     </ItemMainPrice>-  </PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>-Cause-This happens when the Price being sent in the Payload is 0 and no Currency Code has been maintained in the Payload as well.-Resolution-To avoid this issue, please ensure that the <CurrencyCode> tag is also maintained in the same Webservice call. You can find an example below, using the Currency Code for Euro:-  <PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>-     <ItemMainPrice>-        <Rate>-           <DecimalValue>0.00</DecimalValue>-           <CurrencyCode>EUR</CurrencyCode>-        </Rate>-     </ItemMainPrice>-  </PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>-Keywords-Web Service, Payload, Request, Response, Zero, 0, Value, Price, Error, Invalid, Ignore, Calculation

Title: Cost Price Component not Shown in Over-the-Counter Sale
Content: Symptom-When creating an Over-the-Counter Sale, you observe that the system does not show the "Cost" Price Component in the "Pricing" tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Open the Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Find Document ABC (Where ABC represents the Over-the-Counter Sale ID).-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Click the Expand All button.-You observe that the "Cost" Price Component is not maintained.-Cause-This happens in cases where the Currency is not determined in the document. The system needs to first determine the Price in the Over-the-Counter, and since the Currency is not determined, that is not possible and subsequently the Cost is also not determined.-Resolution-You need to make sure that the Currency is correctly maintained for the Account and Sales Organization used in the Over-the-Counter document. To check this, follow these steps:-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-Open the Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Find Document ABC (Where ABC represents the Over-the-Counter Sale ID).-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Make note of the Account DEF and Sales Unit GHI (Where DEF and GHI Represent the Account and Sales Unit ID's, respectively).-Open Account DEF.-Navigate to the Sales Data tab.-Under Sales Organization, make sure that Sales Unit GHI is maintained and that the Currency is also present in the Details section when you Highlight it.-Keywords-Over the Counter, OTC, Sales, Sales Org, Sales Unit, Cost, Price Component, Unable, Missing, Mismatch

Title: The Tax Code for Tax Exemption is not Selected Correctly in your Sales Document
Content: Symptom-The tax code for tax exemption is not selected correctly in your sales document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-pre-requisite : You have created the sales quotes XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of a sales quote), the Account/Buyer ABC (ABC represents the identification of your account) is located in Austria. The Seller party is located in Germany and the Ship-from party is also located in Germany.-In the account master data, you have maintained a Tax Exemption as follow :-Go to the Account management work center.-Go to the Account view.-Select the account ABC.-Go to the Financial Tab.-Select the Taxes sub tab.-Go to the Tax Exemption.-Country AT- Tax Exemption reason : 1 - Tax exemption for sale-Steps to reproduce the issue :-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quote view.-Select the Sales Quote XYZ.-Go to the Items Tab.-Select Item 10 > Tax Sub-tab.-You can see that the Tax Country is Germany, the tax code 501 - Domestic Supply (Standard Rate) and no tax exemption were applied.-Cause-In a Sales Document where the Ship-from party is Germany and the Ship-to party is Austria (or any other country in EU); the tax country will be defaults to DE - Germany. In order to have a tax exemption, you should create a tax exemption for the country Germany in the account master data.-Resolution-Go to the Account management work center.-Go to the Account view.-Select the account ABC.-Go to the Financial Tab.-Select the Taxes sub tab.-Go to the Tax Exemption.-Choose the country of the Ship-from party (DE-Germany in our example) and one of the following tax exemption :  7 - Tax Exempt According to §4, Nr. 7 UStG or 1 - Tax Exempt According to §4, 2 - 6 UStG. Once you have save your account master data the correct tax code should be triggered in your sales document with account ABC (e.g 513 - Exempt According to §4, Nr. 7 UStG if you have maintained Tax Exemption : 7 - Tax Exempt According to §4, Nr. 7 UStG).--Keywords-TAX Code, Tax Country; EU

Title: What Are the Different Users Involved in Implementation and Their Roles
Content: Symptom-This document lists the different users and their roles during the implementation of your system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Initial User:-After subscription / signing the contract, the user receives an e-mail with the Initial User and password. The first logging into the new system is made with this initial user and password.-The initial user is responsible for:-Creating the implementation project.-Completing the scoping.-Completing the milestone "Designed Acceptance".-Once the milestone is completed, the initial user will be assigned the Service Agent view and then the initial user can create service agents.-Once the initial user creates a service agent, then the Initial User will be locked.-Key User:-There can be more than one key user for a system. The first key user will be created by the initial user.-The key user is responsible for:-Completing the fine-tuning, migration, testing and go-live.-Administrator activities.-End User:-User who is responsible for business processes and business activities.-This is the most common type of business user and its creation is triggered automatically whenever a new employee or new service agent is created.-PDI User:-User who is responsible for performing PDI activities in the system. PDI users cannot access any administration related work centers such as Business Configuration, Application and User Management (ByD), Administrator (C4C).-A PDI user is a business user with access to the work center PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT. This type of business user is created the same way as an end user (by the creation of an employee or service agent).-Support User:-Used by support engineers to access a customer system and analyze reported incidents.-This type of user cannot be created in a system. It is a technical user and can only be used by SAP.-Keywords- end user; key user, different, pdi

Title: Value Help Types: Use Context and Use Master Data
Content: Symptom-In the selection area of a report, you have the option to use the value help to enter values in variables. For some fields, the value help lists all available values, whereas in others some are missing.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-For example:-Open the report Business Partner with Marketing Attribute Assignment.-In the selection, click on the value help for Attribute Set.-In the new window, you will see - for example - 5 attribute sets.-Go to the work center Administrator, view Sales and Marketing Settings.-Click on Maintain Marketing Attribute Sets.-You will see - for example - 8 attribute sets.-Why are not all of them shown in the value help?-Cause-There are 2 value help types: Use Context and Use Master Data.-Use Context means that the system checks if a particular value is used in any document or object. If so, it is displayed in the value help.-Use Master Data displays all values for a field that are maintained in the system, whether or not it is used.-Resolution-In our example, the value help type for Attribute Set is Use Context. So any attribute set that is not used (for example it it is marked as obsolete it cannot be used) will not be shown in the value help list.-Value help types are set in the backend and cannot be changed.-See Also-The value help in data sources may behave slightly differently than a report. To be sure which values are shown in the value help, please always test this on a report value help, and also ensure that the selection variable was added to the report via the report wizard (instead of the Add Fields feature).-Please also note that in reports based on customized joined data sources, the value help type is set as described below.-If a field has a master data reference, the value help type of this field will be set to Use Master Data. To check if there is a master data reference for a field, please go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Data Source. Search for the data source and click on the Documentation link. Check the column called Master Data - Data Source. If there is an entry here, the value help type will be User Master Data.-If there is no master data reference as described above, the value help type will be Use Context.-Additionally, the following fields will always show the master data in a value help if the report is based on a join:-Date or time fields-Codelist fields (such as Document Type, Status, etc)-In temporal join data sources it will always be of type use master data and show all values. This is the expected system behaviour at the moment and is working as designed.-Keywords-use context, use master data, data sources, temporal join, value help, attribute, report, selection area-value for variable is not valid

Title: Modal Dialog cannot be Navigation Target for OBN Button Navigation
Content: Symptom-Modal Dialog cannot be the navigation target for OBN Button navigation.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business Bydesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio-Open PDI Solution-Open UI Designer-Open the standard ui component-Go to extensibility explorer -Select "Assign Component to View"-Select Navigation Target-Your Modal Dialog is missing -Cause-Modal dialog can't be OBN navigation based. It has to be simple navigation. There should be a simple navigation given where inscreen flow happens. As it is a reusable component that is why it will not be part of assigned objects.-Resolution-This is the system standard behaviour.-Keywords-Modal Dialog; MD; OBN;

Title: Key User can not Enforce Default view or Selection to end Users for Already Assigned Reports
Content: Symptom-Report is already assigned to end users and key user/Admin wants to set default view/selection again for all end users but in few cases, its not working.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login as key user.-Go to business analytics work center.-Go to design reports.-Search for a specific report for which you want to set the default view/selection for end users (note the report must be assigned and end user has access to the report).-Open and run the report.-Set the default view/selection.-If the report is assigned for the first time then all end user will be seeing the default view/selection set by key user but later on if key user again wants to set new default view/selection and enforce it to all end users then it may happen that few end users are seeing the default view/selection set by key user but few end users are not.-Cause-If an end user has personalized and saved the default view/selection manually then key user cannot override the default view/selection set by key user.-Resolution-Once the end user deletes the default view/selection (which means that for that time, report does not have any default view/selection set), then that report will take the default view/selection set by key user at that time and later on if key user changes the default view/selection, it will be applicable for that end user as well unless that end user has again saved the default view/selection.-If the end user deletes the default selection only (and not the default view) and opens the report, it will open with default selection set by key user at that time along with default view set by the end user itself. Same is applicable in case of view as well.-Keywords-Admin, Key User, Report, Default View, Default Selection, End User

Title: Reversal Postings after Running the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash
Content: Symptom-G/L Account ABC (ABC is the G/L-Account ID) is a balance sheet account of type Cash. After running the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash you notice that the balance of the account is adjusted for the relevant period, however a balance shows again for the next period. This shows especially for G/L accounts whose balance should be 0,00 after clearings. Here again, you notice postings resulting from the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-In the Periodic Tasks view choose Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs.-Highlight the relevant Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Run and access the Log Result.-Under Postings you see the postings for the relevant cash accounts and exchange rate gain/loss accounts based on the maintained exchange rates in the General Ledger work center.-Cause-On the last day of a period amounts resulting from exchange rate differences are posted against the configured exchange rate gain/loss account. For balance sheet accounts it is customary that postings resulting from Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash are reversed at the first day of the subsequent period. This can be illustrated when looking at the G/L Accounts - Line Items report for g/l account ABC. Journal entries of type Foreign Currency Remeasurement are re-posted for the first date of the subsequent period - reversing the previous postings.-Resolution-If required, postings resulting from Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for Cash can be rendered to remain permanent at a period's end. In order to suppress the reversal postings at the first day of the next period proceed as follows.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Fine Tuning activity Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash.-Select option Assign remeasurement Method to Accounting Principle.-Choose the Accounting Principle ABC.-Open the Use for Cash tab.-Select the No Subsequent Reversal Posting box.-Save.-In case previous postings shall be adjusted, Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs for Cash have to be repeated for each relevant period.-See Also-2500611-Keywords-Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, Cash Run, Exchange Rate

Title: HTML Tags Are Shown on Reports
Content:
Symptom-When accessing a report, HTML tags, such as

or

are shown for one or more fields.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find and open a report 123 (123 represents the affected report name).-Click Go.-Result: The data for the field ABC (ABC represents the ID of the filed that displays HTML tags.-Cause-The field ABC is an extension field created via key user tools that has rich text enabled, which means it is of type Formatted Text. It is possible in specific cases to use the rich text feature in reporting to see formatted text.-Resolution-For further details on the rich text feature, please see the KBA <2864008 - Rich Text Feature Missing in Reports>.-Keywords-html tags, report, wrong data, report characteristic, formatted text, extension field, analytics, c4c, reporting-special characters,data source,html,html tags,report tag,report html

Title: Task Type Alias: CRM_OPM_OPP_NTF_ALERT
Content: Symptom-You have received a Health Check related to a business task where the system cannot determine an appropriate user to whom the items can be distributed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Task Management view.-Show: Unassigned Items.-Select the task for Opportunity ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Opportunity).-In the details section open the Application log XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Application Log).-You can see the following error:-Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization.-Searching for manager in org structure:-Manager must be a reporting line unit manager.-Manager must be manager for the following employees: (DEF) (DEF represents the ID of the employee).-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Opportunity List view-Open Opportunity ABC.-You can see that the Employee Responsible is DEF.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business User view.-Select user DEF.-In the Details section you can see that no Manager is assigned to the user.-Cause-If an opportunity remains too long in a certain phase, then it is said to be stalled. In this case, the system notifies the manager of the sales representative who is responsible for the opportunity.-Generally, the relevant sales manager receives this notification in his/her Inbox in the Home work center. In case the manager is not maintained for the employee responsible the task cannot be assigned and appears in the Unassigned Items.-  Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-You need to either maintain the manager of the employee responsible or manually assign a respective user to the task.-Keywords-Task, Health Check, Opportunity, Task Type, CRM_OPM_OPP_NTF_ALERT

Title: How to Find Which is The Project Task of a Change Log in The Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-How to Find Which is The Project Task of a Change log in The Project-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Projects view.-Search and open the Project ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Project).-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Project Overview tab.-Select the Changes sub-tab.-Select the desired change.-You want to know for which Project Task the changes have been done.-Resolution- Start transaction SESFTS and enter BO PRO_PROJECT.-Use option “Load by Alternative Key” and enter the given project ID in the field ROOT – PROJECT_ID.----Copy the project UUID in field UUID/content.----Start transaction SESFTS and enter BO PRO_PROJECT by BO /ISPCD/CHANGE_DOCUMENT.-Use option “Load by Query” and select the query ROOT – QUERY_BY_OBJECT_TYPE_COD.--Enter the following data in the red marked fields: -ObjectTypeCode/content: 231-ObjectNodeTechnicalID: The copied Project UUID.-Set the FromChangeDateTime and the ToChangeDateTime to the change date time given by the user. Be aware that the change date shown to the user is shown in the time zone of the project whereas here UTC is used. --Select the entry and navigate to CHANGE_DOCUMENT_RECORD.----There you find the relevant entries by having a look at the ObjectNodeElementName that corresponds to the field name shown on the UI. You can find the task in the column CompleteNodeHierarchyText. -You can find the task in the column CompleteNodeHierarchyText. Copy it.-Start transaction SESFTS and enter BO PRO_PROJECT.-Use option “Load by Node ID” and enter the copied task UUID in the field TASK.-You can find the ID of the task in field ID/content.

Title: Discount Not the Same Between Sales Order and Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have added a discount to the Sales Order document, but when invoicing through the Customer Invoice, the same value is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Expand Item 10.-Discount of 10% is determined from the discount list.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Expand Item 10.-Discount is not carried to the Invoice. -Cause-In the discount list, there is a custom field which serves as a parameter for it to be determine.-The field has been extended to the Sales Order business object, but the same was not extented to the Customer Invoice business object.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to prevent this issue in the future, please maintain this extension scenario in the system.-Keywords-Sales Document, Price, Discount, Custom field, Pricing Engine, Mismatch, Disappearing

Title: Field is Missing in the Sample Request while Testing Service Operation for Integrated Third Party Web Service
Content: Symptom-Field is missing in the sample request while testing service operation for integrated third party web service.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio-Open PDI solution-Upload one WSDL file-Right click your wsid file-Click Test Service Operation-In the sample request, there will be missing field which is available in the WSDL-Cause-Backend tables and structures do not accept the duplicate element names in the WSDL file while generating the runtime artefacts.-Resolution-Please kindly make sure there's no duplicate element name in the WSDL before uploading it.-Keywords-WSDL; Field missing;

Title: How to Add Job Profile to Form Template
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-After custom font is uploaded to ADS, it is expected to add Job Profiles to relevant form template. This document explains the steps to perform this action.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Pre-requisite*: -Go to Application and User Management work center.-Click on Business Flexibility view.-Then select on Form Template Maintanance.-Open Advanced Filter.-Under Template Group, select Customer Invoice as example.-Click on Go.-Click on your user-> Key user settings-> Start adaptation mode.-Under Adptation, make Job Profile Name visible.-*You can skip this steps if the field Job Profile Name is already visible.-Assign Job Profile Name:-Select form template.-Click on Actions and then Assign Job Profile.-Enter Custom/Print/always_embed_fonts.-Publish the form template.-Note: Custom/Print/always_embed_fonts is case sensitive-Keywords-JobProfile, Add Jobprofile, custom font, ADS font, Font update, ADS update

Title: Follow Me Printer on Cloud Print Manager
Content: Symptom- Cloud Print Manager does not support Follow Me Printing.-Environment-SAP CLOUD PRINT MANAGER-Resolution-Cloud Print Manager(CPM) runs as a Windows service with a single user. All print jobs technically belong to the CPM user. Therefore follow me printing is not supported with CPM.-Keywords-Follow Me Printing, SAP Cloud Print Manager, SAPCPRINT

Title: Product, Product Category or Tax Code of Item Missing
Content: Symptom-You have created a Invoice Request, which became inconsistent due to the error: Product, Product Category or Tax Code of Item Missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Click Check.-Error: Product, product category or tax code of item missing.-Cause-1. One line item was added without an item. Hence, the system is not able to determine the tax code.-2. A line item was added manually as a free text item (description). For such, the tax code needs to be added manually.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-1. Enter a product, which will enable tax determination.-2. Enter the tax code manually.-If Tax Exemption is enable, perform the following:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Taxes subtab.-Remove the flag from the Tax Exemption checkbox.-Tax Code is enable for determination.-Enter a Tax Code.-Select the Tax Exemption checkbox again.-Click Save.- This is make the document consistent.-Keywords-Product, Tax, Tax Code, Manual, Credit Memo, Invoice

Title: Dump Message When Uploading Supplier Invoices Using Excel Upload
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Customer is getting a 500 Internal Server Error when uploading Supplier Invoices via Excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Click on the New button.-Click on the Import from Microsoft Excel®.-Fill the data in the template.-Connect to the system via the Add-In.-Select Save Data to-The import starts but aborts with the 500 internal Error.-Cause-The Payload generated when the template is uploaded has a wrong value assigned to the tag <BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>.-Connect to the customer system backend.-In transaction SRT_UTIL you can check for raised error messages during the excel upload.-By default, we see only the errors from today.-Click re-select and set the correct date and remove the user and execute.-Scroll to the right to see the interface name and sort by interface name.-The interface we are looking for is II_SRM_SI_SI_MBO (Supplier Invoice) or II_SRM_PO_MBO (Purchase Order).-You can see the error details:  ----ERROR_TEXT Value is longer than the maximum permitted length 5: "Credit memo item"-If you click on Payload button, you will see a line similar to the one below:-<BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>Credit memo item</BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode>-The tag <BusinessTransactionDocumentItemTypeCode> has to be populated with a code of three numbers, for Credit Memos, for example, the correct code is 003. Since the field is populated with the wrong data, the dump happens.-Resolution-You can advise the customer to make a dummy change on the field affected. If the field is Credit Memo Item, for example:-Change the data of the field to any other option available (Invoice Item, for example).-Save the Excel sheet.-Change it back to Credit Memo Item.-Save the Excel sheet.-Try again to upload the Excel File.-See Also- 1921060 - Find the Cause for 500 Error during Supplier Invoice or purchase order Excel upload-Keywords-error, 500, Excel, upload, Supplier Invoice, template, dump

Title: How to Enhance or Modify Existing Product Category Hierarchy Using Migration
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to enhance, modify or add a new child node to the existing Product Category Hierarchies using Migration, for example, if the description is not maintained for a particular language or you want to change the description that already maintained for the existing Product Categories.-However, when you navigate to the migration tool for Product Category Hierarchy, you cannot find the Enhance Already Existing Records or Modify Already Existing Records modes.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Find and open the fine-tuning activity Product Category Hierarchy.-Click the link to Migrate product category hierarchy using the migration tool.-Upload a migration template.-Click the Properties button.-There is no Enhance Already Existing Records or Modify Already Existing Records option.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-Product Category descriptions can be enhanced or modified using Add New Records itself as the migration mode. Similarly, you are able to add a new child node to the existing product categories using this mode as well.-Note: in case the Product Category has the “Product Assignment Allowed” indicator, then you need to add the same to the template before adding/enhancing information.-Keywords-Product Category Hierarchy, Migration, Enhance Already Existing Records, Modify Already Existing Records.

Title: Design of Fields Original Value Date and Expected Value Date in Report Liquidity Forecast - Transaction Details
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article explains the design of fields Original Value Date and Expected Value Date in report Liquidity Forecast - Transaction Details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics - Design Reports-Run Report Liquidity Forecast - Transaction Details-Show fields Original Value Date and Expected Value Date in the report-You want to know what is the design of these two fields and why they are the same sometimes.-Cause-The Original Value Date is the date the item is expected to be paid.  This Original Value Date is the same as the due date seen in the invoicing screen and reports.  It will be move to the next working day if it falls on a non-working day-The Expected Value Date is the same value as long if the run is created on or before the Original Value Date.  If the run is created after the Original Value Date and the item still has not been paid then the Expected Value Date will be moved to the date the run was created.  It essentially means that the item is expected to be Valued as soon as possible as it is overdue.-Resolution-System works as designed-Keywords-Original Value Date, Expected Value Date, Liquidity Forecast - Transaction Details

Title: Error While Trying to Use the Service Customer Incident Via OData Console
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the OData Console to perform a GET/POST in the Service Name customerincident, however the system is showing the error message below.-Could not load service URLs. Please reload the page!-Unknown error. Please check the metadata and try again.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2008 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management WoC.-OData Services view.-Select the Service Name customerincident.-Click Test.-System shows the error message.-Cause-The OData service "Customer Incidents" is used to access the Partner Support Request Business Object. To use this service, the system must be partner enabled.-Resolution-To configure partner system, you can follow the below blog post:-How to configure and use the new feature of ByD1705 – Customer Incident Handling by Partner-A change will have to be done in your scoping project to be able to use this OData Service. The authorization to the user is provided as work center assignment. After doing the change, please assign the work center /ITSAM/CUST_INCIDENT (Customer Incidents) to the user who is requesting access then.-After setting up the system, the OData Service "Customer Incidents" can be used properly.-Keywords-Error Message, OData Console, Could not load service URLs, Please reload the page, Unknown error, Please check the metadata and try again, Service Name, customerincident.

Title: The Name Format of An Employee is Not Consistent in All Views
Content: Symptom-You have observed that the name format of an employee is not the same, for example, in the Employee's OWL (object worklist, the work center view screen) and the TI (thing inspector, the details screen of a specific employee record).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Employees work center view.-Search for employee XYZ (where XYZ stands for an actual employee ID in the system).-The employee's name is displayed in the "<Last Name>, <First Name>" format.-Open the employee's record.-In the new screen, the employee's name is displayed in the "<First Name> <Last Name>" format, or even show an additional name.-Cause-The name format is not the same in all views because in OWLs, the Business Partner Sort Name field is used, to facilitate sorting based on last name. In the employee's record, the field used is Business Partner Formatted Name, which will be displayed according to the format set for the respective employee's country/region in the General Business Partner fine-tuning activity of the Business Configuration work center (under the "Maintain Name Formats" section). This field is also the one used in Account Team tabs within customer records, for example.-The same is also valid for other business partners, such as contacts.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior and it is planned to be enhanced in future releases.-Keywords-Name Format, Employee, Contact-employee,name format,people,contact

Title: Error OBJECTS_OBJREF_NOT_ASSIGNED
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the error OBJECTS_OBJREF_NOT_ASSIGNED when trying to update an Over-the-Counter or Customer Invoice Request via Web Service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Send the Payload Request using any middleware.-Cause-When using External Invoice Request in Over-the-Counter or Customer Invoice Request, it is expected that the gross amount of the transaction would be greater than 0 (zero).-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please ensure that the value being used for gross amount is greater than 0 (zero).-Keywords-OBJECTS_OBJREF_NOT_ASSIGNED, Over-the-Counter, Customer Invoice Request, gross amount, Web Service

Title: Avalara Error due to Incomplete Account Address
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Orders).-Click Edit button.-Process Communication Error under the Sales Order document.-Go to the BO Test Shell (SESFTS).-Sender Party: CustomerRequirementProcessing-Receiver Name Interface: SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn     -Error Information: Error message CM_APTC_TAX_CALCULATOR must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task       -Message ID: 00163E0E38B11EEAB4EF36B9D8AA233B-Double Click on the XI message ID.-Select the Error Information.-Search for the following:----------MSGID        EXTTAX_MSG----------MSGNO        007-Search for /ose91-Enter Message ID and Message Number-Click Display-Result: The error is because of there is an inconsistency between Business ByDesign and Avalara.-/0SE24-Enter Object Type: CL_EXTTAX_TAX_CALC_PROVIDER_RS-Click Display-Double click on Method:-<IF_EXTTAX_TAX_CALCULATOR> REQUEST_TAX_CALCULATION-Enter a break point in the line 120 "IF lv_response IS NOT INITIAL."-Go back to the BO Test Shell-Restart the error message-Double click on the "IF lv_response IS NOT INITIAL"-Double Click on LV_RESPONSE-Copy message below:-  To retrieve the full message, you may use the Services of the Tool to extract the information.-  {-"ResultCode": "Error",-"Messages": [-{-"Summary": "Tax calculation cannot be determined. Zip is not valid for the state.",-"Details": "The provided address contains a postal code and state combination that is not valid.",-"RefersTo": "Addresses[2]",-"Severity": "Error",-"Source": "Avalara.AvaTax.Services.Tax"}-]-}-Cause-The information maintained under the Sales Order's master data, was incomplete, and for this reason Avalara is not being able to validade de the information.-Resolution-1.-If customer is able to update the Address information in the Sales Order.-Please ask the customer to update.-Once this is confirmed, please restart/reconcile the erro.-  2. Title: How to delete the cache for all reports and data sources
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Use Only ***-*** To be done by the Analytics team only ***-Some issue may require a deletion of the cache of a report or data source. If the number of affected reports or data sources is very high, you may want to delete the cache for all objects in one go.-The error messages you may encounter could be:-'Internal error in OLAP processor occurred - restart your report'-'Technical error occurred: An exception occurred'-'Technical error occurred: Message E R7 245 cannot be processed in plug-in mode HTTPS'-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Before performing the steps below, please note:-It is always preferable to delete the cache of a specific data source or report via MDRS (see KBA <1858240 - OLAP and Technical Error Occurs When Executing a Report>). Please try this approach first, and only proceed with the steps below if it is not successful.-Once all the cache is deleted, all reports will load a little longer the first one or two times. The customer should be made aware of this.-To delete the cache for all analytical objects, please log on to the backend and proceed as follows:-Go transaction SE16;-Open the DB-Table MDRS_MDAV_MODEL_CONFIG;-Click on create New Entries;-Name: DEACTIVATE;-Value: X;-Click on Table Entry > Save-Open the transaction ANAST;-Click on MDRS_ANA_INVALIDATE_LOAD;-Select MDAV;-Execute.-See Also-KBA 1858240 - OLAP and Technical Error Occurs When Executing a Report-Keywords-data source, report, inconsistent, delete cache, analytics, MDRS_ANA_INVALIDATE_LOAD, invalidate runtime object, Internal error in OLAP processor occurred - restart your report, Technical error occurred: An exception occurred, Technical error occurred: Message E R7 245 cannot be processed in plug-in mode HTTPS

Title: Functionalities in SAP Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-Your business requirement is to use SAP Excel Add-In for reporting purposes and for that it is needed to understand it better.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1. Open-Opens existent Excel workbooks saved in Business Analytics work center.-2. Save All-Saves the current workbook to the SAP System.-3. Workbooks-Personal Workbook-A personal workbook can be a workbook created and saved by you, or maybe a modification of a public workbook that is stored in the system-Public Workbook-A public workbook is either existent in the system or has been defined the key user-Design Workbook-Very similar to the work center Business Analytics and used to design a report, before publishing it. In order to publish it, just make it a Public Workbook.-4. Insert Report-Insert a report from your SAP system to an active cell in the current workbook-5. Copy Report-Copies the report along with its current view and value selection-6. Paste Report-Paste the previously copied report-7. Remove Report-Deletes the report from the cell range-8. Protect-Prevents the report from unwanted changes. The cell range is locked, while the rest of the worksheet can be edited-9. Refresh-Refreshes the data of the current report. You can also make use of the “Refresh Automatically” function and choose between “When Worksheet is Activated” and “When Worksheet is Open” options-10. Defer Refresh-Stops all reports in the current workbook from being automatically refreshed-11. Paging-Inserts pagination in the report-12. View-Choose between the existent views for the current report-13. Selection-Choose between the existent selections for the current report-14. Mark Selected-Marks cells that you select to be sent back to the system. By marking selected cells, you set the value for the cell. The value therefore does not change when you redistribute values by clicking Refresh-15. Unmark All-Unmarks all selected cells-16. Insert Header-Inserts technical information of the current report-17. Navigate-Jumps to another report in different worksheets or opens the current report in the Web Browser-18. Insert Chart-Insert a chart with the report data-19. Grid Display-Displays the report using the solution cell styles in the Microsoft Excel grid, or in a Pivot Table-20. Settings-Freeze Panes-Uses the Microsoft Excel freeze pane function to fix the header columns and rows-Format Report-Formats the report using the default SAP Business solution cell styles as listed under the Microsoft Excel Home tab-Adjust to Complete Column-Adjusts the width of columns to the width of the longest value in each column-Adjust to Report Result-Adjusts the column width to the width of the longest value in the column.-Use Outline for Hierarchies-Uses the Microsoft Excel outline function to group characteristic hierarchies by expansion level.-Expand Rows to Level-You can choose the hierarchy level up to which the hierarchy is to be displayed when it is expanded.-Merge Repeated Cells-You can specify whether every instance of a characteristic value is displayed in a row or column.-Show Results First-You can specify how results are to be displayed. You can decide if they are to be displayed above rows or to the left of columns.-Arrange As Hierarchy-The system arranges characteristics in rows and in columns as a hierarchy. The row or column further left serves as the tree structure into which characteristics to the right are inserted.-Invert Hierarchies-The system inverts the hierarchy so that the hierarchy is displayed from bottom to top or from right to left. You can decide to invert a hierarchy in rows and in columns.-Suppress Zero Values-You can suppress columns or rows that contain zeros in your report.-Key Figures-Converts all the key figures currencies-Report Data Settings-Shows extended text instead of 60 characters per cell-Show / Hide-Shows or hides the following:-View-Variables-Planning-Header-Messages-You can specify if all messages or only errors are displayed. You can also decide if messages are displayed on user request.-Dynamic Paging-You can retrieve report data in chunks rather than all at once. To do this, go to Show/Hide  Dynamic Paging. The system opens a dialog box. Select the Dynamic Paging checkbox and in the Page Size field, enter the desired number of data that you want to run at one go.-Keywords-excel, sap excel addin, functionalities, excel addin, addin, workbook,-excel,excel add-in

Title: Error While Setting Concur Expense Status to Failed - Registration for OAUTH not found for user XYZ
Content: Symptom-When setting an Expense Report from Concur to Failed an error is prompt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur - Expense Reports view.-Find the relevant Expense Report.-Click Change Status to Failed.-Error is prompt: Registration for OAUTH not found for user XYZ.-XYZ - Is the relevant User Technical ID.-Cause-This error is caused due to User that is not registered under User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services.-Resolution-The steps to add the user can be found in Step 2.3.6 - Register User for OAUTH Web Services on SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide.-The link to the Guide can be found under References.-Keywords-concur,registration for oauth not found for use,expense report

Title: Wrong Form template is Picked
Content: Symptom-A form template rule was set up, but the form is not picked correctly.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Selection and set a rule i.e. for Sales Quotes. For example the template is "SAP Sales Quote"-If you preview any Sales quotes - still the Form "Sales Quote" is picked and not as expected the "SAP Sales Quote"-Cause-There are two ways of maintaining form template rules: -a) Via the form template rules-b) On Account Level-For setup on account Level, go to the Accounts work centre view.-Edit any Account and click View all. Navigate to the communication tab sub tab collaborations. Here you can maintain a template of your desire and it will overrule the form template rules.-Resolution-Maintain the correct template on account level or remove any form template from the account level and the form template rules will work.-Keywords-Wrong template, Form Templates, Form template rules

Title: Error While Resetting a Manual Clearing: 'Calcellation not possible; cancel last clearing first'
Content: Symptom-You cannot reset a Manual Clearing due to the error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Select the relevant Journal Entry ID related to clearing.-Click View.-Open the Source Document XXX.-Press View All.-Click Reset Clearing.-System raises the error message 'Cancellation not possible; cancel last clearing first'.-XXX - Manual Clearing ID-Cause-The error is raised because there are Released Tax Adjustments available in the system for at least one of the Invoices included in the Manual Clearing and this would be an inconsistent transaction.-You can identify the Invoices that have Tax Adjustments using the following steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Adjustments view.-Resolution-To reset the Manual Clearing it is necessary to cancel the Tax Adjustments for the Invoices maintained in the Clearing.-Once you have identified the affected Invoices, the Tax Adjustments can be canceled as follows:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Adjustments view.-Select the relevant Tax Adjustment.-Click Actions -> Cancel.-Keywords-Manual Clearing, Invoice, Tax Adjustment.

Title: Calendar Quarter Characteristic in Opportunities, Quotes or Sales Orders Volume Reports
Content: Symptom-You ran the report for Opportunities, Sales Quotes, Sales Orders, and select the Characteristic: Calendar Quarter.-You expect to see the months based on your Fiscal Year configuration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Select Opportunity Volume Report (for example).-Select the Characteristic: Calendar Quarter. -Run the Report.-The months are based on Calendar Year and not according to your Fiscal Year configuration.-Cause-Reports like the Opportunity, Sales Quotes, Sales Orders Volume are not based on the Fiscal Year but in Calendar Year. Also the characteristics available are related to Calendar Periods, e.g. Calendar Quarter, Month Calendar Year.-Currently, the reports that would select data based on the Fiscal Year of a corresponding date, would usually be the Accounting Reports (G/L Line Item, Journal, etc) where there is a Journal Entry posted in the respective period and the period can be used as selection parameter.-Resolution-This is the current design of such reports.-If required, as a partner you can evaluate the possibilities of enhancing the required reports via extension fields, custom add-ons, to work with a different selection or even create a custom report via PDI.-You can also access our Influence Platform for suggesting it as new idea, or post question in our Community.-See Also-Note that you may also refer to Characteristics Index to have an overview of all available characteristics in the system.-Keywords-Reports, Calendar Year, Calendar Quarter, Fiscal Year

Title: Sales Quote not Automatically Rejected
Content: Symptom-When you creation a New Version of an existing Sales Quote, you expected that the system would automatically reject/complete the Master Quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Master Quote).-The system returns two Open Sales Quotes. The Master Quote and the New Version.-Cause-As per the blog How to create version of a sales quote, the system does not complete the older quote, since "at the end, the customer will decide which of the sales quotes he will accept and close the deal."-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. --In regards to the completion or auto rejection of the document, this has to be performed manually, by performing the following steps:-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Select ID ABC.-Click Actions.-Click Reject.-Enter a Cancellation Reason.-Click OK-Now the will be Rejected and the status will change to Completed.-See Also-Help Center: How to create version of a sales quote-Keywords-Sales Quote, New Version, Master Quote, Reject, Complete
