Title: Logistics Area Missing When Confirming Execution for a Service Order
Content: Symptom-When confirming execution for the Service Order XXX the Logistics Area for a Spare Part is missing and you cannot enter it manually. (XXX represents the ID of the Service Order).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Find the Service Order XXX.-Open the Service Order XXX.-Select Confirm Execution, the New Service Confirmation screen will open.-Select View All.-Choose Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select the relevant Line Item.-Select Part(s) Consumption subtab.-Notice that there is no Logistics Area proposed and you cannot enter it manually, as it is grayed out.-Cause-In order to determine the Logistics Area the Ship-From needs to be determined.-If the Location of Service Provision is Own Service Center, the Ship-From for the Item will be determined from the Service Center maintained in the Service Location.-If the Location of Service Provision is On-Site, the Ship-From for the Item will be determined from the Service Execution Team.-To check this, you can follow the steps:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Find the Service Order XXX.-Open the Service Order XXX.-Choose View All.-Go to the General tab and the Account and Affected Product sub tab.-In the section Service Location for the field Service Execution Team you selected either:-Own Service Center and did not maintain a Service Center.-or-On-Site and when you navigate to the Main Information sub tab you can see that you did not maintain a Service Execution Team.-Hence the Logistics Area will not be determined.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In order to maintain a Logistics Area you need to maintain a Service Center if you use the Location of Service Provision is Own Service Center or a Service Execution Team is you use the the Location of Service Provision is On-Site.-Keywords-Ship-From; Logistic area; Digi; Spare Part; Service Confirmation, Location of Service Provision; Service;

Title: Memo Lines are not Automatically Created for Bank-to-Bank Transfers
Content: Symptom-You would like to set up payment correspondence profiles for bank-to-bank transfers to automatically generate memo lines. The aim is to automatically match the cash transfer with the payment allocation, via memo line rules, upon bank statement upload later in the process, however the memo line is not being automatically created when posting the bank-to-bank transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under Common Tasks, click New Bank-to-Bank Transfer.-Input all the required fields and post the payment.-Upon posting, the memo line is not being automatically generated, based on the payment correspondence profiles, as it happens for other outgoing bank transfers.-Cause-The current correspondence profiles for outgoing bank transfer do not support bank-to-bank transfers, therefore the memo line field is not automatically populated.-Resolution-The memo line for bank-to-bank transfers can be manually maintained before posting the payment.-Nevertheless, the system wouldn't need the memo line rules to assign a cash transfer to a payment allocation automatically. Whenever a bank statement is posted, the system already tries to generate an allocation proposal where the company/self-initiated payment takes precedence and cash transfers are identified for an automatic allocation.-Hence, if you have a In Transfer bank to bank transfer and the bank statement line item has a corresponding payment method (Incoming/Outgoing Bank Transfer) and an exact matching amount, then the cash transfer shall be automatically allocated.-Keywords-Bank Statement. Cash Transfer. Memo Line. Automatic Allocation. Automatically Allocated. Payment Allocation. DME.

Title: Wrong VAT Translation for Portuguese
Content: Symptom-When previewing a Customer Invoice document, you see that the description for VAT in Portuguese is showing "Imposto sobre valor agregado" and not "Imposto sobre valor acrescentado".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Preview.-The description for the VAT shows as the following: Imposto sobre valor agregado p/ Port. (23 %).-Cause-Both translations are correction, however, the displayed value of "Imposto sobre valor agregado" is the most common value used in Brazil.  The standard translation in SAP Business ByDesign is the Brazilian Portuguese.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-What can be used to perform text changes, is the Customer Language Adaptation Tool.-See Also-Customer Language Adaptation Tool Guide-Keywords-VAT, Imposto Sobre, Valor Agregado, Translation

Title: Unable to Maintain Contact's Business Communication Details in Account
Content: Symptom-You are trying to maintain a contact's business communication information (E-mail, Fax, Phone etc.), but you observed these fields are uneditable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Access the Customers work center view.-Select the relevant account. -Click Edit, then select Contacts.-Notice that the Business Communication fields are read-only and can't be edited.-Cause-Business communication fields for Contacts are dependent on the account–contact relatioship address information, which is shown as Business Address for the contacts. If the corresponding account itself does not have an address maintained, then the contact's business address would be empty — hence, this communication information cannot be maintained.-Resolution-Maintain address information for the account, to do so,-Go to the Account Management work center.-Access the Accounts work center.-Find and open the relevant account.-Navigate to the Communication tab, then the Addresses sub-tab.-Click Add Row.-Maintain the necessary address information.-Click Save (or Save and Close).-Now open the corresponding contact record and ensure the Business Address is reflected properly. If not, then manually assign the Business Address from the Account.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Navigate to the Contacts work center view.-Find and select the relevant contact.-Click Edit, then select Addresses.-Check if the contact has a row of address type Business Address with the information from the relevant account.-If this is now correct, it should be possible to edit Business Communication data for this contact in the account's screen.-Keywords-Contact, E-Mail, Address, Business Communication, Read-only, Can't Edit

Title: Non-Localized Country: Only One Withholding Tax Line Is Calculated For a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-For a non-localized country, you need two withholding tax lines calculated in a supplier invoice (for example, regular withholding tax and withholding tax on VAT line item); However, this is not working as system only calculates one line.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Click New Invoice Without Purchase Order view.-Enter required data such as Supplier, Buying Company, etc. and click View All.-Enter Product, Quantity and Net Price.-Click Taxes tab > Withholding Tax Details sub-tab.-In case the automatic withholding tax determination doesn't happen (Withholding Tax Code is blank), select the withholding tax code manually.-Notice that two withholding tax lines are displayed, however the system it not able to compute taxes on both, only in the first one.-Cause-In your SAP Cloud Application Studio you are using standard withholding tax calculation procedure to calculate withholding taxes. Standard procedure will support only one level of tax type, and for the non-localized country there are multiple withholding tax types.-Resolution-You need to create a custom withholding tax calculation procedure and implement it accordingly.-See Also-For further information, please check PDF document "Enable Withholding Tax for NonLocalized Countries in SAP Cloud Applications Studio" > section 5.2 Configure Tax Calculation Procedure (Optional), available in SAP Business ByDesign Localization Toolkit.-The Localization Toolkit is available in SAP  Business  ByDesign–Localization  Jam  Page (by invitation only).-Keywords-wht lines; withholding tax supplier invoice; non-localized country; tax calculation procedure; localization toolkit

Title: Application log information for this run is not available when opening Application Log for File Input Run
Content: Symptom-You want to view the Application log of a File Input run, for example of Service Interface type 'Vertex Tax Rate File Upload Save'. But the message 'Application log information for this run is not available' appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the File Input view.-Select the respective run ID.-Go to the Execution Details sub-tab.-In the Application Log ID collumn click on the relevant ID. -The error 'Application log information for this run is not available' appears.-Cause-File Input Application logs are only available for 7 days after the Execution. But you are trying to open the Application Log for a run that was executed more than 7 days ago.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Application log information; Application Log; File Input Runs; Vertex-application log,application log information,file input runs,vertex

Title: Invoice Schedule Dates Not Copied in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When creating a copy from an existing Sales Order with Invoice Schedule, the Invoice Schedule Dates change Start Date / End Date Values to be ABC and XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the current Sales Order).-Click Copy.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Click Invoice Schedule.-Click Edit Invoicing Time Frame.-Start Date: 05.10.2022.-End Date: 02.02.2031.-These dates don't match the dates from the source Sales Order.-Cause-This is system behavior.-When you copy a sales order, you are copying the data and the current configuration. -In the case of invoice schedules for items, we first check the original /  source Sales Order Posting Date and the original / source Sales Order Invoice Schedule Start Date. We locate the difference between these two dates.  For example, the difference between the two dates is 100 days.-When the new invoice schedule is being created on the NEW document, we take the posting date for this NEW document (which defaults to the current day), and we add the mentioned difference on this date.-This ensures that the invoicing period matches the same as the old document. This does not necessarily mean that the same dates will be shown, but the same time difference will be applied.-Resolution-To have the expected dates, please modify the newly created document dates as needed.-Keywords-Sales Order, Invoice Schedule, Copy, Date, Change, Wrong

Title: Error When Updating Price/Discount List via Microsoft Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload an excel file to update a price/discount list, but faces an error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Discount Lists view.-Select the Discount List.-Download the Microsoft Excel file.-Try to send the data in the Microsoft Excel file.-You face an error.-Cause-The excel upload does not work for custom price list/discount list when it contains a Standard Header table with a Custom Item table.-The system is designed to support the following:-Standard Header + Standard Item table-Custom Header + Standard Item table-Custom Header + Custom Item table-Resolution-This is the expect system behavior.-If you would like to proceed with the custom item table, please create a custom header table and assigned this to the price list/discount list.-See Also-SAP ByDesign Price Determination using Extension Fields.-Keywords-Price List, Discount List, Excel, Upload, Update, Error, Standard, Custom

Title: Clearing Split Invoice Open Items via Bank Advice Web Service
Content: Symptom-You have an open customer invoice in the customer account monitor, which you have split into smaller open items. When you import a bank advice with reference to this invoice, you expect that the system automatically clears the bank advice against one of the split items. However, the payment remains on account and the clearing does not happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center. -Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the customer account monitor.-You have some split items and the created bank advice via web service remains open on account.-Cause-In this specific case, the split items have all the exact same amount and exact same due dates. Therefore, the open items overlapp and the system cannot select one for the clearing against the bank advice.-Resolution-When splitting the original invoice via customer account monitor, you may either create the split items with different amounts or make them have different Due Dates. The due dates for the split items can be set upon creating the splits in the table 'New Split Items' and columns 'Net Due Date'.-For other reasons and solutions on why the automatic clearing may not happen, you may refer to the KBAs mentioned in below section.-See Also-2589692 - Automatic Clearing Between Bank Advice Created via Web Service and Invoice is Not Working-2490272 - Automatic Clearing of Bank Advices via Web Service and Open Invoices-Keywords-Bank Payment Advice. Automatic Clearing. Open Items. Customer Invoice. Web Service. ManageBankAdviceIn.

Title: Error in Broadcast: Test recipient e-mail address is missing in the business configuration
Content: Symptom-Your broadcast fails with the following error message:-Test recipient e-mail address is missing in the business configuration-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Choose the view Broadcasts .-Search for your broadcast and check the Last Broadcast Run tab.-It failed with the above error message.-Cause-Your system is a test system and it is currently configured to send all outgoing emails to 1 email address only, instead of sending them to the actual recipients. However, as the error message in the broadcast indicates, this email address was not specified.-Resolution-Please either change your business configuration so that the emails are sent to the actual recipients, or alternatively maintain an email address.-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Choose the view Overview.-Search for the activity 'E-mail and fax settings' and open it.-Click 'E-mail and fax settings'.-The relevant settings need to be made in the section 'E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System'.-See Also-KBA: 2585650 - Broadcast E-mails are Not Received by the Recipients-Keywords-broadcast, error message, not delivered, not sent, Test recipient e-mail address is missing in the business configuration

Title: Login of technical User Not Available in Reports
Content: Symptom-Logon details on SAP Technical User cannot be seen in Reports-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Reports View under Analysis Work Center - Open report of User Logon Details-Filter for user " Support and Technical user" with SAP technical user id, say of pattern *_xyz*-No Report generated even though the user has logged into the system-Cause-It is not possible to provide the Records on login and logout details of the SAP Technical Users.-These users are back end users created by the system/admin to execute tasks.-Login information is not available for these users, as they do not have access to front end features or the UI.-For this reason, login data is not available as the users have very limited access to the front end, and those front end features are responsible for capturing data like login info.-These users are solely for back end use by the system, and as a result should not be logged in to, and due to the very limited front end access, there should be no reasons for this user to be logged in.-Resolution-This is expected System behaviour.-Keywords-Technical User, Logon Details, Reports, Analysis Work center.

Title: Payment Statistics Report Shows Wrong Average Number of Days Until Net Due Date
Content: Symptom-You are running the Payment Statistics - Customer report and noticed that the keyfigure Average Number of Days Until Due Date does not calculate the expected average.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open Payment Statistics - Customer report.-Execute the report for a given customer ID and posting period.-The report shows and unexpected Average Number of Days Until Net Due Date.-Cause-The Average Number of Days Until Net Due Date key figure picks the maximum value of the difference between invoice and payment date for a given customer account.-Resolution-To get the exact average, you have to add to the report the Customer Invoice ID characteristic to the rows. Once this characteristic is added, the average is calculated.-Keywords-Payment Statistics, Receivables, Payables, Clearing.

Title: Service Order Does not Show in Service Order Statistics Report (CRMSORHB_Q0004)
Content: Symptom-You are using the Service Order Statistics Report (CRMSORHB_Q0004), and you noticed that some Service Order documents are not showing in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the List view.-Open the report Service Order Statistics (CRMSORHB_Q0004).-Execute the report.-Service Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Order) is not showing in the report-Cause-The report will only display/retrieve Service Order documents which fall within the following parameters:-1. Consistent (The document is not in errors).--AND--2. Released OR Not Relevant (The Service Status of the Item).-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-2726367 - Service Order Statistics Report Shows Incorrect Amount of Service Orders-Keywords-Service Order Statistics, Report, CRMSORHB, Consistency, Release, Not Relevant, Missing, Not Showing

Title: Error While Migrating Materials: Error detected in source record with key value 'XYZ'
Content: Symptom-Error received while migrating Materials: Error detected in source record with key value 'XYZ'.-XYZ - Corresponds to the Material ID in the file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Migration of Materials.-Click Open.-Click Migrate materials using the migration tool.-Select the relevant Migration Unit.-Click Execute Migration - Execute Migration Step by Step.-The Log shows:-Statistics: Errors detected during import simulation-Import Simulation (1 Errors Found, 0 Warnings Found):-Error detected in source record with key value 'FMXTAG-READER'-Goto Correction-Edit Source Record-Service call failed; report an incident-Cause-A possible cause for this error is that the Business Residence used in the file doesn't belong to the Company ID used.-For example, you used Company ID XXX and Business Residence ID YYY, however the Business Residence ID YYY belongs to Company ID ZZZ.-During the migration the system will generate the links on Valuation using this information, since the system is not able to find said Business Residence to allocate on Valuation the system gives error.-XXX means Company ID.-YYY means Business Residence ID.-ZZZ means Company ID.-Resolution-Check on Organizational Structure the correct Business Residence ID and adjust the file.-This can also be tested by manually creating a Material to check if the Business Residence ID will show for selection.-Keywords-Migration of Material, Valuation, migration, Error detected in source record with key value, Service call failed-migration of material,valuation,migration,error detected in source record with key,service call failed

Title: Billing Organization (Customer Invoice ID) Shows No Text for UUID
Content: Symptom-You see the following result "No Text for UUID" when running a standard report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will be using the report Aging List for Receivables [FINDUEU04_Q0008]-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Search for the 'Aging List for Receivables [FINDUEU04_Q0008]' report.-Open the report.-Filter with the following parameters:-Company: ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Company).-Cut Off Date: Today.-1st Due Period in Days: 30.-2nd Due Period in Days: 60.-3rd Due Period in Days: 90.-4th Due Period in Days: 120.-Run the report.-Go to View.-Add Fields to Row.-Add 'Billing Organization (Customer Invoice ID)' field.-You can see 'No Text for UUID' as result.-Cause-For Reports the navigation is there for Business Partner in the data source not for Organizational unit.-In case where 'Billing Organization (Customer Invoice ID) is not having value please rely on Billing Party (Customer Invoice ID) which also has the expected value.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign.-Keywords-Report, Data Source, Business Partner, No Text for UUID, UUID, Customer Invoice

Title: Data Source Cannot be Used as Join Member
Content: Symptom-You are trying to join a HCM or CRM data source with another data source but you receive the following error message "Datasource cannot be added. Temporal Joins are only allowed as Anchor."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics > Design Data Sources.-Find the data source.-Click on New > Join Data Source.-Enter a name and click Next.-Select your fields and complete this step.-Go to the Joined Data Sources tab and click Add.-Select another data source which you would like to add to the first.-See the error message:  "Datasource cannot be added. Temporal Joins are only allowed as Anchor."-Cause-There are few data sources that use temporal joins. Such data sources can only be used as the anchor data source.-The data sources with temporal joins are:--Employee Turnover HCMPAU01-Employee Times HCMTLMU01-Employee Master Data HCMEMPB-Service Request History CRMSRQHHB-Headcount HCMPAB01-Actual Utilization HCMRPMU03-Employee Recorded Times HCMTLMB07-Employee Time Accounts HCMTLMU02--The reason why is because it uses a characteristic as a temporal key member of its query, and therefore it cannot be used for Join Data Sources as it would affect the overall result once the query is executed.-Resolution-You can use the data sources that have this particular characteristic to create a combined data source with another application data source. However, this will very likely result in performance issues due to huge data processing, eventually leading to time out dumps. Applying very specific filtering in report level would be mandatory in this scenario, but according to the total system data amount this may still result in time out issues.-See Also-2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling Data Sources and Reports-1779804 - Report Based on Employee Times Data Source is Timing Out-Keywords-Employee Turnover HCMPAU01, Employee Times HCMTLMU01, Employee Master Data HCMEMPB, Cannot join data source, error join, a temporal join.

Title: Item Pricing Information Not Available In Reports
Content: Symptom-You would like to include information like unit price, surcharges, discount, material cost, profit margin, etc of sales and purchasing document in a report. You find that standard reports like Monitoring Purchase Orders or Sales Order Volume can provide information on total price level. But there is no key figure that displays the unit price or the discounted unit price that is used to calculate the total.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In the current SAP Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer architecture, the pricing business object does not have the replication feature available. For this reason fields related to List Prices per Sales or Purchasing Unit are not extended to data sources.-Resolution-For now this requirement is not feasible to be delivered, however it is on our backlog list. At this stage we are not able to foresee precisely in which release it will be available.-Note that to consider a re-factoring of the pricing business objects, this will require a new code and remodeling of topology so that this information can be extended to SRM / CRM or any other data sources. This request was strongly considered. -Keywords-Unit Price, surcharges, discount, material cost, profit margin, Monitoring Purchase Orders, Sales Order, key Figure.

Title: Identified Stock Quantity Conversion Not Considered in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you create a Customer Invoice from a scenario where there is a Quantity Conversion maintained in the Identified Stock used, you notice that the system is not considering that configuration, which in turn causes an unexpected Value in the Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find Invoice ABC (Where ABC Represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Open and View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow.- Here, you can verify that the Outbound Delivery uses an Identified Stock which has a Quantity Conversion maintained, for example: 1 EA = 15kg.- However, when checking the Value of the Customer Invoice, you notice that the system did not take this Conversion into consideration when calculating the Values of the item(s).-Cause-The system currently does not support any conversions based on Identified Stock information.-Resolution-The system will only consider conversions maintained in the Product Masterdata. You can maintain this information by following these steps:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search for the Product DEF (DEF represents the Product ID).-Edit the Product and go to the General tab.-Change the Quantity Conversion Rule maintained and click the Save button.- In a case where the scenario has a conversion maintained both in the Product Masterdata and the Identified Stock, the system will only consider the information from the Product Masterdata.-Keywords- Identified Stock, Masterdata, Conversion, UoM, Pick Task, Product, Conversion, Customer Invoice

Title: Custom Filter Does Not Show Any Results
Content: Symptom-When trying to use a custom filter in any work center view of the system (for example, accounts and sales orders), the result list shows no records, or fewer records than expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-After creating a new custom query using the advanced filter, apply the query to a certain dataset.-Cause-This happens because the query is executed on top of the current dataset selected.-Taking as an example the Accounts screen, if you apply the custom query when "All Accounts" is selected, the results will be different from when you apply it on top of the dataset "My Accounts".-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-custom query, custom selection, filter ; no data ; no results found ; no data found ; filter ; results ; organize ; adaptation ; master layout ; layout

Title: How to Add a Customized Party Role to your Sales Document Using Account Responsibility
Content: Symptom-You have defined a new party role in the activity Involved Parties for Sales, but it is not showing up as default for selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You would need to define your party role in fine-tuning and define an Account Responsibility rule.-Resolution-To define the party role in fine-tuning:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview work center view.-Find and open the activity Party Role Definition.-Add a party role and tick the box Responsibility Role.-Next, you will need to define an account responsibility rule in order to add your party role to the specific account or all accounts-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution work center view.-Go to the Employee Work Distribution sub-view.-Select Account Responsibility by Party Role.-You can now define a specific employee for your party role.-Finally, you need to add the party role to the fine-tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Find and open the activity Involved Parties for Sales.-Add the party role-If you want to trigger an error message in your sales order in case this party is no filled by the user, please tick the Mandatory check box.

Title: Where to Find Country and its Respective Postal Code Length?
Content: Symptom-Where to find Country and its respective Postal Code length in Business ByDesign System?-Resolution-It is not possible to find out Countries and its respective Postal Code length in Business ByDesign system. For Postal Codes, we follow the international rules in the coding. Hence you can look into the following internet page:--http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_postal_codes-Address Formatting is determined by standards set by the postal organizations:-https://www.upu.int/en/Postal-Solutions/Programmes-Services/Addressing-Solutions#scroll-nav__5-You can also setup/find the Postal Code setting as per Countries under "Countries" fine tuning activity

Title: The Monthly Invoice Generates a Tax Difference of 1 JPY - Yen
Content: Symptom-You notice that the monthly invoice generates a tax difference of 1 JPY - Yen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Invoice Summary Documents view.-Open the relevant Monthly Invoice.-There is a Total Tax Difference of 1 JPY - Yen.-Cause-This is the correct system behavior:  The difference occurs due to the rounding of each individual invoice and the rounding of the monthly invoice that adds all other invoice amounts.-For example:-Invoice ABC has a tax base amount of 153 with a tax rate of 10%, it would generate a 15.3 tax amount, since JYP has no decimals, it will round to 15.-Invoice DEF  has a tax base amount of 153 with a tax rate of 10%, it would generate a 15.3 tax amount, since JYP has no decimals, it will round to 15.-On the monthly invoice XYZ, both tax base amounts add up to 306. With a tax rate of 10%, the generated tax amount is 30.6.  Since JYP has no decimals, it will round to 31.-The tax amount of the Invoices ABC and DEF adds up to 30, while the monthly invoice XYZ has a total tax amount of 31. It will generate the 1 JPY - Yen in the tax difference.-(ABC, DEF are two different invoice IDs, XYZ represents the monthly invoice ID).-Resolution-System is working as expected.-Keywords-Tax Difference, Monthly Invoice, JPY-tax difference,montly invoice,jpy

Title: Placeholder in Email text or email Subject is not showing the Correct Date Format
Content: Symptom-Placeholder in e-mail text or e-mail Subject is not showing the Correct Date Format.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work centre-Go to the Form Template maintenance view-Find a Customer invoice-Click Actions-Either create an e-mail template or maintain an e-mail subject.-Result: the date format will be that which is maintained in the template.-Cause-Neither the e-mail template nor the e-mail subject can be converted via a script.-Resolution-If if the placeholder is  XML <PaymentDate>2020-11-27</PaymentDate> please be aware that the date format will be shown as-2020-11-27. As of now there is no way of converting this format into i.e. 27.11.2010-Keywords-E-mail Template, e-mail Subject, date format

As a general statement all printer which can handle the PDF printer language should be fine.-Keywords-Printer, Drucker, supported printer, unterstützte Drucker, recommended printer, recommend printer

Title: Chart Colours in 1808
Content: Symptom-You opened a report chart in the 1808 release and realized that the colors are different than in 1805.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to RUI.-Go to the View Reports or the Work Center Analysis and then to the View Reports.-Search for the report Open Incidents (technical ID /ITSAM/SAPSRB_Q0001) for example.-Open the report and change the table to the bar chart as an example.-You will notice that the colors look different than in the 1805 release in RUI.-Cause-The default chart colors have been updated with 1808. This is the expected system behavior and works as designed.-Resolution-In the report go to Show Chart Settings.-On the right-hand side, you will find Change Chart Color Palette.-By clicking on the key figure name (for example IRT exceeded), you will get a new popup window.-In the new window, you will find the option to change the color.-To get the exact same color as they were in 1805, you have the option to enter the hex color code in the last row (#). For the report Open Incidents you can enter the following codes:-MPT exceeded = fac364-Automatically generated = 8cd3ff-Open Incidents = 5cbae6-IRT Exceeded = b6d957-Other default hex color codes can be found below:-8cd3ff-d998cb-f2d249-93b9c6-ccc5a8-52bacc-dbdb46-98aafb-27a3dd-9dc62d-f8ac29-See Also-The setting for custom chart colors is not available, if a key figure was added to the rows or a characteristic was added to the columns in a report. Further information can be found on our SAP Help Portal here.-Keywords-chart; color; colour; 1808; new colours

Title: How to find the corresponding ABAP code line to an ABSL script line
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY -You want to find an ABAP script line which corresponds to an ABSL line of code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-Open the tenant's backend and go to XREP transaction to find the ABSL script.-Find the line of the code e.g. 123 (123 represents the line of code) of the ABSL script file that you need and note the line number in the bottom right-hand corner of the screen.-Open the transaction SE24.-Type the first three letters of the solution ID plus an asterisk e.g. YAB* and click the OVS.-In the pop-up window displayed, find the name of the Business Object in the Short Description column. e.g. BoName.Root : ABSL Runtime Class and double-click.-Once the PDI class is selected, you can click on Display to see a list of the ABSL scripts for the Business Object. (In ABAP, we are checking the list of methods for the given class).-Now double-click the relevant event or action (method) as found with the previous steps.-This opens the corresponding ABAP file of the ABSL file we started with.-Check the ABSL file path at the top of the window to make sure that it is the correct one (the one you are looking for).-Some lines in the ABAP code will have the following: ABSL_SCRCPOS [x] [xy]-The [x] number represents the ABSL code line and the [xy] number represents the line column.-Keywords-ABAP, ABSL, code, line, correspond, corresponding, script, number, file, debug, path

Title: Unable to Use Pro forma Invoices With the Goods Stated for Customer Returns
Content: Symptom-While trying to generate Pro forma Invoices with the Goods Stated for Customer Returns, Error message is shown.-Determining item type with parameters Outbound Delivery, Delivery Return Item, Increase not Possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Outbound Deliveries View.-Select Return to Customer Delivery ABC (ABC refers to Return to Customer Delivery No)-Select Pro Forma Invoice.-Following error message is triggered.-Determining item type with parameters Outbound Delivery, Delivery Return Item, Increase not Possible.-Cause-You can only create a pro forma invoice if the following prerequisites are fulfilled:◦-     Outbound delivery is consistent, and not canceled-     Sales order must be consistent and is not rejected-     Sales quote must be consistent, open, approved, and not canceled-Pro Forma Invoice does not support the following scenarios listed below.-     Service scenarios-     Return to Supplier-     Intracompany Stock Transfer-Resolution-In this case Return to Customer is linked to Service Scenario, Hence this is not supported.-This is the system behavior as designed.-Keywords-Unable to Use Pro forma Invoices With the Goods Stated for Customer Returns, Pro Forma Invoice does not support the following scenarios listed below.-     Service scenarios-     Return to Supplier-     Intracompany Stock Transfer

Title: Fulfillment type of Third Party Sales Order changes whenever there is a change in its Ship-To Address.
Content: Symptom-Whenever there is a change in ship-to address in Third party Sales Order XYZ the Fulfillment type will automatically change from External to Internal.*XYZ refers to Sales Order id.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Find the order XYZ.-Select the option Edit.-Select View All.-Navigate to General Tab.-On Ship-To Click on Address Details.-Update the address details.-Select OK.-You have successfully updated address details.-Go to Sales Order Work Center.-Go to Sales Order View.-Find the order XYZ.-Select the option Edit.-Select View All.-Navigate to Items tab.-Observe Fulfillment type changed from External to Internal.-Cause-Changing Ship-To-Party at header level after adding an item invalidates all the calculated parties at Item level. This means that vendor party would also get invalidated. It is not possible to identify whether fulfillment type was changed manually or not.-Resolution-Therefore the ATP check would always look for best possible source of supply where Internal would take preference over External.-For the items of a Sales Order, when the source of supply is maintained as External and the ship-to information is changed, an asynchronous ATP is triggered with no Fulfillment type.-Due to this, ATP will determine the source of supply giving priority to internal fulfillment. Hence, the source of supply gets re-determined from external to internal.-This is the standard behavior of the system.-Keywords-Fulfillment type of Third Party Sales Order changes whenever there is a change in its Ship-To Address, Whenever there is a change in ship-to address in Third party Sales Order  the Fulfillment type will automatically change from External to Internal

Title: Error While Migrating Fixed Asset: Error detected in source record with key value 'ABC'
Content: Symptom-During Migration of Fixed Asset there is an error regarding Valuation View.-ABC - Existing Inventory ID in the migration file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configurations work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Click Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select Migration Unit FA.-Click Execute Migration.-Select Fixed Asset (extended).-Click Process Asset.-Error detected in source record with key value 'ABC'-Valuation view XXX not assigned to set of books YYY in company DEF-DEF - Company ID-XXX - Valuation View ID-YYY - Set of Books ID-Cause-This can occur due to incorrect Value Conversion for Valuation View.-If there are Set of Books with different Account Principle that have different Valuation Views, each Valuation View needs to be added in the Value Conversion separately.-For example:-Set of Books: 1-ID 1 - Valuation View A01 - Company ABC - Active-ID 2 - Valuation View B02 - Company ABC - Active-Set of Books: 2-ID 1 - Valuation View A01 - Company ABC - Active-ID 2 - Valuation View C03 - Company ABC - Active-A01, B02 and C03 - Valuation Views IDs-Resolution-To adjust this, each different Valuation View needs to have an ID in the file even if they belong to different Accounting Principles.-Using the example above, each Valuation View needs to have a different ID in the file, instead of repeating ID 2 for B02 and C03, change C03 to ID 3.-In the file each Valuation View needs to have a different number, and after in the Value Conversion of Valuation View (step b Convert Values on Process Files) the conversion needs to be added for all Valuation Views:-ID 1 - Valuation View A01-ID 2 - Valuation View B02-ID 3 - Valuation View C03-Keywords-Valuation View, Migration of Fixed Assets, Error detected in source record with key value-valuation view,error detected in source record with key,migration of fixed assets

Title: How to check changes in report assignments
Content: Symptom-You notice that the assignment of some reports was changed. For example, reports that were assigned are now unassigned or hidden. You would like to know when and by whom these changes were made.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Select the view Design Reports.-Search for the affected report(s).-The assignment status is not Assigned anymore, but Unassigned or Hidden.-Cause-Reports can be unassigned / hidden due to the following:-A key user has manually changed the assignment of one or several reports to either Unassigned or Hidden.-A key user has run the Unassign All report, which will unassign all reports from all work center views and business roles. This will change the assignment status to Unassigned (not Hidden).-Resolution-If the changes were done manually, you can check the logs via the following steps:-Go to the work center Administrator > General Settings.-Scroll to the Adaptation Changes section, and click Layout Change History.-Run the query All UI Changes.-Filter for the type AddRemoveAssignedObject.-You will now see a list of all report assignment changes. To see more details, click on the File Path.-Hover over the Value. You will see the report ID here. Additionally, if the report was set to hidden, you should see the text: hideInReportList= "True" in the value of the file path.-Please note: It is possible to delete change transactions here, but it is strongly recommended not to use this option to revert assignment changes. Please be aware that deleting change transactions indiscriminately may cause inconsistencies in the system. We recommend to only use the Delete option if advised to do so by SAP Support in order to solve an issue.-You can also check the help center article 'View Layout Changes'.-If the reports were unassigned using the Unassign All run, please check the KBA: 2678576 - Report Assignments Missing - How to Reassign Reports .-See Also-Currently, no more logs are available on the report assignment changes, neither from the frontend nor from the backend of the system. It is not possible to search for a specific report ID.-If you would like to suggest changes or enhancements to this feature, please use the Influence Forum (link).-Keywords-report unassigned, hidden, change log, assignment status, business analytics, reporting, change transactions

Title: In Your Customer Return the Ship-to Party Address is Not Copied From the Referenced Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In your customer return, the ship-to party address is not copied from the referenced sales order.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Find and select the relevant Return.-Click the Edit button.-Go to View All.-Select the Involved Parties tab.-The Ship-to party address is not the one expected as you have maintained a document address in the sales order.-Cause-The Ship-to party in a customer return is determined according to the following rules :-Step 1: Business Partner relationship of the Account-Step 2: Copied from Account--Resolution-If you want to change the Ship-To party address manually in your Customer Return, you would be able to do so only if the status of the Inbound Delivery is set to not Finished.-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Inbound Deliveries view.-Find and select the appropriate Inbound Delivery for the affected Customer Return.-Select Undo Release.-You can now maintain a Ship-To party address in the Customer Return.-Keywords-Change, Ship-To, Address, Return

Title: Start Date and End Date for Withholding Tax Classification are Disabled
Content: Symptom-Within the supplier account master data, you noticed that the Withholding Tax Details entry currently does not have a validity period, as the columns disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Accounts view.-Open the master data for a given supplier.-Go to Financial Data tab and then Tax Data.-In the Withholding tax section, you notice that the Start Date and End Date columns are disabled. -Cause-These fields are grayed out as they are relevant only for country/region Israel. As these columns are part of the list in the screen, they are not hidden but shown to other country/regions as read-only.-Resolution-The time-dependency feature for other country/regions would incur in changes to the tax logic to consider a validity period, hence this would be a new development request. If you wish to address this feature you may raise a request for modifying the current system definition by submitting this suggestion in details via our Influence Forum.-Keywords-Withholding Tax. Supplier Account. Tax Data.

Title: Refresh Button Disabled in Excel Report
Content: Symptom-You have created an Excel file and inserted some SAP reports into the sheets. You have saved this file locally on your machine. After a while, the Refresh button in the Excel file is grayed out and you cannot refresh the report(s) anymore.-This may happen after you edit and save the file, after a system upgrade, or even after no noticeable changes done.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign Excel Add-In-SAP Cloud for Customer Excel Add-In-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Excel file on your laptop.-Log on to the Excel Add-In.-See that the Refresh button is grayed out.-Cause-Your file is likely quite old, and / or you have used macros and other Excel features to enhance the SAP reports. Such a file is static, but the SAP reports are dynamic, i.e. report metadata changes over time.-The longer you use such a file, the more users access it and the more Excel features are layered on top of SAP reports, the more likely it is that the connectivity between the SAP report in the system and the SAP report in your file will break, meaning that the system does not recognize the report in your file as a report anymore.-Resolution-It is not possible to reinstate the connectivity.-We would recommend to always save Excel reports back to the system, rather than saving them locally. If you do need a local copy, we would recommend to regularly save a backup to the system, especially before you make changes to the file, so that you have a backup version of your reports.-See Also-2585720 - Refresh Button greyed out in Excel Add-in-Keywords-excel report, business analytics, refresh greyed out, disable, not possible to refresh, grayed out

Title: Error Message in Payment Allocation - Remittance advice already confirmed or canceled; release of allocation not possible
Content: Symptom-You notice the error message'Remittance advice AAA already confirmed or canceled; release of allocation not possible' when trying to post a payment allocation connected to a bank statement item (AAA means the Remittance Advice ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Open Payment Allocation BBB, which is In Preparation (BBB means the Payment Allocation ID).-Press Post.-The error message 'Remittance advice AAA already confirmed or canceled; release of allocation not possible' appears. -Cause-In the Payment Confirmations/Returns tab of the payment allocation a payment advice which is either confirmed or canceled has been selected. Therefore, even if the Open Amount of the payment allocation is zero, the system cannot post the payment allocation.-Resolution-The payment advice has to be removed from the allocation using the upwards pointing arrow.-As a result, an error message will indicate that there is now an open amount in the allocation which is equivalent to the amount of the removed item.-For example: 'Payment amount not allocated completely; check the open amount (-100.00 USD)' - The 'open amount' of  the payment allocation is now -100.00 USD.-This open amount will now need to be allocated before you can proceed (for example, for another item, or directly to a G/L Account, using Allocation to G/L Account tab). Once this amount is allocated and the allocation open amount is zeroed you will be able to post the allocation.-Keywords-payment allocation; Remittance advice; bank payment advice; payment advice

Title: Error message "Asynchronous error (final) sending mail" in Broadcast Log
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-In the tab Last Broadcast Run or in the Broadcast Log you see the error message 'Asynchronous error (final) sending mail'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-One possible reason for this error message can be an automatic out of office reply being sent from one or more of the broadcast receipients. The broadcasts are usually sent from a donotreply@(customer URL) address. When the system receives a reply to a broadcast email it assumes that the broadcast email bounced / wasn't delivered successfully and throws the error message.-You can check if the broadcasts were delivered sucessfully and whether an out of office reply was sent in the SCOT transaction in the backend.-STFK > SCOT > Business Communication Administration > Administration > Outbound Send Request, Inbound Send Request.-In the outbound send request view you can see which broadcast was sent to which receipient on a specific day or time period and whether or not it was sucessfull.-In the inbound send request view you can see incoming emails. Double click on the item will show you the incoming email. If it was an out of office reply that matches the date and time the broadcast was sent, it will have triggered an error message.-Resolution-If the broadcast was delivered sucessfully this error can be ignored.-See Also-2631154 - Asynchronous Error (Final) Sending Mail in Broadcast Log-Keywords-Broadcast Run, Broadcast Log, Asynchronous error, SCOT, Broadcast

Title: Delivery Status Shows That Not Delivered
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-[RELEASE INTERNALLY]-Purchase order shows completely delivered, but when you are trying to create the invoice under invoice entry the Delivery Status showing as Not Delivered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Choose the Invoice Entry view.-Find the Purchase Order XYZ.-Here you can see the Delivery Status is showing as Not Delivered.-Cause-The Inbound Delivery cannot update Supplier Invoice Request because of an error "Tax code Imported Goods (Supplier invoice), No VAT not valid for country ABC on tax date DD.MM.YYYY".-Please follow the steps to view the error :-Application and User Management work center.-Process Communication errors view.-Show: Open Errors with Incident.-Here you can see the above error messages.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to maintain the TAX code.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on the Fine-Tune button.-Select Activity Goods and Services link.-Choose Open button.-Here maintain Tax code Imported Goods (Supplier invoice), No VAT for country ABC on tax date DD.MM.YYYY".-The tax code date should be valid for the Actual Delivery Date.-See Also-Once the customer validates the date then you can restart the messages in the backend-Backend Details :-Sender Party: InboundDeliveryProcessing-Receiver Party: SupplierInvoiceProcessing-Error:"Tax code Imported Goods (Supplier invoice), No VAT not valid for country ABC on tax date DD.MM.YYYY".-Keywords-Inbound Delivery cannot update Supplier Invoice Request

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Error: Valuation View XXX Not Assigned To Set of Books YYY In Company ABC
Content: Symptom-During the Fixed Asset migration process, the error message 'Valuation view XXX not assigned to set of books YYY in company ABC' appears.-XXX - Relevant Valuation View ID-YYY - Relevant Set of Books ID.-ABC - Relevant Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Open.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant migration unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select Migration Object Fixed Assets.-Click Process File.-Go to Step c.- The following error is raised: 'Valuation View XXX Not Assigned To Set of Books YYY In Company ABC'-Cause-This error message appears when you add a Valuation View to a Set of Books after there have been already Fixed Assets created in the system. In this case the new Valuation View's Status is set as Partially Active.-Use below steps to check the Status of the Valuation View:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find activity Set Of Books.-Click Open.-Select relevant Set of Books.-Click Edit.-Go to the Fixed Assets Settings tab.-Select the Valuation View ID XXX.-Here, you can find the Valuation View status is set to Partially Active.-Resolution-In case there are Fixed Assets already Capitalized in the system then it is not possible to activate the new Valuation View for the respective Set of Books-Company combination.-On cases where the Fixed Assets created are all in Status In Process you can adjust this with below steps.-First, delete all previously created Fixed Assets for the respective company.-After, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Fixed Assets Valuation View activity.-Click Open.-Select relevant Valuation View.-Go to the Assignment to Accounting Principles tab.-Select the Accounting Principle applicable.-Click Delete.-Click Save and Close.-Close all Set of Books relevant screens such as Business Configuration views, Open and Close Periods activity, New Fiscal Year activity.-Make sure no other User locks the Set of Books in any of these mentioned screens. This is required as the additional Accounting Principle for a Valuation View triggers backend changes on all the Set of Books assigned to the respective Accounting Principle.-Wait for 10 minutes, this is to avoid any inconsistency in the Set of Books Valuation View assignments while the Set of Books is being updated in the backend.-Open the Fixed Asset Valuation View activity again.-Go to the Assignment to Accounting Principles tab.-Select relevant Valuation View.-Click Add Row.-Add the Accounting Principle you removed before.-Click Save and close.-After proceed with below steps.-Open Set of Books activity.-Select the relevant Set of Books.-Click Edit.-Go to the Fixed Asset Settings tab.-Now the Valuation View is added to the assigned Company and Set of books with the Asset Valuation View Status 1 - Active.-Now the migration file will be processed with no errors.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Migration, Fixed Asset Migration Error, Valuation view, not assigned to set of books

Title: How to Update PaymentFormCode of ManageEmployeeIn Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update the PaymentFormCode of ManageEmployeeIn2 SAP Web Service but is unable to do so.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Use the MaintainBundle operation from ManageEmployeeIn2 Service to update it with SoapUI (third party software) or similar.-You are using actionCode "05" to update in the BankDetails path.-It does not change anything. -Cause-The PaymentInformation Node of the XML is not mapped internally to a BO meaning it will not be handled. The data from the PaymentFormCode is being pulled from the PaymentAgreement BO and not the Employee BO, which changes behavior here.-Resolution-To update the PaymentFormCode, you can use the actionCode "04" in the BankDetails path. This will then update the PaymentFormCode.-Keywords-PaymentFormCode; Web Service; MaintainBundle; BankDetails; ManageEmployeeIn

Title: Error When Migrating Material Valuation Data: Entered data already contain unit costs for the same key
Content: Symptom-You notice and error message when migrating Material Valuation Data:-"Error detected in source record (Material ID), (Company ID), (Business Residence ID)."-"Entered data already contains unit costs for the same key".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Click Open.-Click Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool.-Select relevant migration unit.-Click Execute Migration - Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error is shown.-Cause-There are duplicated lines in the migration file. The Material ID, Company ID, Business Residence ID, and Set of Books ID have to be unique for each material.-Resolution-Recheck the file and remove the duplicated lines.-Keywords-Migrating, Material Valuation Data, Entered data already contain unit costs for the same key, Migration-migrating,material valuation data,entered data already contain unit costs,migration

Title: Report "Revenue by Team Member" Does Not Show Actual / Planned Work per Team Member
Content: Symptom-You are viewing the report Revenue by Team Member and the key figures Actual Work and/ or Planned Work. You would like to see the work per employee, however you notice that it is shown as zero.-Environment-SAP ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the assigned work center, for example Project Management.-Set up the view and selection of the report, including the characteristic Team Member and the key figures Actual Work and / or Planned Work.-The key figures show zero although the respective employee has recorded or planned work on this project.-Cause-The data source of this report is based on several other internal data sources. The values for Actual Work / Planned Work come from a data source which fetches the sales order information. But the team member comes from a different data source which uses the list of expenses for the project. It is thus not possible to display the actual or planned work per employee, but only per project.-Resolution-The report Revenue by Team Member is not meant to show the actual or planned work for a team member. To achieve this, you can use the report Project Time Recordings or Team Member Work Analysis.-Keywords- actual work, planned work, Erlös nach Mitarbeiter, geplant, data source, project , time recordings

Title: Error: Tax prepayments not permitted for tax return type Tax Return in "Country Name"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to pay advance Tax or Tax Prepayment for non-localized country and you are facing error message: Tax prepayments not permitted for tax return type Tax Return in XYZ country[Non-localized Country]-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Click on New Tax Payments view-Enter the Tax Return Arrangement ID [Make sure the country is non-localized]-Select Tax Payment Type as Tax Prepayment-Press Enter-Here, you can see the Error message: Tax prepayments not permitted for tax return type Tax Return in "Country Name"-Cause-This is a standard system behavior and cannot be change.-Resolution-SAP ByDesign system does not support Tax Prepayment functionality for non-localized country.-Keywords

Title: How To Add Or Remove A System Language
Content: Symptom-You would like to log on to the system with a system language other than English, however, the desired language is not available for selection in login screen.-Alternatively, you would like to remove one of the several languages available on the login screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to your SAP Business ByDesign tenant.-Go to the Personalize menu.-Select My Settings option.-Click Regional Settings tab.-In the dropdown list for Language option, the system language required by you is not available.-OR:-Open the login screen of your tenant.-On the login screen, several languages are available from the language dropdown list, however, the language you would like to use is not available for selection.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Cloud for Customer support multiple languages. Multiple languages might be scoped as solution languages. The language you would like to use might not be scoped as solution language.-Resolution-You may specify the language(s) in the Business Configuration scoping, as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant change project and click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next and navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Select All Elements.-Expand Built-in Services and Support > Business Environment > Address and Languages.-Under Languages section, there are the scoping questions "Do you need XYZ as a solution language?" (where XYZ is the language).-Check the languages that you need and uncheck the languages that you do not need.-Click Next and Finish.-See Also-2858619 - Logon Language is Not Available After Scoping-SAP Help Portal - SAP Business ByDesign - Country/Region-Specific Features-SAP Help Portal - SAP Cloud for Customer Set Up Guide - Language Settings-Keywords-system language, logon language, add language, remove language, solution language.

Title: Report Default Currency Different From the Company Currency
Content: Symptom-You open a report with a specific user and notice that the default currency is set to USD although your company currency is a different one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Choose any report which involves a Currency Value,  for instance: Sales Order Volume.-Execute the report and check a key figure which includes a currency. It shows USD.-The respective currency field from the selection screen (usually the variable Display Currency) shows USD as well.-When you check the Company Currency, you see that is set to something else, for example EUR.-When you check with other Users, the report shows the correct currency. I.e. EUR.-Cause-You see USD as the default currency for the reports because you are not assigned to any company in the system; the report uses the system default currency instead, which is USD.-Resolution-You can assign employees to org units of a company via the Org Structures view of the Organizational Management work center.-OR-You can leave the field Display Currency empty in the report's Selection. If Default Company Currency is already maintained when executing the report, the system defaults to USD since no Company can be associated to your User.-See Also- 2411412 - Cash Position by Transaction Source Report Shows the Transaction Amount in USD Currency Which is not Expected-Keywords-Sales orders, commandes client, Sales Order Volume, transactional currency, net value, company, company currency, default, report, rapport, devise, volume, afficher devise-wrong currency

Title: Expense Service Item is Not Supported in Lead
Content: Symptom-When adding a service item into a Lead, you get error messages:-Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.-Service product with expense indicator not allowed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Click New Lead from Common Tasks view.-Enter the account and other mandatory data in the General tab, then go to Items facet.-Click Add Row and enter the service item ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the service item).--You get the error messages.-Cause-The service ABC is marked as Expense.-Expense item types are not supported in the Lead. They are supported in the Sales Quote and the sales documents afterwards.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.--An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-2580468 - Expense Service Item is Not Supported in Opportunity-1714641 - Error Message "Item X: Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.-Keywords-Expense, Lead, Service, Indicator, Not Allowed

Title: Edit a Communication Arrangement Warning - Functionality not included with regular SAP OnDemand solution license
Content: Symptom-When editing a Communication Arrangement you notice a warning at the top of the screen:-"Functionality not included with regular SAP OnDemand solution license! Any scoping and use of this functionality is subject to a prior written agreement with SAP, or a written agreement between customer and an SAP approved third party solution provider for this particular scoping option. Please contact SAP for further information on SAP approved solution providers."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Communication Arrangements view.-Select the relevant communication.-Click Edit Credentials.-The message shows at the top of the screen.-Cause-This message is only relevant when using Hubs like Crossgate for communication.-Resolution-If this does not relate to Hubs, you can ignore this message.-Keywords-Communication Arrangement, Crossgate, Hubs, warning-communication arrangement,crossgate,hubs,warning

Title: Error Message During Migration: 'Unit cost does not comply with currency rules'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload material valuation data via migration template, however an error message is being raised: 'Unit cost does not comply with currency rules'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Acccess the Migration of Material Valuation Data activity. -Open the migration template.-For the relevant migration unit, click Execute Migration -> Step-by-step.-Go to Simulate step.-The error message 'Unit cost does not comply with currency rules' appears. -Cause-The unit cost maintained in the template is not in accordance with the currency specifications. For example, it may have more decimal places than allowed.-You can check the allowed number of decimal places for each currency in the activity Currencies.-Resolution-Since all currencies are predefined according to ISO code list 4217, most currencies do not enable you to change the allowed decimal places. Therefore, you need to adjust the decimals of the unit cost so that it conforms with the currency specification.-Keywords-Currency. Currencies. unit Cost.

Title: Error Message "Concur Integration Is Not Active, Please Check Communication Arrangements"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute a replication from SAP Business ByDesign to SAP Concur, but the run is failing with error message "Concur integration is not active, please check communication arrangements."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In cases where a new SAP Business ByDesign tenant is created as copy of another, the Concur Integration communication arrangements are set to status Isolated. This is to avoid that data from a ByDesign test tenant getting automatically replicated to a Concur productive instance directly after the copy by a scheduled job (i.e. before customer has the chance to change the target system in this integration scenario to the corresponding Concur test instance).-Resolution-To de-isolate the communication arrangements, please follow the below instructions:-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Access the Communication Arrangements work center view-Select the row for communication arrangement "Concur Integration" (see that the box in column Isolated is marked)-Click the button De-isolate-Repeat steps 3 and 4 for communication arrangement "Concur Integration OAUTH2"-Keywords-Concur integration, Not active, Communication arrangements

Title: How to Create a New Org Unit In-Between Two Hierarchical Levels in an Org Structure
Content: Symptom-An additional organizational level is required within the existing organizational structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To understand the requirement better, consider the following scenario:-In an existing org structure, org unit A has units B and C immediately under it. The requirement is to have new org unit D in such a way that D falls under A and in turn B and C fall under D.-The approach to address the requirement will be to temporarily move the sub-units B and C to a position under another org unit. Then, create the unit D under A. Subsequently the two shifted org units can be brought back below the new org unit D.-The steps to achieve the scenario will be as follows:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select Common Task.-Edit Org Structures.-Select the date in the Effective From field from which date the changes are to be active in the system.-Select the relevant org unit that needs to be moved, in this case B.-Select the small arrow (bottom-right) of the selected org unit to open its menu, select Edit Org Unit option, and select Cut.-Highlight the target root org unit where the org unit can be placed.-Select the arrow in the target Org Unit to open its menu, select Edit Org Unit option, and select Paste. The Org Unit moves to the target org unit (repeat steps 5 through 7 for Org Unit C as well).-Now, select the root org unit A and Select the New button.-From the drop-down list, select Org Unit.-Enter the new org unit ID as D.-Now, repeat the steps 5 through 7, in a reverse fashion to bring back the two shifted org units under the newly created one.-Select the org unit A.-Use the Check button to validate the org structure.-Select Activate button to activate the changes.-Keywords-Create, Org Unit, change parent, org unit, org unit between two levels, hierarchy update

Title: How to Revert an Org Unit Deletion in the Planning Area of an Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate an org structure, but error messages point to an org unit that cannot be relevant. You would like to understand how to revert the org unit's deletion in the Planning Area of the Organizational Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When you try to check or activate an org. structure hierarchy, system is throwing error messages such as the ones below:-Cannot delete profit center XYZ (); postings exist in accounting.-Cannot delete cost center XYZ (); cost center is used by financial accounting.-(Where XYZ represents an actual org. unit ID)-You might be aware of the steps to resolve the issue, but in the Planning Area, you are not able to find the org. unit XYZ whose deletion needs to be reverted.-Resolution-First of all, you should confirm whether the org. unit was deleted or is simply delimited. There are two ways to identify it, they are:-Option 1:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access the Org Structures work center view.-Find and select the relevant org. unit.-Navigate to the Timelines tab.-Get the Valid From date.-Go to the Planning Area by clicking the Edit button.-Set the Effective From date to be the same as the Valid From date from the org. unit and click Go.-If you could find the org. unit, then its validity is delimited; if not, then it has been deleted.-Option 2:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access the Org Structures work center view.-Find and select the relevant org. unit.-Navigate to the Changes tab and click Go.-If all the parameters have changed to an empty value, then the org. unit was deleted.-If the org. unit's validity was changed, then it is delimited.-So, how to revert in case the org. unit was deleted? The only option to bring back the deleted org. unit is to use the Roll Back feature.-Steps to be followed:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access Edit Org Structures.-Click the Roll Back button.-A prompt will be raised, warning that performing a rollback means that all inactive changes will be undone and the org. structure in the Planning Area will be set back to its last active version.-Click Ok.-If you have any changes to other org. unit hierarchies not related to the one from which the relevant org. unit was deleted, then we suggest activating them using the Activate Selected and Dependent Org Units option before performing the rollback to restore the deleted org. unit.-Keywords-Activate org unit; delete cost center; delete profit center; planning area; active area; roll back
