Title: Request to Change Maintenance Schedule
Content: Symptom-You want to change the maintenance schedule time of a tenant to a different time, for example because most of the users are located and working in a different time zone.-You are wondering, if this can be enabled, and if yes, how.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In case your system is hosted on multi customer system, a change is not possible, since all customers share the same maintenance schedule.-In case your system is hosted as private customer system, a change  might be possible and needs to be checked.-In the second case, or if you are not aware of the hosting type, please create an SAP incident with your request and provide time and time zone.-Keywords-other, plan, wartung, foreign, abroad, switch, changing, requirement

Title: Process Communication Error in Purchase Order Processing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Process communication error from Sales Order to Purchase Order. Due to this, invoice cannot be raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view-Search for the purchase order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order ID)-Navigate to Document Flow.-There is a process communication error where the receiver party is Purchase Order.-Cause-This issue occurs particularly where the sales order contains a Sales Kit item. Initially, when the sales order is created with the sales kit, the sales kit contained X items. A message is passed to the Purchase Order side. Once the purchase order is generated, there is an intercompany sales order generated automatically.-In the meantime, the sales kit is modified and now the sales kit has Y items. The user updates the sales order. This updated list of items of the sales kit does not update the purchase order again. Due to the mismatch in the kit items, there is a process communication error.-The error is raised from the following class and method:-Class: /SRMAP/CL_PCO_PAF_MAP_FROM_EXTCM00D-Method : KIT_COMP_PO_PCO (/SRMAP/CL_PCO_PAF_MAP_FROM_EXT)-Error message at the backend: Error msg: Bestätigungs-Paketpositions-ID Y in Bestellung nicht gefunden (where Y is number of items in sales kit after modification)-translation: Confirmation package item ID Y not found in order (where Y is number of items in sales kit after modification)-Resolution-The only solution for this is to cancel the affected Sales Order and related documents, restore the Kit definition back to the contents included in the purchase order, and then recreate the Sales Order again, keeping the KIT master data consistent in the meantime-Keywords-Process communication erorr, Sales kit, purchase order, TPOP scenario issue

Title: "Ordered Revenue Forecast" K-Figure in Revenue Forecast Report Splits Values by Month
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when checking the "Ordered Revenue Forecast" Key Figure (K-Figure) in the Revenue Forecast [CRMRVFU_Q0001] report, the values displayed are split by month while it's not clear what criteria the system is using.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Open the Design Reports view.-Open the Revenue Forecast [CRMRVFU_Q0001] report. -Filter by Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order which is being split by months in the report).-You will see results in K-Figure Ordered Revenue Forecast for more than one month.-However, if you check the Requested Date K-Figure in the same report, the dates for all items are in the same month (Or differ in other ways).-Cause-This happens because the K-Figure behaves in a way that shows the time in which the revenue will be generated.-Resolution-The system splits the values dynamically here to give the user a forecast of revenue over the period. For example, if a Material has a Confirmed Date from ATP to November while another item is a Service with Requested Completion Date to October, the system will split them in the Ordered Revenue Forecast K-Figure.-Keywords-Ordered Revenue, Forecast, Report, Date, Split, Wrong, Incorrect, Unexpected, Merge

Title: Hebrew letters in exported CSV file aren't displayed while opening in Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have exported a CSV file and opened it in Excel. The Hebrew characters in the file are displayed wrong.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-There is no issue with your SAP product rather the Excel need to be configured while opening CSV files with Hebrew characters.-Resolution-Follow the steps to display the Hebrew letters in csv file.-Save the CSV file in your system.-Open Excel and click Data Tab.-Click From Text/CSV tab.-In the new window, select the file from the saved location.-Now in the next window for the field 'File Origin:' Select '65001: Unicode (UTF-8)'.-Click Load. -Excel will now display the Hebrew characters.-Keywords-Hebrew characters, CSV, Export to CSV

Title: No Communication System Available to be Selected in Output Channel Selection
Content: Symptom-You are creating an output channel rule to communicate to an external system, however cannot see any communication system available in the list.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Output Channel Selection view.-Select Customer Invoices (or any other).-Click New.-Select Output Channel as External System.-Cause-There is no communication arrangement maintained or a wrong arrangement was created.-Resolution-Maintain a communication arrangement of type Output Management XML Integration:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open Communication Arrangement view.-Click at New.-Select scenario Output Management XML Integration.-Complete the rest of the steps. -See Also-SAP Help - External System Output Channel Quick Guide-Keywords-Output Channel, Communication System, empty communication system

Title: Product Category Filter of Stock Overview Not Filtering Correctly
Content: Symptom-On the Stock Overview, you make a search using the advanced filter field Product Category ID, however the search results shows different Product Categories.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Go to the Stock Overview common task.-Click on the advanced filter button.-On Site ID field, enter ID ABC (ABC represents the Site ID).-On Product Category ID field , enter ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Product Category ID).-Click on Go button.-At this point we can see that there are Product Categories that are not the XYZ, as you used on the filter.-Cause-This is a standard behavior of the system. The system considers both Product Category ID field and Storage Group ID field as product categories. Therefore, when you make a search using these filters, there will be results where the Product Category ID is different then the one you entered. This happens because the Storage Group of the product is also XYZ, even though its Product Category is different.-Resolution-Since this is a standard behavior of the system, you can do the following workaround: To filter the Product Category IDs, you can do the search normally, as described on the steps above, and then filter the results by clicking on the Product Category ID row and typing XYZ on the Filter.-Keywords-Stock Overview, Product Category ID, filter, advanced filter, Storage Group, search

Title: Semantics not working as expected
Content: Symptom-Chosen color in Semantics does not show correctly.-Environment-SAP byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics-2. Go to Design Reports-3. Choose a coulour for a keyfigure-4. Open report CRMCIVIB_MQ0001-The color will show different than just chosen.-Cause-There is a characteristic in the column area-Resolution-You can drag the characteristic to the row area-Keywords-semantics, reports, data source, key figure

Title: Outgoing Bank Transfer Error: Account Determination is missing for cash
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a new outgoing bank transfer due to the error:-'Account determination is missing for cash. Define the account for chart of accounts XYZ (XYZ indicates chart of accounts) Chart of Accounts, tab Cash Disbursement - In Tr' field 'Cash Disbursement - In Tr.-Enter a general ledger account for the account determination group ABC (ABC indicates account determination group) and payment method Bank Transfer.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select New Outgoing Bank Transfer and fill all the required details and try posting it.-You end up getting the mentioned error.-Cause-Settings are maintained but might have maintained with a particular currency and the currency used in the bank transfer is different.-Settings are missing completely for the Account Determination Group for Cash.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Overview view.-Select the fine-tune activity and select Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination. -Choose the Account Determination Cash.-Navigate to tab Cash Disbursement - In Transit.-Add Row, Enter the Account Determination Group for Cash, Payment Method, Currency and the G/L Account under Cash Disbursement - In Transit.-Remark: if the currency is left blank, then it applies to any currency that you select in the outgoing bank transfer, else if you specially mention the currency here, then the setting is applicable/restricted to the currency that is maintained here.-Keywords-outgoing bank transfer error, account determination group missing for cash-outgoing bank transfer,account determination group missing

Title: Field Replenishment Lead Type is not available in Product Master
Content: Symptom-Replenishment Lead Time is missing on availability confirmation screen in Material Master DEF (DEF refers to Material id).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Product Portfolio Work Center-Go to sub-tab By Materials  in Products View-Select Material DEF and Select Edit-Select View All-Navigate to Availability Confirmation tab-You observe that Field Replenishment Type is missing on availability confirmation screen.-Cause-In the tab Availability Confirmation, Availability Check Scope is maintained as Stock, Hence the Replenishment Lead time is not  visible for this type, Also for Availability Check Scope of  Type, , the  Replenishment Lead time won't be visible.Also the rule for visibility of Availability Check Horizon is  applied to Replenishment Lead Time in 'View all' UI. This is causing Replenishment Lead Time to be hidden in 'View all' UI.-Resolution-Replenishment Lead time is only visible based on value of Availability Check Scope(only those suffixes with horizon, that is, Stock and all receipts within horizon, Stock and released receipts in horizon, Stock within horizon & Supply except unfirm receipts in horizon) in 'View all' UI.However, there is no data loss in this case. The value for Replenishment Lead Time can be maintained at Edit UI and it is just not visible in 'view all' UI, but data is present.-Keywords-Field Replenishment  Lead Type  is not available in Product Master, Replenishment Lead Time is missing on availability confirmation screen in Material Master.

Title: Condition Inactive After Removing Characteristic from Report
Content: Symptom-You created a key figure condition in a report and are using that in a report. Now you remove the characteristic used in that condition, you add it back to the view and realize that the condition is not active anymore and the report values are different.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-A condition is specific to a report view. When you remove the characteristic the condition becomes inactive and when you try to add the characteristic back to the view the condition will still be inactive as the view has changed. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior and is working as designed. If you want to change the standard behavior, please go to our SAP Influence Forum.-The only workaround is to go and select the original view from the view list again, so that it loads the saved view with active condition.-Keywords-key figure; condition; characteristic; dashboard; report-report values wrong,report inconsistent

Title: Total Item Net Value in Migrated Sales Order is Incorrect or Missing
Content: Symptom-For migrated sales orders the Total Item Net Value is not displayed in the Total Pricing section. Once you add an item the Total Item Net Value is displayed in the Total Pricing section but only the value of this newly added item is displayed instead of the value of all line items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the migrated sales order).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Line item XX was migrated (XX represents the line item number of the migrated item).-Add line item YY with the Net Value 100.00 EUR (YY represents the line item number of the manually added item).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and select the Pricing sub tab.-In the Total Pricing section you can see that the Total Item Net Value only displays 100.00 EUR which is only the Net Value of the newly added item and not all line items.-Cause-When using migrated sales orders you need to activate the price component Total Item Net Value in step 78 which also includes the migration price in the pricing strategy of your business configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select the respective implementation project.-Click the Open Activity list button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click the Configure Pricing Procedure hyperlink.-Deactivate the price component Total Item Net Value in step 50 and activate the price component Total Item Net Value in step 78 by setting the Total Display to yes and also the Total Print if you want it visible in the Form Template.-Save your changes.-The Total Item Net Value ﻿will now display both.

Title: Error appears "Serial Number DEF already used" when Serial Number is assigned in Pick Task.
Content: Symptom-While assigning a serial number with ID DEF for a product XYZ in the pick task you receive an error message. *DEF refers to SerialNo, XYZ refers to Product id.-Serial Number DEF already used.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work center.-Navigate to Task Control view.-Search for the relevant pick task and choose the Confirm button.-In Confirm Pick Task screen select the product XYZ and enter the serial number DEF in Serial Numbers sub-tab.-You receive above mentioned error message:-Serial Number DEF already used.-Cause-The serial number with ID DEF have been used for the same product XYZ in another line item of the same pick task.-Since you cannot ship a product with same serial number more than once in the same delivery you receive the reported error message.-Resolution-You will have to use a different serial number other than DEF for the product XYZ in the pick task.-Keywords-Serial Number  already used" when Serial Number is assigned in Pick Task, Serial Number already used

Title: Cannot post supplier invoice - Error 500 - Dump in class CL_GLO_SIV_FDT_APPL_SETTING
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User cannot post a supplier invoice. He gets a 500 error. The dump is in the class CL_GLO_SIV_FDT_APPL_SETTING.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the workcenter 'Supplier Invoicing'.-2. Go to the view 'Invoices and Credit Memos'.-3. Open a Supplier Invoice which is in status 'In Preparation'.-4. Click on the button 'Post'.-5. You get a dump in class CL_GLO_SIV_FDT_APPL_SETTING for method GET_COMPANY_COUNTRY.-Cause-The issue occured as the country code for the company <XYZ> was not fetched when the numbering rules were created.-This could be because the country of registration was not maintained for this company when the numbering rules were created in the company attributes.-Resolution-You can send the incident to AP-SRM-FND with reference to CSS 4402945 2009.-A possible solution could be to reactivate the rules in the backend and the country code will be fetched this time for the company <XYZ>.-That is how it is done:-1. Login to the backend.-2. Start transaction sesfts.-3. Open the BO Name 'SRM_FDT_SIV_NUM_RANGE'.-4. Execute the query ROOT -> Queries -> OFFICIAL_DOCUMENT_NUMBER.-5. One record on root is returned.-6. Navigate to TAB_ALL (if the tax country is other than FR). You will see all numbering rules there.-7. Change anything in any of the rules (valid from or valid to) and press enter, save. This will reactivate all the rules automatically. You can revert back the changes after that and save again.-Keywords
