Title: Error: PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure During Migration of Projects
Content: Symptom-You are importing projects via Migration Tool and faced error 'PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure' during Simulate step of the migration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Show: All Configuration Elements and find the activity: Migration of Projects.-Upload the populated migration file.-Select the Execute Migration button and select the Execute Migration Step by Step option from the dropdown.-Continue until the Simulation Phase.-Cause-The main root cause for the error message is with the field Finish Date in the main sheet, where currently 31.12.9999 is entered.-Another possible cause is having inconsistencies in Task Details tab of the migration file, where Right Neighbor Task IDs are filled in a contradictory way.-Resolution-Use a more current date as Finish Date (technically: 30.12.9998 at the highest), to avoid any issues with the calendar calculations in the year 9999.-As for Task Details tab, fill Right Neighbor Task IDs with a hierarchy logic. “Right neighbor” means that this task will go after the task in the task hierarchy (not subordinate but on the same level).-See Also-2987536 - Error: PAF: Inbound Processing: System Failure When Migration Open Sales Orders-Keywords-migration of projects; PAF Inbound Processing: System Failure; error;

Title: Asynchronous Web Services triggers error while executing in Cloud Application Studio.
Content: Symptom-Asynchronous Web Services  errors while executing in Cloud Application Studio.-WSDL file ABC.wsdl is asynchronous, External web service integration does not support asynchronous web services.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Try to import the WSDL in the solution.-Error occurs.-Cause-Asynchronous web services are not supported in the Cloud Application Studio.-Resolution-SOAP UI can be used in order to consume asynchronous web services customized by Customer.-Keywords-asynchronous web services,asynchronous web service not working,no synchronous webservices

Title: System triggers error "Serial ID XXX not valid" when maintaining Serial Numbers.
Content: Symptom-While maintaining Serial Number for a Product at the time of Post Goods Issue, system triggers errors.-     Modification not permitted- --->Serial id XXX not valid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Delivery Proposals View.-Search for Delivery Request ID ABC (ABC refers to Delivery Request ID)-Select Post Goods Issue.-Select a Product and Under Details: Item maintain a Serial Number  -System throws error as below:-              Modification not permitted-          --->Serial id XXX not valid-Cause-The error is caused due to the special characters entered at the time of maintaining Serial Numbers for a Product.-Resolution-Serial Numbers are designed in a such a way that it cannot contain Special Characters.It can contain as follows-Serial Numbers can be Numeric.-Serial Numbers can also be Alpha Numeric. -Keywords-Modification not permitted, Serial id XXX not valid, Serial Numbers can be Numeric, Serial Numbers can also be Alpha Numeric

Title: Mass Upload/Creation of Expense Reports
Content: Symptom-You want to create/upload multiple Expense Reports in the system using the Migration tool or Excel Upload functionality.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The mass creation/upload of expense report is not supported. Currently, the mass creation functionality in both UI and backend for Expense Reports is to possible as each creation can only be processed individually: -For example, Expense Report type, Posting date, From/To dates are usually different for each Expense Report and different accounting periods must be open to post these transactions.-Resolution-The mass upload functionality to create Expense report is not available.-You have to create an expense report manually.-NOTE: Similarly, mass cancellation or change of Expense Reports (from the UI or the backend) is not supported either.-Keywords-Mass upload expense report, Expense report migration tool, Expense Report using Excel upload

Title: Incoming 3PL Message With Errors
Content: Symptom-The Incoming Message XXX from your Business Partner / Communication System contains errors. The message is trying to process an Outbound Delivery Execution Confirmation and create an Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Choose Business Communication Monitoring view-Search for the message XXX-The Status Information is:-Errors reported by Application: “Error while creating or updating follow-up document”, “Reference order item rejected; changes not allowed”, “Outbnd dlvry creation not possible; referenced 3PL request is rejected.”-XXX = Message ID-Cause-The Delivery Request is rejected. Although the item is not rejected on 3PL Request, the system considers the Delivery Request Status too. If you reject the items after they were previously received and also rejected on all documents (i.e. Sales Order), it gets canceled. If the item is rejected only on the Delivery Request, the status stays only rejected.-Resolution-The system is working as designed as the Delivery Request is rejected.-Keywords-Incoming 3PL Message With Errors, Business Partner / Communication System contains errors. The message is trying to process an Outbound Delivery Execution Confirmation and create an Outbound Delivery, The Delivery Request is rejected.

Title: Error message 'The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments' appears during Post Goods Issue.
Content: Symptom-System throws the following error messages when proposing quantities during Post Goods Issue.-         Action failed------> Proposed quantity not possible. The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Delivery Proposals View.-Search for Delivery Request ID PQR (PQR represents the ID of the Delivery Request).-Select Post Goods Issue.-Select Propose Quantities.-Error messages appear:-         Action failed------> Proposed quantity not possible. The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments.-Cause-The errors occurred because the material involved in the Delivery have the Serial Number Profile set as Mandatory.-Resolution-In order to correct the error we will have to maintain the serial numbers at the time of Post Goods Issue.-1) Creating Serial Numbers or Registered Product by following the steps below.-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-In Common tasks navigate to New Registered Product.-Maintain the Registered Product ID and Product which needs to be assigned.-Select Save.-Change the Status to Active.-Select Save and Close.-2) Assigning Serial Numbers at the time of Post Goods Issue.-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Delivery Proposals View.-Search for Delivery Request ID PQR.-Select Post Goods Issue.-Now maintain the registered Product or Serial Number in Next Serial Number.-Select Propose quantities.-This should solve the issue.-Keywords-error, open, quantity, differs, sum, serial, number, assignments, post, goods, issue, profile, mandatory, propose, quantities, The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments, Error message 'The open quantity differs from the sum of serial number assignments'

Title: Missing Warranty ID When Creating Custom OData Service For the Business Object: Warranty
Content: Symptom-You notice that WarrantyID is missing in the ROOT when creating custom OData service for the business object: Warranty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Select the OData Services view-Under Overview, select Custom OData Services-Select the New button-Fill the Service Name field with value, e.g. 'Warranty', 'Test' etc.-Save and Open to continue-Click  Select Business Object-BO Name Warranty and BO Node Name: Root-Expand the Root-You notice that there is no property name called Warranty ID, instead you will only see ProductIntenralID.-Cause-The ProductInternalID on the Root Node of business object Warranty is the Warranty ID itself.-Resolution-There is no field called Warranty ID on the business object. ProductInternalID represents the WarrentyID.-Keywords-Root, ProductIntenralID

Title: Missing Data on Remittance Advice With Direct Posting to G/L Account
Content: Symptom-You have created an Outgoing Check and generated the preview of a Remittance Advice. The created PDF file does have the check ID and amount, however you are missing the Document Number, Document Date and other item information in the file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor View.-Click to open an Outgoing Check.-Click Preview -> Advice.-The system will show the Remittance Advice PDF for this check. Inside this PDF you are missing the Check's line item details as above described.-Cause-Considering you are using the SAP standard form template for remittance advice, the fields such as document number, document date, document type, payment amount, etc., are populated in the form template based on the payment explanation item, which in this case would be the invoice that the check has cleared. The document number would be the invoice's external reference, document date is the invoice's document date, and so on.--In this case, there is no invoice cleared against the check, instead a Direct Posting to G/L Account option has been used. For outgoing checks that has a direct posting to G/L account, there is no payment explanation item. Hence, the data is not populated in the form template, since there is not document being cleared but a G/L Account instead.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. The G/L Account data is not shown in the remittance advice details.-Keywords-Remittance Advice. Form Template. Outgoing Check. Open Item.

Title: Reproducing an Issue with Catalogs and Shopping Carts with Support User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The sap support user does not have the Self-Service Overview assigned and you cannot reproduce an issue related to catalogs in a shopping cart. As well you cannot visualize the Shopping Cart from there.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Catalogs are also available in Purchase Order.-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Choose New Purchase Order.-Under the section Add Item from Catalog, select the problematic catalog and choose Start.-Add the relevant items as per the customer issue.-Manipulate the data on the PO and press the Check button.-If a follow-up document exists for the shopping cart, you can visualize it below ways-A) Use Enterprise Search (Ctrl+F), then input the Shopping Cart ID.-B) Via the follow-up Purchase Request:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Requests view.-You can do a search by shopping cart ID in the Advanced Search.-Check the Doc Flow of the document and open the Shopping Cart from there-If Shopping cart has follow up or not you can view it  with below steps-Go to Business analytics work center-Search for report"Monitoring Shopping carts"-Search for  respective shopping cart-Clcik on the ID and choose last option-and then click on  View shopping cart- Keywords

Title: Field Missing in Payment File When Using Customized Payment File Format
Content: Symptom-After creating a customized Payment File Format the Customer ID at Supplier field is missing in a newly created outbound file.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files view.-Show All Outbound Files.-Select the respective file ID.-Press View All.-Go to the Attachment tab.-Download the file.-The Customer ID at Supplier field is missing in the file.-Cause-The new payment file format is assigned to the  SAP delivered Payment Medium Format 36 - UK BACS Domestic Payment. Due to this standard Payment Medium Format's special coding some of the more generic code, such as the Customer ID at Supplier field, might get skipped, as this information is not usually required for this particular payment medium format.-Resolution-Create a new customized Payment Medium Format and assign this new format to the customized Payment File Format. This way the Customer ID at Supplier field will be correctly derived in the generated Payment Files.-Keywords-Payment File; Payment File Format; Customer ID at Supplier; Payment Medium Format-payment file,payment file format,customer id at supplier,payment medium format

Title: Cloud Print Manager Saving Files in Different Locations and Folders
Content: Symptom-You have installed and configured Cloud Print Manager (CPM) at your server or computer to "Save to File" instead of printing in a regular printer. However you noticed that just some prints are saved in the folder you have configured.-Also, some prints are appearing as Failed in CPM queue and when looking for print queues in ByDesign front-end you can see different filepaths:-Saved to directory C:\Users\YourUser\YourFolder-Saved to directory C:\Users\DifferentUser\DifferentFolder-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Print Manager-Cause-This is caused because the CPM is running in a different user or computer with same logon settings.-Resolution-The best approach is to ask your IT team to identify the user or computer under the wrong filepath "C:\Users\DifferentUser\DifferentFolder" and uninstall CPM from it.-If you are unable to identify the different user you can change the PRT user used in the print queues or create a new one. With this change the other user/computer will not be able to authenticate anymore.-To create a new user:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Go to Print Queues.-Select the desired print queue.-Click at Edit button.-Go to Details tab.-At Assigned User field you can click at New.-Set the password and save clicking at OK button. -After this you will need to set the new user in CPM:-Open Cloud Print Manager-Select the system in the list and edit it with right click of the mouse.-Change the PRT user and password. -Save. -CPM services will restart and connect with new user.-Keywords-cloud print manager, CPM, print queue, save to file, different locations, different folders

Title: Cannot Edit the Ship-From Under an Item in a Service Order
Content: Symptom-You have added a Product (spare part) to the Line Item of the Service Order, but when you try to change the Ship-From value, the field is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Orders Processing view.-Select Line Item for the relevant Service Order.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the relevant Line Item.-Go to the Spare Part Logistics sub-tab.-You can see under Shipping that the Ship-From field is greyed out.-Cause-You have maintained in the Product (spare part) master data the Item Group as DIGI - Spare part - direct goods issue for the Sales Organization.-If you maintain the Item Group DIGI - Spare part - direct goods issue, it is the system expected behavior to deactivate the field for Ship-From address. The system will in this case automatically select the most appropriate Site maintained in the Material master data for affected product.-The system only allows the Ship-From address to be editable for SHIP - Spare part (advanced shipment/sales) and PICK - Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) Item Groups. The system is therefore behaving expectedly.-Resolution-If you want to have the field editable, we recommend that you maintain the appropriate Item Group in the Product master data. Please follow the following steps to do that:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Select the Product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the spare part).-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Go to Sales subtab.-Change the Item Group for one of the following options:-SHIP - Spare part (advanced ship/sales)-PICK - Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) Item Groups.-Keywords-Service Order; Item; Ship-From; Grayed Out; DIGI; PICK - Spare Part; SHIP - Spare Part

Title: Error "Your current logon language is not English" While Logging into SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You received error "Your current logon language is not English" while logging into SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign -SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio -Fill in user information-Click button OK-Error shows up-  Cause-Your developer user has Non-English language.  The valid developer user needs to have English language.-Resolution-Go to Administrator Work Center(Cloud for Customer)/Application and user management(Business ByDesign)-Go to Business User View-Open your PDI developer user-Edit Attributes-Change Language to English -Keywords-Your current logon language is not English; SDK;Logon; Lanuage;

Title: Incorrect Contract Selected as Source of Supply in Purchase Proposal-INTERNAL
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Only-You run MRP for a product having two Supplier Contracts A and B created for two different companies A1 and B2 respectively as Sources of Supply, however when Purchase Proposal gets created system proposes the contract for the company with ID A1 instead of B2.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the view Products.-Search for the relevant product with planing area, select it and choose the button Open.-In the product planning details screen choose the button Run Planning and select the option Single or Multi BoM Level as per your business requirement.-You see that the system has created a purchase proposal, with the source of supplier contract created for the company with ID A1.-Cause-In Business ByDesign, sourcing engine does not check the source of supply dependent of the company. It proposes contract as source of supply whichever it finds first. This is an expected system behavior.-You can check this from back end with below steps :-SE11 _. Table Name: SOS_C_SRCPRFL-Check Field name : OCDEPSOSSELREL-Field OCDEPSOSSELREL = ‘X’ for SRCPRFLCODE = ‘3’ for company specific contract.-Resolution-If Customer requirement is to have Company Specific Contracts to be proposed as Source of Supply, then we do have a BC settngs which must be enabled via backend.-Please update the customer that once it is done then system will propose only company specific contracts. Hence customer will not be able to choose any other contracts which are not valid for the given company.-Note: To perform these changes via backend, please forward the incident to AP-SDM-MRP so that development can set the company dependent flag.-Keywords-Company Specific Contracts, Source of Supply, Supply Dependent,Supplier Contract,Purchase Proposal

Title: Missing PST Tax Line Item in Journal Entry of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You create a Supplier Invoice with Tax Country Canada and you expect a G/L Line Item in the Journal Entry for the PST Amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the relevant document.-Click View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the associated Journal Entry. -Here you expect that system should include a Line Item with the PST Taxes.-Cause-The Tax Type PST (Provincial Sales Tax at Province level) is generally expensed off for the Purchase / Expense Items and the Amount is not deductible. This can be checked using the steps below:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Open the relevant document.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab -> Taxes sub-tab.-That is why the system does not create a separate G/L Line Item in the Journal Entry.-On the other hand, GST at federal level is Deductible, and the amount is reported as Input Tax Credit in monthly reporting. In these cases the GST will have a separate Line Item in the Journal Entry.-On the Sales side, the Seller has to collect the PST from the customer and report and remit PST to the government as part of monthly reporting.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Journal Entry, Canada, Tax Type, PST, GST.

Title: Error message in report / data source: Move injectivity test failed for component
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-When previewing a Data Source or running a report, you receive an error message stating: Move injectivity test failed for component $t_right.('@*').COND00000X.-* This situation only happens to Partner or Customized Data Sources.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-There are two ways of reproducing such situation via UI:-a) By previewing the specific Data Source:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Sources view.-Search for your specific Data Source (i.e: CRMSLOIB) and click on Preview.-You will face an error message: Move injectivity test failed for component...-b) By running a report based on such specific Data Source:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open a report (i.e: CRMSLOIB_Q0001) and execute it.-You will face an error message: Move injectivity test failed for component...-Cause-The cause behind this situation is that the Join Condition(s) of this Partner/Customized Data Source are of different data types.-Resolution-To correct this situation, you have to change such Join Condition to a new one using other characteristics. The affected characteristics are not joinable with their current data type (Please refer to section See Also). A small analogy would be: You can't insert a square into a round space.-In case you have more than one Join Condition, you need to check on the error message. i.e: "Move injectivity test failed for component $t_right.('@*').COND000008". This means that the 4th condition from top to bottom is causing the problem.-The Join condition final count is always half of the number of your error message, because first you have the connecting elements and then the logical condition to see if is true.-In case it is an ODD number, then it means that even though data types are matching, the resulting condition is not logical. However by subtracting one unit you will see the characteristics condition that is being affected.-To change the Join Condition, you can do as follow:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Select your specific Data Source and click on Edit.-Click on the Join column in order to group your Join Conditions.-Identify which condition based on the previous description.-Remove the join condition.-Save your Data Source.-See Also-To check on the current Data Type of the elements on your join condition, you can do as follows:-Open MDRS.-Open your Data Source.-Expand Join Pairs.-Expand Join Conditions-Double-click on your Join Condition-Double-click on the element present at Left Member Element or Right Member Element-On Data Type Information section, you can double-click on Data Type in order to check its structure*.-Please note: The Left Member Element must have the same data type or the same structure of data type as the Right Member Element.-Keywords-Move injectivity test failed for component, data source, report, join conditions, wrong data type, error message, reporting, analytics, $t_right.('@*')

Title: Error message appears Stock change invalid; you must change at least one stock separator ,When trying to change stock from inspection to restricted or unresticted stock
Content: Symptom-When trying to change stock from inspection to restricted or unrestricted stock, error message is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Under Common tasks view, go to Change of Stock.-Choose Product Id PQR; Site ID XYZ and select  Inspection checkbox.-Select on Next and in step 2, Select Next again.-Error message appears-Stock change invalid; you must change at least one stock separator-Cause-The issue was due to user ABC is not assigned to Quality Planning Module.-Once the user is assigned to Quality Planning Module, user can do a change of stock.-Resolution--If you want to move inspection stock to restricted or unrestricted stock, you must be assigned the following:-Internal Logistics Logistics work center (Change of Stock common task)-Quality Planning work center, Inspection Plans view-But, only the Quality Planning assigned User can move the stock from inspection to Unrestricted/Restricted.-In Order to check and assign Quality planning work center, follow steps as mentioned below.-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Under User and Access and Management Navigate to  Business Users.-Find User ABC.-Select Edit -> Access Rights.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment.-Select  checkbox for Quality Planning Work Center.-Keywords- Stock change invalid; you must change at least one stock separator , When trying to change stock from inspection to restricted or unresticted stock

Title: Origin Field Does Not Exist
Content: Symptom-When checking the consistency of an Analytical Data Source, you get the error message: "Origin Field "1AN/ABC123" does not exist" (1AN/ABC123 represents the field name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Source view.-Find and open the Data Source ABC in Preview mode (ABC represents the Data Source name).-In the Data Source Edit screen, click "Check and Repair" button.-The error message shows up: "Origin Field "1AN/ABC123" does not exist".-Cause-The reason for this behavior is that the mentioned extension field has been removed from UI level.-Resolution-The extension field referred in the error message should be removed from the data source to eliminate the inconsistent reference, which is pointing to a field that no longer exists in the UI. To remove this field, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Source view.-Find and open the Data Source ABC in Preview mode.-Find the extension field with the same ID as shown in the error message.-Select the field.-Click Remove button.-Click Save, to save the changes in the Data Source.-Keywords-Origin Field does not exist; Extension Field; Field removed; Data Source error;

Title: Bank Account Selection in Reports Does not Work
Content: Symptom-You executed the Cash - Open Items report with Bank account selection, however the report returned no results.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open report Cash - Open Items.-Specify the Company ID and Posting date in the selection parameters.-Click on Go.-The report returned results clustered by bank accounts. You now wish to select the data for a specific bank account.-In the selection area, inform the desired bank account ID in the Bank Account / Petty Cash ID parameters.-Click on Go.-The report returns no values, even though you' have seen the entries for this bank account in the first query.-Cause-The check storage and the bank account ID have the same ID.-This can be seen as follows:-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Check Storages view-You see that the bank account ID and check storage ID is the same. Since bank account and check storage are two different objects, it is allowed to have same ID.-Resolution-In order to correctly retrieve the data in the report in this case, you need to use the Bank Account (Bank Account / Petty Cash ID) instead of Bank Account / Petty Cash ID in selection screen.-If not yet enabled, the field Bank Account (Bank Account / Petty Cash ID) can be added via Add Fields.-Alternatively, you can provide a unique ID for check storage and bank account.-Keywords-bank account, release, selection, petty cash ID, storage, reports, posting date

Title: 'Bank statement ID does not exist or has not been posted yet - Warning Message When Uploading a Bank Statement File
Content: Symptom-You notice a warning message when uploading a bank statement file:  'Bank statement ID AAA does not exist or has not been posted yet' (AAA means the Bank Statement ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Click New > Inbound File.-Enter required data, open bank statement file and click Start File Upload.-Warning message appears: 'Bank statement ID AAA does not exist or has not been posted yet'.-Another warning message might be thrown as well, depending on the number of bank statements missing:-'A great number of bank statements missing; check bank statement numbering'-Cause-These warning messages are raised as part of consistency checks in the system and they highlight to the user the bank statement IDs that have not yet been used or are not yet associated to 'posted' bank statements. The bank statement ID is specified in the uploaded file and then once uploaded, the system checks to see what IDs were last used. The warning messages highlight the IDs (within the range) that have not been used.-Resolution-Unless the file upload and bank statement creation fails, then these warnings can be ignored but would not be removed as they are serve to maintain consistency.-Keywords-Bank statement does not exist; bank statement has not been posted; bank statements missing; bank statement numbering

Title: How to Use The Interactive Sales Quote Form
Content: Symptom-You want to send an interactive sales quote to a customer to allow the customer to update or change the sales quote and send it back to the system. You would then like to know the entire process of how the edited interactive sales quote form updates the sales quote in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the New Business workcentre.-Go tothe Sales Quotes view.-Open the sales quote XYZ(XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-Click on the You Can Also button and select the Edit Output Settings option.-In output details make sure that template Sales Quote (Interactive Form) is selected.-Under Send by select the output channel E-Mail.-In the E-Mail Settings, ensure that the customer’s recipient email ABC is entered (ABCrepresents the e-mail address).-Click Apply.-Click on the Submit button to send the interactive form to the designated e-mail.-The email recipient must carry out the following steps:-When opening the PDF, the recipient must enable JavaScript for the document One time only or Always (in the yellow JavaScript enable bar) and existing editable fields will be highlighted once the Edit function is activated.-Editing the interactive sales quote: The recipient clicks the Edit button in the line item on the form and then edits the changeable fields e.g. Quantity.-The edits are usually Quantity, List price, or Add a new item, or a signature added, depending on the needs of the customer.-The recipient clicks Submit at bottom of form once all changes are completed.-An automatic e-mail is created (e.g. via the default application or the webmail) that is sent back to the system (Example: to IFORM@myXXXXXX.mail.sapbydesign.com)-The recipient can then save the changed quote locally if required.-Receiving the interactive sales quote in the system:-The Employee Responsible of the sales quote will receive a notification in their Inbox in the Open items section of the Home Workcenter.-The Subject of the notification is Sales Quote: ABC Changed By Customer.-Click on the Subject drop-down button and select Open Details.-Select the Attachments sub tab and open the PDF of the sales quote.-Enable JavaScript and check the changes that have been made e.g. change in the Quantity-At the bottom of document click on the Update Quote button to approved the changes.-An e-mail with chosen email client (e.g. via the default application or the webmail), will open.-Once you send the e-mail the system updates the sales quote in the system. -When you open the sales quote ABC you can see that the changes were incorporated.-See Also-Please see also Blog: Sales Quote Interactive Form-Keywords-Interactive Form; Quote;

Title: List Price is Being Removed When Changing Labor Resource in a Service Order
Content: Symptom-You are making the attempt to change the Labor Resource available in a follow-up Service Order from a Contract, but the system is automatically removing the list price value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for Contract ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Contract document).-Select the document.-Click Follow-Up button.-Select Service Order.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Enter Service XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service).-Enter List Price: 100 USD.-Navigate to the Service Planning subtab.-Enter Labor Resource: DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Labor Resource).-System removes the list price value.-Cause-For Service such as a Time and Material item (and other items), the price is determined by the master data maintained for the item (service/product).-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please maintain a valid price list for the service under the Pricing view of the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Keywords-Service Order, Labor Resource, Price List, List Price, Removed, Service, Material

Title: Report Auftragsbestand is not Returning Value
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the report Auftragsbestand with the Data Source Sales Order Item & Service Confirmation Item, however the same is not returning the expected value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for the ID Auftragsbestand.-Click the hyperlink.-Click Apply-The system does not return any information.-Cause-The report you are trying to use is a combination between Sales Orders and Service Confirmation. If one of the work centers are not scoped in the system, the report will not return any value.--Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To use the report, please scope the following:-Sales Orders work center.-Sales Orders view.-Field Service and Repair work center.-Service Confirmation view.-Keywords-Auftragsbestand, Source NameSales Order Item, Service Confirmation Item, IDCRMSLSCIB

Title: Error Message: “The Sales Price List Could not be Released” While Migrating the Discount Lists
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate the Discount Lists using the Discount List Type 7PL2, but you receive the below error during Simulation:-The sales price list could not be released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Discount Lists.-Choose Migrate discount lists using the migration tool.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File.-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step.-Cause-Since there is no modification triggered for example: no change of Discount for all the existing Products or no new Product Discount added, no changes were triggered. This means the Discount List is in status Released and not in Partially Released as there was no change triggered in migration payload and action of Release fails since the status of Discount List is already in Released status.-Resolution-Perform at least one change in Discount List, for example, change Discount of one Product or add new Product. The changes will go through and Release will happen without error in migration workbench.-Another alternative solution is to use the Excel approach to upload the Discount List using the steps below:-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center-Go to Pricing view-Go to Discount Lists subview-Select Download button and download the List Template-Logon to SAP Business ByDesign in the MS Excel using your user credentials-Fill the data in the respective fields-Select Save Data To option-Upload the file using Excel Add-in-For discount list in Account specific, there is no need to add Account ID at the Item level again. Kindly remove the entries maintained under Items->Account ID.-See Also-Help Center Document: Configuration: Migration of Discount Lists-2774933 - Error Message "The combination of context elements is not supported" During Migration of Price List-2030884 - Error "The combination of context elements is not supported" During Migration of Price List-2763208 - Migration of Price List Throws Error "The combination of context elements is not supported"-Keywords-migration, discount list, price list, error, Migration of Price Lists, 7PL2

Title: Invoice Schedule Shows Different Value for Fixed Amount in Contract
Content: Symptom-You are maintaining the time frame for the invoice schedule of the contract with fixed amount, but the system is not showing/rounding to the expected value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will use a contract with a net value of USD 1800,00 with an invoicing schedule of 30 recurrences.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Contract document).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select Invoice Schedule subtab.-In this example, you would expect that each recurrence would be of USD 60,00, however, the system is showing USD 59,94.-Cause-The system is displaying this value, because of the rounding calculation and the number of decimals places selected in the business configuration.-In the business configuration, you have selected 2 decimals places for Percent (%), hence, the system will do the following calculation:-1800/30 (net value divided by days).-Hence, 100/30 (100 percent of the value divided by 30 days).-= 3,333333333-System detects the two decimals places.-3,33*1800 (invidual day percentage times net value).-= 5994-5994/100 (amount divided by the percent).-= USD 59,94.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To increase the number of decimals places, please perform the following:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select Physical Unit of Measure.-Select Unit: P1 | Description: Percent-Increase the value to 3 or above.-Please note that the changes performed in this activity will reflect in all documents.-Keywords-Wrong, Value, Invoice Schedule, Fixed Price, Contract, Percent, Quantities, Unit of Measure

Title: Report View Error on a Workcenter Overview
Content: Symptom-When you log on to your ByDesign System or enter a Overview work center, you may face an error message at one of your reports:-View ABC not found. (ABC is the title of the view.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The only way to reproduce the issue is to access the Overview work center. To do so, you can click on a work center or you may click on the Overview view of the desired work center.-For Example:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Overview view.-You will see the error message right on the bottom of a report.-Cause-The cause of this error is that the view that the report is trying to display has been deleted.-Resolution-In order to solve this issue, you have to trigger an update on the report and in the user interface.-To do so, you need to remove the assignment of the report on this work center and assign it again.-These steps are an example:-Go to the 'involved' work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Click on the Personalize button right beside your user.-Click on Edit Screen.-Remove the Visible flag for your report (for example: Sales Order Volume).-Click on the Save button.-Close the Personalize.-Now, open Personalize again and check the Visible flag so your report appears in the Overview view.-Keywords-embedded report, business analytics, report view, view not found, deleted view, overview error message

Title: You Cannot Find the Option for Revenue Assignment in the Customer Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the option for Revenue Assignment in the Customer Invoice Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for invoice requests in To be Invoiced status of type Sales Order, Outbound Delivery, Contract etc.-Edit the invoice request and go to the Items tab.-The Revenue Assignment button is grayed out and there is no other option available for it.-However this option is available in the New Manual Invoice.-Cause-The system do not support the feature of Revenue Assignment in an Invoice Request which is created for any other predecessor document like Sales Order. It is only available in New Manual Invoice.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Keywords-revenue assignment; sales order; manual invoice; manual invoice request

Title: TimeZoneCode is Not Stored for the Text Collection
Content: Symptom-You are using query web service to search the a sales document, i.e. QueryCustomerInvoices API, in the response XML, the timeZoneCode for Text Collection is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Execute the QueryCustomerInvoiceIn request XML.-2. In the reponse XML, the part of text collection, you find the element timeZoneCode="", the value is empty.-<TextCollection>-<Text>-<TypeCode>10024</TypeCode>-<CreationDateTime timeZoneCode=" " daylightSavingTimeIndicator="false">2020-08-03T09:26:17</CreationDateTime>-<ContentText> ABC </ContentText>-</Text>-</TextCollection>-Cause-The timeZoneCode attribute is not stored for the <TextCollection> text business object and as a result is not mapped for the outbound response.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-TextCollection; timeZoneCode; empty; Query Customer Invoices; QueryCustomerInvoiceIn

Title: Performance Issue in Post Goods Issue and Post Goods Receipt Screens
Content: Symptom-Whenever you open Post Goods Issue or Post Goods Receipt screen, it takes some time to load the screen and the performance of this screen while loading is slow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For Post Goods Issue:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Delivery Control-->Delivery Proposal view.-Search for the relevant proposal and select it.-Choose Post Goods Issue button. System takes some time to load the screen.-For Post Good Receipt:-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant purchase order and select it.-Choose Post Goods Receipt button. System takes some time to load the screen.-Cause-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign, due to a technical limitation, performance during the initial loading of Post Goods Issue and Post Goods Receipt is slow. It may take approximately 10 seconds to 2 minutes to completely load the screen.-Resolution-Note that after system upgrade, when you open this screen for the first time, the time lag may further increase.-Keywords-Whenever you open Post Goods Issue or Post Goods Receipt screen, it takes some time to load the screen and the performance of this screen while loading is slow.-post goods issue or post goods receipt,it takes some time to load the screen,performance of this screen while loading

Title: How to Properly Setup a Communication Scenario and Communication Arrangement for Web Service ManageAttachmentFolderIn
Content: Symptom-You want to set up the web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn, however, in some cases, the attachments do not retrieve the proper BinaryObject from the attachments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a communication scenario for web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn and setup its Host Object as CUSTOMER, now you are trying to retrieve the attachments for another object, such as Materials, and the binary objects are not returned properly.-Cause-When a Communication Scenario is created for the web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn, a host object needs to be defined, then, within this communication scenario, only this object will return proper data.-Resolution-Create the Communication Scenarios and Arrangements for each host object that you intend to return data from attachments using web services.-See Also- Blog: Read and Write ByDesign Attachments using Web Services-Keywords-Attachments, Web Services

Title: Common Issues with Text, Attachments and File IO
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document details you the common issues that occurs with Text, Attachments and File IO in any of the Business transaction Documents and Master Data.-S.No Issue Solution How to Debug?-1 Customer requests download of all attachments (e.g. because quitting the contract) This can be performed by the Hosting team using the report DMC_EXTRACT_ATTACHMENTS This is also mentioned in case document 2034068 -2-Attachments are not displayed on the UI or No new attachment can be added on the UI (button not enabled)-Mostly this could be a UI issue.-For example, set a breakpoint in-CL_OBRN_DC_DOCUMENT_LIST=>IF_OBERON_DATA_CONTAINER_EXIT~GET_DATA-Check the context that is given from Oberon; in case BO and Node Name are not filled, set the message to Oberon-BO Name-BO Node Name-BO Node ID 00163E05A3161EE4958F13435199991D-3-TREX has no authorization to access attachments. "HTTPS Status Code 401: Unauthorized" or Resource Search for attachments does not work-Return customer message with the reply: "System is not correctly set up. Please run CTC function module ATTCHMNT_ICF_CREATE_FSI_ALIAS."-More Information from Johannes which can be added to avoid questions by support colleagues: "For the Attachment-FSI-Integration a callback from TREX is required to load the content of the attachment. For this purpose there is a special ICF node. For this node, we have to create a user, generate a password and assign them to the node. This is done by the CTC script ATTCHMNT_ICF_CREATE_FSI_ALIAS. This script (function module) is typically run during system setup."-After the script ran, it is necessary to reload the FSI view: transaction GFSSTM > open affected FSI view > check whether AttachmentFolder.FILE_CONTENT contains all expected data sets > if not, reload node AttachmentFolder.FILE_CONTENT > after reload data sets should be available-IMPORTANT: Contact Managed Services team to run the CTC function module ATTCHMNT_ICF_CREATE_FSI_ALIAS.-To check that the system is not set up correctly, start report (/DOC/DS_GET_DOCUMENT) and press on button "Check config". If the user is not shown on the report output screen, this indicates that the system is not set up correctly.-  There is a note from Johannes in CSS: Note 1769575-CSS answered from Johannes-3500100626 / 0004886859 2012 - BYD40:Search in Attachments not working-3100411552 / 0000054599 2011 - ByD26:Attachment to resource is not sear-4 Customer or partner want to have action CREATE_FOLDER to be PSM released-We are not able to PSM release the action CREATE_FOLDER for partners or customers.-The functionality is not tested since a long time in BOPF implementation and not enabled in ESF2 implementation at all.-  5 XI messages fail with error /DOC/DS_COMMON 055 - Upload of MIME type &1 not permitted-  Check in Business Configuration Activity "Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload" (or backend table /DOC/C_DS_MIMES) whether affected MIME types exist and are allowed. If the affected MIME types are not allowed, return to customer with hint to allow them. If the affected MIME types are not available in the table, return to customer with the hint to add them via button "Restore Defaults".-There are several cases where the attachments with the forbidden mime type (typically XML) are generated by the system (e.g. from BO Incident or Service Delivery). Long-term solution could be, that the application can temporarily switch off our MIME type check (plus the same check implemented in virus scanner, see entry below) for attachments generated by SAP. Our reuse component already has an API which could support this in the future, but has neither been finally implemented nor tested. This would require some joint development effort from both us as reuse component, the virus scanner team as well as the application team(s) that would like to use it. Waiting for official development request to this long-term solution proposal ...-Meanwhile we have discussed an alternative solution proposal with Martina Keller. The outcome was that she will try to change the behavior of the BO incident / software problem report that locally deletes attachments with forbidden MIME type at time of upload.-  6 The URL of the image stored in the HOST_BO-ATTACHMENT_FOLDER-DOCUMENT-FILE_CONTENT_URI-CONTENT is not directly usable in the UI.-  The FileContentURI and the FileContentURIPathName cannot be used for a direct access of an attachment. The reason why the URL stored there doesn't work is simply because it is missing the shared memory information as part of the URL. Normally the standard Attachment CUIBBs, which are used to show the images on the ByD UI, use API /DOC/CL_AS_ATTCHMNT_SHMEM=> PUT_CONTENT_TO_SHMEM_API to get the right URL.-If a consumer of this URL (which is present in the BO) complains that such a URL doesn't work, then ask the same consumer to use the API to get the right URL.-Check feasibility to remove the FileContentURI and the FileContentURIPathName from the web service result-7 Some of the attachment doc types are missing in the dropdown control of the Document list CUIBB-  Forward it to the component who own the UI which uses our Document List CUIBB.-This is because, the CUIBB in such a UI will have the property "AddableTypes" overridden in the UI designer. In UI designer it is possible to filter out certain Attachment types which are basically allowed by the BC config for a particular OTC and ONTC combination. This setting would cause the mentioned symptom-Open the UI in the UI designer and see the properties of the DocumentList CUIBB-Check the property - Addabletypes to see if the default list is overridden.-8 XI messages fail with error AP_SEC_VSCAN 001 - Upload of MIME type &1 not permitted-  Breakpoints can be set in corresponding methods in CL_SEC_VSCAN where messages are raised (CALL_VIRUS_SCANNER, CHECK_MIMETYPE_LIST, CHECK_MIMETYPE_DEFAULT)-Business Configuration Activity "Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload" (or backend table /DOC/C_DS_MIMES)-Check whether coding in CL_SEC_VSCAN is new in the system between creation of BO and creation of XI message-9 Dump in '/DOC/CL_AS_ATTCHMNT_FLOW_COM'-  Application is calling the generic attachment flow API for a BO with missing RBAM rights.-Forward it to the component which owns the UI / BO with request to maintain RBAM properly.-  10 Customer request write access in web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn- Its not possible-the AttachmentFolder is a so-called dependent object. This means it "lives" only in the context of a certain host object. For instan-ce the AttachmentFolder of an instance of the employee can contain an employee image belonging to this employee or, as a second exam-ple, the AttachmentFolder of an instance of a supplier invoice may contain a scanned image of that invoice.-The web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn has only one released operation. This is used for read and can only be used when defining a-new so-called "communication scenario”. This is an example for explanation: e.g. you can use a scenario to query for and read emplo-yees. Both the query and read operation do not return AttachmentFolder content for performance reasons. If you want to read the Atta-chmentFolder content you can add the ManageAttachmentFolderIn Read operation to the scenario.-In case of changing AttachmentFolder content the case is different. This must be done correctly using the Maintain operations of the-hosting object. If that service does not offer the functionality of changing the AttachmentFolder content it must be requested as a-new functionality from that service owner - there is no generic MantainAttachmentFolder web service operation.-11 Service ManageAttachmentFolderIn returns no content or error "/DOC/DS_COMMON 006 Document does not exist"-  This service is generic and requires the configuration of an AccessControlBO in the ProcessComponentInteraction in MDRS. In PDI generated artefacts this is sometimes missing.-Solution: Forward ticket to AP-RC-CSE ("Communication Scenario Explorer", previously covered by component AP-RC-HIE)-  open Inbound Service Interface /DOC/II_MANAGE_ATTCHMNT_FLD_IN in MDRS-do a WhereUsed on it-double click on all results in "Object is directly used by ..." all of type "ProcessComponentInteraction: OperationConnection / InboundServiceInterfaceOperation"-on the opening screen check if entry in field Access Controlled BO is empty-  Documentation on how to configure this service is within this blog:-http://scn.sap.com/docs/DOC-68069, chapters "Read Attachments" and "Some Trouble Shooting".-  Note: ODT does not follow the above approach of creating scenarios in the "Communication Scenario Explorer"-12-Error message occurs when user opens a editable screen (QA or OIF), but has only read-only access to the Business Object- Forward the incident to the Business Object, which includes our attachment DO. The BO needs to implement the RETRIEVE_DEFAULT_NODE_VALUES for the configuration profile. More details can be found here https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki//x/RoL5IQ-  Set breakpoint in CL_RUI_ATTACHMENT_FOLDER_ACP, method IF_RUI_ATTACHMENT_FOLDER_PROXY~GET_TYPE_CODE_LIST to check whether attachment folder root is created due to missing configuration profile.-13 Application has issues with 'wrong' special characters in attachment content.- Check attachment content to ensure it is no display issue. In case content is stored as displayed, forward incident to host BO component as our DO does not have any (unicode) conversion logic and typically this is an issue of the host BO before upload of data.-  SE11 > go to table /DOC/D_AF_FILE_CNT (for ESF2 BOs) > download as excel spreadsheet > here you can see the full content (hint: in SESFTS and SE11 SAPGUI you typically do not see all characters as the field length is limited) > copy and paste the content to an online "hex to string" converter > check how content is stored-14 Upload of attachments with identical name prevented with error message "attachment already exists".- Forward / Return ticket to application team.- Check whether document with same key (attribute NAME) already exists in attachment folder-15 File Upload did not work due to error "System expected the end of the element 'BinaryObject'"- Return ticket back to customer as the XML structure is not filled correctly.-  16 XML message failes with error message "Document not found" or "Document already exists"- Usually, it is an issue with wrong change/create modifcations from inbound agent: as a document with the same name does already exist.-  17 Some of the Text translations are missing in the Attachment EC - Documentlist.-  Usually the case is that the translations are present in the system but somehow they are not picked up. This is especially valid for old ECs with known oberon UI controls and their texts which have not undergone any textual change.-The reason for this bug is unknown. But the fix for this is as follows:-open the affected EC in the backend in the XREP transaction. Goto the update mode, save, add the EC to a transport request and activate. Releasing the transport will automatically trigger the Text translations.-One can then test in the UI to find out if the translations work now. If there is still a problem, please forward the ticket to the translation colleagues on the component SRD-TRL-* .-  18 Unable to open Attachments (Link). When you click the link nothing happens- The Link upload in the Attachment section is only for Web Link/External Web Address (HTTPS). Link to a share/server folder is not supported in Business ByDesign/C4C.-However, as a workaround,User can copy the link shown in the details area below and paste that copied link in the windows explorer and clicks enter key, the file can be opened.-19-Unable to Delete Unprocessed file in File I/O.-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Select Input and Output Management -> File Input-Show Unprocessed Files and select Go-Select the file and click Delete button-Confirm Deletion message pops out and Click Delete-System message: Your entries have been saved.-But he file doesn't get deleted.-Deletion does not work in this case because for the unprocessed file which has no service interface is maintained. Without service interface, deletion via standard UI is currently not supported (see /DOC/IF_WDS_RESOURCE~DELETE in CL_GFI_WDS_RESOURCE)- The file should be deleted from backend-20-When the user replicate Attachments for an Object, system removes the duplicate attachments- This is expected system behavior that the system doesnt allow attachments with same name.- But this is not the same behavior in UI-21- Is it possible to add Extension fields in Attachment DO. Example adding a new extension in attachment OWL- In general extensibility of Dependent objects is not supported. This includes the AttachmentFolder and accordingly also the corresponding UIs.-  See Also-Blog: Read and Write ByDesign Attachments using Web Services

Title: Dump When Adding Product to Sales Order: Conversion of type "APC_S_PARTY_ID" to type "C LENGTH 50" not supported
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-The customer create an extension field via SDK and added the extension scenario CRM Pricing (Header) or CRM Pricing (Item). This extension field was then added to a custom pricing table, the access sequence and pricing group assignment in the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-When adding a product to a sales order the following dump occurs:-OBJECTS_MOVE_NOT_SUPPORTED-CL_PRCTAX_ESF_EXT_UTIL-IF_PRCTAX_ESF_EXT_UTIL~PROVIDE_EXT_ATTRIBUTES-Conversion of type "APC_S_PARTY_ID" to type "C LENGTH 50" not supported.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click on the New button and select the Sales Order option.-Enter the respective data such as account, employee responsible, sales unit etc.-Add the respective Product.-A following Dump occurs.-Logon to the backend and check the respective dump in transaction ST22-You can see the following details:-Runtime Errors: OBJECTS_MOVE_NOT_SUPPORTED-ABAP Program: CL_PRCTAX_ESF_EXT_UTIL========CP-Short Text:-Conversion of type "APC_S_PARTY_ID" to type "C LENGTH 50" not supported.-Information on where terminated:-Termination occurred in the ABAP program "CL_PRCTAX_ESF_EXT_UTIL========CP"-in "IF_PRCTAX_ESF_EXT_UTIL~PROVIDE_EXT_ATTRIBUTES".-The main program was "SAPMHTTP".-Source Code Extract:-You can see that the dump occurs in Line 102  ( ls_attribute-values  =  value  #(  (  <lv_ext_field>  ) )-Chosen Variables:-Since the dump points to an issue with the data type of the variable you can check in the section IT_EXT_FIELD_NAME which field is causing the issue.-As this is a PDI field it will start with the PDI solution name e.g. YABCDEFG_P000ABCDEFG (YABCDEFG_P000ABCDEFG represents the proxi name of the extension field).-Go to transaction /N/EXT/FIELD-Filter for BO Sales_Order-Select the PDI extension field YABCDEFG_P000ABCDEFG-In the Field Metadata tab under section Definition you can see that the Field Type is ID_DT and the Data Type Name is PartyID.-Note down the Label of the PDI extension field.-Cause-The extension field is of data type ID. In the price list extensibility, the data type ID is not supported as price extension field. This is the reason why the error occurs. In the price list extensibility we only support data types such as Text, Code List, Numeric.-Extension fields of type Code List are only supported when created via Key User Tools. Extension fields of type Code Lists created via PDI solution are not supported in Pricing Extension scenario.-Resolution-The author of the Add-On needs to change the data type of the PDI extension field to the data type Text instead of ID.

Title: Access Restriction in Report Value Help
Content: Symptom-A user opens a report, for example a report on opportunities. His access rights to opportunities are restricted, and he does not see the opportunity ABC neither in the report, nor in the Opportunity work center view. However, when he uses the value help of the field Opportunity in the report, he can see the opportunity ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the assigned work center.-Run the report and check all opportunities that are displayed. The opportunity ABC is not listed because the user has no access right to see this particular document.-In the report selection, click on the Opportunity value help.-The user sees the opportunity ABC listed here.-Cause-This report uses a joined data source. In data sources of this type, the access context of the user is not applied to value helps. This is done for performance reasons - when you join data sources, the system needs more resources to calculate every join and compile the data. So to avoid delays, the access context is ignored in value helps. This behaviour is consistent across all reports that are based on a joined data source.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour. The access context is nevertheless applied to the report data, so even if the user select the opportunity ABC from the value help, he will not see any data in the report if he is not authorized via his access restrictions.-Also note that value help in reports based on standard or combined data source will not display value ABC if end user is not authorized via access restrictions as in such case, access context of user will be applied to value help as well.-Keywords-Report,Data Source, Access context, User, Value help, Performance, AP-RC-ANA, combined, joined, Access Restriction-unrestricted,joined data source,access context

Title: Contract Item 10 was not Renewed as Expected.
Content: Symptom- The Contract Item date has expired and based on the Renewal rules configuration, you expected to have a new item created automatically right after the expiry date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for the Contract ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Contract).-Navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that Line Item 10 is expired with the Contract Item End Date 30.06.2020.-The renewed Line Item 20 with the Contract Item Start Date 01.07.2020.-Navigate to the Changes tab.-You can see that the Renewal of the item was only executed on the 02.07.2020, whereas you expected to be renewed on the 01.07.2020.-Cause-Based on the configuration maintained under the Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts activity, the item is expected to renewal, however, the system ran into a conflict since when the new item creation was requested, the termination for the expired item was occurring and thus blocking the document.-Also, Automatic Renewal of Contract with Auto Release has no 'renewal duration' maintained and hence when item XX was renewed, system copy the duration from previous item which was, e.g, 31 days.-If you want to renew item for 1 month duration then you should maintain renewal duration in renewal rule.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.--In order to avoid this in the future, please create a rule and activate the Advance Creation Duration. This will avoid the overlad of tasks being executed at the same time.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the activity Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts.-Create a new rule.-On Renewal Create: Contract.-Enter a value for Advance Creation Duration, for example: 2 Hour(s).-Keywords-Contract, Renewal, Item, Expired, Advanced Creation Duration, Customer

Title: Uploading Deprecated Custom OData Service Files
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-With release 2005 SAP the button '(Deprecated) Upload' was introduced in OData Service Explorer.  This button served to upload Custom OData Service XML files which were downloaded prior to the 2005 upgrade. This button is missing in the latest SAP Business ByDesign releases.-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-With release 2008  the button has been removed ('(Deprecated) Upload') from OData service explorer.-Resolution-Go to the backend-Use the transaction SE16 and enter the table name  ‘ODATA_GLOBAL_VAR_L’.-Maintain below entry in table ‘ODATA_GLOBAL_VAR_L’. -                         PROP_KEY           = IS_DEPRECATED_UPLOAD_ENABLED-                         VALUE                  = ‘X’-Then refresh OData Service Explorer. ‘Deprecated Upload’ button should be visible for Custom OData Services.-See Also-Metadata of OData Services-Keywords-Deprecated Upload button; OData Service Upload;

Title: Project Tasks Object Value Selector in Purchase Order items details are filtered on three parameters
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Project Task Object Value Selector (OVS), from the Purchase Orders Item Details, shows different content depending if the item is copied or added as new.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-2. Select the Purchase Orders view.-3. Search for a specific Purchase Order.-4. Select the Items tab.-5. Select line Item 1.-6. Click on Copy.-7. With the copied line item selected, go to the Account Assignment tab.-8. On the Project Task field, click on the selection button (Value help).-9. Verify how many tasks appear on the list.-10. Repeat the same steps above but without copying the line item. For example, by adding a new item (Add row).-11. You can see that now the Project Tasks list shows more records.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-This system behavior is as designed. In fact, the reason why you see less project tasks from the list, when copying an item, is as following:--We filter the Project Task list in Purchase Order based on three parameters.--1. BlockingStatusSelectionCode.-2. Customer ID.-3. Project Type Code.--In this case, the copied items have a customer Id filled. Hence the list of the project tasks contains less records.-The Items Copy option will copy all the References, such as delivery address, party details, BTD References, etc.-For this reason you may see the list of project tasks which is the same as the item you have copied.--If you manually create a new item from scratch (add row) the above parameters are not filled and you'll be able to see the full list containing the project tasks.--Note: You may be able to see the copied Customer ID, for a copied item, from the Delivery tab under item details.

Title: Previously Complete Quote is Now In Process
Content: Symptom-You have either a Quote (Sales Quote, Service Quote or Quote for Contract) which was previously in status Completed, but is now In Process without changes being made directly it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Open Sales Quote ABC (ABC represents the ID of a Sales Quote which is now In Process but was Completed previously).-Navigate to the Changes tab.-You will see that a user has made a change which modified the status of the document to In Process, however, afterwards, a change was made by SAP_SYSTEM which put it back to In Process status.-Cause-This happens when the follow-up document created from this quote is either deleted or cancelled. In these cases, the Quote will automatically be opened back up by the system (Represented by the In Process status).-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour for these cases. If the Quote is not needed anymore, you can cancel it by following these steps:-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Open Sales Quote ABC-Edit Sales Quote ABC and select the View All button.-Go to the General tab.-Add a value in the Reason for Rejection field.-Save the Sales Quote. -Keywords-Sales Quote, Service Quote, Quote for Contract, Completed, In Process, Opened, Reopened, Unexpected, Status.

Title: Errors during Checking Items and Runtime Objects
Content: Symptom-When performing a consistency check on your custom solution from the Cloud Applications Studio, the following errors are prompted:-Multiple attributes for text node in BCO TaxType are not supported.-Content of IV_ATTRIBUTE is inconsistent.-Error when check runtime object of IV_ATTRIBUTE.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Studio.-Open the affected PDI solution.-Right click on the solution name in the Solution Explorer section and select Check -> Items and Runtime Objects-Error occurs. -Cause-Following the system design pattern, the Tax Type business configuration sets are supposed to be country-specific, as well as the Business Adaptation Content (BAC) file.-The reason why the issue is happening, is because the BAC file in your solution is not country-specific.-Resolution-You would need to change the existing BAC file to a country-specific BAC.-See Also-Please check the section Create a Country and Business Options in the Cloud Applications Studio from the SAP Help Portal.-Keywords-BC, set, BCC, BCO

Title: OData Filter Returns Wrong Result
Content: Symptom-You have built your OData query but when you run it with a filter, you notice that it does not work. You may not get any results even though that filter values you defined should return data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Ensure that your OData query has some values in the filter.-Run your OData query in the browser.-You get no results even though there is data for those values in the report. You may also notice that without the filters, the expected values are returned.-Cause-You have put the filter on an ID field. Let us assume the following example: You are filtering on the Contract and Contract Item. These are UUID fields, however in the item field, you filter for the ID '10'. Since it's a UUID field, the ID 10 will be converted into a UUID. However there are multiple items with the ID 10. Hence the system takes the first UUID with this ID, which may not correspond to the item of that contract. As a result, no data is returned.-Resolution-For item fields (or other fields where 1 ID may correspond to several UUIDs), it is strongly recommended to use an ID field in the filter, for example Contract Item ID.-Keywords-Odata, report, data source, analytics, reporting, filter not working, no results, missing data

Title: Report Shows Asterisk (*)
Content: Symptom-You are running a report but for some key figures (or in the result line), you see an asterisk (*) instead of the appropriate value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the assigned work center.-Via the Settings, add the required key figures or a result line.-You notice that some lines display * instead of the actual value.-Cause-The asterisk is shown due to different currencies or units of measure. For example, if you have opportunities in different currencies for the same account, and you only display the Account as a characteristic in the report view, the system tries to aggregate the key figure values of all opportunities for this account. However, if there are different currencies, these values cannot be aggregated, e.g. 100 EUR + 100 USD cannot be aggregated to 200 since this would be a wrong value.-Resolution-This is the correct behaviour. You can make use of one of the following workarounds:-You can use the selection to convert currencies so that the aggregation can take place. In some reports for example, you can use the variable Display Currency to show all values in the same currency. In this case please make sure you maintain currency exchange rates in your system.-Alternatively, you can add additional fields to the report view so that you see each value separately, with the respective currency / unit of measure. In this example, you can add the field Opportunity in addition to the Account to see the separate values for each opportunity. This way, no aggregation will take place and each value will be shown separately with the corresponding currency.-See Also-2492820 - 'Aggregation not possible. Multiple Unit/Currency used' Message Showing Up in RUI Home Tile Reports (Cloud for Customer)-Keywords-Report, *, aggregation, Display Currency, asterisk, Key Figure, key figure shows asterisk-currency,business analytics,currency conversion

Title: User Sees Real Data in Reports in Business Analytics
Content: Symptom-A user ABC opens a report from the work center Business Analytics. His access context is No Restrictions. If another user (e.g. DEF) opens this report from the work center Business Analytics, he can only see test data (access context Test Data). Your business configuration is not set up to show real data in reports from this work center, so you are wondering why the user ABC has no restrictions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log on as user ABC.-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports, and open a report.-You will have the access context No Restrictions and the data in this report is real data.-Perform the same steps logged on as user DEF.-The access context shows Test Data.-In the work center Business Configuration, view Overview, open the activity Administrator Analytics - Settings.-The option Show Real Data Instead of Generic Data is not ticked.-You would thus expect that in the work center Business Analytics, all users see test data in reports.-Cause-The user ABC is assigned to a PDI work center. Users with this access right will always see real data in reports in Business Analytics.-Resolution-If this is not intended, please remove the assignment to the PDI work center:-Go to the work center Application and User Management, view Business users.-Search for user ABC and click Edit > Access Rights. -In the tab Work Center and View Assignment, remove assignments to work center views that are related to Partner Development.-Keywords-business analytics, report, real data, test data, business configuration, analysis, access context, access restriction
