Title: Last Name Displayed Twice in Personnel File
Content: Symptom-When looking at an employee in work center Personnel Administration, you notice that an additional or double last name is displayed.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Personal Administration work center-2. Open the personnel file of an employee ID-3. Observe that a double or additional last name is displayed.-Cause-The duplication or additional surname for an employee appears due to the fact, that the Additional Family Name attribute on the Personnel Data tab on the Personnel File has a value maintained.-Note:-If this field does not show up for your user on the Personnel File, then you can add it via the Personalisation mode for the Personnel Data tab on the Personnel File.-Resolution-To correct, please add the attribute and/or remove the value from the Additional Family Name attribute. Save the change and then if required, start Personalisation again and remove the attribute from the Personnel File.-See Also-Please also see attached example taken from SAP internal reproduction system.-Keywords-duplicate name; surname; twice; personnel data; family name

Title: Sort Option Not Working on Extension Field in Sales Document Table View
Content: Symptom-You created a PDI Extension Field and added it to a Table as a column in any Sales View (E.g Sales Order, Sales Quote, Customer Invoice, etc), however, you are not able to Sort the column by clicking on it.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Using an example where the field is added to the Sales Order view:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-In this screen, click on the Column Header ABC (Where ABC represents the PDI Extension Field name).-Select "Sort Ascending" or "Sort Descending".-Nothing happens.-Cause-This used to happen due to a corrupt ChangeElementSequence change transaction (in PDI fields). This type of change transaction is created once an user changes the order of the table columns via drag & drop action.-This behaviour was fixed by the development team so there should be no new cases, but on cases where it has already happened, it's necessary to perform some steps in order to fix it.-Resolution-Navigate to a screen where you have added the PDI Extension Field as a Column.-From the Adapt menu, select Enter Adaptation Mode.-Select the Table.-Drag the Column to a new position.-Drag the Column back to it's original position.-Click on Save and Publish on the Right-side of the screen.-Exit Adaptation Mode.-You should now be able to sort this Column.-See Also-2813020 - Calculation Table is Not Available in Invoice Documents view-Keywords-Table, Sort, Extension Field, Ascending, Descending, unable, not working, OWL screen.

Title: Error "HTTP 500 (InternalServerError)" Occurs While Activating the Web Service
Content: Symptom-Error "HTTP 500 (InternalServerError)" occurs while activating the web service-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio-Open PDI solutiom-Right-click the corresponding web service and select Activate-Wait for some time-Error "HTTP 500 (InternalServerError) - Dump or unhandled exception in backend" occurs-Cause-The issue happens because the WSDL contained large number of operations and its activation gets timedout in the Cloud Applications Studio.-Resolution-Try and activate the entire solution.-Login to Cloud Application Studio-Open Solution-Right click and activate entire Solution.-As this is a background job, it will not time out and should solve the issue.-Keywords-InternalServerError; Webservice, Error activating Webservice

Title: Error : Data type 'ABC' is not supported. Use values suggested by code completion
Content: Symptom-You will receive the error Data type 'ABC' is not supported. Use values suggested by code completion, where ABC is a complex data type.-Reproducing the Issue-You are using a data type for example GLOBAL_DateTime in extending a standard business object using SDK. But you will receive the error while checking, Data type 'GLOBAL_DateTime' is not supported. Use values suggested by code completion, even though you will get these data types in the list of data types  that can be used.-   Cause-Complex Data Types are not supported in the Extension Framework hence in this case the data type GLOBAL_DateTime cannot be used in XBO definition.-Resolution-You should use the basic data types if you are using Extension of standard BO. Below are the examples of basic data types that will be supported in Extension Framework.-Amount-Date-DecimalValue-CodeList – SAP code lists-ID-Identifier – SAP identifiers-Indicator-Quantity-Time-Text-WebURI-EmailURI- See Also-You can find the basic data types that can be used for extension in the following link:-http://help.sap.com/saphelpiis_studio_1502/KTP/Products/bf889ebdf45d4dd19d4a0e0bd39a07fb/LibraryStructure/SAP_BBD_Studio.html-And the path is:---SAP Cloud Application Studio-> Scripting Languages -> Scripting Language for the Studio -> Element.- Keywords-data type is not supported,use values suggested by code completion

Title: Approval Process for Cancellation Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have set Approval Process for Customer Invoice, however, when you cancel the document, the Cancellation Customer Invoice doesn't trigger the Approval Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its version.-Reproducing the Issue-Customer Invoicing work center.-Invoice Documents view.-Search for XYZ (XYZ refers to a released Customer Invoice).-Click on Cancel button.-New Cacellation Invoice is created.-After saving or releasing, the document doesn't trigger the Approval Process.-Cause-Before Release 2008 the Customer Invoice Approval Process is only triggered on release of Customer Invoice documents and not on Cancellation Customer Invoice documents.-Resolution-The Approval Process is available for Cancellation Customer Invoice documents with Release 2008-Keywords-Approval Process ; Customer Invoice ; Cancellation ; Cancelation

Title: Cannot Change Sales Unit in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to change the sales unit in a Sales Order, but the system only returns the value already maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from the Common Task.-Enter account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-The system determines the Sales Unit automatically.-Select the value box for the Sales Unit.-The system only returns the option already maintained.-Resolution-This is the current expected system behavior.-To view the others options available for the Sales Unit field.-Navigate to the Sales Unit field.-Remove the current value. -Click the value box. -Now the system will retrieve the other values available.-Keywords-Sales Unit, Filter, Not, Showing, Sales Order

Title: Error/Warning in Service Order "Item 10: Release not possible;quantity exceeds inventory quantity at custodian XYZ"
Content: Symptom-In your service order, the following error/warning message is triggered: "Item 10: Release not possible;quantity exceeds inventory quantity at custodian XYZ" (XYZ represents the identification of the custodian).-Custodian stands for the ship-to party of the service order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Order Pipeline view.-Select the Service Order ABC (ABC represents the identification of the service order).-Select the action Confirm execution to create a service confirmation.-The following error/warning message is triggered: "Item 10: Release not possible;quantity exceeds inventory quantity at custodian XYZ".-Cause-If the documents are being created through the UI, one of the reasons for the error/warning message is that the service confirmation already exists for the service order, however the binding of the item from the service confirmation to the service order has been removed.-This can happen if the item is first removed and added again to the service confirmation. It is then required to add the service order reference to the item.-If the document is being created via webservice, this can happen if you're not passing the identified stock (batch) information in the API call. Passing this information along with the payload will ensure that the stock gets reduced from the inventory.-Resolution-To fix the issue in the UI, you can follow the steps below:-Cancel the invoice for the service confirmation already created.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select the invoice DEF (DEF corresponds to the invoice of the service confirmation).-Select Cancel.-Release the Cancel invoice.-Cancel the service confirmation.-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmation view.-Edit the service confirmation for the service order ABC and item 10.-Go to View All.-Go to the General tab.-Input a reason for rejection and click Save.-Create a new service confirmation with the reference to the item 10.-Create a new invoice.-If the scenario is being created via webservice, please make sure to include the Identified Stock information associated with the product in the Service Confirmation.-Keywords-Impossible to release Service Order Confirmation, trying to release, Serviceauftragsbestätigung, Position 10: Freigabe nicht möglich; Menge überschreitet Bestandsmenge für Besitzer

Title: Sales Order Volume Report Show Incorrect Data
Content: Symptom-Sales Volume Report is showing incorrect data, it is also showing the sales order which are not even available in the SAP ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Open Sales Order Volume report.-Selection Parameters:-Time Frame: Last Month.-Remove the filter: Status (Header).-Select the Go button.-Move Account to rows (from Currently not shown).-Search for the account ABC (ABC represents the ID of a customer account).-Here the account ABC with a turnover of XXX amount is shown. This Order does not exists in the SAP Business ByDesign system (XXX represents the net value of the order).-Cause-The report also shows the data for the sales order created via web shop.-The sales order which is not visible in SAP ByDesign system was created via web shop and sent to ByD.--Now the reason for Sales Order created for the account ABC not being shown in the ByDesign sales order interface is because, this sales order is created from internet and this Sales Order has Customer Request Release status as Not Released.-SAP ByDesign does not show sales order with status Not Released on the sales order interface.--To set or manage the sales order (created via web shop) release status you need to check the Business Configuration scoping questions and take appropriate actions:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Show All Projects and select the relevant one.-Edit the Project Scope-In Scoping, go to the section Questions -> Select Sales -> Selling Products and Services -> E-Selling -> Questions:-Would you like your customers to confirm sales orders that originate from an E-Shop with information calculated in the Business ByDesign system?-Would you like your employees to control the release of sales orders that originate from a web shop in order to initiate order processing?-Do you want the system to automatically send an order confirmation to the customer when a sales order that originates from an E-Shop is released?-For the question 1, If you select Yes: This means that when a Sales Order is created the Request Release Status will be Not Released . This will change-to Released when the operation SalesOrderActionIn -> ReleaseCustomerRequest is executed.-NOTE: The operation SalesOrderActionIn -> ReleaseCustomerRequest has to be to be executed from the Web Shop, this means customer has to release the-customer request in the web shop itself. Unless this is executed the sales order will not appear on the user interface of Business ByDesign.--If you select No: Then you wouldn't not have to call the action SalesOrderActionIn -> ReleaseCustomerRequest (In web shop) to explicitly confirm the Order.-The order created by the webshop is confirmed and can be viewed by the sales representative. The sales order can be seen on the sales order interface or sales order view.--The report is designed to show all the sales order created both in SAP ByDesign & via web shop. In case you do not want to see the webshop order-then you have to set the Parameters for the report accordingly:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports view -> List subview.-Open the Sales Volume Report in the Web Browser.-In the Selection -> Select Edit Selection tab -> Find the Origin field.-In the value help of the Origin, you have three values for selection 1, 2 & 4.-1 represents: Manual data entry (i.e. document created manually in the ByDesign system).-2 represents B2B messages.-4 represents Internet.-Depending upon the selected parameter the data will be displayed in the report.-Following are the additional details about the Sales Order Interface and the Sales Volume Report:-1. Report displays all non internet sales orders and sales orders with origin internet which are ‘Released’ and ‘Not Released’. Hence the number of sales orders between Report and Sales Order UI differ. Sales order UI displays all non-internet sales orders and sales orders with origin internet which are only ‘Released’ (Mandatory filter).--2. Report by default displays Net Value however Sales order UI displays the Total Value.--3. Report displays sales orders with the following filters by default:-Status: Open, In Process and Completed, Item Cancelation status is Not Canceled, Time frame is Current Year to Date, Employee Responsible is logged in Employee. You can change the default filters as per your requirement.-Resolution-You can either change your scoping options accordingly or alternatively you can set up an Internet Order Deletion Run to remove the Sales Orders for which no second call for releasing/explicitly confirming the Sales Order (ReleaseCustomerRequest) was sent.-This can be done as follows:-Go to the E-Commerce work center.-Select the Internet Order Deletion Runs view.-Click on the New button.-Maintain the respective data.  -Click on the Schedule button.-Maintain the recurrence schedule in which the run should be executed.-Click on the Set Activate button.-Save the run.-Please note that you have to maintain both Sales Organization From/To and Distribution Channel From/To. In the Created Before field you can maintain the amount of e.g. days or hours, before the time of deletion. For example if the Sales Order was create yesterday and the Created Before is maintained as 1 Day(s), the run will remove the Sales Order.-See Also-1840866 - You Are Not Able to Find your Sales Order created from your E-Shop in the ByD system-Keywords-Sales Order Volume; E-Commerce; Web Shop; Internet Order Deletion Runs; Missing Sales Order in the UI;

Title: Dump When Trying to Delete Implementation Project Draft
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USER ONLY***-Customer tries to delete an unwanted or no longer necessary draft in the Implementation Projects work center view of the Business Configuration work center, but a dump occurs.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Notice that the project has a warning icon next to it. Hovering over the icon with the cursor shows message "Project is in draft state. Finish editing the project scope before continuing with the activity list."-Click Delete Draft; in some screen resolutions, it might be necessary to click the (...) icon to display this option.-Dump occurs.-Cause-Most frequently, this issue occurs because more than one draft exists. In this case, system cannot determine which draft to delete when the option is triggered from the frontend and the system dumps.-There are two ways to confirm if this is the case — the first is that the log for the dump in the ST22 transaction of the backend will state "More than one draft workspace exists" and the other is:-Access the system's backend-Navigate to transaction BCTADM-In the Workspace Overview section, the transaction lists all existing workspaces in the tenant, including ones only visible in the backend; if the dump is happening because there are multiple draft workspaces, there will be more than one workspace listed here with the Draft column checked.-Resolution-In this case, deletion of the drafts must be executed from the backend upon customer's authorization.-Access the system's backend.-Navigate to transaction BCTADM.-In the Workspace Overview section, take note of the Workspace ID of all draft workspace.-Change selection to Delete Workspace.-Input the Workspace ID of one of the draft workspaces in the Workspace ID field.-Press Enter to confirm the selection.-Click the Execute button (or press F8).-A popup will be raised, asking you to confirm the deletion; click Yes.-Repeat steps 5 to 8 for the remaining draft workspaces until all drafts are deleted.-Keywords-Dump, Delete Draft, Business Configuration

Title: No Error shown for Custom File Input Run Execution Log
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload Custom Business Object Instances through File Input Run and, although the Run is successful, there are no records created in the System.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites (Check See Also for Blog with more details):-You have created a Custom Business Object.-You have created an XML File Input Service Integration.-You have created a File Input Run ID in the UI.-Steps to reproduce:-Go to the Work Center "Application and User Management".-Select the View "File Input" under "Input and Output Management".-Select "Unprocessed Files" from Dropdown.-Click Add and Upload your XML File to the Service Interface.-Select "Active Runs" from Dropdown.-Schedule the Run ID relevant to Service Interface.-Cause-Case 1:-The Processing consists of two steps:-Parsing the XML file and performing basic checks.-Processing the XML file and modifying the Business Object accordingly.-When processing the XML in File Input Run, only the errors that occur in the Step 1 are shown in the Execution Log. These errors will cause the Run to fail. If the error occurs in Step 2, the Run will be successful but the errors are shown in the View "Process Communication Errors" under "Application and User Management" Work Center. You can switch the Dropdown on this view to "Open Errors with Incidents".-Case 2:-If you still cannot determine the Root Cause, it is most likely because the XML File provided is too large. It can be roughly defined that the maximum file size is 20,000 KB for a basic Business Object however, this limitation can vary depending on a number of factors:-The structural complexity of the Business Object (Number of Nodes, Elements, Associations).-The number of Internal Communications defined as part of the Business Object.-The number and complexity of ABSL Events that will trigger as a result (AfterModify, ValidationOnSave, BeforeSave).-Resolution-Case 1:-Check the error messages in the View "Process Communication Errors" and correct your XML File accordingly.-Case 2:-Try uploading a smaller file size and see if the records are uploaded. Records will be visible up to 30 minutes after the Run status is updated to "Finished" for files of ~19,000 KB.-If you are still facing issues, please open an incident with SAP Support Services.-See Also-Refer to this blog for more information: How To Upload Mass Data via XML File Input-Keywords-XML, Restriction, Limitation, PDI, SDK, Process, Processing, Parsing, Parse, Service Integration, Unprocessed Files, Finished, Schedule, Completed, Finish, Maximum, File Size, Entries

Title: How to set a Specific Hierarchy Level as Default View for a Report
Content: Symptom-You would like to choose a specific hierarchy Initial expansion Level and display it as default every time the report is opened.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Resolution-You should be able to choose the desired hierarchy and display it as default view as following:-1. Go to the view, click More and open the Characteristic Settings.-2. Select how you would like to display the hierarchy (i.e. Description or ID).-3. Choose an option from the Initial expansion Level column. i.e. Expand to 03 hierarchy node and click ok.-4. You will then see that the report hierarchy has been adjusted to the level you have chosen.-5. If you are happy with the display then save the view by selecting View button and Save.-6. Set the saved view as default by selecting the Set as Default button.-7. Close and re-open the report and you should be able to see the report opening with the desired layout.-Keywords-report hierarchy; report; characteristic settings

Title: Guideline of Internal Incident Handling for Consulting in Analytics
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You are handling a project-specific customer request or consulting customer question, which goes beyond the support scope and you want to know how far you can go and how to deal with such requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The responsibility of supporting a report (including its performance) lies with the creator of the report / data source.-Cause-You can refer youself to these guidelines bellow when you are in doubt about the expected effort you should put to provide consulting answers as well as what is the common recomendation for those consulting incidents you might be handling.-As a rule of thumb, it works more like as guidance, do not stick only to templates texts. Even without provide accurate consulting, they expect to feel like we care about their request, so adjust your reply accordingly-Resolution- Typical scenarios:-Scenario Example  Expectation  Incident Priority-Create new ANA objects  How do the customer create a report or data source that shows a particular information   You can still spend up to 30 min of analysis to provide some guidance and close it straight way Medium-How to build up a new ANA content  Looking for field or certain data in data source, which data source to use  Check in the system, spend ~30 mins and provide suggestions to customer (if any). Refer to consulting channels for further questions. Medium-Content issue in custom Data source or Report Customer reports an issue in the content of a custom report-Possible conditions applied to this scenario:-Check if the same wrong content is shown in standard data sources / report (if possible). If yes, follow known approach-If not, spent ~30 mins to see if you can find more details or suggestions. Refer to consulting channels for further questions.-If PDI basic Data Source, check with PDI.-If PDI joined / combined: spent ~30 mins to see if you can find more details or suggestions. Refer to consulting channels for further questions.-Medium-Questions about Key Figure values Standard key figures show incomprehensible values, or it’s not clear what scenario they can be used for. Reproduce in a standard report and clarify with the application team (Support in ByD, or DEV in C4C) Medium-Slow performance issues in ANA Bad performance in when running custom Data sources, Reports or Dashboards. Spent ~30 mins to see if you can find more details or suggestions. Refer to consulting channels for further questions. Medium-See Also-For all scenarios: Refer to 2559087 - How-To and Consulting Queries in Reporting for Analytics when closing an incident categorized as Consulting.-Keywords-Consulting, handling of consulting, Analytics queries

Title: Unable to Bind a Field using Adobe Livecycle Designer Even When the Data is Available in XML
Content: Symptom-You have a valid binding path and trying to bind a field using Adobe Livecycle Designer, however you are unable to traverse the whole path in Livecycle designer.-"Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Download the standard template from Form template maintenance-Open the ".xdp" file in ALD-Select a field to bind with binding path (example: x->y->z->data)-When tried to traverse the path at times we do not see whole path.-Cause-Data connection to the Main schema would be lost or not updated with latest data.-Resolution-You nee to reconnect the main schema to data view.-Steps to correct:-Open .xdp file (template) in Adobe Livecycle designer and go to Data view.-Right click on ‘Dataconnection’ and select ‘Connection properties’ (refer: screenshot 1).-Click Next & Ok.-In this screen, browse and select the MainSchema.xsd (refer: screenshot 2).-Click ‘Finish’.-Once the connection is updated, now you should be able to bind the field respectively.-    See Also-2580034 - How to Enable XML Schema in Adobe LiveCycle Designer-2757983 - Cannot Do Binding Of Custom Involved Party For Service Request Form In Adobe LiveCycle Designer-Keywords-XML, Schema, Adobe LiveCycle Designer, Connections Properties, ALD,

Title: Delete Line Item in Sales Quote via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are not able to delete items in Sales Quote via webservice - ManageCustomerQuoteIn. The following errors appear:-"Deletion not possible; existing data for ITEMS not fully specified".-"Missing key specification for processing node CUSTOMER_QUOTE ITEM".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run the webservice - ManageCustomerQuoteIn using the tag for deletion as below:-<CustomerQuote actionCode="04">-<ID>ABC</ID>-<Items itemScheduleLineListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" actionCode="03">-<ItemProduct>-<ProductInternalID>YYY</ProductInternalID>-</ItemProduct>-ABC represents the Sales Quote ID-YYY represents the Product ID-The response of the payload comes with the errors:-"Deletion not possible; existing data for ITEMS not fully specified".-"Missing key specification for processing node CUSTOMER_QUOTE ITEM".-Cause-It's necessary to provide the Line Item ID of the Sales Quote while deleting the item via webservice-Resolution-Run the webservice - ManageCustomerQuoteIn using the tag for deletion as below:-<CustomerQuote actionCode="04">-<ID>ABC</ID>-<Items actionCode="03">-<ID>XX</ID>-</Items>-</CustomerQuote>-XX represents the Line Item ID of Sales Quote ABC.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Customer Quote, Webservice, Delete, Items

Title: Aggregated Values of Key Figures From MAT_GENERAL Data Source Not Displaying Correctly
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that the aggregation values of some key figures in reports built upon standard data source MAT_GENERAL are not matching the actual sum of those fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Access the Design Reports work center view.-Search for the relevant report created using the MAT_GENERAL data source.-Open the report.-Without filtering for any specific records in the key figures, run the reports — this will show values aggregated from all data.-You expect the aggregated values display the result of summing up the respective values from all products in the system, but for some fields (for example, Gross Weight), the value displayed does not match this total.-Cause-All key figures of the MAT_GENERAL data source (except "Count") have aggregation type set as MAX instead of SUM. This means that, for each field, the highest value will be displayed instead of a sum of all values.-Resolution- This is the standard system behavior.-Other data sources will have similar key figures that will show only the max value.-Keywords-MAT_GENERAL, value, reports, aggregation, summation

Title: SAP ByDesign and SuccessFactors Integration Pre-Requisites
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to map existing employees/users in SAP ByDesign and SuccessFactors?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-This scenario is currently not supported, hence the mapping of existing employees is not possible. Pre-requisites are mentioned as below:-ByD HCM application does not contain any (legacy) employee master data. A migration of those to the EC landscape is not supported.-All employees are maintained in Employee Central. No mixed scenarios like maintaining the employee data for one company in EC and for another one in ByD are supported.-The system is working as expected.-One Employee Central tenant is connected to one Business ByDesign tenant as the only source of employee replication.-All employees are maintained in Employee Central. No mixed scenarios like maintaining the employee data for one company in EC and for another one in ByD are supported.-If the PDI enhancements are used to also replicate service agents, no service agents may be maintained in ByD. This has to be ensured by means of the ByD authorization concept.-Keywords-SuccessFactors, Employee Central, Integration, Pre-Requisites

Title: No Matching Inventory Found When Trying to Scrap the Product
Content: Symptom-You want to Scrap the product which exists at Site with Id ABC which is an Externally Managed Warehouse managed by your warehouse provider.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View and select Scrapping subview.-Enter Site ID which is externally managed and Product ID details.-Choose Next using guided activity, system throws error message:  No matching inventory items found-Cause-When you are trying to perform Scrapping for any product which is at 3PL Site with id ABC, it actually does not physically exists at your end.-Resolution-Go to the Third Party Logistics Work center.-Go to Common Tasks View.-Choose New Inventory Change in Externally-Managed Location subview.-New Window Opens up, enter all mandatory details under General Tab.-Navigate to Line Items tab, Add Row, enter Item ID.-Now in next column, enter reason as Scrapping and Movement Direction as Goods Issue.-Then enter the required Product ID, Identified Stock and Quantity which you want to scrap.-Perform Check and Release.-Now system creates Notification ID for scrapping, which you can see under Third Party Logistics Work center.-Go to 3PL Inventory Management View.-Choose Inventory Notifications subview.-Show All Notifications and find required ID.-Keywords-No matching inventory items found, You want to Scrap the product which exists at Site with Id

Title: How to Set Characteristics as Set Fixed Value Selection From the Report Wizard
Content: Symptom-This document is intended to explain how you can set characteristics as Set fixed value selection from the Report Wizard.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Resolution-In order to Set Fixed Value Selection, for a specific characteristic, the following needs to be done:-From the Business Analytics work center Edit the desired report with the Report wizard.-On Step 4, Characteristic Properties, highlight the desired characteristic name.-Change the value selection to Fixed Value Selection and you should see that the Set fixed value selection button is enabled.-Click on the Set fixed value selection button and enter the desired selection as follow:Click Ok.-For single value click on the value help icon.-For additional values and options click on the more icon.-Save the report.-Keywords-Set Fixed Value Selection; fixed value; report wizard; setting fixed value

Title: Cloud Print Manager Not Showing the Print Queues or With Error "Connection test failed Object reference not set to an instance of an object"
Content: Symptom-You have installed Cloud Print Manager (CPM), however you are not able to configure the print queues, you face the following error:-"Connection test failed: Object reference not set to an instance of an object."-Or, after configuring the print queues you are seeing a yellow icon next to system URL.-Or, in the error logs there are messages similar to:-*** ERROR *** [6] Object reference not set to an instance of an object. GetAllPrintQueues in DocumentsAvailable (2) ***** [ DocumentsAvailable in RetrievalManager.cs at line 894 ] *****-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Cause-The yellow icon indicates a network issue. The Cloud Print Manager is not able to communicate to the system, however the root cause could be more than one.-Resolution- There are some steps to be performed to correct this problem:-1) Proxy Settings - If you are using proxy you can configure it directly inside the CPM.-Click on Settings.-Select Proxy.-Choose the correct option and fill the proxy configuration.-2) Security Protocol - Select a different Transport Layer Security:-Click on Settings.-Select Security Protocol.-Choose a different Protocol in the list. The supported option is TLS 1.2 only, TLS 1.0 and 1.1 is not supported anymore.-Ensure to perform this step before proceeding: *For certain systems you must change this value two or three times (from 1.2 to 1.1 and 1.1 to 1.2) to ensure that the correct value is recorded in the registry.-3) PRT user - Change the password or create a new one.-In ByD system, go to Application and User Management -> Print Queues.-Edit your Print Queue and go to details tab.-In the PRT user field, try setting a new password. Now, try configuring the print queue in the CPM with the new password.-If changing the password does not solve the problem, you can try creating a new PRT user. After creating the new PRT user, use it to configure the print queue in CPM. -After changing one of theses options the CPM service will be restarted. If this not happen, you must restart the services manually.-4) Connect the computer into a different network.-5) Install CPM in a different computer.-See Also-When setting or changing the password you need to follow this policy for Print User:-1) Password must be more than 8 characters.-2) The password must contain at least 2 letters(alphabets).-3) The password must contain at least 1 uppercase characters (A-Z)-4) The password must contain at least 1 digits (0-9).-See also: KBA 2046947 - How to Remove User Lock or Change the Password for Technical Print User-Keywords-Cloud Print Manager; Print Queues; Connection test failed: Object reference not set to an instance of an object

Title: The Last Updated Date and Time is not the Correct One When Using Export to Excel Functionality
Content: Symptom-Using the Export to Excel functionality the Date and Time in the report does not match the local Time.--Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-1. From the Application & User Management work center choose the User and Access Management view.-2. Go to the Business Users sub view.-3. Highlight a User and choose Export to Excel.-4. The Last Updated On field shows a Date and time which doesn't correspond to the actual one.--Cause-The last update Date and Time, on the spreadsheet, is filled with the timezone set by the logged in User.--Resolution-In order to have the correct Date and Time shown you must make sure that the User Regional Settings are set as follow:--1. Go to the Home work center.-2. From the menu, select Personalize then My Settings.-3. Choose the Regional Settings tab.-4. Change the Time Zone based on your requirement.-5. Re-login.-6. If you try to export the User to Excel you should get the local Date and Time.----Keywords-Last updated on; business user; local settings; export to excel; my settings; user regional settings

Title: How to Show Repeated Text on Each Individual Line for a Report
Content: Symptom-You want to show the repeated text on each individual line for a report.-This example will be based on the standard report Opportunity Volume. However, the same settings can be applied to any Browser or MS Excel Based reports.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the Design Reports view.-Open the Opportunity Volume report (CRMOPPU_Q0002) and choose the desired variable selection.-Add the Calendar Year/Month, Employee responsible, Sales partner and Country characteristics to the rows.-You noticed that the Calendar Year/Month value, for example Sep 2011, is shown only once for the whole group of Employee responsible.-You would like to have the Calendar Year/Month value displayed (repeated) for each row for each Employee responsible.-Resolution-In order to show the repeated text on each individual line for a report you need to adjust the Table Setting as follow:-1. For Browser Based reports.-When you open the Browser Based report with the display format to table and go to the View you will see the Chart/Table Settings. When you go to the Table tab you can change the layout of the table.-In this case you need to tick the checkbox next to the Display Repeated Texts. This indicator allow you to specify whether repeated texts are to be displayed more than once.-Note: By default, the setting is deactivate.--2. For MS Excel Based reports.-When you open the MS Excel Based report with the display format to table and click on the SAP tab, from the menu, the icon with the Settings appears. Using the Settings options you can change the layout of the table.-In this case you need to Un-tick the Suppress Repeated Values option (the tick 'V' next to the text should disappear).-This indicator allow you to specify whether repeated texts are to be displayed more than once.-Note: By default, the setting is activated.-Keywords-repeated text; browser reports; excel repors

Title: How to Delete or Cancel an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to delete the Outbound Deliver Invoice Request from the Invoice Requests view under the Customer Invoicing work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Invoice Request view.-Find the Outbound Deliver Invoice Request ID XYZ which has to be deleted.*XYZ refers to Outbound Delivery Request ID-You will find no option to Delete/Cancel the Invoice Request.-Cause-The outbound delivery invoice request XYZ is created from the outbound delivery request ABC and hence until unless you cancel the outbound delivery XYZ, the outbound delivery request ABC will not get canceled.*ABC refers to Outbound Delivery ID-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to cancel the outbound delivery ABC and subsequently invoice request.--First you need to undo release the outbound delivery.-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search the relevant outbound delivery, which you want to cancel.-Select the searched outbound delivery and from the Action button drop down, choose Undo Release.-Now you have to perform the adjustment confirmation-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Now select the Monitoring view and sub-view By Warehouse Order.-Select All Warehouse Orders from Show drop down and select Advanced link.-Enter the outbound delivery ID in the Delivery ID field and select Go button.-In the warehouse order screen, select Adjustment Confirmation button.-In the adjustment confirmation for warehouse order screen, select the line item and choose Enable Entry button.-In Quantity Difference column, enter negative value of the fulfilled quantity. For example, if fulfilled quantity is 20, then enter -20 in the Quantity Difference column.-Choose Save button.-You will be able to cancel the outbound delivery-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Choose the Outbound Delivery view.-Search the relevant outbound delivery.-Select the searched outbound delivery and from the Action button drop down, choose Cancel.-Now the status of the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request XYZ changes from To Be Invoiced to Processed.-Please note that line item status of this outbound delivery invoice request line item status will be canceled.-Keywords-How to Delete or Cancel an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request, find no option to Delete/Cancel the Invoice Request-cancel outbound delivery,revoke outbound delivery invoice request,reverse outbound delivery invoice reques,cancel outbound delivery invoice request,delete outbound delivery invoice request

Title: Process Error Communication on Sales Order: CM_APTC_TC_O_ITEM must be a subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be Able to Create
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Once you are in the Document Flow tab of a Sales Order and you identify a Process Communication as Sales Order ABC (ABC stands for the Sales Order ID) cannot create a Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-The sales order ABC has error symbol.-Open the error message from the sales order ABC: Sales Order cannot create a Sales Order.-Cause-Login to the backend system.-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Search for the BO Sales_Order.-Select Load by Query and then select ROOT – QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the ID/content field Enter the Sales Order ID ABC.-Execute.-Right click on the Sales Order ID ABC and then Select the monitoring message option.-Select the Action button and Restart the message.-The message does not restart.-Message Error: CM_APTC_TC_O_ITEM must be a subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be Able to Create.-PAF Error: Tax Exemption Certificate Not Valid.-The tax exemption certificate XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Tax Exemption) is being validated for date e.g. 18.10.2019 when we get the error.-The tax date on the taxation terms of SO header is still the same of account master data e.g. 18.10.2019 because the pricing date on "Pricing and Invoicing" tab of Sales Order is still the same of account master data e.g. 18.10.2019.-Resolution-There are two options to fix this scenario.-Change the pricing date of the SO ABC also to a date which is valid for exemption certificate XYZ and save the SO. -Remove the exemption certificate indicator from the general tab of the SO and save it.-After these steps-Login to the backend system.-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Search for the BO Sales_Order.-Select Load by Query and then select ROOT – QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the ID/content field Enter the Sales Order ID ABC.-Execute.-Right Click on the Sales Order ID ABC and then Select the monitoring message option.-Select the Action button and Restart the message.-See Also-2365768 - VAT Exemption Certificate is Not Applied to Service Items (France Only)-2557594 - Customer Tax Exemption Certificates (with US specifics)-2464221 - Tax Exemption Certificates Missing in the Account Master Data-Keywords-Tax; Exemption, Tax Exemption, Sales Order, Process Error Communication, PEC

Title: The Excel Add-In is not Visible After Installation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**RELEASED INTERNALLY ONLY**-You have successfully completed the Excel Add-In installation however when starting MS Excel the new tab sheet SAP Business ByDesign is not shown and the Excel Add-in is not ready to use.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Download the Add-In for Microsoft Excel from the Install Additional Software page.-Install the Add-In for Excel.-The installation is completed successfully and the SAP Business ByDesign Add-In for Microsoft Excel is now shown in the list of installed programs from the Control Panel.-When starting Microsoft Excel the new tab sheet SAP Business ByDesign is not shown from the menu and the Add-in is not ready to use.-Cause-The Add-In could be disabled in Microsoft Excel.-Resolution-If the Add-In got disabled in Excel you will need to enable it as following:-1. Go the Excel Options menu.-2. In the Add-ins section of the Excel Options dialog the add-in should normally show up under the COM Add-in section.-  Note: The Add-In could be disabled in one of the following ways:-The Add-In may still be contained in the COM Add-ins section but with the active flag unchecked.-Excel may have automatically disabled it (e.g. in response to frequent crashes) by moving it to the Disabled items section.-In case A you need to reactivate the Add-in in the following way:-  Choose COM Add-ins in drop-down box Manage: and click on Go.-   Activate the check box for SAP Business ByDesign Excel Add-in and confirm with OK.- In case B the correction is quite similar to A. You just need to search for Disabled Items from the drop-down box Manage.-  Keywords-MS Excel Addin, Excel Add-In, disabled Add-In, add-in is not visible

Title: Excel Does Not Open From Reports View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**RELEASED INTERNALLY ONLY**-When you try to view a report with MS Excel nothing happens.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center and choose the Reports List.-Highlight any report.-Choose a report view with Microsoft Excel.-Nothing happens and the report view is not being opened. -Cause-The internet browser file download settings need to be enabled for downloading.-Resolution-In order to allow Excel to open the view the following steps should be done:-From the internet browser options choose the security tab.-Click on the custom level button.-From the settings make sure that the downloads options, automatic prompting for file downloads and file download, are enabled.-Note: Normally these settings are covered by System Check and do not need to be done manually.-Keywords-MS Excel, report view, home work center, reports list, excel does not open, excel does not open report view

Title: Condition/ Value Filter not saved in report
Content: Symptom-You have created a condition (C4C) / value filter (ByD) in a report and saved it to a view. When you activate it, the condition/ value filter is not applied and you can see that the activation was not saved.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Create a condition / value filter and save it.-Save the view with the condition / value filter.-Now activate it and click OK.-The key figure value does not change. When you open the list of conditions / value filters again, you see that the Active checkbox is not ticked although you have activated it.-Cause-The characteristic that you have used for the condition / value filter is not part of the report view.-Resolution-The characteristic that you have used for the condition / value filter needs to be part of the report view. Please add it to the view, activate the condition / value filter and save this to the view.-Keywords-report, business analytics, reporting, condition, value filter, exception, conditional formatting, missing, not applied, not saved, not activated

Title: Custom Financial Report returns Errors - Fiscal Year Variant Missing
Content: Symptom-Some errors are returned when opening a custom created report based on the standard data source Material Inventory- Reconciliation (technical ID FININVU08).--Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-From the Business Analytics work center choose the view Design Reports.-Create a new report from scratch, based on the standard data source Material Inventories - Reconciliation (FININVU08), choosing New then Report.-Do not change anything and click on Next then Finish.-When you open the newly created report the following errors are shown:-INTERNAL_MDAV_FISCVARNT_MISSING-An exception with the type CM_MDRS_MDAV_FAILED occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-Error reading the data of InfoProvider @MFININVU08-Error reading the data of InfoProvider @MFININVU08-Error while reading data; navigation is possible-Cause-To enable full and consistent data in financial reports the following characteristics are always required:-Company-Set of Books-Accounting Period/Year-Chart of Accounts-Fiscal Year Variant-Resolution-In a financial report the Fiscal Year Variant has to be part of the report. The reason for this is that the Accounting Period relies on this characteristic.-In this case you need to add the Fiscal Year Variant (FISCVARNT), via the report wizard, either do the fixed or variable selection criteria.-Note: The required characteristics will already be included when you make a copy of an existing report. Therefore it is recommended to use the Report copy functionality.-See Also-You find additional information on custom finance reports on our SAP Help Center in the article Custom Financial Reports.-Keywords-fin report; fin reports; financial reports; custom reports; financial custom reports; fiscal year variant missing;

Title: How to check report relative selections in the backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Use Only ***-This KBA describes how you can find a relative selection in the backend and check which component is responsible for it.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Log on to the backend and go to the transaction MDRS.-From the first dropdown, select the type Transformation Definition.-Click the second dropdown and enter the Transformation Type 3 and click Start Search:-You will now see a list of all available relative selections. You can use the magnifying glass icon to search for the one you need. Double-click it.-The table in MDRS is now populated. Double-click the Object Name on the left hand-side. You will now see a package on the right.-Double-click the package and you will see the component who created this relative selection.-For any issues regarding this relative selection (e.g. wrong results when used in a report), you can use this component (for the development team) or check with the respective support team.-Keywords-relative selection, select, backend, mdrs, transformation definition, wrong report result, business analytics, reporting, selections

Title: How to delete a File from the Output History
Content: Symptom-You consider to delete an output file from the Output History.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to (for example) the Customer Invoice Work Center (this aplies to all output Histories).-Select Invoice documents and edit a released Customer Invoice.-Go to the Output History and try to delete this file.-Resolution-Deleting of Output Files from the Output History is not allowed.-Keywords-Output History, Delete Document.

Title: Unable to View All Sales Orders in a Report Which is Based on the Standard Data Source Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-You have defined your own report on the Sales Order Item data source to show all Sales Orders. But the report does not show all Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Select the New->Report button.-Use the Report Wizard to define your own report based on the standard data source Sales Order Item (technical ID CRMSLOIB).-Execute the report to view all Sales Orders.-You are not able to see all Sales orders which are visible in the Sales Orders view of Sales Orders work center.-Cause-The standard data source Sales Order Item (ID CRMSLOIB) includes only released and consistent Sales Orders. Implies data source does not include documents which have the status Not Released. The reason is as follows:-The documents in status Not Released have the semantical meaning of draft or preliminary versions. Therefore, these are not intended to appear in the report which show aggregated information on Sales Orders. The same applies for documents in status "inconsistent". Since these could contain misleading or even wrong data. In order to avoid these effects, a central filter was implemented which only passes Released and Consistent documents. This central filter applies for the entire data source Sales Order Items (CRMSLOIB). Therefore, all reports which are built on the data source CRMSLOIB show only released and consistent Sales Orders.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords-CRMSLOIB, sales orders, sales order, custom report, sales order item, released and consistent

Title: G/L Account Balances Migration Showing Error Message - Cost/exp acct. permitted with assigmt to cost center ABC
Content: Symptom-You are executing the G/L Account Balances Migration and the system shows the error message Cost/exp acct. permitted with assigmt to cost center ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Cost Center).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project and click on Open Activity List button.-Go to the tab All and search for the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data and choose Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Click on the Create Unit button.-Enter a Title and Company and click on the Create button.-Select the new unit created and click on the Execute migration button.-Click on the Upload File button for G/L Account Balances and select the template to be used.-Then choose the Process File button.-The system shows the error Cost/exp acct. permitted with assigmt to cost center ABC.-Cause-You have maintained a Cost Center in the Template and this is not expected for balance sheet accounts.-Resolution-In order to resolve this error you have to check the data in the excel template and maintain Cost Center only for cost or expense accounts.

Title: Cloud Data Source Primary Keys
Content: Symptom-You want to have more than one primary key set in a ﻿Cloud Data Source﻿.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Cloud Data Source﻿ and set the required fields as ﻿Primary Keys﻿.-Cause-The system supports whatever amount of fields set as Primary Keys, as long as the total field length of all primary keys in total is not higher than 240.-Resolution-Set the length of primary key fields in a way that the total length is not higher than 240 characters.-Keywords-cloud data source; primary key; 240 characters

Title: How to Add Fields (Characteristic or Key Figure) to a Report
Content: Symptom-While working with report XYZ you want to know if additional fields, available from the respective data source, can be displayed in the desired report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In ByD:-Open the respective report.-In the top right corner click Configure > Add Fields.-Choose between the Characteristic and Key Figure tab depending on what type of field you'd like to add.-For characteristics, you can decide if you'd like to add it to the report only, or if you would like to add it to the selection as well.-Make the required changes and click OK.-In C4C:-Open the respective report and run it.-Go to the view.-Click Add Fields.-Choose between the Characteristic and Key Figure tab depending on what type of field you'd like to add.-For characteristics, you can decide if you'd like to add it to the report only, or if you would like to add it to the selection as well.-Make the required changes and click OK.-Note:-If you are working with a custom report, it is strongly recommended that you (or your administrator) add fields through the report wizard. This will ensure the best possible performance, since adding fields via Add Fields uses more system resources. -Changes made by standard Users will be visible only to their own User.-Changes made by the Administrators via the Business analytics work center will be visible to all Users.-Changes made by the Administrators cannot be overridden by a Business User.-Keywords-report, add fields, more fields, additional fields, missing fields, business analytics-add field report,characteristic missing,key figure missing

Title: Custom report built on financial data source is inconsistent
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report based on a financial data source and when you run it you notice that the behavior is not as expected.-For example no or inconsistent data is shown although when you check the SAP standard report, e.g. Financial Statements, both the behavior and data are correct.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, the custom report was created as New and the Fiscal Year Variant characteristic was not selected during the report wizard as following:-Business Analytics work center then Design view.-Select New then report.-Enter the desired Report name and select the desired Data Source. In this case, Financial Statements data source. -Select the desired Key Figures and Characteristics (Step 2 and 3). In this case Fiscal Year Variant was not selected.-For the characteristics selected, maintain properties (step 4). In this case Fiscal Year Variant was not visible.-For the characteristics selected as variables, maintain properties. In this case Accounting Period/Year was selected as variable.-Select Finish.-When running the report no data was shown and the following message displayed: No report data available to display.-Cause-There are missing settings in the customized report.-Resolution-In financial accounting, due to the interdependencies between the underlying data source and the key figure structures, it is strongly recommended that you create new reports only by copying existing reports.-To enable full and consistent data in financial accounting reports, the following characteristics are always required as fixed or variable selection criteria:-Company-Set of Books-Accounting Period/Year-Chart of Accounts-Fiscal Year Variant-NOTE: When you copy a financial accounting report, these characteristics run automatically in the background and therefore you do not need to select them in the Select Characteristics step. You only need to select characteristics in the Select Characteristics step if you want to be able to display them in the report.-Otherwise please make sure that you select these characteristics and either set them up as variables or set fixed value selections on them.-Keywords-financial reports, custom financial report, wrong data, reporting, missing entries, business analytics, new report

Title: 'Release not possible; invoice schedule missing for one or more items' Error Message Appears When Opening a Contract
Content: Symptom- Contract is inconsistent due to an error: 'Release not possible; invoice schedule missing for one or more items'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the Contract ID).-Click on Edit button.-It's possible to see the document as Inconsistent due to the error: 'Release not possible; invoice schedule missing for one or more items'.-Cause-Error occurred because Price Per Period (PPP) indicator is checked for Line Items XX (XX represents the Line Item ID), and when PPP indicator is checked, it's mandatory to maintain the invoice schedule.-If the Line Item is with Completed status, it means that the user did not release the Line Item, but cancelled them while they were In Preparation status. In this case, the release at header would always fail as it will check all items for which PPP indicator is checked, hence invoice schedule should be maintained.-Resolution-If the Line Item is not Completed, it's necessary to un-check the PPP indicatior in Items tab, or add the invoice schedule for the mentioned line item in Pricing and Invoicing tab.-If the Line Item is Completed, it is necessary to open an incident for further analysis.-Keywords-Invoice Schedule, Contract, Price Per Period

Title: How to Customize an Output Form while Printing?
Content: Symptom-You have created a customized form template which is being used for specific document (e.g.purchase order) output form.-But while printing the output form, you want to further edit/customize few specific output forms.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Form Template Maintenance work center-Select the standard form-Download it-Customize the form-Create a Purchase Order document and order it-Output form is generated with the customized form template-Now the output form is ready for printing-Here you want to edit the output form again when it is ready for printing-Cause-This option is not available for ByDesign system at the moment.-Resolution-You can do the customization on specific form template before using it for business transactions. Once done, the customized output form is generated in output history tab and you can take print out of the same.-Kindly post this requirement in Customer Influence Site: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-This is our official channel to address all new requirements.-Keywords-Purchase Order output form, customize form template for printing

Title: How to Create Key Figures That Show Positive Values Only
Content: Symptom-A report key figure shows +/- signs but you need only positive results and therefore need to eliminate the - sign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open any report.-Execute it.-Check the key figure values.-The key figure shows both positive and negative results.-Cause-The behavior of some key figures is to show both positive and negative results depending on their context. Most financial key figures are credit and debits and therefore need to have a sign.-Resolution-You can eliminate the negative results by creating a calculated key figure on top of the key figure that presents both positive and negative results. To do so, you can proceed as follows:-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the view Design Key Figures.-Click New.-Input a name for your key figure and select Calculated Key Figure.-In step 2, put in the following formula: ABS(Key Figure). Where Key Figure will stand for the Key Figure that has both positive and negative results. E.g: at Financial Statements, we can do this with Amount Company Currency and therefore the Formula will be ABS("Amount Company Currency").-Add your new key figure to the report.-Once this is done, you will only see positive results in the report.-Keywords-reporting, business analytics, key figure, positive, negative, ABS, remove sign

Title: How To Use the Broadcast Bursting Feature
Content: Symptom-When creating a new Broadcast you notice the tickbox Use Broadcast Bursting. You want to understand how this feature works.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, Broadcast view.-Click the New button.-In the New Broadcast screen you find the tickbox Use Broadcast Bursting in the Recipients section.-Cause-To use the bursting feature, the report view which is broadcasts must include a characteristic which shows the email address.-Please note it is not sufficient to add the employee only to the view, or to add the email address as an attribute to the employee - the email address must be a standalone characteristic in the report view.-Resolution-This feature will allow you to send reports to E-mail recipients that are part of the report result.-Take for example the following use case: You run the Sales Order Volume report and display the Employee Responsible in it. You know that you have maintained valid E-Mail addresses for each Employee Responsible. So you display the characteristic E-Mail (Employee Responsible) in the report.-Follow these steps to send the Sales Order Volume report to each Employee Responsible (filtered by their respective e-mail address):-Save this view and your selection and give it a name, e.g. Sales Orders by Employee Responsible.-NOTE: It is important that the view and the selection produce report results with valid e-mail addresses. Otherwise the Broadcast Bursting feature will not work.-Now go to the Business Analytics work center, Broadcast view.-Click the New button.-In the field Object Name select the report that you want to distribute, in our example Sales Order Volume.-In the Format and Content area select the View and the Selection of the report that you would like to distribute, in our example Sales Orders by Employee Responsible.-Tick the Use Broadcast Bursting box.-Open the value help for Attribute For Email.-Select an attribute which is in a valid e-mail address format, in our example E-Mail (Employee Responsible). Please make sure you select the email address characteristic view here, not the employee characteristic.-Click the Save & Close button.-The broadcast is now ready to use and can be either started immediately (via the Start Now button) or it can be sent in a periodic schedule.-If you get the error message E-mail address is invalid your created report view does not include a characteristic which shows valid e-mail addresses. In this case please go back to your report and use a different characteristic as explained in the steps above. Afterwards please save the report view and try to run the broadcast again.-See Also-2878726 - Unable to use Broadcast Bursting-Keywords-broadcast bursting, feature, broadcast not sent, E-mail address is invalid-broadcast,broadcast bursting

Title: Error Template Code XXXX is Not Valid in the Output History
Content: Symptom-You have released a document, however you noticed the Output Document has the "Error" status. In the detyails of the error you could see the following:-Contact your key user to investigate this error. When the error has been solved your key user should inform you so that you can retry outputing the document.-/DOC/OUTPUT_MANGMT117-An output error occurred:-Template code XXXX is not valid-View the details and follow the steps provided to solve the error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The error 'Template code XXXX is not valid' would occur in the cases where there is no template in the Form Template Maintenance, or the particular form template variant for the corresponding country and language is not maintained in the Form Template Maintenance.-Resolution-You should maintain a form template with the XXXX name in the Form Template Maintenance and valid Country and Language.-Go to Application and User Management.-Go to Form Template Maintenaince.-Search for the template XXXX.-If the template does not exist you should create it or change the template at the specific Output Rules of teh document.-If the template exists you should validate if there is a variant for the Country and Language requested for the document.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Template code is not valid,

Title: During the Upgrade Process there are no Data Source Changes Possible
Content: Symptom-While you try to create, modify or save a data source you get the following warning and then error message:-During the Upgrade Process there are no Data Sources Changes Possible-Save Failed-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and then choose the view Design Data Sources.-Create a New Data source or Edit an existing one.-During the various step you first get the warning message:-During the Upgrade Process there are no Data Sources Changes Possible.-If you continue and try to save the Data source the following Error message is then displayed:-During the Upgrade Process there are no Data Sources Changes Possible-Save Failed-Cause-The reason of the error is that the system is undergoing an upgrade and such action is not allowed.-Resolution-This system behavior is as designed. In fact, it is not allowed to perform such activities during the system upgrade as it may cause system inconsistencies. In order to be able to perform such activities you must wait for the completion of the upgrade.-Keywords-save failed; during the Upgrade Process there are no Data Sources Changes Possible; error message; upgrade process; data source change; data source save

Title: Released Invoices Now Showing as To Be Invoiced Under the Invoice Request View
Content: Symptom-You have released invoices, however, the Schedule Invoice Requests are now showing as To Be Invoiced.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Schedule Invoice Request ABC shows as To Be Invoiced.-Cause-Under the source Sales Order from the Schedule Invoice Request ABC, a change was performed in the quantity of one of the items, changing from 100 to 50 for example, however, when the original invoice was created from the Schedule Invoice Request the quantity amount was of 100.--Document is now in the To Be Invoiced status, as it is expecting the quantity to match the source document.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.--To correct this, please create a new invoice to match the quantity found under the source Sales Order. In this case being of -50.-Keywords-Schedule Invoice Request, To Be Invoiced, Wrong, Quantity

Title: Percentage Value is Displayed as * in the Report
Content: Symptom-You create a Key Figure to display the Percentage however it only displays the character * in the Report.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Key Figures.-Click on New.-Enter a key figure name and select the type Calculated Key Figure. Click on Next.-Maintain a formula here that uses percentages, as well as other operands.-Finish your key figure.-Open a report based on the same data source as your key figure.-Via Add Fields > tab Key Figures, add your key figure.-Then go to Settings > Key Figures and add your key figure to the report view.-The key figure shows * in all entries.-Cause-In this specific percentage case, the reason behind the value * is because the system is trying to calculate two different units at the same time and as they are different units, the system cannot convert them and thus the value * is shown.-For example: you are calculating the percentage of hours and you have the following formula: "Actual Hours (h)" %A 100. In this case, the system will accept this formula as its syntax is correct. However, the result will be * as you are dealing with HOURS -> "Actual Hours (h)" and a NUMERICAL -> 100.-Resolution-In order to correct this behavior, you need to use the operator NODIM.-NODIM stands for No Unit or Currency, which returns numeric values of the operand and suppresses units and currencies.-If we take, for example, the previous formula: "Actual Hours (h) %A 100" and use NODIM, we would suppress the hours unit, the calculation would flow normally and thus the result would be displayed correctly into the report.-The final formula would be:-NODIM("Actual Hours (h)") %A 100.-See Also-2502994 - Report Shows Asterisk (*)-Keywords-reporting, key figure, business analytics, wrong result, *, asterisk, star, percent, formula

Title: How to find the BO and NODE of a Screen Attribute (OWL Specific Case)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Use Only ***-You want to find the Business Object or Business Object Node behind a screen attribute.-* Please note that this method is only applied to OWL screen elements.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Although there is no specific application scenario for this case, we should consider that the actions from this CD can be executed when data is missing from an OWL. Therefore, the usage is to find the exact BO node that you need to check TREX/LCP layers for persistency cross-check.-Example:-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to Sales Order view.-Search for all Sales Orders.-You notice that an entire column is missing data.-Resolution-The solution for this procedure is to do the following: (i.e: Sales Order OWL is missing data for the Sales Order ID column) o to the affected OWL screen.-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to Sales Order view.-Apply either KBA: 1650568 or KBA: 1727676 in order to find the FSI View(s)* / join index that is fetching data at the screen. (i.e: .c003:1fs:jdx_slo_overview_elements).-Once you have found it open a back-end connection to this specific system.-Access T:code SFSG_SHOWIDX.-Insert your join index and click on Show.-Please check ATTR_NAME or OBJECT_NAME columns which are the CLOSEST we have to find the UI attribute. You should be seeing an screen like this:-The last and final step is to match the ATTR_NAME or OBJECT_NAME to your UI attribute (please note that for most cases both UI and ATTR_NAME may look the same, however the minority result is still significant and you might struggle to find it).-In case you have found it, please take a look at the PHYSICAL index as the BO/BO_NODE is contained inside of it.-For example:-We are trying to find the BO/BO_NODE responsible for the Sales Order ID attribute, which should be this one:- -Physical index: .c003:1fs:idx_sales_order_root_n9803140.-As a result, the Sales Order ID comes from BO: SALES_ORDER NODE: ROOT-* Please note that each OWL has its own behavior. This means that there are OWL's that use 2 or more FSI Views in their query because that is how application has modeled such element.-See Also-2780154 - How to find which Enhanced Controller Object (ECO) a UI field is bound to in a UI compoent for a ByDesign System-Keywords-backend, back end, BO, node, UI field

Title: KPI Negative Values are Displayed as Zero
Content: Symptom-You created a KPI and noticed that when the value of a key figure is below zero, the system will display 0.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Log into your SAP Cloud for Customer system for example.-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the view Design KPI.-Search for the KPI ABC (ABC stands for your KPI name).-In the result rows, select the KPI ABC and click on Preview.-Notice that the result on the left top shows the value 0 when this KPI actually has negative values.-Cause-The KPI scaling is applied on actual value by 100. The result being a single digit with minus sign, when system tries to apply scaling and round off the value becomes 0.-Resolution-When creating the KPI ABC, please change the scaling to 1 from 100. Thus the KPI will show the actual value as expected. This behaviour also applies for SAP Business by Design.-See Also-Further details on scaling is availabie in the Knowledge Base Article 2627252 - Custom KPIs are displayed with the incorrect scaling.-Keywords-Key Performance Indicator, negative, zero, 0, home, analytics, negative KPI, KPI, value is 0, scaling

Title: Internal Comment is Grayed Out for Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You want to edit the Internal Comment from an Invoice Request, but the box is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Click Edit.-Scroll down to the comments section.-Internal Comment box is grayed out.-Cause-Once the status of the document changes to Canceled or Processed, the field becomes disable for editing.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-2835661 - Internal Comment Not Visible In Project Invoice Request-Keywords-Invoice Request, Internal, Comment, Grayed, Out

Title: Sorting of Characteristics and Key Figures in Reports
Content: Symptom-Sometimes when you change the sorting order of a characteristic in reports, the sign changes but the sorting does not work.-You would like to know how the sorting of fields work in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the respective report, for example Sales Order Volume.-Add the following characteristics Sales Organization, Product Category and Sales Order ID and the key figure Net Value to the Report. (In the same order)-Change the sorting order of the field Product Category. The Sign changes when you change the sorting but the values are not sorted in the report.-This is just one example, this document also applies to other reports and other combinations of fields.-Cause-The sorting order of the characteristics in the report is always from left to right. The report will be sorted based on the first characteristic that is added to the report. In our example the report is sorted based on Sales Organization(1st Column).-Please note that when you change the sorting order of the other characteristics in the report, the sign changes because a secondary level of sorting will take place for that column. For example if the first column Sales Organization "A" has 10 Product Categories, then those ten values will be sorted in the second column. Similarly if each Product category has 10 Sales Order IDs, then those ten values will be sorted in the order that you choose in the third column, and so on.-The above scenario is applicable only when there are multiples entries in the second column against each value in the first column of the report. The same will continue for the remaining columns.-Resolution-If you want to sort by the Product Category, you have to move the Product Category column to the very left. The report layout will be as follows: 1st column Product category - 2nd column Sales Organization - 3rd column  Sales Order ID.-In the Characteristic Settings, under the Sorting tab you have the option to choose from to Sort by the ID or Description. You can also choose Ascending or Descending Order.-The primary sorting sequence is set by the drill-down displayed in the report. The drill-down sets the order of the characteristics displayed in the report.-Key Figure Sorting Overrules any Settings for Characteristic Sorting.-If a characteristic has attributes, you can also sort the characteristic by attribute. The attribute specified does not have to be selected for display. Only if you set an attribute for the characteristic in the settings the sorting will be applied based on that.-Keywords-characteristics, key figures, sorting, sort by ID, sort by description, reports, sorting order-sort fields,analytics,reports,sorting,key figures,sorting does not work,characteristics

Title: Missing Custom Memo Line in Bank Transfer
