Content: Symptom-You have created custom payment correspondence profiles and assigned to your payment medium formats, however when creating a new payment order the memo line remains in blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Open the activity list-Open activity Outgoing Bank Transfers-Click Edit payment medium formats-You have created a customer payment correspondence profile in e.g. 11 - My Profile 2.-When creating a payment order with the payment medium format assigned to this profile, no memo line is created.-Cause-In your payment correspondence profile you defined a prefix text as well as the source of the variable date, which composes the memo line text. However for reasons of memo line restriction the system split the text in accordance with the length capacity set for each memo line row. Since the correspondence profile you created does not cover the resulting memo line, it remains in blank in the payment order.-The line length and the number of allowed rows depends on the payment medium format.-Resolution-You need to adjust you payment correspondence profile accordingly.-You may check the payment medium format limits, with regards meno line, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Open the activity list-Open activity Outgoing Bank Transfers-Click Edit assignment of payment correspondence profiles to payment medium formats.-Find the relevant payment medium format and refer to the Line Length and Maximum Number of Lines columns-Keywords-Payment Correspondence profiel, memo line, bank transfer.

Title: Error Message 'An Internal Error Occurred' When Executing the Broadcast
Content: Symptom-You are facing the error message 'An Internal Error Occurred' when you are trying to run a broadcast, even if it has been scheduled to run automatically or manually. And the e-maills are not being sent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center and Broadcast view.-Select the broadcast XYZ.-Click on Start Now.-See that the broadcast has not been delivered.-Check the broadcast log and see the error message 'An Internal Error Occurred'.-Cause-This is happening due to the large amount of data present in your Broadcast Object (data source, report, etc). If the report is working in the UI, hence you are trying to send it to several e-mail addresses, which is causing the error message.-Resolution-The broadcast has the .ZIP option, which is an archive file format that supports lossless data compression. If you select this option, your broadcast will be delivered even if it has a lot of data either if it is being sent to a large e-mail distribution list.-In order to enable this option, please follow the steps below:-Select the Broadcast XYZ.-Click on Edit button.-Go to Format and Content tab.-Check the checkbox for ZIP format.- Keywords-braodcast, internal error, e-mail, email, zip

Title: Filtering is not Supported for Attributes of the Characteristics in Reports
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Set Filter on the Attribute column added to the report.-You are trying to find the Attribute in the selection screen or under the available fields when you click on Filter.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics -> Design Reports.-Open any Report. For Example let us consider the standard report Account Contact Data.-Execute the Report. Go to View Section.-In the Row Fields section, Click on (+) Add Fields to Row.-Add a characteristic and its Attribute to the report. For Example : Account characteristic and its attribute Industry.-Now Go to the attribute, Industry column in the report. Click on the column header.-Choose Set Filter. You will get only the value list of the characteristic Account and not the attribute industry.-Cause-The current system design will not allow you to filter on Attributes. You can filter only on the characteristics added to the report.-Resolution-You can add the attribute as a characteristic to the report. Follow the steps given below.- Execute the Report.- In the top left corner, Click on Configure -> Add Fields.- In the pop up window search for the attribute . (Example : Industry).- Check the checkboxes for Display in Report and Display in Selection.- Click on OK.- Now in the Row Fields, you will find the attribute added as characteristic. (It will be available as Industry (Account)).- You can now set filter on this column where the attribute is added as characteristic. Also this field will be availble under Filter in the selection screen. It allow you to filter the values.-Keywords-Filter, Attribute, Selection, Value help, Set Filter, Filter, characteristic , Add Fields , Add Fields to rows, Column filter, Inaccurate, Wrong Values

Title: Custom Outbound SEPA Payment Files
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a custom payment file structure that mimics a SEPA Credit Transfer file, however your custom structure does not work as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Outbound Files view.-Select a corresponding outbound file that was meant to use you custom SEPA struture.-Click Display Log.-You see an error as follows: 'File format <your custom file structure> is not consistent'-Cause-Currently it is not possible to customize SEPA payment files within SAP Business ByDesign. Hence creating a custom file structure for SEPA does not work. There are set of fields which are very specific in SEPA files and currently these values are determined in ByDesing.-The requested execution date, for exmaple, gets recalculated during the file creation if the file is SEPA CT/DD also the pain version information, service code level, mandate type code, sequence type code and other fields are getting filled based on certain localization-specific conditions of the file format. Additionally, SEPA payment files correspond to an xml file and custom payment file structures are not open for xml files.-Resolution-Currently, this is the designed system behavior. We plan to have this functionality available in a higher release. Nevertheless, at this point in time, we are not in a position to provide more accurate information on date and/or timelines for this future release.-For evaluating the feasibility of a custom-development you might consider dicrectly contacting the SAP Cloud Service Center. You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-a) If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-b) If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-Keywords-SEPA. Outbound File, Payment File Structure.

Title: Country With Wrong Translation in Pro Forma Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a Pro Forma Invoice which should be showing the country name under the Address in the Ship-To language, however, the system is showing the address in the language of the Ship-From or the System Based country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, the system is based in Germany and the country to which the document is being sent is India.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Click on the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click on the Pro Forma Invoice button.-If the preview does not show automatically, click on the Print Pro Forma Invoice button.-Under the Address, the word India shows as INDIEN.-*Indien is the German translation for India.-Cause-All address parts are formatted in the language of the receiving country (Ship-To) and only the country name is printed in the language of the "sending" country (Ship-From).-In this case, the document is being sent from Germany to India, therefore the "receiving" country information in the postal address is printed in German, so that the German post will understand where to send the mail to.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-This is the standard way the Universal Postal Union (UPU) recommends printing the name of the country.-Keywords-Pro Forma Invoice, Address, Country, Translation,  Language, Template, Preview

Title: No Relevant Payments Found For Payment Media Run
Content: Symptom-No relevant payments are found during Payment Media Run execution, even though there are supplier invoices to be paid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Media Run sub view.-Find Payment Media Run ID XXX (XXX represents the Payment Media Run ID).-Navigate to the Application Log and find Application Log ID YYY (YYY represents the Application Log ID).-Navigate to Summarizing Messages in General tab.-Notice the message: No relevant payments found.-Cause-To create a Payment Media Run it is mandatory to process and finish a Payment Run in the Payables or Receivables work center first or create the respective invoice payment manually. This can be done automatically or manually.-Only then the respective payments in status Ready for Transfer and Payment Media or the files for data media exchange can be created via a Payment Media Run.-The Payment Media Run only considers payments with status Ready for Transfer which were created through the payables payment run, the receivables payment run and payments created manually from the Supplier/Customer Account Monitor or bank statement items.-The Payment Media Run then creates outgoing payment files which are to be sent to the respective bank for processing.-Resolution-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks sub view and select Payment Run.-Click the New button, create and execute a new Payment Run.-When the Payment Run is successfully created go to Payment Management work center.-Navigate to Payment Media Runs sub view.-Click the New button and create and execute a new Payment Run.-See Also-For further information, check SAP Help Portal document: Create a Payment Media Run-Keywords-payment media, payment media run, payment file.

Title: Copy button is Grayed out for Payment Term IDs 1026 and 1027
Content: Symptom-Copy button is grayed out for payment term IDs 1026 and 1027 in the fine tuning activity Accounts -> Maintain Payment Terms-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementations Projects view-Select the First Implementation and select Open Activity List button-Go to Fine Tune tab-Search and open the Activity Accounts-Select the link Maintain Payment Terms-Highlight 1026-Cause-This is the standard behavior. The Copy functionality is disabled, because the payment terms were created out of a specific enhancement of the standard code (Business Add-In (BADI)) provided by SAP for country France specifically. This enhancement supports both fixed date calculation as well as variable dates with percentage of discount (Based on the number of days after Invoice/Receipt Date).-Resolution-This cannot be achieved and copying this would lead to inconsistencies as it does not support the above functionality.-SAP ensures that the standard is been delivered to all customers which is compliant for all countries. For country specific (e.g. for France in this case ) the SAP Globalization team provides the implementation with respect to that country.-Also providing this feature ( including copy functionality ) via Standard code would require changing the implementation logic which would affect other customers as well.-Hence the standard provide certain code exits where the SAP Globalization team would provide the code via backend.-Please note: As precondition the country (France) must be scoped.-Please note: If  custom codes are required for a country, this can be handled via Partner Development.-See Also-2945293 - Payment Terms IDs 1026 and 1027 Are Not Available-Keywords-French, Business Configuration, not possible, not available, unable

Title: SAC error for ByD / C4C reports: is restricted and cannot be added to the query
Content: Symptom-You are trying to extract report data from C4C/ ByD to SAC. When trying add some fields to your query, they see errors like these:-'ABC' is restricted and cannot be added to the Query. (Where ABC stands for the name of your field)-Environment-SAP Analytics Cloud-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to your SAC system.-Create the connection and create your OData query, based on a C4C or ByD report.-Drag and drop some fields from the left-hand side to the "Selected Data" section.-You will receive the error message: 'ABC' is restricted and cannot be added to the Query.-Cause-You are trying to add a report variable to the 'select' clause of your OData query. Variables cannot be added to the view, they can only be used in the filters.-Note: 'Variable' means a field which is added to the report selection in your ByD/ C4C system.-Resolution-To create your query, you would need to add characteristics instead of variables to "Selected Data". To differentiate them:-On SAC side, the fields in black are variables. They should only be used in the Filter, not under "Selected Data". The fields shown in blue are characteristics or key figures. These are the ones to be used for "Selected Data".-On C4C side, there are 2 options to differentiate the 2 different types:-You can go to the Design Reports work center view, search for the respective report and click Build OData Queries. All the fields listed under "Attributes" can be used for the view, i.e. for "Selected Data" in SAC. -You can also run a metadata query for your report. Here you can check the properties of each field. If the field is a variable, it has the property sap:selection=true. -In summary, variables on a C4C/ByD report can only be used for filters in SAC. Characteristics and Key figures on C4C side can be used for the SAC view ("Selected Data").-Keywords-cannot be added to the query, sac, integration, reporting, business analytics, error message, OData, characteristic, variable, sap:selection=true, selected data, dataset, model

Title: Outbound Delivery Created from Completed Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that a new Outbound Delivery document was created from a completed Sales Order document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Delivery view.-Select the Filter.-Enter the Sales Order ID as reference.-System retrieves Outbound Delivery ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the new Outbound Delivery).-Cause-Via web service, the system does allow the creation of a new Outbound Delivery document from a completed Sales Order document as reference.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Sales Order, Completed, 3PL, Third-Party

Title: The PDI Extension Field is Missing after It's Extended to the standard CustomerInvoiceQAF
Content: Symptom-Your PDI Extension Field is missing after it's extended to the standard CustomerInvoiceQAF-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoice Work Center-Go to Invoices Request View-Open the drop down list and select "To be invoiced Invoice Requests"-Select any request-Click Invoice button-You cannot find your extension field in the standard CustomerInvoiceQAF-Cause-The CustomerInvoiceQAF have two forms. One is the 'SingleInvoiceForm' and other one is the 'MultipleInvoiceList'.-In the UI designer, there is a drop down list to select one of them.-Resolution-After selecting one from the list, the UI changes can be made accordingly.-If 'SingleInvoiceForm' is selected and changes are done, the change would appear in the normal invoice QAF screen.-If 'MultipleInvoiceList' is selected and changes are done, the change would appear in the screen which multiple invoice details are included. For example, in case of invoicing multiple invoice requests together which results to multiple invoices.-If the details needs to be included in both cases of normal QAF and multiple invoice QAF, the changes have to be done twice. -Keywords-extension field; CustomerInvoiceQAF; missing

Title: Unable to Select Multiple Values in Report
Content: Symptom-You are unable to select multiple values for Characteristic under selection in the report.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics-Go to Design Report and search for the effected report-Click on the value help of the Characteristic and while making selection, you notice that only one value is allowed at a time-Cause-Edit the same report in report wizard and go to step 5 - "Define Variables"-You should see that under "Selection Type" , you have "Single Value" as selected for the same characteristic-Resolution-Changes need to be done in the "Selection Type" as to "Multiple Value" from "Single Value"-This will allow to select multiple values in the selection of the characteristics under the report-Keywords-report selection,single value in selection

Title: Bank Payment Advice not Automatically Allocated in Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-You upload a bank statement with a line item referring to a bank credit advice existing in the system.-The resulting payment allocation does not allocate the statement amount to the bank advice. Instead, it allocates the amount to an existing Cash Transfer, which has the same amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Find the related payment allocation In Preparation. This allocation is for a bank statement created via file upload.-The payment advice's external reference is maintained in tag :61: in the bank statement file (in case of MT940) and the Payment Reference field in the bank advice is also equal to the Advice ID. Nevertheless, the bank advice is not being chosen in the payment allocation and a e.g. Cash Transfer is selected instead.-Cause-It is the current system design that self-initiated payments have a higher priority over the Foreign initiated payments.-Here, the Cash Transfer is a self-initiated payment which happens to cover the exact same amount as the payment allocation amount. Hence, the system does not search further for the Payment Advice even though the document ID is a match.-Resolution-For this specific case, adjust the payment allocation by manually matching it with the concerned payment advice instead of the cash transfer.-Once the cash transfer is confirmed and/or there are no other self-initiated payments with the same amount as the payment allocation, then the automatic allocation with the bank advice works  - given that the pre-requisites mentioned in KBA 2373026 are fulfilled for an automatic payment allocation posting with bank advice.-See Also-2373026 - Automatic Allocation of Incoming Payment Advices in Bank Statements (MT940 UK)-Keywords-Incoming Payment Advice. Remittance Advice. Bank Credit Advice. Bank Advice.

Title: Tax Date Not Editable While Creating Customer Project Invoice Requests.
Content: Symptom-Tax Date not editable while creating Customer Project Invoice Requests.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select an Invoice Request with To be Invoiced status.-Click on the Invoice button.-Complete the necessary data.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Tax sub-tab.-Tax Date is not editable.-Cause-For Invoice Requests that are copies from source documents, such as Sales Order Invoice Requests or Contract Invoice Requests, the Tax Date is not editable, the same happens to Customer Project Invoice Requests.-Customer Project Invoice Request is the mirror image of Project Invoice Request on invoice request side, here the Tax Date is read only.-Resolution-In order to change the Tax Date, you can go to the source document of the scenario which in this case is a Project Invoice Request, and change the Tax Date on this document. Once the Project Invoice Request has the correct Tax Date, you can create the Customer Project Invoice Request and it will have the same Tax Date.-Keywords-Customer Project Invoice Request, Project Invoice Request, Tax Date-

Title: Tax Basic Country is not on the List of the Scope Countries
Content: Symptom-You don't know how to scope a so called 'tax basic country' and the country does not have the visibility flag.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view-3. Edit Project Scope-4. Click on Edit Countries-5. The (tax basic) country is not available among the countries to scope-Cause-Tax basic countries are not available for scoping because there are some specific prerequisites, which should be first configured by SAP partner. Examples of tax basic countries are: Ireland, Czec Republic, Luxembourg, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Macao, Barbados etc.-Resolution-Please contact your SAP partner. Once these prerequisites are configured by your partner, the country will be visible in the scoping questions.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign: Localization Roadmap and Outlook 2020-Localization at SAP Business ByDesign: Frequently Asked Questions-Keywords-Tax basic countries, Ireland, Macao, Barbados, Luxembourg, visibility flag

Title: Report Zero Suppression
Content: Symptom-Zero Suppression is not working for Key Figures in Rows or Columns in your reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Go to Design reports.-Search for your Report.-Open the report and run it.-Change to "View".-Open the key figure settings.-Add Suppression of zeros in either rows or columns.-You notice that the zeros are not suppressed and still showing in the report.-Cause-The "Apply Suppression to Rows" only works, when all Key Figures in the Row are zero; in that case the complete line is hidden.- If only the "Key Figure ABC" is zero, and "Key Figure DEF" is greater than zero, the setting will have no effect.-The same can be said for trying to suppress values in columns. If one of the figures is greater than zero then it will have no effect.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-Zero, Zero Suppression, blank, report, key figure, settings

Title: Report Navigation from Result Row not Working
Content: Symptom-You have created a report navigation and set certain characteristics to be transferred. When you click on a key figure value and navigate, everything works correctly and the characteristic values are transferred. However when you navigate from the result row, the characteristic values are not transferred and the target report is not filtered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Open your report which is the source for a navigation, and run it with the respective view and selection.-Click on the key figure value in the result row, then click on the name of your navigation.-The target report opens. You will see that the characteristic values were not transferred and the target report is unfiltered.-Cause- At the moment, the report navigation from report result lines does not transfer characteristic values.-Resolution-Please navigate from a single row to make sure that characteristic values are transferred.-You can also register the navigation from result rows as a feature enhancement here:-Keywords-report navigation, reporting, business analytics, result, summary, transferred, characteristic, filters, missing

Title: Relative Selections Missing for Cloud Data Source Field
Content: Symptom-You are running a report and would like to use a standard relative selection on a field. When you open the value help for that field from the selection area, you can only choose absolute values, however relative selections are missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Open your report.-In the selection area, open the value help of the field in question.-No relative selections are offered here.-Cause-This field comes from a cloud data source. There are no relative selections for such fields.-Resolution-This can be enabled by creating a reference to another data source and field which already has a relative selection. Please follow these steps:-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Find the cloud data source where your field comes from and click Edit.-Find the respective field.-In the column Referencing Data Source, select a data source which contains a field with the same information.-In the column Referencing Data Source Key Field, select the field which contains the same information. Please make sure that this field has relative selections enabled. This can be checked by previewing the data source and opening the value help for that field.-Click Save.-Note that by editing a cloud data source, all existing data is lost and you will need to upload the data again.-Keywords-relative selection, select, missing, not available, data source, cloud, business analytics, reporting

Title: Brackets in Key Figure Creation
Content: Symptom-You are creating a calculated key figure with a number of components, and you need to set brackets in the formula to get the desired result. However, there is no option to set brackets manually; the system sets them automatically and it may not be according to your requirement.-Let us assume the following example requirement - you would like to set up the following formula:-((A - B) / C)+1-(A, B and C stand for key figure names which are used in your formula).-When you enter this formula in the key figure wizard, you get the following result:-A - (B / (C +1))-This will yield a different result.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Key Figures.-Click New.-In step 2, enter a key figure name, a data source, and the type Calculated Key Figure.-Click Next.-Enter your formula here.-You notice the brackets are set incorrectly and you would like to know how to change this.-Cause-You have to enter the major components of the formula first, and then proceed to add smaller and smaller parts of the formula.-This way the brackets will be added as expected.-Resolution-In this example, enter the following first:-A + 1-Then click into the A component and add the division. The brackets will be added as follows:-(A / C) + 1-Now you just need to add the subtraction by clicking into the A component again. The brackets will be added like this:-((A - B) / C) + 1-Keywords-key figure, create, business analytics, brackets, parenthesis, parentheses, klammern, formula, calculation

Title: Invoice Scheduled is Cancelled Even If the Line Item Was Finished With Keep Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You observed that Invoice Scheduled is cancelled, however, the Line Item AA (AA represents the Line Item ID for the Invoice Scheduled) is finished with the option of Keep Invoice Requests.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for XYZ (XYZ represents the Contract ID).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoice Schedule subtab.-It's possible to see the Invoice Scheduled for Line Item AA with status Cancelled. -Cause-This happens due to a manual action of changing the status to Finished by clicking on Finish button, then Invoicing. The action of Finish Invoicing was done even though the Invoice Scheduled was still opened.-The Invoice Cancellation option "Keep Invoice Requests" has no influence on this at all since it is only relevant for cancellation of the line item and not for other further action.-Resolution- Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for XYZ.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Line Item AA.-Click on Revoke button, and select Invoicing.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Select the Invoice Scheduled for Line Item AA.-Click on Add Date.-Enter the Invoice Schedule with the Date DD.MM.AAAA.-You can then either trigger the creation of the Scheduled Invoice Request for the DD.MM.AAAA manually or wait until the batch job ran over night.-After you can invoice Scheduled Invoice Request for the DD.MM.AAAA. Only then, you should select Finish Invoicing for the Line Item AA.-Keywords-Customer Contract, Scheduled Invoice, Cancellation, Line Item, Finished

Title: How to find the Change Logs of Analytical Objects
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You wanted to check the Change Log of Analytical Objects like Reports, Data Sources etc..-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-If you have the ID of the Analyltical Object and you wanted to know who has Created , Updated or Deleted the object in the system.-Cause-N/A-Resolution-Please follow the below steps to get the log details.-Login to the backend system.-Go to the Tcode or Transaction code SE16.-Open the Table MDRS_D_ANA_MO_CHANGE_LOG.-Give the ID of the analytical object (Report ID or Data Source ID) in MO_NAME field in the selection.-Execute the Table.-You will get the User details and the Time when the objects were modified.-Note: The CHANGE_MODE codes indicates the below actions.-C CREATE-D DELETE-U UPDATE-  Keywords-Logs, Reports, Missing, Data Sources, Views, Change Log, Deleted, Created , Updated, restore objects, restore analytical objects, Create an incident to restore previous data

Title: 'Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first' Error Message While Reversing a Bank-to-Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-When you try to reverse a bank-to-bank transfer you get the error message: 'Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Select the Payment Monitor view.-Select the bank-to-bank transfer which you would like to Cancel / Reverse.-Click Edit.-Click Reverse.-Enter Posting Date and Document Description.-Click OK.-Error message is displayed: Cancel not possible; Payment file already generated; Reverse that first.-Cause-When you create a payment file, system will change the status of the bank-to-bank transfer to In Transfer. You can also manually set the status to In Transfer without creating a payment file. The error message when trying to reverse the payment stays the same. When a payment is In Transfer it cannot be canceled. Its status needs to be changed to Ready for Transfer.-Resolution-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Select the Payment Monitor view.-Select the Outgoing Bank Transfer with status In Transfer.-Click Actions for Bank Transaction button (gear icon) and select Set to Not Transferred.-Status of the payment is now changed to Ready to Transfer.-Click Edit > Reverse.-The payment can now be reversed.-Keywords-bank-to-bank transfer; payment file; reverse; cancel; in transfer; rejected

Title: Target Unit Grayed Out During Key Figure Creation
Content: Symptom-You are creating a key figure and you would like to set a currency conversion. In step 3 of the key figure wizard, you select the option Currency Conversion, but the field Target Unit is grayed out and you cannot set a target unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Key Figures.-Click New.-Go through the setting in step 1 and 2.-In step 3, selection the conversion type Currency Conversion.-Now you see that the Target Unit field is grayed out.-Cause-The currency conversion setting in the key figure means that there will be a conversion enabled for this key figure when you use it in the report. There will be a "Display Currency" variable in the report selection; i.e. the target currency is defined on the report level, not on the key figure level.-Resolution-Please complete your key figure and add it in the required report. You will see the Display Currency field in the selection. Here you can set the currency required.-See Also-You can also check the help center for further information on this. The relevant article is "Conversion" (scroll down to Currency Conversion).-Keywords-key figure, currency conversion, greyed out, grayed out, target unit, not possible to select unit, reporting, display currency, business analytics

Title: Auto Logoff Time Not Respected When Using Single Sign On
Content: Symptom-You have setup a certain period of time for for auto-logoff at company settings. However, this time is not being respected for the users which are using single sign on (SSO). And After a certain period of inactivity a message is displayed offering to prolong the session.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer -Cause-In this case the auto logoff is triggered due the single sign on token renew.-Resolution-Review the token time-out settings with your Identity Provider (IdP). It's recommended to configure the same setting as in the SAP system.-Keywords-Auto logoff, timeout, inactivity message, single sign on, token

Title: Extraction of Data in BW from C4C or BYD System Fails with Error Message
Content: Symptom-When you try to do Data Extraction in BW system, the extraction will fail for all the data sources and you will get an error message like below.- "SUBMIT authorization SODQADM required for program ODQ_TASK"-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business By Design-Cause-When you switch to Pagination (Open Fetch) Method, it is a mandatory step that the Communication Arrangement needs to be Reactivated.-If this step is not followed, the necessary roles will not be assigned to the technical user. This is the reason for the failure in Data Extraction.-Resolution-You need to Reactivate the Communication Arrangement. Follow the steps given below.-In C4C-Navigate to Administrator work center and choose Communication Arrangements , select an Arrangement, and click Reactivate.-In ByD-Navigate to Application and User Management work center and choose Communication Arrangements , select an Arrangement, and click Reactivate.-See Also-To know more about Pagination and communication arrangements refer to the below help center documents.-https://help.sap.com/viewer/637db7a0d01e47009d9420e9a927c571/1708/en-US/982376a43cdc409aa2f38b8a5fc492e9.html-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2005/en-US/c30ccd16669c43a69482b490fdecaad0.html?q=reactivate%20communication%20arrangement-Keywords-communication arrangement, extraction, fails, failure, data extraction, BW , integration, error message, SOAP , authorization, roles , user, data sources, C4C , BYD, ODP , Endpoint

Title: How to Find out BO Details behind an Object for a Report or Data source
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You are analyzing a Report or Data Source issue and want to find out where the data of a specific Object (field) is coming from.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Example with Sales Order, Best Practice and Confirmed Quantity from the Sales Order Volume Report and Data Source.-Open the Report or Data source from the UI and click on Details to view the Report/Data Source Name and ID. In this case:-Report: Sales Order Volume (ID CRMSLOIB_Q0001)-Data Source: Sales Order Volume (ID CRMSLOIB)--Identify the fields you would like to check. In this case:-Sales Order (Characteristic)-Best Practice (Extension Field)-Confirmed Quantity (Key Figure)--Open the report from the backend via Tx MDRS as following:-Metadata Repository-MDAV Key Figures Composites for reports-MDAV (Multidim. Analytical View) for Data Sources (MDAV)-Enter the Report or MDAV ID: CRMSLOIB_Q0001 or CRMSLOIB--Double-click on the MDAV (CRMSLOIB) then select the View Elements tab.--Under Column Text search for the fields: Sales Order and Best Practice and Confirmed Quantity. When you find the field you may highlight the row and you should be able to see the following details:-Sales Order-Object Name: DOC_UUID-Object Description: Sales Order-Element Type: Characteristic-BO: SALES_ORDER-BON: ROOT-Node Element: UUID-CONTENT-Master data MDAV: CRMSLOHB-Best Practice:-Object Name: /1AN/F10122280CA27C-Object Description: Best Practice-Element Type: Characteristic-BO: SALES_ORDER-BON: ROOT-Node Element: /BYD/A0014P000000000000080-UI Text: /1XT/UIT000000000000126-Confirmed Quantity -Object Name: ITV_CONF_QTY_BU-Object Description: Confirmed Quantity-Element Type: Key Figure-BO: SALES_ORDER_AEO-BON: ITEM_TOTAL_VALUES-Node Element: BSUNT_CONFIRMED_QUANTITY-CONTENT-Aggregation type: Summation-Currency/Unit Ref.: ITV_CON_QY_U_BU-NOTE: You can find similar information by double-clicking on the desired object from the Characteristic or Key Figures list under the MDAV.-For example: If you double click on the extension field Best Practice (/1AN/F10122280CA27C) you will see all the BO details from the General tab.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords-report, data source, backend, BO details, business object details, business object, how to find, MDAV, Metadata Repository

Title: Supplier Invoice cancellation is not Possible due to an Error Message: Credit quantity greater than invoiced delivery quantity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are unable to post the supplier invoice cancelation document due to an error message:-Credit quantity greater than invoiced delivery quantity;-Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount;-The sum of the credit quantities is greater than the sum of the debit quantities for the preceding supplier invoice item;-The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice .-The cancelation document is in status Exception and the original document is in status In Cancelation.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the cancelation document (in status Exception).-Select  Edit button and navigate to the Exceptions tab (in View All mode) or click on Show Exceptions (in normal mode).-Cause-The Supplier Invoice Cancelation document is created but Goods and Services Receipt which is referred in the supplier invoice is canceled and posted first before posting the Cancelation Supplier invoice.-Resolution-Void the cancelation invoice  and cancel the Supplier Invoice again.-The cancelation invoice gets posted after the Goods and services receipt cancelation.

Title: Error Message in SAC when Retrieving Data From ByD/ C4C Data Source
Content: Symptom-You are running an OData query for a ByD / C4C data source from your SAC system and you receive the following error message:-System query options '$skip' are not allowed in the requested URI-However, you are not using $skip in your query, and when you run it in the browser directly, the query runs through without any issues. The error happens only on SAC side.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Analytics Cloud-Cause-SAC retrieves the query records by paging for performance and load reason. Each page has 1000 records. When the query results is over 1000 records, SAC uses $skip and $top operators to acquire the subsequent pages of records, for example, SAC sends the following queries to the OData service:-$top=1000 for the first 1000 records-$skip=1000&$top=1000 for records from 1000-2000-$skip=2000&$top=1000 for records from 2000-3000-However, as you can see in the KBA 2822026, ByD / C4C does not support $skip unless the data is non-aggregated in your query.-Resolution-You have to set your query in such a way, that the data is non-aggregated. This means that certain fields need to be included in the list of fields that you request.-See Also-For further details, please see the KBA  2822026 - Error in OData Query for Data Source: Skip Are Not Allowed In The Requested URL.-For the SAC integration with ByD, you can also see the blog here.-Keywords-data source, '$skip' are not allowed in the requested URL, odata, sac, error, business analytics, paging

Title: The Net Value of the Service Order Does not Consider the Coverage (Goodwill) Added at the Item Level
Content: Symptom-The Net Value of the service order does not consider the Coverage (Goodwill) added at the item level.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Create a New Service Order from Common Tasks.-Add the mandatory details like account in the service order.-Select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Add the service ABC and maintain and add Goodwill 50% under Coverage (ABC represents the ID of the service).-The Net Value calculated for the service order has not considered the Coverage (Goodwill 50 %) added for the product.-Note: The behavior is same for the other CRM documents like Sales Order & Manual Invoice.-Cause-You have not maintained the Coverage (Goodwill) in the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Resolution-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-Go to the Special Surcharges, Special Discounts subview.-From the dropdown select Special Discount: Coverage Goodwill.-Create new entries for Goodwill 50% and Goodwill 100%.-Release the Coverage Goodwill.-Now the CRM documents will consider the Coverage (Goodwill) while calculating the Net Value.-Keywords-Coverage, Goodwill, Warranty, Service Order, Special Discounts

Title: Advice Required Indicator is Set Although not Required in the Master Data
Content: Symptom-The Advice Required is set to Yes in a payment order, however the Remittance Advice Required was not set as required in the account's master.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Select a payment and refer to the Advice Required field set to Yes on the Details section.-Cause-Payment has been created with reference to many invoices, however, for reasons of memo line restriction, not all invoices could be considered in the payment file.-Therefore, a memo line note about payment advice is created, based on the payment correspondence profiles, to explain the invoice that could not have been added, thus the Advice Required indicator is set, although Remittance Advice Required is not set in the master data.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Nevertheless, note that in case payment medium has been created manually, for example, Bank Transfer, the advice will not be automatically created, nor the system would abort the payment file creation in case the advice is not issued.-The Advice Required indicator itself is the indication that the advice needs to be sent.-In case the advice has to be sent automatically, then a Payment Media Run must be scheduled via Payment Management work center.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Outgoing Bank Transfers — Configuration Guide-Keywords-Payment media run, payment advice.

Title: Undefined Date Format When Uploading a Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You are uploading a migration template via Migration Tool, however you get a date format error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list of the relevant project.-Open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the migration unit that you are using to migrate or create a new migration unit.-Click Execute Migration.-In the Process Files step, Click Upload File for one of the migration elements (e.g. Fixed Assets, Open Items Payables, etc.)-Browse your xml migration file and start the upload.-A dialog window is shown stating an Undefined Date Format. The messages can be as follows:-'File contains some date values for which the format could not be determined. Correct these entries before executing migration.'-'Some date entries are in error; enter dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration'-Cause-The attributes that carries a Date parameter, such as Document Date and/or Base Line Date, Depreciation Start Date, Deactivation Date (depending on the template being used) have one or more records in the file with, for example, time details alongside the Date. The cells itself are formatted to display only date information, hence you have to select the concerned cell and refer to its content in the Formula Bar.-Resolution-In order to be able to upload your excel file and process it in the migration tool, you have to remove the time details so that the fields are populated only with Date.-In case you have many records, you may copy all the column content to a Notepad, you'll see that only the Date is copied due to cell formatting, and copy the Notepad content back to the excel file only with Date information.-You must review your file and make sure that all the records have the correct date assigned back, before you upload the same into the system.-Keywords-Migration, Date Format, Fixed Asset, Migration Tool, Open Items Payable, Open Items Receivable.

Title: NONEX values displayed in Time Accounts reports
Content: Symptom-You notice that the key figures Taken and Planned are displayed with the value "NONEX" in any of the Time Accounts reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Time Administration-Go to View Reports-Open any of the Time Accounts reports-Cause-The characteristic Time Account Type is not displayed in the report, neither in Rows nor Columns. It can be found in Not Currently Shown.-The report is not meaningful without the characteristic Time Account Type which contains attributes like Working time, Travel time and Vacation. An aggregation of the key figures Taken and Planned without these attributes would not be meaningful.-Resolution-Move the characteristic Time Account Type from Not Currently Shown to Rows or Columns. The values for key figures Taken and Planned will then be displayed as expected.-If the "NONEX" value is occurring in any result field then it might be because that the calculation is between two different Time Accounts or different Units or any calculation where the parameters are not same.-Keywords-business analytics, time accounts, reports, nonex, key figure values wrong, zeitkonten, bericht, reporting, wrong results, result row, result line-time accounts report

Title: Unexpected Value in Customer Invoice Resulting from Currency Conversion
Content: Symptom-When Invoicing a Sales Order, you expect the Net Price of your Customer Invoice to take the Currency Conversion value of the Customer Invoice's Posting Date, but this is not happening.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Customer Invoicing work center.-Find the Invoice Documents view.-Open Customer Invoice ABC (Where ABC Represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Edit the document and click View All.-You see that the Posting Date for this document is DD.MM.AAAA and the Net Price for a Product is GHI. However, when checking the Exchange Rate History:-Go to Audit work center.-Open the View Exchange Rates Task.-Click the View Exchange Rate History button.-For Date DD.MM.AAAA, you see that the value does not match the one used in the Currency Conversion of Product GHI.-(DD.MM.AAAA Represents the Posting Date).-(GHI Represents the Product ID in the Customer Invoice).-Cause-This happens because the Currency Conversion happens based on the Pricing Date of the Sales Order, rather than the Posting Date of the Customer Invoice. You can check the Pricing Date in the Sales Order by following these steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order JKL (Where JKL represents the Sales Order ID).-Edit the document and click View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-There you will be able to see the field Pricing Date.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Platform to submit an idea:.-See Also-2827196 - Customer Invoice Total Value does Not Match with Service Order Total Value.-Keywords-Sales Order, Customer Invoice, Pricing Date, Posting Date, Exchange Rate

Title: Broadcast Logs are Empty
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled a broadcast or run it manually, and you would like to see the logs. However, the broadcast logs table is empty and the logs are missing.-Environment-Cloud for Customer-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Select the view Broadcasts.-Search for your broadcast.-Click View Logs.-The view is empty and you cannot see any logs.-Cause-The broadcast name is longer than 50 characters. When the system searches for broadcast logs to display on the UI, only the first 50 characters are searched. Due to this, the broadcast name created by the user (51 characters or more) and the broadcast name in the logs table do not match and the logs are not found.-Resolution-Please modify the broadcast name so that it has less than 50 characters (spaces included). The logs will be shown from the next broadcast execution onwards.-See Also-2542020 - Broadcast Logs Incorrect or Missing-Keywords-broadcast, logs, missing, empty, business analytics, report run, emails, protokoll

Title: Custom KPIs are displayed with the incorrect scaling
Content: Symptom-You have created a new KPI and realised that it is displaying the result for example in Thousand Euro,  instead of displaying the actual figures. For example displaying 1.2 T Euro instead of 1200 Euro.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the view Design KPIs.-Show only the Customer Created KPIs.-Select the KPI ABC (ABC represents a custom KPI that you created).-Click on Preview.-You will notice that your KPI is displaying in T€ and you don't see the actual figure.-Cause-The KPI has the setting 1.000 for scaling maintained.-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the view Design KPIs.-Show only the Customer Created KPIs.-Select the KPI you would like to change the scaling for.-Edit the KPI.-Go to the tab General.-Under Value Setting you have the option to change the value for Scale.-If the Scale option is not available under Value Setting, please do the following steps:-Perform the first 5 steps mentioned above.-Go to Adapt and click on Enter Adaptation Mode.-Go to Adapt and click on Edit Screen.-Under Sections, please select the Value Setting.-Under Fields, please tick the box for Scale.-Click on Save and leave the Adaptation Mode.-You can now change the scaling from 1.000 to 1 (or whatever scaling is required).-Keywords-KPI, scalling, in thousand, analytics, home page, Millions, T Euro, M Euro, Custom KPI, T€, M€, value setting, custom KPI, customer created KPI

Title: How-to Transfer Cash Between Two Petty Cash With Different Currencies
Content: Symptom-You get the error message Currency given is not supported by the cash storage when trying to post a New Outgoing Cash Transfer between two Petty Cash with different currencies (e.g. from an EUR Petty Cash to a USD Petty Cash).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Make sure you have entered at least two petty cashes with different currencies each.-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Petty Cash view-Select any active petty cash and take note of its currency, which could be found in Balance Amount column-Click on New and then Outgoing Cash Transfer-Fill out Transaction Amount, Posting and Document Date-Under To Petty Cash/Bank Account, choose Petty Cash as Selection Target-Type a Petty Cash ID which has a currency different from the one you are transferring the money-Click on Post-Error message Currency given is not supported by the cash storage is displayed-Cause-Transfers of cash between petty cash with different currencies are currently not supported in Business ByDesign.-Resolution-As an alternative solution, you can use a bank account as an intermediate for the cash transaction, because bank accounts can be configured to work with different currencies.-First of all, it's crucial verifying whether the Exchange Rates for these involved currencies are set up as desired.--Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Edit Exchange Rates under Common Tasks view.-Check if the exchange rate for 'Source Currency: XXX' and 'Target-Currency: YYY' is set up as desired. If it's not, change it accordingly.-Check the same for YYY to XXX.-Click on Save and Close.-After that, the process flow would be as below-Transfer from XXX petty cash to a bank account-Transfer from bank account to YYY petty cash-Part 1-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Petty Cash view-Select any active petty cash with XXX currency, which could be found in Balance Amount column-Click on New and then Outgoing Cash Transfer-Fill out Transaction Amount, Posting and Document Date-Under To Petty Cash/Bank Account, choose Bank Account as Selection Target-Select the desired Bank Account ID-Click on Post-Part 2-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Petty Cash view-Select any active petty cash with YYY currency, which could be found in Balance Amount column-Click on New and then Incoming Cash Transfer-Fill out Transaction Amount in YYY (corresponding to Part 1 in XXX, according to exchange rate that you set up before) Posting and Document Date-Under To Petty Cash/Bank Account, choose Bank Account as Selection Target-Select the same Bank Account ID that Part 1-Click on Post-It is preferred that you create a dummy bank account for this since you would not receive a bank statement and hence you would not be able to confirm the bank part of the transaction unless the money is actually deposited to the bank account and then withdrawn. -The bank statement items will balance to zero since it should effectively be only used for currency conversion.-As a result you have transferred money between two petty cash with different currencies and the cash position from the bank account you've used as an intermediate remains the same.-Keywords-Petty Cash Transfer, Payment Management, Currencies.

Title: Error: “Enter the unit of measure for the specified quantity”
Content: Symptom-While performing an activity in the UI, you receive the below error although you did not manually make changes to a quantity:-"Enter the unit of measure for the specified quantity."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have created a Custom Business Object or Extension Business Object.-You have implemented a custom script which modifies a Quantity attribute.-Cause-In the Cloud Application Studio, you have made changes to a Quantity field / extension field but while filling the attribute, you are filling only the content part and not the unit code part (Unit of Measure). This script then causes the extensibility layer to raise the error.-Resolution-Please adjust the custom logic and include the Unit of Measure (UoM) value in the script also.-Keywords-SDK, PDI, absl, UoM, unit of measure, script

Title: Delay in Broadcast Execution
Content: Symptom-You scheduled broadcast to be executed at any specific time but the broadcast is delayed by 1 hour in execution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Click on the view Broadcasts.-Search for the desired broadcast.-Check the schedule time and when it got executed via view logs.-Cause-This is system standard behaviour.-Resolution-There is a broadcast trigger job that runs every hour which picks all the due broadcasts runs for the last 1 hour. So you can expect a delay of up to 1 hour between scheduled time and delivery time of the broadcast.--The reason to run by the hour is because batch processing needs some possibilities to manage various concurring jobs. There is an explanation text for the same for the corresponding field in the broadcasting UI :For technical reasons, there can be a delay of up to an hour from the selected start time.-Keywords-Broadcast, C4C, ByD, delayed, wrong time

Title: You Receive an Error During Activation in Your PDI Solution -> The File X Could Only be Modified in its Original Language EN
Content: Symptom-You are trying to activate an item in your custom PDI solution, however you cannot as you are receiving errors.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer Add-ins-Reproducing the Issue-For this example the BeforeSave in the Customer.xbo represents the file you are trying to activate, SAP_SUPP001 represents the user who is affected, 100 represents your Tenant ID and Y1234567 represents your PDI solution.-Open the Cloud Application Studio.-Open the Y1234567 PDI solution.-Right click the BeforeSave in the Customer.xbo file.-Select Activate.-You see the errors:-Unable to perform the content operation for user SAP_SUPP001 in client 100.-Unable to save the content for file /Y1234567_MAIN/GEN/CustomerXBO/Event-BeforeSave.absl in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT-The file /Y1234567_MAIN/GEN/CustomerXBO/Event-BeforeSave.absl could only be modified in its original language 'EN'.-Cause-These errors have occurred because the files have been modifed by a PDI user, whose Master Language is not set to English.-Resolution-The PDI user who is working on the custom solution, must have their master language set to English. To do this, please contact the system Key User / System Administrator to ensure the PDI Users Master Language is set to English.-Keywords-Activation;Original language;Unable to save content

Title: Language Adaptation not Collecting Extension Fields for Reports
Content: Symptom-You are trying to collect reports texts in Language Adaptation but you are not getting any result.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports.-Select the custom report.-Click on Edit With and Report Wizard.-Go to Step 4: enter a characteristic name in the column Rename Characteristic To.-Go to step 5: enter a variable name in the column Rename Variable To.-Click Finish. Afterwards, the language adaptation tool will pick up these texts as well.-Go to Administrator work center.-Go to General Settings.-Go to Language Adaptation.-Click on New.-Fulfill the required fields. -Click on Save.-You cannot see any new result.-Cause-PDI extension fields cannot always be found via the Language Adaptation tool. This tool should only be used for fields created on the UI directly.-Resolution-Please translate PDI fields using the SAP Cloud Applications Studio. There you will be able to translate business object extension like a label or tooltip of an extension field.-See Also-Translation Quick Guide-Keywords-language adaptation, extension field translation, pdi translation, sdk

Title: Missing Clearing House Statement in Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-You have successfully uploaded a clearing house statement into the system, nevertheless it does not show up for allocation in the payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Banks Statements view.-Open the related bank statements.-Click the Required link in the corresponding bank statement line that should allocate the credit card payments.-Once the system opens the relevant payment allocation, Click Actions -> Import Clearing House Statement.-In the dialog window that opens, click the value help.-You notice that the uploaded clearing house statement is not available for selection, even though it has status Released.-Note that the payment allocation can also be opened via the Payment Allocation view under Payment Management.-Cause-One of the reasons for this to happen is due to an unconformity in the content structure of the uploaded file. This may happen due to the FormatCode tag that was uploaded with value 01 instead of 1.-Resolution-You need to correct the FormatCode tag in the file from 01 to 1.-Keywords-Credit Card. Clearing House. Payment Allocation. Pre-confirm. Bank Statement. Inbound File.

Title: Report Session Lost After Inactivity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to refresh a report after the session was idle for some time and you can see the error message box at the bottom of the screen and one of the following error messages:-'Report Cannot be Opened; Report an Incident'-'Report session is lost. Please restart report'-Then, you have to close and reopen it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Open your report.-Leave the report window open but do not make any changes.-After some time, try to work with the report e.g. by opening a value help, changing any setting or refreshing the report.-You can see a red error message box and one of those error messages. You have to close the report and open it again.-Cause-The session times out after 20 minutes if it is idle.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior. If you would like to have it changed, you can submit it as a new idea/ suggestion in our SAP Customer Influence. The Customer Influence site allows customers to log Improvement Requests themselves and have the ability to work directly with our technology and development group.-SAP Customer Influence- < https://influence.sap.com >-See Also- 2625012 - Dashboard Times Out in RUI: Report Cannot Be Opened / Report Session is Lost-Keywords-report, analytics, html5, time out, session, empty error message, red exclamation mark, session lost, report cannot be opened, idle time report,-failed to open report,internal server error,report an incident

Title: Error Message 'Data type of data source field XYZ is not available' when creating a new data source
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field and extended it to a data source. You also have checked the consistency and it should be working as expected. However, when you try to create a new data source and add this field the following error message is raised  'Data type of data source field XYZ is not available'.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work-center and Design Data Sources view.-Click on New button and New Data Source (Join or Combined).-Click on Add Row button and select the data source.-Define your data sources and join conditions.-Click on Save button.-See the error message 'Data type of data source field XYZ is not available'.-Cause-The extension field had some inconsistencies and needed to be repaired.-Resolution-Access the Object on which your extension field is based.-Enter Adaptation Mode.-Go to Extension Fields tab.-Access the Further Usage.-Click on the Data Sources and Reports pane.-See the red lights on the status column.-Click on the button Repair.-See the green lights.-Click on the Publish button.-Exit Adaptation Mode.-Try to re-create your data source.-Keywords-Extension field, data source, new, adapt, adaptation, further usage, Data type of data source field XYZ is not available

Title: Error Message: 'Account determination is missing for item type Scrapping of Fixed Assets'
Content: Symptom-You are trying to scrap a fixed asset, however an error message for missing account determination for item type Scrapping is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Find the related asset.-Click Manual Posting -> Complete Scrapping.-Enter relevant data and click Simulate.-The following errors are raised: -'Account determination is missing for item type Scrapping of Fixed Assets. Specify account determination in chart of accounts <chart of accounts ID> and account determination profile <account determination profile ID>. Column Path Fixed Assets->Asset Sale/Scrapping->Loss from Scrapping, Item Type Scrapping of Fixed Assets.'-'Journal entries for journal entry voucher cannot be simulated'-Cause-The account determination group of the fixed asset is not maintained in the account determination profile.-Resolution-You may check the account determination of the concerned asset as follows:-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Highlight the related asset and click Edit -> General. -On the top of the screen that opens, you find the asset class and account determination group.-Once you find the account determination group, you maintain the account determination via below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Search and open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination section, click Fixed Assets.-Click tab Fixed Asset Sale/Scrapping.-Select the relevant account determination profile.-Maintain the account determination group for the asset.-Keywords-Manual Postings. Fixed Asset. Account Determination Profile.

Title: Company Paid Expense Reports Does not Have Tax items in Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have posted an expense report with a company paid expense (Taxation, No payment), however the corresponding journal entry does not split the amount and no tax entry is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Reports view.-Click New -> Expense Reports on Behalf of-Create the expense report accordingly.-In the Expenses tab, add an expense which is company paid (Taxation, No payment) and select a tax code for this expense entry. -Post the expense report.-Open the resulting journal entry.-You expect a journal entry line item for the tax item, however the journal entry has a net posting, without any taxes.-Cause-In the Expense and Reimbursement Management Application paid by company receipts generates always a net posting without any taxes.-Even if the expense type is company paid(Taxation,No payment) or company paid(No Taxation,No payment), the taxation term in this case means that the traveler must pay income tax for the company paid receipt (even if he does not get any money). There is no VAT (that the company can claim back) on such an expense type.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Expense type, Expense Report, Tax, VAT, Journal Entry, ER, ERM.

Title: Report View Not Found Error shown While Opening a Workbook in Excel
Content: Symptom-While opening a Workbook ABC (ABC is the Workbook name) in MS Excel via the Addin you receive the error message 'Report view XYZ (XYZ is the view name) not found'.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login into Excel.-Click on Open.-Search and Select the Workbook ABC.-Error message 'Report view XYZ not found' is shown.-Cause-The report view XYZ of one of the reports in the Workbook might have been deleted. While opening the workbook, the system tries to find all the views. Since the view has been deleted, it throws the error message.-Resolution-Please set one of the report views as default and save the workbook as a new workbook.-Select one report in the workbook.-Click Save All.-Select Save workbook as new.-Keywords-report view, Excel Addin, Excel Add-in, report view not found, workbook

Title: Report Data Missing for Pie Chart
Content: Symptom-The pie chart is not showing all the key figure values of the report.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Select any report with more than one key figure.-Choose chart type as Pie Chart.-It will show only first key figure value in the pie chart.-Cause-The pie chart was designed to be used with no more than 1 key figure. A second key figure cannot be shown in this chart type.-Resolution-If you require to see more than 1 key figure in your report view, please make use of another chart type, or display as table instead.-Keywords-Pie Chart,Reports,Analysis,Key Figure, missing, chart types, business analytics, wrong view-reports,pie chart

Title: Time Out While Using Value Help in Report Confirmation Journal
Content: Symptom-You receive a time out while using value help in the report Confirmation Journal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Click on the Report ABC (ABC represents the name of the report to open).-Click Go.-Click on the Value Help DEF (DEF represents the name of the value help to open).-After several seconds the system displays a dump screen with the run-time error 'TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED'.-Cause-This run-time error is related to the fact that the value help is context based and not master data based.-Resolution-The system has a lot of data, hence please give more filter parameter like logistics area, location, product etc to limit the records. Then the value help for confirmation document type will work.-Keywords-Report, Help Value, Time out , AP-RC_ANA, Product, Dump

Title: The Inbound Delivery for This Return Was Updated
Content: Symptom-You canceled the Inbound Delivery and expected to have the Customer Return with the status as Completed, but the Return is still with the status as In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Return).-Click the Edit button.-Warning: The inbound delivery for this return was updated. Review the credit memo request issued before this correction, and make the necessary adjustments to prevent incorrect payment to the customer.-Cause-The Return did not complete automatically, due to a message which was raised when the approval status of the document went from Approved to Not Started.-This happened since the Credit Memo document was already created when the Inbound Delivery was later canceled.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.--To complete the Return, please perform the following steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Return).-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Under the Details subtab, scroll to Inbound.-Enter any value from the list for Reason for Rejection.-Hit the Enter button.-Document status changed to Completed and you can save the document.-See Also-2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return-Keywords-Return; Not Completed; Status; Inbound Delivery;

Title: How to Create Restricted Key Figure
Content: Symptom-You need to create a restricted key figure and you want to know how to do it.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center and Design Key Figures view.-Click New button.-Type a name.-Select a data source.-Type: Restricted Key Figure.-Select a Key Figure.-Click Next button.-In the 2nd step, please select a Characteristic.-Select a Restriction Type (the available ones will be listed after this step-by-step).-In case you have selected Fixed, please maintain a restriction by clicking on Set Fixed Value Selection.-In case you have selected Variable, please maintain a default value by clicking on Set Default Value Selection.-If you need to have more parameters, click Add Row.-Repeat the steps 8-11.-Click Next button.-Please maintain the key figure properties.-Click Next button.-Finish.-Keywords-keyfigures, key figures, restricted, restricted key figures, custom key figure-key figure,restricted key figure

Title: How to Bring the Next Integer of a Key Figure Value
Content: Symptom-There is a business requirement to check the next integer number of a key figure value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Ceil is a mathematical operator that will analyze the given value/key figure and bring the next integer number. It means that if a value is 2,5, its ceil is 3.-Example:  CEIL[Key Figure]-Keywords- key figures, next integer, CEIL, value, integer

Title: Fields Related to Employee Address are Shown as Not Assigned in a Report
Content: Symptom-You are working with a report that contains employee information, such as Employee Times: Monthly. The fields related to employee address like City (Employee), State (Employee), Country (Employee),  etc are shown as Not Assigned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open a report, e.g. Employee Times: Monthly.-Click on the Add Fields button.-Expand the Employee dimentions.-Tick the fields City, State, Country etc and click on OK.-Now add these fields to the report view.-Their value is # (Not Assigned).-Cause-The Change Workplace Contact Data is not maintained in Personal Administration work center for the respective employee.-Resolution-Go to the Personal Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the respective employee and click Edit.-Go to the Employement tab and click Workplace Contact Data.-Maintain the address details here.-Keywords-reporting, wrong data, employee times, city, country, address, county, state, postal code, missing, #, unassigned, street,

Title: How to Truncate a Key Figure Value to Integer
Content: Symptom-There is a business requirement to remove the decimal or fractional part of a key figure value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In order to truncate a value to integer, you can use the TRUN mathematical operator.-Example: TRUNC[Key Figure]-Keywords-key figures, truncate, integer, trunc, key figure value, operator, trun

Title: Wrong Net Value in the Data Source Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-You are using the standard report Sales Order Volume or have created your own report on the data source Sales Order Item. The key figure Net Value shows the wrong value and currency.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the respective report from the assigned work center.-Add the key figure Net Value and the characteristic Sales Order to the view.-For a specific sales order, check the displayed Net Value - let us assume it shows a value in EUR although you expect it to show GBP.-Cause-There are 2 points to note:-Your sales order was at first created with the transactional value EUR. However after releasing the sales order and after its fulfillment has begun, you have changed the currency to GBP. Once the sales order was released and fulfilled, the report cannot reflect changes anymore. The values are locked to ensure consistency with follow-up documents.-If your company currency is a different one to the transactional currency at the time of saving the sales order, the system will convert the transactional currency to the company currency (according to the conversion rate that is maintained at this time). These values will then be used to calculate further results if necessary. If the currency is subsequently changed in sales orders and further conversions become necessary, different conversion rates may apply and the result value may be different from what is maintained in the sales order.-Resolution-Reporting reflects the sales order data at the point of document release since it is uncommon that values are changed after that. A change on the sales order after it has been released could potentially cause inconsistencies in the follow-up documents and should be avoided.-Keywords-business analytics, sales order, wrong value, net value, wrong currency, conversion, transactional, company currency, reporting, CRMSLOIB-sales order volume report,crmsloib_q0001

Title: How to Bring the Exponential Value of a Key Figure Value
Content: Symptom-There is a business requirement to return the exponential values of key figures referred on the exponential base 2,71828183.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-The mathematical operator EXP returns the exponential value (with base 2,71828183) raised to the power of the given value or key figure. The number 2,71828183 is a constant value and the base of the natural logarithm. So if we have the number 2, its exponential result will be 7,38905610.-Example: EXP[Key Figure]-Keywords-key figures, exponential value

Title: How to Bring the Absolute Value of a Key Figure
Content: Symptom-There is a business requirement to create a custom key figure that shows the distance of a number from zero and it should also ignore negative values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-ABS is a mathematical operator that brings the absolute value of a number. It will show you the distance of a number on the line from zero and it will not considerate if the value is negative, meaning, if you have a key figure with the value -246, its absolute value will be 246. It means that the same value will be shown but without its sign.-Example: ABS[KeyFigyure]-Keywords-keyfigures, keyfigure, key figure, ABS, absolutevalue, absolute value

Title: Error Message "Please close all the activities before merge back"
Content: Symptom-When you open the Merge Changes with Production System activity, system throws below error message:-Please close all the activities before merge back-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Highlight the Change Project and select the Open Activity List button.-Go to Go Live phase.-Highlight the Merge Changes with Production System activity and select the Open button.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you have not closed some activities in Prepare, Fine-Tune, Integrate and Extend, and Test phase of the Change Project. So, ensure that you have closed all the activities in all the phases of Change project.-Resolution-Once you have closed all the Activities, go to the Go Live phase in the change Project. Open the activity Merge Changes with Production System and select the Start Merge button.-Note: Once the Merge is successful, the status of the change project will change to Merged.

Title: Cancelled Project Invoice Request Causes Problem in Subsequent Customer Invoice - Italy
