Content: Symptom-You are not able to release a Customer Invoice due to the following error: Conflict detected in item XXX of Project Invoice Request ID ABC; release not possible-But since the Tax Country of the Customer Invoice is Italy you are not able to cancel the Customer Invoice as described in KBA 2925079 - Not Possible to Release Customer Invoice Due to Error: Conflict detected in item XXX of Project Invoice Request ID ABC; release not possible-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select invoice XYZ(XYZ represents the Invoice ID).-Click on the Release button.-The following warning occurs and the invoice is not released:-Conflict detected in item XXX of Project Invoice Request ID ABC; release not possible (XXX represents the line item number in the Project Invoice Request and ABC represents the ID of the Project Invoice Request).-You are not able to cancel the invoice since the Cancel button is grayed out.-Cause-The Customer Invoice XYZ is based on the Project Invoice Request ABC and this Project Invoice Request was cancelled after the Invoice XYZ was created and saved. Since the Project Invoice Request was canceled it is not allowed to release the Customer Invoice anymore.-The reason why the Cancel button is not enabled is due to fact that the Tax Country of the Invoice is Italy and therefore the Customer Invoice needs to be in status Released before it can be cancelled. This is a legal requirement to respect Sequential Numbering Rules and ensure no gap in the customer invoice numbering sequence is created. We also do not allow the creation of a Credit Memo in this case because since the Project Invoice Request has been cancelled.-The correct process to cancel a Project Invoice Request if a Customer Invoice was created is the following:-Ensure that the Customer Invoice created is in status Released.-Cancel the Customer Invoice.-Cancel the Project Invoice Request.-Resolution-Since the Tax Country is Italy and the cancelation of the Invoice is not possible please create an incident with reference to this KBA, the document numbers of the affected documents and the approval to perform a backend correction and cancel the Invoice.-For countries which need to comply with Sequential Numbering rules, the development team is currently also exploring the possibility of introducing Sequential Numbering checks for Cancellation Invoices, similar to what already exists for Customer Invoice, and on making the Posting Date field of the Cancellation Invoice editable so that it is possible to create Cancellation Invoices while complying with Sequential Numbering rules.-See Also-2925079 - Not Possible to Release Customer Invoice Due to Error: Conflict detected in item XXX of Project Invoice Request ID ABC; release not possible -2922093 - Unable to Cancel Customer Invoices - Japan-1381358 - Reversal of Outbound Delivery-2741597 - Customer Invoice is Created Manually for a Project Invoice Request, but in Sales Order, Invoice Status Displays as Open-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, Conflict, Credit Memo, Cancellation, Italy, Sequential Numbering, Invoice, Cancel; disabled; grayed out, greyed out.

Title: KUT Extension Field is missing from .REF file
Content: Symptom-An extension field created in the front-end UI using KUT tools (Adaptation mode) is missing in the reference file (.ref) to customer-specific fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Cause-Customers can enhance their SAP cloud solution by creating extension fields in the adaptation mode. In the studio, the partner can create references to these customer-specific fields. After that, a business logic can be implemented for the referenced fields in script files of a custom solution.-Resolution-There are some restrictions when it comes to referencing customer-specific fields in your custom solution:-You cannot reference a customer-specific field in a solution template.-You cannot reference a calculated field.-You can only reference a customer-specific field in the extension of a business object that has been released in the public solution model (PSM). -See Also-Please check the Help Portal document: Create References to Customer-Specific Fields.-Keywords-KUT, field, .ref, extension, PDI, SDK, Cloud, Applications, Studio

Title: Error Message "DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1 Business Residence XYZ cannot be moved from its current company" While Activating an Org Structure
Content: Symptom-When you activate an Org Structure, system throws below error message:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1 Business Residence XYZ cannot be moved from its current company-Environment-SAP Business BYDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective date.-Highlight the Org Unit ﻿XYZ-Check or Activate it.-Cause-There is a gap in the validity from DD.MM.YYYY to DD1.MM1.YYYY1 for the attributes Company, Company Attributes and Default Currency in the Org Unit XYZ. This can be verified in the Timelines tab (Planning Area) of this Org Unit.-Resolution-To overcome this issue, please follow the below steps:--1. Go to Organizational Management work center.-2. Select Edit Org Structures-3. Highlight the Org Unit XYZ-4. Go to Timelines tab,-5. Change the Valid To date from DD2.MM2.YYYY2* to Unlimited for the Company (second row) and select Enter key in the keyboard.-6. Check the consistency of the structure.-*DD2.MM2.YYYY2 -> One day prior to DD.MM.YYYY-Keywords-Org Unit, error,  Business Residence XYZ cannot be moved from its current company

Title: Error Message in Report: Parameter Does Not Exist
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute a report, however once you click on it and open it , you face a Parameter error message:-Parameter ABC does not exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for your report.-You will see an error message like this, for example:-Parameter PARA_ACCYRPER (MKFC FINCACU04_ROB_01) does not exist-Cause-The report is inconsistent as a parameter no longer exists in the data source where the report is based or the parameter has been removed from the report.-Resolution-In order to solve this error problem, the report needs to be recompiled again which will remove the inconsistency.-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design and Assign Reports View.-Select your report.-Click on Edit With -> Report Wizard button, this will open a new screen.-You will see a message in the bottom of the screen saying that the Parameter has been removed.-Click on Finish button.-Keywords-Parameter does not exist, report, error message, cannot be run, dump, business analytics, analysis, reporting

Title: Report Based on Employee Times Data Source is Timing Out
Content: Symptom-You have created a customized report based on the Employee Times data source and the report times out once you execute it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open your customized report.-Click on Go.-The report will run for a while and an exception will be shown.-Cause-The cause of such behavior is that the report is pulling the entire data from the Employee Times data source and therefore it causes a time out exception.-Resolution-You have to minimize the amount of data that the report pulls.-To do so, you need to insert the time-frame characteristic controller, known as Key Date.-The following steps guide you to make this characteristic mandatory in your report:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design and Assign reports view.-Select your report and click on Edit With -> Report Wizard.-On the new screen, advance until step 3 - Characteristics.-Tick the box at Selected Column for the Key Date characteristic.-Click on Next.-On Step 4, select Key Date and change the Value Selection column from No Value Selection to Using Variable and click on Next.-On Step 5, tick the box at Mandatory column and click on Finish.-This will insert the Key Date characteristic into your report and you will be able to manage the Time Frame. As a consequence you will be able to check on the results of your report.-Keywords-employee times, time out, internal server error, memory, key date, time series, reporting, business analytics

Title: Edit Filter is Grayed Out in Reports
Content: Symptom-You want to filter the content of your report, however the button ﻿Edit Filter﻿ is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-In the reports list, open the required report.-The Filter tab is grayed out.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior as there is no actual content to be filtered yet.-Resolution-To enable the Edit Filter button, you have to first run the specific report and then this button will be available.-The reason for such behavior is that if there is no content to be filtered then the functionality is not necessary, therefore it is grayed out. However, as soon as you execute such report, the button Edit Filter will be available.-Keywords-filter, report, reporting, business analytics, analysis, greyed out, disabled, filter not working

Title: Not able to set Remember Assignment for Future Payment Allocations Checkbox (Grayed Out)
Content: Symptom-You are not able to set Remember Assignment for Future Payment Allocations checkbox (grayed out) in payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Search for Allocation ID ABC (ABC is the payment allocation ID).-Click open the same and then View All.-You will see the "Remember Assignment for Future Payment Allocations" checkbox is grayed out.-Cause-The Remember Assignment for Future Payment Allocations flag is only editable if the corresponding Bank Statement item has the Bank details of the referred Business Partner.-You can check as follows:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Search for Allocation ID ABC.-Click open the same and then View All.-The National Bank Code and Bank Account fields are empty.-Resolution-System is behaving correctly.-The Remember Assignment logic is about finding the correct Business Partner with the help of the Bank details provided in the bank statement.-See Also-According to Help Document: Allocate a Payment Manually-If you receive or make recurring payments from or to customers or suppliers, you can reuse this assignment of the customer or supplier to the bank data specified in the bank statement item you edit in this tab. To make use of this function, set the Remember Assignment for Future Payment Allocations indicator. The next time a payment allocation occurs, the system can automatically assign the payment to the given customer or supplier based on the bank data given in the bank statement item, hence saving you manual effort.-Keywords-Remember Assignment for Future Payment Allocations, payment allocation

Title: How to Show and Use the Report ID
Content: Symptom-This document will help you to understand how to show and use the Report ID to analyze incidents for support purposes.-The Report ID can be shown by following the below steps depending on the report type:-For Browser Based Reports:-Open the desired report.-From the report layout screen click on Details (Top-right of the screen).-The Technical Information window will open and will include the Report ID, Data source name, Creator etc.--For Excel Based Reports:-Open the desired report.-Choose the SAP Business ByDesign, from the menu.-From the Sub-Menu click on Show Report Header icon.-From the report Header you should be able to see the Report name and ID. (Note: this details won't be available for customized workbook)--For Formatted Reports:-Open the desired report with the Crystal Report Designer. (Note: such info is not available via the Crystal Reports Viewer)-From the designer header, right click then choose format field and on the Format Editor screen choose the Common tab-In some cases the Report ID is shown.  -You can also show the Report ID within the Design reports view from the Business Analytics work center as following:-Login to ByD Frontend for the desired system.-Navigate to Business Analytics work center and choose the Design Reports view.-Choose This Screen from the Personalize menu.-From the Screen Layout List of Fields find the Report ID and tick the Visible check box.-Save the new settings and Exit the Screen layout.-From the Design and Assign Reports list you should be able to see, beside the report name, the Report ID.-The report ID is the report technical name which lies underneath the UI name, it is unique and provides some useful information.-For Example, it can be used to identify the report origin, type and where the data is coming from, as shown below:-Sales Order Volume (CRMSLOIB_Q0001) --> Standard SAP report based on application CRM - Sales order - item data.-Sales Order Volume (CRMSLOIB_MQ0001) --> Standard Mobile SAP report based on application CRM - Sales order - item data.-Custom Test (ZFC9D5010214DB2BE) --> Custom created report. In this case you need to check the data source name to figure out where the report data is coming from. i.e. CRMSLOIB (SAP Standard data source) or Z0D5C51594043AA65 (Custom created data source).-Environment-SAP Businesss by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-See Also-A full overview about the available standard data sources can be found below:-1830749 - Complete Data Sources and Characteristics Documentation-2850666 - SAP Cloud for Customer: Complete Data Source Documentation-Keywords-Report ID; report; show the report ID; standard report

Title: Objects Become Inactvie in PDI Solution with Status 'In Development’ after Tenant Move or Tenant Copy
Content: Symptom-The objects are in inactive status in the PDI solution with status 'In Development’ in the target tenant after the tenant move or tenant copy.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio with target tenant URL-Open the solution with status 'In Development’-Objects in the this solutions are inactive-Cause-This is the standard system behavior after the tenant move or tenant copy, the artifacts which created by the solution are not sync with the Layer strategy.-Resolution--After a tenant copy or a tenant move, the solution with status 'In Development’ in the target tenant have to be activated by customer/partner from the SAP Cloud Applications Studio to bring it to the same state as in the source tenant.-This is required to ensure that all runtime objects of the PDI solution are updated.-Go to Cloud Application Studio-Open affected all " In development" solutions-Go to Solution explorer view-Right click and Activate all items-Keywords-tenant move, tenant copy, inactive, PDI solution

Title: Expense Reports: Company Specific Reimbursement Rates
Content: Symptom-You want to use Company Specific Mileage Rate/ Per Diem Rate instead of the statutory rates provided by SAP.-You have maintained the Company Specific Mileage Rate/ Per Diem Rate in Business Configuration.-When you create an Expense Report the Mileage Rates/ Per Diem Rates derived are statutory rates instead of the Company Specific rates.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Click Create New Expense Report.-Enter all the necessary details.-Click Next until Review tab.-The Reimbursement rate displayed is derived from the Statutory Rates.-Cause-You have maintained an Expense Reimbursement Group for the Company Specific Rate.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Mileage Rates/ Per Diem Rates activity.-Click Change Immediately.-Select Edit mileage reimbursement rates/ Edit per diem rates for meals.-Here you have maintained the Company-Specific Rates.-You have also maintained an Expense Reimbursement Group.-If you maintain an Expense Reimbursement Group for the Company Specific Rate, you need to also maintain this Expense Reimbursement Group for the Employee in Expense Arrangement.-If you want Company Specific Rates applied to all employees then you should not maintain an Expense Reimbursement Group.-Resolution-If you want Company Specific Rates applied to all employees then you should not maintain an Expense Reimbursement Group.-You can delete the current Company Specific Rates and create new rows with no Expense Reimbursement Group.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Search for Mileage Rates - Netherlands activity.-Select Edit mileage reimbursement rates.-Click Add Row or click Copy and copy the necessary Mileage/ Per diem Rate and remove the Expense Reimbursement Group.-Delete the row with the Expense Reimbursement Group.-Click Save.-The Company Specific Rates will be applied to all employees.-If you want to apply the Company Specific Rates to only one employee:-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Arrangements view.-Select the Employee.-Click Edit.-Under Expense Reimbursement Group, select the correct group from the drop-down menu (Mileage/ Per diem Rates).-Keywords-Mileage, Expense Reimbursement; per diem rates-mileage, expense reimbursement

Title: Field shows ID and no description in a report
Content: Symptom-You run a report and you notice some fields shows ID and no description.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Report view.-Run the report.-From the field setting choose show ID and Description.-You notice the field shows ID and no description. Alternatively, the "ID and Description" setting may be missing and only the ID option can be selected in the settings.-Cause-This can happen on a cloud data source or PDI data source if the field description was not maintained.-Another cause might be if the particular field is an extension field of type Text. Such fields do not have ID and description, but only text entries.-Resolution-In a cloud data source you have to maintain Referencing Data Source and Referencing Data Source Key Field:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design data source view.-find the cloud data source.-Click Edit.-For the respective field maintained the columns Referencing Data Source and Referencing Data Source Key Field.-In a PDI data source you have to maintain the description in the studio.-If it's a Text extension field, it is not possible to show ID and description in reports. You can create another extension field with a different type which shows an ID and a description.-Keywords-Field Format, ID, Description, ID and Discription, AP-RC-ANA, cloud data source, PDI data source, description missing, display setting

Title: How to Activate Avalara or Vertex
Content: Symptom-You want to activate Avalara or Vertex to provide tax determination services in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation.-Click on Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the 4th step (Questions).-Expand Built-in Services and Support.-Expand Business Environment.-Select Tax Calculation.-Here you have the option to activate one of the following:-Do you want to use the services provided by Vertex to determine tax rates for US?-Do you want to use the services provided by Avalara to determine tax rates for US?-See Also-2188748 - VERTEX Add-on Instalation-2331942 - Scoping Changes not Possible to Disable the Vertex Add-On-See also the following Blogs:-Avalara Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign -Vertex Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign-Avalara and Vertex Integration in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Activate, Avalara, Vertex, Tax, Calculation

Title: Error: The parameter is incorrect. (Exception from HRESULT: 0x80070057 (E_INVALIDARG))
Content: Symptom-When attempting to assemble or activate your custom solution in the Cloud Applications Studio, the below error message is shown:-The parameter is incorrect. (Exception from HRESULT: 0x80070057 (E_INVALIDARG))-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cloud Application Studio-Open Respective Solution -Go to Implementation Manager-Click on Activate OR Assemble & Download -Above error pops up-Cause-This might be a temprory issue which can be caused due to newly added artifacts are not in sync with the existing repository content.-Resolution-This error message can be avoided by taking the following steps:-Open the Solution Explorer Section-Right-Click on the Solution Name.-Click on Check and then click on Enable Background Mode.-Click on Check and then click on Items and Runtime Objects.-You can also check the logs:-Click on Check and then click on Display Logs.-Resolve any error raised, if applicable.-Keywords-PDI;Parameter;E_INVALIDARG;HRESULT

Title: Service Confirmation Creation From a Sales Order via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You expect to create the Service Confirmation from a Sales Order via webservice, however, the response comes as ID does not exist.-Environment- SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-You use the service: manageserviceconfirmationin_v1 to create a Service Confirmation from a Sales Order via webservice.-You filled the tag as following:-<CreateWithReferenceToServiceOrder>true</CreateWithReferenceToServiceOrder>-<BaseServiceOrderID>YYYY</BaseServiceOrderID>-The response comes as following: Service Order ID YYYY does not exist.-YYYY: Represents the ID of the Document.-Cause-The webservice manageserviceconfirmationin_v1 only creates the Service Confirmation from a Service Order, and not from a Sales Order, hence the error faced.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior. Currently, there's no webservice that takes Sales Order as the base reference to create a Service Confirmation. This is considered a new requirement.-It's necessary to add this idea in the Influence Platform.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Webservice, Sales Order, Reference

Title: Syntax Error in Generated ABAP Method
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are working on an ABSL Implementation and copied a code example from the Repository Explorer to your ABSL script file.-You were able to save the file but when activating it you get the message:-Syntax Error in Generated ABAP Method.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign -SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Reproducing the Issue-Open SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Open the Repository Explorer-Find the Code Example you need-Copy it and paste in your ABSL script file-Save the ABSL script file-Activate the ABSL script file-It will fail with error:-Syntax Error in Generated ABAP Method.-Cause-This error message is displayed because you have to make adaptations into the Code Example you take from Repository Explorer.-You have to adjust it to fit in your code logic.-Resolution-Code Examples are just hints on how you can proceed to implement determined functionalities. They are not pre-delivered functions.-Hence, you will always have to adjust the code examples to fit in your code logic.-See Also-In case of doubts on how to adjust the ABSL scripts please reach out to the SAP Cloud Applications Studio Community.-Keywords-ABSL; SDK; Script;

Title: Financial Reporting Structure: Subtotal Print Option Not Being Reflected in Analytical Reports
Content: Symptom-You customized a ﻿report layout, however the changes that you performed in the Subtotal Print Option are not being reflected in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective project.-Click Open Activity List.-Open the Activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Click the link Edit Financial Reporting Structures.-Select any of the Financial Reporting Structure.-Click Edit.-Here you have filled Subtotal Print Option field, for example, 2 - Header without Subtotal-Now open an analytical report (for example, Total Costs by Cost Center and Assigned Projects) and run it. You will see that the value defined for Subtotal Print Option in the respective financial reporting structure is not reflected in the report.-Cause-With the Subtotal Print Option you can specify at which structures items you would like to insert additional subtotals. However, this setting is only relevant for Statutory Reports. It is not evaluated for the normal analytical reports. Hence, when value for the Subtotal Print Option is changed, it does not have any impact on the report content display.-Resolution-As per current system design, this is the expected behavior.-Keywords-subtotal print option; financial reporting structure; analytical report; statutory report

Title: Custom Validation in Attachment Does Not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-You are using the standard functionality of attachments and implemented a custom validation to verify the files to be attached.-You have implemented this scenario in the ABC (ABC stands for the view name) view of the XYZ (XYZ stands for the work center name) work center.-When adding a new attachment to an instance which is already created your event before save is not triggered as you expects.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to XYZ work center.-Open ABC view.-Select an entry.-Click on Edit.-In the Attachments Session click on Add.-Upload an inconsistent file (according to the validation you created).-Click on Save.-Your entries will be saved and the event before save will not be called.-If you modify the value of any field in the header of this entry and click on Save, the event before save will be triggered. In this case the validation will occur for all the files you have attached.-Cause-The framework does not count the change in the attachment folder as a change in the instance, hence the validations are not called.-Attachment Folder is an association within the custom BO(stands for Business Object) and just changing the content of it would not trigger the validations once the custom BO Instance is already created.-If you use the Trace Funtion on SDK while trying to add an attachment in an already created instance you will see in the trace results that anything was called and because of it the save was successful.-Resolution-If a field on Root Node is changed before clicking on save, the validations are called and the scenario works as expected. It happens because when you change a field in Root Node the framework understands the instance was changed and the validations happen for the entire instance and its associations, hence the validations on the attachments must happen again.--To overcome this scenario some modeling adjustments on ABSL would be needed.-See Also-In case of further questions on ABSL Implementation, please reach out to our SAP Cloud Applications Studio Community.-Keywords-Attachment; Validation; Before; Save;

Title: Wrong DoNotReply Sender Email Address When Releasing Documents
Content: Symptom-You have released a document and the sender your client received in the e-mail from the system was donotreply@myxxxxxx.mail.sapbydesign.com (where myxxxxxx is your tenant address). However, you have maintained another email address under Output Channel Selection (example@example.com).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the work center of the document.-2. Search for document 123 (123 is the document you want to edit).-3. Click in edit.-4. Go to Output Channel History.-5. You will see that example@example.com was mantained as the sender e-mail.-6. The customer received the e-mail from donotreply@myxxxx.mail.sapbydesign.com instead of example@example.com.-Cause-The sender e-mail address gets the "donotreply" in case where customer has enabled the "Signing Outgoing E-mails" setting under Configure S/MIME screen but has not uploaded the certificate for the same.--You need also check under Business Configuration if the document type is set as "Sign" for Outgoing emails.-Follow the steps to check this.--1. Go to Business Configuration WoC.-2. Then click in Overview.-3. In Fine Tuning Activities search for "E-mail Encryption and Signature Check".-4. Click in View button.-5. Under Outgoing E-mail section, scroll until you find your document type.-6. Change it to "Do not sign"-Resolution-You have two options to trigger the PO with the sender email address manteined by output settings:--1. Disable the "Signing Outgoing E-mails" setting under Configure S/MIME screen.-2. Upload the certificate.-Also check the E-mail Outgoing settings under Business Configuration if this is set as "Do not sign".-Keywords-Wrong; E-mail; Sender; Output; Channel; Address; donotreply

Title: Output File for 1099 Misc Has Previous Year Indicator Set for Current Tax Year
Content: Symptom-You ran a Withholding Tax Return Run for a 1099 - File tax arrangement. When checking the generated output .txt file, you notice that in the 'T' record for the current tax year, the 'P' character is set in the 6th position - indicating it as previous tax year.-The file gets rejected by FIRE system in IRS - Internal Revenue Service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Withholding Tax Return view.-Open the related tax return (tax Return Type Miscellaneous Income (1099 MISC) - File) executed in the current tax year (e.g. Jan-Dec/2019).-Go to the Attachments tab and download the .TXT file.-You see that, in record 'T', the 'P' indicator is set in the 6th position: T2019P....-Since 2019 is the current tax year (to be reported beginning of 2020), the 'P' characters would not be expected.-Cause-The 'P' character is currently being set since the Send Date field of the tax return is after December, 21st.-This field can ben seen in the Tax Return under General tab. It is editable while the return is In Preparation. Since you would only report the 1099 taxes of e.g. 2019 (tax year) in 2020 (after the December, 21st check) the indicator is set for the current tax year.-Resolution-Our developers are working on enhancing the system. Expected changes to be delivered in one of the subsequent ByDesign releases.-Until then, if you are reporting current tax year taxes and the indicator is being set, you may edit the output file manually and remove the previous year indicator.-Keywords-WHT, Withholding Tax, Previous Year Indicator, Tax Management.

Title: Error "ProtocolError" or Dump "500 SAP Internal Server Error" while Downloading WSDL File of Custom Web Service
Content: Symptom-Error "ProtocolError" or dump "500 SAP Internal Server Error" while downloading WSDL file of custom web service.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio-Open Solution-Right click your custom webservice-Select Download WSDL-Error "ProtocolError" shows up-OR-Go to fronted UI-Go to Application and user management(BYD)/Administration(C4C) Work Center-Go to your Communication Arrangement view-Select your custom web service-Click Download WSDL Button-Dump "500 SAP Internal Server Error" shows up-Cause-Your BAC element is missing in your PDI solution, so this custom web service is not scoped in the tenant.-Resolution-Open your PDI Solution in Cloud Applications Studio -Create BAC element-Right-click solution-> deploy business configuration-Scope your solution in the fronted UI by scoping your BC question-Wait few minutes-Try to download this WSDL file from cloud applications studio/fronted UI-Keywords-ProtocolError; Protocol error; download WSDL; web service; ws

Title: Renewal Rule is Not Editable on Customer Contract Item
Content: Symptom-You have selected a Renewal Rule in the contract header, it copies into the items. But you find Renewal Rule field in the Item level is grayed out, you are not able to remove it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2005 onwards-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Find the contract ABC and go to General - Renewal and Cancellation tab. Renewal Rule <XYZ> is maintained.-Go to the Items tab, select one line, the Renewal Rule is filled with <XYZ> as well, but it is grayed out. -ABC represent the ID of a contract, XYZ represents the ID of a renewal rule.-Cause-In the renewal rule <XYZ>, you have selected Create New Contract' option. In this case, the rule will renewal the entire contract, hence the change on item level is not allowed. If the option of 'Create New Contract' is not selected in the renewal rule, it is possible to remove the renewal rule on item level.-To check the Renewal Rule settings.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts, Open it.-Click Maintain renewal rules.-Select one rule, You can see the detailed settings, for example, if the Create New Contraction option is selected.-Resolution- This is currently the designed behavior of Contract Item Renewal.-Keywords-Renewal; Contract Item; Renewal Rule; 2005 new feature

Title: Net Sales Revenue and Invoiced Net Revenue Does not Match Between Invoice Volume and Profit Overview By Key Figure Reports
Content: Symptom-In an Earned Profit analysis, you are comparing the Net Sales Revenue key figure from the Profit Overview By Key Figure report with the Invoiced Net Revenue key figure form the Invoice Volume report. However, the amounts do not match.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open the Profit Overview by Key Figure report.-Open the Invoice Volume report.-Apply the selection that matches in both reports (company, product category, Time Frame, Accounting Period/Year).-You see that the Net Sales Revenue and Invoiced Net Revenue do not match.-Cause-Among different reasons that could cause a difference between these reports, there are:-The related customer invoice remains as an unposted source document or has an associated process communication error.-The Profit Overview by Key Figure is based in the accounting period/year of the invoice's journal entry, while the Invoice Volume is based on the invoice's time frame. If these dates are different in the invoice, it will cause differences between the reports. Hence, if you are running both reports for e.g. April but you have an invoice with Document Date also in April but posting Date in May, the Invoice Volume considers this invoice but the same is now shown in the Profit Overview by key Figure. The invoice will be accounted in the Profit overview by Key Figure when the selection is made for May, since it considers the Account Period/year.-The invoice may be present in both the Invoice Volume report and in the Profit Overview by Key Figure, nevertheless the invoice amount is in blank in the key figure Net Sales Revenue, even though it is present in other key figures from the Profit Overview by Key Figure report. Since you are comparing the Net Sales Revenue with the Invoice Sales Revenue and the Net Sales Revenue shows in blank for a specific invoice, a difference is noticed. The way the amounts are populated in the Profit Overview by Key Figure depends on the setup of the contribution margin scheme and the functional area assignment (for Earned Profit Analysis) to the G/L Account in the journal entry of the customer invoice. In this case, the posting of the concerned invoice has derived a functional area e.g. 1000 - Cost of goods sold (or other functional area not mapped to Net Revenue), which is generally displayed under key figure of Cost of Goods Sold and not as Net Revenue.-Resolution-To narrow down to where exactly is the difference between the reports, you may add in both reports the Company, Product Category, Product and Invoice characteristics. Use the same time period in both reports, that is, the Time Frame selection in the Invoice Volume shall correspond to the same time period (coverage of the same days) as the Accounting Period/Year selection in the Profit Overview by Key Figure report.-Based on that, you may select by e.g. Product Category in both reports and check the amounts. Select a product category whose amount do not match and add the Product ID characteristic. Check the amounts for the products of that specific product category. Select a product whose amount do not match and add the Invoice characteristic. Compare the list of invoices for that specific Product and Product Category combination in both the Invoice Volume and Profit Overview by Key Figure reports to find which invoices are causing the difference.-Once you find the invoice(s) causing the difference, refer to the possible causes mentioned in the above section.-For the above mentioned case a), you may follow below steps:-Go to General Ledger view.-Go to Source Documents subview.-Search for the invoice and check whether it is an unposted source document or not.-If it is an unposted source document, refer to the related error message in order to post it. If the invoice is not an unposted source document:-In this same work center view, change the filter to show all documents and search by the invoice ID.-If you find the document, refer to case b).-If you do not find the document via General Ledger work center, open it through e.g. Customer invoicing -> Invoice Documents work center.-Open the invoice and go to Document Flow tab. You see a red icon with an exclamation mark (Process Communication Error) in the blue object that represents the invoice.-Open an incident to support for the process communication error be analyzed.-For case b), you may follow below steps:-Open the concerned invoice ID.-Refer to the Document Date. This date is considered in the selection by Time Frame via Invoice Volume report.-Go to Document Flow tab and open the journal entry for this invoice.-Refer to the Posting Date in the journal entry. This posting date is considered in the selection by Accounting Period/year via Profit Overview by Key Figure report.-Therefore, if the dates (Document Date and Posting Date) are different and correspond to different accounting periods, you experience the difference in the reports, based on the explained behavior in the above section.-For case c), you may follow below steps:-Open the journal entry of the concerned invoice.-Highlight the journal entry items and check to which functional area the posting has occurred.-The functional areas are determined based on the G/L Account mapping made in Business Configuration or based on Cost Center. Depending on the determined functional area as well as depending on the structure items of the contribution margin scheme, the amounts will be assigned to a specific key figure. The contribution margin scheme specifies the calculation of the key figures in the Profit Overview by Key Figure report. You identify a structure item as a key figure by assigning fixed structure items to the node. For more details, please refer to help documentation Settings for Earned Profit Analysis – Configuration Guide.-See Also-Profit Overview by Key Figure-Settings for Earned Profit Analysis – Configuration Guide.-2052832 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports-2177622 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports for Order / Invoice Profit-Keywords-Net Amount. Invoice Profit, Order Profit, Earner Profit, Profit Type, Invoice Volume, Profit Overview, Net Revenue.

Title: Not Possible To Enhance Form With Custom Node
Content: Symptom-You extended a Standard BO(Business Object) on SAP Cloud Applications Studio by creating a Custom Node and some Extension Fields within this Node.-Now you are trying to add these fields to a Form by "Enhance Form" option on Studio.-The fields from the Custom Node are not visible within Enhance Form tool to be extended to the form.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer -SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Reproducing the Issue-Phase 1 - Create a BO Extension and create a Custom Node inside of it.-Phase 2 - Follow these steps:-1. Right-Click on the BO you extended-2. Click on Enhance Form-3. You will see the Extension Fields from your Custom Node are not listed-Cause-You cannot see the fields from your Custom Node while Enhancing a Form because this is not allowed to add Extension Fields from a Custom Node to a Form.-Only the Extension Fields created in the Root Node of the BO will be available while enhancing the form.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Keywords-Custom Node; Enhance Form; Extension BO; Form; Custom; BO;

Title: Profit Overview by Key Figure Report: Sales Quantity is Zero
Content: Symptom-The Sales Quantity key figure has zero value in the Profit Overview by Key Figure report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the Profit Overview by Key Figure report.-Enter mandatory data, such as Profit Type, Company and Contribution Margin Scheme and execute the report.-Notice that Sales Quantity is zero, even though Net Sales Revenue and Counter key figures are higher than zero.-Cause-The Sales Quantity is shown as zero because the values are picked from the associated journal entries. There is quantity coming in from goods issue and also from customer invoice. Since the quantity from customer invoice is negative, these quantities add up to zero.-Resolution-The report works as designed. To have Sales Quantity amount displayed (both the negative and positive quantities), further characteristics can be added to the report, like Functional Area, for example.-Keywords-profit overview by key figure; FINPRFU30_Q0002; sales quantity; functional area

Title: Employee Time Recording From Previous Year With Status In Approval Shall be Removed
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to delete employee time postings from previous years with status: In Approval-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Reproducing the Issue on the Time Administration work center:-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select Employees sub view-Find an employee-Click on Edit-Go to the Employee Times tab-Select the relevant date range-Filter for status In Approval-Reproducing the issue on the Project Management work center:-Navigate to Project Management work center-Choose the Approvals view-Choose the Time Recordings subview-As project manager, try to approve or reject the time recordings against a project.-Select Save-Error: Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes (where  DD.MM.YYYY represents the date)-Cause-It is advisable to approve times in a timely fashion, as the times are awaiting an action from the employee’s manager or project manager,  and the times could have an impact on project times, employee time account balance etc..-Resolution-It is not possible to remove the times, neither in the UI nor in the backend. But it is possible to filter out the very old In Approval times on the Time Admin > Employee Time Records view.-Go to the Time Administration work center-Go to the Employee Time Records sub view-Select category Pending Approval from the Employee Time Recording drop down list-Open Advanced Filter by clicking on the filter icon-Select Free Selection in the Time Period Selection drop down list-Save Query--Once the parameters are set (as per your requirements), the filter can be saved as a query and defaulted as the query to be launched on opening the view.-Similar advanced filtering is generally available on other views, including Approvals: Time Recordings view on the Project Management work center.-However, the approval for non-project time recordings does not allow this filtering, except at column level where a pattern for a date or a year can be set, showing only times In Approval for that specific date/year pattern.-Keywords-Financial accounting is closed;  time postings in status in Approval; Arbeitszeitgenehmigung,  Financial accounting is closed on DD.MM.YYYY. Change not permitted; close screen. Accounting-relevant data would also be changed. Check whether you can enter time confirmation without accounting attributes

Title: Externally Fulfilled Sales Order In Process But You Expect it to be Completed
Content: Symptom-You have a Sales Order with Externally Fulfilled items which you expect the status to be Completed, however, it is still In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order number).-Navigate to the Items tab.-You notice that for one or more of the Items with External Fulfillment, the delivery status is still In Process.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-You notice that Purchase Order DEF (DEF represents the Purchase Order number) has been created, but no Third-Party Delivery Notification is present.-Cause-For a Sales Order to be Completed, you need to have both Fulfillment and Invoicing statuses as Completed.- In this case, the Third Party Delivery Notification will allow the Fulfillment to be completed, and also allow you to proceed with Invoicing of the document in order to complete the Invoicing status.-Resolution-Navigate to the Third-Party Order Fulfillment work center.-Open the Third-Party Purchase Orders view.-Select Purchase Order DEF.-Click the New Third-Party Delivery Notification button.-Provide the necessary information.-Click Check Consistency to check that the details of the delivery notification are consistent with the corresponding Purchase Order.-Once the consistency status is consistent, click Release.-See Also-Quick Guide for Third-Party Purchase Orders-reference KBA:2852086 - Third party Inter Company Scenario-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Third-Party, Fulfillment

Title: Not Possible to Add TaxCalculationItem Into a Custom Web Service
Content: Symptom-You created a Custom Web Service within SAP Cloud Applications Studio and you are trying to add the element TaxCalculationItem to this Web Service.-You are able to check the box of the TaxCalculationItem and save/activate it. Once you close and open the Web Service again you will notice that TaxCalculationItem checkbox is not checked anymore.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open your Custom Solution.-Open the file where you created the Web Service. E.g: "/YXXXXXXXY_MAIN/SRC/Extension/SupplierInvoice/SupplierInvoice.webservice".-Add the Node "TaxCalculationItem".-Save and Activate the web service.-Close the file.-Re-open the file and note that the Node TaxCalculationItem is unchecked.-Cause-The element TaxCalculationItem is an association to a DO(Dependent Object) and selection of elements of a DO is not permitted.-Since this element does not contain any sub elements, it is not saved to the backend and thus during reopen it is not selected.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system.-Development Team is working to enhance the tool in a way this kind of elements won't be available into the Web Services if they are not allowed to be add.-Keywords-TaxCalculationItem; SDK; Web Service; Dependent Object; DO;

Title: How to Use Boolean Operators in Custom Key Figures
Content: Symptom-You want to create new custom key figures and need to have more information on Boolean Operators.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Boolean Operators in your system-AND-EQ-GE-GT-LE-LT-NE-NOT-OR-XOR-LEAF-AND-AND is a logical operator which will return the Boolean value 1 (when it’s true) if all involved analyzed operands are true, otherwise it will return the value 0.-Example: AND(GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”, “Criteria1”)), GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared2”,”Criteria2”))-EQ-The logical operator EQ will analyze if a value or key figure is equal to a previously specified value or key figure.-Example: EQ(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”,”Criteria1”).-GE-The logical operator GE will analyze if a value or key figure is greater than or equal to a previously specified value or key figure.-Example: GE(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”,”Criteria1”).-GT-The logical operator GT will analyze if a value or key figure is greater than a previously specified value or key figure.-Example: GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”,”Criteria1”).-LE-The logical operator LE will analyze if a value or key figure is less than or equal to a previously specified value or key figure.-Example: LE(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”,”Criteria1”).- LT-The logical operator LT will analyze if a value or key figure is less than a previously specified value or key figure.-Example: LT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”,”Criteria1”).- NE-The logical operator NE will analyze if a value or key figure is not equal to a previously specified value or key figure.-Example: NE(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”,”Criteria1”).- NOT-NOT is a negation logical complement and it has to be used with other logical operators. Its single formula is NOT(“Criteria”).-Example: AND(NOT(GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”, “Criteria1”)),NOT(GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared2”,”Criteria2”)))- OR-OR is a logical operator which will return the Boolean value 1 (when it’s true) if at least one of the involved analyzed operands is true, otherwise it will return the value 0.-Example: OR(GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”, “Criteria1”)), GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared2”,”Criteria2”))- XOR-XOR is also called as exclusive or, it returns true only if one of the analyzed criteria is true and the other one is false.-Example: XOR(GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared1”, “Criteria1”)), GT(“ValueOrKeyFigureToBeCompared2”,”Criteria2”))- LEAF-LEAF Boolean operator is used to define hierarchy in the report. It will be started as 0 for the root node and proceeding downward to a leaf. The value for the result rows will be zero, while the elementary row (the last one in the hierarchy) will be shown as 1.-This operator can help you to have several types of calculation on result rows and elementary rows. Also, the result row will be always 0 if your report is not displayed in hierarchy.-See Also-Further information on Boolean Operators is available on our SAP Help Portal for SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP Business by Design.-Keywords-key figures, boolean operators, custom key figure, help portal, new key figures

Title: Scanned Supplier Invoice/Credit Memo goes into exception with missing data
Content: Symptom-Supplier invoices and credit memos are created via the Scanning feature through the collaboration window but the newly created documents go into exception as none of the data from the original document is populated.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-A new invoice or credit memo is created through the Collaboration Window.-Upon checking the newly created invoice, it appears in exception.-The exceptions relate to the many missing relevant details in spite of their presence in the original PDF file.-Cause-The Collaboration Window settings are incorrect and as a result, only the PDF file is uploaded and not the txt file that the system requires to recognize the data.-As a result, the newly created document is missing critical data.-Resolution-The Collaboration Window Invoice Scanning Settings must be checked:-Open the Collaboration Window.-Click Menu / Settings / Invoice Scanning.-In the Invoice Scanning Settings window, check that the "Only upload PDF files" option is not selected.-Also make sure that the "Enable service Scanned Invoices" is selected.-Keywords-Scanned Invoice, Missing data.

Title: Blocked/Obsolete Suppliers are Still Available in Service Agents but not in Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-You have blocked/obsolete some Suppliers in the system. You have observed that these blocked Suppliers are still available in the Value Help while assigning to a Service Agent. But these Suppliers are not available in the Value Help of Purchase Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Service Agent view.-Create New Service agent.-In the value help for Supplier, the blocked Supplier is available.-Go to Purchase Orders work center.-Select Purchase Orders view.-Create New Purchase Order.-In the value help for Supplier, the blocked Supplier is not available.-Cause-We handle the Business Partner lifecycle status in different ways for transactional processes and the master data maintenance. In transactional processes obsolete and blocked business partners are not allowed (therefore they don't appear in a value help (i.e.-purchase order)).--In the master data maintenance. we don't consider the status (i.e. status of supplier in service agent screen). Reason for this is an user might want to maintain his master data first and change the lifecycle status of the supplier back to active afterwards.--Resolution-The system is designed in a way that usage of Business Partner (Supplier) will not consider the status. Because It might be that you want to complete the data of a blocked/obsolete account before you unblock/active that again.--Here is the evaluation of status of Business Partner (Supplier):--In Preparation: It is not possible to use the Business Partner in any other business transaction documents.--Active: All business documents are allowed to create references with this status value. This status value is a prerequisite for the consistency of the reference.--Blocked: Business documents are only allowed to create new references with this status when they can save inconsistent data.--In contrast, if the Business documents which already have a reference to a meanwhile blocked Business Partner can finish their process / do not need to change their behavior.--Obsolete: It is not allowed to create references to Business Partner with this status because the intention of this status value is that the Business partner gets archived.--In the upcoming release, the status of the Business Partner will be displayed in the value help pop-up.-See Also- 2889470 - Blocked/Obsolete Supplier is used in Purchasing Documents

Title: Data Not Supported When Uploading Journal Entry Vouchers
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload journal entry vouchers via web service, nevertheless the web service call gets rejected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Input and output Management -> Business Communication Monitoring view.-Show: Rejected Web Service Calls and click Go.-You'll see error messages due to technical error, as follows: Message "data{}" not supported (interface: "ACCOUNTINGENTRYREPLICATIONIN" binding key: "00163E030FC91EE29B819C1771304C69")-Cause-You are using the wrong web service for this upload. The service interface that you are using, II_FIA_ACC_REPLIC_ACC_ENTRY_IN, is used by the excel add-in to upload journal entry vouchers from the excel.-Resolution-For more information about the correct webservice and also to download the WSDL file, please go to:-Application and User Management work center-Input and Output Management -> Service explorer-Search for Create journal entries.

Title: The Customer Information is not Copied from the Contract to the Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-The Customer Information is not copied from the Contract to the Service Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-From the Common Task, select the New Contract.-In the New Contract screen within the General tab maintain all the mandatory information.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-Add product LMN (where LMN is the item of type: Service - time and material).-Scroll down to the Details section of product LMN.-Navigate to the Notes subtab.-Under the section Customer Information maintain the value.-Save the Contract.-The Contract ABC is created (where ABC is the Contract ID).-Click the Submit button.-Select the Release option to release the Contract.-Click the Edit button for the Contract ABC.-Click the Submit button and select Confirm Execution.-In the New Service Confirmation screen click on the View All button and go to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Click on the Add Row button.-Add the Reference Contract/Item.-Navigate to the Notes subtab under Details.-You will see the Customer Information maintained in Contract ABC is missing in this reference Service Confirmation.-Cause-The Customer Information maintained in the Item of a Contract used to not be copied to the Service Confirmation up until the 2002 release of the system. From 2002 onwards, this was fixed.-Resolution-For Service Confirmations created before the 2002 release of the system, this is the expected behaviour. For Service Confirmations created after 2002, this is no longer the case and the Customer Information will be copied to the Service Confirmation.-Keywords-Contract, Service Confirmation, Customer Information

Title: Counter of Data Source Shows More Records in C4C/ByD Compared to BW
Content: Symptom-You have extracted a data source to a system other than C4C/ByD and you have noticed the counter is not showing the same figure as your system.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Go to Design Data Sources.-Search for your data source e.g. Account Contact Data (technical ID BPCSCONTB).-Click on Preview and run the data source.-You will notice the counter shows something like 150000.-Now you extract this data source to your BW system.-You notice that the counter shows considerably less than the system. -Cause-The counter in some data sources where no characteristic is selected may include additional records which are required for access restriction. This is the reason why an unrestricted user would see all records which may be more than the total number of counted entries.-For example: This type of behavior can be seen in the standard data source Account Contact Data.-This type of behavior can be seen in the Business Warehouse/BW system.-Resolution-In order to get a correct count please select the relevant characteristics - the count will change based on selected characteristics and reflect the correct number of entries.-Keywords-BPCSCONTB, counter, BW, less, data source, design data sources, preview

Title: MT940 UK Bank Statement Upload Stuck With Status In Process
Content: Symptom-The upload of a bank statement with format MT940 UK gets stuck with status In Process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Opel File ID AAA (AAA means the File ID) with status In Process.-Notice that the file has Import Format MT940 UK and has been In Process for quite some time (at least for one hour).-Cause-Among other possible reasons, the issue might be caused due to the usage of tags 60a and 62a for initial and closing balance, respectively.-The initial balance and closing balance tags recognized by the system for MT940 UK are 60F and 62F, only.-Resolution-The bank statement file should be amended by substituting tags 60a and 62a by 60F and 62F, respectively.-Keywords-mt940 uk; bank statement; inbound file; 60a; 62a; 60f; 62f
