Title: Exchange Rates Template: The Value '' of The Field 'Valid From' is Invalid
Content: Symptom-You cannot upload New Exchange rate Excel due to the error message:- "The value '' of the field 'Valid From' is invalid."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Open the Microsoft Excel file you want to upload.-Navigate to the SAP Business ByDesign tab.-Login to SAP Business ByDesign from Microsoft Excel.-Click Save Data to.-You get the error message "The value '' of the field 'Valid From' is invalid."-Resolution-For solving the issue, you need to download a fresh exchange rate template and fill in the details by typing them in (do not copy paste).-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Microsoft Office® Template Maintenance subview in the Business Flexibility view.-Search and select the "New Exchange Rates" template.-Click Download.-Open the Microsoft Excel file New Exchange Rates.-Enter the data by typing in.-Click Save.-Navigate to the SAP Business ByDesign tab.-Login to SAP Business ByDesign from Microsoft Excel.-Click Save Data to.-The File is uploaded without any issues.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Edit Exchange Rates subview in the Common Tasks view.-The new exchange rates are visible.-Keywords-new exchange rate; currency conversion; template

Title: Excel Report Time Out errors
Content: Symptom-This documentation explains the points to be considered when it comes to Excel Report errors caused by a time-out during:  the report execution, by Inserting the Report via Excel Add in or when Refresh via Excel add in.-Most common error messages: -Unexpected error in server communication-Unexpected error during backend processing-Out of Memory Exception-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Some Use Cases-Point 1:  Sometimes the excel report works fine and sometimes it doesn’t. Why?-                Just a matter of few KBs extra could create a difference. Number of rows alone is not the culprit; even more columns can make the data set larger.-Point 2: How many Rows is acceptable to Insert or Run a Excel report without the mentioned errors ?-For the same reason as Point 1, we cannot give a benchmark figure which says more than XX rows. It really depends on the data.-Point 3: Why do we not have an official documentation in the system which can precise or set the boundaries of Data Volume that cannot be viewed in an excel report?-                We cannot document this just as X MB of data volume, because this also depends on the client configuration. If there is a big RAM capacity, it's possible to process more XML data.- So it all depends on the OS and the RAM and how much bulk allocation of RAM the system allows.-Point 4: Is there any plan to make such documentation available?-The development has agreed that we should have a benchmark and threshold document with all these parameters involved. We plan to make the excel Add in better by chunking the data in multiple calls so that end user could not frequently see this issue.-Cause-The large amount of data being fetched might leads to Time Out in the system response, as consequence the Excel Add-In throws an error. In such cases, the Excel add-in usually cannot handle such huge data, by resulting in memory exception.-Resolution-You can prevent the dump by using the Paging option. As consequence, the result rendering is very quick and the response time is improved. You may also need to reduce the report data by adding variables in the report selection.-With custom reports, it may be necessary to adjust the design to ensure optimal performance. Please check the KBA 2366796 for suggestions.-See Also-2143214 - Error When Opening Excel Workbook-2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling Data Sources and Reports - Performance-Keywords-Message was: The remote server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error; Unexpected error in server communication; session needs to be closed; Exception System.Net.WebException; excel report, add-in, addin, time out, excel performance, business analytics-unexpected error in server communication,session needs to be closed

Title: Item Product Description is Missing in your Sales Document such as Sales Order or Service Order Although Maintained in the Product Master Data
Content: Symptom-The item product description is missing in the Sales Document such as a Sales Order or Service Order although it is maintained in product master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to any Sales Document such as Sales Quote, Sales Order, Service Quote, Service Order etc. We will use Sales Orders as an example.-Product Description is missing:-Go to the Sales Orders work center and the Sales Orders view.-Select the sales order and press the Edit button.-Navigate to the Items tab and enter a product ABC (ABC represents the product number). Here you can see that the description for the product ABC is missing, although it's maintained in the product master data.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center and the Products view.-Find the product ABC and here you can see that the description is maintained.-Cause-You can maintain the product description in different languages. The language of item product description displayed in the sales order is the same as the communication language defined for the account in the sales order. The default communication language defined for the account XYZ in this sales order is L1 (XYZ represents the number of the account and L1 represents the respective Language). However, you only maintained the description for the product ABC in language L2. Therefore, no product description in language L1 can be found.-Resolution-Either change the communication language of the account or maintain the product description in the language of the account.-How to maintain product description in different languages:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center and the Products view.-Select the product ABC and press the Edit button.-Press the View All button and navigate to the Other Languages tab in the General tab.-Add the product description in the required language.-Please note: If you change the language in the Account Master Data this will only apply to new created Sales or Service Orders.-Keywords-Sales Order; Service Order; Quote; Opportunity; Invoice; Description; missing; empty; not filled; no description

Title: In a Service Order the Error "Products w/ item group Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) not supported for location of srv provision" is Triggered
Content: Symptom-When creating a service order, you receive either of the following error message:-Products w/ item group Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) not supported for location of srv provision.-Products w/ item group Product – delivery-based not supported for location of srv provision On-Site-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to Service Order processing View-Search and edit any Service Order-Click in the View all Button-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts-Enter the respective product -One of the below error messages is triggered :-Products w/ item group Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) not supported for location of srv provision-Products w/ item group Product – delivery-based not supported for location of srv provision On-Site-Cause-You have defined multiple distribution channels for the sales unit.-Resolution-In a Service Order  if  you have defined multiple distribution channels for a sales unit, the system will always take the first  entry in the master data. If you would like to ensure that the Item Type XX will be determined you need to select the respective Sales Organization and Distribution channel for which in the Product Master Data the Item Group XX (XX represents the item type) has been defined.-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Create new Service Order via Common Tasks view.-Enter the respective Account.-Press the view all button.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoicing sub tab.-Enter the respective Sales Unit.-Select the Distribution Channel.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts.-Enter the respective product.-The Item Type XX will now be determined by the system and the error will not appear.-Keywords-Service Order; not supported; item group; SHIP; NORM

Title: Migration of Bill of Exchange (Receivables) documents (from legacy system)
Content: Symptom-Migration of Bill of Exchange documents from legacy systems are currently not directly supported.-In case you already migrated Bill of Exchange documents and cannot process them as Bill of Exchange documents, please revert them and use the described work around.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Migrated Bill of Exchange Documents cannot be processed any further as usual when compared to in the ByD system created Bill of Exchange documents.-Cause-Migration of Bill of Exchange documents from legacy systems and their further processing in ByDesign are currently not directly supported.-  Background information-Bill of Exchange documents are special receivables and are posted to a special G/L account. This can be seen in the Customer Account Monitor in the General Monitor.-In the “Trade Receivables” tab, the Bill of Exchange documents are not visible in the standard Invoices / Payments as they are not standard receivable documents, check sub-tab “Postings“ for them.-During Migration of Customer Invoices (CI) rsp. Bill of Exchange documents, these are therefore also handled differently in regards to G/L accounts:-Document G/L account - Debit G/L account - Credit-Migrated CI  411100 - Customer of goods/services 892010 - Initial Data Carry Forward Accounts Receivable-Migrated BoE 413000 - Customer Bill of exchange 892010 - Initial Data Carry Forward Accounts Receivable-Note: G/L account for migrated accounts receivable are the same, no matter whether BoE or CI, as only one G/L account can be defined for those migrated accounts receivable! (see also BC Chart of Account, Account Determination view)-Also note that these are example G/L accounts, they can be differing from your account set-up.-Resolution-Current inconsistencies arising during the dedicated migration of Bill of Exchange documents may be overcome by a workaround that warrants consistency of all associated G/L postings and customer account status. Bill of Exchange documents will be re-generated and the standard payment and clearing process including handling of contingent liabilities for these documents may thus be executed. We recommend the following steps:-1. Reversal of Migrated BoE  (only relevant if BoE documents have been generated via the dedicated migration process for Bill of Exchange already)-2. Migration of BoEs with different migration type  “Open Items Receivable”-3. “Converting” these as CI migrated BoE documents to Bill of Exchange documents in the ByD system – via manual payment with payment method “Bill of Exchange Receivable”….-Please see attached document for more details.-  NOTE: This is also recommended for Bill of Exchange documents Payables, in this case please check for the corresponding handling as SRM documents.-

Title: How to Activate Additional Overall Discount
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Customer is requesting the activation of "Additional Overall Discount" Price Components, as described in KBA 2891573.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Open the system and navigate to the Business Configuration activity "Configure Price Strategy".-Open Pricing Procedure.-Steps 111 (Standard Pricing Procedure) and 170 (Gross Pricing) have to be set to No Display/Print for all options:-Save the changes.-Open the Backend, and select Transaction BCTADM.-Copy the Workspace ID of the current Implementation Project:-Open Backendtransaction BCE.-Query for the determined Workspace ID.-Activate Edit Mode and open Scoping (with Question):-Extend the menu to find Additional Over Discount and check the box:-Save your changes and activate the workspace.-Check in the Configure Price Strategy for the following new steps:---Once the price components are visible in the Configure Price Strategy, Additional Overall Discount is scoped and can be used.-Keywords-Additional Overall Discount, Activation, Scoping,

Title: Pricing Components Are Not Available in Item Level for Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You expect to have the steps 071 and 072 maintained in Pricing Procedure of the Configure Price Startegy activity available in the Item Level of a Sales Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the New Manual Invoice common task.-Add the Account ABC (ABC represents the Account ID).-Add the Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-In the Item Level, click on Add Row button.-You expect to see the fields maintained for Steps 071 and 072 available.-However, they are not available.-Cause-There's a scoping question "Do you want additional surcharges at document level?", once this is scoped for "Yes", you will have five additional lines for Surcharges.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the activity Configure Price Strategy.-Select Pricing Procedure.-You will be able to check the steps 071, 072, 073, 074, 076.-These Surcharges are Header Level Price Components and, therefore, making their Item Display option as "Yes" won't allow you to manually add them at Item Level.-Item Display option as "Yes" means that once you have them at the Header level, you can see their distribution across the items.-If you set the Header Display option of these components to "Yes", you can add them to the Header Level and if the Item Display option is also "Yes" you can see the distribution on the items.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-In case you need the Price Components on Item Level, the Step 014 (Item Level Surcharge) of Pricing Procedure of Configure Price Strategy can be used in this way.-See Also-2461886 - Price Component Surcharge Cannot be Selected in the Total Pricing Section of a Sales Order or Service Order-Keywords-Surcharge, Item Level, Pricing Procedure, Configure Price Strategy; Price Component

Title: Error Message: Maintain Conversions Between UoMs XXX and YYY
Content: Symptom-You are unable to make a change to a particular material. An error occurs. Error: Maintain conversions between UoMs XXX and YYY (while XXX and YYY are different quantity units).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Click on By Materials view-Search for the relevant material-Click on Edit-Make any change to the material-Click on Save-Cause-A possible cause could be that the quantity type was added to the material. It can be also added via a partner add-on or a web service. It can be seen in the tab Changes. The system expects a conversion of all other units available on this product master data to this UoM, because it has been added to the quantity unit association.-Resolution-You need to check how this UoM was added to the quantity unit of the material and then remove it via the same method.-Keywords-Making adjustments in material master, maintain conversion between UoMs, not able to find the UoM maintained,

Title: Error Message: "Item AA: No suitable template found for entitlement XYZ, distribution chain XX."
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order and the document gets inconsistent due to an error: "Item AA: No suitable template found for entitlement XYZ, distribution chain XX."-AA represents the line item ID.-XYZ represents the entitlement ID.-XX represents the distribution chain code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for: ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click on Edit button.-The following error message appears: Item AA: No suitable template found for entitlement XYZ, distribution chain XX.-Cause-Once you add an entitlement of Item Group ETCS – Entitlements in Contract Sales, a related Contract Template is determined and a contract automatically created when you release the sales order.-It means that, it's necessary to create a Contract Template with the entitlement of Item Group ETCS.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contract Templates view.-Click on New button, then Contract Template. -In the General tab:-Add the Entitlement in the field: Sold via Entitlement-Add the Sales Unit and Distribution Channel.-Note that, this Item Group ETCS is not supported in the Items tab of Contract Template-See Also-Help Document - Services-Help Document - Sell a Contract in a Sales Order-Keywords-Entitlement, Sales Order, Contract, Contract Template, ETCS

Title: Duplicated Column Label on Form Template
Content: Symptom-You edited the form template using Easy Form Editor and added a new column, after add this new column, the label of the column has been duplicated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management.-Form Template Maintenance.-Open template ABC (ABC is a form template on list).-Click on Open > Easy Form Editor.-Go to Table > Columns.-Click on Add.-Cause-The possible cause of the issue, is that a caption has been added to this column header. This inconsistency can be caused by editing the template using Easy Form Editor.-Resolution-You can confirm it by this steps:-Downloading the template.-Open with Adobe LiveCycle Designer.-Select the column header.-Go to Layout tab, on right pane.-On Caption section, it should be set as None. -In case it has any other value set there, change it to None and upload the template again.-See Also-KBA 1849768 - Table in Form Gets Distorted When Editing Using Easy form Editor.-How to start edit a form with Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer.-Keywords-Columns Form Template, Duplicated Label, Easy Form.

Title: Payment Allocation from Bank Statements when employing Payment Run
Content: Symptom-You pay open invoices employing the Payment Run, e.g.:  in Work Center Payables. Subsequently you enter bank statements reflecting those payments. This document describes how to allocate those transactions in the resulting payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Payment allocations are created after a bank statement is entered either manually or automatically and posted.-Those can be accessed either via the bank statement itself or in the work center Payment Management.-Liquidity Management:-Go to work center Payment Management.-Select the relevant posted bank statement.-In the column Postprocessing, follow the link Required.-Payment Management:-Go to work center Payment Management.-Navigate to view Payment Allocation.-Select the relevant payment allocation of type 'Bank Statement'.-Cause-In case the invoices have been paid already (e.g.: by executing a payment run and sending a bank file) it has to be avoided to generate a new payment when posting the bank statement. In this case transactions in bank statement lines rather have to be allocated to the corresponding payments already entered in the system. This can be done once a payment generated by a payment run is in status 'In Transfer'. There are several ways to achieve a proper payment allocation depending on the applied business process.-Resolution-Payment Allocation while entering a manual bank statement.-In case bank statements are entered manually you have the possibility to allocate existing payments during the entering process. You can however also access and perform the payment allocation after the relevant statement lines are entered or the statement is posted.-Go to work center Liquidity Management, view Bank Statements.-Via the button New you have the possibility to enter a new bank statement.-In step 2 of the creation wizard you have the option to select relevant existing payments from the list All Not Confirmed Items in Transit.-In step 3 Create and Edit Items those transactions are transferred in the bank statement line for editing.-In case the bank transaction is equal to the selected payment no further post-processing is required and the affected payment will be in status 'confirmed'.-In case automatic bank statements are posted and no automatic payment allocation has been performed you can either enter the payment allocation via the bank statement line itself or in work center Payment Management. The same applies for manual bank statements where a payment allocation hasn't already been performed as outlined above.-Upon entering the payment allocation the tab Payment Assignment is opened by default.-Depending on the specifics of the transaction existing candidate payments in status 'in Transfer' are shown in the grid according to the applied payment method specified in the choose-from-list.-Select the relevant payment and drag it in the grid below using the arrow. (You can un-select the payment by using the opposite arrow).-You can post the payment allocation when the Open Amount is zero.-If necessary you also have the possibility to allocate payment differences or even the entire amount not as Payment Assignment but as payment on account via the tab Customer/Supplier or other allocation via the tabs Bank Charges and Interests or Other Allocation.-    See Also-Kontoauszug; Zahlung; Zahlungszuordnung; Lastschrift; direct debit; payment; payment allocation; bank statement.

Title: User is Able to Change Open and Close Periods even though No Write Access to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies
Content: Symptom-You have set up the user's access rights with no write access, only read access, to work center view Sets of Books and Assigned Companies. Nevertheless, the user is still able to make changes to Open and Close Periods.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for the related user and click Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to Access Restrictions tab. -Find work center view ID FIN_COMPANIES (Sets of Books and Assigned Companies).-You see the Write Access is set to 'No Access'. Nevertheless, the user is able to make changes to Open and Close Periods.-Cause-The write access restriction is set to FIN_COMPANIES only. The Work center views FIN_CLOSINGCOCKPITGL (Closing Cockpit) and FIN_COMPANIES (Sets of books and assigned companies) are dependent, if you restrict access for FIN_COMPANIES but not for FIN_CLOSINGCOCKPITGL, then this will over-ride the first access restriction, as it's the same screen under both views.-Resolution-if you wish to restrict the access to Open and Close Periods, you also need to set the access restriction to work center view FIN_CLOSINGCOCKPITGL.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Open and Close Periods. Sets of Books. Access Restrictions. You are not authorized to change the data. No Access.

Title: How to find the responsible Application Component for an Enhancement Implementation (BADI)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-This Knowledge Base Article will show how to find for the responsible application component of an Enhancement Implementation (BADI = Business Add In).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Partners can create an enhancement implementation of a SAP enhancement option (BADI) to allow their customers to apply business rules that meet specific requirements, for example, country-specific requirements, without modifying the standard functionality of the SAP cloud product. An enhancement implementation consists of a message definition, a filter, and a script file.-Enhancement Implementations (BADIs) are provided by SAP and the Application teams are responsible for the further usage of the BADI.-Resolution-Log into the back-end of the relevant system.-Enter the XREP transaction code-Expand the Development folder and navigate through the PDI solution folders until you locate the .enht file (The partner should provide the repository path for this on the SDK)-Double click the .enht file and click on the XML tab-Copy the content of the tag <EnhancementSpotProxyName>-Enter the SE20 transaction code-Select the Enhancement Spot option and paste the content in the OVS field-Click the Display icon in the Enhancement: Initial Screen window-Click on Attributes tab and double click in the package content-Check for the Application Component responsible for this BADI-See Also-You can check for more details regarding BADI in the KBA 2658366.-Keywords-BADI, Enhancement, Option, Implementation, Spot, Business Add In, SDK, Cloud Application Studio, development, component

Title: How to Update the Quantity of a Sales Order with PATCH Operation in Postman
Content: Symptom-You don't know how to update the quantity of a sales order with PATCH operation in Postman, even though the sales order is in a consistent state.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The sequence of steps to update the item schedule line in postman is as follows:-GET Call to get objects ID of the item: https://<Tenant URL>/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/YYY/SalesOrderCollection('XXX')/Item (where YYY is the name of the Custom OData Service and XXX is the Object ID)-GET Call to get the object ID of the item schedule line: https://<Tenant URL>/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/YYY/ItemCollection('XXX')/ItemScheduleLine-PATCH Call to update the quantity: https://<Tenant URL>/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/YYY/ItemScheduleLineCollection('XXX')-Payload in the PATCH Call should include the ObjectID, quantity, unitCode. -Keywords-Custom OData Service, update operation, 204 error, 204 no content,

Title: Outbound WSDL File Is Empty
Content: Symptom-You try to download the WSDL file of an Outbound Communication Arrangement and when you try to open it, it is empty and the size of the file is 0 KB.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Communication Arrangement View.-Click in View All for any Communication Arrangement and download the Outbound WSDL file.-Open the file and notice it's empty and its size is 0 KB.-Cause-The reason on why you are not able to get an usable WSDL for an Outbound Communication Arrangement is because they are in "In Preparation" status and in this phase the WSDL is not ready yet.-Resolution-This can be solved activating the Communication Arrangement and downloading the WSDL file again.-Keywords-WSDL, Outbound, Empty, 0 KB, File

Title: Price Manually Maintained on Opportunity Not Derived to Following Sales Quote or Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You create an Opportunity, the item has a price maintained manually.-You notice that the item on the following Sales Quotes or Sales Orders does not have any of the price maintained.-Error message 'Item ABC: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation' is triggered on the Sales Quote (ABC is the item ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go the New Business work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Create a New Opportunity.-Fill in the relevant Master Data.-For the item, maintain the price manually.-Save the Opportunity.-Click the Follow-up button, select Sales Quote.-In the new document, all the previous Master data is derived automatically except for price data.-The error message 'Item ABC: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation' is displayed.-Cause-This is the expected behavior and the system is working as designed.-There is no Price List maintained for Item ABC so the system cannot determine the price on the Sales Quote.-SAP Business ByDesign uses price master data such as Price Lists to determine the price on a Sales Quote even if the price is manually maintained on the previous Opportunity.-Resolution-You have two possibilities:-Maintain a Price List for item ABC in the Product and Service Portfolio work center, Pricing view.-Manually maintain the expected price on the Sales Quote-Note that this behavior is also applied for Sales Orders.-See Also-The following Help Documents from the Help Center explain pricing on sales documents in SAP Business ByDesign:-Sales Quotes Quick Guide-Sales Orders Quick Guide-Pricing in Customer Relationship Management-Keywords-error message, price determination, price, sales quote, price missing, no price, opportunité, nouvelles affaires, offre client, prix, postes, pas de prix, sans les prix.

Title: Cannot Cancel Contract Item to Avoid Invoicing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to cancel a Contract item to avoid invoicing, but you cannot as the Contract Item Start Date is in the future.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for the Contract ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Contract).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Line Item XX (XX represents the Line Item ID)-Enter the Cancellation information.-Click Save.-Item XX remains In Process.-Cause-A Contract item will only be canceled once it reaches a date within the speficied Contract Item Start Date and Contract Item End Date range.-For example, if the Contract Item Start Date is set as 02.01.2021 and the Contract Item End Date is set as 01.01.2022, the system will only be able to cancel the item within these dates, not before.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In order to avoid having the system generating the invoice, please perform the following-Go to the Contract ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoicing subtab.-Select an option under Invoicing Block.-Click Save. -The Invoice Request document will remain blocked and once the system reaches the cancellation date within the Contract Item Start Date and Contract Item End Date, it will be canceled.-See Also-2153275 - Not able to Cancel a Contract Line Item with the Same Date as the Start Date-2865417 - Error When Trying To Cancel Contract: "Item XX: Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates"-Keywords-Contract, Item, Invoicing, Cancel, Invoice Request

Title: Adding Material Items for B2B Sales Order is not Allowed
Content: Symptom-You are making the attempt to add a new line item to a Sales Order, but the system does not allow you to perform such action as it throws an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row button.-Error message: Item XX: Adding Material items for b2b Sales Order is not allowed (XX represents the line item ID).-Cause-The Sales Order you are trying to add the new item is a A2A order, meaning, it belongs to an Intercompany scenario between Purchase Order and Sales Order.-For intercompany Sales Orders, the items always flows from the Purchase Order.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Sales Order, Purchase Order, Intercompany, A2A, B2B

Title: Error in embedded report: Value not Valid for Variable
Content: Symptom-You have embedded a report into a particular screen, for example the account, and you have done the appropriate mapping between a report field and a screen field. However when you open an account, you receive an error:-'Value not valid for variable XYZ' (where XYZ stands for the report field you have mapped).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Customers, view Accounts.-Open an account.-Go to the tab where you have embedded your report.-The report results in the above error message.-Cause-There are 2 possible causes.-Cause A) You have enabled a hierarchy on the respective report field. Once you have a hierarchy on a field, to use the selection, you would need to select the value from the value help (rather than entering it manually). When you do a mapping in an embedded report, the variable is not passed via the value help.-Cause B) The value help type of your report field which you have used for mapping is Use Context. This means that only values which actually appear in the report will be listed in the value help. If your embedded report does not contain any data for the respective account (in our example), this account is not listed in the value help and this error message will be shown.-Resolution-Resolution for cause A) You can use the Filter instead of the Selection to map the fields between the embedded report and the customer screen. The steps to do so are:-Go to the work center Customers, view Account.-Open any account.-Go into the Adaptation mode.-Edit your embedded report.-In the "Selection" tab, remove the mapping you have maintained, e.g. between Account (BP_UUID) and Account (*).-Go to the Filter tab.-Here, map the fields once again, e.g. Account (BP_UUID) and Account (*).-Click on Apply.-Alternatively, you can also remove the hierarchy if you prefer to use the selection. To do so:-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Reports.-Search for your report and click on Edit with > Report Wizard.-Go to step 4.-Search for the field you are mapping (e.g. Account) and set the hierarchy setting to No Hierarchy.-Click on Finish.-Resolution for cause B) This is the current product design. You can make use of the following workaround:-When mapping screen fields to report fields, instead of using the selection fields (Selection tab), you can make use of the Filter tab to map the fields.-See Also-2277591 - Value Help Types: Use Context and Use Master Data-Keywords-embedded report, value not valid, error message, reporting, missing data

Title: Payment Allocation is not Automatically Posted. Document ID is Found from Memo Line but Error is Raised: 'No outgoing check found'
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded a bank statement, which has an item corresponding to an Outgoing Check. The 'DME Reference' rule for analyzing memo line is working as expected and it derived the correct payment ID, however the payment allocation remains In Preparation.-If you try to create a proposal, an error message is also raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Open the concerned In Preparation payment allocation.-Click Edit rules for analyzing memo lines. -On the screen that opens, click Simulate.-Paste the payment allocation's memo line and click Simulate.-You see that the DME Reference rule correctly determined a Document ID.-Go back to the payment allocation and under Payment Confirmations/Returns tab.-You see the related Document ID not assigned to this payment allocation.-Click Actions -> Create Proposal.-The system starts searching for outgoing checks, but returns the following error: 'No outgoing check found'-Cause-The DME rule for analyzing memo line is successfully reading the memo line and extracting the Document ID as a result. Nevertheless, the system logic is to set the result of the DME rule as an 'External ID' as one of the search parameters of the query in backend when looking for payment orders.-Therefore, the system is searching for an outgoing check with External Reference ID as the Document ID from the DME Reference rule result. Since this check with external reference doesn't exist, errors are raised and the allocation is not automatically posted.-This is generally not an issue for Outgoing Bank Transfer since Document ID is equal to External Document ID. Nonetheless, the External Document ID of an outgoing check concerns the Check Number, retrieved from a check lot.-Resolution-For the automatic allocation to work using a DME Reference rule and Outgoing Checks, the check's external reference ID needs to be given in the bank statement inbound file so that it populates the payment allocation memo line accordingly.-Alternatively, you may edit the payment allocation's memo line manually to change the Document ID to the concerned External Reference ID. After that, you may click Actions -> Create Proposal for the system to read the memo line, search for the payment and allocate it.-See Also-2907107 - Bank Credit Advice not Automatically Allocated in Payment Allocation-Keywords-Payment Allocation. Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines. DME Reference. Outgoing Check. Inbound File.

Title: Customer Part Number is Not Appearing as Expected in Sales Order Volume Report
Content: Symptom-You want to check the Customer Part Number used in Sales Order via the Sales Order Volume Report, and you observe that the Customer Part Number is not appearing as expected in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for: Sales Order Volume Report.-Run the report.-Add the Sales Orders and Customer Part Number as new Row Fields.-You can see that no Customer Part Number is appearing.-Cause-The Sales Order Volume report fetches the Customer Part Number from Product Buyer ID (Account) field of item node in Sales Order. This information is maintained in Product master data for the specific Account.-Since the Part Number details were not available for the item as it was not present in Product Master data during Sales Order item creation, the data is not getting displayed in the report.-Resolution-The value appears in the report, when in the Product master data and in the Account, the value matches with the ones in Sales Order.-Then, it's necessary to have an Account in Product Master data with a Customer Partner Number, and this Account and Product need to be used in the Sales Order.-It's also important to observe when the Sales Order is created, and when the information was added in the Account. The change in master data should be done before the creation of a Sales Order.-So, the report will show the correct information.-Keywords-Customer Part Number, Sales Order, Sales Order Volume, Report

Title: Approval Process for Lease Contracts
Content: Symptom-You'd like to set up approval process for Lease Contracts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2005-Resolution-Approval process for Lease Contracts is currently not available.-You are welcome to propose the new functionality via Continuous Influence Session for ByDesign.-Improvement requests need 15 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis twice a year, with the results being communicated in the corresponding review blog post.-Keywords-lease contracts; lease contract management; approval process;

Title: Supplier Invoice is not created from Customer Invoice due to the Error in Output of a Customer Invoice: Invalid Chanel Type Code IDX
Content: Symptom-In an intercompany scenario the following error occurs for the Output Document in the Output History of a Customer Invoice: Invalid channel type code IDX-Due to this error the corresponding Supplier Invoice is not created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-In the Common Tasks, select New Manual Invoice Request.-Enter Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account).-Maintain the respective data.-Click on the Release button.-Open the newly created Customer Invoice XYZ in the Invoice Documents view (XYZ represents the ID of the new Customer Invoice).-Navigate to the Output History tab.-You can see that the Output Document has the status Error.-Click on the Error hyperlink.-You can see the following error:-An output error occurred:-Invalid channel type code IDX-View the details and follow the steps provided to solve the error-Click on the Details button.-The following Output Error Details are displayed:-Contact your key user to investigate this error.  When the error has been solved your key user should inform you so that you can retry outputing the document.-/DOC/OUTPUT_MANGMT000-  Cause-In the Output Channel Settings for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo of your Account Master Data of Account ABC you maintained the Output Channel the option Internal EDX not in the first position.-Resolution-You need to ensure that the Output Channel option Internal EDX is on the first position in the Account Master Data.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open Account ABC.-Navigate to the Communication tab and select the Collaboration sub tab.-Select the Business Document Name Customer Invoice / Credit Memo.-In the Output Channel Settings, remove all other Output Channels except for Internal EDX via the Remove button and then add them again.-This ensures that the Internal EDX Output Channel is on first position.  -Newly created Invoices will determine the Output Channel correctly and create the respective Supplier Invoices.-The failing message for the existing Customer Invoice cannot be resolved. However, you need to set the Output Document to successful.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Open Customer Invoice XYZ.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Select the Output Document with the status Error.-Click on the Set to Successful button.-You now need to create the respective Supplier Invoice manually.-  This requirement has been added to the Product Backlog in order to enhance the functionality with this feature in one of the future product releases.-See Also-2911155 - How to Define Multiple Output Channels-Keywords-Intercompany; EDX; IDX; /DOC/OUTPUT_MANGMT000; Supplier Invoice; Customer Invoice; Invalid channel type code IDX, multiple Output Channels, Multichannel

Title: PDI: ABSL to ABAP debugging conversion helper
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This KBA has been designed primarily for the PDI team and other colleagues interesting to debug PDI scripts in the backend.-Colleagues should also utilize this KBA when debugging through PDI script ABAP logic to assist in their troubleshooting.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-To debug a PDI script in the backend, you first need to locate the script in SE24. The ABAP script will have a naming convention similar to the following:-[SolutionID]_[BOName]_[NodeName].-You can follow another KBA in the central document to locate classes in SE24. See-2698660 - How to Find Any Custom or Standard ABAP Class to Debug- .-Resolution-To understand what you will be viewing, you should have a background on how the PDI architecture works with ABSL scripts in the SDK.-Introduction:-The SAP Cloud Solution is an example of a Full-Stack software solution. The cloud solutions have key components such as:-UI (User Interface).-SAP ABAP backend to handle complex business processes.-Connection to HANA DB.-In PDI, customers can create their own “add-on” solutions to “stick onto” the main solution provided by SAP. Customers do NOT have access to the ABAP backend, so they cannot make changes to standard scripts or create their add-on business logic with ABAP.-To develop an add-on for C4C / BYD, we use the cloud application studio. Using this SDK, we can create screens, logic and business objects. The scripts must be created in a language called ABSL. (Application Business Scripting Language). ABSL cannot run on its own during runtime. This MUST be converted to ABAP to execute. The runtime object for a script is generated the first time the script is activated in the SDK.-Every subsequent activation will then update the <Converted> ABAP script.-KEY:-Debugging can be a difficult process, especially if you do not have any understanding or knowledge in ABAP (or the language you are observing).-The ABSL and ABAP scripts have a direct link with each other and each statement in ABSL can be correlated in the backend. The ABSL line numbers are also shown too which makes it even easier!-Top Tip:-Locate any PDI ABAP class, just open SE24 and search for the PDI solution name followed by a * .-This will show you all the classes related to that solution.-KBA:  2698660 - How to Find Any Custom or Standard ABAP Class to Debug-                                                                                                           Let's look at some of the statements that are referred to in this document:-ABSL Line Numbers.-Queries / Retrieves.-Associations.-Creating Nodes.-Web Service calls.-Operands – Assigning values.-If / Else statements / Foreach loops.-Conditional checks (IsSet() / IsInitial() )-Conclusion:-The above information should give you great insight when debugging PDI related scripts in the SAP backend for Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer. The information above is not to say all statements are covered, but the majority of conversions are seen like the following.-Note: The above images were taken from a PDI solution created and developed in a SAP Internal Test Tenant.-Keywords-SAP, ABAP, Debug, Debugging, ABSL, Conversion, Webservice, Scripting, Loop, BO

Title: Number of set copies not considered while printing
Content: Symptom-You have setup 3 copies for a business document for output Channel printing, but only one is printed.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work Center Application and User Managment.-Open the output Channel Selection and search for any Business document.-Set up 3 copies.-If you release the document you get only one printout instead of 3.-Cause-You have setup ISR for the printer queue you are printing the document on.-Resolution-The "Use ISR tray selection" and the setup here should only be used for Swiss ISR Scenarios. Please remove the tick as shown in the screenshot-Keywords-Copies, printing, Tray.

Title: Bank Statement TIS Integration: System Crashes While Clicking Request Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You have activated TIS (Treasury Intelligence Solutions) integration for bank statements in ByDesign.-However, while trying to Request Bank Statement the system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Click the Request Bank Statement button.-System crashes.-Cause-Among other possible causes, the system crash might happen due to missing Service Provider ID in the Bank Account configuration for the Bank Account ID ABC for which the bank statement is to be created.-ABC means the Bank Account ID.-Resolution-The Service Provider ID should be maintained as follows:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the My Banks view.-Select My Bank ID XXX (XXX represents My Bank ID) for the bank containing Bank Account ID ABC.-Click Edit > Bank Accounts.-Select Bank Account ID ABC and maintain the Service Provider ID.-Remark: the Service Provider ID is the payment service provider. The entry is shown in the list as soon as you have created the provider as a supplier in the master data record.-Once you save the change, the Request Bank Statement functionality should work properly and the bank statement for Bank Account ID ABC should be created.-Keywords-TIS; Treasury Intelligence Solutions; bank statement; request bank statement; service provider ID; system crash; dump; backend dump

Title: Service Item is Not Copied From Contract to Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-When you try to Confirm Execution on a Contract containing Services, you notice that the generated Service Confirmation does not automatically fetch the Service Items from the Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open Customer Contract ABC (ABC Represents the ID of a Contract including Service Items).-Click the Submit Button and then Complete Execution.-The system will open a New Service Confirmation screen, and scrolling down you can see that the Items section is empty.-Cause-Service Contract items are not automatically copied over to the subsequent Service Confirmation. This differs from the Sales Order and Service Order scenarios where the items are automatically copied.-Resolution-For the cases where the Service Confirmation is created from a Contract, you will need to manually add the items.-Keywords-Service Contract, Copy, Fetch, Bring over, Items, Service Confirmation

Title: Error when building Odata Queries: TOO_MANY_DRILL_DOWN_OBJECTS
Content: Symptom-You build an Odata query but when you launch the query you get an error.-Example:-https://<your system hostname>/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RP<report ID>QueryResults/$count- You get the following error:- Program error in class CL_RSBOLAP_QV_RESULT_SET method: TOO_MANY_DRILL_DOWN_OBJECTS-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Report view.-Find the report you want to build Odata Queries.-Click the button Build Odata Queries.-Click tab Build Odata Queries.-Tick the box Count on the top right and click tab Generate Data Query.-Copy the link to the browser.-You get the following Errors:-Program error in class CL_RSBOLAP_QV_RESULT_SET method: TOO_MANY_DRILL_DOWN_OBJECTS-Cause-The error message is displayed because the report has too many fields (characteristics + key figures). You have either selected a high number of characteristics by using $select, or you have not selected any fields at all which means that the system will try to retrieve all characteristics and key figures.-The report must not have more than 50 fields to work correctly.-Resolution-Select fewer fields to be displayed in the report, by using the $select operator.-You can also make use of the INLINE Count - the number of records will be retrieved.-See Also-OData Blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2015/03/10/odata-for-sap-business-bydesign-analytics/-Keywords-Program error in class CL_RSBOLAP_QV_RESULT_SET method : TOO_MANY_DRILL_DOWN_OBJECTS, Count Odata Queries,AP-RC-ANA, Odata ,error, characteristics,TOO MANY DRILL DOWN

Title: Goods and Services Receipt Blocked by Tax Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-A Purchase Order contains Item ABC with the Item Type Expense (ABC represents the Item ID).-You create a Goods and Service Receipt DEF for this Item (DEF represents the Goods and Service Receipt ID) and get the error message: Item ABC: Tax region for country XYZ in item ABC is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab. (XYZ represents the Tax Region)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work centre.-Go to Receipts and Returns view.-Show All Goods and Service receipts.-Find DEF.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Select Check.-The error Item ABC: Tax region for country XYZ in item ABC is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab appears.-Cause-The Tax region under the Delivery tab of the Item is not maintained.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you can follow the steps below:-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work centre.-Go to Receipts and Returns view.-Show All Goods and Service receipts.-Find DEF.-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Delivery subtab of Item ABC.-Click Additional Fields.-Maintain a Province in the City/Province/Postal Code section.-Select Check.-You will need to repeat this for all the affected items before you post the Goods and Service Receipt DEF.-Please note that if the field in Additional Fields is grayed out, you will have to cancel the GSRs affected, go to the original items on the PO, click 'Resume' - > Delivery.-This will open the Delivery fields under the item level, then you can update the tax jurisdiction from here.-After this, you can create the GSRs needed from this PO.-Keywords-Tax region for country XYZ in item ABC is missing, You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab appears, goods and service receipt, expense, purchase order-goods and service receipt,expense,purchase order,tax region for country in item is missin

Title: Is it Possible to add New Document Types to the Attachments of Suppliers?
Content: Symptom-In the Attachments tab of Suppliers, you can find pre-defined Document Types such as Business Partner Image, Standard Attachment, Supplier-Specific Attachment and Technical Drawing. You would like to know whether it is possible to add a new Document Type.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-Select Suppliers view-Search and Edit a Supplier-Go to Attachments tab-Select Add button and choose File option-Select the drop down for Document Type-Resolution-It is not possible to add a new Document Types in the Attachments of Suppliers.-Further, it is also not possible to change the titles with the Cloud Development Studio or via Business Configuration.-Note: Usage of Document Type in Attachments:-Business Partner Image - This is an attachment type, which can add more value from the Business Partner aspect. Example: An image of a product.-Standard Attachment - This is the standard attachment, which is a global available standard.-Supplier-Specific Attachment - In the Account Master, Suppliers can also be maintained. Hence, any attachment that is added, which is specific to Suppliers or adds more value to the Supplier, can be maintained under Supplier-Specific Attachment.-Technical Drawing - This refers to a Blueprint type of an attachment. Where you maintain the technical blueprint. Example: A blueprint of a product, with the X and Y axes.-Keywords-Document Type, Attachments, Technical Drawing, Standard Attachment, Business Partner Image

Title: Price Component Surcharge Cannot be Selected in the Total Pricing Section of a Sales Order or Service Order
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add surcharges to sales order or service orders in the total pricing section since the price component surcharge does not appear in the drop down list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use service orders as an example:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Open Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-In the Total Pricing section click on Add Row.-In the drop down list for Price Component the price component Surcharge is not available-Cause-The scoping element Addtional_Surcharge is not in scope.-Resolution-To activate the scoping element Addtional_Surcharge in your solution scope you can use the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Select the path General Business Data -> Product and Service Pricing -> Sales Price Specifications-The following question needs to be active: Do you want additional surcharges at document level?-Once you have activated the question and finished your changes you can find and configure the Surcharges in the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project and click on Open Activity List-Navigate to the Fine Tune step.-Open fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Configure Pricing Procedure hyperlink.-You can see that the Price Component Surcharge is available in step 71, 72, 73 and 74.-Please note that if you like to see them in the Total Pricing section in your sales order or service order you need to ensure that Total Display is set to Yes.-See Also-2898021 - Pricing Components Are Not Available in Item Level for Sales Documents-Keywords-Surcharge, Item Level, Price Component; Header Level

Title: Error: "No released item change state assigned to variant X" When Migrating Bills of Material
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Bills of Material using the migration tool, you receive the error:-No released item change state assigned to variant X-where X represents the Variant ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the project and open activity list-Open activity Migration of Bills of Material-Select the link Migrate bills of material using the migration tool-Select file and execute migration-System throws the mentioned error-Cause-The engineering change order mentioned in the migration file is in status In Process instead of Completed in ByDesign system.-Resolution-You have to set the status of Engineering Change Order (ECO) to Completed before you migrate Bills of Materials.-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center-Go to Engineering Change Order view-Show Single Date Order in the drop-down menu-Search for Engineering Change Order ID -Select button Edit-Select button Change Status->Completed-Save and Close-Now you can proceed with the migration activity.-Keywords- Bills of Materials, Migration, Engineering Change Order, ECO, Variant, Planning and Production Master Data

Title: Additional Font Package is Required to View Document on Adobe Reader
Content: Symptom-You have generated an output pdf document, however when trying to open it using Adobe Reader you receive the following error message:-"A font package is required do correct dysplay this page..."-However, in the most of the cases this is not observed whyen opening the pdf files using Google Chrome browser.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Usually this is caused when customer edited the form template on Easy Form Editor or Adobe LiveCycle Designer and inserted some blank spaces on it.-On this cases the font KozGoPr6N-Medium is added to the form and is the root cause of the message in Adobe Reader.-The font KozGoPr6N-Medium is considered by Adobe a restricted font and this behavior is because Adobe changed the way it leads with CID (Character Identifier font) fonts. It now prompt the users to install an Asian language pack for documents that do not have a single eastern character in them. All because the encoding for the used CID fonts is Eastern (it has to be, because Adobe requires it for CID fonts).-You can check this information here in Adobe Restricted Fonts page.-Resolution-First thing to do is check if the pdf file has the font KozGoPr6N-Medium:-Open the PDF file on Adobe Reader.-Go to File and click on Properties.-On Document Properties window go to Fonts tab.-To correct this we need to remove the extra blank spaces fom the form template:-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter.-Open Form Template Maintenance. -Search for your form template in the list.-Click on Open and select Easy Form Editor.-Search for blank spaces and remove them.--"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Keywords- Adobe Reader; Additional Font package; KozGoPr6N-Medium

Title: Registered Product Missing in Installation Point Data Source (CRMIPOINTHB)
Content: Symptom-You are using the data source Installation Point (CRMIPOINTHB) and you notice that the field Registered Product shows # (unassigned) in some cases.-Environment-Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Search for Installation Point.-Click Preview.-Make the required selections by adding an Installation Point ID.-Add the field Registered Product to the view.-It shows # (unassigned).-Cause-The Data Source CRMIPOINTHB is used to show data for both Ipoints and Registered Products (which is also a type of IPoint). The Registered Product field shows the serial ID and description of that registered product. Note that it shows the registered product of the same id and not of the sub items.-Hence if you filter for a specific installation point which is not a registered product, the field shows #.-If you select an ID of a registered product, then the field Registered Product shows the serial ID and description of that registered product.-Resolution-If you would like to view sub items of an installation Point, then you can make use of the variable Parent Installation Point ID in the selection.-Keywords-installation point, registered product, CRMIPOINTHB, missing data, #, reporting, business analytics, data source, datasource, ipoint, parent

Title: Report Filters Are Not Saved
Content: Symptom-You want to save filters applied to your report using Additional Filters option, however after including the values to filter by and Saving the report Selection the results will not be reflected in the report after you close and reopen the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Design Reports.-Search for the report XYZ.-Run the report.-Click on "Selection" facet.-Click on "Additional Filters" Icon.-Add a valid value in the desired Characteristic field.-Click on "Save" icon under Selection facet.-Give the report selection a name and click Ok.-After closing and reopening the report, the results are not reflected.-Cause-You did not confirm the Filter values added by clicking "APPLY" button.-Without this action, the filter you defined to a given Characteristic field will not be applied in the report, and therefore it won't be saved.-Resolution-Repeat the steps above by clicking on "APPLY" button after step 7. The report will then reflect the changes and after that you can save the report, which will then keep the changes as expected.-Keywords-Filters, filter, additional filters, not save, saved, APPLY,

Title: BO Node: ExpenseReport - CostAssignmentView is Empty Even Though There's Cost Assignment Maintained For Expense Report AAA
Content: Symptom-While querying BO Node: ExpenseReport - CostAssignmentView of expense report AAA in the SDK you notice there's no data maintained, even though there's Cost Assignment data maintained for the expense report in frontend.-AAA means the expense report ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Cost Assignment View is only filled if the user has entered a deviating cost assignment in expense report, otherwise it's not maintained.-Resolution-System behaves as designed. If you want to evaluate or query the cost assignment of an expense report you must use the node Settlement Result Totals Cost Assignment View instead:-BO Node: ExpenseReport - SettlementResultTotalsCostAssignmentView-Keywords-expense report; cost assignment; settlement result totals; sdk; bo; bo node; CostAssignmentView; SettlementResultTotalsCostAssignmentView

Title: Over the Counter Sales Multiple Printer
Content: Symptom-You want to use the Over the Counter Sales Scenario and want to print the Invoices on different printer, but it is not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create an Invoice via the Over the counter sales Scenario using mandatory Printer queue BYDCRM_CUSTOMERINVOICE_DEFAULT in combination with the Cloud Print Manager. You have defined output rules and want to set up output on different printer based on the Invoicing Unit ie. using the Output Channel Selection.-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales Work Center.-Select the New Over-the-Counter Sale View.-Fillout the needed Information-Click on the Invoice button to generate the output.-Result: The Invoice is generated and can be found in the BYDCRM_CUSTOMERINVOICE_DEFAULT printer queue-Cause-Since the Over the Counter Sales Scenario needs the special queue BYDCRM_CUSTOMERINVOICE_DEFAULT and per queue only one printer can be chosen it is not possible to output Invoices via the Sales over the counter Scenario on multiple printer.-Resolution-As of now the Over the Counter Sales Scenario output in the standard Scenario can be done only on one printer regardless which output rules have been set up.-Keywords-Over the Counter Sales-Printing-BYDCRM_CUSTOMERINVOICE_DEFAULT

Title: Valuation of Supplier XYZ in company ABC failed on DD/MM/YY
Content: Symptom-You have triggered Valuation for your project, however one of the project's tasks ended up in  this valuation error.-Where XYZ is supplier iD and ABC is company ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Projects view.-Select your project and click View Plan Project.-Trigger the valuation if not done yet.-Select the line with the red error status.-Go to the Messages tab.-You find two error messages as follows:-Valuation of Supplier <ID> in company <name> failed on <date>-Cannot determine account origin for service in company <name>-Navigate to the Services tab.-You notice that the error is raised from the entry which has supplier, labor resource and team member assigned, but Service filed is in blank.-Cause-Since a team member assigned in project againt this service is service agent so a supplier is appearing against the task, thus system treats this as an external service procurement. Hence in order for the system to valuate this, it is requires a service to be maintained, so that the valuation strategies given below can checked to get relevant price to valuate the item.-Price from fixed source of supply-Price from contract-Price from list price-Service cost rate-The other error for Origin Account is also related to the first one. Since there is no service product maintained, the system cannot determine the origin account correctly.-Resolution-You need to maintain a service for this entry in the project for costing to go through. In order to do so, please follow below steps:-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects subview.-Select the concerned project and click Edit -> Project Plan.-Select the project's task and go to the Work tab.-On this list, you are able to maintain a service for the concerned team member entry.-After the above steps, the valuation can be done.-Note that if the record to which you need to assign a service is read-only, you need to add a new line for the service and team member assignment. After that, the old entry can be deleted.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2002/en-US/daf4fe95-e920-45f1-967b-8f3caf56895b.html-Keywords-Valuation of Supplier  in company  failed on
