Content: Symptom-In the report you are not able to delete the navigation target.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the view Design reports.-Open any report and click on a key figure or a characteristic value.-A menu will offer you a list of navigation targets.-You are not able to delete the ones you do not need.-Cause-Report navigations cannot be deleted.-Resolution-Please create a new idea or vote for an existing one in the Influence forum-Keywords-navigation target, delete, not possible, Navigationsziele, löschen, disable, report navigation, navigation

Title: Unable to Save New Check Lot: The Previous Check Lot is Also Flagged for Automatic Payments
Content: Symptom-Your current check lots are gone. You are trying to set up a new Check number range, however the system informs that the previous check lot is also flagged for automatic payments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to MyBanks subview.-Select your bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select the relevant bank account and go to the Check Lot tab.-You have already have created check lots, however the number range on each of them are gone, hence you click Add Row and set up a new one.-Flag the field Used for Automatic Check Numbering.-The following error message is raised: 'Check lot <check lot ID> is also flagged for automatic payments'-Cause-Even though the previous check lots have no further numbers available, the automatic check number assignment is still in place.-Resolution-In order to create a new check lot and set the automatic number assignment, you have to uncheck this option from the already used check lots and mark them as blocked.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to MyBanks subview.-Select your bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select the relevant bank account and go to the Check Lot tab.-Select the check lot, which has no check numbers available.-Uncheck the Used for Automatic Check Numbering option.-Mark it as blocked.-After that, you should be able to mark your new check lot for automatic check numbering.-In case the previous check lot is not yet fully consumed, you may use the Next Check Lot ID field with reference to the subsequent check lot ID. With this field populated, more than one check lot may have the automatic flag.-Keywords-Check Lot, automatic payments, house bank account

Title: Error in report: No SID Found for Value ABC of Characteristic XYZ
Content: Symptom-You are running a report or a data source and you receive the following error message: No SID found for value 'ABC' of characteristic @XYZ.-(ABC stands for the unit of measure or currency, and XYZ refers to the characteristic.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to the view Design Reports or Design Data Sources.-Search for your report or data source and open it.-Make the required selections and run it.- You will see the above error message.-Cause-The currency or unit of measure ABC is not maintained as a valid currency / unit of measure (UoM) in the system. However the report or data source contains documents that have this invalid unit. This can happen if you either maintain documents such as invoices or credit memos incorrectly, or if you upload the currency / UoM into a cloud data source without maintaining it in the system first.-Resolution-Please correct the document so that it uses valid currencies or units of measure. Alternatively, you can maintain the currency / UoM in the business configuration of your system, so that the system recognizes it. This can be done in the business configuration activities 'Quantities and Units of Measure' or 'Currencies' respectively.-Keywords-No SID Found for Value of Characteristic, cloud data source, report, error message, units of measure, currency, missing, AP-RC-ANA-no sid found,currrency in report,error while reading data

Title: Scheduled Sales Order Status still In Process / Open
Content: Symptom-Sales order is in status In Process but you expect it to be in status Completed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order number).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select line item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Line item XX is linked to project XYZ (XYZ represents the number of the project).-The Invoice Status for the line item is in status Finished and all invoicing has been completed for this sales order.-Therefore you would expect the sales order ABC to be in status Completed but the status is In Process-Cause-Case 1.-Manually created Project Invoice Requests do not change status of scheduling items and Sales Order.-Case 2.-The automatic finish invoicing on a Sales Order item works only for Fixed Price Items. In case of Time and Material the Sales Order will be in In Process status--In case of Service - time and material (project) item type, this is not the case reason being - Service - time and material (project) items type are based on actuals. It is not a fixed amount expected. The actuals could be equal or more than the planned amount in the Sales Order. Because of this reason, Service - time and material (project) items type are not completed automatically. Once all the actuals are there, you can do the finish invoicing manually.--A sales order can be only in status Completed if both statuses are set to Finished. The Invoice Status is set to finished when all invoicing for the sales order has been completed. The Delivery Status in project based Invoicing can be set to finish when the project is completed.-Case 3.-You have open invoice schedules in the Sales Order and therefore the Change Status button in the Customer Invoicing work center -> Project Invoicing view and Sales Orders sub view is disabled. Hence you are not able to select the Finish Invoicing option.-Resolution-Case 1.-Cancel the manually created Project Invoice Request and retrigger the schedule the system will created the scheduled invoice the sales order status becomes consistent.-If you intend to keep the manually created project invoice request then please follow the case to resolution.-Case 2.-In order to complete the sales order ABC you need to change the delivery status of the sales order to finished by changing status of the project to Complete or to Complete and Close.-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Open project XYZ via the Edit -> Project Plan button.-Select the Basic Data sub tab.-In the Project Status field select the Complete or Complete and Close option.-You can finish the invoice status of the sales order as follows:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Project Invoicing view.-Select the Sales Orders sub view.-Select sales order ABC.-Press the Change Status button and select the Finish Invoicing button.-The Status of the related sales order ABC will now change to Completed.-Case 3.-In order to select the Finish Invoicing option you need to ensure that all Invoice Schedules in the Sales Order are Invoiced.-You can cancel any open Invoice Schedules in the Sales Order via the Cancel open dates option.-Using this action you can cancel all invoice schedule items that are in open status.-If an unreleased invoice document exists for any open date then corresponding invoice request will change to status “With Conflict” and you can then cancel the invoice document. (See also KBA 2776630 - Customer Invoice Cannot be Released due to a Conflict detected in the Scheduled Invoice Request)-you can proceed as follows:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Select the respective Item.-Click on the Action button and select the Cancel open dates option.-  See Also-2776630 - Customer Invoice Cannot be Released due to a Conflict detected in the Scheduled Invoice Request-Keywords-Invoice Status; Status; Completed; Invoice Schedule; Cancel open dates

Title: Error Message "Invoices not released; Approvals cannot be scoped" While Merging a Change Project
Content: Symptom-You finish the scoping of your implementation project, or you merge a change project. But this fails with below error message:-Invoices not released; Approvals cannot be scoped-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementations Projects view.-Select the Change Project and select Open Activity List button-Go to Go Live tab-Open the Merge activity and start the merge-Cause-The reason for this error is the attempt to scope the question Do you want to set up approval process for manual customer invoices and credit memos?, although one or more open invoices exist in the system.-Resolution-Before you scope this question, you need to complete all the Manual invoices and Credit Memos created in the system. This can be verified in Customer Invoicing work center, Invoice Documents view.-Keywords-Not possible, is failing, Frage, Möchten Sie einen Genehmigungsprozess für manuelle Kundenrechnungen und -gutschriften einrichten

Title: Incoming Direct Debit Not Allocated Against Receivable
Content: Symptom-A bank statement is uploaded containing an incoming direct debit payment. This corresponds with the external transaction code in the statement line (e.g. SEPA direct debit deposit). In line with the definitions made in Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines you expect an allocation and clearing against an open receivable. However, no receivable is allocated. Also the function Create Proposal does not show any results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You can access relevant payment allocation either in:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant payment allocation.-or via the posted bank statement.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Open the Bank Statements view.-Navigate to the relevant bank statement and edit.-Follow the link Postprocessing required to access the relevant payment allocation.-The relevant payment allocation is in status In Preparation.-Cause-If an incoming direct debit is contained in a bank statement, the system is presented with two options:-Allocate the payment to a self-initiated payment which already cleared a receivable.-Clear an open receivable ( for example customer invoice) by a newly created incoming payment.-The intention here, however, is the clearing of an open receivable. The underlying definition is made in the matching of external transaction codes and applied payment method.-A payment method Payment Processing - Of Incoming Direct Debit indicates that a self-initiated payment already exists and shall be merely allocated. An allocation against customer account and clearing of a receivables is not intended.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center and navigate to Fine Tuning.-Choose the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements / Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Highlight the relevant Import Format (e.g. MT940 DE).-In the bottom pane - definitions for External Transaction Codes and their corresponding Payment Methods are listed.-For the External Transaction Code representing direct debit (e.g. SEPA direct debit), the Payment Method needs to be changed from Payment Processing - Of Incoming Direct Debit to Payment Processing - Of Incoming Bank Transfer.-This indicates that a payment against a customer account and possible clearing against an open receivable shall be effected.-Keywords-incoming, direct debit, not allocated, receivable, payment processing

Title: You Cannot Change The Bill-To In The Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You cannot change the Bill-To in a sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the sales order).-Click the Edit button.-You can see that field Bill-To is grayed-out. (This behavior is also happening for new sales orders).-Cause-The Bill-To party is grayed-out because the business option Redetermination of Bill-To party at customer invoice creation has been scoped. Selecting this option leads to the redetermination of address at the time of customer invoice creation and hence you cannot change the Bill-to in sales order.-Resolution-Please check the Business Configuration scoping following the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the Questions tab. -Open Sales ->Customer Invoicing ->Miscellaneous Invoicing.-Uncheck the question: Do you want to redetermine the address of the Bill-To party from the master data at the time of invoice creation?-Now the Bill-To name in sales orders can be changed.-Keywords-Rechnungsempfänger, nicht bearbeitbar, Bill-To grayed out, not editable,

Title: User Can View a Project Task in Time Sheet
Content: Symptom-A User is able to view a project task ABC from Time Sheet when he is not assigned to this task.-He can therefore add an activity on it and record some time on it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The user is following this path:-Work Center Home.-Self Service overview.-Select Time view.-Edit Time Sheet.-Click Manage my Work List.-Click Add Work Package.-From here, the user is able to find the task ABC, even if he is not assigned to this project task.-Cause-According to which scenario has been followed, this is the normal system behavior.-Resolution-If an employee is added to the ‘Team & Staffing’ tab of the project, then it is possible that the employee can work on any task within the project.-In this case the ‘Manage My Work List’ from Time Sheet will show all the tasks of the project.-Also, if the employee clicks on ‘Add Work Package’, the tasks will also be visible.-If an employee is added to a specific task via the Work Tab for the Task on the project, then the employee is automatically assigned to the ‘Team & Staffing’ tab for the project.-In this case the ‘Manage My Work List’ from Time Sheet will show all the tasks of the project.-Also, if the employee clicks on ‘Add Work Package’, the tasks will also be visible.-If an employee is not assigned to a project but is required to work on the project, then the employee can add the project task and service directly onto Time Sheet and record times.-All times recorded in this manner will always require approval before being added to the project. ‘Manage My Work List’ and ‘Add Work Package’ do not show the tasks of the project.-Keywords-Project task, Project, Edit Time Sheet, Time recording

Title: Remittance Advices View Missing in Payment Management Workcenter
Content: Symptom-You want to send Remittance Advices but are not able to find this view in Payment Management Work Center in your system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management Work Center.-The view Remittance Advices is missing.-Cause-Remittance Advices is not included in your solution profile. Therefore the Remittance Advices view is missing in your solution.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration.-Go to Implementation Projects. -Edit Project Scope.-In Questions tab, navigate to Cash Flow Management - Payment and Liquidity Management and select Payment Methods.-Tick the In Scope box for question Do you want to receive remittance advices?-Press Next to review and then Finish to confirm the solution changes.-After you have scoped this question you will be able to see the view Remittance Advices in Payment Management workcenter.-Keywords-Remittance Advice. Target Not Available.

Title: How the Show Master Data Value Selection affects the Report Content
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report and selected the option Show Master Data Value for a specific characteristic, and you would like to know how this selection affects the report content.-In this example, we use the Account Details report and the Sales Organization characteristic.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a copy of the Account Details report and called it XYZ.-For the custom report (XYZ) you have selected the option Show Master Data Value for the Sales Organization characteristics follow:-Report wizard then Characteristic Properties (Step 4)-Highlight Sales Organization characteristic-From the Details: Sales Organization select the Display tab and tick the Show Master Data Value box.-Save the report-When you open the custom report (XYZ) and select a Sales Organization, for example 123, from the value help list, you notice that in some cases no data is associated to specific organizations while there is for others.-If you perform the same steps with the standard report (Account Details) and search for the same Sales Organization (123) from the value help you are not able to find it on the list and add it to the report content.    -When you check the details of the mentioned Sales Organization (123) in respect to the available Accounts you find out that are yet to be referenced to an Account.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The reason why the Sales Organization characteristic, from the custom report (XYZ), shows Sales Organization even if no Sales data is associated to it is because with the Show Master Data Value Selection the report is modeled to display all master data values without any restriction; consequently the Sale Organization characteristic will get all the value available from the system, as per the Org Structures, irrespectively if the Sales Organization is used in the Account as part of Sales Data or not. On the other hand, the Sales Organization characteristic which doesn't have the Show Master Data Value selection ticked, like in the Account Details (standard report) it will restrict the Sales Organizations which are used in the Accounts as part of Sales Data.-Note: The above selection may also affect the result of the value help when similar characteristics are used from the Selection/Filter screen. for example Sales Organization and Functional Unit ID (Sales Organization) where the first will show a Sales Organization while the second won't.-See Also-2595933 - Show Master Data Value is Not Working Properly-1889658 - How to Display Master Data Values In A Report Even If Key Figures Are Zero-Keywords-show master data, report, business analytics, analysis, reporting, too many entries, duplicate lines

Title: Cannot Update Tax Country of an Over-The-Counter Sale Using Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update the tax country information of an Over-The-Counter Sale document using the Manageoverthecountersalereques service, however the information is not being updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The service does not have the provision to pass tax country from an external request for the Over-The-Counter. This is only available for Customer Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Over-The-Counter, Sale, Web Service, Tax Country

Title: Dunning Address Determination in Dunning Letters
Content: Symptom-This KBA will explain what drives the determination of dunning address in dunning letters generated out of dunning runs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The dunning address is determined by the Dun-To field selected as Yes (Standard) in the customer master data.-The address can be checked by following the steps below:-Go to the Business Partner Data or Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search for the respective Account ID for which the Dunning Letter has been created.-Click Edit > Addresses.-Find the Address maintained with Dun-To set as Yes. This address will be the one used by the system in the Dunning Letter PDF document.-See Also- 2112390 - Bill-To, Ship-To and Dun-To Columns Missing in the Account's Address Tab-Keywords-dunning letter; dunning run; dunning; dun-to; yes(standard); address; addresses; communication

Title: Tax Code or Tax Country Is Not Triggered As Expected by the System in Sales order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order and you expected to see a specific Tax Code for the Tax Country US, but the system triggers a different one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-We will use the following example:-The Seller Party is from California with the Tax Jurisdiction Code CA and the Ship-From Party has Internal fulfillment and is from New Jersey Tax Jurisdiction Code NJ.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for sales order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order created).-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Taxes subtab.-You can see that the system determines CA as Tax Jurisdiction Code but you expected NJ to be determined.-Cause-In order to determine the Tax jurisdiction role in a sales order the relevant roles of the business partners involved are:-The contract-from (CF) party – in our example of a sales order the legal seller.-The contract-to (CT) party – the legal buyer.-The ship-from (SF) party – the location the goods are being ship from (Fulfillment which can be internal or external).-The ship-to (ST) party – the receiver of the goods which can be the buyer party but also any other party.-Specifically for services: the service location (SL) – the place and party where a service is provided.-Taxes on materials deliveries within the United States are levied according to the law of the destination state (Ship-to). Only in California and Texas are the deliveries taxed according to the state of origin (Ship-from). You can add your own combinations in business configuration and decide which combination is origin-based or destination-based for an intrastate transaction, which means that ship-to and ship-from are the same US state. To find the activity:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-tune phase.-Select the Tax on Goods and Services — US activity from the activity list.-Here you can add additional rules for destination-based or origination-based taxation for intrastate transactions. The rules are checked from top to bottom, with the rules having more precise parameters placed higher in the list. The less specific a rule is, the lower the rule should be placed in the list. Empty fields are handled as wildcards. In general the rules are destination-based. If you want an origination-based taxation, you have to set the flag "Origination Taxation".-However, this only applies if the transaction is within tax reporting group (if all parties reporting to the same tax authority) and/or we have nexus in the state. To have nexus in the state, this means that for destination based states you need to have a tax authority for the Ship To State and for origin based states you need to have a tax authority for the ship from state. If both don’t apply then the tax jurisdiction code of the Contract-From party (CF) which is the seller party in the sales document will be used to determine the tax jurisdiction code.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you want to ensure that as in our example NJ will be determined as the Tax Jurisdiction Code you would have to ensure that you have nexus in the state. To have nexus in the state, you need to have a tax authority:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Go to the Tax Authorities sub-view.-Click on New button.-Select the Tax Authority.-Fill up the mandatory fields.-After that, you have now the nexus in the state.-See Also-Knowledge Base Article 1621997 - No taxes calculated for US - Tax Code US 507-Keywords-Tax Code ; Tax Country ; US ; Tax Jurisdiction Code.

Title: Non-Billable Indicator not Selected in Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You have created a Service Order with fixed price items and selected the Non-Billable checkbox, however, the indicator is not carried over to the Service Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Select the Service Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Order).-Click Edit.-You have selected the Non-Billable indicator for item 10.-Click the Submit button.-Select Confirm Service Execution.-Click View All.-Navigate to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Item 10 Non-Billable indicator is not selected as expected.-Cause-For items of item type Fixed Price, the invoicing is not performed through the Service Confirmation, but rather through the Service Order and for this reason the indicator is not carried over in the Service Confirmation.-Upon the creation of the Service Confirmation, the Invoicing Status of the item is already marked as Irrelevant, confirming that the invoicing is not going to be performed via the Service Confirmation document.-The indicator will be carried from the Service Order to the Service Confirmation for items which are of item type Time and Material for example, as the invoicing becomes Irrelevant in the Service Order and it is performed through the Service Confirmation.-Also, when the indicator is selected in the Service Order, upon invoicing the system will not invoiced the item which was selected.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Service Order; Non-Billable; Indicator; Service Confirmation; Not Selected;

Title: System Crash When Issuing Bill of Exchange Receivable
Content: Symptom-You have created a Bill of Exchange Receivable with Acceptance or a Bill of Exchange Receivable without Acceptance, however the system crashes when trying to Issue the documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Find the related Bill of Exchange.-Click Actions -> Issue.-System crashes.-Cause-One of the causes for this case is that the form template selection rule is missing for Bill of Exchange Receivable with or without Acceptance.-Resolution-You need to maintain the form template selection rules as follows:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Selection view.-Show Rules for Bill of Exchange Receivable.-Maintain the rules as follows:-Form template Bill of Exchange Receivable Advice to be maintained for Payment Form Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance.-Form template Bill of Exchange Receivable Acceptance to be maintained for Payment Form Bill of Exchange Receivable with Acceptance.-After maintaining the above rules, may issue the related bills of exchange.-Keywords-Bill of Exchange Receivable with Acceptance, Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance, BoE, bill of exchange.

Title: XML Data Not Available in Output History Tab for Outgoing Check
Content: Symptom-In the Outgoing Check screen, the View Data XML button is grayed out under the Output History tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Monitor view.-Open the Outgoing Check AAA (AAA means the Outgoing Check ID).-Click View All.-Go to the Output History tab.-You will see that the View Data XML button is grayed out.-Cause-The XML data is not available for Outgoing Checks in UI. Technically, the function is not based on the Document Output Request (new architecture for forms), and hence this has never been available. For some other documents it is available as they were ported to the new architecture, as for example, Service Orders and Invoices, and so on.-Resolution-The behavior is correct.-Keywords-output history, XML, Outgoing Check, Output Channel, form, payment management, download, xml download.

Title: Defining of Direct Approval rule for Multiple Approvers
Content: Symptom-You want to assign multiple approvers under Direct Approvers rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Application and User Management work center-Select View Task Distribution-Select view Approval Processes-Select Default Approval Process for Purchase Order-Select the approval rule with Direct Approvers-You can assign multiple approvers under "Direct Approvers" rule.-Cause-1.   Condition 1-If you want all approvers to approve, then you have to check "All Approvals Required" option.-    2.   Condition 2-If you want only one of the approvers to approve, then you should uncheck "All Approvals Required" option.-    3.  Condition 3-If you expect any 2 or 3 out of multiple approvers to approve, then follow these steps-Create an approval rule with "Direct Approvers" option-Create separate approval steps with the same approvers under "Direct Approvers" option and uncheck "All Approvals Required" option-In the next approval steps, flag "Skip Reapproval" option, so that approval task will not go to the same person who has approved in the previous step-Resolution-You can set multiple approvers under "Direct Approvers" rule.-"All Approvals Required" option should be set when you want all the approvers in the "Direct approver" list to approve the document, else uncheck this flag.-You can use the skip reapproval option when you set multi-step approval process where same approver is determined in the next steps.-Keywords-Approval, Direct Approver, Skip Reapproval, All Approvals Required

Title: How To Solve the Fixed Asset Migration Error: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount
Content: Symptom-You are using the Fixed Assets (extended) migration template to migrate fixed assets data, since you have multiple set of books, valuation views or fixed asset retirements in your legacy system.-While simulating the migration you come across the following error message(s):-Asset XXX val.view YYY: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount-XXX = Asset ID-YYY = Valuation View ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective migration unit and click Execute Migration.-Select the Fixed Assets (extended) migration object and click Process File.-You'll see the error message(s) on the Log section:-Asset XXX val.view YYY: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount-Cause-The reason for the error message(s) is that not all the combination of set of books and valuation views are maintained in the xml file for migration.-A typical case: for example, there are 5 valuation views tied to the set of books you are migrating fixed assets, but in the Fixed Assets (extended) template > Asset Posting Lines worksheet there are some lines with data for only 2 valuation views.-Resolution-You could verify whether all the valuation view data is maintained or not by adding an extra worksheet to the excel downloaded from the migration tool and, in the new worksheet, adding 2 new columns for verifications, for example "Key" and "Count" (header row).-Steps on Microsoft Excel:-In the new worksheet, copy the following relevant columns (without the header) from Asset Posting Lines worksheet:-Inventory ID (A)-Set of Books ID (B)-Valuation View (C)-Movement Category (D)-Line Item Type (E)-Valuation Date (F)-Posting Date (G)-Currency (I)-Debit or Credit Amount (J)-In the next column (K) use the CONCATENATE function to concatenate columns A, B, D, E and F.-In the next column (L) copy and paste the data obtained with the function on column K (use paste option Values(V)).-In the next column (M) use the COUNTIF function giving K as range and L as criteria. The COUNTIF function counts the number of cells within a range that meet a single criterion that you specify.-Apply the COUNTIF function to all rows of column M.-In the row #1 of this worksheet you can add a Filter (Data section > Filter icon).-Finally, on column M you have the result of how many valuation view lines are maintained for each Inventory ID in Asset Posting Lines worksheet. You can use the downward arrow from the filter to check in details.-Please check the Attachments section for an example where you are migrating thousands of fixed assets (9137 entries in Asset Posting Lines), there are 5 valuation views tied to the set of books, but for 2 fixed assets you entered lines for only 2 valuation views (3 missing for each one).-See Also-This KBA is a complement of KBA 2565787.-Microsoft Excel version used: 14.0.7145.5000 (32-bit).-Keywords-fixed assets migration; extended template; acquisition cost; excel template

Title: No Data Sources Found Message in Further Usage of Extension Field (PDI)
Content: Symptom-You are getting a message in Further Usage of Extension Field screen when you try to extend a PDI field from SDK.-No Data Sources Found.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the Solution and navigate to the relevant XBO where you have added the extension fields.-Right click and select the option Enhance Report.-The system will ask you to select the extension field that you want to add.-Select and click on OK.-System will take you to the further usage screen of the UI.-You will receive the warning message or you will not be able to find the reports that you want to enhance.-Cause-There are different use cases for this issue:-When you log into SDK with the PDI development user e.g. PDI_DEV. In parallel you had opened already a browser session where you have logged in with another user  e.g. KEY_USER in the same system/client that you have logged to SDK.-You have not added any extension field to the Extension BO to extend.-The Business Object where you have added the extension field cannot be extended to a data source and hence the data source was not available.-Resolution-Resolution for the above mentioned cases are:-You should ensure that you log-in to SDK and UI with same credentials when you try to enhance report from SDK to the frontend.-You should maintain atleast one extension field in the XBO to extend to report.-Check the help document Data Sources Enabled for Extension Fields - it contains a list of all data sources that can be extended, as well as all business contexts where the field has to be created in order to be extendible.--If the respective context which you are working on is not mentioned in this list then Extension fields cannot be added to any data source from this business context.-Keywords

Title: Recipient's Country Name is Not Written in Recipient's Native Language
Content: Symptom-When you open the Form Template Customer Invoicing, you find recipient's country name is not in his native language. But the remaining address is in the recipient's native language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management-Go to view Business Flexibility->Form Template Maintenance-Open a Customer Invoice-Find the name of the country is not written in the customer's language-Cause-According to the official international postal guidelines, the country name is supposed to be written/printed in the language of the sender country, while the remaining address is supposed to be written in the language of the recipient country.-Resolution-If you want the country name to be displayed in the english language on all business documents you can activate this in your Business Configuration as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Expand the following path:-Built-in Services and Support ->  Business Environment -> Addresses and Languages-You can activate the following scoping question: Do you want the country name to be displayed in the english language on all business documents?-See Also-2245681 - How is the Language of the Sender Country Determined-2831434 - How are Address Formats for Different Countries Defined-Keywords-Address; Countries; Country; wrong language; language

Title: Web Service Error Message When Printing Documents using a Custom Solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When looking at web service message monitoring you see many application error messages related to the PrintQueueWebService.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is a known limitation. These errors are generated only when the Print queue documents are triggered using API rather than the normal document flow.-Here's the background for understanding:-In the normal document release process (Sales Order, customer invoice etc.,) the document output request item instances are created. Therefore, when the print queue item is created, it will have the reference to our output request item instance. When we receive the call from print manager to set the print queue item status, we also fetch and update the output request item status.-In case of custom solution, the print queue items are directly created using an API with a dummy output request item reference. There will not be any output request item instances created for these print items. Therefore, when the print manager calls setItemStatus of these print queue item instances, the call fails as there is no reference output request instance in our BO.-Resolution-If customer is using a custom solution (PDI) to print the documents this is an expected behavior. These error message will not interfer in the functionality of the printing service and could be ignored.-Keywords-Print Queue , web service, custom PDI output

Title: Duplicate PDI Extension Fields Appears in Data Source
Content: Symptom-In the Data Source you will observe that duplicate entries exists for every extension fields you have created in the original solution, after the creation of patch solution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to frontend system.-Business Analytics work center.-Data Source sub view.-Open the relevant data source created.-You will be able to see the two fields with same name.-Cause-The duplicate extension fields appears in the data source is because the system is a development tenant and hence PDI extended fields from both original solution as well as patch solution will be shown in the respective data source. This will not be the case in the target tenant (production).--When patch is assembled and downloaded and then uploaded into Production tenant, there won't be any duplicates, because in production tenant there will be only original solution and no patch namespace. Hence, extension fields from original solution only would exists.-Note: This is the same scenario with webservice and Migration Templates/ Mass Data Maintenance Templates.-Resolution-In this case you can follow either of the below mentioned cases:-1. If you disable the patch and enable the Original solution you will be again see only one field.-2. If you need the patch changes to be applied then you can also download and upload the patch solution to the original solution in the same tenant, which will again shows only one extension field(you should enable the original solution).-3. When you design the report you can decide whichever field you want to display, hence select only one extension field from the namespace which is active.-

Title: Wrong Export Tax Code For Indian Seller
Content: Symptom-You have a sales scenario from an Indian seller, where you expect a Zero Tax Rate tax code to be determined.-The System always determines Tax Code 562 with 18% IGST Tax Rate.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new sales order.-Select an Indian seller.-Select an international customer.-Add a standard product.-Tax code determined will be 562 with 18% Tax Rate. You expect a 0% Tax Rate Tax Code to be determined.-Cause-In the automatic tax determination not all tax codes can be determined that are available in the system.-The standard tax code for export sales is 562 with 18% IGST.-Other tax codes are available and can be either selected manually or automated via external tax determination.-Resolution-Select the tax codes manually.-Create external tax determination for your scenario.-See Also-External Tax Determination-Keywords-Indian Seller, Export, Tax Code, Zero Tax Rate, Indischer Verkäufer, Steuercode, Steuerrate

Title: XML Transformation Error While Previewing or Releasing a Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer gets XML transformation error while triggering preview or during document release.-Environment-SAP Bussines ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-This error triggers due to invalid length of value, or, wrong data passed for decimal, integer or Boolean fields.-Resolution-To find what data value is getting passed you can follow these steps:-1) Go to transaction SE24-2) Enter the Class name - /DOC/CL_DOR_ITEM_PREVIEW_UTIL and click display button-3) Double-click on the Method - CREATE_ITEM_PREVIEW to insert a debug point in the method-4) Search for the statement – ‘CALL METHOD cl_proxy_xml_transform=>abap_to_xml_xstring’ in the method and put an external breakpoint. Now, trigger the preview so that the control reaches the breakpoint:-  5) Press ‘F6’ until the control reaches following statement in ‘Catch’:-  6) Double-click on the variable - LX_ROOT to check the error:-  7) Scroll down in the LX_ROOT object to find the internal ABAP field name:-  8) Now, check the object - PREVIOUS under CX_ROOT to get more details of the error:-  9) In this case, the error class is - CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_BOOLEAN, so scroll down to check the value passed for this Boolean field:-Keywords-XML conversion error; preview error; release error;

Title: Error Message in New Key Figure: Key Figure ABC is Not Correctly Defined
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new calculated key figure, but after maintaining the formula you receive the error message:-Key figure ABC is not correctly defined (ABC stands for the name of your key figure).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and select the view Design Key Figures.-Click New.-In step 2, enter a key figure name, a data source and select the type Calculated Key Figure.-Click Next.-In step 2, enter your formula.-Click Next.-You receive the error mentioned above.-Cause-The formula is incorrect. Several causes are possible. One cause would be if you are setting up a calculation using other key figures and they do not have the same unit (or one of them has a unit of measure and the other one does not).-Resolution-Correct the formula. In our example, if one used key figure has a unit, remove it by adding NODIM to the formula.-You will find the NODIM option under the Data tab in step 2.-See Also-Check the help center article called Formulas in the Analytics Guide for more details.-Keywords-key figure, error message, inconsistent, not defined correctly, not correctly defined, business analytics, customization, unit of measure, currency-key figure not correctly defined,cannot create key figure

Title: How to Configure a Domain Name Alias to the my-URL or How to Maintain a Second URL
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The document describes how to maintain a second URL which is an alias to the my-URL.-Environment-SAP Sales Cloud-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-When a DNS alias is configured to point a custom URL to a my-URL, the name resolves correctly to the IP of  my-URL. However, when you try to browse via the custom URL an SSL certificate error appears and redirects you to a system maintenance/ temporary system-down page.-Cause-This happens when an alias URL is not configured on the ICF node of a system. The web dispatcher does not know the URL and gives back a maintenance page.-Resolution-If you want to use the custom URL, you have to configure it on the system at the same place where the my-URL is configured.-Go to the backend transaction SICF (in client 000), select the correct Virtual Host (respective client), double-click and notice the Virtual Host Number.-   2.   Go to table ICFVIRHOST_CONF and add a new entry for the new URL.-HOST = enter new URL without https://-PORT = keep default value 443-PROTOCOL = keep default value HTTPS-HOSTNUMBER = enter the number of step 1. It’s the unique identifier for the virtual host node in SICF (each virtual host has an own number/see step 1).-ICFORDER = check all existing entries of the regarding HOSTNUMBER and set the next higher number (this number defines the priority of the URL’s.  1= primary URL, 2= secondary1 , 3=secondary2, and so on).-Important: Two times the same ICFORDER for one HOSTNUMBER will not work!-Example: In the above picture you see that for HOSTNUMBER=75 has two entries with ICFORDER=1 and ICFORDER=2 respectively.  So next URL get’s ICFORDER=3.-Currently the above table changes can only be made with the debugger.-Select the HOSTNUMBER for which the entry has to be made and select display.-Once it is displayed, go to transaction /h and press Enter twice to start debugging.-Double-click on C code variable, select the Create icon (as shown above) and type INSR as value and execute.-This takes you to a new window where you can insert the URL and save it.-  3.  Execute function module ICM_SAP_UPLOAD_URLS with parameter (GLOBAL = 1) in transaction SE37, or if it's not working restart ICM (transaction SMICM in Client 000).-  Keywords-domain alias, custom dns, custom URL,

Title: Product Category Displayed as # Not assigned in G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-Upon execution of G/L Accounts - Line Items Report for a journal entry with source document type Journal Entry Voucher, the Product Category field is displayed as # Not assigned, even though there's a Product Category displayed in the journal entry itself.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open the report G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Enter mandatory selection data and Journal Entry ID (which has a Journal Entry Voucher as Source Document).-Add characteristic Product Category to the report and execute the report.-Notice that Product Category is displayed as # Not Assigned, even though there's a Product Category displayed in the Journal Entry itself.-Cause-Product Category in this case is a sub-ledger specific data. This can be seen in the Journal Entry, under Items Details: Overhead Cost (ledger). The G/L Accounts - Line Items report is supposed to show only G/L specific data and not sub-ledger data.-Resolution-For this case, the Cost Centers - Line Items report can be used to see data with Product Category. In Cost Centers - Line Items report the Product Category characteristic should be added via Add Fields function.-Keywords-product category; not assigned; #; G/L Accounts - Line Items; journal entry; je; journal entry voucher; jev; cost center - line items; subledger

Title: Cannot Upload Customer Specific Discount Products (Gross) Using Microsoft Excel Add-In
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***WAITING FOR VALIDATION***-You are trying to upload a Customer Specific Discount Products (Gross) with scales into the system using the Microsoft Excel add-in, and the system is not accepting the execution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Discount Lists (Gross) view.-Using the drop-down select Customer Specific Discount Products (Gross)-Click Download button.-Open the Excel File.-Fill the file with the expected data.-Log on to your SAP ByDesign System Add-In.-Click Save Data To.-Error: First Dimension Unit of Measure of scale code "x" does not match with unit of measure in Data.-Error: Total number of records saved: 0.-Cause-Currently the Microsoft Excel add-in upload does not support item creation along with scales for gross discount lists that do not have unit of measure at item level.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please use the Migration of Discount List if scales are to be uploaded with items.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-See Also-Help Document: Configuration: Migration of Discount Lists-Keywords-Discount List; Migration; Upload; Excel; Add-In

Title: No Bank Statement Created from Inbound File
Content: Symptom-No bank statement created from Inbound file ID ABC (ABC is the inbound file ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files subview in the File Management view.-Search for Inbound File ABC and select it.-The status is Finished.-Click View.-File Type:  Bank Statement.-Import Format: ISO20022 Bank Statement.-Go to the Bank Statement view in the Liquidity Management work center.-Filter for File ID ABC and click Go.-No bank statements are displayed.-Cause-For amounts less than 1.00 (for example .82) if there is no zero before the decimal point, the file cannot be processed.-For example, in the tag <XchgRate>.999254</XchgRate>, zero is missing before .999254.-You need to maintain the tag as <XchgRate>0.999254</XchgRate>.-(The tags and the amounts displayed here are for reference only).-Resolution-You have to maintain the number zero before the decimal point for the effected amount in the inbound file.-Keywords-Inbound file; bank statement; Eingangsdatei; Kontoauszug

Title: Query.ExecuteFromDB().CommonNode.field Retrieve the Buffer Entry
Content: Symptom-While using Query.ExecuteFromDB().CommonNode.field, it retrieves the buffer entry instead of the database entry.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio -Use Query.ExecuteFromDB().CommonNode.field in absl-It retrieves the buffer entry-Cause-The function ExecuteFromDB will only return fields and not nodes. You will be able to read fields only on the node on which the query will be fired. This will be mostly relevant for Custom Business Objects and SAP BusinessObject nodes that have an inbuilt query delivered. Also, it offers better performance when queries are used in a long piece of code.-One example:-var result = CustomerQuery.ExecuteFromDB();-var a = result.field; //This will be the database entry.-var b = result.CommonNode.field; //This will still be buffer entry.-If you use the DOT(.) operator on the query result to navigate via an association, you will see buffer data as the dot operator does a retrieve again. Every DOT is interpreted as retrieve which is a default read from buffer from the framework.-Resolution-Please kindly persist last saved data information in a custom BO or in some extension fields on ROOT node and then use ExecuteFromDB().-Keywords-ExecuteFromDB ExecuteFromDBDataOnly buffer ExecuteFromDB() ExecuteFromDBDataOnly()

Title: Not Assigned Values (#) in Assignment Details and User Logon Activity Reports
Content: Symptom-When reporting on standard User Activity reports, like Assignment Details and User Logon Activity Reports, the User related columns (for example: User, Changed By) are displaying # (not assigned) values for some of the report lines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Find and open report ABC ('ABC' represents the report name).-Run the report with the respective fields added to report results.-See that User related columns (for example: User, Changed By) are retrieving some # values.-Cause-The # values displayed are caused by Data De-Personalization / Deletion in the system. As part of Data Protection and Privacy policies, individuals may request the deletion of their personal data from the system. So when the personal data deletion occurs, the user activities related reports will display # (not assigned) values for all the User related fields.-For additional details, please check into See Also section.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-See Also-KBA: 2866980 - User Logon Activity Report Shows "Not Assigned" for all Users-Help Document: Remove Personal Data-Keywords-User Not Assigned; Not Assigned; Missing Data in Report;-not assigned,missing data in report,user not assigned,user logon acitvity

Title: Order of the Attributes Under Characteristics Cannot be Changed
Content: Symptom-Attributes in a report (the sub fields which come under the characteristics in 'Available Fields'), when added to Rows and Columns, cannot be moved up and down.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Open a report.-Go to Available Fields tab.-Select an attribute under a characteristic.-Go to the Rows and Columns tab.-Click the attribute.-The options like Move up or Move Down are not available.-Cause-The order of a field added as an attribute cannot be changed. It will be placed next to the parent characteristic.-Resolution-One can add the same field as a Master Data reference instead.-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Open a report.-Click Add Fields.-Select the field from the sub fields.-This field will be added as a Master Data Reference  eg: DEF(XYZ) where DEF is the field and XYZ is the characteristic.-Now go to Available Fields tab.-Select the field DEF(XYZ) from the list.-The same field having the same data will be added as a Master Data reference. Order of this Master Data Reference can be changed in the list of Rows and Columns.-Please also note that removing a characteristic will force the attributes of that characteristic to show inconsistent results or no results at all. An attribute cannot work without the characteristic in the view.- Keywords-order of characteristics, master data reference, attribute, rows and columns

Title: Error in Report Forecasted Demand: An Exception Was Raised
Content: Symptom-You are running the report Forecasted Demand (technical ID HCMRPMU02_Q0001) or Forecasted Utilization (technical ID HCMRPMU01_QICP001). However when using specific key dates, like for example Last 3 Months To Today or Last Day Of Current Month, you receive the following error message: 'An exception was raised'.-Alternatively, you may also see the message 'Key date must be later than current system date'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center where this report is assigned to, for example Project Management.-Go to the view Reports and open this report.-Enter a key date in the selection, for example Last 3 Months to Today.-Click Apply.-You see on of the error messages.-Cause-This report has 2 restrictions on the key date:-Since it is a forecast report, only dates in the future can be selected.-Only time periods can be selected, not single dates. So for example "Next 3 Months From Today" is a valid selection, however "Last Day of This Month" is not valid since it is a single date.-Resolution-If you would like to select different types of dates, you can create a report copy and change these settings. Please proceed as follows:-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Search for example for the report Forecasted Demand (technical ID HCMRPMU02_Q0001), mark the line and click New > Report as Copy.-In step 1, enter a report name.-In step 2, deselect the key figure group Forecasted Demand and instead, select the single key figures that are required.-In step 3, make sure you select the characteristic Calendar Day, in addition to the ones you need in your report.-In step 4, set the setting of this field to Using Variable.-In step 5, make sure that the selection type is Any Selection for the Calendar Day field.-Finish the report and assign it afterwards.-Keywords-forecast report, exception occurred, exception occured, Forecasted Demand, Forecasted Utilization, Key date must be later than current system, past key date

Title: Bank Statement formats available to import from TIS (Treasury Intelligence Solutions)
Content: Symptom-You want to use TIS (Treasury Intelligence Solutions) to import Bank Statements into Business ByDesign and you want to know what formats SAP Business ByDesign supports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-When a Bank Statement is imported to Business ByDesign, through the external service provider TIS, a corresponding import format is used based on the country code and statement type to execute the new bank statement.-The formats are maintained in the following Business Configuration activity:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Select the option Assign custom bank statement format.-The formats that are supported by SAP Business ByDesign are the following:-Import Format  Country Code Statement Type-MT940 DE DE - Germany MT940-BAI2 US - United States BAI-MT940 China CN - China MT940-MT940 DK DK - Denmark MT940-MT940 NL NL - Netherlands MT940-MT940 SG SG - Singapore MT940-MT940 UK GB - United Kingdom MT940-MT940 ZA ZA - South Africa MT940-MT940 Austria AT - Austria MT940-MT940 CH CH - Switzerland MT940-  In the scenario where you would like to use a format that is not mentioned in the above table you have two options:-Create a request for the country code and statement type on the Customer Influence Page (https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886).-Contact your Implementation Partner to create your own customer bank statement format for TIS Integration. And then add this custom format to the above list.-Keywords-TIS, Treasury Intelligence Solutions, Bank Statements, Import Format

Title: Error Message "Tax calculation for gross amount not supported, use net calculation" VAT Split Code
Content: Symptom-You are creating an invoice document with a VAT Split Code, and the system shows an error "Tax calculation for gross amount not supported, use net calculation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of Invoice Document)-The document ABC is Inconsistent due to the error message: "Tax calculation for gross amount not supported, use net calculation".-Cause-VAT Split Code is valid only for Net amounts. Gross amount is not supported, as this amount is payable directly to Tax Authorities.-Resolution-This is the initial requirement from Legal Authorities.-It's necessary to use Net amount.-Keywords-VAT Split Code ; Gross Amount ; Net Amount ; Invoice

Title: Unable to Manually Change Tax Amount From Canada Tax Code
Content: Symptom-System does not allow to change the Tax Amount manually from Canada Tax Code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search and open the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Supplier Invoice).-Enter a new amount in the Tax Amount field.-System reverts back to the calculated amount.-Cause-The handling and distribution of external amounts entered manually by the user on the header are not supported when the accounting tax type for the chosen Tax Event is "Self-assessed VAT" or "Use Tax".--This means that while using the following tax events for Canada, it is not possible to change the tax amounts from the User Interface (UI) manually: 122, 123, 124, 126, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 21, 23.-Resolution-To resolve this case, we suggest one of the following approaches:-Use the Tax Codes which correspond to the Tax Events other than those mentioned above. For example Tax Code 127.-Create a Z Tax Code in the system and map it to the Tax Events other than the ones mentioned above and assign the required tax types to it. You can then use the same tax code in the Supplier Invoice and edit the tax amounts on the UI as per the requirement.-Keywords-Tax Code, Canada, Tax Events, Tax Amount, Change Tax

Title: Error Message "You cannot access this project with your user, please use business user"
Content: Symptom-When you try access the Project Scope or Activity List of the Implementation Project or a Change Project, system throws below error message:-You cannot access this project with your user, please use business user-or-You have access to all workcenters and views irrespective of the workcenters assigned in Access Rights.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementations Projects view.-Select the First Implementation and select Edit Project Scope or Open Activity List button-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the user might have assigned to PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work centers.-Resolution-According to the documentation of the ByD Studio, those Work center views shall not be assigned to regular business users because of this fact.--Please try to access the Business Configuration with a user which don't have the PDI work centers assigned or un-assign the PDI work center and access the Business Configuration.

Title: Error: Changing Line Not Possible; Field is Read-Only in Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a new item to a Service Order using the ManageServiceOrderIn interface, however, the system is not allowing you to perform the update and it is returning the following error: Changing Line not possible; field is read-only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Once the Service Order is released and document status is no longer In Preparation, passing item ID is not allowed, hence the error.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.--Please remove the Item <ID> tag from under the <Item actionCode="XX"> tag of your payload and once the request is sent, the system will add the new item to the Service Order.-Please see below, a sample payload Request (XXXX represents the internal system ID's.):-         <ServiceOrder ItemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false" actionCode="02">-            <ID>XXXX</ID>-            <Item actionCode="01">-               <ID>XXXX</ID>-               <ProcessingTypeCode>SVP3</ProcessingTypeCode>-               <ItemProduct actionCode="01">-                  <ProductInternalID>XXXX</ProductInternalID>-                  <UnitOfMeasure>HUR</UnitOfMeasure>-               </ItemProduct>-               <Quantity unitCode="HUR">6</Quantity>-               <ItemTextCollection>-                  <Text>-                     <TypeCode>XXXX</TypeCode>-                     <ContentText>XXXX</ContentText>-                  </Text>-               </ItemTextCollection>-               <AddServiceAndSparePartsActionIndicator>true</AddServiceAndSparePartsActionIndicator>-               <RequestedFulfilmentItemPeriod>-                  <EndDateTime>2019-07-02T19:21:00Z</EndDateTime>-               </RequestedFulfilmentItemPeriod>-             </Item>-         </ServiceOrder>-      </glob:ServiceOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-Keywords-Web Service; ManageServiceOrderIn; Add; Item; Update; Service Order; <Note>Changing Line not possible; field is read-only</Note>

Title: Calculation Table is Not Available in Invoice Documents view
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add the Table Calculation for the Invoice Documents view, however, you do not see the option under the Personalization/Adaptation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Click on the user icon.-Select Start Personalization Mode.-Or-Click on Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Right Click on the table below Type.-The Calculation Table is not available.--You would expect the Calculation Table to be available as it is for example in the Sales Order OWL:-Cause-Since the Invoice Documents OWL (Object Work List) is SADL (Service Adaption Definition Language) based, the view does not support Aggregation and Calculation.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-If you need this functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by Cloud Service Center link. You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of Cloud Service Center link, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea.-Keywords-Calculation Table; Customer Invoicing; Invoice Documents; OWL; SADL;

Title: Total Item Net Value Does Not Match Total For Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-You notice a mismatch between the Total Net Value and Total Value for sales quote ABC in the Overview (ABC is the sales quote ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Search for the sales quote ABC and select it.-Click Edit.-Scroll down to items, there you can see for example:-Total Item Net Value is listed as 11 591.00 EUR,-Total shows 11 595.00 EUR.-Cause-The 2 fields displaying the total values are described as extension fields but are part of the regular layout.-Both are read only.-Click View all, navigate to the pricing tab.-Check total pricing:-Total Net Value is 11 591.00 EUR,-Total is 11 591.00 EUR.-All components are from list price but were added manually.-At header level, net value without freight and total are 11 595.00 EUR.-Resolution-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Search for sales quote ABC and select it.-Click Edit.-Click View all, navigate to the pricing tab.-Under Total Pricing header click Update Pricing and select one of the options.-This redetermines the values again. Hence now the correct value of 11 591.00 EUR is shown.-Keywords-total value, sales quote, value, net value

Title: System Crashes While Creating Remittance Advice
Content: Symptom-The system crashes upon creation of a remittance advice in Payment Monitor work center view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Search for the Outgoing Bank Transfer ID AAA (AAA means the Outgoing Bank Transfer ID).-Click Create Remittance Advice button.-System crashes.-Cause-There's no address maintained for the payee of Outgoing Bank Transfer ID AAA.-Resolution-Maintain an address in the master data of the respective payee of payment ID AAA (for example, a business partner person).-Once the address is maintained, it should be possible to create the remittance advice in Payment Monitor.-Keywords-remittance advice; business partner person; address; outgoing bank transfer; payment monitor

Title: Remove The Watermark From Form Output
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Customer would like to remove the watermark from previewed forms.-Environment-SAP ByDesign-Resolution-To remove the watermark from previewed forms customer would have to open your form in Adobe LifeCycle Designer and search for an attribute called WatermarkName.
