Title: Key Figures Behavior in KPI's
Content: Symptom-When working with a key performance indicator (KPI) in your system, you notice that the current value is being displayed as '0', however, when checking the report which the KPI is based on, the report is working without errors.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Design KPIs work center view.-Search for your KPI and click Preview.-Check the Current Value of the KPI.-In this scenario, the value '0' is shown instead of the expected value, according to the report the KPI is based on.-Cause-There are many causes which may cause this behavior when it comes to the KPIs, as stated in other KBAs. However, this issue might also be related to the specific key figure which is set in the Current Value section in the KPI parameters.-The key figure or the characteristic part of the selection which the KPI is using were added to the report via Add Fields (not via the report wizard). When added this way, the key figure or selection variable are technically not part of the report definition and the KPI cannot retrieve the key figure value.-Resolution-Please ensure the following settings in the report which is used by the KPI:-Add the key figure to the report via the report wizard (step 2).-Add the variable to the selection via the report wizard (step 4, select Using Variable for the respective fields).-See Also-In case the KPI is showing the '0' value even though these requirements are fulfilled, you may also check the KBAs 2629746 - KPI Shows 0 or a Wrong Value and 2547529 - KPI showing wrong value which describe some additional scenarios when it comes to wrong values or 0 values being displayed in KPIs.-Keywords-KPI; Key Figure; Zero; Analytics; 0; Current Value; add fields, business analytics, report-kpis,zero,kpi value,behvaiour

Title: Impact of the Posting and Requested Date on the Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager) report
Content: Symptom-While running the The Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager) report you noticed that some values are not considered by the report. In this case, the Key Figure Net Value (Incoming Sales Orders) seems to exclude specific Sales Orders amount where the Requested Date match the Calendar Year while the Posting Date doesn't.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center and choose Report List.-Open the Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager) report.-Choose the desired values from the Selection screen and select GO. (In this case, we select Calendar Year equal to 2014).-Add the desired Characteristics and Key Figures. (In this case, we display the Calendar Year and the Net Value (Incoming Sales Orders) Key Figure).-You noticed that some Sales Orders amounts are missing from the Net Value (Incoming Sales Orders) Key Figure.-When you drill down in the amount missing you could see that the missing Sales Orders had the Requested Date within the Calendar Year time frame selection (in this case 2014) although the Posting Date didn't (in this case 2013).-Cause-The system behavior is as designed.-Resolution-The Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Manager) report uses the Posting Date as main reference and does not take the Requested Date into consideration.-For this reason the Net Value (Incoming Sales Orders) Key Figure will include Sales Order amounts of Sales Order that have a Posting Date within the Calendar Year selection time frame.--The reasons why posting date of a sales order is considered are:-This is the date when the Sales Order document is entered in the system.-While invoicing the Posting Date is what is considered.-For a continuous fulfillment of a Sales Order the posting date is preferred/used (e.g. where SO item is project).

Title: The PDF Icon is Missing for the Customer Invoice in the Document Flow
Content: Symptom-You find that the PDF icon is Missing for the Customer Invoice in the Document Flow.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the customer invoice XYZ and choose the Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the Document Flow tab.-You find that the PDF icon is missing for the customer invoice.-Cause-The print task generated after the release of the customer invoice has not been confirmed by the responsible user.-Resolution-You have two options to get the PDF icon for the customer invoice in the document flow:-Confirm the print task generated for the invoice in Home work center.-Manually mark the PDF document to Set to Successful in the Output History tab of the customer invoice.-Follow the steps below to confirm the print task generated for the invoice in Home work center:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Work view.-Go to the Manual Print Tasks subview.-Search for the invoice document XYZ.-Select the invoice document and choose Confirm Task button.-Follow the steps below to manually mark the PDF document to Set to Successful in Output History tab of the customer invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the customer invoice XYZ and choose the Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the Output History tab.-Select the PDF and choose Set to Success button.-Save the customer invoice.

Title: Broadcasts: Status Indicator is Missing in Last Run Column
Content: Symptom-You notice that for some broadcasts, the column Last Run is not showing any indicator (green, yellow, orange), even though the broadcast was run.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Broadcasts.-Check the column Last Run.-For some broadcasts, it shows no green / yellow / orange indicator, even though it was run before.-Cause-This is currently a missing functionality when the following combined conditions are fulfilled:-The User-Specific indicator is checked for this broadcast.-The creator of the broadcast is not one of its recipients.-The last run was successful.-In these cases, unfortunately the Last Run column will remain blank.-Resolution-We are working to enhance this in a future release, however at this point in time, we cannot yet estimate a specific date.-If the run was not successful, there will be an orange indicator. If you require to see the green indicator as well, you could add the creator of the broadcast to the recipients as a workaround.

Title: The External Reference ID Assigned to the Customer Return Using PDI Does Not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-You have assigned external reference ID to the customer return using a PDI solution, but the system shows the error message Reference not assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer return).-Edit the customer return XYZ.-You get error message: Reference not assigned.-However you have already assigned a external reference to the returns using a PDI solution.-Cause-Creating reference for the items in return using a PDI solution is not supported in the SAP Business ByDesign system.-You can only assign the reference which is created in the SAP Business ByDesign system i. e. Sales Order or Invoice or Invoice Request(in case of over the counter sales).-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: The Service Confirmation has not been Created Automatically in the Third-Party Repair Scenario
Content: Symptom-The service confirmation has not been created automatically in the Third-Party Repair scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Create a New Service Order ABC for the third-party repair (ABC represents the ID of the service order).-Save and Release the service order for Execution.-Subsequent documents like Purchase Request, Purchase Order and Goods Service Receipt got created from the service order.-You are expecting creation of the Service Confirmation with the release of the Goods Service Receipt, however the Service Confirmation remains in Not Released status in the Field Service and Repair work center -> Service Confirmations view.-Cause-The service confirmation did not got released automatically because the Individual Material (Registered Product) XYZ used in the Purchase Order (created from the service order) is blocked (XYZ represents the ID of the registered product).-Resolution-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Orders Processing view.-Search for the service order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service order).-Select the service order and choose the Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the Documents Flow tab.-Select the ID of the purchase order DEF to open it in a new screen (DEF represents the ID of the purchase order).-Select the View All button in the purchase order DEF.-Go to the Items tab and select the Basic Data tab.-Find the registered product XYZ under Main Affected Product section (XYZ represents the ID of the registered product).-Open the registered product XYZ -> select the View All button -> Go to the General tab.-You can find the status of the registered product XYZ is Blocked.-Select the Change Status button and choose Active.

Title: You are not Able to Add the Extension Field in the Payment Section of the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add the extension field in the Payment section of the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order.-Enter into the Adaptation Mode and select View All button.-Go to the General tab.-No extension field can be added under Payment section.-Cause-The addition of extension field for the Payment section is not allowed in the General tab (View All mode).-However adaptation can be done in the Overview screen.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order.-Enter into the Adaptation Mode.-Do not select the View All mode as addition of the extension field for Payment section is only allowed in Overview screen.-In the overview screen you can add the extension field under Payment section.

Title: Error Occurs in the Sales Order While Selecting a Location at Item Level
Content: Symptom-Error Occurs in the sales order while selecting a location at item level.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order ABC and select the View All button.-Select the Items tab.-Add a line item as Material.-Select the Details subtab.-Maintain fulfillment as Internal and chose ship-from location as DEF (DEF represents the location ID).-Error occurs: Item 10: Location 1000 Energy must be of type site in master data.-Cause-The value help shows all locations, if you do not choose a valid one then there is an error message sent from the ATP check.-If you only want to see the valid locations/supplier, You should use the assign Source of Supply button. Here only the valid locations for the given item product are shown.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order ABC and select the View All button.-Select the Items tab.-Add a line item as Material.-Select the button Assign Source of Supply.-Now the system will show only valid locations in the value help.

Title: How to Change the Company Logo in Html5 in ByD
Content: Symptom-How do you change the company logo in the ByD Html5 UI?-Resolution-Logon in Html5.-Open the Key User Settings.-Start Adaptation mode.-Right click on the UI Element Background Design and use Change Company Logo.-Refer to the attached Screenshot.-

Title: You are not Able to Release Service Confirmation Due to Error "Release not possible; quantity exceeds inventory quantity at the area XYZ"
Content: Symptom- You are not able to release Service Confirmation due to error: Release not possible; quantity exceeds inventory quantity at the area XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the logistic area).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Service Confirmation view.-Search for the service confirmation ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the service confirmation ABC and choose the Edit button-Select the View All button and go to Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the Release button.-Error Occurs: Release not possible; quantity exceeds inventory quantity at the area XYZ.-Cause-In the Service confirmation you are trying to fulfill quantity more than available in the logistic area.-Follow the steps below to check the logistic area for the product maintained in the service confirmation: -Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Service Confirmation view.-Search for the service confirmation ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the service confirmation ABC and choose the Edit button-Select the View All button and go to the Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the  Parts(s) Consumption subtab.-Check for the field Logistics Area, you can see the logistic area maintained for the product is XYZ. -Follow the steps below to check the stock in the logistic area:-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Select Stock Overview under Common Tasks.-In the Stock Overview screen, search for the product DEF (DEF represents the ID of the product maintained in the service order).-In the result you can see stock available is for the product DEF in the logistic area XYZ.-Resolution-You need to increase the stock in the logistic area XYZ, before trying to release the service confirmation.

Title: You get Error Messages While Creating Follow-up Service Order From the Service Request
Content: Symptom-You get error messages while creating follow-up Service Order From the Service Request:-Currency missing;update account in Account Management work centre.-Party with roles sales unit missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Go to the Service Requests view.-Search for the service request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service request).-Select the service request XYZ and choose Follow-Up - Service Order.-You get below errors in the follow-up service order:-Currency missing;update account in Account Management work centre.-Party with roles sales unit missing.-Cause-The error occurs as the Service Order is not able to determine the Service Execution Team and hence Service Organization is not determined.-Resolution-You have two options for removing the error messages from the Service Order:-Manually add the Service Execution Team in the General tab of the Service Order.-Create a work distribution rule for the automatic determination of the Service Execution Team.-You can create a work distribution rule for determination of the Service Execution Team using below steps:.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Organization Work distribution view.-Select Service Execution Team for Service Orders under Business Area: Service and Support.-Edit the Service Execution Team for Service Orders.-Maintain a rule, this will ensure the automatic determination of Service Execution Team and Service Organization in the Service Orders.-Save your changes.

Title: Account Details data source showing same data for Created On and Changed On fields
Content: Symptom-When navigating in a report based on Account Details data source, you note that report results is showing the same data for both Created On and Changed On fields.-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system-Go to Business Analytics work center and Design Reports view-Search for the report ABC-Open and run the report, ensuring both Account, Changed On and Created On fields are included in Rows pane-Note that Changed On and Created On fields are showing the same value for some Accounts-Cause-This behavior occurs because once you create an Account in the system, it will assume that you're not only creating, but also you are changing the account at this given time. So, in other words, you're changing the account for the first time as you create it.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.

Title: Wrong Address is Displaying for a Specific Contact
Content: Symptom-You have observed that the same Contact is displaying different address in Contacts and Responsibilities tab of that Account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Contacts view.-Search and Edit the Contact.-Here the correct Address is displaying.-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Contacts view.-Search and Edit the Contact.-Go to Relationships tab.-Go to Responsibilities tab.-Here, the wrong address is displaying.-Resolution-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Contacts view.-Search and Edit the Contact.-This Address is maintained for the actual Contact.-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Contacts view.-Search and Edit the Contact.-Go to Relationships tab.-Go to Responsibilities tab.-This Address is picked from the Employee Workplace address. Because the Party Role is assigned to the Employee Role of Employee who has the role Contact.--This can be verified as follows,--1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.-2. Regular Tasks view.-3. Select Change Workplace Contact Data.-4. Input the Employee.--Here the address is same as above.,-This is expected system behavior.

Title: You are not able to Hand Over Freight Charges on Header Level of a Customer Invoice Request using Web ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn.
Content: Symptom-You are You are not able to hand over freight charges using Webservice  ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn  to the Header Level of a Customer Invoice Request.-Reproducing the Issue-You are filling the XML for creating the Invoice Request in Business ByDesign system from external system.-However the Web Manage Customer InvoiceRequestIn does not provide certain elements in the XML to carry the Freight Charges to Business ByDesign.- Cause-The customer invoice request web service does not allow you to add freights at the header level.-Resolution-There is a workaround available to get freights at the header level-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work center.-Select the Pricing view-Click Freights view-Click in the button New  and select Freight option.- Here you can maintain freights for the document "Invoice" and this will be taken into account when you create invoice from the external customer invoice request.

Title: Download Report Data in Text Format
Content: Symptom-You have some reports in your system and you currently need to download them in text file (.txt, .doc, etc). However, you cannot find this option in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center and Design Reports view.-Show All and Find XYZ report.-Open the report.-Click on Go button.-Move all the fields which you want to see in the report from Not Currently Shown to Rows.-Click on Download button.-See the available options as below-Report in Microsoft Excel® in XML Format-Report in CSV Format-Data Source in CSV Format-You cannot find Text Format there.-Cause-SAP provide only the shown options.-Resolution-This is the system designed behavior. We do not provide the Text Format option.

Title: Letter Character is Allowed in the Phone Number Field
Content: Symptom-While maintaining the phone number in account, you find system allows to save the phone number which includes letter characters, for example:1234ABCD.-You expect that the Phone field only allows numerical characters.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Accounts work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Open one certain account and go to Addresses tab.-Enter the phone 1234ABCD. System allows to save it.-Cause-It is possible that in some countries, they are using the letter to be part of the phone number.-PS: If you enter an special symbol, i.e.@, it will be removed automatically with an information message.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.

Title: Process Communication Error: 'Delivery group ID expected for item XX of order XYZ'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-A process communication error for service order XYZ and line item XX with the following error message occurs: Delivery group ID expected for item XX of order XYZ-An item or items of a service order are missing the delivery group ID, where the ID should have been assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-In the backend in SRT_MONI the following process communication error occurs for an XI Message of service order XYZ (XYZ represents the order ID and XX represents the line item number):-Sender Party: ServiceOrderProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn-Error: Delivery group ID expected for item XX of order XYZ-Cause-This is a known issue, which is caused by ATP failure on the service order.-Resolution-To solve this issue without the need to route the incident to development, please follow the steps below:-Obtain the customer's permission to perform a small dummy change in their system.-Once obtained, please do the following:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing.-Open the relevant service order-Navigate to the General tab - main information view.-Confirm that the Complete Delivery indicator is selected (if it is not, then delivery group ID is not relevant and should not have been assigned)-If this is selected, navigate to the Service and spare parts tab.-Highlight an item for which the delivery group ID is missing.-Navigate to the Spare part logistics sub tab.-You will see that the delivery rule is Single Delivery-Full Quantity.-Change this to Multiple Deliveries and hit enter.-Now change it back to Single Delivery-Full Quantity and hit enter again.-You should now see that a delivery group ID has been assigned to this item-Do this for all items which require it.-Save the order.-Restart any failing messages in the backend and they will now deliver successfully and the issue will be resolved.-

Title: Key Figures Amount posted until Key Date and Amount posted after Key Date not Usable
Content: Symptom-You have added the key figures Amount posted until Key Date / Amount posted after Key Date to the report Accounts Payable - Open Items via Settings > Key Figures, however they do not appear in the report.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report Accounts Payable - Open Items from the reports list of the respective work center.-Click on Settings > Key Figures.-Choose the key figures Key Figures Amount posted until Key Date and Amount posted after Key Date and move them to the Selected table. Click OK.-You noticed that the key figures are not displayed in the report.-Cause-These key figures are part of an hierarchy organization. They are subordinated to the key figure Balance Line Item Currency. You need to use Balance Line Item Currency ﻿in the report to display the other two key figures.-Resolution-Open the report and click on Settings > Key Figures.-Choose the key figures Amount posted until Key Date, Amount posted after Key Date and Balance Line Item Currency and move them to the Selected table. Click OK.-You can now expand the key figure Balance Line Item Currency. Here you will see Amount posted until Key Date and Amount posted after Key Date.

Title: Extension Field Value is Cleared After Changing the Account Party
Content: Symptom-You have some extension fields created on the service order. When creating new service order by using Copy function, you find the value of some extension fields are removed after changing the account party. But some values are remained.-You do not know the reason of the different behavior on extension fields.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Open one service order, there are 2 extension fields (ABC, DEF) you have created on the General tab. (ABC, DEF represent the name of extension field)-For example, the value of extension field ABC is 123. The value of extension field DEF is 789.-Click Copy to create a service order out of this one, the values of these extension fields are copied to the new service order as well.-Remove the account and enter an account again. You find the value of extension field ABC is removed. However, the value of extension field DEF remains as 789.-You are wondering why the behavior of these 2 extension fields are different.-Cause-The reason of the behavior is due to the extension scenario:Account - General Information to Service Documents - General Information.--The scenario is enabled on the extension field ABC. Since you change the account in the new service order, it triggers a data redetermination on the extension field. Because there is no value maintained in the account master data, so the field is cleared. However, the field DEF has no extension scenario activated, so there is no data refresh when account changes.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.

Title: Updated Additional Entry Days Not Reflected in Process Control
Content: Symptom-You change the Additional Entry Days from the default 15 days to 20 days, for example, but the change does not take effect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center and choose the Master Data view.-Select the Companies view.-Select the Company ID and Set of Books and then choose Set Additional Entry Days under Actions.-Change the Additional Entry Days from the default 15 days to 20, for example, and then click OK.-Choose Open and Close Periods.-You then move on to check process control of those Not Blocked periods, and you can see the Entry Possible Until date is still 15 days after the end of the period.-You also try to select one Not Blocked period and change the First Allowed or Last Allowed step to make sure 10 - Operational Posting is not included.  -After that, you directly change them back and make sure 10 - Operational Posting is included again.-But the Additional Entry Days in the newly created process control are still 15 days.-Cause-If you open an accounting period with the closing step 10 — Operational Postings, the system automatically creates an entry in the process control with the updated additional entry days.-If you close the accounting period, the entry is automatically deleted.-However, the updated additional days will not be reflected in the already opened periods, so the additional entry days in these open periods remain as 15 days.-Resolution-For the new Additional Entry Days to take effect in the already opened periods, follow the steps below after you change the Additional Entry Days: -Go to the General Ledger work center and choose Open and Close Periods.-Select the combination of Company ID and Set of Books, for which you change the Additional Entry Days.-Select one Not Blocked period, do a dummy change, and then revert the change: the updated Additional Entry Days should be reflected in the Entry Possible Until field of the process control of this period.-For example, change the First Allowed Step to 015 - Late Operational Posting, and make sure the step 10 - Operational Posting is not included.-Save it.-After that, change it back to 010 - Operational Posting, and then press ENTER.-The update Additional Entry Days are reflected in the Entry Possible Until field of the process control of this period.-Keywords-Additional Entry Days; process control; first allowed step; last allowed step; open and close periods

Title: Not Assigned Service Order ID in Profitability Report
Content: Symptom-You have executed a profitability report with service order ID characteristic, however you notice that, for some entries in the fiscal year, the ID is either in blank or has '#' (Not Assigned).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Sources view.-Show All and Find FINPRFU01 (Profitability : Order Profit).-Click on Preview button.-Move Customer, Associated Service Order ID and Fiscal Year characteristics from Not Currently Shown section to Rows.-For a specific customer, you notice that the Associated Service Order ID  shows in blank or '#' Not Assigned for e.g. fiscal year 2016.-Cause-The reason why the field is in blank/# for the fiscal years is because those rows belong to other objects and not service orders. This data source shows everything, Sales Order, Service Orders, Contracts, etc. Some of those items actually belong to Sales Orders and not Service Orders.-Resolution-In order to properly distinguish the documents in the data source, you may include further characteristics such as the Associated Sales Order ID. Hence, the #-Not Assigned entry for the Associated Service Order ID would have an ID under Associated Sales Order ID if the document is a sales order.

Title: Unable to Select Multiple Companies in <XXX> Financial Reports
Content: Symptom-You want to select multiple companies for Company ID field in <XXX> financial reports.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Report view and click on the List option.-Open and run the involved <XXX> financial report in web browser.-Move the Company ID field from Not currently shown section to the report.-Here, you wish to select multiple companies for the Company ID field.-Cause-The data in these reports will depends upon the set of books. The restrictions have been made to make sure that the same Set of Books are available. The fiscal year variant is defined per set of books and if the fiscal year variant is different for two set of books then report will not return inconsistent data as comparisons can not be made.--These restrictions have been set in SAP delivered reports to ensure that only single value for the field Company ID in financial reports are entered. The G/L or profit revenue generating reports are expected to show the results for only one company at a time.-Resolution-This is designed functionality for most of financial reports such as G/L and profit revenue reports.-As these restrictions are designed in SAP delivered reports and not hard coded in the data source, workaround is available by which you can create a new report based on involved data source to have multiple company selection.-Please follow below mentioned for the workaround if companies are using same set of books:-Go to Business Analytics work center and click on Design Reports view.-Click on New button and select option Report.-On the New Report Screen, give the name of the report and the data source you want to base the report on.-Click on Next button to go next steps.-Step 2: Select Key figures as required.-Using Next button, go to Steps 3: Select Characteristics that you need to display in the report.-Here, by clicking in the check box corresponding to characteristic name, you can select or deselect the characteristic as per your requirement.-Clicking on next button, go to Step 4: Characteristic Properties.-Here, as you would want to have field Company in the variable selection section to be able to select multiple companies, select Using variable from drop down of value selection column.-In Step 5: Define Variables; as in previous tab, Company field has been set as variable, here you can choose the selection type to be Multiple Values. This will allows you to have multiple companies in the Company field in the report.-Finish and save the report creation.-Now, when the new created report is run in the web browser, you will be able to select multiple companies in Company field.

Title: Managing My Area Work Center can be assigned to Non-Managers
