Within Managing My Area such user has access to data of all Org Units (comparable to a user who is manager of the highest Org Unit).-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-The Administrator has to ensure that the Managing My Area work center is only assigned to users with manager function.

Title: Customized Tax Jurisdiction Code is Not Appearing in Account Master Data
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Tax Jurisdiction Code in Business Configuration, but it is not available when adding new address in account master data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Find the activity Tax on Goods and Services - US.-Open Define Tax Jurisdictions, you can see the code ABC is maintained. (ABC represents the ID of tax jurisdiction code)-Go to the Account Management work center.-Open one account and go to Communication - Addresses tab.-Click Add Row, maintain the country to US and State.-Open Tax Jurisdiction Code selection list, the code ABC is not available.-Cause-You have to maintain the Tax Rate Schedule for the Tax Jurisdiction Code.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Find the activity Tax on Goods and Services - US.-Open Define Sales Tax Rate Schedules.-Click Add Row, and maintain the tax rate for this code.-Afterwards, it will be available in the account master data.

Title: Error Message: Service Order Missing In Aa Petty Cash Transaction
Content: Symptom-You get an error Service order missing while selecting the service order option in the Outgoing Cash Payment - Direct posting to G/L Account for Petty Cash.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Workcenter.-Navigate to the Petty cash view.-In the New tab, select Outgoing Cash Payment - Direct posting to G/L Account for Petty cash - Petty Cash.-Enter the Mandatory details as in Payee -XXXX.-In the account assignment section, select the Service order option and choose a GL account.-The system displays an error message as Service order missing.-Cause-The Service Orders in Petty Cash are not supported in Business Bydesign system.-Resolution-The System behaves as designed .

Title: Solution ABC_ cannot be enabled in the front end application
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message Solution ABC_ cannot be enabled in the front end application while activating /enabling the solution.-Below is the error screenshot :--Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the Solution-Go to Administration tab , select implementation manager-Under the current version you can see the status .-Click on ﻿Enable-Cause-To avoid inconsistency we do not allow the BC sets creation on standard SAP BCOs.-Resolution-Solution can not be enabled, as you have developed BC sets on standard SAP BCOs.-Its the known restriction.

Title: Sales Targets for Incoming and Invoiced Orders (Manager) Report Does not Show "Opportunities Expected" and "Opportunities Weighted" Values
Content: Symptom-Sales Targets for Incoming and Invoiced Orders (Manager) report does not show Opportunities Expected and Opportunities Weighted values.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to view the report in the Managing My Area work center:-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Reports view -> List (Sales Planning).-Open the report Sales Targets for Incoming and Invoiced Orders (Manager).-Execute it for plan XXX- YYY (XXX - YYY represents the plan period).-The two fields Opportunities Expected and Opportunities Weighted will show blank.-Follow the steps below to view the report in the Business Analytics work center:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Open the report Sales Targets for Incoming and Invoiced Orders (Manager).-Execute it for plan XXX- YYY (XXX - YYY represents the plan period).-The two fields Opportunities Expected and Opportunities Weighted will show blank.-Cause-The report Sales Targets for Incoming and Invoiced Orders (Manager) is only meant for the manger and end users cannot access the important data of this report even though the access has been provided to them.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Cannot Add Down Payment Request to Item to be Invoiced
Content: Symptom-You cannot add a down payment request to an item to be invoiced.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-In the Show field select the All Items option.-Select the respective item to be invoiced e. g. outbound delivery invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents the document identification number of the outbound delivery).-Highlight the outbound delivery invoice request XYZ and press the Edit button.-Select the General tab.-In the Reference Documents section press the Add Row button.-Press the value help in the Down Payment Request ID field.  -The Down Payment Request ID ABC is not displayed in the result list (ABC represents the document identification number of the down payment request).-Cause-Only a down payment can be assigned to an item to be invoiced. The down payment request ABC is only a request, no payment has been cleared and hence you cannot assign it to the outbound delivery XYZ in your Invoice Requests. The down payment request needs to be in status Cleared.-Here the explanation of the full process:-You ask the customer for a down payment, also called a down payment request. This down payment request is sent to the customer. This request is handled in the trade receivables as an open item, which can be included in dunning, is part of the balance confirmation or can be paid. But it is not posted in the General Ledger. It does also not update the taxes. Taxes are only due when the payment is received. After having received the payment and identified this payment to clear a down payment request, the taxes are updated and will be reported in the next tax declaration. Also, accounting is informed and the posting to general ledger accounts can take place. The final invoice is issued and the down payment received is assigned to the invoice. The clearing is also updating the General Ledger so that a reposting from down payments received to receivables is done. Also, the taxes posted during the down payment are cancelled so that the tax information on the invoice is the final one. The residuary open amount is now ready to be cleared with the final payment.-You can find more detailed information in the integrated Help under the Topic: Down Payments From Customers- Resolution-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer view.-Select the Customer Account sub view.-From Show list select All Customers and Find account EFG (EFG represents the account identification number of the customer account).-Select the account EFG and choose View Account. A new window will open up.-In the Trade Receivables tab activate the Include Statistical Items checkbox.-In the Show drop down select All Items.-You can see that down payment request ABC is still in status Open.-To clear this Down Payment Request you have to select both the respective Open payment and the Open down payment request ABC.-Select Clear Manually. A new window will open.-To clear both press the Match items and then the Clear button.-The down payment request ABC will be in status Cleared and a new document, down payment ABC,  will be created.-This down payment can then be assigned to the item to be invoiced.

Title: You Have Select 'Cancel Pending Invoice requests' for Your Contract's Items But the Invoice Request are not Canceled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You have select Cancel Pending Invoice requests for your Contract's Items But the Invoice Request are not Canceled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-Edit the Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the contract).-Go to View All.-Go to the items tab.-Select Cancel Pending Invoice requests against all items.-You expect that all invoice request for contract XYZ are canceled.-Cause-There are basically 2 cases:-The fulfillment of the contract item is not set to finished.-The fulfillment is set to finish.-In each case you have to consider Customer Invoice Request (CIR) and Customer Invoice (CI).-Fulfillment of the contract is not set to finish:-You can cancel the contract item by setting a cancelation date and cancelation reason.-You can also specify if the CIR should be canceled or not (This field is always enabled, but it really makes sense once the item is canceled. If you change this field without item cancelation, nothing happens)-A BTM task is run at the cancelation date and sets the item to cancel.-In regards to invoice there are 2 issues:-- In case there are already invoices against the contract item these invoices needs to be canceled manually. They will not be canceled by sending a message to CI.-- In case there are CIR against the contract item and by cancelation of the contract the customer specifies With CIR cancelation then they will be canceled by sending a message to CI.-Once the item is canceled, the contract item end date will be set to cancelation date.-A BTM task will then run and sets the item validity date to “Expired” and so the item will be completed-Fulfillment of the contract item is set to finish-You cannot cancel this item, since the fulfillment is finished. There has been efforts to fulfill the contract and therefore it cannot be canceled.-Resolution-Development is looking into the requirement to cancel a contract when the contract has been fulfilled.-In case the contract is fulfilled it is no longer possible to cancel the contract item. If you do not want to create an invoice for the time being you have the possibility to apply an invoice block on the contract.

Title: Error Message: Third Party Location Not Valid for Sales Kit items
Content: Symptom-You try to assign external warehouse XYZ as source of supply to your sales document, you receive the error message.-Item XX : Third Party Location Not Valid for Sales Kit items.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Choose New Sales Order view.-Provide mandatory information and choose View All.-Navigate to Items page.-Choose Add Row.-Input the sales kit ABC ﻿and choose the external warehouse XYZ as source of supply.-Cause-In the current version, we do not allow external fulfillment for sales kit and hence you are getting the error message.-Currently we do not support sales kit in third party order scenario.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior and system behaves as designed.

Title: Sales Quotes Are Not Being Shown in The Sales Quotes View
Content: Symptom-The Sales Quotes are not being shown in the Sales Quote view for a business user even though the New Business work center and the Sales Quotes view has been assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Click on the Go button.-The sales quotes are not being shown.-Cause-The business user belongs to an Organization Unit but this unit has not been assigned to the user in the Access Rights.-Resolution-You can assign the Organisation Unit to a business user in the Access Rights.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management and go to Business Users view.-Show All Business Users.-Edit Access Rights of the Business User XYZ (XYZ is the identification of the business user).-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Select CRM_SALESQUOTES work center ID.-Go to the Detailed Restrictions sub tab.-Here you can assign the corresponding Organization Unit to the business user.

Title: Account Determination Missing For Item Type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation
Content: Symptom-During the migration of the fixed asset you get the following errors:-Account determination missing for item type Proportionally Accumulated Regular Depreciation.-Journal entry voucher cannot be posted.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Select Integrate and Extend chevron.-Search and open Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Open the Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link and create a new unit.-Select the new unit and click Execute Migration.-Click Upload File to upload the Fixed Assets data.-Click Process File ﻿and simulation is not successful-Cause-For the inventory id 123 you maintained in the migration file you have assigned fixed asset class XYZ for which the account determination group maintained is PQR. Currently you observe no general ledger account assigned is done in the fine-tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Resolution-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Go to Implementation Project view and select Fine-Tune activity.-Select and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination, select the Fixed Assets subledger, sub tab Depreciation.-Select your Account Determination Group for Fixed Assets PQR, which belong to your fixed asset class XYZ.- Maintain the combination of this account determination PQR and General Ledger Account for it under the tab Accumulated Depreciation. Now you perform the migration then fixed asset migration will be successful.

Title: You are not able to Generate Renewal Order Using the View "Generate Renewal" (Valid for Customer Numerical Algorithms Group Limited )
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are not able to Generate Renewal Order using the View Generate Renewal  (Valid for Customer Numerical Algorithms Group Limited).-Reproducing the Issue-This functionality has been provided by Service Center for customer : Numerical Algorithms Group Limited. -Go to Sales Order work center.-Select Generate Renewals option.-Once the customer has launched the renewal an email should be sent informing him/her the number of Sales Orders have been created and any which have failed. -The customer receive the following email :-Total line item selected:-Successfully completed line items:XXX-Error items:0-XXX represents the number of line items.-The email is stating that there is no errors, however, the customer cannot see the renewal orders.- Cause-This issue should be investigated by development colleagues.-Resolution-Please send the incident to component : SRD-CCS.-Contact Name in development : Meyana, Prajul.-In case of issue in the view Customer Products please also follow the same approach.-

Title: When a Credit Card is Used for a Sales Order the Payment Terms Should be "Due Immediately"
Content: Symptom-When a credit card is used for a sales order the payment terms should be Due Immediately.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Enter the mandatory details and add a product under Items.-Select the payment method as Credit Card.-Once the credit card is selected as payment method then the system should override the standard payment term to the Due Immediately.-Cause-This is a very specific use case which deviates from the standard behavior.-Generally the requirement is that the payment term should always be picked from the distribution chain.-Hence in case of credit card also the only option is to to manually change the payment terms.--Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.

Title: Changing the Requested Date in Sales Order triggers an Outbound Delivery Automatically
Content: Symptom-Changing the requested date in Sales Order triggers an outbound delivery automatically.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Show All Orders.-Search for the ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Click the Edit button for the Sales Order ABC-Click on the View All button.-Select the Items tab.-Select the Item XYZ (XYZ represents the line item ID).-Navigate to the Details subtab. -Change the requested date to one day ahead in future.-This change has triggered the automatic release of the outbound delivery however you would like to initiate the outbound delivery manually.-Cause-The system is behaving as expected, the delivery is done due to the setting maintained by the customer in the sales order ABC. The Delivery Priority maintained for the sales order is Immediate due to which automatic release of the outbound delivery has been triggered.-Follow the steps below to check the delivery priority of the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Show All Orders.-Search for the ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Click the Edit button for the Sales Order ABC-Click on the View All button.-Select the General tab.-The Delivery Priority maintained is Immediate.-  Resolution-You should maintain the delivery priority as Normal for the delivery based on the date maintained in the sales order.-Follow the steps below to maintain the delivery priority as Normal:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Show All Orders.-Search for the ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Click the Edit button for the Sales Order ABC-Click on the View All button.-Select the General tab.-Set the delivery priority as Normal.-

Title: Detailed Explanation of the User Authorizations for Customer Accounts
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Use Only-This case document provides a detailed explanation of the user authorizations for customer accounts.-Reproducing the Issue-The user does not have the expected restrictions for a customer account.-Cause-The authorizations of the user for an account depend upon the restrictions maintained for the user.-Resolution-The account restriction does not consider employee work distribution rules but only direct responsibilities which are maintained in the account user interface directly.-If you maintained direct responsibilities in the account user interface, you can restrict the access for this account instance.-If no direct responsibility is maintained no instance restriction is possible (every user can access the instance).-If you maintain the instance restrictions for a business user (Application and User Management work center) you can maintain for the accounts work center view the restriction on:-Functional unit level (i. e. sales unit) or-Employee level-Hence only for the account where a responsibility is maintained the restriction on basis of sales unit will work. You can find the direct responsibility in the Accounts -> Contacts tab -> Relationship & Responsibilities.--Example:-MOM (Organization Management)--Company1-Sales Unit 1-Employee1-Employee2-Employee3 (Manager of the sales unit1)-Sales unit 2-Employee-Customers-Customer 1 (C1) with direct responsible Employee1.-Customer 2 (C2) with direct responsible Employee2.-Customer 3 (C3) with direct responsible Employee4.-Customer 4 (C4) without direct responsibility.-Users Restrictions-User 1 – Accounts view restricted on Employee1.-User 2 – Accounts view restricted on Employee2.-User 3 – Accounts view restricted on Sales Unit1-User 4 – Accounts view restricted on Sales Unit2-User1 will see in the accounts view: C1 (restriction fits to the authorization of user1) , C4 (no restriction)-User2 will see in the accounts view: C2 (restriction fits to the authorization of user2) , C4 (no restriction)-User3 will see in the accounts view: C1 + C2 (as employee1+2 belong to sales unit1(MOM) and they are direct responsible for C1+2) , C4 (no restriction)-User4 will see in the accounts view: C3 (as employee4 belong to sales unit2 (MOM) and he is direct respponsible for C3) , C4 (no restriction)-Additional limitations:-The instance restriction will only work for the accounts view (not for the enterprise search and not for account value helps (i. e. in the sales order).-Since FP3.5 the direct responsibilities can be uploaded together with the accounts during the account migration, but there is no mass maintenance possibility afterwards (planned for future).-Currently it is not planned to consider indirect responsibilities for the account instance restriction.

Title: VAT ID of the Bill-to Party is not Displayed on the Customer Invoice Form
Content: Symptom-VAT ID of the bill-to party is not displayed on the customer invoice form.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the invoice ID).-Select the invoice ID XYZ and choose Preview button.-The PDF invoice form does not display the VAT ID of the bill-to party.-Cause-You are using an adapted form template in which you have not done the mapping for the VAT ID of the Bill-to party.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Select the Form template Maintenance sub view.-Search for the form template ABC (ABC represents the adapted form template).-Open the form template in Easy Form Editor.-Select the Contact and Document Information Section.-Now under the table Details: Contact and Document Information.-Find the Your VAT Reg. Number field.-You need to map the Your VAT Reg. Number field to the adapted customer invoice form template.-For more details on form adaptation you can go through below help documentation available in the Business ByDesign system:-Form Template Adaptation.-Form Template Maintenance Quick Guide.-Template Maintenance - Configuration Guide.

Title: The Field Added in the Sales Quote Form Template Appears in Preview but not in the PDF Generated in the Output History
Content: Symptom-The field added in the sales quote form template appears in Preview but not in the PDF generated in the Output History of the sales quote.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote.-Select the Preview button.-In the Preview shows the Internal Comments field added in the form template.-Now open the sales quote in View All mode.-Go to the Output History tab.-Open the PDF, the Internal Comments field is not available here.-Cause-The changes include the form template by adding the Internal Comments field was done after the generation of the Output History in the sales quote XYZ.-The Preview always shows the latest form template changes, however the Output History is a historical record which shows the data as per the form template data during the submission of the quote.--You can test another Quote which has been completed after the changes made in the form template, this quote shows the Internal Comments field.-Note: The behavior is same in other business documents like Sales Order, Customer Invoice etc.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: The Currency is Not Displayed for Y-Axis in The Chart Report View
Content: Symptom-The currency for the key figures are not being displayed for Y-Axis in the report chart mode (e.g. US, GBP, CNY, INR, etc...).-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to C4C in HTML5-Go to Analysis -> Reports-Open the report view-Click on Go-Currency selected for report not showing in Axis-Cause-You should have more than one unit existent for the currency key figures. If so, it is an expected behavior. The current logic checks for units in values, If it has two or more different units (or even empty) then it treats it as difference in units.-As consequence, the system cannot provide any unit for the axis label, nevertheless the tooltip adapts to its respective unit and it shows the label accordingly.-Resolution-In case you still want to display the currency in Y-Axis regardless if you have assorted units involved, you still can maintain the Y-Axis label in the Chart Settings by customizing it in the following way:--Open the report-Click on the Show More icon (gear icon)-Click on Chart Settings-Check 'Show my Axis Description' box-Fill out the Y-Axis Label (e.g. GBP, US, CNY, INR)-Save the view

Title: The Status of the Sales Order is "In Process" Though the Delivery and Invoicing is already Complete
Content: Symptom-The status of the sales order is In Process though the delivery and invoicing is already complete.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-The status of the sales order in General tab is In Process.-In the Items tab the Delivery Status and Invoice Status is In Process.-However the outbound delivery and invoice is already created for the sales order.-Cause-The outbound delivery document created for the sales order was un-released after the release of the invoice due to which the status of the sales order is still In Process.-Follow the status below to check the delivery status of the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-In the document flow the check the status of the outbound delivery which is Not-Released.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Document Flow tab and open the outbound delivery ABC (ABC represents the ID of the outbound delivery).-Release the outbound delivery ABC.-Now the status of the sales order is Completed.-

Title: Product Discount Maintained as Automatic Entry has Priority and Therefore You Expect Discount Field in Sales Quote as Editable
Content: Symptom-The Discount field in the Sales Quote is greyed out and cannot be edited manually, although the user expects the field to be editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesgin-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Under Common Tasks, select New Sales Quote.-Enter the required Account details and maintain the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel.-Click View All and navigate to the Items tab.-Enter Product ABC (ABC represents the Product ID).-Observe that the system automatically determines a discount of XX%.-Check the Discount (%) field and observe that it is greyed out and cannot be edited manually.-Cause-The Automatic Entry Has Priority option is enabled in the Manual Change Control in pricing procedure under Configure Price Strategy. With this setting, a price component value can only be manually changed when it has not already been determined automatically by the system. Therefore, when a discount is automatically determined, the Discount (%) field in the Sales Quote is greyed out and cannot be edited.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-If you want to make the Discount (%) field editable in the Sales Quote, change the Manual Change Control setting from Automatic Entry Has Priority to Manual Entry Has Priority.-Follow these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search and open Configure Price Strategy.-Open the Pricing Procedure.-Locate Product Discount (%).-Under the Manual Change Control column, change the setting from Automatic Entry Has Priority to Manual Entry Has Priority.-Save the changes.-After this configuration is updated, the Discount (%) field in the Sales Quote can be manually edited.-Keywords-Sales Quote Discount; Discount Field Not Editable; Automatic Entry Has Priority; Manual Entry Has Priority; Configure Price Strategy

Title: How to Retrive Output History Data of the CRM Documents in Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to Retrive Output History data of the CRM Documents in backend.-Due to issue in the printing some of the PDF could not have been sent to output history or they are sent with error. Now customer want a list of such business documents as the data cannot be retrived from frontend.-Reproducing the Issue-You get the incident from customer where they need the document IDs for which output history is not available (e.g. 3500027168).-Send this incident to the relevant Expert Support Application (e.g. CRM for Sales Orders), and request them to provide the list of all documents for which output history is missing.-Once you have the data from application, send the incident to AP-RC-OUT or ES-Output Management component to get the list of document ID’s which are actually printed(e.g. between duration 05/03/12 to 22/03/12).-How to get the Missing Documents = List retrieved after executing the query given by application team – List given by Output Management team.-We have to compare the data manually in the excel to retrieve the exact documents.Send the missing document details to customer.-Follow the steps below to see the empty output history in one of the CRM document i.e. Sales Order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and go to the Output History tab.-The output history is empty though the sales order is completed and for the completed sales orders a re-submission cannot be done.-The above scenario is also valid for other CRM documents like sales quote, customer invoice etc.-Cause-The issue occurred due to failure of ADS server.-Resolution-The retrival method of output history data is not same for all BO's. Below is the description for retriving the required data from different CRM BO's:-1. Sales Orders:-Login to the backend.-Go to the transaction SESFTS and open the BO Sales_Order.-Do a Query by Elements.-Select all relevant sales orders using the query for the required date range e.g. CreationDateTime LT 16.03.2012 00:00:00.0000000 Z AND LastChangeDateTime GE 05.03.2012 00:00:00.0000000 Z.-Select Status/ConfirmationIssuingStatusCode = 1 in the query (1 represents Not Issued output).-Select all the records navigate to the Ctrl_Output_Request =>Select all the records and navigate to the ProcessedItem.-Export the List to Excel.-In the excel sort all the records whose output status code is 1 or 3 (1 is for Pending status and 3 is for Error status). -2. Customer Invoice:-Login to the backend.-Go to the transaction SESFTS and open the BO APCI_Customer_Invoice.-Do a Query by Elements.-Select all relevant invoices using the query for the required date range e.g. CreationDateTime LT 16.03.2012 00:00:00.0000000 Z AND LastChangeDateTime GE 05.03.2012 00:00:00.0000000 Z.-Select ReleaseStatusCode = 3 in the query (3 represents relased invoice, Invoices get printed when they are released.).-Select All the records navigate to the Ctrl_Output_Request =>Select all the records and navigate to the ProcessedItem.-Export the List to Excel.-In the excel sort all the records whose output status code is 1 or 3 (1 is for Pending status and 3 is for Error status). -3. Sales Quote:-Login to the backend.-Go to the transaction SESFTS and open the BO Customer_Quote.-Do a Query by Elements.-Select all relevant sales quotes using the query for the required date range e.g. CreationDateTime LT 16.03.2012 00:00:00.0000000 Z AND LastChangeDateTime GE 05.03.2012 00:00:00.0000000 Z.-Select Status/ConfirmationIssuingStatusCode = 1 in the query (1 represents Not Issued output).-Select All the records navigate to the Ctrl_Output_Request =>Select all the records and navigate to ProcessedItem.-Export the List to Excel.-In the excel sort all the records whose output status code is 1 or 3 (1 is for Pending status and 3 is for Error status). -Similarly the list for other business documents can be retrived. -Once you have the data from application, send the incident to AP-RC-OUT or ES-Output Management component to get the list of document ID’s which are actually printed.-See Also-Details for Output Management team:-How to get the Missing Documents = List retrieved after executing the query given by application team – List given by Output Management team.-Steps to be followed by output team in the backend to get the required records:-1. Search table /doc/d_oe_root with status_code = 2, log_type_id = 006(CM_OM_CFC) or 009(CM_OM_CFC) or 010(CM_OM_CFC) or 011(CM_OM_CFC),-then you will get on list, get all db_key for next search.-2. Search table /doc/d_oe_item with parent_key = <step 1 result> and item_status_code = 2, then you get list, get all bo_obj_id for next search.-3 search table /doc/d_om_his with id = <step 2 result>, you will get list, these are all history records for ADS error, you could find information at field document_title and form_group_code for which-business.-Now you can compare the records from the application and the records from output tables to get the list of missing documents.-Note: It is not possible to generate the Output History for the document again, hence the workaround is to use the PDF from the Preview option.

Title: Bank Payment Advice Status as In Preparation
Content: Symptom-In Advanced Search of Bank Payment Advice, there is status as In Preparation, but it is just an internal status. It is impossible to create bank payment advice with such status.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center and Bank Payment Advice view.-Select Advaced Search.-Open the drop down list of Status, there is a status as In Preparation.-However, if you create a new bank payment advice, you can only release it but cannot save it as In Preparation.-Cause-Status of In Preparation is an internal status for technical usage.-It is not feasible to hide it from status list.-Resolution-There is no result if we search bank payment advice with status as In Preparation.

Title: Packing & Forwarding Price Component are not Available in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-The Packing & Forwarding price component are not available in the customer invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Edit the invoice and choose the View All button.-Go to the Pricing tab.-The Packaging & Forwarding charges are not available under Total Pricing section.-Cause-The price component Pricing & Forwarding has to be added manually in the customer invoice.-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoicing Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Edit the invoice and go to the Pricing tab.-Select the Add Row button under the Total Pricing section.-Select the price component Packing & Forwarding and add the amount.-Save the changes.-However you will be able to add the price component Packing & Forwarding manually only in those invoices which are not released.

Title: Rules Type Drop Down List for Memo Line is Not Displaying any Value
Content: Symptom-Rule type drop down list is missing for configure rules to analyze memo lines in Bank Statement.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Open the activity Global Settings for Payment-Here you find the option to Create and edit rules for analyzing memo lines-In the column Rule Type, you observe that the drop down list is not coming.-Cause-The reason that Rule Type drop down is not appearing because the Rule is not entered first.-Resolution-In order to get the Rule Type drop down list, first you need select the Rule, once you select the Rule, accordingly the system provides the Rule Type drop down list.-Go to Work Center Business Configuration-Open the activity Global Settings for Payment-Here you find the option Create and edit rules for analyzing memo lines-In the column Rule, you need to select the Rule first-Then in Rule Type column you can see the drop down list

Title: Service Confirmation not created for Service order and Goods and Service Reciept(GSA)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Service Confirmation is not created immediately after the GSA is posted and the inbound process is completed in the third party scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Field and Service Repair workcenter.-Go to Service Confirmation view and show All Service Confirmations.-Go to advanced search and enter the service order Id ABC and click on go(ABC is the ID of the Service Order for which the Service Confirmation is not created).-You find that the service confirmation is not created for the service order ABC.-Login to backend, use transaction SEFTS and go Service Order BO and search for service order ABC, you will find a failing message which upon restart will be successful.- Cause-Whenever a GSA is posted, a message from GSA is triggered for confirmation creation and another message from PR to service order to adjust the fulfilled quantity. Since both these messages access the service order, one of the messages encounters the lock and waits for a retry. There are 7 automatic retries that happen on the source document(service order) over a span of 2 hours in incremental wait-time. Whenever the GSA finds the service order unlocked, it creates the service confirmation. This is standard functionality and the reason why the user might not see the confirmation immediately.-Resolution-This is the system standard behavior.

Title: In the Account Advanced Search the List of State/Region is Not Returning Any Value
Content: Symptom-In the account advanced search the list of State/Region is not returning any value. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Choose Accounts view-Select All Account then select Go-Choose Advanced hyperlink-Go to the State Field-You are not able to fetch any values whereas the correct master data are maintained in the system-Cause-Region and State depends on the Country. The country needs to be filled as a prerequisite.-Resolution-Go to Account Management work center-Choose Accounts view-Select All Account then select Go-Choose Advanced hyperlink-Fill the country field with country XYZ (XYZ represents the name of the country)-Go to the field State-You should now be able to see in the drop down all the values for region or state.

Title: Fixed Value Selections for the Characteristic Sales Unit - No Report Results Shown
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the Fixed Value Selections for Sales Unit does not pull data for managers assigned to Sales Units within the org structure.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Search for any Data Source XYZ (XYZ represents the name of the Data Source) which has the ﻿Characteristic Sales Unit, say for example Opportunity Header and Item.-Click on New and select Report option.-Under the Define Report and Select Data Source* ﻿tab, create the report XXX (XXX represents the name of the report).-Navigate to the Define Variables tab, select the Characteristic, Sales Unit and click on Set Fixed Value Selections.-Click on﻿ More option in the Maintain Default Values screen.-In the Select values for Sales Unit screen, click on the Relative Select radio button.-From the drop-down for Select, choose the My Assigned Sales Units option.-Click on Ok.-Click on Finish.-Open the report XXX.-Click on Go.-Find that the report does not pull data for managers assigned to that Sales Unit within the org structure.-Cause-The reason why the report does not show any data for the Manager (Sales Unit) is because the org unit does not have a manager assigned to it.-Resolution-Assign the managers to their corresponding org units. Then the Fixed Value Selection for Sales Unit will show data for the Manager (Sales Unit) as well.

Title: The Approval Task has Been Created Even Though the Sales Quote is Created by the Manager Himself
Content: Symptom-The approval task has been created even though the sales quote is created by the manager himself.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP Business ByDesign system with the user XYZ (XYZ represents the sales manager).  -Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Create a New Sales Quote.-Save and Submit the sales quote.-An approval task has been created for the quote though the quote has been created by the sales manager himself.-Cause-This is the current implemented logic of the SAP ByDesign system, the task would be created even though the sales quote has been created by the manager himself.-This is intended behavior of the system and cannot be changed.--Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: How to Re-authorize Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have a sales order XYZ(XYZ represents the ID of sales order) is pre-authorized which means the sales order is in Authorized status. You  want to re-authorized the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center-Show All Sales Order and Find Sales Order XYZ-You find the sales order XYZ in Authorized status. And you want to re-authorize the sales order.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work center-Find Sales Order XYZ and choose Edit-Go to the View All extension-Choose Items tab-Manually change the Quantity in the sales order (for example,if the initial Quantity is 6 change it into 4)-Go to the General tab you will find the Authorization Status changes into:Check Pending-Now go back to Items tab and manually change the Quantity into the initial number(changed Quantity as 6 in this case)-Go to the General tab and authorize the sales order by selecting Check Authorization button

Title: The Column Name Days in Phase ,Which is Available in the Opportunity List is Missing When you Export the Data to Excel
Content: Symptom-The column name Days in Phase , which is available in an Opportunity List,  is missing when you export data to excel.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunity List view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Opportunities and click on the Go button.-You can see there is column name Days in Phase .-Now click on button Export - > To Microsoft Excel.-You can see the Microsoft Excel for an Opportunity which opens ,don't have column Days in Phase available .-Cause-The column name Days in Phase is a calculated column. Calculated columns in the Opportunity List screen will not be exported to an excel.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Not possible to report on the identified stock type values available from the Product Portfolio work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to know if it is possible to report on the Identified Stock Type values which are available from the Product Portfolio work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center and choose the Material view.-Edit a Material and select View All then General Tab.-You will see the Identified Stock Type field.-You want to add this field to the report.-You create a new report from the Business Analytics work center as following:-Design reports view.-Select New report.-Choose the data source Identified Stock (SCM_ISTOCK).-You see that although fields like Product ID and Stock ID are shown, in the list, the Identified Stock Type is not available.-Cause-The system behavior is as designed. In fact the request refers to a missing functionality.-Resolution-Currently it is not possible to report on the Identified Stock Type field.-The reason is that no data source contains such field.-The data source Identified Stock (SCM_ISTOCK) would be the correct one to use since it provides identified stock master data, including ID and description, as well as the reference Product ID and Material ID.--If the customer needs this functionality they can use the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://ideas.sap.com/SAPByDesign alternatively they can approach their implementation manager.

Title: Cannot Delete a Contract in Status In Preparation due to the Error: "Deletion of header not possible due to status"
Content: Symptom-You are not able to delete a contract which is in status In Preparation. The following error occurs: Deletion of header not possible due to status.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view-Select contract XYZ which is in status In Preparation (XYZ represents the contract ID).-Click on the Delete button.-Click Delete to confirm the deletion.-The following error message occurs:-Deletion of header not possible due to status-Cause-The contract XYZ has been created via the sales order ABC line item XX with item type ETCS - Entitlement - contract sale (ABC represents the sales order id and XX represents the line item number).-When you enter an entitlement in the sales order, a related contract template is determined and a contract automatically created when you release the sales order. Due to this, it is not possible to delete the contract even though it is in status In Preparation.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-You can cancel the contract. Once the contract is cancelled the Reason for Rejection field for the sales order line item will be enabled and you can also cancel the item in the sales order.-See Also-Help center document: Sell a Contract in a Sales Order

Title: Document numbering rule with GSTIN Number for Customer invoice is not working as expected(Indian specific scenario)
Content: Symptom-You have created a new rule for document numbering format for customer invoicing for country India with GST Identification number in the rule without ending the validity of the existing rule and you expect that the new numbering format is picked for the invoices which has the respective GSTIN Number. However the system picks existing numbering format instead of new one.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents work center.-Search for the invoice created for the invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice request).-The Invoice created has numbering prefix as ABC however you are expecting it to be DEF( ABC is the prefix of the existing rule and DEF is the new rule which you have created).-Note: The GSTIN number of seller in the invoice is same as the GST Identification number maintained in the document numbering rule.-Cause-The new rule(DEF) which you have created in the Document Numbering formats is placed below the existing rule(ABC)  in the table Document Numbering Formats Specific to India in the Business Configuration workcenter. The system will pick the first available rule(ABC) in the table. In this case since the existing rule(ABC) does not have any specific GSTIN Number or any other specific conditions and this rule is placed before the newly created rule(DEF), the system will always pick the existing rule(ABC).( ABC is the existing rule and DEF is the newly created rule).-Resolution-The newly created rule should be placed above the existing rule in the table Document Numbering Formats Specific to India , then system will pick the first rule and if the GSTIN Number matches then this new rule will be picked. You can implement above suggestion in Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Select the activity and choose View button.-Open the Document Numbering Formats for India.-Select the newly created Rule with Prefix DEF and Click on Move Up button and place it above the existing rule with prefix ABC

Title: Unable to find The SDK element - Extension Business Object Organization is the Application.
Content: Symptom-In Repository explorer you have created custom BO OrganisationalCentreExtension however the same is not available in Business Configuration and Scoping. This BO scoped in SDK has Org Structure which have different roles/purposes. You need to add an extension field so we can see the role/purpose (no SAP field is relevent) and then use this for a query. Upon selecting this BO the below message displays in SDK:-In Business Configuration And Scoping we are unable to find option Extensibility For Org Units.-Cause-We do not support Extensibility on the MOM UI/BO. There are some technical limitation - like handling of time dependency for extensions.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.
