Title: The Sales Unit is not Determined According to the Rules Set Up in the Responsibility Rule Sales Unit for Sales
Content: Symptom-The Sales Unit is not determined according to the rules set up in the responsibility rule Sales Unit for Sales-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select New Sales Order.-Enter the Account XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the account or buyer party)-The sales unit determined is not the one expected according to the responsibility rule Sales Unit for Sales.-Cause-The responsibility rule were extended with parameter field Company ID only for the use case where the Company is entered manually. In a Sales Order the Sales Unit and Sales Organizational determination happens before the seller party is entered in the Sales Order.-Resolution-In case you have defined a parameter Company ID in the responsibility rule Sales Unit for Sales you will need to enter manually the Seller party in the sales order.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select New Sales Order.-Enter the Account XYZ.-Go to View All.-Go to the Involved Parties tab.-Enter the Seller DEC (DEC represents the identification of the Seller party) which is maintained as COMPANY in the responsibility rule.-The correct sales unit is now determined in the sales order.-Additionally, you can add the field Seller via the Personalize functionality as follows:-Open a New Sales Order-Select Personzalize -> This Screen-In the Screen Layout select the section Organizational Assignment-Make the field Seller visible.-Save and close your personalization.-Now before you enter an account enter the company in the field Seller. The Sales Unit which has been set up in the rule for this company will now be determined.

Title: How to Create a Discount List Specific to a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-How to create a discount list specific to a sales order ?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order.-Add 20 line items in the sales order.-Now you intend to add a discount to each item automatically using a discount list maintained specific to a sales order.-Cause-Creating a discount list specific to a sales order is not possible however you can create a customer specific discount products list.-The discount list is not sales order specific but customer specific for e. g. You are creating a sales order with 20 line items for a customer XYZ and you have already created a customer specific discount list for this customer, so now in the sales order you don't have to add the discount in each line item manually but it will be picked from the customer specific discount products list.--Resolution-Follow the steps below for creation of discount list:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Pricing view, Discount List sub-view.-Show Customer Specific Discount Products and then select the New button - Customer Specific Discount Products.-In the General tab add mandatory details like Name, Validity, Account ID (i. e. customer account).-Go to the Items tab and add the product and percentage of discount.-Save and Release the Discount List.-Now the discount list will go for the approval, once the approval is done the discount list will be active.-After the activation of the discount list if you add the items in the sales order then the system would automatically pick the discount percentage.--For the older sales orders (i. e. those sales orders which are created before release of the discount list):-Go to the Pricing tab of the sales order.-Select Update Pricing button - Completely.-The discount would be updated for the items in sales order.

Title: Interest Code Maintained But Interest Deactivated For Val. View
Content: Symptom-You want to assign an Interest Method to valuation view XX00YY of Fixed Asset Class ABC.  An Error Message appears: Interest Code Maintained But Interest Deactivated For Val. View XX00YY.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Edit the Fine Tuning activity Fixed Asset Class.-Select Edit Fixed Asset Classes.-Select Asset Class ABC.-Go to sub-tab Default Interest Methods.-Select the Valuation View XX00YY and select interest method XXX from the drop down.-Press Save.-The error message appears: Interest Code Maintained But Interest Deactivated For Val. View XX00YY.-Cause-Notional interest can only be calculated for valuation views different from XX00YY, i.e. different from the valuation view which posts to the General Ledger and is reported on the financial statements.-Resolution-You can only assign a default interest method to valuation views which are of statistical nature. Interests are calculated on top of the normal depreciation and this is ok for internal valuation views but does not apply for those where real postings happen.

Title: You are Not Able to Create Phone Call Activity
Content: Symptom-You are not able to create Phone Call Activity.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities view.-Now, go to the New tab and select New Phone Call from the drop down option.-Select Outbound.-Error coocurs Not possible to create Phone Call activity.-Cause-You have not scoped Phone Call Activity in Business Configuration scoping.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the First Implementation Project and select Edit Project Scope.-Go to tab Questions.-In scoping element, select Sales.-Select Activity Management.-Select Yes for the question Do you record phone calls?

Title: Payment Terms are not Determined in A2X Customer Invoice Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When creating Customer Invoice Requests from A2X (web service integration) the Payment Terms are not automatically determined from the Account Master Data.-Reproducing the Issue-To reproduce the issue, you must create Customer Invoice Requests via A2X using Accounts which have the Sales Arrangement configured and the respective Payment Terms defined.-Go to Customer Invoicing work center;-Select Invoice Requests view;-Open one of the Customer Invoice Requests, select View All;-Check in Payment section of General tab, the Payment Terms will not be defined.-This happens even when the master data of the Account has the necessary information for Payment Terms definition. To check this information follow the steps below:-Go to Account Management work center;-Search for the Account used in the Customer Invoice Request;-Open the Account, select View All;-Go to Sales Data tab;-Check for the respective Sales Organization / Distribution Channel the selected Payment Terms.-Cause-The Payment Terms and Cash Discount Terms are required when uploading Customer Invoice Requests data.-While processing Customer Invoice Requests through A2X interface, the application will determine the Due Date and respective information only if Cash Discount Terms are passed.-In case this information is not passed, Payment Terms are not determined in the Customer Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.

Title: In External Invoice Request, You Get Error: Party Employee Responsible ID does not exist in master data
Content: Symptom-There is an external invoice request in your system, you cannot process it further due to the error:-Party Employee Responsible ID XYZ does not exist in master data (XYZ represents the ID of the field).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Find the invoice request which is with status Inconsistent.-Click Check button and you can find the error message: Party Employee Responsible ID XYZ does not exist in master data.-Now go to the Personal Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view, you search XYZ, this employee is existed.-You do not know why system gives such error message.-Cause-You should use the Business Partner ID of this responsible person instead of the Employee ID.-Resolution-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partner view.-Search the name of the person and you can find the Business Partner ID of the person.-Replace the ID with Business Partner ID in the XML and update the invoice request, it will update the Employee Responsible field and remove the error.

Title: You are Unable to Handover Leads to the Sales Team
Content: Symptom-You are unable to Hand Over leads to the sales team.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Leads view.-Show All Leads and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the lead).-Edit the lead XYZ.-The Handover button is grayed out.-Hence you are not able to handover the lead to the sales team.-Cause-You are not able to hand over the lead XYZ because the Qualification field is not set in it. It is mandatory to have the Qualification in the lead for handover.-Resolution-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Leads view.-Show All Leads and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the lead).-Edit the lead XYZ.-Add a value (Cold, Warm, or Hot) in the Qualification field.-Once the Qualification of the lead is set, you can handover it to the sales team.

Title: In a Sales Document, the following Error Message is Triggered :"Tax Jurisdiction Code is not set up for Account"
Content: Symptom- You already have tax jurisdiction code configured in your address information and relevant account ABC (ABC represents name of the account), but once you are creating a new sales quote by utilizing account ABC (ABC represents name of the account in a sales quote),-an error occurs : Tax Jurisdiction Code is not setup for the account ABC.----Reproducing the Issue-1.  Go to the New Business work center-2.  Go to the Sales Quotes view-3.  Click New then choose  Sales Quote-4.  Fill up the mandatory information and select the Account Name as ABC-An error message stating  "Jurisdiction code missing in address of Account ABC" occurs-Cause-When you create a new line item then the parties of the header are copied to the item. If the header points to an "old" or outdated address that has not the corresponding tax information (ship-to party), then you must either maintain it there or just delete and reenter it to get the address changes from the master data copied into the document.--Resolution-1. Go to the relevant Sales Quote-2. Edit the sales quote then choose View All as extension view-3 .Go to the Involved Parties tab then choose Ship-to Party, after this clearing the previous name under parties details and reenter it again.-The error should disappear after this.

Title: Check Printing Is Not Available as Payment Method for Bank Accounts
Content: Symptom-Check Printing Payment Method is not available in the drop down under Payment Method Tab for Bank Accounts.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to Master Data view.-Go to My Banks Sub view.-Show All MyBanks and Find Bank ID.-Select Bank ID.-Choose Edit and Go to Bank Accounts Tab.-Choose the Bank Account and Go to Payment Method Tab.-You are not be able to see the Check Printing Payment Method in the drop down.-Cause-Check Printing is not available in the drop down under Payment Method tab for Bank Accounts as Scoping question for Check disbursement is not scoped under Payment and Liquidity Management scoping element.-Resolution-You may follow the below steps for Check Printing to be available:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and Choose Edit Project Scope.-Go to Questions step.-Go to Cash Flow Management element and then to Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select Payment Methods.-Go to Group: Outgoing Payments.-Select the checkbox for Scoping Question Do you want to use checks for cash disbursement.

Title: Data > Upload Button Missing for Cloud Data Source
Content: Symptom-You cannot upload any data into your cloud data source because the Data button is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Data Sources.-Under Show, select Cloud Data Source.-Search for the respective cloud data source and mark the line.-There is no Data button, hence you have no option to use the Upload function.-Cause-You have not enabled the Manual Data Upload for this cloud data source.-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Data Sources.-Search for your cloud data source and click on Edit.-Tick the check box Manual Data Upload.-Save.

Title: Document Numbering for Self Invoice - India
Content: Symptom-The Self Invoice Numbering Rule is not working and the numbering rule which is set is not effective for the supplier invoice documents.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select New Invoice Without Purchase Order-Enter the details-Select Save-Cause-The Self Invoice Numbering Rule will be active only for ERS (Evaluated Receipt Settlement) Invoices and no other type of invoices. As a result, the Self Invoice Numbering rule maintained in Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing under Business Configuration is not picked up.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-You need to create an ERS invoice with relevant Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) tax codes. For these documents, an Official Document Number (ODN) is generated, based on the GST registration number and the annual year.-Note : All existing ERS invoices should be posted before creating the document numbering rules for self invoices. This will avoid mismatch in the document numbering format.

Title: Error Message "Target not available" While Accessing the Fine Tuning Activity "Credit Card Service Provider - Computop"
Content: Symptom-When you try to access the fine tuning activity Credit Card Service Provider - Computop, system throws below error:-Target not Available-Cause-The fine tuning activity Credit Card Service Provider - Computop will be enabled based on the scoping question Do you want to select Computop as your Credit Card Service Provider?--The cause for the issue is that you are trying to activate the Addon for Computop by doing this scoping question but you haven't subscribed for this Addon.-Resolution-Refer to the Help Center document About Credit Card Service Provider Computop and subscribe the respective addon.

Title: Unable to Use Internet Explorer Browser to Upload File into WebDav Folder
Content: Symptom-You are trying to configure your Internet Explorer for mass data-uploads and automated transports from other systems in the SAP Cloud Solution. But you are not able to upload files using Internet Explorer because it is not possible to open the file explorer.-Environment: Citrix-Terminalserver-Resolution-Internet Explorer allows to view the WebDAV folder but does not allow upload. To upload data into the WebDAV folder the only way is to map the drive using the file explorer (or some other dedicated tools).--But again, we cannot provide information on what kind of configuration needs to be done in a specific Citrix-Terminalserver Environment. This needs to be investigated by your IT department.--Refer to the attached document related to Map WebDAV Folder.

Title: Extension field is not Getting Migrated Using Migration of Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You have requirement to Enhance the Extension field using Migration of Suppliers, but values are not getting reflected in the system-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-3. Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Suppliers-4. Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-You have extended Supplier using Adaptation Mode and wants to Enhance the field using Migration of Suppliers. Enhance of field content of existing record using migration mode Enhance Already Existing Records is not possible. It is only possible to add new set of data for a node.-Resolution-You can use Mass Data Maintenance work center to Enhance the Extension field

Title: Error When Running a Formatted Report: JRC Returned an Error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to run a formatted report, however you get an error message starting with JRC Returned an Error...-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report and set the required variables.-Click on Go.-You get the above error.-Cause-Via the Crystal Designer, you have added a field to this report that is not present in the data source. This makes the meta data of this report inconsistent.-Resolution-For consistent report data, you will need to make sure that all fields in the formatted report are present in the data source as well. So if you need extension fields in this report, please create the extension field in the system first, and then add it to the data source.

Title: Unable to remove Account Determination groups
Content: Symptom-You want to disable these options for account determination group:--Domestic, Affiliated-Foreign, Affiliated-Foreign, third party-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account management Work center-Select Accounts view-Select Show: All accounts-Search and select an account-Select Edit -> Financial Data-Select the Payment data tab- Under Account determination group you want to remove: These three options:-Domestic, Affiliated-Foreign, Affiliated-Foreign, third party-Resolution-The account determination groups that you see in the dropdown are SAP delivered and it cannot be deleted

Title: Dashboard Interactions
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**RELEASED INTERNALLY**-You should consider the following expected behaviors when it comes to Dashboard interactions in Cloud for Customer:-Size of dashboards adjusts automatically according to size of screen;-When you drill down into a dashboard in RUI, the other ones become read only;-A refresh does NOT reset the drill down, you have to click Reset;-Filters: there is Delete as well as Clear-Delete Setting in one tile will not affect the others. The tile where you are applying setting will become blue;-When you change something in the target tile, go out of it and refresh (e.g. by creating a new interaction), the filters will be back. The source does not know what was done on the target;-Via Ctrl key on key board you can select several values. Only on releasing the key will trigger the interaction.-Exclusively when accessed via Mobile:-Tooltip and interactions are combined into 1 in mobile: tapping on a point = shows tooltip; tap on the tooltip = close the tooltip; tooltip can also be dragged to a different place on the screen (it's a place on the screen, NOT the dashboard. i.e. when you scroll, the tooltip box will not move), this is session based so the system will remember the place for tooltip as long as you don't refresh the dashboard and also the system remembers this for every tile separately;-For interactions: click on the Filter + button on source tile. This button appears once you've tapped on a value.- Resolution

Title: Error While Editing an Account: "Please select State Name in Main Address section."
Content: Symptom-You are getting an error while trying to edit an Account to select a State, however the value help for state is empty for the selected country.-Please select State Name in Main Address section-Reproducing the Issue-  Go to Account Management  workcenter.- Select Accounts view.- Select an Account.- Select Edit and go to Contacts tab- Select Add Row and Enter the required data.- Select the General tab.- In the Main Address section, select the required country.- The value search for state is empty.- Select save and the error is generated.-Hence not letting you save the changes.-Cause-By default State field is not mandate. This happens if you have done customization for the field State to make it mandate for an Account.-Resolution-If you have customized State as a mandate field, in that case make sure to add states for all the countries if it is not already existing in the system.-Please follow the below mentioned steps following which you can maintain the state for any country:-Go to Business configuration workcenter.-Search the Activity Regions.-Select Change Immediately.-Select Add Row-Select Add country-Select Maintain States and add states-Select Save

Title: Broadcast Start Time in "Next Run" Wrong
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Start Time of broadcasts differs between the Next Run column and the Details tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Broadcasts.-Mark a broadcast and compare the Start Time in the Next Run column and in the Details tab underneath the broadcast list.-The 2 times differ. For example, Next Run may show the time 11am, whereas the Details tab shows 10am.-You set up this broadcast with the start time as 10am (in this example), so you would expect the same time to be reflected under Next Run.-Cause-The broadcast was created during a time when the daylight saving time was not active, however now, the daylight saving time is applied. It is the current behaviour that broadcasts will start at the time they were scheduled initially, with the daylight saving changes being applied on top of this initial time.-So in this example, the broadcast was initially set to 10am (without daylight saving time). Once daylight saving time is applied however, this becomes 11am.-Resolution-At this point in time, there is no option to automatically change the start times of (several) broadcasts. You can change the start time manually if required.

Title: Error Message: Save Failed When Trying to Delete Forecasting Group ID
Content: Symptom-When you create a Material, it is possible to save a Material without Forecasting Group ID. Later when you try to delete Forecasting Group ID from Product Master Data and perform save, system throws an error message: Save Failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data Workcenter.-Go to Materials View and choose Materials subview.-Find the relevant Product ID.-Select and Edit it .-Select View All and navigate to Planning tab.-Find field : Forecasting Group ID under General Information.-Select and remove it.-Perform Save.-System throws an above error message.-Cause-Once a forecasting group is added to a material, it cannot be deleted. You can assign any new Forecasting Group ID via value selection.-Resolution-You can assign any new Forecasting Group ID via value selection to replace the old one.-This is the current system behavior.

Title: Modify Employee Work Place Address
Content: Symptom-How to modify Employee workplace Address Data-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center-2. Select Employee view-3. Search for Employee XYZ-4. Select Employee XYZ and select Edit button-5. Select Employment tab-6. Under Employment, select Workplace Contact Data-7. Under Address Data, select the Value Selection field-Result: No record found-Cause-It is not possible to modify Employee contacts, email address or address data under Personnel File.-Resolution-1. Go to Personnel Administration work center.--2. Go to Regular Tasks view.--3. Select Change Workplace Contact Data task.--4. Search for Employee XYZ and perform changes as needed-

Title: Mass Update Customer With Text Collection
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Mass Update Customer Notes or Update by Mass Customer With Text Collection-Reproducing the Issue-First Option-Go to the Account Management workcenter.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select account XYZ (XYZ is the identification of the account).-Click the Edit - Notes button-Second Option-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity List and Search for Migration of Customer-Select the All tab-In the Show field, Select All Activities and in Find field, search for Migration of Customers-Click the Open Button and select Migrate Customer using the Migration Tool-Select the Upload button and select Data from Migration Template-Select the Properties button and in select Modify Already Existing Records as Migration Mode and Save-Click Execute Migration and Select Execute Migration Step by Step- Cause-Only the user that created a Note is allowed to delete This note again in the user interface. For Notes created via Migration, the User That triggered the upload of the Migration Data should be able to delete the Notes.-There is no mass delete available for Notes.-It is only possible to add Notes to existing Customers via the user interface or via the usage of the web service ManageAccountsIn. -Also note that Notes created via the service will not be changeable or deleteable on the user interface as the service is always called with a Technical User.-Resolution-Options such as deleting the Notes (All Notes  for an Account) via the Backend for a provided List of Accounts and creating Notes en Masse Using the Webservice, are available-You can contact the Component: AP-BP-CUS for the deletion of the Notes in the Backend.-Creation of WebService-Setting up Communication Arrangement In Application and User Management workcenter the Communication System, Communication Scenario and Communication Arrangement have to be created. -See Also-And Example XML code be like:-<n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<Customer actionCode="04" textListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<InternalID>Token 18</InternalID>-<Text actionCode="01">-<TypeCode>Token</TypeCode>-<ContentText>String 1048</ContentText>-</Text>-</Customer>-<Customer actionCode="04" textListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<InternalID>Token 18</InternalID>-<Text actionCode="01">-<TypeCode>Token</TypeCode>-<ContentText>String 1048</ContentText>-</Text>-</Customer>-<Customer actionCode="04" textListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<InternalID>Token 18</InternalID>-<Text actionCode="01">-<TypeCode>Token</TypeCode>-<ContentText>String 1048</ContentText>-</Text>-</Customer>-</n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>--You Need to Enter the ID of the Account and Then the Type Code of the Note /text and the Content.-You can Have Multiple Customers in one Message.

Title: Error message: Target Not Available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are configuring the Integration of the SAP Business ByDesign and SF, when you try to access the Outgoing document, system throws below error message-Target Not Available-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and User Management work center-2. Select Business Communication Monitoring view-3. Here, you could find the Document IDs with Technical Error.-4. Select any of the Document ID and above error may occur-Resolution-On clicking the Document ID for messages related to Cost Center Replication, Org FactSheet should open.-Right now the implementation of OBN Navigation is not complete in case of Cost Center Replication, hence the Error Message: Target Not Available. Hence it is not a Business Configuration related error.-It would be fixed in future release.--As far as the Technical Error is concerned, it is due to a java error 'Cannot cast class [Ljava.lang.String; to class java.lang.String' on the consumer/receiver side.

Title: "Error Message: Mutual Authentication Failed. The server's password is out of date at the domain controller"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You need to send an interface file via WebDAV folder. However through Windows OS you can only establish the connection for a short time.--In other word, The connection to the WbDAV folder can be established but if you leave the OS (Window) idle for a while (may be less than 2 minutes),--then the connection is disconnects and says "Error occurs: Mutual Authentication Failed. The server's password is out of date at the domain controller"-Note: This scenario is applicable when developing integration process with external system.-Resolution-Ask the user to apply all available window updates and then perform the Interface setup.

Title: Sales and Use Tax and VAT Returns use the Same Account Determination
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the Sales and Use tax returns and VAT returns are going to same account under tax ledger.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Sales and Use Tax Returns view.-Open the relevant tax return.-Click to open the associated journal entry.-You'll see that the journal entry hits the Sales and Use Tax Payable G/L Account.-Go to the VAT Returns tab.-Open the relevant VAT return.-Open the related journal entry.-You'll see that this journal entry is posted to the same G/L Account for Sales and Use Tax Payable.-Cause-The VAT returns run automatically closes the VAT accounts and the input tax accounts and posts to tax payable account as well as the Sales and Use tax return also posts to tax payable.-Only the withholding tax has a separate tax payable account.-Resolution-It is the designed system behavior that both tax return types are posted to the same tax payable account.-Keywords-sales and use tax, Sales and Use Tax Payable, vat return, tax return

Title: Error: "Site is externally managed and cannot be used in inbound logistics" while creating customer return notification.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create Customer Return Notification via Inbound Logistics workcenter but system throws an error message:-Site is externally managed and cannot be used in inbound logistics-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View and choose New Customer Return Notification subview.-Select required Product ID and navigate to next step via guided activity.-Enter Delivery Notification ID and all required details.-Perform Save.-System throws above error message.-Cause-The returned product is Externally Managed by a warehouse provider and the product needs to be sent back to your warehouse provider.-Since this product is managed under External Site (3PL) therefore you have to create New Customer Return Notification via Third Party Logistics instead of Inbound Logistics Workcenter.-Resolution-Go to Third Party Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks View and choose New Customer Return Notification subview.-Select required Product ID and navigate to next step via guided activity.-Enter Delivery Notification ID and all required details.-Perform Save.-No erorr would be shown.

Title: 1705 Data Migration with the Migration Tool - Validity or Period Related Error Messages During Import Simulation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is trying to migrate data via the Migration Tool, for instance Fixed Assets in the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-The import simulation reports validity or period related errors. For fixed asset migration the following error messages appear:-Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY.-Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY.-Other validity error messages might arise when migrating-Employee Data-Suppliers-Customers-Sales Quotes-Open Sales Orders-Customer contracts-Accounting transaction data-Materials-Projects-Reproducing the Issue-In the Implementation Projects view of the Business Configuration workcenter select the respective implementation project and press Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend phase.-Find the migration activity, for instance Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Press Open.-Choose the Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-In the next screen select the respective migration unit and press Execute Migration.-Provided the file has already uploaded and processed sucessfully the Import is being simulated in step 1c-Simulate Import.-Errors are reported. For a Fixed Asset file the errors will be Segment missing; segment reporting active from DD.MM.YYYY.-Profit center missing; profit center accounting active from DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-Once you have verified that all involved conditions have been met,-[For Fixed Asset migration this would be:-For each migration item a cost center is maintained in the migration file.-The assigned cost center is valid and active on the migration posting date.-Each Cost center is associated with a profit center and segment so that these can be derived during the migration process.]-the reason for the error message is a missing fixed value of a validity period field for which a start and end date is usually set. However, due to a slight code change, the fixed start value has been reset to 000000 in SAP ByDesign version 1705.-To verify the missing fixed value:-Request a support user with L6-Access Level.-Log on to STFK.-Go to SE16.-In the Table Name field enter DMC_FIXEDVALUE .-Press Enter.-In the IDENT field enter VAL_START_DATE.-Press Execute.-Check the DEF_VALUE field:-If the value 19000101 appears here, the issue is NOT the missing fixed value. It has already been maintained. Forward the incident to development for RCA.-If the value 00000000 is displayed, then the issue is related to the missing fixed value:- Resolution-The fixed default start date needs to be set back  to 19000101. For this you need to create a small report in the customer system:-In STFK go to SE38.-In the Program field enter ZUPDATE_TABLE_RECORD.-Press Create.-In the Title field enter Update Fixed Value.-Press Save.-In the next screen, in the Package field enter &temp.-Then press Local Object.-In the report select all content and delete it, so that the report is empty.-Then copy and paste the following into the report:-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-*& Report  ZUPDATE_TABLE_RECORD-*&-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-*&-*&-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-REPORT ZUPDATE_TABLE_RECORD.-UPDATE dmc_fixedvalue SET DEF_VALUE = '19000101' WHERE GUID = '01HUzOZi0joHb4se7wc0NG'.-Press Activate (a little match sign).-In the Activation table, under Local Objects, press OK.-Finally, press Direct Processing (F8). Please note, there will be no confirming message. The date is being updated without generating a confirming message.-To check if the fixed start date under DEF_VALUE is now set to 19000101 go back to SE16 and use the steps above to identify the default value. It should now display 19000101 .-Now ask the customer to check if the import simulation is successfull.-Please note:  This correction is applied accross systems: If customer tenants are allocated to the same system the correction will be applied by running report in one tenant only.

Title: Webservice request failed to change the element AccountDeterminationGroup
Content: Symptom-Your ManageCustomerIn webservice request to update the Financial Data of an Account fails to change the value in the element AccountDeterminationGroup despite the status code returned by the service indicating a successful processing.-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the ManageCustomerIn webservice after changing data in the element AccountDeterminationGroup.-In the system, go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts.-Find Account XYZ (XYZ represents the account's name).-Select the account and click Edit - Financial Data.-In the tab Payment Data, for the concerned company, check in the column Account Determination Group if the change has been applied.-You can see that the change has not been reflected in the Account's Master Data.-Cause-The data is not getting updated because the value of element AccountDeterminationGroup cannot be changed directly. The agent is modelled to ignore update requests on that element, leading to an empty change request that is processed successfully.-As the element AccountDeterminationGroup is not a regular one but rather an alternative key element, the update of this element's value has to be resolved by a deletion and a subsequent creation. The backend model behind the PaymentData message segment is quite complex and consists of three different business objects. In order not to break the choreography, the deletion and creation of PaymentData have to be done in separate, subsequent web service calls.-Resolution-In the webservice's XML, this AccountDeterminationGroup element's value has to be updated first by a deletion of the data and then a subsequent creation of the new data:-The initial XML data is : <AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode>123</AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode> - (123 represents one Account Determination Group).-Delete the data from the AccountDeterminationGroup element in the webservice XML and execute it to save the changes.-Enter the new data to the XML: <AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode>456</AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode> - (456 represents another Account Determination Group).-In the system, you can see that the change has now been reflected in the Account's Master Data.

Title: Business Configuration Changes of Self-Approval of Expense Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There was a scoping question of expense report self-approval in ByD release 1402. But there is no such question in 1405.-Reproducing the Issue-In ByDesign release 1402 you could configure the self-approval of expense reports following the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center and view Implementation Projects.-Select the project and select Edit Project Scope.-Select Next till steps 4, Questions.-Expand Scoping Element Travel and Expenses, then Expense and Reimbursement Management.-Select Approval Process, you can see a question as Allow approvers to approve their own travel documents in Country XYZ.-However, this question does not exist here in ByDesign release 1405.-Cause-The configuration of expense report self-approval has been moved from Business Configuration (BC) Scoping to an activity in BC Fine Tuning.-Resolution-You can find it now following the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and select Open Activity List.-Search for activity Business Task Management for Expense and Reimbursement Management and open it.-Select Edit self-approval settings. You can configure self approval of expense report here.

Title: Payment Clearing with Inconsistent Status in the Document Flow
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You noticed that a Manual Payment Clearing has the clearing status completed, however in the Document Flow the same clearing has the status proposed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center-Go to Customer Accounts view-Show All Customers-View the Account ID XXX-Go to Trade Receivables-Click Invoices/Payments-Search and open the respective Invoice-Click View All-Go to Document Flow tab-You'll see that the clearing status in the document flow is Proposed.-Open the clearing-You'll see when you open the clearing document, the status is shown as Completed-Cause-Due clearing explanation node does not have a payment amount and have a remaining balance in the clearing. Because of this the remaining balance of the clearing has become inconsistent and hence you are not able to post it.-Resolution-You need to cancel the clearing and payment and clear the invoices again in a new clearing.-You need to renew the entire clearing. When user does a new clearing, in the payment allocation screen Search Open Items button can be used to quickly search the invoices and select them for clearing.-See Also-If this do not solve your issue, please report an incident.

Title: No Account Determination Group for Services in Revenue Recognition - Deferrals Tab
Content: Symptom-In order to refine your Revenue Recognition on Services, you would like to find in the Sales Subledger, in tab revenue Recognition - Deferrals, the possibilities to add an Account Determination Group for Services, similar to what can be found in the Revenues tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Centre-Go to the First Implementation View-Search for Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Select and open the activity-Navigate to the Account Determination section-Select the Sales Subledger-Select the relevant Account Determination Profile XYZ-Navigate to subtab Revenues-You can see there is an additional menu that allows you to further determine your accounts for Material, Services and Entitlements.-Select 2 - Services from the scroll-down menu, you can see there is a column for Account Determination Group for Services-Now navigate to subtab Revenue Recognition - Deferrals-There is no mention of Services for Deferrals and you expect to have the possibilities to narrow down your Account Determination for them as well.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour, based on the current logic regarding Account Determination and its configuration, there is no need to refine Revenue Recognition - Deferrals based on Account Determination Group for Services.-Resolution-All Revenues are bundled on the same Deferred Revenue G/L account. If you need to know where this revenue is coming from (i.e. its origin), then you have the possibility to filter on the G/L Account (Origin) in different reports, such as Project - Line Items or Sales Documents - Line Items.-This is why there is no possibility to add an Account Determination Group for Services in tab Revenue Recognition - Deferrals as it would be a redundant feature that could cause further inconsistencies on your Account Determination should you maintain different G/L Accounts.-Whether the G/L account is the same as the G/L account (Origin) depends on the Accrual Method assigned or lack thereof i.e. if there is no Accrual Method maintained, then G/L account = G/L account (Origin).- See Also-For further information on how to determine your accounts properly in the Sales Subledger, please refer to Case Document 2359397 - Wrong G/L Account Determination for Line Items of a Customer Invoice on Services

Title: Demand Forecast Key Figure Values Not Updated When Uploaded With Excel Add-in
Content: Symptom-Demand Forecast key figure (for instance: Final Forecast) values not reflecting while uploaded through Excel Add-in-Reproducing the Issue-Go To  Demand Planning Work Center-Go To Demand Plans View-Select option 'Upload'-Fill The Data In Excel-Save The Excel Data-To check the updated Key Figure Forecast values, Go Back To ByD System-Go To Supply Planning Work Center-Select Common Tasks-Select Maintain Demand Forecast-Choose The Product ID, Period Type -> Execute The Query-Forecast Values Not Updated Under Forecast Planning Table (for instance: Final Forecast)-Cause-Demand Plan ABC was not released after uploading the Demand Forecast Key Figure Values-Resolution-After uploading the Demand Forecast key figure values, user has to manually release the Demand Plan ABC --Go To Demand Planning Work Center-Go To Demand Plans View-Find Demand Plan ABC -> Release

Title: How to Create a Negative VAT Entry for Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Manual VAT Entry for Credit Memo to have into Output VAT Register a negative tax import, however system does not allow to create a negative value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Manual Tax Entries -> VAT Entries sub view.-Click on New -> Tax Entry.-The system does not allow VAT Entry with negative signs.-Cause-A Manual Tax Entry with only one Tax Code in Debit and Credit side gives only a sum of zero.-Resolution-To resolve this, it is necessary to create two manual Tax Entries instead of one:-One Manual Tax Entry with only Debit item with the respective Tax Code-A second Manual Tax Entry with only Credit item with respective Tax Code.-The output tax with +/- sign will be then visible in Output VAT Register of the VAT Return.-Keywords-negative VAT entry, credit memo, Output VAT Register, manual VAT entry, debit, credit

Title: Product Specification Field not Enabled in Sales Order Items Tab
Content: Symptom-The Product Specification field missing in the items tab of a sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center. -Go to Common Tasks and select New Sales Order.-Enter the respective details and click on View All. -Add the product XYZ (XYZ represents the product for which product specification is maintained). -The Product Specification Field is not displayed under the Details sub tab. -Cause-To enable the Product Specification field in a sales order, you need to check the Product Specification Enabled check box in the product master data.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center. -Go to the Products view. -Open the product XYZ.-Click on the View All button. -In the General tab maintain Identified Stock Type as 03 - Optional Specified Stock or 04 - Mandatory Specified Stock. -The Product Specification Enabled check box will get enabled automatically.-Click on the Save button.

Title: Information Required for Migration in Implementation
Content: Symptom-In order to process and analyse issues efficiently, we should gather the following information: -Migration Object for which you are trying to Import the data-Migration Mode which you are using-Are you facing the issue in Validation step or Simulate Import step?-Exact steps on how to reproduce the issue.-If the error is in Validation Step, then let us know the error which you are facing. If it is for mandatory fields missing, then add it to the template-If the issue is in Simulate Import step, then you can check the Display Help for the error which is occurring-If the error is Service Call Failed then check the content of the template or check the PDI field and PDI logic of those fields which are filled in the migration template-If you are facing any issue in Conversion, then you can Export the Value Conversion of all files by selecting Completed Files and then you can select You Can Also and select Export Value Conversion-Is this issue a general issue or does this only occur for a specific user (in this case please provide the user).

Title: Defining Number Range for Service Quotes
Content: Symptom-You want to define number range for Service Quotes.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implenmentation view.-Click Open Activity List.-You expect to find Number Ranges for Service Quotes as well in the selection list.-Resolution-Currently the numbering for Sales Quotes, Service Quotes and Quotes for Contracts are shared with a single number range and cannot be configured separately.

Title: Mass Change of Supplier Data using Web service and Excel Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When Customer Requires a Mass Update possiblity for the Payment Methods of Existing Suppliers-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Implementation Projects-3. Open the Activity List-4. Search for Migration of Suppliers and Open-5. Select Migrate Supplier using Migration Tool-6. Upload XML File XYZ-7. Select Execute Migration and Execute Migration Step by Step-Remark: Error occurs during Simulation Import-Errors: Error Detected in Source Record With key Value '11111' / Insertion of Data Failed; Data With key 22222 Already Exists for Node ROOT-Cause-This is an Expected Behaviour of the System and no fix has yet to be provided, However there is an Alternative Solution or Possibility to Mass Update Payment Methods of Existing Suppliers.-Resolution-The Alternative Solution is based on Webservice and Excel as 'UI' but not a SAP Solution, on top of that, the Customer will have to Provide us With a List of Suppliers to be Updated with Payment Methods and which Fields need to be updated. Best would be to provide us with a Screen Shot of the UI with the Ffields that need to be updated.-This will allow us to Verify Whether all the Prerequisites for this Solution are Fullfilled.-The Precondition is that There Must be Payment Data with Company Maintained for Suppliers. The Customised Excel Helps the Customer to add Only Payment Method to Existing Payment Data With Company, for Which no Payment Method Exists. It Must not be Used as ‘Update’ for Changing Existing Payment Methods.

Title: Error Message: External Fulfillment Requested But Third-party Processing Not Scoped
Content: Symptom-You are trying to maintain a Reason for Rejection for a line item in a sales order and the following error is displayed: External fulfillment requested but third-party processing not scoped.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Click on View All.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the line item XX and enter a Reason for Rejection in the Item Details (XX represents the line item number)-The following error is dipslayed: External fulfillment requested but third-party processing not scoped.-Cause-The Delivery Rule maintained for item XX is Multiple Delivery.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Click on View All.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the line item XX.-Under the Item Details section, change the Delivery Rule to Single Deliveries.-Enter the Reason for Rejection.-The change will lead you able to enter the Reason for Rejection and save the document.-The status will change from Open to Completed.

Title: Unable to Create Mileage Rates per Company Level
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a new Company-specific Mileage Reimbursement Rates, however you cannot find how to add the Company.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine-Tune tab.-Search and open the activity Mileage Rates.-Click Edit mileage reimbursement rates.-Under Company-Specific Rates tab, click Add Row.-System does not show the option to add the Company.-Cause-It is not possible to create mileage entries per company level. This is possible only for vehicle type or vehicle class for some specific countries.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-Help Document: Configuration Guide for Mileage Rates

Title: Error During Migration of Fixed Assets
Content: Symptom-You are performing fixed asset migration and received the below error messages:-Cost Center (XXX) not available for entire period MM-DD-YYYY.-Profit Center (ZZZ) not available for entire period MM-DD-YYYY.-Segment (YYY) not provided for interval MM-DD-YYYY; derived automatically.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation view.-In Activity List: click on Integrate and Extend tab.-All Activities: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Execute Migration which has status In Process for Fixed Asset.-Click on Process File.-You see the below error messages:-Cost Center (XXX) not available for entire period MM-DD-YYYY.-Profit Center (ZZZ) not available for entire period MM-DD-YYYY.-Segment (YYY) not provided for interval MM-DD-YYYY; derived automatically.-Cause-The error message is displayed because you have entered the wrong dates of cost center, which is before the validity date of cost center.-Resolution-The system behavior is correct. You have to maintain the cost center dates in migration template as per the Org. Untits validity dates. If the dates are outside the Org. unit validity, the errors are raised.

Title: Not Able to Import the Industries in Business Configuration Work Center
Content: Symptom-Your business uses different types of Industries for organizations, which is maintained for every Account in your system. Your requirement is to import and translate huge amount of Industry names along with their Description into the activity Industries in Business Configuration work center using the Migration tool.-Resolution-It is not possible to Import the entries in the Industries table and translate them. You have to manually add the Industry names along with their Description in the activity Industries in Business Configuration work center.

Title: Missing Statutory Stay Type and Statutory Meal Group in the Screen
Content: Symptom-You see that the StatutoryMealsPerDiemRates.xlsx downloaded from Busienss Configuration Activity Per Diem Rates for Meals - Generic Country Version provides an option to enter Statutory Stay Type and Statutory Meal Group. However, after upload, the UI screen does not show these fields.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects View.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Go to Fine Tune tab and open Activity: Per Diem Rates for Meals - Generic Country Version.-Click on link Edit per diem rates for meals.-In the Microsoft Excel button, click on Download where you get a template to enter values for StatutoryMealsPerDiemRates.-Click on Upload.-The fields Statutory Stay Type and Statutory Meal Group which were entered in the template is not available in the screen.-Cause-The excel contains all fields known to the system, however not all fields are enabled for every country version.-If the fields are not on the UI then currently this is not supported by the Business Configuration activity - Per Diem Rates for Meals - Generic Country Version and therefore it cannot be used.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: After Migration of Customers the Payment Term Field is Greyed out in the tab Sales Data
Content: Symptom-After migrating Accounts the Payment Term field is greyed out in the tab Sales Data-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Account Management work center-2. Select Accounts view-3. Search for the migrated Account-4. Navigate to the tab Sales Data-Cause-The cause for this is that specific Account contains sales organization for which Cross-Account Sales Data are maintained.- Resolution-1. Go to the Account Management work center-2. Select Common Task view-3. Select Maintain Cross-Account Sales Data-The maintained sales organizations there are several fields like Payment terms, Customer Group also which will be defaulted and the checkbox for Cross-Account Sales Data is set. You cannot overwrite the default sales data with Account-Specific Sales Data entered in the Accounts view.-If you add Account-Specific Sales Data, the system will give preference to this data over the default sales data and use it in the related business documents. If you want to change the actual default sales data, you have to change the Cross-Account Sales Data that you entered earlier.

Title: My Budget Feature does not Populate Data on the UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is trying to access planning functionalities under Managing My Area, however the screen remains in blank.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to My Budget view.-There is no data being displayed. The screen remains blank.-Cause-My Budget queries are related to the old planning solution. Since customer's system is based on HANA database, a new planning solution is available, which does not encompass the Managing My Area planning at the moment.-You can refer to the System Overview via Service Provider Cockpit (SPC) to access whether the system's database is HANA or MaxDB.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. Development team agreed that if the feature is not available anymore, the work center views should not be shown. The work center scoping rules will be adjusted in feature releases.-In the meantime, please advise the customer to unassign the respective work center views via Application and User Management.-Please, note that depending on the scenario in your sytem the MyBudget access right may still be required in order to grant the user the required access rights for expense report approval.

Title: Error : An approver could not be determined. Either approval is not relevant or the task is unassigned. Please contact your system administrator
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to approve a customer invoices due to the error: An approver could not be determined. Either approval is not relevant or the task is unassigned. Please contact your system administrator-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select customer invoice XYZ which is in status Not Released (XYZ represents the invoice ID).-Open customer invoice XYZ and go to the Approval process tab.-You notice the error: "An approver could not be determined. Either approval is not relevant or the task is unassigned. Please contact your system administrator"-Cause-Customer invoice XYZ was created with the status Not Released before the Approvals on Manual Customer Invoicing was scoped. Before enabling the approval process feature, you need to ensure that no manual customer invoices and credit memo documents are in status Not Released.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-See Also-Help center document: Approval for Manual Customer Invoice and Credit Memo

Title: Tax Payment Allocates Amount to Tax Difference Account Instead of Sales Tax Advance Payment Account
Content: Symptom-You have released VAT tax return A with a tax payable amount, e.g. -1000,00 LC. Later you schedule  and then release correction run B for the same period, resulting in a higher tax payable amount, e.g. -1500,00 LC.-After this you generate an external tax payment through allocating the total amount (-1500,00 LC) to the tax authority in the payment allocation.-The tax payment has automatically assigned the released correction run B.-In the Clearing Data section of the tax payment you notice, however, that the payment only considers the difference between tax return A and correction tax return B (here -500,00 LC) as Assigned Tax Returns' Amount.-The remaining amount (the tax amount of tax return A) appears as a Payment Difference Amount which is going to be allocated to the Tax Difference account as maintained in Tax Account Determination (Fine Tuning).  -You expected the total tax amount (here, of -1500,00 LC) to be considered as Assiged Tax Returns' Amount which would then be posted to the respective Sales Tax Advance Payment Account as maintained in Fine Tuning.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management navigate to the the Tax Returns - VAT Returns view.-Here, tax return A with a payable tax amount, e.g. -1000,00 LC appears as well as a correction return B for the same period with a higher tax payable amount, e.g. -1500,00 LC.-In the Tax Payments view of the Tax Management workcenter an externally initiated tax payment to pay the full tax amount appears.-Open the Tax Payment.-Here, in the  Payment Amount Details section you notice that the Assigned Tax Returns' Amount is only the difference between tax return A and correction return B (-500,00 LC).-As as result, the payment difference has been posted to the Tax Difference account instead of the Sales Tax Advance Payment Account.-Cause-Note: This situation only occurs when a tax return is being automatically assigned to a tax payment. This happens when there is only one reported tax return available for payment.-As the tax payment is assigned to acorrection tax return B it is assumend that the original tax return A has already been paid. Hence, only the additional amount is being considered as Assigned Tax Return's Amount. The payment then suggestes to post the remaining amount (i.e. the amount of the original tax return A) as payment difference.- Resolution-If the Tax Payment has not been posted yet: Unmatch and Match the Tax Return again:-Open the Tax Payment.-In the Tax Payments section remove the selection from the Matched box and set it again.-This will trigger the consideration of the full tax return amount as Assigned Tax Returns' Amount.-If the Tax Payment has already been posted: Reverse the Tax Payment:-Open the Tax Payment and press Reverse.-This will generate a new tax payment in status In Preparation.-This time the tax return is not automatically matched.-Select the Matched box.-Automatically, the full tax return amount is considered as Assiged Tax Returns' Amount.-To prevent this situation:-If a tax return has not been paid yet it is recommended to reverse the tax return and create it again. The tax return Correction functionality is to be used once a tax return has already been paid but needs to be corrected due to further transactions in the period of the return period.

Title: Tax Rate Type Rounding to 3 Decimals is Not possible for Currency INR
Content: Symptom-Tax Rate Type Rounding to 3 Decimals is Not possible for the Currency INR-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Navigate to the Invoices and Credit Memos View-Later find an invoice and go to the Items tab  and Tax Details sub tab-Here you can see that Tax is rounded to 0.00% instead of 0.000%-Cause-SAP Bydesign does not support 3 decimal places for the currency INR.-Resolution-SAP ByDesign only supports 2 decimal places for the currency INR according to ISO standards.-This is the standard behavior of the system.

Title: Employee Responsible changes in Sales Orders Automatically
Content: Symptom-Whenever the user ABC is editing a sales order which was created by user XYZ, the sales order automatically changes the name of the Employee Responsible from the user XYZ to the user ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the system with user ABC (ABC represents the user ID). -Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select the respective sales order with the status of In Preparation for which the Employee Responsible is user XYZ (XYZ represents the user ID). -Click the Edit button.-In the General tab change any data of the Account party e.g. the Address Details.-The Employee Responsible will automatically change to user ABC before saving the sales order.-Cause-The change of the Employee Responisble is due to the settings for the party role determinations in a sales order in your Business Configuration.-In the fine tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders you activated the following determination steps for the party role Employee Responsible:-Step 10 - Direct responsible of Account-Step 20 - Responsibility  "Employee Responsible for Sales"-Step 30 - Logged on User-Because the step 10 and 20 both depend on the account's details for the determination of the Employee Responsible party role, whenever any account details are changed in a sales order a redetermination will take place. You have not maintained a direct responsible in the account master data and there is also now work distribution rule maineined for Employee Responsible for Sales.-Therefore, since step 10 and step 20 do not apply, eventually step 30 would lead to re-determination based on current logged on user.-Resolution-You have two options to solve this issue:-Option A: Maintain a rule for the Employee Responsible. -Go to the Organizational Management work center. -Select the Employee Work Distribution subview under the Work Distribution view.-Select the Employee Responsible for Sales work category.-click on the Edit button.-You can now add a rule according to your requirements.-Option B: Deselect step 10 and 20 in the fine tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders you activated the following determination steps for the party role Employee Responsible:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view. -Select your respective implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the fine tuning activity Involved Parties for Sales Orders.-Select the Employee Responsible party role and click on the Maintain Determinations button.-Deactivate step step 10 - Direct responsible of Account and step 20 - Responsibility  "Employee Responsible for Sales".-Save your changes.-See Also-You can find more information on the Party Role Determination in a Sales Document in the following blog in the SAP Business ByDesign Community forum:-https://blogs.sap.com/2016/10/13/party-role-determination-sales-document/

Title: Unable to Create Bank Advice through ManageBankAdviceIn Webservice via SoapUI due to Error: Save of Draft is Not Possible
Content: Symptom-Unable to create Bank Advice through ManageBankAdviceIn Webservice.-Reproducing the Issue-Communication Arrangement for this webservice is set.-You are trying to create a bank advice through ManageBankAdviceIn webservice via SoapUI . But the request is not completed due to the error: Save of draft is not possible-Cause-The operation BankAdviceBundleMaintainCheckRequest is a Check Request. This means that the data sent over will not be saved but only checked for potential errors.-For payment advices the system does not allow draft saves. Consequently the Bank Advice can only be posted and not saved.-Resolution-You should use the operation BankAdviceBundleMaintainRequest to overcome this error and to create a Bank Advice.

Title: Unable to block Logistic Area for Outbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-You are trying to block the Logistic Area XXX for Outbound Operations, but there is no option for that.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data-Select Locations view-Expand the site and select the Location where the Logistic Area XXX is in.-Select Edit Layout-Find the Logistics Area XXX and select it.-See there is no option do block the Logistic Area for Outbound Operations-Cause-You can block a Logistic Area for Inbound Operations, because for this it is necessary to have a Target Area and a Storage Location. But it is not possible to block a Logistic Area for Outbound operations.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.

Title: How to Find Work Center Views for a Single Floorplan
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document describes how you can get all the Work Center Views for a single floorplan.-Resolution-In order to check the floorplan you must use the Microsoft Silverlight user interface. Title: Error Creating new Calculates Key Figure
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new calculated key figure with any key figures that have a special character in their name, but an error is occurring when you try to proceed to the next step.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Design Key Figures;-Click on New and fill in the data as requested (Key Figure name, Data Source being used, etc.)-Create your formula as requested with the key figures with special characters;-Click on Next and see the error message indicating that the formula is incorrect.-Cause-Special characters are not supported in key figure names that are being used for a calculation.-Resolution-Edit the key figure you are trying to use in the formula and remove all special characters from the Key Figure name.

Title: Warranty not assigned automaticaly in Outbound Logistics
Content: Symptom-You created a Sales Order from a Purchase Order with assigned warranty. In the Goods issue, you assign the same registed products. The registered product is created automatically for serial number, but the Warranty is not assigned.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center-Go to Outbound Deliveries view-Open the Outbound Delivery ABC-Go to the Line Items tab-Select the product XYZ-Under Serial Numbers sub tab-Open on the desired serial-See that the Warranty Assignment section is empty-Cause-The Automatic Warranty Assignment is not scoped for Outbound Delivery Processes.-Resolution-To scope the Automatic Warranty Assignment for Outbound Delivery Processes, follow the steps below: -Go to Business Configuration-Select Implementation Projects-Select the project-Select Edit Project Scope-Go to the Question tab by selecting Next-Expand Service, Entitlement Management and select Warranty Entitlement-Check the box with the question Do you want the solution to automatically assign warranty for registered products sold during the outbound delivery process?-Select Next and then select Finish and Close

Title: Find Out More about a PDI Enhancement in the Customer System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This case document is listing steps to help you analyse issues and find out if a PDI enhancement is causing the issue reported.-   Resolution-1) Is the functionality standard ?-You should first test the functionality in a test system to check if the reported issue is standard. For Cloud for Customer, customers can deploy custom content using PDI but also using the Key User Tool. You can simply ask the customer if a PDI enhancement has been deployed for this particular screen. However, the user might not be aware of all Add-ons in his/her system.-2) Check SAP Incight-https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/LeanByD/One+Off+-+Supportability-3) SDI Monitor-https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/LeanByD/One+Off+-+Supportability-4) Table SDI_REGISTRY- You can find all the add-ons in the system in every client along with information about the current status of the add-on.-  5) Useful information for Development-Usually System ID and Tenant and the name and version of the solution/Template are mentioned in the message or Incight.-System ID (SID)-Tenant-Tenant role code (if this information is not in Incight you can use transaction SE16, table TENANT)-Name of the Solution/Template-Version of the Solution/Template-Is a customer specific solution (One Off) or a template affected  (if this information is not in Incight you can use transaction SE16, table SDI_REGISTRY, in field PROJECT_NAME enter the solution, display the entry and then field PROJECT_TYPE says ONE_OFF or TEMPLATE) ?- 6) If an Error happened while a Customer or Partner did something in the Studio-Customers and partners use the Studio (SAP Solutions OnDemand Studio or SAP Business ByDesign Studio) in order to create Customer Specific solutions (also called One Off) or templates, include objects to the solutions/templates, edit these objects, to download the solution/template into a zip file or upload the solution/template (zip file) to another system. They can also create patches for solutions in a similiar way.-Write down which actions were done in which system/tenant and what happened (e.g. which error message occurred) in case this is not yet mentioned in the message.-Which User got the error ? I.e. with which user was the customer or partner logged in in the studio when he/she did the actions which lead to the error.-Is a screenshot of the Studio attached to the message/Incight ? If so you can display it and check if it mentiones the component where the error happened. If so, you can forward the message to this component (in case this component did not yet analyse the issue (can be seen in the action log of the message)).-Indicate the Solution Name.-7) Logs in SDI Monitor-  8) If an Error happened while System Administration (Hosting) did something (tenant copy, tenant move, tenant deletion)-System administrators are at SAP for ByDesign systems and they e.g. copy a tenant inside a system or to another ystem or they delete a tenant. System administrators also apply patches or upgrade a system. During such activities errors related to Customer Specific Solutions can happen.-In case of tenant operations (tenant copy, tenant move, tenant deletion) you can check if the details of the error are available in the text or in screenshots. Such details can look the following way:-Transaction TLM (system client) shows which actions had errors or warnings and you can display the 'Process Log' of this action via the button with the blue circle.-9) SLG1 Logs - PDI Log-call transaction SLG1 with object COP. The logs may give more details about the actual issue.-10) Inconsistent Document is created and/or an error message is triggered in the UI - You want to check if this caused by a One-Off Solution-1981270 - The Message "Changing data not possible; data is read-only" is Raised for a Failed XI Message-11) XI Message failed - You want to check if this caused by a One-Off Solution-1981270 - The Message "Changing data not possible; data is read-only" is Raised for a Failed XI Message-12) Report : AP_CRM_TOOL_PDI_ANALYZE-Get Solutions / Analyse Solutions / Search Solution Object-

Title: The Net Amount in Company Currency is Different from the Journal Entry Amount in SRM Reports
Content: Symptom-In the report Monitoring Invoices (Report ID : SRMIV_B03_Q0020, Data Source ID : SRMIV_B03, Data Source Name : Supplier Invoice Item Details) for a supplier invoice needing a currency conversion in Accounting, there is a difference between the Net Amount in Company Currency and the amount in the associated Journal entry.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find Monitoring Invoices - SRMIV_B03_Q0020.-Open by clicking on the hyperlink.-Input Invoice ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Supplier Invoice ID).-Click Go.-Check Net Amount in Company Currency.-You can see the value in the field Net Amount in Company Currency is different from the amount appearing in the Journal Entry.-Cause-This is normal system behaviour. Whenever the Net Amount in Company Currency is calculated, the system relied on the Invoice Date to fetch the exchange rate from the General Ledger for the Invoice ID. The Journal Entry, however, relies on the Posting date to fetch this exchange rate.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, two new key figures have been created, namely Net Amount in Company Currency On Posting Date and Gross Amount in Company Currency On Posting Date. They reply on the posting date to calculate the exchange rate and in turn the Net Amount, similarly to the Journal Entry, to guarantee the values will be the same.-Exception : If an Exchange rate is maintained in the Supplier invoice directly, under the General Tab, Exchange rates sub-tab, this rate will be fetch over the one maintained in the General Ledger work centre. In that case,-Net Amount in Company Currency On Posting Date and Gross Amount in Company Currency On Posting Date will be of 0.-Net Amount in Company Currency and Gross Amount in Company currency in this case will always match with the amount shown in the Journal entry as the exchange rate used will not consider the Dates (Posting date/Invoice date).

Title: Is it Possible To Remove Blank Spaces from a Payment File Created Based on a Custom Payment File Structure?
Content: Symptom-You've created a custom Payment File Structure and a custom Payment Medium Format based on it. When generating a payment file from this payment format you notice that when certain field doesn't reach the maximum length defined (i.e.real data getting populated in the field is less than maximum length defined) the system fills the remaining characters with blank spaces.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Go to File Management > Outbound Files view-Open the respective File ID created based on the concerned payment format-Click View All and download the file-Open the respective file in a text editor or Web browser-Notice that for a specific field (or more) the system entered blank spaces to complete the field length specified.-For example:-Field :50K has a maximum length of 46 characters. The field's data source is the IBAN (which has 22 characters in this case). The system then adds 24 blank spaces to complete the 46 characters of field length.-Cause-You've configured your Payment File Structure as follows:-Field Length Type: Specific Length for each Field-Field Length in: Characters-For this Field Length Type, fields have fixed positions in a Record (Header, Transaction, Trailer), which are also valid even if other fields do not have any values.-Therefore, in case some field doesn't have enough data to complete its length the system will always enter blank spaces to complete the length.-Resolution-Business ByDesign offers two possibilities for Field Length Types used for Custom Payment Structures:-Specific Length for each Field: Fields have fixed positions in a Record (Header, Transaction, Trailer), which are also valid even if other fields do not have any values-Delimited Fields: Fields are separated by means of special delimiters. In this case, the position of a certain field can depend on whether other fields are filled with values-If you choose the second option you have also the choice to NOT specify a delimiter (SPACE).-These are the options to generate the file as of your bank requirement.-ByDesign does not offer an option to remove spaces in a fixed length type defined structure.

Title: Changes to PDI Reports Are Not Saved
Content: Symptom-You are using the Studio and have created and deployed a report to your system. Now you are trying to edit the report via the Key User Tools in Business Analytics. When saving the changes, the system says that it was saved however when you check the report you can see that your changes were not taken over. This only happens when you log on to the system in a language other than English.-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to the system in any language other than English.-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Search for your PDI report and click on Edit With > Report Wizard.-Make a change. For example, you can rename one of the characteristics in step 4.-Click on Finish. You get a Saved message.-Open your report.-The change you just made was not taken over.-Cause-It is currently not possible to edit PDI reports in the system in another language than English, however we are checking if this can be enabled in the future.-Resolution-Please note that generally we recommend to edit PDI objects via the Studio, where they were created. If you need to edit it in the system directly, please log on in English.
