Title: VAT Exemption Certificate is Not Applied to Service Items (France Only)
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the VAT Exemption Certificate in the account master data. However, when creating a new sales order for this account, the exemption certificate is not applied to service items.-Reproducing the Issue-To check the VAT Exemption Certificate maintenance:-Go to the Account Managementn work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Open the respective account and go to Tax Exemption Certificates sub tab in Financial Data tab.-You can see the Continuous VAT Exemption Certificate is maintained and is valid.-Now create a new sales order using the following steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Click New Sales Order from the Common Tasks view.-Enter the account, then go to the Items tab and enter the respective service item, the VAT Exemption Certificate maintained in the account master is not determined.-But if you enter a product item, the VAT Exemption Certificate could be picked automatically.-You are wondering, why the VAT Exemption Certificate is not applied to the service item.-Cause-The system has been configured that way that the automatic determination of tax exempt certificate is available for selling goodds, not services.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior in current releases.

Title: Extension Field With Type Value Default Value Behavior
Content: Symptom-You created a Extension Field with type Time after adding the field to the screen you can notice that the field has a default value even though you didn't specify it during the creation of the field.-Cause-The cause of this behavior is that a field with type Time cannot exist without a default starting time hence when it is created by default the system specify either 00:00 or 12:00 depending of your time zone settings in the system.-Resolution

Title: Project Task is not available in Timesheet
Content: Symptom-Employee is unable to fill timesheet as project task is not available in the value help-Reproducing the Issue-Goto Home work center-Select Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Select Time and choose Edit Time Sheet-Add Row-Project task is not populated in the value help-Cause- The employee has manually deleted the project tasks from the timesheet entry .-Resolution- The employee has to manually add the project task in the timesheet and save the entries.

Title: Org Structure Activation Error: Operation not possible; perm. estblmt. referenced by material ABC
Content: Symptom-Error during Org Structure activation : Operation not possible; perm. estblmt. referenced by material ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Organization Management workcenter.-2. Go to Organization Structure view.-3. Select an Edit Org Unit : XXX.-4. Navigate to General tab.-5. Update Global Location Number.-Above error message pops-up.-Cause-This is because the Business Residence YYY is used by the some Materials and the Business Residence was deleted from the Org Structure.-Resolution-The possible solution to overcome this issue is to DELIMIT the Org Unit with Business Residence YYY to a specific date instead of deleting it. Since the Business Residence was deleted. The only option is to Roll Back the changes in the Planning Area and the DELIMIT the validity of Org Unit with Business Residence YYY.-NOTE: Roll Back will delete all inactive changes in the Plannng Area and revert the Org Structure to last active version.-You can activate any changes in lower hierarchy with activate selected and dependent org units before making the Roll Back.

Title: Separator in HTML5 Dashboards Not Displayed
Content: Symptom-You have created a dashboard in HTML5, with a report view that is set to chart. You notice that in the report view, the decimal and thousand separators in the axis descriptions are displayed correctly, however in the dashboard view they are not.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Analysis work center, view Dashboards.-Select and execute your dashboard.-In the axis descriptions of report view ABC you will for example see numbers like these: 1500,0 ; 2000,0 ; 2500,0 and so on.-Click on Options > Analyze Data to open the report view ABC.-Now you see the correct separators - the axis description shows the numbers 1.500,00 ; 2.000,00 ; 2.500,00 and so on.-Cause-This is a limitation in the HTML5 UI. It applies to dashboards and home tiles opened in HTML5.-Resolution-The limitation was addressed in dashboards in RUI.

Title: Fields Missing in upload of Suppliers via Excel
Content: Symptom-Fields related to Tax Data are missing in upload of suppliers via Excel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Select Suppliers view.-Select New -> Suppliers from Excel.-The fields related to Tax Data are missing.-For example: Tax Number, Tax Number, etc.-Cause-The fields related to Tax Data are not supported in Excel Upload in SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Alternativaly you can use the migration of Suppliers to upload Tax Data of suppliers.-Keywords-Suppliers from Excel; tax data; suppliers

Title: How to Descope Overhead Absorption: You Can Apply Overhead to, for Example, Service Orders and Projects
Content: Symptom-You wanted to Descope Overhead Absorption but the In Scope box is flagged and is not editable to unflag the box.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select Implementation Projects view.-Edit the scope of your project.-Go to step Questions.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting -> Management Accounting -> Cost Center Management Accounting.-Check the Question You can apply overhead to, for example, service orders and projects?.-In Scope box is flagged already and not editable to unflag it.-Cause-To avoid inconsistencies and avoid uncontrolled data loss of posted data, there are various consistency checks which avoid disabling and changing of certain settings once they are in use.-Note - the steps provided below will help to unflag the scoping in the early stage before making any sort of posting effecting this settings.- Resolution-Follow the sequence in the scoping:-Expand Financial and Management Accounting -> Inventory Valuation -> Valuation of Work in Process - > Do you want to allocate overhead costs to production lots and material cost estimates? De-Scope it.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting -> Management Accounting -> Sales and Profit Analysis -> Do you want to allocate overhead costs to Service Orders?  De-Scope it.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting -> Management Accounting -> Project Cost and  Revenue Management -> Do you want to allocate overhead costs to Projects ? De-Scope it.-Since these are dependency questions for the Overhead costs, and when you de-scope the above then automatically Overhead Absorption and the Question You can apply overhead, for examples, service orders and projects is will be De-Scoped/unflagged.

Title: Unable to Select Relationship Type Has the Freight Forwarder for Accounts
Content: Symptom-You are unable to assign the Relationship Type Has the Freight Forwarder for Accounts. When you select this Relationship Type, the Business Partner value help has no values.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select and Edit an Account.-Go to Contacts tab.-Select Relationship sub tab.-Select Add Row button.-For Relationship Type, select Has the Freight Forwarder.-When clicking on the Business Partner value help, nothing appears in the value help, it's empty.-Cause-The relationship type Has the Freight Forwarder is empty because there is no Freight Forwarders in your system. This can be verified as follows,--1. Go to Business Partner Data work center.-2. Select Supplier view.-3. Select Advanced.-4. Choose the Role as Freight Forwarder and select Go--The result is empty because there is no Freight Forwarders.--Resolution-If you want to assign a Supplier as a Freight Forwarder, follow the below steps--1. Go to Business Partner Data work center.-2. Select Supplier view.-3. Open a Supplier-4. In General tab, you can tick the check box for Freight Forwarder.-5. Now, you can assign this Freight Forwarder with the relationship type Has the Freight Forwarder for an Account.

Title: Error Message: Planning Procedure for Product ABC in Planning Area XYZ Missing, While running MRP.
Content: Symptom-When you run MRP for a product ABC, system is not creating proposals and throwing an error message:-Planning Procedure for Product ABC in Planning Area XYZ Missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select the Products view.-Search for the Product ID and choose Open button.-Select the Run Planning button and the option Multi BoM Level from it.-The system shows the error message.-Cause-Since you have not maintained any Planning Procedure for product ABC in planning area XYZ, hence system is unable to create planning proposals for the product.-Resolution-You have to maintain a Planning Procedure for a product ABC in the planning area XYZ under Planning tab.-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Select the Product ID view.-Choose the Edit button and View All.-Go to the Planning tab, select the Planning Area XYZ.-Under section: Planning Area, enter the required Planning Procedure.-Perform Save.

Title: The Field District is Not Printed in the Form
Content: Symptom-The field District is not printed in the form.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work ceter New Business.-Go to view Sales Quotes.-Open Sales Quote XYZ.-Click on preview.-The content of the field District is not showing in the form.-Cause-The content of the field District is printed depends on the combined length of the fields city and district. If the combination is longer than 36 characters then only the city is printed.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.- See Also-Note: Under business configaration settings for Countries you can choose this address formatting routine per country.

Title: Sales Price List Alternate Approval not Triggering
Content: Symptom-Sales price list alternate approval not triggering even though there is an employee work distribution Rule maintained in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Under Unassigned Items shows Subject Approve Price-/Discount List XYZ (XYZ represents Price list ID).-You are expecting this to be assigned according to the Employee Work Distribution rule maintained.-Cause-The Employee Work Distribution Rule in place for an Alternate Approver is based on sales organization context. But the Price List XYZ is of type customer specific price list and there is no sales organization context.-Resolution-The alternate approvers with sales organization context only works for price list that contain sales organization as one of the parameters based on which the price list is defined.-Therefore maintain a work distribution rule without sales organization context.

Title: A Numeric Entry is Expected in Field Tax Number - Error When Maintaining Business Partner CIF Number
Content: Symptom-You are entering the Spanish CIF number for a business partner, starting with A or B followed by 8 digits, for example: A12345678.-An error message appears: "A numeric entry is expected in field Tax number". -The CIF number, however, must start with either an A or B: if you enter a number instead of the letter, for example: 012345678 another error message appears: "In field Tax number, a letter is expected in position 1 or 9". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Supplier Base work center, navigate to the Suppliers view.-Find the respective supplier and press Edit - Financial Data.-Navigate to the Tax Data sub-tab.-In the Country field enter ES-Spain.-In the Tax Number Type field select CIF Number.-In the Tax Number field enter the CIF number, for example: A12345678.-An error message appears: A numeric entry is expected in field Tax number.-Cause-The tax number check rules have been changed for Spain to only accept numerical values in the Countries/Regions Fine Tune task.-Resolution-To be able to accept alphanumeric values for tax numbers you need to change a rule accepting such values:-In the Business Configuration work center, navigate to the Implementation Projects view to open the Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune phase and find and open the Countries/Regions activity (if your system is live open this activity from the Overview view, via Change Immediately).-Click Edit Countries/Regions.-In the Country/Region table select ES-Spain.-Navigate to the Tax Attributes tab.-Here, in field V A T Registration Number Check Rule as well as Tax Number One Check Rule change the rule back to rule "3 - Length to be kept to exactly, without gaps" (the standard setting).-After this you will be able to save alphanumeric tax numbers for Spanish Business partners.-Keywords-ES - Spain; CIF Number; 3 - Length to be kept to exactly, without gaps; V A T Registration Number Check Rule; Tax Number One Check Rule; Countries/Regions

Title: Error While Activating the Solution: Phase Transition from UG2_DEV to RAD not allowed in Project Type ONE_OFF
Content: Symptom-You are getting the error Phase Transition from UG2_DEV to RAD not allowed in Project Type ONE_OFF  while trying to activate the solution from SDK.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the solution.-Navigate to the tab Implementation Manager.-Click on the Activate icon.-Error occurs.-Cause-The reason for the error message is that the activate is executed from Implementation Manager, which is not allowed after the solution is upgraded.-Resolution-You should right click on the solution and choose Activate-> All Items, the solution will be activated without any issues.-Note: If the solution is in Deployed status , the solution explorer level activation will be greyed out and the reactivation/ activation from implementation manager is used when there are any new patch solution which is failed or not activated.--In this case solution is already activated, so you do not need to reactivate the solution again from your end.

Title: Wrong Language Displayed in the Itemized List PDF Document of Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You are looking at itemized list in the project invoice request XYZ, however the PDF entry appears in language ABC where it should be in DEF.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Project Invoicing & select Project Invoice Requests view.-Select the relevant Project Invoice Request ID.-Select Edit.-Go to Itemized List and View & Edit.-The PDF document appears in language ABC instead of DEF.-Cause-You have changed the communication language in the master data of account from DEF to ABC on DD.MM.YYYY. Since the source document (Sales Order) has been created prior to change, it retains the old language. This address is used for the itemized list in the Customer Project Invoice Request and cannot be changed.-Resolution-Mintain the required communication language in the account master data before you create the sales order document for the account. Then system displays the Itemized List in the correct language for newly created project invoice requests.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select Edit and navigate to General tab.-Under Main Communication, enter the Language information.-Select Save and Close.-Note: You can find the account details either in Customer Invoice document or Project Invoice Request document.

Title: Health Check : Save not possible; buyer party missing or Party xxx not found as company
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You receive a health check where no Supplier Invoice gets created from Customer Invoice in an Intercompany scenario.-Ideally in Intercompany Scenario when customer invoice gets created, system should create supplier invoice at Buying Company side.-Cause-The reason why system is not creating Supplier Invoice automtacically because Customer Invoice sends wrong Buying Party to SIV because of which Buying company is not being determined on the document and cannot be saved.-Buying Company is always a mandatory attribute in Supplier Invoice; without it an invoice can’t be saved and hence message fails. Therefore no Supplier Invoice gets created in the system.-Resolution-You have to check  below information to identify a failed message at backend:-Sender Party: CustomerInvoiceProcessing-Receiver Interface name: SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoicingIn-1. Communication between CIV and SIV is determined by the output channel set in Bill to party of CIV, and if the communication channel is set as Internal EDX, the CIV output will be sent to SIV in form of an XML message.-NOTE : In SRT_MONI screen, you can find the stuck message with error message related to Account Assignment data missing.-But to find the specific message you need to check the Error Log for particular Message ID which displays correct erorr etails as Save not possible; buyer party missing or Party xxx not found as company .-2. Once you find correct message ID at backend, you have to follow below given steps :- a). Cancel the failed message.- b). Inform the customer to create a manual Supplier Invoice corresponding to the CIV.-Due to complexity of the steps, these steps should not be executed at direct support level. So this case document is relevant for Expert Support colleagues.

Title: How to View the Reports List With Support User Despite Missing Business Role
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer has enabled the business role assignment for reports. When you log in with a support user, you cannot see any reports in the Analysis work center because the support user has no business role, and thus no reports assigned to him.-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to the customer system with a support user.-Go to the work center Analysis -> Reports-No reports are shown.-Resolution-In many cases, you can request an L3 user and copy the access rights from the key user. If that does not help, you can use the transaction ANAST:-Log on to the backend and go to the transaction ANAST.-Click on ANA_IGNORE_ROLE_SCOPE. Please make sure you do not click on any other option here - some of these reports cause considerable and irreversible change in the customer system.-In the new window, per default, there is no entry for the support user. Enter X:-Execute. You will get a confirmation like this:- Now you can see all reports in the Analysis work center.

Title: Error Message: Target UI Could Not be Determined in the Current Scope. Please Ask Your System Administrator to Check the Scoping
Content: Symptom-You want to create new Service Agents after the scoping is finished. But when you try to create, you receive the following error message:-Target UI could not be determined in the current scope.-Please ask your system administrator to check the scoping.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementations Projects view-Select the First Implementation project and select Open Activity List button-Go to Prepare tab and open Define Administrators for Project Team activity-Cause-The activity Define Administrators for Project Team is not completed in the system.-Resolution-The status of the First Implementation project in the Business Configuration work center is In preparation.-Before creating a Service Agent you need to complete the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted by following the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view-Highlight the First Implementation project and choose Open Activity List-Go to the Prepare tab-Open the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted and check the Design Accepted box, and select Confirm-Close the activity-Once this is completed, the First Implementation project will be in Started status and you can create new Service Agents.

Title: You Get an Empty XML File From Electronic Financial Reporting Run
Content: Symptom-When you perform an Electronic Financial Reporting Run ﻿the output XML file is empty.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center General Ledger-Select view Electronic Financial Reporting - Germany-Choose the relevant run and press View Report Run Results-Click tab Attachments-Download the respective XML file and open it in Excel-You can see that there are no values displayed in the XML file.-Cause-In work center Business Configuration﻿ the assignment of the Financial Reporting Structure to the nodes of the Assigned Financial Reporting Item/Accounts and the respective Taxonomy ID has not been done correctly. Therefore you get a zero value in the output XML file.-Resolution-Go to work center Business Configuration-Select view Overview-Search for "*Electronic Financial*"-Click on Electronic Financial Reporting-Press Edit Taxonomies for Electronic Financial Reporting-Highlight Taxonomy ID and press Add Row-Add e.g. Financial Reporting Structure Type as Balance Sheet and select a corresponding Financial Reporting Structure-Select Edit Assignment-On the right section you see now the Balance Sheet-Expand this Balance Sheet-Open up e.g. Assets - Long Term Assets - Tangible Assets - Plant and Machinery - Acquisition Value-Under Assignment Details below you can see that nothing is maintained-On the left section now open a node and press "Assign" to assign a node or "Unassign" to unassign a node. Beware here: "Assign" button is only activated on node level on the right, not on G/L Account level.-Note: You can mark the checkboxes for "Calculation" as per your needs-Press Close and then Save and Close-If you conduct now a Electronic Financial Reporting Run the XML output file should have values. -See Also-Also see Case Document:-2208351 - Financial Reporting Structures Missing for Year End Closing Report Run

Title: Account Hierarchy icon not available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created an Account Hierarchy for Account XYZ but the icon Show Complete Hierarchy next to the Account ID in Account Hierarchy is not available for Business User ABC (ABC stands for a Business User that is no key user).-Reproducing the Issue-Maintain an Account Hierarchy for Account XYZ-Log in with Business User XYZ-Go to Customer workcenter-Go to the Accounts view-Open Account XYZ-Go to the Account Hierarchy facet- You cannot see the icon Show Complete Hierarchy when logged in with Business User ABC.-  Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-Resolution-The Account Hierarchy icon for the functionality Show Complete Hierarchy in the Account Facet is only visible for the key user. The Business User ABC is no key user and therefore they are not able to see the icon.

Title: You Notice the Following Error in the Sales Order:"Update of sales order not possible; change is not allowed. Time frame: End day or occurrence missing."
Content: Symptom-You notice the following error in the sales order document：Update of sales order not possible; change is not allowed. Time frame: End day or occurrence missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work center.-Select the  Sales Order view.-Search for the Sales order ABC.  (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order)-Click in the button View All.-Go to Document Flow tab and select show extend view.-You see the error: Update of sales order not possible; change is not allowed. Time frame: End day or occurrence missing. Here you notice that if you restart the process, the process communication error just comes back again.-Cause- You have maintained in Business Configuration section Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders a recurrence pattern, but the End After value is missing.-Resolution- To correct the issue please follow the steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-In the search field, put Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders.-Open this activity in edit mode and check the field End After.-If there is no end value specified, there will be no end to the number of occurrences that will get created. Please correct the configuration element and then process the task assigned to user responsible user.-

Title: How to Maintain Taxes Data in Product Master Data to Follow DOM Tax for Country FR
Content: Symptom-You are from country France (FR) and selling service or material to DOM countries i.e. Martinique (MQ). When creating sales order in the system and put account (from MQ), the tax code is not determined as expected. You expect the DOM tax with rate 8.5% to be used but system failed to determine the tax details. The auto-determined tax code is empty and rate 20% is used.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Create a new sales order and enter the necessary data like account (which is from country MQ), sales organizational data and then enter the product XYZ. (XYZ represents the ID of the product).-Go to the Taxes tab, you find the Automatic Tax Determination is ticked but no tax code determined. And the tax rate defaults to 20%.-At the bottom of the screen, there is an error message:Determination of tax code failed.-However, you expect the tax code 535 with rate 8.5% for DOM countries could be determined automatically by system.-Cause-The determination of tax code fails because the decision tree determines the tax event “313 - Sale of Services to DOM (GP, MQ, and RE)” and this tax event has only the tax code “535 – Sale of Services to DOM (GP, MQ, and RE), DOM Standard Rate” assigned. The tax code 535 can only be determined automatically if the corresponding product used in the sales document has following tax classification in its master data: Country FR, Region – empty, Tax Type 1-VAT, Tax Rate Type 3 – DOM Standard, the rest empty.-DOM Standard Rate  (8,5%) is not marked as standard rate for VAT FR in this case (instead 1-Standard with 20% maintained). Because this classification is missing, the tax code determination fails as there is no tax code in the system for tax event 313 and standard rate for FR.--Resolution-The system can only have one VAT classification per country for each product. You will need to modify the taxes setting in product master data to following DOM tax.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Services view.-Find the service product XYZ, edit it and go to Taxes tab.-Find the row for country FR, you can see the currently setting for country FR is with Tax Rate Type as 1 - Standard. This is not for DOM country.-You need to select the Tax Rate Type as 3 - DOM Standard in this case, and save it.-Now when you creating new sales order with this product XYZ, the tax code 535 for DOM standard (with rate 8.5%) will be used.

Title: Header Discount is Not Recalculated on Item Level in a Follow-Up Document Such as a Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-Manually added header price components such as in your example the Discount at document level are not getting recalculated at item level (on change of price relevant attributes like quantity of item) in follow up documents such as a Credit Memo created as a follow up document form an Invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select invoice XYZ (XYZ respresents the invoice ID).-Click on the Follow-Up button and select the Manual Credit Memo option.-In the New Credit Memo change the quantity of an item e.g. from 2 to 1.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Expand the respective item.-You can see that the discount is not split according to price and quantity reduced for the line item.-Cause-The header price component cannot be recalculated on item level when the quantity changes is due to the complexity involved in pricing with header price components (document level price components).-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour and works as designed.-You can use the following workaround:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select the respective invoice-Click on the Follow-Up button and select the Manual Credit Memo option.-In the New Credit Memo perform the respective changes e.g. removing an item and change the quantity.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Select the price component Discount in the Total Pricing section.-Click on the Remove button.-Click on the Add Row button.-Select the price component Discount.-Enter the respective amount.-Save your changes.

Title: Error: Enter an account determination profile. Save Failed.
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Set of Books in Fine Tune activity: Set of Books and you can see the error message: Enter an account determination profile. Save Failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work center-Select Implementation Projects View-Select the project and click on Open Activity List-Go to Integrate and Extend tab-Find the activity Set of Books and open the activity-Click on New and select the option Set Of Books from drop down list-Navigate to Company Settings tab-Here, you have entered the Company and Account Determination Profile. click on Save-You can see the error message: Enter an account determination profile. Save Failed.-Cause-A company can only use an account determination profile if that profile has been assigned to the country for that company. The assignment of a profile to a country, activates the country-specific account determination within that profile. For example, If your company is located in country - Peru then, the country - Peru must be aqssigned the account determination profile.- Resolution-In order to asisgn a country to account determination profile, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center-Select Implementation Projects View-Select the project and click on Open Activity List-Go to Fine Tune tab-Search for the activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Click on any of the subledger-Select an Account Determination Profile-Click on Assign Countries to Profile-Here, you have to maintain the country

Title: Report Does Not Open in ODATA
Content: Symptom-You are trying to open a report (standard or customized) via an ODATA URL, however you get a blank screen or a Bad Request error. You have done the following checks:-The system and report information in the URL are correct-The report is assigned to a work center-You are using supported ODATA query options (please check the help center for supported queries)-Nevertheless, the URL does not open.-Cause-The respective report uses a restricted key figure of the type Grid. This key figure type is not supported in ODATA. -Resolution-To check the key figure type you can proceed as follows:-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Reports.-Search for the respective report. If it is customized, click on Edit With -> Report Wizard. If it is a standard one, click on New -> Report as Copy.-Go to step 2. Click on Personalize in the top right corner of the screen, and select the field Key Figure ID as visible. Save and close the Personalize screen.-Now you will see the ID of the key figure group that is selected. As an example, let us assume that it is the group HCMTLMU01_GRI_02 (Employee Times: Monthly). If GRI is part of the ID, the type of key figure is Grid.-Unfortunately, this key figure type cannot be used with ODATA. You would need to remove this key figure / key figure group from the report via the report wizard.

Title: Service Ping Error in Vertex Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-You have checked vertex connection in the communication arrangement, however a ping fails with error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and user Management work center.-Go to Communication Arrangements view-Edit the Vertex communication arrangement.-Click Edit Advanced Setting.-Click Check Connection.-The following error is raised: Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: Processing error in Internet Communication Framework: ("ICF Error when receiving the response: ICM_HTTP_CONNECTION_BROKEN") ()-Cause-The communication arrangement ping works only for systems which are in the SAP firewalls. In this case, Vertex is outside so ping will always raise this HTTP error.-Resolution-This error does not necessarily mean that the connection is not working. You may open a document that retrieves tax data from Vertex, e.g. Sales Order, and check whether the automatic tax determination happens in the Items tab.

Title: Open Outgoing Checks Migration Error: My Bank Account Internal ID not found
Content: Symptom-During execute migration of Open Outgoing Checks you get the error as-My Bank account internal ID XYZ not found-Error detected in source record with key value ZZZ, XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Create Unit, Execute Migration, Upload File for Open Outgoing Checks and click on Process File.-Cause-Bank internal ID XYZ for this account you have still not enabled that it supports the payment method Check printing and unless you have this method to your bank settings, system will not accept any open outgoing check items under this payment method to be in the system for this bank account ZZZ.-Resolution-Now to correct it follow the below steps.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under Master Data click on My Banks.-Select My Bank ID ZZZ, click on Edit Bank Accounts.-Click on Payment Method, Add Row and select Check Printing ﻿and Save.--Perform the migration Open Outgoing Checks again then this time the error will not persists.

Title: You Want to Change the Calculation of VAT but the System Does not Allow to Change the Standard Calculation
Content: Symptom-You want to change the calculation of VAT but the system does not allow to change the standard calculation.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the Invoice  ABC  (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Document ).-Click in the button View All.-Go to Items tab.-Here you will see VAT is calulated based on Net Price. In Business Configuration, Configure Price Strategy activity is available but system is not allowed to change the standard calculation.-Cause-The system works as expected. This is the designed behavior of the system.-Resolution-The standard way to calculating the VAT is on the net price.  -See Also-However as workaround to calculate the VAT the partner BADI  PDI_ES_PATC_CALCULATE_TAX can be used by using the tax base amount in the extended field.

Title: Withholding Tax Tab Missing For Country France in the Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination
Content: Symptom-Withholding Tax Tab missing in the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination under subledger Tax for the country France.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Select activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Under Account Determination, select Tax.-During the loading of the screen if notice the Withholding Tax tab but once the screen is ready/loaded then the Withholding Tax disappears.- Cause-For Country: France it doesn't have Withholding Tax (WHT) postings, so the tab Withholding Tax is not maintained/provided.-Resolution-For Country: France it doesn't have Withholding (WHT) postings, only base amount of WHT must be reported and this is why we delivered WHT calculation with 0% rate in accounting, no postings for WHT will happen, this is why the tab is not maintained for France.

Title: Unexpected Debit Entry Posting in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-In the journal entry resulting from a posted customer invoice XYZ - a some small decimal value of the amount posted as Revenue also shows in Debit for the same account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Journal Entries view and find the Customer Invoice XYZ.-Click on the Journal Entry ID 001.-Sample Posting:-Accounts Receivable Debit 954.00 INR-Service Tax Payable Credit 4.15 INR-Revenue Credit  950.00 INR-Revenue Debit 0.15 INR-Cause-In India, its a business requirement that all documents should either end in .50 paise or 1 rupee of rounding.-Resolution-Rounding only happens, if the document does not end either in .5 or .00 INR, In India its a business requirement that all documents should either end in .50 paise or 1.00 rupee rounding. so if your document net price is 900 INR ( 900 + 4.5 ) is ending with 945.50 then no rouding is applied but this results in 945.60 then rounding will come in and create diff price .10 INR component to make for the rounding value to be paid /received as 945.50 only since the dedominations should either in 0.50 paise or 1 rupee of rounding.

Title: Item Sorting in Pricing and Invoicing tab is Not in Order
Content: Symptom-You see that the Sorting for Items under the Pricing and Invoicing Tab of the Service Confirmation is not shoing in approporiate Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Field Service and Repair Work Center-Go to Service Confirmation View-Select Show All and find for a releveant Document-Click on Edit-Navigate to Pricing and Invoicing Facet-Select Pricing-Here you see that the Order of Items is Scrambled-Cause-The String Displayed is a combination of  Line.Productid .-This is because it is a concatenated column and sorting is done alphabetically instead of numeric. --This is a generic behaviour across all CRM documents which use this reuse UI componet and since this is a UI sort and we cannot control this.-Resolution-This is expetced system behavior.

Title: You are NOT Able to Add New Field Into Existing Pricing Table
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add new field int an existing pricing table. You get error messages:-Number of field assignments and key fields do not match-Insertion of condition table fields not allowed.-Save failed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find the activity: Configure Price Strategy.-Open it and click on the Pricing Tables hyperlink.-Select one custom pricing table ABC. (ABC presents the name of the custom price table)-Click on Add Row button.-Select the a field from the list, for example Currency.-Click on the Save button, you get the mentioned errors and not able to save the change into this pricing tab ABC.-Cause-Pricing table once saved, it is not possible to update or delete. Due to this reason, adding new field to saved pricing table is not allowed.-Resolution-You have to create new pricing table and maintain the desired fields. This is the design of the system currently.

Title: It is Not Possible to Cancel a Customer Invoice via Web Service

There is no web service operation can be used to cancel the customer invoice.-Maintain customer invoices legal authorisation-Find customer invoices-Cause- It is not possible to cancel a customer invoice by web service.-Resolution-Possible work around :-Customer invoice BO action is PSM release , which can be used for cancellation of CI’s via PDI.

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to activate the Design KPIs and Design Dashboards view in the Business Analytics work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Scoping not done properly under Business Configuration work center-Resolution-Please add the element SAP Business in Focus Mobile App to your scoping by following these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Project Scope view-Proceed to Questions and expand Built-in Services and Support > System Management > Analytics-Select SAP Business in Focus Mobile App-Once scoped the two mentioned views get controlled via Application and User Management > User and Access Management > Business Users > Edit > Access Rights > Available Work Centers and Views > ANA_BUSINESSANALYTICS- ANA_DESIGNKPIS (Design KPIs)-ANA_KUA_ADB_WOC_VIEW (Design Dashboards)

Title: Production Task Data Source missing data
Content: Symptom-You might realize a discrepancy between the number of results shown for Production Task data source or report faces created on the top of this data source, with the total number of Tasks in the Task Control UI.-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to check the tasks number in the Task Control list:-Go to Production Control Work Center-Go to Task Control View-Select All Production Tasks by Selection--It shows XXX tasks.-Steps to check the tasks number in the Task Control list:-Go to Business Analytics-Go to Design Data sources-Open Production Task data source-The counter shows a smaller number of records in comparison with the number of tasks shown in the Task Control list.-Cause-The Task Control list shows the total count of tasks in the system, whereas the data source shows the aggregated values of materials in the task.--For example: if there are 4 input material for one task there are 4 count in data source and one in task control.-You may also note if in your system, you have tasks which are intermediary tasks and does not have input materials.  This also can be a cause for having a lesser number of records (counter).-Resolution-As conclusion, there is no discrepancy, this is an expected behavior which is based on usage.

Title: Form Template Missing for Service Work Ticket and Service Request
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that no one form template is available in the system for Service Work Ticket (code C37) and Service Request (Code C31).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management.-Select Form Template Maintenance.-Click in Advanced Search and in Template Group field, select Service Work Ticket (Code C37) or Service Request (Code C31).-Then click over OK.-No form template will be found.-   Cause-In Business Configurartion, you have selected a country for which there are not standard delivered form templates for Service Request/ Tickets there are no country-specific form template variants. Hence it is required to also scope country US - because the master form template is in United States/ English.-Resolution-Please to scope US in addition to currently country in your system, following the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration-Select Implementation Project-Click in Edit Project Scope-For Country, add US for your tenant.-Now the standards form templates should be available for you.

Title: Error Message: Unable to Load Collection for the connection ByD OData Source, reason: Cannot open this connection
Content: Symptom-You are performing the testing for, ByDesign ODATA connection issue via SQLServer Integration Service. Within SQLServer Integration Service (SSIS), you are able to create a new ODATA connection via the Connection manager and successfully test the connection. When you create a Data Flow within SSIS and create an ODATA source using the ODATA connection, system throws below error-Unable to Load Collection for the connection ByD OData Source, reason: Cannot open this connection-Resolution-SQL server integration services is a product by Microsoft. Such issues were already reported by other customers, it looks like a Microsoft issue, as the same connection works nicely in other tools, or the browser.--We do not have a concrete solution for this. but below information may help:--1. Just to be sure: verify, that the password is correct. connection tests often do a technical connection test only, that is: look, if the server is reachable, but do not use the credentials to really authenticate.--Hence a typo in the username/password would not be detected by such a test.--2. It could help to enter the URL directly in a browser and provide the basic authentication credentials as queried to the browser. if something is returned, it is in fact working.-3. Some SSIS issues are discussed here: MSDN forum:-https://social.msdn.microsoft.com/Forums/sqlserver/en-US/82e35d79-764e-4 da2-a3d0-56452c0a9873/cant-load-atom-odata-feed-with-ssis-2014-odata-source-feature-pack-component?forum=sqlintegrationservices

Title: Tax Payment Deferral For Over The Counter Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have created over the counter invoices, however you expect the system to have the option to defer taxes for the created invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales work center-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales view-Edit one of the documents-Go to the Items tab-Open the Taxes section-You see that the Tax Payment Deferred indicator is not enabled.-Cause-For the over the counter (OTC) scenario, this is expected system design. If you want to use the OTC process, ByDesign is creating a customer invoice with the deferred tax flag unchecked and when you post the invoice the taxes are posted directly to the tax account. Usually in the OTC process, you have the customer in the store and he pays immediately (via credit card or cash). From a ByDesign perspective, you have to post the payment of such a OTC-customer invoice ideally in the same day, but mandatory in the same reporting period (month) as the invoice itself and then the taxes will be reported correctly (no need to defer taxes).--If you have created a customer invoice via the OTC process and get the payment much later (2-3 month later), than from our perspective this would not be an OTC process. In this case, you may start the process directly with the customer invoice (which would have deferred taxes and the taxes will be due when you post the payment of the customer invoice).-See Also-2467050 - All VAT/Sales Tax Items Report Does not Show All Customer Invoices

Title: Error Appears in the Purchase Order Containing kit Items
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order for kit item and when you are trying to add items, you get the below error message--Error: Company 0 does not exist or is invalid or not accessible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order which has Kit Item.-Select Edit and add items with Process Type Non-Stock.-Cause- You have to use Process Type To-Stock  to create Purchase Order with kit item.-Resolution- Purchasing kit items are supported for Process Type To-Stock and Third-Party Procurement. This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-How to Scope Stock Material Procurement?-Go to Business Configuration work center and select view Implementation project (Screen with titled Implementation Projects screen will open)-Select project First Implementation and click on action Edit Project Scope-Go to 3rd tab called Scoping-Go to Purchasing , select Stock Material Procurement under Purchase Request and Order Management-Select check box of Stock Material Procurement-Select Next-In 4th tab called Questions, Navigate to Stock Material Procurement via Purchasing and select Purchase Request and Order Management.-On right hand side of it, under Questions for Stock Material Procurement block , select Business option You can receive stock materials -Select next and finish to configure To-Stock

Title: Notes Tab Missing in Customer Migration Template Using the Option Enhance or Modify
Content: Symptom-Notes Tab is missing in Customer Migration Template using the migration mode Enhance or Modify.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Find the activity Migration of Customers in the activity list.-Upload the migration file and change the mode to Enhance Existing Records.-Notes tab will disappear.-Cause-System works as designed.-It is not possible to migrate notes for existing accounts.-Resolution-The only way to add note to an existing acount is to update it manually.

Title: The Intercompany Project is not created automatically.
Content: Symptom-Intercompany Project is not created automatically from intercompany relevant sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Go to the Products tab.-Go to the Purchase Orders subtab.-Open the Purchase Order and go to the Document Flow tab here you can see the Intercompany Sales Order.-Edit the Intercompany Sales Order, you can see the Intercompany Project is not created via B2B communication.-Cause-In the Intercompany Sales Order if an item has the type Fixed Price instead of Time and Material, then the intercompany project must be generated manually by selecting Create Project in the sales order. Automatic creation of intercompany project is supported only for Time and Material item type.-Resolution-System works as designed.

Title: Extension Scenario Material to Contract Item is not Available
Content: Symptom-The Extension Scenario to pass on the extension field from a material to a contract line item is currently not available.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Open any product.-Go to the General tab.-Click on Adapt and select Enter Adaptation Mode.-Click on Adapt and select Edit screen.-Select the Extension Fields section.-Select the extension field ABC (ABC represents the name of the extension field)-Click on the Further Usage button.-Select the Extension Scenario tab.-The extension scenrio Material - General Information to Customer Contract – Item is not available.-Cause-The Extension Scenario to pass on the extension field from a material to a contract line item is currently not available. This Extension Scenario is currently only available for Services and Entitlements. Here you need to activate the following Extension Scenarios:-Service - General Information to Customer Contract – Item-Entitlement - General Information to Customer Contract – Item--For Materials to Contract there are currently only the following extension scenarios available:-Material - General Information to Customer Contract - Covered Product-The extension field will be passed on to the Contract in the Covered Products tab.-You can add the extension field to the section Covered Products.-Material - General Information to Customer Contract - Item Entitled Product-The extension field will be passed on to the Contract in the Items tab and the Entitled Products sub tab.-When you add an Entitlement to a contract you will get the sub tab Entitled Products.-You can add the extension field in this sub tab.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-You can add this new requirement in the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum as an idea: https://ideas.sap.com/SAPByDesign

Title: Error Message Connection GBB Not Configured While Requesting a New Tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer receives the error message Connection GBB Not Configured when requesting a new test tenant from Service Control Center-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center-Select the view Systems-Select Request Creation-Fill the system Request-Receive the message above-Cause-The GBB connection is not configured for this tenant and hence it is not possible to request new tenants.-Resolution-Send the incident to hosting queue MS - System Setup/Termination to configure the GBB connection

Title: The field Datev ID is considered unnecessary
Content: Symptom-The field Datev is mandatory but not considered needed, nor can the field be found in the webservice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work centre.-Go to the view Accounts.-Select All, search and open account ABC (ABC represents the name or ID of the account).-Click View All.-Select the tab Financial Data.-Scroll down to Datev Integration.-Cause-The field Datev ID that you find on the UI when editing or creating an account is mandatory in certain constellations.-Resolution-In the webservice you find this field under CustomerMaintainRequestBundlePaymentData as AccountDebtorExternalID.

Title: VAT Moss Return Report For Country Belgium
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You wish to know where to find the VAT Moss Return Run report in the system.-Resolution-VAT MOSS return for Belgium is not currently delivered/supported in the system.

Title: Cannot Download Golden Tax Invoice Due to the Error:Cannot download file; Mandatory field(s) Net Amount missing. (China Only)
Content: Symptom-You are not able to download the Golden Tax Invoice from system due to the error: Cannot download file; Mandatory field(s) Net Amount missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Golden Tax Invoices work center view.-Find the required invoice.-Click Prepare for Download button.-In the new window, click New- With or Without Combined option. Error appears:Cannot download file; Mandatory field(s) Net Amount missing.-Cause-The error only occurs when there is a item line with zero net price.-Net price is mandatory for every line item in the customer for downloading golden tax file.-Resolution-It is the designed system behavior.

Title: Buyer ID Shows Unexpected Value on Customer Invoice Form and Sales Order Confirmation Form
Content: Symptom-You have not maintained any Customer Part Number in the product master data, however when previewing a customer invoice, you find the Buyer ID fields shows the Product ID instead of showing blank.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Find the certain invoice and click Preview.-You find in the preview layout, the Buyer ID equals to the Product ID, however you did not maintain any Buyer ID (Customer Part Number in the product master data). You think it should be blank if there is no Customer Part Number maintained.- Cause-In Customer Invoice form, if the Customer Part Number is not maintained, then the Buyer ID will be defaulted to Product ID and will not be shown as blank.-Additionally, in the Sales Order Confirmation form, the behavior is different. If the Customer Partner Number is not maintained, the Buyer ID shows blank.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.

Title: Depreciation Report With Incorrect Planned Depreciation
Content: Symptom-You ran the Depreciation report under Fixed Assets and expect to see an overview of all asset classes set off against future periods showing the expected depreciation per year and calculated book value at the end of each period, nevertheless, the planed depreciation is being shown as either 0,00 or in blank.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center-Go to List subview-Open the Depreciation report.-Fill out the mandatory fields and also a given time frame.-Click Go.-You'll see that for same asset classes the key figure for Planned Depreciation is either 0,00 or in blank.-Cause-The Planned Depreciation is based on the fixed asset details that belong to that asset class. You may drill down to the fixed asset ID in the report by adding the Fixed Asset characteristic and check the report values and asset's master.-In this case, the time frame that you have selected as report parameter does not cover the depreciation plan for that fixed asset, hence the Planned Depreciation is shown as 0,00. Alternatively, the depreciation method for the asset might also be 000 - No automatic depreciation.-For the cases where the planned depreciation is in blank, there might exist an inconsistency in the asset. This could be caused due to an invalid interval assignment, for example. The Planned Depreciation also remains in blank if the asset is Capitalized (first acquisition posting) having the depreciation method as 000 - No automatic depreciation.-Resolution-In order for the report show the proper Planned Depreciation, drill down into the concerned asset class to the fixed asset IDs, identify the asset with the wrong planned depreciation and verify its master data.

Title: Error : Change Not Possible for Org Employee Assigned
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the error Change Not Possible for Org XYZ; employee ABC assigned while trying to replicate to the org structure.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Data Integration work center.-Select the view Organizational Structures Replication Requests.-Selct the record and Schedule.-Process fails with errors.-Cause-The replication requests are failed because you are entering start date as DD1:MM1:YYYY1 in the ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE REPLICATION REQUEST wherein the org unit is valid from DD:MM:YYYY and thereby restricting the validity.-Resolution-The date of replication request should be exactly the same as in the org unit where an employee is assigned to that org unit. Change the start date in the replication request as same as org unit and try the replication again which will resolve the issue.

Title: Sales orders with Invoice Schedule are Still Listed in the Sales Orders without Invoice Schedule Query
Content: Symptom- Sales orders with invoice schedule are still listed in the Sales Orders without Invoice Schedule query.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Order Invoicing Overview view.-From the Show list, selected the query Sales Orders without Invoice Schedule.-You find that the sales orders which is having invoice schedule maintained are still listed in this query.-Cause-Sales Order Without Invoice Schedule query is showing all sales orders as of now. -Resolution-This is the system design currectly.

Title: Create XSLT File For Payroll Interface
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to create your own XSLT file for Payroll Interface -Cause-There are no tutorials from us published on how to maintain / create a new template. But there is always a set of code examples that the user can get from the internet.-Resolution-SAP provides with a template which is with reference to payroll providers ( if any ).-You are free to create their own implementations to suit the needs of your payroll and payroll providers-Also you can download the template from the link and use any XSLT editor to create your own.-There is a standard XML signature for each country version.-During each payroll run, an XML file is the standard file that is being delivered from SAP and we also delivered an XSLT to transform this XML into an excel to have a human readable format which only included the subset of fields that was delivered in the XML.-So you can modify the XSLT to remove existing fields in excel or add extra fields that are a part of XML but not a part of excel ONLY.

Title: Item Groups XACT and XFIS are Missing in Sales tab of a Service
Content: Symptom-Item Groups XACT and XFIS are missing in Sales tab of a Service.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Services view.-Search and Edit (View All) the Service.-Go to Sales tab.-Drop down for Item Group, where the above values are missing-Cause-Below questions should be scoped in order to have the required Item Groups:-Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts, that result from selling services, directly from the sales order using a fixed price?--Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts that result from sales or services, taking actual costs from the service confirmation?-Resolution-The system is working as designed

Title: When doing a Material Replication you receive the following error message: Number Range Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When doing a Material Replication you receive the following error message: Number Range Missing-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center;-Click on Web Service Monitoring View;-Select the erroneous message-The message is related with the a Material Replication error-Cause-The issue occur because you have not maintained the Number Ranges for Materials-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center;-Click on Implementation Projects View;-Select the relevant project and click on Open Activity List;-Select the tab All;-Search for "General Business Partner";-"Define Number Ranges for Materials";- Click on Add and maintain them as per the below screenshot.

Title: Error message received "Action not Enabled" while Approving Goods & Service Receipt
Content: Symptom-You cannot approve the Goods and Services Receipt due to an error message:-Action not enabled-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work centre.-Choose Approvals view.-Search for your GSR approval task.-Choose Approve.-Cause-Accounting period relevant for date DD/MM/YYYY has Period Status as Blocked and hence you are getting this error message.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you can follow either of the following option.-Open relevant period in financial and post the Goods and Services Receipt document by following the below steps.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies sub-view under Master Data view.-Select the relevant company ID and choose Open and Close Period.-Search for the accounting period relevant for date DD/MM/YYYY. Here you can see that the Period Status of this period is Blocked.-Now select the period and choose Open Periods.-Choose Save button.-OR-If you do not want to open the accounting period, then you can use Set Process Control and choose to post to accounting to some other open period by following the below steps.-First you need to Set Process Control. To do so, following the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select sub-view Master Data under Companies view. Select the relevant company.-Choose Set Process control.-Choose Add Row.-Select Process Control Status as Not Blocked, Business Process Group as Goods and Services Confirmation.-Entry Possible Until should be the date by which you want to do the reverse confirmation. Like if you are planning to do it today, then enter today's date.-From Posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ or the date before XX/YY/ZZZZ and To posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ  or any day after XX/YY/ZZZZ.-Finally choose Save and Close button.-Now you will be able to approve the correspoding goods and service receipt which will create a Goods and Services Receipt BTM task which is in in process status. --Note that it will not post into accounting yet but it will create a business task in General Ledger work center, where you need to select a new posting date for which accounting period is open. -To do  so, follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Closing Cockpit--> Closing-Relevant Tasks.-Choose Advance button. In the Related Source Document, enter Goods and Service Receipt ID and for Related Source Document Type select Goods and Services Receipt.-Choose Go button. You will get the relevant business task.-Choose Edit button.-In this screen, you will see an entry for the source document i.e. Goods and Services Receipt ID, which should be in In-Process status.-Choose View Business Transaction button.-Now choose Post to Another Period button. In the field Alternate Posting Date, enter a suitable date for which accounting period is currently open.-Then choose OK button. It will take you back to the task screen. Choose Refresh button.-Now the document Processing Status will change from In Process to Finished.-    With this, Goods and Service Receipt will be posted into accounting with posting date selected by you.-OR-Approver can choose Send Back for Revision on the BMT task which will make the GSR to In Revision status and open for editing. The creator of GSR can edit the posting date to any open period and send back to approver for approval.

Title: Accounts Receivable - Balance Audit Trail Shows Balance Company Currency is Cumulative of Previous Customer Account Balance
Content: Symptom-You are checking the balance company currency of a certain receivable account balances with the Accounts Receivable - Balance Audit Trail report. You observe that the Balance Company Currency is derived by also including the Previous Customer Account Balance-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Show All and find Accounts Receivable - Balance Audit Trail and click on it.-Fill the required fields and leave the customer field if filled then the balance company currency shows correctly-Customer ID Debit Amount Company Currency Credit Amount Company Currency Balance Company Currency-ABC 3000 USD 300 USD 2700 USD-PQR 4000 USD 400 USD 3600 USD-      If the Customer field is left blank then the behavior is as shown below-Customer ID Debit Amount Company Currency Credit Amount Company Currency Balance Company Currency-ABC 3000 USD 300 USD 2700 USD-PQR 4000 USD 400 USD 6300 USD ( PQR 3600 + 2700 of Customer ABC )-Cause-If you leave the customer field blank then the balance company currency is cummulative of previous customer account aswell and Accounts Receivable Balance audit trail report is not the correct report for doing any kind of comparisons of balances of all customers together.-Resolution-if you explicitely select a particular Customer ID then the balance amount is not a cumulative and does not add the previous customer account balance. -If you want the balances listed for all customers then you need to look into Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance - Report. Here the balance does not cumulate the previous customer account balance - irrespective of whether you enter the Customer Account in the selection criteria or not.

Title: When You Are Trying to Access the Sales Order Work Center it is Appearing an Error Message Stating that Planning on HANA is Currently Not Supported.
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to access the Sales Order work center it is appearing an error message stating that Planning on HANA is currently not supported.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Sales Order Overview.-These following error will appear: Planning on HANA is currently not supported, Error Reading the data of data source Sales Target Setting.-Cause-This is occcuring because there is a report added to the Sales Orders overview , this report is trying to link a Sales Planning with a HANA database, however this is not possible for now.-Resolution-If you remove from the screen the report that is running this data, the error message will disappear-Go to the Sales work center.-Sales Order Overview.-Scroll down the page and look for the report that is trying to push this data from the Sales Planning-Click on Personalize-Select the option This Screen-Uncheck the desired report at the sections list-Press the save button-   See Also-For further information you also check the following case documents:-2002950 - Unable to Create Sales Planning.-1901758 - Sales Planning not Supported

Title: On Changing the Date in the Contract->Item ,the Schedule Invoice Request gets Removed
Content: Symptom-On changing the date in the Contract->Item ,the Schedule Invoice Request gets removed.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-In the Show field select All Invoice Requests from drop-down and in the Find field enter ABC (where ABC is the Contract ID).-You will find the Schedule Invoice Request PQR (where PQR is Schedule Invoice Request ID) ,reference to Contract ABC with status as To be Invoiced for date XX.YY.ZZZZ for an item LMN.-Now go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view and search for the Contract ID ABC.-Edit the Contract ABC and click on the View ALL button.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and sub tab Invoice Schedule .-Expand line-item LMN and change the date from XX.YY.ZZZZ to XX1.YY1.ZZZZ1 and Save the Contract.-Now go again to Invoice Request view and search for the Schedule Invoice Request PQR.-You will no more find the record for Schedule Invoice Request PQR for date XX.YY.ZZZZ ,nor for the updated date as XX1.YY1.ZZZZ1.-Cause-If you change the date within the Contract->Item , the Schedule Invoice Request which exist for an earlier date will get disappear from the Invoice Request view.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Report Navigation Does Not Apply Filters Correctly
Content: Symptom-You are using a report chart in HTML5. Via the shown values you navigate to another report, but you notice that the filters set in the first report are not taken over to the navigation target.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Analysis, view Reports.-Open the report from which you want to navigate, for example ABC.-Let us assume that you have added the characteristic Calendar Month in this report, so the key figure values are shown per month. Click on one of the key figure values (for example for February) and choose the navigation target, for example report DEF.-When the report DEF opens, you see that the values are not filtered for February.-Cause-The field Calendar Month (in this example) was added to the report by going to Add Fields. For those fields, the navigation is not supported.-Resolution-If the report is customized, you can proceed as follows:-Open the report from the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports, by marking the report and clicking on Edit With > Report Wizard.-Go to step 4 (Characteristic Properties).-For the field Calendar Month you will have to choose the option Using Variable.-Save the report.-This is unfortunately not possible in a standard report. You may consider creating a report copy with the above settings.

Title: Intercompany Indicator Is Missing In The Project Types Activity.
Content: Symptom-Intercompany Indicator is missing in the Project Types Activity. However the Intercompany Project Setting are scoped in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose Implementation Projects view.-Choose the Open Activity button.-Go to Fine tune tab.-Here choose the Project Types activity-Choose Open button.-Here you can see the Intercompany Indicator is missing.-Cause-The change project is not active. So we have to merge and activate the change project first. Otherwise the changes in scoping and fine tuning will not be active in the system.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Choose the respective project.-Choose the Open Activity List-Go to Go live tab.-Select the Activity Merge Changes with Production System.-Select Open button.-Select Start Merge button.

Title: Cannot Create a Custom Approval Process for Purchase Orders.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a custom Approval Process, but the following error appears.-You can’t leave a condition field empty.-Impossible, block  instance /SRMAP/PUR_PO_APP-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User Management work center.-Click on Approval Process.-Search for Default Approval process for Purchase Order.-Click on it.-Error described will appear.-Cause-The error shown because the functionality is not scoped in the system.-Resolution-To Scope the Activity in the Sytem, please follow the steps below.-Go to Business Configuration.-Click on Implementation Projects.-Click on Edit.-Go to Questions tab.-Drop down Purchasing.-Select Purchase Order.-Scope the question. Do you want to use an approval process for Purchase Orders?-Save

Title: Restrict The Employee To Select Per Diems Multiple Times In A Day
Content: Symptom-While creating an expense report the employee is able to select Per Diem multiple times for a day. How do we restrict it?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel & Expenses view.-Create a new expense report.-Choose a country in the header.-Click Add More Destinations.-In the Expenses Tab we are allowed to enter the per diem expense type for multiple times for the same day.- Cause- You can use the expense types for per diem rates. Expense types usually represents receipts which can be entered several times per day.- Resolution-There is no validation in the system which checks whether one expense appears more than once a day and hence cannot restrict employees to select per diems multiple times in a day.

Title: Length of X exceeds maximum length 4, specified with tt:maxLength
Content: Symptom-Error : Length of X exceeds maximum length 4, specified with tt:maxLength on consuming a webservice. (X= a number)-Cause-This is because ByDesign system will be receiving the value in request XML tag as follows:--X with a space in the end. So the BYD considers it over limit (more than 4).-or X again coming up with a space in between.--Resolution-You can remove the space from the request XML structure and send the data back again to the ByDesign system.

Title: Validity Filter is not Availale for Person Responsible ID Mass Change Contact Data
Content: Symptom-To make a subsequent change in Responsibilities after an employee left the company the field Validity in the help selection field for Person Responsible ID shall be used. This field is not available on the screen for Mass Change Contact Data. But it is available on the screen for Mass Change Account Data.-In Mass Change Account Data, In the Validity field you can select from All Employees, to Current and Future Employees and Past Employees. This allows to search for active and inactive employees because contacts/accounts can also be assigned to terminated employees.--Whereas, Validity is not available in the Mass Change Contact Data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks and select Mass Change Contact Data.-Select Advanced and select All Contacts from the drop down-Select the Value Selection for Person Responsible ID-Select Advanced, where Validity Field is not available.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Extension Feild with Calculation Rule Does Not Update when the Purchase Order is in Approval
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a extension field with calculation rule {example - creation date with calculation rule Created On (SystemAdministrativeData/CreationDateTime)} however the field is not updated when the purchase order is sent for approval.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Order work center.-Choose Purchase Order view.-Edit you purchase order which is in status In-Approval.-Choose View All.-Navigate to sub-section General Information-you will notice the extension field creation date is not filled with the creation date from purchase order header.-Cause-When a purchase order is sent for approval, all the nodes of the document are made read only since the key user extension is on the PO ROOT Node which is read only at the time it fails to copy the information into this field. Hence any update to any extension field is disabled.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior and system behaves as designed.

Title: Error Message Value not valid for variable Partner Company
Content: Symptom-You have selected Partner Company as a variable in the selection of the G/L Accounts - Line Items report. For some values you select from the value help of this variable you immediately receive an error message:-Value XYZ not valid for variable Partner Company-(XYZ represents the Partner Company ID that you have selected from the value help)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center-Go to the Reports view-Open report G/L Accounts - Line Items-Open the value help for variable Partner Company (please note this variable is not shown by default - it is only shown after selection via the Add Fields button)-Select a value from the value help and confirm-The mentioned error message will be displayed.-Cause-Business Partner XYZ was created as a separate entity and will not be available in the Organizational Management. You can see that by going to the General Ledger work center, Partner Companies view. If you find the checkbox in column Org Unit is unticked for Partner Company ID XYZ this case document applies.--Partner Company in the selection screen of the G/L Accounts - Line Items report compares the input value with the existing org structure. When no such org unit is found it gives the mentioned error.-Resolution-Use selection on variable Business Partner to retrieve data for Partner Company XYZ.

Title: Description of G/L Account (Origin) Field Shows Field Code in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The description of G/L Account (Origin) field is missing in the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report. The field only displays the field code but not the actual description.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center, open the  Reports - List view.-Select Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report, enter all the mandatory selection and press go to execute the report.-Add G/L Account (Origin) field from the Not Currently Shown section to Rows.-The description of G/L Account (Origin) displays the field code instead of a meaningful description.-Cause-If there are any issues related to G/L account description in reports, there is high probability of FSI inconsistency.-Resolution-Reload the respective FSI view as follows:-Login backend and enter transaction GFSSTM.-Select Fast Search View with FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT and Execute.-Expand Fast Search Views and select all the 4 nodes.-Click on Persistence button and then click on Refresh button to check that FSI has been reloaded and the status is green.-If reload does not help, please check whether customer maintained the G/L account description in local language.-Login system with local language.-Go to General Ledger work center and view General Ledger Accounts.-Select Company and Set of Book.-Check whether there is description of each G/L accounts here.-If description is maintained and there is still the issue, please forward to development team.

Title: The Milestone Of Project Is Assigned To Wrong Date.
Content: Symptom-You are defining the tasks of a project. During this process you have created a Milestone as a successor of one of the tasks-The system however scheduled this Milestone to start one day after the predecessor task is finished. Your expectation is that the Milestone should occur on the same day as the task is finished, since you define a lag time of Zero days, however this is not occurring.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Search and select the desired project-Select the option Edit, then choose Project Plan-Select the Task ABC.-See it is scheduled to finish on XX-YY-ZZZZ-Select the Milestone XYZ-See it is a successor of the task ABC. It has a dependency type defined as Finish-to-Start and a lag defined as Zero days.-Hover the cursor on the milestone icon in the Gantt Chart-System shows the start date as X1.YY.ZZZZ (where X1 is one day after XX)-Cause-System is behaving as expected.-If you have a milestone that is a successor of a task and you maintain the lag as Zero, this means that the milestone is planned on the following day after the task is finished.-The reason is that typically a milestone is not just a mark in the calendar but sometimes also something has to be done when closing a milestone.-Resolution-To achieve the desired scenario, where the Milestone starts on the same day as the task is finished, the Lag time needs to be maintained as -1-
