Title: How to Edit or Maintain a Valid From - Valid To Date for Addresses in an Account?
Content: Symptom-How to Edit or Maintain a Valid From - Valid To Date for Addresses in an Account?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select and Edit an Account.-Go to General tab.-Select Communication sub tab and Addresses section.-Here there is Valid From and Valid To date specified. But there is no option to change it.-Neither when adding a new address row nor by select the current line there is no option to modify this date.- Resolution-The time dependent address details cannot be edited via Account Screen.--Account screen is capable of presenting the non-editable view of time dependent addresses maintained via migration or web-service. In case you wish to maintain the validity date and address details for different addresses, you need to do so via migration or web-service.--It’s also clearly mentioned in the help document that The time dependent address can be created and maintained through migration or service.--The new fields for time-dependent addresses are available in the migration template as hidden fields. You need to first un-hide the sheet Addresses and then un-hide the relevant fields on this sheet.

Title: Creation of new Account defaults to a Particualr Language
Content: Symptom-When you create a new Account, system picks the Language by default and you wants to know, what is scenario here?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select New button and choose Corporate Account.-Cause-The Language is default to the Language which was chosen during the creation of previous Account.-If you create an Account with Language as English. Then the next Account, by default picks English as language.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-It’s not possible to reset the language every time we create an account.

Title: Dump when changing the Valid-from Date of Tax Deductibility Type for Purchasing
Content: Symptom-A dump occurs when you try to change the Valid-from Date of the of tax deductibility type in the fine-tuning activity Tax Settings for Purchasing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview.-Search and find the activity Tax Settings for Purchasing.-Click Change Immediately.-Select the country in the Available Deductibility Types list.-Scroll down to the bottom of the page and change the Valid-from Date.-Click Save or Save and Close.-A dump occurs.-Cause-You cannot change the Valid-from Date directly - if you add a new date and hit ENTER, the system will report the following error message:-Change of field Validity Start Date not permitted.-Resolution-Instead of modifying the date in the existing row, you should maintain a new row with a new date and deductibility rate. This will allow you to save the new validity.

Title: How to Check if the Business Document Difference Still Exists
Content: Symptom-A Business Document Difference is detected in the Application and User Management work center, and its current status needs to be verified.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesgin-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to Business Data Consistency view.-Select the Business Document Differences subview.-Locate the business document listed with a difference.-Verify whether the reported difference is still present.-Cause-The Business Document Difference displayed in the Business Data Consistency view may refer to a difference that has already been resolved. The difference entry can remain visible even though the underlying inconsistency no longer exists.-Resolution-In the Business Document Differences subview, select the Documented in DFV Result ID field.-Open the corresponding DFV Result ID hyperlink for the identified issue.-Check the DFV result to verify the current status of the difference.-If the DFV result displays No records found, the previously identified difference has already been resolved.-No further action is required for the resolved difference.-Keywords-Business Document Difference;DFV; DFV Result ID; No Records Found

Title: Profit Center Differs in Each Line of Posting in Goods and Services Receipt
Content: Symptom-You have posted a Goods and Service Receipt and you realize that the profit center determined is not the same in each line of the posting.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Journal Entries view-Choose Advanced-In the Journal Entry Type field, select Journal Entry Type 00029 - Goods Receipt from Supplier-Select the Journal Entry ID XXX for the relevant Source Document ID YYY and click on View-Machinery and Equipment Account DR with profit center PQR-Unbilled Payables Account CR with profit center XYZ-Cause-You have changed the ship to location after the purchase order is created and later changed the ship to and send update is done in the purchase order. You'll then find the old profit center in one line of the posting and new profit center in another line.-Resolution-After the Goods and Services Receipt is posted, the General Ledger Account that belongs to purchasing ledger will be updated with new profit center and this is taken as per the new ship to location that is updated in the purchase order. The general ledger account that belongs to fixed assets ledger will continue to show with the old profit center that belongs to the old ship to location.-After the changes are done it is only the purchasing ledger, which will be updated, so profit center will only be changed in the purchasing ledger. This is the expected system behavior. In case this behavior does not suits your needs, you may then create a new purchase order with the correct details then the profit center will be same in the new Goods and Services Receipt posting.

Title: Collaboration tab is Grayed out in Corporate Account
Content: Symptom-When you create a new Corporate Account, the Collaboration sub tab under Communication tab is grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select New Corporate Account under Common Task.-Select View All button-Go to Communication tab.-Select Collaboration sub tab but it is grayed out-Cause-The main requirement for enabling the Collaboration in a Corporate Account is to Save the Account for the first time. But, before saving there two mandatory information that should be filled in. They are Account Name and Account Address.-Resolution-These are the conditions for enabling the Collaboration.

Title: Point of Sales Transaction Does Not Show up in Payment Monitor
Content: Symptom-Point of Sale (POS) transactions are not displayed in the Payment Monitor, even though the transactions have been processed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Point of Sales Transactions view.-Open the Sales Transactions sub view.-Open the sales transaction ABC (where ABC represents the Document ID).-Navigate to the Payment Management work center.-Open the Payment Monitor view.-Verify that no records are displayed for the Point of Sale transaction ABC.-Cause-To display external payments in the Payment Monitor, enable the External Transactions checkbox in the Advanced Search section of the Payment Management work center. After selecting this option, execute the search again to view the external payment transactions.-Resolution-To display Point of Sale (POS) transactions in the Payment Monitor, perform the following steps:-Navigate to the Payment Management work center.-Open the All Payments view.-Select Advanced Search.-Select the External Transactions checkbox.-Choose Go to execute the search.-The external payment transactions, including the corresponding POS transactions, are now displayed in the Payment Monitor.-Keywords-Point of Sale (POS); Payment Monitor; External Transactions; Payment Management; POS Transaction Missing

Title: Outgoing Check Preview: Any Sorting You Make on The User Interface Is Not Reflected on the Outgoing Check Preview (PDF)
Content: Symptom-You've created an outgoing check and now want to preview its PDF, using the outgoing check form template. You want the list of Open Items (e.g. invoices) assigned to the check to be sorted numerically (e.g. sort the list of invoices numerically under Invoice number column on the PDF). However, you notice that any change you make on the user interface (e.g. sorting the Open Items numerically by External Reference) is not reflected while previewing the outgoing check PDF.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center-Go to Payment Monitor view-Search and open any Outgoing Check-Click View All, move to General tab and check the Open Items section-Click the External Refence column to sort the open items numerically by External Reference-Now click Preview > Check-System loads the outgoing check form template and opens it in a PDF document.-You notice that the ordination you made (sorting by External Reference) is not present on the PDF (invoices are listed in a random order).-Cause-Currently is not possible to apply any sorting to the data displayed on Outgoing Check Preview (form template).-The system list the invoices in a random order and there's no sorting algorithm implemented on the outgoing checks, meaning that clicking over External Reference in the UI will sort it only in the UI, it doesn't affect the output of the form.--Resolution-System behaves as expected.

Title: How to Check if Postal Code is Mandatory for the Country
Content: Symptom-System requires postal code in the account address which was not mandatory before. In this case, country SA - Saudi Arabia.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoice work center.-Go Sales Order View.-Find the sales order and click on New tab and select Manual Project Invoice Request.-Now go to step 5 Refine Invoice Items, system throws the error: Enter a postal code.-Or, when you edit the account master data, the error shows up.-However, it was working fine without error.-Cause-There was a system change and the case is country sensitive. For exmaple, the country SA is not required Postal Code as mandatory before the change, so the creating of project invoice request without postal code was fine. But as per the new requirement legally, country SA requires the postal code as mandatory information in address, so system changed accordingly due to the legal requirement.-Resolution-For the exisitng documents without postal code, you can remove this check (on postal code) and continue the creation of invoice request.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search key word Countries and click Go.-Select the activity and click Open.-Click Edit Countries link and select for example country SA.-Go to the Postal Atributes tab, Now we have removed the flag for postal code.-Afterwards, you should process the documents with the accounts which has no postal code maintained.

Title: Automatic Determination for Account Relationship or Responsible is Not Happening When Creating New Sales Order
Content: Symptom-No determination for account relationship, for exmaple Sales Partner, happening in the new sales order, it just throws error message when you mark it as mandatory though the relationship is added in the account master data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work Center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open the account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Choose the button View All.-Go to Contacts, then, Relationships tab.-See that there is a relationship defined, i.e. Sales Partner.-Choose the button You Can Also.-Create New Sales Order.-Choose the button View All.-Choose the Involved Parties tab.-The Sales Partner didn’t flow to the sales order, information needs to be add manually.-Cause-The Maintain Determination steps are not provided for some of the party roles, like Sales Partner, Competitor, Sales Employee. The activation or deactivation of the determination is only possible for the parties where the determination steps are provided. And, here it is not possible to add any determination steps.-(Refer Business Configuration work center - Overview view - search Involved Parties for Sales Order -  select Sales Partner - click Maintain Determination button and see that there are no determination steps available).-Now it is specified in the help document you have another note which says: "If a party role does not have any active determination steps, no party determination takes place, and the user must enter the party manually in the document." This means that for the party where determination steps are not provided, you have to enter the party manually in the business document. So, this is the expected behaviour for Sales Partner not getting auto determined.-Resolution- This is the expected System Behaviour.

Title: Amount in Transaction Currency Showing as 0,00 in Profit Overview by Key Figure Report.
Content: Symptom-You are using the report Profit Overview by Key Figure to derive the the profitability of a Sales Unit A. -Here you observe that for a particular General Ledger Account XXX the Amount in Transaction Currency is showing as 0,00 but its Amount in Company Currency has some value determined.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design and Assign Reports view.-Select the report Profit Overview by Key Figure.-Filter the report for the Sales Unit and customer in question and select the G/L Accounts Move to Rows.-Click on Settings-> Key Figures, select Amount in Transaction Currency and Amount Company Currency and Save.-Fill the Sales Unit and other required parameters and Select G/L Accounts and Move to Rows.-You will observe that for a particular G/L Account the Amount in Transaction Currency amount is showing 0,00 only but its Amount in Company Currency as some value determined.-Cause-If there is no money transaction happening in a transaction then the Amount in Transaction Currency shows as 0,00 and only Company Currency Amount will be updated.-Resolution-For the G/L Account XXX if you found that all the records are of type Goods Issue for Customer i.e. Goods and Activity Confirmation then system doesn't use the transaction currency and will apply only company currency.-The reason is that since there is no money transaction is happening for Goods and Activity Confirmation transaction, hence there is no hard amount involved in the transaction and so doesn't contain transaction currency.

Title: Company is Not Displayed in Activity Set Migration Date and Process Control
Content: Symptom-A new Company has been created and activated in Organizational Management. Now the goal is to set a migration date for the new company, but this is not displayed in activity Set Migration Date and Process Control.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity Set Migration Date and Process Control.-Notice that the relevant company is not showing.-Cause-The reason why the company is not displayed in activity Set Migration Date and Process Control is because there isn't any set of books assigned to this company.-Only companies with set of books assigned are displayed in this activity.-Resolution-In order to assign it, follow the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open the activity Set of Books.-Assign a set of books to the company.-Keywords-set of books; migration date; process control; company

Title: Payment Differences Reasons for Non-Localized Country
Content: Symptom-You have a non-localized country and you need to create Reasons for Payment Differences but in the fine-activity Reaons for Payment Differences you did not find the option to select the non-localized country.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Fine Tuning activity and find Reaons for Payment Differences.-This activity is an SAP Default screen and you did not have a choice to add the Non Localized country.-Cause-The fine-tuning activity to maintain Reasons for Payment Differences is available only in the business configuration of country versions of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-To Enable Reasons for Payment Differences for a Non-Localized Country you need to use ByDesign Studio to make this activity accessible for an installation in a country that doesn’t have an SAP country version (Non-Localized Countries).-In the Business Center ( www.sme.sap.com ) under About the Localization Toolkit and Customer-Specific Localization (CSL) information you can find this documentation available and upon configuring which you be be able to add the payment differences to Non-Localized Countries.-Category Subtopic Description of Toolkit Enablement Option Documentation-AP/AR Reasons for Payment Differences You can use the SAP Cloud Applications studio to add reasons for payment differences How to add reaons for payment differences using the SAP Cloud Applications studio

Title: Create Relative Selections
Content: Symptom-In release 1311 a new feature is available for Administrators in Business Analytics: Relative Selections.-You wonder what is the purpose and how to use this new feature.-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the Business Analytics work center-You go to the Design Data Sources view-You select the Relative Selections sub view-You click on the button New-Cause-The requirement for the Administrator to create relative selects was this example:--You - as a user in Financials and Accounting - work on financial reports and the current quarter is Q1. In April the usual “current quarter” relative selection changes to Q2.-However, in order to work on your business you need to select Q1 e.g. until mid of April as you still do some bookings for the first quarter.--In such scenario the Administrator would use Q1 first as value and once Q1 is no longer interesting for his organization he switches to Q2 and all reports select then on Q2.--Advantage of this new feature is that you can use one relative select in multiple selections or report definitions. If you want to change the value you need to change only the relative selection.--Without the new relative selection you need to adjust each selection and report definition which contains the old values – the key user for his objects and every end user for his own objects.-Resolution-The Type of the relative selection determines in which basic time characteristic or data source the relative selection is available.--For example, when the type of your relative selection is Month you will find it in characteristics defined as Month only (e.g. Calendar Month in the Sales Order Volume report).

Title: Freight Description in the Total Pricing Section of a Sales Document is not Displayed as Expected
Content: Symptom-The description of the Freight in the Total Pricing section of a sales document is not displayed as expected.-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to any sales document. We will use a sales order as an example.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Freights view.-Open the respective freight .-You have maintained the description XYZ (XYZ represents the text of the desciption). -  Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select option New Sales Order in the Common Tasks.-Enter the respective details such as account and product.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-You can see in the Total Pricing section that the Freight has been correctly determined but the Description does not display XYZ but Freight.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-The freight description in the Total Pricing section of a sales document such as a sales order is determined from the description maintained in the Business Configuration and not from the master data of the freight. Only for Item price components like Surcharge, Price, Discount etc. the description of item price component is read from master data.-Resolution-If you would like to change the description of the Freight in the Total Pricing section of a sales document you would need to change this in the Business Configuration as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select you implementation project.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Select the Fine Tuning tab.-Search for fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-Open the activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Configure Pricing Procedure hyperlink.-Here you can change the description of the Freight to the required description.-Note its language dependent, to set in another language please login with desired log on language to system.

Title: How to Change the Default Delivery Rule in the Service Order
Content: Symptom-How to change the default delivery rule in the service order from Single delivery - full quantity to Multiple Deliveries.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Edit the Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the service order ID).-Navigate to Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select the line item and select Spare Part Logistics sub tab. -Here Delivery Rule ﻿is maintained as Single delivery - full quantity even though Complete Delivery ﻿is not checked under General tab.-Cause-System automatically consider the delivery of service parts together. Therefore system always select the default delivery rule in the Service Order as Single delivery - full quantity.-Resolution-It is not possible to make Multiple Deliveries as a default Delivery rule, this need to be set manually.

Title: Unable to Create Automatic Serial Number While Post Goods Issue.
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to Upload Serial Numbers during post goods issue, system is not creating Automatic Serial Numbers and displays field as Blank.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Delivery Control View and select Delivery Proposals sub view.-In the field Show, choose All Proposals by Selection by drop down.-Search for the required Delivery Request ID.-Select and choose Post Goods Issue button.-New Window opens up as Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue.-Now under Details Section, navigate to Serial Number subtab.-Then choose Upload button to upload serial numbers with excel or text file saved in your computer.-Here once you upload the file, even then system does not displays any Serial Number IDs.-Cause-For Automatic Creation of Serial Number, you have to choose serial number profile as Mandatory on Transfer (to/from Customers) in product master data for the required Product.-Resolution-Go to Product Portfolio Workcenter.-Go to Products View and select By Products sub view.-In the field Show, choose All Materials and search the required Product ID.-Select and Edit it, go to the View All option.-Under General tab, naviagte to General subtab. -Now choose Serial Number Profile as Mandatory on Transfer (to/from Customers) using drop-down.-Choose Save button.

Title: Cannot select multiple line items on the "Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt" screen.
Content: Symptom-In the Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt screen you want to select the Line Items in a batch and want to remove them at once.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders by Selection.-Search for the Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Select the Purchase Order and choose the option Post Goods Receipt.-Press the Shift button on the keyboard and select the Items in a batch.-Here you are able to see, you can not select the line items in a batch.-Cause-In the current release it is not possible to select the line items in a batch to remove them at once.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Updated Sales Activity Will Not be Reflected for the Existing Opportunities
Content: Symptom-You want to reflect the Sales Activity of an existing opportunity which are maintained in the Business Configuration for the Sales Cycle.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities vew.-Show All Opportunities.-Search for the Opportunity ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Opportunity).-Click the Edit button.-Go to the Sales Activities tab.-Here you are not able to see the Suggested Activities table.-Cause-The Sales Activity of an existing opportunity will always reflect the Business Configuration settings for the Sales Cycle which was active at the time when the opportunity was created.-The reason for this is the following:-When you create an opportunity and select the Sales Cycle, the system will determine the information displayed in the Sales Activity tab according to the settings maintained in the Business Configuration.-Since the Sales Cycle cannot be edited after creating an opportunity (which is also the standard system behaviour) the changed settings in the Business Configuration regarding the Sales Cycle cannot be updated in the opportunity.--Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: XML Upload for Attendees is not Working
Content: Symptom-You are receiving the below error messages while uploading XML file for attendees.-Free Text for Person is not Allowed-Free Text for Organization is not Allowed-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cockpit work center.-All Expense Reports.-Search for the Expense Report ID.-Click Expense Report ABC.-Click the Expense and open the Expense Details.-Here we can see the below error message for the Attendees:-Free Text for Person is not Allowed-Free Text for Organization is not Allowed-Cause-The error message is displayed due to the reason that free text is not allowed for Persons and Organizations in your Business Configuration settings.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the relevant Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune chevron.-Show All Activities and search for the activity Configure Beneficiary Types and Spend Tracking.-Select Define Beneficiary Types and Enable Spend Tracking.-Select the Country and select the checkbox for Free Text for Person Allowed and Free Text for Organization Allowed.

Title: Sales Unit is Unexpected in Return
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new sales return, but you find the sales unit picked by system in the return is unexpected. It is not the same sales unit as in the original sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Open the certain return, you find the return is DEF. However the sales unit in the original sales order is ABC. (ABC, DEF represents the ID of the documents).-You expect the sales unit in the return should be ABC which is taken from the original sales order.-Cause-The return was created with reference to invoice XYZ. The invoice XYZ however, is a single invoice for multipule sales orders. (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice). Therefore the system simply copies the unit from one of the orders.-In this case it was another different order which had the same sales unit as that of the return.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.

Title: Approval Process for Purchasing Contracts Missing
Content: Symptom-Purchasing Contract is not listed as Approval Process in the work center Application and User Management.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Application and User Management.-Go to the view Task Distribution.-Go to the sub-view Approval Processes.-Purchasing Contract is not listed.-Cause-You have not scoped the question Do you use an approval process for purchasing contracts?, hence multi-step approval will be available for selection.-Resolution-Kindly follow the below steps to resolve your issue,-Go to Business Configuration work center and choose Implementation Projects view.-Select your relevant project and choose Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions page.-Expand the option business option Sourcing.-Select and expand the business topic Sourcing and Contracting view and choose Purchasing Contracts sub-topic.-Scope the question - Do you use an approval process for purchasing contracts?-Finish Scoping.-See Also-Kindly note the logic determination for the purchasing contact approval-By default, the system will send the approval task to Purchasing Unit manager assigned to the contract. -Once you have defined the Alternative Approver for Purchasing Contract , both the manager and alternative approver will receive approval tasks. Once one of the approvers has processed an approval task, the system completes the task and removes it from the worklist.-If no purchasing unit is assigned to the contract, the task is only sent to alternative approver if employee work distribution is maintained for contract approval.-In case no approver is defined in that way, the reporting line manager of the employee responsible for the Purchasing Contract is the approver.-If none of the above are satisfied this will go to all employees who are assigned the Manager My Area work center and Strategic Purchasing view will get an approval task.

Title: Cannot scrap Externally-owned Inventory item "XYZ".
Content: Symptom-Cannot Scrap Externally-Owned Inventory item XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Internal Logistics Work Center-Select the Common Task Scrapping-Search for the Product XYZ-System informs no item can be found-Cause-The Product XYZ is part of the Externally-Owned stock management scenario, which enables company to manage inventory that physically resides on the premises of company but belongs to a different owner.-For legal reasons and due to business constraints, externally-owned stock is excluded from some standard business and logistics processes:-- > Externally-owned stock items cannot be considered in scrapping processes.- > Externally-owned stock does not support custodian stock processes.-Resolution-If the product XYZ is procured through Third Party Order Processing, you can only remove of the product XYZ from the warehouse through the Return processing i.e. Returning the Goods to the Supplier.-In general, it is not possible to scrap the Externally-Owned stock. This is expected system behavior.

Title: Errors When Creating a New Service Quote
Content: Symptom-The following errors occur when trying to create a new Service Quote:--Create not possible; source object inconsistent-Process type not valid-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Quotes view.-Click on the New button and select Service Quotes.-The following errors occur in the new Service Quote window:--Create not possible; source object inconsistent-Process type not valid-Cause-Service Quotes does not have its own scoping object. In order to include Service Quotes in your solution scope you need to scope Sales Quotes.- Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Scoping step.-Expand the element Sales -> New Business.-You can see that the scoping option Sales Quotes is not active.-Activate the scoping option Sales Quotes.-Finish you scoping changes.-You will now be able to create Service Quotes.

Title: Supplier Invoice of Partner Company does not Create a Receivable Item for Invoiced Company
Content: Symptom-Your company XYZ is invoiced by your partner company ABC which is part of your organization and set-up as such in your ByDesign system. You are creating a supplier invoice for company ABC and the invoice is shown in the supplier's account monitor for company ABC. Since this is an intercompany transaction, your expectation is that consequently a receivable item (e.g.: customer invoice) is automatically created and reflected in the receivable monitor for your company XYZ.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Create a new Supplier Invoice.-As Buying Company you define your company XYZ. As Supplier choose the associated company ABC.-Navigate to Receivables / View: Customer Accounts work center.-Select your company XYZ and View / Trade Receivables.-Cause-The scenario described here does not reflect the Intercompany Supplier Invoicing process as outlined in the online-help. Intercompany Supplier Invoicing in ByDesign relates to the invoicing of a company by a third-party supplier. In case Intercompany Supplier Invoicing is enabled in your configuration, a partner company can be charged for selected invoice items. In this scenario a receivable item of type 'Other Receivable' is automatically created in the account monitor for the charged company XYZ. -Resolution-In the original scenario of invoicing company XYZ by partner company ABC, a separate customer invoice has to be created for company XYZ in order to reflect this transaction as a corresponding receivable item in the account monitor.

Title: No Tax Calculated For Tax Country CA - Canada in New Charge/Credit
Content: Symptom-A new charge/credit entry for customer account doesn't calculate tax and picks the tax rate as 0%.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customer Accounts sub view.-Select the customer XYZ, and choose View.-Choose New Charge/Credit.-In the New Charge/Credit screen, enter the required information.-In the Line Items table, choose Add Row, enter the required tax code and other details.-You observed that tax rate picked is 0% for the combination of tax code and its tax type.-Cause-You have defined the tax rates and tax validity dates for the selected region and tax rate type in the activity Tax on Goods & Services - Canada only but the combination for country is missing in the activity Tax Rate Schedules under Tax on Goods & Services.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Open the Activity List.-Find Tax on Goods and Services.-In the activity, select the hyperlink Tax Rate Schedules.-You can define the tax rates and the tax validity dates belonging to these tax rates. If you selected a country during scoping or if you are required to calculate tax for a country, you should verify the rates and their settings. You must specify tax rates for Canada and the US in another activity Tax on Goods and Services <Canada> for region level tax declaration.-Particularly for Canada and US there are two activities to complete:-Tax on Goods and Services.-Tax on Goods and Services <Canada>/<US>.-Failing to update the tax rate combination either in tax rate schedule or tax rate schedule <Canada> if the tax country is Canada then the result in tax calculation lead to 0% in New Charge/Credit or in any other receivables.-Keywords-tax, tax rates, Tax on Goods & Services - Canada, Tax on Goods and Services

Title: How to set custom Report Views visible to other Users
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report view, for a specific report, and would like to have such view available for other Users.-Resolution-In order to have the custom report view visible to other user you need to create and save such view, for the desired report, directly from the Business Analytics work center.-Once this is done you will be able to see the name in the Views Created by Key User tab, for the respective Work Center, otherwise it will just appear in the My Views tab.-Note: You may also save the custom report view from any other work center although the view will then be visible on for your User.

Title: Unable to Approve Sales Orders from Mobile Devices
Content: EXTRACT_ERROR

Title: Error message "Safety stock must not be more than target stock"
Content: Symptom-For a particular Material, you have maintained Target stock level as Lot-Sizing Method and maintained XYZ value for Target Stock Quantity. System throws below error message-Safety stock must not be more than target stock-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Materials view.-Edit a Material and go to Planning tab.-Where Lot-Sizing Method is Target stock level; Target Stock Quantity is XYZ.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Target Stock Quantity is lesser than Safety Stock.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior that the Safety Stock should be less than Target Stock Quantity.

Title: Available Fields are Missing While Adding Fields to a Table in Easy Form Editor
Content: Symptom-Available Fields list is not showing when you select Add Field in the table for a form template in Easy Form Editor.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Form Template Maintenance sub view.-Select a form template for example Customer Invoice US EN.-Open in Easy Form Editor.-Expand tblTable, and select Columns.-Click on Add and then click on Field.-No available fields list is displayed.- Cause-The reason behind the blank additional fields list is that the form design and the binding of the table does not permit to add fields in the table.-Resolution-You would be able to add fields to the form template(eg: customer invoice ) by selecting any other section in the Easy Form Editor for example Contact Information section and click on add field. But here also you would not be able to see all the fields you might require. Hence the only way to incorporate these fields are by using Adobe Life Cycle Designer.-You could contact your implementation partner for the same.-

Title: Error Message "Responsibilities: The employee already exists with the party role"
Content: Symptom-When you try to Mass Change Account Data, for changing the Employee responsible for a Party Role, system throws below error message:-Responsibilities: The employee already exists with the party role-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Account Management work center-2. In Common Task, select Mass Change Account Data-3. Select Advanced Search and input Person Directly Responsible ID as XYZ-4. Select Add to work list -> All Accounts-5. Select Next button.-6. Select Show as Responsibilities-7. In the default row ABC and party role as Employee Responsible sales.-8. Apply Mass Change to All Accounts.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Employee ABC is already an Employee Responsible for Sales in some of the Accounts.-Resolution-Hence, to overcome the issue:-1. Find out the Accounts which already has the Employee Responsible as ABC.-2. In the Mass Change screen (step 1), add all the accounts (Person Directly Responsible ID as XYZ) to the work list and remove the Accounts from the work list which has the employee responsible as ABC-3. Continue with the Mass Change and Save the changes for other Accounts-4. For those Accounts, try to change the details manually.

Title: Address Missing While Previewing a Particular Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User reports an incident where the preview of a particular business document (Sales order, customer invoice and so on) doesn't display the address. But there are some documents which has the address but the address is missing for particular invoices or sales orders.-Cause-This issue mainly occurs in customized Form templates, where the user might have written a script, For Example:-Example 1:-If the Net Price is less than 1000 do not show the address. if the Net price is more than 1000 display the address.-FormInvoiceRequest.bdyMain.frmSummaryBlock.frmPricing::initialize - (FormCalc, client)-//Display Recipient's address and ABN number only if it's $1000. AU specific changes.-  if (this.decCalculatedAmount.rawValue lt 1000) then-bdyMain.frmAddInfoBlock.frmReceiverAddress.frmAddress.presence = "hidden"-bdyMain.frmAdditionalAddresses.frmShipToAddress.presence = "hidden"-bdyMain.frmAdditionalAddresses.frmAccountAddress.presence = "hidden"-bdyMain.frmAddInfoBlock.frmInfoBlock.txtBuyerVATRegID.presence = "hidden"-bdyMain.frmAddInfoBlock.frmInfoBlock.txtCustomerName.presence = "hidden"-endif-Example 2:-If the country is XY do not display the address.-Resolution-For these issues, figure out the field where the script was written because it might not be in the address field, might be in a field related pricing or country or any thing. Since it is a customized template.-Once, you identify the script, provide the solution accordingly.

Title: Backend Exception When Add a New Address into Accounts Master Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the user try to add a new address to an existing Account, system throws backend exception.-Error ID SYSTEM_NO_ROLL-Error Txt More main memory area was requested. However, all the available space has been used up. Possible reasons: - Many (large) internal tables. - Many (large) programs active. - Deep nesting of subroutines with a lot of local data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select and edit an Account.-Go to Addresses tab.-Select Add Row button.-Maintain a new row with a new address-Select Save button. The process indication bar goes up to Saving Data 70%, resulting afterwards in a DUMP.-Cause-The cause is only applicable when the particular Account has more than 100 Contacts assigned to it and many Employees Responsible.-Dump due to Time Out / Out Of Memory is happening post-save during Groupware Integration.-Resolution-Lets take an example, that the Account ID is XYZ and it has 200 Contacts assigned to it and 20 Employees Responsible.-When there is a new change to the address of the Account. So change in account would result into message to all the 20 employees with account and its contacts. i.e. 20 *200 + 20*1 = 4020 messages to be created, which would result into the exception.--This issue was addressed and now there is a new way of integrating Accounts and Contacts with Outlook. With this new way of sync, you would need to specify employee responsibilities at Contacts level as well. The Accounts and Contacts for which you are responsible and have opted for "Groupware Synchronization" will only be synced to your outlook.-The sync is triggered whenever any data which is outlook relevant of account or contact is updated. Since Address is an outlook relevant data, the sync is expected. This can be done by scoping the question "Do you want to maintain direct responsibilities for contacts?".--Please try to add the address to the affect Accounts/Contacts.--To maintain the responsibilities at contact level individually would be a difficult task. For which Mass Change of responsibility was created for contacts (Mass Maintain Contact Data).--Please find the related document and information below to understand the functionality accordingly. Search the following documents in Help Center.--1. Quick Guide for Contacts in Account Management-2. Maintain Mass Contact Data-3. Quick Guide for Microsoft Outlook Integration®-4. What's New: Business Partners-5. Contacts — Configuration Guide--Kindly note that, the query "My Contacts" in Contacts screen will be getting affected with the scoping change in Business Configuration work center. Also note that, Along with “Mass Maintain Contact Data” (Preferred way of updating), you can also create responsibilities as soon as they log in to Outlook after scoping for “Contact Management”. A Pop-Up will open with all the contacts available in outlook and will have checkboxes which represents Groupware Synchronization. You can subscribe for contacts which you would like to sync to outlook.--The responsibilities will be maintained only for the contacts which are subscribed. Hope this information would be useful for you understand the Contact Management Use case.-There was an issue with assignment of employee to account. That's what exactly fixed in one of the earlier release.--Now you have possibility to maintain responsibility (employees) at contact level. And you can sync only these contact to outlook. This is related to Outlook Add in, because of any change with account/contact, it triggers a sync to outlook which is required if you have scoped for outlook integration. With each change, there were a lot of messages to be created which was resulting into time out/ memory overflow.--Please refer to the help center documents referred above to understand the whole process regarding outlook integration and new functionality of contact management-

Title: Web Service APIs in SAP Cloud for Customer 1405
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Our 114 Web Service APIs enable the integration of on-premise, cloud-based, and third-party solutions with SAP Cloud for Customer 1405. Click on a service description to get detailed information, such as documentation and examples.--For your implementation project, we recommend that you look up the Web services in your system. Go to the work center view Application and User Management -> Input and Output Management -> Service Explorer. There you can find the complete list of available Web services and their current scoping status.You can also find the detailed documentation and download the system specific WSDL including all customer defined fields there.--The icons in the table below have the following meaning:-  The Web Service API is released and will be kept stable-  The Web Service API is deprecated and should not be Title: Bank-to-Bank Transfer with Different Currencies - Account determination is missing for cash
Content: Symptom-You want to transfer an amount from one internal bank account to another internal bank account.-The currencies of the accounts are different, i.e. EUR and USD.-You have maintained a cash G/L account - account determination assignment in Fine Tuning.-But when trying to post the bank-to-bank transfer an error message appears: Account determination is missing for cash. Define the account for chart of accounts ABCD, tab Cash Receipt - In Transit' field 'Cash Receipt - In Transit. Enter a general ledger account for the account determination group XXXX and payment method Bank Transfer.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Liquidity Management workcenter navigate to the Common Tasks and select New Bank-to-Bank Transfer-Maintain an amount in the Transaction Amount field-In the From Bank Account section maintain the respective bank account. For this account the company currency is maintained, i.e. EUR.-In the To Bank Account section maintain the second account. This account has a different currency as the first account, i.e. USD.-Press Post-An error message is displayed: Account determination is missing for cash. Define the account for chart of accounts ABCD, tab Cash Receipt - In Transit' field 'Cash Receipt - In Transit. Enter a general ledger account for the account determination group XXXX and payment method Bank Transfer.-You follow this error message and check the settings in Fine Tuning:-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation Projects view and open the activity list-Go to the Fine Tune phase, search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and open it*-Navigate to the Account Determination section and select the Cash link-In the Cash Receipt- In Transit tab you find the account determination group used for your two bank accounts.-It is assigned to a G/L account in the Cash Receipt- In Transit column.-The payment method 05-Bank Transfer is maintained.-The currency of the second bank account is maintained, i.e. USD.-Cause-You also need to maintain the currency of the account from where you are transferring the amount. Or, alternatively, don't maintain a currency.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation Projects view and open the activity list-Go to the Fine Tune phase, search for the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and open it*-Navigate to the Account Determination section and select the Cash link-In the Cash Receipt- In Transit tab you find the account determination group used for your two bank accounts.-Press Add row-Maintain the account determination group used for the bank accounts again.-Maintain the payment method 05-Bank Transfer-Maintain a G/L account in the Cash Receipt- in Transfer column-Leave the currency field blank (easiest option) or maintain the currency of the other bank account, ie EUR.-If the bank accounts are assigned to two different account determination groups you need to make this setting for both account determination groups.-Press Save and Close-Now you will be able to post the bank-to-bank transfer with different currencies.-

Title: Employee XYZ is Missing in Person Responsible Field of Accounts
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to find a list of Account for which Employee XYZ is responsible but in the value selection for Person Responsible, the Employee XYZ is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select All Accounts.-Go to Contacts tab.-Select Advanced Search.-Enter XYZ in the Person Responsible field.-No Records found-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the Employee XYZ is terminated.-Resolution-This activity should have been done before the employee was terminated. Once employee is terminated, it will not appear in search option hence it is not possible to find out the list of account he was responsible for.
