Title: Feeds Workflow
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Feeds workflow-Reproducing the Issue-I. Where are Feeds visible in the UI?-Feeds can be found under the Feeds work center or the Feeds tab available within the object or employee you are following.-II. When are Feeds visible for you?-In order to be able to see the Feeds related to an object (Sales Quote, Opportunity, Marketing Lead, ect) or a person you have to follow it.-III. How to post a Feed manually?-Go to the Feeds work center.-Select the Feeds view.-Enter a text in the communication box.-Choose Post (arrow).-When posting updates using the Feeds functionality you can also use shorthands.-Following shorthands can be used:-@ - is used to tag an item or mention a person in your update. Also when using the @ and also enter two characters the system automatically searches for entries matching the entered characters and provides a results list.-* - is used to send a private update to an employee.-IV. Automatically created Feeds: Create a Sales Quote and follow it in order to see the Feeds.-Log into the system as Administrator.-Go to the Sales work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Click the New button.-Fill in all mandatory fields.-Save the changes.-Log into the system as Sales Manager.-Go to the Sales work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Select All in the filter and then search after the Sales Quote ID.-Open the Sales Quote.-Click the Follow icon.-Go to the Feeds work center.-The updates related to the Sales quote you are following are available.- V. How do you manage your Feed?-There are 2 options available in the System to manage your Feeds:-1. Feed Settings: here you can determine How your follow requests are accepted, if e-mail digests for feed updates are sent, what updates should be shown based on the Business Object (Opp, Account, Campaign, etc).-2. Feed Sources: her you can determine the source events that will trigger an update for the followed source.-VI. Other Information.-You can also comment, add to favorites, flag (in order to be added automatically to the Shelf), open or delete by using the corresponding icon on the Feed. -Resolution

Title: Profitability Reports Not Showing Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report or Profit Overview by Key Figure report doesn't display any data although there are financial postings relevant for selection parameters.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Reports-List view.-Select the report Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme or Profit Overview by Key Figure.-Enter the selection parameters and click on Go.-You get an information message that: No report data available to display; check selection for the report 'Profit detail by contribution margin scheme'-Cause-Due to some technical issues, the FSI view for G/L Account is not updated.Hence you don't see the data as expected.-Resolution-First of all, make sure that data exists in the system for the selected Parameters.-Then refer to the case document 2052832 - No Data Displayed in the Profitability Reports for the Profitability Setup.-If the data is still not shown in the report, then send the incident to ES - Tech queue to perform the reload of FSI View : FSP_FIN_GLACCOUNT

Title: How to take Payload Trace for Synchronous Web service call
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document explains how to take the Payload trace for Synchronous Web Service Call.-Overview:-Scenario: We usually take the SRT_UTIL traces when Processing Mode of message is Synchronous. To make sure that your message is synchronous please see the Error Context as shown in below screen shot:-Steps to take the trace:--1. Go to SRT_UTIL and add the user who will take the Trace(or who will reproduce the issue): Right click on: "Users & Terminals & Request URI" and select the User.-2. Go to Configuration tab and select Payload Trace: Active. Then Click on Save Configuration button.-3.  Now reproduce the issue from application UI.-4. Go to the SRT_UTIL and Expand the option: "Users & Terminals & Request URI" there you will see the user added by you. Click on the user and select the tab: "Payload Trace" under this tab you will find the payloads of both request and response of the Synchronous Message.-5. After taking the trace always go to the Configuration tab and set the Payload Trace option to "Inactive" and click on "Save configuration"-6. Right click on the user and Remove it as shown in the screenshot below.-Resolution

Title: Customer want to stop replication of prospect account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer creates an Account and made it as Prospect Account and when they save it the account gets replicated. Customer does not wants Prospect Account to be replicated from C4C to CRM system as they dont need in their CRM system.-Reproducing the Issue-Once you create an Account and mark it as Prospect, it will be replicated to CRM or ERP system.-Cause-The Hidden Backend option in C4C was not enabled.-Resolution-To enable the hidden Backend option got to C4C backend.- 1.Run Transaction BCE.-2. Select Adaptation Workspace and in the search box search with *.-3. Select object name ->Scoping ->Expand scoping-> select: BA_A1S_FIND_COLSERV(Communication and Information Exchange)-4. Then in the middle panel -> top bar select Scoping (with question)button-> then in the middle window select select: BA_A1S_FIND_COLSERV-and expand it and select BP_OD_FND_PIEXTAPP(Integration with External Applications and Solutions).- 5. Then select- BT_OD_FND_PIERP(for ERP integration) or BT_OD_FND_PICRM(for CRM integration) and check option BO_A1S_FND_ACCERP_FLTR_BY_ROLE(Integration of Business Partner Data to SAP ERP: Filter by Role).

Title: Changing the User Type Defined in the Business Role
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In a business role, the customer would like to assign the work center view XXX to a specific user type.-For Example: CRM Sales Team User or Standard Enterprise User, however, the customer is not able to change this.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management-Go to View User and Access Management-Click on subview Business Roles.-Show all business roles and edit the relevant Business Role-Go to tab Work center and view assignments, Locate the desired View ID-It is already assigned to a specific user type, like Standard Enterprise User or CRM Sales Team User and there is no options to change it.-Cause-This is normal system behavior.-The user types are pre-delivered content and the categorization is done by Product Management. This means that user type can not be changed locally in the customer system.- Resolution-The work center user license assignment is not critical for the operational business and does not effect the functionality of the system. It determines which license type will be taken into account for the assigned work centers of a user.--For such reported issues, please update the customer that this is system designed behavior. If customer needs any further change, please forward the incident to relevant application team of the corresponding Work Center which has the wrong user type for further processing.-Currently, it is not possible to change this directly via Backend or Frontend. The user license assignment must be re-calculate with Development and Product Management Team and corrected via HotFix.

Title: Report Customer Contract Volume Shows the Invoiced Quantities and Values as Zero
Content: Symptom-You are viewing the report Customer Contract Volume. You notice that for some contracts, the key figure Invoiced Value or Invoiced Amount show the value zero. However, there are invoiced quantities / values for these contracts and you expect them to be shown in the report.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report Customer Contract Value from the work center it is assigned to, for example Sales Orders.-Go to Settings > Key Figures and select the key figure Invoiced Quantity.-Check the value that is displayed in this key figure. It is zero in some cases although there are invoiced values in the system.-Cause-If the contract resulted in a sales order, the invoiced values and quantities are considered to be invoiced against the sales order, not the contract. They will thus not appear in the report Customer Contract Volume.-Resolution-If you would like to report on those invoiced values and amounts, you can use the report Sales Order Volume.

Title: Austrian PAYMUL AZV Foreign Payment File Without Sender Identification
Content: Symptom-You create outgoing payment files by using the payment medium format AT PAYMUL AZV V3 Foreign payment for foreign payments.-In the created txt file the sender identification of the paying house bank, for instance ATRAI32000 for Raiffeisenlandesbank Niederösterreich-Wien AG, is missing. It should be displayed at the start of the file in the following way: UNB+UNOC:3++SENDER ID+. Instead, you can only see UNB+UNOC:3+++ without the sender ID.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre condition: You created an outgoing payment with non SEPA payment method International Bank Transfer for a foreign payee outside the SEPA area.-You verify the created payment file in the Liquidity Managment workcenter under File Management - Outbound Files.-Click on the File ID.-In the new screen press View All and go to the Attachment tab.-Click on the Document title to open the created text file.-In the first line the sender ID of your house bank should appear after UNB+UNOC:3++. But it is not displayed.-Cause-The sender ID is derived from the EDIFACT identification in the bank directory. It needs to be maintained separately.-Resolution-In the Liquidity Management workcenter navigate to the Master Data view and go to Bank Directory.-Find the respective bank directory and click on it's ID to open it.-In the General tab under National Bank Codes press Add Row.-Under National Bank Code Type select ATE - Austrian EDIFACT Identifier* and maintain the respective ID under National Bank Code.-Press Save and Close.-When you now create an outgoing payment for a foreign payee the sender ID/EDIFACT ID will be derived in the created text file.-*A list of all Austrian EDIFACT IDs can be found in the Attachment tab of this case document.

Title: Tax Code Description: Non-Taxable Sales (Out of Scope of Law)
Content: Symptom-You are creating a customer invoice which has the account located on the United States. Once selecting the Tax Code for this document the system gives you the option in select the Tax Code 500 - Non-Taxable Sales (Out of Scope of Law).-You assume the description is wrong considering the content of the text (Out of Scope of Law).-Reproducing the Issue-You can see the Tax Code information on the Customer Invoice work center. -Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Select the Invoice Documents view-Search for the Invoice ID-Click on the ID-Click on View All button-Navigate on Items tab-Go to Tax sub-tab-On the Tax Code field you can search for the reference  500 - Non-Taxable Sales (Out of Scope of Law)-  You can see the Tax Code information on the Business Configuration work center. -Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Overview view-Show Activities option-Find Tax on Goods and Services activity and open it-Open Define Tax Codes session-Search for the Tax Code type 500-Filter for country US - United States-Under the column Description you can see Non-Taxable Sales (Out of Scope of Law)-The Tax Event linked to it is 300 - Sales Out Of Scope Of Law-Cause-The description of the Tax Code 500 for the United States is correct and conforms with local legislation.-Resolution-The Tax Code 500 linked to the Tax Event 300 represents the Sales Out Of Scope Of Law. In this case the text description is correct since this Tax Event and Tax Code is determined when the Ship From party is outside United States. According to United States legislation, if the sale is originating outside the United States then it is outside the scope of law and cannot be taxed within the United States.-If the scenario is aligned with this explanation you cannot use the Tax Code 507 or an alternative one.

Title: Tab is Missing in the Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You want to fill the migration template of any migration object, but you noticed that there is tab missing in the template and you can't find it.-You also can see the message Tab Hidden by Personalization in the migration workbench.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center and select Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list of your project.-Search for the migration activity that you noticed the issue.-Open with migration tool.-Select the file that you are processing the migration.-You see the message Tab Hidden by Personalization in a specific tab.-  Cause-The tab is hidden in the Excel file template.-Resolution-Go to the migration activity and open it with Migration Tool.-In the Migration Workbench, select the file that you are processing and the issue is occurring.-Select the button Actions->Download.-Save the file in your computer and open the file with Microsoft Excel.-In the Excel, click with the right button on any sheet of the template. E.g: Sheet Field List.-Select the option Unhide.-Unhide the tab missing and save the template.-Upload it to Migration Tool again.

Title: Error Message "Template variant cannot be deleted; it has been used to output a document"
Content: Symptom-When you try to delete the Dunning Letter template, system throws below error message:-Template variant cannot be deleted; it has been used to output a document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Search for the Dunning Letter group.-Select the Dunning Letter template and select Delete button.-Cause-The reason that you are not able to delete the template is that this template was already used in the Output of Dunning Letters. This can be verified as follows,--Step 1:--1. Go to Application and User Management work center.-2. Select Form template selection.-3. Search for Dunning letter.-4. Here the template is used for Dunning Level X.--Step 2:--1. Go to Receivables work center-2. Select Dunning view-3. Select All Dunning-4. Preview a Dunning which has Highest Dunning Level as X.-5. Here the Dunning Letter X is being used for output.-Resolution-It is not possible to delete the Template once it is used in output document.-Note: This behavior is same for all the Form Templates.-See Also-Template variant, cannot,  deleted, output a document

Title: Common Task 'Mass Change Account Data' is Missing in Account Management work center
Content: Symptom-Common Task Mass Change Account Data is missing in Account Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Go to Common Tasks-Cause-The reason that Mass Change Account Data is missing is that the Financial and Management Accounting is not scoped in your system.-Resolution-The Common Task Mass Change Account Data is associated with Accounting and hence scoping of Financial and Management Accounting is required to have this common task.-You can scope this scoping element in Business Configuration.-Note: If your system is already Live, you can create a new change project to perform the scoping and merge the changes.

Title: Unable to Add Free Cost Object in the Fixed Assets Migration Template
Content: Symptom-In the Fixed Assets migration template you are missing a field to add a free cost object.-Reproducing the Issue-In the  Business Configuration workcenter go to the Implementation Projects view and open the Activity List.-In the Fine tune phase find the Perform data extraction activity.-Click on the Download Migration Templates link.-Find and download the Fixed Assets template under Transaction Data Financial Accounting.-In the Excel template navigate to the Master Data tab. -Here you can't find any fields related to cost objects.-In the Field List tab there is no sign of a Cost Object field either.-You are now wondering why the Free Cost Object is visible for fixed assets in the Fixed Assets workcenter.-Cause-The Cost Object field is available in the Fixed Assets (Extended) migration template. In this Excel template the field is hidden by default.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration workcenter navigate to the Implementation projects view and open the Activity List.-In the Fine tune phase find Perform data extraction.-Click on Download Migration templates.-Now download the Fixed Assets (Extended) template under Transaction Data Financial Accounting.-The Cost Object field is only available in this extended migration template. -You now have to unhide the Cost Object field in the template in order to use it.

Title: How to View List of Check Deposits For a Particular Time Period
Content: Symptom-You need a report which lists all the check deposits for a particular time period.-Cause-There is currently no specific report available listing all the check deposits for a specified time period.-Resolution-A Workaround would be to-Go to the Payment Management workcenter.-Deposits view.-Check Deposits sub-view.-Click on the Export button.-You can download the details of the desired check deposit information for a particular time period by using the various filter options.

Title: How to delete a Not-Published Version of a Form Template
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a Not-Published Version of a Form Template but you don't know how to do that-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management and select Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the Not-Published form template variant that you want to delete.-The Delete button is disabled.-Resolution-As per help document Form Template Maintenance Quick Guide, to delete a Not-Published Form Template you have to follow the steps below- In the Form Template Maintenance view, select the form template variant and click on button Versions.- In the Versions dialog box, select the current not-published version of the template and click on Delete.-Note that when you delete a not-published version of a template your changes will be lost and cannot be reinstated.

Title: Mass Import Fields of Contact Person via Excel
Content: Symptom-Unable to mass import specific contact person fields via Excel, such as the “E-Mail Invalid” field under Business Communication. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Mass Change Account Data view.-An option for Excel upload cannot be seen.-Expectation:-Is it possible to make a mass change in account data for contact persons via an Excel upload?-Cause-Mass import via Excel for contact person fields is not delivered in the current release.-Resolution-The feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-bulk load, batch update, spreadsheet upload, CSV import, contact data, email status flag, mass edit, data maintenance, feature limitation, unsupported operation, UI option missing, bulk change, Excel integration, contacts update, data import

Title: Customer Invoice Does Not Appear in Customer Account Monitor After 100% Discount
Content: Symptom-You created an invoice with a 100% discount.-But when checking the Receivables account monitor there has been no item created for this invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Customer Invoicing work center navigate to the Invoice Documents view.-Press Edit to open the invoice.-In the Items section you can see a discount of 100% has been applied in the Discount % column.-The status of the invoice is Released and in the document flow of the invoice you can see that a journal entry has been created.-Therefore you expect to find this invoice in the customer account monitor:-Navigate to the Receivables work center and there to the Customers - Customer Accounts view.-Search for the customer that the customer invoice has been created, select the account and press View. By default the Trade Receivables-Invoices. Payments tab opens.-Select Show- All items.-You can find the customer invoice with 100% discount here.-Cause-The system works as designed.-If a 100% discount is applied to a customer invoice then there will be no receivables item created to appear in the account monitor as the invoice does not need any further processing from receivables side.-Resolution-To identify the invoice you can check for instance the Invoice volume report:-In the Customer Invoicing work center navigate to the Reports list.-Here you find the Invoice Volume report and then filter for the respective customer and invoice document.-Keywords-customer invoice; customer account monitor; 100% discount; invoice volume report

Title: Extension Fields Missing from Delivery Note Preview
Content: Symptom-You have maintained 2 extension fields at line item level in the Outbound Delivery View of the Outbound Logistics work center using the adaptation mode. In the floor plan for Further Usage, you have also set the options to add these fields to the Delivery Note document. When trying to add these fields as columns in the Delivery Note using the Easy Form Editor, these fields are not displayed in the selection view.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Select the outbound delivery ID XYZ and click Edit.-Go to the Line Items tab.-Click Adapt - Enter Adaptation Mode.-Click Adapt - Edit Screen and select the Untitled Table section.-Click the Extension Fields bar and add the required fields.-Select the created extension field and click Further Usage.-Go to the Form Templates tab and make the field available for the required Delivery Note templates.-If you check the Delivery Note template using the Easy Form Editor, the created extension field do not appear there and will also not be shown in the delivery note preview.-Cause-Adding a new extension field in the delivery note items and extending it to the form template using the Easy Form Editor is not available as a standard functionality in SAP Business ByDesign.--The reason for this design is that data inconsistencies may occur if this action is performed without an exhaustive assessment of the technical consequences.-Resolution-You can use Adobe LifeCycle Designer to enhance the Delivery Note Form Template with your extension field.

Title: G/L Account differs from Distribution Allocation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer have different results for G/L Account and Distribution Allocation.-Reproducing the Issue--- In order to check if the G/L Account, the senders and receivers are defined please follow the steps bellow:-1. Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-2. Go to Allocation View.-3. Go to Distribution Rules Sub-view.-4. Show All Rules.-You can see that it is define G/L Account XXXX. Also, you can see that the senders and receivers are defined.--- Generate the G/L Accounts - Line Items Report by following the steps bellow:-1. Go to General Ledger Work Center.-2. Click on General Ledger Accounts View.-3. Open the Advanced search and complete the Company ID and the Set of Books ID.-4. Show All G/L Accounts and Find G/L Account XXXX.-5. Select it and click on View Line Items.-6. Select the Accounting Period/Year.-7. Go to the Edit Filter tab move the Cost Center to Rows and complete Cost Center YYYY.-8. Click on Go.--- Now, generate the G/L Accounts - Line Items Report by following the steps bellow:-1. Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-2. Go to Periodic Tasks View.-3. Click on Overhead Distribution Sub-view.-4. Click on the Run Description from the Distribution Run.-5. Go to Posting tab.-6. Under Journal Entries, open the Journal Entry ID.-7. Click on Reports and then in G/L Accounts - Line Items.-You'll see that the subtotal of the Credit Amount Company Currency is different for the reports.-Cause-This will happen as the distribution works with iteration.-As a consequence any cost center listed as sender in a rule will be cleared of all costs finally. As a consequence the overall "credit" will appear larger than the original amount. Only the total of all credits and debits will be zero.-Resolution-If customer's rule states that the amount on G/L account XXXX and Cost Center YYYY shall be distributed to 29 receiver cost centers and Cost Center YYYY is one of the receiver cost centers, the distribution iterates the process until there is no total cost on the Cost Center YYYY anymore.-It distributes all 100% according to the rule, picks up the 2.2% received by Cost Center YYYY and distributes it again. Therefore the total allocated amount is larger that the original amount.-Example 1: If the original amount was 100 USD the first step distributes 10 USD to Cost Center YYYY and the rest to the other 28 cost centers.-The next step distributes the 10 USD, 1 to Cost Center YYYY and 9 to the others.-This is done until no cent is left.-The total allocated amount could be calculated like interest: 100 + 10 + 1 + 0.1 + 0.01 +-The formula would be Amount + SUM starting from 1 to n (Amount*p) **n. (p = percentage, n = number of iteration steps).-Only if you take this final amount and apply the distribution rule you can calculate the partial amounts directly.-There are other algorithms so solve such a system of linear equations but this was the method that was actually implemented.-=================================================================-Example 2:-The situation before the distribution was:-Cost Center YYYY / G/L Account XXXX:-debit 473.610,40 USD-credit 6.080,29 USD-total of 467.530,11 USD to be distributed.-The debit and the credit are distributed separately:-1. Debit:-original debit 473.610,40 USD-distributed credit 484.236,08 USD --> 10.760,80 to Cost Center YYYY-2. Credit-original credit 6080,29-distributed debit 6.215,31 --> 135,12 USD as credit to Cost Center YYYY-total credit: 484.236,08 + 135,12 = 484.371,20 USD-total debit: 6.215,41 + 10.760,80 - 135,12 = 16.841,09 USD------------------------------------------------------------------total allocated amount 467.530,11 USD-=================================================================-If you look at the Cost Center Line Item Report the numbers will look a bit different as they show charge and allocated amount rather than credit and debit postings (You can add the credit/debit indicator to the layout though and see in detail which credit and debit was allocated). The net allocated amount of Example 2 will be the same of cause: 467.530,11 USD.-Because of the iteration the total of debit and credit provides the "net" credit.-Customer wanted 2.2% of the cost to remain on the Cost Center. He cannot achieve that when distributing 100% of the cost in the current setup as there is no option to switch off the iteration.-But we could set the distribution percentage to 97,8% in the rule and remove Cost Center YYYY from the list of cost receivers.-Then, no cyclic links exist and no iteration takes place and the distribution would pick up 97.8 % of the costs only and distribute them to the 28 remainng cost centers. The distribution factors can be used as maintained. The distribution percentage will be re-calculated of cause because 2.2% are excluded from the distribution and the distribution factor refers to the distribution amount not to the total amount.-The example would then look different:-The debit and the credit are distributed separately-1. Debit:-original debit 473.610,40 USD-distributed credit 473.610,40 USD --> 0.00 to Cost Center YYYY-2. Credit-original credit 6080,29-distributed debit 6080,29 --> 0 USD as credit to Cost Center YYYY-total credit: 473.610,40 USD-total debit: 6080,29 USD-------------------------------------------------------------------total allocated amount 467.530,11 USD

Title: IBAN, BIC and Mandate Reference is missing on the Customer Invoice form template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is able to create a Customer Invoice, but if their customer is paying the Invoice through SEPA direct debit, the sentence on the bottom which indicates that the payment will be withdrawn through direct debit is not indicating the IBAN, BIC and Mandate Reference hence the Customer Invoice is not eligible for their customer. Customer claims, that this sentence needs to be adapted otherwise this customer would not be allowed to withdraw payments from their customer, according to the law.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work centre.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Search for the form 'Customer Invoice'-Select it and click 'Open > Easy Form Editor'-In the 'Sections' select 'Geschäftsbedingungen'-In the 'Details: Geschäftsbedingungen' lower section search for the 'Label'-"Der fällige Rechnungsbetrag wird gemäß den Zahlungsbedingungen per Lastschrifteinzug abgebucht."-(this can be found in the lower part by scrolling almost down to the bottom).-*The above sentence means in English:-"Invoice amount due will be remitted by direct debit in accordance with the payment terms."-Customer wants to have this sentence adapted as follows: "Der fällige Rechnungsbetrag wird gemäß den Zahlungsbedingungen per Lastschrifteinzug abgebucht von IBAN, BIC und MANDATE REFERENCE."-Whereby IBAN, BIC and MANDATE REFERENCE should be populated according to the customers details for which the invoice is issued, so basically they should be interactive.-Resolution-The field(s) which are requested in the Customer Invoice Form template is currently not available in the Standard Forms provided by SAP.-Hence, you may consider the below options:-1. The Service Center to enhance your Forms with the required fields but this is paid service.-2. The form template can be enhanced using Adobe LifeCycle Designer but SAP is not supporting the Forms that are created/modified using this software.-

Title: How to Create Customized Order Block Reasons for an Account
Content: Symptom-You want to create new Order Block reasons for an account, but you don't know how to create it.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management Work Center and select Accounts view.-Select the button Edit and then select Sales Data.-You want to create customized Order Block reasons and add it to the dropdown.-Resolution-To maintain the Order Block reasons of accounts you have to follow the steps below-1. Go to Business configuration and select Implementation Projects view-2. Open the activity list of a project.-3. Select the tab All and select to show All Activities-4. Search for activity Accounts.-5. Open the activity and select Maintain Order Block Reasons-In this view you can maintain the Order Block Reasons using the button Add Row.

Title: Visits are not shown on the Summary
Content: Symptom-Visits are not shown on the Customer Summary.--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customers work center.-Choose the Accounts view.-Find relevant account. Press Name of the account.-Navigate to the VISITS tab.-Press the Summary button.-This summary shows all the activities (appointments and phonecalls e.g) but not the visits.-Cause-Not all data is supported for display in the Summary. Currently, the visit facet is one that is not supported.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.
