Title: How to integrate the Eco participation in price calculation
Content: Symptom-This case document explains how to integrate the "ECO contribution" (recycling tax) to the calculation of item pricing in Sales document. This requirement is specific to French customers.-Reproducing the Issue-When creating a Sales order, you need to add in the price calculation,  a fix amount for each item added,  that corresponds to the recycling cost of each item.-This additional fee should be also visible on the invoice and corresponding reports.-You cannot find a specific price component for the "eco contribution".-Cause-No specific price component exist in the system by default for the Eco Contribution.-Resolution-Create Surcharge based on product category and release the surcharge.  -1. Go to the Product and service portfolio work center.-2. Select the Pricing view --> Surcharges.-3. select Surcharge: Product Category.-4. fill the details and add a description as Eco contribution.-5. Save and Release.-Create a new customer specific price list for the required customer and add the products for which the Eco contribution has to be calculated.-1. Go to the Product and service portfolio work center.-2. Select the price list view.-3. new customer specific price list.-4. In the General tab, fill the account ID for your specific customer.-5. In the Items tab, click Add Row and add all products for which the tax has to be calculated.-6. Save and Release.-All the Sales orders and Invoices created with the account and products defined in the surcharge will have an additional cost line called Surcharge with the amount calculated based on the unit and the amount specified in the surcharge.-The printed invoice will also show the details of the new surcharge.

Title: Description and Handling of Unix signals in TREX
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- A signal is an asynchronous notification sent to a process or to a specific thread within the same process in order to notify it of an event that occurred.-While troubleshooting a TREX related issue, TREX trace files may show Unix signals encountered in the system which either killed the service/process or informed of a rare condition, which the system doesn't know how to handle,  has occurred.-This case document will explain following about Unix Signals:-Handling Signals-Risks-Description of signals-Cause-Signals are a limited form of inter-process communication used in Unix.-When a signal is sent, the operating system interrupts the target process's normal flow of execution to deliver the signal. If the process has previously registered a signal handler, that routine is executed. Otherwise, the default signal handler is executed. Signals can cause the interruption of a system call in progress, leaving it to the application to manage a non-transparent restart.-Signal handlers should be written in a way that doesn't result in any unwanted side-effects and they can instead put the signal into a queue and immediately return. The main thread will then continue uninterrupted until signals are taken from the queue, such as in an event loop.  Uninterrupted here means that operations that block may return prematurely and must be resumed. -The kernel can generate signals to notify processes of events. For Example: Exceptions such as division by zero or a segmentation violation will generate signals.-Resolution-A process's execution may result in the generation of a hardware exception, for instance, if the process attempts to divide by zero.-In Unix-like operating systems, this event automatically changes the processor context to start executing a kernel exception handler. In case of some exceptions, such as a page fault, the kernel has sufficient information to fully handle the event itself and resume the process's execution.-Other exceptions, however, the kernel cannot process intelligently and it must instead defer the exception handling operation to the faulting process. This deferral is achieved via the signal mechanism, where the kernel sends to the process a signal corresponding to the current exception.-Similarly, if the process attempted to access a memory address outside of its virtual address space, the kernel would notify the process of this violation via a SIGSEGV signal. The exact mapping between signal names and exceptions is obviously dependent upon the CPU, since exception types differ between architectures.-Here is the list of all the signals with short description.-Signal    Code    Default Action Description-SIGABRT 6          A-Process abort signal i.e. to terminate.-This signal is usually initiated by the process itself when it calls abort function but it can be sent to the process from outside as well as any other signal.-SIGALRM 14         T-Alarm Clock.-The SIGALRM signal is sent to a process when the time limit specified in a call to a preceding alarm setting function (such as setitimer) elapses. SIGALRM is sent when real or clock time elapses.-SIGBUS 10        A-Access to an undefined portion of a memory object.-The SIGBUS signal is sent to a process when it causes a bus error. The conditions that lead to the signal being raised are, for example, incorrect memory access alignment or non-existent physical address.-SIGCHLD 18        I - Ignore the Signal-Child process terminated/stopped.-The SIGCHLD signal is sent to a process when a child process terminates or is interrupted, or resumes after being interrupted. One common usage of the signal is to instruct the operating system to clean up the resources used by a child process after its termination without an explicit call to the wait system call.-SIGCONT 25       C - Continue the process-Continue executing, if stopped.-The SIGCONT signal instructs the operating system to continue (restart) a process previously paused by the SIGSTOP or SIGTSTP signal.-SIGFPE 8       A-Erroneous arithmetic operation.-The SIGFPE signal is sent to a process when it executes an erroneous arithmetic operation, such as division by zero.-SIGHUP 1       T-Hangup.-This signal usually means that the controlling pseudo or virtual terminal has been closed. Many shells will reload their configuration files and reopen their logfiles instead of exiting when receiving this signal.-SIGILL 4      A-Illegal instruction.-The SIGILL signal is sent to a process when it attempts to execute an illegal, malformed, unknown, or privileged instruction.-SIGINT 2      T-Terminal interrupt signal.-The SIGINT signal is sent to a process by its controlling terminal when a user wishes to interrupt the process. This is typically initiated by pressing Control-C, but on some systems, the delete character or break key can be used.-SIGKILL 9      T-Kill (cannot be caught or ignored).-The SIGKILL signal is sent to a process to cause it to terminate immediately (kill). In contrast to SIGTERM and SIGINT, this signal cannot be caught or ignored, and the receiving process cannot perform any clean-up upon receiving this signal.-SIGPIPE 13      T - Abnormal termination of the process-Write on a pipe with no one to read it.-The SIGPIPE signal is sent to a process when it attempts to write to a pipe without a process connected to the other end.-SIGQUIT 3      A - Abnormal termination of the process-Terminal quit signal.-The SIGQUIT signal is sent to a process by its controlling terminal when the user requests that the process quit and perform a core dump.-SIGSEGV 11     A-Invalid memory reference.-The SIGSEGV signal is sent to a process when it makes an invalid virtual memory reference, or segmentation fault.-SIGSTOP 23     S - Stop the process-Stop executing (cannot be caught or ignored).-The SIGSTOP signal instructs the operating system to stop a process for later resumption.-SIGTERM 15     T-Termination signal.-The SIGTERM signal is sent to a process to request its termination. Unlike the SIGKILL signal, it can be caught and interpreted or ignored by the process. This allows the process to perform nice termination releasing resources and saving state if appropriate. It should be noted that SIGINT is nearly identical to SIGTERM.-SIGTSTP 23     S-Terminal stop signal.-The SIGTSTP signal is sent to a process by its controlling terminal to request it to stop temporarily. It is commonly initiated by the user pressing Control-Z. Unlike SIGSTOP, the process can register a signal handler for or ignore the signal.-SIGTTIN 26    S-Background process attempting read.-The SIGTTIN and SIGTTOU signals are sent to a process when it attempts to read in or write out respectively while in the background. Typically, this signal can be received only by processes under job control; daemons do not have controlling terminals and should never receive this signal.-SIGTTOU 27    S Background process attempting write.-SIGUSR1 16    T User-defined signal 1.-SIGUSR2 17    T User-defined signal 2.-SIGPOLL 22    T-Pollable event.-The SIGPOLL signal is sent to a process when an asynchronous I/O event occurs.-SIGPROF 29    T Profiling timer expired.-SIGSYS 12    A Bad system call.-SIGTRAP 5    A-Trace/breakpoint trap.-The SIGTRAP signal is sent to a process when an exception (or trap) occurs: a condition that a debugger has requested to be informed of — for example, when a particular function is executed, or when a particular variable changes value.-SIGURG 21     I High bandwidth data is available at a socket.-SIGVTALRM 28    T Virtual timer expired.-SIGXCPU 30    A-CPU time limit exceeded.-The SIGXCPU signal is sent to a process when it has used up the CPU for a duration that exceeds a certain predetermined user-settable value. The arrival of a SIGXCPU signal provides the receiving process a chance to quickly save any intermediate results and to exit gracefully, before it is terminated by the operating system using the SIGKILL signal.-SIGXFSZ 31    A File size limit exceeded

Title: SEPA Mandate - Company Logo and Company Address Not Displayed Properly
Content: Symptom-When previewing a SEPA mandate, you can see that your company logo from the first page is not properly displayed. Also the footer of the first page does not display the company`s address and other address related data, but displays only the description Placeholder for Company….-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Select the account ID XYZ and click Edit - Financial Data.-Select the Payment Data sub-tab.-Scroll down to the SEPA Mandates section and click to open the maintained SEPA mandate.-Click View All.-Click Preview.-You see that your company logo is not displayed correctly on the first page. Also the footer of the first page does not display the company`s address and other address related data, but displays only the description Placeholder for Company….-Cause-The form template being used for the preview is the Direct Debit Mandate form template. The cause for the issue is that the Form Template Direct Debit Mandate is not using the Master Template.- Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the respective form template - Direct Debit Mandate.-Under the Details section, you can see that the Form Master Template status is Not In Use.-Click Actions button and choose the option Change Master Template Usage.-Activate the Use Form Master Template option and click OK.

Title: Duplicating check for Sales Orders Using Different Communcation Channels
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are using different communication methods to get the sales order request from their customer (eg: Email order, Internet order, EDI order, SOAP, ecommerce) and therefore customer might update/request through multiple methods and and this results in creation of multiple sales order for one order. Therefore you required a duplication check method to be available in the system--Your suggestion is to use the External Reference field for the duplication. So that if mentioned the same External Reference number in a new sales order system will show a warning message.-Cause-This feature is not supported in current release.-Resolution-This can be a new requirement for future SAP ByDesign releases.

Title: ABC Classification is Missing in Accounts or Partners
Content: Symptom-When you Edit an existing Accounts (or Partners) or create a new Account or Partner, ABC Classification is missing in the drop down.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Accounts view.-Edit or create an Account.-  Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Select Partners view.-Edit or create a Partner.-Cause-The reason that the ABC Classification not available in the system is that the Partners is not scoped in the system.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to scope the Partners,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Edit the Project Scope.-Go to Review Questions.-Expand Sales, expand Account and Activity Management.-Highlight Account Management.-Check the question Would you like to manage partners, such as resellers or service partners, in your solution?-Finish the scoping.

Title: Journal Entry of Goods Issue for Customer (Third Party) Does Not Calculate Total Amount with Product Cost Rate
Content: Symptom-The journal entry of type Goods Issue for Customer (Third Party) posts the cost to G/L account of Finished Goods Consumption.-However, system does not calculate the total cost based on product cost rate.-Cause-The journal entry is type Goods Issue for Customer (Third Party). It means that goods are not delivered from warehouse but procured from a third party and delivered.-In this case, the price in purchase order is taken to calculate the actual cost of the product sold.

Title: System Re-uses Only the First Outgoing Check When All Checks Have Been Voided for a Multi-page Check
Content: Symptom-You have an outgoing check which was supposed to pay more than 999 invoices. Therefore system creates two checks (XXX and XXX+1) to pay them.-However, you have to cancel check XXX. Then system re-used only the first one and the second one XXX+1 was skipped.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments.-Search for Outgoing Check XXX.-You can see this check number is Canceled and has been already re-used. However, when searching for check number XXX+1 we can see the number is Canceled and has not been re-used.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior, and currently this logic is not planned to be changed. -Resolution-Two options are available:-You could take the following workaround: -As soon as you cancel such a multi-page check which is not printed yet, you would need to take the voided check pages out of the printer.-You could alternatively make use of the print advice functionality:-Instead of having the invoice reference numbers on the check form, you could print or even email a payment advice with these reference numbers. But for that you would need to generally change the check print form in the way that the whole invoice reference lines are removed, so that it is ensured that only one page is printed only.

Title: Is it Possible to Delete a File in Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are processing files using Mass Data Maintenance and there is no Delete button to delete a unsuccessful file. You would like to whether there is an option to delete the failed files?-Resolution-In current release, it is not possible to delete any files that are uploaded into the Mass Data Maintenance. This functionality is added as a new requirement and will be available in one of the higher release.

Title: Account Migrated Without Spaces Between Names
Content: Symptom-The accounts names appear without spaces between their names in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend tab.-Open activity Migration of Customers.-Click the Migrate customers using the migration tool link.-Open the maintained migration template - the account names have been maintained without spaces in between (e. g. CustomerGmbH instead of Customer GmbH).-When checking the corresponding accounts in the Account Management work center, their names appear also without spaces and you want to remove them and migrate them again correctly.-Cause-When you created the records in the migration template, you forgot to maintain the spaces between the accounts` names.-Resolution-It is not possible to delete an account in the system once it is created.-It is also not possible to change the Account Name of multiple accounts via Mass Change. Hence, only available option is to change each account manually.-The following options are available:-1. Change production system, where only the solution profile is copied, but without master data and perform the migration of accounts correctly.-2. Restore point to the date before the migration has been performed.-3. Manual change, but this will be time-consuming, if a large list of records needs to be corrected.

Title: Using Complex Restriction Is Not Available When Creating a New Report
Content: Symptom-You notice that for some reports and characteristics, like report Details for Open Items - Suppliers on data source Trade Receivables Payables Register and characteristic Proposed Posting Date, the value selection is set to Using Complex Restriction. You are creating your own report on the same data source and would like to use the value selection Using Complex Restriction as well. However, the selection is not offered in the report wizard.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Find the report (in this example it is Details for Open Items - Suppliers on data source Trade Receivables Payables Register) and click on New > Report as Copy.-Go to step 4 - Select Characteristics.-You notice that for some characteristics, like Proposed Posting Date, the value selection is set to Using Complex Restriction.-Since you would like to create your own report rather than a report copy, you use the report wizard to built your report based on the standard data source Trade Receivables Payables Register or your own data source that contains the standard data source.-In the report wizard of your new report, select the desired data source in step 1.-Choose the key figures and characteristics as required in steps 2 and 3.-Go to step 4. Here you can see that the value selection Using Complex Restriction is not listed for the characteristic Proposed Posting Date.-Cause-Using Complex Restriction means that there is a restriction applied to that characteristic which is based on specific characteristic values. SAP delivers these restrictions via key figure groups which can be selected in step 2 of the report wizard (Select Key Figures). This means that without selecting the relevant key figure group, the option Using Complex Restriction will not be available.-Resolution-In this example, the relevant key figure group is Open Item List.-Edit your report with the report wizard.-In step 2, choose the required key figures / key figure groups, but make sure to select the key figure group Open Item List.-Choose the desired characteristics, including Proposed Posting Date, in step 3.-In step 4 you will see that the option Using Complex Restriction is now available for the Proposed Posting Date.-If you would like to check which key figure group is relevant for your characteristic, you can use the function New > Report as Copy to see the key figure groups in the original report.-

Title: Account Determination Group and Cost Information Missing in Materials Migration Template
Content: Symptom-The information pertaining to Account Determination Group and Material Costs is not available for migration in the template for Materials.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find and Open the activity Migration of Materials.-Select the You Can Also button and Download Migration Template.-Cause-As per the design of the Business ByDesign system, the accounting view of the the Materials is expected to be migrated as a follow-up through the activity 'Migration of Material Valuation Data' in business configuration.-Resolution-You may use the Migration of Material Valuation Data as a follow up after the Migration of Materials.-The steps would be as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find and Open the activity Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Select the You Can Also button and Download Migration Template.

Title: No Field to Input Value Limit for Purchase Order Item with Type as Limit
Content: Symptom-You create a purchase order and select item type as Limit, but you cannot find a field to input the value limit.-Cause-You have not input the currency of the purchase order yet. So the system does not allow you to input the value limit at that stage.-Resolution-Once you input the currency for this purchase order, the field Value Limit is there.

Title: Deleting an Open Task is Not Possible
Content: Symptom-Deleting an open task is not possible-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select business task management view-In Find enter open task here there is no option to Delete this task.-Cause-This is system standard behavior.-Resolution-You can only accept or reject or send it for revision for any open tasks you cannot delete them also any changes done to the tasks will not affect the PO even if you reject also the PO will not be deleted.-Also PO can be deleted from the Purchase Request and Orders work center only. Once the PO is deleted it will not be possible to retrieve it back.

Title: Account Assignment Type missing Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When choosing the specific supplier and check the Account assignment type, no purchase order Item can be found.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to WoC: "supplier invoicing " and common tasks click "New Customs Duty invoice".-Then choose the specific supplier item, and check from account assignment type but found no purchase order item.-Cause-Purchase Order is not a valid Cost Object and cannot be selected in the Cost Distribution.-Resolution-Customer can however post the invoice with reference to the relevant purchase order.-Personalize the Basic View of the task 'New Customs Duty Invoice' and add the columns 'Order ID' and 'Order Item'.-Alternatively Customer can click 'View All' and navigate to the tab 'Items'. There the fields will be present by default.-Afterward enter the PO ID and Item number, then press ENTER.

Title: Project Type "Intercompany Project" is Missing
Content: Symptom-When you create a new Project in Project Management work center, you have observed that the Project Type Intercompany Project is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Select New Project from Common Tasks.- Resolution-The Project Type Intercompany Project cannot be created directly and it will created with reference to a another Project (Type: Customer) where a Service Agent of another Organization is employed. Please refer to the help center documentation Intercompany Project Time and Expenses.-You can able to filter the Projects in the Project view, you can find all the project types including Intercompany Project.

Title: Comment and Personal Expense Icons are not Visible during Itemization
Content: Symptom-You are unable to see Comment and Personal Expense Icons during Itemization.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cockpit work center.-Go to All Expense Reports.-Find Expense Report XYZ.-Click on Add Expense.-Enter the Expense Type, for example,Hotel and click on Add.-Click on Edit details, and then select Itemize Expense.-After Itemizing, the Expense type you see that the Personal and Comment Icons are not visible.-Cause-The Checkbox is unselected for Field Personal Expense and Comments  in the Personalization settings.-Resolution-Go to Cockpit work center.-Go to All Expense Reports.-Find Expense Report XYZ.-Click on Add Expense .-Enter the Expense Type details.-Click on Add.-Click on Edit details.-Click on Personalize symbol.-Select the checkbox for Fields Personal Expense and Comments.-Once the checkbox is selected,the Fields Personal Expense and Comments are visible during Itemization.-

Title: How to Show a Calculated Key Figure in Percent
Content: Symptom-You want to show a custom Key Figure with the percent sign, but when adding its unit conversion to Percent the report keeps showing the values without the sign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Design Key Figures;-Click on New;-On this new screen define the name of the Key Figure, the Data Source that it is going to use and select Calculated Key Figure for the type of this Key Figure, then click on Next;-Define your calculation of this Key Figure and click on Next;-Define the Conversion Type as Unit Conversion and the Target Unit as Percent;-See that when you add this key figure to the report, it doesn't have the percent sign on it.-Cause-This happens due to the wrong calculation of the Key Figure, if you are not using the percent operator, it is most likely that no conversion will happen.-Resolution-In order to show a calculated Key Figure as percent you will need to use one of the percent operators (Percentage Deviation - % or Percentage Share - %A) alongside with the NODIM function. You might also need to use the NDIV0 function to avoid miscalculation of some values.-Also remove the Conversion Type from the Key Figure properties.-Example:-NODIM("Order Quantity") %A NODIM("Valuation Quantity")-See Also-You can also check the document Formulas in the Help Center of your SAP Business ByDesign system in order to check all functions available for creating calculated key figures.

Title: Error Message "Address incomplete; complete all mandatory fields for org unit XYZ"
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate a particular Organizational Structure, system throws below error messages:-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; main address must be specified for org unit XYZ (Org Unit Name)-Address incomplete; complete all mandatory fields for org unit (XYZ)-DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY; country of registration of company in org unit XYZ incomplete. Provide the necessary information in the Details of the company on the Definitions tab.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective date.-Highlight the Org Unit.-Check or Activate it.-Resolution-If you are marking an Org Unit as Company, then it is mandatory to maintain the Country of registration and Main Address.--Please maintain the required information and try to activate the Org Structure.

Title: You don't want the filed Incoterms or Incoterms Location shown on UI for all Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You don't want the filed Incoterms or Incoterms Location shown on UI for all Sales Documents (Sales Quotes, Sales Orders etc)-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Choose the Sales Quotes view.-Select New->Sales Quote.-You will find the filed Incoterms or Incoterms Location on UI.-However you don't want either of them to be shown.-Cause-You have scoped Sell Standard Products, so Incoterms or Incoterms Location Shown on UI as an expected behavior.-Resolution-Follow below steps if you want filed Incoterms or Incoterms Location invisible on UI,please do following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Select the Next button and go to step 3.-Expand Scoping -> Sales-> Product and Service Portfolio for Service-> deselect the Sell Standard Products-> Choose Next Button and Finish this scoping.-

Title: Error : Maintain username/password for VAT e-filing for company ABC
Content: Symptom-When you try to release the VAT return, you get the error : Maintain username/password for VAT e-filing for company ABC.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax management work center.-Select the VAT Returns view.-Select the VAT return which you would like to release.-Click on Release.-You will get the error : Maintain username/password for VAT e-filing for company ABC.-Cause-In the business configuration Scoping, You have selected the question: "Do you use British tax file for periodic tax return?". Find this question by following below steps:-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation project view.-Select the project and click on Edit project scope.-Navigate to questions tab by clicking next.-Select Cash Flow Management.-Select Tax management.-Select Tax Filing.-On the right hand side, under the Group : Tax Filing - UK.-You can find that question : "Do you use British tax file for periodic tax return?" is selected.-Also in the Company Tax arrangement, Electronic Submission field is selected.-Go to Tax management work center.-Select company Tax arrangement view.-Select the respective line and click on Edit.-Select the company.-Go to tax return arrangements tab.-Select the Tax return arrangement ID.-In the details section, you can find that Electronic Submission checkbox is selected.-When you try to release the VAT return with the above setting, system tries to find the user name and password to submit the file to electronic filing facility for which system is unable to find the user name and password in the system.-Resolution-You must enter the username and password that you obtained from HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) when you registered for the electronic filing facility. This is a legal requirement in the UK.-To maintain username and password in the system, follow below steps.-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation project view.-Click on Open activity list.-Go to Fine tune tab.-Search for activity Tax Return Authentication Details - UK.-Click on Open.-Click on Add row.-Maintain the details and save the changes.-after you maintain username and password in the activity,-Go to Tax management work center.-Select the VAT Returns view.-Select the VAT return which you would like to release.-Click on Release.-You should be able to release the VAT return successfully.-If you wish to report the VAT return manually, or you are yet to receive username and password from the HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC), you should maintain dummy username and password in order to release VAT return.

Title: You cannot Post Invoices with error "Warning Only Accountants Responsible (such as [User ID] ([User name])) can Post The Document"
Content: Symptom-You have the correct access rights but still are unable to post invoices for some of the buying companies setup in the system.-You get the error message : "Warning Only Accountants Responsible (such as [User ID] ([User name])) can Post The Document" When Posting Supplier Invoices.-There is also a work distribution rule maintained for the Org Unit you belong to under Organizational Management / Work Distribution/Organizational Work Distribution / Supplier Invoicing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select Show All Documents and then the Go button.-Select the relevant invoice.-Select the Edit button.-Select the Post button.-Note that the aforementioned warning message appears at the bottom of the screen.-Cause-There is no default "Employee Responsible for Supplier Invoices" maintained in the Employee Work Distribution.-As a result, the responsibility goes to an employee of the org unit.-If you are not the manager of the invoicing unit or even assigned to this org unit you won't be able to post invoices.-Resolution-To allow you to post, you must be assigned to the supplier invoicing org unit of the invoicing document.-or you must be defined as employee responsible for this org unit using the work category : Employee Responsible for Supplier Invoices under the Employee Work Distribution.-Another option would be if you were populated as an additional accountant for this invoicing unit under the Additional Accountant work category under the Employee Work Distribution.

Title: Profile Generation of Roles
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Currently, the user roles are imported into the system without having the profiles generated. Hence, even if the roles are assigned to the users, the users will not have the authorizations contained in the roles. This leads to the authorization error messages displayed to the end users at the front end and the technical and operating users at the back end.-Resolution-1. Go to the transaction SUPC.-2. Select the radio buttons as shown in the following screen: -Select Roles with Current Profiles for New Generation.-Select Generate automatically.-Select Execute.-3. A screen with an important note pops up. Confirm proceeding by selecting the green colored icon as shown in the following screen.-4. Confirm proceeding by choosing the relevant icons in the all the screens that appear until relevant roles are listed.-5. If only the role SAP_CHANGEMAN_ADMIN is displayed, no action is required to be taken and you have to quit working on this guide. Else, select all and generate profile by choosing the icons as shown in the following screen: -6. Select In the Background. -7. Check if the job is completed successfully in the transaction SM37,the job name is SAPPROFG_NEW. -8. Perform the above mentioned steps in all the clients.-Created by BYDMS-KB-IM

Title: Ship-to address missing in the Output History of the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You find the Ship-to address missing in the  Output History of the Sales Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents sales order ID).-Select Edit button and choose View All.-Go to the Output History tab.-Select document Sales Order Confirmation view.-You find the Ship To address is missing in the Output History.-Cause-When contact party address is same as Ship-to then you would not see ship-to in  Sales Order Confirmation form or Output History.-Resolution-Ship To Address in some of the sales order confirmation forms is because it differs from contact party's address or customer's address.-When contact party address is same as Ship To address then you would not see Ship To in confirmation form.-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: How to configure a payment term "50% down payment and 50% on delivery"
Content: Symptom-How to configure a payment term 50% down payment and 50% on delivery in the Business Configuration work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List.-Select Fine-tuning and go to Accounts.-Open Maintain Payment Terms.-You cannot find the option to configure the payment term "50% down payment and 50% on delivery".-Cause-This option is not available in the current release of Business ByDesign.-Resolution-You can contact your Partner/SAP Service Center to customize the feature via PDI/Add-on.

Title: Cannot Enter Multiple Accounting Periods in Sales Info for IS By Nature of Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You want to enter more than one accounting period (multiple selection) on the Accounting Period/Year variable of the Sales Info for IS By Nature of Expense report.-However the system only allows you to select a single accounting period (e.g. 003.2014).- Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center (report is also available under Business Analytics work center)-Go to Reports > List sub view-Search and open report Sales Info for IS By Nature of Expense-Under report Selection area, click on the icon to expand the available selections for Accounting Period/Year variable-Under Advanced Select tab, mark Add More and click the icon to expand. You'll see that only one accounting period/year can be selected.-Cause-The report Sales Info for IS By Nature of Expense is meant to provide support for creating manual postings for switch to Nature of Expense from Function of Expense.-Using the nature of expense method requires manual correcting entries to be made monthly. In this way, if multiple selection on Accounting Period/Year variable is allowed, it will be difficult to create manual postings on monthly basis as the data will be aggregated.-Also using Add Fields is not an option as a hard restriction was implemented on Accounting Period/Year to be single entry.-Resolution-That is how the report was designed to be built and hence the system behavior is correct.-The help documentation below is useful as further reference:-Sales Information for Income Statement by Nature of Expense (Posting to COGS Accounts)-Switching from Function of Expense Method to Nature of Expense Method-

Title: Result row will not be displayed at the bottom in some reports
Content: Symptom-Displaying a result row on the bottom is not possible for some reports.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to Reports view.-Choose e.g. Invoice Volume (Kumuliertes Rechnungsvolumen).-Use Settings: Show result row as: First row --> result is shown in first row.-Use Settings: Show result row as: Last row --> result is shown in first row.- Cause-The reason is that some reports are displayed as a hierarchy. In hierarchies the top node acts as a sum node. It is not possible in a hierarchy to have an extra sum row additionally to the root node.-Resolution-To display the sum at the bottom, the hierarchy can be inverted. But then it will be expanded from bottom to top as well.

Title: Error message:Cost object cannot be used for Intercompany Cost Assignment
Content: Symptom-You have received error message Cost object cannot be used for Intercompany Cost Assignment during Internal order Replication.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master data replication Work center.-Go to Import view.-Select Other Cost objects sub-view.-Select the relevant File Name.-Select the Cost object.-Click on Process button.-Cause-The scoping question Do you want to integrate your expense reports in intercompany processes, such as projects with partner companies is not scoped in Project.-Resolution-Go to Business configuration Work center.-Go to Implementation Projects.-Select the relevant Project and click on Edit Project scope button.-Go to Questions.-Go to Expense Reimbursement and then Expense Reporting.-Go to Group:Intercompany Cost Assignment.-Select the checkbox for Scoping Question.-Do you want to integrate your expense reports in intercompany processes, such as projects with partner companies?

Title: Unexpected Behavior of the Search Queries in the Suppliers View
Content: Symptom-The search query in the Supplier view does not work as expected while searching using Product Category ID and Engagement Status criteria.-Reproducing the Issue-To better understand the issue, consider the following example:-The below suppliers:-Supplier: A (S100000)-Supplier: B (S100001)-Supplier: C (S100002)-Are assigned the Product Category 100.-The initial Engagement Status for all three is set to 1 - In Pre-Evaluation.-The supplier query for Product Category 100 and Engagement Status: 1 - In Pre-Evaluation retrieves the expected results.-Now, change all the engagement statuses to 3 - Released For Purchasing, the query for the same will still work fine.-However, now the query for Product Category 100 and Engagement Status: 1 - In Pre-Evaluation still shows the same results as well.-Change the Engagement Status of the Product Category in Supplier: A (S100000) to 5 - Removed, the query Product Category 104 and Engagement Status: 5 - Removed gives only the supplier (S100000). However, all the previous queries still shows all three suppliers.-Cause-As per the current design of the system, the query pulls records which atleast once had obtained the Engagement Status equal to the parameter value.-Resolution-This is a known issue which will be fixed in a future release.

Title: Upload not allowed. Solution is developed for customer YYYYYYY.
Content: Symptom-When partner tries to Upload  the Customer Specific Solution to the Customer Test/Productive tenant system displays an error message as Upload not allowed. Solution is developed for customer YYYYYYY. (YYYYYYY represents SAPReferenceSystem ID for EX: 1234567)-Reproducing the Issue-Login to BYD STUDIO with the customer tenant details .-Enter the URL of Customer tenant.-Go to  Administration --> Implementation Manager toolbar.-Choose the  Upload button and  choose  the zip file Customer Specific Solution YABC (YABC represents the customer specific solution which is created in the assemble and download step), An upload disclaimer appears.-Agree to the terms of the upload disclaimer and click Continue.-The system unpacks the .zip file into the production tenant During the upload process, the system runs compatibility checks on the solution to ensure the following: The tenant where you develop your solution and the tenant where you upload your solution must be on the same release and should contain the same Customer ID if not the system will throw an error message as the system throws an error message “Upload not allowed. Solution is developed for customer YYYYYYY."-Cause- The system will not allow to upload a Customer Specific Solution that was implemented for a specific customer YYYYYYY to the tenant of another customer XXXXXXXXXX (XXXXXXXXXX represents customer ID for EX: 0012345678). To solve the problem a New Customer Specific Solution has to be implemented for the specific customer with the  specific customer ID XXXXXXXXXX and you can copy the source code from the existing solution.-There is no way to do a migration of the existing solutions developed for customer YYYYYYY to your current customer XXXXXXXXXX, since the Customer Name is used to generate the Customer Specific Solution name.- Note : If the partner is new, he is not aware of Customer ID's, while creating the customer specific solution then system shows the default SAPReferenceSystem ID available in the partner system. If he tries to upload the solution to the customer tenant they will come across this error message “Upload not allowed. Solution is developed for customer YYYYYYY ”and they will ask us How to change or remove the customer ID and how to create the new Customer.-Steps to create the Customer Specific Solution with specific customer ID.-1. After Log On to the Partner Development Tenant via ByD Studio you need to switch to the customer for which the solution should be developed.-2. As this is your first Customer-Specific Solution in the Partner Development Tenant the Customer needs to be created first.-3. A Customer-Specific Solution can only be uploaded in tenants of a customer for which the solution has been developed. During Solution Upload in a Customer Tenant the Customer ID of the solution and of the tenant are compared. Therefore it is required to fill the right Customer ID into the field Customer ID, if the solution should be uploaded into a customer tenant. If the Customer created in ByD studio is only used for test reasons, any value can be used but make sure not to use a real Customer ID.-4. Now you need to switch to the Customer you just created.-5. Switching a Customer requires you to Log Off and Log On again to ByD Studio.-6. After the new Log On a new Customer-Specific Solution can be created for that specific customer.-Resolution-SAP ByD Studio works as designed.-

Title: Add a New Import Format for Automatic Generated Bank Statements for South American Countries
Content: Symptom-You want to add a new import format for South American Countries in Business Configuration activity Automatic Generated Bank Statements.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-2. On the Fine tuning step, open the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-3. Click on Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-4. You want to add a new Import Format for a South American country.-Cause-Currently SAP is not planning to deliver complete country versions for the South American countries, thus no localized bank statements will be made available in SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The Software Development Toolkit (SDK) offers the possibility to implement the corresponding formats, please see the dedicated information provided here.--In case you do not have a license for the use of the SDK, please contact your partner or the SAP Service Center for a corresponding service delivery.

Title: Is it Possible to Sort Customer Notes in Accounts in Chronological Order?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to sort Customer Notes in Accounts in chronological order?-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Select and Edit an Account.-Go to Notes tab.-Here, the notes shown are not sorted in chronological order and there is no option to change the sort order of the Customer Notes to a chronological order-Resolution-Currently, it is not possible to sort the Customer Notes in chronological order and you can view the Comments in the order of latest date. You can further filter either Internal sales Note or External Sales note.

Title: Test Copy Watermark is shown on First Print Out of Balance Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You print a Balance Confirmation in Work Center Receivables and Test Copy Watermark is shown on First Print Out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Schedule an already existing Balance Confirmation Run or create New Balance Confirmation Run.-You see the Test Copy Watermark on the first Print Out-Cause-The respective Balance Confirmation is still in Status Not Released. The Test Copy Watermark is shown on the first Print Out to distinguish a Balance Confirmation with status Not Released from a Balance Confirmation with status Released.-Resolution-Go to Receivables Work Center.-Navigate to Balance Confirmation View.-Show All Balance Confirmations and find Balance Confirmation XXX.-Select Balance Confirmation XXX with Status Not Released.-Click on Release.-Choose Actions Repeat Print Out. -Alternatively -Go to Receivables Work Center.-Navigate to Balance Confirmation Runs.-Set flag in Box Release Immediately before executing Balance Confirmation Run.- After following the steps described above Test Copy Watermark is only shown on second Print Out and all successive Print Outs.

Title: Illness Not Shown in Time Account Reports
Content: Symptom-You are viewing one of the Time Accounts reports, e.g. Time Accounts: Yearly. You notice that some time recordings on a specific time account are not shown, for example illnesses are not displayed at all for some employees.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report Time Accounts: Yearly from the work center Time Administration.-Start the report and add the characteristics Employee and Time Account Type.-You see some postings, like vacation, but illnesses are missing for one or several employees.-Cause-The Time Account Illness is not assigned to this employee. You can check this via the following steps:-Go to the work center Time Administration and the work center view Employee.-Open the time file of the employee by clicking on Edit.-Navigate to the tab Time Profile and the subtab Time Account Rules.-In this table, you can see all time accounts that are assigned to this employee. The Time Accounts reports can only show those time accounts that are listed here. If the Illness-Account is not assigned, it will not be shown in the report.-Resolution-Please assign the missing time account in the time file of the employee by following the steps mentioned above. Then perform a correction run to activate the data.

Title: How to find Assigned Tasks for a User in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How can you find assigned tasks in a users home work center in the backend.-Resolution-Logon to the Backend of the customer system.-Go to the sbtm_task_sel transaction.-Click on the UWL View symbol (Ctrl+F2).-In the User (Identity) field click on the value help.-Select the respective user.-Below the Inbox folder on the left, select the respective task type you would like to check e.g. Open Items.-Click on the Execute symbol (Ctrl+F8).-The Task Instance Monitor will open and you can see all task of the respective task type which are visible for this user in the users Home work center under the respective view.

Title: The Weekly Recurrence Pattern of your Invoice Schedule in a Customer Contract Does Not Exceed 26 Weeks
Content: Symptom-The weekly recurrence pattern of your invoice schedule in a customer contract does not exceed 26 weeks.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-Select New Customer Contract.-Enter the account and all required organizational data (Sales Unit and Distribution Channel).-Select the Contract Start/End date for a period longer than 26 weeks.-Go to View All.-Add a new item.-Select the quantity as Week (e.g. 1 wk).-Select the flag Price per Period.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing work center..-Select the Invoice Schedule tab.-Select Edit Invoicing Time Frame-Choose the recurrence pattern as Weekly.-Apply your selection to the line item.-The quantity field is only showing 26 weeks.-Cause-This is the normal system behaviour as we have a maximum of 26 invoice dates for weekly recurrence patterns.-Resolution-You can choose to modify the Recurrence Pattern to year instead of weeks. Moreover, if you need to have more than 26 recurrence shown, you have the possiblity to add more items in the item tab of the contract.

Title: List of Error Codes Related to TREX (Text Retrieval and Information Extraction) or Underlying FSI inconsistencies
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You come across a TREX error code while performing an activity within the ByDesign system and want to find a solution.-Reproducing the Issue-While trying to perform one of the following activities you receive a TREX error or ABAP Dump showing TREX-GEN-ERROR in application information. For example:-Running a query via the OWL (Object Work List).-Opening a report.-Saving/editing or releasing any documents from application side.-A screen shows exception which has TREX error message.-Scheduled background job fails with TREX-GEN-ERROR-Health checks are generated reporting dumps in the system involving TREX error.-Cause-The root cause of these dump could be either TREX or FSI inconsistencies.-Resolution-If you face one of the below errors you may follow the below guidelines:-# Error Message Meaning Processing Team-1 TREX-RUN-ERROR (2004): Index has not been assigned to this IndexServer Join index is not available on TREX at runtime. Since we create join index after receiving error code 2004, this is already the 2nd execution of the query. TREX-2 TREX-ERROR (2007): Index not found; nameserver not found If join index is not found, it is the same problem as for 2004. If physical index is not found, it is to check why it was not created. FSI or TREX-3 TREX-ERROR (2029): syntax error (parsing query)   TREX-4 TREX-ERROR (2030): general configuration error;index=   TREX-5 TREX-GEN-ERROR (2437): join index part does not exist It should be provided in TREX error message, which part of the join index does not exist. FSI or TREX-6 TREX-ERROR (2972): The index is temporary not available;index=   TREX-7 TREX-ERROR (23000):Invalid join query;can't generate where condition   TREX-8 TREX-ERROR (23007): Join graph not connected;Predicate '.c002:1fs:idx_aplc_log_exec_re   TREX-9 TREX-ERROR (5508): NameServer error: no servers found Nameserver service of TREX was/is running; could be because of huge load on system or incorrect restart of TREX services. TREX-10 TREX-RUN-ERROR (23013) unknown view attribute The attribute path specified in join index for the view attribute mentioned in the error message does not lead to an existing TREX index attribute.-To be checked why the error occur.-Possible reasons:-1. old TREX index scheme in SFSG_REPL_META_J or SFSG_REPL_META_I tables.-2. the attribute was not created in physical index. FSI or TREX-11-TREX-GEN-ERROR (2434): join index inconsistent;unknown anchortable-We have the following problem now:-1. An extension was created about 1 year ago for the view. Then, the index scheme entry is created in table SFSG_REPL_META_J.-2. The extension was deleted for the view. Then, the entry is supposed to be deleted out of SFSG_REPL_META_J. Due to the error in FSI, which was fixed about a year ago, the entry was not deleted.-3. A new version of the view with new anchor is imported into the system. Then, the entry in table SFSG_REPL_META_I is updated with new TREX join index scheme.  Table SFSG_REPL_META_J is not updated, since the view does not have any extensions, and contains the old TREX  join index scheme.-4. During query execution SFSG_REPL_META_J is always read first and the outdated TREX join index is created.-We are to send an XPRA to fix this problem. After that the error should not occur any more and is to be treated as TREX error. FSI-12-TREX-GEN-ERROR (2431): TRexCommonObjectsException in IndexName.cpp(54) Type: IndexNameError: invalid index name-Refer to CD 1637377 FSI-13 TREX-ERROR (2570): Unknown or inconsistent attribute 'fsi_mt_enhancemness_partner_tmpl_common_n0630550en) The same as for TREX-RUN-ERROR (23013) unknown view attribute; could pertain to extension fields. FSI or TREX- Note: Underlying component corresponding to each of these TREX-GEN-ERROR may vary from issue to issue and the processing teams listed for each error is the expriences made as far from the incidents. Hence, these processing teams may vary depending on the root cause of the issue.-See Also-You may also refer to the Note 1260249 for a full list of TREX error codes.

Title: Error 'Interval is Already in Use' Occurs When Trying to Change Number Range
Content: Symptom-When you try to change number range in fine-tuning activity Number Ranges for New Business, you get error message Interval is Already in Use.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Configuration-Go to view Implementation Projects-Open activity list-Open activity Number Ranges for New Business-Change Begin Number and/or End Number-Select button Save-An error occurs: interval is already in use-Cause-The number range cannot be changed if interval is already in use.-Resolution-You can change current number:-Select button Change Current Number-In the new screen, enter the value per your needs/requirements-Save the change-For example : if you have created sales quote till 100, it means you have used numbers till 100. So the current number is 100 and next available number will be 101. If you set the current number as 200, then the next available number will be 201.
