Title: Contact Details under Business Communication in the Business Partner Data is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-The fields for contact details under the Business Communication are greyed out in the Business Partner Data workcenter.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Select the Business Partners view.-Search for the business partner id and click on Edit button.-Navigate to Business Partner Roles and click on the link Contact Person.-Click on the button View All.- Here the contact details under the Business Communication are in greyed out mode.-Cause-The cause for the issue is, the address field under the Business Address is not maintained.-Resolution-To do so, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Select the Business Partners view.-Search for the business partner id and choose the Edit button.-Go to Business Partner Roles and click on the link Contact Person-Click on the button View All.-Maintain the address in the Address field under Business Address.-Once you maintain this address, the contact fields under the Business Communication will get enabled.

Title: Fields added Through Adobe LifeCycle Designer is Missing While Previewing the Document
Content: Symptom-You have added Fields in the Form Template using Adobe Life Cycle Designer and established the Binding Path for it. You have also marked these fields as Show if exists in Easy Form Editor but still the fields are completely missing in the Form Template while previewing.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that you have maintained the script in such a way that, if there is no value for these fields then the presence should be hidden. So, in the document there might not be any value for those fields.-Script may be like below:-if(this.rawValue==null ||this.rawValue == "")-{-this.presence="hidden";-}-Endif-Resolution-In order to overcome the issue, change the scripting accordingly and publish it

Title: Questions Related to the Business Partner and Product Data Integration are Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer wants to implement the Business Partner Data and Product Data Management Integration, but the questions related to it are not available in the scope of customer's project.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select Implementation Project view-Edit the scope of the project and go to step Questions-Select Business Partner Data-Select Communication for Business Partner-There is no questions available-Expand the tab Products and select Communication for Product Master Data-There is no questions available.-Cause-The add-on ADDON_MASTERDATA_MAINTINT is mandatory for this integration, but is missing on customer's tenant. Hence the questions are not visible.-Resolution-Send the incident to the queue MS - Patches asking the hosting team to deploy and activate the addon ADDON_MASTERDATA_MAINTINT ﻿on customer's tenant.

Title: How to Make Changes to the Activity Define Administators for Project Team?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirment to change details in the activity Define Administators for Project Team, but you are not able to add this activity into the Change Project as it is missing from the list.-Resolution-The Activity Define Administators for Project Team is available only in the First Implementation project and this activity is not available in the Change project.--If your requirement is to access the activity Define Administators for Project Team, then follow the below steps:--1. Go to Business Configuration work center.-2. select Overview view.-3. Search for the activity Define Administators for Project Team and highlight the row.-4. Select Change Immediately button--Now, you can able to proceed with the activity.

Title: Form Template Title Missing While Previewing a Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you preview a particular Customer Invoice, the title (EX: Invoice) is missing where as when you preview some other Customer Invoice, the Title exists.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Documents.-Highlight a Customer Invoice.-Select Preview button.-Cause-The title of the Invoice is always icked from the Form template. So, what ever title is being provided in the template (Form Template Maintenance) will be picked when previewing that in the document.-In this case, the issue might be with the Form Template variant.-

Title: Is it Possible to Maintain Main Address in Multiple Languages in an Account?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to maintain Main Address of an Account in two different languages but couldn't able to find an option. Is it possible to maintain address in multiple languages?-Resolution-In the General tab of any Account, it is possible to have only one Address which is the Main Address of that particular account.--If you requirement is to have same address in two different language then it is not possible but you may consider the below option:--1. Go to Account Management work center.-2. Edit an Account and go to Communication tab and Addresses sub tab.-3. Here, you can maintain the same address in different language but without maintaining it as a Main Address. Because, the Main address is always used for any communication related to this Account and hence, there is always one Main Address.

Title: The Yearly Recurrence Pattern of your Invoice Schedule in a Customer Contract Does Not Exceed 10 Years
Content: Symptom-The yearly recurrence pattern of your invoice schedule in a customer contract does not exceed 10 years.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-Select New Customer Contract.-Enter the account and all required organizational data (Sales Unit and Distribution Channel).-Select the Contract Start/End date for a period longer than 10 years.-Go to View All.-Add a new item.-Select the quantity as Years (e.g. 1 yr).-Select the flag Price per Period.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing work center..-Select the Invoice Schedule tab.-Select Edit Invoicing Time Frame-Choose the recurrence pattern as Yearly.-Apply your selection to the line item.-The quantity field is only showing 10 years.-Cause-This is the normal system behaviour as we have a maximum of 10 invoice dates for yearly recurrence patterns.-Resolution-In case you need to have more than 10 recurrence shown, you have the possiblity to add more items in the item tab of the contract.

Title: The VAT Value is Displaying Twice in the Sales Quote Documents
Content: Symptom-While previewing a Sales Quote Form, VAT values are displaying in multiple lines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business work center.-Go to Sales Quotes view.-Find the Sales Quote number.-Select the Preview.-Observe that the system discloses the tax codes separately on the Sales Quote Form.--Cause-The cause for this issue is, different tax codes are assigned to different line items.--Resolution-The VAT is displaying multiple times for the Sales Quote is the correct system behavior.-It can be verified by following below mentioned steps:-Go to New Business Work Center.-Go to Sales Quotes View.-Select and Edit any Sales Quote number.-In the next screen, Navigate to View All button.-Choose the Items tab.-Select the Line Item.-Under details, choose the Taxes tab.-Check the line items, the line items with same tax codes adds up the values and display in one line in the Sales Quote Form and the other tax code values displays separately.-Keywords-value added tax, tax aggregation, aggregated tax line, grouped tax line, tax code split, mixed tax rates, multiple tax rates, item-level tax, print form template, PDF output, document printout, tax breakdown, tax summary, combine tax lines, output management

Title: Values Not Displaying Completely in the Footer of the Form
Content: Symptom-Information added in the Footer of Master Template Form is not displaying completely.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Master Template Maintainance View.-Select Form Master Templates from the Show drop down.-Select the relevant master template from the list and click on Edit button.-You can see there are four blocks for the footer is seleted and in the Preview of the form in the same screen itself the value is truncating. -Cause-The cause for the issue is the information entered in the footer of the Master Template is exceeding the standard footer length.-Resolution-This is the standard behaviour of the form template.--If you want to dispaly a long information in the Footer of the Master Template, the Service Center can reduce the number of blocks and then extend length of each block.--This also needs an on-demand service request raised by responsible service advisor.-In order to display the information correctly if it exceeds the footer length of a particular block, as a workaround you can give the value in the next line as a continuation of the previous line.-

Title: How to Maintain Ship-To address as "Yes (Standard)" in the Migration Template for Customer
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating Customers (Accounts) in your system and you wants to know, how to maintain Ship-To address as Yes (Standard) in the Migration Template?-Resolution-In order to have Ship-To address as Yes (Standard), in the migration Template for Customer (Address sheet), Use indicator "X" for the fields Ship-To and Default Ship-To.--After migration with above settings, the address for Ship-To should be Yes (Standard).

Title: Report Revenue by Team Member Does Not Show Amounts from Credit Memos
Content: Symptom-You open the report Revenue by Team Member and are reviewing the invoiced times and expenses. You notice that values that were invoiced via a credit memo are missing in this report.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work center Project Management-Choose the view Reports and open the report Revenue by Team Member-Set the required selection parameters and start the report-In the key figure Net Value - Invoiced Time and Expenses you see an incorrect value. Quantities that were invoiced via a credit memo are not considered.-Cause-The report Revenue by Team Member shows values that are associated via a project invoice request. Additionally, if the customer invoice is cancelled and a cancellation invoice is created, then this value is considered in this report as well. The values from manual credit memos however are not available in the project invoice request and thus they cannot be considered in this report. This behaviour is correct.-Resolution-If you would like to see the final invoiced amount you can use the report Customer Project Overview.

Title: In the Invoice Request View the Contract's Line- Item is Missing
Content: Symptom-In the Invoice Request view the Contract's Line-Item is missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Contracts and in the Find field enter ABC(where ABC is the Contract name) and click on the Go button.-Edit the Contract ABC and go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the sub tab Invoice Schedule.-Expand the line-item 10.-You can see there is an Invoice Schedule for the date XX.YY.ZZZZ.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-In the Show field enter All Invoice Requests and in the Find field enter ABC to search Schedule Invoice Request with reference to Contract ABC for the date XX.YY.ZZZZ.-There is no record founds for Schedule Invoice Request although the date XX.YY.ZZZZ is already reached.-Cause-The Schedule Invoice Request with reference to Contract->Items will be available once the Contract->Item is released.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-Select All Contracts from the drop-down option and in the Find field enter the contract ABC.-Edit the Contract ABC and go to Items tab.-Select the Contract ->Item 10 and click on the Release button and then Save the Contract.-Once done ,the Contract ->Item will be available in the Invoice Request on the scheduled date.

Title: The Account Name is Not Shown on the Migrated Sales Order With Error Message: "Postal codes, street, and, P.O. box in address of Account party missing", "City in address of Account party missing"
Content: Symptom-The account name is not shown on the migrated sales order with error message: Postal codes, street, and, P.O. box in address of Account party missing", "City in address of Account party missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the migrated sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ.-In the Account field only ID is shown not the account name as it shows for other sales orders.-Also error message appears on the sales order: Postal codes, street, and, P.O. box in address of Account party missing", "City in address of Account party missing.-Cause-You have added the country name in the migration template of the sales order. In general the address for the account of the sales order is determined based on the Account master data maintained in the system, but if you add the country in the migration template of the sales order then system considers it to be manual entry of data and will not determine the address of the account party.-Resolution-To avoid this problem in the migrated sales order it is advisable that before the migration you should remove the entry from the Country field for account in the migration template.-For already migrated sales order, following workaround can be applied:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the migrated sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ.-Manually remove the account ID from the Account field, press Enter, add the same account ID again.-Save the sales order.-Now the sales order will show the account name without any error.

Title: Packing List Form Template is Missing in the System
Content: Symptom-The form template Packing List is missing in the view Form Template Maintenance of your system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Select Form Template Maintenance view.-The form template Packing List is missing.-Cause-The reason that the Packing List Form Template is missing in your system is because it is not enabled in the scope of your implementation Project.-Resolution-The Question to enable the form in your system is called You will be able to print packing lists.-You can find it following the steps below-1. Go to Business Configuration and Select Implementation Projects view-2. Edit the scope of your project.-3. Go to Questions-4. Search for You will be able to print packing lists-5. Select Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics->Tracking, Tracing, and Identification-6. Select Communication for Tracking, Tracing and Identification-7. You will see the question You will be able to print packing lists is disabled.--However, this question is in read-only mode since it has a dependency of question Packing into Logistics Units.-Therefore your must enable the question Do you want to pack into logistics units creating package IDs based on outbound deliveries? to the scope of your project in order to enable the Packing List Form Template in your system.--To find this question follow the steps below:--1. Go to Business Configuration and Select Implementation Projects view-2. Edit the scope of your project.-3. Go to Step Questions.-4. Search for Do you want to pack into logistics units creating package IDs based on outbound deliveries?-5. Select Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics->Tracking, Tracing, and Identification-6. Select Handling and Logistics Units.-7. Enable the question Do you want to pack into logistics units creating package IDs based on outbound deliveries?.-Following these steps, the question You will be able to print packing lists will be enabled automatically and the Packing List form template will be available in your system.

Title: Error Message "Go live not possible; close mandatory activities" While Trying to Close a Change Project
Content: Symptom-When you try to close a Change Project, system throws below error message:-Go live not possible; close mandatory activities-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select one of the Change Project and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Go Live tab.-Open activity Close Project.-Check Close Project and select Confirm button.-Cause-The cause for the issue that you are trying to close this Change project without closing some of the fine tuning or migration activity.-Resolution-In order to close a Change Project, it is required to close all the activities in the Change Project.-Note: The activities which are Repetition Required might have re-opened after merge. Hence, it is required to close these activities again after merge.

Title: Is it Possible to Convert a Private Account to Corporate Account or Vice Versa?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to convert a Private Account into a Corporate Account or vice versa but couldn't able to find such a option in the system.-Resolution-It is not possible to convert a Private Account to Corporate Account or Corporate Account to Private Account because, a Private Account is a Business Partner Person which represents a single person whereas Corporate Account is a Business Partner Organization which represents the group/organization.-Hence, these two are completely two different entities which cannot be merged or covertable.

Title: How to Modify the Dropdown List for Extension Fields
Content: Symptom-How to modify the dropdown list for the extension fields?-Reproducing the Issue-Example of an extension field:-On the Supplier screen under the Details section there is a field Goods or Service Provided with dropdown menu options:-Services-Consulting Services-Marketing-Hardware-Software-Office Suppliers / Equipment-Facilitites-Unknown-You want to modify this list.-Resolution-The values in the drop-down list for an extension field can be changed through the following steps:-Go to the concerned work center.-Go to concerned view.-Navigate to the screen where the Extension field is present.-Select the Adapt button.-Select the Enter Adaptation Mode option from the drop-down.-Select the Adapt button again for the Edit Screen option.- For example in the Supplier Base screen:-Select any Supplier -Click on View All -Click on Adapt-Click on Enter Adaptation Mode-Click again on Adapt-Click on Edit Screen-Click on Sections Enabled for Extension Fields-Click on details under the head-Click on List of Fields-Sselect Goods or Service Provided-Click on Edit-A window pops up-Choose the respective language (example English) and then click on Add, choose Value and input the data required to be shown in the drop down.--Once the above steps are followed, click on Save and Publish. Once this is done, the respective value in the dropdown can be seen.

Title: Error Message "Error in moving down the Section Element" While Moving a Field in Easy Form Editor
Content: Symptom-You have created a Extension Field in a particular screen and extened it to a Form Template. Now, when you try to move that Extension Field using Easy Form Editor either up or down, system throws beloe error message:-Error in moving down the Section Element-Error in moving up the Section Element- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Flexibility view and sub view Form Template Maintenance.-Select and highlight the Form Template, select Open button and choose Easy Form Editor.-Go to the Sections table and expand hierarchy.-Highlight the respective field and change display to Show Always.-Highlight the row of the respective field again and use the down arrow or up arrow to move the field.-Cause-It is not possible to change/move a Extension Field in the Table of Form Template using Easy Form Editor. You can move only the pre-delivered fields in the Easy Form Editor.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-You can use Adobe Life Cycle Designer to move the extension field as required.

Title: Error Message: Catastrophic Failure or unable to load local library or Not enough storage to edit the template while opening Form Template
Content: Symptom-While opening Form Template using Add-in for Adobe LiveCycle Designer, you have recieved below error.-Catastrophic Failure or Unable to load local library or Not enough storage to edit the template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Select Business Flexibility view.-Click on Form Template Maintenance.-Click on Go.-Select any Form template.-Click on Open and then Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer.-Cause-To open Form template in Online Mode (from Bydesign system), the Internet Explorer must be Compatibility Mode.-Resolution-In Internet Explorer perform following checks.-Check the IE status bar (it appears at the bottom of the browser) for the Bydesign url. If it shows Protected Mode: Then it needs to be set to Off for Bydesign url. To do so follow the steps listed below :-Open Internet Explorer Tools -> Internet Options -> Security tab -> Select Trusted Sites zone.-Check that under the Security Level for this zone, Enable Protected Mode checkbox is not ticked.-Click on Sites button and enter the Bydesign url (if it’s not pre-filled) in the text box appearing before the Add button and click on the Add button.-Now on visiting the Bydesign url, the protected mode should come as Off.-and then-In the Command bar, go to Tools , click to get a drop down and select Compatibility View settings. Here you can exercise any of the two options:-Select the Checkbox Display all websites in Compatibility View and click on Close button. This will render all the websites accessed via IE9 in the Compatibility View.-Add individual website to the Compatibility View. To do so, mention the byd-url in the Textbox adjacent to the Add button. The textbox comes prefilled with the website url in case the website is already open in the browser window. Click on the Add button and then click on Close. This will render the added website in Compatibility View when accessed via IE9.-If above step doesn't help resolve the error then follow below step.-Clean up the system environment temp folder.-To know the path of the temp folder, go to Start Button, click on Run and type 'cmd' to open the command prompt.-Type 'echo %temp%' in the command prompt. This would show the temp folder path. Also type 'echo %tmp%' and check that the folder path shown is same as that shown earlier.-Navigate to the temp folder and clean up the files/folders present in temp folder. Even if all files/folders are not deleted , please try to clean up the Low folder inside the temp folder.-

Title: Migrated Org Units are Missing in the Planning Area of Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-You have created an Org Structure (either manually or using Migration) and again, you have used Migration to add some more Org Units. The Migration is successful but the Org Units are missing in the Planning Area of the Organizational Structure.-Cause-After successful migration, those Org Units will be in Planning Area (inactive) and it needs to be activated later. There are two possibilites that may end up in this issue. They are,-You have deleted the Org Units in the Planning Area.-or-You have performed the rollback in the Planning Area which is delete all inactive changes and revert the Org Structure to the last active version.- Resolution-The system works as expected.

Title: Is it Possible to have Segregate Authorization Access to Account Management?
Content: Symptom-You as Account Manager, Would like to know, whether it is possible to have segregate authorization access to Account Management?-For example:-For a particular Account, one user can only create the Account but cannot Block the status, and another user can only block status but should not have access for creation. This is sort of an internal control.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-It is possible to have Read, Write or Read and Write.

Title: List of fields and their Data Type for a service interface
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You can find the elements of a service interface XML and their use case using this document.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps in MDRS to find this data :-Logon to SAP system backend.-Enter the tcode MDRS.-Select the Inbound Service Interface from drop down.-Enter the name of interface or you can search for an interface.-Once the interface is selected, click on button Enter to see the details.-Click on Operations -> Select an operation -> Request message type.-Select the message type by a double click.-Click on Data Type.-Select the tab Elements.-Here you can see the data type elements for message Header and request.-You can also see if a field is mandatory or not.-

Title: User is missing from user accounts screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Whenever we get security_22 (Inconsistent ABAP profile assignment for user XXXX ) or security_ 21 (Incorrect user type, security policy, or classification) incidents that means there is inconsistency with user mentioned in the error information.-Example :User name: SP_ADEM003-Reproducing the Issue-Following steps to be followed.-In work center Cloud landscape select User Accounts and enter the SID and Client for which incident was reported.-        2. As per RA there must be 3 categories for users DDIC(1), Support users (10), fallback users (05) total of 16 users.-       3. Tenant user consistency status must be green.-       4. If you find any user is missing and tenant user consistency status is red then there is issue with users.- Cause-The user is not created.-No synchronization between backend and front end.-Resolution-Login into backend of the client for which incident is reported.-Execute the transaction SU01-In the user tab ,give the user which is in the error information (In this case SP_ADEM003)-                      4.   Select View (marked in yellow)-    5.   If the user is not displayed a error pops out which means user does not exists , user has to be created-               For documentation purpose SP_ADEM003 is type as SP_ADEM003)-    6.    In order to create user the following report has to be executed A1S_IAM_CHECK_USERS.-    7.    If the data of the user is displayed which means user exits then there must be synchronization issue between backend and front end.-Then got to Logon Data, the following screen appears.-                      8.     Synchronization issue will there because no alias name maintained in user data as shown in the screenshot.-      9.     Select Edit  (In order to edit alias name select SAP By Design mode off in SU01 and proceed further )-                  10 .   Enter the alias name same as the user name (marked in yellow and select Save.-                       11.   Go to the user accounts in the cloud landscape in SPC enter the SID and client or tenant id for which incident was reported and select Synchronize user accounts and wait till Tenant user consistency status to turn green and close the incident once it is green.- Created by ByDMS-KB-IM-

Title: Error Occurs While Creating the Customs Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a tax code of your own and while creating a new customs invoice document with tax code which you have created, system throws the error message :-Tax code not valid for product tax on import-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the New Customs Invoice hyperlink under the Common Tasks.-In the opened window fill in the required fields and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab, select Add Row button enter the description, the tax code which you have created.-Select the Check button, system throws the error message.-Resolution-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign system, it is not possible to use the customized tax code in the Customs Invoice document. However, if you want to change the tax rate then it is possible to do so. You can change the tax rates in the fine tune activity Tax on Goods and Services -> Tax rate Schedules in Business Configuration work center.--Note : If you have defined the tax rates with the same tax type then the system will pick the tax rate which has been created recently i.e. if you have two tax rates A created on 01.01.2013 and created B created on 01.05.2013 then the system will pick the tax rate maintained for B.

Title: Released Customer Invoice Not Visible In Customer Account Monitor
Content: Symptom- You post a  customer invoice, however, the invoice is not visible in the Customer Account Monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Find the corresponding Invoice ID for the particular customer.-Status of Customer Invoice is Released.-Go to the Receivables work center.-In the Customer Accounts view, open the details of the particular customer.-Notice that the document entry for the Invoice is not available.-Cause-The customer invoice is Released but the corresponding journal entry is not available as the period in which the invoice is posted is blocked for accounting transaction.-You will be able to observe a task under Unposted Source Documents work center view.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Master Data view.-Select the Companies sub view.-Select the company ID and then choose Set Process Control.-Show 0-All Entries.-Click Add Row.-Maintain Process Control Status as 1-Not Blocked.-Select Business Process Group, for example, 02 Customer Invoicing.-Specify Entry Possible Until with a date in the future.-Maintain From Posting Date and the To Posting Date, and make sure the posting date of the Invoice is included.-Save and Close.-You should be able to successfully post the customer invoice from Unposted Source Documents view and now it will be available for selection in the Customer Account Monitor.-Keywords-customer invoice; customer account monitor; journal entry; set process control

Title: Incorrect Language When Previewing Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-When previewing a Sales Quote document, the language of the form template is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Open the required Sales Quote document.-Click Preview.-The document is displayed in an incorrect language instead of the expected language.-Cause-The issue occurs because no communication language is maintained for the Account associated with the Sales Quote. During document preview, the system determines the form template language based on the communication language defined in the Account Master Data under Main Communication Data.-  If the communication language is missing or not maintained correctly, the system cannot select the appropriate language-specific form template, resulting in the Sales Quote being previewed in an unexpected language.-  Maintaining the required communication language in the Account master data ensures that the Sales Quote preview is generated in the corresponding language.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Navigate to the Accounts view.-Search for and open the relevant account DEF (DEF represents the Bill-to Party of the Sales Quote).-Click View All.-Go to the General tab.-Under Main Communication Data, maintain the required Language.-Click Save.-Preview the Sales Quote again. The document will now be generated in the language maintained for the Account.-Keywords-Sales Quote; Form Template Language; Communication Language; Bill-to Party; Document Preview

Title: Expense Settlement Not Clearing from Deferred CoGS with Revenue Recognition
Content: Symptom-You have submitted an expense report for a project. After running the revenue recognition you notice that the journal entry posting to the Deferred Cost of Goods Sold account is not clearing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select Reports view.-Select the report Project Costs and Revenues by Project Structure.-Select the project XYZ in the variable screen.-You observe that for the Business Transaction Type - Expense Settlement there are incurred cost under deferred cost of goods sold - material.-Cause-There are two possible reasons:-If the expense report was taken back from Released for Reimbursement - the system will not include the deferred CoGS for clearance.-Corresponding Customer Project Expense Lists (CPEL) relating to the expense reports are not effectively posted and still show as  un-posted source documents when executing the revenue recognition run.- Resolution-Check if the expense report is in status Released during the revenue recognition run and that no relevant CPELs for the respective expense report are showing under Unposted Source Documents in the General Ledger work-center. If either applies - correct them and run the revenue recognition to clear the deferred cost of goods sold (DCoGS).

Title: Error: The BO Company Node Root with ID XZY does not exist
Content: Symptom-Error Message: The BO Company Node Root with ID XZY does not exist-is seen while migrating employee Data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Show: All Configuration Elements and find activity Migration of Employee Data - <Country>-Choose to migrate Personnel Administration data using the migration tool.-Upload the populated migration file.-Select the Execute Migration button and the Step by Step option from the drop down list.-Continue until the Simulation Phase.-Cause-The cause for the error is that the value specified in the field Company within the template is not and org unit flagged as a Company.-Resolution-You may correct the data replacing the field Company with a valid Org Unit that is defined as a Company in Organizational Management.

Title: How to Change the Tax Return Arrangement of a Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You have done a tax return to the tax authority; However, you notice that the wrong tax arrangement was selected as the tax run parameter.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view and select the respective tax return type (either VAT Returns or ES Sales Lists). Select your tax return.-On the Run Information section, click on the ID of the tax run.-On the tax return run screen, under Selection Criteria,  the Tax Return Arrangement ID is not the correct one.-Resolution-In order to change the tax arrangement, the tax return has to be re-generated from a new tax return run with the correct selection. In this case, the correction run would not be a feasible approach once both the return run and the correction run can only be done with the same tax arrangement and company. Therefore. the tax return has to be reversed a new a tax run created, as follows. -Go to Tax Management work center-Go to the Tax Returns view and select the sub-view according to the respective the tax return type.-Reverse/Delete the tax return, based on its status.-If the tax return has status in Preparation: Click Delete.-If the tax return is Reported: Click Reverse.-If the tax return is Completed:-The tax payment associated to the tax return has to be reversed.-Select the Completed tax return.-On the details section, click on the identifier of the tax payment on the Tax Payment ID field.-On the View All mode, click Reverse. This will set the status of the tax payment and payment order to Canceled. The associated tax return is set to Reported.-Reverse the related tax return.-Create a new tax return run with the correct tax arrangement for the same period.-After the tax return run is executed, a new In Preparation tax return is created with the correct tax return arrangement.

Title: Fail to Create Material by Using Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You fail to create material by using excel. System displays an error The Remote Server Returned an Error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Product Data-Go to view Materials-Click New->Material from Microsoft Excel-Upload fails with error The Remote Server Returned an Error-Cause-In the backend, by using the transaction "srt_util", you can see the statement being logged: "RBAM: No authorization for 'InterfacePattern <default> CREATE' on 'BONodeProxy <default> PDM_MATERIAL <default> ROOT'". This indicates you have no write access for view Material in work center Product Data.-Resolution-To set write access to Unrestricted, do below steps:-Go to work center Application and User Management-Go to view Business Users-Find your user ID and select button Edit->Access Rights-Go to tab Access Restrictions-Find view ID PMM_MATERIALS (Materials), work center ID PMM_PRODUCTDATA (Product Data), set write access to Unrestricted

Title: Shopping Cart Approval. Reporting Line Unit Manager does not Receive Approval Tasks
Content: Symptom-An approval task for Shopping Cart is not routed to the relevant Organizational Unit Manager. In the approval process for shopping carts, you have previously selected the Work Distribution: Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager.-Cause-The Valid To date for the Organizational Unit Manager is expired.-Resolution-Go to the work center Organizational Management.-Go to the view Org Structures.-Find the relevant org unit of the manager.-Go to the tab Timelines.-Find the Attribute Organizational Unit Manager.-Verify that the Valid To is expired.-If so, select the Common Task Edit Org Structures and change the validity.

Title: How to Hide or Remove, Ship-to Field from Customer Invoicing Form Template?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to hide or remove Ship-to field from your Customer Invoice form but there is no option to hide this field in Easy Form Editor. The only option you could find for this field is Show Always.-Resolution-Basically the field Ship-To is mandatory for Customer Invoice hence it is not possible hide or remove this field in Easy Form Editor.-But, you have remove or hide this field using Adobe LifeCycle Designer tool. The steps are,-1. Go to Application & User Management work center.-2. Go to Form Template Maintenance view under Business Flexibility.-3. Search and find the Customer Invoice form template.-4. Download the form template (or) edit directly using - Open -> Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer-5 In the ALD tool, find the fields and go to Object Palette.-6. Change the Presence as Invisible.-7. To delete the field: go to the Hierarchy in the left side.-8. Find the fields and right click.-9. Press Delete.-10. Save the .XDP file template.-11. Publish the form template.-

Title: The Sales Order XYZ Has Not Been Updated by the Customer Invoice ABC and Still with Status in Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Sales Order XYZ has not been updated by the Customer Invoice ABC and still with status in Process.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Edit the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the sales order).-The sales order has been fully delivered and invoiced however the status still shown as In Process.-Cause-The message from CI to SO was not processed successfully.-Resolution-A. Search in SRT_MONI if you find any failed message-You can then restart the failed message.-B. Check if you can trigger a reconciliation-Go to the Test Shell (SESFTS)-Open the Sales Order XYZ-Navigate to the Node : BTD Reference-Look for the Node with the following details :-BTD_REF-ID-CONTENT :     ID of of the customer invoice-BTD_REF-UUID-CONTENT : UUID of the customer invoice-BTD_REF-TYPE_CODE :      28 (Customer Invoice type code)-In case the customer invoice ABC is not maintained as a BTD reference a reconciliation between CI and SO can fix the issue. However if the if the BTD reference already exists, the inbound agent from CI to SO does not support reconciliation, you would need to send the incident to development.-C. In case it is an old business document-You are not able to find the XI message to reconcile.-You can use the following report :-apci_tst_trigger_recon_opa (check with your topic owner before using this report)

Title: Error Message "Academic Title XYZ is not Available" While Uploading Contacts Using MS Excel
Content: Symptom-When you try upload Contacts using MS Excel, system throw below error message:-Academic Title XYZ is not Available-or-The 'AcademicTitleCode' element is invalid. The value XYZ is invalid according to its datatype. The actual length is greater than the MaxLength value-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Contacts view.-Select New button and choose Contacts from Microsoft Excel®.-Enter the details and upload using SAP Excel Add-in-Cause-The cause for the exception or above error messages while uploading the Contacts through MS Excel is that, for the Columns Title or Academic Title, the values are provided on your own instead of choosing it from the drop down.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, there are two possible options:-1. Select the values from the drop down for these two fields.-Example 1: When you select the drop down for Title, you can find 2 options 0002 - Mr. and 0001 - Ms.. These two are the valid options.-Example 2: When you select the drop down for Academic Title, you can field 6 options 0003 - Prof. Dr., 0006 - Ph.D., 0004 - B.A., 0002 - Prof., 0001 - Dr. and 0005 - MBA. These six are the valid options.-or--2. You can create new values for these fields in the system and then the values can be selected in the excel for the Contacts and the excel can be uploaded into your system.--The steps are,--a. Go to Business Configuration work center.-b. Go to Implementation Projects view or Overview view.-c. Search and Open the activity General Business Partners.-d. Select Maintain Academic Titles link, where you can add new Academic Titles.-e. Select Maintain Titles link, where you can add new Titles.-f. Now, export the excel for Contacts and maintain the data.-g. Upload the excel (Save Data To) into the system.

Title: Not Possible to Merge Duplicated Master Data
Content: Symptom-You want to merge duplicated master data in your system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center-Select Suppliers/Accounts/Contacts/Service Agent/Business Partners view-You want to merge the duplicated data in only one. e.g: Supplier ID XYZ and Supplier ID ZYX are the same supplier and you want to keep only one in the system.- Cause-The data is duplicated because it was created without using the functionality Check for Duplicates.-Resolution-Is not possible to merge the duplicated master data in only one and also is not possible to delete the data. As workaround to leave just one business partner active in your system you can set the duplicated data to obsolete.-Go to Business Partner Data Work Center-Select Suppliers/Accounts/Service Agent/Business Partners view-Edit the master data you want to set to obsolete.-Press the Actions button and select the Set to Obsolete option.-To avoid duplicated data in your system you can use the option Check for Duplicates when creating a new Supplier/Account/Service Agent/Business Partner/Contact- See Also-For further information about Check for Duplicates functionality, please see the help document Business Partner Duplicate Check.

Title: Mobile reports not available in Excel Add-In
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to open a report using SAP Business ByDesing Add-In you will not be able to find any mobile reports in the list.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the MS Excel and go to the SAP Business ByDesign tab;-Click on Logon and type in the URL to your system and your user credentials;-Click on Insert Report and search for a mobile based report that exists in your system;-You will not be able to find the report in this list.-Cause-Reports that are assigned to mobile will not be available to report inside the SAP Business ByDesign Excel Add-In, they will be only available on the mobile app for iOS/Android/Blackberry devices.-Resolution-In order to make a mobile report available in the Business ByDesign Excel Add-In, you should create a copy of the report and uncheck the box Enable for Mobile Device.

Title: "Import Your Organizational Structure Copied from Test System" Link is Missing in Productive System
Content: Symptom-You are in the Productive system and observed that the link Import Your Organizational Structure Copied from Test System is missing in Business Configuration.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button of the respective project.-Go to Prepare phase.-Open Perform Organizational Structure Setup activity.-Here the link Import Your Organizational Structure Copied from Test System is missing.-Cause-The link Import Your Organizational Structure Copied from Test System is available in a productive system only if the productive system is requested out of a Test system.--If the Test system is requested out of a Productive System then the link Import Your Organizational Structure Copied from Test System will not be available.-Resolution-The system works as designed.

Title: Supplier payment terms in multiple installments
Content: Symptom-You are trying to configure payment terms for suppliers of the following type: a fixed percentage paid upon receipt and another fixed percentage after a certain amount of time.-Cause-It is not possible to use the payment terms configuration for this; a payment term only specifies the discount rate for payments made in a certain amount of time.-Resolution-In order to achieve the desired behavior, you can follow the steps below:-Go to the Payables work center-Go to the Suppliers > Supplier Accounts view-Select a supplier and click on View-Select the Trade Payables > Invoices / Payments tab-Select a payment and click on Actions > Split Open Item-Add a new row and enter a percentage for the invoice amount; for the first percentage, specify an immediate due date and, for the second, the due date required.-This has to be done manually for each invoice you want to pay using installments.

Title: Error Message "Operation not possible; perm. estblmt. referenced by material ABC"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to activate an Org Unit XYZ, system throws below error message:-Operation not possible; perm. estblmt. referenced by material ABC-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Org Structures in Common Tasks.-Activate the Org Unit XYZ or activate the Org Structure.-Cause-The cause for the issue is, you attempted to delete an org unit whose respective Business Residence/Planning Area is assigned to a Material which is active.-Resolution-This is error messages can be ignored and hence, please get the approval from customer to activate the Org Unit by bypassing this error message in the backend and forward the incident to Expert Support Foundation.

Title: Error: "Work agreement XYZ/001 already exists; unique ID required"
Content: Symptom-The above error is encountered for individual records when migrating Personnel Administration Data.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Change Project.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Search and find activity Migration of Employee Data - <Country>.-Hyperlink: Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool.-Upload the populated migration template and Execute Migration.-In case there are no change projects open, access the concerned activity by searching in the Overview view of Business Configuration work center and select the Change Immediately button.-Cause-The cause for this error message is that for the respective records, the employee's Personnel File is already updated with the Work Agreement, Organizational Assignment in the system and it is not possible to migrate the Personnel Administration Data for the employees whose data was already updated in the system.-To verify the Personnel File of the employee, please follow the below steps:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Select the employee XYZ.-Select the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employment tab.-Here you can find the Work Agreement and Organizational Assignment sub-tabs.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.

Title: Notes Description of any Activity is Truncating
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add the Description in the Notes of any activity but the Description is truncating to certain length.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select an available Project and select Open Activity List button.-Highlight any Activity and select Actions button and choose Add or Edit Notes option.-Maintain Description for some length (more than two lines).-Select Save button.- Cause-The field Description can have only a maximum of 256 characters and any characters more than 256 will be truncated.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-We will enhance the screen with the warning/error message when more than 256 characters are entered.

Title: How to Verify Which Business Process Variant Type (BPVT) for Leads is Used in the System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to check which Business Process Variant Type (BPVT) has been selected by the customer.-Reproducing the Issue-The customer experience issues with leads and you need to verify which BPVT has been selected in scoping.-Cause-Once the customer change scoping option, different BPVT would be activated.-Resolution-In the frontend:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 3 Scoping.-Expand the following Scoping Elements:-Marketing > Marketing Development > Lead Generation > tick the box to activate the BPVT Lead Generation.-Sales > New Business > Lead Management > tick the box to activate the BPVT Lead Generation.-In the backend :-Go to SE16.-Enter table : BPVTC_PVT_ACTIVE.-Enter 15 to check if the scenario with Leads with Handover has been selected.-Enter 255 to check if the scenario with Leads without Handover has been selected.

For Example: Nielsen ID.-Resolution-In order to update/add a value in a field which is in General sheet of Accounts, then you can Mass Change Account Data functionality.-1. Go to Account Management work center.-2. Select Mass Change Account Data under Common Tasks.-3. Add the respective Accounts in the Worklist and move to next step.-4. Then Finish the Mass Change.-Note: It is not possible to use Migration to enhance a field which is in General tab.

Title: How to Enable the Add-on Point of Sales Integration
Content: Symptom-You have installed the add-on Point-of-Sales via SAP Store and now you need enable it in the scope of your project, but you don't know how to do it.-Resolution-Once the deployment of Add-on Point of Sales is completed, the scope option Point-Of-Sale will be available in your implementation project.-To activate it follow the steps below-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Select Implementation Projects view-Edit the scope of your project-Go to step Scoping-Expand the option Sales-Expand the option Customer Invoicing-Select Point-of-Sale-Complete the project setup

Title: Not able to assign International Time Account to employee
Content: Symptom-You have hired an employee through the non-localized tab, however it is not possible to assign the International Time Accounts to them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the relevant employee.-Edit.-Go to Time Profile tab.-Go to Time Account Rules subtab.-Click Add Row.-You will see 'No items found' message.-Cause-Although you have hired this employee through one of the options in the non-localized dropdown, the country you selected is actually a localized country in SAP Business ByDesign.-This dropdown is the same one used in every country/region selection in the system, so all countries are displayed - not only the non-localized ones.-Each localized country has its own specific Time Accounts, and it is not possible to make the International Time Accounts available for employees from localized countries (even if this country is not scoped in your tenant).-Below is the list of localized countries in SAP Business ByDesign. If the employee is hired in one of these countries, the Time Accounts for this respective country must be used - it is worth noting that they will only be available if this country is scoped in the tenant.-Australia-Austria-Belgium-Canada-China-Denmark-France-Germany-India-Israel-Italy-Japan-Mexico-Netherlands-New Zealand-South Africa-South Korea-Spain-Switzerland-United Kingdom-United States-Resolution-You need to use the Time Accounts which are specific to a localized country. If the employee is indeed hired in a non-localized region, the International Time Accounts will then be available.-Keywords-time accounts international, not able to assign time accounts, time accounts not working, no records found

Title: Time Account Balances not Calculated
Content: Symptom-The Time Account Balances for one or multiple employees and a specific time type are not calculated, although all settings seem to be correct and a posting order is maintained.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Select relevant employee -Go to Employee Times tab-Find time records with affected time type-Go to Time Account Balances tab-Find associated time account without any of the above mentioned times being reflected-   Resolution-The situation might be caused by the following issue: A special posting order is maintained. However, the posting order start date is a date that is subsequent to the date of the first time recording. E.g., times are recorded on 01.01.2023, and the start date is 01.01.2024. Hence, the posting order is not working as expected and does not consider the times-See Also-Correct the posting order start date to a date before the time of the first time recording. Afterwards, perform a correction day closure run for the affected employees, with a start early enough to include the affected times.-Keywords-missing, not considered, counted, incorrect

Title: How to Change Report Download Name
Content: Symptom-Request to change the downloaded report name  "SAPAnalyticsReport(XXXXXX)"  to actual report name, where "XXXXXX" standards for report ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The name of a downloaded report cannot be changed, as the report ID is always unique. Hence, the report ID is shown in the file details.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. Report Name can be same and to avoid confusion, it shows report ID in the subject details.-Keywords-SAPAnalyticsReport(XXXXXX); report name; report ID

Title: Error "Replication Failed for Remote Employee from System" While Replicating Employee
Content: Symptom-User is receiving error "Replication failed for remote employee from system" while replicating employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Go to Employees view-Search for particular employee -Replicate again-Error message "Replication failed for remote employee from system" occurs- Cause-The user is deleted from SuccessFactors without successful replication to ByDesign. -Resolution-In order to proceed with the replication, the employee needs to be active in SuccessFactors. If the employee has been deleted, the replication does not flow to ByDesign-Keywords-Replication failed; employee deleted; SuccessFactors; Replication failed for remote employee from system;

Title: Extension Field in Task Control is Greyed Out
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field for Task Control Confirmation - Input Products, however when opening the confirmation screen you can see that the field cannot be edited.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Enter the Task Control View.-Select one of the tasks from the list.-Click on the Confirm button.-Enter the sub-tab Input Products.-Here the field can be seen, however cannot be changed.-Cause-The extension field is created/extended to the incorrect Business Context. In order to have the field editable, it needs to be in the PRODUCTION LOT - MATERIAL_INPUT context.-Resolution-You can check this by following the below steps:-Follow the steps described in the Steps to Reproduce section of this KBA.-Click on the avatar icon on the top right of the page.-Click on Key User Settings.-Click on Start Adaptation Mode.-Right-click on the extension field.-Click on the +Extension Fields button.-At the top of the pop-up that appears, you can see the business context.-In order to have the field in the correct context, you can either change the context and create a new field or extend an existing field to the PRODUCTION LOT - MATERIAL_INPUT context.-Keywords-KUT, PDI, Further Usage, Production

Title: Error "File validation failed. Create an incident" While Performing the Migration for Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When users are enhancing customer master data using the migration activity and receive the below mentioned error in the validation step:-"File validation failed. Create an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center.- Select Overview view.- Search and open Migration of Customers activity.- Select Migrate Customers Using the Migration Tool.- Upload the Migration Template using upload option.- Select Execute Migration.-System shows the error as mentioned in the symptom.-Cause-There could be many possible causes for this issue, one of the reasons is duplicate records existing in source record.-For Example:-Account ID         First Name  Last Name-000                    ABC            XYZ    -000                    ABC            XYZ    -(Here 000 is an Account ID, ABC and XYZ is first name and last name)-Resolution-Verify the data in the migration template and remove the duplicate records from source file and execute the migration.-Keywords-Migration of Customers, File Validation Fail, contacts, duplicate

Title: Error Message "Price Calculation ended with error, for details check log/report incident" Occurs When You Execute The Webservice CalculatePriceIn.
Content: Symptom-The webservice call for CalculatePriceIn web service runs into error message "Price Calculation ended with error, for details check log/report incident " when you try to calculate the price from a extension field based price list.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-You create a CalculatePriceIn call to check the pricing for extension field based Price List  with below sample request:-<n0:CalculatePricesRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">- <CalculatePricesRequest>-  <Application>2</Application>-  <CurrencyCode>USD</CurrencyCode>-   <Item>-       <ID>1</ID>-       <ProductID>XXXXXXX</ProductID>-       <ProductTypeCode>1</ProductTypeCode>-       <Quantity unitCode="EA">1</Quantity>-       <QuantityTypeCode>EA</QuantityTypeCode>-       -  <n1:HeaderExtension xmlns:n1="http://sap.com/xi/AP/CustomerExtension/BYD/ZZZZZ">String 66</n1:HeaderExtension>- </CalculatePricesRequest>-</n0:CalculatePricesRequest_sync>-You receive 0 value returns for the items and the following:-<Log>-<MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>3</MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>-<Item>-<SeverityCode>3</SeverityCode>-<Note>Price Calculation ended with error, for details check log/report incident</Note>-</Item>-</Log> -Note: The above mentioned data is a sample data only.-Cause-You have enabled the extension field which is defined at the header level to both the services Calculate Price - Price List and Calculate Price - Price Specification.-For example, If the extension field in Sales Order is in General tab, then use extension scenario CRM Pricing (Header) and the service Calculate Price – Price List.-If the field is in Sales Order is in Item tab, then use extension scenario CRM Pricing (Item) and the service Calculate Price – Price Specification.-Resolution-Kindly remove the extension field from the service Calculate Price – Price Specification and you will be able to get the correct results.-Keywords-CalculatePriceIn; Extension field; Error;

Title: Cost Rate Appears Zero for all Employees Under Work tab of Project Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a project with service item however the cost rate appears zero in the project task despite labor resource cost rate is maintained. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project-Select the Project task-Go to Project Plan tab and navigate to Work tab-For all the Employees, the cost rate appears zero-Cause-You have not maintained the planned work. It is necessary to enter the planned work for system to calculate the cost rate. System will try to fetch the cost rate based on planned work and based on labor resource cost rate. If resource cost rate is not maintained, then system will check for service cost rate. This is an expected behavior. -Resolution-In order to fix the problem, it is mandatory to enter the Planned work under work tab of project and make sure resource cost is maintained for all the team members. -Note - If you do not update planned work, cost rate will not be calculated despite the actual work is captured. -Keywords-Cost Rate Appears Zero for all Employees Under Work tab of Project Document; Cost Rate Appears Zero in Project Document;

Title: An internal error occurred. For error details check MPL ID XXXX In 3PL Business Communication Monitoring
Content: Symptom-- A technical error is displayed when executing 3PL outbound delivery requests.-- No further details are visible under the Message Details section.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-2. Go to the Common Tasks view and select the Business Communication Monitoring sub-view.-3. Under the section Messages with Errors, observe the Standard outbound 3PL Requests with Status technical Error.-4. Note that no further details are visible under the Message Details section.-The error message : An internal error occurred. For error details check MPL ID XXXX in message monitoring or use the URL https://eYYYY-tmn.hci.eu1.hana.ondemand.com directly access the error information. can be identified at SAP side-***Where XXXX represents the message ID in Cloud Integration and YYYY represents the Cloud Integration tenant number*** -Cause-This integration scenario has failed due to an issue with the authorization check.-Resolution-Please ensure the below three settings have been checked:-Ensure the username and password/client certificates maintained in the Cloud Integration's Integration Flow are maintained correctly for the authorization check to succeed.-Ensure the Cloud Integration client certificates are correctly maintained in STRUST on your ERP system.-Map the client certificates to the Integration user in ERP.-If all the above settings are correct, please collect an ICM trace to find the real root cause of the issue, to do so, please carry out the following steps:-Execute transaction RZ11.-Adjust parameter icm/trace_secured_data to the value TRUE (this parameter is dynamic and no downtime or restart is required for its adjustment).-*This is only applicable to HTTPS, for all other traffic please skip to step 6*-Execute transaction SMICM.-You are advised to reset the ICM trace file, to do so, select Goto > Trace File > Reset.-*It is not mandatory to reset the ICM trace file ,however it is recommended to do so to prevent the ICM trace file you are about to generate from being unnecessarily large.*-Set the ICM trace level to 3, to do so, select Goto > Trace > Level > 3.-Reproduce the issue once more.-Execute transaction SMICM.-Set the ICM trace back to level 1, to do so,  select Goto > Trace > Level > 1.-Display the newly generated ICM trace, to do so , select Goto > Trace File > Display All.-Save the ICM trace file to a local file, to do so , Type '%pc' or navigate to System > List > Save > Local File > Unconverted.-As per step one , readjust parameter icm/trace_secured_date to the value FALSE.-The Purpose of carrying out an ICM trace is to analyze the data stream to and from the SAP Web Application Server. The HTTP data traffic is regulated by the Internet Communication Manager (ICM).The resulting trace file will enable you to categorically identify the exact issue , as it will display the exact certificate which is causing the problem within the flow of traffic. Following this you will be able to compare and contrast the certificate chain maintained by your basis team on the  system and also on the Cloud Integration tenant.-See Also-2547679 - Internal Error Occurred Check MPL ID XXXXXX in C4C Message Monitoring-- SAP Business ByDesign Documentation-- SAP Cloud Tenant Documentation-Keywords

Title: When User Navigates To Competitor Product Finds Competitor Product Overview is Blank
Content: Symptom-The competitor product overview is blank when the user navigates to a competitor product from competitor overview-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Marketing work center-Go to competitors view-Select any competitor (which has products maintained) -In Competitor Overview , select any of the competitor product ID-Navigate to the competitor product data-As you enter the Competitor Product Overview, the view is empty-Cause-This issue is scheduled to be resolved in a future release of our software.-Resolution-As a workaround you can follow one of the below,--1. Instead of navigating on competitor product directly from competitor overview, follow below steps:-Go to Marketing work center-Go to competitors view-Select any competitor (which has products maintained) -Go to view all-Navigate to Competitor Products tab-Choose the product ID.-The Competitor product overview has data-2. Search for the competitor product from the 'Competitor Products' Work center view, user can find  the competitor product details -Go to Marketing work center-Go to competitor products view-Search for competitor product-The Competitor product overview has data-See Also-Competitors Quick Guide- https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2ddce42e722d101488d89b516fc6701e.html?q=Competitor%20Product%20Overview-Keywords-Competitor Product Overview, Marketing , blank, competitor products, competitor overview

Title: Intercompany In-Transit View Error
Content: Symptom-- Intercompany In-transit stock continues to be displayed even after the delivery process has been completed.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-2. Go to the Common Tasks view and select the sub-view Intercompany In-Transit.-3. The outbound delivery appears as In-transit even though the delivery process has been completed.-Cause-- The product was sent with a serial number and received without a serial number. As a result, the product with the serial number remains in-transit as it was never received.-Resolution-1. Perform adjustment confirmation in the inbound delivery document.-2. Update the serial number for the product in the inbound delivery. This will resolve the stock In-transit issue.--Note: Before making the recommended changes, please perform the changes on a similar scenario in your test system. Once you are convinced that the system has updated as per your expectations, move the recommended changes to the production system.-See Also-- N/A-Keywords

Title: You Are Not Able to Change Tax Code in Sales Order Item Line
Content: Symptom-You want to change the tax code in a sales order line and find the tax code field is read only. You are not able to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Sales Orders.-Choose the view Sales Orders.-Search for Sales Order XXX (XXX represents sales order ID).-Open the order and go to View All.-Navigate to tab Items and sub-tab Taxes.-Here it can be seen that the tax details are greyed out and you cannot change tax code.-Cause-The invoice status of the sales order item line is In Process. This means there is invoice created for the order line already. In this case, tax code is not changeable, it is read only.  The tax code is changeable only when the invoice status is Not Started.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-2628525 - Unable to edit tax code in sales order-Keywords-tax code; read only; not editable; sales order; change; grayed out.

Title: Price Component Overall Discount Percentage Disappears After you Enter the Discount in the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order with the price component overall discount percentage, however it disappears after you insert in the Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase requests and orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view -Search for relevant purchase order-Select Edit button-Go to Price and cost tab at header level-Click on Add Row under price component-Select overall discount percentage and it disappears-Cause-When you create a Purchase Order by adding the price component Overall Discount (Percent) and system creates a new entry. Once you select the price component, the price component moves to the top list. In fact the new row just disappears but not the price component. -Resolution-The price component Overall Discount (Percent) moves up in the list and there you can enter the Overall Discount percentage. -Keywords-Price Component Overall Discount Percentage Disappears After you Enter the Discount in the Purchase Order; Price Component Overall Discount Percentage Disappears

Title: Inconsistency in 3PL outbound delivery: Identified stock of line item * and 3PL request item * must match
Content: Symptom-There is a document flow from purchase order, 3PL inbound delivery to Return to Supplier and 3PL outbound delivery. However, the 3PL outbound delivery is inconsistent due to error: Identified stock of line item * and 3PL request item * must match.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Third-Party Logistics.-Access view Outbound Deliveries.-Select outbound delivery ABC (ABC represents outbound delivery ID), click Edit.-Click button Check Consistency, error triggered: Identified stock of line item XYZ and 3PL request item XYZ must match. (XYZ represents line item ID)-Cause-In third-party logistics return to supplier scenario, for 3PL return to supplier delivery, its product - identified stock combination should match with that in related 3PL inbound delivery.-Resolution-Check related line item in corresponding 3PL inbound delivery, find the identified stock, then maintain the same identified stock for the same product in 3PL return to supplier delivery. Check consistency again, no error will be triggered.-Keywords-Third-Party Logistics, 3PL, Return to Supplier, Outbound Delivery, Identified Stock, Line Item, Match

Title: The Displayed Name for the IT Contact is Incorrect
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-After including the IT contact information for an  employee ABC, there is a discrepancy in the name, as it conflicts with that of another employee, XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work center.-Go to Contact Details view.-Select Create Contact Assignment button.-Select the Contact type.-Fill form with the require information.-Select Send Changes and Close button-The displayed name is of another user.-Cause-The IT contact name was reflecting from the ICP system, and it is updated with employee name 'XYZ'.-Resolution-Verify the Personal Administration Data (PAD) for employees to identify any duplicate entries or instances where the same email is maintained.-If all information is maintained correctly, send it to the SRD-CC-CI-CCS development team. Title: How the Warranty Reference Date is Determined in the Registered Product
Content: Symptom-You want to know, how system determines the Warranty Reference Date in the registered product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Registered Products view.-Open a registered product, you can see the Warrant Reference Data is filled. You want to know how this date is determined.-Resolution-Generally, the warranty reference date in the registered product is taken from the creation date. -If you manually create a new registered product, the current system date is used as Warranty Reference Date.-If the registered product is created via outbound delivery, the shipment date is used as Warrant Reference Date.-You still have chance to modify the warranty reference date, so the warranty start date is getting updated accordingly.-Keywords-registered product; warranty reference date; determination; calculation.

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom--User has a requirement to be able to make changes to quantity before performing post goods issue via Integration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Select the required Delivery Proposal ID.-Choose Post Goods Issue option.-Here actual quantity can be changed and updated.-However user wants to do integration where they wany to change the quantity before PGI which is not possible as this field is read-only.-Further go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the OData Services and select Custom OData services.-Select required data services created.-Here under functions, PGI is read only.-Cause-Currently, this Quantity field is not available for editing either via using the Odata service / webservices.-Resolution-Update user to post query in Influence Forum via below link:--Customer Influence Forum, at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-   Keywords-PGI, Odata service, post goods issue, change in actual quantity, integration.

Title: Error Message "You have already requested a restore point for this system" While Creating the Restore Point
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Error message "You have already requested a restore point for this system" when creating the restore point-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center-Go to Systems view-Choose Restore point button-Choose Request restore point -You receive the error message "You have already requested a restore point for this system"-Cause-An old request which was created has not been deleted -Resolution-Checklist 1: Create an incident with operation team and check if there is any old request present in the system , if it is available then operation team can delete it.-Checklist 2: If there is no old request present in the system then you can create an development incident with component SRD-CC-CI-CCS to resolve the case-Keywords-Restore point, service control center

Title: Missing Account Assignment Type During the Creation of a Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-During the creation of a Supplier Invoice, you noticed that some account assignments types are missing in the dropdown list box.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Create invoice without purchase order-Fill in mandatory information and navigate to items tab Cost distribution sub-tab-Under Account Assignment, enter the G/L Account-In the Account Assignment Type, click the dropdown list box. You notice that some types are missing -Cause-Missing configuration-Resolution-Maintain the required Account Assignment Type under Business Configuration work center -> Mandatory Account Assignment activity -> Edit Mandatory Account Assignments for Account Determination Groups for the G/L Account determination group.-Keywords-Account Assignment Type, Supplier Invoice, Cost Distribution

Title: Unable to navigate to Concur Expense Report Source Document
Content: Symptom-In the Journal Entry for Expense Report you see the link for the Source Document for the Expense Report. When you click on this Source Document it does not open the document details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Expenses.-Search and find Report Key: XYZ (XYZ represents the Expense Report Key ID).-Select View -> Journal Entry -Source Document ID: XYZ is a hyperlink-Select the link-Error Appears: -Navigation to external source doc. from system xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxx not supported.- Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-The expense report is a Concur Expense Report.-The source document was created in Concur.
