Title: How to find the changes done in the Fine-Tuning Settings in SAP Business ByDesign & SAP Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-You see there is a changes done to one of the Fine-Tuning Settings and you want to see who and when these changes are done.-Example:-Changes are made to Email & Fax Settings activity, where the E-Mail settings are changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Overview.-Search for Email & Fax Settings activity.-Click the link E-mail and Fax Settings.-Under Emails section, you find there was a change.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to find the details of the changes done to the Fine-Tuning Settings in your system:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Reports view.-In the new window, open the Configuration Change History Report.-Navigate to the Tab Fine-Tuning Settings.-Select relevant drop-down.-Find the Fine-Tuning Activity in our case will find for the E-Mail and Fax Settings, if there are changes, list will have the entry for this activity and relevant details will be displayed accordingly in the Details section.-You can Download the Change Details, this will give you the details on when the changes done and by whom these changes are done.-Keywords-Email & Fax Settings, Fine-Tuning Settings, Configuration Change History, Report, byd, c4c

Title: Incorrect payment method Reflecting during employee replication
Content: Symptom-When replicating information for new employees from SuccessFactors, it has been observed that the payment method data in SuccessFactors indicates "Bank transfer," but upon replication in ByD, it appears as "Check.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master data replication work center-Select Employee List Reports-Search for the affected employee and select Edit-Go to Personal Data-Select Payment Information-Under payment method it shows as check -Cause-Future Valid "From Date" is set for the payment information of an employee during replication in Success Factors.-Resolution-The payment method information for an employee is effective from the date that is entered in the Valid From field.-In this scenario, you are making the payment method as Bank Transfer payment before the validity starts, hence the system is picking the default value i.e. Check.-For example, the Valid From Date for Bank Transfer is set to 10.01.2024 but you are trying to do the bank payment on 29.12.2023.-This has to be verified and corrected in Success factor system.-Note : The information is accessible in SuccessFactors, request a screenshot of the changes made to the payment information from customer.-Keywords-Payment Method, Payment Information, Check, Bank transfer, Success factors, Replication

Title: Invalid Production Model is Proposed as Source of Supply When Create New Production Order
Content: Symptom-When creating new production order through common task New Production Order, you find system proposes invalid production model.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access common task New Production Order.-Maintain Product, Site, and Quantity.-Press Enter button on the keyboard, you can see REM A is proposed in Source of Supply ID.-Check in work center Planning and Production Master Data view Production Models, for this product, there are two production models A and B. A has a past date as Valid to while B has a future date in Valid to.-Cause-Though you have changed valid to date in the master data of production model A, but didn't release it yet. Only after the model is released and the maintained valid to date reflects in the latest released execution model, will the maintained valid to date being considered in new production order creation.-Resolution-Please release production model A and try creating new production order again.-Keywords-Production Order, Valid to, REM, Source of Supply, Invalid

Title: Dereferencing of the NULL reference
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Use SOAP UI to create supplier invoice with reference to a purchase order, but get error: "Web service processing error; more details in the web service error log on provider side" in the response.-Go to backend and check the error details, the error text is "Dereferencing of the NULL reference".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view.-Download WSDL for service ManageSupplierInvoiceIn.-Open a new project for it in SOAP UI.-Input payload for request and run it.-Get error in the response: Web service processing error; more details in the web service error log on provider side.-Go to backend via SRT_UTIL.-Click on Error Log.-Double click on the latest relevant error.-See the error text is "Dereferencing of the NULL reference".-Cause-Need to check the payload. Although it is well-formed, it contains certain content that system cannot refer to.-One possible cause is that in the request payload, below section is used by mistake:-----------------------------------------------------------<SupplierInvoiceReference actionCode="01">-    <BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-    <TypeCode>004</TypeCode>-    <ID>XXXX</ID>-    <ItemID>MM</ItemID>-    <ItemTypeCode>18</ItemTypeCode>-   </BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-</SupplierInvoiceReference>-----------------------------------------------------------<SupplierInvocieReference actionCode="01"></SupplierInvocieReference> is used when referring to a supplier invoice, not a purchase order. Besides, ID XXXX stands for the purchase order ID. Therefore, system cannot find this document as reference. -Resolution-Since the target is to create a supplier invoice based on a purchase order, it is necessary to use the below section:-----------------------------------------------------------<PurchaseOrderReference actionCode="01">-    <BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-    <TypeCode>004</TypeCode>-    <ID>XXXX</ID>-    <ItemID>MM</ItemID>-    <ItemTypeCode>18</ItemTypeCode>-   </BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-</PurchaseOrderReference>-----------------------------------------------------------Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Purchase Order; SOAP UI; Web Service

Title: Unable to Create Serialized Labels
Content: Symptom-Under labels user is trying the function "generate serial numbers" however it doesn't work.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to production control-common tasks-labels.-Choose New labels-add row-enter the relevant details of the product.-Under Label type Select: Serialized Product and add the number of labels as per requirement-Now under the Serial numbers tab, add the name under Next Serial Numbers.-Choose create serial numbers, you notice no serial numbers are created with labels.-Cause-No Serial number assignment profile is maintained in the product master data General tab-Resolution-Maintain the relevant serial number profile.-    1.Go to Product Portfolio - Products.-    2.Select the relevant product and choose edit and view all.-    3.Under the General tab Serial Number Profile field maintain the relevant profile.-  Keywords-Serial number, Create Serial Numbers, new labels, labels, serialized Product

Title: Wrong Sort Order in the OutboundDeliveryExecutionRequest Items
Content: Symptom-In a 3PL scenario OutboundDeliveryExecutionRequest Document ID KLM has the items in wrong order it starts at the highest Line item ID  and ends with the smallest line item ID.(KLM refers to 3PL Request ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Third-Party Logistics Work Center-Go to 3PL Requests View-Search for KLM and Select Edit-Go to Document Flow-Open Outgoing Outbound Delivery Execution Request KLM-View all-Show Payload-You can find the line items are in descending order.-Cause-In relation to the payload sent by the B2B outbound process agent to the 3PL provider, there is currently no exit in the B2B outbound agent to control the data being populated or the sequence in which it gets populated.-Resolution- This is the current designed behaviour of the system.-Keywords-Wrong Sort order, OutboundDeliveryExecutionRequest, Item, web service, 3PL, Document ID, items,wrong order, it starts at the highest Line item ID and ends with the smallest line item ID

Title: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data Activity is Getting Stuck at 1% With Error "File Validation Failed. Create an Incident'
Content: Symptom-User trying to migrate accounting transaction data but File Validation Stuck at 1% and system throws validation failed error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center view.-Navigate to overview tab.-Select "Migration of Accounting transaction Data" Activity.-Choose the file affected by the issue.-Execute Migration.-Execute Migration Step by Step.-Migration is stuck at 1% and system throws error "File Validation Failed. Create an Incident" -Cause-Mandatory fields are not updated in source file.-Resolution-User has to make the data consistent by updating all the mandatory fields in source file ,so that data validation run successfully when migration is executed.-Keywords-Validation stuck, mandatory fields, migration stuck, migration unsuccessful, validation unsuccessful

Title: The System Information Does not Display the "Valid To" Date
Content: Symptom-You want to know the System's validity. However, the system information only shows the "Active From" date and not the "Active To" date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center-Go to Systems View-Select the system you want to know the information-In the details, only the "Active From" date is visible; the "Active To" date field is empty.- Cause-There is no expiration date concept specifically for the tenant.-Resolution-The "Active From/To" field within the tenant's information provides clarity on the timeframe during which a specific tenant was operational, even after its termination, particularly relevant for decommissioned tenants. The allocation of tenants and their corresponding license usage is determined by the licenses acquired in the contract.-Users can access these specifics in SAP4Me using their key user ID or alternatively, they can contact their Customer Experience (CE) representatives for assistance in obtaining this information. -Keywords-System Validity, Active To, Active From

Title: HTML Mashup Preview Displays An Error: Refused To Connect
Content: Symptom-User has created an HTML Mashup in Mashup Authoring, but when previewed, the system displays an error: Refused to Connect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Mashup Authoring view-Select the New Button-Choose HTML Mashup-Enter the General Information such as Port Binding Type, Mashup Category, Mashup Name -Under Configuration Information, select the Type as URL and enter the URL-Under Request Parameter, select Add Row-Enter the parameter details, for example: Employee ID-Now click on Preview-Observe the error 'Refused to Connect'-Cause-Request Parameters are added to the HTML Mashup.-Resolution-For the combination of HTML Mashup and Configuration Type as URL, the Request Parameters are not supported as per the Standard System Behaviour. Remove the Request Parameters as per the below steps and save the HTML mashup, now the preview should work as intended.-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Mashup Authoring view-Select the New Button-Choose HTML Mashup-Enter the General Information such as Port Binding Type, Mashup Category, Mashup Name -Under Configuration Information, select the Type as URL and enter the URL-Under Request Parameter, remove the line-Keywords-HTML Mashup, Refused to Connect, Configuration Type, Mashup Authoring

Title: Material Missing From An Exported File Of Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-User notices that some materials are missing in file after exporting all materials data from mass data maintenance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass data Maintenance work center.-Go to export materials link.-Export all materials.-Download the csv file.-Here some materials are missing from csv file.-Cause-The system is functioning as designed, however this behavior deviates from the standard.-User can contact respective PDI partner to explore the possibility of addressing this through a PDI solution.-Resolution-As a work around, below is recommended:-1. Search based on a combination of material and language in which the data is maintained specifically. -2. User must search without a language filter to export and remove the duplicate entries from the file.-3. Also, user can use Data extraction functionality https://me.sap.com/notes/2473303-See Also- 2473303 - How to Enable and Use the Data Extraction Tool in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords- Mass Data Maintenance, exported file ; csv file ; materials ; export all materials ; missing materials ; data extraction; material missing ; export;

Title: Error : "Identified Stock is mandatory if the related material or product is batch managed; make an entry in the Identified Stock field" While Confirming Check Task
Content: Symptom-System throws an error while confirming a check task after maintaining mandatory fields and clicking Finish Results Recording, below error triggered:--Identified Stock is mandatory if the related material or product is batch managed; make an entry in the Identified Stock field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Select a required check task and choose Confirm.-Under tab Inspection, maintain mandatory fields like Inspected Quantity.-Select Accepted for Proposed Evaluation.-Error triggered: Identified Stock is mandatory if the related material or product is batch managed; make an entry in the Identified Stock field.-Cause-The output product of this check task has Identified Stock Type as "Batch", therefore user must maintain Identified Stock ID in the same screen before click Finish Results Recording.-Additionally, enable Identified Stock field under Inspection tab via Adaptation mode to fill the Identified Stock ID.-Resolution-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Select a required check task and choose Confirm.-Under tab Inspection, maintain mandatory fields like Inspected Quantity.-Select Accepted for Proposed Evaluation.-In the same screen, maintain Identified Stock ID.-Then choose Finish Results Recording.-Keywords-Check Task, Inspection, Identified Stock, Identified Stock is mandatory if the related material or product is batch managed

Title: Value DIV0 in Yield and Scrap Report
Content: Symptom-In report : Yield and Scrap, system displays value as "DIV0" for fields: Actual Scrap, Scrap percentage deviation and actual scrap percentage.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the reports view and find :Yield and scrap.-Open with web browser and enter required production order ID.-Choose apply.-Now here value for all fields Actual Scrap, Scrap percentage deviation and Actual scrap percentage results as DIV0.-Cause-The key figures show the value DIV0 when it is being divided by zero.-Actual Scrap key figure is based on the following formula:-((Yield Quantity/(100-Actual Scrap Percentage))x100)-Yield Quantity).-Resolution-It is an expected system behavior.

Title: Error ''Employee with Emp ID 'XXX' and Login ID 'YYY' could not be updated because the Employee ID was specified as 'ZZZ'. If you want to change the Employee ID"
Content: Symptom-You are replicating employee in SAP Business ByDesign system with Concur. When running the Employee Outbound run, you are receiving the following error:-x-tinymce/html-"Employee ID: XXX-Employee with Emp ID 'XXX' and Login ID 'YYY' could not be updated because the Employee ID was specified as 'ZZZ'. If you want to change the Employee ID, please use the[...]-Employee XXX not replicated"-Where: -XXX stands for the Employee ID being replicated.-YYY stands for the Employee's e-mail address.-ZZZ stands for a different Employee ID.-Although employee ID ZZZ is referring to a terminated employee, it is not possible to stop the system using that data.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-x-tinymce/html-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Go to Employee Outbound Runs view.-Search for relevant Application Log.-Go to Results tab.-You will see the error.-Cause-There are a few possible causes for this error.-Scenario 1: the Employee ZZZ has been manually changed in Concur.-Scenario 2: this employee might have more than one employee ID in Concur, which is associated with the e-mail address YYY.-Scenario 3: this Employee is possibly being re-hired, but with a different Employee ID (which means a new person, for the system). A new Employee ID also requires a new e-mail address for the Concur system. Both e-mail address and Employee ID are key and it is not possible to "reuse" one of them for a different user.-This error message indicates that there is an Employee ZZZ in Concur instance with e-mail address YYYY. And now XXX (new Employee) is sent with the same e-mail address, which is rejected.-Resolution-To fix this, you need to search for the relevant Employee in Concur (make sure to include inactive employees in the search) and check if the relevant Employee's data is correct. You may change their e-mail address manually to a different one. After that, the replication of the new Employee should go through.-If this is not feasible or the situation appears to be different, open a case for SAP Product Support with the following information:-Explain the scenario.-Inform us about all employee IDs for the affected employee in both systems, including their status.-Inform us to which employee e-mail address YYY is assigned in Concur.-Which employee ID is the correct one in ByD?-Why is there more than one employee ID?-Which on needs to be terminated?-Which e-mail address shall be kept for employee ZZZ?-Would it be an option from your point of view to delete one of the employee IDs in Concur?-Keywords-replicate, replication, employee replication, failed replication, master data replication

Title: Generate Project Name by Combining Multiple Custom Fields
Content: Symptom-This is a new function of BYD2402 which is introduced in the below link:-What's New in Project Management | SAP Help Portal -It says that "While creating a new project, you can now generate a project name by concatenating different fields of the project in your solution".-User wants to know more details about the functionality.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Generating a Project name means combining or concatenating more than one Customer enhanced UI screen with multiple inputs fields for Project name creation.-This can only be realized when there are PDI Add-ons to support UI screen enhancement while creating a new Project and generating or creating Project name.-Note: In Standard SAP BYD Project creation, we directly have one mandatory input field to define project name, which is "Project name*".-Resolution-Example of this function:-In customized screen at Project GAF page, step 3: Define Project.-With two self-defined name fields, the Project Name* field will show the combined/generated name as the project name.-Note: String Concatenation logic of these inputs’ fields will be written in PDI Addons using Cloud Application Studio by Business Partner Developer.-Below screenshot is for reference.-Keywords-Project; Project Name; New Function

Title: Get Error "Tax Region for Country ABC in item 10 is Missing" When Creating Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You get error 'Tax region for country ABC in item 10 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab. ' when creating down payment request for sales order XYZ.-* ABC represents the country code and XYZ represents the ID of the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the sales orders work center view.-2. Select the order XYZ, click Create Down Payment button.-3. In the pop up screen, enter External Reference and Amount value, click OK.-System shows the error: Tax region for country Canada in item 10 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab.-Cause-In this case, the Account/Ship-to/Payer are in country US and the bill-to is in country CA.-When creating down payment out of the sales order, the tax country is determined based on Bill-To party. Hence, in this case the tax country in the new down payment request is CA. However, since the item level has no address information about country CA, the error 'Tax region for country Canada in item 10 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab.' raises up.- This could be reproduced when creating new manual down payment request via Customer Invoicing work center. -If you manually create a new manual down payment request,  add the same account and sales unit, the default tax country/range is US, and tax code is521.-in Involved Parties tab,  you can manually change Bill-To party address to country=CA and give Province information, you will get the same error. "Tax region for country Canada in item 10 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab. "-In the Agreement tab, you can see the tax country is CA and Tax Range is empty.- Resolution-You can get ride of the error by creating a new manual down payment request and manually select the Tax Range in the Agreement tab.-Keywords-Tax Region for Country ABC in item 10 is Missing; down payment; Tax Range;

Title: Manual Time Entry is Reflecting Wrong Time Zone
Content: Symptom-When a manual time sheet entry is stamped using OneTime or the terminal via webservice, UTC+1 is applied. Conversely, if the entry is not manually clocked and is stamped through OneTime or the terminal, UTC+2 is correctly added to the time entry.- Note: OneTime is a third party software.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-NA-Cause-In the Webservice Payload, within the <EmployeeTimeEvent> section, the daylightSavingTimeIndicator is currently set to "false".-Resolution-In the Webservice Payload,  <EmployeeTimeEvent> section, the daylightSavingTimeIndicator should be updated to "true".-Keywords-Webservice, Daylight-saving,UTC+1

Title: Entries in Activity UK Making Tax Digital Need to be Deleted for Inactive User
Content: Symptom-You have a situation where an employee left the company, and now you need to remove data maintained in the business configuration activity UK Making Tax Digital. However the data maintained by the user is not visible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The UK Making Tax Digital business configuration activity is user-specific, which means that it is expected that the users will only see the data maintained by themselves in this activity.-Resolution-Since the activity restriction currently cannot be bypassed, it is suggested to temporarily unlock the business user, and use it to log in and modify the activity as required.-This can be done by following the below steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Business Users view.-Search for the relevant user.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the Attributes option.-Here you can unlock the user through the "User Locked" checkbox, and also change the e-mail address if required (since the new password will by default be sent to the e-mail address registered).

Title: Serial Number Generation for Registered Products
Content: Symptom-You experienced any of the following scenarios, then you want to understand what's the default rule of serial number generation for registered products, such as which symbols can't be included, limited length and so on. -An error "Registered product ID XXX not valid" occurs while fulfilling Registered Product ID during create new Registered Product.-An error "Modification not permitted; Serial ID XXX not valid" occurs while creating a new serial number during post goods issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-/:\ is the Default Character Set for Serial Number.  It means that the system can only accept these characters, it would report the expected error mentioned in the above scenarios if user types other characters.-The maximum length of serial number ID is 30. When user enters more than 30 characters, the system would pick the first 30 characters as the ID.-Furthermore, you can use Configuration Activity Serial Number Generation for Registered Products to create and maintain number range template for serial number generation. For more information, please view Configuration: Serial Number Generation for Registered Products.-See Also-Configuration: Serial Number Generation for Registered Products-Keywords-Default Rule, Serial Number Generation, Registered product ID, Serial ID, Not Valid.

Title: Cannot set Production Task to Finished Due to Error.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User cannot set the Production Task to Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control Work Center.-Go to the Task Control View.-Search for and Select Task ID ABC. (ABC = Production Order ID).-Click Change Status >> Finish.-Click OK.- User receives the below error messages: - (XYZ = Parent Node ID.)-Node ProductionSegmentAttachmentFolder.ROOT for parent node ID XYZ not found-Node ProductionSegmentAttachmentFolder.ROOT for parent node ID XYZ not found-Finishing of production tasks failed------> Finishing of confirmation group failed-----------> Execution of action not permitted----------------> Processing not possible due to status Finished-Save failed-   Cause-The reason the User cannot change the Status to Finished is because the customer has not confirmed the task yet.-Resolution-The User must Confirm the task, then they would be able to Set it to Finished.-Keywords-Error, ProductionSegmentAttachmentFolder.ROOT, Save failed, Production Task, Finish.

Title: Dump "500 SAP Internal Server Error" while executing the query in Resource Search
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User trying to execute the query in resource search but system throws dump " 500 SAP Internal Server Error".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open Project Management workcenter view-Navigate to Resources view.-Select and open Resource Search-Click on "Click here to execute the query"-After a while error pops up stating  "500 SAP Internal Server Error"-Cause-This issue occurs due to increase of change node References in the system and the memory allocated is not sufficient to hold too many change node References hence the dump occurs.-Resolution-Report an incident to Development component SRD-HR-RPM.-Development team will check the memory allocated and they will align with operations team if memory extension required and then they will perform Initial load for Resource calendar. -Keywords-resource search,Click here to execute the query,Resources view,Project Management

Title: Excel Addin Logon error: "Invalid User or Password"
Content: Symptom-While logging into the Excel Add-In an error occurs, "Invalid User or Password"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Excel-Logon to the Plugin with a user name which contains i.e. characters like ś -The error appears-Cause-While special characters like ś or similar characters as in Spanish, French or east European languages can be used to logon to the browser itself, Office and Excel and Outlook do not allow such characters in User ID to logon.-Resolution-Open the work center Application and User Management-Go to Business User view-Search for the user and change the User ID to standard characters-The User Name still can use such special characters.-Keywords-Excel error, Logon Error, Password and User.

Title: Gross Capacity Is Not Getting Populated While Using Data Source "Forecast Utilization" In Custom Report
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a report using data source HCMRPMU01 (Forecasted Utilization) , but while joining the key figure "gross capacity" which is coming from Forecast Utilization data source, you see no value is getting populated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-> Design Data Sources view.-Open the report you created using Forecast Utilization data source.-Gross Capacity values are not getting populated.-Cause-HCMRPMU01 (Forecasted Utilization) data source is not working as expected. New resource planning management is scoped in for customer so data source HCMRPMU01 (Forecasted Utilization) cannot be used. HCMRPMU01 (Forecasted Utilization) is designed for the old resource planning management functionality.  -Resolution-Now it is advisable to use the data source HCMRPMU05 (Resource Calendar) to fetch the Gross Capacity. Please generate the report for GROSS_CAPACITY (Gross Capacity) retrieval using the alternative data source HCMRPMU05 (Resource Calendar).

Title: Object Item: 1 Conditions: Lease Installment - invalid condition term; must meet recurrence criteria
Content: Symptom-You enter a lease installment in the Conditions tab of a lease contract. When pressing Check or Save an error message appears: "Object Item : 1 Condition : Lease Installment - DDMMYYYY invalid condition term; must meet recurrence criteria"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Lease Contract Management work center go to the Lease Contract view. -Find an existing or create a new lease contract.-Maintain all the mandatory data in the General tab. -Then, in the Lease Objects tab navigate to the Conditions tab. -After entering a lease installment condition the error Object Item : 1 Condition : Lease Installment - DDMMYYYY invalid condition term; must meet recurrence criteria appears. -Cause-The installment does not cover full periods:-The installment might end in the middle of the month when the lease contract ends on the last day of a month. -Or the installment ends at the end of a month when the lease contract starts and ends in the middle of a months. -Resolution-All installments must cover full months: -If a lease contract starts on the first day of a month it must end on the last day of the last contract's period. -If the lease contract starts in the middle of a month it must end in the middle of the month. -In accordance with the lease contract start and end date, the installment periods must start and end in the same way: -Example:-Lease contract ABC (ABC represents a lease contract ID)-starts on 07.02.2024-has a lease term of 24 month and therefore ends on 06.02.2026. -Accordingly, create lease installments that start on 7th of a month and end on the 6th of a month:-Lease Installment 1: valid from 07.02.2024, valid to 06.08.2024-Lease installment 2: valid from 07.08.2024, valid to 06.02.2026.-Keywords-invalid condition term, must meet recurrence criteria

Content: Symptom-User is facing an issue when uploading Customer template on “migration of customers” activity in Enhance mode and system throws the following error.-Account determination group company XYZ [company name] missing, although this group info has been informed in the template. -(Here XYZ refers to Company Name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Locate and open fine-tuning activity Migration of Customer Contracts.-Choose the link "Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool."-In the next screen, select the relevant migration file.-Choose Execute Migration, then select Execute Migration Step by Step.-On step 1, Validate File, error occurs.-Account determination group company XYZ [company name] missing, although this group info has been maintained in the template.-Cause-Payment Data sheet of the migration template needs to be filled for the migration of SEPA Mandates for existing accounts-Resolution-User needs to fill the Payment Data sheet of the template for the migration as well.-See Also-2429196 - Error Message: 'Enter Account Determination Group for Customer ABC, Company XYZ'. -3099021 - How to Remove and Incorrect Account Determination Group and Company Assignment in the Employee Account Monitor -2565163 - Errors When Migrating SEPA Mandate and Bank Data for Existing Customer -Keywords-SEPA Mandates, Enhance already existing records; Account determination group company missing; Payment Data Sheet

Title: How to Avoid Business User Bypass Password Change?
Content: Symptom-You have observed that it is possible for the users to bypass the password change by selecting Cancel button or Refresh button in the logon page.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-This symptom is possible in two scenarios,-Initial Password Change / Password reset by Admin-Password expired-Cause-This system behavior is consistent with the security policy configuration's expected behavior.-The Admin Password Change Enforcement is set to Ignore. Therefore the user is able to logon, even after clicking the Cancel button / Refresh option in browser-Initial Password Change:-The administrator can set an initial password for each user in the system. On the first logon of the user, the system requests to change the password which is otherwise known to the administrator.-The Admin Password Change Enforcement allows to ignore or to enforce the change of the initial logon password.-Resolution-To resolve the issue:-Go to Application and User Management (SAP Business ByDesign) or Administrator (SAP Cloud for Customer) work center-Go to Edit Security Polices under Common Tasks-Change the Admin Password Change Enforcement to Enforce-The Admin Password Change Enforcement field is visible, if Password Logon Enabled is selected for a particular security policy.--If it is set to Ignore, a user will be prompted for the change of initial password, and after selecting Cancel, the user will be still allowed to log on to the system.-To set up the security policy, follow the instructions in the Security Policies Quick Guide.-See Also-For more information, see the Security Policies Quick Guide.-Keywords-Anmeldung ohne Änderung Initialpasswort, initial password, user id, password, login, log-on, log-in, credentials, ignore, enforce, bypass, renew password, byd, c4c

Title: No Code Selection Available For Latin Language In OData Query
Content: Symptom-The user has a report on Business Partner that includes script information, specifically Latin script. However, they are unable to extract address information from an OData query in Latin because no script code is available to filter the Address Information in Latin.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Business Analytics workcenter-Go to Design Reports view-Select the Report (For Example: Business Partner Report)-Select Build OData Queries-Go to Filters Tab-Select Generate Data Query/Metadata Query-Observe the data is not retrieved in Latin Language.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign Analytics, the Code for Latin is registered as "#" in the system. This is expected system behavior.  However, when selecting the filter by "#", OData will not be interpreted correctly.-Resolution-Here Address is taken as an example, this could happen with the other fields as well.-Use Filter (CADDRESS_REPRESENTATION_CODE lt 'A') and (CMAIN_ADDRESS eq true). This will give the correct result and return only LATIN address. -https://<Host Name>/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/<ReportName>?$filter=(CADDRESS_REPRESENTATION_CODE lt 'A') and (CMAIN_ADDRESS eq true)-NOTE: In OData ' ' is not recognized in query parameters.-Keywords-Latin Language, OData Query, Business Analytic, Script code, Code Selection

Title: In The Sales Order Items Tab Quantity is Getting Over Written by 0 and Cannot Update Item Group
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update Quantity in the sales order but it's getting over written by 0 and cannot update item group as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to sales order work center.-View: sales orders.-Search and edit ABC (ABC represents sales order ID).-Navigate to Items tab-Change the quantity to 10 and click enter but quantity value reverts back to 0.-Click on drop down in Item type and it's blank and also manual entry is not allowed.-Cause-As we can see in the General tab of sales order ABC that sales unit, sales organization and distribution channel is not maintained. Hence the system won't allow to update the quantity.-This is because in product master data the Item group, quantity and sales UOM is configured for respective sales organization and distribution channel. The sales order fetches the information from product master data which won't allow you to update quantity or item group if the sales unit and distribution channel are not maintained.-Resolution-This is expected system standard behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order; Item Type; Sales Unit; Sales Organization; Distribution Channel; Quantity; Item Group

Title: Unable to Assign Reporting Line Unit to Service Agents
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to assign Reporting line unit "UNASSIGNED - Default org unit" to service agent .--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Select the Service Agents view.-Select respective service agent and select the Edit button.-In the General tab, the  reporting line unit "UNASSIGNED - Default org unit" cannot be saved.-Cause-Service agents can only be assigned to RLUs which are replicated from EC.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior. Service agents can only be assigned to RLUs which are replicated from EC. "UNASSIGNED" as well is an RLU but it's not any real manager which has been replicated from EC. Therefore, assigning any internal employee or service agent under "UNASSIGNED" might not have any reporting manager. This is also because "UNASSIGNED" RLU cannot be edited in Org Management and also because its the top RLU in the hierarchy.-If customer wants the Manager of such service agents who are assigned under "UNASSIGNED". There will be no manager for them. For customer's scenario where they want service agent to be assigned with "UNASSIGNED" RLU in the "Business Partner Data" WoC.  -This will be an enhancement from SRD-MD-OM team, where they may have to relax their check for "UNASSIGNED" specifically and allow its assignment as an exception. Please forward this incident to SRD-MD-OM for further investigation. -Keywords-Service Agent, Reporting Line Unit, Unassigned, Org unit, replication, Ec, Employee central

Title: Error: 'Email Address Of Certificate Does Not Match Outgoing E-mail Address' When Uploading The Key Pair In S/MIME
Content: Symptom-When the user tries to upload a key pair for the e-mail address XXX in configure S/MIME displays an error: 'Email Address Of Certificate Does Not Match Outgoing E-mail Address'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Configure S/MIME view-Navigate to the Outgoing Email-Choose Upload Key Pair-Enter the File path and the Password-Select OK-Notice the error: Email Address Of Certificate Does Not Match Outgoing E-mail Address-Cause-The user has not maintained the DKIM signed domain.-Resolution-User has to maintain the DKIM signed domain or keep the SAP default sender address DoNotReply@myxxxx.mail.sapbydesign.com which will directly validate the certificate. This can be verified by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to overview view-Search for Email and Fax Setting-Verify the Default Sender Address maintained in the system-Keywords-Email Address, Certificate, Outgoing E-mail Address, S/MIME, DKIM

Title: Seller Tax Registration Number Picked In The Customer Invoice Is Not The Expected One.
Content: Symptom-The Seller Tax Registration number picked in the Customer Invoice is not the expected one. You have changed the Tax number in the Company Tax Arrangements for the Seller and you expect the new tax number to be picked in the Customer Invoices created for Contract(Including Scheduled Invoice Requests created for Contract), however the old tax number is getting picked in the Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-View: Invoice documents-Search and edit ABC (ABC represents Invoice ID).-Navigate to General tab.-You can see the Seller Tax Registration number is not the Expected one.-Note: The customer invoice ABC could be created from a Scheduled Invoice Request or a Customer Contract Invoice request for Contract XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Contract)-Cause-The tax date of the Item in Customer Contract is before the Valid from Date in Company tax arrangements for the New Tax number which you have maintained.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue , You have to make dummy change to the tax data in Customer Contract and make sure the tax date is nor before Valid from date for the corresponding company in the company tax arrangements with the correct VAT ID.-Please follow the below steps to make the dummy change:-1. Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-2. Go to Contracts View.-3. Search for Contract XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Contract).-4. Edit the Contract and navigate to Items Tab-5. Select the Item and navigate to taxes tab-6. Change the tax date to a later date or make a dummy change if the tax date is already later than the Valid From date in Company tax arrangements.-7. Once the system recalculates the correct taxes as per new tax date, correct seller tax number will be picked up. -8. Save your changes.-Keywords-Seller Tax Registration; Invoice; Incorrect; Unexpected; VAT;

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on ByD B2B (ByD Integration)
Content: Symptom-This KBA is to list some of the frequently asked questions on ByD Integration (B2B).-The scope of this KBA is restricted to:-Connectivity issues-Authentication-Communication Arrangement-Communication Scenarios (lifecycle)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-1. Where to find the APIs for SAP Business ByDesign?-Answer: https://api.sap.com/package/BYD/overview-2. SAP Business ByDesign – API Overview-Refer to the blog - https://blogs.sap.com/2019/09/26/sap-business-bydesign-an-api-overview/-3. What are the possible Integration scenarios with SAP Business Bydesign?-Refer - https://support.sap.com/en/alm/solution-manager/expert-portal/public-cloud-operations/sap-business-bydesign.html-4. How can you expand your business with SAP Business Technology Platform?-Refer - https://blogs.sap.com/2021/02/21/how-smes-can-expand-their-business-with-sap-business-bydesign-business-technology-platform/-5. How to add an Operation into a Communication Scenario?-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select Communication Scenario view-Select New button-Give a Name for the scenario-Now, select Add Operations button and Search for the respective operations (eg: Find Accounts)-Save and Close-Note: In case if you search with Operation name in Scenario screen then your search result will be nil-6. SAP Business ByDesign Integration Scenarios-Access the link for the release 2208 - https://help.sap.com/doc/7f6eeef4edc84312870d687b2ce0f3a1/2208/en-US/IntegrationScenarios.html-To access the latest version, change the version 2208 to a latest release version of ByD-7. Why the ping test always fails for third party integration scenario?-Refer KBA "1903596 - SOAP Ping fails with 3rd party service provider" for details-8. Why isolate button is not available in production system?-When system is migrated from production system to test system then only isolation happens.-when test system is made as a copy of production, in order to prevent the URLs in communication arrangement to still point to production-it is marked as isolated.-so isolate/deisolate buttons are there only in test tenants. In prod system isolate will not be listed.-9. How to get ByDesign Code Lists via Web Service QueryCodeListIn?-Refer to the blog - How to get ByDesign Code Lists via Web Service QueryCodeListIn | SAP Blogs-10. Is SSO supported for Communication Arrangements scenarios?-No. SSO would not be relevant for Communication Arrangement's Users as the users used in Communication arrangement are technical users, with which the incoming communication calls are authenticated.-11. Is it possible to use Communication Arrangement to connect SAP Business bydesign tenant to a software installed in a local PC/laptop which doesnt have the provision to connect with internet?-No, this requirement is not possible-12. Why are inbound and outbound messages grouped under the "Communication Arrangement Not Determined" scenario in the Communication Usage Monitor view?-This is a generic message which is displayed in all systems. No action needs to be taken on this and it can be ignored.-Keywords-B2B, integration, ping, integration documentation, API, third party, ByD Integration, B2B FAQ, Communiciation Usage Monitor, communiciation arrangement not determined

Title: Incident ID is set to Pending in Track My Incident.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--This KBA will give you knowledge on the issue "Incident ID" column is set to Pending and how to resolve this issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to HelpCenter-Select Report Incident-Create incident by filling all the details and send it to SAP Product Support-Go to Incidents from Application User Management work center-You will find all the details including the Incident ID-But when you navigate to the below path you will not find the Incident ID and this column is set to Pending:-Go to Help Center-Select Track my incidents-Find the Open incident you will see the Incident ID as Pending as shown below:-Cause-Error while lock BO for the incident, due to this backend messages are failed or in a waiting list.-OR-Error due to increase of messages in queue in the backend-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue please validate the below:-Validate and get the confirmation from customer for the same and collect the screenshot for the same.-Ask customer to try to create new test incident and get the confirmation to reproduce the issue from SAP Support.-If issue exist follow the below actions:-Login to affected tenant backend-Enter the srt_moni T-code and search for the Error messages for the sender party: SAPSupportRequestProcessing & SoftwareProblemReporting-If you find any of the above sender party is having status as Application Error: Incident or Not first in queue(waiting)-Select the respective line item and Select Actions button as shown below-Click on Restart-Refresh the page these messages will be processed and set to Delivered-If the issue still persist please send the incident to AP-LM-AM-INC Development team to check further.-If incase there is increase in the messages in queue in the backend then Development team will add additional resource to the system to resolve issue.-Keywords-Pending, Incident ID, Track My Incident.

Title: Error: "Serial numbers count is not equal to delivery quantity" while trying to Undo Release Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-User is facing the error "Serial numbers count is not equal to delivery quantity" while trying to undo release an Inbound delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics - Inbound Deliveries.-Select the relevant Delivery.-Choose Undo release, notice the above mentioned error.-Cause-The serial number profile of the relevant product is being changed after release of the respective inbound delivery.-Resolution-Check the changes Tab in the Product master data to check the previously assigned Serial number profile and change it accordingly.-Go to Product Portfolio - Products.-Select the relevant product and choose edit and view all.-Select the changes tab and check for the Serial number profile which was assigned previously and restore it.-Keywords-Serial numbers count is not equal to delivery quantity, Serial number Profile, Serial number, Inbound delivery, Undo release

If you are not using the latest version of the Bot.-Resolution-For windows credentials, refer to the Tech Spec documentation for the respective BOT in the BOT Store -For version update of BOT, refer to the KBA -It is worth noting that in some cases the most up-to-date version of the bot may have been uploaded to the store as a separated version (for example, the Supplier Invoice Scanning bot 1R1 has its most updated version as 1R1-CSV Log).-Keywords-latest version, odata, credentials,

Title: Cost Object ID Field not Filled While Creating Purchase Order Using Web Service Operation Manage Purchase Order Upload
Content: Symptom-You are creating purchase order with Cost object ID field using the operation Manage purchase order upload however the field is not filled after the purchase order creation. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SOAP UI-Enter the payload for operation Manage Purchase Order Upload-Fill the necessary details along with Cost Object ID field-Execute the web service-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order created via web service-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Select Account Assignment tab-Cost Object ID not filled-Cause-You are creating the purchase order using the operation ManagePurchaseOrderExcelUpload. This operation is similar to the excel upload. If you look at the purchase order excel upload template, you are only allowed to enter the below Account Assignment Types ; Cost Center, Fund ID, Function ID, Individual Material, Project Task ID, Sales Order, Sales Order Item ID, Service Order, Service Order Item, Customer Contract, Customer Contract Item ID G/L Account. In the excel, the custom object is not allowed to enter in a standard template. Meaning, it is also not possible to enter the cost object ID details through the ManagePurchaseOrderExcelUpload operation. -Resolution-This can be taken as a new requirement for development to allow cost object in the ManagePurchaseOrderExcelUpload operation. As a work around you can create purchase order with another operation -  PurchaseOrderBundleMaintainRequest and system will fill the cost object in the purchase order document.-Keywords-Cost Object ID Field not Filled; Cost Object ID Field not Filled while creating PO using ManagePurchaseOrderExcelUpload; ManagePurchaseOrderExcelUpload.

Title: Recognize based on manual amounts - Revenue Recognition run Posts Unexpected Accrued/ Deferred Revenue Amount for Sales Order Item in Foreign Currency
Content: Symptom-You create Sales Order item XYZ-XX with net value in a foreign currency (FC) (XYZ-XX represents the sales order item ID, FC represents a foreign currency). -You assign accrual method 8-Recognize based on manual amounts to the sales order item. -You maintain manual revenue amounts per period in the foreign currency. -After executing the revenue recognition run for a period you notice the expected revenue in company currency LC, based on the exchange rate, valid on the posting date of the run is different to the posted, earned revenue amount. -You might notice values posted to Unbilled Receivables (accrual) or Deferred Revenues (deferral), if the sales order item's total invoiced amount is higher or lower than the total earned revenue amount. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find item XYZ-XX with a net value of, for example, 1000,00 FC. -Choose the Edit Manual Revenue Recognition function and select Recognized Costs and Revenues. -You maintain Recognized Revenue per period in a foreign currency (FC). -Example: -Period 1: 01.05.YYYY - 31.05.YYYY : 150,00 FC.-Period 2: 01.06.YYYY - 30.06.YYYY : 300,00 FC etc. -You have invoiced the due revenue of 150,00 FC in period 1.-You expect the revenue to be realised based on the LC-FC exchange rate valid on the posting date of the revenue recognition run.-Example: Exchange rate on 31.05.YYYY of LC-FC = 1,09-You expect the realised revenue to be 137,61 LC (150,00 FC÷ 1,09)-But the revenue recognition run for period 1 realised a different revenue amount, e.g. 141,51 LC. -You notice, the run posts the difference between the invoiced amount in company currency (137,61 LC and the earned revenue amount (141,51 LC) as Unbilled Receivable (3,90 LC). -Cause-If the manual values of a sales document item of revenue type Product-Sales, are maintained in foreign currency, then the recognized revenue amount of the respective period is converted into company currency based on the exchange rate valid on the sales order item's creation date.-If the revenue to be recognized exceeds the actual (invoiced) revenue, then the difference between the recognized revenue and actual revenue will be offset as Unbilled Receivable (accrual).-If the revenue to be recognized is lower than the actual (invoiced) revenue, then the difference between the recognized revenue and actual revenue will be offset as deferred revenue. -Example: -Sales Order item XYZ-XX was created on 03.01.YYYY. The exchange rate on this day is LC-FC 1,06.-Therefore, in period 1 (here May,YYYY), the revenue recognition run realises 141,51 LC (150 FC ÷  1,06) and accrues the difference, 3,90 LC as Unbilled Receivable. -Resolution-Once the sales order item is completed, all accruals or deferrals will be cleared and only the actual, invoiced revenue is realised. -If specific values in company currency are to be realised, maintain the manual values in company currency (here LC).-The revenue recognition run will then recognized the respective, manual value in company currency, provided the inverse exchange rate (here LC- FC) is the same as the original exchange rate (FC-LC) on all considered dates.-Keywords-sales order item, recognize based on manual amounts, accrued revenue

Title: Cancel Button Enabled for Invoiced Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-Why the Cancel button is enabled for the Invoiced Project Invoice Request?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Project Invoicing view-Go to Project Invoice Requests sub view-Search for Project Invoice Request-You can see that Cancel button is enabled for Invoiced Project Invoice Request-Cause-If the project invoice request is already invoiced, the project invoice request can be canceled. And the corresponding customer invoice has to be canceled manually. So the cancel button will be enabled for project invoice requests with the status Released, Partially Invoiced, or Invoiced.-Resolution-Cancel button will be enabled for project invoice requests with the status Released, Partially Invoiced, or Invoiced. This is an expected behavior. -You can refer to help document - Project Invoicing Quick Guided https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dd7d33a722d1014bd09fd5609a05429.html?locale=en-US- Keywords-Cancel Button Enabled for Invoiced Project Invoice Request; Cancel Button Enabled for Invoiced PIR; Project Invoice Request can be cancelled after invoicing

Title: Note on purchase order cannot be passed to supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-You find the Notes on Purchase Order cannot be passed to Supplier Invoice, though it is passed to Goods and Service Receipt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Open Purchase Order ABC (ABC represents for the purchase order ID).-Navigate to Notes tab/ Item tab - Notes sub-tab.-Add Note of type:-Remark from Supplier-Remark for Supplier-Internal Comment-You find that all these type of notes cannot be passed to Supplier Invoice document.-Cause-The Note on Purchase Order item level can all be passed to Goods and Service Receipt item level note.-There is no Note on header level for Goods and Service Receipt document.-The Note on Purchase Order item/header level cannot be passed to supplier invoice.-There is no link between these two documents in case of Notes.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-Notes, Remark from Supplier, Remark for Supplier, Internal Comment, Purchase Order，Supplier Invoice, 注释，采购订单，供应商发票
