Title: Extraction of query designer table to Excel
Content: Symptom-You are generating a query with the OData designer for reports and data sources and you want to export the table of attributes to excel.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Go to Design Reports.-Search for your report you want to build the query with.-Click on Build OData Queries.-In the next window there is a table with Attributes and you want to export this table to Excel.-Cause-This is currently not possible, there is no export function for this table to Excel.-Resolution-Please add this as a new feature request to the Influence forum here.-Keywords-OData, excel, export, attributes, selection, build queries

Title: Unable to Upload ZIP file to attachments tab in Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error when saving the Purchase Order containing ZIP file attachment:-"zip file to upload.7z could not be scanned: File is encrypted and scanner is unable to decrypt" -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to the Purchase Orders view-Search for Purchase Order ABC and access the attachments tab (i.e. Here ABC refers to Purchase Order)-Add 7z format zip file and choose save ,  However, an error occurs with the following message:-        "zip file to upload.7z could not be scanned: File is encrypted and scanner is unable to decrypt"-( Note: This applies to all other documents like Sales Orders, Supplier Invoices, Purchase requests etc)-Cause-The error message is shown because the virus scan is not able to scan the file content when it is password protected and, therefore, does not allow the file to be uploaded.--Password-protected office file is not supported as per current design.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior, in accordance with our security policy.--In order to adjust this behavior, you may raise an incident to Operations team to proceed to disable the Virus Scan for password-protected files.-When the incident is raised, you must acknowledged that you are aware of the following: "changing the virus scanner settings upon your request will allow files to be uploaded into system. To keep the security level, files should be scanned before encryption and the parties downloading files should have on-access virus protection active."--As an alternative, you may remove the password protection from the file. -Keywords-Unable to upload ZIP file , ZIP file attachment, password protected file, .7z ZIP file, .7z format

Title: Employee Hours Missing in the Project Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 6 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Employee have released the time sheets and approved. However these times does not show when you create new project invoice request. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project -Select New and Manual Project Invoice Request-Select Time and expenses period from DD.MM.YYYY - DD.MM.YYYY-Few hours are missing for an employee-Cause-The time sheet which is released on DD.MM.YYYY by employee is already invoiced with reference to Employee Time Confirmation. Meaning this is already invoiced with Project Invoice Request and Customer Invoice. Since the time is already invoiced with the customer invoice, released times are not available for specific month. -Resolution-How to check the time sheets that are already invoiced from backend? -Go to Project Management work center-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses-Search with relevant Project -select Edit Time and Expenses -Filter based on Provision Date-At the bottom you can find the Source Document i.e. Time Confirmation -Now go to backend system and enter SESFTS-Enter the BO Name PRO_PROJECT_EXPENSE_VIEW-In the CPIR_ITEM_REF_ID_CONTENT field, you will get the Project Invoice Request ID. If you open the document flow of Project Invoice Request ID, you will see the corresponding customer invoice. -Keywords-Missing hours in PIR; Missing hours in CPIR; Time sheets missing in project invoice request; Released time are missing

Title: Vacation Times are not posted against the Time Account Balance
Content: Symptom-You applied for Leave through New Leave request (half day or full day). You also observed that the Leave is approved but there is no deduction in the respective Time Account assigned to the Employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Employees view-Search for the employee and select the employee-Select Edit button-Go to the Employee Times tab-Highlight the vacation period and go to the Account Posting tab. No Postings is displayed-Go to the Time Account Balances tab, for the Time Account XYZ, the Balance and Taken remain unchanged-Cause-Could be technical inconsistency. -Resolution-Follow the below steps to resolve the issue:-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Employees view-Search for the employee and select the employee-Select Edit button-Go to Time Profile Tab-Select Work Schedule Under Details.-Remove the Time Model 'ABC' under Predefine Work Schedule  which is already assigned -Select Save.-Assign the same Time Model 'ABC' under Predefine Work Schedule and Save.-Keywords-Time Model, Vacation, Deduction, Time Profile, Wrong Balance, Incorrect Time

Title: Attachments are not Taken Over While Forwarding the Supplier Invoice Clarification Task to Accountant
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice with attachments and it contains an active exceptions. Now you want to forward the supplier invoice clarification to another employee along with attachments, however attachments were not taken. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and credit memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to Attachments tab-You can see the attachment-Now go to Exceptions tab-Click on Save and forward the clarification-Invoice clarification sent to employee with out attachments-Cause-Currently when you forward the invoice clarification, system does not carry forward the attachments. This is the current behavior.-Resolution-Since the purpose of invoice clarification is to clarify about invoice, attachments are not included in the forward request. This can be taken as a new request and you can post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-Attachments are not Taken Over  While Forwarding the Supplier Invoice Clarification Task to Accountant;Forwarding the Supplier Invoice Clarification Task to Accountant

Title: Customer Invoice Documents are not Getting Named Consistently
Content: Symptom--When you releasing the Invoice document navigate to the output history and open the document by clicking on the document name.-Here you see the inconsistency(Some documnets are with correct name and some documents name are with UTC stamp)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Documents view-Search for Document-We can observe invoices are getting named in a strange way-Cause-This is due to the ouput channel setting configuration.-When you set the output channel is printer you see the name and the UTC time stamp-but when you set the output channel is DO NOT SEND or XML you now click on the document name and save it, it shows the document name only.-Steps to check the maintained output channel:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open the respective Account.-Navigate to the Communication tab and the Collaboration sub tab .-Select the respective Business Document e.g. Customer Invoice / Credit Memo.-In the section Output Channel Settings you can add multiple Output Channels via the Add-Row button.-Resolution-This is expected behaviour, when the output channel is DO NOT SEND or XML, we are not appending the UTC time stamp in the document title.-However, we do append UTC timestamp for remaining output channels.-See Also-Keywords-Invoice document, Output channel,Printer, XML, DO NOT SEND

Title: Only One Scheduled Invoice Request Created for Different Invoice Dates
Content: Symptom-You created a customer contract with an invoice schedule. You notice that the system created only one scheduled invoice request for your item whereas it has two different invoice dates.-You expected two different invoice requests and you want to create two different customer invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select the Scheduled Invoice Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice request).-In the Details table, you can see that there are two line items for Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the contract).-But you expected two separate Scheduled Invoice Requests created since they are related to 2 different invoice schedule dates for this item:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Select the Customer Contract XYZ and click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and to the Invoice Schedule sub-tab.-Expand the related Line Item.-You can see that there are 2 Invoice Schedule dates, for example:-Invoice Schedule Date 01.07.2020-Invoice Schedule Date 05.07.2020-Cause-The scheduled invoice requests were created together because the contract was created on the 04.07.2020. When the invoice schedule was created (due to the horizon maintained) there were two invoice schedules due to be created:-Invoice Schedule Date 01.07.2020, as it was in the past.-Invoice Schedule Date 05.07.2020, as it is within the Invoice Schedule horizon.-In this case, the system only creates one Scheduled Invoice Request for all relevant Invoice Schedules dates which are within in the Time Horizon.It is the current system behavior. You can check the time horizon by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select your respective implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tune step-Open the fine tuning activity Time Horizon for Scheduled Invoice Requests Run.-You can maintain the time horizon(in number of days) for the consideration of scheduled invoice requests run. The run only picks those scheduled invoice requests which fall within this time horizon from the date of run.-Resolution-When you invoice this Scheduled Invoice Request, the system will split the invoices according to the invoice schedule dates.-Click the Invoice button.-In the New Invoice screen, you can see that two invoices are suggested:-One with the Invoice Date 01.07.2020-One with the Invoice Date 05.07.2020-Keywords-invoice schedule, invoice date, merged, combined, split, demande de facture, échéancier de factures

Title: Horizon Theme / Appearance Available in ByD with 2208 Release
Content: Symptom-After 2208 release upgrade, 'Horizon' theme has become available in the SAP Business ByDesign systems. This KBA is to provide additional details about this appearance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-2208 upgrade only impact the users using default Belize theme right now. If some users have changed their theme, they will continue using their old theme.-1. Why Horizon theme?-New User Experience-Intuitive Enterprise Search-Refaced Page Tabs-New Visual UI-Brighter colors and rounded shapes present delightful user experience.-Bolder font and adjusted visual focus improve information accessibility.-Multi-level shadows and card layout set out information structure-For detailed explanation, please refer to the Blog - Horizon New Theme Available with SAP Business ByDesign-2. How to change the theme only for a particular user?-Go to My Settings-Appearance tab-Select a theme-Save the changes-Refresh the page / Logoff - login-3. Is it possible to change the Appearance on Company level? / We want to pick key theme for all users in Key User adaptation-No, Theme in Company settings may not suit for all Users. Because, each user has the flexibility to change and use available themes.-4. How to change the background color?-Start Personalization Mode.-Right-click either inside the content area or in the personalization panel on the right-hand side of the screen. -Select the value help to choose the color.-Save the Changes.-5. Names of the themes are always in English irrespective of logon language, why?-This is correct behavior and there is no translation for the theme options in SAP Business ByDesign.-6. After 2208 release upgrade, Horizon is set as default theme. Now the customer wants to set back to Belize. In this case, after 2211 upgrade, will it again default to Horizon? What will happen if they continue to user Belize?-If users change the theme back to Belize, it will still be Belize after 2211 upgrade. -7. After 2208 release upgrade, Horizon is set as default theme. Now the customer wants to set back to Belize.  Will there be any impact in the future if our clients continue to use the traditional theme, Belize?-We currently support both Horizon Morning (default) and Belize (optional) themes.-In the future all enhancements would be shipped on the Horizon theme, starting with Horizon Evening Theme being made available in addition to the Horizon Morning theme.-Kindly note, SAP can decide to deprecate the other themes over the coming releases and hence it is recommended that users stay with the latest offering. Currently we do not have a defined timeline for such a deprecation.-8. Is there a possibility to change the theme for mobile devices?-No, it is not possible to change the theme in SAP Business ByDesign mobile app. Even if you log in to the system via browser in your mobile device, selecting a theme will not have any effects, as the themes are only available for desktop.-Keywords-Theme, Appearance, background color, horizon, theme for mobile app, app, themes, mobile

Title: System Dump While Changing the Time Model from X to Y for Employee ABC
Content: Symptom-When changing an employee's Time Model from X to Y, the system throws a dump (X and Y represent time models)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Time Sheet View.-Open Time File of an Employee.-Go to Time Profile facet.-Change the Time Model from X to Y.-System throws dump-ST22 Log:-1 CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY, Program:CL_ESF_ALV_DP_CACHE===========CP, Include:CL_ESF_ALV_DP_CA-2 Info: A row was to be added that would have lead to a duplicate of the NODE_ID key.-Cause-There are two possible causes:-Cause 1-One of the Statistical Account assigned to this Employee has minimum balance is Negative (Eg: - 20)-Cause 2-For the Time Account, in the details section in Business Configuration, you have maintained a "Fixed Limit", but no Minimum Balance.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you can either set the Fixed Limit in the Check limit to No Limit or ensure a valid Minimum balance is maintained.-Keywords-Fixed Limit, minimum balance, negative balance, time account

Title: Valid-to Date is in the Past but Contract is not Closed
Content: Symptom-Auto-closure function of contracts is scoped in the system.-But when checking a certain contract, the valid-to date is in the past, but it is still in Released status (but expired), not closed by system as expected. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Scope the question: "Do you want automatic notification of expiring purchasing contracts?" -Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center, Contracts view.-Select Expired from the dropdown list on the left top.-See the contract XXX (XXX represents contract ID) is in Released status.-Cause-It is system design that for contract, if released value  is equal to the target value, system will set it to expired even though valid-to date is still in the future. But system will not close it even though auto-closure function is scoped. -Therefore, although valid-to is in the past when user checks it, it will not be displayed in the Closed category but in "Expired" category with status being "Released".-User has to manually close the contract.-Resolution-This is a normal system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2354147 - Purchasing Contracts status set to Closed-Keywords-Contract; Close; Expired; Valid

Title: Error Message: 'Error in configuration for account 123' When Opening the Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error while executing the Financial Statements Report (or) Trial Balance Report-Error in configuration for account 123. (Here 123 is G/L account id)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work Center.-Go to the List view.-Search for Report: Trial Balance  (or) Financial Statement report.-Enter the required data.-Click Apply.-Error message shown: Error in configuration for account 123.- Cause-You cannot delete the G/L account from backend as the General Ledger Account is still shown under Trial Balance Report (or) under Journal entries. There are line items associated with the G/L account and deleting data from the chart of accounts would not delete data that has been created as part of a journal entry. Deletion of G/L account from the chart of accounts is basically removing it from being used again in future. - Resolution-You need to add the same G/L account with Account type in the Chart of account activity and you should mark the account for No postings allowed to remove the error from the reports.-you should really mark the account for No postings Allowed rather than delete it, as deleting it will have reporting implications.-You should follow the below steps to mark the account for No postings Allowed.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the General Ledger Accounts view.-Find the respective G/L Account and click Edit > Chart of Accounts.-Change the G/L Account Posting Block to 3 - No postings allowed.-Click Save.-Keywords-Error in configuration for account, Financial statement, Trial balance report

Title: Labor Resource Issue Even Though the Labor Resource Is Maintained While Approving the Time
Content: Symptom-The Labor resources of the employees are maintained still getting the labor resource error while approving the time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the Employee ID XYZ-Click Edit-Check the Job-Observe the below details:-Job, Validity and RLU details-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Access the Master Data view.-Access the Resources subview.-Search for the relevant job.-Select and click the Edit button.-Go to the Valuation tab.-In the Job Assignment section, the job ABC is not assigned.-Cause-The Employee ABC belongs to cost center XXX and assigned to job YYY. (XXX represents the ID of cost center and YYY represents the ID of a job)-However, there is no labor resource created with the Cost Center and Job assignment, therefore, the error is triggered.-Resolution-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Resources view.-Select the Resources sub-view.-Click New to create a new labor resources.-Maintain the basic information in the General tab, go to the Valuation tab.-in the Cost Center Assignment table, click Add Row, enter the validity period and maintain Cost Center as XXX.-In the Job Assignment table, click Add Row, enter the validity period and maintain the Job as YYY.-Save and change status to Active.-See Also-1473402 - Labor Resource in customer service documents-Keywords-Job, Labor Resource, Employee, missing

Title: Localization - Countries/Regions Where SAP Delivers Tax Content for SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-SAP Business ByDesign supports localization content for more than 193 countries with different levels of process automation.-In SAP Business ByDesign three localization versions are available: Tax Basic, Pre-localized and SAP Standard or Localized. Each of these feature an increased level of process automation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Standard Localization -In this version, SAP supports customers to run business with SAP Business ByDesign according to the international standards and local requirements. We support customers running their business in different countries/regions of the world by providing them with the legal standards and best practices of the country/region.-This includes the following features:-Functional Localization: Ensures that the solution enables legal compliance and follows thebest practices.-Internationalization: Ensures that we support the specific local languages and cultures. Some of the generic features supported are Unicode, Currencies, Time Zones, Calendars, and Script Direction.-Translation: Ensures that we translate the SAP Business ByDesign solution into other languages, focusing on the user interface, and the documentation for certain languages.- Currently SAP provides standard localization for 21 countries as follows:-Australia -Austria -Belgium -Canada -China -Denmark -France -Germany -India -Israel -Italy -Japan -Mexico -Netherlands -New Zealand -South Africa-South Korea-Spain-Switzerland-United Kingdom-USA-Pre-localized Version -In this version, SAP offers partial localization features and enables you to use SAP Business ByDesign with further customer specific developments based on your needs. The content delivered differs for each country/region, but it addresses taxes, logistics related forms like invoices, orders, delivery forms (not in local language) or financial accounting. The template used for these forms is that of Germany and any deviations must be adopted by the customer. Several country/region-independent features are available within SAP Business ByDesign, for example, features in the areas of migration tools for SEPA, flexible tax configuration, document numbering flexibility or employee hiring. Flexibility options may vary per country/region.-Additionally, the following standard system functionalities can be used:-Chart of Accounts, Account Determination and Financial Reporting Structures-Fixed Assets and Depreciation-Generic Tax Returns-Generic Reporting-Generic Expense and Reimbursement Management-International Employes-The list of countries that are pre-localized are as follows:-Algeria -Egypt -Estonia -Finland -Greece -Hong Kong -Kuwait -Latvia -Lithuania -Malaysia -Morocco -Norway -Poland -Romania -Singapore -Sweden -Thailand -United Arab Emirates - Tax Basic Version -In this version, SAP provides a minimum enablement to create additional localization for a specific country/region. The scope comprises the basic tax events and tax codes for the country/region, the tax number validation (if applicable) and the availability of the generic tax return. A tax basic version covers the basic scenarios like domestic sales and purchases, export and import, and reverse charge. For the taxable countries/regions, there is a standard and a zero VAT rate available.-Country/region-specific content is not part of the tax basic delivery, but the following standard system functionalities can be used:-Chart of Accounts, Account determination and Financial Reporting Structures-Fixed Assets and Depreciation-Generic Tax Returns-Generic Reporting-Generic Expense and Reimbursement Management-International Employee-The tax basic countries/regions are listed below:-Alnia Andorra Angola-Antigua and Barbuda Armenia Azerbaijan-Bahamas Bangladesh Barbados-Belize Benin Bermuda-Bolivia Botswana British Virgin Island-Bulgaria Burkina Faso Burundi-Cambodia Cameroon Cape Verde-Central African Republic Chad Chile-Colombia Comoros Republic of the Congo-Costa Rica Ivory Coast Cuba-Curacao Cyprus Czech Republic-Democratic Rep. Title: Incorrect Numbering of Project Tasks
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY.-The Project ABC was created (ABC represents the Project ID).-The Project Task ID for the first task is ABC-XX (ABC-XX represents the Project Task ID), you were expecting the ID to be ABC-1.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work centre.-Go to Projects view.-Show All Projects.-Find ABC.-Select Edit - Project Plan.-You can see the first Project Task ID is ABC-XX instead of ABC-1.-Cause-Project Task IDs cannot be duplicate from one project to another. The numbering starts with the first available ID.-Additionally, Project Task IDs cannot be longer than 20 characters. If the Project ID given is too long, the Project Task ID will use the prefix determined in the Business Configuration Activity Project Types rather than copying the Project ID. This means that the Project ID can be ABC but the task ID will be DEF-XX (DEF represents the default prefix set up in the Business Configuration).-When you try to create a Project with the ID DEF, the task numbering will start on XX+1 to avoid duplicates.-Resolution-You can check the numbering allocation in the back-end.-Open the back-end.-Go to transaction SE16.-Find PSF_D_TASK.-Enter the Project ID with a wildcard in the External ID field, eg. ABC*.-Execute.-All the Project Tasks beginning with that prefix will appear.-Select the GUID from the Project Task you were expecting, eg. ABC-1.-Go to transaction SE16.-Find PSF_D_PROJECT.-Execute.-The name of the Project containing the task ABC-1 appears here.-To avoid this issue, you can either rename the Project Task ABC-1 by changing ABC to another ID or create the Project DEF to fill the gap in the numbering and make the system use the next available Project ID.-Additionally, we recommend that you always take into account the character restriction of 20 in Project IDs to avoid this issue altogether.-See Also-KBA: 3309236 - Wrong Project Task IDs When Creating Project From Older One-Keywords-Incorrect Numbering; Project Tasks; SE16; PSF_D_TASK; Project Task ID; wrong; unexpected;-project id,project task id,business configuration,se16,prefix,incorrect numbering

Title: Revenue Recognition Run error: Only doc. items with the same buyer party can be merged
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You execute the Revenue Recognition run. The run finishes with the error 'Doc. item ABC/XX: Only doc. items with the same buyer party can be merged.' (ABC/XX represents a Sales Order item ID). -The Sales Order Item ABC-XX is a fix-price project based Sales Order item using the Accrual Method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find the run with the Error Processing Status and open the Application Log.-In the Messages tab the error 'Doc. item ABC/XX: Only doc. items with the same buyer party can be merged' appears. -Cause-Numerous fix-price Sales Order items, not belonging to the same Project, got assigned to Accrual Method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC, at the same time. Currently, the system cannot handle this mass update across Projects. As a result one Sales Order item is assigned as Leading Sales Document Item randomly to numerous Sales Order items which might not be associated with the same project.-This error can usually be corrected by applying a dummy change (see KBA 2385608 - Revenue Recognition: AccrualMeth. Assignment For Fixed Price Project Incomplete) to all affected Sales Order items of the same Project.-However, sometimes it can happen that the internal, project based item*, is still connected to the wrong Sales Order Item. If this item is assigned to a different Customer ID, the error appears.-(*To bundle all fixed-price sales order items with accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC, the system automatically creates an internal ONLY-project-based item. This internal item is associated with the same attributes (Customer, Profit Center, Segment) of the Leading Sales Document Item.)-Resolution-We are working on improving the mass data update functionality for fix-price Sales Order items.-For now, we need to delete the inconsistent internal item and re-create it:-Before this backend correction you need to-Ask for Customer permission for backend correction and to execute the Revenue Recognition run in test mode,-Locate the Leading Sales Document Item:-In the Sales Document Items view open the Advanced Search.-Under Related Documents, in the Project ID field enter the Project ID, here XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID). -Under Accounting Data, in the Revenue Type field select 3- Project Sales (Fix Price).-Press Go to display all Sales Order items connected to the project. -Select the first Item and go to the Accounting Data sub-tab.-Find the Leading Sales Doc. Item column and take note of its Sales Order ID. If this column is not displayed then you are looking at the Leading Sales Document Item. Or there is only one Sales Order connected to the project. In this case, just take note of the Sales Order ID, here ABC.-Press Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data.-Select Percentage of Completion.-If there are any manual values maintained, either in the Edit Manual Percentage of Completion table or below, under Reference Values take note of these values, for example in your Excel list.-Keep the Edit Percentage of Completion screen OPEN (even if no manual values are maintained here) but navigate back to the Sales Document Items view.-After these steps-Access STFK with a L6-support user authorization.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC.-Select Load By Query and select ITEM-QUERY_BY_PROJECT_REF. -In the ProjectReference/ProjectID/content field, enter the Project ID XYZ and press OK (green tick in the bottom right).-Ensure that you are viewing all items in Table view. You can see all items of the sales order in a table list. If you can only see information on one specific Item click the Table View button in the top left corner.-Under More Functions mouse-over Switch Attribute Names and select Display Proxy Names. -Identify the Internal Item: Find the OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT_ITEM_REF-UUID-CONTENT column. For one item only 000000000000000000... appears*. This is the internal project-based sales order item.-Select the Internal Item. -Press Navigate and choose TO_PARENT.-In the Parent Node the OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT_REFERENCE-FORMATTED_ID column displays a Sales Order ID.  You will notice that the ID appearing here is not the ID of the Sales Order of the Leading Sales Order Item.-Go back to the Items table (button left beside Navigate). -Go back to the UI and Sales Document Items view. -Select all items of Project XYZ. -Press Reassign and select Accrual Method.-Choose a different Accrual method, for example 101 - Reverse deferrals and accruals.-Press OK. -Go back to SESFTS.-To be 100% sure, check the BO Node again. It MUST display: FinancialAccountingViewofSalesAndServiceDocument - Item. -Select the Internal Item. -Press Edit. -Press Delete. -Go back to the UI and the Sales Document Items view again. -Close the still open Edit Percentage of Completion screen.-Select the Leading Item of Project XYZ and now re-open the Edit Percentage of Completion screen. -Enter all the values which you noted down.-Select all items of Project XYZ.-Reassign Accrual method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC to all items again. -This will trigger the generation of a new Internal item for Project XYZ, which will now be connected to the Sales Order of the Leading Sales Document Item of Project XYZ.-After this change, execute a revenue recognition run in test mode. The error message should not appear anymore.-See Also-2860171 - Revenue Recognition Run Errors for fix-price Sales Order Items: Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only--2479036 - Revenue Recognition Run Error - Doc. item: Only Doc. Items of the Same Profit Center can be Merged-Keywords-Only doc. items with the same buyer party can be merged

Title: ARCHIVED:Error Message: Exchange rate Currency/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion on a new Purchase Order

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: Duplicate of KBA:  2370139 - Error: Exchange Rate X/Y on date DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion. -You receive this error message in a Purchase and you cannot find any reason why this is happening. You searched and cannot find the mentioned currency anywhere-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Select and open the affected Purchase Order.-Click on Check.-You will receive the error message.-Cause-If you follow the steps below you will find the cause of this message:-Go to Items tab of the affected PO.-Go to Taxes subtab.-See that the Tax Country is maintained as the one from the mentioned Currency and the Tax Date is the Date mentioned on the error.-Resolution-Navigate to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Common Tasks.-Open Edit Exchange Rates.-Maintain the relevant Exchange Rate.-You are now able to proceed with the Purchase Order.-See Also-For the Same Error in different documents/Usage, check the documents below:-1961446 - Error Message : Exchange rate Country/Currency on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion-2492408 - Supplier Invoice Clearing - Conversion rate for Currency ABC and DEF missing on DD.MM.YYYY-Keywords-Purchase Order, Exchange Rate, Error, Currency, Conversion

Title: Not able to View the Results of the Day Closure Runs due to an Exception
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Your requirement is to view the Results of the Day Closure Runs. Upon accessing the Results tab and selecting the entries or scrolling through the entries, the system loads for a while and throws an exception.-Unexpected error during backend processing-An error occurred. Try resuming your work. If you still face issues, open an incident-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Under the section Time Valuations, select the link Administer Day Closure Runs-Show All Runs and select the row containing the respective Day Closure ID-At the bottom of the screen, able to see many logs-Open the Application Log ID: XXXXX (where XXXXX represents the Application Log ID) which ran on DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM (where DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM represents the day, month, year, hour and minutes)-Go to Results tab-Select Expand All-Try to select the entries or scroll up or down-System loads for a while and throws an exception-Cause-As Hierarchical Lists do not support any paging and all operations on a hierarchy are performed at your side, performing an Expand All operation on multiple rows recursively takes time and memory. Due to this the Internet Explorer browser takes up system resources and any further operations done on Internet Explorer shows the message sapbydesign.com is not responding and the only option is to Recover webpage.-Huge set of logs getting generated creates browser problem with Microsoft Silverlight technology.-Resolution-Currently, there is no concept to implement paging for Hierarchical Lists.-As a workaround, you may use the HTML5 version of the system to view the Results of the Day Closure Runs in case all details are required to be displayed.-To make it work in this scenario, you can filter up logs to show relevant logs choosing Log Detail Level as Terminations and Errors or Terminations, Errors and Warnings to display only relevant warnings/erroneous logs.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-[Enter your Keywords here...]

Title: ARCHIVED:Email Notifications not Received for the tasks
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA 2658668 - How to set up an E-Mail notification for Tasks-You are not receiving any e-mail notifications when BTM tasks are modified in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You see a task created in your Inbox under the Home work center. But no email notification is triggered to your email ID.-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Inbox view-Here, you can see the open task in the inbox for processing.-However, you do not receive an email notification although you see all the tasks are successfully created/modified in the system.-Note : The Open Tasks can also be seen from the respective work center view.-Cause-The Function Subscribe To Task contains a list of task types (task titles) that can be subscribed by the end user.-If the list does not contain the task type mentioned in your case, then the task cannot be subscribed. But if the task type is available in the list, then the check box must be enabled to include the task for an email notification.-Resolution-If the task type exists in the subscription list, please follow below mentioned steps to subscribe the email notification for these tasks:-Go to the Home work center.-Select the Inbox view.-Select the Subscribe To Task button.-Select the relevant Task Type for which you want to receive the email notifications and check the corresponding check box.-Click on the Save button.-Note: ensure that the correct email id is maintained in the master data for the user.-See Also-   2895942 - How to configure email notification -Keywords-task, notification, e-mail, BTM task,Email Notifications Received for the task, wrong email received, email received why

Title: ARCHIVED:Payment Due Date Not Calculated Correctly in a Uploaded Suppleir Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Achived reason: duplicate of KBA 2714705 - Due Date Greyed Out When Create New Supplier Invoice -You have uploaded a supplier invoice via excel tempate , and the payment date is not calculated correctly.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Choose the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-In the field Find, enter XYZ (XYZ represents the invoice ID).-Choose the button Edit.-Here the Payment Due Date and the Receipt Date are not the same.-The payment due date is taken as Invoice Date.-Cause-In order to have the Payment Due Date calculated as desired, you must configure the settings in the Fine-Tuning in Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Go to Business configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Choose the button Open Activity List .-Go to Fine tuning tab.-Search for Suppliers.-Choose the button Open.-Select Define Payment Terms for Procurement.-Set the Calculate Due Date Based on 'Receipt Date'.-Choose button Save and Close.

Title: ARCHIVED:System is not Allowing to Maintain Price having more than two Digit in Product Catalog
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: this is very old KBA db its contents are  not valid any more.You ay check the KBA   1657940 that has  relavent details  about this error-1657940 - No More than 2 Decimals Are Allowed for Prices in Price Lists-You are creating a new Customs Catalog and imports items from a CSV file. The items have prices with more than 2 decimals and you can import without any error but if you are trying to add via ByDesign screen you are getting error message Enter a value that matches the unit XXX and has a maximum of decimal places 2.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Catalogs view.-Select the button Open Catalog file Template.-Under the column E Price and enter the amount having more than two decimal values.-Enter other fields in CSV file and Import the same.-Now add the item manually with price having 3 decimals digits.-You will get the error message Enter a value that matches the unit XXX and has a maximum of decimal places 2.-  Cause-In current release system is not able to match the currency logic of the ByDesign System in the excel generator.-Resolution-In one of the next feature release of SAP Business ByDesign system will be able to validate the currency decimal values in CSV file.-Meanwhile you can follow the workaround below to solve the issue.-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to Catalogs view.-Select the button Open Catalog file Template.-Under the column E Price and enter the amount not having more than two decimal values.-Enter other fields in CSV file and Import the same.-Also add the item manually with price having 2 decimals digits and Save.

Title: ARCHIVED:Wrong Tax Country Determination on Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason 1: Duplicate of 2891848 - Wrong tax country In Purchase order or supplier invoice-Archived reason 2: we updated the  details of Cause  section on to KBA 2891848 - Wrong tax country In Purchase order or supplier invoice-You have a Purchase Order where the Supplier and the Buying Company are from the same Country and you have correctly maintained the Taxes for the country you expect to be the Tax Country on the Product's Master Data, even though the Tax Country is being determined for a foreign one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter.-Go to Purchase Orders View.-Search for the affected Purchase Order and open it.-Click on View All and go to Items tab.-Go to Taxes subtab and see that the Tax Country is a foreign one.-Cause-Open the affected Purchase Order.-Go to Items tab, select the affected item and go to Delivery subtab.-Here you can see that the Site is XXX and the Recipient is YYY.-If you open any of those by clicking on their Hyperlinks, you will see that they are both located in the same country as the one on Tax Country.-Resolution-The system would only assign the Tax information maintained in the Product Master Data if the receiving country was from the same as yours. Since the taxes maintained there are for the same country as the one the Company is from. Although, since the Ship-To is from a foreign country, the Tax Country is automatically determined based on the Site Location.-See Also-2481562 - Wrong Tax Country Determined While Ordering Intercompany Third-Party Purchase Order Document-2536809 - Wrong Tax Country Determination in Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Purchase Order, Tax, Taxes, Tax Determination, Tax Country

Title: ARCHIVED:Wrong Tax Country Determination in Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Archived reason 1: Duplicate of 2891848 - Wrong tax country In Purchase order or supplier invoice- Archived reason 2: we updated the  details of Cause  section on to KBA 2891848 - Wrong tax country In Purchase order or supplier invoice-You have a Supplier for a foreign country and under Taxes tab, the Tax Country field is not determining the Supplier’s country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoice Entry View.-Search for a Purchase Order to be delivered with the affected Supplier.-Select the document and click on New Invoice.-When the new screen shows up, click on View All and go to Items tab.-Fill in all required information.-Click on Taxes sub tab.-You see that the Tax Country is not the same as the Supplier's country.-Cause-The Tax Country field is determined by the country in which acquisitions are reported for tax declaration. It is not supposed to show the Supplier's country specifically, but the country where the purchase is being triggered.-Resolution-Please check the Parties and Locations tab of the invoices where you can see the Delivery address details which is what determines the tax country in supplier invoice.-Keywords-Tax country determined wrongly, tax country not same as company's country, tax country not same as suppliers's country

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of  KBA:2571013 - You are Unable to Confirm Delivery for Shopping Cart-Archived reason 2:  I have merged this detaisl on to KBA:2571013-You cannot confirm deliveries from your shopping cart since the Confirm Delivery button is inactive/greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select the relevant Purchase Order.-Open it and select the View All button-Select the Document Flow tab.-In the chart select the Shopping Cart.-In the Shopping Cart select the View All button.-Note that in the items section the Confirm Delivery button is inactive.-or-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services view.-Select Track My Shopping Carts.-Open the relevant Shopping Cart and select the View All button.-Note that in the items section the Confirm Delivery button is inactive.-or-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services view.-Select Confirm Deliveries.-Open the relevant Shopping Cart and select the View All button.- Note that in the items section the Confirm Delivery button is inactive.-Cause-The corresponding Business Configuration rule needs to be set in order to enable the functionality.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 Questions.-Drill down Purchasing > Self-Service Procurement > Shopping Carts.-Under Decentralized Goods and Services Receipts the question Do you want to allow your employees to confirm the receipt of goods or the completion of services? is not in scope and hence disabled.-Once the flag is set, the functionality will be enabled.

Title: ARCHIVED:Approval Rules in Supplier Invoicing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:  duplicate of help document , link given below-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2002/en-US/2ce105a3722d1014b296bb96796cfa92.html?q=Approval%20rules-Overview-Before defining an approval process for supplier invoice, it is important to understand the various approval rules available for a supplier invoice approval.-You can define approval limits for an approver of a supplier invoice, in the Application and User Management work center, Task Distribution header, Employee Work Distribution view, Purchasing Approval Value Limit Work Category.- Prerequisites-You have assigned a manager for a cost center, a reporting line unit, a project or a project task-You have setup value limits for organization unit managers.- Approval Rules-The supplier invoice approval supports following rules.-All Cost Center Approvers by Value Limit-Approval by Cost Assignment-Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task-Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit-Approval by Line Manager of Recipient-Approval by Recipient-Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager-Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager by Value Limit-Approval by Reporting Line Unit Managers of Recipients by Value Limit-Approval by Reporting Line Unit Managers up to Value Limit-Direct Approvers-Manager of Manager-Supplier Invoice Approver- The rules are explained below in detail:- All Cost Center Approvers by Value Limit-The All Cost Center Approvers by Value Limit rule enables you to send an approval task based on the approval limit to the cost center manager. If the gross amount of the supplier invoice exceeds the manager’s approval limit, then the next cost center in the hierarchy is found and its manager is also assigned an approval task. The process is repeated until the cost center that is at the top in the hierarchy is found. Once this is done, the system assigns the approval task to the manager of that cost center as well. Hence, all the managers in the hierarchy will get an approval task. We recommend that all managers must approve. In case no cost center is assigned to the supplier invoice or the approval limit does not match, the reporting line unit manager is used as fallback for the approval.- Approval by Cost Assignment-The Approval by Cost Assignment rule enables you to send an approval task based on the cost assignment of a supplier invoice. Based on the cost assignment the approval task is either sent to the cost center manager, project manager or the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible for approval.- Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task-The Approval by Cost Center Manager based on Project Task rule enables you to send an approval task based on the cost assignment in the supplier invoice to the cost center manager of the project task, the project task manager or the project manager.- Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit-The Approval by Cost Center Manager by Value Limit rule enables you to send an approval task based on the approval limit. An approval task is sent to the cost center manager, provided the gross amount of the supplier invoice is within the limits of the approving manager. If the gross amount of the supplier invoice exceeds the approval limit of the approver, the system automatically determines the next eligible approver from the organizational management hierarchy. The process is repeated until the cost center at the top of the hierarchy is found and the system assigns the approval task to the manager of that cost center. In case no cost center is assigned to the supplier invoice or the approval limit does not match, the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible is used as fallback for the approval.- Approval by Line Manager of Recipient-The Approval by Line Manager of Recipient rule enables you to send an approval task to the reporting line unit manager of the employee who received the product as assigned in the supplier invoice.- Approval by Recipient-The Approval by Recipient rule enables you to send an approval task to the employees who received the products as assigned in the supplier invoice.- Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager-The Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager rule enables you to send an approval task to the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible as assigned in the supplier invoice.- Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager by Value Limit-The Approval by Reporting Line Unit Manager by Value Limit rule enables you to send an approval task to the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible as assigned in the supplier invoice. If the gross amount of the supplier invoice exceeds the manager’s approval limit, then the next reporting line unit in the hierarchy is found and its manager gets an approval task. The process is repeated until the reporting line unit that is at the top in the hierarchy is found. Once this is done, the system assigns the approval task to the manager of that reporting line unit.- Approval by Reporting Line Unit Managers of Recipients by Value Limit-The Approval by Reporting Line Unit Managers of Recipients by Value Limit rule enables you to send an approval task to the reporting line unit manager of the recipients assigned in the supplier invoice. If the gross amount of the supplier invoice exceeds the manager’s approval limit, then the next reporting line unit in the hierarchy is found and its manager gets an approval task. The process is repeated until the reporting line unit that is at the top in the hierarchy is found. Once this is done, the system assigns the approval task to the manger of that reporting line unit. Hence, all the managers in the hierarchy will get an approval task.- Approval by Reporting Line Unit Managers up to Value Limit-The Approval by Reporting Line Unit Managers up to Value Limit rule enables you to send an approval task to the reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible assigned in the supplier invoice. If the gross amount of the supplier invoice exceeds the manager’s approval limit, then the higher level managers are determined. We recommend that all managers must approve.- Direct Approvers-The Direct Approvers rule enables you to send an approval task to an employee or employees mentioned in the Approval Process Definition.- Manager of Manager-The Manager of Manager rule enables you to send an approval task to the next level reporting line unit manager of the buyer responsible assigned in the supplier invoice.- Supplier Invoice Approver-The Supplier Invoice Approver rule enables you to send an approval task to the manager of the invoicing unit assigned in the supplier invoice. In case no approver is able to determine, the reporting line manager of the buyer responsible is used as fallback for the approval.

Title: Health Check: Workcenter View Assignment Adjustment Needed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The system has detected inconsistencies in work center assignments for a user. There are 5 possible situations that can occur to cause this.-Resolution-Locate the appropriate error message in the following table and perform the activity to resolve it.-Error Message-Activity-E009 - Technical conflicts between the views assigned to the user-Two or more work center views that were assigned to this user conflict with each other.-In the User and Access Management work center, remove one of the work center views.-E010 - Missing prerequisite views for already assigned views to the user-The user was assigned to a work center containing prerequisite views that were not assigned to him or her.-In the User and Access Management work center, assign the prerequisite view or views for the work center.-E011 - Missing mandatory views for already assigned work centers to the user-The user was assigned to a work center containing mandatory views that were not assigned to him or her.-In the User and Access Management work center, assign the mandatory view or views for the work center.-E015 – Combination of work center and work center view invalid-The user was assigned a work center view that does not belong to the work center with which it was attributed.-In the User and Access Management work center, remove the invalid combination and then assign the appropriate work center that contains this view.-E016 - Wrong role assignment restriction assigned to the user-The user's authorization does not allow him or her to access this view.-In the User and Access Management work center, assign the user a valid authorization to access the work center view.-Keywords-Error Message, Technical conflicts, Missing prerequisite, Combination invalid

Title: Unable to Create New Project in Test System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You can't create a new implementation project in your test system.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer 1805 and higher;-SAP Business ByDesign 1805 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select Implementation Projects view;-Button New is disabled.-Cause-This is a change project test system. The purpose of this system is to test a project and merge the configurations with your production. In this type of system, it is not possible to create local change projects.-Resolution-There are two possibilities, as described below:-If your intention is that of creating a change project to be merged to the production system, please trigger the creation of the change project from that production system and request a solution profile copy to the test system. That way, you will be able to test the changes in the test system, decide them and then merge them back to the production system;-If your intention is not to create a change project to merge back into the production system, but rather to use this test system as a standalone, you will have to request a new system.-Please check the See Also section of this knowledge base article for additional information regarding the above-mentioned scenarios.-See Also-2329588-2136036-Keywords-Change Project, Create, Disabled, New

Title: Images do not Display in Inbound e-mail With Embedded pictures.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-   **** Archive Reason: More Details on the same are available in KBA 2784869 ****--You have set up inbound e-mail channels for customer service tickets. Those e-mails are successfully received and added to the ticket, however the embedded pictures do not display. The only thing that remains is a line in the e-mail text with the name of the embedded picture.-Environment-[Enter your Environment here...]-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Tickets workcenter.-Select the view Tickets.-Select a Ticket with in bound mail containing embedded picture.-Cause-There can be different causes for this to occur. In the given scenario the email content was not of type ms-tnef, but mhtml content which was being displayed in View Original content. This option doesn't show up for plain text emails as in those cases interactions reflect the actual email content.-The email that has winmail.dat attachment was a plain text email with a .dat attachment. So it didn't show the View Original Content option and the attachment came up as regular attachment in the interaction, and like all attachments, the user should open it with appropriate software on their machines.-Resolution-The e-mail sent had a .dat attachment in it. The content is being processed and you can see the attachment in the interactions. If you have to view the attachment, they will have to do so in your local machines.-This is similar to how a word or excel or pdf attachment works. You need appropriate software in your machines to open the attachment.

Title: ARCHIVED:Wrong Amounts in Supplier Invoice for Purchase Order (Negative Subtotal)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived Reason: This is no more valid and we have tested it already cause we do allow supplier invoce to be created for excess quanity and price when compared to its Purchase order.-When you invoice a purchase order, a negative Subtotal is derived. The calculated Gross Amount is negative and the balance is not equal to zero.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Entry view.-Select the purchase order and choose New Invoice.-Fill in the fields Quantity, Net Price, Price Unit, Total Gross Amount, etc...-Negative Amounts come up and the Balance is not equal to zero.-Cause-This is the desired behavior. The purchase order has already been invoiced for a value/quantity greater than the ordered one. So a credit memo item is defaulted. In the Basic View, the field Item Type is not displayed by default.-Resolution-You can change the item type from Credit Memo to Invoice, the following way:-Choose View All on the top right corner.-Go to the tab Items.-Choose Add Row.-Enter an invoice item with the same values as the credit memo item.-Remove the row for the credit memo item.

Title: ARCHIVED:Error Message: 'Item 1: Tax event(s) could not be determined'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: Duplicate of KBA: 2831115 - Error message:Tax event(s) could not be determined-You are unable to create a New Manual Invoice due to the above error message for a Non-Localized Country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Enter the relevant information.-Go to the Items section and add the Tax Code 1 - Non-Taxable Purchase.-You will find the error messages below:-'Item 1: Tax event(s) could not be determined.'-'Item 1: Cannot determine taxed for ABC, business configuration does not exist.'-ABC - Relevant country.-Cause-The Tax information maintained in the Master Data of the Product / Supplier comes from a Non-Localized Country created via Localization Tool.-The root cause is that the system cannot find a Decision Tree for Withholding Tax for the respective Country.-Resolution-A Decision Tree for Withholding Tax needs to be configured for the created Country.--Using the referenced link, you can go to the table Tax -> Withholding Tax -> Decision Trees -> How To create a tax decision tree.-Obs: The Automatic Determination will only work if the decision tree is configured.-As a workaround, you can manually change the Withholding Tax Code using the below steps:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view -> New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Enter the relevant information.-Click View All.-Go to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes sub-tab.-Select the Withholding Tax Details view.-Here you need to manually assign the Withholding Tax Code described in the Supplier / Produto Master Data.-See Also-Localization Toolkit-Keywords-Tax Event, Supplier Invoice.

Title: ARCHIVED:MRP is not creating any Production Proposal
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archive Reason: Duplicate KBA-You have the available stock as 5 ea for the product XXX in Planning Area ABC. As you have a Sales Order which is selling this 5 ea and the Reorder Point Quantity maintained in product master data is 5 ea, it is expected that the system creates a production Proposal.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning-Select Products-Search for the Product XXX in Planning Area ABC-Select Open-Choose Run Planning-Choose Single BoM Level-Select Ok-See no Production Proposal is created-Cause-You have maintained the Planning Procedure in product master data as Consumption-Based Planning. Consumption-Based Planning only considers the negative Available Stock, Safety Stock and Reorder Point Quantity as demand. The system creates Production Proposals when Reorder Point Quantity is greater than Available Quantity.-Resolution-System is working as expected.

Title: Some of the Employees are Missing in Personnel Administration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-CONSOLIDATED IN KBA #2058364-You have migrated an Employee but the Employee is missing in Personnel Administration but the respective Business Partner exists in Business Partner work center with the role Employee.-And also, you are not able to Block the employee in Business Partner work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Business Partner work center:-Go to Business Partner work center.-Select Business Partner view.-Search with employee XYZ , the Business Partner exists for the employee XYZ.-Personnel Administration work center:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for the employee XYZ, employee XYZ is not available.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that you have migrated this employee using Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool but the follow up activity Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool was not completed. So the employees have no personnel administration specific data (as work agreement, employment, etc.) till now. Therefore within work center Personnel Administration and view Employees the Employees will not be found.-Resolution-So, you have migrated at first only the Employee data (without Personnel Administration data) with the functionality 'Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool' or you created the Employee at a point of time there Process component Personnel Administration has not been scoped in your system. The Personnel Administration is now scoped. So in both cases you have to add the missing Personnel Administration data via the migration functionality as below described:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview.-Search for the activity Migration of Employee Data.-Select the link Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool. -Open the respective Migration Template and You can find the employee here. This step is for verification.-Now, you have two possibilities:-Select the link Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool or  select link Manually create Personnel File using basic employee data' and add the missing personnel administration data.-Afterwards the Employee will occur in the work center Personnel Administration within view Employees.-Note: if you don't want to have this Employee in the system, then report Incident to SAP Support to remove the Employee.

Title: The PDF Form of the Sales Quote Does not Show the Discount and List Price Values
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-To Be Archived:-Standard form template for Sales Quote now also includes the Disocunt and List Price Values. -  The PDF form of the sales quote does not show the Discount and List Price values.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-Edit the sales quote and select the View All button.-Go to the Output History tab.-Open the PDF form, the form does not show the values for Discount and List Price.-Download the XML file of the output.-The fields are also not available in the output XML.-Cause-The List Price and Discount fields is not available in the standard form template but you can add it using the Adobe Livecycle designer in the adapted form template.-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign system is passing the Discount and the List Price fields to the form. So, in the xdp, you can add these columns and map the fields as follows:-QuoteForm-->Item-->PriceAndTax-->PriceComponent.-Here, you will get several records. In the PriceComponent table, there is a field called TypeCode. You need to select the records which have TypeCode 7PR1 (List Price) and 7PR6 (Product Discount).-You can implement the above suggestion using Adobe Livecycle Designer:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Go to the Maintain Form Templates subview.-Search for the standard Sales Quote form.-Copy the standard form to create your adapted copy.-Open the adapted form in the Adobe Livecycle Designer and implement the changes.
