Title: Odata query gives maximum 1000 entries
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are calling an Odata query via URL, for example:-https://myxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/cust/v1/datasetqa/CustomerCollection-But the Query returns only a result of 1000 entries.-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to reproduce:--1) Enter the following URL in your browser:-https://myxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/cust/v1/datasetqa/CustomerCollection--2) In the pop-up which is prompting for user and password enter the credentials--3) Results only shows 1000 entries.-Cause-There is a limit set for the query.-Resolution- In case you wish to fetch more or less than 1000 records, you need to pass the query parameter 'top'--For example:-https://myxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/cust/v1/datasetqa/Custo merCollection?$top=10 will fetch you 10 records.--https://myxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/cust/v1/datasetqa/Custom erCollection?$top=50000 will fetch you 50000 records.--If no query parameter is passed, by default, 1000 records are fetched:--https://myxxxxx.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/cust/v1/datasetqa/CustomerCollection will fetch 1000 records.-

Title: Contract End Date is Being Changed by the System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-To Be Archived: Time Zone is now available in the Contract for the Contract Start and End Date.-Contract End Date is being changed by the system automatically.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Click on the Contracts view.-Search for the Contract ID ABC (ABC represents your Contract ID).-Click on the Edit and View All button.-Scroll down and check the Contract Start and End Date.-The end date is 01.01.YYYY and you are expecting 31.12.YYYY.-Cause-This behavior happens because the ByDesign systems works in UTC 0 and the you must be in another UTC e.g. UTC +1-Resolution-Go to My Settings.-Under Regional Settings.-Enter the time zone as UTC 0-This action will accurate the system according to your time zone and the contract will finish on the expected day.

Title: Error Message “Service Call failed, Report an incident”, While Migrating Materials
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you migrate Materials, you are receiving below error message for some of the Materials-Service Call failed, Report an incident-Environment-[Enter your Environment here...]-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Materials-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File-Cause-There are multiple causes which may lead to this issue, some of them are as follows-Case 1:-The issue is that in the worksheet GTINs, you might have maintained GTIN number as 0000000000000 or a GTIN number which is already assigned to a Material.-Case 2:-The combination of Supplier ID & Supplier Part Number must be unique across all products-Resolution-Solution 1:-The GTIN number is unique to a Material and it should not be duplicated.-Hence, please correct this GTIN number and try migration the Materials. If there is no GTIN number for a material then do add those materials in the worksheet GTINs.-Secondly, a same GTIN number should not be used for more than one Material, hence remove if there is any duplicate entries.-Note: Also make sure that, you are entering the valid GTIN numbers for the Materials because system will check whether GTIN is valid as per the standards.-Solution 2:-The combination of Supplier ID & Supplier Part Number must be unique across all products i.e. if one supplier id & supplier part number has been maintained for one product, then the same combination cannot be used for an other product.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-GNIT , Duplicate GNIT , GNIT UNIT Already Used

Title: The Tax Reporting Unit Selected in the Customer Invoice Request is not the Expected One
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Tax Reporting Unit selected in the Customer Invoice Request is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Create a New Manual invoice from the Common Tasks.-Add the account, employee responsible, sales unit in the invoice request.-Add the Invoicing unit ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoicing unit).-Select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and add a product.-Select the Taxes subtab.-The tax reporting unit selected is XYZ which is not the expected one (XYZ represents the ID of the tax reporting unit).-You are expecting the tax reporting unit QRS to be selected in the invoice request (QRS represents the ID of the invoice request).-Cause-The invoicing unit ABC selected in the customer invoice request is not assigned to the function Customer Invoicing in the Organizational Management work center,-the org unit ABC belongs to the org unit QRS which is also the Business Residence.-Since the org unit ABC is not assigned to the function Customer Invoicing, its reporting org unit QRS which is also a business residence, cannot be selected as Tax Reporting Unit.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Find the org unit ABC (ABC represents the ID of the org unit).-Edit the org unit ABC.-Select the Functions tab.-Select the check box for Customer Invoicing under Finance.-Save and Activate the org unit.-Now create the Manual Invoice Request again with the invoicing unit ABC, the invoice request will now select QRS as the Tax Reporting Unit.

Title: Archived:Open Tasks in Supplier Invoice: Cancel Invoice if Required; Preceding Purchasing Document Changed or Blocked
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason: Already help document is there for this task.-You find the following task in your work inbox in the work center Supplier Invoicing: Cancel Invoice if Required; Preceding Purchasing Document Changed or Blocked.-From the description of the task, you are unsure what caused the creation of the tasks and what needs to be done.-In the Help, you have this article: Task - Cancel Invoice if Required; Preceding Purchase Document Changed or Blocked. It tells to cancel/create an invoice/credit memo which is not desired or to complete the task manually.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Work.-Choose Show: Open Tasks.-You find tasks with subject: Cancel Invoice if Required; Preceding Purchasing Document Changed or Blocked.-Cause-You canceled or modified goods receipt(s) that was/were matched against the invoice at the time of posting the invoice.-Resolution-You should open to the invoice and navigate to the sub-tab Cost Distribution for the Items. Check that the desired deliveries are matched against an invoice item. If you click the button Edit Cost Distribution, you have the chance to amend the referenced deliveries. For example you can match the invoice explicitly against a new delivery that replaces a canceled delivery. If you save changes there, another version of the invoice will be sent out to Accounting. You can verify this in the work center General Ledger, view Closing Cockpit -> Source Documents. Another version of the invoice will be listed.-If the new goods receipts references are correct in the invoice, you can select Actions -> Complete for the task. The task will then disappear from the work inbox.

Title: Error While Migrating Purchase Order "File validation failed. Create an incident."
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You receive the below error when you migrate Purchase Orders using Migration tool.-"File validation failed. Create an incident. "-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Select Implementation Projects.-Select Open Activities list-Search the activity Migration of Purchase Orders-Select Migrate Purchase Orders using the migration tool-Select and Execute step by step migration-Cause-There can be many reasons for this error. One of the reasons can be due to the value entered for the column name Price Unit. If you enter the value as currency type e.g. EUR instead of the of the number this error can arise.-Resolution-Change the value for Price Unit field and re-execute.

Title: Request For ISAE 3402 Audit Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVED-You receive a request for an ISAE 3402 SOC 1/SOC 2 Audit Report and/or a Bridge Letter.-This is a legal requirement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-ISAE 3402 means International Standard for Assurance Engagements and is approached from a financial reporting perspective.-The ISAE 3402 reports are issued twice a year, the periods are the following:-HY1: 01. November - 30.April issued and available in July-HY2: 01.May - 31. October issued and available in December-In the scenario where you require a bridge letter for your auditors in January, you can request the Bridge Letter for November and December at the beginning of January.-Resolution-These reports are confidential documents, which may only be shared with existing SAP Cloud Customers who had live, financially-relevant systems during the last audit period.-The request for the report can be made via the SAP Cloud Trust Center: https://www.sap.com/about/cloud-trust-center/cloud-certification-compliance/compliance-finder.html .-Go to the SAP Cloud Trust Center  - Compliance Finder via the above mentioned link.-Use the filter option and select the Audit Report for the required period.-Click on the icon on the bottom of the page or select the hyperlink.-Fill in you details and send your report request.-You will receive an email in the following days with the required information via the SAP Cloud Trust Center.-Please note that you will have be asked to enter an SAP Contact Email Address. This would be your primary SAP contact address on SAP's side like your SAP Account Executive or a SAP Customer Support contact.-If you have bought the product from a partner, please contact them for this information.-The Bridge letters has to be requested via an incident and will not be available through SAP Cloud Trust Center.-See Also-Cloud Trust Centre https://www.sap.com/about/cloud-trust-center/cloud-certification-compliance/compliance-finder.html-Keywords-Audit Report, Bericht, Wirtschaftsprüfung, SOC

Title: ARCHIVED: Purchase Order Net Price Rounds Off Into a Two Decimal Digit Number in The New Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: KBA was created for wrong component***-You have a Purchase Order created for a Unit of measure as Liters, for example. The calculation for this, as an example is based as 123.45 for each 100 Liters. When you try to invoice this Purchase Order, on the New Invoice Screen the Net Price is rounded off to a 2 Decimal digit number, such as 1.23 instead of 1.2345.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Workcenter.-Go to Invoice Entry View.-Search for the affected Purchase Order.-Select it and see that the Net Price is for example 123.45 for 100 Liters.-Click New Invoice and see that the Net Price is rounded off as 123.45 / 100 and it shows up as 1.23 instead of 1.2345.-Cause-In the Activity Currencies in the Business Configuration, the Decimal digits for the affected Currency is set as 02.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Workcenter.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the current Project and Click Open Activity List.-Search for the Activity Currencies.-Open it and see that for the affected Currency the Display Decimal column shows 02.-Change it from 2 to a digit that better suits your need between 0 and 6. You also need to change the Rounding Value Accordingly.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Currencies, Rounding, Decimal, Supplier Invoice

Title: How to Find the Creator of an Addon

Title: How is the Exchange Rate Derived Considering Different User's Time Zone
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Document archieved. Got re-created due to Case Doc. to KBA migration. Please, refer to 2609018 - How Exchange Rate is Derived for Different User's Time Zone-You have business users across different time zones accessing the system and posting documents in foreign currency. You wonder how the system validates the applicable exchange rate for the different users in different time zones.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For posted documents, you may check the exchange rate derived by the system in the Journal Entry, which can be found as follows:-Go to General ledger work center-Go to Journal Entries view-Open the relevant journal entry.-Resolution-The exchange rates are always stored in UTC time zone.-For example, a user with time zone settings in UTC+8 creates a supplier invoice with posting date on 25.07.2017. When creating the document, the system always appends time as 23:59:59 to the posting date, hence 25.07.2017 23:59:59. The user time zone is then considered for the exchange rate logic derivation. Since the user has time zone as UTC+8, the UTC time to be considered for exchange rate is 25.07.2017 15:59:59-Therefore, to derive the exchange rate, the system looks in the exchange rate table (in UTC) for the valid rate on 25.07.2017 15:59:59 UTC-In order to check user's time zone, please follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Highlight the user and click Edit Attributes.-In case you do not have access to Application and User Management, you can check only your own user's time zone by clicking Personalize -> My Settings at the top of the screen on the right-hand side.-Keywords-Exchange Rate. Time Zone. Foreign Currency.

Title: How To Solve the Fixed Asset Migration Error: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are using the Fixed Assets (extended) migration template in order to migrate fixed assets data, since you have multiple set of books, valuation views or fixed asset retirements in your legacy system.-While simulating the migration you come across the following error message(s):-Asset XXX val.view YYY: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount-Error detected in source record with key value 'ZZZZZZ'-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool-Select the respective migration unit and click Execute Migration-Select the Fixed Assets (extended) migration object and click Process File-You'll see the error message(s) on the Log section:- Asset XXX val.view YYY: Posting leads to different acquisition cost amount-Error detected in source record with key value 'ZZZZZZ'-Cause-The reason for the error message(s) is that not all the combination of set of books and valuation views are maintained in the xml file for migration.-A typical case: e. g. there are 5 valuation views tied to the set of books you are migrating fixed assets, but in the Fixed Assets (extended) template > Asset Posting Lines worksheet there are some lines with data for only 2 valuation views.-Resolution-You could verify whether all the valuation view data is maintained or not by adding an extra worksheet to the excel downloaded from the migration tool and, in the new worksheet, adding 2 new columns for verifications, e. g. "Key" and "Count" (header row).-Steps on Microsoft Excel:-In the new worksheet, copy the following relevant columns (without the header) from Asset Posting Lines worksheet:-Inventory ID (A)-Set of Books ID (B)-Valuation View (C)-Movement Category (D)-Line Item Type (E)-Valuation Date (F)-Posting Date (G)-Currency (I)-Debit or Credit Amount (J)-In the next column (K) use the CONCATENATE function to concatenate columns A, B, D, E and F.-In the next column (L) copy and paste the data obtained with the function on column K (use paste option Values(V))-In the next column (M) use the COUNTIF function giving K as range and L as criteria. The COUNTIF function counts the number of cells within a range that meet a single criterion that you specify.-Apply the COUNTIF function to all rows of column M-In the row #1 of this worksheet you can add a Filter (Data section > Filter icon)- Finally, on column M you have the result of how many valuation view lines are maintained for each Inventory ID in Asset Posting Lines worksheet. You can use the downward arrow from the filter to check in details.-Please check the Attachments section for an example where you are migrating thousands of fixed assets (9137 entries in Asset Posting Lines), there are 5 valuation views tied to the set of books, but for 2 fixed assets you entered lines for only 2 valuation views (3 missing for each one).- See Also-This Case Document is a complement of 2151986 - Fixed Asset Migration Error: Posting: Leads to Different Acquisition Cost Amount .-Microsoft Excel version used: 14.0.7145.5000 (32-bit).

Title: DO NOT USE : Unposted Supplier Invoice Error "An Error Occured During Depreciation Calculation For Asset XYZ"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-DO NOT USE THIS DOCUMENT AS THIS CONTENT IS OBSOLETE -You want to post the Supplier Invoice to Accounting. However while trying to post it you get the errors:-An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset XYZ (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Asset XYZ Val View 1: Transaction Contradicts Net Book Value Rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing Cockpit View.-Click on Source Documents Sub-view.-You will see an unposted Source Document Type - Supplier Invoice with the error message:-An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset XYZ.-Asset XYZ Val View 1: Transaction Contradicts Net Book Value Rule.-Cause-You have activated Valuation Check Settings as 1 - Perform standard checks, so if the above posting is leading to a negative value or an inconsistency, the system will not allow you to post this document affecting the Fixed Asset data.-Resolution-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and Select the Fixed Assets subview.-Choose the Fixed Asset in question,and then click Edit.-Navigate to the Master Data tab, and then choose Asset Valuation.-Click on subtab Current Valuation View Settings and under Additional Parameters.-Check the Valuation Check Settings field.-If the Valuation Check Settings is 1 - Perform standard checks, then you will not be able to post documents which will lead to inconsistencies or contradicting the net book value. If you want to allow the postings, you should choose 3 - No checks, this will allow postings in spite of inconsistencies or that contradict the net book values.-Keywords-An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset ; Asset Val View: Transaction Contradicts Net Book Value Rule ; Fixed Asset ; Supplier invoice ; Purchase Order ; Business transaction ; Ocurrió un error durante cálculo de depreciación para activo

Title: How to clear Accounts Payable against Accounts Receivable
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to clear payables items against the receivables items. In your case, your customer is also a supplier. So you want to offset supplier invoices against customer invoices.-Resolution-Netting is not supported in the current release. But we have a workaround.-There are 2 scenarios :-A. Receivable amount is same as that of payable amount. In this case, no payment will be made. You can do the below steps:-Go to Payables work center.-Select Supplier Accounts view.-Select the appropriate account and click on View.-Click on the button New Charge/Credit.-Create a new charge for the total amount and post it.-Select this new charge posting and the open items you want to clear.-Click on Clear manually.-If there is more than one item for clearing then you can also simply start manual clearing with only one item selected. On the following screen you also see all open items of that account and can filter e.g. by document ID to find the matching one.-Go to Receivables work center.-Select Customer Accounts view.-Select the appropriate account and click on View.-Click on the button New Charge/Credit.-Create a new credit for the total amount and post it.-Select this new credit posting and the open items you want to clear.-Click on Clear manually.-If there is more than one item for clearing then you can also simply start manual clearing with only one item selected. On the following screen you also see all open items of that account and can filter e.g. by document ID to find the matching one.-Please note the below points :-This approach will clear items in the Customer and Supplier sides of the account. Creation of New Charge Credit items (Other Payable/Receivable) items will lead to Accounting Entries.-The Document Description for these items can be maintained in the New Charge Credit screen, so that it is clear as to why these items are being created.-The balances in both Accounts will be consistent.-Use the same GL Account for both the charge credits.-The posting dates of the charge credits should be the same.-Please also be noted that, if your transaction currency is diferent from your company currency, this approah might lead to profit/loss from exchange rate difference.-B. Receivable amount is not same as that of Payable then do the below steps :-If payable amount is larger than receivable then you will initiate the payment. For example : if payable balance is for 100 USD and receivable balance is for 40 USD then an outgoing payment for 60 USD will be made which will clear your supplier and customer account. You need to do the below steps :-Go to Payables work center.-Select Supplier Account view.-Search for the respective account and select the row.-Click on view.-Go to Trade Payables tab and Invoice/Payments Sub-tab.-Select one item.-Click on Pay Manually by and select Other Payment Method.-Go to Open Items tab.-Click on Accounts and select the Add Account. Here add the customer account.-Enter the values in the field.-This will add the account on the screen , now you can select the customer invoices and the supplier invoices. When you click on Execute Payment, 40 USD is cleared, 60 USD is made as an outgoing payment to the supplier.-If Recievable is larger than Payable and the payment is foreign initiated then the clearing will be done for the existing payment. For example : if payable balance is for 40 USD and receivable balance is for 100 USD. You need to do the below steps :-First of all, create an incoming payment via bank statement with amount 60 to the customer account.-When clicking the Reqired link of the bank statement item, make sure this amount partially clear one invoice item, instead of having the payment paid on account.-Then go to Receivables work center.-Select Customer Account view.-Search for the respective account and select the row.-Click on view.-Go to Trade Receivables tab and Invoice/Payments Sub-tab.-Select the Clearing ID. Reset the clearing.-Click on Accounts and select the Add Account. Here add the supplier account and match the supplier invoices.-Select the button Clear.- This clears you supplier account and customer account with existing payment.-Please note that, in case there is no incoming payment from the customer yet, after the clearing, you can create a customer new charge/credit to set the receivable back to the customer account, in this case, it should 60 USD.-Of cause, if you do not want to choose any solutions above, you may create dummy incoming payments through bank statments of your bank to clear the receivables first, and on the same day, create same amount of dummy outgoing payments via bank statement of the same bank to clear the payables. In this case, both receivables and payables are cleared, and the bank account balance is not changed.

Title: Error: "Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times" when Terminating Relationship with Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Consolidated in KBA #1934540-You are trying to terminate a relationship with an employee, but the following error message is being displayed :-Termination failed.-Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times.-You have checked in Time Administration work center for approved, in approval or active time entry which might overlap with termination date but you did not find any of these maintained. Still, the error message occurs when trying to terminate the relationship with the employee.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work Center.-Go to the Regular tasks view.-Click Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Select the employee XYZ.-Click Save.-The following error occurs: Cannot Delimit Time File Validity; Employee Times Exist; Cancel Times.-Cause-A manual adjustment has been maintained for a corresponding time account ABC, which is vacation for the upcoming year to the termination. Since the termination date is supposed to be from the current year, this is the reason why you are getting the error message. Since this manual adjustment is no longer required (due to termination), you can remove it and try again to terminate the employment with the employee.-Resolution-Please perform the following steps:--1. Go to the Time Administration work center.-2. Select the Employees view.-3. Find and Edit the employee XYZ.-4. Go to the Time Account Balances tab.-5. Highlight all the time accounts available in this view.-6. Check the Adjustments sub-tab-7. Remove the manual adjustment for the time accounts that might overlap with the termination date.-8. Save the changes.--Try again terminating the relationship with the employee by adding the same last working day.

Title: Supplier Invoice Net Price Rounding to Two Digits Instead of four Digits From Purchase Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a Purchase Order for a Product for in which the Net Price Calculation works as for example: 30.50 XYZ per 100 units (Where XYZ stands for the Currency being used).--When you go to Invoice it, you see that the calculations changes for each unit and the rounding instead of being 0.3050, using four digits as you would expect, it is 0.30, using only two digits.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoice Entry View.-Show All Purchase Orders and search for the affected Purchase Order.-Select it and see that Net Price is 30.50 XYZ per 100 units.-Click New Invoice button.-See that in the New Invoice Screen the Net Price will show up as 0.30 XYZ per unit.-Cause-This happens because in the Activity Currencies in the Business Configuration, the Decimal digits for the affected Currency is set as 02.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select the Current Project and Click Open Activity List.-Search for the Activity Currencies.-Open it and see that for the affected Currency the Display Decimal column shows 02.-Change it from 2 to a digit that better suits your need between 0 and 6. You also need to change the Rounding Value Accordingly.-Once you have done this, the rounding will no longer be of only 2 digits for this Currency.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice, Currency, Currencies, Decimal, Digit, Rounding, Net Price

Title: Error Message "Cannot delimit time file validity; employee times exist; cancel times" While Terminating an Employee

Title: Exception While Hiring Employee for France
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Upon trying to hire an Employee for France, you are not able to complete the hiring process. Title: Reschedule Bottom-Up Action in Resources Does Not Affect Production Proposal Dates
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are performing Reschedule Bottom-Up action on a production resource . You see that the Start Date of the proposals does not get rescheduled as you expect.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Resource Load view.-Search for the relevant resource and choose the Open button.-In the Resource Planning Details screen, choose the Reschedule Bottom-Up button.-When you check your production proposals using the above resource you see that the Start Date of the proposals are not rescheduled.-Cause-Performing the Reschedule action on the resource will not change the Start Date of the proposals of a particular product. You have to perform the Reschedule Bottom-Up action for a product from the Material Flow view of the product available in the lowest level of the production chain. This will make sure that all the proposals in the above top level are adjusted accordingly.-Resolution-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Navigate to the Products view.-Search for the relevant product whose proposals you need to reschedule, select it and choose the button Open.-In the Product Planning Details screen, select the production proposal and choose the button Open Material Flow.-In the Material Flow screen you can perform the Reschedule Bottom-Up action for the product available in the lowest level of the production chain.-Performing the above steps will adjust all the proposals in the above level accordingly.

Title: Cash Ledger Balance for Bank Account Differs from Cash Register
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a Reconciliation Run for the period-end activities, however the run reported an error indicating a difference in the Cash ledger.-Environment-Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Reconciliation view.-View the relevant run and jump to the Messages tab.-You find the following error: Cash ledger balance for Bank Account <bank account ID>  differs from register.-Go to Cash tab.-You see the Absolute difference.-Cause-You have created a tax payment via bank statement directly. The payment allocation is posted, which updated the balance in the cash-register, however the tax payment remains In Preparation (or In Approval).-Since this tax payment is not posted, the same amount was not updated in the ledger, which is causing the absolute difference in the reconciliation.-In order to help you to find the source of the difference, you may use the Cash Reconciliation report. Use the key date to identify precisely when the difference is raised. For example, if you have executed the Reconciliation run for 001/2018, you will see the same difference when you run the Cash Reconciliation with key date 31.01.2018.-Therefore, change the key date to i.e. 15.01.2018. If there is no difference in this date, you know that the transaction from where the difference comes from dates somewhere between 15.01.2018 and 31.01.2018 and so on. When you find the cut-off date, you may drill down the amount to the Payment List Reconciliation report and see the documents (usually Bank Statements) with the Proposed Posting Date equal to the key date in the report (cut-off date you found). In this bank statement ID, one of the transactions is a payment from or to a tax authority, whose payment allocation is creating the aforementioned tax payment.-Resolution-In order to clear the difference, you need to post the tax payment. After that you may re-run the Reconciliation run or the Cash Reconciliation report.

Title: Wrong Site Being Taken in the Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-System is taking the Ship-From Site ABC for Sales Order XXX automatically. However, the Site ABC has no stock and there is another Site DEF which has Available Stock. Although the Availability Check Scope in Product Master Data is Stock for both sites, the system is taking the empty one.-ABC = Site ID-DEF = Site ID-XXX = Sales Order ID-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select Sales Order view.-Search for the Sales Order XXX.-Open the Sales Order.-Select View All.-Choose Items.-Notice that system has taken the Site ABC automatically in the Ship-From field.-To check the Availability Check Scope, please follow the steps:-Double click product ID.-Select View All.-Choose Availability Confirmation.-Notice that the Availability Check Scope is maintained as Stock for Sites ABC and DEF-Cause-The Transport Lane Priority for Site ABC is higher than for Site DEF. If the Transport Lane Priority is higher for one site, the Availability Check Scope is not considered.-Resolution-In order to fix it, you need to change the Transport Lane Priority for Site ID ABC or DEF. To do so you can follow the steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Select Transport Lanes view.-Search for the respective Transport Lane.-Select the Transport Lane.-Click Edit Priority.-Change the Priority for Ship-From Site ID ABC to one lower than for DEF.-Save it.

Title: Limit Access To Post Journal Entries
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Apologies for the delay, since it took us-a while to test in the internal system for any work around,-unfortunately this is not supported. The reason being, the Dual Control-for Journal Entry Voucher comprises two possibilities:-1) Only create journal entry vouchers-2) Create and post journal entry vouchers-The idea behind this functionality is that user with access level #1 is-not able to post to accounting, but only create the documents to be-posted by someone else who has the approval to post to accounting-(create journal entries). From access level point of view it is not okay-that someone who could post a JEV is not able to create it also.-A possibility to only post journal entry vouchers without being able to-create them is currently not present in the latest Business ByDesign-release, the 1705.-We recommend you to post this idea in the SAP Idea Place for ByDesign-(https://ideas.sap.com/SAPByDesign). Your submitted ideas will be-checked by SAP and be eligible to be voted by other customers. Based on-the amount of votes the ideas might be collected to the development-backlog for future versions.-Please feel free to approach us for any further clarifications or to-reopen the incident if the issue still occurs.-At SAP, we are constantly working on improving the quality of our-service. Thus your input on how satisfied you are with our incident-processing is of great importance to us.-Sincerely,-Cryssal Pereira-SAP Cloud Product Support-Forum:-http://go.sap.com/community/topic/business-bydesign/all-content.html-____________________-27.07.2017 18:20:43 I332311-This is a limitation: 3100986147,GL Manager role has ability to create-Also, tested in the IRA, https://my316075.sapbydesign.com-Requirement: I need user id AABCE1111 to be able to ONLY Post JE's and-NOT create JE's.-So tested for the user AABCE1111(Name: A, ABC) as below.-Work Center / View ID: FIN_JOURNALENTRYVOUCHERSGL-Work Center / View Name: Journal Entry Vouchers-Assigned to User: Yes-Work Center / View ID: FIN_JOURNALENTRYVOUCHERSGL_CO-Work Center / View Name: Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only)-Assigned to User: No-This allows the user still to post and create JE's.-Conclusion: The solution for a user to ONLY post JE's, is not supported.-Reason: The Dual Control for Journal Entry Voucher comprises two-possibilities:-1) Only create journal entry vouchers-2) Create and post journal entry vouchers-The idea behind this functionality is that user with access level #1 is-not able to post to accounting, but only create the documents to be-posted by someone else who has the approval to post to accounting-(create journal entries). Title: Error: Product X of order YYYY: No Expense Posting for Price Determination
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are performing a revenue recognition run and see that it failed with the error message, Product X of order YYYY: No Expense Posting for Price Determination.-This is followed up with a warning stating that Service product X of order YYYY: No product price available.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition View.-Click Open the Run Id in question and then click open the Log Result.-Go to Messages tab where you see the error message and warning.-Cause-As per the current design of system, if the corresponding sales order item has accrual method Recognize at the point of Invoice and Customer Invoice is done against the sales order, then system first tries to calculate the material price from the Goods and Activity Confirmation, which is posted on or before the corresponding invoice. And if the Goods and Activity Confirmation posting date is greater than Customer Invoice posting date, system does not consider the Goods and Activity confirmation and tries to derive the inventory price then. If it doesn't find any, reported error occur in revenue recognition run.-Resolution-Verify the posting Date of Goods and Activity Confirmation and also the cost rate valuation price/labor cost rate of the product.

Title: Wrong Depreciation Calculation

Retained Earnings amount is showing as 'not assigned' in the report --US - I/S Nature of Expense - New ( ZU19 )-2. This Retained Earnings is showing under 'Retained earnings current-year' instead of Retained Earnings Previous Years in the report - US --Balance Sheet_New ( ZU01 )-( because of which the amount is showing under GL 303000 instead of-302000 ) ( The system does not transferred calculated Retained Earnings-Current year to Retained earnings Previous year )-Root Cause:-Retained Earnings in total is the sum of Retained Earnings(Posted)-<(>&<)> Retained Earnings(Calculated).-The Posted Ret. Earn. account is the GL account 300200 (Retained-Earnings Previous Years) which has a balance of (293.523.739,93) US-D through Data migration. This accounts gets the value whenever a-Balance Carry Forward is done and a new year is opened, then the-balances are carried forward to the new year.-The Calculated Retained Earnings is computed in the Financial Statement-to balance the equation Assets = Liabilities + Equity. The difference-amount calculated in this equation is put to the 0BSRESULT account. In-this case, a difference of (14.678.838,27) USD exists. This amount was-actually posted to the account 303000 by BCF. However, in the Financial-Statement, we move this balance to the account 0BSRESULT and make 303000-a zero balance account.-Solution:-When you perform a Balance Carry Forward at the end of the Fiscal Year,-then the same Calculated Retained Earnings balance will be put to 300200-account.-==> If the query is answered, please provide your positive feedback, by-following the provided link to our incident satisfaction survey, that-has been included in the Email with the proposed solution to your-reported issue.-Please send the incident back to us, in case of further questions-related to this issue. This accounts gets the value whenever a BCF is done and a new year is opened, then the-balances are carried forward to the new year.-The Calculated Retained Earnings is computed in the Financial Statement to balance the equation Assets = Liabilities + Equity. The d-ifference amount calculated in this equation is put to the 0BSRESULT account. In this case, a difference of (14.678.838,27) USD exis-ts. This amount was actually posted to the account 303000 by BCF. However, in the Financial Statement, we move this balance to the a-ccount 0BSRESULT and make 303000 a zero balance account.-When the customer will perform a BCF at the end of the FY, then the same Calculated Retained Earnings balance will be put to 300200-account.-Hope this clarifies. Title: How to Assign a Default Employee Responsible for Supplier Invoicing for all Invoicing Units
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Resolution-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to the Task Distribution view.-3. Select the Employee Work Distribution radio button.-4. Select the Business Area Employee Responsible for Supplier Invoices and select Edit.-5. Select Add Rule button under the Work Distribution Rules tab.-6. Select a responsible user and select Save.-Once you maintained the responsible user, you need to re-determine the assignment of the unassigned tasks to the responsible user. To do so:-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to the Task Distribution view.-3. Select the Business Task Management radio button.-4. Select the relevant Unassigned Items.-5. Select the button Determine Assignment.-The tasks would now appear in the Approvals view under Managing My Area work center of the responsible user defined.

Title: How to explicitly trigger - FinishScenario
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-It may happen that the tasks of Data Workbench are stuck with status “In Process”, there is a background job which triggers “FinishScenario” after six hours. If one wish to trigger it explicitly, below are the steps for the same. This will hit the “finish” end point on Data Workbench for the scenario, the “finish” writes the error file and then send end of scenario to C4C.-Resolution-Get the Scenario ID and Scenario Object ID using below steps.-Call the link: https://<tenant_host>/sap/c4c/odata/v1/dwbmonitor/ScenarioCollection?$filter=ScenarioName eq '<ScenarioName>'.-Take the field values of “ScenarioID” and “ObjectID”.-Log in to the system via SAP Logon.-Go To transaction SE24, enter the class name as “cl_cod_data_workbench_utils” and press F8 or click the execute button.-      6.    Just press enter for the below screen.-      7.   Click execute method for “TRIGGER_SCENARIO_FINISH” method.-      8.   Enter the Scenario ID in the field “IV_SCENARIO_ID” for which the “FinishScenario” needs to be triggered. Then click on the icon on the field “IV_OBJECT_ID” to enter the object ID of the scenario.-     9.   In the next screen, enter the object ID of the scenario and press “F3” or the back button on the screen.-     10.   Enter the technical user name and press “F8” or click the execute button.

Title: How to Change the E-mail Template for Remittance Advice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to change the standard e-mail writing that is created by the system when you issue an outgoing advice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Select your payment and click Create Remittance Advice.-You wish to change the e-mail writing that is sent to the remittee.-Resolution-In order to send e-mails in a given format, you have to upload a template in HTML format along with the form template for remittance advice.-Please, refer to the below steps in order to upload the template.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance subview.-Find the form template for Remittance Advice-Click Actions -> Create e-mail template and upload the HTML file with the required text.-After that, once the system sends a remittance advice form, the attached e-mail template is sent along, instead of the standard one.

Title: Cannot Reverse And Repost Journal Entry Due To Receivables Line Item
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to reverse and repost the credit memo from the Source Documents in the General Ledger work center but you get the error message:-Cannot Reverse And Repost Journal Entry Due To Receivables Line Item- Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents subview.-And search for your Source Document ID of the credit memo.-Click on Actions tab and select View Business Transaction.-Click on button Reverse and Repost.-Cause-It is technically not feasible to reverse and repost a credit memo which is already cleared. This is a system-definition.-Resolution-If the reverse and repost is really required then the clearing would have to be reset and the credit memo would have to be opened and then reverse and repost can be done.-Your credit memo is cleared against your customer invoice.-Go to Receivables work center and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customers Accounts subview.-Choose Customer XYZ, and then select View.-In the Trade Receivables tab, show Cleared Items.-You can see the credit memo is cleared, Click on clearing ID 123, then clearing overview screen gets opened here select view all button.-Click on Reset Clearing.-Since the credit memo is now separated from clearing and is with the status Open - you can now Reverse and Repost from the Source Documents, General Ledger work center.

Title: How to Enable XML Schema in Adobe LiveCycle Designer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to know how to enable the XML schema in Adobe LiveCycle Designer in order to work with the binding path.-Resolution-Open the form template in the Adobe LiveCycle Designer tool.-Click on the Data view tab.-Click on the right arrow.-Select Connection properties.-Give a connection name (not mandatory) and click Next.-Browse and select the XML file which you want to enable the XML schema.-Click Finish button.-The required XML schema will be loaded.-Now you will be able to navigate to find the required binding path.-

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-____________________-11.05.2017 12:01:46 I305826-Hello Colleagues,-As per the current design of the distribution run, (irrespective of any sequence) if the receiver cost center has postings against t-wo or more G/L accounts (say A, B, C and so on), then system consider only the amounts against first G/L account (A) to derive Perce-ntage and Distribution Factor, if ‘Distribution Factors’ and ‘Calculation Factors Based On’ maintained as “Based on costs” and “All-costs” respectively, in the assigned distribution rule.-Although, system calculates actual distribution amount appropriately (like you mentioned in memo #8).-Now if we talk about customer’s issue then, amongst all four receivers cost centers, only TRA has postings against two G/L accounts-3200000010 and 3203200005, with the amounts 111 EUR and 9652 EUR respectively. So here, system has only considered amount 111 EUR to-derive percentage and distribution factor, though entire amount has considered to calculate distribution amount (from cc CACAFC). A-ttached screen-shot for your reference.-Calculations, for cost center TRA, are explained as below:-        Total Cost to distribute (Sender) => 55463.01-        Total receivers cost => 8963,00 + 5692,00 + 10000,00 + 9763,00 (111 + 9652) = 34418-        Percentage => 111/34418 * 100 = 0.32 %-        Distribution Factor => 111/100 = 1.11-        Distribution Amount => 9763/34418 * 55463.01 = 15732.62-However, we feel this design is not correct and needs to be corrected, i.e., Distribution factor and Percentage are also needs to be-shown properly. Therefore, we have marked this issue as our improvement topic and will fix it later. (Can’t commit on timeline, as-extensive debugging and testing is required to fix this and we have prior commitments pending, for ongoing release)-Having said that, since distribution amount is getting calculated properly (which is required further for reporting, closing purpose-) and only percentage, distribution factor not appearing fine, this issue is not a show-stopper. Title: Reconciliation Report Error: There is a Difference Between Balance in Register and Balance in Cash
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you execute the reconciliation report you are getting error message : There is a Difference Between: Balance in Register and Balance in Cash. Absolute difference XXX.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger and select Reconciliation.-Select the Reconciliation Report which shows error and click Log Result.-Navigate to Messages tab.-Here you can see the error : There is a Difference Between: Balance in Register and Balance in Cash. Absolute difference XYZ.-Cause-There are documents for Reversal of Cash Disbursement posted in the month of your reconciliation report and which was previously confirmed in the bank statement already.-Go to Cash - Line Items Report.-Enter the same Bank Account / Petty Cash ID and other parameters.-Filter the Journal Entry Type: Reversal of Cash Disbursement.-You will observe the same amount, which is shown as absolute difference in Reconciliation Report will be shown here too. Since a reversal is posted for this amount the reconciliation shows this error.-Resolution-After you again post the relevant disbursement amount you can run the reconciliation report and succeeding reconciliation report will not carry this error message.

Title: Unable to Set Ready For Transfer Outgoing Check to In Transfer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to set the status of one Outgoing Check from Ready for Transfer to In Transfer, system gives you the error message: Action not enabled.-This case document only applies if the outgoing check is created before Nov. 1st, but later on voided, and system generates a new outgoing check.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Payment Management.-Select view Payment Monitor.-Filter with All Payments.-Choose the outgoing check in question, and select Actions for Checks, and choose Set to In Transfer, and you then get the error message. -Cause-This is a known issue that the outgoing check status is not correctly updated in the case that checks are generated after voiding a check. This is already corrected with two hotfixs which have been deployed to all 1308 systems on November 1st,  2013. So this will not happen again. The issue here is that this check is created before the hotfix deployment, so the issue still exists.--Resolution-We need to manually correct the inconsistency from the backend:-First of all, identify the check in question from backend:-Log on to the backend, and run Transaction Code: SESFTS.-Load BO by Proxy Name: FOPXP_OUTCHQ. ( Outgoing Check)-Load by Query: Query Query_By_Elements.-In the ID/Content field, enter the Check ID, which is the External Reference in the Payment Monitor view, or in the BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentReference/ID/content field, enter the Document ID of the outgoing check.-Check that you have found the right check (amount, date, etc), and check the Status/LifecycleStatus (e.g. it is Not issued = 1  or Issued = 2. ) Note: this status is correct. The only thing that is not correct is the status in another BO (Payment Register).-Find out the Split Item Node which has the wrong status:-From the outgoing check instance above, choose Navigate, and select SPLIT_ITEM.-This is the Payment Register – Split Item Node which has the wrong status.-Press on Edit Mode and simply change the field PaymentTransactionStatusCode accordingly:-if  the check status is Issued, then change from 3 (Ready For Transfer) to 4 (In Transfer).-Respectively it can also be that customer tries to change the check status back from Issued to Not Issued, then change the PaymentTransactionStatusCode from 4 to 3.-Save the change.

Title: Inbound File Upload Error: Unknown File Format
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are unable to upload Incoming File with the file type as Bank Transaction Status Notification due to the error-Unknown file format.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to File Management view and select Inbound Files subview.-Click New and select Inbound File.-Select File Type - Bank Transaction Status Notification - Company and Bank ID.-Cause-A default import format is assigned to the combination of your company and bank account but the file what you are trying to upload is in different format.-Resolution-Assign the same format which you are trying to upload as incoming file in the fine tune activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-On the Fine Tuning step, open the activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Click Assign import formats for bank statements.-Maintain the default format for the combination of Company, Country, Bank ID etc.-If you still get the error as Unknown File Format then you need to contact your bank and find out if there is any change in format or file is corrupt.

Title: Depreciation not Calculated Correctly With Transfer Posting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have performed a transfer from Asset Under Construction to Fixed Asset with a Capitalization / Depreciation date before current date. You expect the depreciation for the current period to include the depreciation from previous period (s) in current month-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Choose fixed asset XYZ and Edit.-Navigate to Values tab. By default the Book Values tab will open.-Go to Depreciation Overview-You observe that current period depreciation doesn't include the depreciation from previous periods.-Cause-The Initial Acquisition date has been set to current year based on the transfer posting data. The depreciation will not start before the initial acquisition date.  -Although the Capitalization and Depreciation Start date has been set to past, but asset will not start depreciating before the Initial Acquisition date.-Resolution-System works as expected. If you still want to include the depreciation from the previous periods, then you will have to reverse the asset transfer posting and re-do the transfer with the posting date in the past. Then the initial acquisition date will be set to past and then depreciation will be calculated for the previous periods as well.

Title: Enter Manual Paymt Format At Bank If No Elec. File Processing Required
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to modify the add/modify overdraft limit for a bank account but you are unable to save it due to the errror.-Enter Manual Paymt Format At Bank If No Elec. File Processing Required- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to My Banks subview.-Select your bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select the relevant bank account and go to the Account tab.-Go to Overdraft Limit field and modify/change the amount and save.-Enter Manual Paymt Format At Bank If No Elec. File Processing Required- Cause-If you view the payment method tab after receiving the error,you can find some of the payment methods are highlighted by the system, because for these payment methods the supported/ valid payment format is missing or deleted in the Payment Format tab-For example:-If the payment method highlighted is SEPA Credit Transfer then in the payment formats tab SEPA Credit Transfer format is deleted or missing.-Resolution-Remove all the payment methods which are erroneous and highlighted by the system or go to the Payment Formats tab and add the formats that can support the highlighted payment methods.-Once you do either of these then you will be able to change the overdraft limit for your bank account.

Title: Customer Invoice Cannot be Posted Due to Error Message: Determination of permanent establishment from SalesOrgnazisation XYZ failed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A customer invoice is not posted to accounting due to the error message: Determination of permanent establishment from SalesOrgnazisation XYZ failed.-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Not Posted Source Documents.-You can find there is a source document ABC with the Source Document Type being 28 - Customer Invoice.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the error message: Determination of permanent establishment from SalesOrgnazisation XYZ failed.- or-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Work view.-You can see an open task with the Subject being Determination of permanent establishment from SalesOrgnazisation XYZ failed.-Cause-The document date of the invoice is on DD. MM. YYYY. When you post the customer invoice to accounting, the system checks the validity of the sales organization on the customer invoice against this date, and finds out that the sales organization XYZ is not valid on this date yet, it then gives the error message: Determination of permanent establishment from SalesOrgnazisation XYZ failed.-Resolution--In order to successfully post the customer invoice to accounting, you have to adapt the timeline of the sales organization XYZ:-Go to the Organizational Management work center, and choose Edit Org Structures under Common Tasks.-Choose the sales organization XYZ.-Navigate to the Timelines tab.-Under the attribute of Functions, you can find the value Sales Organization.-Set the Valid From date with a date that is the same as or earlier than the document date of customer invoice ABC.-Save and Close.-Go back to the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Not Posted Source Documents.-Select the customer invoice ABC.-Choose View Business Transaction, and then try to post the customer invoice.-   You should be able to post the customer invoice without errors.

Title: How To Setup Dual Control for Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Dual Control for Journal Entry Voucher Posting Business option provides additional Workcenter views that restrict the authorization of the user to creating journal entry vouchers only. Users that have these work center views assigned to them cannot post journal entry  vouchers.-This affects journal entry voucher, Intercompany Journal entry voucher, and recurring journal entry voucher.-Resolution-You need to enable the following scoping option to use the Dual Control For Journal Entry Vouchers.-    Then you will get the following additional Workcenters while setting the Access Restrictions for the User. Using the following views, you can set up the access restrictions for the user to only create the Journal Entry Vouchers and restrict them from posting the Journal Entry Vouchers.-Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only)-Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only)-Recurring Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only)-Kindly follow the below instructions to setup the access restrictions to only create the Journal Entry Vouchers.-Go to Work Center Application and User Management-Go to the view User And Access Management  and Search for a Business User-Select/highlight the User and press Edit and choose Access Rights-Find the Work center/View ID: FIN_GENERALLEDGER and uncheck the option for  Journal Entry Voucher-Check the option for Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only)-Note: You can allow the Users to access either Journal Entry Vouchers or Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only) and cannot assign both Views together [ at a given point of time, one user can only have one option but not both the options at the same time].-Find the Work Center/View ID: PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT and uncheck this.-Press the button Save And Close-After maintaining the above settings, user will have the option of Journal Entry Voucher (Create Only) but not the normal Journal Entry Voucher. User will be able to only save the Journal Entry Voucher and cannot post it-You can similarly setup the access restrictions for Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only) and Recurring Journal Entry Vouchers (Create Only).

Title: State Missing Error While Creating A New VAT Tax Entry From Excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to create a new VAT tax entry from excel and noticed that the state/province field is missing which is very important during tax calculation in the template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center.-Go to Manual Tax Entries View.-Go to VAT Entries Sub-View.-Click on New > Tax Entry from Microsoft Excel-Log in Business ByDesign system.-Fill out the excel file.-Note: You notice that no field is available to enter state/province.-While saving the data you get the message as 1 record(s) failed to save due to the errors : state missing.-Cause-It is the current system-behaviour that you are not able to view the state field in the excel template.-Resolution-Excel template is enhanced from release 1311 onwards and you will be able to view and enter the profit center for revenue and balance accounts.-In Order to fix this issue, in the lower version systems you have been provided with a workaround to enhance the template yourself.-Go to Application and  User Management work center.-Select the Business Flexibility > Microsoft Office template maintenance.-Select Advance search for Template Group and Enter Manual Tax Entries Upload.-Here you also find a description how to enhance the template manually-Open the Excel template and navigate to the "Developer" tab register.-Choose "Source" to display the XML source.-In the XML source window select the XML map "SAP_BYD_MAIN". => Now you can see the structure of the XML map.-Look for the element "ManualTaxEntry -> AccountAssignment -> ChangeStateID".-This element has to be mapped to a column for the item table in the Excel sheet.

Title: How to Display the Account Assignment in Approval Task Subject
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You try to approve a project invoice in the Managing My Area work center, but in the approval task subject, you need to edit the approval task to know the Account Assignment.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-You need to approve the invoice XXZ.-The Account Assignment of invoice XYZ is PRO - Project Task ABC.-But in the approval task subject , You cannot find it . Currently, you need to Edit the approval task to know the Account Assignment.--Resolution-In order to to display the account assignment in approval task subject, follow the steps below:-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Click on Actions button on the header level.-Under Actions dropdown, you can see Open details.-Here you can click on Open Details which should allow you to view the task without you being the owner for the same.--Note: As part of the standard functionality, SAP Business ByDesign does not have a feature to enhance the subject line with account assignment feature.

Title: Excise Tax Annexure Report Shows Positive Amounts for Canceled Invoices
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Excise Tax Annexure Report shows positive amounts under columns Tax Base amount, BED, EC on Excise Duties, SHEC on Excise Duties for canceled Invoices but you expect that they show negative amounts for canceled Invoices.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Show All Reports and Find Excise Tax Annexure 10 Report.-Give the selection criteria as Posting date of Canceled Invoice and Choose Go.-You could see that the Canceled Invoice shows positive amounts.-Cause-You should have used Deprecated/Obsolete fields in the Report such as Tax Base Amount (Deprecated), BED (Deprecated), EC on Excise Duties (Deprecated), SHEC on Excise Duties (Deprecated).-These Obsolete fields show positive values.-Resolution-You can change the Deprecated/Obsolete fields to valid fields by following steps:-Go to Business Analytics Work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Show All Reports and Find Excise Tax Annexure 10 Report.-Choose Edit with Web Browser.-Go to Settings tab and then to Key Figures view.-Under Key Figure Settings, choose Edit.-Select Tax Base Amount, SHEC on Excise Duties, EC on Excise Duties and BED from Available and move to Selected and move Tax Base Amount (Deprecated), EC on Excise Duties (Deprecated), SHEC on Excise Duties (Deprecated), BED (Deprecated) to Available.-Excise Tax Annexure Report will show the negative amounts for Canceled Invoices once this is done.

Title: Migration of Material Valuation Data Error: Wrong currency; cost should be in ABC only.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-During migration of Material Valuation Data the following error is raised: Wrong Currency; cost should be in ABC only.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Go to view Implementation Projects.-Click button Open Activity List.-Search and open activity Migrate of Material Valuation Data.-Click link Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool.-Select the file.-Click Execute Migration.-During the simulation step the error occurs: Wrong Currency; cost should be in ABC only-Cause-If you try to migrate the data with non-company currency, you get this error message. Non-company currency is not allowed currently for migration.-Resolution-Change the Currency in the Material Valuation Data template to company currency and start the migration again. After that, the system does not prompt you with the error message.

Title: Maximum Number of Labor Resources in The System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You wish to know whether there is any technical limitation in the system for the number of labor resources.-Resolution-There is no limitation on the total number of resources in the system. The limitation could be how many records can be created in one transaction and this depends on the performance of the web-Service or add-on used to create the resources.

Title: Inventory Value Zero For A Product In Material Inventories - Balance Summary Report.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have added stock to some products and observed that stock overview for the same is reflecting correctly under On-Hand Stock but it does not reflect the same in Material Inventories - Balance Summary Report.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center or alternatively to the Physical Inventory work center.-Select the Stock Overview link under the Common tasks-Enter a Product ID XYZ and press the Go button.-The system shows the On-Hand Stock that you have added.   -Now you run the Material Inventories - Balance Summary Report.-Business Analytics work center choose Design Report view.-Find and run the Material Inventories - Balance Summary report.-Enter the desired values on the Selection screen and select Go-For this example add Material XYZ-You observe that Inventory Value and Inventory Quantity shows as zero and is not matching with its Stock Overview-Cause-Please note that Stock Overview is immediately updated based on Supply Chain processes. However, if corresponding financial postings are pending, then material balance report will not be updated until financial posting is completed.-Resolution-For the pending financial posting the system creates a Business Task Management tasks and the documents will be found in the un-posted view under the source documents in the  General Ledger work center with the document type as Goods and Activity Confirmation.- If you able to figure out the reason for the error message, correct it and come here and post the business transaction - else report an incident to know how to fix the error.-See Also-1791575 - Error Message - No value of subtransaction company , setofbooks XYZ, BO out FIA_PRODUCTION_LACCT, BO in FIA_MATERIAL_LEDGER_ACCT

Title: Credit Amount is Double the Debit Amount In The Accounts Receivables - Line Items Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are checking the total amount of a certain receivable with the Accounts Receivable - Line Items report.-You notice that the credit amounts shows as twice the amount of debit amounts for certain lines, for example journal entry type - cash receipt.- Reproducing the Issue-In the Receivables work center navigate to the Reports-List view.-Open the Accounts Receivable - Line Items report.-Maintain the mandatory variable fields as well as the select the customer to check the amounts.-You observe that credit amount is double the amount of debt amount for certain lines and you see the journal entry type for that is cash receipt.-Cause-In Account Receivable sub-ledgers, some postings are not General Ledger relevant (for example: Reset Clearing might happen multiple times). Hence, in Accounts Receivable – Line Items report, you get the aggregated view which shows aggregated data for both G/L relevant and Not G/L relevant postings.---You will observe that the same amount is shown twice. This is because there is a clearing which is happening for this customer invoice with the payment. The data for these postings is managed exclusively in the sub ledger so that items of an account are assigned to each other. This is not relevant for general ledger accounting. In the case of journal entry - because it is used to clear open items - no general ledger relevant line items are generated.--Resolution-You need to drag the field Not G/L relevant from the Not Currently Shown pane into the report's rows. Any journal entry, has 2 kinds of posting:--"#" in the Not G/L relevant field means related with G/L posting.-"X" in the Not G/L relevant field means non G/L posting.--In order to match the debit & credit amounts in the report then filter the Not G/L relevant into the report.-In order to match the figures in the Trade Receivables tab of a Customer Account with the Accounts Receivable - Line Items report, you need filter the not G/L relevant posting out from the report.

Title: Outgoing Check Payment Error : Bank Account 123 Does Not Support Payment Method Check
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to make outgoing check payment but you errors as-Payment method details are not determined-Bank account 123 does not support payment method check.-Reproducing the Issue-  Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier XYZ, and then choose View.-Choose one Open Item, and then choose Pay Manually By-Select payment method Outgoing Check-Fill all the required fields.-or-Go to work center Payment Management.-Go to view Payment Monitor.-Select New Payment By -> Outgoing Check.-Fill all the required fields.- You get the error message as above-Cause-For the Bank 123 the payment method are correctly defined as Check printing-For example : First check is from 1 and last check is 20 and you give the check number as 21 in outgoing check payment.-Things to observe here is in the next check field in the bank account will be blank & last check 20 will in the place of current check indicating that the checks are completely utilized and you are giving a check number which is not from the check lot.-Resolution-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to MyBanks subview.-Select your bank and click Edit -> Bank Accounts-Select the relevant bank account and go to the Check Lot tab-Add Row and set up a new one.-Maintaining new check lot for the bank account  resolves this issue and you can try making the check payment by selecting the check within the range of the new check lot.
