Title: Schedule Reminder Emails for Pending Approvals Functionality Doesn't Works as Expected
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to use the functionality Schedule Reminder Emails For Pending Approvals in order to schedule a run that sends reminder emails to the approvers who have time recordings or leave requests that are waiting for their approval, however you notice that you cannot schedule the run, it is performed a single time.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Common Tasks > Schedule Reminder Emails for Pending Approvals.-Enter any text on mandatory field Run ID.-Click Schedule.-Note that there are no options to configure the schedule of the run. The system informs that The run will be scheduled immediately and you see an information message on the page bottom: Your entries have been saved.-Right after, the approvers who have pending approval tasks in their names (time recordings or leave requests) start receiving emails with subject REMINDER: Pending Approval Tasks.-Cause-The current functionality Schedule Reminder Emails For Pending Approvals doesn't offer the scheduling facility. Once you click Schedule an immediate e-mail generation is triggered and all the approvers with pending approval tasks are notified.-SAP is working on refining this functionality and plan to offer the scheduling capability in Business ByDesign 1502 Release (expected for February 2015).-Resolution-Until the arrival of the refined functionality you can still use the Schedule Reminder Emails For Pending Approvals in a manual mode by clicking Schedule button every time you want to trigger e-mail generation for the approvers with open approval tasks.

Title: Supplier Invoice Posted to Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables Instead of Purchase In Transit
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have migrated the Purchase Order into the system and posted a supplier invoice and noticed that the Debit entry is posted to Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables instead of Purchase In Transit.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Journal Entries view.-Choose Advanced.-In the Journal Entry Type field select Journal Entry Type 00023 - Supplier Invoice.-Select your source document id XXX and view the posting.-Your Expected posting is:-Purchase in Transit is debited.-Actual Posting:-Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables is Debited.-Cause-Your invoice has a reference to a Purchase Order, which was Migrated but additionally you have set the order Migrated Code as Not Migrated.-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos.-Select Supplier Invoice 123 and Edit.-Navigate to Items and subtab Basic Data.-Under Buyer References-You notice that for Order Migration Code is set as Not Migrated.-Resolution-As a rule, for Migrated Purchase Orders, the system posts the Open Goods Receipt to migration clearing account 990070 - Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables, due to this the system ensures that Supplier Invoice also posts to this same account -If you want to move the balance from this Initial Data CarryForward Unbilled Payables to Purchase in Transit then,-Finish the pending Goods Receipt, pending invoice Quantity if any.-Finish the Purchase Order and post GR/IR Clearing Run.-Post the Manual Journal Entry Voucher in order to remove the amount from Migration Clearing account and move it to the Profit & Loss account.

Title: Forgot Password Link on the Logon Screen Does Not Validate the Email Address Entered by You
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The forgot your password link on the initial logon screen does not validate the email address entered by you if it is correct or not. The system does not validate the email address based on what is in the system and no error message is displayed.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the logon screen.-Click on Forgot your password.-Fill out an email address which does not exist in the system and it is not assigned to anyone.-The system does not send an email to such email address which is expected; nevertheless the system does not display any warning message.-Cause-For security reasons the system does not display any information to the user if the entered email address is valid and existing in the system. This shall prevent the misuse to search for valid email addresses in the system.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.

Title: VAT on Service Tax calculation on Software Purchase (India) /New VAT rate on Software Purchase (India)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-As per the Tax rule in India when you buy Software,  both VAT and Service Tax will be applicable. VAT will be calculated on Software Price plus Service Tax amount eg.  [(Software Price Rs. 100 + Service Tax 12.36 = Total Amount ( 100 + 12.36) * VAT Rate ].-- Cause-Tax Code 75 - Purchase (VAT & ST) is already there in the system but  it will calculate Tax on the Base Amount eg. Software Price say Rs. 100 and Tax Code-75 Purchase (VAT & ST), under this  both VAT and Service Tax calculated on Rs. 100 ( on the Software Price). Tax Code 75 will be calculating as per VAT on Service Tax principle. Due to reason there will be mismatch on the  VAT Tax amount.-Resolution-In order to overcome such mismatches in the VAT Tax amount, there is a workaround to solve this issue. The Tax Amount can be changed in the Supplier Invoice for any transact ion, please follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Select the View of Common Tasks and then select New Invoice Without Purchase Order-Then Click on  the View All button-Fill your require details for the supplier Invoice like Material Item Details eg. Software License, select the Tax Code- 75 - Purchase (VAT & ST), price and other details-After filling the above mentioned details, then go to the General Tab, you select Taxes tab, under that select Tax Details sub tab and there you have the option adjust your Tax Amount manually in the Tax Amount field.-Under that select Tax Details sub tab and there you have the option adjust your Tax Amount manually in the Tax Amount field.-Then calculate the Total Gross Amount & Total Tax Amount  as per your calculation , put it manually in those fields and click on the Save button.-Document will get save and it will generate document ID.-Select the view of Invoices and Credit Memos and find your desired document with the ID.-You can see that your Invoice is In Process status , click on the Edit button.-Clarify the Exception ( Accept the Exception ) and then Post.-Now your document has got posted with the different tax amount which you have manually adjusted.-

Title: Asset XYZ Entry Missing For Period Determination In Fiscal Year Variant Y1
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to acquire a fixed asset using invoice process. However, the invoice is not posting to accounting showing an error Asset XYZ Entry Missing For Period Determination In Fiscal Year Variant Y1. Consequently the asset is not created in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and then choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Not Posted Source Documents.-You can see supplier invoice XYZ is on the list.-Choose View Business Transaction.-      You can see the error message: Asset XYZ Entry Missing For Period Determination In Fiscal Year Variant Y1-Cause-You have designed an own fiscal year variant for which you have not maintained period control keys for the fiscal year in question.-Example:-Your defined fiscal year is non calendar that starts from 21.6.2014 to 19.6.2015-Period control maintained till 2014 only-Invoice posting date 07.08.2014 falls under year 2015 because of Non-calendar that you are following-Resolution-In order to successfully post the supplier invoice, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project in question, and choose Open Activity List. -Navigate to the fine tune step, and open the activity Other Fiscal Year.-Click on open and select your fiscal year variant.-Select subtab Period Control for Fixed Assets under the Fiscal Year Variant Details.-Maintain settings for your current fiscal year i.e 2015 and try again posting your un-posted invoice for fixed assets.

Title: No Cost Center in The Accounting Document of A Physical Inventory Difference Posting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you post physical inventory difference to accounting, the cost center assignment is missing for the accounting document line items.-Reproducing the Issue-In the 'General Ledger' work center, choose the 'Journal Entries' view.-Select the 'Journal Entries' subview.-Select a journal entry with the 'Journal Entry Type' being Goods Issue without Reference.-Click on 'View'.-In the 'Journal Entry' tab, you can see the 'Cost Center ID' is missing for each of the line items.-Cause-In the Business ByDesign system, it is not provided to assign cost centers to the accounting document line items of a physical inventory difference posting.-Resolution-If you post a physical inventory difference to accounting, the corresponding accounting document has the following two items:-Raw Material Inventory-Gain/Loss from Physical Inventory-Both items have the material as the revelant subledger information. So there is no possiblility to assign a cost center to the accounting document.

Title: No Overhead Amount Calculated in the Overhead Run for Direct Cost Projects
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You execute an Overhead Run for Direct Cost Projects, but in the Processed Successfully tab of the run, you can see the Overhead Amount for the processed project tasks is zero.- Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Direct Cost Projects - Overhead Absorption subview.-Choose Overhead Run for Direct Cost Projects under New.-Enter a Run Description.-Select Test Run if you want to perform a simulation of the run.-Select the Company and the Set of Books.-In the Project field, select XYZ.-Select the Closing Step that you want the system to use for the postings.-In the Period/Year field, enter XXX/YYYY for which you want to execute the overhead run.-Choose Start Now.-When the run is finished, go back to the Direct Cost Projects - Overhead Absorption subview.-Select the run ABC that has just been performed, and choose View.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab. -You can see the Overhead Amount for project XYZ is listed as zero.- Cause-You create overhead rules to specify how overhead is absorbed by cost objects, such as projects, production lots, or service orders. The overhead rules are automatically assigned to projects based on assignment rules that you specify in the overhead rule. Overhead rules are comprised out of overhead rates in which the accounts that make up your calculation base are specified.  If no direct costs of the projects are posted to these accounts, then there is no relevant data for the Overhead Run for Direct Cost Projects to process.-The overhead rule assigned to project XYZ is DEF. Follow the steps below to check the details of overhead rule DEF:-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center, and choose the Master Data and Allocations view.-Select the Overhead Rules subview.-Search overhead rule DEF and choose Edit.-Navigate to the Overhead Rates tab.-Under Calculation Base, you can see there are two accounts maintained.-As mentioned above, only postings to these two accounts are read by the Overhead Run for Direct Cost Projects. But if you check the Project Costs -Line Items report for period XXX and project XYZ, you can see there is no posting to these two accounts, which is why the processed amount is zero.

Title: Bill of Exchange Deposit - In File Creation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You release a Bill of Exchange Deposit. This release should automatically trigger the generation of an outbound file for your bank. Instead, the status of the file is In File Creation but it is not being generated.-Reproducing the Issue-In the Payment Management workcenter navigate to the Deposits -  Bill of Exchange Deposits view.-Select the respective bill of exchange deposit and press Actions - Release. This release generates a file, which can be downloaded and sent to your bank.-Navigate to the Liquidity Management workcenter and there to File Management - Outbound Files.-The file of type Bill of Exchange Deposit is in status In File Creation. This status does not change and the payment file is not being generated.-Cause-A bill of exchange deposit payment file cannot be generated when there are certain details of the used bank account missing. Most common issues relate to the missing bank account description.-It is also possible that the chosen deposit file format is not valid for bill of exchange deposit files.-Resolution-In the Liquidity Management workcenter navigate to Master Data - My Banks.-Select the respective bank and then press Edit - Bank Accounts.-If there is none maintained enter an Account Description for the bank account that you are using for the bill of exchange deposit.-Now navigate to the Payment Formats tab.-Here make sure that the Payment Medium Format Code FR AFB Bill of Exchange Deposit is maintained.-Press Save.- These changes will NOT trigger the completion of the bill of exchange deposit file creation. Therefore you need to reverse the bill of exchange deposit and create a new one, assign your payments and then release this new bill of exchange deposit. This time the outbound file will be generated.-

Title: Missing Service Tax Accounting Code leads to error 'Standard Classification Code is initial' when Creating Service Tax Payment
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are unable to make service tax payment due to the error Standard Classification Code is initial. Moreover you cannot select your required service tax accounting code as the list is limited.-This primarily relates to localization India.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Select Tax Payment view.-Open the tax payment with In Preparation Status -Selected Tax Payment Type is Tax Prepayment and Tax Return Arrangement ID is Service Tax Challan.-Click on View All.-Attempt to Post.-First of all you are not able to view the required accounting codes for selection under Prepayment Data.-You are presented with the error: Standard Classification Code is initial.-Cause-A list of service accounting codes comes already pre-delivered by the system. However, if you you want to use other codes than those already maintained in the system you are required to manually maintain the corresponding settings.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Choose the Implemented Projects view-Go straight to Fine-Tune icon and select Show All Activities-Search for Product Tax Standard Classification Code for India - Service-Open this activity and click on the link Service tax Accounting Codes-Maintain the values you require and save it.-The tax authority provides you with a list of service tax accounting codes. You must enter the service tax accounting codes that you need and the corresponding service names.

Title: Unable To Release New Bank Payment Advice Due To Error Message Releasing The Allocation Not Possible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You get the error message Releasing the allocation not possible; Save failed-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks section.-Select the activity New Bank Payment Advice-On the new screen, Select debit or credit advice as per your requirement-Activate the flag Posting Advice and fill the mandatory fields-Activate the flag Direct Posting to G/L Account-Select the General Ledger Account group and relevant information-Click on Release-  You get the error message Releasing the allocation not possible; Save failed.-Cause-You have selected the reporting principle which supports Income Statement by Function of Expense. For Instance: Function of expense.-With this principle, the Functional Area characteristic is included in your journal entries. But with the payment advise you are trying to release - the system could not find a combination of general ledger account and the relevant function area for it or a default functional area to select. Consequently the system could not post the transaction and the release fails.-   Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Activity List and choose Fine-Tune.-In the Fine-Tune Activities look for the activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-If you choose Edit Functional Areas-Ex:Activate the Default Flag against "Not assigned functional area(P/L accts) and save.-If you choose Functional Area Determination-You can select the general ledger account and assign the functional area which is missing.-Now you should be able to post the bank payment advice without any error and basically if you are using cost related reporting principle, journal entries will get posted along with functional areas and incase functional area is not determined or no default functional area is assigned in the system it will not allow postings.

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run Status Shows In-Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have run the Goods Receipt and Invoice Receipt Clearing (GR/IR Clearing) but the run was not successful and showing the status as In Process.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center-Select the GR/IR Clearing sub view under the Period Tasks view.-Select the Run ID.-Status shows In Process and unable to set it to finish.-Cause-Recalculate items flag was set to true . When this flag is set to true , all the purchase orders in the system until the selection period in the run are processed irrespective of the status of the clearing sets, i.e., even if they are posted . This leads to a huge amount of data which cannot be handled and has resulted in a memory overflow.-Resolution-The recalculate items flag has to be used only on specific purchase orders which needs to be corrected .Otherwise this will cause huge performance issues. The recalculate items feature is meant to be used only for singular purchase orders. For a normal GR/IR run , entire periods can be executed.

Title: Unexpected Manual Payment Clearing Task in the Closing-Relevant Tasks List
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You create a bank statement, in the third step, you add an incoming bank transfer item, and assign it to one customer. Now this payment shows up in the Trade Receivable account of this customer as an open item. But in the Closing-Relevant Tasks list,there is still a manual payment clearing task expecting you to assign the incoming payment to this customer account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, choose the Bank Statements view.-Open the bank statement in question.-For the concerned item, choose the Required link, the system then opens a Manual Clearing screen which expects to clear the payment on the customer account in question.-Then go to the Receivables work center, choose the Customers view.-Select the Customer Accounts subview.                             -Open the concerned customer account, and you can see the payment is already shown as an open item there.-Cause-Before the 1308 release, when you manually create an incoming payment in a bank statement and assign it to a customer account, if there is no open item on the customer account to match this item, the system creates a payment allocation first.-From 1308 release onwards,this process is changed in a way that the system directly assigns the payment on account for the customer, but it creates a clearing task for you to confirm whether to clear with other items, or just keep it on account, if you just click Clear, the system then automatically sets it to On Account Payment.-Resolution-For this Manual Payment Clearing task, you can just click Clear, the system then automatically sets it to On Account Payment. After that, the payment still stays on the customer account, and the task is finished.

Title: Field Disappears When Creating Depreciation Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You try to create a fixed asset depreciation run, after you specify the Assignment Type as Cost Center, and select a cost center from the drop-down list, the Assignment Type field is empty, moreover, the whole Cost Center field disappears.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center, and choose the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Depreciation subview.-Create New Depreciation Run for all the companies.-Specify the Assignment Type as Cost Center.-From the Cost Center drop-down list, select a value.-Then the Assignment Type field is empty, and the whole Cost Center field just disappears.-Cause-This is a known issue, and it's fixed in 1308 and higher releases.-Resolution-For the moment, after the field disappears, you can still successfully create the deprecation run if you set Assignment Type with the same value specified before, in this case, Cost Center, then the Cost Center field should show up again with the same value selected earlier.

Title: Migration of Bills of Exchange Payables and Receivables
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to migrate Bills of Exchange Payables, and Bills of Exchange Receivables into the system, but there are no such migration templates in the system, and you are not sure if Open Items Payables template and Open Items Receivables template should be used to migrate Bills of Exchange Payables and Bills of Exchange Receivables.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the target project, and choose Open Activity List.-Select the Prepare step, and show Activities in Projects.-Open the Prepare for Data Migration activity.-Choose Download migration templates.-Under the Transaction Data Financial Accounting section, you cannot see templates related to Bills of Exchange Payables and Bills of Exchange Receivables. -Cause-Bills of exchange are currently only supported for France, and will be supported for Italy and Spain later in Feature Pack 4.0. So bills of exchange are not in the scope of the country version for China, and cannot be migrated into the related system.

Title: You Cannot Log On to the System Using HTML5 and SSO
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to access the system using HTML5 and Single Sign-On (SSO); however you are not able to do so.-Reproducing the Issue-Open your browser and enter the following URL:-https://myXXXXXX-sso.travel.ondemand.com/sap/public/byd/runtime?client_type=html-The connection is not redirected to your Identity Provider (IdP) and then you cannot log on to the system using SSO and HTML5.-Cause-You can add a string to your system URL to use HTML5 client, but such string is different when you log on via SSO.-Resolution-Add the string /sap/public/byd/runtime?client_type=html to your Non-SSO URL to log on using HTML5:-https://myXXXXXX.travel.ondemand.com/sap/public/byd/runtime?client_type=html-Add the string /sap/byd/runtime?client_type=html to your SSO URL to log on using HTML5 and SSO:-https://myXXXXXX-sso.travel.ondemand.com/sap/byd/runtime?client_type=html

Title: Unposted Goods And Service Receipt : An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset; Posting Leads To Different Acquisition Cost Amount
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have posted a Goods and Service Receipt (GSR) but it appears as unposted source document in the General Ledger work center due to error message : An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset XYZ; Asset XYZ Val View X: Posting Leads To Different Acquisition Cost Amount-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center, choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Show Unposted Source Documents.-Select the not posted goods and services receipt document in question.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the same error message: An Error Occurred During Depreciation Calculation For Asset XYZ; Asset XYZ Val View X: Posting Leads To Different Acquisition Cost Amount.-Cause-If you see the purchase orders status for this GSR, the delivery status is already Completed. Therefore accounting will not accept another GSR that refers to the same purchase order item.-   Resolution-Since the original GSR appears as unposted source document its cancellation will also appear here. They both can be marked as irrelevant as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center and choose the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Documents subview.-Here you can see both. the original GSR as well as its cancellation.-Select the cancelation document and pres View Business Transaction.-Choose Mark as Irrelevant. This way both, the cancellation GSR as well as the original GSR are not relevant for posting and will no longer appear as unposted source documents.

Title: Cannot Post New Charge/Credit Due to Error Message: For debtor, use either revenue account or post to GL account only
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You try to post a New Charge/Credit to an expense G/L account from the Receivables work center, but the system gives you an error message: For debtor, use either revenue account or post to GL account only. Your system is with Feature Pack 3.0, and you are sure that you never meet the same issue back in Feature Pack 2.6 system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customer Accounts subview.-Select the customer XYZ, and choose View.-Choose New Charge/Credit.-In the New Charge/Credit screen, enter the required information.-In the Line Items table, choose Add Row.-From the drop-down list of the General Ledger Account, select the an Expense Account ABC .-From the Project task drop-down list, select a project task DEF.-Post it.-The system gives you an error message: For debtor, use either revenue account or post to GL account only.- Cause-For a New Charge/Credit in the Receivables work center, only revenue accounts are allowed if there is a cost object as project task  assigned, Expense accounts are only allowed if there is no cost object as project task assigned, which means it only allows posting to expense G/L account only.-Because of payment differences problems during the payment processing , this additional check is introduced since Feature Pack 3.0 system, so from Feature Pack 3.0 on,  it is no longer possible to post a New Charge/Credit to an expense account in combination with a project task.-Because the G/L account ABC you select is an expense account, also project task is combined, so the system gives an error message: For debtor, use either revenue account or post to GL account only.- Resolution-In order to successfully post the New Charge/Credit, follow the steps below:-Go to the Receivables work center, and choose the Customers view.-Select the Customer Accounts subview.-Select the customer XYZ, and choose View.-Choose New Charge/Credit.-In the New Charge/Credit screen, enter the required information.-In the Line Items table, choose Add Row.-In the drop-down list of the General Ledger Account field, select the value ABC which is a revenue account if you want to assign a project task, or remove the combined project task if you want to post to an expense account.-Post it.-

Title: Recurring Time Accounts Have the Same Year in Their Description
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-For a certain Time Account Type (e.g. Paid Time Off) you defined its Creation as Recurring in the respective fine tuning activity Time Accounts - <Country>. Later on, while checking the Time Accounts created by this recurrence you noticed that two Time Accounts were created with the same year on their description, even though they are set up with different Bookable periods.-Reproducing the Issue-Check the Time File for the employee to whom the Time Accounts were assigned:-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the respective employee-Click Edit-Move to Time Account Balances tab-Notice that two Time Accounts with exactly same description exist (e. g. Paid Time Off 2015), even though they have different Bookable periods (Bookable From / Bookable To).-Cause-The reason for the same year in the Time Account descriptions is the periods defined as Bookable From and Bookable To.-Time Account descriptions for Recurring Time Accounts are created as follows:--1. If Time Account identifying period is bigger than half year (e. g. Bookable From 01.05.2014), then the Identifying Start Year is added to description i. e. Paid Time Off 2014 etc.-An exception happens when the start month is 10 (October). In this case the Identifying End Year is added to the Time Account description.-The logic behind this is the assumption that most bookings from time account might happen in the following year, therefore the end year is used to clarify the description.--2. If Time Account identifying period is lesser than half year (e. g. Bookable From 31.07.2014) then the Time Account description does not include a year value.-Take a look on this example:-The first Time Account Paid Time Off is defined as Bookable From 20.10.2014 and Bookable To 30.04.2015. This Time Account will be named as Paid Time Off 2015 as the start month is 10.-The second Time Account Paid Time Off is defined as Bookable From 01.05.2015 and Bookable To 30.04.2016. This Time Account will be named as Paid Time Off 2015 as well, since the identifying period is bigger than half year.--In this way, the first time account takes the end date year of 2015 and the second time account takes the start date year of 2015.-  Resolution-This is the current system behavior for SAP Business ByDesign 1502 release.-Nevertheless, this behavior is under discussion for the next SAP BusinessByDesign releases and a solution should be available in the next software versions. An enhancement of this functionality is being considered as a new feature.-At this point in time, we are not in a position to provide more accurate information on date and/or timelines for this future release.-

Title: Error When Uploading Material Unit Costs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While uploading Material Unit Costs using Microsoft Excel you receive the following error message: The remote Server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Master Data view -> Material Unit Costs subview.-Select Import Unit Cost -> From Microsoft Excel®.-Logon in the system using the SAP Add-In.-Fill the required data.-Press Save Data To.-The error: The remote Server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error. is shown.-Cause-Selection list fields such as Cost UoM or Cost Type were wrongly maintained. Fields are case sensitive.-Resolution-Please check all selection list fields and maintain according the value selection (lower or upper case).

Title: Down Payments are Reevaluated in Foriegn Currency Remeasurement Runs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have observed that Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs for Payables is taking into consideration of Down Payments. As per IAS 21,Down Payments should not be taken inconsideration in Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work center.-Go to Periodic Tasks view.-Go to Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs subview.-Find Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run ID XYZ.-Go to Details:Logfiles.-Go to Log Result.-Go to Processed Successfully view.-You see that Down Payments are also considered by the run.-Resolution-It's the current system design that Foriegn Currency Remeasurement Runs will even remeasure the Down Payments if the relevant Business Partner is selected.-You can only adjust the Journal Entries by manual vouchers later after the Foriegn Currency Remeasurement Runs.

Title: Error Message : Tax Return Arrangement Does not Exist while running New Tax Return Run.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to run a new tax return run, but you are getting the error message Tax Return Arrangement Does not Exist.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Work Center-Go to Common Tasks View-Click on the New Tax Return Run Sub-view-Enter the details required and Tax Return Arrangement ID: XYZ.--You get the error message as  Tax Return Arrangement Does not Exist.-Cause-The tax return arrangement has not been created. That is the reason you are getting the error message.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select Company Tax Arrangements view.-Edit the selected the company tax arrangement.-Click on sub-view Tax Return Arrangements under company tax arrangement tab.-Select Add row and add the tax arrangement id XYZ and the required details.-Save.-Now the tax return arrangement id XYZ is available in value help for selection in the activity new tax return run and you will be able to complete the tax return run.-

Title: Patch is not Getting Assembled to Original Solution but to the Patch Version
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have observed that the patch you have created is not getting uploaded to the original Solution but to the patch version of the solution in the test tenant.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the original solution in the test tenant.-Go to the current version tab of the Implementation Manager.-Click on the button Upload.-The patch will be uploaded with the new namespace and not to the original solution.-Cause-The system behavior is as expected. The reason why the patch is directly uploaded with the new namespace is that the test tenant and the production tenant are in the same system.-In this case if you try to upload the solution you will get a pop up window with the warning message: Please note that an older version of this solution already exists on the production tenant.-If you click on OK in this pop up then the solution will be uploaded with new namespace. So if it is only test tenants in the system then original namespace would have been picked during upload of patch.-Resolution-You can follow either of the below solutions:---You can terminate the production tenant if you do not want to use the tenant.-            If you terminate the production system then you will be able to upload the patch solution to your Original solution. After this if you try to upload the patch you will get a pop up to select whether you want to add to the original solution or as a new namespace. Here you need to select    the Merge with the original solution in the pop up window.-    2.   You can directly upload the patch solution to the production tenant and that will trigger an automatic deployment in test tenant with the same version.-         Here you don't need to do any manual actions in the test tenant to bring the patch to the same level, once the patch is uploaded to the production tenant it will be automatically synced with the test tenant as both tenant are in the same system.-

Title: Archived:Cannot Determine Account Origin For Material XYZ in company XXX
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Archived reason:Duplicate of KBA: 2184250 - Error message:Cannot Determine Account Origin For Service XYZ in company XXX-Planned cost not showing or determining correctly in project.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose project XYZ.-Choose the Edit button.-Choose the Valuate button.-Here you can see the planned cost not showing correctly.-OR-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Projects view.-Choose the Project XYZ.-Choose the View Plan Values button.-You can see here some of the project tasks are in Error status marked in Red color.-Choose project task and navigate to the Messages tab here you can see error message Cannot Determine Account Origin For Material XYZ in company XXX.-Cause-The project valuation will be failed if the account determination group is not maintained or if the account is not maintained for the respective Material assigned for project task.-Resolution-Kindly follow below steps to maintain the account determination group and account.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Choose Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine Tune tab.-Search and choose Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose Open button.-Choose the Account Determination -> Inventories then you need to maintain a Material Consumption G/L account for the material account determination group.-In the Gains and Losses tab.-For all Account Determination Group for Materials field in the Material Consumption field, enter the G/L account for material cost posting.

Title: ARCHIVED :Error Message: "Business Residence Not Determined For Goods And Services Receipt Item"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVED REASON: Duplicate of  KBA1937039 - Error Message in Supplier Invoice: Business Residence Cannot Be Determined. There May Be An Error In System Configuration. -While creating a New Goods and Service Receipt, system throws the error message: Business residence not determined for goods and services receipt item.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Choose Purchase Orders to Be Delivered view.-Choose Show by Documents subview.-Search purchase order XYZ.-Choose New Goods and Service Receipt option.-Choose Save or Post.-System triggers the error.-Cause-The Purchase Order Account Assignment for this item is a project and the respective project responsible unit is not marked as Cost Center, hence the system is unable to determine the Business Residence.-Resolution-Follow below steps to resolve this issue;-Go to Organization Management workcenter.-Select Org Structures view.-Highlight the Org Unit and select Edit button.-Select the current Org Unit (Project responsible org unit).-Go to Definitions tab.-Select Cost Center check box.

Title: ARCHIVED:Supplier Invoice not Created From the Collaboration Window
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVED REASON:   2481299 - Error message:System.Runtime.Remoting.ServerException-You are creating supplier invoice via collaboration window by setting up a dedicated folder. However no invoice is created in the ByDesign system after you upload the file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Collaboration Window.-Go to Menu -> Settings -> Invoice Scanning.-Select the check box Enable service Scanned Invoices.-Move to Observed Folder and select the file for upload.-Select OK.-Now login to the ByDesign system.-Go to the Supplier Invoice work center.-Go to the Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Search for Scanned Invoice.-No records found.-Cause-The user who is trying to upload the invoices via collaboration window have not been assigned to any Company. As a result, system cannot determine the Company details from the user and failed to upload the invoice.-Resolution-Assign the user to the Company and then try to upload the invoice via colloboration window. Now supplier invoices will be present in the ByDesign system.-Note: If only one user uploads the scanned invoices for multiple companies, then do not assign that user to any of the companies and in text file, provide the company for which the scanned invoice is relevant. From the text file, system pulls the company information. However make sure that the company name matches exactly between the text file and the company name in ByDesign system.

Title: Error Message: 'VAT ID Missing in Document of Type Customer Invoice in EC Sales List Run'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There is an error message in the EC Sales List Run: 'VAT ID For XYZ Missing in Document ABC of Type Customer Invoice' (where XYZ is the VAT ID and ABC the ID of the customer invoice). You can see this in the application log of the EC Sales List Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Switch to the EC Sales List Runs View.-Show All Tax Return Runs, find XXX and press Go (where XXX represents the Tax Return ID).-Select Details.-Show All Logs and press Go.-Click Link for Log ID YYY (where YYY represents the Application Log ID of the EC Sales List Run).-Switch to the tab Results.-You can see an error message like VAT ID For XYZ Missing in Document ABC of Type Customer Invoice.-Cause-The error occurs due to a missing Tax Number in the Account Financial data. You need to add a valid VAT Number in the Customer Account to solve this issue.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management Work Center.-Go to the Accounts View.-Show All Accounts, find DEF and press Go (where DEF stands for the respective customer account).-Choose Edit - Financial Data.-Switch to sub tab Tax Data.-Insert a Tax Number in case there is none maintained.-Cancel the respective Customer Invoices and create new Customer Invoices from the respective Sales Order.-Rerun the EC Sales List Run in question.-Now there should be no more error message appearing.-Keywords-EC Sales List Run, VAT ID Missing

Title: How to Extract Business Partner Records with Roles
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You would like to extract all business partner records from the Data Extraction tool. But after extracting it you found that not all business partner records in the system have been extracted. You don't know why not all business partner records have been extracted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Data Extraction view-Select New-Enter a Run ID-Select the Business_Partner as extraction object-Select the Package Active checkbox and define package size to automatically perform the extraction in packages with each package containing the number of instances selected-Select Export Code Description to show texts/descriptions for the codes-Click on Save or Activate and Run-To view the results, search for runs with status Finished-Select the run to see a list of files that are extracted-Select the extracted files-Click on Download -Cause-The cause why not all business partner records were extracted is as follows.-Business partner records without a role will be extracted when you extract the object Business_Partner.-All other business partner records that have a role such as Account, Supplier, Service Agent, etc. assigned won't be extracted.-Resolution-You need to extract the correct business object. Then you will be able to extract business partners with roles Account, Supplier, Service Agent, etc.-You need to the extract the business object Account, Supplier, Service Agent, etc, not Business Partner.-Keywords-Geschäftspartner extrahieren, extract business parter, Datenextraktionslauf

Title: ARCHIEVED: How to Change the Posting Date of a Clearing Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archived Reason: Duplicate of KBA 255846 ***-You have processed and invoice and manually cleared it against an existing payment, which has already been processed. However the clearing did not get successfully completed due to an error concerning the validity of the posting date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing-Relevant Tasks subview.-You'll see a task asking to review the manual payment clearing. When you open the clearing, an error concerning an invalid posting date is raised, however the posting date, in this scenario, is not editable.-There might be also the case that you have the period error being raised when trying to approve an approval task for the concerned clearing.-Resolution-In order to be able to change the posting date, please refer to below steps:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Closing-Relevant Tasks subview.-Click the task concerning the manual payment clearing.-The document opens. Withdraw it from approval, if that's the case.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the Payment Allocation that precedes the payment to which the open item (e.g. invoice) is being cleared against.-Reverse this payment allocation. As a result, a new In Preparation payment allocation is created.-To this new allocation, allocate all the relevant items again and change the Posting Date to an open period.-Post the payment allocation.-Result: The new clearing gets the posting date set in the newly created allocation.- Alternatively, you can use the Send to Allocation function as follows:-Go to Payables or Receivables work center.-Go to the Payment Clearing view.-Highlight the Received clearing and click Actions -> Send To Payment Allocation. This action cancels the existing allocation and creates a new one.-In the newly created payment allocation, the posting date is editable.-Change the posting date to the expected date and click Post.-This also creates a new clearing with the newly selected posting date.-Keywords-Clearing, posting date, period block.

Title: An Error Happens When You Try to Enter a Value on The Sales Cycle Activity on Business Configuration

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to enter the Stalled After X Days information, but you are facing an error message such as: Entry 0.0 not valid; only numbers permitted, but you have not entered the special character.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Checking the Activity on Business Configuration-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Click on the button Open Activity List.-Search for the activity Sales Cycles.-Select the Sales Cycle Code.-Under the Assign Phases select one of the sequence.-On the column Stalled After X Days enter the relevant value and press enter.-The system throws an error message.-Error: Entry 0.0 not valid; only numbers permitted, but you have not entered the special character.-Cause-The system throws this error because you have pressed on the Enter button.-Resolution-In this case we recommend to you do not press Enter or Tab, use the mouse to proceed to the next field.-Keywords-Sales Cycle; Business Configuration;

Title: Dump and Analytics functions not Working after Log-on with a specific User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Reason for archiving: Silverlight was discontinued ***-You log-on to ByDesign and notice that a Dump occurs after the Home work center is loaded.-When you try to use any Analytics functions you also notice that are not working as expected. For example, when you try to open a report only a blank page is shown.-Reproducing the Issue-Access the ByD system with the User XYZ.-After the Home work center screen is loaded a Dump occurs. In this case with the below details:-SAP.BYD.LS.UI.ExtensionLoader.Extensions.ExtensionLoadingException: Unable to load extension from xrep:///SAP_BYD_TF/Analytics/AnalysisPattern/sapLSUI AnalyticsReportingUI.xap----> System.InvalidOperationException: The package downloaded successfully but an error occurred while reading the contents of the package. See the inner exception for more details. ---> System.NullReferenceException:-[Arg_NullReferenceException]-Arguments:-Debugging resource strings are unavailable. Often the key and arguments provide sufficient information to-diagnose the problem. See http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=106663 &Version=5.1.20913.00&File=mscorlib.dll&Key=Arg_NullReferenceException at-System.ComponentModel.Composition.Hosting.DeploymentCatalog.DiscoverPart s(IEnumerable`1 assemblies) at System.ComponentModel.Composition.Hosting.DeploymentCatalog.HandleOpenRe adComple-ted(Object sender, OpenReadCompletedEventArgs e)---- End of inner exception stack trace ------- End of inner exception stack trace ----at SAP.LS.UI.ExtensionLoader.ExtensionServices.Internal.ExtensionServic esImpl.handleError(DeploymentCatalog lDepCatalog, Exception error)-at SAP.LS.UI.ExtensionLoader.ExtensionServices.Internal.ExtensionServic esImpl.lNewDeploymentCatalog_DownloadCompleted(Object sender, AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)-at System.EventHandler`1.Invoke(Object sender, TEventArgs e)-at System.ComponentModel.Composition.Hosting.DeploymentCatalog.OnDownlo adCompleted(AsyncCompletedEventArgs e)-at System.ComponentModel.Composition.Hosting.DeploymentCatalog.HandleOp enReadCompleted(Object sender, OpenReadCompletedEventArgs e)-at System.Net.WebClient.OnOpenReadCompleted(OpenReadCompletedEventArgs e)-at System.Net.WebClient.OpenReadOperationCompleted-Although you can still use the system some functionalities are not working. For example, when you open a browser report a blank page is shown instead.-The issue occurs only with your User on your PC and either with IE or Firefox however the issue doesn't occur if another User logs into ByDesign from your PC.-Cause-The issue is caused by corrupted or outdated Silverlight file (.XAP) in the local system for the User.-Resolution-You can solve such issue by clearing the Silverlight application cache as following:-From the ByDesign system Right click and select Silverlight-Select the Application Storage tab from the Silverlight pop up.-Click on Delete All then OK.-Logout the system and Log in again and the issue should be solved.

Title: ARCHIVED:While Positing Supplier Invoice Withholding Tax Is Not Calculating.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVED REASON:Duplicate of 1817674 - Withholding Tax not Calculated Automatically-While posting a Supplier Invoice with Withholding Tax, you have identified that Withholding Tax is not getting calculated. You have verified that the vendor master data, PAN number and Withholding Tax Settings are maintained in it.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Common Task view and click on the New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Select your desired Supplier from the drop down and make all the necessary entries.-Go to the Items tab and select any service items from the Product ID drop down box.-Select Quantity, Tax Code and Net Price etc.-Select the Taxes sub tab and then click on the Withholding Tax Details and select the Tax code from the drop diwn field of Withholding Tax Code.-You can find that system is not calculating Withholding tax despite of giving the Withholding Tax Code.-  Cause-You have not ticked the Withholding Tax Required check box under the Company Tax Arrangements view.- or-You have  not maintained the Withholding Taxes Classification details in the  master data for Supplier or  Product.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the option All Documents in the Show field and type your desired Supplier Invoice Document ID and click on the Go button.-Select your desire Supplier Invoice Document ID and click on the Edit button.-Click on the View All and click on the Items -tab and click on the Taxes sub tab and check the Tax Reporting Unit what you have maintaned.-Now go to the Tax Management work center.-View the Tax Company Tax Arrangements view.-Select the Company DEF (DEF represents the Company ID used in the Supplier invoice) for the Tax Country of your Invoice.-Select the Tax Authority ID based on the Tax Return Type Withholding Tax Returns - File xx with Tax Number Type.-Click on the Edit button and go to the Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Select your Company and tick on the Withholding Tax Required check box.-Click on Save button. -Now if you post any supplier Invoice you can see that Withholding Tax is calucuating properly.- also-  Ensure you maintain th tax clasification details in the  Supplier  or  product master data.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Withholding Tax

Title: ARCHIVED:Withholding Tax Determination isn't working in Supplier Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-ARCHIVED REASON: Duplicate of 1903406 - While Positing Supplier Invoice Withholding Tax Is Not Calculating.-You have maintained the Withholding Taxes Classification master data for Supplier X and Product Y (X represents the Supplier ID and Y represents the Product ID).-You have created a Supplier invoice for Supplier X and Product Y, but the Withholding Taxes are not determined as expected from the previous configuration. The system shows No Records found in the Taxes table under the Withholding Taxes tab of the Item Details.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Invoices.-Find ABC (ABC represents the Invoice ID).-Select Edit.-Select View All.-Go to Items tab.-Go to the Taxes tab in the Item's Details.-Go to Withholding Taxes subtab.-Here you can see that, in the Taxes table, there are No records found.-Cause-As detailed in the Help Center document Withholding Tax Determination, the determination of the Withholding Taxes is based on 3 conditions:-Tax Authority/Company Tax Arrangements,-Supplier,-Material.-You have not configured the Company Tax Arrangements for the Tax Authority used in the Supplier Invoice.-Resolution-To ensure the system picks up the Withholding tax in the Supplier Invoice, you must activate the Withholding Tax Required checkbox in the Company Tax Arrangements for the Company and Tax Authority used in that invoice. For this, you can follow these steps:-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Company Tax Arrangements view.-Find the Company DEF (DEF represents the Company ID used in the Supplier invoice) for the Tax Country of your Invoice.-Select Edit.-Mark the checkbox Withholding Tax Required.-Save.-You can now recreate a supplier invoice for Supplier X and Product Y and the Withholding tax will be automatically picked up.

Title: Water Mark Test Copy Appears in the PDF Document of Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-TO BE ARCHIVED >> DUPE KBA-Original: 1234223 - Watermark 'Test Copy' on Purchase Order Preview and other Sales Documents-The system shows the water mark Test Copy in PDF documents, such as Customer Invoice, Sales Quote, Sales Order, etc..-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The below is an example, the same is true for other views in both Business ByDesign as well as Cloud for Customer.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Invoice Document view.-Select the relevant invoice,choose Edit button.-Press Preview button.-You find water mark Test Copy is visible on preview.-Cause-This is the expected behavior of Business ByDesign. This workaround is also applicable to other Business Documents of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Choose the Invoice Document view.-Select the relevant invoice then choose Edit.-Go to View All and navigate to the Output History tab.-Double click the PDF form then you will realize the water mark is invisible.-Keywords-Test Copy, watermark, output, pdf,

Title: ARCHIVED -Error Message: "No communication arrangement found for company and partner" when consuming Purchase Order Web Service
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a web service to update Purchase Orders automatically, however when you call in the service, the Purchase Order Updates successfully but the following message-(via SOAP UI or Micro Services) appears:-Archive Reason - KBA Content Outdated-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to Reproduce:--1. Goto Purchase Requests and Orders wc-2. Select "New Purchase Order"-3. Create a new PO with supplier XML Test Supplier and company.-4. PO successfully created manually-5. Update the PO via web service-6. Error encountered: No communication arrangement found for company and partner-Other checks:-- Output channel is maintained as XML-- Communication arrangement has been maintained in the system-Cause-This is a known issue:-During update from A2X and when the communication is XML, we look for all possible configurations like B2B , IDX and IDOC .-When a configuration is not found for a specific case ( like IDOC in this case ), it wrongly registers an error message-"No communication arrangement found for company and partner".--This is cleared when updates are triggered from UI ,however this is not cleared in case of A2X .--As such, the update is triggered correctly in PO and the output is being triggered normally.-Resolution-This issue will be fixed in 1702 release.-No Hotfix is planned for the current version as this error does not impact the functionality.

Title: ARCHIVED PI - Error Messages Retained in Adapter Engine of the Runtime Workbench
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Archive Reason: Not Valid***-Attachment Adapter fails to connect Integration Server with the following error message:-Transmitting the message to endpoint http://vacifad:50000/sap/xi/engine?type=entry using-connection Attachment_http://sap.com/xi/AttachmentAdapter failed, due to:-com.sap.engine.interfaces.messaging.api.exception.MessagingException: Received HTTP-response code 401: Unauthorized.-The below display is on the navigation from XI main page --> Runtime Workbench --> Message Monitoring --> Adapter Engine, this is message from component drilldown and data base.-Resolution-Client Certificate is used for the Clients Identity.-The client certificate information, however, is used only for authenticating SAP GUI users. To enable SAP GUI SSO with client certificates users must possess valid client certificates.-To achieve this, correct entries have to be maintained in NWA, client 001 and client 002. The AS ABAP enables you to configure the use of client certificates for SSO when users access the system from a SAP GUI.-Step 1:-1. Verify the Client Certificates entries.-2. Navigate to NWA of the system on address http://<host name>:port/nwa.-3. Select the tab Configuration Management --> Security --> Trusted Systems --> Own Ticket -The entries made above in the NWA should match the content available in the certificate space of transaction STRUSTSSO2 of client 002 and 001.--If the certificate entries are erroneous, make the changes in error client with the same entries of NWA as shown below.-Step 2:-Go to transaction STRUSTSSO2 and select tab Add to ACL (Access Control List) which maintains the list of the users and the systems and save it.-Step 3:-After maintaining the changes, navigate to Message Monitoring of the Runtime Workbench and choose the radio button of the corresponding messages and press the button-      Created by BYDMS-KB-PI-See Also-Issue is captured in the Reference BCP #3100236801.

Title: Archived: Business Residence Cannot Be Determined. There May Be An Error In System Configuration. If The Message Appears, Several Things Can Be Wrong.

Title: How to check the MCS Quality Review validity date on SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-This KBA will describe how you can be checking for the current Multi-Customer Solution quality review validity date on SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the MCS.-Click on Administration > Generate Installation Key-You can find the validity date on field "Quality Review is valid until".-Resolution-The quality review validity is found in Administration tab > Generate Installation Key.-In case a new quality review has been done for your MCS, the new validity will only reflect to the SDK once the current validity has already been expired.-Example:-- Today is 01.01.2024.-- The current QR Validity on SDK is 01.02.2024.-- The new QR Validity is 01.02.2025 -> This date will reflect to SDK only after 01.02.2024.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, MCS, add-on, quality, review, QR, QA

Title: "In Progress" Status and Dump When Running Custom Mass Data Runs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer complains that a Mass Data Run keeps "In Progress" and it does not get executed successfully. By checking on -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Customer Invoicing > Custom Mass Data Run work center view.- Select Run ID "XYZ".- Click on Schedule.- Select Start Immediately.- You can see it keeps "In Process" for long time.-Cause-The issue might be caused because application classes have tried to raise error messages which are not compatible with the MDRO/Application Log Framework. For confirming it, you may follow these steps:-Schedule Mass Data Run in User Interface.-Login to Backend.-Navigate to ST22.-You can see a dump with following information:-Triggering application component: BC-ESI-ESF-2-CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_LIB_MDRO_EXECUTE===========CP, Include:CL_LIB_MDRO_EXECUTE===========CM00I, Position:1-Info: An exception with the type CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause-CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR, Program:CL_LIB_MDRO_EXECUTE===========CP, Include:CL_LIB_MDRO_EXECUTE===========CM00I, Position:215-Info: Source type \CLASS=CM_ABCDE_MESSAGE_CFM is not compatible, for the purposes of assignment, with target type \CLASS=CM_ESI_T100-The above error means that a message of type \CLASS=CM_ABCDE_MESSAGE_CFM is being raised during Mass Data Run execution. All messages that are raised during Mass Data Run execution processing will always be converted to message type of CM_ESI_T100 by the Application Log framework before writing them to Application Log itself. In this case, since both these message types are not compatible, there is a dump. Ideally only messages that are compatible to type CM_ESI_T100 are supported by the MDRO/Application Log Framework. -Resolution-We need to check with the application team why these messages are being raised. In most of the cases, it will be due to data issues (probably updated in custom scripts) that customer can correct. If the application can point to why the error messages are raised, we can communicate that to customer and ask them to correct the data. For checking which is the responsible team, you may follow these steps:-Navigate to SE24.-Insert Class Displayed in the Dump (e.g. \CLASS=CM_ABCDE_MESSAGE_CFM).-Go to Properties tab.-Double Click on Package.-You can see component responsible.-If desired, you may also debug CM_ESI_T100=>CONSTRUCTOR class and method respectively, for checking which are error messages raised.-Keywords-The internal session was terminated with a runtime error (see ST22), mass data run, An exception with the type CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled locally, nor declared in a RAISING clause, CL_LIB_MDRO_EXECUTE,  Source type \CLASS=CM_APINV_MESSAGE_CFM is not compatible, for the purposes of assignment, with target type \CLASS=CM_ESI_T100 , is not compatible, for the purposes of assignment

This is the expected behavior which system takes only (released Outbound Deliveries with finished Delivery Status) or (not released with canceled status with any Delivery Status).-Keywords-Data Source, Outbound Delivery Item Party Details, Outbound Delivery.

Title: At Least One Input Product from Line Item Group Must be Active
Content: Symptom-After delete a line item of input product in Production Bill of Material (BoM), below error occurs while checking consistency for the BOM.-"Variant A of BoM XXX not consistent ;At least one input product from line item group B must be active."-Moreover, to resolve the issue you try to use a workaround that to unmark the variant A from the deleted item, below error occurs while checking consistency.-" Variant A of BoM XXX not consistent;  Assignment of valid line item to var. missing for mandatory item grp B."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Production Bills Of Material View.-Search for the BOM XXX.-Choose Edit button.-Go to General and Variants Tab.-Choose Check Consistency button, then the mentioned error would occur.-Cause-Indicator "Required" is marked for the deleted item in the BOM. It is used to ensure that you do not leave out any input products in your variants.-Hence, the mentioned error occurs as expected.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to unmark the indicator to resolve the issue.-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Production Bills Of Material View.-Search for the BOM XXX.-Choose Edit button.-Go to Input Products Tab.-Select the delete line.-Go to Item Details Subtab, you will find the indicator "Required " is marked.-Unmark the indicator.-Choose Save button.-After this, the error would no longer exist.-Keywords-Production Bill of Material, BoM, delete, Variant of BoM not consistent, At least one input product from line item group must be active, Assignment of valid line item to var. missing for mandatory item grp. Check consistency.

Title: Swiss Decimal Notation
Content: Symptom-User want to know the Decimal Notation format maintained in tenant.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Cause- SAP BusinessByDesign system is not supporting the particular format in the User Interface.-Resolution-According to wiki page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decimal_mark Decimal Notation in Swiss could be more than one formats.-Switzerland: e.g.  1'234'567.89 and 1.234.567,89.-The supported formats are available under "Personalization Settings":-Navigate to your Avatar at top right of SAP Business ByDesign screen.-Go to "My Settings" view-Check the formats under "Decimal Notation" field.-Keywords-swiss decimal Notation

Title: How to Add Custom Validations and Messages to Time Sheet Validation for Employee
Content: Symptom-Validation process of time recording in the time sheet of the employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Go to Self-Service overview view.-Click Edit Time Sheet link under session Time.-Configure the activities, jobs and time that the employee will work and release it by clicking Release button.-You want to add custom validations and messages based on the Employee Time Sheet provided, but you do not know how or the current development made is not working as expected.-Cause-Additional validations and messages during the validation of the Employee Self-Service Overview Time Sheet can only be achieved by creating and configuring an Enhancement Implementation within a custom solution using the SDK.-Resolution-Add a Enhancement Implementation component to your custom solution.-On field Namespace select http://sap.com/xi/AP/TimeAndLabourManagement/Global.-On field Business Object select EmployeeTime.-On field Enhacement Option select Validate Times.-Under the Enhancement Implementation configured, use the script file VALIDATE.absl to write your logic to add your validations and messages.-Under the Enhancement Implementation configured, use the BADI filter component ABCDEF.flrt to configure the conditions based on parameters.-Keywords-Enhancement Implementation; http://sap.com/xi/AP/TimeAndLabourManagement/Global; EmployeeTime; Validate Times; Time Sheet;
