Title: Change Project is Already Merged, But "Merge Changes" Activity is Still In Process
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-After a remote change project was successfully merged with the production system the activity Merge Changes remains with status In Process. Due to this, the remote change project cannot be closed in the test tenant.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the affected project.-Click the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Go-Live tab.-You can see that the Merge Changes fine-tuning activity is still In Process.-Cause-This might happen if due to a temporary issue in the connectivity between the two tenants, the confirmation from the productive tenant that the project was merged does not reach the test tenant, so the status of the fine-tuning activity does not get updated.-Resolution-You have to set the status of the activity Merge Changes to Closed through the backend.-Firstly:-Go to backend transaction BCTADM.-Select the Workspace Overview option.-Click the value help in the Workspace ID field and select the affected project.-System Purpose and Project Status should look like the image below; if not, DO NOT proceed with the next steps.-If the data is correctly as above, copy the Workspace ID-Once that is done:-Go to backend transaction SE16.-Enter table BCTD_WSACTIVITY.-Select the affected Remote Change Project.-Filter using the following information:-WS_ID: enter the Workspace ID copied in the BCTADM transaction.-ELEMENT_ID: BO_A1S_FND_MERGE.-In the next screen, select the row for fine-tuning activity BO_A1S_FND_MERGE and click the Edit (pencil icon) button.-Change the value for FT_STATUS from 2 (In Process) to 3 (Closed) as below:-Click the Save (floppy disk icon) button to save the changes.-The activity Merge Changes is now closed and the customer can proceed in closing the remote change project.-NOTE: In case the status appears already as closed, check this issue with ByD Technology PAL-See Also-2781531 - First Implementation Project In Production System has Status Tested, but System Is Still In Pre-Production-Keywords-Merge Status, In Progress, BO_A1S_FND_MERGE, Action CLOSE not possible, In Process, Change Project, already merged, byd, c4c

Title: Error Message in Report:: Characteristic Missing in MDAV
Content: Symptom-You try to run your report but instead you get the following error message 'Characteristic ABC is missing in mdav DEF; Report 123 cannot be saved'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open your report from the respective work center (depending on the report assignment).-Click on Go.-You receive the above error message.-Cause-In most cases, this behavior is experienced because a characteristic might have been deleted from the data source (for example by deleting an extension field) which the report is based in, but both data source and report were not yet refreshed.-Resolution-Follow the two step by step below to refresh the data source and the report:-Data Source:-Go to Design Data Sources in the Business Analytics work center.-Search for the data source which your report is based in.-Select the data source.-Click on Edit button.-Click on Save and Close button.-Report:-Go to Design Reports in the Business Analytics work center.-Search for the report which you experienced the error message.-Select the report.-Click on Edit With button.-Select Report Wizard on the drop down list.-After the report wizard opens, click on the Finish button.-Keywords-report, data source, characteristic, inconsistent, analytics, error message, Report does not work, Characteristic is missing in mdav-report is inconsistent,message applies to characteristic,following message applies to variable

Title: Copy Solution Profile or Change Project error related to Add-On
Content: Symptom-When requesting for a solution profile copy from a source system to a target system, the bellow errors can be faced:-Copy not allowed; add-on ABC of system X is missing in system Y (ABC refers to the solution name, X and Y refers to the source and target systems ID).-Copy not allowed; source system X has add-ons, but target system Y not (X and Y refers to the source and target systems ID).-Copy not allowed; source and target system have different Add-on versions.-Copy not allowed; source and target system having different versions.-Solution ABC is missing in test tenant (ABC refers to the solution name).-Solution ABC is missing in production tenant (ABC refers to the solution name).-Versions of solution ABC different in test and target (ABC refers to the solution name).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-When it comes to merging a change project or performing a solution profile copy between two tenants which have a custom solution created from the Cloud Applications Studio, the below points must be taken into consideration:-The source and target tenants must be in the same release version, for example 2105, as it is not allowed to copy a solution profile during the upgrade window.-Ensure that the same solution namespace, for example ABCD12345 is enabled on both tenants, as well as having the same version. If not, you should download and upload the correct version to the other tenant, so they are on sync.-You can disable the affected patch solution and enable the original solution in test tenant, to match the original namespace present in the production tenant.-This would make the source and target tenants to be in sync in terms of Add-on namespace and version, allowing the solution profile copy to be completed.-Once the solution profile copy is successful, you can enable the patch solution namespace on the test tenant and continue with your development activity.-- For KeyUserSolution:-In case you have any KeyUserSolution (solutions created via Custom Object Builder in the UI) in your tenant, then the above mentioned points are applicable as well.-If the mismatch occurs due to KUT solutions, then you will have to delete this solution or upload it to the missing tenant, since there is no option to disable a KUT solution. You can delete it from the Administrator work center -> Custom Object Builder view -> Delete Solutions.-Note: If you disable/enable any solutions, the scoping in the business configuration will be removed. Your developed functionalities will have to be scoped in the implementation project again. More details can be checked in SAP Help Portal section: Enable or Disable Your Solution in the SAP Cloud Solution.-See Also-The SAP help documentation section: What You Need to Consider When a Change Project Is on the Same Test Tenant-This SAP community post: Copy Solution Profile – Handling PDI Add-On Conflicts-Keywords-SDK, PDI, KeyUserSolution, byd, c4c, KUT, Custom Object Builder

Title: How to View a Shopping Cart as Support User in Customer System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to view or track a Shopping Cart in customer's system using support user credentials.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select Self Services view.-System throws error message "Technical users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services."-Cause-Support users cannot view user-specific data and this is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-As a workaround, please follow the below instructions:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for Shopping Cart Tracking.-Open it.-In Selection section, insert ABC (ABC is the Shopping Cart's ID).-Leave the field 'Created On' blank.-Click in Apply.-Click in the Shopping Cart ID.-Select the "Go to..." button and then select "View Shopping Cart".-The shopping cart is open.-Keywords-Support User, Access, Shopping Cart, Report-shopping cart track,shopping cart report,shopping cart id

Title: Error Message "Action CLOSE Not Possible; Action is Disabled" in Close Project Fine-Tuning Activity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to complete the Close Project fine-tuning activity, but system raises error "Action CLOSE not possible; action is disabled."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and click the Activity List button.-Navigate to the Go-Live tab.-Select the Close Project activity and click Open.-Mark the Close Project checkbox and click Confirm.-Error message is raised.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that y you are trying to close the change project without Implementing it.-Resolution-Before closing the project, you must implement it by either completing the Confirm Go-Live activity (in case of a first implementation project) or the Merge Changes activity (in case of a change project), which can only be completed after all other activities in the project are closed. If it is a change project and you would like to close it without implementing the changes, you can cancel it.-If the Confirm Go-Live or Close Project activity is already closed, then please report an case.-Keywords-Action CLOSE not possible, action is disabled, Confirm Go-Live, Close Project, implementation project, change project

Title: How to Enable XML Schema in Adobe LiveCycle Designer
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to enable the XML schema in Adobe LiveCycle Designer in order to work with the binding path.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Open the form template in the Adobe LiveCycle Designer tool.-Click on the Data view tab.-Click on the right arrow.-Select Connection properties.-Give a connection name (not mandatory) and click Next.-Browse and select the XML file which you want to enable the XML schema.-Click Finish button.-The required XML schema will be loaded.-Now you will be able to navigate to find the required binding path.-See Also-2545812 - Unable to bind a field using Adobe Livecycle Designer (ALD), even when the data is available in xml.-Keywords-XML, Schema, Adobe LiveCycle Designer, Connections

Title: Cannot Create a Change Project From The Change Test System
Content: Symptom-You are not able to create a new change project out of a change test system or you have requested a test tenant in place of production tenant and cannot close the First Implementation project, which is in "Tested" status.-Now, your requirement is to create a new change project with this test tenant, but the New button is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-The New button is grayed out and it's not possible to click it.-Cause-This tenant is a test tenant, hence you are not able to close the First Implementation project, which is needed before creating change projects.-Resolution-This is the system standard behavior. You cannot create a new change project out of a change test system.-According to the process, the new change project is created in the productive system and subsequently moved from the productive system to the test system through a copy solution profile request.-If this situation happened because you have accidentally requested a test tenant in place of a productive tenant, you have following options:-Terminate your current test tenant and create a new productive tenant.-If you have purchased a license for an additional test tenant, there is no need to terminate any of the test tenants; simply trigger a new productive tenant creation from your Service Control Center work center.-FAQ:-1.Is it Possible to enable New button in the test tenent?-   It is not possible to enable New button or create a new change project as stand alone change project in the test system.-See Also-Keywords-new change project, test tenant, new button, grayed out

Title: Multi-Step Approval Of Expense Report Is Not Released for SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Multi-step approval (MSA) of expense reports is not released for SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The multi-step approval functionality for expense report is only available for SAP Cloud for Travel and Expense. Due to technical reasons, it is also visible in the Business Configuration. However, it is not officially released for SAP Business ByDesign and will not be released for SAP Business ByDesign. Hence, the use will be at own risk. SAP Support will not support any inquiries related to the multi-step approval functionality for expense report.-Resolution-Please check whether your approval process is as below. Or if you have already configured multi-step approval process, please change to the same as below.-There is only one step.-The work distribution is Approver of highest costs or Line Manager of Employee.-The condition has to be Expense Report Approval Configuration Equal to Yes.-We have added the suffix '(Multi-Step Approval not Supported)' to the text 'Standard Approval Process for Expense Report' for new customers and in case of new business configuration deployment. If a specific customer wants to have the suffix '(Multi-Step Approval not Supported)' also to the existing active version of Approval Process Definition without new business configuration deployment, we can change this text in backend in the customer system, please report a case to SAP Support.-See Also-2543238 - How the Approval Process for Expense Reports is Determined in the System and How To Change the Same-1944022 - Change Default Approver Determination For Expense Reports-1874937 - How to Update Existing Expense Report Approval Process-Keywords-multi, step, approval, expense report, approval process calculation, 费用报销单，审批，多步骤

Title: Error When Opening Excel Workbook
Content: Symptom-When trying to open workbook with the Excel add-in you may encounter performance issues or even an error message:-Unexpected error in server communication; session needs to be closed-Message was: The remote server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error.-(Exception System.Net.WebException)-Or--Unexpected error in server communication; session needs to be closed-Message was: The remote server returned an error: (504) Gateway Timeout-(Exception System.Net.WebException)-Or--Unexpected error in server communication; session needs to be closed-Message was: The remote server returned an error: (400) Gateway Timeout-(Exception System.Net.WebException)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the ByD Excel add-in.-Select Open > All Workbooks.-It takes a long time to open your workbook or even fails with the above error.-Cause-This error is generally caused by an insufficient performance of the report. This happens due to a very high data volume in the system and / or due to the design of the report and the underlying data source.-With custom reports for example, it is possible that the workbook contains a report which has been designed in the UI(Business Analytics) and has selection parameters which have been added via Add Fields in the report. This is not advisable as it consumes too much performance internally.-Resolution-If you want to add some characteristics as selections, you can do it in the report wizard itself. Please convert as many selections fields as possible of such report from Add Fields to selections via the Report wizard (Step 4 > Use as Variable) and then add this report into the workbook. This should improve the performance.-Additionally, it is advisable to reduce the report data by adding variables to the report selection.-See Also-Please check this KBA for further suggestions on the best practices in designing reports: 2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling Data Sources and Reports - Performance-See also: 2043737 - Excel Report Time Out errors-Keywords-Add-in, excel, report, time out, session needs to be closed, unexpected error-unexpected error in server communication,excel add-in,analytics

Title: How to Find XI Messages for Errors in the Business Communication Monitor
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Only***-How to find XI Messages for errors in the Business Communication Monitor.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Communication Monitoring view.-In the Show field select the Business Messages with Errors options.-In the result list you see entries with the status such as Time Out, Content Error, Technical Error etc.-You want to find the related XI Messages in the Backend.-Resolution-Logon to the Backend-Go to the Test Shell transaction SESFTS-Enter the BO APBMV_BDM_MONI_VIEW-Select Load by Query -> ROOT-QUREY_BY_ELEMENTS-Remove filter BusinessDocumentMessageTransmissionStatusLastChangeDateTime by clicking Multiple Selection and then clicking Delete Line symbol and then press the green checkbox.-Click on the value help for BusinessDocumentMessageTransmissionStatusCod-Select the error type corresponding to the status in the frontend e.g. 4 to get all the messages having the status Timed Out.-Click on Continue (Enter).-Select all instances in the results.-click on Navigate and select TECHNICAL_MSG_REF-Copy the message Id from the field MESSAGE_ID-CONTENT.-Go to transaction SRT_MONI.-Paste the message id in the Message ID field.-Click on Execute.-

Title: Error Message: Negative Stock not Permitted in Custodian ABC, Material XYZ
Content: Symptom-You have consumed an Item pre-delivered with a Project Stock Order in a Project, but you would like to Undo Release of the Outbound Delivery ID. However, whenever you try to perform the Undo Release Action, the system is displaying the following error message: Negative Stock not Permitted in Custodian ABC (ABC represents the Custodian ID), Material XYZ (XYZ represents the Material ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the Outbound Delivery that you wish to perform the Undo Release action on and select it.-Choose the Action button and select the option Undo Release.-System displays the error message: Negative Stock not Permitted in Custodian ABC, material XYZ-Cause-As the Product is consumed in the Project, there's therefore currently no stock in the Custodian account. That is why the system is showing the error message.-Resolution-When doing spare parts return receipt, Please manage enough inventory.-Check the Confirmation Journal report to confirm the effective quantity.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Negative Stock not Permitted in Custodian , Material , Project Stock Order, Project Stock, Undo release

Title: Invoice Split Occurs due to a Different Seller Tax Number even though the Seller Tax Number Should be the Same for all Items
Content: Symptom-When invoicing an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request an invoice split occurs due to a different Seller Tax Number even though the Seller Tax Number should be the same for all items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select All Invoice Requests in the Show field.-Select the outbound delivery invoice request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice request).-Click on the Invoice button.-The system will suggest 2 invoices.-Select both and click on the Split Analysis button.-The system will display the Seller Tax Number XXX for Invoice#1 (XXX represents the seller tax number).-The system will display the Seller Tax Number YYY for Invoice#2 (YYY represents the seller tax number).-You expected that the Seller Tax Number for both items is YYY.-Cause-The outbound delivery invoice request ABC is based on sales order EFG (EFG represents the sales order ID).-You have created sales order EFG as a copy of an existing sales order.-When you copy an existing document, the system considers the tax number related data in the existing document as a specific data provided by the user and not as system proposed/determined data. Also when you change the Ship From party, this has no impact and will not re-determine the tax data. Therefore in your case you will see for item 10 the seller tax number XXX whereas for item 20 the updated tax number is YYY.-Resolution-To solve this issue please follow the below steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center and select the Sales Orders view.-Select sales order EFG and click on the Edit button.-Click on the View All button and navigate to the Items tab.-Select line item 10 and navigate to the Taxes sub tab.-Note down the Tax Country and the Tax Code used for this item.-In the field Tax Country enter another country e. g. US and press the enter key on your keyboard.-Now change the Tax Country again to the same Tax Country you have noted down previously.-In the field Tax Code, change the Tax Code back to the same Tax Code you have noted down previously.-Save your changes.-The system determines now the correct Seller Tax ID YYY for line item 10 and you can invoice outbound delivery invoice request ABC. The invoice split will not occur.-Keywords-Invoice Split; Sales Order; Copy; Seller Tax Number; Tax Country; Outbound delivery invoice request; Items

Title: Open Data Flow Verification Result With No Detected Differences
Content: Symptom-You have a Data Flow Verification Result with status Open in your system, however, in the Difference column, the value is Not Detected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Under Business Data Consistency, open the Data Flow Verification Results view.-Select the Data Flow Verification Result ABC (ABC represents your Data Flow Verification Result ID).-Checking the Difference column, you see that it is Not Detected.-Now, open the Data Flow Verification Result.-You see that no differences are listed, and that the Start Repeat Check and Start Document Synchronization buttons are grayed-out.-Cause-This means that the issue which generated the Data Flow Verification error in the first place is now fixed, either by a manual Start Repeat Check/Document Synchronization, or an automatic system retry.-Resolution-In these cases, the Data Flow Verification Result can be safely closed by using the Change Status to Closed button in the Data Flow Verification Result itself, or by:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Under Business Data Consistency, open the Data Flow Verification Results view.-Select the Data Flow Verification Result ABC (ABC represents your Data Flow Verification Result ID).-Highlight the Data Flow Verification Result and click Change Status to Closed.-See Also- 2654230 - Data Verification Result is Showing Open differences in BO pair Inventory - PlanningViewOfInventory- 2567752 - Data Flow Verification Result Difference in Unposted Business Transaction- 2626281 - Data Flow Verification Error: 'Document dates differ'-Keywords-Data Flow Verification Result, Repeat Check, Document Synchronization, Not Detected, No Differences, Change Status to Closed

Title: Error When Uploading Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-When manually uploading a journal entry voucher with more than 16000 lines into the system, the system shows the upload fails, and gives error message: The remote server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error. But if you check in the front end, sometimes, the data is successfully uploaded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center, and select the Journal Entries view.-Select the Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Choose New Journal Entry Voucher from Microsoft Excel.-Enter more than 16000 records.-Choose Save.-The system then gives the previously mentioned error message. -Cause-There is a limit imposed by the system itself that one call to the backend may not exceed a certain time limit, usually around 10 minutes. It seems that the processing limit can vary depending on the usage of the system and available resources at the time, it can hit the maximum amount with around 3000 items in your case. It is a current limitation that only affects very few use cases.-Resolution-To avoid the error message, you can either split the journal entry voucher into multiple ones, or try using the asynchronous web service we offer for uploading big vouchers.-Please see the latest Web Service APIs in SAP Business ByDesign.-See Also-KBA 2631680 - Unable to fulfill JEV Upload due to Memory Space-Keywords-journal entry voucher, excel, journal entry, line item, limit

Title: Preview Button Disabled On Goods And Activity Confirmation.
Content: Symptom-Preview Button is Grayed Out for Confirmation XYZ in common task Display / Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmations. *XYZ refers to Goods and Activity Confirmation ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Internal Logistics Work Center.-Go To Common Tasks and select Display / Reverse Goods And Activity Confirmation.-Show All Goods And Activity Confirmations.-Find Goods And Activity Confirmations XYZ. The button Print Confirmation and Preview is grayed out.-Cause-The Print Confirmation and Preview in the Reverse/Display Goods and Activity Confirmations are supported only for the confirmations which have the Change Reason as Transfer.--Resolution-The form can be printed only for the confirmation documents which have the Change Reason as Transfer. For rest, the Adobe form is not supported as per the design.-This is a designed system behavior.-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmation, Preview, Print Confirmation, Grayed Out, Disabled,

Title: How to Assign different Cost Centers or Account Assignment for each line item in Shopping Cart?
Content: Symptom-You want to create a shopping cart where account assignment should be per line item not per document, i.e. you want cost for line item 1 to go to a certain cost center and cost for line item 2 to be assigned to a different cost center or account assignment type. -Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select  Self Services view->Self-Services Overview-> Shopping-Select Go Shopping(Advanced) -> create shopping cart with multiple items-You are unable to assign each line item to different cost centers or maintain separate account assignment type for each item.-Cause-It is not possible to specify different account assignment for each line item in shopping cart. -If you add multiple cost centers or other account assignment types in the shopping cart initial screen i.e. Go Shopping (Advanced): set defaults-> account assignment type-> add row, then it will distribute the quantity for each item  to different cost centers mentioned here .-Resolution-This can be done when purchase request and purchase order is created. At that time, you can assign separate account assignment for each item.-OR-You can also create stand alone Purchase Order for multiple items with different account assignment types.-Keywords-cost center assignment, shopping cart, multiple cost centers, different cost centers, account assignment in shopping cart

Title: Custom Field Not Showing Its Description in a PDI Data Source
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom business object and declared a field having "RegionCode" data type. Then, you have created a custom data source via SAP Cloud Applications Studio and you have extended this field created. When either previewing data source or opening reports, you can't see its description. You can only see "RegionCode" values. -Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Create a Custom Business Object.-Declare a field having "RegionCode" as Data Type.-Save and Activate.-Create a Custom Data Source.-Add field which has "RegionCode" as Data Type.-Go to Business Analytics > Design Data Sources work center view.-Click to Preview Custom Data Source.-You can't see field description. You can only see its values. -Cause-The field which has "RegionCode" as Data Type will not be able to show the descriptions for "RegionCode" Data Type on its own. It would need to be compounded with the field "Country" in order to be able to display descriptions, since the Data Type links State with Country in order to provide descriptions. -However, compounding of characteristics cannot be modelled in Data Sources created via SAP Cloud Applications Studio. Therefore, this feature is not supported in PDI.  -Resolution-Since compounding of characteristics cannot be modelled in Data Sources created via SAP Cloud Applications Studio, it is expected that those descriptions are not displayed either when previewing data source or when opening reports. This feature is not supported in PDI Data Sources.  -Keywords-data source, description, PDI, compounding, regioncode, region code, REGION_CODE , APC_S_REGION_CODE

Title: Unable to Edit Output Settings for an Outbound Deliveries Due to System Error.
Content: Symptom-You try to Edit Output Settings for an Outbound Delivery the System throws the error - "An error occurred - Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work Center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries View.-Search for Outbound Delivery 'ABC' (ABC represents the Outbound Delivery ID).-Select Preview.-Select Edit Output Settings-Error appears: "An error occurred - Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident"-Cause-The reason you are facing this error is because Outbound Delivery 'ABC' is in cancelled status.-Resolution-If the Outbound Deliveries are cancelled preview will not be available. -Keywords-Preview, Edit Output Settings, Dump, Outbound Delivery, Third Party Logistics

Title: A Sales Order has the Status In Process When it Should be Completed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--Sales Order is showing it's status incorrect since the document should be Completed but it is still as In process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Sales Order view.-Search for ID DEF (DEF represents the document ID).-You can see the status is in 'In Process'.-Open the document.-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-The items have it's processes finished.--Logon to the backend system.-Go to Backend Transaction SESFTS.-Load BO By Proxy Name SALES_ORDER.-Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the ID/content field enter DEF (DEF represents the Sales Order ID).-Select Message Monitoring -> Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow.-You will see a Process Communication Error wit the error information 'Time limit exceed'.-Cause-There is a PDI script which runs on Sales Order BO in the method DETERMINE_AFTER_MODIFY, this solution is causing the Sales Orders messages to be stuck on the backend.-Resolution-Customer must be contacted to closed the PDI, when the solution is closed is possible to restart the messages and the Sales Order affected will change it's status to Completed.-The closing of the PDI can be temporary and in agreement with the customer for a specific time frame.-See Also-3050995 - Sales Order is in Status In Process but you Expect it to be in Status Completed.-3082647 - The Sales Order Remains In Process Status-Keywords-Add On, in process, completed, PDI, status, error, backend, stuck

Title: Pre-requisite to post a change record via OData using Postman
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-To change data via OData, e.g. making POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE OData calls, an x-csrf token needs to be retrieved first. -This KBA explains how to retrieve the token in Postman Lightweight API Client, using Basic Auth authentication.-There might be other options.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Open e.g. the Postman Lightweight API Client.-Select '+' to open a new request.-In the Authorization tab, select Basic Auth and maintain your Credentials (as provided in the CAM tool).-The next step is to fetch the CSRF token. This token is necessary  to update or create records in the system.-In order to get the CSRF Token, go to the Headers tab (between Authorizations and Body tab).-Enter ‘x-csrf-token’ in the Key and ‘Fetch’ in the Value field.-After this, a GET call is needed. Note: For a GET Call, you don’t need a CSRF Token.-To make the GET call, choose the action as GET and enter the URL in the related field. Note: You can use any collection to get the CSRF Token. Example: https://myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/v1/company (where xxxxxx represents the specific ID of the system).-Select Send-Once the GET call is done, go to the Headers tab (This is another Headers tab below the previous one in the Body, between Cookies and Test Results tab).-Copy the x-csrf-token that you can find there.-Now, return to the top Header Tab and Paste the CSRF Token (replace Fetch).-The Pre-requisite to post a change record in the system is completed.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign OData services support two authentication protocols: Basic Authentication (user/password) and OAuth 2.0 SAML Bearer authentication, as specified in: -Configure OAuth 2.0 for SAP ByDesign OData Services-Keywords-Authorization; Basic Auth; fetch, value; x-csrf-token; Key; url; authentication

Title: How to Merge Multiple Sales Quotes to Create a Single Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are receiving error message "Action cannot be performed on multiple line items. Please select single line item." while trying to merge multiple sales quotes into a single sales order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business work center.-View: Sales Quotes.-Select 2 sales quotes which needs to merged into a single sales order.-Click on Follow up button and choose Sales order.-It gives an error message stating "Action cannot be performed on multiple line items. Please select single line item."-Resolution-This is standard system behavior, it's not possible to merge multiple sales quotes into a single sales order.-See Also-Sales Quotes; Sales Order; Merge; How to; Error

Title: How to Locate the Inventory Costs for Sales Kit in the System
Content: Symptom-You notice that the inventory valuation for the the Sales Kit in the system are not displayed for Kits in the Sales Kit List View and would like to locate this information in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Sales Kit List View.-Filter for All Kit.-Mark the Sales Kit ABC. (Where ABC represents the Sales Kit ID)-Select Edit button.-Information of the Kit is displayed in the UI, however no further information is displayed regarding the Sales Kit inventory valuation.-Cause-In order to locate the inventory valuation for a Sales Kit is required to search for the specific Kit in the Products View.-Resolution-In order to locate the Inventory Costs maintained for Sales Kits kindly follow the below steps:-Go to the Service and Product Portfolio Work Center.-Go to the Products View.-Filter for All Products.-In the search field, search for the Sales Kit ABC.-Mark the Sales Kit ABC.-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Valuation tab.-The Inventory Costs are displayed for Companies/Business Residence maintained for the for the Sales Kit.-Keywords-inventory valuation, inventory cost, sales kit, kit, sales kit list view

Title: Limitation of Characters in the Pricing Table Name
Content: Symptom-When adding a new Custom Pricing Table in the system, you notice that a few characters are being removed from the Pricing Table Name after the save is performed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-In the search field, search for Configure Price Strategy.-Open, select the Pricing Table hyperlink.-Select Add Row button.-In the Pricing Table Name field, Enter the desired Pricing Table Name.-In the Relevance field, Select either Header Level or Item Level.-In the Fields section, Select Add Row button.-Enter the desired fields.-Select Save button.-A few characters are removed from the Pricing Table Name after the save is performed.-Cause-The Pricing Table Name field has a limitation of 18 characters (including spaces and also the prefix CUS).-If more than 18 characters are maintained in the Pricing Table Name for its creation, the characters add after the character 18 will be removed when the save action is performed.-For example: if a Pricing Table Name is added as CUS TEST TEST TEST123, the characters '123' will be removed after the save is performed and the Pricing Table Name will be displayed as CUS TEST TEST TEST.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior. -See Also-KBA: 2654104 - How to Delete Custom Pricing Table--Keywords-limitation, pricing table name, name, pricing table, characters

Title: Payment Run Error: 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'.
Content: Symptom-You are executing a Payment run and you are getting the following error message: 'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'. -(XYZ represents the Work package ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Payment Runs subview. -Select "All Payment Runs". -Search for Run ID: DEF (DEF represents the Run ID). -Open the Application Log ID in reference to the run ID DEF. -You will see the following error message:-'Work package ID XYZ system error; report an incident'. -Cause-One possible reason for this error is because the logic checks for the payment run require that the total amounts of the items being considered have the same direction, either positive or negative (+ / -).-Usually, there are two groups determined for all Business partners, and they do not have the same sign.-The account used is a mixed account, meaning it is both a customer and a supplier account. Additionally, the netting option is scoped in the configuration. This means that relevant payables items are being picked up, but there are also items from the receivables side that are being considered. Since both positive and negative amounts are identified, the issue arises.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, it is recommended to avoid including "mixed" accounts on payment runs. Instead, it is recommended to clear the payables and receivables separately. By doing so, the payment proposal will only include open due items from either the supplier accounts or the customer accounts, but not both. This will ensure that the logic checks for the payment run are satisfied.-See Also-Payment Run, Work package ID, system error, Payables.

Title: How to get the assigned business users roles with PDI
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to fetch the business roles of a business user with ABSL scripts from your custom solution within SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-You can make use of GetAssignedBusinessRoles function from Context reuse library.-Sample script:-var assignedRolesCollection: Collectionof IdentityBusinessRoleID;-var assignedRoles:IdentityBusinessRoles;-assignedRoles = Context.GetAssignedBusinessRoles();-assignedRolesCollection = assignedRoles.BusinessRoles;-See Also-Please refer to SAP Cloud Applications Studio help portal:-Context (Reuse Library)-Keywords-PDI, SDK, script, business, role, user, logged, fetch, retrieve, query, GetAssignedBusinessRoles

Title: Customer Return is With Status as "In Progress" Even Though the Credit Memo is Already Created
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Customer Return ABC is with status "In Progress", even though the follow up Credit Memo was created and it is with status as "Not Released". (where ABC represents the Customer Return ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Returns View.-Filter for All Returns.-In the search field, search for the Customer Return ABC. (where ABC represents the Customer Return ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The Customer Return is displayed as "In Progress", however the Credit Memo was already created and is with status as "Not Released".-Cause-The overall status of the Customer Return document will only change to "Completed" once the Credit Memo document is with status as "Released".-Note: This is only applied if the Customer Return is released with the option "Release with Credit Memo".-Resolution-This is currently standard system behavior.-In order to complete the Customer Return it is required to Released the Credit Memo in the system.-Keywords-customer return, credit memo, not released, completed, in progress

Title: Background jobs cancelled - Failed to close application log
Content: Symptom-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental-Custom MDR jobs getting cancelled with errors stating 'Cancelled manually or by the system'-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-In your cloud solution, open background jobs and filter by failed jobs.-Open jobs with status 'Cancelled manually or by the system'-Search for erros in such as 'Error called FPP service CLOSE; Action failed' or 'Execution of CLOSE action of BO ApplicationLog failed'-This indicates there is a highloiad of the Applicaiton Log BO due a large number of warnings for example-Cause-A setting in Custom Mass Data Run configurations in your SAP Cloud Applications Studio may be allowing warning messages to be shown. If these exceed many thousands, the Application Log BO can become overwhelmed and cause background jobs to fail.-Resolution-You will need to adjust settings of the related .RUN file in your SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Go to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open .RUN file.-Go to Control Parameters tab.-Click on Detail Level.-Select Errors rather than 'All details' or 'Errors and Warnings'.-  Keywords-Application BO; MDR; background jobs; Failed MDR; AP-RC-APL;

Title: Company name is not updated in the dunning letter
Content: Symptom-Dunning letter is showing the incorrect company name-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work Center > Dunning view-Search for the affected Dunning ID and open it-Go to Output History tab-Open the Document-You can see the Dunning letter is still showing the "old" company name-Cause-One possible cause of the issue is that company name was not update in the Org. Structure-Resolution-Maintain the Company Name under Organizational Management Work Center > Org Structures view > Addresses tab--Keywords-dunning letter, company name, incorrect, wrong

Title: Dump During Creation of New Inspection
Content: Symptom-During the creation of  New Inspection you will encounter the below error-"Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident. "-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Quality Control workcenter and Inspections view.-2.Click on New Inspection-3.Key in the details like Inspection type , Site, Supplier, Material, Identified Stock ,Lot quantity-4.Click on Next and then Finish-You will encounter the dump-Cause-Same Inspection Stage ID  1, 2 was used in Adaptive Sampling Rule ID Z1, Z2( where Z1, Z2 are Adaptive Sampling Rule ID).-Resolution-To avoid this dump you need to ensure that the Inspection Stage ID should be unique amongst all the Adaptive Sampling Rule ID.-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter and find Adaptive Sampling activity and Open-2. Here you can check the Inspection Stage ID for the custom defined Adaptive Sampling Rule ID and change accordingly.

Title: Error "Initial key fields for business partner identification" Occurrs When Migrating Employee Data
Content: Symptom-Error "Initial key fields for business partner identification" occurrs when migrating employee data-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Busienss Configuration work center.-Search Migration of Employee Data.-Select Migration basic employee data using the migration tool.-Click the migration file and select Execute Migration Step by Step.-Then error occurs in simulation step.-Cause-The issue might be caused by missing value in field "ID Card Type" in Personal Data sheet of the migration file. ID Type and ID Number must both be filled or left empty.-Resolution-Please maintain ID Card Type or remove value in ID Card Number.-Keywords-Migration of Employee; ID Type; ID Number

Title: You are Unable to Use a Standard Node in the Script File of an Add-on Solution
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Partner will try to use a standard node or association in the .ABSL file but the node / association is not returned by code completion.-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“ -Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the solution and navigate to the script file.-Write the code and use the code completion (after typing a period (.) or CTRL + SPACEBAR) for the particular node, which does not show up in the list.-Cause-There can be multiple reasons:-The parent node is not PSM released for Read/Write access.-The current node is not PSM released for Read/Write access.-The association from the parent to child node is not released (you have to verify from the backend transaction MDRS in the respective BO node).-   4. The script file that partner has created is mass enabled.-Resolution-For the fist 3 reasons, the incident should be routed to the respective application development team to release the node/ association.-For reason 4, please refer to the KBA:  2469605 - Error While Trying to Activate Script File : Identifier ABC Does not Exist-Keywords-PSM, PDI, SDK, node, association, field, element, BO, not, available, missing, public, solution, model

Title: Long Loading Time when Creating a Credit Memo as Follow-Up from Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a Follow-Up Credit Memo from a Customer Invoice, you notice that the system takes a long time loading or generates an error after a few minutes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find Customer Invoice ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the document you wish to create a Credit Memo from).-Highlight the Line -Click on the Follow-Up button and choose the Credit Memo option.- The next screen takes several minutes to load or fail to load after 10 minutes.-Cause-This behaviour is caused when the Account used in the Customer Invoice has many Relationships with the "Has Ship-To Party" attribute configured. When the system tries to create the Follow-Up Credit Memo, all those records need to be fetched and processed which can take a long time if the list is too long.-Resolution- You can check the Relationships by following these steps:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Open the Accounts view.-Find Account ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the Account used in the Customer Invoice).-In the Account screen, click the View All button.-Navigate to the Contacts tab.-Open the Relationships and Responsibilities sub tab.-Under the Relationships section you can see all the Relationships with "Has Ship-To Party" Maintained.-We recommend keeping less than 100 of such Relationships in the Account to ensure the performance of the Follow-Up operation.-Keywords-System, Long, Time, Processing, Slow, Follow-up, Performance, Relationship, Account

Title: SAP Cloud Applications Studio gets closed as soon as checking the CSD for the WSDL External Web Service Integration
Content: Symptom-SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) gets closed as soon as you select the CSD for the WSDL.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Right click on .wsid file.-Click on 'Create Communication Scenario Definition'.-Select SOAP.-Select Custom Services from the given option.-Click on Next-SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) gets closed.-Cause-This issue happens when there is no binding available in the WSDL file. You can check the same by opening the WSDL file for the affected .wsid file and search for 'binding'. You can see 'no result'.-Resolution-This is known issue and we have a workaround to select the Standard service and create CSD.-Later we can change the services and check custom and uncheck standard from the created CSD to fulfill the requirement.-Below are the example steps :-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Right click on .wsid file.-Click on 'Create Communication Scenario Definition'.-Select SOAP.-Select any Standard Service from the given option.-Click on Next and finish the CSD creation.-Open created CSD and change the service as per the requirement.-Keywords-SDK crashes , Closed , CSD, SOAP

Title: Error: Cannot Create Price List With This Area of Validity; Check Long Text During Migration of Customer Specific Price Lists
Content: Symptom-Error Message Cannot create price list with this Area of Validity; check long text in the validation stage of Migration of Field Lists.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Show Activities and Find Migration of Price Lists.-Hyperlink: Migrate price lists using the migration tool.-Upload the populated template.-Select the Execute Migration button and select Execute Migration Step by Step option from the drop down.-Cause- If you enter the customer specific price list from the UI you will see that only the field Account ID is available.-Resolution-Hence, during migration check other fields in the Validity Area like Product Category ID, Customer Group, Sales Organization ID, Distribution Channel are left blank during migration of Customer Specific Price Lists.-Keywords-  Price List, Migration-validity area,cannot create price list with this area,area of validity

Title: Wrong View / Selection When Opening a Report From E-Mail
Content: Symptom-You are sending a report via e-mail however when the recipient opens it, the report opens with the default view and selection rather than the view and selection that it was sent with.-You may also notice that when generating the XML report from a work center (e.g. Supplier Base), the parameters &VIEW and &VARIANT are not populated in the XML code. This is why the standard selection and view are displayed for that report.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In order to reproduce this scenario, you can follow the steps below:-Open any existing report e.g. Supplier Details under Supplier Base Work Center.-The report would open using the default selection and view.-Modify the selection adding different criteria, e.g. Supplier ID and save the selection as 'Selection ABC' for example.-Add new fields to the report view, e.g. Supplier Address and save the view as 'View ABC' for example.-Make sure that the new view and selection are not set as default.-Once the report is generated, click the Share button and select the option Send E-mail and As E-mail link (Microsoft Excel in XML Format)-Enter a user e-mail and click Send.-Open your mail client and retrieve the e-mail. Right click the link to view the URL. As you can see, the URL has no values for &VIEW and &VARIANT.-This means that when you click the link after entering the logon credentials, the report will run using the default view and selection instead of the ones the report was using when it was shared via e-mail.-Cause-This is currently the expected behavior when the report is shared via e-mail if it was opened using another work center rather than the Business Analytics Work Center.-Resolution-In order to populated the parameters &VIEW and &VARIANT when generating the XML report, this report should be opened and sent via e-mail from the Business Analytics Work Center when the custom view and selection are used.-For end user views and selections, you can make use of the Share View feature in the report.-Keywords-Reports; Send via E-mail; How-To; &VIEW; &VARIANT; Analytics; C4C; ByD; XML; email

Title: Error Message: The Validity of Expense Type ZZZZ Must Lie within the Validity of Tax Code Group YY
Content: Symptom-User from Generic Country Version has created Expense type and receiving below error message while entering tax code group in expense types.-The validity of expense type ZZZZ must lie within the validity of tax code group YY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Show All Current Projects.-Choose the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune chevron and  Find activity Expense Reporting - Generic Country Version.-Click Edit expense types.-Select Expense Type: ZZZZ and go to Definition tab (ZZZZ represent the Expense Type).-Enter Tax code group YY (YY represents the Tax Code Group).-You can see the error message: The validity of expense type ZZZZ must lie within the validity of tax code group YY-Cause-The validity of the expense type is not within the validity maintained for the Tax code group.-For example: You have maintained the validity of Expense type from 01.01.2018 and validity of Tax code group from 04.04.2018. Here, expense type must lie within the validity of tax code group.-Either you need to extend validity of tax code group as 01.01.2018 to unlimited or limit the validity of expense type ZZZZ to 04.04.2018 to unlimited, so that validity of expense type lies completely within validity of tax code group YY.-Resolution-You need to extend the validity from date for the Tax code group or limit the validity from date for expense type by following below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Show All Current Projects.-Choose the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune chevron and  Find activity Tax Activation- Generic Country Version.-Choose Open and click Define and edit tax code groups.-Select the appropriate Country Version and Tax Code Group YY (YY represents the Tax Code Group).-Here you need to maintain the correct Valid From.-(Or)-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Show All Current Projects.-Choose the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune chevron and  Find activity Expense Reporting - Generic Country Version.-Click Edit expense types.-Select Expense Type: ZZZZ and go to Definition tab (ZZZZ represent the Expense Type).-Here you need to maintain the correct Valid From.-Keywords-Expense type, tax code group, Generic country version, Expense reporting

Title: Expose to BW feature Missing for all Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You would like to expose a data source (BW extraction) but the Expose button is missing or greyed out.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Select a data source (notice that the expose option is not available for joined data sources).-The expose option for BW Extraction is not available for any of the data sources (it could be that the feature to Expose for OData is shown).-Cause-The business configuration is not yet scoped to include this feature.-Resolution-SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-On the new screen, go to Step 3 Scoping.-Check the following BC Option: Communication and Information Exchange -> Integration with Eternal Applications and Solutions -> Integration with Central Analytics.-Continue to step 4 Questions.-Navigate as before: Communication and Information Exchange -> Integration with Eternal Applications and Solutions -> Integration with Central Analytics.-Check the question Do you want to make analytics data from the solution available to an SAP NetWeaver Business Warehouse system?-Finish the setup.-SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-On the new screen, go to Step Scoping.-Check the following BC Option: Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Integration with SAP ERP for subsidiaries.-Continue to Step Questions.-Navigate as before: Communication and Information Exchange -> Business Process Management -> Integration with SAP ERP for subsidiaries.-Check the question Do you want to make analytics data from the solution available to an SAP NetWeaver Business Warehouse system?-Finish the setup.-Also, the below scoping question has to be checked for both systems:-Navigate to the BC option: Built-in Services and Support -> System Management -> Analytics.-Check the question: Do you want to enable analytical OData services for data sources?-See Also-2634621 - Allow extended text lengths during Analytics Data Integration-OData API for Data Sources - SAP help portal documentation-Keywords-scoping, BW extraction, expose button, implementation project

Title: Cannot Update Customer Return
Content: Symptom-You have performed changes in the items of the Inbound Delivery and expected to see these changes in the Customer Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use the following example:-ABC represents the ID of the Customer Return.-GHI represents the ID of the Warehouse Order.-MNO represents the ID of the Customer Invoice.-XYZ represents the ID of the Inbound Delivery.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for Customer Return ABC.-Click Edit.-You see that item 10 was mistakenly released with 0 quantity, thus creating a Credit Memo with 0 quantity and not with a quantity of 1 as expected.-Go to the Document Flow tab of the Customer Return.-Open the Inbound Delivery XYZ.-Click Undo Release.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Open the Warehouse Order GHI.-Click View All button.-Click on Adjustment Confirmation button.-Select line 10 and click Enable Entry.-Change the Quantity Difference to 1.-Click Save.-Go to the Inbound Delivery XYZ and click Release.-Go to the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate the Items tab.-The quantity added to the item under the Inbound Delivery XYZ did not update to the Customer Return ABC.-Cause-Once the Customer Return has been released With Credit Memo, the system does not perform updates from changes made in the Inbound Delivery to the Customer Return.-Updated information from the Inbound Delivery to the Customer Return will only happen when the Return has not been released.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-To correct this, please perform the following steps.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select the Invoice MNO.-Click Cancel.-Save the new canceled Invoice.-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Inbound Deliveries view.-Search for ID XYZ.-Click Undo Release.-Go to the By Warehouse Order view.-Search for the ID GHI.-Click Edit.-Click on Adjustment Confirmation button.-Select line 10 and click Enable Entry.-Since you had already added the expected number previously, now perform the following.-Make the quantity negative, such as -1.-Click Save.-Change the quantity to 1 (positive).-Click Save.-Go back to the Inbound Deliveries view.-Search for ID XYZ.-Click Release.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for Customer Return ABC.-Now the document's status has changed from Completed to In Process.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Credited Quantity is now enabled.-Change the value to 1, making it equal to Planned Quantity.-Click Release and select With Credit Memo.-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search with the ID ABC (reference to the Customer Return).-Document is with the To Be Invoiced status with the expected quantity.-See Also-2216315 - The Customer Return Invoice Request is Having the Net Value as Zero-Keywords-Customer Return, Update, Inbound Delivery, Item, Quantity, Customer Return Invoice Request, Quantity, Zero

Title: Unable to Cancel the Contract As Cancellation Fields are Greyed Out
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to enter the Cancellation details in order to cancel the Contract but all relevant fields are greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contracts view and select the Contracts sub view.-In the field Show, choose  All Contracts by drop down and find the relevant Contract ID which you want to cancel.-Select the contact and choose the Edit button.-Under General tab, navigate to Renewal and Cancellation tab.-Now here under Cancellation section , all relevant fields as Cancellation Received On, Cancellation Requested For, Cancellation Reason and Cancellation Effective On are greyed out.-Cause-Since the Contract is with status In Process, it is not possible to Cancel the same either at Header or Item Level.-When you initially create a contract then at the header level user can define a Cancellation Rule and enters the Cancellation Fields as per the requirement. As soon as you save it and the contract is with status In Process, then the same cancellation rule is valid for the contract at the header level as well as at the item level, hence those cancellation fields greys out and data cannot be entered.-Resolution-Once the Contract is Released, the related Cancellation Fields are activated that allow you to review incoming cancellation requests and decide whether they are valid and when they should be put into effect.-See Also-KBA 3436308 - Unable to Cancel The Customer Contract-Keywords-Contract; Cancellation Fields; Greyed out; Released

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Analytics Related Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- In this Knowledge Based Article, we will look at known issues regarding the Analytics topic, and how we can troubleshoot Analytics issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-Report / Data Source name in the UI and steps to display the issue.-Report / Data Source filepath in Solution.-Affected extension field names (if relevant).-BASIC DATA Source-Joined / Combined DS-If the Field/column is not available for a SAP Data Source.-1. Determine technical name of the SAP Data Source by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Analytics work centre.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Search for Data Source name.-Open the Help Documentation.-Take note of tech ID of Data Source.-The above can also be found in MDRS.-2. Check what kind of a characteristic (field) it is. Is it Pdi or KUT?-Check in the backend transacation: /n/ext/field (refer to KBA 2332704 - How to check Extension Field Issue.  to see how to use this transaction).-If it is a KUT field, send it to the application team.-If it is a PDI field, continue with the below steps.-3. Go to the backend transaction MDRS.-Select MDAV (multi-Dimensional Analytical View).-Search for the SAP Data Source you found in step 1.-Open the Characteristics folder/Key Figure.-Check if the element is available.-4. Drill down the Joined / Combined Data Source by opening the Join Members folder to determine where the PDI field is originally coming from.-If the field is not available here, the Data Source Reference Field Bundle is not part of the Field.-Go to the backend transaction XREP/YXXXXXX_MAIN_Assembly.AnalyticalSolution.ana.-Search for combo SAP DS + RFB + Pdi field.-If the Field is not here, the PDI field has not been extended to the SAP Data Source. Close incident informing the partner of this information.-if the Field is here, send the incident to analytics as the Data Source is the issue. Usually this means there is an inconsistency on the Data Source layer. -If the Field is available-1. Open the FSI view in the VIEWBUILDER by clicking Query Definition field value of the Data Source in MDRS.-Select MDAV and then double click the FSI view.-Check if this field is part of this view in Attribute of Data Object.-a. If it is not then there is an issue, check this with Anil Rana.-b. If it is, that means it is available in the Data Source, and an FSI reload required.-  Data value for field is not available.-1. Determine technical name of the SAP Data Source by following the below steps:-Go to the Business Analytics work centre.-Go to the Design Data Sources view.-Search for Data Source name.-Open the Help Documentation.-Take note of tech ID of Data Source.-The above can also be found in MDRS.-2. Check what kind of a characteristic (field) it is. Is it Pdi or KUT?-Check in the backend transacation: /n/ext/field (refer to KBA 2332704 - How to check Extension Field Issue.  to see how to use this transaction).-If it is a KUT field, send it to the application team.-If it is a PDI field, continue with the below steps.-3. If the field was created via PDI, find what Business Object and node it was created on. Then follow the below:-Go to the backend transaction SESFTS. (2571142 - How to Search for a Business Object in the Backend Transaction SESFTS ).-Query the Business Object & determine if value in the field.-If there is no value maintained, then close incident with this information (no value in frontend or backend).-If there is a value maintained, check what the anchor of the Data Source is (open MDAV, open the FSI view of the Data Source and take a note of what the anchor is).-4. If the anchor is below the PDI field and it has no value, then the PDI field will not be displayed.-5. If it is on anchor for that node, then an FSI reload is needed.-Element/Node isn't available during.-Translation issues in DS/Report.-Incorrect Data for a field is shown.-Field can't be added to a particular DS.-Resolution-Kindly follow the above analysis and take approriate steps from your side.-See Also-General:-2584566 - How to Check the Component Responsible for a Data Source-Analytical FSI (missing data) and HANA Issues:-2591696 - HANA-RUN-ERROR (2.007) in Custom Data Source-2655378 - How To Use The Backend Transaction GFSSTM- 2655230 - How To Use The Backend Transaction VIEWBUILDER-2510755 - PDI Data Source is Missing Data-Consulting:-2559087 - How-To and Consulting Queries in Reporting / Analytics-1830749 - Complete Data Sources and Characteristics Documentation-2539499 - Performance of Custom Reports and Data Sources-Errors seen from the frontend UI:-2401879 - Changes to PDI Reports Are Not Saved-2192652 - Error During Enhancing a Report from PDI Solution: Retrieving Data Sources Failed Metadata Utility: Could not Find Field-2433810 - Unable to save Key Figures in Report View-2530322 - Save not Possible;
