Title: In Preparation Contracts are not Showing in the Customer Contract Volume report
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when you are using the Customer Contract Volume report (CRMCCOIB_Q0001), the contracts with status of In Preparation are not displaying as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for CRMCCOIB_Q0001 or Customer Contract Volume.-Click on the Name's hyperlink to open.-Add any filter, such as Last 365 days.-Click Apply.-The In Preparation contracts are not displayed.-Cause-The Customer Contract Volume (CRMCCOIB_Q0001) report will only show contracts with released status equal to Release. -The reason of this is because the Customer Contract Item (CRMCCOIB) data source has an ‘hard coded’ filter based upon the Release status of the contract and it's item.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -If you would like to view the In Preparation contracts, please use the Customer Contract Volume Extended (CRMCCOIB01_Q0001) report. -See Also-2921349 - How Does Reporting Works in Business ByDesign-2724953 - In Preparation Sales Order Missing in the Report-1982397 - Contract not shown on the Customer Contract Volume report-Keywords-Contract, In Preparation, Customer Contract Volume, Report, Missing, Not Showing, Status, CRMCCOIB

Title: Dump Occurs When Posting a Journal Entry Voucher For Material ABC
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When posting a business document related to Material ABC, i.e. a Journal Entry Voucher, a dump is raised. (ABC stands for the Material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Journal Entry Voucher view. -Click on New. Select "Journal Entry Voucher" option. -Fill in all required fields, including Material ID ABC.-Click on Post.-Dump occurs.-Also, when troubleshooting the dump on ST22, you will find that it happened on Class CL_FIA_MATLA_BL=>VALUATE_FLOW_QUAN_MOV_AVG_PRC.  -Cause-One of the possible reasons may be that the Material ABC, which uses Valuation Method: Moving Average has negative Inventory Value on the period you are trying to execute the posting.-You can check this in the Material Cost History:-1. Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-2. Open Materials view.-3. Filter for All Materials and search for Material ABC.-4. Select the entry of the correct Business Residence, then click on View Cost History button.-You will notice that the Inventory Value is negative. -Resolution-In order to be able to post the document that is raising the dump, the Inventory Value cannot be negative. Hence it is recommended for the customer to create an adjustment Journal Entry Voucher such that the Inventory Value becomes positive.-Journal Entry Type: 00087 - Manual Entry for Materials-Business Transaction Type: 630 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials--See Also-Negative Inventories-Keywords-negative, inventory, dump, CL_FIA_MATLA_BL=>VALUATE_FLOW_QUAN_MOV_AVG_PRC

Title: Customer Information Notes Missing in Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when you make the attempt of invoicing an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request from an Outbound Delivery created of two Sales Orders, the system is not considering the Customer Information found in both Sales Orders but only retrieving the value of one of the Sales Order document. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of Outbound Delivery Invoice Request).-Click Edit.-Scroll down Customer Information tab.-System is only showing the value from Sales Order 123 and not 456 (123 and 456 represents the ID of the Sales Orders).-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Delivery view.-Search and open the Outbound Delivery ABC (Outbound Delivery created for both Sales Orders).-Click View All.-Navigate to the Notes tab.-There are two Customer Information.-One holds the value from Sales Order 123 and the other for Sales Order 456.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior. -The way the Invoice Requests business object was designed, does not support two customer or internal notes as it is found in the Outbound Delivery business object. -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Portal to submit an idea. -Improvement requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis, with the results being communicated in a corresponding review blog post.-Keywords-Customer Information, Internal Information, Invoice Request, Missing, Disappearing, Sales Order, Outbound Delivery, Notes

Title: System is showing warning messages regarding the Material Flow Rules when performing Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-When you click on the Post Goods Receipt button when trying to receive an Inbound Delivery, system is showing warning messages.-"Determination of destination inventory failed for product KLM (KLM refers to the product id).-Sequence determination result for item X (X refers to the line item no) is missing.-Inventory in logistics area not available.-Determination of destination inventory failed for product KLM.-Sequence determination result for item X is missing.-Inventory in logistics area not available-Sequence determination result for item X is missing." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Search for the relevant Site ID.-Click Edit Layout.-Notice that relevant Logistics Area is In Preparation status.-Cause-You set the Logistics area status In Preparation instead Active for the relevant Site.-Resolution-You need change the Logistics Area status from In Preparation to Active in the relevant Site, after that it will appear to select source or destination Logistics Area when choose Basic Rule in Material Flow-See Also-644970 - System Triggers Material Flow Warning Messages While Performing Post Goods Receipt -Keywords-Determination of destination inventory, Inventory in logistics area not available, Sequence determination result

Title: The error "Item xx: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is displayed in a Over-the-Counter Sales
Content: Symptom-You notice that the Over-the-Counter Sale is with status as "Inconsistent" and when opening the document the error "Item xx: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is displayed in the UI (User Interface).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales Work Centers.-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales View.-In the search field, search for the Over-the-Counter Sale ID ABC (ABC represents the Over-the-Counter Sale).-Open, Select View All.-The following errors are displayed in the UI:-Item xx: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation (KBA: 3147367)-In addition, a Customer Invoice has already been generated for the Over-the-Counter Sale ID ABC.-Cause-A valid List Price has not being maintained in the payload for the creation of Over-the Counter Sales ABC in the system, which resulted in document being created with status Inconsistent.-Resolution-As a Customer Invoice has already been released in the system for the Over-the Counter Sales, It is not possible to correct the values in the Over-the-Counter Sales documents (also not via the backend).-In this case in order to correct this scenario it would be necessary to roll back the process and cancel the Over-the-Counter Sales documents ABC and create a new one either manually or via the web service but with the List Price of the Items properly maintained in payload.-Keywords-inconsistent, over-the counter sales, mandatory list price missing, list price, released

Title: You Cannot Edit the Tax Details in the External Customer Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You want to edit the tax details on invoice requests, but you find in some invoice requests, the tax details is editable but in some invoice requests, the tax related fields are grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Open one invoice request and go to Items tab.-In the Taxes sub tab, you can see the tax details, for example Tax Code fields is not editable.-However, in some requests, you can change the tax details.-Cause-This is an invoice request with type External Customer Invoice Request.-The external invoice requests are not editable in the systems and any updates if required should be made in the external system and the uploaded as an update in the system.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior as designed.-Keywords-External Customer Invoice Requests, Change, Update, Read-Only, Tax, Edit, Tax Exemption

Title: Release Button Greyed Out in Cancellation Invoice scenario
Content: Symptom-In a Cancellation Invoice scenario, you wish to Release the Cancellation Invoice, however, the 'Release' button is Greyed-Out and cannot be clicked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find Cancellation Invoice ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Cancellation Invoice that needs to be Released).-Select the document.-You see that the 'Release' button is Greyed-Out.-Cause-In a Customer Invoice Cancellation scenario, the Release action is performed by the 'Save' button. When hovering the mouse over the 'Save' button, the following tooltip is displayed: "[...] In case of a Cancellation Invoice the document will be released by the system"-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. In order to Release the Cancellation Invoice, you need to follow these steps: -Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find Cancellation Invoice ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Cancellation Invoice that needs to be Released).-Edit the Cancellation Invoice.-Click the View All Button.-Click the Save Button.-The Cancellation Invoice is then Released.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Cancellation, Release, Button, Unable, Impossible, Greyed, Grayed, Grey, Gray, Save, Tooltip.

Title: Integration issue between the SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Customer Checkout - Credit Card Payments
Content: Symptom-You are trying to integrate the SAP Business ByDesign with the SAP Customer Checkout and you noticed that the sales transactions paid in the SAP Customer Checkout with credit card are inconsistent in the SAP Business ByDesign with the following error:-Payment Item XXX-Y: Credit card payment is not scoped-Payment Item XXX-Y: Credit card ID not valid (KBA: 3308356)-Payment Item XXXX-X: Credit card payer is missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Customer Checkout-Reproducing the Issue-In the SAP Customer Checkout, create a sales transaction and pay with credit card-The sales transaction is sent to the SAP Business ByDesign-In the SAP Business ByDesign, go to Customer Invoicing Work Center > Sales Transaction view-In the drop-down box list, select Sales Transactions that require Processing-Search for the External ID: XYZ-Click Check-The following error is shown-Payment Item XXX-Y: Credit card payment is not scoped-Payment Item XXX-Y: Credit card ID not valid (KBA: 3308356)-Cause-In the SAP Business ByDesign, the scope question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" has been removed as of the release 2302 and due to this missing configuration in your system, this issue is happening.-Resolution-Create an incident with SAP Support and mention this KBA, please.-SAP will enable this feature in your system.--After that, you could continue with the integration following the steps mentioned in this blog.-See Also-Integrate SAP Customer Checkout Point-of-Sales with SAP ByDesign blog--KBA 3308356 - Inconsistent Sales Transaction due to Error "Payment Item: Credit card ID not valid" --KBA 3330989 - Scoping Question "Do you accept customer payment using credit cards?" is Missing in the Project Scope --KBA 3414185 - While Enabling "Credit Card Payment" Scoping Question Missing In The Project Scope.--Keywords-integration, byd, cco, credit card, payment, sales transaction, POS system

Title: Contract not shown on the Customer Contract Volume report
Content: Symptom-You have created a Contract however when you check the Customer Contract Volume report the contract is not listed on the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Sales Orders work center and report list view.-Search and open the report Customer Contract Volume.-Adjust the selection values based on the contract you have created and click Go.-Add the Contract field to the rows and selection screen.-The contract you have created is neither available from the report nor form the value help selection.-Cause-Only Contracts with released status equal to Release are shown on the report.-Resolution-The Customer Contract Volume (CRMCCOIB_Q0001) report shows the contracts where net and invoiced values are defined. So the contract will be shown on the report only if the contract itself or the item has been released and consequently an invoice request has been triggered once.-The reason of this is because the Customer Contract Item (CRMCCOIB) data source has an ‘hard coded’ filter based upon the Release status of the contract and it's item.-The release status value can be checked, where the contract or item was released, via the Contract details, Changes tab then Attribute and by filtering for Release Status.-Note: In case you want to see all contracts available independently of their release status you can use the data source Customer Contract Header (CRMCCOHB).-See Also-3422792 In Preparation Contracts are not Showing in the Customer Contract Volume report-Keywords-Contract, Report, Missing, Not Showing, Display, Customer Contract Volume, CRMCCOIB

Title: Sales Order Numbering Gap
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when Sales Orders are created via web shop (web service) the system creates gaps in the numbering sequence of Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-The reason the system is performing gaps within the numbering of the documents is because the numbers are stored within the internal buffering system. -Within the internal buffering system, the engine selects the numbers randomly from the define range to create the documents, however it does consider a chronological order when executing such action.-This logic is applied for both sales orders created from the UI (user interface) and from web service. -See Also-2675078 - Gaps in Number Range of Outbound Delivery Numbers-Keywords-Sales Order, Numbering, Range, Gap, Sequence, Skip, Issue, Error, Web Shop, Web Service

Title: 'No se generaron documentos de pago electrónico' Message In The Log of Mexico Receivables - Electronic Payment Run
Content: Symptom-The Receivables - Electronic Payment Run executed in the system is not able to generate any document, which is evidenced by the message in the run's log:-'No se generaron documentos de pago electrónico'.-This scenario is valid for Mexico country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Electronic Payment Run view. -Find the respective Run ID.-Select the row of respective Execution ID / Application Log ID and open it.-Under Summarizing Messages, notice the message: 'No se generaron documentos de pago electrónico'.-Cause-The run has been executed for a given customer invoice ABC (ABC means the customer invoice).-In data selection, the Posting date from/to date has been defined as, for example, 29.12.2023.-However, the Due Clearing Date of invoice ABC is 01.06.2023. Hence, the expected document couldn't be found by system and no e-payment documents were created.-To check the Due Clearing Date of invoice ABC:-Open invoice ID ABC.-Click View All.-Open Document Flow tab.-Open Clearing ID DEF (DEF is the Clearing ID), which is connected to invoice ABC.-Check the Posting Date: the Posting Date of Clearing ID DEF represents the invoice's Due Clearing Date.-Remark: There's no Due Clearing Date field in the UI. The Due Clearing Date field, that exists in system backend, is represented in the UI by the Clearing's DEF Posting Date.-Resolution-The Posting date from/to date should be set to cover the Due Clearing Date (identified by the Posting Date) of the Clearing that is clearing the respective customer invoice being fetched by the run.-Keywords-mexico; clearing; Electronic Payment Run; due clearing date; posting date; receivables

Title: How to Copy Solution Profile in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." --You need to copy your existing solution profile from one tenant to another tenant. The copy of the solution profile includes scoping and fine tuning.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to Systems view.-Select the line of source system and click on copy solution profile button.-Choose Source system ID, source solution profile ID as well as the target system where the solution profile will be moved.--Click on OK and the request will starts.-In general copy solution profile request is completed within 2 hours.-You can follow up the status of your request through Service Control Center work center in Service Requests view. -See Also-2799608 - How to check Existing Service Request Details in C4C /ByD-Keywords-BYD, Copy Solution Profile, Service Control Center

Title: Sales Order Cancellation Status Not Updated to "Partially Cancelled" as Expected.
Content: Symptom-In a Sales Order scenario involving Sales Kits, after cancelling one or more line items, you expect the Cancellation Status to change to "Partially Cancelled", however, the status changed to "Cancelled".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Open the Sales Orders view.-Find and open Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Sales Order ID).-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You see that one or more of the cancelled line items have not been fully delivered or invoiced, however, the cancellation status is "Cancelled" and not "Partially Cancelled".-Cause-This happens when one or more of the cancelled line items of the Sales Order is a Sales Kit line item. Even though one or more of the Child items of the Sales Kit have not been fully delivered or invoiced, once the Sales Kit Header is cancelled, the system considers all the respective Sales Kit Child Items as fully cancelled.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Kit, Sales Order, Cancellation Status, Fully Cancelled, Partially Cancelled, Reverse, Reversed, Reason for Rejection, Rejected, Erroneous, Incorrect, Status.

Title: Failed XI Message "Logon failed" is Displayed in Backend for a Sales Order Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***  -Customer reported that a Sales Order is with status as "In Progress", however the document should be with status as "Completed" as all items were completely invoiced through a Customer Invoice document.-Checking in the Process Communication Errors View, no error is displayed for the Sales Order document. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-In the search field, search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-The overall status of the Sales Order ABC is displayed as "In Progress", however the document should be with status as "Completed" as all items maintained in the Sales Order are completely invoiced through a Customer Invoice document.-Cause-A failed XI message is preventing further messages from being delivered for the Sales Order ABC in the backend, hence the overall status of the Sales Order is stuck as "In Progress".-Resolution-In this case, it will be required to perform the restart action failed XI message in the backend.-Go to Transaction SEFTS-Search for the BO name -> APCR_CUSTOMER_REQ-Select the arrow in the folder Icon-Select the option Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-In the "BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentID/content" field, insert the Sales Order ID ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Select Confirm-In the BO Instance Structure Column, Right click the Customer Requirement ID EFG (where EFG represents the Customer Demand backend ID)-Select Message Monitoring -> Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow-Mark the failed XI message-Select Actions button-In the dropdown, Select Restart -Sender Party: CustomerRequirementProcessing-Receiver Interface: SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn-Error Information: Logon failed/ CPIC-CALL: 'ThSAPCMRCV' : cmRc=17 thRc=672 Logon fa-After this process the stuck communication should be delivered for the Sales Order enabling the overall status of the document to change to "Completed".-Keywords-sales order, logon failed, cmRc=17 thRc=672 Logon fa, in progress, status

Title: Multiple Companies in Financial Reports
Content: Symptom-You are following the steps outlined in the case document <1869419 - Unable to Select Multiple Companies in <XXX> Financial Reports > to create a new financial report that enables the selection of multiple companies. However, after completing steps 1, 2, 3 and 4 as described, you find that in step 5 it is not possible to select the selection type Multiple Values.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center and click on Design Reports view.-Click on New button and select option Report.-On the New Report Screen, give the name of the report and the data source you want to base the report on.-In Step 2: Select Key Figures, you choose a Plan / Actual key figure since it is necessary for your report. -Using Next button, go to Steps 3: Select Characteristics and choose the characteristics that you need to display in the report.-Clicking on Next button, go to Step 4: Characteristic Properties. Select Using Variable for the characteristic Company.-In Step 5: Define Variables; you notice it is not possible to choose the selection type Multiple Values. Thus it is not possible to create a report which allows several companies to be selected.-Cause-As soon as you select a Plan/Actual key figure group, the report inherits the parameters defined therein. Those parameters do not allow the selection of several companies.-Resolution-In order to define the multiple selection on the characteristic Company, you need to create the key figures Plan and Actual from scratch to replace the standard key figure group. To do so, please follow the following steps:-Create a new report as shown below (do not copy an existing report). Choose the data source for the report as FINGLAU04:- Select the Key Figure Amount Company Currency as shown below.-  Additionally create two key figures – one for Plan Balance and one for Actual Balance. See screenshots below for step by step process.  Please note that the field Report Item Category decides whether it is Plan or Actual.-For Plan Balance, use the restriction as Report Item Category = 002 ( Plan )-For Actual Balance, use the restriction as Report Item Category = 001 ( Actual )- Select all three key figures, Amount Company Currency, Actual Balance and Plan Balance.- Select all Characteristics.- In the Characteristics Properties tab, select the properties as shown in the 4 screenshots below. The important properties to be maintained are highlighted. In Particular, choose Hierarchy as Using Variable for Balance Sheet and Income Statement Item. Additionally enter Fixed Value Restriction for Default for Plan/Actual Report as shown in the last screenshot.- In Define Variables tab, see the properties as highlighted in below 2 screenshots.  Additionally you could maintain default values as in the below example. Please note that there is a variable for Balance Sheet and Income Statement Item for hierarchy activation as defined in the previous step. Also, Financial Reporting Structure is required for the hierarchy for technical reasons. So you need to have both on the selection – Balance Sheet and Income Statement Item and Financial Reporting Structure.- Then finish the report as shown below.- Assign this report to appropriate work center views and run it from the assigned view. Enter the selections as shown below. In particular, as already explained above, you need to enter the Reporting Structure twice for technical reasons – one in Financial Reporting Structure ( Hierarchy ) and one in Financial Reporting Structure.  Also, enter 001 – Actual and 002-Plan in Report Item Category. You could also have added these as Fixed Value Restrictions. Additionally enter Fiscal Year Variant, Chart of Accounts , Set of Books, Multiple Companies and the fiscal year and periods.-Keywords-fiscal year, multiple companies, financial reports, fin

Title: Cost Price Component is Displayed with Different Currency and Amount for the Sales Order and Sales Quote Documents
Content: Symptom-You notice that when creating a new Sales Quote document the Cost Price component is displayed with a certain currency and amount.-However when creating a new Sales Order document the Cost Price component is displayed with a different currency and amount, even though the same information was entered for the creation of both documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-In the Common Task column, Select the New Sales Order.-Select View All button.-Fill the required information for the creation of the document.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Add Row button.-In the Product field, enter the desired Product.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-In the Item Pricing Section, Select Expand All button.-The Cost Price component is displayed with a certain currency and amount.-Go to the New Business Work Center.-In the Common Task column, Select the New Sales Quote.-Select View All button.-Enter the same information as in the Sales Order document .-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select Add Row button.-In the Product field, enter the same Product as in the Sales Order.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-In the Item Pricing Section, Select Expand All button.- The Cost Price component is displayed with a different currency and amount from the one displayed in the Sales Order.-Cause-For the creation of a Sales Quote document the system do not determine a Ship From party, hence the Cost Price component is always determined from the Inventory Cost for the Company YYY maintained in the Valuation tab of the Product Master Data. (Where YYY represents the Company ID).-In case more than one business residence is maintained for the same Company in the Valuation tab of the Product Master Data, the system will determine the Cost Price component as an average of the Inventory Cost maintained for the valid business residencies.-For the creation of a Sales Order document, the Ship From party is always required to be maintained and can defined as Internal or External.-If the Ship From is determine as External than the supplier will get populated as ABC (where ABC represents the Supplier ID). Since this is an external procurement, the Cost Price component is determined from the corresponding List Price information for the Supplier ABC and desired product.-If the Ship From is determine as Internal than the Cost Price Component will be determined according to the Product Master Data maintained in the Valuation tab.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior.-See Also-KBA 2547292 - Cost Price Component of Sales Order Item Shows Incorrect Value-Keywords-cost, price component, cost price component, sales quote, sales order, amount, currency, different

Title: Currency not converting when using a custom key figure in the report
Content: Symptom-You have created a calculated key figure, which uses a currency unit, and you notice that Currency Conversion, via the Display Currency, is not applied to the key figure if the key figure is used in the report.-The outcome is that the Key Figure currency unit stays as it is independently of the Display Currency selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Create a Calculated Key Figure via the Business Analytics Work center via Design Key Figures view then New. In this example:-Step 1 (Define Key Figure and Select Data Source)-Key Figure Name: XYZ-Data Source Name: Sales Order Item-Key figure Type: Calculated Key Figure-Step 2 (Restrict/Calculate Key Figure)-Calculation Formula: "Net Value" / "Requested Quantity"-Step 3 (Properties)-Conversion Type: NONE-Step 4 & 5 (Review & Confirm)-Review and Select Finish-Add the custom Key Figure (XYZ) to the desired report. In this case, Sales Order Volume report.-Change the Display Currency to the desired currency (e.g. EUR) and Click Go.-The report does not update the currency of the custom Key Figure (XYZ), to the selected value, e.g. EUR, although it updates the one for the standard (SAP) Key Figures. NOTE: The expected Result is that the report shows the updated display currency as previous selected. -Cause-The Conversion Type was not defined for the custom key figure.-Resolution-To have the report to update the currency of the custom Key Figure as the standard one, to the Display Currency selected value, you need to define the Currency Conversion type from the Key Figure properties (Step 3) for the custom Key figure.-Note: If the Currency Conversion type is set as NONE the currency conversion cannot be applied to the key figure if the key figure is used in reports.-Keywords-Key figures, Conversion Rate, Currency, Expected Value, Report, AP-RC-ANA, conversion not working

Title: Error: You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does not Match Your User Settings.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--The error message: You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings.-is seen while trying to access the Activity List, or the Project Scope.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view:-Select the concerned project.-Select the Open Activity List/Edit project Scope button.-Verify if the backend logs are as below:-Solution XYZ missing in implementation project-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that the concerned tenant had the Solution Profile copied from another tenant that had the add-on XYZ deployed onto.-Quick Tip: The add-on composition of the source system and the target system can be compared through the Service Control Center work center's Systems view. If there is a mismatch in the value for field Partner Solution for the two tenants, then you may confirm that this is the cause.-In this case the LAYER_CUST may still have references to the BC_GEN part of the solution, even though the add-on solution is not present.-Resolution-We can take two approaches to resolve this issue.-Advise the customer to contact the partner and have the mentioned add-on XYZ installed onto the system.-In case the customer mentions that they do not require the add-on in the current system, then obtain written approval from the customer to remove the references and transfer incident to AP-RC-BDS-1O to remove all references to the mentioned add-on solution.-Incident 3100805206 can be used for reference.-See Also-1721418 - You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does Not Match Your User Settings-1826066 - Error Message "You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does Not Match Your User Settings", While Accessing Scoping or Fine Tuning-Keywords-You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile, Error, Edit Project Scope, Open Activity, Solution Profile

Title: Sales Quotes not linked to Opportunities in the Sales Pipeline Report
Content: Symptom-When accessing the Sales Pipeline report in the system and filtering for the Sales Quotes IDs linked to Opportunities, you notice that none of the Sales Quotes displayed in the report are linked to an Opportunity, even though the Sales Quotes were created as a follow up from an Opportunity.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Filter for All.-In the search field, search for the Sales Pipeline.-Open the Sales Pipeline Report.-Select the View Icon.-In the Row fields, add the Sales Quote column.-In the Row fields, add the Opportunity column.-Click in the Selection icon and filter for the Sales Quote ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Quote ID).-Select Apply button.-The Sales Quote column will display the ID ABC, however the Opportunity column will display the symbol # (Not assigned). -Cause-In the Sales Pipeline report, the Sales Quotes are not displayed linked to the Opportunity documents because in the Data Source (CRMOPQU) used in this report, the Opportunity IDs are linked to Sales Quotes backend IDs instead of the Sales Quote IDs maintained in the system. -Therefore, in this report no Sales Quote ID will be displayed linked to an Opportunity document and no Opportunity will be displayed linked to a Sales Quote.-This behavior occurs for all the records displayed in the Sales Pipeline report.-Resolution-This is currently the standard design for the Sales Pipeline report.-Keywords-sales pipeline, report, sales quote, opportunity, linked, not assigned, #

Title: How to take a HttpWatch trace in IE and Chrome
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Occasionally SAP Support requests a HTTP trace for further analysis of reported problems. This document describes the necessary steps to create such a HTTP trace. HttpWatch integrates with Internet Explorer and Google Chrome browsers to show you exactly what HTTP traffic is triggered when you access a web page. If you access a site that uses secure HTTPS connections, HttpWatch automatically displays the decrypted form of the network traffic.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Download the free version of 'HttpWatch Basic Edition' and install it on your system.-1. Logon to the system with Google Chrome 50+, Microsoft Edge 80+ or Internet Explorer 8 - 11-After logining into the system, press right click. You can see the option - HttpWatch Basic-The HttpWatch plug-in can be displayed in the lower part of the browser window.-  Open the ByDesign/C4C system's workcenter/view where you are facing the issue and then press 'Record' on the HTTPWatch screen and follow your steps to reproduce the issue. -Press 'Stop' once the issue is reproduced completely.-Click on 'Save' to save the trace file. The extension of the file is hwl.-Convert the .hwl file to .zip and Attach the file to the case and send it back to SAP Support.- 2. Logon to the system in Chrome.-Click on the HTTP Watch Icon.  -      After launching it, the HttpWatch plug-in will be displayed in a new window.-     Open the ByDesign/C4C system's workcenter/view where you are facing the issue and then press 'Record' on the HTTPWatch screen and follow your steps to reproduce the issue. -Press 'Stop' once the issue is reproduced completely.-Click on 'Save' to save the trace file. The extension of the file is hwl.-Convert the .hwl file to .zip and Attach the file to the case and send it back to SAP Support.-Keywords-http trace, performance, time out, edge chrome

Title: Customer Return Displaying the Overall Status as "In Progress" After Credit Memo Document is Released
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Customer has reported that a Customer Return document is with status as "In Progress", however it should be with status as "Completed" as the Credit Memo has been already released for the Return document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Returns View.-In the search field, Search for the Return ABC (where ABC represents the Customer Return ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-The overall status of the Return is displayed as "In Progress", however it should be with status as "Completed" as the Credit Memo has been already released for the Return document.-Cause-According to our development team this issue occurs due to a delay in the synchronization between of the overall status of the Credit Memo and Inbound Delivery, the status of the Credit Memo is updated before the status of the Inbound Delivery in the backend which cause the Customer Return to revert the status to "In Progress".-Resolution-In this case a backend correction from the development side will be required to correct the overall status of the Customer Return document to "Completed".-Kindly forward the case to the development side for a backend correction.-Keywords-customer return, credit memo, in progress, completed, status

Title: Reason for Rejection field is Grayed Out in a Sales Order Linked to a Project
Content: Symptom-You notice that after maintaining a Reason for Rejection in a Sales Order linked to a Project document that was Released, it is no longer possible to revert the changes from the UI as the Reason for Rejection field becomes grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-In the search field, search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the General tab.-In the Reason for Rejection field, select any of the available values.-Select Save button.-The Reason for Rejection field becomes grayed out in the Sales Order document.-Cause-Once a Sales Order linked to a released Project is rejected via Reason for Rejection in the General tab, no further changes can be performed as this is a permanent action for the document.-The Reason for Rejection field becomes grayed out and cannot be reversed in the UI.-Note: According to our development team this action cannot be reversed in the backend as well.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-In case the Reason for Rejection was incorrectly maintained for the Sales Order document, it will be required to recreate the Sales Process for the Sales Order and Project document manually in the system as the actions performed cannot be reversed.-Keywords-project, reject, reason for rejection, sales order, field, grayed out

Title: Countries/Regions Are Not Available in the Business Configuration Scoping
Content: Symptom-You are trying to scope a country/region, but cannot find this option in the Business Configuration scoping.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-In the scoping step Country/Region and Type of Business, click Edit Countries/Regions.-Here you are not able to see the country/region required.-Cause-The desired country is a non-localized countries/region. Such country/region will not be available in the business configuration by default.-You can check more information on the Business ByDesign Localization capabilities in the following Help Document page:-Localization-Resolution-The localization for a specific non-localized country/region can be implemented through a custom solution. It is possible to engage with a certified SAP partner to implement the localization and the associated objects (for example, dedicated Sets of Books) by employing the Localization Toolkit.-Since some constraints exist for this toolkit, it is advised to discuss your specific requirements in detail with your SAP partner.-See Also-SAP Community blog post SAP ByD: Localization Toolkit and Language Adaptation Tool services. Set new subsidiaries anywhere in the world.-Keywords-Localization Toolkit, Non-Localized Countries, Non-Localized Country/Region, Business Configuration

Title: Customer Invoice Split Rule not Working for Customer Project Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a Customer Invoice Split Rule and you have noticed that when you are creating invoices from a Customer Project Invoice Request, the system is not splitting the document as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the Customer Project Invoice Request ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Click Invoice.-The split does not happen as expected.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Currently, the fine tuning activity Customer Invoice Split Rule does not apply for Customer Project Invoice Requests and its line items. -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Portal to submit an idea. -Improvement requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis, with the results being communicated in a corresponding review blog post.-See Also-1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-2564411 - Invoice Split of Credit Memo and Invoice Items-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Customer Project Invoice Request, Project, Invoice Request, Split, Split Rule

Title: The Seller's Tax Number, Tax Number Type and Tax Country are a Split Criteria for your Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-The Seller's tax number, tax number type and tax country are a split criteria for your customer invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite : You have released your Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the identification of your sales order). Two outbound deliveries were created as invoice request.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Select Invoice A_XYZ (A_XYZ represents the identification of the first invoice request for sales order ABC) and Invoice B_XYZ (B_XYZ represents the identification of the second invoice request for sales order ABC).-Select Invoice.-The system is creating two invoices instead of one.-Cause-The Seller's tax number, tax number type and tax country are a split criteria for your customer invoice-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Request view.-Select Invoice A_XYZ.-Select Invoice.-Go to View All-You can see the information for the Tax Number, Tax Type and Tax Country.-Execute the same steps for invoice B_XYZ.-You can see that for at least one field the Tax Number, Tax Type or Tax Country is different than for A_XYZ.-In order to have only one invoice for invoice request A_XYZ and B_XYZ, you would need to update the Seller's tax information in the master data for the Sales Order ABC.-You want to create one and only one invoice with the following data :-Tax Country : CTY_XYZ-Tax Number Type : Typ_XYZ-Tax Number : TNum_XYZ-You would need to follow the steps below:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Edit the tax authorities for country CTY_XYZ (in case there is no tax authorities maintain for this tax country, you would need to create a new one).-Go to the Tax Company Arrangement tab.-Maintain the Tax Number Type as Typ_XYZ.-Maintain the Tax Number as TNum_XYZ.-Save and Activate the Change.-Go back to the Sales Order ABC.-Go to View All.-Go to the Pricing tab.-In the Total Pricing section, select update pricing > Keep manual change (this will trigger the manual tax recalculation).-Save the sales order to update the invoice request.-You should now be able to create one invoice for this sales order.--See Also-1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Split, Company Arrangement, Invoice Request, Sales, Document

Title: Difference in Recorded Hours between Timesheet and Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When creating the supplier invoice, it is picking up only few hours. However, in the project you can see the actual worked hours more than shown in the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Choose Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Choose the Advance link and enter the reference purchase order.-Open the Invoice.-Click Edit and you can see the few hours are shown for invoicing. -Cause-The reason why we only see few hours are allowed to invoice because the relevant Goods and Services Receipt still in preparation and not posted. Once you post Goods and Services Receipts you will be able to invoice same as the available hours in the project.-In case of procuring the service externally we create the purchase order with reference to the project to the supplier. The service agent will be able to record time against the project using purchase order as reference document. In this case the system generated and posted Goods and Services Receipt automatically as soon as the time recordings is set to release. However, in few situations the Goods and Services Receipt will not be posted to accounting side for number of reasons so we could see the difference in the recorded hours at project side and invoicing as it will be able to find the reference Goods and Services Receipt.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to post the Goods and Services Receipts:-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Choose Receipts and Returns view.-Choose the Advance link and enter the reference purchase order or service agent.-You can see the Goods and Services Receipts status is In Preparation.-Click Edit and you can see the Post button is greyed out.-Click Check, you can see a message: Check complete; goods and services receipt contains no errors.-Click the Post button.

Title: FAQ’s on UI Designer Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-FAQ’s on UI Designer Issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Buisness ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the Solution.-Open UI Designer screen if solution is in In Development status.-Design the screen as per your requirement.-Resolution-Que 1 : Dump error when opening UI Designer-Ans 1 : There could be multiple reasons for dump, following are few among them :-UI inconsistency due to multiple changes from different users, we have observed multiple times different users try to make changes for the same screen /field /button. That will create duplicate change transactions (CT ) and result in inconsistencies.-Perform save and activate once the changes are done from your end.-Perform Metadata update to avoid inconsistency.- Que 2 : Button comes up as disabled on screen-Ans 2 : Make sure enable property is true in UI Designer .- Que 3: Unable to use extensibility framework on a SAP delivered Button/Button group/Section group/ List / Tabs-Ans 3 : Below could be the reason :->>Anchor is not provided by SAP application team for partners to enhance UI element like - Button/Button group/Section group/ List / Tabs .->>You can create an incident with valid business use case to provide the anchor on UI element like - Button/Button group/Section group/ List / Tabs .- Que 4 : Issues related to change in Mandatory / Read only property using  Adjust Property in  Extensibility explorer-Ans 4 : PDI: Adjust Property in Extensibility Explorer :-"OR" operation is followed by mandatory and read-only property.-Example: If one CT with READ-ONLY property is "TRUE" then the field will always remain READ-ONLY as true irrespective of any other CT on that field.- You need to delete extra CT created under Adjust Property modeler. Follow the steps:-Get the control id of the field/button/ UI entity (for which Mandatory/Read-Only property is having issue) from UI designer -> Properties.-Open the extensibility explorer. Select the anchor for which changes are applied using Adjust property modeler.-Get the extra CT created under Adjust property by checking the xml of CT for that particular control id for Mandatory/Read-Only property.-Delete the CT which is making the Mandatory/Read-Only property as fallback value = true.- Que 5 : Issues related to change in Visible / Enable property using  Adjust Property in  Extensibility explorer-Ans 5 : "AND" operation is followed by Visible and Enable property.-Example: If one CT with Visible property is "FALSE" then the field's VISIBILITY will always remain FALSE irrespective of any number of CT on that field.-You need to delete extra CT created under Adjust Property modeler. Follow the steps:-Get the control id of the field/button/ UI entity (for which visible/enable property is having issue) from UI designer -> Properties.-Open the extensibility explorer. Select the anchor for which changes are applied using Adjust property modeler.-Get the extra CT created under Adjust property by checking the xml of CT for that particular control id for  visible/enable property .-Delete the CT which is making the visible/enable property as fallback value = false.- Que 6 : Error while solution deployment-Ans 6 : If such error occurs and there are red dots on any component under that particular solution in Cloud Studio then it means Solution has inactive contents.-Activate all those components (with red dots on it) separately and then finally activate the solution.- Que 7 : RBAM authorization error for partner created UI. (Not on partner extended UIs)-And 7 : There could be multiple reasons for RBAM authorization, following are few among them :-First of all, update your Cloud Studio to latest version .-Open Studio -> Help -> Check for updates.-[Update option in Cloud Studio does not always work so it’s better to uninstall studio and then reinstall it again from SMP]-Now follow the steps:-Find the UI component where such RBAM issue is occurring. -Open the solution in studio.-Find the Partner BO on top of which this UI component was built.-Check for the UI components with extension .TT or .uiwocview  built on top of that BO. Open those UI components in UI designer.-Check under properties for ShortID of that UI component.-Complete ShortID text should be in upper case as per RBAM policy guidance.-If the ShortID has any character in lower case then you need to delete that UI component and recreate using Create screen wizard on top of the BO. This time it will create the UI component with ShortID completely in upper case.-If the original UI created was using the option - "Select Screen" to create screens individually then you should create the new screen using same way.-But, If the original UI created was using options other than "Select Screen" to create a set of screens with navigation then you should create the new screen using same way using that same navigation option but before that you need to delete all other UI components built along with that affected UI component on top of that Partner BO because this option creates all set of UI along with referencing each other components used for navigation.[ All those UI components having same short ID as the affected UI component needs to be deleted ]- Que 8 : Unable to delete Partner created UI in Cloud Studio due to reference from other UI components/PDI Anchor-Ans 8 : When a screen is created by selecting navigation scenario in Cloud Studio, a set of UI components are created based on the selected navigation. All the UI components are referenced by one another. For deleting such UI components, you need to delete them from top to bottom level reference approach. This is because all the child level UI components will have a reference in it's parent UI component.-For example: OWL will have a reference in WCVIEW which in turn will be referred by Work Center (WCF). Try deleting in this order:-WCF, WCVIEW, OWL, QC, QV, TI, TT-In case, WCF is referred by any PDI anchor then first this PDI anchor or the reference needs to be removed then follow above steps.- Que 9 : Issues where you need to generate load of UI component-Ans 9 : Example scenario: Custom UI using Cloud Application Studio which is built on custom BO. At a later point of time, you edited the custom BO by changing labels and tooltips and then activated it. This change got reflected in UI Designer but it didn't came on frontend UI. The reason for this issue is UI Load.-Load Invalidation ->This feature was introduced in UI designer for manually triggering Load invalidation by you in sdk. It's a button in UI designer.-UI load can only be generated in XREP and you don't have access to backend. So this feature is introduced for manual invalidation of Load as only option which can be used by Partners to Invalidate the load. Now, By simply clicking on Load Invalidation Button or using it from Tools Menu, Partner can Invalidate load on XREP at any point of time. If any issue like this comes, it can be resolved by Load Invalidation- Que 10 : New Button to open QC is not visible-Ans 10 : This could be issue with authorization, role of the user or ThingType name in case components are created via PDI-Partner/Users can check following points:-ThingType, Quick Create, Thing Inspector, Quick View should be part of AssignedObjects of WorkCenter View and user should have authorization for this WoC View.-User should have valid role for editing /creating new data via QC-If these components are created via PDI, please make a point that Short ID of Thing Type is case sensitive and it should be in upper case and same at all places, for eg: in Inport of QC.Please check in all components and confirm the case also of ThingType.- Que 11 : Feature not available in other devices like Mobile / Tablet .-Ans : Perform tagging for the particular device from extensibility explore UI designer for the UI to be available in required device.- Que 12 : Add Extension Field to Section Group not available in Extensibility explorer.-Ans 12 : Please check the anchor modelling for particular field group ,  Add Extension Field to Section Group will only be available for Extension Anchor.-Example scenario you can find in below Blog:-‘Add Extension Field to Section Group ‘ missing in the Extensibility Explorer of UI Designer SDK- Que 13 : Query missing in the frontend.-Ans 13 : You should defined an anchor for the query defined in the UI Designer .-Example scenario you can find in below Blog:-Option missing to personalized query in the frontend- Que 14 : How to define basic search option using SADL query.-Ans 14: Please refer to the KBA 2338075 - How to define Basic search option using SADL query-See Also-KBA 2424050 - How To Open the UI Designer in HTML5-KBA 2936686 - Error: "Application cannot be started. Contact the application vendor." while trying to launch the UI Designer-KBA 2338075 - How to define Basic search option using SADL query-Blog: Option missing to personalized query in the frontend-https://blogs.sap.com/2016/05/25/option-missing-to-personalized-query-in-the-frontend/-Blog: ‘Add Extension Field to Section Group ‘ missing in the Extensibility Explorer of UI Designer SDK-https://blogs.sap.com/2016/05/25/add-extension-field-to-section-group-missing-in-the-extensibility-explorer-of-ui-designer-sdk/-Keywords

Title: System Dump When Cancelling Uploading Of Attachment
Content: Symptom-The System dumps when you cancel uploading an attachment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Help-Click, for example, Solve a Problem or Report an Incident-Go to the Attachments and upload an attachment with a size of around 4 MB-During the upload, hit cancel-Result: a dump occurs.-Cause-You are uploading a document into the system backend and canceling the upload process will cause a dump.-Resolution-Finish the upload and cancel after the upload is completed.-Keywords-Attachments, upload attachments , dump attachments.

Title: Error When Posting Goods Receipt for Notification
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Post Goods Receipt for the Stock Transfer Notification XXX, however an error is faced even if the Outbound Delivery is Released.-XXX = Outbound Delivery ID and Inbound Delivery Notification ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Inbound Delivery Notifications view. -Find Notification XXX. -Click Post Goods Receipt. -The errors are faced:-Action can not be performed, Related Outbound Delivery is not released-Creation of inbound delivery failed-Cause-The errors can be a sync issue between the documents, as the Outbound Delivery XXX is released.-Resolution-As a workaround, you can follow the steps:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Select Inbound Delivery Notifications view. -Find Notification XXX. -Set the Notification XXX as Advised. -Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Select Outbound Deliveries view. -Find Outbound Delivery XXX. -Undo Release the Outbound Delivery XXX. -Release the Outbound Delivery XXX again. -Now you can try to Post Goods Receipt for Notification XXX and no error should be faced. -Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, Post Goods Receipt, Outbound Delivery, PGR, IDN, OD, Release

Title: Error "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 1 characters, for example, No."
Content: Symptom-Error is encountered when searching production model in advanced filter with Bill of Operation ID BOO1  (BOO1 represents the Bill of Operation ID) as filter.-"Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than 1 characters, for example, No."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Models view.-2. Open advanced filter, enter BOO1 in filter BoO ID, click Go.-You will encounter the above error.-Cause-This is a known issue that we plan to fix in the future.-Resolution-Please take below workaround:-1. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Models view.-2. Open advanced filter, click on the value help button of filter BoO ID.-3. In the pop-up window, enter BoO ID and click Search.-4. Select the BoO ID and click on Go-You will find the expected result.-  Keywords-Planning and Production Master Data, Production Models, BoO ID, character, Bill of Operation ID

Title: Error Message "You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does Not Match Your User Settings", While Accessing Scoping or Fine Tuning
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--You attempt to access the Edit Project Scope or Open Activity list from the Implementation Projects ﻿view, but an error occurs.-Error message: You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings.-You might notice that the status of LAYER_CUST in the transaction APXREP_BROWSER is inactive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects View.-Select First Implementation project.-Select Edit Project Scope or Open Activity List.-Error: You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings.-Cause-This issue can have two possible causes:-The user who tries to access the scoping does not have LAYER_CUST assigned or the user could be assigned to the wrong layer strategy in table APXR_SETTINGS.-The deployment of one-off solution ended with errors which caused layer LAYER_CUST to become inactive and therefore, there is a mismatch in the solution profile of the user and the main workspace.-Resolution-First, you need to check that the user is assigned to LAYER_CUST and is also assigned to the correct layer strategy as follows:-Login to backend.-Search for T-code SE38.-Execute the report RP_BCT_WS_SOLUTION_MISMATCH.-Enter the Workspace ID and User name.-Execute.-if the user is assigned to the layer strategy and it is also the correct one, then you should make sure that the layer strategy is active. If it is not active, then you can activate it as follows:-Log in to the backend using the support user.-Enter t-code APXREP_BROWSER.-Go to menu path Environment -> Layer St. Maint.-Enter LAYER_CUST for the input field Layer Strategy Name.-Select Display. You will find that the layer strategy is Inactive.-Select Activate.-Once the activation is complete, you can access the activity list of the project.-Here, you can find the further details about the layer strategy assigned to that user.-If the report displays that the user is assigned to PDI dev layer strategy, which means, this user cannot access the Business Configuration work center because access Business Configuration work center works only with a user with default layer strategy LAYER_CUST.-As described in chapter 'User Setup Quick Guide' of the studio documentation, you have to use separate users for working with the studio and for performing business user tests. In fact a business user should not have the partner development work center assigned and hence a logon to the studio would not be possible at all. Once you open a solution in the studio with a user, the visibility of objects in ByDesign is limited.-Note 1: Business users must not be utilized for working in the studio. When working in the studio the layer strategy of the user is switched to the layer strategy of the solution.-Note 2: Development do not set back the layer strategy of development users as long as they have the work center partner development assigned as this could lead to numerous inconsistencies.-So, To overcome the issue please follow any of the below option to fix this issue:-Either access the Business Configuration work center only with a regular business user or,-Assign the default layer strategy LAYER_CUST to the user when accessing the Business Configuration work center with this user. Unfortunately there is no way to reset the layer strategy of a development user. Please instruct the partner to create another business user for the development user for performing scoping / fine-tuning and testing. This process is described in the User setup quick guide in the Online Help of SAP Solutions OnDemand Studio.-Support/Development do not set back the layer strategy of development users as long as they have the workcenter partner development assigned as this could lead to numerous inconsistencies. Please instruct the partner to create another business user for the development user for performing scoping / fine-tuning and testing. This process is described in the User setup quick guide in the Online Help of SAP Solutions OnDemand Studio.-See Also-If this is not the cause for the issue, you can refer the document:-1721418 - You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does Not Match Your User Settings-2002244 - Error: You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile. The Solution Profile Does not Match Your User Settings.-Keywords-You are not Authorized to Access the Solution Profile, Error, Edit Project Scope, Open Activity
