Title: In Preparation Sales Order Missing in the Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the Sales Order Volume report and when filtering for the In Preparation Sales Orders, you see that not all Sales Orders which are found under the Sales Orders view are displaying in the report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select List under Reports view.-Open the Sales Order Volume report.-Filter for the In Preparation status.-Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the missing Sales Order).-Not all Sales Orders which shows on the OWL (Object Work List) are showing at the report.-Cause-For the In Preparation Sales Order to show in the report, the Sales Order needs to have an item maintained under the Items tab.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Order view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add an Item.-Click the Save button.-Now you can refresh the report and the Sales Order ABC shows.-See Also-3422792 In Preparation Contracts are not Showing in the Customer Contract Volume report-Keywords-Sales Order, Sales Order Volume, Missing Documents, In Preparation, Report, Not Showing

Title: The Tax Calculated for a Service Product is Incorrect if the Ship-to Party is the Contact of Account (EU Tax Scenario)
Content: Symptom-The tax calculated is incorrect for a service product if the Ship-to party is the Contact of Account.-Note: This case document deals with the EU specific tax scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from Common Task.-Add the account ABC in the sales order (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Add ship-to party XYZ (XYZ is the contact maintained under account ABC).-Go to the Items tab of the sales order and add a service DEF (DEF represents the ID of the service).-Select the Taxes subtab.-The tax calculated is for the Ship-to country.-If you change the ship-to party from the contact XYZ to account ABC then the tax determined for the ship-to country.-However, since both contact and account belong to same country, you expect same tax determination while keeping any of them as ship-to.-Cause-The tax determination logic in the system differs if a ship-to party is not a company:-If you select contact XYZ as ship-to, then the condition Is Service Recipient is company? becomes False -> hence the tax is determined as Domestic Supply.-If you select account ABC as ship-to, then the condition Is Service Recipient is company? becomes True -> hence the tax is determined as EU sale of services, reverse charge which determines ship-to country as tax country.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Tax Code; Service Recipient; Ship-To; Person; Company; Employee; 504; 540; EU Sale of Services; RevCharge; Domestic Sale of Services; VAT Exempt Art 7

Title: Unable to close the change project after successful merge
Content: Symptom-You want to close the change project after a successful merge changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Administration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-You will see that change project remains with status as "Merged" instead of closed.-Resolution-After the merged changes, you have to close the activity Close Project.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects.-Select the project with status as "Merged" and open activity list.-In the Go Live tab you will see that the activity "Close Project" remains opened.-Close the activity to get the project status as closed.-Keywords-Merge changes, Change Project, Close Change Project, Merged Status

Title: How To Check If The User Has The layer Strategy
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to check if the user has the layer strategy.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Open the incident in CAM Tool and request user.-Click STFk.----Click red icon of R/3 Support and change it to green-Click Request Opening-> Open-Click Logon-> No Password-Input tenant, user and password, then press Enter-On the top, input Transaction "SE16" and press Enter.-Open table  “APXR_SETTINGS”.----Enter the User Name and Execute (F8).----If your user does not show up, it has LAYER_CUST. Partner development users will have an entry though and their layer strategy (field LAYERST) usually says something like “BY<digits>_DEV”.----Keywords-APXR_SETTINGS; LAYER_CUST.; LAYERST; layer strategy

Title: Error reported by application Agent CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI has triggered a fatal error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You find serveral 3PL Outbound Delivery Execution Confirmation messages are failing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Business Communication Monitoring View.-Select Search criteria Business Messages with Errors.-You will find some content errors with the following messages，its direction is incoming and operation is Process Outbound Delivery Execution Confirmation.-"Error reported by application: Agent CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI has triggered a fatal error."-Cause-We do not support Update calls from SOAP for the Delivery. Only Create is supported.-Failing as update message not allowed as stated in;-CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI-GET_INCOMING_BO-Line 88-update message is not supported => raise an error message-Resolution-No further action can be performed since system works as expected.-Keywords-CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI; Outbound Delivery Execution Confirmation.

Title: Error Message: A technical error (Mandatory initialization missing) occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 502. Report an incident
Content: Symptom-When running a query in PRC_SALES_PRICE_LIST BO, the error message appears: "A technical error (Mandatory initialization missing) occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 502. Report an incident."-This error might happen when ever customer/partner is trying to do customizations via PDI (Add-On).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The initialization of the BO has not been done.-Resolution-When using the Sales Price List BO for querying the BO, you will need to initialize the BO first.-See Also-Blog - How to query?-Or Attached work document How to query BO PRC_SALES_PRICE_LIST.docx-Keywords-Query Sales Price List BO, Initialize, Technical Error

Title: ATP Status Shows as Red Although Stock is Available in Stock Overview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Although stock is available in Stock Overview, ATP shows as Red while checking availability for a item of customer demand.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control Work Center.-Go to Customer Demand View.-Search for the customer demand XXX and select it.-Choose Actions- Check Availability button, you will note the ATP status shows as Red.-Cause-The on-hand stock in stock overview had been already allocated to other demands.-Resolution-You can run report AP_SCM_ATP_TOOL_BOUND in T-code SE38 for the product and SPA combination to understand the orders against which the stock (supply) is allocated in ATP.-Unfortunately, this information isn’t exposed to the customers as they don’t have access to the backend.-Keywords-ATP; Check Availability.

Title: Unable to Replicate Employees due to Error "Bank ID missing"
Content: Symptom-You are unable to replicate employees from EC to BYD due to error "Bank ID missing", even if the bank details are already maintained in SF EC. You would like to know how to populate Bank Details (Bank ID) during replication.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for employee and select failed replication request.-Then you can find error.-Cause-No SWIFT/BIC and only National Bank Code is currently maintained for the required Bank. Therefore the Replication must include matching information.-Resolution-If you want the system to populate the Bank during replication, then you should pass the National Bank Code. Please follow the below steps:-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for employee and select Edit (failed replication).-Remove SWIFT/BIC.-Enter the National Bank Code and click Enter in keyboard.-Now the Bank ID will be fetched correctly.-Keywords-Employee Central; Employee Replication; Bank ID; National Bank Code

Title: Dump Occurs When you try to Cancel the Customer Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-Dump occurs when you try to cancel the Customer Invoice Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice request).-Select the invoice request XYZ and select the Cancel button.-Approximately after 10 minutes, dump occurs (Time_Out dump).-Dump Details from ST22 transaction in backend:-Short Text: Time limit exceeded.-Runtime Error: TIME_OUT-Terminated Program: CL_APCI_WRAPPER_SAM===========CP-Class: CL_APCI_WRAPPER_SAM=>IF_SAM_RUNTIME_BUFFER~RETRIEVE-Method: CL_APCI_WRAPPER_SAM===========CP- Cause-The problem is due to huge (more than 100) line items in the invoice requests which is resulting in time out dump.-Resolution-It is recommended to keep less than 100 line items in the invoice requests to avoid the time out dump.-Please instruct the customer to cancel the document and split the document so that it created smaller invoice requests.-Keywords-Dump, Customer Invoice, Invoice Request, Error, Quantity, Backend, Cancel

Title: "Select Key Figures" step skipped while creating or editing a report
Content: Symptom-You are unable to add Key Figures in a report and Step 2 in Report Wizard "Select Key Figures" is skipped.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics.-Go to Design Report.-Create or edit any Custom report.-Click on Next to got to Step 2 "Select Key Figures"-Notice that Step-2 is skipped-Cause-You have enabled "Only for Master Data" under Properties in the Step 1-Resolution-Do not enable, if there is need to add custom key figures in the report.-Keywords-Key figures, Edit Report step-2, Master Data, Select Key Figures, skipped-editing report, adding keyfigures

Title: Tax Event Missing in Account Determination for Tax Events Activity
Content: Symptom-The Tax Event is not available under Activity Account Determination for Tax Events.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on open activity list.-Open the activity Account Determination for Tax Events.-Not all Tax Events applicable to Country XYZ are displayed. (XYZ represents the country name).-Cause-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and click on open activity list.-Open the Tax on Goods and Services activity.-Select the country and see the tax rate type assigned for this tax code and event combination.-If the Tax Rate Type is left blank then such a Tax Event will not be shown in the activity Account Determination for Tax Events.-Resolution-Wherever the Tax Rate Type is zero or left blank then that particular Tax Event is not required in the Account Determination for Tax Events.-When this Tax Rate Type is assigned to a Tax Event and Tax Code, the tax amount is calculated as zero during transactional postings. As a result, no tax amount is carried forward or reflected in the accounting journals.-So this setting is not needed in the activity.-Keywords-Tax Event Missing, Account Determination for Tax Events, Activity, Tax code, Tax amount, Country

Title: Error "No Delivery to XXX, as recipient unknown"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-An error occurred while trying to deliver an e-mail.-"No Delivery to XXX, as recipient unknown" (where XXX represents the e-mail address).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-E-mail ID is on the suppression list for user account.-An e-mail address may be added to the suppression list if the recipient has marked a previous e-mail from the sender as spam or if the e-mail address is identified as invalid. When an e-mail address is added to the suppression list, no further emails will be sent to that address from the SAP system. This helps to protect the sender's reputation as a legitimate e-mail sender and also prevents further emails from being marked as spam.-It is important to note that adding an e-mail address to the suppression list is a system-wide action and not specific to any one tenant or user. This means that once an e-mail address is added to the suppression list, it will not receive any further emails from any tenant or user on the SAP system. Additionally, the suppression list is regularly updated to remove invalid e-mail addresses or addresses that have been cleared from being marked as spam by the recipient.-Resolution-Log in to Backend.-Execute T-Code "SCOT".-Check "Inbound Send Requests ".-Enter e-mail sent date under "Data received " tab.-Click Update.-Select e-mail which was failed to deliver.-Click Display Document or double-click to Open.-Open "Delivery Status Notification".-Log displays the message: "Diagnostic-Code: Amazon SES did not send the message to this address because it is on the suppression list for your account. For more information about removing addresses from the suppression list, see the Amazon SES Developer Guide at Using the Amazon SES account-level suppression list.-Open an incident with the operations team to remove e-mail ID from Suppression list.-Keywords-Suppression list, e-mail not delivered, recipient unknown

Title: Unit of Measure and Currency Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reported a Process Communication Error from the Customer Return to the Customer Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Return).-Click the Edit button.-Click View All button.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Error is between the Customer Return to the Customer Invoice document.-Go to the Backend.-Open transaction SESFTS.-Search for BO (Business Object) CUSTOMER_RETURN.-Click the Down arrow for Load BO for Node Instances (folder icon).-Select Load by Alternative Key.-Select Root - ID.-Enter the ID ABC.-Click on Execute.-Right click on the ID ABC.-Hover over Message Monitoring.-Select Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow (XX msgs).-You see the following:-Sender Party: CustomerInvoiceProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: CustomerReturnProcessingRequestInvoicingIn-Error Information: Unit of measure and currency missing-Go to back to BO Node: CustomerReturn - Root.-Navigate to the Pricing_Terms.-Currency_Code: XYZ (XYZ represents the Currency Code).-Navigate back To - Root.-Navigate to Item.-Navigate to Item_Pricing_Terms.-Currency_Code: Empty.-Cause-The inconsistency occurs as the Item_Pricing_Terms node on the Customer Return Item does not have currency information.-Resolution-This is a known inconsistency by the development team.-Steps to correct:-Request customer's permission to perform a manual correction.- Go to the Backend.-Open transaction SESFTS.-Search for BO (Business Object) CUSTOMER_RETURN.-Click the Down arrow for Load BO for Node Instances (folder icon).-Select Load by Alternative Key.-Select Root - ID.-Enter the ID ABC.-Click on Execute.-Select the ID ABC.-Navigate to the Pricing_Terms.-Click F6 (This will give write access).-Remove the Currency_Code: XYZ.-Click Save.-Enter the Currency_Code: XYZ.-Click F6 again.-Click Save.-Navigate to Item.-Navigate to Item_Pricing_Terms.-The currency XYZ is now reflecting under the item Currency_Code.-After that, the XI failed message can be restarted.-Keywords-Unit, Measure, Currency Missing, Return, Error, Process Communication Error, Customer Invoice, Issue, Unité de Quantité et Devise Manquantes

Title: Cost Estimate in Sales Orders For Project Based Service Items
Content: Symptom-The Cost Estimate for project based service items such as PBTM - Service - time and material (project) and PBFP - Service - fixed price (project) is displayed as 0,00 in sales orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Got to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Go to the Items tab.-Select line item XX (XX represents the number of the line item).-You can see that the Item Type of the service is either Service - time and material (project) or Service - fixed price (project)-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and select the Pricing sub tab.-Expand the item XX and select the line Cost.-The cost is displayed as 0,00.-You expect a cost estimate for this Service to be displayed. This cost estimate should be pulled from the valuation tab in the service master data.-Cause-The Cost Estimate for Project based Services such as PBTM - Service - time and material (project) and PBFP - Service - fixed price (project) is never determined in the sales order and therefore always 0,00. This is the correct and expected system behaviour.-Resolution-You can edit this Price Component manually in the Pricing view for profit analysis reasons for project based services and entitlements.-Keywords-Cost Estimate, Project, Sals Order, Service, PBTM, PBFP, Time and Material, Fixed price (Project), Zero, 0.

Title: How Does Reporting Works in Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This KBA provides an overview for the Reports scenario within SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Reports-SAP Business ByDesign delivers predefined content for reports that are defined in your scope. Reports can also be defined by administrators for business users. The Reports view is a central access point to reports associated with a work center.-Reports can be access from most work centers.-Using Sales Orders work center for example.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select List subview under the Reports view.-List view will display the available reports for the Sales Order work center. For example, Sales Order Volume report.-Open the report, you are in the report Selection section. You may set selection as per the request here, click Apply button to run the report. The result then shows in the content area in the middle.-Click Additional Filters icon to add more available fields into selection. Click Apply again to refresh the report. Click Save icon to save the selection. It will be saved in the Selection list for quick access.-In the View section, you are able to select which fields or Key Figures to be shown in the report.  Click More icon besides the row field to find more settings on characteristic level. Click + incon to add more fields or key figures. Drag the fields or key figures to adjust the display order. You can save the view by clicking Save icon. Or swith to a difference view by selection a view from the view list on the report top.-If you have advanced settings in the report, you can try the Configure option on the right top. -You are able to send the report via E-Mail or download it in CSV or XML format for further usage.-Types of Objects in Analytics-Data Source-Data sources are associated with a specified access context or can be unrestricted.-Key Figure-A field according to which values are selected. Key figures are data items with numeric values and have an associated unit of measure or currency assigned. Some examples are pipeline value, Invoice Net Value, Purchase Order Quantity or tickets in queue.-Characteristic-A field according to which values are selected. Characteristics are alphanumeric, numeric, or text values. Examples include Product ID, Supplier, and Purchase Order Status. Variables are often associated with specified characteristics. Variables restrict characteristics to one or more specified value selections.-Report-A compilation of data for analysis. Reports show values derived from key figures and characteristics in data sources, key figure structures, and key figure grids.-See Also-Reports View-Overview of Analytics-Working with Reports Using the Report Wizard-2659611 Sales Order Employee Responsible Reported as Not Assigned-2724953 In Preparation Sales Order Missing in the Report-1823336 Payment Term field is Unavailable in the Sales Order Volume Report-1817278 The Invoice Date is Different on the Sales Volume Report and on the Sales Order.-2657293 Sales Order Volume Report Shows Incorrect Values For Project Sales Orders-1945179 How System Defines the Posting Date on Sales Order and Sales Order Volume Report-2803034 You Can't Find Key Figure "Quantity" and "Net Value" when Download Data Source in CSV format for Report "Sales Order Analysis".-2727105 Customer Contract Volume Report Shows no Value for Fulfilled Quantity-1757249 Sales Volume Report Show Incorrect Data-2373775 Wrong Net Value in the Data Source Sales Order Item-2861116 The Product ID is displayed in the reports and data sources of sales documents is not the expected one.-2711194 Cannot Find Any Report Showing Surcharge Applied in the Customer Invoices-2801597 Net Value Different Between the Reports Invoice Volume and Sales Targets for Incoming and Invoiced Orders (Manager)-2006845 Item Pricing Information Not Available In Reports-1982397 Contract not shown on the Customer Contract Volume report-2766602 Report Customer Contract Statistics Does Not Show All Contracts-2727105 Customer Contract Volume Report Shows no Value for Fulfilled Quantity-2040886 Report Customer Contract Volume Shows the Invoiced Quantities and Values as Zero-2066338 Sales order items with the item type Entitlement - Contract Sale are not Displayed in Report Open Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee).-2850976 Customer Invoice Volume Report Shows Incorrect Quantity-2835402   Net Value in Customer Invoice and Invoice Volume Report Differ for an Item-2718456 Invoice Volume Report Displays an Incorrect Currency for the Invoices-3422792 In Preparation Contracts are not Showing in the Customer Contract Volume report-Keywords-Sales Order, Customer Contract, Report, Data Source, Invoice, Key Figure

Title: How to Enable the Hash Library
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-This Knowledge Base Article will inform how to handle incidents related to the enablement of the reusable hash library in a tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-If the partner wants to encrypt or need any PDI enhancement for HASH library for a specific tenant via Cloud Application Studio.-Cause-Partners can raise an incident to SAP stating that they would like to use a hash function/method for encrypting a string value in the scripting of their Add-on in the Cloud Applications Studio application.-Resolution-In case you receive such incident, please forward the same to the development component (AP-XPE) to proceed with the evaluation whether the reusable hash library can be further enabled in the tenant for the customer.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Hash, function, method, platinum, engineering, library

Title: Cost Estimate is Zero in Sales Document if Item Type is PMAT
Content: Symptom-You have created a Product ABC with Cost Estimate DEF, however it is not carried on to your created sales quote or sales order.-(Where ABC Represents the Product ID and DEF Represents the Cost Estimate)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business work center.-Choose Sales Quotes view.-Find Sales Quote GHI (Where GHI Represents the Sales Quote ID).-Edit the Quote and choose View All.-Go to page Pricing.-Navigate to sub-view Item Pricing.-Choose Expand All.-You notice that Cost Estimate displays zero value.-Go to Sales Order work center.-Choose Sales Order view.-Find Sales Order JKL (Where JKL Represents the Sales Order ID).-Edit the Sales Order and choose View All.-Go to page Pricing and Invoicing.-Navigate to sub-view Item Pricing.-Choose Expand All.-You notice that Cost Estimate displays zero value.-Cause-The cost estimate for item type: PMAT - Product - project based will not be carry forward to sales document.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior and system behaves as designed.-Keywords-Cost Estimate, PMAT, Project Based, Missing, Zero, 0, Sales Quote, Sales Order.-project,0

Title: Custom Key Figure Shows Wrong Result
Content: Symptom-You have created a key figure and you have displayed it in a report view. The result line shows the wrong total for your key figure.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report from the assigned work center view or the view Design Reports in the work center Business Analytics.-Make sure your key figure is part of the report view.-Click on Settings --> Characteristics.-Set up a result row for one of the characteristics and click on OK.-Check the result row for your key figure. The total value is incorrect.-Cause-You have not set any Local Calculation in the key figure properties.-Resolution-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Key Figures.-Search for your key figure and click on Edit.-Go to step 3.-In the option Calculate Result As, select a value (e.g. Total if you want to see a summary).-Save this setting.-Keywords-Custom Key Figure Shows Wrong Result, Business Analytics, view Design ,Characteristics, key figure, incorrect result

Title: Creation of Expense Reports via API or PDI Not Supported
Content: Symptom-You attempt to create expense reports (Business Object ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT) via API. e.g. Web Service with or without PDI involvement or OData.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Expense Report Business Object is exposed and write-enabled.-SAP, however, does not actively support in any issues that may occur in the process of modifying data related to Expense Reports via API.-This includes any data sent via Web Service and/or logic applied via PDI or ABSL scripting - outside the Business ByDesign Application.-Resolution-External Access and Modification via cited methods is not within Product Support Scope.-The Expense Report Business Object (ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT) is subject to various interdependencies as Employee Data, Payment Arrangements, Cost Assignments, Localization Specifics.-Features of Expense Reports are determined to a large degree by Application Frontend Logic which is not altered by modifications via API.-The accessibility of such processes is limited in order to secure the consistency of processed documents.-Keywords-Web Service, Expense Report, PDI, API, PSM, Business Object.

Title: Common Issues and How-To Questions Related to WebDAV/File I/O Functionalities
Content: Symptom-This document is to list some of the most common issues with solution and How-To Questions & Anwsers related to File I/O and WebDav-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-1. Is it possible to Integrate C4C/ByD and SAP DMS (Document Management System)? or How to send a file/attachment from C4C/ByD to SAP DMS?-C4C doesn't support sending file to any other system. If user wants a file in one of our BOs then they have to Read it and put it into their target systems themselves. We just have made possible for applications to read files out of the C4C/ByD system via a webservice--You can also refer to the blog https://blogs.sap.com/2015/10/08/read-and-write-bydesign-attachments-using-web-services-Above blog also helps to correctly set up the file input run process-2. How to map WebDAV folder to a network drive in Windows?-Refer to the attachment "Map WebDAV folder.docx"-3. File input run is not working when there are a large number of records to be updated. There are no issues when the file being run has a low number. is there any constrains in number of records?-Below are some of the general guidence:-Resources are not unlimited; Limits depend on the specific usecase. So it can well be that a file containing e.g. 1000 items work while 5000 does not work. In this case the customer will need to split files.-A file is always processed completely. E.g. if it contains 1000 items and 1 fails, the complete file will fail.-However, if several files are imported together, each file should be processed independently, i.e. if there are 5 files with 1000 items each and out of one file 1 item fails, then 4 files (adding up to 4000 items) should be processed and one file (with 1000 items) would not be processed.

Title: How to Create Proposal for Kit Product Through MRP.
Content: Symptom-Kit KIT_1 has two items - KI_1 and KI_2. The two items are also input products in a production model whose output product is PROD_1.-When running MRP (multi BoM level) against PROD_1, purchase proposal created for KI_1 and KI_2. However, you expect purchase proposal created for kit KIT_1.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Kit has no function of planning, hence supply planning won't consider kit product. -Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Kit, MRP, Supply Planning, Proposal

Title: Error Country/Region in Address of Service Recipient Party Missing
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order from a Purchase Order during an intercompany process scenario, and you are not able to release the document due to the error Country/Region in address of Service Recipient party missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-The following error shows: Country/Region in address of Service Recipient party missing-Cause-The reason the system is showing the error message Country/Region in address of Service Recipient party missing, is because the Service Recipient has not being maintained as Ship-To under the account data. -Resolution-This is the system behavior. -As the system does not perform dynamic updates from the account data to already created documents, please proceed with the following: -Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for Account XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Account).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Contacts tab.-Select the Relationships subtab.-Click the Add Row button.-Select Has Ship-To Party and maintain the expected Service Recipient as the Business Partner. -Once this is completed, please cancel the respective Sales Order and Purchase Order, and recreate new documents with the updated data.-Now the system is able to retrieve the expected address details. -See Also-2738172 - Error: "City in address of Account, Ship-To, and Bill-To party missing"-2633213 - Intercompany Sales Order Cannot Be Released Due To Errors-2821916 - Error 'City in address of Bill-To party missing' in Intercompany Sales Order-2935240 - Error: Item XX: City in address of Ship-To party missing occurs for Intercompany Sales Order-Keywords-Error, Sales Order, Purchase Order, Intercompany, Country/Region in address of Service Recipient party missing, Service Recipient

Title: State Value is not Showing in the Sales Document or Form
Content: Symptom-You have notice that when creating a sales document, such as a Sales Order or Customer Invoice, that the value maintained for the state is not showing despite being present within the Account. -In this case we will use the state of New Territories from Hong Kong as an example.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Preview.-Here you see that state value of New Territories is missing for the Bill-To address.-Cause-The reason the system is not considering the state for the document or form, is because the expected Address Formatting Routine was not enabled within the configuration.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -Please follow the steps below to configure the scenario:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select an active/started implementation by clicking on the title hyperlink.-Under All, search for Countries/Regions.-Click on the activity Countries/Regions hyperlink.-Filter for the expected country, in this Countries/Regions: HK (Hong Kong).-Navigate to the Postal Attributes tab.-Select the most appropriate option under the drop-down for Address Formatting Routine.-Click Save and Close.-Now the system is will display the state maintained at the account level as expected. -Keywords-Form, Sales Order, Invoice, Customer Invoice, Missing, State, Not Appearing

Title: 500 Error When Trying to Send Order Confirmation to Account in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You receive a system exception (dump) when clicking the 'Send Order Confirmation to Account' button in a Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open the Sales Order.-Click on the View All button.-Click on the Submit button and choose the 'Send Order Confirmation to Account' option.-An Error 500 occurs and the confirmation is not sent.-Cause-If you are sending order confirmations via business-to-business communication (B2B), one of the possible reasons for this is because the system requires the scoping question "Do you want to receive sales orders electronically from your customers using Electronic Data Exchange?" to be enabled in order for this process to work.-Resolution-In order to enable the scoping question, follow these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Highlight the relevant Implementation Project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button. -Navigate to Step 4 (Questions).-Expand "Sales" and then "Selling Products and Services".-Select Option "Communication for Selling Products and Services".-Enable Question "Do you want to receive sales orders electronically from your customers using Electronic Data Exchange?"-Save the Implementation Project.-Keywords-Dump, Error, 500, Exception, Impossible, Unable, Send Order Confirmation to Account, B2B, Internal EDX, Sales Order.

Title: You Are Not Able to Modify Tax Details on Contract Creation via Webservice
Content: Symptom-When you are creating a Contract via Webservice ManageCustomerContractIn, you try to send Tax Code Details on the creation request, however, they are not reflected in the created document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When creating a Contract via Webservice ManageCustomerContractIn, you include the Tax Code information alongside the creation payload, for example: -<TaxationCharacteristicsCode listID="ABC">DEF</TaxationCharacteristicsCode>-(Where ABC Represents the Country Code and DEF Represents the Tax Code)-However, you notice that the Tax Code of the created Contract is not taken from the payload, but rather determined by the system.-Cause-The modification of Tax Details via Webservice ManageCustomerContractIn cannot be done on the same request where the Contract is being created.-Resolution-A second ManageCustomerContractIn request needs to be sent with the Tax Code Details in order to update this information in the Contract via Webservice.-Keywords-Web Service, Contract, ManageCustomerContractIn, XML, Payload, Request, Unable, Ignores, Ignored, Unable, Tax Code, Missing, Different, Tax Details.

Title: Opportunity Being Copied with Referenced Contract
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when creating a copy of an Opportunity with reference to a Contract, system is also copying the reference Contract into the document flow. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Opportunities view.-Search for any document ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the source Opportunity).-Select the document.-Click the Copy button.-Click Save and Close.-Search for document ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the newly created Opportunity).-Open the newly created document.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Here we can see that the document is linked to the Contract of the source Opportunity.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -In order to avoid having reference contracts being retrieved to copied documents, please create new/fresh documents. -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Portal to submit an idea. -Improvement requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis, with the results being communicated in a corresponding review blog post.-Keywords-Issue, Opportunity, Contract, Reference, Copy, Existing Opportunity

Title: Add Button is not Available When Trying to Add a Sales Note for a Material by Using the Mass Change Functionality
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Add a Sales Note for a particular Material, however you notice that the Add button is not available (greyed out) when using the Mass Change functionality.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product Data WoC.-Go to the Materials view.-Search for the required Material ID.-Click Mass Change.-Show Sales tab.-Click Edit Sales Notes.-Add button is greyed out.-Cause-You will only use the Add button when you don't have a note for a specific language, for example:-You have scoped the languages English, German and French, and you already have a Sales Note for all the 3 languages.-For such cases, the Add button will be greyed out. Instead of using the Add, you will only Edit the Note by selecting the required language.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-greyed out, Product Data, Materials, Mass Change, Sales, Edit Sales Notes, Add button,  is greyed out, not available.

Title: Error Message "Log-on to Employee Central failed" While Replicating Employees from Employee Central to SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-When you replicate employees from SAP SuccessFactors' Employee Central to SAP Business ByDesign, system throws error message "Log-on to Employee Central failed."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Select Replication Runs view -Select Application Log with Error status-Cause-There might be different root causes related to this error.-Credentials for the SuccessFactors' Employee Central admin user were not maintained in the Communication Arrangement on ByD side-The credentials for the admin user in SuccessFactors' Employee Central (which is the technical user for communication between EC and ByD) have expired.-You are trying to connect using a non-standard (not 443) HTTPS port.-Host Name in the Communication Arrangement was set wrongly.API Key Value is not maintained or it's wrong.-API Key Value is not maintained or it's wrong.-Resolution-Please check if the credentials from the SF EC admin user are maintained in the EC Integration Communication Arrangement on ByD side. The fields for maintaining this only become available when authentication method "User ID and Password" is selected.-Ensure that the SF EC admin user credentials are active and valid.-Please test the connection using HTTPS port 443. In case you cannot use standard port 443, raise an SAP Incident asking if BYD operations team can open the required target port (this will be evaluated internally and might take several days).-Check if the Host Name in the Communication Arrangement is maintained properly according to your requirements.-Please check if the API Key Value is maintained in the Communication Arrangements and then Edit API Keys option.-Note: If the details are correct in the Communication Arrangement and even though the error is still appearing, you might want to delete the Communication Arrangement and create it again. For a few cases, there is a old reference in the Communication Arrangement and it's must be re-created from the scratch.-See Also-Set up Communication Arrangement, in the SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Log-on to Employee Central failed; Employee Central; Employee Replication.

Title: How to Find the Dependency/Constrains for a Scoping Element and Scoping Question?

You may need to follow the below steps when you find that a particular Scoping Element/question is read-only in the UI for check/un-check.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-Login to Backend.-Enter T-Code BC80.-Select BC Repository Browser and choose Business Adaptation Catalog from the drop down.-       4. For Example: if you wants to find the rule for "Personnel Administration" then expand "Human Resources" and double-click "Personnel Administration"-       5. Select Rules tab, under Constraints you can find the rule.-       6. Title: Error: “Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project” While Copying Solution Profile
Content: Symptom-While copying the solution profile from the production system to a test system, you receive the below error:-"Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project" (where XXX represents the tenant ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center-Go to Systems view-Select source instance-Select Copy Solution Profile button-Source System is selected-Choose your respective Solution Profile-Select respective tenant as Target System-Select Ok-The error "Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project" occurs.-Cause-In case the target test system is already linked to a change project, you cannot copy another solution profile to this test system.-Resolution-Once the change project is either closed or canceled, try to copy solution profile again.-In case the error remains, open a case with the permission to perform a backend correction. In this case, a remaining reference to a recently abandoned copy solution profile process in the system may prevent a new change project from being able to be copied to the system. Before the process can be triggered again, this reference needs to be removed in backend.-Keywords-Target System is Already Linked to an Implementation Project, Tenant, copy solution profile

Title: Unexpected Error When Creating Custom Price List with Extension Fields via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Custom Price List with Extension Fields via Webservice, however, the Price List is not created due to an error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-In SOAP UI or any other API testing tool, when trying to create a Custom Price List with Extension Fields, you receive the following error: -<Note>Base Price List ABC with same validity already exists</Note>-(Where ABC Represents the ID of the Price List).-However, they are not trying to create a Base Price List, but rather a Custom Price List. -Cause-In this scenario, the error happens when the Extension Field in question is being used in the request payload to create the Custom Price List, but it has not yet been properly added to 'Manage Sales Price Lists' Service via further usage.-Resolution-In order to add the Extension Field to the 'Manage Sales Price Lists' Service, follow these steps:-Navigate to a screen where you have added the field.-Go into Adaptation Mode.-In the side bar, scroll down until you see a plus ('+') sign.-Click on it and select Extension Fields.-Highlight the extension field that you wish to extend.-Click on Further Usage.-Go to the tab Services.-Highlight Service 'Manage Sales Price Lists'.-Click on 'Add Field'.-Once the field is added to the Webservice, it can be properly used in the creation request payload.-Keywords-Web Service, Webservice, Manage Sales Price Lists, Custom, Extension Field, Pricing, Price List, ManageSalesPriceListIn, Cannot, Unable, Impossible, Not Possible, Error, Erroneous, Request, Response, XML, Payload.

Title: Journal Entries Missing in Supplier Invoice with Following Error Message: 'A Table or List is Being Reloaded. Please Wait or Try Again Later; This May Take up to a Few Minutes'.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are not able to view Journal entries in the Supplier Invoice Document Flow due to below error message.-Error message: 'A table or list is being reloaded. Please wait or try again later; this may take up to a few minutes.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Click on any Supplier Invoice.-Go to the Document Flow.-You get the following error message:-'A table or list is being reloaded. Please wait or try again later; this may take up to a few minutes.'-Cause-The error message is caused due to inconsistency of the FSI views related to the /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV Business Object.-Resolution-Reload the inconsistent FSI views for BO /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV.-Please note: Consult with senior colleagues and/ or development colleagues before performing the FSI Reload.-Login to the Backend.-Use Transaction GFSSTM.-Enter Business Object /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV.-Click Execute.-Navigate to the Load Status.-The Business object /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV  is showing red.-Expand the same.-For all Objects displayed here, check the value displayed in the Number column. If this value is (much) higher than 20.000 it is possible that the reload will take some more time. During the Reload the Business User cannot access any Financial Project Planning reports.-Therefore you may consider asking the customer for a suitable time when the Reload shall be performed.-As the BO /SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV  is inconsistent, customer will not be able to do any postings. So you can perform the FSI Reload on this BO during any time. But it is necessary to inform the customer the same.-According to the data volume, you have to perform the reload per Node.-It is recommended to do the ROOT Node first and then the ITEM Node.-Select the ROOT Node.-Click Persistence.-Click Refresh.-The ROOT Node is refreshed and the status is green.-Select the ITEM Node.-Click Persistence.-Click Refresh.-The ITEM Node is refreshed and the status is green.-Check the result in the UI:-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Click on any Supplier Invoice.-Go to the Document Flow.-Data is displayed without any error.-Please note: If the number of records for the business object is too high you have to get the customer's permission to perform the steps during a low activity time.-Keywords-FSI reload for Supplier invoice, Invoices and Credit Memos view, Document Flow, Journal entries missing in Supplier invoice document flow

Title: How to migrate attachments using the Sales Order Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You are migrating sales order using the migration tool in the Business Configuration. You are wondering how to add a locally stored file as attachment to the migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration-Select Overview view-Search for Migration of open Sales Order-Open Activity Migration of open Sales Order-Click in Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool hyperlink-Click in You Can Also => Download Migration Template-Search for option to add an Attachment-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign currently does not support the migration with attachment document from local file. But you can add an URL link to a file.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-  When open the migration template the following data is visible under Field List:-  General - Attachments (optional, hidden)        -Key-Sales Order ID-mandatory for sheet-Text-35(80)-Attachments-URL-mandatory for sheet-Text-unrestricted-  Document Title-mandatory for sheet-Text-128  -  Document Type-  Text-80   -  Comment-  Text-unrestricted-                                         Items - Attachments (optional, hidden)        -Key-Sales Order ID-mandatory for sheet-Text-35(80)-  Line-mandatory for sheet-Text-10(80)-Attachments-URL-mandatory for sheet-Text-unrestricted-  Document Title-mandatory for sheet-Text-128  -  Document Type-  Text-80   -  Comment-  Text-unrestricted-         To make the respective fields visible, you should perform the following steps:-  Right click in General tab and select Unhide-Select General - Attachments or Items - Attachment (Depending on the business process).-See Also-Sales Order Migration-Keywords-Migration, local file, archive.

Title: G/L Account Description Appears Cryptic or in English Rather Than in Logon Language
Content: Symptom-You execute a financial report, such as the Financial Statement report and notice that some G/L account descriptions appear in English or as a cryptic code.-You need to view the G/L Account description in a language other than English (for example Japanese, German). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in with a language other than English, for example Japanese. -Go to the Business Analytics (or the General Ledger) work center.-Select the Design Reports view (In the General Ledger go to the Reports view). -Find and open the Financial Statements report. -Enter the required data.-Press Apply to execute the report.-For some G/L accounts their description appears in English or as a cryptic code, for example CAJP113200 (when logged on in Japanese).-Cause-In the Chart of Accounts the affected G/L accounts are maintained with an English description. The system cannot detect or translate the description when logged on in a language other than English.-Resolution-To see the G/L Account description in a language different to English, you need to translate the G/L account description:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity (either from the activity list of the Implementation project or from the Overview if your system is live already).-Press Edit Charts of Accounts.-Press Translate and then Expand All.-Select the Target Language, for example Japanese.-Maintain the description in the local language. -Press OK.-Press Save.-Note: There is no mass upload functionality to translate the Description of All G/L Accounts together.-Keywords-G/L Account Description, Translate, Target Language, G/L Account Description in reports

Title: How to Maintain New Region Code for Morocco?
Content: Symptom-You observed the region codes for Morocco available in the tenant is outdated. These codes where renamed/consolidated during 2015-Region Codes as per ISO Standard: https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:code:3166:MA-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below is an example to find the region codes-1. Go to Customers work center-2. Select Country/Regions-3. Open drop down for State-Cause-There is incompatibility between regions codes available in ByD system / C4C system and ISO Standards-Below is the detailed explnantion based on Region Codes as per ISO Standard: https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:code:3166:MA-1- Earlier the region codes for this country was 1-16  and now it is 1-12-2- Majority of region codes have completely different Region Name-For eg, for region Code : 02 old name was ‘”Gharb-Chrarda-Béni” but now new name is “L’oriental” which is somewhat similar to region name acquired by region code:04.-Resolution-Since there is conflict of similar description of region , we are not going to provide adjustment to Description as per new ISO standards as this may lead to Inconsistency for existing Business Documents / Users consuming these old codes.-As a workaround, you can region codes based on your requirement.The steps are as follows-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search and Open the activity - Regions-Select Add Row-Select County as Morocco; Enter a Code (Region code excluding 1 - 16) and Region Description (refer to Region Codes as per ISO Standard: https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:code:3166:MA)-Select Save-You can also refer to the KBA (2727372 - Predelivered content for regions is changed (sap.corp) with the list of pre-delivered region codes and changes per release-Keywords-morocco, region code, iso

Title: Project Task Cannot be Deleted from Sales Order After Assignment
Content: Symptom-You have assigned an incorrect Project Task to a Sales Order and saved the document. You now wonder if the incorrectly assigned Project Task can be deleted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order which has an incorrectly assigned Project Task).-Open the document and click on View All .-Navigate to the Items tab.-Highlight a line item and scroll down to the Cost and Revenue Assignment section.-In the item that had a Project Task assigned, you notice that the value of the field cannot be deleted.-Cause-Once a Project Task has been assigned to a line item in a Sales Order, the field becomes mandatory and does not allow the deletion of the Project Task assigned.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Project Task, Sales Order, Remove, Removed, Unable, Impossible, Delete, Greyed out, Stuck, Mandatory, Project Task Does Not Exist, Project Missing.

Title: Org Units not Available When Trying to Assign Them to a Master Template
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Assign an Org Unit into a Master Template, however, the system is showing only the Companies. Org Units that are not marked as Company are not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-And then Master Template Maintenance view.-Select Default Form Master Template.-Click Assign.-Click Add Row.-Click the Value Help for the field Company/Org Unit.-It appears only the companies.-Cause-This scenario is occurring because the scoping element related to the Sales Order is not scoped in the system.-Resolution-Please scope the Sales Order element by following steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select a Project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Scoping step.-Expand: Sales and then Selling Products and Services.-Select the scoping element named as Sales Order.-Note: If the system is already live and there is no project available, you would need to create a new Change Project in order to edit the tenant's scoping.-Keywords-Org Unit, Company, Master Template, Assign, Not available, Missing, Application and User Management, Master Template Maintenance, BT_A1S_CRM_SALESOR.

Title: How does the Purchase Order Approval Process for Item Level Approval Work
Content: Symptom-Approval Task is first created to the persons responsible for Purchase Order Item Level Approval and not for the persons responsible for Purchase Order Approval (Header Approval).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Task Management sub-view.-Search for Purchase Order XYZ  (XYZ refers to the purchase order ID).-Open the task.-You see that the task is created for persons responsible for Purchase Order Item Level Approval and not for Purchase Order Header Approval.-Cause-The approval task for Purchase Orders will be created for each step as follows:-Purchase Order Item Level Approval steps 1,2,3 etc..-Purchase Order Approval steps 1,2,3 etc..-  Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In general, once the task created for step 1 is approved, the task for the persons responsible in the following step for approval will be created.-All the steps mentioned in the Purchase Order Item Level Approval must be completed first and then the Purchase Order Approval tasks will be created for the persons responsible for approval one step after the other.-Keywords-purchase order approval, PO approval, purchase order, approval, approval process

Title: Missing Withholding Tax Income Type Field in Supplier's Master Data
Content: Symptom-You create a custom country localization and enable withholding taxes, however the Withholding Tax Income Type field is missing in the supplier master data when adding the withholding tax details for this custom country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Open the concerned supplier master data.-Go to the Financial Data -> Tax Data tab.-Under Withholding Tax Classifications, add a new row and give the non-localized country, your custom tax type and tax rate.-You notice that, after giving the above parameters, the Withholding Tax Income Type field does not become visible.-Cause-As per localization toolkit, when creating custom withholding tax configuration, there is a field named WhtIncome TypeAtBP, which needs to be set if you want to enable income type field in supplier master data. In this case, the field has not been activated, hence the income type is not enabled in the supplier master.-Resolution-You need to revise the withholding tax configuration in your custom add-on and flag the WhtIncome TypeAtBP in the solution.-For more details on this process, you can refer to the guide "Enable Withholding Tax for Non-Localized Countries in SAP Cloud Applications Studio", available in the Localization Toolkit.-Keywords- Withholding Tax. CSL. Income Type. Non-localized.

Title: In the Contract - Items the Cancelation Reason is maintain , but the Status of an Item is Showing as Cancelation Requested
Content: Symptom-In the Contract -Items the Cancelation Reason is maintained, but the status of an item is showing as Cancelation Requested.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Contract and in the Find field enter ABC(where ABC is the Contract id) and click on the Go button.-Select the Contract ABC and click on the Edit button and go to the Items tab.-Select the line-item YY and go to the Details section below and sub section Cancelation.-Here you can see for the field Cancelation Reason, the value is maintained but still the Cancelation Status is showing as Cancelation Requested.-Cause-In Contract->Item sub section Cancelation, Cancelation Effective On is of future date. Once the date is reached the Cancelation Status will change from Cancelation Requested to Canceled.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-contract, cancelation reason, cancelation effective on, cancelation requested, item, cancel item, cancel, cancelation status, status

Title: Error During Migration of G/L Account Balances
Content: Symptom-You are migrating General Ledger Account Balances and received the below error messages:-'Item X: A profit center must be provided in set of books PQRS'-'No functional area could be assigned'-'Derivation for acc.principle YYYY, chart of accts PQRS, G/L account 123, Nonsales Object'-'Journal entry voucher cannot be posted'-(PQRS represents the set of books)-(123 represents the G/L account)-(YYYY represents the acc.principle)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List.-Search and open the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Process the file and during simulate import you get the below errors.-'Item X: A profit center must be provided in set of books PQRS (PQRS represents Set of Books ID)'-'No functional area could be assigned'-'Derivation for acc.principle YYYY, chart of accts PQRS, G/L account 123, Nonsales Object (123 represents G/L account ID)'-'Journal entry voucher cannot be posted'-Cause-You have not maintained the Default profit center and default functional area.-Since you have selected the reporting principle which supports Income Statement by Function of Expense. For Instance: Function of expense: the system tries and assign a functional area when it is hitting the gl-account 123 which is another operational expenses. However - the system failed to assign since it could not find a default functional area for nonsales object or a functional area assigned to this G/L account in particular in the activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Resolution-You need to follow the below 3 steps to set the configuration:-Step 1:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project, and select Open Activity List.-Go to the tab Fine-Tuning Activities.-Select Fine Tuning activity Profit Center Derivation.-Select Edit Default Profit Center.-Click Add Row.-Enter required data and specify Profit Center for each Subledger.-Choose Save.-Step 2:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project, and select Open Activity List.-Go to tab Fine-Tuning Activities.-Select activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Select Functional Areas.-Select Functional Area and select Default check box-Select Save.-Step 3:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the project, and select Open Activity List.-Go to tab Fine-Tuning Activities.-Select activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Select Functional Area Determination.-Select Add Row in tab Determination Using G/L Accounts.-Input the G/L account 123, and select Functional Area.-Select Save.-Now you are able to migrate the G/L account balances.-See Also-2761711 - Error While Migration G/L Account Balances: 'G/L Account as Chart of Accounts Item 'CAIA SAKOMIG' not found'-Keywords-Migration of G/L account balances, Profit center, functional area, Derivation for acc.principle

Title: Removing the Watermark "Test Copy" from the form while previewing a document
Content: Symptom-You are previewing a document, however in the preview PDF there is a "Test Copy" watermark.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-As an example, we will consider a Customer Invoice document:-Navigate to Customer Invoice Work center.-Enter the Invoice Documents view.-Select a document.-Click on the Preview button.-After the PDF is loaded, you can see in the bottom right corner the watermark "Test Copy".-Cause-All SAP standard forms contain a watermark by default when the document is in preview. This is a legal requirement on the standard forms.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-It is possible to remove the watermark by customization of the form template. However please note that once the form is customized, SAP does not have responsibility in terms of audit/compliance checks on the forms being used.-SAP does not recommend the removal of the watermark, as it will not appear in the official output document once it is posted.-Keywords-Watermark, Test Copy, Template

Title: Not Possible to Exclude Values for a Characteristic in Custom or Standard Reports
Content: Symptom-The option to exclude values is not available for a specific characteristic in a custom or standard report.-Unable to exclude values for a specific characteristic in a custom or standard report, receiving error 'Report cannot be opened. (KBA:1926357)' when you done with exclude action.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-When you open a custom or standard report, for example Sales Order Volume (technical ID CRMSLOIB_Q0001) and click on the drop down menu for the characteristic Account the option to exclude values (!=) is not available. You can select multiple accounts but not exclude values from the report-Open value help for characteristic XXX from selection, go to advanced filter, select 'is not' (exclude) for required values.-Cause-This is caused by the definition of the characteristic in the ﻿Report Wizard﻿.-Resolution-In order to correct the definition in a custom report, please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the view Design Reports.-Select the custom report ABC that is presenting the issue and click on Edit With and select Report Wizard.-Click on Next until you reach the step 5: Define Variables.-Change the Selection Type of the characteristic from Multiple Values to Any Value.-Click on ﻿Finish﻿ to save the report.-As standard reports cannot be edited please create a new report copy. Please follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Analytics work center and the view Design Reports.-Select the standard report for example Sales Order Volume (technical ID CRMSLOIB_Q0001).-Click New > Report as Copy.-Fill out the mandatory fields and click on Next until you reach the step 5: Define Variables.-Change the Selection Type of the characteristic Account from Multiple Values to Any Value.-Click on ﻿Finish﻿ to save the report.-See Also-Exclude selections take up more system resources than Include. Try to avoid the Exclude operator if possible, however if they are necessary, set them on fields of type ID, rather than UUID. So for example, if you need a negative selection (IS NOT) on the Employee field, make use of the field Employee Responsible ID, rather than Employee Responsible.-Keywords-variables; exclude values; variable; selection type; report wizard; step 5;-is not,exclusion

Title: Error: Creation Failed as it Exceeds the Maximum Limit of 15 for Communication Scenario Definition
Content: Symptom-The below error prevents you from creating a communication scenario in SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-Creation failed as it exceeds the maximum limit of 15 for Communication Scenario Definition-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Studio.-Open the relevant solution.-Open External Webservice Integration Wizard via New Item.-Define Communication Scenario and click on OK.-Error pop up appears.-Cause-The number of Communication Scenario Definitions (.csd) are limited to a maximum of 15 per solution from 1811 release.-Resolution-The best practice is to build one communication scenario per system and use it for the multiple services being consumed from that external system.-The system allows you to assign more services to an existing .csd content in a patch solution.-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/09/12/limit-on-the-number-of-content-types-in-cloud-applications-studio-solution/-Keywords-PDI, SDK, unable, to, create, .CSD, files, error, during, creation, of, communication, scenario, definition, maximum, limit

Title: Save rejected Because the Field is Defined as Mandatory by Key User
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to release any document / saving in Bydesign-HTML5 UI, you are getting an error message Save rejected Because the Field is Defined as Mandatory by Key User.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management Work Center.-Then go to Projects view.-Click any Project and create New Project Invoice Request.-After completing steps, on Finish, you get error message.-Cause-If a field property is mandatory and there is no value filled, then error message is triggered in the system.-Resolution-Enter the value for the field which is marked as mandatory or you can remove mandatory property by following below steps in Silverlight client.-Go to relevant screen.-Click your User Profile icon and go to Key User settings > Start Adaptation mode-Hover over the field ABC and make a right click.-Underneath the name of the field there is a Set Mandatory checkbox.-Uncheck the Set Mandatory checkbox-Save and publish the change-Keywords-Save rejected Because the Field is Defined as Mandatory by Key User, Mandatory, Remove Mandatory

Title: What are the Different Milestones during Implementation and their usage
Content: Symptom-This document lists the Milestone in the Implementation Project and their activities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted.-This activity should be performed after the Scoping. Once this activity is confirmed then only its possible to create a Key User (Service Agent). With the Key User, the fine tuning activitiy can be performed.-Note: You cannot move on to the next phases of the Activity List until you have confirmed this milestone.-Confirm Milestone: Solution Accepted.-This milestome should be confirmed once the fine tuning is completed. It is also possible to peform the fine tuning after closing this milestone.-Confirm Milestone: Go Live Readiness Accepted.-This milestone shoule be confirm after the Test phase.-Confirm Go Live.-After completing this activity, your solution is live and ready for use. You can still view all previous phases and activities of your project, but you cannot make changes to them. Once completed, you cannot change the status of this activity. The project status is set to Live and all phases except Go Live are set to read-only.-Note: There are two ways to make changes to your live solution. You can make smaller changes to configuration elements, or, for more complex changes, you can create change projects.--At the end of the Go Live phase, you and the project team have:-Resolved all mandatory and open configuration issues;-Migrated all legacy data to your production system;-Completed knowledge transfer;-Signed off the project.-See Also-Keywords-Design Accepted,  Milestone, Service Agent, Project, Implementation Project

Title: The Sales Order Invoice Request is Inconsistent with Error Messages
Content: Symptom-Sales Order Invoice Request is Inconsistent with below error messages:-"Organization Sales Unit ID ABC must have organizational role Sales" (ABC represents the ID of the sales unit).-"Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company DEF" (DEF represents the ID of the seller company).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show Inconsistent Invoice Requests and select Go button.-Select the inconsistent invoice request and choose Check button.-Below error messages are shown:-Organization Sales Unit ID ABC must have organizational role Sales (ABC represents the ID of the sales unit).-Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company DEF (DEF represents the ID of the seller company).-The invoice request is old and was created one year back.-Cause-The invoice requests are inconsistent as the check at Org. level is done on the current date and not on the invoice date. Since the invoices were created last year the check will run for today's date and check if the org. unit is valid now.-In case the org. unit is not active anymore you will see the error message. This is the designed behavior of the system.-In such case you need to activate the org. in master data to get rid of the inconsistency.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Search for the Org. Unit used in the Invoice Request.-Edit the Org. Unit.-Activate it again.-Again go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show Inconsistent Invoice Requests and select Go button.-Select the inconsistent invoice request and choose Check button.-The error message should not occur anymore.-See Also-KBA: 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-KBA: 2121251 - Invoice Request is Inconsistent due to the Validity of the Sales Unit-Keywords- invoice request, inconsistent, sales order invoice request, sales unit, seller company, party role

Title: Tax Region for Country ABC in item 10 is Missing
Content: Symptom-You are creating a manual invoice request or an intercompany scenario and upon entering the item to the document, the system returns the error informing that the tax region is missing for item 10.-ABC represents the ID of the country displayed in the error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Customer Invoice from the Common Tasks.-Enter the account ID FGH (FGH represents the ID of the account).-Click Add Row.-Enter item XYZ (ABC represents the ID of the product/service).-Error: Tax region for country ABC in item 10 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab.-In this case we have taken examplet of customer invoice but similar error can be seen in the intercompany sales order as well when the Seller's address is not maintained completely/inconsistent.-Cause-The reason the system is generating this error is because the Seller's address is inconsistent/incomplete.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please maintain the complete address for the seller party and create a new manual invoice.-See Also-3037882 - Error Occurs When Entering a Product in a New Manual Invoice for an Account Located in Canada-Keywords-Error, Tax, Region, Manual, Invoice, Invoice Request, Entering, Jurisdiction, Intercompany, Tax Jurisdiction, Sales Order

Title: How to Delete End User Change Transactions from Production Tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to Delete End User Change Transactions from Production Tenant.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Open the transaction Se38.-2. Open the report AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW-3. Select the personalized CT which you want to delete. Upon clicking the delete button, you get an error message 'Not Allowed in the Productive Environment'.-Resolution-Please, proceed with caution and in case of doubt consult an expert colleague from UI team (AP-RC-UIF component)-This solution is valid for both C4C and ByD:-Open STFK connection.-Go to SE24 Transaction.-Type Class Name: CL_AP_UI_FLEX_CT_HELPER.-Click Display.-Click 'In Test Environment' (or press 'F8').-Now run 'DELETE_CTS'.-Check 'Upper/lower case active'.-In 'IT_CTS' section click in 'Edit Table'.-Paste the Change Transaction path in the given row.-Press 'F3' (Back).-Click on 'Debugging'.-Breakpoint Debugger will pop up. Type in the 'Variable' Column 'sy-uname'.-Change its 'Val' to the business user backend user ID.-Press 'Continue' (F8) to run the code.-CT will be deleted.-This solution is valid only for C4C:-In front-end acess the system by adding the &debugMode& in the URL.-Now with debugMode active go to affected screen.-Hold Ctrl button and perform a left click in the screen (Ctrl+Mouse Left Click) to open the Client Inspector screen. -In the Client Inspector screen go to UI Changes tab.-Fill the field "Personalization Backend User Name" with the business user technical ID and click in the search button. -The result list will show all personalization changes for this specific user.-Click in the change you need to delete to open it (it will open in the background) and close the Client Inspector screen.-Now select the tab with the change you clicked before and read the details about it to confirm. -Click in the button Delete.-Keywords-Delete CT, Personalization, End User, Change Transaction, business user
