Title: Expense Report Approval for Top Manager
Content: Symptom-There are unassigned approval tasks for expense reports appearing for the key user in the Business Task Management view of the Application and User Management work center.-This expense report belongs to the CEO of the company.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The CEO of the company creates an expense report-You notice the Expense Report approval task is not assigned to any employee -Cause-In Application and User Management you can see the Default approval process for Expense Report: Default Line Manager of Employee.-As a consequence, the approver determination for expense reports sent by the CEO (an approver who is at top of the hierarchy) does not return any approver.-Resolution-Due to segregation of duties, an employee may not be the manager of himself. -Therefore accessing the organisational structure will not give an answer to the question who will be the approver of a top manager.-This means that for the top manager(s) you need to define a rule, what should happen if a manager is not found.-Define additional approval step for CEO in approval processes for Expense Reports.-Go to the Application and User Management work center. -Go to the Task Distribution > Approval Processes view-Select the active version of Default Approval Process for Expense Report.-Copy this Approval Process.-In the copy press "Add Row" in order to add a new  Process Step CEO Approval also with Step No 1.-Under "Work Distribution" select "Direct Approver" and Press Edit in order to select the Employee responsible for Approval of CEO’s expense reports.-Then go to "Conditions" and  press "Add a Group" and enter a condition for the Employee Id of the CEO.-Finally it should look like as follows:-Save and Close the approval process definition.-Keywords-Approval Expense Report; Manager Approval, Geschaeftsfuehrer

Title: You Cannot Create a New Tax Event
Content: Symptom-You cannot create a new customized Tax Event in the User Interface in Business Configuration activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Centre.-Go to the Implementation Project View and select the relevant one.-Open the Activity list.-Navigate to Fine-tune.-Search for Activity Tax on Goods and Services and open it.-Open Sub-actvity Define Tax Codes.-Click the Add row button.-Fill in the relevant information for the customized Tax Code: Country, Tax Code (starting with "Z"), Description and Validity.-Now, navigate to the Tax Event column and open the drop-down menu:-Only SAP delivered Tax Events are available and there is no possibilities to create a new one.-Cause-Since Tax Events are linked to VAT Return submission forms, they are subjected to very precise legal requirements, hence no customization or modification is available for these from the User Interface.-Resolution-If the addition of these new Tax Events is linked to a legal requirement or to a valid business scenario that cannot be fulfilled by using SAP delivered Tax events, this request can be forwarded to our development teams, provided there is legal provision for this addition or impaired Business Processes.-If you need to make such request, please open a case with SAP Product Support describing your business scenario in details as well as the new Tax Event needed with all relevant information pertaining to it.-Keywords-Tax; Tax Event; Goods and Services;

Title: Wrong Form Template or no Form Template is Picked While Previewing Any Business Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a Business Document (EX:Sales Order/Customer Invoice etc).-When you preview the document, the Preview is selecting an incorrect form template ﻿or no template is being picked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Example: Customer Invoice-Open Customer Invoice Workcenter.-Navigate to Invoice Documents.-Select Invoice ID.-Choose Preview.-User notice wrong Form Template or no Form Template is Picked while Previewing selected document.-Cause-[Enter your Cause here...]-Resolution-There are many reasons that may cause this issue, they are-Case 1:-When you open the document in the Output History, the preview is in Form Template XYZ but when you preview the same document, the preview is in Form Template ABC. (i.e.Here XYZ and ABC are Form Templates ID)-The cause for the issue could be, after you submitted the document there might be a change in the Form Template or the Rule to pick the form template. In this case, the preview will always picks the form which suffices the current rule.-Case 2:-You might have maintained the rule for the Form Template (Form Template Selection) in such a way that, for a particular Org Unit (Ex: sales unit), this Form Template should be picked and for other Org Units different Form template.-Check the Rule for the Form Template in Form Template Selection view (Application and User Management work center) and correct the rule if applicable.-Note: You can manually change the template via Edit Output Settings but that would only be applicable for that document only, if you again check the Preview or Sends Confirmation to Account then it will pick the template based on the Form template rule defined.-Case 3:-You have maintained a empty Rule (without any parameter checked) in Form Template Selection. In this case, this Template will be picked always inspite any rule that set below this Template rule.-Case 4:-The Form Template is picked based on the Tax Country maintained in the document. So, check the Tax Country maintained in the document and if required create a new Form template if there is no Form template for that particular country variant.-In principle, The Form Template is picked in the document preview based on the Country Variant and Language, and the country variant is based on the Tax Country.-  Keywords-sales document, preview, incorrect template,wrong form template picked

Title: Reason for Rejection Field Greyed Out in Items Tabs and Also Getting Error While Maintaining Reason for Rejection in Header Level.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to maintain Reason for Rejection at header level and receive the error message, Item XX: You cannot change the data in Reason for Rejection. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident. When you check the Line Item XX in Service and Spare Parts tab, the Reason for Rejection field is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Service Orders-Go to view Service Order Processing-Edit the Service Order ABC (ABC represents the service order id)-Navigate to Service and Spare Parts tabs-The Reason for Rejection field is grayed out.-Navigate to General tab and there you maintain Reason for Rejection and you receive the error message. -Item XX: You cannot change the data in Reason for Rejection. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident-Cause-The item XX is of Item type service- Time and Material and the corresponding service confirmation is not with status Finished. Therefore the reason for rejection is disabled at Item level.-This item cannot be canceled with open service confirmation.-Resolution-For Item type service- Time and Material, we need to complete the corresponding service confirmation or delete the service confirmation (if service confirmation is with status Not Started) and then you can maintain reason for rejection for the line item at service order.

Title: Cannot Delete G/L Account in the Edit Chart of Accounts Activity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are not able to change G/L Account Posting Block for any G/L account as the row is greyed out.-(or)-You are not able to delete the G/L Account as the Delete tab is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L Account in question and cannot make changes to G/L account Account Type as the row is greyed out.-Or you are not able to delete the G/L account in question as the Delete tab is greyed out.-Cause-The root cause is that prevoiusly you have deleted the G/L account from UI(Fine tuning based on BC set) and not deleted from Global Net Fine Tuning.-There are two kinds of fine tuning data exist in backend:-1.Global Net Fine Tuning (Fine Tuning not based on a BC set).-2. Fine Tuning based on BC set.-The Global Net Fine tuning is the configuration tuning not based on the Business Configuration which exists in parallel in the Business Configuration. It has the higher priority than Fine tuning based on BC set in the backend of the system. The entry in the backend table is based on the Global Net fine Tuning.-The fine tuning setting that the user provides through UI Business Configuration -> Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity is the Fine Tuning based on BC set.-To resolve this, it is either necessary to change the same in the Global Fine Tuning(make both consistent), or to remove the Global Fine Tuning completely.-It is always preferred to delete the Global Net Fine Tuning completely than changing the value in the Global net fine tuning because any change that is done for those accounts (which are present in the Global net Fine tuning) in the future will not effect as long as Global fine tuning content exists for the same. Once the Global Net Fine Tuning is deleted, the BC set based Fine Tuning which is visible on the front end of the system will not be changed and will be considered in the runtime.-Resolution-You can check whether the G/L account ABC is deleted by user or not in the backend:-Go to Transaction code: BCTADM.-Go to Fine Tuning tab.-Enter node id: A1S_FIN_CHOFACCTFIAC_GLACCT and enter.-        4.   Go to Fine Tuning History-      5.  Select CHANGED_AT column and click on Sort in Descending Order Icon.-       6.   Click on one by one line to view if any data is deleted related to respective G/L account and note down the Changed At time.-Request for customer's permission to delete the G/L account from Global Fine Tuning and forward the issue to AP-RC-BCT component to delete the g/l account from backend.-    Keywords-Delete G/L accounts, chart of accounts, Delete tab greyed

Title: You get Error While Creating a New Sales Quote: "Costs not determined"
Content: Symptom-You get error while creating a New Sales Quote: Costs not determined: No valid purchase price for material in company XXX; There is no inventory cost for material ABC in company XXX.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select New Sales Quote under Common Tasks.-Add mandatory details in the sales quote.-Select the View All button and go to the Items tab.-Add the product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the product).-Error occurs: Costs not determined: No valid purchase price for material in company XXX; There is no inventory cost for material ABC in company XXX (XXX represents the ID of the company).-Cause-There is no inventory cost maintained for the material/product ABC in company XYZ.-Resolution-Go to the Products and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search for the product ABC (ABC indicates the ID of the product).-Select the product ABC and choose Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the Valuation tab.-Add the Valuation UOM, Company, Account Determination Group and Set of Books (with Cost Rate, Cost Unit, Valid From and Valid To dates).-Set the Status Indicator to Active.-Save your changes.-Go to the New Business  work center.-Go to the Sales Quote view.-Open the Sales Quote you created previously-Click on Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Total Pricing and click on Update Pricing.-The system will update the pricing and get the cost value from product master data. The issue will now be resolved.-See Also-2879580 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Order: "Costs not determined"-2936992 - Error Message "Item X: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service ABC and set of books IFRS valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing"-Keywords-Cost, Costs, Inventory Costs, Costs not determined, no valid purchase price for material in company, Sales Quote

Title: Process Communication Error in GSR: Error message /CDF/CM_BO_SERVICE_PROVIDER must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer is facing a process communication error between the GoodsAndServiceAcknowledgement and the ServiceConfirmationProcessingServiceConfirmationIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Service Receipt work center.-Select the Receipt and Return view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Goods and Service Receipt).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Process Communication Error shows.-Cause-The message to Service Confirmation is failing because the customer has not scoped the item type 'service - time and material'.-In the scenario with supplier service center, any service item used will be created in the confirmation as a time and material item.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please ask the customer to scope the following question:-Do you provide services for a price based on actual time and materials needed?-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project.-Click Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions tab.-Expand Services.-Expand Product and Service Portfolio for Service and Repair.-Select Offered Services.-Under Group: Service Types for Service with Cost Tracking-Do you provide services for a price based on actual time and materials needed?-Add this question to the scoping.-Once the customer does this, please ask them to revert the ticket so that the you may restart the message.-See Also-KBA 2912984 - Process Communication Error in GSR: Error message /CDF/CM_BO_SERVICE_PROVIDER must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task-Keywords-Process Communication Error, GSR, Error message, /CDF/CM_BO_SERVICE_PROVIDER must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task, Goods and Service Receipt, Service Confirmation

Title: Wrong Sequence of IDs for 3PL Requests And Other Logistics Documents
Content: Symptom-For 3PL Requests, you get an unexpected sequence for the IDs generated by the system, which is not consecutive.-You could observe the same behavior for other logistics documents as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center. -Select 3PL Requests view. -Execute the query. -Order by Creation Date. -Notice that the system generates the 3PL Request IDs not in sequence, as an example ID 2 is generated first and then the system created the ID 1.-Cause-The documents which are legally required to follow a strict sequence in their Document ID will follow them, such as Invoices.-For these documents where the IDs have to follow a sequence, the buffering is disabled. However, this has an adverse impact on the performance, hence for all the other objects have buffer setting maintained.-Other documents like Warehouse Order, request, Delivery Proposals, Tasks, have document numbers which are assigned from a cache of sequence for each of the documents and the number from this cache might skip occasionally when there are any connection errors or interruptions.-Documents for which you have the option to set up number range sequence could also experience the above behaviour.-The number range object used for the documents like Inbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery and other similar documents in the system uses the memory buffer.-When the system buffers a number range object, it does not update numbers individually in the database but reserves a present group of numbers (depending on the number range object) in the database the first time a number is requested.-The system makes these numbers available to the application server in question. These numbers can then be taken directly from the application server buffer.-New numbers are not used in the database until the application server buffer has been used up.-As there are more than one application servers available, the numerical sequence will not reflect the (chronological) insert sequence because the numbers are buffered separately on the individual hosts.-The above  definition could potentially to the following symptoms:-Gaps (jumps) occur when allocating internal numbers-The number assignment does not reflect the insert sequence.-Resolution-Any document which is legally required to follow a strict sequence as per the local governmental authority those documents will be following the sequence.-The explanation is valid for documents those are not required to legally follow strict sequence. -They follow the number range buffer setting which is a central configuration and this behaviour cannot be changed.-See Also- 1914346 - ID of Documents are Created Out of Order or there are Gaps in Document IDs-Keywords-3PL, order, TPOP, number range not in sequence, Inbound delivery number range not in sequence, sequence not followed in document id, document ID not in order, document numbering issue, document number not in order,

Title: Supplier Invoice with Accepted Exception Not Sent to Approval
Content: Symptom-You have set in your system that all supplier invoices that have an accepted exception should be sent to approval, however for a specific invoice, the approval process was not triggered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos-Select a Supplier Invoice that once had the status Exception-Click on Post-The invoice is posted without approval-However, in supplier invoice approval process, you have set condition Random Exception Check Percentage equal to 100. You expect all supplier invoices that have an accepted exception should be sent to approval.-Cause-The exceptions were created and accepted by different users.-If the user that accepted the exception is not the same one that have created it, the approval process will not be triggered, since there are two users involved.-This can be confirmed by accessing the Exceptions tab of the supplier invoice, selecting the accepted exception and clicking on Action Log. You will see that the user that created the exception is not the one who accepted it.-Please note,-Stochastic exception approval is applicable only for manually created supplier invoice.-Missing Purchase Order reference exception is not applicable during stochastic exception approval determination.-If the exception has been accepted more than once, then only the last acceptor party is considered.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior. The approval process will only be triggered if the same user creates and accepts the exception. Then, the approval of a second user will be necessary-See Also-KBA :Approvals is skipped in supplier invoice-https://itsm.services.sap/kb_view.do?sysparm_article=KB0766580-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Approval,  Random Exception Check, Approval Not Triggered

Title: Cannot complete task XYZ-N; associated sales order item(s) not yet delivered
Content: Symptom-While trying to change the multi customer project task or milestone status to complete the system throws an error message : "Cannot complete task XYZ-N; associated sales order item(s) not yet delivered".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center.-Go to Projects view.-Go to Projects sub view.-Search with Project ID XYZ .-Choose Edit -> Project Plan button.-Choose the Project Task or Milestone XYZ –N-Try to change the status to Complete or Complete and Close.-System throws an error message: "Cannot complete task XYZ-N; associated sales order item(s) not yet delivered".-Cause-This is the expected system behavior because multi customer project task or milestone  XYZ-N is associated to the sales order or sales order items hence you are not allow to complete or close the project task or project milestone without finishing the delivery and the invoicing of the associated sales order.-If the Sales Order ABC is In Process/ In Preparation status you cannot complete or close the Project task or Milestone which are associated to Sales Order ABC.-Steps to check if there are any open Sales Order for the Project task or Milestone:-Select the Project task or Milestone to be closed-Navigate to Sales tracking tab-Search for Project task or Milestone name -We can see the associated Sales order ABC and its respective status-Resolution-Kindly finish the delivery and the invoice then try to complete or close the project task or milestone.-To manually finish the delivery of the Sales Order at header level.-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to Sales Order view.-Search with Sales Order ID ABC.-Select Edit Button.-Select the Submit button-Choose Complete Service Execution.-To manually finish the delivery of the Sales Order at Item Level,-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to Sales Order view.-Search with Sales Order ID ABC.-Select Edit Button.-Select the Line Item which delivery needs to be completed.-Select Complete Service Execution.-Keywords-Cannot complete task XYZ-N; associated sales order item(s) not yet delivered, Complete Project, Project task cannot be closed

Title: Changed frontend behavior due to introduced session-timeout (security)
Content: Symptom-After an inactivity period of 60 minutes a message is displayed offering to prolong the session. The message adds a courtesy buffer of 5 minutes.-The confirmation will reset the timeout counter again and would count up to 60 minutes. Every interaction with the SAP system will reset this counter as well.-Session will be terminated, if the defined time frame has passed without any activity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-A timeout is not an issue but a security requirement.-Cause-Common data protection and privacy requirements demand for this session handling.-In alignment with SAP Security officials, session-timeouts of 60 minutes are defined for OnDemand products.-Resolution-SAP follows the principles of data consistency and data security first.-This system behavior will ensure best security and privacy practice.-Keywords-session-timeout, session, ByD, inactvity, compliance, security

Title: Central Case Document: Troubleshooting issues with BTM tasks
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You receive an incident from a customer relating to Business Task Management. Please check whether issue may lie in one of the following categories and forward the incident to Expert Support Queue accordingly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Category 1) Responsible not found and task is appearing in Unassigned Items:-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue in frontend:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Utilities view.-Select the radio button Business Task Management.-Show Unassigned Task.-Unassigned tasks exist (Example: subject Solve Error in Service Interface SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn).-Follow the steps below to check the BTM tasks in backend:-Go to the transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-Search the BTM tasks using input field Creation Time (or use another like creation from/to date, status, short text etc).  -Check the tasks with Task Title (Example: Service Interface SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn).-Select the Responsibles tab -> The users are already assigned to task even though the task is shown as unassigned in frontend.-Use Case1.1: Issue may occur because user does not have does not have Managing My Area work center assigned-Resolution:  Assign Managing My Area work center to the responsible Manager and then Determine Assignment of the task. Follow the steps below to do so,-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select view User and Access Management and sub-view Business Users.-Search user of the responsible manager.-Select the searched user and click on Edit button.-In the Maintain User and Access Data screen, click on Next button.-Here you can see that Managing My Area work center is not appearing under Assigned Work Center list.-Bring this work center under Assigned Work Center list from Available Work Center list.-Click Next button thrice and finally click on Finish button.-Come back to Application and User Management work center.-Select view Utilities and sub-view Business Task Management.-Search approval task (i.e. leave request).-Select the task and click on Determine Assignment. System will determine your manager as responsible for the task.-Related Case Documents:-        i.          1466948: Approver Task for expense report is not getting assigned to correct approver-        ii.         1432853: System is not able to find responsible for leave approval tasks-Use Case1.2: Work Agreement of User is not valid.-Resolution: Need to check the work agreement of employee responsible (refer case document for more information).-Related Case Documents:-        i.          1419921 - System is not able to find responsible for expense report notification-        ii.          1419956 - System could not able to find responsible for notification for expense report-Use Case1.3: The validity of this user is not defined in the system.-Resolution: Need to check the validity of employee responsible (refer case document for more information).-Related Case Documents:-         i.          1466948 Approver Task for expense report is not getting assigned to correct approver-Category 2) Approval Task is not getting assigned to correct approver because missing approver in the global work list-Resolution: Need correct implementation of a fall back, need to assign approver in the global work list (i.e. operational purchasing).-  Related Case Documents:-          i.          1384308 Missing approver in the global work list of operational purchasing Released For Customer-Category 3) Approvals tasks are not forwarded correctly as per the defined substitution rules. -Resolution: Approval tasks are not visible to the user due to incomplete responsibility assignment. Since substitution mechanism does not copy the responsibility assignment from one user to another user responsibility need to be assigned separately to the  substitute.-Related Case Documents:-  2856475 - The approval task does not show up in the substitute's approval list - 2282930 - Substitution Manager not Able to View tasks of Actual Manager Under My Managing Area -Category 4) Approval tasks are not forwarded because correct Organization Unit not assigned to the manager.-Resolution: -Related Case Documents:-          i.         1483361 - The task remains unassigned even though the manager is assigned to the employee responsible-         ii.         1414115 - The task is not visible to the manager of the organization unit.-Category 5) Business Task cannot be closed - Resolution: Forward the incident torelated CSSComponent(0001419507 - How to find CSS component for a task).- Related Case Documents:-   i.          1498398 Tasks cannot be deleted which do not require any action  Released For Customer-Category 6) Issue may occur due to some functional limitation and incident should be forwarded to that Application Area. - Resolution:  Please check the Business Document column and then forward the incident to that Application Area. For examples if Service Request forward the incident to Expert Support - Application – CRM queue.- Related Case Documents:-           i.          1472184 - Completed Service Request XYZ is appearing as Unassigned Item-Category 7) if issue does not fall in any above cases then forward the incident to ES Tech. - BTM-See Also-KBA 3288032 - Troubleshooting Wiki Links - Business Task Management(BTM)-Keywords-BTM tasks, unassigned Task, BTM Issues

Title: You Cannot Overwrite the Requested Date in a Sales Order Which is Partially Delivered
Content: Symptom-You cannot overwrite the requested date in a sales order which is partially delivered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and find sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select View All.-Select the Items tab.-Select the line item ABC (ABC represents the ID of the item).-Select the Details sub-tab.-Try to change the requested date to future.-The system does not allow changing of the requested date field.-Cause-Once a sales order item is in process, the corresponding customer demand is released for execution due to which all the logistics relevant fields in the sales order are no longer changeable. This means the fields are already not changeable before even a delivery exists.-After a partial shipment the only option is to cancel the remaining quantity and create a new order item for it specifying the new date.--Resolution-This is the expected system behavior and it is is working as designed.-See Also-Keywords-sales order, requested date, partially delivered, field, change requested date

Title: Cannot Make Outgoing Check Payment Due to Error Message: Payment method details are not determined
Content: Symptom-When you manually create an outgoing check to pay the partner company XYZ, the system gives you an error message: Payment method details are not determined. Address of payee/payer XYZ does not exist. (Here XYZ is the Business Partner ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the Supplier Accounts subview.-Choose Supplier XYZ, and then choose View.-Choose one Open Item, and then choose Pay Manually By.-You could only see Other Payment Methods from the drop-down list.-You then go to the Payment Management or Liquidity Management work center, and then choose New Outgoing Check under Common Tasks.-In the Payee field, select the supplier XYZ, and then press ENTER.-    The system gives error message: Payment method details are not determined. Address of payee/payer XYZ does not exist.-  Cause-This is an intercompany stock transfer scenario,when the customer invoice is posted, the supplier invoice is posted automatically in the receiving company and can be checked in the Supplier Invoicing work center, in the Invoices and Credit Memos view. The system sends the information to Financials, which you can see as journal entries in the General Ledger work center.-Now you are initiating manual outgoing payments for the buying company, one of the prerequisites in the master data settings is that you have to make a payment agreement between the buying company and the charge-to company. Because in the Financial Data of the company XYZ master data, you do not maintain the payment method for the buying company, which is the payment agreement mentioned earlier, so the system gives you an error message: Payment method details are not determined, and you cannot see any specific payment methods available while clicking Pay Manually By in Payables work center.-  Resolution-In order to fix the issue, follow the steps below:-Go to the Supplier Base work center, and choose the Suppliers view.-Select the supplier XYZ, and then choose Financial Data under Edit.-Go to the Payment Data tab.-Select the concerned buying company, and then choose Add Row under Payment Method.-Select Check, and Save it.-Now you should be able to select the option of Outgoing Check when you do the manual payment in Payables work center, meanwhile, you should not receive the same error message any more.-Keywords- Payment method details are not determined, Address of payee/payer

Title: Cannot Combine Invoice Requests to Create a Single Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Cannot combine invoice requests to create a single customer invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show All Documents.-Select invoice request ABC and DEF (ABC & DEF represents the ID of the outbound delivery for which invoice requests have been created).-Select the Follow-Up - Advance Creation button.-Enter the required details and Finish the creation of invoice.-Two separate invoices have created even though no split criteria is applicable for the invoice requests.-Cause-The reason for the invoice split is given by the extension field XYZ in the sales order. (XYZ represents the ID of the extnesion field)-The extension flow for this attribute is defined that the field is part of the customer invoice header. The extension field is not filled with different value in sales orders.-Resolution-You can follow the workaround below to avoid the split of the invoice:-Restrict the the extension field XYZ only to Sales Order and not define it for the Invoice.-Remove the extension field from the sales order screen and manually maintain the value in the Additional Information field of the sales order.--See Also-1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-2276079 - Invoice Split due to Different Value of Extension Fields on Invoice Requests-Keywords-invoice split; extension field; customer invoice; outbound delivery invoice request; merge invoice; consolidate invoice

Title: When you Cancel a Customer Invoice for a Contract the Invoice Request Shows the Status 'To be Invoiced'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created a Customer Invoice for a contract and later canceled it, when you search for the Invoice Request related to this Customer Invoice that was canceled the Status is showing as 'To be Invoiced'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Contracts view.-Select All Contracts and search for the ID THN (THN represents the Contract ID).-Click on Open and then on View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Select the Extended view.-The Customer Invoice ABC will have 'Release Canceled' status (ABC represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Invoice Requests view.-Search for the Invoice Request DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Invoice Request for Customer Invoice ABC).-The Invoice Request status is 'To Be Invoiced'.-Cause-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Contracts view.-Select All Contracts and search for the ID THN (THN represents the Contract ID).-Click on Open and then on View All.-Navigate to the Renewal and Cancellation sub tab in the General tab.-Scroll down until you see Cancelation information-In the Field Invoice Cancellation the option 'Keep Invoice Requests' is selected, and for this reason the Invoice Request will return to the status 'To Be Invoiced' if the Customer Invoice is canceled.-If you choose Keep Invoice Requests in the Invoice Cancellation field, the system will not cancel any Invoice Requests. If you choose Cancel Pending Invoice Requests, the system will cancel any Invoice Requests that are in Status To Be Invoiced.-Resolution-If the Cancellation Status of the Item in the Contract is Cancellation Requested and you do not wish the Invoice Request to have the 'To Be Invoiced Status' follow the steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Contracts view.-Select All Contracts and search for the ID THN (THN represents the Contract ID).-Click on Open and then on View All.-Navigate to the Renewal and Cancellation sub tab in the General tab.-Scroll down until you see Cancelation information.-In the Field 'Invoice Cancellation' change the option selected from 'Keep Invoice Requests' to 'Cancel Pending Invoice Requests'.-Once the Item in the Contract has the Status Cancelled, the Invoice Request will have the status Canceled.-If the Item is already cancelled you cannot change the 'Invoice Cancellation' from 'Keep Invoice Requests' to 'Cancel Pending Invoice Requests' anymore. -However, you can invoice it the Customer Contract Invoice Request with a 0 Amount if you do not wish to invoice the customer for the already fulfilled services.-Keywords-Invoice Cancellation, status, to be invoiced, request, contract invoice request.

Title: Item in Project Invoice Request Does Not Have Option To Credit
Content: Symptom-In newly created Project Invoice Request the user is unable to change the option from Debit to Credit in specific item. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Project Invoicing view.-Go to Sales Orders sub view. -Search for ID ABC (ABC is the Sales Order's ID). -Click in New button and select 'Automatic Project Invoice Request'. -Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Invoice Items subtab. -In the Proposed According to Sales Order Items section, we can see that there is a column 'Debit/Credit'. -The value Debit is grayed out. -So the user is unable to change the value from Debit to Credit. -Cause-There are two cases:-Invoicing Method is 'Fixed Price': the field 'Debit/Credit' is editable while the Project Invoice Request has 'In Preparation' status. -Invoicing Method is 'Time and Material': the field is not editable. -Resolution-The system is working as expected. -See Also-Help Portal: Create a Project Invoice Request for a Customer Project-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2d8fe148722d10148c6bd2771ea48a32.html?locale=en-US-Keywords-Project Invoice Request, Item, Debit, Credit, Invoicing Method, Fixed Price, Project

Title: PSM Release for RateTypeCode in Sales Order Business Object
Content: Symptom-You want to have a write access to the RateTypeCode of a specific Sales Order. You wonder if it is PSM released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The field Tax Rate Type is read-only and has not had it's write access publicly released. Title: How Contract Works with Different Item Types
Content: Symptom-You can create and manage contracts related to materials and services.-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how contract works with different Item Types in SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-This Knowledge Base Article will explain how the following scenarios work with different Item Types.-Scenario 1: Create a Contract-On the General tab, Main Information enter relevant contract information: For contracts with item type Material, the Service Level field will be disabled.-On the Items tab, enter the product that you are selling. This can be a Material, a Service, an Expense, or an Entitlement.-The Price per Period indicator can only be activated for the following item types. The field Price per Period can be activated in combination with an invoice schedule that was created for an item. This invoice schedule has to have the Schedule Type Period fixed price for a service which has a quantity unit which describes time (e.g. hours, working days etc.).-Service - fixed price-Service - fixed price without actuals-Expense - fixed price without actuals-Entitlement - fixed price-Entitlement - fixed price without actuals-On the Entitled Products tab, list the products or product categories contained in the entitlement item and to which the account is privileged. This tab is only active for Entitlements; not for materials, services, or expenses. -An Entitlement product is one type of product that can be sold in the contract. Entitled products are a list of products that break down, or detail, the entitlement product.-On the Price Agreements tab, you review and maintain contract specific list prices, and discounts for materials and services. This tab is active only for Time and Material items. It is not displayed for fixed-price items.-When maintaining price agreements in a contract item with the invoicing method Time and Material, the system proposes a list price automatically when you click Add Row. The system proposes list prices as follows:-For items of type Entitlement – Time and Material, the system proposes the list price of the corresponding service or expense.-For items of types Service – Time and Material and Expense – Time and Material, the system proposes the list price of the item.-For items of types Material – Product – contract, the system proposes the list price of the corresponding materials.-On the Covered Products tab, enter the products secured by the contract. For contracts with item type Material – Product – contract, the system does not allow you to enter any information under the Covered Products tab.-Scenario 2: Determine Contracts in a Service Request-When an account requires support and a service request is created, the system checks if the affected product in the service request is covered under contract.-Scenario 3: Create a Service Confirmation-You can process contract items with standard service confirmation functions if you are working with confirmation-relevant service, expense, or entitlement items sold on a time and material or fixed price basis.-Note: Entitlement - fixed price w/o actuals is not confirmation relevant, no confirmation will be created for this item type.-Scenario 4: Invoice a Contract-There are several ways to invoice contract items:-Create an invoice request for Fixed-Price items that will then be the basis for a one-time invoice-Choose the Invoice Requests view>Select an invoice request>Click Invoice or Invoice — Advanced>At the top of the new invoice click Release to release the new invoice.-Fixed-Price items, and Time and Material based items, with invoice schedule using an invoicing time frame-On the Pricing and Invoicing tab, you can create an invoice schedule. For contracts with item type Material – Product- contract, you cannot create invoice schedules.-Under Pricing and Invoicing choose Invoice Schedule > Click Edit Invoicing Time Frame. Now you can edit a new time frame or view an existing time frame with a monthly recurrence pattern for the actual year, for example. > Select the Applied check box to assign the selected invoicing time frame to the item.> Click OK button. The system creates monthly invoice dates for the applied items.-For Fixed-Price items, the system creates a scheduled invoice request automatically three days before the invoice schedule date is reached. You can trigger this invoice request manually if you do not want to wait for the next job run.The system creates service confirmation invoice requests for Time and Material items.-Revoke Invoicing of Customer Contract Items.-You can revoke invoicing of items in a contract, by selecting an item in Items and clicking Revoke > Invoicing. -You can revoke invoicing of an item, if it meets all the below criteria:-Item type as fixed price, fixed price without actuals or expense fixed price without actuals-Invoicing status as Finished-Associated with invoice schedule-Please Note: A Scheduled Invoice Request for an Item in a Contract with an Invoice Schedule will only be created if the respective Item has been released.-Scenario 5: Create a Follow up Sales Order from Contract-Currently a sales order with reference to a contract for service items is not supported. If you click Follow-Up > Sales Order to create a sales order with reference to a contract for Service items, the system will display the warning message "Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - Fixed Price to Service - fixed price missing".-Scenario 6: Complete a Contract-For Items to be in status Complete the following 3 criteria have to be met:-Invoice Status has to be completed,-Item has to be expired,-Service has to be fulfilled.-        In general, for Services, the fulfillment must always be finished in the Contract.-Unlike sales orders, there is no contract pipeline from which you can confirm service execution and you can create a service confirmation only directly from the contract.-For confirmations created based on contracts, releasing items with or without completion is not possible as in standard service confirmations. There is only an implicit release without completion.-For Services which do not require a Service Confirmation such as the item Type SEFL (SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals) the service execution needs to always be done in the respective document (Sales Order and Contract). Therefore, you must finish the fulfillment in the contract itself.-For the item type ETCS (Entitlement - contract sale), this is used for selling contracts in sales orders via entitlements. When you enter an entitlement with this item group in the sales order, a related contract template is determined and a contract automatically created when you release the sales order. The contract created is in status In Preparation. Only once the contract is released the Fulfillment Status in the sales order will change to Finished.-Scenario 7: Extension Scenario-The Extension Scenario to pass on the extension field from a Material to a contract line item is currently not available. This Extension Scenario is currently only available for Services and Entitlements. Here you need to activate the following Extension Scenarios:-Service - General Information to Customer Contract – Item-Entitlement - General Information to Customer Contract – Item-For Materials to Contract there are currently only the following extension scenarios available:-Material - General Information to Customer Contract - Covered Product：-The extension field will be passed on to the Contract in the Covered Products tab.-You can add the extension field to the section Covered Products.-Material - General Information to Customer Contract - Item Entitled Product-The extension field will be passed on to the Contract in the Items tab and the Entitled Products sub tab.-When you add an Entitlement to a contract you will get the sub tab Entitled Products.-You can add the extension field in this sub tab.- See Also-Keywords-contract, different item types, material, service, expense, entitlement, item, item type, fixed price without actuals, fixed price, time and material, product, service confirmation, service request

Title: Org Units Are not Available When Trying to Assign an Org Unit for a Master Template Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You noticed that the Org Units that are not marked as a Company in the Organizational Management work center are not appearing in the Master Template Maintenance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management  and then Master Template Maintenance view.-Select the Form Master Template.-Click Assign.-Click Add Row.-Click the Value Help for the field Company/Org Unit.-System shows only the Org Units that are marked as Company.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. Currenlty, the system only shows the Org Units that are marked as Company in the Master Template Maintainance.-See Also-Master Template Maintenance Quick Guide-Keywords-Application and User Management, Master Template Maintenance, Form Master Template, Assign, Add Row, Company/Org Unit, Missing, Not Available, Unable to, Not Able, Assign an Org Unit.

Title: Error message "Error in Confirmation creation: Individual material does not exist" displayed for the Goods And Service Receipt Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reported that a Process Communication Error "Error in Confirmation creation: Individual material  does not exist" is being displayed in the Goods And Service Receipt XYZ (XYZ represents the Goods And Service Confirmation ID). Furthermore, this error message is also preventing the Service Confirmation document from being generated in the system. -Note: All documents were generated from a Service Order with a Third Party scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders Work Center.-Go to the Service Orders View.-Filter for all Service Orders.-In the search field, search for the Service Order ABC (ABC represents the Service Order ID).-Open and select View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Select the Anchor Icon in the Purchase Order EFG (EFG represents the Service Order ID).-The Process Communication Error is displayed in the Goods and Service Receipt.-Backend:-Sender Party: GoodsAndServiceAcknowledgement-Receiver Interface: ServiceConfirmationProcessingServiceConfirmationIn-Error Information: Error in Confirmation creation: Individual material  does not exist-Cause-The Registered Product ID in the Service Order ABC maintained as the Affected Product does match the Affected Product maintained in the Items tab of the Purchase Order EFG .-This mismatch between the Registered Product ID in the Service Order and Purchase Order generates a failed XI message in the backend, which prevents the creation of the Service Confirmation document in the UI. -Resolution-Customer needs to update the affected Product ID in the Service Order ABC according to the one displayed in the Items tab of the Purchase Order EFG.-Go to the Service Order Work Center.-Go to the Service Order View.-In the search field, search for the Service Order ID ABC.-Navigate to the General tab.-Select the Account and Affected Product sub tab.-In the Affected Products section, Click in the value box.-Select the Product with ID/Serial Number according to the one displayed in the Purchase Order.-Select Save button.-After this process is performed, it will be possible to restart the failed XI message in the backend.-Keywords-service confirmation, error in confirmation creation, individual material, not exit, does not exist, goods and service receipt , service order, third party

Title: Missing Sales Quote in Sales Quote Funnel (CRMQUFU) Data Source
Content: Symptom-You notice that there is one or more missing Sales Quotes in the Sales Quote Funnel (CRMQUFU) Data Source preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Workcenter.-Go to Design Data Sources view.-Search for the Data Source 'Sales Quote Funnel'.-Click on Preview.-When checking the available results, you notice that one or more Sales Quotes are not displayed in the preview.-Cause-One of the possible reasons for this is because the Sales Quote Funnel (CRMQUFU) Data Source will not fetch data on empty Sales Quotes. So if the Sales Quote has no items, it will not be displayed.-Similarly, the Sales Quote Funnel (CRMQUFU) Data Source will not fetch data when the Sales Quote has all items marked as 'Optional'.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Report, Data Source, CRMQUFU, Missing, Data, Unable, Find, Empty

Title: How to View Changes History of Price Lists
Content: Symptom-You want to know the changes performed in Sales Price List.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Price Lists view.-Show: choose relevant Price list-Open the Price List.-No Changes tab / Changes history is available.-Cause-The reason why changes history or tab has not been implemented is due to performance issues. Having a change history for price or discount lists would mean that every single change for an item would be recorded and since price and discount lists usually have a large number of items this would lead to a huge data volume.-Resolution-There is no change history details available for Price or Discount Lists. This is expected system standard behavior.-Keywords-Price Lists; Discount Lists; Changes; Performance Issue, Change log

Title: 'Delete not permitted; confirmations already exist for input product ABC' Error While Removing Input Product From An Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Symptom-Errors are displayed while trying to remove Input Product ABC from Create Adjustment Confirmation for Production Lot AAA:-'Confirmation creation failed'-'Delete not permitted; confirmations already exist for input product ABC'-ABC means the Input Product ID.-AAA means the Production Lot ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Production Lots view.-Find and open production lot ID AAA.-Click View All.-Click Adjustment Confirmation.-Select the row of respective Task ID.-Select the Input Products tab.-Click Enable Entry.-Click Remove-Errors are thrown:-'Confirmation creation failed'-'Delete not permitted; confirmations already exist for input product ABC'-Cause-An input product for which a confirmation ID already exist cannot be deleted, even though the reversal confirmation (Confirmation Type: Reversal) is already done.-Resolution-The system behaves as designed.-See Also-Help Document:-Quick Guide for Monitoring (in Production Control) -> Tasks -> Create an Adjustment Confirmation-Keywords-production lot; input product; enable entry; remove; adjustment confirmation; task; confirmation

Title: Tax Amount Displyed Incorrectly for Line items When Using Switzerland Tax Rate in a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When using Switzerland Tax Rate and changing the Tax Date of a line item in a Sales Order to 01.01.2024, the tax amount is displayed incorrectly in the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Select the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-In the search field, search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Click Open and select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Mark the Line Item XY (XY represents the Line Item number).-Select the Taxes sub tab.-In the field Tax Date, enter 01.01.2024.-Select Save.-The tax rate change from 7.7% to 8.1%, however the tax amount displayed is wrong.-Cause-The system does not allow different Tax Rates for the same Tax Rate Type. The Tax Rate is determined based on the Tax Date.-From 01.01.2024 the Switzerland Tax Rate for Tax Rate Type Standard will change from 7.7% to 8.1%.-Therefore if Switzerland is maintained as the Tax Country for the Line items in a Sales Order, it will not possible to maintain items with a Tax Date on or after the 01.01.2024 if items with a Tax Date before the 01.01.2024 already exists in the Sales Order, this occurs because the Tax Rate for some of the Line Items will be displayed as 7.7% and others as 8.1%.-This discrepancy in the Tax Rate of the Line Items will cause the document to become inconsistent.-Resolution-Therefore, in case the Tax Date of all line items in the Sales Order ABC requires to be changed to 01.01.2024, then following are the steps required to be performed:-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Filter for All Orders.-In the search field, Search for the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Mark the Line Item XY (XY represents the Line Item number).-Select the Taxes sub tab.-In the field Tax Date, enter 01.01.2024.-Repeat for all line items.-Navigate to Pricing and Invoice tab.-Select Update Pricing -> Keep Manual Changes.-Select Save.-After this process is performed the Tax Amount and Tax Rate will be displayed correctly for all line items.-However, in case not all line items maintained in the Sales Order ABC are required to be maintained with the tax date as 01.01.2024, then a new Sales Order will have to be created for these line items, as the Tax Rate Type cannot differ for the line items in the Sales Order.-See Also-2578729 - New Tax Rate Schedules for Switzerland Valid From dd.mm.yyyy-Keywords-tax date, tax rate, switzerland tax rate, sales order, tax amount

Title: How to clear Process Communication Errors from backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer has Process Communication Errors which were already handled but are still showing in the UI, so they want these PCEs to be cleared.-You have tried to restart the messages in backend but it did not clear them from UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go Process Communication Errors view.-Change filter to Open Errors With Incidents.-Execute query.-You will see the Process Communication Errors.-Resolution-*You need customer's authorization to cancel the PCEs from backend.-Login to backend.-Go to SESFTS.-Enter BO Name: SPAF_TECHNICAL_ERROR_BO-Click Load By Query.-Select ROOT - Query_by_elements.-A "Set Query Options" pop-up will show.-For ErrorResolutionStrategyCode maintain "6".-Execute query.-Select all root instances that appear.-Navigate to subnode MESSAGE_ATTRIBUTES.-Click on the Table View icon.-In case you have a lot of results here, you will need to scroll through all the messages so they can be properly loaded. DO NOT use your mouse/touchpad, scroll using the Page Down (PgDn) key.-Find the column "MESSAGE_UUID-CONTENT".-Click the column name, so it will select all records.-Copy it.-Now go to transaction SRT_MONI.-Click the Multiple Selection option in the Message IDs field.-Paste all the IDs copied from SESFTS.-Execute.-Compare with the errors in UI.-Select all relevant records.-Click on Action button.-Click Cancel.-Once cancelling the messages from SRT_MONI, they might take up to 42 days to be cleared from UI.-Keywords-process communication errors not cleared, not cleared, pces, instance with the same key, already exists

Title: IP range mentioned in the Next Generation Blog SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The IT department does not want to whitelist the full AWS IP range mentioned in the blog Next Generation-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-not applicable-Cause-not applicable-Resolution-Without using DMARC you need to whitelist the IP Range mentioned in the blog.-If DMARC is used and the policy is set to at least "quarantine" or better "reject", then you don't need to whitelist the AWS IP range if the email receiver is using the authentication mechanisms supported by DMARC.-See Also-Keywords- IP Range, DMARC

Title: Alternative Approver for Supplier invoice does not Receive Approval Tasks
Content: Symptom-Approval task is not visible for alternative approver of supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create, for example, a Supplier Invoice.-Submit for approval.-Log on as the alternative user.-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-The task regarding the created supplier invoice is not here.-Also the alternative user was correctly maintained:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Employee Work Distribution view.-Select 'Alternative Approver for Supplier Invoices'.-Click in Edit button.-You can see that the rules apply for the Supplier Invoice created.-Cause-The Approval Process is configured directly to 'Direct Approvers'. For this configuration, the Employee Responsible in the approval process is the one that will receive the approval tasks. You can check it by following the steps below:-First, analyze who is the person responsible for the approval task:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Search for the approval task.-See who is the Person Responsible.-Second, check which is the user maintained in the approval process:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view.-Select the approval process regarding Supplier Invoices.-Click in View button.-You can see that the information is shown as below:-Work Distribution: Direct Approvers-Employee Responsible: (The same user that is in the approval task)-Resolution-If you need that the approval tasks are sent to the alternative user, you should update the approval process. Please change the Work Distribution from 'Direct Approvers' to 'Supplier Invoice Approver'.-Also: remember that if it is maintained the multi-step approvals functionality, the alternative approver won't receive the tasks, as explained in KBA: 1788952 - Alternative Approver for Purchase Orders does not Receive Approval Tasks.-See Also-KBA: 1788952 - Alternative Approver for Purchase Orders does not Receive Approval Tasks-Keywords-Alternative Approver, Approval Process, Task, Business Task Management, Supplier Invoice

Title: Print and save to file in combination with a csv attachment using the Cloud Print Manager
Content: Symptom- While using the SAP Cloud Print Manager, you want to print and also save the PDF including csv files on a drive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-It is not possible to print csv files by now, therefore you can print and save to file (including attachments in the csv format) only PDF, docx, xslx, ppt and text file extensions.-Resolution-Use one of the mentioned file extensions by now.-We are reviewing the functionality to allow at least the save to file function.-Printing of csv file extensions will not be permitted, this would not change.-See Also-Keywords-CSV, save to file, Cloud Print Manager, attachments, include to output, printing.

Title: How to get Network Trace and Console Logs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--In case of random exceptions, support might request for console logs from chrome browser for further analysis.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Turn-Off compression:-Goto system backend.-Goto SE16.-Select table APUI_KEY_VAL.-Click on Create button-Give below details and save the entry.-GUID- 00163E0E06601EE8BBAA572369632012(Some Random 32bit char)-UserName – COMPANY-Key Name  - /XTS/COMPRESSION-Key Value  – OFF-ROLE UUID –leave it as it is.-Steps to take trace:-Logon to system in Chrome.-Click on Settings -> More Tools.-And then Developer Tools.-Or-In Keyboard, click on Fn + F12.-This will launch developer tool.-Dock to separate window.-Then Navigate to Console.-Clear off old logs.-Click on Network tab.-Network Trace:-Navigate to screens and perform normal Business activities.-Once dump is noticed, Navigate back to network trace.-Click on any JSON request and right click.-Click on Select all as HAR with content.-Console Logs:-Then Navigate to console tab.-Right click and click on Save as.-Save file with .log extension.- Note: Once network trace and console logs are received, Turn-on the compression.-Goto system backend.-Goto SE16.-Select table APUI_KEY_VAL.-Select entry which was created click on Edit.-GUID- 00163E0E06601EE8BBAA572369632012 (Some random 32bit char)-UserName – COMPANY-Key Name  - /XTS/COMPRESSION-Key Value  – ON-ROLE UUID –leave it as it is.-Save.-Keywords-Console logs, Console, Chrome, Developer tools

Title: Supplier Invoice and Purchase Order Error: 'Company XYZ not registered in country United States, define relevant Tax Number Type'
Content: Symptom-The following warning message is shown on Supplier Invoice XXX when you perform check on Supplier Invoice or a Purchase Order:-'Company XYZ not registered in country United States, define relevant Tax Number Type.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work center.-Go to Invoice and Credit Memos view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find Invoice XXX.-Choose Check.-The warning message 'Company XYZ not registered in country United States, define relevant Tax Number Type.' is displayed.-Follow similar steps to check a Purchase Order in work center Purchase Requests and Orders.-Cause-For instance, Tax Number Type 4 - State Sales and Use Tax Registration Number are not maintained in Tax Authority.-The same error is raised for other Tax registration numbers missing.-Resolution-You can maintain Tax Number Type 4 - State Sales and Use Tax Registration Number by following the below steps:-Go to Tax Management Work center.-Go to Tax Authorities view and go to Tax Authorities sub view.-Show All Tax Authorities and Find the corresponding Tax Authority ID.-Go to Edit and Go to Company Tax Arrangements.-Choose the Company and Go to Tax Numbers tab.-You can maintain the Tax Number Type as 4 - State Sales and Use Tax Registration Number and the Tax Number or any other missing tax number.-Once this Tax Number Type is maintained, the warning message is not raised.-Keywords-tax number, registration, tax authorities, missing, company, supplier invoice, purchase order

Title: Convert Binary to String
Content: Symptom-You are using a method which returns a binary value as result and you want to convert this value to string.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-You are using a library method to return some values.-E.g: You are using the method EncryptWithHashBasedMessageAuthenticationCode of the library WebServiceUtilities to return values. You need a String as result but this method returns only binary values.--Example:-The binary value contains 164E920F43E495FC62BA3545AE83FBC2D8721FA38170B94CBC694AD9D0999F60--var str = Binary.ToString();-Result: str = "<data><simple><type>String</type><value>"�N��C���b�5E�����r���p�L�iJ�Й�`"</value></simple></data>"--The value in str should be 164E920F43E495FC62BA3545AE83FBC2D8721FA38170B94CBC694AD9D0999F60 of type string.-Cause-Resolution-You can use a variable with data type LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text. In this case you can directly assign the value of your token to the variable, without having to use ToString() function.-The variable with this data type will storage the string representation of the binary hexadecimal value.-You can use this string representation as parameter for the method EncryptWithHashBasedMessageAuthenticationCode.-See Also-Keywords-Binary; ToString; String; Token; method; PDI; SDK

Title: The Function Assign Reference for Returns on Item Level Does not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-The function assign reference for returns on item level does not work as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-Go to the Items tab and select the Assign Reference button.-You assign reference Sales Order ABC(ABC is id of the sales order).-You get an error message: Sales Order reference with ABC-XX not valid(ABC is the id of the sales order and XX is the line number of the product which you have as assigned reference).-Cause-This is the expected behavior, you can only assign a valid reference that is a sales order order with same product, otherwise the reference would not be valid.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business byDesign. If you want assign reference to any other sales order then you need the select the check box External Indicator in the Assign Reference tab of the Item for which you want to assign reference. After this you will be able to assign reference to any sales order in the system.-See Also-KBA 0003401203- In Customer Return Assign Reference at Item Level Does Not Work As Expected-Keywords-Customer Return; Assign Reference; Sales Order; Item; Error Message

Title: Error Message: Second Acct Det.Group for Expense Type XYZ not Permitted
Content: Symptom-When trying to change payment/taxation to Reimbursement Amount(Payment, No Taxation) from drop down, system displays the below message:-Second acct det.group for expense type XYZ not permitted.(where XYZ refers to expense type)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity List and go to Fine Tuning tab.-Show All Activities and find Expense Reporting – AA.(where AA refers to Country)-Click on Expense Reporting – AA.-Click on Edit Receipt Types.-For any available receipt types change the Payment/Taxation to Reimbursement Amount(Payment, No Taxation).-Click on Save.-System displays the error message Second acct det.group for expense type XYZ not permitted.-  Cause-This is because Offsetting Account For Paid Receipts was maintained under Account Determination tab.-Resolution-For any available receipt types under activity Expense Reporting – AA, when Payment/Taxation is changed to Reimbursement Amount(Payment, No Taxation) then Offsetting Account For Paid Receipts under Account Determination tab need not be maintained.-Follow the below steps to set Offsetting Account For Paid Receipts blank.-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view-Click on Open Activity List.-Click on Fine Tuning tab.-Show All Activities and Find Expense Reporting – AA.-Click on Expense Reporting – AA.-Click on Edit Receipt Types.-For any available receipt types change the Payment/Taxation to Reimbursement Amount(Payment, No Taxation).-Go to Account Determination tab and leave the field Offsetting Account For Paid Receipts blank and click on Save.-See Also-Keywords-Expense type, Account determination group

Title: You Get the Incorrect Exchange Rate in Invoice Volume Report
Content: Symptom-The exchange rate in the Invoice Volume Report is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Reports view.-Find the Invoice Volume Report.-Open the report in web browser.-Select the account ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Select the Go button.-Select the Invoice field from Not currently Shown option, move it to Rows.-You will see that XYZ shows the Invoiced Net value as XXX (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice and XXX is the net value amount of invoice in the report).-However if you see the Journal Entry in the financials General Ledger work center for the same invoice, the Net value of the invoice is YYY (YYY is the net value amount of invoice in Journal Entry).-Cause-You have changed the concerned currencies after the creation of the invoice, which caused the difference in the Net Value in the Journal Entry and the Invoice Volume Report.-You can view the changes done in the exchange rate by following below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Edit Exchange Rates under Common Tasks.-Select the relevant exchange rate line and choose the View Exchange Rate History button.-In the next screen you can view the changes made to the exchange rate.-The exchange rate for the invoice date/posing date (depending on your Business Configuration) needs to be active. E.g. if the invoice date/posting date is in the past there needs to be a valid currency exchange rate for this particular date when the exchange rate is calculated.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.-Additional remarks concerning the Display Currency Date:-For reporting the invoice data is consolidated, i.e. all amounts are converted to the company currency with exchange rate valid at the invoice date/posting date.-The company currency is the default display currency used in the invoice volume report.-Changing the Display Currency Date makes only sense with changing the Display Currency as well. In case both are changed, the date is used to determine the exchange rate and this exchange rate will be used in the conversion from the company currency into the new display currency.-Changing only the Display Currency Date will not change the already into the Company Currency converted amounts.-See Also-KBA 2393488 - Invoice Total is Invoice Volume Report is Different Than Journal Entry-Keywords-Exchange Rate; Valid; Validity; Invoice Date; Posting Date;

Title: Unable to do Reverse/Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You want to reverse a warehouse confirmation, but Reverse Confirmation button is disabled. So you tried to do Adjustment Confirmation, but Enable Entry button is also disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Monitoring-->Warehouse Order view.-Search for the relevant warehouse order.-Select the warehouse order and choose Edit button.-Go to the Confirmation tab. Here you can see that the Reverse Confirmation button is disabled.-Then choose Adjustment Confirmation button. Here, Enable Entry button is disabled even though the corresponding outbound delivery is in Not Released status.-Cause-The status of the warehouse order is Finished. It is not possible to do Reverse Confirmation, if the warehouse order is Finished.-But, for a Finished warehouse order, you can post Adjustment Confirmation, if the corresponding outbound delivery is in Not Released status. In this case, both the criteria are met but Enable Entry is still disabled because you have canceled the outbound delivery itself. So no further adjustment confirmation is possible on this warehouse order.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Note: Though this Knowledge Base Article has been explained for outbound delivery processing, it is also valid for inbound delivery processing.-Keywords-Reverse Confirmation, Warehouse Confirmation, Adjustment Confirmation, Enable Entry, Warehouse Order.

Title: Error "Sales kit integrity violated for item XX; sales kit information missing" In Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-In the Document Flow of a Sales Order, you see a Generic Process Communication Error between Sales Order and Customer Demand.-Checking further in the Process Communication Errors view of Application and User Management, you find the following error message:-"Sales kit integrity violated for item XX; sales kit information missing" (Where XX Represents the line item number in the document).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Sales Order ID).-Click on Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-You will see a Process Communication Error between Sales Order and Customer Demand.- Then, we can check the error text in Application and User Management:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Process Communication Errors view.-Show Errors with Incidents.-Find the error where the Sending Document is Sales Order ABC.-The error displayed is "Sales kit integrity violated for item XX; sales kit information missing".-Note: The error message can also be displayed as "Sales kit integrity violated for item XX; base quantity not consistent" (Where XX Represents the line item number in the document).-Cause-This error is a known issue in ByDesign. The development team is aware of and it has been added to their backlog.-Resolution-Open the Backend.-Go to transaction SRT_MONI.-Choose a timeframe which coincides with the error timestamp in Application and User Management.-Check for messages related to Sales Order ABC.-Restart the XI Message.-If restart does not go through, the message needs to be reconciled.-Check if the new message was created after reconciliation and then cancel the old failing message if it is still failing.-See Also- The failing XI Message will have the following attributes:-Sender: SalesOrderProcessing- Receiver: CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn- Error: Sales kit integrity violated for item XX; sales kit information missing-Keywords-PCO; Sales Order; Process Communication Error; Stuck; Red; XI Message; Backend; SESFTS; Inconsistent; sales kit information missing; sales kit integrity violated for item, sales kit, base quantity not consistent

Title: In an Intercompany Scenario the Sales Order Item Has the Item Type as 'Text'
Content: Symptom-Sales Order is showing Item Type as "Text" while you expect it should be one of the available options in the Item Type dropdown list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Order view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the document ID).-Open and click View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Item.-In the Item Type field the value shown is 'Text' instead of having the drop down option to choose the Item Type. -You may see the error messages in the document:-Organizational data missing-Party with role Sales Unit missing (KBA: 3215948)-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again (KBA: 2744399)-Item : Distribution channel or sales organization missing (KBA: 3215892)-Item : Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.-Cause-In the Sales Order General tab under Organizational Assignment Sales Unit and Sales Organization are not determined, so the Item is created with the Item Type as Text.-Since the Sales Organization is not determined the correct Item Type cannot be derived from the Service Master Data. -Resolution-To make the Item Type field consistent the master data necessary for the system to show the correct scenario, in this case sales unit and Sales Organization, must be maintained.-Keywords-item type, field, Text, intercompany, sales unit, sales organization

Title: Error Message: 'Determination of profit center from Sales Unit XYZ failed'
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales document (like sales order, customer invoice, customer contract, …) with XYZ (XYZ represents the sales document) as a Sales Unit and get the following error in the Unposted Business Transactions:-'Determination of profit center from Sales Unit XYZ on DD.MM.YYYY  failed.'-'The posting date specified in the sales document is not within the validity range of the sales unit.'-'The validity range can be seen on tabstrip 'Timelines' under 'Functions > Sales' in the Organizational Management Work center.'-'If the posting date was specified correctly in the sales document, adjust the validity range of the sales unit accordingly. Then complete and post the business transaction.'-Otherwise, correct the posting date in the sales document. Note that the posting date is often specified on item level of the sales document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Step 1: Creation of sales document with XYZ as a Sales Unit with Posting Date as DD.MM.YYYY.-Step 2: Steps to view the error description in Unposted Business Transactions.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Source Documents subview under Closing Cockpit view-Select the row which has the affected sales document and select View Business Transaction.-Cause-In the sales document you have specified Sales Unit XYZ and posting date DD.MM.YYYY. (Note that the posting date can often be specified on item level of the sales document.)
