However, for DD.MM.YYYY, the sales unit is not valid.-Resolution-If the posting date in the sales document or sales document item was specified incorrectly, adjust it to the correct date.-Otherwise, enhance the validity of the sales unit in organizational management. The validity can be found on tabstrip ‘Timelines’ under ‘Functions > Sales’. For the organizational structure, certain validations will be performed. For example: Every sales unit must be assigned to a profit center. This means that either the sales unit itself is defined as a profit center or an organizational unit above the sales unit. After you have adjusted the organizational structure, so that all validations are successful, you can activate your changes.-See Also-Keywords-Profit Center, failed, Determination, Customer Invoice, Sales Order, Customer Contract.

Title: The Error Message "Corrupt Template; contact your administrator" is Displayed When Trying to Upload an Excel Template to Create a Sales Order Document
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a field from the XML in the Sales Order Microsoft Excel template and uploading the file in the system, the error message "Corrupt Template; contact your administrator" is displayed in the screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Oder work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Select New button.-In the dropdown, Select Sales Order from Excel.-Open the Excel Template.-Click with the Right button on any of the fields from the Template.-Select XML option.-Select XML Source option.-Drag any field from the XML and Drop in the Excel template.-Fill all the mandatory field of the template.-Select Save data as button.-The error "Corrupt template - contact system admin" is displayed in the screen.-Cause-The Sales Order Excel template does not allow the addition of any XML fields in order to create Sales Order Documents.-Therefore, when a Sales Order Excel template is uploaded in the system with an XML field customized in the template, the error message "Corrupt Template; contact your administrator" is triggered.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior.-In case you would like have more options regarding the possible information to be maintained in each field for the creation of the Sales Order Document in the system, we kindly recommend to use the Migration Tool for the creation of Sales Order documents.-See Also-3048070 - Error Message: 'Exception occurred. Contact your system administrator' when trying to Save the Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Template.-Keywords-sales order, template, excel, upload, corrupt template, contact your administrator, xml field, xml, create, customization, modification

Title: Error: Check for Current Merge of Another Project During Merge of a Change Project
Content: Symptom-Error Message: Check for current merge of another project in the merge report of a change project.-Details :-Another merge in process.-Technical Details :-RTLC state on product tenant not finalize, project (XYZ)-Change Project <Workspace ID>(XYZ) with owner <User-ID> is merged but not activated-Please activate change project <Workspace ID>(XYZ) first then try again-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the concerned project.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Go-Live tab.-Select and Confirm the Merge Changes to Production System activity.-The issue is also faced while simulating the merge of the project.-Cause-The cause is that the Change Project XYZ, is merged with production, but not yet activated.-Resolution-To resolve the issue and proceed with merge perform the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project XYZ.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Integrate and Extend chevron.-Select and Open the 'Activate Solution Capabilities' activity.-Select the Confirm button.-Once the project XYZ has been activated, the merge of the new project should go through without any issues.-See Also-Keywords-Merge Fail , Activate Solution Capabilities, Please activate change project XYZ first then try again

Title: Error Message: 'Profit Center ABC not Found on MM-DD-YYYY'
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error message while posting a Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.-'Profit center ABC not found on MM-DD-YYYY'-(ABC represents the Profit Center ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Go to Recurring Journal Entry Vouchers subview.-Click New -> Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter all required parameters and choose Post.-You get an error message: 'Profit Center ABC not Found on MM-DD-YYYY'-Cause-The validity of the profit center is not viable as of today and ended before the posting date of Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.-You can check it on the Organizational Structure:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Organizational Structure view.-Find the Profit Center ABC.-Go to tab Timelines.-Check attribute Profit Center.-You will see the valid to date is not valid on the moment that Recurring Journal Entry Voucher was posted.-Resolution-In order to adjust the validity of the Profit Center, please follow below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Organizational Structures view.-Click Find, search for Profit Center ABC and click Locate.-Click Edit.-Go to Timelines tab.-Here adjust the valid to date accordingly. It is necessary that profit center is valid on the day to post Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.-After updating the date, ensure that ‘Active’ is selected for the structure, then save and close. This will update the date correctly.-If you do not intend to use profit center ABC and therefore do not wish to extend its validity, you must assign an alternative profit center to the Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.- Keywords-Profit Center, Not found, Journal Entries, Recurring Journal Entry Voucher.

Title: Description of List Price Line is Incorrect in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In the Pricing and Invoicing tab of a Sales Order or Sales Quote, the description shows an unexpected text value in the List Price line. This also applies to other Sales Documents such as Sales Quotes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use Sales Orders as an example: -Got to the Sales Order workcenter.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Show all orders and in the Find field search for Sales Order XXX (XXX represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click View All and navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select line item YYY (YYY represents the line ID of the relevant line item) and click on Expand.-In the List Price line, you see an unexpected text value.-Cause-The description for the List price line is derived from the description maintained for the price list which is based on the pricing details of the line item. When hovering over the description value, the system displays the underlying price list.-Go to Product and Services Work centre.-Go to the Price Lists View.-Show relevant price list type and search in the list for price list ABC (ABC represents the ID of the price list).-Select the price list and below the table you see the description which is maintained for the price list.-If there is no description maintained, the system will automatically show List Price in the description field. -Note: The Description maintained in the Price List is carried over to the form template aswell in the respective language when the List Price for the respective Product is derived from the Price List..-Resolution-Maintain a valid description for the Price List if you want this description to be displayed in your Sales Documents.-Note: The description for the price list is language specific. A description maintained when logged on in, say German,  is only valid and displayed when a business user is logged into the system in German.-See Also-Keywords-Form Template; List price; Listenpreis, Price List, Template, Description, Language

Title: Configure Tax Event / Tax Code Determination for Special Use Cases
Content: Symptom-How to Configure External Tax Event / Tax Code Determination for special use cases such e.g. a 3rd party drop-shipment process or any other special use case, which are not covered fully by the standard tax determination.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-2. Click on New > Sales Orders.-3. Complete the necessary information.-4. Go to the Items tab > Taxes Sub-Tab.-You see that system has automatically completed the Tax Determination yielding an incorrect country as tax country and an incorrect tax code, e.g. erroneously returning the country of the ship-from party as tax country in a customer invoice in an international 3rd party drop-shipment scenario when the country of the contract-from party would be required to be determined as tax country.-PS: This functionality is also relevant to all other types of documents and processes where taxes are to be determined, such as Purchase Orders.-Cause-Automatic tax determination in SAP Business ByDesign for an operational document, e.g. a Sales Order, is based on the following guiding principles:-A tax event is determined for each country where business partners involved in the operational document are located, according to their specific roles described below. For a 3rd party drop-shipment process this could result in multiple country tax determinations getting executed for each operational document.-The relevant roles of the business partners involved are:-The contract-from (CF) party – in our example of a sales order the legal seller.-The contract-to (CT) party – the legal buyer.-The ship-from (SF) party – e.g. in a 3rd party drop shipment process, this could be a 3rd party with a warehouse anywhere in the world.-The ship-to (ST) party – the receiver of the goods which can be the buyer party but also any other party.-Specifically for services: the service location (SL) – the place and party where a service is provided.-Tax event determination is executed by comparing specific parameters of the operational document with a country-specific parameter set that is available either in the form of tax decision trees (offered by SAP or created by PDI) or may be configured using the external tax event determination. Depending on the parameter match the relevant tax event for the country is returned.-If the external tax event determination functionality is scoped and a valid result is obtained, then this tax event is propagated for further processing.-If external tax event determination functionality is either not scoped or does not return a valid result, the standard determination via tax decision trees is executed, thus it is ensured that a final and valid result is always made available.-Tax events have, amongst others, a characteristic defined by SAP that makes them taxable or non-taxable tax events. The non-taxable ones across all countries are usually tax events 1 (non-taxable purchase), 200 (import scenario) and 300 (non-taxable sale).-Tax country determination is executed in potentially 4 steps detailed below  – a country is determined as tax country if the following applies:-The tax event returned for this country is the only taxable tax event overall.-No taxable tax event has been determined and the resulting tax event is the only non-taxable tax event  (e.g. we have only one country returning a non-taxable tax event).-If none of the above are true, specific fallback solutions apply based on the parameters e.g. of the product line items or other.-The fallback tax country for a third-party deal scenario is determined as the country of the SF partner role.-  The new configuration solution for external tax event determination operates within these guiding principles. Given an appropriate parameterization, any tax result desired may be obtained.-The parameters of an operational document that are relevant for the tax event determination may be inspected online by use of the tax trace functionality, the details of which may be reviewed in the help center searching for Tax Trace Details.-A valid configuration entry consists of the following parameters:-Configuration item ID – a two digit ID / key field for the configuration entry.-Valid-for country – the country to which the respective entry applies and for which the specific tax event is to be defined.-Tax Category – prefilled with Product Tax, no further tax category is presently supported.-Tax Event Direction – two options are:-Incoming for purchasing.-Outgoing for sales.-Valid-from / Valid-to dates – validity dates of the configuration entry, required to also validate the tax event result.-Third-Party Deal Scenario (TPDS) indicator –to be set explicitly if the configuration entry relates to a TPDS operational document, please check the tax trace details for this.-Tax Event – evaluation result to be propagated for further processing in case of a positive parameter match.-Tax Code (only tax codes registered for chosen tax event are offered) – evaluation result to be propagated, the tax code does not need to be set when it is e.g. necessary to derive a tax code based on the parameters of the product line items (standard rate, reduced rate etc.) but can be used to always enforce a specific tax code in an operational document (e.g. if there are specific purchasing scenarios for which the automatic determination of a tax code with a special deductibility would be required).-During execution of a tax event determination for an operational document, the configuration entries relevant to the case are selected using parameters 2. to 6. above and then an evaluation of the selected relevant configuration entries for the remaining parameters is executed in detail. These remaining parameters are-The location details of the participating relevant parties / locations. These may be defined:-By specifying a dedicated single country.-By specifying the business partner to be located within a certain region or specific area like e.g. within the European Union (EU) or outside the EU. A number of special areas are offered.-If the valid-for country specified in b) above is the United States of America (US), a further field Tax Jurisdiction of Bus. Part. Role becomes available; here the tax jurisdiction to be propagated in case of a positive result may be maintained; it is preset with the CF party for an outgoing and CT party for an incoming tax event direction. Fallback rules for the case that the selected jurisdiction party role is actually not located in the US are:-The system checks if one of the other business partner roles is located in the US and defaults this.-If none or more than one business partner role are located in the US, a manual input in the operational document needs to be made.-Tax Details – these offer further specifics like tax exemption reasons per tax type related to the business partner roles for which location details with a single country have been maintained.-Additional parameters:-Product type – entry valid for a specific product type only.-When product type Material is chosen, a further indicator Material related to Service (Order) becomes available. This feature will check if a material product line is contained in or originates from a service order, thus materials used as e.g. replacement or spare parts from service orders may be taxed differently from normal product sales.-With the exception of the parameter Third-Party Deal, which is evaluated explicitly during comparison of the configuration entry parameters with the operational document parameters, all other parameters:-Can either be set and will then be evaluated explicitly. A positive match of one parameter will result in the evaluation of the next parameter until all parameters of the respective entry are evaluated. A negative match of a parameter will invalidate the entire configuration entry for the given use case.-Or can be left initial and will be treated as unspecific wild card entries. The priority of an entry with e.g. 5 wild card parameters is lower than for an entry with only 2 wild card entries in the final determination of the most relevant result for a use case.-A specific combination of parameters represented by an entry may exist only once, the system will check for duplicate entries to ensure that any result obtained is unique. It is thus possible to build a hierarchy of configuration entries for a country if many different use cases are to be covered, the one with highest priority being the one where all parameters are maintained explicitly, the one with lowest priority being the one where only the mandatory parameters are defined.-During execution of a tax event determination for an operational document, the system will thus evaluate all applicable configuration entries for each country according to the criteria laid out and – when positive matches have been obtained - determine the most relevant one according to the specificity of the entry (related to the wild card count and the party location details).-The tax event maintained for the most relevant entry as well as the tax code (if maintained) is then propagated as the final result of the tax event determination for the respective country. For country United States of America, the maintained tax jurisdiction is also returned.-Resolution-How to obtain the desired tax result / tax country for your use case.-Given the example of a third-party drop shipment scenario involving business partners in three different countries A, B and C and multiple operational documents like a sales and purchase order, customer and supplier invoice to be created for the respective parties, how do you proceed to obtain the desired result for taxation in the respective documents:-Scope the external tax determination functionality without creating any entries in the configuration at first, this will already propagate the relevant parameters from the operational documents to the tax trace during tax determination.-Create the source documents like sales / purchase order and check the result of tax determination, in this case derived from the evaluation of the tax decision trees. If the result obtained is not the desired one, the configuration is required to address the special use case. Activate the tax trace functionality in the operational document and check the parameters.-Create the necessary configuration entries based on the parameters from the tax trace for the operational document, rerun the tax determination for the operational document and check the result, adapt the entries as required.-As outlined in the guiding principles above, the tax event determination is executed for all three countries in our example and the tax country is determined in the post processing of the tax event determination according to the priorities defined in guiding principle 5. Thus, if e.g. country B is required to be the tax country for the operational document, it is necessary that the tax events for countries A and C are returned as non-taxable tax events. Country B will then be determined as the tax country if:-Either the tax event returned for country B is the only taxable tax event.-Or the tax event for country B is non-taxable and a corresponding tax code is provided.-Setting up the configuration entries for our example use case, thus two possibilities now exist from release 1702:-For a given parameter set in the operational document, three individual entries need to be created for countries A, B and C respectively with the same / similar parameter set such that the entry evaluation routine will determine the three entries as the relevant result entries. The tax events for countries A and C need to be set to non-taxable tax events and the tax event for country B as required. This set of 3 entries needs to be created for every use case / operational document if none of the already existing entries apply.-New with release 1702 is the indicator “Enforce country as tax country” in the configuration entry. In our example, only one entry is now required for country B using the parameter set based on the operational document tax trace with the desired tax event / tax code combination as end result and the indicator set to true. Upon execution of the tax determination for all three countries, the system will execute the following steps:-When evaluating for country B, the system will retrieve the entry and – in case of a positive match with highest priority – return the tax event / tax code as the final result for country B.-When evaluating for countries A and C, the system will not retrieve an entry for the dedicated countries since none have been maintained. It will however check if entries for any of the three countries A, B and C exists where the indicator “Enforce country as tax country” is set. In our case, it will retrieve the one entry for country B. The evaluation of the parameters in this entry will again result in a positive match and the system will return non-taxable tax events for countries A and C since they are different from country B for which the entry is maintained Thus the need for the creation of multiple entries for the same scenario is greatly reduced.-The specific feature to automatically return non-taxable tax events for countries A or C is however only active if no further configuration entries exist for country/regions A or C dedicatedly. If some exist, these and only these will be evaluated.-1. Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-2. Go to the Implementation Projects View.-3. Select your Implementation Project and click the Open Activity List button.-4. Go to the Fine-Tune Tab.-5. Search and open the External Tax Determination for Goods and Services activity.-6. Create a configuration entry including if required and the Tax Code Details accordingly.-For details, check the enclosed screenshot.--  See Also-Keywords-Externe Steuerfindung, External Tax Determination, Streckengeschäfte, Third Party Sales Process, Steuercode, Tax code

Title: Activation Error: Identifier is read-only and cannot be changed
Content: Symptom-You receive the following error message when trying to save or activate an .ABSL script file in your custom solution within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-"Identifier 'My_Field' is read-only and cannot be changed" (where My_Field is the name of an element)-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“ -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Case 1:-The cause for this issue can be related to the Deployment Unit of the affected business objects.-You can directly access business objects that reside in the Foundation deployment unit from any deployment unit (DU). However, business objects in the Foundation deployment unit cannot access any business object residing in another deployment unit, not even by using asynchronous communication. You can only use a query to read the data of this business object.-In case your script was created on a business object that resides in the Foundation DU, you will not be able to write on elements from a business object that resides on the CustomerRelationshipManagement DU, for example.-For all other deployment units the following applies: You cannot directly change the data of a business object residing in another deployment unit. However, you can read the data of such a business object by using a query, the Retrieve method or an association. To change the data of a business object residing in another deployment unit, use asynchronous, message-based communication.-Case 2:-You are trying to change data in a Validation / ActionValidation script. Validations can only read data and cannot change any values.-Case 3:-You are attempting to write to a persistent field on the AfterLoading event-Resolution-Case 1:-You can assign the business object to another Deployment Unit by making use of the annotation in your BO: [DeploymentUnit(<deployment unit name>)] businessobject <name> {-Example: [DeploymentUnit(Foundation)] businessobject MyCustomBO {-Case 2:-You must move the custom logic to a supported script type such as an Event.-Case 3:-It is only possible to write to a transient field on the AfterLoading event.-From Help documentation: Actions, Events, and Validations | SAP Help Portal-You can implement this event to modify transient fields (only available for business objects) of the current node of a business object. The system executes the AfterLoading event when it reads a node instance of a business object from the data base.-You cannot use an AfterLoading event to do the following:-Read and modify a transient field of another node-Modify a persistent field-Create or delete a node-Call an action-Keywords-SDK, PDI, Deployment Unit, validation, XBO, BO, DU

Title: '500 SAP Internal Server Error' During Replication of Employees
Content: Symptom-The standard integration scenario for Successfactors & SAP Business ByDesign replication is activated. But you are facing the following error when trying to replicate an employee from Successfactors to SAP Business ByDesgin:-'500 SAP Internal Server Error'-Note: The replication for other employees may work fine.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select Master Data Replication work center.-Select Import > Employees.-Select the affected employee.-Click Replicate.-'500 SAP Internal Server Error' occurs.-Cause-A possible reason for this error is the following situation: the address information in replication request and the employee data does not match.-Resolution-The address information coming from SuccessFactors must be the same as it is in SAP Business ByDesign.-See Also-Keywords-technical, replicate, employee,

Title: Error "Unable to write Data Replication Requests" Occurs When Replicating Employees from SF EC to ByD
Content: Symptom-You are trying to replicate employees from Employee Central to SAP Business ByDesign, and the following error occurs:-"Workpackage execution ended with errors"-"Unable to write Data Replications Requests"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Enter the Replication Runs view.-Select the respective application log.-Here the error is displayed.-Cause-The issue might be due to incorrect data setup for some of the employees in the system. If you try to Upload Data from Employee Central for these employees, you can see issues such as Replication of Supervisor/Managers for these employees missing.-When you open the Replication Request file, you could also notice below issues under Organizational Assignment Tab:-Duplicate Entry for Reporting Line Units-Overlap in the Validity Periods for Org Units-This data setup (Overlap in Employment) is not supported scenario for Replication to Business ByDesign.-Another scenario that can lead to this error is that the employee replication is being performed before the Reporting Line Unit replication. In case you are replicating employees that are managers, this will not trigger the creation of a Reporting Line Unit, and will cause this error since the function is not yet defined in the organization structure.-Resolution-The data needs to be corrected in the connected EC system. Please replicate Supervisor/Manager files and then replicate the employees again.-Also, the replication of Reporting Line Units needs to be performed before the replication of employees with management roles. Please check the documentation in the "See Also" Section.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign and SuccessFactors Employee Central Integration Guide-Keywords-Data Replication Requests; Employee Data; Reporting Line Units

Title: Product Quantity Decimal Display Incorrect In Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You have set the Physical Unit of Measurement X to display 'n' decimal places in Business Configuration. However, system displays only 'm' decimals (m is less than n) in Stock Overview Screen.-X represents a unit of Measure for example: Liter, Meter, Each etc.-m and n represent a numerical value for example: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Unit of Measure configuration in Business Configuration:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select Open Activity List.-Search for the Activity: 'Quantities and Units of Measure'.-Click either 'Create and Maintain Physical Units' (or on 'Create and Maintain Trading Units' depending on your requirement).-Search for Unit of Measurement: X.-You can see in the column 'Display Decimals' that 'n' decimals is set.-Open the Stock Overview Screen from any Logistics Work Centers for example: Inbound Logistics, Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, and so on... When you enter the relevant Product and execute the search, the Stock is displayed only up to 'm' decimals for the given Product and Site combination.-Cause-System will not append the zero at the end of the decimal value. System will display the actual decimal number if there was a digit other than zero.-For example:-99,932.9740 - there are 4 decimal places here, as indicated in the fine tune setting activity.99,932.974 - there are 3 decimal places here as displayed in Stock Overview. Hence, the digit '0' is truncated. Please note that the same quantity will be shown in other inventory screens like Product Planning Available Stock, Projected Material Flow, Valuated Stock Overview.-The system will display 4 decimals if there is a digit other than zero like for example: 99,932.9742.-If there are no decimal places to display, the system will not display any decimal value. Example: 99,932.0000 will not be displayed in the stock overview. It will be displayed as 99,932-  Resolution-This behavior is the designed system behavior.-See Also-Keywords-Unit of Measure, Decimal places, Stock Overview, Quantities and Unit of Measure, decimal places not displayed correctly, UoM display error, ByDesign, ByDesign display error UoM Decimals

Title: How to Edit an Active Invoice Run
Content: Symptom-You want to edit an active Invoice Run, however, the buttons are all greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Runs view.-Select and edit Invoice Run ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Run).-The Add Row button is disabled.-You notice that the Add Row button and all other options are greyed out.-Resolution-In order to edit the run, you need to set it's status to In Revision by perform the following steps: -Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Runs view.-Select and edit Invoice Run ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Run).-Click on the Actions button.-Select Set to Obsolete.-This will change the status of the run from Active to Obsolete.-Click on the Actions button.-Select Revoke Obsolescence.-Now that the status of the run is In Revision, you are able to edit the Invoice Properties, Selection Criteria and the Split By.-Once you have completed the changes, active the run by clicking on the Actions button and selecting Activate. -Observation: -Please deactivate any scheduled runs before changing the runs status to Obsolete. -See Also-How to edit ACTIVE Invoice Run parameters in SAP ByD-Keywords-Invoice Run, Status, Active, Obsolete, How-to, Edit, Add Row, Button, Exclude, Greyed Out, Change

Title: Payment Allocation Error: 'Net Amount missing'.
Content: Symptom-You try to post a Payment Allocation with Zero open amount and you can see the error message: 'Net Amount missing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select the Payment Allocations view.-Show all In Preparation allocations, and select the one in question.-Edit the Payment Allocation, and you could see that the open amount is zero.-Choose the Post button.-You can see error message: 'Net Amount missing'-Cause-The error reported is that you tried to post the payment allocation in both the Customer/Supplier tab and Allocation to G/L account tab. You have filled incorrect details, in either Customer/Supplier tab or Allocation to G/L account tab.-For Example:-Over the payment allocation screen you have maintained the correct details in the Customer/Supplier tab.-You went to the 3rd tab - Allocation to G/L Account. You have entered only the G/L Account and missed to enter the credit/debit amount. When you click on post at that time system throws the error message.-Resolution-Make sure that the details are filled correctly while allocating payment. If you are trying to allocate the amount in - Supplier/Customer tab and Allocation to G/L account tab then, the details should be filled correctly.-See Also-Keywords-Payment Allocation, Net amount missing, Payment Management.

Title: Wrong Currency picked in Supplier Invoice created from a Scan Invoice
Content: Symptom-While you create a Supplier Invoice (SIV) from a Scan Invoice, you have noticed the currency picked in the SIV is not the same as the one mentioned in the scanned PDF.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have uploaded a PDF from the view Invoice Scanning under the WoC Supplier Invoicing.-The associated PDF shows a currency such as ABC.-Go to WoC Supplier Invoicing-Invoice Scanning View-Select the uploaded PDF and click Review-From here we can see the scanned currency is ABC, as per the PDF-Now click Create Invoice, the currency picked by the system is XYZ instead of ABC-Cause-An invalid on non-existing Purchase Order (PO) was present in the PDF and therefore in the Scanned Values.-The scan invoice tries to pick the Currency code by default based on the PO mentioned, if a valid PO is not mentioned, it tries to pick the default Supplier/Buying currency code which in this case is XYZ instead of ABC.-Resolution-Go to WoC Supplier Invoicing-Invoice Scanning View-Select the PDF upload and click Review-Under Order ID > Reviewed Values, maintain a valid PO ID-Click Create Invoice: the system will pick the correct currency ABC.-See Also-Keywords-Invoice Scanning, Wrong Currency, Purchase Order, Supplier Invoice.

Title: Error When Running a Report or Previewing a DataSource: HANA-RUN-ERROR Unknown View Attribute
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-+++INTERNAL USE ONLY+++-You can see some unexpected error messages when running a report, previewing a data source or doing a search/query on a work center view:-No connection to search engine.-HANA-RUN-ERROR (23.013): Unknown view attribute;BYD1ANXXX_XXXXX_X_XXXXXXX. Column Index .c363:1fs:jdx_fsp_scm_istock.-HANA error occurred.-Unexpected error occurred.-No report data available to display; check the selection.-Error reading the data of data source.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Analytics work center.- Go to Design Reports work center view.- Search for a report.- Open and run it.-You can see some error messages. -Or-Go to Design Data Sources. -Search for a Data Source ABC. -Open and run it.-You can see some error messages-Or-Go to the Purchase Request view (it could be any other view).-Filter for All Purchase Requests.-Execute the query.-You can see some error messages.-Cause-The issue is caused due to a temporary inconsistency in the FSI which the BO data, report or data source is based. It usually occurs after a deployment of a HotFix where the FSI has not been reactivated and the FSI keeps referring to an old attribute. You can check if the FSI has the same errors following these steps:-First find the FSI view name: -In case it is mentioned in the error message:-Cut-off .cxxx:1fs:jdx_ of the INDEX_ID and you have your FSI view.-EG : HANA-RUN-ERROR (23.013): Unknown view attribute;BYD1ANXXX_XXXXX_X_XXXXXXX. Column Index [.c363:1fs:jdx_fsp_scm_istock].-Take [.c363:1fs:jdx_fsp_scm_istock] and cut-off [.c363:1fs:jdx_].-The view name will be fsp_scm_istock.-In case it is not mentioned in the error message, you will need to debug:-Open SE24.-Set a breakpoint on class: CL_FSI_TREX_QE and method: CALL_TREX.-Reproduce the scenario in the UI.-The breakpoint will hit and debugger will trigger.-Do a search (ctrl + F) for the variable "in_index_list" in the code.-Double-click the code variable.-Double-click the variable in the Variables section.-You should obtain a value with a similar pattern in the above step 3.-This will be the FSI view name. (Remove the section from the beginning of the INDEX_ID until after the first underscore (in this example, ".c002:1fs:jdx_") and what remains is the name of the FSI view).-Press F8 until the debugger ends its execution.-Remove the breakpoint.-Check if the FSI has the same error as in the UI:-Go to VIEWBUILDER transaction.-Enter the FSI Name. (Remove the section from the beginning of the INDEX_ID until after the first underscore (in this example, ".c002:1fs:jdx_") and what remains is the name of the FSI view).-Click on Display button. -Click on 'Test / Execute' button or press 'F8'.-Click on Load button.-Select 'Analytics' under 'View Execution'.-Click Execute.-You can see the same error message in the 'Last TREX Error' box. -Resolution-In order to solve this inconsistency, you need to Activate the FSI View following these steps:-Go to VIEWBUILDER transaction.-Enter the FSI Name.-Click on Display button. -Click on Activate button. -Keywords-PDI, KUT, field, SDK, unknown view attribute, CL_FSI_TREX_QE, c002:1fs:jdx_

Title: Document Numbering Of Sales Documents Is Not Sequential
Content: Symptom-The document numbering of sales documents such as Sales Orders, Service Orders, Service Requests and Service Confirmations is not sequential.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Select in the Show field the option All Orders.-Sort the Sales Orders ID column.-You will find some gaps in the numbering of the Sales Order ID. The number range is not sequential.-Cause-The number of Sales Orders, Service Orders, Service Requests and Service Confirmations are not sequential. The numbering rules are different from accounting documents. If you select, for example, the New Service Order hyperlink, the Number will be reserved even if the document is not saved. If the action is canceled without saving the document this will lead to a 'lost' number.-Numbering rules and the need to explain gaps in number ranges currently only hold for accounting documents, but not for documents such as for example, Service Orders. There is no legal or accounting principle based requirement concerning the internal number of these documents. Since forcing a strict numbering has a big impact on the system performance, we have not implemented a numbering rules for sales documents unless there is a strict legal requirement.-Therefore, the number range of documents such as Service Orders will not be sequential.-Resolution-This is the current behavior provided by SAP Business ByDesign.-We are considering making this feature available in a future release.-See Also-3202910 - Sales Order Document Numbering Missing-Keywords-Sales Order, Service Order, Service Request, Service Confirmation, Sequential, Numbering, Sequence.

Title: Payments of Status as In Transfer Are Not Included Automatically in New Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-Payments in transfer are not included automatically in the second step of new bank statement creation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center and select common task New Bank Statement.-Input Bank Account, Statement Date and other required parameters.-Select Next, however, the payments in transfer are not included automatically.-Cause-The payment date of those payments are later than the statement date in the new bank transfer.-Resolution-You need to change the Statement Date in the new bank statement to be later than the payment date of those payments.-See Also-Keywords- Bank Statement, payments, in transfer, automatically.

Title: Cannot Post Payment Allocation Due to Error Message: 'Payment Allocation Missing'.
Content: Symptom-You are not able to post the payment allocation due to error message: 'Payment Allocation Missing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select the Payment Allocations view.-Show all In Preparation allocations, and select the one in question.-Edit the Payment Allocation and allocation is complete, and you could see that the open amount is zero.-Choose the Post button.-You will see the following error message:--'Payment Allocation Missing.'-Cause- Although an appropriate customer / supplier was selected and stored, the error message suggests that an assignment subject is missing. Such error occurs due to buffering problem and most the time it is a temporary issue.-Resolution-Assuming this as temporary problem, please proceed as follows:-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select the Payment Allocations view.-Show all In Preparation allocations, and select the one in question.-Edit the Payment Allocation, remove the customer/supplier and save.-Try again to re-edit the assignment and post the payment allocation.-Keywords-Payment Allocation, Missing, amount, Payment Management

Title: Error: 'Period XXX in Fiscal Year YYYY Closed in Set of Books XYZ for Closing Step Closing Entries'
Content: Symptom-You create a new Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for period XXX (XXX is the period) in year YYYY, but the system gives an error message: 'Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY closed in set of books XYZ (XYZ is the set of books ID) for closing step Closing entries'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work Center.-Select the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs subview under the Periodic Tasks view.-Click New and select Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Run.-Fill in all the details and click Start Now.-Or-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Select the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs sub view under the Periodic Tasks view.-Click New and select Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Run.-Fill in all the details and click Start Now.-Or-Go to the Receivables Work Center.-Select the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs sub view under Periodic Tasks view.-Click New and select Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash Run.-Fill in all the details and click Start Now.-The system gives an error: 'Period XXX in fiscal year YYYY closed in set of books XYZ for closing step Closing entries.'-Cause-When a run is created with closing step 010 -Operational Postings, then a posting is made for the open item in the current period and a counter posting is made for the open item on the 1st day of the next period. If you want to close this open item in between, then this is not possible if a posting is already made in the next period with closing step - 010 Operational Postings. To avoid this, you get the error message.-The Foreign Currency Remeasurement should be created with the closing step as 020 - Closing Entries and the period must also be closed for Operational postings. So make sure that the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step is 020-Closing Entries for the period (XXX) for which you have executed the run. For the next Accounting Period (YYY), set the Last Allowed Step to 020 - Closing entries.-Resolution-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose Open and Close Periods under Common Tasks.-Choose the row of Accounting Period ID XXX, and set the First Allowed Step and Last Allowed Step to 020 - Closing entries.-Choose the row of Accounting Period ID YYY, and set the Last Allowed Step to 020 - Closing entries.-Make sure that the period is not Blocked.-Go back to the Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run-Create the run with closing step as “020 - Closing Entries” and choose Start Now.-The run should be successfully executed.-See Also-Keywords-foreign currency remeasurement run, Fiscal Year, Set of Books, closing entries,

Title: You Are Receiving an Error Message When Trying to Integrate SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Success Factors
Content: Symptom-You have performed the configuration to integrate SAP Business ByDesign and SAP Success Factors, however the system is showing the error message below in the Web Service Message Monitoring.-An exception occurred.EC CC Repl. error: [LGN0004]You’re not allowed to access APIs using Basic Authentication-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Web Service Message Monitoring view.-Check for the errors generated from the Integration Scenario.-Cause-This error message is occurring because the Scoping Question below is scoped:-Do you want to enable OAuth based authentication for cost center replication in SuccessFactors Employee Central integration scenario?-However, since there is no OAuth based authentication setup for cost-center replication in the system, the error is occurring.-Resolution-There are two approaches to fix it.-While editing project scope, de-scoping (uncheck) the above question and save the project. Then logout from the system and login again. Then try for cost-center replication.-Setup the OAuth based authentication for cost center replication. Check the below SAP help document for the same. Then try for cost-center replication.-Configure OAuth Based Authentication for Cost Center Replication for Existing Users-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, ByD, Integration, Master Data Replication, Success Factor, SF, An exception occurred, EC CC Repl, [LGN0004]You’re not allowed to access APIs, using Basic Authentication, LGN0004, Web Service Message Monitoring, Application and User Management.

Title: Report: Bank Statement Items Details - Changes in SAP ByDesign Version 1602
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -This document lists and describes modifications implemented in SAP ByDesign version 1602 (February, 2016) for the report Bank Statement Items Details.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Open the Reports view and List.-Find the report Bank Statement Items Details (Report ID: FINPAYU07_Q0001).-For the selection criteria, define appropriate parameters, namely Bank Account and Statement ID.-Cause-Several report features have been enhanced to provide a more accurate and detailed view on transactions processed in a respective bank statement.-These changes mainly concern the depiction of allocated and cleared amount in the column Transaction Amount for each bank statement transaction.-Resolution-Field: Business Partner-Scenario:-A payment transaction (for example: Other Outgoing Payment) is allocated to multiple business partners under Payment Confirmation/Returns in a respective Payment Allocation.-Previously:-The report field Business Partner was filled with '#'.-Now: -The respective Business Partner is listed also for Payment Allocations resulting in a 1:N allocation.-  Field: Transaction Amount-Scenario:-Multiple Payment Allocations:-A payment transaction (e.g. Other Outgoing Payment) is allocated to multiple business partners under Payment Confirmation/Returns in a respective Payment Allocation.-Previously:-The entire payment amount contained in a bank statement item is shown in the field Transaction Amount for each Reference Item.-Now: -The actual allocated amount per each Reference Item shows under Transaction Amount.-Scenario:-Transactions including Tax:-A payment transaction (e.g. Incoming Bank Transfer) contains a gross amount including tax. In the resulted Payment Allocation / Allocation to G/L Account the amount is posted according to Net Amount and Tax Amount.-Previously:-Only the Net Amount shows as Transaction Amount.-Now: -The entire processed payment amount (Gross Amount incl. Tax) shows as Transaction Amount.-Scenario:-Partially cleared Open Items:-A bank statement transaction (e.g. Incoming Bank Transfer) subsequently partially clears one or more open items (e.g. customer invoices).-Previously:-The full respective invoice Document Amount is shown.-Now: -A new Key Figure: 'Cleared Amount' has been introduced depicting the respective Applied Net Amount(s).  (You can access the criterion via Settings / Key Figures; Pull Cleared Amount into the Selected pane.)--Scenario:-Overallocation and Sign (+/-) for Debit/Credit:-A payment transaction (e.g. Other Incoming Payment) has been over-allocated to a G/L Account (e.g. Credit). Consequently the resulting remainder is allocated with an inverse notation (e.g. Debit). Both allocated amounts will show the same sign (+/-).-Example:-Incoming Payment:  1000 EUR; Credit Allocation:  1100 EUR; Debit Allocation:  100 EUR-Here no changes are implemented. The direction of the payment continues to determine the sign for a Debit/Credit - G/L Allocation in the report under Transaction Amount. In the stated example an Incoming Payment is 'over-allocated' to a g/l account. The remainder is then allocated to another g/l account in Debit. Here no (-) sign will be introduced. However, if the underlying transaction is an Outgoing Payment, a corresponding G/L Debit-Allocation would show indeed a (-) sign.- Features of the Report as on release 1608-Displays all the bank statement items for a posted bank statement with post processing status as Not Required. The report does not show any  data if the Bank Statement is In Preparation or the post processing status is In Process or Required-Shows the business partner, payment method, external reference, invoice ID, GL Account, for each split of the bank statement item-If for one bank statement item there are multiple open items selected in the external allocations tab of the bank statement items allocation, then it shows multiple lines in the report for each open item ID-If for one bank statement item there are multiple GL accounts selected in the direct posting to GL account allocations tab of the bank statement items allocation, then it should show multiple lines in the report for each unique GL account-Outgoing payments/Bank Charge will be displayed as negative and incoming payments would be positive in the Transaction Amount column-Cleared amounts will be shown in the Transaction Amount Column itself and not the actual invoice amount. The column Cleared amount can be ignored-Limitations:-On Account Payments: When there is an invoice selected in the payment along with a part of the whole payment amount posted on account, the report would not display the amount correctly. It would not show the amount that is paid on account. This is the same case for Overpayments where an additional amount is posted on account. If the whole amount is posted on a single account the report still shows the correct amounts.-When there are multiple internal allocations along with other allocation items for one single bank statement item, this would not be displayed correctly-If any of the above limitations are encountered for any bank statement item, then the sum of the amounts for this item in report would not match the amount in the bank statement item-When there are same GL Accounts in multiple lines of the payment, then the amount is not displayed correctly. Unique GL Accounts are displayed as one row in the report.-How to check the actual amounts in case of discrepancies in the report:-Download the report data to an excel and take the sum per bank statement item-Check sum of amounts for each item in the report and compare this with the amount for this item in the bank statement-In case there is a difference, click the post processing link of this bank statement item. Here check the actual amounts in the corresponding allocation/ clearing.-Kindly check the attached document for steps to verify the values in the report-See Also-Keywords-FINPAYU07_Q0001; bank statement items details

Title: New Zealand Bank Account for Supplier - Special Characters not Permitted in Bank Account Number
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a New Zealand Bank Account for a Supplier Account, an error message appears: "Special characters not permitted in bank account number: enter digit only."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Payables Work Center navigate to the Suppliers View and here to the Supplier Accounts sub-view.-Click the Supplier Name to open its master data.-Press View All.-In the Financial Data Tab, go to the Bank Data Sub-tab.-Enter Bank Account Number as XXXXXXX-XX. (XXXXXXX-XX represents the Bank Account Number)-Press Save.-The error message appears: "Special characters not permitted in bank account number: enter digit only".-Cause-Special characters are not allowed in bank account numbers for New Zealand as there is a special characters validation check.-Resolution-As per the standards bank account number should be as the format BB-RRRR-AAAAAAA-SSS (B- Bank, R-Branch, A-Account, S-Suffix).-BBRRRR is captured as the National Bank Code and it is expected to enter a 10 digit account number, like so:  AAAAAAASSS.-If the suffix has less than 3 digits a respective amount of zeros is added to it instead of a hyphen (-), like so: XXXXXXX0XX instead of XXXXXXX-XX.--With the error message a new 10 digit account number is suggested with added zeros should the suffix have less than three digits. This number should be used instead.-See Also-Keywords-New Zealand, Special Characters

Title: In the Sales Order you get the Option 'Submit for Approval' Though the Approval Process has not been Created for the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In the sales order you get the option Submit for Approval though the Approval Process has not been created for the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales work center.-Go to the Sales Order tab.-Open the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Select Actions -> the option Set as Complete is grayed out.-Select Actions -> Choose the action Submit for Approval.-Now the action Set as Complete is available for selection.-You are expecting the action Set as Complete to be available without selecting Submit for Approval.-Cause-The current system behavior is that if you have scoped Multi-step Approval Process for the sales order, then the sales order cannot be Set as Complete without clicking Submit for Approval option (regardless of approval process defined or not defined in the Application and User Management work center).-Resolution-If you want a change in the behavior, please raise it as a new requirement from via the link provided in the KBA 2531650 - New Customer Request for Additional Feature or Function in SAP standard software-See Also-Keywords- no approval process,

Title: Attachment is Not Being Sent via Peppol
Content: Symptom-You are sending documents via the Peppol integration, however, the attachments are not being sent as expected. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Cause-The reason the attachment files are not being sent is because the type text/html under Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload is not set to Allowed. -Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -To solve this, kindly perform the following:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload.-Click Open.-Filter for MIME Type: text/html.-Select the checkbox under the column Allowed.-Click Save and Close.-Now you can perform the same actions and the attachment will show under the Incoming Documents. -Keywords-Peppol, Attachments, Type, text/html, MIME Type, Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload, Not Sent

Title: How to Add the List Price and Requested Date Fields in the Sales Order Excel Upload Template
Content: Symptom-While creating the Sales Orders from Microsoft Excel the fields List Price and Requested Date are not available in the Excel Upload Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click on New and select Sales Order from Microsoft Excel® option.-In the downloaded excel template file, the fields List Price and Requested Date is not available.-Cause-It is not possible to add list price and requested date in the New Sales Order Excel Template as the excel is used to quickly create sales orders and required pricing master data needs to be setup in the system.-Resolution-It is the current system behavior. It is recommended to use the Customer Influence Forum to submit or vote for an improvement request.-Additionally, kindly check the ManageSalesOrderIn web service help documentation https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2305/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_SLO_SO_BUNDLE_MBO.html to assess whether the requirement can be fulfilled by the Web Service.-See Also-KBA 1972763 - How to Add the Sales Unit Field in the Excel Upload Template-Keywords-Excel Template; Excel Upload; Upload; Sales Order; XML; List Price; Requested Date

Title: The Kit Sub Items are Not Removed When the Kit Header Line Item is Removed in a Copy Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer has reported that when removing the Kit Header Line Item during the creation of an invoice using the copy option, the Kit Sub Items are not removed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-Filter for All Invoices.-In the search field, Search for the Customer Invoice ID ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Mark the Customer Invoice ABC.-Select Copy button.-Select View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Mark the Line Item xx (Kit Header Line Item).-Select Remove button.-The Kit Sub Items are not removed.-Resolution-In this case a backend correction from the development side will be required in order to solve this inconsistency.-Kindly forward the case to the development side for a backend correction. -Keywords-sales kit, kit header, kit, kit components, kit sub items, invoice, copy, copy invoice, remove kit, remove.

Title: 500 Native SSL error when executing REST service
Content: Symptom-You have created a REST web service in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio. After checking in the UI, you can see the 'Check Connection' function in the Communication Arrangement is failing. You now debug the execution of this service in the Cloud Applications Studio and can see the error 500 Native SSL error is returned.-Image/Data is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems.  Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the Cloud Solution.-Go to the Administrator (or Application and User Management) work centre.-Go to the Communication Arrangement view and open the affected arrangement.-Click on Edit - >  On the Technical settings.-Enter Advanced Settings mode.-Use the actions Check Connection and Check Service.-Observe the error messages raised.-Errors:-Ping failed.-Checking connection failed.- Now you must debug this scenario in the Cloud Applications Studio by activating debugging and triggering the web service in the UI. You will then see the response variable with the 500 Native SSL error.-Cause-This issue is usually raised because of missing or insufficient authentication. You have not added the service's trusted certificate to the Cloud Solution.-Resolution-You must download the certificate from the called HTTPS page and upload it in SAP Cloud Solution under the list of trustworthy certificates in the Administrator (or Application and User Management) work centre. Please kindly make sure "Chain Incomplete" is not marked for your uploaded certificate. If it's marked, please kindly refer to the case documentation in "See Also" section.--Please follow the below steps in order to upload the certificate.-There are two tasks required to install the Certificate:-Extract. -Upload.-To extract the certificate you need to:-Open the API URL on the browser. We will use Google Chrome and the SAP standard API -  https://sapseod.mindtouch.us/, as an example. You need to use your URL API then.-Once it is opened, you need to click the locker icon, like the screen below.-Then, the below screen will open. Click Certificate (Valid) to open the certificate.-Once you click on Certificate, the Certificate popup is opened. You need to click on Certification Path tab, then double-click the first level, then click onDetails tab and then on Copy to File... button and Next.-On the Certificate Export Wizard, select the Base-64 encoded X.509 (.CER).---Save the file on your computer. It is advised to use the same name as the Certificate, to avoid confusion.--Important: you will need to do this for all Certificate levels.-To install the certificate on the SAP Cloud Solution:-Go to the Administrator or Application and User Management work center.-Select the Common Tasks view.-Click Edit Certificate Trust List.-Click Upload.-Click Browse and select the files you saved on the previous steps. (You will need to do it separately for each file, but the order is not important).-Click Save.-See Also- KBA 2049823 - Certificate Trust List Chain Incomplete-Keywords-REST, WS, Web, Service, SSL, Error, 500, SDK, PDI, HTTP, code, authentication, method, outbound, call, HTTP error while receiving response-ssl,rest

Title: Production Model showing as Check Pending or Consistent when it should be inconsistent.
Content: Symptom-There are Production Models that are showing as either Check Pending or consistent when they should be inconsistent since the Production Bill of Material is obsolete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Go to Production Models view.-Find Production Model ID ABC (ABC means Production Model ID)-Open it and notice that Obsolete Bills of Material Variant checkbox is not marked, and the Planning-Consistency Status and Execution-Consistency Status are Consistent, but when you see above Save and Close buttons the Planning-Consistency Status and Execution-Consistency Status are Check Pending.-Cause-When you created a Production Bill of Material variant and Production Bill of Operation in consistent status, then you go for production model creation. Once the Production Model is created and the status is consistent, then you can release the same for production planning model and production execution model. After that, if you make the Production Bill of Material variant obsolete and make some changes in Production Bill of Operation where the status of Production Bill of Operation also changed to Check Pending, you can also observe that Production Model status is also changed to Check Pending and the planning and execution model also changed to Check Pending.-If you again try to release the planning and execution model, you will get the error and Production Bill of Material variant is marked obsolete and Production Model is inconsistent, you cannot further release the Production Model.-Resolution-If you want to make a Production Bill of Material variant obsolete then you should open the Production Bill of Material view and all others view should be closed. In Production Bill of Material view, obsolete the Production Bill of Material variant and click on Save and Close. Then open Production Model view and, if that Production Bill of Material variant is used in that Production Model, do Check Consistency, you will get the error message and the status of Production Model will also change to Check Pending.-Keywords-Production Model, Production Bill of Material, Bill of Material Variant, Obsolete, Check Pending, Consistent

Title: A2A Sales Orders are Released Automatically
Content: Symptom-You created an Intercompany Sales Order which came from a Purchase Order and the Sales Order is released automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Purchase Order).-Click the Order button.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Sales Order).-The Sales Order status is showing as released.-  Cause-For Sales Orders created from an A2A message, the Sales Order is always released automatically once it is created unless:-the Sales Order is inconsistent.-the price in Sales Order is different from the price in Purchase Order. In this case, the Sales Order remains with the In Preparation status due to the warning message: Customer expected net value differs from item net value.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-1828436 - Intercompany Project Scenario: The Automatically Created Sales Order Is not Released Automatically by the System-Keywords-A2A; Intercompany; Sales Order; Purchase Order; Release Automatic; Open; In Process

Title: Error "No authorization for 'InterfacePattern..." When Trying to Create Sales Quote via Webservice ManageCustomerQuoteIn
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a Sales Quote via Webservice ManageCustomerQuoteIn, the creation fails with error "No authorization for 'InterfacePattern <default> SAVE' on instance 'ABC' of 'BONodeProxy'" (Where ABC Represents the ID of the Instance).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run the Payload for Sales Quote creation on the ManageCustomerQuoteIn interface.-The creation fails with an error that follows this pattern: -<SeverityCode>3</SeverityCode>-<Note>RBAM: No authorization for 'InterfacePattern <default> SAVE' on instance 'ABC' of 'BONodeProxy <default> -Cause-This error can happen when the Sales Unit is not specified in the payload. The system is unable to create the document due to this missing information.-Resolution-You need to include the information about the Sales Unit in the payload sent to the ManageCustomerQuoteIn interface.-This is a sample snippet of how the information needs to be included:-<SalesUnitParty>- <PartyID>DEF</PartyID>-</SalesUnitParty>-Where DEF represents the ID of the Sales Unit.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Creation, Error, Web Service, Webservice, Failed, Payload, Response

Title: Error "Inventory in logistics area not available" when inserting Logistics Area manually.
Content: Symptom-System cannot process a Supplier Return due to error "Inventory in logistics area not available" when inserting Logistics Area manually.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Search for Task ID ABC (ABC means the Task ID).-Insert Logistics Area manually and receive errors "Inventory in logistics area not available" "Line item 1: Logistics Area XYZ not valid" (XYZ means the Logistics Area)-Cause-When you are selecting manually source Logistics Area, it is necessary check if Restricted checkbox is marked. If yes, it will not be possible to select Logistics Area.-Resolution-It is necessary to confirm when it is selecting manually Logistics Area if Restricted checkbox is marked and after that it is necessary check if Restricted checkbox under Target session is marked as well. If it is, you need to unmark it.-Keywords-Source Logistics Area, Task, Inventory, Restricted

Title: Share Sales Order Query Settings to Other Users
Content: Symptom-How to share the query settings to find Sales Orders using Product XYZ to other Users (XYZ represents Product ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The Query needs to be created in Adaptation mode and then publish it to all users it should be available for all users. Kindly follow below steps to do the same:-Click on the Avatar.-Click on the Key User Settings and select Start Adaptation Mode.-Navigate to the Sales work center.-Select the Sales Order view.-Open Advanced Filter, create the query for Product ID XYZ (XYZ represents Product ID).-Then, Save Query and Rename as "ABC" (ABC represents the query ID).-Publish and save the changes to all the users. -Change another user to logon the system, you can find the custom search query ABC.-Keywords-Sales Order; Query Settings; Product; Adaptation Mode

Title: Cash Payment created via ManageCashPaymentOrderIn Web Service
Content: Symptom-You have created a cash payment using ManageCashPaymentOrderIn web service and observed that the system do not show Cash Discount line item in Journal Entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click on Payment Monitor view. -Select the Cash Payment created via ManageCashPaymentOrderIn web service.-Open the Journal Entry ID.-Here, you cannot find Cash Discount line item. However, the Cash Payment shows some discounted amount in Cash Discount in Original Document Currency field.-Cause-The XML or Payload information is not correctly formatted. You have used the field "TransactionCurrencyCashDiscountAmount". The field is not relevant to trigger Cash Discount in accounting.-Resolution-In the XML or Payload information you have to include "CashDiscountAmount" field. The Cash discount will appear under "Taken Cash Discount" field in Payment.-Once the XML or Payload has corrected then the system will display Cash Discount line item in Journal Entry.-Keywords-Cash Payment, Cash Discount in Journal Entry, ManageCashPaymentOrderIn Web Service

Title: Error "New case for conflict resolution" Occurs When Scoping Sell Project-Based Products and Services
Content: Symptom-When you scope "Sell Project-Based Products and Services" in Business Configuration, below error occurs-New case for conflict resolution-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Scoping step.-Expand Sales, Product and Service Portfolio for Sales.-Select Sell Project-Based Products and Services.-Click Next.-Then error New case for conflict resolution occurs.-Cause-Due to a constraint, with scoping "Sell Project-Based Products and Services", it is necessary that also Business Package "Project Planning and Execution" comes into scope. This, in turn requires a conscious decision by you in the area of Resource Management, which the system unfortunately cannot make on its own.-Resolution- To resolve the issue, please proceed as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Scoping step.-For now do not scope "Sell Project-Based Products and Services", but instead check "Project Planning and Execution" under "Project Management".-Navigate to Questions step.-Under "Project Management"-"Project Planning and Execution", select "Project Resource Management", and on the right hand side, group "Resource Management", you need to decide whether to select question "Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on  Commitment Quantity of the employee from Projects Team and Staffing?" If necessary, check this question.-Select Next to finish the changes.-Once this is saved, please go to scoping again and now you should be able to check "Sell Project-Based Products and Services".-Keywords-New case for conflict resolution; Sell Project-Based Products and Services; Business Configuration; Scoping

Title: Save Query Button is Not Visible in the UI of a Custom Screen
Content: Symptom-You have added a "Save Query" or "Organize Queries" button in the OWL Advanced List Pane, but these buttons are not visible in the UI.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to frontend UI.-Navigate to the screen.-Click on Advanced Search icon.-You will see that the query buttons are missing.-Cause-To make the "Save Query" button work, a stable anchor for the Default Set in the DefaultSet Mapping of the Advanced List Pane has to be added, as well as an anchor for the query on Controller tab.-Resolution-The steps you need to perform to add the anchor for the custom screen are:-Open UI Designer.-Navigate to the respective screen.-Select the Advanced List Pane - Object WorkList.-Configure the DefaultSetMapping.-Add an Anchor.-After the anchor is created for the default set, you have to add a stable anchor to the query in the Controller tab.-Save and Activate the OWL.-NOTE: If you have more than one Query or DefaultSet, an anchor should be defined for all of them.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, save, organize, query, queries, anchor, missing, UI, custom, screen, extensibility-enable save query,enable save button in custom ui

Title: How To Fix Error 'Cost object type could not be derived from coding block type PRO'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer has posted goods and services receipts with account assignment to a project task, however the document remains stuck under source documents view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Source Documents view.-Find the related unposted goods and services receipt.-You see the error message: 'Cost object type could not be derived from coding block type PRO'-Cause-The project task used as account assignment could not be found in the Financial Accounting View of Project BO due to a stuck XI message.-Transaction: SRT_MONI-The XI messages can be found via transaction SRT_MONI:-Define a suitable time range.-Specify Processing Status Group as Erroneous.-Fill is Sender Party as ProjectProcessing.-Fill in Receiver Interface Name as CostingProjectCostingIn.-Execute.--> This will show some Failed XI Messages related to the project.-On transaction SESFTS, you can load the BO FIA_FAV_PROJECT-Select Load by Query-Select Root - Query by Project-Enter the Project ID into the ProjectReference/FormattedID-No values will appear.-Resolution-Complete a dummy change on the Project. Such as changing the Project name, save changes. And then change the name back again. With this dummy change you are re-saving the Projet details to the above mentioned BO.-Again you can recheck if the Project details appear in the BO FIA_FAV_PROJECT. Once you can see the Project is available in this BO you can restart the XI messages that appear as mentioned in SRT_MONI in the above steps.-Once the message is delivered, the customer shall be able to post the unposted source documents.-See Also-Keywords-Project Management. Cost. Cost Object. Account Assignment. Project Task, block type PRO.

Title: Howto Check If the Tenant is Isolated
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***--"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-It is not possible to change the project scope, or to perform the merge from a test system to the productive system. Usually the following error message is thrown when trying to navigate between the steps:-“Load scoping workspace model failed” (when trying to access scoping or fine tuning)-"Internal error during merge. Please create an incident. (when trying to merge)- When checking the issue using transaction SLG1, the following error message is displayed:-    Consumer is temporarily isolated. No processing is allowed.-    SOAP:1,044 SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated. No processing is allowed.-    Error when processing Web service call; processing terminated; for more information, see the system log or error log files.-    An exception occurred in include CL_SOAP_RUNTIME_CLIENT========CM005 in line 065.-    Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated. No processing is allowed."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First Case:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation view.-Select the change project and click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Click on the Next button.-The error message is displayed.-Second Case:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation view.-Select the Change Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Search by the Merge the Changes Back to Production System.-The merge fails and an error message is displayed.-Cause-The concept of tenant isolation was introduced for use cases in the following area:-System is copied/cloned: In this time no further messages shall be sent out or be received by the original system.-A copy of a system still has the old configurations. In this case the copied system must not send data out to other productive systems over existing configurations, until the productive use is not switched to the copy.-The reason why the system is isolated is to avoid sending and receiving web service messages.-The reason why the system is not de-isolated after the provisioning, is due to a NetWeaver bug.-Resolution--First verify if the system is really isolated.-Open the incident in BCP and request user.-Click More-> STFK.-Click red icon of R/3 Support and change it to green.-Click Request Opening-> Open.-Click Logon-> No Password.-Input tenant, user and password, then press Enter.-On the top, input Transaction "SE16" and press Enter.-Enter the table “SRT_ISO_SET_C”.-Click Enter.-Click on Execute.--In this table an 'X' in the Isolated column marks an isolated system.--In order to de-isolate the system, send the incident to Operations team (Hosting) with information about the tenant ID and requesting help to de-isolate it.-See Also-3234355 - URL for Outbound Communication Missing-2986871 - Vertex Error: SOAP:1,044 SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated.No processing is allowed-Keywords-Tenant, Isolated, Error, Consumer is Temporarily Isolated, No Processing is Allowed

Title: How to Revert the Status of an Implementation Project from Tested to Started?
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--How to revert the status of a Implementation Project or a Change Project from status Tested to Started?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In order to revert the Project status from Tested to Started, please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Highlight Implementation Project or Change Project and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Test phase.-Highlight Confirm Milestone: Go-Live Readiness Acceptance activity and select Open button.-Uncheck Go-Live Readiness Accepted check box.-Select Confirm button.-Now, you can find that the status of the Implementation Project or Change Project reverted to Started.-See Also-You can also rever the KBA: 1922087 - How to Create a Change Project and Its Lifecycle -Keywords-Tested, Started, Go-Live Readiness Acceptance activity, Go-Live, Readiness Acceptance activity.

Title: How to add approval details to purchase order form template
