Content: Symptom-How to add approval details to purchase order form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view -Select the Purchase Order number and click on Preview tab-Open the form, there is no approval details in the form-You want to add this information to the form template, but you can't find it when creating new form template for purchase order-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Approval details are internal information, which is not a mandatory information for suppliers. Hence it is not included in the purchase order output form template. -Resolution-The approval details cannot be directly added to purchase order form template. -As a Workaround, an Extension field to store the Approval details can be created , and then this Extension field can be added to the PO Output Form Template, which will help to achieve this request. -Firstly, follow the below steps to create an Extension field:-Navigate to a screen where you want to add the new field.-From the Adapt menu, select Enter Adaptation Mode.-In Adaptation Mode, select Edit Screen from the Adapt menu.-Click on the Extension Fields pane of the Adaptation panel.-Select a section from the list, or alternatively, click directly on a section that has been enabled for Extension fields on the screen.-Click Add.-Select a Field Type.-Enter a Field Label.-Save your changes.-Select the Visible checkbox next to the Extension field to make it visible on the current screen.-Click Save.-  After creation of the Extension field, please follow the below steps to add the Extension field to Form Template:-Go to the respective Work Center.-In the screen where you have created an extension field, choose the Adapt button on the right corner of the screen and select the option Enter Adaptation Mode.-It opens a confirmation screen, select the YES option.-Again choose the Adapt button on the right corner of the screen and select the option Edit Screen.-Select the heading Extension Fields you can see the extension field has been marked for display.-Highlight the field and select the Further Usage link, it opens a page.-In the Form Templates tab, highlight the Form Template.-Select Add Field and Edit button, choose either Easy Form Editor or Adobe LiveCycle Designer.-Note: Easy Form Editor, will extend the field to Easy Form Editor and you can set the conditions (Show always, show if exists and do not show). Adobe LiveCycle Designer will generate the binding path and you need to create a field using Adobe LiveCycle Designer and assign the binding path.-The Field Available option will be checked for the respective template.-Note: If you wants to extend the field to another screen then go to the Extension Scenarios tab and user Add Field to extend to selected screen- See Also-1764460 - How to Add Extension Field in the From Templates?-2905703 - How to Work with Extension Scenarios-Keywords-Approval, Form Template, Purchase Order, Easy Form Editor, Adobe LiveCycle Designer

Title: How to Personalize UI for a User Through Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You may have a requirement to personalize particular UI for a user at backend. How to achieve this?-Resolution-Login to the backend of the system.-Run Tcode SE38.-Execute the report AP_UI_XTS_GET_FLEX_INFOS.-In the resulting screen, input: XRepository - file path: '/SAP_BYD_UI_CT/Main/root.uiccwoc' and Username: the backend-(abap-) user name of the customer.-The report basically displays all personalization information for a specific user and a specific UIComponent.--The UIComponent '/SAP_BYD_UI_CT/Main/root.uiccwoc' is used to store general personalization information like TabbedNavigation.

Title: An Outgoing Payment is not Shown in the Payment Assignment tab of a Payment Allocation as Expected
Content: Symptom-You edit a payment allocation, and then go to the Payment Assignment tab to select a specific outgoing bank transfer payment, but the outgoing bank transfer is not shown in the list.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center, and select the Payment Allocation view.-Find the payment allocation XYZ (XYZ means the payment allocation ID), and then Edit it.-Navigate to the Payment Assignment tab, and then try to select the outgoing cash payment ABC (ABC means the outgoing cash payment ID).-But outgoing cash transfer ABC is not shown in the list as expected.-Cause-You create an outgoing cash payment directly from a bank statement, but you do not specify the Customer/Supplier ID, or Invoice ID for the payment item, so a payment allocation XYZ is generated which requires your manual action. Meanwhile you create the outgoing cash transfer ABC from a different bank account other than the bank account from which you make the outgoing cash payment via bank statement, moreover, this cash transfer is made to a petty cash fund, so the cash payment and the cash transfer are not related, and this is why you cannot find the cash transfer from Payment Assignment list of the payment allocation XYZ.-Resolution-If it's meant to make the outgoing cash payment from the Petty Cash, you should follow the steps below to make the payment:-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Choose the Petty Cash view.-Select New Outgoing Cash Payment - Reference to Open Items, for details, check the help document: Create an Outgoing Cash Payment.-While for the payment directly made in bank statement, you can edit the bank statement, and then choose Reverse, so the payment is then canceled.-For the outgoing cash transfer ABC to a petty cash fund, you need to confirm it in the bank statement.-Create a new bank statement for the concerned bank account, in the second step, you can see the cash transfer payment, select it.-Then release the bank statement.-If the payment made in bank statement is not meant to be canceled, then you can follow the steps below to process:-In the Payment Management work center, choose the Payment Allocation view.-Search payment allocation XYZ, and then edit it.-In the Customer/Supplier ID field, enter the related ID.-From the Open Items list, select the open item to clear.-If there is no open item to be cleared, you can choose Assign Payment On Account, to directly pay the payment on the customer or supplier account. In this way, the payment allocation XYZ will be released.-For the outgoing cash transfer ABC, it's the same process as described above, that is to say, you need to confirm it in the bank statement.-Create a new bank statement for the concerned bank account, in the second step, you can see the cash transfer payment, select it.-Then release the bank statement.-See Also-Help Document: Create and Outgoing Cash Payment-Keywords-outgoing cash payment; payment allocation; assign on account payment

Title: Extension field content from Product Master Data is not displayed in Put Away Task.
Content: Symptom-The content of extension field ABC (ABC means the extension field) displayed in Product Master Data is not displayed in Put Away Task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Find and open Task ID DEF (DEF means the Task ID).-Go to View All.-Notice that the extension field ABC is not populated.-However, if looking in Product Master Data the same field is populated.-Cause-From Product Master data, where extension field ABC shows data, there is no extension scenario to inbound processing and that is the reason why ABC shows blank in Put Away Task DEF.-Resolution-To enable the value of an extension field between two documents to be passed, it is necessary to ensure that the corresponding extension scenario exists between the two business contexts. However, the system does not have a standard connection between inbound delivery and warehouse request, so this is the reason that you will not be able to have the field populated.-Keywords-Extension Field, Put Away Task, Task Control, Product

Title: Creation of Serial Number Failed
Content: Symptom-Error "creation of serial number XXX failed" occurs when posting goods receipt for Customer Return Notification (IDN).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Inbound Delivery Notifications View.-Search for the IDN YYY.-Choose Post Goods Receipt button.-Go to Line Items- Serial Number subtab.-Fulfill the Serial Number as XXX, then the error occurs.-Cause-You did not fill in serial number for the product while creating an IDN and you filled in the SN when posting goods receipt based on this.-Therefore the expected error would occur.-Resolution-Please fill in the new serial number for the product during creating the IDN, if you want to create a new serial number.-Keywords-Creation of serial number failed;  Customer Return Notification; Post Goods Receipt.

Title: Outbound Messages are Sent if the Communication System is Obsolete
Content: Symptom-You have created an external web service integration on your add-on from the SAP Cloud Applications Studio and also created the communication arrangement, communication scenario and communication system.-Even after changing the communication system to obsolete, the outbound messages are still being sent from the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-Outbound messages for a custom web service interface are still sent if the communication system is obsolete or if the "Outbound Communication Enabled" option is turned off from the communication arrangement.-Resolution-You would need to delete the related communication arrangement or comment the ABSL script lines where the outbound web service call is done from the add-on.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, WS, web, service, integration, disable, enabled, communication, triggered, message

Title: Error Message: Company XYZ not allowed, as it corresponds to the account ZZZ, While Assigning a Company to an Account
Content: Symptom-When trying to assign a Company to an Account, system throws below error message:-Customer or supplier is invalid-Company XYZ (XYZ represents Company Name) not allowed, as it corresponds to the account ZZZ (ZZZ represents Account Name)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Locate an Account.-Select Edit button and choose Financial Data option.-In the Companies section, select Add Row button.-Select Company XYZ.-Cause-The issue here is that you're trying to assign Company XYZ to a Account which was actually created out of the Company XYZ.-This is against standard business protocols because it could result in generating revenue from internal transactions, which goes against standard business practices and could potentially violate legal regulations.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords- Company, Account, Financial Data

Title: In a Third Party Order Scenario, the Seller Tax Country of the Customer Invoice is Not the Expected One
Content: Symptom-In a third party order scenario, the seller tax country of the customer invoice is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Document view-Edit the Customer Invoice XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the customer invoice).-Go to View All.-Go to the General tab-You can see that the Seller Tax Country is XX which is not the expected one and the following warning message is triggered : Check tax codes; taxation for chain transaction may apply. (XX represents the Country).-Navigate to the Items tab. -Select any Line Item and the Taxes sub tab. -You can see that the Tax Country is XX. -Cause-As the scenario is the a third party order scenario, in the customer invoice, the tax country of the item and the seller tax country in the General tab will be set by default to the country of the ship-from party which is set up in the corresponding sales order. The system will generate a warning message as follows: Check tax codes; taxation for chain transaction may apply.-Resolution-You have the possibility to change manually the tax information in your Invoice Document.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Click Invoice button.-Under the General tab, navigate to the Seller's Tax Registration.-Here you can change the Tax Country/Region which will reflect to the Tax Country under the Taxes subtab.-Please note that in case the document has already been invoiced, it is not possible to change the Tax Country, even if the Customer Invoice is still Not Released.-See Also-2427419 - How to use Activate Tax Trace-Keywords-Tax Country, Tax Info, Change, Modify, Rollback, Edit, Unable, Impossible, Greyed Out, Grayed, Invoice-Country

Title: Customer Invoice Not Included in Dunning Proposal List
Content: Symptom-A Dunning Run was executed; however, an overdue customer invoice was not included in the resulting Dunning Proposal list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the Dunning view.-Show All Dunning Proposals.-Search for the Dunning ID: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the Dunning).-Click on the ID.-Select the Dunning Items tab.-Invoice XYZ is missing in the Dunning Proposal List (XYZ represents the overdue invoice ID expected to appear in the Dunning Proposal list).-Cause-There are few causes that may result in this issue:-A dunning level is not defined for the document type (invoice or down payment request).-The invoice was excluded because its due date falls outside the configured dunning interval window.-The receivable has already been dunned and the next dunning level has not yet been reached.-The highest dunning level has already been reached.-It has been agreed with the customer that payments will be made by direct debit.-The receivable has been blocked for dunning.-The customer has been blocked for dunning.-Once the Receivable item or the Customer satisfy one of the status listed above, the Receivable item is not included in the Dunning Proposal list.- Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.- See Also-Help Portal Document: Automatic Dunning-Keywords-Dunning Run, Dunning Proposal List, Cycle de Relance Client, Facture Echue, Highest dunning level.

Title: How The Price Component Value is Calculated in Invoice Documents
Content: Symptom-How to check if the Price Component Value is correct for the Customer Invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to the Invoice Documents View.-In the search field, Search for the Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Select View All.-Go to the Pricing tab.-In the Line item, select the dropdown arrow.-The Price Component Value is displayed in the system.-Resolution-The calculation of the Price Component Value is performed using Base UoM (Unit of Measure) maintained for the Line Item in the system. - While performing the calculation of the amount for Price Component Value in the Customer Invoice document, the system multiplies the Price List of Line Item by the quantity maintained in the document always using the Base UoM (Unit of Measure) of the Material.-The equation for this calculation is:-(Price List * Base UoM) = Price Component Value-In case there is a quantity conversion maintained for the material, the system will always convert the quantity to the Base UoM when performing the calculation.-The equation for this calculation is:-(Price List *Base UoM*UoM converted) = Price Component Value-Note: A Line Item can have other price components that can affect the Total amount of the Price Component Value, the equations showed above can only be applied in case no other price component was used for the Invoice of the Line Items.-Keywords-price component value, base uom, uom, calculation, quantity conversion, conversion, quantity, unit of measure

Title: Unable to Delete the Note From the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Supplier Invoice with note type Remark from Supplier, however you have entered a wrong note in the Supplier Invoice and need to remove the note from the Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the Common Tasks and select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Fill the mandatory details and navigate to Items tab.-Select Note sub-tab and enter Note Type Remark From Supplier.-Select Save.-After that try to delete the note.-See that the note is still there.-or-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Entry view.-Search for the relevant document.-Click on New Invoice.-Fill the mandatory details and navigate to Items tab.-Select Note sub-tab and enter Note Type Remark From Supplier.-Select Save.-After that try to delete the note.-See that the note is still there.-Cause-Once you save the document the note cannot be removed.-Resolution-System is working as per the designed behavior. If you add and save any notes to the Supplier Invoice (Remark From Supplier or Approval Note), it is not possible to remove the note from the Invoice. -Kindly make sure that, you have entered the correct Note in the Supplier Invoice, before the Save action. If you still do not want to send the Supplier Invoice with wrong note, you can Delete the Invoice (if the document is In Process status) or Cancel the invoice.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Remark from Supplier, Approval Note, Note

Title: 'Foreign Currency Account No. is 8 digits, other Account No. is 7 digits' Error While Creating Bank Account for Japan
Content: Symptom-Error message is thrown while creating/editing a Bank Account Number for a Japanese bank (or) when adding the bank data in supplier master.-Foreign Currency Account No. is 8 digits, other Account No. is 7 digits-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Master Data > My Banks view.-Select the respective My Bank ID and click Edit > Bank Accounts.-Click Add Row.-Enter Bank Account Number with 9 digits and hit Enter in the keyboard.-Error message is thrown: Foreign Currency Account No. is 8 digits, other Account No. is 7 digits-(or)-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Select the respective Supplier ID.-Click on Edit-Financial Data ->Bank Data tab.-Enter Bank Account Number with 9 digits and hit Enter in the keyboard.-Error message is thrown: Foreign Currency Account No. is 8 digits, other Account No. is 7 digits-Cause-For Japanese bank accounts with 9 digits a specific Account Type should be used.-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Select the respective Supplier ID.-Click on Edit ->Financial Data ->Bank Data tab.-Select Account Type : other Account (only for Japan) under Additional Details-Now, you are able to accommodate Japanese 9 digits bank accounts.-Resolution-The Account Type to be used in this case is: other Account (only for Japan). This account type has been built specifically to accommodate Japanese 9 digits bank accounts.-Keywords-other account; only for japan; FOP_BANKCCOUNTCHECKS; FOP_BANKCCOUNTCHECKS:031; 9 digits; japan; japanese

Title: Confirmation Date Status and Confirmation Quantity Status is "Unknown" in Customer Demand
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL ONLY-In Customer Demand ABC-100(where ABC is the customer demand ID and 100 is the line item ID) you notice that Confirmation Date Status and Confirmation Quantity Status is "Unknown".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Outbound Logistics Control workcenter and Customer Demand view.-2. Find Customer Demand ABC line item 100-You can see that Confirmation Date Status and Confirmation Quantity Status is "Unknown"-Cause-There was a missing Logistics Execution Request node level for the Customer Demand ABC-Line 100 (sales kit item) hence the inconsistency.-Resolution-Send the incident to Development component AP-CR-CR to adjust the missing node.-After the backend correction Confirmation Date Status and Confirmation Quantity Status will be updated.-Note: 1. Valid values for Confirmation Date Status is Early, On Time, Late.-Valid values for Confirmation Quantity Status is Not Confirmed, Incomplete, Complete, Split.-Keywords-Confirmation Date Status , Confirmation Quantity Status, Unknown, Customer Demand, Logistics Execution Request, Outbound Logistics Control

Title: Unable to Create Project Stock Order When All Materials Are Non Stock
Content: Symptom-The user cannot raise Project Stock Order for specific project due error message 'Project stock order not created; all materials are non stock'. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view. -Search for project ABC (ABC is the project's ID). -Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Product Overview tab.-Select product XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the product). -Click in Create Project Stock Order button and select 'For Whole Project' or 'For Released Project tasks'.-You get error message: 'Project stock order not created; all materials are non stock'.-Also you cannot edit the product to 'From Stock':-Open Project ABC. -Navigate to Project Plan tab, Gantt Chart subtab and Materials sub subtab. -You can see that material XYZ is not flagged for 'From Stock' column. It is not editable.  -Also the Delete button is grayed out. -Cause-You cannot create Project Stock Order for a material that is 'non-stock'. -Resolution-You can follow the workaround below:  -Open Project ABC. -Navigate to Project Plan tab and Gantt Chart subtab.-Create a new Task under the main task ABC. You can create task ABC-1, for example. -Select the newly created task. -Navigate to Materials sub subtab. -Click in Add Row button. -Enter product XYZ, check mark the option 'From Stock' and enter the planned quantity.-Click in Save button. -Navigate to Product Overview tab. -Select product XYZ (the one which is 'From stock'). -Click in Create Project Stock Order button and select 'For Whole Project' or 'For Released Project tasks'. -See Also-KBA: 2038616 - Error Message : Project stock order not created; all materials are non stock-Keywords-Project Stock Order; Non-Stock; Material; Project

Title: How to Complete Purchase Order Notification Task
Content: Symptom-You have received purchase order notification task(Notification - Approved Purchase Order Changed) in your inbox but do not know how to remove it from your open task list.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Inbox view-You can see purchase order notification open tasks with subject:Notification - Approved Purchase Order Changed-Cause-This is a standard notification which is raised when a purchase order has been changed after getting approved once.-The relevant users receive the notification in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center.-Resolution-To complete the notification and remove it from the worklist, you can acknowledge it as follows:-Go to the Home work center  Work view  Inbox subview.-Select the notification.-Click Actions and acknowledge the notification.-OR-The default priority of this type of notification is medium but can be configured. The system automatically cancels the notification after 30 days.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dcb52ad722d1014b8c4eccb5ceba233.html?version=2305-Keywords-purchase order notification task, how to complete notification task

Title: Error Information "Creating data not possible; creation disabled" is Displayed After Performing the Restart of a Error Message in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer has properly maintained a valid inventory cost in the Product Master Data, to solve the error "Item: XX, Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material YYYY in company ABC for date Z" in a Completed Sales Order.-However after performing the restart of the error message "Item: XX, Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material YYYY in company ABC for date Z" in the backend, the error information changes to "Creating data not possible; creation disabled".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Transaction SEFTS.- Search for the BO name -> APCR_CUSTOMER_REQ.- Select the arrow in the folder Icon.- Select the option Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.- In the "BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentID/content" field, insert the Sales Order ID ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).- Select Confirm.- In the BO Instance Structure Column, Right click the Customer Requirement ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Customer Demand ID).- Select Message Monitoring -> Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow.-Mark the error message with the error information "Item: XX, Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material YYYY in company ABC for date Z".-Select Action button.-Select Restart button.-The Error Information changes to "Creating data not possible; creation disabled".-Cause-According to the development team, the item is read only and therefore the system do not allow the creation of the cost pricing component. This cause the error message to not be delivered and change it to "Creating data not possible; creation disabled" after the restart.-Resolution-The pricing component requires to be created by the development team via debugging in the backend and then restart the XI message.-Kindly forward the case to the development team in order to apply the correction for the error message in the backend.-See Also-Please kindly refer to the KBA below to find further information regarding the steps solve the error "Item: XX, Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material YYYY in company ABC for date Z" when displayed in a Sales Order document.-2879580 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Order: "Costs not determined"  -Keywords-creating data not possible, creation disabled, backend, error message, restart, error information, costs not determined, there no inventory cost for material

Title: Reporting based on field “Supplier’s Sales Order ID/Item”.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to find a Report or a Data Source where the field “Supplier’s Sales Order ID/Item” is present.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-WoC Purchase Request and Order-Purchase Order View-Search, Edit and View All the Purchase Order ABC-Go to the Document Flow tab and open the related Purchase Order Acknowledgement-From this view, you can find the field “Supplier’s Sales Order ID/Item”-You are trying to report based on this field-Cause-There is no Report or Data Source related to this field in the current version of Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Please create a customized Report or Data Source in order to achieve your goal.-Keywords-Supplier’s Sales Order ID/Item, Purchase Order Acknowledgement, Report, Data Source

Title: Unable to Replicate Employee Due to Error "Employee X has more than one position assignment per time frame"
Content: Symptom-It is not being possible to replicate an employee due to error message:-Error activating employee assignment at position; see detailed messages-Save failed-Employee X (X represents the name of the employee) has more than one position assignment per time frame.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication Work Center. -Go to Employees view.-Search for the employee to be replicated and click Edit.-Click the Replicate Button.-Once the replication is processed, the error message appears.-Cause-This might be occurring because already  a position assigned for a period exists, and system currently cannot also create this employee as an internal employee at the same time for overlapping period.-Example a) Overlapping time frames as employee and service agent:-The employee had been a service agent for period DD.MM.YYYY-Unlimited and had also been staffed under Cost Center: XYZ (XYT represents Cost Center ID). This has internally created a position for this employee for this period.-With new replication request, the system is now trying to staff this employee as an internal employee again for this period which also created a position but this time it overlaps with the existing one (as a service agent).-In order to check it, please follow the steps below:-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee and check if there are more than 1 record.-If yes, select the Last Successful Replication Request.-Click Edit.-Go to Organizational Assignment Tab and check the Organizational Assignment validities assigned.-Go to Employment Tab and check the Work Agreement validities.-After that come back to Employees view in Master Data Replication work center.-Search for the employee again and select Last Failed Replication Request.-Go to Employment Tab and check the Work Agreement validities.-Here you will see that times are overlapping.-Such issues might also appear, if the stored in the backend does not match the replication.-Example b) Overlapping time frames as employee:-The following situation is found for an employee:-Last Successful Replication:-Work Agreement End Date: 31.12.2021-Latest Replication Error:-Work Agreement End Date: 31.12.9999-The backend currently maintains a work agreement date range from e.g. 01.01.2020 to 31.12.2021. However, in the latest replication record, the work agreement End Date of 31.12.9999 has been registered, leading to an error state in the replication process.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-a) Employment and Organizational Assignments information should be such that it does not overlap with the existing one for Service Agent and delimits it first.-b) Ensure that workagreement info is consistent. Ideally and for the given example, the work agreement record in the backend should reflect either an End Date of 31.12.9999 instead of 31.12.2021 or alternatively, a second record with a Start Date of 01.01.2022 and an End Date of 31.12.9999 should exist.-Keywords-Replication, AP-HMD-RPL, HCM

Title: "Total" and "Total (Transactional Currency)" Value Mismatch in "Customer Invoice Item [CRMCIVIB]" Data Source Based Report.
Content: Symptom-In some Invoices in a report based on Data Source "Customer Invoice Item [CRMCIVIB]", the "Total" Key Figure shows a negative value, while the "Total (Transactional Currency)" Key Figure has a positive value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search for report ABC (ABC represents the Report ID).-Open it.-Filter by Invoice DEF (DEF represents the Invoice ID).-You will see the difference in values between the Key Figures.-Cause-This happens when Cancellation Invoices are being shown in the report. For those Invoices, the "Total" Key Figure includes a negative sign to represent a Cancellation, while the "Total (Transactional Currency)" Key Figure does not have this distinction and shows the value as is displayed in the document.-This behaviour is same for Net Value (Transactional Currency)-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Platform to submit an idea.-Keywords-Report, Invoice, Minus, Negative, Mismatch, Incorrect, Positive; positive value; currency positive;

Title: No Values are Displayed When Selecting the option "Release Status" as a Condition for a Workflow Rule with Business Object Quote
Content: Symptom-You would like to setup a Workflow Rule to receive a notification for when a Service/Sales Quote is submitted to approval, however when filtering for "Release Status" as a condition in the creation of a new Workflow Rule using Quote as the Business Object, no values are displayed in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to the Workflow Rules View.-Select New Button.-In the Description field, enter a desired description.-In the Business Object field, Select Quote.-In the Timing field, enter On Ever Save.-Select Next button.-Select Add Group.-In the dropdown, Select Release Status.-In the Compare Operator field, Select Equal to.-In the With field, Select Value.-In the blank field, Select the dropdown arrow.-No records found are displayed in the UI.-Cause-The "Release Status" condition can be selected as a option when creating a new Workflow Rule using Quote as the Business Object, however the condition will not display any values as Sales/Service Quote do not have the status Not Released/ Released.-Resolution-The possible workaround for this scenario is the creation of an extension field in the Sales/Service Quote document that can be used as a condition in the Workflow Rules to trigger the notification for the business users, however it is important to note that the extension field in the Service/Sales Quote will require to be filled manually based on the parameter set in the Workflow rule after the Sales/Service Quote is submitted.-Keywords-sales quote, service quote, quote, workflow rule, release status, submit, approval, business object

Title: Withholding Tax Return Not Processing Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice and the document computed the withholding tax. The invoice is paid and it tax amount is shown in the Withholding Tax Items report, hence you assume that the invoice will be processed in the next withholding tax return run. Nevertheless, the run returns no results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to List view.-Open the report Withholding Tax Items.-You see the tax base amount for the supplier invoice.-Go to Withholding Tax Returns view.-Create an appropriate tax return that covers the tax due date.-Execute the run.-You notice that even though the company is flagged to withheld taxes, the supplier master data is complete, the invoice has calculated withholding tax and payment has been made, the document was not considered in the tax return.-Cause-For the payments to be considered in the withholding return, the sum of the base amounts for an income type and business partner should meet a particular threshold. In this case, the sum of tax base amount is below the threshold amount for the given income type.-Resolution-Once you have sufficient documents such that the sum of the base amounts exceeds the threshold the documents will start being considered in the tax return.-You can check the threshold amounts for the income types via fine-tune activity Withholding Tax Return - <country code>.-See Also-2123734 - Supplier Invoices not Processed on a 1099-Misc Tax Reporting-2327747 - Income Type Missing in Supplier Invoice-Keywords-withholding tax return; tax base amount; threshold

Title: Changes Made in the Financial Structure Is Not Reflected in the Financial Statement Report
Content: Symptom-In the Business configuration work center, you choose a financial structure whose Financial Reporting Structure is I/S by Function of Expense and edit it by adding a Functional Area to the structure. But you cannot see the newly added functional area on the Financial Statement report. Also, more value is posted to the 9900-Not assigned functional area (P/L accts) than expected.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First of all, you edit the financial structure:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project in question, and choose Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Choose Edit financial reporting structures.-From the Available Financial Reporting Structures table, choose zXYZ (zXYZ represents the Financial Reporting Structure), whose Financial Reporting Structure is I/S by Function of Expense.-Choose Edit Structure.-Add one function area DEF (DEF represents the function area) to the structure.-In the meantime, you also go to the fine-tune activity of Settings for Income Statements by Functions of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Choose Edit the function area determination.-Choose the Accounting Principle.-Then, in the Determination Using General Ledger Accounts tab, assign the Functional Area DEF to a G/L Account.-Then, you go to check the Financial Statement report.-Go to the General Ledger work center, and choose the Reports view.-Select the Financial Statement report.-View the report.-In the Variables screen, choose zXYZ as the Financial Structure.-Choose Ok.-In the result list, expand the structure.-You cannot see the newly added function area on the structure. Also more value is posted to the 9900-Not assigned functional area (P/L accts) than expected.-  Cause-After the structure is changed, no postings are made to the G/L account that is assigned to functional area ZXYZ, so the functional area is not reflected on the Financial Statement report. Meanwhile, the system does not automatically reallocate the historical data according to the new functional area assignment, which is why you still see them in the 9900-Not assigned functional area (P/L accts).-  Resolution-In order to have the data correctly reflected in the Financial Statement report according to the functional area assignment, follow the steps below:-Go to the General Ledger work center, and create a new Journal Entry Voucher.-In the new Journal Entry Voucher, maintain the necessary information, and add a row.-If there is debit balance on the concerned account, then in this new row, enter the exact same debit amount for this account, the system automatically derives the latest functional area assignment for this line item. -Add another row to have a credit posting for the same account and amount.-For the credit line item, check Change Functional Area, and select the old Functional Area assignment of the account in order to balance the previous debit posting with the old functional area assignment. If there is no functional area assignment before, then you need to leave Functional Area blank here.-Choose Post.  -The balance on the account is then the same as before but with the correct Functional Area.-Keywords-Financial Reporting Structures, I/S, G/L account, function area, Report

Title: CostCentreID Field Missing in Items node of ManageAccountingEntryIn
Content: Symptom-You are checking the documentation for webservice ManageAccountingEntryIn and see that there is a CostCentreID field within the Items node, as per the documentation. However, when checking the sample payload you do not find the related field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view.-Find ManageAccountingEntryIn.-Open the documentation.-Check the details for the Item section.-You see that the documentation indicates the existence of CostCentreID tag at item level. However, the user does not find this tag when using the webservice.-Cause-The CostCentreID is not directly under the Item note. It is within the OverheadCostsLedgerAccountItem.-Resolution-Therefore, you can find the CostCentreID in the below structure:-<AccountingEntry>-  ...-   <Item>-    ...-     <OverheadCostsLedgerAccountItem>-      ...-       <CostCentreID>-Keywords-Service Interface. Web service. Journal Entry web service. Cost Center. CostCenterID.

Title: Standard Report does not show the GTIN number
Content: Symptom-You have opened data source Material General Data and UoM characteristics or Material General Data or a report based on them and noticed that the GTIN number is not shown for some Materials.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Data Sources.-Search for the data source (technical ID MAT_GENERAL_MULTI) and open the preview for it.-Go to the view and add characteristic GTIN.-You notice that # is shown instead of the original data.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-Please maintain all the UoM conversions and characteristics for the material in the master data and the data is available in the data source Material General Data and UoM characteristics or reports created on top of it.-See Also-This is the current system behaviour and works as designed. If you want to change the standard behaviour, please to go our SAP Influence Forum and post your idea. On this forum, other customers can vote for your requirement which will give us a better understanding on the priority of this functionality. Our product management delivers the features requested here according to priority and technical feasibility and effort.-Keywords-report; GTIN; not assigned; data source; #, MAT_GENERAL_MULTI, MAT_GENERAL, no data

Title: How to Create a New Bank Account Upon a Company Merge
Content: Symptom-You have processed the merge of two of your companies in ByDesign, however, the system does not allow you to create a new identical bank account for the newly created company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the MyBanks view.-Select your bank entity and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Create a new bank account record with identical bank details to the old company, however assigned to the new company.-The system raises an error message as follows: 'Combination of bank , account number <bank account number> with different company exists'-Cause-The error message is a proper and expected system check that does not allow one bank account to be assigned to two different companies.-Resolution-It is not possible to add the same account number for different companies unless the other account is closed.-Therefore, in order to have the same bank account number assigned to a different company ID, you have to close the existing bank account via below steps.-Be aware that before performing the Close action, you must bring the account balance to zero and make sure that you have Confirmed/Canceled all open transactions/items/payments in the system. Once the bank account is closed, this same entry cannot be re-activated.-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to MyBanks view.-Select your bank entity and click Edit -> Bank Accounts.-Select the bank account assigned to the old company and click Actions -> Close.-After closing the account, you are able to create a new bank account with the same number but assigned to the new company.-See Also-2568072 - You Are Unable to Close a Bank Account as Balance Is Not Zero-Keywords-new bank account; identical bank account

Title: Unable to get descriptor for BO
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are facing a dump which have the below error text on the Application Information section:-Unable to get descriptor for BO MyBO and namespace (where MyBO represents the name of a custom BO)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Resolution-Please ask the customer to activate this custom BO on the SAP Cloud Applications Studio (SDK) and also share to which PDI solution this belongs (which can be seen on the namespace from the error).-Keywords-PDI, SDK, error, dump, unable, to, get, descriptor, for, BO, and, namespace

Title: Allocated Budget field is not available in Migration of Projects template
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the field 'Allocated Budget' (in tab Financing Sources of any Project) in the Migration of Projects template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Migration of Projects.-Open it.-Click in link: Migrate projects using the migration tool.-Click in You Can Also button and select Download Migration Template.-Open the downloaded Excel template.-Unhide the Sheet Financing Sources.-You can see that there is no field as Allocated Budget.-Cause-The field 'Allocated Budget' is intentionally not available in the Migration of Projects template. That's because the costs for each project task have to be calculated. When the costs are known, then the budget can be allocated to the project task.-When entering Project data in the Migration template, in general the costs are not known. The system calculates the costs of a task when the project is created based on the assigned work packages, materials and expenses. The system also determines the currency of the Allocated Budget amount automatically. So there is no need to fill this information in the Migration template.-Currently the process is working as below:-Firstly create the Project from the Migration template.-Check the calculated costs.-Allocate the budget.-Finally release the Project. -Resolution-This is the currently system behavior.-Keywords-Migration template; Project; Allocated Budget

Title: Different Values in Forecast Consumption Report and Confirmation Journal Report
Content: Symptom-When using Forecast Consumption Report and Confirmation Journal Report, you get different results of XXX and YYY.-XXX = quantity in Forecast Consumption Report.-YYY = quantity in Confirmation Journal report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Select common task Forecast Consumption Report. -Filter by relevant product and relevant period.-Notice that Consumed Forecast is quantity XXX. -Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Find Confirmation Journal report (SCMCFJU01_Q0001)-Open the report-Filter by relevant product and relevant period.-Notice that the Amount of Effective Quantities is YYY instead XXX.-Cause-Once Sales Order is created in the system Forecast consumption report will get updated with Consumed Forecast quantity.-As once Outbound Delivery is released and Goods Activity Confirmation is created at that time that Confirmation Journal will fetch the Goods Activity Confirmation and show the quantity.-As the dates of creation of the Sales Order and creation of the Outbound Delivery can be different, the reports will display different values.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-report, forecast, forecasting

Title: More Filters Option Allows User to Remove Value of Read-Only Field
Content: Symptom-You realized that users could access ‘More Filters’ option of a read-only custom field and remove its values in Advanced Search. Then, you want to avoid users from removing filters of a read-only field and hence you would like to hide ‘More Filters’ option from your custom field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center view.-Click on Advanced Search.-Check your extension field read-only.-Click on More Filters option.-You can Edit and Remove Filter Conditions.-Cause-It happens because ‘ShowSelectOption’ parameter within UI Designer has ‘True’ maintained for the custom field. It then shows ‘More Filters’ option along with custom field.-Resolution-For hiding ‘More Filters’ options, you need to change value of ‘ShowSelectOption’ parameter by using UI Designer. You can then follow these steps:-Open Affected UI Component (e.g. /YABCDEFGH_MAIN/SRC/SAPTest_OWL.OWL.uicomponent).-Select the field.-Go to Properties tab.-Under Appearance, change the value of ‘ShowSelectOption’ from ‘True’ to ‘False’.-Save it.-Activate it.-Then, you will not be able to see the option ‘More Filters’ to be used on the user interface.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, extension, field, read, only, more, filter, selection, extension, remove, custom, advanced, search

Title: Unable to Delete an Attachment from a Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-You are not being able to delete an Attachment from a Credit Memo, as the Delete button is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2208 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the required Credit Memo ID.-Click Edit > View All.-In the General tab, click Attachments in the bottom of the screen.-Delete button is not available.-Cause-As the status of the Credit Memo is Released, it's not possible to delete an attachment.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. It's not possible to delete an attachment from a Credit Memo that has the Status as Released.-Keywords-Delete, Button, grayed out, not available, cannot delete, Credit Memo, Attachment.

Title: Key Figure Calculation From Cumulation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom----DO NOT USE- TO BE AMENDED----When trying to create a calculated key figure ABC using a custom cumulated key figure DEF, you can see the result does not consider the cumulation in the calculation of the key figure ABC.-ABC stands for a key figure ID.-DEF stands for a key figure ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Create the key figures ABC and DEF, where ABC is based on DEF.-Apply cumulation on the key figure DEF.-You’ll see that the key figure ABC shows the result without consider the cumulation of DEF.-Hence, the key figure ABC shows a wrong result.-Cause-The Cumulate feature is part of the local calculation settings of a key figure. It sums up the values after all the calculations of the key figure formula were performed (the cumulation happens just before the number be shown on the screen).-If such a key figure is used in another key figure, the values of the first key figure (DEF in our example) are never shown on the screen, but only used in the calculation of the key figure ABC. This means that the Cumulate setting has no effect on the key figure ABC.-It has similar behavior as the scenario 1 of KBA 2593540, where the order of the calculation affects its result.-Resolution-There is no technical error. The system works as expected.-Keywords-cumulation, accumulation, key figure, key figures, cumulated, accumulated

Title: Characteristics that are displayed as an Attribute in Reports
Content: Symptom-You found a field in a report (for example Report Profit Overview by Key Figure technical ID FINPRFU30_Q0002) via the Excel Add-in which was not available in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You open a report in the UI and then navigate to the Excel Add-in. There you are able to find field XYZ (Where XYZ represents the field name) which you cannot find in the system  via Add Fields.-Cause-The field is not a characteristic. It is called an attribute.-Resolution-You are looking to display an attribute in a report. In HTML5 all attributes are available via Add Fields (like normal characteristics).-But in Silverlight they are available from a different place.-To show an attribute in Silverlight please follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Analytics Workcenter.-Select Show Settings.-Open the Characteristics Settings.-In the General Tab under Characteristics in Rows, you will see one column called Attribute Shown.-Select the value help for this, you will get a list of all available attributes for this characteristic.-Now you can select an attribute and display it in the report.-See Also-More information can be found in the SAP Help Document Characteristic Settings available via the Help Center in SAP Business by Design.-Keywords-Characteristics; attribute; report; Excel Add-in; Add fields;

Title: Report Material Inventories - Balance Summary is Missing from Business Analytics work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Title: Unexpected Approval Status of the Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-A Sales Order has already finished the invoicing, and its status is already displayed as Completed. However, you find the approval status on this Sales Order to be displayed as Not Started, which is unexpected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ABC (where ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Open, Select View All-Navigate to the General tab-The status of the Sales Order ABC is already Completed, but the approval status for this Sales Order is shown as Not Started.-Cause-You have changed the activated Sales Order approval process after the delivery.-If you make any changes to an already defined and activated approval process for a Sales Orders, the system sets the approval status to Not Started. In this case, you have made changes on the activated approval process for Sales Orders, so the approval status changed into Not Started.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-approval status, sales order, not started, completed, delivery, change, invoicing

Title: Exception Settings Not Taken Over in Broadcasted Reports
Content: Symptom-In report ABC, on key figure DEF, you have set up an exception. For example, this key figure shows a different background colour when a certain value is reached. You have also set up a broadcast using this report. However, when opening the report from the broadcast, the exception (i.e. the background colour in this example) is missing and the key figure does not show the defined background colour.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report ABC from the work center Business Analytics.-Click on the key figure in the rows or columns and choose New Exception.-Choose the key figure DEF and set up the exception as required, for example by defining  a background colour for specific values.-Click OK. You will see the background colour in the report. Save this view.-Now go to the work center Business Analytics, view Broadcasts.-Click on New and set up a new broadcast with the report ABC as required.-When the recipient opens the report from the e-mail, the exception is not maintained and the background colour is not taken over.-Cause-Exceptions in broadcasts are not supported.-Resolution-Should you need this new  functionality you can create a request via the Influencer page (https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886) or consider creating a PDI solution, or contacting the SAP Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by the Cloud Service Center here.-You can contact the Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right-hand side here, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-See Also-2870727 - Exceptions/Conditional Formatting Settings in Report are not Taken Over in Excel-Keywords- Exception, Report, Color, Excel, Indicator, Conditional Formatting

Title: The tax code field is not available in Purchase Order template for Migration of Purchase Orders.

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Tax Code field is not available in Purchase Order template for Migration of Purchase Orders. The Tax Code field is available when creating Purchase Orders manually but not via Migration Tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects and select the Project.-Select Open Activity List and navigate to Integrate and Extend tab.-Select Migration of Purchase Orders activity.-Select Migrate Purchase Orders using the Migration Tool.-In the migration file, you are unable to enter the Tax code.-Cause-The Tax Code field is not available in the Purchase Orders template in Purchase Order Migration.-Resolution-This field is available when manually creating a Purchase Order, but not through the Migration Tool.-The Tax Code field in the migration template will be available in a future release.-Keywords-Purchase Order, Tax Code field, Migration Template

Title: Error Occurs in Customer Return 'Payment Card Blocked'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error occurs in Customer Return: Payment card blocked.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find ABC (ABC represents the return ID).-Edit the return.-Error occurs Payment card blocked.-Cause-The credit card used in the return has expired.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the account used in the customer return ABC).-Edit the account XYZ.-Go to the Financial Data tab.-Select the Bank Data sub-tab.-See the table Credit Cards.-Here select the credit card XXX and extend the date in Expiration Date column (XXX represents the credit card number).-Save the changes in account.-Now no error message appears in the return ABC.-- See Also-This case document is valid for the similar error message in other business documents like Sales Order.

Title: No Records Available in the Changes tab of an Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-There are no records available in the Changes tab of an invoice document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view and select All Invoice Documents from the dropdown option.-In the Find field search with ABC (where ABC is Invoice Document ID) and click the Go button.-Open Invoice Document ABC and go to the Changes tab.-You can see there is no record/details in the changes tab.-Cause-If you have directly released an invoice request, then invoice document created from it will have no details/records available within its Changes tab.-Therefore Invoice Document ABC ->Changes tab have no records, since preceding invoice request was directly released.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Filter in Excel Report Does not Work
Content: Symptom-You have opened a report via the Excel add-in. You mark a specific value in Excel which you would like to filter for. Clicking on the 'Set Filter for the Current Report' icon (next to the Selection icon) has no effect on the result, the data is not filtered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, Excel Add-In-SAP Cloud for Customer, Excel Add-In-Cause-You are using dynamic paging in your Excel report. This feature cannot be used in conjunction with Excel filters.-Resolution-Please switch off dynamic paging by following these steps:-In Excel, go to the ByDesign or Cloud for Customer tab.-Click Show / Hide > Dynamic Paging.-Untick the box for dynamic paging.-Close and reopen Excel. -Keywords-excel, report, business analytics, filters, no effect, not working, set filters for the current report

Title: Expense Reports for Mexico Does not Check for Duplicate Folio Fiscal/ Receipt ID in the Expenses
Content: Symptom-You are creating expense reports for the Mexican localization. When adding new expenses to the expense report, you fill in the Folio Fiscal/ Receipt ID field. However, you noticed that the ID has already been given in another expense item from another expense report.-You expect the system to raise a message informing about the duplicate receipt ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Scoping Country: MX - Mexico-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Reports view.-Find and open e.g. expense report AAA and BBB.-Go to Edit mode.-Go to Expenses tab.-Under Expense Data tab, refer to field Folio Fiscal/ Receipt ID.-You see that both expense report have the same Folio Fiscal/ Receipt ID. You expect the system to raise a message about the duplicate expense entry.-Resolution-This is not considered a legal requirement and would be the current system design, as the expense reports do not check for duplicate Receipt ID entries.-Keywords-Travel and Expenses. Expense and Reimbursement Management. Mexico.

Title: Error "Scheduling processed with warnings" When Changing Production Order
Content: Symptom-You have errors when trying to change the Earliest Start or the Latest End dates for the Production Order XXX.-XXX = Production Order ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center. -Select Production Orders view. -Find Production Order XXX. -Open the Production Order XXX. -Click View All. -Change the Earliest Start or Latest End dates. -The errors are faced:-Scheduling processed with warnings-An exception occurred-Error while processing-Cause-The operation timing of the Site is different from the operation timing of the Labor resource used.-Resolution-You need to change the operation timing of the Site or the operation timing of the Labor resource. Both operation timing needs to be the same.-Keywords-time, exception, date

Title: Basic search behavior with extension fields
Content: Symptom-You try to search, via the basic search, for a value which is contained in an extension field but the result is not as expected. If you use the filter option on the extension field column you can find the expected value.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-From the desired work center, open the desired view. In this example Product Data – Materials view. (the same is true for other business objects such as opportunity, ticket, etc., too).-Select the relevant query from the drop-down. For example 'All'.-Search for the desired value (for example a value available on an extension field XYZ), using the basic search. For example, the value XXX available on the extension field XYZ.-Result: The search doesn't return the expected result. It might a) not find the value XXX available on the extension field XYZ, or b) find different amounts of results compared to your expectation.-However, if you filter the column of the field XYZ directly with value XXX, results are found as expected.-Cause-The system behavior for the basic search consists in having a search limited to a fixed number of set fields.-If an extension field is added to the system, it will not be searchable using the basic search unless the field is added to the advanced search screen via adaptation mode.-Resolution-In order to make extensions fields searchable via the basic search the extension field must be added to the advanced search via adaptation mode, first.-This can be done as following:-From the desired work center, open the desired view. (Products, Opportunities, Tickets, etc.)-From the menu (Top right) select Start Adaptation.-From the main screen, select the Advanced search to expand the list of searchable fields.-Edit the screen (Advanced Search) to include the fields for which you require results to be found in your search, for example, add extension fields as needed.-Leave Adaptation mode after making the relevant changes. -Once fields are visible on the advance search pane, they can be searched also via the basic search.

Title: Error: Severity: is not allowed. PDI Solution:
Content: Symptom- You are facing the below error message when attempting to perform a save on any business transactional document or master data object:-Severity: X is not allowed. PDI Solution: YABCDEFGY_. (where "X" is the given severity and "YABCDEFGY_" is the custom solution namespace ID)- Business Object: BO1, Node: Node1, Method: DETERMINE_AFTER_MODIFY. (where "BO1" is the business object name, "Node1" is the node name and "DETERMINE_AFTER_MODIFY" is the event name)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue---Cause-The error occurs due to an event of type AfterModify or BeforeSave in the specified Business Object and Node, where a message is raised with a severity parameter that is not allowed.-The severity parameter allows the following values:-"E" for errors-"W" for warnings-"S" for success messages-"I" for information messages-Resolution-Verify the severity parameter in the event of type AfterModify or BeforeSave in the specified Business Object and Node.-Ensure the severity message parameter is supplied only with the allowed values: E (error), W (warning), S (success), or I (information). -See Also-SAP Help Portal:-Define a Message for a Business Object Extension-Raise Message (Business Logic)-Keywords-PDI, SDK, error, script, message, severity, allowed, logic, AfterModify, BeforeSave, warning message, event

Title: Duplicate Communication Arrangement in the Collaboration Tab of Account
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY**-When you open the Collaboration tab of an account, there are duplicate entries for the same document.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Access the Accounts work center view.-Select the relevant Account.-Select the Edit button, the select Addresses.-Navigate to the Collaboration sub-tab.-You can see that for one of the document types (for example, Customer Invoice / Credit Memo), there are duplicate entries.-Cause-The duplicate entries might have been caused by data migration, where the duplicate communication arrangement entry was created for the same account.-Resolution-To correct this:-Go to backend transaction SESFTS.-In the Load BO by Proxy Name field, enter CUSTOMER and select Enter.-To the right of the Load BO by Proxy Name field, click the arrow next to the folder icon.-Inside Load By Alternative Key, select OVERVIEW - INTERNAL_ID.----Paste the account ID and select Enter.-Select the Navigate button, then select ROOT.----Select the Navigate button again, then select COMMUNICAT_ARRANGEMENT.-Select the Navigate button again and this time, select CHILD_COMMUNICATION_ARRA.   -Select the Table View button to see all available values in the table.----Check for rows with the same value under the SIF_CODE-CONTENT  column; these rows will be the duplicate entries seen in the UI.----Select one of the duplicated rows and choose Edit an then Delete BO Node Instance (the trash can icon).----Select the Save button (the floppy disk icon) or press Ctrl + S.-Keywords-Output, Channel, Communication Arrangement, Communication, Collaboration, Tab, Duplicate, Delete, Backend, SESFTS, BO Test Shell

Title: Expose Option is Grayed out for some Data Sources
Content: Symptom-The Expose button is disabled (grayed out) for some data sources in your system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center and the view Design Data Sources.-Select your data source.- The Expose button on the top is disabled or shown grayed out.-Cause-If the data source is a cloud or joined data source, it cannot be exposed.-Exposing and extracting data from joined data sources show huge performance impacts on Cloud system. In many cases, this extraction fails as there is not enough memory to extract the entire dataset. Hence, this feature cannot be supported for joined data sources.-In cloud data sources, the data is coming from an external system, but exposing a data source serves the purpose of sending data to an external system. This is not a valid use case.-If the data source you would like to expose is combined, please check which data sources are combined. If either of them is a join or cloud, then the combined data source cannot be exposed for the mentioned reasons.-Resolution-Joined Data Sources: The underlying data sources which are used as join members can be exposed in such cases and you can extract data from them.-Cloud Data Sources: Since the data of cloud data sources is created externally, please send this data directly to your BW system. -Combined Data Sources: Check which data sources are combined, and if possible, trace this back to the basic data sources which can be exposed. Should this not be possible (for example if some internal data sources are involved which are not public), you can create a new data source which is a combination of basic data sources only.-See Also-This is valid for both exposing for ODP extraction (to send data to your BW system) as well as exposing data sources for OData.-Keywords-OData, greyed out, expose to BW, oData, joined data source, cloud data source, business analytics, data sources, exposing not possible

Title: How to Find Whether a Change Test System is Manually Decommissioned Out of BC Process?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document describes you the steps to find whether a Change Test was decommissioned manually instead following the regular Business Configuration process.-***Internal Use Only***-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-In principle, when a Test system is requested through a Change Project, that system will be terminated when the Change project is closed. But, many times users drop mail to SCC to delete the Test System and Test System deletion will be initiated. This always ends up in Inconsistency in the Business Configuration. The most common issue that happens to customer because of this inconsistency is Merge Failed while merging any change Project.-To find, if there is any Change Test System of any particular customer, follow the below steps:-1. Login to Backend of the customer system.-2. Use T-code SE16.-3. Enter Table BCTD_WSORGCPY.-4. Under the column "CPY_LOGIC_PORT", you can find some Logic port so called Tenant IDs.-5. Note down these logic ports.-6. Login to SPC.-7. Go to "Cloud Landscape" work center.-8. Select "Customers" view.-9. Search for the customer (ex: use Customer name).-10. Select the respective Customer ID link.-11. In the new screen, go to Tenants tab.-12. Use filter icon and search for the Tenant ID (Here Tenant ID is same as logic port which you have noted down in STEP 4 and 5).-13. You can find out whether the tenant is Live or Deleted. if the Tenant Status is Deleted or DIP - Decommissioning in Progress, then this is one of the logic port which is causing the issue.-14. Forward this incident to Business Configuration Expert Support to remove the inconsistencies /  logical port-Note: if you don't have access to SPC, you can check with your IET member of your location or respective Topic Owner.

Title: Fund and Function Being Wrong Determined for an Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a Fund and Function Mapping for a Customer account. However, when creating a customer invoice for this same customer account, with account assignment as ACC - General Ledger Account Only, Fund and Function gets derived based on the mappings maintained for the Company assignment, but you expect it to be derived based on Customer assignment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Common Tasks, click Edit Fund and Function Assignment.-From the dropdown, select 'Customer'.-Open the advanced search and query the assignments for the relevant customer.-You see that Fund AAA and Function BBB are mapped to the selected customer account.-Change the dropdown to select 'Company'.-Open the advanced search and query the assignments for the relevant company.-You see that Fund YYY and Function ZZZ are mapped to the company.-When creating the customer invoice with account assignment as ACC - General Ledger Account Only for the same customer account as above, you notice that the system derives Fund YYY and Function ZZZ from the company assignments. Whereas, you expect that the system derives Fund AAA and Function BBB from the customer assignments.-Cause-For invoices, the derivation happens based on the cost object in the account assignment of the invoice. Since the cost assignment is done to G/L Account only, the system defaults the Fund/Function/Grant from the Company assignments in General Ledger.-The derivation based on master data for Fund/Function/Grant only happens for Manual Journal Entry Vouchers. For non-financial objects, the determination happens only via cost object (cost center, project, material) and if none of these are in the cost assignment, the system uses the Company assignments as default.-Resolution-If the invoice has cost assignment as ACC- General Ledger Account only, this is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Public Sector. Fund Management. Function. Grant Management.

Title: Invoiced Item Showing Open Status Under Sales Order Invoice Schedule
Content: Symptom-You have released an invoice for an item which belongs to a Sales Order, however, when navigating to the Sales Order, you noticed that the invoiced item still shows as Open under the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select Invoice Schedule subtab.-Expand item 10.-Here you see that the status is Open.-Cause-Since the invoice request used was not generated from the invoice schedule but rather it was generated manually in the Customer Invoicing work center, marking the invoice schedule date as invoiced would be inconsistent and not correct system behaviour.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To set the status to Invoiced, you will need to release and invoice the Scheduled Project Invoice Request and cancel the existing Invoice Document which was created manually.-See Also-2741597 - Customer Invoice is Created Manually for a Project Invoice Request, but in Sales Order, Invoice Status Displays as Open-3050995 - Sales Order is in Status In Process but you Expect it to be in Status Completed-2453791 - Scheduled Sales Order Status still In Process / Open-Keywords-Invoice, Status, Sales Order, Invoice Schedule, Schedule, Pricing and Invoicing, Project, Project Invoice Request, Scheduled Project Invoice Request, Invoice Document, Open

Title: Invoice File Upload stuck under "In Process" status
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded an Invoice File Upload but it remains under status In Process and cannot be actioned from your side.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supplier Invoicing.-Select Invoice File Upload View.-Use the filter Invoice Creation In Process.-You can find your entry being stuck under status In Process, even after a lengthy period of time.-Cause-You have uploaded an XML (not standard PDF) which contains an erroneous XSLT file.-Resolution-You must check your Transformation XML as it is failing during the transformation call.-When going to:->>Business configuration->Overview and search for Common Master data configuration.->>Then select the Transformation Repository ->edit and find the XSLT transformation type of SIV.->>Select Transformation Trace-Here we see the XSLT file on the left, the example XML in the middle and the output on the right.-The XSLT is like a decipher map that allows ByD to translate customers XML to XML we understand.-Here you will find an example XML: when we compare this with the XML added to the SIS, there is a difference.-This difference is causing the issues.-There are tags in the uploaded SIS XML that is not in the XSLT file.-You can search online "XSLT XML transformer tool" and compare the XML in the SIS with the XSLT and you will find some errors, which need to be corrected.-Keywords-Invoice File Upload; Stuck In Process; XSLT file; XML

Title: ATP and Ship-From Name are Cleared When A New Line is Added to a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-In the new Sales Order screen, ATP and Ship-from name are cleared when a second row is added.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select new Sales Orders in Common Tasks.-Select Account ABC (Where ABC represents the Account ID).-Add Product DEF (Where DEF represents a Product ID).-Click on Add Row.-Add Product GHI (Where GHI represents the ID of the second Product which does not have a Price List).-You notice that ATP is grayed-out and Ship-from is emptied on both lines.-Cause-This happens when Product GHI does not have a Price maintained.-This means that when this Product is added to the Sales Order, error "Mandatory List Price missing for the Price Calculation" is raised, which causes the Sales Order to be inconsistent, therefore the ATP cannot be calculated.-Resolution-In order for ATP and Ship-from to be redetermined you need to maintain a valid Price:-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select new Sales Orders in Common Tasks.-Select Account ABC (Where ABC represents the Account ID).-Add Product DEF (Where DEF represents a Product ID).-Click on Add Row.-Add Product GHI (Where GHI represents the ID of the second Product which does not have a Price List).-Add a value to the List Price field.-Keywords-Sales Order, ATP, Ship-from, empty, emptied, greyed-out, List Price, value, unable

Title: Wrong UoM Displayed in Report Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items
Content: Symptom-You have created the Inbound Delivery XXX with Unit of Measure YYY, however in report Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items (SCMCIDB03_Q0001) the Unit of Measure displayed is ZZZ.-XXX = Inbound Delivery ID-YYY = Unit of Measure-ZZZ = Unit of Measure-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Choose Design Reports view.-Find report Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items (SCMCIDB03_Q0001).-Open the report Inbound Delivery Detailed Line Items (SCMCIDB03_Q0001).-Filter by Inbound Delivery XXX.-Notice that the Delivered Quantity is with Unit of Measure ZZZ. However if you check the Inbound Deliver XXX, you can see that the Actual quantity is in YYY Unit of Measure.-Cause-The issue is caused when the Delivery Quantity and UoM in message from Third-Party system is different from the Notification quantity and UoM.-Resolution-This is a known issue which will be resolved in a future release of ByD.-Keywords-UoM, report, key, figure
