Title: The inport and outport of a PortBinding is not available on mashup creation
Content: Symptom-When selecting the Port Binding for a PDI mashup created from a SAP Cloud Applications Studio add-on, there will be no Inport or OutPort available.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Double click on the mashup-The Mashup Authoring view is opened on the user interface-Open the OVS of Port Binding field-Check that the Inport and OutPort data will not be visible for the port binding-Cause-There is no inport configured for the PortBinding file .PB.uimashup.-Resolution-Open the .PB.uimashup file on the UI Designer and configure an inport for this port binding on the Controller tab.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, mashup, inport, outport, missing, PB, PTP, port, binding, add, adding, showing

Title: Journal Entry is Not Generated in a Service Confirmation Scenario
Content: Symptom-In a completed Service Confirmation scenario, you notice that the Journal Entry was not generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Open the Service Confirmations view.-Find and Open Service Confirmation ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of the completed Service Confirmation).-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.- You notice that the items in this Service Confirmation are of type "Spare Part - Consumable".-Now, navigate to the Document Flow tab.- You notice that there is no Journal Entry icon for this Service Confirmation.-Cause-This happens because the item type "Spare Part - Consumable" in the Service Confirmation. This item type does not generate Financial Postings so a Journal Entry will not be created.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior for this item type in a Service Confirmation.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Service Order, Journal Entry, Jornal, Spare Part, Consumable, CONS

Title: Unable to Scope the Question Do You Want to Centrally Assign Service Performers Based on Their Availability in the Resource Calendar?
Content: Symptom-You are trying to scope the question Do you want to centrally assign service performers based on their availability in the resource calendar? in your Implementation Project, however the scoping question is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2205 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Then go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Questions step.-Expand Service > Service and Repair > Service Order.-The question Do you want to centrally assign service performers based on their availability in the resource calendar? is grayed out.-Cause-It's not possible to use the dispatching board when resource calendar for projects based on committed work is scoped.-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-You can follow the steps below to activate the Question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center. -Then go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to the Question step.-Expand Project Management > Project Planning and Execution > Project Resource Management.-Then you need to scope the question Do you want to use Resource Availability Search based on planned work specified at the task level of a project?-By doing the steps above, the question Do you want to centrally assign service performers based on their availability in the resource calendar? will be available for scoping.-Keywords-Scoping, Question, Grayed Out, Do you want to centrally assign service performers based on their availability in the resource calendar?, Business Configuratiog, Edit Project Scope.-

Title: "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date" Error Raised in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When editing a Customer Invoice, you notice error "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date" is raised on the document which prevents processing.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Open Customer Invoice ABC (Where ABC represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Click on View All.-You see error "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date". In this case, the Customer Invoice has originated from a Scheduled Invoice Request from a Customer Contract which is now with status "In Conflict".-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Open the Invoice Requests view.-Find Scheduled Invoice Request DEF (Where DEF represents the ID of the Scheduled Invoice Request from a Customer Contract which originated Customer Invoice ABC).-You can see that the status is With Conflict.-Click the Check button.-The following errors are displayed: -Conflict in item XX; invoice schedule item XX: date has changed-Conflict in item XX; the referenced invoice schedule data was changed- (Where XX represents the line item ID)-Cause-This issue is caused when the Invoice is created for the Scheduled Invoice Request of a Customer Contract but not released. Then, before releasing the Invoice, the date on the Invoice Schedule Item is changed, which generates the Conflict in the Scheduled Invoice Request and the error in the Customer Invoice.-Resolution-In order to solve the error, first you need to cancel the Customer Invoice that was created from the Customer Invoice Request that had a conflict (This will cancel the Scheduled Invoice Request.-Then, create the Scheduled Invoice Request again by following these steps:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select Customer Contract Invoice Request GHI (Where GHI represents the ID of the Contract that originated the Scheduled Invoice Request).-Click on the Edit button.-Click on the "You Can Also" button and select option "Create Scheduled Invoice Requests".- A new Scheduled Invoice Request will be created without the Conflict.-See Also- 3124649 - You Can't Release the Customer Invoice Request Due to the Error: "Due date must not be before invoice date" and "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date"-Keywords-Contract, Invoice, Scheduled, Invoice Schedule, Error, Issue, Payment Baseline, Start Date, End Date, Invoice Date

Title: The Printings From SAP Cloud Print Manager Stopped Working Without Reason
Content: Symptom-The printings that were sent to SAP Cloud Print Manager are not working properly, no error message appears during this process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2208 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Then go to the Print Queues view.-Select the affected Queue ID.-Click Edit and go to the Processed Documents.-Notice that the printings were not sent to the system.-Cause-A possible root cause for this issue might be version of the SAP Cloud Print Manager, which is not updated.-Resolution-Download and install the new version of the SAP Cloud Print Manager.-Keywords-SAP Cloud Print Manager, CPM, Not Working, Printing, Not reaching the printer.

Title: System is Not Accepting Manual Serial Number during Post Goods Receipt And Does Not Display Any Error.
Content: Symptom-You are performing Post Goods Receipt and when you try to manually enter Serial Number in the 'Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt' screen, the system clears the value you enter into the Next Serial Number field. Also, the system does not return any error message. However, if you use the Upload function, the Serial Numbers are confirmed without any issue. You therefore would like to know why the system is behaving this way.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Find and select the relevant Purchase Order.-Click Post Goods Receipt.-Go to the Serial Numbers tab (if not automatically navigated there already).-Click the Next Serial Number field and enter a valid Serial Number and hit enter on your keyboard.-The value disappears without any error message. However, if you use the Upload function, this works flawlessly. -Cause-You have not scoped Automatic Identification in your system and that is required for the automatic creation of Serial Number.-Upload is not based on this Business Configuration scoping and hence it is working.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you need to scope Automatic Identification option in Business Configuration. You can find this option in scoping by navigating to:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Implementation Project and click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next until you get to the phase '3 Scoping".-Expand 'Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics'.-Expand 'Task Management and Automation'.-Check mark 'Automatic Identification' to activate same into your scope.-Finish the selection and deploy the solution.-After that if you try again to post the goods issue, the manual input of Serial Number should work.-Note: You may need to log out of the system and log back in for the Business Configuration changes to take effect.-Keywords-Serial Number, Manual, Automatic Identification, Post Goods Receipt, Post Goods Issue, barcode

Title: Error Value for Unit of Measure and XX is invalid for Line Item
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload data for a price list and when performing such action the system returns one of the following:-Message: 0 Record(s) successfully saved in SAP Business ByDesign-or-Error: Value for Unit of Measure and XX is invalid for Line Item-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use Company Specific Price List.-Navigate to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price Lists view.-Search for Company Specific Price List.-Select ABC (ABC represents the name of the price list).-Click Download.-Fill the excel file.-Click Save Data To.-The system returns the following:-Message: 0 Record(s) successfully saved in SAP Business ByDesign-or-Error: Value for Unit of Measure and XX is invalid for Line Item-Cause-You are passing the Unit of Measure as lower case such as "ea" or using the value value.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please change the Unit of Measure to upper case, changing "ea" to "EA" and click Save Data To.-If this does not work, please click the Lookup button and the system will propose all valid Unit of Measures.-See Also-2788104 - Quantity Unit Error When Uploading Customer Invoice-Keywords-Price List, Quantity, Unit of Measure, UoM, Price, Value, Unit, Error, Upload, Invalid, Excel, SAP Add-In, Microsoft Excel, 0 Record(s) successfully, 0 Record(s)

Title: Open Item's Payment Block Indicator to be Accessible via PDI/ODATA
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a custom PDI Solution or ODATA service that requires you to set/reset the Payment Block indicator of open items in the customer account monitor. However, you did not find the respective elements.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the respective customer account monitor.-Select any open item.-Click Item Details.-In the screen that opens, refer to the Payment Block indicator.-You wish to set/reset this indicator via custom add-on/ODATA service.-Resolution-The payment block indicator is controlled by two actions: CreatePaymentBlock and ResetPaymentBlock-These actions are PSM write enabled via BO Path TradeReceivablesPayablesRegister -> Root -> Item -> ItemSplitItem. In this ItemSplitItem node, check the available actions "CreatePaymentBlock" and "ResetPaymentBlock"-Nevertheless, although the actions are PSM released, there is no query enabled so that a specific object can be selected. There is only one queryable node in the TRPRegister and this is TRPOverview. This is a display only node that has no actions nor associations. It would show the basic information regarding open amounts, clearing status, etc of an item. This is the only real interface that the system allows at the moment.-The payment block (and reset payment block) actions are on the ItemSplitItem and although the actions are released, there is no way to currently navigate to them through PDI. The ODATA service creation allows you to bring in all of these nodes, but without any queries its not possible to construct a mapping that leads to the actions.-This is ultimately a new requirement that would have to be requested via the influence page. It should be requested that an association from the TRPOverview to the PaymentControl and SplitItem should exist.-Therefore, please navigate through the Influence Portal (https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886) to check if this idea has already been posted so that you can vote up. Otherwise, a new idea can be created for this requirement.-Keywords-PDI. ODATA. Payment Block. Supplier Account. Payables. Supplier Account Monitor. Cloud Application Studio.

Title: Lease Posting Run Journal Entry: Transaction Currency Amount is Empty
Content: Symptom-A journal entry created as a result of a Lease Posting Run has Transaction Currency Amount empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Find and open Journal Entry ID AAA (AAA means the journal entry ID).-Under Line Items section, select any line (either debit or credit posting) and notice that the Transaction Currency Amount is empty.-Remark: the behavior described above is valid for both journal entry types 00150 - Lease Initiation and 00151 - Lease Clearing.-Cause-When the company currency is ABC, and the lease-in contract is created with transaction currency DEF, both Initiation and Clearing runs are designed to only post in company currency. This was a design decision at the time of introducing the functionality.-ABC means the company currency.-DEF means the currency defined in the respective lease-in contract.-Resolution- This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-lease-in contract; lease posting run; journal entry; initiation; clearing; transaction currency amount; company currency

Title: Error "Label YYY already assigned" When Trying to Reverse Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse the Confirmation XXX, however an error is faced related to Label YYY.-XXX = Confirmation ID-YYY = Label ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Task Control view. -Find the related Task.-Select Confirmations tab.-Open the Confirmation XXX.-Edit the Confirmation XXX.-Click Reverse Confirmation. -The error is faced: -Label YYY already assigned-Cause-You have created the Label YYY for output product in Production Lot 1 then they used this output product as input product in Production Lot 2 with same Label YYY. Now you want to reverse the Confirmation XXX for Production Lot 1 where Label is marked as Assigned in corresponding Task, so on reverse confirmation it gives error that label is already assigned, this is expected.-Resolution-If the Label XXX is marked as Assigned to some Task then you cannot reverse the Confirmation related to same task directly. First you have to remove all the assigned Labels and then do the reverse confirmation:-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Task Control view. -Find the related Task.-Open the Task. -Click Confirm. -Go to Output Products tab. -Select Assigned Labels. -Remove the Label YYY. -Click Save. -Now you should be able to reverse the Confirmation XXX:-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Task Control view. -Find the related Task.-Select Confirmations tab.-Open the Confirmation XXX.-Edit the Confirmation XXX.-Click Reverse Confirmation. -Keywords-confirmation, label, assignment

Title: Error Message 'Form template variant Customer Invoice for language ABC and country DEF cannot be found'
Content: Symptom-You cannot release Customer Invoice YYY (YYY represents the Invoice ID) as error messages are raised:-'Form template variant Customer Invoice for language ABC and country DEF cannot be found' (ABC stands for the language in use and DEF for the target Country)-'Save failed'.-You also notice that the Preview is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for Invoice YYY and select it.-Click on the Release button.-Error messages are raised:-'Form template variant Customer Invoice for language ABC and country DEF cannot be found'-'Save failed'-If you click on the Preview button, No record found is displayed.-Cause-When determining the form template the system uses the Tax Country of the document for the determination of the country variant of the form template  If no Tax Country is maintained the system will use the country of the Bill-From Party (Invoicing Unit) and if no Bill-From Party is available either, the system will use the country of the Seller Party.-The language variant of the form template is determined by the system as follows:-If the Bill-To Party is a Corporate Account the system will use the language maintained as the main address communication language in the Account Master Data of the Bill-To Party.-If the Bill-To Party is a Private Account the system will use the language maintained as the communication language in the Account Master Data of the Bill-To Party.-If the Bill-To Party is a Contact the system will use the language maintained as the communication language in the Contact Master Data of the Bill-To Party.-If no language is maintained the system will use the logon language of the user creation the document.-Please Note that the determination of a specific Form Template can also be influenced by in the Account Master Data of the Bill-To Party in the Communication tab and the Collaboration sub tab for the respective business document and via the rules set up for the business documen in the Form Template Form Template Selection view in the Application and User Management work center.-Resolution-You need to maintain the expected template in order to proceed further:-Go to the Application and User Management workcenter.-Go the Business Flexibility view.-Open the Form Template Maintenance subview.-Select the Advanced Search and fill in C41 in the Template Group field, click on Go.-Select the Form Template: Customer Invoice.-Check that you do not have the relevant template waiting to be published first. If not, create the template that you need for the relevant Country-Language combination as shown on the error message.-Keywords-customer invoice, ship-to, bill-to, country, form template variant cannot be found, release, unable to release, template

Title: Error Message "Item X: Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.
Content: Symptom-When you assign a Service Product ABC as a Line Item into a Sales Order, system throws below error message:-Item XX: Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from the common tasks.-Maintain the respective information.-Go to Items tab and add the service ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service)-The following error message occurs:-Item XX: Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.-Cause-There can be two causes for this issue:-A) The Service ABC is not marked as Expense but the Item Goup is an expense item group.-To verify follow the below steps:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Services view.-Open the Service ABC.-Go to the Sales tab.-Select the respective Sales Organization used in the Sales Order.-You can see that the item group is an expense item group e.g. XFIX - Expense - fixed price without actuals-Navigate to the General tab.-You can see that the Expense indicator is not checked.-B) There is no rule for party determination maintained.-The Service ABC is marked as Expense in the master data. But when the sales order is created, no party role determination takes place for seller, sales unit, ... It is resulting in the creation of a text item instead of an expense.-C)The Service ABC is marked as Expense but the Item Group in the Service Master Data is a Service item Group.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Services view.-Open the Service ABC.-Go to the Sales tab.-Select the respective Sales Organization used in the Sales Order.-You can see that the item group is an service item group e.g. SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals-Navigate to the General tab.-You can see that the Expense indicator is checked.-Resolution-A) If you want to use a Service as an Expense in a Sales Order, it is required that the Service is marked as Expense.-Once the service master data was saved, it is not possible to activate the expense indicator anymore. The activation is only possible before the first save.-The reason why the indicator cannot be activate after the first save is due to the fact that the service could have been used which would affect other scenarios and lead to inconsistencies.--To overcome the issue, you can create a New Service with the same data as per the above service (you can use the Copy functionality) and in addition mark it as an Expense. After saving the Service, you can use it in a Sales Order.-If you wish to use this Service as a Service instead you need to ensure that a Service Item Group is used in the Sales tab e.g. SEFL - Service - fixed price without actuals- -B) You need to create rules for party determination.-See KBA 1435095 - How to Determine Sales Unit in a Sales Order.-For detailed information on the Party Role Determination in a Sales Document you can find the following Blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2016/05/16/party-role-determination-in-a-sales-document/-Once the party determination is set up and the expense can be determined correctly, this issue can be avoided.-C) If you want to use a Service as an Service in a Sales Order, it is required that the Service is not marked as Expense.-Once the service master data was saved, it is not possible to deactivate the expense indicator anymore. The activation/deactivation is only possible before the first save.-The reason why the indicator cannot be deactivated after the first save is due to the fact that the service could have been used which would affect other scenarios and lead to inconsistencies.--To overcome the issue, you can create a New Service with the same data as per the above service (you can use the Copy functionality) and ensure that the Expense Indicator is not active. After saving the Service, you can use it in a Sales Order.-If you wish to use this Service as an Expense instead you need to ensure that a Service Item Group is used in the Sales tab e.g. XFIX - Expense - fixed price without actuals-See Also-2642419 - The Expense Indicator In The Service Master Data is Grayed Out-1435095 - How to Determine Sales Unit in a Sales Order.-Keywords-Service, Expense Indicator, Category Group, Master Data, ByD, item type code do not match, Expenses, party role determination

Title: Error: Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-While performing undo-release of Confirmed Inbound Delivery against a Third Party Processing document, the system throws the below errors:-Cannot save the document as inconsistent; document already released-Save failed-Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item A in Outbound Delivery XYZ     ( i.e. here A refers to an Item ID and XYZ refers to an Outbound Delivery ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-  Step: 1-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Common Tasks and create New Customer Return Notification-In guided activity, enter relevant Third Party Outbound Delivery ID.-Navigate to Step 2, here maintain Delivery Notification ID, and Ship to location.-Now under the Details subtab, keep follow-up activity as Return to the supplier only.-Navigate to Step 3 and choose Finish.-Once the guided activity is completed, Inbound Delivery Notification gets generated.-Again go to the Inbound Logistics work center and find the newly generated Inbound Delivery Notification ID.-Select it and perform Post Goods Receipt.-At last, Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID: C is generated. (i.e. here C refers to Inbound Delivery ID)-Step 2:--Again go to New Customer Return Notification and create a new Inbound Delivery Notification of type: Customer Return.-In this case, again enter the same Outbound Delivery ID as above i.e. XYZ with the same item.-The system will throw an error thrown straight away.-Now, enter Ship to location and change Follow-up activity to Post to own goods under the Details section.-The system still throws the same error however Inbound Delivery Notification can still be created.-Navigate to Step 3 and choose Finish.-Once the guided activity is completed, Inbound Delivery Notification gets generated.-Now go to the Inbound Logistics work center and find the newly generated Inbound Delivery Notification ID.-Select it and perform Post Goods Receipt.-Once the process is completed, another Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID: D is generated. (i.e. here C refers to Inbound Delivery ID)-Step 3:--Go to the Inbound Deliveries work center-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Here, search for the first Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID: C created via Step:1. (i.e. here C refers to Inbound Delivery ID)-Select it and choose Undo-release.-The system throws the above error messages.-Cause-Since two Confirmed Inbound Deliveries with (Delivery Type: Customer Return) were created with reference to one Third Party Outbound Delivery: XYZ therefore when a user tries to perform undo-release of the first Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID: C in random order system throws errors.-Resolution-Go to Inbound Deliveries work center-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Now, perform Undo-release for the second Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID: D which got generated as per Step:2-Once it is done then cancel the same.-Later perform Undo-release and Cancel the first Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID: C as well which got generated as per Step:1-See Also (optional) ⓘ-Keywords-Third Party Order Processing, Inbound Logistics, Customer Return, Undo-Release, Cannot save document as inconsistent; document already released, Quantity entered exceeds delivery qty for item in Outbound Delivery

Title: Data Extraction: Payment Documents Containing Memo Line Data
Content: Symptom-You need to extract payment related documents which contain memo line and the respective memo line data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-At the moment it's not possible to extract payment related documents which contain memo line and their respective memo line data via the available data extraction options, such as, Reports, Mass Data Maintenance, Data Extraction and Extraction Run for Financial Data, etc.-If you have this requirement, please Report an incident to SAP and the request will be fulfilled via a backend report execution.-The data will be provided via Excel files (".xlsx" file extension).-Memo lines can be attached to any of the following source documents:-Bank Statement Line Items-Incoming Check-Manual Payment-Cash Transfer-Payment Advice-See Also-2810769 - SAP Business ByDesign Data Return Process-2667932 - Frequently Asked Questions on Data Extraction in SAP Business ByDesign System-Keywords-data extraction; memo line; payment documents; bank transfers

Title: Extension Field Does not Appear in Adaptation Mode
Content: Symptom-When trying to change or add an extension field to a certain screen, the field is not available in adaptation mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter the screen where the field needs to be operated.-Click the avatar icon on the top right of the system and click Key User Settings -> Start Adaptation Mode.-Right click the section of the screen where the field needs to be added, or right click the field that needs to be changed.-Click "+ Extension Fields".-A list will appear with the extension fields, however the desired field does not appear. -Cause-The extension field was created as part of a PDI solution, instead of being created through Key User Tools.-Resolution-The system works as expected. In these cases the extension field needs to be operated directly through the custom solution.-Keywords-partner, KUT, personalization

Title: Why it was Possible to Change the Account Type of a G/L Account Even With Supplier Invoices Posted
Content: Symptom-You have created a G/L Account with type OASSET - Other assets and posted a supplier invoice with this G/L Account. You later changed the G/L Account type to AP - Payables and posted further transactions to this G/L Account.-Then, you decide to change the G/L Account type back to OASSET - Other Assets, but the system raises an error message that transaction data exists.-You wonder why this error message is raised, since you managed to change the G/L Account type before even with posted supplier invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click link Edit chart of accounts.-Select a G/L Account in question and go to the view G/L Account Type and change the required G/L Account Type.-Choose Save button and below error occurs:-Acct XYZ in CoA ABC Cannot be Deleted/Changed; Transaction Data Exists-You wonder why the error message is being raised this time.-Cause-When the G/L Account had account type as OASSET - Other assets, you created and posted an invoice with account assignment to General Ledger Account Only.-In the e.g. supplier invoice, this can be checked as follows:-Open the respective supplier invoice.-Go to View All mode.-Go to Items tab.-Go to Cost Distribution.-You see that in the account assignment type, there is an account determination group that is mapped to the G/L Account. Since the G/L Account was of type OASSET, the account determination most likely happened directly to General Ledger (Miscellaneous ledger).-If you open the corresponding journal entry, you see the posting to Miscellaneous Account.-Therefore, since the posting was done to the Miscellaneous Account, the system still allowed you to change the Account Type, since there is no subledger posting.-Once you changed the account type to AP - Payable and posted further transactions to this account, the account determination was done to AP - Payable subledger. Once there are postings to a subledger, it is no longer possible to change the account type without reversing the postings.-Resolution-If you wish to change the account type, the posting made to a subledger needs to be reversed.-For more details, please refer KBA 2433095 - Acct XYZ in CoA ABC Cannot be Deleted/Changed; Transaction Data Exists and help document Account Type.-Keywords-General Ledger. Chart of Account. Account Determination. Other Assets.

Title: Characteristic Displayed as (Hierarchy) in Report Level and Original Characteristic Cannot be Selected
Content: Symptom-You are looking to filter your report based on characteristic ABC (ABC represents the field name). However, the field cannot be selected and instead only field 'ABC (Hierarchy)' is available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports work center view.-Find and open the desired report.-Go to the report selection pane.-Note that both fields 'ABC' and 'ABC (Hierarchy)' are present in the Selection pane.-Open the value help for field 'ABC'.-There are no values displayed. Instead, only the field 'ABC (Hierarchy)' is working when value help is opened.-Cause-This behavior is caused by a personalization done from User level. From Add Fields option in the report, when the field 'ABC' is selected, the option "Display in Hierarchy" was enabled. When the hierarchy is enabled, first the field 'ABC (Hierarchy)' needs to be filled and then the actual field 'ABC' can be selected.-Resolution-If this is not the desired behavior, the user can simply unselect the "Display in Hierarchy" Checkbox in his personalization, from Add Fields option.-Keywords-Hierarchy Fields; Hierarchy Characteristic; Display in Hierarchy; Hierarchy Reports; Hierarchy-hierarchy fields,hierarchy,hierarchy characteristic,display in hierarchy,hierarchy reports

Title: History logs show aribasystem deleted subprojects. Why?
Content: Symptom-If sub-projects are deleted, system marks an entry in the main parent project that the subproject is deleted by aribasystem. Audit logs under Site Manager do not show any information as to which user has deleted and how the projects were deleted. -Resolution-If an user with permission to mass delete projects has deleted the projects through Mass Delete option, then system records the deletion carried out by aribasystem. The end user who would have carried out the Mass Delete would not be recorded in the main project's History nor in site level audit logs.-However, this action can be confirmed by checking out Mass Delete Status that provides a log entry showing which projects are deleted. -If subprojects are deleted, then checking the history of the mainproject will show that the projects are deleted but the real and effective user will be recorded as aribasystem. In such a case, user can validate if the projects are deleted through mass delete. -To confirm if the project is deleted through Mass Delete:-1. Access Project Manager-2. Mass Delete Status-3. Check and select the logs as per the date. You will notice that the logs will show entry as to which project was deleted. User can look for the deleted the project searching with the project ID to cross-verify.

Title: Distribution Percentage with Distribution Factor as Based on Costs
Content: Symptom-A distribution rule with distribution factor as Based on Costs has been created. There is no Percentage to Distribute defined for receiving cost centers.-You want to know how the percentage among receivers is set when distributing overhead-costs using this distribution rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Choose the Allocation view and Distribution.-Select New and Distribution Rule for Cost Centers.-Besides all necessary entries - In step 1 Enter Basic Data select Based on costs as Distribution factor.-Resolution-When a distribution factor is set as Based on costs or when there is no distribution factor/percentage maintained for the receivers, distribution of cost from sender to receiver will occur as per the ratio of costs of each receiver cost center.--For example, we have a sender cost center A and receiver cost center X and Y.-"A" has total cost of 150 USD whereas X and Y have 40 and 60 USD respectively in a give accounting period. We have created a rule to distribute cost from A to X and Y without setting any percentage on X and Y.-Now when we execute an Overhead Distribution Run for that period, cost will be distributes as follows:-Total cost on receivers (X + Y) = 40 + 60 = 100-Ration on X and Y, 0.4 and 0.6 respectively.-Cost distribute from A to X -> 150 * 0.4 = 60-Cost distribute from A to Y -> 150 * 0.6 = 90-Total cost on X and Y after distribution is 100 and 150 respectively.-Keywords- Overhead Distribution Run; distribution factor; Based on costs

Title: URL for Outbound Communication Missing
Content: Symptom-Whenever you are navigating and processing documents such as Sales Orders for example, you face the following errors:-No result returned by external provider-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Errors:-No result returned by external provider.-Cause-The communication arrangement being used in the Vertex integration has the path missing and thus the URL is not completed.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Communication Arrangements view.-Select the Vertex communication scenario.-Click Check Completeness.-Error: URL for outbound communication missing.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Technical Data tab.-Click the Edit Advanced Settings button.-Under Outbound and Outbound Communications.-Path is empty.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To correct this, please maintain a path in the communication arrangement.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Communication Arrangements view.-Select Request tax rates from Vertex.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Technical Data tab.-Click the Edit Advanced Settings button.-Under Outbound and Outbound Communications.-Add the path vertex-ws/services/CalculateTax60.-Click Save and Reactivate.-See Also-2257888 - No Result Returned by External Provider VERTEX-2986871 - Vertex Error: SOAP:1,044 SRT: Consumer is temporarily isolated.No processing is allowed-Vertex Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Vertex, Error, URL, Outbound, Outbound Communication, Missing, issue, Path, Sales, Document

Title: System is Not Showing The Logistics Area ID in The Inventory Balance Report
Content: Symptom-System is showing Site ID and Logistics Area ID showing as not assigned (#) in the Inventory Balance report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Internal Logistic work center. -Go to the Reports view. -Find and open the Report: Inventory Balance.-Enter the relevant Actual Execution On (Date) between aa.bb.cccc and xx.yy.zzzz (aa.bb.cccc and xx.yy.zzzz calendar date).-Enter the relevant Product ID.-Click Apply.-You can see for the row with a particular Increasing Quantity and a particular Decreasing Quantity the system is showing the hash symbol (#). -Cause-The stock type for the highlighted row is Goods issue, which can be added as a characteristic in the report's output. The Goods Issue stock is tagged to a Warehouse Order and unless you use a two-step outbound task model (where the pick operation is complete, but the Load operation is not), system does not assign the Logistics Area to it.-Resolution-System is working as designed.-Keywords-Inventory Balance Report, Logistics Area ID missing-

Title: Planned Delivery Date of Notification Does Not Update the Product Planning
Content: Symptom-You have created the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX for s stock transfer scenario. You have set a different Planned Delivery Date in this Notification, which is different from the requested one. However this date is not updated in Product Planning.-XXX = Inbound Delivery Notification-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Select Products view.-Find the related Product Planning. -Click Open.-Notice that the Date for Inbound Delivery Notification XXX in Product Planning is not the same as Planned Delivery Date in Inbound Delivery Notification XXX. -Cause-When you set the Inbound Delivery Notification XXX to Received, it means shipment is already received, hence no further updates are made to planning.-If the Notification was once set to Received, no updates to planning are expected.-Resolution-As the update to planning does not occur when the Notification is set to Received, the system is working as expected.-Keywords- IDN, Notification, STO

Title: Expense Report for Mexico: Meals Expense Posting to an Unexpected G/L Account
Content: Symptom-The expense report AAA has been posted containing an expense type belonging to expense category Meals. You expect the full expense amount to be posted to the expense account BBB defined in fine tuning activity Expense Reporting - Mexico, however, this doesn't happen.-AAA means the expense report ID.-BBB means the G/L Account tied to the expense account (account determination group).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view.-Open Journal Entry ID CCC (CCC means the Journal Entry ID) for expense report AAA.-Notice that just part of the expense amount belonging to the Meals expense has been posted to G/L Account BBB. The remaining expense amount has been posted to a different General Expense account.-For example:-Expense Type DNNR - Dinner/Meals (tied to Expense Category Meals)-Expense Amount for DNNR in expense report AAA: 3.370,00 MXN-Expense Amount posted to G/L Account BBB in Journal Entry CCC: 750,00 MXN-Expense Amount posed to a different General Expense account: 2.620,00 MXN-Cause-For Mexico, there are Statutory Limits for Mexico Deductibility that define maximum amounts for deductibility based on expense categories.-The maximum limits can be checked as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for activity Expense Reporting - Mexico and open it.-Click View statutory deductible limits and rates for mileage and receipt types.-In the new screen Statutory Limits for Mexico Deductibility, select the Expense Limit tab and check the Maximum Amounts per Expense Type.-Remark: the Maximum Amounts for deductibility are defined based on Expense Categories and not Expense Types.-For example, maximum deductibility amount for expense category Meals is applicable for expense types Dinner and Lunch.-Resolution-The system behaves as per design.-Keywords-mexico; expense report; meals; dinner; lunch; deductibility

Title: How System Defines the Fulfilled Quantity on Sales Order Volume Report
Content: Symptom-You want to know how system defines the Fulfilled Quantity on Sales Order Volume report.-Environment-SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN-Cause-In the Sales Order Volume report,-- Confirmed Quantity is the quantity confirmed in customer demand.-- Fulfilled Quantity is the quantity delivered via outbound delivery.-- Confirmed Fulfilled Quantity is used in contracts. Which are confirmed in a follow up sales/service order, need to be tracked with the keyfigure Confirmed Fulfilled Quantity in the respective application reports.-It is also applicable for third party and inter-company scenario.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords- Fulfilled Quantity, Confirmed Quantity, Confirmed Fulfilled Quantity, Sales Order Volume, Report

Title: Journal Entry Vouchers Numbering not in Sequence
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Journal Entry Vouchers created for a given company and noticed that some IDs are out of sequence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Show All Journal Entry Vouchers and filter by e.g. company A.-You see that the sequence of Journal Entry Vouchers looks as follows:-Journal Entry Voucher with ID 1-Journal Entry Voucher with ID 2-Journal Entry Voucher with ID 3-Journal Entry Voucher with ID 35-You wonder why the ID assigned to the Journal Entry Voucher jumped to 35.-Cause-This can happen if you have more Companies using the same tenant and the journal entry voucher was originally created for company B. The journal entry voucher was saved with company B assigned, hence the system derived the ID from the sequence related to the company B. After that, the user changed the company assignment to Company A (the ID of the journal entry voucher did not change) and posted.-Therefore, since the journal entry voucher was initially saved with Company B assigned, it derived the ID based on the numbering sequence for Company B. If the company is changed, the ID of the journal entry voucher is not changed and is used for the new company assigned to the journal entry voucher.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher ID. Numbering. Sequence. Order. Assignment. Number Range.

Title: QR-Bill - Switzerland not Recognized in Scanned Invoice
Content: Symptom-When using Scanned Invoice to create a Supplier Invoice with QR-Bill - Switzerland the system does not recognize this as a Payment Reference and leave the field empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Scanning view.-Select the relevant Invoice.-Click on Create Invoice.-See that the Payment Reference Type is empty.-Cause-System did not recognize a QR-Bill as Payment Reference Type in Scanned Invoice.-Resolution-The QR-Bill function is supported by the system, although this function is not recognized by the Machine Learning of the Scanned Invoice.-Our recommendation is to select manually the Payment Reference Type as QR Bill - Switzerland in the creation of the Scanned Invoice.-See Also-for more information, please refer to the Country/Region-Specific Features documentation: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2e30d84496214461ad763692c3a0b4a5/5ee235eaa58445db94152c4fbd15b2b7.html-Keywords-Scanned Invoice. Payment Reference Type. QR-Bill - Switzerland. QR Code. Machine Learning.

Title: Errors When Trying to Finish Production Task
Content: Symptom-You want to change the status of Task XXX to Finished, however you are facing errors regarding Product YYY, Serial Number ZZZ.-XXX = Task ID.-YYY = Product ID.-ZZZ = Serial Number ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Select Task Control view.-Search for Task XXX.-Select Change Status. -Select Finish.-Click Ok.-The error is faced:-Parent reference product YYY and reference product YYY cannot be same-Parent Reg Product ZZZ and Parent Ref Product YYY resulting in cycle-Save failed-Cause-The issue is with the same Serial Number ZZZ used in Input and Output Product. In the Bill of Operation, the Output Product is YYY.-And you have added product YYY manually as an input product.-Resolution-In this case it is suggested that you revert the Confirmations already created for the Task XXX and confirm it again with a different Serial Number.-The use case itself is only allowed when the products are not serialized.-Keywords-SN, Registered, Task

Title: Sales Order ID Not Derived after Entering Project Task in the Manual Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You create manual journal entry voucher, journal entry type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents, screen variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.; In the Item Details, you enter project task but the sales order ID is not derived automatically in the line items. You expect the sales order ID to be derived automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to New Journal Entry Voucher common task.-Enter below values: Company AA, Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents, Screen Variant 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc(AA is the Company ID).-In the Line Item, click Add Row.-In the Item Details - Sales Write-Up/Write-Down, enter BCD in the Project Task(BCD is the Project ID).-You notice that the Sales Document ID EFG is not derived automatically(EFG is the Sales Document ID) and you have assigned Project Task BCD to the Sales Order EFG. Besides, you notice for some other Project Tasks entered in the Journal Entry Voucher, relevant Sales Order IDs are derived.-To check the assignment in the Sales Order, you can:-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Sales Orders View.-Open Sales Order EFG.-Click View All.-Go to Tab Items.-In the Details, you see that it is assigned to Project Task BCD.-Cause-There's logic where it is decided whether the SO can be derived for the project or not based on certain factors. One such factor is the SO line item itself has invoice status as finished. So basically we are getting the SO back as we expect, but then in this code, because invoice status of the SO item is finished, it's not allowed to be used.-To check the Invocie Status of the Sales Order EFG:-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Sales Orders View.-Open Sales Order EFG.-Click View All.-Go to Tab Items.-In the Details, you see that the Invoice Status is Finished; While checking other sales orders derived when entering project tasks, the Invoice Statuses are In Process.-Resolution-This is the system design. And this is long-standing logic and it would be a new requirement to change same.-Keywords-manual journal entry voucher. 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents. 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc. project task. sales order ID. missing. blank.

Title: Form Templates for a Certain Template Group are Missing in Form Template Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You search for a certain form template group in the Form Template Maintenance work center view and notice that no results are returned in the search.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Under Business Flexibility, acess the Form Template Maintenance work center view.-Show Active Forms.-Search for the required form, for example, Purchase Order form template.-No results are found and there is no option for uploading a new template, since the form template group does not exist.-Cause-The form templates are not displaying in the system because there are only non-localized and/or pre-localized country/regions scoped.-Some of the template groups might not yet be supported in the current system version for the country/regions in scope, which is why the templates can't be found.-Resolution-With each new product release, the SAP Business ByDesign works on improving the localization of its features—hence, these forms might be available for the relevant country/regions in the future.-Until then, you can create a variant from existing form templates of a country/region that is already localized by SAP. To do that:-In the Business Configuration, scope a fully localized country/region (such as US, Germany etc.)—this will enable the form templates for these country/regions.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance work center view and select the form template for the newly scoped country/region.-Click the Copy button, then select As New Variant.-In the prompt that opens, set the Country/Region and Language for the new variant.-Click Ok to complete the creation.-After that is done, you can even remove the localized country/region from scope and use only the form variants created.-See Also-Localization at SAP Business ByDesign: Frequently Asked Questions, on SAP Community.-Keywords-Form Template, Localization, Countries, Missing, Non-Localized, Template Group

Title: How to Find Message Class (and Responsible Component) for Error Message Using Google Chrome
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This knowledge base article will guide you on using Google Chrome's development tools to determine the message class of an error message raised in the UI.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Google Chrome-Resolution-While logged into the relevant SAP Business ByDesign tenant using the Google Chrome browser:-Set up the scenario to reproduce the error message, but don't execute the action that triggers it.-For example, if the error message is raised after clicking Save, do everything except clicking Save.-Open Chrome's development console by pressing Ctrl + Shift + J (on Windows/Linux) or Option + ⌘ + J (on macOS).-In the development console, navigate to the Network tab—this will automatically start a trace recording.-In ByD, take the final action to trigger the error message.-Click the red circle button in Chrome's development console window to stop the recording.-Open the last JSON request logged and toggle to the Response tab.----Select the JSON response shown here and copy it.-Paste it onto a JSON editor for easy reading (in the example screenshot below, I'm using Notepad++ with the JSON Viewer plug-in installed).-Here you can see the error message text with a key right above.--The key is composed by the message class ID and the message number within that message class. So, in the example, above key CL_RCNR_MESSAGES.008 means this error message is message 8 in message class CL_RCNR_MESSAGES.-With this information, you can determine which component is responsible for this error message and message class by doing the following:-Log into the tenant's backend.-Access backend transaction SE91.-Fill the Message Class field with the value found in the JSON payload earlier.-Click Display.-Navigate to the Attributes tab.-Double-click the Package information.----Once the Package details have been opened, you can find the Application Component field.---Keywords-Error Message, Message Class, SAP Business ByDesign, Chrome, Development tools

Title: Error message : Invalid combination of account <ABC> and item type Other Liabilities
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are reversing the payment allocation and observed the exception error/dump over the UI. Now, you checked the dump in ST22 and found the Info message: Invalid combination of account <ABC> and item type Other Liabilities.-Remark: the same dump could also be found when reversing a bank advice.-ABC means the G/L Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Navigate to the Payment Allocations view.-Select the relevant payment allocation.-Click Reverse.-You see the Exception error/dump over the UI. -Now, login to the backend.-Enter the T-code - ST22.-Open the relevant dump entry. -Click Application Info.-Here, you see the message - Invalid combination of account <ABC> and item type Other Liabilities.-Cause-When the payment allocation was posted, at that time the G/L Account - ABC has Account Type - Other Liabilities. Now, when you check the same settings in the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination Activity fine tune activity, then you observe the different G/L Account Type. Hence, you see the exception error or dump.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Open Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination Activity.-Click Edit Chart of Accounts view.-Select the Relevant G/L Account.-Change the Account Type to Other Liabilities.-Click Save and Close.-Go back to the Payment Allocation view and Reverse the allocation.-NOTE: You have to change the Account Type based on the message in the Application Info.-Keywords-Payment Allocation Dump, Reverse Payment Allocation exception error.

Title: Documents Like Customer Invoices are Posted Even Though Process Control Maintained as Not Allowed.
Content: Symptom-Customer invoices are posted to a period that you have set it as not allowed for the process control. (Same scenario applies to other doucments: supplier invoices, etc.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-To check the dates of the Customer Invoice:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Journal Entries View.-Search and open Journal Entry ID XXXXXXXX, the source document is Customer Invoice: CIV-AAAA.(XXXXXXXX is the ID of Journal Entry, CIV-AAAA is the ID of the Customer Invoice.).-You see it is posted on 29.03.2022 and created on 05.04.2022 10:00.-To check the period control maintained in the system.-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Open and Close periods View.-Filter Company BBBB, Set of Book CC, Year 2022, Period 003.-Select the period 003, scroll down and you will see:-Process control: status 1 - Not Blocked, Business Process Group 01- All, entry possible until 15.04.2022 18:00, from posting date 01.03.2022, to posting date 31.03.2022.-Process control: status 3 - Blocked, Business Process Group 02- Customer Invoicing, entry possible until 01.04.2022 23:59, from posting date 01.03.2022, to posting date 31.03.2022.-(Here, all dates and time are only examples.)-Cause-Business Process Group All will supercede the individual Business Process Groups.-You can check the change history via below path:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Open and Close periods View.-Go to Tab Changes and you can see:-On 01.03.2022 02:00, end user opened process control for 01.03.2022 to 31.03.2022 for All Business Process Group, entry possible until 2022-04-15 18:00:00.-On 01.04.2022 06:00, end user blocked the Business Process Group Customer Invoicing for 01.03.2022 to 31.03.2022. This is specific for Customer Invoice, but the All Group was still open.-So, the process control for type All was always open until 15.04.2022, and the posting happened on 05.04.2022 10:00 which is allowed in this case.-Resolution-To make the Process Control for Customer Invoice work, you need to block the Process Control for All type if it is the scenario mentioned in the Cause:-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Companies View.-Select Company BBBB and click button Set Process Control.-Find the Entry: Process Control Status 1-Not Blocked, Business Process Group 01- All, Entry Possible Until 2022-04-15 18:00:00, From Posting Date 01.03.2022, To Posting Date 31.03.2022-Change the Process Control Status from 1-Not Blocked to 3 - Blocked.-Save the changes.-Here, on the page of Set Process Control, you can click button Actions->Simlulate Process Control to test your desired documents and if their posting dates allowed.-Now, if you create a Customer invoice after 01.04.2022 23:59, the system won't post it and throw an error.-Keywords-process control, customer invoice, supplier invoice. business process group, 01 - all.

Title: Cannot Add Attachment to Bill of Operation
Content: Symptom-The button Add, to add new attachment to Bill of Operation XXX is grayed out.-XXX = Bill of Operation ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center. -Select Production Bills Of Operation view. -Find XXX. -Open the Bill of Operation XXX. -Select View All. -Go to Structure tab. -Expand the affected operation. -Select the affected Activity. -Select Activity Attachments tab. -Notice that the button Add is grayed out. -Cause-The operation type of the operation you are using is Check and the Activity type Final Inspection.-Resolution-The system does not allow you to add attachment to operation Check and Activity Final Inspection, this is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-disable, greyed, BoO

Title: System Shows Process Communication Error in the Goods and Services Receipt Document - INTERNAL
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-System shows process communication error in the document flow of Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) and GSR was not posted successfully to accounting.-Error:-Operation not possible; Business document locked.-Error during Inbound processing; referenced object does not exist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts (GSR) work center.-Go to the Receipts and Returns view.-Select Show By Documents and select the relevant GSR document which contains Process Communication Error.-Select View All and go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see a process communication error symbol.-Cause-The XML messages in the backend were containing an unallowed MIME types say for example HTML and this format is not configured in the customer system.-Message Details:-Sender Party: GoodsAndServiceAcknowledgement-Receiver Interface Name: SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoiceVerificationIn-Sender Interface Name; GoodsAndServiceAcknowledgementInvoiceVerificationOut-Application Area: /SRMAP/LSIV_SIR-Error Short Text: Poste de commande référencé non trouvé-To-Service: _LOCAL_SYSTEM_ALIAS_SAP_INTERNAL_CONSTANT_VALUE.-Resolution-If customer wants to enable the upload for MIME type say HTML, they need to define the particular MIME Type by following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Activity List (Change project if necessary).-Select the Fine Tuning chevron.-Select the activity Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload.-Check Allowed for the particular MIME Type with description say for example; HTML Document Template.-Allow the MIME Type.-Select Save and Close.-Keywords-Operation not possible; Business document locked, Error during Inbound processing; referenced object does not exist.

Title: Dunning Generating a Reminder Letter Instead of a Dunning Letter
Content: Symptom-You are trying to generate a Reminder letter for a Dunning, however the system is generating a Reminder Letter instead.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2205 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Select the required Dunning.-Click Preview > Dunning Letter.-Cause-There is no matching rule in form template selection screen for the parameter combination (Country code, Dunning and Max Dunning Level).-Hence, the default template dunning letter is being picked.-Resolution-Configure the parameter combination in the Form Template Selection view according to your requirements.-See Also-2918177 - Dunning Runs are Generating Reminder Letters instead of Dunning Letters for Dunning Level 1-Keywords-Dunning, Reminder Letter, Dunning Letter, Not Working, Wrong Form Template, Receivables.

Title: Error in OData report query: In the context of Data Services an unknown http error occured
Content: Symptom-You are running an OData query for a report, but you receive the following error:-In the context of Data Services an unknown http error occured-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When you log on to the OData query, you are using a technical user. However, reports can only be accessed with a business user.-Resolution-Please use a business user when you log on.-Keywords-odata, In the context of Data Services an unknown error occured, occurred, business analytics, reports, technical user, business user

Title: External Reference Field is Disabled for Sales Orders created via A2A and B2B Communication
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order document from an external application and when navigating to the General tab of the document, you noticed that the External Reference field is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Navigate to the General tab.-External Reference field is grayed out.-Cause-A2A (Application to Application)-In an Intercompany scenario, the Sales Order is created from a Purchase Order within the same system. In such case, the External Reference Number in the Sales Order will be the ID of the Purchase Order.-B2B (Business to Business)-When a Sales Order is created from a Purchase Order from an External System (via the B2B web service Sales Order Inbound (SAP ESD)), the External Reference Number in the Sales Order will be the ID passed in the payload as shown bellow:-<PurchaseOrder reconciliationPeriodCounterValue="1" itemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<ID>XYZ</ID>-</PurchaseOrder>-In both cases the External Reference field will be read only since this is referencing to the Purchase Order ID and should not be changed.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-As an alternative, if you would like to suggest or propose any enhancement to the system, please reach out via the SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence Platform.-Keywords-Sales Order, External Reference, Field, Purchase Order, EDI, webservice, A2A, B2B, Web Order

Title: Business Partner VAT ID shows no information on Intrastat Declaration
Content: Symptom-When processing an Intrastat Declaration, you have noticed that no information is available under column "Business Partner VAT ID"-Environment-SAP BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Select the work center Intrastat-Go to Intrastat Declarations view-Search and open the Intrastat Declaration ABC-Go to Items tab-From here you can see the column "Business Partner VAT ID" (it can be added through adaptation mode if needed).-No information is available under this column.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-During the creation of the Intrastat Declaration, the system will find and maintain data to build the document.-Only the mandatory information will be fetch by the system.-Business Partner VAT ID is not a mandatory field, therefore the related information will not be shown.-Resolution-This can be enabled through add-on.-Please contact your PDI partner for further information.-See Also-Intrastat Enhancements in SAP Business ByDesign as of August 2015-https://blogs.sap.com/2015/08/31/intrastat-enhancements-in-sap-business-bydesign-as-of-august-2015/-Keywords-Intrastat declaration, Business Partner VAT ID

Title: Master Template for Goods and Service Receipt Shows Unexpected Logo and Footer
Content: Symptom- Master template for Goods and Service Receipt shows not the expected Logo and Footer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to:-the Goods and Service Receipt work centre -the Receipts and Returns view-here click Preview-The logo is not shown as for other documents Master Template assignment-Cause-For goods and service receipts, if you check the Master template assignment check you will see no matter which Org Unit you maintain the default Master Template is picked always.-Resolution-This works as designed.-Assign the wanted Master template as Default or alternatively if you need different logos in goods and service receipts you can add the logos in Adobe LifeCycle Designer, adopt the logo into your form and after uploading the form which contains the correct logo use the functionality "Master Template not in Use".-Keywords-Master Templates, Logo, Goods and Service receipts.

Title: Data Flow Verification Result Fails Between Outbound Delivery and Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-You have the Data Flow Verification Results XXX failing for a Stock Transfer scenario, between Outbound Delivery and Inbound Delivery Notification.-XXX = Data Flow Verification Result-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Select Data Flow Verification Results view. -Find Data Flow Verification Result XXX.-Open the Data Flow Verification Result XXX.-It has the error:-No outbound delivery item matches inbound delivery item 10-Outb.deliv. itm qty YYY of type Delivery Quantity differs from inb.deliv. item qty YYY-YYY = quantity.-Cause-Identified Stock is involved between the Outbound Delivery and Inbound Delivery Notification. In this case the Data Flow Verification Result could be expected use case where Outbound Delivery has certain qty delivered but the same is received at Inbound Delivery Notification using Identified Stock. The Data Flow Verification Result is expected in this case.-Resolution-In this case you can close the Data Flow Verification Result XXX following the steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Select Data Flow Verification Results view. -Find Data Flow Verification Result XXX.-Open the Data Flow Verification Result XXX.-Select Change Status to Closed.-Save it. -Keywords- DFV, DFVR, IStock

Title: Error Message: 'Payment Method Bank Transfer Not Permitted for Debit Advices'
Content: Symptom-You are not able to save a new bank payment advice due to the error message 'Payment method Bank Transfer not permitted for debit advices'.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Liquidity Management.-Go to View New Bank Payment Advice under Common Tasks.-Select Advice Type as Bank Debit Advice and open dropdown box for Payment Method.-You will see that there is no option for Bank Transfer under Payment Method.-Cause-Payment method Bank Transfer is not maintained in the scoping of the project-Resolution-Go to the work center Business Configuration.-Open the project scope in Edit - mode.-Go to the step 4 – questions of the project scope.-Select Scoping Element Cash Flow Management – Payment and Liquidity Managements - Payment Methods.-You need to check yes for the following questions:-- Do you want to use bank transfers for cash disbursements?-- Do you want to use wire transfers for cash disbursements?-Save your project scope and then you will be able to use bank transfer as a payment method for bank payment advice.-Keywords-Payment Method Bank Transfer Not Permitted for Debit Advices; New Bank Debit Advice; Bank Transfer; Payment method;-payment method bank transfer not permitt

Title: The Freight Can't be Added in Invoice Generated from Migrated Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You find that the freight can't be added in the invoice generated from a migrated sales order.-Environment-SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center - Invoice Documents View-Open Customer Invoice ABC (where ABC stands up for custoemr invoice ID)-Navigate to the Pricing tab-Under Total Pricing Add Row button is grayed out- The Customer Invoice ABC is generated from a migrated sales order.-Cause-For items that are migrated with a net value, the assumption is that this value is the total value been processed OUTSIDE of the byd system. For items that have this migrated price component maintained in the migration file, the price components are all read only due to the above. The same is carried forward to all documents including customer invoice.-For items that do not have this migrated price component maintained in the migration file, the price components are editablein the customer invoice, as the total value of the process has not yet been recognised (eg.. freight, surcharge etc).-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-You can migrate a sales order without price component maintained in the migration file and make the system determines the net value based on the price list in the system.-See Also-KBA 2730098 - Migrated Sales Orders Have Open Status-KBA 3096254 - Wrong Net Value is showing in Migrated Sales Order-KBA 1408186 - Change of Pricing of Products at Item Level for Migrated Sales Orders is not Possible-KAB 2779823 - How to Change the Tax Date When Invoicing the Outbound Delivery Invoice Requests from Migrated Sales Orders-KBA 1966031 - You are Not Able to Add a New Overall Discount in the Invoice Request-Keywords

Title: How to Find if an Anchor is Visible in The UI Designer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- How to find if an Anchor is visible in the UI Designer.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Insert the C4C or ByD URL on Edge browser.-Replace everything after the ".com" with /sap/public/ap/ui/xrep/VIRTUAL/SAP_BYD_UI_DT/UIDesigner.application-Hit enter to start UI Designer.-In the login screen, put the tenant URL (with "https://") in the System field and 433 in the Port field.-Log in with the username and password.-Select Ok and the UI Designer will open.-OR-Open C:\Program Files (x86)\SAP\SAP Cloud Applications Studio 2XXX\Extensions\Application\UIDesigner.exe-Do steps 4-6 as above.-Go to the corresponding screen.-Highlight any UI section of the Designer tab.-In the Extensibility Explorer tab, an anchor should be selected automatically.-If there is no anchor for the UI section, an anchor should be released by the development team who owns the screen.-If the anchor is visible but the required operation does not exist (e.g. Add extension field to section group), the operation should be released by the development team who owns the screen.-See Also-UI Designer training from a public SAP JAM group: https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/AjpMgLOC6SsT0XLc0CzMUs/content?folder_id=jqPr4a3TuWBcHEjf4zcanE -UI Designer explained: https://blogs.sap.com/2020/03/05/ui-designer-of-the-sap-cloud-application-studio/-General: 2396197 - FAQ’s on UI Designer Issues-2657644 - Troubleshooting PDI UI Issues-Keywords-PDI, Anchor, UI, Designer, SDK

Title: Not Possible to Alter the Default Number Ranges for Customer Contract and Contract Template
Content: Symptom-You change the Number Range for Customer Contract or Customer Contract Template in the activity Number Ranges for Sales Orders, Customer Contracts, and Customer Returns in the Business Configuration work center. -Saving fails with the error message: Update for from number APCRM1_CONTRACT_IN failed; interval is already in use.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview.-Open the Activity: Number Ranges for Sales Orders, Customer Contracts, and Customer Returns. -Mark for example Customer Contract and change the Begin Number.-Click Save button.-You get the error message: Update for from number APCRM1_CONTRACT_IN failed; interval is already in use.-Cause-The automatic Number Range from 0000000001 to 9999999999 is available by default.-The intended system behavior is:-As long as no document has been created drawing a number from a given number range, in ByDesign it is possible to change the lower boundary of this interval (if it does not contradict with e.g. other ranges). -As soon as the first number has been drawn from this number range, the lower boundary cannot be changed anymore. Then the error message "Update for from number... failed; interval is already in use." is returned and the change is prevented. -Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-numbering, 0000000001 to 9999999999, begin number, Betriebswirtschaftliche Konfiguration, Vertrag, Nummerierung, service, sales
