Title: PSM Request for an UI Anchor or Operation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In order for the customer or partner be able to extend a standard UI via the Cloud Applications Studio or via Adaptation mode, the required anchors or operations should be in place for that screen.-These have to be released by the corresponding development team who is responsible for the UI screen.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Insert the C4C or ByD tenant URL on Edge browser.-Replace everything after the ".com" with /sap/public/ap/ui/xrep/VIRTUAL/SAP_BYD_UI_DT/UIDesigner.application-Hit enter to start UI Designer.-In the login screen, put the tenant URL (with "https://") in the System field and 433 in the Port field.-Enter Client number from CAM tool (for example, 000).-Log in with the user and password from CAM tool.-Select Ok and the UI Designer will open.-Resolution-Go to the corresponding facet (i.e. Account Team).-Select the corresponding table/section (i.e. Account Team).-Go to the Extensibility Explorer.-If there is no operation visible, a release needs to be requested to development (In this example, anchors are available, but there is not any available operation to add a field, for example).-To exit the UI Designer, simply close the screen.-See Also-UI Designer training from a public SAP JAM group: https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/AjpMgLOC6SsT0XLc0CzMUs/content?folder_id=jqPr4a3TuWBcHEjf4zcanE -UI Designer explained: https://blogs.sap.com/2020/03/05/ui-designer-of-the-sap-cloud-application-studio/-General: 2396197 - FAQ’s on UI Designer Issues-  2657644 - Troubleshooting PDI UI Issues-Keywords-PDI, SDK, PSM, request, UI, anchor, operation, add, extension, field, screen, adjust, properties

Title: How to Remove the Unit of Measure/Currency Sign from Key Figure
Content: Symptom-You are looking to use a report in your system which works with multiple currencies and units of measures. But since there are multiple currencies, you can't get a proper result of all the values, so you are looking to remove the Unit of Measure/Currency sign from the value which is being displayed by a specific key figure, so that you can use this key figure to perform calculations without any problems.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In order to reproduce this behavior, you may access any report in your system which make use of key figure that display monetary and measurable values, then, you may see that all these values are displayed followed by 'lb', 'Kg', 'GBP', etc.-Cause-The Key Figures behave like this since when the system was designed, our developers defined that monetary and measurable values should be display followed by the sign which it represents.-Resolution-Even if it is the standard behavior of the system, if you wish to display the values of a key figure without the sign of Currency/Unit of Measure, please follow the step by step below:-Go to 'Business Analytics' work center;-Go to 'Design Key Figures' view;-Click on 'New' button to create a new key figure;-In step 1, choose the name and description for the new key figure, notice that this key figure will be the same of the one you are looking to separate the sign from value;-For the Data Source, choose the same Data Source which the report you are using is based on;-In the 'Type' option, choose the 'Calculated Key Figure' option and click on 'Next';-In step 2, click on the 'Data' dropdown list and choose the option 'NODIM';-Search for the Key Figure you are looking to remove the sign in the list, drag it and drop it inside the 'NODIM()' parameter on the screen; (For example: NODIM("Item Value"));-The expected result should be 'NODIM("KeyFigureName")';-Click on 'Finish' button;-Please notice that this procedure must be followed for each key figure you wish to display the values without the sign of Currency and/or Unit of Measure. Please notice that this procedure must be followed for each key figure you wish to display the values without the sign of Currency and/or Unit of Measure.-Also notice that depending on the version of your system, the creation of key figure functionality might not work as expected in HTML5 UI, so in order to ensure you can follow this approach, kindly use the Silverlight UI.-Keywords-report, business analytics, NODIM, currency, currencies, unit of measure, remove, * asterisk

Title: Priority Definitions for Cloud Applications Studio Incidents
Content: Symptom-How to determine the correct priority for Cloud Applications Studio relevant issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Definitions as stated in the Cloud Services Agreements:-Very High: An incident should be categorized with the priority "very high" if the problem has very serious consequences for normal business processes or IT processes related to core business processes. Urgent work cannot be performed.-This is generally caused by the following circumstances:-- A productive service is completely down.-- The imminent system Go-Live or upgrade of a production system cannot be completed.-- The customer's core business processes are seriously affected.-A workaround is not available for each circumstance. The incident requires immediate processing because the malfunction may cause serious losses.-High: An incident should be categorized with the priority "high" if normal business processes are seriously affected. Necessary tasks cannot be performed. This is caused by incorrect or inoperable functions in the SAP service that are required immediately. The incident is to be processed as quickly as possible because a continuing malfunction can seriously disrupt the entire productive business flow.-Medium: An incident should be categorized with the priority "medium" if normal business processes are affected. The problem is caused by incorrect or inoperable functions in the SAP service.-Low: An incident should be categorized with the priority "low" if the problem has little or no effect on normal business processes. The problem is caused by incorrect or inoperable functions in the SAP service that are not required daily, or are rarely used.-The below table shows examples of how this policy relates to the Cloud Application Studio (Please also check important clarifications):-Very High High Medium Low-Solution Deployment / Activation is failing in a Production Tenant and it cannot be resolved by KBA Solution Deployment / Activation is failing in a Test / Partner Tenant A Partner requests help with a consulting issue in which we have some capacity to help the Customer / Partner There are cosmetic issues in the front-end-The Solution is causing core business processes to not work in the Production Tenant (Business Impact and financial loss must be provided) The Partner is having Business Configuration issues for their PDI Solution in a Production Tenant A field / view / event / action / query is not working as expected in the Test Tenant There is a clear error message shown but further clarification is needed from support-There are dumps / exceptions in the Production Tenant that completely stop the business from working (Business Impact and financial loss must be provided) A Solution / object is locked by an SAP colleague and it is stopping further development An object is failing to activate or is not working as expected in the Solution (In Development) There are translation issues which are non-critical-The Go-Live is within three business days and the issue is already determined to be of “high” priority The Solution cannot be downloaded from the Test Tenant for upload into Production Tenant only and no clear error message is thrown It is a PSM release request There are performance issues caused by  partner code -  A Patch Solution cannot be created and there is no clear error message thrown It is any other request that needs to be put forward to SAP (for example, Multi-Customer Solution creation requests) The issue has been resolved but a RCA is requested-  A custom function relating to normal business processes is no longer working in the Production Tenant due to SAP tenant lifecycle activities (for example, upgrades) There are errors thrown while using the SDK / UI designer There are issues with the Repository Explorer-  There are inactive files on an already deployed Solution There are dumps / exceptions / errors being triggered during Development and no KBA can be found with the given information  -  A workaround is available for a “very high” incident There are issues with version control and the deployment landscape (non-critical life-cycle management issues)  -Consulting issues refer to any custom functionality that the Partner is trying to implement and is unable to. The issue can be reviewed by Partner Development Infrastructure (PDI) Support and determined if we can assist in any way. If the issue is simple, the answer can be provided by PDI Support, otherwise the Partner will be directed toward SAP Customer Experience Services the SAP Community. PDI Development will not process consulting issues. Further information available in See Also section.-Business Impact is “What business processes have stopped, with how many users affected, until when the issue must be solved, including underlying business rationale”.-Go-Live is only in reference to the Business Configuration task in Production Tenant. Any other milestone such as Quality Assurance, User Acceptance, Solution Acceptance are not qualified.-For performance issues, we can only provide the performance recommendations and it is not Support responsibility to optimize code. If further assistance is needed, Partner will be directed toward SAP Customer Experience Services or the SAP Community.-If a KBA is found and the resolution requires opening an incident with SAP Support, please defer to the priority provided in the KBA.-Any incident can be upgraded to a higher priority once the criteria is met.-See Also-Cloud Services Support Policy-SAP Support Information for Customers and Partners-SAP Cloud Customer Support Overview, Chinese-SAP Cloud Customer Support Overview, Japanese-2706322 -  What is Support – What is Consulting: Cloud Solutions-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Studio, Cloud, Services, Agreements, Support, Consulting, VH, Very high, High, Medium, Low, Solution, Policy

Content: Symptom- You want to install the Collaboration Window on a Mac Book but its not possible-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Try to install the Collaboration Window on a Mac Book-Cause-The collaboration window does not support Installation or usage on Mac Books-Resolution- Since the Collaboration window supports only Windows desktop installation install the Tool on a Windows Desktop.-Keywords-Collaboration Window, Mac Book

Title: Form Master Template Determined for e.g. Sales Order Confirmation is not the Expected One
Content: Symptom-You created Form Master Templates and assigned them to different Org Units but when previewing a Sales Order Confirmation, the Master Template determined by the system is not the one expected but the Default Master Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to the Master Template Maintenance (Under Business Flexibility view).-Result: You can see the Form Master Template ABC (ABC represents the Template Name) you assigned to Org Unit XXX (XXX represents the Org Unit), and also Form Master Template DEF (DEF represents the Template Name) you set as Default so with no Assignments in use.- Now you check the Form Master template determined by the system for a Sales Order Confirmation:-1. Go to the Sales Orders work center.-2. Go to the Sales Orders view.-3. Show All Orders and open Sales Order GHI (GHI represents the ID of the Sales Order).-4. Click on View All and navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-You can see the Sales Unit and Sales Org are XXX and the Seller party is YYY (YYY represents the ID of the Seller party).-5. Click on the Preview button.-Result: You can see the default Form Master Template DEF is determined by the system to create this Sales Order Confirmation. However, you expect that the Form Master Template ABC is determined by the system since you assigned it to Org Unit XXX.-Cause-Unlike Invoicing, for Sales Orders the Form Master Template cannot be determined using the Sales Organization of the Sales Order. The Form Master Template is only determined by the Seller party of the Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-For the correct Form Master Template to be determined, you need to maintain the assignments based on the Seller party (Company) and not the Org Unit.-Note: The same behaviour is also valid for Sales Quotes.-Keywords-Quote, Quotes, Orders,-form master template org units

Title: Service Request is Not Considering Operating Hours
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Service Request and notice that when adding the expected criteria such as Service Category and Processor, the Due Dates are not calculating as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use Service Category as the criteria to determine the Service Level.-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Select New Service Request from Common Tasks.-Enter account ABC (ABC represents ID of the account).-Enter Service Category XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Category).-The system performs the determination-Example:-Reported On: 13.07.2022 01:10 PM CST_NA-Due Dates-Initial Response By: 13.07.2022 02:10 PM CST_NA--Based on the Operating Hours maintained in the Service Level, you would expect that the system ended the Initial Response by 03:10 PM, since there is a break between 02:00 PM and 03:00 PM in the operating hours.-Cause-The reason the system is displaying different values than the one expected is because of the time zone difference between the User/Processor and Service Level.-Example:-Under the Service Request, you noticed the following:-Service Request Data-Priority: Immediate-Reported On: 13.07.2022 02:10 PM CST_NA-Due Dates-Initial Response By: 13.07.2022 04:10 PM CST_NA-The Service Request is considering the Service Level HIJ (HIJ represents the ID of the Service Level).-When navigating to the Operating Hours tab, the time zone maintained is UTC-6-Between UTC-6 and CST_NA there is an hour different, since there is Day Light Savings.-For UTC-6, there is never Day Light Savings, but you can have another timezone such as CST_NA which does consider Day Light Savings during a period for year.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.--In order to correct this, you can perform the following:-Adjust the timezone maintained for the user, so that it matches to the timezone maintained under the Service Level.-Or-Change the timezone maintained in the Service Level through the following steps:-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Select the Service Levels view.-Click Edit for Service Level HIJ.-Click Change Status to Blocked.-Navigate to the Operating Hours tab.-Change the Time Zone to the expect one.-Click Change Status and select Active.- Now the service request will display the expected values.-Keywords-Service Request, Service Level, Operating Hours, Due Date, Initial Response By, Completion By, User, Time Zone, Service Desk

Title: Installation of the SAP Collaboration Window
Content: Symptom-You want to upload Supplier Invoices with the Collaboration window but you are getting an undefined error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The collaboration window needs to be installed on a Windows desktop.-Any Installation on a VM, Terminal server, Windows Server might work - but is not supported.-Resolution-Install the Collaboration Window on a Windows Desktop, for example, Windows 8, 10 or 11.-Keywords-Collaboration Window,  Supplier Invoice scan,

Title: Itemized List of Expense is Missing in Form Template Selection
Content: Symptom-You want to set up a form template selection rule for form template group "PS1" / form template "Itemized list of Expense" but it's not being possible since the respective form template group/form template is missing in Form Template Selection Rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Select the view Form Template Maintenance.-Select Advanced filter.-Enter Template Group: PS1.-After that go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Select view Form Template Selection.-Search for "Itemized list of Expense" or "PS1".-No result is found.-Cause-Currently the system presents no option to configure rules for Itemized Lists, also the creation of rules in Form Template Selection is currently not supported for custom forms of a custom business object.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior and it would be considered as a new feature request. Our recommendation is to access our Influence Portal:-Customer Influence Portal-For future development/changes suggestions, this would be the best platform to register the request.-The team will then look into this request and based on the Viability and Feasibility of the request will then decide on when or if the request will be developed.-Keywords-Form Template Selection Rule, Itemized list of Expense, PS1

Title: Error Message: Tax Exemption Reason Missing in the Tax Data of Business Partner
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-While trying to add a tax exemption reason for a business partner you get the error message "Tax exemption reason missing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customers subview.-Search for Customer ABC (ABC is the customer ID) and select it.-Click Edit and select Financial Data.-Navigate to the Tax Data subtab.-Tax Number for Country DEF (DEF is the country name) has been entered.-Under Tax Exemptions.-Click Add Row to enter Country DEF and Tax Type for example VAT.-You get the error message "Tax exemption reason missing".-Cause-There are no tax exemption reasons/ codes available for selection for business partners for country DEF.-You can check this as follows:-Login to the Backend.-Enter transaction SE16.-Enter Table Name: APC_C_TXEXMTRSN-Click enter.-Enter COUNTRY_CODE: for example PL.-Click Execute.-For Country Code PL there are various Exemption codes available for TAX_TYPE_CODE 1(VAT), but none of them are Business Partner Relevant (IS_BP_RELEVANT).-Resolution-System is behaving correctly.-There are  no tax exemption reasons/ codes available for selection for business partners for country DEF.-Keywords-tax exemption, Steuerbefreiungsgrun, Kunde, Geschäftspartner, customer, business partner

Title: Copying Document not Possible; Configuration From Service Order to Service Confirmation Missing
Content: Symptom-You are attempting to create a Service Confirmation from a Service Order, however when doing so the system returns an error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Select document ABC.-Click Confirm Execution button.-The following error shows in New Service Confirmation window.-Copying document not possible; configuration from Service Order to Service Confirmation missing-Cause-The error is happening because the following question under the business configuration has not been maintained:-Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts that result from sales or services, taking actual costs from the service confirmation?-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please perform the following steps to configure the question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Navigate to the Questions.-Expand Services.-Expand Product and Service Portfolio for Service and Repair.-Select Offered Services.-Under Group: Expense Types for Service.-Select Question:-Do you intend to invoice expenses based on receipts that result from sales or services, taking actual costs from the service confirmation?-Once we do this, it will by default select the Business Configuration that is related to using service confirmations for after sales service, which allow you to do Service Confirmation.-See Also-2057712 - Service Items are not Copied from a Contract to a Sales Order-Keywords-Service Order, Service Confirmation, Confirm Execution, Copying Document, not, Possible, Configuration, Business Configuration, Missing

Title: html E-Mail Template is Deleted but still gets Considered in Sales Oder/ Service Order Output to your Account
Content: Symptom-An html e-mail template which you deleted still gets pulled in some of your already existing, submitted sales orders or service orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The same issue can happen for both Sales Order and Service Orders.-In Sales Orders work centre, create create a new Sales Order 123 (123 represents the sales order ID)-Click Edit Output Settings-You will see the output channel is e-mail and you see that an html e-mail template ABC is used (ABC represents the template name)-Now submit and release the order-Navigate to the Application and User Managements work centre-Go to the Form Template Maintenance view-Search for example for Sales Orders, where you have the html e-mail template ABC maintained-Delete the html e-mail template ABC-Now navigate back to sales order 123-Here, click submit this time-To trigger Output to the account use "Send Order confirmation to account" which will trigger an e-mail with the Sales order/ Service Order to the e-mail address of your account.-Your expectation is that the html e-mail template you previously deleted is not used anymore, but that is not the case.-Cause-As there is no additional validation between submitting and "send Order to account", for existing documents the html e-mail template will still be used.-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Before you use the function "Send Order confirmation to account" navigate to "You can also" in the upper right corner of the screen and Edit the output settings.-Perform a "Dummy Change". For example, change e-mail output channel to printing and then back to e-mail.-This triggers a new validation and now you can use "Send Order confirmation to account" without the previously deleted html e-mail template.-See Also-This applies to all submit output scenarios  ie Sales Orders, Service Orders etc.-Keywords-html email Template, Service Orders, Sales Orders, e-mail

Title: Unauthorized User is Able to Perform a Change Of Stock
Content: Symptom-A Business User is able to perform a Change Of Stock although it would not be possible due to their access rights settings.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the Access Rights for a Business User:-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter.-Go to User and Access Management view.-Go to Business Users subview.-Select All Business Users then search for the relevant Business User.-Click Edit then Access Rights.-You check the access rights for Work Center Names PLM_QUALITYCONTROL and SCM_INTERNALLOGISTICS with Work Center View name SCM_INTLOGSCHANGEOFSTOCK and it is possible to see that the user is not authorized to perform a Change Of Stock by these settings, as the Assigned to User checkbox is not checked.-However, the relevant Business User is able to perform a Change of Stock by following the steps bellow:-Login in your tenant with the relevant Business User-Go to Internal Logistics workcenter-Go to Change of Stock common task-Perform any stock change then in Step 3 Review, click Finish-You will see that it saved the change of stock performed, although it should not be permitted due to the User's Access Rights settings.-Cause-The Business User is being permitted to proceed with the Change of stock due to assignment of Workcenter View SCM_INTLOGS_GAC_OWL_WOCV.-When the WoCV SCM_INTLOGS_GAC_OWL_WOCV is unassigned, the Change of Stock stops appearing under the common tasks and the Business User is not allowed anymore to perform a Stock Change.-Resolution-If you don't want the user to perform a change of stock, unassign the relevant Business User access to Workcenter View SCM_INTLOGS_GAC_OWL_WOCV-Keywords-Access rights, Change Of Stock, Unauthorized Access, Business Users access rights

Title: How can I Configure the Automatic Determination of the Employee Responsible, Sales Unit and Invoicing Unit in a Manual Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-How can I configure the automatic determination of the employee responsible, sales unit and invoicing unit in a Manual Invoice Request ?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice.-The new manual invoice request screen is displayed. However, the employee responsible, sales unit and invoicing unit is not filled as you expect.-Cause-The employee responsible fetched by the system is the logged on user. The determination of the Sales Unit and Invoicing Unit can be configured using work distribution rules.-Resolution-- The employee responsible fetched by the system is the logged on user :- This is standard system behavior, the employee responsible will be filled with the business user that logged in. You have however the option to change it manually, in the document.-- The determination of the sales unit can be configured using the following rule :-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Organizational Work Distribution sub-view. -Select the rule : Sales Unit for Manual Invoices.-You can then enter the sales unit that should be determined for a specific employee--    The determination for the invoicing unit can be configured using the following rule :-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view.-Go to the Organizational Work Distribution sub-view. -Select the rule : Invoicing Unit for Sales and Invoicing.-You can then enter the invoicing unit that should be determined for a specific sales unit-Keywords-Sales Unit; Invoicing Unit; Work Distribution; Invoice Request; Manual Invoice Request; logged on user;

Title: How to extract National Insurance Number of Employees in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)
Content: Symptom-You want to extract "National Insurance Number" from report/data source to Odata.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to extract the National Insurance Number by following the below steps:-Go to Business Analytics-Open Design Reports view-Search for the report Business Partner Identification-Enter the Business Partner ID-Execute the report.-National Insurance Number is visible in the identification number column-See Also-The national insurance number is part of the employee personal data.-Using the Business Partner IDs can be obtained in a below report:-Business Analytics -> Design Reports -> Employee Social Insurance Arrangement-Execute the report for the employee and add Business partner ID to the row fields. Copy the Business Partner ID.-Keywords-National Insurance Number, Identification Number, Business Partner Identification

Title: How to Debug an Erroneous Message sent by a Technical User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to debug an Erroneous Message sent by a Technical User in SRT_MONI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Resolution-Set breakpoint in the T100 Message Class (Transaction: SE24 > CM_ESI_T100)-Go to SRT_MONI-Search by Message ID-Click Technical View button-Click Unit ID link-Right-click “Unit” on right side-Go to Unit Analysis > Debug Unit with Current User-See Also-2105848 - How to Remove the Document / User Lock in Backend-2647497 - How to Debug Failed Process Communication (XI) Messages For Custom Addons (PDI)-2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger

Title: How to Download M User Certificate to Integrate SAP Business ByDesign System with Third Party System
Content: Symptom-How to download "M User Certificate" to integrate SAP Business ByDesign system with Third Party System-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The integration of SAP Business ByDesign with another system of any product can be achieved by downloading the Tenant Certificate, following below-1. Go to Application and User management-2. Click on Communication arrangements-3. Click Download Tenant Certificate - this downloads a "M User certificate"--After downloading this, User would need to create the required integration scenario-Also, you can go through this blog SAP Business ByDesign – API Overview which can give more information on integration-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign – API Overview-Keywords-Integration, M User Certificate, Tenant Certificate

Title: Product not Removed from Project Stock Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You have a product which is in Project Stock Logistics Area XXX, however you expect this stock in Logistics Area YYY, since you have done the return via Consumption for / Return from a Project.-XXX = Logistics Area ID.-YYY = Logistics Area ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Open the Stock Overview common task. -Filter by Logistics Area XXX. -Notice that the product quantity is in Logistics Area XXX and now in Logistics Area YYY. -Cause-No Goods Movement was performed, hence the stock is still in Logistics Area XXX.-Resolution-You need to post goods movement in this case following the steps:-Go to Internal Logistics work center. -Select Goods Movement common task. -Select the stock in Logistics Area XXX. -Select Next. -Choose Target Logistics Area YYY. -Select Next. -Select Finish. -See Also-Return Case C in blog:-https://blogs.sap.com/2019/02/05/product-returns-from-projects-to-inventory/-Keywords-Return, project, adjustment

Title: MT940 FR Bank Statement Upload: Inbound File Remains In Process and No Bank Statement is Created
Content: Symptom-No bank statement is created and the inbound file remains In Process while uploading a bank statement file with format MT940 FR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2205-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management --> Inbound Files view.-Click New Inbound File.-Enter File Type Bank Statement, Company, Bank ID and Import Format MT940 FR.-Click Add --> File, browse the file and click Add again.-Click Start File Upload.-As a result the inbound file remains In Process, no bank statement is created and no message (either error, warning, etc) is raised.-Cause-The parsing logic is having an issue in case the last line of the file is tag :62F: (empty/blank lines are ignored).-Resolution-As a workaround, please add a line with just "-" (simple minus) at the end of the file before uploading it.-SAP Business ByDesign development team is working on enhancing the parsing logic for the next releases.-Keywords-MT940 FR; inbound file; bank statement upload; closing balance; :62F:

Title: Different Generic E-mail Text Body is Shown After Copying a Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You see a different generic e-mail text body after copying a Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Purchase Requests and Orders work centre-Select and copy any sent PO.-In the original PO you see as e-mail text Body:-Dear Sir or Madam,-Attached please find new purchase order 2229. Please send us a PO acknowledgement confirming whether or not you can complete our order as requested.-If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me by phone or by e-mail.-Best Regards-In the copied PO if you navigate to the "Edit output settings" you see this:-Dear Sir or Madam,-Attached please find new purchase order $1. Please send us a PO acknowledgement confirming whether or not you can complete our order as requested.-If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me by phone or by e-mail.-Best Regards-$BUYER_RESP-Cause-No validation happens between copying and Ordering.-Resolution-Click Order and the e-mail will update the generic e-mail text correctly.-Keywords-E Mail text body, generic email text body, Purchase Order email text, email, e-mail, text

Title: Error "Delete Logistics use not possible; logistics area not empty" during Removal of Logistics Use Not Relevant for Planning
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Remove Logistics use as "Not Relevant for planning" for Logistics Area KLM (where KLM refers to Logistics Area).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Supply Chain Design Master Data WorkCenter-Go to Locations View-Search for Logistics Area KLM-Select Logistics Use as "Not relevant for planning" and Remove-Error appears-Cause-There could be 2 reasons-Stock still exist in Logistics Area KLM-If any tasks from workcenter(Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics) which are open for Logistics area KLM -Resolution-Stock need to be moved from Logistics Area KLM to some other Logistics Area via (Internal Logistics-->Goods Movement)-Open Tasks which exists from Workcenter (Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics) need to be closed.-To check any open tasks from workcenter(Outbound Logistics, Internal Logistics, Inbound Logistics)-Go to Outbound Logistics/Internal Logistics/Inbound Logistics Work Center-Navigate to Task Control View-Select Open Advanced Filter-Select Task Status as "Not Started" & "In Process"-Key in Source Logistics Areas as KLM-Select Go-Keywords- Delete Logistics use not possible, Logistics area not empty,Remove, Not Relevant for Planning

Title: Cannot Create a Business Partner Person as a Supplier
Content: Symptom-You want to create a business partner as a Supplier, but the option is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partners work center.-Select the relevant business partner.-Click the Create As button.-See that the Supplier option is grayed out and can't be selected.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign, business partners are divided as business partner persons and business parter organizations.-Suppliers are strictly a business partner organization role, so business partners that already have a business partner person role (such as Contact, Service Agent or Employee) cannot be created as Supplier.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-If you wish to create a business partner as a Supplier, you can only do this with business partners that have no business partner person role assigned to them.-Keywords-Business Partner Data, Business Partner Person, Business Partner Organization, Supplier, Can't Create

Title: Change the Serial Number Profile in the Material throws error "Changing material XXX to Consumable not allowed; Change the serial profile"
Content: Symptom-Change the Serial Number Profile for the Material throws error "Changing material XXX to Consumable not allowed; Change the Serial Profile"-Environment- SAP Business BYDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Product Data work center-2. Go to the Materials view-3. Search and open the Material XXX-4. Click on the View All button-5. Change the Serial Number Profile to 'Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes'-6. Click on Save button.-Cause-Consumables are generally not Inventoried and hence not Serialized.-Resolution-Request to create an influence request if there is a business case for us to evaluate the requirement.-SAP ByD Customer Influence:  https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords

Title: Cryptic E-Mail Text Body While Receiving an E-Mail
Content: Symptom-You receive an e-mail from the ByD or C4C System, but the e-mail text body is cryptic and the expected attachment is gone.-Environment-SAP Business for ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Send yourself an e-mail and check the e-mail you received. The e-mail text is cryptic, while the attachment is missing.-Cause-Please check that your e-mail subject does not contain special characters such as @?!*&$£ etc.-Resolution-Remove the special characters from the e-mail subject line.-ByD Only: If you want to use an e-mail subject placeholder, it is valid if the placeholder is enclosed in square brackets "[]," which map to the form message field only.-Keywords-E-Mail Text Body, Attachments, Email, Cryptic, Text Body, Special Characters

Title: Warning Message "No bank account maintained for the business partner" During Migration of Customers
Content: Symptom-When you migrate Customer, system throws below warning message,-No bank account maintained for the business partner-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select a project and select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open Migration of Customers and choose Migrate Customers using the Migration Tool.-Execute Migration for the upload file.-The system triggered the warning messages Warning detected in source record with key value 'xxxxx' and Additional message generated; see help for more information. After clicking the Display Help link, the system triggers the message No bank account maintained for the business partner-Cause-If you maintain in sheet Payment Data, the Payment Method as Bank Transfer and if you did not maintain a corresponding bank for these customer, this warning appears. This behavior is also in the respective screen of Customer Master Data.-Resolution-For all customers in the file have this warning, maintain the respective information in the Bank Data sheet for the customers those who have payment method as Bank Transfer.

Title: Unable to Record Time Since the Dates are Greyed Out in Employee Availability Calendar
Content: Symptom-You are recording Time for an Employee and find that for certain dates, the fields are greyed out which block you in recording time. There is no other time recording or vacation or No holidays.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Resource Management work center-Select Resource Search view-Search and edit an Employee-Go to Availability Calendar-Cause-The cause for the issue is that initially there was a Time Model assign to this Employee and now there is a change in Time Model. If these Time Models differs in working days (Example: the former had Tuesday - Thursday as working day and current have working days as Monday - Friday). Since there is change in time model working day the availability calendar of already assigned project is not updated.-Resolution-To solve this issue, you can use the action Reset Commitment for respective Projects, it will solve the issue. But the day on which you have manually maintain the commitment will also get reset.-Please follow the below steps in order to locate the Reset Commitment button:-Go to the Project Management woc-Search for the respective Projects and Edit-Select Team and Staffing-Under the Team Tab Select the Employee Clément Servat-Select the "Show Availability" button-Navigate to the required Date and Select the Reset Commitment button

Title: Difference in Quantity of Input Products in BOM and BOM Multi-Structure
Content: Symptom-The input product quantity on the Bill of Material(BOM) edit screen and the input product quantity checked on the BOM multi-level structure screen are different for BOM1 (where BOM1 is the BOM ID).-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Bills Of Material view.-2. Find BOM ID : BOM1 and Edit.-3. Go to Input Products tab and note the quantity of input products.-4. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Bills Of Material view.-5. Find BOM ID : BOM1 and click on Multi-Level Structure.-6. Note the quantities of Input products.-You will see that the quantities in step 3 and step 6 do not match.-Cause-In Business configuration for "Quantities and Units of Measure", the number of decimal places visible for each is 2.-Hence, where viewing multi-level structure, the quantity are rounded up according to number of decimals maintained in Business Configuration.-Example: In the BOM, the input products have the quantities 0.0002  each, in Multi-Level Structure, the quantity is displayed as 0.01  each.-(i.e. using excel, roundup(num = 0.0002, decimals = 2) results in 0.01 each-Resolution-Modifying the decimals allowed in Business Configuration setting to 4 for each will display the exact quantities in multi-level structure.-Keywords-Quantities and Units of Measure, Business Configuration, Bill of Material, Input Products, BOM , BOM Multi-Level Structure, decimal

Title: Currencies in exchange rate are inconsistent - Error Message in Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You create a journal entry voucher. When trying to post or simulate the posting an error message appears: "Currencies in exchange rate are inconsistent."-Scenario: company ABC has two sets of books, for example, set of books DEF for country UK and company currency GBP and set of books GHI for country US and company currency USD.-ABC means the Company ID.-DEF means the Set of Books ID.-GHI means the Set of Books ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Common Tasks view > New Journal Entry Voucher subview.-Select the Company ABC and let the field Set of Books empty.-Choose the Journal Entry Type: 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter Screen Variant: 601 - Journal Entry Voucher.-Select Closing Step: 010 - Operational postings.-Keep the Set of Books field empty/ blank. -Enter Posting Date and Document Date.-Enter an Exchange Rate.-Press Simulate.-An error message appears: 'Currencies in exchange rate are inconsistent.'-Cause-As per current functionality this posting is not possible as the set of books assigned to the company use different company currencies.-Resolution-To post the journal entry voucher you could-maintain an exchange rate between the two company currencies, here GBP and USD, valid on the posting date of your document.-Or you create two separate journal entry vouchers, one for set of books DEF and one for set of books GHI. -See Also-This error occurs also for Recurrent Journal Entry Vouchers.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, Exchange Rate, Set of Books, Company Currency, Currency Conversion Date, inconsistent

Title: CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH Missing in User Registration for Oauth Webservices
Content: Symptom-When performing the setup for Concur integration in ByD, you notice that in the activity "User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services" the following entries are missing:-CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH-CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-As of release 2022, there were changes made in the OAuth authentication for Concur integration.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. You can check more details on how to configure the authentication in the updated Integration Guide:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/a3103b7f36d448118907c43686720329/019787a49f50442e8009e106b4d5fcdf.html?locale=en-US&q=Concur%20Integration-Keywords-Replication, EC, Concur

Title: Created By Field in Report Shows Technical ID of User That Doesn't Exist
Content: Symptom-The Created By field of the reports usually displays the names of the business users who created them.-However, you've noticed that some reports are showing technical IDs instead, and of users that do not exist in your tenant.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports work center view.-In the Created By column, most of the reports show a name, but certain report(s) show a technical ID instead.-Now:-Open the Application and User Management work center-Access the Business Users work center view.-Change selection to All Users.-Search for the technical ID(s) found in the Created By field of the report(s).-Nothing is found.-Cause-This tenant was created by copying the solution profile from a pre-existing, source tenant. In this process, business user data is not copied, but flexibility data is (which includes reports).-Hence, since the reports are brought to the new tenant, but the business users who originally created these reports in the source tenant are not, the new tenant does not have its names to show in the Created By field and instead shows the business user's technical ID.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Business Analytics, Reports, Created By, Technical ID, Business User, Missing-business analytics,technical id,business user,missing

Title: Error Message "Target UI Could Not be Determined in the Current Scope" While Accessing a Fine-Tuning Activity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports the following error message when trying to access a fine-tuning activity: "Target UI could not be determined in the current scope. Please ask your system administrator to check the scoping."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementations Projects view.-Select the relevant project and click the Open Activity List button.-Open the relevant fine-tuning activity as informed by the customer.-Upon clicking any of the links within the activity, the error message is raised.-Cause-First, check if more than one user is being affected by the issue. If not, the user affected might lack all necessary access rights and you can advise this to the customer.-If multiple or all users are affected by the issue, however, this might be an inconsistency in the Role-Based Access Management (RBAM) policies of the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-RBAM policy regeneration is one of multiple background jobs that are executed overnight and often the problem disappears once that happens.-If the issue persists or customer needs an urgent solution, it is possible to manually trigger the regeneration of the RBAM policies as follows:-In the backend, go to transaction SRBAM.-Click RBAM Policy Generation.-Ensure that Initial Load is Not Active (green icon) and that Generate, Send and Wait is set in the Action field.-Ensure that All Policies are available under Scope.-In the field XRepository - Short Name, enter BC_BUSINESSCONFIGURATION -Press F8 or click the clock icon to Execute-Go back and in the field XRepository - Short Name, enter BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS-Press F8 or click the clock icon to Execute-Important: The report may terminate related active sessions in the system. Ensure that you have the customer's approval to perform the backend correction. If possible, perform outside business hours or clarify the situation with the customer.-Keywords-Fine-Tuning Activity, Target UI Could Not Be Determined in Current Scope, SRBAM

Title: Cannot Limit Write Access to Account Bank Data
Content: Symptom-You are aware it is possible to provide users with read and write access to supplier records while having only read access to the suppliers' Bank Data tab.-You would like to set this up for customer accounts as well, but cannot find this option.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This level of access control is currently not available for customer accounts.-You can either provide read-only access to the entire account record of provide read and write access to all of it as well (including Bank Data).-Resolution-If your business requires only some users to be able to edit bank data, you can try providing read and write access to all users, then use Detailed Restrictions so that the users can only find and edit certain accounts in the Account Management work center.-Additionally, you can try using custom coding to restrict access to certain tabs and attributes of an UI, such as the Bank Data tab (read more in the See Also section). To discuss custom coding implementations with an implementation partner:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer:            -Contact your Account Executive.-Check the link for SAP Advisory Services. -See Also-Blog "How to make a UI flexible/dynamic using UI Switch in SDK/PDI/Cloud ApplicationStudio" on SAP Community.

Title: Net Value Showing in Different Currency in Sales Order Item Data Source and Sales Order Document or Customer Invoice Item Data Source and Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-Currency maintained in the Sales Order Item data source and in the sales order document are different for the field Net Value.-or-Currency maintained in the Customer Invoice Item data source and in the Invoice document are different for the field Net Value.-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to both the Sales Order Item data source and the Customer Invoice Item data source. We will use Sales Orders as an example.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID).-Naviagte to the Items tabs.-The Net Value currency is ABC (ABC represents the currency in the sales order document).- Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Data Sources view.-Open the Sales Order Item report.-Select the sales order XYZ.-Net Value currency is DEF (DEF represents the currency in the report).-Cause-In the report the Net Value key figure always fetch the currency based on the country of the company.-Resolution-To fetch the same currency in the data source select the field Net Value (Transaction Currency) instead of Net Value.-Keywords-CRMCIVIB; CRMCIVIB_Q0001; Invoice Volume; Sales Oder Volume; Data Source; CRMSLOIB_Q0001; CRMSLOIB;

Title: Error message: Cannot create; project used in open request of another sales order
Content: Symptom-When you creating new project invoice request, you see error message:-Cannot create; project used in open request of another sales order.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Project Invoicing: Sales Orders view-Search the sales order which you want to invoice-Select it and press New: Manual/Automatic Project Invoice Request-In the new project invoice request, you see error:-Cannot create; project used in open request of another sales order.-Cause-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Project Invoicing: Project Invoice Requests view-Set the search query as Open Project Invoice Requests-Search the project ID whihc the sales order is assigned to-You see there is already an open project invoice request exists, the status is In Preparation.-To avoid data inconsistency, for same project, system does not allow multiple open project invoice requests in same time.-Resolution-You need to release or cancel the existing project invoice request firstly, then you will be able to create a new one.-Keywords-Cannot create; project used in open request of another sales order, Project Invoice Request, Cannot Invoice Project

Title: Freight Calculation not Working When Combining Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-You are combining multiple invoice requests to create a single customer invoice document and noticed that the Freight value is not the sum of all sales orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ID ABC and XYZ (ABC and XYZ represent the ID of the Invoice Requests).-Select both documents.-Click the Invoice button.-In the Basic view, you see that the value maintained for Freight is not the sum of both document.-Cause-The value shown in the Basic View screen for invoice is depended on the business configuration question:-Do you calculate freight amount based on net weight?-If this business configuration question is not scoped, then freight shown in the Basic View screen will be the Amount that you can find in the Pricing tab.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please perform the following steps to scope the question:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions tab.-Expand General Business Data.-Expand Product and Service Pricing.-Select Sales Price Specifications.-Under Group Freights, you can see the question:-Do you calculate freight amount based on net weight?-Scope the question and confirm/finish the process.-Once you scope the question within Business Configuration, the Freight value with be calculated for new documents created after the scoping.-See Also-2677469 - Mismatch of Freight in Sales Order and corresponding Customer Invoice-Keywords-Freight, Calculation, Basic View, Invoice, Invoice Requests, Price, Business Configuration,

Title: Unable to Terminate the Employee who is an Org Unit Manager
Content: Symptom-Unable terminate an employee in Personnel Administration. Upon trying to terminate the employee, system throws an exception:-An error occurred. Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an incident.-500 SAP Internal Server Error-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Select Country XYZ (where XYZ represents the Country)-Select the link Terminate Relationship with Employee-In the Employee field, select Value Help and find Employee ID-Select the Last Working Day DD.MM.YYYY-Choose the Termination Category-Choose the Termination Reason-Select Save-System throws an exception-Cause-This Employee is the Org Unit Manager for multiple Orgs Unit in the Org Structure. If his/her manager assignment is higher than the last working day (Terminiation date) then the termination will fail. Because the Manager assignment is on/after the termination date.-Resolution-Adjust the manager assignment (org unit manager validity) to a date which less/equal to the termination date. Once the changes are performed in the respective org units, activate the Org unit with below steps,-Go to Organizational Management work center -Go to Org Structures view -Select the Edit button-Enter the effective date -Select the Org Unit -Select the Activate button and select Activate All-After activating the changes then try terminating the Employee-Keywords-Organizational Management ,Terminate Relationship with Employee ,Org Unit Manager

Title: Lease Contract: System Crashes When Selecting Cost Center
Content: Symptom-In a lease contract you add a new cost center. But an Internal Server error message appears after selecting the cost center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to the Lease Contract view.-Open the respective Lease Contract.-Go to the Leased Objects tab.-Go to the Organizational Assignments sub tab.-Click Add Row.-Select Cost Center ID AAA (AAA means the Cost Center ID).-An internal server error appears. -Cause-1. Cost Center ID AAA is not valid on the Lease Contract Start Date.-For example, the Lease Contract Start Date is 01.10.2018 and the Cost Center ID AAA is valid from 01.01.2020.-2. The selected Cost Center does not have a derivable Profit Center.-Go to Organizational Management work center-Go to Org Structures view.-There is no derivable profit center for the selected cost center.-Resolution-1. There are two options to solve the issue:-Change the validity of Cost Center ID AAA to embrace the start date of lease contract.-Change the start date of the lease contract to embrace the validity of the Cost Center ID AAA.-SAP is working to treat this code exception so the system does not crash but raise an error message.-2. Customer need to maintain at least one derivable profit center for the selected cost center.-Keywords-lease contract; cost center; start date; valid from; dump; crash; exception; DET_ORG_ASSIGNMENT_NODE; CL_FIA_LEASE_CO; Message E FIA_FD_ACCESS 015 cannot be processed in plug-in mode

Title: Time Data in Employee Replication Seemingly Ignored by SAP Business ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-You have a replicated an employee into the system, but noticed that time data sent along in the request payload appears to have been ignored.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First, send the employee replication request into SAP Business ByDesign and ensure that is has been successful.-Then:-Open the Master Data Replication work center.-Under Import, access the Employees work center view.-Locate the employee's replication request by the Remote Employee ID (the employee's ID in the external system).-Select it and click Edit.-Navigate to the Time Administration tab.-Here, you can see that the data you've passed in the payload (be it time model specification, assigned time accounts etc.) can be seen.-Now:-Open the Time Administration work center.-Access the Employees work center view.-Locate the employee by the internal Employee ID (the ID generated by ByD upon the employee's creation).-Select it and click Edit.-In the employee's time file, you can see that the data from the replication request is not found.-Cause-Although part of the employee replication request, time data is actually written on a separated business object related to the Employee BO through association.-The time data object has its own integration process that, if not scoped, will cause time data from replication requests to not be written in the ByD system.-Resolution-Please scope the time data integration as follows:-Open the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects work center view.-Select your main implementation project and click Edit Project Scope.-On productive systems, this might require a change project; see KBA #1922087.-Navigate through the wizard until step 3 - Scoping.-Expand the Human Resources business topic.-Below it, expand the Time and Labor Management business topic.-Check the box for Integration of Employee Time Master Data from External Application to SAP Business ByDesign.-Proceed with the scoping wizard until it is finished.-Note: as with other integration processes, once the integration of time data is scoped, system will expect all creations and changes to be done by integration. This means that directly editing an employee's time file in SAP Business ByDesign within the Time Administration work center will no longer be possible (with the exception being the Time Recording Method, which can be changed directly in the employee's time file at any time, even with time data integration scoped).

Title: Multiple Errors for PrintQueueWebService3 Web Service Interface
Content: Symptom-You have observed multiple errors for interface PrintQueueWebService3 in the Web Service Message Monitoring work center view.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Web Service Message Monitoring work center view-In SAP Business ByDesign, this is within the Application and User Management work center-In SAP Cloud for Customer, this is within the Administartor work center-Here you see many of the errors as shown in the screenshot below:-Cause-If you are using a PDI (partner developed) solution, SAP provides an API which does not send a response.Due to this, the documents are successfully printed, but the status does not change to Successful nor you see the output medium, such is the name of the printer etc.-Print Queue status with a partner solution:-Print Queue status with SAP's standard solution:-Resolution-Please ignore these messages.-Correcting this requires huge coding change on SAP's part, which will provided in one of the products' future releases.-Keywords-Webservice, Printer queue Error, Web Service Monitoring, PrintQueueWebService3

Title: Custom Activity entries are lost in the Fine-Tuning
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer have created BCO and BCC files on their add-on.-When defining the fine-tuning data on the UI and saving the content, the field values get vanished.-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“ -Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Overview view.-Search for the custom activity name.-Click on the relevant BC set name (if applicable).-Add a row or input values for the fields of existing entries.-Save your changes.-The data will be erased.-Cause-There can be two main reasons for this behavior:-Case 1 - The entries have been defined directly on the .bcc file within the Studio and the customer tries to edit the values on the activity fine-tuning from the UI.-Case 2 - The entries were not defined on the .bcc file from the Studio, but the customer is creating new entries or updating field values on the activity fine-tuning from the UI.-Resolution-For Case 1: Entries defined in the .bcc file from the Studio cannot be edited in the activity fine-tuning from the UI.-It is only possible to delete and add new rows/entries in the fine-tuning. (Note that the "Values can be added in Fine-Tuning" and "Values can be deleted in Fine-Tuning" checkbox option should be checked on the .bcc file)-Changes are only allowed to the Description field, if the checkbox option "Change Description in Fine Tuning" is selected on the .bcc file.-For Case 2: There can be an inconsistency with the Business Configuration Object (BCO) for which the .BCC file is created and would require a BOPF model regeneration.-Please follow the below steps to verify if there is an issue with the BCO and proceed with the correction:-Open MDRS to search and open the BCO ESName in the Business Object category.-Double click on the Business Object to view the Overview details.-Click on BOPF Button in the MDRS.-Alternatively, open BOPF transaction.-Expand Business Configuration Objects folder from Local Business Objects folder.-Double-click on the BCO twice.-Click on Extended Check button to see any errors.-Click on Synchronize with MDRS button.-Click on Activate button.-Click on Extended Check button again.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, save, erased, custom, missing, gone, BC activity, BC View, model, elements, are, missing, inconsistent, or, superfluous, attribute, mapping, configuration, is, inconsistent

Title: Product Cannot be Removed from Project Stock Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You have a product XXX which is in Project Stock Logistics Area YYY, however want to return this product from project.-XXX = Product ID-YYY = Logistics Area ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center. -Select Stock Overview common task. -Filter by Product XXX and Logistics Area YYY. -Notice that there is a quantity here, however the expected is zero. -Cause-You need to create a Goods Movement to completely return the product from project.-Resolution-Go to Internal Logistics work center. -Select Goods Movement common task. -Choose the relevant Site ID. -Select Add Row. -Fulfill the Product XXX, Logistics Area YYY and the quantity. -Select Next. -Select the Logistics Area which you want to move the product to. -Select Next. -Select Finish. -Keywords-Project, sto, LoA

Title: Performance Issue with Report Customer Demand Details
Content: Symptom-You are using report Customer Demand Details (SCMCDU01_Q0001), however it takes several minutes to load a small number of lines.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Find report Customer Demand Details (SCMCDU01_Q0001).-Open the report.-Use the relevant filter.-Click Apply.-Notice that the system takes several minutes to load the data returned. -Cause-You need to remove or replace the default selection of Last 12 months for Requested Delivery Year/Month of the report.-This will ensure that the orders of only the requested period are fetched by the report and would be faster, as a lot of data will be called when Last 12 months is utilized.-Resolution-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Find report Customer Demand Details (SCMCDU01_Q0001).-Open the report.-Use the relevant filter.-Delete the variable value for Requested Delivery Year/Month or change it for other selection. -Click Apply. -Keywords-report, performance, load

Title: Migration of Open Sales Orders not Working with Recurrence ID
Content: Symptom-The system returns errors when you are using the Migration of Open Sales Orders activity to migrate sales order with Invoice Schedule and Recurrence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the Migration of Open Sales Orders activity.-Open the activity.-Click on the Migrate open sales orders using the migration tool hyperlink.-Migrate the template which contains data under the following tabs:-To Be Scheduled Items-Recurrence Details-The system returns the following errors:-Recurrence Details-Recurrence ID': 'ABC123' is not a valid value; edit source value-To Be Scheduled Item-Recurrence ID': 'ABC123' is not a valid value; edit source value-Cause-The Recurrence ID field is not an alphanumeric field, hence passing letters is not permitted, only numbers are allowed.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please change the Recurrence ID value for only numbers, such as 123.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-3198143 - Error "Time Frame Not Valid" Occurs in Migration of Open Sales Orders-3106328 - Migrated Sales Order Doesn't Have the Invoice Schedule or Milestones-Keywords-Migration, Open, Sales Orders, not Working, Recurrence ID, Migration of Open Sales Orders, Number, Letters, To Be Scheduled Item, Recurrence Details

Title: How to cancel an Inbound Delivery when all its item have Zero Quantity
Content: Symptom-You have created an Inbound Delivery XYZ (where XYZ is the ID of the Inbound Delivery) recording that none of the products were received. Now you are trying to cancel the involved Purchase Order, but you are receiving an error saying you have open Deliveries, even with all items already being set to zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Select the desired document.-Click on Cancel.-Receive the error "Cancellation not allowed. Check open delivery documents".-Cause-The error is triggered as the Inbound Delivery is still a valid document, even if their items have zero quantity. The document must still be reverted.-Resolution-To cancel an Inbound Delivery with no quantities, the following steps must be performed:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Find the Inbound Delivery XYZ.-Access the Document Flow.-Open the Warehouse Order.-Perform an Adjustment Confirmation for the same, adding 1 unit for all items.-Now, perform a new Adjustment Confirmation, removing 1 unit for all items.-After executing these steps, the documents will be available for cancellation.-Keywords
