Title: Error message: Solution Profile is locked by user shows in the Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You are getting the below errors while trying to deploy business configuration of a solution from SDK or while deploying a solution into a tenant.-Implementation project is temporarily locked. Try deploying again.-Solution Profile is locked by XYZ (where XYZ is a business user)-BC deployment failed.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the affected solution.-Right click on the solution in the project explorer.-Select the option Deploy Business Configuration.-Select the radio button for the deployment as per your requirement and click on Ok.-Error occurs.-OR-Login to the Cloud Applications Studio.-On the Implementation Manager toolbar, click the Upload button and select the.zip file.-Click on Continue.-Click on Activate.-Error occurs.-Cause-The implementation project from Business configuration work center is currently locked by a business user.-Resolution-In order to deploy business configuration successfully from SDK or to deploy the solution into the tenant, you should ensure that the implementation project is not locked by any user.-Check with the user XYZ which you get from the error message and ask him to come out of the implementation project. After that, you can try deploying business configuration again from SDK or continue with the add-on deployment.-See Also-You can also refer to the below KBA for another use case where the Deploy Business Configuration is failing:-2189206 - Error During Deploy Business Configuration: Deployment Not Possible. Enable Solution For Business User Testing-Keywords-Deploy, BC, failed, Project, locked, user, Solution, Profile, locked-bc deployment failed,error during bc deployment from sdk,bc is locked

Title: Sales Order Confirmation with E-mail Not Maintained in Account Master Data
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order with an Account which does not have an e-mail address maintained, you have added the e-mail address to the Account/Bill-To Additional Details and when clicking Sales Order Confirmation the output is not being sent to the address maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Click on View All button.-Select the Additional Details under the Account.-In the General tab, enter the desired e-mail.-Click Send Order Confirmation to Account.-Open the document again.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-The confirmation is not sent to the expected e-mail address. -Cause-As per the Help Center document "Process-Integrated Output Settings" in order to be able to send an e-mail to the expected e-mail address, you need to maintain it in the Collaboration tab for the Account Master Data or in the Sales Order view, following the steps below:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Click on View All button.-On the top of the page, in the right side, click on You Can Also.-Select Edit Output Settings.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-As a work around, you can pass or update the Contacts e-mail but make sure that under the Account master data, you have maintained the E-mail as the Output Channel.-Go Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the Account XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Account).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Communications tab.-Select the Collaborations subtab.-Select Sales Order Confirmation.-Under Output Channel Settings, enter E-mail as the output channel.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales Order ID.-Click Edit.-Click on View All button.-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Select the Account.-Scroll down to the Related Contacts subtab.-Here you can maintained a contact and the e-mail address. -Please note that you can update the Related Contacts information via PDI or Webservice.-  See Also-Process-Integrated Output Settings-Keywords-Sales Order Confirmation, E-mail,  Sales Order,  Not Maintained, Account, Master Data, Output Channel

Title: Output Error "Recipient Address Rejected" After Sending E-Mail
Content: Symptom-You are trying to send a document to a recipient, but output is failing with a message 5.1.0 - Unknown address error and additional text including the recipient e-mail address and something along the lines of "Recipient address rejected."-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For this example, we are using customer invoices, but this can also happen to other documents.-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Access the Invoice Documents work center view.-Open the relevant document.-Go to Output History tab.-You see that the status is Error and the error message is similar to the one in the screenshot below:-Cause-The recipient has a custom E-mail Reputation Service which is blocking the emails from SAP.-Resolution-As the configuration causing the issue is on the recipient's e-mail server, no action can be taken by SAP.-You will need to check with the recipient's e-mail service provider and ask to unblock the emails from SAP. If needed, you can suggest allowing (whitelisting) the following IP addresses:-155.56.208.100/30-157.133.97.216/30-169.145.66.70/31-169.145.66.72/31-Keywords-Recipient address rejected, ERS-Customized-Block, 5.1.0 - Unknown address error, 550-'5.1.1, Sorry, no mailbox here by that name

Title: Supplier Invoice Cancellation Document Be Posted Even The Cost Center Is Invalid
Content: Symptom-You are able to post a supplier cancellation document even the assigned cost center is no longer valid. System does not raise any error messages.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Create and post supplier invoice A (A refers to invoice ID), with cost assignment cost center XYZ (XYZ refers to cost center ID), posting date 01.01.2022-Cost Center XYZ expires on 31.01.2022-Create and post cancelation document B for supplier invoice A, with same cost center and posting date 01.04.2022 -Cancellation document B is successfully posted without any error-You wonder why system allow cancellation document B be posted with an invalid cost center.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-For new supplier invoice with posting date after the cost center validity end date, system does not allow posting and raise below error message:-Cost center XYZ not found.-However, for supplier cancellation document, once it is posted then everything is reverted as if the original posting had never happened. Including reversing the value posted to that cost center. Hence even the cost center is no longer valid, posting of cancellation document is still allowed.-Keywords-Cancel Supplier Invoice, Invalid Cost Center, Cost Center Expired,  Cost center not found

Title: Error ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR for Outbound Messages in ByD or in C4C
Content: Symptom-You see outbound web service messages with error "ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR".-Full error message "Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Error when calling SOAP Runtime functions: SRT: Processing error in Internet Communication Framework: ("ICF Error when receiving the response: ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR") ()"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Open the Business Communication Monitoring view. -You see outbound messages with the error described above.-Cause-There a possible 6 different root causes:-The certificate chain (root and intermediate certificates) of the server host is missing in the certificate trust list.-The server firewall does not accept the inbound calls from ByD IP address.-The server does not accept TLS 1.2 protocol version.-You are trying to connect using a non-standard (not 443) HTTPS port.-Host Name in the Communication Arrangement was set wrongly.-Host Name in the communication system was changed when already communication systems were there.-The outbound service status was set to isolated, because of which the url was not getting updated when reactivating the communication arrangement.-Resolution- 1. Steps to upload the root/intermediate target server certificates:-Go to Application and User Management and select Common Tasks-Click on Edit Certificate Trust List-Upload the root and intermediate certificates from the server host-2. Step to whitelist the ByD inbound IP Address:-Contact your network admin and ask to whitelist the BYD outbound IP range as mentioned in the KBA: 2570539.-3. Enable in the target server the TLS 1.2 version protocol.-4. Please test the connection using HTTPS port 443.-In case you cannot use standard port 443, raise an SAP Incident asking if BYD operations team can open the required target port (this will be evaluated internally and might take several days).-5. Check if the Host Name in the Communication Arrangement is maintained properly according to your requirements.-6.  You will have to delete all the arrangements associated with that system and recreate them. Please delete and recreate those communication arrangements.-7. This happens when a tenant is set up as a copy of the Productive environment. Kindly raise an incident to SAP as a backend correction is required.-Keywords-Service Ping ERROR, outbound message failing, communication failing, Communication Arrangement, Host Name, ICF Error when receiving the response, ICM_HTTP_SSL_ERROR.-service ping error,error accessing service;,icm_http_ssl_error

Title: Font is Different In Output Preview Than When Editing Form Template with Adobe LifeCycle Designer
Content: Symptom-When you are editing form templates in Adobe LifeCycle Designer, you set one font type, but when previewing the form in the system, you see that the font type is different.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign- SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the relevant form template in Adobe LifeCycle Designer.-Set the font of a certain text as font A (A represents a font type).-Now, log into the system.-Access a document that uses this form template for output.-Click Preview-In the output preview, the text uses a font B, which is different from the font A you set in ALD. -Cause-The font you are using in the form template is not supported by the Adobe server. When generating the PDF, Adobe's server replaces the font type with the best-matching supported font.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-If you still want to use the not supported font, please create a incident for updating the new font and attach a valid font license for business usages.-Keywords-Font changes, Custom fonts, ADS fonts, Job profile assignment, Job profile , font update, Install font

Title: Process Communication Error "Changing Delivery Block not possible; field is read-only" in Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***- You identify a Process Communication Error for Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the Sales Order ID) in the Document Flow tab. Upon checking further, you see that the underlying error is "Changing Delivery Block not possible; field is read-only".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID: ABC-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-You can see the Process Communication Error icon.-Checking further, we can see the error text:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Process Communication Errors view.-You will be able to see Sales Order ABC with error: Changing Delivery Block not possible; field is read-only.-Cause-One of the possible causes for the error is when the Sales Order is still In Approval, which means that the system cannot change the value of the Delivery Block field.-Resolution-Via backend, you can find the stuck XI message causing the Process Communication Error:-Enter the transaction SRT_MONI.-Enter SALES_ORDER as Business Object.-Enter ROOT QUERY BY ELEMENTS-Enter ID-CONTENT-Enter the ID of the Sales Order.-Run the query.-There'll be a failed XI message which does not restart with the following info: - Sender: CustomerRequirementProcessing- Receiver: SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn- Error: Changing Delivery Block not possible; field is read-only- In order to solve this issue, the customer has to either complete the Approval process of Sales Order ABC or send the document back to revision so it's no longer pending approval. After that, you will be able to restart the XI message and the Process Communication Error will be cleared.-Keywords-Sales Order; Approval; Delivery Block; PCE; XI; Stuck; Erroneous

Title: Error: Posting date required to determine document number is missing
Content: Symptom-When you creating supplier invoice via custom Odata service, below error raises in response and invoice cannot be created.-Posting date required to determine document number is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Odata service testing tool (like Postman)-Fill the custom Odata service URL and maintain the necessary authorizations-Maintain the request content, send-In the response, no supplier invoice be created and above error message is raising-Cause-In business configuration activity "Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing", you define the Year Suffix Selection Date as Posting date. Hence if you don't provide posting date in the supplier invoice creation request, system cannot numbering the supplier invoice and cannot save the invoice.-Resolution-Please add posting date to your supplier invoice creation odata request.-Or, adjust the setting in business configuration activity "Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing", do not make the Year Suffix Selection Date as Posting date.-Keywords-Odata, Supplier Invoice,  Posting date required to determine document number is missing

Title: Task type exists with instantiation lock
Content: Symptom-After creating a custom approval process on your add-on within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio and then clicking on the Submit for Approval button on the UI, the below errors are shown:-Task type exists with instantiation lock-Process definition exists with configuration error-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Cause-This issue occur when there is a change in the design time data in the approval process related files. In order to keep data consistent, approval task type is "Instantiation locked" until the changes are deployed into the solution profile workspace.-Resolution-You can be resolving the issue by following either of the opstions below:-1. To update the solution workspace when opening the tenant's Implementation Project or by deploying Business Configuration for the solution on the Studio.-2. If this does not fix this issue then please try to cross check if the solution is completely scoped on this tenant.-3. If it is scoped, please descope it and scope again. (be aware of consequences which are stated on CAS help portal when descoping it).-Keywords-YXXXXXX_AXXX_AXX, SDK, PDI, BTM,  approved, rejected, in, revision, task, type, exists, with, instantiation, lock, process, definition

Title: Error While Adding Key Figure to the Report
Content: Symptom-You create a calculated key figure but cannot add this key figure to a report. You receive a dump or error message when editing the report and adding the key figure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Reports.-Open your custom report by clicking on Edit with > Report Wizard.-Go to the Select Key Figures tab and click the Create button.-On the next screen, provide the name and description of your key figure.-By default, Calculated Key Figure will be selected.-Click the Next button and maintain a formula here. Complete the key figure.-Go back to the Select Key Figures tab in the report wizard and add the key figure you have just created to the report.-You will see an error message, such as:-System error in program SAPLRRI2 and form CHECK_MAX_MEMMERS-01-.-Other errors are possible.-Cause-This report reached the maximum members of 1000 components. An example of a report component would be a key figure, a formula step, a restriction of a selection variable etc.-In most cases, such a scenario occurs when you create very complex key figures. For example: You create a calculated key figure whose calculation uses 10 more custom key figures. If you check each of these 10 key figures, they in turn are calculations, using other custom key figures etc.-The setup of your key figure can be checked by following these steps:-Open the report in the report wizard as above.-Go to the Select Key Figures tab.-Select the customer created key figure and click the Edit button.-On the next screen, click the Next button and count the key figures used in the formula.-Repeat the same for all the key figure structures for both calculated and restricted key figures.-Resolution-It is not possible to have more than 1000 components per report. Please make use of one or more of the following options:-You can split the report in two or more reports and distribute the key figures between the sub-reports.-Check if all key figures added to the report are actually required. Remove all unnecessary elements.-Check the modeling of each of the used key figures. Is the modeling as brief and simple as possible? Remove all unnecessary steps / elements / calculations.-In scenarios with multiple restricted key figures, where the base key figure is the same and the restriction is different, please also consider creating 1 key figure with a variable restriction. You will be able to set the restriction in the report selection. This eliminates the need for several key figures.-Keywords-report, key figure, 1000, key figure limit, exception, MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT, CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION, dump, error message, crash, SAPLRRI2, CHECK_MAX_MEMMERS-01

Title: Error Message "Interval with Start Number XXX and End Number YYY Must Not Overlap"
Content: Symptom-You are editing the number range for a business partner or document type, but when saving the changes, error message "Interval with start number XXX and end number YYY must not overlap" is triggered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-Reproducing the Issue-For this document, we will be using the Number Range for Business Partners as an example:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview work center view.-Search and open the fine-tuning activity General Business Partners.-In the new screen, click the link to Define Number Ranges for Business Partners.-Select one of the number range rows.-Change or enter a value for the Start Number and/or End Number.-Click the button Save and Close.-System throws the above-mentioned error message.-Cause-The error is due to the overlap between the available number range rows.-The number ranges are separated, often by source (internal and external), so that the system knows from which "pool" of number ranges to draw a new ID when a new record is created based on the source. If these number ranges overlapped, the system could draw IDs from an incorrect number range pool and this would generate inconsistencies — as such, system does not allow saving a configuration in which number ranges overlap.-Resolution-Please define number ranges that do not overlap between categories. For example, if you are defining the internal number range as 0001 to 9999, the external number range should be 10000 to XXXXX (where XXXXX represent any end number higher than 10000).-If you can see no overlap, than the issue might be caused by alphanumeric values in the interval of a manual number range, which can cause effects that are not obvious at first sight. Check the "See Also" section for more information.-See Also-Number Ranges and Number Assignment, at SAP Community wiki.-Keywords-Number Range, Interval with start number, end number, must not overlap, Employee ID, Service Agent ID, General Business Partners.
