Title: Percentage Under 100% on Invoice Schedule Prevents Sales Order Completion
Content: Symptom-On Sales Order AAA, you have set up an Invoice Schedule (AAA is the Sales Order ID) with several Invoice date for Item XX (XX is the Line Item ID).-You have already one Scheduled Invoice Request invoiced which represents n% of the total amount, the invoice is released, posted and cleared.-You cancel the other invoice dates for Item XX on the Invoice Schedule.-Now, you cannot set Sales Order  AAA to Complete even after the invoicing is finished.-Reason for Rejection fields on Header and Item levels are grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Open Sales Order AAA.-Navigate to the  Pricing and Invoicing tab and then the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Expand Item XX.- Only one Invoice Date remains and the Percentage is n%.- On Sales Order AAA, the following warning message is raised:-Item XX: um of dates' amounts YY CUR falls below the item's amount' amounts YY CUR falls below the item's amount ZZ CUR-(CUR stands for currency, YY is the amount invoiced and ZZ is the original net amount)-Go to the Items tab and select Item XX.-Go to the Details subtab.-The Invoicing status is In process-Cause-You have invoiced  only n% of the original net amount and the system still expect 100% of the amount to be invoiced.-This set the Invoicing Status to be In Process.-As long as Delivery and / or Invoicing Statuses are still In Process, Sales Orders cannot be completed.-Resolution-There are two possible scenarios to bring the total percentage to 100% and complete Sales Order AAA:-scenario 1: There is still an outstanding amount to be invoiced.-scenario 2: The total amount has to be invoiced in one invoice.-  Scenario 1-Open Sales Order AAA.-Navigate to the  Pricing and Invoicing tab and then the Invoice Schedule subtab.-Expand Item XX.-Add new dates to the invoice schedule to bring the total percentage to 100%-Save Sales Order AAA.-Create a Manual Scheduled Invoice Request for each new date added and invoice them.-Sales Order AAA is completed once all invoicing is finished.- Scenario 2-Cancel all follow-up documents, up to Sales Order AAA.-After you have canceled the documents, you can modify the Invoice Schedule and ensure that the amount to be invoiced is 100%.-Sales Order AAA is completed once invoicing is finished.-See Also-Help Document Canceling a Customer Invoice-KBA 3050995 - Sales Order is in Status In Process but you Expect it to be in Status Completed-Keywords-Sales Order; Invoice Schedule; Cancel Open Dates; In Process; sum of dates; amounts; falls below; 100%

Title: You Cannot Change the Address Details in a Sales Order Created via Internet
Content: Symptom-You created a sales order via web service and found the postal code in the account address is wrong, but you are not able to change the address any more. However, if the sales order is created manually, then the address can be modified after save.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the sales order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of a sales order).-Notice that the Origin is Internet. This is a order created via web service.-Open the Address Details hyperlink under the account, you cannot edit the address, all the fields are grayed out.-However, if you open another order with Origin as Manual Entry, the address details can be changed.-Cause-When creating a Sales Order via the web service (Origin Internet), the address data cannot be changed.-An address that is maintained via the web-service becomes a document address, that is, an address that is valid only for that sales order document. An address in a document cannot be changed, but a new one can be created which will overwrite the previous document address. This would be mean that if the customer wants to change, for example, an email ID, the customer would have to read all information present in the current address and send it back along with the new email ID as an update request.-This is also mentioned in secondary help document.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer view.-Select the web service ManageSalesOrderIn-Click on the Link for Documentation-You can see the details in the section  Child Node – Address-Resolution-You will need to send an update request via the web service in order to change the address details.-Keywords-Sales Order; Internet; Origin; Address; Read Only; Web Service; Change

Title: How to Process Duplicated Bank Statements
Content: Symptom-One bank statement is required for Postprocessing, and it has the same items with another bank statement which has already been posted and allocated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and select the Bank Statements view.-Select the bank statement in question, and you can see that the value for Postprocessing is shown as Required.-Cause-The reason for the duplicate bank statement is that you first create and post a bank statement, and directly afterwards create the next bank statement. As the payment allocation run has not finished yet, and therefore the items of the first bank statement are not allocated yet, which are still selectable in the second step of the guided activity for creating bank statements.-Resolution--To fix the issue, you have the following options:-To reverse the bank statement in question, but if there is at least one bank statement with a later date that has been already posted or uploaded and ready to be posted manually, you should reverse all the follow-up bank statements for the same bank account starting from the latest one.-The other option is to work on the payment allocations of bank statement in question, marking all the allocations as Returns, and posting the returns in new bank statement.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center, and choose the Bank Statements view.-View the bank statement in question.-For each item, choose Required link under Postprocessing.-In the upcoming Payment Allocation, choose View All.-In the new screen, set the Return Reason as 9- Correction of duplicate entry, and then choose Mark As Return under Actions.-Repeat the above steps for all items of the bank statement in question.-After that, create a new manual bank statement on the same bank account.-In the step Selected Items, you find for each outgoing check an entry with Payment Method being Incoming Return of an Outgoing Payment, select all these items.-For the incoming checks or incoming bank transfers, go directly to bank statement step Create and Edit Items, for each incoming check or bank transfer, create an item with payment method Outgoing Return of an Incoming Payment and debit the amount of the incoming check/bank transfer.-Then press Required link in the Postprocessing column.-In the upcoming Payment Allocation screen, under the Payment Assignment tab, select the bank transfer/incoming check in the lower table, and press the Arrow Up button to add the item to the bank statement.-After that, choose Save and Return.-Post the bank statement.-Keywords-bank statement; duplicate; duplicated; reverse bank statement

Title: How to Process Expense Report Items in The Business Task Management For Employees That Are Blocked or Have Left The Company
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer have Unassigned Items in the Business Task Management such as:-Your Expense Report XYZ was Reimbursed (XYZ represents the ID of the Expense Report).-Your Expense Report XYZ was Approved and Payment was Authorized.-Revise Expense Report XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work centre.-Go to the Task Distribution subview.-Navigate to the Business Task Management view.-Show the Unassigned Items.-You see Business Tasks regarding Expense Reports Approval and Reimbursement.-Click Actions.-The Cancel option is greyed out.-You do not want to assign the Item since the respective Employee has left the Company or is marked as Blocked in the system.-Cause-The responsible Employee in the respective Expense Report XYZ is blocked in the system and/or has left the Company.-Resolution-In this case a Backend Correction is necessary.-The Unassigned Items needs to be canceled via the Backend in order to remove it from the Frontend.-A solution in the Frontend is in this case not possible.- You can send the Incident either to the component  AP-ERM-ER or proceed as follows:-Logon to the Backend.-Use Transaction SESFTS.-The BO Name is ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT.-Load By Alternative Key - Root ID.- A new window opens.-Put in the ID of Expense Report XYZ.-Write down the UUID number or the NODE ID. Both are the same.- Leave the Testshell and go into transaction SBTM_TASK_SEL.-Select Status as Ready.-BO Name is ERM_EXPENSE_REPORT.-Copy the NODE ID or the UUID number into the BO Node ID field.-Execute the query.-A new screen opens.-Make sure you select the correct Task Instance.-Click the Cancel Task Instance Button and save.-Check in the Frontend if the task was successfully canceled.-Close the Incident. -Keywords-Spesenabrechnung, Geschäftsvorfall, BTM task, Blocked Employee, Employee left company,

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Enhancement Implementation (BADI) Related Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In this Knowledge Based Article, we will look at known issues regarding the Enhancement Implementation (BADI = Business Add In) topic, and how we can troubleshoot Enhancement Implementation issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-Name of Enhancement Implementation / filepath of the .enht and related ABSLs.-Steps and permission to reproduce the issue in the UI (only if required for analysis).-Resolution-SAP provides enhancement options based on SAP technology that allow you customers and partners to enhance the standard behavior of the specific application without modifying the standard solution.-In the Cloud Applications Studio, partners can create enhancement implementations based on SAP enhancement options (BADI).-Incidents related to Enhancement Implementations (BADIs) are routed to the corresponding application team, as they are the provider and are responsible for the BADI.-There are two types of Enhancement options:-Single use: it can be implemented only once in a solution.-Multiple use: it can be implemented more than once in a solution.-We can find out information on the BADI in the Repository Explorer of the SDK by selecting Enhancement Options.-Name, Namespace, Description, Type (multiple or single use), Related Business Object, Deployment Unit.-The Public Solution Model (PSM) section is displayed too, however they are all released if they are visible in the Repository Explorer.-What filters are available, and a brief description is displayed.-What Operation is available, and what Input / Output is needed for this to work. The Input and Output expects a specific value, and will tell you what Datatype is expected. Check that the Datatype used, matches the expected Datatype in the Repository Explorer for this BADI.-If the enhancement is implemented according to the set-up documentation, but the BADI still doesn't behave as expected, the incident shall be moved to the Application team responsible for this BADI, after the below checks are done:-On SDIM, if solution is Deployed Successfully:-Go to BCE to check if solution is scoped.-Check XREP on both layers to see if the related files are active.-  On SDIM, if solution is Develop Started:-Check layer_cust on XREP to see if the solution is enabled (if the add-on is not enabled there will be no solution folders and partner should enabled the add-on on the SDK).-Check XREP on both layers to see if the related files are active.-Filters:-By default, all filters are disabled except for mandatory filters.-To enable a filter, the partner must select the filter checkbox.-If the partner does not specify a value for a mandatory filter, the system reads the value as blank. -If a code list is available for a filter, you can select a value from a dropdown list.-If you hover over the filter name, the data type of the filter is displayed as a tooltip. -Related KBAs:-2604776 - Unable to Use KUT Fields in PDI Enhancement Implementation-2568317 - How to Add Custom Validations and Messages to Time Sheet Validation for Employee-2623964 - Unable To Send Attachments With Workflow Rules-2442964 - How To Check CTI Enhancement for Inbound Calls-2565911 - You Want to Enhance The AWS Email Feeder Using A BAdi-2651252 - Cannot Activate BADI Enhancement Implementation ABSL Script File-2824055 - How to Find the Responsible Application Component for Enhancement Implementation (BADI)-You can use the backend transaction SE20 to search for, and find information on BADIs. Please see above KBA 2824055.-Keywords-BADI, SDK, PDI, Enhancement, Option, Implementation, Business, Add, In, Cloud, Applications, Studio

Title: Cannot Maintain Transport Lane Shipping Duration as 0 Day 00:00:00
Content: Symptom-When editing shipping duration for a transport lane, you find it's impossible to maintain it as 0 Day 00:00:00.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Go to Transport Lanes view-Select a transport lane, Edit-Maintain Shipping Duration as 0 Day 00:00:00-Save and Close-Open the transport lane again, you see the Shipping Duration automatically changed to other value, like 1 Day 00:00:00.-Cause-You have maintained business configuration fine-tuning activity Default Shipping Duration as other value, like 1 Day 00:00:00.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search and open activity Default Shipping Duration-Change the default value to 0 day 00:00:00, Save-Then you will be allowed to maintain shipping duration as 0 Day 00:00:00 for transport lanes.-Keywords-Transport Lane ; Shipping Duration ; 0 Day

Title: How to Change the Cash Flow Key for the Foreign Currency Remeasurement.
Content: Symptom-When you execute the foreign currency remeasurement run, in the Journal Entry posted, you see the cash flow key is shown as CF023 in the Item Details.-You would like to know how to change this.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2205.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Journal Entries View.-Find and open Journal Entry AAAA(AAAA is the ID of the Journal Entry) for foreign currency remeasurement run BBBB(BBBB is the ID of the run).-In the Item details for G/L Account CCCC(CCCC is the number of the G/L Account), you see the value of cash flow key is CF023.-Cause-Before the release of 2205, the cash flow key is missing in the Journal Entry posted when you execute the foreign currency remeasurement run.-After the release of 2205, there is one and only one cash flow key can be marked as FCR relevant, and CF023 is marked as FCR relevant by default.-Resolution-To change the default Cash Flow Key for Foreign Currency Remeasurement:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open Activity: Direct Cash Flow Statement - China.-The Foreign Currency Remeasurement (FCR) Indicator is checked for Cash Flow Key CF023 by default.-Uncheck it for CF023 and check the Cash Flow Key XXX (XXX is the ID of the Cash Flow Key)as your expectation.-Click Save and Close.-Then the system will use the Cash Flow Key XXX in the Journal Entry posted when you execute the foreign currency remeasurement run.-TIPs:-If the journal entry was created before the release of BYD 2205, there was no cash flow key in it. You can create manual Journal Entry Vouchers to adjust the values if required.-Keywords-cash flow key. foreign currency remeasurement run. journal entry. CF023. 现金流代码. 外币重估运行. 日记账分录.

Title: How to See And Edit An Existing Holiday Calendar
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to see and/or edit an existing holiday calendar.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search for fine-tuning activity Working Day Calendar.-Select it and click Open.-In the new screen, select the option "Maintain existing holiday calendar."-NOTE: only custom holiday calendars will be editable. Standard holiday calendars will raise warning messsage "SAP Delivered Calendar: Cannot be maintained" before opening and will not allow any editing.-Keywords-Edit, Open, Maintain, Holiday Calendar, Custom, Standard, SAP Delivered Calendar

Title: Automatic Clearing of Bank Advices via Web Service and Open Invoices
Content: Symptom-You are creating bank credit advices via web service ManageBankAdviceIn with reference to existing invoice in the system, however the automatic clearing between invoice and bank advice does not happen. Instead, the advice becomes an open item in the customer account monitor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the concerned customer account monitor.-You'll see that the advice created via web service remains as an open item.-Cause-One of the reasons why the automatic clearing does not happen is that the request XML has been made with the Initiator Invoice Request tag (<PaymentTransactionInitiatorInvoiceReference>) for the invoice, which refers to Invoice ID field in the bank advice screen, being an external reference ID. Hence, the automatic clearing does not happen.-The Invoice ID field can be seen in the References section in the bank advice.-Resolution-In order for the automatic clearing to be possible, you need to create the bank advice with the Document ID filled as reference. In the XML request, add the <PaymentTransactionDestinatedInvoiceReference> being the internal reference for the invoice you wish to clear, which is the Document ID.-The resulting payload file shall have both the <PaymentTransactionInitiatorInvoiceReference> and <PaymentTransactionDestinatedInvoiceReference> with the corresponding external reference ID and document ID.-Keywords-ManageBankAdviceIn; bank credit advice

Title: Sales Orders is Generating Different Delivery Groups Between Items
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order and when navigating to the Items tab, you noticed that the delivery groups are different between the items, despite having the same Delivery Rule.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will be creating a Sales Order via the UI (User Interface), however the behavior also applies for Orders created via Webservice.-Go to Sales Order workcenter.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Select All Orders then search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order created).-Click Edit then View All.-Go to Items subtab.-Item 10 has the Delivery Group: 3-Item 20 has the Delivery Group: 4-Cause-The Ship-To address has been specified at item level (individual items) and in such cases the system will generate a different GUID (globally unique identifier) for each item even if the addresses are the same.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-If all the items in the Sales Order are going to the same Ship-To address, the address should be maintained on header level so that the same cascades to the items.-or-If there is a difference in Ship-To address between the items, please maintain the Ship-To addresses in the Account master data.-For webservice scenarios, when there is a difference in Ship-To address between the items, please maintain the Ship-To addresses in the Account master data and then use the relevant address reference GUIDs at item level in the payload.-See Also-2709773 - Complete Delivery Order With Multiple Deliveries-Keywords-Sales Order, Webservice, Payload, Delivery Group, Delivery Rule, Item, Difference

Title: Not Able to Invoice Customer Project Invoice Request After Changing Organization Structure
Content: Symptom-After performing changes to the companies Organization Structure, you are trying to invoice your invoice request documents and facing the following errors:-Organization Sales Unit ID  must have organizational role Sales-Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Company)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Select the Customer Project Invoice Request XYZ.-Click Check-Error:-Organization Sales Unit ID  must have organizational role Sales-Party with role Sales Unit does not belong to seller company XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Company)-Cause-For the Customer Project Invoice Request, we do not have the Sales Organization as party. The party used to the determine the Sales Organization is the Sales Unit party.-It works in the following way:-When the Sales Unit is changed in the Sales Order document, it reflects this information to the Project Management (CustomerProjectInvoicingAgreement), causing it to update accordingly. When a new Customer Project Invoice Request is created, it copies this Sales Unit from the CustomerProjectInvoicingAgreement.-Existing Customer Project Invoice Requests are not updated with changes from the Sales Order and for such, they keep the old Sales Unit that was valid when the Customer Project Invoice Request was created.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In order to solve this, please cancel the inconsistent Customer Project Invoice Request and create a new one with the correct master data.-Keywords-Customer Project Invoice Request, Inconsistency, Sales Unit, Organization, Structure, Sales Organization, Party Role

Title: Employee Missing in Direct Approvers for Supplier Approval
Content: Symptom-You are trying to define Employees for Supplier Approval, but they are not showing up in the Direct Approvers list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Go to Task Distribution and Approval Processes View.-Filter it by All Processes.-Edit an available one under "Related Business Document: Business Partner Approval Request".-Under "Work Distribution" change it to "Direct Approvers" and click in Edit button.-You won't find any available approver.-Cause-Case 1:- This happens because there are no Business Users with the work center "Managing My Area" and the views "Supplier".-Case 2:- Also if there is no write access for the "Managing My Area" and the views "Supplier" for the respective user.-Resolution-Prerequisties:-Scoping Question "Do you want to set up approval process for suppliers?" should be scoped.-Resolution 1:-If you want the Employee to be appearing in the list of Approvers for "Business Partner Approval Request", then assign the work center "Managing My Area" and the views "Supplier".-Note: If you want to check the Supplier data then you can also assign "Supplier Base" work center-Resolution 2:-2. You also need to verify whether the user has write access for "Managing My Area" and the views "Supplier" to the respective user. Ensure that the user have Unrestricted write access-Keywords-Approver; Employee; Business Partner, Approval, Process, Missing, Empty, List

Title: You are Receiving E-mail Notifications Related to Purchase Orders Not Assigned to Your User
Content: Symptom-You are receiving e-mail notifications about Purchase Orders even when you are not the responsible for the document. You don't want to receive those notifications via e-mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The current system behavior is that an e-mail notification will be sent in two cases:-There is a rule maintained for the scenario;-The user is subscribed to the mentioned task.-Resolution-First you need to check if there is any rule maintained:-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to Workflow Rules view. -See which rules are maintained.-Then you check if the user is subscribed to those tasks:-Go to Home work center. -Go to Work view and then to Inbox subview. -Click in Subscribe to Tasks button. -Expand Purchase Requests and Orders. -Expand Purchase Requests. -You can see that for some tasks the box may be checked, for example, 'Complete Purchase Order' and 'Revise Purchase Order'.-If you do not want to receive e-mails regarding those tasks, you need to uncheck those tasks.-You can also check who is the Person Responsible for that task:-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to Business Task Management view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID. -Check the information of the task:-Subject (for example): Revise Purchase Order ABC. -Person Responsible: Global Work Assignment -Also in the case that the Person Responsible for the task is 'Global Work Assignment', all the users that have access to the work center will receive those tasks. For example, if a task is about Purchase Orders, the user will receive it if they have access to the purchasing work center.-See Also- KBA: 2647446 - Not Receiving E-Mail Notifications for the Subscribed Tasks-Keywords-E-mail, Notification, Purchase Order, Rule

Title: Assigned Printer Queue for checks (cheques) is not considered
Content: Symptom-You have assigned a printer queue A for outgoing checks (cheques), but checks are going into printer queue B and your output configuration seems to be ignored (A & B represent the relevant printer queues).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Release a check (cheque) for printing and instead of the assigned printer queue A you see the check (cheque) in printer queue B.-Cause-For check (cheque) printing it is important as they are numbered to have the right print on the right check (cheque).-To prevent mistakes by accident or changing output settings there is a place you can "hardcode" the output printer queue.-Navigate to the-Go to the Liquidity Management work centre  -> View: My Banks-Go to the facet Bank Accounts, facet check lots-Under Details: Check Lot you see a field named output device.-Resolution-Remove the maintained device from the output device and the standard application output logic will take place again.-Keywords-Check Printing, Check lot, Check Printer Queue, cheque, cheques,

Title: "No items found" for the Dropdown of Column G/L Account When Creating New Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for G/L.
Content: Symptom-"No items found" for the dropdown of column G/L Account when creating New Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for G/L.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Foreign Currency Remeasurement View.-Click New Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for G/L.-Enter company AAA and leave the set of books empty(AAA is the ID of the company).-Click add row in the selection by G/L Account.-Then click the value help of the G/L account, you see "No items found".-Cause-This is working as designed.-Whenever set of books is not selected then it is expected that G/L selection drop down list to be empty and this is expected behavior as per functionality, it is mandatory to select set of books to have G/L drop down populated due to multiple set of books scenario.-Resolution-You are able to see G/L Accounts after you select set of books.-Keywords-No items found, G/L Accounts, Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for G/L, missing.

Title: Form Template Production Confirmation not available
Content: Symptom-You can not find the form template Production Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work centre-Select the Form template Maintenance view and use the extended help-Search for the template name 'Production Confirmation Template' and you will get no result.-Cause-System configuration needs to be reviewed.-Resolution-Navigate to the Business Configuration-Select the relevant Implementation Project-Click edit project scope-Navigate to the step "Questions"-Open the scoping Element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistic-Now open the sub-view "Internal Logistics" and click on "Communication for internal Logistics"-Activate the Business Option "You will be able to print confirmation notification-Finalize the new scoping and the form will be available.-Keywords-Production Confirmation template, Form missing, Forms internal Logistic

Title: Unable to Save Opportunity When Logged in Arabic Language
Content: Symptom-You are unable to save an Opportunity when logged on in Arabic language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Logon in Arabic and:-Go to New Business work center.-Go to Opportunity List view. -Click in the New button and select Opportunity. -In the Account section, add the information Name. -Click in the Save button.-You get the warning messages: 'Save failed' and 'Name is missing'.-Even if you change the Account Name, the warning message is still triggered and you're unable to save it.-Cause-This issue occurs because the translation for description of Activity Task and Appointment Activity is not maintained for these activities created by Sales Assistant, during opportunity creation.-Resolution-You should maintain the translation for description of Activities in the Sales Assistant:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select your current project. -Open the Activity list. -Search for Sales Assistant and open it. -Click in 'Maintain Activities'. -Select any activity.-Click in the Translate button. -Keep the translation for the activities for Arabic (Target Language).-Save it.-Keywords-Opportunity, Arabic, Translation

Title: Task Cannot be Finished Using Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to finish the logistics task XXX using web service, as an example ManageSiteLogisticsTaskIn, the quantity is confirmed, however the task is still In Process.-XXX = Task ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Select Task Control view. -Find the Task XXX. -Notice that it is still In Process instead Finished. -Cause-There are two possible causes for this behavior:-Case 1: You have not specified the Output Product in your XML.  As we do not enter the type of task in the payload (if it is a Pick Task, Put Away Task, ect), we need to work with these tags to drive the products. It is the combination of these tags that will drive the products to our out our stock, as well as from and to different logistics areas for internal tasks.-MaterialInput tag - it is used to inform the system the Source Logistics Area, from where we are taking the products of.-MaterialOutput tag - it is used to inform the Target Logistics area, where we are stocking the product.-Case 2: The Task XXX was not finished by the web service when all products were fully delivered in one go.-The payload must contain all products with their full quantities. Therefore, if we have an item already updated in the system and send a payload with the second line item, the system will still keeps the task in process. We need to do all in one message. We can repeat the already updated item in a second payload if necessary, as this would not cause errors.-Resolution-These are the resolutions for this behavior:-Case 1: In case of tasks in Outbound Logistics, you need to add the MaterialOutput tag to the XML.-Case 2: You need to confirm the full quantities of the tasks in one go.-Keywords-Tasks; ws; payload

Title: Goods and Services Receipts not Being Assigned to Expected Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You expect a given Goods and Services Receipts to be assigned to a Supplier Invoice, but a different document is assigned instead.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant document and open it.-Click on view all and go to Items tab.-Go to Document Flow sub tab.-System has assigned Goods Receipts different that the expected, being the expected the Receipt that it has the exact quantity of the invoice.-Resolution-When we have several invoice items, which can be deassigned or reassigned (refer to the same delivery or order), there is a specific order when which item is assigned:-First the one that has an unassigned item with same quantity as the delivery that is created.-Then the posted ones (Status Posted, Paid, Partially Paid).-Then the ones that have the Status "In Approval".-Then in order of the invoice date (oldest one is changed first).-Keywords-Supplier Invoice. Goods and Service Receipt. Purchase Order.

Title: Service Order and Services Confirmation are not Shown CRMSRSCIB Data Source
Content: Symptom-Service Orders and Services Confirmations are not shown, when you search on the data source CRMSRSCIB.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Navigate to the Data Sources view.-Open the Data Source Service Order Item & Service Confirmation Item (CRMSRSCIB).-Click on the Preview button.-Click on the Apply button.-You can see the data source does not display the data.-You expect that Service Confirmation XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation) is displayed here.-Cause-This report only shows data for those sales order which have service confirmations linked to them. In your system, there are no such sales orders.-Resolution-The Service Order / Service Confirmation should be referenced on Item Level:-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Open the Service Confirmations view-Search for the Service Confirmation XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Click on Edit button-Click on the View All Button-Navigate to Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select the line item.-You can see that in the field Reference Service Order/Item no value is maintained. You need to maintain the Sales Order and Line Item of the respecive referenced Sales Order. -Keywords-Service Order; CRMSRSCIB; Data Source

Title: You Cannot Edit the Layout of a Site or Location
Content: Symptom-While attempting to create a layout for a Site or Location, the “Edit Layout” button is greyed out and cannot be selected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Find and select the relevant Site/Location ID.-The Edit Layout button is greyed out.-Cause-The Logistics Relevance and Storage Location check box is unchecked in Site or Location master data.-Resolution-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Find and select the relevant Site/Location ID.-Choose Edit.-Select Logistics Relevance checkbox.-Upon selecting Logistics Relevance checkbox, Storage location checkbox also gets enabled.-Select Storage Location checkbox.-Choose Save and Close.-The Edit layout button is now enabled.-Note: The Logistics Relevance checkbox is available only at the Site level. In the Location master data, enabling the Storage Location checkbox enables the Edit Layout button for the Location.-See Also-Help document: Create and Edit a Location and Simple Location Layout Creation.-Keywords-Edit Layout; Location; Site; Logistics Relevance; Supply Chain Management; Storage Location; Greyed Out; Supply Chain Design Master Data; Create and Edit a Location; Simple Location Layout Creation

Title: After Changing Setting for MDR in SDK, the Run in the Fronted UI Still with Old Setting
Content: Symptom- After changing the setting for Mass Data Run(MDR) in SDK, you found the run in the fronted UI still has the old setting.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio-Open your custom MDR-You changes the old setting (ex. parallel processing, retention time of the application log)-Go to fronted UI and schedule the run which's created before the change-You found this run still has the old setting-Cause-Once you change the setting in MDR definition(ex. parallel processing, retention time of the application log), a new run needs to be created for having the new setting. Old runs which were created before the change remains old setting.-Resolution-Please kindly create a new run in the fronted UI and make the old run obsolete.-Keywords-MDR;PDI;retention;parallel processing

Title: Change of Pricing of Products at Item Level for Migrated Sales Orders is not Possible
Content: Symptom-Change of pricing of products at Item level for Migrated Sales Orders is not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders.-Select the Migrated Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the migrated sales order).-Select Edit button.-Select the View All button.-Select the Item tab.-Try to edit or change the Price of a product.-Price cannot be changed or edited.-Cause-Once the sales order is migrated to the SAP Business ByDesign system, the price for the item is not changeable and replicating same price calculation as in the legacy order may not be possible.-So legacy order item's net value is taken as migration price for the item in SAP Business ByDesign order and then this migration price is made read-only.-Resolution-The workaround to resolve this issue is to cancel the migrated sales order and create a new sales order with required details.-To cancel the sales order set its status as completed i.e. block its further processing and create a new Order.-Follow the steps below to cancel the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders View.-Show All Orders.-Select the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the sales order).-Select the Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the General tab.-Select the reason available in drop down list of Reason for Rejection.-Save the sales order.

Title: You Cannot Edit the Tax Details in the Service Confirmation Invoice Requests
Content: Symptom-While trying to edit the tax details on a Service Confirmation Invoice Request, found that the tax-related fields are grayed out and cannot be edited. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Confirmation Invoice Requests).-Select the Invoice Request ABC and Click Edit and View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-In the Taxes sub-tab, view the tax details; for example, Tax Code field is not editable.-Cause-This is an invoice request with the type Service Confirmation Invoice Request.-For invoice requests of type Service Confirmation, the Tax Code cannot be changed directly in the Invoice Request. To change the Tax Code, the changes need to be made in the corresponding Service Confirmation document.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-The tax code can be changed in the Service Confirmation document, or the tax code data can be edited when invoicing the document.-See Also-KBA 1976626 - You Cannot Edit the Tax Details in the External Customer Invoice Requests-Keywords-Service Confirmation Invoice Requests; Change; Read Only, Tax Code

Title: No filter values are showing on the Badi PaymentToPaymentFileConversion from a MCS
Content: Symptom-You have an implementation enhancement created for the enhancement spot PaymentToPaymentFileConversion in a multi-customer solution within SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-When opening the filter file (.fltr), no values are shown on the dropdown field:-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign -Cause-The use case to have the enhancement spot PaymentToPaymentFileConversion implemented on a multi-customer solution is not fully supported.-Resolution-You would need to implement the enhancement spot within a customer-specific solution.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, add-on, BADI, MCS

Title: Business Object "ControlledOutputRequest" is Not Released for Public Write Access
Content: Symptom-You wish to use the business object "ControlledOutputRequest" (/DOC/OM_CTRL_OUTPUT_REQ) and/or one of its related properties in a custom solution, but notice that the object is not released for Public Write Access.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-Business object /DOC/OM_CTRL_OUTPUT_REQ is part of the old Output Management architecture, which is now obsolete.-This is why it is blocked for Public Write Access and will not be released if requested.-Resolution-Instead, please use business object "DocumentOutputRequest" (/DOC/OM_DOCUMENT_OUT_REQ), the equivalent in the new Output Management architecture which is already released for Public Write Access.-See Also-SAP ByDesign Public Solution Model blog, in SAP Community-Keywords-PSM release, /DOC/OM_CTRL_OUTPUT_REQ, Public Write Access, /DOC/OM_DOCUMENT_OUT_REQ, Print Queue ID

Title: How To Change State Sales Tax
Content: Symptom-You want to change the State Sales Tax (%) from X% to Y%.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Click Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order and click Edit.-Click View All.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Under Total Pricing you can see the State Sales Tax (%) is X%.-Due to legal requirements, you want to change the State Sales Tax (%) to Y%.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to change the State Sales Tax (%):-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Click Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and click Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine-Tune tab.-Select the Tax on Goods and Services - [Country] activity.-Click Open.-Click Define Sales Tax Rate Schedules.-Change the rates for the state as desired.-Rates will get picked if tax calculation is triggered again.-Keywords-tax rate; tax jurisdiction; state sales tax-u.s.,state sales tax

Title: Sales Order Document Numbering Missing
Content: Symptom-You would like to configure document numbering for Sales Orders the same way you can perform for other documents, such as Customer Invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configurations work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the active project.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine-Tune tab.-Search for Document Numbering*-Here you see that the system does not return any Document Numbering rule for Sales Order.-Cause-Currently there is no Document Numbering rule for Sales Order.-Resolution-The feature/functionality is currently not part of the SAP product you have subscribed to, as outlined in our Product Documentation.-You have the following options:-In order for you to directly get in contact with the decision makers in SAP Product Management, please submit your enhancement request via the following SAP Continuous Influence sites: SAP Business ByDesign-This program is related to Products and Solutions. Ideas are reviewed by SAP Product Management. Votes help to prioritize ideas along with other important selection criteria such as:-DESIRABILITY: How many customers voted for this? How many customers will benefit from it?-VIABILITY: Is this Improvement Request globally relevant? Is this in alignment with SAP’s strategy for the product?-FEASIBILITY: Is the development effort realistic?  Is this request achievable within the product’s architecture?-All ideas are welcome and valuable. However please note that the volume of ideas will usually be much higher than the scope of what we can accomplish on our product development roadmap.-See Also-1572833 - Document Numbering Of Sales Documents Is Not Sequential-Keywords-Sales Order, Document Numbering, Rule, Business Configuration

Title: Error Message "Time Period or Duration Mandatory in Combination with Project Data"
Content: Symptom-While saving and releasing the time sheet, system throws an error message as "Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1:-Go to Home work center.-Select the Self Services view.-Select the Self-Services Overview sub view.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Enter the Work Description without entering the hours in the timesheet for the day.-Click on Save and Release here you can see the system throws an error message as "Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data."-Case 2:-Go to Home work center.-Select the Self Services view.-Select the Self-Services Overview sub view.-Click on Edit Time Sheet.-Enters the duration and the work description (for that exact duration), deletes the duration and the work description (just wants to delete it and leave empty, eg. by mistake he filled in the next week).-Choose Save button here you can see the system throws an error message as "Time period or duration mandatory in combination with project data."-Cause-In the project, the Work Description is maintained as required for the project task which is assigned to the employee.-In this case, it is mandatory to maintain the duration when confirming project task.-Resolution-Case 1:-Enter the time period or duration (it should be greater than zero) along with the work description which is mandatory for project time confirmation while recording the time sheet.-Case 2:-For deleting the entries, only remove the duration from the cell in the grid view (work list). It is not necessary to delete the work description.-This would trigger the deletion of the complete time record and leave cell empty. On save, system will not throw an error message.-Keywords-Time Period or Duration Mandatory in Combination with Project Data, Project Task, Confirmation, Time Sheet

Title: There is No API for Golden Tax Invoice (for China Only)
Content: Symptom-You want to know if there is API available for Golden Tax Invoice functin in ByDesign system, so that you can use web service to integrate the function with external system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-n/a-Cause-Currently, thre is no API available in the system for Golden Tax Invoice.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-Golden Tax Invoice; China; Web Service; API

Title: Failed Authentication in Avalara Does Not Trigger Error Message
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** Internal use only ***-Customer has reported an error with Avalara.-The underlying root cause was determined to be an Avalara Authentication issue on the communication arrangement.-However customer mentions there was never an error shown for this, which meant throughout their business process this was not recognised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Attempted to reproduce in QCL/134.-To reproduce: breakpoint in the mentioned class/method.-Add an item to the Sales Order.-Breakpoint should trigger.-CREATE_BY_DESTINATION (CL_HTTP_CLIENT)        445 change user name (remove a character for example). then authentication error will be shown.-You will see that the response now will be:-Result:-{"RESPONSE" :{"ERROR": {"CODE": "AUTHENTICATIONEXCEPTION","MESSAGE": "AUTHENTICATION FAILED.","DETAILS": [-{"CODE": "AUTHENTICATIONEXCEPTION","MESSAGE": "AUTHENTICATION FAILED.","DESCRIPTION": "MISSING AUTHENTICATION OR UNABLE TO AUTHENTICATE THE USER OR THE ACCOUNT.","FAULTCODE": "CLIENT","HELPLINK": "[HTTP://DEVELOPER.AVALARA.COM/AVATAX/ERRORS/AUTHENTICATIONEXCEPTION|http://developer.avalara.com/AVATAX/ERRORS/AUTHENTICATIONEXCEPTION]"}-]}}}-Note: The response lv_response variable has a max length of 255 characters. The response provided is more than 300 characters, so it gets truncated.-The transformation then triggers at CL_EXTTAX_TAX_CALC_PROVIDER_RS=>REQUEST_TAX_CALCULATION in line: 140, and this is unable to fill the error-messages table. Hence we have no error message to push.-Note: the error message is not shown in the UI, just "Avalara Error"-Cause-The issue occurs since the response structure for authentication error seems to be different from other cases which was the reason why response or error parsing doesn't seem to return any value in line 129 and 140 of method IF_EXTTAX_TAX_CALCULATOR~REQUEST_TAX_CALCULATION of class CL_EXTTAX_TAX_CALC_PROVIDER_RS.-Resolution-The issue has been fixed by raising the authentication error from Avalara when the credentials in the communication arrangement are invalid. The changes will be delivered as part of 2208 release.-The error 'Avalara Error: AUTHENTICATION ERROR.' will be raised when authentication fails due to invalid credentials maintained in communication arrangement.- Customer can resolve the issue by updating valid authentication details in communication arrangement for Avalara in ByD.-See Also-Internal Incident 2270082769-Keywords-Avalara, authentication, error-3204085

Title: Extension Field Cannot be Modified in Delivery Proposal Screen
Content: Symptom-Extension Field XXX created in Delivery Proposals view is not editable in Delivery Proposals view, only when extended to other documents.-XXX = Extension Field name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Select Delivery Proposals view.-Notice that Extension Field XXX cannot be edited.-Cause-The Extension Field will not be editable in Delivery Proposal as the system does not allow any fields to be editable here, only Freight Forwarder is editable.-Resolution-The feature for creation of Extension Field in Delivery Proposal is working as designed.-Keywords-Ext, extensibility, adaptation

Title: Error message: 'Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates' While Posting a Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-Error message: 'Currency conversion failed due to missing exchange rates. Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from DEF (refers to source currency) to PQR (Target currency) for Mid Rate while posting the bank statement'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Select the Bank statement which is In Preparation with Bank Account ID 123 (123 refers to the bank account).-Click Post button.-Error is displayed: 'Maintain the exchange rates for conversion from DEF (refers to source currency) to PQR (target currency) for Mid Rate while posting the bank statement'. -Cause-The exchange rate from DEF (refers to source currency) to PQR (target currency) for Mid Rate is missing for the Currency Conversion Profile and which uses Posting Date as conversion date. This has to be maintained.-Resolution-You need to maintain exchange rate for DEF (refers to source currency) to PQR (target currency) for the Currency Conversion Profile, as follows:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Open the Edit Exchange Rates view in the Common Tasks section.-Maintain the relevant exchange rate between Source Currency: DEF to Target Currency: PQR.-Confirm the entries by clicking Save and Close.-Now you will be able to post the Bank Statement.-Keywords-bank statement; exchange rate; source currency; target currency

Title: Identified Stock Maintenance Run does not Expire Identified Stock XXX
Content: Symptom-You created a Identified Stock Maintenance Run to expire Identified Stocks, however Identified Stock XXX is not set to expired.-XXX = Identified Stock ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center. -Select Identified Stock Maintenance Run view. -Notice that the Applicationg Logs are succesful, however the Identified Stock XXX is not expired. -Cause-The Identified Stock XXX is blocked. Blocked Identified Stocks will not be picked up by the Identified Stock Maintenance Run.-Resolution-The system is working as expected.-Keywords-Run, IStock, Schedule

Title: Account Address (P.O. Box) Details Missing on Sales Document Form Template such as a Customer Invoice Template
Content: Symptom-You've maintained the following account address details in the Account master data. While either in the output or preview of the Sales Document e.g. the Customer Invoice, the additional fields you've maintained don't get populated on the Customer Invoice output layout.-P.O. Box-P.O. Box Postal Code-P.O. Box City-P.O. Box State-P.O. Box Country-You expect above fields to be populated in the Customer Invoice output layout.-Environment-Business ByDesign all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Maintain additional address in Account Master Data.-Go to Account Management Work Center-Go to Accounts and select respective account-Under General tab and Main Address section-Click Additional Fields and maintain the following fields:-P.O. Box/P.O. Box Postal Code/P.O. Box City/P.O. Box State/P.O. Box Country-Save and Close-We will use the Customer Invoice as an example.-Check in Customer Invoice Preview.-Create a Customer Invoice for this account-In the respective Customer Invoice, click Preview-Only the following fields have been populated on the Customer Invoice layout-Country-Address Line 1-Address Line 2-Street/House Number-Address Line 4-Postal Code/City-Cause-The address is calculated at runtime via the API GET_FORM_ADDRESS_FROM_BUFFER which would get Street address in return as a priority if both Street and Postal address are maintained in the Account Master Data.-Which means if you've maintained main house address in the Account Master Data, it will overwrite the P.O. Box Address in the Form Template.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Invoice Layout, Additional Address, P.O.Box address, Account; Form Template; PO Box; missing; not visible; Bill To; Sales Order; Form Template; Sales Quote; Service Order

Title: Not able to view the Projects, Snapshots: Earned Values Data Source / PROPRJU06
Content: Symptom-The user wants to create a custom Data Source or report based on the Projects, Snapshots: Earned Values (PROPRJU06) Data Source. However when trying to do it via the "Business Analytics work center - Design Data Sources view" the user is unable to find PROPRJU06 in the list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Sources view.-Click in New and select one of the options below:-Combined Data Source-Joined Data Source-Report-For the Data Source name field, enter Projects, Snapshots: Earned Values (PROPRJU06).-The data source is not in drop-down. The message is: "No search result".-Cause-This data source is not visible because it is not available to be customized. -Resolution-This system behavior is as designed.-Please refer to the Data Sources Documentation or the Characteristic index documents to check if there are additional data sources which the user may use. These documents are available via the help or Business Center.-If the functionality is still needed, of of the below approaches can be considered: -Your implementation manager can be contacted for such request; -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea here;-Or use the SAP Business ByDesign forums, available here, for questions of this nature.-See Also-KBA: 1830749 - Complete Data Sources and Characteristics Documentation-Keywords-Projects, Snapshots: Earned Values, PROPRJU06, data source, not available, missing, create custom report, project data source

Title: Warning Message During KPI Creation
Content: Symptom-As an analytics administrator you create a new KPI and select a report along with an amount type key figure XYZ. When selecting the key figure a warning message is displayed:-Currency for key figure XYZ cannot be converted and will be used as is-You want to understand the meaning of this warning message.-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the Business Analytics work center.-You go to the Design KPIs view.-You select New.-On the New Key Performance Indicator screen in the General tab select a report and a key figure in the Current Value area.-If the key figure you selected is of type monetary amount you may get above warning message.-Cause-The warning message is displayed when the selected key figure does not have any currency conversions maintained. There is a check in the KPI for any currency conversions in the report. When these are missing the warning message is displayed.-Resolution-There are three possible solutions:-You understand why the warning message is thrown according to the previous explanation and would like to ignore it. In this case you just leave everything in the KPI as it is. Then the currency unit code of the default currency will be displayed for this key figure.-If this is a KUT field created as Key Figure and added to report.-Then you need to create a key figure out of this KUT field and add the same in data source and further to report.-You want to maintain currency conversions for the key figures in order to get rid of the warning messages:-If it is a customized key figure you can go to the Business Analytics work center, Design Key Figures view and select your key figure. Open the key figure wizard (Edit button). Proceed to step 3. Select Conversion Type = Currency Conversion-If it is a standard key figure delivered by SAP you cannot edit it. Hence you need to create a new key figure based on the standard key figure in the Business Analytics work center, Design Key Figures view. Open the key figure wizard (New button). In step 1 select the standard key figure XYZ. Proceed to step 3. Select Conversion Type = Currency Conversion. Use your new key figure in your KPI instead of the standard key figure.-Keywords-kpi warning,currency conversions in kpi

Title: Form Template Code Mandatory Proforma Invoice in Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You get Form Template Code Mandatory error while trying to generate Pro Forma Invoice for an Outbound Delivery.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Select the Outbound Delivery view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Outbound Delivery).-Select the line.-Click Pro Forma Invoice button.-Error: Form template code mandatory-Cause-The system will not generate a Pro Forma Invoice for an Outbound Delivery that has all of it's Line Items Canceled.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In case you believe this functionality could be enhanced, an alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-3009144 - Form Template Code Mandatory Proforma Invoice-Keywords-Outbound Delivery, Canceled, Cancelled, Pro Forma Invoice, Form Template Code Mandatory

Title: Status of Tax Authority is Blocked While Blocking the Status of its Respective Supplier
Content: Symptom-You have created Supplier and Tax Authority for a particular Business Partner. When you block the status of the Supplier, the status of the Tax Authority and the Business Partner is also getting blocked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Supplier and Tax Authority are the Roles of the Business Partner and the status is completely dependent on the roles of Business Partner.-Resolution-This is the general system behavior.--So, if you block the status of the Supplier, it will block the status of the Tax Authority and vice versa. This will also block the status of Business Partner.-In general, if you block a status of one Business Partner Role, all the roles will be blocked.-Keywords-business parter; business partner role; tax authority; supplier; account

Title: Error Message "Reliable Message (RM) Configured, But No Message ID and No WRSM Assertion Provided" During Employee Replication
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the user tries to use the web service for Employee Replication (interface name: II_HCM_MDR_EMPLOYEE_MD_REPL_IB), system throws below error message.-SRT: Plain SOAP: Reliable messaging (RM) configured, but no Message ID and no WSRM assertion provided-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application User Management work center-Select Communication Scenarios-Select Employee Replication for External System-Select New Configuration Tab-In System Instance ID Fields, Select the respective system-Select Next-Cause-In most of the cases, the error "Reliable message (RM) configured, but no Message ID and no WRSM assertion provided" means the user would like to use plain SOAP, but the provider is configured as "asynchronous reliable."-Resolution-For using plain SOAP you need to configure it as an "asynchronous" service. So the user needs to set the service as asynchronous and reconfigure the binding as well.--There are several ways to do this (please check the See Also section for more information). Customers may also refer to the attached payload, which works for most cases.-NOTE: In case of SoapUI, the proper way is to use the WS-A protocol. As SoapUI is not an SAP product, we can not provide further support. Please ask customer to check the SoapUI documentation on how to use WS-A.-See Also-Plain SOAP in the SAP Community Wiki (specially the "Interoperability with 3rd party products" section)a-Keywords-Reliable Message, Configured, No Message ID, SoapUI, Employee Replication, II_HCM_MDR_EMPLOYEE_MD_REPL_IB
