Title: Exchange Rate ABC/XYZ on DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion
Content: Symptom-You have an Invoice Request which is showing as Inconsistent due to the following error: Exchange Rate ABC/XYZ on DD.MM.YYYY Missing for Currency Conversion.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use ABC as the source currency and XYZ as the target currency.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the ID.-Click Check.-Error: Exchange Rate ABC/XYZ on DD.MM.YYYY 2021 Missing for Currency Conversion.-Cause-The error is expected by the Tax Engine.-In the Tax Engine, the system performs a conversion between target currency and source country default currency, and since this conversion rate is not valid, the error will show.-Even though the currency is maintained for the company under the Org Structure view of the Organization Management work center, the system will always consider the country default currency if there is a Tax Return.-Example:-You have set the company FGH (FGH represents the ID of the company) to have USD as the default currency, however, the company is located in Ireland.-Since there is a Tax Return involved in the scenario, the system will consider EURO as the country default currency and not USD maintained for the company FGH.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To correct this, please go to:-General Ledger work center.-Select Exchange Rates from the Common Tasks.-Enter a new conversion rate.-See Also- 2638285 - Error While Releasing a Sales Order: 'Exchange rate US Dollar/Tenge on DD.MM.YYYY missing for currency conversion'-1757256 - Error in Tax Calculation in the Sales Order Created for an Intercompany Scenario-Keywords-Exchance Rate, Rate, Missing, Currency Conversion, Tax Return, Currency, Default

Title: To avoid inconsistencies in the Open Items report, the reversal posting date for re-posted payments must be the original posting date
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In 2108 release, a new feature was introduced where you can now see an additional message while cancelling a payment that was already reposted to a different account.-The messaage 'To avoid inconsistencies in the Open Items report, the reversal posting date for re-posted payments must be the original posting date' is now available for the following payment related user interfaces:-Incoming Check-Outgoing Check-Outgoing Bank Transfer-Bank Payment Advice-Payment Allocation-Automatic Payments-When the Payment is opened and you click on View All, then Reverse action will cause this error.-However, when the payment is selected and you choose Reverse directly in payment monitor screen, the message won't appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Click on New Payment By and select Incoming Check(or any other payment types). Here payment type Incoming check is taken as example.-Select necessary data like Company, Payer, Check Number etc.-Click on Assign On Account Payment and provide the details like Customer ID XYZ(XYZ refers to Customer ID), Payment Amount, Debit/Credit and Click on OK.-Click on Post. This creates a new incoming check PQR(PQR denotes incoming check ID).-Now navigate to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Search with Customer ID used above i.e XYZ.-Click on View.-Open payment PRQ.-Click on View All.-Click on Actions and select Reverse. At this point, there should not be any text regarding the reposted payment as its not yet reposted.-Now go back to previous screen i.e. Customer Account Monitor and then select payment PQR and click on actions->repost payment -Click on Account and select Add Accounts. Now add account AAA(AAA refers to another customer account)-Select line for account ID as per step 2/3 and adjust the payment Amount to desired amount. Click on save.-Search for Payment posted PQR in Liquidity Management work center -> Payments screen click on it and view all. Click on actions->reverse. Now You will be able to see "To avoid inconsistencies in the Open Items report, the reversal posting date for re-posted payments must be the original posting date"-When the same Payment PQR is select directly in Liquidity Management work center -> Payments screen and hit Reverse, message wont be shown.-Resolution-The message is not shown to the user if the reversal is done from the payment monitor (or other UIs where multiple document selection is possible) as it would not be possible to distinguish the different payment methods and furthermore the  "reposted" documents from all others. So for this reason, the user will only see the message when reversing the actual document (from within the document itself). This is a limitation of ByD for the reason stated above.-See Also- 2108 Release: What's New in Financial Management - SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Payment Management, Repost, Open Items

Title: Payer/Payee Details not Displayed in Journal Entry From Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-The Payer/Payee data has been assigned to the Payment Allocation in the Allocation to G/L Account tab, however the corresponding journal entry shows no debtor/credit name and IDs in the concerned postings.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view. -Open the respective allocation.-Go to Allocation to G/L Account tab.-See that Payer/Payee data is maintained.-Open the corresponding journal entry. -The associated journal entry has no debtor nor creditor IDs related to Payer/Payee maintained in the payment allocation.-Cause-There are some possible related causes for the ID not to be derived in the journal entry. In this case, there is no financial data maintained between the Payer/Payee and the respective company.-Resolution-You need to maintain the Financial Data for the company ID in the master data of the Payer/Payee.-See Also- 2926726 -  Payer/Payee details not Displayed for Payment Allocation Posting to G/L Account-Keywords-Journal Entry. Journal Entries. Payment Allocation. Debtor name. Creditor name.

Title: Inbound Delivery is missing in Purchase Order's Document Flow
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -Inbound Delivery is not shown in Purchase Order's Document Flow tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First you check the Inbound Delivery:-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Search for Inbound Delivery XYZ.-Select the document.-Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Document Flow tab. -You can see that Inbound Delivery is related to Purchase Order ABC.-Now you can check Purchase Order ABC:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center. -Go to Purchase Orders view. -Search for ABC. -Select the document.-Click in the Edit button. -Navigate to Document Flow tab. -The Inbound Delivery XYZ is not maintained in Purchase Order ABC's Document Flow as expected.-Cause-The message in the backend wasn't fully delivered, so it needs to be reconciled.-Resolution-In the backend, first part:-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Insert the BO APDL_INB_DELIVERY_REQ.-Navigate to Load By Query and select ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Insert the Purchase Order ID in field ItemBusinessTransactionDocumentReferencePurchaseOrderItemReference/ID/content.-Click in Continue.-Select the document in BO Instance Structure.-Copy the NODE_ID in your notepad.-Second part:-Go to transaction SE16.-Enter Table name SPAF_BDOCVIEW.-Press F7 or click in Table Contents. -Enter the NODE_ID you copied before in the field BO_ROOT_NODE_ID. -Press F8 or click in Execute. -Copy all MSGIDs which COMMDIR is equal to 'OUT' and REM_PARTY is equal to 'LogisticsExecutionControl'. -Third part:-Go to transaction SE38. -Enter Program Name: /SRMAP/PI_RECONCILIATION.-Press F8 or click in Execute. -Enter the MSGID in the field Message ID*. -Press F8 or click in Execute. -Repeat for other MSGIDs you copied (if there is more than one). -After performing those steps, check the Purchase Order's Document Flow.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Inbound Delivery; Backend; Reconcile

Title: Error while activating External Web Service Integration from Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You receive the below error messages while activating an External Web Service Integration from SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-Recheck WSDL and upload it again.-Exception occurred in library handler.-Error in WSDL of-Error creating MDRS entities-PortType (name/namespace) not found in WSDL-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the Solution.-Right click and activate the .wsid file.-You receive error messages.-Cause-This error appears when the WSDL file contains schema location (.xsd) referring to a remote location.-Resolution-Download the .xsd from the remote location.-Change the schema location in the .WSDL file.-Upload the .xsd into the .WSID using the add button.-Save and Activate.-Please refer to the blog on the See Also section.-See Also-External Service Integration with XSD file in SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Keywords-PDI, SDK, WSDL, WSID, XSD, Recheck, upload, again

Title: You see unpublished Form Templates in the form template selection
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded a new Form template but you have not published it. Nevertheless you can "chose" that form template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This happens if the form template was for example uploaded as "replace existing Variant".-Whenever there are previous forms, you can check by hitting Versions - the previous form will be shown.-No matter if you publish the new form or not.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Unpublished Forms, Forms, Form templates

Title: How to Mass Cancel PDI Internal Messages
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You need to Cancel erroneous PDI Internal (XI) messages in a customer tenant as they are confirmed no longer required by customer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-Root cause for the errors have been determined and recommended Solution communicated to the customer.-Attempts to Restart the erroneous PDI XI messages have not be successful after customer/partner has fixed root cause.-Customer has explicitly requested that SAP delete the relevant PDI XI messages.-Resolution-Important: If the relevant XI messages are not PDI (neither sender nor receiver is a PDI interface) then DO NOT proceed with the steps. Non-PDI XI messages must only be handled by the appropriate component.-Go to back end transaction: SRT_MONI-Select Result Output: Summary.-Select Processing Status Group: Erroneous-Refine other Standard Selection options as required-Click Execute-Double-click appropriate Status Group entry-Add filters to columns as required-Click Select All button at top left corner of result table (selection is now based on filters)-Click Actions and select Cancel-Click Yes-Note: Messages will remain in Canceled status for 42 days before permanent deletion.-Keywords-SRT_MONI, Application Error, PDI, SDK

Title: Approval Tasks Not Shown in the Open Tasks Tile of Launchpad
Content: Symptom-You have some tasks for approval in the Managing My Area work center, but notice that they are not coming up in the Open Tasks tile of the Launchpad.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Access the Approvals work center view.-You can see there are some tasks waiting for your approval.-Now, go to the Home work center.-Access the Launchpad work center view.-The Open Tasks tile shows zero tasks.-Cause-The Open Tasks tile is related to Work Inbox tasks, such as found in the Home > Work view.-Resolution-For a tile related to the Approval tasks within the Managing My Area work center, please use the Personalization mode as follows:-Click the user icon at the top-righ corner of the screen-Select Start Personalization Mode-Click the Add Tile (+ icon) button-Select the Managing My Area work center in the left-hand column and click the Add button for the Managing My Area - Approvals tile-Click Apply-Finally, click Save in the Personalization menu to complete the change -Keywords-Launchpad, Approvals, Open Tasks, Tile, Missing

Title: System Crash When Saving Sales Order With Credit Card as Payment Method
Content: Symptom-You have created a new sales order and changed its payment method to Credit Card. The card details are correctly derived from the customer account master data to the sales order. However, when saving the sales order or when checking the authorization, the system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Find and open the respective sales order.-In View All mode, add payment method as Credit Card. -See that a valid credit card is derived from the account's master data.-Click either Save or Check Authorization. The system crashes.-Cause-One possible cause for this to happen is that the system is failing to calculate the authorization expiration date, since the authorization validity is not maintained in the clearing house.-Resolution-Therefore, you need to maintain the validity period for the authorizations in the respective clearing house accounts, as follows:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Clearing House Accounts view.-Edit the relevant clearing house account.-Go to Credit Card Type tab.-Maintain the Authorization Validity Days for all the credit card types.-Save and close.-After that, save the sales order again with credit card as payment method.-Keywords-Clearing House Account. Computop. ISO Duration. Credit Card. Payment Method.

Title: Incident in C4C does not get created after clicking "direct forward"
Content: Symptom-You cannot direct forward an Incident to SAP from C4C.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-You business user needs a valid e-mail address and telephone number.-Resolution-Maintain a valid email and a Phone Number for your user.-Go to the Administration or the People work centre.-Go the Employee view-Find and open the relevant employee/ user-Maintain both a valid e-mail address and phone number.-See Also- 2594317 - Error message when reporting an Incident to provider ByD and C4C-Keywords-Incident, Incident error.

Title: Approve Manual Payment Task Is Not Displayed In Home - Inbox Work Center View
Content: Symptom-Tasks of type Approve Manual Payment are not visible in both Home work center -> Inbox view and Home work center -> My Launchpad view -> All Open Items tile.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Work -> Inbox view.-Notice that tasks of type Approve Manual Payment are not displayed.-Such tasks are also not visible via Home work center -> My Launchpad view -> All Open Items tile.-Cause-Due to the differing tasks types, certain tasks (for example, Approve Manual Payment) will not be visible in the user's Home work center -> Inbox view or Home work center -> My Launchpad view -> All Open Items tile.-Resolution-Tasks of this type will be visible in the Managing My Area work center -> Approvals view and also in the following paths:-Home work center -> Work -> Workload Overview view -> Managing My Area -> Approvals section -> Open Tasks.-Home work center -> My Launchpad view -> Approvals tile.-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-approve manual payment; FIN_PAY_PAYOR_APP; home; inbox; my launchpad; all open items

Title: Report Shows Employee's First and Last Name in Wrong Order
Content: Symptom-You are showing employees in a report, for example the report Opportunity Analysis. You notice that for some employees, the order of last name and first name is correct, while for others it is reversed.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Select the view Design Reports.-Search for your report. In our example, it is the report Opportunity Analysis.-Run the report with the required selection.-In the view, add the field Employee Responsible.-You see that for some employees, the system shows the last name first, while for others, it shows the first name first.-Cause-There is a Business Configuration setting that determines the name format for employees of a specific country. The system will check the workplace address of an employee, determine the country based on that, and then apply the settings of that country to the name.-In your case, either the name format is not maintained in the business configuration, or the respective employee has no workplace address in the system due to which the country cannot be determined.-Resolution-Maintain the business configuration settings here:-Go to the work center Business Configuration and the view Overview.-Search for the activity: General Business Partners.-Open it and click Maintain Name Formats.-In the first table called Name Formats, you can either change settings for an existing country or add a new country.-In the second table called Details of Name Format, you can maintain the order of each name element (first name, last name, academic title etc).-Now also make sure that the employee with the wrong format has a country in the workplace address:-Go to the work center Administrator and the view Employees.-Search for your employee and click Edit.-Scroll down to In-House Address and maintain at least the country.-Save.-Keywords-employee, name, order, first name, family name, last name, name format, sequence, business analytics, report, data source, business partner, address, employee responsible

Title: No values coming up on the BankStatementImportFileMapping BCO from a MCS
Content: Symptom-No values are coming up on the dropdown list field "Bank Statement Format Structure Mapping" on the "ABSL Configuration" node within the BC set file created for the SAP BCO BankStatementImportFileMapping within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisites:-You have created 3 .bcc files each for the below SAP BCOs:-BankStatementFormat-BankStatementFormatStructureMappingCode-BankStatementImportFileMapping-Reproducing the issue:-Login to the Studio.-Open the affected MCS.-Open .bcc file created for BCO BankStatementImportFileMapping.-Click on Field values tab.-First maintain the values on ABAP Configuration.-Then, on ABSL Configuration, check that the dropdown list for "Bank Statement Format Structure Mapping" is empty.-The dropdown list value should be retrieved from the BC set created fro the BCO BankStatementFormatStructureMappingCode.-Cause-The use case to have to develop with Bank Statement BCOs on a multi-customer solution is not fully supported.-Resolution-You would need to work with the Bank Statement BCOs within a customer-specific solution.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, add-on, CSS, MCS, BCO, values, value, not, showing, appearing, drop, down

Title: Payment Method is not Being Maintained When Replicating Employees from Success Factor into SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-When replicating Employees from SF into ByD, the Payment Method field is not being maintained in the Employee's file. However, the Payment Method can be filled out in the Employee Replication Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2202 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center-Then go to the Employees view.-Search for the required Remote Employee ID.-Select the required Creation Date.-Click Edit.-Go to the Personal Data tab and then Payment Forms.-Maintain the Payment Method as Cash.-Then Replicate the Employee.-Cause-The "Payment Method" is currently not pushed for employees in system because of missing bank account information from Success Factor system. Currently system expects a bank account detail from SFSF with "PayType" as "MAIN". With this information, payment agreement will get created in SAP Business ByDesign which will also capture "Payment Method" information.-Resolution-Maintain the required data in Success Factor with "PayType" as "MAIN" and replicate employee again for payment method to reflect.-Keywords-Payment Method, Replication, Master Data Replication, Employee, Not replicated.

Title: NONEX in Custom Key Figure
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom calculated key figure, however when you use it in a report you notice that it shows NONEX instead of the expected values.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business byDesign-Cause-This can happen in the following scenario:-You are using the options %CT  or %GT in your key figure formula. You are also using a a matrix table, i.e. characteristics in both rows and columns.-%CT and %GT indicate how high the percentage amount is with regard to the result. Result here means the result of the aggregation at the next-highest level (intermediate result).-When you have a flat table, i.e. characteristics in the rows and key figures in the columns, the aggregation is quite simple - it happens based on the chosen characteristics and their order in the rows. However when you have a matrix, i.e. characteristics in both rows and columns, the aggregation is more complex and the system aggregates across rows and columns.-Resolution-Unfortunately the percentage cannot be calculated using %CT / %GT in a matrix. If you would like to use this option in the key figure calculation, please use a flat table.-Keywords-key figure, nonex, custom calculation, formula, percentage, business analytics

Title: SAP Forms by Adobe: Position of table entries are shifted
Content: Symptom- You have customized or developed a new form template. After rendering, the position of some table cells are shifted.-You might expect your table to look like this:-Name Value optional value-Item 1-Value 1-OV 1-Item 2-Value 2-  Item 3 Value 3 OV 3-But your actual table looks like this:-Name Value optional value-Item 1-Value 1-OV 1-Item 2-Value 2-OV 3-Item 3 Value 3  -Environment- SAP Business byDesign-Cause-The reason for this behavior is the usage of absolute binding instead of relative binding for your table cells.-You can evaluate the type of the data binding by selecting the table cell in Adobe Lifecycle designer and checking Object->Binding property.-If you see a wildcard symbol (e.g. *) you are using absolute binding. For example: $.FormQuote.Item[*].ID.-The results of absolute binding and relative binding will differ if the referenced properties do not exist in every parent node. This is because the wildcard symbol will return the next possible data item. In this case the data from the next parent node is read. This creates a shift in the item positions.-Resolution-Rewrite the table in your form template to use relative binding. In relative binding you assign the data path with the wildcard symbol to the parent container.-Therefore all child elements will have access to the item context.-Absolute binding:-Table:-   rowItem: -      cell1: $.FormQuote.Item[*].ID-Relative binding:-Table: $.FormQuote.Item[*]-   rowItem: -      cell1: $.ID-Keywords-ads, form template, table, data binding, absolute binding, relative binding

Title: Customer Demand Not Created from Service Order
Content: Symptom-You have set the delivery priority under the Account as immediate, however, when creating a Service Order for the expected Account, the Customer Demand is not created automatically for Spare Parts items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Click New.-Select Service Order.-Enter the Account ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account which contains the delivery priority as Immediate in the master data).-Enter a Spare Part item.-Click Release.-When navigating to the Document Flow tab, you don't see the Customer Demand.-Cause-The delivery priority maintained in the Account master data is not carried to the Service Order.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-When issuing a Service Order which requires the creation of the Customer Demand immediately, please change the value during the creation of the document under the General tab.-If you believe that this feature could be enhanced, please create a thread under the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Service Order, Spare Parts, Delivery, Priority, Immediate, Normal

Title: Communication Usage Report Shows no Data
Content: Symptom-The report "Communication Usage" (COMUSGB01) shows no data.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Open the report Communication Usage.-It shows no results.-Cause-This report can be used to monitor statistics on inbound synchronous service requests. However, the feature needs to be scoped first.-Resolution-You can scope the Communication Usage view in the Business Configuration work center. Go to the Business Configuration work center and choose the Implementation Projects view. Select your implementation project and click Edit Project Scope. In the Questions step, expand the Communication and Information Exchange scoping element, select the Process Integrated Input and Output Management within Business Process Management and answer the question related to Group: Communication Usage.-For details, please check the help center article called "Communication Usage Quick Guide".-Keywords-Communication Usage, COMUSGB01, no data available to display, missing data, information exchange

Title: No Data in the My Team's Sales Orders Query
Content: Symptom-You, as a manager, are trying to filter for open sales orders from your team members using the My Team's Open Orders query, but no results are returned.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Access the Sales Orders work center view.-Change selection to My Team's Open Orders.-No records found. -Cause-In order for data to be displayed in the My Team's Sales Order query, the user executing the query must be assigned as manager to an org unit that has the Sales function enabled.-Resolution-Please review the org structure data in the Organizational Management work center and ensure that the above-mentioned prerequisites are met.-Keywords-My Team's Sales Orders, manager, no data, Organizational Management

Title: Unable to Scope Lease Management Accounting Due to Error During Finish Project
Content: Symptom-You want to scope lease management accounting. When you finish scoping, error 'Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data. If error messages are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.' occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation and click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 4 Questions.-Expand Financial and Management Accounting -> General Ledger -> General Ledger.-Mark question 'Do you want to enable lease accounting for lessees' In Scope.-Click Next.-Click Finish.-Error 'Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data. If error messages are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.' occurs.-Cause-You have maintained the net content of asset class 5000/5100/5200/5300/5400 in the fixed asset classes activity in business configuration. However, 5000/5100/5200/5300/5400 is the pre-delivered content for RoU asset class.-Resolution-You need to remove the record for 5000/5100/5200/5300/5400 in fixed asset classes.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open activity Fixed Asset Classes.-Click Edit Fixed Asset Classes.-Select Asset Class 5000 and click Delete.-Click Save and Close.-If you already have a Fixed Asset with one of these Fixed Asset Classes, the Fixed Assets need to be moved to a different Asset Class. You can fix this issue by copying the range 5*** to Z-5***. This will allow you to delete the class 5*** as described below. The Fixed Asset Class can be copied in the Business Configuration setting "Fixed Asset Classes", then Edit Fixed Asset Classes and copy Asset Class 5*** to Z-5***.-The Asset Class can be changed from 5*** to Z-5*** under Master Data tab of the Fixed Asset. Once this is complete, you can delete the class as described in the steps above.-Then you can scope lease management accounting. After the scoping of lease management accounting is completed, you can see pre-delivered ROU asset classes 5000,5100,5200,5300,5400 in the following path.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open activity Lease Management Accounting.-Click Edit ROU Asset Classes.-Keywords-Lease Contract Management, Scope, Fixed Asset Class, ROU Asset Class

Title: Outbound Payment File with Multiple Lines for Each Payment
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom payment file structure and when generating the outbound file, you see multiple lines for the same entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Find the payment for which you have created outbound file.-Open the corresponding file.-Download and open the txt file.-You notice that the file shows multiple lines, even though the file was made for one payment only. Hence, you expect only one transaction line in the file.-Cause-The custom payment file structure does not have the Records properly structured. You are using Payment Item level for the transaction records in the file, hence the system brings the defined fields in the structure for each of the payment items of the payment transaction. Therefore, if your payment order cleared more than one open item, the resulting file would have the same corresponding number of payment items, hence the multiple lines.-Resolution-You need to access what kind of information is requires to be shown in the file. If you need to create the file with the payment orders details but not at payment item level, you set the payment structure with Records at Payment Transaction level, as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Outgoing Bank Transfers.-Click Edit payment file structures.-Edit the respective format.-Go to Define Records step. You see that for transaction record, you have assigned Payment Item level.-Assure that you have defined proper Header and Footer records and for transaction records assign the Payment Transaction level.-Save your changes.-Once you create the outbound file again, the system shall populate the file with the defined fields for payment transaction level. If needed, you can also add another record for the Payment Item of the corresponding Payment Transaction.-For more details, you may refer to help document Create a New Payment File Structure-Keywords-Outgoing Bank Transfer. Outgoing Wire Transfer. Payment File Structure. Payment Medium Format. Payment Media Run.

Title: Unable to Edit E-Mail Field via Self-Services
Content: Symptom-When a service agent or employee is trying to maintain or change his/her e-mail in the Home work center, the E-Mail field is greyed out and he/she can't edit it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Home.-Choose view Self-Services overview.-Choose Edit my Contact data under Company Address Book.-E-Mail field is not editable / is greyed out.-Cause-Service agents and employees cannot maintain or change their E-Mail address in the Self-Services overview via My Contact Data. Due to security reasons, the E-Mail field has been made read only. If employees or service agents want to maintain or change their E-Mail address, they need to contact their administrator to perform the action.-Resolution-Employee data can be maintained in Personnel Administration work center.-The workplace e-mail address of an service agent can be maintained as follows:- (1) From Business Partner Data work center.-Go to work center Business Partner Data.-Choose view Service Agents.-Choose the desired service agent.-Choose General under Edit button.-Click on link Copy Address under In-House Address.-Allocate the desired address to the service agent. Once you allocate the In-House Address, the field E-Mail will be enabled under In-House Communication.-Enter the In-House Communication details, such as E-Mail etc.-Review the details and click Save to save the details.- (2) From Supplier Base work center.-Go to work Center Supplier Base.-Choose the View Service Agent.-Choose the desired service agent.-Choose General under Edit button.-Click on link Copy Address under In-House Address.-Allocate the desired address to the service agent. Once you allocate the In-House Address, the field E-Mail will be enabled under In-House Communication-Enter the In-House Communication details, such as E-Mail etc.-Review the details and click Save to save the details.-The new workplace contact details are saved to the system which will be replicated in the Home Self-Services work center.-Keywords-employees agents you email id selfservices selfservice self services service  available possible able  read only read-only try grayed  be edited attempt are

Title: Cost Determination Error When Adding Material to a Sales Document
Content: Symptom-When adding a material to a sales document the following error occurs:-“Item XX: Costs not determined: There is no active inventory price for material ABC in company 1000 (EFG)”.-The document cannot be saved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use Sales Orders as an example:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-In the Show field select the All Orders option and press the Go button.-Select the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the number of the sales order).-Open the sales order and press the View All button.-Select the Items tab.-Add product ABC (ABC represents the identification name of the product)  -Following error occurs:-Item XX: Costs not determined: There is no active inventory price for material ABC in company 1000 (EFG). (XX represents the line item number and EFG represents the name of the seller party).-However, the material and costs have been maintained (cost type inventory cost) in the product master data.-  Cause-When adding an item the system will compare the posting date of the document with the validity of the the sales prices and for consistency also to the inventory prices of the item. The validity of the inventory price for material ABC needs to be changed to the posting date/pricing date of the sales order or earlier.-When a sales order was created as a follow-up from a sales quote, the pricing related data are copied from the sales quote.-The posting date/pricing date will be compared with the validity of the sales price and for consistency also with the inventory price of the newly added item and with the validity date of this particular item. As this date is the same for the header level of the sales order, it is also valid for an item added newly in the order. Hence, also for material ABC the access is done with the posting date/pricing date of the sales quote. However, the inventory price for material ABC is only valid as of a later date than the posting date/pricing date  of the sales quote. Therefore the validity of the inventory price for material ABC needs to be changed to the posting date/pricing date of the sales quote or earlier.-Resolution-Since the inventory price for material ABC is only valid as of a later date than the posting date/pricing date of the sales order or if the sales order was created as a follow up document of the sales quote, the validity of the inventory price for material ABC needs to be changed to the posting date/pricing date of the sales order / sales quote or earlier.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Select the material ABC and press the Edit button.-Press the View All button and go to the Valuation tab.-Select the respective line for the cost determination and press the Edit Costs button.-In the pop up window Input Parameters for Edit Cost enter a date in the in the Valid From field which is equal to the posting date/pricing date of the sales order / sales quote or an earlier date.-Press the OK button.-Press the Save and Close button.-You can now enter the material ABC in the sales order XYZ and save the document. The error will not occur anymore.-See Also-Please see the following KBA's for this error:-1772824 - Warning message "Item XX unidentified costs.There is no Inventory cost for material DEF in company ABC" Occurs While Creating the Sales Order-2879580 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Order: "Costs not determined"-1892976 - You get Error While Crating a New Sales Quote: "Costs not determined"-2662519 - Error: Costs Not Determined: Required Entry Field ID Of QueryItem Not Filled-2710002 - Sales Order is Inconsistent Due to the Error: Costs not determined: SoapFaultCode:5 connection closed (no data)-2936992 - Error Message "Item X: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service ABC and set of books IFRS valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing"-3000720 - Error message: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service XYZ and set of books AAA valid on DD/MM/YYYY is missing-1919386 - You Get Error Message "Costs not determined" for the Sales Order Line Item Which was Created From a Purchase Order-2641478 - You Get Error Message: Costs not Determined:Valuation not Successful:Fuilure of all Steps of Valuation Strategy 'Valuation for Operational Applications'-2669382 - Valuation Error When Adding Spare Part To Service Quote/ Service Order-  Keywords-Costs not determined; Sales Order; Pricing Date; Add Product; Inventory Costs; Sales Quote; Cost; Cost Rate; Unidentified costs; Quote

Title: No Employees Are Available to Add to an Org Unit
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add an employee to an org unit, but no employees are listed (or only service agents are displayed, in case there's any in the system).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Access the Edit Org Structures work center view.-Select the relevant org unit.-Go to Employees tab.-Click the Add button.-In the value help for the new field, no employees are listed.-Cause-For any org unit, you can only assign Service Agents through Add button of the Employees tab.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-If you want to assign an employee, that should be done through Personnel Administration work center.-Keywords-employees, missing, add, org unit, service agents, Organizational Management

Title: Identifier does not exist
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-The below error is observed on SAP Cloud Applications Studio when trying to perform a solution life-cyle operation like activation or assemble:-Identifier 'ABCD' does not exist. (where ABCD refers to a KUT or PDI extension field)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -Resolution-One possible resolution to this issue is to perform the activation on the backend of the .ref file (in case it is a KUT field) as well as the .absl file where the field is used.-Please follow the KBA from See Also section.--In case this does not resolves the issue, then follow KBA: 0002931292 - Failed to activate items of type ByDScriptingLanguageImplementation - Identifier 'ABCD' does not exist.-See Also-2980177 - SE38 - Activating Pdi solution files in the backend-Keywords-identifier, does, not, exist, deploy, deployment, upload, deployed, activate, PDI, SDK

Title: Collaboration Window Upload does not Work for Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a scanned Supplier Invoice but they not uploaded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You are using a folder on a Network Drive.-Resolution-Use a local folder on your machine. Network drives are not supported due to connectivity losses and instabilities of most Network drives.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice scan, Invoice Scan, Collaboration Window.

Title: Patch Activation Failed due to Business AnalyticsWork Center Not Assigned
Content: Symptom-You are facing the below errors during the activation of your custom solution on the SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-User not assigned to Business Analytics WoC. Analytics file not processed-Assign WoC Business Analytics to continue with the activation-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the solution.-Right click and select Activate Solution or Activate from the Implementation Manager.-Activation fails with the errors. -Cause-The reason for this error is that the Business Analytics work center is not assigned to your user.-Resolution-The requirement is that the user creating reports should be a key user. Login to the system and add the Business Analytics work center to the user who is trying to activate the solution:-In C4C: Go to the Administrator work center. In ByDesign: Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the view Business Users.-Search for the respective user and click Edit > Access Rights.-Go to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Assign the work center Business Analytics to this user and save. -Then trigger activation again from Cloud Applications Studio.-See Also-2731514 - PDI Extension Fields Are Not Added to Data Source During Patch Upload-Keywords-Business, Analytics, work, center, not, assigned, Deployment, failed, PDI, SDK

Title: Not able to access the Google Play Store
Content: Symptom-You cannot access the Google Play Store.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Scan the QR code on the Home page of SAP Business ByDesign. This will lead you to the google playstore - but you cannot access the page.-Cause-We are aware of the issue, that customers located in China are not able to use the Google Play Store.-For that reason we also made our ByD Mobile App available via Tencent App Store (full name: SAP Business ByDesign Mobile for Tencent -> the app is called “SAP Business ByDesign Mobile”).-Resolution-Please use the download Link: -Keywords-ByD Mobile App, Mobile App, QR Code, Android.

Title: Point-of-Sale Transactions is Inconsistent with the Error the Quantity type ABC is not permitted for the product
Content: Symptom-You created a Point-of-Sale Transaction but the Sales Transaction is Inconsistent with the following error:-The quantity type ABC is not permitted for the product XYZ.-Sales Item: Quantity type ABC not valid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Point-of-Sale Transactions view.-Select the Sales Transaction sub view.-Search for Sales Transaction EFG (EFG represents the Internal ID of the Sales Transaction).-Click Check button.-The following errors are displayed: -The quantity type ABC (ABC represents the quantity type) is not permitted for the product XYZ (XYZ represents the product ID).-Sales Item: Quantity type ABC not valid-Cause-The error occurs as the POS transaction has been created with product XYZ having the quantity unit code maintained as ABC in the product but the quantity type code as (ABC) instead of the type maintained in the product master data (abc).-For example, the correct Quantity Unit Code should be:-<Quantity unitCode="abc">1</Quantity>-<QuantityTypeCode>abc</QuantityTypeCode>-Resolution-You can cancel this inconsistent document and recreate the POS transaction with the correct information to create it consistently for further processing.-Keywords-POS; Point of Sale; Quantity Type Code; Quantity type; not valid; error; Inconsistent

Title: The Availability Check Button is Missing in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Availability Check button is missing in Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Sales Orders view.-Select the relevant Sales Order.-Click the Edit and then the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-You will find the Availability Check button is missing in the UI.-Cause-This is because you have not scoped ATP in your Implementation Project.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Open the relevant Project and click Next until you reach '4 Questions'.-Expand Selling Products and Services and select Sales Orders.-Please select question:Do you want to immediately confirm quantities and requested dates during sales order creation based on an availability check?-Select the Finish button to complete the project and Save the changes.-Keywords-ATP, BYD, Sales Order
