Title: ISO code XI is not correct in the VAT registration number
Content: Symptom-Since 31 January 2020, the UK is officially no longer part of the EU. Although Northern Ireland is part of the UK, the region is currently intended to remain under EU VAT legislation when it comes to the supply of goods. Code GB will be used by the UK and assigned according to British legislation, the EU Commission has proposed a new country code 'XI' to be attributed as a prefix of Northern Irish tax ID numbers.-But when trying to maintain a new tax number code for Northern Ireland with prefix XI, the system is throwing the error: 'ISO code XI is not correct in the VAT registration number'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Receivables work center-2. Go to Customers subview-3. Find the appropriate account-4. Click on Edit and select General-5. Go to the tab Financial Data-6. Change the Tax Number from GBAAAA to XIAAAA (where AAAA represents digits in the tax number code)-7. An error appears: ISO code XI is not correct in the VAT registration number-Cause-You need to use a new tax number type which is delivered to handle the XI tax numbers.-Resolution-Create a new row and  use tax number type Northern Ireland Protocol: VAT Reg. No. for entering the XI tax number. This is the tax number type delivered to handle the XI tax numbers.-Keywords-Northern Irish tax ID numbers, GB; XI; Northern Ireland Protocol

Title: PaymentFormCode in ManageEmployeeIn2 SAP Web Service for Employees From Mexico Is Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update the PaymentFormCode of ManageEmployeeIn2 SAP Web Service using an actionCode in the BankDetails but noticed that the only action code that works is "05".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Use the MaintainBundle operation from ManageEmployeeIn2 Service to update it with SoapUI (third party software) or similar.-You are using actionCode "04" to update in the BankDetails path as explained in KBA.-It does not change anything.-Cause-For México a Main Bank is required and for this reason you cannot use any other Payment Form code for Main Bank account, you can only use Bank Transfer because the only Payment Form Code that is enabled for Main banks is Bank Transfer.-For example: If you try to to select Cash for Payment Method and add Bank Details and mark it as Main, it will not allow you from UI.-Same is the case from Web Service, it will not allow you to create a Main Bank Account without selecting Bank Transfer.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior from the ByDesign System.-See Also-2981648 - How to Update PaymentFormCode of ManageEmployeeIn Web Service-Keywords-PaymentFormCode, ManageEmployeeIn, actionCode, México, BankDetails, Web Service

Title: The system is not set up for translation, system supported translation languages are not installed
Content: Symptom-You will receive the below error message while attempting to translate an item of your add-on within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio on a production tenant:-The system is not set up for translation, system supported translation languages are not installed-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio on your production tenant.-Open the affected Solution.-Right click on the item (e.g. a .codelist file)-Select Translation > Export Text.-Below error message appears.-  Cause-It is not possible to export texts from a live system i.e. production system.-Resolution-The translation should be performed on the test/development system where the patch solution is developed.-See Also-Please refer to the Help portal documentation: Translation Quick Guide -Keywords-PDI, SDK, translate, export, text, system, is, not, set, up, for, translation

Title: How is the Remaining Planned Cost Calculated for a Project Cost and Revenue?
Content: Symptom-Using a report for Project Cost and Revenue and not sure how the value of the Remaining Planned Cost field is calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search and open any report for Project Cost and Revenue (this applies to FINCACU04_Q0001, FINCACU04_Q0002, FINCACU04_Q0003 or FINCACU04_Q0004).-Provide the Selection Criteria.-Click on Go.-Unable to determine how the Remaining Planned Cost value is calculated.-Cause-The field calculates the Remaining Planned Cost based on the Remaining Quantity available under the Products tab of the respective project.-Resolution-For example, Project ABC has the product XYZ assigned under Products tab (ABC corresponds to the Project ID and XYZ to the Product ID).-If there is 50h of Planned Quantity, however Actual Quantity is 5h, this will result on 45h of Remaining Quantity.-Open product XYZ and Go to Valuation tab, for the respective company and set of books, find the Cost Rate. Let's assume the Cost Rate is 50 USD / h.-Then multiply the Planned Quantity with the Cost Rate, which is 50 * 50 = 2500 USD, this is the Planned Cost.-Now do the same for Remaining Quantity: 45 * 50 = 2250 USD, which is the Remaining Planned Cost.-Keywords-Project, Cost and Revenue, report, planned cost, Remaining Planned Cost

Title: Not able to Select a Distribution Channel in a Sales Document and the Sales Data in the Account
Content: Symptom-You are not able to select a distribution channel in the sales documents and in the sales data of the account master data. In the drop down list there are no records shown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click on the New button and select the Sales Order option.-Enter an account.-Enter a Sales Unit.-The following error message is displayed:-Item : Distribution channel or sales organization missing-When you click on the drop down list for the Distribution Channel you can see that there are No records found.-Open the account master data for the respective account.-Navigate to the Sales Data tab.-Enter a Sales Organization.-click on the drop down list of the field Distribution Channel.-You can see that also here the system displays: No records found-Cause-The reason why you get no results for the distribution channels is due to the fact that the work distributions rules for your sales organizations have either not been set up or are not valid anymore.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Work Distribution view and the Organizational Work Distribution sub view.-In the field Effective Date enter today's date.-Click on the Go button.-Select the work category Relevant Distribution Channels.-You can see that no rule has been set up and the Work Distribution Status is Global Work Assignment.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Work Distribution view and the Organizational Work Distribution sub view.-In the field Effective Date enter today's date.-Click on the Go button.-Select the work category Relevant Distribution Channels.-You can see that no rule has been set up and the Work Distribution Status is Global Work Assignment.-Click on the Edit button-Create the rules for your sales org units.-Click on the Save and Close button.-You will now be able to select the distribution channel in the sales documents and in the sales data of the account master data.-See Also-2487296 - Error Message Distribution channel or sales organization Missing While creating New Manual Customer Invoice.-2548518 - The Sales Order or Sales Quotes Uploaded via Excel Failed with Errors-2682040 - The Service Order Uploaded via Excel Failed with Errors-1893004 - The Sales Order Uploaded via Excel is Inconsistent-Keywords-Distribution channel; sales organization; missing; No records found;

Title: Cannot See all Items in the Price Lists
Content: Symptom-You would like to correct or remove items in the price list. However the respective items are not visible and you cannot remove or update the data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-Select Price Lists.-Select the relevant Price List.-Click on the Edit button.-Go to the Items tab.-You cannot see the respective items and therefore cannot remove or update the item.-Cause-In the items tab of base price list, you can see a field called Number of Items. By default the value sets to 100. Which means system displays 100 product IDs under items tab.-It is not possible to change the default value of 100 items to any other value.-The reason why we defaulted the Number of items displayed in the Price List in the Items tab to 100 is for performance reasons.-Resolution-Increase the value of Number of Items to e. g. 200 manually. This specifies the maximum number of displayed items. Now you can see the respective entries. Select Remove button to delete the entries and Save the base price list.-Keywords-Items; Price List; Product; Service;

Title: Invoice Total is Invoice Volume Report is Different Than Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have released an invoice successfully. When checking this invoice in the Invoice Volume report, you find the total amount is different than the corresponding journal entry document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoicing Documents view.-Open the invoice ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the invoice), the total amount is 2,100 EUR for example. (note that the invoice was released on 14th Oct and the posting date is 30th Sep).-Go to the Document Flow view, click on the journal entry icon.-System then opens the Journal Entry document of this invoice, from here the total amount is 649.215,00 HUF. And the exchange rate from EUR to HUF is 309,15.-Now, open the report Invoice Volume, run it and filter the invoice ABC.-You find the total amount in company currency is 641.592,00 HUF. It is different than the Journal Entry total.-Cause-The way the currency conversion / exchange rate is determined in the invoice volume report is different from the financial documents or reports. In this case, in the invoice volume report, the system determines the exchange rate based on the time of creation of the invoice, and uses the exchange rate that is active at this moment in time to calculate exchange rate from EUR into HUF.-The invoice in our example was created on the 14th Oct and the exchange rate that was valid at this time is 350,52. So the total of the invoice in HUF is 641.592,00 HUF.-In the Invoice Volume Report the specific time used for the exchange rate is 00:00:00 UTC. In case the exchange rate has changed on the 14th of Oct at 4:00:00 UTC, the exchange rate before the change will be considered for the Invoice Volume Report.-However, in financials, the exchange rate is determined based on posting date. In this case, the posting date for the invoice is the 30th Sep. The exchange rate valid on the 30th Sep is 309,15. Thus, in the Journal Entry, the total of the invoice in HUF is 2100 * 309,15=649.215,00 HUF.-Additionally, the sales reporting and financial reporting are different since they are using different methodologies. The Invoice Volume report as such has no effect on the financial part.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-See Also-KBA 1892948 - You Get the Incorrect Exchange Rate in Invoice Volume Report-Keywords-Rechnungsvolumen, Bericht, Währung, Kurs, Invoice Volume, Report, Currency, Exchange Rate

Title: Delete Change Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-If you don't need a change project anymore, you can delete it to prevent its impact to production system and other change projects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Enter backend of production system (refer CD 1704961)-Input transaction code "/obctadm" and press Enter on keyboard-Select Workspace Overview-Select the workspace ID which you want to delete-Press Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+C to copy workspace ID-Input transaction code "/ose16" and press Enter on keyboard-Input Table Name bctd_wsorgcpy and press Enter on keyboard -Input copied workspace ID in the field CPY_WS_ID-Press Execute button and Display button-Enter debugging mode (refer CD 1706205)-Clear value in the field "CPY LOGIC PORT" and click Save button-Click Back button twice-Please Note: The steps/this action should be performed by Development. In critical case, Business Configuration Expert Support colleagues can also perform the above deletion.-Keywords-deletion removal remove

Title: Performance Issues, Locks and Time Out During Material/Service Valuation Migration
Content: Symptom-You are migrating a large volume of Material or Service Valuation Data records using the Migration Tool.-The process is time-consuming. Especially during the Import Simulation step, latencies and even time-outs can be observed (message "Data Import in Progress").-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Locate and open the relevant fine-tuning activity, either Migration of Material Valuation Data or Migration of Service Valuation Data.-In the next screen, click the link Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool (or Migrate service valuation data using the migration tool).-Execute the migration.-Cause-The volume of data that can be reasonably processed during the migration process is limited as to migration sessions run in parallel and record volume in each file.-This can be exacerbated by combinations of Materials/Services and Business Residence in involved migration files.-Resolution-The following recommendations should be followed to mitigate experienced problems.-Materials/Services and Business Residence:-Materials/services related to several Business Residences should be contained in 1 file and should be sorted accordingly in continuous order.-For example:-2 Materials/Services ABC, DEF (ABC, DEF represent two Material or Service IDs)-5 Business Residences A1, B1, ... , E1 (A1, B1, E1 represent different Business Residence IDs)-The Financial Data - General and Financial Data - Details data entry tabs should hence be structured as:-ABC A1-ABC B1-ABC C1-ABC D1-ABC E1-DEF A1-DEF B1-DEF C1-DEF D1-DEF E1-The number of entries in the Financial Data - General tab should not exceed 20,000 records.-Volume and Parallel Sessions: -In case larger date volumes are to be migrated, it has to be observed that only a maximum of 3 sessions running in parallel is technically supported.-Included migration files should not exceed more than 20,000 records under tab General (see above).-Having more concurrent migration sessions can result in process- and/or user locks.-The same material should not be maintained in parallel processed files, as this leads to contractions as to the execution status of concerned files.-Keywords-Migration of Material Valuation Data, Migration of Service Valuation Data, Locked, User Lock, Time Out, Data Import in Progress

Title: How to Create New Expense Categories to Be Assigned to Expense Types
Content: Symptom-You want to create new Expense Categories to be assigned to Expense Types (either standard ones or custom ones, that you've created).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Creation of new Expense Categories is not available in SAP Business ByDesign.-New Expense Types can be created instead.-In case you'd like to have the functionality implemented in SAP Business ByDesign, we suggest you to create an idea in the Continuous Influence Session for ByDesign.-Keywords-expense reporting; expense category; expense categories; expense type

Title: Send With DocuSign not Working
Content: Symptom-After installing C4C Quote integration to DocuSign, you see that Send With Docu Sign button  on the UI is not enabled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Work Center.-Open any Quote.-Go to DocuSign Tab.-Send with DocuSign button is not enabled.-Cause-If the Approval status of the Sales Quote is set to Approval Neccessary, then Send With DocuSign will no be enabled.-Resolution-Please check the approval status of sales quote. If approval status is "Approval not required" or "Approved" then only Send With DocuSign button gets enabled.-

Title: Hierarchies Not Displaying Correctly in the Excel Add-In
Content: Symptom-When opening a report using the Excel Add-In, you cannot expand and collapse all hierarchies. You can just expand and collapse hierarchies by 8 levels, but the report should display more.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Search and open any report.-You can see it has 10 levels of hierarchy to be expanded or collapsed. -Go to Microsoft Excel.-Go to Excel Add-In tab.-Insert the report.-You can just expand and collapse hierarchies by 8 levels. -Cause-The analytical Excel Plug-In reuses the existing grouping functionality of the Microsoft Excel. As the Microsoft Excel only supports 8 levels of hierarchy, the Excel Add-In also supports only 8 levels.-Resolution-If you need to use collapse and expand options for more than 8 levels, we recommend you to access the report directly within your system. When using Excel Add-In, it will just allow you to collapse and expand by 8 levels of hierarchy.-See Also-For SAP Cloud for Customer: Work with Reports and Plans in Microsoft Excel-For SAP Business ByDesign: Working with Reports and Plans in Microsoft Excel-Keywords-collapse, excel hierarchy, hierarchy report, excel add in, expand excel, hierarchy level, report hierarchy, hierarchy excel

Title: You are Updating a Sales Order or Contract via Web Service, but the System is not Passing the Items in the Expected Order
Content: Symptom-You are updating a Sales Order or a Contract via the web service and want to add items in a sequential order. However, the system is not adding the items in the same order as you passed them via the web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we will use a sales order as an example. The sales order has already one item and you want to update the sales order with 3 additional items.-We will only use a a smal extract of the payload to represent the sequence you are uploading/updating to the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-<SalesOrder actionCode="04">-<ID>ABC</ID>-<Item actionCode="04">-<Description>1</Description>-</Item>-<Item actionCode="04">-<Description>2</Description>-</Item>-<Item actionCode="04">-<Description>3</Description>-</Item>-.-.-.-</SalesOrder>-Once the upload/update is concluded, you see the following inside the Items tab of the Sales Order document:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-earch for ID ABC.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that the items are added not in the same sequence and provided in the payload.-Item 20 | Description: 2-Item 30 | Description: 3-Item 40 | Description: 1-Cause-This is a technical limitation. The system does not guarantee the item order.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Please update the documents before the document is released, which will allow you the chance to pass the item ID.-See Also-2811862 - Error: Changing Line Not Possible; Field is Read-Only in Web Service-Keywords-Web Service, Sales Order, Contract, Update, Sequence, Order, Not Possible, Wrong; line items; item number

Title: How to Display Master Data Values In A Report Even If Key Figures Are Zero
Content: Symptom-You want to display all values (master data) for a charactertistic in a report, even if there are no key figure values (and thus the row with this master data value would normally be not displayed at all).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Reports.-Find your report.-If it is a standard report, click on New > Report as Copy. If you created this report yourself, click on Edit with > Report Wizard.-Go to step 4 and mark the check box Show Master Data Value for the respective characteristic.-The effect of this setting will be that all values for this characteristic will be shown in the report, regardless of whether there are key figure values for them or not. However please avoid using this setting excessively (for too many fields) - depending on the volume of master data, this may lead to performance issues in your report.-Keywords-show master data, key figure missing, characteristic, values missing, report, business analytics, show 0, zeroes, zero-master data value in report,master data

Title: Accounting Principle Built via PDI: The System Crashes After Flagging/Unflagging No Subsequent Reversal Posting for Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods
Content: Symptom-You have built an Accounting Principle via PDI. Now you want to modify some parameters concerning this feature in the system itself.-For example: You were able to assign a Foreign Currency Remeasurement Method to the respective accounting principle and is now trying to flag No Subsequent Reversal Posting for this method.-However, after flagging the checkbox and clicking Save the system crashes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash.-Click Assign remeasurement method to accounting principle.-Select the respective Accounting Principle built via PDI (starting with Y).-Select Use for Cash tab (notice that you cannot flag No Subsequent Reversal Posting because it is grayed out).-Click Add Row (now notice that the flag is available).-Delete the newly added row.-Flag No Subsequent Reversal Posting.-Click Save.-An Exception is thrown in the UI.-Cause-If the content is created via PDI (accounting principle in this case), then it also needs to be configured via PDI implementation (editing the solution on SAP Cloud Application Studio).-This change needs to be made in the PDI solution. The attempt to make this change in the system and not in the PDI implementation will result in a system crash. This is a general rule and not only valid for the specific case covered in this case document.-Resolution-To avoid system crashes you should change data related to the PDI Accounting Principle in the PDI Solution itself.-Keywords-PDI; accounting principle; Foreign Currency Remeasurement Methods for Cash

Title: Unable to Finalize Scope Changes Due to Inconsistencies in the Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add new elements to the scope of your system, but once you try to finish the selection, an error message is raised stating "Currently unable to finalize these scope changes at this time; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects work center view.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Proceed through the scoping wizard, adding the desired new elements to the scope.-Continue until the fourth step.-Click Finish.-System raises the mentioned error message.-Cause-In some cases, this issue is caused because one of the default fixed asset classes and/or account determination groups may be missing in the system, most likely deleted by user action because it was not necessary.-However, the lack of these default values causes the Business Configuration to become inconsistent. At the end of the scoping process, the system runs a check in the Business Configuration to ensure that everything is in order — it is then that it catches the inconsistency and raises the error message. As such, the error message is not necessarily connected to the scoping elements that are being added.-Resolution-You can restore default values for fixed assets by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Find and open the Fixed Asset Classes fine-tuning activity.-Select Edit Asset Classes.-Click Restore Defaults.-In the prompt, select the missing values listed and click Restore.-Confirm and save the changes.-You can restore default values for account determination groups by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Find and open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine-tuning activity.-Select Edit Account Determination Groups-Click Restore Defaults.-In the prompt, select the missing values listed and click Restore.-Confirm and save the changes.-Keywords-Currently unable to finalize, Scope changes, Inconsistencies, Business Configuration, Scoping.-a1s_fin_faclass_fiac_assetcls0,acctdetfxa

Title: Calculation of Depreciation Amount for Each Period When It's Rounded
Content: Symptom-The acquisition cost for fixed asset ABC (ABC represents the ID of fixed asset) is YYY (YYY represents the amount), the useful life is ZZZ (ZZZ represents the number of periods) periods, the depreciation method is L010-Str.-line from acq.value to 0.-System calculates the depreciation as follows: Acquisition cost YYY divided by ZZZ periods resulting in the same depreciation amount with decimals for each period. System rounds decimals but the results of rounding of each period are different.-You don't understand how the system is calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Go to the Fixed Assets view.-Search ABC.-Select Fixed Asset ABC and click Edit Values.-View subtab Depreciation Overview. You find depreciation amount of each period as below:-        Accounting Period 1, Depreciation XXX (XXX represents the depreciation amount)-        Accounting Period 2, Depreciation XXX-        Accounting Period 3, Depreciation XXX+1-        Accounting Period 4, Depreciation XXX-Cause-The depreciation methods have period control methods, etc. that all affect the calculation of the depreciation. Below is an example that drills down into the values system are using to get the depreciation values month on month.-Example:-Acquisition cost of fixed asset ABC: 6050 JPY-Useful life: 1 year = 12 periods-Depreciation method: L010-Str.-line from acq.value to 0. Depreciation method L010 has period control method 003. For period control method 003, transaction depreciation, the period control key is 01-Pro rata at period start date, which means the depreciation start or end date is always on the first day of the period in which the transaction takes place. You may refer to help documents Depreciation Methods and Period Control Methods and Keys for more details.-Depreciation starts from fiscal year 2018, accounting period 004.-Period Factor = period/total periods in year-Percentage is periods in segment (year) over total remaining useful life periods for that segment (2018 = 12).-A snippet from this, to explain accounting period 004/2018, 005/2018 and 006/2018.-Accounting Period 004/2018, Depreciation Amount 504 JPY:-Base Value = 6050 JPY-Period Factor = 1/12 (0.083333333)-Percentage = 12/12 (1.000000000)-Depreciation: 6050 JPY * 0.083333333 * 1.000000000 = 504.1666667 or 504 (rounded) JPY--Accounting Period 005/2018, Depreciation Amount 504 JPY:-Base Value = 6050 JPY-Period Factor = 2/12 (0.166666667)-Percentage = 12/12 (1.000000000)-Depreciation: 6050 JPY * 0.166666667 * 1.000000000 = 1008.333333 or 1008 (rounded) JPY - this value is 2 periods together. So to get 005/2018 on its own we subtract 1008- 504= 504 JPY.--Accounting Period 006/2018, Depreciation Amount 505 JPY:-Base Value = 6050 JPY-Period Factor = 3/12 (0.250000000)-Percentage = 12/12 (1.000000000)-Depreciation = 6050 JPY * 0.250000000 * 1.000000000 = 1512.5 or 1513 (rounded) JPY - this value is 3 periods together. So to get 006/2018 on its own we subtract 1513-1008 = 505 JPY.-And it continues along this line.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. You can also refer to the 'Explain Values' PDF on the Values tab of the fixed asset (click Values -> Explain Values).-Keywords-Fixed asset, Depreciation, Round

Title: Product Description is not Determined when creating an A2X Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order via A2X or e-commerce and the product description of the line items is not determined.-“Image/Data is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to your system in the respective logon language e.g. German.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-You can see that the description is not visible for product ABC (ABC represents the product ID).-Open product ABC.-Navigate to the General tab.-You can see that description is maintained.-Select the Other languages subtab.-You can see that the language English is not maintained for the product description.-Cause-Unless a preferred communication language is maintained in the account master data, the product description in a Sales Order is always determined by the logon language. When you create a Sales Order via A2X or e-commerce and you are providing no logon language, the system will use the logon language of the technical user which is by default always EN. If no product description in EN is maintained in the product master data, the system will not determine any description.-Regarding preferred communication langugage maintained in the account master data, please refer to 'KBA 1284582 - Item Product Description is Missing in your Sales Document such as Sales Order or Service Order Although Maintained in the Product Master Data'.-Resolution-You can pass the language in the SOAP UI by entering the respective value in the accept-language header element e.g. DE.-  See Also-KBA 1284582 - Item Product Description is Missing in your Sales Document such as Sales Order or Service Order Although Maintained in the Product Master Data-Keywords-Sales Order; Product Description; Webservice

Title: How Does the System Distinguish B2B and B2C Sales for Taxation
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales document to a corporate account, which has not VAT Registration Number maintained in its master data. Therefore, you expect the system to consider the sale as a B2C - Business To Customer scenario and derive the taxes accordingly to private person transaction. However, the transaction is being taxed as a B2B - Business to Business sale.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-Checking if the transaction is a B2B or B2C based on VAT number was an old criteria used by the system. As per the current design, B2B and B2C scenarios are checked based on the type of account.-Resolution-You need to use Corporate Account type for B2B scenario and Private account type for B2C scenario.-The accounts types can be checked via Business Partner Data -> Buiness Partner. Under the Details section, refer to the Business Partner Roles for the selected business partner.-Keywords-Business Partner. Taxation. Tax Code. Sales Order. Customer Invoice. Taxes.

Title: OData API for Data Sources not Working: Service Cannot Be Reached
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use an OData URL for data sources, but any URL results in the following message in the browser:-Service Cannot Be Reached-Environment-SAP CLoud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Enter an OData URl for data sources, for example:-https://<your system information>.sapbydesign.com/sap/c4c/odata/analytics/ds/-You will receive the message 'Service Cannot Be Reached'.-Cause-The required scoping for the data sources API is currently missing.-Resolution-All required steps are outlined in the help center.-In  C4C, the help center article is called 'Extract Data from Data Sources Using OData'.-In ByD, it's 'Retrieving Analytics Data Using OData'.-Please make sure you scope the required question in your implementation project, that the communication arrangement is set up and the data sources exposed.-See Also-2801302 - Expose to BW feature Missing for all Data Sources-2675247 - Build OData Queries Button Grayed Out or Missing-OData Webinar-Keywords-service cannot be reached, odata, data source, sap/c4c/odata/analytics/ds/, scoping, communication arrangement, expose not possible, missing

Title: Alpha Conversion in Cloud Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You are using the alpha conversion in a cloud data source to ensure that data in this field is stored in a particular format, for example with leading zeros. However you notice that the data is not stored with leading zeros. This could be relevant when joining this data source with another one on that field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Data Sources.-Search for your cloud data source and click Edit.-For the relevant field (let us say field ABC in this case), maintain the length, e.g. 20 characters.-For the same field, tick the option Alpha Conversion.-Save.-With this option, you would expect that if you upload a value in ABC which is shorter than 20 characters, the system will extend the value with leading zeros, until it has 20 characters.-However, when you join this data source with another one, on a field which also has 20 characters, the field values don't match and the join does not work.-Cause-The Alpha Conversion is used to display the values correctly on the UI.-Resolution-If you would like to ensure the correct number of characters in a cloud data source field, you would need to upload the values with the corresponding number of characters.-In our example, instead of uploading a value like 123 into the field ABC, you would need to ensure that the data is uploaded like this: 00000000000000000123.-Keywords-cloud data source, alpha conversion, leading zeros, zeroes, join does not work, join conditions, business analytics, design data sources

Title: Preview in Chrome Does Not Show Asian Fonts
Content: Symptom-During the preview of a document which contains Asian fonts (e.g. AdobeSongStd) in Chrome, the text vanishes.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This can happen for all business documents which contain Asian fonts for the Chrome browser during preview.-Cause-This is a Google Chrome browser issue. This is a browser limitation.-Resolution-You can use following workarounds:-Use a different browser such as: Internet Explorer, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox.-Try another Chrome PDF viewer extension. -Keywords-preview empty, missing, vanished, Chinese, Japanese, Korean,

Title: Checklist For UI Issue Analysis and Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Case document inteded for UI related issues analysis: a checklist before forwarding to development.-What is needed before forwarding:-Check UI Support Wiki for known issues and behaviors: click here-Then Check UI - Extensibility JAM for relevant information click here.- How to Analyze in case of backend dumps:-Go to ST22 transaction.-Check the Application Information, forward to relevant component, If you have not enough information please go throught below information find right component-Get relevant transaction ID.-Then go to SE16 transaction and enter data base table SSPRTTIDMAP and then F7.-Fill Transaction ID into field TID  and then F8.-Select SSPR_GUID (Software Problem Report).-Go to transaction /nSSPR_ADM.-Press button "Position..." (at bottom of screen) and fill SSPR_GUID-Mark found line and press "Status Administration" in tree at left screen side as last double click /SAP/ABAP/Exception-In this XML file, check for Call stack.-Note: Always check for second call stack which would say <CALL STACK>.-Based on affected class, forward incident to respective team.-In case if issue is related to UI changes/Personalization/Adaption:-Check XREP Transaction or CT Overview Report(AP_UI_XTS_CT_OVERVIEW).-Verify if it is end user or key user or it is partner changes.-In CT report, try to find relevant CT which has caused issue for respective UI component .-In XREP, under virtual folder, cross check the field / section information based on CT details for respective UI component.-How to check if there is any issue with Extension field.-Goto /n/ext/field transaction.-Check if field is in active or inactive status.-Verify if extension field is created in KUT or in SDK.-Then check extension field Is created properly or not in underlying BO.-How to check for CIP implentation (if any)-Check UI Designer Modeling and CIP (if any) regarding the UI issue that you have. It can be with respect to any field or section.-Ex: In below case, you could see field labelled as Dedicated.-In such cases, application would have defined logic in their class.-Application Team: Needs to clarify what they modelled in UI Designer and what they expected out from that modeling.-Note: Support Team should forward to UI team only if they are clear on application modelling and after checking if there is any special handling in CIP or exit class.-Template to be used when forwarding:-Steps to Reproduce the issue (every step is needed in details).-Business User Details (User ID - Note that if the issue is related to a specific user we would need the approval to reset the user password).-UI Component Path e.g. (You can get it via Browser Console - via Debug Mode flag: &debugMode=true or via Silverlight UI in Help -> Technical Information tab -> Technical Information option).-UI Field Name/List Path (Data Model Path).-CT Related to the issue (if caused by any).-Dump Transaction ID.-Client Dump Message - Call Stack from Console.-DETAIL YOUR ANALYSIS.-Without any pre analysis from application team ticket should not forward to UI framworkteam for any issue.-Keywords-Dump.backend

Title: Changes to MIME Type in the Business Configuration Are Not Being Applied in the System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer reports that changes done to fine-tuning activity Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload (for example, setting a certain MIME type as allowed or the opposite) are not being recognized by the system-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Cause-One of the most common causes for any change to the Business Configuration not being recognized by the system is that this change is not yet part of the active workspace, i.e. customer made this alteration in a change project that has not been merged yet (status Started). For those cases, please check the See Also section.-In case the support engineer has confirmed the change is part of the active workspace, but still not being recognized by the system, an inconsistency might be causing the change to not be updated on relevant backend table /DOC/C_DS_MIMES. You can check this as follows:-Log onto the system's backend.-Access transaction code SE16.-Access backend table /DOC/C_DS_MIMES.-Using the MIMETYPE field, filter for the relevant MIME type using its name (for example, image/jpg).-Execute by clicking the button (clock icon with a check mark next to the search bar) or pressing the F8 keyboard key.-Check the settings for the MIME type here and see if they match what is shown in the frontend — if, for example, the Allowed checkbox is marked in the frontend, but the ALLOWED_IND checkbox is not marked in the backend, the MIME type configuration is inconsistent.-Resolution-To solve this inconsistency, it will be necessary to redeploy the active workspace. You can do this with the following actions:-Log onto the system's backend.-Access transaction code BCTADM.-Select the Update Workspace option.-In the Workspace ID field, select the main workspace (click the value help for the field and select the workspace whose Is Main checkbox is marked).-Under the Deploy/Update Workspace, mark the Bypass Change Pointer box.-Execute by clicking the button (clock icon with a check mark next to the search bar) or pressing the F8 keyboard key.-Click Yes in the "Are you sure to update this workspace?" prompt.-If the process completes successfully, the log will show message(s) with a green icon and the inconsistency should be solved. You can check back in the /DOC/C_DS_MIMES table and inform the customer if the configuration is now correct.-See Also-1938088 - Changes in the Change Project Are Not Reflecting in the System-Keywords-MIME type, Allowed, Not Allowed, Change, Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload, Not Working

Title: When Invoicing External Customer Invoice Request a Customer Invoice is Created Even Though the Total Value is Negative
Content: Symptom-You uploaded an External Customer Invoice Request with Credit Memo Items and Invoice Items via the web-service. When invoicing the External Customer Invoice Request the system creates a Customer Invoice and not a Credit Memo even though the Total Net Value is negative.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select external customer invoice request ABC (ABC represents the id of the external customer invoice request).-You have invoice items (positive amount) and credit memo items (negative amount) in this external customer invoice request. The total net value is negative.-Click on the Invoice button.-The new invoice created is a Customer Invoice and not a Credit Memo.-Cause-The scoping option Invoice and Credit Memo Items in Customer Invoice Request is Not In Scope.-In this case, if you create an external customer invoice request with invoice items (positive amount) and credit memo items (negative amount) the created invoice is always of document type Customer Invoice no matter if the total net value is positive or negative. However in accounting in the Receivables the correct document type will be determined according to the total net value. If the total net value is positive the document type will be Invoice and if the total net value is negative the document type will be Credit Memo.- You can check this as follows:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the Customer Accounts view.-Select the respective customer (Account Party of the invoice) and the respective company (Seller Party of the invoice).-Click on the View button.-Search for the respective document number.-In the field Document Type you can see if the document is an Invoice or Credit Memo.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you wish that 2 different Customer Invoices are created (one for the Invoice item and one for the Credit Memo item) you can include the scoping option Invoice and Credit Memo Items in Customer Invoice Request in your solution scope:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Select Sales, then Customer Invoicing, then Miscellaneous.-You can activate the second question: Do you want to allow customer invoice requests/invoices to contain invoice and credit memo line items?-In this case an invoice split for the Invoice Type will occur and an Invoice is created for the Invoice item and a Credit Memo is created for the Credit Memo item.-See Also-KBA 1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-Keywords-Split; Credit Memo; Customer Invoice; web service; negative; positive; minus; plus; ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Scripting Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In this Knowledge Base Article, we will look at known issues regarding the Scripting topic, and how we can troubleshoot Scripting issues.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-The filepath for all affected ABSL scripts.-Pre-analysis from the Partner (traces, debugging, breakpoint placement).-What is the expected and current behavior.-Steps and permission to reproduce (only if it is required for your analysis).-Prechecks:-Before debugging, always ensure that the solution is Enabled, Activated and that all the affected files are also activated successfully.-Set a breakpoint in the custom PDI script file (in ABSL or in ABAP), and reproduce the steps in the frontend in order to trigger these breakpoints.-For debugging in ABAP in the backend, please see KBAs: 2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger  and 2638557 - Advanced: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger-  1. If the customer reports that they receive a Null Reference dump, or whereby the value is not displayed in the field as expected, even though they are sure that their code is setting/passing the value correctly, then you will need to check the last custom script file that the system triggers in order to see is this true.-If you are debugging in ABSL, then check if the value is set in the Locals in the last custom script file that is executed.-If you can see the code does not set the value, or it is emptying the value, then return the incident to the partner with a screenshot of the Locals..-If it is set by the code, and the value remains set even after all of the custom script files are finished executing, then you will need to debug in the backend in ABAP to see if the issue is caused by the Framework classes, UI classes, or Application classes.-If you are already debugging in ABAP in the backend, then check the local variable to see if this value is passed from the custom script file to the standard classes.-If the value is passed correctly to the standard classes, the issue is not with PDI. Check if the ABAP code in the standard classes is emptying the value. If it is, then send the incident to the support team that the affected class belongs to.-Additional check that can be done:-If it is a standard field that they are trying to fill a value to, check if it is PSM write released.-If it is a custom field, and it is not being updated / if it is a custom button, ensure the field / button is on the same node that the script file is on. (refer to: 3101086331)-2. If an error message is occurring, but the partner / you are not sure where the message is coming from, you will need to debug in the backend.-Please see the KBA 2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger  and use the message class: CM_ESI_T100.-Follow the steps in the above KBA to identify where the message is coming from.-If the partner insists they are not causing this error message, you can debug in the backend to see what values are being passed, and what is triggering this error.- 3. If a custom script is not triggering as expected.-Check if the file is activated.-If it is a custom field, and it is not being updated / if it is a custom button, ensure the field / button is on the same node that the script file is on.-If it is a standard button (action) that is affected, please refer to the incident 3101087373. Ensure that the action the partner is using corresponds to the action on that standard button. If the action does correspond correctly, then these incidents will need to be checked by the relevant Application team.-4. If the partner is receiving an error such as 'Identifier not found' or if their field is not displaying in code completion, it can be caused by them selecting Mass Enable for their custom script file.-2559829 - You are Unable to Use a Standard Node in the Script File of an Add on Solution-2469605 - Error While Trying to Activate Script File : Identifier ABC Does not Exist-5. If the partner is receiving the error "Identifier 'My_Field' is read-only and cannot be changed", it can be caused by the Deployment Unit of the related BO or if data is changed in a Validation/ActionValidation script.-2993815 - Activation Error: Identifier is read-only and cannot be changed -Resolution-Kindly check the above scenario and take the necessary action as per released KBA's.-See Also-For debugging in ABAP:-2638478 - Central Case Document for Debugging-2635374 - Basic: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger-2638557 - Advanced: How to Debug Backend Messages Using The Debugger-2365114 - How to trace in the Cloud Application Studio SDK-2366451 - How to debug incoming email to C4C from backend-2590252 - How To Find the ABAP Code Line Corresponding to an ABSL Script Line-2559829 - You are Unable to Use a Standard Node in the Script File of an Add on Solution-2753314 - How to Disable ABSL Execution without the SAAB Switch-2684987 - Disabled Solution .pid File is Executed-2684218 - Dump Error: GETWA_NOT_ASSIGNED-2727089 - ABSL Event Script is not Getting Triggered-2829705 - PDI ABSL DUMP: The argument XYZ cannot be interpreted as a number-2768491 - How to take AP trace in the backend-2924088 - Unhandled Exception while debugging in the Cloud Application Studio-2682367 - Backend Dump Occurs During Any Action in the UI due to PDI Involvement-2365114 - How to take trace in the Cloud Application Studio SDK-2831523 - Lead Creation via SDK is Taking Too Long for Processing-2764703 - Error "SP CL_PDI_RI_XREP_SP_ABAP1 failed process file /YPQR_/……/XYZ.absli in solution $STAGING branch $DEFAULT " Occurs-2654462 - DATREF_NOT_ASSIGNED as a Runtime Error in UI due to Custom Addon-2909212 - Slow Performance when editing an ABSL script -Blogs: -Performance ABSL Trace – New functionality in 2005 Release -SAP Cloud Application Studio : Performance Check-SAP Cloud Application Studio Performance Best Practices-Performance improvements with ABSL-Keywords-Scripting, PDI, Debugging, ABSL, ABAP, custom action, custom event, not triggering, triggering, executed, tracing

Title: The Button 'Delete' is Disabled for Expense Types.
Content: Symptom-You would like to delete some expense types for some countries, but you see the function is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open activity expense reporting - ABC(ABC stands for the Country).-Click Edit Expense Types.-You will see the button 'Delete' is disabled(The button 'Delete' is grey out).-Cause-Currently, for some Countries/Regions like France, Canada and China etc, the function 'Delete' is disabled.-But for Countries/Regions like Germany and Austria etc, the function 'Delete' is enabled.-Resolution-Despite you can not delete the expense types for some Countries/Regions, you could use below method as a workaround to make sure relevant expense types won't be shown when you create expense reports:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open activity expense reporting - ABC(ABC stands for the Country).-Click Edit Expense Types.-Select the Expense Type you want to disable, you see the Valid To is Unlimited.-Click Add Row, then the Column Valid To is editable for the line mentioned in step 5.-Delete the new row and enter a previous date in the Valid To.-Click Save and Close.-Then this expense type will be disabled and will not be shown when you create expense report for a date after the one in the column Valid To.-Keywords-expense reporting; expense types; delete; disabled; grey out.

Title: Incorrect National Bank Code Derived in Payment File Based in Custom Payment File Structure
Content: Symptom-The National Bank Code (NBC) derived in a payment file created based on a Custom Payment File Structure is not the one you expect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files view.-Open the respective file.-Click View All.-Open the file (for example, a .txt file).-Notice that on the field you've set up with data source as National Bank Code of Payer/Payee in respective custom payment file structure the National Bank Code derived is not the expected one.-Cause-There are two or more National Bank Codes set up for the respective supplier's bank in Bank Directory Entry and none of them are flagged as Identification via National Bank Code.-In this case, system is deriving one of the NBCs configured while you you expect other.-Resolution-When there are multiple NBCs defined in respective Bank Directory Entry, you should flag the one you want to be derived in payment files as both Default and Identification via National Bank Code.-Keywords-NBC; national bank code; payment file; payment file structure; bank directory entry; supplier bank data

Title: Expense Arrangements are not Automatically Created Upon Hiring an Employee
Content: Symptom-You have hired a new employee, however the corresponding expense arrangement has not been created automatically for this employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Arrangements view.-There is no expense arrangement created for the newly hired employee. -Cause-The country version under which the employee has been hired is not completely configured and deployed from a business configuration perspective. Therefore, the corresponding expense arrangement cannot be created.-For example, you have country Spain deployed and set up in business configuration, however you have hired the employee with a German employment. Since Germany is not in scope and the corresponding ERM - Expense and Reimbursement Management settings for Germany are not set up and deployed, the German expense arrangement is not automatically created.-Via below steps, you can check the country/region related to the employee:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the corresponding employee.-Via Personalization menu, add the column Country/Region to the list.-Refer to the country mentioned in the above column for the respective employee.-Resolution-You need to evaluate if the employee has been hired under the correct country of employment or not. If not, you need to terminate the current employment and re-hire the employee under the correct country, which has the ERM settings correctly deployment in business configuration. Unpon re-hiring the employee, the expense arrangement shall be automatically created - given that the ERM activities are all correctly set up and deployed.-Otherwise, if the employment country is correct, you need to scope the country and complete the ERM set up accordingly in business configuration. After that, you can reach out to support to check the feasibility of triggering the expense arrangement creation via backend.-Keywords-Expense Arrangement. Expense Report. Expense Type.

Title: Wrong Address Found in Sales Order Account
Content: Symptom-You have a Sales Order which is displaying the wrong address, despite change having performed changes inside of the Account master data, prior to the creation of the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, the master data address which is not correct is the account's zip code.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit. -You see that the zip code is not maintained as expected.-Cause-Although you did perform updates in the Account master data before the creation of the Sales Order, since this document is a follow-up from a sales document, such as an Opportunity, and the preceding sales document was created before the Account master data update, the Sales Order will inherit the data from the preceding document.-Resolution- This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Account, Changes, tab, Address, Sales Order, Opportunity, Sales, Document

Title: Sales Kit Sub-Item Missing Currency Value Under Sales Order Form
Content: Symptom-You are working with sales kit items and when navigating to the XML structure of the form, you noticed that the currency value is missing for the kit sub items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click on View Data XML.-<NetAmount currencyCode="   ">0.0</NetAmount>-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign does not store this data for the sub items.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Keywords-Sales Kit, Sub-Item, Missing, Currency, Value, Sales Order, Form, NetAmount

Title: Customer Return is Inconsistent - Sales Order Reference Not Valid
Content: Symptom-You received an error message when trying to assign a Sales Order as reference to a Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Search for the Return ID: ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Return).-Press Go button.-Select the Return and click the Edit button.-Error appears: Sales Order Reference with ID XYZ-10 not valid (XYZ-10 represents the ID of the Sales Order and Item).-Cause-The reason why the system is not able to assign the Sales Order XYZ to the Customer Return ABC, is because the Sales Order items have been canceled.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Remove the reason for the rejection maintained in the Sales Order and assign the reference to the Customer Return.-See Also-1505322 - Customer Return is Inconsistent - Order Reference Not valid-Keywords-Customer Return, Sales Order, Reference, Not Valid

Title: Project Planning Data not Showing in Reports
Content: Symptom-You are running a project planning report, for example Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project, but some projects are missing entirely or the related key figures are all blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Design Reports view.-Open the e.g. Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project.-Run the report for the desired project ID.-You see that either some/all key figures are blank or the project is not even retrieved.-Cause-There are different reasons for the project plan data to be missing. One of them is that the calculation of project cost estimate failed in financials.-Resolution-You can check the project plan status as follows:-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Projects view.-Find the related project.-The last column (Error Status) in this view shows if it was successful or is in error.-You can click Project Plan Value button to display the project's plans and revaluate if required.-Keywords-Project Plan Value. Project Management. Cost and Revenue.

Title: Error When Trying to Upload Inbound File With File Type MT940
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload the Inbound File XYZ (XYZ refers to the Inbound File ID) with file type MT940, but when you click on Start File Upload button, the error "An exception was raised" appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Search for the Inbound File XYZ.-Click on Start File Upload button.-Error message "An exception was raised" appears.-Issue can also be reproduced with the steps below:-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Inbound Files view.-Click on New button, then select Inbound File.-Select the relevant Bank ID and Company ID-Select the File Type as Bank Statement.-In the Import Format field, MT940.-Click on Add button, then select File.-Browse the file in your device.-Click the on Add button.-Click on Start File Upload button.-Same error message appears.-Cause-The root cause of this error message is a data overflow that happens at mapping the values of Bank Account Holder Name field. Here the following text is separated by a question mark ("?") with two identifier digits, followed by the content, until the next separator (another question mark or a new line that starts with a colon).-If the file you provided contains a collection of more than 80 characters between the "?33" and the next "?", the error will occur since this field is limited to 80 characters.-Resolution-The logic will be enhanced in the future, in the meantime you can manually delete part of the string so that it has 80 characters or less. This will avoid the overflow and the upload will be successful.-Keywords-Inbound File, Bank Statement, upload, start file upload, exception, an exception was raised, MT940

Title: Error 'Currency Code XYZ does not exist'
Content: Symptom-When running a Report or Data Source, the message "Currency Code XYZ does not exist" appears.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system.-Navigate to the work center and work center view that leads you to the desired Report or Data Source.-Open and run the Report or Data Source.-Note the message in the bottom of the screen that says "Currency Code XYZ does not exist"-Cause-This message indicates that the Currency Code XYZ has been maintained in some fields of item (Opportunity, Ticket, or Sales Order), however this Currency Code does not exist in the codelist of Currency Codes, which causes consistency issues when the data source tries to retrieve such code from the system.-Resolution-Invalid currencies cannot be shown in reporting. Please make sure your documents use valid currencies.-Keywords-Currency Code does not exist; table /ISCER/C_CER

Title: Value "#" is Displayed if the Text is Maintained Blank in Reports and Data Sources
Content: Symptom-When consuming data from a report, fields without value maintained in the system are displayed as "#" rather than null or blank.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports or Design Data Sources work center view.-Open the related Report or Data Source.-Execute the Report or Data Source.-The values for field ABC ('ABC' represents the field name) are displayed as '#' when there is no value assigned to this field.-Cause-The '#' symbol corresponds to entries that are not maintained in the system. In other words, this value represents blank or null values for a specific entry.-Resolution-Currently, it is not possible to display entries with no values maintained in the system with blank value or 'null' text. Hence the '#' is displayed to indicate that a specific field does not have any entries in the system.-Keywords-#, Not assigned, blank, null, # in reports, # in data sources-blank,null,#,not assigned

Title: Freight Based on Weight for Sales Kits
Content: Symptom-You would like to use Freight based on weight for Sales Kits. However, when entering the Sales Kit in a Sales Order the weight is empty for the Sales Kit - Header. It is only filled for the Sales Kit - Sub Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Click the New button and select the Sales Order option.-Enter all respective data such as account, employee responsible etc.-Navigate to the Items tab-Add sales kit XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of Sales Kit - Header).-You can see that no weight is displayed for the Sales Kit - Header XYZ in the table.-However the Sales Kit - Sub Items ABC and EFG both display the respective gross weight (ABC and EFG represent the ID of the Sales Kit - Sub Items).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Pricing sub tab.-Click Expand All-You can see that the Price Component Freight is determined but since there is no weight in the Sales Kit Header the Price Component Value is 0,00.-Since there is no pricing data on the Sales Kit - Sub Items there is not Freight calculated there either.-Cause-Weight based freight is not supported for Sales Kits.-Currently, it is not possible to add the weight dimension to the Sales Kit Header: When adding a Sales Kit to a e.g. Sales Order, the Freight is not determined for the Kit if it is weight based; The weight always comes from the item whereas the pricing for the Kit is on the header and there is no way of adding the weight for a Kit on the header level.-It was planned to enable this with Release 2111 but due to issues in the weight calculation in the Delivery Note if a weight is maintained for both Kit header and Kit Items, the feature will be reverted again.-Resolution-This feature is planned for a future release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-header, item, sales order, pricing, price component, kit de vente, fret, prix

Title: Expense Report Error Balance Not Zero for Country Italy
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You notice that there are Business Transaction errors in document flow of Expense Reports for Italy.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select the Expense Report which is in Not Submitted status.-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Go to the Document Flow and you observe that there is an error 'Expense Report (Expense Report Number) cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting).-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Now, logon to SE38 in the backend and try to restart the XI message and it is unsuccessful.-You observe the XI message in the backend as 'Balance not zero in document'.-Cause-This could be because the field 'Number' is consisting values. It is expected that the no values are to be entered in this field for the country Italy. For few countries this field is either hidden/ disabled, going forward this will be handled for the country Italy. For now follow the below steps to avoid the error.-Resolution-Kindly create a new Expense report and ensure that the field 'Number' is blank. You can also create the expense report by copying the existing report. Please note that updating the already existing Expense report will not work.-In addition, the field 'Number' should be left blank for all the future reports until this field is being handled. You can find the Number Field in the following steps.-Go to the Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Click New Expense Report.-Click View All.-Go to the Expenses tab.-Go to the Expense Data tab.-Under Other Details section, leave the number field empty, do not enter any data.-Once you enter all other details and create Expense Report, there will not appear.-If still you see the error and unable to solve the issue, kindly forward the incident to AP-ERM-GLO component.-Keywords-Balance Not Zero-saldo non pari a zero nel documento

Title: Cloud Print Manager compatible with Windows 11
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Is the SAP Cloud Print Manager for Business ByDesign compatible with Windows 11?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-We have tested the Installation, setup and Print options with The Operation System Windows 11 and we have not seen any issues.-Keywords-Windows 11, Cloud Print Manager, Printing.

Title: Schedule Line Type 1 is not Valid
Content: Symptom-You are facing the error "Schedule line type 1 is not valid", when trying to create a Sales Quote with reference to a Project using the Create with Reference button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select New Sales Quote from the Common Tasks.-Click Create with Reference.-Reference Type: Project.-Enter any project.-Enter any creation method.-Click Ok.-Error: "Schedule line type 1 is not valid".-Cause-The scenario is generating the error because of the following scenario.-The Sales Quote is being created with reference from a Project with items.-The Account data is pulled to the document, however the party determination is not completed for Sales Unit / Sales Data.-When the system tries to add the items, it is not possible to perform the determination as the items data since the Sales Data is missing.-This causes the inconsistency with the item type determination as the Sales Data is needed for this work as expected.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please review your party determination so that the Sales Data to be pulled accordingly upon document creation.-Kindly check the attached KBA called: Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-See Also-2852861 - Party Role Determination in a Sales Document-Keywords-Schedule Line; Type 1 is not Valid; Sales Quote; Project; Reference; Error; Item; Account Party

Title: Identification of Ship From Location From Sales Unit
Content: Symptom-You want the system to determine Ship-From Location based on the Sales Unit used in the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the view Sales Orders.-Choose the button New and select the option Sales Order.-In the New Sales Order page choose the button View All, In the General tab enter the account details and navigate to the Items tab .-In the Items tab choose the button Add Row and under the column Product ID enter the product ID in the sales order .-You expect the system to determine the Ship-From location as ABC, but the system determines the location as XYZ﻿.-Cause-Ship-From determination is based on Ship-To address from the sales order. It is not possible to select Ship-From site according to the sales unit. Sourcing of the ATP rely on the Ship-To address and not on the selling organization of the company.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-ship from determination, ship from determination for sales quote, ship from determination

Title: Expense Report Not Posted Due To Process Communication Error
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have at least one Source Document 555 - Customer Project Expense List which is not posted because the Expense Report AAA is not posted. You notice that there is a Process communication error for the Expense Report. When you restart the XI message (SRT_MONI) it does not work and you see that the error message here is: 'Balance not zero in the document'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Travel and Expense workcenter.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select the Expense Report AAA and open it.-Click View All.-Click the Document Flow Tab.-You notice that the posting did not work. Instead there is a [!] icon. If you click it, the following error addressed to your service provider is displayed:-'Expense Report AAA cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)'.-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Cause-If you go in the backend in SRT_MONI to find the XI message, you see the error message 'Balance not zero in the document'.-You have at least 2 Expense with the same Expense Type but not the same Tax Code or not the correct Tax Code.--For instance:-Expense 1: Expense Type: Train / Tax Code: Domestic purchase of freight services, freight reduced rate.-Expense 2: Expense Type: Train / Tax Code: Domestic purchase of goods, zero rate.-Resolution-In the given scenario, if you change the Tax Code of the first Expense to Domestic purchase of goods, zero rate, the issue is resolved.-Keywords-Balance not zero in the document, Process communication error, Expense Report,-expense report,process communication error,balance not zero in the document

Title: How to Add Extension Fields Created by PDI Solution to a Migration Template
Content: Symptom-You want to add extension fields which have been created within a PDI solution to a migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-To add extension fields to a migration template you would need to create a Process Extension Scenario item within the PDI solution. This Process Extension Scenario has to be created on top of the Namespace, Business Object and the Business Object Node, on which the extension field is residing.-To create a Process Extension Scenario you can use the following steps:-Open the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the PDI Solution ABC (ABC represents the ID of the PDI solution).-Click the Add New Item icon.-Select the Process Extension Scenario item.-Click the Add button.-Use the Scenario Selection (Namespace, Business Object and Node) on which the extension field is residing.-In the Scenario View section select the migration service DEF.-Click the OK button.-A Process Extension Scenario item with the name XYZ has been created.-Note: You can determine which service is a migration service by hovering over the service. For migration services it will state Inbound Migration.-Once the Process Extension Scenario item is added to the PDI solution, a reference has to be created on the corresponding extension fields.-To create the reference you can use the following steps:-Open the Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the Add-On Solution ABC (ABC represents the ID of the PDI solution).-Open the Extension Business Object GHJ.-Add the following code snippet at the beginning of the respective extension fields: "[Scenario (XYZ)]".-Save and Activate the Extension Business Object.-The extension fields are now added to the migration template.-Keywords-Extension field, PDI, SDK, Migration, Mass Data Maintenance, Add

Title: Employee Replication Request Error "Assignment not Valid; Target Object Only Valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY"
Content: Symptom-You try to replicate an employee, but the Employee Replication Request failed with error message "Assignment not valid; target object only valid from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Access the Import > Employees view.-Show Failed/Not Started.-Search for the respective Remote Employee ID you are trying to replicate.-You will find the failed replication request and under the Log Items for Selected Employee section the error message "Assignment not valid; target object only valid from DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY' is displayed.-Cause-In the concerned Employee Replication Request, you have entered an organizational assignment which is not valid: its validity period does not match the validity period of the respective Remote Org Unit ID (either a Cost Center or a Reporting Line Unit).-For example: you have entered an Organizational Assignment validity period from 01.05.2020 to 31.07.2020 to Remote Org Unit ID ABC (ABC represents the Remote Org Unit ID), but org unit ABC is only valid starting from 01.04.2021.-You can check the Remote Org Unit's validity period as follows:-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Depending on the org unit type:-If it's a cost center, access the Import > Cost Centers view.-If it's a reporting line unit, use the Import > Reporting Line Units view.-Show Successful.-Search for the relevant remote org unit ID.-Select the latest replication request and check the Start Date and End Date data.-Resolution-In the concerned Employee Replication Request, maintain an Organizational Assignment with a validity period which corresponds with the respective Remote Org Unit's validity period.-Keywords-Employee Replication request, assignment not valid

Title: Extension Field For Sales or Service Order Cannot Be Updated on Item Level via your PDI solution
Content: Symptom-An Extension field on item level in Sales Order or Service Order cannot be updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Your PDI solution is trying to update an Extension field in SalesOrder-Item.node or ServiceOrder-Item.node but this is not possible due to the following error: Changing data not possible; data is read-only-Cause-In order to modify the item in a Sales or Service Order the system checks for the CancellationStatusCode, FulfilmentProcessingStatusCode, InvoiceProcessingStatusCode and CustomerOrderLifeCycleStatusCode.-Apart from the lifecycle status code the ApprovalStatusCode and CancellationStatusCode are also checked by the system.-In a Service Order for example the item will always become read only when the item is canceled via Reason for Rejection or when the Service Order is in Approval.-In a Sales Order, for service items it will also become read only when the Delivery Status is Finished.-For materials it will also become read only when the Delivery Status is Finished and the Invoice Status is either In Process or Finished.-Resolution-Apart of the lifecycle status code the following mentioned statuses should also be checked before updating item:--Status/ApprovalStatusCode - a change is only allowed if the status value is 'Approved' or 'Not Started'-Status/CancellationStatusCode - a change is only allowed if the status value is 'Not Cancelled'-CustomerOrderLifeCycleStatusCode - a change is only allowed if the status value is not 'Completed'-Status/FulfilmentProcessingStatusCode - for a service item a change is only allowed if the status value is not 'Finished'-Status/InvoiceProcessingStatusCode - for a material item a change is only allowed if the status value is not 'In Process' or 'Finished'-  See Also-2838653 - Extension Field For Project Invoice Request Cannot Be Updated on Item Level via your PDI Solution-Keywords-CancellationStatusCode; FulfilmentProcessingStatusCode; CustomerOrderLifeCycleStatusCode; Sales Order; ApprovalStatusCode; CancellationStatusCode; InvoiceProcessingStatusCode; Read Only; Changing data not possible; data is read-only

Title: "My Teams" Functionality Does Not Work For A Manager
Content: Symptom-You have a manager who has employees reporting to them, but they are unable to view data in queries such as My Team's Account, My Team's Open/In Process Activities, My Team's Opportunities and others.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities view.-Go to My Team Opportunities.-No results are displayed.-(The Opportunities work center view is used here as an example. Behavior can be observed in other work centers as well.)-Cause-The org unit to which the manager and the employees are assigned does not have the Sales function selected.-Resolution-Please edit the org unit in the Organizational Management work center and check the Sales box under the Functions tab, then save and activate the changes.-Keywords-"Approvals","My Team's Account","My Team's Open/In Process Activities","My Team's Opportunities" and "My Team's Uncompleted Quotes"

Title: Asynchronous Error (Final) Sending Mail in Broadcast Log
Content: Symptom-You have created and executed a broadcast.
