When you check the broadcast logs, you see the following error message for some users: 'Asynchronous error (final) sending mail'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Broadcasts.-Select the respective broadcast from the list.-In the table underneath the broadcast list, click the tab Last Broadcast Run.-Here you will see the error.-Cause-Some of the recipients have set up automatic out-of-office replies. When the system receives a reply to a broadcast email, it assumes that the broadcast email bounced / was not delivered successfully and throws the error message.-Another cause might be that spam settings on the recipient's side prevent the delivery of the email.-Resolution-Check if any of the recipients are sending out-of-office replies. If so, the broadcast was delivered successfully and the message can be ignored.-If the broadcast was not delivered, please ensure that the spam settings do not block emails from the sender address, and that attachments (csv, xml, xlsx, html) are allowed.-Keywords-Asynchronous error, error in broadcast, broadcast logs

Title: Warning message "Item XX unidentified costs.There is no Inventory cost for material DEF in company ABC" Occurs While Creating the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You get a warning message while creating a sales order stating: Item XX unidentified costs,There is no Inventory cost for material DEF in company ABC.-However you have already maintained the inventory cost for material.-Note:-XX represents the line item number.-DEF represents the ID of the material.-ABC represents the ID of the company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Find the sales order GHI (GHI represents the ID of the sales order).-Select the sales order GHI and choose the Edit.-Error occurs stating:Item XX unidentified costs,There is no Inventory cost for material DEF in company ABC.-Cause-The error message was coming because inventory cost was not maintained when the sales order was created.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order GHI (GHI represents the ID of the sales order).-Choose the Edit button.-Go to the Pricing Tab and select Item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Select Update Pricing in the Total Pricing section.-Save the document.-Keywords-Costs not determined; unidentified costs

Title: CA 005 Domestic Payment: Outbound File Is Empty
Content: Symptom-The payment file created based in payment format for Canada CA 005 Domestic Payment is empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Outbound Files view.-Open the respective file ID with status In File Creation.-Click View All.-Open the file which has file size of 0 Bytes.-The file is empty.-Cause-The system has aborted the file creation in the backend with a system crash, which happened due to at least one of the reasons below:-An alphanumeric value has been maintained for routing number of Company Bank. In this case, routing number is usually the National Bank Code (NBC).-An alphanumeric value has been maintained for routing number of Payee's Bank. In this case, routing number is usually the National Bank Code (NBC).-Resolution-For payment format CA 005 Domestic Payment, the routing number (NBC) should be a numeric value.-Once you change the required National Bank Code(s) to a numeric value you should be able to create a payment file successfully.-See Also-2716578 - You create an Outbound file but the file is empty-Keywords-CA 005 Domestic Payment; NBC; national bank code; payment file

Title: How To Massively Delete Tax Data from Materials
Content: Symptom-How to delete tax data from materials in a massive way (for more than one material at a time).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There is an option to use web service. Using web services, you can update large number of records.-In this case, the standard web service "ManageMaterialIn" and Operation "Maintain materials" can be used.-For deletion of records, you can use actionCode="05" for DeviantTaxClassification.-See Also- Help Documentation for Manage Materials web service.-Keywords-material; tax; taxes; delete; remove; manage materials; devianttaxclassification

Title: Error When Migrating Bank Account Balances: Fund is not Valid for Company and Posting Date
Content: Symptom-You are migrating bank account balances via migration tool, however an error related to an invalid Fund ID is being raised. However, no fund ID is provided in the migration file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center.-Implementation Projects view.-Open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant migration unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select Balances of Bank Accounts.-Click Process File.-Go to Simulate step.-Error: 'Fund <Fund ID>is not valid for Company <company ID - name> and Posting Date <migration posting>'-Cause-The error message would be correct and is raised when the determined Fund ID is wither not within a validity date or is blocked for transactions (not active).-The Fund ID is not provided in the migration file directly, it is determined based on the assignments maintained under General Ledger. In this case, the given fund is assigned to the company ID or even specifically to the bank account being migrated.-Resolution-You need to either change the fund assignment to the company/bank account so that a valid fund is assigned or make the current fund valid and not blocked for postings.-The fund assignments can be checked as follows:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Edit Fund and Function Assignment.-From the dropdown, choose company and/or bank account selection.-In this view, you see that Fund and Functions being determined for the transactions.-The validity of the Funds can be managed as below:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Funds view.-Search for the respective fund.-Click Edit.-Make sure that the Fund is within a validity date and is Active (not blocked for transactions).-Keywords-Fund and Function. Bank Statement. Payment Allocation. My Bank. House Bank Account. Bank Balance. Migration. Fund Management.

Title: You are Unable to Release/Activate the Service Catalog
Content: Symptom-You are Unable to Release/Activate the Service Catalog and get one of the below error messages:-Conflict between catalog XYZ (version 1) and catalog ABC (version 1). There is a usage conflict between the specified catalogs. Therefore, you cannot release this catalog.-Validity date conflict with catalog ABC (version X) release not possible.-XYZ and ABC represents the ID of the catalogs.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Service Categories view.-Search for the service category ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service catalog).-Edit the service category ID XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Catalog Structure tab.-Select a line and then choose the Change Status button and select Release.-Error occurs: Conflict between catalog XYZ (version 1) and catalog ABC (version 1). There is a usage conflict between the specified catalogs. Therefore you cannot release this catalog (XYZ and ABC represents the ID of the catalogs).-Cause-The error message is raised due to the overlapping of the validity dates of the category ABC & other categories.--For the category ABC -> You have selected the validity date range as 01.01.2012 - 31.12.9999.-Now if you try to release any other service category with the above range, the system will throw error message due to overlap.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the system. Additionally, if you intend to create more than one category then it is advisable not to keep valid to date unlimited (i.e. XX-YY-9999).--Catalogs that have already been released and are in use cannot be deleted or modified. To remove the catalog from use, create a new version of the catalog, limit the valid-to date to todays's date, and release it.-See Also-For C4C, Kindly refer the SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer Administrator Guide - Configurin Service Categories  for more details.-Keywords-Service Catalog, Service Catalogue, Release, Activate

Title: Error: Maximum length reached for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are activating your custom solution in Cloud Application Studio and receive the following error message:-"Maximum length reached for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'"-"Delete extension/KUT fields from other PDI solution for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'" (ABC refers to name of Standard BO, and DEF refers to the node under standard BO)-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer  -Reproducing the Issue-As a prerequisite you have previously:-Created a custom add-on in Cloud Application Studio.-Created an extension of standard Business Object (.xbo).-Created an extension fields under some BO-Node combination.-Attempted to activate your solution.-Cause-Error message points clearly that the memory allocated for the extension fields under specific BO-Node combination have been exceeded. System acts and behaves differently for both Custom Bo's and Standard Bo's:-Custom BO's: each custom node in every tenant and every solution has its own persistency table. Each node have limit of 15000 bytes of memory.-Standard BO's: all tenants share the same DB table for each node, so 15000 bytes is a shared limit across tenants. Once this limit is crossed the persistency table of the BO becomes inconsistent, making it unusable . In order to prevent this situation PDI framework runs series of checks during activation/deployment/patch creation etc. The below mentioned error is thrown when limit of 15000 bytes have been exceeded.-Pay attention to error message:-"Delete extension/KUT fields from other PDI solution for BO 'ABC' node 'DEF'-System directly suggest that you are already utilizing shared limit for specific BO-Node in other solution. This means that allocated memory for current Add-on is reduced by what you are already consuming.-NOTE: allocated memory depends on datatype given for each extension field.-Resolution-The customer/partner could see the extension field usage and calculate the required length by following the steps below.-Go to Administrator work center-Open General Settings-Open Extension Field Usage-There you will see the following information: Business object, number of fields created, allowed number of fields (remaining fields to create), aggregate length and aggregate length allowed (remaining size)-Change the drop downlist to extension field -You can filter the fields by using BO name and Node name -In order to check what is the exact amount of consumed memory, you can debug the solution activation by using KBA  3115582 - How to Check the Extension Field Number Limit?:-There are few solutions which can be applied:-Scenario 1.-You request a customer/partner to delete a list of redundant KUT fields. Fields must be deleted in each BO-Node combination listed in the error message.-Scenario 2.-If the tenant is Cloud for Customer, you request a customer/partner to create the deletion patch to delete a list of redundant PDI field. Fields must be deleted in each BO-Node combination listed in the error message. If the deleted extension exists in the original solution, please kindly upload the patch to the original solution also. -Scenario 3.-If the tenant is Business ByDesign, you request a customer/partner to provide a list of redundant fields which can be deleted by SAP (AP-RC-BDS-BO). Fields must be deleted in each BO-Node combination listed in the error message.-You verify, that the fields provided are enough to go below the limit, which allows activation/assemble/deployment of solution. If this is not the case, you request a partner/customer to provide more fields.-Once sufficient amount of fields can be deleted, you provide a list of files in which those fields are used and send the incident back to the customer/partner for final confirmation.-Upon receiving final confirmation, SAP (AP-RC-BDS-BO) deletes fields from the backend, assemble the solution, and create active and edible patch for the partner. -Depending on the scenario chosen you need to make sure both SAP developers, and a customer are on the same page in terms of which tasks to handle (deployment/activation/assemble). Please make sure you have clear structured plan in place which is well communicated to both sides. -See Also-2823480 - Check Limit of Fields Per Business Object-3115582 - How to Check the Extension Field Number Limit?-Keywords-Extension fields, Limit Exeeded, Extention BO

Title: Unmarked for Final Clearing Purchasing Document is Still Processed by the GR/IR Clearing Run
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order, whose delivery and invoice are completed and you unmarked it from final clearing. Nevertheless, the GR/IR run still picks it up to clear the Unbilled Payables and Purchase In Transit account. You do not expect to have this purchasing document cleared by the run, since you have unmarked it from final clearing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Purchasing Document Items view.-Find the relevant purchase order to be cleared (with a Marked Final Clearing Date set).-Click Final Clearing -> Unmark.-In this case, the delivered quantity and the invoiced quantity are equal or exceed the ordered quantity. However, you wish to prevent this purchasing document from being processed by the GR/IR Clearing Run, since you unmarked it in step 4 above.-Go to GR/IR Clearing run view.-Execute a new GR/IR run for this purchasing document.-You notice that the document is processed by the run and it ends up creating postings and clearing the Purchase In Transit and Unbilled Payable G/L Accounts.-Cause-Whenever the delivered quantity and invoiced quantity are equal or exceed the ordered quantity and you unmark the purchasing document from final clearing, the GR/IR Clearing run will still process this document and clear the quantities that are equal to the ordered amount. However, the extra delivered items would remaind open for clearing instead of posted to a differences account.-For example:-Ordered quantity: 5 ea.-Delivered quantity: 7 ea.-Invoiced quantity: 5 ea.-Since delivered and invoiced quantity are equal or exceeds the ordered quantity, the system marks this purchasing document item for final clearing and assigns a final clearing date.-If you execute the GR/IR Clearing, the run considers a clearing quantity of 7 ea and posts the 2 ea difference to an offsetting account. It also clears Purchase In Transit and Unbilled Payable accounts accordingly.-If you unmark this purchasing document via Final Clearing -> Unmark and execute the GR/IR Clearing, the run will process this document with a clearing quantity reference of 5 ea (ordered quantity) and clears the Purchase In Transit and Unbilled Payables accordingly. The 2 ea difference is not yet accounted for clearing and no differences postings happens yet.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. Whenever the delivered and invoiced quantity are equal or exceeds the ordered quantity, the system will consider the purchasing document in the GR/IR run and will clear the unbilled payables and purchase in transit accounts. With the Unmark option, you can define if the exceeded quantity will be treated as a difference and posted to an offsetting account now or, in case unmarked, cleared in a future run as you know that the supplier will send an additional invoice for the extra pieces later.-For more details, please refer to help document Marked Final Clearing Date for Purchasing Document Items-Keywords-Inventory Valuation. GR/IR Clearing Run. Purchase order. Inbound Delivery. Supplier Invoice.

Title: Sales Kits Are Not Supported in Point-of-Sales Transactions
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Point-of-Sale Transaction with a Sales Kit item, however, this is not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-You create a Sales Transaction via the web service PointOfSaleTransactionProcessingPointOfSaleTransactionIn using a Sales Kit.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Point-of-Sale Transactions view and the Sales Transactions sub view.-The newly created Sales Transaction is in status Inconsistent. -Click on the Check button-The following errors are displayed:-Sales Item XY - A:  Type of product  not valid (where XY is the ID of the Sales Transaction and A the line item).-Sales Item XY - A:  The product ABC has the logistics status Initial or In Preparation (where ABC is the ID of the Sales Kit).-Sales Item XY - A:  The product ABC in the planning area XYZ has the planning status Initial or In Preparation (where XYZ is the ID of Planning Area).-Cause-The PointOfSaleTransactionProcessingPointOfSaleTransactionIn, when you create a Point Of Sales Transaction (Inventory Material), it's necessary to pass Site ID and Logisticas Area ID. So, for a Sales Kit this would not be possible, because the sub items could have different LogisticsAreaID. -Resolution-As a possible solution for this scenario, you can add each sub item of Sales Kit seperately to the POS (Point-Of-Sales) transaction.-Keywords-Point-Of-Sales ; Sales Kit ; POS ; Sales Transaction; Type of product  not valid; Kit; IS-SE-CCO; SAP Customer Checkout

Title: Save not possible. A rule already exists for company/org unit
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to assign a Form Template to a Company you will get the mentioned error:-Save not possible; a rule already exists for company/org unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management and select Master Template Maintenance.-Choose Form master template.-Select the required template.-Click on "Assign" and choose the company ID.-Click on Save and close.-You will get the error message: Save not possible; a rule already exists for company/org unit.-Cause-This is because the Company/ Org Unit is already assigned to a Form Master Template.-Resolution-You need to check the relevant Master Template and re-assign the Company ID accordingly.-If there are no rules assigned and you keep receiving the error message, please open an incident to SAP support.-Keywords-A rule already exists for company/org unit, Org Unit,

Title: Inventory Migration Error - Inventory Relevance Setting Missing in Location Hierarchy - Permanent Establishment Not Determined - Material Not Valid
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate your Inventory details via Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity. You receive the below error messages when you execute the Process File button.-'Inventory relevance setting missing in location hierarchy.'-'Permanent establishment not determined.'-'Material not valid.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view, select the relevant Project and choose the button Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend tab and search for the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Select the activity and press Open.-Select the Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool link.-In the Migrate Accounting Transaction Data screen select the relevant file and press Execute Migration button.-Select Migration Object Inventory and press Process File.-System will display above mentioned error messages.-Cause-The logistics area under the site for which you are migrating the inventory details is not active. It is in status In Preparation and therefore not available for Inventory data migration.-Resolution-To activate the Logistics Area:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data workcenter and navigate to the Locations view.-Select the relevant Site and choose Edit Layout.-In the Site Layout screen, select the relevant Logistics Area, press Change Status and select Activate.-Save and Close the page.-Once the above mentioned settings are performed, the Inventory migration file can be processed and migrated.-Keywords-Inventory; Migration; Site; Logistics Area

Title: GDT of Data Field Does Not Exist in Namespace
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-** FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY **-You are handling an incident where Partner is facing a dump when accessing a Custom View or trying to access a Standard View that contains a Custom View. Looking further on Transaction ST22 logs you can find under the section Application Information the log:-"Info: GDT of data field /Root/SubNode/Datafield does not exist in namespace".-Where "/Root/SubNode/Datafield" stands for the path of the Data Field on UI Designer.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login on system.-Navigate between Work Center and View.-System raise dump message.-Login on Backend.-Go to backend transaction ST22.-Open the logs for the dump.-Go to section Application Information and you found a log similar to:-"Info: GDT  of data field /Root/SubNode/Datafield does not exist in namespace"-Cause-SAP provides a functionality called Field Transformation that allow that Data fields be directly filled by an ABSL Script without bound it to an Element. This way a field could show that the return value of a Custom Reuse Library created with SAP Cloud Application Studio or provided by SAP. To work with that, the Data Field should be set as Dedicated Field and in this condition the Data Field properties have a new section called Dedicated Field Settings where some properties should be maintained. The dump faced is regarding the GDT (GDT stands for Global Data Type) information missing for the Data Field. Partner should always maintained a proper value on the properties GDT Namespace and GDT Type that tells system which type of data is expected to be shown on that field.-UI Designer properties:-Resolution-Login on SDK.-Open Solution YABC1234_ (YABC1234_ stands for the ID of the Solution).-Open UI Designer.-Open Custom View.-Go to tab DataModel.-Find the Data Field mentioned on the ST22 transaction log and click on it.-Click on tab Properties-Under section Dedicated Field Settings, check if the properties "GDT Namespace" and "GDT Type" are properly configured.-If not, ask partner to properly configure these properties. If yes, you will need to check it further.-Keywords-Dedicated, Field, Transformation, UI, dump, Data, GDT, Type, Namespace

Title: Check Deposit Slip Missing In The Document Output History Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the 'Document Output History [/DOC/OMDORB01_RPF_01]' report and when checking results, you cannot see results for 'Check Deposit Slip' business document type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Search for the 'Document Output History' report.-Open and run it. -You cannot see results for 'Check Deposit Slip' business document type.-Cause-The 'Check Deposit Slip' business document type is not supported by the 'Document Output History [/DOC/OMDORB01_RPF_01]' report. There are some document types which are not supported by the report and therefore these documents will not be available within report results. It occurs due some technical designing of the data source as well as the architecture storage of the document within backend.-Resolution-These are the business document types supported by the 'Document Output History [/DOC/OMDORB01_RPF_01]' report:-Advanced Shipping Notification-Balance Confirmation-Canceled Purchase Order-Changed Purchase Order-Confirmation Notification-Created Purchase Order-Customer Contract-Customer Invoice-Customer Return-Delivery Note-Down Payment Request-Dunning Letter-ERS Invoice-Inbound Delivery Notification-Incoming check receipt-Invoice Request-Journal Entry Report-Order to Service Performer-Petty Cash Receipt-Purchase Order Reminder Letter-Remittance Advice-Sales Order-Sales Quote-Service Order-Service Request-Summary Invoice Form-Tax Return-Third Party Logistics Outbound Request-Unified Reporting Israel-See Also-Document Output History-Keywords-document output history, check document split, output report, document history report, /DOC/OMDORB01_RPF_01

Title: Mandatory Property for An Extension Field Set From KUT is Not Working
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer has reported that an extension field set as mandatory is not being respected by application: even if left blank, the creation/change of a record is still saved successfully.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the UI screen where the extension field has been created.-Start Adaptation Mode.-Navigate to the relevant field's properties.-Check the box for option Set Mandatory.-Save and publish the changes.-Now open the screen again in Edit mode and Save without filling the mandatory field.-The record gets saved successfully without any error.-Cause-The reason for the mandatory property being ignored is that there are mandatory post conditions created by partners on the reported fields.-You can verify this in the UI Designer of the respective screen.-Right-click on the relevant field the extension field.-Navigate to Select, then click FieldGroup.-On the right-side panel, in the Extensibility Explorer tab, click the arrow next to Adjust Properties.-Here, you will set listed some Change Transactions (CTs) of type AddConditions which have been created for the field.-Download the XML of the CTs by clicking the XML button next to them.-Check the User tag in the XML to see who created them.-Resolution-You will have to remove the CTs created by the partner to set the mandatory property using Key User Tools.-Keywords-Mandatory, Field, Extension Field, Ignored, Save, Blank

Title: Query Service Confirmation Using SelectionByUUID Not Working
Content: Symptom-You are querying Service Confirmation documents using SelectionByUUID, however, the system is not reverting the expected data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-To query Service Confirmations, it is required to pass both SelectionByID and SelectionByUUID as SelectionByID  is mapped to ID and SelectionByUUID is mapped to UUID field of the business object.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Please pass both SelectionByID and SelectionByUUID tags.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Query, SelectionByID, SelectionByUUID

Title: Error While Activating the Solution: Field at Business Object, Node does not Exist
Content: Symptom-The below error is occurring when trying to upload a PDI solution into a target tenant:-Field ZField at business object PQR, node XYZ does not exist (Where ZField is a field name created from adaptation mode (KUT); PQR is the name of the business object and XYZ is the node name)-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Studio of a target tenant.-Open the solution.-Upload the patch version downloaded from the source tenant.-Upload is complete but the activation failed with the mentioned error.-Cause-This error is due to the field in source tenant has one extra persistency compared to the target system.-Resolution-You will have to extend the attribute (field) to the business object (PQR) and node (XYZ) mentioned in the error message. You can do this from Field Definition (Edit Field) screen.-Login to the frontend UI of the target tenant.-Navigate to the screen where the BO belongs to.-Edit Master Layout.-Hover on any field and click on settings icon.-You can see the field definition.-You can search and find the relevant field and add to the BO.-Keywords-Solution, activation, failed, Node, does, not, exist, while, activating, the, solution

Title: SAP Cloud Print Manager on their Horizon/VMware Server
Content: Symptom-Installation of the SAP Cloud Print Manager on SAP Cloud Print Manager on their Horizon/VMware Server, VM ware-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for customer-Cause-The SAP Cloud Print Manager is a Windows Server application.-The setup on VM-Ware should work but it is not supported from SAP Side.-Resolution-Look into the system requirements as the Perquisites which you can find in the CPM under the Tab. Help.-Keywords-VM-Ware, Virtual machines,

Title: Broadcast Logs have Missing, Incomplete or Incorrect Information
Content: Symptom-The logs for some broadcasts are missing, incomplete or have incorrect information about delivery or recipients. This happens in both the Last Broadcast Run tab and the View Log details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Choose the view Broadcasts.-Mark a broadcast and either select View Log or check the Last Broadcast Run tab underneath the broadcast table.-You notice that some logs are missing, incomplete or have incorrect information. This can happen for only one or a few recipients. For example:-The broadcast resulted in an error (orange symbol), however no error details are shown.-The broadcast was successful (green symbol), but no confirmation is shown that it was delivered.-The broadcast Log details have incorrect information about delivery or recipients.-Cause-This behavior can happen in the following circumstances:-Several broadcasts are created by the same user.-Several broadcasts are scheduled to run at the same time.-The broadcasts that fulfill these conditions share the same log number. This is the reason for the logs becoming inconsistent.-Resolution-To avoid this issue, please change the schedule of one of the broadcasts so that it starts at a different time. This will change the log number and the issue will not occur.-Keywords-Broadcasts logs Missing, Broadcasts, Missing, Missing Broadcasts, Incorrect, Incorrect Logs, Logs, Incorrect Information, Incomplete Information, Incomplete, Missing Information.-empty,logs wrong

Title: Enter Products/Services the Account is Entitled to for This Contract Item
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform the migration of a Customer Contract which has Entitlements related to it, however, you are facing the following message: Enter products/services the account is entitled to for this contract item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview work center view.-Search and open fine-tuning activity Migration of Customer Contracts.-Click the link to Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool.-In the new screen, select file ABC (ABC represents the ID of the file you are using).-Click the Execute Migration, then select Execute Migration Step by Step.-Message is displayed in the log for step 3 - Simulate Import-Cause-In the migration template the sub tab Entitled Products for Entitlements is not available.-For entitlements, the Customer Contract expects the list of the products or product categories contained in the entitlement item to which the account is privileged (in the Entitled Products tab of the Customer Contract).-Since the entitled products cannot be included in the migration, the warning message occurs.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-The Customer Contract can still be migrated but the Entitled Product(s) have to be manually maintained in the Customer Contract after the migration is finished.-Keywords-Customer Contract, Migration, Entitlement, Entitled, Products, Services, Account, Item

Title: Migrated Contract From Extracted File has Different Start and End Dates
Content: Symptom-You have extracted Customer Contracts from the system and when performing a migration of this Contract, the Start and End Dates differ between contracts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Search for ID ABC and XYZ (ABC and XYZ represents the ID of the migrated Contract).-Open Contract ABC and XYZ.-You see that Start and End Date differ between contracts.-Cause-The data extraction pulls the data from the backend and the values in the backend are stored in UTC.-The migration service takes the date that is entered in the migration file for the contract start date and considers this date to be associated with the logged in user's timezone-Example:-Logged user's timezone is CET. The service then converts this date to UTC and stores that converted timestamp in the backend. When you open the migrated contract on the UI, you will see the same date that was present in the migration file because the UI converts the UTC timestamp from the backend to the logged in user's timezone. This implementation ensures that we always maintain the date that was entered in the migration template.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To solve the scenario, you will need to do an additional conversion step after the data extraction and before migration.-This can possibly be performed via an add-on, where you can convert the UTC timestamp in the data extraction file to the timezone in which the contracts were created, and then migrate the data.-See Also-1984439 - Migrated Contracts Have Different Contract Date or Time Than in The Migration Template-Keywords-Migration, Contract, Start, End, Date, Timezone, UTC, Data Extraction

Title: Unable to Hide Fields in Petty Cash Screen While Using Tile View
Content: Symptom-You are unable to hide/unhide fields in Petty Cash screen (either in Liquidity Management or Payment Management work centers) while using Tile view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2111 Release-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management or Payment Management work center.-Go to the Petty Cash view.-Click the Tile View icon.-On top of the screen, right-hand side, click the User icon and Start Personalization Mode.-Notice that no fields are displayed (No data message) hence you cannot hide/unhide fields.-Cause-Currently, it's not possible to personalize/adapt fields in the Tile View in Petty Cash screen.-Resolution-To hide/unhide fields in Petty Cash screen you can use the List View instead of Tile View.-Keywords-petty cash; tile view; list view; hide; unhide; personalization; adaptation

Title: Error in Report Transfer: Source Variable Not Valid for Report
Content: Symptom-When uploading a report to a system, you receive the following error:-Source variable not valid for report-This error can also appear in other scenarios, such as when trying to delete a report etc.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to the source system.-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Common Tasks.-Go to Download and download the respective report on to your local drive.-Log on to the target system.-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Common Tasks.-Go to Upload.-Select the downloaded file and click Save.-You get the mentioned error.-Cause-The report you are transferring contains report navigations which are inconsistent. This can happen in various circumstances, for example when a report navigation is created first and some variables are transferred. However later, the report and the variables are edited.-Resolution-Please edit the report navigations and adjust any inconsistencies.-Keywords-Source variable not valid for report, report upload, transport management, business analytics, common tasks, PARA_

Title: Error: No WSDL for service ABC available when downloading WSDL in a Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-You cannot download the WSDL file in a communication arrangement in C4C (Cloud for Customer) and SAP Business ByDesign due to an error:-No WSDL for service ABC available (where ABC represents the service).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Administrator work center.-Open the Communication Arrangements view.-Open the relevant communication arrangement.-Select the service.-Click on the button Download WSDL.-Result: an error message occurs and the download does not take place.-Cause-The service and its process components are not part of the Business Configuration.-To be able to download the WSDL, the related process should be scoped.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select the project and click on the button Edit Project Scope.-Put the relevant node in Scope.-Reach the Questions stage, find the relevant element and select the In Scope checkbox.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, fail, error; ByD; WSDL;

Title: Error updating extui app name in WOC file
Content: Symptom-The below errors prevents your add-on from being activated on the SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-Error updating extui app name in WOC file for/YABCDEFGY_MAIN/SRC/WSAuth.wsauth-File /YABCDEFGY_MAIN/SRC/WSAuthView.WCVIEW.uiwocview is not found in layer strategy YABCDEFGY_DEV-File /YABCDEFGY_MAIN/SRC/WSAuthView.WCVIEW.uiwocview does not exist-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Studio.-Open the affected solution.-Right click on the solution name and select Activate -> All Items.-Cause-The error happens because the affected .uiwocview file which is deleted is still being referenced on the .wsauth file.-Resolution-A new work center view will need to be assigned to the .wsauth.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Error, updating, extui, app, name, in, WOC, file

Title: Tax Event Has Been Determined in Journal Entry, but Tax Code is Missing From Source Document
Content: Symptom-You have posted a journal entry voucher for a e.g. customer invoice and see that a tax event and tax rate were applied, even though there is no tax code being shown in the corresponding invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Open the respective invoice.-The following warning message is raised: 'Determination of tax code failed'-Go to Items tab.-Go to Taxes.-You see that no product tax code is determined.-Go to Document Flow tab.-Open the corresponding journal entry.-Check the tax lines and see, under details, tax a corresponding tax event and tax rate are determined.-Cause-The corresponding tax code that would be used by the system had it's Valid To date set by a user and is no longer valid.-To check the tax code validity, proceed as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list. -Open activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Click Define Tax Codes.-Filter the list by country and tax event that has been applied in the above mentioned journal entry.-You see that the tax codes mapped to the applied tax event are no longer valid. Both Tax Event and Tax Code have their own validity period, Tax Event is valid but Tax Code is not valid at the time of invoice creation so the system is not able to determine the tax code.-Resolution-It is recommended to keep a valid tax code mapped to the concerned tax event. This prevents the cases where a tax event is applied without a tax code.-The tax code validity can be maintained via the steps mentioned in the above section. The corresponding validity of a tax event cannot be modified via user interface. These Tax Events are linked to Tax Return submission forms, which are subjected to very precise legal requirements, hence no customizations or modifications are available via user interface.-If you consider that a tax event is no longer valid, please raise an incident to support informing the corresponding tax event, country and the legal requirement notice informing about it's expiratory.-Keywords-Tax Event. Invoice. Tax Code. Tax Return. Customer Invoice. Supplier Invoice. Project Invoice Request. Sales Order. Journal Entry.

Title: Migrated Sales Order Doesn't Have the Invoice Schedule or Milestones
Content: Symptom- Migrated Sales Order have no Milestones or Invoice Schedules.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Search for the Sales' Order ID.-Navigate to Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Navigate to Invoice Schedule subtab.-You can see that there is no Invoice Schedule maintained for this document.-Cause-The causing of this behavior is how the Migration File was set up. In the template the 'To Be Scheduled Item' tab was left empty, causing the Invoice Schedule to not be created.-Resolution-When migrating a Sales Order with an Invoice Schedule, the 'To Be Scheduled Item' tab needs to me maintained with the Milestones, regardless of whether you are using 'Items Individual Dates' or 'Recurrence Details'. So you need to fill this tab in the template with the data that matches the content in 'Item Individuals Date', but without a recurrence ID for these items.-Keywords-Sales Order. Invoice Schedule. Milestone. Migration of Sales Order.

Title: Error Message: System Failure When Migrate Open Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate Open Sales Orders through Migration Tool, but you are facing the error message below:-"System Failure When Migration Open Sales Orders"-Environment-SAP BUsiness ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center, in the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Open Sales Orders.-Click on Migrate Open Sales Orders using the migration tool.-Execute migration step by step for the required file.-In the simulation step, you will see the mentioned error.-Cause-In the migration file, you are using an item of type service fixed price (project). For project based items, we consider these items in the pricing framework to have a code of 7CEP.-This means that the price details will be determined in the system and not used as the migrated price.-In your scenario, you have a discount on this item which changes the value from 1100 to 880. The value that is then in the invoice schedule item is 1100 in the migration template.---- Migration template:-- Item: 1100 e.g.-- Invoice Schedule: 1100 e.g.-- Item Type: Service fixed price (project).--- Determination in process for the UI:-- Item: List price of 1100 e.g.-- Net Value of 880. e.g.-- Invoice schedule value: 1100 e.g.-As the net value of the item is less than the invoice schedule, we do not allow this.-As a workaround for this issue, if you remove the Value in the invoice schedule section in the migration template, and you add a Percentage value e.g., 100. then this will take the value that is determined by the system later on as 880.-Resolution-The issue is currently the behavior of the system in terms of the setup that is in the migration file.-Keywords-Open Sales Orders; Migration; Error Message;

Title: How To Maintain Data for Account Assignment CUSTOM_OBJECT1_ID - CustomObject1ID
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to maintain data for account assignment "CUSTOM_OBJECT1_ID - CustomObject1ID", which is available in fine tuning activity Account Assignment Types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Account Assignment Types.-Select an Account Assignment Type, for example CC - Cost Center.-Under Available Account Assignments tab, click Add Row.-Enter account assignment CUSTOM_OBJECT1_ID - CustomObject1ID.-You are wondering how to maintain values for CustomObject1ID.-Resolution-The Custom Object ID is filled via Business Object /ISCB/CUSTOM_OBJECT_1. This BO is PSM released and this needs to be filled by you/your partner using an add-on solution.-In other words, you/your partner need to create an instance using a PDI Solution UI on top of BO '/ISCB/CUSTOM_OBJECT_1'.-Keywords- account assignment type; account assignment; CUSTOM_OBJECT1_ID; CustomObject1ID; /ISCB/CUSTOM_OBJECT_1

Title: Blank Screen After Closing Approval Task Navigated From E-mail
Content: Symptom-You received an e-mail to perform an approval in SAP Business ByDesign.-You click on the e-mail link to execute the activity, then you are directly routed to the Task Approval screen. There you execute the activity according to your need and after clicking on the "X" button to close the Task Approval screen you are left with just a white screen and is not navigated into SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-From approval e-mail click on the hyperlink to perform the approval.-On the Task approval screen execute the activity according to your need.-Click on the "X" button to close the task approval screen.-You are left with just a white page. -Cause-When you navigate from within an e-mail via the deep link, you are routed directly to the task approval screen and only that screen session is loaded in the process. The other workcenters are not loaded.-Resolution-This is working as intended, as navigation from e-mail deeplink is to perform one-time only activity in the system.-If you wish this to be changed an alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence to submit an idea.-Keywords-White Screen; Blank Screen; Empty Screen; Page; Close; Finish; Task; Approval; Browser; Interface; E-mail; Email; Deeplink;

Title: Employee Responsible is not Copied Using Follow Up Button from Opportunity to Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-Employee Responsible is not copied from opportunity into the sales quote. The same is applicable also from quote to order follow up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business Work center.-Select the  Opportunities view-Search for the Opportunity ABC  (ABC represents the ID of the Opportunity).-Select the Opportunity ABC.-Click in the button Follow -Up and select  Sales Quote.-You will see that Employee Responsible is not the same as the previous document-Cause-Due to the Involved Parties for Sales Quote you maintained in Business Configuration, system will check the rules and determine the Employee Responsible again in the sales quote.-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.- To check the determination rules, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-In the search field, put Involved Parties for Sales Quotes.-Select Employee Responsible and click Maintain Determination. Here you can see the active rules how the employee responsible determined in your system.-See Also-1436885 - How to determine 'Employee Responsible' in a Sales Quote-1435056 - How to determine 'Employee Responsible' in a Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Quote; Follow Up; Follow-Up; Employee Responsible; determination; Rules; Copy

Title: Collaboration Window "Server 500 Error" while login
Content: Symptom-You are trying to logon to the SAP Collaboration Window and you are getting a "Server 500 Error."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to the Collaboration Window and wait for the error.-Cause-Due to  TLS 1.2 additional entries in the registry might be required.-Resolution-If you are unsure please contact your IT department to make those entries into the Windows registry:-Mistakes can mess up your OS System easily.-Execute the windows command: regedit-follow the steps below.-First entry:-Key: Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\.NETFramework\v4.0.30319 Value: SchUseStrongCrypto Type: REG_DWORD 32 bit Data: 1-Second entry:-Key:Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\.NETFramework\v4.0.30319 Value: SchUseStrongCrypto Type: REG_DWORD 32 bit Data: 1-Keywords-Collaboration Window, server 500 error.

Title: Cannot Find the Form 1099-MISC Copy A
Content: Symptom-You want to perform an electronic submission of the 1099-MISC Copy A to the IRS, however you cannot find it on the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-System currently supports the Tax Return Types 1099-MISC FormB, which produces the form Copy B separately for each supplier, 1099-MISC File, which produces a text file formatted for sending data to IRS and Non Employee Compensation 1099-NEC.-Resolution-To be able to use the Tax Return Type 1099-MISC File you need to perform following configuration:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities > Tax Authorities view.-Search for the corresponding Tax Authority.-Click button Edit and then select Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Go to the Tax Return Arrangements Tab.-Add a row for the Tax Return Type 2 - Miscellaneous Income (1099 Misc) - File.-Once the above setup is finished, you should be able to select it during the Tax Return Run creation.--Note: The Tax Return Type 1099-MISC File is available only for Electronic Submission, the system does not support the Print Form.-See Also-You can refer to help document Withholding Tax Returns Quick Guide — US available on the Help Center for more details.-Keywords-1099; MISC; FormB; File; Miscellaneous Income; Electronic Submission; Print Form Required;

Title: Unable to Maintain Payment Method 'Bill of Exchange Receivables Sole Bill' in Account Master Data
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the Payment Method 'Bill of Exchange Receivables Sole Bill' in the Master Data of Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select the relevant Account.-Click Edit -> Financial Data.-Go to the Payment Data sub-tab.-Under Payment Methods, click Add Row.-You expected to find the Payment Method 'Bill of Exchange Receivables Sole Bill', however this is not available.-Cause-The Payment Methoed 'Bill of Exchange Receivables Sole Bill' cannot be maintained on Business Partner level.-On Business Partner level it is only possible to maintain the following Payment Methods related to BOE:-BOE - Receivable with Acceptance -BOE - Receivable without Acceptance-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-The Payment Method 'Bill of Exchange Receivables Sole Bill' can be seen and used from the Payment Monitor in either Liquidity Management or Payment Management work center.-Keywords-Bill of Exchange, Receivables Sole Bill, Payment Method, Account Master Data

Title: External Payment is Not Copied to New Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are using External Payment as payment method in a Sales Order which was created inconsistently. You expect the payment method to be copied into the new Sales Order when using the Copy button, but External Payment method is not taken into the new document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Document is still In Preparation status.-Select the document.-Click Copy button.-In the new document navigate to the General tab.-Scroll down to Payment.-You see that the Payment Method, along with the other external information is not copied to the document.-Cause-The External Payment is not supported for the copy action of Sales Order.-Resolution-This is expected behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.-See Also-3000720 - Error message: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service XYZ and set of books AAA valid on DD/MM/YYYY is missing-3096404 - Deletion not Allowed due to External Payment-Keywords-Sales Order, External Payment, Copy, Web Service, In Preparation, New

Title: No Journal Entry Created for a Paid By Company Expense
Content: Symptom-You have created an expense report with expenses that are paid by company, however, after submitting and approving successfully the expense report, no journal entry is created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense reports view. -Open the related expense report.-Go to Document Flow tab.-You see that no journal entry is created. You also notice that the expense report neither has landed as an unposted source document nor there is a process communication error associated.-Cause-The expenses in this expense report are paid by company, however the account determination group associated for expense posting and for offsetting posting is the same. Therefore, the debit and credit lines would derive the same G/L Account for the same amount posting. Hence, no journal entry is created.-In order to check the account determination groups maintained for the expenses, proceed as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Expense Reporting - <country>-Click Edit expense types.-Find the expense type being used in the report.-Click tab Account Determination.-You see that the account determination group maintained for Expense Account and Offsetting Account for Paid Expenses are the same. In this case, the Expense Account is taken for debit line in the journal entry and the Offsetting Account for Paid Expenses is taken for credit in the journal entry.-Therefore, if both are identical, i.e. credit = debit, neither an expense item nor a paid invoice expense item are created. Consequently, no message to accounting is sent and no journal entry is created for this expense report.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. If you wish to have journal entry postings for company paid expenses, the associated account determination group for Expense Account and for Offsetting Account for Paid Expenses must be different.-Keywords-Expense Report. Create Expense Report on Behalf Of. Account Determination. Expense Arrangement. Reimbursement. Settlement. Journal Entry.

Title: How Tax Jurisdiction Codes Define the Tax Calculation for Sales Orders Items
Content: Symptom-How does tax jurisdiction codes define the tax calculation for sales order items based on ship-to address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In a sales order with multiple items and multiple ship-to addresses, the tax for each item includes jurisdiction taxes based on the ship-to address.-Depending on the tax jurisdiction codes maintained in your system you can face unexpected taxes included for a given address.-To verify the applied taxes for a sales order item follow the steps below:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open the respective sales order.-Select the View All button and navigate to the Items tab.-In the Details tab you can see the ship-to address for the item.-Select Taxes tab and you will see Tax Determination and Tax Details.-Cause-In Business ByDesign, tax jurisdiction codes are defined by a hierarchical pattern.-The tax jurisdiction code consists of the pattern "2,6,6,1". Each part of this pattern represents a level:-The first 2 characters are level 1 (standard state code)-The next 6 characters are level 2 (country)-The next 6 characters are level 3 (city or local level)-The last 1 character is level 4 (local or district)-The length of a jurisdiction code will define the number of levels to be considered during the tax calculation.-Resolution-During the creation of a tax jurisdiction code, you must consider the number of levels to be included in the tax calculations.-For instance, if you need a tax jurisdiction code to include two levels (state and country level), follow the required pattern including 8 characters and then assign the relevant addresses to this jurisdiction code.-To create/change a tax jurisdiction code, follow the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your current implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Select the Fine-Tune phase and open the Tax on Goods and Services activity.-Select the hyperlink Define Tax Jurisdictions to edit or create tax jurisdiction codes.-Note that if you change or delete a jurisdiction code already in use, this jurisdiction code will not be available to assignment to any document or item. However, items or documents that used this jurisdiction code in the past will maintain the taxes previously calculated.-  Keywords-Jurisdiction; State level; State Code; Country code; City code; Local code; District Code; Tax Code;Tax Jurisdiction; does not exist;

Title: Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher Only Allows Selection of Tax Codes From Leading Company's Country
Content: Symptom-When creating an Intercompany Journal Entry Voucher, when two companies from different countries are added, it is only possible to select Tax Codes for the same country as the Leading Company.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Intercompany Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Click on the New button, then select IC Journal Entry Voucher.-Click on the Add Row button.-Add a company from a different country than Leading Company.-For the second company, expand the dropdown menu from the Tax Code field.-System shows only Tax Codes for the same country as Leading Company.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. The overall idea behind documents that facilitate the posting of Receivables and Payables, in this case the IC Journal Entry Voucher, is to have the prima nota (i.e. Source Document) only be posted in leading the company.-For taxes it is expected that the use cases are simple and hence only taxes for one country are supported, in this case, the Leading Company.-Resolution-As a workaround for this scenario, Create a Customer and also Supplier Invoices between partner companies. This provides full flexibility and also enables taxes to be posted accordingly.-Keywords- IC Journal Entry Voucher, intercompany, Tax Code, Leading Company

Title: How Meals Per Diem Deductions are Calculated in Germany
Content: Symptom-You have created an expense report for a two day trip with lodging within Germany. Some of the meals have been marked as free meals, hence you expect the corresponding deduction to happen. However, the amount to be reimbursed to the employee with regard to the meals per diem calculation is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Reports view.-Open the respective expense report.-Go to General tab.-Click Deduct Free Meals.-See that for each day some free meals have been marked, for example:-Day 1 -> dinner is flagged as free meal.-Day 2 -> breakfast and lunch flagged as free meal.-Go to Review tab.-Refer to the amount to be reimbursed related to meals per diem.-The amount is not as expected considering the current per diem rates and deductions due to free meals. You would like to understand how the deductions are calculated.-Resolution-The applicable meals per diem rates and corresponding deduction amounts due to free meals can be checked in business configuration activity 'Per Diem Rates for Meals - Germany'.-As an illustration, let's assume a per diem rate of 14 EUR or this trip and deduction rates of 20% for breakfast, 40% for lunch and 40% for dinner.-According to the legal German settlement of per diems and deductions, the amount of deductions is calculated based on the highest rate in Germany (= 28 EUR), which leads to a deduction of 5.60 EUR per breakfast and 11.20 EUR per lunch / dinner.-However, these deductions are subtracted day wise from the real rate per day (14 EUR for a two-day trip) and not from the cumulated sum over all days. Considering the example mentioned in the above section, that means:-Day 1 -> 14 EUR - 11.20 EUR per Dinner = 2.80 EUR-Day 2 -> 14 EUR - 11.20 EUR per Lunch - 5.60 EUR per breakfast = 0 (and not -2.80).-Since you cannot get more deducted as you get paid per day, the maximum deduction for this day is the whole daily rate of 14 EUR.-Therefore, for this example, the total meals per diem reimbursement amount in the Review tab is 2.80 EUR.-See Also-2468345 - Per Diem Rates for Meals - Germany is Calculated Differently-Keywords-Expense Report. Settlement. Reimbursement Amount. Meals Per Diem.

Title: Payment Allocation Does not Automatically Allocate an Invoice Based on Rules to Analyze Memo Lines
Content: Symptom-You have set up rules to analyze memo lines. Even though the rule you have created can correctly derive the document's external reference from the memo line, the assignment does not happen automatically in the payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Open the respective payment allocation.-Under Memo Line, click Edit Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines.-On the screen that opens, simulated the corresponding memo line.-You see that the system is able to properly derive an external reference ID for an invoice, for example. You check that this invoice exists in the system, it is not assigned to an existing clearing and it posts on or before the payment allocation posting date. However, this document has not been automatically allocated in the payment allocation.-Cause-There are different reasons for which an automatically allocation may not succeed. In this case, the payment allocation has been created with a payment method that do not conform with the business transaction specification of the utilized memo line rule type.-For example, you have set up a memo line rule of type 'Open Payable External Reference', which reads the memo line and extracts the correct invoice's external reference ID. However, this rule type is used for transactions being paid by Outgoing Direct Debits and your payment allocation has been created with payment method as Outgoing Bank Transfer. Therefore, the applied payment method does not match with the requirements from the memo line rule and hence it does not allocate the invoice.-Resolution-Taking as example the above mentioned rule type, the payment method would have to be 'Outgoing Direct Debit' in the payment allocation for the invoice to be allocated by this rule.-To verify it, you can:-Open payment allocation.-Change the payment method to Outgoing Direct Debit.-Click Actions -> Create Proposal.-For more details on which business transaction each memo line rule can be used, please refer to help document Rule Types For Analyzing Memo Lines.-Keywords-Bank Statement Upload. Inbound File. Bank Statement. Payment Allocation. Memo Line. Memo Line Rules. Invoice ID. Open Items.

Title: How To Reduce The Several Changes Made By User in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have noticed several changes periodically trigered by a user in the sales order. You want to reduce the number of changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID of your document. -Click in the Edit button and then in the View All button.-Navigate to the Changes tab.-See that user ABC is making changes periodically. -Cause-Those changes are related to a Confirmation Update which is scheduled to run for all Customer Demands with a selected Planning Area.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Background Jobs view.-Show: All Scheduled Jobs.-Search for a Confirmation Update that has the recurrence of the changes in the Sales Order.-To confirm if this background job is the one related to the Sales Order:-Go to Outbound Logistics Control WoC and to Confirmation Update Runs view.-Show: All confirmation update runs.-Search for the Confirmation Update ID.-Click in the Edit button.-Navigate to Planning Area subtab.-Note which is the Planning Area.-Open the Sales Order.-Navigate to the Document Flow.-Open the Customer Demand.-Navigate to the Line Items tab and to Schedule Lines subtab.-Check if the Planning Area is the same from the Confirmation Update.-To resolve this behavior, you should reduce the frequency of this Confirmation Update. It is recommended to schedule job for each run with the recurrence of not less than four hours.-See Also-Confirmation Update Run Guidelines-Keywords-Sales Order. Confirmation Update Changes.

Title: How to Preview Form Template for Bank Payment Advice(Israel)
Content: Symptom-You have created the Bank Payment Advice and you want to Preview the Form Template. This functionality is specific to Israel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work centre.-Click on Bank Payment Advice view. -Open the Bank Payment Advice. -Click on View All.-Here, you want the option to Preview the Advice. -Resolution-You have to scope the element using below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work centre.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation project.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Ensure that Country - Israel is selected. -Go to section 4 Questions.-Select Cash Flow Management.-Expand Payment and Liquidity Management.-Select Communication for Payment and Liquidity.-Expand Group: Payment Forms.-Mark checkbox In Scope for "You can print and send bank payment advices.”-Click Next.-Review and click Finish.-Note: -1) The above Scoping Question is specific to Israel. Meaning - You can find this question for any of the scoped Country. However, the Bank Payment Advice Template(Application and User Management work centre - Form Template Maintenance View) can be visible, Only if the Country - Israel is selected as mentioned in the Step - 5.-2) In the Application and User Management work centre - Form Template Maintenance View, You can copy the Template for other countries except Israel, but you can Preview the Bank Payment Advice only for Country - Israel.-Keywords-Preview Bank Payment Advice, Bank payment advice - Form Template Missing, Preview Advice for Israel.

Title: Customer Information is Missing in the Invoice Output History XML
Content: Symptom-When you create and open the form template, you cannot see the Customer Information in the form and in the XML.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Navigate to the General tab, Customer Information is maintained.-Click on Preview, Customer Information does not appear in the PDF.-Cause-The Customer Information is not included in the Output History XML because the XML was generated before the Customer Information was added to the Customer Information sub tab in General tab.-You resubmitted the XML after they added the Customer Information but this will not change the XML data to include the Customer Information as a resubmission does not regenerate the XML, it uses the original data.-Resolution-The customer information therefore should not be included in the XML this is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Information, XML, Output History, Customer Invoice

Title: How to Check if Solution File was Manually Deleted

Title: Error Message: It Is Only Possible to Confirm an Advice Collection Completely while Posting a Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-You created a Bank Statement and the Postprocessing shows as Required, so you open the Payment Allocation with status In Preparation and you see that the payment is already allocated. You try clicking on Post button and system displays the error message: It is only possible to confirm an advice collection completely.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to the Bank Statements View.-Select the Bank Statement.-Under Postprocessing column click on Required link.-A Payment Allocation with Status In Preparation pops up.-It is possible to see that the Document ID is already Allocated.-Click on Post button.-System displays the message: It is only possible to confirm an advice collection completely.-Cause-System does not allow multiple payments created with the same Payment reference ID, a single payment from the batch cannot be allocated.-You can check the duplicate Payment reference id in the below steps:-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center.-Go to the Bank Payment Advices View.-Search for the Payment Advice id.-You can see Document ID and note down the ID.-Search for the ID and you could see the duplicate Bank Payment Advices.-Resolution-In order to resolve this issue, you need to cancel the Bank Statement and create a new one with the total amount of the Payments with same Payment reference ID added in the Step 3 of the Bank Statement.-Then you need to allocate all the payments in the same Payment Allocation.-Keywords-Paymen tAdvice, Payment Allocation

Title: Published Excel Template Only Works For Specific Users
Content: Symptom-You uploaded and published a new version of a Microsoft Excel template and it only works for the user who uploaded it or for a very specific set of users in your application.-The other users still see the older version of the template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Cause-You have uploaded and published the template with an user that has assigned to it the Partner Development (PDI) access roles. This will publish the template only in the layer of the users that have these roles assigned, so normal users will still see the previous version, as now you will see two templates uploaded and published for the same document.-Resolution-The user that is performing the upload and publishing must not have any of the below workcenter assignments on his/her user or business roles:-PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT-PARTNER DEVELOPMENT FOR MCS-If the Excel template was already published with a PDI user then you must delete it with the PDI user and then reupload with a normal user.-Keywords-Excel Template; Publish; Upload; PDI; Partner Development; SDK; Adaptation;

Title: Warning Length of Data Type 'UNLIMITED_WebURI' is Restricted to 255 Characters In the Data Base when used with [Transient] tag
Content: Symptom-You need to use the Data type UNLIMITED_WebURI to store a URL of length greater than 255 characters for use during runtime.-You do not need to to store the value in the database.-You have used the datatype UNLIMITED_WebURI in your Custom BO with the [Transient] tag and you see the following warning in the Error List in the Cloud Applications Studio:-"Warning Length of data type 'UNLIMITED_WebURI' is restricted to 255 characters in the database."-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Define an element on your Custom BO in your Custom Solution as follows: Element:[Transient] element NameOfElement:UNLIMITED_WebURI;-The warning is displayed in the error output window-Cause-The truncating will only occur while storing the data in the database.-Resolution-The warning message "Length of data type 'UNLIMITED_WebURI' is restricted to 255 characters in the database" is correct. -Since this field is Transient, it will not be stored in the database.-The value will not be truncated and you can use it to store URLs with more that 255 characters for use during runtime. -See Also- https://blogs.sap.com/2018/08/10/single-persistency-has-finally-reached-pdi/-Keywords-Cloud Studio, PDI, UNLIMITED_WebURI, 255, Transient, URL, Runtime, Custom Business Object, SDK

Title: In the Invoice Volume Report the Net Value of the Invoice for a Specific Item Does not Match the Amount Posted in the GL Account
Content: Symptom-In the Invoice Volume Report the net value of the invoice for a specific item does not match the amount posted in the GL account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports view -> List subview.-Open the report Invoice Volume.-Select the required parameters and execute the report.-In the report the Net Value of credit memo ABC is XXX.YY (ABC represents the ID of the credit memo and XXX.YY represents the net value of the credit memo). -Now go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to Reports view -> List subview.-Open the report G/L Accounts - Line Items.-Select the required parameters and execute the report.-The Credit Amount Company Currency i.e. the posted amount of credit memo ABC is XXX.YX (ABC represents the ID of the credit memo and XXX.YX represents the posted value of the credit memo). -Cause-The exchange rate was changed from XX to YY after posting of the credit memo. The reports uses the rate YY because this is currently maintained in the system.-Follow the steps below to check the exchange rate.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Edit exchange rates.-Select View Exchange Rate History.-Secondly, the report Invoice volume derives the company currency for display from the username. The company to which he/she is assigned, the-report shows that particular currency. Hence the net value can differ depending upon currency & the exchange rate for the currency displayed in the report.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Reactivate Set of Books Company Assignment Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You deactivated the assignment of company XYZ (XYZ represents the company ID) to Set of Books ABC (ABC represents the Set of Books ID). This modification is not reversable in the frontend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration workcenter access the Set of Books activity, either via the Integrate and Extend tab in the activity list of the current Implementation project or via the Business Configuration Overview.-Select Set of Books ABC and press Edit.-In the new screen go to the Company Settings tab.-In the List of Companies select company XYZ.-You notice that the Deactivate button is greyed out. This indicates that the company assignment has been deactivated.-Cause-Currently and until further notice it is not possible to reactivate the company- set of books assignment in this activity.-Resolution-Under no circumstances will it be possible to reactivate an inactive set of books.-The only possibilities here are to either roll back the system to a restore point when the now inactive set of books was still active, or to set up a completely new company and migrate/transfer all existing data over to this company.-Keywords-deactivated default set of books, re-activate set of books

Title: Error 'Only X digits before the decimal point and Y decimal places permitted.' for a field with Decimal Annotation
Content: Symptom-You are working on a custom field and receive error upon saving: 'Only X digits before the decimal point and Y decimal places permitted.' for a field with Decimal Annotation.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Set the value for a PDI field with Decimal Annotation.-Save the changes.-Error is raised.-Cause-When using Decimal Annotation, there are two parameters which should be set as below:- [Decimal (x,y)]- x = Total digits allowed-y = Number of digits allowed after decimal point- Now for example, if you make use of the annotation as below:-[Decimal (7,2)]- This means that 2 digits will be reserved for after decimal point. Since 7 digits is the total, this means there are still 5 digits remaining to be used in front of the decimal point.- Therefore, for the parameters on the example above, if you try to set the value to 123456 or 1234.567, the system will prompt the error. That’s because 123456 contains 6 digits before the decimal point, and 1234.567 contains 3 digits after decimal point.- In case the value is set as 12345, or 1234.56, both would be allowed, as it does not exceed the number of digits set on the first and second parameter of the annotation.-Resolution-Ensure that the total digits set to the element does not exceed the value set as first parameter on Decimal Annotation (Note that the numbers after the decimal point are also counted for the first parameter)-Ensure that the digits after the decimal point does not exceed the value set as second parameter on Decimal Annotation-See Also-2934267 - Dump when assigning a value to an extension field of type DecimalValue-Keywords-Decimal Annotation, digits before decimal
