Title: Central Case Document Forms Related Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Released internally**-This document describes the details on identifying the different types of issues with Forms and basic guidelines for processing it.-SAP pre-delivered forms.-Service Center created/enhanced forms.-Customer created Forms (using Adobe Lifecycle Designer).-Basic rules:-If the error lies within the content of the form (layout, fields not filled or not filled as expected): Application should analyze the problem. Most of the time it will be an application problem or changes the customer has done to the form.-If the customer has changed the form or created a new one which isn’t working as expected in regards to content the application should take care as well because they know the business process and the behavior of the original form.-If the form does not get generated it can have multiple reasons which can be in the area of Output Management but application as well.-There could be problems with the involved output agents (which are implemented by the applications), as XREP is involved it could also be a XREP problem, missing translations or missing country information.-Furthermore there are BAdI’s involved which are implemented by the applications which could as well lead to forms not being generated (especially in Frontend Preview).-This would all be cases where the application should take care of in the first step.-If the form template derivation or the output channel derivation does not work application should take the first look as well because application BAdIs are involved here as well.-If the Form is with Language variant German (DE), then the issues will be handled by Application. For other language variants, Forms Globalization development is responsible.-There is troubleshooting guide which will be helpful for you or the corresponding application, most problems should be addressed in it:-https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/APArchOffSec/Output+Management+Trouble-shooting-SAP Pre-delivered Forms:-If there is an issue with SAP pre-delivered forms (Easy Form Editor) and customer created forms (issue while editing in Easy Form Editor), then the incident should be routed to Application first and later to ES Applications – BC/Forms/FND/MIG (if the issue is not with Application).-If there is an issue with SAP pre-delivered forms (Issue after made changes using Adobe LifeCycle Designer) and customer created forms (issue while editing in Adobe LifeCycle Designer), then these are not support by SAP and it classified as "Consulting Issues". But it is recommended to do a Solution Search before closing this incident as consulting.-If customer wants to have a new field or feature which is not available with pre-delivered forms, then check with Application team whether the this requirement can be fulfilled by development or Service center. If the new requirement is for Service Center, advise the customer to contact Service Center.-Service Center created/enhanced forms:-All issues with Service Center created/enhanced forms should be routed to "Service Center - Form Service" after pre-analysis and solution search.-To differentiate whether the Form is SAP pre-delivered or Service center created form, refer to the KBA: 1729835 - How to Identify a Service Center Form Template.-Useful Knowledge Base Article:-Refer wiki page https://wiki.wdf.sap.corp/wiki/display/BYDES/Forms+Case+Documents for some of the useful KBAs related to Form issues.-S.No Topic KBA-1 CRM 1690729 - How to Troubleshoot a Content Issue in a Sales Form

Title: BADI ProfitCenterAndSegmentDetermination Does not Overwrite the Profit Center Determination When Creating a Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You wish to change the profit centers being determined by the system in the journal entry posting for certain transactions, for example for Bank-to-Bank Transfer's journal entry. To achieve that, you have created a script in the SAP pre-delivered BAdI "ProfitCenterAndSegmentDetermination" via Studio. However, when you post the Bank-to-Bank transfer, the custom script is not triggered and the profit center is not overwritten.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Having a Bank-to-Bank transfer as example:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under Common Tasks, select New Bank-to-Bank Transfer.-Fill in the required fields.-Post the transaction.-Upon posting, the system determines the profit center for the resulting journal entry. You expect that the BAdI is called and your custom script gets executed to overwrite the profit center.-Cause-Whether or not this BAdI is called to overwrite the profit center, depends on the subledgers that the journal entry posts, since not all subledger and subledger line items are supported. Therefore, if the transaction posts to a not supported subledger the overwriting does not work.-The supported subledger and subledger line item types by this BAdI as are as follows:-Supported subledger types:-01 - Fixed Assets-02 - Materials-03 - Production-04 - Procurement-08 - Sales-09 - Overhead Ledger-11 - Other Direct Costs-Supported subledger line item types:-07200 - Bank Interest-07201 - Bank Maintenance Charges-07202 - Bank Transaction Charges-Resolution-This is the expected behavior for this BAdI. For any transaction that posts to different subledger/line item types than mentioned above, the overwriting via BAdI script is not supported.-If you aim to address this feature and want to raise a request for enhancing the current definition, you may submit this suggestion in detail via Influence Forum.-Keywords-SDK. PDI. Profit Center Determination. Profit Center Derivation. Journal Entry.

Title: Transformation used for Sales Orders

Title: Error: 'An Write-Up/Write-Down line has either sales data or cost center' When Creating a Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-Unable to add a Cost Center in a Journal Entry Voucher with type Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Journal Entries > Journal Entry Vouchers view.-Click New and select Journal Entry Voucher (Manual Entry for Sales with Screen Variant as Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Documents).-Add debit and credit entries with sales document reference.-Add the Cost Center ABC (where ABC represents the Cost Center ID).-Hit Enter.-System shows following messages:-'Technical error AP_ESI_COMMON 106; report an incident'-'An Write-Up/Write-Down line has either sales data or cost center'-Cause-You tried to add a cost center on a debit or credit line which already has a sales document assigned. The error message is raised since both a sales document and cost center within the same line item cannot be provided. It must be either e.g. cost center ID or sales object.-Resolution-In order to overcome the error message, you need to add a cost center to an entry without sales document item. It is mentioned in the help center document Manual Entries for Sales Documents that for screen variant 634 – Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Documents the Journal Entry Voucher should have one entry for Expense or Revenue line (non-sale) and one entry for Sales ledger line.-See Also-Manual Entries for Sales Documents-Keywords-  Journal Entry Voucher. Sales Document. Manual Entry For Sales. Cost Center. Sales ledger.

Title: How to Identify a Service Center Form Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**Released internally**-This document helps you to identify if a form template was provided by Service Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The first step in identifying, whether a form template is provided by the SAP service center is to identify,-if the form is a SAP standard form template or a customized one.--If you do not find the corresponding form template code in table /DOC/C_OM_FMT, then it’s a customized form.- If the form template code starts with Z, then it indicates that the form was created from the UI (Form Template Maintenance)-but it does not indicate which party has uploaded the form.-Service center colleagues can directly upload a form template or they can provide to the customer and the-customer can upload it.-We can identify if the form template was uploaded directly by service center colleagues by the below steps.-1. Go to the work center Application and User Management, view Business Flexibility, sub view Form Template Maintenance-2. Select the form you want to check.-3. Click the button Version.-4. Check the users who have modified it.-If a user has name PDI in it (for example PDI_CCS) , then it is uploaded by the service center colleagues.- We can also check, if there is a BADI implementation corresponding to the form template.-If it has, then it is provided by the service center colleagues.-1. Run transaction SE18 -> enhancement spot = SPAF_OUTBOUND_EXIT.-2. Double click Implementation to get a list of BADI implementation class-3. if there is an implementation class with name like /SFA******/*****, then it is delivered by Service Center.-4. Double click each implementation class and check the filter value. In most case you can know the BADI is for which form-   according to filter value.- If you could not find a BADI implementation or the user with PDI, then we need to contact the service center colleagues or-the customer, to know, if this template was provide by SAP Service Center.-Keywords-Troubleshooting, form template

Title: You Are Unable to Display an Extension Field Extended from Business Partner Address on the Sales Order screen.
Content: Symptom-You have created an Extension Field in the Business Partner Address and extended it to "Business Partner - Address to Sales Order - Party", however, you don't see an option to display this field in the Sales Order screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After creating and extending the Extension Field, you try adding it to the Sales Order screen:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Open any Sales Order.-Click your Profile Picture in the top-right side of the screen.-Hover the mouse over Key User Settings.-Click Start Adaptation Mode.-Click the Plus sign (+) In the bottom left of the screen.-Select Extension Fields.-Change the Selected Business Context to "Sales Order Account Address Info".-You will not find the Extension Field.-Cause-This is an intended limitation. The scope of the Extension Scenario "Business Partner - Address to Sales Order - Party" is to only allow an extension scenario from Account address to Account address of Customer Contract, Sales Orders and Quotes. Therefore, the extension field can only be added under the Account section on the Sales Order screen.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-You can consult the following KBA for possible future solution:-2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-Sales Order, Extension Field, Business Partner Address, Pass, Add, Unable, Impossible, Send

Title: Wrong Net Value is showing in Migrated Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Sales Order documents into the system using the Migration Template, you maintain a Net Value amount and when executing the template the newly created Sales Order document is displaying a different value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Migrate the template into the system with Net Value 100 USD.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order document).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Net Value is displaying as 20 USD and not 100 USD which was maintained.-Also, there is a warning message which states the following:  Item 10: Customer expected net value 100,00 USD differs from item net value 20,00 USD.-Cause-When migrating a Project service item in the template for Migration of Open Sales Orders, we will map the Net Value to the "Customer Expected Price" component and not to the "Migrated Price" Component.-This value is only an statistical value and there would not have any effect on the calculation. So the system will determine the list price of the item from the system and not the Net Value from the migration template.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2975199 - Wrong Net Price is showing in Migrated Sales Order-Keywords-Migration, Migrate, Sales Orders, Open, Template, Net Value, Wrong, Upload, Logic, Customer Expected Price, Component

Title: Foreign Key Error with Accounting Nodes
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-This document helps in analyzing any error messages relating to Accounting Principle, for the logs in the transaction SLG1.-Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-While analyzing any workspace inconsistency issue, you found the below error messages in the logs in the transaction SLG1.-Foreign Key error in node A1S_FIN_AD_AP_PAY_BP; field ARPDUEITEMTYPE; Application Component: AP-ACC- Cause-If some Accounting Principles are de-scoped and the reconciliation types values are also de-scoped, it will leads to an inconsistency in the workspace, as these are referenced in the copied Chart of Account content.-In fine tuning, if the user has deleted some SAP delivered data (e.g. Account Determination Groups) and then adds a new country in scoping, the content for the newly added country refers to the deleted data. This will result in errors.-Resolution-Case 1:-Follow the below steps to confirm the issue and provide the solution.-From the logs find the source BC node. For example: In transaction SLG1, for the error message Value 4000 in setting A1S_FIN_FUNCADETFIAC_FDACCOUNT must also be entered in A1S_FIN_ACCPRINCFIAC_ACC_PRINC, the source BC node is A1S_FIN_ACCPRINCFIAC_ACC_PRINC.-Check if the mentioned values are present in the workspace currently. This is checked using the transaction BCE for the option Configuration Workspace. Enter the workspace ID and node ID and check the values in the node under section Information System -> Global Fine Tunning -> Node Name.-Get the BC Set that is the source of the content. This is checked using transaction BCE, option BC Nodes.-Check the Business Option linked to the BC Set. This is checked using transaction BCE, option BC Sets.-Check if this option has been de-scoped by the user.-Special Case of Chart of Account: since CoA is a copy of the SAP delivered content, the content will have to be manually adjusted before the referenced option is de-scoped.-Case 2:-Follow the below steps to confirm the issue and provide the solution.-From the logs find the source BC node.-Check if the mentioned values are present in the workspace currently-If not, check the corresponding BC fine-tuning activity in the frontend. Click the Restore Defaults button in the BC View and check if the values are present for restoring.-Inform the customer that he has to restore the deleted content using Restore Defaults and then complete the scoping changes.-For this case, please refer to KBA #1730383 for detailed steps.-See Also-External KBA: 2532689 - Unable to Finalize Scope Changes Due to Inconsistencies in the Business Configuration-Keywords-Foreign key error, Value, must also be entered, Business Configuration

Title: Deletion not Allowed due to External Payment
Content: Symptom-You are trying to delete a Sales Order which was created via Web Service with External Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Document is still In Preparation status.-Click Delete button.-Error: Deletion not allowed due to external payment-Cause-You are only allowed to Delete Sales Orders which fall within the following criteria:-In Preparation-AND-Manually Created OR A2A OR B2B origin without any items OR B2B origin and inconsistent.-Documents with External Payments are not allowed to be deleted.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-As a work-around, you can send a new update to cancel the document.-Sample payload:-<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:glob="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-   <soapenv:Header/>-   <soapenv:Body>-      <glob:SalesOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-         <BasicMessageHeader/>-         <SalesOrder actionCode="04">-            <ID>ABC</ID>-            <SalesTerms actionCode="04">-               <CancellationReasonCode>08</CancellationReasonCode>-            </SalesTerms>-         </SalesOrder>-      </glob:SalesOrderBundleMaintainRequest_sync>-   </soapenv:Body>-</soapenv:Envelope>-See Also-3000720 - Error message: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service XYZ and set of books AAA valid on DD/MM/YYYY is missing-3096429 - External Payment is Not Copied to New Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Order, External Payment, Delete, Reject, Reason for Rejection, Web Service, In Preparation

Title: Web Service is not Retrieving the Price List as Expected
Content: Symptom-You are using the service SalesPriceListFindByIDQuery to retrieve information the system, but the data is not being reverted back.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Send the request to SAP Business Bydesign.-Cause-You are trying to retrieve a price list which is too many items. When trying to query data from list with more than 10.000 items, this may cause memory inconsistencies.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.--Please reduce the amount of data you are trying to retrieve from the system.-If you need to extract a high volume Price List or Discount List from the system you can use the web service ManageSalesPriceListIn with the operation Read price lists with filter.-Please see the following Blog for details on how to use the web service and the operation: Price List and Discount List Read with Pagination in SAP Business ByDesign Cloud ERP-See Also-2121972 - Dump While Filtering the Number of Items in the Price List-Keywords-SalesPriceListFindByIDQuery, Web Service, Price List, Limit

Title: Bank Statement Item Still Refers to a Canceled Document ID From a Previous Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-When a bank statement is confirmed with allocation of a payment, if this allocation is reversed and another payment is allocated, the original payment remains present on Document ID for bank statement Item. However, you expect the system to update the bank statement line item with the new payment ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Find the related bank statement bank statement.-Open the bank statement in View All mode.-Go to Transactions tab.-Under Transaction Data, you'll see that the system has reference to a Document ID that is canceled.-Open the corresponding payment allocation and you'll find that the amount has been re-allocated with a different payment order.-You expect the new payment order ID to be updated as Document ID in the bank statement line item, however the system still shows the previous payment order ID.-Cause-It is the designed system behavior to do not change the reference of this payment ID in the bank statement, since this is an information sent by the bank. Otherwise, in case we update the payment ID reference, the information originally provided by the bank in this bank statement would be lost.-Resolution-If you aim to address this feature and want to raise a request for modifying the current definition we would ask you to submit this suggestion in detail via https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Bank Statement. Payment Allocation. Payment ID.

Title: Error Occurs When Saving a Price List or Discount List: Save Failed, Exists Price-/Discount List XYZ already exists
Content: Symptom-You want to create a new Price List or Discount List for a new validity period with the same name as an already existing price list in your system. When trying to save the new price list you receive the error message:-Price-/Discount List XYZ already exists (XYZ represents the Name of the Price List).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Services Portfolio Work Centre.-Go to the Price Lists View.-In the Show field, select a price list type for which you want to create the new price list.-Click on New.-Create your new price list with the necessary parameters, validity period and products.-Click on Save.-You receive the error message: Price-/Discount List XYZ already exists-Cause-It is not possible to maintain two price lists with identic names in SAP Business ByDesign. This applies regardless of the price list type, validity period or products included in the new price list.-Resolution-When creating a new price list in your system, either manually or via Excel Upload or via the Migration tool, ensure that you choose a name for the new price list that is different to the name of any of the existing price list in your system.-Keywords-Price List; Discount List; Name; unique;

Title: How to Create a Primary Account Assignment For Account Assignment Types
Content: Symptom-How to Create a Primary Account Assignment for Account Assignment Types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and select Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine-Tune and search for the activity Account Assignment Types.-Open the activity and select Maintain Account Assignment Types.-Select Add Row and in the drop-down for Primary Account Assignment you wish to add a new Primary Account Assignment.-Resolution-You can add a new Cost Object Type for the field Primary Account Assignment, which have to begin with the letter Z:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and select Open Activity List.-Navigate to Fine-Tune and search for the activity Cost Object Types.-Create a new Cost Object Type and Save.-The newly created Cost Object Type is available in the drop-down of Primary Account Assignment.-Keywords-account assignment type; primary account assignment; cost object type

Title: How To Find Port Binding Information for Any Screen for Mashup Usage
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You want to know the fields and port bindings available for a specific screen-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Open UI Designer-Open the required screen  (eg. Contact TI -  /BYD_COD/SalesOnDemand/Contact/UI/COD_Contact_TI.TI.uicomponent)-Open the Controller tab-Expand Outports-There, locate the relevant Mashup outports (usually, the ending will be *_Info_Out or just *_Out)-To be sure that this is Mashup relevant, see the field PortType Package - this will be globalmashupporttypes.PTP.uicomponent)-There, you can see the ParameterName column, the fields Exposed by each application to be used.

Title: Attachment Tab is Not Available in the Form Template for CRM Area
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add the Attachment tab (folder) available in Sales Quote, Sales Order in your Form Template but the information comes blank, however it works for the Purchase Order Template, for example.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-For CRM documents this functionality is current not available.-You can consult the following KBA on how to proceed: 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-Attachment ; Form ; Template ; Sales Quote ; Sales Order ; CRM

Title: Account ID Missing in Excel Export for Customer Specific Price List
Content: Symptom-In the Customer Specific Price List, you select the option Export in the Items tab, however, the Account ID does not showed up.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Price Lists view.-Query for Customer Specific Price List.-Select any Price List and click on Edit.-Go to the Items tab and click on Export button.-Download the excel file and open it.-It's possible to see that the Account ID and Description fields are missing data.-Cause-Excel export from Price List via Items tab, selecting the option of Export To Microsoft Excel® is used to download Items data only.-This option of Excel export is used only to download fields of Items table, it's used in high volume Price Lists-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Price Lists view.-Query for Customer Specific Price List.-Click on the Price List hyperlink (it will take control to Price list Factsheet)-Click on button "Download"-You can save the Price List into excel (which will have both header and item information).-Keywords-Export, Excel, Price List

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Mashup Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In this Knowledge Based Article, we will look at known issues regarding the PDI Mashup topic, and how we can troubleshoot PDI Mashup issues.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-What do we need from the Customer/Partner?-Description and type of Mashup (URL, HTML, Data).-Filepaths of relevant mashup elements.-If issue is related to loading / runtime data, steps to view mashup in UI.-Resolution-2912544 - Error when Creating Mashup-2909578 - No Items Found to Create Mashups in Solution Template from SDK-3064148 - Delete option not available for Mashup in Add-On Solution-2756792 - You are unable add your custom HTML mashup to any screen within UI designer because "Pipes" folder is missing-2719935 - Mashup Created is Not Showing Up on Cloud Applications Studio

Title: Product Dependent Unit Conversion Not Allowed
Content: Symptom-You have created a Key Figure that is supposed to convert created product dependent unit conversion, i.e. conversions that you have maintained on a product level, such as EACH to PALLET. -However, you noticed that some Conversion that are not product dependent Unit are working, but the dependent Unit conversion is not working at all, even thought your formula is correct.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In Business ByDesign reporting product dependent unit conversion is currently not allowed. Only general conversions can be applied, such as grams to kilograms etc.-Resolution-This is the expected system standard behavior.-Currently reporting product dependent unit conversion is currently not allowed in Business ByDesign, instead an use general conversions.-Please use the Influence Forum if you would like to register this as a new feature request.-Keywords-Unit Conversion, Product Dependent Unit Conversion, Key Figure now converting.

Title: Item Type for a Service is missing in a Sales Order and the Service Master Data for selection
Content: Symptom-You are not able to select an Item Type of a service e.g. Service - Time and Material in a sales order. The item type is not displayed in the drop down list.-When entering the ID manually one of the following errors occurs:-Products with item group Service - fixed price without actuals not supported-Products with item group Service - time and material not supported-Products with item group SERV - Service - fixed price not supported-Products with item group Service - time and material (project) not supported-Products with item group Service - fixed price (project) not supported-Further the respective Item Group e.g. SECO - Service - Time and Material is also not available for selection in the Sales tab in the Service Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab-Select the respective service-In the drop down list of the Item Type field in the Details sub tab the respective item type (in our example Service - Time and Material) is not displayed.-  Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Services view.-Open service ABC.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Select the Distribution Chain which is also maintained in the sales order XYZ.-In the drop down list of the Item Group field in the Sales sub tab the respective item group (in our example SECO - Service - Time and Material) is not displayed.-    Cause-The respective scoping questions is not active.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select the respective implementation project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Scoping step.-Expand the element path: Sales -> Product and Service Portfolio for Sales-The scoping option Sell Services needs to be active.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Expand the element path: Sales -> Product and Service Portfolio for Sales -> Sell Services--For Item Type SECO (Service - Time and Material) the following question needs to be active:-Do you sell services for a price based on the actual time and material needed?--For Item Type SERV (Service - Fixed price) the following question needs to be active:-Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price, but track the actual time and materials needed for reporting purposes?--For Item Type SEFL (Service - Fixed price without actuals) the following question needs to be active:-Do you sell or provide services for a fixed price, but do not track the actual time and materials needed?--For Project based services you need to expand the element path: Expand the element path: Sales -> Product and Service Portfolio for Sales -> Sell Project-Based Products and Services--For Item Type PBTM (Service - time and material (project)) and  PBFP (Service - fixed price (project)) the following question needs to be active:-You can sell project-based services.--Please note that if you want to activate Item Type SECO (Service - Time and Material) there is a dependency with the scoping element Service Confirmation. You need to ensure that Service Confirmation is activated in the Scoping step under the following path: Service -> Service and Repair (needs to be active) -> Service Confirmation (needs to be active)

Title: Creating Sales Order via Webservice An Error is Raised "Process component of communication party is empty"
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Sales Order via webservice, and as response, and error is raised - "Process component of communication party is empty"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Run the payload using Inbound Service (salesorderprocessingorderingi1).-After that, the error is raised: "Process component of communication party is empty"-Cause-There are missing information in tags of Seller ID and Recipient ID in the request payload.-It's also necessary to maintain and ID in the Purchase Order section.-Resolution-Find below the tags where the Communication Party ID needs to be maintained.-<SenderParty>-<InternalID schemeAgencyID="310" schemeID="CommunicationPartyID">XXXXXXX</InternalID>-</SenderParty>-<RecipientParty>-<InternalID  schemeAgencyID="310" schemeID="CommunicationPartyID">XXXXXXX</InternalID>-</RecipientParty>-<BusinessScope>-<TypeCode listID="25201" listAgencyID="310">3</TypeCode>-<ID schemeID="10555" schemeAgencyID="310">XXXXXXX</ID>-</BusinessScope>-<BusinessScope>-<TypeCode listID="25201" listAgencyID="310">2</TypeCode>-<ID schemeID="10555" schemeAgencyID="310">XXXXXXX</ID>-</BusinessScope>-See that XXXXXXX needs to be replaced by the referenced ID of the party.-See Also-Blog - Create Sales Order using Webservices-Keywords-Sales Order, Error, Webservice, Communication Party, Empty

Title: You Want the Extension Field to Dynamically Pick the Value Based on the Selection of the Value of Another Extension Field
Content: Symptom-You want the extension field to dynamically pick the value based on the selection of the value of another extension field.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the customer invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Edit the customer invoice XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the General tab where you have created two extension fields ABC and DEF (ABC and DEF represents the IDs of the extension field).-The values in both the fields will be selected from the drop-down created.-Here you want the functionality of dynamic data selection i.e. extension field DEF should pick the data based on the selection in ABC.-Cause-Note: This scenario is also applicable for the other SAP Business ByDesign screens like Sales Quotes, Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Supplier Invoice etc.-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-To request a change in the existing behaviour you can consult KBA 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available

Title: Bill-To Party Cannot be included in Sales Order Confirmation via the Adobe LifeCycle Designer.
Content: Symptom-The Bill-To party cannot be included in the Sales Order Confirmation form template using the Adobe LifeCycle Designer. In the Data View of the Data Connection in the main schema of the form template Sales Order Confirmation the Bill-To party is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is the current system behaviour.-The Bill-To party is not a part of form message type, we only pass on the following party roles in the form template:-Buyer Party-Seller Party-Product Recipient Party-Employee Responsible Party-Sales Partner Party-Payer Party-Resolution-To request a change in the existing behaviour you can consult KBA 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available

Title: MDR Run description is empty when logging on another language
Content: Symptom-When you log in the system with a different logon language, the run instances maintained on the custom Mass Data Run view are not displaying the description which was previously maintained.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new MDR instance and fill the description.-Log into the tenant on a different language.-The description for the MDR instance is missing.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. The description field is bound to a language code, and will only be available on the same language where it was initially maintained.-Resolution-The description will be displayed on the same logon language it was created.-Keywords-PDI, SDK

Title: Is it Possible to Define a Separate E-mail Address for Invoices Centrally?
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to define a separate e-mail address for invoices centrally?-Requirement: You would like to use a different e-Mail address for the customer invoice using which you do not need to define the e-mail address seperately in the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Open any Invoice Document.-Select View All button.-Select You Can Also button -> chosse Edit Output Settings.-Select Snd By Email.-Add the e-mail ID of the receipient.-Release the invoice.-The recepient would receive the Invoice output:-The From address has been picked from the e-mail address maintained for the Invoicing Unit.-You can check the e-mail address of the Invoicing Unit in the Organizational management work center (under Addresses subtab of the org unit).-Cause-It is not possible to define a separate e-mail address for invoices centrally.-If this requirement is urgent then you can consider to contact your partner to check the possibility of implementing the behavior using PDI.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: Placeholder in Email Subject is Showing the Invoice ID Twice
Content: Symptom- The subject of the e-mail shows the Invoice ID twice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Invoice Documents View. -Search for Invoice ID XYZ and select it. (XYZ stands for the Invoice ID)-Click in the Edit button and then in the View All button.-Navigate to the Output History tab and to E-mail Text subtab. -See that E-mail Subject: 'ABC - Invoice No. XYZ XYZ'. (ABC represents the Seller's Account)-Cause-The Invoice ID is always attached to the end of the e-mail subject, so it only shows once. However if a placeholder is added, the e-mail subject is going to show the ID twice.-Resolution-In order to avoid the Invoice ID from showing twice in the E-mail Subject, please remove the Invoice ID Placeholder and let the system automatically add this information.-Keywords-Invoices, e-mail template, e-mail subject

Title: Some components are not displayed for selection when you click on an EC
Content: Symptom-When you click on an embedded component section from group within UI Designer, you cannot see all the different components available for that selection.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is the expected behavior. On clicking an embedded component only the EmbeddComponent section gets selected.-Resolution-In order to view all the components you should right click on the EC -> Go to Select -> Click on EmbeddedComponentPane.-Keywords

Title: Exception When Creating Down Payment From Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to generate a Down Payment from a Sales Order document, however, every time you click OK after maintaining the expected information, the system generates an exception.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Create Down Payment button.-Enter the expected data.-Click Ok.-System generates an exception.-Cause-The reason the system is generating an exception is because a currency was not maintained for the Sales Organization inside the Sales Data tab of the Customer Account being used in the Sales Order.-Due to this, no pricing terms is created on the Down Payment request and therefore no instance for price and tax is generated.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To solve this, please maintain a currency for the Sales Organization inside the Sales Data tab of the Customer Account.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Customer Account).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Sales Data tab.-Select the Sales Organization.-In the Currency field, enter a currency.-Click Save.-If the field is grayed out, it is because the Cross-Account Sales Data checkbox is ticked.-To edit this, please perform the steps below:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select Common Tasks.-Click on Maintain Cross-Account Sales Data.-Select the row of the required Sales Organization, change or add the Currency.-Click Save.-See Also-2135145 - Distribution Channel Cannot Be Maintained in Account Master Data-1783576 - Error Message "The currency was not found for account XYZ, sales organization ABC and distribution channel Direct sales"-Keywords-Sales Order, Down Payment, Dump, Exception, Currency, Account, Sales Data, Account Management, Price; CX_ILM_BONI_PLUGIN_ERROR; ESI contract violation during update in BO APCI_CUST_INV_REQUEST;

Title: An Error Occurred When Selecting a Cost Center in the Organizational Assignments of a Lease Contract
Content: Symptom-You have created a new lease contract and when you specify the organizational assignment, a system crash is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Lease Contract Management work center.-Go to Lease Contracts view.-Open the relevant lease contract.-Go to Leased Object tab and click Organizational Assignments.-Add Row.-Open the Cost Center value help.-Select cost center you wish to assign.-Upon selecting the cost center, an exception is raised.-Cause-One of the possible causes for this to happen may be related to the way that the organizational hierarchy is set up. In this example, the selected Org. Unit is defined as Cost Center as well as a Segment, however its profit center is an Org. Unit higher in the hierarchy. With regard to financial reporting, the Segment is usually the top most in the hierarchy. Therefore, in this case, the system is not able to derive the profit center and hence the error happens.-Upon activating the Org. Unit, the system would also raise the following warning for this set up: 'cost center <cost center ID> must be below a profit center. Check that a profit center exists in the structure above and that there are no segments between the cost center and this profit center'-Resolution-In the Organizational Management work center, you can run a Check in the corresponding Org. Unit and see if there are warnings being raised.-Given the illustrated scenario, you need to adjust the Org. Unit's definitions so that a profit center can be derived from the selected cost center and considering that a segment is the top node of a profit center hierarchy.-See Also-Help Document: Guide: Setting Up Your Org Structure-Keywords-Organizational Management. Org. Structure. Lease Contract. IFRS15

Title: How to Block Only Partner Role of a Business Partner?
Content: Symptom-You have a Business Partner which has the roles Account and Sales & Service Partner. You would like to continue with the Account role and block the Sales & Service Partner role.-When you try to block the Partner role, it blocks the Account role as well as the complete Business Partner role. Hence, you would like to know, if there is a way to block only the specific role.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center-Access the Partners work center view-Locate the relevant partner and select it.-Click the Change Status button, then select either Blocked or Obsolete.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to blocking/setting as Obsolete a single role of a business partner without the change affecting the business partner as a whole. This will be considered as a future requirement in one of the upcoming releases.-Resolution-As a possible workaround, you can create an extension field called, for example, "Custom Status" in the General tab of the Partners screen and extend it to the OWL in the Partners work center view within the Account Management work center. You can then maintain status such as Active and Blocked, or Obsolete. Based on this status, you can filter the Partners using a custom query; however, the standard status will remain as Active, which means it will continue appearing in standard queries throughout the system that fetch Active partners.-Keywords- Block, Business Partner Role, Partner

Title: Actual Utilization and Forecasted Utilization reports missing
Content: Symptom-The following standard SAP reports / ICP embedded reports cannot be found in the WoC Business Analytics, Design Reports view:-Actual Utilization (HCMRPMU03_Q0001)-Actual Utilization (HCMRPMU03_QICP001)-Actual Utilization - My Area (HCMRPMU03_Q0003)-Actual Utilization - My Area (HCMRPMU03_QICP003)-Forecasted Utilization (HCMRPMU01_Q0001)-Forecasted Utilization (HCMRPMU01_QICP001)-Forecasted Utilization - My Area (HCMRPMU01_Q0003)-Forecasted Utilization - My Area (HCMRPMU01_QICP003)- As a consequence, you might encounter the following error messages when opening the Work Center Managing My Area:-No authorization to execute report Actual Utilization - My Area-No authorization to execute report Forecasted Utilization - My Area-You are not authorized to execute report Actual Utilization - My Area-You are not authorized to execute report Forecasted Utilization - My Area-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Go to View Design Reports.-One or more of the above mentioned SAP standard reports is missing.-OR-1. Go to Managing My Area work center-2. My Department-Cause-Go to Work Center Business Configuration.-Find and highlight the First Implementation project.-Hit the View Project Scope button.-Proceed to Step 4 Questions.-Find Scoping Element Project Management > Project Planning and Execution > Project Resource Management and highlight this row.-Expand the Questions for Project Resource Management.-You will find that the question Resource Search "Do you use Resource Management with skill profiles?" is answered with No.-Resolution-You need to answer the question Resource Search "Do you use Resource Management with skill profiles?" with Yes so that the above mentioned error messages will disappear and the missing reports will be available.-Keywords

Title: Customer Invoice Form Shows Multiple Entries for the Price Component VAT
Content: Symptom-Customer invoice form shows multiple entries for the price component VAT.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the customer invoice XYZ and choose the Preview button.-Multiple entries for the price component VAT is shown under the Total section.-Cause-The Customer Invoice Forms only shows the number of price component VAT available in the customer invoice Pricing tab.-If the invoice has one VAT added, then the invoice form will show one entry for it and if the invoice has multiple entries of VAT, then the form will show the multiple entries.--Follow the steps below to check the number of entries for VAT in the customer invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Edit the customer invoice XYZ and select the View All tab.-Go to the Pricing tab.-Check the number of entries for the price component VAT under the Total pricing section.-Resolution-If you want the form to calculate all VAT entries of the Pricing tab and show a consolidated line, then you can write a script in the adapted/customized form to implement.-Keywords-VAT, Pricing, Customer Invoicing.

Title: Invoice Volume Report Displays an Incorrect Currency for the Invoices
Content: Symptom-Invoice Volume Report displays an incorrect currency for the invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go the the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Edit the invoice and select the View All button.-Go the the General tab.-The currency in the invoice is XXX (XXX represents the currency).-Now go to the Reports view and the List sub view.-Open the Invoice Volume Report.-The currency displayed for the invoice is YYY (YYY represents the currency).-Cause-The logic used, to derive the currency in the report, first checks the employee's position assignment in the company. He/she should have a valid assignment in the company. The System then derives the currency from the company.-The org unit, to which the user is assigned to, has a currency YYY, hence the displayed currency in the report is YYY not XXX. The default report which is provided by SAP displays the Net Value in the company currency, this is the standard practice.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.--Keywords

Title: There is No Possibility to Add the 'Quantity', the 'Net Value' or the 'Amount' Fields in the Customer Return Form
Content: Symptom-There is no possibility to add the Quantity, the Net Value or the Amount fields in the Customer Return form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue for the standard return template:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find ABC (ABC represents the return ID).-Open the return ID ABC.-Select the Preview button.-The PDF form does not show the Quantity, the Net Value or the Amount fields.-Follow the steps below to check if the fields are available in the Easy Form Editor:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Open the template for the Customer Return in Easy Form Editor.-No data source is available for the Quantity, the Net Value or the Amount fields.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign does not support the fields Quantity, Net Value and Amount in the customer return form.-Resolution-We have added this as a new requirement for future releases.-Keywords

Title: Business ByDesign Not Supported To Be Used In Mashups
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a HTML mashup to display a specific screen ABC (where ABC is any screen) of SAP Business ByDesign (ByD) inside its iFrame, however this is not working when you try to preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Mashup utilise the iFrame technology to display its content and SAP Business ByDesign is not supported to be displayed from within an iFrame.-Resolution-This feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1.  If you are a customer:-Contact your Account Executive.-Check the link for SAP Advisory Services.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence to submit an idea.-Keywords-Mashup; Mashups; HTML; iFrame; Custom;

Title: The Total Amount Shown in the Customer Contract Confirmation Form is not Correct
Content: Symptom-The Total amount shown in the Customer Contract Confirmation form is not correct.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Show All Contracts and Search for the Contract ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Contract).-Click the Edit button.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Invoice Schedule subtab.-The line item XX has the quantity 10 MO i. e. Month (XX represents the number of line item).-Expand the line item where you can see there are 12 subsequent entries for months, each having amount of YY (YY represents the amount of individual invoice schedule).-Now select the Preview button.-The contract confirmation form shows value for 1 month and do not consider all 12 months in Total.-Cause-The Invoicing will always be done on the basis of Invoice Schedule. However, on preview you will not be able to see the complete price. The Contract Form is designed to show only the current invoice schedule.--Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Dump analysis tool in Cloud Applications Studio not opening
Content: Symptom-Dump Analysis tool in Cloud Applications Studio does not work and leads to a 500 Internal Error.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio -SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business by Design -Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio.-Click View > Dump Analysis.-In Dump Analysis tool > Select All Filter.-Dump occurs and the Cloud Applications Studio crashes.-Cause-The partner has written a line of code which is spread across many columns (+300) and will cause some functions to behave ambiguously. In other words the length of a line of code has exceeded 255 characters and it causes the Dump Analysis Tool to crash.-The Cloud Applications Studio Dump Analysis Tool picks up the Dumps from the back end and converts them into the format required by the Dump Analysis Tool. The Data Type used by the tool does not support a column number of 255 or greater. This will result in an overflow dump and a 500 internal error in the Cloud Applications Studio.-Resolution-To avoid this dump from occurring, the partner responsible must split the code logic into multiple lines. Once the line of code does not exceed 255 characters, the Dump Analysis Tool should work as expected.-Keywords-SDK, PDI

Title: Remeasurement Run Without Reversal due to Company Closing Down
Content: Symptom-A Company, Bank or Supplier Account is closing down.-You want to execute the Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash run for that company without getting a reversal.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You close account ABC (ABC stands for the Company, Supplier or Bank account) valuated in monetary unit X (Where X stands for the currency).-GL Account DEF (DEF stands for the name of the GL Account) has a balance because the company's monetary unit used is Y (Y is the other currency in use).--You run the Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash which is posted at the end of the month.-Reversal for that posting is posted at the beginning of the following month, even if the company is account ABC is closed.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-There is two possible solutions:-Not allowing automatic reversals on the Cash Run by activating the No Subsequent Reversal Posting in the Business Configuration.-This is on a Chart Account level, rather than for specific accounts, so if it is set, it will affect all Companies, Suppliers and Banks linked to the same Chart of Accounts.-Run the The Foreign Currency Remeasurement for Cash as usual, then, following the run, create a manual Journal Entry Voucher with Journal Entry Type 00083 - Manual Entry for Cash and Business Transaction Type 636 - Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Cash, which brings the GL accounts balance to 0,-so it will not be picked up any longer.-See Also-Foreign currency remeasurement run-Keywords

Title: Mono type Font Printing
Content: Symptom-Asian Fonts might be not printed correctly using PDFPRINT 760 included in CPM, CPM for ByD, CPM for SCP, SAPSprint or SAP GUI.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-With release 760 the above products contain PDFPRINT from Aspose. Contrary to the 750 releases with PDFPRINT from Adobe, no Asian font package is included in the installation. The font substitution from Aspose does not work in all cases. If you experience issues with certain Asian characters, you can install the Monotype Fonts for Printing package once. If installed, it will be used commonly from all installed products with the below patch levels. The usage of the font package should be switched on in each options dialog of the appropriate product.-Resolution- SAP Cloud Print Manager 760 Patch 5- SAP Cloud Print Manager for ByD 760 Patch 5- SAP Cloud Print Manager for SCP 760 Patch 2- SAPSprint 760 Patch 5-or above-You can download the needed Mono Type Fonts here: Mono Type Fonts for ByD CPM-Keywords-Font Substitution, Asian Fonts

Title: How to add Additional Fields of Main Address in the Account Overview
Content: Symptom-How to add Additional Fields of Main Address in the account overview.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select New Corporate Account in the Common Tasks section.-In the New Corporate Account Overview open the adaptation mode by selecting Adapt in the top menu and the Enter Adaptation Mode option.-Select Adapt and the Edit Screen option.-In the Screen Layout section select Main Address.-None of the field of the Additional Fields are available in the Fields section you can only see the standard fields which are displayed in the Main Address.-Cause-The additional fields of the Main Address are only visible if they are filled. The position of these fields are dependent on the country which has been selected in the Main Address Country field since different countries have different address requirements e. g. for the US the Tax-Jurisdiction is a part of the address section but for Canada it is not.-Resolution-If the you would like to move the fields Address Line 1 and Address Line 2 to a specific section within the Main Address this can be done as follows:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select New Corporate Account in the Common Tasks section.-In the New Corporate Account Overview open the adaptation mode by selecting Adapt in the top menu and the Enter Adaptation Mode option.-Enter the country e. g. CA in the Country field of the Main Address.-Select the Additional Fields hyperlink.-Enter a value in the field you would like to add e. g. Address Line 1 and press OK.-This field will now automatically appear in the Main Address section.-Select Adapt and the Edit Screen option.-In the Screen Layout section select Main Address.-The field Address Line 1 is now also available in the Fields section.-You can use the up and down arrows to move the fields to the respective position.-Save and Publish your changes.-You will need to repeat this for other countries if you would like to move the position of the additional field also for accounts located in other countries.

Title: Internal Server Error when executing $expand operation in OData call
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-When executing a get operation using the $expand operation in OData the system returns an error 500:-500 internal server error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Log into the system.-2. Perform a get request to an OData collection using the $expand operation.-3. After executing a request, the error 500 is returned in the response.-Cause-The $expand functionality works when it has the 'entity' which has to be expanded under another 'entity'. The customer may be trying to do an expand for an entity that is created at the same level as the one which is being queried. Hence expanding is not supported in this scenario.-Resolution-Customer needs to adjust the OData modelling so the entity that is expanded is under the collection that is being queried.-Keywords-OData, $expand, Postman

Title: Changing Number Range Settings Does Not Yield the Expected Results
Content: Symptom-As best practice, you should set up a number range at the beginning of a project and keep it that way.  However, in rare occasions, you might have to change the number range to meet certain circumstances. At this point, the result might not be the same as you expect. For example, in your initial setup, you define:-External number range: 000001 to 009999-Internal number range: 010000 to 099999-After this definition, you created several IDs.  The last ID created was 010009.  Now you re-define the number range as following:-External number range: 000001 to 000099-Internal number range: 000100 to 099999-However, the latest ID the system generates automatically is 010010 and not 000101 as you expected.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause- This is the standard system behavior.-Resolution-When working with number ranges, you need to keep the following guidelines in mind:-The system generates a new ID in the current internal number range.-The new ID is always larger than the last ID used.  It won't go back to a smaller ID number because you lowered beginning number of the internal number range.-We still use the above example to demonstrate these guidelines:-Example 1: After changing the beginning number from 010000 to 000100, the system will take a note of it.  However, whenever a new ID is generated, it looks for the last ID number. In your case, it is 010009.  Since this number is in the range of 000100 to 099999, so the next ID should be 0100010, not 000101 as you expected.-Example 2: If the original number ranges of 000001 to 009999 for external number and 010000 to 099999 for internal number have never been used, and you make a change, then the first ID it generates will be 000101 instead of 010001.-Example 3: If your new internal number range is 000100 to 000999, it won't work. Because the last ID number of 010009 is already larger than your maximum number of 000999.  The next ID has to be larger than 010009.-Example 4: If your new internal number range is 100000 to 999999, and the last ID is 010009, the new generated ID should be 100001.-In conclusion, the number range should be defined before any ID has been generated. If a change is absolutely needed, you need to understand above guidelines and accept its consequences.-Keywords-number range, change, beginning number, current number range

Title: Bank Transfer Documents not Shown in the Printer Queues
Content: Symptom-You expect the bank transfer document to appear in one of your predefined printer queues or Default queue, the same way as other documents appear there.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Work Center Payment Management.-View Payment Monitor and search for an incoming bank Transfer.-Click Edit.-Here you see a button "Print" - hit it.-You will see a dialog window open.-Chose a printer.-RESULT: You expect this document to appear in one of the printer queues, but that is not the case.-Cause-Since this Printing Concept is using the Print Concept and Dialogs of Microsoft Windows the document and any documents with a similar behavior will not appear in any of the printer queues. Only documents which have an Output History, and in addition can be selected in the output channel selection, will appear in the Printer Queues-Resolution-This is the expected Application behavior.-Keywords-Printing, Payment Monitor, Bank Transfer Documents.

Title: Postal Code Region Mismatch Error in Sales Document
Content: Symptom-Creating a New Sales Order, adding the required information: Account, Sales Unit, Employee Responsible, Items, the error is triggered:-Postal Code Region Mismatch-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the New Sales Order common task.-Add Account, Sales Unit, Employee Responsible and Items.-System triggers the error: Postal Code Region Mismatch.-Cause-There are some regions in US that shares the same Zip Code, for example - 57645 South Dakota and North Dakota.-System triggers the error, because the Address has the Zip Code for SD (South Dakota) and Vertex has it's done as North Dakota, hence, the error happens.-Resolution-It's recommended to validate if the Zip Code fits in this scenario (same Zip Code for two different regions in US). After that, it's necessary to reach back Vertex in order to get the details with them.-They will confirm if the address is assigned to one or another Region in US, and so preventing the error to occur again.-Keywords-Region Code, Zip Code, Mismatch, Postal Code Region Mismatch

Title: How To Retrieve An Email From Web Service
Content: Symptom-You sent an email to the recipient and would like to retrieve this via web service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Sales work center as example and open Sales Order view.-2. Open the "123" document.-3. Navigate to Output History tab.-4. Select the Sales Order Confirmation Output document.-5. You can see that the Output Channel is E-Mail.-6. In Output Details you cas see the email to "abc@exemple.com"-Resolution-You can use the FindByElements operation of QueryDocumentOutputRequestIn web service to extract the recipient email address.-Keywords-retrieve, email, web, service

Title: Wrong Contact Details in Opportunity Volume Report
Content: Symptom-The report Opportunity Volume shows the wrong e-mail or phone details for the contact.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Open the report Opportunity Volume.-Run the report with the required selection.-In the view, add the field Main Contact, and also attributes from Main Contact, such as E-Mail or Phone.-Compare these details to the contact information maintained in the work center Account Management, view Contacts.-THe report does not show the business contact details that are maintained in the Account Management.-Cause-The attribute shows the e-mail from the Business Partner details maintained in the work center Business Partner Data. This can be a different address than is maintained in the work center Account Management, view Contacts.-Resolution-This is correct. For the business e-mail maintained in the contact details, the data source "Account Contact Data" can be used as an alternative.-Keywords-opportunity volume, Opportunity-Volumen, wrong e-mail, contact details, reporting, business analytics, address, phone

Title: Inconsistent Discount Redetermination Behaviour for Follow-Up Service Orders.
Content: Symptom-On a Follow-Up Service Order, you notice that after changing the Account, the system did not redetermine the Discounts for them items in the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Order Processing view.-Find Service Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Service Order ID).-Select it and Click on Follow-Up > Service Order.-In the new document screen, click on View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-You will see that a Discount is maintained.-Now, navigate to the General tab.-Change the Account to a different one.-Navigate back to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.- You expect to see a new Discount determined based on the new Account, however, the old Discount remains the same.-Cause-This happens when a Manual Discount is maintained in the document alongside the one determined based on the Account.Due to this when account is changed, the redetermined discount is not applied since there is already a Manual change in the scenario.-Resolution-In order to avoid this, please follow these steps:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Open the Service Order Processing view.-Find Service Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Service Order ID).-Select it and Click on Follow-Up > Service Order.-In the new document screen, click on View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Remove the discount which has the "Manually Added/Changed" Checkbox marked.-Now you can change the Account.-The system will be able to redetermine the Discounts as expected.-Keywords-Discount, Determination, Service Order, Sales Order, Manual, Automatic, Follow Up, FollowUp

Title: Dump When Uploading a Document via Legal Approval in Invoice Documents View
Content: Symptom-Dump happens when uploading a document via Legal Approval in Invoice Documents view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for: ABC (ABC stands for the Invoice Document ID).-Select the document and click on Legal Approval button.-Select Upload Approval Information.-Add the file and click OK.-System dumps.-Cause-The dump is caused by the fact that there is no Due Date specified in the document. Currently the document has a Legal Approval Status of In Approval, so the Due Date can not be modified.-Resolution- In order to change the Due Date, perform the following:-Open the ABC document.-Click on Legal Approval button.-Select Roll Back Approval.-This allows the Due Date to be set-After that, you are be able to upload the Legal Approval documents as required.-Keywords-Upload, Legal Approval, Dump, Invoice

Title: Expire Date For Notifications About Canceled Items in Shopping Carts
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-System shows notifications about canceled items in Shopping Carts and is not showing the expired date.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Filter for Unassigned Items.-System shows some messages about canceled items in Shopping Carts and is not showing the expire date.-One or More Items in Shopping Cart ABCDE Canceled by Buyer (ABCDE refers to the Shopping Cart ID)-Cause-System behavior.-Resolution- Log into the backend and follow the steps:-Use SBTM_TASK_SEL transaction.-In Selection Based on Reference BO Properties, use the BO Name /SRMAP/LREQX_IR.-Click to execute.-Double click on the Task Title: One or More Items in Shopping Cart ABCDE Canceled by Buyer.-Check the Creation Time.-Navigate to the Deadline tab.-Navigate to the Expiration tab.-Check the Deadline Date (one month).-See Also-3066043 - Notifications About Canceled Items in Shopping Carts-Keywords-Shopping Cart; Expire Date; Notification; Canceled Items;

Title: Attachment File Missing from Output of Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have attached a file to a Customer Invoice document and expected to have the attachment sent with the business document when an Output is generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Select the Attachments tab.-No Attachments-Cause-In order to have the attached file available for Output, you need to select the option 'Include in Output' when adding the attachment.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-To have the attached file added to the Output, please perform the following:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the General tab.-Select the Attachments subtab.-Click Add button.-Select File.-New window pops up.-Search for the expected file.-Click Add again.-Check the checkbox for Include in Output. -Now the attachment file will show in the Output and be sent with the business document.-See Also-2738163 - How to Include Attachments in the Output Document to Customer in Sales Quotes and Sales Orders-3058306 - Include in Output not Passing to Scheduled Invoice Request.-2794615 - Include in Output Indicator is Not Available in the Service Confirmation-Keywords-Attachment, File, Missing, Output, Customer Invoice, Include in Output

Title: Guaranteed Holiday Landing On An Incorrect Business Day
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-In SAP Business ByDesign, guaranteed holidays are configured to be pushed to the next or preceding business day, should they land on the weekend.-However, customer reports that the system is shifting the holiday to an incorrect day (e.g. the second business day instead of the one immediately after).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the relevant holiday is part of a custom holiday calendar, please ensure that the configuration for this calendar is correct in the Working Day Calendar fine-tuning activity of the Business Configuration work center.-Should the configuration be correct, but the issue persist, it might be caused by an inconsistency in the associated backend tables.-Resolution-Please forward such incidents to the AP-RC-DT development component, so that they can execute a corrective report to address the issue in the backend table.-Once the incident is returned to support, inform the customer that they will need to execute a time valuation correction run, as outlined in the SAP Help Portal document linked under the See Also section of this article. This will complete the resolution of the inconsistency.-See Also-Time Valuation in SAP Help Portal

Title: Patch upload not possible; deploy the patch version content
Content: Symptom-The below error message is showing up when trying to upload an add-on within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-Patch upload not possible; deploy the patch version X content (where X is the patch version)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the Studio.-Open the Implementation Manager tab.-Click on upload button.-Cause-This is the standard system behavior related to a patch which was partially assembled.-Resolution-It is mandatory to deploy each partially assembled patch solution – you cannot skip the deployment of a patch version.-See Also-Assemble and Download – New and Changed Items-Assembly of Patch Solutions with New and Changed Items-Keywords-SDK, PDI, partial

Title: Different Form Template is expected in the form preview
Content: Symptom-A different form template than the one you expect gets picked. Your expectation is based on a UI change performed for example on sales quotes.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Administration work center-Open the Form Template Selection view-Search for the relevant BO, for example: "Sales Quote"-Now upload 2 Form templates i.e. "A" and "B" and restrict the rule based on the Sales Org." A" and "B".-As next Step-Navigate to the Work Center Sales-Go to the Sales Quotes view-Create a new Sales Quote and choose sales Org. "A"-Navigate to the Action -> Edit Output Settings. You will see the correct template A based on the Sales Org. A is picked as you have setup the rule.-Now change the Sales Org. to "B"-Navigate to the Action->Edit Output Settings. You will see the correct template "B" based on the Sales Org. "B" is picked as you have setup the rule.-Open the Action Edit Output Settings-Change the template manually or hit apply and you change the Sales Org.. Again the template would be shown as the template after you hit the apply button.-The expectation is that the template is still changing based on the i.e. Sales Org. change as before you hit the "Apply" button.-Cause-After hitting the apply button no further template validation happens therefore the last template before hitting apply will always be shown.-Resolution-If you still want a validation of form template rules, please do not use the apply button. This is the expected system behavior and has not changed.-Keywords- Preview, Wrong Form Template, Edit Output Settings, Apply.

Title: Service Level is not Determined Correctly
Content: Symptom-Service Level is not determined correctly or not get determined in Service Request or Service Order even though you've maintained necessary configuration in Determine Service Levels page and all the respective fields in service documents have been fulfilled.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Entitlements workcent and navigate to Service Levels-Select respective Service Level XYZ (XYZ represents the name of Service Level)-In the You Can Also tab, Select Determine Service Level-Open Incident Category Select Operator, choose filter option as BT - Between-Fulfill Incident Category value in numeric range. (For example: From 1 to 10)-You expect that in service documents which has any Incident Category number in between 1 and 10 will get determined as Service Level XYZ.-Go to Service Desk work center, click New Service Request.-Maintain Incident Category as 2.-The Service Level doesn't get determined.- Cause-Per system's design, Incident category is text field not a numeric field, which means even though you have maintained Incident Category in a numeric range(In this case, from 1 to 10) , since this is a text type field, hence only the two Incident Category you've input will be activated(In this case, 1 and 10).-Determinations for the data's to be shown in the add row is the following:- - Product category usage code = 1. - - Catalogue usage:  Service request or service order.- - Categories: service request or service order from type 1. - - Incidents: Type code 2. - - Service level objective = active.-This is standard behaviour. These are the restrictions for when adding a new service level and why some things might not been shown.-Resolution-You need to maintain multiple steps with proper string comparisons accordingly.-Keywords-Service Level, Service Request

Title: Account Notes Edited Are Not Showing in Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-When creating a Sales Order, you find out that the Account Note edited in Account master data is not showing in the Internal Comment of the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search for Account ABC (ABC refers to Account ID).-Go to Notes tab.-Edit a note in Internal Sales Note.-Save the Account.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-New Sales Order common task.-On the Account field, enter ABC.-You will be able to see that in the bottom of the page, in Internal Comment,  the note which is expected to appear is the last created and not the last edited.-Cause-After creating a new Internal Sales Note in Notes tab in the Account master data, this is the note which is going to appear in the Sales Order. Any edition made will not reflect in the Sales Order. If any important information needs to be added, then create a new note, do not edit it.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order ; Account ; Note ; Internal Comment ; Internal Sales Note

Title: Web Service Monitor Not Showing Custom Web Service Calls
Content: Symptom-Custom Web Service Calls are not shown in the Web Service Monitor in SAP Business ByDesign or Cloud for Customer system.-Reproducing the Issue-For C4C:-Go to the Administrator work center-Click the System Administration - Web Service Message Monitoring link-For ByD:-Go to the User and Application Management work center-Go to the Input and Output Management - Business Communication Monitoring view-Cause-Synchronous calls are logged only if those fail.-Asynchronous calls are logged irrespective of success or failure.-Custom web service calls are synchronous.-Resolution-Only failed log calls are maintained in the Web Service Monitor for custom web services. The A2X trace internal function in C4C/BYD should be active when the request payload is triggered in order to save the payload contents. To activate it,  click "Start Trace" button, then reproduce the issue.

Title: XML is Not Available as a Resubmit Option for Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-**** Archived since the Output can now be resubmitted with the Output Channel External System which is an XML format ****-For a Customer Invoice where the Output has already been Submitted, you are not able to Resubmit it via XML format.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Open the Invoice Documents view.-Find Customer Invoice ABC (ABC Represents the Customer Invoice ID).-Open it and click the View All button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-You see that the Output has already been sent by another channel (For example, Printer or E-Mail). -Click the Resubmit button.-Open the Send By dropdown.-You see that XML is not available as an option in this dropdown.-Cause-In the current version of the system, the XML channel is not supported in the Resubmit scenario. Therefore, XML is not shown as an option in the dropdown.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-Keywords-Customer Invoice ; XML ; Resubmit ; Output ; Printer ; E-Mail ; Fax

Title: Cannot Find Any Report Showing Surcharge Applied in the Customer Invoices
