Content: Symptom-There is no report available to show surcharges applied to Customer Invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Reports view and List view.-No report shows the Surcharge field for the customer invoice.-Cause-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Report for the Surcharge field is not supported. However, SAP is considering to add this field in the Customer Invoice reports in a future SAP ByDesign releases.-See Also-KBA 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Report, business analytics, surcharge, field, data source, not available, ByDesign.

Title: No PDF found. Invalid Form Template Group Code
Content: Symptom-The below error message is shown when clicking on a button to preview a form on the user interface (UI):-No PDF found. Invalid Form Template Group Code YABCDEFGY_123 (where "YABCDEFGY_123" represents is the form Group Code)-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the work center view.-Open any instance.-Click on the preview button.-Cause-The cause for this error is that the add-on is not properly scoped.-Resolution-The solution needs to be scoped on the implementation project on the UI.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select the project and click on the button Edit Project Scope.-Put the relevant node in Scope.-Reach the Questions stage, find the relevant element and select the In Scope checkbox.-See Also-Step by Step to create an Adobe Print form in Cloud application Studio-Create a Preview Button for a Print Form-Keywords-PDI, SDK, PDF

Title: Error Message: Processing of Document ID ABC From Bank Account XYZ Failed
Content: Symptom-You are not able to pay the expenses for the employee as the Payment Media Run is giving the below error message:-'Processing of document ID ABC from bank account XYZ failed' (where ABC means the Document ID and XYZ means the Bank Account ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Payment Media Runs subview.-Search for Run ID and select the Run ID.-It shows the Processing Status as Finished With Errors.-Open the respective Application Log ID.-Go to the Results tab and notice the error message:- 'Processing of document ID ABC from bank account XYZ failed'-Cause-You have not maintained the proper address information of the Employee in the Employee Master Data.-Resolution-You have to maintain the address for the Employee.-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for the employee and choose Edit tab.-Go to the Personal Data tab.-Choose Private Contact Data tab and maintain the correct address for the Employee.-Keywords-payment media run; bank account id

Title: You Want the Tax Number to Remain Blank in the Invoice Documents if the Account has More Than One VAT Numbers Maintained
Content: Symptom-You want the Tax Number to be blank in the invoice documents if the account has more than one VAT numbers maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to check the Tax Data in the account:-Go to the Accounts Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer account).-Go to the Financial Data tab and select the Tax Data subtab.-The Tax Data tab has multiple tax numbers entered for different countries.-Follow the steps below to check the Tax Number in the invoice documents:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the New Manual Invoice from Common Tasks.-Add the account ABC in the new manual invoice (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Add the Invoicing Unit, Sales Unit, Product in the new manual invoice.-Go to the Items tab and select the taxes subtab.-The Tax Number XXX has been select in the Customer's Tax Registration section (XXX represents the number of the VAT).-You expect that the invoice document should not select any Tax Number if the account has multiple entries for the tax numbers for different countries.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign system picks the Tax Number under Customer's Tax Registration section as per the below logic:-If the Tax Number is not available in the Account Financial Data then the Tax Number field will be blank in the business document like Manual Invoice Request.-If there is a Tax Number maintained in the Account Financial Data, the Tax Number will be added in the business document like Manual Invoice Request.-If multiple Tax Numbers are available in the Account Financial Data, then the system picks the first entry and add it in the business document like Manual Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.-This is a specific requirement and a customer specific change is required for it.-You can consult the following KBA on how to proceed: 2531827 - Functionality Currently not Available-Keywords-Customer Tax registration, Tax number, Account, Master Data, Financial Data, invoice, customer invoice

Title: You are Getting an Error Message while Creating Budget Queries
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This KBA is not in use.-You are unable to create Budget Queries in the system due to an error message-"Login User must be an employee"-.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center.-Go to Self Services Overview-Go to Track My Budget Queries  view.-Click on New Budget Query.-You get an error message "Login User must be an employee"-Cause-There are some pre-requisites for using Budget Queries: A Financial Plan should be existing for the Company in the current Financial Year--The financial plan is not present in the system for the current fiscal year for the company and hence you are unable to create the Budget Queries.-Resolution-First you need to create the financial plan for the current year and you will be able to create the Budget queries without any issues.-See Also-Refer to the case document 2109436 - How Budget Queries Work With the New Planning Solution  for more details on Budget Queries

Title: The 'Customer Information' Field is not Available in the 'Sales Volume Report'
Content: Symptom-The Customer Information field is not available in the Sales Volume Report, and need to know how to enable filtering for this field.-   Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports view and select the List sub view.-Search for the Sales Volume Report.-Open the report in a web browser.-Enter the required parameters and execute the report.-The report does not display the Customer Information field.-As a result, a customized report cannot be created in the Business Analytics work center using this field.-Cause-This occurs because filtering is not enabled for the Customer Information field.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the Reports view and select the List sub view.-Search for the Sales Volume Report.-Open the report in a web browser.-Enter the required parameters and execute the report.-Select View.-In the Row Fields section, add the Customer Information field under Sales Order.-Keywords-Sales Volume Report; Customer Information; Customer Information Field; Report Filtering; Business Analytics; Row Fields; Custom Report; Key Figure Report

Title: What is the Path to Map the Description and Order Confirmation Date Fields in the Customer Invoice Form Using Adobe LiveCycle Designer
Content: Symptom-What is the path to map the Description and Order Confirmation Date fields in the customer invoice form Using Adobe LiveCycle.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the invoice XYZ and choose Preview button.-You want Description and Order Confirmation Date fields in the customer invoice form, however you are not aware of the path to map theses fields in the form using Adobe LiveCycle Designer.-Cause-The path for the Description field in the Adobe LiveCycle Designer is: $record.CustomerInvoice.Item[0].Description.-The Order Confirmation Date field is not available on the invoice, hence it cannot be mapped to the invoice form.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance subview.-Select the Advanced option and enter Customer Invoice in the Template Group field.-Select the Go button.-Choose the required from template and select the Open button -> Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer.-Map the Description field in the Adobe LiveCycle Designer using path: $record.CustomerInvoice.Item[0].Description.-The Order Confirmation Date field is not available on the invoice, hence it cannot be mapped to the invoice form.-Keywords-Customer Invoicing, Description,Order Confirmation Date.

Title: "Ship-from" Column Lines in Sales Orders View Not Populated in External Fulfillment Scenario
Content: Symptom-When checking a Sales Order Item which has External Fulfillment, you notice that the "Ship-From" Line is not populated in those Items.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders screen.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC represents the Sales Order ID) and Highlight it's line.-In the lower part of the same screen, select the "Items" subtab.- You notice that for items which have their Fulfillment as External, the "Ship-From" Line is blank. -Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. In cases of items with External Fulfillment, the field "Supplier" will be populated instead of "Ship-From".-Resolution-If the "Supplier" column is not already present in the Sales Order search screen, you can add it by following these steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders screen.-Search for any order.-On the top-right side of the screen, click on your Avatar.-In the submenu, click on Start Personalization Mode.-In the lower part of the same screen, select the "Items" subtab.-On the right-side of the screen, click on the ">" arrow on the right of "Unnamed Table".-Check the "Visible" checkbox for "Supplier".-Click on the "Save" button.-Keywords-Personalize, Customize, Supplier, Ship, To, External, Internal, Fulfillment, Sales Order, Column, List, Line

Title: You are not able to assign a custom view to a business user
Content: Symptom-You are unable to locate a custom work center view created from the Cloud Applications Studio, while editing the access rights for a business user.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management or Administrator work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Click on Edit and select access rights.-You are unable to find the related work center view using the Find and Locate option.-Cause-The add-on solution where the custom work center view belongs is not scoped.-Resolution-You would need to scope the custom solution within the implementation project from the Business Configuration work center.-Keywords-assign, assignment, RBAM,  authorization, PDI, SDK

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate not Considered in Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-When maintaining a Tax Exemption Certificate in a Sales Order Item with a manually maintained Price List, you notice that the Tax Exemption Certificate is not influencing the Tax Calculation for that Item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Sales Order ID).-Open it and click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-You notice that one or more items have the List Price maintained manually.-Navigate to the Items tab.- You notice that for items that are not maintained in Price Lists (Hence had their List Prices maintained manually in the Sales Order), the Tax Exemption Certificate is not being considered in the Tax Calculation/Determination.-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. As that item is not maintained in a price List, the system considers the Net Value for the product as Zero and therefore with a Zero value there is no need of Tax Exemption.-Resolution-In this case, please maintain the Item(s) in a Price List and follow these steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Sales Order ID).-Open it and click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Click on the Update Pricing button and select the Completely option.- The system will then be able to use the Tax Exemption Certificate in the calculation.-Keywords-Certificate not required; amount to be tax-exempted is 0, Tax Exemption Certificate, Price List, Update, Ignored

Title: Key Figure not Available in Filter
Content: Symptom-You want to filter on standard Key Figures or Key Figures you have created but they are not available in the Filter Tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Open any report and run it.-Click the Filter Tab.-You cannot see any Key Figures to Filter on.-Cause-Filters can only be used on characteristics, not on key figures.-Resolution-In key figures, you can make use of Conditions (C4C) / Value Filters (ByD).-If you require being able to filter on Key Figures then please open a thread on our influence forums listed below:-Continuous Influence Session for SAP Business ByDesign-Continuous Influence Session for SAP Cloud for Customer-On these forums other customers can vote for your requirement which will give us a better understanding on the priority of this functionality. Our product management delivers the features requested here according to priority, technical feasibility and effort.-Keywords-key figures; filter, report, business analytics, conditions, value filters, missing, cannot filter-key figures,filter

Title: Supplier/Fulfillment is Removed for the Released Sales Order Line Items
Content: Symptom-You enter a new Line Item for an existing Sales Order, and the Suppliers for the released Line Items are removed/deleted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for Sales Order ABC (ABC is the Sales Order ID for the existing document).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click on Add Row button.-Add a new Line Item.-Set the quantity.-Error message appears: Item XX: Party with role Supplier missing. (XX is the Line Item ID for the released Sales Order Line Item)-Cause-When you enter a new Line Item that causes the Sales Order to become inconsistent (for example, the error "Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is displayed), and then make a further fulfilment-relevant change, Sales Order updates Customer Demand with the new information, including the inconsistent status of the Sales Order. Customer Demand can't fulfil the requirements for an inconsistent Sales Order, so the system deletes the Suppliers.-Resolution-Solve any inconsistencies that occur after you enter the new Line Item, before you make any further changes to the Sales Order. For example, first add the Price List of the new Line Item entered.-This will ensure that the Sales Order is consistent, and then any further changes will not result in the deletion of the Suppliers.-Keywords-New Line item, Deletion, Supplier, Fulfillment, Remove

Title: Journal Entry Voucher Error: For sales document item AAA-BB (Sales Order) use journal entry type 00047 to post to assigned project task DEF
Content: Symptom-While attempting to post a Journal Entry Voucher, an error is raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Common Tasks View and click New Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents and other mandatory data.-Under items, enter Sales Doc. Type Sales Order, Sales Doc. ID AAA-BB and Sales Doc. Item ID BB (where AAA-BB means sales order - sales order item and BB means sales order item)-Click Simulate or Post.-Error message is thrown:- 'For sales document item AAA-BB (Sales Order) use journal entry type 00047 to post to assigned project task DEF' (where DEF means project task)-Cause-A Journal Entry Voucher (JEV) with Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents cannot have both Sales Doc. data and Multiple-Customer Project (MCP) data (in Project Task field) at the same time.-Resolution-The primary cost collecting object in case of MCP is the project itself. Hence while doing manual sales postings only the project task is required.-Sales Document is only an additional information which is not required while posting the manual JEV. That is the current design.-To post or simulate the journal entry voucher, leave the Sales Doc. Type, Sales Doc. ID and Sales Doc. Item ID fields blank and enter only Project Task.-Keywords-Project Task; JEV; 00088; manual entry for sales documents-general ledger

Title: You observe the following error when activating a web service: Recheck WSDL and upload it again: Object TTYP YABC Could Not be Activated->Check DDIC
Content: Symptom-You have attempted to activate your custom web service in the Cloud Applications Studio and it fails with the following errors.-Recheck WSDL and upload it again-object TTYP YABC could not be activated->check ddic-TTYP YABC1 Activated with errors for dependent objects (Details -> DDIC log)-Where YABC and YABC1 are the solution namespaces.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the relevant solution.-Select the required web service file .WSID.-Right click on the .wsid file and select the option Activate.-Error is shown on the popup.-Cause-The WSDL file contains some fields with the same name from both Original solution and Patch solution.-Resolution-You have to remove the duplicate fields for either the original or patch schema definitions.-To do this please follow these steps:-Open your WSDL file in any open source wsdl editor. e.g. notepad++, etc.-Find this tag in the wsdl <wsdl:types>.-In the wsdl types there are .xsd schemas which belong to each target namespace used in the web service.--e.g.:-<xsd: Schema targetNamepace ="http://123"> (http://123 represents any of the following namespaces).-http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global;-http://sap.com/xi/AP/Common/Global;-http://sap.com/xi/A1S/Global;-http://0050010927-one-off.sap.com/Y123_; (Y123 represents a PDI solution)--The PDI solution namespaces will start with Y*.--e.g.:-<xsd: Schema targetNamepace ="http://0050010927-one-off.sap.com/Y123"......>-<xsd: Schema targetNamepace ="http://0050010927-one-off.sap.com/YABC"......>  (Y123 represents the name of the original solution & YABC represents the name of the patch solution)--Since one of these solutions is the original and the other is the patch solution, some or all of the fields in two these schema definitions may have the same name, which causes the duplicate issue.--Expand these structures to see the element information in each, an example of which is seen below;--e.g.:-********************************************************************************************************************-<xsd:group name="Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955">-         <xsd:sequence>-                 <xsd:element name="BeneficiaryAddress2" minOccurs="0" form="qualified" type="xi11:Ext00163E3B22471ED881AD62347B0602B4"/>-        </xsd:sequence>-</xsd:group>-<xsd:attributeGroup name="Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955"/>--Each field is declared inside a group with the  tag <XSD:GROUP Name> and also has attribute group with tag <XSD:ATTRIBUTEGROUP Name>-The value of the group name and the attribute group name are the same-********************************************************************************************************************--Find which of these fields are present twice in the WSDL and comment out the duplicate fields from the solution namespace which is not needed.-i.e.:-The element is present in both the original and patch solution schema definitions and you wish to comment it out of the original namespace schema definition.--To do this comment out the whole element part using: <!-- -->-e.g.-********************************************************************************************************************-<xsd:group name="Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955">-         <xsd:sequence>-        Add comment here:  <!-- <xsd:element name="BeneficiaryAddress2" minOccurs="0" form="qualified" type="xi11:Ext00163E3B22471ED881AD62347B0602B4"/> -->-        </xsd:sequence>-</xsd:group>-<xsd:attributeGroup name="Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955"/>-********************************************************************************************************************--Now search by the value of the group name i.e. "Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955"  from the example above.-You will find a reference to it (<xsd:group ref="...">)under the following tag structure:-e.g.-********************************************************************************************************************-<xsd:ComplexType name =..........-<xsd:sequence..........-<xsd:group ref="xi2:Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955"/>-********************************************************************************************************************--Comment out this reference also:   <!-- <xsd:group ref="xi2:Ext00163E6B75071EE980B3EB4F1F560955"/> -->-Repeat these steps for all the fields which are duplicated. -After commenting out all duplicated fields (from one of the namespace schema definitions), save the WSDL and upload it again to the WSID file.-Activate the WSID file. -Keywords-WSDL, PDI, SDK, add-on, DTEL, activated with errors for dependent objects, details, ddic log

Title: Saving a Preview has not the File Name as expected
Content: Symptom-You are previewing a document and want to save the preview. While saving you expect a different file name, similar to email and print scenarios.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Customer Invoice.-Here, navigate to Invoice Documents and open any released document.-Click Output History and have a look at the file name.-Click Preview and save the preview.-Your expectation is, that the file name of the saved document is the same as the document name in the output History - but it is not.-Cause-The document name is applied during email and print scenarios The 'Preview' would not use it, as the same is applied during document release.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior since the document logic applies only for printing and email scenarios.-Keywords-File Name, Preview, Save Preview.

Title: Inconsistent display of Currency on Discount Price Component.
Content: Symptom-When checking the Price Components of a Sales Order, you notice that for some documents the Currency is not shown in the "Product Discount(%)" Price Component.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the Sales Order ID).-Open it and click the View All button.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Click on Expand All under the Pricing section.-Check the Price Component "Product Discount(%)"- You will see that under "Amount", the currency is not displayed to the right of the monetary value.-Cause-This happens when the Discount List is updated in the document via Web Service but the <CurrencyCode> tag is sent along. In cases where the Discount List is operating in a Percent basis, this tag is not needed on updates and might lead into issues such as this one.-Resolution-The following is a .xml payload snippet sample which avoids the issue: (All mandatory values have been changed to "XXXX")- <SalesPriceList>-    <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>PriceList</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-    <TypeCode>7PL1</TypeCode>-    <ID>XXXX</ID>-    <Description languageCode="XXXX">XXXX</Description>-    <StartDate>XXXX</StartDate>-    <EndDate>XXXX</EndDate>-    <PriceSpecification>-       <TypeCode>7PR6</TypeCode>-       <Percent>XXXX</Percent>-    </PriceSpecification>-</SalesPriceList>-Keywords-Webservice, Web Service, Price Component, CurrencyCode, Currency, Display, Show, Shown, Missing

Title: Changes Tab is Blank Due To Missing Translation
Content: Symptom-You access the Changes tab in a Sales Document (Sales Order, for example), and observe that the information is blank. You expect to have the full information translated in your expected language.-Environment- SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search for: ABC (ABC stands for the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Changes tab.-Information is blank.-You expect to have the information translated to Czech (for example), however, it's blank. -Cause-Translations in the Changes tab into a language that is not delivered by standard such as Czech are currently not supported via the Language Adaptation Tool for certain controls and hence a 100% translation coverage cannot be achieved currently.-Resolution-Development team has taking this into their Product Backlog to be taken into consideration for a future release. However, they will ensure that the fallback language English will be used in this case.-This is currently also not available but is planned to be implemented with a future release.-Keywords- Translation, Changes tab, Not available

Title: Microsoft Teams for Business By Design
Content: Symptom-You want to use Teams and Business By Design-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Resolution-Download the MS Teams App from either the self service or the Download Center in the Application and user Management.-Please have a look into the following Blog: SAP Business ByDesign for Microsoft Teams (Beta)-Keywords-Microsoft Teams, Teams, Byd and Team

Title: Not Able to Create New Extension Field on Adaptation Mode
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom EC and there is no option to add a new extension field or you cannot hide fields or perform any adaptation on the EC.-“Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal system, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.“-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the affected work center.-Open the affected work center view.-Navigate to the custom facet.-Start Adaptation Mode.-You have no option to adapt the EC.-Cause-Anchors are missing on the EC or not configured correctly.-Resolution-To add an extension field or to perform an adaptation to an EC, anchors should be defined on all "UI levels" from the respective EC section on UI Designer.-Especially for a extension field creation, the respective BO and Node information must be present.-  See Also-Please refer to the Help Document: Define an Anchor for a Floorplan-Keywords-PDI, SDK, flexibility, rule, display, remove

Title: Amount Differs from Rebate Report to Rebate Credit Memo
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -You are checking for Rebates Report, and observe that the Amount differs from the Rebate Report to Rebate Credit Memo document.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view-Search for: Rebates-Open and run the report.-In the View option, add the Invoice.-Checking the Invoice ABC - Accrued Rebate Base Amount | Accrued Rebate Amount | Accrued Rebate Base Transaction | Accrued Rebate Transaction. (ABC stands for the Invoice ID)-Value is - -5.840.000.000,00 VND.-Opening the Invoice ABC from the Report.-Total is: -321.200.000 VND.-Net Value is: -292.000.000 VND.-Cause-This is the expected behavior based on the Rebate Agreement and Settlement Runs.-Resolution-Analysis done through backend:-Open the Transaction MDRS-Legend:-1: To understand an analytical view it often helps to locate it in MDRS (use MDAV as the selection type).-2: Select the View (In this case the relevant view is CRMREBATE – searching via the ES name is generally quite straight forward if you use the relevant BO – e.g. ‘Rebate’.-3: Select the Keyfigure (or value you are interested_).-4: Examine the relevant configuration details.-5: The expected behaviour for the field is to Sum up the values it is provided.-Analysis in the UI:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view-Search for: Rebates-Open and run the report.-In the View option, add:-Changed On field to the Row fields inside the report in the front end shows how the list of the summed values for the Rebate Agreement.-Rebate Agreement field to to the Row fields as well.-Go to the Rebate Management work center.-Search for the Rebate Agreement ID (based on the Report).-In the Execution Run Details it's posible to match it based on the Changed On field in the Report-So, adding the Rebate Agreement ID and Changed On to the Row fields, you see how these Accrued (accumulated over time) values are calculated.-For this example, for the Invoice ID ABC, the Rebate Agreement ID XYZ (XYZ stands for the Rebate Agreement ID) was run 4 times in a short period of time--1.460.000.000,00 VND is added 4 times which sums to -5.840.000.000,00 VND--Which justified the results in the Report.-Keywords-Difference, Amount, Rebate Report, Rebate Credit Memo

Title: Inconsistent Determination of Pro Forma Invoice Templates in a Split Scenario
Content: Symptom-When dealing with a scenario of Pro Forma Invoice creation with a Split in the Invoice, you notice that different templates are being determined for each Split document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (Where ABC Represents the ID of a Sales Order where a Pro Forma Invoice Split will happen).-Highlight it and click on the Pro Forma Invoice button.-In the Pro Forma Invoice Split Analysis screen, select one of the Invoices and click on the Print Pro Forma Invoice button.-The system will determine template DEF and use it in the Preview.-Now, select a different Invoice and click on the Print Pro Forma Invoice button.-The system will determine template GHI, a different one than the previous.- (DEF and GHI Represent different template IDs).-Cause-The different determination will happen because there are different Tax Countries maintained between the Items in the Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. The system will determine each template separately for each item, and if there is a discrepancy in the Tax Country maintained in that item, that will be taken into consideration for the determination and result in the selection of a different template.-See Also- 2038600 - While Selecting the Print Pro Forma Invoice From a Sales Order, the System is Selecting a Different Form Layout- 2591499 - Error Message 'Form template variant Customer Invoice for language ABC and country DEF cannot be found'-Keywords-Pro Forma, Proforma, Template, Incorrect, Inconsistent, Different, Split, Country, Language

Title: How to Add Ecommerces Work Center
Content: Symptom-You have activated E-selling in scope but Ecommerce work center does not appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The E-Commerce work center has only the view Sales Order Deletion Run. To see this view you need to answer the scoping question for Sales Order Release Procedure. If it is set to 'No', the view is not scoped and the work center is also invisible.-Another Scoping question:-- Customer Release of Internet Orders-You need to scope this in E-Selling. Name is Customer Release of Internet Orders.-Resolution-Set the scoping question for Sales Order Release Procedure to Yes.-If the view isn't available immediately, you may have to re-log into the browser / clear cache.-Keywords

Title: Custom Activity values are not saved in the Fine-Tuning
Content: Symptom-You have created some BCO and BCC files, along with the QA view on your add-on within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-When updating the fine-tuning values directly on the UI, you notice that your data is not changed.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Overview view.-Search for the custom activity name.-Click on the relevant BC set name (if applicable).-Change the fields values of the existing entries.-Save your changes.-Data will not be updated-Cause-In case the BC Set rows have been defined directly on the .bcc file within the Studio, only the Description can be changed, if you have checked in the option "Change Description in Fine Tuning" on your .bcc file.-Apart from this, those entries defined in the Studio can only be added or deleted within the UI fine-tuning (Note that the "Values can be added in Fine-Tuning" and "Values can be deleted in Fine-Tuning" checkbox options should be checked as well on the .bcc file so you can add and remove entries/rows from the UI).-Resolution-It is currently not possible to update/edit a BC Set entry via fine-tuning which was defined in the Studio, apart from the Description field (if the mentioned checkbox is selected).-However, if the entry was added in the activity fine-tuning (not defined on the Studio), it can be changed/deleted.-In such case when customer wants to keep updating the fine-tuning value in the UI, a dummy row can be defined in the .bcc file, where it can be also deleted from the UI, so all data is maintained via fine-tuning.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, erased, custom, missing, gone, vanished

Title: On a Follow-up Sales Order from a Contract, Price Agreements Are Not Carried Over
Content: Symptom--When checking a Sales Order created as a result from a follow-up of a Contract which contains a Price Agreement, the system does not consider the Price Agreement in the Price Calculation of the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Contracts view.-Find Contract ABC (Where ABC represents the ID of a contract that has a Price Agreement maintained).-Open Contract ABC.-Click the Follow-Up button and select Sales Order.-In the created Sales Order, you can see that the Price Calculation did not take the Price Agreements from the previous document in consideration.-Cause-This is the expected behaviour for ByDesign.-The system behaviour was changed with release 2102, however, the changes are reverted back with 2105 HFC 03.-Resolution-Please see the following KBA for exact details on the system behaviour.-KBA 3035845 - How the List Price is Determined in a Follow-Up Sales Order From a Contract-Keywords-Price Agreement, Contract, Sales Order, Unable, Carry Over, Fulfill, Maintain, Populate, Calculate.

Title: Message Bounced By Administrator For E-mails From SAP Domain In C4C/BYD
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-You are trying to send e-mails from your SAP Cloud for Customer (C4C) or SAP Business ByDesign (BYD) using a @sap domain (e.g. @sap.com), but are receiving the following bounce backs in SOIN transaction:-Reporting-MTA: dns; esa04.eu.cmail.ondemand.com-Final-Recipient: rfc822;ABC@sap.com-Action: failed-Status: 5.0.0 (permanent failure)-Diagnostic-Code: smtp; 5.x.0 - Message bounced by administrator (delivery attempts: 0)-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-DKIM signing for @sap.com was introduced and the filter “restrict-sap-com” that makes sure that only authorized systems (not customers) are using @sap.com addresses in the from headers.-Complying to this, @sap.com cannot be used as “from” address domain for any mails sent from C4C/BYD(by default). That is why these mails are bouncing.-Resolution-Below steps need to be followed if you really want to send mail using @sap.com:-Customer to get approval from Digital Governance Team - Markus Marweg and Tilo Wormek (from DG can help) and forward this approval to C4C Ops.-An internal contact person from the customer team can provide these details to us.-Cisco, once notified, can implement a Change Request to allow myURL as technical sender when @sap.com is in the from headers (add to filter).-These steps can enable a mail sent from myURL technical user to be with @sap.com will be DKIM signed.-Keywords-E-mails; E-mail; Email; Emails; Bounce Back; SOIN; SOST; Administrator; Delivery Failure; Domain;

Title: Duplicated Product ID shown on Exported Excel of Price List.
Content: Symptom-Duplicated Product ID shown on exported Excel of Price List.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfiolo work center.-Choose the Price Lists view.-Select Show Base Price->press the relevant price list->View All->Items tab.-Choose all items ->choose Export->Select to MS Excel.-You will find the product ID is duplicated on the exported excel.  -Cause-In case if description is missing in the Product Master Data, the Product ID is shown in place of description. That is the reason why the Product ID is repeated.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords

Title: Error message "No records Found" when previewing Customer Invoice and Credit Memo or Wrong Template is Determined
Content: Symptom-When you preview the Customer Invoice or Credit memo, you get either the error message "No records Found" even though you have maintained a form template correctly with correct country and language or the Form Template Determined is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Documents View-Select any Invoice and click on Preview button-The Error message “No Records Found” appears-Cause-Even though the form template for Customer Invoice and Credit memo is maintained correctly in Form template Maintainence View, In the form template selection you have defined a default form with no rules maintained. This form cannot be selected by the system as the template variant (country, language) does not exist in Form template Maintainence View.-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Input and Output Management View and naviagate to subview Form Template Selection-Select Show Rules For Customer Invoice and you will find the below form templates-Customer invoice for professional service-Customer invoice-Credit Memo for professional services-Credit memo-The form template Customer invoice for professional service is first in the sequence and hence is considered for the Customer Invoice preview and you have not maintained the form template for this one in Form template Maintainence View. The template which is first in the sequence is used by the system to determine which form template to use for the output of a business document. The rules entered in the sequence are applied along with condition which you have maintained for each rule.You have to enter generic rules at the bottom of the list and specific rules at the top.-Resolution-Change the sequence of the form templates by following the below steps-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Input and Output Management View and naviagate to subview Form Template Selection-Select Show Rules For Customer Invoice-Select the rule Customer Invoice and Click on Change Sequence button and move the rule to Top  -See Also-1981017 - In your Sales Order no Form Templates are Displayed When Selecting Preview-Keywords-wrong template; not expected; Form Template; Determination; No Records;

Title: Dashboards Display Only 50 Records
Content: Symptom-When consuming analytical data from Dashboards in table format, the Dashboards are retrieving only 50 records when there are more entries available to be displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system.-Go to work center ABC (ABC represents the work center name).-Go to the relevant work center view.-Start the Adaptation mode.-Click + (add) icon in the screen.-Select Reports tab.-Select the relevant report.-Click Apply.-Check into the added report, and note that it Displays only 50 records.-Cause-This is the expected behavior. Dashboards are designed to display a small amount of data, focusing on providing quick insights, working differently than Analytical Reports which are designed to display larger amounts of data.-Resolution-In case a Larger Data amount needs to be consumed, then data must be consumed from Analytical Reports UI instead of Dashboards.-Keywords-Dashboards; Data Limit; Dashboard Data Limit; 50 records;

Title: Document ID is not Updated in Bank Statement Transaction Data
Content: Symptom-You create a new incoming check, assign it to a check deposit and then assign this to a bank statement.-Later you cancel the check deposit and the check and recreate them again. -You then check the bank statements Transaction tab. Here, the old, now reversed incoming check ID still appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank Statements view.-Search for the Bank Statement ID.-Select the Bank Statement.-Go the Transactions tab. -In the Transactions Data sub-tab, in the Document ID field you see the original, now reversed incoming check ID. You expect the new check ID to be displayed.-Cause-The Document ID field only displays the first document reference when the bank statement is created. Any changes/updates of the document flow are not reflected here.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-Bank Statement, Document ID, Incoming Check

Title: How to Nullify Safety Stock Value in Material Master Data?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to phase-out some materials to archive them and would like to know if there's a mass change option available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The quantity field SafetyStockQuantityValue cannot be updated to a null value using the Migration Tool due to the framework of the same. It is also not changeable through the Mass Change function in the Material work center view.-However, it is possible to set the field to zero using the A2X web service ManageMaterialIn. Sample payload is as follows:-<Material actionCode="02">-<InternalID>XYZ</InternalID>-<Planning actionCode="04">-<SupplyPlanning actionCode="04">-<SupplyPlanningAreaID>ABC</SupplyPlanningAreaID>-<SafetyStockQuantityValue>0</SafetyStockQuantityValue>-</SupplyPlanning>-</Planning>-</Material>-(Where XYZ stands for the ID of the material to be changed and ABC stands for the ID of the planning area of which the safety stock will be nullified.)

Title: Approval is Expected To Be Triggered After Clicking on Submit Again
Content: Symptom-You have set Approval Process for a Sales Quote.-Document is sent to approval and approved. After that, you delete one item, click on Submit and the document is not triggered for approval again as expected.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the New Sales Quote common task.-Create the document, and click on Submit button.-Sales Quote ABC is triggered for Approval (ABC is the Sales Quote ID).-Sales Quote ABC is approved.-Then, you delete one item from Sales Quote ABC, and click on Submit button again.-Approval is not triggered again as expected.-Cause-The document is not going for Approval again as the Profit Margin increases in this situation for the document header.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior as the new Profit Margin (after the deletion) is not less than the older.-Keywords- Approval, Not trigger, Deletion, Profit Margin

Title: Error Message: "Not allowed to delete last WorkAgreement for Employee X" When Replicating Employees to ByD
Content: Symptom- When trying to replicate employees to Business ByDesign using the Master Data Replication work center, the replication run raises the following error message:-"Not allowed to delete last WorkAgreement for Employee X" (where X is the ID of the employee in ByD)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee request to be executed and click on Edit.-Click on the Replicate Button.-Once the replication is processed, the error message appears.-Cause-When replicating data, the system will try to overwrite the existing data in ByD by deleting it and creating a new record, even if there are no changes performed.-In the case of employment data (such as work agreement information) this cannot be done, so the replication raises an error.-Resolution-Inside the Replication Request edit screen, there is a section named Data Without Changes, which should be used to indicate sections of the employee that were not changed, hence there is no need to be replicated again.-In case there are no changes being performed in the employment data, this checkbox can be used to avoid the error.-Keywords-Concur, EC, Employee Center, HCM

Title: Date Formatting for "Valid From/To" Fields Are Not Correct in Sales Quote Created via Webservice
Content: Symptom- Date Formatting for "Valid From/To" Fields are coming broken in Sales Quote created via webservice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Payload is being passed with the following value: (The Dates below are being used as example)-<ValidityPeriodPeriodTerms actionCode="01">-<StartDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">2021-03-04T12:00:00Z</StartDateTime>-<EndDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">2021-03-21T12:00:00Z</EndDateTime>-</ValidityPeriodPeriodTerms>-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Search for: ABC (ABC is the Sales Quote ID created via webservice).-Open the document, in the View All, fields "Valid From/To" are with the following format: 2021--0-3--Cause-The character '-' being used bettwen dates, like: 2021-03-04 is not expected.-Resolution-This is the expected tag to be used and passed (The Dates below are being used as example):-<ValidityPeriodPeriodTerms actionCode="01">-<StartDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">20210505T12:00:00Z</StartDateTime>-<EndDateTime timeZoneCode="UTC">20251230T12:00:00Z</EndDateTime>-</ValidityPeriodPeriodTerms>-Keywords-Valid From/To, Field, Broken date, Sales Quote, webservice

Title: Broadcast Received in Wrong Language
Content: Symptom-You received a Broadcast e-mail in a language which is different from the language in your user settings.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Broadcast from your e-mail inbox.-The e-mail is in a different language. The report or dashboard attached to the e-mail is also in a different language.-Cause-The language of the Broadcast is determined by the language of the user who creates the broadcast.-Resolution-You receive the broadcast in the language of the user who created the Broadcast. To change this, you can mark the broadcast as user specific, which will ensure that the users receive the broadcast according to their own language setting. Please see the KBA 3021208 for further reference.-See Also-3021208 - Users Receive Reports via Broadcast, but in Different Languages-Keywords-Broadcast, wrong language

Title: System Crashes While Uploading Serial Numbers During Post Goods Issue.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload serial numbers while performing a Post Goods Issue, however the system is crashing during the process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center-Go to the Delivery Control view, Delivery Proposals sub view-Select the relevant Delivery Proposal-Select Post Goods Issue button-Navigate to Line Items tab and select the sub tab Serial Numbers-In the Next Serial Number field, select Upload button-Select the upload file and select Open-Cause-The file which you are uploading contains more than 500 serial numbers, therefore the system crashes.-Resolution-In the current release, it is not possible to upload the serial numbers on big batches (such as 500 at a time). Instead you can split the serial numbers into multiple files and then upload the same.

Title: Forecasting Group ID showing wrong value
Content: Symptom-You are looking for to use the 'Forecasting Group ID' characteristic of the 'Material Planning' data source to build a report, but the values shown by this characteristic are incorrect.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In order to reproduce the issue, kindly follow the step by step below:-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Data Sources view-Search for the 'Material Planning' data source-Open it-Move the 'Forecasting Group ID' characteristic to rows tab-See there are values which are not compatible with the values you maintain in your Forecasting Group ID's-In order to verify the Forecasting Group ID's you have in your system, kindly follow the step by step below:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center-Go to Forecasting Groups view-Click on the Actions button-Click on the Expand All option-See your Forecasting Groups which are maintained in your system-Cause-This behavior is experienced since the 'Material Planning' data source was designed to work this way. The 'Forecasting Group ID' field actually references the 'Product Category ID' accordingly to this specific data source documentation in the system.-Resolution-In order to get the correct value and also the correct characteristic 'Forecasting Group ID', you may use the 'Forecasting Group Master Data' data source and create a left outer join between the 'Material Planning' data source and the 'Forecasting Group Master Data' data source, following this approach, you may retrieve the data you wish from this join data source and create your report based on it.-Remember to use the 'Forecasting Group Master Data' data source as the anchor in order to successfully create the left outer join.-Keywords-material planning, mat_planning, forecasting group, product category id

Title: How to delete a report condition from the backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Use Only ***-*** To be performed by PS Analytics only ***-The customer reported an issue where the upload of a report fails. While analyzing the issue, you notice that in the downloaded report file, there is a report condition. However on the report UI, no such condition can be found. You need to delete the condition in the backend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-[Enter your Reproducing the Issue here...]-Cause-Due to a temporary inconsistency, an old condition was not deleted fully and is still present in the report metadata.-Resolution-You can delete the condition as follows:-Log in to the backend of the source system (where the report is downloaded).-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO MDRS_MKFC_DSPSET.-Load by Query > ROOT_Query by Elements.-Under MDAVKeyfigureCompositeKey/ProxyName, enter the report ID and execute this.-You will get one or more results, depending on how many report views exist for this report.-Mark all the report views and go to Navigate > CONDITION.-Any condition that is still present in the backend will be listed here.-Please note: Be careful to never delete a condition that is still in use. Compare with the conditions that you find on the report UI!-Once you have identified which condition needs to be removed, click the pencil icon (Set Edit Mode).-Mark the specific line with the condition that needs to be deleted and click the bin icon (Delete).-Click the Save button.-Keywords-report, upload, download, data source, key figure, condition, exception, error message, delete, back end, Report component does not exist, xml, T_CONDITION

Title: Inbound Delivery ID Appears as # in the Confirmation Journal Report
Content: Symptom-You want to see the Inbound Delivery ID details in the Confirmation Journal report, but the system is only showing the value # in the Delivery ID fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Data Sources view and select Design Data Sources.-Select the Data Source ID: SCMCFJU01 (Confirmation Journal).-Select Preview.-Move Original Document Type, Reference Document Type and Inbound Delivery ID to rows.-You see that the value of the Inbound Delivery ID is displayed as #.-Cause-The Confirmation Journal report is meant to show only the Confirmations that affect the Inventory for particular selection parameters.-Resolution-The Confirmation Journal report is meant to show only the Confirmations that affect the inventory for particular selection parameters. In this case, the Inbound Delivery Notification (IDN) is shown as the Reference Document Type, because the IDN is the immediate preceding document to the Confirmations listed.-If you want to see the details of the Inbound Delivery, you need to navigate to Display Original Document details and from the Document Flow, you can see the Inbound Delivery. The characteristics 'Inbound Delivery ID' and 'Inbound Delivery Item ID' in the Confirmation Journal report are part of special stock separators in the backend of your system. They hold values only in case of Return to Customer/Supplier scenarios. For normal Inbound Deliveries, this field does not store value. Hence, the Delivery ID value appears as # in the report.--Note: You can make use of the characteristics Reference Document Type and Reference Document ID to check the receipts against the report. For these characteristics you would get the Inbound Delivery Notification ID instead of the "Inbound delivery ID.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Report, Inbound Delivery, Not Assigned,  Confirmation Journal

Title: Unable to Select the Standard Data Type Division Code in BCO
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the standard data type Division Code as a subtype in your custom business configuration objects.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Cloud Aplications Studio.-Open the relevant custom solution.-Navigate to the affected .BCO file.-Try to find the Division Code under the subtype column which is not available, although the data type is released.-Cause-The data type Division Code is not a compatible data type to be used as a code data type on a BCO and hence this data type is filtered out when showing in the wizard.-Resolution-You can use the data type Division Code in the script and will work fine. If you want to use it on a code list, you will have to create a custom codelist and use it in the BCO.-See Also-You can also refer this KBA for more details 2700811 - How to Add New Values from the UI to the Codelist Created from SDK?-Keywords-Division, Code, Data, type, not, available, missing-standard data type missing,division code missing in bco

Title: Key Date Not Available in OData Query Filter
Content: Symptom-In some reports, for example, Material Inventories - Balance Summary (FININVU14_Q0001), 'Key Date' is available for selection but not available in OData queries filter when using Build OData Queries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open a report, for example, Material Inventories - Balance Summary (FININVU14_Q0001).-You can see 'Key Date' is available in Selection. -Click Build OData Queries.-Search for 'Key Date' in Filters tab.-You will notice that 'Key Date' is not available.-Cause-The parameter 'Key Date' is actually available in the OData Service. It does not show up in the Query Builder.-You can find it in the $metadata document, for example, f'. /sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/$metadata?entityset=RPFININVU14_Q0001QueryResults'.-Resolution-If you want to provide a $filter on it, you can write the $filter statement manually.-See Also-2734842 - Attributes Not Available in OData Query-Keywords-Key Date, OData, Report

Title: Form Template Code is Missing in the Output Channel Selection
Content: Symptom-You want to set up a Form Template Code for the Delivery Note, for example, but the Form Template Code "disappears" after creating a new Output Channel Rule.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Workcenter.-Select Output Channel Selection.-Search for Delivery Note and hit Go.-Click New and you will see shortly the field Form Template Code.-However, it is not available other than in the Form template selection for the same document.-Cause-The Delivery Note is already the Main Form Template code. For example for Customer invoice documents, you can use the Form template code since we have sub-forms here such as Credit Memo etc. All forms which do not have sub-forms as mentioned will not have the Form Template option.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior for the Delivery Note Output Channel Selection.-Keywords-Form Template Code, Output Channel.

Title: Unable to Use KUT Fields in PDI Enhancement Implementation
Content: Symptom-You will receive the below errors while trying to activate an ABSL file created for an enhancement implementation within the SAP Cloud Applications Studio:-Error in activation of runtime object-Syntax error in generated ABAP method-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the solution in the Studio.-Select and activate the KUT extension field in the .ref file for the respective XBO.-Navigate to the ABSL file created for the Enhancement Implementation.-Make use of the KUT field in the coding.-Save and Activate.-Error appears.-Cause-The activation fails because accessing KUT fields on a script is currently not supported in BAdi (Business Add-in/Enhacement Implementation). When the code in the backend is generated for the corresponding ABSL file, the declaration to handle KUT fields are skipped, leading to errors in the generated ABAP classes.-Resolution-Usage of KUT extension fields on an ABSL script is currently not supported for a BADI Implementation. As a workaround, you can use the extension fields from the XBO.-Keywords-CustomerObjectReferences, spot, PDI, SDK-customerobjectreferences in badi,syntaxt error in generated abap method,public

Title: Relative Selections for Fiscal Time Characteristics Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You have created a customized data source using FIN data sources. In step 4 of the Report Wizard you are trying to assign a relative selection to a fixed value selection for a fiscal time characteristic such as Fiscal Year. However after confirming this with OK you are receiving a warning message:-Relative selects for fiscal time deleted (no keyfigure group is used)-Also you notice that your changes on this characteristic are gone i.e. the field Value Selection shows the default value again instead of Fixed Value Selection.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-You go to the Business Analytics work center.-You go to the Design Reports view.-Mark the report which was built on the joined data source and click on Edit With Report Wizard.-Proceed to step 4.-For the Fiscal Year attribute select Value Selection = Fixed Value Selection.-Click on button Set Fixed Value Selection.-For the Fiscal Year attribute click on More and choose Relative Select = last 2 fiscal years.-Click OK, and then OK again.-You will get the warning message Relative selects for fiscal time deleted (no keyfigure group is used).-Also the value selection for Fiscal Year is reverted from Fixed Value Selection to No Value Selection.-Cause-This happens because relative selections require specific coding exits (e.g. for the determination of applicable fiscal year variant) which are only available on SAP delivered key figure structures. These key figure structures are only available on SAP delivered standard data sources.-Resolution-You cannot use relative selections for fiscal time characteristics (fiscal year, quarter, etc) on customized data sources.-Keywords-attribute, relative selection, fixed value,

Title: Error: Authorization missing for payment method Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance
Content: Symptom-Error shows in Payment from Payment Run using Payment Method Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Payment Runs view.-Select relevant Run.-Click View Payment Proposals.-Click relevant Payment.-Error:-Authorization missing for payment method Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance-Payment details not determined-Cause-A possible cause is due to the Valid From of the Bill of Exchange Receivable Bank Account that is after the Payment Date of the Payment.-Resolution-This can be adjusted in the Customer Account.-First check that the Bank Account Valid From is also before or on the Payment Date:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Find relevant Customer Account.-Click Edit -  Financial Data.-Go to the Bank Data sub-tab.-Check that the Valid From Date of the Bank Account is before or on the Payment Date.-Go to the Payment Data sub-tab.-Under Bill of Exchange-Change the Valid From to the Payment Date (this field may be hidden and can be added by Personalization).-Click Save.-Once this is done, go back to the Payment.-Click Actions - Determine Payment Details.-You can also do this Action directly on the Payment Run or execute a new Payment Run.-See Also-2750415 - Authorization Missing For Payment Method Bill of Exchange Receivable-1739834 - Authorization Missing For Payment Format Bill of Exchange Receivable [INTERNAL]-Keywords-Payment Run, Bill of Exchange Receivable Without Acceptance, Payment, Authorization missing-payment run,bill of exchange receivable without acce,authorization missing,payment,bill of exchange receivable with accepta

Title: BYD - No payload data in Web Service Message Monitoring
Content: Symptom-In BYD Webservice Message Monitor, for requests with errors, the payload is always empty.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Workcenter "Application and User Management" -> "Input and Output Management: Web Service Message Monitoring.-Make a selection (e.g. display all messages from the past 24 hours).-Select a message and press "View" -> "Payload". -A pop-up called "Payload" is displayed, but it's empty and the button "Download" is grayed out.-Cause-In case of synchronous web service calls: Request – Response type of web service calls.This type of service execution provides an immediate response to a query. In this situation, the client (external application) will wait until the server (BYD) sends back the response message.-Successful calls of this type are not recorded by default in web service message monitoring for the primary reason that the source system will get an instant response with the result of the transaction. However, few failed calls will be logged on web service message monitoring which are raised by SOAP Run-time (such as parsing errors), but the payload contents are not stored.-Resolution-The A2X trace internal function in BYD should be active when the request payload is triggered in order to save the payload contents. To activate it, in Web Service Message Monitoring, click "Start Trace" button, then reproduce the issue.-The payload contents should be visible in the monitor after that the request was triggered.-Keywords-BYD A2X TRACE WSM, BYD - No payload data in Web Service Message Monitoring, No error log in Web Service Message Monitoring

Title: Navigation Targets not available in Columns
Content: Symptom-When characteristics are displayed in Columns, it is not possible to access navigation targets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open any report that has navigation targets available for characteristics and move a characteristic from Rows to Columns, when in Columns, you will receive an error and not be able to navigate to the object.-Cause-Navigation is not supported for any data that is displayed as column header.-Resolution-System is working as designed. Navigation targets are available for characteristics in Rows, but for Columns, this is not supported.-As this is a new functionality request we recommend to follow the below approaches:-If you need this report/functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by Cloud Service Center on https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html . You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-You may also use the SAP Business ByDesign forums, available at: https://www.sap.com/community/topic/business-bydesign.html for questions of this nature.-Keywords-report, business analytics, no navigation targets available,-report navigation,column

Title: Error "Resolve Profit Center Segment Related Warnings in Org Management" While Trying to Finalize Scoping Changes in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add Profit Center/Segment reporting in the scoping of your tenant. Upon trying to complete the configuration, you see the following messages:-Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data. If the error messages are displayed, resolve them before your proceed.-Resolve Profit Centre Segment related warnings in Org Management-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to section 4 - Questions by clicking the Next button.-Select and expand the Financial and Management Accounting option.-Select and expand the General Ledger option.-Select General Ledger.-Under section Questions for General Ledger (right-side column), locate question "You can create financial reports based on segments and profit centers" and check the box for it.-Click Next.-On step 5 - Review, click Finish.-Error message is raised.-Cause-There might be some warnings related to profit centers and/or segments in your current org structure.-In general, before scoping is completed, a check is done to verify if the organizational structure will remain consistent with the new scoping question switched on — although the settings causing the warnings to be raised might be fine in the current Business Configuration, they might not be acceptable after the new scoping is in place.-Resolution-First, check if there are any organizational centers already maintained in the system. If so, check if the structure raises any warnings upon checking:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Access the Org Structures work center.-Select the top-most org unit of your structure.-Click Edit.-In the Planning Area screen, click Check, then select Check All.-If there are warnings, please correct them (the messages have straightforward texts on what must be altered) and activate the changes afterwards. This is highly recommended for any scoping change that may affect Organizational Management.-Once warnings have been resolved, you should be able to scope the question. If there are no warnings or even after resolving them, the error message is still raised in the Business Configuration, please report an incident.-Keywords-Organizational Management, Organizational Structure, Profit Centre, Segment, Profit Center, Segment Accounting, Resolve Profit Centre Segment related warnings in Org Management

Title: Wrong Value is Shown in the Due Balance Field When Add the Down Payment to an Invoice
Content: Symptom-You assign a Down Payment to an Invoice but the Due Balance field does not calculate the amount correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Document view.-In the Show field select the All Items option.-Select the respective item to be invoiced e. g. Outbound Delivery Invoice document XYZ (XYZ represents the document identification number of the Outbound Delivery).-Highlight the invoice document XYZ and press the Edit button.-Select the General tab.-In the Reference Documents section press the Add Row button.-Press the value help in the Down Payment Request ID field.-Navigate to Pricing tab-The invoice value is e.g. 10,000.00 and the Down Payment is 15,000.00. You are expecting that the Due Balance should show a positive 5,000.00, but the field is empty.-Cause-Currently ByD does not allow change the assigned down payment amount on the invoice after the invoice is created.-Resolution-For now the best solution would be to discard the invoice and change the amount on the invoice request. Once the invoice is created it will attempt to add the down payment for the full amount of the invoice.-Keywords-Due Balance; Down Payment; Invoice Document

Title: You Are Getting an Error Message: Customer Hierarchy Specific Discount Product Category XXX With Same Key ZZZ Already Exists When Release the Discount List
Content: Symptom-An error Customer Hierarchy Specific Discount Product Category XXX With Same Key ZZZ Already Exists occurs when release the Discount List view in the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Discount List view.-In the Show field select ABC (ABC represents the description of your custom discount list).-Click on the New button and create Discount List XXX (XXX represents the newly created discount list).-Enter all respective data and Save and then Release the Discount List.-The error message will appear: Customer Hierarchy Specific Discount Product Category XYZ With Same Key ZZZ Already Exists.-(XXX represents the newly created discount list).-(ZZZ represents the Extension field Key used on the discount list).-Cause-When setting up the extension fields you setup custom code to be used to identify the different option that are available. When you select these to be used in sales price list, ByD will store the code value for that value.-So in the case of Automatic Discount Determination, you have maintained the extension 'ZZZ' as code 100 and similar to the other customer extension field ABC (ABC Extension field Key used on the discount list) had code 100 for 'ZZZ' for the field "ABC".-In the database it will sort the code value and in the case of the both price list it would be storing 100 for all the custom values, this is why there is an issue.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you need to use different code in the extension fields if you are going to be used in the price lists.-Keywords-Price Lists; Discount List; Extension Fields

Title: Report Print Option Only Prints Current Page
Content: Symptom-When printing a report, you can see that only the current page is being printed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports work center view.-Open and run any report.-You can see it has more than one page.-Click on 'Print' button.-It opens 'Print Preview' screen.-You can see it has only current page.-Cause-If the report you are accessing has more than one page, when you click on Print button, the Print Preview only shows the first page and would print only the current page.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior. In order to print all pages, you will need to choose the next page again and click on 'Print' button again to print another pages.-See Also-Viewing Reports with the Web Browser Option-Keywords-print preview, report print, current page print, report print current page, current page, print, print preview

Title: Access Restriction for Price Lists does not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-You have set up access restrictions for price lists for a user but the user is still able to see and edit all price lists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Select user XYZ (XYZ represents the user ID).-Click the Edit button and select the Access Rights option.-Navigate to the Access Restrictions tab.-Select the work center view ID CRM_PRICELISTS.-You can see that the view is read and write restricted. The user only has read and write access for the org unit he is assigned to.-When user XYZ logs on to the system:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price Lists view.-In the show field select Customer Specific Price List.-The user can see all price lists.-  Cause-This is the expected system behaviour. The access restrictions for pricing master data (such as price lists, discount lists and surcharges) can only be applied if a sales organization is an attribute of the price list type (for example distribution chain price list).-The mentioned price lists are customer specific price lists which do not depend on the sales organization. It is not possible to restrict the customer specific price lists based on the sales organizations where this account is setup for sales.-Resolution-One possible solution is to create a new condition table which includes the account and sales organization (also likely distribution channel). These fields appear on the general tab of price lists.-This can be done in the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-See Also-Please see also the Help Center documentation Quick Guide for Pricing in Customer Relationship Management.-You can find more information on how to in the Help Center document: Pricing with Extension Fields.

Title: Account Collaboration Data Report Displaying Not Assigned Values
Content: Symptom-You are looking to use the standard report Account Collaboration Data (technical ID: BPCSCARB_Q0001), however, after executing the report you notice that several characteristics display Not Assigned or # values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to the Design Reports view.-Search for the report Account Collaboration Data.-Select the report and open it.-Execute the report.-See the values.-Cause-This is currently the behavior when this report is executed and you are using the feature of Multi Channel for Output Management. This feature is working correctly, however, the reporting was not yet adopted to this use case, therefore, it is not possible to see the data in this report.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-If you need this functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by Cloud Service Center . You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of SAP Application Development site , choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea.-Keywords-Account Collaboration Data; Report; Data Source; Analytics; Business Analytics; Not Assigned; #; Limitation; Multi Channel for Output Management; ByD;

Title: Query Response Shows Multiple List Price
Content: Symptom-You have sent a Query payload to the system, and in the response, you see that the system is returning multiple list prices, even though in the UI you see only one price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Example: Customer Invoice.--The system displays more than one list price, as the Query results show all the prices that were determined for the product in Invoice Document.-Resolution-This is the expect system behavior.-Please see an sample Request payload below (XXXXX represents the internal system IDs.):-      <glob:CustomerInvoiceByElementsQuery_sync>-         <CustomerInvoiceSelectionByElements>-            <SelectionByID>-               <InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>-               <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>-               <LowerBoundaryIdentifier>XXXXX</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>-            </SelectionByID>-         </CustomerInvoiceSelectionByElements>-       </glob:CustomerInvoiceByElementsQuery_sync>-Keywords-Double; Price List; Response; Query; Web Service;
