Title: Balance Confirmation: Delete Button Is Grayed Out
Content: Symptom-The Delete button is grayed out for either Receivable or Payable Balance Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables or Payables work center.-Go to the Balance Confirmation view.-Select the row of the Balance Confirmation ID AAA (AAA means the Balance Confirmation ID).-Notice that the Delete button is grayed out.-Cause-Once a Balance Confirmation has been Released, it's no longer possible to Delete it.-The Delete button is only available for Balance Confirmations in statutes Not Released and Release Discarded (after Void action).-Resolution-System behaves as per design.-Keywords-balance confirmation; delete; released; not released; release discarded; payables; receivables;

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate Disappears When Adding Item in New Manual Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have added a Tax Exemption Certificate to the Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account) and when you add an item to the Invoice Request, the system automatically removes the Tax Exemption Certificate data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the New Manual Invoice  from the common tasks.-Enter Account ID.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row button.-Enter product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the item).-Navigate to the Taxes subtab.-The following information disappears:-Tax Exemption Certificate checkbox marked.-Tax Exemption Certificate ID.-Tax Exemption Reason.-Cause-You have not maintained a price or net value for the item maintained in the document.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Enter the List Price manually to the Invoice or, create a Price List for the item under the Price Lists view, in Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Keywords-Tax Exemption Certificate; Manual Invoice; System Remove; Item;

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate not Determine in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have added a Tax Exemption Certificate to the Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account) and you expect to see the certificate under the items tab of the Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the New Manual Invoice from the Common Tasks.-Enter Account ID.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row button.-Enter Product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the item).-Navigate to the Taxes subtab.-The following information disappears:-Tax Exemption Certificate checkbox marked.-Tax Exemption Certificate ID.-Tax Exemption Reason.-Cause-The reason the exemption certificate appears as soon as the Account ID is added, is because the evaluation of exemption certificates does not happen at that point.-The evaluation of exemption certificates happens when adding the item and then the tax exemption priority of the system is as follows:-Tax event exemption.-The following are for countries, except Germany and US (Exemptions are all already covered by decision tree).-Business Partner (Account) exemption in Financial tab, Taxes subtab.-Tax Exemption Certificate.-Product exemptions.-Resolution- This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-2804294 - Tax Exemption Certificate is not Determined in Item Level of Manual Invoice-2804301 - Tax Exemption Certificate Disappears When Adding Item in New Manual Invoice-Keywords-Tax Exemption Certificate; Manual Invoice; Missing; System Remove; Determine;

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate is not Determine in Item Level of Manual Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have added a Tax Exemption Certificate to the Account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Account) and you expect to see the certificate under the items tab of the Customer Invoice.-However, the system is not triggering the Tax Exemption Certificate information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the New Manual Invoice from the common tasks.-Enter Account ID.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row button.-Select the Taxes subtab.-You expect to see the following:-Tax Exemption Certificate checkbox marked.-Tax Exemption Certificate ID.-Tax Exemption Reason.-Cause-The reason this information was not automatically maintained, is because the system was not able to determine a currency.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please maintain a currency under the general tab of the manual invoice request, or maintain the currency under the Sales Data tab of the Account.-Steps:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the Account ABC.-Open the Account ABC.-Navigate to the Sales Data tab.-Select the line of the expected Sales Organization.-Under Details, click on the drop-down for Currency.-Select the expected Currency.-Click Save.-Once this information was not automatically maintained, is because the system was not able to determine a currency.-Keywords-Tax Exemption Certificate; Manual Invoice; Missing; System Remove;

Title: You Get An Error Message When You Try To Delete A Sales Quote: "Deleting Document Not Possible; Output History Exists"
Content: Symptom-You get an error message when you try to delete a sales quote: "Deleting document not possible; output history exists."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-Select the sales quote XYZ and choose the Delete button.-The sales quote cannot be deleted due to the error message: "Deleting document not possible; output history exists."-Cause-The sales quote was already submitted in the past and output was sent to the customer account.-It is not possible to delete sales quotes which already have the output history, this is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-Instead of deleting the sales quote, you can cancel the quote by adding a Reason for Rejection:-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-Select the Go button.-Edit sales quote XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the General tab.-Add a value in the Reason for Rejection field.-Save the sales quote.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]

Title: Sender Address in the Output Document of a Sales Document is not the Expected One
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-The sender address in the output document of a sales document such as a customer invoice is not the expected one.-Images/data in this KBA are from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems.  Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The sender address in the output document of a sales document such as a customer invoice is not the expected one.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Open invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Go to the Output Documents tab.-Open the generated PDF.-The Sender Address in the letter head of the PDF is not the expected one this is for example:-Almika | Somestreet 123 | 12345 Hannover | Deutschland-The Sender Address in the form template is determined by the Form Master Template.-You need to first check the master template:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Master Template Maintenance view.-In the Show field select Form Master Templates-Select template ABC (ABC represents the master template which is used for the respective sales document)-Click on Edit.-You can see that the Sender Address is a different one that in the PDF for example:-Almika | Anotherstreet 456 | 12345 Hannover | Deutschland-Cause-The reason for this could be that the Form Master Template ABC was changed when invoice XYZ was released.-Resolution-You can check the versions of the Form Master Templates in the backend as follows:-Logon to the Backend-Go to transaction XREP-Open the following path:-Development -> SAP_BYD -> Foundation -> Master Templates:-You can see the available Form Master Template.-Select the respective master template (you can find the UI description of the template in the tab Attributes under DESCRIPTION).-Select the Version History tab.-You can see when and by which user the Form Master Template was changed.-Select the respective change entry and click on the button Show Version-Here you can check in the XML which changes e.g. Sender Address were made.

Title: Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Sales Revenue. Specify Account Determination in Chart of Accounts and Account Determination Profile.
Content: Symptom-You cannot post customer invoice due to the error message: "Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue. Specify account determination in chart of accounts and account determination profile <PQR> (PQR is the account determination profile ID). Column Path Sales->Rounding Differences->Rounding Differences, Position/Item Type Sales Revenue."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents subview in the Closing Cockpit view.-Search for Source Document ABC (ABC is the Source Document ID) and select it.-The Status is In Process.-The error message is "Account determination is missing for item type Sales Revenue. Specify account determination in chart of accounts  and account determination profile <PQR>. Column Path Sales->Rounding Differences->Rounding Differences, Position/Item Type Sales Revenue."-Click Actions View Business Transaction and then View All.-Click Post.-You get the error message mentioned above.-Click on the task to open the same.-The description is "Account Determination is missing. Configure account determination in chart of accounts and account determination profile <PQR>. Column Path Sales->Rounding Differences->Rounding Differences, Position/Item Type Sales Revenue."-Cause-You have not maintained a G/L-Account for Rounding Difference for account determination in chart of accounts and account determination profile <PQR>. Column Path Sales->Rounding Differences->Rounding Differences, Position/Item Type Sales Revenue in business configuration.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click the link to open the same.-Click the Sales Link under Account Determination.-For Account Determination Profile PQR, navigate to the Rounding Differences tab.-No G/L-Account is maintained.-Resolution-In order to add the required G/L-Account: -Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click the link to open the same.-Click the Sales Link under Account Determination.-For Account Determination Profile PQR, navigate to the Rounding Differences tab.-Add the G/L-Account.-Click Save.-In order to post the business transaction/ the source document:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents subview in the Closing Cockpit view.-Search for Source Document ABC and select it.-Click Actions Post Business Transaction.-Keywords-Column Path Ergebnisrechnung; Rundungsdifferenzen; Item Type Sales Revenue; Account determination; Rounding Differences; Position Type Sales Revenue; Kontenfindung

Title: Frequently Asked Question on Compensation WOC
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-These are some frequently issue and queries from customers about the Compensation WOC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-1.   Customer scoped Compensation subsequently. Now no active employees are shown in employee list-Please execute Reports one after the other.-a. AP_CMP_ECA_MIGRATE_FOR_UPGRADE-b. AP_EPA_FOR_UPGRADE-c. AP_TIM_RECON_WITH_PAYROLL-2.   Why you cannot perform an update for "Migration of compensation data" for rehired employees due to error message: 'Cannot open compensation file; compensation hire is not complete'?-According to the system design if we are migrating the compensation data of employee using migration template then the data will pick the work agreement which was created when employee was migrated into system and it will update the compensation agreement item node which was associated with this work agreement.-If Employee is rehired in system then another work agreement is created for the employee.Now when customer is trying to migrate the compensation detail of employee, the data is not getting stored in the compensation agreement item node which was created when employee is rehired, the data is stored in the compensation agreement item node which was created during migration.-Since employee is rehired into system using UI so compensation data has to be maintained again using UI-3.   Why is it in report HCMCMPB01_Q0002 not possible to show the Name and the Compensation Component ID at the same time?-The compensation component description was so far not enabled for reporting, so this feature is currently not available.-4. Why Compensation workcenter is not available after Scoping Compemsation from Busienss Configuration?-      The Compensation workcenter is dependent on Payroll worcenyet scope till 1908 release. Once the Payroll workcenter is scoped, you will be abe to see Compensation workcenter in you ByDesign Systems until 1908. After 1911 release, the two workcenters will be delinked and set as independant.-Further information you will find in:-CD 2249516 - Grade Field is Not Displayed for Inactive Employees-CD 1662085 - Error Message 'No Support for Recurring Compensation Component Type' in Payroll Processing-Keywords-Compensation, faq on Compensation, Compensation woc

Title: Wrong Language Determination in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You created a new form template for customer invoice with Adobe Lifecycle  Designer, the template  is created  for accounts in XYZ(XYZ represents the preferred language) ,then you uploaded and published the template.-After this,Once you preview the invoice ABC(ABC represents the ID of invoice) which is newly created, you notice the language in invoice is not in XYZ.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-2. Select the Invoice Documents view-3. Show All Invoice Documents-4. Find  invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of invoice)-5. Select invoice ABC -6. Choose Preview tab-You find the language in invoice ABC is not XYZ-Cause-No communication language defined in the Master Data of the Bill-To party in invoice ABC. Therefore, the system uses the logon language of the user to determine the language of the form template. --If the Invoice is not released yet, you can check which Account is used as Language Source and the Language determined when you click on the You Can Also Button and Select the Edit Output Document-In the sub tab Output Details of the new window you can see the Business Partner used as Language Source and the respective Language which is determined.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center-Go to the Account view-Edit  Account DEF(DEF represents the account name of invoice ABC)-Choose View All tab-Go to the General tab. The language can be maintained in the Main Communication Data.-Choose Save it-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Form Template; Language; Sprache; Kundenrechnung; Bill-To Party; Bill To

Title: Values in Form Template Appear in Incorrect Order on Preview
Content: Symptom-You have added an extension field into a table in a custom form template using Adobe Live Cycle Designer. And observes that values in column appear in wrong order or appear mismatched during the preview in the system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have opened the Form Template in Adobe Live Cycle Designer.-You see that the current binding of the column looks like, e.g: $.FinancialTransactions.ManagementFees[*].WeightedManagementFeesForm-Upon adding an XML to the Preview PDF on Adobe and viewing the Form you observe that the values in the Form appear mismatched. E.g: Value from line 1 appear in the line 2.-The binding could be anyone, this used here is just an example.-Cause-Such kind of Binding of column can cause ADS to jump to next instance of row item to get the value, if there is no value in the current instance of the row item for the Column. To avoid such skipping or jumping to occur, we need to be perform binding slightly differently.-Resolution-We need to adapt the Binding at Row level and column level, so the correct values appear for the respective row.-To do so, follow the steps as follows:-Select the Row of the Table from the Form Template Hierarchy tab and add the Binding to the Row only till the row item level, for the above example it would be as follow: $.FinancialTransactions.ManagementFees[*]-Once the value has been maintained at Row level of the Form template, we can go on and maintain the value of the column field as: $.WeightedManagementFeesForm-Once such a change has been performed you will observe that the values start coming up correctly upon Preview.-In case you do not want to see blank values upon preview, you can add default value through the Value tab of the field.-Keywords-Wrong value Form Template, Wrong Preview, Incorrect order of values of Preview, mismatch value preview

Title: Concur Integration Expense Types Wrongly Mapped to the Category "Other Expenses"
Content: Symptom-When posting an Expense Report into SAP Business ByDesign from SAP Concur, the ByDesign Expense Category is only determined correctly for Concur Hotel Expenses type.-All other Expense Types are mapping to the category "Other Expenses".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Concur Integration-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view.-Select the Project ABC.-Click Edit Time and Expenses.-Click Quantity and Expense Detail in the bottom of the screen.-Check the row for the Project Task ABC-D: you will see that mostly of the Expenses Category are "Other Expenses", and the ones which are not "Other Expenses" are appearing as "Lodging".-Cause-Currently for Concur Integration scenario with SAP Business ByDesign only the description of the External Expense Types are mapped, and not the Expense Category Code.-Resolution-This functionality is currently not available and the Expense Category will be either 1-Lodging or 4-Other Expenses.-In case you would like to change the same, you can post a requirement in the SAP Customer Influence Portal for SAP Business ByDesign.-Based on priority of release, it will be decided whether it can be picked and when it can be developed and deployed.-Keywords-Expense Category, Expense Reports, Integration, Concur, Mapping, Business Configuration, Concur Integration, ByDesign

Title: Value Missing Under New Column Created With Easy Form
Content: Symptom-You have created a new column in a form template usying Easy Form editor, but the value dos not appear in the template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the "ABC" work center.-2. Select the "YYZ" view.-3. Search for Document "ABC".-4. Click Preview.-5. Click on the Document.- You will see that data under new column created is not appearing.-Cause-Easy Form only supports absolute binding to the field in form template, so as this is relative binding the Easy Form will not trigger this binding and hence the data is not shown.-Resolution-You can either remove the relative binding at table "rowMain" that will automatically set absolute paths for all the underlying fields, or mantain the binding using Adobe LiveCycle Designer (ALD) for the affected field to set the relative path.-You can open the form template in ALD and check how the absolute biding looks like from Easy Form.-Example: $.FinancialTransactions.ManagementFees[*].WeightedManagementFeesForm-This is how relative binding looks like:-Example: $.WeightedManagementFeesForm-If you set the relative binding in ALD manually, the data should appear in template just fine.-See Also-You can also check the KBA "2804532 " which is related to values in Form Template.-Keywords-Easy Form; Missing; Binding; Absolut; Relative

Title: You Are Not Able to Create Service Confirmation for Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-You are not able to create Service Confirmation for sales order item. The function is greyed out and not available.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Here you would like create a service confirmation for a line item but the option is greyed out-Cause-The service items in the sales order are all tied to project tasks.-In project based scenario, fulfilment and invoicing for the line item happens through the project and not the sales order, times need to be recorded against the employee responsible for the task in question. The project then sends a message to the Project Sales Order (visible in the extended document flow) which in return sends a message to the sales order, updating the statuses.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Remarks for Supplier not Showing in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating an Intercompany Sales Order using webservice and the Remarks for Supplier is not being added to the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-If Remarks for Supplier is coming from a webservice, when the Sales Order is created from a Purchase Order (Purchase Order being the source document), the system converts the Remarks for Supplier into Internal Comments, as the Sales Orders is supposed to be the supplier if considering the functionality point of view.-When you create a Purchase Order from a Sales Order, the system sends the information maintained under the Remarks for Supplier, and this is sent for the supplier party, which can be the Purchase Order or a Third-Party scenario.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-In case there is a desire to still use the same service to create the documents, it is recommended to use a custom Add-On to achieve the expected behavior. Once the Sales Order is created, a Add-On can be created to perform updates in the Remarks for Supplier field.-Keywords-Remarks for Supplier; Sales Order; Webservice; Purchase Order;

Title: Error Message in Deletion of Access Sequence
Content: Symptom-You are facing an error message when trying to remove a standard table from the Access Sequence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we use the standard table Overall Customer Discount.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Hyperlink.-Click on Access Sequence.-Scroll to and select:-Relevance: Item Level-Name: Discounts-Search for Overall Customer Discount.-Remove button is enable.-Click on the Remove button.-Error: "Please remove SAPPR002 in maintenance group Overall Customer Discount before removing pricing table SAPPR002"-Cause-Once a standard table is added it cannot be removed from the Access Sequence as long as the standard price/discount list is not de-scoped which is using that particular table.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Access Sequence; Remove; Error; Price List; Discount List;

Title: Logistics Area ID Missing For Point Of Sale Sales Transaction
Content: Symptom-System throws following error message while processing Point-Of-Sale Sales Transactions for Third Party Logistics Site (3PL) --Logistcis Area ID Is Missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Customer Invoicing Work Center-Go To  Point-of-Sale Transactions View-Go To Sales Transactions Sub-view-Create the Sales Transaction  - here, the site selected is a 3PL site-Logistcis Area Field will be blank-At this point, system throws error message - Logistcis Area ID Is Missing-Cause-Third Party Logistics Warehouse/Site is not supported for a Point of Sale transactions. 3PL sites are externally managed & the layout creation (i.e. Logistcis Areas) doesn't exist for a 3PL site.--Resolution-This is the standard system behavior

Title: Nayose Enablement Confirmation (Japan)
Content: Symptom-You want to edit a Japanese Customer Financial Data to do some amendment on the account (for example: amend credit limits).-On action: Edit > Financial Data, you have the Nayose Enablement Confirmation box and you wonder which action to take.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Open the Advanced Filter icon.-In the field Country, select Japan.-Select Go.-You have your Japanese customers.-Select the line item of the account you want to amend.-Select Edit > Financial Data.-You have the Nayose enablement confirmation box stating:-Changes done till now will be saved before enabling Nayose feature for this customer. Do you want to proceed with saving the changes? Save Changes and Continue. Cancel enablement of Nayose feature.-Cause-The Nayose confirmation box is once per Account for initial confirmation for all Japan Accounts.-Nayose is an alternate name for the Account and is used for Payment Clearing for both customer account and private account.-Resolution-This is the normal system behavior.-If the Account has any alternate name, you can maintain it here and the Payment Run will use it to clear. If there is record maintained, there will be no effect.-If you save and continue, then the system will consider the alternate name for that account.-You can also save without maintaining any alternate name.-If you cancel the enablement, then the system will not consider alternate name for the account.-This Nayose option is given to user once per account. So, if you select cancel, the feature will not be usable for this customer account.-There is no impact on enabling the Nayose feature on the Japan Invoice Summary functionality or editing the Financial Data of the account.-Note:- An example of alternate name is: If your name is Joe Bloggs, your alternate name is Joe B.-Keywords-Nayose Enablement Confirmation, Japan Nayose feature.

Title: Broadcast logs show more recipients than the one maintained
Content: Symptom-You have created and executed a broadcast. When you check the broadcast logs, you see there is more recipients than the one you maintained.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Choose the view Broadcasts.-Mark a broadcast and either click View Logs, or check the Last Run tab underneath the broadcast table.-You notice that the broadcast was successful (green symbol) but it was sent to more recipients than the one you maintained.-Cause-You had created other broadcasts with the same subject and they are scheduled on the same time.-Resolution-Rename the other broadcasts subject and change the run time.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-broadcast, subject, View Logs, Last Run tab, AP-RC-ANA.

Title: Maintain Determinations for Customized Party Role
Content: Symptom-You have customized a Party Role through the activity 'Involved Parties for Sales Orders' in Business Configuration. You tried to maintain the determinations for it, however, the system shows the message: "No records found."-Also, you have maintained the customized Party Role in the Account Master data, however, the system does not trigger the information in sales documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Click on Open Activity List button.-Search for: Involved Parties for Sales Orders.-Open the activity.-Click on Define New Party Role-Highlight the party role created.-Click on Maintain Determinations button.-The system shows "No records found" as result.-After that, you maintained the information in the Account Master Data, and create a new Sales Order. You expect to see it in Involved Parties tab, however the system does not trigger the information automatically.-Cause-This is the system behavior. For Party Roles customized, it's not possible to maintain any determination rule at account levels.-Resolution-It's only possible to maintain rules for Account Responsibility by Party Role under Employee Work Distribution. Here it's possible to maintain a rule related to the customized Party Role, the country, state, postal code can be changed with respect to Accounts. The combination of the Company and the Account Location can be used to determined the responsibilities for customized roles.-See Also-1820411 - How to Add a Customize Party Role to your Sales Document Using Account Responsibility-1837827 - How to Define Customized Party Roles for Leads and Opportunities-Keywords-Customized ; Party Role ; Determinations ; Account

Title: ODATA Case Sensitive Operators
Content: Symptom-While generating an ODATA query you are using $filter however notice that a filter on specific field does not return specific values.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have generated an ODATA query like the one below:-https://myXXXXXX.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPZ123456789123456789123QueryResults?$select=CREL_CP_WPA_EMAIL_URI_CONTENT&$filter=CREL_CP_WPA_EMAIL_URI_CONTENT eq 'at123@gmail.com'-There are no results even though there is data for this e-mail address.-Cause-$filter is case sensitive but in your query you have used the wrong case for the filter value.-The example above has the e-mail at123@gmail.com in it. Originally this e-mail address would have looked like AT123@gmail.com.-Resolution-You either have to use the correct case for your value or you can make use of the following filter functions: substringof, startswith and endswith.-These operators are translated to a "Contains-Pattern" in ABAP which is not case-sensitive.-By using the startswith operator you will be able to select data that is case sensitive and bypass this sensitivity, see example below:-https://myXXXXXX.crm.ondemand.com/sap/c4c/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPZ123456789123456789123QueryResults?$select=CREL_CP_WPA_EMAIL_URI_CONTENT&$filter=startswith(CREL_CP_WPA_EMAIL_URI_CONTENT,'at123@gmail.com')-See Also-ODATA Blog-Keywords-ODATA, case sensitive, upper case, lower case, report, query, operator, filter, no data, filter not working, returns no data

Title: Extension Field Value is Not Retrieved When Querying Sales Orders via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are not able to Query the value of an Extension Field in Sales Order using the QuerySalesOrder Webservice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In SOAP UI or any other API testing tool, when retrieving Sales Order information via QuerySalesOrder webservice, you notice that the XML response does not include some or all of your Extension Fields.-Cause-This is due to the Extension Fields not being configured to be added to the webservice QuerySalesOrderIn.-To check this, follow these steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open any Sales Order.-Hover over Key User Settings and click Start Adaptation Mode.-In the top-right of the screen, click on the button with your profile picture.-Go into Adaptation Mode.-In the side bar, scroll down until you see a plus ('+') sign.-Click on it and select Extension Fields.-Highlight the extension field that is not being shown in the webservice.-Click on Further Usage.-Go to the tab Services.-You notice that the field is not marked as Field Available for Service: QuerySalesOrderIn (Communication Direction: Outbound).-Resolution-You need to add this field to the QuerySalesOrderIn webservice.-To do so, follow these steps in the screen reached on step 11 of the Cause section:-In the list, highlight the line for Service: QuerySalesOrderIn (Communication Direction: Outbound).-Click on the Add Field button.-Close the Further Usage screen.-See Also-2789125 - Extension Field Value is Not Retrieved When Querying Sales Orders via Webservice Even Though the Field is Marked as Available for Service-Keywords-Sales Order ; Extension Field ; QuerySalesOrderIn ; Webservice

Title: Restriction in 0BYD_MDAV during BW extraction
Content: Symptom-When adding parameters in the BW system to extract information from data sources, you adding restrictions in the field 0BYD_MDAV relative to the data sourced desired for the extraction. e.g 0BYD_MDAV: FINGLAU01.-Even using that specific restriction you are not able to extract the information from the system to BW.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The field 0BYD_MDAV refers to underlying data, or combined data source under the data source referred. Please note that some underlying data sources are not even released to customers, which will also cause an error during the extraction if this restriction in the 0BYD_MDAV is selected.-Resolution-Do not use any value in the field 0BYD_MDAV, if you are not trying to trigger underlying data sources.-Remove this restriction, and let the field empty then retry the extraction.-Keywords

Title: Process Communication Error in Point-of-Sale Transaction: Payment Card Type <ZXX> Not Permitted for Clearing House Account XXX
Content: Symptom-You have a process communication error inside the document flow of the Point-of-Sale Transaction document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Under the Point-of-Sale Transaction view, select Sales Transaction subview.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the document).-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-A process communication error is found under the Sales Transaction document.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Process Communication Errors view.-In the Show field Select Open Errors with Incidents.-Search for Point-of-Sale Transaction ABC.-The following error is displayed for this Sales Transaction Document:-Payment card type <ZXX> not permitted for clearing house account XXX (ZXX represents the ID of the Payment card type and XXX represents the ID of the clearing house account).-Cause-The error is being raised, as the Payment Card is not maintained under the assigned Clearing House. In order to correct the behavior, please maintain the Payment Card ZXX under the expected Clearing House Account.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Under the Master Data view, select Clearing House Accounts subview.-Select the active Clearing House Account XXX.-Click on the Edit button.-Select the Credit Card Types tab.-You see that the Payment Card Type ZXX is not maintained.-Click the Add button.-Enter the expected Payment Card Type, for example ZXX.-Click Save.-Once this is completed, perform the following steps:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Under the Business Data Consistency view, select the Business Documents Differences subview.-Select All Differences.-Search for the Point-of-Sale Transaction ABC.-Click on Start Repeat Check button.-Click on the Document Synchronization button.-In case this does not solve the error, please create an incident with all relevant details.-Keywords-POS; Point-of-Sale; Error; PCE; Process Communication Error; Payment Card Type; Credit Card; Clearing House

Title: Bill-to party Address is missing in a Particular Customer Invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you preview a particular Customer Invoice, the address (Bill-To Party) is missing in that invoice. But, in some other Customer Invoice, the address is displaying as maintained in the Invoice Document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Documents view.-Select Show: All Invoice Documents and Find the invoice.-Select Preview button.-Cause-The cause for the issue could be that, there exist a script for this address with specific condition to display the address based on Price, Country and so on.-For Example, if the script is to show the address only if the price is more than $1000 then,-FormInvoiceRequest.bdyMain.frmSummaryBlock.frmPricing::initialize--// Display Recipient's address and ABN number only if it's $1000.-Resolution-The Form Template works as expected based on the script.-You can check the script of a field using Adobe Lifecycle Designer either online or offline mode.

Title: Norway: Payment Reference Number-Norway of a Supplier Invoice Is Not Present in the Corresponding ISO20022 Payment File
Content: Symptom-The Payment Reference Number-Norway displayed in supplier invoice XYZ is not displayed in ISO20022 payment file AAA.-XYZ means the supplier invoice ID.-AAA means the bank transfer file ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management > Outbound Files view.-Open File ID AAA.-Click View All.-Open the ISO20022 XML file.-Notice that the Payment Reference Number - Norway is not mapped to the payment file.-Cause-Norway is a pre-localized country and as thus, localized payment formats are not supported.-Resolution-If the aim is just about getting the Payment Reference Number - Norway into the ISO20022 file and not in a particular field, there are two options:- -1) Enter the Payment Reference into the External Reference field of the supplier invoice.-This will end up being populated in the <EndToEndId> Tag of the ISO file.- -2) Enter the Payment Reference into the Memo Line of the Payment. This will end up in the <RmtInf><Ustrd> Tag.-Also, if you consider creating a custom payment file structure and custom payment medium format (hence not using standard ISO20022) you can create a field with data source Scandinavian Payment Reference ID.-This data source will display the Payment Reference Type for Norway.-Keywords-Norway; ISO20022; Payment Reference Number - Norway; <EndToEndId>; <RmtInf><Ustrd>; Scandinavian Payment Reference ID

Title: Error When Adding a Custom Pricing Table to the Pricing Group Assignment: "Header condition table 7PL1 and header condition type SAPPL001 is being repeated"
Content: Symptom-The following errors occur when adding a custom pricing table to the pricing group assignment:-Header condition table 7PL1 and header condition type SAPPL001 is being repeated.-Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Configure Price Strategy.-Select the activity Configure Price Strategy and click on Open.-Select the Pricing Tables hyperlink.-You create Pricing Table CUSXYZ (Item Level) and added the respective fields to the pricing table (CUSXYZ represents the pricing table).-You then created an access sequence:-Select the Access Sequence hyperlink.-Select the access sequence Discounts on Item Level.-The Pricing Table CUSXYZ was assigned to e.g. Discounts on Item Level.-You now want to defined a pricing group assignment:-Select the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-Select the pricing group Discounts.-Click on Add Row.-In the Pricing Group Item Assignments section you enter a description and add the header pricing table Base price list and the item pricing table CUSXYZ.-Click on Save.-The following error occurs:-Header condition table 7PL1 and header condition type SAPPL001 is being repeated.-Save Failed-Cause-It is not possible to have another combination with Base price list in the header pricing table. The same condition table cannot be added twice in the access sequence. Since the Base price list is already delivered by SAP this combination cannot be reused.-Resolution-You have to create another price table (e.g. with an extension field assigned) and use this pricing table in combination with the other pricing table you created.

Title: When Creating a New Service Confirmation the Error : "Copying referenced sales order item ID ABC-YY for service confirmation is not possible as it is enabled for time recording" is Triggered
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When Creating a New Service Confirmation the error "Copying referenced sales order item ID ABC-YY for service confirmation is not possible as it is enabled for time recording" is displayed in the UI.-(where ABC represents the Sales Order ID and YY represents the Line Item Number)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-In the Common Task collmun, select New Sales Order.-In the New Sales Order screen, select View All.-In the General tab, enter the Account and other mandatory details.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row button.-In the Product ID field for the Line Item YY add the Service Item PQR (where PQR represents a service item of type Time and Material or Fixed Price).-Click on the button Submit-> Release Order.-Open the Sales Order ABC again.-Select Submit button-> Release to Service Execution.-Mark the Sales Order ABC.-Click on Confirm Execution button.-In the New Service Confirmation screen the error "Copying referenced sales order item ID ABC-YY for service confirmation is not possible as it is enabled for time recording" is displayed in the UI.-Cause-The scoping question "Do you want to record time for sales orders?" is activated under the Business Configuration Work Center. Therefore the confirmation for the Service Items are not done when manually creating a Service Confirmation. Additionally the Service Item are also not populated automatically when creating a manual Service Confirmation.-In this case the Service Confirmation is automatically created when the employee records his/her time for the respective Sales Order Item. The Service Performer can record the time through the Home work center. He/She can enter the time and upon the “Release” action the Service Confirmation is automatically created by the system.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the current Project and click on button Edit Project Scope.-In the Scoping screen, go to the Step 4:Questions.-In the Show field from drop-down select All Elements and expand the scoping element:Sales ->Selling Products and Services->Sales Order.-Uncheck the Question for Sales Orders: Do you want to record time for sales orders?-If the Service Items requires to be confirmed via a manual Service Confirmation, then the scoping question "Do you want to record time for sales orders?" must not be selected.-See Also-See also the following Blog: How to sell Services in Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Order; Service; Service Confirmation; Copying referenced sales order item, Time Recording

Title: Central Case Document: How to Find Trex Index ID and FSI View Which Fetches Data on the Screen - Using STAD Tcode
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-The transaction STAD can be used to find the TrexServer Index and FSI view name that are used by the system to fetch the data on the screen.-Benefits of using STAD:-Setting External breakpoints are not required.-Gives you result in less time compared to external debugging.-Please NOTE:-STAD T-code is a report for checking the workload analysis in the system and consumes lot of system memory and resources, hence it should be used very carefully and only when required customer system to find the indexes or FSI view name.-If the FSI/TREX Index involved in fetching the data from the screen for customer defined report or view, please forward the incident to the relevant Experts.-Steps mentioned in this case document only show how to find involved Trex Index ID and this should not be referred to switch on any sort of system trace.-Target Audience: STAD T-code must only be used by Expert support colleagues.-Environment-SAP Sales Cloud-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Method:-Log on to the Front End and backend with the same user.-Move to screen from front end where you want to find FSI view name. Perform the steps to reproduce as mentioned by the customer.-Now, go to TCode: STAD in the backend.-4. On the STAD screen - SAP Workload : Business Transaction Analysis; under the Filter Parameter tab, enter the client and user details.-5. For field Task Type, select option 1 by click the the value help. Using this option system will record only the overall runtime of a function and some of its attributes – such as the date, time, user, consolidation area, and task category. Press enter.-6. SAP Workload: Single Statistical Records Overview window opens that lists all the transaction performed in the customer system as per the selections.-7. Try to find the program name corresponding to the screens you opened in the frontend and the action you performed.-For example: If you open the Purchase order OWL from the frontend, in backend it will look like SRM_POOWLQRN_CO. In most cases you should be able to find it easily.-8. Double-click the entry -> On the next screen, click the TREX button on the top right of the screen.-10. On new screen, under TREX Records tab, you can find TREX Index ID which is the required join index.-Note:-On the STAD code screen, under Read Interval tab, system by default shows last 10 minutes transaction that happened in the system. So, set the date, time and length fields accordingly.-By clicking on Additional Options button, you can also the date and time past days as well. -As STAD, lists all the statistical records for selected user, ensure exact steps are performed to reproduce the issue. -Every FSI View has one Join index assigned to it. You can search FSI view name from Join index.-Example 1. Join index is .c009:1fs:jdx_bpr_identification_addr. FSI View name is bpr_identification_addr-Example 2. Join index is .c003:1fs:jdx_bupa_ident_a_addr_qrs. FSI View name is bupa_ident_a_addr_qrs.-See Also-Related Case Document: 1650568 - How to find out the FSI View which Fetches Data on the Screen-Keywords

Title: How To Add Non Editable Extension Field to Customer Account Monitor/TRP Register/Business object Trade Receivables Payables Register
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You want to add a Non-Editable Extension Field to Customer Account Monitor/TRP Register/  Business object  Trade Receivables Payables Register.-BO FOPXD_TRPREG is PSM enabled but Write Access is not enabled.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work center.-Go to the Customers view and then to the Customers Accounts Sub view.-Find any Customer Account and Choose view.-Go to Trade Receivables and then to Invoices/Payments Sub view.-You want to add the Extension field in this screen.-Cause-BO FOPXD_TRPREG holds information of posted Invoices, other Receivables/Payables and hence it is not write enabled.-There are other means to ensure that any extra information is persisted in this BO through extension fields.-Resolution-The requirement can be fulfilled with the help of Extension Scenarios.-Go to the Receivables Work center.er Accounts Sub view.-Show All Customers and Find the relevant Customer Account ID.-Select the Customer ID and Choose view.-Go to the Trade Receivables and then to the Invoice/Payments view.-Click Adapt -> Enter Adaptation mode.-Click Adapt again and Go to Edit Screen.-Go to the Extension Fields Hyperlink and Add the field.-Select the visible check box and Go to Further usage Hyperlink.-Go to Extension Scenarios-Customer Invoice - General Information to Trade Receivables Payables Register – Item.-Choose Add field and you can add it.-Once it is added over here, the Extension Field would be available in Customer Invoice Screen.-Go to Further Usage Hyper link.-Go to Extension Scenarios again .-Choose Extension Scenario Invoice Requests - General Information to Customer Invoice - General Information.-Choose Add field.-Then the Extension field should be available on Invoice Request screen.

Title: Issue in SPC Task "Registration RFC (Remote Functional Call) Destination to Target Tenant"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-In Service Provider Cockpit (SPC), the task registration RFC destination to target tenant ends in error and the application log displays Name or password is incorrect (Repeat logon).- Cause-The password of the user SAP_SPC is not in sync in the secure store and tenant.-Resolution-1. Log in to the back end of the SPC tenant and the target tenant.-2. Run the class /A1SSPC/CL_LMPROV_COMMON of the transaction se24 and run GET_PASSWORD_FROM_SEC_STORE in the SPC tenant.-3. Give the tenant ID and user ID, SAP_SPC as input and execute. The password is displayed in secure store as in the previous screenshot.-4. Use transaction SU01 to check if the user SAP_SPC is locked in the tenant. Unlock the user if the user is locked.-5. Check if the password in secure store is set for the user in the tenant in the transaction se37->SUSR_CHECK_LOGON_DATA.-6. Go to the transaction su01 and set the password that you found from secure store for this user.-7. Check se37->SUSR_CHECK_LOGON_DATA. The password will be in sync.-The task registration RFC destination to target tenant will run without issues.-Created by ByDMS-KB-Multitenancy-Keywords
