Title: Rebate Credit Memo not Created; Accrued Amount is Zero
Content: Symptom-You have created a Rebate Agreement, however, the system did not generate the expected Credit Memo.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Rebate Management work center.-Select the Rebate Agreement and Settlement Runs view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Rebate Agreement).-Scroll down to the Execution Details.-Click on the Application Log.-Navigate to the Results tab.-Click Expand All button.-Message: Rebate Credit Memo not created;Accrued amount is zero.-Cause-The reason the system did not generate the Rebate Credit Memo is because of the master data which is not correctly maintained, so that the system may create the document as expected.-To test this, perform the following:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the New Credit Memo from the Common Tasks.-Enter the Account ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Account maintained under the Rebate Agreement).-Click the Check button. -System returns the following errors:-ID of party with role Invoicing Unit missing.-ID of party with role Sales Unit missing.-Party with role Seller missing.-Currency missing.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please maintain the needed configuration of the system, in order to generate the expected Credit Memo.-See Also-2120644 - Unable to Cancel the Manual Credit Memo Invoice Request-Keywords-Rebate; Agreement; Credit Memo; Accrued;

Title: Report to Object Navigations (OBNs) Missing in Custom Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal use only ***-After copying a standard report or creating a new report based on a standard data source, you notice that a report-to-object navigation is missing, even though it was available in the standard report.-For example: In the ByD standard report Confirmation Journal (technical ID: SCMCFJU01_Q0001), there is the navigation Display Original Document Details when you click on a value in the field Original Document ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue- In our example:-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Search for Confirmation Journal and open it.-Run the report and make sure that the characteristic Original Document ID is in the view.-Click on a value of this field.-You will see the navigation Display Original Document Details. If you click on it, a window with the respective document will open.-Go back to the Design Reports view.-Mark the report and click New > Report as Copy.-Go through the steps of creating a report copy and then open your new report.-Add the field Original Document ID to the view.-Click on a value.-No navigation is offered.-Cause-There are 2 different types of report-to-object navigations:-Simple OBNs. They are frequently used for the navigation to master data, such as Account, Product etc. These navigations are set on the characteristic, on data source level.-More complex navigations have to be created as standalone Analytical Navigations. They are not part of the data source, but only enabled on report level. Our example of the navigation from Original Document ID is a case of a complex navigation. The navigation target depends on the document type (e.g. sales order, invoice etc), hence more complex calculations are required to determine the target screen-Resolution-Simple OBNs are kept when a custom report is created, because the same data source is used.-Analytical Navigations are linked to the specific report they are part of, and hence when a report is copied or a new one created, this navigation is lost. -If the customer would like to request a change to this, they would need to use the Continuous Influence Session.-To check the type of navigation, you can proceed as follows:-Logon to the backend and go to the transaction MDRS.-Select MDAV Key Figure Composite and enter the report ID which has the navigation (the standard report).-If it is a simple OBN, you will find it in the characteristic under the data source:- Expand the data source folder, an then the Characteristics folder.-Double-click on the respective characteristic.-Go to the Characteristic tab.-Make sure that there are no entries in the Reference Characteristic section. If there are, double-click on the reference Key Characteristic, go to the View Elements tab and double-click on the characteristic again.-Scroll down to the section Simple OBN Target Reference. If you have an entry here, it's a simple OBN. For example:-If it is a standalone navigation, you will find it in a separate folder:-In the report folder, search and expand the folder Used as Navigation Source.-Double-click on the entry you find here.-Go to the Target tab.-Here you will see all the navigations. For example:-Keywords-report navigation, report to object, OBN, target reference, customized report, customised, berichtsnavigation, business analytics

Title: Report Showing Empty Results
Content: Symptom-You are running the report XYZ (XYZ represents the name of the report) and you can see the column names are displayed in the report results section, but all data is empty.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to the Design Reports work center view.-Find the report XYZ.-Open the report.-Run the report.-See that though the column names are displayed in the report results section, all report data is empty.-Cause-You have not added any key figures to the report results (e.g. report Columns), but only characteristics instead.-Resolution-In order to retrieve results in a report, you should include both characteristics and key figures in the report results.-Keywords-No Report Results; No Key Figures; Cannot Run Report

Title: Cash - Open Items Report Still Shows Bank Statement Amounts
Content: Symptom-You have executed the Cash - Open Items report and noticed that some cash items still shows as open in the G/L Account for Cash Receipt - In Transit through a posted bank statements.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open Cash - Open Items report.-Give the relevant selection for company and set of books.-For illustration purposes, give key date as 31.12.2018.-Execute the report.-You see some entries related to bank statement being shown in the report, even though the concerned payment allocation is posted.-Cause-The posting date of the invoice, bank statement and payment allocation differ.-Resolution-The system behavior is correct. Once you execute the report on or after the posting date of the payment allocation, the items wont show as open.-You can cross-check the data as follows:-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Open Cash - Open Items report.-Give the relevant selection for company and set of books.-For illustration purposes, give key date as 31.12.2018.-Execute the report. You see the concerned amount.-Add the Source Doc. Item characteristic.-By adding this characteristic, you see to which line items of the bank statement the amount refers to.-Take as example one of the line item ID XX-YYY. (XX represents the bank statement ID; YYY represents the line item ID in bank statement XX).-Click on the Journal Entry ID (posting date on 31.12.2018) in the report and open the corresponding bank statement XX.-Click View All.-Go to Transactions tab.-Filter by ID YYY.-Click on Not Required in the Postprocessing column. The payment allocation screen of that line item will open.-Click View All.-You see that the posting date of the payment allocation is on 15.03.2019. This payment allocation is what connects/clears the invoice with the bank statement posting.-Go to Payment Confirmations/Returns tab. You'll see the concerned payment/invoice.-You'll see that this payment/invoice has posting date as 14.03.2019.-Therefore considering a cash receipt case, you have:-The bank statement journal entry posting on 31.12.2018 (credit the G/L Account for Cash Receipt - In Transit).-The payment/invoice posting on 14.03.2019 (debit the G/L Account for Cash Receipt - In Transit).-The payment allocation posting on 15.03.2019 (debit and credit the G/L Account for Cash Receipt - In Transit).-Having that said, once you run the report:-with key date 31.12.2018 the credit amount is open.-with key date 14.03.2019 the debit becomes open and the credit remains open.-with key date 15.03.2019 the above items are cleared by the payment allocation posting and no longer shown in the report.-In the case of external payments, the customer invoice can be open via General Ledger -> Source Documents (Show All).-Keywords-Incoming External Payment. Bank Statement. Payables. Liquidity Management. Cash Management. Reports. Source Document Item.

Title: Contains "~" Operator Not Working in Report Selection
Content: Symptom-When using the operator ~ "contains" in the report selection, no values are retrieved in report results.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system.-Go to Business Analytics > Design Reports.-Find and open the report XYZ.-In the report selection pane, click the arrow on the left side of characteristic YXZ.-Select the operator ~ "contains".-Insert the text you want to filter by in characteristic YXZ.-Click the Apply button to update the report results.-See that no results show up in the report, despite you inserted the correct filter for characteristic YXZ.-Cause-You are inserting only a part of the text. For example, though you are looking to list all results containing the word "green", you are typing only "re" in the selection for characteristic YXZ.-Resolution-Whenever using the operator ~ "contains", you should insert the term between asterisks "*". For example: *re*.-See Also-Please also note that when using UUID fields like Opportunity or Account in the selection, you will need to enter the ID, not the description of the opportunity / account / etc.-Keywords-asterisk; report contains; contains operator report; business analytics; reporting; *; star

Title: How to Upload Your own Single Sign on (SSO) Certificate
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-This case documents will detail the steps to be followed for uploading your SSO Certificate.-These steps can be shared with the customers.-Resolution-1. Navigate to the Cloud For Customer login page by entering the URL in the browser. You will see the SSO certificate list dialog popup. There could be multiple certificates in this popup.-2. Select the certificate that you would want to use to login and click OK.-Note: If you don’t click on OK then this certificate will not appear as a certificate to be used in Cloud for Customer in step 6.-3. Now, login to SAP Cloud for Customer using you frontend user and password.-4. Click on Personalize and select My Settings.-5. Click on Manage Certificates and then select option Assign Logon Certificate.-6. You will see the SSO certificate that was selected in step 1. Clicking on Assign Certificate will save it locally on your computer.-7. The next time you login via Outlook plugin you can choose this certificate to login.-

Title: Warning During Material Valuation Data Migration: 'Inventory cost change document created'
Content: Symptom-You are executing the migration of material valuation data and a warning message is being raised during simulation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Find the activity Migration of Material Valuation Data.-Click to open the migration tool.-Highlight the relevant migration unit.-Click Execute Migration -> Execute Step by Step.-Go to Simulate step.-The following warning is observed: 'Inventory cost change document <ID> created for company <company ID and name>'-Cause- The warning is raised in the cases where there is already cost details maintained for the material and the migration would update the cost entry, where a change document is required.-Resolution-The system works as designed. After the migration is completed, the costs are updated via the change document. This can be seen as follows:-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Material Unit Costs view.-Search for the material.-Click View Cost History.-You see the inventory cost change logged with source document ID as the inventory cost change document shown in the warning message.-Keywords-Inventory Cost. Change Document.

Title: Bill-To, Ship-To and Dun-To Columns Missing in the Account's Address Tab
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the Ship-To, Bill-To and/or Dun-To addresses of an account, but you cannot locate the columns for this in the Address tab of the account's record.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Access the Accounts view.-Select the relevant Account.-Click Edit > Addresses.-The columns for Bill-To, Ship-To and Dun-To addresses are not available.-Cause-The reason that the columns to define Ship-To, Bill-To and Dun-To addresses are missing is that you have scoped the question "Do you want to view the time dependent address maintained for accounts?" in your project's scope.-If this question is scoped, addresses are displayed as time dependent in the account's master data, but cannot be changed in the UI.-Resolution-It is still possible to edit these aspects of the address through migration. To do that, please follow the below instructions:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Customers.-Click the link to Migrate customers using the migration tool.-In the new screen, click You Can Also > Download Migration Template in the top-right corner.-Open the XML file that is downloaded.-Go to the Addresses tab.-The Bill-To, Ship-To and Dun-To columns can be found in the Address Overview section.-For time dependent fields, select the columns of this section, right-click on the selection and click "Unhide".-Fill the relevant information, as well as any mandatory information in the tab.-Back in the migration tool screen, click Upload > Data from Migration Template to upload your file.-Select your file in the table and click Properties.-Set migration mode to Enhance already existing records (for updates).-Click the button Execute Migration > Execute Migration Step by Step.-Proceed with the steps as outlined in the on-screen instructions until the process is complete.-Alternatively, you can also remove the mentioned question from the active scope. The addresses will no longer be time dependent, but the columns for editing Bill-To, Ship-To and Dun-To definitions will once again be made available in the account's master data UI:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Access the Implementation Projects view.-Select your current project.-Click the Edit Project Scope button.-Click the Next button until you reach step 4 – Questions.-Under Scoping Element, expand General Business Data.-Now, expand Business Partner.-Select Handling of Business Partners.-In the Questions for Handling of Business Partner section under the Account Maintenance group, deselect the check box for question "Do you want to view the time dependent address maintained for account?".-Click Next until the end of the project and confirm the changes.-Keywords-Bill-To, Ship-To, Dun-To, Missing, Account, Addresses, Column, Edit

Title: Calculated Field Is Read Only
Content: Symptom-You created a field with calculation rule, so values shall be displayed automatically based on the rule defined on this field. Then you notice that after add this field to the screen, it is read only and does not allow you to edit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-Currently this is the system expected behavior, as the value is filled based on the rule defined for the field. By business logic is not necessary edit this field.-Resolution-You can also submit your feature request on our Influence page, that is the official tool to propose new functions and share scenarios like this.-Keywords-Read Only, Calculated Field

Title: Update Pricing in Customer Contract Via Add-On, PSM Release Not Possible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You want to update price for contract or sales order items automatically using an Add-On. For that it's necessary to request a PSM release.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-It's necessary to request a PSM release for the path below and we are using contracts as an example:-Business Object: CustomerContract.-Node: PriceAndTaxCalculation.-Action: Recalculate.-You will send it to developers, however this is not an available option to be released.-Cause-A PSM release for this action is not possible. The orchestration between the host object and dependent object can't be established for certain in the update pricing use cases.-Price and Tax Calculation is a dependent object and hence unaware of the host object's status. Hence this action cannot be PSM released.-The same applies also for Sales Orders.-Resolution-You can change pricing relevant fields which will retrigger pricing (like quantity, date etc.) and then change it back via the Add-On which will retrigger pricing. However the Pricing Recalculate is not an option.-Keywords-PSM Release; Add-On; Update Price; Recalculate; Customer Contract

Title: Employee Payroll Data Source Shows Inconsistent Data
Content: Symptom-You are using the data source Employee Payroll Data Source (technical ID GLOPAEMPNLHIR001 or GLOPAEMPNLHIR002), however you notice inconsistent data, such as missing or wrong address details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, and the view Design Data Sources.-Search for Employee Payroll Data Source.-Click Preview.-Add some fields like Employee ID, Street, State etc.-You notice that data is missing or wrong.-Cause-This data source was designed to show payroll information specific to the Netherlands. It does not work for any other country.-Resolution-If your employees are from a different country, please use a different data source, depending on your requirement. If you would like to see employee addresses, you can also make use of the employee list reports as follows:-Go to the work center Personnel Administration and the view Reports > Employee List Reports.-Click on the dropdown in the top left corner of the screen and select Address List.-This list can be downloaded to Excel if required.-Keywords-data source, report, employee payroll, missing data, wrong address, street, country, GLOPAEMPNLHIR001, GLOPAEMPNLHIR002, netherlands, dutch

Title: Only One Sales Order Reference Number is Visible in the Preview Whereas other References are Missing
Content: Symptom-You have a Customer Invoice which had multiple Sales Order References but when you preview the Customer Invoice only one Sales Order Reference is displaying in the Form Template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Documents view.-Search and preview the Customer Invoice.-Cause-The field Sales Order Reference is a text field which is bound to $.CustomerInvoice.SalesOrderReference.ID and can accept only one value.-Resolution-This feature is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.--The Sales Order Reference is being picked based on the selection while creating the Customer Invoice. The first or the last Sales Reference is taken and displaying in the Preview because, the field Sales Order Number is designed to display only one reference.

Title: KPI Shows 0 or Wrong Value - Possible Causes
Content: Symptom-You have created a KPI, however the preview shows 0 or a wrong value. When you open the report and check the respective key figure, the value is correct.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the KPI from the respective work center view (most commonly Home) or open a preview:-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design KPIs.-Search for the respective KPI and click on Preview.-Check either the KPI or the Reference Value.-A wrong result is shown. If you compare it to the report and key figure that this KPI is based on, the report will show the correct value.-Cause-There are several possible causes why a KPI is not calculated correctly. Please check the respective KBAs listed below.-Resolution-2629746 - KPI Shows 0 or a Wrong Value-2547529 - KPI showing wrong value-2657239 - Key Figures Behavior in KPI's-2413052 - KPI Negative Values are Displayed as Zero-2365399 - Target Value Missing in KPI-2627252 - Custom KPIs are displayed with the incorrect scaling-Keywords-key performance indicator, wrong KPI, key figure, current value, target value, context report

Title: Difference on the Balance of G/L Accounts with Open Item Management
Content: Symptom-You ran the G/L Accounts with Open Item Management - Open Items report and notice a missing posting, which led to a difference, for a given G/L Account, when comparing the balance in G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find and open the report G/L Accounts with Open Item Management - Open Items.-Specify the relevant parameters such as G/L Account, Company, Key Date.-Execute the report and add the balance key figure. You see the balance of e.g. 400 USD.-Through steps 1 and 2, find and open the G/L Accounts - Line Items report.-Specify the relevant parameters so that it covers the same selection as the above report.-Execute the report and add the balance key figure. You see the balance of e.g. 900 USD.-Assuming that the parameters in both reports cover the same selection criteria, you notice the difference of 500 USD in the balances.-Cause-In the G/L Accounts with Open Item Management - Open Items there is a credit entry of 500 USD from a journal entry, which hits the selected balance sheet account in the MISC - Miscellaneous ledger.-The difference, in this case, comes from a Journal Entry Voucher posting that debits the corresponding 500 USD to the account but is not accounted in the Open Item Management.-This Journal Entry Voucher has been created with Journal Entry Type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents and debits the 500 USD to the concerned balance sheet account with a project task assignment in the line item, which hits the sales ledger and not the Miscellaneous ledger. The Open Item Management only concerns the postings to MISC ledger and hence the Journal Entry posting to sales ledger does not show up in the report G/L Accounts with Open Item Management - Open Items.-The referencing of a project task in the line for the open item managed account (balance sheet) led to a G/L Account Origin being chosen, and this line posting to sales. No sales ledger item will ever appear in open items, only miscellaneous ledger items are considered.-Resolution-The posting needs to hit the Miscellaneous ledger to be considered for Open Items Management. An example could be a manual Journal Entry Voucher for sales in a write up/write down scenario with no project task reference in the line item for the balance sheet account with open item management.-See Also-1786985 - Transactions Not Listed in Open Item Management for G/L Accounts-Keywords-Open Item Management. Balance Sheet. Char of Accounts.

Title: Backend Error - Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a price must be entered manually. - Process Communication Error Between Customer Invoice and Sales Order - INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- * ** INTERNAL USE ONLY ** *-Checking a Customer Invoice in the UI, you see that the document has the following Process Communication Error: Sales Order cannot process an update sent by a Customer Invoice. Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Checking the same document in the backend, you find a stuck XI Message with the following error: Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a price must be entered manually.-However, when checking the Product, you can see that it is maintained in a non expired Price List.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Open the Customer Invoice.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Click on the Process Communication Error icon. -You see the following message: Sales Order cannot process an update sent by a Customer Invoice. Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Now, login to the backend of the system.-Go to the transaction SRT_MONI.-Search for the XI Messages of Customer Invoice ABC.-You find a stuck XI Message with the following characteristics:-Sender: CustomerInvoiceProcessing-Receiver: SalesOrderProcessingRequestInvoicingIn-Error: Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a price must be entered manually.-Cause-The reason for the process communication error is due to the fact that the Products used in the document are blocked for Sales in the Product Master Data for the respective Sales Organization.- Since the Products are blocked the system is not able to determine prices and therefore the Process Communication Error occurs.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Open the Products view.-Search for DEF (DEF represents the ID of the Product).-Open the Product.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-You see that for the Sales Organization used in the Customer Invoice, the status is Blocked.-In this case, the customer needs to change this status to Active and then revert the incident back to SAP.-Then, you can successfully restart the stuck XI Messages.-See Also-This solution also applies to Sales Orders and Service Orders, although with different Sender/Receivers on the stuck XI Message.- 2638372 - Sales Order Still as In Process Status- 1796830 - The List Price is not Determined for an Item Following Error Occurs "Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation"-Keywords-List Price ; Missing ; Process Communication Error ; Backend ; XI Message ; Stuck ; Customer Invoice ; Sales Order ; Service Order ; CustomerInvoiceProcessing ; SalesOrderProcessingRequestInvoicingIn

Title: Report Hierarchy Not Working
Content: Symptom-You have saved a hierarchy to your report to show expanded results but after saving your view the hierarchy is not expanded.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to any report and open it.-Click on the cog wheel icon and then click on Table Settings.-You set the hierarchy settings at the table level.-Save the view.-You notice that the hierarchy is not saved.-Cause-You have set the hierarchy settings at the table level and not on the characteristic.-Resolution-To show expanded hierarchy, you need to set the hierarchy on the actual characteristic and not on the table. To do this follow the below steps:-For Business ByDesign-Open any report and run it.-Click on the View button.-Click on the 3 dots ... next to the characteristic.-Click on characteristic Settings.-Set the hierarchy to what you want.-Save the view.-In Cloud For Customer-Open any report and run it.-Click on the Rows and Columns tab.-Click on the 3 dots ... next to the characteristic.-Click on Characteristic Settings.-Set the hierarchy to what you want.-Save the view.-Keywords-Hierarchy, table, rows, columns, report, characteristic, characteristic settings

Title: Country in Address of Ship-To Party Missing
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use an Employee/Service Agent as the Ship-To address of a Sales Order document, however, when adding the user ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Employee/Service Agent), you face the error: Country in address of Ship-To party missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Orders from the Common Tasks.-Enter an account ID.-Enter the user ABC as the Ship-To.-Error: Country in address of Ship-To party missing.-Cause-The reason you are facing this error, is because the address under the Service Agent was not correctly maintained for line In-House Address.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Select the Service Agents view.-Search for the user ABC.-Click Edit.-Select Addresses.-Select the In-House Address line.-Maintain the expected address for the user.-After maintained the correct information you should not receive the error anymore.-Keywords-Address; Ship-To; Service Agent; Business Partner Data; Sales Order

Title: PDI: How to Check the Tenant Type and if a User is Assigned to a PDI solution.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-You would like to check if the a tenant is a partner development system and if a specific user is assigned to a PDI solution.-Environment-Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can check the they tenant type in the Backend Transaction SE16.-Enter the Table Name TENANT-In the field MANDT enter the client number.-Click on Execute (F8).-In the ROLE_CODE field you can see the tenant type.--  Possible Tenant Roles are:-Please note: If the tenant is a Partner Development tenant the key user field extensibility cannot be performed.-You can check if a user has been assigned to the PDI solution in the Backend Transaction SE16-Enter the Table NamePDI_DEVELOPER-Click on Execute (F8).-If the respective user appears in the column DEVELOPER the user is assigned to the PDI solution.-

Title: How to Define Customized Party Roles for Leads or Opportunities
Content: Symptom-How to define party roles for Leads or Opportunities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This applies to both Leads and Opportunities. We will use Leads as an example:-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Leads view.-Show All Leads and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the lead).-Edit the lead XYZ.-Select the View All button and go to the Involved Parties tab.-Select the drop down for the Party Role.-You want to add the customized party roles here.-Cause-The customized party roles can be added in the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the button Open Activity List.-Search for the activity Leads if you want to add the customized party to Leads or the activity Opportunities if you want to add the customized party to Opportunities.-Open both the respective fine tuning activity.-You can find Maintain Involved Parties link where determination of parties can be maintained.-Also Sales Unit party determination depends upon the work distribution rule maintained in the Business ByDesign system:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Work Distribution view.-Select the Organizational Work Distribution subview.-For Sales (Opportunity, Sales Order): Define rule under Sales Unit for Sales and for Leads: Define rule under Marketing Unit for Leads.-Keywords-Party Role; Involved Parties; Opportunity; Lead

Title: Concur Expense Integration Error: Access Context Missing for Account
Content: Symptom-  You are unable to get expense reports from Concur due to error message.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Get Concur Documents Run view.-Open the application log of the relevant run.-Go to Results tab and expand the list.-Errors:-'Access context missing for account <technical user ID>, please run access grant procedure'-'Technical Response: Service URL / Path PROCESS_DATA'-'Connection to Concur system could not be established.'-Similar error can be achieved with following steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to User Registration for OAUTH2 Web Services view.-Check both OAUTH and OAUTH2. One of them have the registered users in red.-Click Ping Service.-Similar access context error is raised.-Cause-There are different reasons why this error may be raised. In this case, both client registrations CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2 have the same client ID, which should not be the case.-Resolution-Revise all the parameters for both OAUTH service providers.-For further details and steps, you may refer to the SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide in chapter 2.3.3 Register Client for OAUTH Web Services-To access the most recent version of the integration guide, follow below steps:-Access https://help.sap.com-In the search field, type SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide-Keywords-Concur, Expense Report, Register Client, OAUTH Web Services.

Title: The Order of Sales Kit Items in Customer Invoice Does Not Match With the Order in Sales Kit Master Data
Content: Symptom-You created a Customer Invoice with a Sales Kit. Once this Sales Kit is added you observe that the order of the Sales Kit Items does not match with the order in the Sales Kit Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of Customer Invoice).-Navigate to the Items tab.-You observe the order of the Sales Kit Items.-Then,-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Kit Item List view.-Search for DEF (DEF represents the Sales Kit ID).-Highlight the Sales Kit.-You observe the order of the Sales Kit Items.-Comparing both orders, you see that the order in Customer Invoice ABC does not match with the order of Sales Kit Items in Sales Kit DEF Master Data.-Cause-The sequence of Sales Kit Items on Customer Invoice is based on the UUID of the Products included in the Sales Kit unlike the Sales Kit itself.-Resolution-The order of the Sales Kit Items can be changed at any point of time. Ultimately, this order does not make any difference and does not impact on the scenario.-Keywords-Order ; Sales Kit ; Sales Kit Items ; Customer Invoice

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-How to use the backend transaction MDRS-Resolution-MDRS is a very useful transaction, here you can check content of the Metadata Repository, Repository Browser, MDRS Information System and MDRS Test Cockpit.-To find the relevant Business Object, follow the below steps:-Use transaction: MDRS----Select: Metadata Repository-Choose: Business Object-Select: drop down icon----In the field 'ES Name', enter the Business Object that you are trying to find (in this example I will try to find Installed Base).-Enter *Installed* (the '*' is known as a wildcard, which will allow words / letters to come before the '*' and after the '*' to search more efficiently)-Select the green tick icon to Start Search----Double click InstalledBase:----You can now see the Business Object:-Keywords-backend transaction mdrs,mdrs

Title: Root Cause Analysis for DFV issue Between Customer Invoice and Accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-The Customer Invoice has been released but it has not created Journal Entry in Accounting. The system shows Data Flow Verification (DFV) error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to check the status of the Customer Invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-Select the invoice ID ABC and choose the Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the General tab.-The status of the invoice ABC is Released.-Go to the Documents Flow tab.-The icon for journal entry is not available on the invoice ABC which means no financial document has been created for this invoice.-Now go to the General Ledger work center -> Journal Entry view -> No document is available for invoice ABC.-Follow the steps below to check DFV run for Customer Invoice & Accounting:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Data Flow Verification Results view.-Select the result ID DEF and choose Edit button (DEF represents the ID of the DFV).-In the resulting screen you can see the information No accounting notification matches customer invoice.-Cause-The XI message from Customer Invoice to Accounting is stuck due to temprary issue in FSI on the date when invoice was release.-Analysis to arrive at above conclusion:-Step 1: Check the status of the invoice and the document flow to check the documents created.-Step 2: Double check if there is no Journal Entry available for the Invoice in the General Ledger work center -> Journal Entry view.-Step 3: Check the error message in DFV run.-Step 4: Analyze the problem in backend:-Search for the failed XI message:-Go to the XI Monitor via transaction SRT_MONI.-In the selection screen put a Execution Date Range according to the release date of the invoice and put Status as Erroneous.-Select Sender party as CustomerInvoiceProcessing and Receiver Interface as AccountingInvoiceAccountingIn.-Execute the transaction.-Search for the relevant XI message created for invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-In the the failed XI message, the error text is "Run-time exception thrown by component. For details, see the 'Application info' in the dump".-In the XI monitor, select the erroneous XI message and click on Error Log button where you can see the error message Invalid business object name-'BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL' or business object node name (Exception type: CX_ESF_CORE_SERVICE, User: Technical user ID, Date). -Check the PAF Error BO:-Click on the Technical View button in the message monitor.-Click on the PAF ERROR BO button.-This will open the SPAF_TECHNICAL_ERROR_BO in SESFTS.-Select ProcessIntegrationInboundError - Root:-Select the root node for e.g. 0000000000011EE1B6F7497E393B012D (it will come up automatically).-Select the root and Navigate to Message Attributes:-Receiver: Accounting.-RECEIVER_INTERFACE_OPERATION: CreateAccountingDocument.-INBOUND_PROCESS_AGENT_NAME: MaintainAccountingDocumentBasedOnInvoice.-Come back to root node and navigate to Log Item -> Log Item-Note:-Agent CL_FIA_ACC_INVACC_IB_AGENT has triggered a fatal error.-We already have clear evidence of dump also occurred for this issue.-Analyze the dump in ST22:-Go to the ST22 transaction.-In the parameter add client, date, user, termination program (you already have these information from XI error log).-Execute the transaction.-Go to the dump details.-Go to the Active Calls and identify the class which triggered this dump (In this case it is CL_FIA_ACC_INVACC_IB_AGENT=>MODIFY_BO).-Go to the Application Info: Invalid business object name 'BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL' or business object node name.-The analysis till now indicates that there is some issue in the BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL i.e. Customer Account Details.-Check the customer account & parties used in the customer invoice:-Open the customer account of the invoice in frontend and check if all necessary details are maintained.-Open the customer invoice and check if the Involved Parties in the invoice has consistent data.-If the above frontend analysis does not show any inconsistency then go to the backend to check FSI load status for BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL:-Go to the GFSSTM transaction.-Search for the BO BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL.-Execute.-Go to the Load Status tab.-Status of all node is Green.-With the all above analysis it seems the issue was a temporary FSI inconsistency for the BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL BO and system was unable to find it which resulted in the application error for the related XI message from Customer Invoice to Accounting.-Resolution-Restart the XI message in the XI-monitor but with Development Approval.-Follow the steps below to restart the XI message:-Go to the SRT_MONI transaction.-Put the message ID in the search parameter field (we already have identified the message ID during analysis).-Execute the transaction.-Select the message ID & choose the Actions button -> Select Restart.-Confirm the pop-uo.-Refresh the screen.-Now the status of the message is Green.-With above steps the message from Customer Invoice has reached the Accounting and has created the corresponding Journal Entry.-  See Also-The analysis steps provided here is valid when the XML message has an application error. It is not valid for other cases like system error.-Keywords-No accounting notification matches customer invoice; DFVR

Title: How to check when solution was scoped and descoped in the system.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You need to check whether specific Custom Solution was descoped by a partner within specified period of time. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-Scoping of PDI solution is a generic topic within Business Configuration. PDI framework does not have any specific transaction where scoping logs are maintained (as of July, 2019). The only way to check if some changes were done to solution in terms of scoping, is to check change history directly in Business Configuration Work Center.-Resolution-Before you take a look at change history logs within, you need to find out the description of .bac element within the solution in question. You proceed as follows:-Open transaction xrep in SAP backend.-Expand folder "in Development" and search for appropriate solution namespace, for example Y123456  (Y123456 refers to an solution Ynamespace).-Expand the folder Y123456_BC.-Open XML tab and search for description of the .bac element. You will find it in tag <Description></Description>.-Now navigate to the "Business Configuration" Work Center in the UI.-Open View "Reports".-Select Report with name "Configuration Change History": this report shows all changes made in terms of scoping in some selected period in the past. You can choose changes made in last 31 days, 90 days, 180 days etc.-Pay attention to Scoping Element column and Action: If any change has been registered in terms of scoping and descoping of custom solution (selected/deselected refers to scoping/descoping respectively),you should see the description of .bac element under Scoping Element column. If you do not see this description in this report you can assume scoping changes were not made. -Keywords-.bac element, scoping the solution, scoping logs

Title: Web Services not Available for Selection in Accounts View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You expect all web services to be selectable in the Accounts view.-But for private or corporate accounts not all web services are displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Choose any Account and click on View All.-Click on Web Services button.-The web services expected by you are missing.-Cause-The issue may be caused by the fact that web services are not added to the screen.-To be available for selection for this type of account, web services need to be added to the screen.-Resolution-These web services are available via mashups that need to be manually added to the screen. This is only possible by a key user.-Please perform the following steps:-Log on to the system as a key user-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Select any Account and click Edit-In the upper right corner, enter Adaptation Mode under Key User Settings-In the side panel, press the little "+" Icon and choose Mashup-In the search field, enter the name of the desired mashup and add it to the screen.-Now the chosen services should be available via Web Services button-Keywords-account mashup, mashups, visible, visibility, add mashup

Title: Extension Field not Showing in Covered Products Section
Content: Symptom-You have created an Extension Field for Covered Products under a Customer Contract, however, when opening the form, the value is being displayed under the Covered Registered Products section.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-This is happening due to the current system mapping.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior of the system.-Development is working on a correction for a future release, so that the system may perform the expected mapping.-If you need this functionality urgently you may contact your implementation manager to help with such request or approach directly the SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by Cloud Service Center link. You can contact Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right hand side of Cloud Service Center link, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea.-Keywords-Extension Field; Covered Products; Covered Registered Products; Customer Contract; Not Showing;

Title: You cannot Cancel / Set to Obsolete Master Data Replication Job.
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set the Cost Objects Outbound run in Master Data Replication work center to Obsolete, since you need to stop it for a period of time. But you are unable to perform this action, since there is a released job scheduled to run. You get the error:  'Cannot change status; run SAP_COMMON is scheduled'.-You then try to cancel the released job, but the button to view the jobs is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Master Data Replication work center.-2. Go to view Replication to Concur -> Cost Object Outbound runs.-3. Highlight the current active job.-4. Click on Actions -> Set to Obsolete.-5. Error is thrown: 'Cannot change status; run SAP_COMMON is scheduled'.-Cause-It is not possible to halt the daily run, neither by cancelling it or setting it to Obsolete.-Resolution-If you want to interrupt the run, you can de-select the companies switched on for Replication of Cost Objects in the Configuration UI. The run would set the Cost Object in Concur to Deleted (obsolete).-You would then need to select them again when you want to continue the run, and the next run would activate the Cost Object in Concur again.-Keywords-Concur Integration
