Title: Balance Carryforward Run Stuck in Scheduled Status
Content: Symptom-The Balance Carryforward Run gets stuck in Scheduled status.-By checking the job log for the run there's the following step:-'Error: RBAM: No authorization for 'Action <default> EXECUTE' on instance 'XYZ'-XYZ means the instance ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > Balance Carryforward view.-Select the row of Run ID AAA (AAA means the Run ID).-Click View Jobs.-Select Run Jobs from the show list.-Select the row of the failed job.-Click View Job Log.-There will be a step 'Error: RBAM: No authorization for 'Action <default> EXECUTE' on instance 'XYZ'.-Cause-The User ID of the user who created the Balance Carryforward Run does not have read and write accesses to the Company ID for which the run has been executed.-Resolution-You should grant read and write accesses to the respective User ID, as follows:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the User and Access Management > Business Users view.-Find User ID ABC (ABC means the User ID).-Click Edit > Access Rights.-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Search for the Work Center View ID FIN_BALANCECARRYFORWARD-Under Detailed Restrictions tab, mark Read Access and Write Access for the respective Access Group ID which represents the Company ID-Click Save-Execute the Balance Carryforward Run again and it should finished successfully.-Keywords-bcf; Balance Carryforward; scheduled; RBAM; authorization; action execute; access group; read; write; access context;

Title: Dunning Run not Creating Dunning Items for Customer Accounts
Content: Symptom-You are executing a dunning run, nevertheless you notice that dunning proposals are not being created.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning Runs view-Create or Schedule an execution.-Once the run finishes, go to the Dunning view.-You see that no dunnings have been created for a given customer account.-Cause-The concerned customer account has the payment method set as Direct Debit in the master data. Once this is set, the system only duns the open items upon a specific flag as set in the dunning run.-In the job log of the dunning run, you may also see a message as follows: 'Direct debit agreement exists ABC, business partner DEF' (ABC represents the company code, DEF represents the Business Partner ID).-Resolution-In order to dun customer accounts that have direct debit set, you need to create the dunning run with the checkbox flagged. The following steps apply:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning Run view.-Create a new run.-Flag the checkbox Include Direct Debit.-You complete the Dunning Run. The Error Message no longer appears.-Keywords-Dunning Run, Direct Debit Agreement exists, Business Partner, Customer Account, Lastschrift, Überweisung, Mahnlauf

Title: You Cannot Send E-mail: "Contacting party not permitted according to master data"
Content: Symptom-You want to exclude a contact from marketing communication and activities.-You have disabled communication channels in Marketing Consent.-You have set Contact permissions in General to Disallowed.-You try to send a Follow-up e-mail to a contact.-Error message "Contacting party ID123 (Contact Name) not permitted according to master data"-ID123 represents the contact ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search for contact ID123.-Select related Account ABC (ABC is the account associated to the contact).-Click Follow-up and choose E-mail.-Error message "Contacting party ID123 (Contact Name) not permitted according to master data" is raised on the e-mail screen.-Cause-You have disabled all communication channels in Contact ID123 master data:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Contacts View, search for Contact ID123.-Go to the General tab.-In the Contact section, Contact Permissions are disallowed for all channels.-Resolution-You need to enable Contact Permissions for this Contact in the General tab:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Contacts View, search for Contact ID123.-Go to the General tab.-Navigate to the Contact section.-In the Contact Permission drop down menu, select Allowed and save.-Now, you can send follow-up emails and leave Marketing Consent on Disallowed.-Keywords-contacts, e-mail, E-mail, follow-up, contact permission, disallow, channels, marketing

Title: Unable to Open Attached Documents from Employees Created Via Migration of Employee Data
Content: Symptom-You uploaded an attachment for an Employee via Migration Tool but you are unable to open the Document as a file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Management work center.-Access the Employees View.-Search for the required Employee.-Edit the Employee.-Go to the tab of Attachments.-Then you will see the attachments only as a link.-Cause-While uploading attachments via Migration of Employee Data the system migrates only the link, not the file itself.-Resolution-This is a standard behavior.-If you need to search the documents, you have to upload them manually to the system after the migration of the person took place.-Keywords-migration of employee data, attachment links, personnel management

Title: How to Use GLN And Not Business Partner ID for Sales Order Creation in a A2X Or B2B Scenario
Content: Symptom-You want to use the partner's Global Location Number (GLN) and not the Business Partner ID in a webservice in A2X and B2B.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-When you need to integrate two different ByD systems (B2B scenario), then you need the concept of GLN, because you create message communication profile, where you map GLN ID to a Business Partner ID of two systems.--In case of A2X scenario, this is very similar to how we work on the UI (system). This webservice is synchronous and you have to execute the webservice directly by passing correct Business Partner IDs to the system.-So, it means that this requirement (GLN) is current not supported in the system for A2X scenario.-Resolution-Please check the following documentation available on Web Service and the use of GLN in B2B:-Blog: Create ByD Sales Orders using Web Services. Section "B2B Collaboration for Sales Orders" shows a Sample XML request with the use of GLN.-SAP ByDesign Help Document: Webservices. Section "Use of Standard IDs in B2B scenarios for collaboration partner identification" also refers to the use of GLN.-Keywords-Sales Orders, ManageSalesOrderIn, Inbound, webservice, web service, command client, GLN, global location number, B2B, API

Title: Error During Checking a Solution : Business Object Not Assigned to a Business Option
Content: Symptom-You are getting the below error while checking a solution even though you have assigned the business option to the BAC file.-Business Object XYZ Not Assigned to a Business Option, where XYZ is the name of the BO.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Open the solution.-Right click on the solution and select Check -> Items and Runtime Objects.-Error appears.-Cause-The issue is caused due to the mismatch from SDK and the backend system. Even though the business option is added in the .BAC file in the SDK, the respective BO is not updated in the .BAC file in the backend.-Resolution-You can resolve this issue by following the below mentioned steps.-Login to SDK.-Open the Solution.-Double click on the .bac file.-Verify that the mentioned business option is added.-Click on FINISH button.-Right click on the .bac file and activate the .bac file.-The issue will be resolved.-Keywords-Assembly failed due to business option not assigned-business option-inconsistent attribute

Title: Phases for Solution Development in Transaction SDIM
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***- You are analysing incident within Life Cycle Management of solution YXZ (YXZ relates to the namespace of the Solution in question). -You wish to understand what Life Cycle activities were performed to the solution however you are not able to desipher abriviations used in column "Phase" within the transaction SDIM.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the Backend and navigate to transaction SDIM.-Open folder ONE_OFF. Search for the solution namespace and double click on the version which you want to investigate.-In tab Status & Logs you see similar table to the one displayed in the above screenshot.- Cause-Column "Phase" provides all necessary information about all Life Cycle activities which were performed on the solution in a sequential order. "StatusID" provides exact timestamp of the activity itself.-Below listed represent all possible abbreviations for phases of solution development which are used in SAP backend system:-TMV1-Tenant copy/move phase 1-TMV-Tenant copy/move phase 2-EXP- Assemble-EXP_AS- Assemble as new solution-IMP- Upload-IMP_TEMPL- Upload a template-ACT- 1st time activation-ACT_PTCH- 1st time action of patch during create patch-POS- Data update or post processing-POS_PTCH - Data update or post processing of patch during create patch-RAD- Delta activation-RAS- Full solution activation-REM- Remove solution-SOL_CRT- Create 1st time patch-SOL_COPY- Copy solution during 1st time creation-DISCARD- Delete patch-UG2-Upgrade of assembled & deployed solution-UG2_DEV- Upgrade of the solution in status In Development-UG2_FAIL- Upgrade phase failed solutions- Resolution-Based on the above listed Phase abbreviations you can conclude that the following was performed to solution depicted in the above screenshot:-IMP- Solution was uploaded on this tenant (assembly have been performed on diffrent tenant).-ACT - It has been activated.-POS- After activation it went into post processing phase which is standard behaviour after succesful solution activation.-See Also-2581500 - How to Use The Backend Transaction SDIM-Keywords-SDIM, ACT, RAD, REM, TMV1, TMV, EXP, EXP_AS, IMP, IMP_TEMPL, ACT, ACT_PTCH, POS, POS_PTCH,RAS, SOL_CRT, SOL_COPY, DISCARD, UG2, UG2_DEV, UG2_FAIL, Solution Status

Title: How to Check Analytical Objects in the Testshell
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-****INTERNAL USE ONLY****-You would like to check some analytical objects (reports, data sources etc) in the testshell.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Open the transaction SESFTS. Enter the following BOs, depending on which object you would like to check:-Reports:-Enter the BO MDRS_MKFC.-Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter the report ID in NameKey/Name.-Data Sources:-Enter the BO MDRS_MDAV.-Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter the data source ID in NameKey/Name.-Dashboards:-Enter the BO MDRS_ADB.-Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Since you often do not have the dashboard ID, just execute it without filters. There should not be too many dashboards in one system. -Double-click on one of the dashboards. On the right hand-side, under UITEXT, you can see the name of the dashboard.-Report Personalisations:-Enter the BO MDRS_ANA_PERS.-Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter the report ID in the field AnalyticalPersonalizationKey/BusinessAnalyticsReportReportKey/ReportName.-Report Conditions:-Enter the MO MDRS_MKFC_DSPSET.-Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-Enter the report ID in the field MDAVKeyfigureCompositeKey/ProxyName.-This will load all the report views of this report. Since conditions are part of the view, navigate as follows for the respective view (or try all views if you are unsure which one has the condition):-Navigate > CONDITION.-See Also-1652460 - How to show and use the report ID-Keywords-report, data source, dashboard, personalization, condition, backend, testshell, sesfts, analytics-analytical objects,backend,report,personalization,data source,dashboard

Title: Custom Price List is Selected Over Customer Price List
Content: Symptom-You expect your Customer Price List to be determined on your sales document but you notice that it is your Custom Price List which is applied-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders View.-Open the relevant Sales Order.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then the Pricing subtab.-In Item Pricing, select Expand All.-Select Item XX (XX being the Item ID).-Hover the mouse on the Price Component Description for List Price:-The Price list applied is your Custom Price List.-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Open the Overview.-Search for activity Configure Price Strategy.-Open Access sequence and choose the relevant Header level for Price List.-In Pricing Table, the table at the bottom is your Custom Price List and it is preceded by the Customer price list.-Cause-The system behaves as expected with the following logic: it is always the most specific price list in which Item XX is found that is selected.-It is expected that in the Access Sequence the most general price list in on top of the list and the most specific at the bottom.-The system checks each price list one by one with a top to bottom approach in the Access Sequence. -The system does not stop when it finds a match for the item but checks if an even more specific price list contains Item XX.-In this case, if Item XX is included in both Price Lists, your Custom Price list is the most specific and is the one determined.-Resolution-It is not possible to change prioritization for now.-See Also-Help Document Pricing In customer Relationship Management-Keywords-Tables de détermination du prix, access sequence, pricing, prix, détermination des prix, price determination, inattendue, incorrecte, wrong, Price list

Title: Some Relative Selections Are Not Available on Preview of Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You are looking for relative selection that you have already used in report, however, when you go to the data source, and try to find this relative selection in the very same field, it is not appearing.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-The steps to reproduce the behavior:-1. Go to the Business Analytics Work Center.-2. Go to the Design Data Sources.-3. Click on Preview button at top of your screen.-4. Find the field you already know that has the relative selection.-5. Click on the value help box, and check the relative selections available.--You won't be able to find it.-Cause-Some relative selections are available only for reporting tool. Hence, they will not be available on the preview of Data Source.-Resolution-Instead of using Preview Button, click to create report based on the data source. It will enable all relative selections to display even in the Report Wizard.-Keywords-Relative selection not showing, Relative selections, relative selection employee master data.

Title: Self Created Relative Selection not Visible in Data Source
Content: Symptom-You create a relative selection of type Data Source but you cannot see it in reports based on this data source after creation.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Create a new relative selection for a date (ByD - view Design Data Source, C4C -  view Common Task).-Fill in the necessary details and choose the type Data Source.-Go to a report based on this data source and you will see that the created relative selection is not available.-Cause-For special characteristics, like Currency, Date, Month, Year, and so on, there is a specific relative select type. Such fields only work with this relative select type.-Resolution-Please choose the special type Date for date fields and the relative selection will appear in the report.-Keywords-Data source, Relative Selection, Not available, Currency, Date, Month, Year

Title: Pro-Forma Invoice Button Is Missing
Content: Symptom-You want to use the Pro-Forma Invoice functionality, but you cannot find it on the Sales Orders, the Sales Quotes or the Service Order screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-You cannot find the "Pro-Forma Invoice" button.-Cause-The relevant scoping questions for Pro-Forma invoice have not been scoped in the system. Hence, the "Pro-Forma Invoice" is not enabled in the system.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Workcenter.-Go to Implementation Projects.-Select the First Implementation project and choose Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to Step 3 Scoping.-Click the Action button and Select Expand All.-In Sales, go to Customer Invoicing.-Check that Miscellaneous Invoicing is set on Select.-If it is not in Scope, it needs to be added.-If it is, check that the relevant options are activated:-Navigate to Questions with Next.-Select Miscellaneous Invoicing in Sales > Customer Invoicing.-In Questions for Miscellaneous Invoicing, go to Group: Pro Forma Invoice (4)-Check that the option Based on Service Order is In Scope.-If not, set it to In Scope and Save Draft.-Review and Confirm your changes.-Once the changes are done, you will be able to see the "Pro-Forma Invoice" button.-Keywords-"Pro-Forma Invoice", "Sales Orders", "Sales Quotes", "Outbound Delivery", proforma, pro forma, scoping, in scope, Miscellaneous Invoicing

Title: Excel Add-in: Report View Refresh
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You are using the SAP Excel Add-in Integration with the Cloud for Customer/ Business By Design systems. When you are working with report views and another user tries to execute the same report with the view you designed in the Excel, the view is not maintained if the Refresh button is clicked.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Cause-This is currently the behavior on which the Excel Add-in can only store the view on a specific user session, since no connection to the backend of the system is needed. When the report is shared with other users, the Excel Add-in would need a connection with the backend of the system, so it would be able to store the complete view previously designed, and it would be successfully retrieved when the report is refreshed.-Resolution-Our developers are currently analyzing and studying if a framework upgrade would be possible, so that the connection with the backend of the system can be implemented and the views can be maintained when another user refreshes the report previously designed by a colleague using the Excel Add-in.-Keywords-Excel; Excel Add-in; Add-in; Report; Report View; Report Refresh; Refresh; Pivot Table; Layout; Analytics; Business Analytics;

Title: Filed Length of Data Type LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text
Content: Symptom-When you enter over 255 characters for PDI Business Object Extension filed, it could be saved successfully. This field has data type LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the fronted UI-Enter over 255 characters for this field-The field can be saved successfully-Cause-If you use this data type in a business object extension, the length of the corresponding field is not restricted to a specific number of characters. Only in business object definitions, the field length is restricted to 255 characters.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior-See Also-SAP Cloud Application Studio-> 7.2.3.7 Element (Business Object Extension).-Keywords-Data Type LANGUAGEINDEPENDENT_EXTENDED_Text Length Character Limit

Title: In a Customer Contract, the Quantity Displayed in your Invoice Schedule is Not the One Expected (the Recurrence Pattern is set up as Monthly and the Quantity in Days)
Content: Symptom-In a customer contract, the quantity displayed in your invoice schedule is not the one you expected (the recurrence pattern is set up as monthly and the quantity in days).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-From the Common Tasks select New Contract and click on View All.-Select the contract date and the duration 01.01.2014 until 31.12.2014 (for instance).-In the General tab, enter the account and all mandatory information such as the sales unit.-In the Items tab, add service item XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the service item).-Select an item type as Service - fixed price without actuals (for instance).-Select the Quantity as: 1 day.-Check the box Price per Period.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Invoice Schedule sub-tab.-Click on Edit Invoicing Time Frame button.-Select the Start Date as: 01.01.2014.-Select the End Date as: 01.03.2014.-Select Recurrence Pattern: Monthly.-Check the Applied box to apply it to the line item.-Click OK.-The quantity 60,874 is displayed and each recurrence has a quantity of 30,437, but you expect to see instead 31 days and 28 days.-Cause-As the price per period flag is selected, the system calculates the quantity as per the year. In a non-leap year there are 365 days, in a leap year there are 366 days. The length of the year is then 365.2425 days. The system calculates: 365,2425 / 12 = 30,436875 days. For this reason, each recurrence would have 30,436875 days.-Resolution-In case you want to keep the recurrence pattern set up as monthly, we would suggest to use the unit Month in the Items tab. Once this is done you will see 2 reccurences pattern with quantity 1 month. Or you can also uncheck the box for Price per Period on Items tab if it is not relevant.-Keywords-contrat ; échéancier de factures ; période de facturation ; traiter période de facturation ; quantité

Title: How to Create Surcharge Based on Extension Field
Content: Symptom-You want to create a surcharge based on extension fields. When creating sales orders, the surcharge could be added automatically into the item pricing.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Here is an example:-Create extension fields-Create extension field ‘ECO_Item_EXT’ on product and enable the extension scenario from material to sales order item.-  Create extension field ‘ECO_ACCOUNT_EXT’ on account and enable the extension scenario from account to sales order General.-Now, when you creating a sales order, the extension field ‘ECO_ACCOUNT_EXT’ and ‘ECO_Item_EXT’ are in the sales order and the value would be copied from account and product master data into the new sales order.-2. Enable the extension fields for Pricing Scenario and enable the Price Calulation Service on sales order.-  Now these 2 extension fields are available for pricing.-3. Create Custom Surcharge based on extension field.-Step1: create custom price table-Step2: Assign Access Sequence-Step3: Assign Pricing Group-Step4: Create Surcharge-Example:-Create new sales order, the surcharge is successfully determined and added into the item level pricing.-Note: the surcharge is supported on item level.-Refer to more explanation from help document:Pricing with Extension Fields.-

Title: Wrong Template on Preview of Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-When you try to preview the form template of an Invoice document, the selected template is not the expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this example, we will use a Credit Memo as the invoice document.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Credit Memo).-Click the Preview button.-Template: Customer Invoice.-You expect to see the Customer Credit Memo template.-Cause-At the Form Template Selection view, you have to maintain the order of the templates to be selected for Preview and output, however, if you have maintained the Collaboration rule for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo under the Account level, the system will first consider the Account rule and then the Form Template Selection.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Accounts view.-Search for the account XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer account maintained under the Credit Memo ABC).-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Communication tab.-Select the Collaboration subtab.-Select the line for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo.-Under Template, remove the Customer Invoice value.-Click the Save button.-Now the system will pick the expected Credit Memo template.-Keywords-Form Template; Preview; Invoice; Collaboration; Communication; Account;

Title: Access Context in Joined Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You created a customized report on top of a joined data source (left outer join) and defined an access context while creating the data source. Now when you are running your customized report the data shown is not restricted.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Go the view Design Reports.-Show all and search for the report ABC (ABC stands for your customized report).-Run the report with the selection you would like to use.-You notice that the report data shown is not restricted as expected.-Cause-The access context in your joined data source that the report was build on was not set correctly. In joined data sources (when the join condition was defined as a left outer join) the data is fetched from left to right. It starts with the anchor data source and goes to the most right data source. In this example it fetches the data from the anchor data source first and since there is no access context on this data source maintained all data is fetched.-Resolution-For the access context to work correctly in joined data sources, please get the access context from the anchor data source so that the full data will be restricted. Another option would be to change the join condition to an inner join.-See Also-2488825 - Access Context of Report Not Working-2366796 - Best Practices for Modelling Data Sources and Reports - Performance-Keywords-access context, restricted data, restriction, join data source, joins, customized report, left outer join

Title: Manual Clearing Error: Error while recalculating the withholding tax: Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again Amounts on Invoice ABC are inconsistent
Content: Symptom-When performing a Manual Clearing for Supplier EFG of an Invoice ABC with a Credit Memo XYZ, the following errors as thrown:-Error while recalculating the withholding tax:-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again.-Amounts on Invoice ABC are inconsistent.-ABC - Represents the Invoice ID.-EFG - Represents the Supplier ID.-XYZ - Represents the Credit Memo ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts view.-Select Supplier EFG.-Click View.-Select Document IDs ABC and XYZ.-Click Clear Manually.-There are error messages:-Error while recalculating the withholding tax:-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again.-Amounts on Invoice ABC are inconsistent.-Cause-The Withholding Tax Classification was removed from the Supplier Account information after creating the Invoice and before creating the Credit Memo.-Resolution-To be able to perform this Clearing the following needs to be done:-Cancel the Credit Memo XYZ.-Maintain the Withholding Tax Classification again on the Supplier Account.-Create the Credit Memo again, which will have withholding taxes as well (even if the Withholding Tax Amount is 0%, the system needs this information).- Now the Manual Clearing will be possible using the new Credit Memo.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Classification, recalculating, Tax calculation failed, Invoice, inconsistent, Credit Memo-invoice,credit memo,manual clearing,withholding tax classification,recalculating,tax calculation failed,inconsistent

Title: Original and Duplicate Print Output Document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-According to some country regulations, you need that the first printing of a document should be the original and the next printing should be with duplcate title.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Currently the system has an option that will allow you to output two documents at the same time after release a document.-One that will be the original, and the second one with a water mark as duplicate.-To have this option, follow the steps below:-Go to Application and User Management-Select Output Channel Selection-In Show Rules For, select the desired document, for example Customer Invoice, and click in GO.-Select the line for an already existent rule, or create a rule and edit it.-In Number of Copies change the value 1 to 2.-Save and Close it.-Now, when you release the document you automatically will have an original document and a resubmited marked as duplicate.

Title: Error Message Upon Posting an Outgoing Cash Transfer: Insufficient funds in petty cash XYZ
Content: Symptom-While trying to post an Outgoing Cash Transfer from a petty cash to another petty cash or to a bank account you get the error message 'Insufficient funds in petty cash XYZ', even though the Current Balance of the petty cash XYZ is sufficient.-XYZ means the Petty Cash ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Petty Cash view.-Select the row of the respective Petty Cash ID and click New > Outgoing Cash Transfer.-Enter required data and click Post-Error message is thrown:-Insufficient funds in petty cash XYZ-Cause-Even though the Petty Cash ID has sufficient balance in the current date (as displayed by Current Balance) the system considers the balance available on the Document Date you are selecting for the Outgoing Cash Transfer, and in this case on the Document Date the balance was insufficient.-For example, on 11.08.2016:-Current Balance: 1.000,00 EUR-In the New Outgoing Cash Transfer you enter Transaction Amount 500.00 EUR and Document Date of 19.07.2016. The system will check the balance available on 19.07.2016.-The balance available on 19.07.2016 was insufficient (for example, 400.00 EUR) and hence the error message is thrown.-Resolution-For the petty cash you want to withdraw cash you should check the balance available on the Document Date you've defined in the Outgoing Cash Transfer.-The balance can be checked using the Cash Reconciliation report, that compares the balances of petty cash, checks, and bank accounts in the cash register against the balances on the reconciliation accounts for a key date.-Keywords-petty cash; insufficient funds; outgoing cash transfer; FOP_PAYM_ORDER:010

Title: Time Out Error While Releasing a Demand Plan
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to release a Demand Plan, but after a long processing, system is showing timeout error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Demand Planning work center.-Select the Demand Plan view.-Search for the relevant demand plan which you want to release.-Select it and choose Release button. After a long processing, system shows time out error.-Cause-The scope of the demand plan contains large number of product/planning area combinations. In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign this is a known issue and processing such large data may lead to time out errors-Resolution-Please use automated Release Run to process such large data. By using automated run, data is processed asynchronously and so system is able to handle such large data. Release Run is available in Demand Planning work center--> Automated Actions.-Also please split the demand plan into small demand plans based on for example, planning area, forecasting groups etc.

Title: Checkbox for a Field is not Available in Add Fields
Content: Symptom-You have created a new report and when you try to add a field via the "Add Fields" feature you notice that the checkbox is greyed out and cannot be selected.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Open a custom report.-Select the Add Fields feature.-Find the field you wish to add and you will notice the checkbox is not selectable.-Cause-You have a Fixed Value Selection on that specific field in your report.-Resolution-For the checkbox to be available you will need to remove the Fixed Value Selection.-Select the value "No Value Selection" to be able to add the field in the report.-Keywords-Fixed Value Selection, Report, Add Fields, Checkbox, Check Box,

Title: Form Template Selection for Service Quotes
Content: Symptom-You cannot find a specific form template for Service Quote similar to the Sales Quote template available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Select the Form Template Selection sub view.-Open the Show Rules for drop-down menu.-For Sales Quote there is a form template available but for Service Quote no specific template is available.-Cause-All quotes use the same form template. This is the expected system logic.-Resolution-The Sales Quote form template available is used also for your Service Quote or Quote for Contract.-See Also-If you have a specific need of this template, please submit a new feature request in the Customer Influence forums.-Keywords-quotes, contract quote, service quote, form template selection, formulaire, sélection, service, contrat, devis

Title: Extension Fields are not Populated in Pro Forma Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have maintained an extension field with extension scenarios from Sales Order to Outbound Delivery and then from Outbound Delivery to Customer Invoice.-The extension field values are correctly displayed on the Outbound Delivery document, but the Pro Forma Invoice from the Sales Order does not populate the Extension Fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order workcenter.-Open the Sales Orders view.-Find Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID with extension fields).-Click Pro Forma Invoice.-The generated Pro Forma Invoice does not include the extension fields from the Sales Order - Outbound Request - Outbound Delivery - Customer Invoice extension scenarios.-Cause-The Sales Order based Pro Forma Invoice does not consider extension field data from the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-The extension scenario from Sales Order - Outbound Request - Outbound Delivery - Customer Invoice provides the extension field values only in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-The extension scenario Sales Order - Customer Invoice provides data for the Sales Order Invoice Request.-The Pro Forma Invoice generated from the Outbound Delivery considers the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-Resolution-If you use the extension scenario Sales Order - Outbound Request - Outbound Delivery - Customer Invoice, use the Outbound Delivery to generate the Pro Forma Invoice.-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Select the Outbound Deliveries view.-Find the Outbound Delivery related to Sales Order ABC (filter for Reference Data - Sales Order ID).-Click Pro Forma Invoice.-Now you will see all extension fields, which are passed to the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.-Keywords-Sales Order, Outbound Delivery, Pro Forma Invoice, Extension field, scenario, Kundenauftrag, Auslieferung, Pro Forma Rechnung, Erweiterungsfeld, Erweiterungsszenario-extension field,proforma

Title: Language Code is Mandatory
Content: Symptom-You are receiving an error message when trying to perform the preview of a Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-In this example we use Customer Invoice ID ABC which represents the ID of the document.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the Customer Invoice ID ABC.-Select the document.-Click the Preview button.-New window pops-up with error message: Language Code is Mandatory.-Cause-The reason why you are receiving an error message is because you have not set an Output Channel Selection rule for Customer Invoice or the rule which you have created is restricted for a specific Bill-To, Seller / Invoicing Unit and/or Business Document.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Output Channel Selection subview, under Input and Output Channel view.-Under Show Rules For select Customer Invoice.-Click the Go button.-Click the Edit or New button.-Here you can maintain a new rule or update the current one.-If you have a field, such as Seller / Invoicing Unit which is restricted for one Company, but would like to have for all companies of the system, please leave the field empty.-Keywords-Preview; Error; Customer Invoice; Invoice Template;

Title: Technical Field ID Duplicated for OData Service Extraction
Content: Symptom-When extracting a standard Data Source from SAP to another system using OData service, some fields have the "Name in Odata Service" id duplicated, causing incompatibility to extract the information properly to external system.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Sources view.-Find Data Source ABC (ABC represents the data source name).-Click on the Data Source documentation icon.-In Data Source documentation icon, click in Integration Information.-See the values in column "Name in Odata Service" for fields.-Some IDs look duplicated, as in below example.-a) 'FieldABC' ('FieldABC' represents the field name)-Field ID: ABC_ID-Name in BW Extraction: ABC_ID-Name in OData Service: Abc_odataid--b) 'FieldABCDE' ('FieldABCDE' represents the field name)-Field ID: ABC_DE_ID-Name in BW Extraction: ABC_DE_ID-Name in OData Service: Abc_odatAid-Note that "Name in OData Service" info are the same for both fields above, except a single letter which is lower case in field A, and UPPER case in field B.-Cause-The Name in Odata Service id of the fields are set according to the OData standards. Therefore, any specific changes in the format would be an incompatible change to the OData standards, and would also affect all other customers that already consume the data as per the standards.-Resolution-In case of incompatibility with any external system, this needs to be adapted by the consumer system.-Keywords-OData; Name in OData Service; OData field id; wrong id in OData; incorrect field id; BW extraction; Technical Field;

Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."]-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Check with customer where exactly the dump is occurring and take necessary permission to reproduce the error from support end-Reproduce the issue from your end and see if you are still getting the dump-If yes check in the dump details in the incight, if you can see the class from where the dump is coming- First Scenario: If you know the Exception class-If the dump is in the following format, you can see the exception class in UI also:-,-Incight:-  Here, the exception class is  CM_TAX_JURISDICTION-Goto Backend and Find the component responsible for this class-T-code: SE24-Enter the Class name in Object Type-Double click on the package: You can find the responsible application component:-Alternately, you can always check with T-code: ST22, you can find the Application Information-And check Active Calls and Events to find the class and related  application component-Scenario 2:  If you do not know the Exception Class from Incight-Open Backend, enter T-code ST22 and Open the latest dump encountered by the respective user (using Technical User ID( e.g. K12XYZ12345))-Then , check which class is causing the dump-Check in Application Information, for the class information.-Check in Active calls/events, if any application related class is present (/SRMAP/..)-Double click on the class, select Properties , select class definition and Find the package, then doucle click it to find Related application component-Then send to that component with the application information, class name and responsible component-Note: Do not send to BC-ESI-ESF..( This is a Generic Component)-Note: If you cannot get any application class from the application information/ active calls and see only generic class,:-Here, this is all generic class(OBERON) and there is no readable error information-e.g:- Then, send the incident to the component responsible for that screen where exception occurred.-E.g. If, it is Purchase Order screen , send to AP-POP-PO- Scenario 3: If error is coming due to Add-ON, you can generally find ADD-ON name in application information-Refer case document: 2424439-  Keywords-Dump Analysis, Debug, Error, ST22

Title: How to Set Up Automatic Tax Determination for Jebel Ali Free Zone
Content: Symptom-You set up Jebel Ali free Zone as a Tax Exempted region in Business Configuration based on the postal code.-All Involved Parties have postal codes within the relevant range, but there is no Automatic Tax Determination:-The expected tax code is not used.-Tax exemption is not applied.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite: You have maintained Jebel Ali Free Zone as a tax exempted region in Business Configuration activity: Tax on Goods and Services.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Open the Sales Order view.-Open Sales Order AAA (AAA stands for the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes subtab.-You can see that Tax Code BBB (BBB being the Tax Code number) is applied as Domestic Sales, Standard Rate.-The Tax Code expected is CCC (CCC is the correct Tax Code number): Domestic Sale, Zero Rate.-Check the Involved Parties tab.- Each relevant party has its address in Jebel Ali Free Zone with the relevant Postal Code.-Cause-Automatic Tax Determination for Jebel Ali is a new feature; it needs to be configured according to the settings outlined below.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the relevant Implementation Project.-Go to Fine-Tune, open activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Open Define Exempted Regions.-Add a row and maintain the following Information:-For Country United Arab Emirates, FEZ needs to be entered in the Postal Code with Status 03 - reduced tax rate area:-  Make sure all relevant parties — Customers, Suppliers and Company Addresses — have the same Postal Code maintained in their Master Data:-Create a Sales Order to check that Automatic Tax Determination applies the right values: Tax Code: 300 - Non-Taxable Sale, Tax rate = 0%:-  Keywords-Tax code, Tax determination, automatic tax determination, tax decision tree, Jebel Ali Free Zone, AE, UAE, United Arab Emirates, Dubayy, Dubai, 0%, 310, Domestic Sale, Zero Rate, Determination automatiques des Taxes, Jebel Ali, Emirats Araes Unis, Taxes, ventes,

Title: Refresh Button Does not Load Changes
Content: Symptom-You refresh your report after making some changes in the system, but the changes are not reflected. For example: You change the status of the ticket and refresh the report. The status field in report displays the old value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports.-Open a report.-In the system, change a field value of one of the items displayed in the report. -In the report, select the refresh button.-The changes made in the particular field is not reflected in the report.-Cause-The field is added to the report as an attribute of a characteristic. Such attributes are placed under the characteristics. The refresh button only reloads the characteristics, not the attributes.-Resolution-You can add the field as a master data reference field instead of an attribute by following these steps:-Click Add fields.-Select the field from the sub fields.-This field will be added as a Master Data reference eg: ABC(XYZ)  (ABC represents the field and XYZ represents the Characteristic).-Go to Available fields tab.-Select the field ABC (XYZ) from the list.-The same field having the same data will be added.-Now if you change the field in the system and click the refresh button in report this field will load the changed value.-See Also-2536012 - Order of The Attributes Under Characteristics Cannot be Changed-Keywords-Refresh does not work; master data, characteristics, report, analytics, attribute

Title: The Sales Organization and Distribution Channel in the Document Do Not Match with the Product Master Sales Data.
Content: Symptom-When editing a B2B Sales Order, you receive the error: The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data. Check your entries in the document or the product master.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search fot the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order document).-Click the Edit button.-Error: "Item XX: The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data. Check your entries in the document or the product master."-Cause-Upon the creation of the Sales Order document, the product master data does not have the given Sales Organization and Distribution Channel found under the document.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Master data updated after the creation of Sales documents, are not fetched. It will only be taken for new documents.-Change the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel to match the data found under the product master data or cancel the Sales document.-See Also-1508411 - Changed Master Data are Not Taken Over Dynamically in existing Sales Documents and new Documents created as a Follow-up-Keywords-Sales Order; Sales Organization; Distribution Channel; B2B

Title: Exceptions and Conditions for Key Figure in a Report are not Saving
Content: Symptom-You added an exception or a condition for a key figure in a report. When you open the report you don't find the added exception or condition in Manage Conditions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Report view.-Open a report.-Click Go.-Click on key figure under Columns.-Click Manage Exception.-Create a New Exception.-Click Ok.-Close and reopen the report.-Click Manage Exception.-You don't find the created exception.-Same behavior can be observed with conditions.-Cause-The reason for the created exceptions and conditions not saved is because the view is not saved.-The exceptions and conditions are view specific not report specific.-Resolution-You have to save the view after creating the exceptions or conditions. Then the created exceptions or conditions will also be saved and can be viewed under Manage Exceptions.-Keywords-report, exception, condition

Title: Currency cannot be removed for Standard Key Figures in Reports
Content: Symptom-You opened a report that included a standard key figure and now you want to remove the currency value from this report but it is not possible.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Design Reports.-Search for the your report and open it.-Click apply and display the report table.-Go to the view and open the report or key figure settings for example.-You will notice that it is not possible to remove the currency Euro in this report.-Cause-There is no standard functionality that allows you to remove currencies from the values displayed in standard key figures. This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-It is possible to create new custom key figures that can be treated as a normal value, without the currency symbol.-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Design Key Figures.-Click New.-On the new Key Figure screen, select the data source you want to use and name your new key figure, make sure that the option Calculated Key Figure is selected.-On the Formula screen, go to the tab Data and use the operator NODIM(), inside the parenthesis put the key figure name you wish to remove the currency from.-Click Finish.-In order to add the just created key figure to your report, follow the steps below:-On the report you wish to add this key figure to, click Add Fields.-Switch to the tab Key Figures.-Expand the area Own Key Figures and select the key figure you want to use, then tick the checkbox for Display in Report.-Click OK and go to the report view.-Click + to add a new field to the columns.-Expand the Key Figures and tick the checkbox for your just added Key Figure.-Click OK.-Keywords-currency; key figures; standard key figures; report; Währung

Title: One Confirmation Should Contain Items Referring to a Single Document
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a Service Confirmation "With Order Completion" and you get an error.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmations view.-Search for the ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Confirmation).-Click the Edit button. -Click the Release button.-Select "With Order Completion".-Error: One Confirmation should contain items referring to a single document-Cause-ABC represents the ID of the Service Confirmation.-XYZ represents the ID of the Service Order.-MNO represents the ID of the Contract.-The Service Confirmation ABC has been created from Service Order XYZ which has 5 items. The Service Order was created from the Contract MNO which has 2 items. The Service Order XYZ was created from Contract MNO for item 10 (item 20 is not present on the order).-Subsequently items 20, 30, 40 and 50 were added at Service Order level. These items did not come from the Contract MNO.-The system prevents the release of Service Confirmations containing a mixture of items that have Contract references and Service Order references.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Two independent Service Confirmations are necessary, one for the item with reference to the Contract and another for the items with reference to the Service Order.-Keywords-Service Confirmation; With Order Completion; Error; Contract;

Title: Service Items are not Copied from a Contract to a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You create a Sales Order as a ollow-up from a Contract or by using Create with Reference.-The system automatically copies the general data such as Account ID however the item data such as Product ID and Price Agreement are not copied from the contract to the sales order.-Error messages are raised for each item:-Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - time and material to Service - time and material missing -Or-Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - fixed price to Service - fixed price missing-(XX represents the line item number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create with Reference Scenario:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from the Common Tasks.-Click the Create with Reference button and select in the Reference Type field Contract.-Select the Value Help for the Reference ID field.-You cannot see any contracts with service items.-Enter reference id XYZ manually (XYZ represents the id of the contract).-Click on the Enter button.-You can see that the general data is taken over but the items are not and the following warning messages are displayed:--Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - fixed price to Service - fixed price missing-Or-Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - time and material to Service - time and material missing-Follow-Up Scenario:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contract view.-Search for and select Contract ABC (ABC stands for the contract ID).-Click Follow-up and choose Sales Order.-Error messages are raised on the New Sales Order screen:--Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - fixed price to Service - fixed price missing-Or-Copying item XX not possible; configuration from Service - time and material to Service - time and material missing-Cause-Currently creating a sales order with reference to a contract for service items is not supported.-For contracts with service items, the corresponding follow up document can only be service confirmations.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-contract, sales order, service items, follow up, create with reference, cannot create, fixed price to Service, time and material to Service, missing, error message, contrat, services

Title: How To Analyze Partner Dump Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-This Knowledge Base Article helps all the support colleagues to identify which line of the Partner Solution is causing dump.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer Addins; SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the backend system by requesting the user in the CAM tool  and open the transaction ST22. Enter the transaction ID and click on search you will get the dump details.-Select the transcation ID and double click.-Check the Application Information call details for reported Addon with Y namespace.-Check the Active call events.-Double click on the class and scroll up from the reported error to find the absl file path. Copy the absl file path and make note of it.- Please document Application Information about ther reported Addon, Call stack details and the ABSL file path in the incident.  Please provide this information to the customer and inform them to contact the creator of the Addon to get this resolved.-Cause-This issue is caused due to custom Solution which is created by a Partner and hence this need to be analyzed/solved by the creator of this Addon.-Resolution-Kindly document the below information in the incident:-Application Information with Addon Details.-ABSL file path for the reported Addon.-Line number-Please provide this information to the customer and inform them to contact the creator of the Addon to get this issue resolved.-How to find the creator of Addon please refer - 2533413 - How to Find the Creator of an Add On in One Off Table-Note - If this developed by Partner developer then we only we need to send it to Partner, if its developed by service center colleagues then we have to process it by sending it to service center team.-OR-Inform partner to check the below details in dump analysis tool by below steps:-Login to Cloud Application Studio-Open the Affected Solution.-Go to View Dump Analysis view.-Check the Call Stack and Line Number.-Fix this issue from partner side.- See Also-The PDI Dump Analysis Tool in the SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Keywords-Null reference; Dump due to partner Addon; Partner Dump;

Title: How to Request a Translation for a Report Field
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**** INTERNAL USE ONLY ****-The customer reported that one or several report fields do not have a description in a particular logon language. In English however, the description is available, i.e. the translation is missing for this field. This document explains how to request such a missing translation.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-As an example, let us take the data source CODAPAPTYB in Norwegian. As you can see in the below screenshot, some field is missing the Norwegian description. When you log on in English however, all fields contain the correct descriptions, so it is only missing in Norwegian. You have confirmed that these fields are standard fields (not extension fields created by the customer. For extension fields, the customer has to maintain the UI text himself).-In Norwegian:-  In English, there are no missing field names:- Resolution-Open the front- and backend of the system. In the frontend, logon with the local language (for which the translation is missing, Norwegian in this case).-Go to the Business Analytics work center, view Design Data Sources. Search for the data source in question (CODAPAPTYB in this case).-Open the documentation of this data source by clicking on the magnifying glass in the Documentation column.-Scroll through the characteristic names. In our case, there are 2 fields where the label is not maintained. Note down the characteristic IDs:-Now log on to the backend, transaction MDRS.-Open the data source CODAPAPTYB.-Expand the Characteristics folder.-Search for the characteristic without translation. In this example, I am looking at DLC_MEETINGPLAC_NM. Double-click on it.-Double-click on the entry for UI Text (take a note of the UI text):-In the Overview tab, take a note of the ES Name and ES Namespace if provided:-Click on the Texts tab and search for your language - Norwegian in this case. There will either be an entry for this language but no values (as below), or the language will be missing completely: -You have confirmed that the translation is indeed not maintained. Send this incident to the translation component SRD-TRL-* (depending on your language) and provide the below information. The translation team will usually be able to provide the missing translations via hotfix or (if there are no open hotfix collections for the current release) with a correction in the next release.-Please include the following details for development:-Brief description-Steps to reproduce in the relevant logon language-Technical Details:-MDAV-View Element-UI Text (see step 9)-ES Name (see step 10)-Namespace (see step 10)-Keywords

Content: Symptom-When working with the Business ByDesign product, you notice that the work center Analysis is not available in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is the current system behavior.-Resolution-As Business ByDesign product has been going through evolution from time to time, the work centers are being added in each release that is delivered to our customers. Currently, the Analysis work center is one of several work centers that is still not available for the Business ByDesign product.-Even though there is not a clear date that is is goin to be released, this work center is already planned to be delivered to our customers in the future releases of the product.-Keywords-Business ByDesign; Analysis; Analytics; Work Center; Work Center View; Business Analytics;

Title: How to Add a Barcode to Form Template in Cloud for Customer
Content: Symptom-You would like to add a barcode in form templates using the Adobe LifeCycle Designer.-For it, a background knowledge is necessary from the partner/user side to proceed with the advanced settings around this scenario, using Adobe LifeCycle Designer (ALD).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In this example, we will use as reference an Opportunity Form Template.-With the actions below we will summarize the steps to be followed to update a form template with a barcode provided using the data maintained in an extension field.-In Opportunity create and add an extension field (for example shot text) on the opportunity header, that will be used to create the barcode.-In the extension field created go to Field Definition properties and go to tab Form Templates to assign the extension field in the form.--Go to Business Flexibility> Form Template Maintenance.-Select the Template that you desire to edit (in this example, Opportunity Template – Language English).-Download this form template. This action will save a *.zip file in your computer. Open it with Adobe LifeCycle Designer (ALD).--Update the form template main schema to guarantee that the extension field path will be available to binding.-In Insert>Barcodes select the type of code that you will use. Binging the value of the code with the extension field.--Save the changes and upload the template to the system.- Now, if your form template selection is correct according the Country and Language, you will be able to see the barcode when preview your document.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."

Title: Mashup Created is Not Showing Up on Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Symptom-You have created a Mashup, however, you cannot find it on SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Cloud Applications Studio;-Create a Mashup;-When the UI opens and you have to log in, log with a Business User;-Go back to Cloud Applications Studio;-The Mashup you have created is not displayed;-Cause-If the Mashup is created with a Business User, instead of a Development User, it will not be a PDI Mashup, but a KUT Mashup, and therefore the same does not get displayed on Cloud Applications Studio.-Resolution-In order to see the Mashup created from Cloud Applications Studio, the same should be created using a Development User.-Keywords-Mashup; SDK; Cloud Applications Studio; Mashup not showing;

Title: How to Generate MCS Key from Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-This document helps us to explain the detail steps to how Generate installation Key for any MCS solution.-Pre Requisite:-1. MCS Solution should have Review Quality done.-2.You should know the Name-Space of the MCS Solution.-Note -> We should have the Generation Solution Name Space NOT the Global Name Space of the MCS Solution.-3. We should know the Customer ID of the Target System.-  Resolution-1. How to Get Customer ID-The requestor should have provided the Customer ID.-If the requestor has provided the target tenant, get the Customer ID.-Login to backend System to Target Tenant.-Open Transaction SE16.-PDI_PARTNER table, get the value from PARTNER_ID table, which is same as Customer ID.-2. How to Get Solution Name Space-NOTE -> You should know the Source system ( partner development tenant)  where this solution was developed.-Login to backend System to Source tenant.-Open transaction SDIM.-Check the MCS folder.-Double click on 100 Main folder.-Get the Project Name.-NOTE - Please compare the namespace with the downloaded MCS solution from Service Market Place.-3. How to generate Generate MCS Key.-Login to backend System to Source tenant.-Open transaction SE37-Use function Module-PDI_10_MC_CREATE_INSTALL_KEY-Enter input parameters: Namespace and Customer ID retrieved from above steps-Execute (F8) funtion module.-Key would be generated.-Example: 1C936B3AXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, provide to the customer/Partner.-    Keywords-MCS key generation; Backend generatio ;Key.

Title: Background Jobs Change Their Schedule
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled a background job and at some point it changes the schedule by one hour.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Application and User Management workcenter.-Select the Background Jobs view.-Select any Background Job.-Click on Reschedule.-Set up a Recurrence at 8am daily.-During the Daysaving Time change, the run is executed at 7 am.-Cause-The time is saved always in UTC from the backend.-When you set up a time, the adjustment to your time zone is only in the display.-When your time zone changes (due to Daylight Saving), the schedule for your timezone is adjusted.-Resolution-Currently there is no option to automatically adjust the difference in Daylight Saving.-You can manually reschedule the background jobs.-Keywords-Background Jobs, MDRO, Mass Data Run Object, Timezone, Daylight Saving, Schedule, Zeitzone, Sommerzeit, Winterzeit, Hintergrundjobs

Title: No Report Data Available in Corporate Performance Work Center
Content: Symptom-As a manager or system administrator, you are accessing the statistics for Sales, Financials, Purchasing and Human Resources under Corporate Performance work center, and correspondent views as above mentioned, and you notice that no report results are displayed at all.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system-Access Corporate Performance work center-Access the work center view XYZ-See the graphic charts are empty and no options are available in the drill down. No data is available at all.-Cause-The related reports are unassigned from this work center view, and therefore no data can be displayed.-Resolution-As system administrator, log into the system-Go to Business Analytics > Design Reports-Find the relevant report XYZ-Click on Assign button-Assign the report into the relevant work center / business role-Save and go back to step 2-Repeat the step 3 and click on Assignment Overview-Assign the report to the relevant work center views, alternatively clicking on Reassign All, to assign it to all available work center views-The dashboards are based on the following reports:-Financials:-Earned Profit Overview for Dashboard (FINPRFU30_Q0004)-Order Profit Overview for Dashboards (FINPRFU30_Q0006)-Purchasing:-Total Spend per Spend Category (SRMIV_B03_Q0011)-Spend History Comparison (SRMIV_B03_Q0016)-Human Resources:-HR Dashboard - Headcount Development: Quarterly (HCMPAB01_Q0005)-HR Dashboard - Headcount Structure: Date (HCMPAU01_Q0006)-HR Dashboard - Employee Times : Current Year To Date (HCMTLMU01_Q0010)-Service:-Daily Average Service Request Backlog (Year) (CRMSRQHHB_Q0003)-Daily Average Service Request Backlog (Service Organization) (CRMSRQHHB_Q0004)-Daily Average Service Request Backlog (Priority) (CRMSRQHHB_Q0005)-Daily Average Service Request Backlog (Top-10 Serv. Cat.) (CRMSRQHHB_Q0006)-For further details, please refer to KBA 2678576.-Keywords-Corporate Performance; Report;No report data;Missing data in Corporate Performance;

Title: Invoice Requests Numbering
Content: Symptom-You want to know the system logic used for determining the document numbers of Invoice Requests such as Over the Counter Sales or Manual Invoice Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The numbering logic applied is the same for all Invoice Request documents (for example a Manual Invoice Request) which are not created from a preceding document (for example an Outbound Delivery Invoice Request):-The numbers are sequential, starting from one (1) and being incremented by +1 each time a new document of the same type is created.-Since this is not a customer facing document, a simple generation logic is applied for the numbering.--Please note that this behaviour cannot be changed.-Keywords-invoice request, numbering, OTC, over the counter sales, manual invoice request, demande de facture, numérotation, manuelle

Title: You received the Error Message 'Invalid parametertype used at function' during an oData Query
Content: Symptom-You used an oData URL like https://my[your system URL].sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RP[your report ID]QueryResults?&$filter=[your filter/selection characteristic] eq 'value for filter/selection' for example and received the error message 'Invalid parametertype used at function eq'.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business by Design-Cause-You are using an incorrect oData URL and the selection or filter used in the query does not work.-Resolution-Please check the report metadeta via oData and here the parameter type for the field you would like to use.-Metadeta oData Query: https://my[your system URL].sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/$metadata?entityset=RP[your report ID]QueryResults.-You can also use the Build Odata Queries feature to check the report metadeta.--When you check the metadeta, please search for the field you used in your link and the parameter type.-If it shows Edm.String, the values have to be used in ' '.-If it shows Edm.Int64, the values have to be used without the inverted comma in the oData Query.-See Also-More information can be found in the following blog: OData for SAP Business by Design Analytics.-Keywords-odata, error message, odata query, parameter, exception, odata URL, selection, filter parameter type

Title: Service Category ID/Description are Not Displayed in Other Languages
Content: Symptom-When checking a Service Confirmation, the Service Category ID/Description is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field and Service Repair work center.-Go to the Service confirmations view.-Search for ABC (where ABC represents a Service Confirmation which has a Service Category maintained).-Depending on the system language you are using at the moment, the Service Category ID/Description will be blank.-Cause-You have not maintained the Service Category ID/Description while logged into the system using that specific language.-Resolution-Log into the system using language you want the Service Category ID/Description to be localized to.-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Service Categories view.-Search for DEF (where DEF represents the relevant Service Catalog).-Select View All.-Go to the tab Catalog Structure.-You see that the Service Category ID/Description are blank. Once you maintain this info and Save, the text should appear localized in the other screens.-Keywords-Service Category ; ID ; Description ; Blank ; Language ; Localization ; Missing ; Service Entitlements ; Service Catalog
