Title: Bill of Exchange Tab Is Missing in Account Determination for Subledger Cash
Content: Symptom-Both country Spain and function of Bill of Exchange are added to implementation scope, but Bill of Exchange tab is still missing in account determination of subledger Cash.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Both country Spain and function of Bill of Exchange are added to implementation scope. Such settings can be checked with following steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Edit Project Scope, you can see the country Spain in already in scope.-Select Next till Step 4, Question.-Expand Cash Flow Management, then Payment and Liquidity Management, then select Payment Methods.-The flag of Bills of Exchange Payable, Cashing of Bills of Exchange Payable and Bills of Exchange Receivable is checked.-However, the account determination of Bill of Exchange is still missing.-Go to Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation project and select Open Activity List.-Find activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination and open it.-Select activity Cash in Account Determination, but tab Bill of Exchange is missing.-Cause-You need to enable accounting principle of Spain, and create a new chart of account of it. It will be working.-Resolution-In the same activity of Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination, select Copy template chart of accounts.-Select CAES - CAES: Spain Chart of Accounts in the drop down list of Template Chart of Accounts.-Select Copy Chart of Accounts.-Then go back to Account Determination of Cash, select the Spain accounting principle, tab Bill of Exchange is there.-Keywords-Bill of Exchange, Subledger Cash

Title: Revise Sales Quote Task Not Showing in Inbox
Content: Symptom-The Approver sent the Approval Task back for revision, but the Employee Responsible is not able to see the Revision Sales Quote Task in the inbox.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-The task to revise Sales Quotes are available under Sales Quotes view, then query for Open Tasks of the user who is responsible for the Sales Quote.-Resolution-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show Open Tasks and select Go.-Here the task Revise Sales Quote XYZ is shown (XYZ represents the Sales Quote ID).-Note that this is also the behavior for Sales Orders. Once the Sales Quote or Sales Order is approved or sent back for revision, the notification is sent to the Employee Responsible of the document and not the creator. This is the expected system behavior for CRM documents.-Keywords-Sales Quote ; Sales Order ; Notification ; Task ; Approved ; Back for Revision

Title: Pivot Table Does Not Work in Different Language
Content: Symptom-You created a pivot table using SAP Excel Add-in, and when opening it with the business user ABC (ABC represents the business user ID) it does not work.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open a report using Microsoft Excel SAP Add-in.-Insert a pivot table on the report.-Save the report into your computer.-Open the report as the business user ABC.-The pivot table does not work for the opened report.-Cause-You have saved the pivot table in one language (e.g. EN) and tried opening it in a different language (e.g. DE), therefore the pivot table will not load properly since there will be a conflict with the language used in its creation.-Resolution-Configure your business user in My Settings to the same language in which the pivot table has been created and then try opening the report again. Make sure that the business user opening the report has the proper accesses to the same.-Keywords-Pivot Table; Excel; Add-in; Report table; Report

Title: Tax Classification for Free-Text Items not Working in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have made the setup of activity Tax Classification for Free-Text Items in business configuration, however when creating a sales order the tax classification is not as per setup.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Go to Sales Order view.-Create a new sales order with a specific product ID. The product category of this product ID has a given tax classification in the fine-tune activity Tax Classification for Free-Text Items.-Once all required data is entered in the sales order, you noticed that the tax details are not as per the setup in the aforementioned activity.-Cause-A free-text document means that the line item does not have a Product ID reference, it has only a description and a dedicated product category in the Product Category ID field. Free-text items as well as the fine-tune activity Tax Classification for Free-Text Items is relevant only for purchasing documents.-Since sales order is a sales document and must have reference to a product ID, the tax classification for free-text items does not apply.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-Note that in the master data of the Product ID it is possible to include additional tax settings. If there are no tax settings, by default the highest VAT rate is applied as the standard tax rate.-Keywords-Tax Calculation. Tax Code. Tax Determination. Tax Classification. Free-text item. Sales order. Purchasing Document.

Title: [Germany] Payment Information and Addresses on Correction Invoice Cannot be Edited
Content: Symptom-After creating your Correction Invoice as a Follow-up document, you want to edit the Payment Terms and the Bill-To Address.-The fields do not allow any change as they are read-only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Select the Customer Invoice View.-Highlight invoice ABC (ABC stands for the Invoice ID).-Click Follow-Up, select Correction Invoice.-Navigate to the General Tab.-In the Bill-To section, open Address Details.-Information is read-only on the prompt and cannot be edited.-The behavior is the same on Payment data.-Cause-Only some information can be modified on a Correction Invoice-Resolution-Please check Help Document Customer Invoice Processing, section Correction Invoice to check what data can be modified.-Keywords-Correction Invoice, edit, Germany, cannot change, greyed out, grayed out, read only

Title: You Cannot Find a Specific Customer Invoice Form Language for a Country You Have Scoped
Content: Symptom-You have a template for a specific country (E.g. Belgium) and want multiple languages of this template to be available in Form Template Maintenance.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue- Go to the Application and User Management work center.- Select the Form Template Maintenance view.- Find the Templates for Customer Invoice.- In the "Country" Column, you see the correct country, however, in the "Language" Column, you notice that one or more expected languages are missing.-Cause-This happens because the system will generate template languages based on the options chosen in the scoping option "Questions for Addresses and Languages".-Resolution- Go to the Business Configuration work center.- Select the Implementation Projects view.- Select the project line.- Click on the Edit Project Scope button.- Navigate to the 4th option (Questions tab).- Expand Built-in Services and Support.- Expand Business Environment.- Select Addresses and Languages.- Mark the checkbox on "Do you need ABC (where ABC represents the country name) as a solution language?" for all languages you need available.- Confirm the changes.-Now the correct form languages should be available for the respective country.-See Also-KBA 2027531 - How to Create a Form Template in a Specific Language Which is Not Available in the List of Languages in Form Template Maintenance-Keywords-Template ; Customer Invoice ; Language ; Country ; Scoping

Title: Error "Reversal Not Possible Due to Existing Follow Up Vouchers" While Trying to Reverse and Repost to Another Period
Content: Symptom-An error is being received "Reversal not possible due to existing follow up vouchers" when trying to reverse and repost to another period a Goods and Services Receipt and / or a Warehouse Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts Work Center.-Go to the Show by documents view under Receipts and Returns.-Select Show All documents and find document ABC (ABC stands for Goods and Services Receipt ID).-Click Edit.-Click View All button.-Click Document Flow.-Open Journal Entry related to Goods and Services Receipts.-Click You can Also button.-On business transaction for accounting click Reverse and Repost to another Period.-Fill information required and try to repost.-Error message "Reversal not possible due to existing follow up vouchers" will be raised.-Cause-This is the current system design and it is not allowed to reverse and repost once the item is cleared with a GR/IR Run.-Resolution-You need to check if Goods and Service Receipt (or Warehouse Confirmation) is already cleared with a GR/IR Run. If yes, you can cancel this Goods and Service Receipt (or Warehouse Confirmation) to a new period and create a new Goods and Service Receipt (or Warehouse Confirmation) for same Purchase Order. Then you can enter a new posting date for Goods and Service Receipt (or Warehouse Confirmation).-Keywords-GSA;-Reverse and Post to Another Period;-Reversal Not Possible Due to Existing Follow Up Vouchers;-gsa,reverse and post to another period,reversal not possible due to existing fo

Title: Customer Invoice E-mail Subject Shows as Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-You have released an Invoice with an E-mail template to the customer. You expect the subject to show with the structure: Account Name - Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice), however, instead of Customer Invoice, it is written Credit Memo.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click the Edit button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Select the E-mail Text subtab.-Subject: Account Name - Credit Memo ABC.-Cause-The e-mail subject of Customer Invoice/Credit Memo is influenced by the Gross Total value available in the document. If the value is negative, the system will display Credit Memo. If the value of the document is positive, the system will show Customer Invoice.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-See Also-1757292 - How to Change the Subject Text of the E-mail Output Automatically for a Business Document-Keywords-Customer Invoice; E-mail; Subject; Credit Memo;

Title: Why the Text Fields Created Via PDI are Appearing in a Grey Box in RUII Client?
Content: Symptom-You have added extension fields from SDK solution and in UI the value is appearing in a grey box. This behavior can be observed only in RUI/ Fiori client.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to RUI client of the tenant.-Navigate to the relevant workcenter view.-Find the fields which you have added.-You can see, compared to other fields some field values are displaying in a grey colored text boxes.-Cause-This is because you have selected the property DisplayType as TextEdit in the UI designer of the relevant field.-Resolution-If you don't want the custom field to be displayed in a certain way, you can change the property of the field in the UI Designer as per your requirement. For eg: If you are selecting the DisplayType property of the field as InputField then the grey box will not be appearing.-For the extension fields added from SDK to a standard screen, the display type property cannot be changed from UI Designer, this will be controlled completely based on what is the data type you have defined for the field in the business object declaration.-Keywords-Field display is greyed out-Text fields are in a grey box-appearance of the text field in RUI-appearance of the text field in Fiori

Title: Invoice Run not Releasing all Documents
Content: Symptom-You have created an Invoice Run, however, the Invoice Run is not releasing all of the expected Invoice Requests.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Runs view.-Select the Invoice Run ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Run).-Click the Schedule button.-Select one of the Schedule options.-Click the Save and Close button.-Navigate to the Invoice Requests view.-Some of the Invoice Requests which you have expected to be released by the run, are still with the To Be Invoiced status.-Cause-The user who created the run is not assigned to the respective Work Center, View or other document fields, such as Sales Unit.-If the user is not assigned to the Sales Unit maintained under the document, the run will not release the Invoice Request.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users tab.-Search for the ID of the user who created the Invoice Run.-Check the users access rights.-Keywords-Invoice Run; Invoice Request; Not Released; To Be Invoiced;

Title: Over the Counter Sales Do Not Have Shipping Related Dates
Content: Symptom-You create an Over-the-Counter Sale (OTC) document.-You want to maintain shipping and pickup dates.-No field is available to do so.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center.-In Common Tasks, select New Over-the-Counter Sale.-Maintain Customer Account data, Ship-to and Items data.-You can also fill in the Posting and Invoice Dates but no other date can be maintained or is displayed.-You expect that a shipping related date such as delivery date, requested date or pick up dates can be maintained as on Sales Orders Items.-Cause-The creation date and time of the Over-the-Counter Sale is used as the pickup or shipping date for the outbound delivery.  -The system behavior has been designed with having the customer present for the Over-the-Counter Sale and with them picking up the items at the time of creation of the OTC document.-Keywords-over the counter sales, over the counter, OTC, ship-to, shipping, pickup, pick-up, posting date, shipping date, delivery,

Title: Unable To Choose Country Version Finland For Travel And Expenses
Content: Symptom-The country version Finland is not available for scoping for Travel and Expenses.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-View Implementation Projects.-Select the project and select Edit Project Scope.-Select Next steps-Choose Travel and Expenses option in Questions-Expense and Reimbursement Management and Expense Reporting-Navigate to the Reimbursement Rates for Mileage for Country Finland is greyed-Resolution-Finland is a Pre-localized country in Business ByDesign system and it is not supported for Travel and Expenses.

Title: How to Have a New Bank Statement Upload Format
Content: Symptom-You wish to have another format for bank statement upload, however the Add Row button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Click Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-You'll see that the Add Row button for the import Format list is disabled.-Cause-The mentioned activity is used only to edit and adjust the External Transactions codes for the pre-delivered formats.-The logic behind creating a new import format can only be applied via custom add-on (PDI - Partner Development Infrastructure) logic.-Resolution-In order to created custom import formats, you may refer to the Localization Toolkit, which is available in the SAP Business ByDesign - Localization JAM Page.-If you have any issues accessing this page, please get in touch with your SAP contact.-Keywords-Localization. Globalization. Toolkit. Bank Statement Upload. Bank Statement Format. Import Format. Inbound File.

Title: Discount Not Equally Distributed Among Open Items in a Payment Allocation
Content: Symptom-The discount applied to open items in a payment allocation is not equally distributed among the items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Select the row of Allocation ID AAA (AAA means the payment allocation ID) and click Edit.-Under Open Items section, select two or more open items by marking the Matched checkbox.-Click Actions > Apply Discount or Credit.-Enter Amount and Payment Difference Reason.-Click OK.-Notice that the discount amount was not equally distributed among the items.-Cause-The definition on how the system will distribute the payment differences during clearing is done in fine tuning activity Clearing Strategies, on section Distribution of Payment Differences during Clearing.-Resolution-To define an equal distribution of the discount among the open items the option Equal Distribution on All Open Items should be selected in fine tuning activity Clearing Strategies.-Steps to be followed:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and open activity Clearing Strategies.-Click Maintain clearing strategies.-Under Distribution of Payment Differences during Clearing section, select radio button Equal Distribution on All Open Items.-Click Save and Close.-Keywords-payment allocation; discount; credit; other discounts; payment differences; clearing; payment tolerance; underpayment;

Title: Invoice Split Backend Analysis
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer is facing an invoice split scenario and the Split Analysis does not show the expected information.- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select the Invoice Request ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Select the Invoice Request ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Invoice Request).-Open the Backend.-Go to the Transaction Title: How to Mass Upload Custom Fine Tuning Values
Content: Symptom-You want to know how you can do a mass upload of values to a custom fine tuning activity.-Environment-SAP Cloud Apllication Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to frontend UI.-Navigate to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Open the Activity list.-Find and open the custom finetuning activity.-There is no option to upload or import the values to the activity.-Or-Login to Cloud Application Studio.-Open the solution.-Navigate to the BCO and BCSet files.-There is no option to mass upload the values.-Cause-Currently there is no option to upload the fine tuning value in bulk via UI or SDK.-Resolution-You have to maintain the values manually either from the fine tuning activity in the UI or from the SDK.-Keywords-Bulk upload of fine tuning data-BCO values upload-BCSet values mass import-upload of fine tuning activity,maintaining fine tuning values bco,bcset values upload,mass upload of bc view values

Title: Renumber Button Is Grayed-Out in Sales Order Items Tab
Content: Symptom-You want to change the position of an item in the Sales Order, but the Renumber button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents your Sales Order ID).-Select Edit.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that the "Renumber" button is grayed-out.-Cause-You likely have ATP checks scoped in your system. In this case, you cannot change the sequence of the items because it is decided by the ATP check based on availability.-To check this, follow these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Click on the Next Button until you are in the Questions step.-Choose Selling Products and Services, then Sales Orders.-You see that the question "Do you want to immediately confirm quantities and requested dates during sales order creation based on an availability check?" is marked as In Scope.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. If ATP checks are scoped you will not be able to renumber the items in the Sales Order.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-Sales Order ; Renumber ;  Disabled ; Greyed-out ; Grayed-out ; ATP

Title: Clearing House Statement Remains Released
Content: Symptom-You have assigned clearing house statements in payment allocations from bank statements. However, even with the external payments already Confirmed, the clearing house statement remains Released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Clearing House Statements view.-Find the clearing house statement that has been assigned to a payment allocation.-You noticed that it remains Released and does not get the Confirmed status.-Cause-It is the current system design that, even though all the underlying external payments are confirmed, the status of the clearing house statement will remain Released and does not get changed to Confirmed. Also, there is no action on UI (User Interface) through which it can be achieved.-Resolution-For this scenario, the clearing house statement will remain as Released. For the moment, the system is also generating an associated business transaction task. The task can be manually closed, as follows:-Go to Home work center and click Inbox.-Select the tasks created for clearing house statement and perform action -> Acknowledge.-Keywords-Clearing House Statement. Sales order. External Payment.

Title: Key Date Characteristic Not Saved in New Report
Content: Symptom-The characteristic Key Date is not saving to the report when editing it with the report wizard.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work centre.-Create a new report using Employee Times (HCMTLMU01) data source.-Add the characteristic Key Date in step 3 of report creation.-Save the report.-Open the newly created report. Observe: the characteristic Key Date is not available in the report.-Cause-The characteristic Key Date is a special element used in this data source and thus it cannot be used as a row/column element.-Resolution-It can be used as a parameter selection instead. For example: if you go to the Report Wizard and add this characteristic to the report, you can go to step 4 and change the Value Selection column from No Value Selection to Using Variable.--With this, you should be able to control the Key Date.--Whenever using the Employee Times data source, please, bear in mind that the time-frame is uniquely controlled by the Key Date characteristic.--Therefore, use it as a selection parameter in order to get the expected results.-Keywords-Key Date, Report, Data Source, HCMTLMU01, Employee Times

Title: Customer Contract Invoice Request Is Blocked, However Schedule Invoice Request Is To Be Invoiced
Content: Symptom-You have set an invoice block in your Customer Contract, hence you expect to have both Customer Contract Invoice Request and Schedule Invoice Request set with Blocked status.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the ID of a Customer Contract).-You will observe that only Customer Contract Invoice Request is set as Blocked, and Schedule Invoice Request is To Be Invoiced.-Cause-For instance in Logistics based Sales Order processes, when the Sales Order has been set on invoice block, the Outbound Delivery still remains in To be invoiced. The reason for this is that the Outbound process has happened, and for invoicing the information from both Sales Order and the Outbound is used. The Outbound Delivery happened in reference to the Sales Order, and hence only on invoicing this Outbound Delivery we find the corresponding referred Sales Order to see whether this is blocked or not. This is the reason for you find the status of Schedule Invoice Request as To be Invoiced.-Resolution-This is the system behavior. An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site and submit your idea of changing behavior in Customer Influence Portal - SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Customer Contract Invoice Request ; Schedule Invoice Request ; Blocked ; Customer Contract.

Title: Gross Price in Sales Order for Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-Sales Order created after a Purchase Order is with Net Price as default instead of Gross Price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for ABC (ABC refers to Purchase Order ID).-Edit the document.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-Open the Sales Order created.-Net price is set as default.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Click on Open Activity List.-Search for Configure Price Strategy.-Open it and select Default Gross Pricing.-This is set as Distribution Channel: Direct Sales and Default Pricing: Gross.-Cause-In Business Configuration work center, for the activity Configure Price Strategy, it's possible to select as default Gross Pricing for Direct Sales, this behavior applies only for manually Sales Order creation, in which it will be possible to have Sales Order with Gross Price as default instead of Net Price. In this case, it's possible to switch from Net Price to Gross Price when creating the document. This behavior doesn't happen in intercompany scenario.-INTERCOMPANY SCENARIO:-It is not currently possible to switch to Gross Price, even when it is configured, for an intercompany scenario. The reason for this is that in an intercompany scenario, it takes over the Net Price coming from the Purchase Order to customer expected price. This is an A2A (Application to Application, Purchase Order to Sales order) case where the price strategy is not changeable.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-Purchase Order ; Sales Order ; Intercompany ; Gross Price ; Net Price

Title: Create Invoice Request with Invoice Items and Credit Memo Items via Web Service When the Relevant Scoping Question Is Not Checked.
Content: Symptom-You are able to create Invoice Requests with Invoice items and Credit Memo items via Web Service even when you don't have scoped the question: Do you want to allow customer invoice requests/invoices to contain invoice and credit memo line items?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to step 4 - Questions.-Select Sales, then Customer Invoicing, then Miscellaneous.-You are able to see that the second question: Do you want to allow customer invoice requests/invoices to contain invoice and credit memo line items? is not checked as In Scope.-You use the Web Service CustomerInvoiceRequest and you are able to send Invoice items and Credit Memo items without any error.-Cause-This is the system behavior. The scoping question: Do you want to allow customer invoice requests/invoices to contain invoice and credit memo line items? is related to Manual Invoice Requests, which explains the reason for being able to create External Customer Invoice Requests via the web service having both credit memo and invoice items in one invoice document even when this question is not checked in scoping.-Note that the <ReceivablesPropertyMovementDirectionCode> indicates whether the item will be debited (invoice item) = 2 or credited (credit memo item) =1.-Resolution-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-Invoice Request ; Credit Memo Items ; Invoice Items ; Web Service ; CustomerInvoiceRequest.

Title: Missing Products in the Product Search in Product Catalog
Content: Symptom-You want to add a product in your Product Catalog, however, when you search for the Product ID, no values are found in the Product Catalog.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Product Catalogs view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the Product Catalog ID).-Navigate to the Product Search tab.-On right side, search for XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID).-No records are found.-Cause-You are not able to find the Product ID searched because the Product master data information does not match with the Product Catalog criteria, like: Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, Language, Country, etc.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influencer Site and submit your idea: Customer Influence Platform.-See Also-You can see the Help Document - Product Catalogs Quick Guide for more information.-Keywords-Product Catalog ; Product ID ; Missing ; Not Found.

Title: How to Add New Values from the UI to the Codelist Created from SDK?
Content: Symptom-You want to know how you can add new values from the frontend UI to the custom codelist which is created from SDK.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The solution depends on the below 2 use cases:-Static Codelist: Static codelist is the codelist which you directly create in the solution with the extension .codelist. Whatever values you create in this codelist can be edited or changed only via SDK. If the solution is deployed you will have to create a new patch and add the values to the codelist from SDK.-Dynamic Codelist: Dynamic codelists are created automatically in the process of creating the Business Configuration Object(BCO) in SDK. You will get an option to select create codelist checkbox during the creation of the BCO. For such codelists you can create a finetuning activity for the UI and the business user can add values via the fine tuning activity. Also you will have to ensure that you have selected the checkbox Values can be added in Fine Tuning as shown in the screenshot.-See Also-You can refer to the below path in the SAP CLoud Applictaion Studio help document to know how to create a dynamic codelist.-SAP Cloud Application Studio Help -> Developer Desktop-> Business Configuration -> Tasks -> Create a Business Configuration Object.-Keywords-cannot add values in fine tuning-Fine-Tuning values from SDK-Codelist-Static codelist-Dynamic Codelist-BCO Codelist-add values to codelists not working,.codelist file,finetuning codelist

Title: Managing My Area - My Budget Assignment is not displayed in the Assigned Work Centers tab of a Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You notice that when you assign the work center and view Managing My Area - My Budget, the assignment done is not displayed in the Assigned Work Centers tab, even though the assignment is done without experiencing error messages.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-In order to reproduce this behavior, you can follow the steps below:-Go to the Business by Design Work Center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Search for the specific report you would like to assign this view (e.g. Cost Centers - Plan/Actual - My Area).-Select the report and click on the Assign button.-Search for the Work Center and View Managing My Area - My Budget.-Assign the report to this work center and view.-Click on the Save button.-Refresh the screen.-Check the tab Assigned Work Centers and notice that the assignment of this specific view and work center is not displayed.-Cause-This is currently a system behavior, which is caused since, as described in the KBA added in the See Also section, the features related to the Managing My Area Work Center and My Budget View are currently not being supported and used in the system, hence the assignment of this specific work center and view is not displayed in the Assigned Work Centers tab.-Resolution-If you face this situation or incidents where the customer describes this behavior, please advise the customer on the root cause and recommendations of this KBA as well as the 2028290 - My Budget Feature does not Populate Data on the UI KBA.-See Also-You can also refer to some additional details on the following Knowledge Based Article  2028290 - My Budget Feature does not Populate Data on the UI-Keywords-Managing My Area; My Budget; Report; Assignment; Assigned Work Centers; Assign; Analytics; Business Analytics;

Title: Product Specifications in Sales Kit
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a Product Specification which is under a Sales Kit into a Sales Order, and you see that the Product Specification field is grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-We will be using Sales Kit ABC (ABC represent the ID of the Sales Kit) and Product/Material with Specification XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Product Specification).-1. Go to the Sales Orders work center.-2. Select the New Sales Order option under the Common Tasks.-3. Enter the needed Account master data.-4. Navigate to the Items tab.-5. Enter the Sales Kit ABC which holds Product/Material XYZ.--You expect the Product Specification field to be enabled, so that you may select the needed specification, but the field is grayed out.-  Cause-The SAP Business Bydesign does not support Product Specification under Sales Kit Product.-Resolution-This is a system behavior.-We do recommend that you share your ideas at the Customer Influencer site through the link: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886, so that we may enhance the system, or you can contact the SAP Service Center for the extension service.

Title: Enter Identified Stock in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want to enter the Identified Stock information when you are creating a sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Sales Order.-Select the View All button and in General tab enter the relevant and mandatory information required.-Choose the Items tab, select the Add Row button and enter the product information.-While entering the production information you see that there is no option for you to enter the identified stock information of the product in sales order.-Cause-Identified stock or batch information for a product is relevant when the decision to ship/move product from the warehouse is made. This decision is made by a warehouse manager and hence the option to enter identified stock information is available in warehouse related document mainly warehouse tasks.-Resolution-You have the option to add Product Specification in the sales order. If you need to mandatorily add an identified stock due to a specific business scenario at your end you can use a production specification which is mapped to your identified stock.-Please follow the below given steps to map your product specification with an identified stock.-Go to Warehousing and Logistics Master Data work center.-Navigate to the Identified Stock view.-Choose the New button.-In New Identified Stock screen you have the option to add the Product Specification.-Once the product specification and your product is mapped to the identified stock, you can use the Product Specification that was mapped to your identified stock in the sales order that you want to create.-Keywords-identified stock, sales order,  identified stock field, missing, identified stock sales order, add identified stock in sales order, error in adding identified stock sales, istock error in sales order

Title: Delete Variable from Selection Area in Report
Content: Symptom-You try to delete a variable in your selection area, but you cannot delete it via the "X" option next to the field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Design Reports in the Business Analytics work center.-Search for the report and open it.-Run the report.-Try to delete the variable field from the selection clicking on the "X" next to the field.-The variable is still shown in the selection.-Cause-The X only deletes the value which was entered in this particular variable  but it will not delete the variable itself.-Resolution-To delete the variable field from the selection area, you will need to edit the report:-Go to Design Reports in the Business Analytics work center.-Search for the report and open it.-Click on the Add Fields button.-Click on the Key Figures tab.-Choose the option that best fit on the key figure you want to delete.-Search for the key figure-Uncheck the box Display in Report-See the results.-These steps are only possible for custom reports. For standard reports, you would need to create a report copy and adjust the variable settings in step 4 of the report wizard.-Keywords-report, analytics, selection, business analytics, variable, variant, characteristic, selection field

Title: PSM Release Request for Exchange Rate Business Object
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer has requested a PSM Release for the Business Object Exchange Rate (CER_EXCHANGE_RATE), since his business requirment is to populate this BO with his own data via a custom solution, for that, you're looking for more details before forwarding the incident to the application component responsible for this BO.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-Resolution-After receiving several similar cases, our development team has been aware of this being requested by several customers, and they already provided us a follow-up on the PSM release for this specific BO, which is the following:-The Business object Exchange Rate has not been publicly released and is not supposed to be released.--Due to architectural issues the business object is not self-contained. That is, different instances of the business object need to be created together in a consistent way but the business object does not contain appropriate determinations and validations to ensure this. The business object is not suitable for external use and should not be put into partner solutions or customer-specific enhancements.--Therefore, A2X services have been provided to read and to manage exchange rates in the system. Only these services should be used.-In this case, the recommended action to take is to advise the customer about the above details and recommend the use of the A2X services available in their systems, so that they can achieve their business requirement even though the PSM release is not possible.-See Also-In case you face any issues or have any further queries on the PSM Release Requests, you can check the KBA 1757585 - How to Handle Public Solution Model (PSM) Issues.-Keywords-Exchange Rate; Exchange; Rate; PSM; PSM Release; PSM Request; Business Object; BO; ByD; Business ByDesign;

Title: Outgoing Wire Transfer Memo Line Language Determination
Content: Symptom-Outgoing wire transfer memo line language determination criteria.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-System determines the language used in the memo line of an outgoing wire transfer based on two criteria:-First, the Language defined in Supplier Account master data is checked. For example, if Language is English, the memo line will be created in English irrespective of the Supplier's Country.-If the Language is left blank, then the Country of Supplier is checked, and its official language will be used. For example, if Country is Japan, memo line will be created in Japanese.-The above determination has no link with the countries scoped in the Project Scope.-Keywords-outgoing wire transfer; memo line; language; payment correspondence profile;

Title: Missing Authorization Data When Creating a Credit Card Refund
Content: Symptom-You have created an Outgoing Credit Card payment to refund a customer purchase, nevertheless you noticed that even though the refund is created with authorization reference via a credit memo, there is no authorization data in the payment order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Find the related outgoing credit card payment.-Open it.-Under Authorization Data section, you notice that there is no authorization reference, even though it has been created from a credit memo.-Cause-The related incoming credit card payment, for the customer invoice being refunded, which has originally charged the credit card, has been confirmed in a bank statement, however the Settlement Status is still Pending.-The Pending status usually indicates that the payment has not been captured yet in the Payment Service Provider (e.g.: Computop) side. Therefore, if the settlement has status as Pending (meaning not captured), the system does not allow to use that payment authorization as reference for a customer refund, since it understands that the capture was not done. Hence, the authorization is not derived and the refund goes as a blind credit.-If the blind credit is processed or not, that depends if the payment service provider has enabled such feature for your merchant.-Resolution-If your merchant is not enabled to accept blind credits, the refund is set back to Ready for Transfer status with the message ACTION NOT SUPPORTED. In this cases, there are two approaches that can be followed.-You need to create an incident to SAP mentioning the issue, payment details and reference to this KBA. The following two options can be aligned:-Option 1:-You cancel the refund (Outgoing Credit card payment).-SAP to change the settlement status to Accepted in the incoming payment.-You re-create the refund payment to be sent to Computop.-Option 2:-You manually do the refund in the Payment Service Provider portal.-SAP adjust the incoming payment to Accepted.-SAP adjust the refund in ByD to In Process / Accepted without triggering the settlement request.-Note that for both cases a thoroughly analysis needs to be performed in both the incoming payment as well as in the refund in order to evaluate if it is feasible/applicable to change the status via backend.-Also note that Option 1 would be preferred since it has less backend changes and the newly created refund would have the payment reference visible in the document.-Keywords-Credit card. Refund. Outgoing Credit Card Payment. Incoming Credit card. Authorization. Payment Reference. Computop. Payment Service Provider. Settlement. Action Not Supported.

Title: Customer Invoice Output Form, Prints Address only in German for companies based in Switzerland.
Content: Symptom-You have created a customer invoice for a Customer located in a different country, your company is based in Switzerland but the language of the company is French. In the customer invoice output form, the address get printed in German.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Find relevant invoice and choose the Edit button.-Go to View All then select the Output History tab.-Open the document,you will find the country name is not in French but in German language.- In your company's master data, the language used is French, not German.-  Cause-If the sender country and the receiver country differ, the system will always print the address in the language of the sending country since the postal service which needs to deliver the letter needs to be able to read the country name.-In this case, the language available by default in the system for Switzerland is German as per default setting in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-You can change the default language settings.-The language of all countries is maintained in the Business Configuration in the fine tuning activity Countries as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your respective implementation project.-Click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune tab.-Select the fine tuning activity Countries.-Click on the Add to Project button.-Open the fine tuning activity Countries.-Click on the Edit Countries hyperlink.-Click on the Filter symbol and enter desired country and press Enter.-Select the General Attributes tab.-In the Language field you can see which language will be used for the country e.g. FR – French-Keywords-Form Template; Country; Language

Title: RBAM:No Authorization for Service Interface ManageCashPaymentOrderIn.
Content: Symptom-You are using the Web Service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn to create the Payment and to clear the Invoice but the clearing does not happen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Go to the Customer Accounts subview.-Find Customer Account ABC(ABC here represents Customer Account)-Choose the Customer Account and Choose View.-Go to Trade Receivables view and then to Invoices/Payments Subview.-Filter using External Reference of the Invoice.-You could not see any Clearing ID.-Cause-The User who is executing the Web Service do not have appropriate User Authorizations.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to assign the User with appropriate User Authorizations:-Go to Application and User Management Work center.-Go to User and Access Management View.-Go to Business Users subview.-Show All Users and Find the User.-Go to Edit Access Rights.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment.-Assign Liquidity Management and Payment Management Work center to the user.-Keywords-"ManageCashPaymentOrderIn" "RBAM Authorization"

Title: Error Message When Maintaining Second Account Determination Group for an Expense Type
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up an offsetting account determination group (ADG) for an expense type, however the system informs that a second ADG is not permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Expense Reporting - <country>.-Click Edit expense types.-Highlight the relevant expense type.-Click Account Determination tab-Select a ADG as Offsetting Account for Paid Expenses.-Click Save.-The following error is raised: 'Second acct det. group for expense type <expense> not permitted'-Cause-When payment taxation is set as Reimbursement Amount (Payment, No Taxation), there is no need to maintain an offsetting account.-When the mentioned taxation is assigned to an expense type, it means that the expense is paid to the employee via a vendor; i.e. the posting goes from an account (maintained in the expense) to the personal vendor of the employee. Here an offsetting account makes no sense and is therefore not allowed to be entered.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-expense account. expense type. expense report. Reimbursement.

Title: Technical Information for HTML5 (INTERNAL USE ONLY)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You notice that you are not able to access Technical information in HTML5 the same way as you would with the Silverlight Version.-Environment-• SAP Business ByDesign-• SAP Cloud For Customer-Resolution-Via HTML5 version you have the option to access the technical information data:- Option 1(SAP Business By Design and SAP Cloud For Customer):-1. Press Enter.-4. Click on Leave Page on Prompt Window.-Note: UI view will change and look similar to C4C system but it is actually still the same system with full functionality.-5. Hold CTRL + Left Click any where on the screen.-6. Under Client Inspector navigate to UI Changes tab. The header in bold is the field BO identifier.-Keywords-Technical information Debug Mode

Title: Automatic Clearing of Invoices With Manage Incoming Checks Web Service
Content: Symptom-How to use the web service interface Manage Incoming Cheque In (operation Maintain incoming checks) to create incoming checks with reference to invoices and therefore enable automatic clearing of both.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The invoice(s) to be cleared should be specified on tag <Note languageCode="EN"><Note> in the XML request, which represents the Memo Line for the Incoming Check.-Either the Invoice ID(s) or the External Reference ID(s) can be specified, in case they differ.-For example:-<n0:IncomingChequeBundleMaintain xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<BasicMessageHeader>-<UUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>-</BasicMessageHeader>-<IncomingCheque ActionCode="01">-<PayerChequeID>12345</PayerChequeID>-<PayerBusinessPartnerInternalID>CP345678 </PayerBusinessPartnerInternalID>-<PayeeCompanyID>1000</PayeeCompanyID>-<PaymentAmount currencyCode="USD">200</PaymentAmount>-<Note languageCode="EN">1FC-500, 1FC-501</Note>-</IncomingCheque>-</n0:IncomingChequeBundleMaintain>-In the above example, an incoming check of 200.00 USD is being created to clear invoices 1FC-500 and 1FC-501 (for example, each invoice is for 100.00 USD).-Remark: the automatic clearing of the open items (invoices) will only happen if you define a Rule for Analyzing Memo Line, in Global Settings for Payment Business Configuration activity.-Considering the example above, a rule of type Open Receivable Document ID should be created, with Rule Definition Mode Search Term and Prefix for ID Completion "1FC-". The Search Term Suffix Maximum Length should be 3.-In this way, 1FC-500 and 1FC-501 will be read as open receivable items.-See Also-For further information, please refer to:-SAP Help Portal: Web Service APIs in SAP Business ByDesign -SAP Help Portal: Inbound Service Manage Incoming Checks-SAP Business Accelerator Hub: Manage Incoming Checks-Keywords-Manage Incoming Checks; Maintain incoming checks; automatic clearing; PaymentProcessingIncomingChequeProcessingInBasic; Manage Incoming Cheque In; Global Settings for Payment; Rules for Analyzing Memo Lines; Open Receivable Document ID;-manage incoming checks,automatic clearing,maintain incoming checks,paymentprocessingincomingchequeprocessin,manage incoming cheque in,global settings for payment,rules for analyzing memo lines,open receivable document id

Title: Error Message "Constant attribute SCALE does not exist" While Activating Two Dimensional Pricing
Content: Symptom-When you try to activate the two dimensional pricing (weight and quantity) in scoping, system throws below error message:-"Constant attribute SCALE does not exist"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Select the current Project.-Click Edit Project Scope button.-Go to Section 4 - Questions.-Select Product and Service Pricing.-Select Sales Price and Discount lists.-Select option for maintain pricing in 2 dimensions.-Click Next and then Finish.-Cause-The cause for the issue is that there are existing single dimensional scales pricelist existing in the system.-Resolution-To scope two dimensional scales, delete single dimensional scales and then scope two dimensional scales.-This can be achieved with below steps:--1. Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-2. Select Price Lists sub view of Pricing view.-3. Edit the Price List.-4. Go to Items tab.-5. In the bottom of the screen, you can select the Scales of Single dimensional scales (First Dimension) and select Remove Scales button.-6. Save and Release the Price List.-7. Now, you can able to scope the two dimensional scales.-Keywords-scaling, pricing, price lits, dimensional pricing

Title: You receive an error message "Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than X character(s)." while maintaining data in a UI field.
Content: Symptom-You have maintained some value in the OVS field, and while doing so you receive the following error message:-"Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than X character(s)."-Meanwhile OVS works as expected and displays desired values.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Please navigate to the Work Center "ABC". (ABC refers to the name of the Work Center)-Navigate to the view "DEF". (DEF refers to the name of the view)-You may either open a specific Thing Inspector or Quick Create or neither.-Input a few characters into the OVS field and observe the errror message being raised.-Meanwhile your OVS still displays the value as it should.-Cause-Used OVS has a parameter "XYZ" and its configuration is maintained as "True", however this value in the SAP back-end is considered as "X",-Same goes for value maintained as "False" where in the SAP back-end it is displayed as " ".-To fix this discrepancy you have the change the value to either "X" or " " depending on the use case.-Resolution-To check whether this is the case and to apply appropriate solution please follow the below outlined steps:-Open the UI Designer and navigate to the affected screen:-Select the required field and switch to the "Extensibility Explorer" tab.-Select the anchor of this field. (You might have to check different anchors depending on the configuration)-Press "Change ID-Field Configuration" in the Extensibility Explorer.-Scroll down to the field name and expand the OVS clicking on the 3 dots.-Check the value of the parameter, if it's value is "True" change it to "X".-Keywords-UI Designer, True, False, X, OVS, Your entry is too long. Do not enter more than X character(s).

Title: Mandatory Checks and Workflow Expected for PDI Issues in Reports or Data Sources
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Please consider the following approach if any Analytics Partner Enablement Solution (PDI) activation is failing from Analytics Framework as well as to get to known when an issue pertains to Analytics or when it pertains to PDI Support Team:-Check if the End User is a Key User:-How to Check:  Go to Application and User Management Work Center in order to confirm that Business Analytics Work Center is currently assigned to the Business User.-Solution: Only Key Users can activate PDI Solutions.-You can also receive errors during the activation of your patch or solution. If so, please consider the following Knowledge Base Article.- Workflow expected: Advise the customer accordingly.-Check whether the content in the source system has any error:-How to Check: You can select the data source or report (any Analytical content) that is part of the source solution and click on Check button. There should not be any error. Since the object that gets created in the target system is only the copy, you get all these error in the target as well and the activation fails. This can be checked either from the PDI Studio or in the Backend from the source system.-Solution: The error first needs to be corrected in the source system.-  Workflow expected: Assign the incident to CPS EN-Analytics in order to perform the checking.-Check whether the content is using any Key user created data:-How to Check: This can be checked in the error messages after the activation of the solution in the Target System. If there is any error message saying that some Z object does not exist, then this point to the Key User created objects in source system which does not exist in target system.  -Solution: Either the Key User has created data that needs to be created in the target (This can be done via the Upload/Download functionality). Or the customer/partner needs to delete the Key User data from the source solution and then try to create a patch.-  Workflow expected: Advice the customer accordingly. In case the issue still persists, assign the incident to CPS EN-Analytics.-Check if there is any error related to extension fields: for example the data type of the extension field does not exists:-Solution: Check if the extension field exists in the target system, if not, then this needs to be checked with PDI colleagues why this is not yet created.-  Workflow expected: Either you can crosscheck if the Extension field is present in the target system by yourself (e.g. by running the t-code /n/ext/field in the target system) or you can assign the incident to CPS EN-Analytics in order to confirm.-Additional considerations for PDI issues in Analytics:-Key user should not be able to edit PDI Data Source objects, they can only make use of them (like standard metadata objects);-PDI supports only English for creating and editing objects. If the customer wants to continue editing this object they have to do it in the original language where it was created (it is not recommended). Customer can also delete this object completely and recreate it in English language.-PDI Data Sources cannot contain Z objects;-You can create Z report faces on top of PDI Data Sources, however, you cannot create Z report faces on the top of PDI DS in Cloud Studio.-PDI ext fields added to standard MDAV cannot be seen when a report is created on top of this MDAV (in the report wizard). They can only be selected via Add Fields, once the report is created.-PDI Extension Fields are Not Added to Data Source During Patch Upload when the user who uploaded and activated the solution does not have the Business Analytics work center assigned. (KBA 2731514) -Worflow expected between Analytics and PDI Teams:-Y Basic Data Source is handled firstly by Partner (when it’s consulting related) or PDI Support Team (when issues related); Since they used Cloud Studio to build up the object.-Incident goes to CPS PDI queue-Development Component:  AP-RC-BDS-ANA-  Y Join Data Source, Y Combined Data Source as well as Report Faces created on top of Y, PDI KFs are handled by ANALYTICS Support Team; Since they launch from CS to create union MDAV in PDI mode.-Incident goes to CPS EN-Analytics queue-Development Component:  AP-RC-ANA-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-Keywords-PDI; Analytics PDI; Y data source; Workflow-workflow,pdi analytics,pdi data source,y data source

Title: How to Add the Functionally of Calculating the Partial Sum of the Total Amount in the Sales Order or Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-How to add the functionally of calculating the Partial Sum of Total Amount in the Sales Order or Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Click the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-No possibility to calculate the Partial Sum of the Total Amount.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign does not have any standard functionality to calculate the Partial Sum of the Total Amount of a Sales Order or a Customer Invoice.-Resolution-You can implement this functionality by adding extension fields or via customized enhancement by the Cloud Service Center.-Example for the key user adapted extension field:-Go to the Sales orders work center.-Select the New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Select the View All button.-Go to the Adaptation Mode.-Select the View All button and go to the Items tab.-Select the Edit Screen option.-Select the Items section.-Select the Extension Field.-Add a field of type Calculation and select the calculation rule as per your requirement.-You can also check the below help documents for Adaptation:-Key User Adaptation Quick Guide-Create an Extension Field-You can find more details about the services offered by the Cloud Service Center on https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html .-You can contact the Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right-hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Keywords-Total Amount, Sales Order, Customer Invoice, Extension Field.

Title: How to Check Invoice Summary Documents' Creation Information and Reference Summary Invoice in the Backend

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to know the creation time, relevant invoice summary run information, previous and next summry invoice ID of payer/monthly invoice ABC(ABC represents the ID of invoice summary document), but couldn't find the information directly in the frontend.-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Invoice Summary Documents view.-Search and open Invoice ID ABC. You check all the tabs and fields but couldn't find information of creation, reference invoice summary documents, etc.-Cause-To get the required information of invoice summary document directly you would need to check in the backend.-Resolution-You can check payer/monthly invoice ABC's creation information and reference invoice summary documents in the backend.-Open backend and go to transaction SESFTS.-Open the BO GLO_SUMMARY_INVOICE_JP.-Go to Load by Query->ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-InvoiceID/content as ABC and click on Continue(or press Enter)-Click on ABC, you can check required information, such as RUN_ID-CONTENT, PREVIOUS_INVOICE_REFERENCE_ID-CONTENT, NEXT_INVOICE_REFERENCE_ID-CONTENT, SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATIVE_DATA-CREATION_DATE_TIME.-Keywords-Payer Invoice, Monthly Invoice, Creation Time, Invoice Summary Run

Title: No Records Found for Transactions Under Account Overview - Sales or Service
Content: Symptom-The Account Overview shows no data for an account that has associated transactions.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue occurs for both the Sales and Service tab in the Account Overview. We will use the Sales tab as an example:-Go to Account Management work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Select an account and open by clicking on the Account Name/Account ID.-Navigate to the Sales tab.-Message No records found for all documents like Sales Quotes, Opportunities, etc.-Cause-The Account factsheet has certain restrictions which will be solved by a correction in in one of our future releases.-Resolution-If you still want to see the correct data on account fact sheet then as a workaround you shall remove the work center view Personal Data Disclosure (PERSONALDATADISCLOSURE) from the corresponding user(s).-Steps to do so:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Select the concerned user.-Select the Edit button, followed by the Access Rights option.-Ensure that the Personal Data Disclosure work center view is unchecked.-Select the Save and Close button.-Keywords-Account Overview; No records found; Report; embedded Report

Title: Excel Add-In Limits the Number of Rows in Inserted Reports
Content: Symptom-You inserted a report into SAP Excel Add-In and noticed a message in the last row saying "Result set has been cut off; hiding NNNNN rows".-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open MS Excel-Go to SAP HYBRIS / BUSINESS BY DESIGN tab-Log into the tenant myNNNNNN-Click on Insert Report-Select and add the report XYZ-Note that not all report rows are being displayed, and there is a message at the bottom informing: "Result set has been cut off; hiding NNNNN rows".-Cause-Excel SAP Add-In limits the total rows by default in order to improve the performance of inserted reports.-Resolution-In order to display more values, you can make use of the "Dynamic Paging" function, through the following steps:-After you inserted the report as per steps above, click on "Show/Hide" button-Click on Dynamic Paging-In Dynamic Paging box, set the maximum limit of rows to be displayed (e.g. 300000)-Refresh the report-The report will now display the total rows as per maximum limit defined above-* Note that allowing too much rows to be displayed via Dynamic Paging may result in performance loss, so it is expected your report may take several minutes to load up.-Keywords-Excel Reports; Rows Cut Off; Limited Rows; Excel Add-in; Missing Rows

Title: Mexico Grouping Code is not Enabled in the Chart of Accounts
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add the Mexico Grouping Code column via Personalize menu, however the field is grayed out/disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit Chart of accounts.-Start Personalization mode.-For the Details section, the Mexico Grouping Code cannot be enabled.-Cause-The chart of accounts is not yet assigned to a set of books with Mexican accounting principles.-Resolution-In order for the Mexico Grouping Code to be enabled in the Personalize menu, you need to map the char of account to a set of books. This can be done as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list.-Open Set of Books activity.-Make sure that you have one set of books with accounting principle as Mexican GAAP.-Keywords-Set of books. Accounting Principle. Adaptation mode. Adapt. CoA. MX.

Title: Extension Field in a Report Displays Extra Zeros in Decimal Places
Content: Symptom-You have added an extension field with zero decimal places to a report. When you execute the report the field shows 5 decimal places with zeroes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Run a Report-Extension field in the report shows 5 decimal places.-Cause-The extension field is a key figure field and you have added it to the report as an attribute of a characteristic. The underlying data type of an extension field added as attribute has 5 decimal places. Hence it will show 5 decimal places for the field in the report. The key figure extension field added as a key figure will not show such a behavior.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Extension field, Attribute, Decimals

Title: Report Navigation Not Possible from Overview Work Center View
Content: Symptom-You added a report into the work center ABC, Overview view. The report you added contains navigation targets in it, however it does not work when adding the report into the Overview of this work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into system in new HTML5 ui -Go to work center ABC and to Overview work center view -Start Personalization Mode-Add the report XYZ into the screen-Make sure you use the proper report View and Selection that will allow using Navigation function-Once report is available in the screen, you note that no Navigation option appears when clicking on the relevant cells.-Cause-Navigation function is not supported for reports in Overview section of work centers.-Resolution-You can use report navigation in work centers which support this function, like Business Analytics.-Keywords-Report Navigation; Navigation Target; Navigation issue;

Title: Key Figure Restrictions in Reporting
Content: Symptom-You created a new customized key figure to display a specific scenario for which the key figure result will be zero in the report. This key figure is not shown in the report view unless you add another key figure which has a non-zero value (Counter for example).-Environment-SAP Business by Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-When a report is executed with only one restricted key figure and no other drilldown available then the restriction on this key figure is applied globally. This means the complete report is executed with this restriction.-For example, first when a report is executed, say we have one restricted key figure and counter. Since there is a counter, first the report is executed with the given selections and then the restrictions are applied only to the restricted key figure. And now if we remove the Counter, since the full report is executed with only one key figure, the restrictions of that key figure is treated as a selection.-Resolution-At the end the report data you will get is always correct and instead of displaying an empty line it is showing the message no report data available to display. This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-restriction, restricted key figure, zero value, non zero value, not displayed
