Title: You Cannot Find Any Report Which Shows Items/Products Added in a Lead
Content: Symptom-You cannot find any report which shows items/products added in a lead.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You tried to find a report that displays item/product for a lead in different work centers like Home, Managing MyArea, Business Analytics, Marketing & New Business.-You are not able to find such report in the system.-Cause-There is no standard report available in the system which displays items/products added in the Lead.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign System. However we are considering this requirement for future releases.-Keywords-product ID, Item details, leads with item

Title: Data Sources Cannot be Combined
Content: Symptom-You want to combine two Data Sources. After adding one Data Source to the New Combined Data Source window, the second one is not available to add.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Data sources view.-Click New.-Select Combined Data Source.-Click Add Data Source.-Add a Data Source eg: Opportunity Item.-Click Ok.-Click Add Data Source.-Add Data Source eg: Promotions.-You are not able to find the Data source Promotions.-Cause-Data source Combination is possible only when access context of one of the data source completely overlap the other. Access contexts are visible on the Design Data Sources view. The data source Promotions has access context 2012 Employee and Territory where the 2012 Employee access Context is not available for Opportunity item Data source. Hence the combination between these two data sources is not possible as there is no complete overlap of the access contexts. For instance a data source with access context A and B can be combined with a data source with access context A, B and C where you have a complete overlap of access context. The same Data source with access context A and B cannot be combined with another data source which has access context B and C while there is only a partial overlap of access context.-Resolution-In such cases where two data sources do not have a complete overlap of access context please join the two Data sources.-Keywords-Combined data source, Access Context, Combine data source

Title: Bank Payment Format is Missing for Swedish Bank
Content: Symptom-You require to make the Bank payments for the Swedish Bank. But the Bank Payment Format MT101 is not available in the system, even though country Sweden is scoped in Business Configuration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Sweden is a Prelocalized country and as thus, we do not offer full functionality.-Resolution-Business ByDesign system supports only MT940 Bank Payment format and that too specific to a Country. It does not support Sweden country and anything related has to be enabled seeking assistance from your Business Partner, using partner developed solution (PDI) or you may contact SAP Cloud Service Center.-You can find more details about the services offered by the Cloud Service Center on https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html .-You can contact the Cloud Service Center as follows:-If you are a partner: please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder.-If you are a customer: please use the little blue box “Contact Us” shown on the very right-hand side of https://www.sap.com/services/application-development.html, choose “Contact Us”, choose “Services”, choose “SAP Custom Development” and complete the page.-Note: The services of the SAP Cloud Service Center will be charged as packaged services based on fixed prices.-Keywords-Bank payments, Swedish Bank, Format MT101

Title: Start Option Not Applied To Report Tile On Home
Content: Symptom-You're looking forward to add a report tile in your homepage, using the option Start option - Show selection but do not start, however, you notice that when the tile is added, the report runs and provides the data even though this option is selected in the report itself.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is currently the system designed behavior when it comes to reports added as a tile in the homepage of the system, since in order to display the preview data in the tile, the report needs to be running before it is expanded, so the option Start option - Show selection but do not start ﻿cannot be applied to this specific scenario.-Resolution-In order to access this option, the report needs to be executed from within the Business Analytics Work Center, since the report added as tile needs to be running in the background to display the preview data.-Keywords-Start Option; Report Tile; Home; Homescreen; Analytics; Business Analytics;Start option - Show selection but do not start;

Title: How to Extend a KUT field in BYD HTML
Content: Symptom-How to Extend a KUT field to Reports, Forms or other screens in BYD HTML-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-Navigate to the Page where you have added the extension field.-Click on User Icon on the Top right corner.-Select Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Click on the + icon on the bottom of the screen.-Select Extension field.-Here in the list of fields shown select the extension field.-Click on Further Usage.-Keywords-Further usage, extension scenarios

Title: GR/IR Clearing Run: It Is Not Possible to Select Accounting Period for a Recurrent Execution
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to define an accounting period (Period/Year) for a scheduled recurrent execution of GR/IR Clearing Run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1811.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > GR/IR Clearing view.-Select a GR/IR Run that you want to schedule a recurrent execution and click Schedule Recurrent Execution button.-Select Start Immediately option and click Save and Close.-Notice that a new GR/IR Run is created with description Copy of XYZ (XYZ means the original Run ID). For execution of the new run system has derived the current accounting period, even if the original run has been executed for a past period.-Cause-In ByDesign none of the accounting runs support recurrence. With special request GR/IR Clearing Run has been enhanced to support recurrence. Since all accounting runs including GR/IR run are periodic runs, it's always expected to run periodically. Thus based on execution date the period is derived.-Resolution-The system behaves as designed here.-Keywords-schedule recurrent execution; gr/ir clearing run; year/period;

Title: How to Set the Default Value for Golden Tax Invoice Field in Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to set the default value for the field Golden Tax Invoice in customer invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Open an invoice and go to the Genaral tab, you can see the field Golden Tax Invoice. Now the default value is Normal Invoice.-You want to set the default value to Special Invoice.-Cause-You can set the VAT Payer Type in the account master data.-When the VAT Payer Type is Small Scale VAT Payer, the default value of Golden Tax Invoice in the invoice is Normal Invoice. You are not able to select Special Invoice with the type.-When the VAT Payer Type is Normal VAT Payer, the default value of Golden Tax Invoice in the invoice is Special Invoice. You are able to select Normal Invoice manually in the invoice.-Resolution-Go to Account Manangement work center.-Go to Accounts view.-Open one account and in General tab.-In the Details section, you are able to see the field VAT Payer Type,  select Normal VAT Payer and save it.-In the new invoices created after the modification in account master data, system determines the Golden Tax Invoice to Sepcial Invoice accordingly.-Keywords-Golden Tax Invoice; VAT Payer Type; GT Invoice

Title: Multiple Price Lists are Active With Different Validity Dates
Content: Symptom-You find that there are two or more customer specific price lists active at a moment with different validity dates, for a particular customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and service portfolio Work center-Select the view Price lists-Select Show: Customer specifis Prise List-Search for the particular price list-Select Release-Here you can see multiple Price Lists.-Cause-When you create an order different prices of the Product are pulled depending on the pricing date you enter.-This is because prices for that product is different in both the above mentioned Price Lists, hence the prices are picked according to the maintained price in accordance with the pricing date.-Resolution-It's a standard system behavior.-Keywords-Price list, active, Validity

Title: E-Mail Notifications about Incidents are only Sent to the Key User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-E-mail notifications about asynch. infos, questions, answers are only sent to the key user / initial requestor of the incident. Even though the customer changed the processor in ByDesign/C4C, the messages are still sent to the key user who originally opened the incident.-Please note: This issue is mostly relevant to incidents with a long processing time, where the initial requester either already left the company or was assigned to other tasks.-Cause-After the incident is sent from ByDesign/C4C to BCP, the only contact information BCP considers is the requester / key user. The processor details are not forwarded and are therefore not regarded.-Resolution-If the processor of the incident is changed and the customer wants that the new processor receives all the notification e-mails, he has to close the incident and open a new one (referring to the old one) with the new key user.-Keywords-e-mail notifications key user,e-mail notifications, key user

Title: Steps to be Followed to Activate HILTI Specific Addon in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Steps to be followed to activate Hilti Specific Addon in the Backend.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the  UI and go to the work center Product and Service Portfolio and view Discount List :-Check in the discount list drop down list and you notive that Fair Pricing related discounts (Product , product Category) are not displayed.-Resolution-Run the report "PRICE_BACKEND_FINETUNING" (goto transaction SE38 and open report).-Enter BC Context Text as "BC_A1S_CRM_PP_FLX_CS".-Set checkbox “Hilti” in section “Set complete configuration for special customers”.-Note: Make sure none of the check boxes are checked.-Press F8 / run the report.-Make sure the report log => doesn’t have any errors.-See Also-2081710 - Steps to Followed to De-Activate HILTI Specific Add-On in the Backend.

Title: Not Possible to Add a Function in the Business Configuration Scoping
Content: Symptom-Your First Implementation project has not gone live yet. You want to change or add a new funcation in the business configuration scoping. But there is no option to edit the project scope of your First Implementation project.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the  First Implementation project. Here there is not option to edit the project scope, you can only view  the project scope.-Cause-The status of the First Implementation project is Tested. In this status the scope is set to Read Only. That is why you are not able to make scoping changes.-Resolution-For making scoping changes, you need to revert the status of the First Implementation project. To do so, follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Choose Open Activity List.-Select the Test tab.-Open activity Confirm Milestone: Go-Live Readiness Acceptance.-Un-check Go-Live Readiness Accepted and then choose Confirm button.-After this, status of the First Implementation project will revert to In Preparation and then you will be able to make changes in the scoping.-Keywords-Add a Function in the Business Configuration Scoping, Can't edit Scoping , Unable to edit scoping,

Title: How to Issue a Credit Card Refund with Reference to an Authorization of an Existing Payment
Content: Symptom-You have already processed an incoming credit card payment from your customer, however you wish to initiate a refund to your customer with reference to that payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Note that in order to create a refund with reference to a payment, an original payment must already exist in the system.-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Find the corresponding invoice of the original incoming payment.-Select the document and click Follow-Up -> Manual Credit Memo.-Release the credit memo.-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Accounts view.-Open the related customer account monitor.-Find the open credit memo that you have released on step 5.-Click Pay Manually By -> Credit Card.-On the screen that opens, an information message will be raised as follows: The selected items will result in a refund to the customer's credit card-Click Post.-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-You can see the refunded transaction in the form of an Outgoing Credit Card Payment.-Keywords-Credit Card Refund. Outgoing Credit Card Payment.

Title: Unable to View Serial Inventory in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You would like to view the storage location details of a Product with serialized inventory using the Serial Inventory Overview view. However, the Open Serial inventory button is missing in Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work Center Physical Inventory.-Select Common Task Stock Overview.-Click Advanced filter to expand it.-Enter Product ID XYZ (XYZ represents the exact Product ID).-Click Go button.-Result: you will note that the Open Serial Inventory button is not displayed.-Cause-The new Serial Number Profile - Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes - has not been maintained in the Product XYZ master data.-Resolution-This is a new function available from SAP ByDesign 1802 release. You must maintain Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes Serial Number Profile in Product XYZ master data to enable Open Serial Inventory.-Keywords-open, serial, inventory, button, missing, stock, overview, serial, number, profile

Title: Sales Kit Sub-Items do not Follow Sales Kit Header on Sales Order
Content: Symptom-On a Sales Order, you notice that the Sales Kit sub-items do not follow immediately after the Sales Kit header in the Item worklist.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to the Sales Order View.-Search for Sales Order XXX and select it (XXX stands for the Sales Order ID).-Click on Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that the Sales Kit header and the sub-items are not in sequential order.-For instance, the Sales Kit header is Line Item 10 but the sub-items are line 30 and 40. There is another unrelated item on line 20.-Cause-This behavior is caused because empty lines were first added and then filled in. That is, you created lines 10 and 20 as empty and then assigned the relevant items to them, starting with the Sales Kit on line 10.-The logic is as such: when you create empty lines (10 and 20), temporary line item IDs are assigned for the items.-When you add a Sales Kit Header item to line item 10, line 20 appears as already assigned.-The system creates additional item nodes for the Sales Kit sub-items as lines 30 and 40.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-To ensure that a Sales Kit header and the Sub-items are in sequence, first, fill in the Sales Kit ID on line 10 and let the system create the Sub-item nodes automatically with the next IDs.-Keywords-Sales Kit, Sales Kit items, header, sub items, separated, order, sequence, lines, different, IDs, sales order, Kit de Vente, poste, ordre, ne suivent pas

Title: Incorrect Payment Method in Payment Allocation From Bank Statements with SEPA
Content: Symptom-You are getting an incorrect Payment Method in Payment Allocation from Bank Statements with SEPA, instead of the desired Payment Method system assigns Other Incoming/Outgoing Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 1802-SAP Business ByDesign 1805-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Allocation view.-Find the relevant Payment Allocation.-The Payment Method is showing as Other Incoming/Outgoing Payment.-Cause-As per system specifications, if the Country Code is DE, for instance, and proprietary-code is available in the file, then system will derive the transaction code from the proprietary-code.-For example, if file has the tag <Prtry><Cd>XXX</Cd>, that is the information the system will use, and the information maintained in the tag is <SubFmlyCd>ABC</SubFmlyCd>.-This is why even though you maintained the mapping of the code ABC to use, for example, the Bank Statement item gets created with Other Incoming Payments and not as per maintained in Fine Tuning.-(XXX - Relevant Proprietary Code).-(ABC - Desired External Transaction Code).-Resolution-Please maintain Proprietary Code in the Business Configuration so the system will provide the desired Payment Method in the Bank Statement.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Automatically Generated Bank Statements.-Click Open.-Click Edit import formats for automatic generated bank statements.-Select relevant Import Format.-Click Add Row.-Maintain information for External Transaction Code XXX.-Keywords-Payment Method, SEPA, Bank Statements, Payment Allocation, Other Incoming/Outgoing Payment-payment method,payment allocation,other incoming/outgoing payment,other incoming payment,other outgoing payment,sepa,bank statements

Title: Poor Performance During Employee Replication
Content: Symptom-You require to replicate new Employees from an External system. But system takes more than 5 minutes to Replicate a new Employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Go to Employees view-Go to Failed/Not Started Employees-Search for any Employee-Select Edit-Select the Replicate button-System takes more than 5 minutes to Replicate a new Employee-Cause-An Employee may take more than 5 minutes time to be Replicated. It always depends where in the Organizational Structure the Employee is located and additionally if its a Manager position. The Organizational Management is doing some calculations up the hierarchy structure.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Master Data Replication, Employee Replication

Title: Items In The Sales Quote Are Not In The Same Order As In The Project Tasks
Content: Symptom-The items in the Sales Quote are not in the same order as in the project tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Use the Common Task view.-Select the New Sales Quote subview.-Choose a valid Sales Unit.-Choose Create with Reference.-Reference Type: Project.-Choose the Reference ID.-Create method: By Top Level Elements and Services.-Now you see that the order of Sale Quote items is the opposite of the order within the project tasks.-Cause-We do not guarantee the ordering of the line items to match that of the project.-While looking at the documentation, the tables do indeed appear to be in the same order but you notice this behaviour is not described in the test anywhere.-The main consideration from a system performance point of view, is that all project tasks are copied to the sales quote and added as items. There is no particular order on the items.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Project Task, Reference

Title: You Want to Plan Financial Statements, Cost Centers and Profit Centers
Content: Symptom-You want to use the function of the financial planing tool and be able to maintain a planned profit and loss account, but you cannot find the scoping question to enable this function.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Click on Edit Project Scope-In Step 3 - Scoping expand: Financial and Management Accounting > Management Accounting-Here Financial Planning is scoped.-In Step 4 - Questions expand: Financial and Management Accounting > Management Accounting and highlight Financial Planning-You notice that the question: You can plan financial statements, cost centers and profit centers is missing here.-Resolution-For HANA DB systems, we don't support the planning solution (Financial Planing tool and maintaining a Planned Profit and Loss Account).-For HANA DB, we have a new planning solution. You can check the documentation in Help Center by entering Planning Quick Guide in the search area.-Keywords-Bilanz, GuV oder Kapitalflussrechnung, Kostenstellen und Profitcenter

Title: Event-AfterLoading Is Not Getting Triggered
Content: Symptom-You have a custom solution with Event-AfterLoading added on a Extension BO's Node  (BO stands for Business Object), you access a view on frontend that has data of the Node that you added the event, but the event is not triggered.-E.g.: You have a Event-AfterLoading on Node Item of BO CustomerQuote. You open a CustomerQuote instance on frontend and click on tab Products. Tab Product have a list of Items that is related to the current CustomerQuote, but accessing this tab didn't trigger the Event-AfterLoading.-Environment-All Versions of SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer.-All Versions of SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Login on SDK.-Open a Solution YABC1234_ (YABC1234_ stands for the ID of your custom solution).-Create a Extension BO.-Create a Event-AfterLoading for one of the Nodes of the Extension BO.-Login on frontend.-Access the Work Center related to the Extension BO.-Access a TI (TI stands for Things Inspector) View or Tab or EC (EC stands for Embedded Component) that use data of the Node that you created the Event-AfterLoading, but the event was not triggered.-Cause-The Event-AfterLoading is a event that will be only triggered when a instance of the Node is loaded on frontend. This means that only if the whole instance of the Node is loaded, the event will be triggered. Other retrieved methods, like associations, direct access and field binding will only load specific element data and not the instance, so for this cases the event is not triggered.-E.g.: You have a Event-AfterLoading on Node Item of BO CustomerQuote. You open a CustomerQuote instance on frontend and click on tab Products where a list of Items that is related to the current CustomerQuote is maintained, but event After-Loading was not triggered. The data on that List is just a reference to some data of some elements of Node Item. The event will only trigger if you click on the Item and open its own View. Once the Item View is opened, system load the entire Node Item and then the Event-AfterLoading is trigger.-Resolution-Adapt your ABSL Script and Business Logic to consider that Event-AfterLoading will only trigger when the whole instance is loaded and that any kind of retrieve, association or bound data performed on the View will not trigger the event.-Keywords-ABSL; Script; Event; AfterLoading; Extension; BO; Node; Trigger;

Title: How to Add New Resposibilities to Existing Account
Content: Symptom-You want to mass add responsibilities to existing accounts.-Via the Common Task Mass Change Account Data you can only change existing responsibilities, not add new ones.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Mass Change Account Data from the Common Task section.-Find the relevant account and click Go (leave the field blank to display all accounts).-Select the relevant accounts (by holding the shift button and left clicking, you can select multiple accounts) and click Add to Worklist (Selected Accounts) or click Add to Worklist (All Accounts).-Select Next.-Show the Responsibilities.-You expect that you can add new responsibilities in this step.-Cause-The Common Task Mass Change Account Data is just to change the existing entries and not to add new data to the existing accounts.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-You can add new responsibilities to the existing accounts via the migration tool.-You need to download the migration template Customers first:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-In the phase Prepare, ﻿Show All Activities and find the Prepare for Data Migration Activity.-Open the Prepare for Data Migration Activity.-Open Download migration templates.-Mark the entry Customers and click Download.- You have to Unhide the Direct Responsibilities Book in the Customers migration template:-Open the downloaded migration template Customers.-Right mouse click on any book label and select Unhide.-In the dialog box select Direct Responsibility and click Ok.-You are now able to maintain the new responsibilities in the book Direct Responsibility.-To Enhance already existing records you can use the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Implementation Projects view.-Click Open Activity List.-Navigate to the phase Integrate and Extend.-Show All Activities and find the Migration of Customers activity.-Open the activity.-Click the link Migrate customers using the migration tool.-Click Upload (Data from Migration Template).-Click Browse to select the migration template.-Click Upload.-Click Properties and change the Migration Mode to Enhance already existing records and click Save.-Press the button Execute Migration (Migration Step by Step)- The system adds the new responsibilities according to the data in the migration template-  Keywords-Add New Resposibilities to Existing Account , Add New Resposibilities , Enhance Resposibilities to Existing Account

Title: How to find the BO, BO Nodes and Query from the Test Shell for any Query Action in the UI
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to find the BO, BO Node and Query from the Test Shell for any Query Action in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You should use one of the IRA Test System and not the Customer System.-              1. Login to a Test System-              2. As an example, we are looking for the BO(s), BO Nodes and Query from Test Shell -              for the Action Go in the Value Help of the field Ship-to Name in the General tab of a Sales Order.-                 3. Retrieve the FSI View name for this query using case document : -                1727676 - How to Find Trex Index ID and FSI View Which Fetches Data on the Screen - Using STAD Tcode.-               Using this case document you will find that  : the Joint Index is jdx_bpr_identification_addr AND The FSI View Name is bpr_identification_addr.-               FSI View Name : BPR_IDENTIFICATION_ADDR-             4. Following the same approach as describe in case document 1727676 (above) retrieve the ESF Information.-                               5. From the result (in attachment ESF.txt), retrieve the relevant ESR Names and their corresponding BO Node(s) :-               5.1 Find the BO Core Operation Query-               One can see that there is 2 instances with the BO Core Operation Query :-                       BO Core Operation             QUERY                                                    -                       ESR Name                           Party                                                    -                       Namespace                         http://sap.com/xi/AP/FO/Party/Global                     -                       BO Node                             NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ADDRESS                                 -                       Entity Name                        QUERY_BY_IDEN_AND_ADDR-                       BO Core Operation             QUERY                                                    -                       ESR Name                           BusinessPartner                                          -                       Namespace                         http://sap.com/xi/AP/FO/BusinessPartner/Global           -                       BO Node                             DEF_ADDR_AND_DEF_HAS_CP                                  -                       Entity Name                        QUERY_BY_IDENT_A_ADDRESS-              5.2 The Query Name  and BO Node are mentioned in the ESF Trace-                     Bo Node                                 NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ADDRESS-                     Query Name                          QUERY_BY_IDEN_AND_ADDR-                    BO Node                                 DEF_ADDR_AND_DEF_HAS_CP           -                    Query Name                           QUERY_BY_IDENT_A_ADDRESS-              5.3 Retrieve the Business Object name from the ESR Name-              Using the transaction MDRS you can easily find the BO Object name as mentioned in the example below. ESR Name "OrganisationalCentre" => The Bo Name is "/MOM/ORG_CENTRE/"-                                     You have now find the BOs, BO Nodes and Query for a specific action in the UI-                       BO - BO Node - Query :-                      PARTY - NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ADDRESS - QUERY_BY_IDEN_AND_ADDR-                      BUSINESS_PARTNER - DEF_ADDR_AND_DEF_HAS_CP - QUERY_BY_IDENT_A_ADDRESS-In order to determine if the issue is an FSI issue or Application, you would need to go to the Test Shell (Transaction SESFTS) and check the query for each BO Nodes.-Go to SESFTS-Enter BO PARTY-Select Load by Query NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ADDRESS - QUERY_BY_IDEN_AND_ADDR-          > Error Messages will be displayed in case of any issue with the BO PARTY and BO Node NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ADDRESS.-Enter BO BUSINESS_PARTNER-Load by Query DEF_ADDR_AND_DEF_HAS_CP - QUERY_BY_IDENT_A_ADDRESS-         > Error Messages will be displayed in case of any issue with the BO BUSINESS_PARTNER and BO Node ROOT.-In case error messages are application related, please forward to Application Development. Otherwise, send the incident to FSI Expert Support with your detail analysis.-  Keywords-BO; BO Node; Query; Backend

Title: Visibility of Characteristics in Data Sources and Reports
Content: Symptom-You are creating your own data source, key figure or report and you notice that a characteristic or key figure that is available in the standard data source is not available for your own object.-Alternatively, you are checking the data source documentation and noticed the column Visibility. You would like to know what this setting means.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-The steps to reproduce vary depeding on your scenario. You may find yourself in-The work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports > in the report wizard-The work center Business Analytics, view Design Data Sources > in the data source wizard-The work center Business Analytics, view Design Key Figures > in the key figure wizard-Cause-There is a setting that determines in which other Analytics UI the respective field can be viewed:-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Data Sources.-Search for the required data source.-In the column Documentation, click on the magnifying glass symbol. This will open the documentation.-In the Characteristics and Key Figures table, there is a column called Visibility, which shows one of the following entries:-Visible for MDAV Modelling-Visible for MKFC Modelling-Visible for Report Modelling-Visible for End User Personalization-Resolution-Visible for MDAV Modelling: The field is visible in data sources, however not in reports or other analytical objects (e.g. key figures).-Visible for MKFC: The field is visible in data sources and during key figure creation.-Visible for Report Modelling: The field is available in data sources, key figures and reports. However in report, it cannot be added via the Add Fields feature.-Visible for End User Personalization: This is the highest level of visibility. The field is available in all analytical objects (data sources, key figures and reports) without restriction.- These settings cannot be changed.-Keywords-visible for MDAV modelling, visible for MKFC, visible for end user personalization, visible for report modelling, field not available, field missing in report, missing field in key figure wizard, add fields-analytics,report,data source,custom,key figure,missing field

Title: How to Create a Customer Return without a Reference
Content: Symptom-How to create a customer return without a reference.-Business Scenario could be that you have not migrated sales orders from your legacy system and a customer returns goods which are referenced to a sales order in your legacy system. The customer is now returning goods and you need to create a customer return which is referencing your document in the legacy system instead of a document in your Business ByDesign System.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select New Customer Return Notification in the Common Tasks.-You are not able to create a customer return without reference as the system is asking for a sales order or customer invoice reference.-Cause-In order to create a customer return without a reference, you would need to skip the first step when creating a New Customer Return Notification.-Resolution-To create a customer return without reference, follow these steps in logistics:-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select New Customer Return Notification in the Common Tasks.-Skip step 1 Select Outbound Delivery Items and navigate straight to step 2 Edit Customer Return Delivery Notification.-Enter the Delivery Notification ID XYZ, Ship-to Party, Ship-to Location and the Sender ABC (XYZ represents the Delivery Notification number and ABC represents the number of the account which returned the goods).-In the Line Items tab press the Add Row button.-Enter your Product ID, the Delivery Notification Quantity and the Reason for the Return.-In the field Sales Order ID and Sales Order Item ID you need to enter a reference e. g. EXT (EXT represents the external number of the reference document you are creating the return for e. g. a sales order from a legacy system).-Navigate to step 3 Review.-Note: there will be a warning message (Sales order item reference not valid) displayed since the system does not recognize the entered reference number. This warning message can be ignored.-Press the Finish button.-Select the link Post Goods Receipt for Customer Return Notification Document XYZ.-In the Create Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt ensure that the data is complete e. g. that the Actual Quantity has been maintained and then press the Save and Close button.- Now you can execute these steps in the Sales Order work center:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Open return EFG (EFG represents the number of the return which has just been created out of the Inbound Delivery and Goods Receipt).-You will see that the return EFG is inconsistent and the following error messages will be displayed:-Item XX: Sales Order reference with ID EXT-EXT not valid (XX represents the line item number).-Ref ID EXT and type Sales Order is not valid. Enter a valid ref ID-Ref ID EFG is not valid. Enter a valid ref ID.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Line Item and press the Assign Reference button.-In the Assign Reference window activate the External Indicator.-Enter the Reference Type Sales Order, Reference ID EXT and Reference Line EXT.-Press the OK button.-The return will now be consistent and you can continue the return process e.g. Release the return with Credit Memo.-Keywords-Retoure ohne Referenzbeleg, Customer Return, Reference,

Title: Credit Card Payment Outside Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You wish to select Credit Card as payment method for sales transactions (for example: Sales Order/Customer Invoice), however you receive Credit Card payments and process them out of SAP Business ByDesign system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Cause-The Payment Method entered in Customer Invoice, for example, has the meaning to define how the Business ByDesign system will collect the money from the customer. It is not an information field as “the invoice is paid by”.-The Credit Card payment method can only be used in sales transactions if there's an integration with a third-party system like Paymetric, Computop, for example, otherwise the system would be obliged to store delicate credit card detail information which is highly sensitive, such as tokens.-Caution:-SAP Business ByDesign has been supporting point-to-point integration with very few payment service providers until now. This will be replaced by the SAP Digital Payments add-on which provides a central add-on, supporting multiple payment service providers out of the box, granting more flexibility and choice. Also, as SAP Digital Payments is integrated with many SAP products, there is only one central integration with the payment service provider. For detailed information about SAP Digital Payments, please refer to this blog.-Setting-up point-to-point integration with Computop will not be possible with the deprecation from the February 2023 release of SAP Business ByDesign. However, for customers productively using Computop integration there will be no changes. They will still be able to use the scenario and accept credit card payments via Computop point-to-point integration.-Resolution-It is still possible to process these payments externally and inform the system (ByDesign) that these are external payments, which means, not processed within the SAP Business ByDesign system. In other words, the External Payment in the sales transactions can be selected, then each open item can be cleared on the bank statement with the transaction details provided by the credit card provider.-External payments are payments not processed within the SAP Business ByDesign system. If an e-Shop is connected to the system, the e-Shop collects payment confirmation from the online payment service provider used and supplies this information to the system. An online payment service provider offers online services for accepting electronic payments through a variety of payment methods. The system enables the processing of these external payments.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Customer Payments by Credit Card-Keywords-Credit Card. External Payment.

Title: Prerequisites for B2B Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-When working on B2B Orders; you might come across inconsistencies. Please be aware of the following prerequisites :-•Product ID sent via the Create request should be maintained in the Product master data in the CRM system.--•If any of the mandatory information is missing/incorrect (say list price of items, organization data mismatch, etc), it would result in an inconsistent Sales Order in the Create scenario.--•If the list price information of the product is not sent via the Create/Change request, and if the same is not maintained in the product master data, it would result in creation of an inconsistent sales order. On creation of such an inconsistent order, the list price for the missing items should be maintained from the sales Order UI.--•If an inconsistent sales order has to be canceled, it should first be made consistent by maintaining the missing information from the UI. Only then should you cancel the sales order. If you cancel such a sales order by selecting a value from the ‘Reason for Rejection' drop-down, the life cycle status of the sales order would still be 'In-Preparation'. When you click the Submit button -> Release Order, the life cycle status would then change to 'Completed'.--•If the inconsistent sales order is canceled from the sales order UI by entering a 'Reason for Rejection', then the sales order life cycle status would be 'In-Preparation', and the Submit button would be disabled on the UI. This sales order would then become unusable.--•If a Change request tries to update the sales order with some information which will change the consistency status of the sales order from consistent to inconsistent, then such a change request will be rejected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-error message, pricing, Item XX: Mandatory Price List missing for the price calculation, reason for rejection, greyed out, grayed out, cannot remove

Title: Unable to Register Credit Card With Service Provider
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of integrating with a service provider for customer payments by credit card.-You have gone through the needed scoping changes, set up the communication arrangement, Clearing House, Clearing House Account and maintained proper supplier details for your service provider-However, despite that, the Register With <Service Provider Name> button is not available in the account's master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Select a customer account and click Edit -> Financial Data.-Go to the Bank Data sub-tab.-In the Credit Cards section, the Register With <Service Provider Name> button is missing, therefore generating a token and adding the credit card in the system cannot be done.-Cause-It's not possible to generate a token with the service provider because the supplier account, which represents the service provider, is not assigned to a Clearing House Account.-Resolution-A clearing house is a financial institution or service provider that acts as a third party in the clearing of future payment contracts. A clearing house account, therefore, is an internal representation of an account that is set up and managed at a clearing house for card payments to the company.-To be able to add a new credit card via Register With <Service Provider Name> button, the service provider must be assigned to the clearing house account by the following steps:-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Clearing House Accounts sub view.-Edit the account.-Fill out the Service Provider ID with the credit card service provider. The entry is shown in the list as soon as you have created the provider as a supplier in the master data record.-Save the changes.-After the above settings, it should be able to register the credit card in the customer's master data.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Customer Payments by Credit Card-Keywords-Credit Card. Register With. Payment Service Provider. Tokenize.

Title: Message: The Following Assignment is Required: Business Configuration Work Center, Business Area - Sales Work Center View
Content: Symptom-When attempting to make changes in the Fine-Tuning activity under the Business Configuration work center, the system displays the following authorization error:-“You cannot change this activity because you do not have the required authorizations. The following assignment is required: Business Configuration Work Center, Business Area – Sales Work Center View.”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project from the list.-Click Open Activity List.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune tab.-Open the required activity XXXXX (where XXXXX represents the name of the activity).-Attempt to make changes to the activity.-Cause-The error occurs because the Business Configuration – Business Area Sales Work Center View is not assigned to the affected business user XYZ (where XYZ represents the business user).-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to User and Access Management and select the Business Users sub view.-Search for and select the affected business user XYZ.-Select Edit and choose Access Rights.-Navigate to the Work Center and View Assignment tab.-Expand the BC_BUSINESSCONFIGURATION identity role.-Select the Assigned to User checkbox for the BC_SALES identity role.-Select Save and Close.-Log in again as the affected business user and verify that the required activity can now be modified.-Keywords-You cannot change this activity because you do not have the required authorizations;  The following assignment is required; Business Configuration Work Center; Business Area – Sales Work Center View; BC_SALES, Authorization, Work Center, Fine-Tuning

Title: Data Flow Verification Error: 'Document dates differ'
Content: Symptom-You've ran a data flow verification run, which ended up in error due to date differences.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Data Flow Verification Results view.-Find the relevant result.-Expand the error log.-You see the error messages:-Accounting Notification <document ID>, Operational Document Type <Document type>, Company <Company ID>-'Document dates differ'-Cause-The data flow verification is comparing the posting dates of the source document.-The changes on the posting date occurred and has been reflected in separate source document versions. The data flow verification has been executed in between these two source document versions, hence the matching posting date in the second version was processed after the data flow verification.-Resolution-A repeat check after the second version of the source document is processed clears the error.-Keywords-Data Flow Verification Result. Source Document Version. General Ledger.

Title: Error When Processing MT940 Bank Statement File - File Contains Invalid Content
Content: Symptom-You try to upload a MT940 Bank Statement.-An error message appears after starting the upload: 'Error in processing, file contains invalid content'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the File Management view and select the Inbound Files sub-view.-Press New and select Inbound File.-Under Attachments click Add and select File.-Add the file and pressStart File Upload.-You receive the error message: 'Error in processing, file contains invalid content'.-Cause-Information in the TAGS is not consistent.-Resolution-The MT940 file is a text file that containing multiple text lines. These text lines describe the records for the resulting bank statement.-The following rules apply-Each record must be preceded by a TAG (: XX:).-A file can include one or more messages.-A message comprises a Bill.-A message can have multiple: 61: and: 86: records include.-The SAP MT940 format consists of a sequence of fields defined as follows.-    Tag Type                          Meaning-    :20:-  Transaction Reference-:25:-  Account Specification-:28:, :28C:-  Transcript Information /Statement Number/Sequence Number-:60F: :60M:-  Initial Balance-:61:-  Statement Line(One per transaction)-:86:-  Definition /Information to Account Holder-:62F:, :62M:-  Closing balance-Sample Format-:20:20130305-:25:200771/61999318-:28C:22063/01-:60F:D020305GBP3701098,07-:61:0203050305DX72,25NCHK701099//-:86:999/CHEQUE 701099-:61:0203050305DX273000,00FTFRNONREF//-:86:999/00TFRNEW TREASURY DEPOSIT 72264933-:61:0203050305RCX1,50FREVNONREF//-:86:999/00REVREVERSAL-:62F:D020305GBP3823849,93-Keywords-Error MT940 Bank Statement, File Contains Invaild content

Title: The Payment Method Bill of Exchange is Not Available to be Scoped as Payment Method in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-In Business Configuration during the setup of the Implementation Project or in a Change Project you cannot select/scope Bill Of Exchange as the payment method.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesing all versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center. -Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select the Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the step 4: Questions.-From the Show filter Select All Elements.-Under Cash and Liquidity Management select Payment Methods.-You cannot find any question relative to the Payment Method the Bill Of Exchange-Cause-The payment method Bill of Exchange is only released for France, Spain and Italy.-Resolution-You need to scope France, Spain or Italy as a country to be able to select Bill Of Exchange as payment method.-Keywords-Payment Method, Bill of Exchange, Business Configuration, Not available, How to.

Title: Error Message: To-stock Process Type Not Possible; Inventory Data in Product Missing
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release purchase order ABC but the Order button greyed out, and system raising error message:-Item X: To-stock process type not possible; inventory data in product missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purhase Request And Orders work center, Purchase Orders view. -Find purchase order ABC, open it.-Click Check button, system raising error message:-Item X: To-stock process type not possible; inventory data in product missing-Cause-The ship to location for item X, saying site DEF (DEF stands for site ID) is not maintained in the Logistics tab of the corresponding product master data.-Resolution-Please open the product master data of item X, add a row in the Logistics tab of for the site Y and activate it.-Once this is done and saved, you can go back and check the Purchase order. You will no longer face the error and will be able to order it.-Keywords-Purchase order, To-stock, Inventory Data

Title: Customer Demand is Released Automatically
Content: Symptom-When you create and release a Sales Order, the Customer Demand is released automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center and navigate to Sales Orders view.-Create a New Sales Order ABC via the Common Tasks (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Enter all respective details and click Save.-Release the Sales Order ABC by clicking on the Submit button and selecting the Release Order option.-The status of the Sales Order will change to In Process instead of Open.-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center and the Customer Demand view.-In the Show field select All Orders by Selection and search for sales order ABC.-You see that the Customer Demand is in status Released.-Cause-There are two conditions when a Customer Demand is automatically released after the Sales Order is released:-In case of TPOP Scenario (Sales order item fulfilment = External)-In case of Immediate delivery (Sales order item fulfilment = Internal) in a sales order where the stock is Confirmed (ATP is green)-Apart from this there is an exception that if a sales order has a Delivery Block set then regardless of the above two conditions the customer demand does not gets released automatically.-Resolution-This is the system standard behavior.-Keywords-customer, demand, released, automatically, sales, order, immediate, delivery

Title: GDPR - Google Maps Mashup
Content: Symptom-Due to new to the new GDPR laws (General Data Protection Regulations), you would like to know what information the Google Maps Mashup would send to Google, for the Maps functionality from the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer-Resolution-The Google Maps Mashup Integration will only send the Address master data to Google in order to retrieve the map location. This means that no customer data (e.g. Names) will be sent to Google.-Keywords-Google Maps; Mashup; GDPR

Title: No taxes calculated for US - Tax Code US 507
Content: Symptom-When you create CRM sales documents (e.g. Sales Order, Customer Invoice) tax code 507 is determined for tax country US.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new CRM sales document or edit an existing one.-Fill in the mandatory data.-No taxes are calculated for items with tax code 507, which can be seen on sub tab taxes of item tab.-Cause-A sale to a particular US state is only taxable in case the seller has a nexus in this state. Without nexus, no sales tax will be determined. The system determines that a company has nexus in a particular US state if, and only if, there is a company tax arrangement with a tax registration for this state.-A company tax arrangement must be created for every tax authority that is relevant. For tax calculation to work properly, a tax registration number of type “State Sales and Use Tax Registration Number” has to be entered. This documents that the company is tax registered in the state where the tax authority is located, and provides the basis for nexus determination in the tax determination.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Click on the button New - Tax Authority or edit the relevant one in case this is already existing.-Click on the button View All.-In case you create a new Tax Authority, fill in all the mandatory data on the tab General. Please note, for US the State field is mandatory for a correct tax calculation.-Go to the tab Company Tax Arrangement and create a tax arrangement for the concerned company and region. Ensure that a tax number of number type State Sales and Use Tax Registration Number is used.-Click on the button Save.-Trigger a new tax calculation in the affected document.-Keywords-seller, nexus, state, tax management, company tax arrangement, tax authority, calculation, determination, évèmenent fiscal, gestion des taxes, administration fiscale, tva

Title: Over the Counter Sales ID missing from the Worklist
Content: Symptom-You have created an Over the Counter Sales document with a Credit Card payment.-When you check the transaction document from the Credit Card Processor you notice that the ID AAA provided cannot be found in the User's Interface of ByDesign (AAA is the Merchant reference number).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over the counter sales Work Centre.-Go to the Over the counter sales View.-Search for Document BBB (BBB being the Over the Counter Sales Document) with ID AAA.-You expect to find a Sales document that matches ID AAA but none can be found.-Cause-The Merchant reference number is not expected to match SAP Business ByDesign Source Document ID since it is an externally generated number.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Computop, payment processing, Over the counter sales, ID, Merchant reference number, credit card, paiement, carte de paiement, carte de crédit, vente de gré à gré

Title: Error: Entry In Mandatory Field Bank Charges Paid By For Domestic Bank Transfer Missing
Content: Symptom-When processing the payment to employee, you receive the error message:'Entry in mandatory field Bank Charges Paid By for Domestic bank transfer missing.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Payables.-Go to view Automatic Payments.-Show All Payment Proposals and Find XXX(XXX represents the ID of payment).-Open Payment ID XXX.-Click on View All.-Payee is employee ABC(ABC represents the ID of employee).-Click on Check or Execute Payment, receive error message:Entry in mandatory field Bank Charges Paid By for Domestic bank transfer missing.-You are unable to find field Bank Charges Paid By of employee ABC.-Cause-When payment medium format is S.W.I.F.T. MT103 for a payment, it requires a bank bearer code i.e. Bank Charges Paid By is a mandatory field. Currently, if such a payment is generated from a payment run, this error cannot be overcome because the screen for automatic payment does not contain this field.-Resolution-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payment and Find XXX.-Select Document ID XXX and click on Edit.-Note down all the details as you are going to void and create a new payment.-Click on Actions and select Void Proposal.-Go to view Payment Monitor.-Click on New Payment By and select Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Fill in the details as per previous payment. Make sure to check the open item that was there on the original payment.-Ensure you have filled Bank Charges Paid By field.-Post the payment.-Keywords-bank charges paid by, bank transfer

Title: Fixed Asset Transfer Between Companies
Content: Symptom-You want to transfer one or more fixed asset(s) from Company ABC to Company DEF. ABC represents the source company ID, DEF represents the Target Company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-There is currently no intercompany process available for fixed assets in SAP Business ByDesign.-As a workaround, you can scrap/retire the asset in Company ABC and create a new fixed asset in Company DEF.-Keywords-transfer fixed asset; intercompany transfer fixed asset; move fixed asset;

Title: Price Lists not Determined as Expected on Different Items of Same Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-WAITING FOR VALIDATION-You notice that the Items of a Sales Order have different Price Lists applied to them. The product ID for each item is the same.-Item BB: the determined Price List is XYZ (BB is the Item ID, XYZ is the Price List ID) and is for Country B.-Item CC: the Price List is UVW (CC being the ID of another Item and UVW the ID of the other Price List) and is for Country C.-Both have the same Product ID DEF (DEF stands for the Product ID) and are shipped both to Country C and the same Customer.-You expect that both Items must have Custom List Price RST determined based on these specifications: Validity Range, Product, Ship-to Country and Customer. (RST being the ID of expected Price List).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the  Sales Order Work Center.-Go to the Sales Orders  View.-Search for Sales Order AAA and select it.-Click Edit, then View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then the Pricing subtab.-In Item Pricing, click Expand All.-Hover the mouse on the Description of the Price Component List Price.-Both Items BB and CC have different Custom Price Lists.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio.-Go to the Price Lists Subview.-In Show, select the relevant Price List Filter.-Go to the Advanced Search.-In Product Category ID, search for Product DEF, click Go.-In the Name column, filter on Price List UVW.-Repeat the Same for XYZ.-Price List UVW is still released, however its validity range is over at the time Item CC was added to the sales order.-Price List XYZ is still valid, however it is created for another Ship-to Country than Sales Order AAA.-Cause-Custom Price List UVW is determined for item CC as it was still valid at the time of Sales Order AAA Pricing Date.-Custom Price List XYZ is determined for item BB as a different Ship-to Country (Country B) was originally maintained. The price was not redetermined after Country C was selected.-Custom Price List RST is not determined as it is not valid at the time of Sales Order AAA Pricing Date-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-To have Price List RST applied on Items BB and CC, its validity dates need to be changed:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio.-Go to the Price Lists Subview.-In Show, select the relevant Price List Filter.-Go to the advanced search.-In Product Category ID, search for Product DEF, click Go.-In the Name column, filter on Price List RST.-Click Edit, stay on the General tab.-In the Valid From /To fields, extend the date so that it covers Sales Order AAA Pricing Date.-Save.-Go back to Sales Order AAA.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then to the Pricing subtab.-Scroll down to the Total Pricing section-Click Update Pricing, select Completely.-This action redetermines the price for all of the items and applies the valid Price List.-Keywords-Price List, Items, Sales orders, Product, validity, dates, date, different, Price Component, changes tab, Liste, Postes, Commande client, Validité, Produit, Element de prix, prix, onglet modification

Title: How to assign Down Payment for Customer Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You want to assign a Down Payment document to a Customer Invoice Request-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-Create a Customer invoice request via a Web Service (This is similar to creating or updating a manual invoice request under the UI).-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer subview, Under Input and Output Management.-Search for the Manage Customer Invoice Requests (ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn).-Select the Maintain customer invoice requests.-Click the Download WSDL button-If you are assigning with an existing Down Payment, please fill the BusinessTransactionDocumentReference node.-In this node there are two subnodes that needs to be filled out.-First, the ID has to be filled out on the BusinessTransactionDocumentReference subnode. This is the Down Payment ID that will be assigned to the invoice. The BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues node would be used when you want to put a certain amount of the Down Payment against the Invoice. There are two elements that need to be filled out.--A. The PlannedDownPaymentAmount needs to be filled out with the amount which you wish to assign to the invoice and the currency of the Down Payment.--B. The MaximumDownPaymentAmountApplyIndicator is used to indicate if the maximum possible amount will be used from the Down Payment. This will have to be set to false if you wish to assign.-<BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-<BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-<ID>ABC-123</ID>-</BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-<BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues>-<PlannedDownPaymentAmount currencyCode="USD">100 </PlannedDownPaymentAmount>-<MaximumDownPaymentAmountApplyIndicator>false </MaximumDownPaymentAmountApplyIndicator>-</BusinessTransactionDocumentReferenceActualValues>-</BusinessTransactionDocumentReference>-2. The Down Payments should be created and cleared by accounting before assigning to Invoice Request-Create a New Down Payment Request.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Service Explorer subview, Under Input and Output Management.-Search for the Manage Downpayment Customer Invoice Request (ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn).-Select the Maintain downpayment invoice request.-Click the Download WSDL button.-OBS: Only Manual Invoice Request type ( No Predecessor document) created via the Web Service  can have a Down Payment assigned via Web Service.-Keywords-Assign; Down Payment; Invoice Request; Webservice; Web Service;

Title: Unable to Uncheck Scoping Question "Do you want to specify textual master data using more than one script?"
Content: Symptom-You want to uncheck scoping question "Do you want to specify textual master data using more than one script?", but system throws below error message:-"Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings of the productive data."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration Woc-2. Select Implementation Projects View-3. Highlight current project and select Edit Project Scope-4. Navigate to step 4 Questions and select Build-in Services and Support > Business Environment > Addresses and Languages-5. Uncheck question "Do you want to specify textual master data using more than one script? " and select Finish, then error occurred.-Cause-The issue might be due to that you have already maintained Multiple Scripts in Business Partner and/or Organization Management-Resolution--Please check all your master data maintained in Business partners and organizational management, and remove the script entries for scripts other than the default one.-Next to the drop-down list for choosing in which script to maintain, you can choose to DELETE entries for the choosen script. Please note, that it is impossible to delete the entries for the "Default" script. Once you cleaned up the master data in such a way, you will be able to unscopre the multiple script option.-Keywords-Multiple scripts

Title: Customer Account Statements Only Available for South Africa
Content: Symptom-Customer Account Statement Run cannot be created successfully for countries other than South Africa. The run remains in In Process status and cannot be finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Receivables work center.-Open the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Customer Account Statement sub view.-Select New and select Customer Account Statements Run.-Enter the required data and save.-The run remains in In Process status and cannot be finished.---Cause-The Customer Account Statement Run is only relevant for South Africa to fulfill local legal requirements. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The Customer Account Statement Run functionality is available only for South Africa due to local legal requirements. -See Also-For additional information, refer to SAP Help Portal: Quick Guide for Customer Account Statements-Keywords-Customer Account Statement Run, Customer Account Statement, South Africa; In Process; Status; Functionality

Title: How to Check the Status of the Tenant Requested by the Customer and Password Delivery Status of the Delivered Tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Scenario 1: Customer has requested a tenant (for instance; test, data migration and so on) and wants to know the status of the tenant, if the tenant is delivered or the provisioning of the tenant is still in progress.-Scenario 2: Customer has received the tenant and wants to know, if the initial credentials is been delivered to the customer.-Scenario 3: To check the status of the service request in SPC (that is on 2.6 or 3.0).-Resolution-Scenario 1: The first approach is to see the status of the service request that is raised by the customer in ICP. If you find, that the status of the tenant is delivered, then you can conclude that the tenant is delivered to the customer.
