Title: Backend Error When Uploading MT940 Bank Statement File
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You try  to upload a MT940 Bank Statement but a backend error occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Access Bank Statement view.-Select New button, option Bank Statement Upload.-Fill the New Incoming File data.-Upload the file.-Go to Save button.-The backend error appears.-Cause-One of the root causes can be that the data in Tag 25 is inconsistent, as it contains an Account Number that is not stored in the system because it contains no letters.-Resolution-Data should be mainatined in Bank statement text file as it is maintained in system.-For example:-:25:302020175/021-632195-100-:Tag25:National Bank Code / Account Number-OR-:25:AE770200000021632195100-:Tag25:IBAN Number-See Also-For further information on MT940 Bank Statement text format, you can refer to resolution of Case Document 1888056 - Error in Processing, File Contains Invalid Content While Uploading Bank Statement Using MT940 Format-Keywords-MT940 upload, backend error

Title: Extension Fields for Petty Cash Screen
Content: Symptom-You are unable to create Extenstion Fields for Petty Cash screen level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Petty Cash view.-Click on New and select the payment method.-Select Adapt button and choose the option Enter Adaptation Mode.-Select the Adapt button again and choose the option Edit Screen from it.-Choose the Extension Fields button and select Untitled Table-Click on Add and enter Field Label.-System gives message: Field creation in business context Coding Block no longer supported.-Cause-Currently, it is not possible to create extension fields for Petty Cash at screen level.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Extension field, Petty Cash

Title: Unable to edit tax code in sales order
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the tax code as the tax details are greyed in the sales order.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Sales Orders.-Choose the view Sales Orders.-Search for Sales Order XXX (XXX represents sales order ID).-Open the order and go to View All.-Navigate to tab Items and sub-tab Taxes.-Here it can be seen that the tax details are greyed out and you cannot change tax code.-Cause-The tax date of the sales order is in a closed fiscal year and when you're closing financial periods, all items that fall into this period must be blocked from change- because if change is allowed then it would contradict your annual closing results for that particular fiscal year.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Unable to edit tax code; Tax code greyed out in sales order; cannot change tax code;

Title: Copy button appears greyed out for Interactive Forms
Content: Symptom-You want to Copy an Interactive Form 'As New Variant' or 'As New Template' but the Copy button appears greyed out.-Environment-BusinessByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1) Login to system.-2) Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-3) Scroll to or Search for Form Template with name XXX(Interactive).-4) Select the row of the Template.-5) Copy button remains greyed out.-Cause-The Interactive forms cannot be copied.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Interactive Forms, Copy button greyed out, not able to copy Form Template

Title: How to Check if Report Field is Hierarchy Enabled
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-In the report wizard, in step 4, you can set a hierarchy for certain report fields. You would like to know where to check if a field is enabled for hierarchies.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics, view Design Reports.-Choose your custom report and click on Edit with > Report Wizard.-Click on Next until you are in step 4.-In the column Hierarchy, you can set up hierarchies however this is not possible for all fields. For most of them, the drop-down only shows No Hierarchy.-Cause-The application component who created the data source where the field comes from has made this setting. If required, you can check with this component why particular fields are not hierarchy enabled.-Resolution-To check the setting in the backend:-Go to MDRS.-In the option MDAV Key Figure Composite, search for your report.-Open the folder Characteristics and double-click on any of the fields.-On the right hand side, you will see a list of characteristics available in the report. Check the columns Hierarchy Type and Value. A hierarchy is only enabled when these columns are filled like in the example below.-See Also-2584566 - How to Check the Component Responsible for a Data Source-Keywords

Title: Determination of Default GST Tax Codes for Excisable Products in Customer Invoices
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The default GST relevant tax codes do not apply to your business use case (Alcohol Beverage). But the Default GST tax codes are automatically selected in business transactions, e.g. Customer Invoices.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Create a New Manual Invoice from the Common Tasks.-Add the required details in the invoice request.-Go to the Items tab and add a product.-Go to the Taxes subtab. The Automatic Tax Determination flag is already checked: Based on Bill from & Bill To parties ( if both are in same state then tax code 561 - Domestic Sale Intrastate (CGST & SGST), otherwise tax code 560 - Domestic Sale Interstate (IGST) will be applied. You, however need to use tax code 531-Dom. Sales - Goods (VAT).-Cause-In order to assign the correct tax code in Customer invoices the system checks the Bill from and the Bill To parties; if both are located in the same state then CGST & SGST will be applied. Otherwise IGST will be applied.-Resolution-If the in the Customer Invoice used Material is exisable then follow the below steps:- Go to the Product Data work center.- Select the Materials view.- Select the relevant product and press Edit.- Press View All and go to the General tab.- In the Material Tariff ID for India field enter the Tariff ID*. *If this field is not visible you can add it via the Personalize functionality.-The Material Tariff ID for India is used for excisable products.-By Default, the Basic Excise Duty (BED) is applied for excisable products for which the Material Tariff ID is maintained in the Product Master data. In this case the Tax Code 538 - Domestic Sale Of Goods (Excise and CST) will be applied.-However, if this tax code is not suitable for your business needs, e.g. if you need to use tax code 531 - Dom. Sales - Goods (VAT) then you can either-manually change the automatically determined tax code to 531 - Dom. Sales - Goods (VAT) should there be an existing, not completed Sales Order. This tax code would then also be used in the resulting Customer Invoice.-manually change the automatically determined tax code to 531 - Dom. Sales - Goods (VAT) directly in the manually created Customer Invoice.-Keywords-GST Tax Codes, Excise Duty, Customer Invoice, Automatic Tax Code determination

Title: How to Add Separate Document Numbering Per GST Registration - Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing
Content: Symptom-You want to add a separate document number format per GST Registration Number for Customer Invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Open the Activity List and go to the Fine-Tune activity.-Find the Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing activity and open it.-Press Define document numbering formats for India.-Add Row and maintain the details, such as Company ID, Document type, Sales Document type..You also need to explicitly maintain Tax Registration Number and maintain a number range.-You wonder how to add a separate document number format per GST Registration Number for Customer Invoicing.-Cause-As per GST law, a separate document number format for each of GST Registration number is required.-Resolution-While maintaining the document number ranges,-1. Enter the Tax Registration Number; Select a tax registration number only if you want a separate numbering rule for this registration number.-Addtionally,-2. Enter Tax Reporting Unit - Select a tax reporting unit only if you want a seperate numbering rule for this tax reporting unit.-Keywords-Document Numbering GST Registration

Title: Invoice Schedule in Sales Order Does Not Work For Products to be Delivered
Content: Symptom-You created a Sales Order with services and delivery-based products and you noticed that invoice scheduling is only available for the items type services and not for the products.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select the Sales Order ABC you created (ABC represents the ID of the sales order) and click Edit.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Go to the Invoice Schedule sub-tab.-Result: You can only see the line items for the item type services are available but not the line items for the delivery-based products.-Cause-Invoice schedules can only be created for services, expenses, and entitlements (entitlements can only be used in contracts) but not for products to be delivered, only for products with a project based item type.-Resolution-Please refer to the Help Center Document "Invoice Schedule" for more information.-Keywords-Invoice Schedule, Products-norm,invoice scheduling

Title: How to Complete an E-Mail Activity in the Account Managment Work Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the Activities view of the Account Managment work center, you see e-mails in status open. If you try to change the status via the Change Status button, the option Complete is inactive.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities work center view.-Click on Advance search.-Filter for Activity Type E-Mail and for the Status Open.-Select an e-mail in status Open.-Click on Change Status button, the option Complete is inactive.-Cause-The following requirements are necessary to be able to complete an email :- The fields From and To should be filled with a valid party.- The message to party should have a valid email ID.- User ABC(ABC represents the Business User) cannot complete an email created by user XYZ(XYZ represents the Business User).-As a consequence, if User XYZ creates an email with Message from = User XYZ then only User XYZ can send or-Complete the email.-Moreover, if User XYZ creates an Email with Message from = User ABC then User XYZ-cannot send an email. User XYZ can put the email to complete provided User ABC is not an employee.-However you can put the email to complete provided the message from is an external party. Which implies an Inbound email. When you try to create an email in the system as if you recieved it from an external party. For this we need to trigger the Recieved action.-The e-mail activity scenario has two variations:-The e-mail activity has been created by user XXX, the-e-mail is not sent but just saved, the status has been changed to In-Process by user. After this step the Change Status button is grayed out-and it is not possible to change the status of the email to Completed-(XXX represents the ID of the user).-The email activity has been created by user XXX, the email has been sent-to the recipient, the status has been changed to Completedautomatically.-After this step user XXX can change the status to In Process and if required-it can be again changed to Completed. Hence if you do not send the e-mail activity then it is not possible to change the status.-Resolution-To complete the inbound email activity. Please perform the following steps:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities work center view.-Open the respective Email.-Click on change status and then click on received.-Now the status of the email will be completed.-  A possible alternate workaround is to change the status of the e-mail activities by using the migration tool:--1. Go to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Go to the Overview view.-3. Search for the Migration of e-mail activities.-4. Open the activity and select the Migrate e-mail activities using the migration tool.-5. Data migration window would pop up.-6. Then follow the step by step procedure to upload the template, you can define the status of the email activity.-See Also-Refer to the KBA 2606176 to check the origin of the E-Mail activity.-Keywords-Account Managment, E-Mail Activities, Change Status, E-Mail

Title: Adding an Additional Field For Freight in a Sales Document.
Content: Symptom-In the pricing information in your sales document on header level, you want to add an additional price component line which calculates the same way as freight.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Centre.-Go to Overview.-Find the Configure Price Strategy activity.-Use the Configure Pricing Procedure link.-There is one line for freight but you cannot copy the row and you cannot add any additional rows.-Resolution-In the current system release it is not possible to add another price component line which calculates similar to freight.-It is only possible to add additional price component lines for surcharges. However, these will be calculated like a surcharge and not like a freight component.-Go to the Business Configuration Work Centre.-Go to the Service Order Processing View.-Click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the Scoping Questions.-Use the following path: General Business Data > Product and Service Pricing > Sales Price Specifications.-Activate the Do you want additional surcharges at document level? Question.-Now refer back to:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Centre.-Go to Overview.-Find the Configure Price Strategy activity.-Use the Configure Pricing Procedure link.-Here you will now see five additional lines for surcharges that can be used on header level in your sales document.-See Also-A request for an additional field for freight in sales documents has been posted on the Customer Influence Page.-Keywords-freight, additional price component, surcharge, sales order, header level, Frachtfeld

Title: Creating E-Mail Activity via WebService ManageEmailActivityIn and via UI
Content: Symptom-When you create a New E-mail Activity via WebService ManageEmailActivityIn or via UI, you receive an error: Sending e-mail not possible; sender must be the logged-in user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all its versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the New E-Mail common tasks.-You complete the mandatory information and the following error appears: Sending e-mail not possible; sender must be the logged-in user.-You can create the E-Mail also from the WebService ManageEmailActivityIn following the documentation available in the system, find it on See Also.-Cause-This error is appearing due to the user log in. The same user who is logged in, needs to be the one who is considered as From in the E-mail Activity. Note that if you are creating the E-Mail Activity via WebService, you need to log in the ByD system with the same user to send/release the activity, this functionality is not available in WebService.-Resolution-To solve the issue, log in with the correct user (the one who is sending the email). After that, no error will be faced.-See Also-Please find the documentation for ManageEmailActivityIn WebService to be able to perform this activity via WebService.-Keywords-E-Mail Activity ; User ; WebService ; ManageEmailActivityIn

Title: Convert Lead to Account not available
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Lead and would like to convert the lead into a Corporate or Private Account.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Marketing work center-2. Select the Lead ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the new lead created)-3. Click the Edit button-4. Click the New button under Account-5. There are only two options available:-5.1. Corporate Account-5.2. Private Account-Cause-In order to have the options Convert to Corporate Account or Convert to Private Account from the New button, you need to maintained an Address and a Contact under the Lead created.-Resolution-1. Go to the Marketing work center-2. Select the Lead ID XYZ (XYZ represent the ID of the new lead created)-3. Click the Edit button-4. Click the Address Details hyperlink-5. Maintain a valid address.-6. Under Contacts, click the Add Row button and add a contact. In case there are no contacts available, please click the New button.-Once you have maintained this information, the options Convert to Corporate Account or Convert to Private Account from the New button under the Account will be available.

Title: When you open a report with the Excel Add-In, Characteristics and Key Figures appear in a different language
Content: Symptom-You log into the system in language English. You open a report with the Excel Add-In and the characteristics and key figures appear in a different language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system in English.-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Select the report you want to view.-Run the report with the required selection options.-Select Navigate to and then select Microsoft Excel.-The report will open in Excel but Characteristics and Key Figures are shown in a different language.-Cause-When a report is opened in a browser, it would be in a language by which the user has logged in, in a particular application.-In this case, in what languague you have logged-in into the Excel Add-In, the report would be in the same language.-But the Excel Add-In takes the language from the system settings. So it could happen that you login with language ABC but the Excel Add-In shows language XYZ.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior and works as designed.-To change your language, please follow the steps:-Go to Personalize and My Settings-Go to Tab Regional Settings and under language, you have the option to change the language setting.

Title: ByD - Using Filter Rows in Worklists
Content: Symptom-Filtering worklists for values with special characters e.g. hyphen “-“ returns no results.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Choose filter icon in Worklist.-Use special character for filter criteria and press enter.-Cause-In SAP Business ByDesign the search syntax supports the following operators:-Resolution-If you want to use a character string as a filter and this character string contains one of the special characters (e.g. C-1025) you need to place the entire character string in quotation marks (e.g. "C-1025").-See Also-https://help.sap.com/doc/saphelp_byd1802_en/2018.02/en-US/KTP/Software-Components/01200615320100003379/WEKTRA_for_Work_Centers/CROSS_TOPICS/ENTERPRISE_SEARCH/ESS_CON_FILTER_OWL.html-Keywords-filter; filtering; operators; column filter; search; worklist; byd; special characters

Title: Labor Resource in customer service documents
Content: Symptom-This KBA describes how the labor resource master data can be set up, and how it is used in customer service business documents.-Definition:-A labor resource represents an employee or a group of employees having similar skills and qualifications, with the capacity to operate specific equipment or to perform specific tasks or services.-Usages:-Determination of cost center in finance (mandatory).-Determination of cost rate (optional, if a labor resource has no cost rate, the product cost rate is used).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Master data setup:-The labor resource master data is created and managed in the work center Cost and Revenue in the view Master Data and Allocations in the subview Resources.-A labor resource can be assigned to only one cost center at a time. Over time, a labor resource can be reassigned from one cost center to another.-However, several labor resources can be assigned to one cost center, making it possible to differentiate cost rates within a cost center. To enable the automatic determination of a specific labor resource, specify for which job or jobs it usually is used in the following work center:-Go to the work center Cost and Revenue.-Select the view Master Data and Allocations and the subview Resources.-In the resources work list select respective labor resource and press the button Edit.-Select the tab Valuation.-Select the table Job Assignment.-Press the button Add Row to enter the job assignment.--Labor resource in CRM documents-The labor resource is stored on item level, and is relevant only for service items.-It is mandatory if the item triggers a service provision posting in financials. For this reason, the following item types require a labor resource. Exceptions are listed below.-- service order or sales order documents with item type Fixed Price without actuals (SEFL).-- service confirmation documents with item type Time and Materials (SECO) or Fixed Price with actuals (SERV).-Item type aside, the labor resource is not mandatory if one of the following holds true:-- FIN is not active (for example, in the scenario CRM Focus).-- You work with project based items.-- You work with items with external fulfillment.-Entry/determination of labor resource in service items-A labor resource can be entered manually, and is then checked against relevant item parties.-There is also a determination logic to determine it automatically, based on the service performer party and the service execution team party (if available).-If there is a service performer for this item, and he or she has a unique labor resource assigned to their job or uniquely to their cost center), the labor resource is transferred to the document item automatically. The service execution team is not evaluated if there is a service performer. If there is no labor resource uniquely assigned, one of the resources is transferred to the document, and an information message indicates existing alternatives.-If there is no service performer for this item but a service execution team, the labor resources of the cost center for this service execution team are taken into account. If the cost center has a unique labor resource assigned, this labor resource is transferred to the document.-Keywords-labor resource, master data, revenue, service items, cost center, fixed price, actuals, tiem and materials

Title: Error Message: 'The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data' on Customer Return
Content: Symptom-The following error message is triggered in your Customer Return: 'The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Return view.-Select the Customer Return XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the customer return).-The following error message is triggered: 'The sales organization and distribution channel in the document do not match with the product master sales data.'-Cause-The sales arrangement has been maintained after the creation of the customer return.-Resolution-It is necessary to cancel the customer return and create a new one. You will find guidance to cancel the customer return in the case document entitled "How to Cancel a Customer Return".--Keywords-Return, error, sales arrangement, cancel, cancelation,

Title: Cannot Migrate Customer Contract with Status Field
Content: Symptom-You want to migrate contracts into system with different status, but in the migration template, you cannot find a field to put the status.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and find activity Prepare for Data Migration.-Click Download Templates, then download the template Open Customer Contracts.-You find there is no field to put the contract status.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign system does not support importing status, the functionality is only for Open Customer Contracts, hence when a contract is migrated, it will be created with status In Preparation always.-Resolution-You have to release the contract manually in the system.-Keywords-customer contract, migration template, status field, In Preparation

Title: Dump When Updating the Minimum Order Quantity on Material Sales Tab
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When Customer is trying to update the minimum quantity of a material in the sales tab, a backend dump is generated.-This issue is generally user-specific, and happens when the line of the sales tab contains a custom distribution chanel.-The issue may also happen only by selecting the row with this custom distribution channel, not being necessary to try changing the quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign - all versions.-Reproducing the Issue-Enter Work Center Product Portfolio;-Navigate to the view By Materials;-Select Material XYZ; (XYZ represents the material ID)-Click the button Edit;-Click View All;-Enter the Sales tab;-Click thea row with the custom distribution channel and change the minimum order quantity.-After editing the value, the backend exception is raised, and the system crashes.-Cause-This particular issue occurs due to a timing issue with Silverlight technology, and since this system version will be discontinued a fix will not be deployed.-Resolution-Since no correction is available, you can advise the below Workaround:-After editing the quantity field, click another field (for example, the field "Reference price Material") before saving or moving to another row. This way the system does not raise the error and the system does not crash.-Keywords-crash, backend exception, minimum order, material master data, sales data tab

Title: How to Delete an Activated Organizational Structure Which has References to Other Business Areas?
Content: Symptom-You have created an Organizational Structure and activated the whole structure which has many references to other business areas as listed below. Now, you would like to delete the Organizational Structure but system throws many error messages which are in reference to the other areas.-And you couldn’t able to change the Org unit IDs as well.-Cause-1.       Once an Org Unit is activated, then it is not possible to remove/change the ID assigned to it.-2.       If an Org Unit which is assigned as Company and after activation, it is not possible to delete the Org Unit.-3.       If the Org Unit is assigned as Cost center, profit center, etc., and if it is used in any business transactions documents like assigning an employee to the cost center, Sales order, etc., then it is not possible to delete the org unit until the business transactions documents exists.-Resolution-In these cases, it is highly complex to delete the activated org structure.-Refer the Knowledge Base Document 1497736 - Cannot Delete Org Unit because There Is Employee Work Agreement Reference for the error messages related to employee references while deleting the Org Unit.-Once a Company is activated, then it is not possible to delete the unit.-In order to proceed further, please perform the below actions,-Remove the employee reference from the above org unit as per the document 1497736.-Remove (or change the status to obsolete), if there is any other reference business documents created with any of the org units. For example: sales order, purchase order, fixed asset and so on.-Once you confirm that there is no reference, try to delete the org unit from bottom to top approach. i.e., Child Org units should be deleted first then the parent org units.-But you will not be allowed to delete the company.

Title: Random Dump While Making Changes in Project
Content: Symptom-You are attempting to make a change in a Project and every time you do, the system raises a dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Go to Projects View.-Edit the affected Project and go to its Project Plan.-Change any information in it.-Cause-Check the Project's Finish Date. It is too far in the future such as 30.12.9999.-Resolution-When you change it to a date not so far in future, then those dumps will stop generating.-Keywords-Project Management. Finish Date.

Title: Central Knowledge Base Article: Troubleshooting Dumps
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer reports an issue that they got a DUMP while executing 'XYZ' steps in the Business ByDesign System.-Cause-There could be two major areas which could be responsible for the dump as mentioned below.-It could be caused by a problem in Oberon UI.-It could be caused by a problem in the ABAP code written by the application developers.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to analyze the dump-If the issue is reported from the screen where the dump occurred-Open SAP Incight from the BCP incident.-Navigate to the section 'Dumps and Exceptions' and expand it.-Under this section look for the two sub sections 'Front End Exceptions' and 'ABAP Runtime Errors'.-If there is nothing populated under  'ABAP Runtime Errors'-This means that the dump is caused by the OBERON UI component and not by the ABAP code.-Forward the incident to ES - Client Infrastructure UI Rendering Oberon queue for further analysis.-If you find one or more entries under 'ABAP Runtime Errors'-Expand the section 'ABAP Runtime Error--> ABAP Call stack Table.-Check the top 3 levels and look for any class name that you can find there.-Please note that if you only find the Oberon or Framework related Classes in these levels then its not very helpful because these are the generic classes used by every application. The framework classes will look something like "CL_ESI*" and 'CL_OBERON_RT_LOAD'.-If you find any application related class then it becomes clear which ES- Application queue you need to send the incident to.-If the information from SAP Incight is not enough to find the responsible component or the incident is not created from the same screen where the dump occurred-Log on to the backend of the ByDesign system and execute the transaction ST22.-In the selection screen, use the relevant selection criteria to find the relevant dump in the backend. For example the search criteria you can use are the creation date and time based on the information provided by the customer in the incident.-Once you find the relevant dump, double click on the entry to open the details of the dump-On the details screen, Press CTRL + F on your key board to open the search pop up.-Enter the search string as 'BO_NAME' and press enter. (BO_NAME is part of the variables that are used by the application code to save the name of the BO).-You can find multiple lines as a result of your search.-In most of the cases the entries you will see in the result will look something like 'IN_REQUEST-IN_BO_NAME' or 'IN_BO_NAME'. Double click on the entries at the top of the list to navigate to the place the search text is found in the dump.-You will find the name of the underlying BO that caused the dump mentioned under the variable '*BO_NAME'.-Copy the BO name and execute the transaction '/nMDRS'.-Select the entry 'Business Object' from the drop down and paste the name of the BO in the text box below the drop down and press enter.-you will find the details of the BO on the right side of the screen.-Select the tab 'Overview' and double click on the class name mentioned against the heading Service Provider Class.-On the class details select the tab 'Properties' and then double click on the package name.-you will find the CSS component responsible for your BO against the heading Application Component.-Once you have the CSS component, you may forward the incident to ES-Application queue to which this component belong. For example if the CSS component you found is 'SRD-FIN-GL' you can forward the incident to ES- Financials with your findings.-In case none of the above steps are helpful to find the responsible component for the issue then use your best judgment to forward the incident to relevant ES queue based on which workcenter or workcenter views are involved in incident reproduction.-Having said that, if you are still not sure, forwared the incident to E2E RCA other topics queue.-

Title: Service Quotes View is missing in Service Order Workcenter and New Business Workcenter
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find the Service Quotes View in the Service Order Workcenter-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Order Workcenter-You will not find the View Service Quotes-Cause-You have not given sufficient the access rights for the User to view Service Quotes in Service Order Workcenter-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management-Go to Business User View-Search for the user XYZ who is facing the issue(XYZ is user who is facing the issue)-Click Edit and Select Access Rights-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment tab-Under Available Work Centers and Views select CRM_SERVICEORDERS and expand the view-Select the Checkbox for CRM_OPP_SRVQUO and save the changes

Title: Sales Order in Preparation - Deleting Document Not Possible; Follow-up Document Exists
Content: Symptom-You try to delete a Sales Order, which is in Status In Preparation and you get Error Message 'Deleting document not possible; follow-up document exists'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Workcenter Sales Orders.-Navigate to View Sales Orders.-Find a Sales Order ABC, which is in Status In Preparation (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Click on the Button Delete.-You receive the Error Message 'Deleting document not possible; follow-up document exists'.-Cause-You have created a follow up task for the Sales Order and thus cannot delete the Sales Document, as long as the task is not deleted.-Resolution-You need to delete the Follow-Up Task in order to delete the Sales Order.-To do so follow these steps:-Open Sales Order ABC.-Navigate to Document Flow tab.-Select Show: Extended View.-You can see created Task with ID XXX (XXX represents the Task ID),-Open the Account Management work center.-Navigate to Activities view.-Show All Activities and find Activity XXX.-Click on the Delete Button.-Navigate back to the Sales Order Overview and find Sales Order ABC.-Now you can delete Sales Order ABC.-Keywords-Sales Order Follow-Up Activities Calls E-Mail Task Delete

Title: ByDesign UI - Issues With Screens Extended by Extension Fields After Upgrade or Import of Hotfix
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-One of the following issues occurs after an upgrade/import of hotfix collection-Missing extension fields on screen-No values are displayed for extension fields on screen-Screens which have been extended by extension fields dump-See, for example, BCP incidents 3100792296 and 3100792368-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on to ByDesign UI and navigate to the affected screen.-Cause-Inconsistency in XRepository load-Resolution-These steps have to be performed for each affected tenant-Log on to the backend of the tenant-Transaction SA38-Fill in P_XREP_CORE_GENERATE_LOAD as program name-press SHIFT+F6 and choose variant SAP&INVALIDATE-The screen that is displayed should look like in this screenshot - now press F8 ('execute') - execution of the report will take 5 - 15 minutes-Keywords-XREP, BYD, C4C, Generate Load, Dump

Title: Output Channel Selection Seller Unit and Invoice Unit are Missing from Reminder Letter

Title: How to Check the Origin of an E-Mail Activity
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Customer reports that E-Mails activities cannot be completed. This KBA will help to identify the origin of the E-Mail and will determind if it can be completed or not. See KBA 2595193 for further information.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Cause-The value in the DATA_ORIGIN_TYPE_CODE will determind in accordance of the KBA 2595193, if an E-Mail activity can be completed.-Resolution-Login to the Backend via STFK or similar access.-Enter transaction sesfts(Testshell).-Enter in to the search field for Load BO by Proxy Name; EMAIL_ACTIVITY.-Hit enter.-Go to Load BO Node Instances.-Select Load by Query and Root - Query by Elements.-In the new pop-up window search for Attribute ID/content.-Enter in this field the E-Mail ID found in the frontend work center view Activities.-Click on the check symbol.-Look for the Attribute Name of the result list for DATA_ORIGIN_TYPE_CODE.-Click on the Value Help to show detailed information.-Code   Description-  1        Manual Data Entry (email created in the system but only saved and not send).-  2        Groupware (the email is synchronized from Outlook to C4C).-  3        Direct Mailing (directly received from external party).-  4        Telephony (email created by Telephony).-  See Also-KBA 2595193 - How to complete E-Mail Activites.-Keywords-E-Mail origin, E-mail activity, Complete E-Mail

Title: How to Display a Key Figure in the Report in HTML5
Content: Symptom-You added a standard or custom key figure in the report, but you noticed that it is not showing up in the report view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center and Design Reports view.-Search for XYZ report.-Open the report.-Go to the last one tab  (engineering symbol).-Click on Add Further Fields symbol.-Go to Key Figure tab.-Select the fields which you want to see in the report.-Click on Ok button.-See that the key figure is not showing up in the report.-Cause-It is the system designed behavior. Even though you have added the key figure in the report, you need to display it in the report view.-Resolution-To display the key figure in report view, follow the steps below-Go to Business Analytics work center and Design Reports view.-Search for XYZ report.-Open the report.-Go to the last one tab  (engineering symbol).-Click on Add Further Fields symbol.-Go to Key Figure tab.-Select the fields which you want to see in the report.-Click on Ok button.-Go to Key Figures area and click on the reticence symbol (...).-Select Key Figure Settings.-Move the key figures that you need from Available tab to Selected tab.-Click on Ok button.-Save the report view, if needed.-Keywords-key figure missing

Title: Time Sheet's Column's Sequence Using Drag and Drop
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to reorder the sequence of columns on the Time sheet. After performing reorder by drag and drop, the sequence of columns is not reordered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the View Worklist from the drop-down menu-Move any of the columns Task, Activity, Monday, Tuesday and so on between one another by drag and drop-Select Save and Close-Select Edit Time Sheet-The positions of the columns are not as the same as it was saved-Cause-The drag and drop of columns to maintain the order is not working completely. This is because there are hidden columns in list.-For example, on the Time Sheet, if you drop the column Wednesday next to the column Activity, then you will see the column Wednesday in between columns Task and Activity, since one position taken by hidden column.-Resolution-There are 2 options to rearrange the columns:-Drag and drop-Explicit Personalization-Reorder of columns using Explicit Personalization is more preferred way since you can see hidden columns as in side panel and maintain order accordingly.-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services view-Select Self-Services Overview-Under the section Time, select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the View Worklist from the drop-down menu-Select Start Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-You are now entering the Personalization Mode-Select OK-Choose and expand the UI element from the list-Example: Time entries from DD1.MM1.YYYY1 to DD2.MM2.YYYY2-Change the order of the columns Task, Activity, Monday, Tuesday and so on the Time sheet-Select Save in the Personalization panel-Select Stop Personalization Mode at the top right corner of the screen-Choose Save and Close-Select Edit Time Sheet-In the Time Entries section, select the View Worklist from the drop-down menu-The positions of the columns are reordered as Saved -Keywords-Drag and drop, Personalization

Title: Partner Add-Ons Not Visible in HTML5 UI in SAP ByDesign
Content: Symptom-Partner developed add-ons are visible in Silverlight but not in HTML5 in productive ByD tenant.-Environment-ByD HTML5 client-Reproducing the Issue-Log into HTML5 UI https://myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/public/byd/runtime?client_type=html-Custom work centers and views are not visible.-Cause-Partner content is not enabled by default in Bydesign HTML5 productive systems. This is done to ensure that the content added via Partner Add-on using HTML5 client does not corrupt the data on the productive system.-In test tenants custom add-ons are enabled by default.-Resolution-With 1711 HFC02 administrators can enable partner developed content in HTML5 productive systems following these steps:-Click on the profile icon in the upper right corner.-Select Key User Settings and choose Enable Add-on.-Note that it is not possible to enable individual partner add-ons. It is strongly recommended to first test all the partner add-ons and ensure they work as expected in HTML5 test systems before enabling them in the productive environment.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/viewer/p/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN-Keywords-enable add-on; pdi; custom workcenter; html5; enable content-partner addon,partner add-on,partner content,partner work center,custom work center,html5 addon,html5 byd,enable html5

Title: Report does not indicate correct data because of faulty conversion rate
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The USD exchange rate was maintained incorrectly (dot instead of comma) which caused incorrect sales statistics.-Invoices issued in USD were calculated incorrectly. [RELEASE INTERNALLY]-Reproducing the Issue-WoC Customer Invoicing-View Reports - Invoice Volume Month-to-Date-- Select time period-- Select currency eg-EUR-- The displayed values are not correct in EUR but are correct if one chooses USD-Cause-The USD exchange rate was maintained incorrectly (dot instead of comma) which caused incorrect figures.-Invoices issued in USD were calculated incorrectly.-Resolution-Solution for the involved business transactions--1. Maintain the correct exchange rate in the system in fine tuning-2. WoC General Ledger , View Journal Entries . Identify the correct posting & press edit.-3. Click further possibilities -> show business transaction-4. In the business transaction there is a buttom cancel and repost. When clicking here the posting document-with the incorrect exchange rate is cancelled and reposted with the correct exchange rate.-Subsequently perform a reload for the impacted info-provider on which the query is based on.

Title: How to Split Input VAT Into Partially Deductible And Non-Deductible Input Tax
Content: Symptom-You need to set up a tax code referring to a tax event for which a part of the input tax, X% is deductible, whereas a second part, Y% is to be posted as non-deductible input tax to an expense account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-According to the SAP ByDesign help document Configuration: Tax Codes you have created a partial deductibility code and a tax code using the newly created deductibility:-To create a partial deductibility:-In the Business Configuration work center navigate to either the Implementation Projects view, select your implementation project and open the Activity List.  -Go to the Fine-Tune- phase.-Select the Tax Settings for Purchasing activity (If your system is already live navigate to the Overview view and select this activity from there).-In the Available Deductibility Types table press Copy to add a new line.-Select the respective Country and Tax Type.-Enter a new Deductibility Code, e.g. DCX and an adequate description, e.g. Partially Deductible: X%.-In the table underneath specify the validity and the Deductibility Rate in %, e.g. X%.-Press Save and Close.-To assign the new deductibility to a tax code:-In the Business Configuration work center navigate to either the Implementation Projects view, select your implementation project and open the Activity List.  -Go to the Fine-Tune- phase.-Select the Tax on Good and Services activity (If your system is already live navigate to the Overview view and select this activity from there).-In the new window, under Tax Codes click on the Define Tax Codes link.-Under Available Tax Codes press Add.-Select the respective Country.-Enter a new Tax Code, e.g. DCX,and a Description, e.g. Domestic Acquisition, X% deductible.-Maintain a Valid From and Valid To Date.-In the Tax Event column select a tax event for incoming tax scenarios, e.g. Domestic Acquisition (ID 10).-Press Save and then Close.-You now need to define the G/L Account that shall be used for the non-deductible Input Tax:-In the Business Configuration work center navigate to either the Implementation Projects view, select your implementation project and open the Activity List.  -Go to the Fine-Tune- phase.-Select the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity (If your system is already live navigate to the Overview view and select this activity from there).-Under Account Determination press on the Costs link.-Navigate to the General Expenses tab.-Here search for the Account Determination Group that is to be used for this scenario.-Enter an expense G/L account in to the Non-Deductible Input Tax column. -Resolution-You can now assign the tax code and cost account determination group to the respective item in your purchasing document:-Assign the newly created tax code, e.g. DCX.-In the Account Assignment tab (Cost Distribution tab for a Supplier Invoice item) select an account determination group for which you have defined a G/L account for non-deductible input tax.-Keywords-Split Input VAT, Partially Deductible, Non-Deductible Input Tax, Input Tax

Title: How to assign an approver to a PI Count Document.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You noticed that any user can approve Physical Inventory Count Document and you want to assign a particular approver to your Physical Inventory Count Document.-Resolution-In order to achieve this functionality, you can define Access Restrictions at the Site Level for the Business Users.-With the help of Access Restrictions, you can decide which Business User will have read/write access to the Work Center View.-Go to the Work Center Application And User Management.-Go to the view Business Users.-Select the Business User for which access restriction has to be assigned.-Select the option Edit then Access Rights.-Once the new screen opens, select the Tab Access Restrictions.-Use the filter button and search for the Work Center ID SCM_PHYSICALINVENTORY.-Here you can provide the Read and Write Access at the Site Level for the given business user on Physical Inventory Work Center View.

Title: Unable to Save Material Inventory Valuation Cost
Content: Symptom-The system crashes when saving Material Inventory Valuation Cost.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Materials view.-Show All Materials and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of material).-Select Material ID ABC and click Maintain Valuation Data.-Click Edit Cost for the assigned Sets of Books.-Input parameters and click OK.-Click Save.-The system crashes.-Cause-If the last day of the fiscal year is on current month, system will check whether next fiscal period is open or not.-A system crash occurs if next fiscal period is not maintained yet.-Resolution-To maintain a new fiscal year, follow the steps below:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select required Set of Books ID with assigned Company ID and click Edit Fiscal Years.-Click New Fiscal Year to create it.-Keywords-Maintain Valuation Data; material; inventory valuation; fiscal period; accounting period; fiscal year; Material Inventory Valuation Cost

Title: Controlling the visibilty of an Embedded Component based on the value entered
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. You now try to control the Embedded Components visibilty via Master Layout, Page Layout-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP UI Designer-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the frontend of the system.-Navigate to the affected screen.-Select Master Layout / Edit Page Layout.-You will not be able to edit the Custom Embedded Component using these tools.-Cause-ECs that are added to an existing facet of the host cannot be hidden via Master Layout, Page Layout or Key User defined rules.-Resolution-You will need to use a different approach, to achieve the desired functionality. Title: How to view the Customer Groups in the Backend.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-How to view the customer group in the backend.-Reproducing the Issue-Steps to check the customer groups in the front end.-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Go to view Implementation Projects.-Select First Implementation Project and click on button Open Activity List.-Go to Fine Tuning chevron and select All Activities in the field Show.-Now search for the activity Accounts under the activity group General Business Data.-Open the activity Accounts and click on the link Maintain Customer Groups.-If the status of First Implementation Project is Completed, go to view Overview and search for activity Accounts-After step 7 refer the step 6 again.-Here you can the see all customer groups maintained in the system.-Customer Groups are maintained in the Accounts. Steps to check the customer groups in accounts are as mentioned below.-Go to work center Account Management.-Go to view Accounts.-Select account ABC (Here ABC refers to account ID).-Edit the account and click on button View All.-Now go to tab Sales Data.-Here you can see the Customer Group maintained in the Details of Sales Organization maintained in Sales Data table.-Resolution-Steps to check the Customer Group in backend which are maintained in Frontend.-Login to the backend system.-Now go to Transaction SE16.-Type the table name as 'APC_C_CUSTGRP' and click on button Table Contents or press F7.-Now in the new screen just click on button Execute or F8 without entering any data in any field.-Here you will be able to see all the Customer Groups maintained along with the Client number and description of customer group.-Also in the table 'APC_C_CUSTGRP', you will only be able to see the customer groups maintained language specific. For e. g. If you are logging in the system in English language then you can see the customer groups which are maintained in the system in English language (Frontend system with English language).-Steps to check all the customer groups maintained in the backend system independent of language. It will show all the customer groups which are maintained in the English, German, Spanish and Chinese language etc.-Login to the backend system.-Now go to Transaction SE16.-Type the table name as 'APC_C_CUSTGRP_T' and click on button Table Contents or press F7.-Now in the new screen just click on button Execute or F8 without entering any data in any field.-Here you will be able to see all the Customer Groups maintained along with the details of Language, Client number, customer group and description of customer group.-

Title: How to Dowload the WSDL for Customer Invoice Outbound (SAP ESD)
Content: Symptom-You would like to dowload the WSDL file for Customer Invoice Outbound (SAP ESD).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Communication Arrangements view.-Select the Communication Scenario Output of Customer Invoices.-Click on the Output of Customer Invoices hyperlink.-In the Communication Arrangement Overview: Output of Customer Invoices under the section Outbound Communication select the Service Customer Invoice Outbound (SAP ESD).-Click on the Button Download WSDL.-Save the wsdl file.-Keywords-WSDL, Communication scenario, Customer Invoices, Communication arrangement, webservice

Title: ViewElement of Union MDAV is not in sync with involved MDAV
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new combined data source, and when linking two compounded characteristics between a standard and a customized data source, you observe the following message: "ViewElement Z1234 of Union MDAV is not in sync with involved MDAV".-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the system and go to Business Analytics work center and to Design Data Sources work center view-Click on New button and on Combined Data Source-Include a title for the darta source, and click on Add Data Source button-Search the the standard data source, select its characteristics and click on OK-Repeat the previous step to add the customized data source-Select the compounded characteristics in common with the previously added data source-Click on OK-Note the characteristics in common among both data sources will show in a single row-Click on Check Mapping button-The following message is displayed: "ViewElement Z1234 of Union MDAV is not in sync with involved MDAV".-Cause-When including compounded characteristics in a new Combined Data Source, you must ensure that all the compound fields of each one are also added.-Resolution-Remove the rows of the compounded characteristics involved, and add them again in separate rows, making sure that all compound fields belonging to each compounded characteristic is added in both data sources.-Keywords-Compounded; Characteristics; Data Source; Combined;

Title: Report is not Executed. Error Message is Displayed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you try to run a report you either receive the error message `Report cannot be opened; report an incident` and/or `xmlProperty`.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Report through the desired work center or Business Analytics and click on Go;-See the error messages at the bottom of the screen.-Cause-In case you can also see the XML Property error message, this means that the Report is trying to get too many data, causing the system to crash in the background. There is a system limitation for the amount of data that a Report can fetch.-Resolution-You can either set some fields for the Report in order to cause it to fetch less data or create a Broadcast using the Initial selection/view of the Report.-The Broadcast will make the Report run in the background of the system and will not consume too many system resources. When using Broadcasts, when the report is done, it will be sent to the defined email address. You can use the steps below to create a Broadcast:-Go to the Business Analytics work center and access the view Broadcasts.-Click on the button New.-Define a Name for the Broadcast and select a Report in the field Object Name, you can use the Value Help for this field to select a Report.-In the field Subject, you will define the Subject for the email to be sent, and in the field Message is the message to be sent in the email.-In the Recipients area you will define if you are going to use the feature Broadcast Bursting, this feature allow you to use the emails maintained in the Report, in case you have selected a Report that contains this information, usually, you will only click on Add Row and add only the recipients who you want to receive the report through email.-In the Format field you can select which type of Report will be sent: the CSV format sends out a file that can be opened in the Microsoft Excel, this file is not formatted. The XML format will send out a formatted version that can also be opened in Microsoft Excel. The HTML format will send out a formatted HTML file that can be opened with any Browser. The URL format will send out a web link to open the report through the system itself, however, this will cause the Report to be generated by the time you open the Report through the link.-The View field is used to define which view of the Report will be used to send the Broadcast and the Selection is used to define which selection parameters will be used to send the Broadcast.-The ZIP checkbox defines whether the report will be compressed before sending.-You can define if the report will be sent only once or periodically in the Schedule Area.-After you have made all changes you'd like to have in the Broadcast, you can click on Check and then on Save & Close.-When you go back to the Broadcast screen under Business Analytics, you can now select your newly created Broadcast and click on Start Now to execute it﻿.-Keywords-Report cannot be opened; report an incident, xmlProperty

Title: Tax Refund Amount is Send to G/L Account Nonconvertible Bonds Instead of G/L Account Sales Tax Advance Payment
Content: Symptom-Journal Entry related to Tax refund is showing the posting to G/L Account Nonconvertible Bonds instead of G/L Account Sales Tax Advance Payment.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-You are creating an Electronic Bank statement and the tax refund information is present in the file which you got from the bank. The Journal Entry related to this Tax refund is getting posted to the G/L Account Nonconvertible Bonds instead of Sales Tax Advance Payment.-Cause-If you are addressing a tax refund via bank statement, ideally the bank statement should be created manually. Here you will be able to allocate to the correct tax authority. A Tax payment will get created and later you can assign the Tax returns in the system and release the same. Follow the resolution steps as a work around to correct this journal entry posting.-Resolution-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Allocation view.-Select the payment allocation which is happened via the bank statement and perform the action Reverse.-You will get a new Payment allocation which will be in status In Preparation.-Edit the allocation and enter the Tax Authority as the Business Partner in the field Customer/Supplier ID under the tab Customer/Supplier.-Enter the transaction Amount.-You should not assign any amount on the tab Other Allocations which by default will be blank.-Release the payment allocation which will trigger a Tax payment.-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Tax Payments view.-View the tax payment and you will see the Review Task on the header.-Select the task and on the new screen you will be able to enter the Tax returns.-Perform the action Release to release the tax Payment.-The journal Entry which will get posted based on this will be posted to the G/L Account Sales Tax Advance Payment instead to Nonconvertible Bonds.

Title: Cannot Assign G/L Account To Financial Reporting Structure - Identify Duplicate Assignments in the Structure
Content: Symptom-You want to add a G/L account to a structure item of your reporting structure. But the G/L account is not available in the selection list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration workcenter go to the Implementation Projects view and select the current project.-Open the Activity List and navigate to the Fine-Tune-phase.-Find the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account determination task and open it.-Under Financial Reporting Structures press on Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the respective structure and press Edit.-Now navigate to the structure item where you want to add the G/L account.-Select the row and press Actions - Assign Account.-In the selection list you can't find the G/L account that you want to add. -Cause-The Financial Reporting structure is not consistent. Not being able to assign further G/L accounts to the structure is a symptom of the structure inconsistency. In most cases the inconsistency is caused by duplicate G/L account assignments:-A) Structure was created in SAP ByDesign:-Use the Check Consistency function to find a reason for the inconsistency: Press on the Check Consistency button.-An error message appears: Duplicate assignments exist in the structure.-B) Structure was created via Import from Excel:-In this case the consistency check is not reliable. It will state: Financial Structure is consistent.-It is however very likely that the reporting structure is not consistent.-Resolution-To check if there are duplicate assignments in your financial reporting structure you can export the structure to Excel. In Excel use the Duplicate Values function to identify the respective assignments:-Again in the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination task press on the Edit financial reporting structures link under Financial Reporting Structures.-Select the respective strucure and press Export to Microsoft Excel.-Save the structure locally and then open it.-In Excel highlight the Items column.-In the Home tab press Conditional Formatting.-Select Highlight Cells Rules and then select Duplicate Values.-In the little pop-up window you should see Format cells that contain: Duplicate values with Light Red Fill with Dark Red Text.-Press OK.-This way all duplicate values can be easily identified.-You can remove the duplicate assignments either in Excel and then import the structure again* or you remove the assignments directly in Fine tuning:-Open the structure via Edit.-Find the structure item where you want to remove a duplicate.-Press Actions - Assign Account and deselect the account by unticking the box.-The structure should now be consistent again and it will be possible to assign further accounts.-Keywords-Cannot Assign G/L Account, Financial Reporting Structure, Identify, Duplicate Assignments,  Structure, G/L account, not available, selection list

Title: Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme Report Shows Profitability Lines with Technical IDs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-In the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report the Profitability Lines appear with their technical ID and not according to their descriptions as maintained in the respective fiancial reporting structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue workcenter navigate to the Reports - List view and open the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report.-In the report setting you made sure to display the Profitablity Line descriptions only.-But the Profitability Lines appear with their technical ID, e.g. 0GREV instead of Gross Revenue.-Cause-An FSI inconsistency exists on the Profitability data source which can be solved via FSI reload of FSI View FSP_FIN_PROFLINE.-Resolution-Request an L6 support user and log on to STFK.-Enter transaction GFSSTM.-In the Fast Search View field enter FSP_FIN_PROFLINE and press Execute.-In the next screen, in the Node Persistence tab expand all nodes.-Select all nodes and press Persistence.-Press Refresh to check if the reload is complete.-After the reload the profitability lines should appear according to their descriptions maintained in the respective Financial Reporting Structure.-See Also-2276032 - Profit Detail Report does not show data-Keywords-Profit Detail , Contribution Margin Scheme Report , Profitability Lines , Technical IDs, FSI inconsistency, Profitability data source , FSI reload, FSI View , FSP_FIN_PROFLINE

Title: Error Message: Tax Arrangement Is Inconsistent When Creating New Sales and Use Tax Return Run
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new Sales and Use Tax Return run, but when you save the run, the system throws the error message 'Tax Arrangement is Inconsistent'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Sales and Use Tax Return Run.-Click New > Tax Return.-Fill in the required data.-Save.-The Run is saved with errors.-Cause-The error message appears because the Sales and Use Tax Return Run is made for Tax Authority US. When the Tax Authority is US, there must be the state filled in the Tax Authority so it can populate the field in the Sales and Use Tax Return Run.-Resolution-Fill the State in the Tax Authority Master Data e rerun the Sales and Use Tax Return run.-Go to Tax Management work center.-Access View Tax Authority.-Select the Tax Authority and Edit it.-Got to Addresses tab.-Fill the State field.-Save the changes.-After that, run the Sales and Use Tax Return Runs again. The error message won't appear this time.-Keywords-Tax Management. Sales and Use Tax. Tax Authority.

Title: Value Help Limit in Reports
Content: Symptom-You are using a report in your system, and when accessing the Value Help of any characteristic, you notice that the following warning message is displayed Value Help Restricted to 200 records. Although this happens in reports, you notice that it's a message which is displayed in some reports and not in others.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In this case, the behavior for the report Balance Audit Trail, for instance, can be reproduced as follows:-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for the Balance Audit Trail report and open it.-In the Selection tab, search for a specific characteristic and open the Value Help-After the Value Help open, notice that the messsage Value Help restricted to 200 records is raised.-However, you also notice that when you follow the same procedure for reports created before 1708 release, this message is not displayed.-Cause-This is currently the system expected behavior on reports created after the 1708 release of the Cloud for Customer system.-Resolution-Before the 1708 release of the Cloud for Customer system and also for the Business by Design system, there was no restriction on how many values the Value Help of reports could display on the UI. However, the limit of 200 records was implemented after this release, since several users were experiencing performance issues in reports when opening the Value Help for a specific characteristic.-Still, reports which were created before the 1708 were not affected by this limitation, so that's the root cause for some reports which display the warning message and some that doesn't display it.-Last but not least, the 1708 release of the Cloud for Customer system and the Business by Design system was delivered to our customer in October, 2017.-See Also-For more clarification on this specific limitation, see the KBA 1884963 - Value help result is restricted to 200 records-Keywords-Report; Limitation; Value Help; C4C; ByD; Records; Restriction;

Title: How to Display Repeated Text for List of Report
Content: Symptom-In some business case, you need to display duplicate fields of the report to repeat every instance of characteristic value in a row or a volume. By defult, system will summarize the same characters.-Environment-SAP ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-For instance, you want employee name to show in each line of expense item in report Expense Report.-1. Go to Travel and Expenses work center and access List view.-2. Choose the Expense Report and Open .-System does not display the employee name for each line of expense item for the same expense report.-Cause-System shows only one line for repeated content in report by default.-Resolution-Please refer to the capture as below.-You can go to Show Settings - Table, to check Display Repeated Texts and save.-It will apply to the report that no matter if contents are the same or not, it will display them all.-Keywords-report, display setting, duplicate values, content

Title: No Reporting Structure Available When Creating Distribution Rule
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new distribution rule under Cost and Revenue, however no records are shown in the financial reporting structure dropdown.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Distribution Rule view.-Fill in cost center and set of books.-Change the Distribution Basis to Group of G/L Accounts (Origin).-Click the Financial Reporting Structure dropdown.-You see that no records are shown in the dropdown.-Cause-The financial reporting structures of type Cost Center and Project Cost Structure does not have a char of accounts assigned.-For the company to which you are creating the distribution rule, there is an assigned chart of accounts. The system tries to find out the relevant reporting structure for this chart of accounts. Since there is no char of accounts assigned to the reporting structure in business configuration, the derivation fails.-Resolution-You need to maintain a char of accounts for the reporting structure. The structures can be found as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the main project and open the activity list.-Open the fine-tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Edit financial reporting structures.-Keywords-Financial Reporting Structures. Cost and Revenue. Distribution Rule. Chart of Accounts.

Title: How to find the Binding Path from Adobe Life Cycle Designer
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to find the binding path used for a particular field in a form template.-Resolution-How to find the binding path from Adobe Life Cycle Designer?-Download the .XDP format of form template of the required document from the system.-Unzip the file downloaded.-Open the Adobe Life Cycle Designer.-Click on Open from the File option.-Browse and open the form template.-Select the Design View tab and double click on the required field which you want to know the binding path.-Select the tab Binding in the Object Library window.-You will be able to see the Name of the field and the current binding path of the field.-How to change the binding path?-Follow the same steps till step number 7.-Click on the arrow button next to the binding path field.-Select Use “Data Connection”.-Navigate to the required field path and select the field which you required.-The new binding path will be applied.-

Title: How to Extend Field From Supplier Invoicing to Payment Proposal in Accounts Payables
Content: Symptom-You want an extension field value to flow from Supplier Invoicing to the Payment Proposal in Accounts Payables.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can follow the steps below:-Open Customer/Supplier Account Monitor of any account.-Click on Adapt -> Enter Adaptation Mode. A yellow bar will appear on the top Adaptation Mode.-Click on Adapt -> Edit Screen.-Click on Extension Fields in the right-bottom.-Add a new Extension Field. Select the field from the list and scroll down to the bottom and click on Further Usage.-In the following screen, go to tab -> Extension scenarios.-Select the first scenario of Customer Invoicing as shown in the screenshot attached and Click on Add Field button to add the field to all the related screens of the scenarios.-The field will now appear in Customer Invoice screen and will be propagated from Customer Invoice UI to Account Monitor.-Keywords-extension, field, supplier, invoicing, payment, proposal, account, payables, adaptation

Title: Adobe LiveCycle Designer Executable Location
Content: Symptom-You installed Adobe LiveCycle Designer however you cannot find the shortcut from the application in the Desktop.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign; SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Cause-This is a expected system behavior as the Adobe LiveCycle Designer does not contain the shorcut option within the installer itself.-Resolution-You have to navigate to the path where the application was installed: the default location is in:-C:\Program Files (x86)\Adobe\Designer 9.0-In this location you can then create a shortcut for the FormDesigner.exe-Right Click in FormDesigner.exe-Select Send To-Select Desktop (create shortcut)  option-Keywords-LiveCycle; Adobe LiveCycle Designer; Designer; Installer; Location;

Title: "Automatic Upgrade" Showing in Project Column of Configuration Change History
Content: Symptom-You want to know why it is showing "Automatic Upgrade" in the Project column of the reports under Configuration Change History.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Open the Reports view-Click on Configuration Change History-In one of the records, you may see "Automatic Upgrade" in the Project column-Cause-This is shown when there is a selection/deselection made by the system to meet the dependency requirements, according to selection/deselecion made in the change project.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior. In order to avoid inconsistencies, the system takes this actions according to the existing dependencies.-Keywords
