Title: Restrict Balance Confirmation Run Result to Positive Value
Content: Symptom-You want to restrict the Balance Confirmation Run to only show results having positive values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Under Periodic Tasks view choose Balance Confirmation Runs.-Start a new run.-Even when you set the criteria as to restrict the value bigger than 1 USD - results are shown including negative values. You want to restrict the result to exhibit strictly positive values.-Resolution-Under Choose Criteria for Considering Balance of Accounts you need to check the flag Restrict To Debit Balances if you want the result only to show positive values.-Go to Receivables work center.-Enter the Periodic Tasks view and Balance Confirmation Run sub-view.-Start a new run. input all general information.-Select Next. Under Restrictions  select Consider Account Balances Greater Than under Choose Criteria for Considering Balance of Accounts.-Check the flag Restrict To Debit Balances.-Execute the run, and it only shows positive values.-Keywords-Balance Confirmation Run, Positive Value

Title: System Crashes for New Credit Card Payment
Content: Symptom-Dump occurs when you create new credit card payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center, navigate to the Customers view  and here to the Customer Accounts  sub-view.-Select customer account XYZ and press View.-In the Trade Receivables tab select an open item.-Press Pay Manually By and choose Credit Card.-Select Check Authorization.- A dump error message appears.-Cause-Authorization Validity Days is not maintained in the active clearing house account.-Resolution-Maintain Authorization Validity Days in the active clearing house account with following steps.-Go to Liquidity Management work center, navigate to the Master Data view and here to the Clearing House Accounts sub-view.-Select the active clearing house account and press Edit.-Maintain Authorization Validity Days in Credit Card Type tab.-Press Save.-Keywords-New Credit Card Payment Crash

Title: Sales order items with the item type Entitlement - Contract Sale are not Displayed in Report Open Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee).
Content: Symptom-The Net Value of contract line items is not displayed in the Open Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee) report when the contract is created from an Entitlement – Contract Sale item in a sales order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesgin-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open the Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select line item XX, which is of item type Entitlement – Contract Sale.-Observe that the entitlement item does not have a List Price, Net Price, or Net Value.-Note that this entitlement item has created contract XYZ (XYZ represents the Contract ID).-Open the Reports view.-Open the report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee).-Search for the relevant entry associated with the sales order/contract.-Observe that the Net Value of the contract items is not displayed in the report, even though the contract contains items with Net Values.-Expected Result:-The Net Value of the relevant contract items should be displayed in the Open Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee) report, since the Entitlement – Contract Sale item in the sales order points to the contract containing those items.-Actual Result: -The Net Value of the contract items is not displayed in the Open Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee) report.-Cause-Contract items and sales order items with item type Entitlement – Contract Sale are not relevant for sales target calculation and are therefore not considered in the Open Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee) report.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Contract items and Entitlement – Contract Sale items are not considered for sales target calculation and therefore their Net Value is not displayed in the report.-Keywords-Contract Item Net Value; Entitlement – Contract Sale; Open Sales Targets; Sales Target Calculation; Net Value Not Displayed-

Title: In a Sales Document you are not able to Set Different Tax Rates Separately for the Different Price Components Like Packaging, Insurance Charges and Freight
Content: Symptom-In a sales document like Sales Order, you are not able to set different tax rates separately for the different price components like Packaging, Insurance Charges and Freight.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order ID XYZ.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Pricing tab.-You do not see any possibility to have different tax rates separately for the different price components like Packaging, Insurance Charges and Freight.-Follow the steps below to check the Pricing Strategy in the Business Configuration work center:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for the Configure Price Strategy activity.-View the Configure Price Strategy activity.-You cannot find any possibility to implement the separate price strategy for the different price components like Packaging, Insurance Charges and Freight. The only possibility for the additional charges is to include it in Freight.-Cause-The functionality of having different taxes for different price components is not supported in the current release of the SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Busienss ByDesign system.

Title: How to Deactivate Product Availability Check
Content: Symptom-Removal of Availability Check Scope values maintained in the product master data is required, after deactivating the Product Availability Check in business configuration scoping.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose Edit Project Scope.-In the guided activity, navigate to the Scoping tab.-Under All Scoping Elements, select Supply Chain Planning and Control.-Choose Demand Management and Order Confirmation.-Deselect the checkbox Product Availability Check.-Go to Product Data work center.-Choose Products view.-Search for the relevant Product ID.-Choose Edit and Choose View All-Go to Availability Confirmation tab.-Select the relevant Planning Area.-Observe the field Availability Check Scope, values remain visible in the dropdown list.-Cause-It is not possible to remove the values maintained in Availability Check Scope in the Product Master Data.-These values are retained to ensure consistency in order processing and would lead to errors during sales order creation.-The system requires these values to validate and release customer demand for execution.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Deactivation of Product Availability Check in scoping does not remove existing values from product master data.-Keywords-Product Availability Check; Availability Check Scope; Product Master Data; Availability Confirmation; Scoping; Business Configuration; Demand Management; Order Confirmation; Supply Chain Planning and Control; Availability Check Deactivation; Product Data; Planning Area

Title: Inconsistent Profit Center on Customer Invoice and Relevant Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You find the Project Center is inconsistent on Customer Invoice and its relevant Journal Entry.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Choose the Journal Entries view.-Find relevant Source Document then select ID. You will find the Profit Center ID is inconsistent with the one on relevant customer invoice. (Note:on the customer invoice, Sales Unit takes place of Profit Center ID on relevant Journal Entry).-Cause-This is an expected system behavior, the Profit Center been changed due to the Sales Unit at the bottom was obsolete when generating the Journal Entry.-Resolution-The Sales Unit was obsolete when generating the Journal Entry, therefore, system retrieves a different Sales Unit which is more advanced.

Title: You Find Wrong Calculation of Net Value at Decimal Level in the Service Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You find wrong calculation of Net Value at decimal level in the Service Confirmation.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Service Confirmations view.-Search and open service confirmation XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the View All button.-Go to Pricing and Invoicing Tab-Select Line product XX (XX represents the ine of the product).-Here you will see the price calulated is wrong at decimal level (e.g. system shows the price as 1799.89 INR which should be 1799.81 INR).-Cause-The Service Confirmation XYZ created from a Contract ABC. The document currency maintained in contract is USD, however the price maintained at ietm level is in INR.-In this case conversion is done from INR to USD since document currency in contract is USD. This causing difference at decimal level.-Resolution-It is advisible to maintain the Document Currency in Contracts same as maintained at Contract Item Level. This avoids inconsistency in pricing calculation at decimal level.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search and open contract ABC (ABC represents the ID of the contract).-Select the View All tab.-Go to the General tab.-You will find Currency field under General Information (Currency field at General tab is refered as Document Currency).-Change the currency same as it is maintained in List Price at Ietms level.-Save the document.

Title: The Sales Order Status Changes to 'In Process' Instead of 'Open' After its Release.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The sales order status changes to In Process instead of Open After its release.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Create a New Sales Order.-Select the View All button.-Add the required information in the General tab.-Add a product (project relevant) in the Item tab.-Select the value help of the Project Task field and add a valid project task.-Release the sales order.-The status of the sales order is changed to In Process instead of Open.-Cause-If you create a Sales Order and assign a Project Task which is already processed to it then its  status will be In Process after the release.-This behavior occurs only for the project scenario where no delivery documents (e. g. Customer Demand) or Service Confirmation is involved.-The sales order in the project scenario will move directly to Customer Invoicing work center (Project Invoicing view -> Sales Orders subview) from where you can start the invoice process.-In a sales order where a material is involved, it is necessary to release the Customer Demand to change its status to In Process.-In the service scenario, it is necessary to complete a service confirmation to change the status of the sales order to In Process.-However in the project scenario, the release of the sales order itself changes the status to In Process (as no delivery or service confirmation involved here).-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Cancel Confirmation Button Disabled On Customer Demand
Content: Symptom-User is unable to Cancel Confirmation for a Service Order or Sales Order in Customer Demand as the Cancel Confirmation button is greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Outbound Logistics Control Work Center-Go To Customer Demand View-Show All Orders -> Find Service Order ABC-Select the Line Item -> Actions -> Cancel Confirmation- Cause-Once the user has released the Service Order ABC line items in full, it is not possible to cancel the confirmation at customer demand screen. Reason being, once (fully/partially) customer demand is released, the outbound delivery request would get created and then that department handling delivery will not know if you just cancel the demand. Hence, there is no option to cancel demand when demand is released fully.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.

Title: Error Occurs While Creating a New Opportunity: 'Entering an expense product is not possible'
Content: Symptom-Error occurs while creating a new opportunity: Entering an expense product is not possible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Leads View.-Search for the lead XYZ (XYZ represents ID of the lead).-Edit the lead XYZ.-Select the Follow Up button and select Opportunity.-Add Item ABC in the lead XYZ (ABC represents the ID of the item).-Error occurs for the Item ABC: Entering an expense product is not possible.-Cause-The scoping questions have not been answered correctly.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select the Edit Project Scope button.-Choose the relevant project then go to step 3 Review Questions.-Show All Elements.-Find Sales then select the Product and Service Portfolio for Sales.-Choose Yes to Question for Sales and Service as per your requirement, e. g. you can select Yes for the questions under the section Expense Types for Sales.

Title: Sales Order Actions Button Grayed out
Content: Symptom-The button Action in Sales Order Work Center, is greyed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Select the Sales Order view-Search for Sales Order ABC (ABC is the respective sales order)-Select the Sales Order document line-Button Action is grayed out-Cause-Since the document is in approval process, the button Action will not be available.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: Blocked Supplier is Active for Purchase Contract Creation and Active for Sourcing
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new purchasing contract for supplier ABC however this supplier is blocked for purchasing in the supplier master data. Even so, during the purchase contract creation, the blocked supplier is active and available for sourcing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sourcing & Contracting work center-Go to the Common Tasks view-Select New Contract-In the Supplier field, enter the blocked Supplier ABC-The Supplier ABC is active for Sourcing-Cause-System is behaving as designed.-Resolution-The functionality will be available in one of the future releases of SAP ByDesign. In later releases blocked suppliers will not be active for sourcing during purchase contract creation.

Title: The Ship-From Party Changes Automatically After Performing the ATP Check
Content: Symptom-The ship-from party changes automatically after performing the ATP check.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Select the sales order XYZ and choose Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the General tab.-The sales order has picked ABC as default Ship-From party (ABC represents the ID of the ship-from party).-Manually change the Ship-From party to DEF (DEF represents the ID of the ship-from party).-Go to the Items tab and choose the Check Availability button for performing ATP check.-The Ship-From party again changed to ABC automatically.-Cause-This situation will only occur if you change the ship-from party manually in the sales order and try to do ATP check. In this case system will always return the default ship-from party.-Resolution-It is suggested not to change the Ship-From party manually, instead you can use the Assign Source of Supply button for assigning a new supplier or Ship-From location:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Create a New Sales Order.-Add the mandatory details and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Select the line item:-Instead of changing the Ship-From party manually, use the button Assign Source of Supply and add the party from the list in the pop-up screen.-Do ATP check using Check Availability button.-Save the sales order.

Title: Incoterms Field Created in the Sales Order is not Carried to the Invoice Request but Directly to the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-Incoterms field created in the Sales Order is not carried to the Invoice Request but directly to the Customer Invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new Sales Order with any of the given Incoterms from Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center -> Customer Demand view -> Release the Customer Demand for the above created Sales Order.-Go to the Outbound Loistics work center -> Delivery Control view -> Delivery Proposals subview -> Release with Post Goods Issue.-Go to the Outbound Loistics work center -> Outbound Deliveries view -> Release the Outbound Delivery created in reference to the Sales Order.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center -> Invoice Requests view -> The Incoterm value is missing in the Customer Invoice Request.-Create the Customer Invoice in reference to the above Customer Invoice Request -> the field is available at the Items tab of the Customer Invoice.-Cause-The Incoterm is not captured in Invoice Request but directly to Customer Invoice. This is the designed behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-You can follow below steps as workaround using which you can check the incoterm to be captured in the Customer Invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the relevant invoice request.-Select the Invoice Request ID.-It will open the Outbound Delivery Overview which has the Incoterm value.

Title: COD1708:Missing list values of KUT field
Content: Symptom-****Not Yet Finalized****-Field" ECD on Time?" show value as Not assigned in report : Agent Workload(CRMSRQHB_Q0014) and  Daily Average Tickets Created vs. Completed (YTD-Reproducing the Issue-· Go to the work Business Analytics-· View Design Report-· Find and Open Report  (CRMSRQHB_Q0002) or report (CRMSRQHB_Q0014)-· Open value help for selection ECD on time?- *OBSERVATION- only # as selection available-However-Preview data source CRMSRQHB and ad to row field  ECD on time?-KUT Field "ECD on Time" show value Y,N and not assigned-Cause-This is a code list field (kua extension field). The possible values for this field are 101 - Y and 111 - N.-So the internal IDs for this field is either 101 or 111. But in the BO instead of storing 101 or 111, it is stored as Y or N. Y or N-Since it is stored incorrectly in the BO, the data is not shown properly in the Value help.-Resolution-This is Master data issue Analytics framework is working as expected-Customers have to check how they aresaving data  from the UI (Master Data).

Title: Is There any Possibility of the Uploading the Price List and Sales Kit Products via Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Is there any possibility of the uploading the Price List and Sales Kit Products via backend?-Reproducing the Issue-You have huge data for the price list & sales kit and you want to know the possibility of uploading the data in backend.-Cause-There is no possibility of uploading the Price List and Sales Kit data via backend. This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The possibility of uploading the price list can be done using migration template:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for the Migration of Price List activity and select the View button.-In the next screen select the Migrate price lists using the migration tool.-You can upload the price list using the migration template.-There is no template to upload the Sales Kit data. Sales Kit data can only be added manually in the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-
