Title: Enter a Value For The Mandatory Field G/L Account With Row Key 'Chart of Accounts' 'XY' '1000000495' in 'G/L Account Assignment'
Content: Symptom-While importing a new Reporting Structure you get the error message: 'Enter a value for the mandatory field G/L Account with row key 'chart of Accounts' 'XY' '1000000495' in 'G/L Account Assignment' (where XY stands for the relevant Chart of Account ID).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center and choose Overview View.-In the field Show, select  All Activities using drop down and select fine tune activity Chart of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Choose Change Immediately.-Edit financial reporting structures-Import from Microsoft Excel-Choose File  AB (AB stands for the Reporting Structure) to be imported-Save--The following error messages are raised:-'Enter a value for the mandatory field G/L Account with row key 'chart of Accounts' 'XY' '1000000495' in 'G/L Account Assignment'-'Save failed'-Cause-This is a generic error message raised because there is an empty Item field on the XML file. Because this is a mandatory field it causes  errors.-Value 1000000495 looks like a G/L Account ID however it does not refer to any existing ID in your Chart of Accounts.-Resolution-Please fill or remove this field according to your needs from this XML File.-Afterwards it is possible to save the new imported Reporting Structure in the system.

Title: Error: Cash Items With Amount Zero Not Permitted in Cash Transfer Posting
Content: Symptom-Cash items with amount zero not permitted in cash transfer posting.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center-2. Go to Cash Transactions view-3. Look for Cash Transaction XXXX-4. Click on Check.-You see an Error: Cash Transaction XXXX: Cash items with amount zero not permitted in cash transfer posting).-Cause-It is not possible to make any cash transaction with the amount zero.-Resolution-You may cancel this cash transaction and this will not affect any other transactions.-1. Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center-2. Go to Cash Transactions view-3. Look for Cash Transaction XXXX and click on Cancel-

Title: Issue During Installation of Crystal Reports (Viewer)
Content: Symptom-You are trying to install Crystal Reports or the Crystal Reports viewer, however you face an issue during the installation.-The program is not installed on your computer and you cannot make use of Crystal Reports (Viewer).-Cause-This is a local issue on your computer.-Resolution-Please note that the installation of Crystal Reports, or the Viewer, it out of the scope of Cloud Support. Please use one of the following channels to get support:-Check with your local IT department.-Crystal Reports forum, available on https://www.sap.com/community/topic/crystal-reports.html .-Check the Crystal Reports installation guide: https://help.sap.com/viewer/p/SAP_CRYSTAL_REPORTS .-Some general troubleshooting includes the following:-Copy the installation package to hard drive if possible to avoid any networking issues-Temporary disable any kind of firewall, antivirus, network security etc., if possible.-Make sure there is enough space on the computer.-On the latest versions of Windows, even if logged in as a local Administrator, right-click setup.exe file and select Run as Administrator. If you do not have an Administrator account, try right click Run As, select the current user and uncheck the Protect My Computer And Data From Unauthorized Program Activity.-Make sure all the traces from previous failed installation attempts are cleared (location e.g: C:\Program Files (x86)\Crystal Reports Viewer).

Title: Unable to Change the Product ID in a Sent Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-The Product ID field for an item cannot be modified once the Purchase Order has been sent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Select ABC (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Select the relevant Item.-The value in the Product ID field cannot be modified or deleted.-Cause-Once a Purchase Order has been sent, the Product ID, Item Type, and Process Type fields can no longer be modified or deleted. Additionally, existing line items cannot be removed.-These fields can only be edited in Purchase Orders with the status In Preparation, provided that the Purchase Order was not created through a Third-Party scenario or an MRP run.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-A new line item can be created for the desired Product ID, and the Send Update button can then be selected.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Show All Purchase Orders.-Search ABC (ABC represents the relevant Purchase Order ID).-Select Edit.-Go to Items tab.-Select Add Row.-Enter the required data.-Select Send Update button.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Product ID; Send Update; In Preparation; Sent

Title: Key Figure Quantity Written-Off Shown with Invoice Request ID = # in Customer Project Overview Report
Content: Symptom-You run the standard report Customer Project Overview (PROCPIU02_Q0001) and expect that the value for key figure Quantity - Written-Off is shown in the same row as the project invoice request from which the value is derived. Instead it is shown in the row for Invoice Request ID = # (not assigned).-Reproducing the Issue-Create a new manual project invoice request (Project Management work center > Invoice Preparation: Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view).-In step 4 (Select Time and Expenses) assign a value to Time to Be Written Off, e.g. 2 hours.-Release the invoice request XYZ (XYZ represents the invoice ID). You will then find the written-off hours in the document in tab Items, subtab Time and Expenses.-Open the report Customer Project Overview (Project Management work center > Reports view).-Run report with default selection.-Move characteristic Invoice Request ID to rows.-Display key figure Quantity - Written-Off (technical ID WRITTENOFF_QTY).-Result: In the row for invoice request ID XYZ the key figure Quantity - Written-Off displays 0,00.-However, 2 hours are displayed in the row for the same project for Invoice Request ID = # (not assigned). These are the 2 hours that you have written off in the invoice request.-Cause-The system behaviour is as designed.-Resolution-The data source which is based on the Customer Project Overview is called Customer Projects and contains several underlying data sources which feed it.--The data for characteristic Invoice Request ID comes from a different underlying data source than the values for key figure Quantity - Written-Off. The underlying data source which provides the values for key figure Quantity - Written-Off looks on projects as a whole and not on single documents. This is why you find the Invoice Request ID as # (i.e. not assigned) for all values related to key figure Quantity - Written-Off.

Title: How to disable Delete button from Sales Order or Service Request or Service Order Processing View.
Content: Symptom-You want to disable the Delete button for an user from Sales order or Service Request or Service Order Processing view.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order  work centre.-Navigate to Sales Order view.-Select any Sales Order XXX in status In-Preparation.-you can see that Delete button is enabled.-Go to Service Order work centre.-Navigate to Service Order Processing view.-Select any Service Order XXX in status In-Preparation.-you can see that Delete button is enabled.-Go to Service Desk work centre.-Navigate to Service Request view.-Select any Service Request XXX in status Open.-you can see that Delete button is enabled.- Cause-The User is having unrestricted write access and this is the cause for Delete button enabled in frontend.-Resolution-User have to restrict write access authorization to make Delete button disable from view page.-Go to Application And User Management work center.-Navigate to Business User View.-Choose User and select Edit -> Access Rights.-Go to Access Restrictions tab.-Select the Work Center View ID CRM_SALESORDERS-Change the Read Access to Unrestricted and change the Write Access to No Access.-Select the Work Center View ID CRM_SERVICEREQUESTS.-Change the Read Access to Unrestricted and change the Write Access to No Access.-Select the Work Center View ID CRM_SERVICEORDERPROCESSING.-Change the Read Access to Unrestricted and change the Write Access to No Access.-Save and Close.-

Title: You Want the Account ID to be Picked as Default Ship-to Party in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want the account ID to be picked as default ship-to party in the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Orders under Common Tasks.-Add the account ABC in the sales order (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-The ship-to party picked in the sales order is XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-You are expecting that the ship-to party picked should be by default the account ID.-Cause-In the account XYZ you have maintained the relationship Has the Ship-To Party as XYZ, hence if you create a sales order for account ABC then the ship-to party will always be XYZ not the account ID itself.-Resolution-If you want the ship-to part to be by default the account ID, then you need to remove the Has Ship-to Part relationship from the account:-Go to the Accounts Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Open the account ABC and select the View All button.-Go to the Contacts tab and select the Relationship and Responsibilities tab.-Remove the Has the Ship-To Party as XYZ from the Relationships section (XYZ is the ID of the business partner maintained as ship-to party).-Save your changes.-Now if you create a new sales order for the account ABC, the default ship-to party ID will always be ABC.

Title: Employee With Read Access to the Customer Invoicing is Not Able to Release the Invoice
Content: Symptom-Employee with a Read Access to the Customer Invoicing is not able to Release the invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select and Edit any not-release Invoice.-Select the Release button.-The user is not able to release the invoice though the user have the Read Access for the Customer Invoicing.-Cause-Releasing or Posting a customer invoice do change the status of the invoice, hence a write permission is required for such operation or action.-The read permission is only meant that user can see the data but cannot do any changes and also cannot perform any action on the document.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: You are not Able to Generate the Proforma Invoice From a Sales Quotes
Content: Symptom-You are not able to generate the Proforma Invoice from a Sales Quotes. The following Error occurs: Generating pro forma invoice for document failed; Party with role Employee Responsible missing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Show All Quotes and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-Select the sales quote XYZ and choose Create Pro Forma Invoice button.-The following Error is triggered: Generating pro forma invoice for document failed; Party with role Employee Responsible missing.-Cause-For the generation of Proforma Invoice it is required to have the automatic determination of the Employee Responsible party in the sales quote document. Currently you do not have any rule maintained for the determination of Employee Responsible and you are adding this manually in the sales quotes.-Resolution-Follow the below steps for defining the rule for determination of Employee Responsible:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Work Distribution view -> Select the Employee Work Distribution.-In the next screen under Business Area: Sales and Marketing (6) -> Select Employee Responsible for Sales.-Edit Employee Responsible for Sales -> In the next screen you can see that no rule is maintained for Employee Work Distribution.-Select Add Row button to add a rule according to your requirement.-Save your changes.-Alternative Steps for maintaining rule for determination of employee responsible:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Task Distribution view -> Select the Employee Work Distribution.-In the next screen under Business Area: Sales and Marketing (6) -> Select Employee Responsible for Sales.-Edit Employee Responsible for Sales -> In the next screen you can see that no rule is maintained for Employee Work Distribution.-Select Add Row button to add a rule according to your requirement.-Save your changes.-Also go through the help documentation: Employee work distribution rule quick guide.

Title: The XML Uploaded for Customer Invoice Request Does Not Appear in the SAP Business ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-You have uploaded the XML messages for the Customer Invoice Requests using webdev folder, however the invoice requests does not appear in the SAP ByDesign system.-Reproducing the Issue-You have added the XML files with Customer Invoice Requests data in the WebDev folder.-You have uploaded the XML file in the Business ByDesign system.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show All Invoice Requests.-The list does not show the invoice requests uploaded via WebDAV folder.-Cause-The account maintained in the XML does not exists in the system due to which the upload of the invoice request has failed. In general if for the account maintained in the XML does not exists in the system or the address for the account does not exists in the system then the creation invoice request fails in the Business ByDesign system.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Create a New Corporate Account from the Common Tasks.-Maintained the account Name/ID as in XML.-Maintain Address and other required details.-Save the account.-Now upload the XML messages again in the Business ByDesign system.-Now the Customer Invoice Requests will be visible in the Customer Invoicing work center.

Title: What is the Significance of "% of Return Items from Sales Order Items in Sales" Field in the "Sales Order Returns Rate"
Content: Symptom-What is the Significance of % of Return Items from Sales Order Items in sales field in the Sales Order Returns Rate.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Search for the Sales Order Returns Rate report .-Execute the report.-You want to know the significance of the % of Return Items from Sales Order Items in Sales field in this report.-Cause-The % of Return Items from Sales Order Items field of the Sales Order Return report provide the details about the return % of the items,-for e. g. if there is a sales order having 5 items and a return of 5 items has been created with reason Ordered Incorrectly, then the % of return with reason Ordered Incorrectly would be 100 %.-To get more details from the report try to add Sales Order ID in the report row first: This will give you a view of return at each order level.-Then try to add Sales Order Item ID in report row: this will give you a view of return for each item of a sales order.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: In the Manual Customer Invoice the Default Posting Date is not Visible
Content: Symptom-In the Manual Customer Invoice the default Posting Date is not visible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Create New Manual Invoice from Common Tasks.-In the manual invoice, do not enter the Posting Date.-Release the invoice.-After the release the default Posting Date is not available in the Customer Invoice but in the Journal Entry created for it.-Cause-The Posting Date in the Customer Invoice has been provided, if the Transaction need to be posted on a specific date i. e. depending upon the business requirement.  If there is no such requirement then the end users can leave this field blank, In this case the Posting Date will be determined automatically in the Journal Entry. So, the automatic determination is always done in the financial document not in the Customer Invoice document. The financial document will give first preference to the Customer Invoice Posting Date (if maintained), else it will do its own determination.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: How to Restore Customer Group
Content: Symptom-You are unable to Post Source Document in the General Ledger work center. However,you noticed an communication error occurs from sales order to account. Error message stating:Sales Order XXX cannot create a Business Transaction for Accounting.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Source Document subview.-Find EDF (EDF represents ID of the source document)-Choose Post.-You notice the status of source document still In Process. You find a communication error at Document Flow, stating: Sales Order XYZ cannot create a Business Transaction for Accounting.--Cause-The Customer Group maintained in the Account used in the Sales Order was deleted after the creation of the Sales Order, and you have added a different Customer Group in the same Account.-This caused the inconsistency in the Sales Order. Now for processing the Sales Order successfully, you need to restore the Customer Group in the Fine-tuning activity Accounts.-You can find the Customer Group in the Account by following below steps:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the the Accounts view.-Find the relevant account.-Choose View All then go to the Sales Data tab.-You can find Customer Group in Details subtab.-  Resolution-You restore the Customer Group in the Business Configuration work center:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Choose the  Implementation Projects view.-Press Open Activity List for the current project First Implementation.-Then go to Fine Tuning step and select All Activities.-Search for Accounts.-Choose the link Maintain Customer Groups.-

Title: Error Message: Add-in for Adobe LiveCycle Designer cannot be found , while Opening Form Template Using Internet Explorer 64-bit
Content: Symptom-Though you have installed Add-in for Adobe LiveCycle Designer in your system, you are getting following error message when opening Form Template in Internet Explorer 64-bit edition.-Add-in for Adobe LiveCycle Designer cannot be found. You can install this front-end component from the Download Center view in the Application and User Management work center under Business Flexibly.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Select Business Flexibility.-Click on Form Template Maintenance.-Click on Go.-Select any Form template.-Click on Open and then Adobe® LiveCycle® Designer.-Cause-Add-in for Adobe LiveCycle Designer is not compatible on Internet Explorer 64-bit.-Resolution-To open Form Template using Add-in for ALD, use Internet Explorer 32-bit version.

Title: You are not Able to Resubmit the Invoices Created via EDI
Content: Symptom-You are not able to Resubmit the Invoices created via EDI.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the customer invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice which was created via EDI).-Edit the customer invoice XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Output History tab.-The Resubmit button is grayed out.-Cause-The EDI invoice is more than 30 days old. For such EDI invoices it is not possible to do a resubmission.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Exception of Absolute Deviation of X Hours for a Resource
Content: Symptom-In Supply Planning, system is showing exception of Absolute Deviation of X hours for a resource on a particular date. You want to know why system is showing this exception.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select Exceptions-->Resources view.-Search for the exception for the relevant resource. It is showing Absolute Deviation of X hours on a particular date.-Cause-On that particular date, a production proposal has been scheduled for M hours. However, this resource has capacity of N hours per day only. That is why it is showing deviation of M-N= X hours.-If you the Resource Planning Details screen, you can see the details of the scheduled production proposal and available capacity of the resource. To do so:-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Select Exceptions-->Resources view.-Search for the relevant resource.-Select it and choose Open Resource Planning Details button.-Resolution

Title: Unable to Transfer Business ByDesign Studio Solutions to the System
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created some Analytic Objects (Solutions) via the SAP Cloud Studio and want to make them available to your system via Transport Management. When you try to do so, the solution you have created is not listed hence you are unable to continue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The transfer of Analytics Objects created via the Studio is not supported via Transport Management.-Resolution-Please use the Studio to Upload/Download your Solution.-The standard Transport Management supports only the analytics objects that you have created using the standard Key User Analytics tool such as Data Sources, Key Figures, KPI, Dashboards and Reports.-See Also-1803144 - Error Message Received When Uploading a Report or Data Source Objects-Keywords-report, data source, transfer, transport management, missing, administator, business analytics

Title: How to find the User Who Creates the Sales Order XYZ
Content: Symptom-How to find the User Who Creates the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the sales order).-Reproducing the Issue-You are not able to find the user who create the sales order XYZ.-Go to the Sales Order work center-Go to the Sales Order view-Edit the Sales Order XYZ-Go to View All-Go to the Changes tab-The Changes tab only shows updates after the creation.-Cause-You would need to enable an additional field in the list of sales order.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Order work center-Go to the Sales Order view-Select Adapt > Adaptation Mode-Select Sales Order in the Sections-Scroll down the fields list and select the Created By field to make it visible in the User Interface-Save and Publish-You are now able to see the creator of the sales order in the list of sales order.

Title: How to find the Recurrence Pattern of the "Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders" in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to find the recurrence pattern of the "Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders" in the backend.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select Activity List.-Go to Fine-Tune.-Select the activity Invoice Schedule Template for Intercompany Sales Orders.- You noticed that the time frame details are not taken into account once you create an invoice schedule for your Intercompany Sales Order.-Cause-To analyse the issue you would need to check BC set value in the backend.-Resolution-Go to Transaction BC80-Select BC Repository Browser-Select BC Sets-In BC Set (Content), select *tmpl*-Select Enter-Select the Node BC_ISCD_C_TMPL_INTER_COMP-On the right you will be able to see the recurrence pattern selected by the customer-OR-Go to the transaction BCTADM-Navigate to the Fine Tuning tab.-Enter the BC Node ID ISCD_C_TMPL in the field Schema ID and Node ID-Go to Fine Tuning UI View- You will find the value of the recurrence pattern.- In case the recurrence pattern in the backend does not match the one selected in the UI, a dummy change in the UI is required.

Title: You Want to Clear the Inconsistency Caused by the Unintentional Addition of the Line Items Twice in different Service Orders
Content: Symptom-You want to clear the inconsistency caused by the unintentional addition of the line items added twice in two service orders.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center-Create a New Service Order from Common Tasks.-Add the account and other required details.-Add 5 line items in the service order.-Select the Submit button and choose Release to Service Execution.-Again open the service order ABC created (ABC represents the ID of the service order).-Select the Submit button and choose Confirm Service Execution.-A new Service Confirmation screen will open.-Add the required detail in the service confirmations screen and Release it.-After the release of the service confirmation you have realized that you need to add 5 more items in the service order which is not possible anymore.-Create a Follow-up service order of ABC.-Add all the 5 items of the service order ABC in the new service order and also add the 5 new items required.-However you have now realized that with second service order, you will have added the 5 items twice (in service order ABC and DEF), which is not reuired and you want to know the further steps required to clear the inconsistency.-Cause-You have created a service order ABC and related service confirmation. Then you realized that you have additional items, so you have created a follow up service order of ABC i.e. service order DEF-where by mistake you have added the all the line items of service order ABC too.-Resolution-In such situation you should cancel the duplicate line items added in the second service order DEF and do the second confirmation for the new items added in the service order DEF:-Go to the Service Orders work center-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Show All Orders and Find DEF (DEF represents the ID of the second service confirmation created).-Edit the service order DEF and select the View All button.-Go to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Select each duplicate items individually.-Add the Reason for Rejection for each duplicate line item.-Save the service order DEF.-Open the service order DEF.-Select the Submit button and choose Release to Service Execution.-Again open the service order DEF.-Select the Submit button and choose Confirm Service Execution.-This will open the New Service Confirmation screen.-Add the required details in the service confirmation and release it, this will release only the required items.

Title: How to add Freight Costs in the XML for Customer Invoice Upload.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to add freight costs in the XML for customer invoice upload.-Resolution-The Freights are part of a PriceComponent and at the moment only the Freight on Header is supported.-To include Freights in the xml the following tag has to be inserted on each Item Level: (see below for default PricingScheme)-All values of the XML tag are fix except the RateFields and the currency for the CalculationBasis.-        <PriceComponent>-          <Description languageCode="EN">Freight</Description>-          <TypeCode listID="2">7PR8</TypeCode>-          <CategoryCode>3</CategoryCode>-          <PurposeCode>4220</PurposeCode>-          <MajorLevelOrdinalNumberValue>60</MajorLevelOrdinalNumberValue>-          <MinorLevelOrdinalNumberValue>1</MinorLevelOrdinalNumberValue>-          <Rate>-            <DecimalValue>20</DecimalValue>-            <CurrencyCode>EUR</CurrencyCode>-          </Rate>-          <CalculationBasis>-            <BaseCode>2</BaseCode>-            <Amount currencyCode="EUR">0</Amount>-          </CalculationBasis>-          <CalculatedAmount currencyCode="">0</CalculatedAmount>-          <RoundingDifferenceAmount currencyCode="">0</RoundingDifferenceAmount>-          <EffectiveIndicator>true</EffectiveIndicator>-          <ManuallyChangedIndicator>true</ManuallyChangedIndicator>-          <GroupedIndicator/>-          <OriginCode>2</OriginCode>-          <PriceSpecificationUUID/>-          <PriceSpecificationDeterminationTimePoint>-            <TypeCode>1</TypeCode>-            <Date/>-          </PriceSpecificationDeterminationTimePoint>-        </PriceComponent>-See Also-Please find attached a sample XML file with 2 Products and Freight.-

Title: You Receive an Error Message when you submit a new Service Request: Form template Service Request variant for Language English and Country None cannot be found
Content: Symptom-You Receive an Error Message when you  submit a new Service Request: Form template Service Request variant for language English and country None cannot be found.-Reproducing the Issue-  Go to Service Desk work center.-Select the  Service Requests view-Search for the Service Request ABC  (ABC represents the ID of the Service Request).-Select the Service Request ABC and Edit-Click in the button Submit- The follwing error will appear:  Form template Service Request variant for language English and country None cannot be found-Cause-The form template determination uses the country of the seller party plus the language of the Account for finding the correct form template variant. In case the language is not maintained, the logon language of the user is used by default. Also if the Service Request has no seller party  therefore the country is empty  so no template will be found.-Resolution-Please maintain a seller party in the Service Request in the tab "Involved Parties" following the steps below: -Go to Service Desk work center.-Select the  Service Requests view.-Search for the Service Request ABC  (ABC represents the ID of the Service Request).-Select the Service Request ABC and Edit.-Click in the button View All.-Go to Involved Parties tab.-Click Add Row.-Select Seller in the drop down list and then fill out the Name.-Click in the button Submit again.

Title: The Contract->Item ,Which is Canceled is Still Showing in the Invoice Request View with the Status as To Be Invoiced
Content: Symptom-The Contract->Item ,which is canceled is still showing in the Invoice Request view with the status as To Be Invoiced.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Contract view.-In the Show field from the drop-down select All Contracts and in the Find enter PQR(where PQR is contract id).-Edit the Contract PQR and go to the Items tab.-You will see for the Item YY ,the Cancelation Reason is maintained.-Now go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Request view and search with Customer Contract Invoice Request Id PQR.-The Invoice Request id PQR is with status as To Be Invoiced.-Cause-Although for Contract->Item,the Cancelation Reason is maintained but Cancelation Effective On date is not yet reached. Once Cancelation Effective On date is reach the Cancelation Status will be Canceled for the Contract->Item and also under the Invoice Request view.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: How to Change the Time Frame of the Service Request Priorities
Content: Symptom-How to change the time frame of the service request priorities.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Create a New Service Request from Common Tasks.-Add required details like Account, Registered Product, Service Performer etc.-You find a field for the Priorities in the General tab -> Main Information subtab.-You want to change the default time frame of the priorities however you cannot see any possibility to do so in the system.-Cause-You have not scoped Service Level Agreements in the system.-Resolution-You can scope the Service Level Agreements in the system by following below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and choose Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the step 3 Scoping.-Expand Service -> Entitlement Management.-Select and scope Service Level Agreements.-Complete the guided activity to Finish the scoping.-Once the Service Level Agreements is scoped in the system, you can define the time frame for the service request priorities:-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Select the Service Levels view.-Choose New button and select Service Level.-Add Service Level Name and Service Level ID in the General tab.-Go to the Reaction Times tab to add the Milestones and Details for Milestone (which ultimately defines the priority reaction time and Due Date).-Go to the Operating Hours tab to add the weekly operating hours and calendar.

Title: You get a Request From Customer to Delete the Customer Accounts From Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-THIS DOCUMENT IS RESERVED FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-You get a request from customer to delete the Customer Accounts From backend.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Sear for the relevant accounts.-Customer want us to delete the requested accounts from the backend.-Cause-The physical deletion of business partners (e.g. accounts) in SAP Business ByDesign is not supported (from both frontend and backend).-Resolution-The only option is to set the account to obsolete:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search for the relevant accounts.-Select the Change Status button -> Select Obsolete.

Title: You are not Able to Change the Price of the Items in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the Price of the Items in the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the line item XXX (XXX represents the number of the line item).-The List Price field of the item XXX is not editable and you do not find any option to change the price of the item.-Cause-The customer invoice for the sales order item is already created, it is not possible to do any changes in the sales order item if system has already created the invoice for it.-Follow the below steps to check the invoice status of the sales order line item:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the line item XXX (XXX represents the number of the line item).-In the Details subtab, the status of invoicing is Finished.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-In the Document Flow of the sales order you can find that a customer invoice ABC is already created for the line item (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Resolution-If you want to do any changes in the price of the sales order line item then you have to cancel the invoice created for it.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the customer invoice ABC and choose the Cancel button.-Save the cancelation invoice.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the line item XXX (XXX represents the number of the line item).-Now you can find the List Price field editable for the line item.-Do the required changes and Save the sales order.

Title: Guidelines and Tips to Process queries Related To Customised Solutions using the ByD Studio
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This document is intended to help the  Analytics Support to handle queries related to Customized Solutions.-Customer creates an incident because they face an issue linked to an existing Solution created by the Service Center, Partner, Customer, Development or Field Consultant using the ByD Studio.-The query may be in relation to a Report, Data source or Extension field and after the initial analysis you find out that:-The issue lies on the Custom Solution provided by the Service Center.-If you can prove that the issue is caused/related to the Service Center Solution you may forward the incident to the appropriate Service Center queue.-The issue lies with the ByD Studio tool.-If you can prove that the issue is caused/related to the ByD Studio tool you may forward the incident to the appropriate PDI Development queue. CD 1905346-The issue lies with the standard ByD functionalities.-If you can prove that the issue is caused/related to the ByD standard functionalities (Framework or Application) you may process the incident as per the guidelines provided via the CD 1499953.-The issue lies with the customization done by the Field Consultant or Development Team.-If you can prove that the issue is caused/related to the solution or customization created by the Field Consultant or Development Team you may forward the incident to the appropriate Owner or Development queue.-The issue lies with the customization done by the Customer/Partner.-If you can prove that the issue is caused/related to the Solution or Customization created by the Customer or Partner they are responsible for it. Note: in such cases we may help, where possible, to pinpoint the cause or help to reach a solution.-Below are some tips on how you may find out the details of a Solution and the responsible of it.-From the UI-Report and Data Source-You can find out the Solution name for a report or Data source as following:-From the Business Analytics work center, Design reports or Data sources.-Highlight the desired Report or Data Source.-From the Details then General tab you'll be able to see the Solution field. This field should show the Solution Name.-You may also use fields like the Created By to identify the responsible.-In this example:-The Solution name for the Data Source starts with SC_XXX_XXX so we can deduct it has been created by the Service Center.-The Report or Data source ID starts with the indicator (name space) /BY004XXX/ it means that it has been created by the Service Center. You can find the Report ID from the report Technical Information or the Business Analytics work center.- Extension fields-  You can find out more details for a specific Extension Field in the following way:-Identify the desired extension field from the UI work center.-Use the the Technical Information (via the Help option) to find out the details of the extension field such as the UI-Component. In this case SIVQAFCREATEECO.QA. -You can then use the UI Component name, in this example SIVQAFCREATEECO.QA, and the Extension field name, in this case Central Bank Code, to find the respective Extension Field and Solution Name from the Flexibility Change Log view in the Application and User Management work center; in this case SC_***_SRM.- From SAP Incight-You can find out the list of the Solutions available and their details via the SAP Incight, from the Partner Development Products Table, as sown below.-From the Backend-You can find out the solution details as following:-Go to transaction SE16 and select the table name PDI_PROD_PATCH.-Use the available filter to find the the desired Solution. In this case, SC_XXX_SRM.-Once you have filtered the desired Solution/Product you will be able to see details as Patch ID, Version, Description, Status, User Name and Transport Number which can help you to identify the responsible for the Solution. In this case SC*(or SFL*) means its developed by Service Center.-You may also use the following table names, via Tx SE16, to find out additional details.-PDI_DEVELOPER to find out the Developer or Partner Name.-TENANTADDONS to find out the activation status.-Resolution

Title: You are not Able to Delete a Sales Order Which has the "In Preparation" status
Content: Symptom-You are not able to delete a Sales Order which has the In Preparation status.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order which is In Preparation status).-Select the sales order XYZ and choose Delete button.-You get a information message: Deleting document not possible; follow-up document exists.-You have not created any follow-up delivery or invoice document for this sales order, hence you expect the sales order to get deleted.-Cause-You have created a follow-up sales quote for the sales order XYZ.-Follow the steps below to check the follow-up document of the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Select the Go button.-Edit the sales order and go to the Documents Flow tab.-Here you can find that a follow-up sales quote has been created for the order.-Resolution-Once a follow-up document is created for a order, it cannot be deleted. However the sales order XYZ can be canceled by adding the Reason for Rejection.--Follow the steps for Cancelling/Rejecting the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Select the Go button.-Edit the sales order and go to the General tab.-Add a value in the Reason for Rejection fields.-Save the sales order.

Title: How to Reset the Customer Invoice Numbering Sequence
Content: Symptom-How to reset the Customer Invoice Numbering sequence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the activity Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Select the sub activity Document Numbering Formats for Other Countries.-For Company XYZ and and Prefix Value as ABC (XYZ represents the ID of the Company & ABC represents the ID of the Prefix Value).-You want change the numbering sequence from XXX to YYY (XXX & YYY represents the invoicing sequence).-However the sequence field is disabled and there is no possibility to change the sequence from frontend.-Also there is no possibility to use the same prefix ABC with a new sequence.-Cause-The sequence of a Document Numbering Format cannot be changed once documents have been created using that format in the system.-In addition, reuse of an existing prefix is not permitted, as it could lead to duplicate document number generation.-This system behavior is implemented to ensure data consistency and compliance with legal and audit requirements related to document numbering.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign. In this case the only option is to create a new prefix for new numbering.

Title: How to Settle the Down Payment Request Partially With the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have a scenario where you have received a fixed Down Payment for an item from your customer and you are creating separate invoices for each partial delivery for the same item. Now you want to add a part of the single Down Payment Request for each invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Search for one of the invoice request XYZ (XYZ is one of the invoice request created for the partial delivery).-Edit the invoice request and select the View All button.-In the General tab you want to attach a part of Down Payment Request you have received from the customer.-However you only find the option to attach the complete Down Payment Request.-Cause-You cannot settle the proportionate Down Payment Request, you only have the option of settling one Down Payment Request only once.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: In the Preview of the Sales Quote, the Message: 'No Record Found' is Triggered
Content: Symptom-In the preview of the sales quote, the message: No Record Found is triggered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quote view and in the Show field enter All Quotes from drop-down and in the Find field enter ABC(where ABC represents the sales quote id).-Select the Sales Quote ABC and click on the button Preview.-The message: No Record Found  is triggered.-Cause-The form template for the sales quote is in the status Not Publish, therefore it's not been picked while preview of the sales quote.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view and the Form Template Maintenance sub-view.-In the Show field from drop-down select Not Publish Form and click on the Go button.-Using the filter option,search for the Form Template name Sales Quote.-Select the Sales Quote Template and click on the button Publish.-Once Publish,you will be able to preview the sales quote ABC.

Title: Users Cannot Select the Existing Accounts in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Users cannot select the existing Accounts in the Sales Order, the only option provided is to create a new account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order under Common Task.-The Account field value help does not show any of the existing customers, the only option provided is to create a new account.-Cause-You have selected Forbid Manual Changes column for Account in the Fine-Tune activity Involved Parties for Sales Order.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementations Projects view.-Open the Activities.-Go to the Fine-Tuning tab.-Search for the Involved Parties for Sales Orders activity.-Select and open the activity.-Uncheck the checkbox of Forbid Manual Changes column for Account.-Save your changes.-Now you can select the accounts from the value help in sales order.

Title: You Are Not Able to Cancel a Contract if It Is Invoiced
Content: Symptom-You are not able to cancel a contract.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open certain contract and go to the Items sub tab.-Select the row and you can see the Fulfillment is Not Started. But the Reason for Rejection field is grayed out.-You are not able to cancel this contract item.-Cause-There are many cases where users invoice a contract and then cancel it, due to this the Invoice Request goes into the status In Conflict. Considering this fact, we have changed the logic in such a manner that you will not be able to cancel a contract if it is invoiced.-Resolution-You have to first cancel the invoice and then the contract.-See Also-You can find the steps to cancel a customer contract in the case document: 1836112 - You are not Able to Cancel a Customer Contract-Since the Fulfillment Status of the Item is Finished for the reported contract, the Cancelation is not possible anymore.

Title: The List Price is not Determined for an Item Following Error Occurs "Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation"
Content: Symptom-The List price is not determined by the system in a sales order for a product even though the product has been maintained in a Base Price List by Product Category.-Following error occurs: Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-In the Common Tasks select New Sales Order.-Enter the respective data such as account, employee responsible, sales unit etc..-In the Item section add product ABC (ABC represents the ID of the item).-The following error occurs: Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Pricing view and the Price Lists sub view.-In the Show field select the price list type Base Price List by Product Category.-Open price list PLPC (PLPC represents the name of the price list).-Price list PLPC has been set up for Product Category ID 1000 (1000 represents the product category ID of the price list).-The Valid From/To dates of the price list are also in the time range as the posting date of the sales order.-Navigate to the Items tab.-You can see that the product ABC has been maintained in price list PLPC and the price list has been released.-In the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Products view.-Open Product ABC.-The Product Category for product ABC is 1001 (1001 represents the product category ID of the product).-Select the Product Categories view.-Expand product category 1000. -You can see that product category 1001 is a sub node of the product category 1000.- Cause-The product is assigned to product category 1001 but the Base Price List by Product Category has been created for product category 1000. Multi-level hierarchy structures for product categories is not supported for the price determination. Therefore, the price for the product which has been maintained in the Base Price List by Product Category is not determined by the system in the sales order since the product category of the product is a sub category of the product category for which the price list has been created.-Resolution-You have to create a Base Price List by Product Category with the same product category which has been maintained for the product. The price will the be correctly determined in the sales order by the system.

Title: Preceding Zeros are Truncated in the Customer Invoice Number
Content: Symptom-When you create a customer invoice, the system generates an invoice number without preceding zeros.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Invoice under Common Tasks view.-Fill all the mandatory fields.-Upon saving, the preceding zeros are truncated.-Cause-For customer invoices, the system applies default rules and starts numbering automatically with the number 1 irrespective of the company or the invoicing document type .-However, the system does not allow to add preceding zeros. If you have a customer invoice with leading zeros followed by any prefixes, suffixes or separators, then the zeros will not be truncated.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-

Title: Consistency Check Error in 3PL Inventory Notification
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer has received an Inventory Notification from his/her 3PL provider, but it is showing following consistency errors:-Item X-AB: Quantity PQR is not defined-Item X-AB: Conversion factor for quantity ABC not defined in Product definition-Item X-AB: Inventory-relevant quantity missing; check inventory view on product-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Third-Party Logistics work center.-Select Inventory Notifications view.-Search for the relevant notification.-Choose Check Consistency button. It shows error messages and it is in Inconsistent status.-Cause-The XML message which was sent by the 3PL warehouse provider is not correct. It content wrong quantity type code. For example, for Unit of Measure(UoM) l-Liter, the used XML tag looks like as given below:-<Quantity unitCode="LTR">25</Quantity>-<QuantityTypeCode>LTR</QuantityTypeCode>-Here you can see the quantity type code is used as LTR, but the correct type code for liter is volume. So the XML tag should look like as given below:-<Quantity unitCode="LTR">25</Quantity>-<QuantityTypeCode>VOLUME</QuantityTypeCode>-Resolution-3PL warehouse provider should correct the XML tag and send the XML message again.

Title: How to Set-up the Inclusion of the External Sales Order Reference Number in a Customer Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-How to set-up the inclusion of the external sales order reference number in a Customer Invoice Request.-NOTE: Please check the attached PDF file in the case document for screenshot and more details.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show All and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice request).-Edit the invoice request and select the View All button.-You cannot see the external reference sales order linked to this invoice request.-Select the Invoice button to create customer invoice out of invoice request ABC.-The external reference sales order is also not available in the customer invoice.-Cause-You have not configured the external reference number for the customer invoice.- Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for configuration elements containing External reference. -Select the External Reference Number Determination for Customer Invoice.-Select the button showing an arrow pointing down in order to add this configuration element to the shortlist. -Select the Add to Change Project button. -Provide a Title for your change project and a description.-Select the Finish button. -In your newly created change project, select Open Activity List to Implement Changes.-Select the activity External Reference Number Determination for Customer Invoice. -For the various document types, select the Copied from Predecessor Reference ID as a Determination Method. -Select the Save and Close button. -Change the status of the first activity to Closed. -Seect Merge Changes with Production System.-Select Start Merge and confirm the popup window by selecting Continue. -The merge will take a couple of minute,s and the status will be In Process.-After a while the status will change to Completed.-Select Close Project.-With the above steps you have configured the External Reference Number in customer invoice.-Note: The external reference number is also a split criteria for the invoices.

Title: You Cannot Maintain Invoice Schedule for Migrated Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-Using the migration tool to import sales orders. Found that in the migration template there is no Invoice Schedule information, so that it cannot include the Invoice Schedule information when importing. And there is no Invoice Schedule tab in the migrated sales orders after imported.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the Migrated sales order.-Click View All button, observe that there is no Invoice Scheduling sub tab under the Pricing Tab.-Cause-Sales orders which are migrated into the system will not have the invoice schedule tab.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Invoice Schedule; Migrated ; Sales Order; Update; Pricing tab; System behavior; Import

Title: Dump Raised from the Code "CL_PRCTAX_PRICEANDTAX -> FINALIZE method" in CRM Documents like Sales Order, Invoice etc.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-THIS CASE DOCUMENT IS RESERVED FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY---When working with the documents like sales order, customer invoices and so on, there could be situations like below-The save of the sales document might dump at the following code.-The XI message would be stuck because of the backend dump.- Code where it dumps:-CL_PRCTAX_PRICEANDTAXàFINALIZE method-Actual exception is raised at CL_PRCTAX_APIàCHECK_CONSISTENCY method (line 104)-Cause-The dump happens because of the inconsistency (different values) in price and tax property flags in the actual database table. Because of bug which was existing in FP3.5 (later fixed), some old documents have these inconsistent values. This needs a correction in the database table (pced_item and pced_item).-Sample tickets:-0120031469 0000045006 2013-0120061532 0001649780 2013-Resolution-Finding item guid for which the dump happens-Keep a breakpoint at the below class and note down the item node id for which the dump happens-CL_PRCTAX_APIàCHECK_CONSISTENCY method-Line 90 (APPEND lr_prc_item->parent_node_id TO lt_inconsistent_node_id.)- In the debugging mode note down the value lr_prc_item->item_id for which the parent node is added as inconsistent in line 90.-  This item node id (or GUID) will be the input for the backend report.-Change the db entry using the backend report (CHANGE_PRC_TAX_PROP_FLAGS).-Get the customer’s permission for the backend database change.-Execute the report “CHANGE_PRC_TAX_PROP_FLAGS”.-In the screen the item id is the value which was noted down in the previous section.-If you check the check box “Check”, the report will just check and let the user know, if there is any error or if the ticket needs to be forwarded to the development colleagues.-If you check the check box “Check and Correct”, the report will let the user know, if there is any error. If no errors are there then the db change is executed and success message is shown.- Sample screenshot:- Once the db change is done successfully, then the failed XI message should be restarted in case is the customer reports that the XI message is stuck. This should now turn it to green.-If the customer has reported that the save failed because of this, then after the db change ask the customer to recheck if the save is dumping again.-Note:-The report will have following messages (Error, warning and Success). Depending on the message, the expert support should react on how to handle the ticket.-Success message:-Everything is fine. Expert support can restart the XI message or ask the customer to check if the issue is solved (save failed case) depending on the kind of ticket they get.-Inconsistency between the price and tax property fields is corrected succesfully-Warning message: -This message is shown when the check box (“Check”) is selected. So the expert support can do a initial check and if no error message are raised then they can select check box “Check and Correct”.-Inconsistency exists between the price and tax property fields. Correct it-Error message:- When these error message comes check if you have entered a valid item id, if still you get some error send the ticket back to the development team, so that we can check this (as this would need more analysis which cannot be automated).-Enter a valid item_guid. If still this error exists (even after entering valid guid) contact the development team-More that two records exists with the same ITEM_GUID. Contact the development team-Inconsistency exists between the price and tax property fields, but correction is not straigt forward, so contact the development team-The property flags seems to be consistant. The eror could be because of some other reason. Contact the development team-No tax component exists for the given item. Contact the development team- Finding the item guid/item id (in case if it’s a health check ticket and you want ask the customer if they are facing any issue).- Finding the document id from SAP Incight:-1. Open the HC ticket via the CSS.-2. Open the SAP Incight for the mentioned ticket.-3. A sample dump would look like the one shown below. The last statement would be a finalize call.-4. From this dump stack, note down the root node id.-5. Find the host object (BO name) from where the price and tax is triggered. This is not straight forward, depends on the host object. It will be available in one the call stack. The below screen shot is just a sample, depending on the dump this information will be available at different levels.-6. Open the system, go to transaction sesfts and enter the BO name, obtained from the SAP Incight and do a query with the root node id obtained from the SAP Incight.-  7. Since in this case it will be a health check ticket, once you find the object, contact the customer and check with the customer if the customer is facing any issues with the mentioned document or with associated sales order. If yes, ask the customer to create actual ticket with the issue and then once they give the permission to correct the document the steps mentioned in the first two

Title: Sender E-Mail Address of a Sales Document for Different Seller Parties
Content: Symptom-You want to use different sender e-mail addresses for different seller parties when sending the output of a sales document via email to your customer.-Reproducing the Issue-In your Org Management you have created company ABC and company XYZ which are used as Seller Party in a sales document.-When you create a sales document and you send the output document via email to your customer you would like to ensure that the sender e-mail (From field in the e-mail) will be determined according to the Seller Party of the sales document.-Resolution-You have to define an e-mail address for the respective Seller Party (in our example company ABC and company XYZ) in the Org Management.-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Org Structure view and click on the Edit button-Select company ABC and navigate to the Addresses tab.-Enter an email address in the Main Address section under the Communication Details section in the E-Mail field.-Select company XYZ and navigate to the Addresses tab.-Enter an email address in the Main Address section under the Communication Details section in the E-Mail field.-Save and Activate your changes.-When  you now create a sales document e. g. a customer invoice the email you entered for the respective company will be also visible in the customer invoice.-In your sales document e. g. invoice navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Select the Seller party.-In the field E-Mail you can see the e-mail entered in your Org Management.-If you now release the invoice the entered email address will then be the sender e-mail address (From field in the e-mail).

Title: Error Occurs in Return: 'Country code for Business Partner missing, Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again'.
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when editing a return: Country code for Business Partner missing, Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-Edit the return.-The following error occurs:-Country code for Business Partner missing, Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again.-Cause-The error occurred in the return because no country has been maintained for the Ship-to party.-Resolution-To correct the error you need to maintain a country for the Ship-to party. The tax calculation for the return has to be re-triggered.--Follow the steps below to maintain the country in the Ship-to party:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-Edit the return and select the View All button.-Go to the Involved Parties tab and select the the ship-to party.-Select View All button in the new screen of ship-to party and go to the Communication tab.-Maintain the country and address for this party.-Once the above steps are completed you have to re-trigger the tax calculation in return XYZ:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-Edit the return and select the View All button.-Go to the Pricing tab.-Select Update Pricing -> Completely.-Save the document.

Title: The Sales Quote Approval Task Remains Unassigned if the Quote is Created by the Manager of the Org Unit
Content: Symptom-The sales quote approval task remains unassigned if the quote is created by the manager as of the Org Unit which is added in the quote.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Create a New Sales Quote from the Common Tasks.-Add a account and sales unit as ABC in the quote (ABC represents the ID of the sales unit).-Add the employee responsible XYZ (XYZ is the ID of the employee responsible for the quote and the manager of the org unit ABC).-Add a product in the sales quote and Submit it.-Now go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Show Unassigned Tasks.-You can find that the approval task created for the sales quote is not assigned to any user.-You are expecting that the approval task created by the manager of the same org unit should have been assigned to her.-Cause-The approval task for the sales order remain unassigned since it is created by the manager who have been hired and assigned as a manager for the same unit for which the quote has been created.-To avoid self approval possibility, the functionality is so defined that if such a scenario occurs then responsibility for the approval task is not determined to the same person .-Resolution-You can apply the workaround by changing the approval process definition:-Go to the Application & User Management work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-Select the default approval process for Sales Quote (which is in active status).-Copy the approval process definition for sales quote.-In this screen maintain:-step 1 -> Edit condition to maintain sales unit = ABC.-Maintain responsible approver as manager ID i.e.. XYZ (direct approver).-Save the approval process definition.-Activate this definition via Edit Validity on the list.

Title: While Creating a New Manual Invoice for an Account Error Occurs 'Address missing for the party Account ID'
Content: Symptom-While creating a new manual invoice for an account error occurs Address missing for the party Account ID.-The account is also an employee and you are also not able to enter the address manually for the account as the fields are grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue:-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Select New Manual Invoice under Common Tasks.-Enter the Account ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Error occurs : Address missing for party Account ID ABC.-Follow the steps below to check the address fields in the account ABC:-Go to the Business Partner Data workcenter.-Go to the Business Partners view.-Choose Show Active Business Partner and Find ABC.-Edit the account and select View All button.-Go to the Addresses tab.-The fields for the address are empty and non editable.--Cause-The customer account ABC has no address. The only address available in the system is the employee workplace address. This is used in certain-scenarios like (in house ordering) for shipping and billing. Therefore this address might be used in these roles.--For an employee used as a real customer, an account address is also needed. The private employee address is forbidden to be used in these cases due to data protection.--Resolution-Go to Business Partner Data work center.-Go to the Business Partners view.-Search business partner ABC (ABC represents the ID of the business partner).-Select the business partner ABC, go down in the screen in the section Business Partner Roles -> select and open the Account.-Select the View All button.-In the Communication tab select the subtab Addresses.-Select the Add Row button.-Initially the Addresses tab would be non-editable.-Go down under Address and select the country from the dropdown e.g. DE.-Now the country will be filled to the newly added row.-Select the Bill-to or Ship-to party as per your requirement-Set the main flag for the newely added address.-Save the new address.-Now try to create a manual invoice for this business partner ABC, the address should appear in the invoice.

Title: Customer Invoice Does not Have the Output Data, Also Preview Cannot be Generated for the Invoice
Content: Symptom-Customer invoice does not have the Output data, also preview cannot be generated for the invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-Select the Preview button.-No preview is generated.-Select the Edit button and choose View All button.-Select You Can Also and edit the Output Settings.-No records are found.-Cause-You have created your own form template and rule for the form template.-SAP delivers standard rules for Customer Invoicing for each document type and when you adapt or delete these standard rules then you have to maintain the correct rules for template.--In the rule for the template you have maintained the Seller /Invoicing Unit as XYZ, this means for any invoice if you maintain this invoicing unit then only the preview would appear.-Note: XYZ represents the invoicing unit.--You can check the form rules by following below steps:-Go to the Application & User Management work center-Go to the Input & Output Management view.-Go to the Form Template Selection subview.-Select the form template for the Customer Invoice.-Open the form template DEF (DEF represents the form template name).-Resolution-You have following to option for enabling the preview for the invoice:-Change the invoicing unit in the customer invoice as per the rule maintained in the form template.-Change the rule in the form template.-Steps for changing the invoicing unit in the customer invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Documents and Find ABC (DEF represents the invoice ID).-Edit the invoice and select View All button.-Select the Involved Parties tab.-Change the invoicing unit to unit that is maintained in the form template rule.-Save the invoice.- Follow the steps below to change the rule in the Customer Invoice form template:-Go to the Application & User Management work center-Go to the Input & Output Management view.-Go to the Form Template Selection subview.-Select the form template for the Customer Invoice.-Edit the form template DEF (DEF represents the form template name).-In the Edit Form Template Rule screen change the rule for the Seller / Invoicing Unit as per your requirement.

Title: How To Add the Total Net Value Item To a Customer Invoice Form Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You would like to know how to add the Total Net Value (Total Item Value + Freight cost) to a Customer Invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Flexibility view.-Go to Form Template Maintenance sub-view.-Select the form template Customer Invoice (United Kingdom) – English.-Open the form template by click on Open > Easy Form Editor.-You can see in the Preview of the form template includes all product item lines, there is only Total Item Net Value and entries of Value Added Tax (%) displayed. You also require the Total Net Value price component line to be displayed and / or printed below the Total Item Net Value which is the combined sum of Total Item Value and Freight cost, and is later on used to calculate the Value Added Tax.-Cause-The Total Net Value (Total Item Value + Freight cost) price component is not displayed / printed by default in a Customer Invoice, since it is not selected as Item Print / Item Display in Fine Tuning Configuration Element activity.-Resolution-You must first enable the display and print of the Total Net Value in Fine Tuning.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview View.-Click on Go to call up the activities and find Configure Price Strategy activity and open it.-In the follow-up window, click on hyperlink Configure Pricing Procedure.-You can see the 80 - Total Net Value is marked as No in Item Print.-Enable the Item Print for this Step 80 - Total Net Value by changing the value to Yes.-Now you will be able to see this price component on the printed Customer Invoice.-Optionally:-If you want also to see the Total Net Value price component in the Preview of the Customer Invoice form template, you need to perform step 6. also in row Item Display

Title: Discount Maintained in 'Customer Specific Discount Product Category' Does not Appear for the Product Added in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The discount maintained in the Customer Specific Discount Product Category does not appear for the product added in the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to check if product category is maintained for the product:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Show All Products and Find ABC (ABC represents the product ID).-Edit the product ABC.-The product category DEF is maintained for the product (DEF represents the product category ID).-Follow the steps below to check the discount list:-Go to the Products and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-Go to the Discount Lists sub view.-Show Customer Specific Discount Product Category.-Edit the list.-Go to the Items tab.-The discount XXX is maintained only for the product ABC (XXX represents the discount percentage).-Follow the steps below to check if the discount maintained is picked in the sales order:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Enter the mandatory details in the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and the product ABC.-The discount is not derived from the Customer Specific Discount Product Category.-Cause-The validity date maintained for the discount list Customer Specific Discount Product Category is in the future, hence system is not considering the discount in the sales order.-Resolution-The validity date maintained in the Customer Specific Discount Product Category is in the future, hence it is not valid before the maintained date.-Go to the Products and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-Go to the Discount Lists sub view.-Show Customer Specific Discount Product Category.-Edit the list.-Go to the General tab.-Adjust the Valid From/To dates to the current period.-Now the discount maintained in the discount list Customer Specific Discount Product Category will appear for the product added in the sales order.

Title: The "Ship-From Location" Field for the Items in the Service Order do not Show All Locations in the Value Selection
Content: Symptom-The Ship-From Location field for the items in the service order do not show all locations in the Value Selection.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search for the service order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Select the service order and choose Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to tab Services and Spare Parts tab.-Select a line item  and go to the Spare Part Logistics subtab.-Select the Value Selection for the Ship-from Location field under Shipping section.-Value Selection do not show all the Ship-from locations maintained in the Supply Chain Design Master Data.-Cause-The Value Selection of Ship-From Location field of the service order items only shows the locations which are also marked as Site in the Locations view of Supply Chain Design Master Data.-You can check the details Supply Chain Design Master Data by following below steps:-Go to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to the Locations view.-Show Active Sites.-Here you can verify if the locations are marked as Site.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: The Sales Order Volume Report Does not Display the GTIN of the Product
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order Volume Report does not display the GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) of the product.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Reports -> List view.-Find the Sales Volume Report.-Open the report in the Web Browser.-Execute the report with required parameters.-The report does not display the GTIN of the product which has been added in the sales order.-Cause-The Sales Volume Report is not designed to display the GTIN of the product. This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-As a workaround you can maintain the GTIN in the Product Description field of the product master data. With this workaround you will be able to view the GTIN in the Sales Volume Report.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products view.-Edit any product.-Maintain the GTIN in the product description field.

Title: How to Enable Partner Content in Bydesign HTML5
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-RELEASED INTERNALLY-Partner content by default is not enabled in Bydesign HTML5 client in Productive tenants. If there is any request to enable partner content, first get acknowledgement if customers / partners have tested their solution successfully in Test tenants.-Resolution-Once confirmation is recieved in incident, follow below steps.-Logon to System backend.-Go to transaction SE38.-Enter program A1S_UI_SET_OBERON5_TRIAL.-Execute this program (Fn+F8)-Set the flag  Acknowl.Partner Content Test as shown below.-Once executed, login to the front end using HTML5 client and check if the partner content is shown. Title: Unassigned Task Overdue: Complete Payroll Data (Hire) Created in the Business Task Management for HR Administrator
Content: Symptom-You want to know, why system created the unassigned task Overdue: Complete Payroll Data (Hire) in the Application and User Management work center.-Cause-The HR Administrator does not have access rights to work center view HCM_PAYROLLREGULARTASKS and hence the task was unassigned.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the User and Access Management view-Select the relevant Business User-Navigate to the tab Work Center and View Assignment-Assign the work center view HCM_PAYROLLREGULARTASKS-Save and Close-The Overdue: Complete Payroll Data (Hire) is an escalation task informing you that payroll data for a hired employee was not entered on time. The original task Complete Payroll Data (Hire) which appeared in the Payroll Processing Work view still needs to be processed. The system automatically triggers this escalation task after a (configured) deadline has passed. The task is sent to you as the HR administrator who originally performed the hire in the Personnel Administration work center. This escalation task appears in your inbox in the Home Work view.-As the administrator responsible for the hire of the employee concerned, you must ensure that the payroll data is completed. The escalation task Overdue: Complete Payroll Data (Hire) will be completed and removed from the work list automatically once the original task is completed. Alternatively, you can manually set the escalation task to completed or canceled.-If you choose not to respond, both tasks remain in the following locations:-•Original task: Your work list in the Payroll Processing Work view.-•Escalation task: Your work list in the Home Work view.

Title: Invoice Run is not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-Invoice Run is not working as expected.
