The run has not been executed on a particular day though that day is included in the run parameters.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Runs view.-Show All Invoice Runs.-Select the invoice run ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the invoice run).-Select the Execution Details of Run ID XYZ-> No invoice run was executed on DD.MM.YYYY date (DD.MM.YYYY represents the date).-Cause-You are using International Calendar where the DD.MM.YYYY is marked as public holiday, due to this reason the invoice run was not executed on that particular day.-Resolution-As per the scheduling information for Customer Invoicing Run, with Run ID - XYZ, the recurrence is Daily, Every work day using calendar - International with 5 working days(Mon - Fri).--We have checked the holidays for the International Calendar and they are:-New Year's Day-Good Friday-Easter Sunday-Easter Monday-Whit Sunday-Whit Monday-Christmas Day-Boxing Day-New Year's Eve-Since there was a public holiday on DD.MM.YYYY date, the invoice run was not executed.-In case the expectation is that the run executes as per the any other calendar then choose that country holiday calendar in the scheduling UI - Using Calendar field.--You can check the calendar used in the Invoice Run by following below steps:-1. Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2. Go to the Background Jobs view.-3. Show All Scheduled Jobs and click on Go button.-4. Select the run ID XYZ and choose Reschedule button.-5. In the Reschedule Job screen, you can see the calendar maintained which is International with 5 working days (Mon - Fri).

Title: Approval Tasks Still Pending for Finished or Cancelled Purchase Orders Under Managing My Area Work Center
Content: Symptom-You Cancelled/Finished the Purchase Orders but still the system shows approval tasks to complete for the respective purchase orders.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Managing My Area work center-2. Go to Approvals view-3. You will find the relevant Tasks pending for Approval-Cause-The system created a Notification for the Cancelled/Finished Purchase Orders. These are not Tasks. The symbols for Notifications and Tasks are different.-Resolution-1. Go to the Managing My Area work center-2. Go to the Approvals view and search for the Notification Symbol in the fact sheet-3. Choose the relevant Notification-4. Select the Notification icon and a new screen will open-5. Select the Actions button-6. Select the option Complete or Acknowledge to complete the notification-7. After a refresh the Notification will disappear from the list

Title: Production Fix: Double Maintain the ABSL Code Change in Test Tenant Manually Where Solution Exists
Content: Symptom-You will receive the below warning message  as a pop up when you open a solution in test tenant.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK.-Double click on the solution to open.-Warning message appears in a pop-up.-Cause-The reason for this message is if the tenant is of type pre-production, and you have selected the PDI_PRODUCTION_FIX view in the access rights. Steps are as mentioned below:-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users sub View.-Select your PDI user.-Click on Edit Access Rights.-Navigate to Work Center and View Assignment.-Expand PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT.-Here you can see that the PDI_Production_FIX is selected as shown in the screenshot below.-Resolution-If you do not want this message to be displayed you should un-assign the PDI_Production_FIX from your user.-Note: You should assign PDI Production Fix work center view to your user only if you want to perform the Production Fix Correction, then this message is bound to appear to remind you to maintain the same code in your another test tenant to avoid any kind of inconsistencies.-

Title: How to Access HTML5 version of ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-How to Access HTML version of ByDesign System-Reproducing the Issue-You get the error message "Access Denied" while accessing the HTML version of ByDesign system-Cause-Incorrect URL used for accessing the HTML version-Resolution-The correct format of URL to access HTML version is https://myxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/public/byd/runtime?client_type=html

Title: User Get Error: Manual Invoice Processing Not possible, Reference Invoice Locked
Content: Symptom-The system displays an error message: Manual invoice processing not possible, reference invoice locked. when trying to create credit memo fro released invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Customer Invoicing.-Choose the View Invoice Documents.-Take a random released invoice ABC. (ABC represent invoice ID)-Choose the button Follow-Up select Manual Credit Memo from drop down.-Error message appears: Manual invoice processing not possible;referenced data not valid.-Cause-The reason for the error message is in invoice ABC, the concerned item is a credit memo item which is allowed behavior. But you cannot create a follow up credit memo on an item that is already a credit memo item.-Resolution-This is  a s ystem standard behavior.-

Title: The Valuation Cost of the Product Does not Appear on the Contract
Content: Symptom-The valuation cost of the product does not appear on the contract.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search for the contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the contracts).-Select the View All button and go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-The valuation cost of the product is missing.-Cause-There is no automatic calculation of the planned costs in the contract item. This value needs to be entered manually.  In Service Order we have the estimated costs and this value is automatically determined. The reason why we are not calculating the planned costs is that a contract is a long running document (maybe valid for number of years) and therefore not possible to calculate the estimate based on the duration of the work. Duration of the work in case of contract is a multiplication of the duration of work by the number of times an activity needs to be performed within the life cycle of a contract. This information is currently not available in contract and therefore cost estimate can not be automatically performed.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: How to see Goods and Services Receipts Which are not yet Invoiced and how to Check Which Receipts are Posted Against Which Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You want to see the Goods and Services Receipts which are posted against supplier invoices and you want to see the Goods and Services Receipts which are not yet invoiced.-Resolution-How to see which Goods and Service Receipts were posted against which Supplier Invoices;   -On header level:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Go to Document Flow tab.-On Item Level:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice.-Choose relevant Line Item and go to sub tab Document Flow.-     B. How to see the Goods and Service Receipts that are not yet invoiced:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Select the view Invoice Entry.-Choose All Deliveries to be Invoiced from dropdown list.

Title: Update of Counted Quantity Through OData Not Reflecting in the UI
Content: Symptom-When trying to update the Counted Quantity field of Inventory Count (ZeroCountedQuantityConfirmedIndicator) through OData using the PhysicalInventoryCountOperationActivityInventoryItemQuantityCollection. The request is successful, but the information is not reflected in the UI.-Cause-It is not possible to update Counted Quantity of an Invetory Count whose Count Task has status Finished. You will only be able to update this information in Inventory Counts with open Count Tasks.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.

Title: Time out dump when submitting Service Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When trying to submit the Service Order the system loads for some time and then dumps.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Find Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Service Order ID).-Click Edit.-Click Submit -> Confirm Service Execution.-After loading for quite some time the system dumps.-Cause-There are too many line items in the order.-Resolution-Though the system will allow for a nearly unlimited amount of line items to be added to a service order, we recommend to not enter more than 250, ideally max 100, to avoid time out dumps.-In order to submit a very large service order it will have to be split up. To do so line items have to be canceled and re-entered in a new or multiple new service orders. Once this is done a single invoice can be created for the respective service orders combined by following the instructions in help article Create an Invoice or Credit Memo with Reference to Preceding Documents ﻿in the help center.-

Title: Cannot Add the Reference Contract Item in a Service Request
Content: Symptom-You cannot add the Reference Contract Item in a Service Request if a Service Order was created as a follow-up document of the Service Request.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work ccenter. -Select the Service Requests view.-Open service request XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service request).-Go to the General tab and the Main Information sub tab.  -You can see that the Reference Contract Item cannot be edited. The field is not enabled.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see that the follow-up service order ABC (ABC represents the ID of the service order).-Cause-With release 1508 a new functionality was introduced in the service order that you can now add a reference contract Item on line item level. With this new functionality we also changed the system behaviour in regards to adding the reference contract Item in a service request. Now, once a service order has been created as a follow-up document the field Reference Contract Item in the corresponding service request becomes disabled and no value can be selected (independent of the status of the service order).-The reason for this is the following:-If a service order is created from a service request which has a contract reference assigned to this then this contract reference will be carry forwarded to service order. Now, if a user changes the contract reference at service request level, this will be a conflicting situation and could lead to data inconsistencies. Therefore, this was restricted in the service request level so that the user will not be able to change the reference contract in the service request if a service order has already been created as a follow up document to this service request.-However, you can now instead maintain the reference contract item on item level of the created service order.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: You Cannot Find the Option to Add the Surcharge in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the option to add the Surcharge in the sales order. Additionally you want the option to add the surcharges in the sales order in percentage.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Add the account and other required details in the sales order.-Select the View All button.-Add a product in the Items tab.-Select the Pricing tab.-Under Item Pricing select the Add Row  button, the drop down list there is no option to select Surcharge.-Cause-The surcharge has been not scoped by you in the Business Configuration, this is the reason why it does not appear in the sales order pricing.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to add scope the surcharge in the system:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project and select the Edit Project Scope button.-In the scoping screen, go to the 3rd step Review Questions.-Show All Elements.-Expand General Business Data -> Product and Service Pricing -> Select Sales Price Specifications.-In the section Questions for Sales Price Specifications -> Search for the question Do you maintain surcharges?.-Select Yes for this question.-Follow the below steps to configure the percentage option for the surcharges:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Configure Price Strategy activity.-Open the activity and choose the View button.-Select the Configure Pricing Procedure.-Here you can configure your pricing strategy for Gross Surcharge (%) and Gross Surcharge.-Note: The changes in the Configure Price Strategy activity can only be done by creating a change project.-

Title: Purchase Order Output History tab Shows Error Status: Mail delivery failed
Content: Symptom-You created the purchase order and sent to supplier. But when you look at the output history tab system shows the status as Error.-An output error occurred:-Mail delivery failed: returning message to sender. -Open the task and view the details for more information about the error.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Common Tasks view and select New Purchase Order-Fill the mandatory details and you send it to Supplier-Now Edit the Purchase Order and select Output History tab-System shows the Status as Error-Cause-You maintained the incorrect e-mail address in the Supplier Master Data.-Resolution-You have to maintain a correct e-mail address in the Supplier Master Data:-Go to the Supplier Base work center-Go to the Suppliers view-Select the relevant Supplier and select Edit button-Go to the General tab and enter correct e-mail address under Main Communication field-Select Save

Title: How to Check the Approval Note on Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to check the note from approver on approved sales orders.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Sales Orders view.-You want to know how to check the note from approver on Approved sales orders.-Resolution-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Sales Orders view.-Select the relevant sales order and choose Edit->View All->You will find Approval Note at end of the Genernal tab where you can see note for approved orders.

Title: The Product Warranty Does Not Show up for Reference Product
Content: Symptom-The product warranty does not show up for reference product.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Desk Work Center.-Select New Service Request from the Common task.-Select the Account ABC (ABC represents the identification of an account)-Select the Reference Product XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of a product with a warranty maintained).-The Warranty Until field is not visible on the service request.-Cause-When a product is registered, the system identifies the warranty that is associated with that product. When we require a service for the product, the system determines if the product is still under warranty and if the particular service is covered by the warranty-Resolution-In order to display the warranty information, the product must be registered.-Go to the Service Entitlements work center.-Go to the Register Products view.-Select New Registered Product.-Select  Registered Product DEF (DEF represents the identification of a registered product).-Select  Product XYZ.-Save.-Change the status to active.- See Also-Please see the document "Warranties Quick Guide" in the help center for more details.

Title: Country Field Becomes Mandatory (*Asterisk) While Creating new Supplier Master
Content: Symptom-While you creating new supplier, initially the field country is not indicated as mandatory field (without Asterisk). After you fill the field country, it becomes mandatory field. (Asterisk *)-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Supplier Base work center.-2. Go to View Common Tasks and choose New Supplier-3. In the field Main Address, you will find the field of Country indicated as mandatory field (without Asterisk *).-4. Select a Country from the drop list and now system shows Country field as mandatory. (With Asterisk *)-Cause-Country is a mandatory field if a postal address is created, but it is not mandatory to have a postal address for an Account/Supplier.-Resolution-System is working as designed.

Title: Value for Calculated Extension Field do not appear for some records/ducments in the system.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Value for Calculated Extension Field do not appear for some records/ducments in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Create a document, eg,. Sales Order, Opportunity, Service Order etc. on 18.12.2013. Sales Order#100-Create an extension field on 19.12.2013.-Now create another document.  Sales Order#101.-You can find the extension field would appear for Sales Order#101, but not for Sales Order#100.-Cause-The calculated extension fields created later to any document already in the system, would not reflect the extension fields. This is how calculated extension field it works.-Resolution-For any document created before the calculated extension field creation, would not show the values by default.-An explicit dummy modify / roundtrip is required for the extension fields to appear.-For any document created after the calculated extension field creation, would show the values properly.

Title: The Form Template Selected for the Order Pipeline Documents is not the Expected One
Content: Symptom-The form template selected for the Order Pipeline documents is not the expected one.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Go to the Order Pipeline view.-Show All Orders to be Executed and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the order).-Select the Preview button.-The PDF form appeared is not the expected one.-Now open the order pipeline document XYZ and select the Edit Output Settings.-You are expecting the form template ABC to be picked, which is not available for the selection.-Cause-The form template ABC which you are expecting belong to form template group Order to Service Performer, however for the Order Pipeline documents only the template group Service Order is allowed.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.-If you want to have similar form as ABC for the Order Pipeline, then you have to create it for the form template group Service Orders:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance subview.-Search for the existing form templates of Service Orders group.-Select & Copy a form template.-Go to the Easy form Editor and select Add.-Do the required changes as per your requirement or as it was done for the form template ABC (ABC represents the ID of the form template).-Save and Publish the form template.-Now this form template can be selected for the Order Pipeline document.-If you always want the new form template to be picked for the Order Pipeline documents, then you can maintain the rule accordingly:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Go to the Form Template Selection subview.-Show Rules for Service Orders and select the Go button..-Edit DEF (DEF represents the ID of the newly created form template for order pipeline document).-In the next screen, select the form template code DEF and add other details in the rule if required.-Save the rule.

Title: Follow-Up Activity Does not Appear in the Opportunity
Content: Symptom-Follow-Up activity does not appear in the opportunity.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Activities view.-Choose Show All Activities and Find ABC (ABC represents the text of the opportunity).-Two activities DEF and GIH are displayed in the search result (DEF and GIH represents the activity IDs).-Now go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities List view.-Choose Show All Opportunities and Find ABC (ABC represents the text of the opportunity).-Edit the opportunity and select the Sales Activities tab.-Only the completed activity DEF is visible.-Cause-Follow up activities created from an opportunity irrespective of status are shown in Sales Activities tab.-But in your case the second activity is created as follow-up of the first activity which will not appear in the Sales Activities tab.-Only the activities created directly from the opportunity will appear here.-Follow the steps below to check the details:-Go to the Opportunity List view.-Choose Show All Opportunities and Find ABC (ABC represents the text of the opportunity).-Edit the opportunity and select the Document Flow tab.-Here you can see that the activity GIH is created as follow-up of the activity DEF (GIH and DEF represents the activity IDs).-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: How to Set up an Approval Process for Service Confirmation.
Content: Symptom-You created and released a service confirmation however it didn't trigger any approval task but released directly.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Field Service and Repair work center.-Choose Order Pipeline view.-Choose My Orders to be Executed and Go.-Select your service order XYZ and choose Confirm Execution.-Input all mandatory information and choose ﻿Release.-Cause-Since you have not maintained any approval process for the service confirmation, the document is released directly.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, choose the pre-requisite question under scooping and maintain a value limit.-Follow below steps under Scoping to select the mandatory Question,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Choose Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant Project and Edit the Project Scope.-Navigate to Questions.-Expand the business area Service.-Select the business sub-topic Service Confirmation under business topic Service and Repair.-Choose the question - Do you want to use an approval process for service confirmations?-Choose Next and Finish Scoping.-Follow below steps to maintain the value limit,-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Choose Approval Processes view.-Copy the approval process for Service Confirmation.-Maintain the number of Steps, Work Distribution ﻿and ﻿Conditions(Value Limit).-Choose Edit Validity from the drop down of You can also.-Maintain validity then Save and Close.

Title: Error Occurs While Releasing a Customer Invoice: " Enter an e-mail address"
Content: Symptom-You attempt several times to send a Customer Invoice to the Account but each time we try we get an error message "Enter an e-mail address". -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search for the Customer Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-Select the View All button.-Select the Output History tab.-Manually input the E-mail address in Edit Output Settings of You Can Also section.-Choose Resubmit button.-The error message appears stating Enter an e-mail address.-Cause-You have not maintained the email address in the Account Master Data.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Search for the account EDF (EDF represents the ID of the Account).-Select the account EDF.-Select the Edit button and choose Contacts option.-Maintain a valid Email Address.-Save your changes.-Now try to do a resubmission in the customer invoice.

Title: You are not Able to Add New Items in the Follow-up Invoice Request Created From the Existing Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add new items in the follow-up Invoice Request created from the existing Customer Invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the invoice XYZ.-Choose the Follow-Up button - Select Manual Invoice entry.-Remove all existing items in the Items tab.-The Add Row button is grayed out, hence you are not able to add any new item.-Cause-In the Follow-up documents for a customer invoice there can be less number of items than in the original invoice but it cannot have more items or new items.-Hence the Add Row action is disabled and Delete action is enabled. You can change the quantity and discount for the item in the follow-up invoice request.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign system.-As a workaround you can create a new Manual Invoice Request or Credit Memo and add the original Invoice ID as reference in the-the External Reference field to have the reference of original invoice.

Title: User Can Access the Opportunities in the Account Though this User Does not Have Access for the Opportunity View
Content: Symptom-One of your Users who is an external service provider does not have access to the work center New Business and hence not authorized for Opportunities. However the user can see the opportunities table in the corporate account overview of the Account Management work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the account).-Edit the account XYZ.-Select the Sales tab-User can see all the opportunities crated for the account in the Opportunity table.-However the user do not have the authorization for the New Business work center -> Opportunities view.-Cause-You have not restricted the accounts for the sales documents in the Business Configuration Scoping.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant project.-Select the Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Questions.-Select Sales ->Account and Activity Management -> Questions.-Select Yes for the question: Do you want to restrict the display of documents in the account, contact, partner and competitor overview.-Save the changes and finish your scope.-

Title: Error Occurs in the Opportunity 'Value missing,enter an item value'
Content: Symptom-You get an error in Opportunity stating:Value missing,enter an item value. However you have already maintained the item value and quantity under the Items tab in Opportunity.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunities view.-Select the Opportunity List sub-view.-Show All Opportunities then Find ABC(ABC represents ID of the opportunity).-Error occurs Item value missing; enter an item value.-Cause-Price list for the Item added in the Opportunity has not been released.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Pricing view.-Select the Price Lists subview.-Show Base Price List and choose Go button.-Find relevant service and choose Edit button.-Select the Items tab and add service product EDF(EDF represents ID of the product).-Select the Go button.-The product EDF is in Not Release status.-Select the item EDF and select Release button.-Save your changes.

Title: You Received the Following Error Message When Creating a Sales Order : 'Region is Missing; Tax calculation failed'
Content: Symptom-You received the following error message when creating a Sales Order : 'Region is Missing; Tax calculation failed'-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-Enter the account ABC and other mandatory details (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Save the sales order.-Error occurs: Region is missing; tax calculation failed.-Cause-The State has not been maintained in the customer account whose country is US, hence the tax calculation is failing. The tax calculation in Germany is not region dependent but the tax calculation in US is region dependent. In the sales order, the system checks for the Ship-to/ship-from location and if it identifies a country where region is mandatory for tax calculation then an error message is thrown.-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the account and go to the General tab.-Maintain the State in the Main Address section.-Save the changes.-Now the error message will not be shown on the sales order for the account ABC.

Title: Increase the Postal Code Field Length for the Country Kuwait
Content: Symptom-You want to know if it is possible to increase the postal code field length for the country kuwait to 6 digits.-Cause-The limit for the postal code is limited as per each of the countries restriction and format.-Resolution-For the country Kuwait, it is 5 numeric digit only as per this country guideline.-See Also-www.barnesandnoble.com

Title: No Tax is Determined for the Line Items of the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-No tax is determined for the line items of the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab, where you can see 4 line items -Select the Taxes subtab.-The tax is determined for only first line item.-Cause-The first line item of the sales order is a Sales Kit product (which has a bundle of other products), the other line items of the order are subpart of the Sales Kit product, hence the tax determination will only be shown for the first line item.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: You Cannot Add the New Party Role in a Corporate Account
Content: Symptom-You have created a new party role but you cannot add it to an account as a responsibility.-Reproducing the Issue-You have defined a new custom Party Role from the activity Party Role Definition and you expect the new Party Role to be visible in a corporate account :-Go to Business configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Click on Open Activity list and go to Fine-Tune.-Select Party Role Definition.-Open the activity and create a new Party Role.-Save and Close.-Go to Account Management work center.-Select the account ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Edit this account and go to Contacts tab.-Under the tab Responsibilities, click button Add Row.-You expect to find your newly created Party Role but it is not in the list. -Cause-The newly created party role will not be displayed in an account until you have defined a work distribution rule for the work category Account Responsibility by Party Role.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select Task Distribution -> Employee Work Distribution view.-Select the work category Account Responsibility by Party Role.-Click Edit button and select Add Rule.-Chose a name, employee responsible and validity period.-Save and Close.-Now if you check again the account ABC, in the Responsibilities list, the new party role will be displayed.

Title: The Cancelation of a Customer Invoice is Allowed Without the Cancelation of the Related Financial Documents
Content: Symptom-The Cancelation of a customer invoice is allowed without the cancelation of the related financial documents.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoicing Documents view.-Show All Documents and search for the ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Select the invoice XYZ and click the Cancel button.-The invoice gets canceled though their are related financial documents already available in the system.-You expect that the system should through an error message while canceling the invoice if their are related financial documents (e. g. Payment) available.-Cause-If the cleared invoice is canceled, a new journal entry is created in financials with the negative amount and an Invoice Reversal document is created. It is then left to the financial clerk to settle the payments. There is no automatic way of communicating the cancelation of an invoice to financials. So, if the user has by mistake canceled an invoice then he can communicate this via e-mail to financial clerk to repost the items.  We do not prevent any user from cancelling an invoice document but only show warning message. It is not possible to check the clearing status before canceling an invoice.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: NDIV0 Function in Key Figure Formulas
Content: Symptom-You want to know why the NDIV0 function is used while creating a Key Figure.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Key Figures view.-Search for any Key Figure which uses the NDIV0 function, say for example: Average Handle Time.-Click on the Documentation.-Find that the function NDIV0 ﻿is used in the ﻿Formula.-Cause-The NDIV0 function is used to avoid the error caused by division by 0. If you happened to use in your own key Figure an expression of the form DIV("EXP1","EXP2") where one of the values of "EXP2" happens to be 0 then this would raise an error. As a consequence, subtotals on this column would also throw an error.-By using the function the system will return 0 instead of an error.-For example, the formula for Average Handle Time is:-NDIV0(DIV("Ticket Handling Time (Secs)", "Counter"))-if the values for "Ticket Handling Time (Secs)" and  "Counter" are 4 and 0 respectively, then if NDIV0 function is not part of the formula then as per the formula, 4 divided by 0 will result in an error.- Resolution-Use NDIV0 ﻿to prevent the division by 0.-For Average Handle Time: NDIV0(DIV("Ticket Handling Time (Secs)", "Counter")) if the values are applied then, NDIV0(DIV("4", "0")) will result in 0 instead of an error.-This way subtotals (or any other calculation based on this formula) will not give an error.

Title: Company and Account Determination Group Fields are Missing in the Migration Template of Suppliers
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of migrating Suppliers and observed that the fields Company and Account Determination Groups are missing which are actually required for importing Financial Datas.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Migration of Suppliers.-Select Migrate suppliers using the migration tool link.-Download the Migration Template where the Company and Account Determination Group fields are missing-Cause-With the migration object supplier you can't migrate the Account Determination and Company.-Resolution-Instead you can use Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool to migrate the Company and Account Determination Group fields. The steps are as follows,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Open Activity List button.-Go to Integrate and Extend phase.-Open the activity Migration of Suppliers.-Select Migrate account determination groups payables using the migration tool link.-Download the Migration Template, in which you can find the respective fields.

Title: Migrated Contracts Have Different Contract Date or Time Than in The Migration Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Internal Use Only-You have migrated some contracts into system via the migration template. But you find the contract dates, i.e. Closed Won Date, Contract End Date is different from the migration template.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Search and open one certain contract and go to the Items tab.-You find the Contract End date is different, it is one day earlier than the date in migration template.-Cause-The Start Date/Time and End Date/Time are specified in the migration template have to be always specified in UTC. While displaying it on the frontend (UI) after migration, the system shows it after converting to the customer's time zone.-It is a known issue currently that whatever is specified in template cannot be specified in customer time zone, it always has to be UTC.--The End Date has a special behavior. When you say end date is 2014-04-23 on UI, this means that the contract is valid until 2014-04-24 00:00:00 hrs (and invalid on 2014-04-24 00:00:01 hrs). That is why, when you enter 2014-04-24 00:00:00 as end date in migration template, you should actually see 2014-04-23 on UI. Otherwise if you see 2014-04-24 on UI, it would mean that it is valid until 2014-04-25 00:00:00 which is contradictory to what you entered in the template.--Resolution-This is the current system behavior.

Title: Cannot Open a Report with Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You are not able to view or edit a report from SAP Business ByDesign with Microsoft Excel 2010 or 2013.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the required work center.-Click Reports view.-Select a report.-Click Edit With and then Microsoft Excel.-Internet Explorer prompts you to Open or Save the file. Click Open.-Microsoft Excel will be opened.-The following messages are displayed:-Protected View-Starting SAP report...-SAP Add-In for Microsoft Excel Troubleshooting Guide-Install SAP Add-In for Microsoft Excel from Download Center- or-Navigate to Business Analytics work center.-Click Design Reports view.-Select a report.-Click Edit With and then Microsoft Excel.-Internet Explorer prompts you to Open or Save the file. Click Open.-Microsoft Excel will be opened.-The same messages above are displayed.-Cause-To help protect your computer, files from Internet and from other potentially unsafe locations are opened in Protected View.-Resolution-Resolution 1 (Disabling Protected View):-Open MS Excel.-Go to File; Options.-When Excel Options dialog comes up, click on Trust Center and then on Trust Center Settings.-Select Protected View.-Uncheck Enable Protected View for files originating from the Internet and Enable Protected View for files located in potentially unsafe locations.-Resolution 2 (Without Disabling Protected View):-Leave the Protected View settings unchanged.-When Internet Explorer prompts you to Open or Save the file, click Save as rather than Open and then save the file into a safe location, e.g. in the Desktop.-Open the spreadsheet from this safe folder.-Navigate to SAP Cloud for Customer tab and then log on to the system.-You will be able to open the report without changing Protected View setting.-or-Leave the Protected View settings unchanged.-When Internet Explorer prompts you to Open or Save the file, click Open.-When being informed about the Protected view on the Message Bar, click Enable Editing.-Navigate to SAP Cloud for Customer tab and then log on to the system.-Choose the Insert Report button.-In the pop up select the desired report.-You will be able to open the report without changing Protected View setting.

Title: Reports are missing from OData
Content: Symptom-You want to retrieve a specific report via Open Data Protocol (OData) however when you try to run the below queries you are unable to find the desired report. -Metadata Document of an Analytics Service Example:-https://<your system information>.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/<shortened name of work center>_analytics.svc/$metadata-Data of a Report Example:-https://<your system information>.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/<shortened name of work center>_analytics.svc/RP<report ID>QueryResults-Cause-Report is not assigned to a work center.-Resolution-Only the reports which are assigned to a work center can be retrieved via ODATA.-You can check if a report has been assigned to a work center by looking into the report list of the specific work center or from the Design reports view on the Business Analytics work center. Here you can then check the report assignment status.

Title: You Want To Calculate the Pricing of Your Sales Document Using an Interval Scale Type
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The calculation of the price using a scale price list is not working as you are expecting. You want to calculate the pricing of your sales document using an interval scale type.- Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite:-You have defined a scale prices for the product XYZ (XYZ is the identification of the product) in the base price list ABC (ABC is the identification of the Price List) as follows:-100 EA => 50 EUR-1001 EA => 40 EUR-5001 EA => 30 EUR-Steps to reproduce the issue:-Go to the New Business work center.-Select New Sales Quote.-Enter the Account Name.-Select View All.-Go to the Items tab.-Add the product XYZ.-Once you have entered the quantity, the net value is calculated using a base scale (or from scale). For instance, if you enter the quantity 3000, the price of 40 EUR per item will be taken into account (3000*40 EUR). You are expecting that the system takes each interval of the scale into consideration (100*50 EUR + 2900*40 EUR).-   Cause-This is the normal system behaviour.-Resolution-Currently only Base Scales or From Scales are supported in SAP Business ByDesign. Other scale types like To Scales or Interval Scales are not yet supported. This requirement has been address to the product owner and should be included in a future release of SAP Business ByDesign. For further information regarding your request please contact your sales contact (Account Manager/Customer Advocate/Solution Adviser).

Title: Account Cannot be Changed/Edited in the Sales Quote
Content: Symptom-Account cannot be changed/edited in the sales quote.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quotes view.-Search for the sales quote XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales quote).-Click the Edit button.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the General tab.-You do not have the option to change/edit the account.-Cause-The SAP Business ByDesign is working as designed.-Resolution-We are considering to change the behavior in future releases.

Title: The Sales Order UI and the Sales Order Confirmation Form Also Includes the Amount of the Rejected Line Item in the Total Net Value
Content: Symptom-The Sales Order UI and the Sales Order Confirmation Form also includes the amount of the Rejected Line Item in the Total Net Value.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Select one of the line item and set the Reason for Rejection field.-Save the sales order.-Close the sales order XYZ and open it again.-The Net Value shown in the sales order UI also includes the value of the canceled line item.-Now select the Preview button.-The Total Item Net Value field in the form includes the amount of all line items.-Cause-The line item in question is partially delivered and invoice has already been created for the partially delivered quantity. Hence even on cancelling or rejecting the line item its price is considered in the sales order.-Resolution-In this case the only work around is to cancel the customer invoice and the outbound delivery created for the sales order XYZ and then update the pricing of the sales order.-Follow the steps below to cancel the Customer Invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice created for the partially delivered line item of the sales order XYZ).-Edit the customer invoice ABC and select the Cancel button.-Save and Release the cancelation invoice created.-Follow the case document "1381358 - Reversal of Outbound Delivery" for the cancelation of the outbound delivery.-Once the customer invoice and the outbound delivery is canceled:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ and select the View All button.-Go to the Pricing tab.-Select the Update Pricing button to update the sales order pricing data.-Now the sales order and the sales order confirmation form does not include the amount of the canceled line item in the Net Value of the order.-

Title: The Service Confirmation Created for the Repair Scenario Shows the Error Message "Item XXX: Location Service Point has to be equal to Location Ship From Location"
Content: Symptom-The service confirmation created for the repair scenario shows the error message Item XXX: Location Service Point has to be equal to Location Ship From Location (XXX represents the line item ID).-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repairs work center.-Go to the Service Confirmations view.-Show All Confirmations and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the service confirmation XYZ and choose Edit button.-You get an error message in the service confirmation screen: Item XXX: Location Service Point has to be equal to Location Ship From Location.-Cause-You have created the service order ABC with Location as Own Service Center. That means the fulfillment for this order should be Internal.-However, in the service confirmations XYZ, the service performer maintained is a Service Agent, with a user as Service Agent the Fulfillment becomes External,-which is causing the conflict and system is showing the error message: Location Service Point has to be equal to Location Ship From Location.-If you select an employee as Service Performer and Labor Resource "Direct Labor and Ovhd", this error will not occur.-Follow the steps below to check the Location of Service Provision & Service Performer values:-Go to the Field Service and Repairs work center.-Go to the Service Confirmations view.-Show All Confirmations and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the service confirmation XYZ and choose Edit button.-Select the View All button and go to the Document Flow tab.-Open the service order ABC from the document flow.-Select the View All button of the service order ABC.-Select the General tab and go to the Accounts and Affected Product subtab where the field Location of Service Provision has the value Own Service Center.-Now go to the service confirmation XYZ again.-Go to the Services and Spare Parts tab and select the line item XXX (XXX represents the ID of the line item).-Select the Time Recording subtab.-In field Service Performer you have maintained a Service Agent.- Resolution-You need to select an employee as Service Performer to avoid the error in the Service Confirmation screen.-Go to the Field Service and Repairs work center.-Go to the Service Confirmations view.-Show All Confirmations and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation).-Select the service confirmation XYZ and choose Edit button.-Select the View All button.-Go to the Services and Spare Parts tab and select the line item XXX (XXX represents the ID of the line item).-Select the Time Recording subtab.-Maintain an employee in the Service Performer field instead of a Service Agent.

Title: Can't Migrate Suppliers , Error : "No overlapping of validities allowed"
Content: Symptom-When you migrate suppliers using Migration Tool of Suppliers, you receive the following error:-Error : No overlapping of validities allowed-or-Error: Target UI could not be determined in the current scope-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Configuration workcenter-2. Select the view Overview-3. Search for the activity Migration of Suppliers and open.-5. Select Migrate suppliers using the migration tool-6. Execute the migration--The error comes at simulate migration step.-Cause-This issue may occur due to different reasons. One of the causes is stated as below:-1) In the template, the supplier names for the field Script Code are not maintained as required the sheet Script Variants and General-Resolution-To rectify the issue maintain the values in the migration template as mentioned below:-1) Enter the names in Script Code Latin in the sheet General-2) Also maintain the names in script code Japanese in sheet Script Variants together with the appropriate script code for Japanese language.-

Title: Tax Re-calculation in Case of Copied Sales Document (e.g. Sales Quote, Sales Order etc.)
Content: Symptom-How do the tax re-calculation happen in case of copied sales document (e. g. Sales Quote, Sales Order etc.)-Reproducing the Issue-There are two scenarios involved in this process:-Scenario 1: You have copied an existing sales quote and changed the customer account in the newly created quote:-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quote view.-Select the Show All Quotes.-Search for the Sales Quote XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the quote).-Select the sales quote XYZ-Click the Copy button.-In the copied quote screen, change the Account manually.-Select the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes subtab.-System automatically calculates the tax code considering the new added account.- Scenario 2: You have changed the tax code in the initial Sales Quote document then changed the customer account in the copied sales quote:-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Sales Quote view.-Select the Show All Quotes.-Search for the Sales Quote XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the quote).-Click the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes subtab.-Change the Tax Code manually in the quote.-Save your changes and close the sales quote.-Now select the sales quote XYZ.-Click the copy button.-In the copied quote screen, change the Account manually.-Click the View All button.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Go to the Taxes subtab.-System is not calculating the tax automatically but taking the the tax code as maintained in the initial sales quote.-Note: The above scenarios are also valid for the other sales documents like sales order.-Cause-The tax code in the copied sales quote is re-calculated correctly when the tax code of the initial sales quote is not manually changed, i. e. in this case it is determined by the system.-However when the tax code of the initial sales order not changed manually, then the taxes are not re-calculated automatically as in this case system gives the priority to the manual changes done by you.-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.

Title: It is Possible to to Add an Item in a Webshop Sales Order After Sending it to SAP Business ByDesign System
Content: Symptom-It is possible to to add an item in a webshop sales order after sending it to SAP Business ByDesign system-Reproducing the Issue-You have created an webshop sales order and sent it to SAP Business ByDesign system.-Now you want to add additional line items to the sent sales order.-Also you want to have a single invoice for all the line items.-Cause-The requirement is to add additional line items to the already sent webshop sales order.-Resolution-It is possible to create additional item in the web shop order and update in the already sent sales order in SAP Business ByDesign by sending an update message.-For this you need to write an additional update script and send it via XML to SAP Business ByDesign system.-In case if you want a single invoice for all the line items:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Select the Invoice Requests view-Select all the invoice requests created for this sales order-Select Follow-up -> Invoice Advance Creation button.-Maintain the Invoice date and Release the invoice.-This will create a single invoice for all the line items added and updated in the sales order.

Title: In Contact for the Field Name 'Function From Business Card' ,Error Message : "Your entry too long ,Do not enter more than 40 characters" is Triggered
Content: Symptom-In Contact for the field name Function From Business Card ,error message : Your entry too long ,Do not enter more than 40 characters is triggered.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account management work center.-Go to the Contacts view.-In the Show field, from drop-down select All Contacts and in the Find field enter ABC (where ABC represent the Contact name) and click on the Go button.-Click on the button Edit->General .-In the Contact screen which opens, go to the section Business Address and in the field Function From Business Card enter the value.-Error message: Your entry too long ,Do not enter more than 40 characters is triggered.-Cause-For the field Function From Business Card, it allows the value only upto 40 characters.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Suggested Activities are Invisible on Opportunity UI
Content: Symptom-Suggested Activities are invisible on opportunity UI.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Opportunities view.-Select the Opportunity List subview.-Edit the opportunity then go to View All.-In the Sales Activities tab the Suggested Activities filed is invisible.-Cause-You have not assigned the activity to the Sales Cycle in the Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Open the relevant project.-In the Fine-Tune phase search for  Sales Assistant.-Choose Assignment of Activities to Sales Phases.-First you have to Add Row to Available Sales Cycles with Sales Phases, then maintain Sales Cycle and Sales Phase.-Assign  preferred Activities and make it as Mandatory.-Save your changes.

Title: No Allocated Stock Displayed in Project Material Flow after Releasing One Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You expect non-zero allocated stock for a product in project material flow screen since you release a sales order that contains this product.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Select Common Task Project Material Flow.-Enter Site XXX (XXX stands for the site ID).-Enter Product YYY (YYY stands for the product ID).-Click Go, you can see that allocated stock is zero.-Cause-In the Projected Material Flow calculations, system includes the inventory allocations, as well as inventory, warehouse request and production request documents. Since there is no warehouse request ,nor production request involved in the sales order, there wont be any allocated stock shown in projected material flow.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.

Title: The Delivered Amount is Not Shown in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The delivered amount is not shown in the Sales Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-requisite : The sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the order) has been partially delivered.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Sales order view.-Edit the Sales Order XYZ.-As you have partially delivered the order, you expect that the net value gets updated to the delivered amount. Instead, the ordered amount is still showing in the sales order.-Cause-This is the normal system  behavior. The sales order and the sales order volume report always shows the ordered amount and not the delivered amount.-Resolution-You have the possibility to display in the Invoiced Amount in the Sales Order Volume Report.-Go to the Sales Order Volume Report.-Remove the cancelation default value.-(by default the system does not show orders which are canceled or partially delivered)-Go to Key Figures.-Add the Invoice Amount.-You can now see the delivered amount in your Sales Order Volume Report.-

Title: The Cursor Jumps to the Bottom of the Page on the Sales Order Fast Entry
Content: Symptom-The Cursor Jumps to the bottom of the page when you try to add items on the sales order fast entry.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Choose the View Common tasks-Choose New Sales order (advanced).-Go to Items tab.-Choose the button Fast Entry.-In the first row enter 10 and hit Enter this will take the cursor to the bottom of the page.-Cause-This issue is caused by a personalize setting on the UI. You are currently maintaining a 'sort' on line items, which arranges them in ascending order. What you need to do is remove this sorting rule and then the items will no longer jump to the bottom of the screen.-Resolution-Go to Sales  Order work center.-Open certain sales order and go to the Items tab.-Go to Personalize on the UI.-Select This Screen.-Select Untitled Table section and line field.-Choose button Configure Sorting and Group By.-Here, you will see the current sorting option maintained (Line, Ascending)-Choose the back arrow to remove this column name and click OK.-Save the changes made to personalize.-From now the line items wont jump to the bottom.

Title: Display Scope Changes Button Doesnt Display any Changes Performed in the Scoping
Content: Symptom-During Scoping, when you select the Display Scope Changes button, there is no changes being displayed in the new pop.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view.-Select Edit Project Scope button.-From Step 3 onwards, select Display Scope Changes button-Cause-Display Scope Changes functionality shows the scoping changes for particular session. That means, if you modify the scoping options on that particular scoping screen at that point of time, those can be seen by selecting the"Display Scope Changes button.-Resolution-The system works as designed.-The Configuration Change History in the Report view is intended to display entire history of scope changes.

Title: The List Price is not Getting Updated Automatically While Creating a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The list price is not getting updated automatically while creating a sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Select New Sales Order under Common Tasks.-Enter the Account and Distribution Channel.-Select the Items tab.-Select Add Row to add new item.-The list price is not updated for the item.-You find the List Price not populate automatically.-Cause-Price List is not maintained for the distribution channel.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select New Customer Group Specific Price List -Maintain the Price List for relevant Distribution Channel.-Save all changes.

Title: The Delivery Block Obsoleted For the Service Order
Content: Symptom-You have set delivery block on Service Order, but the Service Order still gets released and the embedded item on Service Order get processed as well.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Order work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view.-Show All Orders then Search XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service order).-Select the Service Order XYZ and choose View All button.-Go to the General tab where a field named Execution Block has been set.-You have already set the option in Execution Block,this button means:With this field you are able to block or unblock the execution of the entire service order including the spare parts logistics. When blocked, it is not possible to create a Service Confirmation, to complete the Service Order or to release the delivery due items within Outbound Logistics Control.  But you noticed the delivery still get processed.-Cause-The Block does not impact the delivery of due items which have already been Released to logistics execution. For the Service Order XYZ, you have already released it first then set up the Block Execution.--Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign system.

Title: There is no Information Being Displayed for the Field Contact Person in the Adobe Livecycle Designer
Content: Symptom-There is no information being displayed for the field Contact Person in the adobe livecycle designer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance subview.-Show Active Forms and find form template Customer Invoice.-Open the form template with easy form editor or adobe livecycle designer.-You will see that the Contact Person field is showing as blank--Cause-Since the Customer Invoicing do not have a Contact Party field , it is not possible to provide the needed information in the invoice form template.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: The Customer Return Show an Error Message Reference Sales Order Missing, Though the Reference Sales Order is Already Maintained for the Return
Content: Symptom-The Customer Return show error message Reference Sales Order Missing, though the reference sales order is already maintained for the return.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Show All Returns and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the return).-Edit the return.-The following Error occurs : Reference Sales Order missing.-Cause-The return ABC is created for the sales order XYZ for which the delivery is not complete. The Outbound Delivery created for the sales order is still in the Not Released status.-Note:-ABC represents the ID of the customer return.-XYZ represents the ID of the reference sales order.-Resolution-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Delivery view.-Search for the delivery DEF (DEF represents the ID of the delivery created for the reference sales order).-Edit the delivery DEF.-Release the delivery DEF.-Cancel the return (Follow the case document 1589551 - How to Cancel a Customer Return).-Re-trigger the processing of customer return after the completion of the outbound delivery.-For creation of a consistent return it is required to complete the delivery process.

Title: The Invoice Date is Different on the Sales Volume Report and on the Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-The invoice date is different on the Sales Volume Report and on the Sales Order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Choose the Reports view.-Select the List subview.-Choose Sales Order Volume report.-Select the preferred parameter then choose Go.-You find the a different Invoice Date on report and sales order.- Cause-For the current release, the Invoice Date on Sales Volume report is inherited from the filed Posting Date on the Sales Order .-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: Dump While Canceling an Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-Dump while canceling an invoice document.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Select the Invoice Document XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the Invoice Request).-Click in the cancel button.-In the cancelation invoice screen press Save button.-Dump occurs.-Cause-It is possible to create and release an invoice without output mail address. There is no output document generated in the Output tab. However, when canceling this invoice, dump occurs due to the output e-mail address is not maintained for output.-Resolution-You can maintain the output mail address in the invoice Output Settings or maintain it in the account master data.-1. Maintain the mail address in Output Settings in the Cancellation Invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Select the Invoice Document XYZ. Since the invoice is released, you cannot edit the output settings any more.-Click Cancel button to create the new cancellation invoice.-In the cancellation invoice, click You Can Also -> Edit Output Settings.-In the E-Mail Settings table, add the mail address.-Click Save button to release the cancellation invoice. You will be able to cancel this invoice XYZ without dump.-2. Maintain the communication mail address in the account master data.-Open the Account master data.-Select the Edit Button and choose General.-Go to Main Communication section and fill the E-mail field.-Press save button.-Afterwards, cancel the invoice XYZ, the mail address maintained above will be automatically determined in the cancellation invoice as the output mail address. You will be able to cancel this invoice XYZ without dump.-

Title: The VAT Amount Calculated Differs in Two Customer Invoices Created for the Same Product and the Same Customer
Content: Symptom-The VAT amount calculated differs in two customer invoices created for the same product and the same customer.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Documents view.-Search for the Invoice documents ABC and DEF (ABC and DEF represents the ID of the Customer Invoices).-Open both the invoices and Click the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the Taxes subtab.-VAT calculated differs in both the invoices though both invoices are created for the same product and the same customer.-Under the VAT the Tax Base Amount also differs for both the invoices.-Cause-The difference in tax calculation occurred in the customer invoices because of the manually added Freight charges in the invoice ABC. You have manually added the Freight charges in the invoice ABC in Pricing tab. Freight is also included (whenever available) for the VAT/Tax calculation.--Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Unable to View Design Data Source View in the Business Analytics Work Center
Content: Symptom-The key user has assigned Business Analytics work center to your user. But you are unable view the Design Data Source view in the Business Analytics work center.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-You are not able to view Design Data Source view on the left side of the screen.-Cause-The Key User has not assigned the Design Data Source view to your user while doing assignment of Business Analytics work center to your user.-Resolution-Contact key user to use following steps to assign Design Data Source view to your user.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Search your username from the list.-Select the Edit-> Access Rights button.-Select the Business Analytics work center in the Available Work Centers section.-Tick mark the Design Data Source view option in the Available Views section.-Select the Save and Close button to complete the process.

Title: Error Occurs While creating a Sales Order "Mandatory Gross List Price missing for the Price Calculation"
Content: Symptom-An error occurs while creating a sales order: Mandatory Gross List Price missing for the Price Calculation.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Select New Sales Order and choose Price In Gross.-Add a line item in the sales order.-Error occurs: Mandatory Gross List Price missing for the Price Calculation.--Cause-You have not maintained the master data for Gross Price.-Resolution-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing (Gross) view then Price Lists (Gross)sub view.-Choose New-> Base Price List(Gross). Maintain all necessary information.-Save.

Title: Unbale to Maintain Translation for Jobs
Content: Symptom-You are not able to maintain the Job Description in multiple languages.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Select Implementation Projects view-Select Open Activity List and open-Search and open the activity Job Definitions-Select Manually enter job definitions--Cause-It is not possible to maintain Job Description in multiple languages.-Resolution-You can enter the Job Description in any language (text) and the same Description will be displayed for those Jobs regardless of Logon Language.

Title: When Adding a Service Product to a Contract the Following Error Occurs: "Quantity type code must be time"
Content: Symptom-When adding a service product to a contract the following error occurs: Quantity type code must be time.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Go to the Contracts View.-Created a New Contract.-Select account ID ABC in the General tab (ABC represents the ID of the customer account).-Go to the Items tab and select Add Row button.-Tick the option Price per period.-Add a service product XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service product).-Maintain a list price for the product. and select the Save button.-Go to Pricing and Invoicing tab -> Select the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Select the Add Item button and add the product XYZ.-The following error occurs:-Item 10 : Quantity type code must be time.-Cause-The Pricing Per Period indicator is disabled for quantity types such as Wday, however, it is enabled for types hour, day.-You can test the above suggestion by following below steps:-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Go to the Contracts View.-Created a New Contract.-Select account ID ABC in the General tab (ABC represents the ID of the customer account).-Go to the Items tab and select Add Row button.-Add a service product XYZ before ticking the option Price per period (XYZ represents the ID of the service product).-The Price per period is now disabled because it cannot be used for wday (as explained above).-Resolution-To solve the error either use the valid UoM (unit of measure) such as hour, day or create customized UoM's referring to hour, day etc.-Follow the steps below to create the customized UoM's:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find & open the activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select the link Create and Maintain Physical Units.-Maintain a customized unit (e. g. c-days) referring to the standard quantities such as hour or day.

Title: Extension Filed is Invisible at Preview of Outbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You have added an extension field at the item level of the Outbound Delivery screen in the Adaptation Mode. However,the filed is invisible on the Preview.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Delivery work center.-Go to the the Outbound Deliveries view.-Find the outbound delivery XYZ (XYZ represents ID of the outbound delivery).-Select the Edit button then choose the View All button.-Select the Items tab then choose Adapt, choose the option Enter Adaptation Mode.-Add field to item then choose the Save button.-Select the Preview button.-The extension you have added is invisible in the PDF form.-Cause-Extension field added on the item level will not be visible in the preview. Current application only supports fields added on the General tab to be visible on the form.-Resolution-This is an expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: The 'Net Value' Shown on Invoice Documents View is not Correct
Content: Symptom-The Net Value shown on Invoice Documents view is not correct.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-The amount shown in Net Value column is 110.479,97.-Edit the invoice ID ABC and go to the Items tab.-The Net Value shown in the Item tab is 110.480,00.-Hence the amount shown on the Invoice Documents view screen has a difference of 00.03.-Note: The amount shown 110.479,97. and 110.480,00 are examples to explain the system behavior.- Cause-Here the Net value shown on the initial screen of the Invoice Documents view does not consider rounding, however if you open the invoice in Edit mode or Preview the invoice then rounding will be considered.-Resolution-In the current release of the product this issue cannot be fixed as it will have a huge performance impact on the invoice. We will consider improvement of this feature in future release.

Title: A Sales Order Used as Defaulted Background Image in SAP Business ByDesign System and you want to Clear it off
Content: Symptom-You notice that a Sales Order used as default background image in SAP Business ByDesign system and you want to clear it off.-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the SAP Business ByDesign system.-You find a Sales Order appears as background image of the system.-Cause-Because you have set this sales order as default background in the system.-Resolution-Log in to the SAP business ByDesign system and Choose Personalize.-Then choose My Background Image.-Clear the current background image then choose OK.

Title: Customer Information is Missing on the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created Sales Order with multiple Invoice Requests combining to one Customer Invoice. You find the Customer Information does not inherited in the Customer Invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Choose Show All Documents then Find XYZ(XYZ represents the Invoice Request ID).-Select View All button then go to the General tab.-You find the Customer Information contained at previous sales order does not inherit.-Cause-When multiple invoice requests are combined in to one invoice,the customer information on the header level is copied in to corresponding invoice item.-In this case, invoice is created by combining service confirmation and outbound delivery. For outbound delivery there is no customer information maintained and hence in the customer invoice we can not find any Customer Information inherited.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Customer Information on relevant Outbound Delivery.

Title: The User is Not Able to Assign Reports to Work Center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Even though the customer´s user has the key user role profile assigned, the user is not able to assign reports. The Assign button appears grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center-Select any report-The Assign Button appears grayed out-Cause- Only the Analytical Key User can assign Reports. If the user is assigned to one of the Partner Development Work Center, by consequence his role becomes as Partner Developer (PDI Developer). In this case, it is not allowed to assign any report to a Work Center.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management-Go to Business User View-Filter by the technical user desired-Click on Edit | Access Rights-Uncheck the "Assigned to User" box for the following Work Centers:- Partner Development (ID: PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT)- Development (ID:MAI_DEVELOPMENT)-Save it-Log out the system- Additionally, the Assign button can remains disabled if, for any other reason the user still persists listed in the table PDI_DEVELOPER. If the steps above do not solve the issue, then try to check the table entries in order to delete manually the user maintained into PDI table.

Title: You Find Abbreviated Address for the Ship-To party While Creating a Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You find the abbreviated address shown in Ship-To while creating sales order, however, you want the complete address (same as the one maintained in account master data) in value help for Ship-To party.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Select the New Sales Order from Common Tasks.-In the new sales order screen, choose any relevant account from drop down list.-Select the value help for Ship-To field,you find the address is abbreviated, not as in account master data.-Cause-The system is designed to show the abbreviated address for the Ship-to party field of sales order.-Resolution-The solution to this issue is under investigation.-See Also-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: The Form Preview of the Customer Invoice Uses the Header and Footer of the Master Template
Content: Symptom-The form preview of the customer invoice uses the Header and Footer of the Master Form Template, however you expect them from the Form Template you have maintained in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Edit the customer invoice XYZ and select the Preview button.-The form preview picks the Header & the Footer from the Master Form Template, not from the Form Template maintained by you.-Cause-Since for Customer Invoice form template has the property set Master Template In Use, it will take the Default Master Template.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management Work center.-Go to the Business Flexibility view.-Go to the Form Template Maintenance subview.-Select the form template Customer Invoice.-Uncheck the field Form Master Template - Not in Use, which you can find under the Details section.-With this setting the Customer Invoice form template will not pick the format of the Master Form Template.

Title: No Document Flow Generate for the Sales Order Inovice Request.
Content: Symptom-You find there is no document flow for the Sales Order Invoice Request.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Customer Invoice Request view.-Find the relevant Sales Order Invoice Request.-Press the Edit button then choose View All.-Select the Document Flow tab.-You find only one document displayed i.e.. reference sales order invoice request.-Cause-The system is working as designed.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior for Sales Order Invoice Request, however you will be able to view the related documents in other invoice request type like Outbound Delivery Invoice Request.

Title: The Account Name is not Editable in the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The account name is not editable in the sales order.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order ABC.-The account name is not editable though the sales order is in In Preparation status.-Cause-The sales order has been created via A2X. For orders created via A2A/B2b/A2X, account will not be changeable on UI, it can be changed only via relevant messages before any follow-up document gets created. This order is created via Internet hence the account is not editable.-Resolution-You can send an additional XML message to Business ByDesign system to change/update the account.

Title: On Editing of the Return Error Message "Item XX:Only one business partner of role Sales Unit permitted" and "Item XX:Mandatory List Price missing" are Triggered
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers.
