Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-On editing of the Return error message : "Item XX:Only one business partner of role Sales Unit permitted" and "Item XX:Mandatory List Price missing" are triggered.-XX represents the item line number.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Search for the Return ABC (where ABC represents the Return name).-Select the Return ABC and click on the Edit button.-Error message : "Item XX: Only one business partner of role Sales Unit permitted" and "Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing" are triggered.--Cause-Error 1: Item XX:Only one business partner of role Sales Unit permitted-The cause for the error message is ,Return got saved with inconsistency.-Error 2:Item XX:Mandatory List Price missing.-Return is allowed to be processed without any List Price value,however Price Component as List Price should be maintained.-Resolution-For Error 1: You have to make the dummy changes in the Return ABC.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view .-In the Show field from drop-down select All Return and in the Find field enter Return ABC and click on the Go button.-Select the Return ABC and click on the Edit button .-Go to the Involved Parties tab and select the Party Role as Sales Unit.-Click on the Remove button to make the dummy changes.-Now click on the Add Row button and maintained the same Sales Unit as earlier.-For Error 2: You need to maintain the Price Component as List Price.-Go to the Pricing tab and select the Line Product ID.-Click on the Add Row and include Price Component as List Price .-Click on the Save button .-Now you can see both the error has gone and Return ABC become consistent for further processing.-

Title: Error Occurs While Trying to Preview the Price List: "Error during backend processing"
Content: Symptom-Error occurs while trying to Preview the Price List: Error during backend processing.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-Select the Price Lists subview.-Show Distribution Chain Price List and choose the Go button.-Select the Discount List XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the discount list).-Click the Edit button.-Select the Preview button.-Error occurs stating Error During Backend Processing. -Cause-The PDF has a size restriction of 1000 pages, SAP Business ByDesign print 25 items per page.-In your case the above limit has exceeded, which has caused the error in PDF server during the processing of your Preview request.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign. We are considering to increase the limit of items in the PDF for future releases.

Title: Scoping of Web Service Message Monitoring Option in ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This document explains how to scope Web Service Message Monitoring option-Cause-In order to view the option Web Service Message monitoring workcenter view under Application and User Management workcenter -Resolution-Steps to Scope :-1) Go to "Implementation Projects" view in "Business Configuration" work center.-2) Edit Project Scope.-3) Navigate to "Questions" tab.-4) Expand "Communication and Information Exchange".-5) Under that, expand "Business Process Management".-6) Click "Process-Integrated Input and Output Management".-7) Select both the options under the Group : Web Service Message Monitoring-a) Do you want to use the Web Service Message Monitor.-b) Do you want to enable the display of a message payload

Title: Excel Based Report Takes Too Long to Open
Content: Symptom-You are working with an excel based report, however, when the report is opened, it takes too long to load.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics workcenter.-Search for the required excel based report and open it.-Here, report takes about 7 to 10 minutes to load.-Cause-The root cause for the long loading times is the fact that this particular Excel-based report (i.e. Excel workbook) is quite large. A normal size would be between 80 KB and 500 KB.-Although a workbook of around 5 MB may not be very big, downloading the file from the database to the system can trigger a lot of memory allocation operations on the server side.--Resolution-To fix this issue, it is recommended to reduce the size of the work book either by setting the filters on the variable selection or by making certain fields as mandatory in the report.-This will improve the performance of the report immensely.-See Also-2143214 - Error When Opening Excel Workbook

Title: Intercompany Project Scenario: The Automatically Created Sales Order is not Released Automatically by the System.
Content: Symptom-In an Intercompany Project Scenario the created sales order is not released automatically by the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the Projects view.-Open Project XYZ(XYZ represents the number of the project).-Go to the Products and Purchasing -> Product Overview tab.-Select the product ABC (ABC represents the number of the service).-Select Create Purchase Request -> For Released Project Tasks.-Press the Finish button.-Press the Save button in the project.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view. -Search for the newly created sales order EFG (EFG represents the number of the sales order).-You can see that sales order EFG has not been released automatically by the system.-Open the sales order.-The following warning is displayed:-Item 10: Customer expected net value XXX USD differs from item net value YYY USD (XXX represents the net value of the purchase order and YYY represents the net value of the sales order).-Cause-This is the expected system behaviour.-If the difference between the customer expected price in the purchase order and the net value in sales order is greater than 1% the automatic release is not allowed by the system.-Unfortunately there is no scoping option to configure the automatic release in any other way available in the system.-Resolution-If there is a difference between the customer expected price from the purchase order and the net value in sales order which is greater than 1% you will have to release the sales order manually.

Title: Profit Margin Field is not Available in the Sales Order Query Screen
Content: Symptom-Profit margin field is not available in the sales order query screen.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders.-The Profit Margin field is not displayed here.-Select Adapt -> Enter Adaptation Mode -> Edit Screen.-Also there is no option to add this field via screen adaptation.-Cause-In this sales order query screen only the most important information related to the business document is captured, and the feature of having the adapted-field is not provided in the screen, this is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign.--Resolution-Follow the steps below to view the Profit Margin filed in the sales order:-Go to the Sales Order workcenter.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find the sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order XYZ.-Select Adapt -> Enter Adaptation Mode -> Edit Screen.-Select the Items under Screen Layout.-Check the Profit Margin.-Save and Publish your changes.-Now the Profit Margin field will be available under Items section when you open any sales order.-Alternatively select the View All button of the sales order and go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Here the Profit Margin information is available in the Total Pricing section.

Title: Error Message "You are not authorized to execute report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee)" while accessing Overview view of Sales Order work centre.
Content: Symptom-When accessing the Overview view in the Sales Order work centre, the following error message is displayed:-You are not authorized to execute report "Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee)".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select the Overview view.-The error "You are not authorized to execute report "Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee)" is triggered- Cause-The issue occurs because the Sales Targets business topic is not scoped in the system. As a result, the required report Sales Targets for Incoming Orders (Employee) is not available for execution.-Resolution-Scope the Sales Targets business topic under the Sales business area by following the steps below:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Navigate to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the relevant implementation project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the Scoping step.-Expand the Sales business area.-Expand the Sales Planning business topic.-Select the Sales Targets checkbox.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Expand the Sales business area and then Sales Planning.-Select the Sales Targets business topic.-Select the following question:-Do you want to measure actual order values based on incoming sales orders?-Click Next, and then select Finish Scoping.-After completing the scoping process, access to the Overview view in the Sales Order work center should no longer result in the authorization error.-Keywords-Sales order; Scoping; Overview; Sales target; Employee access; Implementation project

Title: KPI Tile Does Not Show Red Color
Content: Symptom-You are creating a KPI in Business Analytics work center with pattern of colors and the direction of improvement as maximize.-However, after changing many values you still are not able to see the red color in the KPI tile, which is supposed to show you the alert value.-Cause-The KPI is not showing the red tile because your “Current Value” might be far away above your Alert or warning values.-Resolution-This KPI will get the information you have set up in the “KPI Values and thresholds” tab, and calculate it based in your “Current Value”, which is your financial worth. If your current value is too far above, you will not be able to see any red color in the tile.--This is a designed behavior of our platform. Please maintain this values accordingly and the system will be calculated correct, hence the color tiles will show the colors correctly.- See Also-As way of testing this, you will be able to check the red color if you make the "warning value" higher or very close to the "Current Value".

Title: How to Check the Creator and the Creation Date of a Business Document in the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You need to check who is the creator n or the creation date of a business document in a customer system.-Resolution-go to the system backend-transaction SESFTS-load the BO of the business document, e.g. SALES_ORDER-query the BO by document ID-on the attribute list, search for attribute 'Created On'-The Attribute Value is the creation date of the business document-expand the BO Node Instance-find and expand the association 'CreationIdentity'-the Node Instance is the user id of the creation person.-

Title: How to Hide the Financial Tab in the Account Overview Screen for a Sales Employee
Content: Symptom-How to hide the Financial tab in the account overview screen for a sales employee.-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP ByDesign system as a sales employee.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find ABC (ABC represents the account ID).-Select the account ID and open the overview screen (or Account Factsheet screen).-The Financial tab is accessible for the user which should not be there for a sales employee.-The financial tab in the account overview screen displays invoicing, credit balance and open items details which should not be visible to sales employeed.-Cause-The Financial tab is only available to the users if it is allowed via scoping in Business Configuration work center.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and choose Edit Project Scope button.-Go to the Step 4 Questions.-Select Sales -> Account and Activity Management -> Account Management.-Expand the section Overviews for Account Management.-Select No for the question : Do you want to restrict the display of documents in the account, contact,partner and competitor overview?-Finish the steps of scoping.-Now the users can only view the Financial tab in the account overview or factsheet if they are assigned to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Logic behind hiding the Financial tab in the account overview screen only:-The Financial tab of the account overview screen shows important invoicing and financial details like Invoices and Credit Memos, Account Balance and Open Items.-These information are not shown on the Financial Data tab if we do a View All in the account.

Title: Error in Tax Calculation in the Sales Order Created for an Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-Error in tax calculation in the sales order created for an intercompany scenario.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Error messages:-Exchange rate missing for currency conversion.-Tax calculation failed; trigger a calculation again.-Warning messages:-Tax calculated for country DEF in which company GHI is not registered (DEF represents the tax country and GHI represents the company).-Customer expected net value XXX differs from item net value YYY (XXX & YYY represent the net values).-City in address of Account party missing.-Cause-Following is the reason for the error messages in the sales order:-You had created the sales order before maintaining the currency conversion in General Ledger work center, which is not updated in the sales order.-Following is the reason for the warning messages in the sales order:-Tax Authority and associated Company Tax Arrangement for the tax country is not maintained in the Tax Management work center.-Account master data has not been maintained properly. Data like City and Tax Number are missing for the customer account.--Resolution-Follow the steps below to solve the error message:-Go to the Sales Orders work center,-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select the View All button.-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Select the Total Pricing subview.-Select the Update Pricing -> Completely (If no manual price component is added) else select Update Pricing -> Keep Manual Changes.-Save the order.-Now tax calculation is triggered and the sales order is saved without any error message.-Follow the steps below to solve the warning messages on the sales order:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authorities view.-Create a tax authority for the tax country and create associated Company Tax Arrangement.-Now go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find DEF (DEF represents the ID of the account used in the sales order).-Edit the account and select the View All tab.-Go to the Financial Data tab -> select the Tax Data subtab -> Maintain Tax Number for the country.-Also maintain address details like City, Postal Code, State, Country etc. in the General tab.-See Also-Error message is triggered from class CM_APTC_TAX_CALCULATOR.APBTC_COMMON_701.

Title: No Dropdown List Avaliable on Reason for Status Field While Rejecting Lead
Content: Symptom-You find no dropdown list available on Reason for Status field while rejecting lead.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Leads view.-Select the relevant lead.-Choose the Reject button.-In the pop-up Set reason for Status select the drop-down list, you find no entry is available.-Cause-You did not include you can create leads in marketing and hand them over to sales into scope.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Project Implementation view then select the relevant project.-Choose the Edit Project scope button.-Go to step 4 Question->Show All Elements->Sales->New Business->Lead Management.-Select the checkbox for the question You can create leads in marketing and hand them over to sales.-Choose the Next button to Finish the scope.

Title: The Cancellation Status of a Contact Item is Cancellation Requested Instead of Canceled
Content: Symptom-You have set the Cancellation Reason in the contract item details, however the Cancellation Status is Cancellation Requested instead of Canceled.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open the respective contract and navigate to the Items tab.-Select the respective line item.-In the Cancellation part, you can see the Cancellation Reason has been selected. However, the cancellation status is Cancellation Requested.-You expect the cancellation status should be Canceled.-Cause-The item Contract Start/End range is not within the contract general range.-For example: On the header level (General tab), the Contract Start/End date is 31.03.2013-31.12.2999 , however on item level (Items tab) the line items Start/End date is 30.09.2009 - 31.12.2099.-Resolution-The items date range should always be within header date range. You have to change the Contract Start/End date in header in order to make sure that the item date range lie within header range.-See Also-1836112 - You are not Able to Cancel a Customer Contract-1753199 - You have select "Cancel Pending Invoice requests" for your Contract's Items But the Invoice Request are not Canceled

Title: Cannot Complete the Customer Return
Content: Symptom-You are not able to complete the customer return.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view-Show All Returns and Find ABC (ABC represents the return ID).-The status of the return is still In Process.-Edit the return and go to the Document Flow tab.-The credit memo, payment, and clearing documents are already created for the return.-Cause-The return is not completed because the inbound delivery status is still Not started.-Resolution-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Task Control view.-Search for the corresponding task using Advance Search.-Select the Reference Type as Sales Order and Reference ID DEF (DEF is the reference ID of the return).-Select Go button.-Choose the task line and then select Confirm -> Enter actual quantity.-Select the Save and Close button.-The above steps will change the status of the return to Completed.

Title: Wrong Tax Jurisdiction Code has Been Selected in the Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-Wrong tax jurisdiction code has been selected in the customer invoice.-Reproducing the Issue-Follow the steps below to reproduce the issue:-Go to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Documents and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Click the Edit buttin of the selected Invoice.-Click on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab and select the Taxes subtab.-The tax jurisdiction code DEF is picked instead of ABC (ABC & DEF represents the tax jurisdiction codes).-Cause-You have maintained a CompanyTaxArrangement for jurisdiction code ABC recently, however, you have previously maintained the DEF jurisdiction code. For this reason a TaxNumber for DEF was found & the TaxCode was defaulted to XXX.-Note:-ABC represents the the current jurisdiction code maintained in the CompanyTaxArrangement.-DEF represents the older jurisdiction code maintained in the CompanyTaxArrangement.-XXX represents the tax number for the jurisdiction code ABC.-You can check the creation & change of the Tax Arrangement by following below steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authority view.-Search for the jurisdiction code ABC.-Select the Company Tax Arrangement under the tax authority ABC.-You can find that the Tax Arrangement creation & change date here.---Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign, the system is picking the tax jursdiction code & the tax number as per the company tax arrangement maintained.

Title: Creating a New Customer Group Specific Price List Trigger the error message :"Record cannot be found by price calculation;key does not fit to BC"
Content: Symptom-Creating a New Customer Group Specific Price List trigger the error message : Record cannot be found by price calculation;key does not fit to BC.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Pricing view.-In the Show field from drop-down select Customer Group Specific Price List and click on the Go button.-Select New -> Customer Group Specific Price List and enter mandatory field such as the Name,Customer Group and Valid From/To .-For the field Distribution Channel from drop-down select Direct Sales /Indirect Sales-Select Save.-The following error message is triggered  : Record cannot be found by price calculation;key does not fit to BC-Cause-When creating a New Customer Group Specific Price List the following combination are supported :-Maintaining only the Customer Group.-Maintaining the Customer Group and Sales Organization ID.-Maintaining the Customer Group, Sales Organization ID and the Distribution Channel.-If you maintain the Customer Group and the Distribution Channel without the Sales Organization ID an error will occur.-Resolution-1. Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-2. Go to the Pricing view .-3. In the Show field from drop-down select Customer Group Specific Price List and click on the Go button.-4. Select New -> Customer Group Specific Price List and enter value for field Name,and Valid From/To .-4.1) For the field Customer Group from drop-down select any option and further Save and Release the Price List.-4. 2. i) For the field Customer Group from drop-down select any option and for field Sales Organization ID from value help select the value.-4. 2. ii)Click on the Save and further Release button to release the Price List.-4. 3. i) For field the Customer Group from drop-down select any option and for the field Sales Organization ID from value help select the require value.-4. 3. ii)For the field Distribution Channel from drop-down select Direct Sales/Indirect Sales.-4. 3. iii)Now click on the Save and Release the Price List.

Title: The 'Unit of Measure' of an Adapted Quantity Field is not Shown in Local Language
Content: Symptom-The Unit of Measure (UoM) of an adapted Quantity field is not shown in local language.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Choose the Show All option.-Search for the Sales Order ID XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Click on the Edit button.-Click the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-The UoM for the adapted field created for Quantity is shown is the local language (e.g. German) as per the Business Configuration setting for the UoM.-Select the Preview button.-In the PDF form the UoM for the adapted field is shown in English instead of local language.-Note: This case is also valid for all the other business documents like Sales Quotes, Customer Invoice, Purchase Orders etc.-Cause-Current release of the SAP Business ByDesign do not support the display of UoM description in the local language for the extension fields.--Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign, however we are considering to improve this behavior for future releases.

Title: You Cannot Change The Output Settings For a Business Document After It is Released
Content: Symptom-You have a business document(For example- Customer Invoice) which is in status Released. You want to change the Output Settings for the document. But when you click the Edit Output Settings link it’s grayed out.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Show: All Invoice Documents-Search for the relevant Customer Invoice.-Click the Edit button.-Click the You can Also button.-You see that the Edit Output Settings link is grayed out.-Cause-This is the correct system behavior. Users can change the Output Settings for business documents only before the document is submitted for process-integrated output. That means you cannot change the Output Settings once the document is released.-Resolution-If you want to edit the Output Settings of a Released Document, first you have to cancel the Invoice document.-After you have cancelled the document, you can edit the Edit Output Setting under the Invoice Request, under the Invoice Requests view, before you invoice it.

Title: How to Change the Language of the Automated Key User Service Report
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to change the language of the automated Key User Service Report that you receive via email from the Cloud Customer Care Team.   -Resolution-The Key User Service Report language settings are set on the IT contact from the Service Control Center.-You can change such settings as following:-Go to Service Control Center work center and choose Contact Details view.-Identify the IT Contact and select Edit.-Set the desired language for the Correspondence language field.

Title: File Input Job does not Show Any Detailed Summary After Job Execution
Content: Symptom-File input job does not show any detailed summary after job execution.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Select File Input view.-Select All Runs in the field show and Find XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the job run).-Select the run ID XYZ.-Go to the Execution Details sub-tab under section Details.-You can see the Application Log XXX generated with no errors and warnings (XXX represents the ID of the application log).-You expect a detailed job summary here.-Cause-In the current release of SAP Business ByDesign, the feature for detailed summary of Job Run of File Input is not provided.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of SAP Business ByDesign, however, we are considering to implement the requested feature in one of the future releases.

Title: Error Messages Appear on the User Interface While Creating Opportunities With the Service Products of Type "Travel and Expenses"
Content: Symptom-Error messages appear on the user interface while creating opportunities with the service products of type Travel and Expenses:-Service and item type do not correspond. Please make sure that you did not define any service in your service master data with an item type group for expenses or vice versa.-Service with expense indicators is not eligible.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Go to the Opportunity view and select the Opportunity List subview.-Search for the opportunity XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the opportunity).-Click the Edit button of the Opportunity and clcik on the View All button.-Go to the Items tab.-Error messages appear on the user interface:-Service product and item type code do not match. Check your service master data to ensure that you have not defined a service product with an item category group for expenses, or vice versa.-Service product with expense indicator not allowed.-Go to the Sales Activities tab and check your open activities.-Cause-Opportunities would basically include the items which are meant for sales and also used incase of forecasting. Hence it would not make proper use case to include an expense type of an item in the opportunity. Ideally expense type of projects are used during the billing hence it-is supported in Sales Quote and Sales Order.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Cannot Set a Country as Default in the Field Tax Country for All Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-You are not able to set a country as default in the field Tax Country for all sales orders.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order under common task.-Select View All button.-Select the Items tab.-Select the Taxes sub-tab-The tax country should always be ABC (ABC represents the country ID).-Cause-You cannot set country ABC by default as tax country.-The determination of Tax code and country depends upon the parties selected in the sales order (i.e. Seller and Ship-to) and the Tax Authorities maintained.--Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.

Title: Even Though You Have Uploaded a Customer Specific Price List into the System , the Price List is Missing
Content: Symptom-Even though you have uploaded a Customer Specific Price List into the system, you are not able to find this price list.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Price Lists view.-Show Customer Specific Price List, you cannot see the desired price list.-Cause-The default price lists in the Show list are filtered, you have to open the Advanced search and check the search options.-Resolution-To find more price lists, you can follow the steps below:-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to the Price Lists view.-Show Customer Specific Price List.-Click Advance and open the search details. You can see the default search option.-Change the Valid From and Valid To to expend the time range.-Please note that the default Release Status is empty, this only will search for the not canceled price lists. You also can try to choose Release Canceled status to find more price lists.

Title: The Sales History Report Does not Display All Sales Orders Created for the Customer Account
Content: Symptom-The Sales History Report does not display all sales orders created for the customer account.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find ABC (ABC represents the ID of the account).-Open the Account Overview of ID ABC.-Go to the Sales tab.-The Sales Order Report displays the data of the sales order created.-However, the Sales History Report does not show any sales order.-Cause-Sales History Report in the Account UI is not for sales order history data, hence, you cannot compare this with the Sales Order Volume Report. This Report is for displaying the Pricing History of the sales document.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior of the SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Error During Check in: Query While Activating the Add-On Solution
Content: Symptom-You are getting below errors when you try to Activate/Check/Assemble the solution in SDK-Error During Check in: Query-Runtime objects are not up to date. Please activate the item XYZ-SelectAll.qry, where XYZ is the query file path-There is an error in query XYZ-SelectAll.qry.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SDK-Open the relevant Solution and File path-Right click and select Check-Error appears-or-Right click on the solution-Check-> All Items and Runtime Objects-Error appears-or-JSON communication error.HHTP response code: 504(Gateway Time-out)-Cause-This error is due to the naming convention of the query file. The query file is created with the name SelectAll. Select All is a standard query and is not supposed to use in custom developments as a new file.-Note: This is the scenario with all the standard actions, events or queries. The names are reserved for standard use or reuse as it is.-Resolution-You need to follow the below steps to resolve this issue:--First you should remove all the references where the query file is being used in the solution.-Delete the query file.-Activate the BO.-Re-create query file with different name other than the standard query names.-Keywords-Error in query;wrong naming convention;inactive query;referenced query;JSON communication error;HHTP response code: 504(Gateway Time-out)-query error,query/view is not active,dump due to query

Title: Payment Method Wire Transfer is Not Available for Customer Master Data
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find Payment Method Wire Transfer in the Customer Master Data. Or, when you are processing Migration of Customers, the system reports an error 'Payment Method not valid: Wire Transfer'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customers view.-Show All Customers and search ABC(ABC represents the Customer ID).-Click on Edit and select Financial Data.-Open the value hlep of Payment Method, you are unable to find Wire Transfer.-Or-Go to Business Configuartion work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open Migration of Customers activity.-Click on Migrate customers using the migration tool.-Execute migration and you see an error 'Payment Method not valid: Wire Transfer'.-Cause-Payment method Wire Transfer is available only for Supplier and not for Customer master data.-Only when the account is a mixed account (Customer+Supplier), payment method Wire Transfer is available in Customer master data.-Resolution-System works as designed.-See Also-2745521 - Payment Method Wire Transfer is Not shown in Value Help in Customer Account Master Data-Outgoing Wire Transfers (Real Time Bank Transfers) — Configuration Guide | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Customer, Payement Method, Wire Transfer

Title: Error in Goods Receipt: Exchange rate missing for currency conversion
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the exchange rate conversion , but still " exchange rate missing" error is coming in goods and services receipt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center-Under Common Tasks-> select Edit Exchange Rates-Maintain the exchange rate between the respective currencies.-Now go to Goods and Services Receipt work center-Open the respective Goods Receipt document.-Select Check-You can see the error: Exchange rate X/Y on dd.mm.yyyy missing for currency conversion (X and Y refers to currency and dd.mm.yyyy refers to date)-Cause-The exchange rate is maintained after the Goods receipt document creation.-The current posting date in the Goods receipt is generating error because it is getting validated through the exchange rate creation date.-Resolution-Please change posting date in goods receipt to some other date and select check and again reset back to original date and check. Then it will get validated through the effective date.

Title: Application Runtime Exception, Please Report An Incident - Actual Cost Release Run Error
Content: Symptom-You execute a Actual Cost Release run: It finishes with the error "Application runtime exception, please report an incident".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center and the Actual Cost Release view.-Open the application log of the affected run.-In the Messages tab the error "Application runtime exception, please report an incident" is displayed. -Cause-For one or more materials processed by this release run a zero actual cost was calculated. As there is no meaning to release a zero actual cost the run ends with the error.-A zero actual cost is always caused by total zero inventory amount with series of inventory transactions and cancellations. For example, when all inbound and outbound delivery transactions are all canceled in the same period.-The Actual Costing Release run can't set a value for an inventory that is negative or zero.--You can see which materials will cause a dump during the run by checking the Material Inventories - Balance Summary or Material Inventories - Balance History report to identify the inventory levels for the selected range of the Actual Costing Release run.-Resolution-We plan to improve the error message for this scenario to point toward the Materials with a current zero Actual Cost.-For now, and until further notice, if this error appears-Check the actual cost of all materials in the Material Actual Costing view of the Inventory Valuation work center.-Create a new Actual Cost Release run but exclude all the materials with a zero actual cost. -Keywords-Actual Cost Release; 实际成本发布；应用程序运行时异常, Price reference quantity must be greater than zero

Title: Delta Migration of Purchasing Notes in Materials Does Not Update in The System
Content: Symptom-You are unable to update Purchasing Notes for a material via Material Migration with the option Enhance already existing records.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Materials.-Click Migrate materials using the migration tool.-Select Upload.-Select Data from Migration Template.-Select File.-Select the file with the modification of the purchasing notes.-Choose Upload.-Select the file uploaded.-Select Properties.-In the Migration Mode dropdown, select the Enhance already existing records option.-Select Save.-After performing all the migration steps the purchasing notes are not updated in the system.-Cause-It is not possible to add or enhance Purchasing Notes through Migration for the existing Materials or using the Mass Data Maintenance tool, as this is currently a system behavior.-Resolution-It is possible to add Purchasing Notes when you are adding new materials using the migration of materials tool, however the modification or enhancement of purchasing notes for existing materials needs to be performed manually in SAP Business ByDesign systems.-Keywords-Migration of Materials, Purchasing Notes, Mass data maintenance, Enhance already existing records, byd

Title: Purchase Order Status is Finished before Invoice is Posted
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice with respect to a purchase order but have not posted the invoice yet. However, the purchase order status is already showing Finished.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-You can see the invoice status is in exception or in process-Now go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-Search for the relevant Purchase Order-Status is Finished-Cause-The supplier invoice is created for the total quantity and amount, hence the order status got changed to Finished.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior, the order status will change to Finished as soon as invoice gets created for the complete quantity and amount.-You can use the standard report : "Purchase Order History" where you have many fields like purchase order item and for each item you can add fields like document id , document type which displays relevant  delivery , invoice for each line item and document status which shows the status of delivery or invoice for that particular PO item.-Keywords-purchase order status, supplier invoice, purchase order history

Title: How to Correct Inconsistent Bank Account Balances for Previous Fiscal Years
Content: Symptom-After having processed bank statements for the current fiscal year, you notice that you are left with an inconsistent bank account balance for bank account XYZ for the previous fiscal year. A correction via application or repeating an initial migration appears difficult since numerous subsequent bank statements have been posted and processed. Reversing all subsequent statements therefore is not a viable option.-XYZ stands for Bank Account ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Navigate to the Bank Statements view.-Select all bank statements for a unique Bank Account ID.-Compare the Closing Balance of the last statement in the previous fiscal year with the Opening Balance of the first statement in the current year.-Cause-When uploading the first statement for bank account XYZ in the new fiscal year, the statement has been posted. However, the user has been presented with a warning message indicating a possible inconsistency relating to a gap between Closing Balance and Opening Balance of subsequent statements reading:-"Opening balance ABC does not match closing balance DEF of last bank statement in the previous year. Check whether a bank statement is missing." This warning, however, has been ignored.-ABC stands for the Opening Balance of bank statement created in the new year.-DEF stands for the Closing Balance of bank statement created in the previous year.-Resolution-Given the essential rule that bank statements must be continuously numbered and the opening balance has to equal the closing balance of a preceding statement for bank account XYZ, two options lend themselves for consideration.-Manual creation of a consistent, additional bank statement for the previous fiscal year including the items representing the difference. In case several accounts are affected, those corrections have to balance between the accounts. In the resulting payment allocation, this transaction has to be processed in accordance with the original posting intention (e.g. posting against G/L account).-Example:-Statement ID 0, originating from the migration of bank account balances has a Statement Date 31.12.2012. Its Closing Balance is 1.000,00 EUR. Statement ID 1 in the next year shows an Opening Balance of 1.500,00 EUR. Manually create an additional statement with a Statement Date 31.12.2012 with an Opening Balance of 1.000,00 EUR and a credit transaction which renders its Closing Balance 1.500,00 EUR. This statement will assume the Statement ID 1 in 2012.-Rectify the imbalance by posting Journal Entry Vouchers against the affected G/L accounts. This however leaves an imbalance between bank account balance and G/L bank account balance.-Keywords-bank statement; opening balance; closing balance

Title: Unable To Activate The New Asset Valuation View in Set Of Books
Content: Symptom-You have created a new Asset Valuation View and assigned to multiple Set of Books. Now you can see the status of the new Asset Valuation View is 3 - Partially Active and you expect the status should be 1 - Active.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click Overview and search for the activity - Fixed Asset Valuation View.-Select the new Valuation View and click Assignment to Accounting Principle.-Select the Set of Books and click Save.-Now, search for the fine tune activity - Set of Books.-Select the Set of Books and click Edit.-Go to Fixed Asset Settings tab.-Under Company Details, you see the Asset Valuation View Status is 3 - Partially Active.-You expect the status 1 - Active.-Cause-Once the fixed asset is with status capitalized or Retired, system shows the status as 3 - Partially Active. This status cannot be change to 1- Active, neither from the UI nor in the backend. If there are no postings with respect to the Fixed Assets, the status is set to 1- Active.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also- Configuration: Fixed Assets Valuation Views-Keywords-Set of Books - Asset Valuation View Status, Unable to add new Asset Valuation view, activate, add

Title: In Report "Inventory Balance", Information Triggered: No report data available to display; check the selection.
Content: Symptom-In standard report "Inventory Balance" (SCMINBU03_Q0001), search a product in a site (or a logistics area) with a specific "Actual Execution On (Date)", information triggered: "No report data available to display; check the selection". Nothing displayed in the result.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Reports.-Search Inventory Balance (or SCMINBU03_Q0001), click Edit With Web Browser.-Select a period for Actual Execution On (Date), ABC (represents product ID) for Product, maintain value for selection Site (or Logistics Area), remove value for all other selections, click Apply, information triggered:-         No report data available to display; check the selection-Cause-During this period, product ABC has zero inventory in this site (or logistics area) and no inventory change happened, hence system won't display anything in the result. You can validate this via checking in another standard report "Confirmation Journal".-Resolution-If you hope this report can display zero for all key figures (Opening Qty, Increasing Qty, Decreasing Qty and Ending Qty) of a product when its inventory is zero and nothing changed towards its inventory during a specific period, this will be a new requirement.-We recommend you to post your query in SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence Forum https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 so that our development can look into it. Please note you may search it firstly and if it is not found, please register your requirement for this new feature.-Other customers can then vote for it, which will assert its legitimacy as a standard feature by showing the industry need and in turn influence the implementation schedule of the requirement.-Keywords-Inventory Balance, No Report Data, Selection

Title: Bank Statement Posting Failed "must match closing balance of the previous bank statement"
Content: Symptom-When posting a bank statement the following error message appears -ID ABC: Opening balance X must match closing balance of the previous bank statement Y. (ABC represents the Statemen ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Bank Statements.-Select the dropdown: All Bank Statements.-Select the Advance Filter.-Enter Bank Account ID: 123 (123 represents the Bank Account ID).-Select Statement ID ABC (This is the Bank Statement that you are trying to post).-Select View All-Select Next until Step 5 Review-Error : -ID ABC: Opening balance X must match closing balance of the previous bank statement Y.-Cause-The error messages received while posting bank statements is correct.-The opening balance of a bank statement must match the closing balance of the previous bank statement. You need to check the balances with your bank to provide the correct values in the file.-Resolution-When posting a Bank Statement there is a field titled Validity Year.-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Select the view Bank Statements.-Select the dropdown: All Bank Statements.-Select the Bank Statement that you are trying to post.-Select View All.-Check the Validity Year-Now look at the last Bank statement posted for that Year. Check the closing balance of that statement. This closing balance should match the opening balance of the new Statement.- Keywords-Bank Statement, Opening Balance, Closing Balance, must match

Title: Unable to Create E-Invoice Due to Free Text Item used in Customer Invoice.
Content: Symptom-While using a Free Text Item in customer invoice and the system is unable to determine whether the item is Product or a Service.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search and edit Invoice ABC (ABC represents the ID of Invoice document).-Navigate to Items tab.-The HSN code is already assigned to JSON structure for line item XX (XX is line item number).-Cause-The system is considering the Customer Invoice Item as a Product and not as a service. That's why we have tag "IsServc": "N" (Not a service) in the JSON file.-As the Customer Invoice Item is a Free Text Item, the system can't determine whether it is a product or a Service.-Resolution-The recommendation would be to create a service explicitly for particular item, maintain the HSN code there and use that in the Customer Invoice Item.-Create the Required Service using 'New Service' option in the 'Product and Service Portfolio' work center and then assign the HSN/SAC code in field 'Accounting Code of the Service' in the General Tab.-Navigate to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Services view.-Click on New and select Service.-In the General tab.-Enter the HSN/SAC code in the field "Accounting Code of the Service".-Then only the Item will be considered as Service for Customer Invoice and correct HSN/SAC code will be fetched and validated in the IRN portal.-Keywords-HSN Code; JSON; File; Free Text; Invoice; SAC; Product; Service

Title: Unexpected Seller Tax Registration Number is Picked Up in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You want to know why GST number is selected as Seller Tax registration number in Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-View: Invoice documents-Search and edit ABC (ABC represents Invoice ID).-Navigate to General tab.-Cause-For India Seller Tax Registration number, the priority is always given to GST number. Seller can be verified from Involved Parties tab of Customer invoice.-  To verify if the GST number is chosen correct or not please follow the below steps:-Go to Tax Management work center.-View: Company Tax Arrangements.-Open tax authority ID XYZ and click on view all (XYZ represents tax authority ID).-Navigate to Company tax arrangements tab and tax numbers sub tab.-We can see GST number is maintained as PQRS which is same displayed in invoice (PQRS represents GST number).-Resolution-This is expected system standard behavior.-Keywords-Seller Tax Registration; GST; Invoice; Incorrect; Unexpected

Title: Discount List Name is Changed to "Product Discount (%)" When Discount Amount is Changed via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are using web service to create new sales orders. In the request payload, you give specific <ItemMainDiscount> value. -There is a  valid discount list in the system and matches the order condition, so you expect that system determines the discount list, and remains the name in the Pricing, but only update the discount amount.-For example, the valid discount list is ABC with discount -30%.-You pass the request payload with discount as -50%. You expect the discount list name remains as ABC, and discount amount as 50%. But actually, system changed the discount list name to "Product Discount (%)".-ABC represents the name of the discount list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prepare the request payload and execute it.-In the payload, you give the following ItemMainDiscount.-<PriceAndTaxCalculationItem actionCode="01">-                  <ItemMainDiscount actionCode="01">-                     <Rate>-                        <DecimalValue>50.0</DecimalValue>-                     </Rate>-                  </ItemMainDiscount>-               </PriceAndTaxCalculationItem>-Cause-In sales order interface, when <ItemMainDiscount> is added. The payload actually removes the determined discount and add it manually. This could be seen in the response message:<Note>Main discount created for Order Item ; determined discounts deleted</Note>.-In the UI, if you remove the determined discount price component on Item Pricing, and add it manually, the description is 'Product Discount (%)' as well.-You can see the behavior is consistent.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-If you want to change the discount list name, you can edit the price component description for the product discount price component in Pricing tab.-See Also-Inbound Service Manage Sales Orders-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2402/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_SLO_SO_BUNDLE_MBO.html-section: Support for Item Main Discount:-Case 2: In case if there is single discount determined from master data at item level, then determined discount is discarded and discount sent in ItemMainDiscount is set as item discount, and then a warning message is sent in response . Note: ItemMainDiscount takes priority over determined discount from masterdata.-Keywords-ManageSalesOrderIn; discount list name; discount list description; Product Discount (%).

Title: System Throws Dump Error While Posting the Supplier Invoice for Multiple Goods and Service Receipts
Content: Symptom-Dump error while posting the Supplier Invoice for multiple Goods and Service Receipts -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go To Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Entry view-Search and select all the Goods and Service Receipts from which the Supplier Invoice has to be created -Click on New Invoice-Click on Post, we see dump error -Cause-Each Goods and Service Receipts contains multiple line items. When N number of such multiple line items are combined, total number of line items of the Supplier Invoice will be more than 100.-For better performance and reliable system behavior, the recommendation is to keep 100 line items or less. Creating documents with more than 200 items is strongly discouraged as the system performance degrades as more items are added. Maintaining less than 100 line items would allow for better performance and the smooth running of follow up processes.-Resolution-There is a tool to assess the acceptable document size for partners: SAP Business ByDesign Sizing Assessment Tool.-Please download it from below link:-https://partneredge.sap.com/en/library/assets/products/ent_mng/byd/sell/tools_assets/pp_form_byd_epq.html-Enter the number against the document in the Excel spreadsheet. The traffic button will change accordingly and message appearing, where green indicates good to go and red indicates not recommended.-Please contact Customer Engagement Executive or Account Executive for more details related to the limitation.-Please kindly cancel/delete all affected documents, and then create fresh documents with the number of items as accepted in the above Link.-Note: It is recommended to create a Supplier Invoice where the number of line items should be less than 100, in order to avoid the dump error and for better performance.-See Also-KBA 2956449 - Limitation on Number of Items in ByDesign Documents-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Size; Line Item; Limitation

Title: Customer Invoice Document is Posted to the Currency Exchange Rate Difference Account
Content: Symptom-You notice that the journal entry for a customer invoice document is posted to a currency exchange rate difference account and you wonder why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Search journal entry ID for the clearing document: AAA (AAA represents the customer invoice document ID).-You can see it is posted to a currency exchange rate difference account.-Cause-When you create a customer invoice, the system calculates the tax information immediately at the tax date. When the invoice is posted, the system calculates it again. In the customer invoice itself, under taxes tab, you'll see that the tax date maintained is DD.MM.YYYY. The exchange rate for this tax date will be DD.MM.YYYY at 00:00, so the exchange rate is BBB (BBB represents the valid exchange rate).-The exchange rate CCC used in the customer invoice depends on the valid exchange rate on the posting date (CCC represents valid exchange rate), so the exchange rate used in the journal entry and tax is different. That's why there's a difference amount posted to an exchange rate difference account.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you want the new exchange rate to be used for tax calculation, you need to cancel this invoice and create a new one:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and search for the Customer Invoice in question.-Select the Customer Invoice and cancel it.-After that, create a new customer invoice with the right Tax Date and post it.-Keywords-journal entry, currency exchange rate difference account, customer invoice

Title: Error: Value XXX Is Missing in YYY Restore Value Before Finish Scoping
Content: Symptom-You are unable to scope a scoping question and the system requests to restore values.-Example:-You want to scope  'Would you like to use a sales assistant that proposes activities that you have to do in a certain phase of your opportunity?'. When finishing scoping at step 5, an error occurs.-Error message: Value XXX is missing in Sales Cycle Phase. Restore value before finish scoping.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Example:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click Implementation Projects view-Select the current implementation project-Click on Edit Project Scope-Go to Step 4-Expand Sales-Expand New Business-Click on Opportunities-Go to Section Sales Methodology-Scope question 'Would you like to use a sales assistant that proposes activities that you have to do in a certain phase of your opportunity?'-Click on Next-Click on Finish-Error During Finish Project. Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data. If error messages are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.-Cause-In the given example, either one of the values or all values 001 - 006 are missing in the activity Sales Cycles and Phases.-Resolution-Please follow below steps to restore the values for the given example:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview view-Search for Sales Cycles and Phases-Open the activity-Click on Maintain Sales Cycles-Click on Restore Defaults-The restore option will show values from 001 to 006-Select the entries-Click on Restore Defaults-Click on Save-Now you should be able to scope the question.-Note: Similar steps should solve issues related to other value types, like e.g. similar steps in activity Maintain Employee Time Types for values related to Employee Time Item Types.-Keywords-sales cycle phase, value missing, scoping, Fehlermeldung, Vertriebsassistenten hinzufügen, Finetuning Verkaufszyklen und -phasen, Verkaufszyklen, Verkaufsphase 003 zu einem neuen Verkaufszykluscode hinzugefügt, employee time item type. restore value before finish scoping"-error,scope,sales assistant,sales cycle

Title: Fixed Asset Class not Visible in the selection while creating a New Fixed Asset
Content: Symptom-You are unable to select the Fixed asset class for company PQR(Here PQR means Company id) while creating a fixed asset as the asset class is not visible in the selection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed assets Workcenter.-Go to the Fixed assets View.-Enter the Fixed asset name and select the company PQR.-The Fixed asset class does not appear in the value selection.-Cause-The company PQR is assigned to few sets of books and in the Fixed asset Valuation views activity there are many more set of books assigned. Hence all these valuation views should be assigned to the fixed asset classes required.-If you have multiple set of books for a company then all the valuation views associated with each set of books must be associated with the fixed asset class before it becomes available when adding a fixed asset for a company. You can check the respective valuation views in the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.-Select the Fine tune activity Set of Books.-Select the respective Set of books and click on Edit tab.-Go to the Fixed Asset Settings tab.-Resolution- Go to the Business Configuration workcenter.- Select the Fine tune activity Fixed asset class.- Choose the Fixed asset class and assign all the Valuation views to the Fixed asset class and save.-After this you will be able to create a fixed asset with the company and the fixed asset class.-Keywords-Fixed asset creation, Fixed asset class

Title: Error "File validation failed. Create an incident" While Enhancing Customers Data via Migration Activity
Content: Symptom-You are enhancing Customers using the migration activity and you receive the below mentioned error in the validation step:-"File validation failed. Create an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center.- Select Overview view.- Search and open Migration of Customers activity.- Select Migrate Customers Using the Migration Tool.- Upload the Migration Template using upload option.- Select Execute Migration.-You receive the above error at Validation step.-Cause-This error can occur due to multiple reasons, one of the reasons can be due to the duplicate records existing in Payment Data sheet in the Migration Template.-Resolution-Please verify the data in the migration template and remove the duplicate records from the Payments Data sheet and execute the migration.-Keywords-Migration of Customers, File Validation Fail, Duplicate Payment data, byd

Title: Bank Statement File Upload remains In process.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When uploading Electronic Bank Statement File to the system there is no error or warning message shown, but the system does not process the file.-It remains in status In process.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Bank statements sub view.-Press New and select Bank Statement Upload.-Under Attachments click Add and select File.-Add the file and press Start File Upload.-There is no error message, it does not process the file.-It remains in status In process.-Cause-You have checked in the backend, if there is any failed message/inconsistencies via,-1) Go to the Transaction code -SM37.-2) There you couldn't see any job failed with the particular user id who tried to upload the Bank Statement.-One of the common reason might be the XML file contains below mentioned element value is longer than the maximum permitted length 00. ('00' refers to permitted length of the element) -<AddtlNtryInf>*****</AddtlNtryInf>-Please Note: The element might be any data.-Resolution-You have to upload the file by reducing the content of above mentioned XML element.-Once this is done then the system will give the below errors.-Bank statement XX either already posted or uploaded and ready to be posted manually. ('XXX' refers to Bank Statement ID)-Bank statement for bank account ID YYY; not consistent. ('YYY' refers to Bank Account ID)-For the above error messages ask the customer to check the below points:-1. Content of the XML element to be check and permitted length is 00 only : <AddtlNtryInf>*****</AddtlNtryInf> -2. Verify all the XML node element content valid or not.-3. Check the Bank Statement XX for bank account ID YYY.-Once they correct this error messages, then they can able to upload the Bank Statement.-Keywords-Bank Statement, File Upload, Length, Bank Account, In-process, XML File, Liquidity Management.

Title: Deprecation of Non-Pilot SDK.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The non-pilot SDK has been deprecated since 2402. The SDK will still be available to download on the software download centre, but login will only be possible via a backend switch.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Cloud Applications Studio.-Try to Connect to Repository.-Message displayed "Please switch to the new SAP Cloud Applications Studio (Pilot)" as the current SAP Cloud Applications Studio will be deprecated.-Cause-The deprecation is complete this has been updated on the non-pilot’s login page as well as the SDK documentation.-Resolution-Steps required at SAP Support side:-1. In case a customer asks about the non-pilot SDK, inform them that we have deprecated the non-pilot SDK from 2402 release.-Customer has to install the Microsoft Visual Studio Isolated Shell 2015 , as well as the Microsoft Visual Studio Isolated Shell 2015 Update 3.--2. If customer still insist that they need the non-pilot SDK, then we need to get the below details from customer:-Customer/organization name-Tenant URL-Reason of switch-Steps to reproduce the issue-If you cannot reproduce, ask the customer for a video of the issue, or join a screenshare with them and record the screen. -Once the above is gathered, you must ask them for permission for us to internally evaluate the temporary enablement of the non-pilot SDK.-When the SDK pilot becomes stable, they will need to use the pilot version.-  3. All priorities incidents can be sent to development team and in case of any urgent escalated issues, support can perform these backend changes referring to the below steps:-We need to first contact Sasi (sasi.kanth.velagaleti@sap.com) as he is the point of contact for these issues. If he's available, then he would make the switch.-If not reachable, then support can make the switch and enable the non-pilot SDK on backend.-We can switch the non-pilot SDK using a backend switch (ENBLE_VS10) only for the required customers/users.-The switch consists of creating a new table record on the backend as instructed:-Go to backend transaction SE16-Create a new record on table PDI_RESTRICTION_ENTRY with below parameters:-MANDT:        XXX (this is the tenant ID from CAM e.g. 22)-CFG KEY:      ENBLE_VS10-CFG USER:   * (To enable for all users in the tenant)-CFG VALUE:  X-Our development team have created a new wiki page where this information will be maintained. Along with this information, we will also maintain the tenant info and the reason to switch to the old SDK. -Support team to can update this information on the wiki page when we get a switch request from any customer.-https://wiki.one.int.sap/wiki/display/LeanByD/Tenants+for+which+non-pilot+SDK+is+enabled-See Also-Whats new section in SAP Cloud Application Studio-Issues with Pilot deployment-https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/sap/support/notes/3574533-Keywords-PDI, Pilot, Non, Cloud, Applications, Studio, SDK, Switch, debug, debugging, freeze, freezing, stall, crash, slow

Title: Error while Executing web service in Soap UI: Found Nothing to Import in file
Content: Symptom-You are trying to execute a web service in Soap UI but it is showing following error:-"Found Nothing to Import in file".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management - Communication Arrangements ->select the communication scenario(e.g. Purchase Order integration)-Download the WSDL from Communication Arrangement->Purchase Order Integration->view all-> technical data-> edit advanced settings-> under inbound tab / outbound tab->download "Purchase Order Acknowledgement" WSDL or "purchase order' WSDL -SOAP UI tool-> Create New project and add the WSDL-Error encountered: Found Nothing to Import in file-Cause-Application protocol is not set as web service in communication arrangement.-Resolution-Please go to Inbound Communication: Basic Settings and Outbound Communication: Basic Settings and set the Application Protocol as Web Service.-Please type 5 and select enter and system will determine "Web Service" as the application protocol.-Then Download the WSDL now from communication arrangement and use that in SOAP UI and you will  face no error-See Also-KBA 3409778 -/redirector.do?genericParameters={"number":"0003409778","source":"knowledge"}-Keywords-application protocol,  Found Nothing to Import in file, purchase order acknowledgment, web service, communication arrangement,, Purchase Order Integration , how to create PO acknowledgment via web service

Title: Decoding Of Barcode Failed
Content: Symptom-- Inability to successfully provide Bar Code Input while receiving products in SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-2. Navigate to the Purchase Orders view.-3. Select the relevant purchase order and choose the Post Goods Receipt button.-4. Under the line items tab, select the sub-tab Bar Code Input.-You need to understand how to correctly enter the information without errors in the field Bar Code. -Cause-- The data entered is not in the correct format expected by the system.-- The data needs to be entered as per the configurations maintained in the Business Configuration activity .-- The standard Bar Code Type in the system is Bar Code Type UCC/EAN 128.-- There are application identifiers against application fields which can be viewed in the Bar Code type screen.-Resolution-1. If you need the system to read the Product with id ABC has quantity 20 to be received, you need to input this information as follows: 91ABC]C13020.-- 91 is the application identifier for the Product ID.-- ]C1 indicates to the system to expect the next application identifier.-- 30 is the application identifier for Quantities in Ea.-2. You can use this combination for multiple fields and enter the data as one string.-3. If you choose to enter each field individually, you can avoid using the separator ]C1 and enter the information one by one in the field Bar Code.-See Also-- Business Configuration activity-- Standard Bar Code Type-2915535 - Bar Code Does not Contain a Valid Application Identifier-Keywords-Bar Code Input, SAP Business ByDesign, Inbound Logistics, Post Goods Receipt, EAN128, UCC/EAN 128, Product ID, Quantities in Ea., Decoding of Barcode failed, enter bar code, how to enter barode correctly.
