Title: Incomplete Address In JSON File For E-Invoicing India.
Content: Symptom-The Ship-To/Buyer address is incomplete in the JSON file even though you have maintained the complete address in the Ship-to Master data-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Select the Invoice Documents view-Search for the Invoice ID XXX(XXX is the ID of the Invoice)-Click Edit and check the address of the Ship-to party or Account -You can see the address as below:-Test Ship-To Party-XX, Sample Street-Bangalore-Bangalore Urban 560064-India-Now, Navigate to the Attachments subtab.-Download the file e-invoice-JSON file.-When you check the Ship-to Address or Buyer address, it is Incomplete. Since you have maintained the address in the system, you expect the complete address in JSON, however the address is Incomplete.-"LglNm": "Test Ship-To Party",-"Addr1": "Test Ship-To Party / Bangalore-Bangalore Urban 560064 / IN".-Note: The above address is only sample address used to describe the issue.-Cause-You have maintained the value XX, Sample Street in field 'Address Line 1' instead of field 'House No/Street' in the main address. -Resolution-Kindly modify the Ship-to master data by maintaining the value in field 'House No/Street' instead of field 'Address Line 1' in the main address. This will help in modifying the Formatted Address Description and hence the value in the JSON file. -Keywords-Ship-to; JSOn; Incomplete address, Address line 1; 'House No/Street';-

Title: The Currency and Payment Terms are not Fetched in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request from Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see the Currency and Payment terms in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request from Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-View: Invoice Requests.-Show: All Invoice Requests.-Search and edit for ABC (ABC represents the outbound delivery invoice request).-You are not able to view the currency and payment terms information in outbound delivery invoice request.-Cause-The Outbound Delivery Invoice Request will have the quantity details and Sales Order Invoice Request will have the pricing details. When you click on Invoice button, the system will capture all the details from both Invoice Requests and provide all the details in Invoice document.-Resolution-This is expected system standard behavior.-See Also-1532554 - Net Value of Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is not Displayed-3410405 - Price Information is Not Available in Outbound Delivery Invoice Requests-Keywords-Outbound Delivery Invoice Request, Payment terms, Currency, missing, Information, Invoice Requests;

Title: There is no General tab for purchase request after clicking View All for the document
Content: Symptom-There is no general tab for purchase request after clicking 'View All' button for the document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Open several purchase requests and click on View All.-Some of them have General tab, some of them don't. -  Cause-When the purchase request is created manually, there will be General tab displayed for the document on OIF screen.-When the purchase request is created from other methods, like from materials requirements planning (MRP) with To-stock type, from project management, purchase proposals, from shopping carts and from webservice, there is no General tab for the document on OIF screen.-Resolution-This is the current UI design for the document.-Keywords-General tab, purchase request, manually, webservice, API, project management, purchase proposals, shopping carts, MRP, To-stock

Title: You are Not Able to Maintain Cancellation Details When Cancelling a Released Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-When cancelling a customer invoice, you are not able to set data in the Cancellation Details screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Edit a released invoice, click View All.-Click cancel button, the pop up screen for 'Enter Cancellation Invoice Details' opens but blank. You are not able maintain any information here.-Cause-This is known behavior. -Resolution-To cancel a released customer invoice, you  can cancel the invoice in the work center view.-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select the invoice and click Cancel, the new cancellation screen opens and you are able to maintain dates and then cancel the invoice.-Keywords-cancellation invoice; cancel customer invoice; Enter Cancellation Invoice Details; blank.

Title: You receive the Error Message "Invalid Sales order item" when you Assign a Sales Order item to Assignment Rules
Content: Symptom-You try to assign an Assignment Rule to the "Not Invoiced Time and Expenses", when you assign Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID) you receive the error "Invalid Sales order item".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Select the view Not Invoiced Time and Expenses.-Select the drop down "All Projects".-Search for Project ID XYZ (XYZ represents the Project ID).-Select Edit Time and Expenses.-Select Edit Assignment Rules.-Enter the required values and Sales Order Item ABC-1 (ABC-1 represents the Sales Order Item ID).-Select Apply Assigned Rules -> To All Items with Missing Sales Order Items.-Error appears: "Invalid Sales order item".-Cause-Sales Order status is set to completed or finished.-As the Sales Order is in status Completed/Finished - it is not available to be selected, and assigned against the items.-Resolution-Check the status of the Sales Order.-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the view Sales Order-Search and find Sales Order ID ABC.-Status of the Sales Order shows Completed or Finished.-You will either need to update the Sales Order status or select a different Sales Order to assign the items to.-Keywords-Apply Assigned Rules, Invalid Sales Order Item, Costs Without Assignment To A Sales Order Exists For Project, Revenue Recognition, Not Invoiced Time and Expenses

Title: Is it possible to change Account Principle once postings have been created.
Content: Symptom-You have created a company by using Accounting Principles as XYZ (XYZ represents the Accounting Principle code).-You now need to change the Accounting Principles to ABC (ABC represents the Accounting Principle code).--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-It is not possible to change the Accounting Principle-Accounting principles define how certain transactions are to be posted and reported. The accounting principle also defines the fixed asset valuation views, account determination configurations, to name a few.-There are so many areas that are influenced by the accounting principle. It is not possible to make this change. -If you need to change the Accounting Principle you need to set up the Company again and assign the correct accounting principle. -Keywords-Accounting Principle, change, edit,

Title: Canceling invoice ABC not possible; invoice not determined
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer is seeing a the following error within the Launchpad "Canceling invoice ABC not possible; invoice not determined" (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Select My Launchpad view.-This is where the user is able to see the error.-Cause-The reason the system generated an error is because the Sent By option under the Output History tab of the Cancellation Invoice XYZ was set to XML and thus a Supplier Invoice was expected to be created, but the process got cancelled.-(XYZ represents the ID of the Cancellation Invoice).-This generated an XI message between CustomerInvoiceProcessing and SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoicingIn.-Resolution-Go to the backend (STFK).-Open the transaction SRT_MONI.-Search using the Cancellation Invoice ID.-Locate the XI message in error between CustomerInvoiceProcessing and SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoicingIn.--Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ID XYZ.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Confirm that the Sent By was set as XML.--Please ask customer's permission to cancel the XI message on the backend.-Keywords-Canceling invoice, not possible, invoice not determined, Error, Cancellation, Launchpad, CustomerInvoiceProcessing, SupplierInvoiceProcessingInvoicingIn

Title: How to Add Additional Values for the Shipping Condition in your Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to add additional values for the Shipping Condition  in your Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Open the respective Sales Order. -In the General tab under the Delivery section the drop-down list for the field Shipping Condition  has only 2 values (Express, Pick Up).-You would like to know how to add additional values.-Cause-Additional values to the field Shipping Condition  can be added in the fine-tuning activity Shipping Condition  in your Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine-Tune step.-Select All Activities and search for Shipping Condition .-Select the fine-tuning activity Shipping Condition .-If the fine-tuning activity was not added to the project so far click on the Add to Project button.-Open the fine tuning activity Shipping Condition .-You can add new Shipping Conditions as per your requirement.-  Please note: When creating your entries in the table, the Shipping Condition code must begin with the letter Z.-See Also-Shipping Condition; Express; Pick Up; New; Values; Entries;

Title: "The Application Encountered Navigation to an External Web Link that Could not be Validated" Error When Opening a Link
Content: Symptom-You have set up a link in SAP Business ByDesign (either via a custom solution or through URL attachment, for example), however when trying to open it from the UI, a popup error appears:-"Unsafe Navigation"-"The application encountered navigation to an external web link that could not be validated." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The issue is caused by special characters in the URL. For the URL validation, Business ByDesign only allows alphanumerical characters.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-In order to navigate directly by clicking the URL, it needs to be adjusted to not contain special characters.-Note: Changing the special characters to their encoded version (for example, transforming "$" into "%24") will transform the URL from a link to pure text, which also cannot be validated and will cause the same error.-Keywords-URL, URI, Navigation

Title: Payment Due Date is Incorrect in Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You have created a manual invoice request, and find the payment due date is not correct.-For example, the invoice date is 02.01.2024, payment term is "30 days from Invoice Date, End of month", you expect the payment due date should be the end of next month, 29.02.2024. But system gets the due date as 31.01.2024.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the customer invoicing - invoice documents view.-Open the invoice request ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the invoice request)-The invoice date is 02.01.2024, payment term is "30 days from Invoice Date, End of month" and due date is 31.01.2024. -You expect the payment due date should be 29.02.2024, as the invoice date 02.01.2024 +30 is bigger than the last date in Jan. -Cause-The payment "30 days from Invoice Date, End of month" contains the following parameters.-net price due: Number of Days After Invoice Date / Receipt Date (3) =30; Fixed Day of Month (3) =31; Additional Month (3) =0.-The count starts from the invoice date, so 30 days from 02.01.2024 is 31.01.2024, hence the due date is 31.01.2024.-As summary: for payment term "1028 - 30 days from Invoice Date, End of month":-If the invoice date is the first day of the month, the due date is always the last day of the current month. (except Feb).-If the invoice is the second day in odd moth (Jan, Mar, May, etc...), the 30 days from Invoice Date is 31st, so the due date is in current month.-Resolution-This is currently the designed behavior.-Keywords-Payment Term; "30 days from Invoice Date, End of month"; Due Date.

Title: Change Total Length Of Identified Stock ID To More Than Twenty Characters
Content: Symptom-- Inability to change the total length of the Identified Stock Number ID beyond 20 in SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Business Configuration work center.-2. Proceed to the Overview view.-3. Search and open the activity 'Number Ranges for Identified Stock'.-4. Attempt to enter a value more than 20 in the field 'Total Length'.-Cause-- The maximum length that the ID field can accommodate is only 20.-Resolution-- You can enter and save any value up to 20 in the 'Total Length' field.-See Also-- N/A-Keywords

Title: Is it Possible to Query Change Logs of Business Objects Through Odata Service ?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to show the change log or change history of business objects, business documents, or master data through Odata, but there is neither an association to each individual business object nor a generic readable entity that can be queried for any object type.-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-There is no OData service for change history in ByD.-Also, we cannot do PSM release of the change document BO to be accessed via the OData service framework due to complexity and technical constrains.-See Also-In Case of C4C, You can retrieve change document data for all instances of a given business object using filters.-Currently, change document data is only displayed in the detail view of a business object. By providing an OData service, it would be possible to retrieve change document data for several business object instances based on the filter values.-Filter Attributes-Business Object Type - Mandatory-Busines Object IDs - Optional-Change Date/Time-Result List-ID-Business Object Name-Object UUID-ChangeDateTime-ChangedByIdentityUUID-ChangedByUserName-ObjectNodeElementName-ObjectNodeElementOldContent-ObjectNodeElementNewContent-Please also refer the documentation OData Service for Change Documents-Please note, the service is already available in all C4C systems. Request to enable it via case is not necessary anymore. --Restrictions/Limitations: This service supports only business objects that use cross-component 'Platform change documents'.-Keywords-change log, change history, odata service, odata endpoint

Title: Business Object For Labels.
Content: Symptom-User wants to know the BO name for standard tab New Labels -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistic Workcenter.-Under common tasks-select Labels.-In the screen you see the button- New Labels.-Resolution-GDSTG_GOODS_TAG is the Core BO name for the labels.

Title: Dump: Error while generating virtual BO: Target name * not ABAP conform
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The UI is dumping after adding an UI switch to a SAP screen in the UI Designer, using SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Info: Error while generating virtual BO: "Target name 'UI-SWITCH-NAME' not ABAP conform" (where UI-SWITCH-NAME is the name of the UI switch)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Open the solution on the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Open the UI Designer and navigate to the related SAP screen.-Select any section group and click on Adjust Properties, under Extensibility Explorer.-Select the custom already created UI switch from the drop down menu.-Select any field and adjust it's properties e.g. Change column "Read Only" to True-Click on Apply button.-Save and activate the UI.-When navigating to the frontend UI, it dumps.-Cause-You observe the below dump on ST22:-Category               ABAP programming error-Runtime Errors         MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT-ABAP Program           CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP-Application Component  BC-ESI-ESF-ABA-Application Information-Info: Error while generating virtual BO: "Target name 'ISYD1VQGJZY_PRODUCT-GENERAL' not ABAP conform"-The UI switch name have a character (-, +, ?, etc) which is which is not ABAP conform.-Resolution-Partner would need to rename the UI switch or create a new one without such special character.-Keywords-Inf, Error, generating, virtual, BO, Target, name, not, ABAP, conform, dump, st22, +, -, ?

Title: Error "Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax." when creating new supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-User receive below error when creating new supplier invoice:-"Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC: IFRS Chart of Accounts and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Withholding Tax->Withholding Tax, Item Type Withholding Tax." (ABC represents the account determination profile)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Select the and click New Invoice button.-Enter the External Document and the Invoice Date.-Go to Items > Taxes > Withholding Tax Details tab.-Select the expected withholding tax code.-Then system drop the error: Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax. Specify account determination in chart of accounts ABC: IFRS Chart of Accounts and account determination profile . Column Path Tax->Withholding Tax->Withholding Tax, Item Type Withholding Tax.-Cause-The selected withholding tax for certain country has not been maintained in Business Configuration Activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures'.-Resolution-Please maintain the expected Withholding Tax for certain country from Business Configuration Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures --> Account Determination: Tax --> Subledger: Tax  --> Withholding Tax tab.-Keywords-Account determination is missing for item type Withholding Tax, Specify account determination in chart of accounts: IFRS Chart of Accounts and account determination profile, Column Path Tax->Withholding Tax->Withholding Tax, Item Type Withholding Tax, Supplier invoice

Title: Tax Amount in Tax Box Code 81 Different From Tax Amount Calculated by Business ByDesign (Belgium)
Content: Symptom-You run VAT Return for country/region Belgium.-You notice that the Tax Amount in Tax Box Code 81 is different from the sum of the tax amount calculated on the source documents by Business ByDesign.-For example:--Tax Amount in Tax Box Code 81 is 28,750.31 EUR (28,750.31 EUR stands for AAA EUR).--Tax Amount calculated by the system is 6,637.47 EUR (6,637.47 EUR stands for BBB EUR).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Go to the VAT Returns subview.-Select the VAT ID: XXX (XXX stands for the VAT Return ID).-Select View.-Select the Tax Return tab.-Select Tax Box Code 81-Incoming trans-domestic purch goods.-The Amount shown is AAA EUR.-Select Details box.-Calculate the sum of the Tax Amount.-The sum of Tax Amount is BBB EUR.-Select Export > To Microsoft Excel.-Calculate the total of Tax Amount on the Excel file.-The sum of Tax Amount is BBB EUR (Same Tax Amount as in ByD).-Cause-In case of a purchase transaction posted with a tax code with a non-deductible part of VAT (Tax Code 011 - Domestic purchase of goods, standard rate, non-deductible), you must report in box 81 the tax base amount of the transaction and the non-deductible part of VAT.-You have a net invoice entry XYZ (XYZ stands for the invoice ID) with tax code 011.--Tax rate is 21%--Tax Net Base Amount is 792.00 EUR.--Tax Amount is 166.34 EUR.-The amount reported in tax box code 81 for this invoice is the sum of the Tax Net Base Amount plus the Tax Amount (792.00 EUR + 166.34 EUR).-In Business ByDesign, the Details of the tax box code  81 shows only the Tax Amount 166.34 EUR.-On the Tax Details, invoice XYZ appears twice because you need to have 2 lines, so that from one line the system can take the base amount and from the other line it can take the non-deductible part of VAT. This way, both amounts can be added into the appropriate box in the tax return.-Resolution-This is the correct and expected system behavior.-Keywords-Tax Box Code 81, VAT Return, Tax Code 011 - Domestic purchase of goods, standard rate, non-deductible, Belgium.

Title: Business Partner Field in Manual Tax Entries not Derived in Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-In a Manual Tax Entry you maintain partner company ID ABC in the Business Partner field (ABC represents the partner company ID). -Once posted you check the journal entry. -In the journal entry the Partner Company or Business Partner field is not filled. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Tax Management work center go to the Manual Tax Entries view.-Navigate to the VAT Entries sub-view. -Press New and choose Tax Entry to create a new manual tax entry. -In the New Manual Tax Entry screen maintain the partner company ID ABC in the Business Partner field. -Enter all further relevant and mandatory data. -Press Post. -Access the newly generated journal entry. -In the Journal Entry the Partner Company ID field or the Business Partner ID are not available. -Cause-The Business Partner field in Manual Tax Entries is not posting relevant. It is only used for reporting purposes. -In journal entries, the Business Partner ID is derived from the Debitor or Creditor ID for certain transactions (, such as Customer Invoice, Supplier Invoice). If the debitor or creditor happens to be a Partner Company then the Partner Company field will be filled. -Resolution-The information maintained in the Business Parter field of Manual Tax Entries can be derived in tax relevant reports. -For example: In the All VAT / Sales Tax Entries report the information displayed in the Customer/Supplier field is derived from the Business Partner field of a Manual Tax Entry.

Title: External Tax Determination For Goods and Services is Not Working as Expected in Intercompany Scenario
Content: Symptom-You have created a Purchase Order and noticed that the External Tax Determination is incorrect. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center.-Select the Purchase Orders view.-Select all Purchase Orders, find "XXX" (where XXX is the Purchase Order ID).-Press Edit.-Switch to tab items-Select the subtab taxes. -For example you can see that the Tax Code is 2 - Domestic Acquisition (Standard Rate) which is not as expected. Expected would be 14 - Non-Taxable Purchase Within Tax Reporting Group since it is an internal supplier (Own Company fullfills the Sales Order). -Cause-Both External Partners are for example in Germany and fulfill worldwide but there is no option to differentiate between them, the fields in the Business Configuration Activity are equal and you do not see an option to combine both scenarios.-You want to differentiate between:-Own Company External Fulfillment (Third-Party Scenario) -External Supplier External Fulfillment (Third-Party combined with Intercompany Scenario)-In the Business Configuration Activity External Tax Determination the scenarios Third-Party and Intercompany cannot be combined. You can tick the checkbox "Third-Party Deal" or leave it empty. However you cannot add the Intercompany scenario to the Third-Party scenario. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -Keywords-external tax determination, third party, third-party, intercompany, external fulfillment, internal fulfillment, own company, supplier, purchase order

Title: Process communication error - "Tax code XXX not valid for country YYY on tax date" occurs for Employee Time Calendar.
Content: Symptom-You see there are number of Process Communication Errors for the document type Employee Time Calendar which occurs in the Application and User Management--> Process Communication error sub view.-Error Message: "Tax code XXX not valid for country YYY on tax date " -'XXX' refers to Tax Code.-'YYY' refers to the relevant Country.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the Application and User Management work center.-2) Go to the Process Communication Errors sub view.-3) Filter the Sending Document with Employee Time Calendar.-4) You will see there are number of documents stuck with the Process Communication Error message.-Error Message: "Tax code Reverse Charge On Taxable Supply not valid for country XXX on tax date " -Cause-The validity date for the Tax Code XXX has expired. You have to delimit the dates in future as per your requirement.-Resolution-The Valid To Date of the Tax Code XXX needs to be delimited to a date in the future.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview sub view.-Search for the activity Tax on Goods and Services.-Select Define Tax Codes.-Here try to update the Validity of the Tax Code XXX to a date in the future.-Save it.-Once you have made the required changes on delimiting the Tax date for the Tax code, you have to send the incident to Support and we will restart the failed XI message from the backend so that it can be delivered successfully.-Keywords-Tax code, Tax date, Validity date, process communication error, Application and User Management, Employee Time Calendar.

Title: Dump While editing Access Restriction of Business User
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You observe Dump when trying to update Access Rights for a Business User.-*Internal Document*-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Applicaiton and User  Management workcenter-Select Business Users view-Search for required User-Edit Access Rights-Change to Access Restrictions and select the button Edit Without Business Roles.-System Dumps-Tcode : ST22-Application Information-Index Information-1 Triggering application component: SRD-CC-IAM-2 CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:CL_IAM_USER_AUTH_HIER_ECO=====CP, Include:CL_IAM_USER_AUTH_HIER_EC-3 Info: An exception with the type CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY occurred, but was neither handled-4 CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY, Program:CL_IAM_USER_AUTH_HIER_ECO=====CP, Include:CL_IAM_USER_AUTH-5 Info: A * was to be added that would have lead to a duplicate of the NODE_ID key.-Active Calls/Events-No. Ty. Program Include Line-Name-39 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003 66-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-38 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001 24-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-37 METHOD CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CP CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CM03D 31-CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER=>HANDLE_EXCEPTION-36 METHOD CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CP CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER==CM00H 222-CL_ESF_ADAPTER_UPDATE_BUFFER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICE_PROVIDER~RETRIEVE_BY_ASSOCIATION-35 METHOD CL_ESF_ADAPTER_CONTROLLER=====CP CL_ESF_ADAPTER_CONTROLLER=====CM00U 7-CL_ESF_ADAPTER_CONTROLLER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICE_PROVIDER~RETRIEVE_BY_ASSOCIATION-34 METHOD CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CP CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CM04D 193-CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICES_ACCESSOR~RETRIEVE_BY_ASSOCIATION-33 METHOD CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CP CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CM009 46-Cause- The reason for dump is that Insert statement in line no 273 of method CL_IAM_USER_AUTH_HIER_ECO->NAVIGATE_ASGNED_TO_ACC_REST is trying to insert same entry again.-Resolution-The internal table mt_access_restrictions is not getting cleared. So, below statement is needed somewhere before line no 273 in method CL_IAM_USER_AUTH_HIER_ECO->NAVIGATE_ASGNED_TO_ACC_REST-CLEAR mt_access_restrictions-When you are selecting Woc CC_COMMONPERSONALWORK the internal table mt_access_restrictions is getting filled once and when she is clicking on EditWithoutBusinessRoles button the internal table mt_access_restrictions is filling with same entry again.-Select EditWithoutBusinessRoles button as soon as he enetrs into access restrictions tab without selecting Woc CC_COMMONPERSONALWORK for now. It will do same with or without selection of Woc CC_COMMONPERSONALWORK.-Keywords- Dump, Access Restriction

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error while uploading Fixed Asset file in Migration of Accounting Transaction Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform the Migration of Fixed Asset from the Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity, upon uploading the Fixed Asset File, you get 500 SAP internal Server Error.-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Click Create Unit.-Enter the details and select company.-Click Create.-Now upload the File for the Fixed Asset "XYZ.xml" (Where XYZ represents the file name).-It will through the 500 Internal Server error.-Cause-A few fields might be having some notes or comments.-Resolution-You can open the file in the excel and try to check for notes if any added in any of the filed, if note is added it will be displayed as shown below:-Please remove the notes/comments, save the file and try to upload the file, it should go through.-If any issues, you can create an incident to SAP Support, with the below details:-Affected tenant-Steps to reproduce the issue-Error Screenshot-File which you are uploading-Keywords-Migration of Fixed Asset, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, Upload, Migration, Migration of Accounting and Transaction Data, byd

Title: The Billable Hours is Blank in Activity Report
Content: Symptom-The time record for a project is shown in the Hours column but the corresponding Billable Hours column is blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Team work center.-Click View Activity Report under Common Task.-Fill in the necessary information and click Go.-Cause-The recorded time is not approved or active.-Resolution-Unapproved and inactive time will not be shown as Billable Hours in Activity Report. Once the time is approved or active, the Billable Hours column will show the correct time.-Keywords-unapproved time record, Activity Report, Billable Hours, missing time entry

Title: Error "Unit of measure does not exist" when uploading purchase order via excel template
Content: Symptom-Errors when create new purchase order via excel template：-One record failed to save due to the errors:-Error: Unit of measure XYZ does not exist (KBA: 2743428) (XYZ represents the UoM of the product)-Warning: Unit of measure XYZ not valid for product ABC (KBA: 2674385) (ABC represents the product ID)-Warning: Price missing; price required for expected follow-up documents invoice or ERS-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Download the excel template and maintain data in the template then upload.-You see the mentioned errors.-Cause-The product used in purchase order creation does not have base Unit of measure (UoM) maintained.-System is trying to read product master data in backend and trying to do conversion check between blank UoM (from product master) & XYZ (unit passed in excel). That's the first place where process is going into error & later calculation part is also failing.- Resolution-Please maintain base UoM under General tab & Sales UoM under Sales tab for the product.-Once this is done, log out & log in again, then try to upload file.-While uploading file, please follow below steps for UoM column in excel file: Click on the cell "Unit of measure" -> Click on Business ByDesign button -> Click Lookup button ->You see a popup where you can choose the UoM based on Description.-Keywords-Unit of measure does not exist, Unit of measure not valid for product, Price missing; price required for expected follow-up documents invoice or ERS, Purchase order, Excel template

Title: Unable to Assign Different Account Assignments to Shopping Cart Line Items
Content: Symptom-You are unable to assign different account assignments while creating shopping cart. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services overview and select Self-Services-Select Go-Shopping or Go-Shopping Cart advanced-Enter Employee details-Navigate to Account Assignments section-You are unable to assign the shopping cart to multiple account assignments-Cause-In shopping cart document, system will allow you to enter different Account Assignment details only at header level but it is not possible to enter individual Account Assignment details for each product line item. -Resolution-Since the shopping cart is an internal document with in the company, user can enter multiple account assignments in Non-Stock purchase requests as well as in purchase order documents. -Note - If you want system to allow to enter different account assignments for each product line, it will be a new requirement. Please post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Unable to Assign Different Account Assignments to Shopping Cart Line Items; Different account assignments in shopping cart line item;

Title: Complete Delivery is Read Only in the Sales Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to remove the complete delivery check in the sales order and find it is read only. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center view.-Open the order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the sales order)-In General tab, the Complete Delivery checkbox is ticked and is read-only. You are not able to change it.-Cause-Once the sales order is In Process status, the complete delivery checkbox becomes read-only. You are not able to modify it any more.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-sales order; complete delivery; read only; grayed out.

Title: Scroll bar missing in all the workcenters view for MacOS except Safari browser.
Content: Symptom-User want to use multiple browsers for MacOS but both horizontal and vertical scroll bar is missing for all the workcenter views except Safari -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Example:-1. Go to Business Partner Data Workcenter -2. Navigate to Business Partner view-Both horizontal and vertical scroll bar is missing in all other browsers for macOS except Safari.-Cause-This is not an SAP Business ByDesign tenant Issue.-In macOS the visibility of scroll bars is often controlled by the system-wide settings.-Resolution-Browsers like chrome/edge/mozilla etc  typically follows the system preferences for scroll bar visibility.-If you want to ensure that scroll bars are always visible in all browsers, you can adjust the system setting on macOS following below steps:-1.Click on the Apple logo in the top-left corner of your screen.-2.Select System settings. -3.Click on Appearance-4.In Show scroll bar select "ALWAYS" then scroll bar will be visible-Keywords-Scroll bar missing, Safari

Title: Check Deposit XXX is missing while creating the new Bank Statement.
Content: Symptom-The Check Deposit XXX is missing while create the new Bank Statement. The Income Payment and the Deposit have all posted successfully.-There are no Process Control Errors, No Business Document Differences and no Unposted G/L Source documents. -When creating a new Bank Statement, Check Deposit XXX is not appearing in Step 2.-'XXX' refers to Check Deposit ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Payment Management work center.-2) Go to Check Deposit sub view.-3) Search for Check deposit XXX.-4) Here the Lifecycle Status is Released and the Payment status of the Check Deposit XXX is not started.-5) However, when you go to Payment Monitor, you can see the Check Deposit status is In-Transfer.-Cause-So the Payment Status of the Check Deposit XXX is inconsistent, and it should appear as 'In Transfer' instead of 'Not started'.-Ideally you have to release a Check Deposit XXX for Payment.-Resolution-Here you need to Release a Check Deposit XXX for Payment to change the status change.-1) Go to Payment Management work center.-2) Go to Check Deposit sub view.-3) Search for Check deposit XXX.-4) Click that and choose Actions and Release it.-5) Now it will Set to In Transfer status.-In this way, the Check Deposit XXX obtains the 'Required' status meaning that the Payment can then be confirmed in the system with the Bank Statement. -Keywords-Bank Statement, Check Deposit, In Transfer, Required, Payment Management, Life Cycle Status.

Title: Sub Total Field Appears Zero While Creating New Invoice From Scanned Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a scanned file and clicked on create invoice button. During this process, system did not calculate the sub total value automatically. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Select the relevant file ID-Click on Create Invoice button -System fills the necessary details, however subtotal field appears zero-Cause-When you click on Create Invoice button & select Check button, system shows the below error messages. -Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts (KBA: 3124953)-Posting is not possible. Invoicing unit has no employee assigned. Contact a user administrator to assign the default employee responsible.-Tax amount differs from calculated tax amount.(KBA: 1994085)-Balance is not equal zero. The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. You need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero.-When you create a new invoice, system will capture the Total Gross Amount and Total Tax Amount. However the amounts will not be calculated automatically when the new invoice is created. Once you create an invoice, you have to click on Actions - Calculate total amounts. This will calculate tax amounts and invoice amount and error will be vanished. -Resolution-As a standard behavior, when you click on Create Invoice button, system will fill the necessary details in the invoice screen. When you create a new invoice, system will capture the Total Gross Amount and Total Tax Amount. However the amounts will not be calculated automatically when a new invoice is created. The field Subtotal, is a calculated field and will not be filled automatically by the system. So once you create invoice, you have to click on Actions - Calculate total amounts. This will calculate tax amounts and invoice amount and error will be vanished. -Keywords-Sub total field not calculated in scanned invoice; Sub total field appears zero; Sub total field not calculated

Title: List Pricing is Not Taken From Reference Contract Item Into the Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You tried to maintain the contract/item reference in the existing sales order, and find the list price of the sales order line is not taken from the contract item. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Open the sales order ABC.-Go to the Items tab, the line 10 refers to contract/item XYZ/10.-You find the list price of the line 10 is not updated. You expect that the list price should be taken from the contract item XYZ/10.-ABC represents the ID of the sales order.-XYZ represents the ID of the contract.-Cause-When a sales order is created as follow up document from the contract, the list price of the sales order line is then taken from the reference contract item. But if the sales order is created stand alone and then manually maintained a reference to contract item, the list price of the sales order line will be not updated.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-See Also-3035845 - How the List Price is Determined in a Follow-Up Sales Order From a Contract.-Keywords-sales order; list price; contract; reference.

Title: Supplier Invoice ID Starts With Incorrect Format For The Present Year
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Supplier Invoice ID is not according to rules maintained in the Business Configuration activity 'Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos views-Select "All Documents"-Here you can see the invoice posted in the present year are having the different document ID -However the invoice posted in the previous year is having the document ID as per the rule.-Cause-User has set the rule that has worked for the supplier invoice posted in the pervious year .-Now when user is posting the invoice for present year and the rule for document numbering is not working as per the expectation.-While assigning the numbering rule for the 1st supplier invoice of present year, due to a backend error, the start number got reset to 1 in the backend. Title: Inactive Employee Still Presents In The System
Content: Symptom-Duplicate employee ID still present in the system whenever trying to search with the new employee ID or an Employee that is Inactive is appearing as Active for an Account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-There are many steps where you find the Employee is active-For Example:-Go to Account work center-Select contacts tab-Choose Responsibilities, while adding a new row, with the name XYZ in the Employee with the help of the value help, it is showing XYZ as active.-i.e. XYZ is an Employee here.-Cause-Possible causes for the issue:-Case 1: There are 2 different employees with name XYZ which is causing this problem-Case 2: You have not used the re-hire functionality for employee instead you have used new hire.-Resolution-As per system design, for an employee employee ID always remains same even when the same employee is re-hired in the system.-To remove inactive Employee, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Go to Business Partner view.-Click Action and select if you want to Block or Obsolete the Service Agent.-You can use Block usage to prevent further usage of these terminated employees.-Note:-This does not happen automatically. Therefore user must set this manually.-See Also-1645825 - Unable to Block the Service Agent who is Also an Internal Employee-Keywords-Value help, Terminated Employee, Active, Service agent, Rehiring, Duplicate, Account, Still Appearing, Available, Appears.

Title: Error : Mapping for Data Type RegionCode, Code MH, and Local Context IN does not exist
Content: Symptom-You are getting the Error : Mapping for Data Type RegionCode, Code MH, and Local Context IN does not exist-It is already configured in the system, still you can see the error.-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Master Data Replication work center-2.Go to the Employees sub view-3.Click on Actions button and select * Data FROM Employee Central-4.Select an entry from the given date and go to the details-5.Test: Mapping for Data Type APC_S_REGION_CODE, Code MH, and Local Context IN does not exist-6.Click on the link -7. Enter Remote Employee ID: 900862 andf click OK.-8. You will get the Errors:-Mapping for Data Type RegionCode, Code MH, and Local Context IN does not exist-Save failed-Master data has been replicated from Employee Central; please note error messages.-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Go to Overview sub view-3. Find the activity Code List Mapping for Integration with Existing Solutions-4. Select the Mapping Group: Employee Central Integration-5. Click on View-6. Click on Code List Mapping-7. Select the Mapping Group: Employee Central Integration-8. Click on Missing Code Mappings-9. You can see, that all proposals are already mapped-Cause-You can see a number of BC changes through the change history log, pertinent to Code list mappings for IN.-The changes are reflected in the Code List Mappings section and there are more than 1 mapping entries associated with the IN Rule, one with the MH code.-The Replication Request has one Address Entry which is missing the split that is available (and visible) on subsequent requests on further dates.-Resolution-Remove multiple mappings and correct the Address Split as expected from EC system.

Title: Comparison Year not available in Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China
Content: Symptom-Comparison year missing from Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Statutory Reports.-Select Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China.-Select New.-Select Blank Report Run.-Comparison Year field is visible.-Enter the Company ID.-Enter the Set of Books.-Comparison Year disappears.-Resolution-If you enter a Balance Sheet Structure or an Income Statement Structure extra selection fields appear.-Under Balance Sheet Selection  there is a field: Compare with Year Opening Balance -- If you deselect this checkbox you must specify a comparison period and year for which you want to run the balance sheet.-Under Income Statement Selection  there is a field: Compare with Year Opening Balance -- If you deselect this checkbox you must specify a comparison period and year for which you want to run the balance sheet.-Also the Comparison Year field appears as expected.-Keywords-Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China, Chinese, Balance Sheet and Income Statement, Statutory Report, Comparison Year

Title: No task notification in user inbox when recipient send the supplier invoice exception back to sender
Content: Symptom-When user perform 'Save document and Forward for Clarification' button, the recipient receives the task notification in user inbox. However, when the recipient finish the clarification and return it to the sender, there is no task notification in sender's user inbox.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the affected invoice ID and navigate to Exception tab.-Click 'Save document and Forward for Clarification' button and select the recipient employee.-The recipient receives the task notification in user inbox 'Clarify Invoice Exception XXX for Supplier Invoice ABC' (XXX represents the exception type and ABC represents the invoice ID).-However when the recipient finish the clarification and return it to the sender, there is no task notification in sender's user inbox.-Cause-There will be no task will be sent to the sender inbox when the recipient finished the clarification.-Instead, please go to Supplier Invoicing - Work - Documents to Be Processed, you will find a new task there 'Complete Supplier Invoice ABC'.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-If you would like additional notification sent by the system to inform the completion of this task from the recipient, you can go to Home - Inbox and click 'Subscribe to Task' to enable the email notification for the task: Complete Supplier Invoice <Supplier Invoice ID> as you wish.-Keywords-Save document and Forward for Clarification, Subscribe to Task, Task, Notification, Complete Supplier Invoice, Inbox

Title: Supplier Invoice scanning is not successful due to multiple exceptions
Content: Symptom-Below error occurs while performing invoice scanning :-Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts-Tax amount differs from calculated tax amount -Balance is not equal zero. The total gross amount differs from the sum of the subtotal and the total tax amounts. You need to adjust these amounts so that the balance is zero.-You cannot post the invoice. This date is blocked for postings in financial accounting.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Search for ID XYZ to be scanned-Click on Review and then click on Create Invoice-Click on check, we see errors-Resolution-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Search for ID XYZ to be scanned-Click on Review and then click on Create Invoice-Go to Actions and select Calculate Total Amounts options. -Also, we can manually enter the Total Gross amount and Total New amount by checking the actual value from the items tab. -Before Posting the invoice, make sure that the Posting period is open for the proposed Posting date of the Invoice. -Click on check, the errors will be gone. -See Also-KBA: 1610253-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1610253-Keywords-Invoice scanning errors, Tax amount differs from calculated tax amount , Total gross/net amount differs from sum of item amounts

Title: Bank Statement Note in SDK required the Write Access.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 1 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-In SDK development, bankStatement cannot find a place for documents description】-You found enhancement call about 【bankstatementExtension】-You want to maintain the documents description under Business Object BankStatement.-You used a bankstatement in between to create credentials-But the description of the voucher cannot be found where it was written.--Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Login to the Studio (SDK).-2) Give the code MDRS.-3) Give the Business Object as FOPXP_BANKSTAT.-4) Click the Node and expand the ROOT.-5) DT Element Path--> click NOTE.-6) There you will see the UI Text as Document Description, which don't have the write access and this field has only PSM read access.-7) This is a locked state, and you want a write access to modify text description.-Cause-Please Note: The field "Document Description" from a Bank Statement on the UI, is bound to field named Note of BO HouseBankStatement, on Root node which only has the required access as below.-HouseBankStatement.Note field is PSM released with read access, meaning you can read this field value via ABSL scripts on SDK, but can't have the write access.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. Please note that the BO HouseBankStatement contains confidential information and hence we cannot provide write access on this BO. In fact this will not be released in future as well. -Keywords-SDK, House BankStatement, PSM Release, Read Access, Write Access, ABSL Scripts, Business Object.

Title: The Result of Scanning Barcode of Production Order is Incomplete.
Content: ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 2 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-You use external scanner to scan barcode of production order ID, but the result is incomplete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access view Production Orders.-Search production order, for example, 12345, click Preview - Preview.-In the pop-up window, there is a barcode under production order ID on each page.-Use any UCC/EAN 128 (GSI 128) barcode scanner to decode the barcode in the window, the result is 1234.-Cause-This is not a bug but about how the template is set up. In Business ByDesign, we are currently using 128SSCC barcode format by default which is visible in the form, and at the same time we have hidden the barcode format 128B.-Resolution-Please download the standard form template, open it in Adobe LiveCycle Designer, make 128SSCC barcode hidden and make 128B barcode visible, and then upload the updated template into system.-Keywords-Production Order, Barcode, Scanner, ID, UCC/EAN 128, 128SSCC, 128B

Title: Error"Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for CUSTOMER-PAYMENT_DATA - PAYMENT_DATA_CTI"
Content: Symptom-While updating the Direct Debit via webservice you are getting the below error message.-Only list complete transmission (LCTI) allowed for CUSTOMER-PAYMENT_DATA - PAYMENT_DATA_CTI-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The Direct Debit Mandate structure contains all general DDM informtion.-The identifying information is needed in the create scenarios in every case:-Company Information (either UUID or ID)-Payer Information (either UUID or ID)-PayerBankDetailsID-The following information is optional in a create sceanrio:-MandateID (if this is not passed, it will be auto-generated)-DebtorIdentificationCode (default is blank)-Description (default is blank)-SingleUseIndicator (default is false)-BlockedIndicator (default is false)-MandateType (1 - SEPA Core(default), 2 - SEPA B2B, 3 - SEPA COR1)-ValidityPeriod-SignatureDate (default is blank)-SignatureCity (default is blank)-Status (2 - Active, 5 - Obsolete, 6 - In Preparation(default))-Resolution-Here is an example of a simple web service request to update Direct Debit:-<n0:DirectDebitMandateBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">- <BasicMessageHeader>-  <ID>MsgID 1</ID>- </BasicMessageHeader>- <DirectDebitMandate actionCode="01">-  <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>Tech ID 1 </ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-  <MandateID>2018</MandateID>-  <CompanyID>Company_A</CompanyID>-  <PayerID>Customer X</PayerID>-  <DebtorIdentificationCode>123</DebtorIdentificationCode>-  <PayerBankDetailsID>0001</PayerBankDetailsID>-  <Description>Mandate Created in Store by Salesperson</Description>-  <SingleUseIndicator>false</SingleUseIndicator>-  <BlockedIndicator>false</BlockedIndicator>-  <MandateType>1</MandateType>-  <ValidityPeriod>-   <StartDate>2018-01-01</StartDate>-   <EndDate>2028-01-01</EndDate>-  </ValidityPeriod>-  <SignatureDate>2018-01-01</SignatureDate>-  <SignatureCity>London</SignatureCity>-  <Status>2</Status>- </DirectDebitMandate>-</n0:DirectDebitMandateBundleMaintainRequest_sync>--This will create a mandate with ID 2018 for Customer X in Company A. The status 2 in this case will update the status to Active.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2111/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_DIR_DEB_MDT_IN.html-Keywords-unable to update Direct Debit , SEPA Mandate

Title: Sort Ascending and Descending of the Invoice ID is not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-The Ascending and Descending sorting of the Invoice ID field is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In our example you have set up a document numbering rule for Customer Invoices with the prefix RE and the suffix as the current year (e.g. 2024).-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center. -Select the Invoice Documents view. -Show All Invoice Documents.-In the Invoice ID column select e.g. Sort Ascending.-The results are sorted as follows:-RE-1-2024-RE-10-2024-RE-100-2024-…-RE-109-2024-RE-11-2024-RE-111-2024-…-  You expect them to be sorted:-RE-1-2024-RE-2-2024-RE-3-2024-...-RE-9-2024-RE-10-2024-...-RE-99-2024-RE-100-2024-etc. -Cause-The field Invoice ID us an alphanumeric field and combines alphabets and numbers. and is therefore alphanumeric instead of number (numeric).-Any alphanumeric sorting places the alphabets in order, and then the numbers in order by their first numeral, so 10 and 100 etc. will come before 2.-Thus, when you sort by Invoice ID, it is not following an ascending order of numbers but the described pattern of the alphanumeric sorting rule.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sorting; numbers; sequence; alphanumeric; numeric; characters; ID;

Title: Define at least one read restriction and write restriction for view
Content: Symptom-The below warning message is raised when restricting Read/Write access on a Work Center View:-Define at least one read restriction and write restriction for view-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center (in SAP Business ByDesign) or Administrator Work Center (in SAP Cloud for Customer).-Go to Business Users View.-Search for user to be restricted.-Select the user.-Click on Edit-Click on Access Rights.-Navigate to "Access Restrictions" tab.-Search the work center view (the view can be custom or standard).-Change the Read and Write access to "Restricted"-Click on Save.-A warning is shown "Define at least one read restriction and write restriction for view".-Cause-At least one read or write access restriction needs to be checked in the Detailed Restrictions tab for this work center view.-Resolution-To avoid this message from being shown, you need to select either the read or write access for at least one restriction.-Keywords-Access, Context, Restrictions, RBAM, define, at, least, one, read, restriction, write, view, byd, c4c

Title: "The remote server returned an error: (500) Internal Server Error" Error in the Collaboration Window
