Title: Bill Of Material Not Displayed Production Model Details Data Source
Content: Symptom-- In the data source 'Production Model Details', the Bill of Material (BoM) ID is not displayed.-- Instead of the BoM ID, the system displays '#'.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Business Analytics work center.-2. Go to the Data Sources view.-3. Search for the data source 'Production Model Details', select it and choose the Preview button.-4. Enter the relevant Production Model ID. The system displays '#' instead of the BoM ID in the relevant field.-Cause-- The BoM variant associated with the mentioned Production Model is marked as Obsolete.-- This has made the Production Model inconsistent.-Resolution-- Assign a valid Bill of Material to the production model. The relevant BoM ID will then be displayed without errors in the data source.-See Also-- N/A-Keywords

Title: UK VAT Number Validation Logic
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are implementing a front-end solution that allows you to enter the VAT Registration Number from the front end. You would like to know how Business ByDesign checks the format for UK VAT Registration Number for Account to ensure that the checking rule is created as the same as how Business ByDesign does it so the creation is successful.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Below is the logic for UK VAT Number validation in Business ByDesign:-GB649926678    -number multiplier  Number *multiplier -6 8 48-4 7 28-9 6 54-9 5 45-2 4 8-6 3 18-6 2 12-              Sum 213-        97-(sum mod 97) 78-The 97 - (213 mod 97) should be equal to check digits i.e. last 2 digits of the VAT number which in this case is 78.-Keywords-UK VAT Number Validation Logic.

Title: Error Appears While Trying to Post Intercompany Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-System creates an intercompany supplier invoice however there is an exception while posting. -Error Messages: Account assignment data missing for item; see Cost Distribution-- Purchase document canceled (KBA: 1577279)-Warning Message: The delivery note is not found. The delivery note does not exist or is inactive, or the supplier, buying company, product, product category, or product type in the delivery note differs from that in the supplier invoice.-Info message - The purchase document with item does not exist or is inactive; or the supplier, buying company, product, product category, or product type differs from that in the supplier invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to Exceptions tab-You can see the error-Cause-In the Purchase Order items tab under basic data sub tab, there is a section called Follow-up Documents. Here Invoice Expected check box is not selected. Meaning you are not expecting any invoice to be created for this item and system will not allow you to create invoice. Hence the error message appears and it is a valid error. -Resolution-If you want to create supplier invoice, you can create manual invoice with out reference to order. Or Else you have to cancel all the follow up documents created with reference to Purchase Order and then select the Invoice expected check box for an item and create the follow up documents again.-Keywords-Account assignment data missing for item; see Cost Distribution; Purchase document canceled (KBA: 1577279);The delivery note is not found. The delivery note does not exist or is inactive, or the supplier, buying company, product, product category, or product type in the delivery note differs from that in the supplier invoice.

Title: Dump Occurs While Viewing Output History in the Customer Invoicing
Content: Symptom-Dump " 500 internal server error" occurs while viewing output history in the Customer Invoicing work center-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center-Navigate to the Invoice documents Work Center View-Select any Invoice Id & Open it-Navigate to Output History tab-you will get Dump " 500 internal server error"-Cause-The cause for this issue is template name & description are missing for the particular form template.-Resolution-You need to maintain template name & description in the Form Template Maintenance.-Follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Navigate to Form Template Maintenance Work Center View-In the Advanced Filter select Template Group Name-Choose Go & select affected Form Template-Select Actions and Maintain General Information  -Provide Name & Description-Save the Changes-Keywords-500 internal server error, Customer Invoicing, Output History, Form Template details

Title: Standard Data Source HCMTLMU01 is Not Working
Content: Symptom-Standard Data Source for Employee Recorded Times Report is not fetching the data as expected.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics workcenter-Select Design reports view-Select Standard Report - Employee Times Monthly-Enter Employee ID-Current Month-You can see the relevant data-Now Open Data Source: HCMTLMU01-Use same filters, there is no data-Cause-You cannot see the data in any other month as Key Date selection is not an option under the Preview option on the Business Analytics workcenter - Design Data sources HCMTLMU01.-If Key Date selection is not available then reports/data sources only show data for the current date.-Resolution-The Preview of Data Sources does not have Key Date available for selection.-You should create a Z report using the data source for testing data, then the key date will be available.-Keywords-HCMTLMU01, Employee Recorded Times

Title: Electronic Tax Invoice documents are not getting created for a Credit Memo.
Content: Symptom-You are in the process of creating an Electronic Tax Invoice document. After creating a Customer Invoice, executing an Electronic Tax Invoice, and you are creating an Electronic Tax Invoice document which is progressing well without any problems.--However, if you create a Manual Credit Memo or a Credit Memo Invoice created by referring to an "Standalone Invoice" and then run an Electronic Tax Invoice, but here the Electronic Tax Invoice is not created. (If you set it to "Aggregated Invoice" and run it, it is created without any problem.)--Even if you look at the Execution Log, there is no information or any cause of error mentioned. You want to know why the system didn't pick the Credit Memo for the Run XX.  ('XX' refers to Electronic Tax Invoice Run ID)--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-2) Go to the Invoice Documents sub view.-3) Create a Credit Memo for the Customer Invoice.-4) Now again under Receivables work center, go to Electronic Tax Invoice Run.-5) Try to do Electronic Tax Invoice Run for "Standalone Invoice".-6) Once the Run is done, if you click the Run XX, you can see that under execution summary that "No Electronic Tax Invoice Created".-Cause-For Example: You have created Customer Invoice and you want to do the Electronic Tax Invoice Run for this Customer invoice. For this kind of scenario if you choose the "Standalone Invoice" in the Electronic Tax Invoice Run then the Run will pick the Customer Invoice only and it won't pick the Credit Memo. For Credit Memo it is different.-Resolution-Here system is behaved as expected. To to the Electronic Tax Invoice Run, you have to follow the below steps.-1) Go to the Receivables work center.-2) Go to the Electronic Tax Invoice Run sub view.-3) Create a new run and provide all the mandatory details like Company, Fiscal Year, Period and Date-4) Under Selection Criteria, try to select the "Aggregated Invoice" for the Type of Execution.-5) After the Run was completed, now if you check the Run XX, it would have picked the Credit Memo.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Credit Memo, Electronic Tax Invoice Run, Aggregated Invoice, Standalone Invoice, Receivables.

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Generates Redundant Debit and Credit Posting Lines for Deferred Revenue / Cost of Goods sold
Content: Symptom-You execute the Revenue Recognition Run.-You notice that the run has debited and credited the same amounts with all the exact same accounting details on the Deferred Revenue Account or the Deferred Cost of Goods Sold Account for no apparent reason.-Or you might notice that fully completed sales order items are still considered by the revenue recognition run. The Revenue fully recognized indicator is not set for these items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Open the run in question. -Navigate to the Postings tab and here to the Journal Entries sub-tab. -You notice two posting lines, one debit, one credit with exactly the same amount. -Click the Journal Entry ID to open the Posting.-You verify that both posting lines, on the Deferred Cost of Goods sold or the Deferred Revenue account (depending on what is to be recognized by the run) contain exactly the same information (no change of Project Task, Sales Document Item, Business partner, profit center).-Go to the Processed successfully tab of the run. In the POC based or Time and Material Based sub-tab you find sales order items that completed and should no longer be processed by the run. Take note of their IDs, for example XYZ-XX (XYZ-XX represents the ID of a completed sales order item). -Revenue Fully Recognized Indicator not set:-Navigate to the Sales Document Items view in the Cost and Revenue work center.-Find item XYZ-XX and go to the Dates tab. -Verify that a date is maintained in the Final Delivery or Invoice Date field. -Navigate to the Accounting Data tab. -Here, the Revenue Fully Recognized indicator is not set. -You wonder why these seemingly unnecessary postings have been made. -You wonder why completed sales order items do not get finished for revenue recognition. -Cause-Even though the Function of Expense reporting principle is used for the company's set of books a profit center is associated with the affected sales order item(s). Therefore, the revenue recognition run tries to post all values to the respective profit center. However, as profit center reporting is not active, the postings gets blocked. so that the values are posted back again, creating these redundant posting lines:-First, verify that the Function of Expense reporting principle is used:-In the General Ledger go to the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view. -Find the respective company and set of books combination and select it. -In the Details section, under Set of Books Information check the Reporting Principle. Here, Function of Expense is selected.-Cause A) The set of books selected for the revenue recognition run uses the function of expense reporting principle but profit center reporting is activated in the solution profile:-With the function of expense reporting principle in place it is not intended to derive profit centers and segments in the relevant journal entries.-However, the revenue recognition run still tries to distribute values to a profit center, because profit center reporting is active:-In your project scope go to step 4- Questions.-Under Financial and Management Accounting select General Ledger and choose General Ledger again. -In the questions tab, the question under Profit Center and Segment Accounting is selected. -B) If profit center reporting is not part of the solution scope, then the sales unit associated with sales order item XYZ-XX is defined as profit center in the respective organizational structure. In this case the profit center is assigned to the sales order item:-In Cost and Revenue go to the Sales Document Items tab. -In the General tab, under Organizational Data take note of the Sales Unit ID. You notice that the Profit center field is filled, even though the function of expense reporting principle is used. -Go to the Org Structures view of the Organizational Management work center. -Find/ Locate the sales unit ID you just noted down. -Navigate to the Definitions tab: You notice the org unit is defined as profit center.-In this case, the profit center is assigned to the sales order item so that the revenue recognition run tries to distribute all values to the profit center.-Resolution-If profit center reporting is active we recommended to use a reporting principle which includes profit center accounting, such as 'Function of Expense, Profit Center/ Segment', if working with profit centers and segments is an option for your company. Another option would be to deactivate profit center accounting in the solution profile.-If profit center reporting is not active and if the function of expense reporting principle is to be used but sales units are defined as profit center we recommend to remove the profit center definition for these organizational units.-From the date of activation all new sales documents will be created without a profit center association, so that the revenue recognition run will no longer generate redundant postings.-Keywords-debit and credit postings, Revenue recognition run postings, Deferred Revenue, Deferred Cost of Goods sold, revenue fully recognized

Title: Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Unauthorized (401)
Content: Symptom-You receive the following error message when using the Check Connection function in the Communication Arrangement:-Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Unauthorized (401) -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the Cloud Solution.-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to the Communication Arrangement view.-Open the affected communication arrangement.-Go to the Technical Settings facet and click on Edit Advanced Settings.-Select your service.-Click the Check Connection button.-You will now receive the error:-Error accessing service; Service Ping ERROR: Unauthorized (401) followed by Ping Failed.-Cause-The cause of this issue is that the user that the Service is authenticated with is currently locked.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you must unlock the user maintained in the Communication Arrangement setup.  You can do this by opening the Technical Users in the Administrator work center and using the action Unlock. You can finally set a new password for the Communication Arrangement.-The error will then disappear and the service will work again.-Keywords-Web, Service, Ping, Error, 401

Title: No Records Displaying For a Custom Mass Data Run in a Test Tenant
Content: Symptom-You have created a Mass Data Run (MDR) in the Cloud Applications Studio (SDK), and have generated screens for this MDR. However, no records are displaying in the OWL screen for this Mass Data Run in the frontend.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Mass Data Run work center view.-You notice that there are no or fewer records than expected on the OWL screen.-Cause-All the instances of a Business Object (in this case the Mass Data Run Object) are stored in a secondary persistency in the database of the system. This issue occurs when this secondary persistency is not updated, and therefore the data is not visible in the UI.-Resolution-Activate the solution.-Activate the Mass Data Run (.run) file.-If this does not resolve the issue, or if the issue exists in the Production Tenant, please report an incident to SAP with permission to reload the related Mass Data Run view in the backend.-Keywords-Mass Data Run, No Records, Empty, No Data, Missing, PDI, Custom, instance, with, same, key, exists

Title: How to Check When the Latest Version of Accrual Method Determination was Changed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-In the 'Accrual Method Determination' activity, you cannot find out when the latest version was changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open Accrual Method Determination activity. -Click on You Can Also and select View Previous Versions.-It only shows the change time of previous versions. You cannot find out when the latest version was changed.-Resolution-In terms of when the latest version was created for Accrual Method Determination, you can only find this in the backend.-Go to SESFTS transaction.-Open BO A1FIA_ACCR_DET_FDT_QAF.-Load by Query -> ROOT - QUERY_BY_VERSION_ID.-Leave everything empty to get all versions if you wish.-Here you can find the change time (SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATIVE_DATA-LAST_CHANGE_DATE_TIME).-Keywords-Accrual Method Determination;Version.

Title: Max Inventory Age 7300 Days in Report "Inventory Ageing"
Content: Symptom-In standard report Inventory Ageing, there is unexpected inventory with max inventory age as 7300 days.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Reports.-Open standard report "Inventory Ageing" (SCMINVAGV04_Q0001).-Enter ABC (ABC represents product ID) in Material, click Apply. In the result, we can see inventory with Max Inventory Age as 7300.-However, check in another standard report "Confirmation Journal" (SCMCFJU01_Q0001), related confirmation DEF (DEF represent confirmation ID) was created several days before and with business transaction date on the same day.-Cause-Confirmation DEF is a transfer confirmation which results from Change of Stock but during which only product ID is changed. If inventory is added into warehouse by changing product ID during Change of Stock, report "Inventory Ageing" will not calculate its age but set it as 7300 days by default.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Inventory Ageing, Max Inventory Age (In Days), 7300, Change of Stock

Title: Incorrect Break Deductions in Timesheets and Time Statements
Content: Symptom-Incorrect break deductions are displayed in timesheets and time statements.-Business Use Case:-Employees record their attendance times using terminal integration with clock-in and clock-out bookings. The statutory break deductions are taken into account here and are deducted automatically.-In addition, the employees post their times using the time type Project time to the relevant projects, this time type is not credited to the Working Time Account, but the automatic break deduction is also taken into account there and is totaled in the display in the timesheets and time statement.-How to correctly display of the break in the time statement.-Resolution-The system will calculate breaks for working hours and special attendance.-If you have 2 entries for the whole day (1 time stamp for working hours via terminal integration and 1 for special attendance), the system will calculate the breaks twice.-The overall calculation for the working hours will not be affected by this.-The only way the customer can avoid this is by not entering a start and end date for their project time recordings that were done with the given time type.-This is currently the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Break, Time Statement

Title: Unposted Source Document Error: Supplier Invoicing not Possible; Posting on DD.MM.YYYY Blocked in Company 123
Content: Symptom-When attempting to post an Unposted Source Document: Supplier Invoice/Customer Invoice, the following error message is displayed:-Supplier Invoicing not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked in company 123 -Customer Invoicing not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked in company 123-(Here, 123 refers to Company ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View.-Choose Source Documents Sub-View.-Set Show Filter to Unposted Source Documents.-It can be observed that Source Document Type Supplier Invoice/Customer Invoice have the status In Process.-Select the Document.-Choose on Actions drop down button.-Choose on Post Business Transaction.-Observe that there is an error: Supplier Invoicing not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked in company 123 -(or) Error: Customer Invoicing not possible; posting on DD.MM.YYYY blocked in company 123-Cause-Relevant accounting period for date DD.MM.YYYY has Period Status as Blocked, which results in the error message being displayed.-Resolution-Unposted source documents can be manually posted to the current period which is open or can be posted to the old/past period.-A. To post the unposted source documents in the current period, follow the below steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit View and select the Source Documents sub view.-In the Source Documents, select the option Unposted Source Documents in the Show view and Choose Go button.-A list of all Unposted Source Documents will appear, select the unposted document for which error occurs.-Then, Choose Action button and then select View Business Transaction.-Now Business Transaction for Accounting window will open with that Document and then Choose on Post To Another Period.--B. To post the unposted source document in the old/past period, follow these steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Under Common Task, open the Open and Close Periods sub view.-Enter the required selection parameter like Company ID, Set of Books etc. and Choose Go button.-Select the period which is blocked for posting and then Choose Open Period.-The blocked period will open now, and the Period can be opened for Operational Postings.-Finally Choose Save and Close button.-After performing these above mentioned steps, system will allow to post these unposted source documents manually in the old/past period. As it is mentioned in the step (A) how to post unposted source document manually, Choose Post in the Business Transaction for Accounting window. This will post these unposted documents in the old/past Period (current period).- Also, maintain the process control to post source document in specific time periods and posting dates.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Companies view.-Select the Company ID of the buying company in the invoice and press Set Process Control.-In the General Data tab, press Add to add a new Process Control item with Business Process Group: Supplier Invoicing.-Define dates in the Entry Possible Until, From Posting Date, To Posting Date fields, ensuring that date invoice's posting date DD.MM.YYYY is within the defined time span.-Press Save and Close.-Once a Process Control has been maintained for at least source documents of type Supplier Invoice, the supplier invoice can be posted on DD.MM.YYYY.-Keywords-Supplier Invoicing not possible, Posting on blocked in company, Set process control, post without opening periods, ByD Posting Error, Unposted source documents-unposted source document error, posting on blocked in company, set process control, supplier invoicing not possible

Title: Same Prefix Cannot Be Used For Different Document Numbering Rules
Content: Symptom-You are trying to save a document numbering rule, and you want to use the same prefix for two different rules and the system does not let you save them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search for Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing.-Here, the same prefix is tried to be saved for two different rules.-The error, Prefix value already in use, is shown.-Cause-It is a legal requirement that the same prefix cannot be used for documents in the same work-center. For example, invoices and credit memos cannot have the same prefix. However, customer invoices and supplier invoices can have the same prefix.-Resolution-This is the expected System Behavior.-See Also-Prefix; Document Numbering; re-use-Keywords-"Prefix", "Document numbering rules", "Customer Invoices"

Title: Data Source Functional Area Determination Doesn’t Contain the G/L and Functional Area Mapping.
Content: Symptom-You see the mapping of functional area to the G/L Accounts under business configuration is not available in the data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Report Path:-Navigate to Business Analytics Work Center.-Select Data Sources and search for Functional area determination.-Enter the Functional Areas for which G/L is mapped in the field 'Functional Areas'.-Report doesn't display any values.-Cause-The data source/report shows the unassigned accounts. i.e. it basically shows the accounts that are yet to be assigned to functional areas.-Configuration Path:-Navigate to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select overview and search for activity "Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis".-The mappings of Functional Areas and G/L accounts can be seen.-Resolution-It's a system Behavior.-Keywords-Functional Area Determination, Design Reports.

Title: Error: 'Financial data of business partner XYZ not found' when trying to remove a Company in Payment Data
Content: Symptom-It is neither possible to add new payment data to an account, nor to delete existing payment data.-When trying to remove a company in the payment data, the following error occurs: 'Financial data of business partner XYZ not found' (where XYZ represents the ID of the business partner).- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Account Management work center-Go to Accounts view-Edit the related account-Select Financial Data tab-Select Payment Data subtab-Try to remove the assigned company-Error: "Financial data of business partner XYZ not found (where XYZ represents the ID of the business partner). Also adding another payment method for the assigned company is not possible.-Resolution-Open a SAP Support incident, as this might require a backend correction to remove the affected company code from financial data.-Keywords-deletion; existing payment data; add new; not possible; unable; removal

Title: Extension Field Appears as Blank in Document PDF
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field (either via KUT or SDK) and extended the same for a form template.-However when previewing the form template PDF for a document, the extension field value does not appear, showing instead a blank space.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The binding of the field is incorrect, hence it is not being correctly displayed in the final PDF-Resolution-For most transactional documents in Business ByDesign, you can check the XML file which is used when generating the PDF. In this XML file you can search for the required field, and follow the XML path in Adobe LiveCycle Designer to bind it correctly in your form.-In order to check the mentioned XML, you can follow the below steps (in this case we will take as an example the Purchase Order document):-Go to the Purchase Orders and Requests work center.-Enter the Purchase Orders view.-Open the desired purchase order.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Here, if the document was already sent, you will be able to click on the "View XML Data" button to see the data that was passed to the form template, and adjust the binding accordingly.-Keywords-ALD, Preview, Form Template, ADS, XDP, XSD

Title: Error: 'Extraction not possible, cd 362, try again or create the expense manually' in Mobile App
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to create an expense report by uploading a receipt photo in mobile app.-Error: 'Extraction not possible, cd 362, try again or create the expense manually'-The issue occurs although the scoping question 'Do you want to enable data extraction from attachments for automatic expense creation?' is scoped in the system  - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Use Mobile App-Try to uploading a new picture of an expense respectively using the Button <Extract> in the mobile app-Error Message: 'Extraction not possible, cd 362, try again or create the expense manually'-Cause-The error indicates a backend inconsistency.-Resolution-Create an SAP incident so that development can check and solve this issue.-Keywords-attachment; via; out of; travel; picture; pdf; jpg;

Title: Cash Discount on invoice not showing Expected Value.
Content: Symptom-You have posted a customer invoice but the Maximum Cash Discount is showing the calculation as expected.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the Customer Accounts view.-Search and find Customer ABC and click on view. (ABC represents the Customer Account code).-In the Customer Account Monitor select the customer invoice 123. (123 represents the Customer Invoice ID).-At the bottom of the screen you can see Payment Terms / Due Dates tab.-Maximum Cash Discount is updated with unexpected value or the discount amount picked during the payment of the invoice is showing unexpected value.-Cause-In the customer account monitor when you select this customer invoice the values & amounts may look something like this (please note the following values are just example numbers):-Maximum Cash Discount: -18.000,01-Normal Cash Discount: -6.000,01-Total Invoice value: 660000-Cash Discount Percentage: 3%-To calculate the Maximum Cash Discount the system must first calculate a proportional value.-The Proportional value is calculated by:-Total Item Net Value/ Total Invoice value = proportional value-The system calculates a proportion as follows: 600000/660000 = 0.9090909090909--> This data type can hold only 6 decimal places. So the 6th decimal place needs to be rounded up/down. => 0.909091-Resolution-System is calculating Maximum Cash Discount as expected.-Example:  600000/660000  = 0.909091-Maximum Cash Discount Amount calculation = -1 * proportion * Transaction Amount * Maximum Cash Discount Percentage / 100.-Calculation using this example: -1 * 0.909091 * 660000 * 3 / 100-Maximum Cash Discount:  18,000.01-Keywords- Maximum Cash Discount calculation, normal cash discount calculation taking extra decimals

Title: Error: Currency XXX missing but needed in set of books A, company ABCD
Content: Symptom-You are performing migration of Open Items Receivable and during Simulation you see the error message - Currency XXX missing but needed in set of books A, company ABCD (where "XXX" represents the currency type, "A" represents the set of books ID and "ABCD" represents the company ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Change Immediately or Open.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select effected migration unit.-Click on Execute Migration.-Go to Simulation step.-Here, you see the error message: Currency XXX missing but needed in set of books A, company ABCD.-Cause-You have not maintained the Second Company Currency and Amount. If the company uses two or more set of books with different currencies, then you have to maintain the data in the field "Second Company Currency". Once you have maintained then re-execute the migration. You will not see the error at simulation step.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-See Also-3125401 - Migrate Open Items Receivable/Payable With more Than Two Currencies - Currency Missing but Needed in Set of Books-Keywords-Migration of Open Items Receivable, Error in Open Items Receivable, missing but needed in set of books, byd

Title: Invoice Cancellation, Error Message: Reversal not possible because fixed asset XYZ is retired
Content: Symptom-A Supplier Invoice Cancellation cannot be posted; it generates the following Error Message: 'Reversal not possible because fixed asset XYZ is retired' (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Search for, and select ABC. (ABC represents the Cancellation Invoice's Source Document ID).-Press Actions > Post Business Transaction.-Note: Error Message 'Reversal not possible because fixed asset XYZ is retired' appears.-Cause-The Deactivation Date is before the Posting Date of the Cancellation.-If the Fixed Asset is in Retired status it will prevent the posting of the Invoice Cancellation.-Resolution-The retirement has to be reversed to Capitalized.-In the Fixed Assets work center navigate to the Fixed Assets view and select the retired Fixed Asset XYZ.-Press Edit > Values and navigate to the Journal sub tab.-Press the Source Document ID of the transfer posting to open the Journal Entry Voucher.-Press Edit and then press Reverse.-Now navigate back to the Source documents view of the General Ledger work center, select the Supplier Invoice Cancellation ABC and press Actions > Post Business Transaction.-Note: The Cancellation Invoice is now posted.-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Invoice Cancelation, Source Document, Capitalized, Retired, Post,-fixed asset,retired,invoice cancelation

Title: Tax Rate of 1% in Expense Report for China
Content: Symptom-You want to use tax rate 1% in expense report for China.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2008 onward-Resolution-A new tax code group named "Domestic purchase of goods, small scale manufacturing rate" was delivered since 2008 release. It can be assigned to expense types for China.-It is mapped to tax code 5 - Domestic purchase of goods, small scale manufacturing rate.-You have to configurate the tax rate of tax code 5 to 1% manually with following steps.-Go to Business Configuration - Overview.-Select Tax on Goods and Services.-Select Define Tax Rate Schedules.-Filter CN in the Country/Region field.-Change the rate to 1 from 3 for the entry of 1-VAT in Tax Type and 5 - Small Scale Manufacturing as Tax Rate Type and Valid from 2009.01.01.-Save the changes.-You can assign tax code group  "Domestic purchase of goods, small scale manufacturing rate" to new expense type or existing one with following steps:-Go to Business Configuration - Overview.-Search and open Expense Reporting - China.-Select Edit expense types.-Add one new expense type or select an existing one, select the Tax Code Group as  "Domestic purchase of goods, small scale manufacturing rate" .-Save the changes.-Then such tax code group of  tax rate 1% can be used in new expense report.-Keywords-tax rate 1% expense report, 费用报销单税率 1%, Domestic purchase of goods, small scale manufacturing rate

Title: Error Service call failed While Migrating Service Orders
Content: Symptom-You encounter below error in Service Migration:-Service call failed; report an incident-*Internal Document*-Reproducing the Issue- Business Configuration workcenter-Overview-Search and select Migration of Service Order-Simulate the sample file-Error: Service call failed; report an incident-Dump in Backend : Tcode : ST22-Application Information-Index Information-1 Triggering application component: AP-RC-ILM-RET-2 CX_ILM_BONI_PLUGIN_ERROR, Program:SAPMSSY1, Include:, Position:0-3 Info: ESI contract violation during update in BO SERVICE_ORDER-Active Calls/Events-No. Ty. Program Include Line-Name-21 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM003 66-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>PROCESS_ERROR-20 METHOD CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CM001 24-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION=>CONSTRUCTOR-19 METHOD CL_ESF_GSFPI_DATA_RET_CHECK===CP CL_ESF_GSFPI_DATA_RET_CHECK===CM005 45-CL_ESF_GSFPI_DATA_RET_CHECK=>MODIFY_INBOUND-18 METHOD CL_ESF_GSFPI_DATA_RET_CHECK===CP CL_ESF_GSFPI_DATA_RET_CHECK===CM003 45-CL_ESF_GSFPI_DATA_RET_CHECK=>IF_ESF_GSF_PLUGIN~CORE_SERVICE_INBOUND-17 METHOD CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CP CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CM057 55-CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER=>CALL_PLUGINS_PRE_EXIT-16 METHOD CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CP CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER========CM04F 173-CL_ESF_SERVICE_MANAGER=>IF_ESF_CORE_SERVICES_ACCESSOR~WRITE_GENERIC-15 METHOD CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CP CL_ESF_LCP_BASE===============CM00G 16-CL_ESF_LCP_BASE=>IF_ESF_LCP~MODIFY-14 METHOD CL_MBF_LCP_ACCESS=============CP CL_MBF_LCP_ACCESS=============CM004 13-CL_MBF_LCP_ACCESS=>IF_MBF_LCP_ACCESS~MODIFY-13 METHOD CL_APCRM_SRVO_MBO_IPA=========CP CL_APCRM_SRVO_MBO_IPA=========CM001 104-CL_APCRM_SRVO_MBO_IPA=>IF_SPAF_INB_PA_SYN_WRITE~MODIFY_BO-12 METHOD CL_SPAF_INB_PA_CTRL_SYN=======CP CL_SPAF_INB_PA_CTRL_SYN=======CM006 221-CL_SPAF_INB_PA_CTRL_SYN=>CONTROL_INB_WRITE-Resolution-You can refer the blog Party Role Determination in a Service Document which describes how the sales unit is determined based on the settings in the system.-https://blogs.sap.com/2017/11/29/party-role-determination-in-a-service-document/-Part B of the blog describes the determination of the sales unit using the settings in the Fine-Tune settings for the activity Involved Parties for Service Orders in your Business Configuration Work Center. There are 3 steps defined:--Step 1 -> Sales Unit of Service Execution Team-The system will check the Organizational Work Distribution Rules of the Sales Unit of the Service Execution Team-=> This step is inactive in your system, so although the relevant sales unit is defined in the Organizational Work Distribution Rules of the Sales Unit of the Service Execution Team, it will not be determined because this step is not performed.--Step 2 -> Responsibility Sales Unit for Sales-The system will check the Organizational Work Distribution Rules for the work category Sales Unit.-=> The sales unit is not maintained here.--Step 30 -> Organizational Unit from Org Model if only One Suitable Functional Unit Exits-The system will check if there is only one Organizational Unit which has the Functions Sales/Sales Organization active.-=> This function is active in more than one organizational unit, and therefore this step cannot determine which should be used.--For successful migration of the service orders, you need to configure settings accordingly or add the sales unit to the Account under the Sales Data tab.-Keywords- Service Order Migration, Service Call Failed

Title: External Reference Field is Not Editable While Creating Manual Invoice or Manual Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-When creating a New Manual Invoice Request or a New Manual Credit Memo Request , External Reference field in General section is not editable.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center. -Under Common Tasks select New Manual Invoice. -External Reference in General section is not editable. -Click Adapt and Enter adaption mode.-Edit Screen.-Select General section.-External Reference field is marked as Visible.-Cause-The External Reference field has reference to the external business transaction document and is enabled or disabled based on the settings in the External Reference Number Determination for Customer Invoice fine tuning activity in your Business Configuration. The determination in the Customer Invoice or Credit Memo based on this Manual Invoice Request or Manual Credit Memo Request is also based on the settings in the External Reference Number Determination for Customer Invoice fine tuning activity-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Implementation Projects view. -Select the project and click on Open Activity List button. -Select and Open the activity External Reference Number Determination for Customer Invoice.-For Customer Invoice Processing - Manual Invoicing with Invoice type as Invoice and without Predecessor Customer Invoice checkbox.-Change the Determination Method from Copied from Own ID to Copied from Predecessor Reference ID.-Click on Save and Close.-See Also-1720356 - How To Determine The External Reference In A Customer Invoice-Keywords-Greyed out; Geryout; Gery out; Invoice; Credit Memo; External Reference;

Title: Contract Items are not Renewed Correctly
Content: Symptom-You have created a renewal rule for contracts, which extends the line items, but not release them.-The renewal rule works for the first renewal, but the second renewal does not work.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the Sales Order workcenter.-Select the Contracts view.-Open contract ABC (ABC represents the contract ID).-Open the Items tab.-You can see that the renewal task created the first renewal, but not the second.-Cause-The renewal task does not automatically release the item, which is renewed, unless it is set up in the renewal rule and the Auto Release checkbox is checked.-When the first renewal is processed, the line item 20 in contract ABC is created in status In Preparation.-The renewal task for the next renewal is only created at the time, when you release line item 20.-If the item is released after the next proposed renewal, the renewal task is not created.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The system checks that the validity status is Active for the released line item, before the task is created.-If the release of the line item is after the expiration point of that line item, the item is released with validity Expired.-In this case the renewal task is not created, as the validity condition is not fulfilled.-Make sure that you release the line items before the actual expiration of the line item to have the renewal tasks triggered.-Keywords-Contract, Renewal, Rule, Task, Validity, Release, Vertrag, Erneuerung, Regel, Aufgabe, Validität, Freigabe

Title: Troubleshooting PDI Internal Communication Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-In this Knowledge Base Article, we will look at known issues regarding the Internal Communication topic, and how we can troubleshoot Internal Communication issues. Internal Communication is part of Service Integration (SI is comprised of Web Services, File Input Runs and Internal Communications).---Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Cause-Internal Communications are used to exchange data, asynchronously, between two BO’s that are in different Deployment Units (excluding the Foundation DU).-They use XML to communicate, and do not expect a response as they are asynchronous.-Resolution-Checks in the frontend:-Go to the Administrator work centre.-Go to the Business Data Consistency view.-Select Process Communication Error.-Choose Open Errors with Incidents in the Show dropdown list to view errors that occurred during this process and check if its listed.-Checks in the SDK:-Check the Deployment Units of the Business Objects.-Check if the .PID is active and consistent.-Checks in the backend: -I - Check in MDRS process component is active and its scoped ie Productive.-Check in the MDRS if the process component is scoped or not-Go to MDRS-Open the Affected Business Object-Click on Process Component-Scroll down and check the scoping status it should be Productive-Process component should be Active-II Check the transcation SRT_MONI for any failed message. -III Check the transaction SRT_UTIL for webservice scenarios and check for any errors exist for the service interface.-Check in ST22 if any dump exist after the scenario is completed.-See Also-You can also refer below KBAs.-2578362 - Troubleshooting PDI File Input Run Issues-2657734 - Troubleshooting Web Service issues-Keywords-Troubleshoot,SRT_MONI, PDI, SDK, Custom, Service Integration

Title: Translations are not Appearing in the UI after Uploading the Patch to Test or Production Tenants
Content: Symptom-Translations which are maintained for the fields in the development tenant are not coming up in the UI of the target tenants. This happens after uploading the patch from development to other tenants(test or production).-While the translations are working fine in the development tenant UI.-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer Addins-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cloud Application Studio-Open the Solution in the source system and maintain the translations in the source tenant.-You can use the XLIFF file for translation of the fields.-Once the Assemble is done.-Upload the same patch to the target tenant.-You can see all the translations are transported to the target tenant successfully by checking in SDK(Right click on the solution-> Translation-> Check Status).-You will go and test in the frontend UI, you can see that all the fields are not translated in the respective language. -Cause-This issue is happened because you have used the backend text option for labelling the field in the UI designer.-Resolution-You should use only overridden text for the extension fields to ensure that the translation works fine throughout all the tenants.-Open the UI Designer of the respective screen where you have maintained the translations.-Select the field.-Go to Properties tab.-Under Text information section , select the option Label.-Change the text pool from backend text to overidden text.-See Also- SAP help documentation -Keywords-Translations not working;Fields not translated after upload;missing transplations

Title: Cancelling of Service Confirmation Not Possible Due to Error: Financial posting on fixed on date DD/MM/YYYY blocked
Content: Symptom-You are not able to cancel a Service Confirmation due to the following error: "Posting on DD/MM/YYYY Blocked in Financial Accounting".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmations view.-Open service confirmation XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the service confirmation).-In the General tab enter a reason for rejection.-The following error occurs: "Financial posting on fixed on date DD/MM/YYYY blocked"-Cause-When cancelling a service confirmation the system will take the same posting date for the cancellation as for the original posting when the service confirmation was released. For service confirmations this is the Fixed On date. If the Fixed On date is not maintained the system will use the Created On date as the posting date.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, you can follow either of the following option.-Open relevant period in financial and post the cancellation service confirmation document by following the below steps.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the Sets of Books and Assigned Companies sub-view under Master Data view.-Select the relevant company ID and choose Open and Close Period.-Search for the accounting period relevant for date DD/MM/YYYY. Here you can see that the Period Status of this period is Blocked.-Now select the period and choose Open Periods.-Choose Save button.-If you do not want to open the accounting period, then you can use Set Process Control and choose to post to accounting to some other open period by following the below steps.-First you need to Set Process Control. To do so, following the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select sub-view Master Data under Companies view. Select the relevant company.-Choose Set Process control.-Choose Add Row.-Select Process Control Status as Not Blocked, Business Process Group as 08 - Service Execution Confimation.-Entry Possible Until should be the date by which you want to do the reverse confirmation. Like if you are planning to do it today, then enter today's date.-From Posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ or the date before XX/YY/ZZZZ and To posting Date can be same as XX/YY/ZZZZ  or any day after XX/YY/ZZZZ.-Finally choose Save and Close button.-Now you will be able to cancel the corresponding service confirmation.-Note that it will not post into accounting yet but it will create a business task in General Ledger work center, where you need to select a new posting date for which accounting period is open. -To do  so, follow the below mentioned steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Closing Cockpit--> Closing-Relevant Tasks.-Choose Advance button. In the Related Source Document, enter the service confirmation ID.-Choose Go button. You will get the relevant business task for the cancellation posting in status In Process.-Choose View Business Transaction button.-Now choose Post to Another Period button. In the field Alternate Posting Date, enter a suitable date for which accounting period is currently open.-Then choose OK button. It will take you back to the task screen. Choose Refresh button.-Now the document Processing Status will change from In Process to Finished.-    With this the cancellation posting for the service confirmation will be posted to accounting with the posting date selected by you.-See Also-1523324 - Posting date in journal entry for service provision from CRM document-2869746 - In the Journal Entry from Service Confirmation, Posting Date Refers to the Fixed On Date in Service Confirmation-3168336 - Reverse Service Confirmation - Financial posting on fixed on date blocked-Keywords-Posting Date; Service Confirmation; Cancellation; Posting Period; Financial Posting; Period Blocked;

Title: How to Change the Timezone for a Business User
Content: Symptom-You want to change the timezone for a particular user, since the times shown in the UI are always adapted to the user's timezone.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-In order to change the timezone of the user, you can follow the steps below:-Log in with the respective user.-Click on the user avatar icon on the top right of the screen.-Click on My Settings.-In the Regional Settings, you can change the timezone.-Keywords-UTC, GMT, IST, date

Title: No Approver Determined When Creating New Leave Request
Content: Symptom-When creating new leave request you notice that there is no approver determined. But according to the configuration in your system, leave request needs to be approved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Home work center.-Click New Leave Request.-No approver is determined.-Cause-There is no manager assigned to the org unit which the employee belongs to (reporting line unit manager), then system searches for the higher hierarchy org unit, but there is no manager assigned to either. -Resolution-You need to maintain a org unit manager for either the org unit which the employee belongs to or the higher hierarchy org unit.-See Also-3189450 - Time like e.g. Leave Request Activated Without Approval-Keywords-Leave Request, Approver, Org Unit manager

Title: Error "Enter a valid activity Annual Leave" Occurs When Creating a New Leave Request Through Self-Services Overview
Content: Symptom-When you create a new leave request through self-services overview, below error occurs:-"Enter a valid activity Annual Leave"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center.-Select Self-Services Overview.-In the section Time, select the link New Leave Request.-Then error pops up.-Cause-You have deactivated Time Type Annual Leave in Leave Request, but the Default Value for Leave Request isn't maintained properly.-Resolution-After defaulted time type Annual Leave is deactivated in Fine Tune Activity Time Types - Country, please update Fine Tune Activity Default Values for Time Recording - Country:-Go to Business Confirguation work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Activity Default Values for Time Recording - Country.-Update field "Default Value for Leave Request".-See Also-1249419 - Desired Type of Leave Not Available in New Leave Request-2118734 - Error Message: Activity Not Valid - When Releasing Recorded Times-Keywords-Leave Request; Employee Time Types; Default Values for Time Recording; Annual Leave

Title: Incorrect Amount calculated for Invoice Schedule in Contracts
Content: Symptom-Incorrect calculation for Invoice Schedule when specify the List price per unit in months and enter the Invoice schedule date in days. For example, you have set the List price for item as 1000 USD per month and Invoice schedule you add a date for 10 days, calculated amount is not as expected.- Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Work center: Sales Orders.-View: Contracts-Show: All Contracts-Search for contract ID XXX(XXX is the ID of the affected Product)-Go to Items tab, you have maintained the List price as 1000 USD per month-Now to Pricing and Invoicing tab-Under Invoice Schedule sub-tab, add the quantity as 10 days. -The amount calculated for 10 days is not the expected amount.-Cause-The calculation is as below:-So the Amount for 1 month is 1000 USD-Amount for 1 day 1000/30.436875=32.8548840-Amount for 10 days: 328.5488408386209, -Rounded off to 2 decimal value would be 328.55-The reason being the months do not have always the same quantity of days. Also, the conversion between days and months is a known conversion and  is not necessary to maintain this conversion in the master data.-This is a business decision to have the definition of 1 month = 30,436875 days. This is based on the Gregorian calendar, where a month length is defined as 30.436875 days.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior. In order to make number of days an integer (30 or 31 days), you will have to manually edit the data in the UoM field in the business document.-Keywords-Contract; Month; Days; Calculation

Title: Industry Field Update not Working Using Mass Data Maintenance for Private Accounts
Content: Symptom-Industry field is not getting updated for Private Accounts via Mass Data Maintenance.-You want to use in the Industry field for reporting purposes and use Mass Data Maintenance to update Private Account with Industry field value.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance workcenter-Select Customer Import link-Add Industry column value for Private Accounts and upload the file-Nothing happens, you cannot see Industry Field in UI of Private Accounts-Cause-  Private Account does not have Industry field in UI, it is only present for Corporate Accounts. As the field is not available in UI, create/ update / edit is not possible for this field.-Hence, you cannot see the data in any report for Private Accounts Industry field.-Resolution-System is showing standard behavior.-Keywords-Private Account, Industry

Title: SSO Logon Is Not Working For Excel Add-in But Is Working Fine When Logging Directly Into System
Content: Symptom-You are trying to logon via SSO to the SAP Excel Add-in. But you are getting error:-"Sorry, but you are currently not authorized for Access".-If you try to logon to C4C/ByD directly with the same SSO user, there is no issue.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Excel.-Click on the ByDesign Add-in.-Try to Logon via SSO.-Error.-Cause-This could be due to an issue with an older version of the Excel Add-in.-Resolution-Please kindly download the latest version of the Add-in from the downloads section in your system and test again. -Keywords-Excel, Single Sign-On, SSO, Cloud for Customer, C4C, ByDesign, ByD

Title: How to determine the account records that were not (successfully) processed through Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User is performing Mass Data Maintenance of Customers (Accounts) and observed few records are not imported (Failed; Not Started). Since it is not possible to download the delta file with unprocessed records, this KBA helps to identify such records using a backend report-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Go to Import Customer link-Upload file -Validate the data and Execute-There are records with failed and not started status -Cause-Refer to KBA 3416030 - Few Records Missing After Mass Data Maintenance Import-Resolution-Contact ByD Technology PAL for executing the below report-Source Code: Attached with this KBA - MDM_REPORT.txt -Create a local report in SE38 using this source code (package: Local object)-Steps to create the report are given below:-1.Go to SE38.-2.Enter a program name and click Create.-3.Paste the code from MDM_REPORT.txt.-4.Click Activate.-5.Return to SE38.-6.Select the program created, using the value help.-7.Enter the file name from Mass Data Maintenance for which you want to check the records.-8.Execute the report to see the Failed and Not Started records for that file.-This report shows the Accounts in the inputted file with status of the instance-Please note:-If multiple files with the same file name are uploaded in the Mass Data Maintenance work center, the SE38 report will combine and show all failed records together under that file name.-To view the failed records separately for each file in the backend, please upload each file with a unique name in the Mass Data Maintenance view. This will ensure the SE38 report displays the failed records separately for each file.-Keywords-MDM, not started, failed, unprocessed

Title: Cannot access View Scope for closed Change Project
Content: Symptom-While trying to access view scope for a closed change project, the below error message is displayed:--"You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings, caused by one or more Customer-Specific Solutions." -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select a closed Project.-Click on View Project scope.-You will see the error "You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings, caused by one or more Customer-Specific Solutions." -Cause-Once the remote change project is merged successfully, the connection between the two tenants are discontinued, and hence the reference to the remote tenant.-Here in this case, all are closed change project which do not hold any reference to the remote tenant, but only to the current tenant.-The cause is a difference of PDI solution versions in the change project and main workspace, thus the user is getting the error.-Resolution-To resolve the issue you would need to keep the same version of PDI for closed project and tenant.-Keywords-Closed Project, Change Project, Scope View, "You are not authorized to access the solution profile. The solution profile does not match your user settings, caused by one or more Customer-Specific Solutions."

Title: System dumps when uploading new IDP file
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**INTERNAL USE ONLY**-Customer is trying to upload a new IDP meta data file due to an expiring certificate but the system dumps.-If you check in the ST22, the error says "Info: Certificate cannot be saved in address book".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Go to Configure SSO subview.-Go to Identity Provider tab.-Click New Identity Provider.-Cause-The issue is happening due to a conflicting record in the address book.-Resolution-A report program SEC_FIND_CONFLICTING_SAML_CERT has be released as part of ByD 2302 release. It finds the conflicting old certificates in STRUSTCAB2 with an option to delete the same.-Open the system backend.-Go to IAM_TOOLS t-code.-Scroll down to 'Other tools'.-Click 'Find conflicting certificates in the address book'.-Select one of the checkboxes.-Execute.-Upload the file.-It will return the conflicting certificate and/or delete it.-Keywords-certificate, address book, dump, 500 internal server error, identity provider, expiring, expired, idp, meta data

Title: Process Communication Error in Sales Order for Country Spain
Content: Symptom-The following error appears in a sales order document:-Saving not possible due to status of document-Please maintain the correct combination of VAT and Equalization rates-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Select Sales Order view-Under the drop-down, select All Orders-Search for sales order ABC (Where ABC represents the sales order ID)-Click in Edit / View All-Go to Document Flow tab-Process Communication Error is visible for Sales Order ABC.-In addition, the Process Communication error is also visible by following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Under Business Data Consistency view, select Process Communication Errors sub-view-From the drop-down, select Open Errors With Incidents-Click in the Advanced Search-Under Sending Document ID, search for the relevant sales order-The following errors are visible:-Saving not possible due to status of document-Please maintain the correct combination of VAT and Equalization rates-Cause-The error appears due to the combination of the Tax Rate Types against one of the Sales Order Line Items.-Go to the Sales Order work center-Select the view Sales Orders-Search and find Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Go to the Items tab-Select a line item and select Taxes tab-Here you will see the Tax details maintained against the line items.-Each Line item has 2 Tax Types maintained against it.-One Tax Type for VAT and another Tax Type for Equalization.-Both the Tax Types must have the same Tax Rate Types maintained.-For example, if Tax Type VAT has Tax Rate Type: Reduced then the Tax Type Equalization should also match the Tax Rate Type: Reduced.-Resolution-To solve the issue, you need to make sure that the Tax Rate Types are the same.-Please refer to Spanish Tax Agency website which refers to the rates for further details:-Equalization Tax Rates - Spain-Keywords-Spain, Equalization, Rates, error, tax rate type.
