Title: Delete button is not activated to delete PI Count Documents.
Content: Symptom-Delete button is not activated to delete PI Count Documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Go to Monitoring view and Choose By PI Count Document sub-view.-Find and select the Count Document XXX (XXX represents the Physical Inventory count Document ID).-Select the Edit button.-Go to the Count Tasks tab.-Here you can see the Not Started 'Task YYY' (YYY represents the Task ID), but you cannot find any option to cancel or delete it.-Cause-If physical count document is system generated, then it is not enabling delete button.-Resolution-This is standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Physical Inventory, PI Count Document, Count Tasks, delete button.

Title: Exchange Rates are not Visible
Content: Symptom-A team member has performed changes / updates within the Exchange Rates and you are not able to see these changes. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Edit Exchange Rates from the Common Tasks.-You are not able to see the changes or newer updates.-And the following warning shows:-Different user and system time zone. Check that the date/time conversion from user to system time zone does not lead to a date change. SAP recommends to use a user having system time zone. User time zone (UTC-05:00) Eastern Time (New York, Quebec), system time zone (UTC+00:00) Burkina Faso, Bouvet Islands, Cote d'Ivoire, West Sahara, Ghana, Greenland, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Heard/McDon.Isl, Brit.Ind.Oc.Ter, Iceland. -Resolution-In order to see the changes performed, please change the logged on user's time zone to match the time zone of the user who performed such change.-Click on the user icon (top right).-Select My Settings.-Change the Time Zone.-Click Save and Close.-Log off and log in again.-Now you will be able to view the changes performed.-See Also-2150175 - Warning / Information Message While Accessing Exchange Rate Screen-Keywords-Exchange Rates, Invisible, View, Update, Changes, Different user and system time zone, Check that the date/time conversion from user to system time zone does not lead to a date change, SAP recommends to use a user having system time zone

Title: Cannot delete the Service Confirmation because of the error "Deletion of header not possible due to status".
Content: Symptom-You Cannot delete the Service Confirmation because of the error "Deletion of header not possible due to status" even though the status is Not started.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Field Service and Repair work center-Go to Service Confirmations View-Search for Service Confirmation XXX(XXX is the ID of the Service Confirmation)-You can see that the Service Confirmation is in status "Not Started", however when you click on delete button you get the error "Deletion of header not possible due to status" -Cause-Service Confirmation XXX cannot be Canceled if it is not manually created. Service confirmation XXX is created from Goods and Service Receipt YYY(YYY is the ID of Goods and Service Receipt).-   Resolution-In order to Cancel the Service Confirmation, you have to first Cancel the Goods and service receipt YYY and then set the reason for rejection in the service confirmation XXX.-Keywords-Service Confirmation; cannot Delete; Not started;

Title: Restricted Stock Has Zero On-hand Stock and Free Quantity in Common Task New Removal.
Content: Symptom-Restricted stock has zero on-hand stock and free quantity in common task New Removal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open common task Stock Overview, search product ABC (ABC represents product ID) in a specific site and logistics area, there are some restricted on-hand stock, whose identified stock is DEF (DEF represents identified stock ID).-Open common task New Removal,  search product ABC in same site and logistics area, for the line item whose identified stock is DEF, both on-hand stock and free quantity are zero.-Cause-Restricted stock will not be regarded as on-hand stock and free quantity for removal.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior. -You can remove the restricted indicator from the stock through Change of Stock and then perform removal.-Keywords-New Removal, Restricted, On-hand Stock, Free Quantity

Title: Error Occurs While Trying to Download the Customer Project Overview Report
Content: Symptom-You are getting an error message while trying to download the customer project overview report. -Error - Failed to open report "Internal Server Error" - Report an incident-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Search for Customer Project Overview report-Filter report with status and Execute-Try to Download in XML or CSV format-Error appears-Cause-Usually the error can be raised in the following circumstances:-- The number of records that is requested in the report is too high.-- The report is running out of memory due to the number of records that are processed in combination with the modeling of the custom data source / report.-- The report is running for too long and results in a time-out.-Resolution-The easiest way to avoid the error is to reduce the amount of records with a selection on some variables in the report (Edit Selection tab). For example, if a report crashes when selecting data for a full year, try to run it in two packages (one package for the first half of the year and one package for the second half). -Keywords-System dumps while Trying to Download the Customer Project Overview Report; Crashes While Trying to Download the Customer Project Overview Report; Download Customer Project Overview Report; 500 internal server error while Trying to Download the Customer Project Overview Report

Title: Form Template Settings Displaying Incorrectly in the E-mail
Content: Symptom-The subject & document name is displaying incorrectly in the e-mail, while performing the output of a invoice document using the form template-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Maintaining E-mail Subject & Document Name:-Go to the Application and User Management Work Center-Navigate to the Form Template Maintenance Work Center View-In the column Form Template, filter for the template (Example :Customer Invoice )-Mark the Customer invoice Template  -Select Actions button-In dropdown, Select Maintain E-mail subject & Save it-Select Actions button-In dropdown, Select Maintain Document Name-Save your Changes-Releasing the Customer Invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center-Navigate to Invoice Requests Work Center View-Select any Invoice ID & Edit it-Release the Invoice Document-Navigate to the Output History tab-You can see status is Successful & Sent by E-Mail-E-mail will be triggered to the maintained Mail id with Incorrect data-Cause-The cause for this issue is with language code is missing in the advance filter of the Form Template Maintenance view.-Resolution-We have taken example as Portuguese language-When the Portuguese language code is missing in the advance filter of the Form Template Maintenance view. Follow below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center -Navigate to the Overview Work Center View-Under Business Configuration Search Choose Activities-Search for Activity- Additional Communication Language-Open the Activity-Do check box allowed for Portuguese-Save and Close-Once you perform above steps the Portuguese will come in drop down selection of language in Form Template Maintenance view.-Regenerate the affected invoice the data will be displayed correctly in the e-mail.-Keywords-subject & document name, data displaying incorrectly in the e-mail, Form Template Settings

Title: Error on the Sales Order: Retrieving Incoterms From Configuration Not Possible
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You find an error on sales order: Retrieving incoterms from configuration not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the order ABC, you can see the error 'Retrieving incoterms from configuration not possible.' at the bottom.-ABC represents the sales order ID.-Cause-In the sales order ABC, the incoterms is filled with value XYZ, but if you open the drop down list of the field, this value XYZ is not available any more.-Also in the Business Configuration Activity: Incoterms, XYZ is not existed.-XYZ represents the ID of the Incoterms.-Resolution-Remove XYZ from the incoterms field in the order, and select it again with a valid value.-Keywords-Sales order; incoterms; Retrieving incoterms from configuration not possible.

Title: Error 'No Bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XYZ, national bank code, and currency DEF' in Format CSV in utf-8.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The system rejects the upload of a bank statement in format CSV in utf-8 with the following error message:-No bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number XYZ, national bank code , and currency DEF found (DEF represents the currency).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management work center.-Navigate to the File Management view and choose Inbound Files.-Select New and Inbound File.-Select the file (format: CSV in utf-8) containing the bank statement(s) via Add for the selected house bank.-Press Start File Upload.-For a given company and house-bank this file refers to Bank Account ID XYZ and Bank Account Number ABC. -Cause-In the CSV template provided by SAP - column 'My Bank Account ID' functions as bank account identifier.-You have filled column 'My Bank Account ID' with corresponding 'Bank Account ID' XYZ.-Resolution-The Bank Account ID is an internal attribute which usually would not be referenced by an issuing house bank (unless Bank Account ID and Bank Account Number).-Here the Bank Account Number ABC as external identifier would have to be filled in column 'My Bank Account ID'. -See Also-KBA:  1940792 - Error Message: 'No Bank account active on DD.MM.YYYY for account number, national bank code, and currency XYZ'

Title: Service Confirmation with Status "Not Started" Not Available in "Recorded Employee Times" Report
Content: Symptom-Service confirmations with status "Not Started" are not available in "Recorded Employee Times " report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue--1.Go to Field Service and Repair work center-2.Go to Service Confirmations view-3.Filter by all confirmation -4.Select Service Confirmation with status "Not Started"-  Now,-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports-Search for Recorded Employee Times-Select Key date and execute the report-Go to View button-Go to add row fields and select -Service Confirmation and Service Confirmation Item-Go to Selection at the top -Filter and add the "Service confirmation" under the "Service confirmation"-Service confirmations with not started status are not available in report-Cause-If the service confirmation is in the status "Not Started" the task is not completed by the assigned employee so the time recording does not exist.-Resolution-If you navigate to-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports-Search for Recorded Employee Times-Select Key date and execute the report-Go to View button-Go to add row fields and select -Service Confirmation and Service Confirmation Item-Go to Selection at the top -Filter and add the "Service confirmation" under the "Service confirmation"-Service confirmations with not started status are not available in report-This is a system standard scenario-Keywords-Recorded Employee Times, Business Analytics, Service Confirmations, Status, Not Started

Title: You Are Not Able to Change the Contract via Web Service Due to Error: "Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER_CONTRACT does not exist"
Content: Symptom-You are going to change the value in an existing contract via web service payload. But failed and got message in the response:-"Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER_CONTRACT does not exist".-In this case, you are going to update the contract administrator party role in the contract.-        <CustomerContract actionCode="02">-            <ID>ABC</ID>-            <ContractAdministratorParty actionCode="02">-               <PartyID>123</PartyID>-            </ContractAdministratorParty>-         </CustomerContract>-ABC represents the contract ID and 123 represents the contract administrator ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-execute the payload in SOAP UI.-Cause-The error message suggests that you are trying to adjust data, which is not created at the time.-Resolution-Use the actionCode 04 instead of 02 for the update calls, which will create or change nodes.-        <CustomerContract actionCode="04">-            <ID>ABC</ID>-            <ContractAdministratorParty actionCode="04">-               <PartyID>123</PartyID>-            </ContractAdministratorParty>-         </CustomerContract>-Keywords-update; action code 02; action code 04; II_MANAGE_CUCO_IN; ManageCustomerContractIn; "Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER_CONTRACT does not exist".

Title: Error Message 'File validation failed. Create an case' While Migrating Open Items Receivable
Content: Symptom-When you try to migrate Open Items Receivable, system throws below error message:-File validation failed. Create an case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the migration activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Execute Migration for the respective unit.-Highlight the Migration File (Open Items Receivable).-Select Process File.-Error message is thrown: 'File validation failed. Create an case'.-Cause-some date entries are in error-Resolution-Enter the dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration

Title: Supplier invoice Installments being considered in payment run
Content: Symptom-You have created multiple installments (Split open items) for a Supplier invoice, and they are considered in the payment runs even though the invoice is blocked for payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Payables work center-Open Supplier account related to Invoice-Under open items, create split for the invoice and based on splits multiple open items are created.-Now under same work center, create a payment run and you see the splits are considered eventhough the invoice already has the payment block-Cause-Current system design-Resolution-For newly generated split invoices, system does not carry forward payment block information from original invoice.-This is the reason payment run considers split invoice items in payment proposals creation.-Keywords-Split, Invoice, Payment run

Title: You Want to Know Whether Invoice Summary Document Includes Other Receivable / Other Payable
Content: Symptom-You wonder whether invoice summary document include Other receivable/ Other payable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Invoice Summary Documents view.-Search for invoice summary document ID: AAA (AAA represents the invoice summary document ID), and it includes Other receivable/ Other payable.-However, when you search for invoice summary document ID: BBB (BBB represents the invoice summary document ID), it does not include Other receivable/ Other payable.-You wonder why the invoice summary documents behave differently.-Cause-SAP Business ByDesign does not support Other receivable/ Other payable documents in Japan invoice summary documents since 2018 as this requirement is not legally mandatory.-When you check invoice summary document AAA, you can see it is created before 2018, and invoice summary document BBB is created after 2018.-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-invoice summary document, other receivable, other payable, Japan

Title: Error 'G/L account (origin) is missing for sales line item with G/L account Cost of Sales' during New Journal Entry Voucher creation
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new journal entry voucher with the type 00088- Manual Entry for Sales Documents and 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc and encounter error 'G/L account (origin) is missing for sales line item with G/L account Cost of Sales' upon posting or simulation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger work center and New Journal Entry Voucher with the type 00088- Manual Entry for Sales Documents and 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Enter 'Cost of sales' G/L account which includes Sales document details and a debit entry-Enter 2 more rows with 2 different 'Costs or expenses' G/L account and hit simulate to encounter error message.-The message is not thrown when 2nd and 3rd row contains same G/L account even though the 1st row has a blank G/L Account (Origin) field-Cause-System is behaving as expected.-Resolution-If there exists more than one expense or revenue lines with different G/L Accounts, you must enter a valid G/L Account (Origin) for the sales ledger lines. Hence system throws error message.-See Also-Manual Entries for Sales Documents: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cc26fd7722d1014805fb12e7529365e.html-Keywords-JEV, Manual Entries for Sales Documents, G/L Account (Origin)

Title: After Migrating a Contract via the Migration Tool, the Price Component Surcharge (Gross) is Not Visible in the Created Contract
Content: Symptom-Price component Surcharge (Gross) has not been determined after migration of a contract via the migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Select Contracts view.-Show: All Contracts.-Search for contract ID ABC (Where ABC represents the contract ID).-Click in Edit and go to Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Under Pricing - Item Pricing, expand line items.- You notice that the Surcharge (Gross) is not present in the document.-Cause-The reason price component Gross Surcharge is not being passed via the contract migration is due to missing data maintained under Product and Service Portfolio work center  - Surcharges (Gross) sub-view.-Resolution-In order to determine the Surcharge (Gross) in a migrated contract, you first need to maintain the data under Product and Service Portfolio work center  - Surcharges (Gross) sub-view.-The Surcharge (Gross) can only be determined via the system if a Surcharge (Gross) list is maintained for each combination of sales organization and distribution channel used in a customer contract.-Also, before executing the migration, you need to indicate the values to be passed as Gross by selecting "Gross Migration Template" under the General section of the Migration Template, otherwise, the system will migrate the values as Net.-See Also-Help Center Documentation:-Configuration: Migration of Customer Contracts-Keywords-Pricing, Migration, template, tool, Sales documents, Sales Order, Contracts, price component.

Title: Sales Order Line Item Delivery Status and Invoice Status Not Changed to Completed After Reason For Rejection is Maintained
Content: Symptom-Sales Order line item delivery status and invoice status not changed to completed even though the reason for rejection is maintained for the line item. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders Processing view.-Edit Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represent Sales order ID) and click on View all.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select line item and the under General sub tab Reason for Rejection is maintained.-Line item delivery status and invoice status not changed to completed-Cause-Cancellation of sales order item does not mean that the delivery and invoice is finished and hence the delivery and invoice status is not affected by cancellation.-Resolution-This is the intended system behavior.-Keywords-Not Started status to Completed;

Title: Outlook Add-in reports errors for Contacts
Content: Symptom-SAP-Business ByDesign Add-In for Outlook reports errors when synchronizing contacts.-Reproducing the Issue-While synchronizing contacts via Outlook Add-in, below errors are observed:-You can assign party role Contact Responsible only once to business partner XXXXXXX (where XXXXXXX is Business Partner ID)- Cause-It is not possible to store more than one responsible per contact.-SAP already reports an error and it cannot be saved. -Resolution-There is one Contact Responsible and then more Additional Contact Responsible.-You can try adding more Additional Contact Responsible instead of Contact Responsible.-Keywords-Contact Responsible, Business Partner, Outlook Add-in

Title: Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China Report unable to compare Periods in same Year
Content: Symptom-You are trying to complete a Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China report and compare periods in the same year, however you receive the error "Comparison year must be earlier than current year".-Remark: this KBA is also valid for statutory report Balance Sheet and Income Statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Statutory Reports.-Select the report Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China. -Enter Year as YYYY.-Enter same year in the Comparison Year field.-Error appears:-"Comparison year must be earlier than current year".-Cause-Completing a comparison in the same year can only be completed if Company is Chinese.-Resolution-As per the current system behaviour, the report "Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China" is specifically developed for China.-If your Company/Region of Registration is China, the report can be used to compare different periods of same year.-If your Company/Region of Registration is any other country, the report cannot be used to compare different periods of same year and error "Comparison year must be earlier than current year" will be raised.-You can check the Company/Region of Registration under the definitions tab of the Company file.-Keywords-Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China, Chinese, Comparison year must be earlier than current year, Balance Sheet and Income Statement, Statutory Report,

Title: Process Communication Error - 'Individual material 'ZZZ' already assigned in parallel session' occurred in Supplier Invoice.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are facing a Process Communication Error in Supplier Invoice 'XXX' as below. ('XXX' refers to Supplier Invoice)-1) Cannot save Fixed Asset 'YY'. ('YY' refers to Fixed Asset)-2) Individual material 'ZZZ' already assigned in parallel session. ('ZZZ' refers to IMAT ID)-You understand that Individual material ID has been assigned to Multiple Fixed Assets.- --Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-2) Go to Invoices and Credit Memos sub view-3) Search for the Supplier Invoice 'XXX'.  ('XXX' refers to Supplier Invoice)-4) Click that and go to the document flow. There you will see the Process Communication Error.-Cause-When checked in the Backend, you can able to see the error messages as below.-1) Cannot save Fixed Asset 'YY'. ('YY' refers to Fixed Asset)-2) Individual material 'ZZZ' already assigned in parallel session. ('ZZZ' refers to IMAT ID)-This error occurs because the Individual material 'ZZZ' has been assigned to multiple Fixed Asset which is causing the Process Communication Error and leads to failed XI message in the Backend. If you try to remove the IMAT ID, system won't allow you to remove the Individual material. The remove button will be greyed out. -Note: IMAT is mandatory for any Fixed asset and you cannot remove IMAT from the Fixed Asset from UI.-Resolution-When this kind of issue persists, Support has to create Incident to Development Support as they need to make the prior correction from the backend to do the Cancellation Invoice for the affected Supplier Invoice 'XXX'.-Initially if you check in the backend that IMAT should be unique for each Fixed Assets and it cannot be repeated as per the logic available in below methods.-Methods:-VAL_ASSOCIATED_IMAT (CL_FIA_V_FXA_CONSISTENCY) -INDMAT_ASSIGNED_TO_OTHER_FXA (CL_FIA_H_FXA_ASSOC_IMAT_NODE)-Steps:-1) The Cancellation postings of Supplier Invoice 'XXX' should be bypassed with the error and Journal Entry should be posted for the same via Backend.-2) After the Postings of Journal Entry the acquisition value of Fixed Asset 'YY' should get reversed correctly and IMAT status should become 'Assigned' from 'Acquired'. -Please Note: IMAT value should be corrected for Fixed Asset before doing any type of Journal Entry postings on this particular Fixed Asset to avoid the original error 'IMAT already assigned to another Fixed Asset' in future.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2077695-Keywords-Individual Material, Parallel session, Fixed Asset, Supplier Invoice, Process Communication Error, Acquisition Value.

Title: PSM Request Release For BO Address Snapshot
Content: Symptom-User requests PSM release for BO Address Snapshot for "public read and write access"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-As it has multiple dependencies it is not possible to release the required BO Address Snapshot for "public read and write access".-Resolution-This would be a new requirement . -Our recommendation is post this as an enhancement idea over our Influence platform. -The same is monitored by our Product Management team, and posts are considered for next releases of the system.- You can access the Influence forum in the link below:-https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-For more info on influence form please check the link : https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2531650-Keywords-PSM Requests, release, Communication Arrangement, public write access, collaboration data

Title: Output Settings for Changed PO is not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-You have selected output channel for change purchase order by Edit Output Settings for Changed PO and send update. But when you want to update the purchase order again, you find that the new output is not via expected channel you defined in Edit Output Settings for Changed PO.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center, Purchase Orders view.-Find and open the target purchase order.-Click on You Can Also->Edit Output Settings for Changed PO.-The output channel is Printer by default for example. Change it to E-Mail.-Make some changes to the purchase order, click on Send Update.-Navigate to Output History tab and see that the output is sent by E-Mail as defined.-Stay in the purchase order screen. Continue making changes to this purchase order.-Click on Send Update button and navigate to Output History tab again.-The latest output is by Printer.-Cause-This is a normal system behavior. Output channel for Changed PO has to be decided per update.-Resolution-Every time making changes to the purchase order, decide the output channel specifically. -See Also-KBA 2678740 - How is the Output Channel of a Purchase Order Determined-Keywords-Output; Purchase Order; Edit Output Settings for Change PO; Output Channel

Title: Unable to remove "Actual hours worked" times from an employee's time file
Content: Symptom-You are trying to remove times named "Actual hours worked" from an employee's time file, but the "Remove" button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the relevant employee.-Click Edit.-Go to Employee Times tab.-Select any line with time "Actual hours worked".-The Remove button is greyed out.-Cause-These times cannot be removed because they have been booked through Service Confirmations and these documents are already in finished status.-Once the cycle of a document is finished, you cannot remove the times related to it.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-GB0001 - Actual hours worked, time file, time profile, delete, time type

Title: System Dumps during new Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new Journal Entry Voucher and when the company code is entered, system dumps-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to General Ledger work center-Open New Journal Entry Voucher and Add company Code-System dumps-Cause-Issue usually occurs when there's no Set of books maintained for the company code-Resolution-Missing mapping has to be maintained to solve the issue as per below path.-Navigate to Business Configuration work center and Overview-Search and open the activity Set Of Books -Select the Set of books and Click Edit-Add Company under company settings and save it

Title: In Customer Invoice Seller Tax Number is Maintained Multiple Times in Output XML
Content: Symptom-You would like to know the why Seller Tax number is maintained multiple times in output history XML of the customer invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing -> Invoice Documents -Search for invoice ABC (ABC represents the Invoice ID)-Click View All-Navigate to Output History-View Data XML -Search for SellerTaxIdentificationNumber-The Seller Tax Number is maintained more than once. - Cause-The seller tax numbers are collectively shown based on the business partner details of the seller as well as company tax arrangements. In this case multiple company tax arrangements are maintained under Tax Management for this company. -Resolution-Therefore system will show the seller BP tax number and also the company tax arrangements maintained in the system.  -Keywords-TaxIdentification; IdentificationNumber; Company tax;

Title: You Are Not Able to Run Depreciation Recalculation for Fixed Assets due to Error 'Cost Center does not Exist in Profit Center'
Content: Symptom-You are not able to run depreciation recalculation for the fixed asset 123 due to error message: Cost Center XYZ does not exist in Profit Center DEF.-(123 represents the fixed asset ID. XYZ represents the Cost Center ID. DEF represents the Profit Center ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Depreciation view.-Check the run ID: XXX (XYX represents the depreciation run ID).-Move to the messages tab, and you can see the error message:-Cost Center XYZ does not exist in Profit Center DEF for fixed asset 123. -Cause-The start date of the cost center is later than the start date for the assignment interval of the fixed asset.-Open Cost and Revenue work center.-Navigate to master data - cost centers.-Search for cost center XYZ.-You see that this cost center is valid from date dd.mm.yyyy onwards.-Open Fixed Asset work center.-Select Fixed Assets view and click edit - master data.-Under tab basic data you see that start date for the assignment interval of fixed asset 123 is earlier than dd.mm.yyyy.-Resolution-Open Fixed Asset work center.-Select Fixed Assets view and click edit - master data.-Navigate to sub-tab basic data.-Under header all assignment intervals, click add row.-Add a new assignment interval with a date later than creation date of cost center XYZ.-Confirm with save.-Afterwards you should be able to run depreciation recalculation for the fixed asset.-This scenario only appears for migrated fixed assets.-If you create a fixed asset in SAP Business ByDesign, it is not possible to create an assignment interval which is earlier than the start date of the cost center.-See Also-2076699 - You are not able to scrap Fixed Asset as Cost center does not exist in profit center-Keywords-depreciation recalculation, cost center, profit center

Title: Wrong Transport Lane Selected As Source Of Supply
Content: Symptom-- The system selects the transport lane linked to the Global transport zone instead of the transport lane specific to the country of the ship-to location.-- This issue is observed when editing a sales order in the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Outbound Logistics Control work center.-2. Navigate to the Customer Demand view.-3. Search for the relevant sales order, select it and choose the Edit button.-4. Navigate to the Line Items tab and choose the Sub-tab Alternative Sources.-5. Observe that the system has selected the Source of Supply as the lane linked to the Global transport zone, not the lane linked to the zone specific to the ship-to location.-Cause-The system is not selecting the transport lane specific to the ship-to location because the transport lane connected to the global zone has a shorter shipping duration.-Resolution-1. Set the priority of the transport lane that needs to be selected as higher than the one you do not prefer. This takes precedence over any other settings.-2. Change the shipping duration of the lane that needs to be selected to a shorter one.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign User Guide: Managing Transport Lanes-Ship-From Determination and Shipment Scheduling for Customer Demand-Keywords

Title: Period Type Field Is Not Visible In Data Source Material Planning
Content: Symptom-- In the SAP Business ByDesign system, the "Period Type" field is not found in the data source "Material Planning" (ID: MAT_PLANNING).-- This issue is encountered when selecting the value "3" in the "Lot-Sizing Method" field and attempting to add the "Period Type" field to the Row Fields in the report screen.-- The "Period Type" field is expected to be available as all other necessary fields are present.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Business Analytics work center.-2. Go to the Design Data Sources view.-3. Search for the data source with ID "MAT_PLANNING" and select the Preview button.-4. In the report screen, under the selection option, choose the value "3" in the "Lot-Sizing Method" field.-5. Click the Apply button.-6. Under the View option, select the plus symbol against the Row Fields.-7. Notice that the "Period Type" field is not listed among the available fields.-Cause-The "Period Type" field is not directly available in the "Material Planning" data source.-Resolution-The "Period Type" field value can be identified via the "Calendar Unit" field available in the "Material Planning" data source.-See Also-- SAP Business ByDesign Help Center: Working with Data Sources-- SAP Community: Business Analytics in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Data Source, Material Planning, MAT_PLANNING, Period Type, Field Unavailable, Calendar Unit, Business Analytics, Lot-Sizing Method.

Title: System Dumps While Uploading a New Certificate
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a new certificate , but the upload fails with the message 500 SAP Internal Server Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management Work Center-Navigate to Certificate Trust List view -Choose Edit Certificate Trust List view -Select upload & Browse the Certificate-Select the relevant Certification Authority certificate-Choose Open & Add the File-You will see 500 SAP Internal Server Error -Cause-The cause for this behavior is inconsistency in the certificate.-Resolution-This needs to be check by ADFS (Active Directory Federation Services) where you get the certificate from your service provider, please contact your certificate issuer who have issued the certificate.-Keywords-500 SAP Internal Server Error ,Dump , Uploading new certificate, Service provider

Title: "Currently Unable to Finalize These Scope Changes" Error When Trying to Remove Self-Procurement from Scope
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to remove self-procurement from the scope of the system, however the system raises the following error when trying to finish the changes:-"Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Implementation Projects view.-Select the current project.-Click on the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Scoping step of the wizard.-De-select the Self-Procurement scoping element.-After proceeding to the finish of the scoping wizard, the error is raised.-Cause-The Self-Procurement scoping element is responsible for the activation of the Shopping Carts feature.-It is not possible to remove a scoping element if there is data which is still pending processing in its lifecycle. In this case, there are shopping carts which are not closed/completed which are blocking the scope change.-Resolution-Before being able to remove the Self-Procurement scoping element, you need to complete/close all data related to this functionality, including shopping carts.-Keywords-Purchasing, Self-Service, Go Shopping

Title: You Are Not Able To Select 'Payment Block Reason' In The Report
Content: Symptom-The field 'payment block reason' is not populated in the report 'Aging List for Receivables'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Report view.-Search and click on the report: 'Aging List for Receivables'.-You hope to filter the report by 'payment block reason', but it shows as 'not assigned'.-Cause-Payment block reason (trade receivables payables account) is not added to the report for selection.-Resolution-You need to add payment block reason (trade receivables payables account) to the report:-Click on 'configure' button, and choose 'add field'.-Search and add 'payment block reason (trade receivables payables account)'.-Tick 'display in selection'.-Now you are able to filter the report with the payment block reason.-Keywords-payment block reason, cannot select in report

Title: Error "Action Create is not supported within delivery" While Trying to Create Customer Return Notification via Webservice
Content: Symptom-Error "Action Create is not supported within delivery" while trying to create Customer Return Notification via Webservice.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You are using Update request XML <glob:CustomerReturnNotificationBundleUpdateRequest_sync> instead of Create request XML <glob:CustomerReturnNotificationBundleCreateRequest_sync>. -Resolution-Go to Application and User Management - Service Explorer -Search for ManageCustomerReturnNotificationIn-Select the Service "Create customer return notifications"-Download the XML -Keywords-customer return notification payload error; <Note>Action Create is not supported within delivery</Note>;

Title: Error: "Start date must not overlap with another planned period" during Project Migration
Content: Symptom-You are migrating a project using migration tool. When you are executing the import, you meet error: Start date must not overlap with another planned period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center -> Overview.-Search for activity: Prepare for Data Migration and open it.-Click on the hyperlink: Download Migration Templates.-Select "Projects" and click on "Download" button.-Fill in the template accordingly (the template is .xml, open it in Excel). -Go back to Business Configuration work center -> Overview.-Search for activity: Migration of Projects and open it.-Click on the hyperlink: Migrate projects using the migration tool.-In Migrate Projects screen, click on "Upload"->"Data from Migration Template".-Choose the template file and upload it.-Click on "Execute Migration"->"Execute Migration Step by Step".-At step 3: Simulate Import or step 4: Execute Import, there is error: Start date must not overlap with another planned period.-Cause-The template file contains duplicate work records with same Start Date and End Date, so they are overlapping each other.-Resolution-Method 1:-Open the template file, navigate to "Work" sheet -Keep only one combination of Service ID & Team Member & Start and End Date.-Reupload the edited template file and execute rest steps.-Method 2:-Stay at Migrate File screen.-Click on "Edit Source Record" and remove redundant records with combination of Service ID & Team Member & Start and End Date.-Save and close, click on "Import File"->"Import not imported records".-See Also-2532992 - Error While Migrating Projects With Status Completed-Configuration: Migration of Projects | SAP Help Portal -Keywords-Project; Migration; Migration of Projects; Migration tool; Template

Title: SAP Standard Withholding Tax not Calculated in Down Payment Request for Egypt
Content: Symptom-You are creating a new down payment request with country being Egypt, but at Withholding Tax Details field, you can only see "No Record Found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Down Payment Request view.-Fill in mandatory fields.-Navigate to Tax tab then Withholding Tax Details subtab on item level.-Be sure that Tax Country/Region is Egypt.-Select standard withholding tax code accordingly.-See "No Records Found" at Taxes field.-Cause-Withholding tax due has two options:-1-withholding tax due at invoice and not relevant for down payment-2-withholding tax due at payment and relevant for down payment-For SAP delivered standard tax type of Egypt, withholding tax due is maintained as option 2. This means withholding tax will be calculated when creating down payment request.-But there is another tax types for Egypt existing in the system: customized tax type created via PDI. If withholding tax due of customized tax type is maintained as option 1, withholding tax will be calculated for supplier invoices but not down payment request.-And option 2 will not work even for standard tax type. This is because customized tax type is prioritized over standard tax type. So system consider withholding tax due based on customized tax type as well, which means option 1- withholding tax due at invoice and not relevant for down payment.-Resolution-Partner can maintain the option of customized withholding tax due according to Enable Withholding Tax for Non-Localized Countries/Regions in SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-But for standard tax type for Egypt, it cannot be maintained since Egypt is a non-localized country.-Keywords-Withholding Tax; WHT; Down Payment Request; Supplier Invoice; Egypt

Title: Freight is Not Included in the Item Net Value
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have added freight into lines in the service order and found the freight is not calculated into the item net value. -For example, in pricing tab for line 10, we can see list price=100 USD for 1 ea; quantity=1 ea, freight =10 USD. The price component value=100 USD. This price component value (net value) does not include the freight. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Open the service order ABC, go to Pricing tab.-Expand the item pricing and you can see the pricing for line 10. The freight is shown for line 10, but not calculated into the price component value.-Cause-Item price component value does not include freight amount. It is calculated in the total pricing.-Resolution-This is the current system designed behavior.-Keywords-service order; Pricing; Freight; Net Value.

Title: Create a leave type/bank holiday that lasts less than a half day
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement where you would like to create a bank holiday that lasts less than a half day.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search for Working Day Calendar activity.-Click Change immediately.-Click Maintain an existing holiday.-Select the relevant holiday calendar.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to create a holiday with a duration less than half day, as regular holidays always last a full or at least half day.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-We would suggest that you investigate the possibility of fulfilling your requirement by using an Ad Hoc Time Account.-You may find more details about Ad Hoc Time Account in the Help Portal:-Create a New Ad Hoc Time Account-See Also-Create a New Ad Hoc Time Account-Keywords-half day, leave, create leave, leave type, ad hoc, time account, time file, number of hours

Title: Clearing Document is Posted to Currency Exchange Rate Difference Account
Content: Symptom-You notice that the journal entry for a clearing document is posted to the currency exchange rate difference account and you wonder why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entries view.-Search journal entry ID for the clearing document: AAA (AAA represents the clearing document ID).-You can see it is posted to the currency exchange rate difference account.-Cause-The transaction currency for the clearing document and the company currency differs. When processing a document chain where the company and transaction currencies differ and a deviation in the exchange rate between these currencies has been maintained, the system will automatically detect the change, calculate the amount and post it as either a gain or loss from exchange rate differences to the appropriate G/L Account. -Here is how to calculate the exchange difference amount in the clearing document - AAA:-You may check the clearing document uses the exchange rate as XXX(XXX represents the exchange rate), and the total amount is 123(123 represents the total amount). It is to clear the down payment and the invoice.-The down payment document uses the exchange rate as YYY(YYY represents the exchange rate). The invoice document uses the exchange rate as YYY as well.-So the currency exchange rate difference is calculated as: 123*(XXX-YYY). The amount is posted to the currency exchange rate difference account in the clearing document: AAA.-Resolution-System behavior.-See Also-2172409 - Manually Applied Exchange Rate Difference is not Being Posted to the Approporiate G/L Account-Keywords-journal entry, currency exchange rate difference account

Title: How to update data for a specific script via web service
Content: Symptom-Currently when you update master data (for example Suppliers) via web service, the values are only replicated to the Latin script. -You would like to update data for other scripts (Cyrillic, Chinese, Katakana, etc.) via web service as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open relevant WSDL.-Open request.-Maintain relevant data to be updated.-Execute request.-Check in UI.-It will be updated for Latin script.-Change to a different script.-Data will not be updated.-Cause-By default, the data is updated for the Latin script.-Resolution-In order to update data for a specific script, you can use the tag <script> as in below example:-<script>-     <script>C</script>-     <FirstLineName>Chinese Webservice</FirstLineName>-     <SecondLineName>Chinese Second Name</SecondLineName>-</script>-That way you will be able to update the data with respective script information.-Keywords-cyrillic, katakana, chinese, supplier, webservice, scripts, multiple scripts, master data

Title: How to move stuck scheduled migration job to the correct server
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have a migration which is stuck in UI and the job is stuck as Scheduled in backend. -Customer is not able to delete the file from UI, getting an error message saying "Action not allowed; simulation in progress".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center -> Overview view.-Search for the relevant migration activity.-Enter it.-Search for the relevant file.-Click Execute Migration Step by Step.-The migration is stuck in step 3 (Simulate).-Cause-The migration job is stuck in backend and needs to be moved to the correct server.-Resolution-Go to SM37.-Find the job which is in Scheduled status.-Select the job.-Click the Job tab on top of the screen.-Click Move to different server.-A new box will open, then click on the value help.-Select the appropriate server.-Confirm it.-Keywords-migration stuck in ui, migration of surcharges, scheduled job, migration

Title: When PDI Extension Selected as Cyrilic Field in Web Service Value Displayed as Empty

Title: Unable to display the documentation for Time Administration Integration web service
Content: Symptom-When clicking Display Documentation button for the Time Administration Integration web services, you get an error message saying "Get Microsoft Silverlight".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Communication Arrangements view.-Go to Time Administration Integration arrangement.-Select any of the lines.-Click Display Documentation.-Cause-There is an inconsistency in the server routing that is still calling the Silverlight pages instead of HTML5.-SAP Product Management plans to update these outdated links in a future release.-Resolution-There is an workaround available where you modify the URL to access the correct page.-Wrong URL will contain 'SAP_BYD_WEKTRA/CP/cp'. This should be changed to 'SAP_BYD_UI/HTML5/cp5'.-Original URL should look like example below:-https://myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/ap/ui/repository/SAP_BYD_WEKTRA/CP/cp.html?objname=HCM_TIME_AND_LABOR_MANAGEMENT&type=PSM_MCPG_R *-Corrected URL should look like example below:-https://myXXXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/ap/ui/repository/SAP_BYD_UI/HTML5/cp5.html?objname=HCM_TIME_AND_LABOR_MANAGEMENT&type=PSM_MCPG_R *-* Where 'myXXXXXX' represents the tenant URL.-Keywords-silverlight, documentation, Query Employee Actual Times, Query Project Tasks, Manage Employee Time data, communication arrangement, display documentation, document

Title: System Creates an Health Check Incident For Task Type Alias: Assignment of type /SRMAP/PUR_PCT_NTF_ABOUT_EXP
Content: Symptom-You as an administrator or key user receives a notification with subject Assignment of type /SRMAP/PUR_PCT_NTF_ABOUT_EXP BTM items not possible-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Incidents view-Select All incidents-Search with subject - Assignment of type /SRMAP/PUR_PCT_NTF_ABOUT_EXP BTM items not possible -You can see the health check incident-Cause-The health check incident talks about the notification - Purchasing Contract About to Expire. -The system automatically checks the contracts daily and creates a notification to inform you that a purchasing contract or one of its items is about to expire.-A purchasing contract expires in the following cases:--> The validity period of the purchasing contract expires.--> The open target value of the purchasing contract expires.--> The open quantity or open value of at least one purchasing contract item expires.-Note: The default priority of this type of notification is medium but can be configured. The system automatically cancels the notification after 30 days.-Resolution-The notification is relevant to the employee responsible maintained in the purchasing contract.-The employee responsible receives this notification in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center.-To get information about why the purchasing contract is about to expire, you can check the release history of the purchasing contract items, the validity period of the purchasing contract, and the target value.-Choose one of the following courses of action:--> Renew the purchasing contract by clicking Negotiate and choosing one of the options.--> Edit the validity period or the quantities of the purchasing contract.--> If you want the purchasing contract to expire, click Actions and choose Acknowledge in the worklist in the Inbox subview of the Work view of the Home work center.-When none of the items in the contract are about to expire anymore, or the contract has expired, the notification is completed and removed from the worklist. -Note -The expiry check is done by the system once in a day, as a daily job. Therefore, the notification will be removed only on the following day of contract expiry or contract renewal or change in validity period.-Keywords-Assignment of type /SRMAP/PUR_PCT_NTF_ABOUT_EXP; Purchasing Contract About to Expire

Title: Error Detected During Migration of Project
Content: Symptom-While doing Project Migration using Migration Tool-Error detected in source record with key value 'XXXX', Invalid character in ResponsibleEmployeeID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and open the activity Migration of Projects-Select Migrate projects using the migration tool-Select the file ABC.xml when filtering for Not Completed Files-Choose Execute Migration-Execute Migration Step by Step-In step 3 the tool displays an error message:-Error detected in source record with key value 'XXXX'-Invalid character in ResponsibleEmployeeID-Cause-This error is due to incorrect mapping in edit value conversion for employee ID. -Resolution-Please maintain the mapping correctly in edit value conversion for employee ID and confirm the mappings by clicking on confirm value. -Keywords-Mapping, project migration, source record, edit value conversion

Title: Not Receiving Push Notifications for Supplier Invoice Approval in Mobile (IOS & Android )
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is not receiving push notifications for supplier invoice approval in mobile (IOS & Android )-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP ByDesign Mobile App-Go to manager approvals tile-Tasks for approval are present in App but no push notification received on device(IOS/Android)--Cause-Push certificate on BTP is expired-Resolution-Forward the incident to SRD-CC-MOB to extend the date of push certificate - See Also-How To Enable Push Notifications for SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App-Keywords-Push certificate on BTP, notification, Supplier Invoice Approval

Title: Few Records Missing After Mass Data Maintenance Import
Content: Symptom-Few records are missing after mass data maintenance import.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Go to Import Customer link-Upload file -Validate the data and Execute-File finished with errors-When you check the records in mass data maintenance view, you find that (failed records + imported records) are not equal to total records -Cause-The missing records are in not started status . You can filter it by following below steps:-Go to Mass data maintenance work center-Go to particular file -Filter by Not Imported records-You will find missing records are in not started status-The Not Started records will usually happen because the tool could not complete to process a batch of records, due to an error in one of the records or because the processing is taking more time than expected it will get in queue.-Resolution-You need to execute the import again for the not imported records-Go to Mass data maintenance work center-Go to particular file -Filter by Not Imported records-Execute Data Import-   Keywords-missing records, not started , imported records, not imported records, failed records, mass data maintenance

Title: Unable to rename "Counter" key figure in custom reports
Content: Symptom-Trying to rename the key figure names as per business requirement however, the key figure "Counter" is not editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Work center Business Analytics, View Design Reports.-Select your customized report.-Click Edit With Report Wizard.-Go to Step 2 'Select Key Figures'.-Try to edit Key Figure 'Counter', edit button is greyed out.-Cause-This is standard system behaviour.-Resolution-This is standard system behaviour. Title: Serial number cannot be deleted; this is not the last active document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error " Serial number XYZ cannot be deleted; this is not the last active document" occurs while removing Serial Number XYZ during adjustment confirmation for Inbound Warehouse Order ABC.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to By Warehouse Order View.-Search for Warehouse Order ABC.-Choose Edit button. -Choose Adjustment confirmation button.-Select the line.-Choose Enable Entry button.-Go to Serial Numbers sub-tab.-Select Serial Number XYZ.-Choose Remove button, then the error occurs.-Cause-Prerequisite: Make sure the mentioned product is still in the target logistics area at the time of goods receipt and that the product is not restricted for use.-This issue was caused by the 'non-adjustable indicator' flag of the item product serial number being set incorrectly.-Resolution-Non-adjustable indicator is present in Confirmed Inbound Delivery and Outbound Delivery documents.-For this case, you can query Business Object APDL_CONF_INB_DELIVERY in T-code SESFTS based on Inbound Delivery ID. Then click on navigate and check the Non-adjustable indicator with path ROOT->ITEM->ITEM_PRODUCT->ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIALNUMBER.  If the indicator is checked, you can forward the incident to the development team.-*Note: the solution is also suitable for Outbound Delivery Scenario, the Business Object would be APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY in that case.*-See Also-3066550 - Error when trying to remove the Serial Number while performing Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order-2953120 - Error appears when trying to remove the Serial Number while performing Adjustment Confirmation for Warehouse Order-Keywords- Serial Number; Adjustment Confirmation; last active document.

Title: Error - 'Payment method Credit card only permitted for debit advices' occurred while creating a Bank payment advice.
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create a Bank Payment Advice, the system does not allow the Credit Card Payment method for the Bank Credit Advice type (with the Posting Advice option selected).-Furthermore with this option selected, it is not possible to select a Payment Method for the Bank Debit Advice type.--Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Liquidity Management work center.-2) Go to New Bank Payment Advice sub view.-3) Give all the required details and Payment method as Credit Card.-You will see the error message as below,-"Payment method Credit card only permitted for debit advices".-Cause-As per the error you are trying to give a Payment Method as Credit Card for the Bank Credit Advice which is not correct.-For example the 'Bank Transfer' is not permitted for Debit Advices. You will note that if the Payment Advice is a Credit Advice, then 'Bank Transfer' is present in the payment dropdown. But if it is a Debit Advice the payment method dropdown updates to display the permitted methods.-Resolution-The system behaving as expected. For Bank Credit Advice you should try to go with Bank Transfer/Check/Wire Transfer.-Hence it is not relevant to select the Payment Method as Credit Card for Bank Credit Advice.-Note: If the advice represents an existing payment, select the Posting Advice checkbox to create the associated postings in accounting. If you do not select the checkbox, the advice is considered as notice of a future payment and the system does not create any postings in accounting.-Keywords-Bank Payment Advice, Bank Debit Advice, Posting Advice, Credit Card, Payment menthod.

Title: Error When Trying to Integrate Employee Using the Employee Central Between Business ByDesign and Success Factors
Content: Symptom-You have performed the configuration in order to integrate the systems Business ByDesign and Success Factors, however you are receiving the following error message:-/MOM/CX_COST_CENTRE_EC:Se ha producido una excepción.EC CC Error repl.: EC CC Error repl.: [LGN0020]Incorrect format for H TTP B-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management.-Then go to the Web Service Message Monitoring.-Select the affected log, which is related to the Service Interface:OrganisationalManagementOrganisationalCentreReplicationRequestingOut.-You will see the error.-Cause-Such error is occurring because the Service Organisational Centre Replication Outbound with EC is disabled in the Communication Arrangement.-Resolution-You need to activate the Service Organisational Centre Replication Outbound with EC in the Communication Arrangement.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Then go to the Communication Arrangements view.-Search for the EC Integration communication arrangement and open it.-Go to the Technical Data.-You will see that the service is set as Disabled.-See Also-Set up Communication Arrangement-Keywords-Employee Central, Employee replication, Business ByDesign, Error, /MOM/CX_COST_CENTRE_EC:Se ha producido una excepción.EC CC Error repl.: EC CC Error repl.: [LGN0020]Incorrect format for H TTP B, LGN0020, Web Service Message Monitoring, OrganisationalManagementOrganisationalCentreReplicationRequestingOut.

Title: Internal Comments Maintained in Material Not Visible when Executing Query Materials Web Service
Content: Symptom-In Query Material Standard SAP Webservice, only the first comment maintained in Purchasing Internal Comments is visible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Materials view-Edit XYZ [Here XYZ refers to material]-Navigate to Purchasing tab-You can see internal comments, but using Query Material Standard SAP Webservice you can only see one internal comment being displayed.-Cause-The system is designed to display only one internal comment[Purchasing].-Resolution-This is current system behavior.-See Also-https://api.sap.com/package/BYD/soap

Title: Is it Possible to Revert the Period End Closure Date From Future Date to Current Date?
Content: Symptom-User have performed a day closure run and set the period closure date in the future, this caused negative balance on the time account.-Is it possible to revert the period closure date to current date? -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work Center-Go to Regular Tasks View-Select "Run Day Closure for One Employee" link-Select employee-Set Period Closure Date to current date-Error "Entered date DD.MM.YYYY must be after latest day closure date".-Cause-It is not possible to revert the period end closure to current date. The idea of period closure is to prevent possible frauds in terms of time recording, so once the date is set the time booking relevant to accounting is considered complete. -However, user can book times by not referencing any project, since it does not affect accounting-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-See Also-SAP Note - 2350022  Recording and Posting of Times Possible Although Period is Closed-SAP Note - 2710797 Frequently Asked Questions on Period Closure -Keywords-negative balance on the time account, revert period end closure, run day closure, time administration, future date

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-After a copy from the productive system to test, the communication arrangement is marked as isolated and user is unable to activate it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management work center-Go to Communication Arrangements view-Highlight particular communication arrangement-De-Isolate Button is greyed out, Isolate check box is ticked -          Cause-Need to uncheck the isolated flag for the communication arrangement in the backend-Resolution-AP-RC-CEC-B2B development team will uncheck the isolation flag relevance field in the MCPG and activate it. If this doesn't resolves the issue need to check if service is missing for respective communication arrangement from partner development side-Keywords-De-Isolate Button, Communication arrangement, Isolate check box, MCPG, partner development side

Title: Error " Document scanning functionalities are not supported from China Datacenter " While Editing Project Scope

Title: Error: "Posting date DD/MM/YYYY is not in fiscal year XXXX" Is Raised During Migration
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Accounting Transaction Data related to Fixed Assets and when you choose Simulate Import, the error message below is shown for one or more Fixed Assets:-"Posting date DD/MM/YYYY is not in fiscal year XXXX"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Go to Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to Integrate and Extend tab.-Show All Activities and Find Activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on: Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool-Select the Migration file for Fixed Assets and Choose Execute Migration.-In C - Simulate Import step, error message is shown.-Cause-The Posting Date for the Migration is in Fiscal Year XXXX. (XXXX stands for the Fiscal Year in which the Migration was executed)-When the Migration is executed, Journal Entries for those Fixed Assets are created as indicated on the Migration file. If the Posting Date maintained on the file happens to occur on an Accounting Period that does not exists for the Company in the system, this error will be raised.-First, check the Accounting Periods maintained for Company ABC (ABC stands for the Company relevant to Migration ID):-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Open Sets of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Select the line for Company ABC and the respective Set of Books.-Click on Open and Close Periods.-You will notice that for Fiscal Year XXXX, not all the Periods exist.-Then, back on the Migration in the step C - Simulate Import, you will notice that all the error messages "Posting date DD/MM/YYYY is not in fiscal year XXXX" for Fixed Assets happens to occur on an Accounting Period that does not exists in the system for Company ABC.-Resolution-You need to change the Posting Dates for the entries that are with error to a date within Accounting Periods that exist in Fiscal Year XXXX.-1. On the Migration, in the step C - Simulate Import where the errors are raised to click on Go To Correction.-2. Go to the tab Asset Posting Lines.-3. Change the Posting Dates on the entries that lies on Fiscal Year XXXX, but outside Accounting Periods of Fiscal Year XXXX that exists in the system.-4. Click on Save and Close.-5. Execute the process again.-The error message for that specific Fixed Asset will disappear.-Then repeat the process to all other affected entries.-Keywords-Fixed Assets, Migration, is not in fiscal year

Title: Cancel Purchase Order Button is Disabled in the Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-Cancel Purchase order button is disabled for Purchase Order. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and you can see Cancel Purchase order button is disabled-Cause-There is an Invoice Cancellation which is in status Paid with Clearing document and the clearing document is also posted to accounting. Due to this reason, the Invoice Status is updated to Partially Invoiced. As a result, Purchase Order status is in Follow-Up Document Created status and not allowed to Cancel the purchase order when you have the active follow up documents. -Resolution-If you need to Cancel the purchase order, cancel the Clearing document and then Cancel Purchase order button will be enabled in the purchase order. -Keywords-Cancel Purchase order button is disabled for Purchase Order; Cancel Purchase order button is disabled

Title: 'Error in Processing' While Uploading Lockbox File

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer is trying to upload a Lockbox file and encounters file status 'Error in Processing', or when trying to assign new checks to deposits and facing the following error message '500 SAP Internal Server Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Liquidity Management work center.-Inbound file subview.-New
