Title: Error Message: 'Exchange Rate and Time Missing' During Dunning Run
Content: Symptom-You have executed the Dunning Run and the Application log shows the error message: Exchange Rate and Time Missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables Work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Go to the Dunning Runs Subview.-Show All the Dunning Runs and Search for the Respective Dunning Run.-Go to the Execution Details and then to the Application Log ID.-Under Results, you could see the error message.-Error message: Exchange Rate and Time Missing.-Cause-The error occurs as the Exchange Rate is left blank for the respective Dunning Strategy in the Fine Tune Activity Dunning Strategies.-Resolution-You should maintain the Exchange Rate in the Fine Tune Activity Dunning Strategies by the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration Work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the Project and Choose Open Activity List.-Go to the Fine Tune Activities.-Show All Activities and search for Activity Dunning Strategies.-Go to Edit Dunning Strategies.-Go to the respective Dunning Strategy and under General, you could see that Exchange Rate field is left blank.-Once the Exchange Rate is maintained, you can reexecute the Dunning Run and the Error message would not occur.-Keywords-Exchange Rate and Time Missing, Dunning Run, Dunning Strategies

Title: Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM) has Made Some Changes in the Access Rights of an Employee
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-For a particular user, you have observed that there are changes in Business User by Technical user SAP_SYSTEM. There is also authorization issues for this user while accessing certain screen and views.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-This issue occurs when the layer strategy of the user "SAP_SYSTEM" is changed from "LAYER_CUST" to some other layer. With a different layer strategy the work center views are not found which are there in the "LAYER_CUST". Hence, the views are deleted and the same is reflected in the change history.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, the layer strategy of the user SAP_SYSTEM should be LAYER_CUST. This can be changed in the table "APXR_SETTINGS".-Keywords- layer strategy; LAYER_CUST; APXR_SETTINGS

Title: You get Error While Creating a New Sales Order: "Costs not determined"
Content: Symptom-You get error while creating a New Sales Order: Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material ABC in company XXX.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center-Select New Sales Order under Common Task-Add mandatory details in the sales order-Select the View All button and navigate to the Items tab-Add the product ABC (where ABC stands for the product ID selected)-Error occurs: Costs not determined: There is no inventory cost for material ABC in company XXX (where XXX stands for the ID of the company)-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center-Select the product ABC-However, the cost has been maintained (cost type inventory cost) in the product master data. The Valid From is earlier than the posting date/pricing date of the sales order-Cause-While editing Material ABC, you get information message as "Check and save new valuation details for company XXX bus. residence YYY". (where YYY stands for the ID of Business Residence)-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center -Go to Material View-Select All Materials.-Enter Material ABC and Click Edit-Information message shows like below "Check and save new valuation details for company XXX bus. residence YYY"-Only this values will save in Material Valuation BO for further processing.-Resolution-Go to Inventory Valuation Work Center -Go to Material View-Select All Materials.-Enter Material ABC and Click Edit-Navigate to Valuation tab-Maintain new cost and remove the old one-Click Save-See Also-1892976 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Quote: "Costs not determined"-2936992 - Error Message "Item X: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service ABC and set of books IFRS valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing"-Keywords-Costs not determined, Sales Order, Inventory Valuation, Inventory Cost, no inventory cost for material

Title: Unexpected List Price Value in Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components Report
Content: Symptom-You run the Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components report and see the List Price value is not the value you expected for a specific customer invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for the report: Customer Invoice Volume with Price Component (CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001).-Open the report.-In the Selection, enter ABC for the characteristic Invoice (ABC represents the ID of your customer invoice).-Run the report.-You can see the List Price value is: 1,000 EUR. Whereas the List Price in your customer invoice ABC is 400 EUR.-Cause-In the report, if you change the View to the standard "Price Components by Customer Invoice", and expand the line which has value 1,000 EUR, you can see two lines underneath:-- DEF (DEF represents the ID of the current list price) with value 400 EUR.-- GHI (GHI represents the ID of another list price) with value 600 EUR.-The pricing in the report is adding up both maintained price lists that are listed for the customer invoice.-Resolution-The system behavior is as expected.-During the determination of the price for an item, the system can determine a number of possible prices. Then, based on the price configuration it will determine the correct list price to use in the document. The price list that we will not be used is the subsequent price.-In our example you have a price list of 400 EUR maintained and another price list of 600 EUR is determined as subsequent price.-For more clarity you can also add the "Price Component: Inactivity Reason" field in the columns. Then you will see both prices separated and how it gets added to calculate the Price List value.-Also, you can add the field "Price Component: Price Specification Reference" to display the name of the price list that is used.-Note: The same behavior is applicable for the all the CRM data sources with Price components such as Sales order Price Components(CRMSLOPATCIU), Sales Quote Price components(CRMCQTPATCIU), Service Order Price components(CRMSORPATCIU), Customer Contract Price Components(CRMCCOPATCIU) etc-Keywords-CRMCIVIPATCB_Q0001, liste de prix, rapport, facture client, élément de prix, CRMCCOPATCIU, CRMCCOPATCIU, CRMCQTPATCIU, CRMSORPATCIU;

Title: How to Take SAML Traces for SAP Business ByDesign(BYD) & SAP Cloud for Customer(C4C) Systems
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY***-This KBA guides you on how to take the SAML Traces.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Steps to take the SAML Traces:-Login to the backend of the system for which you want to take the trace-Execute T Code: SE80-Input Web Dynpro Comp. / Intf. & SEC_DIAG_TOOL-Double click on webdynpro application SEC_DIAG_TOOL-Take the URL https://vhbydlgkai01.byd01.fra.byd.net.sap:50001/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/sec_diag_tool -Replace the highlighted path with the system URL ex: https://myxxxxxx.sapbydesign.com/sap/bc/webdynpro/sap/sec_diag_tool -Execute the URL into browser (where you have logged in to the system front end, so that it logs in correctly without any issues)-Login with the Support User credentials which are generated from the CAM Tool-Click on Start & ask customer to reproduce the issue in their system-Stop the Trace & check the logs-Click on Download the logs-Identify the issue and ask for correction based on the error-See Also- 3356071 - Upon SSO login user is prompted to NetWeaver screen-Additionally you can find the SAML Trace recording for your reference.-Keywords- SAML Trace, NGAP Trace, SSO

Title: Process Communication Error from CustomerRequirementProcessing to SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn: Not more than 1 locations of role Ship From Location permitted
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--The following Process Communication Error from Sender Interface CustomerRequirementProcessing to Receiver Interface SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn occurs:-Not more than 1 locations of role Ship From Location permitted-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon to Backend transaction SESFTS.-Enter business object: APCR_CUSTOMER_REQ.-Load By Query -> ROOT_QUERY_BY_BASE_BTD.-Enter the Sales Order ID XYZ in the field BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentReference/ID/content (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Execute the query.-Right click on the document ID.-Select Message Monitoring -> Launch XI Monitor for DocFlow.-In the Message Monitor you see the following failed message:-Sender Party: CustomerRequirementProcessing-Receiver Interface Name: SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn-Error: Not more than 1 locations of role Ship From Location permitted-Cause-The fulfillment of the item is External but no supplier is maintained for one of the items.-Resolution-The customer needs to maintain a supplier as follows:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order XYZ.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Check which Item has the Fulfillment External and no Supplier maintained in the Details sub tab under the Section Ship-From.-Maintain the Supplier for the respective item with External fulfillment.-Once this is done the customer can send back the incident and you can restart the failed XI message.-See Also-3423484 - Error Not More Than 1 Locations of Role Ship From Location Permitted-Keywords-PCE, Process Communication Error, CustomerRequirementProcessing, SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn, Sales Order, Ship From Location, Fulfillment, External, Supplier

Title: DMARC Policy - Emails Not Received or in Junk Mail Folder
Content: Symptom-Even after to configure the SPF IP ranges in the customer email server, some emails sent from SAP system are sent to Junk Mail folder, or the customer is not receiving these emails.-Checking in the email logs you noticed some message related with DMARC (fail/error/etc).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the SPF IP ranges were already added to server, the cause of this block can be the DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting & Conformance) policy that is in use on customer DNS Server.-Currently the SAP does not support DMARC policy. For Business emails we support SPF.-And for Bulk mails, we support SPF + DKIM.-Resolution-You have two options:-a) Deactivate the DMARC on your DNS Server.-b) In case of emails in Junk Mail folder, mark it as "not spam" to teach the system that the domain is safe.-Keywords-DMARC; Junk Mail; Issue; Fail; email; Not receive; IP Range; SPF;

Title: No Access to iRPA / BPA Factory After Assigning BTP Roles
Content: Symptom-You have assigned BTP roles to certain users, however those users are not able to access iRPA / BPA factory.-Only the Initial user who scoped iRPA/BPA have access to the factory.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Business Users view.-Search for the business user that needs access to the iRPA / BPA factory.-Select the user.-Click on the Assign BTP Roles button.-Assign the role(s) and save the changes.-Even after setting up the BTP roles, the user does not have access to the factory.-Cause-Users were not set up in IAS tenant by the initial user.-Resolution-The initial user who scoped iRPA/BPA receives the IAS tenant URL via e-mail. From the IAS tenant URL the initial user can setup user accounts and accesses to the BPA factory.-In order to allow other users to access the IRPA/BPA factory, follow the below steps:-Ensure that the user is assigned to a BTP role (please refer to the Steps to Reproduce Section of this KBA).-With the initial user who has the access to IAS tenant, assign the Email address of the users who need the access the IRPA factory.-After this assignment, the users should get an e-mail with the access notification for the iRPA / BPA factory.-Keywords-irpa, bpa, btp roles, ias, access, factory

Title: You Can't Release the Customer Invoice Request Due to the Error: "Due date must not be before invoice date" and "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date"
Content: Symptom-You Can't Release the Customer Invoice Request Due to the Error: "Due date must not be before invoice date" and "Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.Select the Invoice Requests view.-Select invoice request XYZ.-Click the Invoice button.-The following error message appears:-Due date must not be before invoice date-Payment Baseline Date must not be before Invoice Date-Cause-This is a new error that is now raised in 2108. The message indicates that the due date of the invoice is before the invoice date.-In Business terms it would mean that we are expecting the payment before we send out invoice. This would be incorrect.-Resolution-You will need to change the payment terms in there sales order, so that it will pick a valid due date.-Kindly note: The solution will work only when the customer invoice is not saved. You will have to change the payment terms before saving the invoice.-See Also-KBA: 2814513 - Your Invoice Request Is Inconsistent-Keywords-Invoice Request, Due Date, Invoice Date, Payment, Invoice

Title: How to Migrate List Price for Service Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a service order via migration, but the error:"Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" occurs.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Open the Activity:Migration of Service Orders-Click "Migrate service order using the migration tool"-The Service Order ABC (where ABC stands for service order you created) is created-Open the Service Order ABC-Error "Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" occurs.-Cause-The field Net Value in the migration template is mapped to List price. You did not maintain a Net Value in your migration template for the Item and the item is not maintained in a Price List that is valid for the respective Service Order.-Resolution-The System behavior is as follows:-If you did not maintained a Price List for the item and you also did not maintain a Net Value in the migration template, the List Price in the migrated Service Order cannot be determined and the error "Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" occurs.-If you did not maintained a Price List for the item and you maintain a Net Value in the migration template, the List Price in the migrated Service Order is determined from the Net Value in the migration template.-If you maintained a Price List for the item and you don't maintain a Net Value in the migration template, the List Price in the migrated Service Order is determined from the Price List.-If you maintained a Price List for the item and you maintain a Net Value in the migration template, the List Price in the migrated Service Order is determined from the Net Value in the migration template.-Keywords-Service Order, Migration, Net Value, List Price

Title: You Are Not Able to Change the Tax Amount in an Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are not able to change the Tax Amount in an Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center. -Select the Invoice Requests view. -Select the respective Invoice Request and click on the Invoice button. -In the New Invoice navigate to the Pricing tab.-You can see that the Tax Amount cannot be changed.  -Cause-It is not possible to maintain only a total tax amount for the entire customer invoice.-The total tax amount at the document level of the invoices is calculated aggregately i.e. by adding up individual item level tax amounts (calculated depending upon the tax rate, tax type, and tax rate type) and then rounding off that sum to relevant decimal places (as per that currency).-Tax rates are fixed to the selected tax codes which are then used to calculate the tax. The tax amount cannot be changed manually as it is calculated by the system.- You can adjust tax codes that are determined in order to receive a different tax rate, depending on country specific requirements. However a manual change of the tax amount within the document is not possible.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-See Also-Blog: Rules of Tax Difference Distribution in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Tax Amount, Change, Manually, Tax, Rate, Update, Invoice,

Title: Error in Processing, File Contains Invalid Content
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new incoming file and start uploading the file and get an error message - Error in Processing, File Contains Invalid Content for the CAMT053.003 file according to ISO20022 format.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Inbound Files view.-Click on New > incoming File.-Enter all the details.-Click on Start File upload.-Error message appears.-Cause-Initially we supported only CAMT.053 Version 02 and currently it is upgraded to Version 04. Now we support both but in some-cases the customers uploading the version 03 which result in error message.-Resolution-Customers can check with their bank to provide version 04 of CAMT053 and upload it.-As a workaround you may change the version manually a file.-Current tag :-<Document xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.03">-Change to:-<Document xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:camt.053.001.04">-Keywords-error in processing,file contains invalid content

Title: Not able to delete custom query from SAP Cloud Applications Studio
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY--Customer created a custom query; deleted the custom object, the custom query based on the object remained and produce error upon solution check or activation.-It seems that customer deleting the BO before the custom query deletion caused inconsistencies on Backend.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio - All it's versions-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer - All it's versions-SAP Business ByDesign - All it's versions-Reproducing the Issue-1. Right click on the query you want to delete, e.g.  /YXXXXXX_MAIN/SRC/Custom/BO/Customer/CustomerExt-Address.qry and you will get the following error messages:--File /YXXXXXX_MAIN/SRC/Custom/BO/Customer/CustomerExt-Address.sadl does not exist-File /YXXXXXX_MAIN/SRC/Custom/BO/Customer/CustomerExt-Address.sadl is not found in layer strategy YLI3PULRY_DEV-Repository error at file path-Cause-Deleting the BO before deleting it's queries may lead the scenario to inconsistencies on Backend.-Resolution-Only the PDI team are permitted to forward incidents to PDI development (AP-RC-BDS-*)-Please check below things before forwarding this incident to development team.-1. Does the content file either exist in YXXXXXXX_ Layer strategy or Layer_CUST.-2. Check in PDI content file and see if the myrpoject file or query file is in status (1 Run Time Not Updated).-Document these details and then forward your analysis with query deletion request to the dev component AP-RC-BDS-QRY.-Keywords-Query; Delete; SDK;

Title: Unposted Source Document Error: Account Determination for Inventories is Missing for Acct Det. Group XXX
Content: Symptom-You have noticed an unposted source document (e.g. warehouse confirmation) and an error message which prevents the document being posted.- Error message: 'Account determination for inventories is missing for Acct Det. Group XXX'.-XXX represents Account Determination Group ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents sub-view.-Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is a Warehouse Confirmation.-Select the ID and under the Details session you can see this error:-'Account determination for inventories is missing for Acct Det. Group XXX'.-Cause-The reason is that you have not maintained the G/L account under account determination group for the respective material. If a material is involved in the warehouse confirmation, then the respective G/L acocunt is derived is using the account determination group of this material. You need to maintain the G/L account for the respective Account determination group.-Resolution-Go to the  Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Fine Tune and select the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select the link Inventories under Account Determination.-Select the Account Determination Profile YYY and navigate to Inventory tab. (YYY represents Account Determination Profile ID)-Maintain G/L Account for the respective Account Determination Group XXX.-Click on Save button.-Now you are able to post the Unposted Source Document:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to the Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, the warehouse confirmation.-Select the ID and press Actions and select Post Business Transaction.-Keywords-Source document error, Account Determination Group, Inventories is Missing, Material Inventories

Title: Making Tax Digital - UK : Client / Account Registration Located in: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA
Content: Symptom-Unable to submit VAT Return to HMRC. VAT Return Submission status: Returned; Approval Status: Rejected.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to VAT Returns Sub view-Select Tax Return XYZ with Reported status. (XYZ represents the Tax Return ID) -Press View-Press Submit.-Under Submission Information:  Submission Status: Returned; Approval Status: Rejected.-Error Description: |No account determined|. Please check configuration.|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located in: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA.-Cause-Authorized accounts must be added in order to submit the UK MTD data. A communication arrangement have been set between the company and the HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) system to enable the exchange of invoice data required for the approval of electronic invoices.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration work center, select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the responsible project and choose Open Activity List.-In the Fine Tune section, select the UK Making Tax Digital activity.-Under Services, select the UK MTD Integration service and choose Add Row to add an account for the service.-Select Allow Access. This opens a window requesting to launch the web service in new browser window, to sign on to the service.-Select Launch web service in new browser window. Enter the credentials in the HMRC page to generate an authorization code.-Copy the authorization code and paste it in the Authorization Code field in the Allow Access window.-Select OK. The account has now been successfully set up for the company and the tax can be submitted digitally.-Post the activity has been re-performed the submission should go through.-Keywords-No account determined. Please check configuration.|Technical Response: Missing required parameter: Client / Account Registration Located in: REMOTE_CONNECTOR-PROCESS_DATA-hmrc,unable to submit vat return,remote_connector-process_data,making tax digital

Title: How to Delete Key Figures from the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**** INTERNAL USE ONLY ****-**** TO BE DONE BY THE ANALYTICS TEAM ONLY ****-A report is inconsistent and runs into errors when you start it from the UI. In your analysis, you find out that this is due to key figures which were deleted, however a trace of them is still present in the report. With the customer's permission, you are going to delete the key figure meta data. This document describes the required steps.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Various error messages or dumps are possible on the UI.SAP C-When you check the report in MDRS, you find that some key figures have no description. Additionally, when you double-click on the Reusable Component, you get an error saying-'MDAV Key Figure Composite ABC does not exist. Create object?'-Cause-This can happen when the customer deletes the key figures from the UI, however the deletion does not go through fully.-Resolution-Ask the customer's permission to delete these key figures and proceed as follows:-Log on to the backend and go to MDRS.-Get the report ID and key figure IDs.-Go to the transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO MDRS_MKFC and click on Load by Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-Enter the report ID under Key/ProxyName and click on Execute-This will open the report. Click on Navigate > Component-Change to the Table View for better usability:-Now you will see the components of this report. Check the column KEY-NAME which contains the key figure ID. Mark the line with the key figure ID you want to delete.-Click on the Edit button (blue pen icon).-Click on Delete (bin icon).-Click on Save.-Keywords-key figure, delete, back end, test shell, MDRS, SESFTS

Title: "Employee Type end date set to DD.MM.YYYY due to predefined time dependency" Occurs When Changing Hire Date of Employee
Content: Symptom-Information "Employee Type end date set to DD.MM.YYYY2 due to prefefined time dependency" occurs when hire date of employee changes from DD.MM.YYYY1 to past date DD.MM.YYYY2-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for the employee and select Edit.-Navigate to Employment and Navaigate to Work Agreement tab.-Select Change Hire Date and select date DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-This information message shall not impact employee's hire date change in the system. Since this employee is migrated via the migration tool and hence this information message is generated and it holds importance only technically.-Resolution-You can ignore this information message and process further.-Keywords-Personnel Administration; Employee; Hire Date; Employee Type

Title: User is Locked By a User Who Does Not Have Access Rights to Business Users View
Content: Symptom-User A is locked by User B, who doesn't have authorization to Business Users view but have write access to Personnel Administration work center view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Users view.-Search for user A and select Edit Access Rights.-Navigate to Changes tab.-User was locked by another user who doesn't have authorization to Business Users view, and Valid To date was updated in the meantime. -Cause-The validity of a user is derived from the work agreement of the employee to which the user belongs. If an employee is terminated by a HR user, the Valid To date for the corresponding user would be updated based on work agreement. If the Valid To date was provided before the Last Logon Date then the Valid To Date will be set as Last Logon Date, and the user will be locked.-Resolution-You can verify from Change log in Personnel File as below:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Employees view.-Search for the employee to which the user belongs and select Edit.-Navigate to Changes tab.-See Also-2896831 - Valid To Date of the Business User has Changed to a Random Date After the Rehire of the Employee-Keywords-Business User; User Locked; Employee Termination

Title: No Journal Entry Creation for Goods and Activity Confirmation of Project Stock Order
Content: Symptom-In Project Stock Order, you find that no journal entry gets created on delivery Goods and Activity Confirmation(GAC) even if delivery status of item is Finished.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work Center.-Navigate to Project Stock Orders View.-Search for the project stock order and select it.-Choose Edit button, then you note that the delivery status for some items is Finished.-Go to Document Flow Tab, you find that there is no journal entry creation on the delivery GAC(s).-Cause-After stock allocated from warehouse to project, the stock is removed from the source site/ logistics area and is tagged to the project, but there-is no related finical change. Hence it's expected that no accounting notification entry for these delivery GACs.-Resolution-When the project stock is consumed, the consumption GAC along with the project reference would trigger a message to Finance and have footprint in accounting. Then a journal entry would be created on the consumption GAC.-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmation, GAC, Project Stock Order, Journal Entry.

Title: Address Prefecture Is Not Displayed In The Corresponding Language
Content: Symptom-Prefecture of Japanese Address is displayed in different format and language.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center.-Select Accounts view.-Search for the respective account and select Edit.-Navigate to Communication tab and Addresses subtab.-Then you can find one address is displayed as "○○○区, Tokyo", while the other one is displayed as "東京都○○○区".-Cause-There is certain logic implemented in ByD for representing addresses in different format and language for formatted address. Particularly for Asian language there is a logic, that is dependent on amount of characters used in Latin alphabets or Asian characters, the prefecture is displayed in corresponding language.-Resolution-Please check if you have maintained more Latin characters (letters and numbers) in the address line. If you add more Japanese script, the address will be formatted according to the style used in Japan for domestics address formatting.-If you would like to have prefecture displayed in Japanese, the best way is to maintain most of all fields in Japanese characters.-Keywords-Address; Japanese; Asian Language

Title: Error "Changing not possible; field is read-only" is Displayed While Updating the Renewal Rule in Contract Header
Content: Symptom-While Updating the Renewal Rule in Contract Header, system shows the error "Changing not possible; field is read-only". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders - Contracts -Select Contract ABC (ABC represents the Contract ID)-Edit and View All -Under General -> Renewal and Cancellation -Change the Renewal Rule -System shows Error "Changing not possible; field is read-only" -Cause-The renewal rule entered in the header will not copy into items which are Completed/Cancelled, therefore the error message is to alert you that there is at least one line item which is completed/cancelled.  -Resolution-The error message appears after you changing the renewal rule but you are still able to click Save the Contract.

Title: Unable to Match Tax Payment With Tax Return
Content: Symptom-When trying to match a Tax Payment with a Tax Return, but the Matched box is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Payments sub view.-Find the Tax Payment ABC (ABC represents the Tax Payment ID).-Open the Tax Payment ABC and click View All.-To match Tax Payment ABC with Tax Return XYZ (XYZ represent the Tax Return ID).-The check box Matched is greyed out, matching is not possible.-Cause-The Tax Return XYZ is already matched to another Tax Payment, cannot match a Tax Return with more than one Tax Payment.-Resolution-Open the Tax Return XYZ and click View All.-Under the Tax Payment information, see that Tax Return XYZ is already assigned to Tax Payment DEF (DEF represents the already assigned Tax Payment ID).-Open the Tax Payment DEF and click View All.-Un-match the Tax Return XYZ and save the changes.-In case the Tax Payment DEF is in status Approval send it back for revision and perform the changes.-See Also-Tax Management, Tax payment, Tax return, Assigned, Status, Approval, Check box, cannot match, matched, greyed out, another payment, already assigned, un match, no possible.-Keywords

Title: Unable to Check Access Right Consistency for Business Role
Content: Symptom-"No Inconsistencies in Authorization Assignment Found!" displays when selecting "Check Access Right Consistency" under General tab, but inconsistencies can be found when navigating to Access Restrictions tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Roles view.-Search the respective role and select Edit.-Navigate to General tab, select Actions > Check Access Right Consistency, then it shows No Inconsistencies in Authorization Assignment Found!-Navigate to Access Restrictions tab, select Actions > Check Access Right Consistency, inconsistency can be found.-Then navigate back to General tab, select Actions > Check Access Right Consistency, inconsistency displays.-Cause-This is a known issue which is caused by introducing the lazy loading on the screen to improve the performance. The issue here is data related to access restriction is not being loaded unless the tab is clicked. So if a user executed the action: check access right consistency then the relevant buffers are not filled and no results are displayed.-Resolution-Development team has created a backlog for the same and it will be picked in the future release as per its priority. As a work around you can continue to click access restriction tab first and then execute the action.-Keywords-Business Role; Access Restriction; Access Right Consistency

Title: Error: "Change of user license not possible at the moment, please try again later"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit the Business User and upon saving the changes you get the Error Message "Change of user license not possible at the moment, please try again later".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User and Management work center-Go to Business User view-Select the User and click Edit Attribute-Do the changes and click Save-You get the error message as "Change of user license not possible at the moment, please try again later". -Cause-During the Edit or performing the changes to Business User details in the Business User view, this error is raised whenever an SAP internal system upgrade is in progress.-Resolution-As the error message itself says you to try after some time, we request you to perform the changes after some time and it should work fine.-See Also-2870988 - Error 'Changes Lead to License Overconsumption'-3035582 - "Communication Error; Create an Incident on the SRD-CC-CI-CCS Component" When Accessing Service Control Center -Keywords-Business User, Edit User, Edit Business User, User License, Cannot Edit User, SRD-CC-CI-CCS

Title: Validity of User in Personnel Administration Migration
Content: Symptom-Business user is created automatically after migrating employee data using the migration tool. However the validity of user is different from the provided date of Work Agreement of the employee to which the user belongs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Search for Migration of Employee Data - Country.-Select Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool.-Then go to check the created business user.-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business Users view.-Search the users created from employees.-Select Edit Attributes.-Then you can find the validity date is as of the date of migration.-Cause-The dates are picked up from the provided dates of Work Agreement in the Migration Template. For users where the validity period is starting from a date in the past and going in the future the user's validity started as of the date of migration which is generally the current date or today's Date. This will ensure users can login as of today itself.-Resolution-It is an expected system behavior.-See Also-2194460 - Business User is Getting Created for Every New Internal Employee-Keywords-Migration of Employee data; Business Users

Title: How to remove Process communication errors from "Open Error which require no action"
Content: Symptom-You have many Process Communication Errors under the list "Open Error which require no action"  and you want to know how to remove them.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application user management Work center.-Go to Process communication errors view.-Select the option "Open Error which require no action".-Cause-By default it would take minimum of 6 weeks from the date of creation of the message.-Creation date would appear in a separate column under in the same screen.-Resolution-So they will be automatically removed after 6 weeks.-Keywords-Process communication errors, Open Error which require no action, BYD

Title: Font Size Rendered Incorrectly In Sales Quote Preview
Content: Symptom-The font size of the sales quote preview displays larger text even when the font size is maintained at 10px for certain records.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Workcenter-Go to Sales Quote view-Search for Quote ID: ABC-Select the record and choose Preview-Observe the form displayed shows the font size larger than 10 px.-Cause-The existing text was created with a larger font size when the document was released, and the font size was apparently adjusted to 10px after the existing text was created.-Resolution-The font size can be verified by just selecting the text, and the UI will display the corresponding size of the text.-Set the font size to the desired size, then save and preview the document. This should work as intended.-Note: This would be specific for texts using Text Editor.-Keywords-Font Size, Sales Quote, Preview, Text, Rendering, Incorrect Font Size

Content: Symptom-You are trying to post a manual clearing and system raises the error message: 'Invalid item type selected for Netting'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view.-Open the customer account ID.-Open the relevant clearing ID.-Press view all.-The clearing status is proposed and the mentioned error message is raised.-Cause-Netting can be performed for new charge credit, payments and credit memos.-Down payment requests or down payments are not supported.-You may also refer to more details in the help document: <manual netting>.-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-invalid item type, netting, manual clearing, down payment, down payment request

Title: Time Information in Delivery Report
Content: Symptom-User wants to get the time information against delivery and warehouse requests in a report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center-Go to Outbound Deliveries view and find ID-Here on OWL, under General tab.-Navigate to details section, here shipment date and delivery date is available.-These dates must be available in OD report which is created by and created on with time stamp which is an administrative data.-Cause-There is no single report available to get outbound delivery and warehouse request's dates data with timestamp.-Below data sources are available:--SCMWREXE_V1-> Warehouse Request Items-> Created by and Created on are available.-SCMOBDB01 -> Outbound Delivery Header Details ->Shipment date and Delivery date with timestamp is available. -Resolution-User can create a new report with mentioned data sources as required.-Keywords-Datasource; report; outbound delivery; warehouse request; SCMWREXE_V1; SCMOBDB01; timestamp; shipment date; delivery date; created on; created by

Title: Workflow Rules for Inbound Scenario
Content: Symptom-User have created workflow rules to generate notifications for the supplier inbound deliveries with "Goods and Activity Confirmation - PO" however system does not create notifications.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Workflow Rules view.-Choose New and update description.-Maintain Business Object as Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Complete the guided activity until step :5 with condition as per business need.-Once it is done, it is expected that notification must be triggered on release of inbound delivery.-However, no notifications is being triggered to the recipient's mail.-Cause-Since in the BO list, there is no workflow rules available for warehouse confirmation hence no notifications can be maintained.-As per system settings maintained workflow rules for Goods & Activity Confirmation, this helps to trigger notifications upon Outbound Delivery release, similarly to trigger Notifications for Inbound Delivery release, Warehouse Confirmation is necessary. - Resolution-Currently, it is not possible to have notifications created for Inbound Delivery Scenario.-This is current system behavior.-  Post query at Customer Influence Forum, at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-   Keywords-Workflow rules; notifications; inbound delivery; supplier delivery; Goods and Activity Confirmation; Goods and Activity Confirmation - PO;

Title: Edit Fiscal Years for Sets Of Books and Assigned Companies Not Possible
Content: Symptom-You are not able to edit fiscal years for set of books ABC (ABC represents the set of books ID) and assignment of company XYZ (XYZ represents the company ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Set of Books and Assigned Companies view.-Click 'Edit Fiscal Years' for set of books ABC and assignment of company XYZ , and the system shows errors:-'No valid combination of company and set of books found;-Company is required;-Save failed.'-You also notice that the deactivate button is greyed out. This indicates that the company assignment has been deactivated.-Cause-It is not possible to edit fiscal years for the already deactivated company and set of books assignment. And it is not possible to reactivate the company and set of books assignment again.-Resolution-Under no circumstances will it be possible to reactivate an inactive set of books.-The only possibilities here are to either roll back the system to a restore point when set of books ABC is still active, or to set up a completely new company and migrate/transfer all existing data over to the new company.-See Also-2593390 - Reactivate Set of Books Company Assignment Not Possible-Keywords-deactivate button, greyed out, company assignment, reactivate, inactive set of books,

Title: Fixed Asset Migration Error: Asset "PQR" Val.View : Depreciation Positive
Content: Symptom-During the Fixed Asset migration process, the error message 'Asset "PQR" val.view : Depreciation positive' appears.-(Here PQR is the Desription of Fixed Asset)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Find Migration of Accounting Transaction Data activity.-Click Open.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the relevant migration unit.-Click Execute Migration.-Select Migration Object Fixed Assets.-Click Process File.-Go to Step c.- The following error is raised:-Error detected in source record -Asset "PQR" val.view : Depreciation positive-Cause-This error message appears for some of the valuation views, you have entered positive amount for Depreciation amount in the Migraiton file.-Positive amount is not allowed for Depreciation value during the Migration.-Resolution-You need to enter negative value for the Deprecation in the migration file.-Once the Fixed Asset is created, then you can create a Revaluation or Write-up posting via the Manual Postings functionality.-Keywords-Migration of fixed asset, Depreciation positive, Revaluation, Write-Up

Title: Process Communication Error in Over-The-Counter-Sale Document- INTERNAL USE ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-There's a Process Communication Error in the document flow of Over-The-Counter-Sale (OTC) as below Customer Invoice Request YYY cannot update Outbound Delivery XXX.-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-(where XXX is Outbound Delivery ID and YYY is Customer Invoice ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Over-the-Counter Sales workcenter and Over-the-Counter Sales view.-Find OTC ID and Edit.-Navigate to Document Flow.-You will encounter the above error.-Cause-There is an unprocessed message in the backend for Over-The-Counter-Sale from Sender Party: CustomerInvoiceProcessing to Receiver Interface Name: OutboundDeliveryProcessingFulfilmentNotificationIn due to error Item cancellation is not sent for complete kit.-This is an OTCS scenario where an update message sent from OTCS Document about cancellation of items to Outbound Delivery has failed because the cancellation status is not set for the kit header item, but is set for its child item.-Resolution-Reconciliation of message for OTC will resolve the error.-Development Colleagues will assist in the reconciliation.-Keywords-Over-The-Counter-Sale, Outbound Delivery, Customer Invoice, Reconciliation, Cancellation, Kit

Title: Purchase Order Can be Created but Error "Budget Exceeded" is observed When Approving
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You can create a purchase order although the net amount exceeds the available money in the assigned cost center. -However, you get error 'Budget Exceeded for Budget Category AAA Cost Center BBB by 0.00' at the approval step so you cannot approve the purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a purchase order from Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Click Order button, and the purchase order is submitted for approval.-When approving the purchase order, system throws the error message : "Budget Exceeded for Budget Category AAA Cost Center BBB by 0.00".-Task cannot be approved/ rejected/ send back for revision due to this error. -Cause-This is a normal system behavior. System will implement budget control for purchase orders and supplier invoices if Budget Control Function is activated, during the process of creation, approval and order after change.-If purchase order XXX can be ordered but cannot be approved due to the budget control, it is because for this cost center BBB, other purchase orders have not been approved yet when purchase order XXX is created. So the available budget in cost center BBB has not been consumed.-After other purchase orders get approved and there is no enough budget left for purchase order XXX, system will drop error message when approving the other purchase order XXX which has the same budget control.-Resolution-This issue can be avoided by raising the budget or choose suitable cost center which has enough budget.-See Also-3221760 - Error 'Budget Exceeded for Budget Category AAA Cost Center BBB by 0.00' Occurs When Processing Purchase Order or Invoice-Keywords-Budget; Budget Exceeded; Cost Center; Budget Control; Purchase Order; Order; Approve

Title: Information In Balance Confirmation Not Passed to Form correctly.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Custom form not displaying data correctly for the Balance Confirmations. When Credit Memos are on the document the ID isn't the credit memo ID on the form, instead it displays the ID of the preceding Customer Invoice. The idea of this development was to take the ID of the Credit Memo and display that instead. It works correctly on-screen, but that information is lost when previewing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Receivables work center.-2. Go to Balance Confirmation.-3. Open Balance Confirmation 'XXX' (XXX refers to Balance Confirmation ID).-4. Go to Balances & Documents tab.-5. There will be multiple document ID's, check for the particular document 'YYY' (YYY refers to document under the Balance Confirmation).-6. Click on Preview you see details are not displayed as expected.-Balance Confirmation is showing document id as 'ABC' in the form instead of 'XYZ'.-'ABC' refers to the preceding document i.e.., Customer Invoice.-'XYZ' refers to the Credit memo (which is expected to pass on to the form).- Cause-In the Balance Confirmation 'XXX' (XXX refers to Balance Confirmation ID), you found that data is correctly passed in the display but during preview, data is incorrect for the document 'YYY' (YYY refers to document under the Balance Confirmation).-Technical Information: -The form for preview and print is designed in such a way that If partner base BTD ref id is empty, show base BTD ID ref of Original Invoice Document. So balance confirmation is showing document id as 'ABC' in the form instead of 'XYZ'.-This can be seen in Class “CL_FOP_TRPAS_OUTPUT_REQUEST” and method” PRINT TRPAS_BL_TRPAS_BI “With below comments on line no: 209.----> Print External Reference ID on the form show Partner Base BTD Ref ID from Original Invoice Document----> IF partner Base BTD Ref ID is empty, show Base BTD ID Ref of Original Invoice Document.-Resolution-This occurs because there is a custom development done by customer on balance notification form i.e. “Copy of balance notification” and the field "copy" in the form is also not the part of standard form. No changes required from Support side to implement this.-Here Customer needs to check with the partner who has developed the solution. -Keywords-Balance Confirmation, Credit Memo, Preview, Output Form, Receivables.

Title: Form Master Template changes not reflecting
Content: Symptom-Changes made in Form Master template is not reflecting in the  preview of any document example Purchase order-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to  Application user managment work center-Go to Master template maintenance view-Select the option "form master templates " from drop down-Select the  default option existing in your system and click on edit-In the 'form master template ' details screen ,-Make necessary changes-Save and close-Later create new  Purchase order and check  but those changes are not reflecting-Cause- You made changes in master form template while u were logged in a different language than the form template's language-Resolution- Please check the form Template and its language that is  considered in the purchase order by following below steps.- Go to Purchase order- Click on You can also- Click on edit  out put settings- you will see that language there- also this language is determined by system based on Suppliers language- so you have to log in with that language and then make changes in teh Master form template- once you made changes then create new purchase order and the changes will reflect as expected.

Title: Unable to Assign Profit Center while Creating Free Cost Object
Content: Symptom-You wanted to create Free Cost Objects. You are not able to assign the New Cost Object to a profit center as the value help shows No records found.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Free Cost Object view.-Enter the mandatory data and Choose a Company.-Click on Add Row and Enter Valid From and Valid To dates.-Select the value help on Profit center and List is empty.-Message shows No records found.-Cause-The reason is that Profit Center is not valid at the time of creating free cost object. You can check the Profit Center validity in the below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view.-Click on Edit tab.-Find the Profit Center PQR (PQR represents the Profit Center name).-Select Profit Center and go to Timelines tab.-Profit Center is showing the correct validity (Ex: 28.05.2023) and which is valid at the time of creating Free cost objects.-We have verified the Org Structure and Company 10000 is valid from 28.05.2023 and as well as Profit center. Profit Center is not valid as of 01.01.2023 and validity is maintained from 28.05.2023 and hence, system was not able to find the Profit center.-Resolution-You need to maintain the correct validity of the profit centers for the respective company.-You can maintain as per the below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view.-Click on Edit tab.-Find the Profit Center PQR (PQR represents the Profit Center name).-Select Profit Center and choose Timelines tab.-Maintain the validity from DD.MM.YYYY(ex: 30.04.2023).-Now you are able to create Free cost objects without any error.-Keywords-Free Cost Object, Profit center is blank, No records found

Title: Deployment Error: Failed to activate items of type BusinessConfigurationObject
Content: Symptom-You are deploying a Solution patch to a tenant and during the Activation phase, you see the below errors:-"Error while activating BCO YXXXXXXXY_ of solution . Report an incident."-"Error occurred when activating table YXXXXXXXY_1100A1AB10A10AB1 (see activation log)"-"File name:ABC.bco"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Open the SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-Upload your PDI Solution patch version.-After upload, click Activate.-Cause-You have deleted the BCO (Business Configuration Object) in the previous patch version and recreated it with the same name while changing the structure of the BCO (for example, change of data type).-Resolution-To replace the BCO, you would need to deploy a transitional patch to the target tenant.-Delete the required BCO in a patch version.-Deploy to the target tenant.-In the next patch version, create a BCO with the same name as deleted one with new structure.-Deploy to target system.-Alternatively, best practice is not to reuse the same name as a deleted BCO.-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2022/11/24/best-practices-for-business-configuration-contents/-Keywords-BC, Business Configuration Object, PDI, SDK, deploy, upload, activate

Title: Data not shown in Data Source - Inventory Cost Analysis Based On FIFO
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to open Data Source from Business Analytics Work Center and when you try to preview, you see that there is no data shown.--Data Source Name: Inventory Cost Analysis Based On FIFO.---Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Business Analytics work center.-2) Go to Data Sources sub view.-3) Search for Data Source name : Inventory Cost Analysis Based On FIFO -4) There will be a preview option, click it-5) You will see that no data was shown.-Cause-1) Login to backend.-2) Execute T-code MDRS.-3) Select MDAV(Multidim, Analytical View).-4) Input the report ID. For example, report ID is FININVU09, then you input FININVU09 in MDAV(Multidim,Analytical View).-5) Select Display.-6) You see that data is not loaded and even in all the underlying Data Sources, no data is shown.-This Data Source is used for systems that use the FIFO Cost Determination are scoped, as this depends on the execution of FIFO Cost Determination Runs that calculate the FIFO Cost.-   Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. Here the Data Source expects values of Company, Set of Books and Fiscal Year Variant to show the proper data when you create a Report. This Data Source Preview will not show data as the Preview has no restrictions.-You can find more information on the below Help Documents:-Inventory Cost Analysis Based On FIFO - https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cf9d914722d10149310bf4067bc0d20.html?locale=en-US-FIFO Cost Determination Quick Guide - https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2ddc2269722d1014a570d3071d253824.html?locale=en-US-Keywords-Inventory Cost Analysis Based On FIFO, Data Source, Business Analytics, Preview.

Title: System Crashes While Finishing Physical Inventory Count Task
Content: Symptom-- System crashes while confirming the physical inventory task in the Physical Inventory work center.-- This issue occurs when trying to confirm a task with a large number of line items.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Physical Inventory work center.-2. Navigate to the Task Control view.-3. Search and select the relevant task you want to confirm.-4. Click on the Confirm button.-5. Enter the necessary quantities and click on the Finish All Items button.-Cause-The system crash occurs when trying to confirm a task that has a large number of line items, typically greater than 500. This large number is not supported in Business ByDesign, causing memory issues while finishing the task.-Resolution-Ensure that the tasks created do not have more than 500 line items per task.-Try to confirm the existing task using the Confirm with Microsoft Excel option. This option has been successful in some cases where there are not too many value updates required in the task.-See Also-- [SAP Business ByDesign User Guide](https://help.sap.com/viewer/p/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN)-Keywords

Title: Change Storage Location For Resource
Content: Symptom-- The need to change the storage location of a resource in SAP ByDesign.-- Unable to modify the site and storage location of a resource.-Environment-- SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-1. Navigate to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-2. Go to the Resources View.-3. Search for the relevant resource, select it, and choose the Edit button.-4. In the General tab, the current Site and Storage location are maintained.-Cause-The inability to change the site and storage location of a resource is due to the resource being used in any Released Execution Planning Model (REPMS). If the resource is in the "In Preparation" status, the site information can be changed without errors.-Resolution-The storage location of a resource can be changed only if the resource is in the "In Preparation" status. You need to make sure the Site and the Logistics Area of the resource is changed to see the Storage Location information change.-See Also-- [SAP ByDesign Resource Management](https://help.sap.com/viewer/p/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN)-Keywords

field GLACCT99330; Application component: AP-ACC-Value 064100 in setting A1S_FIN_AD_GL_OTHER_LIAB_ALIAS must also be entered in setting FIAV_GLACCT_LIT-Foreign key error in node FIAC_ADMAT_M; field GLACCT_CREDIT; field GLACCT99010; Application component: AP-ACC-Value 478210 in setting A1S_FIN_AD_INV_REVEX_MAT must also be entered in setting FIAV_GLACCT_LIT-Error when check CW/FT collisions for project workspace <workspace ID>--Solution profile check ended with * error-Design Time check ended with * error-Resolution-Analysis:-Step1: Replicate the scenario, or see the SLG1 log providing the date and time of error occurrence.-Click on the details of the error line - . Below screen is shown.-Step2: Identify the source, If the node values are coming from BC set , Fine tuning or Net fine tuning.-Run Tcode- BCTSUPP-Select Workspace – Main Workspace.-Node ID – the error Node ID .-Column Content – N – represents Node values are coming from Net fine tuning. N takes the first preference, even if there are B (BC sets, as these are SAP delivered BC sets.)-Column Content – Space – represents Node values are coming from fine tuning.-Column Content – B – represents Node values are coming from BC set.(When only B is present, X entries can be ignored)-Once you identify the source of Node Value.-For Net fine tuning – double click on the line – N-Click on – Allow, this shows a XML format values, where you can find value – 064100, these values are maintained via fine tuning screen.-Option 2- go to BCTADM, and see if the value(064100) is available (i.e. maintained at the fine tuning).-These node values are dependent on node - A1S_FIN_CHOFACCTFIAC_GLACCT – Repeat the above step, the highlighted values (064100) will be missing in the second node- 1S_FIN_CHOFACCTFIAC_GLACCT.-Resolution: Send the incident to the application component (Eg: AP-ACC), as per the SLG1 log message, and ask them to maintain the values for the node-Resolution note can as below.-There is value 064100 for field ACCT_FROM is maintained for node A1S_FIN_FSTRC___FIAC_FSTRCGLAC but the same value is missing for node A1S_FIN_CHOFACCTFIAC_GLACCT. Please maintain-Keywords-Foreign key error, A1S_FIN_FSTRC___FIAC_FSTRCGLAC, ACCT_FROM

Title: Invoices are not reflected in the Report: Profit Overview by Key Figure
Content: Symptom-You want to check the revenue data of Invoice XYZ(XYZ Refers to Invoice) via Report: Profit Overview by Key Figure, however no data is found for the invoice even though its Posted and Journal Entry is successfully created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics work center-View Design Report and search for Report: Profit Overview by Key Figure -Open the report and Enter the relevant data and you see XYZ is missing from the report with data provided-Cause-Eventhough the JE is created for the Invoice, when the Functional Area is not determined and is blank, so the invoice is not reflected in the report.-Resolution-Check the Journal Entry for other Set of books(in case of multiple set of books present) and if other SoB has Functional area determined, invoice will be available in report. Else check why Functional area determination didn't happen. More details on the same can be found in below help documents.-Profit Overview by Key Figure: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2c28d462722d10148f78e8290463d73e.html-Functional Areas: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2c1f8527722d1014a2abfda42d2b2b50.html-https://answers.sap.com/questions/12267824/functional-area.html-See Also-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2c28d462722d10148f78e8290463d73e.html-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2c1f8527722d1014a2abfda42d2b2b50.html-https://answers.sap.com/questions/12267824/functional-area.html-Keywords-Functional Area, Profit Overview by Key Figure

Title: Unable To Activate Generic Custom Object Field Due To Error: 'Modification of BO Root node content for BO/ISCB/C_CUSTOMCODE1 is not possible'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When the user carry out the activation process to use Generic Custom Object field and want to use it in the SAP Cloud Application Studio, the following error message is encountered:-"Modification of BO Root node content for BO/ISCB/C_CUSTOMCODE1 is not possible" -"The BC Root node is not part of the worklist"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to the customer system-Go to BO_Validate work center-Go to BO_Validate view-Select Instance-Select Edit-Select Validate-Observe the Error:-"Modification of BO Root node content for BO/ISCB/C_CUSTOMCODE1 is not possible" -"The BC Root node is not part of the worklist"- Cause-The BCO’s utilization is not done as per the guidelines. In a general scenario, BCOs (BO and its respective ECO) must be configured with the workspace, which is missing here; the work center view is not falling into the project workspace; rather, it is standalone. -Resolution-There are set of guidelines to be followed when utilizing the BCO(Business Configuration Object) and its respective ECO. Please contact your Partner and suggest them to follow the guidelines from the below document in order work with the BCOs.-BCO_Creation_Guideline_V5_6-FP40_ECOs_BCViews_Guideline_V2_4-See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2022/07/29/generic-custom-object/-Keywords-Generic Custom Object, BO_Validate, Business Configuration Object, BCO, ECO,  BO/ISCB/C_CUSTOMCODE1, BCO Guidelines, Missing Workspace

Title: Changes Tab Unable to Fetch All Changes Made to Supplier
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Changes tab is not able to fetch all the changes made to supplier-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Supplier view -Choose new button to create a new supplier-Enter supplier name -Navigate to financial tab-Enter values in payment data , bank data and tax data subtab-Save the supplier -Go to changes tab, only payment data creation is captured here , bank data and tax data is not reflected in change logs-Cause-Payment data belongs to BO:FIA_ARP_LEDGER_ACCOUNT and bank/tax data belongs to BO:BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL -The table /ISPCD/C_M_BO has entries for BO type code 206(FIA_ARP_LEDGER_ACCOUNT) for create, delete and update operations whereas for BO type code 441(BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL) the table has entries for update and delete operations . So this is the reason tax and bank data are not getting captured for create operation.-Resolution-You need to maintain entry in table /ISPCD/C_M_BO for create operation for BO type code 441 . There is a BC set BC_A1S_FND_CHNGDOC_BYD which is used to maintain entries .This need to be performed by development team-Keywords-Changes tab, Change collector , bank data changes , tax data changes , supplier creation, FIA_ARP_LEDGER_ACCOUNT, /ISPCD/C_M_BO, BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2311 Hotfix Collection 2 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 2 performed in 2311 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 9th of December 2023. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2311 HC 02-Resolution-Cross - Area Topic-UI-While extracting data for suppliers using the data extraction tool, users were encountering errors. These issues are now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500023040)-Earlier the tenant termination process was failing because of the incorrect date format used by Service Control Center. Now the correct date format is used and the process works as expected. (Hotfix ID: 4500022015)-Retrieving description for document types was enhanced to support custom languages also and fallback mechanism in case a document type description was not available in the user's logon language. This enhancement led to regression issue in CDO, which is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000028250. This fix has already been delivered as a patch)-Retention Management-After completion of the Life Cycle Analysis Run log messages were displayed in a different language. This is fixed now. (Hotfix ID: 1000025207)-Output Management-The issue with activating floor plan for a custom purchase order is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000025866. This fix has already been delivered as a patch)-Key User Translation Tool-Via file transfer functionality of the Language Adaptation Tool, text elements can be uploaded into the source or new target system which could lead to duplicate text elements. The duplicate check has been strengthened comparing the content of all text pools with the same language vector. (Hotfix ID: 4500018208)-PDI Enablement-The LegallyRequiredSupplierInvoiceID field of the following objects is now enabled for PDI. (Hotfix ID: 1000026896)-TaxReceivablesPayablesRegister-TradeReceivablesPayablesRegister-AccountingNotification-AccountingDocument-The IsrealEInvoicingAllocationNumber field of the following object is now enabled for PDI. (Hotfix ID: 1000026896)-TaxReceivablesPayablesRegister-Datasources/MDAV-When running the Profit Overview by Key Figure report, selecting the Profit Centers in My Area filter used to crash the report. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000026084)-  Customer Relationship Management-Cross Basic Functions-When users tried to save a customer invoice request that has an active PDI solution defined on it, the save operation used to fail. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500022174. This fix has already been delivered as a patch)-Earlier when a delivery note was created for Outbound delivery for a sales order, the seller tax ID was found missing. The issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000023923)-For Belgium, the mileage rates were updated resulting in incorrect expense reports being generated for the Oct-Dec 2023 quarter. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000024746. This fix is already delivered as a patch)-  Financial Management-Cross Country Extensions-For Croatia, the deferred tax functionality is now enabled on sales side. Earlier, it was enabled only on purchase side. (Hotfix ID: 4500021144. This fix has already been delivered as a patch).-Expense Report-For Germany, the per diem rates have been updated to comply with the latest regulations that come into effect from January 01, 2024. (Hotfix ID: 4500020332)-For Netherlands, the mileage rates have been updated for the year 2024. (Hotfix ID: 1000026907)-Payables-Business users can now search for customer accounts in Cyrillic script in the Accounts view. (Hotfix ID: 1000024157)-Tax Management-The new tax codes in the electronic reporting form for the districts of Columbia and Pennsylvania is updated. (Hotfix ID: 1000027536)-For Israel, all withholding tax returns will now correctly include the payments related to clearing of supplier invoices with credit memos. (Hotfix ID: 4500021962)-For Mexico, a new tax code 19 (Domestic Purchase - Goods and Services (Zero Rate)) with 0% tax rate has been delivered to comply with the latest regulations. (Hotfix ID: 1000024119)-For China, the tax templates have been updated to ensure that the files can be uploaded without any issues. (Hotfix ID: 1000025209)-Statutory Reporting-Earlier when a customer account statement is generated, there were inconsistencies in the amounts displayed in Print form at the section 120+ days. The issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000027465)-You can now maintain the configuration for type "120 - Israel 6111 Header Fields Configuration" from Common Master Data Configuration activity under Business Configuration, for companies, whose ID starts with a number. (Hotfix ID: 1000026228)-Purchase Accounting-In some scenarios the GR/IR clearing run containing items related to Purchase Accounting for Third Party Order Processing (TPOP) lead to errors due to inconsistencies in the difference determination. This inconsistency is now fixed and TPOP-related postings will be complete. (Hotfix ID: 1000028103)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Identified Logistic Unit-Sometimes when a customer tried using barcodes to package outbound logistics unit, it was not working. This issue is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500014969)-Goods and Activity Confirmation-The issue while working with serial products using Goods Movement button is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500023020)-Earlier the Confirm Deliveries button was enabled only for creator or requestor of goods and services receipt. Now it can be enabled for any employee with delegated access. (Hotfix ID: 1000027585)-Material Inspection-In the Material Inspection (MIN_MATERIAL_INSPECTION) business object, under the root node, the following node elements are now write-released in the Public Solution Model (PSM):--SUPPLIER_INTERNAL_ID (Hotfix ID: 1000022949)-Physical Inventory Count-The OperationActivityInventoryItemTextCollection node of the PhysicalInventoryCount object is now enabled for read-only access in Public Solution Model (PSM). (Hotfix ID: 1000026013)-Project Management-Project Processing-While working with production orders, if the consumption stock is greater than the available stock, the application now alerts the users with the message: "Consumption quantity must not be greater than available quantity X unit." (Hotfix ID: 1000025895)-          *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g., operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed)-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2311; HFC02; Hotfix; SPS02; Hotfix Collection; 2311

Title: Custom Tax Type Description is displayed as <YL> instead of Custom tax type
Content: Symptom-You have created tax content using SAP Cloud Application Studio, the tax type description is displayed as <YL> and not XXX (XXX represents the custom tax type created through Localization Toolkit).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Open the Sales Order XYZ(represents the Sales Order ID).-Go to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and then the Pricing tab.-Here under Item pricing, you see description as <YL>(%) and not XXX(%).-Cause-If the tax content is created using SAP Cloud Application Studio, the tax type description is shortened with the first two characters of the solution key in the pricing view.-SAP delivered tax types display the right descriptions in the pricing view.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-See Also-How to Create Tax Content for Non-Localized Countries-Keywords-tax type description, how to Create Tax Content, Non-Localized Countries/Regions, SAP Cloud Applications studio

Title: Dump occurs when trying to Execute Payment for several documents
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Dump occurs when trying to Execute Payment for several documents -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Work Center > Automatic Payments view-Select All Payments-Search for your required payments-Select around 1000 documents and click Execute Payment -After some time a dump occurs-Dump message--Please try resuming your work.
