Title: Minor difference in amount encountered between Calculated and Expected depreciation value
Content: Symptom-The calculated depreciation per period differs from the anticipated value. Instead of consistent amounts with decimal precision in each period, the system produces rounded figures, resulting in uneven values across periods:-The depreciation amount per period is not calculated with the expected decimal accuracy.-Most periods show rounded values (even numbers), rather than precise amounts.-This leads to inconsistencies between expected and actual depreciation postings.-Example: -Net book value: LC 3,595.00-Useful life: 3 years (36 periods)-Expected depreciation per period: LC 99.86-System-calculated depreciation per period: LC 99.60 or LC 100.00-This indicates the system is rounding or distributing depreciation differently than anticipated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Fixed assets work center and go to the Fixed Assets view.-Select the respective fixed assets and press Edit - Values. -In the Depreciation Overview sub-tab you notice, most periods show rounded values (even numbers), rather than precise amounts.-Cause-Arithmetic rounding based on the fixed asset’s net book value is configured for the selected valuation view. :-In Business Configuration access the Fixed Asset Valuation View fine-tuning task.-Locate the relevant valuation view and open the Rounding Rules sub-tab.-The Base Value for Rounding Rule is set to Net Book Value.-The applied rounding method is Arithmetic Rounding.-This configuration causes depreciation amounts to be rounded based on the asset’s net book value.-Resolution-If depreciation amounts per period should be calculated precisely (without rounding), update the rounding settings as follows:-Open the Fixed Asset Valuation View fine-tune task.-Locate the relevant valuation view and go to the Rounding Rules sub-tab.-Set Base Value for Rounding Rule to No Rounding.-Save and close the fine-tune activity.-To apply the change to an existing asset:-5. Open the fixed asset and make a temporary (dummy) change—switch the depreciation method to another option and then revert it to the original method.-6. Navigate to the Depreciation Overview tab to verify that exact (unrounded) amounts are now calculated for each period.-     Keywords-Rounding, Depreciation, Fixed assets, decimals, even

Title: Error "Tax payer Party Address Data not complete" during "Release and Print" of Withholding Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You have created the Withholding Tax Return and when you click on "Release and Print", error "Tax Payer Party Address Data not complete" is encountered. You have checked the addresses for the Company and Supplier and all address data is complete, but still not sure why the error occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Withholding Tax Returns view and select Relevant Tax return ID-Click on Release & Print and system throws below error message-Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions-Tax Payer Party Address Data not complete-Cause-This error occurs because there are some address fields which are not filled for the company to which WHT is created-Resolution-Go to work center Organizational Management-Edit Org Structures and for company and in the Addresses tab click on Additional Fields and then maintain fields House No, Street and P.O. Box. > Save and activate the changes.-After this is done create a new tax return and there should not be any issues in Releasing the new tax return.-Keywords-Withholding tax, Release and Print, Address-

Title: Working Day Calendar does not Appear in the Working Day Calendar Activity
Content: Symptom-You are working with working day calendars (either to change a holiday calendar assignment, or to change the working days of a certain calendar), however you cannot find the specific calendar in the Working Day Calendar activity in Business Configuration-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity Working Day Calendar.-Select the activity and click on Change Immediately.-Click on Maintain an Existing Working Day Calendar.-In a new screen, the system will display the list of calendars of the system. However you are not able to locate the desired entry.-Cause-The calendar you are trying to locate is an SAP standard calendar. Since these calendars cannot be modified, they do not appear in the working day calendar activity.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-If you need to change the working days or the calendar assignment, you will need to create a custom working day calendar, which will be available in the business configuration activity to be modified.-Keywords-Holiday Calendar, Org Unit

Title: Almost all numbers in number range for SALESORDER[AP CRM Sales Order O] reserved
Content: Symptom-You noticed that an incident has been created stating that almost all numbers in a given number range are reserved. However you can see that the number range has more numbers and you would like to know how the Number Range Depletion calculation is done.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Incidents view.-You noticed that the system created an incident with below description (Example)-Diagnostic Information-Health Check Component: Cross-Application Services-Health Check Name: Number Range Depletion-Error Information Number Range Profile Name: APCRM1 Number Range Type Name: APCRM1_SALESORDER-Number Range Object Name: SALESORDER Number Range Object-Long Text: AP CRM Sales Order Object ID-Number Range Subobject Name:-Year: 0000-Interval Number: 01 Remaining Percent Level: 5 % Warn when less than % remain: 10 %-Cause-This is an automatic system alert, which aims to inform that for a specific document, its number range has almost no available numbers/IDs left, hence the related business transaction would not be created.-Resolution-You can check the number range remaining percentage by following the below steps:-Go to the work center 'Business configuration'.-Click on Implementation Project View-Select the project and click on Activity List-Go to the view 'Fine Tuning Activity'.-Search and open the activity "Number Ranges for Sales Orders and Customer Contracts, and Customer Returns".-Here, you can see two columns 'Start Number' & 'End Number' and-Let us consider the following example:  You will find Number range for Sales Orders i.e.-Begin Number: 0000000001-End Number: 119999999-Click Change current number : It shows number as '111.008.561'.-  Now since current number entered by you is 111.008.561' hence only 7% of numbers are remaining.-Calculation for same is : (119999999 - 111008561)/119999999 * 100- This is the reason that system is generating the incident because only 7% percent numbers are remaining and you will get such health check incident if the remaining percent of numbers is less than 10%. Please-Kindly change the number range or current number if you do not wish to get this incident or you could ignore the incident if you have sufficient numbers available in the number range.-Keywords-Health Check Name: Number Range Depletion; Number Range Profile Name: APCRM1 Number Range Type Name: APCRM1_SALESORDER;

Title: Changed Purchas Order via SOAP UI Output Template in Unexpected Language
Content: Symptom-You create a purchase order from frontend. In Output History, you find the purchase order template is in log on language - Chinese.-However, after you make changes to this purchase order via SOAP UI, the output of changed purchase order is in English.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log on the system in Chinese.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Click New Purchase Order to create a new purchase order XXX.-Before ordering it, click on You Can Also -> Edit Output Settings for Create PO to confirm the output template language is Chinese.-Click on Order button and send purchase order XXX to supplier.-Navigate to Output History tab and confirm the created purchase order template is Chinese version.-Open SOAP UI and update the purchase order XXX.-Go to frontend and open purchase order XXX.-Navigate to Output History tab and refresh.-The newly output template for changed purchase order XXX is in English. The title is "Changed Purchase Order XXX". -Cause-This is a normal system behavior. -Language in supplier master data is not maintained, and language for technical user (SOAP UI) is not maintained as well, so the default language of changed purchase order output template by SOAP UI is English.-Resolution-Maintain language in supplier master data-Go to Supplier Base work center -> Suppliers view (or double click on supplier in purchase order) to open supplier master data.-Navigate to General tab -> Main Communication -> Language field, select Chinese from the dropdown list.-Click on Save and Close. -Maintain language in SOAP UI-At SOAP Project screen, click on Header button.-Click on "+" icon to add header. Input "Accept-Language", and then enter "CN".-See Also-2951384 - How to change Log on language of Technical users uploading documents via Soap UI-Keywords-Purchase Order; Output Template; Language; SOAP UI; Web Service

Title: Error in Actual Cost Rollup Run - "Action DET_TRANSFER_QTY_STRU not permitted for status Posted" and "Action CALCULATE not permitted for status Posted".
Content: Symptom-When you trying to do the Actual Cost Rollup Run, you are facing the error as below.-Error message: "Action DET_TRANSFER_QTY_STRU not permitted for status Posted" and "Action CALCULATE not permitted for status Posted"-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-2) Go to Actual Cost Roll Up sub view.-3) Search for the Actual Cost Roll Up XXX. ('XXX' refers to Actual Cost Roll Up Run)-4) Click that go to Messages tab.-5) You will see the error message: "Action DET_TRANSFER_QTY_STRU not permitted for status Posted" and "Action CALCULATE not permitted for status Posted".-Cause-The messages "Action DET_TRANSFER_QTY_STRU not permitted for status Posted" and "Action CALCULATE not permitted for status Posted" basically means that the material actual costing instance has been posted, that is actual cost allocation has been already done and hence those materials cannot be processed again in this period.-Resolution-If you run the Actual Cost Rollup Run again, it would again revaluate the Allocation amount as of then. Hence if any new documents are processed, it would pick that up and determine a new allocation amount. That would get picked up the next time you run the Allocation run.-So if there is no new documents are processed, then where will be errors.-If you would like to re-run the Actual Cost Rollup Run, you have to make sure there are new documents processed.-Keywords-Actual Cost Rollup Run, Inventory Valuation, Allocation Amount, Allocation Run, DET_TRANSFER_QTY_STRU, CALCULATE.

Title: Illness View On Employee Time Record Does Not Show Any Data
Content: Symptom-In Employee Times, when you click on the illness radio button no record is displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Go to Employees view-Search for Employee XYZ-Select Edit-Navigate to Employee Times-Under List subtab select the Illnesses radio button-Observe no records are displayed.-Cause- If you plan to use payroll for your country ABC, Time Data for Payroll Calculation - ABC must be included in your scope (Where ABC refers to the country).-Resolution-Illness view is dependent(constraint) on "Time Data for Payroll Calculation".-Please follow the below steps to scope the element to see the Illness View record:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to the Implementation Projects view-Select Edit Project Scopr-Navigate to the Questions tab-Go to Scoping Element Human Resources-Go to Time and Labour Management-Go to Time Recording-Now scope the question: Do you use time data for payroll calculation in ABC?  (ABC refers to the country)-Keywords-Illness view, Employees, Time Data for Payroll Calculation, Employee Time Record

Title: Confirmed Quantity Column Of Internal Logistics Work Center - Goods and Activity Confirmations Table Did Not Display Any Value.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Confirmed Quantity Column Of Internal Logistics Work Center - Goods and Activity Confirmations Table Did Not Display Any Value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Choose Goods and Activity Confirmations view.-Here you can able to see the Confirmation ID's.-Select any ID's system is not showing any values in Confirmed quantity column.-Cause-The work center "Display/reverse Goods and activity confirmation", Under common task view, is supposed to be used for purposes related to Goods and activity confirmation. The work center in question (Goods and Activity confirmation) was only created to satisfy a particular business case and may not have all the other functionalities working which were not necessary in that use case.-Resolution-To check the confirmed quantity for confirmation ID's please follow the below path. It will display the items with confirmed quantity.-Go to Internal Logistics Work Center.-Choose display/reverse Goods and activity confirmation Under common task view.-Choose confirmation ID below you can see confirmation qty.-Keywords-Goods and Activity Confirmations, Internal Logistics, Confirmation ID's, Confirmed quantity, Item Type, Material, service, Non-stock, direct.

Title: Customer or partner not found in marketing consent report
Content: Symptom-A given customer or partner XYZ (XYZ represents the account ID) is not visible in Marketing Consent report despite having withdrawn consent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center: Marketing-Open view: Reports-Open Marketing Consent report-Search for Business Partner: XYZ-The search results in 'No data'.-Cause-No permissions were maintained in the Business Partner data-Go to work center: Account Management-Open the view: Accounts-Search All Accounts: XYD-Edit, View All-Navigate to the Marketing Tab and then the Marketing Consent subtab-Here you can see no rules have been set.-Resolution-Select Add Row then maintain the appropriate communication channels (E-mail, fax, etc.).-Keywords-Marketing, Marketing Consent, Permission, Report, Account, Accounts, Business Partner, Business Partners

Title: Dump When Using the End Validity Button on an Org Unit
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to end the validity of an org unit, however when you click on the button "End Validity", the system dumps.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Organizational Management.-Enter the view 'Edit Org Structures'.-Input an effective date and click on OK.-Select the org unit to be modified.-Click on the Edit Org Unit button.-Click on End Validity.-Here the system raises a dump.-Cause-There are documents pending for the org unit in question. However currently the system does not correctly handles the errors when trying to check and activate the org unit, causing a dump.-Resolution-Customer needs to change the validity of the org unit through the Timelines tab, where the correct checks and errors/warnings will appear.-To do that, the customer can follow the below steps:-Go to the work center Organizational Management.-Enter the view 'Edit Org Structures'.-Input an effective date and click on OK.-Select the org unit to be modified.-At the bottom of the screen, navigate to the Timelines tab.-Change the org unit validity to the desired value.-Click on the Check button.-Click on Check Selected and Dependent Org Structure.-Using this method, the system should raise the correct errors/warnings for the org unit being modified.-Keywords-organization, limit, expire

Title: How to Perform Mapping from PEPPOL Exchange Service to SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how to perform the mapping of fields, such as extension fields from PEPPOL Exchange Services to SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. -As of today SAP Business ByDesign does not support the mapping of extended fields as we provide out of box mapping for all the fields mandated by Peppol Exchange Service only. -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Portal to submit an idea. -Improvement requests need 20 votes from different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis, with the results being communicated in a corresponding review blog post.-Keywords-PEPPOL, Peppol Exchange Service, Mapping, Extension Fields, Integration, Compliance, Document, Invoice

Title: Values From BCO Codelist Field Not Updating Via Fine-Tuning Activity
Content: Symptom-Values from BCO codelist field is not updating from fine-tuning activity-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer core applications -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales work center-Go to Opportunities view-Search for any opportunity-Go to Tickets tab-Navigate to BCO codelist field -In the drop-down of field , all the values entered in fine-tuning activity is not showing up-Now,-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation Project view-Navigate to activity list for particular Change project where you have created the activity-Go to particular activity-Multiple values for BC Set/field is present-Cause-The change project used to input new values for the BCO codelist field is not merged-Resolution-You need to merge the change project -Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the project and select the Open Activity List button-Navigate to Go Live tab-Select and Complete the Merge Changes with Production System activity-Keywords-BCO codelist, Merge Changes, Multiple values for BC Set/field is present,

Title: "System expected the end of the element XYZ" When Executing a Web Service Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer has reported that when using a SOAP service interface, the system returns an error 500.-When checking in the backend transaction SRT_UTIL, you can see the following error:-"System expected the end of the element XYZ" (where XYZ represents an XML element from the request payload)-When checking the payload, the element mentioned in the error message is properly closed in the XML.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-One scenario that may lead to this error is that the customer may have added an extension field to the service interface WSDL. However they have manually typed the extension field in the XML payload of a WSDL which was already being used previously, before adding the field to it.-In SOAPUI, this can be checked by right-clicking on the webservice operation (for example, "CheckMaintainBundle") and clicking on "New Request". This will create a blank XML payload where you can check if the fields match between the default and the customer's payload.-Resolution-In order to ensure that all fields in the XML are correctly processed and mapped to the service interface and the target business object in Business ByDesign, customer needs to download a fresh WSDL file from Application and User Management in order to use the extension fields added.-Keywords-SOAP, POST, WS, KUT, adaptation

Title: Unable To Hide Reasons For Rejection Dropdown Values
Content: Symptom-User is unable to hide the drop down values in the Reason for Rejection field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below Sales Order is an example:-Go to Sales View-Click on View All-Navigate to Items tab-Navigate to Reason for Rejection field-The drop down values cannot be hidden-Cause-It is not possible to hide the dropdown values. -Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Our recommendation is to post this as an enhancement idea over our Influence platform.-You can access the Influence forum in the link: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 -Keywords-Sales Order, Drop Down Values, Hide, Reason For Rejection

Title: Internal Comments Entered in Goods and Services Receipt Document not Visible for Approver
Content: Symptom-You have added a notes in the Goods and Services Receipts document however these notes are not visible to the approver of Goods and Services Receipt document. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing My Area work center-Go to Approvals view-Select the relevant approval task for Goods and Services Receipt-Select Edit and under Comments no Notes History exists-Cause-In the Goods and Services Receipt document, following note types are available:-Internal Comment-Remark for Supplier-Remark from Supplier-These notes are not relevant for approver and hence they will not reflect in the approval task of the Goods and Services Receipt document. -Resolution-As a work around, you can create an extension field ( Like GSR Approver Note) with field type Text (120 characters) at item level of Goods and Services Receipt document. This extension field is visible in the Approvals screen under Managing My Area work center. -Keywords-Internal Comments Entered in Goods and Services Receipt Document not Visible for Approver; Internal Comments not Visible for Approver;

Title: Project Based Services are not Supported in Contract
Content: Symptom-You are not able to select project based service in the contract. When entering the ID manually, one the following errors is displayed:-Products with item group Service - time and material (project) not supported-Products with item group Service - fixed price (project) not supported-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Click New to open the new contract window, enter the necessary data in General tab.-Go to the Items tab, click Add Row and open the value help of Product, the service ABC is not available. (ABC represents the ID of service item).-Cause-Project based services are also not supported in Quote for Contract documents as they are preceding document for Contracts.-Resolution-The item group of the service item ABC are all project based. Project based services are not supported in contract.-This is the correct system behavior as designed.-Keywords-contract, project based, service, PBFP, PBTM, service - fixed price (project), service - time and material (project), quote for contract, not available, not supported

Title: How to Resend Failed Event Notifications Automatically in UI
Content: Symptom-You want to resend Failed Event Notifications automatically from the system.-      Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Select Event Notification Monitoring view-Filter the Failure error-You need to resend manually-Resolution-Follow below steps:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Select Event Notification Monitoring view-Select Failed events from dropdown-Select Extend Retention button-This will allow the background jobs to pick the failed events within this period and resend them automatically from the system.-

Title: "Value XXX in setting A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT must also be entered in setting APC_C_TXDECLT search item: A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT", error occurs while trying to open activity list.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you are trying to 'open activity list' via Business configuration > First Implementation, you are facing the following inconsistent error message.-"Value XXX in setting A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT must also be entered in setting APC_C_TXDECLT search item: A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT". ("XXX refers to Values in number")-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Business Configuration work center.-2) Go to  Implementation Project sub view.-3) Select the First Implementation project.-4) Try to Open Activity List.-"Upgrade Failed - Some technical issues and inconsistencies have been found in your solution profile". -Error message: "Value XXX in setting A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT must also be entered in setting APC_C_TXDECLT search item: A1S_FIN_TAX_DECLFOP_C_TXDECLAT". ("XXX refers to Values in number")-Cause-This error happens when the value of TaxDeclarationTypeCode that you have defined in the TaxDeclarationProfile BCO is missing in the TaxDeclarationType BCO as this is the foreign key which links the two objects.-(OR)-When you check this issue in UI and you see all the required entries are maintained and still this inconsistency error persist in system, it's because of the Scoping.-Resolution-If the case with this scenario arises Support have to create a Incident to the Development team.-Hence this Technical consistency message pops-up because of Scoping. Once Development team runs the report "RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE" from backend, this issue will be resolved.-Now customer can able to "open activity list" via Business Configuration.- See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2875903-Keywords-Tax Return Type, Cloud Application Studio, TaxDeclarationTypeCode, TaxDeclarationProfile,  TaxDeclarationType

Title: Message 'No Text for UUID {XYZ}' shown in column 'Source document - Created by'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are checking the report Projects - Line Items and see the message: No Text for UUID {XYZ} (XYZ refers to UUID) for field 'Source document - Created by' displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Project Management work center and Reports view.-Search for: project 'Projects - Line Items'-In 'Selection' add necessary data and Click in Apply-In View section click in "+" and add 'Source Document Created By' and message: No Text for UUID {XYZ} is seen.-Cause-As per the system design, 'Projects - Line Items' report Shows the line items for projects of all project types. For customer projects the report also lists the line items of assigned sales order items. Source document created by is not available-Resolution-We suggest you to use report G/L Account - Line items where relevant details are available. For example you can add Source document/JE from Projects - Line Items and you can see Source document Created by is available.-Keywords-Report, Projects - Line Items

Title: Customer Invoice Form Shows City and Country Name in Uppercase
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that for some invoice documents the City and Country name are showing in Uppercase.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Preview.-In the template you can see that the Bill To City and Country name shows in uppercase.-Example: -CITY -COUNTRY--Cause-The reason the system is showing the city and country name in uppercase is because the address exceeds 3 (three) lines. -For addresses which does not exceeds 3 (three) lines, system performs the following logic: -If the postal address collective data is not surpassing 3 (three) lines, then the system considers it as incomplete data in the postal address, even though there some information maintained in the address. This leads to a recalculation of the formatting for the address, considering only the street address and not the postal address (which includes city & zipcode), and since there is no postal address passed to the routine for uppercase functionality, no uppercase for postal code is happening for address line which does not exceeds 3 (three) lines.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Portal to submit an idea. --Improvement requests need 20 votes of different customers/partners to qualify for review. Reviews will happen on a regular basis, with the results being communicated in a corresponding review blog post.-The ideas can be voted by other customers and partners and the most voted ones might be collected to the product backlog for future versions.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, Invoice, Uppercase, Lowercase, Country, City, Master File, Billing

Title: Unable to Replicate Employee Due To Error: Selected Position Not Valid In Current Time Range
Content: Symptom-Unable to Replicate Employee in Master Data Replication due to the below error.-Selected position not valid in current time range -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication Workcenter-Go to Employees view-Select Failed/Not Started status-Search for Employee ID:ABC-Edit and Select on Replicate button-Observe the error: Selected position not valid in current time range -Cause-There are differences in the validity dates under the Organizational Tab for RLU records for Employees.-Resolution-Scenario 1:-Under Organizational Assignment, ensure the Cost Center and Reporting Line Unit Valid To Dates should be the same.-Scenario 2:-In Organizational Assignment, ensure that there are no gaps between the Valid To date of RLU A and the Valid From date of RLU B. (Where A and B refers to Remote Org Unit ID)-Note: The below screenshot refers to 1 day gap, but it could be more than 1 day gap. Please ensure that there are no gaps.-Keywords-Employee Replication, Master Data Replication, Organizational Assignment, Reporting Line Unit, Cost Center

Title: Process communication error in Supplier Invoice - Tax amount is not equal to the sum of deductible and non-deductible amounts for document ID XXX.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-ATTENTION: Quality issue detected...-This KBA contains 1 screenshot(s) pointing to https://itsm.services.sap...Customers can't see them as the url is pointing to an internal system. Please contact KBA owner and ask for a fix.This message is only shown SAP internally, it is not visible for customers!-Symptom-You have created a Supplier Invoice, but Journal Entry have not been posted due to the Process Communication error - Tax amount is not equal to the sum of deductible and non-deductible amounts for document ID XXX. ("XXX" refers to Supplier Invoice ID).-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-2) Go to Invoice and Credit Memos sub view.-3) Search for the Supplier Invoice ID XXX ("XXX" refers to Supplier Invoice ID).-4) Go to the document flow, you will see the Process Communication Error under Supplier Invoice.-Cause-Technical Information:-Sender Party: SupplierInvoiceProcessing-Receiver Interface name: AccountingInvoiceAccountingIn-Error Information: Tax amount is not equal to the sum of deductible and non-deductible amounts for document ID XXX ("XXX" refers to Supplier Invoice ID).-This error occurs due to Tax amount and deductible amount are not equal , there might be some rounding of differences occurred.-Here we can't correct the data in the UI. But the value adjustment needs to be done in backend via Database table: TTED_DO_TAXDETAI.-Resolution-First of all you need to get a authorization from customer to do the required value adjustment in the backend.-Open the backend and go to transaction SESFTS.-Select BO:/SRMAP/LSIVX_SIV (Supplier Invoice).-Load by Query/ ROOT QUERY BY ELEMENTS.-Now give the Supplier Invoice 'XXX' in the ID content field and execute.-Take the Node ID which is failed with the XI Message due to above mentioned error and pass it to the table TTED_DO_TAXDETAI , field TAXDETAIL_GUID.-In Debug mode, edit the value of deductible_amount2 and make it same as Tax_amount2 as below.-Once the adjustment on the values done, Click on Save button.-Continue for all the line items and then reprocess the failed XI message in SRT_MONI.-Now go to Transaction code: SRT_MONI.-In the field Message ID, give the exact Node ID's where you made the adjustment of the values in table TTED_DO_TAXDETAI.-Select Node ID, click on actions-->Reprocess-The failed XI messages will be now delivered successfully.- Keywords-Process Communication Error, Supplier Invoice, sum of deductible and non-deductible amounts, Tax amount.

Title: The Responsible Employee Does Not Receive Customer Contract Notification
Content: Symptom-You have approved a customer contract, ideally system should create a notification task to the responsible employee, but the user does not get it in his inbox.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Search the contract ID and you find the notification "Customer Contract ABC Approved ". (ABC represents the ID of the contract), this notification is cancelled status.-From application log, you see the task determination information as following:-Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Employee:XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the responsible employee)-Info: Work Center Views that potentially grant access:-View:CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES-No employee has sufficient access rights-Cause-The user ABC does not has access right to view CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES, so the notification task is not sent and cancelled after some time.-Resolution-Ensure the user has access to CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES. -Keywords-BTM; notification; not received; No employee has sufficient access rights; CRM_CONTRACTS_SALES.

Title: Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is Not Generated for the Intercompany Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Outbound Delivery Invoice Request is not generated for the intercompany sales order after the Supplier Invoice got created from Purchase Order- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoice -> Invoice request -Search for Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the sales order ID)-There is no Outbound Delivery Invoice Request created and only Sales Order Invoice Request is generated-Cause-In the Third party Purchase Order the Delivery is Manually Finished. Due to that there was an exception in supplier invoice, which was Accepted. Due to this the Third party outbound delivery is not triggered.-Resolution-You need to perform Resume Delivery in the Purchase Order for the line item and then you can create and release third party inbound delivery notification. Once it is released the Third Party Inbound Delivery and Third Party Outbound Delivery will get created and corresponding Customer Invoice Request will get created.

Title: Product ID is Not Enabled in Commercial Credit Note and Debit Note (for India)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the release version 2311, it is introduced a new function for country India, that is Commercial Credit Note and Debit Note. While creating the new commercial credit note, you find the product ID field is disabled, you are not able to enter product into the document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Click New Commercial Credit Note from Common Tasks view.-In the New Commercial Credit Note Request screen, enter the necessary account and sales org information, In the Items section, a new item is auto created, and the Product ID field is not enabled. -Cause-In Items section, you can enter Tax Amount, but Product DI field is disabled and discounts cannot be applied.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-You can find more information about this function from help center document: Commercial Credit And Debit Note – India.-Keywords-Commercial Credit And Debit Note; product ID;2311 new features.

Title: Unable to create Tax Code for the Country which is not enabled as Tax Basic Region.
Content: Symptom-Unable to create Tax Code for the Country which is not enabled as Tax Basic Region. This is because you wanted to add the Tax Code for certain country while creating the Supplier Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business By Design.-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to the  Business Configuration Work center.-2) Go to the Overview sub view.-3) Search for *Tax on Goods and Services* activity.-4) Click 'Define Tax Codes' and give Add Row Button.-5) In Country/Region field, try to add your preferred Country.-6) In Tax Event there is no option to choose from (It shows No items found).-Cause-This is due that SAP haven't enabled certain countries as a Tax basic region.- Resolution-For the Country you've tried to add the the Tax Code is currently not enabled as Tax Basic Region and that this should be customized/addressed through SAP Cloud Applications Studio.-These below documents should help you to achieve the Tax codes enablement for certain countries.-Using the Localization Toolkit (SAP Business By Design) [https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_CLOUD_APPLICATIONS_STUDIO/549c75135a7e44859a53cdf191e0db54/73afdfd273e21014a11be3e82db01de6.html]-Localization [ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/85d74374ac314856a5de4c5e17dd73d9/dca9832505404ab9949106b4e6ed742f.html?q=localization ]-SAP ByD: Localization Toolkit and Language Adaptation Tool services. Set new subsidiaries anywhere in the world. [ https://blogs.sap.com/2017/02/10/sap-byd-localization-toolkit-and-language-adaptation-tool-services.-set-new-subsidiaries-anywhere-in-the-world./ ] -Keywords-Tax Code, Tax basic region, Supplier Invoice, SAP Cloud Applications Studio.

Title: Gross Capacity Not Fetching Data From Temporary Change of Work Schedule
Content: Symptom-The gross capacity of resource calendar is not getting updated with temporary change of work schedule which you have maintained for an employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Time Administration work center-2.Go to Regular Tasks view-3.Navigate to Temporary Change of Work Schedule-4.For particular employee maintain the temporary work schedule-5.Execute Run day closure for that particular employee -Now,-1.Go to Resource Management work center-2.Go to resource search -3.Choose button "show availability"-4.In resource calendar the gross capacity is not refreshed with temporary work schedule data-Cause-According to the configuration of the system, only time types with the "EMPLOYEE TIME ITEM CATEGORY" of 2, 3, 8, 9, or 14 meet the qualifying conditions to transfer the information to the resource calendar. -2        Special Attendance-3        Leave-8        Vacation-9        Illness-14      Unavailability of external employees-Resolution-To reflect the changes in resource calendar, you need to use a time type with category 2, 3, 8, 9, or 14 for temporary change of work schedule.-Keywords-Gross capacity, Resource calendar, resource availability update , refresh resource calendar, temporary change of work schedule , work schedule data not updated

Title: Unable to Enter Invoice Description More Than 40 Characters in the Supplier Invoice Document
Content: Symptom-You want to enter Invoice Description more than 40 characters; however, it is limited to 40 and system shows an error message if you enter more than 40 characters. -Error - Enter a value with no more than 40 characters-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Common Tasks and select New Invoice without Purchase Order-Navigate to Invoice Description field-Enter more than 40 characters-You will get an error-Cause-Invoice description field is limited to 40 characters only and cannot be extended to 120 characters or more. -Resolution-As a work around, you can enter the Invoice Description in the Notes section. You can post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 to extend the characters to more than 40. -Keywords-Enter a value with no more than 40 characters; Invoice Description field;

Title: Receivables Balance Confirmation Custom Field on The Preview Form
Content: Symptom-You create a custom field named 'Custom ID' in the system to show the credit memo ID (in case it references an invoice) in the Print form of Balance Confirmation for receivables.-Your custom field instead of showing the credit memo ID, shows the invoice ID or is blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customers view.-Select Balance Confirmation subview.-Select the Balance Confirmation ID: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the Balance Confirmation).-Select Edit.-Select Balances and Documents tab.-Select the Credit Memo with Document ID: AAA (AAA stands for the Document ID).-Credit Memo (Document ID): AAA has External Reference BBB (BBB stands for External Reference and is the ID of the invoice created before the credit memo).-Select Preview > Print.-In the Print form (Account Statement), your Custom ID field is blank and does not have any ID.-Cause-For the preview of balance confirmation (Account Statement), the system checks if the document has an original invoice reference. If yes, the system replaces the values of Base Transaction Document Reference ID and UUID with original invoice reference ID, UUID respectively.-For credit memo created without reference to an invoice, the credit memo ID shows in the custom field.-For credit memo created with reference to an invoice, the invoice ID shows in the custom field or is blank.-Resolution-This is the standard normal system behavior.-Please note this standard system behavior to show the ID of the original invoice ID instead of the credit memo ID is in regards to the Preview form.-On the system UI, the custom field shows the ID of the  credit memo as you expect whether it has an original invoice or not.-Keywords-Receivables, Balance Confirmation, Account Statement, Document ID, Base Reference ID, Custom ID, External Reference, Credit Memo, Invoice.

Title: GR/IR Clearing Set Type System Behavior for a Supplier Invoice Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have posted a supplier invoice and in the resulting journal entry, the GR/IR Clearing Set Type in the Item Details is not as you expected.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-View Journal Entries and click on Journal Entries.-Enter the Journal Entry ID of the Supplier Invoice and click on view.-Select the Purchases Debit Entry and view the Item Details: Purchase.-GR/IR Clearing Set Type is shown as Supplier Invoice.-Cause-You have posted the invoice first before the Inbound Delivery/Goods and Services Receipt. In that case, the clearing set type is always Supplier Invoice.-Resolution-After the posting of the Delivery/Goods and Services Receipt there will be a New version of invoice posted automatically.-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Source Documents and All Source Documents.-Find the Invoice Source Document ID.-Here, you will see the subsequent versions like 2 or 3 and so on.-Select the subsequent version and Actions > View Business Transaction > View All > Journal Entries tab.-Click on the Journal Entry ID.-You can notice that this journal entry ID is different from the journal entry entry id of the version 1 of the supplier invoice.-This new Supplier Invoice version will post to accounting and it change only clearing set to Goods and Services Receipt. This is expected behavior.-If the scenario is in the sequence of Purchase order, Goods and Service Receipt and Supplier invoice, then in the supplier invoice accounting entry will automatically show the GR/IR Clearing Set Type as Goods and Services Receipt and system doesn't post any versions to change the clearing set.-Keywords-GR/IR Clearing Set, GR/IR Clearing Run-gr/ir clearing set,gr/ir clearing set supplier invoice

Title: Error 'Account determination missing for item type Deferrals of Depreciation for Missing Costs' in Revenue Recognition
Content: Symptom-You have execute the Revenue Recognition run. It finishes with the error  'Account determination missing for item type Deferrals of Depreciation for Missing Costs'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign All Versions-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Revenue Recognition view. -Select the run and Open the  Application log.-In the Processed with Errors tab , find the document item for which the error appears.-Error shows: Account determination missing for item type Deferrals of Depreciation for Missing Costs-Cause-You have not maintianed the G/L account for Account determination. You need to maintain Configuration of 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination > Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination > Sales >Revenue Recognition - Accruals'-Resolution-Maintain the G/L account in configuration path 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination > Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination > Sales >Revenue Recognition - Accruals'-Go to work center Business Configuration and view Overview.-Find and open Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Open Sales subledger of Account Determination.-In tab Revenue Recognition - Accruals', add G/L account for Accrued Costs.-Save the changes.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-项目类型缺少成本的折旧延期缺少科目确定, 收入确认

Title: Withholding Tax Required Field is not Available Under Company Tax Arrangements for a Tax Authority for Non-Localized Country

Title: Requested Date in the Sales Orders Does Not Change as Expected
Content: Symptom-When you change the Requested Date in Sales Order, the system resets the date back to original date which was present earlier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Show All Orders and find sales order XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the sales order).-Edit the sales order and select View All.-In the General Tab, Change the Requested Date to Future date.-The system changes the date back to the date which was present before change.-Cause-Scenario 1:-According to the current system design when a Sales Order is created manually or  via intercompany scenario, function rules are determined for the Requested date(start date) and Requested end date.-When we are trying to change the Requested Date, the requested end date will also get adjusted to the changed date +24 hours .-When you change the Requested end date manually then the rule will get cleared off and no change happens to Requested start date.-If you change the Requested Date to a future date which is later than the current Requested End date, the requested end date will also get adjusted to the changed date +24 hours.-If you change the Requested end Date to a  date which is before  the current Requested start date, you will get error"Start date and time must be before end date and time"-Scenario 2:-When Sales Order is created via A2X web service these function rules are not determined and when we are changing the Requested Date then the Requested End date won’t get adjusted and it won’t allow the changes to Requested Date as end date is less than start date and date will get reset back to old value.-Scenario 3:-Default logic for calculation of requested end date  at  header level(general tab) of intercompany sales order is:-Requested start date is copied from first line item of sales order and  requested end date is + 24 hours of the requested start date.-Resolution-Scenario 1:Change the date in the Requested Date Field and also change the date in the Field Requested End as desired as per above mentioned logic in the cause section for Scenario 1.-Scenario 2:Change the date in the Requested Date Field and maintain the same date in the Field Requested End.-Please Note:-If Field Requested End is not available, then please add it to your Sales Order screen in General Tab using Personalization Mode.-When creating a sales order, the Requested Date on General tab will be copied to the item lines. When you changing the Requested Date on General tab,-If the line Requested Date is not changed before, the date will be updated according to the date on General tab.-If the line Requested Date once changed, then it will not be updated.-If the customer demand is released to the line, the requested date cannot be updated any more.-See Also-1725558 - You Cannot Overwrite the Requested Date in a Sales Order Which is Partially Delivered-2811415 - In a Sales Order Item, Requested Date and Requested End Fields Have Different Formatting-Keywords-Requested Date Reset; Cannot Change Requested Date; Requested Date Sales Order; automatically; changed; by the system; back to the original date; Requested Date; Sales Order.

Title: Incorrect Document Name Displayed In Document Output History Report For Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When the user tries to generate a report for the Sales Order Documents, they observe the template name is incorrectly displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Workcenter-Go to List view-Select 'Document Output History (To be deprecated)'-In the Selection tab, enter the Recipients: ABC (Where ABC refers to Customer Account Number)-Now observe, the template name in the report is displayed incorrectly. (For eg: Sales Order Acknowledgement Sales Order Confirmation XYZ)-Cause-If the document name is not maintained in form template maintenance, it will concatenate template description along with the Form Template Name which is saved in the database at order release time.-Resolution-This is the Standard system behavior. The user should either maintain the document name or remove the description or remove both (Document Name, Template Description) in the Form Template Maintenance.-Please follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Form Template Maintenance view-Search for Sales Order Acknowledgement Template-Select the Record-Select Actions-Select Maintain Document Name and either Maintain or Remove the name-The description of the template can be removed by following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Form Template Maintenance view-Search for Sales Order Acknowledgement Template-Select the Record-Select Copy and Choose As New Template from the dropdown-Remove the Template Description-Save and Publish the template-Keywords-Document Output History Report, Template, Form Template Maintenance, Sales Order Document, Sales Order Acknowledgement, Sales Order Confirmation

Title: Process Communication Error in GSR: Error message /CDF/CM_BO_SERVICE_PROVIDER must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The following Process Communication error occurs in teh GSR (Goods and Service Acknowledgement) and therefore the Service Confirmation is not created:-Sender Party: GoodsAndServiceAcknowledgement-Receiver Interface: ServiceConfirmationProcessingServiceConfirmationIn-Error: Error in Confirmation creation: Error message /CDF/CM_BO_SERVICE_PROVIDER must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Service Confirmations cannot be created for an item for which the Delivery Status is Finished and therefore the creation of the Service Confirmation fails. When the GSR tries to create the Service confirmation the system checks the refferenced item in e.g. the Service Order if the Delivery Status is Finished or if the item is referenced to a contract item which is already completed the error occurs.-Resolution-Check the referrenced Document - Item in the GSA and check the Delivery Status of the respective item in the document e.g Service Order.-Check the creation date of the GSA and compare this with the completion date of the Item in e.g. the respective Service Order-If this item is already completed check with the customer if the Service Confirmation for the GSA is still required.-If this is still required the Process needs to be reversed and the Delivery Status needs to be In Process again. The XI message can then be restarted and the Service Confirmation can be created.-If the Service Confirmation is not required anymore you can cancel the failed XI message with the customers permission.-See Also-KBA 3281095 - Process Communication Error in GSR: Error message /CDF/CM_BO_SERVICE_PROVIDER must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task-Keywords-Process Communication Error; Goods and Service Receipt; Service Confirmation; CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT

Title: No Customer Invoice is Created From Point-Of-Sales Transactions
Content: Symptom-You have created and released a POS sales transaction, in the document flow tab you are able to find the outbound delivery document but no customer invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Point-of-Sale Transactions view.-Select the Sales Transaction sub view.-Open Sales Transaction ABC (ABC represents the Internal ID of the Sales Transaction).-Go to the Document Flow tab, there is no Customer Invoice document created.-Cause-In POS sales transactions,  the financial documents are generated out of the POS sales transaction, no customer invoice documents are generated. -You can find more information from help center documents:-Point-of-Sale Transaction Processing-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cecf566722d101493b9ef865d0d79bd.html?q=point%20of%20sales%20#process-flow-for sales transaction, If the sales transaction data is consistent, it is automatically released to Financial Management and Inventory Management.-Correct and Release a Sales Transaction-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2d9393cf722d1014a13d929b7c1c3db9.html#result If you have released the sales transaction, if required, the system creates a goods and activity confirmation in Inventory Management to post the goods issue and creates a corresponding journal entry in Financial Management. To check whether Financial Management documents have been created, search for the sales transaction in the All Sales Transactions view, open the sales transaction, and check the Document Flow. -Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-POS; Point-of-sales; Point Of Sales; no customer invoice.

Title: Error "Account ID Missing" While Adding Tax Exemption Certificate During Account Creation via ManageCustomerIn Webservice.
Content: Symptom-When you try to add Tax Exemption Certificate while creating new account by using the web service ManageCustomerIn, you receive the error message 'Account ID Missing'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-To find the webservice:-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Go to Input and Output Management view-Go to Service Explorer subview-Search for the webservice ManageCustomerIn-Select the button Download WSDL to download the WSDL file for the webservice-Using a third party tool like SOAPUI, run the Request Payload:-Login to SOAPUI tool-Select File -> New SOAP Project-In the Initial WSDL field, browse for the downloaded WSDL file for ManageCustomerIn-Expand the node: MaintainBundle_V1-Select Request 1-Paste the Request payload-At the bottom of the screen, select Auth (Basic)-Provide the relevant credentials and the domain-Run the Request Payload-You are trying to add Tax Exemption Certificate during creation of Account and response payload throws error message "Account ID missing"-Cause-To add a tax exemption certificate the account must be active. -Resolution--If you are creating new account, save the account first to make it active and then you can maintain the tax exemption certificate via ManageCustomerIn Webservice. -Keywords-Tax Exemption Certificate,ManageCustomerIn Webservice,Account ID Missing, Account must be active

Title: Error: UI Designer has caught an exception. XRepositoryException (4)Element [ABC] is transient but has no valuation source, hence it cannot be resolved [BO/node: [BO /Node]
Content: Symptom-The customer reports the following error when binding a standard BO element/field to the UI data model or when activating their screen:-UI Designer has caught an exception. XRepositoryException (4)Element 'FORMATTED_NAME' is transient but has no valuation source, hence it cannot be resolved [BO/node: IDENTITY/ROOT]-The usage of this BO entity is not allowed in mode 'UI': 'Element 'FORMATTED_NAME' is transient but has no valuation source, hence it cannot be resolved [BO/node: IDENTITY/ROOT]'-SADL View generation failed-An exception was raised-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Bind the UI data field to the standard BO field-Activate the screen-Error Appears -Open the SADL Query - You will see the field in the error message is checked in the result set. -In this example, the field FormattedName should have the "Result" checkbox removed:- Cause-The error happens because a UI data model field is bound to a transient field and is used in a SADL query.-A transient field can never be used in a SADL Query as it will have no value on loading.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, the field should be unchecked from the result column in the SADL Query.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-PDI, SDK, Custom, OWL, EC, OVS, transient, valuation, source, bind, binding, activation, usage, BO, entity, not, allowed, mode

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Realizes Revenue of Contract Item on the Wrong G/L Account
Content: Symptom-You execute the revenue recognition run for contract item XYZ-XX and notice that the run transfers the previously realized revenue from G/L account ABC to G/L account DEF (XYZ-XX represents the contract item ID, ABC and DEF represent two G/L accounts of type REVGAN-Revenue or Gains).-The contract item has been completed (fully invoiced, fully delivered, end date is reached). You do not expect any further postings for this item.-When checking the account determination settings for Sales Revenue you notice that G/L account DEF is maintained for the account determination group (which is assigned in the customer master data).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Select Customer Contract items and find item XYZ-XX.-Press Reports and select Sales Document - Line Items for Customer Contract Item.-In the report you notice that the full net value of the contract item is credited to G/L account ABC in accounting period AAA.YYYY*. -You notice that the run for a more recent or later accounting period  BBB.YYYY**debits G/L account ABC again and credits G/L account DEF. -*AAA.YYYY represents an accounting period-**BBB.YYYY represents a current/later accounting period-To verify the correct account determination settings -access the customer financial master data and take note of the maintained account determination group, ABCD (ABCD represents the account determination group ID). -Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine-tune activity.-Go to Account Determination Sales.-In the Revenues tab, select Services and find account determination group ABCD. -Verify that G/L account ABC is assigned to this account determination group. -To verify that the contract item is completed -Go to the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue work center.-Find item XYZ-XX.-Go to the Dates tab. -The Final Delivery and Invoice date is set. -In the same tab verify that the end date of the contract item has passed. -Cause-Option 1: A different G/L account has been assigned to account determination group ABCD: -The assignment of the Sales Revenue G/L account to the account determination group was changed after the customer invoice for contract item XYZ-XX was posted.-The G/L account (Origin)* of the Customer Invoice posting is account DEF.-After the G/L account assignment, change all periodic revenue for the contract item gets posted to the newly assigned account ABC.-However, during the final accrual posting, after the contract item has been completed, its total net value gets transferred from the new account ABC back to the original account DEF.-Option 2: The account determination setting for the involved service changed. However, it is not possible to identify valuation data changes of services from the frontend. If you need assistance in finding out if there was any change on the account determination group of the involved service, please contact your Product Support team through an incident.-*To verify the G/L account (Origin) of the customer invoice open the invoices Journal Entry. -Find the Deferred Revenue line item and check the G/L Account (Origin). This will be the account where the revenue is going to be realized with the final accrual posting.-Resolution-If the revenue must remain on account ABC, then there are two possibilities:-Either reverse the customer invoice and re-create it so it gets posted with G/L account (Origin) ABC. Then complete the contract items and execute the revenue recognition run again.-Or create a manual journal entry voucher of type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents with screen variant 633 - Man. Adjusting Entry for Sales Documents for the affected customer contract item(s) where you manually debit G/L account DEF again and credit G/L account ABC.-Keywords-customer contract item wrong G/L account for sales revenue, G/L account change revenue recognition run

Title: Approvals is skipped in supplier invoice
Content: Symptom- Approval not triggered in supplier invoice when approval condition has "Random exception check percentage"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Pre requisite: Approval condition has "Random exception check percentage"- then Person A Creates an invoice such that exception comes up that  he can accept.- so he accepts the exception and click on Post and invoice goes for approval as expected.- however if a person B withdraws the invoice and no new exception is created, he then Post the invoice.- you will see that approvals are not triggered and is Posted skipping approvals-Below are scenarios we considered for testing and analysis:-1. Person A created, accepted, posted - goes for  approval-2. Person A created, accepted , but B has posted-  no approval-3. Person A created, person B excepted, Posted-no approval-4. Person A created, person B accepted, person A posted- no approval-5. Person A created, accepts, posts then person B withdraw, edited, accepted and post - goes for approval-6. Person A created, accepts, posts, then person B withdraw ,edited, and posts- no approval.-Cause-Condition: 'random exception check percentage'-This particular condition has this behavior confirmed by developers-Cause its is completely a code-based validation. A complex routine was written considering different scenarios for the validation at the time of development of the product.-Resolution--As per system development, system behavior is such that only when all three actions  of SIV that is creation, acceptance  of exception and posting of done by same person then it goes for approval.- however  when another person involved that is like withdraw and Post or  withdraw,edit and Post(no new exception)  or withdraw and  save .then  system  not considering the approval process thus its not going for approval.-However this scenario seems to be very rare thus may be its not considered while developing this feature initially the system was developed. Thus we request you to put it as new requirement in the Customer influence forum at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-- or -Ask partners to try an achieve this and do let us know if you face issue in doing it .-See Also- 1998519 - Supplier Invoice with Accepted Exception Not Sent to Approval

Title: Error Message "Item X: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service ABC and set of books IFRS valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing"
Content: Symptom-When you save the creation of new Sales Order, system throws below error-Item X: Costs not determined: Cost rate for service ABC and set of books IFRS valid on DD.MM.YYYY is missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-New Sales Order-Enter all required values -System throws above error-When Opening the Service ABC, system shows alert Check and save new valuation details for company LMN-Cause-You have migrated the Valuation details in migration of services, they had not migrated the Valuation "Cost" details and therefore the costs were defaulted to "0" assuming that the user would later on confirm that the costs of valuation are actually 0 or something else.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, do the following after migrating the Services via the Migration of Services: --Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview view-Open the fine tuning activity Migration of Service Valuation Data-Select Migrate service valuation data using the migration tool-Make a note of all the Services migrated along with all other Financial details for respective company ids-Migrate them-You can maintain the cost as 0 there in the template if you want to maintain a cost.-This migration would confirm that the value of "Cost" for Valuation.-See Also-1892976 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Quote: "Costs not determined"-2879580 - You get Error While Creating a New Sales Order: "Costs not determined"-Keywords-service, valuation, cost, 0, zero, costs not determined, cost rate for service, sales order, set of books, check and save new valuation details for company, missing

Title: You have created a Payment Allocation and the "Payment Allocated To" field is not available.
Content: Symptom-The "Payment Allocated To" field is not visible when a specific account, is selected in the Customer/Supplier ID field in a payment allocation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Payment Management work center.-Select the view Payment Allocation.-Select the dropdown option: In preparation Payment Allocations.-Open any allocation.-Enter the value ABC into the Customer/Supplier ID field. (ABC is representing the Customer/Supplier ID).-The "Payment Allocated To" field does not appear.-Cause-This is standard and expected system behaviour.-Resolution-The "Payment Allocated To" field appears only if the account has multiple functions.-To identify if this is the case:-Go to the Business Partner Data work center.-Select the view Suppliers/Customers.-Search and find the account ABC.-Go to the General Tab-Under the Supplier/Customer name you will see the multiple functions available.-If more than one of these are selected the "Payment Allocated To" field will become available.-See Also-- KBA LONG_DIGITS - Error : Payment Allocated To Missing-Keywords-Payment Allocation, Payment Allocated To, Missing Field, Supplier/Customer

Title: Message - You are navigating to an external site

If you are sure about the authenticity of the URL, click OK to proceed. Otherwise, click Cancel.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is a new feature that has been introduced with the 2002 release.- Resolution-If user do not want to see the pop-up message, then need to add the relevant external url 's to the allowed external link as mentioned below:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Project.-Open Activity List.-Select All Activities and search for "Allowed"-Select Allowed External Link and Select "Add to Project" (If not added already).-Open "Allowed External Link" -Select on "Add Row".-Now add the values for Entity ID and make sure to start with Z.-Provide the URL and relevant description.-Save-Keywords-You are navigating to an external site, authenticity of the URL, click OK to proceed, Otherwise, click Cancel.

Title: "Changed On" Row in Monitoring Invoices Report Not Reflecting Posting Date
Content: Symptom-You have a supplier invoice to post. Before you post it, you first make some changes to it.-But when you check Report: Monitoring Invoices, for Changed On row field, the date and time is not the date and time when supplier invoice is posted, but when the last change is made.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create supplier invoice XXX (XXX stands for the document ID).-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Create supplier invoice XXX and save it.-Make some changes to supplier invoice XXX. For example, change the total amount.-Go to Business Analytics work center -> Design Reports view.-Navigate to View button and add "Changed On" to Row Fields. *Note: Changed On is on Supplier Invoice level.-Confirm that the date and time at Changed On row field matches the change made to total amount.-Go back to supplier invoice XXX and post it.-Check the date and time of posing at Changes tab of supplier invoice XXX.-Go back to Report: Monitoring Invoices -> Changed On row field, the date and time doesn't get updated.-Cause-Changed On row field only reflects changes of value like total amount, tax code. Actions like posting will not be recorded in the report.-Resolution-This is a normal system behavior.-Keywords-Report; Monitoring Invoices; Changes; Changed On

Title: Error: 'Bank Data for Business Partner Already Exists' in Customer Migration Template
