Title: Common Issues with PDI Add-On Mismatch in Change Project Merge Scenarios
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***--This documents serves to collect the most common issues related to PDI add-on mismatches that occur during the merge back of a change project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-S.No Issue Description Scenario Frontend Error SLG1 log Analysis Cause What's Next References-1 Solution and/or version missing on one of the tenants Merge back Change Project from Test to Production Check system versions-System versions do not match. Source sys rep is different from target sys. Open transaction SDIM on both target and source tenant’s backend-Check if both tenants have the same PDI solutions-If positive for above, check if all PDI solutions are on the same version Add-on or add-on Version mismatch In case of any mismatch, please ask the partner to either delete or add solutions until both tenants have the same solution composition (same PDIs in the same version).  Blog-2 Reference still exists in workspace after solution was deleted Merge back Change Project from Test to Production Check consistency of change project-Change project inconsistent. “Element XYZ does not exist in current scoping phase.” (where XYZ stands for the ID of the scoping element)-Check SLG1 log for more details on the PDI element and fine-tuning value.-Check on SE16 tables BCTD_WSSCOCD or BCTD_WSDECISION with the element ID to ensure that it's not included in the relevant workspace.-A PDI element has been removed improperly, and reference to it still exists in the Business Configuration. Check with customer and ensure that the solution was intentionally deleted.-If positive, forward incident to component AP-RC-BCT asking for the removal of the references to the deleted solution in the Business Configuration-If negative, please ask the partner to add the solution back to the system so that the reference is consistent.  -3-Check system versions-System versions do not match.-Sync/merge is not possible-One-off solution XYZ_BC missing on productive tenant-Pls ask your partner to upload missing solution(s) and retry afterwards-or-One-off solution XYZ_BC missing on test tenant-(where XYZ_BC stands for the solution name)-Same as #1-Same as #1-4 Move project solution profile to production tenant-An exception was raised-Source sys rep is different from target sys. Source: Target: /BY001234.-Source sys rep is different from target sys. Source: Target: /BY005678.-Skip check with SPA/GPA Param-BCT_IMPORT_NO_CHECK in the target tenant-(where /BY001234 and /BY005678 stand for the names of the add-ons)-Same as #1-Same as #1-Customer might not be aware of the add-on's names, as /BY001234 and /BY005678 are formats for internal reference. Actual add-on name can be found in SPC.-5-System versions do not match--Copy not allowed; source and target system have different add on versions-One of the cause could be that the KUT solution is implicitly created first time when a CBO(Custom Business Object) is created (in case of test tenant ) and CBO is uploaded (in case of productive tenant). Refer KBA 2319213-See Also- 1846200 - Central Case Document for Issues Related to Merge Failed While Merging a Change Project-Keywords-Add-On Mismatch, Merge Issues, PDI, Change Project

Title: Not Able to Modify the Extension Field's Length
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to modify the length of a extension field type of Decimal Number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-For example, if the extension field is from Purchase Order:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ID XYZ (XYZ represents Purchase Order ID).-Choose Edit.-Go to Profile Picture Icon.-Choose Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation mode.-In the bottom, select Extension Fields by choosing "+" icon.-In the custom field dialog box, select the required extension field with the Field Type as "Decimal Number".-Choose Edit.- The Length field is grayed out.-Cause-The Length of a Decimal Number extension field cannot be edited after the extension field has been created.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Extension Field; Decimal Number; Length; Edited; Adaptation Mode; Modify

Title: Full Digits Invoice Number is not Available in the Customer Invoices (Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice Function for China)
Content: Symptom-You have completed the process of Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice (FDEI) for an invoice, but the FEDI number uploaded via the inbound import file is not found in the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices view.-Show 'Completed Invoices' query, you can see the invoice ABC is list. (ABC represents the invoice ID)-Open the invoice, you are not able to find the Full Digits Invoice Number in the invoice.-Cause-There are no enhancements done to show Full Digits Invoice Number in the invoices.-The number can be seen in the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices view only.-Resolution-This is the current system design. -To get Full Digits Invoice Number, you can try the following steps:-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices view.-Show 'Completed Invoices' query, you are able to get the list of completed invoices, and the Full Digits Invoice Number is available.-Click Export, you can download the list and get the Full Digits Invoice number for the invoices.-Keywords-Fully Digital Electronic Invoice; Full Digits Invoice Number; Golden Tax.

Title: Error 'City in address of Bill-To party missing' in Intercompany Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Unable to release an intercompany sales order due the error message 'City in address of Bill-To party missing'.-Or error message 'City in address of Account and Bill-To party missing'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center.-Go to Sales Orders view.-Edit the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-System shows error 'City in address of Bill-To party missing'.-Cause-In purchasing system consider Bill-To as an org unit and in sales order it is treated as a business partner. Since the sales order is created from a purchase order, system selects the address details from the org unit maintained under the Org Structure.-Resolution-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Select the relevant Org Unit.-Click on Edit and navigate to Addresses tab.-Under Bill-To address section, you need to maintain the complete address.-Select Activate & Activate Selected Structure.-Select Save and Close.-See Also-2738172 - Error: "City in address of Account, Ship-To, and Bill-To party missing"-Keywords-Sales order created from purchase order, Sales Order, Purchase Order, City, Missing, Bill-to, Ship-to-

Title: OData Query Builder Does Not Work With Date Time Fields
Content: Symptom-You are using the OData query builder to create a report query, but when you try to set a variable on a datetime field, you receive the following error message:-Value YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS stands for the date and time you enter) not valid for variable ABC (ABC stands for the field for which you are trying to set the value)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and select the view Design Data Sources.-Search for the data source you would like to query via OData.-Click Build OData Queries.-Go to Filters.-Go to the datetime field, for example Last Changed Date and Time.-Enter the GT or GE option.-Enter any value, for example 2019-01-01T00:00:00.-You receive the above error message.-Cause-It is not recommended to use filter in "Date-Time" data type of fields in the OData Query.-Resolution-Kindly check the data source documentation, where you would find an alternate field which shows data in terms of "Date".-Try to use filter in the same and execute the query-Keywords-odata, data source, report, datetime, date_time, date time, value not valid for variable

Title: The Fulfilled Quantity of Output Product is Zero in Product Order while the Output Product Has Been Confirmed with Some Quantity in Related Production Task
Content: Symptom-You have confirmed some quantity of output product in a production task, but the fulfilled quantity is zero in corresponding production order.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Go to view Production Orders - By Order Header.-Search XXX (XXX represents the production order ID), click Edit.-Select tab Products - Output Products, for product YYY (YYY represents the output product ID), fulfilled quantity is zero.-Select tab Document Flow,  find production confirmation ZZZ (YYY represents the confirmation ID), open it, for product YYY, confirmed quantity is a number greater than zero.-Cause-In production confirmation ZZZ, for the product YYY, Product Type is "By-Product". The confirmed quantity of by-product will not be considered in production order, even when it is the same product as output product.-Please note, the confirmed quantity of by-product will also been received into warehouse.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Production Order, Output Product, Fulfilled Quantity

Title: Reconciliation Run: Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry XYZ - Rounding Logic and Line Item Calculation
Content: Symptom-The Processing Status of the Reconciliation Report indicates an Error (red).-Under Tab Messages the error shows as: Calculated tax amount differs from posted tax amount for journal entry XYZ - Source Document Type: Tax Ledger Account-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the General Ledger work center go to Periodic Tasks view / Reconciliation. -Start a New Reconciliation Run with pertinent parameters including Tax under Subledger Selection.-Under tab Tax / VAT / Sales Tax Calculation Details differences as to Calculated Tax Amount and Posted Tax Amount are listed for an affected G/L Account XXX.-Shown difference amounts to under 1 LC (LC stands for Local Currency).-Cause-Shown differences in Tax Amounts can result from applied rounding methodology for involved documents.-Resolution-We want to illustrate applied rounding behaviour using the Example of an Expense Report ABC (ER) and a tax rate of 19%.-Expense G/L Account XXX shows as Tax Base Amount, Calculated Tax Amount, Posted Tax Amount, Absolute Difference:-G/L Account  Percent JE ID Tax Base Amount Calculated Tax Amount Posted Tax Amount Absolute Difference-XXX 19%   75.66  14.40 14.34 0.06-ER ABC over 90.00 LC contains 6 line items of 15.00 LC including VAT (19%). Per line the following calculation logic applies.-Document Item: ABC-1-Document Item Amount: 15.00 LC (incl. VAT [1.19])-Tax Base Amount = 15.00 LC / 1.19 = 12.605042 LC-Tax Amount  = Tax Base Amount * 0.19 = 2.394958 LC-  Document Amount (1.19) Tax Base Amount (1.00) Tax Amount (0.19)-ABC-1 15.00 LC 12.605042 LC 2.394958 LC -ABC-2 15.00 LC 12.605042 LC 2.394958 LC -ABC-3 15.00 LC 12.605042 LC 2.394958 LC -ABC-4  15.00 LC 12.605042 LC 2.394958 LC -ABC-5 15.00 LC 12.605042 LC 2.394958 LC -ABC-6  15.00 LC 12.605042 LC 2.394958 LC -Posted Tax Amount:-Per line-item the Tax Amount is rounded to 2 decimals = 2.39 LC. For the entire document G/L Account XXX this amounts to 6 * 2.39 LC = 14.34 LC.-Tax Base Amount  = 6 * 12.61 LC = 75.66 LC. (This corresponds to the amount posted to expense G/L Account XXX).-Calculated Tax Amount:-For the entire document and G/L Account XXX the calculated Tax Amount is the rounded sum of all line-item Tax Amounts.-2.394958 LC * 6 = 14.369748 LC; resulting in 14.40 LC.-See Also-See SAP Knowledge Base Article 2122131-Keywords-Reconciliaiton Report, Tax, Difference, Rounding

Title: Error message 'Customer Specific Price List XXX with same key YYY already exists' when releasing the Customer Specific Price List
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a newly created Customer Specific Price List ZZZ . Error messages  'Action failed' and 'Customer Specific Price List XXX with same key YYY already exists' are triggered (XXX stands for the Customer Specific Price List which is already created and released, YYY is ID for the Customer/Account which is used in the price list XXX and ZZZ. ZZZ stands for the new Customer Specific Price List)-Environment- SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work centre.-Go to the Pricing view.-Navigate to the Price Lists subview.-Show: Customer Specific Price List.-Click on New button and then select Customer Specific Price List -Enter the Account ID YYY and the name as ZZZ(YYY is the ID of the Account and ZZZ is the name of the price list).-Click on the Release button and choose Release.-Error messages 'Action failed' and ''Customer Specific Price List XXX with same key YYY already exists' are raised.-Cause-This error message is raised because you have already created and released a Customer Specific Price List for the Account ID YYY and hence it not possible to create a new price list with same Account ID with overlapping validity.-Note: Even if you change the currency to a different one in the newly created Price list it would still result in error because Account ID is same. Also if you have already created a Customer specific price list used for business partner of the company then it's not possible to create an another company specific price list using the same business partner.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior and it not possible to create two Customer Specific Price List for a same Account ID with different currencies.-See Also-2563525 - Error Message 'Base Price List with same validity already exists' Raised when Releasing Base Price List -Keywords-Customer Specific Price List; Price List; Account; Company Specific Price List

Title: Bill of Exchange for South Korea
Content: Symptom-You want to know the GL Account configuration for Bill of Exchange postings for South Korea.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Click the Document Id XX[represents document id] to open the payment, which is in Status In Transfer.-Here the Payment Method: Bill of Exchange Payable with Acceptance and a Journal Entry is created.-Cause-Currently, only the Bill of Exchange for Receivable with Sole Bill Process is supported for South Korea.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Localization Country Update: Israel and South Korea-Keywords-South Korea, Bill of Exchange Payable

Title: System Crashes while Changing Unit of Quantity in Production Bill of Operation
Content: Symptom-When you are changing the unit of Quantity in Production Bill of Operation (BoO), system dump with message “500 SAP Internal Server Error”.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center.-Navigate to Production Bills Of Operation View.-Search for BoO XXX.-Edit.-Navigate to General Tab.-Change the unit of Quantity.-Choose button Save or Check Consistency, then the error occurs.-Cause-Other fields like "Send Ahead Quantity" in the Make Operation of BoO still use the original unit.-Resolution-Please ensure the Unit of Measure (UoM) of other fields are the same with Quantity UoM.-Keywords-500 SAP Internal Server Error; Production Bill of Operation; Dump; Unit of Measure; Change.

Title: Unidentified Work Center View ID in Changes Tab of Business Users
Content: Symptom-Unknown workcenter id like 12_#$IBR$#_3 in Business user changes view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and user management work center.-Edit Business user K98TSGINRUP.-Go to Changes tab.-You find a workcenter id like 12_#$IBR$#_3.-Cause-In this case when the user was assigned business role with ID "12" the entry was created in the Identity BO as "12_#$IBR$#_3 ". Hence this signifies when the business role was assigned to the user.-Resolution-This is the designed system behaviour.-Keywords-Business Role, Unidentified Work Center, Work Center ID

Title: ASSIGN on Empty Generic Box
Content: Symptom-You create several extension fields for purchase proposal and also add them to service ManagePurchaseProposalIn. However, error ""ASSIGN on empty generic box"" occurs when calling the API.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Inbound Service Manage Purchase Proposals has clearly stated that this interface Operation Create purchase proposals does not support extensibility.-Resolution-You need to remove all the extensions from the operation of the service.-As a workaround, you can add extensions under Root Node.-See Also-Inbound Service Manage Purchase Proposals-Keywords-Purchase Proposal, Extension Field, Empty generic box.

Title: Display Currency in the report is not as Expected
Content: Symptom-The Expense Reports by Cost Object report is executed by entering the company and other details, and the Display Currency is observed to be different from the company currency.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Reports, Lists sub-view.-Filter for Expense Reports by Cost Object.-Enter the Company, Country Version and expense report details and click on Apply.-The Display Currency is shown as the Default Company Currency XYZ (XYZ represents the default currency), while the selected company has the company currency PQR (PQR represents the currency).-Cause-Default currency is taken from the company of the user that is logged in and viewing the report.-Resolution-Default currency is taken from the company of the user that is logged in and viewing the report. If the user is assigned to a company and if its currency is PQR then the report also shows the currency from the company to which this user is assigned to, even though the data selection has a different company and its company currency is different.-This is the expected system behavior. To use a different currency, manually change the Display Currency.-See Also-KBA 1625369 - How System Determines Default Currency in Expense Report-KBA 2741128 - Currency Derivation for Expense Report Payments-KBA 3407173 - Payment Currency in the Expense Report is not as Expected-Keywords-display currency in the report, expense report, company currency, default currency,-default company currency is not showing,display currency

Title: Payment Advice is Not in the Second Step of the Bank Statement
Content: Symptom-You have created a payment advice via standard web service and the document has been successfully created in the system. However, when you try to select the payment advice in the second step of the bank statement, you will find that the newly created payment advice is not in the list.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Service Explorer view.-Search for Web Service Name: ManageBankAdviceIn.-Download the WSDL file and enter the required information in the file.-Login to SOAP UI.-Execute ManageBankAdviceIn web service to create payment advice, e.g. payment advice 123(123 represents the payment advice ID).-Then go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Bank Statements view.-Create a new bank statement.-In the second step, you find that the newly created payment advice 123 is not in the list.-Cause-You have included the payment reference information in the payload. Once you have entered the payment reference in the payment advice, you won't be able to see the payment advice in the second step of the bank statement.-'<PaymentReference>-<ID>XXX</ID>-</PaymentReference>'-You can also check the payment advice 123 in the system and will notice that this field is filled.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior. Please check if you need to modify the payload by deleting the relevant information.-Keywords-Payment Advice, Payment Reference, Web Service, Maintain Bank Advices,

Title: Tax Authority Error Tax number already exists when adding Tax Number
Content: Symptom-When attempting to add a Tax Number to a Tax Authority, you get the error Tax number already exists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select Tax Authorities.-Search for ID XXX(XXX represents the tax authority ID).-Navigate to Company tax arrangement tab.-Go to the Tax numbers sub tab.-Add row for 5-Tax Number and put ABC(ABC represents the Tax Number ID).-Finally press Enter.-Result: Error Tax number already exists-Cause-You cannot add any Tax Number Type with the same Tax Number as an existing entry. This will lead to this specific error and is expected. For example, you already have the same data for Vat Registration number, hence you cannot add the same for Tax number.-Resolution-This is expected and is the standard system behavior. You cannot use the same data for Tax number and any other Tax Number Type already saved in Company Tax Arrangement.-Keywords-tax authority, tax number exists

Title: Business Partner not Configured for Company
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post an Expense Report fetched from Concur and it fails with error, Business Partner XYZ [represents Business Partner ID] not Configured for Company ABC [represents Company ID].-Payment Type = Company Billed/Credit Card Payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur view.-Go to the Expense Reports subview and search for Expense Report XX[represents Expense Report ID].-Press Post.-Error: Business Partner XYZ not Configured for Company ABC.-Cause-The Clearing Account Code is not maintained as Supplier ID.-You can check this in the Clearing Account Code under Expense Entry in the JSON.-How to Download JSON:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur View.-Go to the Expense Reports subview and search for Expense Report XX.-Click Download JSON button.-Resolution-To handle credit card payments, you can maintain a business partner for the payment type Company Billed/Company Paid (reimbursement offsets not used) in the SAP Concur Expense. Assign an existing business partner from SAP Business ByDesign, to the clearing account code of Company Billed/Company Paid. When you post an expense report with this payment type, an open item is created against the business partner in SAP Business ByDesign. This open item can be viewed from the payables supplier account and can be later cleared.-Path to maintain Supplier ID as Clearing Account Code in Concur:-Login with Administrator User-Administration-Expense-Expense Admin-Payment Types-Select CBCP to maintain Clearing Account Code as Supplier ID.-The Supplier ID should be in the Payables work center and Supplier Accounts of ByDesign.-Keywords-Concur, Business Partner, Company, CBCP

Title: Additional Responsibles in the Shopping Cart Management view
Content: Symptom-User is unable to view the newly assigned persons to the shopping cart-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select Shopping Cart Management view (it is user specific; if this view is not visible, contact your administrator)-Click on the button "Click here to execute the query"-Select the shopping cart record and click Assign To-Select the user and assign the shopping to user1 (user1 is name of the user)-Cause-The Shopping Cart Management view does not display the name of the assigned user.-The user to whom the shopping is assigned is not visible in the Shopping Cart Management view because shopping carts are user specific.-Resolution-The additional user details can be made visible through Personalization mode in the shopping cart. Follow the below steps:-Open the shopping cart X (X refers to shopping cart ID)-Click View All button.-Start the Personalization Mode-Here, make the Additional Responsibles option visible.-Once this is done, the additional responsible person/persons to whom the shopping cart is assigned is visible.-Note: if the shopping cart is not assigned to any user, then the Additional Responsibles hyperlink cannot be made visible from Personalization mode.-Keywords-assigned user in shopping cart, assign shopping cart to different user, assigned user not visible, shopping cart, shopping cart management

Title: Remaining Planned Cost is Shown as Zero in Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure Report
Content: Symptom-You run the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report and the Remaining Planned cost is shown as zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Show All Reports and Find Report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure.-In the Project field, enter ID XXX (Here XXX represents Project ID).-Fill in all the mandatory fields.-Press Apply. -Add the Project task attribute to the rows and press Apply-You notice the Remaining Planned costs field shows zero for project tasks for which costs have already been incurred.-Cause-Only Expenses have been planned for the project task. However, Remaining costs are derived from the Remaining Work field in a project task's Work tab or from the Remaining Quantity field in a project tasks Materials tab. For planned expenses there is no Remaining expenses option from where the Remaining Cost can be derived. -OR-For planned services/materials the Remaining work/quantity field has been manually modified after the project task was released*. As the remaining work/quantity was modified, the Remaining work/quantity is no longer updated automatically, so that the Remaining Cost can no longer be derived in the report, unless updated manually.-Resolution-Remaining Costs for project tasks are only shown for planned services and materials and only if the Remaining work/quantity field was not updated manually after project task release. If it was updated manually after release you need to keep manually updating the Remaining work/quantity field. -Remaining Costs are not derived for project tasks for which only Expenses are planned as here there is no Remaining Expenses field available for the project task.-See Also-2380925 - Remaining Work Not Calculated for Project Task-Keywords-Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure, Remaining Planned Cost.

Title: GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary Report is Showing the Quantity Awaiting Invoice as X for the Canceled Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have canceled a Purchase Order but GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary report is showing the Quantity Awaiting Invoice as X for the same, you are expecting that once PO is canceled the report should not show any Awaiting Invoice Quantity.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order ABC(where ABC is Purchase Order id).-The status of this  Purchase Order is Canceled & all items in the PO are in Canceled status.-Go to the Inventory Valuation  work center.-Go to the Reports & List view.-Open the GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary Report.-Select the Purchasing Document as ABC (where ABC is Purchase Order id) and click Go.-The report displays the Quantity Awaiting Invoice as X.-Cause-GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary report is showing the Quantity Awaiting Invoice as X because Purchase Order ABC is canceled but corresponding Inbound Delivery XYZ (refers to Inbound Delivery id) is not canceled.-Resolution-In order to correct data in report you need to cancel the Inbound Delivery XYZ.-Go to the Inbound Logistics work center.-Select the Inbound Deliveries view.-Search for the inbound delivery ID XYZ, which you want to cancel.-Select the searched inbound delivery and choose Undo Release from Actions drop down.-Now select the view Monitoring and sub-view By Warehouse Order and select Advanced button.-Enter inbound delivery ID in the field Delivery ID and press Go button.-Select the relevant Warehouse order and choose Edit button.-In the Warehouse Order screen, choose Adjustment Confirmation button.-In the adjustment confirmation screen, choose Enable Entry button.-In the Quantity Difference field enter minus of fulfilled quantity e.g. if fulfilled quantity is 4 EA, then enter -4 EA.-Choose Save button.-Go back to Inbound Deliveries view and search for the Inbound Delivery ID.-Select the inbound delivery and choose Cancel from Actions drop down.-Keywords-GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary Report, Quantity Awaiting Invoice

Title: How to Restrict Business Users to Consume License in ByD/C4C System
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--You want to restrict a business user to consume a license type in a ByD/C4C system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-By applying a Business User Lock to an active business user from the Application and User Management work center, you can stop/restrict the business user to consume a license for the production tenant.-In BYD:-To lock a business user, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business User view-Search the respective user and click on Edit Attribute-In the new window, check the User Locked check box-Click on Save and Close-Same is highlighted  in the below screenshot.-In C4C:-To lock a business user, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Administrator work center-Go to Business User view-Search the respective user and click on Edit Attribute-In the new window check the User Locked check box-Click on Save and Close-Same is highlighted in the below screenshot.-Note:-Only active business users from the production system will consume a license type in ByD and will be considered for the Billing Cycle.-Counted User check box is for customer reference to know the overview of license type assignments and the active users in the production system.-Adding User Subscription for a user will reflect these details in the User Subscription view in the Service Control Center work center in which you will be able to see the license types, traffic signals, license type usages and users assigned to a license type.-See Also-Blog: All About Service Control Center in SAP Business ByDesign(ByD)-Blog: All About Service Control Center in Cloud for Customer(C4C)-Keywords-Lock Business User, Restrict User to consume License, stop consuming License.

Title: Selection Screen Missing for User in Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You cannot find selection screen, when you try to access the Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Outbound Logistics.-Select Common tasks.-Click on Stock Overview button.-You will see a screen with no selection Screen and data.-Cause-The Particular user does not have access to the Business Analytics Work center.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select Business User option.-Select the particular User.-Click Edit Access Rights.-In the Work Center and View Assignment tab, Search for Business Analytics work center.-Assign the work center to the user by clicking the Assign Check box.-Keywords-Stock Overview, Reports, Business Analytics, Selection Screen, Access

Title: Missing Custom Work Center in Work Center and View Assignment
Content: Symptom- "Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-You have uploaded your Custom Solution to a Tenant and it is correctly Scoped and Merged with the Active Scope but Work Center Floorplan (WCF) or Work Center View (WCView) is not available in Work Center and View Assignment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have a Custom Business Object.-You have created Custom Screens for your Custom Business Object.-Cause-The WCF or WCView has a Scope Rule bound to a Custom Object in the Scope Rules Editor. During Deployment from a Partner Development Tenant to a Customer Test / Production Tenant, solution changes its Namespace. This configuration is currently not supported and the change of Namespace is not handled by the Scope Rules Editor.-Resolution-This binding must be removed via the UI Designer in a new Patch.-Open UI Designer through the SDK.-Open Custom Screen ABC.WCF.uiwoc (ABC being your Custom WCF).-Open Properties tab.-Open Scope Rules: (Collection).-Remove Binding to Custom Object.-Select Custom View DEF.WCVIEW.uiwocview (DEF being your Custom WCView).-Repeat steps 3 to 5.-Keywords-Invalid Work Center View, Scope Rules, ScopeRulesEditor, Work Center Floorplan, Work Center View, Target Tenant, Source Tenant, Custom Object, UI Designer, SDK, PDI, Invisible, Production, Screen, Scope Rule, Editor

Title: Error 'Amount in cover document XYZ unequal to amount in tax return ABC' Occurs When Releasing Withholding Tax Return
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-"INTERNAL USE ONLY" -Errors as below occur when you release Withholding Tax Return ABC (ABC stands for ID of Withholding Tax Return):-'Amount in cover document XYZ (XYZ stands for Supplier Invoice ID) unequal to amount in tax return ABC.-Release of tax return ABC failed.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Select the Withholding Tax Returns subview.-Select the return ABC with status In Preparation.-Click Release.-You get the following error messages:-Amount in cover document XYZ (XYZ stands for Supplier Invoice ID) unequal to amount in tax return ABC.-Release of tax return ABC failed.-Cause-This seems to be happening as a corner case for only two documents so far, the presumed reason is that you have overridden the rounding value this change coupled with difference distribution is leading to amounts having a wrong sign on tax register.-Development team is aware of it and Jira is created for it. https://sapjira.wdf.sap.corp/browse/BYDCRM-978-Resolution-Please forward incident to component SRD-FIN-TAX for backend correction.-See Also-If the issue is happening for India, please refer first to KBA 2996716 Error - Amount ABC in Cover Document YYYY Unequal to Amount DEF in Tax Return XX, While Releasing Withholding Tax Return for Country India-Keywords-WHT Return, Withholding Tax Return, amount unequal to tax amount

Title: Currency Derivation for Expense Report Payments
Content: Symptom-You want to know how system determines the currency in payment of expense report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-When creating a payment for expense reports manually from the Employee Accounts view:-Go to the Payables work center and here to the Supplier Accounts view.-Select to show All Employees.-Select an employee and press View.-Select an open expense report and select Pay Manually By, for example, Outgoing Bank Transfer.-The currency in the outgoing bank transfer is derived from the currency defined in the expense report.-When creating a payment via Payment Management:-Go to the Payment Management work center/  Liquidity Management work center.-Go to the Common task section and select New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Select the Payee as an employee account and select the open expense report.-The currency in the outgoing bank transfer is derived from the currency that was previously used for manual bank transfer. You can change the currency if required.-When creating a payment automatically via a Payment Run:-Go to the Payables work center and navigate to the Periodic Tasks view. Here, select Payment Run.-Execute the payment run to generate payment proposals.-The currency of the payment proposal is derived from the currency defined in the expense report.-In summary,-In automatically created Outgoing Bank Transfer payments or manually created payments to clear expense reports, initiated from the Payables work center the payment currency to pay an expense report is derived from the currency defined in the Expense Report.-In Outgoing Bank Transfer payments of expense reports created from Payment/ Liquidity Management the payment currency is derived from the previously, manually created Outgoing Bank Transfer.-See Also-KBA 1625369 - How System Determines Default Currency in Expense Report-KBA 2690313 - Display Currency in the report is not as Expected-KBA 3407173 - Payment Currency in the Expense Report is not as Expected-Keywords-Currency in Payment of Expense report, Currency Derivation, 付款货币确定

Title: Error Message E-mail address XYZ could not be mapped to user. Reason: Email address XYZ When Logging in Using Single-Sign-On
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-You are using SSO with Microsoft Azure Active Directory and when trying to log in, you receive error message "E-mail address XYZ could not be mapped to user. Reason: No business partner found for e-mail address XYZ" (where XYZ stands for an actual e-mail address).-"E-mail address XYZ could not be mapped to user. Reason:Email address XYZ"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue- Try to log into the system using SSO.-Error message appears.-Cause-Cause 1:-The e-mail ID being passed needs to be assigned to a user in the system, and not more than one.-This is because when the SAML assertion happens between the IDP and the SAP system, the IDP passes this e-mail ID to the SAP system. In case the same e-mail is used for no user or for multiple users, there is no way to figure out which user is requesting to log on. Hence, SSO will not work as the correct user cannot be determined.-Cause 2:-The address host type code is missing in the identity BO for the respective User. So address node is missing in instance which leads to missing data for any User ,hence email is not found and leads to login issue.-Resolution-Resolution 1:-Ensure that the e-mail being passed is assigned to at least one user and one user only (i.e. users have unique e-mail IDs assigned to them in the system).-You can check the same e-mail address is used by several Users:-Go to backend transaction SESFTS.-Input BUSINESS_PARTNER in the Load BO by Proxy Name field, then press Enter.-Click Load By Query > ROOT - QUERY_BY_COMMU_DATA.-Enter the e-mail address in field EMailURI/content. -Click the Continue button (or press Enter). -Note:-If there are multiple entries for category 1 indicate that the same e-mail ID is used multiple times.-If there are multiple entries by category 2, one person is responsible for more accounts. -Give the list of Users who is consuming the same Email ID and ask customer to perform the changes accordingly.-After they removed the Email ID from the other Business Partners/Users, SSO login should work.-If the error states as No Business Partner Email ID has been maintained, then refer the KBA   2590147-Resolution 2:-Please run this report (RAPID_USER_ADDRESS_CHECK ) with checkbox "Test mode" to fix the address problem. Also refer to the KBA - 2965018 - E-mail Address Does Not Appear in the Business User View-See Also-KBA: 3088743 - Error Message "Email Address XYZ Could Not Be Mapped to User" When Logging In Using Single Sign-On-KBA: 2590147 - Unable to See the E-Mail Address In Business User Overview and Business Partner Data Overview for a Service-KBA: 2965018 - E-mail Address Does Not Appear in the Business User View-Keywords- SSO, Error, Mapped, Azure, Single, Sign, Email address, could not be mapped to user

Title: Serial Number XXX for Product YYY Cannot be Issued
Content: Symptom-The Third party Inter Company Process within Business ByDesign allows the setup of a sales process, where a company can sell products of another company (Partner Company).-This scenario includes both companies sales process, the purchase process between both companies, and the delivery and invoicing for both companies.-The complete process looks as follows:-Company A: Seller-Company B: Vendor-Buyer: Customer and Product Recipient-Company A creates a Sales Order with the Buyer, selecting Company B as the Source of Supply.-This will trigger a Purchase Request from Company A to Company B.-Company A processes the Purchase Request and creates a Third Party Purchase Order.-The Purchase Order will automatically create a Sales Order for company B.-Company B updates and processes the Sales Order with the normal Outbound Delivery process and Customer Invoice.-The Outbound Delivery from Company B will create a Third Party Delivery Notification.-The Customer Invoice from Company B will automatically create a Supplier Invoice for Company A.-Company A releases the Third Party Delivery Notification, creating a Third Party Outbound Delivery.-Finally a Customer Invoice from the Third Party Outbound Delivery is created, completing the Third Party process.-However, you encounter a following error when carrying out the above highlighted business process, that is, when releasing Third Party Delivery Notification, or creating a Third Party Delivery Notification manually based on the Third Party Purchase Order.-"Serial Number XXX for Product YYY Cannot be Issued".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Order Fulfillment work Center.-Navigate to Third-Party Purchase Orders View.-Search for DEF.-Click New Third-party Delivery Notification.-Enter mandatory fields like Delivery Notification ID.-Fulfill the Serial Number as XXX for Product YYY.-Click Release, then the error occurs. -Cause-You have not scoped Entitlement management or its follow-up question in Business Configuration.-Resolution-Please follow the steps below to scope Entitlement management and its follow-up question.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Navigate to Implementation Projects View.-Select the relevant Implementation Project and choose Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the third step Scoping. -Under the element Service.-Select the option Entitlement Management by marking the checkbox against it.-Choose Next.-Under the element Service expand Entitlement Management. -Select the option Registered Products, then scope the question "Do you want the solution to automatically record registered products sold during the outbound delivery process?" in the right.-Choose Next, review and confirm the Implementation Project. -After that, please follow the steps below to maintain owner information for the Serial Number XXX of Product YYY.-Go to Service Entitlements Work Center.-Navigate to Registered Products View.-Search for the Serial Number XXX of Product YYY.-Select and Edit it.-Go to Involved Parties Tab.-Choose Add Row.-Fulfill the owner as Company A.-Choose Save and Close.-Once you have done that, the mentioned error will not appear any more.-See Also-2852086 - Third Party Inter Company Scenario-Keywords-Serial Number; Issued; Third-party Delivery Notification; Entitlement Management.

Title: Working Days Maintained in Fine Tune Activity Working Day Calendar are not Calculated for Employee Times
Content: Symptom-Employee times are not calculated based on working days and non-working days maintained in Fine Tuning Activity Working Day Calendar.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Working Day Calendar.-Select Maintain an existing working day calendar.-Maintain working days in the 4th step Add/Remove Work Days or Non Work Days.-Then you will find the days are still considered as non-working days when editing employee times.-Cause-Working day calendars are used in other areas of the BYD system i.e. Finance, and CRM. Time Labor and Management does not consume the working day /non-working day configuration of the working day calendar. Time Labor and Management logic is written to derive working day / non-working day from the work schedules and public holiday calendars.-Resolution-You can maintain temporary work schedules for the employees. Please follow the below steps:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Temporary Change of Work Schedule under Employee Times.-Select the Employee and Add Temporary Changes.-After making the changes, Day closure for the affected Employee will be required. Please find steps below:-Go to the Time Administration work center.-Open the Regular Tasks view.-Click on the Run Day Closure for One Employee option.-Select the employee in the value help.-Choose the action "Start Time Valuation".-Click on the Run button.-Provide the Time Profile Start Date of the employee selected and click on the Ok button.-Keywords-Time Administration; Working day calendar-holiday,non-working day,overwrite holiday,working day claendar

Title: Supplier Invoice Creation Failed Through File Input Runs
Content: Symptom-File input runs for supplier invoice was successfully executed however no supplier invoice is created from the runs. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the File Input view-You will see Run ID -Navigate to Execution details-Select the Application Log-You can see that the execution is successful-Cause-The file input run was successful because the file is correct and was processed successfully, but the supplier invoice was not created because there was no matching document numbering rule found while creating the supplier invoice. In the xml file, we pass the document date and hence when searching for the numbering rule, document date is getting considered. However in your system, numbering rule for supplier invoice for company, prefix, "Year Suffix Selection Date" is marked as "Posting Date".-Resolution-You can maintain a new numbering rule with the existing rule and for which the value in column "Year Suffix Selection Date" should either be blank or "Document Date" (Please note the default value if blank is considered as Document Date), and later re-upload the xml file and run a new file input run to create the supplier invoice. So when using file input runs to upload the supplier invoices and if there is a document numbering rule for supplier invoice, then the column "Year Suffix Selection Date" should either be blank or "Document Date".-Keywords-Supplier Invoice Creation Failed Through File Input Runs; Invoice not created from file Input Runs;

Title: Functional Area Determination is Incorrect in Journal Entry of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have posted Supplier invoice and functional area in the journal entry of supplier invoice is showing incorrectly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Show All Documents and Find Supplier Invoice PQR(Here PQR represents Supplier Invoice ID).-Select the Supplier Invoice and Choose Edit.-Click View All.-Go to Document Flow and click Journal Entry Icon and it opens corresponding Journal Entry.-Select the line item and you can view the functional area XXX which is determined wrongly (XXX represent Functional Area).-Cause-Functional areas are derived by the system based on general ledger accounts or cost center types. If it is not maintained, then the functional area can be derived from Default Functional area.--You can view the functional area assigned to the cost centre type in the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center and Implementation Projects view.-Select the implementation projects and select Open Activity List.-Open activity Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis.-Select sub activity Edit functional area determination.-Select the related Accounting Principles.-Go to the tab Determination Using Cost Center Types to view the respective functional area and/or Go to the tab Determination Using G/L Accounts to view the respective functional area assigned for the G/L Accounts-Resolution-System behaviour is correct and determining the functional area according to the business configuration settings.-See Also-Edit Functional Area Determination-Keywords-Functional area determination, Incorrect functional area, Journal Entry shows different functional area

Title: Error "Email Address XXX is Not Valid" While Releasing Customer Invoice Document.
Content: Symptom-User cannot release customer invoice document due to below error:-"Email Address XXX is Not Valid"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Customer Invoicing WorkCenter.-Open Invoice Documents.-Select Invoice ID which needs to be released.-Choose Release.-Error: Email Address XXX is Not Valid.-Cause-Receiver Email ID maintained is not valid.-Resolution-Change/add/remove receiver email ID by following below steps:-Go to Customer invoice Work Center.-View: Invoice Documents.-Open Document ID and Click Edit.-Click on View All.-Click on "You Can Also" button and choose "Edit Output Settings"-Now user can change/add/remove receiver email ID.-Keywords-Invalid email ID; edit receiver email ID, email address not valid, unable to release invoice

Title: Dump After Closing Browser Tab
Content: Symptom-You are working on the system using multiple browser tabs, and receive a dump when performing any action after closing any tab containing an instance of Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into the tenant.-Open a new browser tab and enter the same tenant (alternatively, duplicate the browser tab).-Close the tab opened in step 2.-Perform any operation in the browser tab from step 1, such as entering a work center.-Here the dump is raised.-Cause-All Business ByDesign tabs for a given tenant share the same session. Once a tab is closed, the session from the other tab is terminated, causing the dump in any other tabs that were already opened.-This is a current limitation.-Resolution-The systems works as expected.-We suggest the use of the built-in tabs in case multiple pages need to remain open.-Keywords-IAM, Chrome, Edge, Security, Token

Title: BYD2308 Event Notifications not triggering for EmployeeSubstitutions
Content: Symptom-Event Notifications are not triggered for EmployeeSubstitutions BO for any employee substitution.-     Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Select Event Notification Monitoring view-Identity BO Event Notification line item exist-But missing Event Notification for EmployeeSubstitution BO for change of Employee Substitution- Cause-In Application and User Management workcenter, Substitutions view-Employee A is Substituted by Employee B-This substitution shows under Event Notification Monitoring view for Identity BO-When the substitution happens the identity gets updated.-So, you will always get a event notification for identity and in the payload you can see this BO to be updated. This Identity BO is the target BO of the Employee Substitution.-When identity is directly created, if you have an event notification for identity creation you will get a notification with payload creation, if update is checked, in payload it will show updated.-Resolution-If basic settings are changed, then in created event payload, you can see that identity basic settings are changed, but when attribute is changed, you will see that the identity root is updated, same as identity directly being updated. Employee substitution BO does the same as identity's attribute update and not EmployeeSubstituion BO. -Hence, only Identity BO is getting triggered.

Title: Japan Consumption Tax (VAT), Tax Code for Non-Registered Supplier of the New Invoice Method
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Legal tax code missing for Japan effective from October 1st 2023. As new invoice system has been implemented in Japan, customers have some issue with supplier who does not have tax number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Please refer to the below scenario: -Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select New Invoice without Purchase order-Fill the invoice with below details.-If the supplier invoice is JPY10,00 tax 10% 1,000-The supplier who has tax number-10% consumption tax is 100% claimable-Dr input tax 1,000-Dr expense 10,000-Cr Suppliers domestic payable 11,000-The supplier who does not have tax number-only 8% is claimable (80% of total consumption tax), the rest should be expense-Dr input tax 800-Dr non claimable tax 200-Dr expense 10,000-Sr. suppliers domestic payable. Advise how to treat this non claimable tax in supplier invoice entry. -Cause-The functionality is already covered in Bydesign and was delivered with following JIRA - https://jira.tools.sap/browse/GSREQAPJ-2734.-Resolution-Automatic tax code determination was never delivered for the same, only the tax codes were delivered to be used manually whenever required. Unfortunately, the customers would not able have to have the same automatically determined as external tax code determination also does not support the tax registration check.-   Keywords-https://jira.tools.sap/browse/GSREQAPJ-2734; Qualified Invoice method (TEKIKAKU SEIKYUHO) will be introduced from October 1, 2023; partial percentage of paid tax amount can be deductible during Oct. 1, 2023 to Sep. 30, 2029

Title: Unexpected Exchange Rate Determination for Customer Invoice in Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-While checking the expecting exchange rate in the journal entry, it is not validated with respect to the Invoice Date but validated with respect to Posting Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this case the exchange rate is expected to be determined with respect to Invoice Date maintained in document:-Navigate to the General Ledger Work Center.-Select the Journal Entries Sub View.-Search for the Journal Entry and open it.-Go to the Journal Entry tab.-Here the exchange rate is determined with respect to Posting date.-Cause-The Exchange Rate depends on the Conversion Type, Conversion Date (for example, '2 - Posting Date') and Exchange Rate Type maintained in Business Configuration.-Resolution-If the exchange rate needs to be determined based on Invoice Date rather than Posting Date. Please make the below changes:-Navigate to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Select to the Overview View.-Search and open the activity Currency Conversion Profiles.-Choose the desired Currency Conversion Profile and Business Transaction type as Customer Invoice.-Change the Conversion Date to '1 - Document Date' and save it.-See Also-KBA 2223407- Tax Exchange Rate and Exchange Rate are Different on Journal Entry for Same Customer Invoice -KBA 2349917 - Exchange Rate Type Determination for SRM and CRM Documents-Keywords-Exchange Rate; Conversion Date; Invoice Date; Posting Date; Customer Invoice; Document Date; Currency Conversion Profiles; Journal Entry

Title: Max Inventory Age (In Days) shows 7300 Days in Report Inventory Ageing
Content: Symptom-You find that report <Inventory Ageing> shows the Max Inventory Age (In Days) of some products as 7300 days.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Navigate to Design Reports View.-Search for Report <Inventory Ageing>.-Open it.-Run the report, then you find the mentioned issue.-Cause-In generally, report <Confirmation Journal> records all the relevant movement information (like warehouse confirmation for inbound or outbound,  GAC for goods movements....)for a product. If no records can be found for a product in this report, it means that system doesn't know when and how the products were receipt. Therefore, system is by default taking 20 yrs as the age of the stock (365 days * 20 yrs = 7300 days).-Resolution-System is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Max Inventory Age, 7300 days,  SCMINVAGV04_Q0001.

Title: Not Able To View Purchase Order (PO) In Inbound Logistics Work Center
Content: Symptom-Unable to view ordered Purchase Orders in the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order: ABC. (ABC represents the Purchase Order ID)-The Purchase Order is not visible.-Cause-Purchase Order created with Item Type as Material and Process Type as Non-Stock, only Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) processing is supported and the Purchase Order will not be visible in the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Purchase Order created with Item Type as Service and the Process Type as Direct, the Purchase Order will not be visible in the Inbound Logistics Work Center.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Purchase Order; Not Visible; Inbound Logistics; Non-Stock; GSR; Item Type; Material; Service; Non-Stock; Direct; SAP Business Bydesign

Title: Sales Order Cannot Be Released If It Has a Blank Line Item
Content: Symptom-A Sales Order containing a blank line item can be saved successfully, but the Release Order button remains greyed out.-The error message "Item XX: Product for item is missing" is displayed, and the Sales Order cannot be released (XX represents the line item). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Create a new Sales Order.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Add a row without maintaining a product in the line item.-Click Save.-The Sales Order is saved successfully with status In Preparation.-The Release Order button is greyed out.-The error message "Item XX: Product for item is missing" is displayed.-Cause-The Sales Order cannot be released when a line item has been added without maintaining the required product information. -Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-A Sales Order can be saved without any line items. However, a Sales Order can be released only when at least one line item with product information is maintained.-Add a line item and maintain the required product information, then save and release the Sales Order.-Keywords-Sales Order; Release Order; Release Order button; greyed out; blank line item; missing product; Product for item is missing; Sales Order release; line item; product information; In Preparation

Title: Cannot Edit quantity when creating new project invoice request.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Cannot Edit quantity when creating new project invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Select the relevant project under "All Projects" view-Now select New-> Project Invoice Request->Automatic Project Invoice Request- When you try to create an automatic project invoice request for the project-Among the lines to be invoiced, the field "quantity" for the line "quantity = 1 day" is greyed out -Resolution-Sales order items of type "Service - fixed price (project)" with quantity 1 are handled as a lump sum. In this case the quantity is irrelevant. Only the amount (net value) is relevant.-  Keywords-Service - fixed price

Title: Customer Part Number Field Is Not Available In The Sales Order Items Tab
Content: Symptom-You have added Customer part number field in product master data but it is not visible in the sales order items tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-View: Sales Orders.-Show: All orders.-Search and edit ABC (ABC represents Sales Order ID).-Navigate to Items tab.-Cause-This is system standard behavior, as the Customer Part Number field is not available as a standard field.-Resolution-You have to create Extension field for Customer Part Number field in sales order items tab.-Choose the Calculation rule: Product ID (ProductBuyerID - ItemProduct)-Please refer to help documents which brief creation and adding extension fields.-See Also-Extension Fields Quick guide: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/b532137d13184adfbd4d08b4210628d2.html?q=create%20extension%20field-Create Extension field: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2d8c90ce722d1014acc581aad621df2e.html?q=create%20extension%20field-Relevant KBA: 3345375 - Customer Part Number Not Showing In Documents-1733731 - The Customer Part Number is not Displayed in the Product Description of the Form-3220672 - Customer Part Number is not mapped on the XML that is sent to the Outbound Delivery Form-Keywords-Customer Part Number, Sales Order, Account, Items, Product, Extension Field

Title: Account financial data standard report does not show tax data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***SAP INTERNAL USE***-Tax data does not appear in Account Financial Data standard report.-For example, a VAT ID may be maintained in an Account master data, however it is not displayed in the Account Financial Data report. --Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check and maintain the tax data in the Account master data:-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Select the required account.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Financial Data tab.-Enter the Tax Data sub-tab.-Here you have maintained the tax information. For example, a VAT Registration Number.-To check the report:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Enter the Design Reports view.-Search for the report "Account Financial Data", ID BPCSFINB_Q0001.-Click on the name of the report to open it.-Choose selection: Initial.-Choose  View: Account Tax Data.-In the Company field, enter the required Company.-In the Account field, enter the Account.-Click on Apply to run the report.-Here you can see the fields for Find Tax Number type and Tax number have the value "Not Assigned".-Cause-The Analytics Report is using secondary persistence to display the value, and the tax number related data for the account is not available in this persistence layer.-Resolution-A FSI Reload might be required to solve the issue.-You can check the steps provided in the following KBAs to proceed with the FSI reload:-1650568 - How to find out the FSI View which Fetches Data on the Screen-2569067 - How to Perform a FSI Reload for e.g. Organisational Assignment  -Keywords-BPCSFINB_Q0001, missing, not available

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error when using Migration tool to migrate Project into the system- Party not a functional unit, cost center, or reporting line unit- - Party missing- - Party role category missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration - Overview view- Filter and open activity: Migration of Projects- Click on Migrate projects using the migration tool- On the new screen, execute the migration.- Error messages - Party not a functional unit, cost center, or reporting line unit, Party missing,  - Party role category missing-Cause-You can check the mentioned migration file. Title: Error Message - MV_VALVIEW_ID while posting the supplier invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error Message Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Invalid value in field -- MV_VALVIEW_ID while posting the supplier invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Supplier Invoicing workcenter-2. Invoices and Credit Memos view-3. Select the supplier invoice - PQR-4. In the exception tab, you see the Error Message-Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting; Invalid value in field - MV_VALVIEW_ID-  Cause-The issue is occurring because the project in the coding block is creating a settlement posting to AUC  for company. This asset has originally been capitalized with two sets of books, each with multiple valuation views. However, after this, several further valuation views have been added to the accounting principle and thus also added to the sets of books with status partially active-Resolution-These valuation views will never become active now due to already capitalized assets on the system The Credit Memo will never post because of the partially active valuation views. We would advise that these valuation views be removed from the accounting principle as they will only ever be partially active and so won't be used in the assets anyway. Valuation views should only be added when there are no capitalized or retired fixed assets (i.e. no fixed asset postings) in the system.-Keywords-Supplier Invoice

Title: Error Message: No efforts are available in the throttling period, or the efforts are locked in another session.

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to create a project invoice request and notice that already recorded and approved time recordings are missing.- Error message - No efforts are available in the throttling period, or the efforts are locked in another session.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Project Management.-Go to the view Projects -There are many not yet invoiced.-If you navigate to project order request in order to invoice the project, there is an error message:No efforts are available in the throttling period, or the efforts are locked in another session.-Cause-TREX data for expense document items must have been incomplete and a reloaded them have to done then then expenses can be processed.-Resolution-Backend reload of TREX data has to be done.-Keywords-project invoice request
