Title: The Title Field of Private Account is Not Displayed in the Involved Parties of Sales Document
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a service order for private account, but title is not displayed in Name section of involved parties.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this KBA we are taking example of a service order but the behavior is same for sales order as well.-Go to Service Orders work center.-View: Service order processing.-Create new service order for private account ABC (ABC is the Account ID).-Navigate to Involved parties tab.-Title (Mr. or Ms.) is not displayed for private account ABC in Name section.-Cause-In the involved parties of sales document, only first name and last name is displayed for private account and title is not displayed.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-See Also-KBA 0003390613- The Name Section of Sales Document Only Displays Title of Private Account.-Keywords-Title; Name; Service Order; Sales Order; Sales Document; Account; Address

Title: The Updated Main Address in Account is Not Displayed in Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You changed the Main Address in Account Master Data and expect the New Address to be displayed in Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-View: Invoice Requests.-Show: All Requests.-Search and Preview Invoice Request ABC (ABC represents the Invoice Request ID).-The address displayed in the Account is not the new address updated in Account master data.-Cause-The reason why system has not updated the address in invoice is because it fetches the main address of account which was used during creation of document and it cannot be changed or updated afterwards.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-See Also-KBA 2276585 - While Creating A Customer Invoice Or Project Invoice Request You Want To Update The Bill To Address.-Keywords-Main Address; Account; Customer Invoice; Sales Order; Updated

Title: Supplier Invoices not Created From Recurring Invoice Template
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have created and scheduled a recurring invoice however system did not create any supplier invoice from the recurring template. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Recurring Invoices view  -Select the relevant Recurring Invoice ID -Navigate to Invoice History tab-No invoices created-Cause-In the recurring invoice template, for one of the items, you have selected the checkbox "Distribute Additional Costs" in the Cost Distribution Tab. System tries to update the business transaction within a transaction session and creates 500 internal server error in the backend system. Currently the "Distribute Additional Costs" scenario is not handled for Recurring Invoice. When you create a manual invoice with this scenario, it will work as expected.-Resolution-You can uncheck the checkbox "Distribute Additional Costs" in the Recurring Invoice template for a particular item. This will result in recurring invoice getting created automatically.-Keywords-Supplier Invoices not Created From Recurring Invoice; Recurring invoice not created automatically

Title: Incorrect Party Role determination of Service Performer and Supplier while creating a Service Order document
Content: Symptom-Supplier and Service Performer are not automatically fetched by the system when creating Service Orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders work center-Select Service Order Processing view-Search for service order ABC (Where ABC represents the Service Order ID)-Click in Edit and View All-Under General tab, notice that the party role Supplier and Service Performer have not been automatically determined.-Cause-The settings for the Supplier under Business Partner Data work center and/or the determination method for the Service Performer in the Fine Tuning activity Involved Parties for Service Orders are not correctly maintained.-Resolution-In this scenario it is important to highlight that the Service Performer is a Service Agent.-First of all, make sure that a Supplier is assigned to the relevant Service Agent.-You can see which Supplier each Service Agent works for and see the relationship the Service Agent has with the Supplier and other Business Partners by following the below steps:-  Go to Business Partner Data work center-Select Business Partners view-Search for Service Performer ID EFG (Where EFG represents the Service Performer ID)-Open the business partner EFG-You can see in the Business Partner Roles that the role is Service Agent-Click on the Service Agent hyperlink-This opens Service Agent Overview: EFG-Click on View All-Check if the Supplier is maintained.-  In case the Supplier is maintained for Service Agent EFG, we need to check the determination method for the Service Performer in the Fine Tuning activity Involved Parties for Service Orders.-  Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select your implementation project.-Click on Open Activity List-Navigate to the Fine Tuning tab-Select All Activities-Open the activity Involved Parties for Service Orders-Select the Party Role Service Performer-Click on the Maintain Determination button.-  Here you see that there are 4 methods for the determination of the Service Performer:-  Step 10->Direct responsible of Account-Step 15-> Event-Step 20-> Responsibility  "Service Performer for Service Orders" from serv loc-Step 40-> Responsibility  "Service Performer for Service Orders"-The system will go through all steps until it is successful.-  Once you maintains a determination rule, the system will be able to automatically determine both Party Roles while creating a Service Document.-   See Also-Party Role Determination in a Service Document-Keywords-Incorrect, assigned, missing, service order, not available.

Title: Dump when you create a new Sales Target Plan or upload the plan data via excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You receive a system dump / exception when trying to open a newly created Sales Target Plan or when try to save the plan data via excel.- Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Managing My Area.-Go to view Sales Planning.-Create a new sales target plan and select all the data-When you go to Finish step, you get Dump-or-Go to work center Managing My Area.-Go to view Sales Planning.-Select the Plan XYZ and click on Edit -> Plan Data in Excel. (XYZ represents the Plan Name)-Enter the data in excel and try to Save.-Backend Dump details:-Category ABAP server resource shortage-Runtime Errors TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED--Application information from ST22: /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/man/Planning/salestargetplangafpeco.GAF.ui component-Cause-If a data set is very large, such volume of data is not supported.-If, for example, you have a large Sales Unit with a thousand Accounts, then each Account has a large number of employees, and then you also include a high number of products, all of those numbers are multiplied with each other, resulting in the amount of cells which need to be entered in Excel for the plan values.-Number of accounts x number of employees x number of products = sum of cells in Excel to enter plan values.-However, we cannot provide an exact fixed amount of data/ data limit.-Resolution-Please try to build target plans in smaller chunks . You can break them down to further granular sales units which will have a smaller subset of accounts/employees.- Keywords-Sales target plan, Dump, managing my area; TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED  ;/SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/man/Planning/salestargetplangafpeco.GAF.ui component ;

Title: G/L Account does not appear on Financial Statements report
Content: Symptom-You have created a new G/L Account, you have added this G/L account to the Financial Reporting Structure and you now expect this G/L account to appear in the Financial Statements report. However the G/L account does not appear as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select the view Reports.-Search and find Report ID: FINGLAU04_Q0001 (Financial Statements).-Enter the selection criteria for the Company, Set of Books that you require the data for.-G/L account that you have created does not appear on the report.-Cause-The G/L Account does not appear on the report because there are no postings for this account.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, ensure that there are postings for the G/L Account. If there are no postings, the account details will not appear in the report.-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, Financial Statements Report, GL Account, No Values, Report ID: FINGLAU04_Q0001, LONG_DIGITS,

Title: Unable to Create a new Financial Structure using an XML import
Content: Symptom-You try to upload a new Financial Structure using an XML import, when you select Save you receive errors like:-Value XYZ in setting Item must also be entered in setting Item-Node 1234 incorrectly assigned in fin. rep. structure ABC (1234 represents a Node ID)-Node 3456 incorrectly assigned in fin. rep. structure ABC (3456 represents a Node ID)-Fin. rep. structure ABC is inconsistent; correct it with export/re-import (ABC represents the financial reporting structure code)-Save failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the view overview.-Search and find the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Edit Financial Reporting Structure.-Select Import from Microsoft Excel.-Import the XML file.-Select Save.-Observe the error messages.-Cause-One of the issues may be due to the hierarchy maintained in the XML file. -Resolution-You need to review the values that you have in the XML file.-The hierarchy maintained needs to be in number order. Review the data in the XML file and make sure all the values are in number order.-Review the column "Level" and make sure that the numbers are in number order.-Once you have made changes upload the file again.-Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign, XML import, financial structure, error, hierarchy, node assignment.

Title: Error: Some Items Already Belong to the Customer/Supplier Specified
Content: Symptom-You have cancelled a Supplier Invoice and now trying to Repost it to the same Supplier but receive an error stating:-'Some items already belong to the Customer/Supplier specified'.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables work center.-Go to the Supplier Accounts View.-Search open the Account ID: XXX (XXX Represents Supplier Account ID).-Open Invoice: YYY (YYY represents Supplier Invoice ID).-Click on Actions and then Repost Open Items.-In the new dialog box, you enter the same Supplier Account ID XXX.-Error: 'Some items already belong to the Customer/Supplier specified'.-Cause-You cannot repost the open items to the same supplier.-Resolution-The open items are always reposted to a different customer account or supplier account.-Remark: the same solution applies for Receivables as well.-See Also-SAP Help Portal: Quick Guide for Payment Clearing (Payables)-Keywords-Repost, Some items, Customer/Supplier

Title: Frequently Asked Questions on Period Closure
Content: Symptom-This Knowledge Base Article has some frequently asked queries about Period Closure-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-1. Default Period Closure 'SAP_COMMON' set by SAP is not allowed to edit further for any changes like "Relative Date' to be changed to 'Current Date'; Edit 'Fixed Date' to any future date; Edit 'Correction Start' Date-Day Closure Run ‘SAP_COMMON’ is pre-delivered by SAP and is responsible for maintaining consistency in time data of employees. It is protected due to this reason and hence there are very limited scope of changes which can be done on this. It shall only be allowed to de-activate this instance which is highly unrecommended as it shall cause time data inconsistency.-Also, new day closure runs can be created in the system based on your needs and applied to sets of employees like below:-Employees can be included and excluded based on requirement.-It can be set for either ‘Fixed Date’ or ‘Relative Date’. At a time, both are not allowed.-Also, ‘Fixed Date’ can be considered as a one time while relative date as repeated.-When above attributes are set, and instance has been activated, It can be scheduled to run by the button Schedule.-2. 'Schedule' option has options like 'Start Immediately', 'Run After Job', 'Single Run' and 'Recurrence' whereas these options do not take effect when changed to to a particular date or period. It's the same with options 'Schedule' and 'Schedule Directly' at the header level.-When ‘Schedule’ is clicked we have 4 options as below:-Start Immediately: This will set a job in the system and which shall run based on either ‘Fixed Date’ or ‘Relative Date’.  Run shall be scheduled for specified date in the system for Fixed Date while for Relative Date, Run shall start immediately.-Run After Job: This provided user the flexibility to run your run after some runs already scheduled either on provided ‘Fixed Date’. If its relative date is set, system shall schedule run your run immediately after your selected job is executed.-Single Run: Here you can specify a date and time for the single run to be scheduled for both ‘Fixed Date’ or ‘Relative Date’ on specified date and time.-Recurrence: Here you can schedule a run recurrence as per your requirement -3. What happens because of this run?-This run be in ‘Fixed Date’ or ‘Relative Date’, validates all time data of employee from previous day as per the new settings (Time Account Rule, Time Model Changes, Time Account Bookable Period Changes), if everything is fine updated Period Closure Date to latest date but if any inconsistency is found, it errors out and Period Closure is not updated.-4. What not to expect from this run?-When any changed are done in settings as mentioned above in Time Accounts/Time models, this job would not apply new setting automatically. You need to run explicitly ‘Run Day closure for on Employee’ for all employees affected.-Example, if a Time Account TA1 assigned to 5 employees is changed, because of these change in the settings of this Time Account TA1, all of these 5 employees are affected (time data has become inconsistent and need a Day Closure Run). Under application log of run ‘SAP_COMMON’ you can find that these 5 employees has errors and Period Closure Date are not updated for them automatically.-5. What does ‘Run Day Closure for an Employee’ does to the Time Data?-When Day closure run is done, it checks for all configuration changes done which potentially can be applied to this employee and makes all the Time Data consistent. There are two steps of doing this:-Go to ‘Time Administration’ WoC -> Regular Tasks-Click ‘Run Day Closure for an Employee’-> Select Employee-Choose action ‘Period Closure date to either today or tomorrow or any date in future. The main intention of this date is when Time Data will be validated by the system, it will be validated till this date (period Closure Date). Click on ‘Save’-Now, choose the other action Run ‘Time Valuation’, Click ‘Run’ and  provide Time Profile Start Date of Employee , then ‘Save’-‘Time Profile Start Date’ is the date from which all Time Data of employees will be re-evaluated (checked for consistency and apply new settings).-Note : Time Data checks for consistency and apply new changes: Time Profile Start Date  to Period Closure Date-6. What is the logic behind 'Previous Day' set default by SAP in Period Closure Run.-In a Day closure Run we can either specify the run for a 'Fixed Date' or 'Relative Date', 'Relative Date can either be 'Previous Day ' or 'Current Day'. This basically means that as a result of this day closure run, the Period Closure Date for employee shall be set to either Previous Day/Date or Current/Today's Date.-Example: If the Run is set to 'Previous Day' and if the job runs today, Period Closure Dates for all employees will be set to Yesterday's date Provided there are no errors due to backdated configuration changes. In case there are errors for some employees, logs can be checked for details and Period Closure Date for employee shall not be updated by the run.-7. Why every hired employee has Previous Day as Day Closure Run. (Even before hiring an employee, what time is evaluated for the previous day).-When an employee is hired, it is expected to run manual day closure for him/her. By doing this Period Closure date is updated and is further taken up by the SAP provided Day Closure Run which runs on a daily basis to ensure Period Closure date is updated regularly(Previous Day = Today's Date - 1 ) and all time data is evaluated so that manual run or update or period closure date is not required.-Manual Day Closure Run is only required for this employee if there is any backdated configuration changes in either Time Accounts/Time Account Rules/Time Types/Time Model assignments which affects employees.-8. Is it possible to revert a Period Closure date to a prior date?-Currently it is not possible to revert the Period Closure date to a date before the one currently set.-  See Also-Keywords-Day Closure Run, Period Closure, Schedule Options

Title: Your Are Not Able to Create Down Payment Request via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are going to create a down payment request via web service, but failed and got error in the log:-"Error in runtime cardinality for BO APCI_CUST_INV_REQUEST, Node ITEM"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-You can find the web service error by following steps:-Go to the Application and User Management - Web Service Message Monitoring view.-You can a lot of errors from ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn. -Select one, you can see the error: Error in runtime cardinality for BO APCI_CUST_INV_REQUEST, Node ITEM.-Cause-In the request payload, you have maintained the value of tag <BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentID> as 123, However, there is already an invoice request existed in the system with the same ID. -(123 represents the ID of the value of BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentID)-Resolution-You need to ensure the <BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentID> value is unique. -Keywords-down payment; downpayment; ManageDownPaymentCustomerInvoiceRequestIn; "Error in runtime cardinality for BO APCI_CUST_INV_REQUEST, Node ITEM".

Title: Task Regarding Supplier Invoice's Exception Is Not Created
Content: Symptom-Task regarding Exception is not created even though the activity 'Supplier Invoice Exceptions' is correctly maintained in Business Configuration. -Example of task: "Clarify Invoice Exception: Price Variance for Supplier Invoice ID ABC" (ABC is the Supplier Invoice's ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Go to Business Task Management view.-Search for ABC. -There is no task regarding regarding exceptions for this invoice. -Cause-This exception was not forwarded, hence the Task was not created. -Resolution-The steps to forward the invoice's Exception are:-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for ABC. -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Exceptions tab.-Select the exception regarding Price Variance. -Click in 'Save Document and Forward for Clarification' button. -See Also-Help Document: Exception Handling-KBA: 2954116 - Buyer Responsible did not Receive the E-Mail Notification Forwarded by Supplier Invoice Accountant for Exception Type Price Variance for Supplier Invoice ID-Keywords-Supplier invoice, Exception, Price Variance, Forward

Title: "Web service processing error; more details in the web service error log on provider side" when adding a sales org to a service
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY***-  Via API respectively migration, customer cannot add a sales org (or any configuration) for a service. An Error for BO PDM_SERVICE_PRODUCT, Node VALUATION_QUANTITY_UNIT appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-API call / ServiceProductBundleMaintainRequest ends with the following error: "Web service processing error; more details in the web service error log on provider side".--Cause-This is a known issue, usually it occurs when trying to enhance service products via migration tool.-Resolution-This inconsistency can be resolved in the backend via se38 transaction and the report Z_CORR_INCONSISTANT_VAL_QTY in backend.-This report is not yet available in each system, but development is planning a Jira story to make it available in future releases-Send the case to development, check with them the situation and enhance this KBA if needed.-Keywords-web service, webservice, unable, not able, not possible

Title: How Renewed Automatically Checkbox Works in the Contract
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how Renewed Automatically checkbox in the Contract works.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Sales Order -> Contracts-Search for the Contract ABC (ABC is the Contract I'D)-Navigate to the Items tab-Check for the Renewed Automatically checkbox-Resolution-The Renewed Automatically checkbox indicates whether the line item is renewed automatically within the contract or it is manually created.-If the Renewed Automatically checkbox is ticked for a line item then that line item is renewed automatically within the contract as per the Renewal Rule.-Keywords-Renewed Automatically, Contract, Contract Renewal, Line Item-renewed automatically,contract,contract renewal,line item

Title: Deactivate notifications for a single activity in SAP Business ByDesign Mobile
Content: Symptom-In the Mobile App, you want to remove notifications for a single activity, like e.g. Time Recording. But you want to continue receiving other notifications.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-The Mobile App only allows to switch push notifications 'On' or 'Off ' for the whole app, which can be done in the Push Notification settings of the device. However, the app won't allow you to switch off notification for a single module.-Resolution-As soon as the App has been associated with SAP Business ByDesign and registered for Push notifications, you will get notifications on a regular base. This might even happen for modules that aren't scoped.-See Also-  Keywords-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App, push notifications, mobile alerts

Title: System Defaults Delivery Date in Shopping Cart to 7 Days From the Creation Date
Content: Symptom-When you create a shopping cart, system defaults the delivery date with 7 days however you want to change the delivery date to 10 days. Is there a configuration to adjust the delivery date? -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self Services & Self Services Overview-Select Shopping & click on Go Shopping (Advanced)-In the Edit shopping cart stage, system default the delivery date to 7 days-Cause-The default calculation of delivery date is 7 days from the creation date and you can always change the delivery date manually.-Resolution-Since the default calculation of delivery date in shopping cart is 7 days from the creation date, it is not possible to configure the delivery date to 10 days. You can always change the delivery date manually in shopping cart. -Note:-If you are a partner: you can develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partner finder .-If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-See Also-1665380 - Cannot Change the Default Delivery Date of Seven Days in Purchase Order (https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1665380)-2926638 - Default delivery date in Purchase order or manual Purchase request (https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2926638)-Keywords-Defaults Delivery Date in Shopping Cart to 7 Days; Delivery date in shopping carts

Title: You are Unable to Edit or Reverse an Incoming External Payment in Status In Transfer
Content: Symptom-You want to Edit, Cancel or Reverse an In Transfer Incoming External Payment and you notice that the Edit and Reverse buttons are greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments and search for the Incoming External Payment ID: XXX (XXX stands for the payment ID).-The payment is in status In transfer. The Edit, Reverse and Create Remittance Advice buttons are greyed out. It is not possible to cancel the payment.-Cause-An External Payment is a document created in an External System (outside of ByDesign) and replicated in ByDesign system.-For such documents, it is not possible that you can perform the actions like Cancel, Create Remittance Advice.-Only for the documents that have been created from the ByDesign system, these actions are allowed.-Resolution-This is the normal system behaviour. To cancel this payment, you need to contact the External Service Provider.-See Also-Help Center Document: Customer Payments by External Payments.-Keywords-In Transfer External Payment, Edit or Cancel Incoming External Payment, reverse

Title: Price In Field is Missing in Service Quotes
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find the Price in in Service Quotes, but the same is available in Service Orders. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders - Service Quotes-Select and edit the Service Quote ABC (ABC represents the Service Quote ID)-Under Personalize mode, the Price In field is not available. -Cause-In Service Order document the field is dynamic and the label is based on the "Price In" radio box. But currently the Service Quote screen is static and therefore there is no option for "Price In".-Resolution-Currently this is a system behavior.-An alternative option may be to check the SAP Customer Influence Platform to submit an idea.  -Keywords-no gross pricing in service quotes; find Price in field in service quote;

Title: Error: Gross Amount Balance Not Equal To Zero When Entering Manual Tax Entries
Content: Symptom-You are trying to maintain manual tax entries, and you face an error: gross amount balance not equal to zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Manual Tax Entries view.-Click 'New - Tax Entry'.-Enter required information such as company and G/L account, and tax code: AAA.-An error occurs: Gross amount balance not equal to zero.-Cause-The tax rate is maintained at 0 for tax code: AAA.-You may check it in the following way:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and select the activity tax on goods and services.-Click on the define tax rate schedules link.-You can see the tax rate is 0 for tax code: AAA.-Resolution-You need to maintain a correct tax rate for tax code: AAA.-See Also-2805697 - How to Maintain New Tax Rate Schedules-Keywords-gross amount balance not equal to zero, tax code, tax rate

Title: Sender Address Place Holder lbl_A1SFC_SenderAddress Missing in the Standard SAP Changed and Cancelled Purchase Order Forms
Content: Symptom-In the Changed purchase order and cancelled purchase order form, the text block lbl_A1SFC_SenderAddress is set to hidden (Exclude from layout) in the adobe Lifecycle designer. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Form Template Selection view-Select Changed Purchase Order and Cancelled Purchase Order form-Select Download and extract the files-Open Adobe Lifecycle Designer tool -Open the XDP file -You can see that text block lbl_A1SFC_SenderAddress is set to hidden (Exclude from layout) -Cause-The initial design is like that sender address place holder is visible only for create Purchase order form as it is required information at time of creation. Changed & Cancellation purchase order does not have this placeholder visible.- Resolution-It is the current system design. You can raise an idea in the influence portal requesting this functionality - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-Keywords-text block lbl_A1SFC_SenderAddress is set to hidden (Exclude from layout); lbl_A1SFC_SenderAddress is set to hidden

Title: Italy Supplier Invoice is Picking Present Date as Posting Date
Content: Symptom-Posting date is automatically picking up as present date, when a Supplier Invoice related to Italy is Posted. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to New Invoice without Purchase Order view.-Create a new Supplier Invoice by mentioning the Posting Date as DD.MM.YYYY .-Click on Post, the system considers the present date as Posting Date instead of manually entered date DD.MM.YYYY .-Cause-In Business Configuration work center, the question "Automatic proposal of Posting Date based on system date" is scoped for Italy. -Resolution-To resolve the issue:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects.-Open View Active Scope.-Expand Purchasing, Supplier Invoicing and select Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos.-Under the group "Group: Enabling automatic proposal of posting date in Italy (1)" search for the question "Do you want to enable automatic proposal of posting date based on system date?" and descope / uncheck the check box.-Keywords-Automatic proposal of Posting Date for Supplier Invoice, Italy Supplier Invoices, Automatic Posting date is picked by the system, Wrong posting date in Supplier Invoice for Italy

Title: Cannot Reassign Approver Of The Expense Report Because The User Is Not Available On The List
Content: Symptom-You try to reassign the approver of the task 'review expense report', but this user is not on the list to select.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Select the task 'review expense report'.-Click on assign item.-On the list, you do not see the user to whom you want to reassign the Task.-Cause-This user does not have unrestricted access to work center view: PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES.-This unrestricted access needs to be configured.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Users Views.-Search for the user and click on edit > access right.-Search for work center view PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES and assign it to the user.-On the access restriction tab, search for work center view PRO_EXPENSESANDPURCHASES and select unrestricted for read access and write access.-See Also-2838042 - Cannot forward a Task 'Approve Expense Report' because the user is not available on the list-Keywords-reassign the approver, review expense report, not available on the list

Title: The Indicator Relevant For Forecast being Activated Automatically by the System in Opportunities
Content: Symptom-You deselected the Relevant For Forecast Indicator in an Opportunity but noticed that the next day, the Indicator is active again. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center. -Select the Opportunity List view. -Open Opportunity XYZ (XYZ represents the Opportunity ID).-Navigate to the General tab.-Deactivate the Relevant For Forecast Indicator. -Save your changes. -The next day open the Opportunity XYZ again.-Navigate to the General tab.-The Relevant For Forecast Indicator is active again. -Navigate to the Changes tab.-You can see that the Indicator Relevant for Forecast was changed from Yes to No by your user the previous day.-It was then changed back from No to Yes during the night by the Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM).-Cause-You have activated the scoping element Opportunity relevant for forecast in your solution scope.-  You can check find the scoping question as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Extend the path: Sales -> New Business and select Opportunities-The scoping question “Do you always classify opportunity as relevant for forecast?” is active. -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-If you activate the scoping question “Do you always classify opportunity as relevant for forecast?” the system will automatically set the indicator Relevant for Forecast to Yes. If this is changed to No an automated background job that runs during the night will change this to Yes.-See Also-Help Center Document Opportunities Quick Guide-Keywords-Opportunity; Forecast; Forecasting; Relevant for Forecast; Indicator; Checkbox; check box; ticked; active; checked; technical user; system user; unticked; unchecked;

Title: Conditions that Fill Journal Entry Item Text for an Expense Report from Concur
Content: Symptom-You are interested to know how an expense description gets displayed in a Journal Entry Item Text for an Expense Report from Concur.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Expense Reports view.-Select the Expense Report XX [Represents Expense Report Id from Concur].-Click on View and then Journal Entry-Selecting a Journal Entry Line Item, under Item Details you see a field with name - Item Text.-Cause-Resolution-The expense description can get displayed into Journal Entry Item Text, if either of the condition mentioned below gets fulfilled. In case both the conditions are true , the first one gets the preference.-Condition 1:-Go to Business Configuration - Overview work center view.-Select and open the Activity: Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions.-Click on the link: Maintain Code List Mapping.-Select the line with Mapping group  : ByD Concur Integration and Local Data type Name: ExpenseReportExpenseTypeCode-Under Code List Mapping Rule, select the line where the local context is related to the country.-Under Code List Mapping, if the local code and description is maintained then this description goes to that particular line item of JE. But the condition for point 1 to work is that the JSON need to have a value in expense type code (expenseTypeCode ) on expense entry level and home country code (homeCountryCode) on report level. If either of the two is not filled , then the value from finetuning is not even checked.-Condition 2:-If the condition 1 is not fulfilled, then the field entryDescription in JSON is checked. If this is empty and point 1 also didn’t work, only then the Journal Entry Item Text field stays empty.-If you are not maintaining details for point 1 and still want Journal Entry Item Text field , then check at Concur so that the Field entryDescription is never empty.-See Also-Keywords-Journal Entry Item Text,Concur, Code List Mapping

Title: Notes from Supplier contract does not get carried over to the Purchase order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-In the Purchase order, you do not find the Note types  Remark for the supplier transferred from the the contract -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and orders workcenter-Purchase orders view-Select the Purchase order PQR(PQR refers to the Purchase order id)-In the items tab-Navigate to the notes tab and you do not find the Note types  Remark for the supplier from the contract DEF(DEF refers to the contract ID)-Cause-The supplier contract notes do not reflect the purchase order.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.

Title: How to Check the Tax Configuration set up in ByDesign when it is Integrated with Concur
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to check the tax configuration set up in SAP Business ByDesign when it is integrated with SAP Concur.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-  The Tax Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign is used as reference for the tax configuration to be maintained in SAP Concur:-In the Business Configuration work center, open the Tax on Goods and Services fine tune activity (either from the Overview or from the Activity List of the Implementation project).-Under Tax Codes, click Define Tax Codes.-Here, filter for the Country and Tax Codes that you are looking for.- Keywords-Tax on Goods and Services, Concur-concur,tax on goods and services,tax configuration

Title: Workflow Rule not Working for Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-Workflow Rules for sending notifications for Sales Orders not working.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Workflow Rules view-Select the Rule XYZ. (XYZ represents the Rule Description)-Eventhough the Rule is Active, user are not receiving email notifications related to sales order as per the Rule.-Cause-In a non-productive system you can specify whether e-mails and faxes should be sent to real addresses of business partners or to an address used for testing purposes. In this case user choose "Send all e-mails/faxes to this address", But the email address is not maintained.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Choose Show: All Open Projects.-Choose relevant project and Choose Open Activity List.-Select Fine Tune.-Search the activity E-Mail and Fax Settings.-Click on Open button.-Select E-Mail and Fax Settings.-Under E-Mail and Fax Delivery in a Non-Productive System.-Either select Send all e-mails to business partners or select Send all e-mails to this address and maintain the email address.-Click on Save.-Keywords-email missing, notification failed, no output, email, e-mail, workflow rule, notifications, sales order, email address

Title: Error: “Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project” While Copying Solution Profile
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error: “Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project” While Copying Solution Profile.-There is an external KBA for this error (check See Also), which should be checked by the customer first. In case the issue cannot be resolved from their side, this KBA describes how to perform the backend correction required.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center work center-Go to Systems view-Select source instance-Select Copy Solution Profile button-Source System is selected-Choose your respective Solution Profile-Select respective tenant as Target System-Select Ok-The error "Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project" occurs-Cause-This issue usually happens when a link between the test tenant and productive tenant remains after a past change project is completed.-Resolution-Log into the backend of the production system.-Go to transaction SE16.-Enter Table BCTD_WSORGCPY.-Table Contents (F7).-Select Execute (F8).-Under the column "CPY_LOGIC_PORT", find the relevant for your implementation project.-Select the row.-Edit it by clicking the pencil symbol.-Remove the entry in the logical port field.-Save changes.-See Also-2156628 - Error: “Target System XXX is Already Linked to an Implementation Project” While Copying Solution Profile-Keywords-logical port, remove logical port, backend logical port, copy solution profile error, target system is already linked to an implementation project

Title: For All Business Users, You See Counted on Date Is Updated
Content: Symptom- Counted on Date for all Business users is getting updated Often-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Log into SAP Cloud for Customer.-Go to the Administrator work center.-Go to Business Users view-Select All business Users. -You will see the Counted-On date is updated-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. Counted user is a business user valid on the current date and is unlocked (the User Locked flag is not set).-A scheduled job run in the system updates the counted users in the system. -Please find the help document for more information-Business Users: Additional Features | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Business user, Counted on, Current Date

Title: Invoice Volume Report shows Incorrect Invoice Type
Content: Symptom-The invoice type of Credit Memo in the Invoice Volume Report shows only Customer Invoice, whereas it needs to show Credit Memo In Invoice type fields-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Select the Invoice Volume Report and click on the link to start the report.-In the View section add the row Invoice Type under Invoice-Here you can see the Invoice type is Customer Invoice.-Cause-The Credit Memo and The Customer Invoice are both of Invoice Type Customer Invoices.-However, the Processing Type will distinguish if it's an Invoice or a Credit memo.-Resolution-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Select the Invoice Volume Report and click on the link to start the report.-In the View section add the row Processing Type under Invoice-Here you can see the Processing type is Credit Memo.-Keywords-Credit Memo, Customer Invoice, Invoice Volume, Report-credit memo,customer invoice,invoice volume,report

Title: Time Limit for Requesting Password Reset via 'Forgot Your Password?' Link
Content: Symptom-User doesn't receive the Security Code in the mail box after requesting it via the 'Forgot Your Password?' link-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Login page for system: myxxxxxx.com-Choose 'Forgot Your Password?' link-Enter your E-mail Address and Submit-User receives the Security Code in your mail box-Now again choose the 'Forgot Your Password?' link -Enter required E-mail Address and Submit-Observe, the mail is not received in your inbox.-Cause-The system refrained from sending the email because two consecutive requests for the Security Code is being made within a 10-minute timeframe.-Resolution-Time limit for resending security code mail is 10 minutes. Please wait at least 10 minutes, before requesting the Security Code to reset the Password for the second/next time.-Keywords-Forgot Your Password, E-mail, Security Code, Reset Password, Password, Duration, Time Limit

Title: Project IDs are not Available for Selection in the Project Plan Values Report
Content: Symptom-You observe that few of the Project IDs are not available for selection in the 'Project Plan Values' report.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to Reports and then the List View.-Click open the Project Plan Values report.-Go to the selection criteria Projects which is a mandatory field.- You observe that few of the Project IDs are not available for selection in the Project Plan Values report.-Cause-The characteristic Project of Datasource FINCACU03 has the setting "use context" for value help.-This means that only those projects are shown which are part of the transactional data source FINCACU03.-Resolution-In case some business documents exists for these projects, then the value help would show this entries.-Keywords-Project Plan Values, Projects

Title: Business User ID and Contact Details are not in Sync under User Subscription in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-User ID and Contact Details are changed under Business user view, however changed data is not in sync under User Subscription view in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center.-Open User Subscriptions view.-Click on User type for which the corresponding Business user name has been changed.-You will see users (e.g. name, user ID, email, set user lock) details are not updated.-Resolution-Whenever customer update any details related to users (e.g. name, user ID, email, set user lock) in the Business User view these details will get updated in the License view only after the data has been updated in the SAP Backend as well. Since this takes some time to get updated and may cause confusions to customers often.-To avoid these kind of confusions, we have offered new button in the User Subscription Overview called Syncronize Employee Data.-Customer can simply click on this button and that directly triggers the synchronization between the systems and details will be synced. You can also follow below steps to find this button:-Login to Production tenant-Go to Service Control Center work center-Click on User Subscription-Click on Synchronize Employee Data button as shown in below screenshot-Important Note: This button will only work when you trigger this button from your production tenant.-See Also-All About Service Control Center in SAP Business ByDesign(ByD)-Keywords-User Subscription, User Type, User ID name change , SRD-CC-CI-CCS, Synchronize Employee Data, Synchronize User Data, Synchronize User Licenses.

Title: No Field to Enter Payment Method for DE Employees in the Standard Concur Integration
Content: Symptom-You observe that on the UI and for the German(DE) employees, there is no field to enter payment method, only bank details in the Standard Concur Integration.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees View.-Search for a DE employee and click on Edit.-Go to Personal data tab and under Payment Information, there is no field called Payment Method unlike other country employee master data screen.-Cause-There is no option to choose a payment method specifically if user needs to. This is a standard system behavior.-Types of Payment forms are definitely controlled by the country of employment and system scoping. So only bank transfer details are allowed for DE Employees.-Addition of Payment Method field is a new requirement and needs to be routed to SAP Influence Forum-Resolution-You can always add the bank details information for the Employee and mark the relevant one as Main Bank Account.-This would ensure that a payment form Bank Transfer is created for the employee and this will fulfill the need.-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees View.-Search for a DE employee and click on Edit.-Go to Personal data tab and under Payment Information, Add Row for the Bank Account and check mark the Main Bank Account.-See Also-Keywords-Concur Integration, SAP Concur, German Employee, DE employee,Payment Method,Payment Information

Title: Cannot Consume Overhead Absorption Cost Functionality for Customer Projects
Content: Symptom-You want to use the overhead function with the project type customer project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center -Go to Overhead Cost Projects -Go to Overhead Absorption view -Select Advanced filter -You do not find customer projects for selection-Cause-Customer Projects with Sales Integration is neither support overhead cost allocation nor overhead cost distribution. -Resolution-The overhead absorption function was not developed from the past as other customers did not request for the functionality. We do not see any technical or functional limitations as such. You can post the idea in ideas forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886. Product management will validate and take it further for future enhancements.

Title: You Receive Error Message "Operation not possible; document locked by ZZZ"
Content: Symptom-You open a sales order and you receive error message "Operation not possible; document locked by ZZZ" (ZZZ represents the technical User ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order workcenter.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Click on Release or Save.-You receive the error message "Operation not possible; document locked by ZZZ".-Cause-This is a generic error message, suggesting that there is another process affecting the sales order.-This can be caused by:-Two instances that are open and affect the same document (e.g. Mobile, Desktop or other user).-Internal processes that are scheduled such as a confirmation update run to update the sales order at this time.-PDI involvement. For example:-if an Extension Field (KUT or PDI) is modified via a PDI Solution on the Sales Order. This triggers an update to customer demand which in turn will trigger a message back from customer demand to sales order.-If this then triggers the PDI modification again, you will go into an endless loop.-This can occur more frequently with sales orders that are bound to projects, as more internal processes are executed in this use case.-Resolution-Try to execute the same function after some time.-If you receive the same error, then check if you have multiple windows open or you are accessing the sales order from another device.-Check if the Confirmation Update Run is scheduled and currently running. -In case of PDI involvement you can identify the Extension Field that is being modified in the Changes tab of the Sales Order and you need to contact the Author of the PDI solution to check and correct the Add-On Logic to ensure that the modification will not run into an endless loop. -See Also-3319137 - Sales Order is Frequently Locked and Updated-Keywords-Sales Order, User Lock, Project, Kundenauftrag, Projektzoordnung, operation not possible, document locked, locked, multiple changes, changes

Title: Fulfilled Quantity and Open Quantity For a Product is Zero, But There is Still an Inspection Document Created For It Automatically.
Content: Symptom-For a warehouse order, product ABC (ABC represents product ID) has both open quantity and fulfilled quantity as zero. However, there is an inspection document created for this product automatically.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Inbound Logistics.-Access view Monitoring - By Warehouse Order.-Search warehouse order XYZ (XYZ represents warehouse order ID), click Edit.-Select tab Operations, open quantity and fulfilled quantity for product ABC is zero.-Select tab Document Flow, open following inspection document, product ID is ABC.-Cause-Once inbound delivery notification created which involves product ABC, then no matter whether ABC is confirmed with any quantity or not during post goods receipt, as long as corresponding inspection plan exists, system will always create an inspection document for product ABC.-Resolution-System standard behavior.-Keywords-Inspection, Open Quantity, Fulfilled Quantity, Zero, Post Goods Receipt, Warehouse Order

Title: An Exception In Planning View However No Error in Document Flow
Content: Symptom-There is an exception exists for Inbound Delivery Notification for product in planning view however no error in respective document's document flow.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products view.-Find required ID with planning area.-Here select and choose open.-In planning view, there is a row with Inbound Delivery Notification with an exception (red mark).-Cause-This is an exception for Inbound Delivery Notification as per the Availability Date of the document in the past and not for the document flow.-Resolution-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to Products view.-Find required ID with planning area.-Here select and choose open.-Under Supply and Demand view, navigate to the Exceptions sub tab.-Here exception detail is displayed.-As per an exception, user can select and choose Acknowledge option to accept it.-Note: It is valid for other documents also.-Keywords-planning, exception, inbound delivery notification, red mark, supply and demand, planning view.

Title: How to Check in Backend if Concur Integration for Financials is Scoped
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-You would like to check if Concur Integration is scoped in the customer system.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-Resolution-Open Backend via STFK Go to Transaction code :BCE-Go to dropdown and select Adaptation workspaces and enter workspace as per below path.-Now Go to Transaction: BCTADM-Select the Main Workspace ID and copy it.-Paste it under Adaptation workspace and double-click it.-Under Scoping(with question), you will be able to see if Concur integration for Financials is scoped or not.-See Also-2743545 - Invalid Work Center Views 2743545-Keywords-Concur Integration, Scoping, BCE, BCTADM

Title: Approvers Details not Visible in the Data Sources of Purchase Order Item Details SRMPO_B02 and Purchase Order Account Assignment SRMPO_B02
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom report based on data sources Purchase Order Item Details SRMPO_B02 and Purchase Order Account Assignment SRMPO_B02. Here system does not show the approver details for purchase orders. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Data Sources view -Select the Data Sources of Purchase Order Item Details SRMPO_B02 and Purchase Order Account Assignment SRMPO_B02 -Select Preview -Filter with specific purchase order -Approver details appears blank -Cause-System does not display the approver details because you have kept the Purchase Order Status filter to display purchase orders with In Preparation and Sent. -Resolution-You have to remove the Status filter and then system will display the approver details for the corresponding purchase orders. -Note:-You can make use of Data Source BTMAPPV01. This data source will provide the details about an approval task. -For purchase orders which are in In Preparation, system will not show the approver details. Despite system shows the approver details for In preparation orders, it is just a proposal from the system but actual determination happens when the Approval tasks gets generated.-You can refer to the below blog;-ByDesign 1808 Release: Analytical Report – Approval Task Details-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/07/25/bydesign-1808-release-analytical-report-approval-task-details/-Keywords-Approvers Details not Visible in the Data Sources of Purchase Order Item Details SRMPO_B02 and Purchase Order Account Assignment SRMPO_B02; Approvers Details not Visible; Approvers Details not Visible in the Data Sources of Purchase Order Item Details

Title: Closing Balance Result Is Not Zero In Trial Balance Report
Content: Symptom-You notice that the closing balance result is not zero in trial balance report after finishing balance carryforward, and you wonder why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Reports view.-Search and select trial balance report.-Enter required information such as company, set of books, accounting period, and G/L account type.-You notice that the closing balance is not zero.-Cause-When you fetch the trial balance report, for all accounting periods in a year it shows the trial balance for G/L accounts for one year.-The closing balance in the trial balance report shows the amount to be carried forward.-If you navigate to G/L account line-item report, you can see if you include journal entry type: balance carryforward, the result is 0.-Resolution-It is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-closing balance result, balance carryforward, trial balance

Title: Document Description & PO Reference Number in the Remittance Advice Form
Content: Symptom-You are looking for the binding path for the below two fields so that they are displayed in the remittance advice form.-Document description field in the outgoing check screen-PO Reference number from the payable/invoices line item.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor View.-Click to open an Outgoing Check.-Click Preview -> Advice.-The system will show the Remittance Advice PDF for the Outgoing Check. Inside this PDF you are missing the following fields.-Document Description.-PO Reference number from the payable/invoices line item.-Cause-Currently, these fields in the form are not mapped to the fields in the payment.-Resolution-We understood that these fields are not mapped in the output agent class and the issue is taken up and is corrected in the upcoming releases of Business Bydesign.-See Also-Keywords-Remittance Advice Form, Document Description, PO Reference number

Title: Credit Limit Check in Sales Order is incorrect when you use product type Consignment Fill-up
Content: Symptom-When you execute the Credit Limit Check in a sales order when you use the product type as Consignment Fill-up the information message displays a different amount than expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select New Sales Order from the Common Tasks.-Enter account ABC and in the Items tab enter the product of the type Consignment Fill-up (ABC represents the account ID).-The total net value of the Sales Order is 150 EUR.-Click on the Check Credit Limit button.-The following information message appears:-Credit limit not exceeded; 100,00 EUR is left  (100,00 EUR represents the credit limit entered in the account master data)-Since the total net value is 150 EUR, you expect the system to consider the 150 EUR for the Credit Limit Check. However, the system does not consider it.-Cause-The item type Product Consignment fill-up in the sales orders is not considered for the credit limit check.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-See Also-KBA 3240101 - Some Sales Orders are missing in Sales Order Volume Report-KBA 2392105 - Credit Limit Check in Sales Order is Incorrect-Keywords-Sales Order; Credit Limit Check; Consignment Fill-up; Account; Exceeded-sales order,credit limit check,consignment fill-up

Title: Standard Working Time of Employee Shows Blank
Content: Symptom-You are working in an employee personnel file, and notice that the Standard Working Hours field for the work agreement is appearing as blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Enter the Employees view.-Search for the employee and select it.-Click on the Edit button.-Navigate to the Employment tab.-Enter the Work Agreement tab.-Select an entry in the Clauses table.-Below you can see the field Standard Working Time as blank.-Cause-No standard working time is assigned to the combination of Work Agreement, Administrative Category and Company.-Working times are defined in the Working Time activity in Business Configuration, where you can define the times for each Work Agreement and Administrative Category, and then assign it to companies.-In this case, the work agreement of the employee does not fit the working times assigned to the company of this employee, causing it to be displayed as blank.-Resolution-In order to check the configuration, follow the steps from the Steps To Reproduce section of this KBA to get the Work Agreement, Administrative Category and Company of the employee.-Then compare it to the setup of working times following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity Working Time.-Click on the link to open the activity.-Here you have 2 sub-activities, where you can check the working times (with the combination of Work Agreement and Administrative Category) and also the company assignment.-Keywords-Empty, FTE, Work Schedule, No Value

Title: The Print Preview Template of the Expense Report is not Showing the Approval Details Table
Content: Symptom-You observe that the print preview template of the expense report YY (YY represents Expense Report ID) is not showing the Approval details anymore.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses work center.-Go to Expense Reports View.-Check the Print Preview for Expense Report YY.-Cause-The approval table at the bottom of Expense report preview/pdf is only displayed if there is more than one approver / approval step.-If there is only one approver / approval step, the approval step table is empty and therefore it’s not displayed. But then the one and only approver is displayed under Approver in the right upper edge.-In case of several approvers always the latest approver is displayed under Approver in the right upper edge.-Resolution-So, the feature works as intended and designed for expense report approval.-Keywords-Travel and Expense, Print preview template

Title: Corresponding Avail. Conf. Item Party In Customer Requirement Not Found
Content: Symptom-The error message: Corresponding avail. conf. item party in customer requirement not found is displayed in DFV result.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center. -Navigate to the Business Data Consistency view and choose the subview Data Flow Verification Result. -Select the DFV result with errors between Sales Order and Customer Demand business documents. -Choose the Edit button.  -Under Details section of the DFV result you can see the error message: Corresponding avail. conf. item party in customer requirement not found is displayed in DFV result.-Cause-The vendor party could not be created in customer demand due to the missing confirmed ship-from location.-The ship-from location will be populated after successful check availability confirmation of the sales order mentioned in the DFV result.-Currently, the relevant sales order while performing ATP check will display a message: The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data.-Resolution-The business user will have to make sure all your sourcing relevant master data is maintained in the system. The error can be because of any master data setting missing in the system.-You need to check the help document titled Ship-From Determination and Shipment Scheduling for Customer Demand and make sure all the settings are maintained correctly.-Once the settings are maintained correctly, you will be able to successfully determine ship-from location for the sales order via ATP check.-The DFV errors will be resolved during the recheck after ATP has determined a ship-from location successfully.-See Also-2040836 - The Source of Supply Cannot be Determined; Check the Sourcing Relevant Master Data-2933088 - Error: "The Source of Supply Cannot be Determined; Check the Sourcing Relevant Master Data"-1705986 - You Received the following Warning Message in your Sales Order: "The source of supply cannot be determined".-2567661 - Error: "The source of supply cannot be determined; check the sourcing-relevant master data", While Trying to Release Customer Demand Document Created Against a Project Stock Order  -Keywords-DFV error in customer demand, DFV error in sales order, Corresponding Avail. Conf. Item Party In Customer Requirement Not Found, DFV result error

Title: "Combination of Sales org. X and Distribution Channel Y Already Exists" Error When Migrating Materials
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate materials in the system, however in the Simulation step the migration raises the following error message:-"Combination of Sales org. X and Distribution Channel Y Already Exists" (where X represents an org unit, and Y represents a distribution channel).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Materials.-Click on the name of the activity to open it.-Click on the sub-activity Migrate Materials Using the Migration Tool.-Select the file to be imported, or upload a new file.-Click on the button Execute Migration.-Click on Step-by-step.-Proceed until the step 3 - Simulation.-After the simulation is finished, the error message appears in the log.-Cause-You have mapped different source values of Sales Organization to a single target value. This is causing duplicate entries in the migration if both Sales Organizations are being imported with the same Distribution Channel.-For example, consider the following dataset in a migration template:-Sales Organization X - Distribution Channel Y-Sales Organization Z - Distribution Channel Y-In this scenario, the migration would not raise any errors. However in the step 2 of the migration process (Value Mapping), both Sales Organizations were mapped to a target Sales Organization W. This causes the data set to be considered as the following:-Sales Organization W - Distribution Channel Y-Sales Organization W- Distribution Channel Y-This causes the error in the simulation, as there are duplicate entries being imported.-Resolution-In order to fix the issue, check the Value Mapping step of the migration process and ensure that no concurrent source values are being mapped to a single target value.-To check the mapping task, you can follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the activity Migration of Materials.-Click on the name of the activity to open it.-Click on the sub-activity Migrate Materials Using the Migration Tool.-Select the file to be imported, or upload a new file.-Click on the button Execute Migration.-Click on Step-by-step.-Proceed to the step 2 of the migration wizard.-Keywords-Excel, Template, Org Unit
