Title: Case Behavior in Customer System/Tenant and SAP for Me - INTERNAL ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***RELEASED INTERNALLY***-This KBA will help you to understand and provide details on the following:-Case (Status, Priority, Notes) Replication Behavior from Customer System to SAP for Me.-Case Reporter Name Replication from Customer System to SAP for Me.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-SAP Cloud for Customer.-SAP for Me-Resolution- Customer can create cases from Built-in Support as well as from Customer SAP for Me.-Cases which are created from Built-In support(tenant) should complete it's lifecycle from the tenant itself. -Cases which are created from the Built-In support(tenant) will be replicated to SAP for Me, It will be only in Read-Only mode.-Cases which are created from the SAP for Me should complete it's lifecycle from the SAP for Me itself.-Cases which are created from the SAP for Me will not be replicated to tenant.-Case Reporter Name Replication from Tenant to SAP for Me:-“Requester” role in built in support and “requester” role in SAP for Me is not the same role.-In built-in support, “requester” is the business/key user who creates the case :-Requester --> Business/key user opening the case-Processor --> The key user processing the case-The key user can be both the requester and processor.-In SAP for Me there is no end user, it is only between SAP and the Key user-Requester --> The Cloud Super Admin for the customer installation (not necessarily the key user)-Processor --> The Support engineer processing the case-Additional contact --> key user. In SAP for Me this is only visible and required for case notifications.-Conclusion: Case requester in Tenant is not the same as case requester in SAP for Me, these are different roles in Tenant and SAP for Me.-Note: In order to have the same Name in the requester/reporter field in both Tenant and SAP for Me, Customer/Key User/Business user need to reach out to Cloud Super Admin of that customer, i.e. reach out to Reporter found in the SAP for Me.-Case Notes Replication from Tenant to SAP for Me:-When notes are adding by Support Engineer, All customer facing notes(Business Impact, Call to Customer, Info to Customer, Reply) will be replicated to both tenant as well as SAP for Me when case is created from Tenant.-Case Priority Replication from Tenant to SAP for Me:-Customer can create case with any priority from tenant as well as from SAP for Me.-Case priority can be changed by customer in the following scenario:-Customer can reach out to Customer Interaction Center(CIC), requesting them to raise the case priority accordingly.-Customer can add note in the case requesting to raise the case priority by justifying the Business Impact.-Customer can raise the case priority from their end only when the case status is In-process in customer tenant and status in CSS as Customer Action/Solution Proposed.-Note: Whenever Support Engineer or CIC colleagues raising case upon customer request, they need to add customer facing note then only the Priority will replicate to the customer tenant.-Case Status replication from Tenant to SAP for Me:-Case Status in SAP for Me Case Status in Tenant-Not Sent to SAP-In-process-Sent to SAP In-process Provider action-In Processing by SAP In-process Provider action-Customer Action In-process-SAP Proposed Solution In-process-Confirmed Confirmed-Confirmed Automatically-Confirmed Automatically-See Also-SAP Support Channels.-SAP for Me Management.-SAP Help Portal Case Management-KBA 2198153 - How does a Cloud Administrator add/remove S-User ID authorizations - SAP for Me-KBA 2818903 - Incorrect case reporter in the SAP for Me for C4C or ByD cases-Keywords-Case Replication, Case Status Replication, Case Priority Replication, SAP for Me case Replication, Case Replication between tenant to SAP for Me.

Title: Incorrect Net Unit Price value of the product generated in different column of the Sales Quotes preview
Content: Symptom-When the user preview the Sales Quote Output, the Net Unit Price XX is incorrectly printed for an YY item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Workcenter-Go to Sales Quotes view.-Open Sales Quote PQR (PQR represents Sales Quote ID).-Go to Actions and click on Preview.-The net unit price of the product ABC is “0.00” but it is getting replicated in the above column of the product DEF and net unit price value of NNN is not getting replicated in its original place (ABC and DEF represents Product ID).  -Cause-The price data present are not operating prices, but the printing relevant prices which are customized in the pricing procedure customizing in the corresponding ERP system. The relevant price data can directly be checked in the Action 'Check output pricing' (which can be hidden in the user system).-Resolution-This is a problem with the way the form template has been developed; the Net Unit Price uses binding which are populated in an array (for example, $.Form[*]. NetPriceValue) without being anchored to any specific item. The item XYZ appears to have the net value zero, as can be seen in the form preview, which is why the net value of one item is allocated to the other item above it. -Since it is a customized form, the form template needs to be checked and modified by the template responsible as per the user requirement.-See Also-KBA 3246228 - Price Calculation on Quote is Not Correct According to Unit Of Measure-Keywords-Net Price, Sales Quote, Binding, Sales Quote preview, Form Template, Price Calculation

Title: Output Channel Selection Rule Not Working
Content: Symptom-You have defined output channel selection rule for created purchase order. You want it to be output by E-mail or Do not Send for example. You have set parameters to EQ(*) to cover all possible values. But it is not working. The output is Printer by default.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Application and User Management work center;-Open Input and Output Management->Output Channel Selection;-Select Created Purchase Order from the dropdown list of Show Rules For;-Click Go and see the Edit Output Channel screen;-You can see that for the top rule, Company, Supplier, Purchasing Unit and Employee Responsible are all maintained as EQ(*).-Cause-This is a normal system behavior.-If you set the parameter to EQ(*), it means only when the parameter is * can system match the output channel selection rule and output the document as defined. But system cannot catch any value which is *, so it will choose the default output channel, which is Printer.-Resolution-If you would like the parameter(s) to cover all possible values, you may want to leave the parameter(s) N/A. The normal behavior would be showing  *  instead of showing EQ(*).-Open Application and User Management work center;-Open Input and Output Management->Output Channel Selection;-Select Created Purchase Order from the dropdown list of Show Rules For;-Click Go and see the Edit Output Channel screen;-Click a parameter from Company, Supplier, Purchase Unit, Employee Responsible;-Remove values from Select Operator field and Enter Value field, click OK;-Click Save and Activate.-See Also-3190227 - How Output Channel Selection Works in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-Output; Output Channel; Output Channel Selection; Created Purchase Order

Title: The correct cost rate of the employee is not displayed in the project
Content: Symptom-The correct cost rate of the employee DEF(DEF refers to the employee id) is not displayed in the project PQR(PQR refers to the project)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management workcenter-Projects view-Select the project PQR(PQR refers to the project)-Now choose the project PQR(PQR refers to the project)-Add service and service cost and the employee DEF(DEF refers to the employee id) and enter 10 hours but the cost rate is 1.-Cause-The employee DEF was hired on the current date and year but the project PQR has started in the previous date and year which is before the employee was hired. Hence the cost rate will not pick up for the employee until the user mentions the Start date and end date for that work.-Resolution-You can manually enter the start date and it will fetch the correct cost rate of the employee. If not maintained the start and end date, then the system will automatically consider the task's scheduled date which is starts from the previous date and hence no cost rate of this employee will be fetched as the employee hire date is the current one.

Title: User Can See Journal Entry Voucher Without Access To Work Center General Ledger
Content: Symptom-A user is not assigned to "General Ledger" work center view, but the user can still see the journal entry voucher.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First check the business user's access right:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for the user ID.-Click on edit - access rights.-Go to access restriction tab.-Filter with work center view name - General Ledger.-Cannot find General Ledger work center under 'Assigned work center and views'.-Then check the business user's access to journal entry voucher view:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open sales order ABC (ABC represents the sales order ID).-Navigate to the document flow tab.-The user can see the journal entry voucher in the document flow.-Cause-Coming from the additionally assigned work center views listed as below. If any one of the view is assigned to the user, will be able to access the journal entries from the document flow of sales order. -Work Centers: Customer invoicing, Payables, Receivables, Cost and revenue, Supplier invoicing, Travel and expenses, Payment management, Liquidity management, Fixed Asset.-You can find the access rights for work centers using below steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Navigate to the Business User view.-Search for the User ID.-Click on Edit - Access Rights.-Go to Access Restriction tab.-Filter with work center view name.-You can see the user has access to the work center.-Resolution-Please unassign the work center views, and user will not able to see the journal entry voucher.-See Also-1409766 - User can Post Journal Entry Voucher to a company without Read/Write Access-Keywords-journal entry voucher, journal entry voucher access rights, 日记账分录权限

Title: Not Able to Edit IT Contact Name via Service Control Center WorkCenter
Content: Symptom-User wants to edit existing IT contact name-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Control Center Work center.-Go to Contact Details view.-Select IT contact from Active contacts List.-Click on Edit-User cannot edit name field.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour.-Resolution-User can change Email ID and contact details but user name cannot be changed.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2497836-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2101230-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2429016-Keywords-Edit IT Contact, IT contact name change

Title: Report 'Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure' shows 0 ITD incurred cost for a project task
Content: Symptom-You see Zero value in report Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure for ITD incurred cost for project task XYZ-AA(XYZ-AA refers to task of the project XYZ in question)-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management Work center-Open Projects view and Search for Project XYZ(XYZ refers to project ID)-Click on Edit button and Navigate to Project Overview tab and the Reports subtab-In Financial Reports section, click in 'Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure' link  -The Report opens and you can see that for Project task XYZ-AA the ITD Incurred Cost as '0,00' and this is not expected by you.-Cause-The project task XYZ-AA doesn't have the sales order assigned, hence value shows zero-Resolution-The data in the ITD Incurred Cost column is fetched from the actual accounting documents, the journal entry vouchers.-As the project XYZ is a customer sales project, the incurred cost of sales is derived from the Expense Assignment to Sales Order business transaction, from the generation of the customer project expense lists.-This transaction assigns the project expense to the sales order item.-If an accrual method is assigned to the sales order item then the expense is-- credited on the deferred cost of goods sold account, associated with the employee ID, the project task, Resource and G/L account (origin)-- debited on the deferred cost of goods sold account, associated with the employee ID, the project task, Resource and G/L account (origin) as well as the sales order item.-the revenue recognition run then realizes the costs on the G/L account (origin) based on the costs assigned to the sales order item.-When you add the Employee (Account Assignment) and see the data, we can see the ITD incurred costs are shown.-Also, sales document item has no Accrual method assigned, this could be an issue-For further information on the expense assignment to sales order business transaction please have a look at the ByDesign help document Customer Projects:-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2202/en-US/2cba15be722d1014875ab8f607e8f591.html where the above described posting logic is explained in more detail in the New Posting Logic section.-See Also-https://help.sap.com/viewer/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2202/en-US/2cba15be722d1014875ab8f607e8f591.html-Keywords-Report, ITD Incurred cost, Cost and Revenue

Title: Unable to Maintain Serial Number for a Product in Production Task Even When This Product Has Serial Number Profile as "Optional Serial Number Assignment".
Content: Symptom-Product ABC is the output product in a production task, it has Serial Number Profile as "Optional Serial Number Assignment" in master data. However, when confirm the task, there is no tab "Serial Number" to maintain serial number for the product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access view Task Control -Select a task, click Confirm.-Under tab Confirmation, select sub tab Output Products, in the below there is no sub tab "Serial Number".-However, check in the master data of this product, it has Serial Number Profile as "Optional Serial Number Assignment".-Cause-Only product with Serial Number Profile "Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes" can be maintained with serial number in production, no matter it is input or output product.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-See Also-1. Blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2019/01/06/how-new-serial-number-profile-works-in-sap-business-bydesign/-2. Help document "Working with Serial Numbers": https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cd4e8e1722d1014ada5a7b4e51974d5.html#maintaining-serial-number-profiles-Keywords-Production, Serial Number, Optional Serial Number Assignment

Title: You Are Not Able to Create Change Project in Test Tenant
Content: Symptom-You are not able to create change project in test tenant and to implement some configuration changes-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Test Tenant,-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select New button on top of the screen-It is greyed out.-Cause-It is not possible to create change project in test tenant -Resolution-This is standard system Behavior.-You can perform the below activities in only production tenant, Which is Active.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Project view.-Select New button on top of the screen-Create a New Change Project-To copy Solution Profile,-Go to Service Control Center Work Center.-Go to Systems view.-Select source instance-Select Copy Solution Profile button-Select values accordingly for Remote Change Project.-Keywords-Change project, test tenant, Solution Profile, Target

Title: System Dumps While Releasing Production Model for Planning and Execution.
Content: Symptom-System throws 500 SAP Internal Server Error while releasing a production model for planning and execution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Planning and Production Master Data.-Access view Production Models.-Search production model ABC (ABC represents production model ID), click Edit.-Choose button Release Production Model - For Planning and Execution,  500 SAP Internal Server Error  triggered.-Cause-Synchronization issue between the planning view of Bill of Operation with Bill of Operation hierarchy.-Resolution-Please take below steps:-Open the production model which is having this issue.-Select tab Bill of Operations.-Select sub tab Planning View Of BoO.-Click button Update Planning View.-Choose Save.-Choose Check Consistency.-Choose Save.-Now try to release the production model for planning and execution.-Keywords-Production Model, Release, Dump, 500 SAP Internal Server Error, Bill Of Operation, BoO, Update Planning, Planning view, Dump,

Title: Sales Order Released but corresponding Customer Demand not generated, You see error " No access possible via a 'NULL' data reference" from backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-You see that the Sales Order has been generated in the system, however the corresponding Customer Demand has not been generated. When you navigate through backend, you see a stuck message with the following details:-Sender Party:SalesOrderProcessing-RecieverInterfaceName:CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn-Error Information:No access possible via a 'NULL' data reference.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales order Work Center.-Go to Sales order View.-Search and Open relevant Sales Order.-You see that the status is Open and in the document flow extended view no customer demand exists-Cause-This error usually occurs due to a PDI solution attempting to modify the data at the time the message is being compiled which will ultimately result in the above error.-Resolution-Step-1-When this error is encountered, please first attempt a standard restart in the message monitor queue.-Step-2-Should the message still fail to deliver you will need to perform a restart through “Queue Monitor”-Step- 3-If this does not resolve, please disable PDI as defined in KBA 2497419 - How to Switch off PDI in C4C or ByD for a Given User and then restart the meassge either through Step-1 if this does not help then restart as per Step-2.-Step-4-If the message fails to deliver you will be presented with an error, you can close the error popup and navigate back to the failing message in the queue and perform a Reconciliation.-The new message should deliver, confirm this in a separate SRT_MONI session.-If the new message delivers successfully, you can Cancel the original failing message.--If the new message fails to deliver and the same error is presented, please cancel this new Reconciled message and send the case to SCM Dev AP-CR-CR-Keywords-No access possible via a 'NULL' data reference, SalesOrderProcessing, CustomerRequirementProcessingFulfillmentIn, Sales Order, Customer Demand, not exist, not displayed, Open

Title: For A Sales Kit Item The Following Error Occurs In A Return: Item XX: Mandatory List Price Missing For The Price Calculation
Content: Symptom-When creating a customer return based on a sales order with kit items, the system displays the following error for the kit sub items:-"Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Open return XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the return).-The following error occurs for a sales kit - sub item:-"Item XX: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation".-Cause-You created a Return for a Sales Kit but instead of just selecting the Sales Kit – Header Item, you selected the Sales Kit – Header Item and also all of the Sales Kit – Sub Items.-When you create a Return for a Kit Item you need to just select the Sales Kit – Header Item in the first step in the New Customer Return Notification. The Sales Kit – Sub Items will then automatically be pulled as you can see in the second step.-If you select the Sales Kit – Header Item and the Sales Kit – Sub Items in the first step of the New Customer Return Notification, the system determines Sales Kit – Header Item and populates the Sales Kit – Sub Items automatically and in addition the manually selected Sub Items are added as normal items in addition. This means that for these normal items the system expects a List Price in the created Return.-Resolution-To solve the issue you need to first ensure that the Return is consistent and then cancel the Return.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Returns view.-Open return XYZ.-Navigate to the Pricing tab.-Select the respective item and click the Expand button.-Click Add Row.-In the drop down list for the Price Component select the option List Price.-Maintain the corresponding amount.-Now cancel the Return via the Inbound Delivery and also cancel the Inbound Delivery Notification.-You can then create a New Customer Return Notification, Inbound Delivery and Return. Please ensure that you only select the Sales Kit Header in the first step of the New Customer Return Notification.-See Also-KBA 2936830 - How to Cancel a Customer Return-SAP Help Document: Kits Process Flow-Keywords-Customer Return, Sales Kit, Mandatory list price missing

Title: Migration Of Accounting Transaction Data Error: The Sum Of The Balances Is Not Zero
Content: Symptom-You face an error when executing migration of accounting transaction data: The sum of the balances is not zero.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Find migration of accounting transaction data activity.-Press open.-Press migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the respective migration unit.-Execute migration and validate file.-You can see an error: The sum of the balances is not zero.-Cause-The balance of the entries is not zero in the migration template for G/L account balances.-One possible cause is the company currency and line-item currency is wrongly maintained in the migration template.-For example, customer has maintained different company currencies and the same line-item currency.-This is incorrect as there should be only one company currency, and customer can maintain different line-item currencies.-Resolution-You need to correctly maintain the company currency and line-item currency to realize the balance of the entries is zero.-Keywords-migration of accounting transaction data, the sum of the balances is not zero

Title: Error: "Gross volume for EA must be greater than or equal to ..." when trying to create product
Content: Symptom-The following cases fail with error: "Gross volume for EA must be greater than or equal to xxx (Net Volume)" (where xxx is the net volume figure)-You are using an OData service to insert new products.-Alternatively, you are trying to create a product in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps in OData:-In Application and User management work center, open OData Services view-Select and process the relevant service-Error message appears-Steps in UI:-In Product Portfolio work center, select Products view -Select New to create a new product-Enter in mandatory information (Material ID, Material Description, Product Category, Base UoM) and Save-Under the General tab, enter in the Net Volume and Gross Volume-Error message appears-Cause-The maintained Net Volume is bigger than the Gross Volume.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. It is not possible to bypass or supress the error message.-Keywords-gross volume, net volume, product, material, units of measurement, UoM, occurs, appears,

Title: Time and Expenses From/To Field is Greyed out When Project Invoice Request is Created With In Preparation Status
Content: Symptom-You are unable to modify Time and Expenses From/To field in the In Preparation Project Invoice Request document. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center -Go to Project Invoice Requests view -Select the relevant Project Invoice Request -Select Edit and you can see that Time and Expenses From/To field is greyed out for modification-Cause-The Project Invoice Request was created based on schedule invoice request. For such requests, the field Time and Expenses From/To will be greyed out.-Resolution-The Restrict Time and Expenses field cannot be changed or removed or edited for the project invoice requests which were created out of schedule invoice request. The Restrict Time and Expenses is being selected By Specific Dates that it is not the same as maintained in Sales Order Item.-So what is considered for this field? The answer is - An expense item will also be considered as within the period if the service/delivery/expense period only partially falls within the specified date range.-If you create a new manual project invoice request, then the fields are editable. You can choose any one of the below; -By Specific Dates-For Last Week-Until End of Last Week-For Last Month-Until End of Last Month-No Restriction-Note: -Fixed price: The item contains a fixed quantity and net value. The customer invoice is based on this quantity and value, regardless of whether more or less time or expenses than planned have been used to perform the service.-Time and material: The item contains an estimated quantity and net value. The customer invoice is based on the time and material used to perform the service.-Keywords-unable to modify Time and Expenses From/To field in the In Preparation Project Invoice Request; Cannot change From/To field in the Project Invoice Request

Title: You are Unable to Approve Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-While approving Purchase Order system throws below Dump-500 SAP Internal Server error -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests & Orders Work Center-Go to Purchase Order View-Select any Purchase Order which is in approval status-Go to Managing My Area Work Center-Navigate to the Approvals Work Center View-You can find the task Approve purchase order -When you select on approve option, System Dumps with 500 SAP Internal server error-Cause-User didn't maintain the valid Communication Arrangement.-Resolution-You have to maintain the valid Communication Arrangement-A. If the Supplier and Buying company which are not subsidiaries, follow below steps for maintaining communication arrangement.-Go to Application and User Management Work Center.-Select Communication Arrangement sub-view.-Click New button and maintain the communication arrangement.-B. If the Buying company and Supplier are subsidiaries then follow below blog and ensure all prerequisites are met:-SAP Business ByDesign Intercompany Process Automation | SAP Blogs-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Intercompany Process Automation | SAP Blogs -Keywords-Dump, Approve Purchase Order, 500 SAP Internal Server error.

Title: Contacts created in Service Control Center is still in Requested Status
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Customer have created incident with the below concerns:-Contact created in the Service Control Center work center is still in Requested Status-Customer wanted to make the Created contact as Administrator or Key user in the Contact list-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-After Contact type is maintained, it will be displayed in the Requested / In Process Contacts list and contacts will shown in active list within 1 business day when the daily job runs.-There could be other possible reason why contact is not created 1 main reason is during the job run or contact creation time SPC system might not be reachable and down.-Resolution-Contact create flow is as follows:-Customer create contact in the SAP Business ByDesign/SAP Cloud for Customer -> SPC receives this request and register the request -> Once contact is created in SPC this gets register under ICP system -> Once this is registered in the ICP confirmation is sent to BYD and status of the contact will be set to Created.-To continue the investigation this needs access to the SPC backend system access due to security concern it is restricted to get the access to Support teams, access is only given to the BYD Dev colleagues that to with the some restricted access, so whenever you receive incidents/cases with the below please do take respective actions from your end.-Contact created in the Service Control Center work center is still in Requested Status --> Ask customer to wait for 1 Business Day to get the contact created by the background job, if contact is not created dev team colleagues will receive Email if the contact is stuck in between, they will resolve as on when they receive these stuck contact Email from the backend system.-Customer wanted to make the Created contact as Administrator or Key user in the Contact list --> Send the incident to Dev team to do the correction.-Additionally you can have a look on the attached word document on how dev team will fix these issues.-2101230 - How To Create a Commercial Contact , IT Contact or SAP Store Buyer contact-See Also-Keywords-  IT Contacts, Requested, Key User, Administrator, Commercial contact, Contacts, Service Control Center, SRD-CC-CI-CCS

Title: Services Master Data Mass Change not Possible
Content: Symptom-If User want to perform a mass update of Services, e.g. an update of tax rates, but don't find an according option to do so:-Such a change is not possible via Mass Data Maintenance (since there is no option for Services)-Such a change is not possible via Mass Change (since the relevant tab, e.g. Tax, cannot be selected - only General, Valuation and Sales tabs are available)-But a manual change is possible in the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. SAP Business ByDesign does not support to edit this kind of existing data Mass Data Maintenance or Mass Change.-Resolution-Please perform the update manually in the UI, or check webservice for according options.-Keywords-bulk modification, batch edit, rate adjustment, taxation update, catalog items, mass operation, edit limitation, user interface only, programmatic update, integration API, configuration limits, governance, compliance, authorization, maintenance restriction

Title: Approver Notes not Visible to the Shopping Cart Approvers
Content: Symptom-You have added a notes in the shopping cart document however these notes are not visible to the shopping cart approver. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self- Services - Self-Services Overview -Select Go Shopping -Add the relevant details along with Notes-Now approver cannot see the Notes entered by the requester-Cause-In shopping cart document, following note types are available:-Internal Comment-Remark for Supplier-These notes are not relevant for approver and hence they will not reflect in the approval task of the shopping cart.-Resolution-As a work around, you can add the Notes to approver in the Attachment section of shopping cart. When approver opens the shopping cart, they can see the attachment section at the bottom of the approval screen and they can open the relevant Note attached. -Keywords-Approver Notes not Visible to the Shopping Cart Approvers; Notes to Approvers; Notes to shopping cart approvers

Title: Schedule Lines of ShipToLocation in XML File are in Different Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and you copied it. You only changed the content of Street/House No. line for Delivery Address on item level of the new purchase order.-You are using only Japanese environment when doing the creation and changes for both of the purchase orders.-However, in the XML files of the two purchase orders, the PostalRegulationCompliantAddressLines in ShipToLocation are in different order.-And the way they show City are different as well. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Create a purchase order from Purchase Requests and Orders work center;-Fill in all mandatory fields, and click Order to get PO A;-Copy this purchase order. Before order it, navigate to Delivery tab on item level;-Remove the value in Street/House No. field and input new address in English.-Click Order to get PO B.-Open the XML files for the two purchase orders;-You can see the FormattedAddressDescription is in different format.-Cause-This is a normal system behavior. System will analyze the language when inputting address. If you use English to input Street/House No., system will show the English format and reflect it in XML file, although it cannot be seen from frontend screen.-Resolution-If you would like the two purchase orders have the same address format in XML files, it is necessary to use the same language.-Keywords-XML; XML File; Purchase Order; Delivery Address; Format; Japanese; English

Title: Cost Estimate Price Component Not Available For Material In Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want to use the Cost Estimate price component in profit analysis reports for materials, such as the Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme report. You have maintained the respective settings in scoping to calculate profit margins for sales order items. In Fine Tuning the Cost Estimate price component has been included in the Profit Margin.-You expect that the Estimated Costs maintained for material in its valuation master data are to be derived as the Cost Estimate amount for your sales order item. However, in the Sales Order Pricing tab the Cost Estimate price component is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Pre-Requisites:-A) Scoping settings:-In scoping under step 4 - Questions, find the General Business Data element.  -Open Product and Service Pricing and then select the Sales Price Specification element.-Ensure that the question: Do you calculate profit margins for service or sales orders and make them visible to your sales employees? has been added to the solution (selection box is marked).-B) Fine Tuning settings:-In the Activity List of your implementation project navigate to the Fine Tune phase.-Open the Configure Price Strategy activity (if your system is already live, you can access/edit this activity from the Overview view via the Change Immediately button).-Click the Configure Pricing Procedure link.-The Cost Estimate price component is listed for the used Pricing Procedure.- Sales Order settings:-In the sales order you maintained material in the Items tab.-For this material an Estimated Cost has been maintained in the material's valuation master data.-Navigate to the Pricing (and Invoicing) tab of the sales order.-In the Item Pricing table you are checking all the price components available for your material item.-You notice the Cost price component.-However, the Cost Estimate price component is missing and not available to be added neither.-Cause-The Cost Estimate price component is only relevant for project based sales order items.-In sales orders the Cost Estimate price component is available for items of type:-Service - time and material (Project),-Service - fixed price (project),-Product - project-based,-Expense - time and material (project),-Expense - fixed price (project).-The Cost Estimate price component derives its values only from the manually maintained amounts entered for the respective sales order item in the sales order Pricing tab. The values are never derived from the Estimated Cost value entered in a material's Valuation master data. It is used for the profit analysis of Customer Projects with Sales Integration.-This price component is also relevant in the Revenue Recognition functionality, for the calculation of the Percentage of Completion (POC) of a sales order items (only fixed price items) with the accrual method Recognize Using Cost-to-Cost POC or Recognize Using Cost-to-Cost Project POC.-For all other sales order item types the Cost price component is used to calculate the planned costs of a sales process. In this case the amount is derived as an average cost value of all business residences, maintained in a materials valuation master data.-Resolution-In order to display and use the Cost Estimate price component for a sales order item select a project-based item type.-See Also-2192315 - Cost Estimate in Sales Orders For Project Based Service Items-1961701 - Cost Estimate Price Component Missing in Sale Order-1856482 - Cost Estimate Price Component questions-Keywords-cost estimate, price component, missing, sales order, profit margin, project, item type, service, product, project-based, expense, material, not appearing, not displayed, not available, pricing and invoicing tab

Title: Certificate verification failed. Missing DNAME
Content: Symptom-Error message "Certificate verification failed. Missing DNAME:" while importing certificate.-Environment-SAP Netweaver-Cause-Certificate chain is not complete.-Resolution-The SSF function tells which certificate is missing in the uploaded PKCS#12 container,-The system must trust the certificate authority (CA), and the key pair for the certificate must have the entire chain uploaded, the SSF function tells which certificate is missing in the uploaded PKCS#12 container.-Certificates issued by third party must be checked with who supplied this PKCS#12 file to provide the container with the complete chain, not leaving the root certificate.

Title: Unable To Resize An Extension Field Text Box
Content: Symptom-The Extension Field with the field type Extended Text cannot be resized directly, the text field size appears fixed and cannot be manually adjusted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below is an example, this applies to all extension fields of type Extended Text in any screen.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open an existing sales order or create a new one.-Navigate to the General tab.-Select the User icon and choose Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.-Either:-Create a new extension field with the field type Extended Text, or-Select an existing extension field whose field type is Extended Text.-Observe that the text field cannot be resized manually.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior.-Resolution-To increase the size of an extension field with field type "Extended Text":-Start the Adaptation Mode.-Right-click either at the Extension Field on the UI or at the corresponding UI Element in the Adaptation Panel.-In the dialog that opens, the size is configured as "Input field with only 1 row" by default.-Change the Number of Rows as required (available from 1 to 10 rows).-Save and publish the adaptation.-The Extension field will then be displayed with the configured number of rows.-Keywords-Extension Field, Adaptation Mode, Resize, Extended Text, Number of Rows, Input field with only 1 row

Title: Missing values for Budget Category in Purchase Order per Account Assignment Report
Content: Symptom-You have maintained a value against the field "Budget Category" in a Purchase Order.-However, in the Purchase Order per Account Assignment Report, the value "Not assigned" appears under field "Budget Category". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Request and Orders work center. -Go to Lists view. -Search for Report Purchase Order per Account Assignment. -Open the Report. -In the View menu on the left hand-side, select row fields; Purchase Order ID and Budget Category. -Now navigate to the Selection menu on left hand-side, and enter the Purchase Order ID in the Purchase Order ID field.  -Execute the Report. ->> Notice that under Budget Category field that the value for Purchase Order ID is "Not assigned" although in the Purchase Order Document itself there is a budget category with a value maintained. -Please note: in order to see this field, please make field visible in Personalization mode. -Cause-This is a technical limitation of the system.-Resolution-Should you need any new enhancement added to the software, feel free to directly submit your request for this feature to the correct decision makers at SAP via Customer Influence.-The Customer Influence site, https://influence.sap.com, allows customers to log Improvement Requests themselves and have the ability to work directly with our technology and development group.-Thank you for your understanding.-Keywords-Purchase Order per Account Assignment, Report, Budget Category, Not assigned.

Title: The Preview Of Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China Does Not Reflect The Changes Made In Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the financial reporting structure in the business configuration, but the change is not applied in the Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First check the business configuration of the report:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Search for activity: financial reporting structures for cost center management accounting reports.-Click on the P&L statement AAA.-Can see in subtotal print option for operating profit and non-operating net profit is: 1 - subtotal below - no header.-Then check the Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Statutory Reports view.-Click on Balance Sheet and Inc. Statement - China.-Click preview, you can see the preview result is: 1 operating profit and 2 non-operating net profit, and the customer's expected result is operating profit and non-operating net profit without header.-Cause-The company belongs to Taiwan. Title: Ship-To Address Does Not Update Service Location Address as Expected After a Change
Content: Symptom-You change the Ship-To Address in Service Order or a Service Quote via Involved Parties tab, however, the change does not update the Service Location Address as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue occurs in both Service Quote and Service Order. We will use a Service Order as an example:-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Go to the Service Order Processing view.-Search for ABC (ABC represents the Service Order ID).-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab.-Update the address of Ship-To party.-In the General tab, the Service Location Address does not update accordingly.-Cause-The cause could be one of the following:-The automatic update of Service Location Address does not happen because a manual change on the Service Location Address was done before.-You created the Service Order or Service Quote as a copy which already had an item maintained in the Service and Spare Parts tab.-If you create a new Service Order or Service Quote and this is inconsistent initially, you can change the account and this will update the Ship-To and the Service Location will be changed. This is as long as you do NOT save the document.-If the document is Saved, and closed, then the session is lost for that document. This means that when you open the document and try to change the account we do not update the value.-This also applies if you have copied the document and the original document has an Item is maintained in the Service and Spare Parts tab.-Additionally, if you modify the service location in the involved parties, then this will not change automatically.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-However, is a possible workaround for this case:-You can make a dummy change in the Location of Service Provision, like change from On-Site to Supplier, then back to On-Site-The address will update as expected.-Please note that once an Item is maintained in the Service and Spare Parts tab you cannot change the Location of Service Provision anymore. In this case you would have to remove the items in the Service and Spare Parts tab first and then perform the dummy change.-See Also-KBA 3325165 - How to Change the Address Details for The Location of Service Provision of Service Location On-Site-Keywords-Ship-To, Service Location, Address, Service Order; Service Quote

Title: Name Format is not displayed as expected in purchase order lists
Content: Symptom-You find the name format for 'Buyer Responsible' field is not displayed as expected in purchase order lists.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Check the 'Buyer Responsible' field in the lists.-You find the name format is not display as what you have maintained in Business Configuration Activity: General Business Partners.-Cause-You have changed the name format for certain country in Business Configuration Activity: General Business Partners, e.g. from position  <First Name Last Name> to <Last Name First Name>.-The display on purchase order OWL view will only change for the orders created after the change of name format.-This also applies for sales order OWL view.-Resolution-This is the current behavior.-If you open the order, name format of the 'Buyer Responsible' field will always display as per your current setting in Business Configuration Activity.-See Also-2833823 - Report Shows Employee's First and Last Name in Wrong Order-Keywords-Name Format, Purchase Order, Business Configuration, General Business Partners, 姓名格式

Title: Goods Return not Available in the Query All Returns to be Invoiced
Content: Symptom-You have created a Goods Return document however it is not visible in the invoice entry view of supplier invoicing work center. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Entry view-Select the query - All Returns to be Invoiced-Search for the relevant Goods Return document -No records found-Cause-The Goods Return document is available in the invoice entry view for credit memo creation. Title: How System Selects Cost During Material Cost Estimate if Purchase List Price is Used as Valuation Method for Materials.
Content: Symptom-During material cost estimate of a product, one of its input product uses purchase list prices as valuation method. However, now there are multiple list prices for this product with same company but different suppliers. Which price will system select for material cost estimate?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Inventory Valuation.-Access view Material Cost Estimates.-Click New - Cost Estimate, maintain mandatory fields and click Estimate.-Return to view Material Cost Estimates, select corresponding line item, click View.-In the section Material Items, material ABC has Valuation Method as Purchase List Prices.-Go to work center Product Portfolio.-Access view List Prices.-Search material ABC, there are multiple list prices for same company but different suppliers.-You want to know the logic how system selects the price from them for Material Cost Estimate as cost.-Resolution-If all these list prices have no scales maintained, system will always select the lowest price from them as cost in Material Cost Estimate.-Example: List Price 1 with price 1 CNY, List Price 2 with price 5 CNY,  List Price 3 with price 10 CNY. System will select 1 CNY as cost in Material Cost Estimate.-If some list prices have scales maintained, then during Material Cost Estimate, system will check the prices in corresponding scales according to the valuation quantity set of material ABC in Material Cost Estimate, and also other prices without scales, finally select the lowest price as the cost.-Example: List Price 1 has scale as from 0 price is 10 CNY, from 5 price is 8 CNY, from 10 price is 5 CNY. List Price 2 has no scale but only price 7 CNY; List Price 3 has scale as from 0 price is 20 CNY, from 6 price is 5 CNY. In Material Cost Estimate, material ABC has valuation quantity as 8, then system will firstly find price 8 CNY in List Price 1, 7 CNY in List Price 2 and 5 CNY in List Price 3, finally select 5 CNY as cost.-Above logic applies to ByD system with version 2311 or versions after that.-See Also-Help Document "Material Cost Estimates"-Keywords-List Price, Material Cost Estimate, Scales

Title: Pro Forma Invoice Split
Content: Symptom-You have noticed that when creating a Pro Forma Invoice from a Sales Order document, the system is splitting the Pro Forma Invoice into two different documents. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for document ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Select the document.-Click Pro Forma Invoice button.-System splits the Pro Forma into two documents in the new pop-up screen. -Cause-The reason the system is splitting the Pro Forma Invoice is because the Tax Country is different for some of the items. -As Tax Country is a splitting criteria, the system will create two documents. -Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -In order to avoid this behavior, please make sure that all of the line items have the same Tax Country under the Sales Order document.-See Also-1500875 - Split Criteria in Customer Invoicing-2422652 - Pro-Forma Invoice Split based on an Outbound Delivery-3056439 - Inconsistent Determination of Pro Forma Invoice Templates in a Split Scenario-Keywords-Pro Forma, Invoice, Sales Order, Split, Tax Country, Country, Different, Ship-from, Location

Title: Error:"The action CANCEL is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident" While Cancelling Inbound Delivery Notification
Content: Symptom-The following error message appears when cancelling the Inbound Delivery Notification:-  Error:---> The action CANCEL is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.--->Error while creating or updating follow-up document.--->Cancel not possible; invoicing document has already been canceled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification: ABC. (ABC represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID)-Choose Action and Select Cancel Warehouse Request.-System throws the below errors,---> The action CANCEL is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again. If the problem persists, report an incident.--->Error while creating or updating follow-up document.--->Cancel not possible; invoicing document has already been canceled.-Cause-The Error occurs because the Release Status of the Inbound Delivery Notification is not updated to "Not Released".-Due to an inconsistency the Inbound Delivery Notification remains in the "Released" status despite all the successor documents being cancelled.-Resolution-Perform "Refresh Release Status" to update the Release Status of the Inbound Delivery Notification.-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for the Inbound Delivery Notification: ABC. (ABC represents the Inbound Delivery Notification ID)-Choose Edit.-Choose Actions and Select "Refresh Release Status".-The Inbound Delivery Notification Release status updated to "Not Released".-Keywords-Refresh Release Status; Actions; Inbound Delivery Notification; The Action CANCEL is Not Possible. Refresh The Screen And Try Again. If The Problem Persists; Report an Incident; Cancel not possible; Inbound Delivery Canceled; Error While Creating or Updating Follow-Up Document; Cancel Warehouse Request
