Title: Service Orders Created from Web Service are Not Released
Content: Symptom-You execute a request payload to create service orders via web service, you find the service orders created are In Preparation status instead of In Process status even you have passed the <ReleaseToExecuteActionIndicator> as true.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the request XML, system generates the service order but with In Preparation status.-In the response, you can see note  "Action Release not possible; action is disabled" .-Cause-This occurs because the release action is evaluated before the price and tax data from the payload is applied. The system looks for a price list in the system and then disallows the release action when it doesn't find one. The price data from the payload is then applied and so the service order is consistent when it is created in the system, but the release action was already disallowed.-Resolution-As a workaround, if you maintain a price list for the products, the release action is enabled and the Service Order is created in the status "In Process". -Keywords-service order; web service; ManageServiceOrderIn; Not Released; "Action Release not possible; action is disabled".

Title: The value of extension field is not passed from purchase request item to purchase order item
Content: Symptom-You find the value of extension field is not passed from purchase request item to purchase order item as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Filter the list 'All Documents'.-Search and open the affected purchase order.-Check the value of affected extension field, you find it is empty.-However there is value in the preceding purchase request of the given order.-Cause-You have activated the extension scenario: Purchase Contract - Item to Purchase Order - Item for this extension field, however there is no value in the preceding purchase contract.-or-You have activated the extension scenarios like: Material General Information to Purchase Order- Item or Material General Information to Purchase Request - Item, however there is no value in the selected material master data.-Resolution-Please remove these extension scenarios, then check the newly created purchase orders.-See Also-2951892 - The value of extension field doesn't update from material master data to purchase order as expected-Keywords-Extension field, Value not passed, Purchase order item, 字段，采购订单

Title: Web Service Message Monitor does not Synchronize Automatically
Content: Symptom-You are working on the Web Service Message Monitor, and notice that the system is not synchronizing as expected. The "Synced At" time displays a past date and time.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Web Service Message Monitor view.-The description text on the top of the screen contains the last date and time the synchronization was performed.-Here you see that the date and time are from a past timeframe.-Cause-The synchronization in the Web Service Message Monitor happens automatically every 15 minutes. However this automatic synchronization may fail in case there are too many messages in error which need to be processed.-This threshold can vary depending on the service interface and the task/document that needs to be processed.-Resolution-In order to resume the automatic synchronization, please check the Erroneous messages and process the same in order to reduce the amount of pending messages.-Keywords-WSM, Webservice, Inbound, Outbound

Title: Updated Data is not Displayed in Output Form Preview
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Form template preview is not showing the update data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example: User has update new company name in form template but old company name is displayed in output PDF.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search for the purchase order status -Click on Edit-Navigate to Output history-Click and open Form-User can see old company name is displayed in output PDF.-Cause-User might be using custom Form Template-Resolution-If user is using Custom form template please ask your form designer to make the needed changes in your form template as SAP Product Support do not make changes on custom forms.-If Issue is in SAP standard Form template then customer can raise incident to SAP Product Support.-Keywords-Custom form template ,old data is displayed in output PDF, Form Designer

Title: Error While Accessing the First Implementation Project
Content: Symptom-As an Initial User, your requirement is to configure the system, but you are unable to access the First Implementation project due to the error:-Project First Implementation Locked by User SAP_INITUSER-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the First Implementation project-Select Edit Project Scope or Open Activity List button-System throws error-Cause-You may have accessed the First Implementation project in another session due to which the project appears locked.-Resolution-The issue may be temporary where the user locks would be removed automatically from the system within 60 minutes.-You may close the sessions and access the First Implementation project.-See Also-Keywords-Project First Implementation Locked by User SAP_INITUSER

Title: How to find all BOMs with input product quantity zero.
Content: Symptom-How to Retrieve the BOM ID and Input Quantity for the corresponding Input Product ABC from the "Production Bills of Material Variant and Line Item Details" Data Source. -(ABC represents the input Product)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Below are the steps to find all input quantities of the input products for the corresponding BOMs.-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Design Data Sources view.-Search for Data source Production Bills of Material Variant and Line Item Details.-Choose Preview.-In the Selection section, Enter the Input Product in the Input Product field.-Choose Apply.-All input products along with their input quantities for the corresponding BOMs are displayed in the report.-Keywords-BOM; Bill of Material; Input Product; Input Quantity; Production Bills of Material; Business Analytics; Design Reports; BOM ID; Product ID; SAP Business Bydesign; Production Bills of Material Variant and Line Item Details; Data Source

Title: Certain font characters do not appear in a form template preview
Content: Symptom-You have a form template with certain characters in a language other than English. The foreign language characters do not appear in the preview (in e.g. Chrome or Edge) but appear when you download the template and open in Adobe Reader.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Preview a form template with certain characters in language other than English (Open in IE , Chrome or Edge).-You do not see the characters.-Download the form template and open in Adobe Reader. The characters are visible.-Cause-This behavior is caused by browser-specific rendering limitations.-The form preview displayed in the browser depends on the browser’s PDF rendering and the fonts available in the local environment. Some browsers may not fully support embedded fonts or specific Unicode characters used in certain languages.-Adobe Reader uses its own PDF rendering engine with broader font and character support. Therefore, the same form template displays the foreign language characters correctly when opened in Adobe Reader.-Resolution-This behavior is expected and is related to the browser rendering capability, not to the form template generation in the system. Please check the browser settings.-Keywords-form template, preview, Enable JavaScript, font, characters, missing characters-form template,preview,font,characters,missing characters,enable javascript

Title: Unable to Modify the Text Shown in the Approval Task of Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You want to adjust or modify the description reasons in the supplier invoice approval task. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Task Management view-Select the relevant Approval task for Supplier Invoice-Click on Task icon-Under the description tab, you can see the below comments-The system creates this task because at least one of the following is true:-The total gross value of the document exceeds the approval limit defined in configuration.-The document contains items without reference to a purchase order or a purchasing contract.-The employee who edited the document has also accepted an exception; to avoid a conflict of interest, a second person has to approve the document.-Cause-The texts are automatically generated based on the business task for supplier invoice and it is not possible to modify or adjust the content.-Resolution-System is working as expected.  Its not possible to adjust the text created by the business task management. You can respond to this task and choose one of the following courses of action: Click on Approve, Reject and Send back for Revision.-Keywords-Unable to Modify the Text Shown in the Approval Task of Supplier Invoice; Text on approval supplier invoice

Title: How to Get Product Recipient Party Address Snapshot From the Customer Invoice Item via OData
Content: Symptom-You would like to fetch the product recipient party address snapshot from the customer invoice item level via OData. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-To fetch the product recipient party address snapshot at Item level, you need to use the CustomerInvoiceItemCollection('ABCD')/AddressSnapshotPostalAddressItemDelivery in the Service URL query . (ABCD represents the Invoice BO ID)-Resolution-The Service Query looks like https://myXXXX.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/PQRS/CustomerInvoiceItemCollection('ABCD')/AddressSnapshotPostalAddressItemDelivery (XXXX represents tenant URL and PQRS represents Service Name)

Title: Template BO is not active or does not exist
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Activation of a first time patch fails with errors detailing a template BO is not active or does not exist.-SDIM errors:-Failed to activate items of type BusinessObjectExtension.-Template BO YXXXXXXXY_XXXXXXXXXXXX not active or does not exist.-Create request failed.-Expected create notification not found.-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have created a first time patch with two XBO's created from the same Template BO.-Activation fails of the patch with errors in SDIM detailing that a particular template BO is not active or does not exist.-The file in question is present in XREP and active.-It is inactive in the SDK.-It is not present in MDRS.-**This issue can also occur during when deploying this solution to a new tenant.-Some example pairs are:-CustomerContract-CustomerContractTemplate-Project-ProjectTemplate-Cause-Errors such as this generally occur when the customer creates XBOs on a particular pair of standard BOs sharing the same Template BO and one of the standard BOs names ends in "Template", and the XBO of the standard BO whose name does not end in "Template" is picked up first for activation.-In such a scenario, during mass activation, there is a naming conflict which leads to an issue during activation of these entities in the MDRS framework.-Some example pairs are:-CustomerContract-CustomerContractTemplate-Project-ProjectTemplate-Resolution-In order to resolve such issues, during activation, a breakpoint will have to be placed on line 26 of the method CL_PDI_BBC_MAINTAIN=>IF_PDI_LM_APPS_CONTENT~ACTIVATE.-Once the breakpoint is hit, via the debugger, the order of these XBOs will have to be changed in the table LT_XREP_BO_PATH, so that the XBO of the standard BO whose name ends in Template is first.-Please dispatch this to AP-RC-BDS-EXT development component with permissions from the customer.-To allow the activation of both the XBOs created on the same template BO, the order of their activation needs to be changed.-The inactive file is first activated in the backend.-Following this the whole solution is activated during which development teams manually skip activation of the file already activated previously.-It should be noted that this issue only occurs during the creation of the first patch of the solution in a tenant, or during the deployment of the solution to a new tenant. Once the backend artifacts have been generated correctly, subsequent patch creations via the SDK should take place smoothly.-See Also-Keywords-Template BO, Activation Fail, Patch, Activation, PDI, SDK

Title: System Shows Incorrect Cost Rate Unit Working day(s) Instead of Hours
Content: Symptom-System shows incorrect cost rate unit and hence the cost rate for an employee shows the incorrect value. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project ID-Select the relevant Project Task-Go to Work tab-For team member, you can see that cost rate appears in Working day(s) instead of hours-Cause-In the business configuration activity project types, you have defined the Default Unit as Working day(s) and hence system shows the cost rate unit in Working day(s). -Resolution-You can follow the below steps to fix the problem. -Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects-Go to Fine Tune activity-Select the activity Project Types-Here you can see that the default unit is set as Working day(s) -You can change the default unit from Working day(s) to Hour(s)-Keywords-Incorrect Cost Rate Unit Working day(s) Instead of Hours; Unit Working day(s) Instead of Hours; Project unit Working day(s) Instead of Hours;

Title: Access Rights Of The Business User Has Been Deleted By Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM) Automatically
Content: Symptom-Workcenter assignment for the Business User: ABC has been deleted by Technical User 'SAP_SYSTEM'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Administrator workcenter-2. Select Business User view-3. Search for the Business User: ABC and select Edit Access Rights-4. Navigate to Changes Tab-Now, you can find the access rights are deleted by Technical User SAP_SYSTEM in the change log.-Cause-The user authorizations had to be updated manually in Workcenter Administrator -> Business Users -> Action: “Update Access Rights”. Therefore an automated update of the user's access rights has been introduced via backend batch job.-The job is running hourly which is implemented by the following BO types:-    •    Organizational Unit-    •    Business Partner Relationships-    •    Territory-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. The background jobs are executed by the technical user SAP_SYSTEM, modifications to the following assignment results in the deletion of the workcenter. The employee’s authorizations are adapted automatically in case of any relevant change for the below objects, for example:. This includes adding, removing the access to workcenters. As backend jobs run with technical users, these are listed as trigger for such changes. -Employee org assignment changes or is finished,-Account team assignment has changed,-Territory team assignment has changed,-etc.-Keywords-Access Rights, SAP_SYSTEM, Technical User(SAP_SYSTEM), Changes, User Changes, User Access Rights, Business User

Title: 500 SAP Internal Server Error while clicking on GR/IR run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-500 SAP Internal Server Error while clicking on GR/IR run-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Management workcenter-GR/IR Clearing run-Select the run DEF(DEF run refers to the run id)-View all-In the list of logs, click - view-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab-Further to the Advanced information tab-In the export - to microsoft excel-The system displays with the 500 SAP Internal Server Error-Cause-This message may occur when the amount of data handled during the query is too high and may exceed the limit transactional data. -Resolution-This can be solved in following ways.-The best approach will be reducing the total records retrieved in your query, such number of characteristics included in $select or add selections by using $filter. Further you can adjust your query like this:-Increase the parameter $inlinecount=allpages& in the query before the $skip parameter. This parameter is useful for queries which handle high amounts of data.-Not assigned and null values has to be passed as filter condition in the format ‘” “’.-Once you done these it will be under data limit and it will export the data to the excel.

Title: Missing Invoice Status Character in the Purchase Order Item Details Data Source
Content: Symptom-You need an Invoicing Status key figure in the data source Purchase Order Item Details -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order which contains Invoicing status as Manually Finished-Now go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Purchase Order Item Details data source-Here you do not see the Invoicing Status key figure-Cause-Currently there are no reports or data source which shows Invoicing Status key figure. The purpose is to track and display the Manually Finished Invoiced orders. -Resolution-In standard, system do not show the manually finished invoice status in the purchase orders item level data source. In case, if users need this separately, you can approach partner development team and ask them for field extension via custom add on or check with partner to get custom report to show the manually finished orders.-Keywords-Invoice Status Character in the Purchase Order Item Details Data Source;

Title: Legend Icon not Appearing in Changed Purchase Order Form
Content: Symptom-Legend icon or logo not appearing for newly added item in changed purchase order after approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order document and click Edit-Select Output History tab and select the Changed Purchase Order template-Open the Purchase Order PDF file, no New Item legend icon appears for the newly added line item-Cause-While adding the new line item, if the Purchase Order goes for re-approval, the system cannot compare the current image of Purchase Order (with newly added line item) with the previous image of the Purchase Order (without newly added line item). This is a technical system limitation and hence no legend icon for New Item appears against the newly added line added. This case is only if the Purchase Order goes for re-approval after addition of the new line item.-Note:-Case 1: When there is no approval scoped in the system.-A) For 'New item', it won't work in preview mode, but it works in real output under output history.-B) For 'Changed item', it won't work in preview mode, but it works in real output under output history.-C) For 'Deleted item', it works always.-In case of preview, if you directly open the preview after changes done, the symbol will be displaying;-If you change the item then save/send update, then preview, the symbol will not displaying.-Case 2: Once there is approval involved, system will always do the comparison to judge whether the approval is needed and whether there are changes.--1. If approval is scoped and needed-A) if it is triggered by header re-approval, the symbols show before approval (in preview mode), but after the approval, they will disappear.-B) if it is triggered by item approval, the symbols will work as case 1 .--2. If approval is scoped but no approval needed, the case is the same as case 1.-Resolution-Currently, it is not possible to determine the newly added item and the original item once the purchase order is approved during the reapproval scenario. While the purchase order is still in approval, it is technically possible to distinguish between the newly added line and the other lines, but when the purchase order approval is approved, it is technically not possible to differentiate between them, which is the current technical restriction of the system.-If you really need to distinguish new and other lines on the form for purchase orders with an approval process, you can try to do a secondary development of this with help of partner development.-See Also-3243538 - Action code is empty for the newly added line item in Out put XML of Purchase order-Keywords-Legend Icon not Appearing in Changed Purchase Order Form; Logo not appearing in PO form, PO form

Title: Balance Summary Report Shows Negative Value For Material AAA
Content: Symptom-You observe material: AAA shows negative value in the balance summary report, you want to know why and how to correct it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Report view and click on report: balance summary report.-Enter required information such as company, set of books, and material ID: AAA.-You can see the value is negative.-Cause-You can navigate to the line-item G/L account report of the material: AAA to check the journal entries of the material: AAA. This could explain why it shows a negative value.-If you hope to adjust the value, you may follow the instruction on help doc:<Manual Entries for Materials>.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-negative material value, balance summary report

Title: GST Rate Change for Singapore Country
Content: Symptom-You try to create a new supplier invoice in January month however, system considers new changed tax rate as opposed to old one. This is allowed as per Singapore laws where an invoice created in new year can still carry previous year tax rate.-As per Singapore law, post 2023 Jan GST rate is increased to 8% from 7%. This may again gets updated in coming years and customers are legally allowed to post an invoice on 2023 using the old rate if the work was performed before 2023.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Supplier Invoicing work center-New Supplier Invoice-Enter necessary data and in Items tab, under taxes section for the selected tax code, new tax rate is reflected-Cause-As per the system design, when the new invoice is created, the tax date is selected in the current year. So the tax rate is directly picked based on the tax date and hence new rate will be picked.-Resolution-Eventhough new tax rate is updated in system, you can still create invoice with old rate just by changing tax date to previous year. By this method, two different invoices in same year can have multiple tax rates depending on the tax date.-p.s. Same solution can be applied to any other country's new tax rate change scenario-Keywords-Tax rate, Tax code, Supplier Invoice

Title: Error Message 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider'
Content: Symptom-The error message 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider' occurs when you try to upload the Metadata for the new Identity Provider(IDP).-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-For SAP Business ByDesign-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Navigate to the Common Tasks view-Go to the Configure Single Sign-On sub-view-Go to the Identity Provider tab-Choose New Identity Provider-Select the Metadata you wish to upload-Error occurs: 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider'- SAP Cloud for Customer-Go to the Administrater work center-Navigate  to the Common Tasks view-Go to the Configure Single Sign-On sub-view-Go to the Identity Provider tab-Choose New Identity Provider-Select the Metadata you wish to upload-Error occurs: 'Metadata does not contain Identity Provider'-Cause-You will see above error message when you are trying to upload the metadata file of the Service provider. -Resolution-You need to upload the metadata file of the Identity Provider(IDP) not the service provider, you can request your Identity Provider(IDP) partner to provide their metadata file.-Keywords-Identity Provider, IDP, Metadata does not contain Identity Provider, Service Provider, Metadata

Title: Inventory Cost Not Updated After Third-Party Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You create sales order item XYZ-XX with external fulfilment of material ABC (XYZ-XX represents the sales order item ID; ABC represents the material ID). -After the sales order is released, a third-party purchase order is triggered. -You create a third-party inbound delivery notification which triggers the outbound goods issue to the customer. -You expect the delivery to update the material's inventory cost as it is valuated with the Moving Average perpetual cost method. -When checking the Inventory Cost history you can find no entry to update the material's inventory cost. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the involved sales relevant business transactions: -In the Cost and Revenue workcenter go to the Sales Document Items  view. -Find sales order item XYZ-XX.-Press Reports and choose Sales Documents - Line Items.-You can see that the delivery is correctly posted. -To check the Inventory Cost history: -Go to the Inventory Valuation  work center and here to the Materials view. -Search for material ABC. -Press View Cost History.-Go to the respective accounting period. -You cannot find an entry on the delivery posting date to update the material's inventory cost. --Cause-Third-party goods and activity confirmations do not have any impact on the inventory ledger. They are posted as cost of goods sold into the Sales ledger. -As a result, they do not affect the inventory cost of the delivered material.--Resolution--The system is working as designed. Third-party deliveries are not supposed to impact the inventory ledger or the inventory cost of the delivered material.--See Also---Goods Receipt from Supplier Posting Does Not Update Inventory Cost of Material-Keywords--third-party inbound delivery, material moving average, inventory cost, SAP Business ByDesign, Inventory ledger, Inventory cost

Title: Open Task "Check Expired Purchasing Contract" but Contract is Not Expired
Content: Symptom-There is an open task "Check Expired Purchasing Contract", but the purchasing contract is not expired.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center.-Open Contracts view.-There is an open task: Check Expired Purchasing Contract.-Open this contract, the Expiry Status is Not Expired.-Navigate to Items tab, the Item Expiry Status is Expired.-Navigate to Changes tab, there is a record: Changed by Technical User (SAP_SYSTEM); Item Expiry Status changed from Not Expired to Expired.-Cause-System runs a job every day to check whether a contract is expired on both contract level and item level. Except Valid From/To, system also checks:-Whether target value on both contract level and item level are exceeded.-Whether target quantity on both contract level and item level are exceeded.-The system considers the parameters on contract level and item level separately. Specifically, if quantity/net value in related purchase order exceed Target Quantity/Value on item level but not on contract level, system would only set the item to Expired, but the contract itself is still Not Expired.-For example, there is a contract, in which Target Value for the whole contract is 100,000.00 USD, and on item level it is 5,000.00 USD.-In the purchase order created according to this contract, Net Value of the item is 6,500.00 USD. Then this contract remains Not Expired, but the item would be Expired.-Resolution-If the item is expired because of the target value/quantity, user can reactivate it by adjusting target value/quantity on item level so that it will not be exceeded by purchase order(s).-After adjusting the number and saving the change, system would set the item to Not Expired during the everyday run. It's better to make adjustment at an early time during a day and check the contract next day.-See Also-2300994 - Purchasing Contract Status set to Expired -Keywords-Purchasing Contract; Contract; Expired; Item; Total Value; Total Quantity

Title: Error Message : UUID of General Ledger Report YY xxxx is missing. Please create an incident
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -User gets below error message while performing Lifecycle Analysis Runs-Create Lifecycle Items-DD.MM.YYYY MM:SS UTC-UUID of General Ledger Report YY XXXXX is missing. Please create an incident.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Information Lifecycle Management Work Center-Navigate to Lifecycle Analysis Runs Work Center View-Select any Report-Open the Application Log-Navigate to the Results Tab you see below mentioned errors:-       Create Lifecycle Items-       DD.MM.YYYY MM:SS UTC-       UUID of General Ledger Report YY XXXXX is missing. Please create an incident.-   Cause-When there is an inconsistency in the document you will get above error message while performing Lifecycle Analysis runs.-Resolution-As per the design of the system, ByD has a data redundancy layer called FSI which is used in many situations to display the data in the screen. As this redundancy layer works similar to a cache, it is maintained in sync with the database to ensure that the correct data is brought to the user.-However, in some exceptional situations this sync may not be up-to-date, so it requires an FSI reload.-This procedure forces the synchronization between the database and the redundancy layer. However it temporary locks this FSI, which directly impacts in system performance and stability in certain areas during the reload period. So in order to ensure minimal impact in the system usage, we need to perform such procedure in timeframe of low traffic.-AP-RC-ILM Development team will perform FSI reload.-**Please Do Not Copy & Paste the Content directly from the KBA**-Keywords-ILM, UUID of General Ledger Report TB XXXXX is missing. Please create an incident,  Create Lifecycle Items.

Title: Odata Service is Not Showing Correct LifeCycle Status Code
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-You observe that the Employee who is terminated has Life Cycle Status Code '2' which means active.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Backend,-1. Open BO Employee in SESFTS -2. Query -> Load by Alternative key -> Identification -> Employee ID - enter 'XXXX-3. Navigate to Root-4. Check Value of 'STATUS-LIFE_CYCLE_STATUS_CODE'  -Result STATUS-LIFE_CYCLE_STATUS_CODE is 2. (Active)-Cause-The purpose of the Lifecycle status code is to indicate the data lifecycle of a specific record, not the status of an employee, such as active or terminated.-Resolution-The employee type start date and employee type termination date should be taken into consideration while getting the records in order to differentiate between active and terminated employees.-Keywords-ODATA, Lifecycle status code, active, terminated.

Title: Dump occurs when trying to preview a custom form
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***  -Dump occurs when trying to click at preview button on the UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the custom work center view. -Select the document.-Click on preview button.-A dump occurs.-Cause-You can find the below on application information from the dump in ST22:-CX_SY_NO_HANDLER, Program:/DOC/CL_OM_ESI_OUTPUT_REQUEST=CP, Include:/DOC/CL_OM_ESI_OUTPUT_RE-Info: An exception with the type CX_SY_CREATE_DATA_ERROR occurred, but was neither handled l-CX_SY_CREATE_DATA_ERROR, Program:/DOC/CL_OM_ESI_OUTPUT_REQUEST=CP, Include:/DOC/CL_OM_ESI_OU-Info: Could not create data object; type YABC41Y0T_INRM57B483C21CA8B14F does not exist-Resolution-To solve the issue you need to activate the respective custom form .ftgd path on SE38 > PDI_BC_LM_EXECUTE_OLD_SUPP.-The content type should be FORMS.-Keywords-PDI, Custom, Form, Preview, PDF, SDK

Title: Processor and Service and Support Team not Automatically Determined when Creating Service Requests
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When creating a Service Request, the Processor and Service and Support Team are not determined at first attempt.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Desk work center-Under Common Tasks view, select New Service Request-Add account XYZ (Where XYZ represents the account ID)-No Processor and Service and Support Team are automatically determined-Now change the account to ABC (Where ABC represents the account ID)-Processor and Service and Support Team are determined-       Please note that the issue was might not be fully reproducible on SAP side.-Cause-For the party role Processor, the system will try to check if the account has the master data set-up correctly. In the account, there is a responsibility role for employees which can be checked as per below steps:-  Open Account XYZ and go to Contacts tab-Under Responsibilities sub-tab, notice that Processor - Service Requests party role is not currently maintained.-  If the party role Processor - Service Requests is maintained, the system will then determine the Processor - Service Requests party role automatically.-If this was determined first time, then the Service and Support Team is next as a dependent. In the second time you add an account and it works, as the previous process was not able to locate a responsible, it has a "waiting determination" for a fall back as the current user.-Resolution-Ensure that Account master data is correctly set-up and a rule is also maintained under Organizational Work Distribution and Employee Work Distribution for Business Area: Service and Support (4), select Service and Support Team for Service Requests.-See Also-Help Center Documentation:-Processor for Service Requests:-Keywords-Processor, incorrect, determination, determined, service, account, set-up.

Title: ContractID Field in Aging List for Receivables Report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-ContractID Field is shown as #(# represents ContractID) in Report Aging List for Receivables Report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Show All Reports and Find Report Aging List for Receivables.-Execute the Report.-You could see that the ContractID field is shown as #(# represents ContractID)-Cause-The contract field was mapped to a Business object which was never released. Our development counterpart has in the past started working on a feature which was never completed and released. Hence this field is never filled and will always show as #.-This field has no relation to the customer contract object and follow-up documents created in reference to customer contract.-Resolution-This requirement cannot be completed/fulfilled due to technical reasons.-See Also-Keywords-ContractID, Aging List for Receivables

Title: Error Message Acct has Already Been Assigned to nodes Under Assets and Under Liabilities When Removing Assign By Balance Setting for Financial Reporting Structure Item
Content: Symptom-You want to remove the Assign by Balance setting for financial reporting structure item as the assigned accounts are to only appear on one side of the balance sheet. -When pressing Assign by Balance an error message appears "Acct has already been assigned to nodes under assets and under liabilities".-When trying to remove the assigned accounts from the structure node a 500 SAP Internal Server Error occurs. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the Fine-Tune activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structure, Account Determination. -Under Financial Reporting Structures press Edit financial reporting structures. -Select the balance sheet structure XYZ and press Edit (XYZ represents the structure key). -In the structure, find structure item ABC: For the structure item and all its assigned accounts the Show only field displays a value, either Debit Balance or Credit Balance (ABC represents the structure item ID/name). -Select the structure item and press Assign by Balance (you want to remove the setting so that the accounts only appear on one side of the balance sheet).-An error message appears ""Acct has already been assigned to nodes under assets and under liabilities".-To remove the assigned accounts press Actions -Assign Account. -Remove all the assignments and press ok. -A 500 SAP Internal Error occurs.-Cause-It is not possible to reset the Assign By Balance function for a financial structure item by triggering the function again.-Resolution-Option 1: Delete Structure Item and re-create it:-Delete the structure item (This will also delete the structure item on the other side of the balance sheet) and save the structure. Then create it again and assign all the accounts again.-Option 2: Reset the Assign By Balance/ Show Only setting for all structure items via MS Excel export and import:-Only if none of the other structure items or G/L Accounts of the balance sheet use the Assign by balance function and the Show Only collumn shows zero for all of them, you could-export the structure to Microsoft Excel,-remove the structure item ABC and its assigned accounts on the balance sheet side where they are not to appear,-change the exported structures key in the HEADER sheet,-import the structure again via Import from Microsoft Excel.-This will reset the Assign by Balance and Show Only setting for the structure item ABC as well as for all other structure node.-Option 3: Structure Correction via Backend Modification by Support: -If there are many accounts assigned to the structure node (more than 50) you can send an incident to support to assist with the correction of the structure item (Provide exact requirements and approval for backend changes).-See Also-Edit Financial Reporting Structures-Keywords-Acct has already been assigned to nodes under assets and under liabilities; Assign By Balance, Show Only, Balance Sheet, Assign Accounts, Assign by Balance

Title: Enable 'Aggregation Run' Flag for a New Tax Return Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-PLEASE VERIFY WITH DEVLOPMENT BEFORE APPLIYING THESE CHANGES - aggregation run may not be the correct solution for EVERY customer in EVERY country scenario.-You try to perform an Aggregation Run for a Tax Return, however the Aggregation Run flag is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Tax Management Work Center-New Tax Return Run-Enter Relevant data and upon entering 'Tax Return Arrangement ID' value, Aggregation Run flag -Cause-Backend modification is required as this option is selected to aggregate large data volumes for tax return processing. This is enabled only for specific tax return types. However, on demand this can be enabled for larger volume data as required by customer where even the bacground job also fails-Resolution-        1. Login to backend-        2. Open the table FOP_C_TXDECLATTR using t-code SE16-        3. Enter the country and execute it-        4. Tax Declaration type code data will be displayed. Here field 'AGGREGATION_ENB_INDICATOR' can be seen and database has to be modified to add 'X' to this.-        5. To perform this, select the row and click on display  button and below screen can be seen.-        6. Enter '/h' transaction code which enables the debugging. Put mouse cursor on the field next to AGGREGATION_ENB_INDICATOR and hit enter, this will open debugger-        7. Below Code opens-        8. Within debugger, double click on C_CODE, the value currently will be 'SHOW'--        9. Next to the value click on Edit value button and change 'SHOW' to 'EDIT' and hit F8. This will complete the debugger and then new screen will open just like step 5 and now field AGGREGATION_ENB_INDICATOR is editable and 'X' can be entered and       saved.-        10. Once this database table is updated, next open the t-code SE16 and enter FIAI_ACCPE_ADMIN. Then click on New button  and enter PARAM = NEW_AGGREGATION_GENERIC and VALUE = X. Then hit save and this will update the database table-        11. Now that both the tables are updated, new tax return run will have the field 'AGGREGATION_ENB_INDICATOR' enabled-See Also-KBA 3261720 - Error: Release of UK VAT Return: sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest-Aggregation Blog: Aggregation Tax Returns in SAP Business ByDesign-Aggregation Video: UK VAT Return: Aggregation Mode-Keywords-New tax return, Aggregation run, Backend correction

Title: In the Sales Document Items, you are using Advanced filter to filter out the Accrual Method data but you couldn't see any data in the drop down.
Content: Symptom-In the Sales Document Items, by using Advance Filter you are trying to filter the field Accrual Method with some data but initially when you check so there is no data exists in the drop down.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-2) Go to Sales document items sub view.-3) Filter it with Customer contract items.-4) Click Advanced filter near search filter.-5) Under Accounting Data, click the drop down for field Accrual Methos.-There you will see no data.-Cause-There won't be any data for field Accrual Method, because there is no data was selected in Revenue type field. Because Accrual Method type determination is based on the Revenue Type. Without the Revenue type no data will be available in the Accrual Method drop down.-Resolution-First try to select the data for the field Revenue Type. (For Example : Product Sales, Customer Returns, Customer Contracts). Then you click the drop down button for field Accrual Method. Now you will some data which is relevant to the mentioned Revenue Type.-Keywords-Accrual Method, Revenue Type, Advance Filter, Cost and Revenue.

Title: Incident Description in Service Quote Changes When Using the Create with Reference Functionality
Content: Symptom-Incident Description in a Service Quote is removed or changes when creating it as a reference of a Service Request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Quotes view-Open Service Quote ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Service Quote).-Navigate to the General tab and the Main Information sub tab.-In the Incident Description you can see the following text:-Incident Description in the Service Quote you want to copy- Click on the Copy button.-In the New Service Quote you can see in Incident Description you can see the following text copied from the Service Quote ABC:-Incident Description in the Service Quote you want to copy-Click on the button Create with Reference.-Select Reference Type: Service Request and Reference ID:  XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Service Request).-Click on OK.-You can see that in the Incident Description the copied text from Service Quote ABC is removed and the text from the Incident Description of Service Request XYZ is determined by the system.-Cause-When you create a Service Quote as a reference of a Service Request the Incident Description is taken over from the Service Request the same way it would if as if you create a Service Quote using the Follow-Up functionality in the Service Request. If there is no text in the Incident Description of the Service Request, then the Incident Description of the Service Quote created as a reference will also have no Incident Description.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Incident Description; removed; cleared; changed; Follow-Up; Create with Reference; Service Quote;

Title: Exception in Supplier Invoice: 'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Referenced Purchase Order not found'
Content: Symptom-You have created all preceding documents correctly and then finally created a supplier invoice with reference to the previously created purchase order.-But you are unable to post it due to error: 'Referenced Purchase Order not found'.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to supplier invoicing work center-Select invoices and credit memos view-Search for the respective invoice-Go to Exceptions tab-Error: 'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Referenced Purchase Order XYZ not found'.-Cause-The referenced Purchase Order is in approval status.-Steps to check the open tasks for Purchase Order:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Task Management view-Select All Items from the drop down and search for the Purchase Order XYZ (XYZ refers to purchase order in approval)-The open approval tasks for this particular Purchase Order will be visible in "In Progress" status.-Resolution-Kindly approve all the preceding documents and then post the supplier invoice.-Keywords-'Posting of invoice not possible due to error in financial accounting ; Referenced Purchase Order not found', Referenced Purchase Order not found, supplier invoice not posted, supplier invoice in exception

Title: Change Purchase Order Number
Content: Symptom-You want to change an existing Purchase order number. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-NA-Cause-The system will not allow you to change the purchase order number of an existing Purchase order.-Resolution-You will not be able to change the purchase order number. -The system will give you a warning message when the received quantity is more than the ordered quantity. -Keywords-change purchase order ID, change purchase order Id, correct purchase order id

Title: Restrict Goods Reciept
Content: Symptom-You want to restrict Goods Receipt to not receive more than the ordered quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-NA-Cause-The system will always allow you to receive quantity more than the ordered quantity.-The reason why system allows you to do this is to ensure flexibility in supply chain.-As one example there could be cases that the Supplier overdelivered and in such scenarios you will be able to create a return of the product only after receiving it. -Resolution-You will not be able to restrict the goods receipt when delivery quantity is more than ordered quantity.  The system will give you a warning message when the received quantity is more than the ordered quantity.

Title: How to Add Both Landline and Mobile Number to a Contact through Migration
Content: Symptom-How to add both landline and mobile numbers to a contact through migration of customers.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center.- Select Overview view.- Search and open Migration of Customers activity.- Select Migrate customers using the Migration Tool.- Upload the Migration Template using the Upload option.- Select Execute Migration.-Cause-In the web service, the telephone attribute/node is wrongly modeled.-It should be modeled as a message node element with 0*2 cardinality, then it would be possible to add both the landline and the mobile phone.-Resolution-Try to update the telephone information for a contact person of an account via the webservice "ManageCustomerIn"-Follow sample Payload:-  <n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0=" http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global ">-  <BasicMessageHeader>-  </BasicMessageHeader>-  <Customer actionCode="04">-  <InternalID>XXX</InternalID>-  <ContactPerson actionCode="04" workplaceTelephoneListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-   <BusinessPartnerContactInternalID>YYY</BusinessPartnerContactInternalID>-   <WorkplaceTelephone>-    <FormattedNumberDescription>ZZZ</FormattedNumberDescription>-    <MobilePhoneNumberIndicator>false</MobilePhoneNumberIndicator>-   </WorkplaceTelephone>-   <WorkplaceTelephone>-    <FormattedNumberDescription>ZZZ</FormattedNumberDescription>-    <MobilePhoneNumberIndicator>true</MobilePhoneNumberIndicator>-   </WorkplaceTelephone>-  </ContactPerson>- </Customer>-</n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>- NOTE: Here XXX = Account ID , YYY= Contact ID , ZZZ= Telephone Number- Important is, that you need to pass the complete list of telephone numbers at the same time.- It is only allowed to pass workplaceTelephoneListCompleteTransmissionIndicator = "true"-See Also-2563272 - Unable to Enhance Communication Address for Accounts Using Migration of Customers - SAP for Me-Keywords-Migrate both Landline or Mobile Number, Migration of Customer, Webservice, ManageCustomerIn

Title: "Changing UUID not possible; field is read-only" Error When Updating Business Object via SOAP Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are using SOAP webservices to update information to an object (for example, an Account), however when executing the request in the SOAP client the following error message is returned:-"Changing UUID not possible; field is read-only".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-As an example, we will consider the Account business object.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Enter the Service Explorer view.-In the search box, search for the ManageCustomerIn webservice.-Click on the Download WSDL button.-Open the WSDL in a SOAP client.-Open the request payload and fulfill the required data.-Execute the request.-After the request is executed, the error message is returned as result.-Cause-You are passing the object UUID as the identification of the object to be updated.-This is understood by the service interface as an attempt to update the UUID, which is not supported. Hence the error message is returned.-Resolution-Instead of using the UUID property to identify the business object, you can use the InternalID property and remove the UUID property from the business object header level.-Keywords-SOAP, Service Interface, Manage, Check, In

Title: How to Edit Time or Book New Time When Employee Was a Service Agent
Content: Symptom-How to edit time or book new time when employee was a service agent-Environment- SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner Work center-Service Agents view-Find an existing Service agent and edit Time sheet (record times in Dec YYYY1)-Then hire them as an employee from Jan YYYY2-Assign a user and logon for the internal employee.-Logon as the employee and in the time sheet, see if you can add or update times prior to the 1st of Jan via the ESS Time sheet for the Internal Employee.-Note : YYYY1<YYYY2-Cause-This is expected system behaviour .-Resolution-You can edit time or book new time when employee was a service agent.These are the following options:-Here the employee (who was earlier a service agent) can login itself, then goto work-center: Home >Self-services Overview  and choose ‘ Edit Time sheet ’ , then book the time for the period for which employee was a service agent. -The employee’s manger login itself and can also book the time for the period in which employee was a service agent on his behalf. The path for it: Managing My Area>Call Employee Services on Behalf .Then select the employee and choose ‘Edit Time Sheet’.-Third option is go to Service Agent work-center view , then choose option ‘Record times from Microsoft Excel’ from Action and download the template to record the times for the employee (who was service agent).-If you are using the third option  i.e to use the excel template to upload the times, there is business analytical report ‘Recorded Employee Times’ which you can use to see the recorded time for an employee for a period also where he was a service agent.-There is a business analytical report “Recorded Employee Times”  available through which you can see the recorded time for employee.Here enter the employee ID and key date (for which you want to see the recorded times).-See Also-1825859 - Cannot Edit the Time Sheet for Service Agent - SAP for Me-Keywords-  Service agent disappears, edit time or book new time, Recorded Employee Times
