Title: Unable to Create Change Projects in Standalone Test Tenant
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to create change project in standalone test tenant as the New Button in Implementation Projects view is disabled-Prerequisite:"You requested a new test tenant via “Copy of Source Tenant” then you get a “Standalone test tenant” without connection to the production tenant." -Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Tenant-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Go to Implementations Project View-New button to create change project is disabled-Cause-The main work space is decoupled due to which new button is disabled.-Go to backend-Go to T-code BCTADM-Navigate to the particular Workspace ID-The Decoupled option is checked 'X'- Resolution-Create an incident for development team to enable the main workspace  - See Also-2136036 - How to Request a New Tenant for SAP Business ByDesign or SAP Cloud for Customer-Keywords-Main workspace, change projects , new button is disabled, standalone tenant

Title: No Response from Avalara in Sales Document After Avalara Integration and Activation
Content: Symptom-You activated the Avalara standard integration and configured the Communication System and Communication Arrangement.-When creating a Sales Document such as a Sales Order the Tax Code is not determined and you get no response from Avalara.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Cause-You are using the new REST API.-Avalara has provided two APIs for tax determination.-Business ByDesign uses the old REST API https://developer.avalara.com/api-reference/avatax/rest/v1/methods/getTax/.-The usage of new REST API https://developer.avalara.com/api-reference/avatax/rest/v2/methods/Transactions/CreateTransaction/ is not supported as of now.-Resolution-You need to identify a mechanism of using the legacy API https://developer.avalara.com/api-reference/avatax/rest/v1/methods/getTax/ with Avalara.-See Also-Please also see the Blog: Avalara Configuration in SAP Business ByDesign-Please Note: -The blog reffers to the setup in test or development systems and therefore uses the hostname "development.avalara.net" since this should be used for test and development systems.-For productive systems please use the hostname "avatax.avalara.net".-Keywords-Avalara; No response; Tax Code; Not determined

Title: Forward to Provider Failed Invalid Application Area Internal IT Support
Content: Symptom-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."--Forward to provider failed; invalid application area Internal IT Support and Save failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the ByD tenant.-Go to Application User and Management work center.-Go to Incidents view.-Select the Incident which you want to send incident to SAP Support.-Set the Action Feild to "Send to Provider".-Select the Application Area "Internal IT Support".-Click on Add & add a "Note for Provider".-Click on Save.-You will get an error message as shown in below screenshot:-Cause-Application Area "Internal IT Support" is purely for the customers for internal purpose where you can use this Application Area within your Organization for Internal Incident Management.-Resolution- With the new Enhancements in the SAP Business ByDesign(ByD), In the Incidents Edit screen we have introduced new field called “Application Area”, By selecting the application area your incident is directly sent to the correct SAP expert support team, hence this enhancement will considerably help to reduce the processing time of your incident.-While sending the Incident to SAP Support you must chose the Application Area other than "Internal IT Support".-See Also- All About Incident in SAP Business by Design(ByD)-Keywords-Internal IT Support, Application Area, Send to Provider, Send Incident to SAP.

Title: Unexpected Behavior with Local & Global Business Role Assignment
Content: Symptom-The local role assigned users are able to view & assign global roles to the Business user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator Work center-Navigate to  Business Roles View-Highlight the Business Role & Edit it-Under the General tab, checkmark the box Select Scope Manually-In the Scope field, choose Local or Global-Select Save-Cause-Business User has access to Business User view of Application and User Management work center.-Resolution-You have to remove the Application and User Management Work center access to the Business user-Steps:-Go to Administrator Work center-Search for the Business User & select edit-Select Access Rights & Choose on Work Center and View Assignment -Uncheck the Business User from Application and User Management-Save and Close-Keywords-Local Admin, Business role, Admin

Title: Contract Item ID is Not Editable
Content: Symptom-When creating a new customer contract, you find the Item ID is not editable. The first Item ID is always 10. While in the sales order, you are able to edit and change Item Line ID when creating.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Customer Contract.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Create a new contract and fill mandatory fields in the General tab.-Go to Items tab, click Add Row, the first row added, Item ID defaults to 10 and you are not able to change it.-Sales Order.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Create a new sales order and fill mandatory fields in the General tab.-Go to the Items tab, Click Add Row, the first row added and it defaults to 10. The item Line ID is editable, you can change it to another value.-Cause-Item ID in the contract is not editable.-Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-Keywords-Contract; Item ID.

Title: Line Sequence in Customer Invoice and Sales Order are Different
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales order with several lines, the order was delivered and invoiced. You find the line sequence in the invoice is different than the sales order. For example, the last line in the sales order is the first line in the customer invoice.-You expect the lines keep the same sequence in sales order and customer invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the sales order ABC, in Items tab, you can see the product 123 is on last line.-Go to the Document Flow tab, open the invoice DEF. You can see the product 123 is on the first line.-(ABC, DEF represent the sales order ID, 123 represents the product ID)-Cause-In this case, the product 123 is with item type "Expense - fixed price without actuals". This type is invoiced via sales order invoice request.-When invoicing the order, system combined 2 invoice requests.-1. Sales Order Invoice Request ABC, for the expense item.  and-2, Outbound Delivery Invoice Request XYZ for the other produce-delivery based items.-The line in Sales Order Invoice Request was firstly determined then the lines in the Outbound Delivery Invoice Request. So the last line for expense item in the sales order presents as the first line in the customer invoice.-Business ByDesign uses four conditions for sorting line items.-See also KBA 2651521 - Sorting Of Line Items In Customer Invoices From Multiple Invoice Requests-Resolution-This is the correct system behavior.-See Also-Keywords-Sales Order; Customer Invoice; Line sequence

Title: Incorrect Currency in the Purchase Orders per Account Assignment Report
Content: Symptom-System shows incorrect currency in the Purchase Orders per Account Assignment report for all purchase orders. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Select Purchase Orders per Account Assignment report-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Execute the report-System shows the currency in different currency than Company currency-Cause-There is a key figure called Display Currency and if you select the relevant Company Currency, system displays the desired currency which you need. -Resolution-You can go to Business Analytics work center -Go to Design Reports view-Select the Purchase Orders per Account Assignment report-Select Edit with Web Browser-In the selection list, select the key figure Display Currency-Then select the relevant purchase order-System will show the currency in Company Currency-Keywords-Incorrect Currency in the Purchase Orders per Account Assignment Report; Incorrect Currency in the Purchase Orders; Purchase Orders per Account Assignment Report

Title: Incorrect Description of Service shown in Assignment Rules
Content: Symptom-In the Assignment Rules for Time and Expenses system shows product description in German language instead of English language. The login language is English and both languages are maintained in the master data of the service. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Project Management-Go to Not Invoiced Time and Expenses view-Select the relevant Project-Click on Edit Time and Expenses-Click on Edit Assignment Rules / View all Rules-Here you can see the description for Service is in German language and not in English-Cause-In the service master data screen in other Languages Tab, the language is maintained as DE and for service description that is an expected behavior. -Resolution-You can remove that in the Other language tab, so that the service description from the general tab can be fetched in the Edit Assignment Rules screen. -Keywords-Incorrect Description of Service shown in Assignment Rules;Assignment Rules for Time and Expenses

Title: Interrupt Error in Delayed Business Object Processing When Time Recording is Transferred From one Project to Another Project
Content: Symptom-Interrupt error in Delayed Business Object Processing when time recording is transferred from one project to another project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Steps to transfer the time recording from one project to another project.-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the Employee and go to Edit button-Go to Employee times tab-Select the corresponding time recording and go to Labor information sub tab-Modify the Task and provide the service and save-Go to Actions button and Activate the record.-Now,-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Delayed Business Object Processing view-Search for the Object Name: Project Expense Reassignment Requisition -Select the particular Object ID-The status of the transfer posting is Interrupted-Cause-The backdated changes to assignments in a labor resource are not evaluated in the regular time valuation process. It can only be explicitly triggered from the time valuation correction run for an employee in Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Resolution-You need to execute Run Day Closure for One Employee-Go to the Time Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Choose Run Day Closure for One Employee option-Select the employee in the value help-Select the action "Start Time Valuation"-Go to Run button-Provide the Time Profile Start date of the employee selected and choose the OK button-Do not check the checkbox Include backdated labor resource changes record-See Also-Interrupt Error, Delayed Business Object Processing, Run Day Closure for One Employee

Title: Customized Tax Jurisdiction is not Working As Expected for Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have created a customized Tax Jurisdiction. However when creating the supplier invoice, the system is picking both tax jurisdictions (Standard and customized). You expected that only the customized would be picked. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center. -Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view. -Search for ABC (ABC is the invoice's ID). -Click in Edit button. -Navigate to Items tab.-Navigate to Taxes subtab. -Check the Taxes section, there are two entries (those are examples listed below):-Tax Jurisdiction: Region A" -> "Tax Rate: 5%"-Tax Jurisdiction: Region A 2%" -> "Tax Rate: 2%"-You expected that it would show the second entry (customized one, 2%), and not both of them. -Cause-If you want to keep only the % of the customized tax jurisdiction, the user cannot maintain the Tax Jurisdiction Code similar to the code of the standard one. -For example, for region Connecticut, the Tax Jurisdiction Code is 'CT'. For the customized one, do not maintain as 'CT*' (* is any other character) because the system will insert the standard rate plus the customized rate when creating the invoice. -For this example, you can maintain the Tax Jurisdiction Code as 'C1'. -Resolution-Steps to create the customized Tax Jurisdiction:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the current implementation project.-Select Open Activity List button.-Navigate to Fine-Tune phase.-Open the Tax on Goods and Services activity.-Select the hyperlink Define Tax Jurisdictions to edit or create tax jurisdiction codes.-Steps specific to create the customized Tax Jurisdiction in US region:-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Overview view. -Search for *Tax on Goods*. -Open activity 'Tax on Goods and Services - US'. -Open the link 'Define Tax Jurisdictions'. -Click in Add Row button. -Insert the 'Region', the customized 'Tax Jurisdiction Code' and the 'Description' (remember to maintain the Code with a different structure from the Standard one). -Save it. -See Also-KBA: 1667667 - How Tax Jurisdiction Codes Define the Tax Calculation for Sales Orders Items-Keywords-Tax Jurisdiction, Supplier Invoice, Business Configuration

Title: Incorrect Job Title Displayed When Extracting Employee Report
Content: Symptom-Incorrect job title displayed for employee in the report ABC(Where ABC stands for report name).-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Search for "ABC"-Go to View and select the desired view from the drop down-Under Job choose Directors-Go to Employee View and select the Employee-Select Apply, observe the Job title of employee XYZ is incorrectly reflected.-Cause-The value is initially displayed as job J123 because J234 is missing in the selection and the employee has a reference to the job J123 in the past.-Resolution-Select the present Job Code which is assigned to the employee. When the current job is not selected, the report fetches the historic reference which is available in the data source.-See Also-N/A-Keywords-Job Title ,Design Reports ,Directors Allocation, Job code

Title: Unable to Set Workflow Rule Condition with Extension Field
Content: Symptom-When you define the conditions for the workflow rule biographical data with the extension field, you're unable to locate the specific custom field you want to use in the provided dropdown menu under 'Define Conditions' step.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Edit Employee XXX ( Here XXX is an employee )-Select the Personnel File -Navigate to Biographical data in Personal data-Create an Extension field-Adding Workflow rule steps:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Workflow Rules view-Create New and give description -Select the required BO-In step 2-define conditions, go to Add Group button-When you trying to search for the particular extension field in edit condition, you are unable to fine-Cause-Extension fields of biographical data is not exposed to be used in workflow rules.-This is the reason, you are not able to find extension fields that you created in biographical data, while creating workflow rules.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Since this would be a new feature request, you can also give the feedback in influence portal as given below link.-Customer Influence Forum, at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Workflow rule, biographical data,Employee, Business Object,extension field

Title: Extension Field with Field Type Indicator is Not Available in the Output XML
Content: Symptom-You created an extension field with the Field Type Indicator and added the Extension field to the respective Form Template.-When the Output is created you notice that the field is only available in the Output XML if the value of the Indicator is True.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-If the field type of a field is an Indicator, the field is only included in the Output XML if the value is True. This also applies to the standard field e.g. Optional Indicator in a Sales Quote on Item level.-Only non-initial extension fields are included in the Output XML.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour. -Keywords-XML; Output; Payload; Indicator; Checkbox; Check Box; True; False; Checked; Unchecked; Form Template; Output History; Missing; Extension Field; KUT; PDI

Title: Unable to Create Data Source in SAP Cloud Application Studio for BusinessDocumentFlow BO
Content: Symptom-You are not able to create a data source in SAP Cloud App for Namespace AP_FO_BUSINESS_DOCUMENT_FLOW_G http://sap.com/xi/AP/FO/BusinessDocumentFlow/Global ROOT -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In SDK-Select Add Item-Choose Data Source name and create it-In the box that comes up, change the namespace to http://sap.com/xi/AP/FO/BusinessDocumentFlow/Global in the dropdown-Then try to select the BusinessDocumentFlow Business Object from the next dropdown, but nothing shows in the dropdown list.-Cause-Below are the following reasons why it is not showing in the drop down.-If the business objects are configured as BCO (Business configuration Object), this type of Business objects (BCO) will not be visible in dropdown in Partner system.-If the technical category is configured as Transformed object, then this Business Object will not be visible in dropdown in Partner system. -If the BO is not showing the release status and will not be available in dropdown.--Resolution-This is Standard system behavior.-Keywords-Cloud Application Studio, cannot, Business Document, create, data source

Title: Customer Account Statement Display Sequence
Content: Symptom-You created the customer account statement and noted that some line entries are not sorted by posting date, and you wonder what the logic of display sequence is.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Customer Account Statement view.-Click on Run ID: AAA.-Click on 'View Report Run Results'.-The line entries with description clearing-discounts/cr are not sorted by posting date. They are actually grouped and listed towards the end of the customer statement. -Cause-The logic of the customer account statement display sequence is divided into two sections.-The first section deals with line items which stores information about invoice/credit memo/payment items and which are then added first into the file.-The second section deals with split line items which holds information about discounts/credits and are added at the end of file and final amount is calculated. There is a clear technical separation done within the logic. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-customer account statement, posting date, clearing-discounts

Title: You Cannot Update Customer Invoice Request by Using ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn API
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You send a request payload using web service API ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn, but got error that "Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER_INVOICE_REQUEST with key BASE_BTD_ID-CONTENT = `XYZ` AND BASE_BTD_TYPE = `29` does not exist (KBA: 2044206) ”-XYZ represents the value you maintained as BaseBusinessTransactionDocumentID in the request payload.-The XYZ exists in the system as a customer invoice, you intended to update this invoice document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You execute the payload via SOAP UI.-And got response: -<Note>Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER_INVOICE_REQUEST with key BASE_BTD_ID-CONTENT = `XYZ` AND BASE_BTD_TYPE = `29` does not exist (KBA: 2044206)</Note>-Cause-ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn is only used to create and edit External Invoice Request. It is not used to update existing customer invoices.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior.-Keywords-ManageCustomerInvoiceRequestIn; Update not possible; specified data for CUSTOMER_INVOICE_REQUEST with key BASE_BTD_ID-CONTENT AND BASE_BTD_TYPE = `29` does not exist.

Title: Difference Between Planned Useful Life And Remaining Useful Life In Straight Line Depreciation Method
Content: Symptom-You are using the straight-line depreciation method, and you noticed that straight line depreciation formula equals to (purchase price – salvage value) / useful Life. You hope to understand what the difference between planned useful life and remaining useful life is.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Asset work center.-Go to Fixed Asset View.-Search for fixed asset ID: AAA.-Edit master data, and you can see it is using the depreciation method: L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0.-Cause-Depreciation is calculated automatically based on the asset's planned useful life and the depreciation method.-Useful life: Determines the total number of years and accounting periods a fixed asset is estimated to be in service.-Remaining useful life: When choosing the straight-line depreciation of the net book value over the remaining useful life, the depreciation rate is determined for each year from the remaining useful life.-You can further refer to the example 4 in the help doc: L011 Str.-line from rem.life nbv to 0.-Resolution-This is the system design.-Keywords-straight-line depreciation method, planned useful life, remaining useful life

Title: Contact E-mail not Showing in Sales Quote Volume - Extended Report
Content: Symptom-You are using the sales quote volume - extended report and you have noticed that for some of the Account Contacts, the e-mail address is not showing, but rather showing the hashtag (#).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for Report Sales Quote Volume - Extended.-Click Edit.-Execute the report.-Navigate to the View tab.-Click on the Add Fields to Row icon (+).-Expand the Account - Contact.-Select the checkbox for E-mail.-You see that for some of the contacts, the e-mail is not showing as expected. --Cause-The reason the e-mail address is not showing in the report is because the e-mail address is maintained under the Business Communication and not in the Personal Communication. -For the e-mail address to show or be retrieved to the report, the e-mail address needs to be maintained in the Personal Communication section. -Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -Please perform the following to maintain the e-mail in the correct field:-Copy the ID of the contact which does not have the e-mail address in the report.-Go to the Account Management work center.-Select the Contacts view.-Search for the ID of the contact.-Click Edit.-Select General.  -Under the Personal Communication, maintain the e-mail address in the E-mail field. -Click Save and Close. -Now the e-mail address will show as you reopen the report. -Keywords-Report, Sales Quote, Personal Communication, Sales Quote Volume - Extended, Contacts, Incorrect, Data

Title: Inconsistent Document ID Between Accounts Receivable Open Items Report And Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-When you check the report: accounts receivable open items, you noticed that the document ID is not the supplier invoice ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-First check the report - accounts receivable open items:-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Reporting view.-Search and click on report: accounts receivable open items.-After enter the required information, you can find the document ID on the report is: AAA instead of CCC. external reference ID is: BBB.-Then check the supplier invoices:-Go to Payables work center.-Go to Supplier Account view.-Find and select the respective supplier.-Search with external reference ID: BBB.-You can find there are two invoices, and the document ID: CCC is already cleared, and the document ID: AAA is still open.-Cause-Report: accounts receivable open items would only show open items. As this is a split invoice situation, and invoice CCC does not show in the report because it is already cleared. Invoice AAA shows in the report because it is open.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-accounts receivable open items, document ID, supplier invoice ID

Title: Extending the Org Unit Extension Fields to Company Data Source
Content: Symptom-You have created the extension fields and wanted to extend it to the Company Master Data Report as well, however you were not able to extend those fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Go to the Org Structures view-Go to Adaptation Mode-Click on + icon and click on Extension filed you will see list of field label and click on Show further Usage-Navigate to Date Source and Reports tab-Those fields are only enabled for the Cost center & Profit Center-To validate these field are part of the associated reports Cost Center Master Data & Profit Center Master Data like you can follow the below steps:-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Data Source & Search for the above mentoined reports-Select the Report and Navigate to Extension Fields under Details Tab you will find the Extended Extension field listed-Cause- This is expected behaviour.-Resolution-The org unit extension is intended only for financial reports only for profit and cost centers.-If the company is the cost center, then you can access those attributes.-Keywords-Company Master Data Source, Company Master Data Report, Cost Center Master Data, Profit Center Master Data, Extension Field, Org Units

Title: Write-up To Fixed Asset Is Posted To G/L Account: AAA instead of the expected G/L account: BBB
Content: Symptom-User is trying to post write-up to fixed assets, and the simulated journal entry is posted to G/L account: AAA instead of the expected G/L account: BBB.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Fixed Assets view.-Select fixed asset XYZ (XYZ stands for fixed asset ID) and select manual posting - write-up.-Select simulate the journal entry, and you will see the posted G/L account is AAA instead of BBB.-Cause-The required G/L accounts when posting write-up must belong to the following account types, and G/L account: BBB does not belong to the following G/L account type. The G/L account: AAA belongs to the following account type. -For G/L Account-Account Type-Accumulated Depreciation-ASSET – Fixed Assets-Revenues from Write-Up-REVGAN – Revenues or Gains-Resolution-If you hope the simulated journal entry is posted to G/L account: BBB, you may kindly follow the process in help doc: <Account Determination posting Write-Ups> to maintain the G/L account.-Keywords-fixed assets write-up, simulated journal entry

Title: Error "Combination of Sales Org XXXXX and Distribution Channel YY Already Exists"
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to add the new service in data migration then system displays the below error-Combination of Sales Org XXXXX and Distribution Channel YY Already Exists (XXXXX refers to Sales Organization ID and YY refers to Distribution Channel)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and open the migration activity "Migration of Services"-Select the source file and process-Choose on Execute Migration step by step-At Simulate Import stage you will see the below error-Result:  -"Combination of Sales Org. XXXX and distribution channel YY already exists" -Cause-Possible reason for the issue is:-Inconsistent value mapping in task value conversion step of the migration.-In the task to map Sales Organization ID, the target value is being mapped for different source values. -Resolution-To map the values to a unique target value, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and open the migration activity "Migration of Services"-Select the source file and process-Select Execute Migration step by step-Value conversion step in migration is to Convert Values.-The importance of this step is that it will map all the Source Values in the template to the Target Value in the system.-In order to change the value in value conversion step. please follow the below steps-Select the Sales Organization ID task.-Select Target Value.-Press F4.-Once you select F4 help you will get the list of values which can be mapped to unique target value, and you can select and save it.-Keywords-Migration of services, Sales Organization, ID, Sales, migration activity, Distribution Channel

Title: Behavior of WordNum Function in ALD
Content: Symptom-User is unable to covert the Total amount field in Indian word format.-For Example:-Total: 12,24,530 (here 12,24,530 is a digit only)-System Resulting:-Total Rupees in Words: "One Million Two Hundred Twenty-four Thousand Five Hundred Thirty"--Your Requirement(Indian word Format):-Total Rupees in Words: "Twelve lakh twenty-four thousand five hundred thirty Rupees and zero paisa only"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer Core Application-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Adobe LiveCycle Designer-Open the Form XXXX ( here XXXX is a form)-Navigate to the Total amount field-Observe the Total amount field is not as expected-Cause-The scripting program uses the WordNum function to translate in word format.-Resolution-SAP Business ByDesign (SAP ByD) or SAP Cloud for Customer Core Application does not have a built-in feature to directly convert WordNum (number in words) into Indian numeral representation.-See Also-Check Adobe LiveCycle ES3 * WordNum -Keywords-ALD, Wordnum function, conversion, Indian

Title: Some of the Parameters are not Available While Defining Approval Limit for Product Category
Content: Symptom-While Defining rules for approval limit for Product category ID there is no “Between”, “Include” or “Contains Pattern” parameters in Selector Operator, the only option available is “Equals To”.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center view.-Go to Define Approval Value Limit under Common Tasks.-Select the Row-Go to Product Category ID column and select '*'-Select Operator has only Equals To.-Cause-There is no “Between”, “Include” or “Contains Pattern” parameters functionality.-Resolution-The existing operators only include "Equals To." The addition of other operators is a new requirement. Share the feedback through  Influence link https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886  -Keywords-Define rules for approval limit, Equals To, Selector Operator, Product Category

Title: System is Showing The Error "Missing quantity" on Adjustment Confirmation of a Serial Number
Content: Symptom-System is displaying the error "Missing quantity" when you are trying to perform an Adjustment Confirmation against an Inbound Warehouse Order with a Serialized Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Inbound Deliveries view. -Find and select the relevant Inbound Delivery document.-You can see it has the Release Status: Not Released.-Click Edit.-Go to the Monitoring view and select By Warehouse Order.-Click Advanced Search and enter the relevant Delivery ID.-Click Go.-Select in the returned result the Warehouse Order ID and click Edit.-Click Adjustment Confirmation.-Click Enable Entry.-Go to the Serial Numbers sub-tab.-Select the relevant Serial Number and click Remove.-Click Save.-The System displays the error messages: Quantity missing and Save failed.-Cause-The Serial number you are trying to Adjust in the Warehouse Order is currently issued to Customer through an Outbound Delivery. -It is not possible to perform an Adjustment Confirmation against the Inbound Warehouse Order once the product is issued to customer.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, you have to ensure that the Material is returned to your Warehouse by reversing the Goods Issue.-System is therefore working as designed.

Title: Unable to Save Customer Invoice After Entering Customer Information
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User is unable to save the Customer Invoice after entering the Customer Information Note. Title: Mime Type Issues When Downloading Attachments
Content: Symptom-Files are downloaded with unexpected file extension-Files are downloaded without a file extension-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-When attachments are uploaded, their mime type is determined based on the extension of the file name (e.g. example_file.pdf results in mime type “application/pdf”).-You map mime types and extensions and specify which mime types may be uploaded in the activity “Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload” in Business Configuration.-If the mime type cannot be determined from the file extension because the file extension is not maintained, mime type “application/octet-stream” is automatically used instead. Due to this behavior, we recommend not allowing  mime type “application/octet-stream” without a purpose to prevent, for instance, the upload of executable or other unwanted file types.-In integration scenarios (SOAP, OData) the sender may specify the mime type. In this case, the mime type is used as specified and not determined based on the extension.-When downloading an attachment, the extension of the file name is used. If no extension is available or the extension doesn’t match the mime type, the maintained default extension of the mime type will be used.-Resolution-In the Business Configuration activity “Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload”:-Do not assign the same extension to a forbidden and an allowed mime type at the same time. For example, You add 2 new MimeTypes (eg:  ZABC and ZDEF) but should not have same extension assigned. This should be avoided-We recommend not to allow mime type “application/octet-stream”.-In integration scenarios-Ensure that the file name contains an appropriate extension (e.g. the <Name> tag in SOAP messages).-If the mime type is specified in integration scenarios, ensure the mime type / file extension matches the setting in “Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload” to avoid unwanted changes of the extension during download.-Example:-Here in the below screenshot, it is standard png file extension added to one of the MIMETYPE Code which is already allowed.-In this below screenshot you have created custom file extension for png again for different MIMETYPE Code.-Keywords-Mime types, attachments, file extension

Title: Why Approvals not triggered based on currently active approval process
Content: Symptom-You are looking at the Approval tab and you see unexpected approvals.- or- You want to know how the approvals are triggered though conditions are not matching as per current approval process.- or- You want to know which approval process is  considered by system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Open the document and go to approval tab-Cause-The approval task is triggered before the current approval process start time therefore system is not considering the current approval process.-Resolution-Go to Application user management work center-Select Business Task Management-Search for the relevant BTM task for the document and note down the date-Or check the date on which you have sent the document for approval and note it down (you may check the changes tab of the document, if such details of when you submitted for approval is not there then consider the creation date of the document).- Then-Go to Application user management work center-Go to Approval process-Choose all approval process-Filter for respective  document type  like purchase order-Now you will see all  approval process for that document type with From and To validity .-Use the above date to select the respective approval process, cause that was the approval process active when you sent the document for approval-Note: This KBA  is applicable for all documents accross ByDeisgn-See Also-Keywords- Approvals not aligned based on approval process

Title: Clearing House Statement Errors: Payment Reference Not Provided; Bank Statement Format Code XXX Is Not Valid
Content: Symptom-When you upload clearing house statement file, errors occur: Payment reference not provided; Bank statement format code XXX is not valid.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to Inbound Files view.-Click New - Inbound File.-Enter the required information such as company.-Upload the clearing house statement attachment and click 'Start File Upload'.-You can see errors: Payment reference not provided; Bank statement format code XXX is not valid.-Cause-Payment transaction reference in the clearing house statement file has errors.-Resolution-You first need to check whether the total payment reference IDs in the clearing house statement file itself is consistent. You can find the total payment reference IDs in the Tag:<ItemTotalNumberValue>.-You also need to check whether the payment reference IDs in the clearing house statement file are available in the system:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Search the payment reference ID in the clearing house statement file.-Keywords-clearing house statement, payment reference not provided, bank statement format code XXX is not valid

Title: How to Restrict Users from Accessing Customer Invoice Based on Business Residence?
Content: Symptom-You want to restrict users from accessing customer invoices based on Business Residence (BR).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select view Business Users.-Search for a particular user.-Select Edit-> Access Rights.-Select Access Restrictions tab.-You are unable to access restrictions based on Business Residence.-Cause-It is only possible to restrict users for accessing from accessing customer invoices based on Company.-Resolution-You can give access to specific business data, depending on the access context. In customer invoices it is based on Company. -Keywords-User Authorization; restrict user; Access Rights; Customer Invoice; Access Context.

Title: Unable to Add Target Amount for Contracts Created via the Web Service
Content: Symptom-While trying to add Target Amount via the webservice ManageCustomerContractin there is no relevant tag to add the Target Amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Input and Output management view.-Select the sub view Service Explorer.-Download WSDL for ManageCustomerContractIn webservice.-Open the WSDL in a API testing software.-There is no tag available for the that Target amount in the request.-Cause-The tag for adding the Target Amount is currently not available in the web service ManageCustomerContractIn.-Resolution-This is currently the expected system behavior. Kindly submit/ vote for a feature request to the correct decision makers at SAP via the Customer Influence Forum.-Keywords-Contract; Target Amount; Webservice; ManageCustomerContractIn

Title: Not possible to upload supplier invoice with additional cost debit item via excel template
Content: Symptom-Errors when uploading supplier invoice with Additional Cost Debit Item via Microsoft Excel:-Sum of percentages should be 100%.-It is not possible to distribute the costs. Add one or more items among which you distribute costs, or increase the quantity and amount of the existing items (must not be zero).-Purchase document locked/Product differs from product of purchase document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Supplier Invoice Microsoft Excel template, you select 'Distribute Additional Costs (1)' as Yes.-You find there is no column for you to enter reference invoice ID and item to distribute.-Then you enter the reference purchase order ID and item ID in field 'Purchase Order ID (1)' and 'Purchase Order Item ID (1)' respectively.-After saving data into the system, you have the invoice created with errors:-Sum of percentages should be 100%.-It is not possible to distribute the costs. Add one or more items among which you distribute costs, or increase the quantity and amount of the existing items (must not be zero).-Purchase document locked/Product differs from product of purchase document-Cause-The upload of Additional Debit Invoices will only do 'uploading to system'.-There's a separate action required here, which is to select 'Distribute among other invoice or credit memos'.-You must then select the reference document and trigger the distribute action in the system manually.-Resolution-This is current system behavior.-See Also-2532815 - Distribute Cost Among Invoices and Credit Memo Items-Keywords-Additional cost debit item, Microsoft Excel, Excel template, Sum of percentages should be 100%, It is not possible to distribute the costs, Purchase document locked, Product differs from product of purchase document, 百分比总和应为 100%, 采购单据的供应商与发票的不同, 无法分摊成本, 附加成本借记项目

Title: CCM extractor AGS_CC_OBJ_TRAN_EXTRACTOR fails and produces memory dump
Content: Symptom-Custom Code Objects extractor AGS_CC_OBJ_TRAN_EXTRACTOR fails with error: "No more memory available to add rows to an internal table" and produces the following ST22 dump in the managed sytsem:-Category Resource Shortage-Runtime Errors TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED-Short Text-   No more memory available to add rows to an internal table.-What happened?-   An attempt was made to add rows to an internal table. There was no-   memory available for this however.-Active Calls/Events-   8 FUNCTION SAPLSEWB_CONTRO LSEWB_CONTROLU0 388-   RS_SHORTTEXT_GET-   7 FUNCTION /SDF/SAPLCMO_COMP_REPO /SDF/LCMO_COMP_REPOSU04 657-   /SDF/CMO_GET_CUST_OBJ-Environment- Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-E2E_EFWK_LV-Filter for extractor name AGS_CC_OBJ_TRAN_EXTRACTOR and manged sytsem SID-see error in extractor phase-Cause-Resolution-Implement the latest version of SAP Note 2913437 - Corrections for custom code checks in ST-PI in all managed system in which the object extractor runs.-See Also-Keywords-CCM, Objects extractor, AGS_CC_OBJ_TRAN_EXTRACTOR, 2913437, TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED, No more memory, /SDF/CCM_AGS_CC_TRAN_EXTR

Title: Invoice AAA is Not Considered in Invoice Summary Run
Content: Symptom-You create invoice AAA(AAA represents the ID of the invoice).-You execute invoice summary run.-However, invoice AAA is not included in any monthly invoice, or no monthly invoice is created for the account BBB(BBB represents the account of invoice AAA).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center.-Go to Invoice Summary Runs view.-Search the run in question and view Log tab.-Click on the log in question.-You cannot find the monthly invoice for account BBB, or invoce AAA is not included in the monthly invoice of account BBB.-Cause-Invoice Summary Relevancy flag is not set for invoice AAA.-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go t o Invoice Documents view.-Search and open Invoice AAA.-Click on View All.-You find that Invoice Summary Relevancy is not marked.-When this flag is not set, the document is excluded from invoice summary processing.-If the field 'Invoice Summary Relevancy' is not visible, please follows the steps below to make it available via Adaptation Mode:-Go to Adaptation mode.-Go to General.-You will see the 'Invoice Summary Relevancy' field.-Check mark it and save.-Click on Publish changes.-Resolution-System works as designed.-If you would like to include invoice AAA in summary invoices, you need to cancel and re-create, and ensure the Invoice Summary Relevancy flag is set.-See Also-Summary Invoice Document-KBA 3339817  Invoice AAA is Not Considered in Invoice Summary Run-KBA 2870283  Invoice AAA Should Not Be Included in Monthly Invoice BBB-Keywords-締め請求, invoice sumamry, monthly invoice, summary invoice, Invoice Summary Relevancy, 締め請求関連

Title: Customer Information or Internal Comment were Not Passed from Customer Invoice to Journal Entry
Content: Symptom-You have maintained Customer Information ABC (where ABC stands for Customer Information) and Internal Comment EFG (where EFG stands for Internal Comment) in the Customer Invoice XXX (where XXX stands for Customer Invoice document), but Customer Information ABC or Internal Comment EFG are not passed from Customer Invoice to the Header Text field in Journal Entry YYY (where YYY stands for Journal Entry).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoice Work Center-Open Customer Invoice XXX-You have maintained Customer Information ABC and Internal Comment EFG in General tab.-Go to General Ledger Work Center-Open Journal Entry YYY-The Header Text field is blank-Cause-Whichever field is edited last Internal Comment or Customer Information is taken over as Header Text in the journal entry.-This is because it is only possible to send one info text from the invoice to accounting and here the one that was edited last is taken over.-Resolution-You can manually maintain the text in Journal Entry or if you maintain in last text collection element then also it would be passed.-See Also-Keywords-Customer Information, Internal Comment, Journal Entry

Title: System Not Releasing Production Proposal To Production Request Automatically.
Content: Symptom-You want to know why system is not releasing production proposal automatically though required scoping question is scoped. However system displays below errors:-Cannot request production proposal start date out validity period-Exceptions-Proposal Outside Validity Period-Start Date in Past-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning workcenter.-Go to Products view.-Search required Product ID with planning area.-Select and choose Open button.-Under Supply and Demand, you find the Production Proposal is not released..-Select and Open required Production Proposal, you see that under exceptions tab below exceptions.-Proposal Outside Validity Period-Start Date in Past-Cause-Since the corresponding Bill Of Material's Valid From date maintained is later than the Start Date of Production, or Valid To date is earlier than the Start Date of Production, system is not creating production requests.-You can check Start and End Date in relevant Production Proposal ID along with BoM Validity Period From/To.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter.-Go to Production Bill Of Materials view.-Find the relevant BoM ID.-Edit and update the BoM ID as per business requirement.-Or you can create a new BoM for it.-Once the required changes are done, check and release the relevant Production Model again to reflect required changes in proposals.-See Also-Keywords-Production proposal,  Bill Of Material's Valid From, cannot request production proposal start date out validity period, Proposal Outside Validity Period, Start Date in Past, exceptions

Title: Approval Task is Completed by a User who is Not the Actual Approver
Content: Symptom-You have set up an approval process for shopping cart or purchase order or supplier invoice. Based on the approval rules, the approval is triggered for User A as expected. However in the document, it shows approval was completed by user B.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select view Business Task Management-Select the relevant approval task-Check the Person Responsible. It shows user A.-Now open the document-Navigate to Approvals tab-It shows completed by user B.-Cause-You have set user B as the substitute for user A, in Application and User Management - Task Substitutions view, hence user B will get all the tasks that are triggered for user A and if the user B has the necessary access rights, he/she can complete the task.-When substitutions are active, the substitute receives all the tasks that belong to the employee being substituted.  -Resolution-Kindly deactivate the substitution to avoid the tasks going to the substitute when the actual employee is available to complete the task.-Keywords-substitute, task substitution, approval task completed by different user, wrong approver in shopping cart, wrong approver in purchase order, wrong approver in supplier invoice, incorrect approval

Title: Add Input Product in Production Task and Confirm Serial Number against It Through Web Service ManageProductionLotsIn, Serial Number is Not Confirmed.
Content: Symptom-You try to add a new input product into a production task and confirm a serial number against it through standard web service ManageProductionLotsIn, the result is the input product is added but the serial number is not confirmed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Make a payload of web service ManageProductionLotsIn. Add a new input product into a production task and confirm a serial number against this product in this payload.-2. Call the web service with the payload, the response shows "Successfully created".-3. Check the production task from UI, the new input product has been added but no serial number is confirmed.-Cause-Confirming input products with serial number is allowed only with action code 02 in the payload.-Resolution-You need to add the new input product in first payload and confirm serial number against it in the second payload.-Keywords-Production Task, Input Product, ManageProductionLotsIn, Serial Number

Title: Error When Trying to Migrate Fixed Assets via Migration of Accounting Transaction Data
Content: Symptom-You are facing the error message below when trying to migrate Fixed Assets via Migration of Accounting Transaction Data:-Object FIA_FIXED_ASSET is currently not open for data migration specific changes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration and then Overview view.-Search for Migration of Accounting Transaction Data and open the Activity.-Click Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select the Company.-Click Execute Migration and then select Fixed Assets line.-Click Process File.-Errors appears.-Cause-The error happens when the migration object is not enabled for migration.-Resolution-In case of fixed assets, both "Fixed Assets" and "Fixed Assets (extended)" have to be enabled, otherwise the error is raised.-To enable the migration objects, you may proceed as follows:-Go to Business Configuration -> Implementation Projects.-Open the activity list and open activity "Enable Data Migration per Object"-In this activity, make sure that both "Fixed Assets" and "Fixed Assets (extended)" are enabled.-Once done, the error shall no longer be raised in the migration tool.-Keywords-Object FIA_FIXED_ASSET is currently not open for data migration specific changes, Error, Cannot, Migrate, Fixed Assets, Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.

Title: Service Call Error During Migration of Material Activity
Content: Symptom-Service call error during Migration of Material activity-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Search for Migration of Materials activity and open Migrate Materials using the migration tool-Select migration file -Execute migration step by step-At the simulation step, only materials with errors messages are displayed in frontend-Cause-Material IDs are wrongly associated against company code-Resolution-Correct the company code associated with material IDs -Keywords-Service call error , migration of material, company code

Title: Cannot Receive Notification for Project Baseline on Mobile App
Content: Symptom-You have created a Project Baseline and sent it for approval, the approver can receive it on PC end, but cannot receive it on Mobile App, even though the approver is assigned with Mobile Approval Authorization view under Project Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There are 15 categories, for which backend logic is written and is fetching the approval tasks list for sending it to Mobile application for displaying.-If there are any other approval tasks which were created other than these categories, then no backend logic written to get the approval tasks list.-Please find the approval categories list:-TABLE_LINE-ERM_EXP_REP_APPROVE-REQ_IR_APPROVAL-PUR_PO_APPROVAL-/SRMAP/PUR_TPO_APP-SIV_INV_APPROVAL-PUR_GSA_APPROVAL-PUR_PCT_APPROVAL-HCM_TIMX_EMPLOYEE_TIME_APPROVAL-CUST_QUOTE_APPROVAL_REQUEST-CRM_SO_APPROVE-/SRMAP/PUR_PR_APP-CRM_SRVO_APPROVE-CRM_CI_APPROVE-FND_BUPA_SUPPLIER_APPROVAL-TIME_RECORDING-SAP has pre-maintained/implemented the 15 approval categories for all users across the world for every customer. If there any such cases if tasks are created apart from these 15 categories, then they will not be shown on mobile client as their implementation is not for done for Mobile.-Even you are assigned with Project Management work center Mobile Approval Authorization view, the approval task that user has created will show only on Desktop UI/Oberon client not on Mobile Client because the created task is not falling under any of the categories which were mentioned above.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Approval, Project Baseline, Mobile App

Title: Cannot Receive Approval Task of Request for Quotation on Mobile App
Content: Symptom-You have sent a Request for Quotation approval task to your manager and the approver can receive the approval task on PC end, but cannot receive it on mobile app.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-For manager approvals, mobile app only support for customer quotes, customer invoices (including credit memos), expense reports, goods & services receipts, leave requests, purchase orders, purchase order items, purchase requests (when created manually), purchasing contracts, sales orders, service orders, shopping carts, suppliers, supplier invoices, time recordings (for project time confirmations and activity-based time confirmations), not support for Request for Quotation. This is standard system behavior.-See Also-SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App-Keywords-Approval, Request for Quotation, Mobile App

Title: When Confirm a Serial Number in a Pick Task, Error Triggered: Inventory in logistics area not available.
Content: Symptom-When confirm a pick task, enter an in-stock serial number for a product and click Confirm, error triggered:-Line item 1: Logistics area DEF not valid------> Inventory in logistics area not available-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Access view Task Control.-Select warehouse task XYZ, click Confirm.-Under tab Line Items, select line line for example 1.-In the below select tab Serial Numbers, type in serial number ABC, press Enter on your keyboard.-Click button Confirm, error triggered:-Line item 1: Logistics area DEF not valid------> Inventory in logistics area not available-Cause-This serial number has been allocated to other documents.-Resolution-In common task Projected Material Flow, you can find the warehouse requests for which the serial number is allocated. You can open its warehouse task and click Cancel Allocation to free the allocated stock.-Keywords-Serial Number, Inventory, Available, Logistics Area

Title: Dealing with housekeeping issues of database cubes that have large data - Solution Manager
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*Internally released. Use for Product Support guidance for correct supporting team.-The Housekeeping of database cubes e.g. 0HDB_C* fails due to large data in one or more of the database cubes-Which team is responsible for correcting the data in the cubes?-Environment-Infocubes:-0DB2*-0SYB*-0DB4*-0DB6*-0SDB*-0MSS*-0ORA_C*-0DBH*-Reproducing the Issue-During the investigation of the housekeeping issue it has been identified that the issue is due to a large volume of data in the cubes-There is no exact value but as a guideline 500.000 records may be too many-Cause-The data supplied to the Database cubes is supplied by extractors for the specific database-Resolution-It is the responsibility of the team that provides the database metrics to the Database-cube in question in the Solution Manager to make sure that there is not too much data loaded. If there is, it is the team that provides the data that needs to tell the customer how to delete it again and rectify the issue.-E.g. 0HDB_C* is a database cube for Hana data so the issue should be dealt with by the component HAN-DB-For MS SQL server please refer to the KBA 2430136-See Also-1461926 - FAQ: BW report SAP_INFOCUBE_DESIGNS-Keywords-0DB2 0SYB 0DB4 0DB6 0SDB 0MSS 0ORA_D 0DBH

Title: Cannot update Cost Estimate field in Sales Order.
Content: Symptom-You have created a Sales Order linked to a Project and want to update the Cost Estimate of an item.-However the Cost Estimate field is greyed out. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center. -Go to the Sales Orders view.-Search Sales Order ID ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Click Edit.-Click View All.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-Navigate to the Pricing subtab.-Click Expand All.-Notice under Line Product ID XX.YYYYY that Cost of Estimate is greyed out cannot be updated (XX.YYYYY represents the Product ID code).-Cause-The Cost Estimate of a project-based Service in the Sales Order can be only changed if the Invoice Status of the Item is Not Started.-Since the Project Invoice Request DEF was created and invoiced via Customer Invoice XYZ, it is not possible to change the Cost Estimate. (DEF represents the Invoice Request ID, XYZ represents the Customer Invoice ID).-It is not permissible to a edit Cost Estimate in this case because the Cost Estimate is also passed on from the Sales Order to the Project Invoice Request and then the Invoice. -This would result in data inconsistencies. -Resolution-To resolve the issue, you will need to first cancel the Customer Invoice and thereafter cancel the Project Invoice Request. -This would enable the Cost Estimate field in the Sales Order to become editable. -Keywords-Cost Estimate, Sales Order, Project, Project Invoice Request, Customer Invoice, Service, greyed out.

Title: How to add Additional Fields of Main Address in the Business Partner Overview
Content: Symptom-Not able to add Additional Fields into main screen in the Business Partner overview workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partner Data WorkCenter view.-Navigate to New Business Partner Organization in the Common Tasks section.-Navigate to Avatar icon and choose key user settings and start adaptation mode. -In the Screen Layout section choose Main Address.-None of the Additional Fields are available in the Fields section, you can only see the standard fields which are displayed in the Main Address.-Cause-This is expected system behaviour.-The additional fields of the Main Address are only visible if they are filled. The position of these fields are dependent on the country which has been selected in the Main Address Country field since different countries have different address requirements.-Resolution-If the you would like to move the additional fields section to the Main Address section this can be done as follows:-Go to the Business Partner Data WorkCenter view.-Navigate to New Business Partner Organization in the Common Tasks section.-Enter the country in the Country field of the Main Address.-Select the Additional Fields hyperlink.-Enter a value in the field you would like to add e. g. Address Line 1 and press OK.-This field will now automatically appear in the Main Address section.-Navigate to Avatar icon and choose key user settings and start adaptation mode. -In the Screen Layout section select Main Address and the selected field Address Line 1 is now available in the Fields section.-You will need to repeat above steps every time whenever you would like to move the position of the additional field to main Address. -Keywords-move the fields from additional fields section to the Main Address section, additional fields section is not visible in adaptation mode, countries shows different fields under main address.

Title: Total Gross Value of Purchase Order Does not Show in Purchase Order Header Data or Purchase Order Item Details Data Sources
Content: Symptom-You want to see the Total Gross Value of purchase order in the Purchase Order Header Data or Purchase Order Item Details Data Sources however the characteristics does not exist in the data sources. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center -Go to Design Data Sources view -Search for Purchase Order Header Data or Purchase Order Item Details data sources -Select Edit and execute the report for the relevant Purchase Order-Total Gross Value details does not show-Cause-Currently we do not show the Total Gross Price information for purchase order in the data sources and reports that related to purchase orders. This can be taken as a new requirement. -Resolution-You can post the new idea in Influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.Product management team will validate the request and taken for future releases. As a work around, you can create a new extension field (Need to manually fill the value) in General tab or Items tab called Total Gross Value and then extend it to reports. -Keywords-Total Gross Value of purchase order in reports; Total Gross Value of purchase order; Total Gross Value in reports;

Title: JSON Web Token (JWS) based authentication mechanism for Concur and SAP Business ByDesign Integration
Content: Symptom-You are wondering if anything needs to be changed on SAP Business ByDesign side to enable JWS based authentication.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Resolution-The integration with SAP Concur Solutions is automatically adapted to the new JSON Web Token based authentication mechanism. This migration is done automatically and does not require any manual configuration changes. The SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration Guide mentions the configuration steps to set up the integration with SAP Concur Solutions.-See Also-For more details, please check What's New in Cross-Area Topics and help article Set up Communication Arrangement in the Integration Guide.-Keywords-authorization; authorisation; token user; password; credentials; communication arrangement;  JWT; Authentication; change; method; mechanism
