Title: Data Source not showing the time entry data
Content: Symptom-The time entries are not updated in the Data Source XYZ -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Time Sheet view and select Employee A-Open the time sheet and select week 123-Time entries are Active -To check the Data Source-Go To Business Analytics work center -Go To Data Sources view-Search for the Data Source XYZ -Employee Time entry data is not updated in the report-Cause-Employee time confirmations were not visible in the report because it is not posted to accounting successfully yet. -When we check the General Ledger work center - Unposted Source Documents view - We can see employee time calendar is pending due to the financial period closure. -Resolution-The time records which you have released got stuck and you must open the corresponding time periods to post these. -Please unblock the period ABC - Set the first and last allowed step to 010 - operational postings. And then create a Process Control settings to post the time recordings. -Once the time period is open, please do come back to Unposted Source Document entries. Select Actions -> Click on Post Business Transaction. -This should post the time recordings of employee and later, corresponding reports will display the right data. -Keywords-Employee time confirmations not updated in data source, unposted source documents, time entries data is not updated in data source

Title: Error :Product in planning area planned with failures; save and check results of interactive planning log
Content: Symptom-The system throws error while MRP runs for the required product as below-Product in planning area planned with failures; save and check results of interactive planning log-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Search required ID with combination area.-Choose and Open-Choose Run and execute MRP run-System throws above error.-Cause-User is running MRP for required product in combination with planning area where no production model exists for it.-Since Production Model which exists for the product is with Product Requirement Specification however user is running MRP for product with only planning area without PRS combination exists. Additionally, check Output Product is also not PRS enabled.-Resolution-Enable required product with PRS specification and update the production model.-Run MRP again.- Keywords-Product in planning area planned with failures; save and check results of interactive planning log, PRS , MRP run, Product Requirement Specification

Title: You do Not Want to Use Any Approvals for Payment Anywhere in The System
Content: Symptom-Payment entries which are created after undefined date is going for approvals with error-"End date cannot be earlier than yesterday."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Organizational Management work center-2. Go to Employee Work Distribution view-3. Select the Effective date -4. Go to actions, set to undefined-5. Select end date and click OK-Error: "End date cannot be earlier than yesterday." -Cause-This issue is caused because you have not maintained the end date to be earlier than the undefined date.-Resolution-This is the current system Behavior.-As the error tells, the end date for approvals cannot be earlier than yesterday, please maintain the end date to be earlier than the undefined date.-For example, If August 10, 2023, is indicated as the Undefined date. For payment approvals to be withheld, you should have completed it before to August 10th.-You can also maintain "yesterday", "today", or "a date in the future" to be accurate.-See Also-Payment approvals, undefined, Effective date, End date

Title: Error :Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Output Product
Content: Symptom-When trying to confirm the check task, system is not updating the check task status to Finish and throwing error:-Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Output Product -Save failed-   Environment--SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control Work Centre.-Go to Task Control view.-Enter the Production Check Task Id and perform search.-Choose Confirm Button-Choose Finish Result Recording-Now choose Finish Task.-New Pop window opens with "Input Parament for Finish".-Choose Go to complete the task however status does change and throws error.-Cause-The issue occurred since serial number is confirmed before doing finish results recording.-If the serial number is entered in the Confirmation tab, without clicking finish result recording. Confirmation gets created for the entered quantity, however the inspection is still un-finished. Check task cannot be finished without completing the inspection.-Later when finish result recording is clicked the system expects to enter serial number for the inspected quantity, which creates inconsistency.-Resolution-It can be avoided by entering the serial number in check task after clicking Finish result recording.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3254429-Keywords-Check task, Finish results Recording, Task control, Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Output Product

Title: Account balance for Supplier ABC is not 0
Content: Symptom-Supplier Invoices associated with the Purchase Order (in the document flow) are cancelled, still the Account balance for the Supplier used in the Purchase Order is not 0.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center-Go to Suppliers view and search for Supplier ABC-We see account balance is not 0-Cause-If we go to Payables work center -> Suppliers view -> search for Supplier ABC -> click on View, there will be line item which will be in status Open. -Click on the respective External Reference id, Invoices which are not cancelled will appear here.-As there is pending Invoice to be cancelled for the Supplier ABC, the balance was not showing as 0.-Resolution-Cancel the open Invoice. After few minutes, login again and the balance will be updated to 0. -Keywords-Supplier account balance is not 0, account balance of supplier, invoice not cancelled in the purchase order.

Title: Process communication Error Message in Shopping Cart: Enter an e-mail address in the output settings
Content: Symptom-You have entered all the data correctly in shopping cart and there is no output channel required for shopping cart but still system is throwing error in shopping cart: Enter an e-mail address in the output settings-You have maintained automatic purchase order creation settings and expect purchase order to be generated from shopping cart directly.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self Services and Self Services Overview-Track My Shopping Carts-Open the relevant shopping cart ID-Under Items tab go to Document Flow-You can see the process communication error: Enter an e-mail address in the output settings-Cause-Once shopping cart is released, purchase request gets created and then purchase order is generated if automatic purchase order creation settings are maintained.-So, in order to generate purchase order, output channel needs to be maintained.-You have maintained rule "E-mail" as the option for Created Purchase Order in "output channel selection" under Input and Output Management view in "Application and User Management" work center. However, no email address is maintained here or in the preferred supplier master data.-Hence, system is throwing this error in shopping cart because system is not able to find the email address required to automatically generate purchase order from the shopping cart.-Resolution-Please maintain a valid email address in the supplier master data communication-> collaboration sub tab and then create a new shopping cart and check.-OR-Please maintain 3 output channels like printer, fax and email in Output Channel Selection rules, so that system can consider any of them if email address is not found or invalid  and can generate follow up document purchase order automatically from cart considering any of the channels.-Later you can also edit the purchase order and enter relevant email address in "You can also-> Edit Output Settings for changed Purchase Order" if necessary.-Keywords-Enter an e-mail address in the output settings, shopping cart not creating purchase order automatically, process communication error in shopping cart, output channel selection, email address missing for supplier

Title: New Invoice Error - Individual Material XYX is either Obsolete or Blocked
Content: Symptom-When we try to create a new Supplier Invoice , we get the error : Individual Material is either Obsolete or Blocked -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Entry view-Search for Purchase Order ABC -Click on New Invoice-We see the error "Individual Material is either Obsolete or Blocked"-Cause-Go to Fixed Assets work center -> Fixed Assets view -> Advanced Filter -> search for Individual Material ID 'X' -> we find the status of the material is Retired -As the status of the Individual material is Retired, the error occurs. This is not allowing to process the new invoice creation.-Resolution-Please remove the Individual Material which are Retired and then proceed with the creation of the Invoice. -You can also add the active material to the Purchase Order or create a new Purchase Order with the active materials and then proceed with creation of new Supplier Invoice. -As the individual materials are retired, you will not be able to use them further. -Keywords-Individual material is retired, error while creating supplier invoice, Individual Material is either Obsolete or Blocked

Title: Unable to maintain daily overtime premium rule separately for weekends rule
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to maintain different premium pay rule for weekdays and weekends, however system really doesn't skip the overtime rule when premium rule is applicable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview and search for Time Types Activity.-Select Maintain Time Recording Profile.-Select the relevant profile and Go to Overtime Rules tab.-Now Other than Overtime Threshold, if you need to add any specific premium pay rule for weekend, Go To Premium Rules Tab and add your rules.-Save the Entries.-Then you can find Saturday & Sunday gets considered as beyond planned working time hence both overtime as well as premium rule for weekend gets applied to this configuration.-Cause-The feature which should allow to maintain premium pay rule without considering the overtime rule is currently not supported in the system.-Resolution-The feature might be considered for the development topic-Keywords-Time Administration; Premium Pay Rule

Title: Down Payment Request Showing in Exception Status but there are no Errors
Content: Symptom-You have created a down payment request and all details are correctly entered but when you select "Post" , it shows "Exception" status, however there are no errors in the Exceptions tab or on selecting "Check" button.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select view: invoices and Credit memos-Search for the relevant down payment request-Select Check-No errors/warnings displayed-Now select Post-The document gets saved but status is in "Exception"-Cause-The down payment request is created for company belonging to country India and the supplier is from a different country, in such case, down payment request with withholding tax is not supported in Business by Design system.-Resolution-This is a known limitation. Kindly remove the withholding tax from Items->Taxes->Withholding Tax Details sub tab, and then the down payment request will become consistent.-Keywords-not able to post down payment request, down payment in exception status, no errors in down payment request, down payment request with withholding tax

Title: How to Restrict Users From Creating Supplier Invoices ?
Content: Symptom-How to restrict users from creating supplier invoices that do not belong to their company-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User management Work Center-Go to Business Users View-Select the particular business user-Select Edit Access Rights button-Cause- Resolution-To restrict users from creating supplier invoices that do not belong to their company, you have to create Restriction rules.-You can assign the restriction rules to the user in such a way that restricts access to the company to which the employee is assigned.-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Role view-Edit/create a business role.-Assign Invoices and Credit Memos view in work center and view assignments tab.-Choose access restrictions tab, select view Invoices and Credit Memos and assign restricted read and No access to write.-Scroll down and select rule Restrict to Employee's Company-Assign business role to required users and save.

Title: Error : 'Tax region for country United States in item XX is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab' occurs in Customer Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a Customer Invoice Request via webservice Managecustomerinvoicerequestin and the Invoice Request is inconsistent with the error "Tax region for country United States in item XX is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab". The Tax Jurisdiction field is not editable in the invoice request and you cannot pass the same via webservice.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Requests View-Search for Invoice Request YYY(YYY is the ID of the External Invoice request created via webservice)-You can see the Invoice request is inconsistent with error ""Tax region for country United States in item XX is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab "(XX is the Item line number)-In the Invoice request, it is not possible to add the Tax Jurisdiction manually as the field is grayed out and you cannot pass the tax Jurisdiction value via webservice as well.-Cause-The Tax Jurisdiction is determined automatically based on the rules set up in Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules in the Business Configuration. For the system to determine the Tax Jurisdiction you have to ensure, the Sales Unit, Seller, Ship-to , Account party address are maintained accurately with correct tax jurisdictions and other address details.-Resolution-In order to maintain the rules , please follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open the activity list and open activity Tax on Goods and Services - US.-Click Define Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules.-You can add new rows are create your own rules.-Once the rules are maintained, address in parties of the invoice request is consistent , the system will automatically determine the tax jurisdiction for the invoice requests created from the webservice aswell.-See Also-2882306 - Existing US Sales Tax Jurisdiction Determination Rules are not Editable-Keywords-Tax Jurisdiction; Managecustomerinvoicerequestin;

Title: Supplier Name is Missing in Shopping Cart Report
Content: Symptom-You are checking a shopping cart report "Shopping Cart Tracking" but you are unable to see the supplier information in the cart.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Select "Shopping Cart Tracking" report-Open the relevant shopping cart-The supplier field is empty-Now, navigate to the shopping cart screen from this report-The supplier field is still empty-Cause-Since the actual supplier can be changed in purchase request or purchase order in future, hence in shopping cart, only preferred supplier needs to be entered and so supplier field remains empty when you access it from report screen and only preferred supplier field will show the supplier entered during shopping cart creation.-Resolution-To check the supplier information in shopping cart, you can open the shopping cart and under Items tab, open personalization mode, select "preferred supplier" field and flag it to show this field on the UI.-OR-You can check with your partner to create custom field to display the preferred supplier information on the report.-Keywords-shopping cart, supplier missing in shopping cart,  supplier missing in shopping cart report, preferred supplier, Shopping Cart Tracking

Title: Product ID is Not Included In the Project Name field in the FEDI Outbound File (for China)
Content: Symptom-You are using the Fully Digitalized Invoice function (for China only) which was introduced in release 2308. You find the Product ID information is not included in the the outbound file when downloading it from BYD system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Select the Not Released invoice ABC, and click Golden Tax Relevant button. (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice)-In the Golden Tax Processing tab, click Save and Close. This invoice is than marked as golden tax relevant.-Go to the Golden Tax Invoices - Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices sub view.-Select the invoice ABC, click Prepare for Download button.-In the Download File screen, click File Download, system generate the outbound file.-Open the file, in Details sheet, you notice that the Project Name contains the product description only. There is nowhere to see the project ID information.-However, in previous Golden Tax Invoice function, the product ID is presented in the outbound file.-Cause-We have checked with LPE (local product expert), there is no requirement from the legal documents to have product ID in the file.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior in the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices (FDEI) function. -Keywords-Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice; FDEI; Golden Tax Invoice; Product ID missing.

Title: Rejected quantity cannot be reflected in report: Return to Supplier Tracking (SRMRTS_B01_Q0001)
Content: Symptom-You have one return to supplier document which is partially rejected.-However the rejected quantity cannot be reflected in report: Return to Supplier Tracking (SRMRTS_B01_Q0001) as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Return to Suppliers view.-Open return to supplier ABC (ABC represents the ID of affected return to supplier).-See there are rejected quantity X, credit memo quantity Y, and the total quantity is X+Y.-Then go to Report review and open report: Return to Supplier Tracking.-Check the only key figure for ABC displayed in the report <Returned Quantity>, see the value is X+Y.-However the actual returned quantity is Y, since X were rejected.- Cause-There is no key figure <Rejected Quantity> in data source SRMRTS_B01, which is currently a standard design. -Resolution-Please try with extension field to update the rejected quantity into the report.-If you would like to suggest an enhancement of this functionality, kindly turn to our Forum for new requirement proposals: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-This is a place for you to submit any new requirement and also vote for other customers / partners requirements.-Keywords-Return to Supplier Tracking, SRMRTS_B01_Q0001, Returned Quantity, Rejected, 退货至供应商, 否决, SRMRTS_B01

Title: Error When Trying Accessing the Tax Trace Details in the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-User has created a purchase document however when it is displayed the tax trace, throws an error:-Application log information for this run is not available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work center-Go to Purchase Order View-Search for the relevant purchase order-Edit it-Navigate to Items tab-Select the line item-Navigate to Taxes tab-Choose Display link under Tax Trace Details-Error: Application log information for this run is not available. -Cause-User haven't opted the Activate Tax Trace functionality in document so the link displayed the error.-Resolution-The below steps apply to all purchase documents, here using a Purchase order as an example:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Navigate to Items tab and sub tab Taxes-Go to the Actions button and Select Activate Tax Trace-Select Save or Send Update-Navigate to Items tab and move to sub tab Taxes-Click Display link under Tax Trace Details-The log of tax trace will then be visible-If the Tax Trace Details-option does not appear after saving, close the document and open it again.- Keywords-Activate tax trace; Application log information for this run is not available; Purchase order tax trace

Title: Unable to Assign Organizational Unit to a Project
Content: Symptom-The user encounters an issue with recording time for a project when an Organizational Unit is assigned to the Project. Project Task does not appear in the dropdown of the Employee Times/Edit Timesheets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Go to Employees view-Search for Employee ABC-Select Edit-Navigate to the Employee Times tab-Select Add Row-Enter Time Type as Actual Hours worked-Navigate to the Labour Resource tab-Under Project Task Information, for Task select the Value help-Observe the task does not exist. -NOTE: This could also happen in the Self Service - Edit Timesheet.-Cause-The Work Package is not added on the project task while booking the time recording.-Resolution-Follow the below steps to add the Work Package to display the project task while booking the time recording. Please note that these steps has to be performed by each employee to view the task. -Go to Self-Service overview -Select Edit Time Sheet-Select Manage My Worklist -Select Add Work Package-Search for the relevant Project Task XYZ and Save-Now the Project Task appears in the dropdown of the Employee Times.-Keywords- Organizational Unit, Project, Manage My Worklist, Project Task Information, Time Recording

Title: Error: AAA Is Not Available For Selection When Creating New Electronic Financial Report Run In Germany
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create a new electronic financial report run, you are facing the error: AAA is not available for selection when you enter AAA in the balance sheet structure field (AAA represents the balance sheet structure ID). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to 'Electronic Financial Reporting - Germany' view.-Click 'New: Electronic Financial Report Run'.-Enter AAA in balance sheet structure, can see error: AAA is not available for selection.-Enter BBB in income statement structure, can see error: BBB is not available for selection.-Cause-AAA is not maintained in taxonomies for electronic financial reporting under financial reporting structure type: balance sheet.-BBB is not maintained in taxonomies for electronic financial reporting under financial reporting structure type: income statement.-Resolution-Please kindly maintain taxonomy with balance sheet, taxonomy with income statement as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to activity: taxonomies for electronic financial reporting.-Maintain AAA for financial reporting structure type: balance sheet.-Maintain BBB for financial reporting structure type: income statement.-You can also refer help doc: <Assign Financial Reporting Structures> for more information.-Keywords-electronic financial report run, not available for selection, balance sheet, income statement

Title: Dump During Translation of Text
Content: Symptom-After translate text from within the master textpool, Dump appears in the system.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter-Select Textpool view-In the Textpool Administration-Select the master textpool-Select required text-Edit the text and select Ok-It starts translating.-Dump appears on the screen.-Cause-Your Textpool has a huge amount of text elements and has reached a size where it can come to performance issues and UI timeouts for certain actions.- Resolution-When you want to maintain a target text for a text element directly in the UI, use tab Search Translations instead of tab View Translations, this tab view will have a maximum of 10,000 elements only and hence should not run into the UI time-out issue.-Keywords-Textpool, Dump

Title: Identified Stock Shows # for Input Products in Standard Data Source "Production Orders By Header Input Products".
Content: Symptom-In standard data source "Production Orders By Header Input Products", identified stock is # for some input products of a specific production order but actually you have confirmed valid identified stocks for them during production confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Data Sources. -Search "Production Orders By Header Input Products", click Preview.-Under Selection, enter ABC (ABC represents production order ID) into Production Order ID, click Apply.-In the result, some products have identified stock as # Not Assigned.-However, check in the document flow of production order ABC, open the production confirmations, corresponding input products have valid identified stock.-Cause-The data source "Production Orders By Header Input Products" will display the identified stock maintained for input products in the production order instead of the confirmed identified stock in the following production task.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Identified Stock, Production Order, Input Product, Data Source

Title: No Inspection Type Available for Customer Shipment When Creating New Inspection
Content: Symptom-When creating new inspection, there is no inspection type for customer shipment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Access common task New Inspection.-In the screen "New Inspection", open the drop down list of Inspection Type, there is no type for customer shipment.-Cause-In Business Configuration, corresponding question has not been scoped.-Resolution-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Access view Implementation Projects.-Select the Implementation Project and click Edit Project Scope.-Proceed to step 4 "Questions".-Expand Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics > Quality Assurance, select Quality Control, in the right scope question "Do you want to inspect finished products at customer shipment?".-Keywords-Inspection Type, Customer Shipment, Business Configuration

Title: What are Different Error/Warning Messages in Lifecycle Analysis Runs?
Content: Symptom-What are different error/warning messages in Lifecycle Analysis Runs?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Resolution-RFC exception SYSTEM_FAILURE : This happens when Remote system failure occurs and there can be n numbers of reasons which may cause this. Like some temporary system issue, locks on objects being accessed, memory issue etc.-Warning for missing documents : If there are no related documents so you cannot decide when to delete the document and it is correct behavior. The application team with respect to that document can be contacted to know more.-Warnings issued in header, but no warnings in log visible : To check any kind of messages please refer the result tab. This behavior is as expected and comes from MDRO framework. -Error 12 occurred during lifecycle analysis; please create an incident : This error is thrown by MDRO framework while performing ILM process determination. Now '12' is just an error code and system might through various error codes and there can be n numbers of reasons which may causing this like some internal error, infinite loop etc. To put a finger on the reason is quite difficult, it requires deep analysis and debugging to find main cause which is difficult if the error is not persistent indeed.-Keywords-error message , warming message , Lifecycle Analysis runs

Title: When Perform Goods Movement, Information triggered: Logistics area XYZ not found.
Content: Symptom-You are performing goods movement, after click Finish, system gives information "Logistics area XYZ not found" but the movement still succeeds.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access view Goods Movement.-Maintain Site and Storage Location.-Click on Add Row, maintain Product ID, Move Quantity and Source Logistics Area.-Click on Next, maintain Target Logistics Area ID.-Click Next.-Click Finish, information triggered: "Logistics area XYZ not found".-Cause-The stock you are moving is externally-owned stock, hence it is not involved into product planning (in Stock Overview, this stock has planning area ID as blank). However, during goods movement, system is searching on the base of planning area ID and logistics area ID. Since this stock has no planning area, system gives information message as Logistics area not found. However, the goods movement will succeed still.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior-Keywords-Goods Movement, Logistics Area, Not Found

Title: Resulting Balance Items Are Zero In The Direct Cash Flow Statement - China
Content: Symptom-You have selected the cash flow key in petty cash, and you expect the amount to be reflected in the Direct Cash Flow Statement - China report. However, the resulting balance items are all 0 in the Direct Cash Flow Statement - China.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Statutory Reporting view.-Select: Direct Cash Flow Statement - China.-Click new: blank report.-Fill in mandatory fields such as company selection.-The resulting balance items are all 0.-Cause-Table 'GLO_CF_DATA_COLLECT_CA_001' is not populated.-Resolution-You need to populate the table 'GLO_CF_DATA_COLLECT_CA_001'.-Once you populate the table for fields total amount and total comparison amount, you will get the correct amount in 'ITEM description' & 'hierarchy' & 'amount' column.-Keywords-resulting balance items, Direct Cash Flow Statement - China, 直接现金流表

Title: Fine-tuning Activities Locked With Error: Settings Cannot Be Changed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The user tries to Edit or Change an activity in the fine-tuning activities, but the system displays an error message: 'Settings Cannot Be Changed'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud For Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to the Implementation Project view-Select Project-Choose open Activity List-Navigate to the Fine-Tune tab-Search for Activity ABC (For Eg: Code List Mapping)-Select 'Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions'-Select either option  'Maintain Code List Mapping' or 'Maintain Code List Mapping Groups'- Observe an error message: "Settings cannot be changed (KBA: 1692758)"-Cause-Upgrade Failed flag is updated incorrectly in backend table though there is no inconsistency in the workspace. This might happen when multiple BC related activities are happening at the same time in the system and some might get failed.-Resolution-Once when the BC upgrade is triggered, the flags will be updated and the lock will be removed from the fine-tuning. Execute the report by following the below steps to upgrade the flags:-Go to SE38 transaction in the backend-Enter Program: RP_BCT_WS_UPGRADE-Select Execute-The default Workspace ID will be selected-Select Execute without altering the checkboxes-The upgrade flag will now be updated correctly.-Keywords-Settings Cannot Be Changed, Fine-Tune, Upgrade Failed flag, Open Activity List

Title: Not invoiced Costs are Realised for Sales Order Item with Accrual Method Recognize at point of Invoice
Content: Symptom-You assign accrual method 202-Recognize at point of invoice to the project based sales order item XYZ-XX.-You do not create a customer invoice for any of the incurred costs. -You execute the revenue recognition run and notice that the run realised the incurred costs. As no customer invoice exists you expect all costs of sales to remain deferred.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue workcenter and here to the Sales Document Items view.-Select the item XYZ-XX.-Navigate to the Accounting Data sub-tab.-You verify that accrual Method: 202 - Recognize at point of invoice is assigned to the item. -Now press Reports and choose Sales Document - Line items for project.-In the rows maintain G/L account, G/L account (origin), Business Transaction. -You verify that no customer invoice  business transaction exists for the project. -You notice that the revenue recognition run realised the incurred costs. -Cause-The costs that got realised are marked as written off. -You might have marked the respective service as not billable in the project task. Or the incurred quantity/amount was maintained as to be written off in the Edit Time and Expenses screen.-When project expenses are written off they are considered as not invoice relevant. Therefore, they get realised according to their incurrence date rather than on the date when they get assigned to a project invoice request/ the customer project invoice. -Resolution-This is expected system behaviour. -If you need all costs deferred until a customer invoice is created for the project, do not mark any services as not billable in the project or as written off in the Edit Time and Expenses screen. -Rather keep all expenses billable and write off the non-billable expenses when creating the project invoice request. -Keywords-Recognize at point of invoice, project costs realised

Title: After Rehire Employee Remains Inactive in Time Administration
Content: Symptom-After an employee is rehired,  the new validity of the employment is  correctly displayed in the personnel file. But the data is not transferred to the time file. There, still the outdated termination date is shown, which leads to the fact that the employee can currently not submit leave requests or perform time related activities.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Find and Edit the employee-Find correct new employment dates-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Show Active Employees-Notice that the relevant employee is not available as Active-Show All Employees-Find the  employee with outdated Hire and Termination Date-Cause-The issue is caused by a missing time agreement in the backend-Resolution-Open an incident and provide the permission to correct the issue, so that SAP development can perform the correction in the backend. -As soon the time agreement is created, it is possible to manually maintain the Time File in the UI. -Keywords-terminated, being, not available, missing, record, times

Title: Planned Working Time Shows Zero in Report Employee Times: Overtime Overview
Content: Symptom-In report Employee Times: Overtime Overview (HCMTLMU01_Q0013), Planned Working Time is displayed as "ZERO" for employees hired in non-localized country.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports view.-Search for Employee Times: Overtime Overview.-Select View Plan and Actual.-Select Apply.-Planned Working Time for most employess shows 0,00 h.-Cause-Planned Working Time is displayed as "ZERO" because of incorrect configuration. The Employee is assigned with time model with the target hours as "ZERO" in respective daily time models. The Time Type used in the Daily Models is '000010- Working Time" which is not marked relevant for Work Schedule in the configuration.-Resolution-You have to correct the configuration as below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for "Time Types-International".-Click on "Maintain Employee Time Types".-For Time Type used in work schedule "000010", maintain column "Relevance for Work schedule" as "Productive".-Click Save.-Since this is a Time Type change, please ensure correction run is executed for employees assigned already with these time models.-By doing this, Planned Working Times will be regenerated and Planned Working Times should not be displayed as "0".-Keywords- Overtime report; Time Type; Planned Working Time
