Title: "Individual Material" is not showing values in the standard data source "Purchase Order Account Assignment (SRMPO_B03)" and related report
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-"Individual Material" is not showing values in the standard data source "Purchase Order Account Assignment (SRMPO_B03)" and related repor-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics work center-2. Go to Design Reports work center view-3. Search for the 'Purchase Orders per Account Assignment' report-4. Open it, enter the Purchase order -5. Execute it-6. Go to View and Add Fields to Individual Material characteristic-7. You can see the value # instead of any details-Cause-Standard PO Account assignment Data source report individual material id is being floated from Account assignment--> Account assignment type(Individual material)-->Individual material ID.it is not mapped to Item-->Individual material directly.-Resolution-Kindly use other data sources that have these details of individual material and then you can create join data sources.-The documents can be found at SAP Business ByDesign in the SAP Help Portal-If you would like to request for a new field to be included in a data source, you can:-Ask your partner to help achieve it

Title: No Comm. Arrangement Exists for Comm. Scenario ABC(Y123_)and Business Partner
Content: Symptom-You have added a new Service to a communication scenario in the Cloud Studio. You already have a communication arrangement ABC created for this Scenario.-When you try to use the new service, it is not triggered and you see the following error message in the UI:-"No Comm. Arrangement Exists for Comm. Scenario ABC(Y123_)and Business Partner"-ABC represents the name of the related Communication scenario-Y123_ represents the name of the related PDI Solution  -Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Trigger the web service via the UI. -The web service is not triggered and you see the error message displayed. -Cause-There are several reasons for this error to appear related to the configuration when adding a new service. -The communication scenario file (.csd) may not have been reactivated after adding the service.-The service is not selected in the communication arrangement in the UI.-In your request you have tags for the Communication Scenario and the Business partner OR you do not have tags for either. One must be included, both cannot not be included.-Resolution-The communication scenario file (.csd) must be reactivated after adding the service.-Please Checkout the.csd file in the studio.-Save and Activate the CSD.-Check back in the .csd file. -The service must be part of communication arrangement in the UI.-Open the Arrangement in the UI -> Technical data -> Edit advanced settings.-Check that the service is selected for the Communication arrangement.-Check that your request is sending a tag to include either the Scenario OR the Business partner - One must be included but not both.  -See Also-Keywords-PDI, Custom, Web Service, Communication Scenario, .csd, Communication Arrangement, Comm, Business Partner, SDK

Title: Notes Provided in Incident Under Self-Services Overview is not Updated to SAP
Content: Symptom-Users are experiencing an issue within the Self-Services Overview section. When attempting to reply by adding a note under "Track My Incidents," the expected notes is not being received by SAP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Self-Services Overview -Go to Track My Incidents under Service and Support.-Select the Incident and provide the information under Note text box:-Select Submit-Notes is not updated to SAP. -Cause-The notes modified in the Self-Service Overview can only be submitted to Key User. Self-Service work center does not have the option to specify the recipient(Note for Provider) for the updates.-Resolution-The notes or information can be updated through Application and User Management work center, which offers the Note for Provider (SAP)option. The Self-Service Overview is designed for end users to create incidents, which are subsequently validated by Key users. If necessary, these incidents are then forwarded to SAP via Application and User Management -Keywords-Incident, Note for Provider, Self-Service Overview

Title: How Can I Configure the Automatic Determination of the Employee Responsible in Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-How can I configure the automatic determination of the employee responsible in Credit Memo. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select New Manual Credit Memo-The employee responsible is not filled as you expect. -Cause-The employee responsible fetched by the system is the logged on user.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior, the employee responsible will be filled with the business user that logged in.-Keywords-Work Distribution; New Manual Credit Memo;

Title: Purchase Order is not posted to Accounting due to an error message: Cost Center not valid on mm.dd.yyyy
Content: Symptom-Purchase order is not yet posted to accounting, hence follow up documents like Goods and services receipt and supplier invoice are also not posted to accounting.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center-Select Closing Cockpit->Source Documents view-Search for the affected goods receipt document-The Goods Receipt is in status "in process" with following error: Referenced item for Purchase Order not found-Now search for the preceding purchase order which is also in process status-Error: Cost Center not valid on mm.dd.yyyy (refers to date)-Cause-You checked and found that the cost center associated with the purchase order item for which the Goods receipt or supplier invoice is created is valid for that date.-But the receipt was created for purchase order line item say X assigned to cost center say A which had correct validity but the other line item say Y in the order is assigned to another cost center say B whose validity has expired.-Hence system is throwing the validity error because all the items belong to the same purchase order.-Resolution-Please extend the validity of the cost centers assigned to other purchase order line items as well, then you need to first post the purchase order in General Ledger under closing cockpit-> source documents-> unposted source documents.-Then you can post follow up documents like the Goods Receipt document or supplier invoice document.-Keywords-Referenced item for Purchase Order not found, goods receipt not posted to accounting, purchase order not posted to accounting, Cost Center not valid on, No profit center could be derived for forecast document item, No segment could be derived for forecast document item, cost center validity in purchase order items, unable to post goods receipt, unable to post supplier invoice

Title: Unable to Remove a Serial Number for an Input Product in Production Task Confirmation Screen
Content: Symptom-You have confirmed a serial number for an input product in a production task, now you want to remove it, but you find the Remove button is disabled for this serial number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access view Task Control.-Click Confirm against production task ABC (ABC represents production task ID).-Select tab Confirmation, sub tab Input Products.-Select input product DEF (DEF represents product ID).-Select sub tab Serial Numbers in the below, we can see serial number SN_1 (SN_1 represents serial number ID) and button Remove is disabled.-Cause-Once a serial number is confirmed as input product in production task, the button Remove in the task confirmation screen will be disabled for this serial number. The only way to remove the serial number is to reverse the corresponding production confirmation.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Serial Number, Production Task, Remove

Title: How To Restrict Actual Quantity in Supply Task?
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to restrict the Actual Quantity equals to Planned quantity only in a production supply task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control workcenter.-Go to Task Control view.-Search for relevant Supply Task ID.-Select and choose Confirm.-Here user is able to maintain Actual Quantity greater than planned quantity.-Now Actual Quantity field is un-restricted.-Cause-Currently there is no way to restrict the quantity to be entered in a supply task via standard system behavior.-Resolution-Actual Quantity field is  PSM released which can be used and can be restricted as per required business need, via custom solution.-You can check with partner to restrict the actual quantity field.-Keywords-Actual Quantity, Supply Task, restricted, restriction, approval process.

Title: System Crashes While Posting Inbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-System crashes when working with inbound deliveries, and trying to post goods receipt.-Environment- SAP Buisness Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Workcentre.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the relevant purchase order ID.-Choose Post Goods Receipt-System crashes-Cause-The dump is taking place due to the SDD strategy maintained in the receiving site (Location-> Material Flow -> Destination) where the destination determination is set up with last putaway for huge number of Logistics areas.-With last putaway, the SDD engine searches the confirmations (warehouse confirmations) for the products involved in the order for each of the Logistic areas one after another until the right Logistic area for a product is found and the necessary Logistics area constraints are met.-With the amount of huge number of Logistics areas involved and the number of items in the order the transaction times out.-Resolution-Please use a different strategy or reduce the number of LoAs in the material flow rule.-Keywords-Logistics area, Inbound delivery, sap.b.controller.event.PostRequest, MethodName:Post,

Title: AddressSnapshot Result is Empty With Odata Query
Content: Symptom-You have created a Custom Odata Service XXX with BO Customer Invoice. After creating the service the AddressSnapshot result is empty with Odata query. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Select OData services-Select Custom OData services from the dropdown menu-Select XXX (where XXX is your Custom Odata Service)-Select Edit-Select AddressSnapshotPostalAddress-Query the URL-https://myYYYYYY.sapbydesign.com/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/XXX/AddressSnapshotPostalAddressCollection-(Where YYYYYY is Tenant ID)-Cause-Function import is not defined in the Custom Odata. - Resolution-Go to Application and User Management - OData Services-Select existing OData Service and Edit-Select Function Imports tab-Select Add Row-Select Function import type Query-Select the required parameter-Save

Title: Dump Error on Material Cost Estimate
Content: Symptom-You simulate the cost estimate of a material and a dump error occurs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select the New Cost Estimate subview.-Fill in the required data in the fields Material ID, Business Residence, Set of Books and Dates.-Select Simulate.-A dump error occurs-Cause-The cost estimate for the input material failed to accurately retrieves the purchase price list due to cyclic loops created by the Internal Procurement type of the material.-Resolution-Change the Procurement Type of the material from Internal Procurement to External Procurement. The cost estimate will work fine after this change.-See Also-3157010 - Internal Error In The Valuate Action of a New Cost Estimate-Keywords-Material Cost Estimate, Inventory Valuation, Dump Error.

Title: Error Message "Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted Failed; Retry or Report an Incident"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm the Design Acceptance milestone in your First Implementation project, but experience the following error message:-"Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted failed; retry or report an incident."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Click Open Activity List.-Go to the Prepare tab.-Open the activity Confirm Milestone: Design Accepted.-Select Confirm.-System raises the mentioned error message.-Cause-You have scoped question "Do you want to enter supplier invoices via PDF scanning?", but PDF Invoice Scanning not supported from China Datacenter.-Resolution-Please descope the question "Do you want to enter supplier invoices via PDF scanning?" as below:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the First Implementation project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to step 4, Questions.-Expand Purchasing, then expand Supplier Invoicing.-Select the Supplier Invoices and Credit Memos option.-In the right side of the screen, navigate to Entry of Supplier Invoices via PDF scanning.-Uncheck question "Do you want to enter supplier invoices via PDF scanning?".-See Also-3214903 - "PDF Invoice Scanning not supported from China Datacenter" occurs during configuration-Keywords-Confirm Milestone; Design Accespted Failed; Retry or Report an Incident; Business Configuration; First Implementation

Title: Quantity Consumption Of Input product At Check Task In Production Order
Content: Symptom-In a Production Order with Check Task, if the Input product (with backflush as confirmation method) is added after the Production order is Released and is added to the activity previous to the Check Task.-While confirming the check task system will consume the Input product again, which will cause the double consumption of the same input Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view and find the relevant Production Order ID.-Here Production Order is Released.-Edit it and navigate to the execution tab, Order consists of a check task.-Now navigate to the Order Structure tab, select the Produce Activity which exists before check task.-Under Details:Actvity section, go to Input Products subtab and add an input product with Confirmation Method as Backflush.-Now input product is added to the activity previous to the check task.Once it is done, Confirm all the tasks apart from the check task.-Now check the stock of the newly added Input product.-Open the check task and enter the inspected quantity then click on finish result recording.-In the confirmation tab, verify the confirmed quantity and click on Save.-After saving this task, observe that the added input product is consumed again and inventory is reduced.-Now verify the same from the Stock overview.-Cause-Since the added input product's confirmation type is Backflush, the check task is considering all the products added at the reporting point, therefore it is consuming the inventory.-Resolution-Go to the Production Control work center.-Go to the Production Orders view and find the relevant Production Order ID.-Here Production Order is Released.-Edit it and navigate to the execution tab, Order consists of a check task.-Now navigate to the Order Structure tab, select the Produce Activity which exists before check task.-Under Details:Actvity section, go to Input Products subtab and add an input product with Confirmation Method as Explicit.-If the scenario is as depicted, the user has to add a new input product selecting the confirmation type as Explicit.-Keywords-Production Order, Backflush, Explicit, Production Control, Check Task, Activity, Confirmation Method, Consumption, Quantity Consumption

Title: Unable to Download the Newly Added Fields Material ID and Material Description in the Project Stock Order Screen
Content: Symptom-The newly added columns "Material ID" and "Material Description" are added in 2308 version. However it does not show the project stock order view as well as when you export the stock orders. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Show by Items view-Select All Project Stock Order items -Select Export To Microsoft Excel -The fields "Material ID" and "Material Description" are not shown in the excel-Cause-The new columns Material ID and Material Description are hidden under Personalization and you need to enable it from Personalization mode. -Resolution-To enable the field, you can follow the below steps; -Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project Stock Orders-Select Show by Items-Select All Project Stock Order Items -Click on Start Personalization Mode & expand Project Stock Order Items-Enable Material ID and Material Description-Select Save-Now when you export project stock orders, the fields Material ID and Material Description are available in the excel-Keywords-Material ID and Material Description in project stock order

Title: Outlook Add-In Does not Sync E-Mails and Exclamation Mark Appears
Content: Symptom-When trying to synchronise e-mails via Outlook, the attempt fails with an exclamation mark. An Error during Synchronisation might be shown. However, no error is traced in the Synchronization Problems section of Outlook.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example:-Open Outlook-Select the relevant e-mail-Connect with the relevant customer first-Select Contact and Connect and Transfer-An exclamation mark appears-Note: No errors are traced in the Synchronizations Problems section of Outlook-Note: There are no related results in the system in Account Management > Activities -Cause-This error might indicate a missing MIME type in the Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload activity in Business Configuration: There, the MIME TYPE Check is Active, but the MIME Type 'text/html' is not checked as Allowed. -Resolution-Allow this mime type in the Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload activity:-Go to Business Configuration-Open e.g. Overview-Open the Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload activity-Find and select the MIME Type 'text/html' -Check the Allowed box-Save-See Also-For further details about the MIME type, please check the documentation below:-Configuration: Allowed MIME Types for Document Upload---Keywords-mail, email, emails, not working, does not work, synchronization, sync,

Title: Partial Clearing of Supplier Invoice with Supplier Charge/Credit (Israel)
Content: Symptom-When clearing Supplier Invoice with Document Type - Other Receivable i.e, Supplier Charge/Credit partially  or Supplier Invoice with Credit memo( without recording withholding taxes ) then you have observed an issue with the calculation of withholding taxes.-The same calculated Withholding Tax Amount reflects in the Withholding Tax Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Click on Supplier Accounts view.-Select the Supplier ABC.-Click on View.-Select the Document Type - Supplier Invoice and Other Receivable.-Click on Clear Manually.-Here, you have observed the calculated Withholding Tax Amount is not as per your expectation.-For example: You have created a Supplier Charge of 20 ILS(Document Type - Other Receivable) and an invoice amount 100 ILS. You are clearing these documents. Applicable Tax Rate = 30%.-When you click on clear manually, the system will recalculate Withholding Tax on applied amount 20 ILS. It now clears 28.57 ILS from the invoice and the remaining balance is 71.43 ILS.--There is a Remaining Balance of 71.43 ILS in the clearing document, and the same amount appears in the Withholding Tax Return shown below, which is incorrect.The Remaining Balance is expected to be 80 ILS (100 – 20 ILS).-Cause-The initial clearing of Supplier Charge 20 ILS and invoice leads to a clearing of 28.57 ILS from the invoice because there is no provision of recording Withholding Tax on Supplier Charge/Credit.-The system assumes that a payment amount of 20 ILS (Supplier Charge) is to be cleared as there is no Withholding Tax recorded on Supplier Charge and calculates 28.57 ILS from invoice is to be cleared.-Note: In the case of a Credit Memo the Withholding Tax is recorded and the same procedure applies. However, the system knows that is the payment amount is 14 ILS and  Withholding Tax Amount is 6 ILS, that needs to be cleared if the net amount is 20 ILS of Credit Memo.-Resolution-Since there is no provision of recording Withholding Tax on Supplier Charge/Credit like Credit Memo to ensure the system clears the correct amount from the invoice, the Supplier Charge must be posted including Withholding Tax Amount.-Basically, the system assumes that a payment amount of 20 ILS (Supplier Charge) is to be cleared without Withholding Tax Amount on supplier charge and system calculates that 28.57 from invoice is to be cleared for the same using below formula where “X” is the amount to be cleared from invoice and 30% is current rate and 20 ILS is the amount of supplier charge.-X – 30%(X ) = 20 ILS-For example, the below screenshot shows the Supplier Charge = 20 ILS – 30%(20) ILS  = 14 ILS.-As a result, the system will calculate 20 ILS as the amount to be cleared for an invoice,  including Withholding Tax Amount = 6 ILS.-See Also-Keywords-Withholding Tax Calculation in Supplier Charge/Credit, Israel, withholding taxes, WHT-856, WHT-102, WHT-857 returns, Supplier Charge. Withholding Tax Return.

Title: Planned Project Costs or Planned Project Revenue Appear Incorrectly In Project Planning Reports
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You maintain the Project Plan of a Customer Sales Project. You maintain all the planned project expenses in the Work, Materials and Expenses tab and you maintain Planned Revenues for the Project Tasks.-After this you navigate to the Project Overview tab to access one of the Financial Project reports, such as the Project Plan Values report or the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-Here, you notice an unexpected Total Planned Cost amount or an unexpected Planned Revenue amount. -You double-check the Total Planned Cost for the Project in the Cost and Revenue work center where the Planned Costs appear correctly. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-After you have maintained all planned Costs and planned Revenue in the Project Plan:-Navigate to the Project Overview tab of the Project in question.-Here, under Financial Reports open, for example, the Project Plan Values report. -Check and take note of the Result value in the Total Planned Cost or Total Planned Revenue column.-Navigate to the Projects view of the Cost and Revenue work center.  -Here, under Total Plan Values the Total Planned Cost and/or Total Planned Revenue amount is/are different to the Result value displayed in the Financial Project report. -Cause-Most likely this inconsistency is caused due to issues of the FSI views related to the FIA_PROJECT_COST_EST Business Object.-It is also possible that there was an issue when sending on the update from the Project business object over to the project costing business object.-Resolution-If the Project is already Closed you can first try a dummy change:-Open the Project.-In the Project Plan tab, and here in the Basic data sub-tab take note of the Completion date of the project.-Revoke the Status back to Released. -Change the Status to Completed and enter the Completion Date again. -Change status to Closed. -Check the Project Plan data again in the Cost and Revenue Projects view.-If the values are still incorrect check if there are any stuck XI messages:-Request an L6 Support User and access STFK.-Open transaction SRT_MONI. -Select Processing Status Group Incomplete processing. -Under Sender information, in the Party field enter Projectprocesing*.-Under Receiver Information enter Receiver Interface Name field CostprojectcostingIn. -Press Execute. -If there are any fully prossed or stuck messages try to restart/ reconcile them. -If they get delivered check the Project Plan data in the UI again. They should be updated now. -If the values are still incorrect proceed with the FSI Reload:-Reload the FSI views for BO FIA_PROJECT_COST_EST under FSI View FSP_FIN_CAC0* (use the first FSI view of this kind):-Request an L6 Support User and access STFK.-Go to GFSSTM transaction.-Select Business Object and enter FIA_PROJECT_COST_EST. -Press Execute.-In the next screen navigate to the Load Status tab.-Extend the FIA_PROJECT_COST_EST Business Object node. -For all Objects displayed here, check the value displayed in the Number column. If this value is (much) higher than 20.000, it is possible that the reload will take some more time. During the Reload the Business User cannot access any Financial Project Planning reports. Therefore you may consider asking the customer for a suitable time when the Reload shall be performed. -For the Reload select all Objects under the FIA_PROJECT_COST_EST BO.-Press Persistence. -Press Refresh. Once all Objects are reloaded the Loaded Column displays a Green Indicator for all selected Objects. -After this, check the Project Plan Values in the User Interface: Should there still be a difference between the Total Planned Cost/Revenue Result in the report compared to the Total Planned Cost/Revenue amount in the Cost and Revenue work center, forward the incident to Development, SRD-FIN-ANA.-Keywords-Planned Project Cost wrong, Project Plan Values Report, Total Planned Costs wrong

Title: Extension Field Cannot be Added to Advance Search for Sales Order Item
Content: Symptom-You would like to add an extension field to the Advance Search of the product field under the Sales Order item table but you have not been able to achieve the outcome via Adaptation Mode. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open any Sales Order document.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Click Add Row.-Click on the Product value box.-Open Advance Filter.-Click on the User icon (top right).-Select Key User Settings.-Select Start Adaptation Mode.--Here you can see that no option is available to add an extension field to this section of the system. --Cause-This is the system expected behavior. -Resolution-The system does not allow adding extension field to the Advance search of the product field from the Sales Order item level. -An alternative option may be to check the SAP Business ByDesign Influence Portal to submit an idea.-Keywords-Sales Order, Item, Product OVS, Extension Field, Advance Search, Filter-

Title: Project locked when different users work on different tasks
Content: Symptom-Project locked when used parallelly by multiple users -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login with Business User ABC(ABC refers to Business User ID)-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for the Project ID PQR (PQR refers to Project ID).-Select the Project Task PQR-1.-Make the desired Changes (E.g: Change the duration of the Project).-Now login with Business User DEF(DEF refers to Business User ID)-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Search for the Project ID PQR-Error Appears,-Operation not possible; project PQR locked by ABC-Project task PQR-1 locked by user ABC-Cause-This is expected system behavior-Resolution-In general, when same documents is accessed by multiple users at the same time then lock happens, in this case though project tasks are different but it belongs to the same project. Hence lock happens. -When this kind of lock happens, close the system from all the users end who had opened the project, and reopen it after 5mins . System automatically removes the lock.-To avoid such Project locks, make sure that the project is not used by multiple users at the same time.-Keywords-Project Locked; Multiple Users; Different Tasks; User Lock; Not Editable

Title: G/L Account Description Does not Display in the Approval Screen for Scanned Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have sent the supplier invoice for an approval. In the approval screen, system does not display G/L Account description if approver enters the English view. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing my Area work center-Go to Approvals view-Select the relevant approval task for Scanned Supplier Invoice-You do not see the G/L Account description-Cause-The description for G/L Account is not maintained in the EN language and hence it not displayed either in invoice nor in approval screen. -Resolution-In order for system to show the G/L Account description, please follow the below steps; -Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Overview & select the activity Chart of Accounts: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Select Costs & Groups for General Expenses-For G/L Account ABC, you have to maintained the description-Select Save and Close-Keywords-G/L Account description missing in invoice approval screen; G/L Account description missing

Title: Sytsem Failed to Asisgn a Processor to the Notification - Purchase Order ABC with Reference to Project XYZ was created or updated
Content: Symptom- A notification "Purchase Order ABC with Reference to Project XYZ was created or updated" is triggered but not assigned to the Project Manager.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view.-Select Unassigned Tasks.-The notification: Purchase Order ABC with Reference to Project XYZ was created or updated (ABC represents Purchase Order ID and XYZ represents Project ID).-Cause-The system automatically assigns this notification to the Project Manager of the project referenced by the Purchase Order.-  However, the notification was not assigned because the Project Manager's validity period had expired or was not valid.-Resolution-Extend the validity of the project manager and then try to acknowledge the notification. -The user can view this notification in the Home work center.-To process the notification:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Inbox subview of the Work view.-In the Inbox view, select the notification.-From the Actions menu, choose the required action.-Once the action is completed, the notification is automatically removed from your Inbox.-Note: For unassigned notifications, follow the steps below to assign the notification manually:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Business Task Management view.-Select Actions.-Choose Assign Item.-Assign the notification to a valid business user.-Select OK.-The notification will then appear in the assigned user's Inbox for processing.- See Also-Notification - Purchase Order with Reference to Project was Created or Updated | SAP Help Portal -Keywords-Purchase Order; Reference to Project; created or updated; Home; Project manager; user; validity; expire; Notification

Title: Bill of operations created with numerical values through webservice, does not create operations and other related activities.
Content: Symptom-While creating Bill of operations using web services, BOO created with ID including only numerical values does not create Operation and other related Activities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-ManageProductionBillofOperationsIn-Cause- Currently Numeric Values for BOO id not supported through web service.-Resolution-Use the Alphanumeric values while creating the Bill of operations from Web Service.-This has been added to the backlog and will be fixed in future release.-Keywords-Bill of operation, BOO,

Title: Error While Migrating Bill Of Materials
Content: Symptom-The below error message is displayed while migrating Bill of Materials.-Error detected in source record with key value 'ABC'. <ABC> represents sample Bill of Material Id. -Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to the Overview view, search for <Migration of Bills of Material> migration element. -Choose the Execute Migration button, select the option Execute Migration Step by Step. -Error message : <Error detected in source record with key value 'ABC'> displayed. -     Cause-There already exists a bill of material with the same ID in the system. Since duplication of BoM ID is not allowed the system displays the error.  -Resolution-The business user needs to migrate a bill of material with different Id. -Keywords-Error in Bill of Material, BoM Error, Error in BoM.

Title: System Defaults Old Supplier Name While Creating New Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have changed the supplier name and updated in purchasing contracts as well. however while creating purchase order from contract, system takes old supplier name. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to Common Tasks view and select New Purchase Order-Select Add Row and go to Material Item Details  -Enter the relevant Purchasing Contract -System shows the new supplier name in the overview screen -However when you click on View All, system takes old name- Cause-Despite the supplier name is updated in the contract screen, when purchase order is created out of the contract, it will still pick the old name stored in the backend. This is a technical limitation as per current design which can’t be changed.-Resolution-As a workaround you can ask the user to close the old contract and create a new contract with the updated supplier name. Then every  the newly created purchase orders out of new contract, will have the latest supplier name.-Keywords-System Defaults Old Supplier Name While Creating New Purchase Order Document; Incorrect supplier name defaults in PO; Old supplier name

Title: Delivery Notification Run Does Not Select Purchase Orders In
Content: Symptom-The Inbound Delivery Notification Run does not select any purchase orders for processing when executed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the option Inbound Delivery Notification Runs. -Select the relevant Run ID and open the Application Log for the Run.-When you expand the Summarizing Messages you can see that no purchase orders are picked for processing. -Cause-In the delivery notification run, under the section Supplier you have selected the Search Pattern as Equal To. -Against the search pattern Equal To you have entered values under the columns From and To. -Resolution-Against Equal To you should enter only value under the column From. -You can alternatively choose other Search Pattern like Between, in which the values in the column From and To needs to be entered. -Once you maintain values as mentioned above, the issue will be resolved. -Keywords-IDN run Error, automated action error in inbound logistics, IDN Error, automated IDN run error

Title: GR/IR run shows cancelled purchase order Item
Content: Symptom-The GR/IR run shows a cancelled purchase order/Purchase Order Item that is not expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the GR/IR Clearing Subview.-Show All GR/IR Clearing Runs and search for the Run ID: XXX (XXX stands for the GR/IR Clearing Run ID).-Open the Log Results.-Check the Processed Successfully tab.-Purchasing Document Item YYY-1 that is in status canceled is processed by the run.-Cause-The Purchase Order ID: YYY is not marked for final Clearing. (YYY represents the Purchase Order ID).-Resolution- Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Center.-Go to the Master Data view.-Select the Purchasing document Items subview.-Search for the Purchase Order YYY (where YYY stands for the purchase order ID).-Select the Final Clearing button.-Select Mark.-Select a clearing date.-The Purchase Order Item will not be included in the next GR/IR run provided its final clearing date is not in the accounting period selected for the run.-See Also-2080803 - Canceled Purchase Order Line Item Still Showing Awaiting Invoice/Receipts Under GR/IR Inventories - Balance Summary-Keywords-GR/IR run, WE/RE Lauf, Sachkonto, cancelled PO, Storno, Bestellung, Invenotry valuation, Bestandsbewertung, Lieferantenrechnung, Wareneingang,goods receipt, invoice receipt, Cycle EM/EF.

Title: Editable OWL Functionality in Custom Business Objects
Content: Symptom-Users can quickly change a specific field in the OWL without having to opening object details page to make the changes in standard application screen.-You want to know if you can get this functionality of editable OWL for the Custom business objects created via SDK as well.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Resolution-Currently this functionality is not exposed to Partners to implement it in the custom BO's through SAP Cloud Applications Studio. This may be taken in one of our furture releases.-See Also-https://jam4.sapjam.com/wiki/show/Z0g7aZULBzbYeaE3EyPBDi-Keywords-Ediatble OWL in SDK-cannot get editable OWL in PDI custom BO's- enable editing in dataset of CBO OWL

Title: Dump Error on Approval of Withholding Tax Payment (Withholding Tax Challan)
Content: Symptom- You approve Withholding Tax Payment and receive a dump error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approval view.-In Open Tasks, select the Business Task: Approve Tax Payment Difference XYZ (XYZ stands for the Tax Payment ID).-Select Approve.-A dump error occurs.-Cause-The Tax Payment XYZ does not have Challan Identification Number maintained.-Resolution-On Tax Payment XYZ, maintain the Challan Identification Number (CIN) and post the tax payment.-A valid CIN contains data as below:-Bank Branch (BSR) Code - First 7 Characters.-Valid Challan Issue Date in format DDMMYYYY or DDMMYY.-Challan Sequence Number - Last 5 Characters-The total length of the CIN is 20 characters or 18 characters, depending on the format in which the Challan Issue Date is mentioned.-Example:-00043290704200803817-000432907040803817-In the above 2 examples, the BSR Code is 0004329. Challan Issue Date is 07/04/2008 (MM/DD/YYYY). Challan Sequence Number is 03817.-Keywords-Dump Error, Tax Payment Approval, Challan Identification Number, Withholding Tax.

Title: Originally Created On Date is not Updated in "Note for Provider" Incident Memo
Content: Symptom-Originally created on date is not updated in Note for Provider Incident Memo-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Incidents view-Search for Incident ID-Navigate to General tab-For few memos created on date is missing-Cause-Originally created on date and time represents when the note is updated by SAP Support in Customer support system. The note takes few minutes to reflect from Customer support system (BCP) to customer system .This data is only present when SAP Support writes back to customer via incident. The Note for Provider is from customer system to SAP Support so it doesn't requires this date.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Memo , Note for provider , note from provider , Incident memo, created on date and time

Title: Employee can see Supplier Invoices in the Header Search Despite the User is Restricted
Content: Symptom-You have restricted the employee to see another company supplier invoices however when they search the invoice in the header search, system shows the invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Go to header search and search for relevant supplier invoice -System displays the supplier invoice -Cause-The employee is restricted to Read and Write access for supplier invoices. When they do search in invoices and credit memos view, system will not display the invoice. However it will still display the invoice, when you do the search in the header search. -Resolution-In header search, system will show all the invoices from the repository that is stored under Invoices and Credit Memos view. Here system does not filter the invoices based on access restriction. Further, if user tries to modify it, system will throw an error message stating - You are not authorized to access the data. This is an expected behaviour. -Keywords-Header search shows invoice that belongs to another company

Title: You are Not Able to Create Multiple Customer Invoices from One Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You want to know if it is possible to create multiple invoices from one outbound delivery invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices Requests view.-Select the outbound delivery invoice request ABC. (ABC represents the invoice request ID). Let's say the quantity is 10 ea.-You want to partially invoice this invoice request for 5 ea now, and later on create another invoice for the remaining quantity. So you can have more than one customer invoices from one outbound delivery.-Cause-It is not possible to change the quantity when invoicing the invoice request. You have to fully invoice it in one customer invoice.-If you want to have multiple customer invoices for this sales transaction, you need to create multiple delivery documents.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-customer invoice; partially invoiced; fully invoiced; multiple invoice.

Title: File Path for the Standard Field "Cost Center" in Consumption for / Return from a Cost Center Screen
Content: Symptom-What is the file path for the Standard Field "Cost Center" under the BO GoodsAndActivityConfirmation.-Environment-Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics workcentre and open Consumption for / Return from a Cost Center-Locate Cost Center Field-User wants to know the field path for this field under BO GoodsAndActivityConfirmation.-Resolution-Path for Cost Center field is:-APGAC_GA_CFM (GoodAndActivityConfirmation BO) -> InventoryChangeItem -> AccountingCodingBlock -> ACC_CODING_BLOCK_ASSGNMT-COST_CENTRE_ID-User can navigate from root of GoodAndActivityConfirmation to COST_CENTRE_ID by following the above associations.-Keywords-Cost Center,path, GoodAndActivityConfirmation, BO

Title: Not able to update the Customer details in the Project
Content: Symptom-Wrong Customer details entered while creating the Project. Not able to update/remove the Customer details in front-end after releasing the Project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center.-Go to Projects view.-Select the Project ABC and go to Accounting tab.-Customer detail is maintained as XXX , there is no option to modify/remove the Customer details in front-end.-Cause-Customer details or Customer ID cannot be modified/removed for the Projects which are in Released/Closed status.-Resolution-As the Project is in Released status, there is no possible way to modify/remove the Customer details or Customer ID now.-Please proceed with creating a new Project with the correct Customer details.-Keywords-Change customer details in Project. Released project modification, Customer ID update in Project

Title: Bank Statement Item Details Report Shows Wrong Transaction Amount Result
Content: Symptom-You want to see the total result of the transaction amounts through report Bank Statement Item Details (Report ID: FINPAYU07_Q0001). But you find that the total result is not equal to the sum of all transaction amounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Go to List view.-Open report Bank Statement Item Details.-Enter the required parameters and click Apply.-Show Result Row of Statement ID.-The Result amount is not equal to the sum of all Transaction Amounts.-Cause-The Result row is not based on the sum of the transaction amounts therefore the result is different than expected. The Result characteristic can be performed on any column however this a Line Item based report and will therefore not display the total sum of the line items. With this in mind, the report takes the Bank Statement Line with the highest value and displays this as the Result.-Resolution-As this is the expected system behavior in this case, you may suggest a change on our Customer Influence web site. Here other customers can see your ideas and inputs and if they are interested, they can vote for this change in functionality. The more votes it receives, the better the chances are of getting this functionality implemented.-As an alternative, there are other reports which do sum the Transaction amounts:-Cash Position by Transaction Source (Report ID: FINPAYU03_Q0002)-Cash Position - Transaction Details (Report ID: FINPAYU03_Q0003)-See Also-Bank Statement Item Details-Keywords-Bank Statement Item Details, Transaction Amount, Result, FINPAYU07_Q0001

Title: "Error during delivery update" Occurs During Accepting Deviation
Content: Symptom-When trying to accept deviation in monitoring view against a  warehouse task , system throws an error " Error during delivery update".-Environment-Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center-Go to work Monitoring view-Find the relevant warehouse task ID and accept deviation against that task.-System throws the error message "Error during delivery update"-Cause-Serial Number profile of the products is being changed to mandatory after release of Inbound Delivery notification.-Before the release, as the serial number profile is not mandatory, user is  able to release the Inbound Delivery notification without providing Serial Numbers.-However after the release, while accepting deviation for the items in the task, it is changing the status of Delivery process to Finished as a reason system is checking the Serial number validation.-Resolution-Either set the Serial number profile status in product master data as "Optional" for the products-OR-Provide the serial numbers in Inbound Delivery Notification.-Keywords-serial number, Profile, Inbound Delivery notification,Error during delivery update

Title: Unable to find Duration Field in Self Service Overview
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to book vacation Duration field is missing from the UI.-Environment-Source: byd-Type: Productive System-System ID/Name: CLOUD / my349307.sapbydesign.com-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign 2305-System managed by: SAP Cloud Tenant-Install base item: my349307.sapbydesign.com-Sold product: BYD INSTALLATION-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home workcenter-Select Self Service overview-Select New Leave Request link-Apply Full Day or Half Day Vcaation-Duration field is not available.-Cause-Full Day / Half Day leave does not have Duration field.-Only Partial Day leave has Duration field.-This is the same behavior in Time Administration-Full Day / Half Day - Duration Field is greyed out-Partial Day - Duration is active -Also, in case you have used below configuration:-1. In Time Account Posting of selected Time Type is mapped to Time Account Type which has Unit in Days.-2. In Special Posting Order of selected Time Type is mapped to Time Account Type which has Unit in Days.-Resolution-In case you want to use Duration field, use Partial Day-off.-For causes 1 and 2, follow below steps for resolution:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Select Implementation Project view-Select Fine Tuning Activity-Search Time Types activity-Maintain Employee Time Types -Open and select required Time Type-You will see under Time Account Postings or Special Posting Order Time Account Type is mapped-Now, open Time Accounts activity-Maintain Time Account Types-Search the above Time Account from point g-You will notice it has Unit defined as Days and not Hours--For standard Time Account Types, you will not be able to change the Units, then you can create a new similar custom Z Time Account Type for your requirement.-Keywords-Full Day, Half Day, Partial Day, Vacation, Leave

Title: Sorting of Purchase Order ID Column Does not Work in the Line Item Level of Goods and Service Receipt
Content: Symptom-You have created goods and service receipts for multiple line items. When you go to items tab, sorting does not work in the Purchase Order ID column. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center -Go to Receipts and Returns view-Select the relevant Goods and Service Receipt -Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Go to Purchase Order ID column and try to Sort by Ascending or Descending-Sorting does not work-Cause-The sorting for the column Purchase Order ID in the Goods and Services Receipt screen will work when all the line items belong to different purchase order IDs (Multiple purchase orders are created as a single Goods and Services Receipt). However when all the line items belong to the same purchase order and only the item line ID differs, and due to the concatenation of purchase order and line-item ID it will not work. -Resolution-This is a technical limitation currently when all the line items belong to the same purchase order. The improvement can be taken in the future releases of ByDesign. -Keywords-Sorting of Purchase Order ID Column Does not Work in the Line Item Level of Goods and Service Receipt; Sorting of Purchase Order ID Column Does not Work

Title: BaseQuantityMeasureUnitName tag is Missing in the Output XML of Purchase Order Reminder Letter
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order reminder letter. However when you check the output XML, system does not show the BaseQuantityMeasureUnitName tag. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Order Reminder Letter Proposal-Select the relevant proposal-Click on hyperlink & open Output History tab-In the View Data XML - BaseQuantityMeasureUnitName tag is missing-Cause-In the current design, the output XML for purchase order reminder letter does not show the BaseQuantityMeasureUnitName tag. -Resolution-This can be taken as a new requirement and can be taken for backlog management. Please feel free to add the request in the influence forum.  https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-BaseQuantityMeasureUnitName tag is Missing in the Output XML of Purchase Order Reminder Letter; BaseQuantityMeasureUnitName tag; Purchase Order Reminder Letter;

Title: Inbound delivery ID's are missing
Content: Symptom-Some Inbound delivery ID's are missing from the screen and you notice that the ID 's are not in sequence.-Environment-Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center.-Go to Overview and find activity: Document Numbering Formats for Inbound Delivery-Select and open,  you notice that the number range is correctly maintained-Cause-This is usually during locking of numbers. At times cases where multiple IDs are processed to get created, the number range get locked and if not used during that time due to any errors, we will not be able to generate the same number again.-This is a usual issue with number ranges and can happen not only with inbound delivery but with any of the delivery documents-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-See Also-Number range, missing, ID, Inbound Delivery, Document

Title: 'Jump' in the Individual Material ID of a consecutive Fixed assets
Content: Symptom-The Individual Material ID number range in Fixed Assets shows an unexpected jump. Instead of being assigned sequentially (for example, from 100 to 101), the next generated ID increases significantly (for example, from 100 to 300), resulting in a gap of unused IDs between the assigned values.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed assets work center-Search for all the assets and in the column 'Individual material' you see for a certain point of time, IMATs are sequential in nature, but suddenly a big jump is observed in the ID-Cause-This is standard system behavior. Consecutive numbering of Individual Material IDs is not ensured, and skipped numbers are expected under certain processing scenarios.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The Individual Material ID (IMAT) is shared with other business objects, such as Products. When Registered Products are created, they also consume Individual Material IDs. Therefore, gaps in the IMAT numbering sequence can occur.-As a result, sequential Individual Material IDs for Fixed Assets cannot be guaranteed, since other business objects may use IDs before new assets are created. This behavior can be verified in the backend but is not visible in the user interface.-Keywords-Fixed assets, Number Range, IMAT, Individual Material

Title: The Calculation of Material Substitution Variance in the Production Variance Details Report
Content: Symptom-The customer hopes to know the calculation formula of material substitution variance in the Production Variance Details Report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Reports view.-Select Report: Production Variance Details Report.-Input parameters such as Company, Set of books, Production end date, and Production lot.-Click 'Apply'.-In the view section, add input material and input resource.-You can see the material substitution variance result displays as AAA for material XXX.-Cause-Production Variance Details Report compares the actual costs with material cost estimate costs.-Hence, the material substitution variance equals to actual cost of material minus material cost estimate costs.-In the Production Variance Details Report, you can find actual cost of material as BBB.-The cost per unit of this material can be found in the Material Cost Estimate Rollup Run which is CCC.-The quantity of the material used can be found in the report as DDD.-Material cost estimate costs is equal to the quantity multiplied by cost per unit which is CCC*DDD.--Hence, material substitution variance = BBB - CCC*DDD. -Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-Material Substitution Variance, Production Variance Details Report

Title: Calculation of Output Price Variance and Lot Size Variance in the Production Variance Details Report
Content: Symptom-Customer hopes to understand the calculation formula of output price variance and lot size variance in the Production Variance Details Report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Reports view.-Select Report: Production Variance Details Report.-Input parameters such as Company, Set of books, Production end date, and Production lot.-Click 'Apply'.-In the view section, add input material and input resource.-You can see the output price variance result displays as XXX and lot size variance result displays as YYY.-Cause-Lot size variance = lot size independent standard cost * (confirmed quantity/costing quantity - 1).-Lot size independent standard cost: Please refer to Material Cost Estimate where overhead cost is AAA which is not dependent on lot.-Confirmed quantity: Please refer to the report, which is BBB.-Costing quantity: Please refer to the report, which is CCC.-Hence, Lot size variance = AAA*(BBB/CCC-1).-Output price variance = Standard input - Actual output - ∑Input variances - Lot size variance.-Standard input: Standard input is based on estimate, and you can find it in Material Cost Estimate. which is DDD.-Actual output: Please refer to the journal entry related to the production lot, which is EEE.-Input variance: Please refer to the report, which is FFF.-Lot size variance = AAA*(BBB/CCC-1)-Hence, Output price variance = DDD - EEE - FFF - AAA*(BBB/CCC-1)-Resolution-System behavior.-Keywords-Output Price Variance, Lot Size Variance, Production Variance Details Report

Title: Access Restriction for Business User is not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-The Access Restriction assigned to Business User is not working as expected, users are able to edit Accounts for which they do not have access.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Select Business User view.-Search required Business User ID XXX (where XXX represents Business User ID).-Edit and open Access Rights.-Select Access Restriction tab.-Select required Account -You will observe Access Context is 1010 Employee and Restricted Access is given based on Sales Unit.-The employee is able to see Accounts created by another Business User. This user is not a part of the Sales Units assigned to XXX in Access Restriction.-Cause-The access to view an Account is not dependent upon the user who creates the Account.-Case 1: -Restriction Rule 01:-01 - Restrict to Employee and Assigned Employees of Org Unit-Tooltip: Restricts access to employee and the org units for which the employee is the reporting line unit manager-User XXX can access all Accounts where XXX is Employee Responsible.-Manager of XXX can access all the Accounts where XXX is Employee Responsible.-Case 2:-Restriction Rule 99:-99 - Define Specific Restrictions-Detailed Restriction: XXX is selected in the Sales Org Unit.-Any Employee having this Business Role will be able to access all Accounts where XXX is Employee Responsible.-Case 3:-All Homeless Accounts are visible to all Business Users. These Accounts does not have any Employee Responsible.-  Resolution-The system works as designed.-Keywords-Access Restriction, Account, Sales Org Unit, Access Context  1010 Employee

Title: Sales Document Showing Error Currency Missing
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -When customer is trying to use or navigate through a sales document, they face the error Currency Missing.-In this example we will use a Sales Quote.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Quote).-Click Edit.-Error shows.-Cause-Potentially when the document was created, the currency value was not active or maintained in the account. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Please ask the customer to perform the following steps to remove the error:-Go to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Quote).-Click Edit.-Remove the Reason for Rejection.-Remove the Currency.-Hit Enter.-Enter the previous currency value again.-Error is removed.-If customer is also facing a process communication error, check the following:--Sender Party: CustomerQuoteProcessing    -Receiver Name Interface: ProjectProcessingCustomerTransactionDocumentAndProjectAssignmentIn    -Error Information: Error message CM_PRO_PPVOCTD must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task   --Try restarting the message. If it is not delivered with a restart, check whether the Sales document in Completed.-If the document is now completed and all follow-up documents were created, ask customer's permission to cancel the XI message.-See Also-2788413 - Error "Currency missing" While Migrating the Open Sales Orders-Keywords-Currency, Missing, Sales Document, Error, Task, CM_PRO_PPVOCTD, CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT

Title: You are Unable to Access the Tenant With Error "You are not Authorized to Access UI Application."
Content: Symptom-While accessing the tenant the following message is displayed:-"You are not authorized to access UI application."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the tenant URL-Cause-There might be several causes for the issue.-Resolution-Please try to login with the user in a different desktop or laptop.-Try clearing browser cache and cookies and try accessing the system.-Also, you can contact your network team in order to verify if there are any restriction regarding the tenant.

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2308 Hotfix Collection 2 Information
Content: Symptom-The following is the list of fixes*- delivered with Hotfix collection 2, performed in the 2308 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after 16 September 2023. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window for your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2308 HC 02-Resolution-Cross-Area-Cross Country Extensions -Release 2308 had an enhancement on External Tax Event Determination, which was susceptible to producing unexpected tax-calculation results when evaluating the business partners who pertained to private or corporate accounts. Necessary corrections have now been made to ensure regression-free tax calculation. (Hotfix ID: 4500021791)-Statutory Reporting-By using the custom form template of Form Group Code G15, users can now generate customized account statements as per their needs. (Hotfix ID: 1000026623)-Customer Language Adaptation-The Mongolian language and two scripts in Azerbaijani are now enabled for users, so they can translate labels, messages, tooltips, and other UI texts into these languages. (Hotfix ID: 1000027711)-Business Partner-The Script code field is released for Public Read Access in Business Partner and Address Snapshot business objects. (Hotfix ID: 1000021979)-  Financial Management-Expense Reimbursement Management-The statutory rates for UK mileage have been updated in response to legal changes in mileage rates, effective September 1, 2023. (Hotfix ID: 4500020415)-Financial Accounting-In the past, while creating a manual journal entry voucher - selecting a material did not lead to the automatic selection of its appropriate unit of measure if its quantity was zero. Also, the unit of measure did not automatically change with the change in the type of material selected but remained what it was. With this hotfix, the issue is now resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000026734)-Tax Declaration-For Mexico, with respect to the import-relevant tax codes 13, 14, and 17, end users can now select 'Zero' tax rate for VAT tax type when used along with the IEPS tax type. (Hotfix ID: 1000024109)-For Seychelles, the Tax Identification Number (TIN) tax-number type is now available. (Hotfix ID: 1000024516)-For the France CA3 VAT return form, form box 16 now displays the correct value. The value of form box 10, which should be added to the sum of the other values that are considered for computation of the amount for form box 16, was earlier erroneously subtracted. The error is now rectified. (Hotfix ID: 1000024956)-For Spain, a new tax event 38 (Domestic Acquisition, Electricity, Special Rate) along with tax code 38 (Domestic Acquisition, Electricity, Special Rate) have been delivered. (Hotfix ID: 1000025556)-For Spain, the end users can now successfully execute a withholding tax return run, using SAP Cloud Applications Studio. (Hotfix ID: 4500015839)-Due Item Processing-Data models are now loading successfully for the 'Date Part Split' defined scenario in the MLC cockpit. (Hotfix ID: 4500020415)-  Human Capital Management (HCM)-Personnel Administration-For France, in the Personnel File screen, users can now add custom tabs and create extension fields. (Hotfix ID: 1000027012)-Resource Pool Management-In Resource Planning Management, the erroneous calculation of an additional day of planning for an employee due to the time-zone conversion factor - is now rectified. (Hotfix ID: 4500022170)-  Supply Chain Management (SCM)-Execution Material Flow View-When the number of logistic areas in a site is greater than 200 and the material is present in an external warehouse, the projected quantity of flow displays correctly now. (Hotfix ID: 4500022180)-Site Logistics Task-The positive and negative signs of the amount in B100 and B110 are now as per system signs. (Hotfix ID: 1000024418)-For a registered product, the Open Chart shows correctly and no longer produces dump files, including for nested hierarchy. (Hotfix ID: 1000025782)-The web service is now correctly returning the data pertaining to the employee specified. Earlier it was displaying even the data unassigned to others. (Hotfix ID: 1000026902)-All inbound tasks are now correctly showing the Supplier Part number in the UI. (Hotfix ID: 1000027160)-Material Supply and Demand View-Necessary correction is done to populate project stock orders in the SCMMSDVV02 data source. (Hotfix ID: 1000023897)-  Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)-Purchasing Contract-The tasks on "Approved Purchasing Contract XXX Changed After Release" and "Goods and Services Receipt XXX Approved" are now automatically assigned to a user if the user has access to the work center of the corresponding document. (Hotfix ID: 4500022012)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g., operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also- KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2308; HFC02;

Title: Access Restriction Not Working as Expected
Content: Symptom-You have setup access restrictions for objects such as for example Invoices based on a specific Company, but the restriction is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue can occur for other work centers and views and we will use the Customer Invoicing work center and Invoice Requests view as an example:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Select All Invoice Requests from the drop down list.-The user is able to see Invoice Requests for a Company for which he is not assigned in the Access Restrictions for this work center and view.-Cause-The user is assigned to the Data Privacy work center with Unrestricted Access.-This is a work center meant to administrators, that have full access to the system. This work center assignment overwrites other restrictions.-And/Or-The user is assigned to the PARTNER DEVELOPMENT FOR MCS and PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT work centers.  .-These work centers should only be assigned to a development user and not to a standard business user.-Resolution-If the restriction is needed, the Data Privacy work center has to be also restricted or unassigned.-If you are using Business Roles for your access rights assignment of the user you need to correct the Business Role as follows: -Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Roles view.-Open the Business Role XYZ (XYZ represents the Business Role ID assigned the business user).-Click on the Edit button.-If you would like to remove the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY from the Access Rights of the Business Role:-Go to the Work Center and View Assignments tab.-Uncheck the Assigned to check box for the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY in the PERSONALDATAREMOVAL Work Center View ID and the PERSONALDATADISCLOSURE Work Center View ID.-If you would like to restrict the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY from the Access Rights to the Employee's Company in the Business Role:-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Filter for the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY.-Ensure that the Read and Write Access is of the PERSONALDATAREMOVAL Work Center View ID and the PERSONALDATADISCLOSURE Work Center View ID have the Restriction Rule 01 - Restrict to Employee's Company.-In the the Work Center and View Assignments tab uncheck the Assigned to check box for the PARTNER DEVELOPMENT FOR MCS and PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT Work Center ID. -Save your changes.-Click on the Assigned Users button and select the Update Users option.-If you do not use Business Roles but manage the Access Rights directly in the Work Center Assignment and the Access Restrictions of the User:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Roles view.-Search and select the business user ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the business user).-Click on the Edit button and select the Access Rights option.-If you would like to remove the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY from the Access Rights of the Business User:-Go to the Work Center and View Assignments tab.-Uncheck the Assigned to check box for the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY in the PERSONALDATAREMOVAL Work Center View ID and the PERSONALDATADISCLOSURE Work Center View ID.-If you would like to restrict the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY from the Access Rights to a specific Company in the Business User:-Go to the Access Restrictions tab.-Filter for the Work Center ID DATAPRIVACY.-Ensure that the Read and Write Access is of the PERSONALDATAREMOVAL Work Center View ID and the PERSONALDATADISCLOSURE Work Center View ID are restricted and have only Read and Write Access to the respective Company.-In the the Work Center and View Assignments tab uncheck the Assigned to check box for the PARTNER DEVELOPMENT FOR MCS and PDI_PARTNER_DEVELOPMENT Work Center ID. -Save your changes. -Keywords-Access Rights; Company; Restriction; not working; Access Restriction; User; Business User; Business Role;

Title: Submit Button is Disabled in Open Sales Orders
Content: Symptom-Submit button is disabled in some sales orders with status Open. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center -> Sales Orders view. -Select Sales Orders ABC and DEF. (ABC and DEF represents 2 sales order IDs)-For sales order ABC the Submit button is enabled, but not for sales order DEF. -Cause-"Submit -> Send Order Confirmation to Account" will be enabled when there is a change in the sales order which need to be updated to customer. -Resolution-This is a standard system behavior.

Title: ChaRM: 00024error during logon when creating Transport Request from ChaRM document
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are working with a Normal change document and when trying to create transport request for the managed development system the error "00024error during logon" is displayed.-TRUSTED and TMW RFCs to the corresponding development system work fine (connection test and Remote Logon for TRUSTED).-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Go to sm_crm (or crm_ui)-Edit Normal change document-Go to Transport Management assignment block-Click on Transport Request button-Create transport request-Cause-In the managed development system last version of Note 2758146 is not implemented or incompletely implemented.-Resolution-Please go to the corresponding development system and make sure that last version of Note 2758146 - SAP Readiness Check for SAP S/4HANA & Process Discovery (evolution of SAP Business Scenario Recommendations) or SAP Innovation and Optimization Pathfinder is completely implemented. After that please try again to create transport request from ChaRM document.-Keywords-Create transport request, ChaRM, 00024error during logon, TMW, TRUSTED, RFC, TMW_GET_PROJECT_SWITCHES

Title: Script functionality for Employee Screen in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add script details for the Employees, however Script Field is missing in the Employee Screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personal Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Click on Hire Employee-Enter the details, you don't see Script option-Click on Save -Open the created Employee, Edit and You don't see Script option there as well-Cause-Expected behaviour, as this functionality is not supported in HCM area.-Resolution-We checked the UI screen for personnel employee file and there is no such field for Script functionality. This is not supported in HCM. This could be new requirement.-See Also-Further please check the below links:-Using Multiple Scripts-Using Multiple Scripts-Keywords-Script, Employee

Title: Sales Kit is Not Supported in Revenue Recognition Capabilities
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When creating a new sales order and entering a sales kit item, the Revenue Accounting Contract is not filled.-Environment-SAP Business Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center view.-Create a new sales order, enter account, sales unit data.-In items tab, add a sales kit item.-Go back to general tab, the Revenue Accounting Contract is empty. However, if the user enter a product or a service, the Revenue Accounting Contract is auto filled.-Cause-Sales kits currently do not support any revenue recognition capabilities.-see blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2017/10/11/ifrs-15-asc-606-new-accounting-standards-for-revenue-with-customers/-In "Boundary conditions for the * Accounting Contract" section, it states that:-"Sales kits do not support revenue recognition (as in previous releases). Neither the sales kit header nor it’s items can carry an accrual method. Therefore all revenues and cost on these items are realized immediately. Moreover these sales order items that refer to a sales kit do not take part in the allocation basis of a revenue accounting contract. On sales kit items no sales conditions are currently derived, therefore also no standalone selling price in the *revenue accounting contract is available."-In help center document: Sales Document Items:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2dd6d5d5722d1014a245ba37cd1b2074.html-In the "Reassign an Accrual Method" section, you will notice that there is a Note info that states: "You cannot assign an Accrual Method to a Sales Kit Product ID or Sales Kit Product Description".-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-sales kit; revenue accounting contract; revenue recognition.

Title: An Error: 554 5.4.14 Hop count exceeded - possible mail loop ATTR34 occurred in the Purchase Order Output History
Content: Symptom-User has created a PO and have updated it. During the PO submission Output History is shown as "Error".-Error displayed: 554 5.4.14 Hop count exceeded - possible mail loop ATTR34 [PR2FRA01FT004.eop-fra01.prod.protection.outlook.com 2023-08-03T15:25:44.777Z 08DB93AE56ED99C1]-554 5.0.0 Service unavailable -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Workcenter-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the Purchase Order ID: XYZ-Select View All-Navigate to the Output History tab-Observe the status of the document is displayed as "Error".-View the Error hyperlink and notice the error description:-554 5.4.14 Hop count exceeded - possible mail loop ATTR34 [PR2FRA01FT004.eop-fra01.prod.protection.outlook.com 2023-08-03T15:25:44.777Z 08DB93AE56ED99C1]-554 5.0.0 Service unavailable -Cause- There could have been a temporary issue while document output on receiver side. -Resolution-Resubmit the PO output document, this will solve the issue and send the document successfully to the recipients.-For further understanding on the error code, you can also refer to the below list:-https://serversmtp.com/smtp-error/-See Also-Purchase Order, Output History, Error status, 554 5.4.14 Hop count exceeded - possible mail loop ATTR34

Title: Is it Possible to Configure "Business Partner Approval Request" on Company Level?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement that the "Business Partner Approval Request" approval process can be configured by company, because you have two independent companies that need different approvers, however reviewing the configuration of the approval process "Business Partner Approval Request". It is evident that there is no condition to set the approver by company in the Work distribution is by direct Approver.-When trying to set conditions, there is no options related to company code.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-[Enter your Reproducing the Issue here...]-Cause-Business Partner Approval Request cannot be determined by company currently. It also relates to Supplier Approval only, not to Accounts.-Resolution-To achieve the requirement, you can add an extension field that indicates to which company a supplier belongs to. This extension field can be used in the configuration of the Approval conditions.-For a company for which no approval is desired, this could be set to auto-approval.-Keywords-Supplier Approval, Company level, company ID, customer, customers, supplier, account, accounts

Title: Project Task Reassignment status stuck with the status "Wait for retry"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Status of project task reassignment status appears as "Wait for retry" in the time and expense items for the project.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to the Project Management work center -2.Go to the Time and Expenses view-3.Go to the Advanced filter & select the relevant Project ID-4.Select Reassignment Status as In Process-5.You can see around few entries pending for reassignment with "Wait for retry" status-Cause-The lock could have happened for many reasons.
