Title: Common Issues With CSV Files in Data Workbench and Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-This knowledge base article collects some of the issues that occur when using the CSV file format consumed by Data Workbench and Mass Data Maintenance, usually due to the file's encoding or Excel's auto-formatting options.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-Issue-Cause-Resolution-Characters with umlauts and other special characters (e.g. ö, ü, ß, ä) are not displaying correctly in the exported CSV file.-Excel automatically uses the data format ANSI to open files. The server creates the CSV file with the data format UTF-8 if it uses Unicode. If the UTF-8 format CSV or text file is opened by Excel, then multi-bytes characters become unreadable.-You can either:-Open the CSV file using the Excel Import Wizard and specify UTF-8 or UTF-16 as the File Origin;-Open the file with a CSV editor other than Excel.-Please note: all visible UTF-8 characters are supported — that means that control characters are not supported.-When attempting to import a CSV file using Data Workbench, you receive the error message "Error due to unsupported formatting in the CSV file" or "Invalid file format".-On Mass Data Maintenance, you may see message "File could not be Parsed Successfully".-These errors may be caused because your file is in different encoding format than UTF-8. Both Data Workbench and Mass Data Maintenance only accept files in UTF-8 format.-Additionally, when using Linux or Mac, it might be related to the end of line control characters. Linux uses LF (line feed) and Mac uses CR (cartridge return), while the system expects the CR+LF type, standard in Windows.-There are many ways to convert the file to UTF-8 encoding. You may use the program of your preference and which is approved by your company's IT directory, but here are the instructions to do it with Notepad++:-Go to Menu and select the option Encoding;-Select the option Convert to UTF-8;-Now save the file on Menu > File > Save as;-Give a name for the file and add the CSV extension (e.g. filename.csv).-A file which you exported from Data Workbench or Mass Data Maintenance is being rejected after you update it and try to re-import it, with an error such as "Invalid Date Format".-If you're opening the file with Excel, the auto-formatting functions may be changing the date format from SAP's format to Excel's (dates are being changed from YYYY-MM-DD to D/MM/YYYY, currency is being changed from USD to US Dollar, etc.)-You can either:-Open the CSV file using the Excel Import Wizard and specify the Column date format as General;-Open the file with a CSV editor other than Excel.-When attempting to import a CSV file using Data Workbench, you receive the error message "Upload error; Unsupported file format".-This error message may be occurring because you are trying to upload a CSV-Migration-Template to Data Workbench.-The Data Workbench tool only accepts CSV files from its own work center (from Download Metadata in Import view, exported from Export view or templates created in Templates view).-The CSV-Migration-Template is a special type of CSV template, accepted exclusively in the Migration tool.-To avoid the error message, please use the CSV templates downloaded using the button 'Download Metadata' from each Object in the Data Workbench work center, templates downloaded from Export view and/or the templates created in Templates view.-When attempting to import a CSV file using Mass Data Maintenance containing the special character ", some letters following this character are removed from the text (most likely the letter L).-The special character " has character utility and has a specific meaning in the mass data maintenance code logic, so this behavior occurs because Mass Data Maintenance mistakes the characters " in the CSV template with the character logic applied in its code.-To avoid this behavior we recommend avoiding the use of the special character " in Mass Data Maintenance. However, as a workaround after validation, you can input the text again for the lines which have the special character " in it.-      Keywords-CSV templates, data workbench work center, mass data maintenance work center, CSV format, common issues, CSV files, does not match, material, selected, file, total,

Title: Update Tax Rate Type for Material using Mass Data Maintenance or Migration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update the Taxes tab of Materials using Migration of Materials with the Enhance already existing records. However you are getting the errors as-"Taxes: Invalid value 'ABC' in column 'Country/Region of Tax Authority' detected" (ABC is Country)-"Taxes: Invalid value 'XYZ' in column 'Tax Rate Type' detected" (XYZ is Tax Rate Type)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration -> Overview-Search for the Migration of Materials activity-Click on Migration of Materials using the Migration Tool-Upload the file-Click on Properties & Set as Enhance already existing records-Execute the Migration Step by Step-On the Simulate stage you get the errors-Resolution-As part of  2305 changes, there was a plan to remove region field as not mandatory field and made tax rate type field as mandatory which was causing the issue for Vietnam material update.-As per our investigation, above fix is blocking the material update in Mass Data Maintenance and proposing ODATA as workaround for customer to update the material Tax data.-Also, we see  OData is updating the data correctly.-Please find the below pay load detail:-GET-Read the data-1.https://{{TenantHostname}}/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/mat_tax/MaterialCollection?$filter=InternalID eq '{{P-MaterialID2}}'&$expand=MaterialDeviantTaxClassification&$format=json&$select=ObjectID,UUID,InternalID,MaterialDeviantTaxClassification-2PATCH -update-https://{{TenantHostname}}/sap/byd/odata/cust/v1/mat_tax/MaterialCollection?$filter=InternalID eq '{{P-MaterialID2}}'&$expand=MaterialDeviantTaxClassification&$format=json&$select=ObjectID,UUID,InternalID,MaterialDeviantTaxClassification-Body:-{-    "ObjectID":"FA163E22049E1EDD89EBEF3D1B7F9791",-    "TaxRateTypeCode": "3"-} -  Tenant hostname and mat_tax need to be changed accordingly in customer tenant payload.-See Also-2498592 - Error Message While Uploading Tax Data for Materials Using Mass Data Maintenance -OData Example: Create and Update Product Data in SAP Business ByDesign | SAP Blogs-Keywords-Tax Rate Type, Material, Migration of Material, Enhance Already Existing Records.

Title: Error 'Postings to resource xxx found; change/deletion not possible'
Content: Symptom-Customer is trying to change the Valid from/Valid to date of cost center assigned to the labor resource, but system is giving error: Postings to resource xxx found; change/deletion not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Resources view.-Search and select Resource: xxx.-Change Valid from/Valid to date of the cost center, an error occurs: Postings to resource xxx found; change/deletion not possible.-Cause-The system is not allowing you to delete or edit the cost center assignment if it will affect posted data.-You can verify the postings for Resource xxx in the report: General Ledger Line Items.-You need to add the field: Resource ID and Resource by selecting the add field function on the top right hand corner.-Then you can filter for Resource ID: xxx, and see the postings.-Because of these postings the customer cannot delete the cost center values that they have against Resource xxx.-Resolution-The system is working as expected. -Keywords-cost center, labor resource, cost center assignment, 成本中心分配

Title: "The Message was Rejected by Organization Policy" Error in Output History
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer has submitted a document and generated the output e-mail. However in Output History the output has status Error. Once clicking on the error link, the system displays one of the following messages:-"TRANSPORT.RULES.RejectMessage; the message was rejected by organization policy"-"550 Administrative prohibition - envelope blocked"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-As an example for this document, we will use a Customer Invoice document:-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Enter the Invoice Documents view.-Search and select the invoice document.-Click on the ID to open the document.-Click on the View All button.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Here you can see the output entry with status error. Click on the Error hyperlink.-Here you can see the error message.-Cause-The error is likely caused by the output e-mail being bounced back from the destination server. This generally happens due to internal policies which block certain e-mails, e-mail addresses or IPs.-Resolution-Customer needs to check with the recipient of the output e-mail for any blocked messages. SAP Support can send the incident to the Hosting Operations Team to verify the IPs from which the e-mails are sent from the Business ByDesign tenant, so the customer can verify any blacklisting on the target e-mail server.-Keywords-e-mail, output, SOST, SPC

Title: Planned Working Time is Different From The Standard Data Source
Content: Symptom-User has created a custom report from the data source 'Employee Times - HCMTLMU01' and the Planned Working Time displayed is different from the Standard Data Source report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics Work center-2. Select  Design Reports view-3. Search for the custom report "ABC"-4. Open the report "ABC" and run-5. Check the results for "Planned Working Time (PLNDTIME)" Key Figure. -6. Visit the View section and add Date, observe the report has the Planned Working Time displayed incorrectly-Cause-The user has not maintained correct Key Date selection for the generated report.-Resolution-User has to maintain 'Current Month to Date' in the Date field under Key Date selection for the Employee Times report.-By selecting 'Current Month' as the Key Date, the system considers data up to today's date + 1 day. However, when the Key Date is set to 'Current Month to Date,' the system accurately considers data only up to today's date. It is important to note that this solely pertains to the dates used in the report to retrieve data and does not have any business impact. -Follow the below steps to select the Key Date field for the Employee Times report:-1. Go to Business Analytics Work center-2. Select  Design Reports view-3. Search and open the Report "ABC"-4. Run the report-5. Go to Selection Tab -6. Enter the  Employee ID and Maintain the Date field as  'Current Month to Date' under  Key Figure -7. Execute the report-Now the Planned Working Time field will show the accurate hours as expected.-Keywords-Standard Data, Key Date, Current Month to Date, Report, Employee Times

Title: G/L account not available for selection in New Manual Tax Entry
Content: Symptom-You notice that certain G/L accounts are not available for selection when creating a New Manual Tax Entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management Work Center.-Select VAT Entries.-Click New Tax Entry--Result: In the drop-down G/L account, you notice that the G/L account XXX(XXX represents the G/L account ID) is not available for selection.-Cause-The G/L accounts available to choose in the drop-down are not G/L accounts, they are in fact G/L account Groups. These are defined in Business Configuration Activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination->Edit Account Determination Groups. Only the groups defined under General Ledger can be used if they have the indicator Available in Other Transactions checked.-Resolution-Per your business needs, make available the G/L account group required by marking them as Available in Other Transactions.-Keywords-gl account, missing, appear,

Title: The retired fixed asset still reflect value in "Value Adjustments" in the Schedule of Fixed Assets report
Content: Symptom-You are running the Schedule of Fixed Assets report.-You display already retired Fixed Asset ID: AAA. -You notice even though the asset is fully retired, the amounts still reflect under "Value Adjustments".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets work center.-Go to Reports view.-Search for report: Schedule of Fixed Assets. -Enter the Fixed Asset ID: AAA.-You can see for the fixed asset ID: AAA, even though the asset is fully retired, the amounts still reflect under "Value Adjustments".-Cause-The Schedule of Fixed Assets Report shows accrued values for a particular time-period in order to reflect the movements for an asset; completely irrespective of whether a Fixed Assets by now is retired.-The value in the "Value Adjustments" relates to the posted customer invoice and retirement.-Resolution-System behavior-Keywords-Schedule of Fixed Assets Report, Value Adjustments, Fixed Assets, Retired Fixed Assets

Title: Error Message: "Labor resource assignment mandatory for project time recording on DD.MM.YYYY."
Content: Symptom-When trying to approve time recording for Employee ABC the following error occurs "Labor resource assignment mandatory for project time recording on DD.MM.YYYY."-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Team work center.-Access the Edit Time Sheet view under the Common Tasks section.-Select the Employee ABC and select the Approve option.-You receive an error message "Labor resource assignment mandatory for project time recording on DD.MM.YYYY."-Cause-It is not possible to post employee times when there is no Resource maintained. Labor resource assignment is required for Project Time Recording to calculate the project's internal costs based on labor resource cost rates.-Resolution-In the Time Administration work center, in the Regular Tasks view, under Time Valuations, click Run Day Closure for One Employee.-Specify the Employee ABC.-Select the action Select Start Time Valuation-Click Run to specify the valuation start date.-Note:-You can select the Backdated Labor Resource Changes checkbox to include backdated changes to assignments to a labor resource for the valuation run.-Please verify whether the assigned cost center has the valid labor resource created.-See Also-Time Valuation: Correction Run | SAP Blog-Keywords-Time Valuation, Labor Resource, Run Day Closure, Project Time Recording

Title: Issues with Access Restrictions for the Expense Report work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-Business User has restricted Read & Write access to the "Expense Reports" work center ,but still user is able to access "New Expense Report on Behalf Of" Work center View.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application & User Management Work center-Navigate to the Business User View-Select any Business User & Edit the access rights -Select the Expense Reports Work Center in the Access Restrictions Tab-Here you can see Read & Write Access as Restricted for Expense Reports Work Center.-Cause-There is an Inconsistency in the Access Restrictions-Resolution-Restore the SRBAM Policy for the affected Business Users.-Refer below KBA for generating the SRBAM Policy:-2827370 - How To Regenerate RBAM Policy for "You Are Not Authorized to Access UI Application" error-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2827370-Keywords-Access Restrictions, SRBAM, Business user, Read & Write Access

Title: How to Add Sum row in the Supplier Invoicing work center in SAP Business ByDesign(BYD)
Content: Symptom-This KBA will help you on how you can add Sum row in the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center-Go to Invoice and credit memos-Search for any Supplier Invoice with more than one Quantity-Click on "Start personalization mode"-Go to Items tab-Under UI elements "Item"-Right Click on mouse under Quantity field and you will get an pop up window at side of items-Select "Table calculation"-For "Configure calculations" have maintain SUM under the four possible Column Name.-However and despite this configuration being published, you cannot see any Yellow line at the bottom of the the items line with the total being calculated.-Resolution-Please Follow the below steps to add sum row to Items tab:-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center-Go to Invoice and credit memos-Search for any Supplier Invoice with more than one Quantity-Click on "Start personalization mode"-Go to Items tab-Under UI elements "Item"-Right Click on mouse under Quantity field and you will get an pop up window at side of items-Select "Table calculation"-For "Configure calculations"-For quantity select "Sum"-Mark "Display Result Rows at Top of Table"-Click on apply-The user has to expand the table explicitly to see the total row -It will display the sum in the yellow row as displayed in the below screenshot.-Keywords-Sum, Supplier Invoice, Adaptation, Items, Quantity

Title: Not Able to Release Customer Return Due to Error:Gross Amount Must Not be Positive.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Not able to release the customer return ABC due to the error:Gross amount must not be positive. (ABC represents the return ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Find return ABC, there is a warning message at the bottom: Gross amount must not be positive.-Click Release - With Credit Memo or Release - Without Credit Memo button, system shows error: Return cannot be released; gross amount is positive.-Cause-In the Total Pricing section, there is a price component 'Restocking Fee' added manually via web service which is a positive value. It is not redistributed into items.-Resolution-Currently, there is only one customer facing this issue. You can double check the customer name in reference ticket (find it in internal memo). If you receive the issue from the same customer, you may run the report below to correct their documents.-Log into backend system.-Open transaction se38.-Enter report name "Z_CORRCET_RETURNS_01".-Click Execute.-Enter the return document IDd in the text field and execute again.-This can be used by support, as there is no complexity involved. Document can be edited now and price component can be removed. You can then ask customer to modify the pricing as per their business scenarios.-Keywords-Customer return; Gross Amount Must Not be Positive; Restocking Fee, Backend, SE38, Z_CORRCET_RETURNS_01, Error, Message

Title: Not able to invoice the outbound delivery invoice request
Content: Symptom-System shows error Message "Organizational unit ID ABC does not exist in master data" in the Sales Order Invoice Request, due to that you are unable to invoice the corresponding outbound delivery invoice request.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Requests view-Select All Invoice Requests and click Advance Filter button-Under Preceding Document enter relevant sales order id and document type as Sales Order-Click Go-System will show the inconsistent Sales Order Invoice Request-Click check button-System shows error Organizational unit ABC does not exist in master data" (ABC represents the organizational unit id)-Cause-Customer Invoicing functions is not selected  for the organizational unit ABC.-Resolution-Go to Organizational Management work center-Select Edit Org Structure-Select today's date in the Effective-from date field-Click Find and search for the organizational unit ID ABC-Click Locate-Go to the Functions tab-You need to tick the box for Customer Invoicing to assign this function to the org unit-Save the changes-Now you need to redetermine the invoice request XYZ as follows: (XYZ represents the Invoice Request ID)-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoice Requests view-Search for invoice request ABC-Select the invoice request and click the Check button-Click Redetermine All-Keywords-Unable to Invoice; Values missing in Invoice; New invoice missing values;

Title: Error message Occurs while login via Single Sign-On
Content: Symptom-When User tries to login via Single Sign-On below Error message Occurs in the logon screen:- "SAML20 SP (client 016):  Exception raised:SAML20  SAML20 CX_SAML20_CORE: No RelayState mapping found for RelayState value " -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer -Reproducing the Issue-Login to the Tenant Via SSO URL-You will see Error message: "SAML20 SP (client 016):  Exception raised:SAML20  SAML20 CX_SAML20_CORE: No RelayState mapping found for RelayState value "-Cause-In the IDP settings Audience Restriction contains the exact Name of Service Provider that you can check on "Local Service Provider" inside C4C or BYD SSO Settings. The name of the Local Service Provider is not set or incorrectly included in the Audience Restriction element.-Resolution-The Audience Restriction is case sensitive.-you have to use upper case for HTTPS in the URL while login via SSO.-Keywords-Login issue, SSO, SAML20,Relay State

Title: Filter for Job in Employees View Not Working in Time Administration
Content: Symptom-CASE1: Column filter for job in All Employees is not fetching results for employees whose termination date is between today's date and unlimited.-CASE 2: Advanced filter for job in All Employees is not able to fetch data -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-CASE 1:-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Apply filter on column "Job"-If All Employees are selected it is not working as expected. It shows all the data-If Active employees are selected it is working as expected.-CASE 2:-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Apply advanced filter-If All Employees are selected it is not working as expected. It shows all the data-If Active employees are selected it is working as expected.-Cause-There is a difference in the query built for the Active employees and for All employees in which the parameters for filtering out based on dates are different for both these cases and this seems to be the design for this two queries.-Resolution-To filter out employees based on job role ,use below path:-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Apply Advanced Filter on Job.-See Also-2587216 - Filter for Basic Search in Resource Management Does Not Work As Expected -Keywords-Advanced filter, column Filter, Time administration, Job Role

Title: Bill-To Tax Number is Not Presented in Customer Invoice XML
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Customer Invoice with a different Bill-to party then the Account/Buyer party and after releasing the document, you have noticed that the Tax Number of the Bill-to is not presented within the XML structure.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Search for ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click on the View Data XML button.-Search for TaxNumber -Under the section <TaxationTerms>, the Bill-to tax number is not maintained.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. --The Bill-to party tax number is not part of the taxation data for the Customer Invoice document. -In case you would like to have this information maintained, as an alternative option, please check the SAP Business ByDesign Ideas Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-Customer Invoice; Bill-to; XML; Tax Number; Missing; Bill-To Party; <TaxationTerms>.

Title: If the Quantity Changes, the Net Value will also Change in Sales Quote / Sales Order
Content: Symptom-When the quantity is changed in the sales quote, it changes the Net Value as well.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the example of Sales Quote, but it works the same way for Sales Order as well.-Navigate to the New Business work center.-Select the Sales Quotes view.-Search and edit ABC (ABC represents Sales Quote ID). -Navigate to Items tab.-Change the quantity of line item from 1 to 1.1.-The Net Value changes from 60 to 66 accordingly.-Cause-The price fetched from Price list is taken to be for the UoM maintained at that time.-So when a product is added and quantity is maintained as e.g. 1 each, the system applies each as the UoM for the product. Any later changes to the quantity are adjusted accordingly.-  For example, the price for quantity 1 is 60 EUR and any changes made after that will adjust the net value accordingly.-The price of 0.1 quantity is 6 and the value of 0.01 quantity is 0.6. So according to the change made in the quantity the net value gets adjusted.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Quote; Sales Order; Net Value; Quantity; UoM; Change

Title: Prerequisites on Tenant Refresh Request from SSO Configured Tenant
Content: Symptom-This document is to provide prerequistes when requesting tenant refresh from a source tenant which is SSO configured-Possible Scenarios,-Scenario 1:-In the Production (Source tenant), tenant is configured for SSO-In the Test (Target tenant), tenant is configuration of User Name and Credentials-Scenario 2:-Both Source and Target are SSO configured-Environment-SAP Business byDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-SSO Configuration-After Tenant Refresh, tenant ID/URL of the target tenant is constant, or in other words, it stays the same after the tenant copy.-Nevertheless, it will be required to configure SSO in the target tenant.-Tenant refresh is nothing but create new fresh tenant with the whichever Data Source you have selected and replacing the URL, so physically the connection is broken so SSO configuration needs to be done from the scratch.-Resolution-Before raising refresh request make sure that there is at least 1 key user in production system (source tenant)-1. Who can login with password. So the same user login into the target tenant to re-configure the SSO configuration.-2. With correct email configured if needed to set password via 'Forgot Password'-Note:-If you don't know how to change the User login typ from SSO to User ID and Password, you can follow the steps: Application User and Management work center -> Business User -> Select the Key/Admin User -> Click on Edit and edit the Security Policy and change it to either "Default Password Policy for Business Users - Version 2" or one which you have defined to login with the User ID and password. -Once you have done the changes to the Security policy for the Key/Admin User, you can raise the tenant refresh request, so that once the refresh is done, you have the User ID and Password which you can use to login without any issues.-See Also-To know more about Tenant Refresh, refer to the Help Center Documentation-2340655 - How to Request Tenant Refresh in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-sso, tenant refresh, forgot password, login

Title: System throws Error Message 'Certificate already exists'
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to upload the certificate, the system throws error message 'Certificate already exists'. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management Work Center-Navigate to Certificate Trust List view -Choose Edit Certificate Trust List view -Select upload & Browse the Certificate-Select the relevant Certification Authority certificate-Choose Open & Add the File-Error Message : 'Certificate already exists'-Cause-The Error occurs because of below reasons:-When User tries to upload the same certificate which is already exist in the system.-The system behavior may be due to an inconsistency.-Resolution-You have to verify the Certificates whether it is already exists or not.-Case 1:-If Certificate is already exists still you wants to upload the new Certificate, Follow below steps:-Select the Existing Certificate.-Delete it-Save the changes & Upload a new one-Case 2:-When you are trying to upload a new certificate but still getting the error message.-Please open a SAP incident by providing permission to perform backend Correction.-See Also-3146465 - Error: 'Certificate already exists' after Copy of Productive System-Keywords-Certificate already Exists, Certificate Trust List, Error Uploading Certificate.

Title: Purchase Order is not Generated Automatically from Third Party Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a third party sales order and scoped the automatic creation of purchase orders in Business configuration scoping question.-So, you expected the purchase order to be created automatically from that sales order but it was not created.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Select sales orders view-Open respective sales order-Navigate to document flow-Purchase order is not generated-Cause-You have created the sales order before scoping the automatic purchase order creation settings.-Resolution-Kindly set up all the necessary scoping questions before creating any business document and after any Business configuration changes, please create a new document and test.-Any changes will be applicable to the newly created documents.-Keywords-automatic purchase order creation, third party purchase order.

Title: Advanced Search in Activity List Showing Wrong Results when Setting Filter to Exclude
Content: Symptom-When using the Advanced Search option in Activity List, the filter is set to exclude an activity type (example: Instructional). However, the search results show all Instructional activity types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In Business ByDesign-Go to Business Configuration work center-Navigate to Implementation Projects view-Mark the relevant project and Open Activity List-Select the dropdown to be All Activities-Click on the Open Advance Filter button-Under Activity Type, click on the More Filters button-Tick the box But exclude-Set the Options as Equals to and choose your value (example: Instructional)-Click OK and press Go-  In Cloud for Customer-Go to Business Configuration work center-Navigate to Implementation Projects view-Mark the relevant project and Open Activity List-Select the dropdown to be All Activities-Click on the Advance Search button-Under Activity Type, click on the More Options button-Open the Exclude section and set the Condition to Equals to, and enter in the value (example: Instructional)-Click OK and press Go-  In this example, the search results for excluding Instructional activities shown only Instructional activities, the opposite of what was searched for.-Cause-This is a current system behaviour in the filter search. The query entered is considering excluded values as include, which is resulting in an incorrect search list.-Resolution-This has been added to the product backlog and it will be fixed in upcoming releases.-Keywords-Advance Search, Advance Filter, Filter, Activity List, Exclude, Include

Title: Error message "A technical error occurred during consolidation"
Content: Symptom-While performing Data Flow Verification Run system throws an error message "A technical error occurred during consolidation".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management Work Center-Navigate to Data Flow Verification Runs-Verify the "Run to check CPEL and Accounting" Runs-Check the relevant Application Log-You can find the error - A technical error occurred during consolidation-Cause-The reason for the failure of the job run is due to the high volume data which results in an error.-Resolution-You have to reschedule the Run id again and verify the Run.-If you are still facing the same issue then you have to create a new run only for CPELs and starting from a specific date and they can narrow down the selection parameter with Company ID.   -Steps for creating New run:-Go to Application & User Management Work Center-Navigate to Data Flow Verification Runs-Select New & Create Run only for CPELs-Keywords-Data Flow Verification, Run, DFV run, Technical error, Check CPEL

Title: How to add/enable Extension Fields ?
Content: Symptom-This Document helps us to create/add extension fields in the UI, Easy Form Editor & Adobe life cycle-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Creating Extension Field in the UI-The Extension fields are added via the Key User Adaption Process in the UI. Once the field is added, We can use those fields to the other processes or forms.-Here we are extending the Product Master Record with “Material Description 2”-Go to the Product data work center. -Navigate to Materials View.-Start the Adaptation Mode, you will get the  adaptation screen in the UI.-Select '+' symbol & Select 'Extension Fields' to add new fields.-Create your Extension field (Example: Material description 2), add name, type & Save it.-Select the Extension field choose the Show Further Usage by Using this function you can add your field to multiple processes, data sources or form templates. -Depending on the object you are extending, your choice of forms, data sources and extension scenarios will vary. Since this field is on the product master there are no forms by default to add this field .-Here you can use data available in the “Extension Scenarios” tab and move this field to other processes where you can add it to a form. For example when you want to add this field to the invoice, you have to select the mentioned extension scenario “Material – General Information to Customer Invoice Request – Item Information”.-Publish your Changes .-Adding Extension Field in the Easy Form Editor-Above we have selected extension scenario as Customer Invoice Request – Item Information for the extension field “Material Description 2”.-Go to Customer Invoicing Work center -Navigate to Invoice Requests-Select any Customer Invoice to edit & Start the Adaptation Mode-Edit the items & open the extension fields (using the “+” ) you should see your extension field (Material Description 2).-Select the field & Choose the “Is Already Added” box, it will then be added to the UI Screen-To add this field to the print form Choose “Show Further Usage”. Highlight the Form Template appropriate for the countries that you use in your system-Select  the button Add Field and Edit-Choose Easy Form Editor from the dropdown. This will open up the form where you can add your extra field. -In this example since the new field is found in the Items table, we need to select the section “tblTable” and add a new column to show the field then it will open dialogue box that enables you to navigate to your added field.-Select the Material Description 2 ,add it-Refresh the preview on the right of the screen to see the new field on your template.-Publish your Changes-Adding Extension Field in the Adobe LiveCycle Designer(ALD).-Kindly Create Extension Field in the UI & Follow the below steps to add it in ALD.-Go to Application and User management Work Center-Navigate to Form template maintenance -Search for respective Form template & Download it-Open the file with .xdp extension in Adobe LiveCycle Designer(ALD) to modify the content.-Select any field in the form and go to the data binding section-Select the use ‘Data Connection’, to see the extension field is already added-Use binding -> Data Connection -> Form Name -> Extension field-Place the extension field in the desired page layout & SAVE the .xdp file-Login back to the UI & Go to Application and User management Work center.-Here, upload back the modified/enhanced .xdp file in the Form template maintenance.-while uploading, you can replace an existing variant of the form template or add as a new variant. In this case, use the option – ‘Add as a New variant’.-Once the new file is uploaded, select ‘Publish’ for the new version of the template -Open the updated form template ,you could see the extension field as part of the form template.-Note:You can always go back to the previous version of the template by using ‘Revert To’ in the option Versions -See Also-https://blogs.sap.com/2020/01/30/adding-extension-fields-to-print-forms-in-business-bydesign/-Keywords-Extension Fields, Easy Form Editor, Adobe life cycle ,adding ,Creating ,UI

Title: Error while trying to release Outbound Delivery via Webservice
Content: Symptom-When trying to execute the Outbound Delivery via payload , system throws below error in response payload.-A technical error occurred: APDL_VAL 008. Report an incident.-Action RELEASE not possible; action is disabled-Release not allowed-Number range configuration not determined- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Login to SOAP UI.-Open the required Project-Execute the given request payload for an outbound delivery-Cause-The request payload has tag <glob:OutboundDeliveryReleaseReq_sync> which is used to release the instances of an outbound delivery and not to create one.-Further, when you check in the system, the relevant outbound delivery: XYZ does not exists in the system at all to be released. Hence system is unable to find the data and throwing errors.-(i.e. Here XYZ refers to an Outbound Delivery ID)-Resolution-Kindly use the correct tag to create a new outbound delivery in the system.-Keywords-Outbound delivery, A technical error occurred: APDL_VAL 008. Report an incident,  Action RELEASE not possible; action is disabled, Release not allowed, Number range configuration not determined.-

Title: Email Notifications on Customer Cases
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer receives Email notifications for cases.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Resolution-When cases are created from the customer system, the system will send email notifications in the following cases:--1. When we get the case in Service now.-2. When we start processing the case in Service Now.-3. When we send Async info to customer (external Info).-4. When case is sent to customer, means 'Solution proposal by SAP' or 'Awaiting requestor'.-5. When case is confirmed, a mail for survey will be sent out.-Note: SAP Status will change according to the action taken at SAP side on the case.-Notifications are sent to the case Contacts when a support case is updated by SAP.-See Also-1292299 - How to get notified when support incidents are updated by SAP - SAP ONE Support Launchpad [customer facing]-2497370 - How to Scope Email Notifications in C4C for Support Incidents [customer facing]-Keywords-Email Notifications, Updates in incidents.

Title: Schedule of Fixed Assets Report does not dispaly Fixed Asset XXXX
Content: Symptom-You are running the report Schedule of Fixed Assets, which is meant to show the schedule of fixed assets for each asset class, and observe that the Fixed Asset XYZ(XYZ refers to Fixed Asset ID) is not displayed.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Design Reports View.-Click open the Schedule of Fixed Assets report.-Enter the mandatory fields and the Fixed Asset ID: XYZ in order to fetch the report.-The report is not dispalyed.-Cause-For the Fixed Asset XYZ, you have not maintained the Organizational Assignment with the end date extending till the key date of the report.-For example:-You see that for Fixed Asset XYZ under Master Data, the assignment is valid from 01.06.2016 to 30.03.2017 only. However, the report is ran by keying in Accounting Period/Year: Year to Date. All the other Fixed Assets belonging to the same asset class might have assignments up to unlimited and are fetched, unlike XYZ.-Resolution-You have to either maintain the Organizational Assignments Intervals for the Fixed Asset XYZ with the end date extending till the key date of the report.-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center-Go to Fixed Assets View-Search for the Fixed Asset XYZ and click on Edit-Open the Master Data-Under Basic Data, adjust the Assignments Intervals.-Else, run the report by keying in the appropriate Accounting Period/Year.-Keywords-Schedule of Fixed Assets, Assignments Intervals

Title: System Allows To Change Planned Quantity And Input Products Logistics Areas For Released Production Order
Content: Symptom-You want to know why system is allowing to make changes to Planned Quantity and Logistics Areas for Input Products even after production orders is released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Production Orders view.-Find orders with status "In Preparation"-Select any production order ID and release it.-After releasing it, system is allowing to make changes to the Planned Quantity under general tab in production order.-And also to input product's logistics areas under Products tab which should not be allowed.-Cause-It is causing due to Alternatives in Bill of Operations. This is an expected system behavior.-Case 1 : Like for a product, if BoO has a alternative product then after creating and releasing production order-> quantity and Logistics Area is not editable. You can check its relevant BoO expanding the data.-Case 2: When there is no alternative in BoO for products then after creating production order -> quantity field and LOA are editable. It is because there may be a case where alternatives must be added later as per business need.-Resolution-Please check alternatives in relevant Bill of Operations against respective production models for the required product.-Keywords-production order released, production model, alternative, bill of operation, Alternatives in Bill of Operations

Title: Migration Tool Takes a Long Time to Open
Content: Symptom-When using a Migration Tool (for example, the Migration Tool for Identified Stock), it is observed that the staging area takes a long time to load after opening the tool page. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the respective migration activity (for example, Migration of Identified Stock).-In the activity, open the sub activity Migrate XYZ Using the Migration Tool (where XYZ represents the object being migrated).-A new browser tab will open for the Migration Tool. However it takes a long time to load completely.-Cause-When the Migration Tool is loaded, all templates uploaded to the tool are fetched from the system, including completed files. If the number of files is high, the performance of the loading will be reduced.-Resolution-You can remove completed migration files from the tool to increase the loading performance.-This can be done following the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for the respective migration activity (for example, Migration of Identified Stock).-In the activity, open the sub activity Migrate XYZ Using the Migration Tool (where XYZ represents the object being migrated).-In the Show dropdown list, select Completed Files.-Select the files to be deleted.-Select the Actions button.-Select Delete.-Keywords-Migration, Performance, Mass

Title: Custom reports for employee times show incorrect or no hours, and differ from the pre-delivered reports.
Content: Symptom-Reports built using time dependent data sources show incorrect or no hours for Employees, and differ from the pre-delivered reports.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Compare the following:-The Employee's Time File in Time Administration work center, Employees view, Edit, and Employee Times tab.-Any pre-delivered standard time report, in Time Administration work center, Reports view-Your custom report built on a time dependent data source. Business Analytics work center, Design Reports view-The hours in the Time File and the pre-delivered report match but those in the custom report do not.-Cause-The Key Date characteristic is needed for time dependent data source. If a Key Date is not specified in the report, then the system will select a default value which is todays date which can lead to missing data.-Resolution-Please add the characteristic to your report using the steps below…-To add the Key Date:-Edit the report via the Report Wizard-Navigate to Select Characteristics-Add the Key Date characteristic from the list of available characteristics.-Save and then run the report specifying the key date for selection.-Keywords-design report, custom report,

Title: Error "Item : G/L account XXX does not exist or is not permitted" Appears while Creating Credit Memo
Content: Symptom-When attempting to post a Credit Memo for an invoice item, the system displays the error message: “Item: G/L account XYZ does not exist or is not permitted” (XYZ refers to the G/L account).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view.-Search for the relevant Supplier Invoice ID ABC (ABC refers to Supplier Invoice ID).-Choose Credit Memo under New button.-Enter the mandatory details.-Go to Items tab.-Select Cost Distribution sub-tab.-Enter XYZ in the G/L Account field.-Choose Check button.-Error message: "Item: G/L account XYZ does not exist or is not permitted".-Cause-The G/L account XYZ has been deleted from the Master Data.- As a result, when a Credit Memo is created with reference to the Supplier Invoice containing this account, the system is unable to identify the G/L account and prevents further processing.-Consequently, the error message "G/L account XYZ does not exist or is not permitted" is displayed.-Resolution-Restore G/L account XYZ in the Master Data and ensure that the account is valid and permitted for the relevant posting.-Once the G/L account is available, proceed with the required document processing. The document can then be created or cancelled as required.-Keywords-Credit Memo; G/L Account; Exist; Permitted; Supplier Invoice Item; Master Data

Title: Error When Trying To Cancel Contract on Header Level: "Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates"
Content: Symptom-When trying to cancel contract ABC (ABC represents the contract ID) on header level you get the following error message:-"Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates" (XX represents the line item ID of a line item in the contract).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Contracts view.-Open contract ABC.-Navigate to the General tab and go to the Renewal and Cancellation sub-tab.-Enter a date in the Cancellation Effective On date.-Maintain a Cancellation Reason.-You receive the following error message, even though the Cancellation Effective On date is between the Contract Start Date and Contract End Date maintained in the General tab Main Information sub-tab:-"Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates".-Cause-Line Item XX in Contract ABC is already expired since the Contract Item End Date has been reached, but the Line Item is still in Process because the Fulfillment status is Not Started (XX represents the Line Item Number).-When you enter a Date for the Cancellation on Header Level, the system will check if that date lies in the time frame of the Contract Item Start Date and Contract Item End Date of all items.-Since Line Item XX has a Contract Item End Date which lies before the date you entered for cancellation, it does not lie in this time frame and the error occurs.-Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates-Resolution-Complete the Fulfillment of Line Item XX in Contract ABC-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Contracts view.-Open contract ABC.-Navigate to the Items sub tab.-Select Line Item XX.-Select the Finish button and the Fulfillment option.-Save your changes.-You can now cancel the contract in the General tab and the Renewal and Cancellation sub tab.-See Also-2865417 - Error When Trying To Cancel Contract: "Item XX: Effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates"-Keywords-vertrag beenden, vertrag stornieren, cancel contract, effective cancellation date must be between contract start and end dates, cancellation effective on, contract start date, contract end date

Title: 'Edit Payables Line Item' is Disabled for user in Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to select 'Edit Payables Line Item' in supplier invoice , however it is disabled for you but other users can edit it.-You have the access to payables work center as well.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoice work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select any supplier invoice in posted status-Click View All-Under General Tab, navigate to Payment Information->Payment Details-You can see the 'Edit Payables Line Item' button-It is disabled for you-Cause-'Edit Payables Line Item' takes us to the same screen as in Payables-> supplier accounts-> particular line item of the invoice.-Hence, it is necessary to have access to  supplier accounts view along with payables view.-Resolution-Kindly assign this view to the user in this path:-Go to Application and User Management-> Business Users-> select the user->edit access rights->work center and view assignment->FIN_SUPPLIERACCOUNTS ->Supplier Accounts -Keywords-'Edit Payables Line Item' , supplier invoice , payables

Title: Date of Birth field is read-only or grayed out in the Account screen
Content: Symptom-In Account Management, Account's Date Of Birth field is Read-Only or hidden.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Account Management work center - Accounts view.-Highlight an account and Edit - General tab.-In Details section you will see Date Of Birth field. For some accounts this is editable, for others it can be Read Only, and in some cases it is grayed out.-Cause-The Date of Birth is Read Only in the Account when the Account is also a Service Agent.-If a Business Partner is both an Account and Employee then we cannot see data in account screen for certain fields due to employee sensitive information. This behavior is due to the data protection and sensitivity of employee personal data.-Resolution-Review or maintain data for Date of Birth field in Service Agent and/or Employee Data.-See Also-Date of Birth; DOB; Greyed Out;

Title: Other Income Tab not Available in the Account Determination General Ledger Section
Content: Symptom-The 'Other Income' Account Determination Group is not available in the Account Determination -> General Ledger section.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work center-Click on Implementation Projects view.-In the Activity list, open activity 'Chart of accounts, Financial reporting structures, Account determination'.-Under the Account Determination, Click the General Ledger option.-You are unable to find the Other Income tab in the dropdown list for the Others tab of General Ledger section.-Cause-For better grouping, the Other Incomes is moved as a separate tab under the Sales ledger in this activity.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration Work center-Click on Implementation Projects view.-In the activity list, open activity Chart of accounts, Financial reporting structures, Account determination activity.-Under the Account Determination, click the Sales.-Here you find the Other Income tab.-Keywords-Account Determination, Other Income

Title: How to Execute bot in SAP Build Process Automation for Multiple Tenants Through Same Project?
Content: Symptom-How to execute bot for multiple tenants through same project?-In project A, they have a bot for Test tenant and in project B they have a bot for prod tenant. They customize the bot in project A and they want to know if there is an option to sync project B. So that they deploy the changes from project A to Project B.-In IRPA, we have the concept of create Environment but what is the alternative for that in BPA?-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-There is no environment to distinguish DEV, PRD anymore in SBPA.-In SBPA, there is common usage to use two different SBPA tenants for DEV and PRD purpose.-The projects can be synced between tenants using below options.-1. you can manually export and import the project.-Develop the Projects in Dev Cloud Factory tenant, export the package manually and import it to Prod Cloud Factory tenant. -2. use sap transport management service as described in this document and blog.-https://help.sap.com/docs/build-process-automation/sap-build-process-automation/promoting-projects-https://blogs.sap.com/2023/06/23/enabling-the-promote-feature-within-sap-build-process-automation/-Keywords-SBPA, bot, project, different tenant types

Title: RBAM Error Message Displaying After Opening Activity
Content: Symptom-After opening a Business Configuration Activity, the following error messages are displayed:-"RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default>.........."-"RBAM: Skip operation 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default>.........."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Overview of Business Configuration-Search for an activity (Example: Supplier Invoice Exception)-Open the Activity -Two RBAM error messages appear-For 'Supplier Invoice Exception' example:-"RBAM: No authorization for 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default> SRM_BC_SIX_ECO <default> ROOT' in context 'UIApplication <default> /SAP_BYD_APPLICATION_UI/srm/siv/BusinessConfigurationSIXProcessingQAFEnhancedController_QAF.QA.uicomponent <default> <default> Operation <default> Start'"-"RBAM: Skip operation 'BuiltIn <default> WRITE' on 'BONodeProxy <default> SRM_BC_SIX_ECO <default> ROOT'"-Cause-This error is occurring because the user trying to open the activity only has Read Access for Implementation Projects (BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS).-Resolution-The user needs Unrestricted Write Access for Implementation Projects (BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS) to view the activity.-Edit the access rights of the affected user-Go to Access Restrictions tab-For work center view ID: BC_IMPLEMENTATIONPROJECTS, set the Write Access to Unrestricted-Keywords-RBAM, RBAM WRITE, RBAM error, Business Configuration Activity, No authorization,

Title: Product Category is not Shown in the G/L Accounts - Line Items Report
Content: Symptom-You are running a G/L Accounts - Line items report and see that the Product Category is showing as #(not assigned) for few G/L Accounts.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General ledger work center.-Go to Business Analytics View.-Open G/L Accounts - Line items report.-Enter the selection criteria along with G/L Account.-For some G/L accounts, the product category is not determined and appears as “#”.-Cause-The items in the invoice/GSR do not have a Product ID as it contains the Product Category only.-In such a case, the Product Category is not derived in the report.-Resolution-The Product Category is not stored in the accounting line item tables used by the G/L Line Item report.-These reports are built purely on financial posting data and therefore do not include logistics attributes such as Product Category.-Product Category is maintained and available in logistics (sales/purchasing) data or analytical reports, but not in the accounting document itself.--Including Product Category in G/L reports would require additional joins between financial and logistics data, which is not part of the standard design due to performance considerations.--What can be done: Product category is not derived in G/L line items; use analytical/profitability reports for this field, or build a custom report with the necessary data joins if required.-This is standard system behavior, not a defect -Keywords-G/L Accounts - Line items, Product Category-g/l accounts - line items,product category

Title: Revenue is Over-Recognized for Customer Contract Item with Fixed-Price per Period Invoicing (Flat Rate)
Content: Symptom-You create a Customer Contract item with the Price per Period Indicator selected.-After the End Date of the item you notice that the Revenue Recognition run keeps recognizing the periodic revenue according to the maintained Accrual Method.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view. -Select Customer Contract Items and find item XYZ-XX (XYZ-XX represents the Contract Item ID). The item XYZ-XX is of Revenue Type 5 - Customer Contracts (Fixed Price). -Open the Contract and go to the Items tab. Find item XYZ-XX.-In the General sub-tab the Price per Period indicator is selected. -The item has reached its end date, for example 31.03.YYYY  in Accounting period 003.YYYY (YYYY represents the respective (Fiscal) Year). -Back in the Sales Document Items view go to the Accounting Data tab. Here, a time-based accrual method is assigned, such as Straight-Line - Exact Days or - Even Periods or - Prorate Partial Periods. -Via the Invoiced Revenues field you notice that the item is fully invoiced (Invoiced amount equals item net value). -In the Revenues per Period in default Set of Books table you notice that the Revenue Recognition run realized revenue after the contract item's end date, for example in period 004.YYYY (even though the item ends in period 003.YYYY). -Click on Reports and select Sales Accruals for Customer Contract item. -You can see that all the Deferred amounts are cleared until period 003.YYYY.-But in the following period, for example 004.2020 the run accrues further revenue.-Cause-For contract items of type Fix Price per Period or flat rate (meaning: when the Price per Period indicator is selected for the contract item) the revenue recognition works slightly different:-The revenue recognition run checks the start and end date of the respective item, as well as the order quantity and net value as usual.-However, if a flat-rate contract item, has not been completed (invoicing finished, end-date reached, fulfillment finished so that Item status becomes Completed) after the initial time period, then the flat rate is applied again for another time period according to the ordered quantity:-Example:-Contract Item XYZ-XX-End-Date: 31.03.YYYY-Ordered Quantity: 30 d (days)-Fulfillment: Item Status: In Process-Invoicing: finished-End date reached-Fulfillment: Not finished-If you execute a run for a period after the end date of the contract item the revenue recognition functionality assumes that the flat-rate duration of the item is to continue. Therefore the ordered quantity/ time period, 30 d (days) is considered again, pushing out the item's end date to 30.04.YYYY.-Resolution-The system works as designed: the ordered quantity of a flat-rate contract item, will be considered again when the revenue recognition run is executed for the item in an accounting period after its end-date, as long as the item is not completed (end-date reached, invoicing finished, fulfillment finished). Once completed all accrued and not invoiced amounts will be cleared again.-See Also- 2967901 Customer Contract Item Still Considered in Revenue Recognition Runs-Keywords-Customer Contract Revenue, Accrued Revenue, over-accrued, over-recognized, flat-rate, price per period invoicing

Title: Service Confirmation is Inconsistent
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -Service Confirmation is inconsistent without any error message.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Field Service and Repair work center.-Select the Service Confirmations view.-Search for the ID ABC.-Click Edit button.-System opens the new window.-Service Confirmation is inconsistent without any error message. -You have checked the document and other information, but everything is maintained and consistent.-Resolution-Open the transaction SESFTS (BO Test Shell).-Enter the SERVICE_CONFIRMATION Business Object.-Perform a Query to retrieve the document.-Once the document has open, search for:-Attribute Name: STATUS-CONSISTENCY_STATUS_CODE.-Attribute Value: 2 (Inconsistent).-Click on the Set Edit Mode button (Pencil icon).-Click Actions button.-Select CHECK_CONSISTENCY.-Attribute value for STATUS-CONSISTENCY_STATUS_CODE has changed to 3 (Consistent).-Click Save  (disk icon).-Go to the UI.-Click Edit button.-System opens the new window.   -Now the document is consistent as expect.-Keywords-Service Confirmation, Inconsistency, Backend, Check Consistency, Sales Order, Customer Return, Return, Error, Icon

Title: Unable to Approve Service Confirmation
Content: Symptom-You cannot approve service confirmation due to an error message: Action not enabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center.-Go to the Approvals view.-In the Show field from drop-down select Open Tasks-Select the Task Service Confirmation: ABC (where ABC represents the service confirmation ID) and click on the Approve button.-An error message rasied: Action not enabled is trigger.-Cause-Go to Time Administration workcenter.-Select Time Sheet view.-Search the Employee ID of Service performer.-Check the Time Sheet of the service performer EFG (where EFG represents the service performer ID).-You can see no time recording maintained for the sales order.-Now, check if the scope question "Do you want to record time for sales orders?" is checked or not.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Edit Project Scope: First Implementation-Navigate to Step 4 Questions>Sales>Selling Products and Services>Sales Orders-You can see question "Do you want to record time for sales orders?" is checked-The question has been scoped after the creation of the service confirmation.-Since the system can't find the corresponding time recording, the service confirmation can't be approved.-Resolution-Cancel incorrect sales order and service confirmation, create new documents.-See Also-KBA 2875032 - CRM Scenario: Service - Time and Material in Sales Order-KBA 2201132 - On Clicking an Approval of the Service Confirmation, Error : "Action not enabled" is Trigger-Keywords-Approval, Action not enabled, Service Confirmation, time recording, sales order

Title: Project Task Missing In Confirmation Journal Report
Content: Symptom-You want to see the required project task ID however it is missing in Confirmation Journal Report-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Go to Reports view -Find Confirmation Journal report -Enter required Product ID and choose Apply.-Here in Column: Project Task -> no details are being displayed.-Cause-Since relevant Confirmation ID for the product is being created with stock type : Pre-delivered stock and Inventory change reason is Transfer.-However, if Confirmation gets created with stock type as Warehouse against Project task ID then system displays Project Task ID. Therefore, Project Task IDs are available in a report. -Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-project task missing, confirmation journal report, inventory change reason, stock type.

Title: Business Object Document ID values are missing in the Event Notification Monitoring.
Content: Symptom-When user is triggering changes for Employee BO, Business Object Document ID values are missing in the Event Notification Monitoring View.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application & User Management Work Center-Navigate to Input and Output Management View-Select Event Notification Monitoring View-You can see data is missing for Business Object Document ID -Cause-This is the System Standard behaviour for few Business Objects (Example: Employee)-Resolution-Business Object document ID service doesn't supported to Employee Business Object.-When Event messages created with Employee Business Object ,document ID field will be empty in the system.-Keywords-values missing, Employee BO, Business Object Document ID, Event Notification Monitoring

Title: Expected Project ID not available
Content: Symptom-When creating the New Project, you noticed the Project ID is XXX02, however you would expect the Project ID to be XXX01.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center. -Go to Common Tasks: New Project -Enter the necessary details. -When creating the New Project, you noticed the Project ID is XXX02, however you would expect the Project ID to be XXX01 as that Project did not save. -Cause-You were creating a new Project and it was in status "In Preparation" with Project ID XXX01. However, when releasing the Project, an error occurred and the project was not saved. -You try to create a new Project and the system proposes Project ID XXX02. (The next project number).-This is the current system behaviour. -Once a Project ID has been skipped, whether the Project saved in the system or not, the skipped Project ID will never be proposed again and cannot be used.  -Resolution-Please note the Project name / description is editable - you may use this field to maintain the required information. -Should you need any new enhancement added to the software, feel free to directly submit your request for this feature to the correct decision makers at SAP via Customer Influence.-Keywords-Skipped ID, Project ID, Project, not saved, cannot be used.

Title: Check box Does not contain Personal Data is Greyed out in the Invoice Scanning Review Screen
Content: Symptom-In the invoice review screen, the check box Does not contain Personal Data is greyed out and unable to select. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Select the relevant file ID and select Review-You can see that, Does not contain Personal Data check box is greyed out-Cause-The check box - Does not contain Personal Data is greyed out because supplier invoice is already created. If the invoice scanning file status is Scanning Completed, then the check box Does not contain Personal Data will be enabled. -Resolution-You can enable the check box -Does not contain Personal Data when the invoice scanning file status is Scanning Completed. -Keywords-Does not contain Personal Data check box greyed out; Does not contain Personal Data unable to select; Invoice scanning function

Title: Error :Line items with a released ECO assigned to variant 1 do not exist
Content: Symptom-While checking Bill of Material consistency, system is throwing below errors: -Variant 1 of BoM not consistent-Line items with a released ECO assigned to variant 1 do not exist- Environment--SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work center.-Go to Production Bill Of Material view.-Find the relevant Bill Of Material and edit it.-Choose Check Consistency under General and Variants view-System throws below errors:---Variant 1 of BoM not consistent-Line items with a released ECO assigned to variant 1 do not exist-Cause-Since the relevant BoM is being created with variant 1 having output product however variant checkbox is not marked for input products once the ECO is completed.-Therefore, while checking consistency system throws error.-Resolution-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work center.-Go to Production Bill Of Material view.-Find the relevant Bill Of Material and edit it.-Go to Input Products Tab, select the ECO.-Then select the checkbox for variant 1 for all line items with products.-Once it is done, perform Check Consistency.-It will be consistent and perform save.-Keywords-Variant 1 of BoM not consistent-Line items with a released ECO assigned to variant 1 do not exist

Title: Tax Code 320 not Visible While Creating Supplier Invoicing Document
Content: Symptom-Tax code for Spain 320 Electricity and Natural Gas, Special Rate is not available while creating new supplier invoice. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Common Tasks and select New invoice without purchase order-Enter the relevant Supplier, Company and select Add Row-Navigate to items tab, sub tab Taxes you cannot find tax code 320-Cause-The tax code 320 is used in customer invoice document and not in supplier invoice. It is customer side tax code/event and hence not available in supplier invoice document. -Resolution-This is an expected behaviour. You can use any other tax codes available in the list of supplier invoice document.-Keywords-Tax Code 320 not Visible While Creating Supplier Invoicing Document; Tax code 320 Electricity and Natural Gas, Special Rate

Title: The Tax Type is Creating a Separate Tax line in the Journal Entry Rather Than Being Part of the Acquisition cost
Content: Symptom-You are checking the Supplier Invoice Journal Entry and wonder why the Tax Type(Eg: GST) is creating a Separate Tax line in the Journal Entry rather than being part of the Acquisition costs.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos View.-Search the Supplier Invoice Document Id YYY(YYY refers to Supplier Invoice ID) and go to the Document Flow-Open the Journal entry for the posted Supplier Invoice and check the entries.-You observe there are 3 entries as below.-Payable G/L account-Fixed asset ledger creating Fixed Asset: XYZ(XYZ refers to Fixed Asset ID)-Tax related G/L for Tax amount.-Cause-The Supplier Invoice ID YYY uses tax code/tax event and the deductibility is defined as '1 - Fully Deductible' (see in Business Configuration work center, Activity: Tax on Goods and Services - Tax Codes - filter for country).--Now, the duductibility rate also has to be maintained under the Activity Tax Settings for Purchasing. If there's no value maintained here, it will be taken as 0. If this is maintained as 100, then this results in Tax Type creating separate tax line in the Journal Entry, rather than being part of the acquisition cost.-Resolution-Steps to maintain Deductibility Rate in %.-Go to the Business configuration work center.-Go to the Overview and search for the Activity: Tax Settings for Purchasing.-Click on Change Immediately.-Filter for the Country and maintain the "Deductibility Rate in %"-You can set the validity date and the deductibility rate in percent for the available deductibility types. The deductibility rate of 100% corresponds to fully deductible and 0% corresponds to not deductible.-Keywords-Asset - acquisition cost, Singapore, individual material,supplier invoice

Title: Webservice fails with error: "Could not get response"
Content: Symptom-When trying to generate a response in third party tool (for example: Postman), a message appears and says "Could not get response".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Third Party Tool-Reproducing the Issue-Open up the third party tool (for example: Postman)-Enter in the URL for the webservice-Paste in the request xml file-Only response generated is "Could not get response"-Cause-This is due to the response being too big to generate, and as of a result, the response ends up out of memory and not being able to display.-Resolution-In order to generate a proper response, try to limit the amount of data, for example by adjusting the date to a more recent one.-Keywords-Webservice, timeout, could not get response, no response, postman, out of memory

Title: Issue With Single Sign on When Duplicating The Tab in Edge or Chrome
Content: Symptom-When a tab is duplicated in Chrome or Edge with Single Sign-On, the system is not responding.--After logging in to the tenant using a Single Sign-On (SSO), duplicating the browser tab in Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge causes the tenant to become unresponsive or fail to load correctly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to SAP Business ByDesign using SSO.-Then duplicate the browser tab-Observe that the duplicated tab becomes unresponsive or does not function as expected.-Cause-When a browser tab is duplicated, the browser does not fully replicate the authenticated SSO session or security token associated with the original tab.-Resolution-Do not use the browser's duplicate tab feature when accessing the tenant through Single Sign-On (SSO).-As a workaround, follow the below steps:-Open a new browser tab.-Copy and paste the original SSO URL into the address bar.-Access the tenant using the newly opened tab.-Keywords-SSO, Single Sign-On, Duplicate Tab, Browser, Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Session Token, Unresponsive

Title: Wrong Tax Rate Type and/or Tax Rate Determination on Sales Order
Content: Symptom-The Tax Rate Type has been setup in Material Master data of Product but the Tax determined in Sales Order is different.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Sales Order Work center.-Select the Sales Orders View.-Select All Orders.-Search for the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ refers to Sales Order ID which is affected).-Click on View All and go to Items tab.-Select the affected Line Item and go to Taxes subtab.-Observe that the Tax Type and/or Tax Rate Type are for example Standard 19%.-Now for the selected Line Item, double click on the Product's ID Hyperlink and open its Master Data.-Go to Taxes tab and see that the information maintained in there is different.-Cause-This is happening because a Region ABC has been defined on the Product Master Data but the Region used in Sales Order is DEF (ABC represents the region used in the product master data, DEF represents the region used in the Sales Order).-For example if Tax Rate type has been setup for region ABC, it would not be applicable for region DEF even though the Country is same.-Resolution-The Tax Rate Type needs to be setup for Region DEF which is used in the Sales Order.-This is exception in case of Spain and France because there is no region based tax calculation for countries like Spain and France. Hence the Region for those countries should be empty.-See Also-KBA 2627564  - Wrong Tax Rate Type and/or Tax Rate Determination on Purchase Order for Countries such as Spain and France.-Keywords-Tax Rate Type, Tax Type, Wrong Tax, Determination, Sales Order, SO, Reduced

Title: Manage Document Output History does not show Remittance Advice Report
Content: Symptom-The Manage Document Output History does not display Remittance Advice Outputted on a certain date, so the user is unable to generate a report on Remittance Advices sent to business partners.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work center-Go to Design Data Sources view-Search for Manage Document Output History -Select the Preview-Enter the "Form Template Code" as Remittance Advice-Add date to selection "Output On"-Select Apply -Observe the records of the Remittance Advice are not displayed.-Cause-The "Manage Document Output History" currently supports the document types: Customer Invoice, Supplier Invoice, Goods and Services Receipts, and Delivery Notes.-Resolution-Recommendation is to use the "Document Output History (To be deprecated)" as a solution to generate the Remittance Advice report. The "Document Output History (To be Deprecated)" will remain available until feature parity is achieved. Consequently, the user may continue to utilize this report during this transition period. -The introduction of the new "Manage Document Output History" is underpinned by the incorporation of additional functionalities, particularly the ability to execute actions pertaining to the documents. Once we have successfully replicated all functionalities present in the old report, the legacy version will be phased out, making way for the new version, which includes the added actions feature.-See Also-Refer to the SAP Help Center documentation to use the report: Manage Document Output History-Keywords-Document Output History (To be Deprecated), Manage Document Output History, Remittance Advice, Form Template Code

Title: Journal Entry Voucher For Production Lots
Content: Symptom-You create a Journal Entry Voucher of journal entry type: 00086 - Manual Entry for Production Lots. You add two offset lines against the WIP G/L Account. On simulate the JEV, there is the error message:Only one offsetting line allowed for manual adjustment.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Common Tasks view.-Select New Journal Entry Voucher.-Fill in the data as required with Journal Entry Type: 00086 - Manual Entry for Production Lots.-Select Add Row and add G/L Accounts as required with for example two debit entries against one credit entry.-Select Simulate.-Error message: Only one offsetting line allowed for manual adjustment.-Cause-You cannot add more than one offset line to the manual JEV for production lots.-Resolution- This is the normal designed system behavior. You cannot add more than one offset line to the manual JEV for production lots.-Using the Journal Entry Type:00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher, you will be able to add more than one offset lines.-Keywords-JEV, Production Lot, Manual Entry For Production Lots.

Title: Error Assignment to Profit Center is not permitted for new charge credit
Content: Symptom-Error message when attempting to post a new charge credit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select Customer Accounts.-Search for ID XXX(XXX represent the Customer Account ID)-Click on View.-Click on New charge credit button.-Fill in the details as per your business needs and add a profit center.-Error message: Assignment to Profit Center is not permitted-Cause-The customer is assigned to the company YYY(YYY represents the company ID) and for this company there are two set of books assigned AAAA and ZZZZ. The Reporting Principle in the set of books is defined as Function of expense. As the reporting principle does not specify profit center accounting, profit center is not allowed in transaction postings.-Resolution-To allow postings to profit center, you will need to change the reporting principle relevant to profit center accounting.-Keywords-Profit Center; New Charge Credit

Title: Technical error APLC_LER 030; report an incident
Content: Symptom-<Technical error APLC_LER 030; report an incident > error is displayed in the Application Log of Release Due Delivery Runs. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control. -Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the Sub-View <Release Due Deliveries Runs>-Select the relevant delivery run, click on the Application Log link to open it. -Navigate to the Results tab. -You can see the reported error. -Cause-The sales orders have delivery block set for the relevant line items. -The reported error is displayed because of the delivery block set up for the items in the sales order. -Resolution-Remove the delivery block from the sale orders. -The details of sales order can be identified from the Results tab of the Application Log. -Keywords-error in release due delivery runs, technical error in release due delivery runs, delivery block in sales orders, delivery block in customer demand
