Title: Duplicate Record in Employee Time Sheet
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-A leave request, for example a half day of holiday, exists twice in time sheet.-As similar situation might appear for other time types.-The reason is unknown.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Time Sheet view -Filter for relevant country-Find the affected employee-View Time Statement-Open for relevant month-For a specific date, find that e.g. a half day of holiday has been recorded twice -Cause-The reason for the issue could be that the duplicate records were posted via duplicate web service executions.-When checking the records in the employee times tab in the employee file in time administration work center,  it is visible that the records were changed by web service.-The web service was executed twice for the same time type and there might be a difference in creation time of each of the records.-Resolution-To rectify this, remove the excess time entry on the UI.-Keywords-duplicate, time frame, date, record, recorded, recording, time slot,

Title: Project locked when different users work on different tasks
Content: Symptom-Project locked when used parallelly by multiple users -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view and search for the ABC Project-Open the task XX and make desired changes -Parallelly another user open the task YY of the same Project ABC -Project gets locked- Cause-This is the General System Behavior-Resolution-In general, when same documents is accessed by multiple users at the same time then lock happens, in this case though project tasks are different but it belongs to the same project. Hence lock happens. -When this kind of lock happens, close the system from all the users end who had opened the project, and reopen it after 5mins . System automatically removes the block.-To avoid such Project locks, make sure that the project is not used by multiple users at the same time.-Keywords-Project locked, multiple users, different tasks

Title: Sales Order Volume Report does not Display the Cancelled Line Items of Sales Order
Content: Symptom-Cancelled line items in a sales order are not displayed in the Sales Order Volume report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for and open the Sales Order Volume report.-Set the filter for Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-Cancelled line items, for example 10 and 20, are not displayed.-Cause-The Cancellation Status (Item) filter has been set to Not Canceled line items only. Therefore, cancelled line items are not displayed in the report.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-Only items with a status other than Canceled are displayed in the report.-See Also-KBA 3039429 - Sales Order Volume Report not Showing Partially Cancelled Items-Keywords-Sales Order Volume Report; Cancelled Line Items; Cancellation Status (Item); Not Canceled Line Items; Sales Order; Sales Order Report; Report; Filter

Title: Cannot create Supplier Invoice via Webservice
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload a supplier invoice via Webservice and you encounter following error:-"The detailed error description may not be available in logon language: Value is longer than the maximum permitted length 4: "YYYYYYYYY_123" (where YYYYYYYYY_123 is the customised PDI solution you are using to send tax codes).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application & User Management work center.-Go to the Service Explorer view.-Search and download the WSDL file "ManageSupplierInvoiceIn" in SOAPUI.-Create a Supplier Invoices with a ProductTaxationCharacteristicsCode value equal to "YYYYYYY_123". -Error occurs: "The detailed error description may not be available in logon language: Value is longer than the maximum permitted length 4: "YYYYYYYYY_123". -Cause-This is a technical limitation of the system.-The data for ProductTaxationCharacteristicsCode has the rule that the maximum permitted length is 4 chars.-This field does not support PDI or any tax code with more than 4 chars.-Resolution-If you want to extend the number of valid chars for the tax code, the following workaround is available:-Create a new PDI field on invoice item level.-For example, create a new PDI extension field on the invoice with name: Partner Tax code and include the extension field to supplier invoice web service.-When creating supplier invoice via web service , in the standard field product tax code pass a SAP delivered tax code, but on the partner field pass the PDI created tax code.-On the supplier invoice, create an after modify ABSL script via PDI, which pushes the PDI extension field data to the SAP field . This pushes the value of the field Partner Tax code to the SAP field Product Tax code.-Keywords-error with custom tax code,  value is longer than the maximum permitted length 4, supplier invoice, webservice, ManageSupplierInvoiceIn, ProductTaxationCharacteristicsCode.

Title: SAP Outlook AddIn Causing Outlook to Disconnect & Lock-Up
Content: Symptom-The user encounters an issue with the SAP AddIn for Outlook. The utility is causing Outlook to disconnect and lock up/freeze.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When you open Outlook, you will notice that it crashes when you are logging in.-Cause-Conflicting add-ons are causing Outlook to crash.-Resolution-Ensure the user is using the most recent version of Outlook Add-in which can be downloaded following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter-Go to Download Center view-Download the SAP Add-In for Microsoft Outlook-After installing the Add-In, go to Help-Select About SAP Business ByDesign Add-In to see the version-You could try uninstalling Outlook and reinstalling it. It is also possible to confirm by just enabling the ByD Outlook Addin.-Keywords-Outlook Add-In, Lock up, Freeze, Crash, Version

Title: Project Plan Values report not showing expected planned values
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The Project Plan Values (Report ID: FINCACU03_Q0001) is not displaying planned hours in the periods that you expected. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center-Select the view Design Reports-Search and find report Project Plan Values (Report ID: FINCACU03_Q0001)-Enter the relevant selection criteria for the related Project & Project Task.-You have maintained planned hours against a resource within a Project with start and end dates maintained, and when you run the Project Plan Values (Report ID: FINCACU03_Q0001) the planned hours total is distributed over current and future periods. But you expect them to appear over the periods for the maintained dates against the project.-Cause-You have maintained Start and End Date for planned hours under Work against the project, however to see planned hours as expected in the report you need to maintain a period plan. -Resolution-There are two ways for maintaining a period plan for a project task: You can either maintain the periods and planned work directly in the work tab of the project task. Or you use the Plan Period function:-To enter the periods in the work-view:-In the Project Management workcenter, navigate to the Projects - Projects view.-Find project ABC and press Edit - Project Plan. (ABC represents the Project code).-Find project task ABC-XX and then navigate down to the Work subtab. (ABC-XX represents the Project Task Code).-Press Add Row.-In the Service column, select service XYZ.-Enter dates into the Start Date and End Date column, for example, from dd.mm.yyyy to dd.mm.yyyy.-In the Planned Work column maintained the scheduled work hours for this period.-Continue like this for the whole duration of the project task.-Select Edit Period Plans.-In the pop-up window, you can either let the system automatically create a period plan via the Generate Period Plan button. Alternatively, you can create your own period plan manually.-See Also-https://me.sap.com/notes/2101155-Help document: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2db01c35722d10149348e0055ec9912a.html?locale=en-US-Keywords-Project Plan Values, FINCACU03_Q0001, Planned Hours

Title: Error: "Logistics area not valid; Inventory in logistics area not available" while confirming replenishment task
Content: Symptom-You want to confirm the replenishment task for the product which has enough free quantity however system throws errors as below :-Line item : Logistics area not valid------> Inventory in logistics area not available---Environment--SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Go to Task Control.-Find required Task ID-Select it and choose confirm.-System throws error: Line item: Logistics area not valid------> Inventory in logistics area not available---Cause-Since there are warehouse requests for which deviation is yet to be accepted for the required product therefore quantity is still allocated to old warehouse requests and not free to be used hence system throwing errors.-Resolution-Go to Internal Logistics work center.-Monitoring and choose work view.-Once the user accepts the deviation via Accept Deviation for required product and the task.-The stock is available to be used again for other replenish tasks.-Keywords-replenishment task, Line item: Logistics area not valid,  Inventory in logistics area not available, accept deviation, internal logistics, task control

Title: Obsolete Locations still selectable when creating a Shopping Cart
Content: Symptom-You are creating a shopping cart, and you notice you can select locations which have been closed in the Organizational Management work center - Org Structures view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center. -Go to the Self Services Overview view.-Go to "Shopping Advanced". -Create a Shopping Cart and select Location X as Ship-to/Service Location (Location X being the Location you have set to closed in the Org Structures view). -Notice that the Shopping Cart is successfully created and no error message is raised.-Go to Organisational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Search Location X. -Notice the Validity of Location X is expired. -Cause-You have not set Location X's status to "Obsolete" from the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center - Locations view. -Resolution-In order to set Location X to "Obsolete", first you need to ensure you have scoped the Supply Chain Management (SCM) function in your Business Configuration. -Then you can then add the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Next, you must set Location X to obsolete by completing the following steps:-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Locations view.-Set Filter to "All Sites".-Search and select Location X.-Click Edit.-Set Location X to "Obsolete".-Note: If you do not want the user to have access to the Supply Chain Design Master Data work center in the future, you can remove the access rights from this user to this work center after you have set the necessary locations to obsolete.-See Also-2970312 - The Ship-To Address is Incorrect in Shopping Cart-Keywords-obsolete, location, shopping cart, validity, Org Structures, Organisational Management, Supply Chain Design Master Data, Locations.

Title: Supplier Change Log has No Records in the Change Collector
Content: Symptom-The user is unable to view the Change Logs in the Change Collector. The message displayed is "No Records Found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Go to Change Collector view-Select Change Collector ID: ABC-Scroll down and navigate to the Execution tab-Select the Execution ID: XYZ-Navigate to the Changes Log -Observe "No records found"-Cause-The user has not maintained the Supplier or Company ID in the Selection Criteria based on the Selection Attribute.-Resolution-The user has to maintain the Supplier/Company ID in selection criteria following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Go to Change Collector view-Select Change Collector ID: ABC and Edit-Navigate to the Selection Criteria-Choose the Selection Attribute as either "Supplier ID" or "Company ID"-Maintain the From field with the Supplier/Company ID-Select Save and Close-Now Select the Execution ID: XYZ-Navigate to the Changes tab-Observe the logs are now captured successfully-Keywords-Change Collector, Change Log, No Records Found, Selection Criteria, Selection Attribute

Title: Parameter "Customer Group" missing from Form Template Selection for Customer Invoices.
Content: Symptom-Form Template Selection does not consider "Customer Group" as a valid parameter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Under Input and Output Management view, select Form Template Selection sub-view-Show Rules For: Sales Order-Select and open Form Template XYZ (XYZ corresponds to Form Template Form ID)-Under Parameter Settings, Customer Group is visible.-Go back and under Show Rules For: select Customer Invoice-Select and open Form Template ABC -Under Parameter Settings, Customer Group is not available.-Cause-The customer invoices are currently determined by the Seller / Invoicing Unit.-This is the expected system behaviour. -Resolution-This feature/functionality is currently not available and would therefore be an enhancement request.-In order for you to directly get in contact with the decision makers in SAP Product Management, please submit your enhancement request via the following SAP Continuous Influence sites: -https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Not available, New functionality, template, invoice.

Title: Org unit cannot be edited
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-For an org unit, no changes can be maintained. For example, financial data is not editable or e.g. assign manager is not possible. For the same date, similar actions might be possible for other org units.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Org Management work center-Edit Org Structure-Select the relevant date-Try to Edit the relevant org unit-The action is not possible.-Cause-Possible reason: The relevant table in the backend is locked (i.e. /MOM/ORG_CENTRE).-Resolution-Forward to development to check and correct the issue.- Keywords-changed, unable to, edit, change, maintain, organisational, structure, management,

Title: Recurring invoices option not appearing under Supplier invoicing work center
Content: Symptom- Recurring invoices option not appearing under Supplier invoicing work center though you have enabled the respective Business configuration scoping question-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Supplier invoicing work center- You don't see the view Related to recurring invoices-Cause-SRM_RECURRINGINVOICES  is not checked marked in access rights-Resolution- Go to Application user management work Center- Go to Business users view- Search for the employee- Select and click on Actions and choose Access rights- Go to Work Center view and Filter with *SRM*- Expand Supplier invoicing View- Ensure you have check marked SRM_RECURRINGINVOICES - Go to Tab Access restriction - Ensure you have read and right access-Keywords-Support user is able to see the recurring invoice,

Title: Items from Sales Kit not shown separately in Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are creating a New Purchase Order from Purchase Request linked with a Sales Kit and want only the products from Sales Kit to be shown in the Purchase Order, not the Kit itself.  -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data work center.-Go to Kit Item List view.-Set Filter to Active Kit.-Select Kit Z (Z being your chosen Kit).-Notice the Kit is made up of item A and item B. -Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Search and Select related Purchase Request.-Click the "New Purchase Order" button.-Notice Sales Kit Z is visible rather than just the two individual items A and B. -Cause-As Item A and B are the two components that make up Sales Kit Z, once the Kit is removed so will the two items in Kit Z - this is expected system behaviour. -As both Item A and B are both maintained in the Product Master Data as their own entities, once you remove Kit Z and manually enter the two items themselves, it does not register it is a part of Kit Z in the related Purchase Order - as Kit Z is no longer present in Purchase Order, rather just two separate items. -Finally, as Kit Z appears in the related Sales Order alongside its two components, and the Purchase Order is a child document of the Sales Order, Kit Z must remain in the Purchase Order too for the link to maintained between Sales Order and Purchase Order. -Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. -Keywords-Sales Kit, individual items, Purchase Order, Purchase Request, Product Master Data, Sales Order, not shown separately.

Title: Sales Tax Type and Tax Event columns are 'Not assigned' in the reports Accounts Payable - Line Items and Accounts Receivable - Line Items
Content: Symptom-You find, in the reports Accounts Payable - Line Items and Accounts Receivable - Line Items, two columns sales tax type and tax event are "not assigned" and want to know why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Design analytics work center-Open Design reports and search for Accounts Payable - Line Items and Accounts Receivable - Line Items, open them-Enter relevant data and for fields tax type and tax event, data is 'Not assigned'-Cause-Current system design-Resolution-For Supplier invoices doesn't have the VAT related data in Accounts Payable - Line Items report. If the same is required, then report All VAT / Sales Tax Items can be used-Keywords-Supplier invoice, tax report

Title: Cost Object Outbound Runs Appears as Failed, But Shows no Result Log
Content: Symptom-You have created and executed a Cost Object Outbound Replication Run, however the job appears under the Failed Jobs section, while showing no result logs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management.-Enter the Background Jobs view.-In the dropdown list, select the option All Failed Jobs.-Select the job executed.-Click on the View Application Log button.-Navigate to the Results tab.-Here you can see that there are no errors, warnings, or successful logs.-Cause-There are no cost objects included in the replication job. In such situations, the job is automatically cancelled by the system and goes to the Failed job list.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-You can check this situation by following the steps to reproduce the issue, and expanding the logs from the General tab.-Keywords-Replication, Outbound, Cost Center

Title: Value date of an incoming check
Content: Symptom-You want to know how the Value date of an incoming check determined and how to change it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Payment Management work center-Open view payment monitor and search for Incoming check-Open it and check the value date-Cause-Current system design-Resolution-We have tested this and there is hard coding for the Value Date to always be three days after the Earliest Cashing Date. This means there is no business configuration to make this changeable. If you are looking for a change here, please raise your requirement in Influence SAP-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886 where customers and other stakeholders can submit and vote for ideas and suggestions, and by so doing assert their legitimacy as standard features by showing the industry need. As a result, the implementation schedule of the requirement will be influenced. Please direct your suggestion there.-Keywords-Value date, Payment monitor

Title: Payment created through the web service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn is not automatically clearing the invoice
Content: Symptom-You are using the web service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn to create a payment and you expect the system to automatically clear the Invoice with this payment, however, the invoice and the payment are still open.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Customer invoice is created in the system-Payment is created using the Web Service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn -Then, when checking the Customer Accounts, you notice that the Invoice and the payment are still open-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Customer Accounts view-Open the relevant Customer Account. -Search for the relevant Invoice -The Invoice is still Open, but you can find a Clearing ID in the Clearing ID column.-The status of the clearing is Proposed-Cause-System behavior- Resolution-Different clearing scenarios can happen when using the web service ManageCashPaymentOrderIn, below, it is explained how the system works in each scenario.-If the payment amount is equal to invoice amount, then, the system will clear the invoice successfully.--If the payment amount is less than invoice amount, then, the system will Partially clear the invoice.--If the payment amount is greater than invoice amount, then, during the clearing, system checks whether the net amount is greater than the gross amount or not, if yes then it gives an error. So, clearing goes in proposed status and both payment and invoice documents remains in 'Open' status.-This is the standard system behavior.-See Also-Web Service APIs in SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords-webservice, ManageCashPaymentOrderIn, Absolute value of assigned amount too high, Posting not possible; clearing  inconsistent,  manual payments

Title: Product Category Description is missing on Purchase Requests Open Tasks view
Content: Symptom-You notice that in the Purchase Requests view, when you set the filter to "Open Tasks" that the Product Category Description is missing. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Set Filter to "Open Tasks".-Navigate to the Profile button in top right corner.-Click "Key user settings".-Click "Start Adaptation Mode". -Click "Purchase Requests" in the Adaptation menu. -Notice that "Product Category Description" is not available to be selected as a column value in this view. -Cause-This is the current system behaviour.-The Product Category Description field is not available for selection in the UI screen designer of this view. -Resolution-Should you need any new enhancement added to the software, such as this, feel free to directly submit your request for this feature to the correct decision makers at SAP via Customer Influence.-The Customer Influence site, https://influence.sap.com, allows customers to log Improvement Requests themselves and have the ability to work directly with our technology and development group.-Keywords-Product Category Description, missing, Open Tasks, Purchase Requests, Adaptation Mode.

Title: Error PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003 When Migrating Surcharges
Content: Symptom-You are trying to migrate surcharges to the system and when executing the migration steps, you face an error about PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search for Migration of Surcharges.-Open the migration tool.-Search for file ABC (ABC represents the name of the file).-Select Execute Migration Step by Step.-In step 3 system returns an error message about PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003. -Cause-Currently when using the migration tool for surcharges, the system is expecting a pricing table to be maintained with Sale Organization and Distributed Channel as the key fields.-If these are a not used as key fields in the pricing table, then the system is unable to migrate the surcharges.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.-Please create custom pricing table and add Sale Organization and Distributed Channel as the key fields.-See Also-2933057 - A Technical Error (No Business Configuration for Property Valuations) Occurred: PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003-Keywords-Migration, Price List, Surcharge, PRC_ESF_CND_MAINT 003, Error, Migration Tool,

Title: Payment Run Export File is Not Opening in Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-You create a Payment Run for Payables or Receivables and you want to export the results to Microsoft Excel, however there is an Error appearing in the Excel file explaining that the Payment File is corrupt. -You have exported other Payment Runs to excel with similar amounts of data, and these worked as expect.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables or Receivables Work Center - Payment Runs View.-Show Active Payment Runs, search for Run ID XXX (XXX represents the Payment Run ID).-Under Execution Details select all Logs and click on the View Payment Proposals.-Select all Payment Proposals from the Drop Down Menu and press Execute Search.-Press Export - to Microsoft Excel and download the Excel File to the Hard Disk.-Open the File in Excel.-Press Yes.-Now an Error Message appears: "The file is corrupt and cannot be opened". -Cause-A value in the column "External Reference" of Payment ID YYY (YYY represents the Payment ID) contains an unsupported/corrupted ASCII character. If you export all the data apart from the Payment ID YYY everything is working fine. You need to remove this character from the Payment ID YYY. -Resolution-Go to the Payables or Receivables Work Center - Payment Runs view.-Show Active Payment Runs, search for the Run ID XXX (where XXX is the Payment Run ID).-Under Execution Details select all Logs and click on view Payment Proposals.-Select all Payment Proposals from the Drop Down Menu and press Execute Search.-Filter after the Payment ID YYY.-Search for the column "External Reference".-You can see that it contains an unsupported and corrupted ASCII character.-Please remove or change this value, execute the Payment Run again and export the results to Microsoft Excel. -Keywords-Export to Microsoft Excel, Payment Run file, Payables, Receivables, corrupt file, error in Excel file

Title: When exporting Payment Proposal to Excel Sheet - Total amount is Missing.
Content: Symptom-When you try to print the Payment proposal for Payment Run XXX(XXX refers to Payment Run ID), There you can see Total Column in end and this is the system calculated result and shows the values in Print Preview + Downloaded Print File. But when you are trying to export the same payment proposals to excel, there the total amount is not showing in the excel sheet. This has missing system calculated Total amount Row in the end. -   Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks sub View.-Search for Payment Run XXX and click its Execution ID YYY. (XXX represents Payment Run ID, YYY represents the Execution ID).-Here view the Payment proposals and click Show All Payment proposals.-Select Print -Select "Landscape" -Change the size to 45%.-All the payment proposals cannot be printed, so instead you export the data to Excel.-Select Export-Select Microsoft Excel-In the Export file the "Total amount" is not shown.-Cause-Due to huge number of data (i.e. Invoices and its details), the total amount row is missing when you are export to Excel sheet.-Resolution-There are two ways to get the totals as expected.-Export the data from Payment proposal to Excel sheet  - In this data, you have to select the respective amount columns and click on SUM button manually then click on print option to get the total values as expected.-Print option - Click on Print button, and select the page Orientation 'Landscape', Adjust the size to 42% and page size is 'tabloid' then click on print to save the PDF with totals.-Keywords-Payment Run, Payment proposals, Print, Export to Excel Sheet.

Title: Explosion Date in Released Execution Model Doesn't Match With That in Production Order.
Content: Symptom-You have created a production model, released it to planning and execution and then created a production order on basis of this execution model. However, you find the explosion date in released execution model is different from that in the production order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Planning and Production Master Data, access view Production Models.-Search production model PM_1 (PM_1 represents production model ID), click Open Release Execution Model - Current Released Version. In the screen "Released Execution Model: PM_1", we can see Explosion Date is today. -Go to work center Production Control, access view Production Orders.-Search PO_1 (PO_1 represents production order ID), click Edit.-Select tab General, we can see "Released Execution Model Explosion Date" has value which is different from the explosion date in above released execution model. -Cause-In the released execution model,  "Explosion Date" is only for you to simulate the impacts on elements with different reference date. You cannot determine an "explosion date" in a production model so that all production orders from this model could have same explosion date. If you move your cursor on the question mark of this field, you will see its explanation. -In production order, explosion date is calculated by system while consider several factors: fixed duration/variable duration in execution model, requested quantity, requested date, operation hours of involved resource, etc. Hence each production order should have its own explosion date.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Explosion Date, Execution Model, Production Order

Title: Withholding Tax Payment Approval Error 'Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions'
Content: Symptom-Approver is trying to approve the Tax Payment (Withholding Tax), but system is giving error: Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Note: You have to first get customer's permission to login as the approver and the authorization to change the approver's password.-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to Tax Payments view.-You can see Tax Payment XYZ (XYZ represents the Tax Payment ID) is in approval.-Login as the approver. -Go to Manage My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-You can see Business Task: Approve Tax Payment XYZ.-Click 'Approve', an error occurs: Save failed; refresh list to perform further actions.-Cause-The challan identification number entered on the tax payment is incorrect.-A valid challan identification number will constitute of:-Bank Branch (BR) code - First 7 Characters-Valid Challan Issue Date in format DDMMYYYY or DDMMYY-Challan Sequence Number - Last 5 Characters-The total length of the challan identification number should be 20 characters or 18 characters, depending on the format in which the Challan Issue Date is mentioned.-Example: 00012340101200004321, 000123401010004321-In the above 2 examples, the Bank Branch (BR) code is 0001234. Challan Issue Date is 01/01/2000 (MM/DD/YYYY). Challan Sequence Number is 04321.-Resolution-Please correct the challan identification number on the Tax Payment and then try releasing the same again.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Payment Approval Error, Tax Payment, Challan Identification Number, Save Failed

Title: Service Totals Fail With Error in Migration of Services
Content: Symptom-When attempting to simulate an import using the migration tool for Migration of Services, all services totals fail with an error message appearing:-"Service call failed; report an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Enter the Overview view-Search for the Migration of Services activity-Click on Migrate services using the migration tool-Highlight the file to be migrated and click on Execute Migration-Click Execute Migration Step by Step-Navigate to Step 3 - Simulate Import and Repeat Simulation for all records-After it has been processed, an error occurs for all service totals-Cause-A possible reason for this issue is that the correct Value Conversions are not properly maintained.-Resolution-Navigate to Step 2) Convert Values and check that all Value Conversions have been selected properly under the Target Value heading.-Keywords-Migration of Services, Services, Migrate services, services with errors, services total, service call failed

Title: Opening/total quantity and opening/total balance is negative in report: Warehouse Book Greece
Content: Symptom-You check that some material for opening/total quantity and opening/total balance is negative in report: Warehouse Book Greece -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Reports view.-Open report: Warehouse Book Greece.-Enter the mandatory input. E.g. Company ID ; Set of Books; Fiscal Year; Acc Period.-Run the report, and you can find opening balance and quantity for some material is negative.-Cause-The total quantity is sum of opening quantities, purchase quantities, sales quantities.-For example, opening balance is 0 ea, third party purchase quantity is 1 ea and third-party sales quantity is -3 ea.-So, the total quantity = 0 + 1 + (-3) = -2 ea. -This is the standard system behavior.-In the report 'View' section, third party purchase quantity and third-party sales quantity are not selected, so you may neglect these two key figures, and fail to calculate the total quantity.-Resolution-In the report 'View' section, you could add the third-party purchase quantity and third-party sales quantity in your key figures.  So, you are able to explain the opening/total quantity and opening/total balance result.-Keywords-Negative quantity, Negative balance, Warehouse Book Greece report

Title: Logon Error Message
Content: Symptom-When accessing SOAP web services using certificate-based authentication through a third-party integration tool such as Postman, SOAP UI, Orchestra Middleware, or a custom program, the request fails with:-HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Option 1: Error in Business ByDesign-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Go to Communication Arrangement view-Select 'Communication Scenario': ABC-Select Edit-Navigate to Technical Data tab-Select Edit Credentials-Navigate to the Certificate tab-Select Create and Download Key Pair-Enter in password-Observe an error message:-Error outputting keys and certificates-40C7579A457F0000:error:0308010C:digital envelope routines:inner_evp_generic_fetch:unsupported:../crypto/evp/evp_fetch.c:373:Global default library context, Algorithm (RC2-40-CBC : 0), Properties () -Option 2: Error in Postman-Use 3rd party integration tool (e.g. SOAPUI/Postman)-Observe an error message: -HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized-content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8-sap-system: XYZ-www-authenticate: Bask realm=“SAP NetWeaver Application Server (XYZ/ABC](alias)*-strict-transport-security: max-age=000000; indudeSubDomains-set-cookie: sap-usercontext=sapdient=ABC; path=/;HttpOnly;Secure-<html> <head><title>Logon Error Message</title><META http-equiv=“Content-Type* content=*text/html;charset=UTF-8" >< style type=“text/css*>body-Where XYZ is the System ID and ABC is Tenant ID-Cause-The certificate or authentication details are not correctly configured in the third-party integration tool.-Resolution-Verify that the correct client certificate is configured in the third-party integration tool and that it matches the certificate maintained in the SAP Business ByDesign Communication Arrangement.-For example, in Postman:-Go to Settings → Certificates.-Select Add Certificate.-Enter the SAP Business ByDesign host.-Select the correct PFX/P12 certificate.-Enter the certificate passphrase.-Save the configuration and retry the request.-Also verify that the certificate is valid, contains the required private key, and that the correct SOAP endpoint is being used.-Note: If the error occurs while creating/downloading the key pair in SAP Business ByDesign, this is a separate certificate-generation issue and should be investigated separately.-Keywords-HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized, Communication Arrangement, Postman, SOAPUI, Certificate

Title: Report For Transport Zones and Transport Lanes
Content: Symptom-You want to have report for all Transport Zones and Transport Lanes to check the required details.-Environment--SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics workccenter.-Go to Reports view.-Find report Transport Zone.-No records found.-Cause-Currently, there is no standard report to get the transport zone and lanes details.-Via option "Export" you can download the Transport Zones IDs however detailed data is not available.-Resolution-We recommend you to create a custom data source to get the capture the required details using Transport Zone business object,-Also, you can post your requirement on Customer Influence Forum -at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Transport zone report, transport lane, report

Title: Scanned Invoice is created successfully but still the Retraining status is showing "Rejected due to personal data"
Content: Symptom-You have scoped “Do you want to train the ML model with the user values via feedback integration ?".-Then you scanned invoice and selected this checkbox "doesn’t contain any personal data", but still the retraining status shows "Rejected due to personal data".-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to supplier invoicing work center-Select view: invoice scanning-Select the successfully scanned document id-Navigate to the Retraining status column-Error:  Rejected Due To Personal Data-Cause-The scanned document contains some data like email, phone number or other details which is considered as confidential by the system, and hence the retraining status is in error.-Resolution-When you select this checkbox "doesn’t contain any personal data", it ensures compliance is maintained.-The document may not be considered for retraining because of these personal data which system considers as confidential, but with this check, system will allow to scan the document even with such confidential data.-If you do not want so see this rejected message at all, you can always descope this question :“Do you want to train the ML model with the user values via feedback integration ?".-As this intelligent PDF scanning is based on AI logic, it will take time for the system to accept the data and hence we suggest to do scanning frequently to train the model accordingly.-See Also-3320686 - Retraining Status of Scanned invoice is ‘Rejected Due To Personal Data'-Keywords-doesn’t contain any personal data, Rejected due to personal data, retraining status, invoice scanning, intelligent PDF scanning

Title: Resubmit with Watermark Duplicate is selected by Default in the Invoice Documents
Content: Symptom-You are not able to remove the Default check for Resubmit with Watermark Duplicate in the Invoice Documents-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center-Navigate to Invoice Documents View-Select any ID -Choose Edit-Navigate to the Output History tab-Choose Resubmit button-Resubmit with watermark Duplicate checkbox is selected by default-Cause-Watermark is applicable for the sender country codes IL(Israel) & AT(Austria) because of that Resubmit with watermark "Duplicate" checkbox is selected by default for all the Customer Invoices.-Resolution-This is the System Standard behavior for the above mentioned Countries.-See Also-Watermark ,Duplicate checkbox, Customer invoicing, Resubmit Document ,Default.

Title: System crashes while trying to calculate total amounts for supplier invoice
Content: Symptom-  You are facing the Dump when trying to Calculate totals on the invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Entry view -Search for Purchase order DEF(DEF refers to the Purchase order Id)-Click on new invoice Button.-Fill all mandatory fields then -Click on save or post button user getting dump/System Crash-or-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to Invoicing view-Search for Purchase order DEF(DEF refers to the Purchase order Id) -Click on new invoice button-Go to Items then click on Taxes tab here-We can see below tax tab ,Tax country is India but Tax reporting units are not appearing-Cause-In back end we see the error "You can see that  error information as Consumer Fault! Tax Reporting Unit is mandatory for India in the backend of the system"-Casue 1.Tax country is India then TRU is mandatory.-or-Casue 2.Tax country has to be India only when buying company is in india.-Resolution-Solution 1.Follow the details of below KBA to fix the issue.-3241244 - Tax reporting unit determination in Purchasing documents-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3241244-or-Solution 2. Change the tax country and enter country same as buying company's country.-Keywords-Crash when Calculate totals on the invoice; unable to Calculate totals on the invoice

Title: In Personalization or Adaptation Mode, the Sum of the Quantities for Row Calculation is not working
Content: Symptom-The Sum of the Quantities are not displaying on the top of the row for Supplier Invoices in the Personalization or Adaptation Mode -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue-Here we have taken Example as Supplier Invoice:-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center-Navigate to Invoice and Credit Memos View-Search for the Supplier Invoice & Start Personalization mode-Navigate to Items tab & Choose UI elements "Item"-Here you will get an pop up window at side of Items-Select Table Calculation for Configure Calculations-For quantity select Sum & mark Display Result Rows at Top of Table-Choose Apply- You can see no changes in the Quantity tab.-Cause-The Sum of the Quantities row is hidden in the UI.-Resolution-You need to expand the table using expand arrow icon to see the first row of the table, Here you will find the Sum of the Quantities row.--Steps:-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center-Navigate to Invoice and Credit Memos View-Search for the Supplier Invoice & Start Personalization mode-Navigate to Items tab & Choose UI elements "Item"-Here you will get an pop up window at side of Items-Select Table Calculation for Configure Calculations-For quantity select Sum & mark Display Result Rows at Top of Table-Choose Apply-Expand the table using expand arrow icon for Sum of the Quantities-Publish your Changes-Keywords-Sum of the Quantities, Supplier Invoice, Personalization, Adaptation Mode, Calculation, Row

Title: Inconsistency between the status of the Print Queues and the Document Output History
Content: Symptom-Invoice documents show a Pending status in Document Output History when printed to assigned printers.-The same documents show a Successful status in the Print Queue view.-Cloud Print Manager (CPM) logs display the following message: "Unable to connect to the remote server. Exception during cache check. Try to get new cache URL is populated."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter-Go to Print Queue view-Observe the Print Queue Status for the Invoice Document is shown as "Successful".-Now, follow the steps below to notice the discrepancy.-Go to Customer Invoicing Work center-Go to Invoice Documents view-Select Invoice ID: XYZ-Select View All-Navigate to the Output History tab-Observe the Invoice Document Status is shown as "Pending".-Resolution-Create a new print queue and add a rule to the queue to verify the settings. -To verify please follow the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Go to the Print Queue view-Select the Queue ID: ABC-Select Edit to check the Queued Documents-Now Go to the Cloud Print Manager -Enable the Save to File checkbox-Start the SAP Cloud Print Service-The queued documents are now printed successfully.-Keywords-Print Queues, Output History, Cloud Print Manager, Print Queue Status, Successful, Pending

Title: Error: Sales Transaction cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-There is a process communication error in point of sales transaction's document flow with below error :-- Sales Transaction cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation----Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoice work center.-Go to Point of Sales view.-Search for required Point of Sales ID.-Select and Open it.-In Document Flow tab, here you can see PCE on the selected POS with below error.-Sales Transaction cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation.-Cause-As the product is batch relevant, the UOM conversion needs to be maintained at batch level too.-Once its maintained the stuck message can be restarted.  Verify below points:--Go to Identified Stock view and search with relevant product ID and Identified stock ID.-Go to Batch and here you can find there is no conversion maintained under quantity conversion tab.-Resolution-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Identified Stock view.-Find required identified stock ID.-Select it and maintain required UoM conversion for relevant identified stock ID under Quantity Conversions tab.-Once customer maintains the conversions, ask user to send it back to SAP to restart the stuck message.-Keywords-Point of sales,  Sales Transaction cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation, process communication error, identified stock ID, batch managed

Title: Unable to Merge the Change Project in the Tenant
Content: Symptom-When you Merge the Change Project from Test tenant to Production tenant, you can see the merge status as Failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Access the Implementation Projects work center view-Choose the relevant change project-Select Open Activity List-Choose Merge Changes & Start Merge-The merge will end with status Failed-Cause-The Change Project failed to merge because of Version Mismatch between Test & Production Tenant.-Resolution-When you are performing Merge Changes both Test & Production Tenant should be in the same Version.-Tenant upgrades are done on quarterly basis. The test tenants are upgraded first in order to test the functionality of the new version, Once the test tenant is upgraded successfully after 2-3 weeks production tenants are upgraded.-If Test tenant is in Higher Version & Production tenant is in Lower Version, you have to wait till the production tenant gets upgraded to the version of Test tenant.- Keywords-Merge Failed, Change Project, Test Tenant Merge, Versions.

Title: The Tax amount is Showing Different for Invoice Items with Same Net Amount
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice with multiple line items which have same net amount but the tax is showing different for each line(with a minor difference in decimal places).-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Create a new supplier invoice from common tasks view-Enter 2 line items with same price (say price is X) for each item-However, the tax amount which got calculated is showing different for both items (a minor difference in decimal points)-Cause-On header level the total amount calculated for tax is P.QR (gross tax amount) , which is Y% of gross amount rounded to 2 decimal places. -Now, individually at item level, when we calculate the tax,-Tax:-Line item 1: Y % of X =P.QRXT-Line item 2: Y % of X =P.QRXT-Now if we round both the items equally to P.QR and add them up, then total tax becomes little more or less than the actual gross tax amount.-So, the tax amounts in the item level differ by a small amount in order to add up to the calculated header tax amount.-Resolution-So, to balance the header tax amount, one line item shows a minor difference in the tax e.g. (a difference of say .01) so that the total tax value matches the ultimate header tax amount.-i.e. Tax=-line item 1: P.QX (rounded to next value)-line item 2: P.QR (not rounded)-On adding them, the total tax amount displays correct value.-See Also-Please refer this blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2018/04/05/rules-of-tax-difference-distribution-in-sap-business-bydesign/ -Keywords-tax amount is different, The tax amount is Showing Different for Invoice items with Same Amount, withholding tax is different

Title: The Purchase order Delivery End date is not Considered in the Purchase Order Item Completion Run
Content: Symptom-You have created purchase orders with service items where there is a delivery start date and delivery end date.-But when you create the Purchase Order item completion run with delivery date criteria within certain period, the system picks up all the purchase orders even though delivery end date does not fulfill the criteria specified in the run.-You expect the system to consider end date of the service period as delivery date and not the delivery start date shown in items tab.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select Purchase Order Item Completion Runs view-Select the specific Run id which is active-(criteria: e.g. Expected delivery before: X Day(s))-Check the application log-Purchase Orders whose delivery end date is not before X days are also completed via this run.-Cause-System will pick the delivery expected from date only i.e. the start date of delivery, so if the start date of delivery falls within the criteria (expected delivery before) , then system will pick those orders.-The delivery start date is the one specified in the item level as well.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior.-You can post in customer influence forum if you want to change this behavior: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886.-This is our official channel to address all new requirements. If multiple customers vote for the same idea, our development team will check the feasibility of implementing this functionality in future.-You can track the idea and check the status of the idea in that forum.-Keywords-Purchase Order Item Completion Runs, Expected delivery before, purchase order delivery date, delivery start date, delivery end date

Title: Dunning Document Contains Output Referencing to the Old E-mail Contact from Account Master Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer has performed the Dunning Run and the Status is In Preparation. They have changed the Account Master Data before the last Dunning Run for Account ABC and has maintained only the "To" recipient. But when the Dunning Run is performed, even after the changes "CC" recipient is being displayed in the Dunning Preview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Firstly, verify the Account Master Data as below.-Go the Account Management Workcenter-Go to Accounts view-Select the Account ID: ABC-Select View All-Navigate to the Communication tab-Navigate to the Collaboration tab-Select the any Business Document-Notice the Output Channel has only "To" address maintained.-Now verify the E-Mail settings under Dunning as below:-Go to Receivables workcenter-Go to the Dunning view-Search for Dunning ID: XYZ-Choose Preview-Select Send Options-Scroll down to the Output Details-Select Send By: E-Mail-Observe, the E-Mail Settings has CC address fetched incorrectly-Cause-The CC E-mail ID is added by the customer from custom Badi implementation.-Resolution-The customer has to debug and optimize the code.-How to identify the custom PDI solution in the backend?-Below are the steps to check Custom Badi:-Go to Backend Transaction-Enter TCode: SE24-Enter the Object Type: /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_ OR -Select Display-Select the Method - REFRESH_FOR_BACKEND-In Line 359, set the External Breakpoint-Go to the Frontend-Go to Receivables workcenter-Go to the Dunning view-Select All Dunning Proposals from the dropdown-Search for Dunning ID: XYZ-Choose Preview-Select Dunning Letter-The ABAP Debugger will be displayed-Now double click on the " lb_multiple_emails"-Select F5 function multiple times to debug the code. This will route you to the  badi_impl_name which provides the custom solution name starting with Y.-Then route it to the concerned PDI team.-Keywords-Dunning Proposal, CC Email ID, Accounts, BADI Implementation, E-Mail

Title: When Using the Querycustomerinvoicein Service, GTIN is not Returning
Content: Symptom- You are using the QueryCustomerInvoiceIn, however, the system is not returning the GTIN value maintained in the item master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign --Reproducing the Issue- Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -The GTIN field is not present for Customer Invoice, hence no GTIN value is saved in a Customer Invoice document.-Also, as this is not present in the document structure, the same will not return when performing a query.-As a potential solution, you can create an extension field to store this value and extend it do the desired service.  -Keywords-GTIN, Customer Invoice, Webservice, QueryCustomerInvoiceIn, Missing

Title: No Material Cost Appears in Report Enhanced Contribution Margin
Content: Symptom-You run the report Enhanced Contribution Margin with the relevant selection criteria and notice that the column Material Cost is empty or report is blank altogether.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work Centre.-Click on List under Reports View.-Search and open the report Enhanced Contribution Margin.-Fill in your desired selection criteria and click on Apply.-Result: The Material Cost Colum is empty for the Product XXX(XXX represents the Product ID) or 'No report data available to display; check the selection'.-Cause-The report Enhanced Contribution Margin only works if you have Material Cost Estimates as it derives the data from Material Cost Estimates. If you do not use Cost Estimates, it is advised to use the report Profit Detail by Contribution Margin Scheme.-Resolution-As stated in the Cause section, you will have to maintain the Cost Estimates by following the below steps:-Go to the Inventory Valuation Work Centre-Select the Material Cost Estimates View.-Click on New and then Cost Estimate.-Fill in the data and click on the Estimate button.-Keywords-Material Cost missing, no data in report

Title: Price Component Surcharge Cannot be Selected in the Item Pricing Section of a Sales Document
Content: Symptom-You are not able to add surcharges to Contracts, sales order or service orders in the Item pricing section since the price component surcharge does not appear in the drop down list.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will use Customer Contract as an example:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Open Contract XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Contract).-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab.-In the Item Pricing section click on Add Row.-In the drop down list for Price Component the price component Surcharge is not available-Cause-The scoping element Surcharge is not in scope.-Resolution-To activate the scoping element Surcharge in your solution scope you can use the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project and click on Edit Project Scope.-Navigate to the Questions step.-Select the path General Business Data -> Product and Service Pricing -> Sales Price Specifications-The following question needs to be active: Do you maintain surcharges?-Once you have activated the question and finished your changes you can find and configure the Surcharges in the fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Projects view.-Select the respective implementation project and click on Open Activity List-Navigate to the Fine Tune step.-Open fine tuning activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Configure Pricing Procedure hyperlink.-Select Standard Gross Procedure if you want use Gross Surcharges-You can see that the Price Component Gross Surcharge is available in step 30 and 40.-However if you select the Standard Procedure, you can see the Surcharge in Step 13 and 14.-Please note that if you like to see them in the Item Pricing section in your sales order or service order you need to ensure that Item Display is set to Yes.- See Also- 2461886 - Price Component Surcharge Cannot be Selected in the Total Pricing Section of a Sales Order or Service Order -Keywords-Item Price component; Surcharge; Missing;

Title: SAP Business ByDesign: Product Support Checklist for Handling SAP Business ByDesign to SAP Concur Integration Issues
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-List of things to be checked in case of a customer incident regarding SAP Business ByDesign to SAP Concur Integration.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-General Clarifications-Scenario-Is the replication configured point-to-point or is CPI used as middleware?-Check: Is there a communication arrangement for scenario “Concur Integration Middleware”?-If CPI is used, did the customer switch on the extension flows for message mapping of cost objects, employee data, expense reports and/or cash advance documents?-Ask customer-Or check via https://inspect.ci.only.sap/ (You need the CPI tenant name, this can be found in cloud reporting https://reporting.ondemand.com/sap/crp/cdo - Productive Tenants – filter for HCI – field Client) - click WebUI – Manage Integration Content – look for “Integrate SAP Business ByDesign with SAP Concur - enhancement”. You need to request authorizations to be able to do this.-If extension flow is used, what modifications have been done?-Ask customer-Or check via https://inspect.ci.only.sap/ … View deployed Artifact-Connection to Concur System is working?-Check cost object replication and employee replication logs if connection to target system could be established for the last runs-If this is not the case Configuration Settings have to be checked first-Configuration Settings-OAUTH Settings-Check OAUTH System registration-Business Configuration – Activity “Integration with Concur Solutions”: Entry CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT must have Client ID, Client Secret, Company UUID, Authentication + API Server URL correctly maintained. Check if all fields are filled (Client Secret is not visible)-Remark: CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2 are no longer relevant-Communication Arrangements-Check that predefined Communication Arrangement is available Concur Integration (JWT)-Check that User Credentials are available-Check that none of the communication arrangements is isolated-Remark: there might be isolated communication arrangements for “Concur Integration” and “Concur Integration OAUTH”. This is correct and due to the API migration-CPI Used-If CPI is used, check with the customer if the right URL is maintained in Concur Integration Middleware communication arrangement. (You can also find the correct URL via https://inspect.ci.only.sap/)-Check if calls from ByD are reaching the CPI instance-Check CPI monitor or ask customer to do so-User registration-Is the business user registered to run the replication? Does the user have a valid token? If not, does SAP_SYSTEM have a valid token?-Application and User Management - User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services - CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT: Business user is in the list, at least SAP_SYSTEM should have Access Permission Status ok-If not, the customer needs to enter a fresh request token in the configuration to fetch a valid refresh and access token: Communication Arrangement “Concur Integration User Credentials” - Technical Data - Edit Credentials: User ID field should contain the Company UUID, put valid request token into Password field-Error Messages in Log-This Service Provider does not run the HTTPS schema! No connection to Concur system could be established...-Certificate for Concur system is missing---> Forward to development since this should not happen any more-Registration for OAUTH not found for user XXX-OAUTH user registration not correct---> Check “User Registrations for OAUTH2 Web Services”. If the user is listed and SAP_SYSTEM has access, deregister and register the user again (maybe the client secret was wrong in initial registration) – has to be done by the customer since we do not know the concur credentials; If also SAP_SYSTEM is not ok the customer has to enter a new request token in the User Credentials Communication Arrangement.-ByDesign (AP-INT-…) or Concur (XX-INT-CONCUR)?-Before forwarding the incident please check if the problem is likely to be a Concur problem.-Indicators:-“What concur edition am I using?” “I’ve noticed that the integration is only available in the professional edition, we are using standard edition...”-Employee Replication failing with “User Create/Update Failed: Error in CLBK”-If you are able to check the application log: messages with ID CON_REPL_MESSAGE 000 contain the error response of the concur system-When in doubt, contact development team-Cost Object Replication-Cost Centers/Project Tasks/... are not fetched for replication---> Is the company configured for Cost Object Outbound? Is the cost object type flagged?-Error Messages in Log-“xyz: Name Cannot be null or blank string if You Are Not Deleting” (for Cost object type: Project Task)---> Concur is rejecting entities without description. Customer has to maintain a description for the project tasks-Additional Information-Backend BO holding the replicated payload (data which is sent to Concur): /MOM/COST_OBJ_REPL_OUTB-Employee Replication-Employee data is not fetched for replication---> Is the company configured for Employee Outbound?-Error Messages in Log-Invalid list item for field ‘OrgUnit4’, value ‘xxx’, list ‘yyy’-Home cost center of the employee missing in Concur system (not replicated)---> Did the cost object replication for the specific company run before the employee replication?-Invalid BI Manager employee ID (xxx)-Manager/Approver information missing in SAP Concur system in the employee’s masterdata---> Are the manager’s employee data available in SAP Concur? Maybe he is belonging to a different company which is not switched on for replication-Employee with Emp ID ‘xxx’ and Login ID ‘xxx@dummy.com’ could not be updated because the Employee ID was specified as ‘yyy’. If you want to change...---> There is a mismatch between employee ID and email address (login ID). Probably another employee (xxx) is registered with the same email address (could also be an inactive employee), now yyy shall be sent with the same login ID which is not allowed.-Employee with Emp ID 'xxx' and Login ID ‘xxx@dummy.com' could not be updated because the Login ID was specified as 'yyy@dummy.com’. If you...---> There is a mismatch between employee ID and email address (login ID). The employee xxx is registered with login ID ‘xxx@dummy.com' in Concur. ByD now tries to send the same employee with a different login ID ('yyy@dummy.com’). Usually a change of the email address in ByD is handled correctly (in that case a different field is filled to intentionally change the login ID for the user). Only if there have been manual changes in Concur the data is out of sync.---> Customer has to clean up the inconsistency-Additional Information-Backend BO holding the replicated payload: EMPLOYEE_MDR_OUTBOUND-Expense Reports and Cash Advances-If an expense report or cash advance document is not fetched-Check that the document is available to be fetched in Concur system (submitted and approved)-Send to incident to development (AP-INT-GEN)-If there is an error during document posting please-Check the Jam page (https://jam4.sapjam.com/groups/2vgOnLjYQZCIG9u9KKRQeu/content?folder_id=CSgoEljrtJSh6ZOS8Ii23e) or-Forward the incident to AP-ACC resp. SRD-FIN-COR-CPI Problems-If it looks like the processing of the message within CPI is causing the problem sometimes a trace file of certain steps would be helpful. Depending on the message type you could ask the customer for payload traces of the following steps of the integration flow “Integrate SAP Business ByDesign with SAP Concur - pass through” (Steps in the trace file are bottom up!):-“MsgType” after “Cleanup Header” – Message Content-Header: bydmsgtype = CO (resp. EE, ER, CA)-Exchange Properties: enhancementFor... = TRUE/FALSE-Payload à Download Payload-“HTTP” after “Call Concur” – Message Content – Payload -> Download Payload-MsgType” after “Call Concur” – Message Content – Payload -> Download Payload-“End HTTPS” – Message Content – Payload-> Download Payload-See Also-3244859 - Concur Integration Settings Showing new Service Provider CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH_JWT-3225313 - CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH Missing in User Registration for Oauth Webservices-2975930 - Error Message "Concur Integration Is Not Active, Please Check Communication Arrangements"-3231619 - Use encrypted communication (https) for URLs in OAUTH Server Settings-Keywords-concur, support, checklist, oauth, employee, cost object, JWT

Title: Open Items Receivable/ Payable Migration: Value in column Profit Center ID / Segment ID will be truncated; Edit Source Value
Content: Symptom-You migrate Open Items Receivable. -During File Validation (step 1a - Validate File) a warning appears:  "Open Items: value XYZ in column Profit Center ID/ Segment ID will be truncated; edit source value" (XYZ represents the profit center ID which has more than 10 characters). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration work center access the Integrate and extend activity Migration of accounting transaction data - Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select migration unit and press Execute migration.-Select the Open Items file and press Process File.-After the validation a warning appears  "Open Items: value XYZ in column Profit Center ID will be truncated; edit source value".-Cause-The tructation only occurs during the migration activity.-Resolution-You can still go ahead with the warning. -In the next step 1b Convert values you can select the correct profit center ID/segment: -In the Convert Values step.-Go to Edit Value conversion for Profit center ID/Segment ID.-The source value is truncated.-In the target value select the correct profit center/ segment with the long ID.-Confirm the value.-Press save and close.-Then continue with the migration and execute the import. -The import will still finish with the warning. However, all values are going to be posted to the correct profit center / segment ID*.-Keywords-Open Items, Profit Center ID, segment ID,  truncated, more than 10 characters

Title: Error "Value not valid for variable Production Request ID"
Content: Symptom-You want to see production request details against the production order in a report Production Request Fulfillment however system throws an error :-Value not valid for variable Production Request ID -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Search reports: either  Prod. Request Fulfillment Detail (SCMPRFU01_Q0002) and Prod. Request Fulfillment (SCMPRFU01_Q0001) -Enter required production request ID: XYZ.-Choose Apply-System throws an error :Value not valid for variable Production Request ID-(i.e. Here XYZ is a production request ID)-Cause-Since the production request status is Started system throws an error. It is not available in the value selection itself to be displayed in a report.-Production Fulfillment Detail Report (SCMPRFU01_Q0002) and Production Fulfillment Report (SCMPRFU01_Q0001) .-Both report displays the data once the production is completed with the actual confirmed quantities and dates recorded hence system displays the data with the production request finished.-However, for production requests before the start i.e. In Preparation and Finished status -> it displays the data.-(Here IDs :SCMPRFU01_Q0002 and SCMPRFU01_Q0001 -> are the technical IDs for the report)-Resolution-System displays data for In Preparation and Started status only in Production Request Fulfillment report.-This is an expected system behavior.

Title: General Tab Missing for the Migration File While Using Enhance Mode for Materials
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to enhance Materials using the migration tool and you have filled the required data in the respective sheets like General, Other Languages etc. in the migration file. Upon trying to enhance the Materials using migration tool, even if your upload file contains data in the General sheet, the General tab of the migration file is missing in the migration tool.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Materials-Choose Migrate materials using the migration tool-Select You Can Also at the top right corner of the screen and Download Migration Template-Fill the necessary fields and upload the migration file in the migration tool-Select Properties and choose the migration mode: Enhance already existing records-At the bottom of the screen, in the details of the migration file, you see that the General tab is missing-Cause-Since 1811 release, the General sheet is not relevant for the migration mode Enhance already existing records.-Resolution-It is the system behavior that when Enhance already existing records migration mode is used for Migration of Materials, the General tab is not available in the migration tool.-Note: This is applicable for all other modes of migration as well.-Keywords-Material, Migration, Enhance already existing records, Product

Title: Dunning Strategy of Run Does not Match Strategies of Selected Accounts
Content: Symptom-Dunning Run results in errors: "Dunning strategy of run does not match strategies of selected accounts".-No dunnings created.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Under Periodic Tasks select the view Dunning Runs.-Fill the data selection and execute the run.-Under the Execution Details, Select the Application Log ID and navigate to general tab.-Error: "Dunning strategy of run does not match strategies of selected accounts".-No dunnings created.-Cause-If the Dunning Strategy maintained in the account master data and the dunning strategy selected in the dunning run are different then dunning run fails and results in the errors mentioned.-Resolution-There are two ways you can avoid this error.-Go to Business configuration Work center -Select the view Overview.-Search and find the activity Dunning Strategies.-Select the option Assign Dunning Strategy to Company/Customer/Supplier.-Add Row and maintain the company, customer/supplier details and Dunng Proc.-Then during the execution of the Dunning run, the strategy will be picked based on this system for the execution and you do not have to maintain.-Or.-Check the maintained dunning strategy in the customer master and select the same dunning strategy in the dunning run.-Keywords-Dunning Strategy of Run Does not Match Strategies of Selected Accounts, Dunning Run,-Dunning strategy mismatch

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to record time in Project organizational Unit - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration workcenter-Edit Employee-Employee Times -Add Row-Time Type - Actual Hours worked-Labor Resource -Add Project Task-But the task does not exist.-Cause-The F4 functionality is built based on the employee and corresponding assigned projects.  -In the given scenario, Org. unit is assigned to the project instead of employee.
