Title: How to Post Customer Invoices With Different Bill-To Party / Payer
Content: Symptom-In your SAP ByDesign system you maintained a Customer Account XYZ ( XYZ indicates customer ) and Customer Account PQR (PQR indicates customer).-Scenario is that for both the accounts, the Payer is Customer XYZ.  This means the posted invoice of Customer PQR  also should be posted in the Customer Account Monitor of Customer XYZ only.-Environment-Bydesign Financials.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-View Accounts.-Select Customer PQR and click on edit and navigate to Contacts tab.-Navigate to Relationships tab and Add Row and maintain the Relationship Type as Has the Payer and maintain customer account XYZ.-Save.-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-For Customer Invoice of PQR and change the Bill-To and also Payer as Customer XYZ, fill the other required information and post the invoice.-Resulting customer invoice is showing as posted and is visible in the customer account monitor/Receivables of PQR only and is not shown as open item under customer account monitor of XYZ.- Cause-This is correct and expected system behaviour.-Resolution-In case of debtors, we show these items where the debtor is the owner. The debtor is responsible for the payment of the item. There can be an agreement that another partner will pay for this (Bill-to-party), but the payer is a third party which will not be considered for the Receivable Account in Financials.-Also, documents such as dunning letters, balance confirmations and reconciliation reports will always be generated according to the open items of the Receivable account owner, not the payer.-Still, a Dunning will be sent to the debtor should the payment not be made according to the payment terms.-Keywords-Bill-to or payer settings in customer accounts-customer account with another payer,bill-to/ payer of customer

Title: Project Invoice requests displays quantity as Zero for the Time and Material Invoicing Method
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Project Invoice requests displays quantity as Zero for the Time and Material Invoicing Method-It is not picking up the quantity from the supporting documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management workcenter-Select the Project - YPR(YPR means the project ID)-Create a Manual project invoice request-But the quantity for Time and Material Invoicing Method, is coming up as ZERO (0).-It is not picking up the quantity from the supporting documents.-Cause-For time and expense items, you have to click on propose invoice item assignment in the time and expenses tab.-Resolution-Quantity will be updated when invoice item is assigned to the expenses listed in time and expense items.

Title: PSM request for the AddressReference for ProductRecipientItemParty node on Project Stock Order:
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-PSM request for the AddressReference for ProductRecipientItemParty node on  Project Stock Order: -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Basic steps for OData.-In the application and user management workcenter.-OData Services-Fetch Project Stock order.-Fetch AddressSnapshotUUID from ProductRecipientItemParty on that order- Create new AddressSnapshot for party based on retrieved data- Update the address reference for Project Stock Order with the newly created AddressSnapshot.-Cause-ProjectStockOrder  > Changing the Address reference UUID of ITEM_LOCATION-ADDRESS_REFERENCE-ADDRESS_HOST_UUID will  Save the newly entered UUID reference in the DB but not changing the Address snapshot field value of the  ItemLocation node. So on SAP BYD UI, address still showing the address information of the old  address reference uuid one which is referring to Address snapshot uuid field instead changed field address_reference_uuid.   -Resolution- Currently this functionality not there in the system. We are considering this as a new development in the 2402 release

Title: Completed Sales Order XYZ is stuck In-Transit.
Content: Symptom-Sales Order XYZ(where XYZ is the Sales Order ID) is in Completed status and also the related Outbound Delivery ABC(where ABC is the Outbound Delivery ID) is Released and invoiced.-However you notice that the Outbound Delivery ABC is In-Transit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1)Go to  Third-Party Logistics workcenter-2)Under Common Tasks view, select View Intercompany In-Transit Deliveries sub-view.-3)Search for Outbound Delivery ID ABC- The details are being displayed.-Cause-Outbound Delivery ABC is stuck in transit as both buyer and Sender in Sales Order XYZ are maintained as company meaning this is in Intercompany scenario.-Here in intercompany scenario first Purchase order need to be created first and on purchase order release sales order is created.-However, in this scenario we find the sales order XYZ but there is no Purchase order. So, when the outbound delivery ABC is released Inbound Delivery Notification is not created, as for IDN, purchase order reference is required.-Therefore, messages are stuck in backend and cannot be processed.-Resolution-Thus, to have a complete intercompany process, First Purchase order is created, then sales order, then Outbound delivery, then Inbound delivery notification after that Inbound delivery. The document flow will be PO -> SO -> OD -> IDN -> CID.-In this scenario, outbound delivery ABC need to be cancelled and all the other documents up to sales order XYZ need to be cancelled .-New intercompany purchase order need to be created and we have to follow the correct process for intercompany scenario.-See Also-Third Party Logistics, In Transit, Inbound Delivery Notification not created, Inbound Delivery, Purchase Order, Outbound Delivery, Sales Order, Intercompany, Buyer, Seller, Company

Title: Internal Comments not Transferred From Service Order to Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have entered an Internal Comment in the service order. However, when the purchase order is created, the internal comments are not transferred. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit and navigate to Notes tab-No comments visible-Cause-The field Internal Comment in Service Order serves a different purpose. -If an Internal Sales note has been entered in the account master, it is displayed here under internal Comment and can be edited. Meaning in the corresponding Account Master data, there is a tab called Notes. If you enter the notes, it will be displayed in the service order automatically under internal comments.-Resolution-System is working as expected. I do not see any other scoping questions, which can be scoped to transfer the internal comments from service order to purchase order. -Keywords-Internal comments not transferred from service order to purchase order

Title: Service Order status in Order Pipeline View of Field and Service Repair workcenter is not as expected.
Content: Symptom-The status of the Service Order is Not Started in Field and Service Repair work center=>Order Pipeline View, even though the Service Order is released and is in status In Process. -Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Orders work center-Go to Service Order Processing View-Search for Service Order XYZ(XYZ is the ID of Service Order)-You can see the Service Order XYZ is in status In Process-Now, Go to Field and Service Repair work center -Go to Order Pipeline View-Search for Service Order XYZ-You can Status is Not Started in the Overview Screen.-Cause-The system shows the Delivery Status of the Service Order in Order Pipeline View so that the Service Performer can execute the service and create service confirmations.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-Keywords-Service Order; Status; Not started; Order pipeline; Field service and repair;

Title: New Goods and Services Receipt Button Greyed out in Purchase Orders View
Content: Symptom-You have created and ordered the purchase order document. However New Goods and Service Receipt button is greyed out in the purchase orders view. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase order-You can see that, New Goods and Service Receipt button is greyed out-Cause-New Goods and Service Receipt button will be disabled only for To-Stock purchase orders. You can create goods and service receipt with reference to purchase order for non-stock materials and services from purchase orders view. -Resolution-For To-Stock orders, you must go to Inbound Logistics work center and Purchase Orders view. Here you can click on Post Goods Receipt / New Supply Delivery Notification / Post Goods Receipts as Planned button is enabled for receipt creation.-Keywords-New Goods and Service Receipt button greyed out; New Goods and Service Receipt button disabled;

Title: Intrastat Errors - Goods movement and invoice; Company VAT ID missing
Content: Symptom-Intrastat Errors-Goods movement and invoice; Company VAT ID missing-Transfer to declaration not possible for selected criteria: Diagnosis No documents found for Intrastat valuation for the selected criteria System Response Valuation not possible Procedure Change the selection criteria Procedure for System Administration-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center - Intrastat Declaration Runs view-Select the Intrastat Declaration Run ID with Status being Active-There are no Declarations created-There are errors in the execution details-  Intrastat Errors-Goods movement and invoice; Company VAT ID missing-Transfer to declaration not possible for selected criteria: Diagnosis No documents found for Intrastat valuation for the selected criteria System Response Valuation not possible Procedure Change the selection criteria Procedure for System Administration-Cause-As per the specification of Intrastat, it is mandatory to fill the Business partner Vat ID in case of Dispatch scenario but not in arrival.-So we suggest you to maintain tax data for business partner-Resolution-Go to workcenter “Business Partner Data”-Click on Business Partners.-Search for business partner ID-Then click on Business partner ID highlighted in below screenshot.-On next screen, click on business partner role “Supplier” -Click on “View All” button, Go to “Financial Data” tab & then go to “Tax Data” under it.-Here tax data needs to be maintained

Title: Purchase Request ID is Blank/not Populated.
Content: Symptom-Purchase requests are not created when purchase proposal is released either manually or via run.-Also Purchase Request ID is blank/not populated.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Control workcenter and  Monitor Purchase Requests view.-2. Filter by Open Purchase Requests.-3. You can see that the Request ID field is blank.-Cause-Summation of Quota Arrangement for Supplier is exceeding 1,00,000 hence there is a dump in the backend and resulting in unprocessed messages.-Resolution-Set a quota arrangement for the product in such a way that summation of quota for all the supplier should not be more than 99,999 in Sourcing and Contracting workcenter and Quota Arrangements  view.-Keywords-Purchase Request, Quota Arrangement, Sourcing and Contract, Supplier

Title: Unable to find the TaxDueDate field in cloud application studio at the SupplierInvoice BusinessObject.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Unable to find the TaxDueDate field in cloud application studio at the SupplierInvoice BusinessObject.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to the Cloud Application studio-2. Check for the TaxDueDate on the Root Level of the Supplier Invoice-3. This field is not visible in the Repository Explorer. -Cause-The Tax due date field is not editable even in system frontend.-The system use the posting date as the default tax due date. If the tax due date is not available, it uses the invoicing date-Resolution-So the value of this field cannot be manually changed, hence we also can't provide PSM release for it.-You are not expected to change the value via SDK as well.-Hence there is no feasibility to provide the PSM release for the field

Title: View Printed Results in Statutory Reports displays the document status as 'Pending'
Content: Symptom-After selecting View Printed Results for a newly created Statutory Report Run ABC, the status of the output document is shown as "Pending"-Delete button is disabled for the Report Run ABC-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center-Open Statutory Reports view-Select the Report Name XXXX-Select Run Name ABC-Observe the Delete button is greyed out-Select View Printed Results-The status is displayed as "Pending"-Cause-In the Printer Queue there are more queued documents-Resolution-Restart the Cloud Print Manager service, which will process the queued documents.-The Report Runs with status Released cannot be deleted as per the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Print Queue, Statutory Reports, Pending Status, CPM, Print Records, Report Runs, output stuck, released statutory report, delete button, disabled, greyed out

Title: While Creating Sales Order via Webservice Incoterms was not Fetched from XML
Content: Symptom-Incoterms was not Fetched from Webservice While Sending Product Recipient Party in the Same XML for Sales Order Creation. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-You are creating a New sales order via webservice with <ProductRecipientParty> and <Incoterms> tag. -Cause-Incoterms are fetched from the Ship-to location of the sales order. Since we are using <ProductRecipientParty> in the XML, system will capture the Incoterms from the Product Recipient Party (Ship-to) master data. -Resolution-To fetch Incoterms from the XML we need to pass the Incoterms in the second call without <ProductRecipientParty>. -This is a standard system behavior.  -Keywords-ProductRecipientParty; <Incoterms>;

Title: Input Products are Listed Twice In the Preview of a Released Execution Model
Content: Symptom-In the Preview of a released Execution Model, the input products are listed twice.-Once they are listed with the Material description as element description.-After that, they are repeated another time without any information in element description.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Planning and Production Master Data workcenter and Production Models view.-2. Find and select Production Model ID PM1(where PM1 is the Production Model ID)-3. Click on Open Released Execution Model->All Versions.-4. Select any Version ex. Version 2 and Preview.-You will notice that input products appears twice in the list.-Initially all input products with element description and later input products without element description.-Cause-Input products are listed twice because first set of input products are from Supply operation and the next set of input products are from the different operations where the same input products are given.-Resolution-This is current behavior of the system i.e. one set of input products are displayed with description and another set without.-See Also-Input Products, Twice, Production Model, Preview, Element Description, Planning and Production Master Data, Released Execution Model.-Keywords-Input Products, Twice, Production Model, Preview, Element Description, Planning and Production Master Data, Released Execution Model.

Title: Nickname Appears in Header Ribbon of Personnel File
Content: Symptom-Nickname appears in header ribbon of personnel file although no value of nickname field is present in Biographical Data tab.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Search for the employee-Edit the Employee data-Select View All button-Go to Personal Data tab and Biographical Data sub tab  -Not Able to find the Nickname field -But the nickname value is present in name ribbon -Cause-The nickname in header ribbon of personnel file is fetching data from migration of employee file where the nickname value is maintained.-You have enabled nickname in fine tuning activity "Maintain Name Formats" for the particular country and performed the migration of employee via migration workbench and have given the value for field nickname.-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Show Activities and find the activity General Business Partners -Open the activity and select Maintain Name Formats-Select the required country-At the bottom of the screen in the Details of Name Format for the respective country ,you can find nickname-Now,-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview view-Show Activities and find the activity "Migration of employees"-Search for particular migration file -Here you can find for employee , nickname value is maintained-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. This is not possible to change once the employees with nickname field values are migrated.-See Also-  2738661 - How to enable Nickname field for Employee’s Personnel File-Keywords-Nickname , name format, name ribbon

Title: Exchange Rate for Key figure Invoiced Net Value in Invoice Volume Report
Content: Symptom-The Invoiced Net Value in the Invoice volume report is not as expected because the system is considering the exchange rate even though the currency in the customer invoice is USD and the display currency is also USD in the report.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Reports view.-Find the Invoice Volume Report.-Open the report in web browser.-Select the Invoice ID XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Customer Invoice) in the Selection .-Select the Go button.-You will see that the report shows the Invoiced Net value as 101.1234 USD is the Invoiced net value amount of invoice in the report).-However if you see the Customer Invoice XYZ, you can see the net value is 100 USD.-You would like to know why the Invoiced Net value is not 100 USD.-Cause-In the Report Invoiced Net Value key figure always stores the data in backend in the currency based on the country of the company. In your case, the currency based on the country of the company is AUD , hence the system converted the Invoiced Net value field from USD-> AUD and stored the same in the backend.-When invoice XYZ was created, the system considered the active exchange rate for USD->AUD for Invoice date. This value was saved in the backend. However, the exchange rate from USD -> AUD was changed after the invoice was created.-The Invoice volume Report considers the exchange rate based on the date maintained in selection field Display Currency - Conversion Date while displaying the Invoiced Net value field. If you have maintained the current date in this field, the system considers the exchange rate for current date and displays the Invoice net value based on the same.-Note: USD and AUD are considered as example currencies, the behavior is applicable for all currencies-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-See Also-2464846 - Net Value Showing in Different Currency in Sales Order Item Data Source and Sales Order Document or Customer Invoice Item Data Source and Invoice Document-1892948 - You Get the Incorrect Exchange Rate in Invoice Volume Report-Keywords-Invoice Volume Report; Company Currency ; Exchange Rate;

Title: Weighted Value is not Displaying in Opportunity Pipe Line Report While Filtering the Product Category
Content: Symptom-Weighted Value is not displaying in Opportunity Pipe Line Report while filtering the product categories. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-New Business - List-Report: Opportunity Pipeline-Run the report with Product Categories-Cause-Weighted Value is there in the header level of the opportunity and therefore the weighted Value is the sum of all items in the opportunity.-Resolution-Therefore when we exclude items based on product categories the weighted value couldn’t be fetched correctly.-Keywords-Gewichteten Werte;

Title: Unable to Delete the Expired Certificate
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-User is not able to delete the Expired Certificate under Certificate Trust List.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer -SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Navigate to Common Tasks work center view-Choose Edit For Certificate Trust List-Select the Relevant Certificate Services & RSA Certification Authority  -Delete the certificates under the node-The pop-up shows that it's deleted successfully.-But When the screen is refreshed ,the Certificate is still displayed.-Cause-Dump occurs While Deleting the Certificate in the UI.-Due to this certificate is not getting deleted from Backend.-Resolution-Check the backend dump in ST22 Logs, you will find the Triggering Component for the Dump.-This inconsistency can be resolved by respective Development Team.-Keywords-Delete,Expired Certificate,Certificate Trust List.

Title: Unable to Edit the Information in Dunning Proposal with Retry Function
Content: Symptom-You are not able to edit the information in the Dunning Proposal after clicking on Retry button.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Select the relevant Dunning ID.-The status is Released.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-The status of the Dunning letter is in Error:An output error occurred.-Click on Retry.-You cannot edit the information.-Cause-You cannot edit the information using Retry option in the Dunning Proposal.-Resolution-As a workaround, you need to follow the below steps to edit and resubmit the Dunning letter:-Go to the Receivables work center.-Go to the Dunning view.-Select the relevant Dunning ID.-The status is Released.-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Output History tab.-Click on Resubmit>Uncheck Resubmit with watermark "Duplicate".-Click on Resubmit button.-Keywords-Retry in Dunning letter, Ourput history, Edit dunning letter, An output error occurred

Title: Error message -Data missing for active and inactive times, calendar operation error." while migrating projects
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error message -Data missing for active and inactive times, calendar operation error." while migrating projects.-This is only possible if you remove the stored calendar from the upload file. Without this removal, the system issues the error message "Data missing for active and inactive times, calendar operation error..  The calendars were neither edited nor changed in finetuning. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work wenter.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the project First Implementation.-Select Open Activity List.-Select Integrate and Extend Phase.-Select Migration of Projects activity.-Select Migrate projects using the migration tool.-In the new window that opens,-Click on not completed files-Click on execute migration -There is an error messages - .Data missing for active and inactive times, calendar operation error." while migrating projects-Cause-The error message “Data for active and inactive times is missing, calendar operation failed.” is because Finish date 31.12.2999 is too far-off and has to be adjusted.-Resolution-You have to change the Finish date of the project in the excel sheet to the current date so that migration works fine.

Title: Urgent Change loses its link to Request for Change when working with Release Cycles
Content: Symptom-You are working with SMRE Release Cycles.-You have a RfC with several types of Change Documents including Urgent Changes.-You set Release cycle to Hypercare.-RfC and all Change Documents but Urgent Changes are now linked to the successor Release.-Urgent Change loses its link to RfC and remains linked to the original Release.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2 as of SP06-Cause-According to SAP Note 2503525 - ChaRM: When setting a release cycle to Hypercare phase urgent change should stay in current cycle: open urgent changes must be processed in the "Hypercare" or "Operate" phase of the current cycle. They should not be handed over to the successor cycle. -Resolution-This is standard and expected behavior. When setting the original Release cycle to FINI status, the Urgent Changes are also transferred to the successor Release and it should be possible to reassign them to original RfC using the Related Document field of the Urgent Change.-See Also-SAP Note 2503525 - ChaRM: When setting a release cycle to Hypercare phase urgent change should stay in current cycle-SAP Note 2830558 - Link Change Document directly to Request for Change or IT Requirement-Keywords-UC, RfC, Solution Manager, ChaRM, break, link, lost

Title: Manager cannot be assigned in business task management
Content: Symptom-In business task management, the assignment of tasks does not work as expected.-A and B stand for employees of different org/reporting line units.-C stands for an employee who is the manager of a further org/reporting line unit.-For employee A, it is possible to assign e.g. an 'approve leave request' task to employee C.-For employee B, it is not possible to assign e.g. an  'approve leave request' task to employee C.-While C is a manger, C is not the manager of A and B, and also not of an associated  above reporting line unit.-No substitutions are involved.-It is not clear why C can be assigned to A but not to B.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Task Management view-Find e.g. an 'Approve Leave Request' task for A-Try to: Assign Item to C-> C is found and can be assigned -Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Task Management view-Find e.g. an 'Approve Leave Request' task for B-Try to: Assign Item to C-> No search results for C-Cause-Employee A's  org unit has C as assigned employee, hence C is available for assignment.-Employee B's  org unit  doesn't have C as assigned employee, hence C is not available for assignment.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-sending, approval, fails, failing

Title: Customer Invoice is Split Due to Payment Due Date Difference
Content: Symptom-You are going to invoice a project invoice request and a manual invoice request into one customer invoice, but system split them into 2 customer invoices instead.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the customer invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Requests view.-Show To Be Invoiced invoice requests.-Select both invoice requests you want to invoice, and click Invoice, in the new invoice screenshot, split happens.-Select 2 proposed invoices, click split analysis, no reason provided.-Cause-The split is happening because in manual invoice request there is a payment due date maintained, but project invoice requests do not have this field. -Note if you try to remove the payment due date it may make the document inconsistent, a check and redetermine fills the field again, it is not possible to merge these two invoices.-Resolution-You need to invoice the invoice requests separately.-Keywords-invoice split; project invoice request; manual invoice request; payment due date.

Title: Dump While Saving Service Confirmation Of a Service Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer is unable to save the service confirmation for a service order as they are receiving 500 Internal Server Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Order Work Center.-Go to Service Order Processing view.-Filter to show All Orders.-Search and select the required Order ABC.-Open the Service Order ABC and select View All.-Change the Requested Date and confirm the changes by saving the data. -System crashes-Cause-The dump occurred because there were two instances created in TIMX_VIEW_OF_SERVICE_DOC with same UUID for the same service order.-Resolution-A data correction run needs to be performed in backend.-Take the required permissions from the customer end and forward it to development team with the dump analysis. -Keywords-Service Confirmation, Service Order, TIMX_VIEW_OF_SERVICE_DOC, Instance

Title: When creating the Manual Journal entry for Materials with the Negative value, system throws Error: Cost allocation needs a reference quantity >0
Content: Symptom-Customer Return Warehouse Confirmation XXX was marked as irrelevant whereas it adjustment confirmation YYY got posted. -When trying to adjust the difference with a Manual Journal entry Voucher for materials an error message appears: Cost allocation needs a reference quantity >0 - see material ABC (ABC refers to Material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entry Voucher sub-view.-Create a New Journal Entry Voucher by entering the type Manual Entry for Materials. (To adjust the discrepancy occurs as a differences in Customer Return Warehouse Confirmation and adjustment confirmation)-Enter all required details and try to Post the Journal Entry Voucher.-You will see the error message: Material ABC stock qty. AA ea - ref. quantity BB ea is too big (set of books ABC) (or) Cost allocation needs a reference quantity >0---Cause-When you are trying to post the Manual Journal Entry Voucher for Materials ,you should give the Reference Quantity. That Reference Quantity should be less than the actual Material Inventory quantity. In the Quantity difference field you've entered minus value in the Fulfilled Quantity.-For Example: if the Fulfilled Quantity is 1 EA, then you've entered Reference Quantity as -1 EA (which is not greater than 0)and saved it.-Here system compares the values in Material Inventory Quantity and Quantity entered in your Journal Entry Voucher, if the entered JEV Quantity is lesser than the Material Inventory Quantity, then System throws the error message as "Cost allocation needs a reference quantity >0"-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-To check the Material Inventory Quantity.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Materials sub view.-Search for the ABC (ABC refers to Material ID).-Here, you can see the actual Inventory Quantity.-Now go to Manual Journal entry Voucher.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Journal Entry Voucher sub-view.-Create a New Journal Entry Voucher by entering the type Manual Entry for Materials. -There Under Add row, if you are  trying to create with '-1' It won't take as per the nature of the report.-So try to give the Positive value and at the same time it should be lesser than a value in the Material Inventory Quantity-      Keywords-Cost allocation needs a reference quantity >0, Manual Journal entry for Materials, Negative Value

Title: Performance of Supplier Invoices Uploaded Through BOTs
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are using BPA-bot for uploading Supplier Invoices to SAP BYD. The bot processes and upload 4 invoices per minute and you would like to know whether this expected performance of the bot or is there any advice on how to increase the performance?-4 quoted above is a example for this use case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-4 invoices per min means 15 sec /invoice. These 15 sec includes not only the DOX scanning but also picking up the invoice from the folder, uploading it on DOX, receiving the results back, connecting to ByD and creating a new entry and uploading the document in DOX.-The size of the invoices also contributes to the performance. Again there is no benchmark however a normal 1-2 pages invoice this is not qualified as a performance issue-Resolution-Also note that that DOX is an asynchronous process, which means the individual invoices are queued to the DOX service and they are processed once this is free. For asynchronous processing we consider low performance from more then 20 seconds per invoice (only processing time excluding all other bot activities), which means somewhere around 30 seconds per invoice if you include all other bot activities mentioned above.-Keywords-supplier invoice, bot, slow, upload, performance

Title: Supplier Invoice can't be posted on fixed asset due to Open Task: Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XXX in Set of Books YYY
Content: Symptom-When you try to post a Supplier Invoice regarding Fixed Asset procurement to accounting, the system gives the error message: An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ (XYZ refers to Fixed Asset ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1) Go to Supplier invoicing work center.-2) Go to Invoice and Credit memos sub view.-3) Search for the Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC refers to Supplier Invoice ID).-4) Open that Supplier Invoice and click on Actions - try to give Simulate Journal Entry.-5) Then you will receive the error: An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset XYZ (XYZ refers to Fixed Asset ID).-Cause-1) Open the Fixed Asset XYZ, there you will see one open Business task - Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XXX in Set of Books YYY (YYY represents the ID of the Set of Books).-2) You will find a hint to review the changes made to the Fixed Asset XYZ.-3) In the Changes tab, you can see that a user has made a change to the Fixed Asset at DD.MM.YYY, and that the depreciation term is from, for example: L012-S/L over rem. use.life 1st yr.conv. to 0100-LVA 100% complete depreciation (i.e. useful life years from 7 years to 1 year).-4) Here the changes were made to the Fixed Asset, but not being reviewed and saved. Because of this system throws the above mentioned error, while you trying to post the Supplier Invoice ABC.-Resolution-To Clear this task and to post the Supplier Invoice ABC,-You can do this as follows:-1) Go to Fixed Asset Work center.-2) Go for Fixed Asset Sub view.-3) Search for the Fixed Asset XYZ.-4) Go to the Values Tab, there under Valuation Values per Set of Books, you will see Values box. -5) Click that, and give Recalculate Adjustment and then save the Asset.-6) After this changes, Now you try to check and simulate the journal entry in the Supplier Invoice ABC, It will be Posted.-Keywords-Fixes Assets, Low Value Assets, Supplier Invoice, An error occured during depreciation calculation for asset, Review and Release the Changes of Low Value Asset XXX in Set of Books YYY.

Title: Users Receiving Broadcast E-mails Though Not Marked as Recipient
Content: Symptom-Your Users are receiving Broadcast E-mails even they are not configured or marked as irrelevant. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics Work Center.-Go to Broadcasts view.-Search for the required Broadcast Name.-Here you can see only one recipient is added but this being sent to user who are not seen in the list.-Cause-You have not maintained correct recipient to get the e-mails to respective recipient. -Resolution-Ensure that the correct recipient e-mail address in maintained in the system in order to broadcast the same.-Keywords-Broadcast, Recipients, E-mail Addresses

Title: Mobile App Users are redirected to the Desktop UI Screen
Content: Symptom-The desktop UI is invading the Mobile App for the users with access to self-service which opens to My Launchpad and the screen appears unfamiliar. Scroll down to Self-Services Overview, and the page opens with no active icons to access Timesheet.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the SAP Business ByDesign Mobile App-Observe, the UI displayed in the mobile application is incorrect-Cause-The user does not have the corresponding access to the Work Center view-Resolution-The user has to maintain the corresponding desktop Work Center View assigned on desktop UI. If this is the case, to get a tile into the mobile launchpad follow the below steps:-In case you did no manual adoption for the tiles on the screen, the easiest way is to follow the below steps.-1. Navigate to the User Profile on the top left corner-2. Select on Personalize-3. Select the User Profile icon on the top right corner-4. Select on Discard-5. Choose Confirm-6. Select the User Profile icon on the top right corner again-7. Tap on stop personalization mode-The screen should be refreshed and there should be a group shown (e.g. Field and Service Repair with tile Order Pipeline)-In case you did already manual adoption for the tiles on this screen, please follow the below steps:-1. Select the User Profile on the top left corner.-2. Select on Personalize-3. Select Plus Icon on the Group you would like to have the tile-4. Search for the "missing" tile (e.g. Order Pipeline)-5. Select the pin item of the tile-Keywords-Mobile App, Desktop UI, Self-Service Overview

Title: Email Text Body is not Editable while using an HTML E-mail Template
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to edit and change the e-mail text body.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work Center:-Application and User Management-View Form Template maintenance and chose any form i.e. Customer Invoice.-Click the Action button and create e-mail template-Upload your html e-mail template. -Customer Invoicing-Create and save a new customer invoice, where the newly created html e-mail template is used.-Navigate to the You can also button.-Edit output settings, sub tab E-Mail Text body.-Here it is not possible to change or edit the text.-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. As soon an html e-mail template is in use the e-mail text body is not changeable anymore.-If you like to modify the e-mail text body you can do this by using the SAP generic e-mail text bodies.-This text is editable and can be changed.-Resolution-If you like to change the e-mail text body you should not use html e-mail templates.-Keywords-html, e-mail templates, templates, Email.

Title: System Fails to Determine the Pricing Information Automatically From Purchasing Contract While Creating New Purchase Order for a Product
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchasing contract for a particular product and released. However when you create purchase order for the same supplier and product, system failed to recognize the pricing details from the contract automatically. -Environment-SAP ByDesign 2305-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Common Tasks and select New Purchase Order-Enter the relevant Supplier, Company and Product details-Now enter the Quantity-System fails to determine the Price from Purchasing Contract-Cause-You have maintained Minimum Order Quantity for the product in purchasing contract. When you enter the quantity more than the Minimum Order Quantity, system will automatically determine the pricing information from Contract. -Resolution-You have to enter the quantity greater than Minimum Order Quantity or reduce the Minimum Order Quantity in Contract, so that for any quantity, system determines the price for a particular product. To do so; -Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to the Contracts view-Select the relevant Contract-Select Edit and navigate to Items tab-Under Basic Data tab, there is a field called - Minimum Order Quantity-Modify this value according to your business needs-Keywords-System Fails to Determine the Pricing Information Automatically From Purchasing Contract While Creating New Purchase Order for a Product; Does not find price; Price details not determined in PO from Contract;

Title: Process communication error for the Goods and services receipt
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Process communication error for the Goods and services receipt - Problems with project or project element -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts workcenter-Receipts and Returns view-Select the Receipt - DEF(DEF refers to the goods and services receipt)-Navigate to the document flow-Here you see that there is a process communication error - Problems with project or project element -Cause-The project validity is already finished and has a past date -Resolution-Go to the Projects workcenter-Projects-Select the Project -In the General information, the Finish date is a past date-This has to be extended

Title: Mass Data Maintenance and Data Migration for Document Output Channels fails.
Content: Symptom-When trying to update Document Output Channels, using Mass Data Maintenance/Migration, system throws the following error message-"Service Call Failed"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work Center-Select Import Customers-Select attached CSV file-Select tab Document Output Channels and upload the file-Execute data import, you will see "Service Call failed"-Cause-The cause for this issue is, when you look at the output channel for the customer XYZ, you see that the output channel "Printer" already exists for the business document (Customer Invoice) in the template.-Resolution-This is standard system behavior.-Mass data maintenance does not work with multi-Channel. -If the issue occurs in Migration, with the Error "Business Feature 'Multiple Channels' is required for sheet 'Document Output Channels',-Please refer to KBA provided below. -https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2768853 Or https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2768853-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2985092 Or https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2985092-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2768853 Or https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2768853-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2985092 Or https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2985092-Keywords-Document Output Channels, Mass Data Maintenance, Multi-Channel

Title: System Throws Error message"Invalid recipient address "
Content: Symptom-While User is sending E-Mail, System Throws Error message "Invalid recipient address ".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work center-Navigate E-Mail and Fax Queues View-Go to the Advanced Search and select Output Status: Error-Find the relevant Document Name-The error is shown: Invalid recipient address abc@xx.com-Here We have taken Outgoing Bank Transfer as Example.-Go to Payment Management Work center-Navigate to Payment Monitor View-Go to the Advanced Search and Select "All Payments" in the drop down list-Enter the document ID and Choose Payment Method: Outgoing Bank Transfer-Select Output History tab-Error message: Invalid recipient address abc@xx.com-Choose on Error link and it shows the error message below: -An output error occurred:-Invalid recipient address  abc@xx.com-Open the task and view the details for more information about the error.-Cause-Payee is the Supplier for the above payment method scenerio.User has not maintained correct Email Address under Communication tab of the Supplier.-Resolution-User has to maintain the correct E-Mail address under Communication tab of the Supplier by following the below steps:-Open the Supplier Document which is related to Payment Method-Select View all button-Navigate to Communication tab-Choose Collaboration-Here you can Update the Correct E-mail Address-Keywords-Invalid recipient address , Payment method ,maintaining E-Mail ,Error Sending.

Title: System Selects Wrong Purchase Order Price When Assigning Source of Supply in Purchase Request Document
Content: Symptom-System selects the wrong price while assigning source of supply to purchase request using an existing purchase order as source of supply. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Requests view-Select the relevant Purchase Request-System selects the Pricing from wrong Purchase Order-Cause-System proposed two Purchase Orders in the source of supply screen and these purchase orders were created in different currencies. -Resolution-Hence system checks the exchange rate for both the orders and propose the lower value as a highest ranking in terms of source of supply. This is an expected behaviour. -Keywords-System Selects Wrong Purchase Order Price When Assigning Source of Supply in Purchase Request Document; Wrong price in PO; wrong source of supply;

Title: Invoiced quantity is different in report: Monitoring Purchase Orders and report: Monitoring Invoices
Content: Symptom-You find the invoiced quantity is different in report: Monitoring Purchase Orders from invoice quantity in report: Monitoring Invoices, you want to know why.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Report: List.-Open report: Monitoring Purchase Orders (Report ID: SRMPO_B02_Q0004).-Search for purchase order ABC (ABC represents the purchase order ID).-You find the Invoiced Quantity here is X (UoM).-Then go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Report: List.-Open report: Monitoring Invoices (Report ID: SRMIV_B03_Q0020).-Search for ABC.-You find the Quantity here is Y (UoM).-You want to know why there is quantity difference between these 2 reports.-Cause-There is supplier invoice (item) which is in approval status for this Purchase Order.-In report Monitoring Purchase Orders, system only considers those posted supplier invoice items, while in report Monitoring Invoices, system lists all the supplier invoices regardless the status of the invoice item.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Monitoring Purchase Orders, Monitoring Invoices, SRMPO_B02_Q0004, SRMIV_B03_Q0020, Invoiced Quantity, Different, Quantity

Title: OData APIs – Wrong usage of session cookies
Content: Symptom-What is the change?-Before: Security sessions were created and the CSRF token was bound to the security session. If the calls were made without sending the cookies back to server, new security sessions were getting created with every call and it decreased performance of OData calls.-Now: No security sessions are created but for the Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF/XSRF) protection a dedicated cookie is set.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Why the change?-We observed performance degradation during high ODATA activity due to very high number of security sessions being created. This change is implemented to optimize the performance by optimizing security session handling.-Resolution-What is the impact?-Integration scenarios using ODATA APIs might be impacted if not all cookies are sent back to server in subsequent OData calls. The impact is especially seen when "x-csrf-token" value is sent via request header along with a specific session cookie (instead of all cookies).-In such cases, CSRF token validation fails resulting in HTTP response code: 403 - Forbidden. -Example Change observed?-Before Change: Cookie with name: SAP_SESSIONID_<SID>_<Tenant Internal ID>  was sent in the response from the server which was utilized by the customers/partners for the ODATA calls.-After Change: Cookie with name: SAP_SESSION_<SID>_<Tenant Internal ID> is not returned in response header by server. Cookie with name sap-XSRF_<SID>_<Tenant Internal ID> is returned in the server response only when "x-csrf-token" is sent in the request header.-If "x-csrf-token" not requested, cookie "sap-XSRF_<SID>_<Tenant Internal ID>" is not returned.-Expectation from Customer?-Clients should not have any validations or checks or any kind of coding based on cookie names. Such checks need to be removed and the behaviour should be tested.-Clients consuming OData services should send back all cookies received from the server in subsequent calls to that server (without any filtering on cookie names).-How to Test?-OData API calls should work as it used to work earlier, before and after the change is applied in the system.----Keywords-security context session,session cookies,odata,cookies

Title: How to Upload Customer Invoice Requests to WebDav Folder From a Third-party System Using a Batch Job
Content: Symptom-How to upload customer invoice requests to WebDav folder from a third-party system using a batch job.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are trying to automate this copy process by using a batch routine written by you in the external system.-When you get to the point in the script where you use the NET USE command.-SAP ByDesign system asks for a certificate.-Cause-You need to import the certificate from the SAP ByDesign system and use external tools to automate the upload of invoice requests via WebDav folder.-Resolution-Please see below a description on how to get a certificate for the WebDAV connection and an alternative solution by using a different WebDAV client.--1.) Certificate:-You can download a certificate for the WebDAV connection in following way:-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Go to the Input and Output Management view.-Select the Communication Arrangementssubview.-Select the communication arrangement Access Documents via WebDAV.-Select Edit Credentials.-Select the tab Certificate.-Select Create and Download Key Pair-.-Choose a location and filename for the exported Certificate.-Set a password to protect the exported Certificate.-Now the Certificate must be imported in the Internet Explorer by using below steps:-Open the Microsoft Internet Explorer.-Go to the Tools -> Internet Options.-Select the Content tab.-Choose Certificates.-Choose Import.-Follow the steps in the Certificate Import Wizard and Choose the previously exported Certificate file.-When connecting to the WebDAVUrl via NET USE, a prompt for certificate selection should appear, where you can choose the exported certificate.--Note: If you have only one certificate installed, you could hide the command prompt by using below steps:-Open the Microsoft Internet Explorer-Go to the Tools -> Internet Options-Select the Security tab.-Choose the Zone for the ByD system (normally Trusted sites)-Select the Custom Level.-In the area Miscellaneous set the value for Don't prompt for client certificate selection, when no certificates or only one certificate exists to Disabled.-2.) WebDAV Client:-There are several WebDAV Client tools (also free of charge) on the Internet available which can be used to connect to the WebDAV Url.-In these clients a connection user with password can be defined, normally it is possible to store the password encrypted. It is also-possible to map the WeDAV Url as a Windows drive (e. g. D:\ would then point to the WebDAV location).--If NET USE is required, you can find more information on the Microsoft page:-http://www. microsoft. com/resources/documentation/windows/xp/all/proddocs/en-us/net_use.mspx?mfr=true-There was no possibility found to store the password for NET USE encrypted. If the password is stored unencrypted in plain text, it would-be possible for everybody to access the system with the user and password which is used for NET USE.-See Also- 3357180 - Mapping WebDav with Windows-Keywords-Access Documents via WebDAV, WebDav, Certidicate, Download Key Pair.

Title: Project Invoice requests display - wrong quantity as Zero of the Time and Material Invoicing Method
Content: Symptom-Project Invoice requests display - wrong quantity as Zero of the Time and Material Invoicing Method -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management workcenter-Select the Project DEF(DEF refers to the project)-Create a Manual project invoice request-But the quantity for Time and Material Invoicing Method, is coming up as ZERO (0).-It is not picking up the quantity from the supporting documents.-Cause-For time and expense items, you have to click on propose invoice item assignment in the time and expenses tab-Resolution-Quantity will be updated when invoice item is assigned to the expenses listed in time and expense items.

Title: Invoice Date Calculated from Invoicing Time Frame is Unexpected
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create invoice schedule to one contract line, and set up the recurrence pattern to every 2 month on the last day. You expect the invoice date should be taken from the last day of every 2 months, while system picks the last date of the first month instead.-For example, the invoice time range is from date 01.06.2023 to 12.31.2023. -recurrence patter is Monthly, every 2 month, on last day.-You expect the first invoice date should be 31.07.2023. (The last day of every 2 months). However system uses the date 30.06.2023 as the invoice date.(The last day of the first month in every 2 months)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open the contract ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the contract)-Go to the Invoice Schedule, select the line 10. The first invoice date is 30.06.2023.-Open the Time Frame, we can see the following:-start date: 01.06.2023 ~ end by date: 31.12.2023-Recurrence Pattern: monthly; Every 2 month on last day.-You expect the first invoice date should be 31.07.2023.-Cause-Since the recurrence pattern is monthly, system sperate the time into monthly basis. The field 'on' is calculated based on the monthly basis and does not consider the parameter 'every'. No matter what 'every' value you set, the last day is always taken from the first time basis.- Resolution-This is the current system design. -As a workaround, if the recurrence pattern cannot fulfill your requirement, you can use Individual Dates to add the invoice dates manually.-Keywords-invoice schedule; recurrence pattern; last day.

Title: You are Not Able to Descope Pro Forma Invoice Based on Sales Order Option
Content: Symptom-You want to descope the option for Pro Froma Invoice based on sales order. While doing so, you get warning message:-Deselecting Pro Forma Invoice based on Sales Order conflicts with productive data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration - Implementation Projects view.-Select First Implementation and click Edit Project Scope.-Go to Step 4 Questions - Sales - Customer Invoicing - Miscellaneous Invoicing folder.-Select Pro Froma Invoice based on sales order, descope it. -System shows the warning: Deselecting Pro Forma Invoice based on Sales Order conflicts with productive data-You are not able to save this change.-Cause-There are invoice requests not invoiced yet in the system, so the scope question is not able to be descoped.-Resolution-Ensure you have invoiced all the invoice requests before descoping the option.-Keywords-descope Pro Froma Invoice; Proforma invoice based on sales order.

Title: Mass Cancellation of Employee Times
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to cancel employee times massively but you are not able to find a tool to perform such operation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Employee time cancellation should only be done by time administrators of the company after reviewing the scenario.-Considering this, currently there is no tool to cancel employee times massively in SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-TLM, Time Sheet, Excel, Migration, Mass Data Maintenance

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Does Not Realise Manual Revenue Recognition Data in Subsequent Periods
Content: Symptom-You want to realize the planned revenue of Sales Order item XXX-XX (where XXX-XX represents the sales order item ID) equally over a certain time period, say 12 months.-You assign accrual method 106-Recognize based on manual amounts and maintain the same amount to be realized for each month.-Or you use a POC based accrual method, such as 102 - Recognize using cost-to-cost POC or  108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC. -You notice, however, that only the first revenue recognition run realizes the desired amount. All other runs do not realize any revenue on the sales order item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center and here to the Sales Document Items view.-Find and select sales order item XXX-XX.-Click on the Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data button and select Recognized Costs and Revenues.-In the new screen, you see that for each month the same amount is to be recognized, for instance-01.01.2018-31.01.2018: Recognized Revenue: 1000 EUR/ or 10%-01.02.2018-28.02.2018: Recognized Revenue: 1000 EUR/ or 10%-01.03.2018-31.03.2018: Recognized Revenue: 1000 EUR/ or 10% etc.-Now, to check the respective revenue recognition postings:-Close this screen and navigate back to the Sales Document Items view.-Click on the Revenue Recognition button and select Revenue Recognition History.-In the report you check the Current Earned Revenue column.-You notice that the amount which you have maintained for each period is only realized once with the first run. For all other periods 0,00 LC is displayed.-Cause- The revenue recognition run always checks all values that were recognized previously and then adds whatever is due in the respective period.-If you maintain the same amount/POC per period, then this amount is being realized in the first period only. For all other periods the Revenue Recognition run verifies that the maintained amount has already been realized previously and therefore does not execute any further revenue recognition postings.-Resolution-Instead of maintaining the same amount per period, you need to add the respective amount which is due for each subsequent period to the already realized value.-Go to the Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Click on the Sales Document Items View.-Find and select Sales Order Item XXX-XX.-Press on Edit Manual Revenue Recognition Data.-In the new screen enter, for example-01.01.2018-31.01.2018 1000 LC (Current Earned Revenue: 1000,00 LC)/ POC 10%-01.02.2018-28.02.2018 2000 LC (Current Earned Revenue: 1000,00 LC; Total Earned Revenue: 2000,00 LC)/ POC 20%-01.03.2018-31.03.2018 3000 LC (Current Earned Revenue: 1000,00 LC; Total Earned Revenue: 3000,00 LC)/POC 30%.-etc.-In this fashion, for each period, the same amount of 1000 EUR/ or 10% of the planned revenue is going to be realized.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-106-Recognize based on manual amounts, 102 - Recognize using cost-to-cost POC, 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC, revenue subsequent periods no posting, 106-Basierend auf manuellen Beträgen realisieren,

Title: Recipient Name in Purchase Order not Displaying Middle Name
Content: Symptom-Recipients middle name is not displaying in the dropdown list of the users while creating new purchase orders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders Work Center-Go to New Purchase Order View -Under Involved Parties, select the value help drop down for the Recipients field-We will see the Fist Name, Last Name of the employee , but not Fist Name, Middle Name, Last Name -Cause-Name format is maintained only for First Name and Last Name in the Business Configuration work center and hence Middle Name is not displayed in the value help of Recipients field.-Resolution-Follow the below path to set up the Name Formats as per the requirements:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview view and choose Activities from the dropdown list-Search for "General Business Partners" in the search tab and select it-Click on Maintain Name Formats-Add or Delete the row and select the required attribute. Make sure to arrange all the required Field Names in the desired order and save -Keywords-Recipient Name in Purchase Order, Name formats , First name, Middle name, Last name

Title: Total Net Value and Total Gross Value were incorrect for the Purchase order due to incorrect discount calculation
Content: Symptom-Total Net Value and Total Gross Value were incorrect for the Purchase order as the recalculation of  discount does not happen for a incorrect discount calculation does not happen while cancelling one of the line items in the Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase requests and orders workcenter-Purchase orders view-Select the purchase order DEF(DEF refers to the Purchase order id) and it has two line items-In the prices and discounts tab, you see that the discount is for example 100-If you cancel the line item 1-The discount is still shows as 50 and the system is not recalculating the discount correctly-Hence the Total Gross value and net value are incorrect-Cause-For the below issue, purchase order DEF has been created with two-line items. In the prices tab, added an overall discount of 100. The system has deducted the value based on the overall discount amount.-For example, if we have two-line items, the system will deduct 50 from each line item.-Resolution-Once we release the Purchase order, you will not be able to remove the line item, instead, we can cancel the line item. However, the system will not remove the overall discount for cancelled line items. You have the option to add a new line item, and for those lines, the overall discount value is also applicable.-  This is the standard behavior. If you wants to have an item-level discount, under the item tab, select the line item --> select the below prices sub-tab. Under that, we can maintain an item-level discount. If we cancel the line item, it will not affect the other line-item discount.

Title: Task - Approve Tax Payment Difference
Content: Symptom-You have not maintained an approval task for tax payment difference for your company. But, in your worklist you have the task Approve Tax Payment Difference.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Work view.-Select the Inbox subview.-Show Open Tasks.-You have the business task: Approve Tax Payment Difference <Identifier of the Tax Payment> - <DifferenceAmount> (<Tax Payment Amount>-Cause-When the amount of the assigned tax return differs from the tax payment amount (tax payment difference), a task Review and Release Tax Payment is created in the Tax Management work center to process the tax payment difference. Once the employee has released this payment, a task Approve Tax Payment Differences is generated in the approver worklist.-This also happens if an appropriate tax return is not found for a tax payment, or several tax returns are found for a tax payment.-Resolution-This is the normal expected system behavior. This task cannot be deactivated.-See Also-Help Document:-Task - Approve Tax Payment Difference.-Task - Revise Tax Payment Difference.-Keywords-Tax Payment Difference, Task - Approve Tax Payment Difference, Approve Tax Payment.

Title: It is Not Possible to Descope a Country XYZ from Cash Flow Key Country List
Content: Symptom-You are trying to descope a specific country from Cash Flow Key Country List, but you are getting an error message saying that it is not possible.  - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Overview view. -Search for activity: List of countries relevant for generating Direct Cash Flow Statement with Cash Flow Keys. -Select Country/Region XYZ (XYZ represents the Country). -Click Remove button. -Click Save. -You will see the following error message: -'Removal failed. Country XYZ is in use in bank statement ABC.-Save failed'-(ABC represents the Bank Statement ID)-Cause-This is the expected system behavior. The country XYZ is in use in bank statement ABC, and for this reason, you can't descope the country.- Resolution-One possible solution for this issue is to reverse the bank statement ABC which is using the cash flow key, and then re-try the process to remove the country ABC from Cash Flow Key Country List.  - Keywords-Removal failed, bank statement, Country, Cash flow key codes, List of countries relevant for generating Direct Cash Flow Statement with Cash Flow Keys,

Title: Multilevel Bill Of Material Structure Displays Different BOMs
Content: Symptom-Unable to see all BOMs created for one Finished Good however system is displaying different BOMs which are not related to the Finished Product's BoM.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center.-Go to Bill of Material View.-Find relevant BoM ID-Select and Choose Multi-Level BoM Structure.-Here you can see system is displaying BoMs along with other BoM.-Cause-Currently, there is no way to restrict the Multi-Level BoM structure. It system BoMs related to input products as well.-It displays input output combinations which is an expected system behavior. You can select the level until what level in hierarchy user wants to see.-Resolution-This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Multilevel Bill Of Material Structure Displays Different BOMs, Bill of Material, Hierarchy level, Multi-Level BoM Structure.

Title: There Are No Notifications for Approval Tasks on ByD Mobile App
Content: Symptom-You are using the ByD Mobile App (Android version) in China Mainland and cannot receive any notifications of approval tasks.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Notification doesn't work for Android in China mainland since they don't use Google Play Store. This should work fine for IPhone.-Resolution-This is the standard behavior.-Keywords-Notification, Mobile App, Android

Title: Supplier Invoice Cannot be Posted due to error: The system has created an exception because the receipt document is missing or invalid
Content: Symptom-You created a supplier invoice and assigned a delivery document to the invoice item.-But, when you try to post the supplier invoice, you encounter an internal server error and on checking exceptions tab, you can see error:-"The system has created an exception because the receipt document is missing or invalid. Process the corresponding exception."-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select invoice entry view-Create new invoice for the respective purchase order-Assign the respective delivery document to the invoice item-In Exceptions tab, you can see error: Receipt Document is Missing or Invalid-Select Post. System throws 500 internal server error or dump-Cause-Delivery document has been created but not yet posted to accounting. A business transaction is created with error: "Service product AAA / company BBB : valuation data not specified"(AAA refers to a product and BBB refers to the respective company).-This warning is also visible in the supplier invoice.-In General Ledger-> closing cockpit screen, the delivery document is not yet posted.-Resolution-Please go to product master data (Product Portfolio work center) and for the specific product, maintain the valuation data for the respective company.-Then navigate to the General Ledger work center-> Closing cockpit->unposted source documents, post the delivery document.-Now , if you select "Check" action on the invoice, the supplier invoice will not throw any warnings or error which means invoice is consistent and you can post the supplier invoice successfully.-Keywords-valuation data not specified, The system has created an exception because the receipt document is missing or invalid, receipt document missing, delivery missing, Service product/company: valuation data not specified, invoice cannot be posted, internal server error while posting invoice, dump while posting invoice

Title: Cannot Import Multi-Channel Collaboration Data for Customer Using Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to import multi-channel Collaboration Data for Customers via Mass Data Maintenance, but system reports an error of Service Call Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center.-Click Import Customers link.-Upload the file of multi-channel Collaboration Data for Customers you want to import.-Import.-System reports error: "Service Call Error".-Cause-This is the standard behavior. Mass Data Maintenance does not work with Multi-Channel import of Collaboration Data for Customers or Suppliers.-Resolution-You need to use the web service.-Keywords-Mass Data Maintenance, Multi-channel, Collaboration Data

Title: Convert Values in Migration Tool Suggest Incorrect Target Values
Content: Symptom-You are migrating an object using the migration tool. During the Convert Values step, you are completing a mapping activity for an ID however the target value is suggesting a different ID than the source value populated in the template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In this KBA we will take as an example the Supplier ID in the migration of Account Determination Groups for Suppliers.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Suppliers and open it.-Click on Migrate Account Determination Groups Payables Using the Migration Tool.-Select the migration template and click on Execute Migration.-Click on Step-by-Step.-Proceed to the Convert Values step.-Click on the task Edit Value Conversion for Supplier ID.-In this list, you can see that some target values for Supplier IDs are not the same as the source values in the template.-Cause-The value conversion for the migration tool uses the initial ID mapping for the respective business objects, and is shared across all migrations that use the same property.-In our example for Supplier ID, this means that if the ID was mapped to a different value during the migration of Suppliers, the same target value will be suggested for Supplier IDs in the migration of account determination groups.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-Following the example of Supplier ID migration, you can check the value mapping for an object by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search for activity Migration of Suppliers and open it.-Click on Migrate Suppliers Using the Migration Tool.-In the Show dropdown list, select Completed Files.-Click on You Can Also.-Click on Export Value Conversion to File.-this will download a text file where you can see the value mapping that was used during the initial migration. This value mapping will be used in any other migration that has a value conversion task for Supplier ID.-Keywords-Migration, Template, Value Conversion, Target Value, Convert Values

Title: Error Message - operation not enabled while approving Shopping Card
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error Message - shopping cart - Select Approve - Error operation not enabled appears.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing my area work center-Approvals view-Select approval task for shopping cart - Select Approve - Error operation not enabled appears.-Cause-When you go to Application and User -work center - Business Users view - Search for  - Edit Access Rights - Access Restrictions- When we search the work center View Name *common* - system shows three entries.-CC_COMMON - Common Authorizations-CC_COMMONEMPLOYEESELFSERVICE - Common Authorizations for Employees-CC_COMMONPERSONALWORK - Common Authorizations for Users-If you check the authorizations for work center views ID CC_COMMONEMPLOYEESELFSERVICE and CC_COMMONPERSONALWORK, the user Read and write access is Restricted. And hence the user 孙 博颖 getting the error message.-Resolution-In order to approve the shopping carts, you must provide the Read and Access to the work center view CC_COMMONEMPLOYEESELFSERVICE and CC_COMMONPERSONALWORK. Since the user is assigned to work centers based on business roles, please make sure that, these roles have this assigned properly with read and write access.

Title: System Creating Multiple Tasks Against Stock Transfer Order ViaTwo Step Shipping Model.
Content: Symptom-You want to create a task against relevant order however system is creating one task for each line item against Stock Transfer Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Outbound Delivery Proposal view.-Select required ID and choose create warehouse task.-System creates Warehouse task ID.-Once it is created, system creates pick task.-Now navigate to Task Control view.-Search for relevant warehouse request ID.-Here you can find, system has generated multiple tasks for same warehouse request instead of one.-- Cause-Since in the relevant logistics model ID, Activity Type is maintained Move Per Destination due to which system is creating multiple tasks against an order.-In the used Logistics Model, the Activity Type is Move Per Destination for both operations: Pick and Load operations.-Activity Type determines the number of Tasks to be created for a given Warehouse Request. In this case, the Target Logistics Area is fetching different for each item, hence as the "Move Per Destination" Activity, two or more tasks are created based on the Target Logistics Area.-Resolution-Go to Warehouse and Logistics Master Data work center.-Go to Logistics Models view.-Find relevant Logistics Model ID with template ID :Template for two-step shipping with pick and load.-Select and edit it.-Select row with Operation Pick and choose option: Change Activity Type.-Select Activity Type :Move All via drop down.-Select the same Activity for Load operation as well.-Now perform Save and Release.-Note : It is valid for one step shipping model as well.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2754111-Keywords-Template for two-step shipping with pick and load, multiple tasks against warehouse request, stock transfer order, sales order, Change activity type, Warehouse and Logistics Master Data,-Logistics models

Title: Asset Class Determination issue
Content: Symptom-In Asset Class Determination, you have 2 Fixed Asset Class for each Product Category.-One set is specifically for company ID XYZ(XYZ refers to a company ID), as the company's useful life is different and other row is for blank company code.-You would expect, upon performing Goods Receipt of asset of company XYZ, it will be posted to the asset class linked to XYZ, however the assets are still posted to the Asset Class that is applicable to blank, instead of the set for company XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Fixed Asset Classes Activity-Asset Class Determination section-The product category ID has 2 asset classes mapped-Cause-Current system design-Resolution-When setting up the decision table always keep specific entries (ones which have a product category explicitly maintained) at the top and keep the generic entries (ones with blank product category) at the bottom as these serve as a fallback in case a specific product category is not found.-We discovered that any product categories maintained beneath this "empty" line, were pretty much invisible to the system logic.-The current workaround is to move the other rows above the empty one (so in this case, select the last four rows and click button "Move Up"). Once you do this, the document should post fine-Keywords-Asset class, Product category

Title: While Previewing Delivery Note, Customer Part Number Is Missing
Content: Symptom-When you are previewing required Delivery Note, you find that Customer Part Number is missing for line items.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for relevant Delivery ID.-Select and choose Preview button.-You can see there is no customer part number for lines. --Cause-This is a Third Party Sales Order Scenario.-Currently, customer part number is not available at all for this scenarios in corresponding outbound delivery, if sales order is of type: Third Party.-Resolution-This is the current SAP ByDesign behavior.-Kindly post your query in Influence Forum so that our Development Colleagues will look in to this.-Customer Influence Forum, at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Other customers can then vote for it, which will assert its legitimacy as a standard feature by showing the industry need and in turn influence the implementation schedule of the requirement.-See Also-1764406 - Customer Information Note Type is not Visible in the Customer Invoice Screen-Keywords-Customer Information Note, Preview Outbound Delivery, Outbound Delivery, Third party, Sales Order.

Title: Scoping Question: Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months? grayed out.
Content: Symptom-The scoping Question: 'Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?' is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Choose next and navigate Questions tab.-Select the element of Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Choose sub element of Inventory Management.-Select Inventory Postings.-The scoping question: Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months? checkbox is grayed out.-Cause-The checkbox is greyed out as the question have dependency of quality assurance in the Scope tab.-Resolution-To enable the checkbox, follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Choose next and navigate Scoping tab.-Select the element of manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Go to element of Quality assurance and enable the check box, automatically quality control and quality planning get enabled.-Select Inventory Postings and choose next-Enable the check box for the Question: Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?-Keywords-Scoping, Quality assurance, Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months, grayed out, inventory postings
