Title: Unable to Delete Playbooks From Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-You are trying to delete a Playbooks (Sales Cycle or Sales Phase) on Business Configuration, but the option “Delete” is disabled and not able to delete any Playbooks. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Select the Implementation Projects view-Select the First Implementation project and click on the Open Activity List button-Go to the Fine-Tune steps-Open the fine-tuning activity Sales Cycles and Phases-Click on Maintain Sales Cycles-The option “Delete” is disabled and not able to delete any Playbooks-Cause-The main cause for this issue is the First implementation project is in status "Closed' and Cannot access Open activity list.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-You have to create a new project and follow the steps to find Delete Option.-click on open activity list and go to Fine-Tune steps-Open the fine-tuning activity Sales Cycles and Phases-Click on the link Maintain Sales Cycles-The option “Delete” will be available under Define Sales Cycle-See Also- 2939381 - Sales Phase Cannot Be Deleted in the Sales Cycles and Phases Activity-Keywords-Playbooks, Delete, Sales Phase, Sales Cycle

Title: Goods and Service Receipt cannot be posted due to missing Account Determination
Content: Symptom-Goods and Service Receipt cannot be posted due to error: "No account determination group found for product category ABC"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Order view-Open the document flow, open Goods and Service Receipt ID-Goods and Services Receipt not posted due to error: "No account determination group found for product category ABC"-Cause-The Product Category ABC and the Account Determination group for this Product Category are not maintained.-The Product Category ABC is not available when searching for "Default Account Determination Group for Product Category" in the Business Configuration work center under Overview and selecting a line item with change category "Immediate Change."-Resolution-Maintain Product Category ABC and the relevant Account Assignment Group in the master data.-Then, the Goods and Service Receipt can be posted.-See Also-KBA 2999490- Error - Account determination group AAA: G/L acct missing for Inventories ->Gains and Losses ->Material Consumption-Keywords-Goods and Service Receipt cannot be posted, Missing account determination

Title: Customer Language Adaptation Tool Replace Text function is not working - Text Pool is not populating
Content: Symptom-Customer Language Adaptation Tool (LAT) Replace Text function is not working, when using a non-standard language.-Text Pool Details is showing as zero for all fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center-Navigate to Customer Language Adaption view-Open Text Pool Administration -On the General Tab text in the Text Pool shows no values-Cause-The action to replace text entries works only in the context of texts already stored in the LAT or to be collected into LAT, it does not serve to overwrite texts in the standard language delivery. None of the text pools in your system contains any text elements, thus none of the actions that you have done will result in a tangible change-Resolution-Define text pools containing the work centers you wish to adjust in the following parameters-The work centers you wish to adjust-Set source language to English-Select the relevant text type - If the specific text entries you require are only relevant for dedicated UI fields, select only the text type UI Texts. If this is also relevant for other texts like code list, select potential other relevant text types-Should you wish to change specific texts across certain work centers only-On the tab Replace Texts, select the flag Compare to Text Element Source Text-Fill the list in column Compare Text with all the source text expressions (in source language English) where you wish to implement a custom dedicated translation-Execute text action TCO for the text pool. This will collect all relevant texts for the work centers you have chosen – however in this mode it will only STORE text elements in LAT with the source texts that are contained in the list-One the text is complete you may custom translate the expressions in the way that you want to within the text pools in LAT.-Once custom translation is complete, run the action UIL – UI Load Generation once on any text pool – best business practice is to choose the master text pool. This will initialize the translation memory such that at the next opening / loading of the respective UIs, the texts from LAT will be sent into the UI data stream.-In case you cannot decide upfront which texts in English you wish to replace then you can collect ALL texts for the respective work centers and adjust existing translations in a separate step, this you do in the following way:-On the tab Replace Texts, do not select the flag Compare to Text Element Source Text and leave the list empty for now-Execute text action TCO for the text pool. This will collect all relevant texts for the work centers you have maintained-Once text is finished, go to tab Replace Texts in the text pools, maintain in column Compare Texts the texts that you wish to have replaced and maintain in column Replacement Text the new expressions.-Once this is done run action REP – Replace from Register. This will check the contents of the text pool and execute the replacement of the target texts-Once this is complete, run the action UIL – UI Load Generation once on any text pool – best business practice is to choose the master text pool. This will initialize the translation memory such that at the next opening / loading of the respective UIs, the texts from LAT will be sent into the UI data stream.-Keywords-Polish; empty; translation;

Title: Mapping WebDav with Windows
Content: Symptom-This KBA helps you to know how to Map the WebDav in Windows.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Before mapping the driver with WebDAV, we need to enable the WebClient Service that is disabled by default in the windows. In order to do this foillow the below steps:-Go to Start -> Computer Management -Drop down the Services and Applications-Double click Services-Search for Webclient and double click on it-Set Startup Type: Automatic & Click Apply-Now, we need to map the driver:-Go to File explorer -> Right click on This PC-Click on Map Network Drive -Now, insert the webdav path in the folder field & click finish,webdav path you can get it from the Application User and Management work center under respective Integration Communication Arrangement-Check the box for Connect using different credentials -Click on correct certificate in the open prompt and then ok-The Drive is mapped-See Also- 2595252 - How to Upload Customer Invoice Requests to WebDav Folder From a Third-party System Using a Batch Job-Keywords-WebDav, MapNetwork drive, Web Client.

Title: Org Units Appear Out of Order in Org Structure
Content: Symptom-You are checking the organization structure in the system, and see that some org units are not in the expected order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Enter the Org Structures view.-Enter an effective date and click on Ok.-Here you can see some org units do not follow the expected order of the unit ID.-Cause-The order of org units inside an org structure depends on creation and activation, which may cause differences in order in situations where a certain org unit was modified and re-activated. Even then, it is not possible to explicitly control the order of org units in a certain org structure.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-It is possible to order the org units by ID, name and Manager by clicking on the column header once the org structure is loaded.-Keywords-Organization, Org List

Title: How is The Posting Date in a Service Order Created as a Follow-Up From a Service Request Determined?
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how the Posting Date in a Service Order, which was created as a Follow-Up from a Service Request, is determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Desk work center.-Select the Service Request view.-Open Service Request ABC (ABC represents the Service Request ID).-Navigate to the General tab.-In the section Service Request Data you can see that the Reported On Date is XX.XX.XXXX (represents the Reported On Date).-Click on the Follow-Up button and select the Service Order option.-In the newly created Service Order, the Posting Date is YY.YY.YYYY (represents the Posting Date).-You would like to know how the Posting Date is determined.-Cause-When you create a Service Request the Reported On Date is determined from the Creation Date. If the Reported On Date is changed and you create a Service Order as a Follow-Up from the Service Request, the Posting Date in the Service Order will be different than the Report On Date since it is determined from the Creation Date of the Service Request.-Resolution-The Posting Date in a Service Order, which was created as a Follow-Up from a Service Request, is determined from the Creation Date of the Service Request.-See Also-KBA 1523324 - Posting date in journal entry for service provision from CRM document-Keywords-Service Order; Follow Up; Posting Date; Service Request; Reported On;

Title: UI Dump - 500 Internal Server Error during the Service Order/Sales Order creation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-While performing any action from the frontend UI, the user gets a UI dump or a backend exception.-500 Internal Server Error-Error is logged with Tag: {008d96e4}-Application Server Error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Service Order Workcenter-Go to Common Task view-Select New Service Order-Dump Occurs as below,-An error occurred -500 Internal Server Error-Error is logged with Tag: {008d96e4}-Application Server Error-Cause-The issue is due to one of the User Interface (UI) application servers being overloaded. This server experienced high CPU usage, primarily due to a PDI (Partner Development Infrastructure) issue. This abnormality in resource utilization could have caused the UI dump error.-Resolution-A UI dump occurred due to the high response time caused by the ABSL file. The user is advised to run performance checks on ABSL files to avoid such dumps and optimize PDI components. --In order to debug the issue, below are the required traces:-Request users for HttpWatch Trace following the link https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1431064-Take the HAR trace file following the link https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2764266 -After taking the suggested traces forward it to the SPC Integration team.-See Also-2732671 - Backend Dump Occurs During Any Action in the UI due to PDI Involvement -1431064 - How to take a HttpWatch trace in IE and Chrome-Keywords-UI Dump, Internal 500 Server Error, Application Server Error

Title: Attached document to be sent along with the Sales Quote document
Content: Symptom-User is unable to receive an e-mail along with the Sales Quote attachment and the Sales Quote document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-In SAP Business Bydesign:-Go to Sales Quote workcenter-Navigate to Sales Quote ID XXXX and select on view object details-Add an attachment in the Attachments tab -Go to Edit Output Settings and resubmit the document-Only the Sales Quote output document is sent via e-mail to the recipient.--In SAP Cloud for customer:-Go to Sales workcenter-Navigate to Sales quote view-Go to Sales Quote ID XXXX and select on view object details-Add an attachment in the Attachments tab -Go to Edit Output Settings and resubmit the document-Only the Sales Quote output document is sent via e-mail to the recipient.-Cause-User is trying to resubmit an already submitted Sales Quote with an attachment while using the Edit Output Settings, anticipating the attachment to be sent to the recipient together with the Sales Quote document.-Resolution-Re-submitting the document again will result in no additional changes to the original submission, the Sales Quote order has to be submitted. -This is a standard system behaviour. -User can create a new Sales Quote order by including an attachment, and then submit the order. Now, an email containing the sales document and attachment will be sent together to the recipient.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Attachment, Output document, E-mail recipient

Title: Role of Notice Period Field in Termination of Employee
Content: Symptom-What is the role of "Notice period" field in termination of employee ?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work center-Go to Regular Tasks View-Select country and proceed with Hire an employee-Enter personal data , click on next-In employement data field Notice period is there-If you now want to terminate the employee , will this field have any role?-Resolution-This is a generic field for information.In personnel file there is no effect of notice period on termination of employee. It does not depends upon the type of termination.-Keywords-Notice Period, Personal File , Termination , Employee

Title: How to Identify Inactive Changes in Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-An org unit in organizational management is shown with inactive changes. It is not clear which kind or changes are involved, and where they can be seen. - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management-Open Edit Org Structure view-Maintain relevant date -Find an org unit with Inactive Changes--Resolution-Go to Organizational Management-Open Org Structure view-Maintain relevant date -Mark the relevant org unit -Check the Changes tab for changes in the Planning Area without the same changes in Active Area-Keywords-not visible, missing, what, organisational, find, information

Title: The Invoice Status at the Header Level is In Process even though the Sales Order is Completed.
Content: Symptom-In the Sales Orders Header Level, the invoice status has not changed to "Finished" and is still in status "In Process" even though the Sales Order is in Completed status.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work center-Go to Sales Orders View-Search for Sales Order AAA(AAA is the ID of the Sales Order)-Edit the Sales Order-In general tab, you can see the Invoice Status is In process although the Sales Order is completed.-You expect the Invoice status to be Finished since the Sales order is in Completed status.-Cause-The Invoice status at the Header Level is set to In Process when some of the Items in the Sales Order are cancelled with the Reason for Rejection and some of the items are invoiced. Setting the Reason for Rejection will not change the Invoice status to Finished at the header level.- Resolution-This is the current system behavior. -Keywords-Sales Order; Invoice status; Header Level;

Title: Purchase Order is not going for Approval on selecting Send Update
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Purchase Order is not going for approval on send update even though conditions are satisfied.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-> Create a new Purchase Order and select Order-The Purchase Order goes to sent status as conditions for approval did not meet.-Now Select the order which is already sent-Make some changes to price or quantity or account assignment and select send update-Purchase Order is not sent for approval even though conditions in purcahse order approval process are met-Cause-Purchase Order header reapproval is not scoped.-So, initially, since the approval conditions did not meet, purchase order was sent directly.-But later even if the conditions meet , the order will not go for approval again without header reapproval scoped in the system.-Resolution-Please scope Purchase Order Header Re-approval to trigger approval when you make changes in the PO and send update.-You can go to Business Configuration-> under scoping questions for Purchasing-> Purchase orders-> scope this question:-"Do you want to use the header re-approval process for purchase orders?"-Note: If you have purchase order item approval scoped, then header re-approval is will be scoped by default because item approval and header re-approval are connected.-Keywords-purchase order header reapproval, approval

Title: Contract Start Date and Contract End Date Fields are Still Editabld After Relesed
Content: Symptom-You have released a customer contract and notice that the Contract Start Date and Contract End Date in General tab are still editable. While they are read-only on the item level.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Select a contract which is In Preparation status. Open it and you can see the Contact Start Date and Contract End Date are editable.-Click Release button and the contrat is got released.-In the General tab, you find the fields are still editable, and the in items tab, the fields are read-only.-Cause-It is the current behavior that the Contract Start Date and Contract End Date in General are editable after released. You are able to change the contract start and end date, and this change will be copied into the items.-Resolution-This is the current designed behavior.-Keywords-customer contract; contract start date; contract end date; editable.

Title: 500 Internal Server Error during Scanned Invoice Upload via Collaboration tool
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload scanned invoice via collaboration tool , however you get the 500 Internal Server error. The issue is only happening with few users.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the collaboration tool-Login to the respective tenant where you want to upload the supplier invoice-Select the common observation folder where the PDF files are stored to upload the invoice-The upload fails and the error log shows 500 internal server error-Cause-Sometimes, when multiple users use the same observation folder to upload the scanned invoice file via collaboration tool, this type of error can occur.-Resolution-You can create a new observation folder and add the PDF file in that folder and then upload it.-See Also-3260857 - Supplier Invoice Scanning Files Move to Upload Error Folder When You Upload Through SAP Collaboration Window Tool-3049396 - Collaboration Window does not work on Microsoft Server-Keywords-collaboration tool, 500 internal server error, observation folder

Title: Error: "Access to XMLHttpRequest"..." Has Been Blocked by CORS Policy"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to access the endpoint from an integration or your Fiori/UI5 app using an OData Model, while your app is running on a localhost. An error similar to the following one occurs:-"Access to XMLHttpRequest at ‘ABC’ from origin ‘XYZ’ has been blocked by CORS policy" (where ABC represents the Odata URL being accessed, and XYZ represents the access point of the Odata URL)-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently the OData framework does not support CORS.-See Also-See alternative options as mentioned in the blog: CORS and Fiori/UI5 – Everything you need to know-Keywords-localhost, query, get, http

Title: How to Extend or Enhance Data Source (HCMPAB08) Internal Employee Details
Content: Symptom-How to Extend or Enhance Data Source (HCMPAB08) "Internal Employee Details"-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work center-Personal Data tab of any employee-Enter the Adaptation mode.-Add an extension field of type Amount, Quantity or Decimal.-Select the field and click the Further Usage link.-choose the Data sources and Reports tab.-Cause-Currently it is not supported to extend or enhance Internal Employee Details Data source.-Resolution-You can find a list of the data sources which are enabled for extension fields here.-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2bca667a722d10148d35c044e770c405.html?version=2002-See Also-List of the data sources which are enabled for extension fields https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2bca667a722d10148d35c044e770c405.html?version=2002-Keywords-Extension fields, Internal Employee Details, Enhance

Title: Third Party Supplier Return
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find the third party inbound delivery document in the New return to supplier screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Common Tasks view and Select the option New Return to Supplier.-In the new Return to Supplier screen you enter the supplier delivery ID and choose the search option. -You do not see any delivery document displayed. -Cause-The third party order return process flow should be triggered from customer return document as the Third party business flow results in the items being delivered to the customer site via the  third party sales order.-When receiving the returned goods in inbound logistics, the warehouse manager triggers a follow-up activity and the system posts the returned goods to your own stock or to your externally-owned stock accordingly.-While in externally-owned stock, the owner of the goods is still the customer although, physically, they are stored on your premises. -The returned goods stored in your externally-owned stock are to be sent back to your supplier.-The decision to create a credit memo or organize a replacement delivery is taken in customer return processing by the sales representative independently of the logistics process.-Resolution-In the Inbound Logistics work center, the warehouse operator should create a customer return notification by selecting the New Customer Return Notification common task. In the customer return notification, the following information is set:-A reference to the related outbound delivery of delivery type Third-Party.-In the Line Items tab, the Follow-Up Activity field is set to Return to Supplier meaning that the goods are to be sent back to the third-party supplier. Therefore, the goods are posted to externally-owned stock and the customer remains the owner of the goods.-See Also-Detailed help document explaining the Third-Party Order Processing — Customer Return is available in the link here.-Keywords-TPOP return, TPOP supplier return error, TPOP inbound delivery not found, not able to search third party supplier delivery document, Third party delivery error, third party supplier return error

Title: Unable to Edit Value Help (F4) Specific fields in Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-The user is attempting to rearrange the column field in the Value Help, for example, in the Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign--Reproducing the Issue-Go to the question mark on the upper right of ByD.-Go to key user settings and start adaption mode-Open Sales Order WorkCenter and View Sales Orders-Search for Sales Order XXXXX-Click on edit-Go to Items Tab-Search for a position with item type "Product - consignment issue"-In tab Serial Number use the value help-Try editing the table which appears.-Rearrange the column fields, save the changes, and publish. Refresh and view the Value Help again; the changes are not applied.-Resolution-The Changes made in the Value Help table (i.e., F4) will not be captured as "changes" in Adaptation Mode. It is a limitation.-Note: This is applicable for all the Value Help Table.-See Also-Value Help, F4, Adaptation Mode, Sales Order

Title: "Work Agreement Exists for Employee" Error When Modifying Termination Date via Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You are trying to use the migration tool to modify the termination date of an already terminated employee. In the simulation step, the migration tool raises the following error:-"Work agreement exists for employee XYZ in period ABC - DEF" (where XYZ represents the employee ID, and ABC and DEF represent the hire and termination dates respectively). -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Enter the Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Employee Data - XYZ (where XYZ represents the country code).-Click on Migrate Personal Data Using the Migration Tool.-Select the template and click on Execute Migration.-Click on Step-by-step.-Proceed until step 3 - Simulation.-After the simulation is executed, the error is raised.-Cause-Currently it is not possible to use the Migration Tool to modify the termination date of an employee. This happens because the migration of personal data only supports the "Add new records" mode, which tries to create a new entry in the personal data table, instead of changing the existing one. This causes the error as the work agreement for the dates in the migration template already exist.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-See Also-1925049 - Error Message: Work Agreement for Employee Exists In Entered Period-Keywords-Workbench, HR, Import, Termination

Title: VAT Return error 1102 Valor del campo Periodo incorrecto
Content: Symptom-VAT Return XXX is Partially Approved with the following error:-Error Code: 1102-Message description: Valor del campo Periodo incorrecto-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management Wc > VAT Returns view-Search for the Tax Return ID: XXX-You notice the Approval Status is Partially Approved-Open the Tax Return-Click View All-Click Tax Return tab-You will see that for the below documents, the error is shown:-Error Code: 1102-Message description: Valor del campo Periodo incorrecto-Cause-The error is happening as the period is not determined due to the missing Tax due date for some line items.-The tax due date is not present for these line items as these line items are deferred tax items which makes sense. Deferred line items are not allowed for outgoing invoices.-Resolution-How to check if the Tax Payment Deferred is selected for the line item-Go to the General Ledger Wc > Source Documents view-Search for the document YYY and open it-Go to tab Items > Taxes subtab-Under Tax Details section, check if the "Tax Payment Deferred" is marked-Expected system behavior. Deferred line items are not allowed for outgoing invoices.-Keywords-VAT, return, tax, ByD, 1102, Valor del campo Periodo incorrecto

Title: Supplier Invoice Goes to Incorrect Approvers
Content: Symptom-You have created supplier invoice and system determines incorrect approver when you send it for approval. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to Approvals tab-You can see incorrect approvers determined by the system-Cause-In the supplier invoice approval process, you have defined the condition like Supplier Not equal to ABC. Here ABC refers to the Supplier Formatted Name and not Supplier ID. Hence system determines the relevant approvers. - Resolution-In order for system to determine correct approvers, you have to enter the Supplier ID in the condition section instead of Supplier Formatted Name ABC. Then system determines the right approver. In case if you have defined the Supplier ID incorrectly, then you should change the Supplier ID and Name properly, so that incorrect approvers will not be determined.-Keywords-Incorrect approvers determined in supplier invoice;

Title: Language of Product Description in the Output Document of the Sales Document is Not the Expected One
Content: Symptom-You created a Sales Document such as a Sales Order. When changing the Language of the Form Template the Product Description is not the expected one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In our example you are creating a Sales Document such as a Sales Order with an Account that has the Language setting German in the Account Master Data with a Product that has a Product Description maintained in English and German language.-You log on to the system in English. -Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Click on the New button and select the Sales Orders option. -Enter Account ABC (ABC represents the Account ID of an Account that has the Language setting German).-Enter Product XYZ (XYZ represents the Product ID of a Product that has the Product Description maintained in English and German language).-You can see that the Product Description determined in the Sales Order for the Item is in language German. -Click on the You can Also button and select the Edit Output Settings option.-Change the Language of the Form Template to English and click Apply. -When you click on the Preview you can see that in the Form Template the Product Description is displayed in German. -You expect the Product Description to be displayed in English.-Cause-When a Sales Order is created with a Product the language Product Description is determined depending on the language maintained in the Account Master Data and if the description is maintained in the Product Master Data.-In our example if you log on to the system in English create a Sales Order in your system for an Account that has the Language set as German and the Product has the Product Description maintained in German in the Product Master Data, the system will Determine the German Description in the Sales Order in the User Interface (UI).-And when you e.g. click on Preview the German Description will also be pulled in the Form Template since the German variant of the Form Template is determined due to the language setting in the Account Master Data.-If you then click on You can Also -> Edit Output Settings and change the Language to English, the system will still use the German Description since the Description saved in the Sales Order is still the German one with the Language Code DE  and this is what is passed in the XML for the Form Template.-The system does not store any other available Product Description and Language Code in the Sales Order that is available Product Master Data but only the Description and Language Code that was determined when the document was saved.-And hence when changing the language via the Output Settings no redetermination of a different language for the Product Description is done.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-See Also- KBA 2667402 - Product Description Translation in Sales Order-Keywords-Sales Order; Sales Quote; Invoice; Service Order; Service Quote; Contract; Product Description; Language

Title: "Error While Checking Workspace/FT conflicts for project" While Merging Change Project
Content: Symptom-While merging change project you received below errors:-Error while checking workspace/FT conflicts for project -Value in setting G/L Account Assignment must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts -Value in setting Costs: General Expenses must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by -Account Type and Posting -Value in General Ledger setting: Other assets must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts by -Account Type and Posting-Value in setting General Ledger: Other liabilities must also be entered in setting Permitted G/L Accounts -by Account Type and Posting --Environment-SAP Business ByDesign -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Highlight the Change Project-Select Open Activity List-Go to the Go-Live tab-Select Merge Changes and Start Merge-The merge fails and you will see the mentioned errors-Cause-The GL accounts have been maintained in the main solution profile and are missing in the change project which causes inconsistencies during the merge.-Resolution-In order to solve the errors that occur during the merge process these GL accounts need to be maintained in the change project in the same way as they are in the main solution profile.-See Also-2918894 - Error when Merging Change Project: "Value XXX in setting Assignment of GL-Accounts must also be entered in setting General Ledger Accounts"-Keywords-Merge failed, G/L Account, workspace/FT conflicts for project

Title: Business user does not exist; Check Tracing Options
Content: Symptom-You have enabled debugging for a specific user on SAP Cloud Applications Studio but the below error comes up:-Business user _THIS_USER does not exist; Check Tracing Options (where _THIS_USER is the user ID)-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-On the Studio, choose Administration > Options and Settings.-On the navigation pane of the Options dialog box, click on SAP.-Then click on the Debugging and Tracing tab.-Input the user ID on "Debugging and tracing: Enable for business user" and check in the box.-Cause-Either the user ID provided is wrong or the user provided is a technical user.-Resolution-Technical users are different than business users and they can only be debugged with after raising an incident to SAP in order for the technical user be temporarily changed to a dialog user.-See Also-SAP Cloud Applications Studio help portal:-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_CLOUD_APPLICATIONS_STUDIO/cbcebe3cfb1647a8b0322c18dbb0b481/72eb311b73e21014a15f99c70eec4f5e.html?locale=en-US-Keywords-PDI, SDK, debug, business, user, technical, does, not, exist, Check, Tracing, Options

Title: Error: ' Operation not possible; sales org. referenced by material ' during Master Data Replication for Employees
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The following error occurs during Master Data Replication for Employees:-Error occurred during work agreement data update-Save failed-Operation not possible; sales org. referenced by material XYZ (where XYZ represents a material ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Master Data Replication-Select Employees view-Select line of the affected employee-Click Edit-Click Replicate-Errors occur-Cause-Such an error might occur in a scenario similar to the following:-A sales unit ABC is delimited respectively deleted in the meantime.-Sales unit ABC was a child of org unit DEF.-Material XYZ  has a reference to sales  unit ABC.-The employee replication request relates to org unit DEF-In the  employee replication request,  a new job ID is assigned. This will de-limit the existing position of the employee. It will  also  create a new position in an org unit.-The change will activate the org unit DEF and org units under it. Therefore, a veto check is triggered which checks if any sales org unit is referenced at any place or not.-As  sales org  ABC is referenced in the material XYZ, it will not allow the org unit activation, hence employee replication fails.-(Note: ABC represents a sales unit, DEF represents another org unit, XYZ represents a material ID)- Resolution-Undo the deletion changes to the org unit and bring back to the earlier state. This should solve this issue.-See Also-  1681186 - Error Message "Operation not Possible; Sales Org. Referenced by Service Product" (or Material) -Keywords-very specific scenario, hence keeping internal for the time being

Title: System is Removing UOM Value When Updating Kit Item List Through Web Service or Vice Versa
Content: Symptom-You are using web service (Maintain kit item list) and whenever you send a Kit material update to the system, the base UoM is changed from EA to blank or blank to EA regardless if anything else was changed or not. Hence, when you create Sales Orders with Sales Kit where the Material is used, you are faced with situation where the Customer Demand is not created against the Sales Order and this remains in Process Communication Error.-Environment-Product version: SAP Business ByDesign 2305-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the relevant Sales Order.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-You can see the Customer Demand is missing and the Sales Order is showing the following Process Communication Error:-- Sales Order 123 (123 represents the Sales Order ID) cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting).-- Sales Order 123 cannot create a Customer Demand.--Cause-We have analysed the issue and found that if the tag OutputMaterialQuantityTypeCode is not maintained in the payload, it goes as Empty. When this is empty the existing design is such that it aligns the OutputMaterialQuantity unitCode accordingly thereby making it blank.-Resolution-The solution to this would be to add the tag <OutputMaterialQuantityTypeCode>.-For example:-  <OutputMaterialQuantity unitCode="EA">1.0</OutputMaterialQuantity>-  <OutputMaterialQuantityTypeCode>EA</OutputMaterialQuantityTypeCode>-Then the UoM (Unit code) preceding it is not cleared anymore.-See Also-KBA 3308671 - Process Communication Error from SalesOrderProcessingFulfillmentIn to CustomerRequirementProcessing: Unit of measure deviates between schedule lines-KBA 3281134 - Customer Demand is Not Created From Sales Order Due to Error: "Unit of measure deviates between schedule lines"
