Title: Purchase Order Approval Task Being Sent To Wrong Employee Approver
Content: Symptom-Purchase Order is created and sent to approval; however, the task is assigned to the wrong approver. -"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Task Management view. -You can see the task "Approve Purchase Order ABC" (ABC is the Purchase Order's ID). -Select the task. -Now you check the "Person Responsible: John Smith" (John Smith is the user assigned to approve this task). -You expected that the Person Responsible would be actually "Anne Taylor" (Anne Taylor is another user). -John and Anne are fictional names to illustrate the scenario. -Cause-The employee maintained in the approval condition is incomplete. For example, in this scenario, the full name of the employee is "Anne Davis Taylor". -The steps to check the approval condition are:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Approval Processes view. -Show: Active and scheduled processes.-Select the approval process regarding Purchase Orders. -Click in View button.-Select the step that should assign the task to "Anne Taylor". -For this step, you can check that there is a condition: "Created By: Anne Taylor". -The steps to identify the full user's name maintained in the system are listed below:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Business Users view.-Search for Anne. -Click in the link in column "Name": Taylor, Anne.-It opens the Employee Overview. -Then in the Header you can see: "Anne Davis Taylor". -In this example the employee's name maintained in the system is "Anne Davis Taylor". Hence the system does not identify that "Anne Taylor" and "Anne Davis Taylor" is the same employee / user. -Resolution-In the Approval's condition it should be maintained the full employee's name. In this example, the condition should be "Created By: Anne Davis Taylor" instead of "Created By: Anne Taylor". -See Also-KBA: 2705866 - Purchase Order Approval Process Not Working When the Condition is Created By-KBA: 2928419 - Approval conditions not working-Keywords-Purchase Order; Approval; Created By; Business Task Management; Person Responsible

Title: Notes in Appointments and Follow-Up Opportunity have a different input format
Content: Symptom-When user attempts to input text in the Appointment's Notes field, the content does not display with an additional line break (empty line space) however when a follow-up Opportunity is created, an additional empty line break is displayed after each line.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Activities Work center-Go to Appointments view-Select the ID XXXX (Here XXXX refers to an appointment ID)-Click on Follow-Up and Select Opportunity from the dropdown-Enter all the required details and save the Opportunity--In appointment ID XXXX, the input text in the Notes field is displayed without an empty line (no spacing). If user creates a follow up Opportunity, there is now an empty line in the Notes field. -Cause-This could be due to the formatting issue.-The Notes field in the Appointment is using formatted text. It can be verified by seeing all the formatting buttons at the top of the Notes input field in Appointment. The Note field in the Opportunity does not support formatted text. Therefore, only the converted text is visible in the opportunity.-The original text in the Appointment is formatted in such a way that every single line is a separate paragraph. During the conversion into plain text, paragraphs are separated by two-line breaks. Consequently, each line is separated by an empty space.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. -Keywords-Notes, Appointment, Opportunity, Line break, Empty Line Space, Follow-Up

Title: Inbound Delivery Not Visible In Third-Party Customer Return Item Selection Of Supplier Return View
Content: Symptom-You are not able to view the Inbound Customer Return Delivery document created against the Third-Party Outbound Delivery in New Return To Supplier Screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Return to Supplier. -In the Select Inbound Delivery Items section choose the value Third-Party Customer Return Items by Selection from the drop down. -Enter your Inbound Customer Return Delivery Id in the Search bar and choose the search icon. -You can see the system does not return any results. -Cause-When business user created the third-party customer return notification in the system (s)he chose the Follow-Up Activity as Post to Own Stock. -If you expect the goods to be returned to the Supplier, the Follow-Up Activity should be selected as Return to Supplier. -The system will identify the customer return document as the one that need to returned to supplier based on the Follow-Up Activity selected. -Resolution-The goods will be posted to your warehouse as your own stock and now you can-Cancel the entire process flow and create a new customer return document with the correct follow up activity. -Repair the goods in your stock and deliver it back to your customer. -Arrange alternate delivery of product from the supplier. -You will have to discuss your options with the your business and decide on the option you need to move forward with. -See Also-SAP Help Document : Third-Party Order Processing — Customer Return-Knowledge Base Article : 2568673 - Customer cannot Create Return to Supplier from Third Party Customer Return-Keywords-TPOP error, TPOP customer return error, Third Party Customer Return error, Third Party Supplier Return Error, Third party Supplier Return Not Found

Title: 'Tax number missing for business partner XYZ' error in SII VAT Return Run
Content: Symptom-You complete a SII VAT Return Run and you see the warning message 'Tax number missing for business partner XYZ' displayed in the results tab. (XYZ represents the Partner ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periods Tasks view.-Select the subview VAT Return Runs.-Search and find the relevant VAT Return Run ID.-Open the Application Log.-Go to the Results tab.-Here you will see the warning message 'Tax number missing for business partner XYZ'.-Cause-The reason this error is appearing is because you have either not maintained any Tax number, or the incorrect Tax number type against the business partner.-Resolution-To resolve this issue you need to check the Supplier Tax details that are maintained.-Go to the Payables work center.-Select the view Suppliers.-Search for the Supplier Account XYZ.-Select View all.-Go to the Financials tab.-Go to the Tax Data subtab.-Here you can see what has been maintained as the Tax information.-NOTE: For Spanish(ES) Suppliers/Customers only the Tax Number Type: "NIF", "CIF", "VAT" or "NIE" are accepted.-If you have any other Tax Number Type maintained other than the ones mentioned above will not be accepted.-See Also-2665291 - SII Tax Return is Rejected, Partially Approved or Approved With the Wrong Amount by the Tax Authority-Keywords-SII, Tax Management, Suminitro Immediato de Información, Tax Return Run,

Title: Incomplete Goods and Service Receipt due to error: Start date must be before end date; enter new date
Content: Symptom-Goods and service receipt are showing incomplete , Error "Start date must be before end date; enter new date"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipt Work Center-Go to Receipts and Returns View and choose Show by Documents-Search for desired Goods and Service Receipt number-We could see the error "Start date must be before end date; enter new date"-Cause-While creating the Goods and Service Receipt, the customer has entered a posting date, the system saves this as the default posting date. The system will consider this as the posting date , even after changing the posting date. -Due to this, the system will consider the initially set posting date and will not allow the system to enter any delivery date after the initially set posting date. -If there are multiple line items in the goods and service receipt, the system will check for the delivery dates of all the line items. Even if a single line item's delivery date is after the initially set posting date, the system will throw the mentioned error. -Resolution-Header level delivery date should be set toa date which is before the initially set posting date of the Goods and Service Receipt.-Item level delivery date should also be checked and make sure to set it to any date which is previous/before the initially set posting date of the Goods and Service Receipt.-Keywords-Incomplete GSR-Goods and Service Receipt error-Start date must be before end date; enter new date

Title: System freezes while adding help links to Company-Specific Content
Content: Symptom-When attempting to configure help links in Company-Specific Content, the system freezes for a longer period of time and displays the error "Enter a valid url".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Business ByDesign tenant-Navigate to Help Center-Under Company-Specific Help, select:-Add Company-Specific Content - To add company-specific content to a particular screen.-Add Company-Specific Content for all Screens - To add company-specific content to all screens.-To add a new link, Choose New and then select Link.-Enter URL, Name, Duration, Description.-Select OK.-The system freezes and displays error message "Enter a valid url"-Cause-Issue is due to the special character ":" (like as :b) present in the URL link,  which is against the standard http URL validation.  -For example:-abcdefg/:b:/r/sites/ByD-/hijklmn/opqrs.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=IJFHk4 --The SharePoint link above contains the unsupported special character ":b"-Note: The above-mentioned URL is not specific to any customer. It is provided only as a reference to analyze how special characters could be displayed in a copied URL link.-Resolution-According to standard SharePoint behavior, the direct file contains special characters like :b, :x, :w, and :f, that are used to identify the file type. In order to add the help links in Company-Specific content use the file path by following the below steps.-Login to SAP Business ByDesign Tenant-Navigate to Help Center-Under Company-Specific Help select Add Company-Specific Help or Add Company-Specific Help: All Screens-Choose New and Select File-Choose Browse and select the File path-Enter Name, Duration, Description -Choose Ok-The Link is added successfully.-See Also-SAP Note KBA 1843098- How to add Company Specific Help Document in the Help Center in SAP Business ByDesign (ByD)-SAP Note KBA 3293632 - Not Able to Add Company-Specific Help in format "mailto"-Keywords-Company-Specific Content, Help Center, Help Links, Enter a valid URL, Invalid URL, Special Characters, SharePoint Link, File, Link, System Freeze

Title: Phone Number and Mobile Number of Buyer Responsible is not Visible in the Purchase Order Forms
Content: Symptom-You have created and ordered the purchase order. However when you do the preview, system does not show the phone number and mobile number of buyer responsible in the Purchase Order form. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order -Select Edit button and navigate to Output History tab-Click on the pdf form-Phone number and mobile numbers are not visible in the form-Cause-From the output XML, the tags for telephone number and mobile number are coming from <EmployeeResponsibleParty>. -<EmployeeResponsibleParty>      -<BuyerID></BuyerID>-<Description></Description>-<FormattedConventionalPhoneNumberDescription></FormattedConventionalPhoneNumberDescription>-<FormattedMobilePhoneNumberDescription></FormattedMobilePhoneNumberDescription> -You have not maintained the telephone number and mobile number for the buyer responsible and hence the numbers are missing in the form. -Resolution-You can update the telephone number and mobile number for buyer responsible in Employee master data. To do so; -Go to the Personnel Administration work center -Go to the Employees view-Select the relevant Employee-Select Edit and navigate to Employment tab-Select Workplace Contact Data sub tab-Under Communication Data, you can maintain the Phone and Mobile Phone numbers-Select Save and Close-Note: -In case if the numbers are already maintained but still the telephone number and mobile number for buyer responsible is not visible, you can do some dummy changes to the PO and click on Send Update button. You can remove and re-enter the Buyer Responsible details and select Send Update. This will save the updated details of buyer responsible. When you do the Preview, system will show the telephone number and mobile number in the purchase order form.

Title: Error in Production Proposal Run
Content: Symptom-You will encounter an error message during Execution of Release Production Proposal Run ABC(where ABC is the Run ID)-Error for order XYZ(where XYZ is the production order ID)-Cannot request production; output quantity outside SOS validity-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Control workcenter and Release Production Proposal Runs view.-2. Find Run ID ABC and select its Application Log.-3. Go to the Results tab and you will see the errors.-Cause-We have analyzed this issue and found this as a bug.-Resolution-This is critical code fix and hence requires extensive testing.-We have made note of this issue in our internal tool to give the code fix and we will deliver this in future release and we cannot commit any timelines for the same.-There is workaround for the reported issue i.e.if the same Run is executed again (without changing anything) the error vanishes and Production Proposal will be released as expected. -Keywords-Release Production Proposal Runs, production, output quantity, sos validity, supply control, error

Title: Error: 'Field contains an invalid integer value for OrgUnit' During Replication to Concur
Content: Symptom-When trying to replicate to Concur in Master Data Replication work center, an outbound run for employees fails with an error message:-Example:  'Field contains an invalid integer value for OrgUnit1'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication-Go to Replication to Concur > Employee Outbound Runs-Check Application Log ID  for related Execution ID -Check Results > Expand-Find Employee not being replicated; Find for example message: 'Field contains an invalid integer value for OrgUnit1' (as example)-Cause-Concur is set up in a way that it is accepting only integer values, but SAP Business ByDesign is passing a string value. Hence an error is thrown for the same.-Note:-Integer values include whole numbers.-In string values, beside numbers, all types of characters are allowed, including e.g. text.-Resolution-Change the configuration on Concur side to also accept string values for field OrgUnit1 (respectively for the Org Unit ID that is relevant in your case).-See Also-Find further details in the following help documents:-Replicated Cost Object Information-Field and Value Mapping-Keywords-runs, not possible, unable, org unit, orgunit

Title: Error in Goods Receipt screen: "Tax region for country United States in item 1 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab."
Content: Symptom-Goods receipt created from time entry is in "in preparation" status and on selecting check, you get the following error:-"Tax region for country United States in item 1 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Services Receipts work center-Select view Receipts and Returns-Under Show by Documents-> select the goods receipt which is in preparation status-Select Check-Error: Tax region for country United States in item 1 is missing. You have to set the tax jurisdiction code manually on the Taxes tab.-Delete and post buttons are also disabled in the goods receipt-Cause-The delivery address does not match in Goods receipt and purchase order and the Tax Jurisdiction Code is missing in the goods receipt under Delivery address details.-Resolution-Please cancel the time entry which created the goods receipt and create a new time entry with correct details.-Keywords-"Tax region for country United States in item 1 is missing", tax jurisdiction code, goods receipt, time recording, purchase order

Title: How to Create Access Restriction for a Particular Field in Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want to set an access restriction on a particular field in a sales order for a Business User(s).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Navigate to the Sales Orders View.-Select Show: All Orders.-Search for and open the relevant sales order.-Go to the Items tab.-Observe that the List Price field is visible for each line item.-Attempt to restrict visibility of only the List Price field for a Business User(s).-Cause-The access restrictions cannot be set at individual field within a sales order for Business Users.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Sales order, Access Restriction, Field, Business User

Title: Extension Field not Updated in Migration Template of Logistics Area
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in the UI for Logistics Area but the same is not visible in the Migration Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Supply Chain Design Master work center-2. Select Locations view-3. Select Location XYZ(where XYZ is the Location ID) and Edit Layout-3. Select Logistics Area ABC(where ABC is the Logistica Area ID) and create Extension field PQR(where PQR is te extension field)-Then download Locations and Logistics Area Migration Template-1. Go to Business Configuration work center-2. Select Overview view-3. Search for Prepare for Data Migration-4. Select Download migration templates-5. Download  Locations and Logistics Area Migration Template-The extension filed is not avaiable in Locations and Logistics Area migration template.-Cause-Currently we are not supporting extension fields in migration template of Locations and Logistics Area due to technical constraints.-Resolution-This functionality is a new requirement and will be available in one of the future releases.-Keywords-Extension fields, Migration Template, Locations and Logistics Area, Technical, future,

Title: Bueyer GSTIN is nill in the JSON file for e-invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a Customer Invoice which is relevant for E-invoicing and you expect the Buyer GSTIN to be available in the corresponding Json file, but when checking the Json file, you noticed that the value for the GSTIN is nill-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The GSTIN is not maintained in the Account Master Data-Resolution-Maintain the GSTIN number under the Account Master data-Go to Account Management Work Center > Accounts view-Search for the Account AAA (AAA is the Account used in the Customer Invoice XXX)-Click on Edit > Financial Data-Go to Tax Data tab-Under Tax Number add a new row and maintain the GSTIN number -Save-See Also-KBA 3257397 - The Buyer GSTIN is missing in the Json file for E-invoice India-Keywords-BuyerDtls; Buyer GSTIN; E-invoice; JSON

Title: Fast Search Index in Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have observed an incorrect behavior within the User Interface of a Business ByDesign or a Cloud for Customer system which occurred due to the secondary persistency. -Incorrect behavior could include the following: -Records are not being retrieved from the database for a User Interface component. (they are missing on the UI)-A column within a table is not showing content or showing outdated content-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-You have performed either of the following:-You have created a Business Object instance, be it for a custom or standard BO. This newly created instance is not being retrieved within the UI component while executing a Basic or Advanced Search.-You are trying to retrieve instances for a specific Business Object, be it for a custom or standard BO. These instances are not being retrieved within the UI component while executing a Basic or Advanced Search.-NOTE: Those are documented scenarios where the issue is due to the secondary persistence. There could be multiple other symptoms connected to this cause which are yet to be observed and analyzed. Examples include incorrect modeling of the query which gets executed during the Basic or Advanced Search.-Cause-This issue happens when the secondary persistency, the Fast Search Index View (FSI View) is inactive or the FSI table is not in synch with the primary persistency, which is the data base.-The FSI View is used to execute search queries to the HANA database. In case of the FSI View being inactive or the load status of the Business Objects nodes within the FSI View being incorrect, it will lead to incorrect search queries to the HANA database. This is then reflected in the incorrect search results in the User Interface components.-FSI stands for Secondary Persistency of a BO, which in simple terms could be viewed as an additional table which represents BO and its content in SAP backend system. Vast majority of BOs within C4C system have been gradually moved to Single Persistency, with a small exception still remaining (like the Business Partner BO). All custom BO also have been moved from Secondary to Single persistency.-All BO in ByD still have Secondary Persistency. As of now (April 2019) there is no clear indication given as to when ByD BOs will be moved to Single Persistency. -In case of Custom BO, FSI View could become inactive after any Life Cycle Management activity done to the solution on top of which BO is build. Potentially after each deployment of a solution FSI view could become inconsistent. Below proposed resolution needs to be performed each time FSI View goes Inactive/ Inconsistent after solution deployment/patch creation etc.-In case of Standard BO, FSI View could become inactive after tenant upgrade.-NOTE: FSI issues to custom BOs, where reload needs to be performed are to be send to PDI team. FSI issues to standard BOs, where reload needs to be performed are to be send to responsible application team.-In a situation where affected standard BO has a substantial amount of instances, and its reload could take significant amount of time, customer needs to provide a downtime. This could be done either during a nighttime, or a weekend when traffic within the customers system is considerably reduced by our Hosting/operations team.-Resolution-In order to confirm whether FSI View is definitely underlying cause of mentioned incorrect UI behavior you need to compare content of respective BO in the Backend with results visible in the UI. To confirm existing content of specific BO, please follow the below steps:-Navigate to transaction SESFTS and search for the name of specific BO, for which you suspect inactive/ inconsistent FSI View.-Execute the query on the root node to get the view of how many instances exist in the system.-You should observe discrepancy between amount of records listed in SESFTS and the amount of records visible in the UI.- To resolve the inconsistency, a reload of FSI View of the affected BO Nodes have to be performed in the backend.--PLEASE NOTE THAT THE FOLLOWING STEPS HAVE TO BE PERFORMED WITH CAUTION, AS IT CAN CAUSE A PERFORMANCE ISSUE WHEN THE AMOUNT OF RECORDS ARE HIGH.-Go to MDRS transaction and search for the technical name name of possibly affected BO-Copy the BO ID as shown in the below screenshot. -Now navigate to transaction GFSSTM. -Paste the BO ID you got in step 3 as Business Object and click on Execute.--You are presented with an entry for FSI view of a BO which you entered in previous step. There could be a situation whereby you try to expand listed node and you immidietly receive a dump. This indicates that FSI View is not active at all, and needs to be activated first. Please follow below listed steps to activate FSI View. -  Right-Click on the FSI View name and select View Builder.-  Click on activate Icon as shown below to activate the FSI View.-   Go back to transaction GFFSTM-Select the affected BO node and click on Persistence button, you can do this for one node at time.-Alternatively, you can click on Load Status tab and right click on the BO to select Load All Nodes, or you can select the required individual nodes and click on Persistence button.-After performing successful Load BO should have a green icon which means it is consistent now.-Keywords-FSI, PDI, SDK, OVS, BCO, C4C, BYD, data, missing, records, UI

Title: Combination Of Values Not Permitted
Content: Symptom-Combination of Values Not Permitted error while confirming logistics task. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics work center. -Navigate to Task Control view. -Search, select the relevant task and choose the Confirm button. -Enter values in the field Actual Quantity, note that this value is same as the Planned Quantity. -Select the value in field Deviation Reason. -Choose the Save button. -System displays the reported error message; Combination of Values Not Permitted. -Cause-You cannot report deviation in a logistics task when Open Quantity is Zero. -You report deviation for quantities that are Open and if Open Quantity is Zero there is no reason for the warehouse operator to report deviation. - Resolution-You have two options -Remove value from field Deviation Reason and save the task. -Report the deviation quantity correctly.-Keywords-pick task error, not able to confirm logistics task, not able to confirm pick task, logistics task issues, pick task not save, not able to save pick task, not able to save logistics task

Title: Assign Transport Request Error: Transport Request XXX is not in task list YYY
Content: Symptom-You try to assign a TR to a Change Document/Work Item fulfilling the prerequisites of KBA 2361067-You receive error Action Assign Transport Request in system WWW contains errors. Read the application log. (being WWW SID, system type and client) in the header of the CRM document.-You find error message Transport Request XXX is not in task list YYY (being XXX TR Number and YYY Task List number) in the application log (/TMWFLOW/TRANSPORT_N 642.)-Additionally, you notice Task List task "Assign Transport Request" is missing in YYY Task List.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Open a Change Document or WI.-Go to "Transport Management" Assignment Block.-Click on "More" -> "Assign Transport Request"-The assignment of selected TR is not possible and you can find error message Transport Request XXX is not in task list YYY in the application log.-Cause-Task List was not created correctly.-Resolution-Perform "Redefine Landscape" action for involved Change Cycle (just follow the guided procedure,) then missing action Assign Transport Request should appear in the Task List and TR assignment should be possible.-See Also-KBA 2361067 - How to assign Transport Requests created outside CHARM-Keywords-Task List, TR, assign, assignment, task, missing, not in task list, transport, app log, /TMWFLOW/TRANSPORT_N642, /TMWFLOW/TRANSPORT_N 642,

Title: Contents Missing in Migration Template After Uploading
Content: Symptom-After uploading the migration template, you find some characters maintained in the field "Material Description" of the migration template are missing. For example, you have filled value "TEST123" in Material Description field of the migration template, but you find the value converted to "TES" after uploading.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Overview view.-Search for Migration of Materials and select Migrate materials using the migration tool.-Download Migration Template and fill the migration template.-Select Upload.-Then you find some characters maintained in the field "Material Description" of the migration template are missing.-Cause-The cause of the issue might be that you paste other format information into the migration template.-Resolution-To resolve the issue, please download a new migration template and fill the values again. Please fill the template following below steps:-Just enter the original legacy values into the template. And then while uploading the file, you can easily convert the source values to valid values.-Paste values only. To copy and paste any data into the template, choose Edit  Paste Special. Select Paste Values to paste data without changing format information embedded in the template.-Only paste data into one column. Otherwise you might paste data into hidden fields accidentally.-Do not change the template structure. Do not add, delete or move columns.-Keywords-Migration template; Upload; Missing contents; Format

Title: Different Address visible in Customer Invoice Which was not Maintained in Invoice Request
Content: Symptom-You have maintained an address in Invoice Request, but in the Customer Invoice you can see a different address.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer invoicing work center.-View: invoice requests.-Show: All Requests.-Search and edit manual invoice request.-Navigate to involved parties tab.-The address visible in Customer invoice is different from the address you have maintained in Bill-To party-Cause-In the Customer Invoice the address visible is payee main address and not the bill-to address of invoice request. This is because system will allow only one address as a Payee main address. If you want to make main/permanent address then you have to select the option Yes (Standard) from the dropdown list in account master data. -The address which is visible in Customer Invoice is Payee main address which has been maintained in account master data.-Resolution-This is expected system standard behavior.-Keywords-Address, Customer Invoice, Yes(Standard), Payee main address, Invoice Request

Title: Error Message: "Cannot Create Duplicate Entries in Collaboration View" while Updating Collaboration Tab of Accounts
Content: Symptom- When you are updating Collaboration tab of Accounts using Migration tool, it throws an error message-Cannot create duplicate entries in Collaboration view.-Or you are trying to use the Mass Data Maintenance, where after executing the Data Import there is no error message, however the data is not updated in the Account Management work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration and select the Overview view.-Search and open the activity Migration of Customer.-Click link to Migrate Customers using the Migration Tool.-Upload the file and use " Enhance Existing Record" Mode.-Select Execute Migration, then Execute Migration Step by Step.-Error message appears "Cannot create duplicate entries in Collaboration view".-Cause- The customer collaboration data doesn't support in migration tool, neither via Mass Data Maintenance.-Resolution-The following payload will allow you to add multiple e-mail lines to an account in one go:-<n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0=" http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global "> -<BasicMessageHeader/>-<Customer actionCode="04">-<InternalID>XX</InternalID> (Here XX refers Internal ID)-<CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel actionCode="04" communicationChannelListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>D1</CompoundServiceInterfaceCode> (Here D1 refers to Compound Service Interface Code)-<EnabledIndicator>true</EnabledIndicator>-<CommunicationChannel communicationEmailListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CommunicationMediumTypeCode>INT</CommunicationMediumTypeCode> (Here INT represents the Communication Code)-<CommunicationEmail>-<EmailURI>XXX, XXX1</EmailURI> (Here XXX and XXX1 are the E-mail ID)-<RecipientFieldTypeCode>CC</RecipientFieldTypeCode> (Here CC represents the Recipient Field Type Code)-</CommunicationEmail>-<CommunicationEmail>-<EmailURI>XXX1</EmailURI>-<RecipientFieldTypeCode>CC</RecipientFieldTypeCode>-</CommunicationEmail>-</CommunicationChannel>-</CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel>-</Customer>-</n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-As a workaround you can use the web service that is ManageCustomerIn. Here you can enhance the collaboration data via the element "CommunicationArrangementMC" in case of multi channels-Keywords-Customer Collaboration, CommunicationArrangement, ManageCustomerIn, Migration of Customer, Mass Data Maintenance, Customers.-customer collaboration,communicationarrangementmc,managecustomerin,migration of customer

Title: Wrong Payment Method is Picked when a New Bank Statement is Uploaded
Content: Symptom-You upload a new Bank Statement, each transaction is created.-Few outgoing payments with the External Transaction Code example 116 or 191 are automatically assigned with payment method: "Outgoing Bank Transfer"-Few incoming payments have an External Transaction Code example 051 are created with payment method: "Other Incoming Payments" instead of "Incoming Payments"-You see the necessary configuration is already maintained in Business Configuration as well-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Liquidity Management work center-Select related bank statement-Open it and check transactions-Click on 'Required' postprocessing status of the line item-Here the the problem is, that the payment method is 'other incoming payment', instead of 'incoming payment'-Cause-The reason why the codes 116 and 191 works, while the 005 or 051 does not is, the leading zeros in the configuration table of the customer. -In the parsing of the file the leading zeros are removed and the system expects the code 5 or 51 instead of 005 and 051 in the configuration to properly match the entries.-Resolution-You need to add the lines to the configuration with just 5 and 51 as External transaction Code in the configuration(Business Configuration - Activity: Automatically Generated Bank Statements)and then try to upload a bank statement to use these codes.-Keywords-Bank statement, External transaction code

Title: Incorrect Payment Terms Calculated in the Purchase Order Document
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order for the supplier where payment terms is maintained as A. However system populates the payment terms as B which is incorrect. - Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order -Select Edit -You can see the payment terms updated as B instead of A- Cause-In the supplier master data, you have changed the payment terms from B to A on date DD.MM.YYYY. At the time of Purchase Order creation, the payment terms was B and hence system populates or proposes the payment terms as B instead of A. -Resolution-There is a frequent change in the payment terms after the documents were Created/Ordered/Posted. Hence system uses the old payment terms that exists during the creation process. System is working as designed. If you want the updated payment terms to be reflected in the purchase order, please update it manually before you order. -See Also-2807271 - Incorrect Calculation of due Date in Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Incorrect payment terms in PO; Incorrect payment terms; Payment terms configured

Title: How to Add G/L Accounts to a Balance Sheet Financial Reporting Structure From the Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You need to add further G/L accounts to a Balance Sheet Financial Reporting structure. But when trying to add an account or to save the changes the activity crashes.-For some reason, you cannot update the reporting structure via Import from Microsoft Excel. This would be the case, for instance, when for numerous of the G/L accounts the Show Only option is selected. These accounts are to appear either on Asset or Liabilities side of the Balance sheet depending on their balance on a key date. Currently, the Show Only option, however, is not available in the Microsoft Excel template for Financial Reporting Structures.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Business Configuration work center enter the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity, either through the First Implementation project in the Fine Tune phase (if your system is not live) or via the Overview view (if your system is live).-In the new screen select Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the respective balance sheet reporting structure, if it already exists or add a new reporting structure, maintain all the mandatory data and press OK.-Press Edit.-Select the Financial Reporting Structure Item of your choice.-Press Actions - Assign Account.-Select the account(s) of your choice and press OK. It might take a very long time until this task is processed. A time out error might appear.-Press OK to move back to the Financial Reporting Structures screen. This might also take very long or even finish with a time out error.-Cause-Due to the large amount of G/L accounts assigned to the reporting structure's chart of accounts the system cannot process all G/L accounts fast enough. The high amount of accounts causes severe performance issues and can cause time out errors.-Resolution-If it is not possible to update a Financial Reporting structure via Microsoft Excel export we can add G/L accounts from the backend to the reporting structure.-This can be achieved in five steps:-A) Find out the technical name of the reporting structure items which you need to add the account to. Please note for balance sheet accounts with the show-only-option the account must be added on Asset side as well as on Liabilities side of the balance sheet.-B) Important: Prepare an Excel sheet to document all the changes which you are about to make. This way we can investigate, should there be any inconsistencies of the reporting structure after the changes made.-C) Add the accounts to the reporting structure.-D) Finally, update the Workspace.-E) Verify the consistency of the updated Financial Reporting Structure.-Preparation:-Request a business user with L6 access rights as well as read and write access.-Access the Customer system in the language used to create the reporting structure (e.g. German).-Access the Charts of Accounts, Account Determination, Financial Reporting Structures fine tune activity (as described above).-In the Edit financial reporting structures section take note of the ID of the reporting structure as well as the which needs to be edited and open it via Edit (It may take a moment until the structure loads. It is recommended to open the activity in Google Chrome).-Just to be sure press Check Consistency to ensure the structure is consistent.-Via the Search function find the reporting structure node which you need to edit. Take a note of its name (If you log on in a different language, e.g. English, the name is blanc unless it has been maintained in English before).-A) Identify the technical name of the reporting structure item:-In STFK enter transaction MDRS.-Select Business Object and enter FIA_FSTRC. -Press Enter.-Expand the Root Object.-Expand the FIA_FSTRC_FIN_STRUC_ITEM (Description: Item) object.-Double-Click on FIA_FSTRC_FIN_STRUC_ITEM_T (Description: ItemDocumentation).-On the right side, in the Overview tab, navigate to the Implementation Details section on the bottom.-Here, beside the Persist. Table/View field click on the small table symbol.-In the new screen, in the LANGU field enter the language abbreviation in which you have logged on in the UI, e.g. DE (for German).-In the FSTRUCTURE field enter the structure ID.-In the Description field enter the name of the structure node which is to be edited.-Press Execute.-In the new screen verify that the Description displayed really is the name of the structure node where you need to add G/L accounts.-Take note of the ID maintained in the FS_ITEM field.-B) Prepare an Excel sheet to document all the changes:-Open Excel and create a table with the following columns:-Description FSTRUCTURE FS_ITEM CHOFACCT ACCT_FROM ACCT_TO FS_DEB_POS FS_CRD_POS-Structure Node Name on Asset side ZXXX* XXXXXXX* ABC* ACCOUNT A*   X  -Structure Node Name on Liabilities side ZXXX YYYYYYY* ABC ACCOUNT A     X-Structure Node Name, can be on asset or liabilities side ZXXX ZZZZZZZ* ABC ACCOUNT B*   X X-Please see below explanation what each value above represents:-ZXXX represents the financial reporting structure ID.-XXXXXXX represents the structure node ID on Asset side.-YYYYYYYY represents the structure node ID on Liabilities side.-ABC represents the Chart of Accounts assigned to the reporting structure.-ACCOUNT A represents a G/L account ID for an account that is to appear on either side of the structure depending on its balance.-ACCOUNT B represents a G/L account ID with show only option: 0. It does not change its balance nature. It either appears only on asset side or only on liabilities side.-Fill the table with all the information that you need to update:-In the Description field enter the name of the structure node. This column is for your own information only to double-check the structure node name.-In the FSTRUCTURE field enter the financial structure ID-In the FS_ITEM field enter the ID of the structure node which you identified in step A).-In the ACCT_FROM field enter the G/L account ID which needs to be added.-Leave the ACCT_TO field blanc.-Settings for the Show Only Display:-In the FS_DEB_POS field enter an X if the account is to only appear on the Asset side with a Debit Balance (Show Only: Debit Balance). Note: There must be an opposite entry for the account on Liabilities side (FS_CRD_POS: X; UI: Show only: Credit Balance).-In the FS_CRD_POS field enter an X If the account is to only appear on the Liabilities side with a Credit Balance (UI: Show Only: Credit Balance). Note: There must be an opposite entry for the account on Asset side (FS_DEB_POS: X; UI: Show only: Debit Balance).-If the account balance is not to show on one side of the balance sheet depending on its balance enter an X in FS_DEB_POS AS WELL AS FS_CRD_POS (FS_DEB_POS + FS_CRD_POS: X; UI: Show only: 0).- C) Add the accounts to the reporting structure-In STFK go to transaction BCE (Business Configuration Engine).-Select Configuration workspaces from the dropdown option.-In the Configuration workspace field enter * and press Enter.-Double-Click on the Main Workspace object name, usually with Description Initial Implement. On the right side, in the Attribute tab verify that the Main Workspace box is selected.-Then Choose Fine-Tuning                                -In the small pop-up window select Global Fine Tuning on BC Node.-In the Node ID field enter A1S_FIN_FSTRC___FIAC_FSTRCGLAC and press Execute.-Press Edit.-Add the number of rows according to the number of rows in your prepared Excel list.-Copy and paste the Excel table (apart from the Description column) into the empty rows. Note: There must be no empty row. Remove all empty rows before saving.-Then press Save.                                     -D) Update the Workspace-In STFK use transaction BCTADM.-In the Workspace Operation tab, first go to the Workspace Operation section.-Select Update Workspace.-In the Deploy / Update Workspace section under Update Workspace select the options-With Complete Deploy-Bypass Change Pointer-Press Execute.-A small window pops up with the question Are you sure to update this workspace? which you answer with Yes.-After a few minutes the workspace is updated.- E) Verify the consistency of the updated Financial Reporting Structure-Access the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity as described above.-In the new screen select Edit financial reporting structures.-Select the respective balance sheet reporting structure and press Edit.-As the structure consists of a lot of data wait until the first structure item appears.-Press Check Consistency. The message must read: 'Financial Structure is consistent.-If you encounter issues double-check the excel you maintained with the changes you made. Should you not be able to identify the inconsistency involve the development team (SRD-FIN-ANA).-Keywords-Add G/L account to balance sheet exception, Dump, Reporting Structure

Title: Discard button is grayed out when trying to reverse an outbound file
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The discard button is grayed out when trying to reverse an outbound file-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity management Wc > Outbound files-Select "All Outbound files" -Search for the Outbound file and select it-Click the "Gear" button, the Discard button is grayed out-Resolution-Please unblock any files stuck in creation from the-Access the backend and use the Transaction SESFTS-Load BO by Proxy Name: FOPXP_COMP_PAY_FILE_REG-Query by "Load by Node ID" -> Outgoing file-Enter the payment file number and then search.-Click Actions and then from the drop-down, select Notify of File Creation Failure.-Customer can then reverse the payment files.-Keywords-outbound file, reverse, discard, inactive, greyed

Title: Error Message System expected the end of the element 'item' While using Automated Purchase Order Upload Bot
Content: Symptom-You configured Automated Purchase Order upload bot and there is no issues in the factory but the PO wasn't created. The logs files in BPA shows the processing is successful but there is an error in Application and User Management - Web Service Message Monitoring-  Error Type: Application Error-Executed On: <date & Time>-Incoming: ManagePurchaseOrderIn-Error: System expected the end of the element 'Item'-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Step 1: Execute the Bot in BPA-Step 2: Check the log - There is no error-Step 3: Check in Web Service Message Monitoring screen under Application and User Management work center-Cause-Cause for the issue is that below prerequisites might be missing-The communication scenario and arrangements are not maintained for the web-service and once maintained the credentials which you give in the communication arrangements should be maintained as windows credentials and this windows credentials should be given as input parameter when scheduling the bot.-Resolution-Once the above setting / configuration is maintained, execute the bot again-For more details, refer to the "Tech Spec - Automated Purchase Order Upload.docx" in the BOT Store-Keywords-Automated Purchase Order Upload, bot, bpa

Title: Limiting a Business User who has Authorization to Other Company Sales Order and Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-When a business user has read access restricted to sales order and purchase order for "X" company but also was able to view "Y" company sales order and purchase order.-(Here X and Y refers to Company IDs)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Users-Search for user-Select the Edit button-Go to  Access Rights-Go to Work Center and View Assignment tab-Work center view CRM_WOC_SALESORDERS and SRM_PURCHREQUESTSORDERS with read access restricted-Cause-Business user can access the sales orders due to the access rights of PERSONAL DATA DISCLOSURE work center view of DATAPRIVACY workcenter which is deprecated.-Resolution-Follow the Steps to limit the authorization for other company sales order and purchase order:-Go to Application and user management work center-Go to Business Users view.-Select user "XX"  (Here XX refers to an Employee ID)-Select the Edit button-Go to Access rights-Go to Workcenter and view assignment tab-Remove DATAPRIVACY workcenter from the list and save.- Keywords-Limit Sales order , Limit Purchase order, User restriction-limit sales order,limit purchase order,user restriction

Title: When You are Terminating an Employee and Rehire an Employee System Reports an Error "Work agreement ID already exists; unique ID required"
Content: Symptom-When you terminate an employee with employee ID " XXX"(with leading space) and Rehire an employee with employee ID "XXX"(without leading space) system reports an error "Work agreement ID already exists; unique ID required"  .-(Here XXX is an Employee ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center.-Select Regular Tasks view.-Select Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Search the employee you want to terminate.-Select Last Working Day for the employee.-Select the Save and Close button to save the changes -Go to Personnel Administration work center - Regular Tasks view-Click Rehire Employee-Cause-You have configured manual number range for employee ID in the system-While hiring the employees, you have added a leading space for the employee ID-Resolution-You need to terminate the current employee with employee ID " XXX"(with leading space) and Rehire the employee with new Employee ID in a different country-Keywords-Work agreement ID already exists; unique ID required ,-work agreement id already exists,unique id required

Title: FR ETEBAC AFB - Foreign Payment (French Payment Format): Bank Charges Paid By
Content: Symptom-You create an international Outgoing Bank Transfer using the Payment Medium Format: FR ETEBAC AFB - Foreign Payment.-When the Outbound File is created, you wonder how the data of who bears the Bank charges maintained or not in the field: "Bank Charges Paid By" is populated on the payment file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-The information of who pay the Bank Charges is maintained in the tag 04 of the file (13-Initiator, 14-Sharing of costs and 15-Beneficiary) and comes after the country code FR and the Payment Method 0 (In this case, it is 0. It can be 1 or 2 depending on the payment method).-    The determination of who pay the Bank Charges depends on other criteria among which the Currency in which the payment is made.-When the payment is made in EURO or USD, the Bank Charges Paid By determined in the file is always 14-Sharing of costs (even if the Initiator or the Beneficiary has been maintained or the field has been left blank).-When the payment is made in a currency other than EURO or USD, the Bank Charges Paid By determined in the file is always 15-Beneficiary (even if Initiator or Sharing of cost has been maintained or the field has been left blank).-13-Initiator is never selected due to this payment format specifications.-Keywords-FR ETEBAC AFB - Foreign Payment, Outgoing Bank Transfer, Payment File, Payment Medium Format, Bank Charges Paid by, Frais Bancaires Payés Par, Format de Support de Paiement, Virement Bancaire International, Initiateur, Beneficiaire, Partage Des Coûts.

Title: Issue with Providing Input Value for Extension Field.
Content: Symptom-Extension Field isn't editable for providing Input Value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Execution - Production Tasks-Open Adaptation Mode-You will see the added extension field on Manual Selection of Production Tasks-But the extension field is not editable -Cause-User can't edit any field in OWL which is the System Standard Behaviour.-Resolution-If User Wants to Input value for the added Extension Field, then it should be mapped or binded with the backend field so that it can also be added on respective screen when we click on Edit screen.-Keywords-Extension Field,Input Value,Not editable,Production Tasks

Title: While Previewing the Form System throws Error Message 'Form template code mandatory'.
Content: Symptom-You get Form Template Code Mandatory error while Previewing the Customer Invoice Request Document.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Show All Invoices Requests.-Search for relevant ID with status To Be Invoiced.-Choose Preview & Invoice link.-System throws Error Message 'Form template code mandatory'.-Cause-The Form Template Code is not maintained in the particular Invoice.-Resolution-User has to maintain Form Template Code for their respective seller /invoice unit & Form Template Selection rule for the same seller /invoice unit.-Kindly follow below steps for Maintaining Form Template Code:-Go to Application & User Management Work Center.-Navigate to Input & Output Mangement View.-Select Form Template Maintenance.-Search for Customer Invoice.-Choose Edit.-Here you can Maintain Form Template Code.-Keywords-Form template code mandatory,Previewing Error,Invoices Requests,Customer Invoice Request

Title: Unable to Finish Change Project Due to Message: Not Possible to Finalize Scope Changes; Some Decisions would Cause Inconsistencies in Fine-Tuning Settings while Enabling Employee Self Service for an Employee
Content: Symptom-You are unable to finish a change project. You see the following system message: Finish Project:-It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely while Enabling Employee Self Service Leave request for an Employee-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click on Implementation Project overview.-Select the Change Project: approval process for Contracts.-Click on Next until step 4-Review Status: Do you want your employees to submit leave requests using employee self-service?-Click on Accept preselected Answers.-Enter Title-Click on Finish-Finish Project: It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely.-Cause-This could be because these previously used Employee time Item types were maintained however later on user tried to remove mentioned time types and Scoping "Do you want your employees to submit leave requests using employee self-service?" checking the Restriction and Employee time types and due to mismatch, error occurs.-Resolution- You can add the Time types by following the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Go to Overview workcenter -Search for Time-types -Select Maintain Employee Time Types -Now add the Time types that you would prefer -Keywords-A1S_HCM_TM_EETYPTIM_C_TRECTY_2, Time Types, Business Configuration, Employee Self Service, Leave Request

Title: How to Configure the Options for the Reason for Rejection
Content: Symptom-You would like to configure the options available for the Reason for Rejection for a Sales Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-You can find the fine tuning activity to configure the Reason for Rejection as follows:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview.-Search for Reasons for Rejection.-Select the Fine Tuning Activity Reasons for Rejection.-Click on the Button Change Immediately.-You can now add or remove a reason for rejection. -Please note:-This is valid for documents such as sales quotes, sales orders, service orders, service confirmations, or customer returns.--The following Reasons for Rejection cannot be removed since are used in your system in certain scenarios e.g. Intercompany Sales Order cancelled via Purchase Order etc. -95 Canceled from time recording-96 Canceled from goods and services receipt-97 Cancellation from inbound delivery-98 Customer cancellation by XI message-99 Cancellation by system (obsolete)-Keywords-Reason for Rejection; BC; Fine Tuning, Cancellation, Sales, Contract, Cancellation Reason

Title: Message error: Service Provision Accounting notification : Premium Pay Type is missing or invalid
Content: Symptom-Message error: Service Provision Accounting notification **: Premium Pay Type is missing or invalid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User Management Wc-Go to Process Communication view-From the drop-down, select Errors with Incident-Main Error-Service Provision Accounting Notification XXX Item: Premium Pay Type is missing or invalid-Cause-If the "Valuation with Compensation Rate" activity is scoped in your system the Premium Pay type is mandatory-Resolution-Consider to scope the Premum Pay activity in your system-See Also-Help Documentation: Premium Pay-Keywords-premium pay, internal time confirmation, compensation rates, time booking, PCE error

Title: Error: 'Multiple sales orders not allowed.' in Document Goods and Activity Confirmation.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Process Communication Error in Goods and Activity Confirmation AAA.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Sales Orders View.-Search and open Sales Order BBB.-Go to tab Document Flow.-Click the anchor of Outbound Delivery CCC.-You will see the red exclamation in Goods and Activity Confirmation AAA and click it:-The following errors have been addressed to your service provider:-- Goods and Activity Confirmation AAA cannot create a Business Transaction (For Accounting)-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-Logon to the STFK.-Enter the login information.-Enter code SE38 and press Enter.-In the Program, enter FIA_ACCNOTIF_SHOW_PI; Select Source code in the Subobjects and press Execute.-In the Operational Document Type, enter the 55-Goods and Activity confiramtion; In the Operational Document ID, enter AAA; Select XI Message(s) in the Display Options and Press Execute.-In the newly open page, you will see a stuck XI message; The Error Information is 'InventoryChangeAndActivityConfirmation AAA / Item AAA-DD：Multiple sales orders not allowed'.-Cause-As part of jira item https://jira.sme.c.eu-de-2.cloud.sap/browse/BYD2102-2043 for 2102 consignment topic, a new error was introduced. It is not allowed to have more than one Sales Orders referenced in the Outbound Delivery that creates the Goods and Activity Confirmation.-To check the Outbound Delivery CCC:-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Go to Sales Orders View.-Search and open Sales Order BBB.-Go to tab Document Flow.-Open Outbound Delivery CCC(The Delivery Type is Consignment Fill-Up).-Go to tab Line Items and you will see:-Line Item ID 10, Reference BBB Sales Order.-Line Item ID 20, Reference EEE Sales Order.-Resolution-First, you need to get permission from customer to Cancel the XI message for Goods and Activity Confirmation AAA.-Second, customer needs to Undo Release the Outbound Delivery CCC and create separate Outbound deliveries for different Sales Orders.-Keywords-Multiple sales orders not allowed; goods and activity confirmation; Consignment Fill-Up. 不允许多个销售订单; 货物与活动确认; 寄售补货.

Title: GR/IR Run Contains No Postings
Content: Symptom-You ran a GR/IR run for a Purchasing Document and noticed that no postings appear in the Postings tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select the view GR/IR Clearing.-Search and find run ID XYZ (XYZ represents the GR/IR run ID).-Go to the Postings Tab.-No posting details appear.-Expectation is to have the clearing postings to appear.-Cause-The Purchasing document that you completed the GR/IR run for has a Final Clearing Date of DD.MM.YYYY.-The Period that you have run the GR/IR for is before this clearing date.-Resolution-This is correct system behavior. You have two options to get the results that you were expecting:-Option 1: Run the GR/IR for the period the Final Clearing Date is in.-Option 2: Change the Final Clearing Date, and run the GR/IR for the period matching this date.-See Also-GR/IR Clearing Help Document-Keywords-GR/IR, Purchasing Document, Clearing, Goods Receipt, Invoice Receipt, Postings tab

Title: When Performing Migration of Product Categories Facing Error "Service call failed; Report an incident"
Content: Symptom-When performing Migration of Product Categories system throws the error "Service call failed; Report an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Centre-Select the Activities Menu-Search for "Product Category Hierarchy"-Click Execute Migration-Execute Migration Step by Step-Facing Error- Service call failed; Report an incident-Cause-The issue is occurring when you maintain multiple languages for a same product category ID-Resolution-Adding multiple entries in the migration template for the same product category and different languages from migration template is not supported.-This would be a new Requirement.-Workaround:-You can use an inbound web service to update the values from the below help document-https://help.sap.com/doc/a2b4c7ef61d64397b2b1d052082a8a08/2302/en-US/PSM_ISI_R_II_QUERY_PCH_IN.html-Here is a sample:-<ProductCategoryHierarchy>-<UUID>XXXXX</UUID>-<ID>ABCDF</ID>-<Description>-<Description languageCode="EN">Base</Description>-</Description>-<ProductCategoryHierarchyUsageCode>1</ProductCategoryHierarchyUsageCode>-NOTE:-XXXXX - Refers to UUID-ABCDF - Refers to Product Category ID-You can update the languages in the User Interface-Keywords-Migration Of Product Categories, Migration, adding multiple languages

Title: Error: 'Bank account ID missing' When Reversing a Bank Credit Advice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The customer is trying to reverse Bank Credit Advice but they are getting an error message saying that Bank Account ID is missing. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Liquidity Management work center.-Bank Payment Advices view.-Find advice ID XYZ (XYZ represents the advice ID), with status Released and Advice Date dd.mm.yyyy.-Click Reverse button. -You will see the following error message:-'Bank account ID missing'-Cause-Database Inconsistency.-The bank advice was created without bank account id which is a mandatory field. -Resolution-Create an incident for the Development team for Backend correction. Title: Output e-mail for Remittance Advice Outbound fails with error message "Invalid recipient address"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to generate output e-mail for a Remittance Advice Outbound but the status ends in Error. -In Error Details you see the message "Invalid recipient address username@domain.extension". -You do not know where the system is getting this e-mail address from.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Search for the relevant ID.-Enter it.-Go to Output History tab.-You can see the error message "Invalid recipient address (username@domain.extension)".-Cause-Under the Payee's Communication details, there is a rule maintained for Remittance Advice Outbound that defines that this e-mail address is used.-Resolution-To check which e-mail address is maintained under the Remittance Advice Outbound rule and change it, follow below steps:-Go to Payment Management work center.-Go to Payment Monitor view.-Search for the relevant ID.-Enter it.-In General tab, search for the Payee.-Enter it.-Click View All.-Go to Communication tab.-Click Collaboration.-You can see a rule maintained for Remittance Advice Outbound with the e-mail address.-Make the necessary change to the correct e-mail you wish to use.-Keywords-Invalid recipient address, Ongeldig ontvangeradres, Outgoing Bank Transfer not sent, Remittance Advice e-mail not sent, Remittance Advice Output error

Title: Chart Option Grayed Out in Report or Dashboard
Content: Symptom-You would like your report to be shown in a chart view, however the chart option is grayed out. You cannot select any chart type.-In Dashboards the icon will be greyed out and when you hover over the icon it will show "Chart view not enabled for the selected report".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics and the view Design Reports.-Open the respective report.-Set the selection variables as required and run the report.-Arrange the view as needed.-Clicking on the Chart option is not possible because it is grayed out.-Cause-The view is not suitable to be rendered in any chart type. This is often the case when there is too much data in the report result (for example, several pages).-Resolution-Different chart types have different requirements in terms of the minimum or maximum number of key figures or characteristics. Generally however, a chart can only be rendered if the data volume is not too large, i.e. if the table shows no more than 1 page of data. Charts cannot be expanded to more than one page. Hence, please reduce the data volume either by setting more variables in the selection or by removing a few fields from the view.-See Also-There are further KBAs and help center articles available that describe the specific requirement of a particular chart type. So if the chart option is enabled but only specific chart types are grayed out, please check the KBA or help center article about that specific chart type.-Keywords-business analytics, analysis, report, report view, chart, graph, diagramm, diagram, greyed out, no chart possible

Title: Error Message While Migrating Opportunities "Opportunity is relevant for sales forecast; enter an expected value"
Content: Symptom-Error received in Migration of Opportunities:-Opportunity is relevant for sales forecast; enter an expected value-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration workcenter.-Select Overview.-Search Migration of Opportunities Activity.-When you execute the migration file above error message appears.-Cause-In the Business Configuration Scoping, the question Do you always classify opportunity as relevant for forecast? is checked in the ByDesign System.-Resolution-Please uncheck this question to remove the error:-Go to Business Configuration workcenter-Select Implementation Projects view-Select the current Project and Edit-Navigate to Questions tab-Expand Sales-Select New Business-Select Opportunities-Now deselect the question: Do you always classify opportunity as relevant for forecast?-Keywords-Migration of Opportunities; Sales Forecast, Remove, Forecast, Opportunity, Scoping

Title: HSN/SAC Code Missing in the Monitoring Invoices Report
Content: Symptom-You have posted the supplier invoice for India with HSN/SAC code. However HSN/SAC codes for product or service items does not appear in the Monitoring Invoices report. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center -Go to Design Reports view-Select the Monitoring Invoices report -Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-You can see that field, HSN Code appears blank. (HSN Code field appears as Not assigned) -Cause-In the product master data you have not maintained the value for field HSN Code for India and for services you have not maintained the value for field Accounting Code of the Service. Hence the field HSN code and Accounting Code of the Service appears blank in the report. -Resolution-You can maintain the HSN Code for India and Accounting Code of the Service from the below steps; -Go to the Product Portfolio work center-Go to the Products view-Select the By Materials or By Services-Select the relevant Material or Service-Select Edit and navigate to General tab-Under General Information, maintain the value for fields HSN Code for India and Accounting Code of the Service-Once you maintain the values in the master data, system will fetch the details for the new invoices and display the values in the Monitoring Invoices report.-See Also-https://itsm.services.sap/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0647120-Keywords-HSN/SAC code missing in Monitoring invoice report; Accounting Code of the Service; HSN/SAC code for product

Title: Error: Transaction date must not be in the past.
Content: Symptom-The system displays above error message when you try to perform a logistics posting like Post Goods Issue or confirm a pick task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-We will take the example of Post Goods Issue to explain the steps.-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Go to view Delivery Proposals.-Select a delivery proposal, click Post Goods Issue.-In the screen "Create Outbound Delivery and Goods Issue", enter a date over 6 months ago in Shipment Date, maintain other necessary fields, click Save and Close, error triggered:-        "Transaction date must not be in the past-          Save failed"-Cause-In Business ByDesign there is a restriction set up that you will not be allowed to make inventory postings beyond six months in the past. This restriction is done to make sure that all logistics postings are completed within six months. Since there could be genuine reasons where the end users are not able to complete their inventory postings within six months, we have provided an option to enable postings beyond six months in the past. This can be set up in the Business Configuration of your Implementation Projects.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center. Search for the relevant implementation project and choose the Edit Project Scope button.-Navigate to the Scoping section, expand Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics > Inventory Management, ensure Inventory Postings is selected-Move to the Questions section and expand the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics, under Inventory Management select Inventory Postings.-Select the question Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months?-Once above question is selected and updated to the implementation project you will be able to make inventory postings beyond six months in the past.-See Also-2831591 - Actual Delivery Date Must Be Between DD.MM.YYYY And Today-Keywords-Transaction Date, Past, Shipment Date
