Title: Is it Possible to Know the Password Maintained in Communication Arrangement
Content: Symptom-Is it possible to know the password maintained in Communication Arrangement?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter.-Navigate to Input and Output Management view and choose Communication arrangements view-Select and click to Open Communication arrangement-Choose "View All"-Navigate to 'Technical Data' Tab-Password is not visible for user ID-Cause-This password is masked so it is not possible to make the password visible which is maintained in Communication Arrangement. You have to maintain the same password for Communication arrangement User ID in ByD system and in Third party system .-Resolution-This is standard system behaviour-See Also-3313992 - Unable to Change User ID of Communication Arrangement. -Keywords-Masked password , communication arrangement user id

Title: Difference Between Multi-Level Structure View And Multi-Level Visualization View of Production Bill of Materials
Content: Symptom-You want to understand the difference between Multi-Level Structure view and Multi-Level Visualization view of Production Bill of Materials. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data work center. -Navigate to the Production Bills of Materials view. -Search and select the BoM with multiple levels. In customer system the ID - <BOM_ID>. -You can see two buttons <Multi-Level Structure> and <Multi-Level Visualization>. -The customer wants to understand what is the difference between two of these buttons.  <BOM_ID> is the example for Bill of Material ID. -Resolution-A summery of explanation of difference between Multi-Level Structure view and Multi-Level Visualization view of Production Bill of Materials is below.  -Multi-Level Structure: It enables you to review and print the Multi-level Hierarchy for the selected BOM variant.-Multi-Level BoM Visualization:  Here there is no Print option. You can navigate to all the levels in the hierarchy.-You can also view the hierarchy in Top Down or Bottom Up views.-Top-Down View:-Here for any entered product, the underlying input products and there sub-underlying input products are displayed as per the hierarchy entered. -Bottom-Up View:-Here for any entered product, the products in which it is used as an input product is displayed.-Keywords-BoM multi level view, bill of material hierarchy, multi level structure vs multi level visualization, BoM visualization, level of BoM

Title: Serial Number ABCDEF Does Not Exist In Inventory Displayed In 3PL Inventory Notification
Content: Symptom-While trying to remove serial number <ABCDEF> from inventory notification : <1234> you get the above mentioned error message. <ABCDEF> and <1234> are examples of Inventory notification ID and Serial number.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign. -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Inventory Notifications view. -Search for the notification with id - <1234> select it and choose the Edit button. -Navigate to Line items tab, select the sub-tab Serial Number -Select the serial number <ABCDEF> choose the Remove button. -We receive the error message <Serial number ABCDEF does not exist in inventory>. Here <ABCDEF> and <1234> are examples of Inventory notification ID and Serial number.-Cause-You can still remove the serial numbers from the document. As the document is Inventory adjustment, the system will display errors based on the availability of serial numbers. You can continue to remove the serial numbers. -Resolution-You can remove serial numbers by following below steps. -Go to Third-Party Logistics work center. -Navigate to the Inventory Notifications view. -Search for the notification with id - <1234> select it and choose the Edit button. -Navigate to Line items tab, select the sub-tab Serial Number -Choose the Check button to check consistency of the document. -You will receive error message. -Ignore the error messages, navigate to the Serial Number tab. -Select a serial number,  choose the Remove button.-Keep removing the serial numbers you want to remove from the document. -Once you have removed all the documents, choose Save button. -The system will keep displaying the error messages but you can choose to ignore the messages and continue removing the serial numbers from the document.

Title: Journal Entry Type: 00074 Settlement Posting is not Expected
Content: Symptom-You have posted journal entry voucher with journal entry type 47 and postings include assignment of project of type Cost Collecting Project.-With the result of this journal entry voucher there is also another posting of journal entry of type: settlement and the reason for this is not clear to you.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries view and open the journal entry PQR. (PQR indicates journal entry ID).-Notice that Journal Entry type - 00074 - Settlement is also posted along with Manual Journal Entry posted.-Cause-As a rule, all costs charged to an overhead cost project are automatically reallocated back to the cost center that is specified in the project as the Requesting Unit.-Resolution-Standard system behavior:-1st posting: for source document, in this scenario the journal entry voucher posted with type 00047 - Manual Posting - Journal Entry Voucher.-2nd posting: from the source, it's a settlement posting, which will be posted from project to Cost Center.-Keywords-settlement journal entry type, settlement posting, project, cost collecting project, manual journal entry voucher-settlement posting, journal entry type settlement

Title: Error Message "Either Balance Sheet or Profit and Loss Account Required per Material" while Trying to Post Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You are trying to post Journal entry voucher with type 00087 - Manual Entry for Materials and screen variant 629 - Manual Adjusting Entry for Materials and received below error message:-Either balance sheet or profit and loss account required per material-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Journal Entries View.-Go to the Journal Entry Voucher sub-view.-Click on New -> Journal Entry Voucher .-Select Journal Entry Type 00087 - Manual Entry for Materials.-Select the Screen Variant as 629 - Manual Adjusting Entry for Materials.-Enter the relevant details and click on Post button.-Error message shown: Either balance sheet or profit and loss account required per material-Cause-The screen variant 629 - Manual Adjusting Entry for Materials is used to adjust the accounts within Inventory subledger itself and not across subledgers.-Suppose an incorrect account determination group was entered in the material master. As a result, the material values were posted to the wrong material stock account. To rectify this, you assign the correct account determination group and transfer the values to the correct material stock account using the screen variant 629 – Manual Adjusting Entry for Materials.-Resolution-You need to use the screen variant 630 – Manual Write-Up/Write-Down for Materials to adjust the accounts across subledgers.--This screen variant enables write-ups and write-downs for warehouse inventories, material expenses, and material differences. You must choose a G/L account from the account types listed above for at least one line item, and make the subledger account assignments for the business residence or material.-Keywords-Manual JEV, Journal enry voucher, Manual entry for materials

Title: Error Message While Terminating an Employee "Start Date Of Agreement Cannot Be Before Work Agreement Start Date"
Content: Symptom-This is central KBA with collection of KBAs which helps to troubleshoot issues with Output Management and Forms-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go Personnel Administration Work Center-2. Navigate to Regular Tasks View-3. Select Terminate Relationship with Employee-4. Maintain Employee's Last Working Day date-5. System shows the error-Cause-Cause for the issue is, Time Profile Start Date is earlier than the Hire Date / Work Agreement Start Date-To verify Time Profile date-1. Go to Time Administration work center-2. Search and Edit the Employee-3. Go to Time Profile tab-4. Check the Time Profile start date-To verify Work Agreement Date-1. Go to Personnel Adminiatration work center-2. Seach and Edit the Employee-3. Go to Employee and Work Agreement sub tab-Resolution-To fix this, Change the start date of the Time Agreement to match that of the Work Agreement.-This was a known issue and we put a fix in the system to stop this happening going forward. However, the changes to this Employee were made before we implemented these changes. Hence why this error message is being displayed now.-Keywords-time profile, work agreement, employment

Title: Error "The total number of serial numbers must be same as the quantity for product" While Confirming Put Away Task
Content: Symptom-You are trying to confirm the put away, however system throws below errors:---The action Finish is not possible. Refresh the screen and try again/ if the problem persists, report an incident.-Error during delivery update-The total number of serial numbers must be same as the quantity for product.--Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-2. Go to Task Control View.-3. Go to All Tasks by Selection and choose relevant Task ID.-4. Select and choose Confirm.-5. Choose line item with relevant product and enter required quantity.-6. Perform Save.-7. System throws above error messages.--Cause-Since the user has changed the serial number profile IDs from one for example 1005 (Mandatory on all Logistics & Production Processes) to another i.e. 1003 (No serial number profile mandatory) or any other.-Here, the order is  being created on a earlier date with the material ID and changes are done after creating documents does not get updated directly in the task.---Resolution-User must create a new order from beginning to reflect the serial profile changes being done in the material master data in the required logistics task ID.--See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2558836-Keywords-serial number ,Error during delivery update, put away task, pick task, -The action Finish is not possible, Refresh the screen and try again/ if the problem persists, report an incident,-The total number of serial numbers must be same as the quantity for product.

Title: You are Not Able to Release Customer Invoice due to Avalara Error
Content: Symptom-You are not able to release a customer invoice because of error: "Error during calculation of price and tax, Avalara Error".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Search invoice ABC , it is Not Released status. (ABC represents the ID of the invoice).-Open the invoice, the Release button is disabled and you can see error message: Error during calculation of price and tax Avalara Error.-Cause-The state and/or zip code information is missing in the ship-to address in Outbound Delivery document.-Resolution-You will need to cancel the invoice, and then un-release the outbound delivery.-In the outbound delivery document, maintain the state and zip code information in the ship-to address and release it again.-System will update the outbound delivery invoice request with the state and zip information, and you are able to release the invoice request and further invoice without error.-Keywords-Error during calculation of price and tax Avalara Error; Avalara; outbound delivery; state; zip code.

Title: The Following Error Occurs When Creating a Service Quote as a Follow-Up of a Service Order: Invalid Order Reference; Select a Different one
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs when creating a Service Quote as a Follow-Up of a Service Order: Invalid order reference; select a different one-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work centers. -Select the Service Order Processing view. -Select Service Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Service Order ID).-Click on the Follow-Up button and select Service Quote.-In the new Service Quote go to Services and Spare Parts tab.-Remove all the items other than the line item XX (XX represents the line item number).-Click on the Save button. -A new service quote will be created with the error message: Invalid order reference; select a different one-Cause-The error occurs because line item XX in the Service Order has the Delivery Status Finished.  -Resolution-If you would like to create a follow up quote for these services you would have to manually add them again in the Service Quote. These items would then not have a reference to the Service Order items.-Keywords-Service Order; Reference; Service Quote; Invalid; Line Item; Status; Finished; Inconsistent; Error

Title: You Are Not Able to Create Sales Order with Sales Kit via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create sales order with sales kit item via web service. The response does not show any error but the sales order is not created.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You execute the request payload in SOAP UI, and got response as following. There is no error message and no sales order ID created.-For example:--<n0:SalesOrderBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync xmlns:prx="..." xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">--<Log>-<MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>2</MaximumLogItemSeverityCode>--<Item>-<TypeID>294(/CL_CDA_DOCIT/)</TypeID>-<CategoryCode>ENV.CBM</CategoryCode>-<SeverityCode>1</SeverityCode>-<Note>KIT exists in payload; Item ids adjusted in order</Note>-</Item>-</Log>-</n0:SalesOrderBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync>-Cause-In the request payload, you have maintained shipping condition in sales kit sub items, like following. However, shipping condition has to be provided for kit header. -    <ItemDeliveryTerms>-            <ShippingCondition>ABC</ShippingCondition>-    </ItemDeliveryTerms>-ABC represents the value of shipping condition.-Resolution-You need to adapt the request payload, and ensure the shipping condition is maintained in sales kit header. Once the order is created, the shipping condition is presented in both sales kit header and items.-Keywords-sales order; web service; shipping condition; sales kit.

Title: Error Appears When you try to Re-Consume the Project Stock Order
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-When you try to re-consume Project stock order, you get an error message.-Error - Material not available for consumption on project-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Project Stock Orders view-Select Show by Documents view-Select the relevant Project stock order-Select Edit and click on Consume for a specific line item-Error appears-Cause-There is a failed message in the backend.-Sender - ProjectProcessing-Receiver - InventoryProcessingInventoryChangingIn-Error - Date transaction doit être comprise entre DD.MM.YYYY et aujourd'hui. Transaction date must be between DD.MM.YYYY and today.-The error occurred because, the project stock order was already pre-delivered on DD.MM.YYYY. Now, when user tries to consumes, system throws error.-In Business ByDesign there is a restriction set up that you will not be allowed to make inventory postings beyond six months in the past. This restriction is done to make sure that all logistics postings are completed within six months. Since there could be genuine reasons where the end users are not able to complete their inventory postings within six months, we have provided an option to enable postings beyond six months in the past. This can be set up in the Business Configuration of your Implementation Projects.-Resolution-In order to set up this configuration, please follow the below steps;-Go to the Business Configuration work center -Search for the relevant implementation project and choose the Edit Project Scope button -Navigate to the Scoping section and make sure that the option Inventory Posting is selected from the sub-element Inventory Management under the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics -Move to the Questions section and expand the scoping element Manufacturing, Warehousing and Logistics -Under Inventory Management select Inventory Postings -Select the question Do you want to extend the posting period beyond 6 months? -Once the above question is selected and updated to the implementation project you will be able to make inventory postings beyond six months in the past-See Also-2831591 - Actual Delivery Date Must Be Between DD.MM.YYYY And Today-Keywords-Material not available for consumption on project

Title: Payment method cash is not found for a Customer Account
Content: Symptom-You try to add 'Cash' payment method for a customer account and system throws error message 'cash is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables work center-Customers view and search for the relevant customer and Click on customer name-View all - Financial Data tab - Cash can be found under payment method, However when clicked on drop down, cash is missing and even system throws error message 'cash is not a valid value for this field. Enter a valid value.'-Cause-We currently do not support Cash and hence, not available in the payment method drop down.-Resolution-The payment methods section is meant to hold those internally initiated payment methods that we need to support in case of automatic payments for this specific customer account.-For a customer account, we would expect Direct Debit, Credit Card as the values.-It would still be possible to create an incoming cash payment from payment management work center for this specific customer account.-Keywords-Customer Account, Cash, Payment method

Title: How to Migrate "Alternate Employee ID" for Switzerland Employees Through Migration Tool
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to migration 'Alternate Employee ID" field for the Swizterland employees but the field Alternate Employee ID is missing the migration template-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-1- Go to the Business Configuration work center and Overview.-2- Search for Migration of Employee Data - Switzerland and open it.-3- Click Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.-4- In the Migration Tool, click You Can Also > Download Migration Template.-5- Open the template and the fields Alternative Employee ID, ID Card Type and ID Card Number are not available-Cause-The fields ID Card Type and ID Card Number are not part of Employee migration template for Switzerland currently.-Resolution-Following steps will help to migrate employee along with 'Alternative Employee ID', without having to enhance "Migration of Employee Data - Switzerland"-(1) Migration of Employee Data - Non Localized Countries/Regions -> Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool.. Here, "Personnel Identification -> ID Card Type , ID Card Number" can be used to fill 'Alternative Employee ID-(2) Migration of Employee Data - Non Localized Countries/Regions -> Migrate personnel administration data using the migration tool-Keywords-employee, CH, swizterland, alternate employee, id card type, id card number

Title: Error in field mapping configuration detected
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You received an incident with the below dump details:-Triggering application component: BC-ESI-BOF-Info: Internal application error of business object YABCDEFGY_0123456789XYZ -Info: Error in field mapping configuration detected-Info: Could not create object; class YABCDEFGY_CL_YABCDEFGY_FM_123A does not exist-Environment-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open Implementation Project view.-Click on "open activity list" button.-Search for the custom activity name.-Open the activity.-Try to add new values to the list-Dump is shown.-Cause-There is an inconsistency with the Business Configuration Object (BCO) mentioned on the error message which would require a BOPF model regeneration.-Resolution-Open BOPF transaction.-Expand Business Configuration Objects folder from Local Business Objects folder.-Double-click on the BCO twice (YABCDEFG_0123456789XYZ) from the dump.-Click on Extended Check button to see any errors.-Click on Synchronize with MDRS button.-Click on Activate button.-Click on Extended Check button again.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, dump, BCO, BOPF, error, inconsistent, node, element, field, mapping, configuration, detected, could, not, create, object, class, does, not, exist

Title: Complete Delivery Indicator and Delivery Rule are not Taken Over From the Payload When Creating a Service Order via the Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are creating a Service Order via the web service ManageServiceOrderIn and you are passing the Complete Delivery Indicator and Delivery Rule on Header level.-However, no matter what values you are passing in the DeliveryTerms via the payload on header level, the Complete Delivery Indicator is always set to true and the Delivery Rule is always set to Single delivery - full quantity (3)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The following values can be passed for the Delivery Rule (PartialDeliveryControlCode):-1 = Multiple Deliveries;-2 = Single on-time delivery;-3 = Single delivery - full quantity;-8 = Single on-time delivery - full quantity;-9 = Single delivery-In our example we are using 1 for Multiple Deliveries:-You are passing the Delivery Terms with the Delivery Rule (PartialDeliveryControlCode) as Multiple Deliveries (1) and the Complete Delivery Indicator (CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator) as false (not checked) via the payload on header level:-           <DeliveryTerms>-               <DeliveryPriorityCode>1</DeliveryPriorityCode>-               <PartialDeliveryControlCode>1</PartialDeliveryControlCode>-               <CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator>false</CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator>-            </DeliveryTerms>-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view. -Open the Service Order that was created via the web service. -Navigate to the General tab and the Main Information sub tab. -In the in the Delivery section you can see that the Complete Delivery is checked (true) and the Delivery Rule is Single delivery - full quantity (3).-You expected that the Complete Delivery is not checked (false) and the Delivery Rule is Multiple Deliveries (1) since this was passed via the web service. -Cause-Open the Account Master Data of the Ship To Party of the Service Order.-Navigate to the Sales Data tab.-Select the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel that is selected in your Service Order in the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoicing sub tab.-You can see that the Complete Delivery Indicator is checked (true).-There is an additional check for Service Orders which will check the settings maintained in the Account Master Data for the Sales Organization and Distribution Channel and if the Complete Indicator is checked in the Account Master Data of the Ship To Party this will take precedence and therefore the CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator passed via the payload is disregarded.-Resolution-If you want to pass the Delivery Rule (PartialDeliveryControlCode) and the Complete Delivery Indicator (CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator) via the payload you need to ensure that the Complete Delivery Indicator is not checked in the Account Master Data of the Ship To Party used in the Service Order.-Keywords-Complete Delivery Indicator; Delivery Rule; Delivery Terms; webservice; DeliveryTerms; PartialDeliveryControlCode; CompleteDeliveryRequestedIndicator; Service Order

Title: For Intercompany Stock Transfer Advanced Shipping Notification Not Sent For Outbound Deliveries
Content: Symptom-Advanced Shipping Notification is not created or sent for Outbound Deliveries in an Intercompany Stock Transfer scenario. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Outbound view.-Go to Outbound Deliveries subview.-Show All Outbound Deliveries by selection and find the required ID.-Select it and edit the required outbound delivery -Navigate to Document Flow-Observe that no advanced shipping notification generated.-Cause-Scoping needs to be done in Business Configuration work center under Communication for Outbound Logistics. Also, no Communication Arrangement created for Advanced Shipping Notification in the system.-Resolution-To scope the questions, follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your Implementation Project.-Choose Edit Project Scope button.-Choose on the Next button until step '4 Questions'.-Expand the Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Expand the Outbound Logistics.-Select the Communication for Outbound Logistics.-Then, scope the following questions:-Would you like to send advanced shipping notifications to your customers?-Do you want to send advanced shipping notifications electronically to your customers using electronic data exchange (EDX)?-Once these questions are scoped, the Input of the Advanced Shipping Notification scenario will be visible.-Set the "Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound" to Active in respective Account's master data under Collaboration tab-Maintain the Authentication Method in communication arrangement correctly, choose either SSL Client Certificate or User ID and Password as per business requirement.-Keywords-Intercompany Stock Transfer , Advanced Shipping Notification, Outbound Deliveries, Scoping, Questions, Advanced Shipping Notification Outbound, Advanced Shipping Notification scenario, Communication Arrangement, Not created, Not sent

Title: How Does FIFO Strategy Work
Content: Symptom-You want to know how FIFO strategy works. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-NA-Resolution-As per FIFO rule, system sorts the oldest stock according to the identified stock expiration date, identified stock production date and last put away date. The exact order in which the sorting happens once the system retrieves all available inventories for the relevant product is as follows.-The stock is sorted based on put away date first, this helps with getting FIFO information for all the stocks which does not have iStock.-Stock with iStock are sorted additionally based on Expiration Date and/or Production Date. -Keywords-FIFO, FIFO not working, Material Flow Rules, SDD rules, Source and Destination Determination Rules, ByDesign SDD, ByD Material Flow Rules, ByD FIFO, ByDesign FIFO

Title: Base UoM of Materials Missing After Changing Logon Language
Content: Symptom-After changing logon language you find the Base UoM maintained for Materials is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon system in e.g Traditional Chinese.-Go to Product Portfolio work center-> By Materials view.-Select the relevant Material and Edit.-The Base UoM is maintained as e.g PCS-PCS.-Logon system in e.g EN/Simplified Chinese.-Go to Product Portfolio work center-> By Materials view.-Select the same Material and Edit.-The Base UoM is blank.-Cause-Translation for UoM in Quantities and Units of Measure activity under Business Configuration is not maintained.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Search for activity Quantities and Units of Measure.-Select the relevant UoM.-Translation.-Maintain the translation for the target language.-Save.-Keywords-UoM, Materials, Quantities and Units of Measure

Title: Missing Forecast values in Financial Statement report
Content: Symptom-You have ran the "Financial Statements - Plan/Actual/Forecast" report and it didn't show any value in the forecast column.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics > Design Reports-Run the report Financial Statements - Plan/Actual/Forecast ID: FINGLAU25_Q0008-Report does not show any value in the forecast column-Cause-System behavior-Resolution-Currently, forecasting values are only configured to appear as part of Balance Sheet financial reporting structure types, and not other types such as Cash Flow Statements.-Keywords-report, forecast value, reporting structure, FINGLAU25_Q0008

Title: In Standard Report "Production Request Fulfillment" (SCMPRFU01_Q0001), Key Figure "Delay in Days" Shows Odd Value.
Content: Symptom-When you check in the standard report "Production Request Fulfillment" (SCMPRFU01_Q0001), you find key figure "Delays in Days" shows odd value like -738.416 d.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Reports.-Search SCMPRFU01_Q0001, click Edit With Web Browser.-Enter ABC (ABC represents production request ID) in Production Request ID, click Apply.-In the result, for input products, Delay in Days is -738.416 d.-Cause-The key figure "Delay in Days" is calculated based on output product rather than input product.-Resolution-If you remove characteristic "Input Product" from row, you will find Delay in Days displays normally with below formula:-Delay in Days = (([Production End Date] - [Planned Production End Date]) * [PARA_NUMBER_OF_DAYS])-PARA_NUMBER_OF_DAYS is a hidden parameter whose default value is 1. It is used for conversion of the difference in date to quantitative value.-Keywords-SCMPRFU01_Q0001, Delay in Days, Input Product, Output Product

Title: Error: Sales: Duplicate record detected with key value 'XYZ' while performing Migration of Materials for Sales Data
Content: Symptom-You are trying to perform the Migration of Materials a sales data, system throws below error message.-"Sales: Duplicate record detected with key value 'XYZ'"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Materials-Choose Migrate materials using the migration tool-Upload the file and go to properties change to enhance already existing records-Execute migration step by step you get the below error message as shown below:-Error:  "Sales: Duplicate record detected with key value 'XYZ' "-Cause-Migration file has the duplicate entries, which is causing this error message.-Resolution-Please check your Migration file for duplicates and remove the duplicate entries.-Once you remove the duplicates please start the migration, this should work without any issues.-Keywords-Migration of Materials, Sales Data Migration, Enhance already existing data, Sales, Duplicate Record detected.

Title: Migrated open goods receipt amount data not updated at purchase order item document flow
Content: Symptom-You have migrated open goods receipt with reference to a migrated purchase order in ByD system, however you find although the goods and service receipt ID is referenced on order item document flow, only the quantity with UOM shown there, but not amount value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Open activity: Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Select Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-See the Open Goods Receipt is in finished status.-Check the import logs, amount value is migrated successfully.-However the amount value is not updated to purchase order item document flow.-Cause-In purchase order migration template, under Document Flow tab, there is no amount field for delivery document, only quantity can be fulfilled.-After you migrate the order 123 (123 represents the migrated purchase order ID) into ByD system, the goods and service receipt ID (G123 - proposed by system) will be referenced to order item document flow.-After you migrate the open goods receipt into ByD system, amount will not be updated at order item document flow. The goods receipts are not migrated to the subledger for orders but only to the general subledger on a specific general ledger account: Unbilled Payables for Migrated Open Purchase Orders.-Since the goods and service receipt is migrated from legacy system, it is not an independent entity, the behavior is different from those manual goods and service receipts in ByD. You cannot carry out the standard follow-up actions because some of the required objects are not supported by tool-supported migration.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-See Also-KBA 3123400 - Migration of Purchase Orders Does Not Create Goods And Services Receipt-KBA 1920493 - Migrated Goods Receipts Are Not Visible in the System-Help Document: Processing of Open Goods Receipts After Migration-Keywords-Migration, Migrated purchase order, Migrated GSR, Migrated open goods receipt, Document flow, amount

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2305 Hotfix Collection 2 Information
Content: Symptom-The following is the list of fixes*- delivered with Hotfix collection 2, performed in 2305 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after 17th June 2023. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window for your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2305 HC 02-Resolution-Cross - Area Topic-UI Client-The 'Share View' button in the Production variance report is now sending emails to all the selected IDs in the ToList. (Hotfix ID: 1000021147)-The Document Compliance Monitor (DCM) no longer has the irrelevant 'Preview' button. Also, you can now create invoices from DCM for numeric ones. (Hotfix ID: 1000023239. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Output Management-An updated Adobe life-cycle designer is now available. (Hotfix ID: 1000024242. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Business Partner-The data source Business Partner Script (BPARTNER_SCRIPT) now contains the house number. (Hotfix ID: 4500022021)-You can now see the correct account-name in the Account hierarchy. (Hotfix ID: 4500020045)-  Customer Relationship Management-Customer Invoice-Payment terms and Due date calculations for invoices for Japan are now working fine. (Hotfix ID: 1000024053)-The 'Excel Upload' feature of 'Customer Invoice' creation is now resulting in the appropriate mapping of values in the General Ledger account. (Hotfix ID: 4500021882)-Service Product-If you now try to create more than one Valuation Quantity Unit node per Service Product, the system displays an error. (Hotfix ID: 4500020813. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Sales Order-You now have PDI enabled for payment control in Sales Orders via the Accounts work center. (Hotfix ID: 4500021860)-  Financial Management-Due Item Processing-The deferred tax amount is now correctly calculated for partially cleared invoices at the time of data extraction of any open payable-or-receivable item. (Hotfix ID: 4500019426)-Tax Management & Declaration-For India, the GSTR-3 tax return—containing the split items for a down-payment request—of both the incoming and outgoing scenarios - is now functional. (Hotfix ID: 4500021072. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The 'GSTR-2/GST ANX-2' tax return for India now considers the payable line items for import-relevant reverse charge tax codes. (Hotfix ID: 1000024773)-The appropriate tax amounts are now populating correctly to the 'Total Credit', 'Total Debit', 'Output VAT Extra EC', and 'Input VAT Extra EC' boxes in the Italy Summary Register tax return. (Hotfix ID: 4500019895)-For Israel, the withholding tax rate-type of 6% for the income type '08 Foreign by Bank' has been enabled by creating a new withholding tax code 016 - 'Foreign by Bank, Rate 6%'. (Hotfix ID: 4500020862. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Travel and Expense Management-The statutory rates for UK mileage have been updated in response to legal changes in mileage rates, effective June 1st, 2023. (Hotfix ID: 1000019529. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-You can now use meal per diem and lodging per diem rates maintained against 'Other Countries' for the countries not having any specific per-diem rate. (Hotfix ID: 4500021231)-Fixed Asset Accounting (Reporting)-You now have ‘Read’ access to the folder - ATTACHMENT_FOLDER of FIXED ASSET. (Hotfix ID: 4500021601)-General Ledger-The general-ledger-affiliated partner-company screen now displays the latest name of the partner company. (Hotfix ID: 4500016498)-External Expense Report-Regarding the Concur Expense report, the issue with posting the following expense reports to SAP Business ByDesign has now been resolved: Tax deductibility - Full deductible, Partial deductible, & Non-deductible, Expense reports. (Hotfix ID: 1000023615)-  Human Capital Management-Time Management-The record for employee-time-valuation result is available using the 'EmployeeTime' business object through association query. The association 'EmployeeTimeCalendarPeriodItem' under the element 'Item' of the 'EmployeeTime' business object - is now Read-Released. (Hotfix ID: 1000024342)-Personnel Administration-Selecting the 'Retain Manager' checkbox for transferring an employee who may be a manager of one or more organizational units is now working as expected. The system retains the employee as a manager, as expected. (Hotfix ID: 1000022196)-  Supply Chain Management-Logistics-The document numbering is now determined based on the 'Ship-From site' date for both Follow-up Credit and Debit Notes. (Hotfix ID: 1000021527)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Supplier Invoice-You can now post SIVs that are created with 'PO' or 'copy' reference for closed contract reference. (Hotfix ID: 4500020963)-If you try to create an SIV manually or post it when 'Referenced Purchasing Contract' is closed, the system displays an error or restricts you, respectively. Also, if you create any new SIV with a PO reference or an existing SIV copy, the system now warns you. Posting of SIVs will not be allowed later. (Hotfix ID: 4500019199. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g., operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed)-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-ByD2305; HFC02; Hotfix; SPS02; Hotfix Collection; 2305

Title: Error in landed cost allocation: Inbound delivery item net value is missing
Content: Symptom-You are getting error when trying to allocate the invoice item to inbound delivery-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to supplier invoicing work center-Select view Landed Cost Invoice Items-Select the respective Landed Cost Invoice Item-Select allocate-Enter the id in Assigned delivery document field.-Select Distribute-Select Check-Error:Inbound delivery item net value is missing-Cause-The reference document that you are entering may not be the correct reference document for the supplier invoice.-Resolution-Please check if the reference document belongs to the same company and supplier and has the correct details as in the supplier invoice.-Keywords-landed cost allocation, Inbound delivery item net value is missing

Title: Error:Converting currencies ABC and XYZ not possible; currencies not convertible
Content: Symptom-In the Error  ABC and XYZ  are currencies.-You will see a red mark in either Purchase request or Shopping cart-or-You will see a Process communication error in either Purchase request or Shopping cart-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Application user management work center- Go to Process communication errorsview- Choose 'Open errors with incidents'- You will find an entry with sender document 'Purchase Request' and  receiving document 'Shopping Cart'- Select it and scroll down you will see above error-Cause-No exchange rate maintained between the currencies.-Resolution- Go to General ledger work center- Go to Common tasks-> edit exchange rates and Validity- Enter Source currency and Target currency same as those currencies appearing in error message and all other details and save- Once done let us know by creating a case so that we can restart the message in the back end.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-[Enter your Keywords here...]

Title: How to Determine the Percentage of Utilization of the Licenses Assigned to Users
Content: Symptom-How can you determine the percentage of utilization of the licenses assigned to users?-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There is no concept of utilization percentage of the user licenses-Resolution-You can purchase licenses (those can be of type  self-service, core and advanced user license). Each license 'contains' the usage of certain work center views. Self-service licenses only contain some basic woc views, core licenses some more and advance license contains all of them. -Now we come to the 'assigned' licenses: a given ByD user has got some work center views assigned. Based on this we calculate which of the three license types this user consumes.  Those two key figure (purchased numbers and assigned numbers) are displayed in the Service Control Center, user subscription view per license type. -There is no concept of utilization percentage of the user licenses. Even if a user does not actively use the system at all, it still consumes a license.-See Also- 2821292 - How to Assign/Change User License Type for a Business User in SAP Business ByDesign-3065414 - How to find the License Related Reports in SAP Business ByDesign? -Keywords- License utilization , percentage utilization , assigned users

Title: No Product Category Description in Purchase Requests - Open Tasks view
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You navigate to the Purchase Requests - Open Tasks view, and you notice that you cannot add Product Category Description via Adaptation / Personalisation mode.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests view.-Set Filter to "Open Tasks".-Navigate to Profile button in top right corner.-Click "Key user settings".-Click "Start Adaptation Mode".-Click "Purchase Requests" in the Adaptation menu.-Notice that "Product Category Description" is not available to be selected as a column value in this view.-Cause- This is the current system behaviour.-This field Product Category Description" is not selectable via Adaptation / Personalisation mode when in the view "Open Tasks".-This field is available in the views such as "All Purchase Requests" in the Purchase Requests view.-Resolution-Should you need any new enhancement added to the software, feel free to directly submit your request for this feature to the correct decision makers at SAP via Customer Influence.- The Customer Influence site, https://influence.sap.com , allows customers to log Improvement Requests themselves and have the ability to work directly with our technology and development group.-Keywords- Product Category Description, Adaptation Mode, Personalisation Mode, Purchase Requests, Open Tasks.

Title: Different Price Component displayed on Custom Template Vs Standard Template.
Content: Symptom-User has Changed Tax Price Components, but it is displaying different in Custom Vs Standard Template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center.-Open the Sales Quotes view.-Choose Particular Sales Quote. -Open the Document & Preview it.-This will display custom template 'Quote' for Country United States and Language English_GB which was created by the User. The Price Components will be displayed as follows:-Total Item Gross Value -Gross Overall Discount (%) -Net Total Value -Gross Total -Now, click on You Can Also > Edit Output Settings.-Change the language to English.-Click on the Template Name 'Quote' to generate a new preview.-This will display standard template 'Quote' for Country United States and Language English which is a standard template created by SAP. The Price Components will be displayed as follows:-Total (Taxes incl.)-Discount (%)-State sales tax (%) -Amount (w/o taxes)-Cause- This is System Standard Behaviour.-Resolution-The Translations implemented in the Language Adaptation Tool (LAT) will not be transferred to Form Template, more specifically any static texts in Forms are solely derived from the respective Form Template implemented for the dedicated language, not from LAT.-This corresponds to a published limitation on the use of LAT which is aimed at implicitly enabling system translation for end user related texts for the frontend / UI. Only dynamic form content like values that have a language dependency may potentially be derived from LAT but this is not generically warranted but highly dependent on the form and the form message type assembly for the respective form and for dynamic form content, generic LAT support in custom language is not provided.-Thus for this specific use case, please review the Form Templates that you have created for the object and the different language settings and verify that your language versions contain the desired (static) form content.-Keywords-Price Component,Language Adaptation Tool,Translations,Sales Quote,custom template.

Title: Cannot Post Intercompany Supplier Invoice Due to Error Message
Content: Symptom-You have released the customer invoice through internal EDX and system creates an intercompany supplier invoices in exception. -Error:-Item: Account assignment data missing for item; see Cost Distribution-Item: Purchase document ID canceled (KBA: 1577279)-Warning:-Item: The delivery note is not found. The delivery note does not exist or is inactive, or the supplier, buying company, product, product category, or product type in the delivery note differs from that in the supplier invoice.-Environment--SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice -Select Edit and click on Check button-Error appears-Cause-In the Purchase Order document, the Invoice Expected check box is not selected and hence invoice is not relevant. As a result, system shows the error message. -Resolution-Since this is an intercompany scenario, system created the supplier invoice automatically from customer invoice due to internal EDX settings. Since you do not expect the supplier invoice, you can void the supplier invoice. -Keywords-Account assignment data missing for item; see Cost Distribution;-Purchase document ID canceled; -Inter-company supplier invoice not relevant

Title: Merge Failed Error Message: Check for current merge of another project in the merge report of a change project or Solution profile XYZ is locked by ABC
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Error Message: Check for current merge of another project in the merge report of a change project.-SLG1 Logs:-"Solution profile XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX is locked by YYYYYY"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the concerned project.-Select the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Go-Live tab.-Select and Confirm the Merge Changes to Production System activity.-The issue is also faced while simulating the merge of the project.-Cause-Initial Implement is the project once which is set as main workspace in the backend(BCTADM) & in SPC.-Resolution-Before you do anything perform the below checks:-Check which is the current workspace, if it is the different than the one which customer is trying to merge, proceed to next step-Validate the workspace ID which is displayed in the Merge Report-Check SM12 lock entries with the User which is given in the Merge Report-Check the SLG1 logs if it has the below error "Solution profile XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX is locked by YYYYYY" please follow the below steps to fix the backend inconsistency -If all above meet, please follow the below steps to fix the issue:-Go to BCTADM-Navigate to Advance Deploy tab-Select the Project which is marked as Main Workspace (in this case Initial Implement 00163E373C121ED7A3AFADD832DA3D54)-Check "Activate NW * and "Synchronize RTLC Scope", deselect "Trigger After Deployment Exits" and check "Bypass Upgrade"-Click on Execute-Now try to simulate the Merge, Simulation should be successful without any issues.-You can follow the below steps to simulate the Merge:-Go to Business Configuration-Click on Project Title-Click on Action-Click on Simualate Merge-Click on Start Smiluation-See Also- 1989529 - Error: Check for Current Merge of Another Project During Merge of a Change Project-1846200 - Central Case Document for Issues Related to Merge Failed While Merging a Change Project-Keywords-Merge Failed, Merge of another project, Merge Report, Solution profile XYZ is locked by ABC

Title: Error Message in Shopping Cart - Unable to convert DEF and PQR currencies; non-convertible currencies
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Error Message in Shopping Cart - Unable to convert DEF and PQR currencies; non-convertible currencies-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Self-Services view.-Go to the Self-Services Overview sub view.-Select the Go Shopping or Go Shopping (Advanced) link under the Shopping section.-In Step 1, Select Products enter some values.-Error -Unable to convert DEF and PQR currencies; non-convertible currencies(DEF refers to source currency and PQR refers to the Target Currency)-Cause-You need to maintain the currency exchange rates for DEF and PQR currencies-Resolution-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Edit Exchange Rates in common tasks.-Where you can see for currency rates for DEF and PQR currencies are not maintained.-Add a Row and maintain the exchange rates for both the source and the target currencies

Title: Main Contact name of Suppliers is Not Displayed Correctly
Content: Symptom-While accessing to Main Contact name column for Suppliers, you find some of them are displayed as Last Name + First Name, but the others are First Name + Last Name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-> Suppliers view.-You will see in Main Contact column, some of the name are displayed as Last Name + First Name, but the others are First Name + Last Name. -Cause-You have maintained a name format for specific country, but the Country/Region is not maintained for the contacts.-Resolution-For contact person you can maintain either main personal address or you can go to additional name fields and enter the country under country/region for name formatting.-See Also- 2197664 - Employee Name Shows in Different Format in Expense Report-Keywords-Main Contact, Name Format, Supplier

Title: Manual Price Entered in the Project Purchase Request Does not Transferred to Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You have entered a manual price in project purchase request. Manual price did not transfer to purchase request document on procurement side.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Project Management work center-Go to the Projects view-Select the relevant Project and select Edit-Navigate to Products tab and select Create Purchase Request For released tasks-Enter Price manully -Select Submit button-System creates a purchase request however, manual price is not transferred-Cause-The manual price entered in the project purchase request is not taken over to the purchase request.-Resolution-From purchasing point of view, system does not respect the manual price and hence the price from project side is not transferred. You can maintain the List Price or check with your partners if they can achieve this via add-on. You can also post the idea in influence forum; please vote for this request.-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/idea/211410/?section=sectionComments-Keywords-Manual price from project not flows in to purchase request; Price in project purchase request not taken over

Title: Error: wsrm:The value of wsrm:Identifier is not a known Sequence identifier in Health Check Incident
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-This KBA will help you when you get the Health Check Incidents with the Error Short Text: wsrm:The value of wsrm:Identifier is not a known Sequence identifier.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-When a Message got stuck in the system due to Maintenance activity of system.-Resolution-Run report 'SRT_WSRM_RECREATE_SEQ' with Stuck message ID with simulate button not checked and restart message.-Go to SE 38-Enter the Program “SRT_WSRM_RECREATE_SEQ'”-Click on Execute-Enter the Message ID from the health check incident-Uncheck the Simulate Re-creation-Click on Execute-This report would recreate the WSRM sequence.-Once you execute the report, follow the below steps to restart the message:-Go to SRT_MONI-Search with the Message ID-Select the Message row-Click on Actions & Restart the message-This should deliver the message without any issues.-This will deliver the message successfully.-See Also- Incident: 29733 / 2022-Keywords-Identifier is not a known Sequence identifier, SoftwareProblemReportingExternalRequestingOut, SRT_WSRM_RECREATE_SEQ.

Title: Delete Receiving Inspection Document
Content: Symptom-You want to delete a Receiving Inspection for an inbound process.  -Reproducing the Issue-Go to Quality Control work center. -Navigate to the Monitoring view and choose the Inspections sub-view. -Search for the relevant inspection and choose the Edit button. -You do not see an option to delete the relevant inspection. -Cause-There is no option to delete a receiving inspection. -The only option you have is to either Accept or Reject the inspection. -Making the above changes in an inspection will not affect the stock which you have already received via the supplier delivery against which the inspection was created. -Resolution-Please follow below given steps to either accept or reject a receiving inspection. -Go to Quality Control work center. -Navigate to the Monitoring view and choose the Inspections sub-view. -Search for the relevant inspection and choose the Edit button. -Navigate to the Decisions tab -Choose the drop down against the field Quantity Decision. -You can choose to Accept or Reject the inspection by choosing the appropriate value from the drop down menu. -Choose the Save button.

Title: Error: " G/L account <A-XYZ> of type Other Current Assets is not allowed" in Web Service ManageJournalEntryIn
Content: Symptom-You are processing a payload in web service ManageJournalEntryIn of Business Transaction Type 'Customer Credit Memo'. -The account determination is defined as <GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode>A-XYZ</GeneralLedgerAccountAliasCode> - representing a G/L account of type OASSET - Other assets. -When executing the payload you receive the error: -" G/L account <A-XYZ> of type Other Current Assets is not allowed"-Cause-In this web service scenario strictly the provision of a G/L account of type REVGAN - Revenues or gains is expected. -Resolution-Define an Account Determination Group (ADG), e.g. A-ABC under: -In the Business Configuration find the  Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination Fine Tune activity.-Select Account Determination Groups.-Under General Ledger select Groups for Other Income.-In order to assign G/L Accounts navigate to Account Determination in the same Fine Tune activity. -For the respective Account Determination Profile(s) select Subledger: Sales.-Match a suitable G/L Account of type REVGAN - Revenues or gains under tab Other Income.

Title: After Sales Order is Approved, the ATP is Retriggerred Again
Content: Symptom-You find that after a sales ordre is approved, system automatically creates changes on ATP related fields.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the sales orders work center view.-Open the sales order ABC.-Go to the Changes tab, you can find a change made just after the order was approved. The changes are about: Item fulfillment, ATP, Quantity, UoM, Party ID and Delivery Date.-Cause-You would note that the Question "Do you want to confirm quantities and requested dates by initiating an availability check in the sales order?" is scoped.-Therefore once the SO is approved, the ATP would be triggered.-Resolution- It is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order; Change Log; ATP

Title: How To Cancel the Erroneous Goods and Services Receipt (GSR) Against Service Agent
Content: Symptom-You recorded times against the wrong project task or the wrong purchase order (PO) in the time sheet for a service agent.-Now you want to cancel the erroneous goods and services receipt (GSR) however you cannot cancel the GSR in the work center Goods and Services Receipts. Furthermore you cannot delete the corresponding time entry in the time sheet of the service agent.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You cannot cancel the GSR:-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center.-Go to the Receipts and Returns view.-Mark the relevant GSR and choose Cancel Document.-Choose Cancel Goods and Services Receipt.-You get the information that the GSR was created via Time and labor Management (TLM) and must be canceled there.-You cannot delete the time entry:-Go to the Project Management work center.-Go to the Resources view.-Go to the Service Agents subview.-Mark the relevant service agent and choose Edit Time Sheet.-Navigate to the relevant calendar week and mark the relevant time entry.-The Remove button is grayed out and you cannot delete the wrong time entry.-While cancelling/deleting the employee time from backend error is thrown "No further time confirmation possible for purchase order. It could be because the purchase order has the status Completely Delivered, Canceled, or Finished. Contact your purchasing dept."-Cause-You cannot delete the user's time entry from the front end.-Resolution-Steps to find Project-Go to Purchase order-search and open particular purchase order-navigate to Document Flow tab-Open Sales Order-Under Sales Order, Project name will be available.-You need to change the status of the project back to released to allow the cancellation of corresponding employee time via backend to go through.Follow the below steps :-1. Go to Project-2. Change status to Revoke Closure => Status will be changed to Completed-3. Again change status to Revoke Completion => Status will be changed to Released-4. Remove the Time recording. (System should not throw the error).-5. Change the status of the project back to completed if required.-See Also-1582050 - How To Change Times Recorded on Wrong Project Task or Wrong Purchase Order.-Keywords- cancel the GSR, delete the time entry, cancelling/deleting the employee time from backend

Title: Error: 'No time agreement exists for employee' when trying to save project time recordings via excel
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-When trying to save the time recordings on a project via excel upload, the excel add-in throws the following error "No time agreement exists for employee".-This issue is related to a service agent and former employee, for whom the Edit Time Sheet button is grayed out in the Business Partner Data work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Make sure that the Excel Add-in is successfully installed-Open Excel template and fill the data. -Click button Save Data To...-Excel Add-in throws error 'No time agreement exists for employee'.-Cause-There were no time recordings when the user was hired as a Service agent. Later the user got hired as an internal employee and performed some time recordings. The then employee was terminated.-Since there are no time recordings when the user was a service agent, Edit Timesheet button is disabled-Resolution-A possible workaround for this scenario might be the following:-Re-create the service agent and ignore as a duplicate, then try again.-See Also-KBA:  1404035 - Error 'No time agreement exists for employee' when Trying to Save Time Recordings via Excel Add-in for a Project-Keywords-try, attempt, does not work, unable, not able, not possible

Title: Error: 'Action not possible for payment ABC; check status of payment batch PQR' while cancelling payment
Content: Symptom-You would like to cancel payment ABC(ABC refers to payment), but gets the error message: Action not possible for payment; check status of payment batch PQR(PQR refers to payment batch)-When the related payment batch is checked, its canceled but the payment is till "In Transit".-You can not change anything, since the actions button is greyed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center-Select Payment Batches and search for the batch in question. The Status: Canceled and its respective payment which is still 'In Transfer'-Cause-One of the possible errors is when This specific payment is a tax due payment initiated from tax management work center.-Ideally the issue happens when the customer has been changing the status from ready for transfer to in transfer and back frequently.-Resolution-Kindly create a case for SAP so we can set the payment to ready for transfer from our end. Then you can go to the tax payments view in tax management work center and trigger the cancellation.-Keywords-Payment batch, tax payment

Title: Exception Occurs While Posting the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-Exception occurs while posting the supplier invoice. -Error - Item 1: Item amount greater than limit XYZ EUR of purchase order ABC-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to the Exceptions tab-Error is visible-Cause-Supplier invoice contains Price Variance exception.  For Price Variance exception, you have defined the Exception Criteria as - Variance Higher Than (Percentage) % AND Variance Higher Than (Net Amount) XYZ EUR. Since the variance is greater than % and XYZ EUR, system has created the exception. -Resolution-If you want to post supplier invoice for higher net amount, you can accept the exception and post the invoice.-To do so, you can follow the below steps;-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit and navigate to the Exceptions tab-Select the button Accept Price Variance button -Then invoice will be in Ready for posting status. -See Also-3242946 - Error Message - Credit memo has an exception suggesting that the credit amount is greater than invoiced order amount or limit however this is not the case and invoice  appears to be identical.-1642296 - Credit value greater than invoiced order value or limit-Keywords-Item 1: Item amount greater than limit of purchase order; Price variance exception

Title: Open Purchase orders not Picked in the Goods and Services Receipts Run
Content: Symptom-The Goods and Services Receipts Run is not picking up a few open purchase orders in the run-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts work center-Go to the Goods and Services Receipts Run view -Select the Active Goods and Services Receipts Runs-Select the relevant Run ID and select Schedule-Go to the Receipts and Returns view-Select Show by Documents-You cannot find the Goods and Services Receipts created based on run-Cause-The Automatic Good and Services Receipts is not enabled in the Purchase Order Items tab and further navigated to the Basic data Tab in the under Follow-up Documents-Resolution-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders workcenter-Purchase orders-Select the relevant Purchase order Items tab and-Further Navigate to the Basic data Tab under Follow-up Documents-Now, go to the Adaptation mode and Publish this and execute the GSR run again-Keywords-GSR run, open purchase orders

Title: VAT return preview shows only one row inspite of multiple line items when logged into Italian language
Content: Symptom-You login to IT language and preview a Tax return. It shows only one row even though multiple tax line items are available. The same can be seen when logged in EN language-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center-Select VAT Returns view and search for Relevant ID and open it-Hit preview to see the VAT details-When logged in English, all the line items are displayed, but only one is displayed when logged in IT language-Cause-Generally the issue happens due to missing description of custom tax code(starts with Z) in language that the form is being previewed in. Here in this case its IT.-Specifically for the issues raised by customer, tax code description for custom tax code is missing when logged via Italian language while the same is present in english.-Resolution-The missing description has to be maintained in IT language as well, this can be done by logging in IT language and then enter the Missing Custom Tax code description-Keywords-VAT return Preview, IT, Custom Tax Code

Title: Duplicated Supplier Account Records in Supplier Accounts Screen
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You notice a Supplier PQR (PQR refers to supplier account) is showing 2 separate lines with same company and account determination group (ADG) ID and not sure why this is happened.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center.-Select the Supplier Accounts View.-Choose the Supplier PQR.-You notice 2 lines for PQR with same Company Code, ADG.-Cause-Database inconsistency where data is not reflected properly in UI from backend.-Resolution-This issue needs an FSI reload.-Request a support user with L6 access level (SAP_SUPPORT_L6).-Open the Backend.-Enter transaction 'gfsstm' and press Enter.-Under Business Object maintain 'FOPXD_TRPACCT' and press Execute.-Scroll down on the left under 'Fast Search Views' until you can see the node 'FSP_FIN_TRPACCT'.-Expand this node by clicking on the arrow on the left.-Select all the sub-nodes. -At the top of the screen Load, check the Number on the right side. -If the number of records to be reloaded are too high, consult with a FIN senior member or PL/EACs from FIN to decide on the best approach (customer communication, timeline assessment, Ops involvement, etc). Depending on the case, the reload may take days to complete. Always remember that while the reload is being done, data becomes unavailable in the UI and other applications depending on such BO cannot be used as well, which can cause a severe business disruption in the customer system.-Click on Persistence and Press Yes.-Press Refresh until you see the changes are applied.-Go to the UI.-When you open now the Trade Payables tab in the Supplier Account Monitor you can see no duplicated records.-Keywords-Duplicate records, FSI Reload, FOPXD_TRPACCT, FSP_FIN_TRPACCT, GFSSTM

Title: No items relevant for clearing run during clearing run for customer account XYZ
Content: Symptom-You create a new Clearing Run and expect Downpayment and Invoice gets cleared, however below message is seen.-'No items relevant for clearing run during clearing run for customer account XYZ(XYZ refers to customer account)'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Receivables work center-Clearing Runs view-Select the relevant Run ID and open the application log to see the message-Cause-In case of  Automatic Clearing, Down payment won't be cleared against Invoices as this is a standard behaviour of Clearing Run.-Resolution-Manual clearing should be performed to clear invoice with downpayment-Keywords-Clearing Run, Downpayment, Invoice

Title: Some Functional Areas Invisible in Selection of Financial Reporting Structure with Structure Type Income Statement by Function of Expense
Content: Symptom-Some functional areas are missing in the list when you try to assign them in reporting structure of Income Statement.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination activity.-Click on Edit financial reporting structures.-Edit the financial reporting structure in question.-Select the element in question and then click on Actions->Assign Functional Areas, but you cannot see all the functional areas in the list.-Cause-Only the functional areas not already in use in the financial reporting structure can be assigned.-However, it might also happen that the respective Financial Reporting Structure got corrupted. In this case, even if a given functional area is not assigned in the structure, it might not show up for selection.-Resolution-You can create a new functional area to be assigned in reporting structure or remove the current assignment of functional areas.-In case of corruption of the financial reporting structure, please delete it and build it again from scratch, copying a working one, or using one of the pre-delivered templates.-See Also-You can also refer to the help documents below:-Functional Areas-Settings for Income Statements by Function of Expense and Earned Profit Analysis – Configuration Guide-Income Statement by Function of Expense-Edit Functional Area Determination-Keywords-Functional Area, Reporting Structure, Income Statement, Expense of Function, 功能范围，报告结构

Title: Unable to Assign Organizaion Unit to Employee Due to Error
Content: Symptom-Unable to assign org unit to Employee throws as a below error:--Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a Permanent Estb-Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a company-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Partner data Work Center-Go to Employee view-Search for Employee-Unable to assign the required org unit to the employee-It Throws the following error "Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a Permanent Estb" "Organizational unit must be or must be assigned to a company"-Cause- You have maintained the validity end date of org unit as '31.12.9999'  ( Here 31.12.9999 is a date format)-Resolution-Change the validity end date for organizational unit to 'Unlimited' from '31.12.9999'.-Keywords-Permanent Estb, Organizational unit

Title: What are support Issues, What is Consulting: SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-This KBA is intended to clarify what constitutes a supportable case opposed to a Consulting inquiry for SAP Cloud Solutions.  Additionally, options for issues considered as Consulting Inquiries are provided. For on premise solutions please refer to SAP Note  83020 What is Support – What is Consulting: On Premise solutions.-Support Issues-SAP Support agrees to handle problem cases in accordance with Cloud maintenance agreements in the following scenarios:-There is an error in the software or SAP provided Best Practice configuration or with expert configuration done by SAP as requested by the customer;-An error in the software causes subsequent errors or SAP provided Best Practice configuration causes subsequent errors;-standard product functions have incorrect or missing documentation.-If the occurring problem falls into one of these above-mentioned categories, you must open a problem case under the relevant component (or via appropriate SAP Support channels where applicable) to initiate the Support process.-Consulting Issues-The following cases are classified as consulting requests and should not be raised via a Support case.-This includes inquiries concerning:-Advice or assistance relating to configuration, business process analysis, or implementation specific to the customer’s unique environment or already documented in Product Guides-‘How-To’ questions seeking assistance with documented features-Assistance with customization of the core product, core functionality and/or problems or errors caused by customization that has been implemented or completed by customers or partners-For help with configuration, how-to, and implementation issues, please visit the appropriate self-service resources listed below. Alternately, speak with your Account Executive or Customer Engagement Executive about Professional Services options or about engaging an SAP Authorized Partner.-Note that consulting requests are priced separately at the discretion of SAP unless otherwise specified in your maintenance contract.-In addition, all customers that have a valid SAP Enterprise Support Cloud Edition contract are entitled to the additional Empowerment, Innovation and Value Realization services from SAP as part of their maintenance contract as found under the following link: https://assets.cdn.sap.com/agreements/product-use-and-support-terms/cls/en/support-policy-for-sap-cloud-services-english-v2-2017.pdf-See for Reference-2577546   Frequently Asked Questions - SAP Support Expert Chat - SAP Cloud for Customer-2482688  *** MASTER KBA *** Schedule an Expert-2171560  How to be notified of new or updated SAP Notes or KBAs in the ONE Support Launchpad-0067739  Priority of problem cases-Customer Influence - To submit enhancement requests for SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Service Cloud-SAP ByD Community - Blog about your experiences with Cloud for Customer, ask questions, and hear directly from the product team about the latest and greatest with SAP Cloud for Customer.-Support By product Page - To access the FAQ documents and recommended contents-End User & Key User Guide-Cloud Availability Center (CAC) - offers you a personalized dashboard with focus on relevant information about your cloud product availability and maintenance-SAP Business ByDesign Help Portal - Help Portal provides you with all the information you need to start using SAP Business ByDesign

Title: How to Update the Confirmation Method to Blank in Bill of Operations
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to change the setting for confirmation method from default backfulsh to blank in Production Bill of Operations.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production and Planning Master data work center-Select Production Bill of Operation view-Select the required ID and click on edit-Under Structure tab, select required operation via Insert, Make and add activity as per your business-Under Activity Details tab, The Confirmation Method is set to Backflush by default.-Cause-It is not possibe to keep the setting for cofirmation method as blank.
