Title: Defaults of Valuation View XYZ Missing in Fine Tuning of Asset Class DEF
Content: Symptom-You are trying to extend the validity of the assignment interval for fixed asset AAA (AAA represents the Fixed Asset ID), or you are trying to post a Goods and Service Receipt and you are getting the following error message:-'Defaults of Valuation View XYZ Missing in Fine Tuning of Asset Class DEF'.-(XYZ represents the Valuation View)-(DEF represents the Asset Class number)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center. -Go to Source Documents subview. -Select Unposted Source Documents.  -Search for Document ID: 123 (123 represents the Document ID).-You will see the following error message: -'Defaults of Valuation View XYZ Missing in Fine Tuning of Asset Class DEF'.-Cause-The issue happens because you didn't maintain the Valuation View XYZ in Asset Class DEF. You can check this configuration by following the steps below:-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Go to Overview view. -Search for activity: Fixed asset classes.-Select "Edit fixed asset classes" option.-Select the Asset Class: DEF.-In Default Valuation Settings you will see that there is no Valuation View XYZ. -Resolution-Expected system behavior.-You should maintain the Valuation View in the Asset class according to the steps mentioned above.-Keywords- Fixed Asset; Valuation View; Asset Class; Business Transaction; fixed asset classes;

Title: Dump Occurs While Releasing a Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have created a Customer Invoice and when you try to release it you receive a dump: '500 SAP Internal Server Error - ERROR: The application running deliberately caused an abort with short dump.'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and enter ABC in the Search field (ABC represents the ID of the Customer Invoice).-Select the line for Customer Invoice ABC and click on Release button.-A dump occurs: '500 SAP Internal Server Error - ERROR: The application running deliberately caused an abort with short dump.'-Cause-The error occurs because the output is set as XML in the Customer Invoice but no Communication Arrangement is Active for the related Account.-To check the output settings in the customer invoice:-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Show All Invoice Documents and enter ABC in the Search field.-Click on Edit.-Click on You Can Also button > Edit Output Settings.-You can see the output is set as XML.-Resolution-Check the output settings in the account master data:-Go to the Accounts work center and view.-Select All Accounts and Search for Account DEF (DEF represents the ID of the account) corresponding to the Invoice ABC.-Go to the Communication tab and Collaboration sub tab.-You can see the output channel for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo is set to XML.-If you do not want to use XML you need to change the output channel for Customer Invoice / Credit Memo to Printer or E-Mail and then you will be able to release the document.-Check the status of the related Communication Arrangement:-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Choose the Input and Output Management view, and Communication Arrangements sub view.-Here you can see the Output of Customer Invoices Communication Scenario is not maintained for Communication Partner DEF or it is not Active.-If you want to use the output channel XML then the Communication Arrangement needs to be set up and have the status Active for the account DEF for Output Customer Invoices Communication Scenario.-In case there is already an existing Communication Arrangement and you still get the dump, we would recommend that you delete and create again the same Communication Arrangement. After that, you should try to release the invoice again.-Keywords-termination, exception, RABAX_STATE, validation, communication arrangement, output, XML, facture client, accord de communication; CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL:"Local Shortcut Call Failed;TRIGGER_SHORT_DUMP, Customer Invoice, Dump, Release, Error, 500 SAP Internal Server Error

Title: Set Postal Address field as Mandatory is not working as expected
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set Postal Address field as Mandatory under Supplier work center, however field is not set as Mandatory.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-Go to Suppliers-Open any suppliers-Click on View All-Navigate to General Tab -> Main Address-You see Region is mandatory field, however when you click on Additional Fields link and look for the Region field it is not mandatory-However when you perform the same steps in the adaptation mode it displays the Region field as mandatory. -Cause-The behavior seems to be standard, means main address screen fields are dynamic with respect to country selected.-Resolution-Ex: For postal addresses in France the "state" or "region" is not required, therefore our address UI for France the field is not mandatory.-Even if you set the field as mandatory, it will not display as mandatory, however when you enter value to it, it will display it as Mandatory field as shown in the screenshot-           Due to technical restriction, it is not possible to make the field mandatory via UI adaptation/personalization.-It will be possible to make the field mandatory via SDK / Cloud Application Studio by performing additional validations on SAVE.-Keywords-Postal Address, Addaptation Mode, Mandatory Field, General Data

Title: Custom Discount List or Price List Does Not Appear in the Discount List OWL
Content: Symptom-You created a Custom Discount List or a Custom Price List but you are not able to see the newly created discount list/price list in the OWL (Object Work List) or it appears under multiple Discount or Price Lists types.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The issue applies for both Discount and Price Lists. We will use Discount Lists as an example. -Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Discount List view.-In the Show field select CDL (CDL represents the description of you custom discount list).-Click on the New button and create Discount List XYZ (XYZ represents the newly created discount list).-Enter all respective data and Save and then Release the Discount List.-Select the Advance Search and Remove the Valid from and to dates.-Click on Go-The search does not retrieve any results and you cannot see Discount List XYZ in the OWL and instead displays: No records found-Cause-The reason why the custom discount lists or price lists they are not visible in the UI under the Discount Lists or Price Lists is due to the fact that there are two pricing tables with the same key which are used in the access sequence. Both Pricing Tables have the same fields e.g the field Company. One Pricing Table is used in a Price List and the other Pricing Table  is used in the custom discount list CDL. When the system tries to query the discount lists it finds the other table and tries to retrieve an associated discount list but since the other Pricing Table is used, none is available.-Resolution-You need to ensure that you do not create duplicated Pricing Tables.-To solve the issue, you need to use the same Pricing Table in both discount list and price list and remove the duplicated Pricing Table from the Pricing Group Assignments and then also from the Access Sequence of either the respective custom price list or custom discount list. You can then create a new custom price/discount list ensuring the same Pricing Table is used in the price and discount list.-In our example you created custom Pricing Table CUSXZY (CUSXZY represents the name of the Pricing Table) with the Field Company. However, there is already a standard pricing table CUSCOMP2 with the same filed assigned.-The Pricing Table CUSCOMP2 is used in a Price List and CUSXZY is used in a Discount List on header level.-To solve the issue you need to perform the following steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Implementation Project view.-Select the Implementation project and click on Open Activity.-In the Fine Tune tab select the activity Configure Price Strategy and click on Open.-Select the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-Select the pricing group Discounts.-Select the discount list which is using the header Pricing Table CUSXZY and click Remove.-Click on Save and Close.-Select the Access Sequence hyperlink.-Select the access sequence ACH Discount List on Header Level.-Select the Pricing Table CUSXZY and click on the Remove button.-Click on the Add Row button.-Add the standard Pricing Table CUSCOMP2.-Click on Save and Close.-Select the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-Select the pricing group Discounts.-Click on Add Row.-Enter the same Description as for the Discount List you removed in step 7 and assign the header Pricing Table CUSCOMP2 and the same Item Pricing Table used in the custom discount list you removed.-Save and close.-Keywords-missing Price List; missing Discount List; Custom Price List; Pricing Table; Access Sequence; Pricing Group Assignments; Price List; missing; No records found; Discount Lists (Gross); Price Lists (Gross); no results; cannot find;

Title: Mass Change of Multiple Employee Work Address Records Results in Error
Content: Symptom-The attempt to mass change multiple Employee Workplace Address records results in a pop-up message, requesting to raise an case.-Environment-SAP Business by Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Open view Employees-Click on Show All Employees-Use Fn (Ctrl) and Shift key to select all the rows on the screen-Click on Action - > Mass Change Workplace Address-On the next screen the screen dumps and the error message is raised-Cause-The dump is occurring because there are duplicate keys being passed to the mass change UI. When selecting All Employees, the list will include terminated employees and also splits in employees work agreements.-Resolution-When selecting employees for this mass change action, it is advised not to use the All Employees view and use the Active Employees view instead.-This will prevent the duplicate key dump from occurring.-Keywords-Work address mass change Employees contact data duplicate key dump

Title: Default Company Currency is Not Expected in Invoice Volume Report
Content: Symptom-You have set up the default currency as ABC for the company X and in all your invoice documents, the currency is ABC. But when running the Invoice Volume report, system shows the amount in currency USD instead of ABC.-(ABC represents the ID of the currency, X represents the ID of the company)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to Reports view.-Open report Invoice Volume, the Display Currency defaults to Default Company Currency.-Run the report, the currency displayed is USD, instead of the expected currency ABC which is default company currency of the seller company X.-To check the default company currency:-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Select the Company X.-Go to Definitions tab.  You can see the Default Currency is set to ABC.-Cause-Company assignment is needed for every user to be able to derive a default company currency. If this is missing, then Default Currency "USD" is used. Because the login user does not assign to any company, the Default Company Currency is then USD.-Resolution-To display the desired currency, the user has to have a valid assignment in the company's organizational structure. You need to maintained the required organizational information for the user and try it again.-Keywords-Default Company Currency; Invoice Volume; Unexpected Display Currency

Title: The Outbound File Has Zero Kilobytes And You Get an Error 'File Format XYZ is Not Consistent'
Content: Symptom-You create an Outbound File but it has zero Kilobytes. It is empty also.-You expect this Outbound File to be filled with data.-In the Log File you get an Error Message: "File format APAY XYZ (where XYZ is the Payment File Structure ID) is not consistent".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Liquidity Management Work Center - Outbound Files view.-Search for all Outbound Files and enter XXX (where XXX is the Outbound File ID).-Click on the file ID XXX.-Switch to the tab Attachment.-If you click on "Display Log" you can see an Error Message: File format APAY XYZ is not consistent. -You can also see that the PayFile_YYY (where YYY is the Payment File ID) has a file size of zero Bytes. This is incorrect. You expect this file not to be empty.-Cause-In the Business Configuration Work Center under Payment File Structures(Activity: Outgoing Bank Transfers), there is a constant maintained which you need to remove.-Also the Data Source and the Operator are not matching. You need to change the Operator.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to the Overview View.-Search for Outgoing Bank Transfers and open that Activity.-Click on Edit Payment File Structures.-Select the Payment File Structure ID XYZ and press Edit.-Press Next until you get to 3 - Define Fields.-Under Records, select Footer.-Highlight ABC (where ABC is the Footer Record) and select field Conditions.-Remove the Data Source "Constant".-Then change the Operator of the Data Source Transaction Payment Amount to "greater than".-Press Save and Confirm.-After you have done these steps create a new Payment File. This solves the issue.-Keywords-Payment File empty, zero kilobytes, zero, Business Configuration Payment File Structure, File Format is Not Consistent, Data Source, Operator, Constant, Zahllauf, Zahlungsdatei leer

Title: Translation Error In The Standard System - What To Do?
Content: Symptom-You have identified a translation error for a standard description in your SAP Cloud For Customer or SAP Business ByDesign system, or in our Help Documentation.-You would like to know how to proceed.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign System-SAP Help Portal-Resolution-When you find such an error, please open an case with SAP Cloud Product Support.-Please provide us with the following information:-A screenshot of the full screen where the translation mistake can be found.-Steps to navigate to the screen. For example: work centre and view with added steps to find the translation error. Or, in the Cloud for Customer Administration Guide, open the document ABC (ABC represents the document name) and find the error in section DEF (DEF represents the section name).-Specify what the translation error is.-Please provide us with the translation that you consider wrong, as well as with the description you consider correct.-SAP Cloud Product Support will contact the responsible translation team with the request to correct the system.-See Also-SAP Cloud for Customer System and Software Requirements: Languages Supported-Keywords-Translation issue, Übersetzung, Fehler

Title: Product Category Cannot Be Changed for Material
Content: Symptom-You have created a material however you are unable to select Product Category as the field is locked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Click on By Materials View.-Select the Product.-Click on Edit.-Here you can see that the Product Category field is locked.-Cause-The product category cannot be changed if the material was set as a template material.-Resolution-The system works as expected.-In order to revert the scenario, you can set any other material with the same category as template. To proceed, you can follow the below steps:-Go to Product Data work center.-Select Material Templates view.-Create a new product category.-Set that as material template and remove the original product category ID as material template.- Keywords-Product, Template-product category, material template

Title: Unable to Edit the Bank Charge Field in the New Outgoing Bank Transfer
Content: Symptom-You are unable to edit the Bank Charge field in a New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Click on New Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Navigate to the Overview.-Under Payee Data section, notice that the Bank Charge field is non-editable.-Cause-The Bank Charge field is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign for all the countries and currently it can be configured only for the country: Japan-Resolution-As a workaround you can use the option Payment Different Reason Code = Bank Charges.-You can accordingly enter the Additional Credits and Discounts.-You can use this option when creating payments for invoices etc.,inclusive of the taxes. In that way, you can differentiate the tax-amount from the net amount-Also, in case you have to enter additional bank charges amount such as bank processing fees, taxes, etc. you can add the charges in Bank Charges Amount column in the third step of creating New Bank Statement.-Keywords-Bank Charge, Outgoing bank transfer

Title: Dump when opening the Price List view in the Product and Service Portfolio work center
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL ONLY***-A dump occurs when opening the Price List view in the Product and Service Portfolio work center:-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Select the Price List view.-The following dump occurs in backend transaction ST22:-CX_CTE_CUSTOMIZING, Program:CL_CTE_CUSTOMIZING_ENGINE=====CP, Include:CL_CTE_CUSTOMIZING_ENGINE=====CM005, Position:10-Info: Condition Table SAPPR001 for application CDT usage PL missing-or-CX_CTE_CUSTOMIZING, Program:CL_CTE_CUSTOMIZING_ENGINE=====CP, Include:CL_CTE_CUSTOMIZING_ENGINE=====CM005, Position:10-Info: Condition Table CUSHEADER for application CDT usage PL missing-(CUSHEADER is the name of the Pricing Table)-Cause-There can be 2 causes:-1. You are using a Pricing Group Assignment without a valid Header Pricing Table.-2. You are using a Custom Pricing Table in the Pricing Goup Assignment which is not available in the Access Sequence.-3. The Extension Field you used in your pricing table CUSHEADER has been deleted.-Resolution-To solve 1:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Open the Fine Tuning Activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-Select the Pricing Group Prices.-You can see that one of the Pricing Group Item Assignments has no Header Pricing Table assigned.-Select this Pricing Group Item Assignments and click on the Remove button.-Save your changes.-To solve 2:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Open the Fine Tuning Activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Access Sequence hyperlink.-Select the Pricing Group Prices.-Highlight Relevence: Header Level and the respective Access Sequence.-Add the Custom Pricing Table used for the Pricing Group Assignment.-Save your changes.-To solve 3:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Open the Fine Tuning Activity Configure Price Strategy-Click on the Pricing Group Assignments hyperlink.-Select the Pricing Group Prices.-Remove the custom price list that is using the pricing table CUSHEADER. -Click Save and Close.-Click on the Access Sequence hyperlink.-Select the Pricing Group Prices.-Remove the Pricing Table CUSHEADER from the Access Sequence. -Click Save and Close.-See Also-2701341 - Dump occurs when accessing the Price List View-2729340 - Error Message in Deletion of Access Sequence-Keywords-CL_CTE_CUSTOMIZING_ENGINE; CDT; Condition Table; Custom Pricing; SAPPR001, for application CDT usage PL missing-

Title: Multiple Cost Assignment Details Does not Appear for Approver in the Approval Task for Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order with multiple account assignment deails however approver cannot see multiple cost assignment details in the approval task screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Managing My Area work center-Go to the Approvals view-Select the relevant approval task for Purchase Order -Select Edit button and system shows Multiple account assignment as Yes-Cause-Currently system does not show the multiple account assignment details for an approver in the approval task screen. The enhancement can be taken as a new requirement. You can post the idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Resolution-As a workaround, you can ask the buyer responsible to create the Note Type Approval Note and add the account assignment details for an approver. Or you can create an extension field like cost assignment 1 and 2. Then extend the field to approval task screen or Buyer responsible can take a screen shot of account assignment details & add as an attachment to the PO.-Keywords-Multiple account assignment as Yes;  approver cannot see multiple cost assignment details in the approval task screen; multiple cost assignment details

Title: Accounting Posting for the Zero Balance Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom-You have posted a supplier invoice with the zero balance and you are not clear of the journal entry posting done in the system-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Under Journal Entries view select Journal Entries.-Search with the Source Document of your supplier invoice and click the corresponding Journal Entry ID.-Sample-Foreign exch. gains 0 debit-Goods Rcvd/Invoice Rcvd - not yet delivered 0 debit.- Cause-In the case of a zero value invoice, there's no due item created. Because of this, system offset against the miscellaneous ledger.-Resolution-We have specific logic for this in which if there's no due item, we set the miscellaneous ledger as the offset ledger, and we post into whatever account is maintained for foreign currency rounding differences. The balance in this account never actually changes, but we need to have something here when there's no due lines. So this is how it is handled in the system for zero value invoices.-Keywords-zero invoice posting logic, zero price, exchange rate difference,

Title: Various warnings and errors when trying to replicate employees
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When a replication is pulled through, a yellow warning message and then several error messages appear.-Warning:  'Manager ABC  missing in upload request' (where ABC represents the ID of a manager)-Error: 'Creating employee not possible; number range interval DEF missing. (KBA: 1760883)' (where DEF represents a number range )-Error: 'Initial key fields for business partner identification (KBA: 2804872)'-But it is not possible to solve the issue with the referenced KBAs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication-Go to Employees view-Click actions-Upload data from employee central.-Click Upload Data and in remote employee id, enter the related user-Press ok-Find warning:  'Manager ABC missing in upload request'-Close window and refresh table-Highlight new record pulled through-click Edit -> Replicate-Error: Creating employee not possible; number range interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_INT_01 missing. (KBA: 1760883)-Error: Initial key fields for business partner identification (KBA: 2804872)-Cause-Since there is already a replication request for that employee which is processed successfully, the External ID must be filled-Resolution-Select the replication request for the related employee-Go to Edit-Find Remote System Instance ID and  Remote Business Partner ID-Now, go to Master Data Replication work center-Edit ID Mapping for Integration-Select Mapping of Business Partner for the same combination of Business Partner ID and System Instance ID -Click on Go-External ID is blank, it should be same as of i.e. Remote Business Partner ID-Manually maintain this external ID following below path and it will work.-NOTE: These steps should be followed only when there is already a replication request for that employee which is processed successfully. If this is the first time that employee is being created through replication then these steps are not needed.-See Also-KBA:   1760883 - Error Message: "Creating Employee not possible; number range interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_EXT_01 missing"-KBA:   2804872 - Error "Initial key fields for business partner identification" occurrs when migrating employee data-Keywords-upload, request, not possible, fails, does not work, successful,

Title: Unable to Change User ID of Communication Arrangement.
Content: Symptom-User wants to change the User ID which is mapped to a communication arrangement to update services.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Workcenter.-Navigate to Input and Output Management view and choose Communication arrangements view-Select and click to Open Communication arrangement-Choose "View All"-Navigate to 'Technical Data' Tab-Unable to Edit "User ID"-Cause-This is expected system behavior.-Resolution-Once communication arrangement is mapped with a User ID, customer cannot change it.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-User ID grayed out, unable to edit user ID, communication arrangement

Title: Unable to Find Line Item of UoM Characteristics of the Material Master Data to read/update GTIN
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom solution and extended the Material master Business Object to read/update the GTIN element for each line item of the UoM Characteristics tab.-But you are unable to find the required Item Node, which allows you to Read/Insert a value into the GTIN field for each line item where UoM is not NULL.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data workcente-Search ProductID-Edit and View All-Go to UoM Characteristics tab-You can see Line Item GTIN-Loop through the Unit of Measure Characteristics tab in the Material Master-The field GTIN (GlobalTradeItemNumber) is not available to be inserted under any of the Nodes-EndLoop-  Cause- You are using incorrect node.-Resolution-To consume GTIN standard field, you need to loop over GLOBAL_TRADE_ITEM_NUMBER node instead of Unit of Measure Characteristics tab because in the backend the GTIN is present in that node and not in UoM Characteristics tab node.-Keywords-GTIN, GLOBAL_TRADE_ITEM_NUMBER, UoM

Title: Workflow Rule E-Mail is Not Sent to the Processor
Content: Symptom-You created a Workflow Rule for example for the Business Object Sales Order with the Type E-Mail and maintained the Recipient Determination as Processor, but the Employee Responsible does not receive the E-Mail.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center. -Select the Workflow Rules view. -Open the Rule ABC (ABC represents the description of the rule).-Navigate to the Define Actions step. -You selected the Rule Type E-Mail maintained all the relevant data and entered in the Recipient Determination the determination Processor. -Since in our example we are using a Workflow Rule for the Business Object Sales Order you expect that the E-Mail is set to the E-Mail Address of the Employee Responsible in the Sales Order if the Sales Order is created/changed and the parameters set up in the rule are met.-However, the Employee Responsible does not receive the E-Mail eventhough the Employee has a valid E-Mail Address maintained.-Cause-The Business User of the Employee Responsible is not valid.-Resolution-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Select the Business User view-Search for the respective user.-Ensure that the user is valid.-Keywords-Workflow Rule; E-Mail; Recipient; not received; not sent

Title: Error Message: Posting Not Possible; Acq. Cost of Indiv. Mat. Less than Transf. Amnt
Content: Symptom-You are unable to perform the Manual Posting - Partial Transfer of Individual Material due to the error "Posting not possible; acq. cost of indiv. mat. less than transf. amnt".-However, you check the net book value of this asset and find that it is higher than the amount entered.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Under Fixed Assets select Fixed Assets View.-Select the Asset > Manual Posting > Partial Transfer of Individual Material.-Relating to: 1 - Current Year.-Fill all mandatory fields and click post.-Cause-On the entered posting date, relating to the current year, the book value of the asset is lower than what is to be transferred whereas the net book value of the asset was higher than the amount to be transferred in previous years.-For instance if you have selected a posting date of DDMMYY in the current year, you need to check on this particular date what is the net value of the asset in the current year. You can follow the steps below to verify the postings with the Fixed Assets – Line Items report.-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Reports > Lists > Fixed Assets - Line Items.-Fill the required details for your source assets and click Go.-Filters only the journal entries of the current year.-With this you can see the acquisition costs posted in the current fiscal year.-This is the maximum amount that can be transferred in the current year.-Resolution-This is standard system behaviour.-If the net book value of the fixed asset in previous years was higher than the value to be transferred you can choose the option Relating to: 2 – Previous Year’.-To verify the net book value in previous years check the fixed assets – line items report. Exclude all postings in the current year. This way, you only see the acquisition cost posted in previous years. This is the maximum amount that can be transferred relating to previous years.-See Also-KBA 2610839 - Posting Not Possible; Acq. Cost of Indiv. Mat. Less than Transf. Amnt-Keywords-Fixed Asset; Partial Transfer of Individual Material; Net Book Value; Acquisition Cost

Title: Unable To Modify The Outgoing Check in Form Template
Content: Symptom-You want to edit or view a form template using Easy Form Editor but you are unable to get Adobe LiveCycle Designer or use the Easy Form Editor.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center-Go to Business Flexibility View-Select Form Template Maintenance sub view-Select the form template that you want to change-Choose Open button.-Unable to edit the content-Cause-There could be below reasons for this issue:---For some form templates, system does not allow editing the form using Easy Form Editor due to the heavy customizations.-Changes using Easy Form Editor is restricted for Interactive Forms because of it's advanced features.-Resolution-Using easy form editor, user cannot edit the Master pages data.-Only option is download the respective form template and edit as per the requirement in Adobe live cycle designer.-Keywords-Outgoing Check, Form Template, Adobe Livecycle designer

Title: DFV error: Project baseline XXXX (ABCD)-YY missing in accounting
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-DFV error: Project baseline XXXX (ABCD)-YY missing in accounting-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Wc > Data Flow Verification Results view-In the drop-down box list, select Open Results With Differences-Click the Result ID link to open the log-Under Details section you will see the message: Project baseline XXXX (ABCD)-YY missing in accounting-Resolution-First you need to identify the Created on date of the message-Go to Application and User Management Wc > Process communication error-Find the message with the error and take a note of the created on date-After it, connect in the backend via STFK-Access the transaction srt_moni-In the Timestamp from enter the cretead on date -Click Execute-Restart the message-See Also-A solution is planned to be delivered to fix this issue-https://jira.sme.c.eu-de-2.cloud.sap/login.jsp?permissionViolation=true&os_destination=%2Fbrowse%2FBYDM-3127&page_caps=&user_role=-Keywords-DFV,

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate Checkbox Incorrectly Marked in Follow-Up Document
Content: Symptom-In a Follow-up document created from a Sales Quote or Service Quote, you notice that there is no Tax Exemption Certificate maintained, but the checkbox is marked regardless.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Using a Service Quote and Service Order as an example:-Go to the New Business work center.-Open the Service Quotes view.-Find Service Quote ABC (Where ABC Represents the Service Quote ID).-Open the document and click on View All.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab. -You see that no items in the Quote have a Tax Exemption Certificate maintained. If you open the Account used in the Quote, no Tax Exemption Certificate is present in the Account either.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab of Service Quote ABC.-In the Document Flow tab, open Service Order DEF (Where DEF Represents the ID of the Service Order generated as a Follow-Up from the Service Quote).-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Service and Spare Parts tab.-You see that the Tax Exemption Certificate checkbox is marked, with no Tax Exemption Certificate ID maintained.-The same is also true for subsequent documents created such as Customer Invoices.-Cause-In this scenario, this is a visual issue in the UI that does not impact the Tax Calculation process at all. It is caused by an older behaviour for Tax Countries which have Tax Exemption Certificates enabled. The checkbox used to be marked even in cases where the Tax Exemption Certificate was not picked up.- This scenario also applies for Sales Quotes and Sales Orders.-Resolution-This visual issue only happens when a Quote is involved in the scenario. The development team understands that this is a usability issue and has taken this up as an issue to be fixed in a future release of the system in order to harmonize the behaviour of the Tax Exemption Certificate checkbox for all scenarios.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Service Quote, Tax Exemption Certificate, TEC, Exempt, Inconsistent, Checkbox, Marked, Checked,

Title: Your Invoice Is Mapped To Wrong Printer
Content: Symptom-Printing to wrong printer. The print Queue is pointed to printer XYZ however the system keeps printing to ABC. (i.e. here XYZ and ABC are Printer IDs)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Print Queues view-Select the Queue ID and click Edit-Choose Processed Documents.-You can see that some documents are sent to printer XYZ and some are sent to printer ABC.-Cause-The issue is likely caused by some configuration maintained in the CPM.-Resolution-You need to check if the configuration maintained in CPM is correct.-PDF "SAP Cloud Print Manager For ByDesign Quick Guide" attached (section 3.1.3)-Keywords-Wrong printer, Invoice, Print Queue

Title: Date Source SRMPO_B12 Shows Double Quantity in Key Figures "Delivered Quantity in Base Unit of Confirmed Inbound Delivery" and "Delivered Quantity of Confirmed Inbound Delivery".
Content: Symptom-In data source SRMPO_B12, for a specific confirmed inbound delivery, key figures "Delivered Quantity in Base Unit of Confirmed Inbound Delivery" and "Delivered Quantity of Confirmed Inbound Delivery" show double delivered quantity.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Analytics.-Access view Design Data Sources.-Search SRMPO_B12, click Preview.-Under Selection, enter ABC (ABC represents purchase order ID) for Purchase Order ID, click Apply.-Under View, add row fields "Purchase Order ID" and "Confirmed Inbound delivery ID".-In the result, for confirmed inbound delivery DEF (DEF represents inbound delivery ID), key figures "Delivered Quantity in Base Unit of Confirmed Inbound Delivery" and "Delivered Quantity of Confirmed Inbound Delivery" show, for example, 41.800,00 KGM.-Check in inbound delivery DEF, for corresponding product, fulfilled quantity is 20.900 kg.-Cause-Date source SRMPO_B12 shows the combined quantity (Delivery quantity + Quantity which is listed in delivery note) in key figures "Delivered Quantity in Base Unit of Confirmed Inbound Delivery" and "Delivered Quantity of Confirmed Inbound Delivery."-Resolution-If above combined quantities need to be shown separately, you can add row field "Quantity Role".-Keywords-Data Source, SRMPO_B12, Delivered Quantity in Base Unit of Confirmed Inbound Delivery, Delivered Quantity of Confirmed Inbound Delivery, Double

Title: You are not authorized to access the data - Expense Report
Content: Symptom-The approver user can't access the Expense Report to check its details, the system shows the error message: "You are not authorized to access the data"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in the system with an Approver user-Go to Home > My Launchpad and click Open Tasks-Find the "Approve Expense Report XXX" task and open it-In the new screen, click the Expense report ID XXX link-The system shows the error message "You are not authorized to access the data"-Cause-Missing authorization-Resolution-The user needs to have the following authorization/access rights to access the Expense Reports: FIN_EXPENSEREPORTS-Keywords-expense report, access, view, approval, access rights, users

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Template has a few error logs when rendering it on Adobe LiveCycle.-"Invalid append operation: field cannot have a child element of value.The element [value] has violated its allowable number of occurrences." and-"Error importing image. Unsupported image format. XFAImageService: Image cannot be resolved for node".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Documents view-Open required Customer Invoice -Navigate to the Output History tab-You can see that the Output is in status Error-Choose error Hyperlink-"Document cannot be generated; ADS server returned an SOAP error"-Cause-Error logs are shown when rendering the template on Adobe LiveCycle.-Resolution-User needs to make the adjustments according to the logs since this could likely be causing the error.-See Also-3233470 - "Document Cannot Be Generated" Error When Generating Document Output or Preview - SAP ONE Support Launchpad-3243578 - Troubleshooting "Document Cannot Be Generated" Errors With Output or Preview - SAP ONE Support Launchpad-Keywords-Output, Preview, Document cannot be generated, ADS, ADS rendering of SAP template failed, ADS server returned an SOAP error, form template, form master template error, InvalidDataException, Xml parsing error, not well-formed, invalid token

Title: Cancellation Invoice Indicator in Report
Content: Symptom-You would like to know how Cancellation Invoice Indicator works in Reports-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing - List view-Select Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components -Execute the report-Click on Additional Filters under Selection-Under Available selection you can see the Cancellation Invoice Indicator field-Click on value help and it shows "X" and "#"-You would like to know the what "X" and "#" represents-Resolution-"X" represents the cancellation invoices and not the invoices which are canceled.-"#" represents the normal invoices.

Title: Non–Team Member of the Project Can Release the Time Sheets
Content: Symptom-You are not ateam member of project however you are allowed to release time sheets.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self Services overview and select Edit Time Sheet-Select Add Row and enter the valid From and To date-Enter the project task-Select Save or Release -System allows the user to release the time sheets-Cause-System allows you to release the time sheet because in the project settings for a Non–Team Member, you have defined the value as Approval Required. Hence system will allow the user to Save or Release the time sheets but it will go for an approval. -Resolution-You can follow the below steps;-Go to Project Management work center'-Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project -Select Edit and go to Project Plan tab-Go to Project Settings sub tab-Under Time Recording section, For Non-Team Mamber, you have to define the value as Not Allowed-Then system will not allow the user to release the time sheets-Note- Further, if a non-team member tries to release the time sheets, system will throw an error message stating- Time recording for project not permitted; user is not part of the team-Keywords-non-team member tries to release the time sheets; non-team member of project; Release time sheets

Title: Field "Delivery Date" of Purchase order not appearing in standard reports
Content: Symptom-Field "Delivery Date" of Purchase order not appearing in standard reports "Monitoring Purchase Orders" and "Purchase Order Volume"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the report "Monitoring Purchase Orders" or  "Purchase Order Volume,"- you shall not find the field with name delivery date-Cause-Delivery date appearing in Item table of purchase order is linked to delivery date appearing in delivery tab of purchase order.-Field under delivery tab would vary based on item type of purchase order and we have mentioned them below:-Item type:                           Delivery field:-Material                               Delivery date-Service                                Service period from-Expense                               Expense from-Limit                                    Delivery Date/Service Period From- This delivery date  field in Item table is linked to field delivery date from in Report-Resolution-You can add fields' Delivery date from' and 'Delivery date To'  in  above reports by following below steps.-Open the respective report.-In the top right corner click Configure > Add Fields.-Choose between the Characteristic and Key Figure tab depending on what type of field you'd like to add.-For characteristics, you can decide if you'd like to add it to the report only, or if you would like to add it to the selection as well.-Make the required changes and click OK.-See Also-Delivery date; expense delivery;Service delivery;Service period from;Expense from;Delivery Date/Service Period From;Delivery date from;Delivery date To-Keywords-[Enter your Keywords here...]

Title: The Error Message "Price and Tax Calculation Not Possible" is Triggered in a Customer Return
Content: Symptom-The Error Message "Price and tax calculation not possible" occurs in Customer Return and Price Components are not available in pricing tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Select and Edit Customer Return XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the customer return).-The following error message is triggered: Price and Tax Calculation Not Possible-Cause-Due to an inconsistency the price information was not passed successfully from the sales document to the customer return.-Resolution-The issue can be resolved by performing the following work around as a dummy change in return:-Go to the Sales Order work center.-Go to the Returns view.-Select and Edit Customer Return XYZ.-Navigate to the General tab.-Select the Value help in the Field Sales Unit.-Select any Sales Unit apart from the one which was selected earlier.-Select the Value help in the Field Sales Unit again-Select the original Sales Unit which you want to select for this return.-Able to see that the Price Components are available in pricing tab now and error is cleared.-See Also-KBA 1936639 - The Error Message "Item : Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" is Triggered in a Customer Return-Keywords-Return; Price List; List Price; Item; Customer Return; Price Determination; Error Message; Price Calculation; Price components; Tax

Title: Changing Account Name Fails with 500 SAP Internal Server Error
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to change an account name. When trying to perform the action, the system dumps with 500 SAP Internal Server Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management-Go to Accounts view-Edit the relevant account-Go to tab General-Change the Account Name-Click Save-Experience 500 SAP Internal Server Error-Cause-The dump might be caused by an inconsistency of the address. -Example: an empty address line exists. -Resolution-Go to Account Management-Go to Accounts view-Edit the relevant account-Go to tab Communication, sub-tab Addresses-Remove the empty row-Click Save-Edit the account and try the name change again.-In case this does not solve the issue, forward to SAP Support for a backend correction.-Keywords-unable, not able, impossible, fails, change, adapt, business partner, of, overwrite, leads to,

Title: Posting Date is Blank in the Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-You have created some customer invoices from invoice run execution, and you find in these customer invoices, the posting date is blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Documents.-Open the invoice ABC, which was created by the invoice run. (ABC represents the customer invoice ID)-Click View All and go to General tab. You can see the field Posting Date, and find the field is blank.-Cause-When creating a new invoice from invoice request (either manually or from invoice run), the posting date is blank (defaults to invoice date) unless the user manually enter a date.-Put the mouse over the question mark besides the Posting Date field, you can see the explanation:-Used date for posting of receivables and revenues in financials. If nothing is entered the invoice date is used.-Resolution-This is the designed system behavior.-Keywords-customer invoice; posting date; invoice run.

Title: Making Tax Digital-UK: Payment Indicator is Blank
Content: Symptom-You submit your UK Digital VAT Return and expect to see BANK populated as Payment Indicator. But the Payment Indicator is blank.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Select the VAT Returns subview.-Show All Tax Returns and search for the ID: XXX (XXX stands for the ID of the respective UK Tax Return).-Select View.-Under the tab Overview, here for the Submission Information, the Payment Indicator is blank.-Cause-The Tax Return is not successfully submitted and accepted by the Tax Authority (HMRC).-Resolution-The Payment Indicator: (BANK / DD) shows after the return is successfully submitted to the Tax Authority (HMRC). It shows as a response from the Tax Authority after successful submission of the VAT Return. Check with HMRC on the date you are allowed to submit the VAT Return via MTD (Making Tax Digital).-See Also-Help Center Document: Making Tax Digital - UK-Keywords-Making Tax Digital-UK, Tax Return, Digital Tax, VAT Return.

Title: Employee Time Quantity shows 0 hours in Backend
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- Employee Time Quantity is not available in the backend while you query the element QueryActualTimeAndAbsenceTimeByElements-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Employees view-Search for Employee-Select Edit -In Employee Times select the Dates-Records will be shown up with Quantity in hours--In the backend, this data shows 0 hours-Tcode: SESFTS-Query EmployeeTime-QueryActualTimeAndAbsenceTimeByElements-Parameter as EmployeeID/content-ItemDate Select the required date-Navigate to the association CurrentItem-The field Quantity is 0 hours-Also, in Tcode SESFTS-BO TIMX_AGREEMENT-Root - Query by elements-Search the Employee ID-Navigate to Employee Time Items-Select the Date range-Select line item-Time recording Quantity field shows 0 hours-Cause- You are checking incorrect node.-Resolution-Employee time quantity is captured in the EmployeeTimeCalendar-PeriodItem, please follow the below steps for navigation.-  In backedn go to Tcode : SESFTS-Open EmployeeTime BO -Enter the Employee ID-Select date -Navigate to Item-Navigate to Calendar_period_item-Open the last record and check the field quantity/Content.-  Keywords-EmployeeTimeCalendar,

Title: SAP Business ByDesign Data Return Process
Content: Symptom-This document describes the current process to extact Master Data, Transactional Data, Attachments and Output Management files from the system.-This situation could happen when your contract is terminating, moving data from one system to another and so on-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Extraction of Master Data and Transactional Data-Whether the customer is in contract or not, the Master Data and Transaction Data should be extracted by user using:-Reports view in respective work center or-Mass Data Maintenance or-Data Extraction and Extraction Run for Financial Data  or -Any Excel export functionality provided by the respective application team.-Additional Information:-Master Data can be extracted by the user using any of the above options. In case of memory issues or time out, use appropriate filters to split the records into multiple files.-Files exported through Data Extraction (ByD) are in .XML format which is same as Migration template format.-Files exported through and Mass Data Maintenance are in .CSV format.-Notes (Text Collection) are supported only for few objects-Extraction of Attachments and Output Management files-At present, it is not possible to export Attachments for any of the Business Objects and there is no mass export functionality for Output Management files. Hence, user need to request such exports via incident.-Note: Such process might take a few weeks as this process is performed manually by the operations team and, it will depend on the amount of attachments available in the system.-How to extract Organizational Master data in migration template?-Please raise a related incident.-How to extract Data using Life Website?-The URL link to the old web dynpro based extraction (End of Life Tool) is no longer supported. In ByD system, you can use the Data Extraction feature instead-Data Extraction feature in ByDesign-Go to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Data Extraction view.-Select New.-Enter a Run ID.-Select the Extraction Object which you want to extract.-Select the Package Active checkbox and define Package Size to automatically perform the extraction in packages with each package containing the number of instances selected.-Select Export Code Description to show texts/descriptions for the codes.-Choose to Save or Activate and Run.-To view the results, search for runs with status Finished.-Select the run to see a list of files that are extracted.-You can choose to Download the extracted files or to Remove them.-You can also refer to the FAQ of Data Extraction - 2667932-If the object is not available as part of Data Extraction then you may report an incident-See Also- 2667932 - Frequently Asked Questions on Data Extraction in SAP Business ByDesign System-Keywords-data extraction, data return, cancellation, contract, eol, extraction of attachments.

Title: Error Message "Partial Day Absences Not Allowed as No Planned Working Time" When Trying to Book Leave
Content: Symptom-You are trying to book Vacation/Partial Leaves from Employee Timesheet or the Time Administration work center, when the system throws the below error message:-On MM/DD/YYYY partial day absences not allowed as no planned working time (where MM/DD/YYYY stands for a date in month-day-year format).-You have already maintained Period Time / Schedule Time Model in employee Time File-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration workcenter-Select Time Model view-You should have a Daily Time Model and corresponding Period/Schedule Time Model for a given country-Assign this Period/Schedule Time Model in Employee Time Profile-Employee view-Select Employee-Edit and add Time Model under Time Profile Work Schedule tab-Cause-Once the Time Model is assigned, you can check the Show Work Schedule button on top, all the working days shows as Yes under column Day Off.-The error is showing because all working days are being counted as Day Off.-And-Handle Holiday as Holiday is paid day off dropdown is not maintained in the Work Schedule sub tab of Time Profile Tab.-Resolution-In this case check all the details of Period/Scheduled Time Model and Daily Time Model associated with them.-One such case is: Time Type used in Daily Time Model is not active anymore.-Check this under:-Business Configuration workcenter-Overview-Search Time Types Activity-Check the validity of the Time Type-It is Delimited-Either use an Active Time Type in Daily Model Or make the validiy of the same Time Type to Unlimited.-Note: It is suggested to Delimit a Time Model if you do not want to use one but do not Delimit the Time Types as they are used in different scenarios which will create such errors in system.-And-For Holiday is paid day off, select below option:-Time Administration workcenter-Employee view-Edit Employee-Select Time Profile-Work Schedule sub-tab-Select Holiday is paid day off -See Also-1467022 - Error Message "Partial Day Absences Not Allowed as No Planned Working Time" When Trying to Release or Approve Time-Keywords-Partial Day Absence, Work Schedule, Show Work Schedule, Partial Leave

Title: Migration fails with error: 'Address ABC already has a node POSTAL_ADDRESS for address representation code' after activation of scripts
Content: Symptom-In a system language XYZ is maintained as the default script language setting (where XYZ represents the language). To migrate employee data, the migration template provided by SAP  is used. But after the import simulation, the following error message appears:-Address ABC already has a node POSTAL_ADDRESS for address representation code (where ABC represents an internal backend address reference).-This error appears although there is no duplicate record and the employee is not yet existing with this address in the system-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview-Select Migration of Employee Data  - XYZ-Select Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool-Select the uploaded file-Execute Migration - Step by Step-Perform Simulation-Find errors of the following type:-Address ABC already has a node POSTAL_ADDRESS for address representation code -No overlapping of validities allowed-Cause-In the import file, the default script language XYZ is maintained in General tab and also in other tabs. This is causing duplicate entries.-Resolution-Always ensure that default script code XYZ is used in General tab only.-In the Script Variant tab or Workplace Address tab, maintain data related to scripts other than XYZ-Keywords-Address  already has a node POSTAL_ADDRESS for address representation code, script is activated, default script language setting

Title: Unable to post the supplier invoice due to exception "Accounting data differs from accounting data of purchase document".
Content: Symptom-Unable to post the supplier invoice due to exception "Accounting data differs from accounting data of purchase document".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing workcenter-Go to Invoice and credit memos view-Filter with "All documents"-Search for Invoice id"-Click edit and view all-Go to Exception tab-See error message "Accounting data differs from accounting data of purchase document".-      or-Go to Invoice entry view-Choose All orders-Search for PO ID -Click on new invoice button-Enter Invoice date as current day and enter some external id-Then click on check button and you will see all of the below error-"-Item 1: Accounting data differs from accounting data of purchase document-Item 1: Tax event(s) could not be determined-""-Cause-Due to mismatch of cost object id between Invoice and Purchase order.- or-Missing information like Individual material in one of the documents either invoice or order.-Resolution-So please void the invoice and create new invoice with correct Account assignment.- or-PDI is involved that is causing the mismatch of data in either of the documents so ask partners to fix the issue.

Title: ChaRM: My Inbox fails with "Property 'HasPotentialOwners' is invalid" after SolMan upgrade
Content: Symptom-After upgrading SAP Solution Manager to SP >= 13, My Inbox ChaRM application fails with error "Property 'HasPotentialOwners' is invalid" when trying to load the tasks.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fiori Launchpad (either in SAP Solution Manager system using transaction sm_workcenter or in the Frontend Server where SAP Gateway is installed)-Go to Change Control Management group-Click on My Inbox tile-Cause-Old cached metadata-Resolution-Logon to your SAP Solution Manager system, if My Inbox is installed there, or to your Front End Server, if My Inbox is installed on a Front End server:-Create a new HTTP destination of type 3 as a copy of the existing one (created before the ST Upgrade)-In SPRO => SAP Customizing Implementation Guide => SAP NetWeaver => SAP Gateway => OData Channel => Configuration => Connection Settings => SAP Gateway to SAP System => Manage SAP System Aliases =>-Assign this new HTTP destination to the corresponding System Alias of service ZTASKPROCESSING (Task Gateway Service version 2.0)-See Also-KBA 2834985 - How to configure the RFCs needed to work with Fiori My Inbox application to work with ChaRM documents - Solution Manager-Keywords-My Inbox, HasPotentialOwners, invalid, ChaRM, upgrade, TASKPROCESSING, ZTASKPROCESSING, Frontend, Front End

Title: Tax reporting unit determination in Purchasing documents
Content: Symptom-You want to know how the Tax Reporting Unit (TRU) is determined in Purchasing documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Go to Invoicing view-Search for Purchase order DEF(DEF refers to the Purchase order Id) -Click on new invoice button-Go to Items then click on Taxes tab here-We can see below tax tab ,Tax country is India but Tax reporting units are not appearing-Cause-1. The Org unit is not a business residence thus cannot be considered as permanent establishment so not considered as TRU- or- 2. The Org unit  that is expected to be TRU is not valid as on Invoice date of the invoice.-Resolution-1.For materials, the system determines the TRU from the below options as per the below sequence -Ship-to location (will be considered only when Material tariff is maintained in product master data)-Bill-to party-Company-Invoicing unit-First available business residence under the company in organizational management.- Only when above are marked as Business residence in organizational management they are considered if not system will look for next option in the above list.-Once system finds the above option then if they are not valid as on Invoice date of invoice then TRU in invoice will be empty, so you will have to extend the validity  of org unit and then create  new invoice or add new row in the invoice for system to redetermine the details as per new changes you did.-2.For services, the system determines the same way as mentioned above except the first option(Ship to location) is not applicable.-See Also-Multiple Tax Registration – India | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Wrong TRU, why TRU, determination  of Tax reporting unit  in Purchasing documents

Title: Error: Depreciation method ABC still used in fixed asset PQR at company XYZ
Content: Symptom-You try to change the settings of Depreciation method e.g. Unchecking/Checking the flag 'Enable Temporary Shutdown' and below error is displayed.-Depreciation method ABC still used in fixed asset PQR at company XYZ-Veto Raised-Save Failed-ABC Refers to Depreciation Method, PQR referes to Fixed asset, XYZ refers to company code-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview and Search for “Depreciation Methods” Activity-Click on Edit Depreciation Methods and select Depreciation method ABC-Perform some changes within e.g. Unchecking/Checking the flag 'Enable Temporary Shutdown' and mentioned error is displayed after 'Save' button is clicked.-Cause-When the depreciation method is already used by an asset(capitalized or retired), the changes to the method will be prevented-Resolution-A temporary change in the depreciation method for the affected asset can solve the issue. Currently the asset will have Depreciation method ABC and it needs to be changed to L010(example), save the changes in Configuration. Again revert from L010 to ABC-Keywords-Depreciation method, Fixed asset

Title: 'Tax Number Missing For Business Partner XXX'-Withholding Tax Return Run For Israel
Content: Symptom-You execute the Withholding Tax Return run for Israel and receive the warning message:-Tax number missing for business partner XXX.-XXX stands for the supplier ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Returns view.-Select the Withholding Tax Returns.-Select the Tax Returns ID: YYY (YYY stands for the Tax Return ID).-Select View.-Under Run Information, open the Application Log ID ZZZ (ZZZ stands for the Application Log ID).-Select the Results tab.-There is the warning message: Tax number missing for business partner XXX.-Cause-The tax number is not correctly maintained in the Supplier Master Data.-Resolution-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Search for the Supplier ID XXX.- Select Edit > Financial Data.- Select Tax Data subtab.-Under Tax Numbers, maintain country/region: IL - Israel.-In the Tax Number Type column, select Company Legal ID.-Maintain the Tax Number in the Tax Number column.-Select Save.-Execute again the Withholding Tax Return Run.-Keywords-Withholding Tax Return, Israel.

Title: Lease Contract - Valuation Cash Flow Report Shows Two Due Dates Per Month
Content: Symptom-You view the Cash Flow report for Lease Contract XYZ and notice that the report displays two Due Dates every month, one for the due Clearing amount and one for the due Depreciation and Interest Expense amount (XYZ represents a Lease Contract ID). -You expect to see only one Due date for all transactions per month. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Lease Contract Management work center go to the Lease Contract view. -Find and select Lease Contract ABC.-Press Reports and select Cash Flows to open the Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow report.-You notice two dates per month; For example, 01.MM.YYYY for the Clearing Amount and 31.MM.YYYY for the due Depreciation and the Interest Expense amount. -(In the Lease Posting Run, in the Processed Successfully - Clearing subtab you also notice two Due Dates for each month.)-Cause-For the monthly Lease Installment payment you choose the In Advance Payment form. With the In Advance payment form interest expense and depreciation amount are applied on the ending balance and are therefore due on the last day of the month (as specified in the lease contract conditions).-However, irrespective of the payment form all clearings are due according to the conditions specified in the contract.-To verify the Payment set up in the contract-access the Lease Object tab of Lease Contract ABC.-Navigate to the Conditions tab.-Notice Condition Type Lease Installment and Payment Form in Advance.-Resolution-When applying the advance payment form interest expense and depreciation amounts are due at the end of the condition's specified period, whereas the clearing amount is due at the start of the period.-When applying the Arrear Payment form Interest Expense, Depreciation as well as Clearing Amount are all applied on the Opening Balance. They are therefore due on the same date, as specified in the Contract's conditions. In this case the report will display only one date per month.-See Also-Lease Contract Valuation Cash Flow-Keywords-Lease Contract Cash Flow, two dates, Lease Posting Run Clearing tab

Title: Same Inbound Delivery Notification ID for Different Purchase Orders
Content: Symptom-While searching Inbound Delivery Notification ABC, multiple entries are displayed for different Purchase Orders.-(ABC represents Inbound Delivery Notification ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to Inbound Delivery Notifications view.-Search for Inbound Delivery Notification ABC.-Notice that the same IDN ID appears for different Purchase Orders.-(ABC represents Inbound Delivery Notification ID)-Cause-The Inbound Delivery Notification ID is required to be unique only for the same supplier.-Therefore, Same IDN ID can be used when the suppliers are different.-Resolution- This is expected system behavior.-Keywords-Inbound Logistics; Inbound Delivery Notification; ID; Purchase Order; Same; Multiple; Different; Sender Party; Supplier; System behavior.

Title: IFRS15 - Completed Sales Order Item Still Considered for Revenue Recognition in IFRS Set of Books
Content: Symptom-You create a project-based, fix-price sales order item. -You assign an accrual method to the item. The item is connected to a Performance Obligation (POB) of a Revenue Accounting Contract (RAC). -All incurred costs and invoiced revenues have been realized accord to the accrual method conditions.-You close the assigned project task to complete the item's delivery status as well as finish its Invoicing status.-As a result, you expect the revenue recognition run to no longer process this sales order item but rather set the Revenue fully Recognized indicator. -Instead, the revenue recognition run keeps amounts deferred or accrued for the item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To check the sales order item status:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find sales order item ABC-XX (ABC-XX represents the sales order item ID). -In the Accounting Data tab you notice that the Revenue Fully Recognized indicator is not set. -In the Dates sub-tab you verify that a Final Delivery and Invoice Date appears, indicating that the item is completed for Delivery as well as Invoicing. -In the Associated Objects tab, find the project task ID assigned to sales order item ABC-XX. -Click on the ID to verify that the project task is closed. -You expect the revenue recognition run to clear all deferrals, accruals, contract assets and liabilities for the item and to only realize the actual invoiced revenue and incurred cost amount.-However, you notice that the revenue recognition run keeps cost or revenue values deferred/accrued or calculates contract asset/liability values for the item:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Revenue Recognition view.-Find the respective revenue recognition run and select the IFRS set of book's application log.-Navigate to the Processed Successfully tab and choose the Advanced Information tab.-Select POC Based and filter for sales order item ABC-XX.-You notice amounts remain deferred or accrued or are calculated as contract assets/liabilities.-Cause-The IFRS15 functionality is active: With the IFRS15 functionality, revenue recognition is based on the Revenue Accounting Contract (RAC) and its Performance Obligations(POB) where every sales document item  must be assigned to a POB item.-Sales order item ABC-XX is still being considered for revenue recognition as further, not completed sales document items are assigned to its RAC.-Only when a RAC is completed, meaning, when all items are fulfilled and invoiced, the sales order items associated with the RAC will be finished for Revenue Recognition.-As long as there are further, not completed sales document items assigned to the RAC of Sales Order Item ABC-XX, this item will not be completed for Revenue Recognition but considered until all items are completed.-Resolution-First check if there are further sales document items associated with the RAC of sales order item ABC-XX:-In the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue work center find sales order item ABC-XX.-In the Revenue Accounting Contract column you see the RAC ID XYZ (XYZ represents the RAC ID which Sales Order Items ABC-XX is associated with). -Click this ID to open the RAC. -In the Contract Changes tab, under Sales Document Involved press Expand All.-You can now see all POBs of this RAC with the respective sales order or even customer contract item assigned to them. You see POB XYZ-YY, which is associated with sales order Item ABC-XX. You might see further POBs, for example XYZ-ZZ associated with another sales order item or customer contract item, say, DEF-XX (DEF-XX represents the ID of a different sales document item). Or you might see further sales order items associated with the same POB, XYZ-YY, which sales order item ABC-XX is associated with as well. -To check the Status of the other sales document item(s):-Go back to the Sales Document Items view.-Find Sales Order or customer contract Item DEF-XX.-Check the Dates tab. If there is no Final Delivery and Invoicing Date maintained, the sales document item is not completed. Hence, all items associated with RAC XYZ will be considered by the Revenue Recognition run.-Keywords-Completed Sales Order item, IFRS15, Contract Liability, Recognize Based on Manual Amounts, Revenue fully Recognized, IFRS

Title: How the List Price is Determined in a Follow-Up Sales Order From a Contract.
Content: Symptom-With Release 2102 the system behavior on how the List Price is determined in a Follow-Up Sales Order from a Contract has been changed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The reason why the system behavior was changed with 2102 is the following:-If a Price Agreement is maintained in a contract it is expected that the Price Agreement contains the contractual agreed price with the end customer (Account) of the Contract. This is the purpose of the feature Price Agreement. Therefore, any changes that deviate from a price maintained in the Price List need to be maintained in the contract via the Price Agreement. If no Price Agreement is maintained the List Price in the Follow-Up Sales Order will always be newly determined from the Price List. Hence, if no price for the Product is maintained in the Price List and not Price Agreement was maintained it the Contract, no valid List Price can be determined.-However, since this also had a affect on the Freight calculations we have decided to revert the System behaviour with 2105 HFC 03.-Resolution-System behavior before 2102:-If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Contract.--If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List but then manually changed:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Contract.--If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List and a price agreement was maintained for the List Price:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the List Price on the Item and not from the Price Agreement.  --If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was maintained manually:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Contract.--If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List, then manually changed and a price agreement was maintained for the List Price as well:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the manual change of the List Price and not from the Price Agreement.  --System behavior from 2102 to 2105 HFC 03:-If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List:-If a Sales Order is created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price is newly determined from the Price List.-  If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List but then manually changed:-If a Sales Order is created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price is newly determined from the Price List and the manual changes are not taken over.-  If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List and a price agreement was maintained for the List Price:-If a Sales Order is created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price is determined from the Price Agreement of the Contract.-  If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was maintained manually:-If a Sales Order is created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price cannot be determined and has to be maintained manually in the Sales Order.-  If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List, then manually changed and a price agreement was maintained for the List Price as well:-If a Sales Order is created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Price Agreement.  -System behaviour from 2105 HFC 03 onwards:-If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Contract.--If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List but then manually changed:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Contract.--If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List and a price agreement was maintained for the List Price:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Price Agreement.  --If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was maintained manually:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the Contract.--If a Product was maintained in a contract and the price was determined via the Price List, then manually changed and a price agreement was maintained for the List Price as well:-If a Sales Order was created as a follow up document of the contract the List Price was copied from the manual change of the List Price and not from the Price Agreement.  -Please Note:-Any price maintained in Price Agreements in the Contract would have highest precedence among all standard price lists.-If the Sales Order is created manually (e.g. as a copy) and not as a follow up document from a Contract or the Create with Reference function, and an Item is added manually the List Price is determined via the Price List. When the item is then referenced to a contract item via the Contract Item ID value help in the Items tab, the List Price will not be updated with the List Price from the Contract.  -See Also-KBA 2991066 - On a Follow-up Sales Order from a Contract, Price Agreements Are Not Carried Over-Keywords-List Price; Follow-Up; follow up; Sales Order; Contract; Mandatory List Price; Price Agreement
