Title: Unable to Update or Delete Inspection Instruction In Inspection Document.
Content: Symptom-In an inspection duccument, you have maintained an inspection instruction but then find it is incorrect. You want to update it but it is not editable. You want to delete it but the button Delete is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Quality Control.-Access view Inspections.-Select an inspection document whose status is not "Decision Made", click Edit.-Select tab Miscellaneous, select sub tab Notes, there is already an inspection instruction maintained.-You would like to update it, but it is not editable.-You would like to delete it, but the button Delete is disabled.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-However, if an incorrect inspection instruction is maintained, you can add a comment to announce the mistake and insert the appropriate note, if there is any.-Keywords-Inspection, Inspection Instruction, Delete

Title: How the value of field Net Amount in Company Currency on report Monitoring Invoices is generated
Content: Symptom-You have created one invoice XYZ (XYZ represents the supplier invoice ID) with currency ABC, and your company currency is DEF.-You would like to know how the value of field Net Amount in Company Currency on report Monitoring Invoices is generated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing Work Center.-Go to Report - List View.-Open report Monitoring Invoices.-Enable the key figure Net Amount in Company Currency, and enter invoice XYZ. -Display Currency - Conversion Date as Today.-You find the outcome value is not using the valid exchange rate of today.-You would like to know how the exchange rate of this field is determined and how the value of this field is generated.-Cause-Go to General Ledger Work Center.-Go to Edit Exchange Rates View under Common Tasks.-Click View Exchange Rates History button.-Search Source Currency - ABC, Target Currency - DEF.-Sort Ascending for field Created On.-Locate the latest created record with valid from date before the posting date of invoice XYZ.-Here you will find the Ask Rate as the correct exchange rate for this field.-Resolution-This is current system design. System will always locate the latest valid exchange rate for the posting date of the invoice.-Keywords-Net Amount in Company Currency, Monitoring Invoices, Currency, Conversion Date, Exchange Rate

Title: Unable to Define Number Ranges for Purchase Order Based on Company ID
Content: Symptom-You want to define the number range for purchase orders based on company ID.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview-Select the Activity - Number Ranges for Operational Purchase Documents-Select Purchase order-You don't see an option to define number range based on company ID-Cause-Currently it is not possible to define the number range based on the company ID for purchase orders, Return to Supplier, Purchase Order Acknowledgments and Goods and Services Receipts based on Company ID.-Resolution-In the current set up, system allows the user to enter the number range between the intervals. You can post this as a new idea in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign.-Keywords-Number Ranges for Operational Purchase Documents; Purchase order number format; PO number range; number range based on company ID

Title: Appointments are duplicated after being synchronized in Outlook
Content: Symptom-After a synchronization via the outlook addin, duplicate appointments appear in SAP Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Outlook Addin-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Go to Activities view-Filter for the relevant activities-Find duplicate records-Cause-Although a new outlook addin version has been rolled out, still the outdated version is used.-Resolution-Install the newest version and check if the issue is solved. In case the issue still occurs, create an SAP incident and share the log file using following steps:-Open Outlook-Go to Home > SAP Business ByDesign tab-Click Help and select Increase Log level (if not already selected)-Close Outlook-Repeat the actions that lead to the the duplicate appointments-Open Outlook again-Go to Home > SAP Business ByDesign tab-Click Help > Show Log File Directory-Keywords-sync, synced, activity, activities, twice, double, two times, occur, visible, are created, using,

Title: Error : Customer invoice already exist for outbound delivery
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**For SAP Internal Use Only**-While performing undo release of Outbound Delivery, user is getting an error below:--Customer invoice already exist for outbound delivery-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view and find relevant ID.-Select it and choose Undo- Release.-System throws an error message: Customer invoice already exist for outbound delivery.-Cause-There are two invoices for this OD however both are canceled.--The query customer invoice is using to check if any invoice exists is:-APCI_CUSTOMER_INVOICE-CUSTOMER_INVOICE-QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS-Using these PARAMS-BTD ref id: -BTD ref TC: 73-Release status: 1-Release status: 3-Cancellation doc indicator: false-In this case, there is an invoice returned which has nothing to do with Outbound Delivery ID.-This is caused by a bug in the Third-Party Order Fulfillment process. When the OD is released, are sending the tag-(Screenshot taken from internal SAP QCH system)-So there is a TPOP scenario with Inbound Delivery Notification. Meaning there in an invoice that matches the query params above.-Need to identify the reason why the type code 73 is being sent in this case. In this case, issue is caused by the type code 73 being sent in TPOP scenario.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-Invoices for this OD are canceled-Type code 73 being sent in TPOP scenario as shown above.-Note: If you receive similar case, kindly forward it to component:AP-XPS-DLP.-Backend Correction steps:-Undo release the 3PL OD in this case and bypass the validation on invoice.-Keep a breakpoint at class cm_root => constructor and in debugging check what is the validation causing the error. Skip the validation-Post-Checks:-OD is undo-released.-Keywords-Customer invoice already exist for outbound delivery, TPOP, release status, undo release

Title: Cancellation Invoice in VAT Return (Specific to Country Spain)
Content: Symptom-You have posted Cancellation Invoice AAAA and it is picked in the VAT Return Tax Return Type - SII Outgoing Invoice & Processing Type - Spain SII - Cancellation. In the VAT Return the Acceptance Status is Accepted. When you have checked on the Spanish Tax Portal then you cannot find this Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click on VAT Return view.-Open the VAT Return with Tax Return Type - SII Outgoing Invoice & Processing Type - Spain SII - Cancellation.-Go to Tax Return tab.-Here, you can find the Invoice - AAAA with Acceptance Status = Accepted. -However, the same invoice AAAA is not available in the Spanish Tax Portal.-Cause-The Spanish Tax Portal displays the cancelled invoice’s External Reference ID on the Portal and not the actual Invoice ID which appears in the SAP Business ByDesign system. At the time comparing date between SAP Business ByDesign system and Spanish Tax Portal, you must have to check the External Reference ID and compare Base Amount.-Resolution-To verify the External Reference ID, follow the below steps:-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click on VAT Return view.-Open the VAT Return with Tax Return Type - SII Outgoing Invoice & Processing Type - Spain SII - Cancellation.-Go to Tax Return tab.-Select the Invoice line item and click on Details. -In the next screen - Tax Return Details, you can find the External Reference ID of the Invoice. -This External Reference ID and its Base Amount will match with the Spanish Tax Portal.-Keywords-Cancelled invoice not appearing on Spanish Tax Portal, VAT Return, Spain, Spanish Tax Return, Cancellation Invoice, Cancelled Invoice.

Title: Sales Quote Funnel & Success Rate Report is Not Showing Success Rate Value Correctly
Content: Symptom-Sales Quote Funnel & Success Rate Report is not showing Success Rate value correctly-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to New Business - Sales Quotes-Select the Sales Quote XYZ (XYZ represents Sales Quote ID)-Sales Quote is having multiple line items-In this only few line items are converted into sales order-Remaining line items got completed by manually performing Change Status -> Complete button-Go to Business Analytics - Design Reports-Select Sales Quote Funnel & Success Rate-Click here to start the Report-Add the Sales Quote field below Row Fields-Add the below fields the below Column Field-Success Rate - Number of Accepted Quote Items (%)-Success Rate - Net Value of Accepted Quote Items (%)-Filter the report with Sales Quote XYZ-Report shows 100%  -Cause-Sales Quote is manually completed by performing the Complete button instead of rejecting the line items by maintaining the Reason for Rejection-Resolution-Kindly maintain Reason for Rejection for the remaining Sales Quote items.-Go to New Business - Sales Quotes-Select the Sales Quote XYZ-Edit and click on Change Status -> Open button-Navigate to Items tab -Maintain Reason for Rejection for remaining items. -Click on Save.

Title: Error: "Standard address is not always specified" when trying to delete employee address
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to delete the personal address of an employee. The deletion in personnel management work center fails with the following error message: "Standard address is not always specified".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center: Personnel Management-Go to view: Employees-Select and Edit the relevant employee-In Personal Data dab, go to Private Contact Details-Select: Delete-Error: "Standard address is not always specified"-Cause-The standard address information might be inconsistent in the backend.-Resolution-This inconsistency requires a data correction. Title: Total Payable/Receivable amount in Withholding Tax Return
Content: Symptom-You have executed Withholding Tax Return Run and the respective Withholding Trax Return shows Total Payable/Receivable amount 0,00. You are expecting some amount.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center. -Click on Withholding Tax Retrurns view. -Check the Return - AA.-Under Tax Return Amounts section, the Total Payable/Receivable amount is 0,00. -Cause-The system shows Total Payable/Receivable amount only when the Withholding Tax Return Type is marked as Payment Relevant under Tax Authority. To verify,-Go to Tax Authority.-Click on Company Tax Arrangements tab.-Under Tax Return Arrangements, you can verify the Payment Relevant option.-Payment Relevant is not ticked, so the Total Payable/Receivable amount is 0,00.  -Resolution-This is a standard system behaviour.-Keywords-Total Payable/Receivable amount in WHT Return, Total Payable/Receivable , Payment relevant, WHT Return.

Title: Withholding Tax Relevant Error Appears While Trying to Create New Supplier Invoice Without Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Error appears while trying to create new supplier invoice. -Error - Item 1: Determination of withholding tax code failed for country India tax event Withholding Tax-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Common Tasks and select New Invoice without Purchase order-Select the relevant Supplier and Company-Enter the relevant product-Select Check button-Error appears-Cause-Withholding tax is due if the following conditions are all true:-The buyer (buying company) is obligated by law to withhold -The supplier is subject to withholding-The product is relevant for withholding-As a consequence, the following master data objects carry attributes that are specific to withholding tax:-Company Tax Arrangement-Supplier-Product-In the Service master, Withholding Tax Classification details is not defined and hence the error message occurs.-Resolution-You have to maintain the Withholding Tax Classification details in the Service master. Later system will calculate the withholding tax code properly in the new invoice document.-Keywords-Determination of withholding tax code failed for country India tax event Withholding Tax; Determination of withholding tax code failed

Title: Contract Item are not Renewed
Content: Symptom-You have created a renewal rule for contract line item level, but new line item is not created.-Or-You want to add a renewal rule on the contract header level, but the field is read only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work center -> Contracts view-Edit the Contract ABC (ABC represents the Contract ID)-Navigate to Items tab-Renewal Rule is maintained -Go to Sales Orders Work center -> Contracts view-Edit the Contract ABC (ABC represents the Contract ID)-Navigate to General tab-A Renewal Rule cannot be maintained -Cause-Validity of the Contract at header level is Expired.-Resolution-The system creates the renewal task only if the contract status is Active. This is a standard system behaviour.

Title: Bank Name: 'XXX' added to SWIFT/BIC PQR for identification of primary office during BIC entry for the bank directory entry
Content: Symptom-You try to add BIC to the bank directory entry 'ABC' and system throws warning message: 'XXX' added to SWIFT/BIC PQR for identification of primary office-ABC refers to Bank Name and PQR refers to SWIFT/BIC ID-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Liquidity Management work center-Bank Directory and Open required directory-In General Data tab, enter PQR(PQR refers to SWIFT/BIC ID)-System automatically adds XXX in the end with message: 'XXX' added to SWIFT/BIC PQR for identification of primary office-Cause-Current system design-Resolution-This validation is skipped for only one country code i.e. FR and all the other country codes should either have 8 or 11 characters in BIC field.-If its 8, XXX is added else all the 11 characters are retained.-Keywords-Bank directory entry, BIC/SWIFT

Title: Trigger Shows the Error "No agent available to run jobs"
Content: Symptom-"No agent available to run jobs" error seen after creating a trigger for a job, there is an agent available to run the job in the tenant-Environment-SAP Intelligent Robotic Process Automation-SAP Build Process Automation-Reproducing the Issue-Create, release and deploy project-Add a trigger-Trigger shows the status "No agent available to run jobs"-Cause-The agent version in the project does not match the agent version installed on machine-Resolution-When creating a project an agent version for the project is chosen. This version should match the agent installed on the machine. To resolve this issue follow the steps below-For SAP Build Process Automation:-Open the project-Ensure the project is in the editable state (from the dropdown at the top of the screen)-Go to setting in the top right and select Configure agent version-From the dropdown select your agent version-Deploy and release the project again-Create a new trigger-For SAP Robotic Process Automation:-Open the project-Go to setting in the top right and select Configure agent version-From the dropdown select your agent version-Generate a new version of the project-Create a new trigger-See Also-Project Lifecycle Management and Versioning-Keywords-Trigger, Warning, Error, SBPA, SPA, IRPA, RPA, Agent

Title: Export of suppliers via mass data maintenance leads to empty fields in export file
Content: Symptom-When trying to update suppliers via mass data maintenance, previously filled extension fields are showing as blank in the export file, but their values can be updated with the import file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-Go to Suppliers view-Open the supplier ABC (where ABC represents the Supplier ID)-Open Purchase tab-Find values in extension fields-Go to Mass Data Maintenance work center-Export supplier ABC-Check the export file-Observe that above mentioned extension fields are blanc, and possibly also appear in different order-Maintain new values into the fields-Save the file-Import the file via Mass Data Maintenance work center-Complete the import-Go to Supplier Base work center-Go to Suppliers view-Open the supplier ABC -Open Purchase tab-Find the extension fields updated with new fields, possibly in different order -Cause-Due to a technical restriction it is currently not possible to extract extension fields from the procurement data.-Resolution-This as a restriction, that currently cannot be overcome. This way, the mass update via mass data maintenance is not fully supported.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-supplier master, not working, applied, new custom fields, upload, doesn't work, correctly, unable, extract, process, extraction of the data, extract, purchase, purchasing, order, different, supplier

Title: Unable to Cancel Inbound Delivery After Performing Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- **SAP Internal Use Only**-You have performed warehouse adjustment confirmation against Inbound Delivery however you are unable to cancel it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Find relevant ID and select it.-You are unable to cancel it as it is grayed out though adjustment confirmation is being done for line items.-Again check line items in relevant inbound delivery.-You find that still fulfilled quantity is not 0.-Cause-It reqiures backend correction.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-The CID has an incorrect delivery processing status and fulfilled quantity.-The status is “in process” whereas it should have been “not started”.-The fulfilled quantity should be 0.-CID is the only document that is inconsistent.-All inventory and site logistics documents are consistent.-Check status of Warehouse order.It should be Finished with 0 fulfilled qty.-It should be an inbound non 3PL scenario.-  NOTE: If you receive such case, kindly forward it to AP-IDP-CID.-Backend Correction steps:-Change the Processing status to “Not Started “in the Database table of Root node for CID and fulfilled quantity should be changed to 0.-  CID BO- APDL_D_CID_ROOT-Root table – APDL_D_CID_ROOT (for delivery processing status)-Item->Item Quantity dB table->APDL_D_CID_QTY (for fulfilled qty)-Check in IDN BO if entries are correct ,If not correct it.-  IDN BO -  APDL_INBOUND_DELIVERY-Root DB table - APDL_D_IDE_ROOT (for delivery processing status)-Item->Item Quantity dB table-> APDL_D_IDE_QTY( for fulfilled qty)-To reflect correct status in OWL ,make same changes in the corresponding FSI table of the node by reloading the individual  node instance using report ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL.-We have a Z report where we can load individual node IDs instead of reloading the entire FSI table.- The Report is ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL and it is available in QCH. It required BO name (PDM_INDIVIDUAL_PRODUCT in our case) , BO Node Name would be COMMON and please check the Node ID from sesfts.-If the report doesnt exists in the customer system, you can create a Z report by simply copying the above report and can execute the same. Code for the same is attached at the end of the document.-  Post-Checks:-Cancel button is enabled.-Delivery Processing status is set to “Not Started”-Fulfilled Qty should be 0.-CODE:-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-*& Report  ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL-*&-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-*&-*&-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-  REPORT ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL.-  DATA:-  lo_fsi_replication_instance TYPE REF TO if_fsi_replication_instance,-  lv_node_id                  TYPE char70,-  lt_node_id                  TYPE sesf_bo_node_id_tab,-  lv_invalid_so               TYPE abap_bool.-  PARAMETERS:-  p_bo                        TYPE mdrs_v_prx_mo_prx_name DEFAULT 'PRO_PROJECT',     " if_pro_project=>co_bo_name,-  p_bon                       TYPE string DEFAULT 'TASK'.            " if_pro_project_bo_template_sp=>co_bo_node-root,-  SELECT-OPTIONS:-  so_nid                      FOR (lv_node_id)            DEFAULT 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'.-  PARAMETERS:-  p_dele                      TYPE abap_bool AS CHECKBOX  DEFAULT abap_false.-    TRY.-      " this report supports individual node IDs only-    LOOP AT so_nid INTO DATA(ls_nid).-      IF ls_nid-sign <> 'I' OR-         ls_nid-option <> 'EQ'.-        WRITE:  / 'This report supports the selection of single values only; FSI not updated'.-        lv_invalid_so = abap_true.-        EXIT.-      ENDIF.-      APPEND ls_nid-low TO lt_node_id.-    ENDLOOP.-    IF lv_invalid_so = abap_true.-      EXIT.-    ENDIF.-      lo_fsi_replication_instance =-      cl_fsi_replication_facade=>get_replication_proxy_instance(-        EXPORTING-          in_bo_name    = CONV #( p_bo )-          in_connection = CONV #( cl_omm_xtpa_generic=>gc_fsi_db_connection_name ) ).-      IF p_dele = abap_true.-        " delete secondary persistence-      lo_fsi_replication_instance->delete(-        EXPORTING-          iv_bo_node_name = CONV #( p_bon )-          it_node_ids     = lt_node_id ).-      ELSE.-        " update secondary persistence-      lo_fsi_replication_instance->modify(-        EXPORTING-          iv_bo_node_name = CONV #( p_bon )-          it_node_ids     = lt_node_id ).-      ENDIF.-    CATCH cx_fsi_agent_service_error INTO DATA(lx_fsi_agent).-      DATA(lv_text) = lx_fsi_agent->if_message~get_text( ).-    WRITE: lv_text.-    DATA(lv_longtext) = lx_fsi_agent->if_message~get_longtext( ).-    WRITE: / lv_longtext.-    WRITE: / 'Error occured; FSI not updated'.-    EXIT.-  ENDTRY.-  WRITE: 'FSI updated for:'.-WRITE: / 'BO ', p_bo.-WRITE: / 'BO Node ', p_bon.-LOOP AT lt_node_id INTO lv_node_id.-  WRITE: / 'Instance with Node ID ', lv_node_id.-ENDLOOP.-  Keywords-Cancel inbound delivery, warehouse adjustment, fulfilled quantity

Title: Data Source 'Customer Returns Sales Order Reference' Only Shows the Returns With Reference to Internal Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You are running the data source 'Customer Returns Sales Order Reference' to check the returns, and find not all the returns are showing in this data source.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics - Data Sources view.-Select data source 'Customer Returns Sales Order Reference'.-Preview it, return ABC is not showing. (ABC represents the ID of the return)-Cause-In the return ABC, you can check the reference assignment by following steps.-Open the return ABC.-Go to Items tab, and select one item.-The Reference Type is Sales Orders, Reference ID is marked as external.-Data source 'Customer Returns Sales Order Reference' shows the return with reference to internal sales order only.-Resolution-This is the designed behavior.-The user can use data source "Customer Returns" to show all the returns.-Keywords-Customer Returns Sales Order Reference; return; reference assignment; report.

Title: Process Control for Expense Reports from Concur
Content: Symptom-You created a Process Control rule to block postings for Business Process Group - Expense Report for a specific time period. -However, you notice that an Expense Report imported from SAP Concur for this time period is posted without any issues. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Companies view.-Select Company ID 123 and press Set Process Control.-In the Show field, Relevant for Today is displayed.-You verify that the Process Control rule to block the posting of Business Process Group - Expense Report is valid in the period when the Expense report is posted. -Cause-The Process Control settings do not work for externally created documents. This applies to Expense Reports that are submitted from SAP Concur and to be posted in SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The system behaves as designed; Externally created documents are not considered in Process Control settings.-Keywords-Concur, Expense Report, Block, Set Process Control-concur, expense report, posting date, set process control, block

Title: Error Appears When Sending Request for Quotation to the Bidders
Content: Symptom-An error message is displayed during the process of sending the Request for Quotation to bidders.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Requests for Quotation view-Select the relevant Requests for Quotation-Select Edit and Go to General tab-Choose on Send to Bidders-Error appears: "Request Tender fee is mandatory".-Cause-The “Tender Fees Required” checkbox was selected.-When this checkbox is selected, the “Requested Tender Fees” field must be filled.-The error occurred because the “Requested Tender Fees” field was left empty.-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Requested Tender fee is mandatory; Tender Fees Required; Request for Quotation

Title: Empty List of Expense Type
Content: Symptom-You get an empty list of Expense Type when you create a new expense report.-You wonder how to create new Expense Types for the expense reports-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses and select common task New Expense Report on Behalf.-Select the Employee and all other required information.-Select Next, and Add Row.-Open the drop-down list of Expense Type, but it is empty. Or, you wonder to have more expense type options.-Cause-You have activated the expense reporting of a localized country version, e.g US. But you have deleted the Definition entries for Expense Types US in Fine-Tuning.-Resolution-You have to maintain them again per Expense type in Fine-Tuning by following steps.-Go to Business Configuration work center and view Overview-Search for Expense Reporting - US-Under Expense Types, click Edit Expense type.-Under Available Expense Types click Add row to create the new expense type-Add Definitions. -Save-Keywords-Expense Type, 费用类型, create, add,

Title: Error "Only one proposed supplier is allowed" Appears While Trying to Order Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-You are trying to order the purchase order document however you get an error message.-Error - Only one proposed supplier is allowed; Seller or supplier missing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Select Edit button -Click on Check button and error appears-Cause-Error is only reproducible when adding supplier first, because the Product already has a supplier maintained & will be automatically determined. (Source of supply maintained e.g. a Contract or List Price or fixed source of supply) So when a supplier has already been entered manually, and the system attempts to determine the supplier from source of supply again on entering product details which has list price/contract etc, there is already an entry in the backend system and hence error occurs. In addition, the supplier has been added and deleted multiple times in the purchase order and hence the inconsistency occurs.-Resolution-You can remove the supplier or product and reenter the data in the purchase order. In case if error still persists, we strongly suggest you to Delete the purchase order as it is in In Preparation status. And create a new purchase order with reference to purchase request.-See Also-3079794 - Error in Purchase Request : Only one supplier permitted-Keywords-Only one proposed supplier is allowed; Seller or supplier missing;

Title: In Common Task New Replenishment, The Default UoM of Replenishment Quantity Is Unexpected.
Content: Symptom-In common task New Replenishment, you find the default UoM of field Replenishment Quantity is UoM_X, but you expect it should be UoM_Y.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Access common task New Replenishment.-Enter LOA_X (LOA_X represents logistics area ID) in filter Logistics Area ID, click Go.-In the below result, for product ABC (ABC represents product ID), Replenishment Quantity uses UoM_X (UoM_X represents UoM name) by default.-In the below select sub tab Forecasted Documents, UoM_X is used for all quantities.-However, in the master data of product ABC, though UoM_X is Base UoM and Inventory Valuation UoM, UoM_Y (UoM_Y represents UoM name) is set as Planning UoM and the quantity conversion has been maintained for the two UoMs.-Go to work center Supply Chain Design Master Data, access view Locations, find corresponding site, click Edit Layout, select logistics area LOA_X, in the below select tab Replenishment and Removal Rules, select sub tab Replenishment, there is a rule for which UoM_Y is used.-You wonder why UoM_X instead of UoM_Y is the default UoM of field Replenishment Quantity for product ABC in logistics area LOA_X in common task New Replenishment.-Cause-The Inventory Valuation UoM in material master data will be used as the default UoM of Replenishment Quantity in common task New Replenishment.-In your case, for product ABC, Inventory Valuation UoM is UoM_X, hence in common task New Replenishment, UoM_X is the default UoM of Replenishment Quantity for this product.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-UoM, New Replenishment, Replenishment Quantity

Title: Customer Language Adaptation Tool is Performing Partial Translation of Work Center and Views.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Customer Language Adaptation Tool is performing partial translation of work center and views in UI screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in with target language-Some workcenter/views are not translated-Cause-Handling of the tool and the text pools (TP) is not done properly.You need to treat translation with as much care as you would apply to ensuring proper business configuration content where also procedures have to be followed in order to achieve a consistent end result-Resolution-Consider below points while creating Text Pools :-Use on average about 5-6 work centers per TP, not more, since the execution times of specific actions like the text collection or translation data retrieval will exceed the time limits for background processing and thus the actions do not complete properly.-The "Home" Work center only needs to be covered in one TP, thus delete it from all further ones-Do not cover message texts in every TP however only create one TP that only collects messages and nothing else. This is advantageous. In all other TPs collect text types UI texts, code texts and analytics texts-Execute text collection in a single step first, do not combine it with translation retrieval immediately - again for the sake of avoiding time outs and ensuring a comprehensive coverage. Thus do not execute action COM on the empty TP but TCO.-Whenever action call TCO is finished for a TP, then execute translation retrieval using action TPR.. It solely checks for existing translations in SAP Translation Hub.-When action TPR is finished, open the TP and check that all text elements have been translated. if not then you need to provide the missing translation manually-Do this for all text pools. when the text / translation maintenance is completed for all TPs, then and only then run the UI load generation action UIL on the master TP. Ideally no-one is logged into the system during this step in Target language since you will experience screen flickering and UI reload due to the initialization-Once all the steps have been completed, most of the texts in the system for the respective work centers are translated, only the few UI controls for which limitations exist will not be translated.-NOTE: for any text where no translation is available thereafter you need to provide one by yourself. This can be achieved online directly in the system or offline by down-/uploading the lists and translating outside the system.-See Also-Customer Language Adaptation Tool | SAP Help Portal-Keywords-Customer Language Adaptation Tool, Partial translation, language,

Title: Error message: 'Form template code mandatory' occurs when you try to create a Pro forma invoice.
Content: Symptom-When you try to create a Pro forma Invoice from a sales order and try to preview the form , you can see that no template is selected even though you have maintained the template.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Search for Sales Order XYZ(XYZ is the ID of the Sales Order-Select the Sales order and click on proforma invoice.-The proforma invoice is not generated.-You get the error message "Form template code mandatory"-Cause-In this particular case the Sales Order XYZ has tax number determined and it is passed on to the Customer invoice request which is a mirror object of sales order, at this point Customer invoice request tries again to read the Account master data to validate that tax number is valid, but in case it does not find, further it checks if it is a EU community , if it is EU community then not maintaining tax number is an error since there is data mismatch from source and the process of Customer invoice request creation is halted and further proforma invoice creation is also hindered.-The Customer Tax Number was maintained in the Account master data before while the Sales Order C|XYZ was created and later it was deleted before creating the proforma invoice which is causing the issue.-Resolution-Kindly maintain the Customer Tax Number in the Account Master data of the Sales Order XYZ.-See Also- 2614403 - Pro-Forma Invoice Button Is Missing-Keywords-Pro forma invoice, Form template code mandatory, VAT Registration number

Title: Error when a Deleting Business Configuration Set
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You are trying to delete a Custom Business Configuration Set (BC Set) created for a Standard Business Configuration Object (SAP BCO) in your Partner Development Tenant. This action fails with the below error:-"Object reference not set to an instance of an object"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Application Studio -Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have a Development Tenant.-You have extended an SAP BCO with a Custom BC Set.-Steps to reproduce:-Right-Click Delete on the relevant .bcc file in the Solution Explorer.-Cause-This error is a known issue that happens for a few BC Sets created on SAP BCOs. The error occurs because of reading the BCO's schema incorrectly while deleting the BC Set.-Resolution-Incident needs to be forwarded to AP-RC-BDS-BC for manual correction.-Keywords-SDK, PDI, Partner Tenant, BCC

Title: Sender Domains Gmail.com and Yahoo.com are Not Supported in Business ByDesign and Cloud for Customer system
Content: Symptom-When adding sender domains gmail.com or yahoo.com, the error message "To prevent the misuse of e-mail addresses, SAP only allows e-mails to be sent from domains that are owned by you" is shown.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration.-Go to view Overview.-Search for E-mail and Fax Settings.-Click the link for the activity.-On left side, see the Allowed Domains.-Enter gmail.com or yahoo.com-Save-Error is triggered-Cause-Sending the mails with sender domain address as gmail.com or yahoo.com are not supported in C4C and Business ByDesign tenants.-By doing this, our IPs and domain can get added to blocklist, so it is not allowed.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior. Kindly add domains that are owned by you.-Keywords-To prevent the misuse of e-mail addresses, SAP only allows e-mails to be sent from domains that are owned by you, unable to approve purchase order, email not sent , domain error
