Title: Error during activation of Custom Business Objects
Content: Symptom-You are trying to publish (Activate) a Custom Business Object created on Custom Object Builder and you receive one of the following the error messages:-- Error during activation of Custom Business Objects .-- Publish not possible.-- Create an case with component AP-RC-CU-BO.-Environment-On Custome Business Object created via Custom Object Builder (Key User Tool - KUT) and On All Versions of SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer and SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1- Go to WoC Administrator-2- Click on link Custom Objet Builder-3- Open Custom BO-4- Click on button Publish-5- Error message raise-6- Error during activation of Custom Business Objects. Publish not possible. Create an case with component AP-RC-CU-BO-Cause-There is multiples causes that will prevent the publish (activation) of custom business object created via Custom Object Builder. One of them is that you assigned the custom business object to workcenter TEST and this is a invalid workcenter.-Resolution-1- Go to WoC Administrator-2- Click on link Custom Objet Builder-3- Open custom BO-4- Change the workcenter selected on dropdown field Workcenter to a different workcenter than TEST-5- Click on button Publish to activate the custom business object-Keywords-Error during activation of Custom Business Objects. Publish not possible. Create an case with component AP-RC-CU-BO

Title: Error Message: “Enter a date which is smaller than 31.12.9999” While Creating a New Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-While you create a new Customer Contract from the UI, system does not allow to specify the Contract End Date as 31.12.9999 and throws error: Enter a date which is smaller than 31.12.9999-or-While you migrate the Customer Contract with Contract End Date as 31.12.9999, you receive the error during Validation: File validation failed. Create an case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To create a new Customer Contract from the UI:-Go to Sales Orders work center-Go to Common Tasks-Select New Contract-In the General tab, fill the required details-For the Contract End Date, provide 31.12.9999-Press Enter on the keyboard-System throws error:-Enter a date which is smaller than 31.12.9999-  To migrate the Customer Contracts using the migration tool:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Migration of Customer Contracts-Choose Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-You receive the below error during the Validation step-File validation failed. Create an case-Cause-System does not allow the Contract End Date to have Unlimited validity. This is the system behaviour.-Resolution-While creating the Customer Contract, you must specify the Contract End Date lesser than 31.12.9999 (for example: 30.12.9999)-Keywords-Customer Contract, Contract End Date; RULE_1000095803_C; CONTRACT_EDATE ; _RULE__RULE_1000095803_S_C; Migration of, /ISDT/CX_INVALID_DATETIME

Title: Reverse Charge Mechanism Financial Postings in Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You expect the Output IGST RCM Tax General Ledger account must be picked up instead of Output IGST Tax in the Reverse Charge Mechanism Tax Postings for the Supplier Invoices in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing workcenter.-Navigate to the Invoices and Credit memos view.-Search for the Invoice XXX(XXX refers to the Invoice number/id).-Further Navigate to Document Flow, you find the relevant Journal entry with the postings below postings:-Output IGST Tax Debit.-Input RCM IGST Tax Credit.-You expect the Output IGST RCM Tax General Ledger account must be picked up instead of Output IGST Tax.-Cause-System Behaviour-Resolution-The General Ledger accounts are correctly picked up for the Invoice XXX. The Payable Tax Split item amount will go to output IGST tax General Ledger account which is defined in the Account Determinationand in this Output IGST tax.-The Input Tax which is the Receivable tax split item is the one which is Deferred as because the Checkbox of the Tax payment Deferred is checked. This amount should go to the Input Deferred General Ledger accounts and is posted correctly Input RCM IGST tax General Ledger account.-The Output tax will not be Deferred, Hence the Output Deferred tax General Ledger account will never be impacted.-Keywords-Reverse Charge Mechanism, RCM, Input tax, Output tax, Deferred

Title: Not Receiving E-Mail Notifications
Content: Symptom- You have noticed that the e-mail notifications are not coming to the e-mail address you have maintained.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the OWL screen of the affected Business Document.-Click New.-Click Notification.-Enter details and Save. -Then go to the Home work center.-Go to the Inbox view.-You notice the Notification in user X's Inbox, but the user X's not receiving the e-mail notification (X represents the name of the user executing this process).-Cause-User X has not subscribed to task  "<Notification: ID, Name or Description of the Object>" under Common Authorizations for Users in Task Subscriptions.-Resolution-Please subscribe to the aforementioned task by completing the following steps:-Go to the Home work center.-Go to the Inbox view.-Click "Subscribe to Tasks"-Expand "Home" dropdown menu.-Expand "Common Authorizations for Users" dropdown menu.-Check the box for "E-Mail" beside the task "<Notification: ID, Name or Description of the Object>".-Keywords-E-mail Notification, Subscribe to Tasks, Inbox.

Title: System Exception “Unexpected error during backend processing” While Opening any Activity in Business Configuration
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to make some changes in the activities in Business Configuration. Upon opening the activities from Overview or some Change Project in Business Configuration, an Exception occurs.--Unexpected error during backend processing-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity XYZ (where XYZ represents the activity)-Choose the required link to maintain the configurations-System loads for a while and throws an Exception-Cause-The tenant is an old configuration Change Test Tenant with a Change Project that is not working anymore, because the logical connection to the Production tenant is already cut off.-This connection is required in the current state of the tenant.-Resolution-You may choose one of the below Options:-Option 1:-You can create a new Change Project in Production and use Copy Solution Profile to copy it to this tenant. This will overwrite the current configuration in the tenant and re-establish a logical connection.-If your choice is Option 1, then you can trigger it yourself.-  Option 2:-To allow configuration changes in this tenant, it needs to be repaired. We will turn this tenant into a normal Test tenant with the current configuration. This will prevent the tenant from being used as BC Change Test tenant in future, but the configuration can be changed at will.--If Option 2 is required, you may report an case to SAP for us make the necessary changes in the tenant and remove the logical connection to the Production tenant. Thereafter, the Business Configuration will open as in non-BC test tenants.-Keywords-Change Test Tenant, Dump when opening Activity in Business Configuration

Title: 'Technical error FOP_TAXRPREG 025; create case' Error Message After Execution of VAT Return Run
Content: Symptom-After executing a VAT Return Run, you observe an error message in the application log:-Technical error FOP_TAXRPREG 025; create case-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks > VAT Return Runs subview.-Select the row of Run ID AAA (AAA means the VAT Return Run ID).-Open the concerned Application Log ID, which has Overall Status in red.-Go to Results tab.-Notice the error message:-Technical error FOP_TAXRPREG 025; create case-The above error message will be followed by one or more error message(s) as:-Update of tax register for source document XYZ failed-XYZ means the respective Source Document ID.-Cause-You have executed the VAT Return Run for a past period (for example, from 01.01.2017 to 01.02.2017) and left the Posting Date field blank.-When you execute a VAT Return Run for a past period you should explicitly enter a Posting Date for which the books are opened.-Resolution-While creating a VAT Return Run, in the Control Parameter section you should enter a Posting Date which falls in an open accounting period.-Keywords-A1FOP_DUE_ITEM_MGMT:089; FOP_TAXADJ:012;

Title: Error Message: "Service call failed; report an case" While Migrating Registered Products
Content: Symptom-Your requirement is to migrate Registered Products in the system, but you receive the below error during the Simulation step:-"Service call failed; report an case"-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Registered Products.-Select Migrate registered products using the migration tool.-Upload the Migration File.-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records.-You receive the error message mentioned during the Simulation step.-Cause-There could be many causes that may lead to this issue.-You are using the Migration Mode 'Add New Records' for the existing Registered Products in the system.-The Product ID or the Account ID provided in the Migration File are not available in the system.-During Simulation of the Migration File, in the Convert Values step, for the task Edit Value Conversion for Warranty IDs, the correct Target values are not provided for Warranty IDs.-Resolution-Correct the data in the Migration File, revisit the Value Conversion for Warranty ID and proceed with the migration activity.-Note:-The Migration Modes Modify already existing records and Enhance already existing records are not available for the Migration of Registered Products.-You may update them manually in the system.-Keywords-Registered Products, Migration of Registered Products, Warranty ID

Title: Service Agent name is missing in the dropdown list for Requester/Recipient field in stand-alone Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Service agent is missing in the dropdown for selection under Requester/Recipient field in stand-alone purchase order however-if purchase order is created from shopping cart, service agent details are populated from cart to order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Select Self services overview-Select Go Shopping (advanced)-Create a shopping cart with service agent as requester/recipient and release the cart-> purchase request is created-Create purchase order from the purchase request-Go to Items tab-Under Delivery subtab, you will see that the fields Requester and Recipient are filled with service agent name.-Now Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Create New Purchase Order under Common tasks-Navigate to items->delivery sub-tab, search for the service agent name in the fields Requester and Recipient, the name is missing in the drop-down-The system will display "no records found"-Cause-Service agent is excluded from query as system expects that service agent should be someone who is actually processing the purchase request or purchase order which cannot be a Requester/recipient for delivery. Hence, it is not displayed in the drop-down list.-Resolution-You can always manually add service agent in the Requester/recipient field in purchase order. If you enter the service agent's ID in the field manually, it will populate the name.-Keywords-requester, recipient, purchase order, service agent missing in purchase order,delivery

Title: When Create A New Label and Preview, The Label Will Be Printed Automatically.
Content: Symptom-You create a new label and preview it, then click Save and Close, you will find the label has been printed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Access Lables under Common Tasks.-Click New Labels.-Add the Product ABC (ABC represents product ID).-Enter 1 in field Quantity on Label.-Click Save.-Select sub tab List of Labels.-Click Preview> Preview.-Click Save and Close.-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Access view Print Queues.-Select corresponding print queue, click Edit, you will find this label has been printed.-Resolution- This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Label, Preview, Print

Title: Customer Invoice Does Not Appear in the Effective Billing Rate Report
Content: Symptom-You have released the customer invoice based on time and material however system does not show the customer invoice in the effective billing rate report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Select Effective billing rate report -Select Edit and search with relevant customer invoice -No records found-Cause-The report effective billing rate is meant for time recordings that are invoiced according to "time and material", the report provides the net value invoiced divided by the sum of invoiced and written-off hours recorded. The affected customer invoice has been already cancelled and not available for invoicing. Hence it does not show in the effective billing rate report.-Resolution-Make sure that customer invoice is created with reference to time recordings that are invoiced according to "time and material" and Released. Or You can use any other report like Revenue by Team Member which provides the requested data.-Keywords-Customer invoice not appear in Effective billing rate report; Effective billing rate report;

Title: Error "You Are Not Authorized to Change the Data" While Trying to Edit Time Sheet on Self Services Overview
Content: Symptom-You are trying to edit your Time Sheet on Self Services Overview from Home work center, but you are receiving the following error/warning messages:-"You are not authorized to change the data-Time profile has been created; Please save changes before proceeding"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center;-Under Time section, click on Edit Time Sheet;-Receive error/warning messages.-Cause-The error occurs because your Time Profile information was created, but not yet saved by you.-Resolution-To start recording times, it is necessary to first save your time sheet, without entering any data. To solve the error, click on Save, without changing anything. Close the Time Sheet and open it again. After doing that, your calendar will show up and you will be able to record your times.-In case this does not solve the issue, please create an SAP incident to check if a backend correction is required.-Keywords-Edit Time Sheet, Error, Not Authorized, Change the Data, Employee Self Services, Self Services Overview-time profile has been created,please save changes before proceeding,you are not authorized to change the dat

Title: Academic Title Displayed Following The Employee Name While Creating New Sales Order/Sales Report
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create new sales order/sales report, but while selecting Employee Responsible, you find the Academic Title shows following the employee name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-New Sales Order view.-Select any employee as Employee Responsible (e.g employee ABC).-You will see the Academic Title is displayed following the employee name (e.g ABC Master).-Cause-Name Format in General Business Partners activity under Business Configuration work center is not maintained.-Resolution-You need to maintain Name Formats in General Business Partners activity under Business Configuration work center.-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Search for activity General Business Partners and Open.-Maintain Name Formats.-Maintain Name Formats for the relevant Country/Region like First Name+Middle Name+Last Name without Academic Title.-Save.-If it still not works, you can verify if dummy change helps to resolve the issue as changes to Name Formats will not be used for existing names automatically.-Hence you can change the employee name temporarily and then change back which will trigger the Name Formats you maintained.-Keywords-Academic Title, Employee Name, Name Format

Title: How to set up Default Gross Price for a Specific Sales Unit
Content: Symptom-You would like to default the Price In Gross in your Sales Document for a specific Sales Unit.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-You can default the pricing procedure from net to gross based on the distribution channel in the fine tune activity Configure Price Strategy.-You can then set up an organizational work distribution rule for the respective Sales Unit via the work category Relevant Distribution Channels.-Resolution-You can default the pricing procedure from net to gross based on the distribution channel in the fine tune activity Configure Price Strategy:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Select your Implementation Project and click on the Open Activity List button.-Navigate to the Fine Tuning Tab and open the Fine Tuning Activity Configure Price Strategy.-Click on the Default Gross Pricing hyperlink.-Here you can default the pricing procedure from net to gross based on the distribution channel.-You can then set up an organizational work distribution rule for the respective Sales Unit via the work category Relevant Distribution Channels:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Select the Organizational Work Distribution view.-Select the Work Category Relevant Distribution Channels-You can define work distribution rules according to which the system determines the relevant distribution channels for a sales unit.-See Also-Help Center Document Gross Pricing-KBA 2204067 - Default Gross Rule is Copied from Base Document to Target Instead of Determined From Business Configuration-Keywords-Default; Price In; Gross; Sales Unit; Company; Defaulting; Gross Price; Distribution Rule; Net Pricing; Gross Pricing; Net Price;

Title: Purchase Order Approval task is Not Automatically Approved when Buyer Responsible and Approver is same person
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order where approval is triggered based on cost center related approval rule to cost center manager who is also Buyer Responsible for the order.-You expected the task to be automatically approved as it is for same person and self approval is scoped but the task remains unassigned and pending. You need to manually assign the task and complete the approval.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Select view Purchase Orders-The buyer responsible is A and Purchase order is assigned to cost center, where cost center manager is also A (A refers to both cost center manager and buyer responsible)-Navigate to Approvals tab-The task is pending and unassigned-Cause-Here the buyer responsible of the purchase order is the cost center manager and based on the approval rule, he/she is responsible to approve the order. But the task is unassigned because system cannot assign the task to the person who is both approver and buyer responsible.-Note: If the Creator, Requestor, or Recipient / Buyer Responsible and the approver are same, then these users are filtered out from the list of approvers. (e.g.If Manager is creating a shopping cart / purchase order on behalf of employee)-The task will not be auto approved because:-You have scoped self-approval. Self-Approval for Purchase Orders means that system will send task to approver only when he/she is direct approver, in this case, user (buyer responsible) would have got it if he/she was a direct approver and should approve the task. It only works for "Direct Approvers" scenario and will not bypass approval.-You have also set this Business Configuration activity:Purchasing: Purchase Request and Order Management: Purchase Orders: Purchase Order Approvals: "If you want that the buyer responsible or creator should not receive the approval task for purchase order and purchase order items", you have selected the respective checkboxes, hence the respective person will not get the task even if he/she is determined as approver.-Resolution-You are expecting the task to be automatically approved. In this case, you need to set "Automatic Approval" checkbox in the approval rule for purchase order.-With this checkbox, system will bypass the approval task if both buyer responsible and cost center manager is the same person who is determined as approver.-Note:-If the Automatic Approval checkbox is selected, no approval task is created and the purchasing document will be processed.-If the Automatic Approval checkbox is not selected, then an Unassigned Task is created in such cases.-Keywords-automatic approval, self approval, purchase order approval task unassigned, buyer responsible, cost center manager, approval by cost assignment

Title: Product Category Hierarchy Simulation Keep Showing 25% Progress for a Long Time
Content: Symptom-When you are migrating Product Category Hierarchy, Import Simulation keep showing 25% progress even after a hour.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign, SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation Projects view or Overview-Search and Open the activity Product Category Hierarchy-Select Migrate product category hierarchy using the migration tool-Upload the Migration File-Execute Migration for the respective Migration File with Migration Mode Add new records-Cause-The cause for the issue could be:-1.  The data of Product Hierarchy in template lead to endless loop.-2.  ROOT may not be entered in the template since the node ROOT will be created by the system automatically.-Resolution-Report an case to SAP with your approval to Cancel the stuck Product Category Hierarchy migration.-Thereafter, correct the data in the Migration Template for Product Category Hierarchy as below and Execute the Migration.-Note:-1. Product Category ID is a key field and is recommended not to maintain the key field values as 0.-In the backend while processing the data, the Data conversions will happen, during which 0 will be considered as a NULL value. Due to this, many inconsistencies would occur in further usages of this field.-2.  Product Category IDs should be created as parent itself on the first level, that means the field Parent Product Category ID must be initial and may not be filled with its own Product Category ID.-For Example, your root hierarchy is Product Category ID 1 then the information in the Template should be filled as Product Category ID: 1 and Parent Product Category ID should left empty. (You will see after simulation the Parent Category ID gets filled automatically by the system)-3. If you are creating a Product Category A which is the child of Root then do not enter any value in the Parent Product Category ID.-4. If you are creating a Product Category X which is a child of another Product Category Y then make sure that Product Category Y is already entered in the Template.-5. If you are creating a Product Category X which is a child of another Product Category Y then that ID Y should be maintained in the field Parent Product Category ID.-Keywords-Product Category Hierarchy, Product Category ID, Parent Product Category ID.

Title: Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 108; Report an Incident When Removing Target Group Assignment from Marketing Data
Content: Symptom-In the Marketing tab of account master data, when trying to remove the existing target group assignment, the system gives the error Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 108; Report an case.- Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and enter XXX in the Find field. (XXX represents the ID of the account).-Navigate to the Marketing Tab.-Select a target group.-Select Remove Target Group Assignment.-The system gives the error Technical Error AP_ESI_COMMON 108; Report an case.-Cause-The status of the selected target group is set to obsolete. In this case, the system does not allow the user to remove or add any members to this target group.-Resolution-Go to the Marketing Work Centre.-Go to the Target Groups View.-Show All Target Groups and enter XXX in the Find field. (XXX represents the ID of the Target Group).-Click Change Status and change the status to active or blocked.-Now the target group assignment can be removed from the marketing tab of respective account master data.- Keywords-Target group; marketing tab; remove target group assignment; account master data; contact; marketing data

Title: Error Occurs When Trying to Edit a Custom Field on a Standard SAP UI Screen
Content: Symptom-You have enhanced a standard SAP UI screen in the SAP Cloud Application Studio SDK by adding fields to a facet in a standard SAP UI Thing Inspector screen (TI screen). However, when you attempt to edit the custom field on that standard SAP UI screen, you are receiving an error or a dump:-An error occrred. If the error occurs after restarting the screen, open an case.-The details of the error will say:-500 SAP Internal Server Error.-ERROR: No access possible via a 'NULL' data reference. (termination: RABAX_STATE).-Environment-SAP Cloud Application Studio SDK (All Versions).-SAP Hybris Cloud For Customer.-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Open the affected Work Center.-Open the affected View.-Open an instance.-Select the Edit button.-Attempt to edit your custom field on this standard SAP UI screen.-Errors will occur.-Cause-The cause of this NULL reference issue, is that a binding is missing in the UI Designer.-Resolution-Please ask your partner to check the binding for this custom field on this standard SAP UI screen.-If you are the partner, and you are unsure if the binding is correct, you can compare the binding to the other fields on the standard screen.-Please note, if the field has been added to a AdvancedListPane, open Default Set Mapping and ensure Find Form is set to 'FindFormPane' and not to 'None'.-If a binding is not set, or set to none, it can cause this NULL reference error.-Keywords-NULL reference, SAP UI Screen, PDI, Field, Error, Exception, Dump, Binding, AdvancedListPane, OVS

Title: Bank Statement Item Details Report - Inconsistent Transaction Amount Display - Known Limitations
Content: Symptom-The Bank Statement Item Details report (Report ID FINPAYU07_Q0001) displays incorrect values in the Transaction Amount column for payment.-This occurs for clearings against multiple items directly when post-processing a bank statement or in clearings when payments are confirmed through a bank statement item.-Listed scenarios result in deviating values for Transaction Amount and actual bank statement item transaction amount:-Payment Allocation against duplicate G/L Accounts:-In a Payment Allocation, the complete single bank statement item transaction amount is allocated in the Allocation to G/L Account tab to several G/L Accounts. For duplicate G/L Account assignments the line item with the greatest value will show in the Bank Statement Item Details report.-Example: In Bank Statement Item XX/X (XX/X represents the Bank Statement Item External ID) Transaction amount 1.000,00 EUR is to be allocated:-Allocation to G/L Account in the Payment Allocation:-In the Bank Statement Item Details report only the split item with the greatest value, i.e. -600,00 EUR is displayed:-     2.  Payment Confirmation posted against duplicate G/L Accounts:-This applies to incoming as well as outgoing payments (e.g. Bank Transfer, Payment Advice, Check) with Direct Posting to G/L Account selected as Payment Application Method.-The transaction amount is split between line items. Duplicate G/L Account assignments exist.-In the report the line item with the greatest value will show for the duplicate G/L Account assignments:-Example:-Bank Debit Advice XYZ (XYZ represents the Bank Debit Advice ID) is to allocate 780,00 EUR via Direct Posting to G/L Account.-Duplicate G/L Account line items exist in Debit and Credit:-  Bank Statement Item YY/Y confirms the transaction amount of -780,00 EUR of Bank Debit Advice XYZ.-The Bank Statement Item report only displays the greatest amount of each G/L Account in the Transaction Amount column:-     3.  Refund to Employer/Application of Credit Memo in Expense Report and Payment Confirmation:-In case a Credit Memo is directly associated with an Expense Report (e.g. subtraction of per diems) only the credit memo amount is shown in the report:-Example:-Expense Report ABC (ABC represents the expense report ID) to reimburse 448,00 EUR is approved and posted. After approval, an amount of 12,00 EUR (from per diems) is to be refunded to the employer.-After re-approving the expense report with the updated reimbursement amount of -446,00 EUR a credit memo of 12,00 EUR referencing to Expense report ABC appears in the Employee Account Monitor.-Also outgoing payment DEF (DEF represents the payment ID) appears here:-The Outgoing payment amount of 436,00 EUR is fully allocated in Bank Statement Item AA/A.-The Bank Statement Item Details report, however, only displays the Credit Memo Transaction Amount of -12,00 EUR and not 436,00 EUR:-"Image/data in this KBA is from SAP internal systems, sample data, or demo systems. Any resemblance to real data is purely coincidental." -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Liquidity Management work center navigate to the Reports – List view.-Open the Bank Statement Item Details report.-Fill all mandatory fields, i.e. Statement ID and Bank Account.-Press Go.-The Transaction Amount of the respective bank statement item displayed is not the same as the transaction amount maintained in the actual Bank Statement item.-To compare the displayed amount with the Bank Statement item amount-Go to the Bank Statements view of the Liquidity Management work center.-Find the respective Bank Statement and press View to open it.-In the Bank Statement navigate to the Transactions tab to check the Bank Statement items.-Resolution-The outlined limitations are planned to be addressed in future SAP Business ByDesign releases.-For now we advise to carefully review report and actual statement transaction amounts.-Please report a case to SAP Support if you experience incorrect Transaction Amount display in the Bank Statement Item Details report for scenarios not listed above.-Keywords-Bank Statement Items Details; FINPAYU07_Q0001; Transaction Amount; Bank Statement item; G/L Account; payment confirmation; payment allocation

Title: System Displays Incorrect Buyer Responsible Name in Purchase Request Screen
Content: Symptom-You have changed the employee name of buyer responsible. However when you create a new purchase request, system shows the old name in the Purchase Request main screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Requests view-Select the relevant Purchase Request-You can see Buyer Responsible appears with old name-Cause-The buyer responsible person name is pulled from the personnel administration work center. When you edit the personnel file of an employee under Personal Data tab, go to Biographical data, here you have maintained the first name and last name with old name. Hence system shows incorrect buyer responsible name in purchase request document.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to fix the problem;-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Employees view-Select the relevant employee and select edit-Navigate to Personal Data tab and Biographical Data sub tab-Remove the latest entry which has old name-Select Add Row and enter the first and last name with updated details-Select Save and Close-Keywords-Incorrect Buyer Responsible Name in Purchase Request Screen; System shows old name of employee;  Old name of buyer responsoble;name of buyer responsible incorrectly displayed

Title: Cannot Release Customer Invoice Due to Special Character
Content: Symptom-You are trying to release a customer invoice, but system gives dump (500 system error).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invocie Documents view.-Edit the customer invoice ABC. (ABC represents the ID of the customer invoice).-Click Release button, you get 500 system error and not able to release it.-Cause-In this case, the dump is caused due to special character used in the Customer Information section.-For exmpale, the character like 😉 ❤️ 🚚.-Resolution-Remove the special character from customer information. Then, try to release it.-Keywords-Customer Invoice; release; dump; CX_SY_CONVERSION_CODEPAG; Exception 'CX_SXMLP' caught by class 'CL_SPAF_ESF_ADAPTER'.

Title: Print Queues can not be edited
Content: Symptom-You have many queued documents in a printer queue and you want to delete them by first clicking on edit but the system triggers a dump.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Application and User Management work center.-Open the Print Queues view.-Cause-Due to the high amount of queued documents the system triggers a dump.-Resolution-Open an case and adress it to the SAP Client Infrastructure team. Please provide us until which date you wish us to remove the queued documents. All the documents up to that date will be removed from all print queues. The solution cannot be restricted to a specific print queue.-After Cloud Support removes the queued documents as requested it's highly recommended to set up the Output Scenario to Save to File to prevent this in the future.-Keywords-Printer Queue, Queued documents, Printing, dump, Fehlermeldung, Error message

Title: Unable to Discard the Outbound File due to Error Please try Resuming Your Work. If You Still Face Issues, Report an Incident
Content: Symptom-You are not able to discard the outbound file due to the error, Please try resuming your work. If you still face issues, report an case.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under File Management select Outbound Files.-Select the File ID and select Actions > Discard.-Cause-Go to Liquidity Management work center.-Under File Management select Outbound Files.-Click on the File ID and navigate to Attachment.-Open the xml file from the outbound files and take a note of  the payment id which is next to the tag </PmtID>.-Search for the payment in the Payment Management work center and in payment monitor view.-You see the payment is currently Canceled Status and if you edit the payment and refer to the change log, you notice that the payment status will be rejected and revoked to ready for transfer or cancel.-Whenever the payment is rejected, then the link with the outbound file will be broken resulting which even the cancellation of the payment doesnt dicard the outbound file automatically or manually.-Resolution-A manual correction from SAP side is needed to correct discard the outbound file.-You have to create an case with SAP with the permission to discard the outbound file.-To avoid such instances, you should try to avoid reject of the payments and discard the outbound file first and proceed with the cancelation of the relevant payment.-Keywords-Outbound file error, unable to discard outbound file-outbound file error,unable to discard outbound file

Title: OData Query is Resulting in Zero Results or Limited Data
Content: Symptom-An OData request for the standard Sales Order Volume report returns no data or only limited data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Execute an OData request for the standard Sales Order Volume report using the analytics OData service.-https://myXXXXXXX.sapbyd.cn/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPCRMSLOIB_MQ0001QueryResults?-The OData request returns zero results or limited data.-Cause-Report execution through OData requests always gets executed only for initial selection, that is, the parameters which are maintained in the report metadata.-The default selection, such as Employee Responsible = Employee – My User Name, in the browseris therefore applied during OData execution.-Hence the OData request is also not retrieving any data or retrieving limited data.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-The following options are available to retrieve the required data:-Create a copy of the Sales Order Volume report and adjust the selection criteria as required. The variables and default selections can be maintained according to the reporting requirement.-Overwrite the initial selection in the OData query by providing the required selection value. For example to run the query: https://myXXXXXXX.sapbyd.cn/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPCRMSLOIB_MQ0001QueryResults?-To change the Employee Responsible selection, use the field PARA_CRMSLOIB_REP_02 in the OData filter: $filter=(PARA_CRMSLOIB_REP_02 eq 'ABC'-https://myXXXXXXX.sapbyd.cn/sap/byd/odata/ana_businessanalytics_analytics.svc/RPCRMSLOIB_MQ0001QueryResults?$filter=(PARA_CRMSLOIB_REP_02 eq 'ABC') (where ABC represents the Employee ID))-See Also-Blog: OData for SAP Business ByDesign Analytics-Help document: Retrieving Analytics Data Using OData-Keywords-OData; Report; Sales Order Volume; Employee Responsible;  Zero Results; Limited Data

Title: Unable to change termination or hire date - changes are not taken over
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to change the termination or hire date of an employee to a later date. The change is not recognised by the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example:-Go to work center Personnel AdministrationGo to view Employees-Search for the employee-Open the employee's personnel file by clicking the button Edit-Navigate to Employment tab and Work Agreement subtab-As Effective Date,  you will find the current termination date value -Push the button Change Termination Date -Enter the new termination date value and confirm the change.-You will still see the old value instead of the changed value-Save and close the employee.-Final result: You will still see the old termination date value instead of the changed value-Cause-When Personnel Administration is in scope, technical personnel administration hiring and terminating instances get created. But the affected  employee was e.g. hired, while Master Data Replication (MDR) was in scope. This means, the technical hiring and terminating instances were not get created as per design.-In the meantime, the system has moved from MDR to Personnel Administration. During any termination date change, the system looks for those technical hiring and terminating PAD instances. Since these are missing, the system does not allow the change. This is a feature gap and will be taken care in future product backlog.-A similar situation happens after an employee was e.g. hired via EC integration-Resolution-As a work-around, if you want to extend an employment (change termination date to a later one), re-hire the affected employee and terminate the employee at the desired date.-As a work-around, if you want to move the start of an employment (change hire date to a later one), change the service start date accordingly.  This way, employee's service will be calculated from the changed service start date. -Keywords-EC integration, unable, does not work, impossible, unable, change

Title: Customer Return Inbound Delivery Not Updated After Multiple Warehouse Adjustments
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-You want to know in a Customer return scenario where after the user performed multiple WH adjustments, the end result is that the Confirmed Inbound Delivery has fulfilled qty of zero (expected) and delivery processing status as ""In Process"" (not expected, not started is expected here).-Therefore, the status is not ""Not Started"", the cancellation button is disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics workenter.-Go to Inbound Deliveries view.-Find required Confirmed Inbound Delivery ID.-Select it, cancel option is grayed out.-Cause-Unable to perform cancellation as status is “In Process”, the cancellation button is disabled.This is because the delivery processing status doesn’t change after warehouse adjustment confirmation from "In Process" to “Not started” .-Resolution-Pre-checks:-The CID and IDN had an incorrect delivery processing status.-The status was “in process” whereas it should have been “not started”.-Check status of Warehouse order.It should be Finished with 0 fulfilled qty.-This should be an inbound non 3PL customer return scenario.-Note : If you get such case, forward it to AP-CRP-Backend Correction steps:-1.      Change the Processing status to “Not Started “in the Database table of Root node for both CID and IDN.-  CID BO- APDL_D_CID_ROOT-Root DB table – APDL_D_CID_ROOT-  IDN BO -  APDL_INBOUND_DELIVERY-Root DB table - APDL_D_IDE_ROOT-  To reflect correct status in OWL ,make same changes in the corresponding FSI table of the node by reloading the individual  node instance using report ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL.-We have a Z report where we can load individual node IDs instead of reloading the entire FSI table.- The Report is ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL and it is available in QCH. It required BO name (PDM_INDIVIDUAL_PRODUCT in our case) , BO Node Name would be COMMON and please check the Node ID from sesfts.-If the report doesnt exists in the customer system, you can create a Z report by simply copying the above report and can execute the same. Code for the same is attached at the end of the document.-  Post-Checks:-Cancel button is enabled.-Delivery Processing status is set to “Not Started”.-  CODE:-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-*& Report  ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL-*&-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-*&-*&-*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*-  REPORT ZSTS_FSI_RELOAD_INDIVIDUAL.-  DATA:-  lo_fsi_replication_instance TYPE REF TO if_fsi_replication_instance,-  lv_node_id                  TYPE char70,-  lt_node_id                  TYPE sesf_bo_node_id_tab,-  lv_invalid_so               TYPE abap_bool.-  PARAMETERS:-  p_bo                        TYPE mdrs_v_prx_mo_prx_name DEFAULT 'PRO_PROJECT',     " if_pro_project=>co_bo_name,-  p_bon                       TYPE string DEFAULT 'TASK'.            " if_pro_project_bo_template_sp=>co_bo_node-root,-  SELECT-OPTIONS:-  so_nid                      FOR (lv_node_id)            DEFAULT 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'.-  PARAMETERS:-  p_dele                      TYPE abap_bool AS CHECKBOX  DEFAULT abap_false.-    TRY.-      " this report supports individual node IDs only-    LOOP AT so_nid INTO DATA(ls_nid).-      IF ls_nid-sign <> 'I' OR-         ls_nid-option <> 'EQ'.-        WRITE:  / 'This report supports the selection of single values only; FSI not updated'.-        lv_invalid_so = abap_true.-        EXIT.-      ENDIF.-      APPEND ls_nid-low TO lt_node_id.-    ENDLOOP.-    IF lv_invalid_so = abap_true.-      EXIT.-    ENDIF.-      lo_fsi_replication_instance =-      cl_fsi_replication_facade=>get_replication_proxy_instance(-        EXPORTING-          in_bo_name    = CONV #( p_bo )-          in_connection = CONV #( cl_omm_xtpa_generic=>gc_fsi_db_connection_name ) ).-      IF p_dele = abap_true.-        " delete secondary persistence-      lo_fsi_replication_instance->delete(-        EXPORTING-          iv_bo_node_name = CONV #( p_bon )-          it_node_ids     = lt_node_id ).-      ELSE.-        " update secondary persistence-      lo_fsi_replication_instance->modify(-        EXPORTING-          iv_bo_node_name = CONV #( p_bon )-          it_node_ids     = lt_node_id ).-      ENDIF.-    CATCH cx_fsi_agent_service_error INTO DATA(lx_fsi_agent).-      DATA(lv_text) = lx_fsi_agent->if_message~get_text( ).-    WRITE: lv_text.-    DATA(lv_longtext) = lx_fsi_agent->if_message~get_longtext( ).-    WRITE: / lv_longtext.-    WRITE: / 'Error occured; FSI not updated'.-    EXIT.-  ENDTRY.-  WRITE: 'FSI updated for:'.-WRITE: / 'BO ', p_bo.-WRITE: / 'BO Node ', p_bon.-LOOP AT lt_node_id INTO lv_node_id.-  WRITE: / 'Instance with Node ID ', lv_node_id.-ENDLOOP.-  Keywords-Customer return, inbound delivery, warehouse adjustments, Not Started.

Title: Error: Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Output Product
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use only**-When you are trying to perform adjustment confirmation against production lot system throws below errors:--Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Output Product OPXXX-Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Input Product IPXXX  (Here OPXXX and IPXXX are input products)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation workcenter.-Go to Production Lots view.-Find required Lot ID and choose Adjustment Confirmation.-Select the task and choose subtab Supply to Production.-Select relevant Product and choose Enable Entry for task.-Now Remove the Serial Number.-Here system throws above errors.-Cause-Even though the confirmation of the supply task have all the ‘N’ serial numbers, there is one missing in the production lot serial number assignment.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-Number of Serial numbers not same in the Supply Task and Production Lot Serial Number Assignment.-Note : If you get such case, kindly send it to development component: AP-PE-LOT-Backend Correction steps:-Manually add the missing SN via SESFTS in Production Lot Serial Number Assignment Node.-Tcode – SESFTS-Business Object – PRODUCTION_LOT-Open the corresponding Production Lot corresponding to the Production Task-Navigate to the node Serial Number Assignment.-Choose new row icon.-Fill the details of the missing serial number from the supply task.-Save it. -Post-Checks:-Serial numbers added.-  Keywords-serial number missing, Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for Output Product ,Serial Number and Quantity mismatch for input Product, production lot,

Title: Mismatch of Surcharge in Sales Order and corresponding Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You notice that in the Pricing Tab of your Customer Invoice, the amount for Price Component: Surcharge is not same as the Surcharge amount which is added in Sales Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order XXX (XXX is the ID of the Sales Order).-Navigate to Tab Pricing and Invoicing.-Under Total Pricing, you can see that the Surcharge is 10 EUR (10 EUR is used as an example of the Surcharged fixed Amount).-Now Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Open the corresponding Customer Invoice YYY (YYY is the ID of the Customer Invoice created with reference to Sales Order XXX).-In the Invoice,under Pricing Tab, you see the Surcharge is not 10 EUR.-Cause-The Price Component Surcharge with a Fixed Amount added manually on Header level is distributed to the open items and the respective quantity.-For example:-You have a Sales Order with 2 items .-Line Item 10 and 20 each have the quantity 1 EA.-You maintain a Surcharge with 10 EUR on header level.-The distribution is 5 EUR for each item.-If you now deliver the items separately and then invoice the Outbound Delivery Requests separately each Invoice will have a Surcharge of 5 EUR maintained.-If you overdeliver e.g. line item 10 with the quantity of 2 EA instead of 1 EA and then invoice line item 10 with quantity 2 EA and line item 20 with the quantity of 1 EA the Surcharge will increase on the Invoice and the Surcharge in the Invoice will be 15 EUR.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-See Also-KBA 2677469 - Mismatch of Freight in Sales Order and corresponding Customer Inovice-Keywords-Surcharge; Fixed Amount; incorrect; different; Sales Order; Invoice; calculated; Pricing;

Title: Migration of Open Items Payable is Not Possible Because of the Error File Validation Failed
Content: Symptom-Migration of Open Items Payable is not possible because of the error File validation failed-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Choose  "Open Activity List" button.-Choose "Migration of Accounting Transaction Data"-Choose "Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool"-Choose Execute migration-Process the file under Open Item Payable-Received error: File validation failed. Create an incident- Cause-Some date entries are not maintained in correct format in the source file.-Resolution-In the source file, maintain the dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS before initiating the migration-Keywords-File validation failed, Migration of Accounting Transaction Data, Open Items Payable-open items payable,migration of accounting transaction data,file validation failed

Title: Employee Replicated with Incorrect Manager
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-The customer reports a situation where employees are replicated from Employee Central with the incorrect manager.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In order to ensure that employees are replicated with the correct manager, the replication of Reporting Line Units needs to be performed before the Employee replication.-Currently there are 2 replication jobs which are available for the employee replication:-Employee Central Query Run, which automatically queries and replicates reporting line units and employees.-Employee Replication Run, which only queries and replicates employees.-There is a possible scenario where the customer has both jobs scheduled to run with overlapping times. Due to this overlap, the Central Query Run job is not executed and the reporting line units are not updated, causing issues with manager assignments when only the employee replication is performed.-This can be checked by going to Application and User Management -> Background Jobs, then filtering for the replication jobs mentioned above.-Resolution-Customers can either cancel and remove the schedule of the Employee Replication Run or, if necessary, reschedule it to a different time.-This can be done following the below steps:-Go to Application and User Management.-Enter the Background Jobs view.-Open the advanced filter, and filter for "Employee Replication Run".-Click on the "Reschedule" button.-In the new screen, enter a new start time for the job.-Click on Save and Close.-The recommendation is that the start date of the jobs are at least 30 minutes apart, however this may vary depending on performance and data volume.-Keywords-Concur, EC, Integration

Title: Wrong Quantity in Supplier Invoice screen when changes are made to the invoicing period
Content: Symptom-You want to know why wrong vaues are appearing and how  to  get the correct  quantity in supplier invoice as per invoicing period.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create PO (Purchase order) with 3 items and quantity 1 each -Create GSR 1(goods and service receipt) ,  with Delivery date  Jan 1st, item 1 for quantity 1-GSR 2 and 3,  with Delivery dat feb 1st jan 1st respectively  ,for item 2, quantity 1  in each-GSR 4, with delivery date feb 1st, item 3  for quantity 1-Scenario 1:-"create invoice using PO ID ,click on view all-Go to item tab you will see 3 line items where all item has quantity 1,2,1 as expected on  items 1,2,3 respectively-Go to general tab and in the field  Invoicing period From/To as 2023-01-01 to 2023-01-31(January),click on check-Go to item tab you will see 3 line items where  quantity is  1,1,0 as expected on  items 1,2,3 respectively-Now  again go to general tab and change the invoicing period as 2023-02-01 to 2023-02-28( February),click on check-Go to item tab you will see 3 line items where  quantity is  0,0,0 on  items 1,2,3 respectively.-This is wrong we expect 0,1,1, however if you go to cost  distribution of  item 2, 3 you will see the GSR with quantity zero-"- or-Scenario 2:-"create invoice using PO ID, click on view all-Go to item tab you will see 3 line items where all item has quantity 1,2,1 as expected on  items 1,2,3 respectively-Go to general tab and in the field  Invoicing period From/To as 2023-02-01 to 2023-02-28( February),click on check-Go to item tab you will see 3 line items where  quantity is  0,1,1 as expected on  items 1,2,3 respectively-Now  again go to general tab and change the invoicing period as 2023-01-01 to 2023-01-31(January),click on check-Go to item tab you will see 3 line items where  quantity is  0,0,0 on  items 1,2,3 respectively.-This is wrong we expect 1,1,0, however if you go to cost distribution of  item 1, 2 you will see the GSR with quantity zero-"-The system doesn't recalculate correctly the quantities open for invoicing when the invoicing period is changed.-this means that the user has to start from scratch to enter the correct invoicing period.-Cause- Technical limitation and  its known issue.-Resolution-Kindly enter final (desired) invoicing period at once and do not change it later.- or-If you happen to change or want to change then close it and recrete it with desired invoicing period.-Note:Our developers confirmed that they have added this issue to their backlog and will fix it in one of the future releases.

Title: Cannot Extend Field Address Line 5 in Organizational Structure
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are unable to extend the field Address Line 5 from Organizational Structure in SDK.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management workcenter-Select Organization Structure view-Open selected structure-Select View All-Go to Addresses-Select Additional Fields-Check Address Line 5--It cannot be exposed in SDK--In backend :-Go to Tcode: MDRS or SESTS and query a standard BO - LOCATION:-Semantic Name        Location-ES Name              Location-ES Namespace         http://sap.com/xi/AP/FO/Location/Global-Process Component    LOCATION_DATA_MANAGEMENT-Deployment Unit      FOUNDATION-BO - ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT-NODE - POSTAL_ADDRESS-Package - AP_FO_ADDRESS_PRX-Field unavailable.-Go to Tcode: MDRS-BO - /MOM/ORG_CENTRE-NODE:-ROOT --ADDRESS_INFORMATION AddressInformation NODE ROOT --ADDRESS Address ASSOCIATION ADDRESS_INFORMATION-Address.ROOT Root NODE ADDRESS-Associations-FORMATTED_ADDRESS_V1 FormattedAddressV1 ASSOCIATION Address.ROOT-Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS_V1 FormattedAddressV1 NODE FORMATTED_ADDRESS_V1-Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS FormattedAddress NODE_ELEMENT Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS_V1-Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS-FIRST_LINE_DESCRIPTION FormattedAddress/FirstLineDescription NODE_ELEMENT-Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS-SECOND_LINE_DESCRIPTION FormattedAddress/SecondLineDescription NODE_ELEMENT-Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS-THIRD_LINE_DESCRIPTION FormattedAddress/ThirdLineDescription NODE_ELEMENT-Address.FORMATTED_ADDRESS-FOURTH_LINE_DESCRIPTION FormattedAddress/FourthLineDescription NODE_ELEMENT-You can see only till Fourth Line-Fifth Line does not exist.-Cause-The field Address Line 5 on the address snapshot EC in the MOM UI is linked to the backend field ADDITIONAL_STREET_SUFFIX_NAME of node POSTAL_ADDRESS. In SDK the customer would have to select this field if he wants to get the same information as provided on the UI.-If this field is displayed as empty, the data in the backend.-For the specific Org Unit there are multiple address snapshot instances in the system, only the latest one holds this information.-Check in following steps:-Backend Tcode : SESFTS Testshell-BO ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT-Node OrganisationalCentre - Root-Select the Org ID-Navigate to Expand Address Sanpshot - Root-Resolution-You should use the most recent Address Snapshot.-Keywords-Address Snapshot, Address Line 5, Org Structure

Title: Leading Sales Document Item Cannot be Changed for a Project's Fix Price Sales Order Items
Content: Symptom-You create Customer Project with Sales Integration ABC involving numerous fix-price sales order items (ABC represents the project ID). -You assign accrual method 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC to these items. Automatically item  XYZ-XX is generated as leading sales document item to bundle all costs and revenues of the project (XYZ-XX represents the leading sales document item ID). -You need to cancel the sales order item and now want the functionality to assign a new item as Leading Sales Order item. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Open the Advanced search.-In the Project ID field enter ABC.-Press Go. -Numerous sales order items appear for which sales order item XYZ-XX appears as Leading Sales Document item in the Accounting Data tab. -Item XYZ-XX got cancelled and is now completed. -You now want to change the Leading Sales Document item for the project. -Cause-The leading sales order item is selected randomly when accrual method 108 gets assigned to the fix-price sales order items of a customer project.-It is not possible to choose a desired sales order item as leading item (automatically or manually). It is determined by the system.-Even after completing the item that was generated as leading item, the system does not automatically determine a new leading item.-In general, the leading item works just as a place holder for aggregating all the postings on project level: Even after the item is completed it is possible for the revenue recognition run to process the item to recognize the project's costs and revenues.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour. -Keywords-revenue recognition, change leaading sales document item, 108-Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC

Title: Following Error Occurs in a Contract: Time frame Unlabeled Timeframe(1): Start date must be before end date
Content: Symptom-The following error occurs in a Contract:-Time frame Unlabeled Timeframe(1): Start date must be before end date (Unlabeled Timeframe(1) represents the name of the Time fame)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Open Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the ID of the Contract).- The following error occurs: -Time frame Unlabeled Timeframe(1): Start date must be before end date-Cause-The error “Time frame Unlabeled Timeframe(1): Start date must be before end date” in Contract XYZ occurs because there is an Invoicing Time Frame in the Invoice Schedule that has no Start Date and End Date or the Start Date and End Date don't fall within the Contract Start and End Date.-Resolution-To solve the issue, remove the Invoicing Time Frame via the Remove button.-You can do this as follows:-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Open Contract XYZ.-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoice Schedule sub tab.-Click on the Edit Invoicing Time Frame button.-In the Invoicing Time Frames section that select Unlabeled Timeframe(1).-In the Details section you can see that the Start Date and End Date is not filled and therefore not valid and does not fall between the Contract Start and End Date or that the Start Date and End Date do not fall within the Contract Start and End Date. -Click on the Remove button. -The error will not occur anymore.-If you wish to maintain a time frame for an invoice schedule you can click on Add Row and enter the respective parameters with the Start Date and End Date that lies between the Contract Start and Contract End date.-Keywords-Time frame; Unlabeled Timeframe; Start date must be before end date; Start Date; End Date; Contract Item Start Date; Contract Item End Date; Invoice Schedule;
