Content: EXTRACT_ERROR

Title: Incorrect Numbering Format While Creating Scanned Invoices
Content: Symptom-System allocates incorrect numbering range while creating scanned invoices for user ABC. Here user ABC belongs to company MNC but the user is uploading invoice for company XYZ.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login with user ABC-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Click on Upload button-Enter company XYZ and upload the pdf document-System creates invoice for company MNC -Cause-When the user ABC uploads the pdf file, in the scanned values system takes incorrect buying company MNC and hence the incorrect numbering format.-Resolution-When you provide company as XYZ during scanning, it is changing to MNC while creating invoice, not only this company XYZ, if you replace any company it will overwrite with MNC. Because there is org setup for that employee XYZ where company and bill-to will automatically define while creating invoice. Even if you try to create a new invoice without reference to purchase order or with reference to purchase ordere in the supplier invoice work center, Company and Bill-To will be defaulted to company MNC only. System is working as expected.-Keywords-incorrect numbering range while creating scanned invoices; Incorrect company while creating scanned invoice;

Title: Error message: 'No valid offsetting acct found for source account' during termination of employee
Content: Symptom-When trying to end the Relationship with an Employee, the following error message pops up. It is neither clear what is causing the error nor how to solve it:-Error message: 'No valid offsetting acct found for source account ABC  (xx.xx.xxx - yy.yy.yyyy) on zz.zz.zzzz' (where ABC represents a time account and xx.xx.xxx/yy.yy.yyyy/zz.zz.zzzz represent dates)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration work center-Go to Regular Tasks view-Choose Terminate Relationship with Employee-Select the relevant employee and maintain Last Working Day and Termination Category-Save-Error: 'No valid offsetting acct found for source account ABC  (xx.xx.xxx - yy.yy.yyyy) on zz.zz.zzzz' -Cause-The issue might be caused by the following issue:-The Recurrence of the Time Account ABC is Annual xx.xx. - yy.yy. Originally, the Bookable From and To date of this Time Account ABC were defaulted to the same dates. However, they were then changed.-As a result, the Time Account ABC has Bookable From and To dates that are completely outside of the Time Account validity.  The validity of the Time Account and the bookable time frame do not match. The Validity is DDDD, but the Bookable From and To time frame from the same Time Account is EEEE (where DDDD and EEEE represent time frames).-These changes are outside of the scope of the available configurations for Time Accounts and have caused issues with the termination process.-Resolution-To overcome the situation,  specific actions to manually manipulate the Time Accounts are needed. After opening an SAP incident, support can verify the situation. -To prevent such issues, avoid according differences between Validity and Bookable From and To time frames.-See Also- KBA: 2299737 - Error in Day Closure Run: “Creation of period closure date for employee XYZ failed. No valid offsetting acct found for source account ABC (YYYY.MM.DD - YYYY.MM.DD) on YYYY.MM.DD”-Keywords-not possible, unable, does not work, not able, terminate

Title: Purchase Order Does not Appear When you Preview the Data Source Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order and sent to supplier. However when you check the data source Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details, purchase order does not appear.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Select the Purchase Order History report-Select the relevant purchase order-No records available-Cause-The report Purchase Order History is based on data source Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details.-There is a technical limitation which restricts few parameters and because of which records are getting filtered out. Selection parameter enhanced based on below status :-  All purchase orders without follow-up documents  -  Item delivery status - Not delivered  -  Item invoicing status - Not Started   -  Item invoicing status - Not Relevant-In the purchase order Goods and Services Receipt Expected check box is not selected and order was just sent to the supplier. So the delivery status is Not Relevant and Invoicing Status in Not Started. Hence the purchase order does not show in the report or neither in the data source.-Resolution-There is a technical limitation which restricts few parameters and because of which records are getting filtered out. There is a fallback selection at data source level for purchase order with status 'Item delivery status not delivered'. Its not possible to remove filter from data source level as it will have an impact on other reports using the same data source. This is the current system behaviour.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Purchase order does not show in Purchase Order History report; Purchase Order History report; Data Source Purchase Order Items with Extended Tracking Details

Title: Error Message: "Times with Time Types Actual Hours Worked and Allocated Working Time Collide on DD.MM.YYYY "
Content: Symptom-You receive an error message when you are adding a new time recording as "Times with time types Actual Hours Worked and Allocated working time collide on DD.MM.YYYY ".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Employees view.-Search for the Employee XYZ in edit mode and navigate to Employee Times.-Search and select the required DD.MM.YYYY, you can observe that there is no Time Recording from HH:MM to HH1:MM1.-Select Add a new row for the same date DD.MM.YYYY for the time HH2:MM2 and Activate it.-You receive an error as  "Times with time types Actual Hours Worked and Allocated working time collide on DD.MM.YYYY ".-Now navigate to Personal Administration work center.-Go to Analytical Reports.-Open the Report Employee Times and you can observe that there is a time record from HH:MM to HH1:MM1.-Cause-The possible causes are as below:-Time recording for employee XYZ was created on date DD.MM.YYYY from HH:MM to HH1:MM1 were the Time Recording is in Active status and the Approval is not necessary. If this record is modified then this time recording would not be released, and the changes would have been saved, which creates a time entry with Inactive status and the approval status is not yet started.--There could be an existing collision rule against Time Type ABC which will not allow the system to book productive hours in case of any active time recording already existing during that duration. Hence when the employee is trying to book a time recording using Time administration UI for the date DD.MM.YYYY for the time HH:MM to HH1:MM1 the system ends up in showing an error-Resolution-In order to book the time on  DD.MM.YYYY for the time HH2:MM2 the employee needs to take action on the time recording with pending changes as above. This time recording needs to be in active status. Post this the time recording can be done for the required date.-In case the user prefers to "Discard the changes" for the time recording, they cannot create a new time entry from HH2:MM2 on DD.MM.YYYY because of the existing collision rule.-Keywords-Time Recording, Time Types, Actual Hours, Allocated Working Time, Collision Rule-time recording,time types, actual hours, allocated working time,collision rule

Title: Unable to remove scoping question "Do you want your service agents to record absences without any approval workflow using employee self-service?"
Content: Symptom-In business configuration work center, after deselecting the question  "Do you want your service agents to record absences without any approval workflow using employee self-service?" from scoping, it is not possible to complete the implementation project. The following errors occur:-Error During Finish Project-Currently unable to finalize these scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings or the productive data.-If error messages are displayed, resolve them before you proceed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Implementation Projects view-Select the relevant project-Edit Project Scope-Go to Questions step-Expand  Human Resources > Time and Labor Management > Time Recording-Find the checkmark for the question: "Do you want your service agents to record absences without any approval workflow using employee self-service?"-Remove the checkmark-Click Next to last step and Finish-Errors appear-Cause-This question allows service agents to maintain absences. If the question is unchecked, then a service agent will not be able to maintain any absence using Self Service.-A veto check enables system to restrict the removal of selection of this question, if there are any absences maintained by any service agent.  And such absences exist in the system.-Resolution-Identify the  absences due to which the system is not allowing this deployment, and perform the following steps to remove them:-Login with Service agent's User ID and password (or ask service agent to login into the system)-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Service Overview   -Under Time, go to Maintain Absences-Select each and every line one by one and remove it for each year for which an absence is maintained.-After removing all the records, click on Save / Save and Close-Repeat the same steps for all the Service Agents mentioned above-After doing this, try doing scoping again and remove the question - Do you want your service agents to record absences without any approval workflow using employee self-service?-Click Next to last step and Finish-Keywords-uncheck, remove, removal, possible, impossible, change project, implementation, finish, checkmark,

Title: Error:Product assignment to the product category not permitted
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to cancel the Purchase order or  trying to resend the Purchase order for approval-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Product category has been changed in the product master data and  that new product category is not  check marked for "Product assignment allowed"- or-The old Category that is in the purchase order is not check marked for "Product assignment allowed"-Resolution-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center-Go to Product Categories view-Search for respective product category-Select the check box - Product Assignment Allowed for Product Categories. -Now click on send update button/Cancel button on the purchase order- Note: Once cancellation is done,you may uncheck "Product assignment allowed" against the old category.

Title: Cost Center or Profit Center is not available for the Selection under Account Assignment for Supplier Invoicing
Content: Symptom-Note: These screenshots are taken from SAP's internal system and if you find any data reference, would be coincidental.-This KBA helps you with the details on how the Cost Center will be made available for the Selection under Account Assignment for Supplier Invoicing during the creation of New Scanned Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You have created New Org Unit as XYZ by following the below steps:-Go to Organizational Management work center-Open Org Structure-Search with the Org Unit ID or Name as XYZ-You see Org Unit created successfully as shown below-Now you follow the steps to create the New Scanned Invoice,-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to common Tasks & Click on New Scanned Invoice-In the New Screen navigate to the Account Assignment section-Enter the Account Assignment Type select Cost Center -In the Cost Center filed try to enter XYZ as value it doesn't display the Cost center details or If you try to find the XYZ from the value help also it doesn't show up the XYZ Cost Center which is created as shown below-However, your expectation is to make the Org Unit XYZ made available for the selection.-Cause-Reason for this behaviour could be as follows:-Correct Definitions & Functions are not assigned to the Org Unit: XYZ -Inconsistencies in the Org Structure or Unit-Resolution-To get the Org Unit XYZ available for selection under Account Assignment type for the cost center, please assign the respective Definitions & Functions.-In this case request you to assign the-Definitions as Cost Center- Under Functions assign Customer Invoice & Supplier Invoicing.-This would help you to give the Cost Center XYZ for selection for the Cost Center under Account Assignment Type.-Note: If any of the Org Unit which you have created and if it is not available for the selection, please verify the assigned Definitions & Functions.-Even after performing the above changes, it is not available for the selection, please create incident to SAP Support to get assistance on the issue.-See Also- Further you can refer the KBA: 2710333 - Frequently Asked Questions on Business ByDesign Organizational Management-Keywords-Cost Center, Profit Center, Account Assignment Type, Scanned Invoice, Supplier Invoicing, Account Assignment, Cost Center Selection, Profit Center Selection, AP-OM

Title: Warning message: Credit memo ABC blocked for payments
Content: Symptom-You have marked the Customer Invoice / Credit memo for Payment Block and when you try to create a payment then the system shows warning message instead of error and allow you to create a payment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivable work center.-Click Customer Accounts view.-Select the Customer account and Click View.-Select the open document ABC and click Item Details.-Here, you have maintained Payment Block Reason and ticked Payment Block. -Go to Customer Accounts view and select the open Invoice ABC.-Click Pay Manually By - Outgoing Bank Transfer. -You will be navigated to Outgoing Bank Transfer screen and you see the warning message - Invoice ABC blocked for payments.-Maintain all the details and Post the payment. -The Payment is posted successfully.-Resolution-Basically, the Payment Block option is used, when you do not want the system to capture Invoice in the automatic Payment (Payment Run). If you create a Manual Payment, then the system shows only warning message instead of error and allow you to post the payment. The Payment Block option does not work for Manual Payment.-See Also-KBA 3305202 - Warning Message: Invoice ABC blocked for payments-Keywords-payment block, clearing, payment run

Title: Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group Product - delivery-based not supported for location of srv provision On-Site
Content: Symptom-When you add an Item with type NORM - Product - delivery-based in a Service Order and you receive the error message: Item XX: Products w/ item group Product - delivery-based not supported for location of srv provision On-Site-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center.-Select the Service Order Processing view-Press the New button and select the Service Order option.-Enter all respective data.-Press the View All button.-Go to Service and Spare Parts tab and enter product ABC (ABC represents the number of the product with item type NORM).-Following error message occurs:-Item XX: Products w/ item group Product - delivery-based not supported for location of srv provision On-Site (XX represents the line item number of the product)-Cause-The Item Type NORM is not supported in Service documents such as Service Orders but only in Sales documents such as Sales Orders.-In Service Documents the Item Type SHIP is used for products with advanced shipments.-The item group SHIP represents a spare part that is sold in an Order-to-Cash (Products) scenario or used within the Field Service and Repair scenario. If used within Field Service and Repair in service orders, the spare part is normally shipped to the customer before the service is carried out on-site.-Resolution-If you would like to use Material ABC in a Service Order you need to ensure that the Item Group maintained in the Product Master Data of the Material is maintained as SHIP - Spare part (advanced ship/sales) for the Sales Organization and Distribution Chain maintained in the Service Order.-See Also-For detailed explanation on all item types and the respective scenarios please see also help center document Services.-KBA 3215920 - Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group ABC not supported for location of srv provision XYZ-Keywords-NORM; item group; item type; not supported; location; service provision; srv provision; SHIP;

Title: Error: Creating employee not possible; number range interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_INT_01 missing. Initial key fields for business partner identification.
Content: Symptom-When replicating an employee from SuccessFactors to ByD, an error occurs. Error: Creating employee not possible; number range interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_INT_01 missing. Initial key fields for business partner identification.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center.-Click Employees view.-Select Failed/ Not Started.-Search for the relevant employee.-Cause-In Successfactors to Business ByDesign, different Business Partner IDs are maintained for same Remote Employee ID-Resolution-To resolve the issue there are few checks to locate the issue,-Step 1: Check the last successful replication request for an Employee and note the Remote Business Partner ID.-Step 2: Check the latest replication request for this Employee and find the Remote Business Partner ID, compare the Remote Business Partner ID noted in step 1-If the Business Partner IDs in Step 1 and step 2 are different then your data is not intact with initial replication which should be checked and corrected from your end.-Step 3: In the ID Mapping for Integration (Mapping Of: Business Partners; System Instance ID: EC_INTEGRATION_HCM), check ID and External ID of this Employee-If the ID in step 3 is referring to the Business Partner ID in step 1 but different from step 2 then the same cause applies here as well.-Options:-Option 1: If the Remote Business Partner ID noted in Step 1 and Step 2 are different then you need to sort out what is coming from SF and maintain Mappings accordingly.-Option 2: If you require the new Remote ID which is coming from SF (step 2) and that’s visible in the newer failed requests, then you need to adjust you mappings for this Employee accordingly in ByD.-See Also- 2962288 - Error: Initial Key fields For Business Partner Identification. Creating Employee Not Possible; Number Range Interval APHCF1_AP_HCF_EMPLOYEE_INT_01 Missing-Keywords-Business Partner ID, Master Data Replication, Employees.

Title: Unable to Perform a Retroactive Capitalization of Individual Material due to Account Determination Missing
Content: Symptom-While you are trying to post a manual Retroactive Capitalization for a fixed asset, the system shows the following error message:-Account determination is missing for item type Historical Cost Fixed Assets. Specify account determination in chart of accounts XXX and account determination profile YYY. Column Path Fixed Assets->Historical Cost->Historical Cost, Item Type Historical Cost Fixed Assets.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Fixed Assets Work Center > Fixed Assets View.-Search for the respective Asset ID.-Highlight it and click Manual Posting > Retroactive Capitalization-Fill out the fields according to your need.-Click Post or Simulate button.-The System issues the following error message:--Account determination is missing for item type Historical Cost Fixed Assets. Specify account determination in chart of accounts XXX and account determination profile YYY. Column Path Fixed Assets->Historical Cost->Historical Cost, Item Type Historical Cost Fixed Assets.-Cause-The fixed Asset for which you are trying to perform the Retroactive Capitalization uses an Account Determination Group which does not have the Historical Cost maintained in the Account Determination.-Resolution-In order to resolve the issue, you must maintain a Historical Cost for this Account Determination group. This process can be done by executing the following steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Go to Overview View.-Search and open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click Fixed Assets under Account Determination.-Go to the Historical Cost tab.-Click Add Row button.-Maintain a Historical Cost account for your Account Determination Group.-Keywords-retroactive, account, determination group, chart of accounts, fixed assets, FA

Title: System Determines Incorrect Source of Supply and Pricing Details When Creating Project Purchase Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You have created two purchasing contracts assigned to project tasks. When you try to create project purchase request, system takes incorrect source of supply and due to which system takes incorrect pricing details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sourcing and Contracting work center-Go to Contracts view-Select the relevant Contracts-For Example - Contract A for project task X contains price 2000 EUR and Contract B for project task Y contains price 1000 EUR-Now Go to Project Management work center -Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project Y-Select Edit and navigate to Products tab in the Project Overview -Then click on "Create Purchase Request" for all released project tasks -In the new project purchase request screen, system defaults the contract price 2000 EUR instead of 1000 EUR-Cause-Development team have identified the root cause. System is proposing multiple options but it is reading the first line item to propose the price. In this case, system propose the price for contract A and not contract B. Hence you see the incorrect pricing details in the project purchase request screen.-Resolution-This is a new requirement. Hence development team is planning to deliver the fix in future release. You can refer to jira entry - https://jira.tools.sap/browse/BYDDEV-8631.-Keywords-Project purchase request; Incorrect pricing in project purchase request;

Title: No Option to View Prediction Report for a Prediction Run
Content: Symptom-You have created a Scenario, Model and Prediction Run. Execution is successfully but there is no option to view Prediction report-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Creation of Scenario, Model and Prediction in Machine Learning Cockpit work center-Cause-The report doesn't show any data because the Prediction run might have no instances selected for prediction due to which scenario name does not appear in data source 'MLSINFB'. This could be due to the filter condition maintained for the prediction run there is a possibility that there is no data for such criteria.-Resolution-For the query related to the data source / report to find the prediction outcome. You need to use the Data source MLSINFB in Business Analytics work center.-check and confirm whether there is any data for the mentioned criteria-You can also refer to the videos and documentation in the SAP Help Portal - Prediction Management – Consume Predictions-Keywords-scenario, prediction report, MLSINFB, prediction outcome

Title: Data Loss in Print Payment Proposal List
Content: Symptom-You is trying to print Payment Proposal list in Landscape Mode and the data is lost.-You are unable to view data against some fields like Open Amount, Cash Discount and Proposed Payment Amount etc.,-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables Workcenter-Go to Periodic Tasks View-Go to Payment Runs Sub view-Show All Payment Runs and Select required Run ID-Scroll down to Application log-Select All Logs-View Payment Proposals-Select All Payment Proposals-Select Print-Select Landscape mode-You can view items in above mentioned columns are incomplete after printing.--Reduce size to 50/60% after step 9-Line Items reduce after reducing size.--For huge data size if you need to print the entire list, you either miss the whole data or reduce actual size then you miss line items. -Cause-Due to huge data Print will not show the All Payment Proposal Data when saving the pdf with landscape mode and size reduction.-Resolution-There is an alternative way to download the pdf with all the payment proposal data:-Select Export button in Payment Proposal list to download the excel with all proposal data.-Open excel and sort the Payment ID (A to Z).-Select File and print option to change the properties as like - Landscape Orientation, A4 and Fit all columns on One page.-Select Export option (similar like print option) -Create pdf and publish-It will be downloaded as the PDF file.-  Keywords- Payment Proposal, Print, Payment Runs

Title: How to Change the Address Details for The Location of Service Provision of Service Location On-Site
Content: Symptom-You want to change the Address Details for The Location of Service Provision of Service Location On-Site but when clicking on the Address Details hyperlink and the Value Help for the Address there are no records found even though there are Addresses maintained in the Account Master Data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Service Orders work center. -Select the Service Order Processing view. -Select New Service Order.-Enter Account XYZ (XYZ represents the Account ID).-Select View all and navigate to the Account and Affected Product tab.-In the Service Location section select On-Site for the Location of Service Provision, click on Address Details hyperlink under Service Location.-No Address can be selected. The following message is displayed: -No records found-Cause-The Address Details of the Location of Service Provision On-Site are derived from the Ship-To Party Address.-Resolution-If you would like to change the Address Details for the Location of Service Provision On-Site to another Address maintained in the Account Master Data you need to change the Ship-To Address.-You can do this as follows:-In your Service Order go to the Involved Parties tab.-Select the Ship-To Party Role.-Select the Value Help of the Address for the Ship-To Party Role.-You can select any of the Addresses maintained in the Account Master Data.-When you now go back to the General tab and the Account and Affected Product sub tab you will see that the Address Details of the Location of Service Provision On-Site have changed accordingly.-See Also-KBA 2958738 - Ship-To Address Does Not Update Service Location Address as Expected After a Change-Keywords-Ship-To; Location of Service Provision; On-Site; Address; Location; Service Provision;

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2302 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2302 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 22nd of April 2023. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2302-Resolution-Cross - Area Topic-UI Client-The Service Status button was selected by default even though the binding value was null. This issue is now fixed, and the error message no longer appears. (Hotfix ID: 4500018786)-The issue related to the data last loaded time stamp in the Managing My Area Overview dashboard has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500019815)-Identity & Access Management-The application error occurring while changing the Employee address data, Employee web service, and the Employee master data replication, has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500018373. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Output Management-Adobe LiveCycle Designer Version is now updated with the latest patch, ALD110P patch #24. (Hotfix ID: 4500021183.This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Service Control Center-The Refresh System pop-up in the Service Control Center is now enhanced to include the KBA for single sign-on (SSO). (Hotfix ID: 4500017745)-The inconsistencies occurring while collecting licenses in the Service Control Center have been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500018098. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Business Partner-Accounts can now be searched in the value help in non-default script both on the All Accounts worklist and on the Sales Order form. (Hotfix ID: 4500016288)-When using multiple script feature with supplier data (name and postal address) the usage of the ManageSupplier and QuerySupplier interfaces now allow maintenance and reading of this data without errors. (Hotfix ID: 4500020681)-The issue related to updating postal addresses of accounts via web services, has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500020371.This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Supplier-The problem in supplier migration with Tax Exemption Code has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500020682)-  Customer Relationship Management-Customer Contract-The contract item was not being created based on renewal rule. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500021020)-You can now revoke invoice for items with already created invoice schedules using the Revoke Invoicing option. (Hotfix ID: 4500014797)-Tax Calculation-A new tax exemption reason code 15 has now been added as a part of the new tax event 596 and tax code 523. (Hotfix ID: 4500020082)-Customer Invoice-To comply with new legal requirements for Austria, in the 2302 release of SAP Business ByDesign, if an invoice is printed multiple times, the first copy was labeled "Original" and the subsequent copies as "Duplicate." To prevent unauthorized access, the SOAP response for the original document excluded the <OutputPDF> tag. This restriction is now removed and the <OutputPDF> tag is part of the SOAP response. (Hotfix ID: 4500020294. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Financial Management-Financial Accounting-While reversing India Stock Transfer Orders, journal entry now gets posted. (Hotfix ID: 4500020711)-The Beneficiary Category Code is now enabled for Ukraine using the TIS (Treasury Intelligence Solutions) integration. (Hotfix ID: 4500020171)-Tax Management & Declaration-The issue with the Israel SHAAM file processing when it contained supplier codes with entirely numeric characters, is now fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500017857.This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-In the previous versions, the "SII - Outgoing Invoices" tax return used to include discount line items of payment documents of customer invoices, resulting in issues with the tax return acceptance/submission status. With this fix, the discount line items are now excluded from getting reported in the tax return. This exclusion ensures that the tax return acceptance/submission status received from the tax authority is successfully updated. (Hotfix ID: 4500021260)-This fix provided, contains the legal changes required to comply with Spain's regulatory requirement of the following new equalization tax rates from January 1, 2023.-VAT rate 0% (equalization tax rate 0%)-VAT rate 5% (equalization tax rate 0.62%)-The tax returns for Spain that will report documents created with these tax rates are 'Tax Return' (Modelo 303 tax return), 'SII - Outgoing Invoices' and 'Modelo 347'. (Hotfix ID: 4500019553)-The tax event ID 596 is now available in the form box no. 87 for the monthly VAT return, and form box no. 157 for the yearly VAT return. This event also has a new tax code 523 that can be selected during a transaction. When applied in a customer invoice, the tax code 523 now prints a tax exemption reason. (Hotfix ID: 4500017139)-For the USA, the 1099-Miscellaneous and 1099-Non Employee Compensation files are now compliant as per the latest legal specifications for the year 2022. (Hotfix ID: 1000023992)-Payment Management-The issue of missing payment purpose code in customer-defined payment file while the code appears in the outgoing payment, has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500017786)-The "Unexpected Constellation" error with the Foreign Currency Remeasurement (FCRE) Payables has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500018704)-The inconsistency with payment allocation when uploading the bank statement has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500020405)-Statutory Reporting-The following changes were made with regards to the Unified Reporting file BKMVDATA.txt. -Errors related to missing Customer Name in B100 record and G/L Account description in B110 record have been fixed.-Surcharge is included at the fields, 'Total amount before discount' and 'Total amount after discount' in record C100. -Journal Entries of type 'Reversal of Balance Carry Forward' have been excluded in records B100 and B110. (Hotfix ID: 4500019018)-  Human Capital Management-Time & Labour Management-With employee assignment to a project task service for a planned period, there is slight deviation in the planned period shown in the resource calendar as a result of which, the planned quantity distribution was incorrect. With this correction, planned period displayed in the resource calendar for any planned project task service is now aligned with the project without any deviation. (Hotfix ID: 4500018218.This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Supply Chain Management-Outbound Delivery-The issue of incorrect stock expiration date in the ASN template has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500017277)-Product Lot-The issue of missing operation in the query production lot response XML has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500018116)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Supplier Invoice-While creating a supplier invoice via an external application (payload), the cash discount indicator is now defaulted to the same value as received in the payload request. (Hotfix ID: 4500020203)-Supplier invoice can now be created with reference to purchase orders for QR Bill Switzerland. (Hotfix ID: 4500020790)-The issue of invalid 'Bankaccountnumber' node in the ERS Supplier Invoice XML has been fixed and now the valid bank account number as per the ERS Invoice Date is shown. Title: The data of Report: Sales Order Volume with Price Components or Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components is incorrect
Content: Symptom-The fields "Value of Cost", "Net Profit Margin", "Net Profit Margin (%)", "Gross Total", "Gross List Price" have the same value in the report: Sales Order Volume with Price Components or Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This issue can occur in either Sales Order Volume with Price Components or Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components. To view Sales Order Volume with Price Components report, follow the steps below:-Go to Sales Orders Work Center.-Select the Reports View.-Open the standard report Sales Order Volume with Price Components.-Set the value of Employee Responsible to blank.-In the View Settings, set "Sales Order" as the Row Fields and "Net Value" and "Price Component" as the Column Fields.-The report shows the same value, XYZ (where XYZ represents the amount), for the following fields: Value of Cost, Net Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin (%), Gross Total, and Gross List Price.-However, these fields have different values in the corresponding Sales Order.-Cause-The issue was identified as being caused by an incorrect configuration of the Sales Order Volume with Price Components report. -The Price Component field was not a key value in the Column Fields. Adding Price Component as a key field in the Column view resulted in an ambiguous view and caused the report to display incorrect values.-Resolution-To obtain the correct view, right-click Price Component and select Move to Rows.-Additionally, the following fields must be fulfilled to obtain the correct Price Components-Effective Indicator: True-Inactivity Reason Code: NOT Assigned (indicating that the price is active)-How to Set the Effective Indicator to True-How to Set the Inactivity Reason Code to NOT Assigned-This will provide the correct and desired view of the Price Components.-Keywords-Sales Order Volume with Price Components; key value; Column Field; Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components; Incorrect; Wrong; Amount

Title: Unable to Find the Created Organizational Structure
Content: Symptom-You have created an organization ABC in the Organizational Structure figure, however cannot find it.-(Here ABC refers to Organizational structure)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Search for the Org Structure ABC.-No result found.-Cause- If you have more than five independent org structures, the UI shows the first five by default.-Resolution-This is a Standard System Behaviour.-If you wish to view more Org Structures then you need to select which one you want to see, by following the below steps:-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to Org Structures view.-Select the option Edit and then navigate to Select Org Structures and then move the Available Org Structure to Selected Org Structure.-Keywords-Organizational Management, Org Structures-org structures,organizational management

Title: Inconsistent Customer Invoice is Not Available in Data Source
Content: Symptom-You find the customer invoice ABC is not available in the data source CRMCIVIB.-(ABC represents the customer invoice ID.)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics - Data Sources view. -Open the data source CRMCIVIB (Customer Invoice Item), click Preview.-Open the value help of selection field 'Invoice', you find the customer invoice ABC is not available in the list. -Go to Customer Invoicing - Invoice Documents view.-Search ABC, you can find this invoice is existed and with status Released.-Cause-The data source will only return invoice documents that are consistent. Invoice ABC is not consistent, and you can check this when you perform a check on the invoice on the UI.-Resolution-It is the current system design.-Keywords- CRMCIVIB; Customer Invoice Item data source; invoice missing.

Title: How is the Planned order date in Purchase request determined.
Content: Symptom-You may see this field in Purchase request tracking report and  wondering how is this date determined.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Open any  purchase request , Don't click on view all- Go to general tab and we see field "planned order date" and 'planned delivery date' as well-or-Open the report 'Purchase Request Tracking'-Filter with a Purchase request ID -You will see values under column 'Planned Order Date'-Cause-The planned Order date is automatically calculated by the system based on the delivery date-Resolution-Planned order date generally means  :-When Order need to be planned such that delivery date is not impacted and proper escalation are made.So  to identify the Planned order date system is using below logic to identify the planned order date.-Logic given below is as per priority:-1) Default from SCM :  Go to Supply planning Work center>products(view)- Select  the product and click open> you will see purchase request ID> the date appearing against it is planned order date .-2) Lead time from contract if assigned: If in contract id(Purchase request--> items tab--> source of supply sub tab --> contract ID) exist then Lead time is assigned  it will take the planned order date from here .-Go to Sourcing and contracting work center> Go to contracts view> search for the contract and select and open it> go to items and basic data sub tab> Field' lead time ' is there.> if that has a Value then system takes Planned order date as that many days before delivery period start date of PR.-3) Lead time from product if available: If in product ,lead time is available it will pick the planned order date from here .Open the product master data--> Planning tab --> field 'Procurement lead time'> if that has a Value then system takes Planned order date as  that many days before delivery period start date of PR.-4) 5 days before delivery period start date: Planned order date  will be 5 days before delivery period start date of PR.-Keywords-Wrong planned order date, why planned order date, how is the planned order date calculated

Title: How is approver determined in Goods receipt when account assignment has Service order or Sales order
Content: Symptom-You want  to know how the approver is assigned in Goods receipt GSR When account assignment is having sales order or service order provided the work distribution used is "Approver of Goods and Service Acknowledgement'-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and service receipts work center -Select Receipts and returns-Open the respective goods receipt-Click on approval tab-You will see unexpected approver-Cause-When account assignment is Service order or Sales order system take the manager of Purchasing unit maintained in the Purchase order of the goods receipt.-Resolution-Check the Purchasing unit in the purchase order general tab-and click on it to see the manager-See Also-1699149 - Goods and Services Receipts Approval Process-1947478 - Huge list of Persons Responsible Determined for an Approval Task

Title: Unable to Define Approval Process for Posted Supplier Invoices
Content: Symptom-You would like to set up an approval process for the posted invoices for few of your vendors.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Approval Process view-Select the Supplier Invoice approval process-You want to define approval for a posted invoice-Cause-In a standard scenario, currently it is not possible to set up an approval process for the posted supplier invoices. It is only possible to define the approval process before it got posted.-Resolution-Like purchase orders, we do not have item approvals after it is ordered. For the posted invoices, journal entry will be already created and hence it is not possible to trigger the approval process for the posted invoices. May be this can be taken as a new requirement and you can post in ideas forum - https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign. Later product management team will check the feasibility and validate the request.-Keywords-Approval Process for Posted Supplier Invoices; Approvals for posted invoices

Title: Incorrect address for customer invoice
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Addresses of contract and customer invoice do not match.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing work center.-Select Invoice Documents view.-Search for the relevant Customer Invoice.-Click on Edit / View all.-Under the General tab you will notice the Payer address is ABC (Where ABC refers to the address).-Expected Address: DEF (Where DEF refers to the address).-Open the Backend:-Transaction SRT_MONI-There is a failed message with the following details:-Sender Party: CustomerContractProcessing-Receiver Interface: CustomerInvoiceProcessingRequestInvoicingIn-Error: Please see Application Info section in the dump for more details.-  Hence the messages with changes are not processed.-Restarted the failed message with the Support User since the user in the message was locked (see KBA 2105848 - How to Remove the Document / User Lock in Backend) therefore, the message still fails with the same dump.-Details of the DUMP:-ST22-MESSAGE_TYPE_X_TEXT-CX_FATAL_EXCEPTION============CP    27-  Triggering application component: AP-RC-GEN-PAT-CM_ILM_DATA_RET_CHECK, Program:SAPMSSY1, Include:, Position:0-Info: Document change not allowed as retention is over; please contact your data privacy officer-Cause-The Invoice Requests are being processed for invoicing but dump occurred with error "Document change not allowed as retention is over; please contact your DPO".-If you check Document Retention Status for the Invoice Requests in "Information Lifecycle Management Work Center - Lifecycle Items View", you can see the status is shown as "End of Retention".-Resolution-Customer needs to correct Document Retention Status for the Invoice Requests along with other documents where issue is occurring.-After the changes are done, the messages can be restarted.-See Also-Please also refer to following blog:-Configure information lifecycle for data privacy management in SAP Business ByDesign Cloud ERP-Keywords-Customer invoice, address, dump, retention status, DPO

Title: "Agent version differs from LM-SERVICE" Error in Agent Administration - SAP Solution Manager 7.2 SP 11 and SP 13
Content: Symptom-Following the implementation of the Solution Manager 7.2 SP11 LM-SERVICE Patch 14 (LMSERVICE11P_14-80000341.SCA) or SP13 LM-SERVICE Patch 2 (LMSERVICE13P_2-80000341.SCA) the Agent Administration shows the error for the diagnostics agents:-"7.20.11.14.20220211191818 - Agent version differs from LMService"-"7.20.13.2.20220204070621 - Agent version differs from LMService"-Environment-Solution Manager 7.2 SP13-Solution Manager 7.2 SP11-Reproducing the Issue-Error appears in Agent Administration:-Solution Manager Administration-Infrastructure-Framework-Agent Framework-Agent Admin-All Agents-or <Solution_Manager_host>:<port>/smd/AgentAdmin-Cause-This is a minor bug which Development Support already provided a fix.-Resolution-The latest security fix SAP Note - 3145008 - is contained within the current LM-SERVICE Patch 15 (SP11) or Patch 2 (SP13).-Patch the LM-SERVICE with the latest patch level available, and then you can validate that the security fix is installed by accessing:-[AS JAVA URL]:[http(s)port]webdynpro/resources/sap.com/tc~webadministrator~oscommand/OsCommandApp?SAPtestId=9-this should give a 404 Error.-If you see a 500 type error or no error at all, please report it to Product Support by raising a support case.-See Also-2686969 - Upgrading the LM-SERVICE Patch Level--1931100 - "Agent version differs from LM-SERVICE" Error in Solution Manager Agent Administration-Keywords-LM-SERVICE Patch Differs-agent version differs from lmservice,lm-service sp11

Title: FaulString: Error al actualizar cabecera/artículos de la declaración
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal use only***-Spain VAT Return is returned with the FaulString: Error al actualizar cabecera/artículos de la declaración.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns subview in the Tax Returns view.-Select VAT Return ABC (ABC is the VAT Return ID).-Tax Return Status: Reported-Submission Status: Returned-Approval Status: Not Started-FaulString: Error al actualizar cabecera/artículos de la declaración :-Navigate to the Tax Return tab.-The Acceptance Status for the documents are empty.-Cause-There are two invoices with the same external reference ID.-The external references are unique and should not be used in multiple invoices.-When both of these are submitted to the tax authority under the same unique invoice ID/external reference ID, SII tax authority throws an error stating error updating header or item.-You can check this as follows:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the VAT Returns subview in the Tax Returns view.-Select VAT Return ABC.-Navigate to the Tax Return tab.-Click Export and Export to Excel.-Open the Excel.-Select Column Document Ref ID.-Click Conditional Formatting.-Select Highlight Cell Rules and click Duplicate Values.-You can find the documents which have the external ID duplicated.-Resolution-Hotfix id 35311 (2022) and EP 152595 has been released for the same.-Attached is the Backend Report which is used by development to solve the inconsistencies.-Corrections will be performed by development. -The below mentioned steps to be performed by customer only after consultation with development.-A few steps are to be performed to correct this issue:-Step 1: Cancel one of the documents.-Once you have cancelled one of the these documents, send the incident back to us to set the tax due date of the cancelled document and its cancellation to 31.12.9999 from backend.-This will have the the original and cancellation invoice excluded from future SII VAT Returns.-We will change the status of this invoice as accepted in the VAT Return.-Step 2 is only to be done after the backend corrections in step 1 has been performed.-Step 2: Create a new VAT Return for the same period (Please do not cancel or reverse the VAT Return ABC) and submit it.-For all the documents which were sucessfully submitted with VAT Return ABC, the acceptance status will be Rejected with the error "Factura duplicada".-Please send the incident back to us for backend correction.-Keywords-SII, Spain, VAT Return, Approval Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -User cannot download 3PL DDAN payload from Business Communication Monitoring or from document flow-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign [All]-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Application and User Management work center-Business Communication Monitoring View-Select Outgoing messages -> Business Document 'Inbound Delivery Notification' -> ID XYZ -> doesn't exist-    Note: XYZ represents IDN ID-    OR-    Check the DDAN document from 3PL IDN docuemnt flow. Title: Cannot Use a Custom Exchange Rate Type for Invoice Volume Report
Content: Symptom-You have created customer invoices with a different curreny than company currency in the system. While checking in the Invoice Volume report, you find the report ueses default exchange rate type instead of the custom exchange rate type. Hence the invoice value in the report is different than in the Journal Entry.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Go to the Reports view.-Open report: Invoice Volume and show the invoices. -You find the converted invoice value is calculated by using the Default Exchange Rate 001, while in the Journal Entry system used Custom Exchange Rate. -Cause-System does not support a different Exchange Rate Type as the Default Exchange Rate Type in the Invoice Volume report.-The Default Exchange Rate Type is always 001.-Resolution-This is the current system design in reporting.-Keywords-Invoice Volume; Customer Invoice; Exchange Rate Type.

Title: VAT Return in HRK Currency / Not in EUR (Country - Croatia)
Content: Symptom-You have created VAT Return for country Croatia and observed that the currency of the VAT Return is HRK. You are expecting the currency should be EUR.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Click on VAT Return Run view.-Click New --> Tax Return Run.-Fill data and Schedule Run.-The generated VAT Return is in HRK currency. You are expecting the currency should be EUR.-Cause-As of 01 January 2023, the currency of Croatia is the EUR - Euro. The issue is due to the fact that the currency has not been changed to EUR on country (HR - Croatia) as on 01.01.2023. The tax reporting currency is same as currency maintained on country level and hence it is HKR in the VAT Return.-Resolution-You must have to follow the below steps:-1) Reverse the Return.-2) Cancel all documents having tax due date in the year 2023 (including the ones with tax amount = zero, if any) for Tax amount currency = 'HRK'. The list of documents to be cancelled can be seen in the report All VAT / Sales Tax Items when filter for Company and Tax Due Date - 01.01.2023 and having tax amount currency = HRK.-3) Once all the documents are cancelled kindly change the currency on country level from HRK to EUR and then only post new documents.-Note - please do not modify the documents for the year 2022.-4) Once all the documents are cancelled, then you have to "Report an Incident" to SAP with the list of documents. We will mark these documents with Tax amount Currency = 'HRK' as cleared for tax reporting. So, these documents will not be picked by any Tax Return Run. They will not show up under any tax returns but will be visible in the standard reports.-Note - The above resolution steps are exclusively for SAP Business ByDesign system and is not useful/recommended for S4Hana systems or other ERP system. -Keywords-Currency HRK, Croatia, VAT Return

Title: Custom Holiday Calendars are not Available for the Next Year
Content: Symptom-One or more custom holiday calendars for a specific year are not available in the system. -The calendars are missing for a year, although the same calendars are available for other years.-The calendars are correctly assigned to a working day calendar and all settings  are correctly done.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center-Open Time Sheet for an employee-Select Review and Correct tab-Show the affected holiday calendar-Search for dates in the related year-No holidays are available-Cause-This issue might be caused by a backend inconsistency. When the custom holiday calendars were originally created, the system generated them for a limited number of years (e.g. 10) only for performance reasons.-Resolution-Open an SAP incident so that development might extend the calendar in the backend.  Please include the permission to do so. Afterwards, a correction run for the employees, that are assigned to the holiday calendar and have booked holidays in the affected year, is needed on customer side.-First execute a Start Day Closure Run in The Time Administration work center, Regular Tasks view  (with start date: first day of the affected year) for one employee. Please ensure that the box for "Include Backdated Labor Resource Changes" remains blank.-Once this is done and the results are fine, execute a Administer Day Closure run (again with start date: first day of the affected year) for the impacted employees.  The impacted employees will be employees who have the holiday calendar  assigned to them and who are active during the affected year. Note: Here it is not possible deselect the option "Include Backdated Labor Resource Changes", they are not included anyway.-Note: A correction run is required, not a period closure. Therefore maintain the (correction)  start date, not the Period closure.-See Also-KBA: 2297319 - Employees Are Not Able to View Holiday Calendar-Blog: Time Valuation: Correction Run-  Keywords-missing, not selectable, system, anymore, current, following, system, vanished,

Title: Error on Action Delete G/L Account
Content: Symptom- You cannot delete a G/L Account due to a dump error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view.-Search and Open the Activity: Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Select Edit Chart of Accounts.-Select XXX chart of accounts (XXX stands for the Charts of Accounts name).-Select the G/L Account XYZ (XYZ stands for the G/L Account).-Select Delete.-There is the popup of Delete account and usage in the configuration (where the account is used)-select Ok.-A dump error occurs.-Cause-Deletion is only possible if the G/L Account has not been used before. There is still some data in the buffer tables for this G/L account that is stopping the deletion.-Resolution-As this G/L Account cannot be deleted, you can set the G/L Account Posting Block to "3 - No postings allowed". With this setting, the account cannot be used further as no posting is allowed.-When there is posting on the G/L Account, Blocking the account is the recommend action and not deletion.-Keywords-Delete G/L Account, Charts of Accounts, Error.

Title: Daylight Saver Time Zone is not updated
Content: Symptom-Daylight Saver Time Zone such as Australian Eastern Daylight time (AEDT) is not updated in C4C and Business ByDesign.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-SAP Cloud for Customer:-Go to Settings > My Settings > Time Zone.-You can see that this is set for UTC+10:00 Australia Victoria Time.-However, Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT) is UTC +11 so you expect C4C to show UTC +11.-SAP Business ByDesign:-Go to Business Configuration > Overview > Implementation Projects > Open Activity List.-Find and configure the activity : Time Zone Maintenance.-You can see this is set for (UTC+10:00) AU New South Wales Time.-However, Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT) is UTC +11 so you expect the SAP Business ByDesign to show UTC +11.-Cause-The time zone dropdown at user settings and business configuration shows a fixed list.-Resolution-As this is a fixed list, the time zones descriptions are not adapted during daylight saving time. Hence the name of the time zone always remains "(UTC+10:00) Australia Victoria Time".-The additional hour during daylight saving time in this region is added automatically without changing the description. It's a usual convention to denote the difference in hours to UTC followed by a list of regions, cities, or countries. This list of regions then defines the corresponding daylight saving for this time zone.-Note: The same concept is for example also used by Microsoft Outlook. When you open the calendar settings for Outlook, the time zone dropdown shows an entry "(UTC+10:00) Canberra, Melbourne, Sydney". Here the description also does not change during daylight saving time.-Keywords-daylight saver time zone, AEDT, Australian Eastern Daylight Time, UTC+11, Time Zone

Title: How the System Selects Purchase List Price When Running Material Cost Estimate
Content: Symptom-When running the material cost estimate, the valuation method for one costed object is the purchase list price. If there are multiple available list prices, how does the system choose?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Portfolio work center.-Go to List Prices view.-Search AA(AA represents the costed object/product ID).-You can see multiple valid list prices. For example:-Supplier Name CC, Product ID AA, Company ID BB, Price 52.00 LC, Price Unit 1 pcs, Valid From DD.MM.YYYY, Valid To Unlimited-Supplier Name DD, Product ID AA, Company ID BB, Price 50.00 LC, Price Unit 1 pcs, Valid From DD.MM.YYYY, Valid To Unlimited-CC and DD represents the name of the Supplier.-BB represents the ID of the Company.-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Material Cost Estimates view.-Open the material cost estimate in question.-Find the costed object AAA.-You can see the Valuation Method is Purchase List Price, and the Cost Estimate is 50.00 LC / 1 pcs. You want to know how the system chooses.-Resolution-The cost selected from the purchase list prices will be the lowest available value on the same date. Therefore, in the example above, the system selects 50.00 LC / 1 pcs.-Keywords-Material cost estimate, purchase list price, list price

Title: Foreign Key Error in Node A1S_FIN_FRADASSMERMC_FR_ADG_AS And in A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_ADG_ASS_2
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Customer is trying to add new country to Implementation Project under Business Configuration, however they are unable to finish the project as they are getting below Error message "It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely."- Foreign key error in node A1S_FIN_FRADASSMERMC_FR_ADG_AS; field ACC_DET_EXP_GRP; Application component: AP-ERM-Value A-7140 in setting A1S_FIN_FRADASSMERMC_FR_ADG_AS must also be entered in setting APC_V_GLACCTALI2-Foreign key error in node A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_ADG_ASS_2; field ACC_DET_EXP_GRP1; Application component: AP-ERM-Values A-7140, A-7120, A-7130, A-7110, A-7999, A-7410, A-7400, and A-7230 in setting A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_ADG_ASS_2 must also be entered in setting APC_V_GLACCTALI2-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Implementation Project overview-Click on New-Click on Select Scenario-Add new country-Click on the arrow-Click on OK-Click on Next until step 4-Review Status: You have not reviewed all of the decision-relevant questions for your solution scope. For the questions not reviewed, would you like to accept the answers preselected by SAP based on best practices for your country and type of business?-Click on Accept preselected Answers-Enter Title-Click on Finish Finish Project: It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely.-Log in to the back end-Search for T.Code SLG1-You will find the above logs-Cause-There are missing values in the node A1S_FIN_FRADASSMERMC_FR_ADG_AS (Account Determination Group for Reimbursement Rate Type) and in the node A1S_FIN_RECPTYPEERMC_ADG_ASS_2 (Account Determination Group for Receipt Type). The generic country version is using the following SAP provided account determination groups by default:-A-7100 Travel expenses (general)-A-7110 Lodging-A-7120 Meals-A-7130 Entertainment-A-7140 Transportation-A-7230 Fees/penalties/fines-A-7400 Telephone and telecommunication-A-7410 Postage-A-7999 General expenses-These account determination groups have been deleted from the system.-Resolution-You will need to scope the generic country version so that you can create change projects. This can be done as follows:-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Implementation Projects view-Select Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Click on Change Immediately-Click on Edit Account Determination Groups-Click on Restore Defaults-Good to know:-What does restoring the account determination groups do? It simply brings back the default version of that ADG that was deleted or changed - i.e. for a deleted ADG, it' will restore the value exactly the same way as it was delivered by default in the system (same name, same assignment to documents etc), for a changed ADG, it was change it back to default (i.e. if name changed, it will revert the name).-Are only the groups under "Groups for General Expenses" restored or all groups? You can restore any default account determination group.-Are customer created groups deleted? No, the restoration won't affect any custom groups.-Is there a way to manually restore values in backend? There is, but the restoration on the UI is the best approach. If you click "Restore Defaults", you then get a pop-up screen where you choose which defaults you want to restore. Clicking the button doesn't just restore everything automatically. You can select what to bring back.-How can you maintain additional groups?-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Implementation Projects view-Select Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination-Click on Change Immediately-Click on Edit Account Determination Groups-Click on Add Row to add the account determination groups-Keywords-Lösung um Szenario erweitern, Projekt schlägt fehl, Änderungsprojekt, Change project, Konflikte in den Elementen, add new country, AP-RC-BCT, Edit Account Determination Groups, A-7140, A-7120, A-7130, A-7110, A-7999, A-7410, A-7400, and A-7230.-ap-erm,account determination groups,a-7140,a-7120,a-7130,a-7110,a-7999,a-7400,add new country,implementation project,business configuration,ap-rc-bct

Title: The Address of Account in Sales order is not displayed as expected (Japan)
Content: Symptom-When you maintain an Account in a Sales Order, the Address of the Account in Sales order is not displayed as expected. For some accounts, the Postal Codes will appear in Address, while for other accounts, the Postal Codes will not appear in Address.-Note: The Country of the Account is Japan.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a New Sales Order-Maintain the Account ABC (where ABC stands for the account)-You can see in the Address, Postal Code is displays as XXX-XXXX (where XXX-XXXX stands for the Postal Code)-Create another New Sales Order-Maintain the Account EFG (where EFG stands for the account)-You can see in the Address, Postal Code is not displayed-Check the Address in Account ABC and Account EFG, both Postal Codes are maintained in the Account master data.-Cause-If the Street field in the Account Master data is maintained, the Postal Code won't be displayed.-If the Street field isn't maintained, the Postal Code will be displayed.-Resolution-You can maintain the Street field in the Account Master data.-This is the standard system behavior.-Keywords-Postal Code, Account, Sales Order, Street, Address

Title: Error ''File validation failed. Create an incident'' While Migrating Customers Using the Activity Migration of Customers
Content: Symptom-You are Migrating Customers using the activity Migration of Customers and you recieve the below mentioned error in the validation step:-"File validation failed. Create an incident"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview view and Select All Activities from the dropdown-Search and open Migration of Customers activity-Select the link Migrate customers using the migration tool-Upload the file using the Upload option and run the Migration Step by step- You receive the above error message at Validation step.-Cause-There could be many possible causes for this issue, some of them could be:-Contact ID is missing, the combination of Account ID, Contact ID, First Name and Last Name needs to be unique for migration.-You have duplicate entries, for example: same value for Contact ID.-In the Enhance mode, you are trying to change/modify existing contact persons and their details.-Resolution-For missing contact ID: Fill the contact ID, even if the Contact does not exist yet in your system.-For duplicate entries: Remove the duplicate entry-For the issue in enhance mode: You can only add new contact persons. In order to change/modify attributes of existing Contact Persons, you have to use the work center Mass Data Maintenance for Customers. Here you can extract the existing data (ex:Contact Persons). Then you can change certain attributes and upload the changed data.-Keywords-Customer, Migration, Contact ID, File validation failed, Contact, Enhance mode, Mass Data Maintenance, Attributes

Title: Migration of Materials: Quantity conversion not valid; conversions must be interrelated
Content: Symptom- You are performing the Material Migration and you get the below errors:-"Error detected in source record with the key value 'XYZ'"-"Quantity conversion not valid; conversions must be interrelated"-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration-Go to Open Activity List-Open Migration of Materials activity-Simulate Migration Step by Step-You get the error "Quantity conversion not valid; conversions must be interrelated"-Cause-Quantity conversion i.e. From and To quantity conversions were reversed due to which quantities were not interrelated.-Resolution-This error message is a valid one. Please refer to the Quantity conversion node of material where we maintain conversions. Over here it is important that if you know the quantity in any UoM, it should be possible to convert to another UoM. Let's understand this with an example-1 Pallet = 10 cases-1 box = 10 bottles-This is not a valid conversion as you cannot convert from Pallet to Bottles. The correct conversion would be-1 Pallet = 10 cases-1 case = 10 boxes-1 box = 10 bottles-Here all the UoMs are interconvertible.-Please verify the below details to fix this issue from your end:-Verify the Base UoM.-Please check the material for which the error is being thrown and identify the missing link in quantity conversion. -Create the missing link between the used quantity conversions.-Once you fix this you can perform the migration activity again and it should go through without any issues.-Keywords-Conversions must be interrelated, Material Migration, Migration of Materials, UoM,  Quantity conversion.

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are not able to find any documentation for how the Segregation-of-Duty Conflicts works.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-This information is relevant for compliance reasons enabling you to monitor the system to prevent fraud related issues.
