Content: Symptom-Wrong errors in Purchase order when we change service order to a limit  order.-"Item 1: Sum of items does not match total value in quantityValue without unit in coding block""-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create  order with service item-Then click on check you will see no errors-Now  change item type to' limit'-Go to basic data tab and enter 'value limit' with some number say 10000-then click on check  button you will see error mentioned above-However now copy that line item and remove the  first line item-and then click on check you will get no errors-So this is unnecessary effort to  copy and add new item to eliminate the errors-Cause- Bug found-Resolution-For fixing this reported issue code changes are needed.-As it needs coding with lot of integration testing, we shall consider this to our backlog and fix it in one of the future releases

Title: Process Communication Error in Sales Order Due to Error: Only one tax rate allowed for tax type TCS and rate type Standard (country India)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Process Communication Error adheres in the sales order, due to error "Only one tax rate allowed for tax type TCS and rate type Standard (country India)".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Select the Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the identification of the Sales Order).-Go to Documents Flow tab, you can see the Process Communication Error appears on the sales order.-Click the error icon, system shows the error information: Customer Invoice ABC cannot update Sales Order XYZ. (ABC, XYZ represents the ID of the corresponding document ID.)-Go to the Application and User Management - Process Communication Errors view,-Search the invoice ABC, you can see the error details:Only one tax rate allowed for tax type TCS and rate type Standard (country India).-Cause-In customer invoice item, the tax includes tax type TCS, with rate=0,1%. While in the reference sales order line, the tax type TCS is with rate 1%. There is a mismatch on the tax type TCS between the invoice and sales order.-Hence the update message sent from customer invoice failed to update the sales order.-Checking the Tax Rate Schedules in Business Configuration, we can see the rate type TCS for standard is maintained as 0,1% now, this rate was changed after the sales order created. But since the rate scheudle was changed directly without changing the date validation, this results failed message in the backend as different tax rates are detected from the sending and receiving documents.-You check follow the steps in KBA 1912855 on how to check if the Tax Rate was changed at some point.-Resolution-For the XI message to be successful, you have to revert the tax rate changes back to the original state and trigger a restart of the message.-Steps :-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview.-Select the activity Tax on Goods and Services -> Define Sales Tax Rate Schedules.-Select the raw for country=IN; Tax Type=TCS and Tax Rate Type=Standard.-Change the Rate% back to 1%. -Restart the failed XI Message.-Note, in case you want to change the tax rate it is required to add a new row and change the date to today's date.-See Also-1912855 - In your Sales Document the Error Message 'Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Sales And Use Tax and rate type Standard (country United States)' is Triggered-2997829 - Process Communication Error in Sales Order Do Not Restart: "Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type Standard"-3089070 - Only One Tax Rate Allowed for Tax Type Value Added Tax and Rate Type-Keywords-PCE; sales order; Only one tax rate allowed for tax type TCS and rate type Standard (country India); TCS.

Title: How to Delete Collaboration Email from Customer Invoice/Credit Memo?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to delete collaboration data for multiple suppliers at once, but cannot find an alternative to do this using the system's mass update functionalities.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account - Communication - Collaboration-Under Business Document Settings, scroll down to Customer Invoice/Credit Memo-Observe Output Channel Settings and we expect empty information-Resolution-The following payload will delete all "Output Channels" for a given document, but not the instance for the document itself (on the web service called CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel)-This would be similar to deleting all output channels for a document on the UI.-<n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0=" http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global ">-<BasicMessageHeader/>-<Customer actionCode="02" communicationArrangementListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">-<InternalID>XXXXXXXX(Account ID)</InternalID>-<CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel actionCode="04" communicationChannelListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>28</CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>-<CommunicationChannel/>-</CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel>-</Customer>-</n0:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-Note:-28 refers to the communication channel block.-When you use the action code 03 it removes the entire communication channel block i.e. 28. -Action Code 03 should not cause any inconsistency. -After you execute the above payload, the output channel "email" will not be listed any longer (neither query nor on the UI)-See Also-3202932 - How to Mass Delete Collaboration Data for Suppliers-Inbound Service ManageCustomerIn-Keywords-Delete, Collaboration Data, Communication Data

Title: Payment Run Description is not visible with different logon language
Content: Symptom-You have logged in to the system with Spanish logon language and created Payment Run along with Description.-Now, you are re-logging to the system with English logon language, and you see the Payment Run ID but not Payment Run Description.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to the system with Spanish or any other language.-Go to the Receivables work center.-Select the Payment Runs view.-Click on New -> Payment Run.-Enter the details as per your requirements.-Click on Save.-Now, login to the system with English language.-Follow steps 2 and 3.-Here, you see the description is missing for the payment run, which you have created with Spanish logon language.-Cause-There is no translation maintained for static texts.-The Description will come only if it is maintained in that logon language.-For example: if a payment run is created with Spanish logon language and in run description "Ejecución de Pagos de la Empresa 123" is given, then in the backend - this description is mapped with Spanish language and will appear whenever the logon language is Spanish.-Resolution-This is a standard system's behavior across the system and cannot be changed in future.-NOTE:-The same text will not appear as it is meaning without translation.-The solution remains same for any run or view which holds "Description" field.-Keywords-Payment Run Description not showing, Run Description missing or not appearing

Title: Project Expense Assigned To Sales Order Item Not Posted to Deferred Costs of Goods Sold But Realised on Expense Account
Content: Symptom-You create an expense, such as a goods receipt or a supplier invoice for a customer sales project. -In the Account Assignment the expense is assigned to the relevant sales order item and project task. -As an accrual method is assigned to the sales order item you expect the document to be posted to the Deferred Cost of Goods sold account. -Instead, the expense is posted directly to the expense account. -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Example: Creation of goods receipt:-Create a purchase order, for example, from the Purchase Requests and Orders work center. -In the Items tab, enter the relevant product and then go to the Account Assignment sub-tab. -In the Account Assignment Type field, select Sales Order. -Enter Sales Order item XYZ-XX (XYZ-XX represents the sales order item ID). -Automatically project task ABC-AA is derived (ABC-AA represents the project task associated with sales order item XYZ-XX). -Complete the order and create a goods receipt. -Check the posting of the goods receipt:-You notice the document debits the expense account XXX (XXX represents the expense account ID). -In the Item Details: Sales you can see the associated sales order item XYZ-XX and project task ABC-AA.-As an accrual method is assigned to sales order item XYZ-XX you expected the document to be posted to the Deferred Cost of Goods sold account, deriving account XXX only as G/L Account (Origin). -Cause-As you choose Account Assignment Type Sales Order the expense is immediately assigned to the sales order item and therefore posted to the respective expense account.-However, if an accrual method is assigned to the sales order item and if the conditions of the accrual method are not fulfilled the next revenue recognition run will credit the expense account and debit the Deferred Cost of Goods sold account.-Resolution-This is the designed system behaviour.-When creating external expenses for customer sales projects, rather use Account Assignment Type Project Task. The expense is then posted as Deferred Cost of Goods sold and assigned to the respective sales order item separately during the Expense Assignment posting.-Keywords-expense not posted to Deferred Cost of Goods sold; expense not deferred; expense immediately realised

Title: Error During Check in:Communication Scenario. ABCDEFG.webservice Does not Exist. Check out, Save and Activate ABCDEFG
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-Assembly of A PDI Solution fails for the partner without any reported errors.  SLG1 Logs show the following error.- @5C\QError@ Error during check in:Communication Scenario- @5C\QError@ Issue occurred in the application component:AP-RC-BDS-WS- @5C\QError@ /ABCDEF.webservice does not exist. Check out, save and activate ABCDEF.-ABCDEF represents the name of a .webservice file which is not found in the solution.-  Environment- SAP Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You will not find the .webserivce file in the solution but you should find a .csd with the same name. -Run a check on this .csd file -You will see the following error reported. No entries found for the given solution. /ABCDEFG.webservice does not exist. Check out, save and activate ABCDEFG.' -Open the .csd file and navigate to the services tab.  You will see Description MISSING - NOT ASSIGNED (Y123456_II_YXZ123ABC456D) -Check Xrep Development folder for the solution - you will find the .csd file but not the .webservice file. -Check Xrep All folder -previous version of the solution. You will find the missing .webservice file and possibly other related files with the same name -Cause-The current patch is a deletion patch. The customer has used the Where used function to identify files eligible for automatic deletion for a CBO but did not pick up on the .csd file.  This is because the Where Used implementation for CBOs only shows the direct dependencies of the CBO being deleted, along with the direct dependencies of its dependent CBOs.-If the CBO being deleted is not directly used in a .CSD file (I.E The .csd only makes use of the .webservice file of the CBO being deleted) then the  .csd will not be shown in the WhereUsed list for the CBO being deleted.-CSDs making use of deleted webservices would need to be manually adjusted before assembling the solution.-(Assembly would throw an error in the CSD file in case the CSD references a webservice that does not exist).-Resolution-Partner would need to delete the .csd file which refers to the deleted .webservice file.-Keywords-Assembly Failed, Deletion Patch, Communication Scenario, 'webservice does not exist. Check out, save and activate'

Title: Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group ABC not supported for location of srv provision XYZ
Content: Symptom-When you add an Item with in a Service Order and you receive the error message: Item XX: Products w/ item group ABC not supported for location of srv provision XYZ. (XX represents the line item number, ABC the Item type and XYZ the Service Location)." occurs.-Cause-The item type is either not supported for the Location of Service Provision selected in the Service Order or you did not activate the respective scoping question.-Please see the resolution part for the different scenarios for Item Types and Location of Service Provision/-Resolution-2945529 - Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group Service - time and material not supported for location of srv provision Supplier Service Center-2209995 - Item of Item Group SERV - Service - Fixed Price Cannot be Added in a Service Order-3031552 - "Products w/ item group Expense - time and material not supported for location of srv provision On-Site" Error when Using Service Type XACT in Service Order-2013633 - Error: 'Products w/ item group Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) not supported for location of srv provision On-Site' Occurs When Entering a Product into a Service Order-1944380 - In a Service Order the Error "Products w/ item group Spare part (engineer pick-up/sales) not supported for location of srv provision" is Triggered-2616602 - Adding a Spare Part to a Service Order Leads to The Error ‘Item XXX: Products w/ item Group Spare Part (Advanced Ship/Sales) Not Supported For Location of srv Provision Supplier Service Center.’-1793967 - Error: 'Error in business conf.: item type code not determined; report incident' occurs when Entering a Product into a Service Order-2761163 - Error faced on the Service Order: Products w/ item group Sales Kit not supported for location of srv provision On-Site-3319403 - Error: Item XX: Products w/ item group Product - delivery-based not supported for location of srv provision On-Site-Keywords-item group; item type; not supported; location; service provision; srv provision; CL_CDA_DOCIT; 114; 104

Title: Error: "Serial number does not exist in inventory; error while creating goods movement"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-When an Intercompany 3PL Outbound Delivery is created, the user is unable to release the Outbound Delivery. The error messages during the release of the Outbound Delivery document are as below:-Serial number XXX does not exist in inventory  (Here XXX is a serial number ID)-Error while creating goods movement-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third Party Logistics Workcenter.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Find required Outbound Delivery ID.-Select and choose Release.-System throws above error.-Cause-When 3PL Outbound Delivery is created, it has the non-adjustable indicator marked as true. This prevents the Outbound Delivery from being released.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-It should be an Intercompany scenario with 3PL Outbound Delivery Document.-Tagged Inventory Status of Serial Number XXX is ‘In Stock’.-In the BO APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY -> ITEM -> ITEM_PRODUCT -> ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER, NON_ADJUSTABLE is set.-Note: If you receive such case, forward this case to the development component: AP-ODP.-Backend Correction steps:-In the backend, go to TCode SESFTS => BO APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY -> ITEM -> ITEM_PRODUCT -> ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER, remove the NON_ADJUSTABLE flag.-Ask the Customer to Release the Outbound Delivery.-Post-Checks:-The Outbound Delivery should be Released.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Third party Logistics, Serial number does not exist in inventory; error while creating goods movement, Release, outbound delivery, non-adjustable indicator, 3PL, Intercompany scenario.

Title: Unable to Define Document Numbering Format for India Based on Valid From and To Date
Content: Symptom-You want to create supplier invoice document with new numbering format for current fiscal year however there is no From date and To date in the activity - Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business configuration work center-Select the Overview button-Select Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing activity-Select the relevant Company-You cannot create a new numbering rule based on From date and To date-Cause-Currently it is not possible to create a new numbering rule for current year with Valid From and To date. For the relevant company, you have already defined prefix value, calendar year as suffix.-You have selected the check box, Restart Doc. ID Each Cal. Year. This option indicates that the document IDs restart with the number 1 each calendar year. You can select this option only if you also selected the Calendar Year as Suffix option. So select this option to restart the document ID numbers each calendar year.-In addition, you can see that, Format Already Used check box is selected. The check mark indicates that the formatting rules in this row are currently in use, or have previously been used.-Resolution-System will allow the user to update Valid from and To date only for document numbering formats specific to France and Italy. For India, it is not possible to set the new numbering format based on Valid From and To date. It is a standard behaviour.-Keywords-Document Numbering Formats for Supplier Invoicing; Invoicing numbering format for India;Supplier invoice numbering

Title: Error in Revenue Recognition Run: A mix of different merge method codes is not supported for Customer Return Item
Content: Symptom-You execute the revenue recognition run. It finishes with the error message "A mix of different merge method codes is not supported" for a customer return item.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition view-Find and open the related run.-Go to the Messages tab. The error "Doc. item XYZ/XYZ-XX: A mix of different merge method codes is not supported" appears (XYZ/XYZ-10 represents the customer return and customer return item ID). -Cause-Customer return item XYZ-XX is connected to sales order item ABC-AA. The accrual method of the sales order item ABC-AA is different to the accrual method assigned to the customer return item (ABC-AA represents the sales order item ID):-In the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue workcenter select Customer Return items. -Find item XYZ-XX.-Navigate to the Accounting Data tab.-Take note of the assigned accrual method. -Also identify the connected sales order item ABC-AA in the Leading Sales Document item collumn.-Now select the Sales Order items and find item ABC-AA. -Again, navigate to the Accounting data tab. -You'll notice, the accrual method assigned is different to the accrual method of customer return item XYZ-XX. -Resolution-When sales document items are connected to a leading sales document item then all the involved sales document items must be assigned to the same accrual method.-Therefore, either assign the sales order item accrual method to the customer return item or assign the accrual method of the customer return item to the sales order item.-See Also-2654963 - Error in Revenue Recognition: A mix of Different Merge Method Codes is not Supported-Keywords-A mix of different merge method codes is not supported, customer return item; Eine Misch. aus versch. ZusFürMethCodes nicht unterst.

Title: Why Contracts with Validity in the past are not automatically closed

Title: Error - Logistics Area XYZ Has No Output Area
Content: Symptom-System throws following error while creating Bill of Operations through UI or via Migration  -- Logistics area ABC has no output area-Note- ABC represents Logistics Area ID-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All Versions]-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Business Configuration work center-Overview -> Configuration Elements-Open Activity List -->Migration of Bills of Operations-Select Bills_of_Operations file-During Step by Step migration process, system throws error-Logistics area ABC has no output area-Cause-The Fixed Output Area under Resources sub-tab under Location layout had incorrect Logistics Area ABC assigned.-When we check the value help of the Fixed Output Area, the value ABC is not in the list of Active LoAs.-Resolution-User has to maintain the correct/valid Fixed Output Area from the value help, which should be Active.-Keywords-Fixed Output Area, Logistics Area, Bill of Operations, Migration, no output area

Title: Unable to Hide or Restrict Using Common Task Consumption for Cost Center for A Specific User
Content: Symptom-You want to hide or restrict using common task Consumption for Cost Center under work center Internal Logistics for a specific user, but you cannot find this view in the access rights of business user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Access view Business Users.-Select any business user, click Edit, then click Access Rights.-Select tab Work Center and View Assignment, expand work center Internal Logistics, there is no view as Consumption for Cost Center. There is no such view under any work center.-Cause-It is not possible to restrict access of common task Consumption for Cost Center for a specific user.-The only option is to restrict the whole work center, which is not a feasible option in most cases.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Consumption for Cost Center, User, Access Right, Restriction

Title: Sales Order is Frequently Locked and Updated
Content: Symptom-A Sales Order is updated frequently and therefore constantly locked.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Open Sales Order XYZ (XYZ represents the Sales Order ID).-Navigate to the Changes tab.-You can see a large amount of changes that look like the changes from the Confirmation Update Run but the Run is not scheduled as frequently as the changes in the Changes tab.-Cause-An Extension Field (KUT or PDI) is modified via a PDI solution on the Sales Order. This triggers a process message to update the Customer Demand which in turn will trigger a process message back from the Customer Demand to the Sales Order. If this update to the Sales Order then triggers the PDI modification again as per the Add-On logic, the system will go into an endless loop constantly updating the Sales Order and therefore locking the Sales Order.-You can check which Extension Field is responsible in the Changes tab of the Sales Order.-Resolution-In order to solve the issue you need to contact the Author of the Add-On to check and correct the Add-On logic.-See Also-KBA 2733352 - You Receive Error Message "Operation not possible; document locked by ZZZ"-Keywords-Sales Order; locked by user; confirmation update run; changes; large amount of changes; updates; Customer Demand; locking; locked; locks;

The remove button is greyed out-Cause-When an account assignment item is with 0 we will get the error in Purchase order, and we cannot remove it from front end of the system-Resolution-Please create an incident and we will correct it in the backend of the system

Title: EC Replication Error: "Mapping for Data Type APC_S_REGION_CODE, Code ABC, and Local Context XYZ does not exist"
Content: Symptom-A replication with SuccessFactors fails with the following error:-"Mapping for Data Type APC_S_REGION_CODE, Code ABC, and Local Context XYZ does not exist" (where ABC represents a region code and XYZ a Local Context code)-However, due to character limit of 20 for the region code field in Code List Mapping in ByD, it does not seem to be possible to map the region code ABC.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-As the Code List Mapping is not maintained,  follow the below steps:-Step a)-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview view-Search for Activities-Search for Regions and click on it -Click on Add row-Select the Country/Region and name the code as per your choice-Note: Here it s not mandatory to maintain the exact same description as what’s received from Employee Central. It is possible to maintain any description (within 20 characters limit) which will help to identify this region code with this description within SAP Business ByDesign. This is not going to impact integration in any way.-Step b)-Now, it is necessary to maintain the same in activity Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions::-Go to Business Configuration work center-Click on Overview view-Select Activities-Search for Code List Mapping for Integration with External Applications and Solutions-Select it-Click on Maintain Code List Mapping-In section Code List mapping Definition, filter for RegionCode as Local Data Type Name-Select Employee Central Integration-In section Code List Mapping Rule, maintain the Mapping Rule and the Local Context as XYZ-In section Code List Mapping, maintain Local Code as <Code that you maintained in step a)>, External Code as <ABC>, and then save the changes-Note: This is the mapping which is required during employee query and replication from Employee Central. Also, it can have length up to 40 character which is sufficient for most use cases.-Keywords-employee central, impossible, how to solve, unable, not able, message, country

Title: Surcharge is Not Considered in Discount Calculation
Content: Symptom-In the sales document, for example sales order, you have maintained product discount and surcharge on the item level. You find the surcharge is added into the pricing after discount.-For example, list price is 100 USD, quantity is 1ea,  surcharge is 5%. and discount is 10%.-You want the discount applies after surcharge, to be (100 * 1 + 100*5%)*10%=10.5-But actually, system does not consider surcharge in the discount, it is 10.-So different item net price is calculated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Open sales order ABC. -In Pricing tab, you can see product discount(%) and surcharge(%) is added to the line 10. -You notice the surcharge(%) is applied after discount.-Cause-In the Business Configuration activity: Configure Price Strategy - Pricing Procedure, you can see Product Discount (%) is at step 011 and Surcharge (%) is at step 013.-As per the sequence, the Surcharge (%) is applied after product discount.-Resolution-This is the current system design.-Keywords-surcharge; discount; sales order; customer invoice.

Title: Resubmit the Email Documents which are not delivered to Customers
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- ***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You have received incident from customer as "Emails are not received by the clients/customers, in the output history tab we could see Email status shows successful. Customer created incident requesting SAP to resubmit all the Email documents during the particular timeframe."-Note: Emails not received by customer could have possible reasons ex:-Email ID doesn't exist.-Email ID spelling mistake,-DKIM Key not activated.-Email inbox temporarily not reachable.-Email ID is updated in the Suppression list.-Customer have requested a change of Header address, performing changes may lead to Email delivery issue.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Please check this with experts when you are performing this as the Emails will be resubmitted.-Follow the below steps to resubmit the affected documents which ideally should have been sent via Email:-Login to the affected backend system.-Execute the TCode SE38.-Enter the Program /DOC/OM_DOR_RESUBMIT_ITEM.-Enter the timestamp during which the Emails are affected & keep the Test Run selected to verify the number of Emails.-Once you get the expected number of emails are correct than you can contiue with next steps.-This time you can uncheck the test run-It will execute the resubmission of all the affected output documents, this will create the resubmit entry in the UI also under Output History tab.-Once the report is executed it will give you the list of documents which are resubmitted and which you can compare with the SCOT entry.-Keywords

Title: Process Error: Outbound Delivery cannot create a Customer Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-You find process communication error in document flow of required Outbound Delivery as below:-Outbound Delivery cannot create a Customer Invoice Request-Once your service provider has solved the errors, the system closes the errors and restarts the processes automatically.-  Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for required Delivery ID.-Select and edit it.-Choose view all and navigate to document flow.-Here you find process error with red mark.-Cause-User managed to change ship-to party (ID-Description) from ABC to XYZ (ID-Description) in an Outbound Delivery document. (Here ABC and XYZ is an ID description).-Due to this inconsistency, message fails from Outbound Delivery to Customer invoice Request.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-It should be Outbound Delivery Document.-Message failing from Outbound Delivery to Customer invoice Request due to invalid party ID.-Note: If you receive such case, send it to the development component:AP-ODP-OD.-Backend Correction steps:-Ask the Customer to Undo-release the Outbound Delivery and correct the erroneous party id by changing it to only Party ID.-After above correction from Customer, ask them send back the incident.-Cancel the old message from OD to CIR containing incorrect party ID and check if new message from OD to CIR gets delivered if no new messages exist then reconcile a new message from OD to CIR.-  Post-Checks:-Check if message from OD to CIR delivered with correct details.-Check if Customer Invoice Request exists in Customer Invoicing – Invoice Request work center view (can be search by OD id).-Keywords-Customer invoicing, outbound delivery, process communication error, Outbound Delivery cannot create a Customer Invoice Request,

Title: What is the Data Source For The Fields "Top Level Account ID" and "Account Hierarchy".
Content: Symptom-What is the Datasource for the fields Top Level Account ID and Account Hierarchy-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management WorkCenter-Navigate to Accounts View-Search and select any account-In general tab under Details these fields are available-Cause-These are Standard Fields and not available on any Data Sources-Resolution-Business Object CUSTOMER has association to business object BUSINESS_PARTNER_HIERARCHY to identify the hierarchy group to which the instance of CUSTOMER (Account) is assigned to.-On the UI additional logic is applied to determine the TopLevel Group of the hierarchy and the customer/account and instance assigned to this one. This is then displayed on the UI.-There is not "the" field/element on the account/customer object which matches this information. Therefore, it is not available on any existing data sources. If you want to "see" that information on a data source, they need to rebuild that via implementation for a data source (if that is possible in PDI).-Keywords-Data Source , Fields, Account Hierarchy, Top Level Account ID

Title: Extension Field from Work Agreement is not Available in WSDL of Replicate Employee Master Data Scenario
Content: Symptom-You are trying to set up Employee Master Data replication from external system (master) to SAP Business ByDesign. All configuration are in place and the process is working. However extension fields (created in adaptation mode) from "Work agreement - Work Agreement" are missing :-They are not present in WSDL of Replicate Employee from External service-We can not find the service in Adaptation Mode > Show Further Usage > Services-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management and select Communication Arrangements-Open the Communication Arrangement Employee Replication from SAP Business Suite-In Inbound Communication Services select the option Download WSDL-Open the WSDL file-The extension field you have created is not available-AND :-Go to Employees and open an employee personal file-Switch to Adaptation Mode-Open Employment tab and select "Unamed group" > Extension Fields-Select Grade field and click on Show Further Usage-Open Extension Scenario and Sevices tab-Cause-The field was not extended properly because it was not added to the right section of employee master data i.e. personal data section.-Resolution-Since the work agreement and other objects are used internally to store employee data and these are different from the staging area where we store the replicated file before it gets processed and saved in the work agreement and other employee related data.-The web service which is used for replication is built on top of the staging area (Complete Employee Data Replication ). So only the extension fields which are added in Complete employee data replication will be available in the web service as mentioned in the KBA: 2439489 - Extension Field is not Available in WSDL of Employee Replication-And currently only personal data fields are available for extension in the staging area (Complete Employee Data Replication). In case customer wants to add some other fields then can try the PDI based approach for the same.-You must create the extension field in Personal Data section of Employee Replication Request.-Keywords-Emplyee Replication, Extension Field, WSDL, Personal Data, Work Agreement.

Title: Unable to Update the Address via Web Service for a contract which is In Process status
Content: Symptom-You need to update the Account Address via Web Service for a contract which is "In Process" status, however this is not possible.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-When executing the below example payload, the SOAP request goes through without any errors, however the address is not updated:-<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope" xmlns:glob="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<soap:Header/>-<soap:Body>-<glob:CustomerContractBundleMaintainRequestSync_V1>-<BasicMessageHeader/>-<CustomerContract actionCode="02">-<ID>XY</ID>-<BuyerParty>-<PartyID>Test12345</PartyID>-<Address>-<CorrespondenceLanguageCode>EN</CorrespondenceLanguageCode>-<DisplayName>-<FormattedName languageCode="EN">Sopstationen AB</FormattedName>-</DisplayName>-<PostalAddress>-<CountryCode>XX</CountryCode>-<CityName>TestCity</CityName>-<StreetPostalCode>00000</StreetPostalCode>-<StreetName>Teststreet</StreetName>-<HouseID>X</HouseID>-<TimeZoneCode>CET</TimeZoneCode>-</PostalAddress>-</Address>-</BuyerParty>-</CustomerContract>-</glob:CustomerContractBundleMaintainRequestSync_V1>-</soap:Body>-</soap:Envelope>-Cause-You want to update the Account Address with Web Service in a contract which is "In Process" status.-However, we do not support this update if the contract is anything else apart from "In Preparation", hence an error is raised in the web service call:-<Note>Change of party with role Buyer not permitted in a saved document</Note>-This also applies for the SELLER party.-Resolution-This is the current system behaviour.-Keywords-Webservice, Address, In Preparation, Contract

Title: How to set field 'Requestor' as mandatory in Manual Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-Requirement to make the ‘Requestor’ field mandatory for Manual Purchase Requests.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests (Manual) view.-Select one of the Purchase Requests.-Click on Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab, Delivery sub tab, the field 'Requestor' here cannot be set as mandatory in Adaptation mode.-Cause-The 'Requester' field cannot be made mandatory in the View all screen or Items → Delivery subtab.-The 'Requestor' field can be made mandatory in the Basic View of the Purchase Request.-Resolution-By following the steps mentioned below, the 'Requestor' field can be made mandatory in the Basic View.-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to Purchase Requests (Manual) View.-Select All Purchase Requests in drop-down.-Select New Purchase Request.-Access Key User Settings and start Adaptation Mode.-Open Involved Parties in right side window.-Right click the field "Requester".-Select field Set Mandatory.-Save and Publish Changes.-Keywords-Requestor, Manual Purchase Request, Mandatory, Adaptation mode

Title: Due Days in Aging List for Receivables by Document Date Report
Content: Symptom-You are executing the Aging List for Receivables by Document Date report and you have observed that the Due Days are calculated based on the Due Date. You are expecting the Due Days should be calculated based on Document Date. Otherwise, there is no difference between Aging List for Receivables and Aging List for Receivables by Document Date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center. -Click on Design Reports view. -Search for the Report - Aging List for Receivables by Document Date.-Execute the Report.-You can find the Due Days column. The number of days is calculated based on Due Date.-Cause-This Aging List for Receivables by Document Date report displays the data for each customer based on overdue receivables according to a specific Document Date and aging period. However, the logic for Aging List for Receivables by Document Date report and Aging List for Receivables report is same for the calculation of Due Days. The Due Days column display the number of Days based the document Due Date.-Note: The same logic applies to Aging List for Payables & Aging List for Payables by Document Date reports as well.-Resolution-For the report Aging List for Receivables by Document Date its recommended to create new Keyfigure to calculate overdue days based on document date.-Keywords-Aging List for Receivables by Document Date, Aging List for Receivables, Due Days, Aging List for Payables, Aging List for Payables by Document Date

Title: Tax Reporting Unit is not Determined while trying to post the Supplier Invoice
Content: Symptom- Tax Reporting Unit is not Determined while trying to post the Supplier Invoice-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing Work Center-Invoice and Credit Memo view-Search Open and View All the Supplier Invoice DEF(DEF refers to the supplier invoice ID)-Click on the Check-Error message - Tax Reporting Unit is not determined is displayed-Cause-Inconsistency in the system-Resolution-As a work around for determining Tax Reporting Unit in Supplier invoice, please follow the below steps.-Select the supplier invoice DEF(DEF refers to the supplier invoice ID) and click Edit. Go to View All.-In the General tab, change the Invoice Date to any other date.-Now go to Items Tab. Select the Item in the table and go to Taxes Sub-tab.-Check that the Tax Reporting Unit field should be determined now.-Now you can navigate back to the General tab and change the Invoice Date back to original date and save the changes-Following these steps will retrigger the Tax Reporting Unit determination in the document.
