Title: How Rounding Off Works For Gross Value And Gross Price In Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You find Gross Price calculated in Sales Order is not expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work centre.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Open Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the respective Sales Order ID).-Click the View All button.-You can see Price In: Gross-Navigate to the Items tab.-Find the following values: Quantity, Gross Price and Gross Value.-List Price= 117.841,40 CNY-Quantity = 550 XYZ (where XYZ stands for the custom UoM)-Discount= -13,339%-Gross Price= 102.122,55 CNY-Gross Value= 51.000,00 CNY-     8. Open Base Price List (Gross), search for Product EFG (EFG represents the respective Product ID)-         It is maintained as Amount 117.841,40 CNY for 10.000 kg-     9. Open Product: EFG-         The Quantity Conversion: 1 XYZ = 9,08 kg-Cause-The calculation of Gross Price and Gross Value follows a certain calculation schema using the assigned currency of the number of decimals and Rounding Value.-This can be found by following the steps as below:-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center.-Choose respective Implementation Project.-Click Open Activity List and go to the Fine-Tune sub-tab.-Show All Activities and find Currencies.-Based on the assigned currency rules, the System calculates the values as follows [please follow the Example in brackets too]:-Quantity * List Price (for quantity 1 not rounded) = Total List Price (rounded to 2 decimals). Please note that in case of a quantity conversion between the Sales Unit of Measure and the List Price Unit of measure, the List Prices needs to be converted to the Sales Unit of measure fist.-          [550 * 9.08 = 4994-          117.841,40 / 10.000 =11,78414-          List Price=4994*11,78414=58850]-List Price * Discount in % = Discount Value (rounded to 2 decimals)-          [58850 * 13,339% = 7850]-List Price – Discount Value (rounded to 2 decimals) =  Gross Value -          [Gross Value = 58850 - 7850 = 51000]-Gross Value / Quantity = Gross Price (rounded to 2 decimals). Please note that this net price is for quantity 1 of the sales unit of measure. If there is a quantity conversion for the List Price Unit of measure this has to be taken into consideration.-          [(51000(Gross Value) * 10000(Quantity List Price) / (Quantity 550 *9.08) = 102122.5470 (rounded to 2 decimals) = 102122.55. ]-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-If you want to change the Display Decimals or the calculation formula, it is a system change request and has to be submitted in Customer Influence Portal - SAP Business ByDesign.-See Also-KBA 2596856 - How Rounding Off Works For Net Value And Net Price In Sales Order-Keywords- Rounding, Gross Value, Gross Price, Discount, Quantity Conversion, Quantity List Price

Title: Sales Transaction With Zero Value - Unexpected Posting Lines
Content: Symptom-You create a point-of-sales transaction with zero value. In the resulting posting you notice a zero debit entry on a difference account used for exchange rate differences.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Access the journal entry of the point-of-sales-transaction,  either through the Source Documents view or through the Journal  Entries view of the General Ledger. -The credit line is posting, as expected to a revenue account in the sales ledger.-However, the debit line is posting to a difference account that is used for exchange rate differences. -Resolution-In case of a zero value point-of sales transactions there is no due item on the account receivable ledger created. The sales transaction is therefore offset against the miscellaneous ledger. The system logic here is to derive a G/L account defined for foreign currency rounding differences in the cash ledger when no due item is created.-*Note: In case of a zero customer invoice the credit and debit line are both posted in the sales ledger. Also here, no open receivable item is generated, i.e you cannot find a zero invoice in a customer's account monitor.-Keywords-zero customer invoice, zero point-of-sales transaction, difference account, cash ledger

Title: Unable to Scope an Additional Country in the Change Project
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to scope an additional country however you are unable to finish a change project. You see the following system message:-Finish Project: It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. -Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Select Implementation Project overview.-Choose the New option.-Choose the Select Scenario option.-Select to Add the country.-Make the changes and save the options.-Select Next option until step 4.-Review Status: You have not reviewed all of the decision-relevant questions for your solution scope. For the questions not reviewed, would you like to accept the answers preselected by SAP based on best practices for your country and type of business?-Choose Accept for the preselected Answers.-Enter the Title.-Choose on Finish option.-Finish Project: It is not possible to finalize your scope changes; some of your decisions would cause inconsistencies in your fine-tuning settings. Before continuing with your project, you must either reverse the decisions causing inconsistencies and then click Finish again or click Cancel to cancel your changes entirely.-Cause-Scoping an additional country brings all assigned country to a specific Business Configuration sets into scope, which leads to an addition of many country specific fine tuning records in multiple Business Configuration nodes.-Some of these records have a foreign key relation to records in other Business Configuration nodes, which you might have deleted before as part of the fine-tuning settings. Hence, the addition of the new record for the new country would lead to foreign key errors, which blocks the completion of the scoping.-Resolution-In order to allow scoping an additional country, you must restore the deleted records which cause the foreign key errors. These values need to be restored before the new country is added, either in a separate change project or via "Immediate Change" from the "Business Configuration Overview" Work Center View. Now you should be able to use the "Restore Defaults" function of the corresponding Business Configuration fine-tuning views.-Once these records have been restored, you can retry adding the new country. Afterwards, you can consider to delete all country specific fine-tuning referring to the added values, and when this is done, where you should be able to delete the restored records again, if desired.- You can Restore the Valuation views by below steps:-Navigate to Business Configuration work Center.-Select the Overview view.-Open Activity List.-Search for Activity: Fixed Assets Valuation View.-Select the activity and choose change immeditely.-Select Restore Defaults.-Select Save option.-See Also- 2839136 - Unable to Finish Change Project Due to Message: Not Possible to Finalize Scope Changes; Some Decisions would Cause Inconsistencies in Fine-Tuning Settings-Keywords-Change Project, Business Configuration, Country Specific Fine-Tunning, Restore Defaults, Fixed Assets, Implementation Project-change project,business configuration,country

Title: Warning Message " IBAN Required for Country ABC to Support XYZ Payments".
Content: Symptom-You receive a warning message as " IBAN Required for Country ABC to Support XYZ Payments" while executing the payload via SOAP.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-<!-- Add bank accounts -->-<BankDetails actionCode="01">-<ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>XX</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID> (Here XX is the Sender Technical ID)-<BankInternalID>BB</BankInternalID> (Here BB is Bank ID)-<BankAccountID>DDDD</BankAccountID> (Here DDDD is the Bank Account ID)-<BankAccountIDCheckDigitValue>YY</BankAccountIDCheckDigitValue> (Here YY is the Digital Value of Bank Account ID)-<BankStandardAccountID>NNNN</BankStandardAccountID> (Here NNNN is the IBAN/ Bank Standard Account ID)-<BankAccountTypeCode>ZZ</BankAccountTypeCode> (Here ZZ is the Bank Account Type Code)-<BankAccountHolderName>ABC</BankAccountHolderName> (Here ABC is the Bank Account Holder Name)-<ValidityPeriod>-<StartDate>YYYY-MM-DD</StartDate>-<EndDate>YYYY1-MM1-DD1</EndDate>-</ValidityPeriod>-</BankDetails>-The warning message for the above request is given in the below response, with no IBAN created:-<Item>-<TypeID>AAA(/FOP_BANKCCOUNTCHECKS/)</TypeID> (Here AAA is the Bank Account Check Type ID)-<SeverityCode>C</SeverityCode> (Here C is the Security Code)-<ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>XX</ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID> (Here XX is the Sender Technical ID)-<Note>IBAN required for country XYZ to support SEPA payments</Note> (Here XYZ is the Country)-</Item>-Cause-The IBAN is mapped against BankStandardAccountID field.-Resolution-The IBAN is supposed to be filled against BankStandardAccountID field.-See Also-Inbound Service Interface-Keywords-BankStandardAccountID, IBAN, Payments-iban,bankstandardaccountid

Title: Cancelled Sales Order Line is Not Displayed in The Sales Order Confirmation Output
Content: Symptom-You have cancelled a sales order line and notice that this line is not displayed in the Sales Order Confirmation output.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center view.-Open a sales order.-In Items tab, the item line 10 is cancelled.-Click Preview, you notice that the rejected line 10 is not in the Sales Order Confirmation output.-Cause-This is the current system design on the standard sales order confirmation template that cancelled sales order line is not visible in the preview/output.-The sales order confirmation output is used to confirm with client on the sales order details. Cancelled lines are cancelled and not accepted in the order, hence not included in the outgoing document.-Resolution-You may create a custom template to include the cancelled sales order line.-Or, if it is only for reporting purpose, you may use the report tool to get all sales order lines including cancelled.-Keywords-canceled sales order line; sales order confirmation; missing; display

Title: Unable To Modify The Production Order Form Template However Not Saved.
Content: Symptom-You have tried several time to modify the operation table in the production order form template however they are not saved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Applictaion and User Management work center-Go to Form template maintenance view-Search for Template Name and Choose Open with Easy form editor-In the Sections block-Go to tblOperation -In the dropdown Columns-Add some column and save and publish and close-Refresh the page and re-open the form -modifications are not visible anymore-Resolution-It's a known issue for production order. you have to use Adobe Livecycle Designer [ALD]only.-Please use the Adobe Livecycle Designer for any form modifications.-Keywords-tblOperation , Section Block, Production Order

Title: Combination of Product XXX and Planning Area YYY Not Valid
Content: Symptom-You access standard web service - ProductAvailabilityDeterminationIn and would like to see in result quantity from stock overview but facing an error message as below,-"Combination of product XXX and planning area YYY not valid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Request XML:-<n0:ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery>-<ConsiderScopeOfCheckIndicator>false</ConsiderScopeOfCheckIndicator>-<ProductAndSupplyPlanningArea>-<ProductInternalID>XXX</ProductInternalID>-<ProductTypeCode>1</ProductTypeCode>-<ProductRequirementSpecificationID/>-<SupplyPlanningAreaID>YYY</SupplyPlanningAreaID>-</ProductAndSupplyPlanningArea>-<ProductAvailabilityDeterminationHorizonDuration>P0D</ProductAvailabilityDeterminationHorizonDuration>-</ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery>-</n0:ProductAvailabilityDeterminationQuery_sync>-Cause-In the request XML, ConsiderScopeOfCheckIndicator is 'true' meaning all the products in the request XML should have an availability scope maintained.-If not, the error "Availability confirmation mode for product <product> not maintained " will be raised.-The mentioned issue would only occur when any of the Product/Supply Planning Area combination in the request XML do not have an availability scope maintained when scope of check tag in the request XML is true.-Resolution-In order to add availability scope, steps are as follows;-Go to Product Data Work Center.-Navigate to Materials View.-Search for the Product.-Choose Edit.-Go to Availability Confirmation Tab.-You will find that the "Availability Check Scope" is blank, this needs to be filled.-Follow steps 1 through 3, in order to maintain availability confirmation combination.-Add Product XXX and maintain the required planning area YYY mentioned in the error message "Combination of product XXX and planning area YYY not valid".-Keywords-ProductAvailabilityDeterminationIn; Availability Confirmation; Combination; Availability Check Scope, Planning Area.

Title: Business Document Project Baselines Does not Appear Under Approval Process View
Content: Symptom-You have scoped the question for project baseline approval process, however system does not show the business document Baseline under Approval Process view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Approval Processes view-Search for project baseline approvals-No records found-Cause-You have scoped single step approval process for baselines and hence it will not be displayed in the approval process view. If multi-step approval process is not scoped, the configuration in Application and User Management is not possible.-Resolution-You need to scope the multi-step approval process for baselines from the below steps;-Go to Business Configuration work center -Go to Implementation Projects-Select the relevant project and click on Edit Project Scope-Navigate to step 4 Questions section -Select the scoping element Project Management -Select Project Planning and Execution and select Change Management-Select the scoping question - Do you want to use a multi-step approval process for project baselines?-Finish the scoping-Now you should be able to see the approval process for Baselines-Keywords-Approval Process for Project Baselines; Baselines approvals missing;

Title: Inventory Retrieval or Placement is Not Recommended; Some Constraints Not Met
Content: Symptom-When selecting a suitable Identified Stock or Source Logistics Area for an input product during confirming a production task, you note that the available stock for Identified Stock or Source logistics area is greater than the quantity you confirmed, but the system does not recommend it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for the production task.-Choose Confirm button.-Go to Input Products Sub-tab.-Confirm the quantity XXX for the input product.-Open the Identified Stock or Source Logistics Area List, you will note that there is No records found with Only recommended (Green).-However if you select Only possible (Green and Yellow), you will find the available stock for Identified Stock or Source logistics area is greater than the quantity XXX you confirmed.-Cause-Here is one of the yellow light results described in Help Portal: Logistics Source and Destination List.-Available quantity is less than the requested quantity but greater than zero. (You can select the result and then split the line (in the confirmation screen) to add the needed quantity from another logistics area or report a lower quantity.) Where requested quantity refers to the planned quantity.-Resolution-When you open value help for Identified Stock or Source Logistics Area, it shows the results according to the planned quantity and not related to confirmed quantity.-It's an expected system behavior.-See Also-Help Portal: Logistics Source and Destination List-Keywords-Production Task; Confirm; Source Logistics Area;  Identified Stock; Recommend.

Title: Communication scenario "Access Documents via WebDAV "is not available
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Under Communication scenario "Access Documents via WebDAV" is not available in Communication Arrangements-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Check in UI:-Go to Application and User Management  Work Centre-Go to Communication Arrangements view-Find the Communication scenario -Access Documents via WebDAV-In the backend:-In Default the WebDav is scoped in which MCPG XIWEBDAVDOC and MCPG 75 are assigned to the content of the BC set BC_A1S_CD_OM_B2B_DOC_WEBDAV which is assigned to the business option BO_A1S_SRM_PROPERTYMG which gets activated through business package BP_A1S_FND_GLOTOP (part of business area BA_A1S_FND_CTAITS). The business package is always selected.-Cause-In the Tenant even though MCPG [Message communication profile group] is deployed in the Business Configuration a corresponding instance of the BO /DOC/MBCA seems to be missing.-Resolution-we have to run a report "/DOC/B2B_DEPLOY_AND_RUN" which will create scenario "Access documents via WebDAV".-Keywords-Application and User Management, Communication Arrangements, Access Documents via WebDAV-application and user management,communication arrangements,access documents via webdav

Title: Unable To View all the Available Org Units in the Selected Org Structure View
Content: Symptom-Only a small group of Org Units showing in Org Structure when you move all the Available Org Structure to the Selected Org Structure view.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organization Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view. -Select the option Org Structures.-Move the available Org Structure to the selected Org Structure view. -Click OK and save the changes.-After relogging the above changes wont be saved.-Cause-The system supports at most 9 organizational structures in selected organizational structures column.-If you select more than 9 organizational structures, it will persist until current session is on for the next logon it can restore up to 9 organizational structures.-Resolution-It is a Standard System Behavior.-Keywords-Organization Management, Available Org Structures, Selected Org Structures-organization management,available org structures,selected org structures

Title: Error Message while Creating Proforma Invoice for Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You want to create proforma invoice for a Sales Order but you get the error message: "Booking is not allowed for XX.YY.ZZZZ."-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center. -Select the Sales Orders view. -Select Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID). -Click on the Pro Forma Invoice button.-You get the error message: "Booking is not allowed for XX.YY.ZZZZ."-Cause-The creation date of Sales order ABC is XX.YY.ZZZZ. So, by default the proposed Invoice date is set as the creation date of Sales Order.-So, proforma invoice creation goes through just like normal Invoice process and hence all the validations are processed for the proforma invoice as well. But it just creates the proforma invoice output.-Thus, as part of the creation date which is blocked in posting, you can see the error with creation date of sales order XX.YY.ZZZZ.-Resolution-This is expected system standard behavior.-Keywords-Proforma Invoice, Sales Order, Error Message

Title: Cannot Login ByD Mobile App on Huawei HarmonyOS System
Content: Symptom-Cannot Login ByD Mobile App on Huawei HarmonyOS System-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Cause-Currently ByD Mobile App only support IOS and Android system.-Resolution-This is the expected behavior.-Keywords-Mobile App, Huawei HarmonyOS, IOS, Android

Title: System Shows Net Value Difference in Effective Billing Rate report
Content: Symptom-You are trying to verify the net value in the Effective Billing Rate report and system shows incorrect value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design Reports view-Select the report Effective Billing Rate-Select the Selection and View -You see that Net Value invoiced shows incorrect value-Now if you go to the Items tab in the corresponding business document, the net value is different-Here you see the difference-Cause-The report Effective Billing Rate shows the data only with source document type Employee Time Calendar and does not show up other source document types. As description says, the report shows time recordings that are invoiced according to "time and material", the report provides the net value invoiced divided by the sum of invoiced and written-off hours recorded.-Resolution-You can use any other report like Revenue by Team Member which provides the requested data.-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Effective Billing Rate report; Report ID PROCPIU03_Q0002;PROCPIU03; Revenue Contribution

Title: Backend Value Path of Standard Field "Planned Shipment/ Pickup Date" for Delivery Proposal
Content: Symptom-You would like to understand the backend path for standard field "Planned Shipment/ Pickup Date".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Navigate to Delivery Proposals View.-Set Search Criteria All Proposal by Selection.-You will note that the Planned Shipment/pickup date is AA.BB.CCCC for delivery proposal.-Resolution-Delivery proposal with Reference Type Sales Order,-         Item-ItemScheduleLine-ArrivalPeriod- DateTimePeriod/StartDateTime/content or DateTimePeriod/EndDateTime/content-Delivery proposal with Reference Type Return to Supplier,-         Item-ItemScheduleLine-ShippingPeriod- DateTimePeriod/StartDateTime/content or DateTimePeriod/EndDateTime/content-Keywords-Planned Shipment; Pickup Date; Delivery Proposal; Path.

Title: Identified Stock XXX and Product Specification YYY Do Not Match; Confirmation Creation Failed
Content: Symptom-Following error occurs when you confirming production task,-"-----> Identified stock XXX and product specification YYY do not match-Confirmation creation failed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control Work Center.-Navigate to Task Control View.-Search for the Production task.-Choose Confirm button.-Select Identified Stock (Istock) XXX for Product ZZZ, then the error occurs.-Cause-You will note that the Product Specification for all the line items(Input Products) is YYY in the task.-Moreover if you navigate to Stock Overview, there would be no stock for Product ZZZ with Specification YYY.  Therefore it's an expected system behavior.-Resolution-In What's New in Supply Chain Management of 2205 Release, regarding Maintain Product Specification for Input Products: you can now maintain the Product Specification for input products in the production bill of material (BoM) and use them across the production process chain. The product specification maintained in the production bill of material for an input product always takes precedence over an inherited product specification (in case the scoping question ‘Do you want to prevent the product specification from being propagated from output products to input products?’ is not scoped in).-Therefore, for now you can modify the BoM based on above new function and update the production model and re-create a new production order.-Keywords-Identified Stock; Product Specification; Match; Input Products.

Title: Approval of custom time type doesn't work, although 'Approval from Line Manager Required' is set
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom time type, and you set the approval option to 'Approval from Line Manager Required'.-You are expecting time recordings of this time type go to line manager for approval ,however the time recordings don’t go to approval when the time is assigned to project task.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-For the assigned project task, time recording is marked as no approval required. Hence, all the time recordings against this project task will directly be posted without approval if the employee is planned under the project team and staffing tab.-For project time recording, all the project time recording are always sent to project manager for approval.-That is to say, if the line manager and project manager are not the same person, the approval task will go to the project manager instead of line manager.-Resolution-This is a standard system behavior which cannot be changed via configuration.-See Also-2600134 - Project Time Recording Posted Without Approval-Keywords-Project Time Recording, No Approval, Time Entry, Project Manager, Line Manager, Project Team Member

Title: List Price not Considered While Creating Project Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You have created a List Price for a service item. However while creating project purchase request for the service item, system determines incorrect price.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project-Select Edit and go to Products tab-Select the relevant Service-Select Create Project for whole task-Price gets populated-Click on Submit button-System creates a Purchase Request-System did not copy the Price from list price-Cause-You have created a list price in different currency and hence you see a different value when system creates purchase request from project. When you do the currency conversion between two currencies, the value is same.-Resolution-If you want system to capture the same pricing value, make sure that List Price currency and Project Purchase Request currency is same. If it is different, you have to perform currency conversion and calculate the prices.-Keywords-Price from Project Purchase Request not carried to Purchase request; price in Project Purchase Request;

Title: Only One Tax Rate Allowed for Tax Type Value Added Tax and Rate Type
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-Process Communication Error in Sales Order: "Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type Standard", XI failed message do not restart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Sales Orders view.-Search for the ID ACB (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order).-Click Edit.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Process Communication Error.-Cause-The customer manually changed the Tax Date of the item with same Tax Rate Type and this generated the error, as a different Tax Rate was saved in the Sales Order.-Example:-The document was created on the 25.08.2020 and the rate at the time was of 16%.-This date was now changed to 01.01.2021, which had its rate return to 19%.-System does not allow to show the same Tax Rate Type with two different VAT Rates in one document.-Resolution-In order to pass the new added data, a reconciliation is required in the XI message.-See Also-2997829 - Process Communication Error in Sales Order Do Not Restart: "Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type Standard"-2943501 - Error When Adding Items With Different Tax Rates for the Same Tax Rate Type: Only one tax rate allowed for tax type Value Added Tax and rate type-Keywords-Only, One Tax Rate, Allowed, Tax Type, Value Added Tax, Rate Type, Sales Order; Only one tax rate allowed for tax type TCS and rate type Standard;

Title: User Not Authorized to Perform Transfer of Inspection Stock
Content: Symptom-Following error occurs when scoping "Inspection" for Line items during New Inventory Notification,-"Item: User not authorized to perform transfer of inspection stock".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Third-Party Logistics Work Center.-Choose New Inventory Change in Externally-Managed Location Task.-Go to Line Items Tab.-Fulfill the fields.-Scoping the "Inspection", then the error occurs.-Cause-For a user to be able to edit inspection stock using Inventory notification, the user should have access to Inspections in either Quality Planning or Quality Control Work Center.-Resolution-Prerequisite: Quality Assurance is checked in Business Configuration.-You can assign the work centers to the user by following steps,-Go to Application and User Management - Business Users View.-Search for the user and select it.-Choose Edit-Access Rights button.-Go to Work Center and View Assignment Tab.-Scope "Assigned to the user" for View "PLM_QUALITYCONTROL" & "PLM_QUALITYPLANNING".-In addition, if the user should have write access for the Site against which the Inventory Notification is being posted in the Detailed Restriction Tab.-Keywords-Inspection; Business User; Authorized; Quality Planning; Quality Control.

Title: Unable to read the price list ID using Odata service.
Content: Symptom-When using OData service, it is not possible to obtain price list details.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management work center-Under Input and Output Management view, select OData Services subview-In the drop-down menu, select Custom OData Services-Select service XYZ (Where XYZ refers to the service)-Click in Edit button-Under the OData Service, SalesPriceList is selected.-Cause-The material ID and price it is not present in the single node, hence we need to navigate with association to get the details.-This is the standard system behaviour so it's not possible to get the details in one go in ODATA services.-Resolution-As a workaround, in order to get the data together, please use the below SOAP service below:-<n0:SalesPriceListFindByIDQuery_flt_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<SalesPriceList>-<UUID></UUID>-<ID>YOUR_PRICE_LIST_ID</ID>-<SalesPriceSpecificationProcessingConditions>-<QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>1</QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>-<QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>false</QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>-<LastReturnedObjectID></LastReturnedObjectID>-</SalesPriceSpecificationProcessingConditions>-</SalesPriceList>-</n0:SalesPriceListFindByIDQuery_flt_sync>-Otherwise, since this would be a new requirement, please refer to the Influence Forum.-

Title: Unable to add Internal Attachment to the Project Purchase Request
Content: Symptom-You want to add an attachment type Internal while creating Project purchase request however you can only add the attachment type Standard.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Projects view-Select the relevant Project-Select Edit and navigate to Products tab-Select the relevant Product and select Create Purchase Request-In the Attachments section, it is only possible to add Standard attachment and Internal is not possible-Cause-Currently we do not have the memo type Internal available in the project purchase request or in purchase request document.-Resolution-This is a new requirement and you can post the idea in influence site -https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign .-Keywords-attachment type Internal while creating Project purchase request; Internal attachment for Project purchase request;Project purchase request

Title: Exception Condition DATE_AFTER_RANGE Raised While Creating a New Check Deposit
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY-You are trying to create a New Check Deposit and has entered the Company and the Bank Account and an Exception is Raised.-ST22 shows Short Text as Exception Condition "DATE_AFTER_RANGE" raised.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management Work center.-Go to the Deposits view.-Go to the Check Deposits Subview.-Select New and then Check Deposit.-Select Company ID and try to select Bank Account ID.-Exception is Raised-Cause-The Validity of the Custom Working Day Calendar is Expired.-Resolution-The Validity of the Custom Working Day Calendar needs to be enhanced in Table TFACD and this can be done by Development Colleagues(AP-RC-DT)-Keywords-DATE_AFTER_RANGE, Check Deposit

Title: Warning Error Message on Actual Cost Allocation Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-DO NOT USE - To be completed. -You perform the Actual Cost Allocation Run and there is the warning message: Action Post_Adjustment not permitted.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to the Periodic Tasks view.-Select the Actual Cost Allocation view.-Select the Run ID AAA (AAA stands for the Run ID).-Select the Log Result.-Select the Messages tab.-There is the warning message: Action Post_Adjustment not permitted.-Cause-The related material for which the Actual Cost Allocation has been done for does not have a successfully posted Material Actual Costing.-Go to the Inventory Valuation work center.-Select the view Material Actual Costing and enter the Material ID in question.-The Lifecycle Status is In Preparation and there is Exception error.-Select Edit.-Under General tab, the Posting Status is 'Not Posted' with error-Select Messages tab.-There are error messages. One possible error is:-'Valuation with cost estimate of production lot XXX failed. CALCULATE-(XXX stands for the Production Lot ID).-Select the line of the Costed Object in error (here, the Production Lot XXX).-Select Messages tab.-There is the error messages:--Valuation with cost estimate of resource YYY (Resource Description) failed.--Cost center ZZZ (YYY) has no cost.-YYY stands for the Resource ID-ZZZ stands for the cost center ID.-Resolution-The error on the Material Costing mentioned in the Cause needs to be resolved for the Material Actual Costing to be posted before the Actual Cost Allocation can be finished successfully and posted.-Note:-The errors on the Costed Object: 'Valuation with cost estimate of resource YYY (Resource Description) failed' and-'Cost center ZZZ (YYY) has no cost' are just an example of error. Depending on the scenario, the error will be different.-Keywords-Material Actual Costing, Actual Cost Allocation, Resource, Cost Center, Production Lot.

Title: Is it Possible to Change Link in Support E-Mails to SSO
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Is it possible to change link in support e-mails to SSO-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Email Notifications received (in case of Incidents related e-mail notification).-2.The link provided in the e-mail directs to non-sso link instead of SSO link-Cause-It is a known limitation.-Resolution-SAP can only provide one link in the e-mail and it must be the non-SSO one, because if we always provide the SSO one and SSO it not enabled in the system, the link will be broken for many users.-It is a huge effort in SAP IT side to replicate additional URLs and it is hard for us to know which URL is for SSOand which is not-All SAP support portal can support both SSO and user password with only one URL, there is no reason we do it differently for ByD product-If the SSO has never been activated in the system then the ICF node for the same might not be active and the SSO URL mostly shows the downtime page.-Keywords-E-mail Notifications, change link in support e-mails, SSO

Title: Report Material Inventories - Balance Summary Deviates from Inventory Cost History
Content: Symptom-You run the Material Inventories - Balance Summary report for Key Date Today and notice deviations in Inventory Value when compared to the Cost History for a material and respective Business Residence.-Even a larger negative Inventory Value can show although there is no stock or negative stock allowed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inventory Valuation work center.-Go to Reports and List.-Open the Material Inventories - Balance Summary report.-Specify pertinent selection criteria as to material, business residence etc. and Key Date as Today (e.g. 20.03.2023).-The Inventory Value shows a different amount as the Inventory Cost History for this current month (e.g. 003.2023). Depending on the circumstances even a negative value can show although no negative stock is present. -Cause-The WIP Clearing run for involved product and production lots has been performed for the current month.-When running the Material Inventories - Balance Summary report with a Key Date Today (e.g. 20.03.2023) this will not include the postings of the WIP Clearing as these are posted effectively only at the end of a period (e.g. 31.03.2023).-If, for example, you always close a month with 0.00 ea Inventory Quantity, hence 0.00 USD Inventory Value, and run the WIP Clearing during the current month this can result in obvious misleading results in Material Inventories - Balance Summary report as it does not include the WIP postings yet.-In case a WIP posting in 003.2023 results in a posting of 1,000 USD - this amount is not included in Material Inventories - Balance Summary report with a Key Date today (20.03.2023) yet.-Under this condition a native Inventory Value of -1,000.00 USD would show for the inventory account.-Resolution-When routinely running the WIP Clearing during a current month adjust the Key Date to the last day of this month (e.g. 31.03.2023). This will include the WIP postings with an effectively pre-dated Posting Date.-Keywords-Negative Inventory

Title: Material Inventories - Line Items Report Shows Zero Amount for Amt Comp Curr column
Content: Symptom-You execute the report Material Inventories - Line Items and found the Key Figure 'Amt Comp Curr' shows 0 value-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics Work Center-Select Design Reports and search for report 'Material Inventories - Line Items'-Open the report and enter the relevant fields like Company Code, Set of Books, G/L account, Journal Entry and so on-Once its executed, you observe the key figure 'Amt Comp Curr' shows 0 amount-Cause-Eventhough the respective Journal Entry has the non zero values for the G/L account used in the report, same amount is available in both the debit and credit side which means the source document e.g. Goods and Activity Confirmation has in(+) and out(-) quantities, resulting in net value of zero for the G/L Account-Resolution-To accurately see the transactional values, the report needs to have 2 columns Journal Entry Item ID and Journal Entry. Then both positive and negative value of same amount can be seen to which the resultant value is zero.-Keywords-Design Report, Material Inventories - Line Items, Goods and Activity Confirmation

Title: Item Status Updated To Not Canceled While Undo-Cancellation of Outbound Delivery
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-In an Outbound Delivery,  items cancellation status shows as canceled however when you perform Undo cancellation, cancellation status updates as Not canceled which is incorrect.-It should remain as Canceled only.--Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks view.-Choose create Sales Order.-Once it is created, release Customer Demand.-Create warehouse request and task is auto created.-Now Confirm the respective task.-Outbound Delivery gets created.-Now perform Undo release of relevant Outbound Delivery ID.-Perform Warehouse Order adjustment via adjustment confirmation.-Now Check Outbound Delivery items are canceled.-Then Cancel Outbound Delivery.-Again perform Undo-Cancellation of relevant Outbound Delivery.-Now check OD's item cancellation status.-You find Item's cancellation status changed Not Canceled which is incorrect. It should remain as Canceled only.-Cause-On performing the undo-cancellation of Outbound Delivery root, the item stays canceled.-However, in some scenarios due to some PDI issue after undo cancellation is done, the line item status is also changed to Not canceled.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-Ideally, you see from the changes tab of OD that when the undo cancellation is performed, the item stays Canceled.-However, in some scenarios due to some PDI issue after undo cancellation is done, the item is also changed to Not Canceled.-If the item status is changed to Not Canceled, then the backend correction has to be performed to change the item status to Canceled.-Note: If you encounter similar case, kindly forward this case to the development component:AP-ODP-OD for correction.-Backend Correction steps:-Backend Details:-BO: APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY-Node: ITEM-DB Table: APDL_D_ODE_ITEM-Pick up the ITEM Node ID from the APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY  BO and open in the Tcode se11 for the DB table APDL_D_ODE_ITEM-In the debugging mode, change the field value ‘CANCELLATION_CD’ to ‘4’.-Post-Checks:-Check if the OD item status is cancelled.-  Keywords-Undo-cancellation, canceled, item canceled status, outbound delivery, You cannot cancel the outbound delivery as it contains confirmed quantities. Before you can cancel, you first have to reverse the related confirmations or create adjustment confirmations, Process Communication Errors , CM_APDL_VALIDATION must be subclass CM_SPAF_AGENT_TASK_ROOT to be able to create task

Title: Email Template Placeholders Are Not Converted Into The Actual Value
Content: Symptom- Output e-mail template not working as expected where placeholders are not converted into the actual value.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Example: Service Order-Go to Service Order Workcenter-Navigate to Service Order Processing-Open Order ID-Click Edit-Click View All-Under Output History user can find the e-mail sent. User notices in e-mail Template placeholders are not converted into the actual value.-Cause-User should use an HTML Template. Check XML which is a good reference to see the structure and placeholder.-Resolution-Every application area has a generic e-mail text body which variates between the application area like CRM, Finance etc.-User should use an HTML e-mail Template. If no HTML e-mail template is used, the SAP generic text will be used which is hardcoded in the backend.-Keywords-HTML Template, e-mail template, Placeholders, actual value

Title: Supplier Invoice Exception "Tax Reporting Unit is not determined"
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You get an exception while posting a supplier Invoice "Tax Reporting Unit is not determined".                                                                                                                             -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice and Credit Memo view-Search for a relevant Supplier Invoice-Choose Edit-Go to Exception Tab-You find this exception: "Tax Reporting Unit is not determined"-Go to Item tab-Select an Item-Navigate to Taxes sub-tab-Under Tax return, Tax Reporting Unit is blank-Cause-Supplier invoice might be created by copying another document where tax reporting unit is not updated.-Resolution-Customer can follow the work around for determining tax reporting unit in supplier invoice, following below steps.-Select for the relevant Supplier Invoice-Select Edit-Choose View All-Navigate to the General Tab-Change the Invoice Date to any other date-Now navigate go to Items Tab-Go to the Item-Go to Taxes Sub-tab-Check that the Tax Reporting Unit field should be determined now-Now you can navigate back to the General Tab and change the Invoice Date back to original date-Save the changes-Following these steps, system retriggers the Tax Reporting Unit determination in the Supplier Invoice.-Keywords-Tax Reporting Unit is not determined; Tax Reporting Unit; Supplier Invoice Tax determination; Supplier Invoice Exception-tax reporting unit,supplier invoice tax determination,supplier invoice exception

Title: System Allows to Release the Contract when Contract End Date is One Day Earlier Than Contract Start Date
Content: Symptom-You find that system allows to release the contract when the contract end date is one day earlier than the contract start date.-You expect the system to prevent this customer contract from being released and show error 'End date and time must be after start date and time'.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders wrok ceter.-Click New Contract from Commen Tasks view.-In the new contract, maintain the account and necessary data, then enter Contract Start Date as for example 2023.03.20 and Contract End Date as 2023.03.19. -Click Release. System successfully releases the contract. -However, you expect that the contract should not be released as the contract end date is earlier than the contract start date.-Cause-When saving a new contract, system stores the beginning of the input Contract Start Date, which is 2023.03.20T00:00:00Z. When this time reaches, the contract starts.-While for contract end date field, system stores the end of the input date, which is also 2023-03-20T00:00:00Z. When this time reaches, this contract becomes expired.-Since the dates are the same, so error "End date and time must be after start date and time" is not triggerred.-Resolution-This is currently the designed system behavior.-Keywords-Customer Contract; Contract Start Date; Contract End Date; End date and time must be after start date and time.

Title: Planning Areas Disappear While creating New Materials
Content: Symptom-User notices Planning Areas disappear while creating new materials in Product Data Workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product Data Work Center.-Navigate to Materials view.-Choose"New"and choose "Material" option.-Open and choose View All-Navigate to Availability Confirmation Tab.-Choose "add row" under Planning Areas section.-Select Planning Area using value help.-Choose "Copy" to add additional Planning Area.-All pending Planning Areas are not shown in list.-Cause-Choose "Add row" option to add additional; planning areas instead of "Copy".-Resolution-Go to Product Data Work Center.-Navigate to Materials view.-Choose "New"and choose "Material" option.-Open "View All".-Navigate to Availability Confirmation Tab.-Click "add row" under Planning Areas section.-Select Planning Area using value help.-Choose "Add row" to add another Planning Area.-Keywords-Planning Area not visible, pending planning area not shown in list, create new materials, Product Data Workcenter

Title: Accounts Payable - Line Items report showing 'Not assigned' value to Withholding tax type field
Content: Symptom-You execute the report Accounts Payable - Line Items and see value 'Accounts Payable - Line Items' to Withholding(WHT) related tax type, tax rate type and so on.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payables work center.-Go to List view.-Open the report Accounts Payable - Line Items.-Execute the report with relevant data and all the Withholding(WHT) related data shows 'Not assigned'-Cause-Its a system behaviour where the report is designed to show the line items for each accounts payable on the reconciliation accounts.-Resolution-To see more data related to WHT, use the report Withholding Tax Items-See Also-KBA 2877027 - Accounts Payable - Line Items Report Shows 0,00 Withholding Tax Amount For Supplier Invoice-Keywords-Withholding tax, tax type, design report

Title: The Time Zone of Extension Field doesn't change Along With the Change of Time Zone in My Settings
Content: Symptom-There is an extension field in a document, for example a production request, and it is maintained as a date and time like 27.01.2023 04:00. In My Settings, Time Zone is UTC+00:00. Now change it to UTC+08:00, log off and log on system again, the extension field is still 27.01.2023 04:00.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Access view Production Requests.-Select a production request, click Edit.-Select General Tab, for extension field ABC (ABC represents extension field label), its value is 27.01.2023 04:00.-On the up-right corner, click the profile, select My Settings.-Change Time Zone from UTC+00:00 to UTC+08:00.-Log off and log on system again.-Open the same production request, its value is still 27.01.2023 04:00.-Cause-The extension field has type as "Extended Text", hence change of time zone in My Settings will not influence it. Only when an extension field has type "Date and Time", will change of time zone in My Settings influence it.-Resolution-System standard behavior.-Keywords-Extension Field, Time Zone, Field Type

Title: Why Purchase order Emails are sent to supplier though DKIM not maintained for any domain.
Content: Symptom-You created a purchase order and sent to the supplier where No DKIM is mainatined  at all,  However the supplier receives the email.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-System considers default email address mainatined in the  BC activity:E-mail fax settings-Note 1:The Sender email ID will be determined using above methods while creating the Purchase order, i.e for first Output sent only and will not be used for resubmission or changes made.- Note 2: If you copy any Purchase order to create new purchase order then sender email address is also copied  as no redetermination happens( however developers have added this to their back log and shall fix it in one of the future releases)-Resolution-Steps to see the Sender of the Output Email is:-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to the Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order and navigate to You can also-Click on Edit output form of PO-Select Send by as Email-Scroll down-You will see that Sender E-Mail Address -If you see  this field empty then  that means system has considered the default Sender email address  appearing in BC activity E-mail and fax settings.-When buyer responsible' s email  or  sender email in Output channel selection is maintained,- Domain of that email is maintained in the BC activity  Email and fax settings-and if no DKIM is maintained for that Domain- then  No email will be sent cause system considers the email and domain but since no DKIM , it fails to send email.-See Also-1789176 - How is the Sender E-Mail Address of a Purchase Order Determined

Title: Canceled Purchase Order Still Available in Supply Control
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- **SAP Internal Use Only**  -You find Canceled Purchase Orders still available in Monitor Purchase Orders view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Control workcenter.-Go to the Monitor Purchase Orders view.-Select Open Purchase Orders query via drop down.-Here, you find list of purchase orders which are already Cancelled.-Cause-Due to the failed message from Purchase Order BO to EPTR BO, Cancelled Purchase orders show up on the Monitor Purchase Orders screen upon selecting Open Purchase Order Items.-Resolution-Note : If you get this issue, send it to developent component : AP-SDM-Pre-checks:-In the Work Center view: Purchase Requests and Orders.-Confirm that the Purchase Order is in Canceled status.  -Backend Correction steps:-Check for the failed messages and reconcile it.-If failed message is not available – It can happen in case of old documents, we can follow below steps:-Execute reconciliation report: /SRMAP/PI_RECONCILIATION-Select 2nd Variant- Reconciliation for specified Business Object Instance-Since we need to send a message from BO to EPTR so-Select Business Object Type Code - 001-Business Object ID - Purchase Order ID-Namespace of Process Component of EPTR_PVPO BO - http://sap.com/xi/AP/SupplyChainControl/Global-Name of Process Component of EPTR_PVPO BO – ExternalProcurementTriggerAndResponse- Post-Checks:-Go to Work Center:Supply Control and choose Monitor Purchase Orders view.-Cancelled PO no longer shows in Open Purchase Order Items query.-Check the system after to ensure the correction has completed.-Keywords-Supply Control , Monitor Purchase Orders, canceled, cancelled, purchase orders, status, Open purchase orders.

Title: Settings for Company specific contracts - Organizational Center dependent List Price selection
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-User wants to change the default Source of Supply.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-This may vary based on the selected Source of Supply (SOS) and expected SOS hence not specifying the same.-Cause-User wants to change the Source of supply default setting based in Organizational settings.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-Since this is BC setting to be changed from backend, Ask customer's permission to do the changes.-Note : If you get this issue, send it to developent component : AP-RC-SRE-Backend Correction steps:-Table Name: SOS_C_SRCPRFL-Field name: OCDEPSOSSELREL-Example: Please set the field OCDEPSOSSELREL = ‘X’ for SRCPRFLCODE = ‘3’ in case during creation on proposals.-How to change the BC table in such a way that it behaves like a fine-tuning activity and changes are not lost at the time of upgrade:-SESFTS: BCT_BO_WORKLIST-Create Worklist-Add Context-Proxy Name: SOS_C_SRCPRFL-Same session, open BO SOS_C_SRCPRFL-Query By Elements: Profile code which needs to be changed-Edit Exclusive-Mark the OC Dependent Sourcing Indicator as true-Save-Post-Checks:-Once the above setting is made, please verify the same by checking Source of supply.-Keywords-Company specific contracts, List Price, Source of Supply

Title: Customer part number not working as expected for sales order documents.
Content: Symptom-Customer part number is not working as expected in a sales order scenario.-When selecting a distribution chain in the product master data under the sales tab, it is possible to set up a customer part number X which is valid for a specific account XYZ (where X is customer part number and XYZ is the account ID). In the sales document it is then possible to add a product using the customer part number instead of the product ID to determine the product.-Therefore the expectation is as follows: When creating a sales document with a different account LMN (where LMN is the account ID) and entering the product ID ABC (where ABC is the product ID), the product should not be determined, since it is only a valid customer part number for account XYZ.-But this does not work accordingly.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center-Under Common Tasks view, select New Sales Order sub-view-Select account ID XYZ -Click on View All-Go to Items tab and add product ID ABC -The product ID ABC is determined for account ID XYZ, which is as expected since a customer part number is maintained under the Product Master Data .-Go to Sales Order work center-Under Common Tasks view, select New Sales Order sub-view-Select account ID LMN -Click on View All-Go to Items tab and add product ID ABC -The system will also allow to add product ID ABC, which is not expected, since the product ID ABC should be linked to account ID XYZ only.-Cause-The customer part number validation only works in B2B sales order scenarios. For a normal sales order, the behaviour does not apply.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Customer Part Number, Sales Order, Product, B2B, Different, Incorrect, False.

Title: Entitlements Description from Migration are Truncated
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-The Details Field in the Migration Template is Limited to 255 Characters for Entitlements-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio.-View: Entitlements.-Show: All Entitlements.-Search and edit the entitlement XYZ (XYZ is the Entitlement ID)-We can enter more than 255 characters in Details section from UI, but it's not possible while migrating it from migration template.-Cause-Development team has found out that this is the known limitation to extend the field length in migration template.-Resolution-Developing team now found out that how to overcome this field length limitation.-An internal JIRA has been raised as https://jira.tools.sap/browse/BYDDEV-8128-This is expected to be fixed with in future release but not guaranteed.-In the meantime, you could use the web service ManageEntitlementProductIn to update the the Detail descriptions of the migrated entitlements.-Keywords-Field Length, Migration Template, Entitlements

Title: When Perform New Externally-Owned Stock Adjustment, Error Triggered "Material ABC not valid".
Content: Symptom-When perform common task New Externally-Owned Stock Adjustment, click Finish, error triggered:-"Material ABC not valid-Inventory process usability for material ABC-Save failed"-(ABC represents the product ID)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Physical Inventory.-Open common task New Externally-Owned Stock Adjustment.-Maintain site DEF (DEF represents site ID) for Site ID, maintain Owner ID and Key Date, click Next.-Click Add Row, maintain ABC (ABC represents product ID) for Product ID, maintain other mandatory fields. Click Next.-Click Finish, error triggered:-        "Material ABC not valid-         Inventory process usability for material ABC-         Save failed"-Cause-In the master data of product ABC, under tab Logistics, there is no site DEF maintained.-Resolution-Please maintain site DEF under tab Logistics in the master data of product ABC.-Keywords-Material, New Externally-Owned Stock Adjustment, Inventory Process

Title: Customer Return Status Is Still In Process Though Outbound Delivery Is Released
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-In Customer Return Repair Scenario, Customer Return Outbound status for item is still In Process while corresponding outbound delivery is already released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center-Choose Return view and search for the relevant ID.-Here the document is with status In Process.-Select and edit it.-Navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Respective Outbound Delivery status has created and is released already.-Now, go to the Items tab.-The respective Outbound Delivery status is with status In Process for that particular item.-Cause-Status update message from Outbound delivery request to Customer Return is not processed successfully due to ODR having 0 EA in confirmed quantity of confirmation item schedule.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-It should be Customer Return – Repair Scenario.-Customer Return Item – Outbound Status should be “In Process”. Corresponding Outbound Delivery should be released, and Processing Status should be Finished.-Outbound Delivery Request (ODR) Confirmation Item – Schedule Line for corresponding Outbound Delivery should not have confirmed and delivered qty same as Outbound delivery fulfilled Qty.-Note: If you encounter such issue, kindly forward to the development component:AP-ODP-OD-Backend Correction steps:-Change the quantities in ODR Confirmation Item – Schedule Line for corresponding Outbound Delivery to same as Outbound Delivery Fulfilled Qty.-Reconcile the message from ODR to Customer Return.-Post-Checks:-Check if message from ODR to Customer Return delivered with correct details.-Customer Return Outbound status for item should change to “Finished”.-Keywords-Outbound Delivery request, Outbound Delivery, Customer return repair, customer return, status, Released

Title: Unable to Generate PDF For All Customer Account Statements
Content: Symptom-User trying to generate PDF for all customer account statements that are there in the periodic task view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Receivables Work center-Navigate Periodic Tasks View-Go to Customer Account Statement-Choose Account Statement Run ID-Click View Report Run Results-Navigate to Attachments-When Opening the attachment screen shows error" Service Cannot Be Reached"-Cause-Issue is due to "cache" in periodic task attachment tab (represents Output History tab) which has huge documents.-When the attachment tab is loaded the documents that are there in the top/beginning of the attachment tab get loaded automatically and the screen is loaded and stored in browser cache.-However the documents which are at the bottom/end are neither loaded nor stored in cache and when user is clicking on the document screen throws error.-Resolution-To view the PDF, user has to select the entry in Attachment tab first so that information of the document gets loaded and then choose the document link so that PDF is displayed.-Keywords-periodic task attachment tab, Customer Account Statements output not available, unable to generate PDF

Title: Reference Sales Order missing from Data Source: Customer Contract Header
Content: Symptom-You find that Reference Sales Order is missing from Data Source: Customer Contract Header-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Data Source: Customer Contract Header-Select Contract ID ABC (ABC represents your contract ID)-In the View section, add "Reference Sales Order" in Row Fields-You can see it only displays the value as "X" (X represents Sales Order ID)-Open Contract ABC-Navigate to Document Flow tab-You can see two reference sales order X and Y (Y represents Sales Order ID)-Cause-Data Source Name: Customer Contract Header-Data Source ID: CRMCCOHB-Characteristic Name: Reference Sales Order-Characteristic ID: CCCO_DRF_SALES_ORDER_UUID-Key figure "Counter" field is added in the View column field.-Resolution-Remove the Counter field from the column fields, you will get both sales order IDs displayed.-This is the current system behavior.-You could create your own data source in the SAP Cloud Application Studio, and design it so that it will retrieve the data that you need.-Keywords-Customer Contract Header, CRMCCOHB, Reference Sales Order, Key figure, Counter

Title: 'Account Determination Group for Cash' is missing in Cash Subledger of Chart of accounts activity
Content: Symptom-You are trying to do configuration for Subledger 'Cash' under Activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination' and observe 'Account Determination Group for Cash' column is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configurtion work center-Select activity 'Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination' and open it-Open Cash Subledger-Select relevant Chart of accounts row and under 'Cash Disbursement in Transit', you see Account Determination Group for Cash' column is missing.-Cause-The field is hidden in the UI-Resolution-You can unhide it using personalization mode and select Unnamed table -> Account Determination Group for Cash-Please note: Same KBA applies for any field which is missing under the activity.-Keywords-Business Configuration, Chart of accounts, Account Determination group, Personalization mode

Title: Duplicate Entries Visible in Preview Document
Content: Symptom-When user preview document they notice duplicate entries of e-mail ID/Contact/Address/fax etc.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Example: Purchase Order-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders WorkCenter.-Navigate to Purchase Orders view-Select Purchase Order ID-Click Preview-Select and open document-User notices that same data is displayed multiple times. Example: duplicate entries of e-mail ID/contact etc is seen in output-Cause-Fields are being duplicated because there is a text predefined in the form showing the same information as the fields with the data binding.-Resolution-User should check the binding maintained and user need to remove the text and keep only the fields with the binding so the data will be shown correctly in preview output.-Keywords-Binding, duplicate entries, preview output, data shown twice,

Title: User Account and Contact Details Are Not Visible in Customer Workcenter.
Content: Symptom-User maintained the account and contact details however it is not visible in Customer workcenter.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customers WorkCenter.-Navigate to Accounts View.-Search and open account ID to verify if details are maintained.-Navigate to Contacts view.-Select and open the Business Role ID of respective account.-Account and contact details maintained under Business Role ID is not visible in screen.-Cause-Read access "restricted" for Business Role ID.-Resolution-Go to Administrator WorkCenter.-Navigate to General Settings view.-Under "Users" view choose " Business Role"-Select and Open Business Role ID-Choose "View All"-Go to "Access Restriction" Tab. -For Workcenter view Accounts and Contacts read access should be Unrestricted then user can see maintained details on screen.-Keywords-Read access,unrestricted, Account and contact details,maintained details not visible, Customer workcenter

Title: Unable To Cancel Outbound Delivery Though Warehouse Quantity Is Zero
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You are trying to cancel Outbound Delivery when all the quantity adjusted to 0 at warehouse side however system throws below error while canceling :-You cannot cancel the outbound delivery as it contains confirmed quantities. Before you can cancel, you first have to reverse the related confirmations or create adjustment confirmations.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Work Center.-Go to Outbound Deliveries View-Search for required Outbound Delivery ID.-Select and edit it.-Choose Cancel.-System triggers above error message.-Cause-Outbound cannot be canceled even if all the quantity adjusted to 0 at warehouse side. It is caused by Quantity Conversion Remainder Issue where different UOMs are maintained for Sales and Inventory.-Later at the time of warehouse adjustment some residual quantity like 0.00000000000001 kg remains as delivery quantity at Outbound Delivery side.-(i.e.Here 0.00000000000001kg is residual quantity example in kg)-Resolution-Pre-checks:-It is the Outbound scenario.-Delivery quantity in Outbound Delivery has some residual value like 0.00000000000001 kg.-In corresponding warehouse order, fulfilled quantity for the item is zero.-Note: If you encounter such issue, kindly forward this case to development component: AP-ODP-OD.-Backend Correction steps:-Open Outbound Delivery BO APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY in SESFTS (BO Test Shell)-Navigate to ITEM Node and then ITEM_QUANTITY.-Choose the quantity with role code 18 (Delivery Quantity) and change it to 0.-Save, there should not be any error while saving.-Post-Checks:-Check the delivery quantity in Outbound Delivery UI, it should be zero.-Ask the customer to cancel the OD from UI, there should not be any issue.-Keywords-Outbound, You cannot cancel the outbound delivery as it contains confirmed quantities, Outbound Logistics, Outbound Delivery.

Title: Custom Discount List is Not Supported for Customer Return Without Reference
Content: Symptom-You find that the custom discount list is not supported for customer return without reference while the extension scenario has been extended from material to customer return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center - Returns View-Open Return ABC (where ABC stands for the Return ID)-Navigate to Pricing tab-You can see there is no Product Discount-Cause-For now custom discount list is not supported for customer return without reference. It is supported for customer return with reference to sales order.-In the case of freight, this is also not supported for the return. For the surcharge scenario, forcing the recalculation of pricing does not impact this. The surcharge is still carried onto the return.-Resolution-This is the current system behavior.-The issue requires more extensive evaluation and testing. As a result, we have added the issue into the development backlog to enable us to do more comprehensive analysis and testing, to see if we can enable this scenario without any risk to the existing scenarios.-Keywords-Customer Return, Custom Discount List, Without Reference

Title: Created By User of Fixed Asset is different than the Created By from the Supplier Invoice Acquisition
Content: Symptom-The User for the Created By field for an Acquisition Supplier Invoice of a Fixed Asset is different than the one appearing in the corresponding created Fixed Asset.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Assets work center.-Select the Fixed Assets view.-Search for ID XXX and open it.(XXX represents the ID of the Fixed Asset)-Result: Under administrative data you can see for the field Created By, the User ABC appears.(ABC represents the User ID)-Then click on View all.-Go to Values tab.-Select Journal.-Open the Acquisition Supplier Invoice Source document.-From the document flow click on the accounting notification.-Result: The Journal entry shows the User DEF for the field Created By.--Your expectation is that the User that created the Supplier Invoice should also appear in the Fixed Asset for the field Created By.-Cause-The invoice was approved by a User. In Business ByDesign the approver creates the Journal entry. The journal entry does the posting to the different ledgers, including Fixed Asset, hence the approver is the one who will create the Asset.-Resolution-This is the standard system behavior, you can verify this by adding the field Journal Entry Created By. The User appearing will be the approver of the invoice.-Keywords

Title: How to change the license distribution time for JAVA systems
Content: Symptom-The automatic license data distribution process for JAVA Systems is as below.-And you intend to change the execution time of application "com.sap.agent.application.globallicenseaudit" of Diagnostics Agent.-SAP Solution Manager gets the maintenance certificate from SAP Global Support Backbone and the License Information can be found in "License Management".-The Extractor Framework in the SAP Solution Manager system controls the distribution of the licenses or maintenance certificates to Java systems.-The 'License Distribution' extractor captures the license data in the SAP Solution Manager system, daily.-The license data is distributed to the JAVA-managed system automatically by the application "com.sap.agent.application.globallicenseaudit" of Diagnostics Agent and they are then available in the Licensing Adapter.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.20-Resolution-This can be achieved by configuring the time slot for extractor: LICENSE DISTRIBUTION. -Navigate to Extractors Administration UI with tr_cd:e2e_extractor_fwk or from tr_cd:sm_workcenter;-Filter: "LICENSE DISTRIBUTION" extractor for the concerning JAVA system;-Switch to Edit mode;-Click on the "Extractor Detail" tab and then the "Configuration" tab-In the Additional configuration .xml file, specify the time slot of execution hours as below.--<TimeSlots>-<Hour from="03" to="05"/>  ==> modify this range as per requirement and save.--**Pay attention to the format "hh": Ex."03" is correct and "3" is incorrect. -The extractor will not be triggered if setting it to "3".-See Also-Automatic Distribution of License Data
