Title: Error Appears While Trying to Cancel the Down Payment Request
Content: Symptom-You want to cancel the down payment request however system shows an error message.-Error - Cancel not possible; down payment request has already been paid-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoices and Credit Memos view-Selec the relevant down payment request-Click on Cancel button-Error appears-Cause-The down payment request is already Paid and hence the cancellation is not allowed.-Resolution-If you want to cancel the downpayment request, first cancel the correspoinding clearing document and the bank statements. Later you can cancel the down payment request.-Keywords-Cancel not possible; down payment request has already been paid; Cannot cancel down payment request

Title: Unable to View "Key User Settings" in User Profile
Content: Symptom-User want to view Key User Settings option in user profile/Avatar.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to Tenant-Go to User Profile/Avatar icon.-Key User Settings is not visible.-Cause-This is because user is not assigned to workcenter view.-Resolution-Go to Application and User management Workcenter-Navigate to Business User under User and Access Management view.-Select User ID-Edit " Access Rights"-Under "Work Center and View Assignment" navigate to Work Center/ View Name "Application and User Management"-Assign Work Center/View ID "ITS_KEYUSERCHANGELOG" to user.-Keywords-Key User Settings, user session settings, start adoption mode, company settings, avatar, user profile, account

Title: Changes made to list price are not appearing under changes tab
Content: Symptom-You have made changes like price to the existing active list price , however you don't see those changes in the changes tab-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to product portfolio work center-Click on list prices view-Select and edit existing active list price-Change the price to some new value and click on save-Go to changes tab-You will not see the  price changes  at all-however you can see the change in price history tab as expected.-Cause-Since new list price is created thus changes happened to existing active list price does not appear in the changes tab .-Resolution-If you update active list price then system creates automatically a new list price, which you can see under all list prices and then you can release it- If you  update active list price  and you check mark "change the past list price" then no  new list price is created and  thus you will see all changes in the changes tab- Refer below SAP Help Portal-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2cc30f26722d10149ea4fb17e0bbfd8a.html--""-Updating List PricesWhen you update a list price that has the Released status, the system creates a version of the list price using the current date as the Valid From date. Once you have finished updating the list price and release it, you then have two list prices: the updated list price with the current date or date specified by you as the Valid From date, and one list price with the date prior to the new Valid From as the new Valid To date.You can also update past list prices. If you select the Change Past List Price check box, you can only change the price, price scales, and the list price description. You cannot change the valid from/to dates. The changes in price are therefore only displayed on the Changes tab page.When you update a list price that is in the In Preparation status, the system updated the list price and does not create a new version of the list price.The List Price becomes inactive once its validity expires. The expired List Price does not have any implication on Purchasing documents.NoteIf in the product master data the product category that is specified in the list price has changed, the system automatically updates the product category in the list price.-""-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/2754875d2d2a403f95e58a41a9c7d6de/2de04890722d1014aa00fd8f09dfcec6.html-SAP Help Portal-""-Update a 'Released' List PriceIn the Product Portfolio work center, in the List Prices view, select the released list price and click Edit.If you want to update the list price description and/or price scales, check the indicator Change Past List Price.This ensures that you are updating the existing list price instead of creating a new one.Update the List Price Description or price Scales.Click Save.If you want to update the validity period of the list price along with the description or price scales, uncheck the Change Past List Price indicator.Update the List Price Description, price Scales, or Valid From/To fields.Click Save.NoteWhen you try to update a released list price, the system creates a new list price by default-""-Keywords-edit list price

Title: Error When Releasing Over-The Counter Outbound Delivery: 'Negative stock not permitted in logistics area *, material *'
Content: Symptom-You have created an Over-The-Counter-Sale document where the Quantity is more than your Inventory Quantity. Hence, when try to release the Outbound Delivery created against the Over-The-Counter-Sale document, the system is reporting the error: Negative stock not permitted in logistics area *, material * (* is a placeholder for the Logistics Area ID and the Material ID).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Over-the-Counter Sales work center. -Go to the Over-the-Counter Sales view. -Find and select the relevant Over-the-Counter Sales docuemt.-Click Edit and then View All.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see the Outbound Delivery is Not Released.-If you open and then try to release the Outbound Delivery, the system displays the mentioned error message.-Cause-Though you have maintained "Negative Stock Allowed" for the Site/ Location, you have not done same for the Over-The-Counter Logistics Area.-Resolution-Please maintain the stock or allow negative stock also at the Logistics Area level and try to release Outbound Delivery again.-Keywords-Over the Counter OTC Outbound Delivery

Title: Product Specification of Product ABC Assigned to iStock of Product PQR
Content: Symptom-The system allows you to assign the PRS of Product <ABC> to the iStock of Product <PQR>. ABC and PQR are sample product IDs.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view and choose the option New Identified Stock.-In the field Product, enter the product id - <PQR>, enter an expiration date.-In the field Product Specification, enter the product specification ID  and choose to Save the document.-Choose the button Change Status and select the option Activate.-The document is activated without any errors.-The PRS Id is a product specification assigned to the product <ABC> and the system still allows identified stock of <PQR> to have the PRS assigned to it.-Cause-PRS has two use cases:-Specifying a product variant.-Make-to-order.-Especially in the make to order scenario it can happen that the PRS of a finished product is inherited to an assembly or a component during MRP planning. In those cases it could happen that you need to create an istock for that assembly or component for a PRS(product specification) that was assigned to the finished product.-This is the reason why the system allows the above scenario without errors.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-Keywords-PRS error, product specification error, wrong assignment of product specification, wrongly assigned prs, product specification assign error, istock prs error

Title: How to Deactivate ByDesign ERM Functionality When ByDesign Concur Integration is Scoped
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-[INTERNAL USE ONLY]-You have scoped SAP Business ByDesign and Concur Integration .You want to know on how to deactivate SAP Business ByDesign ERM functionality.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-If customer has scoped ByD Concur Integration, creation, change and approval of expense reports in ByD Travel & Expense shall be deactivated.-In order to deactivate this logon to customer’s backend system.-Open transaction SE16 and enter table HCF_I_SUP_PROC and press “Insert Table Entries”.-On the following screen, enter the following values and press “Save”-GROUP_ID          APERM-SEMID   NOEDI-VALUE   X-Then do the same for the following entry to be added as well:-GROUP_ID          APERM-SEMID   NOAPV-VALUE   X-After saving you should have at least (there may be more entries for other switches) the following two entries in table HCF_I_SUP_PROC:-If you now try to create a new expense report or change / edit / approve an existing one, you will always (i.e. for all employees) get the error message “Employee & is blocked.”-Keywords-Deactivate ByDesign ERM,Concur Expense Reporting.

Title: Cancelled Stock Transfer Order Line Items Available In Planning View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-You want to know why cancelled Stock Transfer Order has lines still displayed in supply planning view screen.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supply Planning workcenter.-Go to the Products view.-Find the required Product ID: XYZ ( i.e. here XYZ is a Product ID ).-Select it and choose Open.-Under Supply and Demand tab, Supply and Demand list subtab.-You can find Stock Transfer Order's Line item which is already Cancelled, still displayed in planning screen.-Cause-Due to dangling SPR issue, Cancelled Stock Transfer Order has lines still displayed under Supply Planning – Products.-Resolution-Note : If you get this issue, send it to developent component : AP-SDM-SPR.-Pre-checks:-Go to Supply Planning - Products. Check the Stock Transfer Order mentioned. Take the Supply Planning Area from this screen.-Go to MAT_SUPPLY_DEMAND_VIEW - Overview - Query by Elements - Give the Product and Supply Planning Area.-Go to Root. Go to Item. Here check the quantity and BTD ID (if present). Select the line item. Navigate to SPR. If an entry exists here, then it is a dangling SPR issue.-Backend Correction steps:-If it is a dangling SPR issue, then reassign the incident to component AP-SDM-SPR.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Canceled, Cancelled, Planning, Supply Planning, Products view, Supply and Demand

Title: Bill Of Material Has Line Item With TEXT Items
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-User has a Bill Of Material where there is a line item with only TEXT items as input products.-It is not possible for the user to finish the production order. It gets stuck in the Started status as the supply task is not started and is not possible to finish.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Planning and Production Master Data workcenter.-Go to Production Bill of Material view.-Select the required BoM ID and edit it.-Go to the Input Products tab.-Go to the section: Filter Options and choose All via drop down. -You find Line item with TEXT only.-Cause-An output product cannot be made with zero input products, a text item is not an actual input product. This causes an issue.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-BOM should be created with only TEXT item input products.-Supply to production should be enabled.-Note : If you get this issue, send it to developent component : AP-PMM-BOM-Backend Correction steps:-Delete the Supply Operation and Operation Activity nodes for both PRODUCTION_LOT and PRODUCTION_ORDER-  Open SESFTS-Delete PRODUCTION_LOT operation activity and operation-Open PRODUCTION_LOT BO-Navigate to OPERATION, select Type code 10-Navigate to OPERATION_ACTIVITY-Copy NODE_ID-Open SE11-Open TABLE APPEL_UDD_P3-Search for node ID and delete-Go back to SESFTS and navigate to PARENT-Copy NODE_ID-Go back to SE11-Open TABLE APPEL_UDD_P2-Search for node ID and delete-  Delete PRODUCTION_ORDER operation activity and operation-Open PRODUCTION_LOT BO-Navigate to OPERATION, select Type code 10-Navigate to PEO_OPERATION-Navigate to OPERATION_ACTIVITY-Copy NODE_ID-Open SE11-Open TABLE APPEO_UDD_P3-Search for node ID and delete-Go back to SESFTS and navigate to PARENT-Copy NODE_ID-Go back to SE11-Open TABLE APPEO_UDD_P2-Search for node ID and delete-  Cancel the Production Order.-Mark the BOM with the issue as Obsolete or ask customer to add the input products to the BOM.-Create a new Production Model from the modified BOM and use it to create a new Production Order.- Post-Checks:-Ensure that Supply task is deleted.-Check if the Production Order status has been updated to Cancelled.-Keywords-Production BoM, Bill of Material, Started status, TEXT, Supply Task, Input Product

Title: Tax Details Missing in the Delivery Note for Stock Transfer Invoice in Interstate Stock Transfer Scenario
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see the tax amount details under GST columns when you preview the Delivery Note for a stock transfer order.-Country: India-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-In the Show field, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant Delivery ID.-Select the Delivery ID and choose the Preview button.-In the preview pdf of the delivery note, you could see that the system does not display tax amount details under GST columns.-Cause-You are transferring the stock from one state to another state (Interstate transfer) and IGST is applicable in this scenario.-You have not maintained Assessable Value in the material master data for respective Company and Business Residence (Ship-to and Ship-from loacations).-You can check Ship-to and Ship-from loacations in the Delivery ID:-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-In the Show field, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant Delivery ID.-You can view Ship-to and Ship-from loacations under General tab.-Resolution-You need to follow below steps to maintain Assessable Value for the respective material:-Go to the Product Portfolio work center.-Go to the Products -> By Materials view.-In the Show field, select All Materials by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant material ID.-Click on Edit and select View All tab.-Go to the Valuation tab.-Select teh respective Company and Business Residence.-Enter Assessable Value amount.-Now you need to create new Stock Transfer Order to show the GST details in the delivery note.-Keywords-GST Stock transfer, Interstate STO, GST details not are not showing in delivery note preview, Assessable value

Title: Technical error APACR_APPL_LOG 253 and Technical error APACR_APPL_LOG 257
Content: Symptom-The below error messages  are displayed after confirmation update run is executed-Technical error APACR_APPL_LOG 253; Report an incident.-Technical error APACR_APPL_LOG 257; Report an incident.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound Logistics Control work center.-Navigate to the Automated Actions view and choose the option Confirmation Update Runs.-Select the relevant run and choose the Schedule button.-In the Scheduled Jobs screen, choose the option Start Immediately and select the Save and Close button.-Wait for the Job to complete.-Select the job log once the job is completed and expand the values under Results tab of the Application Log.-You can see the reported error message.-Cause-The reported errors are temporary lock errors.-It means while the relevant run was executed some user(s) were editing the sales order(s) which set system lock on these orders. -As these sales order were locked the run was unable to process them and the reported error indicates the same.  -Resolution-Please make sure that there are no users editing the orders which are scheduled for selected in confirmation update run execution.-Keywords-APACR_APPL_LOG 253,  APACR_APPL_LOG 257, confirmation update run, lock error in confirmation update run, error in confirmation update run

Title: Error Message: Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets
Content: Symptom-You are unable to post a Goods and Service receipt in the unposted source documents as there is an error Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets.-Or-You are trying to perform 'Complete Scrapping' of a Fixed asset and system throws error message: 'Posting not possible; fixed asset incomplete' since the asset is incomplete.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Post a Goods and Service receipt:-Go to General ledger work center.-Go to closing cockpit view.-Select the Source document view.-Under the unposted source documents.-You find the Goods and Service receipt document with the error message Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets-Scrap the Fixed asset:-Go to Fixed asset work center-Search for Related asset and select Manual Posting -> Complete Scrapping-Click on Simulate or Post and system throws error message: 'Posting not possible; fixed asset incomplete' since the asset is incomplete.-Cause-The Migration Objects - Fixed Asset and Fixed Assets(Extended) must be disabled.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration workcenter .-Navigate to the Implementation project view.-Select the activity Enable Data Migration per Object.-Open the activity.-Under the Migration Object, the Fixed Asset and Fixed Assets(Extended) are Enabled.-You need to disable both of the tick boxes and click save.--After this, you will be able to post the Goods and Service Receipt.-Keywords-Scrapping, post a Goods and Service receipt, Fixed asset

Title: Incorrect Non-Adjustable indicator in Delivery Documents in Stock Transfer Order.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-You find incorrect Non-adjustable indicator for delivery documents in Stock Transfer Order scenario.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound/ Inbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Common Tasks view and choose Stock Overview.-In Advanced filter, search for required Product ID as per Outbound Delivery ID.-Choose Go.-You find that Product ID is a serialized product.-Choose Serial Inventory overview.-Here system displays Non-Adjustable Indictaor for respective serial numbers.-Unable to process stock transfer orders delivery documents.-Cause-Outbound Delivery's product's serial number has non-adjustable indicator set preventing release of OD.-The Outbound Delivery is the last active document and there are no changes in Outbound Delivery with respect to Release and Undo-Release actions. -There are also no changes to product master data since creating the document.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-KBA “3154464 - Serial number cannot be deleted; this is not the last active document” should match the scenario if error is coming during adjustment confirmation of delivery documents.-Error “Serial number XYZ does not exist in inventory” on release of Delivery Documents.-Delivery Document should be the last active document in Serial Number tracking.-Non-adjustable indicator is not checked in Serial Inventory and checked in Item Product Serial Number node: ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER of Delivery Document in SESFTS.-It is a STO scenario- Note : If you find similar case after pre-checks, kindly forward this ticket to development component: AP-ODP.-Backend Correction steps:-Open the Delivery Document in backend and navigate to Item Product Serial number node:  ITEM_PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER  of corresponding Product, Serial Number.-Uncheck the Non-adjustable indicator.-Post-Checks:-Once it is done, ask Customer to try same action again (Release or Adjustment confirmation), error should be gone now.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Order, Serial number cannot be deleted; this is not the last active document, serial number, Outbound, inbound, non-adjustable indicator

Title: Cancel Button On Inbound Deliveries Grayed Out
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-You find that Cancel button on Inbound Deliveries is grayed out although corresponding warehouse order is adjusted to 0.-After undo release of Confirmed Inbound Delivery and performing the adjustment confirmation to have all items with zero qty, the CID Delivery Status is still not updated from "Finished" to "Not Started".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Inbound Logistics workcenter.-Go to Inbound Deliveries View-Search for required Inbound Delivery ID.-Select and open it.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-Choose Extended view and open relevant warehouse Order ID.-Now you find that the fulfilled quantity is adjusted to 0.-However the Cancel button on Inbound Delivery is Grayed out.-Cause-Due to some inconsistency, Delivery Status is not updated correctly.-Resolution-Pre-checks:-The Confirmed Inbound Delivery Document is not in Canceled status.-The Confirmed Inbound Delivery Document has the fulfilled quantities as 0.-Note: If you encounter such case, kindly forward ticket to development component: AP-IDP-CID-Backend Correction steps:-Go to TCode SESFTS --> BO APDL_CONF_INB_DELIVERY --> Query CID --> Get the Node ID-Go to TCode SE11 and open table APDL_D_CID_ROOT. Using the Node ID picked in Step 1, find the row to be edited and change the DeliveryProcessingStatusCode field to 1.-Post-Checks:-Ensure Confirmed Inbound Delivery Document’s Delivery Status is "Not Started" in OIF.-The Cancel button is enabled in OIF.-  Keywords-Confirmed Inbound Delivery, Not started, Canceled, Warehouse order, fulfilled quantity

Title: How to Create Workflow Rule Based on Sales Order Approval Process
Content: Symptom-You would like to create a workflow rule based on sales order approval process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management - Workflow Rules-Click New button-Enter a Description and Business Object as Sales Order -Click Add Group-Under Field Approval Status is not there-Cause-In Sales Order there is no Approval Status field available.-Resolution-You can use Lifecycle Status instead of Approval Status to trigger workflow notification.-Go to Application and User Management - Workflow Rules-Click New button -Enter a Description and Business Object as Sales Order-Click Next-Click Add Group-Under Field select Lifecycle Status and click checkbox Value Before Object Change-Maintain Compare Operator as Equal to and Value In Preparation-Click Ok-Click Add Group-Under Field select Lifecycle Status-Maintain Compare Operator as Equal to and Value Open-Click Next and add the details as required-Click Next and Activate. -In this case workflow notification will be triggered for the sales orders with status changed from In Preparation to Open.-Keywords-WorkFlow Rule not working; Notification;

Title: Unable to Export Catalogs Data Through Data Source or Data Extraction Process
Content: Symptom-You want to export product catalogs data through data source or data extraction process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center -Go to Data Sources view -Select Design Data Sources sub view-Search for Catalogs -You do not see any data source to export Catalog data- Or-Go to Application and User Management work center -Go to Data Extraction view-You do not see the Catalog under Extraction objects-Cause-[Enter your Cause here...]-Currently there is no data source or data extraction process to export catalogs data. You can post this as a new requirement in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-  Resolution-You can export the catalogs from the below work center view.-Go to Product Portfolio work center-Go to Catalogs view -Select all Catalogs -Select Export button -> To Microsoft Excel- This way you can export catalogs data to MS excel.-Keywords-Export Catalogs Data; How to export catalogs?; Product Catalog export

Title: South Korea Country Tab is Missing Under Personnel Administration
Content: Symptom-You have scoped country South Korea in Business Configuration, but while hiring employee you find there is no South Korea country tab under Personnel Administration work center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center, Implementation Project view.-Select the Project.-Edit Project Scope.-Country South Korea is maintained in country list.-Go to Personnel Administration work center, Regular Tasks view.-South Korea country tab is missing.-Cause-For South Korea, you need to separately scope 'Non-Localized Employees' in Human Resources for HCM related activities.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center, Implementation Project view.-Select the Project.-Edit Project Scope.-Go to the 3 step: Scoping.-Navigate to Human Resources-> Personnel Administration.-Scope Non-Localized Employees.-Save and Close.-Keywords-South Korea, Personnel Administration, Non-Localized Employees

Title: How to Block Updates to Time Entries in Older Months via Microsoft Excel
Content: Symptom-How to block updates to time entries in older months via Microsoft Excel-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The feature to block updates to time entries is tied to ESS time sheet only. Uploading times via excel is considered to be more an “admin task” – so the feature is not applicable there. Also, the way our timesheet works is that in 95% of cases, time entries can be saved in the inactive state. Only where there are data inconsistencies is when the Save is prohibited. If this feature was also taking excel upload time entries, it results in a large number of inactive times, which is a pain for the administrator to clean up.-Resolution-This feature is not available. You can raise the request for this via influence request channel  https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-block updates to time entries, ESS Time sheet, Excel upload, Feature

Title: Difference of the Ending Balance Company Currency Between Report Trial Balance and Report Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance
Content: Symptom- You run the two reports, Trial Balance and Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance, finding that there is difference in the amount of Ending Balance Company Currency.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Report view.-Open report Trial Balance.-Enter below values in the selection; Company->AA; Set of Books->BB; Accounting period/Year->CCC.DDDD…EEE.DDDD; Display Currency - Conversion Date->FF.GG.DDDD.-Run the report.-Here you found the amount of Ending Balance Company Currency is XXXX.-Now, open the other report.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Report view.-Open report Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance.-Enter below values in the selection; Company->AA; Set of Books->BB; Accounting period/Year->CCC.DDDD…EEE.DDDD; Display Currency - Conversion Date->FF.GG.DDDD.-Run the report.-Here you found the amount of Ending Balance Company Currency is YYYY.-You will see the difference is XXXX-YYYY=ZZZZ-Cause-The difference comes from Journal Entry Voucher postings done on any of the General Ledger Accounts.-Journal Entry Voucher Posting are on the General Ledger Account level and does not show up in Account Receivable Trial Balance Report.-Sometimes the differences dates back to previous Fiscal Years and do not necessarily belong to Fiscal Year for which the reports are being run.-Resolution-Once you have identified the Journal Entry Voucher postings,You can run the General Ledger Account line item to identify the Difference.-See Also-2910918 - The Difference of the Ending Balance Company Currency Between Report Trial Balance and Report Accounts Receivable - Trial Balance-Keywords-Trial Balance,Accounts Receivable Trial Balance,Ending Balance Company Currency

Title: Error message "Ship-To or Product missing" in credit memo
Content: Symptom-An exception with the error message "Ship-To or Product missing" in credit memo-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoices and Credit Memos.-Filter for All Documents.-Search for Credit Memo PQR, open it and click on View All button (PQR represents the Document ID).-Navigate to Exception tab.-The status is Exception and the error message is Ship-To or Product Recipient missing.-Cause-Ideally if the credit memo is created from Invoice, the ship to would be copied from the supplier invoice.-Here, we see that it is an inter-company transaction meaning Customer Credit memo would create a Supplier credit memo.-This is the reason that the ship to location was not updated in the supplier credit memo.-Resolution-There is no ship-to information in the customer credit memo and hence the data was not taken to the supplier credit memo: PQR which got created from Customer Credit Memo.-Note: It is necessary to have ship to location in order to determine the permanent establishment on the Financial side.

Title: System Throws Error: Product ID XXXX does not exist For Outbound Delivery
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-When you are checking consistency for an Outbound Delivery, an error occurs as below:--Product ID XXXX does not exist  (i.e. Here XXXX is the Product ID as an example)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Over-The-Counter Sales workcenter.-Go to Outbound Deliveries view.-Search for the relevant Outbound Delivery ID.-Select and edit it.-Choose Check Consistency.-System throws error message: Product ID XXXX does not exist-Resolution-Pre-checks:-Check if the Outbound Delivery is of type Over the counter sales.-Open the Outbound Delivery  and do the check consistency, we need to get the error – “Product ID XXX Does not exist”.-Ensure that the Product used is valid product and only the proceed for backend correction, else delete the entire process and start the new.-Note: If you encounter such issues, kindly forward it to the development component:AP-ODP.-Backend Correction steps:-Open BO test shell (SESFTS) and open the Outbound Delivery effected.-Navigate to Items – Item Product node-Verify that Product- UUID field is blank.-Open the new BO Test shell and query the BO PDM_MATERIAL with the Product id in the OD.-Copy the UUID in the field UUID_KEY-PRODUCT_UUID-CONTENT-Open the table in SE16 - APDL_D_ODE_PROD.-Query the node id and in edit mode from debugging add Product UUID copied and save.-Post-Checks:-Return to the ByDesign screen and refresh the Outbound Delivery UI, check consistency. It should be Consistent.-Keywords-Product ID XXXX does not exist, over the counter sales, Outbound delivery, check consistency,

Title: Error Party ABC Does not Exist or Not Valid For This Role
Content: Symptom-Error Party <ABC> Does not Exist or not valid for this role; while checking consistency for Custodian Goods Return Notification. (ABC represents a dummy value)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Navigate to the Inbound Delivery Notification view.-Search for the relevant Custodian Goods Return, select and choose the Edit button.-Choose the Check Consistency button.-You get the above reported error message.-Cause-You have not maintained any value in the Sender ID field for the return notification.-The value in Sender ID field should be business partner ID of the sender who created the delivery note and shipped the product.-This will be the Account ID mapped to the custodian in your system.-Resolution-If you check the consistency once the above Account ID is maintained in the Sender ID field, the reported error message will not be displayed any more.-Keywords-custodian goods return error, error while checking consistency for return notification, return notification error, error while goods return notification

Title: Planning board Tab Works With Double Click only
Content: Symptom-After 2211 upgrade, in planning board when user enters number and Tab for next input cell, user needs to double Tab instead of one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go To Demand Planning WorkCenter View-Select Demand Plans-Select any Active demand plans -Enter value in final forecast field one after another-Example: Enter "number" in first column, then 'Tab' to enter value in second column.At this point, cursor stays in first input cell only. User need to 'Tab' twice to move to next input cell.-Cause-This is System Expected Behavior after 2211 Upgrade.-Resolution-This is not a bug however is a requirement from Accessibility Product Standard.-The first Tab focuses on the input field. And the second Tab navigates to the calculator.-At first Tab, user can input the value directly in the field. After second Tab, user can press Enter to open the calculator.-Keywords-Accessibility Product Standard, Tab twice, cursor stays in first input cell, Demand Plan

Title: System Throws Error For Outbound Delivery Invoice Request
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-**SAP Internal Use Only**-For TPOP scenario, system throws below error for Outbound Delivery Invoice Request with status 'Inconsistent' status:-   <BP_ID> is not maintained as Supplier in master data-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Go to Invoice Requests view.-Select required Outbound Delivery Invoice Request ID.-You can see that the status is Inconsistent.-Choose Check button.-Document is Inconsistent.-Cause-Third-Party Outbound Delivery having incorrect Party Type Code (147 instead of 266) for the Supplier Party. ( i.e. here 147 and 266 are Party Type Codes)-Same detail is being sent to Customer Invoice Request due to which the document becomes inconsistent.-Resolution-Note: If you encounter such case, kindly forward to development component:AP-ODP-Pre-checks:-It is the Third-party Order Fulfillment scenario.-Outbound Delivery Invoice Request shows 'Inconsistent' status with an error message “<BP_ID> is not maintained as Supplier in master data"-Third-Party Outbound Delivery had incorrect Party Type Code (147 instead of 266) for the Supplier Party.-The incorrect Party Type Code (147 instead of 266) for the Supplier Party is being sent to Customer Invoice Request through message due to which the document becomes inconsistent.-Backend Correction steps:-Open Outbound Delivery BO APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY in SESFTS (BO Test Shell)-Navigate to PARTY Node.-Find the entry with Supplier ID and change the incorrect party type code from 147 to 266.-Save, there should not be any error while saving.-Check in SRT_MONI, there should be new message triggered from OD to CIR with correct type code and it should be delivered successfully.-Post-Checks:-Customer invoice request should be consistent after successful delivery of new message.-Keywords-APDL_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY, Third Party Order fulfillment, Outbound delivery invoice request, party type code.

Title: Contact Names are Displayed Incorrectly for Country China
Content: Symptom-You find that the Chinese Contact names are displayed incorrectly in the system. The first name appears before the last name. But for the country China, the last name should appear before the first name.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management Work Center, Contacts View-Search for Contact ABC (where ABC stands for the Contact)-It displays as "X Y". But the First Name is X, Last Name is Y. The country is China.-For other contacts, for example: Contact: EFG (where EFG stands for the Contact)-It displays as "M N". The First Name is N, Last Name is M.-For the country China, The last name should appear before the first name. -So you expect the Contact ABC displays as "Y X".-Cause-You have to maintain a value for the field "Country Name Format". If something (i.e. CN) is maintained there,the display order will be correct.-Resolution-Go to Account Management Work Center, Contacts View-Open the Contact which you want to edit-Click View All Button-Navigate to the General tab-Click Additional Name Fields-Maintain CN-China for the field Country for Name Format-Keywords-Contact, Account Mangement, First Name, Last Name

Title: Dump In Production Lot
Content: Symptom- Dump while performing Adjustment Confirmation on Production Lot with serial numbers-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center. -Navigate to the Production Orders view. -Search for the relevant production order and choose the Edit button. -Choose the View All button and navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Select the production lot, choose the View All button.-Choose the Adjustment Confirmation button and navigate to the Input Products Sub.-Select the relevant product choose the Enable Entry button.-Choose the Remove button after selecting the serial number you want to delete from the lot and add the serial number you want to include in the production process.-Choose the Save button. - The system will Dump.-Cause-The business user did not Save the production lot after removing the serial number.-Resolution-Go to Production Control work center.-Navigate to the Production Orders view.-Search for the relevant production order and choose the Edit button.-Choose the View All button and navigate to the Document Flow tab.-Select the production lot, choose the View All button.-Choose the Adjustment Confirmation button and navigate to the Input Products Sub.-Select the relevant product choose the Enable Entry button.-Choose the Remove button after selecting the serial number you want to delete from the lot.-Choose Save and Close button.-Repeat until step 7.-Enter the serial number you want to add to the production lot in the Next Serial Number field and choose the Upload button.-Select the Save and Close button.-The system will not Dump anymore.-Keywords-dump in production lot, adjustment confirmation of production lot error, error in serial number adjustment production lot, production lot error, adjustment confirmation production lot dump

Title: Pro Forma Invoice Displays Different Value than Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-You find that Pro Forma Invoice displays different value than customer invoice if you change the price list.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center - Sales Orders View-Select Sales Order ABC (ABC represents your sales order ID)-The List Price is 3163 EUR-Then change the price in Price List to 2000 EUR-Click Pro Forma Invoice button for Sales Order ABC-You can see the Price changes to 2000 EUR-Create Pro Forma Invoice for relevant Outbound Delivery EFG (EFG represents Outbound Delivery ID)-You can see List Price is still 3163 EUR-Cause-There are pricing relevant extension scenarios are present in the system which are causing the retrigger of price and hence, new list price is being considered during generation of Pro Forma Invoice.-You can see extension fields which are pricing relevant and have extension scenario of Sales Order -> Invoice Request.-Whereas in outbound delivery-> Pro Forma invoice creation, extension scenarios are not scoped which is why you are able to see the old prices from Sales Order.-If the value in the extension field is not filled under sales order and even though they are pricing relevant and values are flowing from sales order to invoice request, pricing recalculation will not be triggered in such cases.-Resolution-This is the expected behaviour.-Keywords-Pro Forma Invoice, customer invoice, Sales Order, Outbound Delivery, Price List, extension fields

Title: Error message: Action Failed Due to Previous Error in Other Instance for Bill of Exchange scenario (BoE)
Content: Symptom-While you try to release a New BoE Rec. Sole Bill, there is an Error message ' Action failed due to previous error in other instance' displayed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management workcenter.-Navigate to the Payment Monitor view.-Under the New Payment By > BoE Rec. Sole Bill and enter the required details and click on the Release button.-An error message ' Action failed due to previous error in other instance' is displayed.-Cause-The reason for the error is because there is no Bill of Exchange Storage maintained.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps to maintain a Bill of Exchange Storage.-Go to the Liquidity Management workcenter.-Bill of Exchange Storages option.-In the New Bill of Exchange Storage, enter all the necessary data-Set it to active.-After this you will be able to create a new Bill of Exchange Sole Bill and Release it.-Keywords-Bill of Exchange, New Payment

Title: Backend Dump With Message Binding of UI Data Field
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-The user is facing a dump error message in the system.-Checking the dump in the backend, transaction ST22, in Application Information section you found a similar message as below:-Info: Binding of UI data field /ABC/XYZ/123 failed-Where /ABC/XYZ/123 represent the field path information.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Dumps with this kind of message can be related with extension fields (KUT or PDI) and change transactions (CTs) done regard it, like:-Deletion of this extension field.-Add or remove the field on screen.-Resolution-Check if the field really is an Extension Field.-If yes, proceed with a Gerenate Load (refer the KBA 3041337 in See Also section).-If this action does not solve the issue, the deletion of the CT will be necessary.-a) For KUT fields the delete can be done by back-end (refer to resolution from KBA 2956807 in See Also section).-b) For PDI fields, the deletion should be done by SDK.-See Also-3316236 - How to find the CT that causes the dump "Info: Binding of UI data field" from front end-3041337 - How to Generate Load of UI using SUPPTOOL-2642346 - How to Generate Load in the Backend-2956807 - Failed to Generate Load Error After Adapting Screen-Keywords-dump, Binding of UI data field, cannot open screen, generate load, Extension field, Change transaction

Title: Error 'Company invalid on posting date' during Journal Entry Voucher simulation
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***Internal Use Only***-You try to post/simulate a Journal Entry Voucher(JEV) and encounters error message: Company invalid on posting date-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-General Ledger work center-Journal Entry Voucher-New JEV and enter relevant data and hit simulate/post-Cause-Eventhough the Company code of JEV is valid for the posting date and periods are open, issue occurs due to one of the JEV item(s) has an open item reference to a different company code.-Issue occurs in below Coding Logic.-Message Class: FAI2D_ACDOC_STEP_OTH/004-Class/Method: CL_FAI2D_CHECK_CLEARING_OBJECTCP->IF_FAI2D_STEP_ACDOC_1~DO_IT-Resolution-The open item reference of the JEV items have to checked and should be in line with comapny code to which JEV is created. If not required, it has to removed so Simulation/Posting will be successful-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, Post, Simulation

Title: Actuals Calculation In Demand Plan
Content: Symptom-You want to know how the values in the field Actuals are calculated for your demand plan.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-The value in the field Actuals for a demand plan is calculated based on its demand category quantities.-These include Customer Requirements, Stock Transfer Orders and Dependent Demands. Sales Order data or Outbound Delivery information is not included in calculation of history data.-In Customer Demands, check for demands with the Requested Delivery Date.-See Also-Demand Plan Help Document-Keywords-demand plan values, how are actuals calculated, calculation of actuals, actuals information, how is history data calculated in demand plan

Title: Error Message: Account Determination is Missing for Item Type Internal Service Provision
Content: Symptom-You try to post the Sales Orders from unposted source documents, but the system gives the following error message:-Account determination is missing for item type Internal Service Provision. Specify account determination in chart of accounts Global Chart of Accounts and account determination profile <PQR>. Column Path Costs->Service->Debits for Internal Services, Item Type Internal Service Provision.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Select the Closing-Relevant Tasks subview.-You can find there is a task that has the subject Account determination is missing for item type Internal Service Provision.-Select the task and you can see the following description: Account determination is missing for item type Internal Service Provision. Specify account determination in chart of accounts Global Chart of Accounts and account determination profile <PQR>. Column Path Costs->Service->Debits for Internal Services, Item Type Internal Service Provision (PQR respresents the account determination profile id).-(Or)-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents sub-view.-Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the Source Document is Sales Order.-Choose View Business Transaction, you can see the same error message: Account determination is missing for item type Internal Service Provision.-  Cause-The reason is that you have not maintained the Account Determination Group for Services. You can view Account Determination Group for particular service by following the below steps:-Go to the Cost and revenue work center.-Go to the Service view.-Search for the Service ID:123(123 represents the service id).-Click on Edit tab.-Click on View all button.-Navigate to Valuation tab.-You can view the Account Determination Group XYZ (XYZ represent the account determination group)-You need to check if the G/L account is maintained for combination of Account Determination Group for Customers and Account determination Group for Services.-In Business Configuration find and open the Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination fine tune activity. -Select Account Determination of Sales.-Go to the Revenues tab and select Services.-Here, check G/L account is maintained under Sales Revenue for the combination of Account Determination Group Commercial Sales for Customers and Account determination group for Services.-Resolution-You need to maintain Account Determination Group for Services by following below steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select the project and open activity list.-Open the activity Charts of Accounts, Financial Reporting Structures, Account Determination.-Click on View button.-Under Account Determination section select Costs.-Select your Account Determination Profile.-Go to the Service tab.-Click on Add Row button.-Maintain the G/L accounts for Account Determination Group for Service XYZ (XYZ represent the account determination group).-Click on Save and Close.-Now you are able to post the Unposted Source Document:-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to the Closing Cockpit view.-Go to Source Documents subview.-Search for your Source Document ID, in this case the source document is Sales Order-Select the ID and click on Actions -> Post Business Transaction.-Keywords-Account determination; services; Internal service provision; account determination group

Title: Tax Code in Customer Contract is Incorrect When Creating Via Web Service
Content: Symptom-You are creating customer contracts via web service. In the web serivce, you have given the tax code for contract item as ABC, but in the created contract, the tax code is XYZ instead of ABC.-(ABC and XYZ represent the tax code ID.)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Ordrers work center.-Go to the Contracts view.-Open the contract created from web service, you notice the tax code on line 10 is XYZ. However in the request payload, the tax code given is ABC.-Cause-Modification of Tax details while creating a Contract via web service is not possible. This is currently the designed behavior.-Resolution-You have to do 2 step modification approach: First create the contract and then send the Tax details as an update modification on the contract.-Reference update payload is attached in the attachment section.-Keywords-Customer Contract; Web Service; Tax Code;

Title: Create E-Mail Template Button Disabled For Form Template
Content: Symptom-User is trying to create E-Mail Template for Form Template under Active Forms.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter.-Navigate to Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the Form Template.-Click "Action"-User notice "Create E-Mail Template" is disabled.-Cause- Selected Form Template is not Published. -Resolution-Create E-Mail Template button under "Action" will only be enabled once the Form Template is published. Kindly follow below steps if user want to publish Form Template,-Go to Application and User Management WorkCenter.-Navigate to Form Template Maintenance view.-Select the Form Template.-Click "Publish".-See Also-Help Portal: Form Template Maintenance Quick Guide-Keywords-Form template, Create E-Mail Template, Action, Not published, Published, Form Template Maintenance view

Title: Error:Ship-from location does not belong to site
Content: Symptom-You are creating  Return to Supplier and want to change the Ship from and you get this error-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center- Go to Common Tasks: New Return to Supplier- Select  the respective entry and click on Next- In the following screen  you see that Site is not Editable- and when you change Ship from you get error-Cause-Since we don't allow change of site as per our existing system.-Resolution-Send the quantity to the Site( or ship from location) appearing in the RTS screen and then finish the RTS-also you may consider to add this feature as new requirement in Customer influence forum-https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords-Cannot change Site, Site greyed out, cannot change Ship from,

Title: Error on Activate Org Unit Changes
Content: Symptom-You want to set a Valid To date for an Org Unit from Unlimited to a specific date for example 23.02.2023-When you try to activate the changes made you receive the below error messages:-Activation failed; resolve all errors.-Business residence XXX (Name) is assigned as site to company tax arrangement XYZ/ZZZ (CompanyID/TaxAuthorityID) from dd.mm.yyyy to 31.12.9999.-XYZ stands for the company ID-ZZZ stands for the Tax Authority ID-dd.mm.yyyy in this case is set as 22.10.2018-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Organizational Management work center.-Go to the Org Structures view.-Find and Locate the Org Unit XXX (XXX stands for the Org Unit ID).-Select Edit.-This open the Org Structure of the parent Org Unit.-Select Activate > Activate Selected and dependent Org Units.-Error message:-Activation failed; resolve all errors-Business residence XXX (Name) is assigned as site to company tax arrangement XYZ/ZZZ (CompanyID/TaxAuthorityID) from dd.mm.yyyy to 31.12.9999.-Cause-The Tax Authority ZZZ Valid From date is 22.10.2018 and Valid To date is 31.12.9999 (Unlimited)-while for the Business Residence XXX, the expected Valid To date which you want to change to is 23.02.2023.-There is an application logic written which checks the validity overlapping of Company Tax Authority and Business Residence and if it overlaps the system gives this error message.-Resolution-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Tax Authority view.-Select the Company Tax Arrangements sub view.-Select the line of the combination of company XYZ and Tax Authority ID ZZZ.-Select Edit.-Select the line of Company XYZ which has validity date starting from 22.10.2018 to unlimited.-Here you have to change 2 things since there is only one business residence assigned to this company/Tax Authority.-Change the Valid To date of the selected record to 22.02.2023.-Set the same Valid To date in the tab Tax Return Arrangements ID maintained.-Save the changes.-Now, the Org Unit changes can be activated without error.-Keywords-Org Unit Changes, Activate, Valid To, Business Residence, Company Tax Arrangement, Tax Authority ID

Title: Simulation/Post of JEV for Manual Entry for Sales Documents resulting in Dump
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a new JEV of type Manual Entry for Sales Documents and you see a Dump-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Journal entry voucher view(JEV).-New Journal Entry Voucher and select type 00088 - Manual Entry for Sales Documents and Screen variant 633 - Man. Adjusting Entry for Sales Documents -Click on simulate or Post.-Cause-One of the issues is because the Set of books is not mentioned in the JEV and the G/L accounts selected is not available for the Set of books of the company code-Resolution-Check the below path to see if G/L is available for the Company Code and Set of Books Combination-General Ledger work center-General Ledger Accounts view and search for Company code and Set of Books Combination to see if the G/L is available-When you select the Set of Books in new JEV for which G/L is mapped, then Simulation/Post will be successful-See Also-[Enter your See Also here...]-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher, Dump

Title: Updating Extension Field Production Order Via Webservice Is Not Allowed.
Content: Symptom-User is updating extension field on production order via webservice: ManageProductionOrderIn. However, only updating an extension field is not allowed using webservice:ManageProductionOrderIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Webservice is created to update only Extension Fields and no standard fields are present in the XML.-Cause-There is no logic in the backend to update only an Extension Field on Production Order via webservice.-Resolution-Pre-checks :-Check the request xml if only the Extension field is being passed on.-Steps to Enhance the Request xml of WS:-WS:-Interface Name: ManageProductionOrderIn-Method: MAINTAIN_BUNDLE_V1-In the request xml, pass production order uuid and existing priority code in the same XML along with Production Order ID and Extension field value.-The tags to pass the Production Order ID and Priority code are:-<ProductionOrderUUID>  </ProductionOrderUUID>-<PriorityCode> </PriorityCode>-For getting these 2 tags, you can use another webservice ReadProductionOrder to get the Production Order details by ID-Interface Name: ManageProductionOrderIn-Method: READ_PROD_ORDER-  Post-Checks:-After passing the mentioned fields along with extension field, check if the extension field value has been updated.-Keywords-Production Order, ManageProductionOrderIn, Extension Field, webservice

Title: 'Assign On Account Payment' using Webservice Manage Incoming Checks(PaymentProcessingIncomingChequeProcessingInBasic)
Content: Symptom-You try to use functionality of Webservice 'Manage Incoming Checks' and directly want the 'Assign On Account Payment' functionality and its missing in the webservice payload-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Webservice payload using SOAPUI.-Sample Payload:-<n0:IncomingChequeBundleMaintain xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">- <BasicMessageHeader>-  <UUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>- </BasicMessageHeader>- <IncomingCheque ActionCode="01">-  <PayerChequeID>Test</PayerChequeID>-  <PayeeCompanyID>XYZ</PayeeCompanyID>-  <PaymentAmount currencyCode="EUR">100</PaymentAmount>-  <Note languageCode="EN">This is an exemplary test cheque.</Note>- </IncomingCheque>-</n0:IncomingChequeBundleMaintain>-Cause-Functionality is not available-Resolution-On account payment can be done only manually and not availabe via Webservice. You can manually perform this using below steps.-Liquidity Management Work Center-Select New Incoming Check-Enter relevant data and under Open Items, 'On account Payment' can be done-See Also-2904169 - On Account Payment Cannot be Allocated Automatically When Creating New Incoming Checks from Microsoft Excel-Manage Incoming Checks Webservice-Keywords-Webservice, On Account Payment, Incoming check

Title: Org Unit Created Without Your Intervention With Employee Assignments
Content: Symptom-Org units are created without your intervention with employee assignments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When EC integration is configured and daily background job is scheduled to import Employees with their respective Manager information from SF system , this results in creation of RLUs without user intervention under "UnAssigned" Org Structure.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-master data replication from SF to ByD, EC integration, Org Unit Created, UnAssigned Org Structure

Title: Name Not Appearing For a Freight Forwarder
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see the name of freight forwarder.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Outbound logistics-Navigate to Outbound deliveries-Search for your delivery-Open it and go to view all-Select the value selection (F4 help) for freight forwarder-Notice that the name is missing, however when you select the name appears.-Cause-For the freight forwarders (suppliers) there is no address maintained. It is the reason why for the value help screen the names of those suppliers are not retrieved.-Resolution-You have to maintain an address for the suppliers:-Go to Supplier Base work centre-Navigate to Suppliers View-Maintain address for supplier-Keywords-freight forwarder, value help missing, Name Not Appearing

Title: Creating a Broadcast for Last Day of Month
Content: Symptom-Creating a Broadcast with the last day of month as 31 generates an error.-Environment-SAP Cloud For Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Business Analytics.-Go to Broadcasts and click New.-Create the Broadcast and choose the option Periodically. -Choose the frequency "Month".-Choose the Day of Month "31".-Click Save.-You will see the error "Scheduling start date does not match day of month".-Cause-It is not currently possible to set a broadcast to the last day of the month as certain months have 31 days and others have 30.-Resolution-We suggest to create a Broadcast for the first day of each month to bypass this error message.-We would also suggest to open a new feature request in the Influence Forum to add relative selections to Broadcasts.-You can register this requirement on the ideas forum: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/903-See Also-Please note you will only see this error when creating a broadcast in a month with only 30 days and using the Day of Month as 31.-Keywords-broadcast, last day of month, Scheduling start date does not match day of month, day of month, periodically, frequency

Title: Error: "Source logistics area is not valid for product, Inventory in logistics area not available"
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to confirm the Production Task, system throws below error though on-hand stock is available:-  Source logistics area is not valid for product, Inventory in logistics area not available-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control workcenter.-Go to Task Control view-Find required Task ID.-Select and Choose Confirm.-Now select required Line item and choose Propose Quantity and Logistics Area.-System throws error for specific product: Source logistics area is not valid for product, Inventory in logistics area not available-Cause-Line items in a Task is already confirmed and confirmations got created, stock is allocated hence Allocated indicator is set.-However while reversal of the confirmation does not remove the indicator therefore it displays stock is allocated.-Resolution-Go to Production Control workcenter.-Go to Task Control view-Find required Task ID.-Select and Choose Confirm.-Select required Line item and choose Cancel Allocation-Perform Save. Now again select the same line item and row.-Now, choose Propose Quantity and Logistics Area-System assigns the inventory.-Keywords-Cancel Allocation, Production Task, task control, inventory, stock, on-hand stock, Propose Quantity and Logistics Area

Title: Message" No Records Found" While Opening Edit Output Settings for Check
Content: Symptom-User trying to view data under Edit Output Settings for Check and system throws message "No Records Found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Example: Payment Management-Go to Payment Management WorkCenter. -Go to Payment Monitor view. -Select All Payments. -Open Document ID.-Click "You Can Also" button.-Open "Edit Output Settings for Check.-Message "No records found" .-Cause-Form template rules failing to find a matching Form. If the rules are correct system finds the standard Form.-Resolution-Form will be picked by system if the rules and forms are correctly setup.. Review Form template rules with the Forms present.-Hint: Upload the form only for language without country.-Keywords-No records found, No data under output settings, message no records found, form template, review form template

Title: Master Data Variant Configuration for Japan - Summary Invoice
Content: Symptom-You cannot find the Japan - Summary Invoice Parameters tab in Common Master Data Variant Configuration. Basically, the columns - Rounding Rule, General Ledger Account & General Ledger Account For Gross Posting is missing.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Click on Overview.-Search for the Fine-tune activity - Common Master Data Configuration.-Click New Configuration. -Select the Configuration Type Code - 110 - Japan Summary Invoice Configuration.-As soon as you select the Configuration Type Code, you cannot find the tab Japan - Summary Invoice Parameters.-Cause-You have not selected Scoping question - "Do you want to enable tax recalculation on monthly invoices?"-Resolution-Follow the below steps to enable the Japan - Summary Invoice Parameters tab:-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Click Implementation Projects. -Click Edit Project Scope. -Go to tab 4-Questions.-Filter the Element - Cash Flow Management - Payables and Receivables Processing.-Select the Node - Communication for Payables and Receivables Processing.-Go to Group: Invoice Summary Processing-Japan (5).-Select question - Do you want to enable tax recalculation on monthly invoices?-Finish Scoping. -Once you have maintained the above setting, then you can find the tab Japan - Summary Invoice Parameters.-Keywords-Japan - Summary Invoice Parameters, Japan - Summary Invoice, Master Data Variant Configuration for Japan

Title: Employee Cannot be Terminated due to Pending Time Records
Content: Symptom-You are trying to terminate an employee, however there are errors regarding pending time records which are preventing the completion of the process.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration.-Click on the view Regular Tasks.-Select the country from the tabs on the top of the screen.-Click on the task Terminate Relationship with Employee.-Fulfill the required fields in the termination screen.-When clicking to save, the errors are shown. -Cause-When an employee is terminated, the system performs several checks to ensure that data is consistent. One of these checks is regarding the time accounts, in which a time account that was deleted cannot have account balance adjustments for a date after the deletion of the account.-For example, the employee had a time account X (where X represents the ID of the time account) which was removed on January 1st. However there is an adjustment on the account with Posting On date as February 1st (after the date of the removal of the time account).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-In order to terminate the employee, the adjustment needs to be manually removed.-This can be done following the below steps:-Go to Time Administration work center.-Click on the Employees view.-Search for the employee and click on Edit.-Navigate to the Time Profile tab.-Select the currently valid time profile.-in the bottom panel, navigate to the Time Account Rules tab.-Add a new rule with the time account X.-Navigate to the Time Account Balances tab.-Select the added time account X.-On the bottom panel, click on Adjustments.-Here you will be able to see the adjustment with the date after the removal of the account.-Click on the Remove Button.-Now go back to the screen of step 6 and remove the account again.-Save the changes.-Keywords-Recording, Unposted, Manual Adjustment

Title: Product with Zero Stock Displayed In Stock Overview
Content: Symptom-You are able to see the stock of a particular product as Zero quantity. Ideally the stock overview does not display products with zero stock.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Physical Inventory work center.-Navigate to the Common Tasks view -Choose the option Stock Overview. -Enter the relevant Product and Site related details as per your requirement. -You can see that the stock of Product is displayed as Zero quantity.-Cause-This occurs because the stock of relevant product is a decimal value similar to <0.0000000123> quantity. Here, <0.0000000123> is just a sample value.-This value is rounded and displayed as zero in stock overview.-The reason why this happens is because you have maintained Quantity Conversions in the relevant product master and when the quanties are converted from one to another there will be decimal places as a by-product. -Resolution-You will have to adjust the stock to zero to avoid any inconsistency in the stock. Please follow below given steps to do so.-Go to Physical Inventory work center. -Navigate to the Common Tasks view-Choose the option New Inventory Adjustment-Enter the Storage Location ID for the product and the relevant Key Date (used for financial postings only, has no impact on stock on this date). -Enter the Product and logistics area related information in which the stock is displayed as Zero quantity and choose the Go button. -Select the relevant line item and choose the Next button. -In the Edit Inventory screen, select the checkbox Zero Quantity. -Choose the Next button and Select Finish. -You will not be able to see the above product related entry in your stock overview.-See Also-1713543 - Stock Overview Does Not Show the Products With Zero Quantity-2660101 - System is Rounding up Quantity for the UoM 'each' in the Stock Overview-Keywords-zero quantity in stock overview, 0 in stock, 0 stock, zero quantity in stock

Title: Change Project Status Mismatch Between Production and Test Tenant
Content: Symptom-You merged a change project from Test tenant to Production tenant but the status of the change project in the production tenant is still remains in 'Started'. However the status is correctly set to 'Merged'in Test tenant-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Copy a Change Project from Production to Test tenant-Merge the Change Project from Test to Production tenant-Status of the change project in the test tenant is Merged-However the status of the change project in the production remains in Started-Cause-The background process to copy a change project from Production to Test was not completed.-In such situation, even though the project is available in the Test tenant the background process is yet to complete-Resolution-When a change project is copied from Production to Test tenant, a mail is triggered to the respective user about the completion of the copy process.-You need to wait for the email and then trigger the merge from the test tenant-Note: You also need to verify the SPAM folder for the email-Keywords-status, started, merged, change project, mismatch, test, production

Title: How to Change Reference Product for an Identified Stock When Identified Stock is Unique Across System.
Content: Symptom-In Business Configuration, question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?" has been scoped. Now there is an identified stock IStock_123 related to product ABC, how to change its reference product?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Access view Implementation Projects.-Select the inmpementation project, click Edit Project Scope.-Proceed until step 4 Questions, expand Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics > Tracking, Tracing, and Identification > Identified Stock,  question "Do you want to use unique identified stock numbers across the system?" has been scoped.-Go to work center Warehousing and Logistics Master Data.-Access view Identified Stock.-Search IStock_123 (IStock_123 represents identified stock ID), click Edit, product is ABC (ABC represents product ID) which we cannot maintain.-Now create new identified stock, enter IStock_123 for Identified Stock ID, error triggered "Identified stock ID IStock_123 already exists for the product ; enter new ID".-Cause-Since the BC setting has been enabled, another Identified Stock cannot be created with the same ID.-Nothing can be done in this case since the identified stock with the ID IStock_123 has already been created.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Identified Stock, Product, Business Configuration

Title: Error on Fixed Asset "Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets (XYZ). While migration remains open, Inventory ID will be required for legacy fixed assets. Close migration for Fixed Assets through BC activity "Enable or Disable Migration".
Content: Symptom-You want to edit a Fixed Asset however the following error appears: Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets (XYZ). While migration remains open, Inventory ID will be required for legacy fixed assets. Close migration for Fixed Assets through BC activity "Enable or Disable Migration". (XYZ represents the Fixed Asset ID).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Fixed Asset work center.-Select the view Fixed Assets.-Search and find Fixed Asset XYZ.-Select Edit.-Go to the Master Data Tab.-At the bottom of the screen you will see the error: Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets (XYZ). While migration remains open, Inventory ID will be required for legacy fixed assets. Close migration for Fixed Assets through BC activity "Enable or Disable Migration".-Cause-For migrated Fixed Assets, the error will appear while the Fixed Asset migration is enabled in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the view Overview.-Search and find the activity Enable Data Migration per Object.-  Search and find Migration Objects: Fixed Assets & Fixed Assets (extended).-You need to disable both of the tick boxes and select Save and Close.-After you have completed this change you will be able to edit the Fixed Asset.-See Also-Related KBA 2776003 - Error Message: Inventory ID is mandatory for legacy assets-Keywords-Fixed Asset, Inventory ID, Enable or Disable Migration

Title: Time Recording not Credited for Night Shift Employees
Content: Symptom-Case 1:-You are creating Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Cap Outside Planned Working Time" and day assignment "Previous day" in the time model.-Case 2:-You are Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Do not Cap" and day assignment "Previous day" in the time model.-Case 3:-You are Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Cap Outside Flextime Bandwidth” and day assignment "Previous day" in the time model.-Case 4:-You are creating Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Cap Outside Planned Working Time" and day assignment "Current Day" in the time model.-Case 5:-You are Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Do not Cap" and day assignment "Current Day" in the time model.-Case 6:-You are Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Cap Outside Flextime Bandwidth” and day assignment "Current Day" in the time model.-Case 7:-You are creating Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Cap Outside Planned Working Time" and day assignment "Following Day" in the time model.-Case 8:-You are Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Do not Cap" and day assignment "Following Day" in the time model.-Case 9:-You are Time recording during night shift at midnight, say from 00:00 to 06:00, having credited times "Cap Outside Flextime Bandwidth” and day assignment "Following Day" in the time model.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration Work center-Go to Time Models work Center view-Create or use existing time model having split time duration with break between the actual hours worked, ranging from current day late evening time to next day morning with previous day assignment to the next day time.-Go to Time Administration work center-Go to Employees work center view-Search employee and open the time file-In employee’s time file,  go to Time Profile tab and Time Account Rules,-Select working time account-In ‘Basic Data’ sub tab select relevant credited times from the drop down.-Now go to Time Sheet Work Center view of Time administration and mark time from 00:00 to 06:00 for some date.-Cause-Working hours are not credited in 1st case.-Resolution-Case 1:-Workaround is, Marking Time starting current date 23:59 to 06:00 instead of 00:00 to 06:00 would consider the time recording within planned working time.-Case 2 to 9:-Resolution not required as case 2 to 9 are working as expected.-Keywords-night shift, split duration, time file, time account rules,planned working time

Title: Cancel not Possible, Item AAA Already Cleared in Company XYZ
Content: Symptom-You are trying to reverse the document AAA(AAA represents the Document ID) and the error message is shown as --Action Failed due to previous error in other instance.-Cancel not possible, Item AAA already cleared in another company.-This is a Bank to Bank Transfer Scenario and the Document Id are similar in both the companies that is AAA and the status of the documents are in Ready for Transfer.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payment Management work center.-Go to the Payment Monitor view.-Show All Payments and Go to External Reference and give the Document ID AAA and Company Id as well.-Choose Go.-You could see that there are two documents with similar Id and the Payment methods being Incoming Bank Transfer and Outgoing Bank Transfer.-Select one of the documents and Choose Reverse.-Error message is shown.-Cause-Error message is shown as the document ID AAA(AAA represents the Document ID) is already cleared in both the companies and hence it does not allow reversal.-You have to reset the clearing and then you can reverse the documents.-Resolution-You can follow the below steps in order to reverse the documents:-Follow Steps 1 to 4.-Choose the Document ID AAA-Choose View All.-Go to Document Flow.-You can see the Clearing ID in which the documents are cleared.-Select the Clearing ID and Choose the Reset Clearing Button.-Once you have reset the clearing, the status of the Document ID can be set to 'In Transfer' from Payment Monitor Screen and can be reversed.-Keywords-"Bank to Bank Transfer" "Reset Clearing"

Title: Supplier Approval Request are not sent to Manager
Content: Symptom-Approval process in supplier creation does not run, i.e., Supplier approval request is not sent to the Manager-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Supplier Base work center-Click on the Suppliers view-Select Potential suppliers from the drop down-Search for the relevant supplier-Here, you will see that the relevant supplier has been sent for approval-Cause-As the Manager not able to receive the Supplier Approval Request because there is a work center assignment missing:-work center view "WCVIEW_SUPPLIER (Supplier)". Therefore, the assignment of the approval task does not work correctly.-Resolution-Assign Work Center View WCVIEW_SUPPLIER (Supplier) to the respective user.-To Assign the Work Center View follow the below steps:-Go to the Business Users view under Application and User Management work center-Search for the respective business user-Select the user-Click the edit button and select access rights , then assign the Work Center View WCVIEW_SUPPLIER (Supplier)-Keywords-Supplier Approval,Supplier View, Supplier Approval Request

Title: When Trying to Create a Contract with 0 Value for the List Price or Discount via Webservice the 0 Amount is Not Taken Over in the Contract
Content: Symptom-You are trying to create a Contract via the web service where one or more items have the value 0 in the ItemMainPrice or the ItemMainDiscount, however, the document is created either inconsistent with error "Item AB: Mandatory List Price missing for the price calculation" (Where AB Represents the line item ID) or the List Price or Discount is determined from a Price List or Discount List instead of taken over from the payload.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-You are passing the ItemMainPrice or/and the ItemMainDiscount in the payload as follows:-....-   <PriceAndTax>-    <ItemMainDiscount>-     <Rate>-      <DecimalValue>0</DecimalValue>-     </Rate>-    </ItemMainDiscount>-    <ItemMainPrice>-     <Rate>-      <DecimalValue>0</DecimalValue>-      <CurrencyCode>EUR</CurrencyCode>-     </Rate>-    </ItemMainPrice>-   </PriceAndTax>-....-But the 0 value is not taken over in the created Contract.-Cause-If you
