Title: Few Holidays Are Not Part of Maintained Holiday List
Content: Symptom-User notices few holidays are not part of maintained holiday list .-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search for fine-tuning activity Working Day Calendar.-Select it and click Open.-In the new screen, select the option "Maintain existing holiday calendar."-User notices few holidays are missing in list.-Cause-Missing holidays might be Floating /Optional holidays.-Resolution-Floating/Optional holidays does not display in the maintained holiday list until user maintains the holiday date manually for each year.-See Also-Refer Blog - How to create new working calendars (holiday/working day) for a not listed Country.-Keywords-Missing holiday calender, optional holiday, floating holiday, maintain manually, holiday date

Title: Unable to Manually Run the Concur Employee Outbound Run
Content: Symptom-You are unable to manually run the Concur Employee Outbound Run,getting the following error: Registration for OAUTH not found for user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center, User Registration for OAUTH2 Web Services view.-On the Overview screen, select service CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH and click Switch Edit Mode.-On the pop-up screen, enter the Client Secret for the Concur application server. (For more information, see chapter Register Client for OAUTH Web Services).-Choose Add Row. You can choose the employee from the drop-down list in the field User Logon Name.-In the field User Account you can enter the employee’s name or any other descriptive text. Choose OK.-Here add a new employee to the list of registered users, you see the User Logon Name and the User Account text in the columns User ID and Description.-Repeat step 4 for all other SAP Business ByDesign users who should be allowed to manually run master data replication or retrieve expense report.-On the Overview screen, select service CONCUR_INTEGRATION_OAUTH2.-Check that the user SAP_SYSTEM is registered for this service provider. If not, click Switch Edit Mode and follow the steps 3-4 to register this user.-Cause-This error occurs due to inconsistency.-Resolution-You may deregister and register it again on the Oauth User Registration screen - in most cases this will solve the issue. You can ignore the access permission status on the Oauth User Registration screen.Once the user has been registered properly the next usage of the Concur connection then finally enables the user automatically and the status turns green.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3248965-Keywords-Registration for OAUTH not found for user,  Oauth User Registration screen.

Title: Unable To Send The Purchase Orders Due Error Message
Content: Symptom-Error in the purchase order while sending the purchase order.-Contact your Key user to investigate this error. When the error has been solved your key user should inform you so that you can retry outputing the document-A technical Error occurred in the form master template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Search and open PO number-Go to Output History tab-There is a record in status Error, Choose the Error link-Contact your key user to investigate this error.  When the error has been solved your key user should inform you so that you can retry outputing the document.-A technical error occurred in the form master template.-On the Output Details tab of the Output Error screen under Technical Information, you can find more details about the error. Create an incident and copy and paste this technical information into the incident.-Cause-There is a record existing with error in a purchase order's output history tab.-Resolution-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders-Go to Purchase Orders-Search and open required PO -Go to Output History tab-There is a record in status Error, Choose the Error link-Choose Retry and opens a New screen-Again Retry-Keywords-Purchase Order, Master Template

Title: Unable to set a KUT Extension field as Mandatory

You will notice, you are unable to mark it mandatory.(ABC represents extension field)-Cause-Creating an extension field on table column is not supported to be set as mandatory.-Resolution-This is implemented to maintain the consistency of the data.-This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-KUT field, mandatory

Title: Error :"500 Internal server error" When Trying to Perform Post Goods Receipt
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to do Post Goods Receipt against a Purchase Order, the system crashes throwing 500 Internal Server Error-Environment-SAP Business Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Find and select relevant Purchase Order ID and choose option Post Goods Receipt.-New window opens up, go to Serial Numbers sub tab, and choose Upload choosing an excel or .txt file.-System crashes.-Cause-Since the Serial Number IDs are duplicate in the upload excel or .txt file, system crashes.-Resolution-Go to the relevant Excel or .txt file file.-Open and search for the duplicate entries of the Serial ID.-Remove duplicate entry from the file of the Serial ID and perform Save.-Once it is done then again go to Inbound Logistics Work center.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Find and select relevant Purchase Order ID and choose option Post Goods Receipt.-New window opens up, go to Serial Numbers sub tab and choose the corrected excel or .txt file.-Upload it again and perform Save.-Keywords- Serial Number

Title: Recorded Employee Times reports shows PO and SO as #
Content: Symptom-Recorded Employee Times reports shows PO and SO as #-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Reports view.-Find the report Recorded Employee Times.-Open the report.-Select the link to start the report.-In the Selection tab, provide the Employee ID and Key Date and apply.-In the View Tab on the top left, select the fields like Project, Project Task, Currency, and so on.-Select Apply.-The columns Purchase Order ID Purchase Order Item ID Sales Order and Sales Order Item are empty. You using the default view for the report without corrections on it.-Sales Orders are created already-You need to know which recording is associated with which SO and SO Item.-Cause-These time recordings are project time recording which does not use purchase order that's why report is no showing purchase order data.The details of the following fields when these fields will be populated in this report.-Project - When time recording is done against project then this time recording will show project information in the report.-Purchase Order - When time recording is done against a project in a intern company scenario where purchase order value is also filled in the time recording .-Sales Order - When time recording is done against sales order-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-See Also- 2891164 - Recorded Employee Times Report Shows all the Time Recordings-Keywords-Recorded Employee Times report, PO and SO as #

Title: Two Business Transactions Created for Expense Report
Content: Symptom-You upload an expense report from Concur into SAP Business ByDesign.-You notice two business transactions for the same expense report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Concur view and then to the Expense Reports subview.-Select Expense Report ABC (ABC is the expense report ID).-Click View and select Business Transaction.-There are two business transactions. -Cause-In the expense report expense items are created with different payment types (for example, "journalPayee": "CBCP" (Company billed / Company paid as well as "journalPayee": "EMPL" (employee paid/ Out of pocket expenses) in the same expense report.-A business transaction is created for each of the type of expense.-You can verify the payment types as follows:-Download the JSON File for the expense report and in the file, filter for journalPayee: You will notice that the field is filled differently for one or more expense items.-Resolution-This is standard system behaviour-See Also- KBA: 3024616  Concur Expense Report Created a Journal Entry With Different Amount From Total Expenses-Keywords-Expense report, Concur, Business transaction

Title: Customer Contract Volume with Price Components Report Shows Wrong Values for Price List.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** Internal Only ***-You execute the Customer Contract Volume with Price Components Report and see the List Price value is not the value you expected for a specific contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Analytics Work Center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Search for the standard report Customer Contract Volume with Price Component - CRMCCOIPATCB_Q0001.-Filter the report for Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the Contract ID).-The value showing is differnet in the report and in the contact document.-Cause-There is a known issue due to which the Sales Price List UUID is updating an additional entry which resulted in this issue.-Follow the below steps to check the entries related to Sales Price List UUID.-Navigate to Business Analytics Work Center.-Select the Design Reports view.-Select the Report report Customer Contract Volume with Price Component - CRMCCOIPATCB_Q0001.-Filter the report for Contract XYZ (XYZ represents the Contract ID).-In View selection Under Row Field add "Price Component: Price Specification UUID" and "Price Component: Sales Price List UUID"-In the report once you drill down the Price you can see that there is an additional Sales Price List UUID with "00000000000000000000000000000000"-This additional Sales Price List UUID is wrong and need to be removed.-Resolution-The issue is planned to be fixed with release 2305.-In the meantime please forward the incident to FSI team (BC-SRV-FSI) and provide the FSI View and Price and Tax Calculation Item node of the report, so that they will restart the Price and Tax Calculation Item node of the report.-In this case for the Report CRMCCOIPATCB_Q0001 FSI View is FSP_CRM_CCOI_PATC and node is PriceAndTaxCalculation.ITEM_PRICE_COMPONENT.-See Also-KBA 2980953 - Unexpected List Price Value in Customer Invoice Volume with Price Components Report-Keywords-Volume with Price Components, double; amount; price; Report; Price Component;CRMCCOIPATCB_Q0001

Title: Unable To Replicate XYZ as Reporting Line Unit 9999 Not Replicated
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Replicate XYZ as Reporting Line Unit ABC but you get an error message: " Remote organizational unit 9999 from not yet replicated & Cannot delimit time file validity; employee times exist; cancel times."-Here XYZ refers to an Employee ID and ABC represents the RLU ID.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center -Go to Reporting Line Units view -Search for theRLU ABC-You can observe multiple error as follows:-Remote organizational unit 9999 from not yet replicated-Cannot delimit time file validity; employee times exist; cancel times-Cause-Possible causes for the issue:-You cannot have any Recorded times associated with Employee XYZ, that have an active status and are after the proposed Termination Date, which is according to the Replication Requests that are failing for the DD.MM.YYYY. -Employee XYZ has been changed from an Internal Employee to  Service Agent, where the end dates being changed to DD.MM.YYYY.-If there was a Manual creation of the file, you would have forgotten to change the valid to date to DD.MM.YYYY.-Resolution-This is a Standard System Behaviour.

Title: Custom PDI BC Set Displaying as No Data or as Empty Lines in Fine Tuning
Content: Symptom-You have created a custom Business Configuration Set (BC Set). However they display as 'No Data' or as empty lines, instead of as a hyperlink to open the BC Set view.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Overview view. -Search for, and open, the affected BC Set.-You see the BC Sets display below:-Cause-Case 1:-This issue is due to an inconsistency between the BAC (Business Adaptation Catalogue) element and the BCO (Business Configuration Object).-Or-You didn't maintain a QA View (BC View) for one or more BCO (Business Configuration Object).-Case 2:-You have existing BCCs that are still marked "Values can be added in Fine Tuning" but purposely have not created/deleted a QA View (BC View).-Resolution-Case 1:-Check if the affected .bco file has a QA View (BC View) linked. If not, create the QA View (BC View).-Open the affected .bco file.-Activate the .bco file.-Open the .bcc file.-Activate the .bcc file.-Repeat for all .bac and .bcc files that are missing in the fine tuning.-Open the .bac file, hit Next > Next > Next > Finish.-Activate the .bac file.-Right click the affected solution name.-Deploy Business Configuration on Solution level.-Case 2:-Unscope the Solution in the UI-Open the Solution in the SDK-Open the relevant "No Data" .bcc-In field values-Untick everything that can be unticked-Save and activate the .bcc-Check in the .bcc-Do the same for all the relevant files-Open the .bac file, hit Next > Next > Next > Finish.-Activate the .bac file-Deploy Business Configuration on Solution level-Re-scope the Solution in the UI-See Also-Create a Business Configuration View-Fix: BC Sets not visible in Fine-Tuning-Keywords-BC Set, No Data, Not Visible, Empty Lines, Custom BC Set, Custom List, SDK, PDI, BCC, BCO, BAC

Title: Unable to fetch correct field data in preview of data source
Content: Symptom-In the preview of a data source, i.e. data source HCMTLMB07, it is not possible to fetch required data.-It therefore seems to be impossible to utilize this data source to merge and create a new report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The preview does not always provide all data. For example, a data source like HCMTLMB07 has a temporal join which requires a key date. But in the preview functionality of this data source, this key date is not available as selection  parameter. So, it takes the current date for the key date and displays the data for the current date. This is the standard behavior.-Resolution-To see the correct data in above example, design a report based on the data source, where the key date will be available for the selection and the data can be displayed accordingly.-This approach is generally useful in cases where the preview functionality does not provide expected results.-See Also-KBA: 2646546 - Unable To Preview Financial Data Sources-Keywords-incorrect, missing, time, get, retrieve,

Title: Unable to add a new bank account via webservice
Content: Symptom-When trying to add a new bank account to a customer via web service, the system throws some or all of the following error types:-Bank details changed; check validity period of mandate-Deletion of bank details not possible; active mandates exists-Bank details alr. used in ... paymts, for instance in paymt -IBAN missing in payer bank account for SEPA mandate-SWIFT/BIC missing in payer bank for SEPA mandate-Payer bank missing in SEPA mandate-Start date of validity period missing in SEPA Mandate-End date of validity period missing in SEPA Mandate -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The request might be semantically inconsistent, with mixing action codes + also with respect to ListCompleteTransmissionIndicators:-The request might include the BankDetailsListCompleteTransmissionIndicator set to "True". In this case, when processing the request, the system will delete all existing bank details and add the ones that are included in the request. This causes error messages about bank details that are already in use, or about bank details that cannot be deleted.-The request might include the DirectDebitMandateListCompleteTransmissionIndicator set tu "true". In this case, when processing the request, the system will try to delete the existing direct debit mandate and re-create it with the information provided (actionCode = 4).-Resolution-To add a new bank account,  the following payload might be used:-  <glob:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-    <Customer actionCode="04">-      <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>001</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-      <InternalID>AAA</InternalID>-      <BankDetails actionCode="01">-      <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>BBB</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>-        <BankStandardID>CCC</BankStandardID>-        <BankAccountHolderName>DDD</BankAccountHolderName>-        <BankAccountStandardID>EEE</BankAccountStandardID>-      </BankDetails>-    </Customer>-  </glob:CustomerBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-    (where AAA represents the Internal ID, BBB represents the Object Node Sender Technical ID, CCC represents the Bank Standard ID, DDD represents the Bank Account Holder Name, EEE represents the Bank Account Standard ID)-  This will create the bank details (bank account) for the customer AAA-Keywords- webservice, soap, account, by, when using, not possible, impossible,

Title: Exchange Rate Mismatch Between the General Ledger and JSON File
Content: Symptom-When opening the General Ledger Work Center, the exchange rate appears to be different when comparing with the attached JSON file under the Customer Invoicing Work Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Select Journal Entries view-Search for the journal entry which corresponds to the source document customer invoice XYZ (Where XYZ corrrepresents the customer invoice ID)-The amount shown is e.g. INR 3,836,902.61-Go to Customer Invoicing work center-Select Invoice Documents view-Search for Invoice ID XYZ-Under the General tab, go to Attachments and open the JSON file.-The amount shown is e.g INR 3,788,589.54 ("TotInvVal": 3788589.54 }}])-Cause-The difference between the amount in the Journal Entries view and the JSON file under the Invoice Documents view is caused by the currency conversion dates on which the documents were processed.-Customer invoice ID XYZ was created on e.g 04.11.2022, JSON would consider the exchange rate that is valid for that date which is 04.11.2022.-On the journal entry side, the system would consider the exchange rate based on the posting date which is e.g 31.10.2022.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Incorrect, Not expected, Not correct, Wrong, Invoice

Title: Inconsistent Sales Transaction due to Error "Payment Item: Credit card ID not valid"
Content: Symptom-You can see Sales Transactio with Status: Inconsistent. The error message is "Payment Item: Credit card ID not valid".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Customer Invoicing Work Center - Sales Transactions View.-You can see Sales Transaction: ABC (where ABC stands for Sales Transaction ID) with Status: Inconsistent.-Click Check button.-You can see error "Payment Item: Credit card ID not valid".-Cause-You can see the payload of Sales Transaction: ABC about Credit card ID as below:-<CreditCardKey>-      <ID>11111111111111111</ID>-      <TypeCode>2</TypeCode>-     </CreditCardKey>-For TypeCode 2 which means VISA, the digit number should be 16. However, you have maintained 17 digits in the payload.-Please refer to the description of <TypeCode> as below:-Code                  Description                 Digits-1                       American Express        15-2                       VISA                          16-3                       MasterCard                 16-4                       Diners Club                 14-Resolution-You need to maintain valid Credit card ID.-Keywords-Sales Transaction, Inconsistent, Credit card ID not valid, TypeCode.

Title: How to Execute the BOT for a ByD Tenant Where BPA is not Scoped?
Content: Symptom-How to execute the BOT for a ByD tenant where BPA is not scoped?-The scenario is as follows,-You have a multiple tenants under your customer account and you have activated BPA in one of the tenant and wants to know, how to execute a bot in a tenant where BPA is not scoped-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-In principle, there is one BPA subscription is per customer account. Refer to the documentation Additional Licensing Implications-Steps / Sequence is as follows,-Below steps to be followed in the tenant where BPA is not scoped-Setup Communication Arrangement:-Create a Communication Scenario using the Web Services relevant for the BOT. Refer to the BOT documentation in the Store-Create a Communication Arrangement for the Communication Scenario-Ensure that you have provided the Credentials in the Communication Arrangement which will be used in the later steps-Window Credential:-As per the documentation How to Set Up Windows Generic Credentials, Create the Windows credentials and use the credentials which you setup using above steps-Note: You maintain multiple windows credentials and one per ByD Tenant.-Configuration in BPA Factory:-Create a separate Environment for this tenant in the factory-In the Trigger, Under Input Parameter-Enter the bydcredentialEntryName = <User ID from Communication Arrangement> . Note: The communication arrangement user id and password you need to maintain in windows credential and that window credential you need to place in bydcredentialEntryName.-Enter tenantURL = <ByD tenant URL>-Now, you can able to execute the bot for this tenant.-Keywords-scoped, unscoped, bot, windows credentials, BPA, Communication Arrangement

Title: Different User appearing for the field Created By in Source Document compared to Journal entries data source
Content: Symptom-For the field "Created By" the User appearing in the Source Document is not the same as the one appearing in the data source Journal entries.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go the General Ledger work center.-Select the Source Documents View.-Search for All Source Documents and ID XXX. (XXX represents the ID of the source document)-Result: The field "Created By" shows ABC. (ABC represents the User ID)-Then, follow the below path:-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Data Sources View.-Search for Journal Entries.-Click on Preview.-Search for the document Journal Entry ID.-Add in row fields "Created By".-Result: User appearing is DEF. This differs from the user visible in the Source Document.-Cause-The Source document, when created, must have got stuck as an unposted document for a time. It could be for various reasons such as period closure or missing data. However, the user that can be seen in the Journal Entries data source is the one that reprocessed the document and got it posted.-Resolution-This is therefore the expected system behavior. The reason behing the difference is due to a second User processing the document to get it posted to accounting.-Keywords-Source document; User

Title: Cost Center Replication Throws Error "Access Using a 'ZERO' Object Reference is not Possible"
Content: Symptom-Cost center replication throws error "Access using a 'ZERO' object reference is not possible".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication Work Center.-Go to Cost Center Export view.-Choose New.-Center Export Run.-Input Company.-Input Cost center.-Choose Start Now.-Now ,-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Go to Web Service Message Monitoring view.-You see the Failed message error :Access using a 'ZERO' object reference is not possible.-Cause-In the communication arrangement the API key company is not maintained.-Resolution-Application and User Management Work Center-Communication Arrangements View-Go to Communication required scenario: EC_Integration -Go to the Technical Tab.-There is a button to edit the API keys, on the pop up you see that no value for company has been entered.-Maintain the value for required company.-See Also-3225746 - Frequently Asked Questions on ByD B2B (ByD Integration)-Keywords- Cost center replication, EC Integration, 'ZERO' object reference

Title: Surcharge was Imported Successfully, But You Are Not Able to Find it in The System
Content: Symptom-We have imported a file for surchage, the status is completed but we are not able to find the sucharge in the ssytem.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration - Overview-Search:Migration of Surcharges, open it.-Click 'Migrate surcharges using the migration tool'.-You can see the file is completed status.-Go to the Product and Service Portfolio - Surcharges view.-Show query: Surcharge: Customer / Product, this surcharge is not found.-Cause-In migration Template, you are providing Percent as value '0'.  Due to input in 'Percent' column of template, system is considering the scenario as % surcharge.-But currently the Surcharge: Customer/Product is 7PR3 (Surcharge) instead of 7PR2 Surcharge(%). Hence, it was not allowing to modify the entry.-Resolution- Make sure you remove 0 from percentage from migration template.-Keywords-Migration of Surcharges; Not Found; Surcharges.

Title: How to Clear the Print Queue?
Content: Symptom-You can set up and maintain print queues to manage the process-integrated printing of business documents. You can also manage the document print jobs in your print queues. Here is a guide on how to clear your print queue.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-Go to the Print Queue work center (Application and User Management > Input andOutput Management > Print Queues)-Select the Print Queue you want to clean up.-Select the Edit button.-Select the Queued Documents list. Since none of these documents are physically printed, they remain in the Queued Documents list.-Select multiple rows by pressing CTRL or SHIFT and clicking on the rows you want to delete-Select the Delete button-Keywords-clear, print, queue, output

Title: Unable To Save Query in Production Task Control View
Content: Symptom-You are trying to save a query in production task control view, however it is not getting saved.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Task Control view.-Select All Production tasks by Selection in the dropdown.-Select the filter option.-Select the value help of Product Specification ID.-Open the filter options and Choose query Standard (2).-Select the more filters option for Status.-Choose more filters and add the status "In Process".-Select OK and then select the Go option.-Save the query (The screen closes automatically).-Result: Changes have not been saved, even after selecting the save options.-Cause-The intention of giving only the released status is to avoid the user from using any other statuses.-It cannot be changed as this is the standard business scenario and any changes on this, affects the overall business purpose.-Resolution-For viewing product specification data, you can use the Product Specification Work Centre.-It is a new Business Requirement, kindly add up your comments in our Influence Portal.-Keywords-Production Control work center, Task Control view, Production tasks, Product Specification ID-production control work center,task control view, production tasks,product specification id

Title: The Calculation of the Field Requested Delivery Date Includes Non-working Days
Content: Symptom-The calculation of the field Requested Delivery Date ﻿does not exclude non-working days.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales work centre.-Go to the Sales Order view.-Select a Sales Order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID).-For the field Creation Date a date XYZ is maintained (XYZ represents the date).-For the field Requested Delivery Date, the date XYZ + amount of day(s) is automatically filled.-The returned date for the field Requested Delivery Date falls on a non-working day.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Requested Delivery Date, Sales Order, Working Day, Request, Calendar, Non, Calculation, Requested Date, Delivery Date, Wrong

Title: Error “Deferral Requires Accrual Method” When You Create a Journal Entry Voucher for Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You get an error message: "Deferral Requires Accrual Method" when posting Journal Entry in associated with Sales Document.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger Work Center navigate to Journal Entry Voucher View.-Select New - Journal Entry Voucher.-Enter All the values required.-Select Journal Entry Type is 0088-Manual Entry for Sales Documents.-The screen Variant is 634 - Man. Write-Up/Write-Down for Sales Doc.-Sales Doc. Type is 114- Sales Order.-Sales Doc. ID is PQR(Here, PQR stands for the number of sales order).-Click Post or Simulate, and the error appears: Deferral Requires Accrual Method.-Cause-The accrual method for the relevant sales document is missing and showing blank. You must assign one accrual method to the sales document.-Resolution- To assign the accrual method for sales order:-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center navigate to Sales Document Items Sub View.-Select Sales Order Items and search Sales Order PQR.-Select Sales Order PQR.-Press Reassign - Accrual Method.-Select one Accrual method here and click OK.-Now, the New Journal Entry Voucher can be posted without error.-Keywords-Journal Entry Voucher; Manual Entry for Sales Documents; Deferral requires Accrual method

Title: Unexpected End Date in Automatically Renewed Customer Contract
Content: Symptom-You have created the Renewal Agreement for the Customer Contracts in the system. But unexpected end date has been determined in the automatically Renewed Customer Contract.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center - Contracts View-Open Contract ABC (where ABC stands for the Customer Contract ID)-Navigate to General tab-You can see Contract End Date is 02/28/2024 instead of 02/29/2024.-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Open "Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts" activity-Select Renewal Agreement X (where X stands for the Renewal Agreement ID), you can see Renewal Duration is 1 year-In Contract ABC, the Contract Start Date is 03/01/2023. Since 2024 is a leap year, so the expected Contract End Date should be 02/29/2024.-Cause-The Contract End Date of the renewed contract will not be set from the 28th to the 29th of February as the normal date calculation that occurs takes the renewal duration of 1 Year and directly adds 1 to the year of 2023. There is no check / calculation to be done to bring to "end of month".-The reason for this is that the original contract has an end date set as 28/02/2023. There is no indicator in the renewal rules to say "end of month", so when you renew for the year the system expects the same date the next year.-This in turn is why there is an influence on the invoice schedule as the item end date is set the same as header end date -> 28/02/2024.-Additionally, for renewed contracts into a leap year if you update the header contract end date , this updates the item level. You can then update the invoice schedule occurrence end date to the 29th for the leap year.-Resolution-The current behaviour is actually system design and there is no bug here.-We cannot change this as this would put other functions at risk of change. However, if you feel an enhancement should be added here please raise this on the influence portal.-Keywords-Customer Contract, Renew, Renewal Agreement, Leap Year, February, End Date

Title: Customer's Tax Registration is Missing in Sales Order for Taiwan
Content: Symptom-You have maintained the Tax Registration Number for a Taiwan Account in the Account Master Data but the Customer's Tax Registration Data is Missing in Sales Order ABC (where ABC stands for Sales Order name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order Work Center-Open Sales Order ABC-Click View All button-Navigate to Items tab, Taxes sub tab-You can find Customer's Tax Registration is missing.-Seller's Tax Registration is maintained.-Go to Account Management Work Center-Open Corporate Account EFG (where EFG stands for a Taiwan Account)-Click View All button-Navigate to Financial Data tab, Tax Data Sub tab-You can find Tax Registration Number has been maintained for the account.-Cause-For Taiwan, if you want Customer's Tax Registration in the sales order be determined, you need to maintain the GUI Registration Number instead of Tax Registration Number in the Account Master Data.-Resolution-Go to Account Management Work Center-Open Corporate Account EFG-Click View All-Navigate to Financial Data tab, Tax Data Sub tab-Maintain the Tax Number Type as GUI Registration Number, then maintain the Tax Number.-You should create a new sales order for further process, the data can't be updated in the old one.-Keywords-Tax Data, Tax Number, Tax Country, Tax Registration, Taiwan, Sales Order, Missing

Title: Extension Field Created using Adaptation Mode is Not Visible
Content: Symptom-User trying to create extension field using Adaptation mode. Created extension field is only visible under one screen("Edit" or "View All")-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in to Customer Tenant.-Open (Example:Material ID).-Click Edit.-Created extension field is visible only under one screen("Edit" or "View all").-Cause-User must add the extension field in both the screens ("Edit" and "View all") separately.-Resolution-Select (Example:Material ID).-Click Edit.-Click user profile and start Adaptation mode.-Add the Extension Field.-Select the Extension Field which user have created.-Enable checkbox for created Extension Field and Publish.-Click Save.-Stop Adaptation mode.- Perform the above steps in "view all" screen separately so that you will be able to see the created extension field in both "Edit" mode and "view all".-Keywords-Adaptation mode, Extension Field, Edit, View all

Title: Error "ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY_CODE-CONTENT is missing ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY_CODE-LIST_ID is missing" While Changing Administrative Category
Content: Symptom-While changing Administrative Category error message appears-ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY_CODE-CONTENT is missing-ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY_CODE-LIST_ID is missing-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work center-Go to Regular Tasks View-Choose Change Administrative Category-Search Employee -Input the details -Save-Cause-In a Replication scenario, the Administrative Category Code is not maintained and therefore, never gets sent into ByD during a Replication Request. However in standard ByD system with no replication, this is a Mandatory field during a Hire / Transfer scenario.-This error is thrown because employee hiring is done when master data replication was in scope.-Resolution-User must manually maintain this Administrative Category for each affected Employee. This can be done by-Go to Regular Tasks-Change Administrative Category and the change date, must be from the beginning of the Work Agreement of the required Employee.-The administrative category is adjusted as per the number of additional clauses defined under Personnel File of the employee -- Employment Tab -- Work Agreement tab.-NOTE: There is no way to complete this process in-mass for the Customer, each instance will need to be tackled manually using the above process.-Keywords-ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY_CODE-LIST_ID , ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY_CODE-CONTENT, changing Administrative Category, Replication scenario-administrative_category_code-content i,administrative_category_code-list_id,replication scenario

Title: Active Day Closure Run not Working Anymore
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Although the current day closure run is still active and was not stopped actively, the run stopped working and no new period closure dates are generated. This can cause various issues, like e.g.:-Period closure dates of employees are not up to date anymore in the employee file in time administration work center-Planned working times are not included in the reporting anymore-And so on-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Time Administration work center-Select the Regular Tasks view-Under the section Time Valuations, select the link Administer Day Closure Runs-Show All Runs and mark the row containing the active Day Closure ID-Show last 5 logs-As visible there, the last logs were already created some time ago  -Cause-A customized day closure run is used, and the creator of this run left the company. Since the employee is not valid anymore, also the day closure run is not valid anymore.-Resolution-Set the existing run to obsolete and schedule a new run to enable the creation of period closure dates.-Keywords-stops, stop, not canceled, changed, no change, still,

Title: ABC Classification is Automatically Determined While Saving the Account
Content: Symptom-When customer is creating corporate account, ABC classification is selected automatically after saving the account.-This behavior is different for different tenants.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Account Management work center-Create new corporate account.-Update the industry code field in the tenant,ABC classification is generated automatically.-Cause-In general standard delivery of SAP Business ByDesign, we do not maintain the ABC classification as a dependent field on other fields.-Resolution-There might be (PDI) extensions in place which perform that dependent maintenance. Check the PDI extension in the respective tenants.-Keywords-ABC Classification, dependency of fields, PDI extensions, corporate account.-

Title: Unexpected DateTime Format in the Response of Web Service QueryIdentifiedStocksIn
Content: Symptom-Query identified stock details through standard web service QueryIdentifiedStocksIn. In the response, ProductionDateTime and ExpirationDateTime are displayed in format UTC. However, the date and time are displayed in UTC+8 from UI.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Query identified stock ABC (ABC represents identified stock ID) details through standard web service QueryIdentifiedStocksIn. In the response, ProductionDateTime is 2021-03-15T16:00:00Z, ExpirationDateTime is 2026-02-28T16:00:00Z, which are in UTC format.-Logon system, go to work center Warehousing and Logistics Master Data.-Access view Identified Stock.-Find identified stock ABC, click Edit, you find Production Date is 2021-03-16 12:00AM UTC+8, Expiration Date is 2026-03-01 12:00AM UTC+8.-Cause-The date and time in the backend is always stored in UTC. What you see on the front UI is the date and time converted to the user’s time zone. If you change the user’s time zone setting from UI, you will see the value of the date and time also changed.-The standard web service QueryIdentifiedStocksIn will retrieve the data stored at backend, which is in UTC. The web service will not (and isn’t expected) to do the time zone conversion.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-QueryIdentifiedStocksIn, Web Service, TimeZone, UTC

Title: How To Set Restart Time For Message
Content: Symptom-For various Service Interface Messages, you get below error which automatic restarts maximum 7 times. Here, you want to know how to change Restart time frequency for messages.-Operation not possible; business document locked.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management workcenter.-Under Input and Output Management view.-Go to Business Communication Monitoring view.-Select Business Messages with errors or required category error.-Under General tab, you find error message.-Under Message Details, system displays maximum retry no. 7.-Cause-System retries automatically restarting the message by 7 times. The restart time is by default set by SAP itself. There is no way to set it manually in the system.-Resolution-You can restart the required message via option Restart in the system.-Keywords-Restart, business communication monitoring, retry 7, restart, message, 3PL

Title: QueryContactIn Web Service Last Change Date Does Not Work as Expected
Content: Symptom-User using QueryContactIn to obtain contacts modified since lastchange date and it is not working as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Cause-The XML that is used for finding the contact for which changes have occurred after a specific date/time is not exactly giving the right parameters:- The parameter is called "SelectionByChangedSinceDateTime" instead of "SelectionByLastChangeSinceDateTime".- The given time stamp must have the format "yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.1234567Z" (SAP recommend to include the 7 number after the   decimal point).-The query underlying this web service is designed to deliver "Query By Role Contact Person Or Relationship Is Contact Person For user".-Parameter which maps to the Last Change Date/Time means that all contacts which are returned are changed by system after the given date/time, or  the relationships of the related user are changed after the given date/time.Hence query you are executing might return more contacts than expected if you look at the response XML.-Resolution-The "parameter part" of the XML (without SOAP header etc) for example should be like as shown below:-<ContactSelectionByElements>-<SelectionByChangedSinceDateTime>yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.1234567Z</SelectionByChangedSinceDateTime>-</ContactSelectionByElements>-<ProcessingConditions>-<QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>true</QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>-</ProcessingConditions>-Keywords-QueryContactIn,SelectionByChangedSinceDateTime,SelectionByChangedSinceDateTime

Title: Error Message: "The Target UI Component Is Not Assigned to Any Work Center View. Please Contact Your System Administrator."
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*INTERNAL USE ONLY*-You receive an error message "The Target UI Component is not Assigned to any Work Center View. Please Contact Your System Administrator." when you try to access Time Recording in mobile mode via html/browser.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The ByD Mobile App's Time-Recording feature uses a free-style Java Script user interface rather than the Oberon UI, which is based on patterns, as its technological foundation.-This has a number of benefits, but it also has a drawback in that this function does not have access to some generic features, like the extensibility features and the option to add customer fields.-Resolution-It's not possible to add own fields to the mobile time recording app. Hence,  ask the customer to raise a new requirement in the Influence Portal.-Keywords-UI Component, ByD Mobile App, Time Recording App-ui component,byd mobile app,time recording app

Title: Extension Field Implementation Engagement Percentage Shows as # in Report.
Content: Symptom-Extension field Implementation Engagement percentage shows as # in report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics - Design Reports.-Search for Employee Skill Set Report and Open.-Filter with Employee ID and Apply.-You see Implementation Engagement % field is showing as #.-Now,-Go to Personnel Administration - Employees.-Search for Employee and Edit.-Go to Personal Data - Biographical Data.-You see Implementation Engagement % field is maintained as a particular number.-Cause-The data in the report is being displayed corresponding to the current valid Biographical Data.-Resolution-Maintain the Implementation Engagement values for the current Biographical Data validity (DD.MM.YYYY – Unlimited) to see them in the report.-Keywords-Implementation Engagement Percentage,  Employee Skill Set Report, current Biographical Data validity

Title: Purchase Order Item Approval Task Does not Show Under My Launchpad Screen
Content: Symptom-As an approver, you have received an approval task for both shopping cart, purchase order and purchase order item to approve the documents. However purchase order item approval task is not visible under My Launchpad where as the open task is visible for shopping carts and Purchase Order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login to SAP Business ByDesign system-System opens My Launchpad screen-Navigate to Work: Inbox-Select Open Tasks-Here you cannot see the task for purchase order item-Resolution-We will add the purchase order item task type to My Launchpad screen in the future release of SAP Business By Design-Keywords-purchase order task not visible under My Launchpad; My Launchpad

Title: Error Message - Credit memo has an exception suggesting that the credit amount is greater than invoiced order amount or limit however this is not the case and invoice appears to be identical.
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-Error message - Credit memo has an exception suggesting that the credit amount is greater than invoiced order amount or limit however this is not the case and invoice  appears to be identical.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the work center Supplier Invoicing.-Go to the view Invoices and Credit Memos.-Open the Credit Memo which is in Exception status.-Choose Post or Check.-You get the error: "Credit amount greater than invoiced delivery amount, The sum of credit amounts is greater than the sum of debit amounts for the preceding supplier invoice item".-  Cause-The Credit memo is posting for the same amount as the Supplier invoice.- However there's a currency conversion based on the Purchase Order-  Resolution-You can either change their tolerance, calculate the difference based on currency conversion or change the conversion rate back to when the original Supplier invoice was posted.

Title: You get Dump While Releasing/Approving Sales Documents
Content: Symptom-You get dump while releasing/approving the sales document (sales order, service confirmation, credit memo......).-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Case 1:-Go to Managing My Area Work Center -> Approvals View-Select the approval task of the sales document-Click Approve button-Dump occurs-Case 2:-Select the sales document-Click Release button-Dump occurs-Dump Details:-Error Txt: CM_SPAF_PROXY_CALL:"Shortcut not available:BUPA_NOT_FOUND" [SAPMHTTP:0]-Cause-This is occurring because the Communication Arrangement DEF (Where DEF represents the ID of the Communication Arrangement) is not active. The status is currently "In Preparation".-Take service confirmation as example:-The communication arrangement that comes up when you go to the account -> Communication -> Collaboration -> Service Confirmation -> Maintain XML settings is "Service Order Integration" -> status "In Preparation".-○ This is not listed under Application and User Management  -> Communication Arrangement-○ It is listed under Communication Scenario but with no communication arrangement maintained.-Resolution-Follow the steps below to find the communication arrangement for the account XYZ (where XYZ represents the ID of the Account):-Go to the Account Management work center.-Go to the Accounts view.-Show All Accounts and Find XYZ.-Open the account XYZ.-Go to the Communication tab -> Select the Collaboration subtab.-Select the Service Confirmation.-Select the Maintain XML Settings button.-The new screen will show Communication Arrangement: Service Order Integration-Activate this Communication Arrangement.-See Also-KBA 3145582  The Service Confirmation is Dumping When it is Released-KBA 3064071  Exception (Dump) When Sending Order Confirmation to Account-KBA 2243860  Dump Occurs When you try to Release an Intercompany Sales Order-KBA 1913179  You get Dump While Releasing the Credit Memo-Keywords-Dump; Communication Arrangement; sales documents; release; approve

Title: Outlook Add-In is Available Only in German Instead of English
Content: Symptom-You have downloaded the Outlook Add-In but the labels are German instead of English-Note: This KBA is an example and the checks mentioned in this KBA is applicable to other language combination as well-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-You installed the New Outlook Add-in from Download center-When you access the add-in in the MS outlook the language of the Add-in is in German. However your MS outlook and OS languages are in English-Cause-The cause for the issue is that the language setting in your PC/Laptop is still pointing to German-Resolution-Step 1: The log file will specify the language and from where it is being picked up-1. Open Outlook-2. In the Home > SAP Business ByDesign tab, Select on Help > Select Increase Log level (if not already selected)-3. Close Outlook-4. Open Outlook again-5. In the Home > SAP Business ByDesign tab, Select on Help > Show Log file directory-From the downloaded log, check the registry using RegEdit and check the entry for 'AcceptLanguage' maintained in the following Paths:-Computer\HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\International-Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\International-If the value is maintained as DE in either of the places then you should change/delete it in Internal Explorer settings.-If the above step didnt resolve the issue then move to below step-Step 2: Preferred Language in the Windows setting-1. Select Windows icon-2. Search for Language Settings-3. In Time & Language > Language & region-4. Under Preferred Language-In the preferred language section If German is coming in the top then this will be taken as the preferred language for applications.-English needs to be added there and in the order it should be moved to the top-Keywords-outlook, language, preferred, outlokk logs

Title: Is it Possible to View all the Changes made in Sales Orders in a Report
Content: Symptom-You are unable to find a report where you can see all the changes made in Sales Orders.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-Select List under Reports view. -Cause-We can view the changes made in a sales order in the changes tab of that particular sales order but there is no report when we can see the changes made in all sales orders.-It is also not possible to extract this data via the web service or OData.-Resolution-The feature described in this incident is not available in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Sales Order; Changes; Report

Title: Contract not Created Automatically Based on Renewal Rule
Content: Symptom-The Contract has expired and based on the Renewal Rule, expecting to have a new item created automatically right after the expiry date.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Set up a Renewal Rule where a Contract should be created before the end of Contract Validity.-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Select the Contracts view.-Edit Contract ABC (where ABC represents the ID of the Customer Contract).-Navigate to the Items tab.-Line item not renewed. -Cause-To Check "Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts" activity in Business configuration.-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Go to the Implementation Project view.-Choose The Title of the Project from "All Projects".-Open Activity List and search for "Renewal and Cancellation for Customer Contracts".-Select "Maintain Renewal Rules".-The checkbox for Auto Renew has already been selected.-Observe the 'Redetermine Price' has also been selected.-To check the error of the Contract item -Go to Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Task Management view.-Filter from the "Automated Task with Errors".-Select the subject "Automatic Renewal of Contract Item ABC ".-Observe the cause of the error and Application Log given below.-Select and open the Application Log hyperlink.-Navigate to the Result Tab.-Select Expand All and observe the Description.-Description : -"Permanent error during execution of automatic task- -Error occurred while executing action RENEW on business object CUSTOMER_CONTRACT/ITEM- -Mandatory List Price missing. List price must be maintained or a price must be entered manually.- -Determination of tax code failed- -Error occurred while saving the changes- -Saving not possible due to status of document"-- -If price list is not maintained for newly calculated price date so, ideally new item is not getting created because of mandatory list price missing.- Resolution-This is the system expected behavior.--In order to avoid this error. Maintain the price list for respective price date.-See Also-Help Document:-Customer Contracts Quick Guide - Renew a Contract or Contract Item-KBA 3020275 - Contract or Quote for Contract is Not Being Created Based on the Renewal Rule Maintained-KBA 2944478 - Contract Item 10 was not Renewed as Expected.-Keywords-Renewal Rule, Contract, Item, Auto Renew, Redetermine Price

Title: When Migrating Kit Item List, Error Triggered "The quantity of kit ABC cannot be more than 1 EA".
Content: Symptom-When migrating a kit item list, on first step Validate File, system reports error "The quantity of kit ABC cannot be more than 1 EA" (ABC represents kit name).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Business Configuration.-Access view Implementation Projects.-Select the implementation project, click Open Activity List.-Find Migration of Kit Item List, click Open.-Click Migration of Kit Item List.-In the screen "Migrate Kit Item List", upload the migration file, click Execute Migration - Execute Migration Step by Step.-On step 1 "Validate File", system reports error "The quantity of kit ABC cannot be more than 1 EA" (ABC represents kit name).-Cause-In the migration file, under tab General, "个" is used as Quantity UoM for kit header ("个" is Chinese of each). However, the UoM has to be maintained as EA only currently. The translation does not work in this case.-Resolution-This is current system limitation.-Keywords-Migration, Kit Item List, Each, UoM, Language

Title: Error Message "The termination occurred in system with error code 404 and for the reason Not found."
Content: Symptom-When you preview a Business Document (ex: Purchase Order), system throws below error message:-The termination occurred in system with error code 404 and for the reason Not found-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Below is a sample steps for a PO preview-1. Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-2. Go to Purchase Orders view-3. Open a Purchase Order-4. In the View All navigate to Output History tab-5. Select the Purchase Order hyperlink-Cause-Cause for the issue is that there are high number of attachments in the document-Resolution-The suggested/ideal number of attachments in a document would be 10-15 files.-So, reduce the number of attachments of the document and resubmit the document.-Keywords-attachment, preview, error, error code 404

Title: Incorrect National Code displayed in Payment Information after Successful Replication
Content: Symptom-After successful replication, wrong national bank code is displayed in payment information.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Employee Data Work Center.-Select Employee.-Search for relevant Employee.-Click Edit.-Select Personal Data.-Select Payment Information.-Incorrect National Bank Code displayed.-Cause-Incorrect bank details are given in replication request from SuccessFactors to Business ByDesign.-Resolution-Kindly double check the bank details provided in replication request from SuccessFactors to Business ByDesign.-Keywords-Replication Request

Title: You Get Dump When Approving a Document such as an Customer Invoice Task Due to the Issue on REPLACE_PLACEHOLDERS_IN_HTML
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-While the user approving a task for a document such as a customer invoice, system gives dump.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Manage My Area work center.-Go to Approvals view.-Select an approval task for customer invoice. -Open and click Approve button, system gives dump.-Cause-In the backend, check ST22, find the dump.  You can see the error is about REPLACE_PLACEHOLDERS_IN_HTML.-|Information on where terminated |-| Termination occurred in the ABAP program "/DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR==CP" - |-| in "REPLACE_PLACEHOLDERS_IN_HTML". |-| The main program was "SAPMHTTP ". |-| |-| In the source code you have the termination point in line 63 |-in |Source Code Extract | section, we can see the details of the place went wrong.-| 55| " Get the place holders from html into an internal table |-| 56| lv_html_email_body = ch_email_html_body. |-| 57| WHILE lv_exit = 0. |-| 58| ls_str = substring_after( val = lv_html_email_body sub = '[' ). |-| 59| ls_str = substring_before( val = ls_str sub = ']' ). |-| 60| CONDENSE ls_str. |-| 61| IF NOT ls_str IS INITIAL. |-| 62| ls_placeholder-name = ls_str. |-|>>>>>| APPEND ls_placeholder TO lt_placeholder. |-Further, in the |Chosen variables | section-|No. 22 Ty. METHOD |-|Name /DOC/CL_DOR_A_REFRESH_DEF_OR=>REPLACE_PLACEHOLDERS_IN_HTML |-CH_EMAIL_HTML_BODY: [CustomerInvoice-BillToParty-FormattedName] - Invoic[ No. [CustomerInvoice.ID] with Ref. [Cust...-LV_HTML_EMAIL_BODY: - Invoic[ No. [CustomerInvoice.ID] with Ref. [CustomerInvoice-ReferenceBusinessTransactionDo...-The issue is from the value Invoic[ No. [CustomerInvoice.ID] , the place holder [No. [CustomerInvoice.ID] is not able to be determined. The string doesn’t match so it cannot be removed., hence it keeps looping. Therefore the internal table for place holder continues to explode.-CustomerInvoice-BillToParty-FormattedName-No. [CustomerInvoice.ID-No. [CustomerInvoice.ID-No. [CustomerInvoice.ID-etc...-Note, completed dump file is attached in the KBA, you can check more details there.-Resolution-You need to ensure that only you parameter is in square brackets [] .-Correct string for an invoice for example is:-[CustomerInvoice-BillToParty-FormattedName] - Invoic No. [CustomerInvoice.ID] with Ref. [CustomerInvoice-ReferenceBusinessTransactionDocumentID] amounting to [CustomerInvoice-PriceAndTax-GrossAmount]-Keywords-dump; REPLACE_PLACEHOLDERS_IN_HTML; customer invoice; sales order; service order; quote; contact; sales document;

Title: SSO Connection Between SAP ByD and SAP BTP to use Odata Services in SAPUI5 Fails
Content: Symptom-You have created a OAuth setup from BTP to BYD system using the blog https://blogs.sap.com/2018/07/13/configure-oauth-2.0-for-sap-bydesign-  odata-services/ and the connectivity fails with an error when ever you peform a connection test.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP BTP -Reproducing the Issue-Log into BTP system and navigate to destination under connectivity and perform connection test for  TEST-SSO.-Error observed.-Failure reason: "Unexpected Token Service response code. Token Service error response: "The provided authorization grant is invalid.-Exception was: There is no trust between entities and https://eu2.hana.ondemand.com/services in client. For more information consult the kernel traces or the OAuth 2.0 trouble shooting SAP note 1688545.".-Check the configuration or contact Token Service owner." Received status code: "400"-Cause-It may have misconfigured, so the trust is not established with https://eu2.hana.ondemand.com/services from ByD in OAuth Identity provider-Resolution- Correct the data and reimport the meta data file-See Also- SAP note 1688545-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/07/13/configure-oauth-2.0-for-sap-bydesign-odata-services-Keywords-OAuth setup from BTP to BYD, connectivity fails with an error, Unexpected Token Service response code.

Title: Resource Calendar Report Shows Data Only for Certain Days/Weeks/Months
Content: Symptom-When you access the Resource calendar (HCMRPMU05_Q0001) to view the details for an employee, the report shows the data from a specific date and there is no data earlier than that date-Environment- SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics or Resource Management work center-Open the Report Resource calendar (HCMRPMU05_Q0001)-Input the Employee and Key Date-Cause-As described in the Help Center Documentation - below prerequisites should by fulfilled:-Time and Labor Management must be in your scoped solution, as the report requires access to the daily work schedule of the employee.-Furthermore, work schedules must be correctly maintained for all involved resources relevant for Resource Management in your company, and-Project time confirmations must be completed by these resources.-There is also a cause which depends on the scoping of new Resource planning management.-Resolution-If the above prerequisties are not met then the data will be not be displayed.-Scoping dependency:-The report HCMRPMU05_Q0001 relies on data existing in the Resource calendar.  This is created at the time of the Resource Planning Management solution being scoped on the system and the changes to projects planning, absences, planned times etc are kept up to date on the resource calendar for the specific employees.-For example: If you scope Resource planning management on a particular day then the data will be calculated and the Resource calendar is updated from that date onwards  This is the reason for the date only being available from the scoping date and not from the duration of the time file and the planned times from the time file.--As per the system design, you can view data only 90 days from past and not more than that. Hence, the report related to the data source HCMRPMU05_Q0001 displays only last 3 months data.--Keywords- HCMRPMU05_Q0001, data missing, no information

Title: <Technical error CM_REQ_SPEC 084; report an incident> Displayed While Creating Product Specification
Content: Symptom-Error message Technical error CM_REQ_SPEC 084; report an incident is displayed while creating a product specification.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Planning and Production Master Data Work Center. -Navigate to the Product Specifications View. -Choose the New button and select the option Product Specification. -Enter the relevant mandatory values in the available fields and choose the Save button. -You receive the above reported error.-Cause-You have not maintained the option to Sell Specified Products in Business Configuration.-Resolution-Go to Business Configuration work center. -Navigate to the Implementation Projects view. -Select the relevant project and choose the button Edit Project Scope. -Navigate to the Scoping chevron and expand the Scoping Element Sales. -Under Sales expand Product and Service Portfolio for Sales element. -Mark the element Sell Specified Products. -Choose the Next button and finish editing the project scope by choosing the Finish button. -Once the above steps are maintained the reported error will not occur while creating product specifications.-Keywords-production specification error, error in creating product specification, PRS error, error in PRS, PRS creation error

Title: Not Able to Add Company-Specific Help in format "mailto"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to to Add Company-Specific Help however the system does not allow it.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click on the question mark button besides the profile icon.-Click on Add Company-Specific Help.-Click on New and select link option.-Try to add the link in "mailto" format.-System will not allow it.-Resolution-This is the system expected behaviour.-SAP Business Bydesign only supports http and https links when maintaining in Company-Specific Help-Keywords-BYD / Company-Specific Help / Documentation

Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-When you are viewing Organization Structure, the system crashes and dumps.-*Internal KBA*-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Organizational Management workcenter-Organizational Structure view-Select an Effective From Date -> OK-Switch to Table view-Expand Organizational Structure-Further expand Sub-org Structure -> Dumps-Dump Details: SAP Logon-Tcode: ST22-Active Calls/Events-No.   Ty.
