Title: How to Enable Tax Exemption Fields
Content: Symptom-Tax Exemption Section is not shown despite Existing in the System.-Environment- SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management work center-Access thee Accounts work center view-Search for Account ID XXXX ( Here XXXX refers to the Account ID)-Select the Account and click Edit, then click Financial Data-Navigate to the Tax Data sub-tab-Under the Tax Exemption section, no data is available; additionally, the Add Row and Remove buttons are greyed out.-Cause-The Tax Exemption section is not visible-Resolution-Go to the Account Management work center -Accounts work center view - open the account ID XXXX.  ( Here XXXX refers to the Account ID)-Choose Edit, then select Financial Data-Navigate to the Tax Data sub-tab, click the Profile icon-Go to Key user settings - Adaptation mode-You need to change the settings, so that all fields are visible for the personalization of the user.-You can see  Tax exemptions click on visible option.-Then click on "publish"-Now the tax exemption fields will be available for all users again.-Keywords- Account Management work center, Accounts work center view, Tax Data, Tax Exemption-tax exemption,account management,tax data,accounts

Title: Error Message "Call to OData service failed"
Content: Symptom-When you execute bot "Automated supplier invoice upload (1R1)",-The job on the iRPA factory shows 'Completed' but the invoice pdf which is in ToBeProcessed folder moves from ToBeProcessed folder to Failed folder.-The log file shows the error 'Call to OData service failed'-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-Check whether the Desktop Agent, SDK dependencies and respective Bot are in latest version-For Desktop Agent and SDK dependencies version, refer to the Blog - https://blogs.sap.com/2023/02/01/keeping-robotic-process-automation-environment-up-to-date/-For Bot, check the bot in the store and use Update button to update it-In case the issue persists, report an incident with the details about the version ID of Desktop Agent, SDK dependencies and respective Bot-Keywords-odata service failed, sdk, desktop agent, bot, upload supplier invoice, invoice scanning

Title: Metric type: TREX SEARCHPERF Metric name: "total search count(n)" is missing in EWA
Content: Symptom-In the EWA report for the TREX system, the following warning is reported in the section "Quality of Service Data in Solution Manager Diagnostics - BW":-No performance data is returned from BW InfoCube. Infocube: 0SMD_MPEH , metric type: TREX SEARCHPERF , metric name: Total Search Count(n) used in section 'TREX System Data for <SID of TREX system>' -In the section "TREX System Data for <SID of TREX system>",  data for metrics "average search count", "Average Search Time", "Average Index Count" and "Average Index Time" are filled.-Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.20 -All TREX versions-Cause-The TREX metrics are collected while calling directly the sapstartsrv via command:-sapcontrol -host localhost -nr 00 -function GetAlertTree  --(nr = Instance-Number of TREX)--The output has changed in 2015 already and “Indexing Count (n)” and Search Count(n) are no longer delivered from GetAlertTree.-Therefore the ‘Total…’ metrics are not available and the “metrics /request” cannot be calculated.-Resolution-The message "No performance data is returned from BW InfoCube. Infocube: 0SMD_MPEH , metric type: TREX SEARCHPERF , metric name: Total Search Count(n) used in section 'TREX System Data for <SID of TREX system>'" can be ignored as this data is not available for TREX.-In EWA report, only 'Average' data will be used in section "TREX System Data for <SID of TREX>".-See Also-2655586 - Unable to Activate TREX Checks in * using Solution Manager 7.2-1978360 - EarlyWatch Alert For TREX-2087027 - CCDB extractor cannot find TREX configuration files

Title: Unexpected Journal Entry Number Range for the Journal Entry Voucher
Content: Symptom-You create a new Journal entry voucher(JEV) and expects the Journal Entry(JE) created is according to number range configured in the system. However system creates JE with a different Number Range.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger Work Center-Go to Journal Entries View and Search for Journal entries created-The JE Created number is not in accordance with the configuration made. E.g. Expected JE is 00000001 however created JE is 10000001.(Numbers mentioned here are for example and doesn't represent an actual one) -Cause-Eventhough the configuration is made, the assigned number range profile to a set of books is different and hence the unexpected JE number is generated-Resolution-To display the correct JE Number, the configured Number range profile has to be mapped to Set of books as well. Details are below.-Number Range Profile Configuration:-Go to Business Configuration Work center-Search for Activity 'Journal Entry Types and Number Ranges'-Open the Section 'Edit Number Range Profiles for Journal Entries'-For each Number Range profile and Journal Entry Type, Number range can be mapped. In case the Journal Entry Type is not maintained here, the Default Number Range can be set. This can be done by clicking on 'Edit Number Ranges' button-Once the above configuration is done, now the Set of books have to be configured with the number range profile-Go to Business Configuration Work center-Search and Open Activity 'Set Of Books'-Here Edit the set if books and select 'Company Settings'-Under Each Company, 'Number Range Profile' can be mapped.-Map the Above configured Number range profile which was configured for a specific journal entry type.-Once this is done for all required company code and Set of books, newly created JEs will follow the Number range properly-Keywords-Number Range, Journal Entry Voucher

Title: Error Message: "Party Seller with ID XYZ (ABC) not contractually capable."
Content: Symptom-When you are trying to create a supplier invoice the following error is shown: "Party Seller with ID XYZ (ABC) not contractually capable."-(Where XYZ is the Supplier ID and ABC is the Supplier Name.)-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoice work center.-Go to Common Tasks and then select New Invoice Without Purchase Order.-Select the Supplier in the Involved Parties section.-We can see an error message as "Party Seller with ID XYZ (ABC) not contractually capable."-Cause-In User Interface, you are using "Legal Competence Indicator" in personalization mode and the indicator is not marked as true.-Resolution-You can change the settings by following the below steps:-Go to Supplier Base work center.-Go to Suppliers view.-Search for the Supplier. -Navigate to the General tab and then to details. -Mark the indicator as True.-Keywords- Legal Competence Indicator, Supplier Invoice, Supplier Base-legal competence indicator,supplier invoice,supplier base

Title: Unable to see Purchase Order Details Under Track My Shopping Cart View
Content: Symptom-Shopping cart users cannot see purchase order details in the track my shopping cart view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self Services overview-Select Shopping and Click on hyper link Track My Shopping Carts-You cannot see the purchase order details for the relevant shopping cart-Cause-Currently it is not possible to bring the Purchase Order details under Track My Shopping Carts view.-Resolution-As a work around, Shopping cart users can go to document flow of shopping cart and check the corresponding purchase order. For new enhancement, you can request in influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign.-Keywords-Purchase Order Details Under Track My Shopping Cart View; Track My Shopping Cart View;

Title: Message "This file is invalid for use as the following: Security Certificate"
Content: Symptom-When you download and open the Certificate from Event Notification screen, system throws below pop-up-This file is invalid for use as the following: Security Certificate-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and User Management work center-2. Go to Event Notification-3. New / Edit-4. Select SSL authentication > Edit Credentials-5. In the pop up, select Download-6. Download the Certificate (only one option)-7. Try to open the downloaded certificate-Cause-The certificate downloaded in the Event Notification screen is corrupted-Resolution-As a workaround,-1. Go to Application User Management work center-2. Go to Communication Certificate view-3. Select the Download Tenant Certificate-Use this certificate for your Event Notification-Keywords-download certificate, event notification, Security Certificate

Title: Web-Services Required To Fetch All Worklist Items For An Employee.
Content: Symptom-Web-services required to fetch all worklist items for an employee.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-There are two webservices.These are Released with restrictions-Query Web-service II_TIMX_WRKLIST_SYNC_ACTION_IN-Worklist synchronization Web-service II_TIMX_QUERY_EMPLOYEE_TIME_I-Resolution-In-order to fetch all worklist items of an employee, it’s important to first call the synchronization Web-service (creates all worklist items for employee) followed by the query webservice.-Step #1: Call webservice II_TIMX_WRKLIST_SYNC_ACTION_IN (Operation: SYNCHRONIZE_WORKLIST)-Note: DO NOT FORGET TO COMMIT WORK-Payload Example:-<n0:EmployeeWorklistSynchronizeActionRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<BasicMessageHeader>-<ID>Token 4</ID>-<UUID>*****</UUID>-<ReferenceID>Token 10</ReferenceID>-<ReferenceUUID>*****</ReferenceUUID>-</BasicMessageHeader>-<EmployeeWorklist>-<EmployeeUUID >*****</EmployeeUUID>-<EmployeeID>XXXX</EmployeeID> -</EmployeeWorklist>-</n0:EmployeeWorklistSynchronizeActionRequest_sync>--Step #2: Call webservice II_TIMX_QUERY_EMPLOYEE_TIME_I (Operation: FIND_PRO_TASK_IN_WRKLIST_BY_EL)-Payload Example:-<n0:EmployeeTimeProjectTaskServiceInWorklistByElementsQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<EmployeeTimeProjectTaskServiceInWorklistSelectionByElements>-<SelectionByEmployeeID>-<InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>-<IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>-<LowerBoundaryEmployeeID>XXXX</LowerBoundaryEmployeeID>-</SelectionByEmployeeID>-<SelectionByDate>-<InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>-<IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>3</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>-<LowerBoundaryDate>YYYY1-MM1-DD1</LowerBoundaryDate>-<UpperBoundaryDate>YYYY2-MM2-DD2</UpperBoundaryDate>-</SelectionByDate>-</EmployeeTimeProjectTaskServiceInWorklistSelectionByElements>-</n0:EmployeeTimeProjectTaskServiceInWorklistByElementsQuery_sync>-NOTE: XXXX= Employee ID , ***** = give your UUID/ReferenceUUID/EmployeeUUID-Keywords-Query Web-service , Worklist synchronization Web-service, Released with restrictions , Worklist Items for an Employee

Title: You Can't Change the Employee Responsible if Sales Order is Completed.
Content: Symptom-You want to change employee responsible after the sales order is completed.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order work center.-View: Sales Order.-Show: All Orders.-Search and edit Sales Order ABC (ABC represent Sales order ID).-Edit and you can see Employee Responsible is greyed out and cannot be changed.-Cause-When the status of the sales order is completed, the employee responsible cannot be changed.-Resolution-This is current system behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order, Completed, Employee Responsible

Title: How is Ship to Address determined in Output form of Purchase order
Content: Symptom-You wanted to know from where the system fetches the details on to Out form related to Ship to location-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Purchase Requests and Orders work center.-Go to the Purchase Orders view.-Select purchase order -Click the Edit button.-Click the Preview button.- or-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Search for the Purchase Order -Now select View All and navigate to Output History tab-Select the output form and open the form- You will see some un expected details  under ship to address-Cause-Ship to address appearing in out put form is combination of ship to location address and  Recipient details maintained in the Purchase order.-Resolution-Open the PO and Go to PO  Items>delivery tab and you will see the Recipient and the ship to location iD-Also in the same screen  under "Delivery Address copied from Location " you see the  combined details of recipient and ship to location appearing.- Since this two details go hand on hand thus they appear together in  Output form as well.-See Also-2217523 - In the output form of Purchase order,Phone number or fax or email or website is not displayed for the Ship To Location-2896690 - Country Name is Displayed in Different Language in Purchase Order Form- 3171312 - Missing Country in Preview of Purchase Order Form-Keywords-Wromg delivery details, wrong ship to, wrong address

Title: Default supplier invoice template not getting picked when creating new supplier invoice via collaboration window
Content: Symptom-You have created a supplier invoice template for the combination of supplier and the company, and mark this template as default.-However this default template is not getting picked when creating new supplier invoice via collaboration window.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log in with SAP collaboration window.-Upload items in the invoice scanner.-Click on Review button, the supplier and the company are correctly scanned and recognized, the invoice type is "Invoice".-Click on "Create invoice".-When the "Create invoice" window opened, you are expecting the default template to be automatically imported with all the data and invoice structure, but nothing happened.-You still need to manually select it from the field "Template ID" -> Update template.-Cause-When you create scanned invoice from the SAP collaboration window, system does not consider the invoice template.-Instead system considers the purchase order reference. (If you have enabled the scoping "Do you want to compare scanning invoice items with purchase order items" )-You can refer to the below scoping questions under Supplier invoicing.-Do you want to compare scanning invoice items with purchase order items ?-Do you want to default the company based on scanned value ?-When you create the scanned invoice manually from Supplier invoicing work center and then, if you select the specific template and update template, system defaults the details from the template.-Resolution-It is very welcomed if you would like to suggest an enhancement of this functionality.-Kindly turn to our Forum for new requirement proposals: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Default supplier invoice template, SAP collaboration window, Scanned invoice, Default template, supplier invoice, invoice scanning

Title: Adding Attachments For Released Inbound Delivery
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to add attachments for Inbound Delivery which is already released.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics workcenter-Go to Inbound Deliveries view-Find required ID and edit.-View All and navigate to attachments tab.-Here choose Add option to add new attachments, however it is greyed out.-Cause-Attachments can be added only when required Inbound Delivery is with status Not Released only.-There is no other way to add attachments once an Inbound Delivery is released.-Resolution- This is an expected system behavior.-Keywords-Attachments, Inbound Delivery, Not Released, Released

Title: Error Message "Overlapping validity periods in time data for remote employee"
Content: Symptom-During Employee Replication, system throws below error-Overlapping validity periods in time data for remote employee-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Replicate Employee from SF EC-In ByD, Master Data Replication work center-The employee is failing with above error-Cause-Cause for the issue is that there is an overlap with Time Profile Validity-Resolution-Correct or Remove the line with the overlapping validity and try the replication again-Keywords-overlapping validity, time profile, employee replication

Title: How to Create Separate Number Range for Sales Documents Per Business Residence
Content: Symptom-You would like to create seperate number range for sales documents per business residence.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration - Overview-Select the activity Number Ranges for Sales Orders, Customer Contracts, and Customer Returns -Cause-The number range works at document level and not at business residence level. You are unable to assign to assign different number range-Resolution-As per the system design, you wont be able to assign different number range based on the business residence.-You can post this requirement in SAP Influence Forum.-Keywords-Number Range per company;

Title: Unable to Subscribe Tasks and Email Notification for Web service Message Monitoring
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to receive Tasks and Email Notification for messages in Web service Message Monitoring view but there is no option to enable these feature.-However, the same feature is available for Business Communication Monitoring-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Cause-This feature is not available for Web service Message Monitoring-Resolution-1. Subscribe to Task option is only available for Business Communication Monitoring and not for Web service Message Monitoring.-The BO for Business Communication Monitoring has task types defined but there is no task types defined on the BO for Web service Message Monitoring. Hence, this is New requirement-2. In workflow rule, we have the Workflow rule option to trigger the e-mail notification. The Business Communication and Web service Message objects are not available in the Workflow rule.-This is a new requirement-Please provide your feedback in customer influence forum-Keywords-subscribe to task, workflow rule, email, tasks, Web service Message Monitoring, Business Communication Monitoring

Title: Error Message "Availability Period in employee's resource profile blocks this event"
Content: Symptom-You are unable to change the termination date in the personnel file of the employee. Post changing the termination date when you click on save you get the below error message:-Availability Period in employee's resource profile blocks this event-Information: This can be removed by navigating to the Resource Management work center-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Work center.-Go to view Employees.-Search and open the employee for which change in termination date is intended.-Go to Employment tab and change the termination date.-You will see the error message: Availability Period in employee's resource profile blocks this event-You will see information message: This can be removed by navigating to the Resource Management work center--Cause-A possible cause of the issue is the availability period data maintained for resource type as service agents in the resource profile of the employee. This information is maintained in Resource Management work center.-Resolution-To fix the issue, you need to remove the availability period entry for the service agent as follows:-Go to Resource Management work center-Select on Resource Profile view-Search for relevant employee-Select on Edit button and choose Resource Profile-In section Availability Period for Work Assignment, select the start and end date of the service agent-Select Delete button-Keywords-delete, resource profile, terminate, personnel file, availability

Title: System Crash When Posting Expense Report from Concur with Cost Assignment to Project Tasks
Content: Symptom-An expense report sent from Concur to SAP Business ByDesign results in Error 500 - Internal Server Error when trying to post.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to Expense Reports view.-Select the related expense report in status New.-Click Post.-System crashes.-Cause-There could be a few reasons for the expense report posting to end up in an internal server error (system crash). One of them is ,The expense report contains expenses with cost assignment to project tasks. The referenced project tasks are either already closed or the project validity has ended.-Resolution-Download the expense report JSON file from the Expense Reports view in the General Ledger work center.-Check the project task IDs referenced in the JSON file.-Check the project task status and validity in the Project Management work center under Projects.-Adjust the project tasks to Released status and ensure that the project validity period is active.-Alternatively, raise an incident with SAP Support to mark the expense report as Posting Failed. The expense report can then be called back, and the project references can be changed in Concur to valid project tasks.-Keywords-HTTP 500, Dump, posting failed, project accounting, Concur, application error, Expense Report, project tasks

Title: "Cannot enhance screens; no UIs exist for business object BUSINESS_PARTNER_RELATIONSHIP" Error in SDK
Content: Symptom-You have extended the business object BusinessPartnerRelationship.xbo with extension fields through Cloud Application Studio, however when trying to enhance the screen, you receive the following message:-"Cannot enhance screens; no UIs exist for business object BUSINESS_PARTNER_RELATIONSHIP"-Also, if you try to add these fields in a different screen, you notice that the BusinessPartnerRelationship.xbo is not available to pull the extension fields from. Only BusinessPartner.xbo is available.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Scenario 1:-Open Cloud Application Studio and open the custom solution.-Right click on BusinessPartnerRelationship.xbo -> Enhance Screen.-Here the above mentioned error is raised.-Scenario 2:-Open Cloud Application Studio and open the custom solution.-Open the UI where the extension field is required, and navigate to the section where the field needs to be added.-Click to add an extension field on the screen.-Here you can see that only fields from BusinessPartner.xbo are available. You cannot see fields created in BusinessPartnerRelationship.xbo.-Cause-The Business Partner Relationship business object does not have a specific UI, so it is not possible to enhance this screen with extension fields, although the fields can still be created.-Similarly, it is currently not possible to extend the UIs where Business Partner Relationship information is displayed with the extension fields created.-Resolution-System works as expected.-Keywords-SDK, PDI, BP, KUT

Title: Customer Invoice Total Value does Not Match with Service Order Total Value
Content: Symptom-You find that the total value of the Customer Invoice does not match the total value of the Service Order. You think that the Exchange Rate calculation mismatches from Service Order to Customer Invoice and due to which the Customer Invoice total value is wrong.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing Work Center, open Customer Invoice ABC (where ABC stands for the Invocie Document)-Navigate to Pricing tab, Total is abc (where abc stands for the Total value)-Navigate to General tab, Invoice Date is XYZ (where XYZ stands for the Invoice Date)-The Exchange Rate of Line Item in Customer Invoice ABC is USD/CNY=6.73 (where 6.73 stands for the Exchange Rate)-Go to Service Orders Work Center, Service Order Processing View-Open Service Order DEF (where DEF stands for the Service Order)-Navigate to Pricing tab, Total is def (where def stands for the Total value), Pricing Date is XXX (where XXX stands for the Pricing Date)-The Exchange Rate of Line Item in Service Order DEF is USD/CNY=6.89 (where 6.89 stands for the Exchange Rate)-The Total of Customer Invoice ABC does not match the Total of Service Order DEF-Go to Audit Work Center, Open View Exchange Rates Task-Click View Exchange Rate History button-For the Pricing Date XXX of Service Order DEF, the Exchange Rate is USD/CNY=6.89-For the Invoice Date XYZ of Customer Invoice ABC, the Exchange Rate should be USD/CNY=6.89, but now is 6.73-You think that the Exchange Rate calculation of Customer Invoice is incorrect.-Cause-When invoicing a Service Order, ByD will use the service provision date of the Pricing Date of the item in the Service Confiramtion.-So in this case, some of the items come from Service Confirmation, which has a prevision date different from Invoicing Date. As such this is you are seeing the different value for the Customer Invoice.-Resolution-Open Service Confirmation GHI (where GHI stands for the Service Confirmation)-Navigate to Pricing tab, Pricing Date is ghi (where ghi stands for the Pricing Date)-For the Pricing Date ghi of Service Confirmation GHI, the Exchange Rate is USD/CNY=6.73-The system is correct.-Keywords-Exchange Rate, Invoicing Date, Pricing Date, Customer Invoice, Service Order, Service Confirmation

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Realizes Total invoice Amount of Customer Contract Item Before Its End Date
Content: Symptom-You create a fix-price customer contract item and assign a straight-line accrual method to have its total net value/ invoiced revenue realized evenly during its life time. -The customer contract item has been fully invoiced and the end date is reached. -You execute the revenue recognition run in a period before the item's end date and notice that the run realized the total net value already. -No further revenue is realized in the next accounting periods of the item's life time. -Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Select Customer Contract items and find item ABC-XX (ABC-XX represents the customer contract item ID). valid from 01.03.YYYY to 31.12.YYYY. for example. -Go to the Dates tab and verify that the item's End Date has been reached, for example 31.12.YYYY, and that the Final Delivery and Invoice Date is set (for example 01.09.YYYY, the latest business transaction date associated with the contract item, usually the posting date of the latests customer invoice). -Navigate to the Accounting Data tab. -In the Revenues per period table you notice that the revenue is realized evenly in the period's of the contract's life time. -But in one period, for example period 010.YYYY, the complete invoiced amount is realised for the item. All deferrals or accruals are cleared. -You check the revenue recognition application log and notice that the Total Earned Revenue amount equals the total net value/ invoice amount of item ABC-XX. -When executing the run for the remaining accounting periods, such as 011.YYYY and 012.YYYY no further revenue is realized. -Cause-Since the last revenue recognition run, the status of contract item ABC-XX got completed: This happens when the fulfillment status of a contract item is set to finished, either manually, for example after cancelling the item or automatically, when the item's end date is reached.-For the Financials application SAP Business ByDesign derives a Final Delivery and Invoice Date (Check the Dates tab as above). This date is derived from the most recent business transaction on the item, here 01.09.YYYY, the posting date of the latest customer invoice).-Once a contract item gets completed (fully delivered, fully invoiced, end date reached) the revenue recognition run realizes its full net book value in the chosen period, even if this period is before the period of its end date.-Example:-Contract Item ABC-XX-Start date: 01.03.YYYY-End Date: 31.12.YYYY-Invoice Date: 01.09.YYYY. -After the end date, 31.12.YYYY is reached, the item's status changes to Completed (or you manually finished the fulfilment status of the item). -You execute the revenue recognition run in a period before the end date, for example 011.YYYY.-The run realizes the full item net book value/invoiced amount. -Resolution-This is the designed system behavior: Once a contract item is completed in Financials it is no longer relevant for revenue recognition. The next revenue recognition run, provided its posting date is on or after the contract item's final delivery or invoice date,  will clear all deferrals and accruals and realize the full invoiced net value of the item.-To prevent this situation-ensure that the revenue recognition run is executed in each accounting period in subsequent order.-If you finish the fulfillment manually, verify first that the due revenue was correctly realized in all the periods of the contract item's life time.-avoid executing the revenue recognition run retrospectively.-Keywords-contract item, realized revenue wrong, total revenue realized in wrong period

Title: Error Appears While Trying to Approve the Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-As an approver, you are trying to approve the purchase order and got an error message.-Error: Contract not available as source of supply-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login as an Approver-Go to Managing My Area work center-Go to Approvals view-Select the relevant purchase order -Click on Approve button and error appears-Cause-The purchase order was already approved and sent. However you have added a new purchase order line item which is assigned to source of supply Purchase Contract. The contract is not available because the status of the Contract is Closed. And all the line item status is set to Inactive for Sourcing and hence the error appears.-Resolution-All the items in the purchase order is linked to closed contract, you will face an error while creating follow up documents. Since the purchase order is in In Approval status, you can Reject it, so that entire purchase order status will be set to Rejected. Later you can create a new purchase order and use cctive contract as a source of supply.-Keywords-Contract not available as source of supply; Cannot approve purchase order due to error;Contrat non disponible en tant que source d’approvisionnement

Title: Custom Form Template is Not Picked While Previewing Customer Invoice
Content: Symptom-A Custom Form Template of Customer Invoice was set up, but the form is not picked correctly while previewing Customer Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Application and User Management work center.-Go to Form Template Maintenance view.-Search for Form Template "Customer Invoice (Japanese)" and open it.-You will see the form is picking a Standard Form.-Or-Navigate to Customer Invoice work center.-Open Invoice-XXXX and Preview it.-You will see the Invoice is displayed in Standard Form.-Cause-The appropriate template variant is picked up by output management based on Country Code and Language Code.-Method to check Language Code:-Navigate to Customer Invoicing work center.-Find the relevant Account in Customer Invoice and open it.-View All.-Go to General Tab.-You will find Language Code under Main Communication Tab.-If the Language Code is not maintained, default language is picked, which is English and hence corresponding template is picked.-Resolution-Navigate to Customer Invoicing work center.-Find the relevant Account in Customer Invoice and open it.-View All.-Go to General Tab.-Maintain Language Code under Main Communication Tab.-See Also-For more information about how system picks form for customer invoices, please refer to KBA 2591499.-Keywords-Custom Form Template, Standard Form, Custom Invoice Form Template, Language Code

Title: Agent Status in RPA Factory Remains in 'idle'
Content: Symptom-The User had setup the desktop Agent, Triggers and Agents. Upon execution, the automation got triggered but the status of the Job remains in status "Ready"-And the agent status remains in status 'idle'-User tried to--- Restart the connection--- removed and added the tenant in the desktop agent--- Checked whether a project is assigne but there is tenant where bot runs without a project-But still the issue persists-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-It is always recommended to keep the Desktop Agent, SDK dependencies and Bot up to date.-In case if one of it is not up to date then there could be issues with bot execution-Refer to the blog - Keeping robotic process automation environment up to date-See Also-3300739 - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) on Build Process Automation (BPA) for SAP Business ByDesign-Keywords- idle, desktop agent, sdk, bot, upto date

Title: Resource Calendar Report Shows Deviation in the Data Source HCMRPMU05
Content: Symptom-Data is not restricted to 90 days for Data source HCMRPMU05 in the tenant-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Data sources-Search for 'HCMRPMU05'-Go to Preview-Click on 'View' and click on Row fields '+'-Select ' Calendar Month' and 'Employee'-You can view the newly set first-earliest date.-Cause-The main cause of the issue is that the older Resource Calendar was scoped in the tenant.-Resolution-You need to have the new Resource Calendar scoped in.-As per the system design, the report related to the data source HCMRPMU05 displays only last 3 months data.-Please go to KBA 3225785, where you may find SAP help links for both RPM solutions, to determine precisely which "new solution" or "new resource calendar" is not scoped in.-See Also-3225785 - Frequently Asked Questions on ByD Resource Management (RPM)-Keywords-Data source, Calendar Month, Employee, RPM solutions, Resource Calendar-data source, calendar month, employee, r

Title: Direct Debit Rejection Run
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You want to set up an end-to-end Direct Debit process in ByD for Australia using specific workcentre SubView - Direct Debit Rejection Runs, but unable to find one.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Payment Management work center.-Select Periodic Tasks.-Direct Debit Rejection Runs.-Resolution-This functionality is specific to Country - Switzerland and will only work with the Payment Media Format : CH LSV + Direct Debit - 22.-See Also-Quick Guide for Direct Debit Rejection Runs - Switzerland-Keywords-Direct Debit Rejection Runs, Switzerland

Title: Scrapping on Project Not Possible as System Displays The Error Message "Account Assignment of Type Project is Not Allowed"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to scrap a Material which you have not used in a Production Process per requirement on a Project Task. However, when you try to scrap same by selecting the Account Assignment Type "PRO - Project Task", the system displays the error message "Account Assignment of Type Project is Not Allowed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the internal logistics work center. -Go to Common Tasks and select Scrapping.-Enter the relevant Site ID, Cost center ID, and Product ID.-Click Next.-Select a row of the Product and enter the Scrapped Quantity-Go to the Account Assignment sub-tab.-Change the Account Assignment Type to PRO - Project Task and select any Project/Project Task via the Value selector.-The system returns the mentioned error message. -Cause-Scrapping with regard to Project Task is not valid and this is the standard behaviour. The Account Assignment Type is a generic dropdown and Stock cannot be scrapped to project it has to be consumed to Project.-Resolution-No further analysis required and no code changes required for the same.

Title: Zero withholding tax amount during Supplier Invoice Creation
Content: Symptom-You try to create a Supplier Invoice XYZ(XYZ Refers to supplier invoice) and under withholding tax, zero tax amount is observed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Search for Invoice XYZ and open it-In the View All navigate to Items tab-Select Taxes sub-tab-Select Withholding Tax Details tab. Here tax amount will be 0-Cause-Issue is due to Rounding value maintained for the currency. E.g. When the Tax Base amount is 20 and tax rate is 2%, mathematically tax amount will be 0.04. However, due to rounding value '1', system rounds off 0.04 to 0.-Resolution-You can navigate to Activity 'Currencies' under business configuration and change the Rounding value from 1 to e.g. 0.01 based on the requirement.-Keywords-Currencies, Rounding Value, Supplier Invoice, Withholding tax

Title: Save failed: Your entries could not be saved due to errors
Content: Symptom-When you try to record time for a Service Agent and upon saving, system throws below error-Save failed: Your entries could not be saved due to errors-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Partners work center.-Select the Service Agent view.-Search for the Service Agent ID.-Open the Edit time sheet.-Choose Add row.-Add the activity enter the hour and the work description.-Click on Save.-Cause-Service Agent can only record time on project task. Here, no project task assigned to the service agent-Resolution-Go to Project Management work center and create a project task which you can assign to the Service agent.-Once done, you should be able to record time on that project.-Keywords-service agent, time recording, edit time sheet, project, project task

Title: System Allows the User to Enter Greater Quantity in Goods and Service Receipts Documents
Content: Symptom-You are creating goods and service receipts for more quantities than the ordered quantity. System shows the warning message and allowed the user to enter greater quantity than the ordered quantity-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Goods and Service Receipts work center-Go to Receipts and Return view-Select Show by Documents-Select the relevant Purchase Order and select New Goods and Service Receipts button-Enter a value more than Ordered Quantity-System allows the user and warning message appears-Cause-When the delivered quantity is exceeded in the goods receipt document, system shows a warning message.-Warning - Item 1: Ordered quantity of purchase order item exceeded-Delivered Quantity specifies the quantity that is confirmed for an item in a goods and services receipt. By default, the Delivered Quantity field in the goods and services receipt is prefilled with the Ordered Quantity of the corresponding purchase order and can be updated by the user. If the user enters a Delivered Quantity, which is greater than the Ordered Quantity, then you can set up approval process for goods and services receipt before it can be released. This is an expected behavior-Resolution-System will allow the user to enter greater quantities in goods receipt document and it will throw a warning message. In case, if you still expects an error message, you can approach partner development team and ask them to create PDI add on to raise an error message instead of warning.-Keywords-Ordered quantity of purchase order item exceeded

Title: Billing Party Shows Not Assigned in Report Aging List For Receivables
Content: Symptom-Billing Party Shows Not Assigned in Report Aging List for Receivables.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics Work center.-Go to the Design Reports View.-Show All Reports and Find Report Aging List for Receivables.-Select Company,Customer,Cut off Date.-You add External Reference and Billing Party in the Row fields.You could see that Billing Party shows as "Not Assigned".-Cause-The Invoice is being Split and when the Invoice is being Split the Billing Party shows as Not Assigned.-Resolution-The Report Aging List for Receivables is working as designed/coded in this scenario that when Invoice is Split the Billing Party shows as Not Assigned.-You can try to use Report Details for All Items - Customers to see if suffice your needs-Keywords-Aging List for Receivables,Billing Party

Title: Unable to Find Template to Upload Commodity Catalog in the Intrastat Work Center
Content: Symptom-You want to create and upload the commodity catalog in the Intrastat work center, however you do not find the template to upload.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Intrastat work center-Go to Commodity Classifications view and select Commodity Catalogs sub view-Cannot find upload file for catalog-Cause-In the Commodity Catalogs view, you can either upload a commodity catalog from a catalog file or create a new commodity catalog manually. Once a catalog has been created and activated, it can be used to classify materials by selecting codes and assigning them to the corresponding materials.-It is only possible to upload catalogs from SAP partners. The system only supports the upload of .xml and .zip files. If a catalog to be uploaded exceeds 10 MB, then it must be uploaded as a .zip file. The system will then unzip the file automatically.-Resolution-I have attached the sample XML file for commodity catalog and blog also contains the sample file. Please get in touch with your partner to upload commodity catalog.-You can refer to the blog: SAP Business ByDesign: Sample Commodity Catalog File to Upload-https://blogs.sap.com/2018/06/18/sap-business-bydesign-sample-commodity-catalog-file-to-upload/-Detailed steps to create a commodity catalog;-In the Commodity Classification view, choose the Commodity Catalogs sub view.-To open the Upload Commodity Catalog screen, click Upload Commodity Catalog.-Enter a unique catalog ID and catalog name.-To search for the catalog file on your computer to upload, click Select File.-Once you have selected a catalog file, click OK and then click Upload. When you start the upload, the system executes the upload in the background, so that you can perform other tasks in the meantime. The system will upload the catalog and return you to the Commodity Catalogs sub view. The system adds the catalog to your work list and sets the catalog file upload status to In Process. You can find the catalog in the work list by selecting either All Catalogs or Inactive Catalogs in the Show field.-When the upload is complete, you can edit the catalog to activate it. Once the uploaded catalog has the Successful upload status, you can select the catalog from the catalogs list. To open the catalog editor to check and activate the catalog, click Edit.-To activate this catalog, click Activate. -Keywords-Upload Commodity Catalog; Template to upload Commodity Catalog; Commodity Catalog in the Intrastat Work Center

Title: Search Function is not Working in Invoice Scanning View
Content: Symptom-Unable to search supplier invoices based on supplier ID or Supplier Name in the Invoice scanning view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Go to Invoice Scanning view-Search the Supplier Invoice based on Supplier ID or Name-No records found-Cause-In the Invoice Scanning view under header search, if user search with Supplier ID or Name, system does not show any invoices. This is the current system behaviour of ByDesign.-Resolution-The extended filter allows for more refined searches based on different parameters such as Supplier, External Document ID, Invoice ID etc. Since this is a new enhancement, you can post the requirement in Customer Influence forum - https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-search supplier invoices based on supplier ID or Supplier Name; Invoice Scanning view; Search Supplier; Suche in Scannen

Title: Unable to Open New Fiscal Year Due to Error Entry Possible Until Missing; Save Failed
Content: Symptom-You are unable to open a new fiscal period due to the error-Entry Possible Until Missing-Save failed.-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to General Ledger work center.-Select Open and Close Periods-Select a period and open the period-Entry possible until missing-Save failed.-Cause-Go to General Ledger work center.-Companies view.-Select Company XYZ.-Select Actions -> Set Addtional Entry Days.-If this date is set to some indefinite number(e.g. 9.999.999) then it causes the issue.-Example: The automatically generated entries in process control allow for 15 additional entry days after the last posting date. So, when you open a new fiscal year, the process control will automtically get created for this year and the entry possible until date is (usually) 15 days after the last posting date in the accounting period.-Resolution-You need to maintain a new entry for the Set Addtional Entry Days and change it to default 15 days or any other number of days which you expect to allow the posting after the end date of a closed period. Once its done, period can be opened-Keywords-Open and Close period

Title: Actions button not visible in Supplier invoice OWL screen
Content: Symptom-You cannot see the Actions button at all-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently system is using the classic OWL.-Resolution-New SADL setting has to be scoped in Business Configuration.-Go to Business configuration work center-Go to Implementation projects-Click on edit scoping-Go to step questions-Expand System Management element-Select User Inteface List Mode-Check mark the question related to SADL-Finish the scoping-Keywords- how to enable SADL

Title: Ship-To and Bill-To Address Appears in Caps When you Preview US Customer Invoice Documents
Content: Symptom-You are trying to Preview the Customer Invoice and noticed that the Ship-To and Bill-To address appears in caps (capital letters) for US Customer Invoice documents.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Documents view.-Select All documents in the drop down list.-Select the relevant Invoice Document.-Click on the Preview button.-You can see that the Ship-To and Bill-To location appears in caps.-Cause-As per the postal regulations, it is necessary to maintain the postal address in caps only. You can check the website universal postal union for US, it is clearly mentioned that, on outward international items, the name of the country of destination must always be printed in capital letters. Hence it is mandate to have the postal address in caps only.-Resolution-It is expected to have caps for ship to and bill to address in customer invoice documents for US as per the postal regulations for outward international items.-See Also-KBA 2736539 - Ship-To and Bill-To Address Appears in Caps When you Preview US Purchase Order Forms-Keywords-Ship-To and Bill-To address appears in caps, customer invoicing, preview document; capital letters

Title: 100% Gross Margin in 'Gross Profit Margin' Design KPI
Content: Symptom-You observe the Gross Margin as 100% in 'Gross Profit Margin' Design KPI eventhough the actual value is lesser than 100% depending on the Gross margin formula = Gross Profit / Net Sales Revenue-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Business analytics work center-Design KPI view-Gross Profit Margin KPI-Preview it and with default values, you see 100% Gross Margin for all Product Categories/product-Cause-Earned Profit Analysis requires some prerequisite configurations like Edit Contribution Margin Scheme which is not configured in customer's system.-Resolution-Once the Configuration is maintained, then you observe the correct Gross Margin. More details on this can be found in below help document.-https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_BUSINESS_BYDESIGN/7c182c462ec043cba338a30b952068c7/2d0a517c722d10148e9ed65c9171d2d4.html-Keywords-Gross Margin, Profitability Analysis, Edit Contribution Margin Scheme

Title: Error in Purchase Order "Error during currency conversion from US Dollar into Euro for at DD.MM.YYYY"
Content: Symptom-Unable to order purchase order due to an error.-Error:-Exchange Rate for EUR and USD for Rate Type 001 does not exist for DD.MM.YYYY-Error during currency conversion from US Dollar into Euro for at DD.MM.YYYY-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant purchase order-Select Edit and click on Check butto-Error appears-Cause-In General Ledger work center under Edit Exchange Rates, you have not maintained the exchange rates between EUR to USD currency or vice versa. Hence the error appears.-Resolution-Kindly maintain the exchange rates between EUR and USD for Rate Type 001 for date DD.MM.YYYY and exchange rate between US Dollar and Euro for date DD.MM.YYYY Then you should be able to order the purchase order document.-Keywords-Exchange Rate for EUR and USD for Rate Type 001 does not exist; Error during currency conversion from US Dollar into Euro

Title: Change or Delete duplicate rows with key 'XYZ' in 'Tax Event External Determination' failed
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY *** -You are trying to add a new row with Configuration ID under External Tax Determination for Goods and Services activity and below error occurs.-Change or Delete duplicate rows with key 'XYZ' in 'Tax Event External Determination'.-Save Failed.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Overview view.-Search with Activity External Tax Determination for Goods and Services and open it.-Click on Add Row button.-Enter Configuration ID XYZ(XYZ refers to configuration ID which customer mentions) and other relevant data.-Hit save button and error occurs.-Cause-The entry you are trying to insert is already present in backend system, however it is not visible in UI due to FSI issue.-Hence, duplicate error is thrown.-Resolution-FSI Reload is required to solve the case and below are the steps.-Open SFTK(backend) via CAM tool.-Enter necessary Credentials and open T-Code GFSSTM.-BO to be entered: GLO_TAX_EVENT_EXT_DET.-Expand the FSI view and check box for both nodes needs to be checked. Before performing the load you can see that the number column has 0 entries for both nodes. That is why in UI there are no entries coming up.-Click on Persistence button under Load section.-Click Yes on the pop up window that appears.-After the action is performed, click on Refresh button under section Action.-Now check again the column Number to see if there are some entries now.-After performing the above steps, in the UI check activity 'External Tax Determination for Goods and Services' and you should see entries now in this activity.-See Also-2655378 - How To Use the Backend Transaction GFSSTM-Keywords-FSI Reload, Duplicate records, Tax, External tax event

Title: Error Message When Migrating Material Valuation Data: 'Combination of Company, SOB, Validity, Price type invalid'
Content: Symptom-You are migrating material valuation data via migration tool, however, in the simulate step, the system returns an error that the combination of company, set of books, validity and price type is not valid for a given material.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Open activity list.-Open activity Migrate material valuation data using the migration tool-Execute migration step by step for your uploaded template. -In the Simulate step, the following error is raised: Combination of Company <company name and ID>, SOB <ID>, Validity, Price type <price type e.g. Inventory Cost> invalid.-Cause-If two materials with same company/SOB are coming in and each have a different validity date maintained, the system does not consider the material itself at all. Hence the error is raised.-Resolution-You need to create separate migration files based on the validity period of the costs being uploaded, so that in one file there are only material costs with the same validity (Valid From and Valid To).-Our developers are looking into this behavior to further enhance the system.-Keywords-Material Valuation. Inventory Cost. Migration Tool.

Title: Balance of Balance Sheet Opening Account shows as 0.00 after Balance Carryforward Step 1
Content: Symptom-You performed the Balance Carryforward Step 1 (Carry forward accounts) for a fiscal year e.g. 2021.-This generates postings to Balance Sheet Opening Account XYZ <> 0.00 MU (Monetary Unit) as of 01.01.2022.-In the General Ledger Accounts View, however, you observe that Account Balance shows as 0.00 MU.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Open the General Ledger Accounts view.-Fill in required parameters for Company ID and Set of Books ID.-Select the Balance Sheet Opening Account XYZ and Period 001, Fiscal Year 2022.-Resolution-Carryforward Step 1 (Carry forward accounts) transfers balance sheet account balances to the Balance Sheet Closing Account as per 31.12.2021.-Equally those balance are transferred back from the Balance Sheet Opening Account as per 01.01.2022.-Typically you would expect a balance according to the movement of balance sheet accounts in fiscal year 2021/2022 on these accounts for respective posting periods.-The balance for the Balance Sheet Opening Account as shown in the view General Ledger - General Ledger Accounts anticipates and simulates the execution of Carryforward Step 2 (Calculate and carry forward profit/loss).-Carryforward Step 2 would transfer the balance of Balance Sheet Opening Account to the Annual Net Income/Net Loss - Account. Therefore leaving it with an ending balance of 0.00 MU as of 01.01.2022.-Balance 0.00 MU already shows in General Ledger Accounts view even before Carryforward Step 2 is performed. This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-G/L Account Balance, Balance Carryforward, Balance Sheet Opennig Account

Title: Error: No key attribute for BCO-node found While creating BCO for Tax Deductibility
Content: Symptom-You are working on a tax content extension via PDI Solution in Cloud Application Studio.-For specific purchasing tax codes you want to define their deductibility.-When defining a Business Configuration Object for Tax Deductibility an error shows as "No key attribute for BCO-node found".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Log into Cloud Application Studio-Specify the Solution YXYZ_-Add new BCO-Use SAP Business Configuration Object-Select: Business Configuration Object Name: TaxDeductibility-Error: No key attribute for BCO-node found-Cause-Tax deductibility can not be created via Cloud Application Studio and has to be created directly in the application via Business Configuration.-Resolution-The purchase tax code is to be created via Fine Tuning Activity: Tax on Goods and Services.-Respective Tax Deductibility can be specified in Fine Tuning Activity: Tax Settings for Purchasing.-The same is illustrated in the Localization: Toolkit "Create Tax Content for Non- Localized Countries in SAP Cloud Application Studio" under section 5.5 Configure Tax Codes, sub section 6.-"For tax codes created for purchasing, you must specify if the tax amount is fully deductible, not deductible and so on. Tax deductibility codes cannot be currently configured through PDI, they have to be configured in the fine-tuning activity Tax Settings and Purchasing. The tax codes for purchasing must be configured in fine tuning activity, Tax on Goods and Services -> Define Tax Codes to assign the deductibility codes defined."

Title: Unable to see/upload Correct Certificate in Communication Arrangement for Selected Communication Method
Content: Symptom-Symptom 1:-While creating or editing communication arrangements, you do not see the correct certificate assigned to the user corresponding to the "Communication Method" selected. The Edit Credentials screen only displays one certificate constantly regardless of the communication method you selected, as shown in following screenshot:-Symptom 2:-You wants to upload a user's authentication certificate for a specific communication method you selected or you wants to maintain multiple certificates for the same user using the Edit Credentials screen. But it is not possible because of issue (Symptom 1).-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Steps for Symptom A:-Go to Application and User Management work center-Go to Communication Arrangement view-New or Existing Communication Arragement-Go to Define Technical Data step-Select a Communcation Method-Now, Select Edit Credentials button besides User ID-Then Certificate sub tab, where you will find the certificate details-Now, select another Communication Method and Edit Credentials-You will find the same certificate details as in step 7-Cause-The Edit Credentials screen displaying only one certificate of the user. If there are multiple certificates assigned to the user, it displays the first instance it finds. It was not designed to distinguish certificates based on the communication method you selected.-Resolution-You may consider one of the below workaround-A) Get the list of certificates assigned to a user-To see the list of assigned certificates of a user, you can go to Application and User Management → Communication Certificates. This list is the source of truth of the certificates assigned to the user for certificate based authentication.-B) Uploading new certificates for a user-Use of "Upload Certificate" button in the Edit Credentials screen is not recommended for such communication methods, as this action cannot be used to upload more than one certificates for the same user. Using the "Upload Certificate" button without removing the existing certificate will overwrite the existing certificate with the new certificate. This action can be used to maintain only one certificate for a user.-The "Remove Certificate" button will remove all the assigned certificates from the user, including the ones not listed in the Edit Credentials UI. Therefore, please be careful on using this action.-For such communication scenarios, it is handled within SAP Business ByDesign to deliver the certificates to the user during release/hotfix upgrade cycles and on adhoc basis as necessary when the certificates are updated.-For exceptional cases, which is not covered by the above point, where you need to assign more than one certificates to a user, please reach out to the SAP support. They would forward the request to the team owning the communication scenario who would handle your request.-Keywords-certificate, communication method, user, user id, certificate, correct certificate, internal error

Title: Net Value Currency in Shopping Cart Does not Change
Content: Symptom-Net value currency does not change if the price per unit currency is changed in shopping cart.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Project Management work center-Go to Common Tasks view-Select Go Shopping (Advanced) and select the relevant Employee-Enter the Product details-Enter Price details (In any currency different from Net value currency)-You can see that Net value currency does not change-Cause-In the Shopping cart, the currency value is determined by the default currency of the company. You want to create shopping carts for multiple companies with different currencies, then system will calculate the net value in company currency only provided corresponding exchange rates are maintained.-Resolution-In Shopping cart system always shows the currency of the buying company in the net value field. If you have multiple countries/companies, then you must ask the specific user to create shopping cart and based on his/her company, system will default the currency. This is an expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Shopping cart, change in currency; Net value currency; currency in shopping cart;

Title: DFV error: Corresponding attachment folder in customer requirement not found
Content: Symptom-You find Data Flow Verification Result is Open in the system with error:-Corresponding attachment folder in customer requirement not found.-Environment-SAP Business ByDeisgn-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management.-Go to the Data Flow Verification Results view.-Select the Data Flow Verification Result, You can see the Description of the result: Corresponding attachment folder in customer requirement not found.-Open the Application Log, in Results tab, you can see the affected service order ID and the message: Attachment Folder (Category Document, Type Pro Forma Invoice).-Cause-There is a difference in the attachments in the Service Order and corresponding Customer Demand.-In the service order, the Pro Forma Invoice is attached. This Pro Forma Invoice is not relevant for the Customer Demand, and is therefore not sent to the Customer Demand.-This is the reason for the difference shown in the Data Flow Verification Results.-Resolution-The attachment is not required in customer demand, you can close these DFV.-Keywords-DFV; Data Flow Verification Result;Corresponding attachment folder in customer requirement not found;Attachment Folder (Category Document, Type Pro Forma Invoice).

Title: Unable to Find the Field "Account Type" in the Front end of the System.
Content: Symptom-The Account Type field is not visible under an employee's Payment Details in the employee master data.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Personnel Administration work center.-Select the Employees view.-Select affected Employee and click on edit.-Go to Personal Data Tab.-Click on Payment Information.-Observe that the field 'Account Type' is not available.-Cause-The Account Type field is designed to be country-specific and is implemented only for employees whose country/region is United States (US), Germany (DE), or France (FR).-Resolution-This is the expected system behavior.-The Account Type field is supported only for United States (US), Germany (DE), and France (FR). Since the field is not part of the configuration for other countries, it is not available in the employee's Payment Details.-Keywords-Account Type, Payment information, employee data, countries, Personnel Administration work center, Employee, SAP Business ByDesign.

Title: Extractors are not executed in SAP Solution Manager System
Content: Symptom-Most of the extractors are active but grey or they are not executed for a long time in the Extractor Framework, even though step "Extractor Setup" is well performed.----Job 'EFWK Resource Manager' finishes successfully. However, its spool log states message: A previous RM is still running - this instance will not be started.--Environment-SAP Solution Manager 7.1-SAP Solution Manager 7.2-Reproducing the Issue-transaction SM_WORKCENTER-Solution Manager Administration-'Extractors Administration' or 'Extractors Alerting Administration'-Cause-The message "A previous RM is still running - this instance will not be started" may sometimes only indicate that another job is running. However, if the long-running job was triggered several days ago, or it has already been too old to be seen in SM37, then it means the job didn't finish well and the lock was not deleted.-Resolution-Please check the lock entry and job EFWM Resource Manager by the following steps:-Run transaction SM12, input the User Name as 'SM_EFWK' and the client number to get the lock entry.-According to the lock's date, try to find out the long-running job 'EWFK Resouce Manager' in transaction SM37.-If the job is found, please judge whether it can finish or not.-If not, or the locked job is too old to be found in SM37, please delete it in SM12.-Keywords-DPC PUSH, DPC PULL, SM_EFWK

Title: Error Message "No emails found matching the filter criteria: Outlook Account details missing in the Config file"
Content: Symptom-When you execute the bot Business Document Extraction from the E-Mail (1x1), it fails with below error in the log file-No emails found matching the filter criteria: Outlook Account details missing in the Config file-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Some of the causes are as follows,-There is no email subject matching the search criteria-Mandatory fields such as "Recipient Search Criteria" and "Subject Search Criteria" are kept blank-Modification or wrong Config file-In Config file, you marked yes for unread emails only but there is no unread emails-Resolution-In order to avoid this issues,-Ensure to maintain all the search criteria/operator fields in config file.-Config file should be up to date and should not be altered.
