Title: Third party system provider requests a password to enable communication with SAP Business Bydesign
Content: Symptom-During the setup of a communication arrangement, authentication method SSL Client Certificate with SAP Business ByDesign system key pair is selected. In such a case, a private key of the key pair is stored in the communication arrangement. Public key has to be extracted by click on button Download. This public key has to be implemented in the third party system for encrypting and accepting the XML messages.-But in some cases, the third party system provider also requests the password. It is not clear why this happens and whether this is justified or not. Making the provider aware of the password might also raise some concerns regarding data protection.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-In inbound communication, ByDesign will be the target system and the third party system will be the source. For SSL certificate based authentication of the communication user, the user in the source (third party system) needs to have the key pair, and the corresponding user in target (ByDesign) only needs to have the public key of the key pair. Since the key pair (.p12 file) is needed at third party system, the third party system provider needs its password to be able to access the private key. In ByDesign, the certificate (which contains the public key of the key pair) is automatically assigned to the communication user when the key pair is downloaded from the UI.-Resolution-In the Edit Communication Arrangement UI, the SSL Client Certificate you are assigning to the user must be from a key pair downloaded by clicking Create and Download Key Pair action on the Edit Credentials dialog. It is not the SAP Business ByDesign System Key Pair, which is actually the tenant certificate itself.-The explanation is shown in the Edit Credentials modal dialog: "You can upload a public key certificate that has been provided by your communication partner. If your communication partner cannot provide a certificate, you can create and download a PKCS#12 key pair file. The PKCS#12 file is password encrypted and contains a public key certificate and a private key. You need to provide the PKCS#12 file to your communication partner."-In short, giving the downloaded .p12 key pair along with its password to the communication partner is how the key pair for the communication will work.-Looking at another angle, instead of downloading the key pair from ByDesign and giving it to third party system, it is also possible to let third party system obtain a key pair from a certificate authority and give the certificate (public key) to ByDesign. Likewise, third party system by default will have the password to the key pair.-Keywords-external, partner, encryption, p12, SSL certificate based authentication

Title: Error Message: Enter account determination group for supplier ABC, company 123
Content: Symptom-You create the Purchase Order DEF and the Goods and Service Receipt GHI as the follow-up document for DEF (DEF represents the Purchase Order ID, GHI reprensents the Goods and Service Receipt ID).-The Goods and Service Receipt GHI cannot be posted in accounting because of the following error: Error: Cannot process Goods and Services Receipt GHI because Purchase Order DEF not yet posted in accounting. As Goods and Services Receipt GHI contains a reference to Purchase Order DEF but Purchase Order DEF has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Goods and Services Receipt GHI. Check why Purchase Order DEF has not been posted.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show All Unposted Source documents.-Find GHI.-You can see the detailed error here.-Cause-The Source Document for the Purchase Order DEF is still In Process with the error Enter account determination group for supplier ABC, company 123. (ABC represents the Supplier ID and 123 represents the Company ID.)-You can check this by following these steps:-Go to the General Ledger work center.-Go to the Source Documents view.-Show All Source documents.-Find DEF.-You can see the status of the Source Document for the Purchase Order DEF is still In Process with the error Enter account determination group for supplier ABC, company 123.-The error is triggered because in financial forecasting the system tries to determine the G/L account through the account determination group maintained for the supplier but it is not found.-Resolution-You have two options to correct this issue :-If not required, you can switch off the Financial Forecast for procurement in scoping questions of the Implementation Project.-For this, you can follow these steps:-Go to the Business Configuration work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view.-Select your implementation project.-Click Edit Project Scope.-Click Next until you reach Questions.-Under Financial and Management Accounting, expand Management Accounting then Financial Planning.-Uncheck the box.-Click Next.-Finish the project.-Or,-Maintain Financial Data for the company 123 in the Supplier ABC's Master Data under the Financial Data tab and Payment Data subtab.-Go to the Supplier Base work center.-Go to the Suppliers view.-Show All Suppliers.-Find ABC.-Select Edit - Financial Data.-Click Add row.-Enter data for company 123.-Save and Close.-Once you have selected one solution, you should post the source document for the Purchase Order DEF in the General Ledger work center and Source Documents view.-Keywords-Enter account determination group for supplier, company, Error: Cannot process Goods and Services Receipt because Purchase Order not yet posted in accounting. As Goods and Services Receipt contains a reference to Purchase Order but Purchase Order has not been posted in accounting, it is impossible to process Goods and Services Receipt. Check why Purchase Order has not been posted, purchase order, goods and service receipt, unposted source document

Title: Identified stock not permitted for material XYZ (XYZ stands for the Material ID) - INTERNAL USE ONLY
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-You have completed a Project Stock Order, but when you go to its Document Flow, you can see the document has Process Communication Error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Go to the Customer Demand view. -Find and select the relevant Project Stock Order.-Click Edit.-Go to the Document Flow tab.-You can see the Project Stock Order is in Process Communication Error.-If you click the error icon, you can see similar error as below:-- Project Stock Order 123 cannot create a Goods and Activity Confirmation (123 stands for the Project Stock Order ID). -Logon to the SAP back-end.-You can see stuck message from ProjectProcessing to InventoryProcessingInventoryChangingIn with the error info: Identified stock not permitted for material XYZ.-Cause-The error "Identified stock not permitted for material XYZ" is being displayed, because the customer confirmed the Goods Issue with Identified Stock, but have now removed the value for the  Identified Stock Type in the Material Master for the particular Product.-Resolution-Send the incident back to customer and ask them to maintain the exact Identified Stock Type in the Material Master which was maintained at the time of the Goods Issue confirmation. They can check the Changes tab of the Material Master to see which Identified Stock Type was previously maintained. Support can also provide this information to them to avoid ping pong.-Once the customer have reverted to the old Identified Stock Type value in Material Master, Support can then restart the stuck message to resolve the issue.-Keywords-Identified Stock Type, Project Stock Order, Process Communication Error

Title: Documentation for Reports and Data Sources is Not Opening
Content: Symptom-You are trying to open the documentation for reports and data sources.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Business Analytics Work Center-2. Go to Design Reports/Design Data Sources view-3. Click the documentation icon, (via magnifying glass icon) for any report or data source-4. The documentation does not open, a blank screen is displayed-Cause-We are currently having an issue with the documentation feature. Development are aware and are currently working on a fix.-Resolution-Note: The functionality will be available in a future release / hotfix collection, approximately January 19th 2023.-In the meantime, please contact support for business critical requirements only, with the names of the data sources and/or field names for which we can help with.-See Also-2850666 - SAP Cloud for Customer: Complete Data Source Documentation-1830749 - Complete Data Sources and Characteristics Documentation-Keywords-Documentation; Documentation Not Opening; Blank Screen; Documentation Issue.

Title: Error Message "You must select a statistical account with the allocation Payout All"
Content: Symptom-You are trying to add a new premium pay for employees (ex: who are available on call on public holidays), with the following compensation:-1) Pay a fixed amount of money per day, and-2) Increase of days off time account (quota), XY per day available.-Save throws an error "You must select a statistical account with the allocation Payout All".-Note: Even if you mark a different option like Bank All or Bank Premium, Payout Base the error persists.-Please note: Above symptom is an example but this error could happen with in general with new premium pay creation.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Overview view-Search for Premium Pay - <Country> and Open-Select Maintain Premium Pay Type-Add row of premium pay-Percentage set (e.g 200), select Allocation as Payout All-Select Time Account as Overtime (paid) which category is Statistical Account-Save-You will see the error "You must select a statistical account with the allocation Payout All"-Note: Account Type used in step 7 is an example-Cause-The new Premium pay or one one of the existing premium pay has Quota account-Resolution-Expected behavior: "Premium pay with allocation "Payout All" should have category as "statistical account".-For a premium pay with has statistical account, perform either of the following actions:-I) Change the allocation from Payout All to other suitable allocation and save-II) Or remove the Assigned Time account type rows, if not required, and save.-After performing any of the above activity, you can add new premium pay in terms with expected behavior.-Keywords-premium pay, paylout, statistical, quota,

Title: Task Processor not visible in Initially
Content: Symptom-In Inbox, The Task Processor is not visible when you check the Task for the first time. However, when you edit the task, close the task and refresh the view, only then the processor data is displayed-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Inbox view-Select Open Tasks-Processor field is blank-Edit the task-Close the screen-Refresh teh view-Processor is filled (the user who edited it)-Cause-This is expected system behavior-Resolution-When a task goes to a team (2 or more people) then no name will be present in Processor field because it requires action from more than one individual. The task in this case is available to all in the team.-When user selects the task, it means the user has picked the task from the queue of team. The task status changes to "In process" . All this even if he doesn't click on edit. The processor name gets filled in only when task status gets changed to "In Process".-Keywords-inbox, task, processor,

Title: Budget Release Upload
Content: Symptom-You upload a budget release and receive the information message: 1 Record(s) saved successfully to SAP Business ByDesign.-When you check the Budget Release view, there is no data uploaded.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Budget Release view.-Select New > Budget Release from Microsoft Excel.-Log into the SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN excel system.-Maintain the required data.-Select Save Data To.-You receive the information message: 1 Record(s) saved successfully to SAP Business ByDesign.-Select the Budget Release view.-There is no budget data uploaded in the system.-Cause-One cause of this message is that you are using an outdated version of the SAP Add-In for Microsoft Excel.-Resolution-Update your SAP Add-In for Microsoft Excel and upload the data.-Keywords-Budget Release, Planning, Upload Data, Planning Data, SAP Add-In for Microsoft Excel.

Title: Action code is empty for the newly added line item in Out put XML of Purchase order
Content: Symptom-You want to know why new item creation is not appearing in change out put form of purchase order.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Create order and order it-2.Add new item in order and approve it.-3.Check the out put history and view the XML of changed PO out put-You will see that the action code for newly added item is Not appearing-Cause-When a new item goes to approval then the action code would be set if it were possible to to have output when in approval.-For example, if we create a new Item (without sending an update) & the perform a Preview, the action code is present.-But when PO comes out of approval there is an update to that item (Status) so it's not considered new or considered a new action.-This is a  known limitation on ByDesign side.-Currently, it is not possible to determine the newly added item and the original item once the PO is approved during the reapproval scenario.-Note: when changes  are made to existing item then those will show the action code '2' in XML  as expected  for respective item.-also when you add new line items and no reapprovals exist then you will see the action code 1 in XML as expected-Resolution-Our developers analyzed the issue in depth and the results are as follows:-While the purchase order is still in approval, it is technically possible to distinguish between the newly added line and the other lines, but when the purchase order approval is approved, it is technically not possible to differentiate between them, which is the current technical restriction of the system.-If you really need to distinguish new and other lines on the form for purchase orders with an approval process, you can try to do a secondary development of this with help of partners.- Since this feature is not supported in the current release of SAP Business ByDesign.-1.If you are a partner: you can help develop this using SDK or  please use cloudsolutionpartner@sap.com or the Partnerfinder .-2.If you are a customer: if you already have a partner ,ask them to help develop it for you through SDK.  -Or      -a. Contact your the Account Executive-b. Check the link https://www.sap.com/uk/services/advisory-development/application-development.html#contact-us -3. Alternatively you may check the Customer Influence Forum to submit an idea: https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#campaign/886-Keywords-change code not appearing in XML; Legend icon missing for changed purchase order item,

Title: Error "Cannot change cost rate of resource XYZ; it was used in valuation after DD.MM.YYYY" during cost rate change of a resource
Content: Symptom-You want to edit the existing labor cost rates maintained for labor resources and while changing the rate, the system throws error message "Cannot change cost rate of resource XYZ(XYZ refers to resource); it was used in valuation after DD.MM.YYYY(DD.MM.YYYY refers to date from which new rate to be ammended).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Chain Design Master Data work center.-Go to Resources view.-Select Resource ID XYZ, then click on Edit.-On the Valuation tab, maintain cost rate effective from DD.MM.YYYY.-Error message appears: Cannot change cost rate of resource XYZ; it was used in valuation after DD.MM.YYYY.-Cause-DD.MM.YYYY is a date in the past.-Resolution-The system allows the new cost rate only from today(current date) and anything prior to that won't be allowed.-Keywords-Labor resource, cost rate, resources, Cannot change cost rate of resource, it was used in valuation after

Title: Unexpected Total Encumbrance Amount in the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report
Content: Symptom-You expect the amount shown for the Total Encumbrance field related to a Project Task different than the one showing in the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Select Design Reports.-Open the Project Cost and Revenue by Project Structure report.-Put your selection criteria.-Add the Field Total Encumbrance to the report.-Run the report.-Result: For Project Task ABC(ABC represents the ID of the Project Task) you expect for the field Total Encumbrance to show YYY(YYY represents the expected amount) but it is a different one.-Cause-One of the potential reason why you would expect a different amount is based on your time selection. For example the related Purchase Order line item not delivered. The total Encumbrance Amount does not follow time selection. It is a cumulative total and not a period specific one.-Resolution-As indicated in the Cause section, you should not expect Total Encumbrance amount result based on periods.-You may also use The Encumbrance - Line Items report for the involved Project Task to verify that the amount is correct.-See Also-Help document Project Cost and Revenue Details by Project-Keywords-Total Encumbrance

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2211 Hotfix Collection 3 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 3 performed in 2211 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 21st of January 2023. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211-Resolution-Cross - Area Topic-UI Client-The issues with the file name seen when previewing a purchase order PDF have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022054. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The issue with the SAP Download Center link has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000023150. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-While creating an expense report in the SAP Business ByDesign mobile application, due to an issue the first line item was not shown or left blank if the total number of expense items crossed 15 for a report. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022502)-When opening the e-mail template for Purchase Order Reminder Letter, an error message was shown that the document was not found. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000019678. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-In the Download Center, the text was not visible while using the High-Contrast Black theme. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000020638)-Action Pad-The Collaboration Window Download ID has now been updated, to facilitate the downloading of the latest Collaboration Window zip file. (Hotfix ID: 1000020416. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Output Management-A new version of the Adobe LiveCycle Designer is now available in the SAP Download Center. (Hotfix ID: 1000022353)-On the release of production order, attachments are now included in the output, based on the business configuration settings. (Hotfix ID: 1000019745. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Countries-For Chile, the "Telephone Attributes" in the country settings have been changed- the "Digit to be Deleted for Calls from Abroad" is changed from "0" to "Initial". This means no "0" is removed when formatting the telephone number for international calls. For existing telephone numbers, this has no immediate impact, unless the telephone number is changed. (Hotfix ID: 1000019584)-Data Privacy: Read Access Logging-The fix provided prevents system issues occurring during the preparation of Downloadable Read Access log. (Hotfix ID: 4500019930)-  Customer Relationship Management-Customer Invoicing-With this fix, the Cancellation invoice now goes through the legal approval process only if the Official Invoice ID is filled and the status is "Approved". If not, approval is not required for the invoice. Previously, only the Official Invoice ID of the original document was used to determine if the Cancellation document goes through the legal approval process or not. (Hotfix ID: 1000023092)-Sales Order-With the fix provided, you can now create a blank sales order by passing only the account, without any application error. (Hotfix ID: 1000018909)-  Financial Management-Set of Books-The business residence was incorrectly derived in Stock transfer orders when the site ID did not match the business residence directly. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000019657)-Payment Processing-The filter parameter for Payment Run now functions correctly without any issues. (Hotfix ID: 1000017959)-Financial Accounting-While completing the payment for a supplier invoice where a project task and a sales order were assigned to an item, the system was throwing an error. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022482)-The fix provided solves the issue with decimal quantities in supplier invoice items, with different GL accounts for the same clearing set which was leading to wrong calculation. (Hotfix ID: 1000022930)-Payment Management-The PaymentReceivingBusinessTransactionDocumentReference ID and UUID fields have now been Read-released. (Hotfix ID: 1000020764)-With the fix provided, the bank statement loading performance has now been improved. (Hotfix ID: 1000019239)-Some of the SAP delivered bank statement formats of type MT940 did not consider the optional funds code at the transaction level correctly. This issue has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022301)-Outgoing bank transfers can now be canceled without the error "submit for cancellation not possible, action is disabled" and the correct status is set. (Hotfix ID: 4500017057)-Tax Management & Declaration-The fix provided includes the following changes corresponding to the German Monthly VAT forms for the year 2023.-The form pages have been modified as per the publication of the Federal Ministry of Finance.-Boxes 87, 90 have been introduced newly.-The file-based output is also incorporated with these two boxes. (Hotfix ID: 1000017855)-With SAP Business ByDesign's 2302 release, for Israel, the Shaam Interface will have Bookkeeping certification details. The fix provided includes the changes for the same. (Hotfix ID: 1000020306)-Expense Management & Reporting-New per diem rates relevant for the year 2023 have been updated. The same will be considered for the expense reports in 2023 and the subsequent years. (Hotfix ID: 1000020785)-The statutory rates for Denmark per diem rates - Mileage, Lodging, and Meals are now updated for 2023. (Hotfix ID: 1000020533)-The fix provided includes the following legal changes for Germany & US, applicable from January 1, 2023.-The Meal & Lodging per diems for foreign trips in Germany have been updated including deductions for meals (values for payments in kind for meals/non-monetary remuneration for breakfast/lunch/dinner).-The Standard mileage rates for Expense reports in the U.S, for the use of a car (also vans, pick-ups & panel trucks) will be 65.5 cents per mile driven for business use, up by 3 cents from the mid-year increase, setting the rate for the second half of 2022. (Hotfix ID: 1000019198. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Project Management-Project Processing-In the Project Stock Order, it is now possible to create consumption with iStock information even if the product does not allow iStock. (Hotfix ID: 1000021046)-  Human Capital Management-Travel & Expense Management-The fix provided includes the new per diem rates for Lodging and Meals for Sweden, for the year 2023. (Hotfix ID: 1000018116. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Master Data Replication-During replication of employees from SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central to SAP Business ByDesign, there were certain cases where the employee replication failed as the payment method was already available. The fix provided ensures the correct handling of the payment method so that employee replication is not affected. (Hotfix ID: 1000020315. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Employee Time Recording-You can now view the remaining leave balance in the Leave Request UI even when using a time type with an underscore. (Hotfix ID: 1000020418)-Work Agreement-The field Administrative Category in BO HCF_WORKAGREENT,Node:ADDITIONAL_CLAUSES have now been Public Write-Access released. (Hotfix ID: 1000022444)-Time & Labour Management-With the SuccessFactors Employee Central integration with SAP Business ByDesign, employees were found with concurrent employment along with overlapping compensation/additional clauses data when queried, which cannot be stored in SAP Business ByDesign. This incompatible data caused the automatic daily query job to fail & create replication files for other employees as well. With this fix, such employees with concurrent employment and inconsistent data have been identified and marked with an "Irrelevant" status. A warning message is also shown in the Application log of the SuccessFactors Employee Central Query Run. (Hotfix ID: 1000022074)-The fix provided includes the following:-National Holiday 2, which falls on December 3, 2022, is marked as a not guaranteed holiday for the year 2022. (This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-In Unified Reporting -> Duplicate records of Outbound Deliveries in D110 records have been handled in BKMVDATA file. (Hotfix ID: 1000023180)-When a service confirmation was done on service orders and the duration entered was in the form of years/months/weeks, the required communication from service orders to the time sheet failed, resulting in missing service confirmation for employees. With the fix provided, the communications now take place without any issues, and service confirmations are displayed correctly on the employee time sheet. (Hotfix ID: 1000019209. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Supply Chain Management-Outbound Delivery-For products having a serial number profile "Mandatory on Transfer to/from Customers", when a duplicate serial number was mistakenly entered in 3PL Outbound Delivery and then corrected, registered products were created for both serial numbers. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022431)-Analytics-Reconciliation for Inventory was showing an error even though the documents are aligned- "Accounting and logistic inventories differ: Material "Business residence "". The issue causing this error has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000020515)-Site Logistics Task-The fix provided includes the error message handling for a finished warehouse task via the standard web service. (Hotfix ID: 1000019815)-Production Confirmation-For production orders, the deviation quantities were calculated in the planned UoM of a purchase order. The UoM being assigned was that of the UoM entered during confirmation instead of the planned UoM. This resulted in quantities being saved with the wrong UoM. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022160)-Production Bill of Operations-Write- access is now provided to the field TransitionTime in Production Bill of Operation: Path - Element->Operation->OperationChangeState->InterOperationLagDuration. (Hotfix ID: 1000022451)-Production Order Creation Run-The Production Order Creation Run wasn't taking the exclusion of production groups into account. Production orders were created for Products having production groups to be excluded as per the selection parameter of the creation run. With this fix, the Production Order Creation Run with the exclusion of production groups now works as expected. (Hotfix ID:1000018709)-Identified Logistic Unit-When 2 different form templates having 2 different LUs were maintained for labels, and the 2 different labels were printed together, the incorrect form templates were selected. Although on the Labels screen, the different form templates were displayed, in the print queue the templates chosen were incorrect (the same template was chosen for both, instead of the 2 different templates). The fix provided ensures that the correct templates are chosen while printing. (Hotfix ID: 1000019349)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Purchase Requests and Orders-Creating a scanned invoice using ML was resulting in an error that the account assignment details were missing for the TO-Stock Item. The issue causing this error has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000021484)-Official Document Numbering-With this fix, the ERS prefix field for Supplier is no longer blanked out after any changes are made to the Purchasing data of the Supplier, using web services. (Hotfix ID: 1000023530)-Supplier Invoicing-When a landed cost allocation document was created for an unposted supplier invoice item, no notifications were sent to financial accounting when the supplier invoice was posted, and the allocation document was released directly from the Landed Cost Invoice Item UI. This issue has been fixed and notifications are now sent correctly to financial accounting. (Hotfix ID: 1000018238)-With the fix provided, an error message is now shown when multiple supplier invoice documents are selected for withdrawal from approval, as the system accepts only one selection at a time. Title: Incorrect price is determined by the system even though Price List is not maintained for the Product
Content: Symptom-Incorrect Price List XXX is picked by the system for the Product AA even though the Product AA is not maintained in Price List XXX.( XXX is the name of the Customer Specific Price List and AA is the ID of the Service Product)-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Order.-Select new Sales Order.-Enter the Account ID YYY(YYY is the Accound ID )-Navigate to Items Tab and add the Product AA. -You can see that price is automatically determined as 150 EUR.-If you go to Pricing tab.-Expand the item pricing, and hover the cursor over List Price , you can see the Price List used is XXX.-Now go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to Price Lists View.-Select Customer Specific price list.-Search for Price List XXX.-When you edit the Price list you can see that the price list doesnot have the Product AA.-Cause-The product has the pricing reference in Product master data. You can check the same by following the below steps-Go to Product and Service Portfolio work center.-Go to Services View-Search for the Product AA -Edit the Product and then click on View All-Navigate to the Sales Tab-Under Distribution chains , select the line with correct sales organization and distribution channel-Under details , you can see the field Reference Price Service.-In this field you can see a Service Product BB is selected which means the relevant price , surcharge and discounts for the reference service is used to determine the pricing of the product AA.-In this case if you check the Price List XXX, you can see that 150 EUR is maintained for the Product BB and hence the same price is determined for the Product AA in the sales documents(Opportunity, Sales Quote, Sales Order, Service Order etc).-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-If you do not wish that the list price of Product BB is determined, you need to remove the entry in the field Reference Price Service in the Service Master Data for Product AA.-  Keywords-Reference Price Material; Reference Price Service; Price List; List Price; not determined; mandatory list price missing

Title: Attachments Not Added Automatically While Previewing/ Printing Production Order Form
Content: Symptom-Attachments are not displayed in the preview or print output of the Production Order form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Production Control work center.-Go to Production Orders view.-Search for the Production Order: ABC. (ABC represents Production Order ID) -Choose Preview and select Edit Output Settings.-Go to Attachments tab.-The "Include in Output" checkbox is not selected automatically.-Cause-The Scoping question "Do you want to print attachments along with production order forms?" is not Scoped in the Business Configuration.-Resolution-Steps to Scope the Question "Do you want to print attachments along with production order forms?",-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Implementation Projects view.-Select the Implementation Project.-Choose Edit Project Scope.-Go to Questions section.-Select Manufacturing, Warehousing, and Logistics.-Choose Production and select Communication for Production.-Scope the question "Do you want to print attachments along with production order forms?"-Keywords-Print Production Order Form Along With Relevant Attachments, Attachment, Production Order Form, Preview, Edit Output Settings, Print Production Order Form

Title: Action EXECUTE Not Possible; Action is Disabled
Content: Symptom-Scheduled MDRO job run fails due to an error  “Action EXECUTE not possible; action is disabled”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign; Cloud for Customer;-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Mass Data Run-Select the Run views-Check the Status of the Run ( It should not be Absolute OR In revision).-Run should be always in ACTIVE status.-Cause-Job execution is only possible if the status of the MDRO instance is “Active”. The above error occurs when an MDRO instance with existing jobs is changed resulting in the change of its status to “In Revision”. When a job execution starts for such instances, you see the above error.-Resolution-Make sure you make the MDRO instance “Active” after finishing changes.-See Also-Please refer to the help documentation section Mass data Run.-Keywords-MDRO Failed;Cannot change status;action is disabled.

Title: How to set default value for field 'Group by'
Content: Symptom--How do I change the attached field 'Group by' at Project Management -> Time and Expenses to 'None' instead of Calendar Week-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Project management  work center> Time and expenses View-2.Change the value of Group By to Desired option for example 'None'(other than what si already existing for example 'Calender week')-3.Go into another work center then back to Project management  work center> Time and expenses View-5.The value of Group By is set to previous value 'Calendar Week'-6.You expect the value of Group By appeared by default as' None'.-Cause-You are not saving the view  to view what you desire as default.-Resolution-1. Get into the personalization mode.-2. Change the sorting  of any column in OWL screen ,for example click on Ascending on first column, so that sorting is applied-again choose same column and choose again ascending so that sorting is removed-3.Change the "Group by" to "None"-4.Save it-5.Stop personalization-6.Go to Project management  work center> Time and expenses View-7.You will see the Desired option'None'-Keywords-How to change group by value permanently

Title: How to Download / Export Region Code of a Country?
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to download the Region Code but there is no options in Regions fine tuning activity-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center-Go to Overview / Open Activity List from a Project-Search and open the activity Regions-There is no options to download-Resolution-There is no options to download the Region Code from the Fine tuning or any other screens. However, it is possible to fetch the details through the Web Service QueryCodeListIn.-Sample request:-<n0:CodeListByIDQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">-<CodeListSelectionByID>-<SelectionByCodeDataType>-<Name>RegionCode</Name>-<NamespaceURI>http://sap.com/xi/AP/Common/GDT</NamespaceURI></SelectionByCodeDataType>-<SelectionByLanguageCode>EN</SelectionByLanguageCode>-<SelectionByContext>-<Parameter>-<Name>CountryCode</Name>-<Value>DE</Value></Parameter></SelectionByContext></CodeListSelectionByID>-</n0:CodeListByIDQuery_sync>-For additional details about this web service, refer to the blog-To know about the changes to the Region Code per release, refer to the KBA 2727372 - Predelivered content for regions is changed-Keywords- country code, region code, codelist, export, download

Title: Wrong header in XML of the changed Purchase order form
Content: Symptom-Changed Purchase Order after Output Channel was changed to XML (from E-Mail or printer or Fax) are being maintained as "PurchaseOrderRequest" in XML payload rather than "PurchaseOrderChangeRequest".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.  initially the Output Channel for  Supplier  is email in supplier master under collaboration  tab> communication tab.-2.  Then Create new PO and order then make change by adding new line by using Copy button and click on send update  button , you will see both create output form and change output form in output history tab of PO also both XML can be seen that they have correct header details respectively.-3.change Output Channel for the Supplier to XML in supplier master under collaboration  tab> communication tab.-4.Now make a change in same PO by adding new line by using Copy button and send update and you see  that it does not create change Purchase order in the XML header rather it  is showing as Create purchase request.-5.Again make a change in same PO  that you created  by  adding another new line by using Copy button and send update and you see  that it does create change Purchase order in the XML header as expected.-( to check the XML go to application user management  work center> webservice monitoring, click on refresh button then choose date  and time same as out put submission  date and time and click on  view button and choose payload)-Cause-In this case when the Output channel selection is changed from other mediums like Email, Fax, Printer to XML then this is a limitation because during the XML processing there is a message communication to Supplier which is triggered.-Now since there are no entries in Process agent Framework View of Business Documents system assumes this as a first instance and hence the create action code is set. When this is set, then while generating the XML , there is create XML which is triggered instead of an update.-Resolution-So we don't advise the customers to make such change.-Thus we don't expect in general this change and its something done very rare and only first time when you make such change for that supplier this issue happens, so no work around as such as of  now.

Title: How Meals Per Diem Deduction Is calculated In Germany When Lodging Is Not Involved
Content: Symptom-You have created an Expense Report and Meals Per Diem Deduction is only considered for the first day and ignored on the Second day. The Expense Report is created for a 2 day trip.-Kindly note that Expense Report does not involve Lodging.-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Travel and Expenses Work center.-Go to Expense Reports.-Find Expense Report > Preview.-In the Preview you could see that the Per Diems is Calculated only for the First Day and Ignored for the Second day-Resolution-This is the intended and correct system behavior according to German Law in case of Expense Report.Expense Report is a two-day trip without lodging.In this case, the absence time of two days are calculated together as only one interval. If this one absence interval includes more than 24 hours,this is in fact as per definition in ByDesign Travel & Expense always the Per Diem of the first day is considered while the 2nd day will be neglected.--See Also-3108615 - How Meals Per Diem Deductions are Calculated in Germany-Keywords-Meal Per Diem Deduction,Germany,Lodging,Expense Report

Title: Health Check Assignment of type CRM_CQ_NTF_APPROVED BTM items not possible
Content: Symptom-You are getting a health check incident with the subject: Health Check Assignment of type CRM_CQ_NTF_APPROVED BTM items not possible-Environment-Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Task Management view.-Show: Unassigned Items.-Select the Business Task with the subject Quote XYZ Approved (XYZ represents the quote id).-Open Application Log 11111111 (11111111 represents the Log number).-You can see the following:-Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Searching for responsible in non-configurable work category: Responsible person for Service Quote-Searching using method Responsible Person for Service Quote-Result:-Employee found: ABC (ABC represents the user name).-Employees without sufficient access rights for the item:-Employee: ABC.-Info: Work Center Views that potentially grant access:-View:Sales Quotes (CRM_SALESQUOTES) - Context: Sales (4)-No employee has sufficient access rights-Cause-The user ABC does not have the work center New Business and the view Sales Quotes assigned. Hence the task cannot be assigned to the user.-Resolution-You need to ensure that the user ABC has access to Sales Quotes or assign the task manually to a user that has the work center assigned and the respective access rights.-Go to the Application and User Management work center.-Select the Business Users view.-Select user ABC.-Click on Edit Access Rights.-Go to the Assigned Work Centers and Views.-Assign the work center New Business and the view Sales Quotes assigned.-Keywords-Sales Quote, Quote; CRM_CQ_NTF_APPROVED; Task; Unassigned

Title: How to Find Time Recording Method in SDK?
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have a requirement to customize Time File of an Employee through SDK but there is no Node for Time Recording Method in TIMX_AGREEMENT BO-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-The Time Recording method in the Work Agreement is not an indicator instead it is based on a logic.-1. Navigation-BO TIMX_AGREEMENT -> ROOT -> ITEM -> ITEM_PERIOD_PROVISIONS -> ITEM_PERIOD_TIM_REC_PROV-Nodes - COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE-2. Logic:-If COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND is true and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE is Null Then it is Positive-If COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND is true and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE is 1 Then it is Positive with Terminal Integration-If COMPLETENESS_REQUIRED_IND is False and EE_TIME_EVENT_USAGE_CODE is Null Then it is Exception-based-Keywords-Time recording method, sdk, TIMX_AGREEMENT

Title: Associated Business Partner ID For The Organizational Unit is Incorrect
Content: Symptom-You have created an Organizational unit XYZ, and Associated Business Partner which is Account XYZ has also been created but there is mismatch between the Organizational Unit Id and the Account Id when the Company indicator was set.-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Organizational Management work center-Go to Org Structures view-Search the Org Unit XYZ-View the Org Unit-In the Header section, the Associated Business Partner is YYYYY instead of XYZ-Cause-For the example in scenario, the situation of Organizational Unit XYZ and Account XYZ in the system may be as follows:--On DD1.MM1.YYYY1 HH1:MM1:SS1 the Account XYZ was created.-On DD2.MM2.YYYY2 HH2:MM2:SS2 the Account XYZ was set to status Obsolete.-On DD3.MM3.YYYY3 HH3:MM3:SS3 the Organizational Unit XYZ was created.-On DD4.MM4.YYYY4 HH4:MM4:SS4 the Company indicator for Organizational Unit XYZ was set.-The company indicator for Organizational Unit XYZ was not changed since then. ( i.e. Here XYZ is an Account ID and Organizational Unit)-Resolution-When an Organizational Unit is turned into a Company, but an Account with a matching Internal ID already exists the program logic has to assume that  this Account is unrelated to the Organizational Unit since it has been created prior. Hence in this case (and only this case) the Account gets an Internal ID drawn from the Internal Number Range. Otherwise, when the Company indicator is reverted (and subsequently set) for an Organizational Unit this should not change the related Account.-Also, the Business Partner ID will be generated when the org unit is activated for the first time. During this time the business partner ID will be generated based on the Organizational Unit. If you desire to have a different or a new Business Partner ID, then it can be provided by using the internal Business Partner ID. This should be done before the Organizational Unit is activated for the first time.-If the Organizational Unit is already activated, there is no way to change the associated Business Partner ID.-Keywords-Organizational Unit, Company, Associated Business Partner, Account, Active, Business Partner ID-organizational unit,associated business partner,active,business partner id

Title: Supplier Data is Missing in the Supplier Collaboration Data Report
Content: Symptom- You are missing supplier data from Supplier Collaboration Data report.-Environment- SAP Business ByDeisgn-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-Select the Reports view-Search for report Supplier Collaboration Data-Select and search for Supplier ID -Select the Apply button -The report is not reflecting all the Suppliers.-Cause-The data source behind report Supplier Collaboration Data is not suitable to find not existing collaboration data.-From the database point of view, the data source uses existing collaboration data as an anchor and then links supplier data to it. As a consequence, if a supplier data is missed in any collaboration data (such as output channel definitions), it won't appear at all in the report.-Resolution-You can create an own data source, by following the below steps:-Go to Business Analytics work center -Select the option Design Data Source -Select on the New button -Here the Data source can be an OUTER join from (for example) data source SUPPLIER ("Supplier master data") joined to data source Supplier Collaboration Data. The JOIN condition is that the Supplier in Supplier Master Data equals Supplier in Supplier Collaboration Data. User could then select any interesting fields (which should be filled in case of existing collaboration data) as view fields and use this data source to find supplier with empty (i.e. non-existing) collaboration data.-In case Business Partner simultaneously plays the roles of an Account and a Supplier, the data of the corresponding Satellite Object /DOC/OM_COMM_ARRANGEMENT which carries collaboration data are toggled forth and back for the document types which overlap the roles, according to their last access. While this toggling is performed for transactional access reasons, it - in these rare cases - results in a flaw of data representation in analytics reporting. However, currently there is no collaboration between the two business object (Business Partner and Communication Arrangement, respectively). Hence, kindly update your idea in our Influence Portal.-Keywords-Supplier Collaboration Data, satellite object, Business Analytics, Design Data Source, Supplier Master Data, /DOC/OM_COMM_ARRANGEMENT-supplier collaboration data,satellite object,business analytics,design data source,supplier master data

Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-How to Find Retention Period of a Web Services Messages in Backend?-This is applicable to Payloads as well-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-The steps in the backend are as follows,-Go to SRTUTIL T-code-Go to Tools and select Global Configuration-In the section Error Log, you will find the Retention Period in days-Development enforce the minimum retention period as 4 weeks. Title: Mass Data Run Error: Your user is assigned to a different solution. Please use a valid user
Content: Symptom-You have scheduled a Mass Data Run to execute. When the execution is finished, you notice an error in the Log Information:-Error: Your user is assigned to a different solution. Please use a valid user-Environment-SAP Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-Custom Mass Data Run(MDR) previously created with all adjoining parts (screen scenario, business object, query, action script etc).-Reproduction:-Navigate to your custom MDR work center.-Open the MDR Runs view.-Select a Run ID.-Click Schedule -> Schedule Immediately.-Observe the MDR logs for the Run ID selected upon completion.-Error: Your user is assigned to a different solution. Please use a valid user-Cause-The run is scheduled using a PDI Development user. This should not be done since as soon as the user works on other solution in the tenant, the user will be "assigned" to the new solution layer and not the original solution layer where the MDR is created.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, we recommend that you only schedule Mass Data Runs with Business Users. This is because the business user is on a "higher" layer, and does not need to be assigned to a specific solution. They have access to all solution layers.-See Also-You can refer to our SAP Cloud Application help documentation section 5.4.3 User Setup Quick Guide.-Keywords-MDR, Failed, Error, Log, User Assigned-mdr,mass data run,valid user,solution

Title: An Extension Field Has Been Extended From Sales Order to Warehouse Request, but for Some Warehouse Requests It Doesn't Work.
Content: Symptom-You have created an extension field in sales order and activated below extension scenarios:-Sales Order - General Information to Outbound Delivery Request - General Information-Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - General Information-  > Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - Item-  > Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - General Information-Then you create a new sales order, maintain value for the extension field and then proceed the process until warehouse request created. However, the value of this extension field was brought to business context "General Information to Warehouse Request - General Information", not brought to business context "General Information to Warehouse Request - Item".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequiste: in any existing sales order, under tab General, open Adapatation Mode, create a new extension field "EXT" (type: Extended Text) and extend it to below scenarios:-Sales Order - General Information to Outbound Delivery Request - General Information-Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - General Information-  > Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - Item-  > Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - General Information-Create sales order ABC (ABC represents sales order ID), maintain value“EXT1" for extension field "EXT" under tab General; then release the sales order to customer demand and then release to delivery proposal.-In delivery proposal DEF (DEF represents delivery proposal ID), under tab General, you can see the same content in extension field "EXT" (business context: Outbound Delivery Request - General Information). Click Create Warehouse Request against delivery proposal DEF, warehouse reques XYZ (XYZ represents warehouse request ID) created.-Go to work center Outbound Logistics, open view Warehouse Requests, find warehouse reques XYZ, click the ID directly, you can see it is blank in "EXT" (business context: Warehouse Request - Item).-However, go to work center Outbound Logistics, open view Warehouse Requests, find warehouse reques XYZ, click Edit, under tab General, you can find "EXT" has value (business context: Warehouse Request - General Information).-Cause-Extension scenario "Outbound Delivery Request - General Information -> Warehouse Request - General Information" has below 2 sub scenarios:-  Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - Item-  Outbound Delivery Request - General Information to Warehouse Request - General Information-We have 2 sub scenarios to cover the merge scenarios from ODR (outbound delievery request) to SLR (site logistics request, i.e. warehouse request). For example, we have ODR1 and ODR 2, both have extension field "EXT" with values "EXT1", "EXT2" respectively. If we merge ODR1 and ODR2 to create SLR1 and above Extension Scenarios are active, then system will copy ODR1 extension field data to SLR1 and then ODR2 to SLR1. In this process, extension field value is getting overwritten due to merge case, so we have sub scenario which will extend the same extension field to SLR1-Item level so that items will get values from their corresponding ODRs.-Hence, extension scenario "Outbound Delivery Request - General Information -> Warehouse Request - Item" only works in merging case, otherwise they can have the extension field on Warehouse Request - General Information which will work.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Sales Order, Warehouse Request, Extension Field, General Information, Item

Title: Error: "Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY" when Replicating the Employee
Content: Symptom-You are trying to replicate Employees in the Master Data Replication work center, however the system shows the error messages below:-Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY-Save failed-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Master Data Replication work center.-Go to the Employees view.-Search for Remote Employee ID XYZ.-Then following error occurs-Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY-Save failed-Cause-This is due to the organisational centre ABC being delimited, and the replication request is trying to assign this Org Unit from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY-Resolution-You need to correct the organisational data to reflect correct validities for the period that they are assigning the Organisation to employees.-The Replication request needs to have the correct validities ranges for the Organisation data assignments.-Keywords-Replication, parent node, Empployee, Remote Employee, Period not valid; parent node only valid from DD.MM.YYYY to DD.MM.YYYY, Save failed

Title: APBCT_COMMON 6060 ERROR MESSAGE
Content: Symptom-Warning message while creating supplier invoice.-Item 1: The determination of withholding tax code failed. Either select one manually or an error occurred in business configuration: APBCT_COMMON 606. Report an incident. (see attached screenshot)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier invoicing work center-Click on Create supplier invoice without reference to PO-While entering one of the details you will get this warning message-Cause-There is no WHT codes created having details appearing in Supplier master or material master  under withholding tax classification.-Resolution-Create Tax code for those details maintained in Supplier master  or material master under withholding tax classification.-See Also- 2551668 - PDI Extension: Automatic Derivation of Withholding Tax Code Fails

Title: Wrong Purchase Order's Item Status In Invoice Entry View
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- *** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-Item has Completed status in Purchase Order. However the item is still invoiceable in Invoice Entry view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center.-Go to Invoice Entry view.-Show: All Orders to be Delivered.-Search for the Purchase Order's ID.-If you check the Processing Status of the item, it shows "Open".-However if you open the Purchase Order, the Invoice Status of this item is "Manually Finished".-Steps to check the item status:-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders.-Go to Purchase Orders view.-Search for the Purchase Order's ID.-Click in Edit button.-Navigate to Items tab.-Select the item number.-Navigate to Basic Data subtab.-See that the invoice status is the one below:-Invoice Completed: Manually Finished-Cause-It is missing some information from Purchase Order to be taken to the Supplier Invoice which can be corrected in the backend.-Resolution-Open the backend. -Use transaction: SE38-In Program field, insert: /SRMAP/PI_RECONCILIATION-Click in Execute. -Select the option 'Reconciliation for specified Business Object Instance'. -Fill the information in the form as below (Check the screenshot):-Business Object Type Code: 001-Business Object ID: Purchase Order's ID-Remote Process Component Namespace: http://sap.com/xi/AP/SupplierInvoicing/Global-Remote Process Component Name: SupplierInvoiceProcessing-Aspect: (leave it blank) -Click in Execute. -Then you go back in the front end, and go to the 'Invoice Entry' view. It may take some minutes for the change to be seen in the UI.-In the 'Invoice Entry' view, them item will not be invoiceable anymore (as expected).-Keywords-Supplier Invoice; Purchase Order; Manually Finished; Backend

Title: Error "Assigned Employee not Valid; Neither Internal nor External from DD1/MM1/YYYY to DD2/MM2/YYYY" during Employee Transfer
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -While trying to transfer employee from one organizational unit to another, these two error messages are thrown.-Update to organizational structure not possible-Assigned employee not valid; neither internal nor external from DD1/MM1/YYYY to DD2/MM2/YYYY-This error comes up even when you change the transfer date to something later.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-1.Go to Personnel Administration Work Center.-2.Go to Employees view.-3.Select the employee.-4.Click Actions button and click Transfer Employee.-5.Select the transfer date.-6.Enter Organizational Unit and Job.-7.Click Save.-Cause-When hiring an employee for the first time, as per the standard behavior, the service start date is same as hire date.It can be later changed in the Personnel File.-The validity from date of employee being transferred is not same as hire date in database/backend which is causing the issue.-Resolution-Check the validity of Employee in backend-1.Go to T-code---SESFTS-2.Load BO by Proxy Name --- EMPLOYEE-3.Load By Query--- Identification query by Employee Attributes-4.Enter Employee ID/Content-5.Navigate Employee Type-6.Check the validity start date of employee-The validity period for node Employee-Employee Type is set as per the hire date and will not change on changing the service start date. This needs to be corrected from backend to perform employee transfer.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/1934540-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3253087-Keywords-Employee not Valid, Employee Transfer , validity start date of employee, BO Shell

Title: Tax Exemption Certificate for US is not working for Quotes
Content: Symptom-You find that the tax is being calculated in the quote (pricing tab) and displayed on the quote form, so the Tax Exemption Certificate apparently does not play any role for quotes.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Service Quote ABC (where ABC stands for service quote ID)-Navigate to Services And Spare Parts tab, Taxes sub tab-You can see Tax Code is 501 - Sales Tax - Standard Rate-The tax exemption can't be determined automatically-While in the follow up Service Order EFF (where EFG stands for service order ID)-The tax code is 509 - Exempt Sale for Resale-Cause-There is no need of tax exemption certificate in Service/Sales Quote. Because the Sales/Service quotes are pre sales documents and tax exemption certificate is mostly something used when we do actual sales. This is why there is no tax exemption certificate in Service/Sales Quote.-Resolution-This is expected system behaviour.-When creating a follow up document for sales quote, i.e. sales order, the user need to check and adjust the order accordingly. You can always change the tax code and select the customer tax exemption certificate.-The same behavior has been also confirmed for Italy.-We suggest for you to raise a new request in the Influence platform, where other customers would be able to also express their opinions on this and the development team would be able to gauge the feedback. Please kindly raise a new request in the Influence platform: https://influence.sap.com/SAPByDesign-Keywords-Tax Exemption Certificate, Service Quote, Sales Quote, US, Italy

Title: Error Message "Remote organizational unit XXX from not yet replicated"
Content: Symptom-You find below error message in Master Data Replication work center in a SAP Business Bydesign - SF Integration scenario-Remote organizational unit XXX from not yet replicated-Below are other symptoms where the solution is relevant-Reporting Line Unit (RLU) is missing in Staging Area (No replication request for the RLU)-Employee is available for the RLU is missing-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Go to Reporting Line Unit view-RLU XXX is missing-Cause-In normal scenario when there is any change in the employee data in SF, the latest record can be pulled in SAP Business By Design and during the process of this query from employee central, RLU replication request gets created as well (provided employee is a manager ).-However, if certain RLU replication request already exists in the stystem then a new one is not created unless there are some relevant difference in the replication request.-When an employee is queried, respective RLU replication requests is not created. System compares the previous RLU replication request(which is successful) and finds no difference. System does this to ensure there is no unecessary replication of RLU as RLU replications are costly in terms of time it takes.-Resolution-To get replication request for the respective RLU, there should be some relevant changes to the employee itself.-Once there is a change and along with the employee change, the RLU also get replicated-See Also-2521562 - Frequently Asked Questions on Business ByDesign and SuccessFactors Employee Central Integration-2511025 - Frequently Asked Questions on Human Capital Management (HCM) – Integration-Keywords-RLU, staging area, missing replication requests

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Errors for fix-price Sales Order Items: Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY***-You notice Inconsistencies with Sales Order Items assigned to Accrual Method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC:-For Example:-The Revenue Recognition run reports error messages such as:-"Doc. item XYZ/XX: Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only." (XYZ/XX represents a Sales Order Item appearing as Leading Sales Document Item)-When checking the respective Sales Order Items you notice that they are connected to the same Leading Sales Document Item, XYZ-XX.-This KBA is also valid in case Sales document Item has assigned to any other Accrual method e.g. 101, however before revenue recognition run, its changed from 108 to other accrual methods which would have already created the issue.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Periodic Tasks - Revenue Recognition view.-Find the erroneous Run and open the Application log (Processed with Errors tab).-You notice several error messages for Sales Order Items, such as XYZ-XX or DEF-ZZ. All these items are fix-price, project-based Sales Order items using Accrual Method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC.-You then check the setting of the affected Sales Order items:-In the Cost and Revenue work center go to the Sales Document Items view.-Find the items XYZ-XX as well as ABC-YY and DEF-ZZ.-Select the Accounting Data tab.-Here, in the Assignment of Accrual Method table you check the Leading Sales Document Item column.-You notice that the Leading Sales Document item for the affected Sales Order Items is XYZ-XX.-Via the Associated Objects tab you verify that Sales Order Item XYZ-XX is not associated with the same project as item DEF-ZZ.-You now wonder if there are further Sales Order items for which item XYZ-XX is incorrectly maintained as Leading Sales Document Item.-You need to identify all Projects and Sales Order items for which item XYZ-XX got incorrectly assigned as Leading Sales Document Item.-You need to correct the Leading Sales Document Item assignment for all affected Sales Order items/Projects. -Cause-Numerous fix-price Sales Order items, not belonging to the same Project, got assigned to Accrual Method 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC at the same time. Currently, the system cannot handle this mass update across Projects.-The mass change causes inconsistencies, where-a Sales Document item can either incorrectly become the Leading Sales Document item for Sales Order items which do not belong to the same Project (Error Message for item  XYZ/XX).-the internal project-based Item of a Project is connected to the wrong Parent Sales Order which can cause further error messages (see the See also section). -Resolution-Error Message: "Doc. item XYZ/XX: Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only": -To find all Sales Order items for which item XYZ-XX is, correctly or incorrectly, assigned as Leading Sales Document Item, you need to identify all projects related to these items in the backend.-In a second step, you can then find the related Sales Order items via the Advanced Search in the Sales Documents view of the Cost and Revenue work center.-Once identified you can correct the wrong assignment with an accrual method dummy change as well as refreshing the Internal Item assignment: -1. How to find the Projects related to the Sales Order Items with Leading Item XYZ-XX:-Request a L6 user and access STFK.-In the backend open the Testshell via SESFTS.-Enter BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC.-Press Load by Query and select Item -Query_By_Element.-In the OperationalDocumentItemReferenceFormattedID field, enter the ID of the Sales Order item which incorrectly appears as Leading Sales Document Item.-Press OK (green tick).-Under More Functions go to Switch Attribute Name and select Display Proxy Name.-Find the UUID-CONTENT Column and copy/note down the UUID.-Open a new Session and navigate back to SESFTS.-Enter BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC.-Press Load by Query and select ITEM_SET_OF_BOOKS-QUERY_BY_ELEMENTS.-In the Maximum Rows field enter -1.-In the AccrualLeadingSalesAndServiceDocumentItemUUID/content field, enter the UUID which you have just noted down.-Press OK. Ideally, you should see here only the items (per set of books) connected with the same Project. But, due to an inconsistency it may happen that further items are wrongly assigned.-Select All lines (Select the small box left beside the Node ID field).-Press Navigate and select TO_PARENT. Ideally you should see here a number of lines corresponding with the number of Sales Orders connected to the same project as item XYZ-XX (If there are two Sales Orders created for the Project, two lines appear).-Again, select all lines.-Press Navigate and select ITEM_ACC_COD_BLOCK_DISTR.-Again, select all lines.-Press Navigate and select ACC_CODING_BLOCK_ASSGNMT.-Find the PROJECT_REFERENCE-Project_ID-CONTENT column.-If numerous Projects are displayed here you can copy the values into Excel:-Click the PROJECT_REFERENCE-Project_ID-CONTENT column header.-Press Space so that only this column is selected.-Press Ctrl+C to copy the Values.-Open an MS Excel work book and copy all values into the Excel file.-If you need to select numerous items press Shift and the Arrow Down key (You might have to copy the values in a few steps as only a limited amount can be stored in the clipboard.).-2. Once you have all Projects identified go back to the UI to identify the Sales Order Items connected to these projects:-In the Sales Document Items view of the Cost and Revenue work center open the Advanced Search.-Copy the first Project ID from your list in Excel, say project ID CPSOGHI (CPSOGHI represents the ID of one of the Customer Sales Projects).-Under Related Documents enter the Project ID and press Go.-All Sales Order items connected to the project are displayed.-3. To remove the incorrect Leading Sales Document Item assignment, make an Accrual Method Dummy change. Before this change you must and keep open the Manual Revenue Recogntion screen, as the accrual method change resets all manual values and as the Internal project-based item might not get triggered immedately otherwise: -Select one of the Sales Order items and press Edit Manual Revenue Recogntion Data.-Select Percentage of Completion.-If there are any manual values maintained, either in the Edit Manual Percentage of Completion table or below under Reference Values take note of these values, for example in your Excel list.-Keep the Edit Percentage of Completion screen open but navigate back to the Sales Document Items view.-4. Assign new Accrual Method (temporarily):-Select all items related to Project CPSOGHI.-Press Reassign and select Accrual Method.-Change the Accrual Method to an Accrual Method other than 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC, for example 101- Reverse Deferrals and Accruals.-Press OK.-5. Delete the Internal Project-Based Item:-Access STFK with a L6-support user authorization.-Go to transaction SESFTS.-Enter the BO FIA_FAV_SLS_SRV_DOC.-Select Load By Query and select ITEM-QUERY_BY_PROJECT_REF. -In the ProjectReference/ProjectID/content field, enter the Project ID and press OK (green tick in the bottom right).-Ensure that you are viewing all items in Table view. You can see all items of the sales order in a table list. If you can only see information on one specific Item click the Table View button in the top left corner.-Under More Functions mouse-over Switch Attribute Names and select Display Proxy Names. -Identify the Internal Item: Find the OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT_ITEM_REF-UUID-CONTENT column. For one item only 000000000000000000... appears. This is the internal project-based sales order item.-Select the Internal Item and check if this item is connected to the Leading Item's Sales Order: -Press Navigate and choose TO_PARENT.-In the Parent Node find the OPERATIONAL_DOCUMENT_REFERENCE-FORMATTED_ID column. Here Sales Order ID XYZ appears, which is not connected to Project CPSOGHI. -Go back to the Items table (button left beside Navigate). -To be 100% sure, check the BO Node again. It MUST display: FinanciaAccountingViewofSalesAndServiceDocument - Item.-Select the Internal Item.-Press Edit.-Press Delete. -Press Save. -6. Change the Accrual Method back to 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC:-Back in the Sales Document Items view select all Sales Order Items connected to Project CPSOGHI.-Change the Accrual Method back to 108 - Recognize using cost-to-cost project POC.-7. Re-enter the Manual Revenue Recognition Data:-Close the still open Edit Percentage of Completion screen and then re-open it again. -Enter all the values which you have noted down earlier and press Save and Close. -See Also-2385608 - Revenue Recognition: AccrualMeth. Assignment For Fixed Price Project Incomplete-2295257 - Error Message: Doc. Item XYZ/10 Only Doc. Items of the Same Profit Center can be Merged-2479036 - Revenue Recognition Run Error - Doc. item: Only Doc. Items of the Same Profit Center can be Merged-2948703 - Revenue Recognition Run Error: Only doc. items with the same buyer party can be merged-Keywords-wrong leading sales document item, 108,  Use one merge item with code 'replace basic data' only

Title: System Failed to Show the Duplicate Exception When External Document ID Contains Apostrophe.
Content: Symptom- You have created a copy of supplier invoice however system does not show the duplicate exception.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Invoicing work center-Select Invoices and Credit Memos view-Select the relevant Supplier invoice ID-Select the Copy and then click on Check button -The system does not show the duplicate exception-Cause-Using Apostrophe or any special characters at the beginning of the external document ID in the supplier invoice is not a best practice as it misleads the invoice search engine. Hence system failed to recognize the duplicate invoice.-Resolution-Avoid using Apostrophe or any special characters at the beginning of the external document ID in the supplier invoice. There by system determines the external document ID and shows the duplicate exception.-See Also-3017709 - Possible Duplicate exception is not appearing in an invoice-Keywords-Apostrophe or any special characters; external document ID in the supplier invoice; Duplicate exception does not show;

Title: You Cannot Use the Flag of Main Address for an Account
Content: Symptom-You are trying to select the Main Address for an Account, however, the field is grayed out.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211 and higher.-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Account Management Work Center and then Accounts view.-Search for the affected Account ID.-Click Edit > General.-Go to the Communication tab.-Click Address Details.-The Main checkbox is grayed out. -Resolution-This is the expected system behavior. It's the standard behavior that the "Main" indicator in the address details screen is "read-only" for address type "Standard".-This "Main" indicator has only effect on other address types.-See Also-2112390 - Bill-To, Ship-To and Dun-To Columns Missing in the Account's Address Tab-Keywords-Main Address, Account Management, Account, Corporate Account, Private Account, Flag, Unable, Cannot, Grayed Out.

Title: Party Sales Unit ID XYZ (Unit Name) Does not Exist in Master Data
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-***INTERNAL USE ONLY*** -The customer has Invoice Requests which have been processed, but are now showing Inconsistent in the system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing work center.-Select the Invoice Requests view.-Search for the Inconsistent Invoice Requests.-Select ID ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Sales Order Invoice Request).-Click Check.-Error: Party Sales Unit ID XYZ (Name) Does not Exist in Master Data-Cause-Error is caused because document uses old master data.-Resolution-With customer's permission and document ID confirmation, perform the following:-Open a document type Text.-Add the Invoice Request ID in the document.-Save the document.-Open the backend.-Go to transaction SE38.-Enter the report name ZINV_REQ_INCONSI_FIX.-Click execute.-In the field for Upload Input File, click the value box.-Upload the .txt file.-Execute the report.-Message shows in the bottom: Updation table Finished.-Now the status of the document has been updated.-See Also-3215925 - The Following Error Occurs in a Document or During Migration: Party XYZ does not exist-Keywords-Invoice Request, Sales Order, Party, Sales Unit, Does not Exist, Master Data

Title: DS fails to extract data from Odata adapter
Content: Symptom-DS tries to extract data from Odata, but fails with error "RUN-058105: |<dataflow name>  Error preparing to read <Query Name>: <Exception occurs when executing 'begin' method of the adapter operation with ID [1]. (406) Not Acceptable [HTTP/1.1 406 Not Acceptable]>."-Environment-SAP BusinessObjects Data Services XI4.2 SP14 and higher version-Reproducing the Issue-Create an Odata Adapter in Management Console.-Create an Odata Adapter datastore in Designer.-Set the Odata Adapter datastore 's Option "OData version" as "V4".-Create a job to read data from the  Odata Adapter datastore's table.-Run the job and it fails with error "RUN-058105: |<dataflow name>  Error preparing to read <Query Name>: <Exception occurs when executing 'begin' method of the adapter operation with ID [1]. (406) Not Acceptable [HTTP/1.1 406 Not Acceptable]>."-Cause- Option "OData version" is "V4".-Resolution-Change the Odata datastore's option "Version" back to V2, and the issue will be resolved.-Keywords-DS, Odata, adapter,  query, 406, Acceptable
