Title: SAP Cloud Applications: add custom field
Content: Symptom-Error : Data type of element xyz_abc missing.Please do not use this element-where xyz_abc is your extension field name defines in BO/XBO-Environment-Cloud Application Studio-SAP Cloud for Customer-Reproducing the Issue-Login to cloud application studio-Open your PDI solution -Navigate to the Data source you have created-check the field defined from your BO/XBO-Activate-You will receive Error "Data type of element xyz_abc missing.Please do not use this element "-Cause-The extension fields you have defined has the data type LongText.-Resolution-Any extension field defined as long text cannot be included in custom data souce as framework does not allow it.-Keywords-PDI, ANA, SDK, CBO, BO, DS, data,

Title: Data Flow Verification Run Canceled
Content: Symptom-SAP Common Alias: Document is locked by: SAP_SYSTEM alias SAP_SYSTEM-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application User and Management work center-Open the Data Flow Verification Runs view-Select the Run_ID: SAP_COMMON-Click on View Jobs for selected Runs-Filter Run Jobs-Select the first entry-Click on View Job log-You see the details as shwon below:-Cause- Reason for canceling the job could the following:-There is a planned weekly maintanace activity.-There might planned system upgrade activity.-There could be planned Service Operational activity.-Resolution-Data Flow Verification, SAP_COMMON job runs on every Saturday at 10:00 IST.-This can be solved in two ways:-This job can be rescheduled based on your convient time or based on the options give as follows:-Go to Application User and Management work center-Open the Data Flow Verification Runs view-You see SAP_COMMON run ID-Select and click on Reschedule-You get the 4 options and you can choose the relevant option and save the entry-Start Immediately - You can select this to run the job immediately.-Run After Job - Either you cn select this run after any of the run or specific time which you can specify.-Single Run - Here you can select the time for single run.-Recurrence - Here you can select occurance for this run and it gives you the date and time selection.-Either you can wait for a Saturday to auto-run this job at 10:00 PM IST.-Keywords-DFV, Data Flow Verfificatio Runs, DFV Runs, SAP_COMMON, object locked by SAP_SYSTEM, MDRO: DFV_RUN, Job cancelled after system exception ERROR_MESSAGE.

Title: Error: "You have already created a relationship with the same business partner. Adapt the relationship you just added or remove it"
Content: Symptom-While Migrating Customer, system throws an error message :-"You have already created a relationship with the same business partner. Adapt the relationship you just added or remove it."-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Business Configuration work center.- Select Overview view.- Search and open Migration of Customers activity.- Select Migrate Contacts using the Migration Tool.- Upload the Migration Template using the Upload option.- Select Execute Migration.-Cause-You are trying to add a new contact ID to an existing business partner ID and you may have entered the same relationship twice: once in the tab "Relationship" and also in the tab "Contact Details".-Resolution-If you have a contact person and need to add the contact relationship to an account, you should only maintain this data in the tab "Contact Details".-The tab "Relationship" is meant to enter additional relationships for the contact, however not contact relationships.-See Also-https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2633570-Keywords-Migration of Customer, contactID, business partnerID, contact relationships, additional relationships for the contact

Title: Employee Central Replication Fails with Error: 'A user with the same ID ... already exists'
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-*** INTERNAL USE ONLY ***-A new employee does not yet exist in ByDesign but in Employee Central (EC)-This employee cannot be replicated into ByDesign, since a replication data record with the same external ID already exists, however  for another employee.-This other employee might no longer work in the company and/or was later replicated under a different external employee ID.-It seems that the replication data record prevents the replication of the new employee. -Therefore it seems to be required to delete the record in the backend.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Master Data Replication work center-Select Employees view-Select record for remote employee ID ABC, name KLM  and remote business partner ID OPQ (where ABC represents an employee ID, KLM represents an employee name and OPQ represents the Business Partner ID)-Find error: 'A user with the same ID ABC (XYZ) already exists' (where XYZ represents another employee name)-Cause-This issue might be caused by the following situation:-A reference to employee XYZ with ID ABC was created in BYD and is now assigned to XYZ.  This might have happen by accident. However, regardless of whether it was by accident or not, the ID cannot be used again for KLM.- -If the new employee KLM has the (person/login user) ID ABC in EC, this indicates that this employee ID was maintained in EC and then this somehow got mixed up with mappings and assigned temporarily to employee XYZ.-Resolution-The only option to solve such a situation is the following: Remove the link between remote business partner ID OPQ from the employee ID ABC of employee KLM in EC. -Based on this, the only feasible option to replicate KLM into ByDesign (as KLM doesn’t exist in ByD yet), is to assign a different ID in EC and create the new employee ID during the inbound process in ByDesign.-Keywords-remote, personnel

Title: Update of Materials Tax Details not possible through Migration Tool and Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You want to update the Tax Details for Materials using the Migration Tool with Enhance already existing record or using Mass Data Maintenance for the same, however you get the below error messages.-"Similar entry already exists"-"Missing key specification for processing node PDM_MATERIAL DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIF Update not possible; existing data for DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION not fully specified"-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Mass Data Maintenance work center-Click on Import Materials link-Upload the Template-Click on Execute Data Import -Error received as "Missing key specification for processing node PDM_MATERIAL DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIF Update not possible; existing data for DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION not fully specified"-And other way is to update the Tax details are as follows:-Go to Business Configuration-Select overview-Search Migration of Materials-Select the link and open the migrtaion tool-Upload the file with details in Tax tab-Select Enhance already existing record-Error received as "Error detected in source record with key value 'XYZ' Similar entry already exists" -Resolution-If you encounter the similar situation please follow the below:-The field: TAX_RATE_TYPE_CODE-CONTENT is PSM write released and therefore kindly use the workaround to make changes using OData service.-See Also-2498592 - Error Message While Uploading Tax Data for Materials Using Mass Data Maintenance-You can refer these documentation for your help:-SAP Business ByDesign – OData API Examples (https://blogs.sap.com/2019/02/27/sap-business-bydesign-api-usage-samples/)-SAP Business ByDesign – API Overview(https://blogs.sap.com/2019/09/26/sap-business-bydesign-an-api-overview/)-SAP Business ByDesign(https://api.sap.com/package/BYD/soap)-Keywords-Tax Details, TAX_RATE_TYPE_CODE-CONTENT, Migration of Materials, Tax Rate Type, MATERIAL-DEVIANT_TAX_CLASSIFICATION

Title: Dump or Timeout during execution of BAdI CalculationProcedureForTaxes
Content: Symptom-You have implemented Business Add-In (BAdI) CalculationProcedureForTaxes and are getting a dump or no response during ABSL script execution.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-SAP Cloud Applications Studio-Reproducing the Issue-Prerequisites:-You have an AfterModify script that updates values relevant for Tax Calculation.-You have retrieve, query or association calls during execution of CalculateTax ABSL script.-During normal business processes, the AfterModify is triggered.-Cause-In PDI framework, for any retrieve, query or association calls, MODIFY_FROM_BUFFER is always called for non-ESF2 Business Objects (BOs). The proxy buffer is independent of a particular BO and contains all the BO information provided to the buffer. Once the AfterModify determination call is over, it calls the MODIFY_FROM_BUFFER method again where it will read the changed data, modify this data and finally update the buffer after the modification is completed.-When a modification is pushed to the application before the modification is completely flushed, the BAdI CalculationProcedureForTaxes is triggered. Inside this BAdI, you have retrieve, query or navigate by association ABSL code for a BO calling the MODIFY_FROM_BUFFER. As the previous changes are still not updated in the buffer, it tries to send the same modification resulting in an update conflict.-This conflict between AfterModify and "within" modify (BAdI) is a limitation with the system architecture.-Resolution-Both these application exits cannot be used in parallel with the present system architecture. You need to make changes accordingly to ensure that you do not trigger CalculateTax from an AfterModify.-Keywords-PDI, SDK, MODIFY_FROM_BUFFER, buffer, CalculateTax, AfterModify, application exit, non-ESF2

Title: Revenue Recognition Run Error: Position Type Material Consumption not Defined for Sales Ledger Account
Content: Symptom-When trying to perform an Revenue Recognition Run, the below error occurs.-Error: Position type Material Consumption not defined for sales ledger account.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue Work Center.-Click Revenue Recognition Sub-View under Periodic Tasks.-Show All Revenue Recognition Runs.-Select the Revenue Recognition ID.-Click View.-Click Processed With Errors.-Click Go.-See errors on the revenue recognition.-Error: Position type Material Consumption not defined for sales ledger account.-Cause-The reason is that previously no accrual method is assigned to this sales order item and the related Goods and Activity Confirmation document is posted to a material consumption account.-Later an accrual method is assigned to this sales order item. Execute the revenue recognition run again and error occurs. The postings are not getting corrected automatically during the new revenue recognition run.-Resolution-it's necessary to reverse and repost the business transaction for the Goods and Activity Confirmation document again. This should derive the sales accounts rather than material consumption account. Then during the next revenue recognition run, the error should no longer occur.-Keywords-Sales Order, Revenue Recognition, Account Determination

Title: There Is Planning Run History in the Product Planning Detail Screen But No Planning Run Exists
Content: Symptom-In the product planning details screen of a product/planning area combination, you find plannng run history. However, check in the work center Supply Planning view Planning Runs, there is no planning run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supply Planning.-Open view Products.-Search product ABC (ABC represents product ID) with planning area DEF (DEF represents planning area ID), click Open.-In the screen "Product Planning Details: ABC/DEF", select tab Supply and Demand, select sub tab Product Information, there is a valid planning run date.-Go to work center Supply Planning.-Open view Automated Actions - Planning Runs.-Select All Planning Runs in dropdown, there is no planning run existing.-Cause-There are two possibilities for this behavior:-An user executed material requirement planning (MRP) manually, the last time of manual MRP will also be recorded into "Last Planning Run Data".-There was a planning run but it was obsoleted and deleted. Once a planning run deleted, you cannot find it again from front end.-Resolution-System standard behavior.-Keywords-Product Planning, Planning Run, MRP

Title: E-Mail Notification for Purchase Order Approval Work Flow Triggered Multiple Times for the Same User
Content: Symptom-You have defined the workflow rules for purchase order. When the Approval Status is changed from In Approval to Approved, system has triggered the E-Mail notifications multiple times to the same user.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center-Go to Purchase Orders view -Select the relevant Purchase order-Change the Approval Status from In Approval to Approved-System creates multiple E-Mail notifications to the same user-Cause-You have maintained multiple E-Mail address at several places. For example, at business partner him/herself, as employee workplace address, as a service performer in the business partner etc. All together, this results in multiple E-Mails being sent to the same email address.-Resolution-E-Mail address are maintained for the same responsible person at multiple places hence when ever you do the changes to the orders, system will check the rules maintained in the workflows and trigger multiple emails. Kindly avoid maintaining E-Mail ID multiple times for the same business user.-Keywords-Work Flow Triggered Multiple Times for the Same User; E-Mail Notification for Purchase Order Approval ; Approval Status is changed from In Approval to Approved; Multiple E-Mail Notifications

Title: Attached image not showing properly in document
Content: Symptom-An attachment in a document, for example a customer invoice request, is not accessible. When clicking on the hyper link for the attachment, a small white box and no image appears. It is required to press the Download button to view the image.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The following example relates to a customer invoice, but this could occur in the attachments of any document.-1. Open the work center Customer Invoicing > Invoice Requests-2. Search for invoice request ABC (where ABC is the ID of the invoice request)-3. Click Edit/View All-4. Navigate to the General tab-5. Click the Attachments sub-tab-6. Click the attachment hyperlink-A small white box appears instead of the image. When downloading the image it appears normally.-Cause-The original jpg file was saved with a Tiff compression (Compression LZW) which can also be seen in the properties of the jpg file. When encoding this and uploading it as an attachment, it is not possible to open it by clicking on the hyperlink for the attachment in the browser.-In web services to create and change business objects incl. attachment folder, documents are to be provided in the web service request as Base64 encoded string in element //AttachmentFolder/Document/FileContent/BinaryObject-Resolution-This is the current behavior provided by SAP Business ByDesign.-To solve the issue, please ensure that none of the jpg files that shall be attached are saved with a Tiff compression (Compression LZW). When uploading a document via web service, in order to upload a jpg or other file, it is required to encode this to a base64 format. For example, this can be done via through web resources that convert images to base64 format.-It is then required to copy the encoded text and past it in the tag <BinaryObject>xxx</BinaryObject> (where xxx is the encoded text).-See Also-Example on how to pass the Attachment element for an image with file extension .png: -            <AttachmentFolder>-               <Document>-                  <VisibleIndicator>true</VisibleIndicator>-                  <CategoryCode>2</CategoryCode>-                  <TypeCode>10001</TypeCode>-                  <MIMECode>image/png</MIMECode>-                  <Name>TestAttachment.png</Name>-                  <FileContent>-                     <BinaryObject></BinaryObject>-                  </FileContent>-               </Document>-            </AttachmentFolder>-Keywords-small white box, not available, no image, not showing

Title: Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run For Payables or Receivables Picks up Documents Already Cleared
Content: Symptom-You run a new Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run (FCR) for Payables or Receivables.-This run picks up Documents (e.g. Down Payments) which are already cleared.-You expect that the Documents which are already cleared should not be picked up by the run.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Payables Work Center - Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs view.-Show all Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs, find XXX (where XXX is the FCR Run ID).-Click on Log Result.-Switch to Tab Processed Successfully.-Highlight the relevant Source Document ID YYY (where YYY is the Source Document ID).-This Document should not have been picked up by the Run since it is already cleared.-Cause-It does not matter whether the Invoice or the Down Payment was cleared before the Run was executed. What matters is what is the Posting Date of the Clearing and the Posting Date of the Journal Entries of the FCR run.-Resolution-Go to the Payables Work Center - Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs View.-Show all Foreign Currency Remeasurement Runs, find XXX (where XXX is the FCR Run ID).-Click on Log Result.-Switch to Tab Processed Successfully.-Click on the relevant Source Document ID YYY.-Press View all.-Switch to tab Document Flow.-You can see that the Clearing Posting Date of the Document was e.g. the 13/11/2022.-Go back to the FCR Run and switch to Tab Postings and Subtab Journal Entries.-You can see that the Posting Date of the Journal Entries here is e.g. the 29/10/2022 and e.g. the 28/10/2022 which is before the Cearing Date of the Document YYY. Therefore the FCR Run picked the Document up since at the time of the Posting Date of the Journal Entry of the FCR Run the Document had not been cleared yet.-Keywords-FCR, Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run, Payables, Receivables, Fremdwährungsbewertung

Title: Product Restriction Maintained In Logistics Area Is Not Applicable to Inventory Adjustment
Content: Symptom-You have maintained some specific products as allowed products for a logistics area, but you can still add the stock of other products into this logistics area through common task New Inventory Adjustment.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supply Chain Design Master Data.-Open view Locations.-Select location LOC_1 (LOC_1 represents location ID), click Edit Layout.-In the screen "Site Layout: LOC_1", select logistics area LOA_1 (LOA_1 represents logistics area ID).-In the below select tab Restrictions, select sub tab Allowed Products, product ABC (ABC represents product ID) is the only allowed product.-Go to work center Physical Inventory.-Open common task New Inventory Adjustment.-In step 1, select LOC_1 for Storgae Location ID, click Next.-In Step 2, click Add Row, select logistics area LOA_1 in the pop-up window.-Select DEF (DEF represents product ID) for Product ID, maintain Identified Stock ID and Product Actual Quantity, click Next.-In step 3, click Finish.-Open common task Stock Overview, search product DEF in logisticsa area LOA_1, there is on-hand stock just added.-Cause-Allowed product restriction at the Logistics Area is not applicable to inventory adjustment and physical inventory count.-Resolution-The system is working as designed.-See Also-KBA: 2611295 - Product Restriction Maintained In Logistics Area Not Considered-Keywords-Allowed Products, Logistics Area, Inventory Adjustment, Physical Inventory

Title: Error 'Accrual method assignment for multi-customer project AAA and a Revenue Accounting Contract enabled set of books BBBB is not supported' Occurs When Assigning Accrual Method to Project
Content: Symptom-Project AAA(AAA represents the ID of the project) is a multi-customer proejct.-You try to assign accrual method to project AAA, but the system reports the error 'Accrual method assignment for multi-customer project AAA and a Revenue Accounting Contract enabled set of books BBBB is not supported'(BBB represents the ID of the Set of Books).-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to Projects view.-Select Project AAA.-Click on Reassign and select Accrual Method.-Select Accrual Method and click on OK.-Error 'Accrual method assignment for multi-customer project AAA and a Revenue Accounting Contract enabled set of books BBBB is not supported' occurs.-Cause-You have scoped IFRS 15 / ASC 606: Revenue Recognition Accounting. Revenue recognition is not supported for Multi-customer projects if IFRS 15 / ASC 606 is scoped.-Resolution-System behavior is correct.-See Also-IFRS 15 / ASC 606: Revenue Recognition Accounting-Keywords-Accrual method, multi-customer project, revenue accounting contract, IFRS 15, ASC 606, revenue recognition

Title: Error Message "You cannot open this link because the required work center view is not assigned to you"
Content: Symptom-When you try creating a Lead from a scanned Business Card, mobile throws below error-You cannot open this link because the required work center view is not assigned to you-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Login into ByD Mobile Application-Access My Customer Interactions-Open Scanning Business Card-Select Inspect Scanned Values-Select Follow-UP-System throws the above error message-Cause-Business Card to Lead conversion will only work if the user has access to Leads in Marketing,-In order to assign the work center view, leads in marketing should be scoped-Resolution-This is the standard behavior and Business card is developed as part of Marketing and not New Business.-Keywords-leads, marketing, follow up, business card, scanning

Title: GL Account not visible in Customer Invoice Request Basic View
Content: Symptom-G/L Account disappears after selecting it in the Basic View/ Quick Activity Floorplan (QAF) of a New Manual Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Customer Invoicing workcenter.-Select the New Manual Invoice view.-In the Quick Action Floorplan, enter all respective data such as account, sales organization etc.-Under Items section in the basic view click on the Add Row button.-Enter any product description, quantity, list price etc.-Still under 'Items' section, select a 'G/L Account' using the dropdown menu.-Note that your selection vanishes right after you made the selection from the drop down list  and the G/L Account' field is now grayed out. W-When you then click on View All.-Navigate to the items tab.-Select the line item and go to the Revenue Assignment sub tab.-You can see that all fields are disabled and all field are empty, the selected G/L Account is not there.-Cause-The field GL Account is only supposed to be used in line with Account Assignment Type.-The reason the field goes hidden is because at that point when GL Account is added, there is no Account Assignment determined and this field is mandatory.-Resolution-This is the system expected behavior. -To solve this, please perform one of the following:-Create a New Manual Invoice.-Enter the expected master data.-Add the G/L Account.-Add an Account Assignment Type.-or -Create a New Manual Invoice.-Click on View All.-Navigate to the Items tab.-Select the Revenue Assignment subtab.-Maintain the GL Account.-Keywords-Customer Invoice, GL Account, Manual Invoice, Kundenrechnung, Sachkonto, Manuelle Rechnungsanforderung

Title: You can't select Item Group in Product Master Data
Content: Symptom-You want to select the value of Item Group in Product Master Data, but No Items Found for this field.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Product and Service Portfolio Work Center, Products View-Open Product ABC (where ABC stands for the prodcut)-Navigate to Sales tab-You want to select the value of "Item Group" field-But No Items Found for this field-Cause-The relevant topic hasn't been scoped in the Project Scope-Resolution-To scope the Item Group: 'NORM', follow the below steps:-Go to Business Configuration Work Center.-Select Implementation Project View.-Select Edit Project Scope.-Go to the 3rd step.-Go to 'Sales' -> Go to 'Product and Service Portfolio for Sales’.-Select 'Sell Standard Products' and 'Sell Specified Products'.-Keywords-Item Group, Product, NORM, Sell Standard Products, Sell Specified Products

Title: BYD2205 Error 500 - Supplier Export (Adapt Migration Object)
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom- RELEASED INTERNALLY -Error 500 occurs when export suppliers link is pressed in mass data maintenance-Environment-Business byDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Mass Data Maintenance-Export Supplier Link-Adapt Migration Object-Ok-Cause-Based on checking in ST12 there is an inconsistent object instance-Resolution-Open CAM Backend-Transaction DMC_INC_CORR-Migration Object SUPPLIER_SCRIPT001-Execute Cleanup Report-Keywords-Error 500, supplier export, Adapt Migration Object, mass data maintenance-cleanup report,error 500

Title: Project invoice request is having net value as zero
Content: Symptom-You noticed that for few entries while doing project invoice request is showing net value as zero-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open Project invoice request-Go to Items tab-Go to Time and expenses sub tab-In item details you will see for few entries the net value is zero-Cause-Respective products in the project 2556 are not marked as billable.Billable means Invoiceable, if its not billable that means you cannot invoice.Hence system is behaving correctly by showing zero amount for non billable materials.-Resolution-Mark them as billable and check if  amount appears when you create new PIR

Title: Incident : Assignment of type /SRMAP/REQ_IR_NTF_CANCEL_PR BTM items not possible
Content: Symptom-You want to know how to action on this incidents- or-You see an unassigned  notification related to shopping cart like-"One or More Items in Shopping Cart XXX Canceled"-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue- Go to Application user management work center- Go to Incidents View- Search for the incident with above subject line- in the incident you will see below details-""Diagnostic Information-Health Check Component: Business Task Management -Health Check Name: Task without responsible-Error Information-Task Type Alias: /SRMAP/REQ_IR_NTF_CANCEL_PR  -Number of tasks without responsible for this task type: 1  -Responsible Application Component: AP-REQ-""-Cause-Go to Application and User  work center -Go to Business Task Management view -You can see below unassigned notification for Shopping Carts (REQ_IR(Internal request))-"One or More Items in Shopping Cart XXX Canceled"-Click on the latest action log you will see below information or similar information-"Business task is inconsistent - no valid responsible person/organization-Searching for responsible in non-configurable work category: Purchase Requesting Employee-Searching using method Requesting Employee as Defined in Purchase Document-Result:-Employee found:ABC (IDXXXX)-Employees removed because they have no validity:-Employee:ABC( IDXXXX )"-Since this user is no more valid or left your organization thus system cannot assign this task to this person.-also you cannot assign this task to any other person  using Assign button in Business task management view.-Resolution-There is a possibility to assign the shopping cart via Application user management work center>Shopping Cart Management view-Here you can search for Shopping Carts XXX by changing the filter of shopping cart status to include Canceled shopping carts in the filter result.-Then you can assign it to responsible employee.-Here system will show the list of employees in the list.-You can search for open shopping carts and assign them to another employee. The additional employee to whom the shopping carts are now assigned will be able to view and process them.-Please assign the Shopping Carts  XXX to active employees and then try to assign the task or do Determine Assignment.-So new employee to whom the shopping carts are now assigned should be able to take actions on notification.-Note:-It is possible to configure certain elements of this notification using the 'Business Task Management for Self-Service Procurement 'fine-tuning activity. For example, you can deactivate the notification in configuration if you do not need it in your business processes, or you can change the priority of the task notification.-See Also-2632150 - Notification - One or More Items in Shopping Cart Canceled by Buyer-3066043 - Notifications About Canceled Items in Shopping Carts-Keywords-Un assigned shopping cart task, One or More Items in Shopping Cart Canceled by Buyer

Title: "Model was Manually Changed - Upload not Possible" when using Transport Management with Analytic Content
Content: Symptom-You are trying to upload an analytical object which you have downloaded from another system, however you receive the error message 'Model was manually changed - upload not possible'. However, the file was not changed.-Environment-SAP Hybris Cloud for Customer-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Administrator work center > Transport Management and create New Transport Request.-Provide Transport Request Name > Save and Open-In Transport Objects tab Click on Select under Available Transport Objects and Select Transport Object type Analytical Content.-Select the object types which you can transfer in Analytical content its object ID-Now under the Target Systems tab Add System to which you would like to transfer the content-Click on Assemble and check the status in the Transport Logs-You get the message 'Model was manually changed - upload not possible'.-Cause-Your source and target system are on different release versions. Test systems are upgraded before production systems, so your test system is likely on a higher release version than your prod system.-Resolution-Transport Management  between different release versions is not recommended, since in certain scenarios it may result in inconsistencies. Please wait until your target system is on the same version as your source system.-If this report / data source is required urgently, please create it manually in your target system.-Keywords-Report, Data Source, Analytics, upload download, common tasks, Upload, Download, release, version, versions-upgrade

Title: Grant Create Access in Object OData for PartyKey/PartyID/content of Sales Unit Party in Customer Invoice Request BO
Content: Symptom-It is not possible to grant Create Access in Object OData for PartyKey/PartyID/content of Sales Unit Party in Customer Invoice Request BO, but the field is set to Change Only.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the work center Application and User Management > OData Services.-Select Custom OData Services from the dropdown.-Select an item and click Edit.-Under OData Service search for SalesUnitParty and expand.-Select the object PartyID.-It does not have Create Access and this can't be edited.-Cause-It is recommended to use an FSI enabled node for the write enabled node from ODATA services.-Resolution-Please use Party Node instead of Sales Unit Party Node with PartyTypeCode as 410 - functional unit, ROLE_CATEGORY_CODE as 44- Sales Unit Party,  ROLE_CODE as 44- Sales Unit which is both create and write enabled.-Keywords-FSI, Object OData, Create Access

Title: Payment terms are reset when changes are made to the account address in a contract.
Content: Symptom-After the adaption of an account address in a contract, the payment terms are reverted.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Open the work centre Sales Orders > Contracts-Search for the relevant contract-Click Edit/ View All-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoicing sub-tab-Change the Payment Terms field to a different value and click Save-Navigate to the Involved Parties tab and change the address of the account (e.g. the house number)-Click Save-Navigate to the Pricing and Invoicing tab and the Invoicing sub-tab-You can see that the payment terms have been reset to what they were previously.-Cause-When a change is performed on a party, such as the address, the system triggers some modifications to be run, one of which is a redetermine of the buyer details. As the payment terms in the master data differ from that in the document, it will be set to the master data details linked to the sales arrangement.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-Keywords-Change address, involved parties, automatically, edited,

Title: Employee Bank Details Data source shows 2 banks for an employee.
Content: Symptom-Employee Bank Details data source shows 2 banks for an employee while he has only one bank details maintained.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business analytics-Go to Data sources-Open Employee Bank Details-Filter for Employee ID-The Data source shows two bank names for the employee while you have maintained only one bank for the employee.-Cause-Employee Bank Details data source will bring all the banks associated with the employee. The employee also has another role which has bank detals maintained in Financial data. For eg: Employee has an Account role which also has Bank data maintained. Then the Data source will bring the bank details of the Account as well.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.

Title: Past or Specified Data Changes in Supplier Master Data are not Being Recorded
Content: Symptom-User reports that they need to see the past changes i.e., on specified date in Supplier master data but changes tab shows : “No Relevant change documents were found”-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supplier Base work center-Select Suppliers view-Edit any Supplier-Go to changes tab and select the specified date or past date-The changes were not registered in Changes tab and it shows as : “No Relevant change documents were found”-Cause-As missing changes are related to changes of the "Collaboration Data" of the suppliers and we cannot provide you any exact details of the changes in the past or specified date because these have not been recorded.-Resolution-Recording of changes related to the "Collaboration Data" will be enabled in the future.-See Also-2242885 - Data Changes in Supplier Are Not Being Logged-Keywords-Supplier master data changes, No Relevant change documents were found

Title: SIN not valid
Content: Symptom-Saving SIN number for Employee located in Canada raises SIN not valid error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Personnel Administration Workcenter-Go to Employees view-Edit the Employee -Go to Personal Data tab-Enter Social Insurance Number-Click Save-Error message 'SIN Entered is not valid' is raised.-Cause-The Social insurance number (SIN) is calculated using the Luhn algorithm.-Multiple the each digit of the number against the respective weight. If the product is greater than 9, then add the digits of the product. The sum of all the digits should be divisible by 10. -Weight used is 121212121-if the product value is greater than 9, eg,. 15 then the value should be (1 + 5 = 6) -eg.,-SIN      1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 ,Disclaimer: The number is for reference purpose only.-weight  1 2 1 2 1 2 1 2 1-product 5 6 8 0 7 5 2 5 6-1 * 1 = 1-2 * 2 = 4-3 * 1 = 3-4 * 2 = 8-5 * 1 = 5-6 * 2 = 12 ( 1 + 2 = 3 ) -7 * 1 = 7-8 * 2 = 16 ( 1 + 6 = 7 )-9 * 1 = 9-SUM  = 1 + 4 + 3 + 8 + 5 + 3 + 7 + 7 + 9 = 46-46 Mod 10 = 4, the sum is not divisible by 10.-Hence, 123-456-789 is an invalid SIN number.-If the SUM mod 10 is not equal to 0, then SIN number is invalid.-Resolution-Please enter the correct SIN nuumber.-See Also-Social Insurance Number, Canada, SIN not valid

Title: Restriction of Read and Write Access Against Common Task Stock Overview Doesn't Work for Business User .
Content: Symptom-You have several sites in the system, and you want to make the stock of some of them visible for a business user. You have set corresponding access restrictions for the business user, but he/she can still see stock of all sites.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon system as key user.-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Open view Business Users.-Find business user USER_A (USER_A represents the user ID), click Edit - Access Rights.-Select tab Access Restrictions, select view Stock Overview under work center Outbound Logistics Control, in the below only tick Read Access and Write Access for site SITE_A (Site_A represents site ID).-For all work center views whose Access Context is 1008 - Site, make same setting: only tick Read Access and Write Access for site SITE_A.-Logon system as business user USER_A.-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Open common task Stock Overview.-Display complete result, stock of all sites is visible.-Cause-Since this user has access to below work center views under work center "Planning and Production Master Data", he/she can still see stock of all sites:-Forecasting Groups-Planning Groups-Production Groups-Storage Groups-Resolution-Please take below steps:-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Open view Business Users.-Find business user USER_A (USER_A represents the user ID), click Edit - Access Rights.-Select tab Work Center and View Assignment, expand work center "Planning and Production Master Data", in the below untick below views:-Forecasting Groups-Planning Groups-Production Groups-Storage Groups-     5. Click Save.-See Also-KBA: 1879662 - Restrictions and Access Rights are not Working Correctly for Stock Overview-Keywords-Business User, Access Rights, Stock, Site

Title: Error When Trying to Create Warehouse Request "Conversion Failed".
Content: Symptom-You are running Inbound Warehouse Request Execution Run, but the Run is not creating Warehouse Request and ending up with errors:-"Inbound delivery notifications not processed".-"Conversion failed".-"Error while creating or updating follow-up document". -Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Inbound Logistics work center. -Go to the Automated Actions view and select Warehouse Request Runs. -Select and schedule the relevant active Run.-Wait for the Job to finish.-Open the relevant Application Log.-Go to the Results tab and Expand All.-You can see the mentioned error messages.-Also when you try to create the Warehouse Request manually, the system reports similar errors:-Conversion failed.-Error while creating or updating follow-up document.-You cannot save and create the warehouse request. Enter the required data first. For more information, see the subsequent error messages.-Cause-When Inbound delivery notifications are created in the ByD system, their ID is saved in capital letters. You have created the Delivery Notifications with lower case letters and as a result, the document is inconsistent.-Resolution-Please make sure however you create the Delivery Notifications (via add-on or web service) that the ID of the inbound delivery notifications are updated in capital letters and not in small letters.-Keywords-Inbound Delivery Notification, Run, Warehouse Request

Title: Approver of the Shopping Cart Cannot add the Attachments in to the Shopping Cart Document
Content: Symptom-As a shopping cart approver you want to add the attachments to the shopping cart, however it is not possible to add the attachments.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Managing my Area work center -Go to Approvals view -Select the relevant Shopping Cart Task -Edit the approval task and click on Add Attachments -Select Approve -The attachments were not visible in the shopping cart-Cause-The attachments added in the approval task will be stored at the task level. The reason behind this behavior is, the shopping cart is a user specific document. Only creator of the shopping cart can add the attachments and no other employee is entitled to access the document.-Resolution-This is an expected behaviour. It is not possible to add attachments  in the Shopping cart by the approver or any other employee except the creator.-Keywords-Approver cannot add attachments to shopping cart; Manager cannot add attachments to shopping cart; Shopping cart attachment;-

Title: How the Time Zone for Purchase Order Line Item Schedules is Determined?
Content: Symptom-You have created a purchase order in your time zone and when you look at line item schedules, it shows the different time zone. Hence you want to know, how the time zone for purchase order line item schedules is determined?-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Purchase Requests and Orders work center -Go to Purchase Orders view-Select the relevant Purchase Order-Click on Edit and navigate to Items tab-Select Delivery Schedule -System shows different date due to incorrect time zone-Cause-The Time Zone for schedule lines are determined by the country of origin from the Ship-To Location. For example, if purchase order belongs to Netherlands, system uses CET. You can see where time zone is this under "Additional Fields" option in Delivery Tab.-Resolution-This is expected behaviour.-Keywords-Time Zone for Purchase Order Line Item Schedules; PO time zone; PO delivery date; Line Item Schedules

Title: Supplier Multi-Channel settings cannot be updated using Migration or Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom-You are trying to update multi-channel collaboration data for a supplier using Migration tool Mass Data Maintenance but it ends in error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-When using Multi-Channel settings, neither the migration with mode “Enhance Already Existing Records” nor the mass data maintenance allows updating these settings.-Refer KBA 2825855 for further details-Resolution-You can always update it in the UI. If the number of Suppliers to be updated is large and if the process it time consuming then the only possibility would be via Web Service.-Please refer the sample payload below-<n0:SupplierBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0=" http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global ">-<BasicMessageHeader>-</BasicMessageHeader>-<Supplier actionCode="02" >-<InternalID>XXXXXX</InternalID>-<CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel actionCode="04" communicationChannelListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>11</CompoundServiceInterfaceCode>-<EnabledIndicator>true</EnabledIndicator>-<CommunicationChannel communicationEmailListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true">-<CommunicationMediumTypeCode>INT</CommunicationMediumTypeCode>-<CommunicationEmail>-<EmailURI>xx@xx.xx</EmailURI>-<RecipientFieldTypeCode>TO</RecipientFieldTypeCode>-</CommunicationEmail>-</CommunicationChannel>-</CommunicationArrangementMultiChannel>-</Supplier>-</n0:SupplierBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>-  Keywords-multi-channel collaboration, supplier

Title: Price per period field is not available in the migration template for customer contract
Content: Symptom-When trying to migrate a Customer Contract, the field "Price per Period" is not available in the migration template.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the work centre Business Configuration > Overview-Search for Migration of Customer Contracts, select it and click Open-Click the hyperlink "Migrate customer contracts using the migration tool"-Click on You Can Also and then Download Migration Template-In the migration template there is no "Price per Period" field included.-Cause- This is the current expected system behaviour.-Resolution-This functionality is not available yet and there is a new requirement request for a future release.-Keywords-Migration, contract, price per period

Title: Change Collector Not Displaying Data For Document
Content: Symptom-Change Collector is not able to fetch data for the Document-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Go to Change Collector Work Center View-Select Change Collector ID and execute-The execution run does not show any change data-Cause-The selection field Change Details and Selection criteria are not defined properly.-Resolution-Go to Application and User Management Work Center-Go to Change Collector Work Center View-Choose the relevant Change Collector ID -Select New->New Change Collector with Reference-Here maintain an ID-Select Validity Type 1 - Standard-Maintain the required Changes Made From and Changes Made To dates-Save and activate respectively execute-Check result.-See Also-https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/sap/support/notes/2242885-Keywords-Change Collector, Data Changes, No Logs Found

Title: ManageBankAdviceIn Web Service Error: External Payment Is Not a Valid Payment Method
Content: Symptom-You are using ManageBankAdviceIn Web Service to create External Payments and you receive an Error message-External Payment is not a valid Payment method.-Payment Form Code is maintained as 20 in the Request.-<PaymentFormCode>20</PaymentFormCode>-Environment-SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Execute the Request in SOAP UI or POSTMAN-Cause-External Payment is not be allowed as a Payment Method in case of Bank Payment Advices and Remittance Advices-Resolution-System works as designed-Keywords-ManageBankAdviceIn,External Payment,PaymentFormCode

Title: Not Able to Display Canceled Item in Contract or Sales Order Preview
Content: Symptom-If you generate the output of a contract or a sales order with the preview button, the canceled item does not appear in the PDF form.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the Sales Order ABC (where ABC stands for the sales order).-Click Preview button.-The canceled item is not displayed in the generated PDF.-The same system behavior for Contract.-Cause- Canceled items are not displayed in the generated output form.-Resolution- This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Canceled Item, Sales Order, Contract, Preview, PDF

Title: Creation Date of Supplier Invoice Does not Match Creation Date in Monitoring Invoices Report
Content: Symptom-You notice that the creation date in your Supplier Invoice differs to the creation date of the same Supplier Invoice displayed in "Monitoring Invoice" report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Analytics work center.-Go to the Design Reports view.-Search and Open the "Monitoring Invoices" (SRMIV_B03_Q0020) report.-Search "Document ID" as Supplier Invoice ABC (ABC is the Supplier Invoice ID).-Within Row Selection, navigate to Product Category and open the drop-down menu.-Select "Created On".-Click OK.-Click "Apply".-You notice that "Created On" date is DD.MM.YYYY in Report differs to the "Created On" date in Supplier Invoice ABC.-Cause- The difference in dates can be attributed to the user being logged in under different time zones.-Resolution-This is current system behavior.-You can change the time zone as follows:-Go to "My Settings" under Login profile in top right corner.-Under the "Regional Settings" tab, you can see the "Time Zone" field.-Change the time zone to the one of your choice.-Click Save and Close. -Keywords-Supplier Invoice, Monitoring Invoices, Report, timezone, creation date

Title: Deletion of Payment Data in Account Through Web Services Results in Inconsistency
Content: Symptom-You have created an Account through Web Service and later deleted the Payment data through the Web Service. This resulted in an inconsistent state of the Payment Data of the given account. Also, tt is not possible to delete it in the UI (Accounts view) or webservice.-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Service interface - ManageCustomerIn-Cause-Cause for the issue is that "paymentDataListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" is not correctly supported by the web service. The system will not completely delete objects of the payment data, and therefore leave an inconsistency in the system.-Resolution-In order to remove the Payment Data from Account, please follow the below instruction-1) Do not set the paymentDataListCompleteTransmissionIndicator-2) Delete all the entries for paymentData explicitely. This will be achieved via the following XML snippet:-<PaymentData actionCode="05">-<CompanyID>XYZ</CompanyID>-<AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode>ABC</AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode>-</PaymentData>-This will delete the payment data for a company XYZand the AccountDeterminationGroup ABC-3) If you need to change paymentData you can also do so for most atttributes:-please note that if you need to change the AccountDeterminationDebtorGroupCode, you have to delete the existing entry first, and create a new entry.-4) Afterwards you can create newPaymentData again-Currently the paymentDataListCompleteTransmissionIndicator cannot be supported by the webservice.-Keywords-Account, payment data, web service, managecustomerIn

Title: Discount Amount is Showing Different Values in Sales Order and Pro Forma Invoice
Content: Symptom-Discount amount is showing different values in sales order and Pro Forma Invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders work center and Sales Orders view.-Select the sales order ABC (ABC represents the Sales Order ID)-Click Pro Forma Invoice and discount shows value XX (XX represents the Discount value in Pro Forma Invoice)-Edit the Sales Order ABC and click View All.-Navigate to Items tab and discount shows value YY (YY represents the Discount value in Sales Order)-Cause-An extension field is used in the discount determination and this extension field is not extended to Invoice request screen.-Resolution-To resolve this issue, select the extension field in adaptation mode and then click Show Further Usage.-Go to extension Scenarios tab and add the below Extension Scenarios.-Sales Order - Item to Invoice Request Item-Invoice Requests - Item to Customer Invoice - Item-Keywords-Net Value different; wrong discount; extension field.

Title: Technical Users Not Authorized To Access Employee Self-Services
Content: Symptom-Re-hired employee or the Business user experiencing Incorrect Functionality, system throws error:--Technical users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home work center-Go to Self-Services Overview view-Below message is on screen:-Technical users are not authorized to access Employee Self-Services.-Cause-Possible causes:-User XYZ is Locked-Termination date of the employee is in the past.-Resolution-To unlock the user, it has to be done from your end as well by contacting Administrator.-The required user is supposed to be an Active Employee.-Check and correct the Termination date.-Keywords-Termination, Technical users

Title: After Check Task Confirmed With Scrap Quantity, Two Open Quantities In The Same Screen Under Tab Confirmation Are Different.
Content: Symptom-You have confirmed a check task with scrap quantity, however, under tab Confirmation, Open Quantity in Reporting Point Details is different from the Open Quantity in sub tab Output Products - General.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Go to view Task Control.-Search check task ABC (ABC represents task ID), click confirm.-Under tab Inspection, maintain Inspected Quantity as N1, Nonconforming Units as N2 (N1 + N2 = Planned Quantity of output product N3).-Click Finish Results Recording.-Under tab Confirmation, in the block "Reporting Point Details", N1 is proposed as Confirmed Quantity, N2 is proposed as Confirmed Scrap.-Click Save.-Now, in the block "Reporting Point Details", Total Confirmed Quantity is N1, Total Confirmed Scrap is N2 while Open Quantity is zero.-In the below select tab Output Products - General, Total Confirmed Quantity is N1 while Open Quantity is N2 (because Planned Quantity of output product N3 - N1 = N2).-You wonder why two open quantities are different.-Cause-The quantities in Reporting Point Details refers to the 'open qty' on the task level, whereas the product section refers to the open qty at planning level (Production Order).-The production order was created with planning qty N3. If the confirmed qty does not equal the planned qty, the open qty will be total planned qty minus total confirmed qty (N3 - N1) until the confirmation finished indicator is set on check task.-If the confirmation finished indicator is set to true, the production order qty are updated and the open qty will be in sync.-Resolution-This is the system standard behavior.-Keywords-Production, Check Task, Open Quantity

Title: INSS number field not available in web service managepersonnelhiringin
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-You have to fill a mandatory field 'INSS number' in UI. When you try to hire employees using web service managepersonnelhiringin, you get the error "INSS number missing".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The field 'INSS number' is not mandatory but can be made mandatory by scoping the question "Do you want INSS number field to be mandatory?".-The INSS number field is not extended to web service managepersonnelhiringin and hence it cannot be used in such cases where the 'INSS number' is made mandatory.-Resolution-Possible workaround is to use data migration to update the data.-Use the activity 'Migration of Employee Data - Non Localized Countries/Regions'>> Migrate basic employee data using the migration tool. In the migration file under 'Personnel Data' sheet, fields ID Card Type, ID Card Number" can be used to fill INSS Number.-Keywords-INSS number, managepersonnelhiringin, Migration of Employee Data

Title: In Third-Party Inter-Company Scenario, Serial Number in Outbound Delivery is Not Brought to Third-Party Delivery Notification Automatically.
Content: Symptom-In third-party inter-company document flow, serial number fulfilled in outbound delivery is not brought to new third-party delivery notification automatically.-Environment-SAP Businee ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-The whole document flow starts from sales order AAA, company CP1 sells goods to customer CT, but need to firstly purchase goods from company CP2 (through purchase order BBB), and for CP2 side, conversely it sells the same goods to CP1 (through sales order CCC). For outbound delivery OD1 of sales order CCC, it issues goods to customer CT directly.-Go to work center Outbound Logistics.-Go to view Outbound Deliveries.-Search OD1, click Edit.-Select tab Detailed Line Items, select sub tab Serial Numbers, there is a serial numbers SN1.-Go to work center Third-Party Order Fulfillment.-Go to view Third-Party Purchase Orders.-Search purchase order BBB, click New Third-Party Delivery Notification.-In the screen "New Third-Party Delivery Notification", select tab Line Items, select sub tab Serial Numbers, there are no serial number.-Cause-If the third-party delivery notification is created manually, then the serial number in corresponding outbound delivery will not be brought to this notification and you need to input it manually again.-If the third-party delivery notification is created through A2A message (which means it is created automatically once the corresponding outbound delivery released), the serial number in corresponding outbound delivery will be brought to this notification automatically.-For your case, since your third-party delivery notification was created manually, serial number will not be there automatically.-Resolution-Please make all necessary settings according to this blog "Intercompany Stock Transfer" and create new document flow to validate above situation 2.-See Also-Community Blog: Intercompany Stock Transfer-Keywords-Third Party, Inter Company, Serial Number, Delivery Notification

Title: Notes in Opportunity are Taken Over In the Customer Information of the Follow Up Document
Content: Symptom-You created a follow up document such as e.g. a Sales Quote from an Opportunity and the text in the Notes of the Opportunity is taken over in the follow up document in the Customer Information of the Notes in the General tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the New Business work center. -Select the Opportunity List view. -Open Opportunity ABC (ABC represents the ID of the Opportunity). -In the General tab you can see that there are Notes maintained. -Navigate to the Document Flow. -Open the document e.g. Sales Quote that was created as a follow up document from the Opportunity. -In the General tab under the Notes section you can see that the Notes from the Opportunity are taken over in the Customer Information.-Cause-The Notes in the Opportunity are of type Additional External Comment and are therefore taken over in a follow up document such as a Sales Quote in the Customer Information  under the Notes section in the General tab.-This has been introduced with Release 2211-The additional customer information maintained in the Notes section of the leads and opportunities documents, is now also reflected in the follow-up sales quote documents.-Please note that the logic was designed so that the transactional note should get preference over the master data note.-Resolution-This is the expected system behaviour.-There is currently no possibility to add internal notes to an opportunity. However, you can create an extension field for internal comments in the Opportunity to meet your requirement.-See Also-See also the Help Center Documentation for 2211 What's New in Customer Relationship Management-Under the section Transfer of Customer Information from Leads/ Opportunities to Sales Quote Documents.-Keywords-Opportunity; Notes; Internal Note; Sales Quote; Sales Order; follow-up; Customer Information

Title: Invoice Schedule Cannot be added in a Sales Orders Created via the Web Service
Content: Symptom-You want to create a Sales Order with an Invoice Schedule for an Item via the web service ManageSalesOrderIn.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-The Invoice Schedule is currently not supported in the standard Sales Order web service API and also not via oData.-Resolution-You can only add an Invoice Schedules manually in a Sales Order.-Keywords-Invoice Schedule; web service; OData

Title: Error: Agent CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI has triggered a fatal error
Content: Symptom-You are trying to consume the Inbound web service OutboundDeliveryExecutionIn to create an Outbound Delivery against Third Party Logistics Request. However, the system is not returning any response. When you check Web Service Message Monitoring, System displaying Error:Agent CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI has triggered a fatal error.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Application and User Management work center-Go to the Web Service Message Monitoring view.-Show Erroneous messages.-Filter for the Service Interface: OutboundDeliveryExecutionIn.-You can see multiple messages with the Error Text: Please see Application Info section in the dump for more details.-If you select any of the message, you can also see the Detailed Error Text: Agent CL_APDL_ODP_OUTDELEXECCONF_PAI has triggered a fatal error.-Cause-The system is dumping, because you have maintained the wrong timezone code under Shipping Date Time Period:-<ShippingDateTimePeriod>-<StartDateTime timeZoneCode="JST">2022-11-24T15:38:20Z</StartDateTime>-<EndDateTime timeZoneCode="JST">2022-11-24T15:38:20Z</EndDateTime>-</ShippingDateTimePeriod>-JST is not a valid Time Zone Code. The correct time zone code in this case is: JAPAN.-Resolution-Please maintain the correct time zone code, in this particular case, this will be:-<ShippingDateTimePeriod>-<StartDateTime timeZoneCode="JAPAN">2022-11-24T15:38:20Z</StartDateTime>-<EndDateTime timeZoneCode="JAPAN">2022-11-24T15:38:20Z</EndDateTime>-</ShippingDateTimePeriod>-Keywords-ODEC,  OutboundDeliveryExecutionConfirmation, Program:CL_APLEX_CHECK_VALID_DATE, CL_APLEX_CHECK_VALID_DATE_TIME=>CHECK_VALIDITY_DATE

Title: Cannot Create An Outgoing Delivery for External Logistics of Consignment Type
Content: Symptom-You cannot use the API Outbound Delivery Execution In to create an outgoing delivery for external logistics of Consignment type.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Third-party order processing combined with consignment is not supported.-Consignment in inter-company process with the receiving company managed in SAP Business ByDesign is not supported. This is because the receiving site in SAP Business ByDesign cannot support externally-owned stock. Consignment can be used in inter-company process where the receiving company is not managed in SAP Business ByDesign.-You can view help document for more information about the Out of Scope regarding Customer Consignment.-Resolution-This is expected system behavior.-See Also-Customer Consignment in Detail-Keywords-Consignment; Outbound Delivery Execution In; Out of Scope.

Title: SAP Business ByDesign 2211 Hotfix Collection 2 Information
Content: Symptom-Following is the list of fixes* delivered with the Hotfix collection 2 performed in 2211 release of SAP Business ByDesign.-The Hotfix collection is planned to be deployed to tenants during the respective planned maintenance window on/after the 10th of December 2022. Please check the planned maintenance downtime window of your tenant from the Service Control Center.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign 2211-Resolution-Cross - Area Topic-UI Client-The following issues have been fixed:-E-mail template could not be opened.-Data was missing after adjusting the size while printing a report. (Hotfix ID: 1000022180. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The issue preventing the enhancement of forms with extension fields has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500017986. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-SAP Ariba catalog item could not be taken back to SAP Business ByDesign after opening the external link. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500018009. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The issue with the wrong configuration for the cloud host in the allowed list of external links has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500018673. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The following issues have been fixed:-Public holiday was updated wrongly for an employee.-Screen in Project Management using the 'Quartz Dark' theme showed white characters in front of a light grey background. (Hotfix ID: 4500018673)-The following issues have been fixed:-Uploading the approval information for invoicing document as a single field value was failing.-Several empty pages were created by scaling the Print view. (Hotfix ID: 1000019285. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Business Task Management-Customer Return Approval tasks are now visible under the Managing My Area-> Approvals view, as expected. (Hotfix ID: 1000022091. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-The following issues have been fixed:-The application error preventing correct replication of new tasks to the Task Center.-The application error causing incorrect translation of the REST service name to be displayed on the Communication Arrangement UI. (Hotfix ID: 4500018693)-Machine Learning-With the fix provided, the RAW field can now be selected as a target field during Scenario Creation for Machine Learning Cockpit. (Hotfix ID: 1000022240)-Service Control Center-The fix provided improves the reliability of user subscription data. (Hotfix ID: 4500018832)-Output Management-Cloud Print Manager Installer is now upgraded to the latest patch level (SAP CLOUD PRINT MNGR 770 Patch 4) in the SAP Business ByDesign Download Center. (Hotfix ID: 4500014527)-Analytics Tools & Framework-In the Machine Learning Cockpit some joint data sources were not correctly processed. This issue has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000021473)-Retention Management-The fix provided includes:-Correction of rare errors when disclosing persons with a huge amount of data.-Correction of internal errors when performing the life cycle analysis run. (Hotfix ID: 1000018927)-Migration Workbench-The Mass Data Maintenance application was resulting in a 500 internal error (runtime) at times, due to migration object inconsistencies. These have now been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 1000018348)  -  Customer Relationship Management-Customer Invoicing-For an OTC document having multiple kit items with different quantities, the quantity for some of the kit items was not updated correctly. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500017573)-With this fix for the India customer invoice, the JSON file now considers the same date as that of the journal entry for the exchange rate and has the same values as the accounting document. (Hotfix ID: 1000020224)-Tax Calculation-With the fix provided, the errors that were appearing while creating a new BC for Tax Type in SAP Cloud Application Studio, for non-localized tax countries have now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000018135. The fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-In the case of jurisdiction codes that involved documents with multiple items and country, state, and county taxes for the US, there was a mismatch of the postal code region. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000020223)-Sales Order-The issue preventing project task assignment at the item level from sales quote to the sales order, has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000020636. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Groupware-You can now get the new SAP Business ByDesign add-in for Microsoft Outlook from the SAP Business ByDesign Download Center. (Hotfix ID: 1000019515. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Pricing Calculation-This fix resolves the application error that occurs when the Codelist type extension field is derived from a BCO. Previously, only that code list created via Key User Tools was supported. Now, this can be done via PDI solutions as well. (Hotfix ID: 4500019291)-  Financial Management-Tax Management & Declaration-The new tax rate of 5% VAT for Spain in Point-Of-Sale (POS) or external documents could not be selected manually. With this fix, a new tax code and tax event (both 320) have been provided so that it can be used based on the business need. The documents posted with this new tax code get reported in the 'Tax Return' and 'SII - Outgoing Invoices' tax returns for Spain. (Hotfix ID: 1000021383)-For Mexico, when the reverse charge tax code was used with ISR withholding tax, at the time of invoice payment, the withholding base amount and tax amount were calculated incorrectly. With this fix, the base amount and tax amount during the invoice creation have been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 1000020486)-The Summary Layout mapping entries in the Business Configuration fine-tuning activity for the Italy 'Summary Register' tax return have now been opened for maintenance by end users. This will enable end users to maintain the summary layout mapping entries by themselves based on their business needs. (Hotfix ID: 1000020855)-In version 13 of the Ukraine Outgoing tax invoice XML, the tax amount tag RXXXXG11_10 is now rounded off up to 6 decimal places. (Hotfix ID: 1000021721)-The tax number type value for the 'VAT Registration Number' for most countries is '1'. But this value can also be another number (other than '1') for instance, Bulgaria. Based on this value 1, the tax code determined earlier (before this fix) by the Spain decision tree was incorrect. Now, a blank value is passed for the PartnerTaxNumber parameter in the Spain decision tree, so that the correct tax code is determined. (Hotfix ID: 4500013889)-Low Value Asset can now be used as a filter in the Schedule of Fixed Asset-Global report and the Investment Allowance status will be auto-set to Completed once the Fixed Asset is Retired. (Hotfix ID: 4500013338)-For Spain, a new tax event and a tax code 170 (Acquisition by Travel Agencies under DA4) have been introduced for non-deductible tax rate types. The description of this new tax event and tax code is 'Acquisition by Travel Agencies under DA4. (Hotfix ID: 4500017825)-For the country IL, VAT PCN874 tax return file record 'K' had the invoice date populated from positions 11 to 19 (both included) instead of the posting date. With this bug fix, the posting date is populated in record K instead of the invoice date. (Hotfix ID: 1000018829. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Financial Accounting-Inventory Re-valuation is now triggered during the reversal process of Manual Postings. (Hotfix ID: 1000020637)-With this fix, the current limitation in payments is removed and during the reversal of payments with cash discounts that relate to landed costs, the discount amount now reflects correctly on the clearing set of the supplier invoices. This removes the need for a manual write-up/write-down journal entry in such a case. (Hotfix ID: 4500018455)-During Fixed Asset Migration using the simple and extended template, there is an option now to enter the field Work Shift-Dependent Depreciation (Percent) from the template. (Hotfix ID: 4500017467)-With the fix provided, the negative posting will not be allowed for journal entries for the set of books, where negative posting is marked as not allowed. (Hotfix ID: 4500014848)-The preceding document in the accounting notification has now been PSM released and is available to be used for partner development. (Hotfix ID: 1000019286. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Payment Management-When executing payment media run for outgoing cheques, the cheques which were in cancellation approval also got picked by payment media run and the status was getting updated to "in transfer" internally and making the instance inconsistent.  With the fix provided, changes have been introduced to not pick up the instances which are in cancel approval. (Hotfix ID: 4500019931)-With this fix, the Bank statement items post-processing link opens the allocation screen quickly. (Hotfix ID: 4500017826)-Cost & Revenue-In IFRS15 scenario, some sales orders had errors during revenue recognition, causing other sales orders to fail along with them. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000018518)-Statutory Reporting-'BKMVDATA file content is now enhanced with the following topics.-Summary Accounts are now removed from the file. Prior to this, summary accounts were part of the file, causing duplicate amounts.-All GL Accounts are now part of the file. Prior to this, only GL Accounts having some transactions in the given accounting period were part of the file. (Hotfix IDs: 4500019232, 1000021004)-General Ledger-The association Item.MiscellaneousLedgerAccountItem (MSCLA_ITEM) is now PSM write-released and partners can access the node data. (Hotfix ID: 4500013909)-'Manage Journal Entry API' for Canada could not be used due to an issue with reading the Canada region code. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500019067)-Set of Books-The Currency Conversion field of Business Object Set of Books is now PSM released with read access for Custom development. (Hotfix ID: 4500019563)-Receivables-The issue with the 'Created By' parameter in the advanced filter for receivables balance confirmation has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500016737)-Costing-With the fix provided Landed Cost Components are now considered in the Actual Costing. (Hotfix ID: 4500015959)-Clearing House Payment Order-This fix provides a renewed certificate for the integration with the service provider, Computop Inc. for Credit card processing with ByDesign. (Hotfix ID: 4500019442)-Accounting Lease Management-AccountingDocument.Item.LeaseContractUUID and AccountingDocument.Item.LeaseContractObjectUUID have been PSM read-released and associated with AccountingDocument.Item. (Hotfix ID: 1000020266)-Expense Report-The UK advisory fuel rates have been updated from December 1, 2022, based on the legal change. (Hotfix ID: 1000018766)-Payment Processing-The issue where an approval task was sent to multiple users, including unauthorized users has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000020927)-FCRE GL (Foreign Currency Remeasurement Run for General Ledger) postings  of journal entry type code ‘00069’ and its reversal postings of journal entry type code ‘90069’ are no longer displayed in the General Ledger Accounts Open Items Manager (OIM) UI, as these postings were not supposed to be displayed in the General Ledger Accounts OIM. (Hotfix ID: 1000020705)-Analytics Content-Sales Documents Actual Costing - Cost Breakdown (Item Type) showed the value doubled in valuation quantity when material and service items were present in the breakdown. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022260)-  Project Management-Project Processing-The generic search field of the Project Stock Order list in the Project Management work center did not consider the project's name as a search relevant field. The issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000022190)-When a Project Stock Order is created via UI the Product Requirement Specification is determined by the system. When the Project Stock Order is created via PDI or service, the Product Requirement Specification was not determined. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500015498)-The following actions of Business Object ProjectBaseline, node Root are released for PSM and can be consumed in projects in SAP Cloud Application Studio or in a Custom OData Service:-Activate-SubmitForApproval-WithdrawFromApproval-SendBackForRevision-Approve (Hotfix ID: 1000021961)-The provision date of project expenses was displayed in the time zone of the expense instead of the time zone of the project. This has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000018558)-Customer Project Invoice-An expense (for example a Supplier Invoice) contains multiple items. Some expense items in Project Invoicing are marked as relevant for processing in a project invoice request although they should not be. This could lead to an error during the processing of these expense items. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500015559)-An issue that could occur when expenses in project invoicing switch between over-invoicing and other scenarios (such as writing expenses off), has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000020332. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-  Human Capital Management-Time & Labour Management-Changing/assigning time recording profile codes to employees via custom solutions, was not possible due to an issue. The issue has now been fixed and time recording profile code of employees can be updated via any custom solution. (Hotfix ID: 4500019211)-  Supply Chain Management-Site Logistics Processing-When a cost center having multiple cost center attributes was used in screens such scrapping and goods movement, and the actual execution date fell within the validity range of a cost center attribute which was not active, the system showed the error 'Transaction date must be within validity period of cost center xxx', although the cost center was valid during that time. With this fix, the issue has been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 1000019614)-Outbound Delivery-On creation of 3PL Outbound Delivery containing materials that have 'Relevant for Outbound Delivery' attachments and multiple Identified Stocks in Outbound Delivery, was resulting in a runtime error in the system. This issue has now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000018389)-Production Task-The production task double printing form issue due to the PDI solution has now been resolved. (Hotfix ID: 4500019910)-Available to Promise Check Run-Due to an issue, the confirmation update run was failing for complete delivery orders with sales kit, when the availability check scope on the kit item is set to 'All supply except unfirm receipts'. This issue has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500017517)-Inventory-The data shown in inventory aging was inconsistent for a particular execution date with and without site as filter criteria. This issue has been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500016747)-The performance issues appearing while releasing production orders have now been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 1000018237)-  Supplier Relationship Management-Supplier Invoicing-With this fix, 'PaymentReferenceIBANIdentifier' is available for a scanned invoice. (Hotfix ID: 4500012189)-The errors in the Allocation Document for Numerical cost components have been fixed. (Hotfix ID: 4500016965)-With this fix for the Italy supplier invoice XML, the total amount value is the sum of the individual item amount values. The XML now considers the same values as in the accounting document. (Hotfix ID: 1000020596)-Purchase Requests and Orders-UI text adoptions which had led to issues in some partner lookups in Excel reports have now been reverted. (Hotfix ID: 4500016804. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Financial documents were not created correctly when a purchase order with landed cost items were released due to missing internal formatting of the landed cost components. With the fix provided the format of the landed cost components has been corrected. (Hotfix ID: 4500018395. This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-Open Catalog Interface-With this fix for Catalog Integration, you can import items from External catalogs. (Hotfix ID: 4500016026.This fix has already been delivered as a patch.)-      *Disclaimer: Note that this list may not include all of the hotfixes that are a part of this collection (e.g., operational, internal, technical fixes may not be listed).-See Also-KBA 2938382 - SAP Business ByDesign Hotfix Collection Information-Keywords-“ByD2211”, “HFC02”

Title: Is there any Tools to access the Certificate Downloaded from Event Notification
Content: Symptom-You have downloaded the Certificate from Event Notification screen and you would like to know, if there any tools to extract the key-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Cause-The certificate that is downloaded in Event Notification screen is not of the right format.-Resolution-Please download the certificate from Communication arrangement screen -> Download tenant certificate. This certificate can be used for Event Notification as well.-Importing Key Pair File to a Third Party Tool-Keywords-event notification, tenant certificate, tool

Title: Error Message "Activity is Read-Only; Settings Cannot be Changed" While Editing Activity Email and Fax Settings
