Content: Symptom-In the Business Configuration overview, when you try to edit an activity Email and Fax Settings, system throws the below message:- "Activity is read-only; settings cannot be changed"-Environment-SAP Business  ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search for the activity Email and Fax Settings .-Click the Edit .-You see the message " Activity is read-only; settings cannot be changed"-Cause-The message might be displayed due to one of the below reasons:-You do not have an open project (with status Started) on your tenant.-The activity in question is not added to any project.-Resolution-If there is an Open Project (with status Started) on your tenant and if activity in question is added to any project follow below steps-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Access the Overview view.-Search for the activity Email and Fax Settings and select option button .-Click on Change Immediately.-Click on Email and Fax Settings-Now you can edit the activity.-See Also-2292221 - Error Message "Activity is Read-Only; Settings Cannot be Changed" While Editing Activity in Business Configuration (https://userapps.support.sap.com/sap/support/knowledge/en/2292221)-Keywords-Modify Email and Fax Settings, Unable to edit Email and Fax Settings activity-modify email and fax settings,unable to edit email and fax settings

Title: The Text Box "Work Instruction" is Not Editable in a Production Task
Content: Symptom-When confirming a production task, under tab Instruction, the text box Work Instruction is not editable.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center  Production Control.-Go to view Task Control.-Select a production task, click Confirm.-Select tab Instruction, we can see the text box Work Instruction is not editable.-Cause-In corresponding production model, select tab Bill of Operations, select sub tab BoO Structure, select corresponding activity, in the below, select tab Activity Descriptions, there is a text box called Work Instruction. The content in this text box will be brought to the corresponding production task and displayed in text box Work Instruction there. This text box is editable in production model but not editable in production task.-Resolution-System standard behavior.-Keywords-Work Instruction, Production Task, Production Model

Title: Standard Report of Material List GTIN wise
Content: Symptom-You are not able to find any Standard Report of Material Master GTIN wise.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics WoC-Go to Design Reports view.-Search for GTIN report.-No results found.-Cause-Currently, there is no report exists with GTIN and Material Data.-Resolution-You can create your own report using the standard data source 'Material General Data'. This has data of GTIN and Product ID(from the material Business object ).-Creating reports via a standalone data source is a new enhancement.-NOTE: The GTIN data cannot be fetched using the Design Data Source for which Quantity Characteristics are not maintained.This is a limitation.-Add any quantity characteristic like Net Weight for Material, in case to view the GTIN for the Design Data Source.-See Also-Data source documentation of the available data sources and reports available in the system-https://help.sap.com/doc/0cb1a8377ed34291887409d02e183785/2205/en-US/E-MDAV-DOKU.pdf-Keywords-Design Reports, GTIN data, Material Master, Material General Data,  Design Data Source

Title: Cannot Find A Production Request Under Work Center Production Control View Production Requests Through Initial Query "All Production Requests".
Content: Symptom-In work center Production Control view Production Requests, you select "All Production Requets" in drop-down menu and search a production request, but there is nothing in result.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Open view Production Requests.-Select All Production Requests in drop-down menu.-Search production request ABC (ABC represents production request ID), no result.-Cause-Open advanced filter, we can see Cancellation Status is Not Canceled by default; Closure Status is Not Closed by default.-Remove the value in the two filters, enter ABC in Production Request ID, click Go, production request ABC displayed and it is canceled.-Resolution-The initial query "All Production Requests" has two preset filters: Cancellation Status is Not Canceled; Closure Status is Not Closed.-This is system standard behavior.-If you want to have a query without any preset filters, you can create a custom one.-Keywords-Production Request, All Production Requests, Find, Found, Query

Title: Time recording method is not updated after replication
Content: Symptom-You have noticed after replicating time data, Time recording method of an Employee is not updated.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Time Recording method cannot be updated using replication.-The initial replication of employee time recording method is set to exception-based. It can be then changed manually in the time file to positive time recording method. Once this is changed to positive time recording, it does not get refreshed back to exception-based from positive using replication.-Resolution-You can change it manually from Exception-based to Positive and vice versa by below steps.-Go to Time Administration work center.-Go to Time sheet view.-Select the Employee XYZ.-Click Open Time Sheet tab.-Click You can also from top right corner > click Open Time File.-Go to Time Profile > Basic Data tab.-Time Recording Method: Select the Time recoding method.-Keywords-Exception-based, Positive, Time recording method,

Title: System Dumps During Adjustment Confirmation
Content: Symptom-System crashes when performing Adjustment Confirmation.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Inbound Logistics work center.-Go to By Warehouse Order Sub-view under Monitoring view.-Choose the Warehouse order ID ABC (where ABC represents the Warehouse order ID).-Choose Edit.-Choose Adjustment Confirmation.-Select the relevant Line Item with the Product to adjust.-Choose Enable Entry.-Enter the negative value of the quantity to be adjusted in the Quantity Difference field.-Choose Save.-System throws dump error. -Cause-Adjustment of the relevant Line Item is not possible as the Product has a Fulfilled Quantity of zero.-Resolution-The system is behaving as designed.-Keywords-Adjustment Confirmation; Dump; Undo Release; Quantity Difference; Zero Fulfilled Quantity; SAP ByDesign; System Crash; Warehouse Order; Fulfilled; Negative Value

Title: You are not Able to Resubmit the Customer Invoices
Content: Symptom-You want to resubmit a customer invoice, but the Resubmit button is disabled in the Output History tab.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the customer invoicing work center.-Go to the Invoice Documents view.-Open the invoice XYA , in Output History tab, the resumit button is disabled. (XYZ represents the ID of a customer invoice)-Cause-In the Output History tab, there are 2 output records.-1. Resubmission of customer invoice XYZ.-2. customer invoice XYZ. (original output)-When accessing to the Output History tab, bydefault, system selects the latest submitted output which is "Resubmission of customer invoice XYZ.". Resubtting a resubmited output is not allowed, so the button is disabled.-Resolution-You need to manually select the original output record, then the Resubmit button will be enabled.

Title: CSV Export and Excel Import
Content: Symptom-Microsoft Excel interprets cells of CSV files. This could have two consequences:-Cells containing certain patterns (like “=2+3”) don´t show their pure content but display a calculation result (like “5”).-Malicious users could enter fields in ByDesign that intentionally show wrong results when exported to CSV.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Cause-The general recommendation is to adjust interpreted CSV cells, e.g. every leading “=” should be prefixed by an apostrophe (like “'=2+3”).-In ByDesign, CSV files are not only used for data display in Excel but also for general data export and import. At several places field values have direct impact of business (e.g.: the ID “=ABC” is different from the ID “'=ABC”). Tests have shown that such a modification leads to critical issues. In consequence, ByDesign cannot follow the recommendation; it leaves the data unchanged during export. (“=2+3” remains “=2+3”.)-Resolution-To avoid that issues interfere with other parts of the document or exploit known vulnerabilities:-Follow your company policy of keeping the software (Excel or other spreadsheet applications used) up to date.-Recommend users to be cautious while dealing with CSV files with macros, following general best practices.-Keywords-CSV, Injection, Export, Import, Excel

Title: Error on the Sales Order: "Sum of Dates' Amounts Exceeds the Item's Amount"
Content: Symptom-You have created a sales order and maintained invoice schedule with 100% for the lines, system reports the below error hence you are not able to release it.-Error: Sum of dates' amounts XXX exceeds the item's amount YYY. (XXX, YYY represent the values of the amounts)-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Sales Orders work center.-Go to the Sales Orders view.-Open the order ABC. (ABC represents the ID of sales order).-You can see the errors at the bottom. -Cause-The error is due to the sum of the invoice schedule amount of the dates exceeds the item total amount.-For example, the line 10 has item total amount as 329,899.70 EUR.-There are 2 invoice dates created for the line 10 in Invoice Scheduling tab.-Date 1, percentage=95%, amount=313,404.72 EUR.-Date 2, percentage=5%, amount=16,494.99 EUR.-So the sum of dates= 313,404.72 + 16,494.99=329,899.71. This sum amount exceeds the item total 329,899.70 by 0.01.-And this difference is caused due to rounding when calculating the date amount by percentage.-Resolution-You can manually adjust the date amount in the Invoice Schedule.-For example, manually change 313,404.72 into 313,404.71. The percentage remains as 95%, invoice total changes to 329,899.70 and the error is then removed.-Keywords-Sum of Dates' Amounts Exceeds the Item's Amount; invoice schedule; sales order.

Title: Lead IDs in the system are different from the Lead IDs in the Migrated File
Content: Symptom-You are migrating Leads from an External system to SAP Business ByDesign. After migrating the Leads, the Lead ID's in the system are different from those maintained in the Migrated file.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-To migrate Leads:-Go to the Business Configuration work center.-Select the Overview view.-Search and Open the activity Migration of Leads.-Select Migrate leads using the migration tool.-Upload the Migration File from Data from Migrate template.-Execute Migration from Execute Migration Step by Step.-Migration is Completed.-To check the availability of the migrated Lead ID:-Go to the Marketing work center.-Go to the Leads view.-Search for the Migrated Lead ABC (where ABC represents the Lead ID you maintained in the migration file).-Unable to find the Lead ID: ABC-Cause-When you migrate Leads into the system, the system will use the New Lead ID's of the migration service, from the Internal Number Ranges.-However, you must fill the Lead ID field in the migration template which is the identifier for the Lead. It is used for the template-internal identification between different worksheets and will not be migrated. The system will use the internal numbering during the creation of Leads for the Lead ID.-Resolution-It is not possible to upload the same Lead IDs as maintained in the Number Range in your External system. This is the expected system behavior.-Keywords-Leads, Lead ID, Migration of Leads

Title: Which UoM System Will Propose in Common Task New Removal
Content: Symptom-For any product, in its master data, there are three kinds of UoM: Base UoM, Inventory Valuation UoM and Planning UoM. You wonder which UoM system will propose in the common task New Removal.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Internal Logistics.-Open common task New Removal.-Enter product ABC (ABC represents the product ID) in Product ID, click Go.-In the below, enter any quantity in Removal Quantity, press Enter on your keyboard, system proposes an UoM.-You wonder which UoM it is, Base UoM, Inventory Valuation or Planning UoM?-Resolution-System proposes Base UoM here, but you can change it to other kinds of UoM manually.-Keywords-New Removal, UoM

Title: Inventory Business Object Is Disabled For Public Write Access In PSM [INTERNAL ONLY]
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY -Inventory Business Object Is Not Set to Be Writable or Public Write Access is Disabled.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign [All versions]-Reproducing the Issue- Logon to SAP Backend -Transaction MDRS > Select 'Business Object'-Enter APINV_INVENTORY-You can see it does not have 'Public Write Access' enabled-Cause-Due to technical limitations, The Inventory BO --Cannot be PSM write released as it is updated by confirmation documents (GAC, Warehouse Confirmation and Production confirmation).-Cannot be marked as relevant for extensibility (the BO in itself can’t support extensibility and there is no workaround for it).-We cannot expose Inventory BO for OData modelling. However, there is a workaround here – we have a data source for Stock Overview (SCMINVV02) and the customers can build an OData service on this Data source.-Resolution-It is not possible to provide public write access to Inventory BO. However, the BO is PSM released.-Keywords-Inventory BO, PSM, public write access, MDRS, APINV_INVENTORY

Title: Fields in Employee Time Sheet not PSM Released
Content: Symptom-For a PDI development you don't have access to the following fields in the Employee Time Sheet in Time Administration work center:-Planned Working Time-Recorded Time-Absences-Overtime-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-These fields cannot be PSM released as the values for the fields are calculated and not persisted as per the current logic for the UI.  However, relates attributes are part of reports & data sources – like HCMTLMU01. To extract related information, you might consider to build a custom ODATA service based on related reports / data sources.-Resolution-A PSM Release is currently not supported.-Keywords-need, require, requirement, field, develop, build, building, UI, user, interact, see, times, check, status, time, script, read, out, not possible, able, unable, PSM Release Request f

Title: System is Generating Stock Transfer Demands Continuously When You Execute Multi-Level Planning Run
Content: Symptom-You have a Sales Order, but the system is continuously generating Stock Transfer Demands at your two Sites when you execute Multi-Level Planning Run for a particular Product.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Supply Planning work center.-Go to the Products view.-Find the relevant Product and Planning Area combination and select same.-Click Open to open the Product Planning Details.-You can see that there are thousands of secondary Demands in the form of Stock Transfer Demand.-Also when you check the Source of the Stock Transfer Proposals, you can see that the system has equally created secondary demands with the source being the current Planning Area.-Further, there is just a single Sales Order.-Now when you check the Planning Run, you can see the Proposals have been created for both Planning Areas through the Run.-You therefore want to understand why the system is creating the Stock Transfer Proposals at these two Planning Areas.-Cause-We have checked the issue and below are our observations:-We can see that the problem for the mentioned product arises from the system design.-For the affected Product, Demand is generated from the Sales Order at Site A (A represents the Site ID). However, if you check the Transport Lane for Site A, the requirement for the site is fulfilled from Site B (B represents Site ID). And on the other hand, the Demand in Site B is fulfilled from Site A.-Further, you have maintained the procurement type as internal procurement in the Material Master of the Product for the two Sites and therefore there is no real source of supply for this product. Consequently, this has formed a recursion and whenever you trigger multi-level planning run, the system is continuously generating demand and supply for the same product in both the sites. -Resolution-As a resolution for this scenario, we recommend you provide the point of source from which the product will have the stock into the system and the same can be utilized whenever there is a demand. This means one of internal procurement must be removed from one of the Site. Depending on your master data, you can maintain In-House Production or External Procurement.-We recommend you delete the generated stock transfer proposals. Once you have deleted the Stock Transfer Proposals, please kindly resolve the recursive cycle for these two sites and try to execute the multi-level planning Run thereafter. This should produce the desired result.-Keywords-Stock Transfer Proposal, Stock Transfer Demand, Planning Run, Multi-level, Multi BOM level

Title: Purchase Order Monitoring Report Does not Show the Delivered Value of Purchase Order
Content: Symptom-Purchase order does not show the Delivered Value in the Purchase Order Monitoring report.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics work center-Go to Design reports view-Search for Purchase Order Monitoring report-Open report and search for relevant Purchase order-Delivered Value appears zero-Cause-Monitoring Purchase Orders report is based on Data Source ID SRMPO_B02 & Data Source Name Purchase Order Item Details. If you go to the item document flow of Purchase Order, for inbound delivery document the amount field is blank. In case of inbound delivery, we do not show the delivered value as it is intend to show more on delivered quantity.-Resolution-System will not show the delivered value for inbound delivery document in Monitoring Purchase Orders report and its an expected behaviour. For Non-Stock scenario and Third-Party orders, Delivered Value will be displayed except To-Stock scenario in any purchasing reports.-Keywords-Monitoring Purchase Orders report; Delivered Value in Monitoring Purchase Orders; Data Source ID SRMPO_B02; Delivered Value appears zero

Title: All About New Communication Scenario for REST Services in SAP Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-With SAP Business Bydesign 2211 release, A new communication scenario for REST services is now available in SAP Business ByDesign. This enables you to create a communication setup for the REST services from the Communication Arrangements view, for technical user-based communication.-This documentation is to provide additional details related to this communication Scenario-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Resolution-The new communication Scenario is available when you create a New Communication Arrangment using below steps,-Go to Application and User Management work center-Communication Arrangments view-Click New button-Search and select the Communication Scenario "Rest Services"-In the next step select a system instance-In 'Define Technical data' you can find the Rest Services.-Select 'Assigned" check box and move on to next steps-Finsh the setup-Now, the communication arrangment is ready to use.-In case, if there is no Rest Services then there is no Rest Services are available in the system. In SAP Business bydesign, one of the Rest Service which is available is SCIM. Below are the steps to enable from Scoping-Go to Business Configuration work center-Select Implementation projects view-Click Edit Project Scope-Go to Questions-Expand Built-in Services and Support-Expand System Management-Highlight User and access management-Under section SCIM Enablement, you find the Question - Do you want to enable SAP Business ByDesign as the System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM 2.0) service provider?-Check the question and complete the Scoping-Now, you can find the SCIM Rest Service in Communication Arrangment for assignment-To know about SCIM integration; Click the Download button in the Communication Arrangment in the screen where you find the SCIM service for assignment-Additional Information:-Just like how you create communication arrangements to consume OData services using the scenario OData Integration, this is another scenario, similar to it, to expose the REST Services. Using this, you can create communication arrangements to enable the consumption of the available REST Services.-The newly introduced scenario is similar to the "OData Services for Business Objects" scenario. This one is to consume the OData services. With the new scenario "REST Services" we have introduced a harmonized way to to create communication setup to consume the REST Services.-Keywords-rest services, odata, communication scenario, scim, scim integration

Title: Refresh Worklist button not available
Content: Symptom-Refresh Worklist button not available in Edit Time Sheet view.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Home Workcentre-Go to Self-Services view-Edit Time Sheet-Refresh Worklist Button not available.-Cause-You have chosen either Day, Month or Week option from the View menu.-Resolution-Please choose the 'Worklist' from the View on the right side. Then the Refresh Worklist Button will be available.-In case, if last save is Day view then the next time when access the Edit Time Sheet, the view will remain day-Keywords-Worklist, Refresh Worklist, Self-Services, Time Sheet

Title: Activation of Landed Costs in SAP Business ByDesign Version 2211
Content: Symptom-The Landed Costs feature is made available with SAP Business ByDesign Version 2211.-You notice that related scoping question cannot be selected and therefore the Landed Costs solution cannot be activated in your system.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work Center - Implementation Projects view.-Highlight First Implementation and click on Edit Project Scope.-Press Next until Tab 4-Questions.-Expand Scoping Element Purchasing.-Expand node Purchase Request and Order Management.-Select on Purchase Orders.-The scoping question "Do you want to plan landed costs in purchase orders" is greyed out and cannot be activated.-Cause-Actual Costing has been enabled in this system.-Edit Project Scope.-Press Next until tab 3 - Scoping.-Expand Scoping Element Financial and Management Accounting.-Expand node Inventory Valuation.-Actual Costing is selected.-As a cautionary measure it has been decided not to run the Actual Costing and Landed Cost framework in parallel at this point in time with the 2211 Upgrade.-Both Scoping Elements therefore are mutual exclusive. Conversely, when the new Landed Cost feature is scoped an activation of Actual Costing is not supported at the moment.-Please also refer to blog: Landed Costs in SAP Business ByDesign – Miscellaneous | SAP Blogs-7    Known limitations-Resolution-We are planning to release the Landed Costs functionality in parallel with Actual Costing in a next hotfix collection.-The prospective time-frame is mid December 2022, subject to technical changes.-Keywords-Landed Costs, Actual Costing, 2211, Scoping

Title: Unable to Update Supplier Product Category via Migration or Mass Data Maintenance
Content: Symptom- Unable to Update Supplier Product Category via Migration or Mass Data Maintenance-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration Work Center-Go to Overview View-Search for Activity Migration of Supplier and Open it.-Download Migration Template for Supplier-Product Category sheet is not available in Migration Template-Cause-The feature is not available for SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is a new requirement. You may register your idea/requirement for this feature in Customer Influence for SAP Business ByDesign at https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also- https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-Keywords- Product Category sheet, Migration of Supplier , Migration Template

Title: How the System Identifies Which Supplier Type is Assigned in A-29 Reports
Content: Symptom-You have generated the A-29 report, and you doubt how the system identifies which supplier type is assigned in Tax Return.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Tax Management work center.-Go to A-29 Reports view.-Show All Tax Reports ad search the one in question.-View the Tax Report in question.-View Tax Return tab..-You can see that different supplier types are assigned, and you doubt how the system identifies which supplier type is assigned.-Resolution-The supplier type code value is getting filled if the below conditions are met.-In case of expense report documents, creditor party is not filled then it comes under 05 - Foreign. A-29 report must report the supplier's tax ID and not the employee's tax ID.-For document does have a supplier and the tax number, the system will check whether the tax number is a Mexican tax number. If yes, it will be under 04 - National. If not, it will be under 05 - Foreign.-Keywords-A-29 Report, Tax Return, Supplier Type, 04 - National, 05 - Foreign

Title: A Business User Has Not Been Assigned Stock Overview In Access Right, But He Can Still See It In Common Task.
Content: Symptom-A business user is only assigned to work center / view "Delivery Proposals", but the user can see common task Stock Overview.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Logon system as Administrator User.-Go to work center Application and User Management.-Go to view Business Users.-Find business user BU_1, click Edit - Access Rights.-Select tab Work Center and View Assignment, assign work center CC_HOME and all views under this work center to this user; assign view Delivery Proposals under work center Outbound Logistics to this user.-Click Save.-Logon system as BU_1, Expand work center Outbound Logistics, I can see not only view Delivery Proposals under Delivery Control, but also common task Stock Overview.-Cause-The Common Tasks are assigned directly to the Workcenter view and are not independent entities. Hence, the authorizations cannot be controlled for the individual common task such as Stock Overview.-The Delivery Control Workcenter view has New Return to Supplier, Projected Material Flow, Stock Overview and Serial Inventory Views assigned to it under the Common Tasks. Access right to Delivery Proposals (which is under Delivery Control) also brings access right to above four common tasks.-Resolution-This is system standard behavior.-Keywords-Stock Overview, Access Right, Work Center, View, Common Task

Title: You Are Not Able to Release Customer Invoices Due to Error: “Document Numbering Rule Missing for Italy”
Content: Symptom-You have maintained document numbering rules for country Italay, but still get error: "document numbering rule missing for Italy" while saving a customer invoice.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Customer Invoicing - Invoice Requests work center view.-Search the invoice request ABC. (ABC represents the ID of a customer invoice)-Click Invoice button and then in the new invoice, click Save or Release.-The error "document numbering rule missing for Italy" shows up, you are not able to save the invoice.-Cause-In the BC activity: Document Numbering Formats for Customer Invoicing -> Define document numbering formats for France and Italy, you have maintained rules for Customer Locations: Domestic and EU customer.-The Customer Location column is based on the Payer's address, in this case, the payer is in country US, so there is no rule matches.-Resolution-You need to create a new rule for Customer Location=Non-EU Customer.-Keywords-Customer Invoice; Italy; Document Numbering Rule Missing for Italy; Customer Location.

Title: External Tax Code Not Determined As Expected
Content: Symptom-You have tried to set the external tax determination settings, but the Tax Code still not determined as expected.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Create a New Sales Order-Maintain neccesary data -You can see Tax Code not determined as expected-Cause-Go to the Business Configuration work center -Choose the Implementation Projects view.  -Select your implementation project and click Open Activity List-Select the Fine-Tune phase-Select the External Tax Determination for Goods and Services activity-The issue can be cuased by the following reasons:-1. You have to check if the relevant roles of the business partners involved have been maintained correctly.-contract-from (CF) party-contract-to (CT) party-ship-from (SF) party-ship-to (ST) party-bill-from (BF) party-bill-to (BT) party-service location (SL)-2. Check if the system is considering the scenario as Third party Deal. You can add "Service" field from Adaptation Mode under Item level in the sales order and if you notice Fulfilment is 'External' also 'Supplier' is maintained. Hence system is considering it as Third party Deal. However, in external tax determination configuration Third-Party Deal checkbox is not checked.-3. Tax number is not maintained for the involved parties in the sales order.-Resolution-1. Maintain the correct business partners involved in the activity.-2. Check the Third-Party Deal checkbox.-3. Maintain the tax related information for involved parties.-See Also-Help Document:-External Tax Determination for Goods and Services - Configuration Guide-Keywords-External Tax Determination, Third party Deal, Tax Code

Title: Employees Work Agreement details are missed post Employee Central replication from Sucess Factors to Business ByDesign
Content: Symptom-You observe that the fields Assessment Period and Notice Period in the Employees Work Agreement details are missed post Employee Central replication from Sucess Factors to Business ByDesign-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Master Data Replication work center.-Go to the Employee's view.-Search for the Employee.-Click on the "You Can Also" button and then select the option Open Personnel File.-Navigate to the Employment tab and see the Work Agreement sub-tab view.-The system throws the below message:-Toggle between the different records. You will the values for the Assessment Period and Notice Period are cleared on the DD/MM/YYYY record. This is the date the EC replication is performed.-Cause-The implementation of Employee Replication assumes that SuccessFactors is the system of record for HR data and that BYD is no longer the system of Record for HR. However, the Employee Replication documentation outlines the fields that are mapped from the external system (SF) to BYD via replication requests- Replicated Fields (Mapping) | SAP Help Portal-As you see the fields ‘Probation Period’ and ‘Notice Period’ are not part of the implementation from SF to BYD, as SF is now considered the system of record.Therefore, the attributes outside of the documented list are not considered relevant in BYD Personnel Administration and the data will not be passed to BYD during a replication process.-Resolution-This is a SAP standard system behavior.-Keywords-Employee Replication, Probation Period,  Master Data Replication, Implementation-employee replication,probation period,master data replication,implementation

Title: Error While Adding Travel Expenses Management During Merge New Project From Existing Production Tenant
Content: Symptom-Error:-Negative reimbursement rates maintained. Positive value expected.-Organizational structure XXX is currently inactive; activate the structure.-Environment- SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Organizational Structure XXX is inactive. Active Organizational Structure.-Resolution-Go to Organizational Management work center.-Select Edit Organizational Structures under Common Tasks.-Set the Effective date.-Highlight the Organizational Structure XXX.-Check and Activate .-Keywords- Org Structure, Activate, Inactive-org structure,activate,inactive

Title: System is Returning Different Dates When You do Manual ATP Check and When You Execute The Confirmation Update Run
Content: Symptom-You have set up your system to use the Confirmation Update Run and created a RUN XYZ (XYZ represents the Run ID). When you execute the Run, it updates the Availability of your Demand (Sales Order) with the Date dd.mm.yyyy (dd.mm.yyyy represents a calendar date). However, when you same ATP check manually for the same Demand (Sales Order), the system returns a different date xx.mm.yyyy (xx.mm.yyyy represents a calendar date).-Hence, you would like to understand why the system is behaving this way.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Navigate to the Outbound Logistics Control work center. -Go to the Automated Actions and select Confirmation Update Runs. -Find and select the Run ID: XYZ.-Execute the Run and wait for it to finish.-Find and open the Application Log once the Run has finished running.-Go to the Customer Demand view.-Find the relevant Sales Order.-Select any Line Item and go to the Schedule Lines sub-tab:-Note down the dates on the row Confirmed for: Execution start date, shipment date, delivery date.-Now select all Order Line Items of the Customer Demand.-Click Actions and select Check Availability.-Go to the Schedule Lines sub-tab again and compare the Dates.-You can see the Confirmed Dates differ from the previous Dates that have been updated by the Confirmation Update Run.-Cause-The dates on the confirmed schedule line after the manual Availability Check and the Confirmation Update Run may differ due to the sorting criteria defined in the Run. For instance, you have maintained in the relevant Run various sorting criteria such as Requested Delivery Date, Delivery Priority, Document Creation Date and Items for Complete Delivery First. All of these are taken into consideration when the confirmation Update Run is executed.-Resolution-System is therefore working as designed.-Keywords-Confirmation Update Run, Check Availability, Manual, ATP, Customer Demand, Actions

Title: A Production Request Displays in the Product Planning Screen of its Output Product, but Doesn't Display in the Product Planning Screen of its Input Product.
Content: Symptom-A production request displays in the Product Planning Details screen of its output product as supply, you expect it will also display in the Product Planning Details screen of its input product as dependent demand, but it doesn't.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Supply Planning.-Go to view Products.-Search product XXX (XXX represents the output product ID) in planning area PA_1 (PA_1 represents the ID of planning area), click Open.-In the screen "Product Planning Details: XXX/PA_1", there is a production requests PR_1 (PR_1 represents the ID of production request) as supply.-Supply Planning - Products, search product YYY (YYY represents the input product ID) in planning area PA_1, click Open.-In the screen "Product Planning Details: YYY/PA_1", PR_1 is not displayed.-Cause-In the corresponding production tasks of production request PR_1, the input product YYY has "Confirmation Finished" ticked, you can also see the open quantity is zero.-Resolution-System behaves as designed. If you want PR_1 displays in the screen "Product Planning Details: YYY/PA_1", you can untick "Confirmation Finished" for this input product YYY in related production tasks.-Keywords-Product Planning, Production Request, Dependent Demand

Title: Unable to Release Production Order Due to Error: As per Released Execution Model settings, release is not allowed.
Content: Symptom-When releasing a production order, error triggered:-"Releasing the production order failed------> As per Released Execution Model settings, release is not allowed".-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to work center Production Control.-Go to view Production Orders - By Order Header.-Select production order ABC (ABC represents production order ID), click Release, error triggered:-        "Releasing the production order failed-          -----> As per Released Execution Model settings, release is not allowed".-Cause-Open production order ABC, under tab General, open Released Execution Model, in the section of "Disallow Production Order Release", Release Feasibility Status - Yellow and Release Feasibility Status - Red are checked.-In production order ABC, click button Stock and Demand Overview, "Release Possible" is yellow, because free stock of input product is less than open demand.-        Hence, release production order ABC is not allowed.-Resolution-System works as designed.-Keywords-Production Order, Release, Execution Model, Release Possible, Release Feasibility Status

Title: Budget Planning Upload Error
Content: Symptom-You upload budget planning data and receive the below messages.-Error message: Profit center XXX (Name) is not valid for company ABC on dd.mm.yyyy-Warning message: Fix errors and submit data again.-XXX stands for the profit center ID.-ABC stands for the company ID.-dd.mm.yyyy is the date of the upload.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Cost and Revenue work center.-Go to the Planning view.-Select New > Plan Version from Microsoft Excel.-Select Template Name (for example): "New Expense and Income Statement Plan.-Select Download.-Fill in all the required data.-From the SAP Business ByDesign tab, log into the system.-Press Save Data To.-Below messages appear:-Error message: Profit center XXX (Name) is not valid for company ABC on dd.mm.yyyy-Warning message: Fix errors and submit data again.-Cause-The org unit XXX is not valid as a profit center for the entirety of the year.-You can check this in the Organizational Management work center / Org Structures view.-For example in this case, the Org Unit XXX has been set as a profit center during or later in the year for example from the date 15.07.2022.-Resolution-The Org Unit XXX must be valid as a profit center for the entirety of the year.-Either you change the time line of profit center XXX to begin in January. Or you change the profit center XXX in the plan for a profit center that is valid for the whole year.-Keywords-Plan Data, Budget Plan, Upload Plan Data, Excel Template, Upload Plan Data for Expenses and Income Statement, Chargement des Données Budgétées Pour les Frais et le Compte de Résultat.

Title: Unable to Login into the Tenant Using Other Languages
Content: Symptom-Unable to login using other languages i.e., other than english-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Click on tenant URL -On Login page you will observe only English-Cause-As this might be temporary issue while accessing the login page of the tenant . so, except english you were not able see other languages like hebrew, german etc.-Resolution-Refresh the page or clear cache of the browser and then try to open the tenant URL again-Keywords-other language login,login

Title: Fiscal Year Variant shows Limited/One Value In Set of Books Activity
Content: Symptom-Fiscal Year Variant shows only one value in Value help while creating New Set of Books in Set of Books Fine Tune Activity-Environment- SAP Business By Design-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Business Configuration Work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view -Select the Project and Open Activity List -Search for Activity Set of Books under Integrate and Extend-Open the Activity -Select New> Set of Books -Fiscal Year Variant shows only one value under General Tab-Cause-The Scoping Element Other Fiscal Year needs to be scoped and the Fiscal Year Variants should be added in the Activity Other Fiscal Year-Resolution-You can add New Fiscal Year Variant in Activity Other Fiscal Year by following the below steps :-Go to the Business Configuration Work center-Go to the Implementation Projects view -Select the Project and Open Activity List -Search for Activity Other Fiscal Year-Choose Open-Select New Fiscal Year Variant -You can add the New Fiscal Year Variant and Save-Keywords-Other Fiscal Year, Set of Books, Fiscal Year Variant

Title: Delete settings manually after Collaboration Window is uninstalled
Content: Symptom-When Collaboration Window is used, the corresponding configuration information such as user setting, tenant and so on is saved in user’s registry.-But the setting of registry is not deleted automatically when Collaboration Window is uninstalled. As a result, when Collaboration Window is installed again, the previous setting is still used.-Environment-SAP Business bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-After Collaboration Window is uninstalled, open Registry Editor. Go to HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\SAP\Business ByDesign\Collaboration Window.-The Settings is still there and not deleted.-Cause- The registry data cannot be deleted in our script when Collaboration Window is uninstalled.-Resolution-Please right click Collaboration Window and choose Delete to remove the Collaboration Window settings manually after Collaboration Window is uninstalled.-Keywords-collaboration window, setting, delete, uninstalled

Title: Posted Amount Differs From Cross-Check Balances Amount in Inventory Migration
Content: Message Strip Error-Warning: This Note/KBA is not yet released to customers. Please do not share it with them.-Symptom-INTERNAL USE ONLY-When you are checking inventory migration Cross-Check Balances, you see that the Inventory G/L account balance is aaa.bb ZZZ(aaa.bb represents the cross-check balance amount, ZZZ represents the currency). After successful import, you check the balance in the general ledger and find that the inventory G/L account balance is aaa.cc ZZZ(aaa.cc represents the posted amount, ZZZ represents the currency).-For example, you're migrating inventory of material ABC(ABC represents the material ID). Perpetual Cost Method of Material ABC is Moving Average. Material unit cost is 141856.19 CNY/ 10000 EA.-In the migration file, you entered two lines for the material ABC. One line is 45 EA and one line is 165 EA.-The Cross-Check Balances is 2,978.98 CNY, however, the posted amount is 2,978.97 CNY.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Configuration work center.-Go to Overview view.-Search and open activity Migration of Accounting Transaction Data.-Click on Migrate accounting transaction data using the migration tool.-Select inventory migration relevant title and click on Cross-Check Balances Preview.-You see the balance of Inventroy G/L account is 2,978.98 CNY.-Go to General Ledger work center.-Go to General Ledger Accounts view.-Input required parameters to search out the Inventroy G/L account balance, you see the Account Balance is 2,978.97 CNY.-Cause-One of the reasons is that, there may be stuck XI messages in the backend from Sender Party InventoryProcessing to Receiver Interface Name AccountingInventoryAndActivityAccountingIn.-Resolution-You have to restart the failed XI messages using below steps and verify the G/L Account balance.-Request an L6 Support User and access STFK.-Open transaction SRT_MONI. -Select Processing Status Group Incomplete processing. -Under Sender information, in the Party field enter InventoryProcessing.-Under Receiver Information, in the Receiver Interface Name field enter AccountingInventoryAndActivityAccountingIn. -Press Execute. -You can find failed XI Messages. -Select the message and click on Actions - Restart. -See Also-2812731-Keywords-Posted Amount Differs From Cross-Check Balances Amount in Inventory Migration, Inventroy G/L account balance not zero.-posted amount differs from cross-check b,inventroy g/l account balance not zero

Title: PSM Release Request for Action Close of Business Object PRODUCTION_LOT
Content: Symptom-You request PSM release for Action Close of Business Object PRODUCTION_LOT.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Resolution-Action close is not PSM released.-What you want to achieve is currently not possible via SDK or standard web service ManageProductionLotsIn.-Development team don't have any plans at this time to commit to a date for when this may be available at a future time.-Therefore you need to raise an enhancement request for this.-SAP Business ByDesign Customer Influence Forum： https://influence.sap.com/sap/ino/#/campaign/886-See Also-2455548 - Information Required for PSM Release Requests-Keywords-PSM Release; Business Object; PRODUCTION_LOT; Action; Close.

Title: No Account Name is Showing in the Migrated Sales Order
Content: Symptom-You find that no account name is showing in the Migrated Sales Order.-Environment-SAP BUSINESS BYDESIGN-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Sales Orders Work Center - Sales Orders View-Search for Sales Order ABC (where ABC stands up for Sales Order ID)-You can see No account name is showing in OWL.-Sales Order ABC is a migrated sales order.-Cause-In the migration file, you have maintained the value in the "State" field and "Country" field. If you try to pass new address value of the account to the sales order via migration, the account name maintained in the system will not be determined automatically.-Resolution-This is the current sysem behavior. You can delete the value maintained in the "State" and "Country".-Keywords-Account Name, State, Country, sales order, migration

Title: Unable to Split Absence in Different Lines to Consume Different Time Accounts
Content: Symptom-Trying to split absences in different lines to consume different time accounts as you have several time accounts in your external system and you need to keep the same data between the SAP Business ByDesign and external systems.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Cause-Currently the system does not calculate the summation of the same absence time type, time recordings for the same day.-The times recorded on your external system, at the granularity that you require, will not be able to be replicated in SAP Business ByDesign .-The times will have to be adjusted to allow the save on SAP Business ByDesign.-Resolution-This is Expected Behaviour .-Possible options to get the times to save,-1. Change the work schedule to accommodate the rounding of the time but this may have an impact on how you manage your standard day, other time recordings for financial purposes/ revenue/invoicing etc-2. Change the time recordings to meet the work schedule that already exists .-Keywords-Split absence,Time accounts,Times recorded on your external system-split absence,time accounts,times recorded on your external system

Title: Unable to Retrieve Attachments from Supplier and Customer Using Web Service
Content: Symptom-You have a requirement to retrieve Supplier and Customer attachments through Web Services manageattachmentfolderin does not return any result-Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-Communication Scenario setup with Web Service QueryCustomerIn in combination with ManageAttachmentFolderIn-Communication Scenario setup with Web Service QuerySupplierIn in combination with ManageAttachmentFolderIn-Cause-The cause of the issue that you have configured service ManageAttachmentFolderIn is bound to business objects CUSTOMER and SUPPLIER-Resolution-The attachment folder web service manageattachmentfolderin is very stable. A How-To guide can be found in section "Read Attachments" in this blog: https://blogs.sap.com/2015/10/08/read-and-write-bydesign-attachments-using-web-services/ . The same blog also has a troubleshooting section which also contains specialties of business partner / customer / supplier attachments.-if the web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn returns attachment content for certain business objects but no content for a business partner (customer or supplier) attachment. These are exactly the scenarios described in the "Trouble Shooting" section of the blog.-If you create the communication scenario for web service ManageAttachmentFolderIn in order to read business partner, customer or supplier attachments, you have to enter the business object BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL (BusinessPartner_Template).-Please change the communication scenarios as per above statement. As you can't edit a communication scenario for which a communication arrangement exists, you need to cut that connection first. When editing the communication scenario, the value help does not show the business object BusinessPartner_Template, but you need to manually enter “BUSINESS_PARTNER_TMPL” in field Business Object Proxy Name. Once you have changed your communication scenarios accordingly and use them in a communication arrangement, this should work fine and return attachment content.-  Keywords-manageattachmentfolderin, attachment, business partner, supplier, account

Title: HTTP Status 403 – Forbidden
Content:
Symptom-When you change the authentication method from one of the event notification from "User ID and Password" (Basic Authentication) to "OAuth 2.0". System throws below error message:----HTTP Status 403 – Forbidden----

HTTP Status 403 – Forbidden

---Environment-SAP Business Bydesign-Reproducing the Issue-1. Go to Application and User Management work center-2. Event Notification Monitoring view-Cause-Cause for the issue is the Access Token URL return the token_type as 'Bearer' with uppercase B-Resolution-OAuth 2.0 authentication of Event Notification supports token_type only 'bearer'.-Please generate the access token response, with token_type as 'bearer' starting with lowercase b-In the higher release of SAP Business bydesign, it will be enhanced to consider both 'Bearer' and 'bearer'-Keywords-event notification, bearer, authentication, Oauth 2.0

Title: What is Actual Scrap in the Yield and Scrap report?
Content: Symptom-When you check the Actual Scrap data in the Yield and Scrap report,  scrap quantity does not match.-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to Business Analytics workcenter.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find ID:SCMYASU01_Q0001 ( yield and scrap) report.-Select and open it with a web browser.-Enter the required Production Order ID and Apply.-Here in the results, the actual scrap quantity does not match as expected.-Cause-Actual scrap is calculated based on a formula that involves overall scrap confirmed over the complete process of Production.-Here since the field is aggregated field - may not show you the correct values. The user must refer to the Confirmed Scrap to get the appropriate values.-In order to get the correct relevant values in Actual scrap, the user must capture the scrap only via a Quality check task by end of the Production process.-Resolution-Go to Business Analytics workcenter.-Go to Design Reports view.-Find ID:SCMYASU01_Q0001 ( yield and scrap) report.-Select and open it with a web browser.-Enter the required Production Order ID and choose Apply.-Here in the results, check column: Confirmed Scrap to check the scrap quantity.-Keywords-SCMYASU01_Q0001, yield and scrap, Actual Scrap, scrap quantity, production order, Confirmed scrap, quality check task

Title: Tax Details are Showing Blank in the Delivery Note for Stock Transfer Invoice in Interstate Stock Transfer Scenario
Content: Symptom-You are not able to see the tax amount details under GST columns when you preview the Delivery Note for Inter Stock transfer order.-Country: India-Environment-SAP Business ByDesign-Reproducing the Issue-Go to the Outbound Logistics work center.-Go to the Outbound Deliveries view.-In the Show field, select All Outbound Deliveries by Selection option from the drop down.-Search for the relevant Delivery ID.-Select the Delivery ID and choose the Preview button.-In the preview pdf of the delivery note, you could see that the system does not display tax amount details under GST columns.-Cause-You have maintained the same Tax number for Ship-from Location and Ship-to Location. You can check the information in the below steps:-Go to the Tax Management work center.-Go to the Company Tax Arrangements view.-In the Show field, Select the respective Tax Authority id as per the State maintianed.-Select the respective row and go to Tax Numbers tab-You can check Tax Number maintain for Tax Number Type: GST Identification Number.-System considers as Intrastate stock transfer if the Tax number is same for both Company Tax Arrangements.-You are transferring the stock from one state to another state (Interstate stock transfer) and CGST & SGST are applicable in this scenario if the Tax number is different.-Resolution-You need to maintain the different tax number to calculate GST and to view the tax amount details under GST columns when you preview the Delivery Note.-Tax amount details will show when you create a new STO after maintaining the correct Tax number.-See Also-2917873 - Tax Details Missing in the Delivery Note for Stock Transfer Invoice in Interstate Stock Transfer Scenario-Keywords-Interstate STO, GST Stock transfer, GST details not are not showing in delivery note preview, Tax number
